items.title: Nin Soomaali ah oo loo xiray dilka haweeney Moroccan ah
items.description: Amsterdam (Caasimada Online) – Booliska Netherlands ayaa xiray nin Soomaali ah oo 23 jir ah, kaas oo looga shakisan yahay inuu ku lug lahaa dilka Hajar, oo ahayd haweeney 29 jir ah oo u dhalatay Morocco. Meydka Hajar ayaa laga dhex helay shandad ku jirtay biyaha agagaarka Amsteldijk ee magaalada Amsterdam, kadib markii la waayay horraantii bishan October. Mid ka mid ah ehelkeeda ayaa fiidkii 4-tii October booliska ku wargeliyay maqnaanshaheeda. Isla maalintaas, kaamirooyinka ammaanka ayaa duubay Hajar iyo ninka hadda la xiray, iyagoo wada jooga meel u dhow xarunta RAI ee Amsterdam. Booliska ayaa maalintii xigtay maqnaanshaheeda u aqoonsaday kiis halis sare leh, waxayna bilaabeen dadaallo lagu raadinayo. Markii lagu guuldarreystay in la helo, baarayaasha ayaa 13-kii October baahiyay sawirkeeda, kadib markii ay arrinta kala tashadeen qoyskeeda. Subaxnimadii 16-kii October, qof jidka marayay ayaa biyaha agagaarka Amsteldijk ku arkay shandad uu ku jiray meydka Hajar. Baarayaasha ayaa xaqiijiyay in la dilay, waxayna rumeysan yihiin inay u badan tahay inay geeriyootay wax yar kadib markii la waayay. Booliska ayaa fiidkii 19-kii October ninka Soomaaliga ah su’aalo u weydiiyay isaga oo markhaati ah. Hase yeeshee, baaritaanno dheeraad ah oo la sameeyay subaxdii xigtay ayaa muujiyay suurta-galnimada inuu ku lug lahaa geerideeda. Taasi waxay keentay in boolisku soo saaro wargelin lagu raadinayo. Tuhmanaha ayaa la xiray Talaadadii , markii booliska loogu yeeray dhacdo rabshado wata oo ka dhacday guri ku yaalla degmada Koggenland. Nin uu yaqaanay tuhmanaha ayaa ku dhaawacmay dhacdadaas, waxaana loo qaaday isbitaal si loogu daweeyo. Ninka la xiray wuxuu Netherlands ku noolaa tan iyo sanadkii 2009, wuxuuna sharciga degenaanshaha joogtada ah heystay tan iyo sanadkii 2014. Waxaa hadda lagu hayaa xannibaado u oggolaanaya inuu la xiriiro oo keliya qareenkiisa, halka baarayaashu ay isku dayayaan inay ogaadaan duruufihii ku xeernaa geerida Hajar iyo goobta uu dilku ka dhacay. items.title: Xiisad la sheegay inay ka jirto Degmada Buurhakaba ee Gobolka Baay
items.description: Walaac dhanka amniga ayaa soo food saaray shacabka ku dhaqan Degmada Buurhakaba ee Gobolka Baay, iyadoo ay dhaqdhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeeda ay ka jiraan degmadaasi iyo deegaanada hoostaga. Ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ee 15-kii bishan dagaalka culus kula wareegay degmadaasi ayaa magaalada ka wada diyaargarow ay doonayaan inay uga hortaggaan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ku sii siqaya Buurhakaba. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ay horkacayaan unugyo ka tirsan Kumaandooska Danab iyo Gorgor ayaa u qalab qaatay degmadaasi, iyadoona uu ujeedkoodu yahay in ay ciidamadaasi dib uga qabsadaan degmada istiraatiijiga ah ee Buurhakaba. Xiisadda sii kordheysa iyo hubanti la’aanta amniga ee ka jira Buurhakaba ayaa sababay in dadka deegaanka qaarkood ay isaga barakacaan guryahooda. “Dareenka dadka aad ayuu u kacsan yahay, maxaa yeelay ma rabaan in lagu dul dagaalamo, waxaadna arki kartaa in ciidamadii la wareegay magaaada ay dhufeysyo ka qodanayaan. Marka dadka waxay bilaabeen inay ka qaxaan.” Ayuu yiri mid ka mid ah dadka deegaanka oo aan la hadalnay. Cali Cabdullaahi Cismaan oo goob ganacsi ku haysta magaalada ayaa tilmaamay in dadka deegaanka ay sidoo kale qabaan dareen ku aaddan in duqaymo ay ka dhici karaan magaaladaasi, bacdamaa sida uu sheegay ay mararka qaar maqlaan guuxa diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn oo dulmaraya magaalada. Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi ayaa Khamiistii Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ka sheegay in Degmooyinka Buurhakaba, Berdaale, Qansaxdheere iyo Diinsoor ay qabsadeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, isagoona ku hanjabay in maleeshiyadaasi ay dib uga saari doonaan Degmooyinka Gobolka Baay.

items.title: Galmudug Election Exposes Divisions Within Somalia’s Opposition as Key Leaders Break Ranks
items.description: Opposition figures from Galmudug congratulate the newly elected regional president despite their camp’s longstanding objections that the process lacked consensus and amounted to a unilateral appointment backed by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. Their endorsements raise questions about the opposition’s unity and political credibility. DHUSAMAREB, Somalia (WDN) — Somalia’s opposition camp is facing fresh questions over its unity and consistency after several politicians congratulated Galmudug’s newly elected president, Libaan Ahmed Hassan (Shuluq), despite the opposition’s longstanding criticism that the regional election lacked broad political consensus and was effectively controlled by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration. Among those offering congratulations were former Prime Minister Mohamed Hussein Roble, former Galmudug president Abdikarim Hussein Guled and opposition MP Abdirahman Mohamed Hussein, widely known as Odowaa. All have been associated with opposition political circles, although their statements supporting the new leadership have highlighted differences within the broader camp. Their reactions contrast with the position taken by prominent opposition figures who declined to endorse the election, arguing that the process was one-sided and lacked the political agreement necessary to confer wider legitimacy. For the opposition, the question is not simply whether Liibaan won the parliamentary vote. It is whether a process they have criticized as politically predetermined can be accepted without resolving the objections that helped fuel the standoff with Hassan Sheikh’s government. Opposition Figures Offer Congratulations Roble, who is part of the Salvation Forum leadership, congratulated Liibaan and prayed for his success in carrying out what he described as a heavy responsibility. Guled, a former Galmudug president and member of the Haybad Qaran alliance, also offered warm congratulations. Describing Liibaan as a capable and experienced leader, he expressed confidence that the new president could help Galmudug overcome its difficult circumstances and promote stability and development. Guled called on Galmudug’s political leaders, both government supporters and opposition figures, to welcome the new president in good faith and cooperate with his administration. Odowaa likewise praised Liibaan’s leadership qualities, saying he believed the new president could strengthen unity, social cohesion and understanding among the people of Galmudug. MP Abdiladiif Sanyare also congratulated the newly elected leadership. Separately, the Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP), led by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, welcomed Liibaan’s victory and wished him success in promoting peace, unity and development. The statements were largely framed as expressions of goodwill towards the new regional leadership. Politically, however, they have drawn attention on the broader implications for matters of principle, because they came from figures associated with an opposition environment that has challenged the legitimacy of election arrangements backed by the federal administration. The Central Dispute: Consensus or Appointment? The dispute over Galmudug’s election reflects a wider confrontation between Hassan Sheikh’s government and its opponents over political legitimacy, electoral arrangements and the role of consensus in Somalia’s federal system. Opposition critics have argued that elections conducted without an inclusive political agreement risk becoming exercises in confirming choices already favored by the incumbent leadership. In their view, a parliamentary vote alone cannot resolve the legitimacy dispute if the process leading to it is perceived as one-sided. The opposition’s central grievance has been that Hassan Sheikh’s administration has pursued political arrangements without securing the agreement of its principal opponents. That disagreement has contributed to the broader impasse between the government and opposition leaders. Against that background, the congratulations from several politicians raise an uncomfortable question: if they previously shared or supported objections to the process, what has changed to justify welcoming its outcome? Their statements do not, by themselves, establish that they have formally abandoned the opposition or endorsed every aspect of the election. Nor does congratulating a newly elected leader necessarily mean accepting all the political arrangements behind his victory. But without a clear explanation, the shift risks creating the impression that the opposition’s objections are negotiable when individual political interests are at stake. A Test of Opposition Credibility The contrast between those who congratulated Liibaan and the heavyweight opposition figures who withheld their endorsement could expose divisions within the opposition at a sensitive moment. A political camp challenging the legitimacy of a government’s electoral approach needs a coherent position, clear principles and a credible explanation for any change in stance. Otherwise, the government can point to opposition figures’ own statements to argue that its political process has received wider acceptance than its critics acknowledge. Opposition leaders are therefore entitled to demand clarification from members whose public positions appear inconsistent with the camp’s stated objections. If those politicians no longer accept the opposition’s common position, they should explain their reasoning openly rather than leave supporters to guess whether political principle has given way to individual calculation. Some opposition members may argue that cooperation with the new Galmudug administration is necessary for stability or that congratulating a winner is a customary gesture. Those explanations deserve consideration. But they do not remove the need to address the substantive disagreement over the election process. The opposition should distinguish between recognizing a political outcome and endorsing the process that produced it. It must also decide whether membership in its political camp carries shared commitments or merely provides a loose platform for politicians pursuing separate interests. Liibaan Wins the Vote, but the Political Questions Remain According to the report, Liibaan Axmed Xasan defeated rival candidate Abdulqadir Abdullahi Diiriye, receiving 72 votes to win the Galmudug presidency. Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyarye was elected vice-president with 64 votes. The result establishes the winners of the parliamentary contest, but it does not automatically settle the broader political arguments surrounding the process. The real test will be whether the new administration can build confidence beyond its immediate political supporters, work with rival constituencies and govern in a way that reduces rather than deepens divisions. For Somalia’s opposition, the episode is also a test of political discipline. It cannot convincingly condemn one-sided electoral arrangements while allowing apparent inconsistencies within its own ranks to pass without explanation. The opposition’s credibility depends not only on challenging Hassan Sheikh’s political decisions, but also on demonstrating that its own positions are guided by consistent principles. If prominent members believe the Galmudug election was legitimate after all, they should explain why. If they still believe it lacked consensus, their congratulations require clarification. The issue is not whether political opponents should ever cooperate with a newly elected administration. It is whether the opposition can maintain a coherent position on the rules governing political legitimacy—or whether its public objections can be quietly set aside when individual politicians choose to break ranks. items.title: China counters US position on breakaway African state with Red Sea navigation pledge days after Trump’s Somaliland remarks
items.description: China and Djibouti have reaffirmed Somalia’s territorial integrity and opposed international recognition of Somaliland’s independence, days after US President Donald Trump described the breakaway African territory as “a totally different country ” from Somalia. A composite photo showing Chinese President Xi Jinping, a demonstrator holding the flag of Somaliland, and U.S. President Donald Trump, highlighting growing diplomatic friction between Beijing and Washington over Red Sea strategy and Somaliland’s sovereignty. (Photos: BI Africa) China and Djibouti issued a joint statement reaffirming Somalia’s territorial integrity and opposing international recognition of Somaliland’s independence. This stance comes days after US President Donald Trump described Somaliland as distinct from Somalia, sparking celebrations in Somaliland. China and Djibouti signed a memorandum on security cooperation and called for freedom of navigation in the Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb Strait. The joint communiqué emphasized support for regional sovereignty and addressed security in the Horn of Africa and vital maritime routes. Africa.businessinsider

items.title: Guddoonka barlamanka HirShabelle oo lagu kala baxay iyo Xasan Sheekh oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Wakiillada Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabeelle ayaa doortay guddoon cusub, iyadoo Cabdixakiin Luqmaan Xaaji Maxamed uu mar kale ku guuleystay xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada. Cabdixakiin Luqmaan ayaa helay 77 cod, isaga oo sidaas ku xaqiijiyay inuu sii hoggaamin doono Golaha Wakiillada HirShabeelle. Sidoo kale, Cabdiraxmaan Cabdi Iidoow ayaa loo doortay Guddoomiye ku-xigeenka koowaad ee Golaha Wakiillada HirShabeelle, kaddib markii uu helay 98 cod. Jaamac Cali Maxamuud ayaa isna ku guuleystay xilka Guddoomiye ku-xigeenka labaad ee Baarlamaanka HirShabeelle, isaga oo helay 97 cod oo gacan-taag ah. Doorashada kadib, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa soo saaray dhambaal uu hambalyo ugu dirayo guddoonka cusub ee Golaha Wakiillada HirShabeelle, isaga oo u rajeeyay inay si hufan oo xilkasnimo leh u gutaan waajibaadka loo igmaday. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in kalsoonida ay heleen ay la timid mas’uuliyad u baahan gudasho wanaagsan, isaga oo ku boorriyay inay ka shaqeeyaan horumarinta dowladnimada, xoojinta dimuqraadiyadda iyo dardargelinta howlaha Golaha Wakiillada. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha dowladda, ilaalinta midnimada bulshada iyo xoojinta nabadda iyo horumarka HirShabeelle, si loo ballaariyo adeegyada dowladnimada, loona xaqiijiyo in shacabka ay si xor ah u doortaan hoggaamiyeyaashooda. items.title: Somalia opposition scores own goal over Galmudug election
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s opposition has come under scrutiny after several of its prominent figures congratulated Liban Ahmed Hassan on his election as leaderof Galmudug state, despite having long opposed similar electoral processes conducted under the federal government. Former Prime Minister Mohamed Hussein Roble was among the opposition figures who congratulated Liban and welcomed his election, in a move that has drawn criticism over the opposition’s consistency on electoral matters. The development comes amid escalating tensions between the opposition and the federal government, with the two sides at odds over the country’s electoral process. Opposition leaders have previously denounced similar elections held in Banadir region and South West State by the Mogadishu-based administration of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud through the same electoral body. Their decision to welcome the Galmudug election has therefore raised questions about the apparent discrepancy between their previous objections and their current position. Analysts have described the move as a political own goal, arguing that it could undermine the opposition’s credibility and weaken its efforts to challenge President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s push for an electoral process that could secure his re-election. The perceived inconsistency could present a significant challenge for opposition leaders as they seek to build a coherent position against the president’s electoral agenda. items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo shaacisay boqolleyda dhulka la xoreeyay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay dib ula wareegtay in ka badan 55% dhulkii ay maamulayeen kooxaha Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish, iyadoo in ka badan 1.5 milyan oo qof laga xoreeyay cadaadiska kooxahaas. La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka Soomaaliya, Aweys Xaaji ayaa sheegay in dalka uu horumar weyn ka sameeyay wiiqidda awoodda kooxaha hubeysan iyo dib u soo celinta maamulka dowladda ee deegaannadii ay hore gacanta ugu hayeen. Isagoo ka hadlayay horumarka dhinaca amniga ee shantii sano ee la soo dhaafay, ayuu tilmaamay in hawlgallada milatari ee la qaaday ay suurageliyeen in in ka badan kala bar dhulalkii ay kooxahaasi maamulayeen dib loogu soo celiyo gacanta dowladda. Aweys Xaaji ayaa sidoo kale shaaciyay in maalgelinta kooxaha argagixisadu ay hoos u dhacday 35%, halka dhacdooyinka la xiriira argagixisada ee magaalooyinka waaweyn ee dalka ay yaraadeen qiyaastii 89%, sida uu sheegay. Dhanka kale, la-taliyaha amniga qaranka ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in sugidda amniga Soomaaliya ay si dhow ula xiriirto xasilloonida guud ee gobolka, isaga oo tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta iskaashiga dalalka deriska ah. Wuxuu sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay diyaar u tahay inay dalalka deriska kala shaqeyso la-dagaallanka argagixisada, is-weydaarsiga xogaha sirdoonka iyo sugidda amniga xuduudaha, si looga hortago dhaqdhaqaaqyada kooxaha hubeysan. Sidoo kale, Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay mudnaan siinayso iskaashiga gobolka ee lagula dagaallamayo dambiyada abaabulan ee isaga gudba xuduudaha, iyadoo ku dooday in wada-shaqeynta dalalka gobolka ay muhiim u tahay xaqiijinta amni waara. items.title: After South West State’s Collapse, Jama and Adan Madoobe Seek a Political Settlement
items.description: MOGADISHU (WDN) — Senior Somali political figures are now scrambling to find a negotiated settlement to the escalating crisis in South West State, following territorial gains by forces loyal to former regional president Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. But the late diplomatic push raises a fundamental question: can those who helped create the crisis now repair the damage inflicted on the people they claim to represent? Speaker of the House of the People, Abdikadir Mohamed Nur (Jama), has met a self-appointed peace committee comprising businesspeople, religious leaders and members of the Somali diaspora seeking a way out of the confrontation. Meanwhile, Adan Mohamed Nur, known as Adan Madoobe, who is currently in Mogadishu, has held separate consultations with federal officials and political figures from South West State. The meetings come as the region faces deepening political divisions and military confrontations between forces aligned with Laftagareen and those supporting the administration in Baidoa, which has backing from the Federal Government of Somalia. For residents of South West State, the consequences are no longer confined to political arguments in Mogadishu or Baidoa. The struggle has expanded into a contest over territory, security and the authority to govern communities already burdened by years of instability. Diplomacy After the Damage During his meeting with the peace committee, Speaker Jama reportedly heard proposals concerning state-building, reconciliation, social cohesion and the restoration of peace and stability. He praised the involvement of community representatives in efforts to resolve the crisis. Federal lawmakers also attended the meeting. Adan Madoobe, meanwhile, met on Tuesday the former Southwest State president Sharif Hassan Sheikh Aden to discuss the worsening political and security situation. Their talks reportedly covered reconciliation, political stability, security and efforts to regain districts captured by forces loyal to Laftagareen. The consultations reflect growing concern over the military and political consequences of the confrontation. Reports indicate that Laftagareen-aligned forces have taken control of Qansax Dheere, Bardale, Buurhakaba and Diinsoor, all in Bay region. The administration in Baidoa is reportedly considering a military campaign to recover the areas. The reported territorial changes have increased pressure on political leaders to find a settlement before the confrontation causes further displacement, civilian suffering and institutional breakdown. Yet the timing of the negotiations is striking. Political consultations are intensifying only after the balance of power on the ground has shifted and the crisis has become harder to contain. The Political Responsibility Question For critics of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s approach to federal relations, the Southwest crisis represents a consequence of a broader strategy of political intervention in the affairs of federal member states. They argue that federal power has been used to influence regional leadership disputes rather than build a consensus-based federal system. Within this interpretation, Jama and Adan Madoobe are not simply neutral intermediaries attempting to resolve a crisis. Critics regard them as political actors whose involvement in the confrontation helped undermine Southwest State’s stability, and who are now seeking negotiations after the consequences have become increasingly difficult to manage. These are contested political accusations, and the precise responsibilities of individual leaders must be assessed against documented decisions and actions. Nevertheless, the central question remains legitimate: what responsibility should political leaders bear when their choices contribute to a conflict that later requires emergency negotiations to contain? Negotiation is necessary, but it cannot by itself erase the consequences of earlier decisions. A durable settlement would require more than meetings among senior politicians. It would need credible guarantees for civilians, an end to military escalation, meaningful participation by affected communities and agreement on the political arrangements governing the region. A Crisis That Cannot Be Solved by Force Alone The confrontation exposes the fragility of Southwest State’s political institutions. When competing factions seek to settle disputes through military pressure, the authority of regional institutions weakens, and ordinary residents bear the greatest cost. A military operation to recover lost districts could deepen the crisis if it is launched without credible efforts to prevent civilian harm and establish a political framework for the aftermath. Conversely, a negotiated settlement that merely accommodates the interests of rival elites, without addressing the grievances and fears of local communities, risks postponing rather than resolving the conflict. The Federal Government also faces a test of its commitment to federalism. If Mogadishu is perceived as a partisan participant rather than an impartial facilitator, its ability to mediate will be questioned. Any credible process must therefore include the relevant regional actors and communities, with clear commitments to de-escalation and a political settlement. Accountability Must Follow Reconciliation The latest meetings suggest that political leaders recognize the need to contain the Southwest crisis. But the people of the region have reason to demand more than expressions of concern after violence and territorial losses have already occurred. Jama and Adan Madoobe may now be seeking a negotiated way forward, but the credibility of their efforts will depend on whether they help secure a genuine settlement, protect civilians and address the political decisions that brought the region to this point. Reconciliation should not become a convenient substitute for accountability. Those who exercised political power and influenced the course of the confrontation must be prepared to explain their decisions and face legitimate public scrutiny for their consequences. The people of Southwest State should not be expected to absorb the costs of political maneuvering while those responsible move from confrontation to negotiations without answering difficult questions. The immediate priority is to prevent further bloodshed and restore stability. But lasting peace will require a broader reckoning with how the crisis developed, whose interests were served and how Southwest State can be protected from future political interference. The time for accountability may come through public scrutiny, political processes and lawful institutions. For now, the test is whether these late negotiations can deliver a settlement that serves the people of Southwest State rather than simply rescuing the political fortunes of the leaders involved. items.title: Somalia: UAE carries out reported drone strike against al-Shabab in Puntland
items.description: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has carried out its first reported drone strike against al-Shabab militants in northern Somalia in nearly a year, according to security officials cited by AFP.

items.title: Sawirro: Soomaaliya oo maanta heshiis muhiim ah la saxiixatay dalka…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Shaqada iyo Arrimaha Bulshada ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Prof. Salim Alio Ibro iyo Wasiirka Jinsiga, Shaqada iyo Horumarinta Bulshada ee Uganda, Hon. Lt. Gen. Henry Tumukunde ayaa kala saxiixday heshiis laba-geesood ah oo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada shaqada iyo shaqaaleysiinta. Heshiiskan ayaa ujeeddadiisu tahay nidaaminta shaqaaleysiinta muwaadiniinta labada dal, ilaalinta xuquuqda shaqaalaha iyo xaqiijinta habraacyo shaqaaleysiin oo hufan, caddaalad ah, isla markaana waafaqsan shuruucda labada dal. Sidoo kale, heshiiska ayaa lagu xaqiijinayaa badqabka iyo daryeelka shaqaalaha Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa Uganda, iyadoo la dejinayo hannaan lagu ilaalinayo xuquuqdooda iyo danahooda shaqo. Qodobada heshiiska waxaa ka mid ah qeexidda waajibaadka loo-shaqeeyayaasha iyo habraacyada qandaraasyada shaqada, si loo xaqiijiyo in shaqaaleysiintu u dhacdo si sharci ah oo hufan. Heshiisku wuxuu sidoo kale dhigaya tallaabooyin lagu ilaalinayo shaqaalaha, gaar ahaan ka hortagga tacaddiyada iyo ka faa’iidaysiga sharci-darrada ah, iyadoo la xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha ay khusayso ee labada dal. Dhanka kale, waxaa heshiiska ku jira hannaan wada-shaqayn iyo dabagal oo lagu hubinayo hirgelintiisa, laguna xallinayo khilaafaadka shaqada, iyadoo la raacayo shuruucda iyo xeerarka Soomaaliya iyo Uganda. Heshiiskan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee lagu horumarinayo maamulka suuqa shaqada, lagu ilaalinayo xuquuqda shaqaalaha, laguna ballaarinayo fursadaha shaqo-abuurka iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee dhinaca shaqada. items.title: South West Somalia’s Escalating Conflict: Why Military Victory May Remain Elusive Without a Political Settlement
items.description: Airstrikes in Bakool target Al-Shabaab and forces loyal to former regional president Laftagareen as fighting spreads across Bay and Bakool. With rival forces contesting control of key districts, the crisis risks becoming a protracted conflict unless Mogadishu and its opponents return to negotiations. WAJID, Bakool Region (WDN) — Somalia’s escalating confrontation over South West State is entering a more dangerous phase, with airstrikes reported yesterday near Wajid targeting both Al-Shabaab militants and forces loyal to former regional president Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. The operation underscores the growing complexity of a conflict in which the Federal Government’s struggle to regain territorial control is becoming entangled with a wider political dispute over who governs the region. Somali military officials said the targeted strikes hit locations where fighters had gathered outside Wajid and that the operation had proceeded as planned. They pledged to continue military operations in the area but did not disclose an official casualty figure. The reported losses could not be independently verified. The strikes come amid mounting tensions across Bay and Bakool, where forces aligned with Laftagareen have reportedly seized several districts from the administration led by Adan Mohamed Nur, widely known as Adan Madoobe, which enjoys the backing of the Federal Government of Somalia. The districts reported to have changed hands include Qansax Dheere, Bardale, Buurhakaba and Diinsoor in Bay region. South West State’s authorities have been preparing a counteroffensive to recover the lost territory, raising fears of further clashes. A Political Dispute Turning Into a Military Confrontation What began as a dispute over regional political authority has increasingly become a contest of military strength. The Federal Government is supporting the administration in Baidoa, while Laftagareen’s forces are seeking to reverse the political and territorial changes that followed the breakdown of relations between the rival camps. The latest airstrikes illustrate the difficulty of separating the fight against Al-Shabaab from the struggle between Somali political actors. The reported presence of both militants and Laftagareen-aligned forces among the targets raises questions about the operational environment and the potential consequences for civilians living in affected areas. For residents of Bay and Bakool, the danger is immediate: renewed fighting could disrupt travel, trade, access to essential services and the delivery of humanitarian assistance. Communities already exposed to insecurity may find themselves caught between rival forces as each side seeks to consolidate or recover territory. The situation also presents a broader challenge for Somalia’s federal system. When disputes over political leadership and regional authority are settled through armed confrontation, the damage extends beyond the immediate battlefield. Institutions weaken, local divisions deepen and opportunities for Al-Shabaab to exploit insecurity may increase. How Long Can the Conflict Continue? The central question is no longer simply whether one side can capture a district from the other. It is whether military operations can produce a durable political outcome in a conflict rooted in competing claims to authority. Even if federal-backed forces recover some of the lost districts, territorial gains alone may not resolve the underlying dispute. Likewise, advances by Laftagareen-aligned forces cannot by themselves establish a lasting settlement acceptable to the region’s political stakeholders and communities. Without an agreed political framework, each territorial change risks triggering another counteroffensive. Districts may change hands repeatedly while civilians bear the cost, and the parties may become locked in a cycle of offensives, retreats and renewed mobilisation. The conflict could therefore drag on unless the competing sides agree to a negotiated settlement. Such an outcome is not inevitable, but the risk of prolonged instability grows when military action replaces political dialogue. Negotiations Are the Necessary Way Forward A sustainable resolution requires the Federal Government, South West State’s authorities and Laftagareen-aligned political actors to address the dispute through negotiations rather than relying on force to determine the region’s future. A credible process would need to establish clear terms for de-escalation, address competing political claims, protect civilians and create an agreed path towards legitimate regional governance. Religious leaders, traditional elders, business representatives and other community figures could help facilitate dialogue, provided the process includes the principal parties and produces practical commitments. Military operations against Al-Shabaab raise separate security considerations, but they should not become a substitute for resolving political disagreements among Somali actors. Nor should the struggle over regional authority undermine efforts to protect civilians and maintain security. The airstrikes near Wajid may demonstrate the government’s willingness to continue its campaign, but they do not resolve the political questions driving the wider confrontation. The lesson is stark: political disputes cannot be settled sustainably by armed clashes . Without negotiations, the struggle for South West State could become a prolonged contest in which neither military advances nor territorial losses deliver lasting stability. The urgent priority is to stop the escalation before more districts become battlegrounds. Somalia’s leaders must decide whether the future of South West State will be determined through dialogue and an agreed political process—or through a cycle of violence that risks weakening institutions, displacing civilians and creating further opportunities for Al-Shabaab. The situation also presents a broader challenge for Somalia’s federal system. When disputes over political leadership and regional authority are settled through armed confrontation, the damage extends beyond the immediate battlefield. Institutions weaken, local divisions deepen and opportunities for Al-Shabaab to exploit insecurity may increase. How Long Can the Conflict Continue? The central question is no longer simply whether one side can capture a district from the other. It is whether military operations can produce a durable political outcome in a conflict rooted in competing claims to authority. Even if federal-backed forces recover some of the lost districts, territorial gains alone may not resolve the underlying dispute. Likewise, advances by Laftagareen-aligned forces cannot by themselves establish a lasting settlement acceptable to the region’s political stakeholders and communities. Without an agreed political framework, each territorial change risks triggering another counteroffensive. Districts may change hands repeatedly while civilians bear the cost, and the parties may become locked in a cycle of offensives, retreats and renewed mobilisation. The conflict could therefore drag on unless the competing sides agree to a negotiated settlement. Such an outcome is not inevitable, but the risk of prolonged instability grows when military action replaces political dialogue. Negotiations Are the Necessary Way Forward A sustainable resolution requires the Federal Government, South West State’s authorities and Laftagareen-aligned political actors to address the dispute through negotiations rather than relying on force to determine the region’s future. A credible process would need to establish clear terms for de-escalation, address competing political claims, protect civilians and create an agreed path towards legitimate regional governance. Religious leaders, traditional elders, business representatives and other community figures could help facilitate dialogue, provided the process includes the principal parties and produces practical commitments. Military operations against Al-Shabaab raise separate security considerations, but they should not become a substitute for resolving political disagreements among Somali actors. Nor should the struggle over regional authority undermine efforts to protect civilians and maintain security. The airstrikes near Wajid may demonstrate the government’s willingness to continue its campaign, but they do not resolve the political questions driving the wider confrontation. The lesson is stark: political disputes cannot be settled sustainably by armed clashes . Without negotiations, the struggle for South West State could become a prolonged contest in which neither military advances nor territorial losses deliver lasting stability. The urgent priority is to stop the escalation before more districts become battlegrounds. Somalia’s leaders must decide whether the future of South West State will be determined through dialogue and an agreed political process—or through a cycle of violence that risks weakening institutions, displacing civilians and creating further opportunities for Al-Shabaab. items.title: ‘Null and void:’ Egypt condemns Turkey-Libya maritime deal, reaffirms pact with Greece
items.description: Eastern Libya’s ratification of sweeping Turkish claims rattles eastern Mediterranean Sean Mathews, Middle east Eye Egypt has declared a contentious maritime deal sealed by Turkey and eastern Libya as “null and void, absolutely”, reaffirming its commitment to an agreement it sealed with Greece. Egypt’s foreign ministry on Wednesday “reiterated that the memorandum is null and void, carries no legal effect, and that its ratification by the Libyan House of Representatives entails no legal consequences whatsoever for Egypt”, according to a statement. Egypt’s statement marks a show of support for Greece, a longtime partner in the Eastern Mediterranean, and underscores Cairo’s own reservations about the Turkish agreement, which directly contradicts one it reached with Athens. Turkey’s eastern parliament surprised many on Tuesday by  unanimously approving  a contentious maritime deal with Turkey that it had opposed for years. The agreement was first approved by Libya’s Tripoli-based government in 2019. Eastern Libya is controlled by Khalifa Haftar, a general who previously was at war with Tripoli’s government. Turkey provided weapons, soldiers and mercenaries to help Tripoli defeat Khalifa’s military offensive in 2019. Khalifa was backed by Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt. But in the last several years, Khalifa’s son and heir apparent, Saddam, has forged a closer relationship with Turkey. Saddam welcomed the ratification of the maritime deal in a social media post on Tuesday. Sources tell MEE that Saddam is seeking Ankara’s support for a wider power-sharing deal in Libya with the rulers of Tripoli. Turkey’s 2019 deal with Tripoli unnerved Greece and Egypt, as it would cement sweeping Turkish claims over the Eastern Mediterranean. In response, Greece demarcated its maritime borders with Egypt in 2020, directly contradicting the Turkish deal. Cairo’s rejection of the deal is notable because it is generally seen as close to eastern Libya’s government. When Greece and Egypt demarcated their maritime zones, Egypt and Turkey had rockier relations. In recent years, they have undergone a rapprochement that has seen them cohere on flashpoints like the Horn of Africa. Last year, Greece sought Egyptian support to forestall eastern Libya’s ratification of the maritime deal. An Egyptian delegation visited Athens days ago to confer with Greece on Libya.  Although Egypt was unable to prevent Eastern Libya’s ratification of the agreement, Cairo’s statement will be welcomed in Athens. Why is the Turkish-Libya maritime deal controversial  Several components make up Greece and Turkey’s decades-old maritime feud. Under international law, countries are generally permitted to claim up to 12 nautical miles of sovereign territory at sea or up to a median line when maritime claims overlap. Greece has not done so in the Aegean, where it has hundreds of islands, because in 1995 Turkey’s parliament declared that extending its territorial waters would constitute a “casus belli”,or reason for war. The dispute involving Libya pertains to Exclusive Economic Zones (EEZ), the maritime space up to 200 nautical miles from territorial waters where a country has the right to exploit subsea resources like fishing and fossil fuels. Greece asserts that its islands are entitled to EEZs, while Turkey denies this. The maritime deal Greece signed with Egypt recognised Greek EEZs around large islands like Rhodes and Crete, home to hundreds of thousands of Greeks, but stopped short of doing so for smaller islands like Kastellorizo, which is just 12 square kilometers.  Egypt said it wanted to leave room for negotiations with Turkey.  Greece has long stated that it is prepared to negotiate its EEZ and continental shelf with Turkey at the International Court of Justice, but will not negotiate over its islands’ sovereign territory such as airspace and waters. Turkey has rejected this offer.  Greece is a signatory to the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), which governs ocean use, but Turkey is not. Egypt was not the only country in the Eastern Mediterranean to condemn Turkey’s deal with Libya. Israel’s foreign ministry said on Wednesday that Turkey was “working to destabilise the east Mediterranean region”. Greece and Israel do not have a maritime demarcation agreement. Eastern Libya’s parliament ratified the maritime agreement just weeks after Saddam met Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in the UAE, Middle East Eye and other outlets reported. The EU also condemned the Turkish-Libya deal as violating UNCLOS. Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan responded to the criticism on Wednesday. “There are countries reacting to this. We know why they are reacting. Some are doing so because they need to; some really do have strategic problems with this issue. However, this is an entirely legitimate deal, both from a legal and a statutory perspective. There is no need to argue this,” he said. Source. items.title: Puntland Civil Servants Left Unpaid for Months as Salary Crisis Becomes the Norm
items.description: Government employees reportedly went eight months without pay this year, raising fears that prolonged salary delays could push an already strained civil service towards a breaking point. GAROWE, Puntland (WDN) — Puntland’s civil servants are facing mounting financial hardship after going for months without salaries, according to officials from the regional Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs, who have warned that prolonged non-payment could lead employees to abandon their posts. WardheerNews has reported in August 31, 2026 , that “What began as delayed payments has evolved into a prolonged hardship for civil servants and their families, raising growing concerns about the government’s failure to honor its basic obligations to the people who keep its institutions running.” The situation is becoming increasingly troubling, as civil servants have gone without salaries for more than a year and are growing increasingly vocal in demanding answers and accountability from the government. The minister and deputy minister of Labour and Social Affairs told Puntland Parliament’s Social Affairs Committee that government employees had not received their salaries since the beginning of the fighting in the Calmiskaad Mountains. They expressed concern that workers could eventually leave their jobs if the situation continued. The officials said responsibility for paying government salaries rests with Puntland’s Ministry of Finance, leaving their ministry unable to resolve the problem directly. But the salary crisis appears to extend well beyond the latest security operations. Civil servants have reportedly endured repeated and prolonged payment delays for much of the past four years or longer. This year, some employees reportedly went eight consecutive months without receiving their salaries, while previous years were marked by similar difficulties. What should be an exceptional administrative failure has increasingly become a pattern of life for government employees—one that threatens household stability, public service delivery and confidence in Puntland’s institutions. Families Paying the Price For civil servants, months without wages mean far more than a delayed payment on a government ledger. Employees must still pay rent, cover school fees, buy food, meet transport costs and support their families, regardless of whether the government pays them. Prolonged salary arrears can leave workers dependent on relatives, borrowing or other informal sources of support. Families with children in school face the risk of falling behind on fees, while tenants may struggle to keep their homes. The uncertainty also makes it difficult for employees to plan even the most basic household expenses. The burden falls especially heavily on workers whose government salaries are their principal source of income. Unlike senior officials who may have other resources, many ordinary employees have little financial protection when wages stop arriving for months at a time. The result is a growing question of fairness: how can a government expect its employees to report for duty, serve the public and maintain essential institutions when it repeatedly fails to meet its most basic obligation to pay them? Security Pressures Cannot Become a Permanent Excuse Puntland officials have previously cited the financial burden of fighting militant groups, including operations in the Camiskaad Mountains, as a reason for pressure on public finances. Security operations are costly, and the government may face genuine budgetary constraints. However, a prolonged salary crisis requires more than explanations. Employees cannot indefinitely absorb the cost of the government’s financial difficulties, particularly when non-payment becomes a recurring feature rather than a temporary emergency. The Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs’ warning that workers may abandon their jobs should be treated seriously. If unpaid employees begin leaving public service or reducing their availability, the consequences could extend to schools, health facilities, administrative offices and other essential services. A civil service cannot function effectively on promises alone. Regular salaries are essential to retaining qualified staff, maintaining morale and ensuring continuity in government operations. An Urgent Test for Puntland’s Government Puntland’s authorities need to address the crisis through a transparent plan that establishes the full amount of outstanding salary arrears, identifies the resources available for payment and sets a credible timetable for settling the debt. The Ministry of Finance should explain the scale of the arrears and the reasons for repeated delays, while the government should make clear how future salaries will be protected from prolonged interruptions. Parliament, in turn, has a responsibility to scrutinise the budget and demand concrete answers from the relevant ministries. If the government cannot pay all outstanding salaries immediately, it should communicate openly with employees and provide a realistic payment schedule rather than leave families in indefinite uncertainty. The warning signs are clear: Puntland cannot expect its civil servants to remain indefinitely patient while their livelihoods deteriorate . Eight months without pay is not a minor administrative delay; if confirmed across affected employees, it represents a serious failure of public financial management with direct human consequences. The government must act before frustration turns into widespread absenteeism, resignations or the collapse of morale across public institutions. Civil servants have families to feed and obligations to meet. Paying them is not an act of generosity—it is a fundamental responsibility of government. Puntland’s leadership should treat the salary crisis as an urgent matter of public accountability and human dignity. If the practice continues, the consequences will be borne not only by unpaid employees but also by the citizens who depend on the services they provide. items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo dhambaal culus u diray Liibaan kadib doorashadii Galmudug
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa hambalyo u diray Hoggaamiyaha cusub ee Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, Liibaan Axmed Xasan iyo ku-xigeenkiisa, Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyare oo maanta ay xubnaha Golaha Wakiillada ku doorteen magaalada Dhuusamareeb. Madaxweynaha ayaa labada mas’uul ugu hambalyeeyey kalsoonida ay ka heleen xubnaha Golaha Wakiillada, isaga oo u rajeeyey inay ku guuleystaan gudashada waajibaadka loo igmaday. Xasan Sheekh ayaa hoggaanka cusub kula dardaarmay inay mudnaanta koowaad siiyaan ilaalinta nabadgelyada, xal u helidda colaadaha sokeeye iyo xoojinta midnimada bulshada Galmudug. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ku boorriyey inay xoogga saaraan horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha iyo adeegyada bulshada, si wax looga qabto baahiyaha jira loona xaqiijiyo horumar waara. Madaxweynaha ayaa doorashada hoggaanka cusub ku tilmaamay mid taariikhi ah, maadaama ay qayb ka ahaayeen boqollaal kun oo qof oo ku kala nool magaalooyinka waaweyn iyo deegaannada miyiga ah ee Galmudug. Wuxuu sheegay in ka-qaybgalka shacabka uu muujinayo doorka ay muwaadiniintu ku leeyihiin geeddi-socodka dimuqraadiyeynta iyo dhismaha dowladnimada. Ugu dambeyntiina, Xasan Sheekh ayaa Alle uga baryey Liibaan Axmed Xasan iyo Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyare inuu u fududeeyo mas’uuliyadda culus ee loo igmaday, si ay uga mira-dhaliyaan himilooyinka shacabka Galmudug ee ku aaddan nabadda, dowladnimada iyo horumarka. The post Xasan Sheekh oo dhambaal culus u diray Liibaan kadib doorashadii Galmudug appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Muxuu Muungaab ka yiri doorashada hoggaanka cusub ee Galmudug?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) ayaa hambalyo u diray Hoggaamiyaha cusub ee Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, Mudane Liibaan Axmed Xasan iyo Ku-xigeenkiisa, Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyare, oo maanta oo khamiis ah lagu doortay magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee xarunta gobolka Galgaduud. Muungaab oo hoggaanka cusub ee Galmudug u rajeeyay guul iyo horumar ayaa sidoo kale u mahadceliyay Guddiga Madax-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka iyo Soohdimaha oo si habsami leh u agaasimay doorashada, isaga oo ku bogaadiyay doorkooda ku aaddan hirgelinta hannaanka doorashooyin hufan iyo xoojinta dowlad-dhiska. Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa sidoo kale adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta iskaashiga Dowladda Federaalka, dowlad goboleedyada iyo Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, si loo dardargeliyo nabadda, midnimada iyo horumarka dalka. Hambalyada Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ayaa kusoo aaday, iyadoo maanta isbeddal wayn uu ka dhacay Galmudug, kadib markii hoggaanka cusub ee maamulkaasi ay ku guuleysteen Madaxweyne Liibaan Axmed Xasan iyo ku xigeenkiisa Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyarye. items.title: Somalia: Key Laftagaren ally survives alleged Turkish drone strike
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Hassan Abdulkadir, the former internal security minister of Southwest State and a key figure behind Laftagaren’s forces, escaped unharmed from an alleged Turkish drone strike on Wednesday night, as his forces continued to consolidate their hold over much of the Bay region wrested from the federal government. Local media reports said two members of Laftagaren’s forces were killed when their motorcycle was struck. Abdulkadir and Mustafa Qoomaal, a military figure affiliated with the forces, survived unscathed. It remains unclear whether the strike was intended to assassinate Abdulkadir, who is believed to be the principal strategist behind the guerrilla campaign waged by Laftagaren’s forces since the former regional president was ousted in a federal government offensive in March. Abdulkadir has made appearances in most of the towns recently recaptured by Laftagaren’s forces, including Qansah-dhere, Burhakabo and Dinsor. The strike marks the second air raid on a Somali opposition politician. On September 3, Gen. Mahad Abdirahman, a former chief of the Somali Custodial Corps, was injured but survived an F-16 airstrike on his home in Dolow, near the Ethiopian border. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Qoor Qoor oo caddeeyay mowqifkiisa kadib doorashadii ka dhacday Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoor Qoor) ayaa war-saxaafadeed uu soo saaray ku caddeeyay mowqifkiisa ku aaddan doorashadii maanta ka dhacday magaalada caasimada ah ee Dhuusamareeb, taas oo Madaxweynaha cusub ee Galmudug loogu doortay Mudane Liibaan Axmed Xasan, halka Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyare isna loo doortay madaxweyne ku-xigeenka maamulkaasi. Liibaan oo muddo dheer kusoo jiray olole xooggan ayaa la tartamay musharrax Cabdulqaadir Cabdullahi Diiriye oo uu ugu dambeyn kaga guuleystay tartanka doorashada Galmudug, isaga oo kusoo baxay cod aqlabiyad leh, wuxuuna helay 72 cod, halka madaxweyne ku xigeenka cusub ee Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyarye uu helay 64 cod, iyada oo guushooda ay isbeddal maamul ka dhalisay Galmudug. Qoor Qoor ayaa soo dhaweeyay guusha Madaxweynaha cusub iyo ku xigeenkiisa, isaga oo ugu hambalyeeyay mas’uuliyadda culus loo igmaday. “Waxaan hambalyo u dirayaa Mudane Liban Axmed Xasan oo ku guulaystay hoggaaminta Galmudug shanta sano ee soo socota iyo Mudane Cabdiwali Ibraahim Aadan oo isaguna ku guulaystay xilka hoggaamiye ku-xigeenka. Waxaan Alle uga baryayaa inuu u fududeeyo masuuliyadda culus ee ay dusha saareen, kuna garab galo gudashada waajibaadka ka saaran shacabka iyo deegaannada Galmudug,” ayuu yiri Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoor Qoor). Sidoo kale, wuxuu farriin u diray dhammaan shacabka Galmudug, isaga oo ugu baaqay inay la shaqeeyaan hoggaanka cusub ee maanta lagu doortay magaalada Dhuusamareeb. “Waxaan sidoo kale ugu baaqayaa dhammaan reer Galmudug inay garab istaagaan hoggaanka cusub, si wadajir ahna looga shaqeeyo xoojinta midnimada, dib-u-heshiisiinta, nabadda iyo horumarka Galmudug,” ayuu mar kale yiri Madaxweynihii hore ee Galmudug. Dhinaca kale, Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa hambalyo u diray hoggaamiyaha la doortay ee Galmudug, Mudane Liibaan Axmed Xasan iyoku-xigeenkiisa Mudane Cabdiweli Ibraahim Aadan (Garyare). Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa hoggaanka cusub ee Dowladda Galmudug ugu hambalyeeyay xilalka muhiimka ah ee loo doortay, isaga oo u rajeeyay guul iyo horumar ku aaddan gudashada waajibaadka culus ee loo doortay. “Waxaan hambalyo iyo duco u dirayaa hoggaamiyaha la doortay ee Dowladda Galmudug, Mudane Liiban Axmed Xasan iyo Hoggaamiye Ku-xigeenka Mudane Cabdweli Ibraahim Aadan (Garyare) oo maanta Golaha Wakiillada Dowladda Galmudug u doorteen hoggaanka cusub ee Dowladda Galmudug. Waxaan Alle uga baryayaa in uu ku guuleeyo masuuliyadda culus ee loo igmaday, kuna garab galo gudashada waajibaadkooda, si ay u horseedaan horumar, nabad, midnimo iyo dowladnimo waarta oo ay ka faa’iideystaan shacabka reer Galmudug,” ayuu yiri Aadan. Waxaa kale oo uu sii raaciyay “Sidoo kale waxaan u rajeynayaa hoggaanka cusub in ay ku guuleystaan xoojinta wadajirka, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, iyagoo ka shaqeynaya danta guud iyo mustaqbalka wanaagsan ee shacabka Galmudug”. items.title: Libaan Ahmed Hassan Elected Galmudug Leader for Five-Year Term
items.description: DHUSAMAREB — Members of the Galmudug State Parliament on Thursday elected Libaan Ahmed Hassan as the regional administration’s new leader for a five-year term, following a vote held at the parliamentary headquarters in Dhusamareb. Libaan secured 72 votes, defeating his rival, Abdulkadir Abdullahi Dirie, who received 14 votes. Three ballots were declared invalid, according to the results announced by Galmudug Parliament Speaker Hussein Mohamed Nur. Officials from Somalia’s Federal Government, the National Independent Electoral Commission and other dignitaries attended the election. Libaan, a member of the Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP), which is affiliated with the Federal Government, will succeed Ahmed Abdi Kariye, widely known as Qoor Qoor, who remains in office but did not contest the election. The outcome had been widely anticipated, with Libaan considered the frontrunner ahead of the vote. His election comes as Galmudug prepares for a leadership transition, with attention expected to focus on the new administration’s priorities and its relationship with the Federal Government. items.title: Somalia Government Seeks 15-Day Extension in Constitutional Lawsuit
items.description: The Federal Government of Somalia has asked the Supreme Court for an additional 15 days to respond to a lawsuit challenging the country’s new Constitution, filed by former President Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed. The request was submitted on Thursday, October 22, the deadline set by the court for the government to present its legal defence. The government is seeking an extension until November 7, 2026, to prepare its response. The request, filed by the government’s Attorney General, is awaiting a decision by the Supreme Court. The court has yet to announce whether it will grant the extension. The lawsuit concerns the constitutional amendment process pursued by the federal government, which Sheikh Sharif has challenged on legal and procedural grounds. He has asked the Supreme Court to rule on the disputed constitutional issues. The case comes amid ongoing political disagreements over the new Constitution and the process through which it was amended. The court’s decision on the government’s request will determine the timeline for the next stage of the proceedings. items.title: Mucaaradka oo si weyn usoo dhaweeyay doorashada hoggaamiyaha cusub ee Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Qaar kamid ah xubnaha siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ayaa si weyn usoo dhaweeyay doorashadii ka dhacday maamulka Galmudug oo ay kusoo baxay Liibaan Axmed Xasan iyo Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyarye, kadib markii loo doortay madaxweynaha cusub ee maamulkaasi. Raiisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Xuseen Rooble oo kamid ah hoggaanka Madasha Samatabixinta ayaa hambalyo u diray Madaxweynaha cusub ee Galmudug, isaga oo u rajeeyay inuu Eebbe u fududeeyo mas’uuliyada culus loo igmaday. “Waxaan halkaan hambalyo uga dirayaa Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo maanta loo doortay Madaxwaynaha cusub ee Galmudug . Waxaan ugu ducaynayaa in Allah u fududeeyo masuuliyadda culus ee uu qaaday,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul wasaare Rooble. Madaxweynihii hore ee Galmudug Cabdikariin Xuseen Guuleed, haddana kamid ah Isbahaysiga Haybad Qaran ayaa isaguna hambalyo diiran u diray Madaxweynaha la doortay Liibaan Axmed Xasan, wuxuuna sheegay in Liibaan uu yahay hoggaamiyiihii loo baahna ee xilligan lagu jiro marxalada adag ka saari kara Galmudug. “Hambalyo mudane Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo maanta Baarlamaanka Galmudug ay u doorteen Madaxweynaha dowlad gobaleedka Galmudug. Madaxweyne Liibaan oo ah qof aan aqoon dheer u leeyahay, islana soo shaqeynay, waxaan ku aqaana inuu yahay masuul wax-garad ah, miisaaman, oday ah, karti badan, wax quur leh, xog ogaal buuxana u ah dadka iyo deegaanka loo doortay. Waxaana aaminsanahay inuu yahay hogaamiyahii loo baahna ee marxaladan adag Galmudug ka saari lahaa, horumar iyo xasiloonina gaarsiin lahaa,” ayuu yiri Guuleed. Sidoo kale, wuxuu sii raaciyay “Waxaan kula dardaarmayaa una soo jeedinayaa waxgaradka iyo masuuliinta kala duwan ee Galmudug ka soo jeeda MUCAARAD iyo MUXAAFADBA in Madaxweynaha cusub si niyo sami leh loo soo dhaweeyo, loolana shaqeeyo . Madaxweynaha la doortay waxaan u rajeynayaa in Allah ku guuleeyo kuna garab galo gudashada waa jibaadkiisa”. Dhankiisa, Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Xuseen (Odowaa) oo kamid ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ayaa taageero u muujiyay Madaxweynaha cusub ee Galmudug, wuxuuna kula dardaarmay inuu xoogga saaro xoojinta midnimada iyo wadajirka bulshada reer Galmudug. “Hambalyo Madaxweynaha cusub ee Dowlad-Goboleedka Galmudug, Mudane Liiban Ahmed Hassan LIIBAN AHMED HASSAN waa shaqsi aan aqoon fiican u leeyahay, kuna tilmaami karo qof leh karti, aragti iyo awood uu bulshada isugu keeni karo. Waxaan aaminsanahay inuu door muuqda ka qaadan karo xoojinta midnimada, wadajirka iyo is-afgaradka bulshada Galmudug. Waxaan kuu rajeynayaa in Alle kuu fududeeyo xilka culus ee laguu igmaday, kuna asturo masuuliyadda aad qaaday,” ayuu isna yiri Cabdiraxmaan Odowaa. Xildhibaan Cabdiladiif Sanyare oo isaguna u hambalyeeyay hoggaanka cusub ee Galmudug, wuxuuna yiri “Hambalyo Hambalyo Hambalyo. Waxaan u hambalyaynayaa guusha uu garay Madaxweynaha cusub ee Galmudug Libaan Axmed Xassan. Xilka culus allah hakuu fududeeyo”. Marka laga soo tago mucaaradka waxaa sidoo kale doorashada Liibaan Axmed Xasan ka hadlay xisbiga uu ka tirsan yahay ee JSP, ee uu hoggaamiyo madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kaas oo soo dhaweeyay guusha uu ka gaaray doorashada Maamulka Galmudug. “Urur Siyaasadeedka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) wuxuu hambalyo u dirayaa Mudane Liibaan Axmed Xasan, oo loo doortay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Waxaan Alle uga baryeynaa inuu ku asturo xilka loo igmaday, kuna guuleysto xaqiijinta nabadda, midnimada iyo horumarka shacabka Galmudug,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal usoo saaray xisbiga. Si kastaba, Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo muddo dheer kusoo jiray olole xooggan ayaa la tartamay musharrax Cabdulqaadir Cabdullahi Diiriye oo uu ugu dambeyn kaga guuleystay tartanka doorashada Galmudug, isaga oo kusoo baxay cod aqlabiyad leh, wuxuuna helay 72 cod, halka madaxweyne ku xigeenka uu isna kusoo baxay Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyarye oo helay 64 cod, iyada oo guushooda ay isbeddal maamul ka dhalisay Galmudug. Madaxweynaha la doortay waxaan u rajeynayaa in Allah ku guuleeyo kuna garab galo gudashada waa jibaadkiisa”. Dhankiisa, Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Xuseen (Odowaa) oo kamid ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ayaa taageero u muujiyay Madaxweynaha cusub ee Galmudug, wuxuuna kula dardaarmay inuu xoogga saaro xoojinta midnimada iyo wadajirka bulshada reer Galmudug. “Hambalyo Madaxweynaha cusub ee Dowlad-Goboleedka Galmudug, Mudane Liiban Ahmed Hassan LIIBAN AHMED HASSAN waa shaqsi aan aqoon fiican u leeyahay, kuna tilmaami karo qof leh karti, aragti iyo awood uu bulshada isugu keeni karo. Waxaan aaminsanahay inuu door muuqda ka qaadan karo xoojinta midnimada, wadajirka iyo is-afgaradka bulshada Galmudug. Waxaan kuu rajeynayaa in Alle kuu fududeeyo xilka culus ee laguu igmaday, kuna asturo masuuliyadda aad qaaday,” ayuu isna yiri Cabdiraxmaan Odowaa. Xildhibaan Cabdiladiif Sanyare oo isaguna u hambalyeeyay hoggaanka cusub ee Galmudug, wuxuuna yiri “Hambalyo Hambalyo Hambalyo. Waxaan u hambalyaynayaa guusha uu garay Madaxweynaha cusub ee Galmudug Libaan Axmed Xassan. Xilka culus allah hakuu fududeeyo”. Marka laga soo tago mucaaradka waxaa sidoo kale doorashada Liibaan Axmed Xasan ka hadlay xisbiga uu ka tirsan yahay ee JSP, ee uu hoggaamiyo madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kaas oo soo dhaweeyay guusha uu ka gaaray doorashada Maamulka Galmudug. “Urur Siyaasadeedka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) wuxuu hambalyo u dirayaa Mudane Liibaan Axmed Xasan, oo loo doortay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Waxaan Alle uga baryeynaa inuu ku asturo xilka loo igmaday, kuna guuleysto xaqiijinta nabadda, midnimada iyo horumarka shacabka Galmudug,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal usoo saaray xisbiga. Si kastaba, Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo muddo dheer kusoo jiray olole xooggan ayaa la tartamay musharrax Cabdulqaadir Cabdullahi Diiriye oo uu ugu dambeyn kaga guuleystay tartanka doorashada Galmudug, isaga oo kusoo baxay cod aqlabiyad leh, wuxuuna helay 72 cod, halka madaxweyne ku xigeenka uu isna kusoo baxay Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyarye oo helay 64 cod, iyada oo guushooda ay isbeddal maamul ka dhalisay Galmudug. items.title: Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo ku guuleystay doorashada madaxtinimada Galmudug
items.description: Liibaan Axmed Xasan ayaa maanta loo doortay in uu noqdo Hoggaamiyaha xiga ee Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, isagoona codad badan kaga guuleystay musharaxii la tartamayay oo lagu magacaabo Cabdiqaadir Cabdullaahi Diiriye. Doorashadan oo ka dhacday Magaalada Dhuusamareeb, isla-markaana ay wax dooranayeen Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Galmudug ayuu Liibaan Axmed Xasan helay 72 cod, halka Cabdiqaadir Cabdullaahi Diiriye uu helay 14 cod, sida uu ku dhawaaqay Gudoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Galmudug, Xuseen Maxamed Nuur. “Codadka halaabay waa saddex, tirada codadka ansaxayna waa 86 cod. Cabdullaahi Cabdullaahi Diiriye wuxuu helay 14 cod. Liibaan Axmed Xasan wuxuu helay 74 cod, sidaasi darteed waxaa guuleystay Liibaan.” Ayuu yiri Gudoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Galmudug. Codeyntan ayaa waxaa ka qayb qaatay dhammaan Xildhibaanada Golaha Wakiilada Galmudug oo ka kooban 89 Xildhibaan, sida ku cad natiijada codbixinta. Dhanka kale Xildhibaanada ayaa Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyare u doortay Hoggaamiye Kuxigeenka Galmudug. Doorashadan oo ka dhacday Xarunta Baarlamaanka Galmudug ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay oo goobjoog ka ahaa Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan, Wasiiro iyo Xildhibaano ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka iyo Gudoomiye Kuxigeenka Amniga & Siyaasadda ee Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, Maxamed Axmed Diiriye (Yabooh). Hoggaanka cusub ee la doortay ayaa shanta sano ee soo socota hoggaamin doona Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug.

items.title: Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo loo doortay Madaxweynaha Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Liibaan Axmed Xasan ayaa goordhow kusoo baxay doorashadii ka dhacday magaalada Dhuusamareeb, isaga oo si rasmi ah loogu doortay Madaxweynaha cusub ee Dowlad-goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee Galmudug. Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo muddo dheer olole xooggan kusoo jiray ayaa la tartamay musharrax Cabdulqaadir Cabdullahi Diiriye oo uu ugu dambeyn kaga guuleystay tartanka doorashada Galmudug. Sidoo kale, Liibaan ayaa kusoo baxay cod aqlabiyad leh, wuxuuna helay 72 cod, halka musharraxa kalena uu helay 14 cod, sidaas wuxuu ku noqday Madaxweynaha cusub ee Galmudug ee beddalay Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoor Qoor). Natiijada doorashadan ayaa lasii ogaa, maadaama uu Liibaan Axmed Xasan uu taageero wayn ka haystay Villa Somalia, oo iyadu galaangal xooggan ku leh arrimaha Galmudug. Dhanka kale, waxaa Madaxweyne ku xigeenka Galmudug loo doortay Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyarye oo isna ka tirsan xisbiga JSP, wuxuuna helay 64 Cod, halka musharaxii la tartamayay Cabdisataar Maxamed Geelle uu helay 20 Cod, sida uu shaaciyay guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug oo ku dhawaaqay natiijada doorashada. Si kastaba, Kala baxa doorashada Maamul-goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee Galmudug ayaa kusoo aadayo xilli xasaasi ah, iyadoo mucaaradka ay horay u diideen qaabka loo mareeyay doorashooyinkii horay uga dhacay Koonfur Galbeed iyo gobolka Banaadir. Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirto marxalad adag oo ka dhalatay xiisad culus oo ku aadan sida ay Villa Somalia u wajahayso doorashooyinka heer feederaal iyo heer dowlad-goboleed oo ay diidan yihiin mucaaradka. The post Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo loo doortay Madaxweynaha Galmudug appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: UN agency warns nearly 874,000 could be displaced by floods in Somalia
items.description: Nearly 874,000 people could be displaced in Somalia over the next three months as heavy rainfall and rising rivers threaten communities already affected by drought and repeated displacement, the UN migration agency warned Wednesday. In a statement, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) said projections developed with the Danish Refugee Council estimate that 874,319 people could be displaced between October and December, with flooding accounting for 92% of the total. “We are looking at the possibility of hundreds of thousands of people losing their homes in just a matter of weeks,” said Manuel Marques Pereira, IOM Somalia chief of mission. The warning comes as Somalia enters a rainy season forecast to bring above-normal rainfall amid strengthening El Nino conditions. IOM said it has secured only 14.4% of the $16.62 million required to prepare for and respond to flooding, with the funding intended to assist more than 517,000 people. Beletweyne and Gaalkacyo face particularly “greatest threat,” with nearly 229,000 and 82,000 people, respectively, at risk of displacement. The agency said rising river levels and heavy rainfall are already threatening communities, while flooding could destroy crops, contaminate water sources and disrupt access to healthcare. IOM urged immediate international funding to strengthen early warning systems, prepare evacuation routes and provide emergency shelter, clean water and sanitation. Anadolu.

items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo tallaabo u qaaday xoreynta degmada Buurhakaba + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) oo haatan ku sugan magaalada Muqdisho ayaa la kulmay siyaasiyiinta ka soo jeeda Degmada Buurhakaba ee ku metela Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, kuwaas oo uu hoggaaminayey Wasiiru Dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Saadad Caliyoow, isaga oo kala hadlay dib u xoreynta degmadaasi. Inta uu socday kulanka ayaa waxaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda guud ee Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan arrimaha amniga, xaaladda siyaasadeed, nabadeynta bulshada deeganka. Sidoo kale, waxaa kulanka lagu soo qaaday dadaallada lagu doonayo dib-u-xoreynta degmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Baay, oo maalmo ka hor ay qabsadeen ciidamada taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Waxaa kale oo ay labada dhinac ka wada-hadleen muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta wada-shaqeynta iyo isku-duwidda dadaallada lagu wajahayo xaaladda ka jirta degmada, sidii loo dardargelin lahaa qorshayaasha dib-u-xoreynta, loona xaqiijin lahaa nabadgelyada iyo xasilloonida bulshada deegaanka. Aadan Madoobe iyo siyaasiyiinta uu la kulmay ayaa sidoo kale adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in la mideeyo dadaallada siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni, si loo garab istaago bulshada Degmada Buurhakaba loona abuuro jawi horseeda nabad waarta, dib-u-heshiisiin iyo dib-u-dhiska adeegyada aasaasiga ah. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa haatan qorseyneysa inay qaado guluf ka dhan ah ciidanka taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ee qabsaday degmooyinka Qansaxdeere, Bardaale, Buurhakaba iyo Diinsoor oo ka wada tirsn gobolka Baay. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa kusoo aaday xi lli ay haatan sii xoogeysanayaan khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen iyo kuwa taageersan maamulka hadda ka jira Baydhaba, oo garab ka helaya Dowladda Federaalka.   The post Aadan Madoobe oo tallaabo u qaaday xoreynta degmada Buurhakaba + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Imaaraadka Carabta oo haweeney diblomaasi ah u soo xulay tartanka xilka Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay
items.description: Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa Lana Nusseibeh, oo hore dalkiisa ugu matashay Qaramada Midoobay, u magacaabay musharrax u tartamaya xilka Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, si ay ugu beddesho António Guterres oo muddadiisa labaad ay ka harsan yihiin wax ka yar saddex bilood. Lana Nusseibeh ayaa ah wasiir ku-xigeenka arrimaha dibadda ee Imaaraadka Carabta, waxayna in ka badan toban sano dalkaas safiir uga ahayd Qaramada Midoobay. Waxay sheegtay in xilli ay sii kordhayaan dhibaatooyinka caalamka, ay ka shaqayn doonto soo nooleynta doorka Qaramada Midoobay ee xal u helidda khilaafaadka iyada oo loo marayo diblomaasiyadda. Haddii la doorto, Nusseibeh waxay noqon doontaa haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee qabata xilka Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Lix musharrax oo kale ayaa sidoo kale u tartamaya xilkan. Wareegga hordhaca ah ee codbixinta musharraxiinta, Rebecca Greenspan oo u dhalatay Costa Rica ayaa hoggaanka u haysa. Musharraxiinta kale waxaa ka mid ah Rafael Grossi oo u dhashay Argentina, ahna agaasimaha guud ee Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Tamarta Atomikada (IAEA).

items.title: Imaaraadka oo duqeyn cusub ka fuliyey Soomaaliya – Halkee?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa Talaadadii duqeyn ka fuliyey marinka buuraha Galgala ee Puntland, isaga oo beegsaday xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, weerarkii ugu horreeyey ee Imaaraadku ka fuliyo waqooyiga Soomaaliya tan iyo November 2025, sida ay saraakiil amni Arbacadii u sheegeen wakaaladda AFP. Laba mas’uul oo deegaanka ah ayaa AFP u sheegay in diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Imaaraadku ay Isniintii iyo Talaadadii sahamin ka sameeyeen aagga, kadib markii walax qarax ah lala beegsaday ciidamada Puntland. Diyaaradaha waxay ka duuleen garoonka diyaaradaha Boosaaso, halkaas oo Imaaraadku ku leeyahay saldhig militari, ayay mas’uuliyiintu sheegeen. Saraakiisha ayaa sheegay in duqeyntu beegsatay afar dagaalyahan oo Al-Shabaab ah oo miinooyin ku aasayay waddo. Laba ka mid ah ayaa dhaawacmay, waxaana markii dambe dilay ciidamo deegaanka ah oo gaaray goobta. Al-Shabaab muddo dheer ayay saldhig ku lahayd buuraha Cal-Madow ee Puntland. Si kastaba, awoodda kooxda ee waqooyiga Soomaaliya ayaa ka yar tan ay ku leedahay koonfurta iyo bartamaha dalka. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Puntland ay maalmaha soo socda ku dhawaaqi doonto guluf cusub oo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya weli kama aysan hadlin duqeynta. Duqeyntan cusub ayaa timid ayada oo dhowaan ay soo baxeen warbixino sheegayey in weerar kale oo Imaaraadku ka fuliyey Puntland, kaas oo ka dhacay buuraha Cal Miskaad sannadkii hore lagu dilay dad shacab ahaa. Sida lagu ogaaday baaritaan la baahiyey 11-kii October, weerarkaas, oo dhacay 26-kii Janaayo 2025, ayaa dilay afar qof oo isku qoys ahaa, oo ay ku jireen saddex carruur ah, isla markaana uu dhaawacay shan qof oo kale. Baaritaanka oo ay daabacday Drop Site News, wuxuu ku salaysnaa wareysiyo lala yeeshay dadkii ka badbaaday weerarka iyo afar sarkaal oo Puntland ah oo aan magacyadooda la shaacin. Duruufaha weerarka si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin, sida ay sheegtay warbixintu. Khadra Cabdi Ismaaciil, oo 38 jir ah, ayaa Drop Site u sheegtay in qoyskeedu isku diyaarinayey casho, xilli ay iyadu ka baxday aqalkoodii si ay u soo booqato deris. Wax yar kadib, waxay maqashay guuxa diyaarad soo dhowaaneysa, waxaana xigay qarax xooggan oo ku dhacay hoygii qoyska. items.title: Soomaaliya oo Sheegtay in 55% Dhulkii AS Dib Loo Qabsaday
items.description: Soomaaliya oo Doha ku sheegtay in dib loo soo celiyey in ka badan 55% dhulkii ay kooxaha hubeysan haysteen La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka Soomaaliya, Danjire Aweys Xaaji Yuusuf Axmed, ayaa madasha Global Security Forum 2026 ee magaalada Doha ee dalka Qatar ka sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay dib ula wareegtay in ka badan 55% dhulkii ay kooxaha argagixisadu gacanta ku hayeen, isla markaana ugu yaraan 1.5 milyan oo qof laga xoreeyey cabsi-gelintooda. Tirooyinkan ayuu Aweys ku soo bandhigay khudbad uu ka jeediyey madasha 21-kii Oktoobar 2026, isaga oo ka hadlay horumarka amniga Soomaaliya, iskaashiga caalamiga ah iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in la dhowro madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalalka. Danjire Aweys ayaa sheegay in Al-Shabaab iyo kooxda Daacish ee Soomaaliya ay weli yihiin caqabadaha waaweyn ee amniga dalka. Wuxuu ku dooday in dadaallada dowladda aysan ku koobnayn hawlgallada milatari, balse ay sidoo kale ku wajahan yihiin xoojinta hay’adaha dowladda iyo dhismaha amni waara. Si kastaba, tirada sheegaysa in dib loo helay 55% dhulkii ay kooxuhu haysteen iyo in 1.5 milyan oo qof laga xoreeyey cabsi-gelinta weli ma laha xog faahfaahsan oo dadweynaha loo soo bandhigay si madax-bannaan loogu xaqiijiyo. Warbixinta Goobjoog ma sheegin goobaha gaarka ah ee laga hadlayo ama habka loo xisaabiyey tirooyinkan, sidaas darteed waa in loo fahmaa xog uu mas’uulku soo bandhigay, ee aan loo qaadan tirooyin si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyey. Khudbaddiisa, Aweys wuxuu sidoo kale ku baaqay in la xoojiyo iskaashiga dalalka deriska ah iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan xog-wadaagga sirdoonka, sugidda xuduudaha iyo la-dagaallanka dambiyada isaga gudba dalalka. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay ilaalinta Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz, oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta. Madasha Global Security Forum 2026, oo cinwaankeedu ahaa Mustaqbalka Isbahaysiyada, ayaa ka dhacday Doha intii u dhexeysay 19-ka iyo 21-ka Oktoobar. Waxaa soo qabanqaabiyey The Soufan Center iyo Qatar International Academy for Security Studies, iyadoo diiradda lagu saaray isbeddellada amniga caalamiga ah iyo mustaqbalka iskaashiga dalalka. Somalia ayaa dadaal ugu jirta in ay si tartiib ah ula wareegto masuuliyadaha amniga ee ay hore uga taageeri jireen ciidamada iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah. Horumarka hawlgallada ka dhanka ah kooxaha hubeysan iyo awoodda hay’adaha amniga ayaa weli ah arrimo muhiim u ah xasilloonida dalka iyo gobolka.   The post Soomaaliya oo Sheegtay in 55% Dhulkii AS Dib Loo Qabsaday first appeared on Radio Dalsan .
