items.title: Sidee Turkiga uga adkaaday isbhayesigii Greece, Israa’iil iyo Imaaraadka Carabta
items.description: Ankara (Caasimada Online) — Maalmihii ka horreeyay inta uusan baarlamaanka Bariga Liibiya meelmarin heshiiska muranka dhaliyay ee badda ee lala galay dalka Turkiga, dowladda Giriigga ayaa si xooggan isugu dayaysay inay isu keento xulafadeeda gobolka — oo ay ka mid yihiin Masar, Israa’iil iyo Imaaraadka Carabta — si looga hortago heshiiskaas, sida ay saraakiil badan oo gobolka ku sugan u sheegeen shabakadda Middle East Eye . Hase yeeshee, maalintii Talaadada, Golaha Wakiillada Liibiya ee fadhigiisu yahay magaalada Benghazi ayaa ansixiyay heshiiska, taas oo muujinaysa in Liibiyada kala qeybsan ay ugu yaraan heshiis guud ku noqon karto aqoonsiga sheegashada ballaaran ee Turkigu ku leeyahay Badda Mediterranean-ka bari. “Turkigu wuxuu si buuxda xididdada ugu aastay gudaha Liibiya. Waxay hadda ku dhowdahay wax aan suurtagal ahayn in hoggaamiye Liibiyaan ah uu mustaqbalka heshiis la saxiixdo Giriigga, maxaa yeelay waxaa jira is-afgarad ay Liibiyaanku ku midaysan yihiin,” ayuu yiri Constantinos Filis, oo ah agaasimaha Machadka Arrimaha Caalamiga ah ee magaalada Athens. Balse heshiiskani wuxuu ka weyn yahay guuldarro soo gaartay Giriigga ama tallaabo diblamaasiyadeed oo Turkigu ka gaaray badda Mediterranean-ka. Wuxuu si qoto-dheer u muujinayaa sida uu dib ugu habaysmayo Bariga Dhexe kaddib dagaalkii Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay ku qaadeen Iran iyo colaadaha kale ee ka aloosan gobolka oo dhan. Isku soo wada duuboo, isbahaysiyadii uu Giriiggu ku tiirsanaa si uu uga hortago Turkiga ee badda Mediterranean-ka ayaa ku guuldareystay inay wax keenaan, maadaama Bariga Dhexe ay ka socoto dib-u-habeyn istiraatiijiyadeed oo lagu kala hor marinayo danaha iyo mudnaanta siyaasadeed. Masar iyo Turkiga ayaa dhammeeyay khilaafkoodii qoto-dheeraa, halka dowladaha Khaliijka sida Imaaraadka Carabta ay raadinayaan shuraako cusub oo dhanka amniga ah xilli dagaalka Iran uu qarka u saaran yahay inuu mar kale dib u qarxo. Arrinta layaabka ku ah Giriigga ayaa ah in ficillada saaxiibkiisa ugu dhow ee Israa’iil ay qeyb weyn ka qaateen is-beddelladan. Booska bannaanaaday ee Mareykanka Loolanka dhanka badda ah ee u dhexeeya Giriigga iyo Turkiga ee Bariga Mediterranean-ka ayaa soo jiray waqti dheer ka hor inta aysan Liibiya u kala go’in labada maamul ee iska soo horjeeda kaddib xukun-tuuriddii Mucammar Al-Qadaafi ee 2011-kii. Labada dal ee deriska ah ayaa sannadkii 1996-kii ku dhowaaday inay galaan dagaal toos ah jasiirad aan cidina degganayn dalkeeda awgeed. Sida caadada ahayd, Giriigga iyo Turkigu waxay xadka u riixi jireen xiisaddooda iyagoo ogsoon in Mareykanku soo dhex-gali doono si uu uga hortago in labada xubnood ee NATO ay galaan iska-hor-imaad toos ah. Balse xaaladdaas ayaa hadda gabi ahaanba isbeddeshay. Mareykanka ayaa hadda doorkiisu ku yaraaday Bariga Dhexe, wuxuuna isku hayaa gaashaanbuurta NATO jihooyin dhowr ah, sida arrinta dagaalka Ukraine. Giriiggu waa dal kharash badan ku bixiya NATO, balse Turkigu wuxuu dhistay wershadihiisa hubka ee u gaarka ah. Awoodda gobolka ee Turkiga ayaa sii kordhaysa, iyadoo hadda dalka Suuriya uu maamulayo saaxiibkiis, dalalka Khaliijkuna ay u eeganayaan wehel dhanka amniga ah xilli Mareykanku dib uga guranayo doorkiisii hore. Tom Barrack, oo ah safiirka Mareykanka ee Turkiga isla markaana ah ergayga Suuriya iyo Ciraaq, ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in heshiiskii taariikhiga ahaa ee Mareykanka iyo Khaliijka ee “shidaal ku beddelashada amniga” uu hadda marayo marxalad kala-guur ah. Ilo-wareed Liibiyaan ah oo xog-ogaal u ah arrintan ayaa Middle East Eye u sheegay in meelmarinta baarlamaanka bariga Liibiya ee heshiiska badda ay tahay hal tallaabo oo qeyb ka ah qorshe ballaaran oo Liibiya loogu mideynayo hal dowlad, kaas oo maamulka Trump uu la oggolaaday Turkiga. Isha ayaa intaa ku dartay in Mareykanku doonayo in Turkigu uu dhex-dhexaadiyo xukuumadaha iska soo horjeeda ee fadhiya Benghazi iyo Tripoli. Madaxa sirdoonka Turkiga Ibrahim Kalin ayaana booqasho ku tagay magaalada Tripoli Talaadadii. Giriiggu wuxuu bilaabay inuu raadsado xulafo cusub oo Bariga Dhexe ah xilli uu Mareykanku dib uga gurtay doorkiisii amniga, Turkiguna uu muruqyadiisa ku muujinayo gobolka. Heshiiska badda ee Ankara ay la gashay Liibiya ayaa meesha ka saaraya sheegashada Giriigga ee aagagga badda, ma aha oo kaliya jasiiradaha yaryar, balse sidoo kale jasiiradaha waaweyn sida Crete oo ay ku nool yihiin 600,000 oo Giriig ah. Giriigga oo raadinaya beddelka Mareykanka Dowladda Athens ayaa labalaabtay xiriirkeeda qoto-dheer ee taariikhiga ah ee ay la leedahay dalka Masar. Markii uu Turkigu markii ugu horreysay heshiiska xadaynta badda la saxiixday dowladda Liibiya ee fadhigeedu yahay Tripoli, Athens waxay kaga jawaabtay inay heshiis la saxiixatay Masar si ay kaga hortagto. Giriiggu wuxuu sidoo kale aad ugu soo dhawaaday Imaaraadka Carabta. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Giriigga Kyriakos Mitsotakis ayaa ka mid ahaa hoggaamiyeyaashii ugu horreeyay ee booqday dalka Khaliijka xilligii uu meeshii ugu sarreysay marayay dagaalkii Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay ku hayeen Iran. Sannadkii 2020-kii, markii ay cirka isku shareertay xiisadda labada dal, Imaaraadku wuxuu diyaarado dagaal u diray jasiiradda Crete. Balse tallaabada ugu muranka badanayd waxay ahayd isbahaysiga dhow ee uu Giriiggu la yeeshay Israa’iil, taas oo ay Turkiga isku hayaan saameynta goobaha xasaasiga ah sida Suuriya iyo xitaa Geeska Afrika. Bishii Ogosto, Giriiggu wuxuu xitaa oggolaaday inuu Israa’iil kaga gato nidaamka difaaca hawada oo ku kacaya $3.5 bilyan oo doolar — taas oo ahayd heshiiskii hubka ee ugu weynaa taariikhda Israa’iil. Meelmarinta heshiiskan ee Bariga Liibiya ayaa si gaar ah u dhibaysa Giriigga, sababtoo ah Israa’iil, Masar iyo Imaaraadku waa taageerayaasha ugu weyn ee Khaliifa Xaftar, taliyaha milateri ee gacanta ku haya Bariga Liibiya, kaas oo horay u ahaa cadowga dowladda fadhigeedu yahay Tripoli. Giriiggu wuxuu aad isugu halleynayay xiriiradan si uu Turkiga ugaga hor tago Liibiya dhexdeeda. Sannadkii hore, Giriiggu wuxuu taageero ka doonay Masar si loo hor istaago in Benghazi ay ansixiso heshiiska badda. Wafdi Masari ah ayaa booqday Athens shan maalmood ka hor si ay Giriigga ugala tashadaan arrinta Liibiya. Saddam Xaftar, oo ah wiilka Khaliifa Xaftar, ayaa si isa soo taraysa loo arkaa inuu yahay hoggaamiyaha xiga ee Bariga Liibiya. Inkasta oo Turkigu uu soo dhexgalay dagaalkii sokeeye ee Liibiya si uu aabbihii uga hor istaago inuu qabsado Tripoli, haddana Saddam wuxuu u dhowaaday dhanka Ankara. Xagaagii la soo dhaafay, isagoo dhiirrigelin ka helay Imaaraadka, ayaa lagu qanciyay Saddam inuu booqdo Athens inkasta oo uu xiriir la lahaa Turkiga. “Masar ama Imaaraadka shaqo uma aha inay Liibiya dhexdeeda nooga hiiliyaan. Waxay leeyihiin dano kale. Waxay ahayd xikmad-darro in Giriiggu ka fisho inay u huraan danteenna dartiis danahooda gaarka ah,” ayuu yiri Filis. Isku soo dhawaanshaha Turkiga iyo Masar Ilaa dhowr sano ka hor, Masar iyo Imaaraadkuba waxay cadaawad adag kala dhexeysay Turkiga. Qaahira iyo Abu Dhabi waxay taageereen reer Xaftar dagaalkii sokeeye ee Liibiya, halka Turkigu uu taageeray dowladdii Tripoli. Balse wixii markaas ka dambeeyay, waddamadan waxay qaadeen tallaabooyin ay ku soo celinayaan xiriirkooda. Saraakiisha Masar ayaa dhowr jeer xaqiijiyay in isku soo dhawaanshaha Qaahira iyo Ankara uusan ku socon Giriigga. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar Badr Abdelatty ayaa Talaadadii wicitaan la yeeshay dhigiisa Giriigga, isagoo dib u xaqiijiyay danaha ay wadaagaan. Masar ma doonayso inay aragto Bariga Mediterranean-ka oo noqda goob uu Turkigu kaligiis ku taliyo, laakiin Masar iyo Turkigu hadda waxay ku midoobeen arrimo ka badan kuwa ay ku tartamayaan. Labada dalba waxay aad uga digtoonaadeen ballaarashada Israa’iil kaddib weerarradii 7-dii Oktoobar 2023, xasuuqii Gaza iyo qabsashada dhulalka Suuriya iyo Lubnaan. Sidoo kale, Masar iyo Turkigu waxay isku mowqif ka yihiin Badda Cas. Labada dalba waxay si toos ah u taageeraan dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, waxayna ka soo horjeedaan aqoonsiga Israa’iil ay u fidisay gobolka gooni-u-goosadka ah ee Somaliland. Waxay kaloo taageeraan ciidamada qalabka sida ee Suudaan oo dagaal kula jira xoogagga RSF, kuwaas oo xiriir la leh Israa’iil, sida uu qiray Ra’iisul Wasaare Benjamin Netanyahu laftiisu. Liibiya dhexdeeda, waxaa sidoo kale ka jira fursad iskaashi; Masar waxay doonaysaa inay dhisto dhuun shidaal oo ku kacaysa $1 bilyan oo doolar oo isku xiraysa Tobruk iyo dekedda Alexandria. Iyadoo Imaaraadka iyo Turkigu ay ku kala aragti duwan yihiin meelaha qaar ee colaadaha gobolka sida Suudaan, haddana waxay u dhaqaaqeen inay maareeyaan khilaafaadkooda; tusaale ahaan, sannadkii 2022-kii Imaaraadku wuxuu iibsaday diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee TB2 ee laga sameeyo Turkiga. Dhinaca kale, aqoonsiga Bariga Liibiya ee sheegashada badda ee Turkiga ayaa ku soo beegmay toddobaadkii uu Netanyahu faafiyay khariidad muujinaysa dhulkaas inuu yahay mid “saaxiib la ah” Israa’iil, Imaaraadka iyo Giriigga. Saddam Xaftar ayaa xitaa bishii Sebtembar kula kulmay Netanyahu dalka Imaaraadka Carabta. items.fullContent: Ankara (Caasimada Online) — Maalmihii ka horreeyay inta uusan baarlamaanka Bariga Liibiya meelmarin heshiiska muranka dhaliyay ee badda ee lala galay dalka Turkiga, dowladda Giriigga ayaa si xooggan isugu dayaysay inay isu keento xulafadeeda gobolka — oo ay ka mid yihiin Masar, Israa’iil iyo Imaaraadka Carabta — si looga hortago heshiiskaas, sida ay saraakiil badan oo gobolka ku sugan u sheegeen shabakadda Middle East Eye . Hase yeeshee, maalintii Talaadada, Golaha Wakiillada Liibiya ee fadhigiisu yahay magaalada Benghazi ayaa ansixiyay heshiiska, taas oo muujinaysa in Liibiyada kala qeybsan ay ugu yaraan heshiis guud ku noqon karto aqoonsiga sheegashada ballaaran ee Turkigu ku leeyahay Badda Mediterranean-ka bari. “Turkigu wuxuu si buuxda xididdada ugu aastay gudaha Liibiya. Waxay hadda ku dhowdahay wax aan suurtagal ahayn in hoggaamiye Liibiyaan ah uu mustaqbalka heshiis la saxiixdo Giriigga, maxaa yeelay waxaa jira is-afgarad ay Liibiyaanku ku midaysan yihiin,” ayuu yiri Constantinos Filis, oo ah agaasimaha Machadka Arrimaha Caalamiga ah ee magaalada Athens. Balse heshiiskani wuxuu ka weyn yahay guuldarro soo gaartay Giriigga ama tallaabo diblamaasiyadeed oo Turkigu ka gaaray badda Mediterranean-ka. Wuxuu si qoto-dheer u muujinayaa sida uu dib ugu habaysmayo Bariga Dhexe kaddib dagaalkii Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay ku qaadeen Iran iyo colaadaha kale ee ka aloosan gobolka oo dhan. Isku soo wada duuboo, isbahaysiyadii uu Giriiggu ku tiirsanaa si uu uga hortago Turkiga ee badda Mediterranean-ka ayaa ku guuldareystay inay wax keenaan, maadaama Bariga Dhexe ay ka socoto dib-u-habeyn istiraatiijiyadeed oo lagu kala hor marinayo danaha iyo mudnaanta siyaasadeed. Masar iyo Turkiga ayaa dhammeeyay khilaafkoodii qoto-dheeraa, halka dowladaha Khaliijka sida Imaaraadka Carabta ay raadinayaan shuraako cusub oo dhanka amniga ah xilli dagaalka Iran uu qarka u saaran yahay inuu mar kale dib u qarxo. Arrinta layaabka ku ah Giriigga ayaa ah in ficillada saaxiibkiisa ugu dhow ee Israa’iil ay qeyb weyn ka qaateen is-beddelladan. Booska bannaanaaday ee Mareykanka Loolanka dhanka badda ah ee u dhexeeya Giriigga iyo Turkiga ee Bariga Mediterranean-ka ayaa soo jiray waqti dheer ka hor inta aysan Liibiya u kala go’in labada maamul ee iska soo horjeeda kaddib xukun-tuuriddii Mucammar Al-Qadaafi ee 2011-kii. Labada dal ee deriska ah ayaa sannadkii 1996-kii ku dhowaaday inay galaan dagaal toos ah jasiirad aan cidina degganayn dalkeeda awgeed. Sida caadada ahayd, Giriigga iyo Turkigu waxay xadka u riixi jireen xiisaddooda iyagoo ogsoon in Mareykanku soo dhex-gali doono si uu uga hortago in labada xubnood ee NATO ay galaan iska-hor-imaad toos ah. Balse xaaladdaas ayaa hadda gabi ahaanba isbeddeshay. Mareykanka ayaa hadda doorkiisu ku yaraaday Bariga Dhexe, wuxuuna isku hayaa gaashaanbuurta NATO jihooyin dhowr ah, sida arrinta dagaalka Ukraine. Giriiggu waa dal kharash badan ku bixiya NATO, balse Turkigu wuxuu dhistay wershadihiisa hubka ee u gaarka ah. Awoodda gobolka ee Turkiga ayaa sii kordhaysa, iyadoo hadda dalka Suuriya uu maamulayo saaxiibkiis, dalalka Khaliijkuna ay u eeganayaan wehel dhanka amniga ah xilli Mareykanku dib uga guranayo doorkiisii hore. Tom Barrack, oo ah safiirka Mareykanka ee Turkiga isla markaana ah ergayga Suuriya iyo Ciraaq, ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in heshiiskii taariikhiga ahaa ee Mareykanka iyo Khaliijka ee “shidaal ku beddelashada amniga” uu hadda marayo marxalad kala-guur ah. Ilo-wareed Liibiyaan ah oo xog-ogaal u ah arrintan ayaa Middle East Eye u sheegay in meelmarinta baarlamaanka bariga Liibiya ee heshiiska badda ay tahay hal tallaabo oo qeyb ka ah qorshe ballaaran oo Liibiya loogu mideynayo hal dowlad, kaas oo maamulka Trump uu la oggolaaday Turkiga. Isha ayaa intaa ku dartay in Mareykanku doonayo in Turkigu uu dhex-dhexaadiyo xukuumadaha iska soo horjeeda ee fadhiya Benghazi iyo Tripoli. Madaxa sirdoonka Turkiga Ibrahim Kalin ayaana booqasho ku tagay magaalada Tripoli Talaadadii. Giriiggu wuxuu bilaabay inuu raadsado xulafo cusub oo Bariga Dhexe ah xilli uu Mareykanku dib uga gurtay doorkiisii amniga, Turkiguna uu muruqyadiisa ku muujinayo gobolka. Heshiiska badda ee Ankara ay la gashay Liibiya ayaa meesha ka saaraya sheegashada Giriigga ee aagagga badda, ma aha oo kaliya jasiiradaha yaryar, balse sidoo kale jasiiradaha waaweyn sida Crete oo ay ku nool yihiin 600,000 oo Giriig ah. Giriigga oo raadinaya beddelka Mareykanka Dowladda Athens ayaa labalaabtay xiriirkeeda qoto-dheer ee taariikhiga ah ee ay la leedahay dalka Masar. Markii uu Turkigu markii ugu horreysay heshiiska xadaynta badda la saxiixday dowladda Liibiya ee fadhigeedu yahay Tripoli, Athens waxay kaga jawaabtay inay heshiis la saxiixatay Masar si ay kaga hortagto. Giriiggu wuxuu sidoo kale aad ugu soo dhawaaday Imaaraadka Carabta. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Giriigga Kyriakos Mitsotakis ayaa ka mid ahaa hoggaamiyeyaashii ugu horreeyay ee booqday dalka Khaliijka xilligii uu meeshii ugu sarreysay marayay dagaalkii Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay ku hayeen Iran. Sannadkii 2020-kii, markii ay cirka isku shareertay xiisadda labada dal, Imaaraadku wuxuu diyaarado dagaal u diray jasiiradda Crete. Balse tallaabada ugu muranka badanayd waxay ahayd isbahaysiga dhow ee uu Giriiggu la yeeshay Israa’iil, taas oo ay Turkiga isku hayaan saameynta goobaha xasaasiga ah sida Suuriya iyo xitaa Geeska Afrika. Bishii Ogosto, Giriiggu wuxuu xitaa oggolaaday inuu Israa’iil kaga gato nidaamka difaaca hawada oo ku kacaya $3.5 bilyan oo doolar — taas oo ahayd heshiiskii hubka ee ugu weynaa taariikhda Israa’iil. Meelmarinta heshiiskan ee Bariga Liibiya ayaa si gaar ah u dhibaysa Giriigga, sababtoo ah Israa’iil, Masar iyo Imaaraadku waa taageerayaasha ugu weyn ee Khaliifa Xaftar, taliyaha milateri ee gacanta ku haya Bariga Liibiya, kaas oo horay u ahaa cadowga dowladda fadhigeedu yahay Tripoli. Giriiggu wuxuu aad isugu halleynayay xiriiradan si uu Turkiga ugaga hor tago Liibiya dhexdeeda. Sannadkii hore, Giriiggu wuxuu taageero ka doonay Masar si loo hor istaago in Benghazi ay ansixiso heshiiska badda. Wafdi Masari ah ayaa booqday Athens shan maalmood ka hor si ay Giriigga ugala tashadaan arrinta Liibiya. Saddam Xaftar, oo ah wiilka Khaliifa Xaftar, ayaa si isa soo taraysa loo arkaa inuu yahay hoggaamiyaha xiga ee Bariga Liibiya. Inkasta oo Turkigu uu soo dhexgalay dagaalkii sokeeye ee Liibiya si uu aabbihii uga hor istaago inuu qabsado Tripoli, haddana Saddam wuxuu u dhowaaday dhanka Ankara. Xagaagii la soo dhaafay, isagoo dhiirrigelin ka helay Imaaraadka, ayaa lagu qanciyay Saddam inuu booqdo Athens inkasta oo uu xiriir la lahaa Turkiga. “Masar ama Imaaraadka shaqo uma aha inay Liibiya dhexdeeda nooga hiiliyaan. Waxay leeyihiin dano kale. Waxay ahayd xikmad-darro in Giriiggu ka fisho inay u huraan danteenna dartiis danahooda gaarka ah,” ayuu yiri Filis. Isku soo dhawaanshaha Turkiga iyo Masar Ilaa dhowr sano ka hor, Masar iyo Imaaraadkuba waxay cadaawad adag kala dhexeysay Turkiga. Qaahira iyo Abu Dhabi waxay taageereen reer Xaftar dagaalkii sokeeye ee Liibiya, halka Turkigu uu taageeray dowladdii Tripoli. Balse wixii markaas ka dambeeyay, waddamadan waxay qaadeen tallaabooyin ay ku soo celinayaan xiriirkooda. Saraakiisha Masar ayaa dhowr jeer xaqiijiyay in isku soo dhawaanshaha Qaahira iyo Ankara uusan ku socon Giriigga. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar Badr Abdelatty ayaa Talaadadii wicitaan la yeeshay dhigiisa Giriigga, isagoo dib u xaqiijiyay danaha ay wadaagaan. Masar ma doonayso inay aragto Bariga Mediterranean-ka oo noqda goob uu Turkigu kaligiis ku taliyo, laakiin Masar iyo Turkigu hadda waxay ku midoobeen arrimo ka badan kuwa ay ku tartamayaan. Labada dalba waxay aad uga digtoonaadeen ballaarashada Israa’iil kaddib weerarradii 7-dii Oktoobar 2023, xasuuqii Gaza iyo qabsashada dhulalka Suuriya iyo Lubnaan. Sidoo kale, Masar iyo Turkigu waxay isku mowqif ka yihiin Badda Cas. Labada dalba waxay si toos ah u taageeraan dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, waxayna ka soo horjeedaan aqoonsiga Israa’iil ay u fidisay gobolka gooni-u-goosadka ah ee Somaliland. Waxay kaloo taageeraan ciidamada qalabka sida ee Suudaan oo dagaal kula jira xoogagga RSF, kuwaas oo xiriir la leh Israa’iil, sida uu qiray Ra’iisul Wasaare Benjamin Netanyahu laftiisu. Liibiya dhexdeeda, waxaa sidoo kale ka jira fursad iskaashi; Masar waxay doonaysaa inay dhisto dhuun shidaal oo ku kacaysa $1 bilyan oo doolar oo isku xiraysa Tobruk iyo dekedda Alexandria. Iyadoo Imaaraadka iyo Turkigu ay ku kala aragti duwan yihiin meelaha qaar ee colaadaha gobolka sida Suudaan, haddana waxay u dhaqaaqeen inay maareeyaan khilaafaadkooda; tusaale ahaan, sannadkii 2022-kii Imaaraadku wuxuu iibsaday diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee TB2 ee laga sameeyo Turkiga. Dhinaca kale, aqoonsiga Bariga Liibiya ee sheegashada badda ee Turkiga ayaa ku soo beegmay toddobaadkii uu Netanyahu faafiyay khariidad muujinaysa dhulkaas inuu yahay mid “saaxiib la ah” Israa’iil, Imaaraadka iyo Giriigga. Saddam Xaftar ayaa xitaa bishii Sebtembar kula kulmay Netanyahu dalka Imaaraadka Carabta. Balse Israa’iil waxay arki kartaa in sheegashada sii ballaaranaysa ee Turkiga ay Giriigga ku sii riixayso dhankeeda, sida uu sarkaal reer Yurub ah sheegay. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee doorashada madaxweynaha Galmudug + Video
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimada Galmudug waxaa saaka ka socota qaban-qaabadii ugu dambeysay ee doorashada madaxweynaha iyo ku xigeenkiisa oo maanta ka dhaceysa gudaha magaaladaasi. Illaa afar musharrax ayaa loo kala codeynayaa, iyadoo laba kamid ah ay u sharraxan yihiin xilka madaxweynaha, halka labada kalena ay u tartami hoggaamiye ku xigeenka, kuwaas oo shalay Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug kahor jeediyay barnaamijyadooda waxqabadka. Musharraxiinta ayaa soo bandhigay qorshayaashooda iyo waxyaabaha ay doonayaan inay ka qabtaan hoggaaminta maamulka, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo doorashada maanta ka dhacaysa magaalada caasimada ah ee Dhuusamareeb. Afarta musharrax ayaa kala ah; Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo u sharraxan xisbiga JSP iyo Cabdulqaadir Cabdullahi Diiriye oo doorashada ku metali doono xisbiga Sincad, waxaase loo badinayaa inuu guuleysto musharrax Liibaan oo ay taageereyso kooxda Villa Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, Cabdisataar Maxamed Geelle iyo Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyare ayaa ku loollami doono xilka madaxweyne ku xigeenka, iyaga oo kala metalaya xisbiga Sincad iyo JSP. Haseyeeshee waxaa guusha loo saadaalinayaa Garyare oo ka tirsan xisbiga madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kaas oo horay loo siiyay kaarka musharraxnimada ee xisbiga. Musharrax madaxweyne Liibaax Axmed Xasan oo hoolka doorashada kula hadlay wariyeyaasha ayaa rajo wanaagsan ka muujiyay ku guuleysiga xilka madaxweynaha Galmudug, isaga oo xildhibaannada cusub ka dalbaday inay codkooda siiyaan. “Baarlamaanka waxaa soo doortay shacabka, waxaan ka rajeynayaa inay codkooda i siiyaan, si aan ugu adeego bulshada reer Galmudug,” ayuu yiri Liibaan Axmed Xasan. Sidoo kale, musharraxa madaxweyne ku xigeenka, Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyare oo isna taageero ka haysta Villa Somalia ayaa yiri “Waxaan rajeynayaa natiijo fiican oo wax ku ool ah inaan kala caraabo meeshaan, haddii Ilaahey uu yiraahdo, rajadeydu waa 100%”. Doorashadan waxaa ka horreysay doorashada guddoonka Baarlamaanka Galmudug, taas oo ay ku guuleysteen guddoomiyaha iyo labadiisa ku-xigeen, xubno ka tirsan ururka JSP. items.title: Diblomaasiyiinta Mareykanka iyo qoysaskooda oo la amray in ay ka baxaan Sacuudiga
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) — Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa ku amartay qaar ka mid ah diblomaasiyiinteeda iyo xubnaha qoysaskooda inay ka baxaan xarumaha diblamaasiyadeed ee ay ku leedahay dalka Sacuudi Carabiya, iyadoo sidoo kale qorsheyneysa inay xubnaha qoysaska diblamaasiyiinta kala baxdo xarumo kale oo dhowr ah oo ay ku leedahay gobolka, sida ay saraakiil Mareykan ah u sheegeen wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters. Amarkan ayaa yimid kaddib markii weerarro ka dhacay dalka Sacuudi Carabiya ay ku dhinteen ugu yaraan hal qof, sideed kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen garoonka diyaaradaha rayidka ah ee magaalada Dammam, halka laba qof oo kalena lagu dilay weerar diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones) ah oo lagu beegsaday goob laga soo saaro shidaalka. Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, Tommy Pigott, ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay barta X ku xaqiijiyay in wasaaraddu ay amartay ka-bixitaanka “shaqaalaha aan howlaha degdegga ah ku jirin ee dowladda Mareykanka iyo xubnaha qoysaskooda ee ku sugan dalka Sacuudi Carabiya oo keliya”, sababo la xiriira weerarrada ay kooxda Xuuthiyiinta Yemen ee xulafada la ah Iran ku beegsanayaan bartilmaameedyada rayidka ah ee dalkaas. Washington ayaa bilihii la soo dhaafay dib ugu celisay gobolka qaar ka mid ah howlwadeennadeeda diblamaasiyadeed, kaddib markii tiro badan oo ka mid ah la soo saaray xilligii ay Tehran weerarrada ku qaadday xarumaha Mareykanka, markii uu dhammaadkii bishii Febraayo billowday dagaalkii Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay ku qaadeen Iran. “Xuuthiyiinta ay Iran taageerto ayaa si isa soo taraysa ugu lug yeeshay colaad ka dhan ah Sacuudi Carabiya, oo ay ku jiraan weerarro lagu qaaday garoomada diyaaradaha rayidka ah iyo kaabayaasha kale ee muhiimka ah, kuwaas oo sababay dhimashada dad rayid ah iyo carqalad xooggan oo ku timid socdaalka,” ayuu yiri Pigott. Afar sarkaal oo Mareykan ah ayaa u sheegay Reuters in xafiisyada iyo safaaradaha kale ee Mareykanka ee ku yaalla dalalka Khaliijka iyagana lagu amri doono in qoysaska laga saaro, inkasta oo Pigott uusan ka hadlin qorshayaasha la xiriira xarumaha ka baxsan Sacuudi Carabiya. Khasaaraha weerarrada Ka-bixitaankan cusub ayaa daba socda xiisadda dagaal ee sii xoogeysanaysa gudaha Yemen, taas oo furaysa aag kale oo colaadeed oo qeyb ka ah qalalaasaha gobolka ee ka dhashay dagaalkii Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ee ka dhanka ahaa Iran. Colaaddan sii fiday ayaa carqaladeysay ganacsiga tamarta ee caalamka, waxayna dhabar-jab weyn ku noqotay dhaqaalaha dalalka Khaliijka. Kaddib amarka ka-bixitaanka Mareykanka, Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa shaacisay in weerar lagu qaaday Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee King Fahd ee magaalada Dammam uu ku dhintay hal qof, siddeed kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Sidoo kale, isla maalintaas ka hor, Wasaaradda Tamarta ee Sacuudiga ayaa xaqiijisay in laba qof ay ku dhinteen kaddib markii ciidamada difaaca cirka ee Sacuudigu ay soo rideen diyaarad drone ah oo isku dayaysay inay ku dhacdo xarun ku taal goobta shidaalka laga soo saaro ee Shaybah, taas oo ay leedahay shirkadda Saudi Aramco. Safaaradda Mareykanka ee magaalada Riyadh ayaa Arbacadii soo saartay digniin amni oo ku saabsan suurtagalnimada weerarro dheeraad ah oo ay Xuuthiyiintu ka geystaan gudaha Sacuudiga, kaddib weerarradii ugu dambeeyay ee dhimashada dhaliyay oo uu ku jiray weerar lala beegsaday garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaalada Riyadh. Safaaradda iyo xarun ay hay’adda sirdoonka ee CIA-du ku leedahay halkaas ayaa la kulmay weerarro diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah horraantii bishii Maarso, xilligaas oo ay Iran billowday weerarro is-daba-joog ah oo ay ka fulisay daafaha gobolka Bariga Dhexe. Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, Tommy Pigott, ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay barta X ku xaqiijiyay in wasaaraddu ay amartay ka-bixitaanka “shaqaalaha aan howlaha degdegga ah ku jirin ee dowladda Mareykanka iyo xubnaha qoysaskooda ee ku sugan dalka Sacuudi Carabiya oo keliya”, sababo la xiriira weerarrada ay kooxda Xuuthiyiinta Yemen ee xulafada la ah Iran ku beegsanayaan bartilmaameedyada rayidka ah ee dalkaas. Washington ayaa bilihii la soo dhaafay dib ugu celisay gobolka qaar ka mid ah howlwadeennadeeda diblamaasiyadeed, kaddib markii tiro badan oo ka mid ah la soo saaray xilligii ay Tehran weerarrada ku qaadday xarumaha Mareykanka, markii uu dhammaadkii bishii Febraayo billowday dagaalkii Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay ku qaadeen Iran. “Xuuthiyiinta ay Iran taageerto ayaa si isa soo taraysa ugu lug yeeshay colaad ka dhan ah Sacuudi Carabiya, oo ay ku jiraan weerarro lagu qaaday garoomada diyaaradaha rayidka ah iyo kaabayaasha kale ee muhiimka ah, kuwaas oo sababay dhimashada dad rayid ah iyo carqalad xooggan oo ku timid socdaalka,” ayuu yiri Pigott. Afar sarkaal oo Mareykan ah ayaa u sheegay Reuters in xafiisyada iyo safaaradaha kale ee Mareykanka ee ku yaalla dalalka Khaliijka iyagana lagu amri doono in qoysaska laga saaro, inkasta oo Pigott uusan ka hadlin qorshayaasha la xiriira xarumaha ka baxsan Sacuudi Carabiya. Khasaaraha weerarrada Ka-bixitaankan cusub ayaa daba socda xiisadda dagaal ee sii xoogeysanaysa gudaha Yemen, taas oo furaysa aag kale oo colaadeed oo qeyb ka ah qalalaasaha gobolka ee ka dhashay dagaalkii Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ee ka dhanka ahaa Iran. Colaaddan sii fiday ayaa carqaladeysay ganacsiga tamarta ee caalamka, waxayna dhabar-jab weyn ku noqotay dhaqaalaha dalalka Khaliijka. Kaddib amarka ka-bixitaanka Mareykanka, Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa shaacisay in weerar lagu qaaday Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee King Fahd ee magaalada Dammam uu ku dhintay hal qof, siddeed kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Sidoo kale, isla maalintaas ka hor, Wasaaradda Tamarta ee Sacuudiga ayaa xaqiijisay in laba qof ay ku dhinteen kaddib markii ciidamada difaaca cirka ee Sacuudigu ay soo rideen diyaarad drone ah oo isku dayaysay inay ku dhacdo xarun ku taal goobta shidaalka laga soo saaro ee Shaybah, taas oo ay leedahay shirkadda Saudi Aramco. Safaaradda Mareykanka ee magaalada Riyadh ayaa Arbacadii soo saartay digniin amni oo ku saabsan suurtagalnimada weerarro dheeraad ah oo ay Xuuthiyiintu ka geystaan gudaha Sacuudiga, kaddib weerarradii ugu dambeeyay ee dhimashada dhaliyay oo uu ku jiray weerar lala beegsaday garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaalada Riyadh. Safaaradda iyo xarun ay hay’adda sirdoonka ee CIA-du ku leedahay halkaas ayaa la kulmay weerarro diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah horraantii bishii Maarso, xilligaas oo ay Iran billowday weerarro is-daba-joog ah oo ay ka fulisay daafaha gobolka Bariga Dhexe. items.title: Harnessing Somaliland’s extreme floods to re-green the deserts with grasses
items.description: The year 2020 was the last that Somaliland, on the north-eastern coast of Africa, received the two rainy seasons its mixed farmers have relied on for centuries to keep living off the land. The farmers there are agro-pastoralists that generally grow no more than one, two or three acres of crops close to their households, while grazing sheep, goats, cattle and camels on sparsely vegetated rangelands, collectively owned by their wider clan-group. Goats and camels generally fare better at browsing sparse shrubs and bushes, as sheep and cattle prove pickier grazers that must search out grasses that manage to survive on the semi-arid landscape.   Times of intense drought, which occur with increasing frequency, see rains fall less predictably – if at all – and any rainfall that does arrive tends to come in short, intense bursts that erodes land without having sufficient time to infiltrate and feed crops or rangeland. The intensity of recent years’ rains have eroded and degraded both rangeland and cropland, worsening a food security situation classed by humanitarian organisations as stuck at “crisis” level More than one in 10 of Somaliland’s inhabitants are malnourished and a significant chunk of the population is scraping by cashing in livestock or farm tools for food.   The cloud of the severe drought and subsequent famine that gripped the Horn of Africa in 2011 costing 250,000 lives lingers in recent memory. However, farmers in Somaliland are adapting to cope with the new normal of two previously predictable rains that have become one erratic downpour. Communities there now face the relentless struggle of safeguarding their livelihood – the soil – from washing away.   Concern Worldwide is one the development organisations on the ground assisting farmers with the transition to a new normal and the Irish Farmers Journal travelled to farms around Boroma in south-western Somaliland to witness what work the group is aiding on the ground. Its work is aimed at training farmers in using local resources to improve farm productivity without creating a reliance on outside inputs and then leaving their programmes in local ownership after this training has been completed.   Typical Somaliland farm     The typical farm on Somaliland’s semi-arid plains will grow the two traditional starchy grain crops of the region – sorghum and maize – to deliver the bulk of their families’ calories. Further foods are purchased with income from the sales of livestock, milk or eggs. Livestock is central to farming and culture in the region as they are the main indicator of status and as the sole accessible storage unit of value in an economy experiencing rapid currency devaluation.   Animals are walked out to graze on uncultivated rangelands during daylight hours before they are closed in for the nighttime in pens created by a circle of cut bushes. Heavily-degraded lands on Somaliland’s semi-arid plains that would have once fed entire communities now lie barren, washing away with every flash flood that comes. / Mustafa Saeed   Farmers must sleep out with their livestock to avoid predation from foxes and cheetahs. In times of drought when vegetation gets scarce near to their villages, families will walk livestock further distances in search of water and grazing. Conflict does not emerge when families stay on their own wider clan’s lands, which can span vast distances.   It is not considered unusual for normally settled herders to head off on journeys of up to 150km, perhaps crossing international borders, during particularly severe droughts in search of grazing. Families will slaughter sheep or goats for their own consumption during religious festivals or for occasions like weddings, with each household milking a cow or two, sheep, goats or camels milked for domestic use and to generate sales. Livestock sales are focussed around Islamic religious festivals when Gulf states, such as Saudi Arabia, drive huge demand for live exports from the north-east of Africa. Finished lambs and hoggets sell live €90-135/head, while off-season sales will struggle to fetch more than €55.   Camels are far more valuable in both milk and meat terms, although far fewer families can afford them compared to cattle, sheep or goats. Ahmed’s once heavily degraded soils now support lush grasses after erosion was addressed and measures put in place to allow rainfall to soak. / Mustafa Saeed   Flock and herd sizes vary widely, with a typical family owning between five and 10-head of cattle, along with 20 to 40-head of sheep and the same number of goats. Land is not bought or sold in Somaliland – families plough and graze the same clan-owned lands their families have worked before them.   Tractors or any other form of mechanisation are also very rare in the region, with donkeys, camels and oxen providing the draught power on farms.   Undoing erosion damage   “We were planning to leave. We had to buy food from the market as our planting area was getting smaller and the erosion was expanding at very quick rate,” Ahmed, a farmer in his 40s, explained.   A growing chasm running 2m deep along 3km through farmland was what Ahmed had faced until 2023, when Concern Worldwide reached out to the community to solve the erosion issue. However, the picture the farmer painted sits in stark contrast to the current scenery, where a green oasis sticks against the wider degraded and heavily eroded landscape. Signs of rangeland rejuvenation on rangelands with hand-dug half-moon craters created to catch rainfall and prevent erosion. / Mustafa Saeed   Ahmed’s farm was, until recently, heavily degraded too, to an extent that it was even worse than many others not far from his as a large gash had been cut into the soil by years of flash floods increasingly funnelled into a single gulley. This gulley formed the path of least resistance for rains desperately needed by crops and rangeland that picked up topsoil every time it sped off his lands and those of the 3,300 locals dependent on adjoining the farmland as it washed downhill.   Concern Worldwide consulted with the community which flagged this widespread and large erosion as the biggest issue facing families, with 50 arable farms at immediate risk of being washed away. The solution lay largely with the power of the heavy flash floods that eroded the land in the first place: leaking stone dams could be laid inside the gulley awaiting the next soil-laden flood waters. The flow would then slow allowing the carried soil to settle behind the dams, filling in the deep crack with each significant rain that falls. As the gulley fills out, rainfall is spread over a wider area of rangeland and cropland to soak in and replenish vegetation, the vegetation itself acting to slow water and increase infiltration as it becomes established.   Just as the degradation would have continually worsened if left unchecked, the restoration follows a positive feedback loop as each improvement accelerates the next.   The process   Installing these dams required rock to be drawn from a nearby mountain into a truck that took it to the gulley’s bank in the only step of the process that was mechanised.   Locals then filled the rock into the steel-meshed gabions across the entirety of the gulley’s 3km-length, with the overall quantity of rock required entering tens of thousands of tonnes. Zebu cattle graze communal clan lands outside a small village in Somaliland, not far from the border with Ethiopia, as autumn rains are awaited after spring’s showers failed to materialise. / Mustafa Saeed   The cost of labour was made up of a mix of community contributions and a ‘cash for work’ scheme that employed locals. “Each year, the land is getting greener.   “We are no longer spending money on food, we have access to enough of our own and we can sell the surplus,” Ahmed said standing in grass up to his shins. The farmer reports that surprise, shock and then curiosity are the main reactions witnessed in visitors who see the restored area for the first time – visitors keen to learn from Ahmed’s community and roll out restoration measures on their own lands.   Bringing grasses back to bare land     There are over 2,700 crescents dug and scattered evenly across 60ha of rangeland on which 70 households graze their livestock in a village in the south-west of Somaliland. The locals dug the semi-circular soil banks by hand in 2025 in a bid to create small catchment-areas for rainfall to pool during flash floods. The hollows catch rains, allow them to soak into the rangeland and prevent the erosion caused by floods running over the land without infiltrating it.   The small structures are governed by a set of bye-laws drawn up by a local management committee and agreed to by the elders that sets out when the lands can be grazed and when they must be maintained. Shrubs, grasses and trees will initially sprout inside the half-moons where the most water pools, before spreading out and filling in the gaps between each crescent. “We are seeing this happen live with out own eyes,” Farah, one of the farmers who dug the half-moon structures said. “The vegetation is coming back and we can see tall trees even though the rain seasons have not come as well as expected.”   The 50-year-old farmer remarks that he had been living next to the rangeland for his whole life and had never seen trees rise above the soil.

items.title: From the Scramble for Africa to Somalia’s Fragmentation: Will History Repeat Itself?
items.description: By Dayib Sh. Ahmed A Nation Divided: The Legacy of Colonial Partition The Berlin Conference of 1884–1885 marked a turning point in African history. Organized by German Chancellor Otto von Bismarck styling himself as “honest broker” to alleviate fears of German hegemony from other European powers after his unification success, the conference established rules governing European colonial expansion and competition for African territories. The General Act of Berlin dated February 26, 1885, helped accelerate the Scramble for Africa, during which European powers competed for territory, natural resources, trade routes, and political influence. African leaders and communities had no representation in the negotiations that shaped their continent’s future. The consequences were profound. Colonial boundaries divided communities, disrupted established political systems, and placed territories under foreign rule. European powers prioritized their own strategic and economic interests over the wishes of African populations. The legacy of this partition continues to influence political borders, conflicts, and debates about sovereignty across Africa. Unfortunately, the Somali people experienced their own painful version of this historical division. During the colonial period, historic Somalia was divided among European colonial powers and neighboring African countries, including Ethiopia and, later, Kenya. The five territories of the divided Somali nation became Italian Somaliland, British Somaliland, French Somaliland (now Djibouti), the Northern Frontier District (NFD), now part of Kenya, and the Ogaden region, now known as the Somali Regional State within Ethiopia. These territories included the historically significant Haud and Reserved Area. In 1960, British Somaliland and the former Italian Somaliland united to establish the Somali Republic. This historic reunion fulfilled part of the Somali people’s long-standing aspiration for national unity. However, three other major Somali regional territories remained outside the new republic. Djibouti gained independence from France in 1977, Ogaden, Hawd and Reserve remained in Ethiopia, while the NFD became part of independent Kenya. The NFD referendum question illustrates the painful consequences of these colonial arrangements. A British-appointed commission reported in 1962 that the Somali populations in Garissa, Wajir, and Mandera overwhelmingly favored Reunion with Somalia. Nevertheless, Britain decided against transferring the territory to Somalia republic. Kenya became independent in December 1963 with the NFD within its borders, contributing to the conflict known as the Shufta War. These events demonstrate a fundamental historical injustice in the eyes of many Somali nationalists the aspirations of Somali communities for self-determination were not fully reflected in the territorial arrangements established at independence. More than six decades later, the question is after failing to win the aspirations of Great Somali Republic, will Somalia’s political leaders protect the unity of the core post-colonial republic or will political competition create further divisions from within? Internal Divisions, Political Ignorance, and Clan Cleavages Today, Somalia faces a serious political crisis. Disagreements over constitutional changes, electoral models, federal authority, and the distribution of political power have deepened divisions between the Federal Government and federal member states. At this point, the disputes are no longer merely administrative disagreements; they raise fundamental questions about constitutional legitimacy, national unity, and the future of the Somali state. Recent analysis has also warned that domestic political divisions and competition among external powers are reinforcing one another. At the center of this debate is President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, whose presidential mandate has already expired, and his administration’s approach to constitutional change and federal relations. Critics argue that the process has concentrated power at the federal level without achieving sufficient political consensus. Supporters of the government’s approach, however, argue that constitutional reform and a more direct electoral system are necessary to strengthen national institutions. Whatever position one takes, constitutional changes affecting the structure of the Somali state requires broad legitimacy, transparent procedures, and all-encompassing participation by the people and their representatives. My concern is that Somalia risks replacing the divisions imposed by colonial powers with divisions produced by its own political class. In my view, Somali political leaders must stop treating public institutions, regional administrations and national resources as instruments of personal political survival. Political competition is legitimate, but it becomes dangerous when leaders prioritize power, political alliances, or external support over an inclusive national settlement. The main concern here is that internal political divisions increasingly serve the strategic interests of foreign governments rather than the long-term interests of Somali people. Foreign governments naturally pursue their own interests, that is the nature of international politics. The responsibility of Somali leaders is to negotiate with those governments from a position of national unity, transparency, and public accountability. No Somali leader should be allowed to use foreign relationships and resources to undermine the country’s sovereignty, bypass constitutional responsibilities, or weaken the rights of its citizens. These concerns should be evaluated through documented agreements, public decisions, constitutional procedures, and measurable consequences not merely through political accusations. My greatest fear is that Somalia could become irreparably fragmented, with its constituent regions reduced to competing political territories and clan-based spheres of influence. The danger is not that every regional administration necessarily seeks independence. Puntland, for example, has historically advocated autonomy and federalism within Somalia, while Somaliland has pursued a separate political status although that has been elite-driven political goals than popular aspirations. These positions must be distinguished. The danger is that persistent political confrontation, unilateral decisions, and clan-based competition stemming from Mogadishu could give opportunistic elites in the periphery a convenient basis for finding common ground among themselves. Such divisions could also create openings for foreign powers pursuing their own strategic interests and allow economic exploitation, political manipulation, and growing public disillusionment to undermine Somali national unity. If federal and regional leaders continue to treat political authority as a zero-sum struggle, ordinary Somalis will bear the cost. Communities could become divided by clan, territory, competing administrations, and foreign partnerships. Public resources may be directed toward political survival rather than public utilities like education, healthcare, infrastructure, economic development, and security. At that point, Somalia could be a victim of another Berlin Conference of its own kind. It does not need a new generation of internal boundaries drawn through political bargaining, clan mobilization, or foreign strategic calculations. It needs a national settlement built on constitutional legitimacy, mutual respect, and an agreement about how power should be exercised and shared. The historical comparison is not that today’s Somali politicians are identical to nineteenth-century European colonial powers. Rather, the internal divisions, political ignorance, and clan cleavages could weaken Somalia’s national unity and undermine its ability to determine its own future. This is a warning that a country can lose control over its future when its leaders lose sight of shared national interests and allow competing interests to overwhelm collective responsibility. A Warning for the Future: The People Must Wake Up Somalia’s future cannot be left exclusively in the hands of a president whom many people consider delusional and unfit to lead, politicians, clan elders, corrupt businesspeople, or foreign interests. The Somali people must recognize that national unity is not merely a slogan used in political speeches; it requires inclusive leadership, constitutional governance, accountability, and a genuine commitment to the national interest. It requires accountable institutions, legitimate elections, constitutional government, equal citizenship, and leaders who understand that public office is a responsibility, not personal property. Citizens must demand answers. Why are constitutional disputes repeatedly resolved through political confrontation rather than inclusive agreement? Why do federal and regional leaders struggle to establish durable rules for sharing power? What safeguards ensure that agreements with foreign governments protect Somali sovereignty? Why should ordinary citizens suffer insecurity and poverty while political elites compete for offices and influence? These questions should be asked of every leader, regardless of clan, party, or political position. Somali citizens must also reject the assumption that criticism of a president or regional administration is an attack on an entire community. A political leader is not a clan, and a clan is not a political leader. National unity is only possible when citizens can question those in power without being accused of betraying their community. The public must demand transparent elections, independent oversight, accountable security institutions, fair distribution of resources, and a constitutional settlement accepted through a legitimate and inclusive process. Political leaders should agree on clear mandates, defined responsibilities, and mechanisms that prevent any individual or administration from unilaterally changing the rules for its own benefit. The international community also has a responsibility to support Somali-led reconciliation and institution-building rather than deepen political competition through selective partnerships that undermine national consensus. The Scramble for Africa divided a continent without giving its people a voice in determining their future. The division of Somali territories remains one of the most painful chapters in the history of the Somali nation. The rejoin of 1960 fulfilled part of the national aspiration, but the continued separation of Somali territories demonstrated the limits of the independence settlement. Today, Somalia faces a different but equally important test: whether its leaders can preserve national sovereignty while building a legitimate, accountable, and inclusive political system. The responsibility for preventing further fragmentation rests first and foremost with Somalia’s political leadership, but it does not end there. Citizens, civil society, intellectuals, religious leaders, the media, and the Somali diaspora must also defend constitutional government and the common national interest. We must not allow political disagreements to become permanent divisions, nor allow clan loyalty to replace citizenship. We must not allow competition for office to become more important than the survival and dignity of the nation. Somalia’s greatest danger is the possibility of losing the political responsibility, public trust, and national solidarity necessary to preserve the country. History has already shown us what happens when others decide a people’s future without their consent. We must now ensure that Somali leaders do not repeat that tragedy through internal political fragmentation. The Somali people must wake up before political rivalry turns today’s divisions into tomorrow’s irreversible realities. Dayib Sh. Ahmed Email:  Dayib0658@gmail.com —— Dayib is a writer, political analyst and WardheerNews contributor The post From the Scramble for Africa to Somalia’s Fragmentation: Will History Repeat Itself? appeared first on WardheerNews .

The legacy of this partition continues to influence political borders, conflicts, and debates about sovereignty across Africa. Unfortunately, the Somali people experienced their own painful version of this historical division. During the colonial period, historic Somalia was divided among European colonial powers and neighboring African countries, including Ethiopia and, later, Kenya. The five territories of the divided Somali nation became Italian Somaliland, British Somaliland, French Somaliland (now Djibouti), the Northern Frontier District (NFD), now part of Kenya, and the Ogaden region, now known as the Somali Regional State within Ethiopia. These territories included the historically significant Haud and Reserved Area. In 1960, British Somaliland and the former Italian Somaliland united to establish the Somali Republic. This historic reunion fulfilled part of the Somali people’s long-standing aspiration for national unity. However, three other major Somali regional territories remained outside the new republic. Djibouti gained independence from France in 1977, Ogaden, Hawd and Reserve remained in Ethiopia, while the NFD became part of independent Kenya. The NFD referendum question illustrates the painful consequences of these colonial arrangements. A British-appointed commission reported in 1962 that the Somali populations in Garissa, Wajir, and Mandera overwhelmingly favored Reunion with Somalia. Nevertheless, Britain decided against transferring the territory to Somalia republic. Kenya became independent in December 1963 with the NFD within its borders, contributing to the conflict known as the Shufta War. These events demonstrate a fundamental historical injustice in the eyes of many Somali nationalists the aspirations of Somali communities for self-determination were not fully reflected in the territorial arrangements established at independence. More than six decades later, the question is after failing to win the aspirations of Great Somali Republic, will Somalia’s political leaders protect the unity of the core post-colonial republic or will political competition create further divisions from within? Internal Divisions, Political Ignorance, and Clan Cleavages Today, Somalia faces a serious political crisis. Disagreements over constitutional changes, electoral models, federal authority, and the distribution of political power have deepened divisions between the Federal Government and federal member states. At this point, the disputes are no longer merely administrative disagreements; they raise fundamental questions about constitutional legitimacy, national unity, and the future of the Somali state. Recent analysis has also warned that domestic political divisions and competition among external powers are reinforcing one another. At the center of this debate is President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, whose presidential mandate has already expired, and his administration’s approach to constitutional change and federal relations. Critics argue that the process has concentrated power at the federal level without achieving sufficient political consensus. Supporters of the government’s approach, however, argue that constitutional reform and a more direct electoral system are necessary to strengthen national institutions. Whatever position one takes, constitutional changes affecting the structure of the Somali state requires broad legitimacy, transparent procedures, and all-encompassing participation by the people and their representatives. My concern is that Somalia risks replacing the divisions imposed by colonial powers with divisions produced by its own political class. In my view, Somali political leaders must stop treating public institutions, regional administrations and national resources as instruments of personal political survival. Political competition is legitimate, but it becomes dangerous when leaders prioritize power, political alliances, or external support over an inclusive national settlement. The main concern here is that internal political divisions increasingly serve the strategic interests of foreign governments rather than the long-term interests of Somali people. Foreign governments naturally pursue their own interests, that is the nature of international politics. The responsibility of Somali leaders is to negotiate with those governments from a position of national unity, transparency, and public accountability. No Somali leader should be allowed to use foreign relationships and resources to undermine the country’s sovereignty, bypass constitutional responsibilities, or weaken the rights of its citizens. These concerns should be evaluated through documented agreements, public decisions, constitutional procedures, and measurable consequences not merely through political accusations. My greatest fear is that Somalia could become irreparably fragmented, with its constituent regions reduced to competing political territories and clan-based spheres of influence. The danger is not that every regional administration necessarily seeks independence. Puntland, for example, has historically advocated autonomy and federalism within Somalia, while Somaliland has pursued a separate political status although that has been elite-driven political goals than popular aspirations. These positions must be distinguished. The danger is that persistent political confrontation, unilateral decisions, and clan-based competition stemming from Mogadishu could give opportunistic elites in the periphery a convenient basis for finding common ground among themselves. Such divisions could also create openings for foreign powers pursuing their own strategic interests and allow economic exploitation, political manipulation, and growing public disillusionment to undermine Somali national unity. If federal and regional leaders continue to treat political authority as a zero-sum struggle, ordinary Somalis will bear the cost. Communities could become divided by clan, territory, competing administrations, and foreign partnerships. Public resources may be directed toward political survival rather than public utilities like education, healthcare, infrastructure, economic development, and security. At that point, Somalia could be a victim of another Berlin Conference of its own kind. It does not need a new generation of internal boundaries drawn through political bargaining, clan mobilization, or foreign strategic calculations. It needs a national settlement built on constitutional legitimacy, mutual respect, and an agreement about how power should be exercised and shared. The historical comparison is not that today’s Somali politicians are identical to nineteenth-century European colonial powers. Rather, the internal divisions, political ignorance, and clan cleavages could weaken Somalia’s national unity and undermine its ability to determine its own future. This is a warning that a country can lose control over its future when its leaders lose sight of shared national interests and allow competing interests to overwhelm collective responsibility. A Warning for the Future: The People Must Wake Up Somalia’s future cannot be left exclusively in the hands of a president whom many people consider delusional and unfit to lead, politicians, clan elders, corrupt businesspeople, or foreign interests. The Somali people must recognize that national unity is not merely a slogan used in political speeches; it requires inclusive leadership, constitutional governance, accountability, and a genuine commitment to the national interest. It requires accountable institutions, legitimate elections, constitutional government, equal citizenship, and leaders who understand that public office is a responsibility, not personal property. Citizens must demand answers. Why are constitutional disputes repeatedly resolved through political confrontation rather than inclusive agreement? Why do federal and regional leaders struggle to establish durable rules for sharing power? What safeguards ensure that agreements with foreign governments protect Somali sovereignty? Why should ordinary citizens suffer insecurity and poverty while political elites compete for offices and influence? These questions should be asked of every leader, regardless of clan, party, or political position. Somali citizens must also reject the assumption that criticism of a president or regional administration is an attack on an entire community. A political leader is not a clan, and a clan is not a political leader. National unity is only possible when citizens can question those in power without being accused of betraying their community. The public must demand transparent elections, independent oversight, accountable security institutions, fair distribution of resources, and a constitutional settlement accepted through a legitimate and inclusive process. Political leaders should agree on clear mandates, defined responsibilities, and mechanisms that prevent any individual or administration from unilaterally changing the rules for its own benefit. The international community also has a responsibility to support Somali-led reconciliation and institution-building rather than deepen political competition through selective partnerships that undermine national consensus. The Scramble for Africa divided a continent without giving its people a voice in determining their future. The division of Somali territories remains one of the most painful chapters in the history of the Somali nation. The rejoin of 1960 fulfilled part of the national aspiration, but the continued separation of Somali territories demonstrated the limits of the independence settlement. Today, Somalia faces a different but equally important test: whether its leaders can preserve national sovereignty while building a legitimate, accountable, and inclusive political system. The responsibility for preventing further fragmentation rests first and foremost with Somalia’s political leadership, but it does not end there. Citizens, civil society, intellectuals, religious leaders, the media, and the Somali diaspora must also defend constitutional government and the common national interest. We must not allow political disagreements to become permanent divisions, nor allow clan loyalty to replace citizenship. We must not allow competition for office to become more important than the survival and dignity of the nation. Somalia’s greatest danger is the possibility of losing the political responsibility, public trust, and national solidarity necessary to preserve the country. History has already shown us what happens when others decide a people’s future without their consent. We must now ensure that Somali leaders do not repeat that tragedy through internal political fragmentation. The Somali people must wake up before political rivalry turns today’s divisions into tomorrow’s irreversible realities. Dayib Sh. items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo soo saartay habraac cusub oo la xiriira guurka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo saartay habraac cusub oo guurka, kaasi oo dhigaya in kaliya ay wax isku mehrin karaan garsoore ama ma’duun u diiwaan gashan dowladda. Wasaaradda ayaa xustay in habraaca cusub ee la soo saaray uu nidaaminayo diiwaangelinta ma’duunnada iyo fulinta guurka, si loo helo hannaan sharci ah oo lagu xaqiijiyo guurka, loogana hortago caqabadaha ka dhasha nidaam la’aanta. “Wasaaraddu waxay ku wargelinaysaa qof walba oo ay khusayso inay u hoggaansamaan habraacan si xal rasmi ah loogu helo dacwadaha guurka,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka ee Soomaaliya. Wasaaraddu waxay sidoo kale adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay ilaalinta sirta iyo xogta shakhsiga ah ee la xiriirta guurka, iyadoo tilmaantay in arrintani ay qayb ka tahay nidaamka cusub ee lagu maamulayo adeegyada guurka. Habraaca ayaa dhigaya in la nidaamiyo diiwaangelinta, tababarka, rukhsad-siinta iyo kormeerka ma’duunnada iyo sidoo kale habraacyada fulinta, xaqiijinta iyo diiwaangelinta guurka. Wasaaradda ayaa dhammaan dadka ay khusayso ku boorrisay inay raacaan habraaca cusub, iyadoo sidoo kale ku wargelisay hay’adaha dowladda ee ay khusayso inay gutaan waajibaadkooda la xiriira nidaaminta arrimaha guurka. Ugu dambayntiina, Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka ayaa ka codsatay bahda garsoorka, wasaaradaha caddaaladda ee dowlad-goboleedyada, maamulka gobolka Banaadir iyo hay’adaha kale ee ay khusayso inay xoojiyaan wada-shaqaynta si looga gudbo caqabadaha ka jira arrimaha guurka. The post Dowladda Soomaaliya oo soo saartay habraac cusub oo la xiriira guurka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: DF oo duminaysa dhismayaal ku dhow garoonka Aadan Cadde
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa wada qorshe lagu xoojinayo amniga Garoonka Diyaaradaha Caalamiga ah ee Aadan Cadde, kaas oo qeyb ka ah qorshe lagu rarayo ama lagu duminayo dhismayaal ku dhow garoonka. Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha Soomaaliya, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag) ayaa kormeer ku tagay garoonka, halkaas oo uu guddoomiyay shirka isku-duwidda hay’adaha ku shaqada leh amniga iyo howlaha garoonka. Kulanka ayaa lagu falanqeeyay sidii loo xoojin lahaa wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha dowladda, loo sugi lahaa badbaadada rakaabka, loona horumarin lahaa adeegyada garoonka. Waxaa sidoo kale diiradda lagu saaray kulanka qorshaha lagu rarayo ama lagu duminayo dhismayaal gaar ah oo ku dhow xarunta duulimaadyada. Wasiirka ayaa adkeeyay in mudnaan gaar ah la siiyo ilaalinta amniga garoonka Aadan Cadde, oo ah marinka ugu weyn ee duulimaadyada caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, isla markaana muhiim u ah isku xirka dalka iyo caalamka. Fartaag ayaa sidoo kale ugu baaqay hay’adaha amniga iyo kuwa duulista inay xoojiyaan wada-shaqeyntooda, si loo xaqiijiyo badbaadada rakaabka iyo habsami-u-socodka howlaha garoonka. Kormeerka waxaa sidoo kale ka qeyb-galay Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo sare. Garoonka Aadan Cadde ayaa door muhiim ah ku leh duulimaadyada ganacsiga, safarrada diblomaasiyiinta, howlaha bani’aadannimo iyo safarrada kale ee muhiimka u ah dalka. Sidaas darteed, sugidda amnigiisa iyo ilaalinta deegaanka ku hareeraysan ayaa ka mid ah arrimaha mudnaanta u leh dowladda Soomaaliya. Hase yeeshee, mas’uuliyiintu weli ma shaacin tirada dhismayaasha uu saameyn doono qorshahan, goobaha sida gaarka ah loo beegsanayo iyo waqtiga la bilaabayo rarista ama duminta dhismayaasha ku dhow xayndaabka garoonka. The post DF oo duminaysa dhismayaal ku dhow garoonka Aadan Cadde appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Shirkii golaha wasiirada Somaliland iyo waxyaabahii lagaga wada hadlay
items.description: Fadhigii 78-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada JSL oo uu Shir-guddoominayey Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) oo uu wehelinayo Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi ayaa maanta ka qabsoomay Qasriga Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Qodobbada lagaga wada hadlay Fadhiga 78-aad waxa ka mid ahaa: 𝟏. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka JSL, Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab ayaa Golaha uga xog-warramay xaaladda amniga iyo xasilloonida guud ee Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isaga oo xaqiijiyey in guud ahaan xaaladda amni ee dalku ay tahay mid wanaagsan, isla markaana aanay jirin wax amni darro ah. Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Hay’adaha kala duwan ee Amniga Qaranku ay si buuxda ugu diyaarsan yihiin ilaalinta nabadda, kala dambaynta iyo amniga Qaranka, iyada oo la sii xoojinayo wada-shaqaynta ka dhaxaysa Hay’adaha Amniga Qaranka iyo feejignaanta bulshada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland oo ah laf-dhabarta nabadda iyo xasilloonida Qaranka. 𝟐. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐂𝐚𝐚𝐟𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐚𝐝𝐤𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka JSL, Mudane Dr. Xuseen Bashiir Xirsi ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey xaaladda guud ee caafimaadka dalka, gaar ahaan xanuunka loo yaqaan Ebola oo uu keeno Virus-ka Bundibugyo, kaasi oo bishii May 2025-kii ka dillaacay Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ee Kongo (DRC), dad badanina ay u dhinteen. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha u xaqiijiyey in ilaa hadda Somaliland aanu jirin qof uu ku dhacay xanuunka Ebola, balse arrintani ay tahay khatar caafimaad oo ku soo wajahan Gobolka Geeska Afrika, gaar ahaan xagga duulimaadyada iyo isu-socodka bulshada, sidaa darteedna ay lagama maarmaan tahay in Qaran ahaan la galo feejignaan dheeraad ah iyo diyaar-garow joogto ah. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay tallaabooyinka ay qaadday Wasiirrada Horumarinta Caafimaadku oo ay ka mid yihiin: 1) Hawl-gelinta guddi joogto ah oo qaabilsan ka hortagga xanuunka Ebola, 2) Tababarka shaqaale caafimaad oo la xidhiidha xakamaynta xanuunka Ebola, 3) Xoojinta shaqaalaha caafimaadka ee ka shaqeeya garoonka diyaaradaha ee Hargeysa iyo magaalooyinka xuduudaha, 4) Xoojinta wada shaqaynta Hay’adaha Dawladda ee ay si toos ah ama si dadban u khusayso, sida Wasaaradaha Arrimaha Gudaha, Duulista, Warfaafinta, Diinta iyo Awqaafta, Waxbarashada, Hay’adda Socdaalka, Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Maroodi Jeex, Mayorka Caasimadda,…. 𝟑. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐚𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐗𝐨𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐇𝐨𝐫𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐑𝐞𝐞𝐫 𝐌𝐢𝐲𝐢𝐠𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Xannaanada Xoolaha iyo Horumarinta Reer Miyiga JSL, Mudane Dr Cumar Shucayb Maxamed ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada uga xog-warramay horumarka Mashruuca Banka Qoolcaday iyo doorka uu ku leeyahay horumarinta reer miyiga, nolosha Xoolaha iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha Qaranka. Sidoo kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay habsami-u-socodka Ololaha tallaalka iyo daaweynta Xoolaha ee ay Wasaaraddu ka fulisay Gobollada Bariga Dalka, kaas oo qayb ka ah dadaallada Qaranka ee lagu ilaalinayo caafimaadka xoolaha, laguna xoojinayo nolol-maalmeedka bulshada Xoolo dhaqatada ah. Dhinaca kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay korodhka muuqda ee ku yimid dhoofka Xoolaha iyo sida ay lagama maarmaan u tahay in la sameeyo Qorshe Qaran oo lagu horumarinayo dhaqashada, caafimaadka, wax-soo-saarka iyo daryeelka xoolaha dalka. Wasiirku waxa uu tilmaamay in ganacsiga xooluhu uu yahay laf-dhabar dhaqaale oo si toos ah u taabanaya nolosha qaybo badan oo ka mid ah bulshada JSL, sidaas darteedna loo baahan yahay in loo wajaho si ka duwan habkii hore ee dhaqashada Xoolaha. Wasiirku waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay muhimadda ay leedahay in Qaranka JSL uu si istiraatiji ah ugu diyaar-garoobo tartanka sii kordhaya ee suuqyada dhoofintooda Xoolaha, isaga oo si adag u soo jeediyey in si degdeg ah loo dhiso loona qalabeeyo Deked u gaar ah dhoofka xoolaha (Livestock Terminal in Berbera), taas oo kor u qaadi karta tayada iyo tartanka dhoofka xoolaha Somaliland. 𝟒. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐀𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐢𝐛𝐞𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐈𝐬𝐤𝐚𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐚: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibedda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Daahir Aadan Bakaal ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada la wadaagay warbixin ku saabsan habsami-u-socodka Siyaasadda Arrimaha Dibedda ee Qaranka JSL, kor u kaca muuqaalka, sumcadda iyo miisaanka diblomaasiyadeed ee JSL, iyo danaynta sii kordhaysa ee ay beesha caalamku u hayso Somaliland. Waxa uu si gaar ah u xusay guulaha diblomaasiyadeed ee laga soo hooyey safarkii shaqo ee Madaxweynaha iyo weftigiisu ay ku tageen dalka Maraykanka, isaga oo si gaar ah u tilmaamay hadalkii uu Madaxweynaha Maraykanku ka sheegay Somaliland (Somaliland waa dal ka duwan Soomaaliya) kaasi oo sare u qaaday muuqaalka Qaranka, soo jiitay indhaha caalamka, isla markaana horseeday fursado iyo xidhiidho caalami ah oo cusub, kaasi oo xoojinaya meeqaamka Somaliland iyo dadaallada ay ugu jirto xaqiijinta danaha iyo himilooyinka Qaranka. Dhinaca kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha Wasiirrada u sheegay in Wasaaraddu ay diyaarinayso hab-raacyo rasmi ah oo lagu jaan-gooynayo hab-maamuuska diblomaasiyadeed ee ay tahay in loo raaco Masuuliyiinta sare ee Qaranka JSL marka ay safarro shaqo ugu baxayaan dalalka dibedda, si loo xaqiijiyo nidaam sax ah iyo matalaad Qaran oo waafaqsan sharafta, haybadda iyo danaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. 𝟓. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐮𝐮𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐚 𝐇𝐚𝐰𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐇𝐨𝐫𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐉𝐒𝐋: Wasiir ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Duulista Hawada iyo Horumarinta Madaarrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Yuusuf Keyse Cabdillaahi ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada uga xog-warramay Nidaamka IATA-BSP, isaga oo adkeeyey mawqifka Qaranka JSL ee la xidhiidha ilaalinta madax-bannaanida maamulka hawada iyo duulimaadyada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Wasiir ku-xigeenku waxa uu Golaha u sheegay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay si adag uga soo horjeeddo faragelin kasta, tallaabo kasta ama hannaan kasta oo lagu carqaladaynayo maamulka madax-bannaan ee hawadeeda, nidaamyada duulimaadyadeeda iyo danaha dalka iyo dadka JSL. Wasiir-ku-xigeenka waxa uu si adag u dul istaagay in arrimaha la xidhiidha hawada Somaliland loo maamulayo si la mid ah xaqa uu Qaranka JSL u leeyahay ilaalinta xuduudihiisa badda, berriga iyo hawadiisa, difaaca madaxbannaanidiisa, badbaadada duulimaadyada iyo danaha muwaadiniintiisa, Qaranka JSL uu qaadi doono tallaabo kasta oo uu ku sugayo maamulka iyo amniga hawadiisa. Goluhu wuxuu isla qaatay in Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay qaadayso tallaabooyin ku habboon fara-gelinta qaawan iyo carqaladaynta ay Soomaaliya ku hayso hawada Somaliland. 𝟔. 𝐀𝐤𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐤𝐚 𝟐-𝐚𝐚𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐐𝐚𝐛𝐲𝐨-𝐪𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐗𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐤𝐚 𝐂𝐢𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐀𝐬𝐥𝐮𝐮𝐛𝐭𝐚 𝐉𝐒𝐋: Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa guda-galay akhriska 2-aad ee Qabyo-qoraalka Xeerka Ciidanka Asluubta JSL. Xeerkan oo waxtar weyn u leh Qaranka JSL, waxa Golaha faahfaahin ka siiyey ujeeddiisa iyo muhimadda Xeerka Ciidanka Asluubta Wasiirka Wasaaradda Caddaalada JSL, Mudane Yoonis Axmed Yoonis. Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Wasaaraddu ay dhammaystirtay Xeerkan, Ciidanka Asluubtuna uu muddo dheer baahi weyn u qabay, maadaama uu yahay Xeer uu waajibiyey Dastuurka JSL qodobkiisa 124-aad. Wasiirku waxa uu iftiimiyey ujeeddada Xeerka, taasoo ah maamulka Ciidanka Asluubta, qeexitaanka qaab-dhismeedka, awoodaha, waajibaadkooda, masuuliyadaha, xuquuqaha, hannaanka dallacaadaha iyo anshax marinta xubnaha Ciidanka Asluubta. Wasiirku waxa uu mar labaad Golaha Wasiirrada ka codsaday in ay soo akhriyaan, soona dersaan Qabyo-qoraalka Xeerka Ciidanka Asluubta JSL, taladoodana ku biiriyaan si loogu codeeyo fadhiyada soo socda.
items.fullContent: Fadhigii 78-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada JSL oo uu Shir-guddoominayey Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) oo uu wehelinayo Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi ayaa maanta ka qabsoomay Qasriga Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Qodobbada lagaga wada hadlay Fadhiga 78-aad waxa ka mid ahaa: 𝟏. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka JSL, Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab ayaa Golaha uga xog-warramay xaaladda amniga iyo xasilloonida guud ee Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isaga oo xaqiijiyey in guud ahaan xaaladda amni ee dalku ay tahay mid wanaagsan, isla markaana aanay jirin wax amni darro ah. Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Hay’adaha kala duwan ee Amniga Qaranku ay si buuxda ugu diyaarsan yihiin ilaalinta nabadda, kala dambaynta iyo amniga Qaranka, iyada oo la sii xoojinayo wada-shaqaynta ka dhaxaysa Hay’adaha Amniga Qaranka iyo feejignaanta bulshada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland oo ah laf-dhabarta nabadda iyo xasilloonida Qaranka. 𝟐. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐂𝐚𝐚𝐟𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐚𝐝𝐤𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka JSL, Mudane Dr. Xuseen Bashiir Xirsi ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey xaaladda guud ee caafimaadka dalka, gaar ahaan xanuunka loo yaqaan Ebola oo uu keeno Virus-ka Bundibugyo, kaasi oo bishii May 2025-kii ka dillaacay Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ee Kongo (DRC), dad badanina ay u dhinteen. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha u xaqiijiyey in ilaa hadda Somaliland aanu jirin qof uu ku dhacay xanuunka Ebola, balse arrintani ay tahay khatar caafimaad oo ku soo wajahan Gobolka Geeska Afrika, gaar ahaan xagga duulimaadyada iyo isu-socodka bulshada, sidaa darteedna ay lagama maarmaan tahay in Qaran ahaan la galo feejignaan dheeraad ah iyo diyaar-garow joogto ah. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay tallaabooyinka ay qaadday Wasiirrada Horumarinta Caafimaadku oo ay ka mid yihiin: 1) Hawl-gelinta guddi joogto ah oo qaabilsan ka hortagga xanuunka Ebola, 2) Tababarka shaqaale caafimaad oo la xidhiidha xakamaynta xanuunka Ebola, 3) Xoojinta shaqaalaha caafimaadka ee ka shaqeeya garoonka diyaaradaha ee Hargeysa iyo magaalooyinka xuduudaha, 4) Xoojinta wada shaqaynta Hay’adaha Dawladda ee ay si toos ah ama si dadban u khusayso, sida Wasaaradaha Arrimaha Gudaha, Duulista, Warfaafinta, Diinta iyo Awqaafta, Waxbarashada, Hay’adda Socdaalka, Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Maroodi Jeex, Mayorka Caasimadda,…. 𝟑. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐚𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐗𝐨𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐇𝐨𝐫𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐑𝐞𝐞𝐫 𝐌𝐢𝐲𝐢𝐠𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Xannaanada Xoolaha iyo Horumarinta Reer Miyiga JSL, Mudane Dr Cumar Shucayb Maxamed ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada uga xog-warramay horumarka Mashruuca Banka Qoolcaday iyo doorka uu ku leeyahay horumarinta reer miyiga, nolosha Xoolaha iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha Qaranka. Sidoo kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay habsami-u-socodka Ololaha tallaalka iyo daaweynta Xoolaha ee ay Wasaaraddu ka fulisay Gobollada Bariga Dalka, kaas oo qayb ka ah dadaallada Qaranka ee lagu ilaalinayo caafimaadka xoolaha, laguna xoojinayo nolol-maalmeedka bulshada Xoolo dhaqatada ah. Dhinaca kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay korodhka muuqda ee ku yimid dhoofka Xoolaha iyo sida ay lagama maarmaan u tahay in la sameeyo Qorshe Qaran oo lagu horumarinayo dhaqashada, caafimaadka, wax-soo-saarka iyo daryeelka xoolaha dalka. Wasiirku waxa uu tilmaamay in ganacsiga xooluhu uu yahay laf-dhabar dhaqaale oo si toos ah u taabanaya nolosha qaybo badan oo ka mid ah bulshada JSL, sidaas darteedna loo baahan yahay in loo wajaho si ka duwan habkii hore ee dhaqashada Xoolaha. Wasiirku waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay muhimadda ay leedahay in Qaranka JSL uu si istiraatiji ah ugu diyaar-garoobo tartanka sii kordhaya ee suuqyada dhoofintooda Xoolaha, isaga oo si adag u soo jeediyey in si degdeg ah loo dhiso loona qalabeeyo Deked u gaar ah dhoofka xoolaha (Livestock Terminal in Berbera), taas oo kor u qaadi karta tayada iyo tartanka dhoofka xoolaha Somaliland. 𝟒. items.title: Muxuu yahay shirka ay DF martigelisay ee maanta ka furmay Muqdisho?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa markii ugu horreysay martigelisay dib-u-eegista muddada dhexe ee kalfadhigii labaad ee Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Wadajirka ah Soomaaliya iyo Uganda (JPC), iyadoo sidoo kale la qabanayo Madasha Ganacsiga iyo Maalgashiga iyo Bandhigga Wadajirka ah ee labada dal. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) ayaa furay kulanka oo socon doona muddo laba maalmood ah, kaas oo looga hadlayo xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal. Ajendaha kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saari doonaa arrimaha amniga, ganacsiga, maalgashiga, dalxiiska iyo shaqaalaha, kuwaas oo loo arko dhinacyo muhiim u ah horumarinta xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Uganda. Madasha furitaanka waxaa sidoo kale ka qeyb galay wasiirrada shaqada ee labada dal, iyadoo Soomaaliya uu matalayay Prof. Saalim Caliyoow Ibroow, halka dowladda Uganda uu uga qeyb-galay Sarreeye Guuto Henry Tumukunde. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga labada dowladood, iyadoo la doonayo in la ballaariyo fursadaha wada shaqeyneed ee dhinacyada kala duwan, gaar ahaan ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga. Ujeeddada ugu weyn ee kulanka ayaa ah in mudnaan siiyo danaha ay labada dal wadaagaan, isla markaana fursadaha jira loo beddelo maalgashi iyo natiijooyin wax ku ool ah oo labada dhinacba faa’iido u leh. Martigelinta kulankan ayaa Soomaaliya siinaysa fursad ay ku xoojiso xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee ay la leedahay Uganda, iyadoo Madasha Ganacsiga iyo Maalgashigu ay abuuri karto fursado cusub oo ay ka faa’iideystaan ganacsatada labada dal. The post Muxuu yahay shirka ay DF martigelisay ee maanta ka furmay Muqdisho? appeared first on Caasimada Online .
