items.fullContent: (ERGO) – Cunno xumo, hoy la’aan iyo daruufo kale oo nololeed ayay qoysaskooda ka saareen tan iyo bishii May ee sanadkaan rag barakac ah oo ku nool xeryaha magaalada Diinsoor ee gobolka Bay. Waxaa u suuraagaliyay lacago ay ka amaahdeen bankiga Salaam oo ay ku furteen ganacsiyo kala duwan. Midkasta wuxuu qaatay $500 oo sanad uu ku bixinayo, maaddaama ay isku deegaan yihiin waxay wada u diyaarsadeen shuruudihii laga rabay oo damiin iyo waraaqahooda aqoonsigu ugu horeeyaan. Arintaas ayaa u sahashay in ay hal maalin lacagta wada qaataan. Waxaa damiintay dad hanti leh iyo qaar deegaanka laga yaqaano. Qaarkood waxay magaalada ka kiraystaan guryo leh biyo iyo koronto oo aysan horay u awoodin, taas oo isbeddel u noqotay. Axmed Liibaan Cali oo dadkaan ka mid ah wuxuu 7 May furtay dukaan uu ku iibiyo raashin tafaariikh ah iyo bagaash. Wuxuu u noqday il dhaqaale oo qoyskiisa ku hogaamisay nolol wanaagsan. Waxay joogto u helaan baahiyaha aas-aasiga ah oo cunnada ugu horayso, kuwaas oo horraan ku adkaa. “Maalgashi ayaan sameeyey oo kala duwaansho oo dhanka nolosha ah ayaan ku jirnaa. Xaaladii aadka u liidatay waa soo wanaagsanaatay. Qof wax awooda ayaa noqday.” Axmed wuxuu ka mid yahay 89 nin oo qorshaha daynta ka faa’iidaystay. Wuxuu sheegay in celcelis ahaan uu maalinkii ganacsigiisa ka helo $5 illaa $7. Lacagtaan oo uu u kala qaybiyo biilka reerkiisa oo 11 ah, waxbarashada carruurta, dukaanka iyo in uu ku yar yareeyo amaahda aya ka fududaysay culaysyo dhaqaale oo haystay. Axmed horay uma lahayn qibrad ganacsi, balse dadaalka iyo ka go’aanaanta shaqadiisa ayaa u miro dhalay. Ninkaan oo 47 jir ah ayaa sheegay in uu nolosha qoyskiisa ka maarayn jiray shaqooyin xamaal ah oo helitaankoodu adkaa. Mar ama labo ayuu toddobaadkii heli jiray waxaana ka soo gali jiray $3 illaa $4 oo aan wax badan u goyn jirin. Marka uu soo waayo wuxuu ku qasbanaa in uu dadka wax waydiisto. “Culaysyada iga fududaaday waxa kamid ah wagii hore maalin waa la qadi jiray ama hal wakhti ayaa dabka la shidan jiray, laakiin hadda waxaa la karsadaa saddex waqti. Dhibkaas waa ka baxay waxkasta waa u awoodaa.” Axmed iyo 11 kale oo kale waxaa damiintay nin ay isaga qaraabo yihiin, ragga kalena uu ku soo xiray oo bankiga dhigay shatiga ganacsigiisa iyo sabraloogada dhulalkiisa. Amaahda wuxuu saddexdii bil ee u danbaysay bixiyay min $25. Inta dhiman wuxuu qorshaynayaa in uu iska dhameeyo bilaha harsan. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay in qoyskiisa uu bishii September ka saaray xero barakac oo ay deganaayeen tan iyo 2024. Wuxuu xaafada Waabari ee Diinsoor uga kireeyay 2 qol iyo musqul oo bishii ah $50. Waxay ka baxeen hoy xumo haysay ku dhawaad 3 sano oo ay ku noolaayeen buush yar oo aan deeqin. Ganacsigaan wuxuu u suuragliyay in markii ugu horaysay uu iskuul hoose iyo dugsi Qur’aan ku daro shan carruurtiisa ah. wuxuu tilmaamay in ay murugo ku haysay daruus la’aantooda, balse uusan xal u hayn, maaddaama uu faro marnaa si dhib ahna uu ku heli jiray cunnadooda. “Waxaan awooday in aan ilmahayga ka bixiyo $25 bil kasta. Waxaan dhigtay kaydkii ugu horeeyay oo $50 ah, si aan ugu baxsado, marka ay culaysyo yimaadaan ama aan ganacsigayga ugu sii kabo oo ugu hormariyo.” Axmed ayaa sheegay in korontada iyo biyaha guriga ugu jira uu isku darkooda bishii iska dhiibo $14. Alaabta dukaanka u taalla iyo kaydka uu dhigtay wuxuu ku qiyaasay in ay gaarayaan illaa $1,000, taas oo rajo weyn u abuurtay. Qoyskiisu waxay ka soo barakaceen horraantii 2024 miyiga degmada Qansax-dheere ee gobolka Bay. Abaaro xilligiis jiray ayay ku waayeen intii u danbaysay 100 ari ah iyo 19 lo’ ah oo noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd. Wuxuu sheegay in daruuftii barakaca ay ka baxeen. Raggaan oo ah beeraley iyo xoolo dhaqato ay hore abaaruhu u saameeyeen waxay furteen ganacsiyo iskugu jira raashin, bagaash, khudaar iyo dhar. Guddi ay samaysteen oo caawin ka helaya ganacsato iyo waxgaradka deegaanka ayaa qorshahooda bankiga hor dhigay, iyadoo damiin laga yahay. Daa’uud Nuur Cali oo ka mid ah dadka ka faa’iidaystay amaahda bankiga Salaam. Wuxuu $15 ku kiraystay dukaan. Wuxuu billowgii u soo adeegay Khudaar iyo bagaash ay ugu baxday $300. Maalinle ayuu hadda uga helaa ugu yaraan $6 oo u noqotay il dhaqaale oo ay uga soo kabsadeen nolol xumo. “Ganacsigaan sidaan u dhexgalay waa ka ku faa’iiday. Qof ayaa gacan igu siiyay {I damiintay}. Culaysyadii waa ka soo gudbay carruurtayda si wanaagsan ayaan u maareeyaa.” Daa’uud ayaa markii hore qoyskiisa oo 8 ah ka maarayn jiray shaqooyin dhisme oo maalinka uu helo ay ka oo gali jirtay $4. Mararka qaar wuxuu sheegay in toddobaadka dhan uu waayi jiray ama uu hal maalin helayay. Bilihii Luulyo, Agoosto iyo September wuxuu sheegay in uu iska bixiyay sagaashan dollar oo dayntii bankiga ka mid ah. Waxaa ku harsan $410 oo uu sii bixin doono. Wuxuu tilmaamay in ay wax weyn uga dhigan tahay baahiyaha reerkiisa ee uu xalliyay. Sanado uu barakaca ku noolaa fursadaan oo kale ma soo marin. Dadkaan qofkasta waxaa la waydiiyay bishii inta uu bixin karo amaahda. Daa’uud wuxuu xusay in uu doortay in bil walba uu iska dhiibo $30, halka bilaha lacago dheeraad ah uu helo uu kordhin karo. “Shaqadaan ayaa ii suuragalisay dayn $50 ah oo magaalada la iiga lahaa in iska dhiibay. Guri 2 qol oo min $25 ah ayaan kiraystay. Hoy la’aanta, markii hore dhibaato ayay nagu ahayd. Buush aan roobka iyo kulaylka midna celinayn ayaan ku jirnay, Faa’iido ayaan dareemayaa hadda.” Ninkaan waxay qoyskiisa oo beeraley iyo xoolo dhaqato isku ahaa ay ka yimaadeen sanadkii 2023 deegaanka Oflow oo gobolka Bay ka tirsan. Roob yari xilligaas jirtay ayay kaga nacfi beeshay beer 3 hektar ah, waxaana uga dhamaaday 70 ari ah oo ay dhaqanayeen, taas oo barakaca ku qasabtay. Aweys Xasan Mayow oo ka mid ah dadka damiintay raggaan ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in talaabadaan ay qoysas badan fursad u noqotay. Wuxuu tilmaamay in iyagoo reerahooda ka biilaya, dayntii yar yaraynaya, haddana uu kobac sameeyay ganacsigoodu. Ninkaan ayaa tilmaamay in illaa iyo hadda aysan soo gaarin cabasho weyn oo ku saabsan caqabado ay la kulmeen ganacsatadaan billowga ah, taas oo wax weyn uga dhigan. “Waxay gaareen isbeddel aad u wanaagsan. Qaarkood lacagta wax badan ayaa ku dhiman, balse guusha ay gaareen darteed dhawaan waa iska bixin karaan.” Aweys waa qofka damiintay Axmed iyo ragga kale ee saaxiibadiis ah. Wuxuu magaalada Diinsoor ku leeyahay bakhaar lagu iibiyo qalabka dhismaha iyo guryaha. Wuxuu xusay in talaabadaan uu u qaaday si ay nolol u helaan dadka barakacay ee waayay ilihii ay ku tiirsanaayeen. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay in ay kormeer ku sameeyaan dadkaan si ay ula socdaan qaabka ay shaqadu u tahay. Lacagaha ay billaha u bixiyaan iyo haddii ay caqabado la kulmaan in ay la xalliyaan. Wuxuu sheegay in ay u soo jeediyeen in ay samaystaan kayd dhigasho ay ku midaysan yihiin. Si haddii ay caqabad ku timaado qof ka mid ah loogu taageero. Bishii sagaallaad ayay billaabeen in ay akoon ku aruuriyaan min hal dollar oo ka dhexeeya, ayna markale u baxsan karaaan. Aweys ayaa sheegay in ay qorshaynayaan in marka ay kuwaan dhameeyaan amaahda ay dadkale damiintaan, si noloshooda ay ugu filaadaan oo barakaca ay uga baxaan qoysas badan. items.title: Maxaa ka cusub xaaladda Koonfur Galbeed? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimada Soomaaliya waxaa weli kasii socda kulamo xal loogu raadinayo Koonfur Galbeed oo ay weli ka jiraan xaalado siyaasadeed iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo u dhexeeya dhinacyada isku haya maamulkaasi. Guddi iskiis isugu xilqaamay nabadeynta Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, ayaa maanta kulan gaar ah la yeeshay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), kuwaas oo ka kooban ganacsato, culimo iyo qurba-joog. Ugu horreyn Jaamac ayaa guddiga ka dhageystay talooyin wax-ku-ool ah iyo aragtiyo muhiim ah oo ku saabsan horumarinta dowlad-dhiska, xoojinta dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada, adkeynta nabadda iyo xasilloonida. Intaas kadib guddoomiyaha ayaa bogaadiyey dadaalka iyo doorka ay qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshadu ka qaadanayaan nabadeynta, wadajirka iyo horumarka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, waxaana kulanka ka qeyb galay Xildhibaano ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya Dhinaca kale, madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo haatan ku sugan magaalada Muqdisho ayaa isna wada kulamo xasaasi ah oo uu la yeelanayo madaxda dowladda dhexe iyo siyaasiyiinta kasoo jeedo deegaannadaasi, isaga oo si gaar ah ugala hadlayo xaaladda kasii dareysa ee ka taagan gobolka Baay, maadaama ay degmooyin badan qabsadeen ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Aadan Madoobe ayaa shalay la kulmay hoggaamiyihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Shariif Xasan Sheekh Aadan oo ay ka wada-hadleen xaaladda guud ee deegaannada maamulkaasi, gaar ahaan arrimaha amniga, siyaasadda, nabadeynta, dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada iyo dib u xureynta degmooyinka ay qabsadeen ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Sheekh Aadan Madoobe iyo Shariif Xasan ayaa sidoo kale is-weydaarsaday aragtiyo ku saabsan muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta nabadda, midnimada iyo wadajirka bulshada, iyadoo la adkeynayo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo xasilloonida siyaasadeed iyo amni ee deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa haatan qorseyneysa inay qaado guluf ka dhan ah ciidanka taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ee qabsaday degmooyinka Qansaxdeere, Bardaale, Buurhakaba iyo Diinsoor oo ka wada tirsn gobolka Baay. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa kusoo aaday xi lli ay haatan sii xoogeysanayaan khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen iyo kuwa taageersan maamulka hadda ka jira Baydhaba, oo garab ka helaya Dowladda Federaalka.   The post Maxaa ka cusub xaaladda Koonfur Galbeed? + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia’s opposition launches first court challenge to new constitution
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s Supreme Court has given the federal government until Thursday to present its defense in a case filed by opposition leader Sharif Sheikh Ahmed seeking to annul a controversial new constitution. Regional states opposed to the president, together with the opposition, call the charter unilateral, arguing that it was drafted solely by the current leadership and its circus. It was approved in March in the absence of opposition members of parliament, who had been blocked from the session. President Hassan Sheikh hailed the document as a new chapter for Somalia. Puntland, Jubaland and the opposition, however, say they do not recognize it and continue to recognize the 2012 draft constitution. That text, unlike the new one, was drafted under a broad-based agreement among all of the country’s political stakeholders, which made it a constitution recognized by all as national. Many say the opposition’s case is a test of the court’s independence. Many have alleged for years that the court is not independent of the executive, and that for decades Somalia’s judiciary has never become independent, with its decisions shaped by political decisions from the top. For its part, the federal government is looking for avenues to win the case, or at least to halt the court’s proceedings. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Dowladda Ireland oo shaaca ka qaaday in ay ka cabsi qabto in 22 caruur Soomaali ah la…
items.description: Dublin (Caasimada Online) — Hay’adda daryeelka carruurta iyo qoysaska ee dalka Ireland (Tusla) ayaa booliska dalkaas ku wargelisay tuhun xooggan oo la xiriira in 22 carruur Soomaali ah oo dalkaas tagay iyagoo aan qoyskoodu wehelin (unaccompanied minors) ay noqdeen dhibanayaal loo gaystay tahriibinta iyo ka-ganacsiga dadka (human trafficking), sida uu Talaadadii shaaciyay wargeyska The Irish Examiner . Tusla ayaa tirokoob ay siisay wargeyska ku caddeysay inay sannadkan walaac dhanka ka-ganacsiga dadka ah ka muujisay 35 carruur ah oo dalkaas soo gaaray, iyadoo carruurta Soomaalida ahna ay noqdeen ku dhawaad saddex meelood laba meel tirada guud ee kiisaska laga shakisan yahay. Wargelinta loo gudbiyay laamaha amniga ayaa ku kooban tuhun laga qabo tahriibin, mana aha mid si rasmi ah u xaqiijinaya in carruurtan ay dhammaantood dhibanayaal noqdeen. Hay’adda Tusla kama aysan hadlin kiisaska shakhsiga ah, sidoo kale wargeysku ma uusan soo bandhigin da’da carruurta, waddooyinkii ay dalka ku soo galeen, iyo nooca dhiig-miirashada ee looga shakisan yahay. Carruurta kale ee la xiriira digniintan ayaa waxaa ka mid ah shan u dhalatay dalka Afgaanistaan, min laba ka soo jeeda dalalka Vietnam, Ereteriya iyo Gambia, iyo min hal carruur ah oo ka yimid Guinea iyo Pakistan. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in Soomaaliya, Afgaanistaan iyo Ukraine ay yihiin dalalka ugu badan ee ay ka soo jeedaan carruurta keligood yimid ee hadda ku jira xarumaha daryeelka ee Tusla. “Inta badan carruurta iyo dhallinyarada keligood ku yimaada Ireland waxay ka soo cararayaan dagaallo ama qalalaase bani’aadannimo oo ka taagan dalalkooda,” ayuu afhayeen u hadlay Tusla u sheegay wargeyska, isagoo xusay in carruurta waalidkood ka maqan yihiin ay wajahaan dhibaatooyin maskaxeed, go’doon, caqabado xagga luqadda ah iyo hubanti-la’aan ku aaddan mustaqbalkooda. Dul-duleellada dhanka aqoonsiga dhibanayaasha Guddiga Xuquuqda Aadanaha iyo Sinnaanta ee Ireland (IHREC) ayaa bishii Sebtembar ee la soo dhaafay uga digay dowladda in dalku ku fashilmay inuu si rasmi ah u aqoonsado dhibanayaal badan oo carruur ah oo loo geystay tahriibinta dadka. Warbixinta guddiga ayaa muujisay in laamaha amnigu ay si rasmi ah u aqoonsadeen 18 carruur ah oo dhibanayaal noqday sannadkii 2025, halka 2024-kii ay ahaayeen 10 carruur ah, iyadoo labadaas sano midna aysan ku jirin carruur u dhalatay Ireland. Warbixinta ayaa si gaar ah farta ugu fiiqday halista ay wajahayaan carruurta aan cidina wehelin iyo kuwa ku jira xarumaha daryeelka dowladda, maadaama aysan helin ilaalin iyo taageero gaar ah. Waxaa sidoo kale warbixinta lagu sheegay in boolisku aysan inta badan u aqoonsan dhibanayaal carruurta loo adeegsado falalka dambiyada ah, sababo la xiriira jahwareer ka taagan qeexitaanka sharciga ee tahriibinta dadka. Guddigu wuxuu caddeeyay in tahriibinta carruurtu aysan shardi ka dhigayn in xuduud laga tallaabiyo ama xoog la adeegsado, balse qorashada carruurta ee ujeeddooyinka dhiig-miirashada ah ay ku filan tahay qeexitaanka dambigaas. Teresa Buczkowska, madaxa fulinta ee Golaha Muhaajiriinta Ireland (Immigrant Council of Ireland), ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku tiri: “Dhibanayaal aad u tiro badan ayaan la aqoonsanayn, xitaa marka la aqoonsadana had iyo jeer ma helaan ilaalintii iyo taageeradii ficilka ahayd ee ay u baahnaayeen.” Dib-u-dhac ku yimid hirgelinta shuruucda Sharci la ansixiyay sannadkii 2024 ayaa dhigayay in hay’ado kale oo madax-bannaan ay booliska la wadaagaan awoodda rasmiga ah ee lagu aqoonsanayo dhibanayaasha tahriibinta. Wasiirka Caddaaladda ee Ireland, Jim O’Callaghan, ayaa qoraal uu u gudbiyay baarlamaanka ku xaqiijiyay in xukuumaddu ay ka go’an tahay xoojinta Nidaamka Gudbinta Qaranka (NRM) ee lagu caawiyo dhibanayaasha, balse wuxuu qiray in qorshuhu uu la kulmay caqabado shaqo, gaar ahaan sidii isbeddelladan lala jaanqaadsiin lahaa nidaamka socdaalka iyo magangalyada dalka. Wasiirka ayaa tilmaamay in xilligan booliska dalka (An Garda Síochána) ay yihiin cidda kaliya ee si sharci ah u aqoonsan karta dhibanayaasha, inkasta oo dowladdu ay waddo qorshe tallaabo-tallaabo ah oo awooddaas lagu siinayo hay’ado dheeraad ah. items.fullContent: Dublin (Caasimada Online) — Hay’adda daryeelka carruurta iyo qoysaska ee dalka Ireland (Tusla) ayaa booliska dalkaas ku wargelisay tuhun xooggan oo la xiriira in 22 carruur Soomaali ah oo dalkaas tagay iyagoo aan qoyskoodu wehelin (unaccompanied minors) ay noqdeen dhibanayaal loo gaystay tahriibinta iyo ka-ganacsiga dadka (human trafficking), sida uu Talaadadii shaaciyay wargeyska The Irish Examiner . Tusla ayaa tirokoob ay siisay wargeyska ku caddeysay inay sannadkan walaac dhanka ka-ganacsiga dadka ah ka muujisay 35 carruur ah oo dalkaas soo gaaray, iyadoo carruurta Soomaalida ahna ay noqdeen ku dhawaad saddex meelood laba meel tirada guud ee kiisaska laga shakisan yahay. Wargelinta loo gudbiyay laamaha amniga ayaa ku kooban tuhun laga qabo tahriibin, mana aha mid si rasmi ah u xaqiijinaya in carruurtan ay dhammaantood dhibanayaal noqdeen. Hay’adda Tusla kama aysan hadlin kiisaska shakhsiga ah, sidoo kale wargeysku ma uusan soo bandhigin da’da carruurta, waddooyinkii ay dalka ku soo galeen, iyo nooca dhiig-miirashada ee looga shakisan yahay. Carruurta kale ee la xiriira digniintan ayaa waxaa ka mid ah shan u dhalatay dalka Afgaanistaan, min laba ka soo jeeda dalalka Vietnam, Ereteriya iyo Gambia, iyo min hal carruur ah oo ka yimid Guinea iyo Pakistan. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in Soomaaliya, Afgaanistaan iyo Ukraine ay yihiin dalalka ugu badan ee ay ka soo jeedaan carruurta keligood yimid ee hadda ku jira xarumaha daryeelka ee Tusla. “Inta badan carruurta iyo dhallinyarada keligood ku yimaada Ireland waxay ka soo cararayaan dagaallo ama qalalaase bani’aadannimo oo ka taagan dalalkooda,” ayuu afhayeen u hadlay Tusla u sheegay wargeyska, isagoo xusay in carruurta waalidkood ka maqan yihiin ay wajahaan dhibaatooyin maskaxeed, go’doon, caqabado xagga luqadda ah iyo hubanti-la’aan ku aaddan mustaqbalkooda. Dul-duleellada dhanka aqoonsiga dhibanayaasha Guddiga Xuquuqda Aadanaha iyo Sinnaanta ee Ireland (IHREC) ayaa bishii Sebtembar ee la soo dhaafay uga digay dowladda in dalku ku fashilmay inuu si rasmi ah u aqoonsado dhibanayaal badan oo carruur ah oo loo geystay tahriibinta dadka. Warbixinta guddiga ayaa muujisay in laamaha amnigu ay si rasmi ah u aqoonsadeen 18 carruur ah oo dhibanayaal noqday sannadkii 2025, halka 2024-kii ay ahaayeen 10 carruur ah, iyadoo labadaas sano midna aysan ku jirin carruur u dhalatay Ireland. Warbixinta ayaa si gaar ah farta ugu fiiqday halista ay wajahayaan carruurta aan cidina wehelin iyo kuwa ku jira xarumaha daryeelka dowladda, maadaama aysan helin ilaalin iyo taageero gaar ah. Waxaa sidoo kale warbixinta lagu sheegay in boolisku aysan inta badan u aqoonsan dhibanayaal carruurta loo adeegsado falalka dambiyada ah, sababo la xiriira jahwareer ka taagan qeexitaanka sharciga ee tahriibinta dadka. Guddigu wuxuu caddeeyay in tahriibinta carruurtu aysan shardi ka dhigayn in xuduud laga tallaabiyo ama xoog la adeegsado, balse qorashada carruurta ee ujeeddooyinka dhiig-miirashada ah ay ku filan tahay qeexitaanka dambigaas. items.title: Iran oo sheegtay inaysan Mareykanka la hadli doonin ilaa laga fuliyo
items.description: Iran ayaa taliyaha ciidamada Pakistan u sheegtay inaysan wada-hadallo la geli doonin Mareykanka ilaa laga fuliyo shuruudaha ay dejisay. Warbaahinta Iran ayaa sheegtay in madaxweynaha dalkaas, Masoud Pezeshkian, uu magaalada Tehran kula kulmay taliyaha ciidamada Pakistan, Field Marshal Asim Munir, ayna ka wada hadleen dadaallada socda ee wada-xaajoodka iyo xaaladaha gobolka. Pakistan ayaa door muhiim ah ka ciyaaraysa dhexdhexaadinta u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iran. Dadaallo hore oo lagu doonayay in lagu gaaro heshiis nabadeed ayaa horseeday is-afgarad hordhac ah bishii Juun ee sannadkii hore, balse heshiiskaasi wuxuu burburay toddobaadyo kaddib markii ay mar kale xoogaysteen xiisadaha u dhexeeya labada dal. Munir ayaa sidoo kale kulan la yeeshay guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka Iran, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf. Bayaan ay Iran soo saartay oo ku saabsan kulanka ayaa lagu sheegay in Tehran aysan dib u heli doonin kalsoonida Washington ilaa Mareykanku fuliyo toddobada shuruudood ee Iran ay bishii hore u dejisay dib u furista marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Shuruudahaas waxaa ka mid ah in Mareykanku qaado xayiraadaha saaran dekedaha Iran, uu joojiyo cunaqabateynta dhoofinta shidaalka Iran, isla markaana la soo afjaro colaadaha ka socda dhammaan jihooyinka gobolka. Madaxa sirdoonka Iran, Mohsen Rezaei, ayaa farriin la mid ah u gudbiyay Munir intii uu la hadlayay. Warbaahinta Iran ayaa sheegtay in Tehran aysan wada-hadallo la geli doonin Washington ilaa laga fuliyo dalabaadkeeda. Rezaei ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dhammaan uranium-ka la kobciyay uu ku sii nagaan doono gudaha Iran. Hadalkiisa ayaa la jaanqaadaya mowqifka hoggaamiyaha sare ee Iran, Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, oo sheegay in uranium-ka la gaarsiiyay heer lagu samayn karo hub aan loo wareejin doonin dal kale. Bbc somali

items.title: Ciidamada Militariga oo ku sii siqaya Degmada Buurhakaba
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Degmada Wanlaweyn ee Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose ayaa sheegaya in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ay ka tallaabeen xadka gobolkaasi uu la wadaago Gobolka Baay, isla-markaana ay ku sii jeedaan Degmada Buurhakaba, si ay degmadaasi ugu soo celiyaan gacanta Dowladda Federaalka iyo tan Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in hawlgalkan ay hoggaaminayaan unugyo ka tirsan Kumaandooska Gorgor iyo Danab, oo ka mid ah Ciidanka Gaarka ee Somaliya. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Guutada 7aad, Qaybta 12-ka April ee Xoogga Dalka ay qayb ka yihiin hawlgalka. Ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa Khamiistii dagaal kula wareegay gacan ku haynta Buurhakaba, oo qiyaastii 60km u jirta Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. Ciidamadan ayaa sidoo kale Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed kala wareegay Degmooyinka Berdaale, Diinsoor, Qansaxdheere iyo deegaanada hoostaga Baydhabo. Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo habeenkii Axadda Magaalada Muqdisho kula kulmay Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal ee deegaan doorashadoodu tahay Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sheegay in uu socdo guluf ciidan, oo sida uu sheegay argagixisada dib looga saarayo Degmooyinka Gobolka Baay ee ay qabsadeen. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaad mooddaa in ay Buurhakaba ka dhigeen barta koowaad ee hawlgalka ay ciidamada dib ugu la wareegayaan degmooyinkaasi. Buurhakaba oo magaalo istiraatiiji ah ayaa saaran jidka weyn ee isku xira Muqdisho iyo Baydhabo, waxayna door muhiim ah ka qaadataa isu socodka badeecadaha ka yimaada Dekedda Muqdisho ee la geeyo Baydhabo, deegaanada Gobolka Baay iyo gobolada kale ee deriska la ah.

items.title: UK oo 12 sano ku xukuntay Maxamed Maxamuud kadib markii uu Somalia usoo aaday…
items.description: London (Caasimada Online) — Maxkamadda Old Bailey ee magaalada London ayaa 12 sano oo xabsi ah ku xukuntay Maxamed Maxamuud oo ah 22 jir asalkiisu Soomaali yahay oo degganaa magaalada Bristol, kaddib markii lagu helay dambiga ah inuu u safray Soomaaliya si uu ugu biiro kooxda Daacish (IS), isaga oo qorsheynayay inuu ku dhex dhinto dagaallada kooxdaas. Maxamed, oo ku dhashay Soomaaliya, shaqadiisana aheyd waardiye (security guard), ayaa bishii Janaayo 2025 u safray Bariga Afrika. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu ku guuldarreystay inuu gaaro goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin dagaalyahannada kooxda sababo la xiriira howlgallada la-dagaallanka argagixisada ee UK, taasoo ku qasabtay inuu dalkaas dib ugu laabto laba bilood kaddib, gaar ahaan 3-dii bishii Maarso. Kaddib maxkamadeyn bishii Ogosto ka dhacday Maxkamadda Winchester Crown, ayaa Maxamed lagu helay dambiga ah inuu u diyaar-garoobay falal argagixisanimo. Garsooraha xukunka riday, Mr Justice Lickley, ayaa Isniintii Maxamed ku yiri: “Waxaad sameysay wax kasta oo aad awoodday si aad ugu biirto Daacish, waxaana kaa hor istaagay arrimo ka baxsan awooddaada.” Xagjirnimada internet-ka iyo “AI Bots” Xubnaha xeer-beegtida ayaa loo sheegay in Maxamed uu sannadkii 2024-kii xagjir ku noqday muuqaallo mayal-adag oo uu si joogto ah uga daawan jiray baraha bulshada ee YouTube iyo TikTok. Maxamed, oo sannadkii 2017-kii u soo guuray UK si uu ugu biiro qaar ka mid ah xubnaha qoyskiisa, ayaa xiriir la yeeshay barnaamijyada ku shaqeeya sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI bots) oo ay Daacish u adeegsato kala shaandheynta dadka cusub ee doonaya inay kooxda ku biiraan. Waxaa sidoo kale baaritaanka lagu helay wada-sheekeysi dhanka Telegram-ka ah oo uu kaga codsaday in laga caawiyo sidii uu ugu safri lahaa Soomaaliya si uu ugu biiro “Mujaahidiinta”, isagoo fariin ku caddeeyay in himiladiisa koowaad ay tahay inuu “shahiido”. Xeer-ilaaliye Naomi Parsons ayaa maxkamadda u sheegtay in markii uu Maxamed gaaray Soomaaliya uu awoodi waayay inuu gaaro dagaalyahannada maadaama colaaddu ay aad u xoogganayd. Xogtii laga helay taleefanka Maxamed Booliska la-dagaallanka argagixisada ee UK ayaa Maxamed xiray sannad kaddib markii uu dalka ku soo laabtay. Xogta laga helay taleefankiisa gacanta ayaa muujisay inuu ku sugnaa meelo kala duwan oo Soomaaliya ka mid ah intii u dhaxeysay bilihii Janaayo iyo Maarso 2025. Taleefanka ayaa sidoo kale laga helay muuqaallo borobogaando u ah kooxda Daacish oo muujinaya qoor-goyn, dilal toogasho iyo goobo dagaal, iyo farriimo uu diray markii uu dalka dib ugu soo laabtay oo uu ku sheegayay inuu weli doonayo inuu naftiisa u huro “jihaad”. Waxaa intaas dheer inuu xiriir la lahaa dadkii dagaal-yahannada u qorayay kooxda, isagoo ku yiri: “Waqti kasta oo aad hadalka dhahdaan, waan soo laabanayaa.” Maxkamadda ayaa sidoo kale loo sheegay in kooxda Daacish ay u soo bandhigtay inuu basaas ahaan ugu shaqeeyo, balse uu diiday isagoo ka baqay in xiriirka qoyskiisa Soomaaliyeed awgeed si fudud loo aqoonsan karo. Difaaca qareenka iyo go’aanka garsooraha Garsoore Justice Lickley ayaa xusay in aysan caddayn howshii loo xilsaari lahaa haddii uu aagga dagaalka gaari lahaa, isagoo ku raacay xeer-ilaalinta in aagga colaadda ee Soomaaliya uu ahaa “aag dil”, qof kasta oo cusubna uu filan karay fursad sare oo dhimasho ah. Dhanka difaaca, qareen Dominic Thomas ayaa sheegay in inkasta oo Maxamed uu sameeyay hadallo nacasnimo ah oo aan wanaagsanayn tan iyo markii uu UK ku laabtay, haddana uusan wax isku day ah u sameynin inuu dib ugu laabto Soomaaliya. Qareenka ayaa xusay in Maxamed uu u tagay halkaas inuu dagaallamo oo uu dhinto, balse xilligaas ay Daacish maalin kasta luminaysay saldhigyo iyo dhulal badan, uuna hadda dib ka garwaaqsaday khaladkii ku jiray qorshihiisa, gaar ahaan maadaama qoyskiisu ay guud ahaan ka soo horjeedaan kooxdaas. Maxamed Maxamuud, oo ku labisnaa dhar nooca tababarka ah oo buluug ah (blue tracksuit) isla markaana aan wax shucuur ah muujin intii dacwaddiisu socotay, ayaa garsooruhu ku adkeeyay in ilaa iyo inta uu ka beddelayo “caqiidadiisa xagjirka ah” uu weli halis weyn ku yahay bulshada, waxaana lagu xukumay 12 sano oo xabsi ah. Taleefanka ayaa sidoo kale laga helay muuqaallo borobogaando u ah kooxda Daacish oo muujinaya qoor-goyn, dilal toogasho iyo goobo dagaal, iyo farriimo uu diray markii uu dalka dib ugu soo laabtay oo uu ku sheegayay inuu weli doonayo inuu naftiisa u huro “jihaad”. Waxaa intaas dheer inuu xiriir la lahaa dadkii dagaal-yahannada u qorayay kooxda, isagoo ku yiri: “Waqti kasta oo aad hadalka dhahdaan, waan soo laabanayaa.” Maxkamadda ayaa sidoo kale loo sheegay in kooxda Daacish ay u soo bandhigtay inuu basaas ahaan ugu shaqeeyo, balse uu diiday isagoo ka baqay in xiriirka qoyskiisa Soomaaliyeed awgeed si fudud loo aqoonsan karo. Difaaca qareenka iyo go’aanka garsooraha Garsoore Justice Lickley ayaa xusay in aysan caddayn howshii loo xilsaari lahaa haddii uu aagga dagaalka gaari lahaa, isagoo ku raacay xeer-ilaalinta in aagga colaadda ee Soomaaliya uu ahaa “aag dil”, qof kasta oo cusubna uu filan karay fursad sare oo dhimasho ah. Dhanka difaaca, qareen Dominic Thomas ayaa sheegay in inkasta oo Maxamed uu sameeyay hadallo nacasnimo ah oo aan wanaagsanayn tan iyo markii uu UK ku laabtay, haddana uusan wax isku day ah u sameynin inuu dib ugu laabto Soomaaliya. Qareenka ayaa xusay in Maxamed uu u tagay halkaas inuu dagaallamo oo uu dhinto, balse xilligaas ay Daacish maalin kasta luminaysay saldhigyo iyo dhulal badan, uuna hadda dib ka garwaaqsaday khaladkii ku jiray qorshihiisa, gaar ahaan maadaama qoyskiisu ay guud ahaan ka soo horjeedaan kooxdaas. Maxamed Maxamuud, oo ku labisnaa dhar nooca tababarka ah oo buluug ah (blue tracksuit) isla markaana aan wax shucuur ah muujin intii dacwaddiisu socotay, ayaa garsooruhu ku adkeeyay in ilaa iyo inta uu ka beddelayo “caqiidadiisa xagjirka ah” uu weli halis weyn ku yahay bulshada, waxaana lagu xukumay 12 sano oo xabsi ah. items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo jawaab adag ka bixisay khariidadii ay soo bandhigtay Israel
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u cambaareysay, una diidday khariidad lagu soo bandhigay shir jaraa’id oo uu dhowaan qabtay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu, taas oo muujineysa Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo kala qaybsan, isla markaana ka hor imaaneysa xuduudaha caalamku aqoonsan yahay ee dalka. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Soomaaliya ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay in khariidaddaasi ay tahay mid marin-habaabin ah, isla markaana xadgudub ku ah madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale xaqiijisay sida ay uga go’an tahay ilaalinta madax-bannaanida qaranka, midnimada dhuleed iyo wadajirka Soomaaliya, iyadoo xustay in arrimahaasi ay ku cad yihiin Dastuurka dalka, Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay iyo Axdiga Aasaasiga ah ee Midowga Afrika. Sidoo kale, dowladda Federaalka ayaa caddeysay in dhulka Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ku jiraan Somaliland iyo Puntland, ay yihiin qaybo ka mid ah qaranka Soomaaliyeed ee midaysan, isla markaana aan laga goyn karin Soomaaliya. “Dhulalka Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ku jiraan Somaliland iyo Puntland, waa qaybo ka mid ah qaranka Soomaaliyeed ee midaysan, mana aha kuwo laga goyn karo,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka oo ku qornaa luqadda English-ka. Wuxuu bayaanka intaas kusii daray in isku day kasta oo lagu doonayo in dib loogu sawiro, si khaldan loogu muujiyo ama lagu wiiqo khariidadda siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya uu yahay xadgudub toos ah oo ka dhan ah sharciga caalamiga ah. “Isku day kasta oo ay sameeyaan dhinacyo dibadeed ama mas’uuliyiin ajnabi ah oo lagu doonayo in dib loogu sawiro, si khaldan loogu muujiyo ama lagu wiiqo khariidadda siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, waa xadgudub toos ah oo ka dhan ah sharciga caalamiga ah, waana jebin aan la aqbali karin oo lagu sameynayo mabaadi’da aasaasiga ah ee diblomaasiyadda,” ayaa laraaciyay. Dhinaca kale, Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in tallaabooyinka noocaas ah ay ka hor imaanayaan mabaadi’da aasaasiga ah ee diblomaasiyadda, ayna yihiin kuwo aan la aqbali karin, iyadoo ugu baaqday saaxiibbada caalamka iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah inay ixtiraamaan madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Ugu dambeyn, dowladda Federaalka ayaa ku celisay inay si buuxda uga go’an tahay difaaca madax-bannaanida qaranka iyo ilaalinta midnimada shacabka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto gudashada waajibaadkeeda dastuuriga ah ee ku aaddan dhowrista midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalka. The post DF Soomaaliya oo jawaab adag ka bixisay khariidadii ay soo bandhigtay Israel appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Netanyahu oo ogolaansho ka raadinaya Mohammed bin Salman, si Israel dagaalka uga qayb qaadato
items.description: Raysal Wasaaraha Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa isku dayaya inuu heshiis la galo Sacuudiga, si ay gacan uga siiyaan dagaalka ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta Yemen, sida laga soo xigtay ilo diblomaasiyadeed. Warbaahinta Israel ayaa ku warameysa in Israel ay taageeradeeda militari ku xirtay shuruud ah in Sacuudigu uu ogolaado inuu caadiyeeyo amaba hagaajiyo xiriirka labada dal. Wargeyska Haaretz oo kale ayaa daabacay in Netanyahu uu doonayo inuu adeegsado dhexdhexaadinta Mareykanka, si uu Sacuudiga uga helo ogolaansho ogolanaaya in Ciidamada Israel ay si toos ah u duqeeyaan kaabeyaasha Xuutiyiinta ee gudaha Yemen, si taasi ay u noqoto waddo loo maro aqoonsi rasmi ah iyo iskaashi dhanka amniga ah oo dhex mara labada dal. Warbixinta ayaa intaasi ku dartay in Netanyahu uu ku dadaalayo in uu helo ogolaanshaha Sacuudi Carabiya, si Israel ay ugu lug yeelato fara-gelinta militari ee dalkaasi Yemen. Wargeyska The Jerusalem Post ayaa sidoo kale qoray in Netanyahu uu shuruuddiisa uga gol leeyahay in labada dal ay yeeshaan xiriir horseedi kara in mustaqbalka la gaaro heshiis nabadeed. Hase yeeshee Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Mohammed bin Salman ayaa ka gaabsaday inuu ogolaado fara-gelinta Israel ee dagaalka, iyadoo la sheegay inuu aaminsan yahay in tallaabadaasi aysan si wanaagsan u soo dhaweyn doonin shacabka Sacuudiga. Sacuudiga ayaan marnaba aqoonsan Dowladnimada Israel, tan iyo markii la aasaasay sanadkii 1948-kii, wuxuuna mar kasta uu aqoonsiga Israel ku xiraa shuruud ah in la helo dowlad madaxbannaan oo Falastiiniyiinta ay leeyihiin. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Sacuudiga, Faisal bin Farhan Al-Saud ayaa dhowr jeer oo hore sheegay in uusan jiri doonin xiriir caadi ah oo labada dal ay yeeshaan, iyadoo aan xal loo helin Dowladnimada Falastiin. Riyadh ayaa waxay marar badan xaqiijisay inaan wax xiriir diblomaasiyadeed ah lala yeelin doonin Israel, illaa si rasmi ah loo aqoonsado Dowlad Falastiin ah oo madaxbannaan, iyadoo lagu saleynayo xuduudihii sanadkii 1967-kii, caasimaddeeduna tahay Bariga Qudus. Netanyahu oo xusul-duub ugu jira, sidii uu xisbigiisa ugu guuleysan lahaa doorashada soo socoto ee la qabanayo 27-ka bishan ayaa aad ugu baahan in uu helo ogolaanshaha Mohammed bin Salman. Ina Salman, oo ah Raysal Wasaaraha Sacuudiga, marka laga soo tago inuu yahay Amiirka taajka ayaa ogolaansho la’aantiisa ay ka hortageysaa in Israel ay hesho fursad ay ku soo gasho dagaalka ama ay uga qayb qaato dadaalada lagu ilaalinayo marinada badda.

items.title: Garabka Laftagareen oo eedeymo u jeediyay Shirkadda Hormuud iyo Salaam Bank
items.description: Mucaaradka uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed ayaa Talaadadii eedeymo u jeediyay Shirkadda Isgaarsiinta Hormuud iyo Salaam Somali Bank, iyagoona sheegay in ay ka fiirsanayaan wada-shaqayntooda. Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo ka mid ah Siyaasiyiinta Koonfur Galbeed ee la safan Ex Madaxweyne Laftagareen ayaa Shirkadda Hormuud iyo Salaam Bank ku eedeeyay in ay adeegyadooda ka xiranayaan Madaxda Koonfur Galbeed, iyagoo raacaya awaamiirta Dowladda Federaalka, isla-markaana ay akoonada iyo telefoonada ka xirayaan dadka ka aragtida duwan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. “Waxaan ogsoonahay waddankeenna burburkii ka dib, waxaa curtay isgaarsiin kala duwan oo telefoono ah, waxaana ugu weyn Shirkadda Hormuud oo Koonfurta Somaliya ka shaqeyso. Waxaa ayaan darro weyn ah in Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo kooxdiisu ay shirkadihii gaarka loo lahaa ku cadaadinayaan ayagoon wax sharci ah u haysanin in la yiraahdo cid walba oo feker iyo aragti ahaanba naga soo horjeedda waa in akoonadooda iyo telefoonadooda la xiraa, waa ayaan darro weyn oo u soo hooyatay dadka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayuu yiri Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed, Afhayeenkii hore ee Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed. Isaga oo sii hadlayay ayaa waxa uu yiri “Shirkadda Hormuud waa shirkad weyn iyo Salaam Bank oo is wataba dadka Soomaaliyeed macaamiil badan bay ku leeyihiin, iyana waxaan leenahay haddaad ka mid tihiin shirkad Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu leeyahay, dee hantida dadka Soomaaliyeed iyo codka ummadda Soomaaliyeed ee ugu badan, gaar ahaan Koonfurta Somaliya idiinkaa ku fadhidaan, waa inaad soo caddeysaan waxyaabaha khaladaadka ah aad ka geleysaan dadka reer Koonfur Galbeed iyo Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya.” Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo muuqaal soo duubay, isagoo ku sugan Degmada Qansaxdheere ee Gobolka Baay ayaa yiri “Haddii qof walboo Xasan Sheekh ay is qabtaan telefoonada iyo akoonada aad ka xirataan, caddaalad ma tihiin, shirkad gaar ahna ma tihiin. Dadka reer Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya in Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu diyaarado la dhaco, idiinkuna inaad Madaxda Koonfur Galbeed iyo shacbigooda adeegyadii gaarka ahaa ka xirataan, waan ka fiirsanaynaa.” Ugaas Xasan ayaa carabka ku adkeeyay “Hormuud iyo Salaam Bank waxaan leenahay fiiro kale ayaan idiinkugu laaban doonnaa, haddii Ilaahay idmo, wada-shaqaynta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed iyo idinkuna waxay noqon doontaa mid si aad ah looga fiirsado.” Shirkadda Isgaarsiinta Hormuud iyo Salaam Somali Bank waa shirkado ganacsi oo madaxbannaan, mana jiraan caddeymo rasmi ah oo muujinaya in ay ku shaqeeyaan awaamiirta Villa Somalia, balse Hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka ayaa ku howlan, sidii loo dhaqangelin lahaa cunaqabatayn dhanka dhaqaalaha ah oo Guddiga Qaranka ee Ka hortagga Lacag-dhaqidda iyo La dagaalanka Maalgelinta Argagixisada (GQKL/LMA) uu 13-kii bishan ku soo rogay toban xubnood oo uu ka mid yahay Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Laftagareen.

items.title: Why Everyone Wants Somaliland
Al-Shabaab Moves Beyond Taxation: Ceelbuur Agreement Signals a New Push to Fund Civilian Projects
items.description: CEELBUUR, GALGADUUD (WDN) — Al-Shabaab has reportedly agreed to finance civilian infrastructure projects in Ceelbuur, central Somalia, in what could mark a significant development in the group’s efforts to consolidate its influence and present itself as a governing authority in territories under its control. Reports from Ceelbuur indicate that Al-Shabaab representatives and members of Hawiye sub-clans from areas of Galmudug have signed an agreement to end previous hostilities and establish peaceful relations and cooperation. Under the reported agreement, projects in Ceelbuur—including the drilling of water wells, construction of educational facilities and establishment of a health centre—are expected to be undertaken with the group’s involvement. If implemented, the arrangement would represent a notable development in Al-Shabaab’s approach to local communities. The group has long been associated with coercive taxation, intimidation and violence. Its reported commitment to finance basic infrastructure suggests an effort to combine its existing system of revenue collection with visible provision of services. The agreement’s precise terms, funding arrangements and implementation have not yet been independently verified. From Taxation to Service Provision Al-Shabaab has developed an extensive revenue-collection system across areas under its influence, imposing taxes and levies on businesses, traders, farmers, transport operators and local communities. Its financial networks have also reportedly reached into government-controlled commercial centres, including Mogadishu, where businesses and other economic actors have faced demands for payments. Reports have identified telecommunications companies, private banks and other businesses among the sectors exposed to the group’s taxation and extortion networks. The scale and mechanisms of these payments vary, and individual claims require careful verification. The group’s ability to generate revenue beyond the territories it directly controls has long raised questions about how it finances its operations and why its financial networks remain difficult to dismantle. Its territorial reach and revenue system have also challenged the assumption that the Federal Government of Somalia’s control of major cities necessarily translates into exclusive authority over the country’s economy and financial flows. The reported Ceelbuur agreement introduces another dimension: whether Al-Shabaab is now seeking to turn some of the revenue it collects into visible civilian projects that could strengthen its standing among local communities. By financing such projects, Al-Shabaab could seek to reinforce local cooperation, cultivate acceptance and portray itself as capable of providing services where government institutions have struggled to do so. That possibility should not be confused with evidence that the group has abandoned coercion or fundamentally changed its ideology. Nor does the reported agreement establish that Al-Shabaab has launched a nationwide programme of civilian infrastructure development. Nevertheless, the development deserves attention. Armed groups that aspire to govern territory may seek to combine force, taxation, local agreements and selective service provision to deepen their influence. If the Ceelbuur arrangement is implemented, it could offer an example of how Al-Shabaab seeks to strengthen its position beyond military operations alone. The agreement also raises questions about the circumstances that led local communities to negotiate with the group, the security guarantees involved and whether residents will be able to access the proposed facilities without intimidation or political conditions. The comparison is not exact: Somalia and Afghanistan have different political, social and security environments. There is not enough evidence from the Ceelbuur agreement alone to conclude that Al-Shabaab is pursuing the same trajectory or that it is preparing to assume national power through a comparable process. What is clear is that the group’s activities cannot be understood solely through battlefield developments. Its capacity to raise money, exert pressure on economic actors, negotiate with communities and potentially finance public works also forms part of its broader challenge to the Somali state. The government and its international partners must also address the conditions that leave communities vulnerable to armed groups offering—or claiming to offer—security, dispute resolution and basic services. If Al-Shabaab can collect substantial revenues while communities continue to face shortages of water, education and healthcare, the problem is not only how the group raises money. It is also whether legitimate public institutions can provide the services and security that citizens need. The reported agreement in Ceelbuur therefore deserves scrutiny. Its significance will depend on whether the projects are actually delivered, how they are financed and whether local communities benefit without coercion. Al-Shabaab’s reported move into civilian infrastructure financing may signal an effort to deepen its local influence. For Somalia, the challenge is to ensure that the group’s capacity to extract revenue does not translate into greater political authority—and that legitimate government institutions become more present, effective and accountable in the lives of the people they are meant to serve. items.title: Somalia’s New IATA System Raises Fears of Politicized Travel Controls
items.description: MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia has announced a new milestone in aviation administration: the adoption of the International Air Transport Association’s Billing and Settlement Plan (IATA-BSP), a system designed to streamline financial transactions between airlines and accredited travel agents. But the announcement has also raised concerns about how the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS) will exercise its new administrative role, particularly in a country where political disputes have repeatedly spilled into public administration and travel regulations. The system was announced by Somalia’s Civil Aviation Authority Director, Ahmed Macallin, at a ceremony in Mogadishu attended by Kamil H. Awadhi, IATA’s regional vice-president for Africa and the Middle East, according to the report. IATA-BSP is an international framework for consolidating ticket sales, reporting payments and settling funds between accredited travel agents and participating airlines. It is intended to simplify transactions and strengthen financial oversight . The concern, however, is not necessarily the system itself, but how it will be implemented in Somalia. Efficiency or Another Instrument of Control? The Federal Government’s growing role in aviation administration comes amid longstanding political tensions with Somaliland, whose authorities operate separately from Mogadishu. Critics fear that a system affecting ticketing transactions across the Somali travel market could create additional administrative and financial complications for travelers and businesses if its implementation is not transparent and impartial. According to the report, travel agencies operating in Somaliland may be required to register within the relevant system to continue processing international tickets. The precise requirements, financial arrangements and scope of the Federal Government’s authority over agencies in Somaliland, however, need to be clarified by the authorities and IATA. For passengers, the central concern is straightforward: will the new arrangements make international travel more efficient, or introduce additional hurdles for people already navigating complex travel and documentation requirements? Somaliland residents are particularly concerned because of the earlier introduction of Somalia’s electronic travel authorization system in September 2025. The Federal Government’s published rules require foreign-passport holders to obtain the relevant authorization before travelling to Somalia. Somalia’s official e-visa announcement Critics of Mogadishu’s approach fear that further centralization of travel-related administration could deepen existing disputes over authority and make travel more difficult for Somaliland residents. Those concerns deserve a clear response, but the adoption of BSP alone does not establish that the Federal Government can arbitrarily prevent particular individuals from purchasing tickets or travelling internationally. The Risk of Politicizing Public Administration The wider issue is public confidence in how the Federal Government exercises its powers. When administrative systems are introduced in a politically divided country, people need assurances that they will be applied consistently, with clear rules, accessible appeals procedures and protection against discrimination. Without such safeguards, even a system designed to improve commercial efficiency can become a source of suspicion and uncertainty. The potential consequences extend beyond Somaliland. Travelers, airlines and travel agencies across Somalia need clarity on registration requirements, payment arrangements, applicable fees, data protection and the respective responsibilities of IATA, airlines, agents and government authorities. There must also be transparency about whether any funds collected through the system are government revenue, commercial settlement payments or agency fees. IATA’s standard BSP framework is principally a mechanism for settling transactions between travel agents and airlines; it should not automatically be portrayed as a government-controlled system for approving or denying every journey. Clear Guarantees Are Needed Neither Somaliland’s authorities nor Somalia’s Federal Government should leave travelers and businesses guessing about how the new arrangement will work. The Civil Aviation Authority and relevant ministries should publish the rules governing the system, explain its implications for travel agencies throughout the country and clarify what powers government authorities possess over ticketing and passenger travel. IATA should also explain the system’s implementation and the responsibilities of the participating parties. Somalia needs modern aviation systems that improve connectivity, commercial confidence and passenger services. It does not need another source of political friction. The test of this reform will not simply be whether Somalia has adopted an international ticketing system. It will be whether the system operates transparently, protects travelers from arbitrary treatment and serves the public without discrimination. For Somalis travelling from Hargeisa, Mogadishu, Garowe, Bosaso or any other city, access to international air travel should depend on clear and lawful requirements—not political affiliation or unresolved disputes over governance. items.title: Speaker Jaamac Helped Open the Door to South West’s Crisis, Now He Must Answer for the Consequences
items.description: By Abdiqani Haji Abdi Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur (Jaamac), the newly Speaker of Somalia’s Federal Parliament selected on 10 August 2026, has risen rapidly through the country’s political ranks, having held various positions under the administrations of both former President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo and President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. His elevation to the speakership followed what appears to have been a carefully orchestrated political plan led by Hassan Sheikh, under which Nur was controversially fast-tracked into Parliament and subsequently positioned to assume the Speaker’s seat. The speed and apparent ease with which he secured the powerful position have raised serious questions about the political calculations behind his rise and the extent to which parliamentary leadership has become a product of executive influence rather than an independent, transparent process. Jaamac has increasingly involved himself in matters that fall outside the scope of his official responsibilities. He wants the Federal Government to hold African Union peacekeepers accountable for losing territory in South West State. He also wants neighboring Kenya to act against people he describes as terrorists who allegedly continue to live openly in the country. But before Jaamac lectures peacekeepers and neighboring governments about their responsibilities, he should answer a more uncomfortable question: what responsibility does he bear for the political decisions that helped bring South West State to the brink of war? The crisis did not emerge from a political vacuum. It developed amid a struggle over who has the authority to govern South West State, who determines its political future and whether Mogadishu can effectively decide who leads a region whose people have their own political interests, institutions and aspirations. Jaamac’s critics accuse him of being a driving force behind the removal of the administration led by former South West President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Lafta-Gareen. They argue that the political transition served President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s interests by opening the way for a more compliant regional administration—one that could help the Federal Government secure its preferred political outcomes, including support in the coming election. These are serious facts, and the precise roles, motives and electoral calculations involved wait to be seen in the near future. But the fundamental political issue cannot be brushed aside : a regional administration cannot secure lasting legitimacy simply because Mogadishu wants it in power. South West State is not a political possession of the Federal Government. Its people are not spectators in a contest between national politicians. They have a legitimate interest in determining who governs them and how their political institutions are constituted. When that principle is disregarded, resistance should hardly come as a surprise. The Consequences of Imposing Political Authority The people of South West State have endured years of insecurity, political uncertainty and the devastating effects of conflict. They have little to gain from another struggle in which competing political leaders use armed forces to settle disagreements over authority. Yet the dispute over the region’s leadership has become increasingly militarized. The Federal Government has deployed forces into a politically contested environment, while armed forces aligned with Lafta-Gareen have advanced in parts of the region. Reports of territorial changes and clashes in Bay, Bakool and Lower Shabelle underline the danger facing civilians. Supporters of Lafta-Gareen describe the mobilization as a liberation struggle against federal interference. They argue that the movement reflects local opposition to an administration they regard as imposed from Mogadishu, and they point to reports of residents welcoming its forces in areas where federal-aligned forces have withdrawn. The scale and meaning of that public support require needs no verification as the elders and the residents of the concerned liberated districts were marching hand in hand with the liberation forces. Nevertheless, the political grievance at the heart of the conflict deserves to be taken seriously rather than automatically dismissed as terrorism. If Jaamac and other federal leaders helped drive a political transition that a substantial section of the population rejects, they cannot expect military deployments alone to erase that opposition. Nor can they reasonably demand that peacekeepers solve a political problem that political leaders themselves helped create. The central mistake was to treat control of the regional administration as a prize to be secured in Mogadishu, rather than a question requiring legitimate political consent in South West State. When Every Opponent Becomes a Terrorist One of the most damaging features of Somalia’s political crisis is the growing tendency to portray opposition to the Federal Government as synonymous with terrorism. Al-Shabaab is a terrorist organization, and the fight against it remains essential to Somalia’s security. But that does not mean every armed opponent of the Federal Government belongs to Al-Shabaab, nor does it mean every political challenge to President Hassan Sheikh’s authority constitutes a terrorist threat. Those distinctions matter. When the government labels its opponents as terrorists without presenting credible evidence, it risks turning counterterrorism into a political weapon. It also undermines the credibility of genuine operations against Al-Shabaab, whose violence has caused immense suffering among Somali civilians. The forces aligned with Lafta-Gareen must be judged by evidence of their affiliations and conduct, not simply by their opposition to Mogadishu. Equally, their claims to represent a popular liberation movement is tested against the long duration and their treatment of civilians up to now is even more than one can expect in war situation. The Federal Government cannot claim the moral authority to defend Somalia’s people while treating every challenge to its preferred political order as an enemy to be crushed. Opposition is not proof of terrorism, and federal authority is not a substitute for political legitimacy. If Jaamac believes particular individuals or armed groups are involved in terrorism, he should present credible evidence and support lawful investigations. Political labels cannot replace proof, and accusations cannot become a license for military action against communities whose principal grievance may be who governs them. Why Is Jaamac Demanding Accountability From Peacekeepers? Jaamac has questioned why areas where peacekeeping forces were present subsequently fell to armed groups. His demand for answers is legitimate in principle. International missions must explain their performance, and any failure to fulfil their responsibilities should be examined. But accountability cannot be selective. The African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) has a mandate focused on supporting Somali security forces, combating Al-Shabaab, protecting civilians and contributing to stabilization. It is not supposed to determine the political leadership of Southwest State or become an instrument in the Federal Government’s domestic disputes. If peacekeepers failed to protect a particular locality, the facts should be established. The loss of territory alone, however, does not prove that they deliberately abandoned it or acted in support of one faction. More importantly, international security partners should not be expected to compensate indefinitely for the consequences of political decisions made by Somali leaders. Jaamac’s demand for accountability would carry greater weight if it were accompanied by an equally serious examination of the decisions that brought South West State into its present crisis. A politician who helped create the conditions for a conflict and then present himself as merely an observer of its consequences. That is the political question Jaamac must confront. Foreign Military Power Must Not Become a Tool of Domestic Politics The South West crisis also raises concerns about Somalia’s reliance on foreign military support. AUSSOM’s role should be assessed according to its mandate and conduct. The same standard must apply to Türkiye and every other foreign partner involved in Somalia’s security affairs. Turkish-supported military operations have caused civilian casualties, failed assassination of opposition leaders and that military capabilities have been used against political opponents. Such actions that resulted the burning of the Turkish Flag in the SWS and Jubaland can’t be excused by Speaker Jama if he has an iota of empathy for his people. The Turkish actions raise an important principle: foreign military assistance intended to protect Somalia must not become a means of determining which Somali political faction prevails. A foreign partner’s strategic relationship with Mogadishu cannot exempt its conduct from scrutiny. Nor should international forces be drawn into a conflict over regional leadership unless their actions are clearly justified by their lawful mandate. The purpose of international assistance should be to protect civilians, combat genuine security threats and help establish conditions for political stability—not to enforce a contested political arrangement. Somalia’s sovereignty means more than the authority of the Federal Government to issue orders. It also means that the country’s political institutions must operate within legitimate constitutional arrangements and respect the political rights of its people. The Electoral Calculation Behind the Crisis The dispute becomes even more consequential when viewed against Somalia’s wider political transition. Opponents of President Hassan Sheikh argue that securing a more compliant administration in South West State would help the Federal Government influence the coming electoral process and secure political support from the region’s representatives. They see the removal of Lafta-Gareen not as an isolated regional dispute but as part of a broader struggle over the institutions and political alliances that may determine the next national leadership. The reality that the transition was designed to manufacture one-sided electoral support enjoys the belief of the masses of SWS. Nevertheless, it points to a serious risk: when regional administrations are treated as instruments for securing national political advantage, the electoral process itself becomes a source of conflict. Elections are supposed to resolve disputes through agreed rules and legitimate procedures. They cannot fulfil that purpose if political leaders attempt to settle the contest in advance by reshaping regional authority to their advantage. If President Hassan Sheikh’s government wants its electoral process to be accepted as legitimate, it must demonstrate that the rules are fair, that regional political institutions are not being manipulated for partisan purposes and that opposition groups can participate without being treated as security threats. Military control cannot manufacture electoral consent. South West State Must Not Pay for Mogadishu’s Political Ambitions The most important voices in this crisis are those of the civilians living through it. They face the consequences when armed forces advance, towns change hands, families flee their homes and public services collapse. Their interests cannot be reduced to the competing claims of federal politicians or regional factions. If the people of South West State reject an administration they believe has been imposed upon them, the answer must be a credible political process that allows their grievances to be heard and their leadership to be determined through legitimate means. That process must also protect minorities, prevent reprisals and respect the rights of communities that support different political positions. Lafta-Gareen-aligned forces, federal forces and every other armed actor must be held accountable for abuses against civilians. No claim of liberation, federal authority or counterterrorism can justify unlawful violence. But lasting peace will remain elusive if the Federal Government insists that military pressure can settle a dispute rooted in political legitimacy. Mogadishu must recognize that Southwest State is not a territory to be administered according to the preferences of the president. It is a community whose people have a legitimate stake in choosing their leaders. Jaamac Must Answer for the Political Choices He Helped Advance Jaamac’s latest remarks focus on the responsibility of peacekeepers and the presence of alleged terrorists in Kenya. Yet the more pressing issue is the responsibility of Somalia’s own political leaders for the crisis unfolding in South West State. If Jaamac played the decisive role his opponents attribute to him in removing Lafta-Gareen’s administration, he must explain why that course was pursued, what legitimate political process supported it and how the resulting confrontation was anticipated to be avoided. If the Federal Government believed the political transition was necessary, it must explain how the process respected the rights and political choices of South West communities. And if the authorities believe the forces opposing them are terrorists, they must provide evidence rather than rely on labels that blur the distinction between terrorism and political resistance. The burden of responsibility is particularly heavy for those who exercise state power. The Federal Government controls national institutions and commands forces that must serve the public, not merely the interests of the incumbent administration. It is therefore not enough to demand that international partners contain the consequences of a domestic political crisis. Somali leaders must be prepared to examine their own decisions and accept that an administration’s political survival cannot take precedence over the security and rights of the people it claims to govern. South West State does not need a government imposed by Mogadishu and defended by force. It needs legitimate leadership, political consent and security institutions that protect its people. Jaamac’s call for accountability should begin with a frank examination of how the crisis developed—and of the responsibility borne by those who helped bring it about. Until that happens, demands for military intervention and accusations of terrorism risk deepening the very conflict they claim to resolve. The people of South West State should not have to fight another war simply to make their political voices count. The forces aligned with Lafta-Gareen must be judged by evidence of their affiliations and conduct, not simply by their opposition to Mogadishu. Equally, their claims to represent a popular liberation movement is tested against the long duration and their treatment of civilians up to now is even more than one can expect in war situation. The Federal Government cannot claim the moral authority to defend Somalia’s people while treating every challenge to its preferred political order as an enemy to be crushed. Opposition is not proof of terrorism, and federal authority is not a substitute for political legitimacy. If Jaamac believes particular individuals or armed groups are involved in terrorism, he should present credible evidence and support lawful investigations. Political labels cannot replace proof, and accusations cannot become a license for military action against communities whose principal grievance may be who governs them. Why Is Jaamac Demanding Accountability From Peacekeepers? Jaamac has questioned why areas where peacekeeping forces were present subsequently fell to armed groups. His demand for answers is legitimate in principle. International missions must explain their performance, and any failure to fulfil their responsibilities should be examined. But accountability cannot be selective. The African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) has a mandate focused on supporting Somali security forces, combating Al-Shabaab, protecting civilians and contributing to stabilization. It is not supposed to determine the political leadership of Southwest State or become an instrument in the Federal Government’s domestic disputes. If peacekeepers failed to protect a particular locality, the facts should be established. The loss of territory alone, however, does not prove that they deliberately abandoned it or acted in support of one faction. More importantly, international security partners should not be expected to compensate indefinitely for the consequences of political decisions made by Somali leaders. Jaamac’s demand for accountability would carry greater weight if it were accompanied by an equally serious examination of the decisions that brought South West State into its present crisis. A politician who helped create the conditions for a conflict and then present himself as merely an observer of its consequences. That is the political question Jaamac must confront. Foreign Military Power Must Not Become a Tool of Domestic Politics The South West crisis also raises concerns about Somalia’s reliance on foreign military support. AUSSOM’s role should be assessed according to its mandate and conduct. The same standard must apply to Türkiye and every other foreign partner involved in Somalia’s security affairs. Turkish-supported military operations have caused civilian casualties, failed assassination of opposition leaders and that military capabilities have been used against political opponents. Such actions that resulted the burning of the Turkish Flag in the SWS and Jubaland can’t be excused by Speaker Jama if he has an iota of empathy for his people. The Turkish actions raise an important principle: foreign military assistance intended to protect Somalia must not become a means of determining which Somali political faction prevails. A foreign partner’s strategic relationship with Mogadishu cannot exempt its conduct from scrutiny. Nor should international forces be drawn into a conflict over regional leadership unless their actions are clearly justified by their lawful mandate. The purpose of international assistance should be to protect civilians, combat genuine security threats and help establish conditions for political stability—not to enforce a contested political arrangement. Somalia’s sovereignty means more than the authority of the Federal Government to issue orders. It also means that the country’s political institutions must operate within legitimate constitutional arrangements and respect the political rights of its people. The Electoral Calculation Behind the Crisis The dispute becomes even more consequential when viewed against Somalia’s wider political transition. Opponents of President Hassan Sheikh argue that securing a more compliant administration in South West State would help the Federal Government influence the coming electoral process and secure political support from the region’s representatives. They see the removal of Lafta-Gareen not as an isolated regional dispute but as part of a broader struggle over the institutions and political alliances that may determine the next national leadership. The reality that the transition was designed to manufacture one-sided electoral support enjoys the belief of the masses of SWS. Nevertheless, it points to a serious risk: when regional administrations are treated as instruments for securing national political advantage, the electoral process itself becomes a source of conflict. Elections are supposed to resolve disputes through agreed rules and legitimate procedures. They cannot fulfil that purpose if political leaders attempt to settle the contest in advance by reshaping regional authority to their advantage. If President Hassan Sheikh’s government wants its electoral process to be accepted as legitimate, it must demonstrate that the rules are fair, that regional political institutions are not being manipulated for partisan purposes and that opposition groups can participate without being treated as security threats. Military control cannot manufacture electoral consent. South West State Must Not Pay for Mogadishu’s Political Ambitions The most important voices in this crisis are those of the civilians living through it. They face the consequences when armed forces advance, towns change hands, families flee their homes and public services collapse. Their interests cannot be reduced to the competing claims of federal politicians or regional factions. If the people of South West State reject an administration they believe has been imposed upon them, the answer must be a credible political process that allows their grievances to be heard and their leadership to be determined through legitimate means. That process must also protect minorities, prevent reprisals and respect the rights of communities that support different political positions. Lafta-Gareen-aligned forces, federal forces and every other armed actor must be held accountable for abuses against civilians. No claim of liberation, federal authority or counterterrorism can justify unlawful violence. But lasting peace will remain elusive if the Federal Government insists that military pressure can settle a dispute rooted in political legitimacy. Mogadishu must recognize that Southwest State is not a territory to be administered according to the preferences of the president. It is a community whose people have a legitimate stake in choosing their leaders. Jaamac Must Answer for the Political Choices He Helped Advance Jaamac’s latest remarks focus on the responsibility of peacekeepers and the presence of alleged terrorists in Kenya. Yet the more pressing issue is the responsibility of Somalia’s own political leaders for the crisis unfolding in South West State. If Jaamac played the decisive role his opponents attribute to him in removing Lafta-Gareen’s administration, he must explain why that course was pursued, what legitimate political process supported it and how the resulting confrontation was anticipated to be avoided. If the Federal Government believed the political transition was necessary, it must explain how the process respected the rights and political choices of South West communities. And if the authorities believe the forces opposing them are terrorists, they must provide evidence rather than rely on labels that blur the distinction between terrorism and political resistance. The burden of responsibility is particularly heavy for those who exercise state power. The Federal Government controls national institutions and commands forces that must serve the public, not merely the interests of the incumbent administration. It is therefore not enough to demand that international partners contain the consequences of a domestic political crisis. Somali leaders must be prepared to examine their own decisions and accept that an administration’s political survival cannot take precedence over the security and rights of the people it claims to govern. South West State does not need a government imposed by Mogadishu and defended by force. It needs legitimate leadership, political consent and security institutions that protect its people. Jaamac’s call for accountability should begin with a frank examination of how the crisis developed—and of the responsibility borne by those who helped bring it about. Until that happens, demands for military intervention and accusations of terrorism risk deepening the very conflict they claim to resolve. The people of South West State should not have to fight another war simply to make their political voices count. items.title: Maxaa kasoo baxay kulankii Aadan Madoobe iyo Shariif Xasan? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo weli dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wada magaalada Muqdisho ayaa maanta kulan gaar ah la yeeshay Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Mudane Shariif Xasan Sheekh Aadan oo ay ka wada-hadleen xaaladihii uug dambeeyay. Kulanka waxaa ka qeybgalay guddoomiye ku-xigeenka koowaad ee Baarlamaanka Koonfur Galbeed, Mudane Aadan Xasan Maxamed (Usaama), Xildhibaan Mukhtaar Maxamed Guuleed oo ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyo agaasimaha guud ee Madaxtooyada Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Mudane Cabdinaasir Yuusuf Maxamed. Inta uu socday kulanka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray xaaladda guud ee deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan arrimaha amniga, siyaasadda, nabadeynta, dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada iyo dib u xureynta degmooyinka ay qabsadeen ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Sheekh Aadan Madoobe iyo Shariif Xasan ayaa is-weydaarsaday aragtiyo ku saabsan muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta nabadda, midnimada iyo wadajirka bulshada, iyadoo la adkeynayo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo xasilloonida siyaasadeed iyo amni ee deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed. Sidoo kale, waxaa kulanka lagu muujiyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada-tashiga iyo iskaashiga siyaasadeed, lana mideeyo dadaallada lagu horumarinayo dowladnimada, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo nabad ku wada noolaanshaha bulshada. Aadan Madoobe ayaa labadii maalmood lasoo dhaafay kulamo ka waday caasimada, waxayana horay isku arkeen Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed (Jaamac) oo ay isna ka wada-hadleen xaaladda kasii dareysa ee Koonfur Galbeed, kadib markii degmooyin horleh ay qabsadeen ciidanka Lafta-gareen. Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa haatan qorseyneysa inay qaado guluf culus oo ka dhan ah ciidanka taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ee qabsaday degmooyinka Qansaxdeere, Bardaale, Buurhakaba iyo Diinsoor oo ka wada tirsn gobolka Baay. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa kusoo aaday xi lli ay haatan sii xoogeysanayaan khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen iyo kuwa taageersan maamulka hadda ka jira Baydhaba, oo garab ka helaya Dowladda Federaalka. items.title: White Stork Travels 5,515 Kilometres From Poland, Dies in Somaliland
items.description: A white stork that migrated from Poland was found dead in Somaliland’s eastern city of Ceerigaabo, approximately 5,515 kilometres from where it was first identified, highlighting the country’s importance as a passage for migratory birds travelling between Europe and Africa. The bird, identified by a metal identification ring marked VX 5509 POLAND , was discovered on September 17 in the courtyard of a residential property in Ceerigaabo, according to a report prepared by wildlife conservation activist Muse Said. The bird’s remains were collected by Mohamed Yusuf, the Sanaag regional coordinator of Somaliland’s Ministry of Environment. Following the discovery, the ministry’s Wildlife Department contacted the Polish Bird Ringing Centre to establish the bird’s origin and migration history. In a response received on October 10, the Polish research centre confirmed that the white stork ( Ciconia ciconia ) had been ringed on June 22, 2026, in northern Poland. The bird was still a nestling when it was ringed, and its sex had not been determined. According to the Polish Bird Ringing Centre, the straight-line distance between the ringing location and Ceerigaabo was approximately 5,515 kilometres, with 87 days separating the ringing date and the discovery of its remains. A white stork (Ciconia ciconia) found dead in Ceerigaabo, Somaliland, on September 17, 2026, alongside a close-up of its Polish identification ring, VX 5509. The bird was ringed in northern Poland on June 22, approximately 5,515 kilometres from where it was later discovered. Photo: Muse Said. The centre recorded the bird as having been found dead but did not establish the cause of death. Muse Said, a Somaliland wildlife conservation activist, told Horndiplomat that the discovery demonstrated the ecological importance of Somaliland’s natural habitats and the need to protect migratory birds. “Birds are nature’s laboratories,” Said told Horndiplomat, emphasising their role in understanding environmental conditions and the health of ecosystems. “Where birds are present, it is a sign of rich biodiversity and a thriving natural environment,” he said. “We must protect birds in their natural habitats,” Said added, calling for greater public awareness of wildlife conservation. Somaliland lies along the Horn of Africa, a region crossed by migratory birds travelling between Europe, Asia and Africa. Said identified several locations in Somaliland as important habitats and observation sites for migratory birds, including Rabshiga Mountain, Sa’ad ad-Din Island, Daallo, the Wagar Mountains and Gacan Libaax. He also highlighted the Warsangli linnet, a bird associated with the Sanaag region, as an example of Somaliland’s distinctive birdlife. The country’s mountains, coastal areas and other natural habitats offer opportunities for birdwatching, wildlife research and biodiversity conservation, Said said. Bird ringing is widely used by researchers to study migration routes, survival rates and bird populations. Metal rings carrying unique identification numbers allow researchers to trace individual birds when they are encountered elsewhere. The discovery in Ceerigaabo provides a documented connection between northern Europe and Somaliland through the movement of a single migratory bird, underscoring the importance of cooperation between local wildlife authorities and international research institutions in studying migration and biodiversity across the Horn of Africa. Source HornDiplomat
