items.title: Abiy Ahmed Says Jigjiga Has Outpaced Asmara as Ethiopia’s Regional Cities Transform
items.description: ADDIS ABABA (WDN) — Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has claimed that Jigjiga, the capital of Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State, has overtaken Eritrea’s capital, Asmara, in its current state of development. His remarks highlight Jigjiga’s growing profile while sharpening the contrast he draws between Ethiopia’s regional development and Eritrea’s economic difficulties. In a reported interview, Abiy said Eritrea had more than 300 factories when it was part of Ethiopia and that its cities were once known for their beauty and development. “Before independence, when Eritrea was part of Ethiopia, it had more than 300 factories. Eritrean cities were very beautiful, but today they look like villages,” he said, according to the reported remarks. Abiy cited Asmara as an example of what he described as Eritrea’s decline, arguing that the city now compares unfavourably with Jigjiga. Jigjiga’s Growing Profile Jigjiga has undergone visible urban development in recent years, with investment in roads, public spaces, commercial facilities and other infrastructure. These projects have strengthened its role as the Somali Region’s administrative centre and an increasingly important hub for business and public services. Its transformation reflects wider efforts to develop Ethiopia’s regional capitals and expand economic activity beyond the country’s largest urban centres. However, Jigjiga’s progress should be considered alongside developments in other regional cities, including Hawassa, Bahir Dar, Adama and Mekelle, each of which has its own economic strengths and development challenges. Determining which city is more developed requires reliable comparisons of industrial activity, employment, infrastructure, public services and living standards. Urban appearance alone cannot establish overall economic performance. Eritrea’s Economic Challenges Eritrea has a long industrial and urban history, shaped by Italian colonial rule and its subsequent period under Ethiopian administration. Its economic trajectory since independence has been affected by conflict, prolonged military mobilisation, restrictions on economic activity and limited access to international investment. However, Abiy’s historical figure of more than 300 factories requires independent verification, as does any assessment of how many remain operational today. Asmara also retains considerable architectural and historical significance, even as Eritrea faces broader economic challenges. His comparison is therefore best understood as a political assessment of the two cities’ development trajectories rather than conclusive evidence that Jigjiga surpasses Asmara across all economic and social indicators. Development Amid Regional Tensions Abiy’s remarks come amid strained relations between Ethiopia and Eritrea, with disagreements over regional security, the legacy of the Tigray conflict and Ethiopia’s pursuit of access to the Red Sea adding to tensions. The two governments have exchanged accusations over security and support for armed groups, raising concerns about the possibility of renewed confrontation in the Horn of Africa. Against this backdrop, the comparison between Asmara and Jigjiga carries significance beyond urban development. It allows Ethiopia’s prime minister to contrast the progress he attributes to an Ethiopian regional capital with the difficulties facing neighbouring Eritrea. Ultimately, Jigjiga’s progress should be judged by whether urban investment produces lasting benefits: more jobs, stronger public services, improved infrastructure and better living standards. Jigjiga’s growing prominence reflects the potential of Ethiopia’s regional cities. But the scale of that progress—and how it compares with Asmara—must be established through evidence, not political rhetoric alone. items.title: Somalia’s Opposition Calls for Dialogue as Hassan Sheikh Pursues a Divisive Electoral Course
items.description: The Somali Future Council wants a president who listens and negotiates. Its critics argue that Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has instead governed unilaterally, deepening political divisions and helping ignite a new conflict in South West State. MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia’s political opposition has issued another warning that the country’s electoral dispute is threatening national unity, federalism and the stability of its already fragile institutions. But the central question remains whether President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud is prepared to listen—or whether he will continue pursuing his preferred political course regardless of the consequences. In a statement, the Somali Future Council strongly rejected the proposed timetable for elections to the two houses of the Federal Parliament and the presidency, accusing the president of making unilateral decisions without an inclusive political agreement. The council called for mediated negotiations to resume, with the participation of the country’s principal political stakeholders and support from international partners. It argued that the electoral process must be based on consultation and consensus rather than decisions imposed by one side. The statement reflects a broader opposition concern: that Somalia is approaching a critical political transition without agreement on the rules that should govern it. A President Who Must Listen At the heart of the dispute is a fundamental question about presidential leadership. In a federal country as politically divided as Somalia, the president cannot resolve every major constitutional and electoral disagreement through executive authority alone. While the President’s term has expired in May 2026, nevertheless, Hassan Sheikh is governing as the presidential power entitles him to determine the country’s political direction beyond his term, without securing the consent of other major stakeholders. Many critics argue that his approach has weakened confidence in his leadership and widened the gap between Mogadishu and political forces that reject his electoral plans. For much of the past year, the opposition has objected to electoral initiatives in Hirshabelle and Galmudug, arguing that the processes have advanced without a sufficiently inclusive national agreement. These disputes have reinforced concerns that regional electoral arrangements are being pursued ahead of consensus on the broader federal framework. The dispute is therefore about more than an election timetable. It concerns who determines the rules, whether federal and regional institutions can operate independently within the constitutional order, and whether political competition will be resolved through negotiated procedures or unilateral decisions. The Future Council’s demand is clear: reopen dialogue and agree on a credible electoral framework before the crisis deepens further. South West State: From Political Dispute to Armed Conflict The consequences of Somalia’s political divisions have become particularly alarming in South West State, where the struggle over regional leadership has escalated into armed confrontation. The Federal Government’s intervention in the region has ignited a conflict that could persist well beyond the immediate political dispute. They contend that attempts to reshape regional authority without sufficiently broad political consent have increased tensions and exposed civilians to further insecurity. Nevertheless, the broader lesson is unmistakable: political disputes over legitimacy and leadership cannot be resolved sustainably through force alone. Somalia has already endured decades of conflict. A new confrontation in South West State risks diverting security resources, disrupting public services and deepening mistrust between the Federal Government and regional communities. If the government’s objective is national stability, its response must include meaningful political engagement with those who oppose its approach—not simply efforts to consolidate control. A Country Facing Multiple Crises The Future Council also highlighted the mounting pressures facing Somalia, including the threat posed by Al-Shabaab and Islamic State, flooding associated with El Niño, drought linked to climate change and intensifying regional rivalries. These challenges make political cooperation more urgent. Security operations, disaster response and economic recovery all require coordination among federal institutions, regional administrations and international partners. Prolonged political confrontation risks weakening that cooperation at a time when Somalia can least afford it. The council warned that the current deadlock could undermine state-building efforts and damage social cohesion. It urged political leaders to avoid actions that could further polarise the country. The Warning—and the Way Forward Although the Future Council said it remained open to genuine dialogue on an agreed electoral process and a realistic timetable, it warned that it would consider further constitutional and political measures if the president continued with decisions it regards as unilateral. It also held the president and those supporting his approach responsible for the potential consequences. The council appealed to the Somali public to oppose actions it considers unconstitutional and called on international partners to support a political process based on consultation and broad agreement. The government and opposition may disagree over the electoral model and the interpretation of constitutional arrangements. But those disagreements cannot be settled sustainably if one side proceeds without sufficient political consent and the other sees no credible route to influence the process. Somalia needs a president who listens, builds consensus and recognizes the limits of unilateral authority—not a presidency that treats political disagreement as an obstacle to be overcome by force of office. The Future Council’s statement is another appeal for negotiations. Whether it produces a breakthrough will depend on the willingness of the president and opposition leaders to move beyond competing declarations and agree on practical rules for the political transition. Somalia’s future should not be determined by which side can impose its preferred outcome. It should be determined through a process that commands sufficient confidence across the country to prevent an electoral dispute from becoming a wider national crisis. items.title: Afar musharrax oo ku loollamaya tartanka madaxtinimada ee Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa galabta shaaciyay liiska musharraxiinta ku tartamaya xilka madaxweynaha Galmudug iyo ku xigeenkiisa oo la qorsheynayo in maalmaha soo socda lagu qabto magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimadda Galmudug. Guddiga ayaa diiwaangeliyay illaa afar musharrax oo laba kamid ah ay ku loollami doonaan xilka madaxweynaha, halka labada kale ay ku tartami doonaan madaxweyne ku xigeenka Galmudug. Afarta musharrax ayaa kala ah; Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo u sharraxan xisbiga JSP iyo Cabdulqaadir Cabdullahi Diiriye oo doorashada ku metali doono xisbiga Sincad, waxaase loo badinayaa inuu guuleysto musharrax Liibaan oo ay taageereyso kooxda Villa Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, Cabdisataar Maxamed Geelle iyo Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyare ayaa ku loollami doono xilka madaxweyne ku xigeenka, iyaga oo kala metalaya xisbiga Sincad iyo JSP. Haseyeeshee waxaa guusha loo saadaalinayaa Garyare oo ka tirsan xisbiga madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kaas oo galabta la siiyay kaarka musharraxnimada ee xisbiga. Doorashadan waxaa ka horreysay doorashada guddoonka Baarlamaanka Galmudug, taas oo ay ku guuleysteen guddoomiyaha iyo labadiisa ku-xigeen, xubno ka tirsan ururka JSP. Sidoo kale, xilka madaxweynaha Galmudug ayaa loo saadaalinayaa Liibaax Axmed Xasan, oo ay taageerayso Villa Somalia, halka la qorsheynayo in madaxweyne ku-xigeen isna loo doorto Cabdiweli Garyare, oo maanta la guddoonsiiyay kaarka musharraxnimada ee ururka JSP. Türkiye Risks Losing Somali Public Support as Military Partnership Becomes Entangled in Political Conflict
items.description: Ankara’s plan to expand military training in 2027 may once have been welcomed as a contribution to Somalia’s security. But its perceived alignment with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and its involvement in South West State’s conflict threaten to undermine that goodwill. MOGADISHU (WDN) — Türkiye plans to expand its training of Somali security forces in 2027, presenting the move as part of efforts to strengthen the country’s ability to defend itself and eventually assume full responsibility for national security. According to a report by Caasimada Online, Türkiye’s Ministry of Defense said its military cooperation with Somalia includes training and equipping Somali forces. During 2026, the programme reportedly trained new recruits and officers both in Somalia and at military facilities in Türkiye. The programme has included the Gorgor commando units and the Haramcad special police, while plans to develop Somalia’s air and naval capabilities form part of the broader defense partnership. Yet the announcement comes at a politically sensitive moment. For a growing number of critics, the question is no longer simply how many Somali soldiers Türkiye can train, but whose interests those soldiers are ultimately being deployed to serve. From Trusted Partner to Contested Actor Türkiye spent years building a reputation in Somalia through humanitarian assistance, infrastructure investment, economic cooperation and military training. Its engagement was widely presented as a partnership aimed at helping Somalia rebuild institutions weakened by decades of conflict. That reputation is now under pressure. Critics of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud increasingly view Ankara as too closely aligned with his administration, particularly as disputes over elections, federal authority and the leadership of South West State have escalated into armed confrontation. The most serious allegations concern reported Turkish air operations and the use of Turkish-supplied military equipment during the conflict in South West State. Local officials and forces aligned with former regional president Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Lafta-Gareen have accused Türkiye of supporting federal operations and contributing to attacks that allegedly harmed civilians. These claims have not all been independently verified, and Türkiye’s government has rejected allegations that its military presence is intended to interfere in Somalia’s internal political affairs. Nevertheless, the allegations have become politically consequential. Reports of protests against alleged airstrikes, including demonstrations in which residents burned a Turkish flag, suggest that anger over the conflict may be damaging Türkiye’s standing among some communities in South West State. For critics, the distinction between supporting Somalia’s national security and supporting the political agenda of the incumbent administration is fundamental. A military partnership intended to strengthen Somalia should not become associated with a domestic political struggle over who governs the country’s regions. Training Soldiers Is Not the Same as Building National Security Türkiye’s training programme has helped develop specialised Somali units, including Gorgor commandos. Ankara and Mogadishu maintain that such cooperation strengthens the Somali National Army and improves the country’s ability to confront genuine security threats. But military capacity alone cannot guarantee national stability. The legitimacy of the institutions deploying that capacity matters just as much. If trained units or foreign-supplied equipment are perceived to be used against political opponents or communities resisting federal intervention, the programme risks losing public confidence—even if its original purpose was legitimate. Critics also contrast Türkiye’s increasingly visible military role with the roles played by Ethiopian and Kenyan forces in Somalia. They argue that Ankara’s alleged involvement in aerial operations has made its presence appear more directly connected to the country’s internal political struggle. That comparison and the conduct of all foreign forces should be judged on evidence, their mandates and their treatment of civilians. The principle, however, is clear: foreign military assistance should protect the population, support lawful security operations and help create conditions for political stability. It should not be perceived as a means of deciding which Somali political faction prevails. South West State Could Become a Turning Point The conflict in South West State has become a critical test of Türkiye’s relationship with Somalia’s wider population. Opponents of the Federal Government argue that Mogadishu’s intervention in the region undermined political consent and helped trigger a conflict that has caused civilian suffering and displacement. They further allege that Turkish military capabilities have supported federal operations against forces resisting the political transition. The Federal Government has presented its operations as efforts to restore security and confront armed opponents. The competing claims underscore the need for independent scrutiny of alleged airstrikes, civilian casualties and the use of foreign-supplied equipment. If Ankara wants to preserve its reputation as a partner of the Somali people, it must take such concerns seriously, explain its role clearly and ensure that its military assistance is not used unlawfully against civilians. Silence or blanket denials will do little to reassure communities that believe they have been caught in a political and military confrontation beyond their control. Ankara Has Put Too Much at Stake in One Relationship A further risk for Türkiye is that its close relationship with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud could become vulnerable to Somalia’s changing political fortunes. Many critics believe Ankara has placed too much of its political capital in its relationship with the incumbent administration. In their view, if Türkiye becomes identified primarily with one president rather than with Somalia as a whole, a change of leadership could expose the limits of that strategy. This remains a political assessment, not a certainty. Türkiye’s relationship with Somalia extends beyond the presidency and includes defense agreements, economic interests, infrastructure projects and long-term institutional ties. The two countries’ defense cooperation, for example, includes a framework agreement signed in February 2024 to develop and support Somalia’s naval capabilities. <Cite refs={[“turn497686search11″,”turn497686search2”]}/> Even so, a partnership built around a narrow set of political relationships can become fragile when those relationships are contested. If significant sections of the public come to associate Türkiye with partisan intervention, rebuilding trust could prove difficult regardless of who occupies the presidential palace. Türkiye’s long-term interests are better served by maintaining relations with Somali institutions and communities across the political spectrum than by being seen as the military backer of one administration . The Test of the 2027 Expansion Türkiye’s proposed expansion of military training presents an opportunity to strengthen Somalia’s security institutions. But it also raises a question Ankara cannot avoid: how can it expand its military role without deepening public suspicions that it has become entangled in domestic politics? The answer requires transparency, accountability and a clear separation between counterterrorism cooperation and political disputes. Allegations of civilian harm must be investigated credibly, and Somali security forces must be held to lawful standards in their use of military equipment and foreign assistance. Somalia needs professional forces capable of defending its people against Al-Shabaab and other genuine security threats. It also needs political institutions that resolve disputes through constitutional and negotiated processes rather than force. Türkiye can contribute to both objectives—but only if its conduct matches its stated commitment to Somalia’s sovereignty and stability. The ultimate measure of Türkiye’s partnership will not be the number of soldiers it trains in 2027. It will be whether Somali citizens believe that partnership makes them safer, protects their rights and serves the country as a whole. If Ankara allows its relationship with the incumbent administration to overshadow those responsibilities, it risks sacrificing years of goodwill for the sake of a political alignment that may not endure. items.title: Khasaare culus oo ka dhashay qaraxyo ka dhacay Sh/Hoose
items.description: Afgooye (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa kasoo baxaya qaraxyo miino oo maanta lala beegsaday gaari ay la socdeen shacab iyo mooto Fekon marayay qaybo kamid ah gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, kawaas oo gaystay khasaare isugu jiro dhimasho iyo dhaawac Gaariga oo rakaab ahaa ayaa ka baxay magaalada Muqdisho, wuxuuna kusii jeeday dhinaca magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay, iyadoo miino ay kula qarxday inta u dhexeysa deegaannada Waraaboole iyo Doonka ee gobolka Shabeelada Hoose. Mid kamid ah dadka deegaanka oo la hadlay Shabelle Tv ayaa sheegay in khasaare badan uu soo gaaray rakaabkii la socday baabuurka,isaga oo tilmaamay in uu gabi ahaanba burburay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in dadka la socday gaariga ay ka badbaadeen oo kaliya darawaalkii iyo haweeney la socotay, inta kalena ay ku noqdeen dhimasho iyo dhaawac. “Dadka dhintay lama qiyaasi karo kor iyo hoos ayaa gaariga laga saarnaa hal maamo iyo darawalka ayaa la sheegay inay ka badbaadeen inta kale waa baaba’een” ayuu yiri qof kamid ah dadka deegaanka. Qarax labaad ayaa sidoo kale haleelay mooto Fekon usoo socotay dhanka degmada Afgooye, waxaana saarnaa 2 qof iyo darawalkii waday, iyadoo ay isla goobta ku geeriyoodeen saddexda qof, sida ay innoo sheegeen ilo deegaanka ah oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. Xaaladda goobta ay wax ka dhceen ayaa hadda deggan, waxaana gaaray ciidamada ammaanka iyo dad shacab ah oo gurmad u fidiyay safarreyda ay waxyeelladu soo gaartay. Deegaanka ay qaraxyadu ka dhaceen ayaa waxaa badanaa howlgallo ka sameeya ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, waxaana mararka qaar soo beegsada maleeshiyaadka kooxda Al-Shabaab. Si kastaba, kooxda Al-Shabaab ayaa muddooyinkii ugu dambeeyay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka waday Shabeellaha Hosoe, iyaga oo inta badan weerarro ku qaada ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo kuwa AUSSOM ee isaga kala goosha waddooyinka waa wayn ee gobolkaasi. Xaaladda goobta ay wax ka dhceen ayaa hadda deggan, waxaana gaaray ciidamada ammaanka iyo dad shacab ah oo gurmad u fidiyay safarreyda ay waxyeelladu soo gaartay. Deegaanka ay qaraxyadu ka dhaceen ayaa waxaa badanaa howlgallo ka sameeya ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, waxaana mararka qaar soo beegsada maleeshiyaadka kooxda Al-Shabaab. Si kastaba, kooxda Al-Shabaab ayaa muddooyinkii ugu dambeeyay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka waday Shabeellaha Hosoe, iyaga oo inta badan weerarro ku qaada ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo kuwa AUSSOM ee isaga kala goosha waddooyinka waa wayn ee gobolkaasi. items.title: JSP oo Garyare siisay kaarka musharraxa madaxweyne ku xigeenka GALMUDUG
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ururka Cadaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ayaa maanta kaarka musharraxnimada ee xilka madaxweyne ku xigeenka Galmudug guddoonsiiyay Senator Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyare, kaas oo noqonaya musharraxa rasmiga ah ee ururka uga qaybgalaya tartanka doorashada ee xilkaas. Munaasabad ka dhacday xarunta dhexe ee ururka JSP ayaa kaarka musharraxnimada lagu guddoonsiiyay Senator Cabdiweli Garyare, waxaana ka qaybgalay Xoghayaha Guud ee ururka, Dr. Xuseen Sheekh Maxamuud, xubno ka tirsan Guddiga Fulinta ee JSP, wasiirro, xildhibaanno, xubnaha ururka iyo taageerayaashiisa. Go’aanka musharraxnimada Senator Cabdiweli Ibraahim Garyare ayaa yimid kadib markii Guddiga Fulinta ee JSP uu si aqlabiyad leh ugu go’aamiyay inuu noqdo musharraxa rasmiga ah ee ururka ugu tartamaya xilka madaxweyne ku xigeenka Galmudug, sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay ururka. JSP ayaa sidoo kale tallaabadan ku xaqiijisay taageerada ay urur ahaan u siinayso Senator Cabdiweli Garyare, iyadoo kaarka musharraxnimada ee la guddoonsiiyay uu rasmi ka dhigayo matalaaddiisa ururka ee tartanka loogu jiro hoggaanka sare ee maamulka Galmudug. Musharraxnimada Garyare ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay socdaan diyaar-garowga iyo loollanka siyaasadeed ee la xiriira doorashooyinka hoggaanka Galmudug oo la filayo in maalmaha soo socda ay ka qabsoonto magaalada caasimada ah ee Dhuusamareeb. Doorashadan waxaa ka horreysay doorashada guddoonka Baarlamaanka Galmudug, taas oo ay ku guuleysteen guddoomiyaha iyo labadiisa ku-xigeen, xubno ka tirsan ururka JSP. Sidoo kale, xilka madaxweynaha Galmudug ayaa loo saadaalinayaa Liibaax Axmed Xasan, oo ay taageerayso Villa Somalia, halka la qorsheynayo in madaxweyne ku-xigeen isna loo doorto Cabdiweli Garyare, oo maanta la guddoonsiiyay kaarka musharraxnimada ee ururka JSP. items.title: Why Somaliland, Why Now
items.description: Israel-Somaliland Friendship Society & Trade Forum The opportunity Why Somaliland, Why Now A market of 5.7 million, a corridor to over 120 million more, and early access for Israeli companies. Latest Oct 12–14 Trump calls Somaliland a ‘totally different country’ from Somalia; Hargeisa celebrates Oct 12 Somaliland’s foreign minister cites Berbera’s spare capacity, says talks with Ethiopia are open Oct 10 Somaliland opens second round of a $500,000 interest-free loan program for young entrepreneurs Oct 4 Egypt, Eritrea, Somalia and Sudan reject Somaliland recognition at El Alamein summit Oct 4 Somaliland rejects Mogadishu’s Berbera base claims, restates support for Ethiopia sea access Oct 3 Somalia’s president alleges an Israeli naval-base plan at Berbera Oct 2 Somaliland asks Israel for air-defense support, citing Turkey’s buildup in Somalia Sep 26 Somalia’s PM says Israel cannot legally establish a base in Somaliland Oct 12–14 Trump calls Somaliland a ‘totally different country’ from Somalia; Hargeisa celebrates Oct 12 Somaliland’s foreign minister cites Berbera’s spare capacity, says talks with Ethiopia are open Oct 10 Somaliland opens second round of a $500,000 interest-free loan program for young entrepreneurs Oct 4 Egypt, Eritrea, Somalia and Sudan reject Somaliland recognition at El Alamein summit Oct 4 Somaliland rejects Mogadishu’s Berbera base claims, restates support for Ethiopia sea access Oct 3 Somalia’s president alleges an Israeli naval-base plan at Berbera Oct 2 Somaliland asks Israel for air-defense support, citing Turkey’s buildup in Somalia Sep 26 Somalia’s PM says Israel cannot legally establish a base in Somaliland     Why now The Window Is Open Three dates tell the story — and explain why timing matters. 26 Dec 2025 Israel becomes the first UN member state to recognize Somaliland since 1991. 2026 Israel names its first ambassador; Somaliland opens its first-ever embassy — in Jerusalem. Today The goodwill window is open for Israeli firms — before competitors normalize their presence. 5.7M population $442M DP World’s Berbera investment 120M+ Ethiopians served by the corridor 3.8M head of livestock exported in 2024 850km Red Sea–adjacent coastline Sources listed at the bottom of this page. The Israeli advantage The One Market Where Being Israeli Opens Doors Israel was the first UN member state to recognize Somaliland since 1991 — and Somaliland answered by opening its first-ever embassy, in Jerusalem. The result is something money can’t usually buy: national-level goodwill, preferential access, and a government that actively welcomes Israeli firms. That advantage is greatest early, before competitors establish their own presence. Jerusalem — home to the first embassy Somaliland has opened anywhere in the world. You would not be first Major Investors Are Already In Sophisticated institutions did the frontier-market due diligence years ago — recognition arrived after they built. Swipe sideways for more → DP World US$442M port agreement (2016); new 500,000-TEU berth inaugurated 2021. UAE & UK capital Abu Dhabi Fund and British International Investment financing the corridor. The State of Israel Recognition, a named ambassador, and joint training programs within months. Growing engagement US strategic interest and multiple countries in the region deepening ties. Somaliland on the Gulf of Aden — Berbera’s deep-water port and the corridor inland to Ethiopia. Where the money is Three Openings Each one concrete enough to act on — and each one deepest for whoever arrives first. Swipe sideways for more → Untapped resources Minerals, gemstones, fisheries along an underexplored coastline — much of it still unsurveyed and unlicensed. A first deal looks like: a geological survey joint-venture or an offtake agreement. Explore mining Israel’s strengths, their needs Water, solar, agtech, fintech — Israel’s export catalog is Somaliland’s shopping list, and the technology was developed for a similar arid climate. A first deal looks like: drip-irrigation supply, an off-grid solar installation, a fintech pilot. Explore all sectors Security & stability Three decades of peaceful self-governance and elections in a rough neighborhood — plus a position on the Gulf of Aden that matters to everyone who ships through the Red Sea. The foundation that makes every other deal on this page financeable. One trade, real math The Livestock Corridor A single provable trade that shows how the pieces fit. 3.8M head exported through Berbera in 2024 — ~85% of export earnings 100,000s live animals Israel imports annually from Australia and Europe Days, not weeks Berbera–Eilat is a short Red Sea run; Australia is ~3 weeks at sea Israel imports live sheep and cattle across oceans, at heavy freight cost and growing animal-welfare pressure. One of the world’s great livestock exporters now sits days away, inside a recognized bilateral relationship. If this one trade works, every other opportunity on this page becomes easier to believe. Read the full livestock deep-dive No varnish The Honest Practicalities Frontier markets reward preparation. Here is what early movers actually deal with. Swipe sideways for more → Getting paid The formal banking system is thin; day-to-day commerce runs on mobile money, and larger flows move through remittance operators and Gulf-hub trade finance. International deals are often structured through UAE entities — an established route the Society can walk you through. Legal protection Somaliland has its own companies law, courts, and a functioning commercial registry. For cross-border contracts, the established practice is to seat arbitration in Dubai or London — and as the Israel–Somaliland framework matures, bilateral protections are expected to deepen. Getting there Hargeisa’s Egal International Airport connects through Addis Ababa and the Gulf hubs; Berbera’s airport is growing alongside the port. Routes and entry arrangements are evolving quickly in the new era — the Society helps members plan the practical details of every trip. The real risks Recognition beyond Israel is still limited; banking friction is real; infrastructure thins out beyond the corridor. Early movers mitigate with corridor-focused projects, UAE structuring, and political-risk insurance. “Two nations that recognized each other twice — in 1960, and again in 2025.” This is not a transaction; it is a friendship with sixty-five years of history. Read the full history We Make the Introductions The ministries, the local partners, the first steps — the Society exists to walk Israeli businesses into Somaliland, and Somaliland businesses into Israel. items.title: DF oo shaacisay magaca horjooge sare oo ay sheegtay inuu qabsaday Buurhakaba
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in horjooge sare oo ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab uu kasoo muuqday degmada Buurhakaba oo dhawaan ka baxday gacanta maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Qoraal uu baahiyay Telefishinka Qaranka ayaa lagu yiri: “Kooxda Khawaarijta oo muddooyinkii ugu dambeeyay deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed ka waday falal ay ku carqaladaynayso nolosha bulshada iyo horumarka deegaanka ayaa dhawaan qabsatay deegaanno ka tirsan maamulka, inkasta oo uu socdo howlgal ballaaran oo ay Ciidanka Qaranka ku doonayaan inay ku soo afjaraan falalka Khawaarijta.” Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in kooxda ay gaartay deegaanno ay kamid yihiin Diinsoor, Qansaxdheere, Bardaale iyo Buurhakaba oo ka tirsan gobolka Bay. Hase yeeshee, arrinta yaabka leh ayaa ah in horjoogaha sare ee kasoo muuqday maleeshiyaadkii qabsaday degmada Buurhakaba uu ahaa shaqsi hore usoo maamulay degmadaas, sida ay sheegtay wasaaraddu. Dowladdu waxay sheegtay in degmada Buurhakaba oo ah goob istaraatiiji ah ay haatan gacanta ku hayaan kooxda Al-Shabaab, xilli ciidanka taabacsan Lafta-gareen ay sheegeen inay la wareegeen gacan ku haynta degmadaas. Haddaba, waa kuma horjoogaha la sheegay inuu qabsaday Buurhakaba? Maxamed Cabdi Xuseen Awkaarey oo dowladdu sheegtay inuu hoggaaminayay maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab ee qabsaday Buurhakaba ayaa taariikh ahaan soo noqday guddoomiyihii hore ee degmadaas xilligii dowladdii ku-meel-gaarka ahayd. Bishii August 2007 ayaa isaga iyo koox la socotay laga sii daayay xabsiga dhexe ee magaalada Baydhabo, xilli ay jireen tuhunno la xiriiray ku biiritaankooda Khawaarijta. Muddo kaddib, sanadkii 2008 ayuu si rasmi ah isaga casilay xilkii guddoomiyenimo ee degmada Buurhakaba, wixii xilligaas ka dambeeyayna wuxuu ku biiray Khawaarijta. Sannadkii 2013 ayuu markii ugu dambeysay kasoo muuqday degmada Buurhakaba, isagoo ka tirsanaa maamulkii kooxda ee afduubka ku haystay dadka deegaanka, xilligaas oo Taliska Qaybta 60-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka uu jab xooggan gaarsiiyay maleeshiyaadkii kooxda. Dadka deegaanka ayay dowladdu sheegtay inay walaac xooggan ka muujiyeen hab-dhaqanka kooxda. “Waxay dhibaataynayaan bulshada, odayaasha dhaqanka oo la xirxiray iyo dhallinyarada deegaanka oo la dhibaateynayo. Dhac iyo bililiqo ayaa laga soo warinayaa degmada Buurhakaba,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka dowladda. Dowladda Soomaaliya oo guluf kula jirta Al-Shabaab ayaa sheegtay inay waddo qorshe lagu soo afjarayo duullaanka ay kooxdu ka waddo deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ay u jiheysteen deegaannadii ay dhawaan rabshadaha ka geysteen maleeshiyaadka kooxda. Dowladdu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in falalka ay kooxdu billowday ay soo dedejinayaan kacdoon shacab, iyadoo degmooyinka iyo deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed ay ka socdaan abaabullo ay shacabku kaga qayb qaadanayaan sidii looga dulqaadi lahaa khataraha ay ku hayaan kooxaha argagixisada. Si kastaba, degmada Buurhakaba oo qiyaastii 60KM u jirta magaalada Baydhabo waxaa mara waddooyin istaraatiiji ah oo isku xira gobollada Bay, Shabeellaha Hoose, Banaadir, Hiiraan iyo Jubbooyinka, waana tan muhiimad gaar ah siinaysa degmadan oo kamid ah deegaano dhowr ah oo laga qabsaday maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. The post DF oo shaacisay magaca horjooge sare oo ay sheegtay inuu qabsaday Buurhakaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Dadka deegaanka ayay dowladdu sheegtay inay walaac xooggan ka muujiyeen hab-dhaqanka kooxda. “Waxay dhibaataynayaan bulshada, odayaasha dhaqanka oo la xirxiray iyo dhallinyarada deegaanka oo la dhibaateynayo. Dhac iyo bililiqo ayaa laga soo warinayaa degmada Buurhakaba,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka dowladda. Dowladda Soomaaliya oo guluf kula jirta Al-Shabaab ayaa sheegtay inay waddo qorshe lagu soo afjarayo duullaanka ay kooxdu ka waddo deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ay u jiheysteen deegaannadii ay dhawaan rabshadaha ka geysteen maleeshiyaadka kooxda. Dowladdu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in falalka ay kooxdu billowday ay soo dedejinayaan kacdoon shacab, iyadoo degmooyinka iyo deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed ay ka socdaan abaabullo ay shacabku kaga qayb qaadanayaan sidii looga dulqaadi lahaa khataraha ay ku hayaan kooxaha argagixisada. Si kastaba, degmada Buurhakaba oo qiyaastii 60KM u jirta magaalada Baydhabo waxaa mara waddooyin istaraatiiji ah oo isku xira gobollada Bay, Shabeellaha Hoose, Banaadir, Hiiraan iyo Jubbooyinka, waana tan muhiimad gaar ah siinaysa degmadan oo kamid ah deegaano dhowr ah oo laga qabsaday maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. items.title: Kadib eedeyntii DF ee Kenya iyo Itoobiya, Abiy Ahmed oo maanta ka degay Kenya
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed ayaa saaka gaaray magaalada Eldoret ee dalka Kenya, halkaas oo ay kusoo dhaweeyeen mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Kenya. Abiy ayaa marti sharaf ka ah munaasabadda xuska maalinta halyeeyada Kenya ee Mashujaa Day, waxaana la filayaa inuu kulan la yeesho Madaxweynaha Kenya, William Ruto. Labada hoggaamiye ayaa ka wada-hadlaya xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo danaha ay wadaagaan ee gobolka. Booqashadan ayaa ku soo aadaysa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan khilaafka ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed oo isku hayaan hoggaanka cusub ee maamulka iyo kii hore ee Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Dowladda Federaalka iyo hoggaanka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa Kenya iyo Itoobiya ku eedeeyay inay taageero siinayaan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen) oo haatan khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo mid amni kala dhexeeyo Muqdisho iyo Baydhabo. Kulanka Abiy iyo Ruto ayaa sidaas darteed imanaya xilli ay gobolka ka jiraan arrimo siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah, inkasta oo aan weli la shaacin in xaaladda Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay qodobada ay labada hoggaamiye kaga wada-hadli doonaan. Hoggaanka maamulka Koonfur Galbeed iyo Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo deegaan ahaan kasoo jeeda Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ku eedeeyay dowladaha Kenya iyo Itoobiya inay qayb ka yihiin faragelinta lagu hayo maamulka. Itoobiya ayaa si gaar ah loogu dhaliilay doorka ciidamadeeda ku sugan deegaannada maamulka, kuwaas oo lagu eedeeyay inay ku guuldarreysteen ka hortagga qabsashada deegaannadaas, oo haatan u gacan galay ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen. Eedeymaha ayaa tilmaamaya in ciidamada Itoobiya ay indhaha ka daawanayeen dhaq-dhaqaaqyada maleeshiyaadka, halkii ay ka qaadi lahaayeen tallaabo ay xaaladda ku xakameynayaan ama uga hortagayaan maleeshiyaadkaas, maadaama ay joogaan deegaanadaas. Sidoo kale, Kenya ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay martigelisay siyaasiyiin ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya cunaqabateyn saartay oo kamid yahay Lafta-gareen, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay ku lug leeyihiin faragelinta ciidan ee ka socota Koonfur Galbeed. Labada dal ayaa ciidamo ka jooga Soomaaliya, waxayna qayb ka yihiin howl-galka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Arrintan ayaa sii xoojinaysa walaaca laga qabo doorka ay dalalka deriska ah ku leeyihiin xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo tan amni ee ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed. Si kastaba, illaa hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay dowladaha Kenya iyo Itoobiya oo ay kaga jawaabayaan eedeymahan. The post Kadib eedeyntii DF ee Kenya iyo Itoobiya, Abiy Ahmed oo maanta ka degay Kenya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dowladda Ingiriiska oo sheegtay inay diyaaradaha dagaalka Typhoon u direyso Sacuudiga
items.description: Dowladda Ingiriiska ayaa sheegtay inay diyaaradaha dagaalka Typhoon u diri doonto ama gayn doono Sacuudiga, si ay uga qayb qaataan difaaca hawada dalkaasi. Diyaaradaha dagaalka Typhoon ee Ciidanka Cirka Ingiriiska (UK) ayaa waxay fulin doonaan hawlgalo difaac oo keliya, iyagoo gacan ka gaysanaya ka hortagga weerarada gantaalada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ay Xuutiyiinta Yemen ku qaadayaan gudaha Sacuudiga. Wasiirka Difaaca Ingiriiska, Wes Streeting ayaa Talaadadan xaqiijiyay in diyaaradahani aysan qaadi doonin wax weerar ah oo ka dhan ah bartilmaameedyada Xuutiyiinta. “Diyaaradahan waxay u hawlgeli doonaan door difaac ah, mana qaadi doonaan weeraro dagaal oo ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka oo warkan ku sheegay war qoraal ah oo ka soo baxay xafiiskiisa. Go’aankan ayaa yimid, xilli Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ay beegsanayaan garoomada diyaaradaha iyo xarumaha saliidda ee Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, iyagoo kaga aargudanaya weerarada dhanka cirka ee uga imanaya Riyadh. Mohammed bin Salman, Dhaxal-sugaha Boqortooyada Sacuudiga ayaa taageero ka raadinaya xulafada caalamiga ah iyo kuwa gobolka, si loo xakameeyo weerarada Xuutiyiinta. Inkasta oo Sacuudiga uu ka mid yahay dalalka ugu iibsashada badan hubka iyo gantaalada difaaca hawada, haddana weerarada Xuutiyiinta ayaa muujiyay in uu nugul yahay difaaca cirka ee boqortooyada.

items.title: Turkiga oo DF Soomaaliya u ballan-qaaday kordhinta…
items.description: Ankara (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Turkiga ayaa shaacisay inay sannadka 2027 kordhin doonto tababarrada ciidamada Soomaaliya, si ay awood dheeraad ah ugu yeeshaan sugidda amniga dalka, ulana wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga guud ee Soomaaliya. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Turkiga ayaa sheegtay in iskaashiga difaac ee labada dal uu dhigayo in Ankara ay tababarto oo qalabeyso ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo ay tilmaantay inay door muuqda ka qaateen xoojinta amniga dalka. Intii lagu jiray sannadkan 2026, Turkiga ayaa tababarro siiyay ciidamo cusub iyo saraakiil Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo lagu tababaray gudaha Soomaaliya iyo xeryaha milatari ee Turkiga, sida ay sheegtay wasaaradda. Qorshaha Ankara ee sannadka soo socda ayaa ah in la ballaariyo tababarrada, iyadoo dowladda Turkiga ay arrintan ku saleysay heshiisyada iyo iskaashiga amni ee kala dhexeeya dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Ciidamada uu Turkigu tababaray waxaa ka mid ah kumaandooska Gorgor oo ka tirsan ciidamada xoogga dalka iyo booliska gaarka ah ee Haramcad. Labadan ciidan ayaa ka mid ah cutubyada sida gaarka ah loo tababaray ee Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, waxaa socda qorshayaal la xiriira tababarka ciidamada cirka iyo kuwa badda Soomaaliya, taas oo qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu dhisayo awoodda difaaca dalka, sida ay muujinayaan xogaha la helayo. Kordhinta tababarrada ayaa imanaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay dadaal ugu jirto xoojinta awoodda ciidamadeeda, si ay si madax-bannaan u sugaan amniga dalka, iyadoo taageerada Turkigu ay qayb ka tahay iskaashiga milatari ee labada dowladood. The post Turkiga oo DF Soomaaliya u ballan-qaaday kordhinta… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo Muqdisho kula kulmay Shariif Xasan Sheekh Aadan (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo weli booqasho ku jooga Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa la kulmay Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Shariif Xasan Sheekh Aadan. “Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda guud ee deegaanada Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan arrimaha amniga, siyaasadda, nabadeynta, dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada iyo dib u xoreynta degmooyinka ay Khawaarijtu qabsadeen.” Ayaa lagu yiri war maanta ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed oo lagu xusay “Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed iyo Madaxweynihii hore ayaa isweydaarsaday aragtiyo ku saabsan muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta nabadda, midnimada iyo wadajirka bulshada, iyadoo la adkeynayo dadaalada lagu xaqiijinayo xasilloonida siyaasadeed iyo amni ee deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed.” Warka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Kulanka ayaa lagu muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wadatashiga iyo iskaashiga siyaasadeed, lana mideeyo dadaalada lagu horumarinayo dowladnimada, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo nabad ku wada noolaanshaha bulshada.” Xubno uu ka mid yahay Gudoomiye Kuxigeenka 1aad ee Baarlamaanka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Xasan Maxamed (Osama) ayaa ka qaybgalay kulanka. Kulankan ayaa daba socdo kulamo siyaasadeed oo Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed uu maalmihii la soo dhaafay ka waday Caasimadda Muqdisho. Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo maamulkiisu uu wajahayo xilli adag ayaa is garabtaag siyaasadeed ka raadinaya siyaasiyiinta deegaanka.

items.title: Xoolaha u dhinta bacaha ay cunaan oo ku badanaya Guriceel iyo deegaano hoostaga
items.description: (ERGO) – Xoolo dhaqato ku nool magaalada Guriceel ayaa qarka u saaran inay ceyr noqdaan. Waxaa sabab u ah bac deegaanka ku baahday oo xooluha cunay ay dhintaan. Waa arin ay maaro u waayeen wax ka qabashadeeda ayaa sidoo kale saamaysay nacfigii ay ka helayeen xoolaha. Faadumo Geelle Cabdi oo ka mid ah dadka ay xaaladan haysto ayaa sheegtay in miyigii ay ku dhaqan jireen xoolaha uu ka yaraaday daaqii iyo ilihii biyaha. Bacda iyo qashinka kale ee lagu soo fogeeyo daafaha magaalada ayaa qabsaday dhulkii daaqa lahaa, kaas caqabad ku noqday reer-guuraaga. Waxay xustay in 29 ari ah ay uga dhinteen bac ay cuneen, tan iyo bishii may ee sanadkan. Labo bil ka hor dhaqtar deegaanka ah ayay tilmaamtay in qalliin badbaado ah oo uu ku sameeyay 7 neef uu uga saaray bac ay cuneen oo 148 kiilo ah. Waxaa uga baxay qarash gaaraya $55. Caqabadahan ayay xustay inay yareeyeen taranka, cadkii iyo caanihii ay ka heli jirtay xoolaha. Faadumo ayaa sheegtay in halista bacdu ay ku dhalisay in xoolaha ay ka ilaaliso inay u foofaan bannaanka. Xero ku taalla gurigeeda ayay ku quudisaa, balse tani waa mid u baahan qarash joogta ah oo helitaankiisu uu ku adag yahay. “Waxa yar ee hadda aan ka lisayay ee aad arkeyseen waa kuwa xerada aan ku celinayo oo bacda ka dhowreyo. Duur uma ka xeyn karno bacdii ayaa cunno noqotay.” Masago, qamadi iyo buunsho uu qiimahoodu yahay $400 ayay sheegtay in bil walba ay soo gaddo oo ay ku quudiso, maadama ay ka joojisay in bannaanka ay daaq u doontaan. Waloow ay maareysay khatartii bacda, waxaa ku adag inay hesho qarashka ku baxaya quudinta oo ay tilmaamtay inuu ka badan yahay dakhliga ka soo gala xoolaha oo maalinkii ah afar liitar oo caano ah, una dhigma $10. Arintaasi waxay sababtay in lagu yeesho deyn gaareysa $400. Mararka qaar oo lacagtu badato ayay xustay inay gaddo dhowr neef, si ay iskaga yareyso. “Waxaan hayaa 67 neef oo ido iyo ari cad ah. Xerada ayuu ku xabisan yahay, maadama wax ku filan aanan u heli Karin. Bacda in nalaga qabto oo la xanibo ayaan ka codsanayaa cid kasta oo awoodeeda leh.” Faadumo, waa 60 jir. Markii hore waxay magaalada ku iibin jirtay caanaha miyiga laga keeno, balse abaaraha oo sababay inay yaraadaan reer miyigii caanaha keeni jiray ayaa ku dhalisay in iyadu isku badasho xoolo dhaqato deggan magaalada. Waa hooyo kaligeed korisa siddeed carruur ah oo ayeeyo ay u tahay, ayna dhaleen ubadkeeda oo reer guuraa ah. Afar ayaa iskuul dhigta oo bishii ay ka dhiibtaa konton Doollar. Xooluhu waa isha kaliya dhaqaale ee qoyskeedu uu ku tiirsan yahay. Qarashka uga baxa xoolaha guri joogga ah ayaa ka badan midka reerka. “Wii iima shaqeeyo, gabadhna ima shaqeyso, oday ima shaqeyo. Hadda waa kaas arigaas waa nool yahay uun. Deyn islaameed ayaan ku daldalaa.” Saameynta isbedelka cimilada oo sanooyinkii dambe noqotay mid togan oo joogta ah, abaaro soo noqnoqday iyo daaqii iyo biyihii oo yaraaday waxay sababeen in xoolo dhaqatadu ay ka fogaadaan magaalooyinka oo ay u hayaamaan miyi fog si calaf ay ugu helaan xoolaha. Arintaas waxay ku dhalisay dadka magaalada deggan inay billaabaan dhaqashada xoolaha, si ay u helaan cadkii iyo caanihii uga imaan jiray xoolo dhaqatada ay ragaadiyeen caqabadaha is biirsaday. Dr Ibraahim Daahir Cismaan oo bartay cilmiga xannaanada xoolaha oo sameeyay xog uruurin shaqsi ah ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in dadka ku nool Guriceel ay 75% yihiin xoolo dhaqato. Wuxuu tilmaamay in taasi aysan ka dhigneyn in isku filnaasho ay ka gaareen nacfiga laga helo xoolaha. Wuxuu sheegay inaysan badi u helin xoolaha quudin ku filan roob la’aan iyo dhaqaale xumo darteed. Wuxuu sheegay in qiimeyn uu sameeyay uu ku ogaaday in celcelis ay bil walba u dhintaan bac ay cuneen 3000 kun oo neef. Xoolaha magaalada lagu dhaqdo ayuu xusay inay wajahayaan halis uga imaaneysa bacda oo taalla meel walba. “Waxaan xasuustaa hadda ka hor nin ay 30 neef Ido ah oo maagalada ku xareysan wuu soofin jiray, laakiin soofkii wey gabeen maaddama tabartooda yaraatay. Idahaas hal neef oo bac ka nabad qaba oo la is leeyahay neefkaas haddan bacda laga bixin waa uu soo kabmi karaa wax walba oo la siiyo kuma jiro. Guud ahaan soddonka neefba kansal ayey ahayeen.”   Dr Ibraahim ayaa intaas ku daray in bil kasta uu qalliin ku sameeyo ari gaaraya 150, illaa 200 oo Guriceel lagu dhaqdo oo bac ay caloosha buuxisay. Dadka leh ayuu ka qaadaa neefkiiba, lacag u dhexeysa $7 illaa $10, inta aan awoodinna bilaash ayuu ugu shaqeeyaa, sida uu sheegay. Neefka ayuu tilmaamay inuusan cayileyn inta ay bac ku jirto calooshiisa, ugu dambeyna uu dhimanayo. Xoolo dhaqatada ayuu tilmaamay in badankood aysan ku baraarugsaneyn halistan, ayna xoolaha xoolaha ka xanuunsan moodayaan inay la il daran yihiin cuduro. Saameynta dhaqaale ee ka dhalatay xoolaha u dhimanaya bacda ayuu sheegay inuu ka dareemay sida dadku aysan u awoodin lacagta qalliinka neefka bacda cunay iyo daaweyntiisa, taaso marar badan ku qasabtay inuu u sameeyo qalliin iyo daaweyn bilaash ah. “Neef aad kasoo bixisay $30 dollar oo waxba kale aadan ka faa’iidin ayaa laga yabaa in uu bacda kaga dhinto. Haddii qalliin lagu sameyana qarash ayaa galaya, daawana waa galleysaa, waqtina waa gallayaa oo neefkii wuxuu rabaa in la baaniyo, lasoo kabo.” Siciid Cabdi Muxumed wuxuu ari 80 neef ku dhaqdaa gudaha degmada Guriceel. Wuxuu Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in 17 ari ah bac ay cuneen ay uga dhinteen isagoo markaas aan fahansaneyn in xoolaha bacda cuna loo sameyn karo qalliin iyo daryeel caafimaad. “Aniga ma aaminsaneyn neef xoolaha ah inta la qalo oo bu’weyntiisa bananka la keeno oo la jeexo oo wasaq laga soo bixiyo ayaad hadana 100 kala baxeysa ma aaminsaneyn, waana ay dhacday oo waan arkay.” Siciid oo horay u ahaa dillaal xoolaha iibiya ayaa ari dhaqashadan ku jira muddo toban sanno ah. Wuxuu sheegay in faa’iido badan uu ka sameyn lahaa iibka xoolaha haddii aysan jiri laheyn dhibaatada bacda. “Galmudug codsiga u dhibanayo wuxuu yahay anigoo wareysiga Raadiyow Ergo ka faa’iideysanaya codsiga u dhiibanayo waxaa ka mid ah in ay bacda la dirirto. Waa cudur dilaa ah, xoolihiina dhameyay. Xoolo haddii la waayana naf la waayay.” Qoyska Siciid oo ka kooban 11 qof ayaa ku tiirsan xoolaha uu ku dhaqdo magaalada. Bacda latuuro marka la isticmaalo, saameynteedu waa mid sii kordheysa. Waaa halis aan lagu baraarug saneyn oo ku sii baaheysa deegaanka, xooluhu ay u dhimanayaan, daaqa iyo dhirtana yareysa. Cabashada ka taagan dhaqaale burburka ay geysaneyso waa mid taagan maalin kasta, hasa yeeshee ma jiraan maamul iyo bulsho u mideysan sidii wax looga qaban lahaa. items.title: Golaha Mustaqbalka oo digniin kama dambeys ah u direy madaxweyne Xasan
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa si adag uga horyimid qorshaha doorashooyinka Soomaaliya, isaga oo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku eedeeyay inuu wado go’aanno hal dhinac ah oo halis gelin kara midnimada dalka, nidaamka federaalka iyo dowladnimada. War-saxaafadeed uu soo saaray Golaha ayaa lagu diiday jadwalka doorashooyinka labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka iyo tan Madaxtooyada, kaas oo Goluhu sheegay in lagu go’aamiyay rabitaanka Xasan Sheekh, iyadoo aan la gaarin heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay. Si looga gudbo ismari-waaga taagan, Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa ku baaqay in dib loo bilaabo wada-hadallada dhex-dhexaadinta, lana gaaro heshiis ay wada oggol yihiin dhinacyada siyaasadda, kaas oo ay taageerayaan saaxiibbada caalamka. Goluhu wuxuu adkeeyay in doorashooyinka lagu saleeyo wadatashi iyo is-afgarad siyaasadeed. Goluhu wuxuu xusay in Soomaaliya ay xilligan wajahayso caqabado isbiirsaday oo ay ka mid yihiin Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish, fatahaadaha la xiriira El Niño, abaaraha ka dhasha isbeddelka cimilada iyo loollanka sii xoogeysanaya ee gobolka. Sida uu sheegay, xaaladahaasi waxay sii xoojinayaan baahida loo qabo hoggaan mideysan iyo iskaashi siyaasadeed. Dhanka kale, Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa ka digay in khilaafka siyaasadeed ee taagan uu wiiqi karo dadaallada lagu dhisayo dowladnimada, isla markaana uu dhaawici karo wadajirka bulshada, iyadoo uu ku baaqay in laga fogaado tallaabo kasta oo sii kala fogeyn karta dhinacyada siyaasadda. Inkasta oo uu caddeeyay inuu diyaar u yahay wada-hadal dhab ah oo lagu gaaro hannaan doorasho iyo jadwal macquul ah, haddana Goluhu wuxuu sheegay inuu qaadi doono tallaabooyin kale oo dastuuri ah iyo kuwo siyaasadeed haddii Xasan Sheekh uu ku adkaysto go’aannada uu ku tilmaamay kuwo hal dhinac ah. Goluhu wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in mas’uuliyadda cawaaqibka ka dhasha go’aannadaas ay saaran tahay madaxweynaha iyo cid kasta oo taageerta. Ugu dambeyntiina, wuxuu shacabka ugu baaqay inay ka hortagaan tallaabooyinka uu ku tilmaamay kuwo ka hor imanaya sharciga iyo dastuurka, halka uu saaxiibbada caalamka ugu baaqay inay taageeraan hannaan siyaasadeed oo ku dhisan wadatashi iyo heshiis loo dhan yahay. items.title: Maxkamadda Shareecada ee Puntland oo Liibaan Tahliil u xukuntay wiilkii lagu muransanaa
items.description: Maxkamadda Shareecada ee Puntland (Guddiga Culimada) ayaa maanta xukun ka soo saartay kiis muddo soo jiitamayay, oo laba qoys ay isku haysteen cidda dhashay wiil lagu magacaabo Maxamed Yare. Maxkamadda Shareecada ee Puntland ee Magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa xukuntay in wiilka uu dhalay Liibaan Tahliil Xaaji Aadan, oo ah mid ka mid ah labadii nin ee wiilka isku haystay, isla-markaana aanu dhalin ninkii kale ee muranka uu kala dhexeeyay oo lagu magacaabo Faarax Cawil Cali. “Ka dib markii Xaliimo Yuusuf Maxamed, wiilka hooyadiis ay u qirtay wiilka in uu dhalay Liibaan Tahliil Xaaji Aadan, oo uusana dhalin Faarax Cawil, dhaar ka dib.” Ayuu yiri Garsooraha Maxkamadda oo intaasi ku daray “Ka dib markii wiilka lagu wareystay foggaan arag maxkamadda horteeda, isagoo qaangaar ah oo caaqil ah, caafimaad qaba, sheegtayna inuu jiro 16 sano, ka caddeeyay markii maxkamadda horteeda la weydiiyay nasabkiisa inuu yahay Maxamed Liibaan Tahliil, oo uusana ahayn Ina Faarax Cawil.” Garsooraha oo ku dhawaaqay xukunka ayaa yiri “Sidaa darteed wiilka waxaa u sugnaatay nasabaddiisa inuu yahay Maxamed Liibaan Tahliil, waxaana anfoobay sheegashadii Faarax Cawil Cali uu sheegtay wiilka. Sidaas darteed waxay u xukuntay maxkamaddu inuu dhalay wiilka Liibaan Tahliil Xaaji Aadan. Wa Billaahi Towfiiq.” Liibaan Tahliil oo intaasi ka dib ka hadlay goobta ayaa sheegay in uu ku faraxsan yahay xukunka, isla-markaana dhibaatadii ka dhalatay kiiskaasi xal laga gaari doono. “Waxaan ka codsanayaa dadka ehelada ah ee labada dhinac arrinta halkaa in lagu soo geba-gabeeyo, waxtar ma ahanee dhibaato dambe arrintaasi inaanan loo gaysanin.” Ayuu yiri Liibaan Tahliil oo loo xukumay inuu wiilka dhalay. Faarax Cawil, oo ah ninka dacwadda looga guuleystay ayaa dhankiisa aqbalay go’aanka maxkamadda, inkastoo uu dalbaday wixii kharash ah ee kaga baxay koriimada wiilka. Kiiskan oo muddo soo jiitamayay, isla-markaana abuuray xiisad weyn ayaa sababay dhimashada toddobo qof iyo dhaawaca 21 kale.

Maxkamadda Shareecada ee Puntland ee Magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa xukuntay in wiilka uu dhalay Liibaan Tahliil Xaaji Aadan, oo ah mid ka mid ah labadii nin ee wiilka isku haystay, isla-markaana aanu dhalin ninkii kale ee muranka uu kala dhexeeyay oo lagu magacaabo Faarax Cawil Cali. “Ka dib markii Xaliimo Yuusuf Maxamed, wiilka hooyadiis ay u qirtay wiilka in uu dhalay Liibaan Tahliil Xaaji Aadan, oo uusana dhalin Faarax Cawil, dhaar ka dib.” Ayuu yiri Garsooraha Maxkamadda oo intaasi ku daray “Ka dib markii wiilka lagu wareystay foggaan arag maxkamadda horteeda, isagoo qaangaar ah oo caaqil ah, caafimaad qaba, sheegtayna inuu jiro 16 sano, ka caddeeyay markii maxkamadda horteeda la weydiiyay nasabkiisa inuu yahay Maxamed Liibaan Tahliil, oo uusana ahayn Ina Faarax Cawil.” Garsooraha oo ku dhawaaqay xukunka ayaa yiri “Sidaa darteed wiilka waxaa u sugnaatay nasabaddiisa inuu yahay Maxamed Liibaan Tahliil, waxaana anfoobay sheegashadii Faarax Cawil Cali uu sheegtay wiilka. Wa Billaahi Towfiiq.” Liibaan Tahliil oo intaasi ka dib ka hadlay goobta ayaa sheegay in uu ku faraxsan yahay xukunka, isla-markaana dhibaatadii ka dhalatay kiiskaasi xal laga gaari doono. “Waxaan ka codsanayaa dadka ehelada ah ee labada dhinac arrinta halkaa in lagu soo geba-gabeeyo, waxtar ma ahanee dhibaato dambe arrintaasi inaanan loo gaysanin.” Ayuu yiri Liibaan Tahliil oo loo xukumay inuu wiilka dhalay. Faarax Cawil, oo ah ninka dacwadda looga guuleystay ayaa dhankiisa aqbalay go’aanka maxkamadda, inkastoo uu dalbaday wixii kharash ah ee kaga baxay koriimada wiilka. items.title: Maxkamadda Sare oo go’aan ka gaartay codsi ka yimid Khalid Sheikh Mohammed
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka Mareykanka ayaa Isniintii diidday inay dib u eegis ku sameyso dacwad uu u soo gudbiyay Khalid Sheikh Mohammed — ninka lagu eedeeyay inuu ahaa maskaxdii ka dambeysay weerarradii 11-kii Sebtembar 2001 — kaas oo doonayay in dib loo soo nooleeyo heshiis lagu baajinayay ciqaabta dilka ah oo lagu beddelayay inuu qirto dambiga. Garsoorayaasha Maxkamadda Sare ayaa diiday racfaanka ay soo gudbiyeen Khaalid iyo laba eedeysane oo kale, kuwaas oo ka soo horjeeday go’aan ay maxkamad hoose ku taageertay tallaabadii uu Wasiirkii hore ee Gaashaandhigga Mareykanka, Lloyd Austin, ku laalay heshiiskii la gaaray sannadkii 2024-kii. Maxkamadda Racfaanka ee Washington (DC Circuit) ayaa horay u diidday doodda qareennada ee ahayd in Austin uu daahay markii uu heshiiska burinayay, iyadoo sheegtay inuu awood buuxda u lahaa tallaabadaas. Go’aankan cusub ee Maxkamadda Sare ayaa waddada u xaaraya in maxkamad milateri lagu qaado eedeysanayaashan ku xiran xabsiga Guantanamo Bay ee dalka Cuba, kiiskaas oo muddo labaatan sano ka badan ku xayirnaa is-mari-waa sharciyeed. Afhayeen u hadlay Wasaaradda Caddaaladda ee Mareykanka ayaa bayaan uu soo saaray ku soo dhoweeyay go’aanka maxkamadda. “Go’aankani wuxuu waddada u furayaa in lala xisaabtamo dadkii ka dambeeyay weerarradii 11-kii Sebtembar. Waa tallaabo muhiim ah oo loo qaaday xaqiijinta caddaaladda dhibanayaashii iyo qoysaskii ku waxyeelloobay mid ka mid ah maalmihii ugu madoobaa taariikhda Mareykanka,” ayuu yiri. Bishii Ogosto ee la soo dhaafay, garsoore ka tirsan Ciidanka Cirka ee Mareykanka ayaa muddeeyay in maxkamadeynta rasmiga ah ee Khalid Sheikh Mohammed iyo eedeysanayaasha kale ay bilaabanto bisha Juun ee sannadka 2028-ka. Heshiiskii dambiga lagu qiranayay ee buuqa dhaliyay Heshiiska dambiga lagu qiranayay ee dhexmaray dacwad-oogayaasha iyo eedeysanayaasha — Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, Mustafa al-Hawsawi iyo Walid bin ‘Atash — ayaa markii hore waxaa saxiixay sarkaalkii dowladda u qaabilsanaa maxkamadda milatariga ee Guantanamo, balse arrintaas ayaa dhalisay caradii ugu xoogganayd oo kaga timid sharci-dejiyeyaasha xisbiga Jamhuuriga iyo qaar ka mid ah qoysaska dhibanayaasha. Laba maalmood kaddib, Lloyd Austin ayaa si degdeg ah u baabi’iyay heshiiskaas. Inkasta oo garsoore milateri uu markii hore sheegay in Austin uusan awood u lahayn inuu heshiiska laalo, haddana maxkamadda racfaanka ee Washington ayaa bishii Luulyo 2025 taageertay go’aankii Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, iyadoo ku doodday in heshiiska la burin karo maadaama dacwadda rasmiga ah aan weli la guda gelin. Qareennada difaacayay eedeysanayaasha, oo ay ku jiraan ururka u dooda xuquuqda madaniga ah ee ACLU, ayaa ku dooday in go’aankii Austin uu jabiyay shuruucda milatariga, uuna dib u dhigay fursaddii ugu weyneyd ee lagu soo afjari karay kiiska 9/11 muddo rubuc qarni ah kaddib. Khalid Sheikh Mohammed ayaa weli ah maxbuuska ugu caansan xabsiga Guantanamo Bay, kaas oo Madaxweynihii hore George W. Bush uu furay sannadkii 2002 si loogu hayo ajaanibta looga shakisan yahay argagixisada kaddib weerarradii 9/11 oo ay ku dhinteen ku dhowaad 3,000 oo qof. Khaalid ayaa lagu eedeeyay inuu qorsheeyay afduubkii diyaaradihii lagu dhuftay xaruntii ganacsiga adduunka ee Twin Towers iyo dhismaha gaashaandhigga ee Pentagon-ka. items.title: Sawirro: Wafdi ballaaran oo ka socda Uganda oo Muqdisho soo gaaray + Ujeedka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wafdi ballaaran oo ka socda dalka Uganda, kana kooban agaasimayaal, saraakiil iyo ganacsato ayaa maanta lagu soo dhaweeyay garoonka diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde ee magaalada Muqdisho. Danjiraha Uganda u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Danjire Fardowsa Maxamed Qanyare iyo diblumaasiyiin ka tirsan safaaradda Uganda ee Muqdisho ayaa garoonka ku qaabilay wafdiga oo dalka u yimid ka qayb-galka kulamo lagu xoojinayo xiriirka labada dal. Wafdigan ayaa Muqdisho uga qayb-geli doona Madasha Ganacsiga Soomaaliya iyo Uganda, taas oo diiradda lagu saarayo horumarinta xiriirka ganacsi iyo kobcinta iskaashiga dhaqaale ee labada dal. Sidoo kale, wafdigu wuxuu ka qayb-galayaa kulanka sannadlaha ah ee Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Uganda (JPC), kaas oo qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu horumarinayo iskaashiga labada dowladood. Kulamadan ayaa la filayaa inay fursad u noqdaan labada dhinac si ay uga wada-hadlaan sidii loo xoojin lahaa xiriirka diblumaasiyadeed, loona ballaarin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan, gaar ahaan ganacsiga iyo dhaqaalaha. Danjire Fardowsa Maxamed Qanyare ayaa warbaahinta u sheegtay in kulamadu ay muhiim u yihiin sii xoojinta xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Uganda, iyadoo tilmaantay fursadaha ay u abuuri karaan iskaashiga labada dal. Waxay sidoo kale kulamadan fursad u yihiin ganacsatada labada dal inay is-dhaafsadaan fikradaha iyo fursadaha ganacsi, si loo kobciyo xiriirka dhaqaale loona abuuro iskaashi waxtar u leh labada dhinac. Soomaaliya ayaa markii ugu horreysay martigelinaysa Madasha Ganacsiga Soomaaliya iyo Uganda iyo kulanka sannadlaha ah ee JPC kadib markii Uganda ay hore laba jeer u martigelisay kulamadan. items.title: Mareykanka oo dowladda Sacuudiga la xiriiriyey nin ay xireen isagoo wax jaajuusaya
items.description: San Francisco (Caasmada Online) — Injineer hore uga tirsanaa shirkadda caanka ah ee OpenAI, oo lagu eedeeyay inuu qalab wax duuba si qarsoodi ah u dhex dhigay qolka shirarka madaxda sare ee shirkadda, ayaa la aaminsan yahay inuu taageero la taaban karo ka helay dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya, sida ay sheegeen xeer-ilaaliyeyaasha federaalka Mareykanka. Dokumiintiyo ay maxkamad u gudbisay xeer-ilaalinta ayaa lagu caddeeyay in ninkan oo magaciisa lagu sheegay Abdulrahman Alfozan, da’diisuna tahay 35 jir, uu xiriir joogto ah la lahaa xubin ka tirsan qoyska boqortooyada Sacuudiga. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu eedeeyay in sarkaal ka tirsan milatariga dalkaas uu bixiyay tikidh diyaaradeed oo hal dhinac ah (one-way ticket) oo ay xaaskiisa iyo wiilkiisa yar dib ugu laabteen Sacuudiga kaddib markii isaga la xiray. Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa garsooraha maxkamadda federaalka ka codsatay in Alfozan lagu sii hayo xabsiga inta dacwaddiisu socoto, iyagoo ku dooday inuu jiro khatar xooggan oo ah inuu dalka ka baxsado haddii damaanad lagu sii daayo. Alfozan, oo u dhashay dalka Sacuudiga balse haysta sharciga deganaanshaha joogtada ah ee Mareykanka (Green Card), ayaa lagu wadaa inuu hor yimaado maxkamadda federaalka ee magaalada San Francisco. Kiiskan ayaa daaha ka fayday loolanka adag iyo caqabadaha dhanka amniga ah ee ku xeeran cilmi-baarista sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI), xilli dowladaha iyo shirkadaha waaweyn ee dunidu ay tartan ba’an ugu jiraan cidda hoggaanka u qabanaysa teknoolajiyaddan mustaqbalka hagaysa. Qalab lagu dhex qariyay TV-ga gadaashiisa Sida ku cad dacwadda ciqaabta ah, Alfozan ayaa qalab casri ah oo si gaar ah loo habeeyay xogtiisana la sireeyay (encrypted) ku dhex xiray telefishin ku yaallay qolka shirarka fulinta ee xarunta OpenAI (Shirkadda sameysay ChatGPT) ku leedahay magaalada San Francisco. Xeer-ilaalinta ayaa sheegtay in xilligii qalabkaas la rakibayay ay qolka ka socdeen kulamo xasaasi ah oo ay ku lug lahaayeen madaxda ugu sarreysa shirkadda, ganacsato heer caalami ah iyo xubno ka tirsan dowladda Mareykanka. Shirkadda OpenAI ayaa sheegtay inay qalabkaas ogaatay 30-kii bishii Sebtembar, kaddibna ay xogta u gudbisay hay’adda dambi-baarista federaalka Mareykanka ee FBI. Xogta dacwadda ayaa sidoo kale muujisay in xubin ka tirsan qoyska boqortooyada Sacuudiga uu isku dayay inuu Alfozan u qoro jago la xiriirta howlaha AI ee gudaha Sacuudiga, isagoo fariin ugu qoray: “Sacuudigu wuxuu kuugu baahan yahay si ka badan sida Mareykanku kuugu baahan yahay!” taasoo Alfozan uu kaga jawaabay “100%” . Kahor xariggiisa, Alfozan ayaa qorsheeyay inuu u duulo magaalada Riyadh xilli uu ku jiray fasax aabbannimo oo laba bilood ah. Xaaskiisa ayaa baareyaasha u xaqiijisay inay qorsheeyeen inay si joogto ah ugu guuraan Sacuudiga, uuna isaguna dib dambe kaga daba iman lahaa. Difaaca qareenka iyo taariikhda Alfozan Qareenka difaacaya Alfozan, William Pernik, ayaa maxkamadda ka codsaday in damaanad lagu sii daayo, isagoo oggolaaday shuruudo ay ka mid yihiin in qalabka lagula socdo dhaqdhaqaaqa lagu xiro lagana qaado baasaboorka. Xafiiska warfaafinta dowladda Sacuudiga ayaan wali wax war ah ka soo saarin eedeymahan cusub, xilli laamaha amniga ee Mareykankuna ay sheegeen in baaritaanku uu weli socdo eedeymo dheeraad ahna lagu soo oogi karo eedeysanaha. items.title: Mogadishu steps up anti-Kenya and anti-Ethiopia rhetoric, after debacle in South West State
items.description: Mogadishu steps up anti-Kenya and anti-Ethiopia rhetoric, after debacle in South West State Somali officials have in the last two days been stepping up attacks on Kenya for allegedly ‘hosting’ ousted South West State President Abdiaziz Laftagareen and his right- hand man Gen Mahad Shub – two leaders accused by the Somali federal government of coordinating their military campaign in Bay and Bakool region with Al-Shabaab. Speaker of Somali Parliament Abdikadir Mohammed Nur Jama (himself from the region) launched a blistering attack on Kenya on Sunday for allegedly hosting ‘wanted terrorists’ and for destabilising south-central Somalia. Similar accusations were also levelled against Ethiopia by pro-regime outlets. The ENDF, based in the region, is accused of ‘doing nothing while Al-Shabaab takes Bay and Bakool.’ Fake pictures of Al-Shabaab leaders ostensibly operating freely within earshot of ENDF outposts were circulated by even usually cautious independent local media. Umut Cagri, a Turkish national who operates as Ankara’s media influencing liaison for Somalia and Sudan has been posting on X claims Kenya, Ethiopia, UAE and Israel are actively supporting the insurgency in SWS as part of an alleged plot to dismember Somalia. Similar accusations have surfaced in one notorious outlet flagged by media disinformation analyst Marc Owens (associate professor of media analytics at Northwestern University) as engaged in systematic disinfo in the Horn. Villa Somalia badly needs to deflect the mounting bad press over the military setbacks in SWS where Laftagareen’s forces have in recent days captured five key towns. Mogadishu has since designated both Laftagareen and Gen Shub as terrorists, frozen their bank accounts and assets and written to foreign states to follow suit. Diplomats in Kenya and Ethiopia and possibly many other states deem the insurgency in Bay and Bakool as primarily political and are reluctant to accept Mogadishu’s terror labelling despite intense diplomatic pressure. Nairobi has a long history of hosting dissidents and politicians from Somalia, wider East Africa. The Kenyan capital serves as a safe, neutral haven for convening and organising legitimate democratic resistance. Laftagareen does not fit the typical insurgent/militant profile. He was ousted from power by use of force and his supporters regard armed resistance as legitimate. Kenyan authorities have fended off multiple direct pressure from Villa Somalia to surrender Laftagareen and Gen Shub. Furthermore, Kenya and Somalia do not have a bilateral mutual extradition treaty. Rashid Abdi

items.title: Jabhada TPLF- Oo diiday hadal ka soo yeedhay Mareykanka
items.description: Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray (TPLF) a Tweet yaa sheegtay inaysan aqbalayn hadalka Marco Rubio, ee weerarrada lagu qaado xarumaha milatariga ku tilmaamay falal argagixisanimo. War-saxaafadeed ay TPLF soo saartay 9-kii Sebtembar 2019 ayay ku muujisay sida ay uga xun tahay hadalka Rubio, kaas oo uu ku sheegay in diidmada Tigray ee gooni-u-goosadka iyo weerarrada lagu qaado xarumaha milatariga ay yihiin falal argagixisanimo. Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka ayaa Sabtidii, isagoo ka hadlayay xaaladda Itoobiya, sheegay in ay dalka ka jiraan kooxo gooni-u-goosad ah oo weerarro fulinaya, isla markaana dowladda Itoobiya ay ka jawaabayso weerarradaas. Waxa uu sidoo kale weerar diyaaradeed oo aan duuliye lahayn oo ka dhacay Addis Ababa la xiriiriyay argagixisanimo. TPLF ayaa sheegtay in hadalka Rubio uu iska indho-tirayo sababaha dib u soo cusboonaaday dagaalka, gaar ahaan sida ay sheegtay, in dowladda federaalku ay fulin weyday heshiiskii xabbad-joojinta ee lagu saxiixay Pretoria, taas oo ku qasabtay shacabka Tigray inay is-difaacaan. Jabhaddu waxay sheegtay inaysan aqbalayn hadalka xoghayaha arrimaha dibadda ee Mareykanka. TPLF ayaa xusuusisay inay marar badan ku baaqday in wada-hadallo nabadeed la bilaabo ka hor inta uusan dagaalku dib u qarxin. Waxay sidoo kale Mareykanka iyo quwadaha kale ku dhaliishay inay qaadi waayeen tallaabo wax ku ool ah oo lagu joojinayo dagaalka. “Waxaa nalagu qasbay inaan dadkeenna ka difaacno dilka iyo burburka markii dowladda federaalku ay ku dhawaaqday dagaal ballaaran,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Jabhaddu waxay intaas ku dartay inay Mareykanka ka filaysay inuu gacan ka geysto soo afjaridda dagaalka iyo fududeynta wada-hadallo wax-ku-ool ah. TPLF ayaa ku tilmaantay arrin “aad looga xumaado” in tallaabooyinka ay ku sheegtay is-difaac lagu tilmaamo falal gooni-u-goosad ah. Waxay sheegtay in hadalka Rubio uu “qalloocinayo taariikhda iyo ujeeddada halganka shacabka ee nabadda, sinnaanta iyo jiritaankooda,” isla markaana uu mugdi gelinayo doorka ay dowladda talada haysa ku leedahay hor istaagga xal nabadeed. Ugu dambeyn, TPLF ayaa Mareykanka ugu baaqday inuu dib u eego mowqifkiisa, isla markaana uu door muhiim ah ka qaato xaqiijinta nabadda iyo xasilloonida Itoobiya.

items.title: Netanyahu’s map reveals a new geopolitical divide: Puntland and Somaliland in Israel-UAE orbit, Mogadishu in a rival camp
items.description: As competing powers reposition across the Red Sea and Horn of Africa, an Israeli security presentation highlights shifting strategic calculations—and the growing risk that Somalia’s internal divisions will become entangled in wider regional rivalries. JERUSALEM (WDN) — A geopolitical map displayed behind Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during a national security presentation on Sunday has placed Puntland and Somaliland in a category considered friendly to Israel and the United Arab Emirates (UAE), while Somalia and the North East State appear in a rival grouping associated with Türkiye, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan. The map offers a striking illustration of how the Horn of Africa is increasingly being viewed through the lens of a wider strategic contest stretching from the Middle East to the Gulf of Aden and the Red Sea. It also raises difficult questions about how Somalia’s internal political divisions may intersect with the ambitions of powerful regional actors. But an important distinction must be made: the map is not proof that Puntland has entered a formal alliance with Israel, nor does its classification constitute diplomatic recognition. Created by researchers Marc Saxer and Marcus Schneider and published by Germany’s Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung in May 2026, it presents an analytical interpretation of emerging geopolitical alignments. Its appearance during Netanyahu’s presentation gives it political significance, but does not turn every category into a formal diplomatic commitment. Two Competing Strategic Visions The map depicts what its authors describe as a potential Israel-UAE-centered partnership, referred to as the “Hexagon alliance,” alongside a countervailing grouping of Türkiye, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan, labelled the “Sunni Diamond.” The emerging alignments reflect competing calculations over regional influence, security and access to strategically important maritime routes. They are not necessarily rigid blocs: states may cooperate on one issue while disagreeing on another, and their relationships can change as national interests evolve. Netanyahu’s presentation nevertheless suggests that Israel intends to capitalize on this shifting environment. According to reports of his remarks, he wants to use the remaining two years of US President Donald Trump’s administration to expand Israel’s network of partnerships and strengthen its regional position. For Israel and the UAE, the Horn of Africa offers strategic value beyond its geography. Its coastline overlooks some of the world’s most important shipping routes, including the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which connects the Gulf of Aden with the Red Sea. Ports, maritime security arrangements and relationships with local authorities can therefore carry significance far beyond the territories in which they are based. For Türkiye, Egypt and Saudi Arabia, the region is equally important because of its proximity to the Red Sea, their security interests and their relationships with governments across the Horn of Africa. The result is a more complicated regional landscape in which local political disputes can become linked to the calculations of external powers. Somalia’s Internal Divisions Enter the Picture The map’s treatment of Somalia is particularly sensitive. Puntland and Somaliland are placed in the Israel-UAE-friendly category, while the territory labelled Somalia and the separately identified North East State appear in the opposing grouping. These classifications should not be interpreted as evidence that Puntland has formally aligned itself with Israel. Puntland has maintained significant economic and security ties with the UAE, while its relationship with Mogadishu has been strained by disputes over federal authority and agreements with foreign partners. Those relationships may help explain the mapmakers’ assessment, but they do not establish a formal Puntland-Israel alliance. Somaliland’s position is different. Israel formally recognized Somaliland in December 2025, a decision rejected by Somalia’s Federal Government. The map’s depiction of the North East State as a separate territory also intersects with longstanding disputes over territorial claims and political authority in the north. The graphic does not, by itself, establish Israel’s definitive position on every disputed boundary. For Mogadishu, the broader concern is that Somalia’s internal disagreements could become more deeply entangled in foreign competition. Türkiye has developed extensive defense and security cooperation with the Federal Government, while the UAE maintains important relationships with Puntland, Somaliland and other regional actors. Chatham House has warned that the interaction between Somalia’s domestic political crisis and external rivalries creates a serious risk of further instability. The danger is not that every relationship automatically produces confrontation. It is that political leaders may increasingly seek foreign support to strengthen their domestic positions, while outside powers pursue strategic objectives through their local partnerships. A Map Is Not a Treaty—but the Signal Matters The map should neither be dismissed as meaningless nor mistaken for an official alliance agreement. Its significance lies in the strategic assumptions it reveals: some Somali territories are being viewed as potential partners in one regional configuration, while others are associated with a competing set of powers. That perception matters because foreign policy decisions are shaped not only by formal treaties but also by security cooperation, port investments, diplomatic recognition and access to strategic infrastructure. For Somalia, the challenge is to prevent domestic political fragmentation from becoming a channel through which regional competition deepens its divisions. For Puntland and Somaliland, being viewed as strategically valuable may create opportunities for external engagement, but it may also expose them to pressures arising from conflicts and rivalries beyond their control. The Federal Government faces a parallel challenge: maintaining constructive relations with its international partners while addressing disputes with regional administrations through political dialogue rather than allowing them to harden into competing foreign-policy camps. The central lesson is that Somalia’s political divisions no longer exist in isolation from the wider geopolitical contest surrounding the Red Sea. Netanyahu’s map does not prove that a new regional war is inevitable, nor does it establish that the countries shown in each color will act as a unified bloc. But it provides a revealing snapshot of how influential strategic circles are interpreting the changing balance of power. As alliances shift and competition intensifies, Somalia’s leaders must recognize that decisions taken in Mogadishu, Garowe and Hargeisa can carry consequences far beyond the country’s borders. In an unsettled geopolitical environment, the greatest danger may not be the existence of competing alliances, but the failure to manage them without allowing Somalia’s own political disagreements to become instruments of a wider struggle for regional influence.
