Two Competing Strategic Visions The map depicts what its authors describe as a potential Israel-UAE-centered partnership, referred to as the “Hexagon alliance,” alongside a countervailing grouping of Türkiye, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan, labelled the “Sunni Diamond.” The emerging alignments reflect competing calculations over regional influence, security and access to strategically important maritime routes. They are not necessarily rigid blocs: states may cooperate on one issue while disagreeing on another, and their relationships can change as national interests evolve. Netanyahu’s presentation nevertheless suggests that Israel intends to capitalize on this shifting environment. According to reports of his remarks, he wants to use the remaining two years of US President Donald Trump’s administration to expand Israel’s network of partnerships and strengthen its regional position. For Israel and the UAE, the Horn of Africa offers strategic value beyond its geography. Its coastline overlooks some of the world’s most important shipping routes, including the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which connects the Gulf of Aden with the Red Sea. Ports, maritime security arrangements and relationships with local authorities can therefore carry significance far beyond the territories in which they are based. For Türkiye, Egypt and Saudi Arabia, the region is equally important because of its proximity to the Red Sea, their security interests and their relationships with governments across the Horn of Africa. The result is a more complicated regional landscape in which local political disputes can become linked to the calculations of external powers. Somalia’s Internal Divisions Enter the Picture The map’s treatment of Somalia is particularly sensitive. Puntland and Somaliland are placed in the Israel-UAE-friendly category, while the territory labelled Somalia and the separately identified North East State appear in the opposing grouping. These classifications should not be interpreted as evidence that Puntland has formally aligned itself with Israel. Puntland has maintained significant economic and security ties with the UAE, while its relationship with Mogadishu has been strained by disputes over federal authority and agreements with foreign partners. Those relationships may help explain the mapmakers’ assessment, but they do not establish a formal Puntland-Israel alliance. Somaliland’s position is different. Israel formally recognized Somaliland in December 2025, a decision rejected by Somalia’s Federal Government. The map’s depiction of the North East State as a separate territory also intersects with longstanding disputes over territorial claims and political authority in the north. The graphic does not, by itself, establish Israel’s definitive position on every disputed boundary. For Mogadishu, the broader concern is that Somalia’s internal disagreements could become more deeply entangled in foreign competition. Türkiye has developed extensive defense and security cooperation with the Federal Government, while the UAE maintains important relationships with Puntland, Somaliland and other regional actors. Chatham House has warned that the interaction between Somalia’s domestic political crisis and external rivalries creates a serious risk of further instability. The danger is not that every relationship automatically produces confrontation. It is that political leaders may increasingly seek foreign support to strengthen their domestic positions, while outside powers pursue strategic objectives through their local partnerships. A Map Is Not a Treaty—but the Signal Matters The map should neither be dismissed as meaningless nor mistaken for an official alliance agreement. Its significance lies in the strategic assumptions it reveals: some Somali territories are being viewed as potential partners in one regional configuration, while others are associated with a competing set of powers. That perception matters because foreign policy decisions are shaped not only by formal treaties but also by security cooperation, port investments, diplomatic recognition and access to strategic infrastructure. For Somalia, the challenge is to prevent domestic political fragmentation from becoming a channel through which regional competition deepens its divisions. For Puntland and Somaliland, being viewed as strategically valuable may create opportunities for external engagement, but it may also expose them to pressures arising from conflicts and rivalries beyond their control. The Federal Government faces a parallel challenge: maintaining constructive relations with its international partners while addressing disputes with regional administrations through political dialogue rather than allowing them to harden into competing foreign-policy camps. The central lesson is that Somalia’s political divisions no longer exist in isolation from the wider geopolitical contest surrounding the Red Sea. Netanyahu’s map does not prove that a new regional war is inevitable, nor does it establish that the countries shown in each color will act as a unified bloc. But it provides a revealing snapshot of how influential strategic circles are interpreting the changing balance of power. As alliances shift and competition intensifies, Somalia’s leaders must recognize that decisions taken in Mogadishu, Garowe and Hargeisa can carry consequences far beyond the country’s borders. In an unsettled geopolitical environment, the greatest danger may not be the existence of competing alliances, but the failure to manage them without allowing Somalia’s own political disagreements to become instruments of a wider struggle for regional influence. items.title: Sawirro: Maxay salka ku hayaan rabshadaha Faransiiska la holcayo ee faraha ka baxay?
items.description: Paris (Caasimada Online) — Xukuumadda dhexe ee Faransiiska ayaa maamullada gobollada qaarkood ka codsatay inay soo rogaan bandow xaddidan, iyadoo dowladda Madaxweyne Emmanuel Macron ay wajaheyso culeys xooggan oo ku aaddan fashil dhanka amniga ah, kaddib dibadbaxyo dalka oo dhan gilgilay oo isku rogay rabshado iyo boob baahsan. Ra’iisul Wasaare Sébastien Lecornu ayaa meesha ka saaray in bandow guud lagu soo rogo caasimadda Paris, balse ma uusan diidin suurta-galnimada in lagu dhawaaqo xaalad degdeg ah haddii loo baahdo. Wuxuu tilmaamay in xilligan ay ka habboon tahay in la adeegsado bandowyo gaar ah oo lagu beegsanayo xaafadaha iyo deegaannada xasaraduhu ka taagan yihiin. “Go’aankeyga ku aaddan soo celinta nidaamka iyo kala-dambeynta waa mid adag oo kama dambays ah,” ayuu Lecornu u sheegay warbaahinta. Dhankiisa, Ariel Weil oo ah duqa badhtamaha Paris kana tirsan xisbiga Hantiwadaagga, ayaa sheegay inuu taageersan yahay bandow la soo rogo. Magaalada Marseille ayaa durba mamnuucday isu-soo-baxyada iyo banaanbaxyada, halka ururada shaqaalaha Faransiiskuna ay ku baaqeen shaqo-joojin cusub iyo mudaaharaadyo dhacaya 5-ta bisha Nofembar. Rabshadahan oo u dhexeeyay dad careysan iyo ciidamada booliska ayaa daba socday toddobaadyo ay ardaydu wadeen banaanbaxyo ka dhan ah hoos-u-dhaca adeegyada dadweynaha, sicir-bararka iyo daynta sii kordheysa, iyadoo dalkuna isu diyaarinayo doorasho madaxweyne oo dhici doonta lix bilood kaddib. Eedeymo loo jeediyay garabka bidix Ra’iisul Wasaare Lecornu ayaa kooxaha garabka bidix ee mayalka adag ku eedeeyay inay ka dambeeyaan rabshadahan oo lagu tilmaamay kuwii ugu xumaa ee Faransiiska soo mara sannadihii dambe. Wuxuu xusay in kooxahani doonayaan inay xasilooni-darro baaxad leh geliyaan dalka ka hor doorashada madaxweynaha. Hase yeeshee, hoggaamiyaha garabka bidix Jean-Luc Mélenchon ayaa ugu baaqay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha inuu keeno caddeymo rasmi ah. “Haddii kale, waa inuu cudur-daar bixiyaa, aamusaa, joojiyaana sii hurinta colaadda,” ayuu Mélenchon ku qoray barta X. Ururka Ganacsiga iyo Tafaariiqda ee Faransiiska ayaa xaqiijiyay in ku dhawaad 3,000 oo dukaan waxyeello iyo boob loogu geystay rabshadihii dhammaadkii toddobaadka. “Mar kale, waaxda ganacsigu waxay safka hore kaga jirtaa dhibaatooyinka xilli ay horeba u wiiqeen dhibaatooyin is xigxigay. Dukaan kasta oo la bililiqeystay waxaa ka dambeeya ganacsato, shaqaale iyo qoysas ay dadaalkoodii sannadaha badnaa ku burbureen saacado gudaheed,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka ururka, iyagoo dowladda ka codsaday dhimis xagga canshuuraha iyo caymiska bulshada ah. Magaalada Paris, gaar ahaan fagaaraha caanka ah ee Place Vendôme oo ay ku yaallaan goobaha lagu iibiyo alaabaha qaaliga ah, daaqadaha iyo albaabbada dukaamo ay leeyihiin shirkadaha Dior, Rolex, Louis Vuitton, Ralph Lauren iyo Gucci ayaa la jajabiyay ama waxyeello loo geystay. Magaalada Marseille, dukaanka rasmiga ah ee kooxda kubbadda cagta Olympique de Marseille ayaa la boobay, halka magaalo ku taal bartamaha dalkana la gubay xaruntii dowladda hoose. Wasiir-ku-xigeenka Arrimaha Dijitaalka, Anne Le Hénanff, ayaa baraha internet-ka ee wax lagu kala iibsado ku amartay inay tirtiraan xayaysiisyada alaabaha la soo dhacay ayna la shaqeeyaan laamaha amniga si sharciga loo horkeeno dambiilayaasha. Fashil sirdoon iyo xarig baaxad leh Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha ayaa sheegtay in la xiray qiyaastii 2,400 oo qof, hal banaanbaxe uu u dhintay wadne-istaag, halka ku dhowaad 1,000 askari oo boolis ahna ay ku dhaawacmeen iska-hor-imaadyada. Xafiiska Madaxweyne Emmanuel Macron ayaa xaqiijiyay inuu diiday is-casilaad uu u soo gudbiyay Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Laurent Nuñez, isagoo ku amray inuu soo afjaro carqaladaha iyo boobka, isla markaana caddeeyo waxa Macron ku tilmaamay “fashil xagga sirdoonka iyo saadaasha ah.” Nuñez ayaa sheegay in inkasta oo ay howlgeliyeen 60,000 oo askari, haddana aysan ku filnaan xakameynta dadkii rabshadaha waday. Wuxuu sidoo kale xaqiijiyay in ciyaarta Champions League ee dhexmari doonta kooxaha Paris Saint-Germain iyo Barcelona ay u qabsoomi doonto sidii loogu talagalay. Duq magaalooyinka Paris, Marseille iyo Lyon ayaa maqaal wadajir ah oo ay ku qoreen wargeyska Libération ku muujiyay caradooda: “Sabtidii… markii ugu horreysay, waxaan dareennay in qeybo dhan oo magaalooyinkeenna ka mid ah laga tagay iyagoo aan wax ilaalin ah haysan.” Xilli Faransiisku la tacaalayo nadiifinta waddooyinka iyo xakameynta khasaaraha, wuxuu qalalaasahani saameyn ku yeeshay suuqyada maaliyadda ee dalkaas. Dhanka kale, Madaxweyne Emmanuel Macron ayaa booqasho ku tagay dalka Kuwait, safarkaas oo ujeedkiisu yahay in lagu helo sahay dheeraad ah oo shidaal ah si hoos loogu dhigo qiimaha shidaalka ee cirka isku shareeray. items.title: Mareykanka oo Sheegay inaan Siyaasaddii ku Saabsan Soomaaliya waxba iskama beddelin
items.description: Danjiraha Mareykanka u fadhiya Itoobiya, Ervin J. Massinga, ayaa sheegay in aysan wax isbeddel ah ku imaan siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Mareykanka, kaddib hadalladii Madaxweyne Donald Trump ee dadka qaar u fasirteen in uu Somaliland ku tilmaamay meel ka duwan Soomaaliya inteeda kale. Massinga ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay wareysi uu siiyay wargeyska The Reporter ee ka soo baxa Itoobiya, kaas oo wax laga weydiiyay hadalka Trump iyo waxa uu uga dhigan yahay mowqifka dowladda Mareykanka ee ku aaddan Somaliland. Danjiraha ayaa caddeeyay in hadallada madaxweynaha aysan ka dhignayn in wax laga beddelay siyaasadda rasmiga ah ee Mareykanka, taas oo muujinaysa in hadal siyaasadeed oo ka yimaada Aqalka Cad uusan keligiis noqon go’aan rasmi ah oo aqoonsi dowladeed. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, hadalka danjiraha Mareykanka ayaa muujinaya in aan hadalladaas loo qaadan karin caddayn muujinaysa in Washington ay qaadatay go’aan cusub oo ku saabsan aqoonsiga Somaliland.

items.title: Tirada Dadka ku Dhintay Duqeyntii Suudaan oo Korortay
items.description: In ka badan 160 qof ayaa la soo sheegay in lagu dilay weerarro isdaba-joog ah oo ay diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ka geysteen qaybo kala duwan oo ka tirsan dalka Suudaan maalmihii la soo dhaafay, iyadoo warar kale ay sheegayaan in dadka ku dhintay weerarrada qaarkood ay ku jiraan muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed. Sida ay baahisay warbaahinta maxalliga ahi 19-kii Oktoobar 2026, weerarrada ayaa lagu eedeeyay dhinacyada ku dagaallamaya Suudaan, oo kala ah ciidamada milatariga dowladda iyo xoogagga gurmadka degdegga ah ee RSF. Weerarkan oo lagu tilmaamay midkii ugu khasaaraha badnaa ayaa fiidnimadii Axadda ka dhacay agagaarka suuqa magaalada Al-Dibab ee gobolka Kordofan Galbeed, halkaas oo diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn ay beegsatay goob ay dadku isugu yimaadeen si ay gaadiid ugu raacaan guryahooda kaddib markii ay suuqa ka soo laabteen. Dadka deegaanka iyo shaqaalaha caafimaadka ayaa sheegay in weerarkaasi ay ku dhinteen 80 qof, halka 47 qof oo dhaawacmay loo qaaday magaalada Al-Mujlad. Ilo caafimaad ayaa sheegay in 30 ka mid ah dhaawacyadaasi ay markii dambe u dhinteen dhaawacyadii soo gaaray, ayadoo kooxda ay RSF ciidamada milatariga ku eedeysay inay ka dambeeyeen weerarka. Dhanka kale, gobolka Blue Nile, weerar loo adeegsaday diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo Jimcihii lagu qaaday goob ay ku sugnaayeen dad barakacayaal ah ayaa la sheegay inuu dilay 41 qof. Kooxda Emergency Lawyers ayaa weerarka ku tilmaantay musiibo bani’aadannimo. Magaalada Nyala ee gobolka Koonfurta Daarfuur ayaa iyaduna la kulantay weerar kale oo dhacay Isniintii, kaas oo ay ilo caafimaad iyo kuwo RSF ah sheegeen in lagu diley 17 qof, oo ay ku jiraan toddobo sarkaal oo ka tirsan xoogaggaas, halka 23 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Wararka ku saabsan khasaaraha ka dhashay weerarrada ayaa sidoo kale walaac ku abuuraya Soomaalida ku nool Suudaan, oo ay ku jiraan ganacsato iyo dad kale oo noloshooda ka raadsada dalkaas. Warbixin ay baahisay Radio Tamazuj 19-kii Oktoobar ayaa sheegtay in weerarro diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn lagu qaaday suuqa Amiet ee gobolka lagu muransan yahay ee Abyei, halkaas oo ugu yaraan 73 qof lagu dilay, 19 kalena lagu dhaawacay, sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiin deegaanka ah. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in ku dhowaad 13 milyan oo qof ay ku barakaceen colaadda, halka 33.7 milyan oo qof, oo ay ku jiraan 17.3 milyan oo carruur ah, ay u baahan yihiin gargaar cunto oo degdeg ah. Waxaa sidoo kale la qiyaasayaa in 825,000 oo carruur ah ay wajahayaan nafaqo-darro ba’an, iyadoo dagaalku sii socdo, weerarrada diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahaynna ay sii kordhinayaan khatarta ku wajahan dadka rayidka ah, oo ay ku jiraan ajaanibta iyo Soomaalida ku nool dalkaas.

Warbixin ay baahisay Radio Tamazuj 19-kii Oktoobar ayaa sheegtay in weerarro diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn lagu qaaday suuqa Amiet ee gobolka lagu muransan yahay ee Abyei, halkaas oo ugu yaraan 73 qof lagu dilay, 19 kalena lagu dhaawacay, sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiin deegaanka ah. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in ku dhowaad 13 milyan oo qof ay ku barakaceen colaadda, halka 33.7 milyan oo qof, oo ay ku jiraan 17.3 milyan oo carruur ah, ay u baahan yihiin gargaar cunto oo degdeg ah. Waxaa sidoo kale la qiyaasayaa in 825,000 oo carruur ah ay wajahayaan nafaqo-darro ba’an, iyadoo dagaalku sii socdo, weerarrada diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahaynna ay sii kordhinayaan khatarta ku wajahan dadka rayidka ah, oo ay ku jiraan ajaanibta iyo Soomaalida ku nool dalkaas.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Kaalinta Labaad ka Gashay Tartanka CECAFA U-17
items.description: Xulka kubadda cagta Soomaaliya ee da’doodu ka hooseyso 17-ka sano ayaa kaalinta labaad ka galay tartanka Bariga iyo Bartamaha Afrika ee CECAFA U-17, kaddib markii ay rigoorayaal kaga adkaadeen xulka Uganda, oo ciyaarta ku badiyay 6-5. Ciyaartoyda xulka qaranka Soomaaliya, oo loo yaqaan Ocean Stars, ayaa tartanka ka muujiyay ciyaar wanaagsan oo ay ka dhex muuqdeen xirfad, kalsooni iyo isku-duubni, iyagoo dadaal badan u galay difaaca sharafta iyo calanka dalka. Inkasta oo xulka Soomaaliya uusan ku guuleysan hanashada koobka, haddana kaalinta labaad ee ay gaareen ayaa muujisay dadaalka iyo horumarka ay sameeyeen ciyaartoyda da’yarta ah intii uu socday tartanku. Dhanka kale, Wasiirka Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha, Maxamed Cabduqaadir Cali, iyo Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya, ahna Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka CECAFA, Cali Cabdi Maxamed (Cali Shiine), ayaa bogaadiyay ciyaartoyda xulka qaranka. Mas’uuliyiintan ayaa ammaanay sida sharafta iyo geesinimada leh ee ay da’yarta Soomaaliyeed u mataleen dalkooda, iyagoo muujiyay dadaal iyo isku-duubni intii uu socday tartanka. Xulka da’yarta ayaa tartanka ku dhammeystay kaalinta labaad, taas oo u noqonaysa dhiirrigelin ay ku sii horumariyaan awooddooda iyo mustaqbalkooda kubadda cagta.

items.title: Laba dal oo lagu eedeeyay inay sahleen horumarka ay sameeyeen ciidanka Lafta-gareen
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hoggaanka maamulka Koonfur Galbeed iyo Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo deegaan ahaan kasoo jeeda Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ku eedeeyay dowladaha Kenya iyo Itoobiya inay qayb ka yihiin faragelinta lagu hayo maamulka. Eedeymahan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee Koonfur Galbeed, halkaas oo maleeshiyaad taabacsan Lafta-gareen ay la wareegeen deegaanno iyo degmooyin dhowr ah. Itoobiya ayaa si gaar ah loogu dhaliilay doorka ciidamadeeda ku sugan deegaannada maamulka, kuwaas oo lagu eedeeyay inay ku guuldarreysteen ka hortagga qabsashada deegaannadaas. Eedeymaha ayaa tilmaamaya in ciidamada Itoobiya ay indhaha ka daawanayeen dhaq-dhaqaaqyada maleeshiyaadka, halkii ay ka qaadi lahaayeen tallaabo ay xaaladda ku xakameynayaan ama uga hortagayaan maleeshiyaadkaas, maadaama ay joogaan deegaanadaas. Sidoo kale, Kenya ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay martigelisay siyaasiyiin ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya cunaqabateyn saartay oo kamid yahay Lafta-gareen, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay ku lug leeyihiin faragelinta ciidan ee ka socota Koonfur Galbeed. Labada dal ayaa ciidamo ka jooga Soomaaliya, waxayna qayb ka yihiin howl-galka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Arrintan ayaa sii xoojinaysa walaaca laga qabo doorka ay dalalka deriska ah ku leeyihiin xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo tan amni ee ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed. Dhanka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, eedeymahan ayaa keenaya cadaadis dheeraad ah, iyadoo laga sugayo inay mowqif cad ka qaadato tallaabooyinka lagu eedeeyay Kenya iyo Itoobiya, gaar ahaan doorka ay ku leeyihiin xaaladda sii cakirmaysa ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Si kastaba, illaa hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay dowladaha Kenya iyo Itoobiya oo ay kaga jawaabayaan eedeymahan. Ciidanka taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ayaa maalmihii dambe qabsaday degmooyinka Qansaxdeere, Bardaale, Buurhakaba iyo Diinsoor ee gobolka Baay. Lafta-gareen ayaa la sheegay inuu adeegsanayo wada-hadallo hoose iyo dhaqaale si uu u helo taageerada ciidamada ku sugan magaalooyinka, taas oo horseedaysa inay ka baxaan goobaha ay maamulaan iyada oo aan dagaal dhicin. The post Laba dal oo lagu eedeeyay inay sahleen horumarka ay sameeyeen ciidanka Lafta-gareen appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaali ku dhimatay duqeymo culus oo maanta ka dhacay…
items.description: Khartoum (Caasimada Online) – Saddex qof oo Soomaali ah ayaa la xaqiijiyay inay ku geeriyoodeen duqaymo ka dhacay deegaanka Abyay ee ku yaalla xadka u dhexeeya Sudan iyo South Sudan, halkaas oo uu ka socdo dagaal u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda Sudan iyo xoogagga RSF. Duqaymaha ayaa lagu beegsaday suuqa weyn ee magaalada Abyay, oo ah deegaan ay Soomaalidu ku leedahay ganacsiyo waaweyn, gaar ahaan xarumaha shidaalka iyo goobo kale oo ganacsi. Weerarradan ayaa la sheegay in ciidamada Sudan ay ku bartilmaameedsadeen xoogagga RSF oo gacanta ku haya deegaankaas, hase yeeshee waxaa ka dhashay khasaare dhimasho iyo burbur hantiyadeed oo saameeyay ganacsatada rayidka ah. Soomaalida ku nool Abyay oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa sheegay in tirada dadka ku dhintay duqaymaha ay ka badnaan karto saddexda qof ee ilaa hadda la xaqiijiyay. Waxay tilmaameen in xogta khasaaraha ay weli tahay mid aan si buuxda loo xaqiijin, iyadoo laga cabsi qabo in dhimashada iyo dhaawacyadu intaas ka badan yihiin. Duqaymaha ayaa sidoo kale sababay gubashada xarumo ganacsi oo ay Soomaalidu leedahay, kuwaas oo intooda badan ku shaqaynayay ganacsiga shidaalka. Dab ka dhashay weerarrada ayaa baabi’iyay hanti ganacsi, taas oo walaac xooggan ku abuurtay Soomaalida ku nool magaalada iyo ganacsatada halkaas maalgashiga ku leh. Weerarkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Sudan ay weli ka jirto colaadda u dhexeysa ciidamada dowladda oo uu hoggaamiyo Cabdulfataax Al-Burhaan iyo xoogagga RSF ee uu hoggaamiyo Maxamed Xamdaan Dagalo oo loo yaqaan Xametti. Dagaalka oo billowday April 2023 ayaa sababay dhimasho baahsan, barakac malaayiin qof ah iyo burbur xooggan oo soo gaaray kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha dalka. Labada dhinac ayaa muddo dheer ku dagaallamayay gacan ku haynta magaalooyin iyo goobo istaraatiiji ah, iyadoo duqaymaha cirka iyo dagaallada dhulka ay halis ku hayaan dadka rayidka ah. Colaadda ayaa sidoo kale carqaladeysay ganacsiga iyo isu socodka dadka, iyadoo xaaladaha amni ee meelo badan oo dalka ah ay sii adkeeyeen helitaanka adeegyada aasaasiga ah iyo gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Dhimashada saddexda Soomaali ah iyo burburka ganacsiyada ku yaalla Abyay ayaa muujinaya khatarta ay colaadda Sudan ku hayso dadka ajaanibta ah iyo ganacsatada ku nool goobaha ay dagaalladu saameeyeen. Ilaa hadda, ma jiraan faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo la xaqiijiyay oo ku saabsan aqoonsiga dadka geeriyooday, tirada dhaawacyada ama baaxadda guud ee khasaaraha hantiyadeed ee ka dhashay duqaymaha. The post Soomaali ku dhimatay duqeymo culus oo maanta ka dhacay… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Gobol maanta afti u qaadaya inuu ka go’o Canada iyo in kale
items.description: Calgary (Caasimada Online) — Dadweynaha ku dhaqan gobolka shidaalka qaniga ku ah ee Alberta oo ku yaalla galbeedka dalka Canada, ayaa Isniinta maanta ah u dareeray codbixin afti ah oo aan sharciyan qasab ahayn (nonbinding referendum), taasoo ku saabsan in gobolku ka go’o dalka intiisa kale iyo in kale. Inkasta oo dhammaan saadaalintu muujinayso in guuldarro baaxad leh ay wajihi doonto kooxda u ololeysa gooni-u-goosadka, haddana dadka falanqeeya siyaasadda dalkaas waxay rumeysan yihiin in natiijadu aysan soo afjari doonin xiisadda iyo doodda siyaasadeed ee muddada dheer taagneyd. Sahanada ra’yiga dadweynaha ayaa si joogto ah u muujiyay in aqlabiyadda shacabka Alberta — oo ay ku nool yihiin ku dhowaad 5 milyan oo qof — ay diiddan yihiin kala go’a Canada. Hase yeeshee, tabashooyinka dhanka dhaqaalaha ah ayaa dabka ku sii shiday ololaha madax-bannaanida ee gobolkan oo bed ahaan wax yar ka yar gobolka Texas ee dalka Mareykanka. Dhaq-dhaqaaqan ayaa culays horleh ku kordhinaya Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Canada, Mark Carney, kaas oo difaaca madax-bannaanida dalka ka dhigtay qodobka ugu muhiimsan ajandihiisa, xilli uu wajahayo canshuuro uu dhowaan Mareykanku ku soo rogay dalkiisa iyo hadallo ka soo yeeray Madaxweyne Donald Trump oo ku baaqayay in Canada ay noqoto gobolka 51-aad ee Mareykanka. Cabasho dhaqaale oo salka ku haysa shidaalka Dadka u ololeeya gooni-u-goosadka Alberta ayaa rumeysan in dowladda federaalka ee fadhigeedu yahay Ottawa, oo uu hoggaamiyo Xisbiga Libaraalka, ay curyaamisay wershadaha shidaalka ee gobolka iyada oo adeegsanaysa xeerar adag oo deegaanka ah. Waxay ku doodayaan in Alberta, oo ah xudunta tamarta dalka, ay dhaqaalaha Canada ku darsato wax aad uga badan inta ay dib uga hesho dowladda dhexe. “Canada waxay leedahay nidaam aan caddaalad ku dhisnayn oo naas-nuujiya dowladda dhexe iyo dadka ku nool bartamaha, iyadoo laga faa’iideysanayo gobollada wax-soo-saarka leh sida Alberta,” ayuu yiri Cory Morgan, oo ah aasaasaha hay’ad u ololeysa madax-bannaanida gobolka oo lagu magacaabo Pathway to Independence . Aftidan ayaa ah tii ugu horreysay ee ku saabsan ka go’itaanka Canada oo lagu qabto gobol ka baxsan Quebec oo ah gobolka looga hadlo Faransiiska. Si ka duwan Quebec oo doonisteedu salka ku haysay arrimo luqadeed iyo aqoonsi dhaqan, khilaafka Alberta ayaa si buuxda ugu qotoma dhaqaale iyo canshuuro. Fariin loo dirayo dowladda iyo doodda Carney Ra’iisul Wasaare Carney, oo ku soo barbaaray Alberta, ayaa maalmihii la soo dhaafay olole ballaaran ka dhex waday gobolka si dadku ugu codeeyaan “inay Canada ka mid ahaadaan”, isagoo cod-bixiyayaasha ugu baaqay waddaniyad iyo garab-is-taag qaran. “Canada ma aha macaamil ganacsi oo u dhexeeya gobollo; ma aha arrin ku saabsan wax la dhiibay iyo wax la helay,” ayuu yiri Carney xilli uu khudbad ka jeedinayay magaalada Red Deer. Si uu u dejiyo carada reer Alberta, Carney ayaa meesha ka saaray xeerar dhowr ah oo deegaanka la xiriiray, isaga oo sidoo kale taageeray dhuumo shidaal oo gobolka u saamaxaya inuu shidaalka u dhoofiyo dalalka Aasiya. Sahan cusub oo uu shaaciyay Machadka Angus Reid ayaa lagu ogaaday in 66% dadka Alberta ay qorsheynayaan inay u codeeyaan in dalka lagu sii jiro, inkasta oo 60% ay rumeysan yihiin in dhaq-dhaqaaqa gooni-u-goosadka uusan waligiis dhammaan doonin. Xogta ayaa sidoo kale muujisay in dadka taageersan kala go’a, 60% ka mid ah ujeedkoodu yahay oo kaliya inay “fariin digniin ah u diraan” dowladda federaalka, halka 37% oo keliya ay dhab ka tahay in la helo dal madax-bannaan. Inkasta oo kooxaha gooni-u-goosadku ay soo bandhigeen qorshe ku-meel-gaar ah, haddana su’aalo muhiim ah oo ku saabsan ciidanka difaaca, lacagta la isticmaalayo iyo maamulka xuduudaha ayaan wali xal loo helin. Madaxa xukuumadda gobolka Alberta, Danielle Smith — oo iyadu ku baaqday in Canada lagu sii jiro balse aftidan u qabatay culeys kaga yimid garabka mayalka adag ee xisbigeeda Conservative-ka — ayaa sheegtay in haddii aqlabiyaddu u codeyso madax-bannaanida ay u gudbi doonto afti rasmi ah oo sharciyan qasab noqon doonta. Duane Bratt, oo ah professor cilmiga siyaasadda ka dhiga Jaamacadda Mount Royal ee Calgary, ayaa sheegay in su’aasha ugu weyn ay tahay halka dhaq-dhaqaaqani u jihaysan doono wixii ka dambeeya natiijada aftidan. “Arrintani hadda ma dhammaanayso, sababtoo ah kooxaha goosashada doonaya hadda way abaabulan yihiin, shabakado ayay leeyihiin, waana isku xiran yihiin. Inkasta oo dhammaan saadaalintu muujinayso in guuldarro baaxad leh ay wajihi doonto kooxda u ololeysa gooni-u-goosadka, haddana dadka falanqeeya siyaasadda dalkaas waxay rumeysan yihiin in natiijadu aysan soo afjari doonin xiisadda iyo doodda siyaasadeed ee muddada dheer taagneyd. Sahanada ra’yiga dadweynaha ayaa si joogto ah u muujiyay in aqlabiyadda shacabka Alberta — oo ay ku nool yihiin ku dhowaad 5 milyan oo qof — ay diiddan yihiin kala go’a Canada. Hase yeeshee, tabashooyinka dhanka dhaqaalaha ah ayaa dabka ku sii shiday ololaha madax-bannaanida ee gobolkan oo bed ahaan wax yar ka yar gobolka Texas ee dalka Mareykanka. Dhaq-dhaqaaqan ayaa culays horleh ku kordhinaya Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Canada, Mark Carney, kaas oo difaaca madax-bannaanida dalka ka dhigtay qodobka ugu muhiimsan ajandihiisa, xilli uu wajahayo canshuuro uu dhowaan Mareykanku ku soo rogay dalkiisa iyo hadallo ka soo yeeray Madaxweyne Donald Trump oo ku baaqayay in Canada ay noqoto gobolka 51-aad ee Mareykanka. Cabasho dhaqaale oo salka ku haysa shidaalka Dadka u ololeeya gooni-u-goosadka Alberta ayaa rumeysan in dowladda federaalka ee fadhigeedu yahay Ottawa, oo uu hoggaamiyo Xisbiga Libaraalka, ay curyaamisay wershadaha shidaalka ee gobolka iyada oo adeegsanaysa xeerar adag oo deegaanka ah. Waxay ku doodayaan in Alberta, oo ah xudunta tamarta dalka, ay dhaqaalaha Canada ku darsato wax aad uga badan inta ay dib uga hesho dowladda dhexe. “Canada waxay leedahay nidaam aan caddaalad ku dhisnayn oo naas-nuujiya dowladda dhexe iyo dadka ku nool bartamaha, iyadoo laga faa’iideysanayo gobollada wax-soo-saarka leh sida Alberta,” ayuu yiri Cory Morgan, oo ah aasaasaha hay’ad u ololeysa madax-bannaanida gobolka oo lagu magacaabo Pathway to Independence . Aftidan ayaa ah tii ugu horreysay ee ku saabsan ka go’itaanka Canada oo lagu qabto gobol ka baxsan Quebec oo ah gobolka looga hadlo Faransiiska. Si ka duwan Quebec oo doonisteedu salka ku haysay arrimo luqadeed iyo aqoonsi dhaqan, khilaafka Alberta ayaa si buuxda ugu qotoma dhaqaale iyo canshuuro. Fariin loo dirayo dowladda iyo doodda Carney Ra’iisul Wasaare Carney, oo ku soo barbaaray Alberta, ayaa maalmihii la soo dhaafay olole ballaaran ka dhex waday gobolka si dadku ugu codeeyaan “inay Canada ka mid ahaadaan”, isagoo cod-bixiyayaasha ugu baaqay waddaniyad iyo garab-is-taag qaran. “Canada ma aha macaamil ganacsi oo u dhexeeya gobollo; ma aha arrin ku saabsan wax la dhiibay iyo wax la helay,” ayuu yiri Carney xilli uu khudbad ka jeedinayay magaalada Red Deer. Si uu u dejiyo carada reer Alberta, Carney ayaa meesha ka saaray xeerar dhowr ah oo deegaanka la xiriiray, isaga oo sidoo kale taageeray dhuumo shidaal oo gobolka u saamaxaya inuu shidaalka u dhoofiyo dalalka Aasiya. Sahan cusub oo uu shaaciyay Machadka Angus Reid ayaa lagu ogaaday in 66% dadka Alberta ay qorsheynayaan inay u codeeyaan in dalka lagu sii jiro, inkasta oo 60% ay rumeysan yihiin in dhaq-dhaqaaqa gooni-u-goosadka uusan waligiis dhammaan doonin. Xogta ayaa sidoo kale muujisay in dadka taageersan kala go’a, 60% ka mid ah ujeedkoodu yahay oo kaliya inay “fariin digniin ah u diraan” dowladda federaalka, halka 37% oo keliya ay dhab ka tahay in la helo dal madax-bannaan. Inkasta oo kooxaha gooni-u-goosadku ay soo bandhigeen qorshe ku-meel-gaar ah, haddana su’aalo muhiim ah oo ku saabsan ciidanka difaaca, lacagta la isticmaalayo iyo maamulka xuduudaha ayaan wali xal loo helin. Madaxa xukuumadda gobolka Alberta, Danielle Smith — oo iyadu ku baaqday in Canada lagu sii jiro balse aftidan u qabatay culeys kaga yimid garabka mayalka adag ee xisbigeeda Conservative-ka — ayaa sheegtay in haddii aqlabiyaddu u codeyso madax-bannaanida ay u gudbi doonto afti rasmi ah oo sharciyan qasab noqon doonta. Duane Bratt, oo ah professor cilmiga siyaasadda ka dhiga Jaamacadda Mount Royal ee Calgary, ayaa sheegay in su’aasha ugu weyn ay tahay halka dhaq-dhaqaaqani u jihaysan doono wixii ka dambeeya natiijada aftidan. “Arrintani hadda ma dhammaanayso, sababtoo ah kooxaha goosashada doonaya hadda way abaabulan yihiin, shabakado ayay leeyihiin, waana isku xiran yihiin. Su’aashu waxay tahay miyey xoogga saari doonaan afti kale mustaqbalka, mise waxay abuuri doonaan xisbi siyaasadeed oo u gaar ah?” The post Gobol maanta afti u qaadaya inuu ka go’o Canada iyo in kale appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia parliament speaker accuses Kenya of harbouring terrorists
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s parliament speaker, Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur, on Sunday accused Kenya of harbouring terrorists, as Mogadishu appears angry with neighbouring countries following rebel advances in Southwest state. Nur said the federal government should ask Nairobi why Kenya continues to allow terrorists who continue to carry out violence in Somalia to remain in the country, especially in the capital Nairobi. He was referring to Abdiasis Laftagaren, the ousted Southwest leader, and other members of his administration. Forces loyal to them recently made a lightning advance in the Bay region, retaking all major towns except Baidoa in just a few days last week. Nur, the real link between the Turkish and Somali governments and a key defender of Turkish interests in the Horn of Africa nation, urged the authorities to act swiftly against Nairobi through diplomatic channels. He also called on the Somali government to hold Ethiopia accountable for its troops not defending the towns recaptured by forces loyal to the former regional leader. Mogadishu ousted Laftagaren, then president of Southwest state, in March in an offensive backed by Turkish airpower. His forces have since waged guerrilla warfare, and last week a surprise counter-offensive allowed them to retake the towns of Dinsor, Burhakabo, Awdinle, Berdale and Qansah Dhere. The Somali federal government has so far failed to mobilise forces to retake the lost towns. Efforts to bring Ethiopian forces into the conflict on Mogadishu’s side also fell through after Addis Ababa insisted on remaining neutral, arguing that the dispute is a political power struggle outside the mandate of its peacekeepers. items.title: Marka killing deepens uncertainty surrounding newly declared regional administration
items.description: The killing of a respected traditional elder has heightened public anger and raised troubling questions about security, political rivalry and the authority of an administration whose legitimacy remains contested. MARKA (WDN) — The killing of traditional elder Aweys in Marka , the capital of Lower Shabelle region, has intensified tensions surrounding the newly declared South-East State administration, exposing the uncertainty and mistrust confronting the emerging political project. Aweys, a respected member of the region’s traditional leadership, was reportedly killed on Sunday. His death has provoked anger among local residents and community elders, with questions mounting over the circumstances of the killing and whether political disagreements may have played a role. The killing of the peace activist occurred days after he reportedly opposed individuals who had declared themselves the leadership of news South East State administration, an incident that has further heightened security concerns among residents of Marka. Unverified reports circulating locally have alleged that the killing was connected to the the newly declared leader Omar Ali Ahmed, also known as Cumarey Ali. The allegations have not been independently confirmed, and no conclusive evidence establishing responsibility has been presented in the information available to WardheerNews. However, the seriousness of the accusations, combined with the fragile political environment in which the administration is operating, has heightened concerns about security, accountability and the treatment of those who oppose its positions. A New Administration Facing Uncertainty The new administration was reportedly declared by clans residing in Lower Shabelle, with Omar Ali Ahmed as its interim president on May 14, 2026, in Hoosqaboobe, an area associated with Marka. The administration has no formal recognition from the Federal Government of Somalia, leaving its political standing and relationship with existing federal and regional institutions uncertain. This unresolved status raises fundamental questions about its authority, the extent of its public support and its capacity to maintain security while pursuing its political objectives. According to information received by WardheerNews, the leader maintains an armed force presence in a neighbourhood of Marka. Reports have also suggested that the slain elder may have opposed the administration’s political ideas and principles. These claims remain unverified, and it is not yet clear whether his death was connected to a political dispute. If political opposition was a factor, the implications would be serious. Traditional elders play an important role in mediation, community relations and conflict resolution in Somali society. Any suggestion that disagreement with an emerging administration could expose community leaders to violence risks deepening divisions at a time when dialogue and reconciliation are particularly necessary. The authorities responsible for security should therefore ensure that the circumstances of Aweys’s death are investigated impartially and that any individuals found responsible are held accountable through lawful procedures. Public Anger Over the Handling of the Body The controversy has extended beyond the circumstances of the killing to the handling of the elder’s remains. According to local reports, Aweys’s body was transported by aircraft to Mogadishu rather than being buried in Marka, his home city. The decision has reportedly left residents and community members questioning why the body was moved and who authorised the transfer. For many in the community, the issue is not simply logistical. The burial of a respected elder carries deep social significance, and decisions concerning his final resting place can become a source of public concern when families and local residents feel they have not been adequately consulted. Nevertheless, the concerns being expressed by residents underline the importance of transparency, respect for the deceased and consultation with the family and community. The authorities involved should clarify why the body was flown to Mogadishu, who made that decision and where the elder will be buried. A Test of Leadership and Legitimacy The killing comes at a sensitive moment for an administration seeking to establish itself in a politically uncertain environment. Without broad public confidence, clear institutional arrangements and credible security mechanisms, disputes can quickly become entangled with wider clan and political tensions. The administration’s leaders face a responsibility to demonstrate that political differences can be addressed peacefully and that traditional elders, regardless of their views, can perform their community roles without fear. The Federal Government also faces questions about its responsibility to protect civilians, uphold the law and respond impartially to allegations of violence. Whatever the disputed status of the new administration, the safety of residents and the right to a credible investigation should not become casualties of political rivalry. For now, crucial facts remain unclear: who killed Aweys, what motivated the attack, whether the killing was politically connected, and why his body was transferred to Mogadishu. These questions require answers based on evidence rather than speculation. The death of a respected elder should not become another flashpoint in an already uncertain political landscape. It should instead prompt a transparent investigation, calm public communication and renewed efforts to prevent further violence. For Marka and the wider Lower Shabelle region, the central question is whether the emerging administration can build public confidence through accountability and dialogue—or whether uncertainty and mistrust will deepen before its political future is settled. items.title: Maxkamadda Sare oo go’aan ka gaartay natiijada doorashada HirShabelle
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamadda Sare ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si kama dambays ah u ansixisay natiijada doorashada Golaha Wakiillada dowlad-goboleedka HirShabeelle, taas oo uu markii hore si KMG ah ugu dhawaaqay Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha. Go’aankan oo ku taariikhaysan 19-ka October 2026 ayaa soo baxay kadib markii maxkamaddu dib u eegtay dukumentiyada iyo habraacyada la xiriira codsiga ansixinta natiijada doorashada Golaha Wakiillada HirShabeelle. Maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay inaan wax dacwad ah laga soo gudbin natiijada doorashada oo qabsoontay 30-kii September 2026, iyadoo la raacayo qodobka 73-aad ee Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, Sharci Lr. 28 ee soo baxay 23-kii November 2024. Sida ay maxkamaddu tilmaantay, saldhigga sharci ee go’aanka waa qodobka 7-aad, faqraddiisa koowaad, xarafka (F) ee Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka. Qodobkaasi wuxuu guddiga siinayaa awoodda ku dhawaaqista KMG ah ee natiijada doorashada, halka ansixinta kama dambaysta ahi ay u taallo Maxkamadda Sare. Waxaa sidoo kale la hubiyay in codsiga guddigu waafaqsan yahay shuruudaha ku xusan qodobka 7/1-aad ee Habraaca Maxkamadda Sare ee Federaalka ee Ansixinta Natiijada Doorashada iyo ka Garnaqidda Durridda Doorashooyinka oo summaddiisu tahay MS/F/005/07/2026, taariikhduna tahay 28-kii Luulyo 2026. Go’aanka waxaa sidoo kale saldhig looga dhigay qodobo kale oo sharciyeed oo ay ku jiraan qodobka 5/4-aad (A) ee Xeer Lr. 3, ee 12-kii Juun 1962, Xeerka Nidaamka Garsoorka, iyo qodobbada 10-aad, 11-aad iyo 13-aad ee Habraaca Maxkamadda Sare ee Federaalka. Ugu dambayn, maxkamaddu waxay si kama dambays ah u ansixisay natiijada doorashada Golaha Wakiillada HirShabeelle, iyadoo kaaliyaha sare ee maxkamadda ku amartay inuu go’aanka gaarsiiyo guddiga doorashooyinka, isla markaana la faafiyo si waafaqsan habraacyada sharciga ah. Doorashada HirShabeelle ayaa ka qabsoomtay 10 degmo, iyadoo tartanka ay ka qayb-galeen 13 urur siyaasadeed oo ku loollamay 99 kursi oo Golaha Wakiillada ah. Tirada guud ee codadka la dhiibtay ayaa gaartay 114,633, waxaana guddigu sheegay in 112,451 kamid ah ay ahaayeen codad ansax ah, halka 2,182 cod loo aqoonsaday kuwo aan ansax ahayn. Natiijada la ansixiyay ayaa muujineysa in ururka Caddaalad iyo Midnimadda Tiir uu ku guuleystay 759 cod iyo hal kursi, halka Madalsan uu isna helay 911 cod iyo hal kursi. Ururka Muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ayaa helay 122 cod iyo hal kursi, halka Dimuqraadiga Soomaaliyeed uu ku guuleystay 2,368 cod iyo laba kursi. Caddaaladda iyo Wadajir ayaa noqday ururka ugu codadka badan, isagoo helay 88,130 cod iyo 78 kursi halka Dadka Soomaaliyeed uu helay 113 cod, balse uusan wax kursi ah ku guuleysan. Sidoo kale, Ururka Iftiin Qaran ayaa helay 6,165 cod iyo shan kursi, halka Karaama uu helay 6,875 cod iyo lix kursi. Ururka Saab ayaa sidoo kale helay 120 cod, balse uusan wax kursi ah ku guuleysan, halka Dan Shacab uu isna helay 51 cod, mana helin wax kursi ah. Ururka Sincad ayaa helay 3,701 cod iyo saddex kursi, halka Dhallinyarada Talo-Qaran ay heleen 97 cod, balse uusan wax kursi ah ku guuleysan. Ugu dambeyn Ururka Ramaas ayaa isna helay 1,939 cod iyo laba kursi. Si kastaba, doorashadan ayaa qayb ka ah hannaanka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo guddiga uu sheegay in doorashooyinku ay u dhaceen si nabdoon oo xor ah, xilli hanaanka doorasho qof iyo cod ee guddiga waddo ay si weyn u dureen mucaaradka. items.title: SUUDAAN: Duqayn dishay 80 qof, iyadoo laga cabsi qabo in dad Soomaali ah ay ku jiraan khasaaraha
items.description: Ugu yaraan 80 qof ayaa ku dhintay duqayn loo adeegsaday diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (Drone) oo ka dhacday meel u dhow suuq ku yaalla magaalada Al-Dibab ee gobolka Kordofaan Galbeed ee dalka Suudaan, sida ay Isniintii sheegeen ilo caafimaad iyo goobjooge la hadlay wakaaladda wararka AFP. Weerarka oo dhacay fiidnimadii Axadda ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday goob gaadiid laga raaco, halkaas oo dadku isugu yimaadaan si ay ugu laabtaan tuulooyinkooda marka ay dhammeeyaan maalinta suuqa. Goobjooge lagu magacaabo Axmed Abakar Wadi ayaa sheegay inuu ka qayb qaatay aasidda meydadka 50 qof, oo uu ku jiro walaalkiis Maxamed. Wararka qaar ayaa sheegaya in dadka dhintay iyo kuwa dhaawacmay ay ku jireen Soomaali meesha ku laheyd ganacsiyo kala duwan. Sida uu sheegay goobjooguhu, 47 qof oo kale ayaa loo qaaday magaalada Al-Mujlad si loogu daweeyo, hase yeeshee 30 ka mid ah ayaa dhaawacyadooda u geeriyooday, sida uu xaqiijiyay ilo caafimaad oo la hadlay AFP. Dhakhtar ka gaabsaday in magaciisa la shaaciyo sababo amni awgood ayaa sheegay in tirada guud ee dadka ku dhintay weerarka Al-Dibab ay gaartay 80 qof. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in afar qof ay ku dhaawacmeen duqayn kale oo ka dhacday Al-Mujlad, kuwaas oo la daweynayay. Dhanka kale, duqayn kale oo diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn ayaa ka dhacday xaafadda Nasser Extension, oo ku taalla bariga garoonka diyaaradaha ee caasimadda Khartoum. Ilo caafimaad ayaa sheegay in weerarkaas lagu dilay saddex carruur ah oo da’doodu u dhexeysay laba ilaa lix sano, iyo nin kale, kaddib markii diyaaraddu weerartay guri ku yaalla xaafaddaas. Maamulka Tasis, oo ay ku dhawaaqeen xoogagga gurmadka degdegga ah ee RSF, ayaa ciidamada milatariga Suudaan ku eedeeyay inay ka dambeeyeen duqaynta Al-Dibab. Hase yeeshee, eedeyntaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Dagaalka u dhexeeya ciidamada milatariga Suudaan iyo RSF ayaa dalka ka socday tan iyo Abriil 2023, waxaana uu sababay dhimasho badan, barakac baahsan iyo xaalad bani’aadantinimo oo aad u daran. Shaqaalaha gargaarka bani’aadantinimo ayaa qiyaasaya in dagaalku sababay dhimashada in ka badan 200,000 oo qof, isla markaana uu abuuray mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka ugu waaweyn

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo IATA oo Heshiis Ka Gaaray Xoojinta Badbaadada Duulista Hawada
items.description: Muqdisho, 19 Oktoobar 2026 — Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Gaadiidka Cirka (IATA) iyo Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa kala saxiixday heshiis is-afgarad oo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga badbaadada duulista hawada. Heshiiskan ayaa la saxiixay 18-kii Oktoobar 2026, waxaana uu qayb ka yahay dadaallada IATA ee barnaamijkeeda Focus Africa, kaas oo lagu horumarinayo adeegyada duulista hawada ee qaaradda Afrika, gaar ahaan badbaadada iyo tayada hawlgallada diyaaradaha. Heshiiska ayaa dhigaya in Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed ay aqbasho habraacyada kormeerka badbaadada hawlgalka diyaaradaha ee IATA (IOSA) iyo kormeerka badbaadada adeegyada dhulka ee garoomada diyaaradaha (ISAGO), kuwaas oo loo adeegsan doono habab lagu xaqiijinayo u hoggaansanaanta xeerarka qaranka. Tallaabadan ayaa la filayaa inay xoojiso nidaamka kormeerka badbaadada duulista hawada ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo la waafajinayo heerarka caalamiga ah iyo habraacyada ugu wanaagsan ee ay adeegsadaan shirkadaha duulimaadyadu. Kamil Alawadhi, oo ah Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka IATA ee Bariga Dhexe iyo Afrika, ayaa sheegay in heerarka badbaadada caalamiga ahi ay saldhig u yihiin hawlgallo duulimaad oo ammaan ah oo hufan. Waxa uu tilmaamay in heshiisku fursad u siinayo labada dhinac inay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan horumarinta joogtada ah ee badbaadada duulista hawada, faafinta habraacyada wanaagsan iyo xoojinta dhaqanka badbaadada ee guud ahaan waaxda duulista Soomaaliya iyo Afrika. Heshiiska ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ku kala saxiixday Kamil Alawadhi, Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Soomaaliya, Maxamed Faarax Nuux, iyo Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed, Axmed Macallim Xasan. Heshiiskan ayaa muujinaya dadaallada lagu xoojinayo wada shaqaynta Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah ee duulista hawada, si kor loogu qaado badbaadada rakaabka, diyaaradaha iyo adeegyada kaabayaasha duulista.

items.title: Maxay tahay tallaabada degdegga ah ee ay DF Soomaaliya isu diyaarinayso?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Qaranka (SoDMA), Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle ayaa kulan la yeeshay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Hay’adda Cuntada iyo Beeraha ee Qaramada Midoobay (FAO) iyo wakiillo ka socday dowladda Norway. Kulankan ayaa waxaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga u-diyaargarowga xaaladaha El Niño iyo ka hortagga saameynta musiibooyinka. Kulanka waxaa ka qayb-galay Agaasimaha Gurmadka Degdegga ah ee FAO, Rein Paulsen, Wakiilka FAO ee Soomaaliya, Etienne Peterschmitt, iyo wakiillo ka socday dowladda Norway. Wada-hadallada ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray digniinaha hore, diyaar-garowga iyo tallaabooyinka degdegga ah ee looga hortagayo khataraha la xiriira El Niño. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa isla eegay sidii digniinaha hore loogu xiriirin lahaa tallaabooyin degdeg ah oo isku-duuban, si looga hortago khasaaraha ka dhasha musiibooyinka dabiiciga ah, gaar ahaan fatahaadaha iyo khataraha kale ee la xiriira xaaladaha El Niño. Waxaa sidoo kale la isku raacay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha dowladda iyo bahwadaagta caalamiga ah, si loo xaqiijiyo in digniinaha la helo loo beddelo tallaabooyin wax ku ool ah oo lagu badbaadinayo nolosha dadka laguna ilaalinayo hab-nololeedka bulshada. Dhanka kale, kulanka ayaa lagu adkeeyay baahida loo qabo abaabulka dhaqaale iyo helitaanka taageero dheeraad ah oo wax looga qabanayo baahiyaha bani’aadantinimo ee taagan, iyadoo la xoojinayo maalgelinta muddada fog ee u-diyaargarowga musiibooyinka iyo yareynta khataraha ka dhalan kara. Ka qayb-galayaasha ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay dhismaha adkeysiga bulshada iyo horumarinta awoodda wax looga qabanayo xaaladaha degdegga ah, si loo yareeyo saameynta musiibooyinka loona xaqiijiyo in gurmadku gaaro dadka u baahan waqtiga ku habboon. Guddoomiyaha SoDMA ayaa ugu dambeyntiina xaqiijiyay sida ay hay’addu uga go’an tahay hoggaaminta dadaallada dowladda ee maareynta khataraha musiibooyinka, xoojinta isku-duwidda iyo horumarinta iskaashiga hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo bahwadaagta kale, si loo helo gurmad waqtigiisa ku habboon iyo awood dowladeed oo wax ku ool ah. The post Maxay tahay tallaabada degdegga ah ee ay DF Soomaaliya isu diyaarinayso? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Caddayn Kooban: Kiisaska Khilaafka Nasabka iyo Meesha DNA-du ka Gasho
items.description: Caddayn Kooban: Kiisaska Khilaafka Nasabka iyo Meesha DNA-du ka Gasho (Kiiska taagan si toos ah ugama hadlayo, mana aha go’aan laga gaaray dadka kiiska ku jira.) Maalmahan waxaan arkayay dad badan oo ku doodaya: “Maxaa la isku waalayaa? Maxaa DNA loo dalban la’yahay?”— Kiiska Gaalkacyo ka taagan ee Wiilka ay isku haystaan labada qoys. Si arrintan loo fahmo, waxaa muhiim ah in la ogaado in kiisaska khilaafka nasabku aanay dhammaantood isku mid ahayn. Xukunka fiqhigu wuxuu ku xiran yahay xaaladda guurka, waqtiga uurku suuragal noqday, iyo caddaymaha jira. DNA-du waxay wax ka tari kartaa xaqiijinta aabbaha bayoolojiyeed, laakiin ma aha in kiis kasta oo nasab lagu murmo si toos ah DNA loogu xukumo. Guud ahaan, waxaa jira laba xaaladood oo waaweyn oo doodaha noocan ahi ku wareegaan. 1. Xaaladda koowaad: Waladul-firaash (الولد للفراش) Tani waa xaaladda uu ilmuhu ku dhasho guur sharci ahaan nasabkiisa u sugaya ninka, iyadoo la buuxiyey shuruudaha fiqhiga ee ilmaha loogu nisbayn karo ninkaas. Nabigu ﷺ wuxuu yiri: «الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ، وَلِلْعَاهِرِ الْحَجَرُ» Macnaha: “Ilmuhu wuxuu raacayaa firaashka guurka, sinaystahana wax xuquuq nasab ah kuma laha sheegashadiisa.” Waxaa wariyey al-Bukhaari (6818) iyo Muslim (1458). https://dorar.net/h/UxMY8sLu Sidaas darteed, haddii haweeney guur sax ah ku jirto, ilmuhuna buuxiyo shuruudaha nasabka, waxaa jira xukun sharci ah oo ilmuhu ugu raacayo ninka guurka leh. Xukunkani kuma xirna oo keliya in ninku qirto ilmaha ama uu diido; haddii uu nasabka diidayo, waxaa jira habraac gaar ah oo fiqhi ah oo ay ka mid tahay li’aan (اللعان), marka shuruudihiisu jiraan. Haddii nin kale uu ilmaha sheegto, isagoo ku andacoonaya inuu xiriir galmo la yeeshay haweeneyda, sheegashadiisa keliya laguma burin karo nasabka sharci ahaan u sugnaa ninka guurka leh. Waxaa taas saldhig u ah xadiiska kor ku xusan. Halkan waxaa kale oo muhiim ah in la kala saaro laba arrimood: xukunka zinada iyo xukunka nasabka. Labadoodu waa laba mas’alo oo kala duwan. Sidoo kale, haddii ilmo aan nasab ahaan loogu nisbayn ninka falka galmada sameeyey, waxaa jira axkaam kale oo ku saabsan aabbanimada, dhaxalka iyo xiriirka qaraabonimo oo u baahan faahfaahin gaar ah. 2. Xaaladda labaad: Khilaaf ku saabsan laba guur Xaaladdani way ka duwan tahay tii hore. Waxaa dhacaya in laba nin mid kastaa sheegto inuu haweeneyda guursaday, ama ay muran ka galaan guurkii hore, furniinkiisii iyo guurka dambe. Markaas waxaa loo baahan yahay in la baaro: Guurkee ayaa markii hore dhacay? Guurkii hore ma dhammaaday, furniinkuna ma dhacay si sharci ah? Haweeneydu ma dhammaysatay ciddadii loo baahnaa ka hor guurka dambe? Ninka labaad ma ogaa inay haweeneydu weli guur ku jirto ama ay ciddadii ku jirto? Goorma ayay galmo suuragal ahi dhacday, goormase ilmuhu dhashay? Laba guur oo is khilaafsan laguma xallin karo sheegasho keliya; waa in la caddeeyo xaaladda sharci ee mid kasta. Haddii guurka labaad si ogaal ah loogu galay guurkii hore ama ciddadii aan dhammaan Haddii la caddeeyo in ninka labaad uu ogaa in haweeneydu weli xaas tahay, ama ay ciddadii ku jirtay, arrintu waxay yeelanaysaa xukun ka duwan guur uu qofku u galay isagoo aan ogayn xaaladda dhabta ah. Haddii guurkii hore weli sharci ahaan nasab u sugayo, xeerka waladul-firaash ayaa muhiim noqonaya. Hase yeeshee, waa in marka hore la caddeeyo guurka saxda ah, xaaladda ciddada iyo suurtagalnimada in ilmuhu ninkaasi ka dhasho. Haddii ninka labaad uusan ogayn xaaladda guurka Halkan waxaa soo geli karta mas’alada وطء بالشبهة (galmo shubho ku dhacday) , taas oo ah galmo uu qofku u galay isagoo haysta shubho sharci ama khalad macquul ah oo ku saabsan xalaalnimada xiriirka. Madhabka Shaaficiga ahi wuxuu xaaladahan ku eegaa duruufaha gaarka ah, waqtiga galmada, muddada uurka iyo suurtagalnimada in ilmuhu mid kasta ka dhasho. Sidaas darteed, ma aha in si guud loo yiraahdo ilmaha waxaa iska leh ninkii guursaday markii hore ama kii dambe; waa in faahfaahinta la hubiyaa. Tusaale ahaan, haddii labada ninba ay jireen waqtiyo uurku suuragal ka ahaa, taariikhaha guurka, galmada, furniinka iyo dhalashada ilmaha ayaa muhiim noqonaya. Muddada ugu yar ee uurka ee fiqhiga Shaaficiga ahi aqoonsan yahay waa lix bilood, iyadoo laga xisaabinayo waqtiga ay suurtagal noqotay galmada guurka. Laakiin xisaabtan keliya laguma go’aamin karo kiis kasta iyadoo aan la hubin dhammaan duruufaha. 3. Haddii nasabku muran galo, maxaa la samaynayaa? Madhabka Shaaficiga ahi wuxuu aqoonsan yahay habka qaafiyada (القافة) , oo ah qof khibrad u leh aqoonsiga xiriirka nasabka iyadoo la eegayo astaamaha jidheed iyo isu ekaanshaha. Imaam al-Nawawi wuxuu Rawdat al-Taalibiin kaga hadlay xaaladaha ay laba qof ilmaha sheeganayaan iyo sida qaafiyada loogu noqon karo marka shuruudahaasi jiraan. https://www.islamweb.net/ar/library/content/95/2226/ Sidaas darteed, haddii labada ninba ay leeyihiin sheegasho nasab oo fiqhi ahaan suuragal ah, ayna jiraan xaalado qaafiyada loo noqon karo, qaafiyadu waxay ka mid noqon kartaa hababka lagu kala saarayo. DNA-du halkaas ayay ka geli kartaa doodda casriga ah. Waxaa jira culimo iyo hay’ado fiqhi oo baaritaanka DNA-da u arka caddayn cilmiyeed oo la barbar dhigi karo qaafiyada, marka ay jiraan shuruudaha ku habboon. Hase yeeshee, tani macnaheedu ma aha in DNA-du si toos ah u baabi’in karto nasab sharci ahaan hore u sugnaa ama ay beddeli karto habraacyada gaarka ah ee shareecadu u dejisay kiisaska qaarkood. https://islamqa.org/shafii/darul-iftaa-jordan/227729/ 4. Ninka labaad ayaa xiriir aan sharci ahayn la yeeshay haweeneydayda. Sidaas darteed, ilmuhu wuxuu raacayaa xeerka waladul-firaash .” Cali , oo ah ninka labaad, wuxuu leeyahay: “Anigaa ahaa ninkii guursaday, ama guurkii hore ayaa dhammaaday. Yuusuf  wuxuu guursaday haweeneyda iyadoo ciddadii aanay dhammaan, ama waxaa jiray xaalad aanan ka warqabin. Sidaas darteed, waa in la baaro taariikhaha iyo suurtagalnimada nasabka, waxaana laga yaabaa in la gaaro marxalad DNA loo baahdo.” Labadaas sheegasho midkoodna keligiis ma caddaynayo xaqiiqda. Waxaa loo baahan yahay in la baaro dukumentiyada guurka iyo furniinka, ciddada, taariikhaha galmada iyo dhalashada, iyo dhammaan caddaymaha kale ee khuseeya. Gunaanad Su’aasha ah “Maxaa DNA loo dalban la’yahay?” jawaabteedu ma aha in DNA-du aanay qiimo lahayn, mana aha in mar kasta la dalbado. Marka hore waa in la ogaadaa nooca khilaafka, nasabku inuu hore u sugnaa iyo in kale, iyo habka caddayneed ee fiqhigu u oggol yahay xaaladdaas. Haddii xaaladdu tahay mid nasabku hore ugu sugnaa ninka guurka leh, DNA-du si toos ah ugama gudbi karto xeerka waladul-firaash . Haddii se ay jirto xaalad dhab ah oo laba ninba nasabku uga suuragal yahay, shuruudaha qaafiyada iyo caddaymaha kale la buuxiyey, DNA-du waxay yeelan kartaa kaalinteeda iyadoo la raacayo aragtida fiqhi ee la qaato. Ugu dambayn, sababaha shareecadu guurka iyo shuruudihiisa u adkaysay waxaa ka mid ah ilaalinta nasabka, xuquuqda ilmaha iyo kala caddaynta xiriirka qoyska. Sidaas darteed, arrimahan waa in lagu wajaho aqoon, caddaalad iyo taxaddar, ee aan lagu degdegin xukun ama eedayn. Runta Alle ayaa og. Alle ha waafajiyo culimada iyo dadka ku hawlan kiisaska adag xaqa, hana dhowro xuquuqda ilmaha iyo dhammaan dadka ay arrintani khusayso. items.fullContent: Caddayn Kooban: Kiisaska Khilaafka Nasabka iyo Meesha DNA-du ka Gasho (Kiiska taagan si toos ah ugama hadlayo, mana aha go’aan laga gaaray dadka kiiska ku jira.) Maalmahan waxaan arkayay dad badan oo ku doodaya: “Maxaa la isku waalayaa? Maxaa DNA loo dalban la’yahay?”— Kiiska Gaalkacyo ka taagan ee Wiilka ay isku haystaan labada qoys. Si arrintan loo fahmo, waxaa muhiim ah in la ogaado in kiisaska khilaafka nasabku aanay dhammaantood isku mid ahayn. Xukunka fiqhigu wuxuu ku xiran yahay xaaladda guurka, waqtiga uurku suuragal noqday, iyo caddaymaha jira. DNA-du waxay wax ka tari kartaa xaqiijinta aabbaha bayoolojiyeed, laakiin ma aha in kiis kasta oo nasab lagu murmo si toos ah DNA loogu xukumo. Guud ahaan, waxaa jira laba xaaladood oo waaweyn oo doodaha noocan ahi ku wareegaan. 1. Xaaladda koowaad: Waladul-firaash (الولد للفراش) Tani waa xaaladda uu ilmuhu ku dhasho guur sharci ahaan nasabkiisa u sugaya ninka, iyadoo la buuxiyey shuruudaha fiqhiga ee ilmaha loogu nisbayn karo ninkaas. Nabigu ﷺ wuxuu yiri: «الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ، وَلِلْعَاهِرِ الْحَجَرُ» Macnaha: “Ilmuhu wuxuu raacayaa firaashka guurka, sinaystahana wax xuquuq nasab ah kuma laha sheegashadiisa.” Waxaa wariyey al-Bukhaari (6818) iyo Muslim (1458). https://dorar.net/h/UxMY8sLu Sidaas darteed, haddii haweeney guur sax ah ku jirto, ilmuhuna buuxiyo shuruudaha nasabka, waxaa jira xukun sharci ah oo ilmuhu ugu raacayo ninka guurka leh. Xukunkani kuma xirna oo keliya in ninku qirto ilmaha ama uu diido; haddii uu nasabka diidayo, waxaa jira habraac gaar ah oo fiqhi ah oo ay ka mid tahay li’aan (اللعان), marka shuruudihiisu jiraan. Haddii nin kale uu ilmaha sheegto, isagoo ku andacoonaya inuu xiriir galmo la yeeshay haweeneyda, sheegashadiisa keliya laguma burin karo nasabka sharci ahaan u sugnaa ninka guurka leh. Waxaa taas saldhig u ah xadiiska kor ku xusan. Halkan waxaa kale oo muhiim ah in la kala saaro laba arrimood: xukunka zinada iyo xukunka nasabka. Labadoodu waa laba mas’alo oo kala duwan. Sidoo kale, haddii ilmo aan nasab ahaan loogu nisbayn ninka falka galmada sameeyey, waxaa jira axkaam kale oo ku saabsan aabbanimada, dhaxalka iyo xiriirka qaraabonimo oo u baahan faahfaahin gaar ah. 2. Xaaladda labaad: Khilaaf ku saabsan laba guur Xaaladdani way ka duwan tahay tii hore. Waxaa dhacaya in laba nin mid kastaa sheegto inuu haweeneyda guursaday, ama ay muran ka galaan guurkii hore, furniinkiisii iyo guurka dambe. Markaas waxaa loo baahan yahay in la baaro: Guurkee ayaa markii hore dhacay? Guurkii hore ma dhammaaday, furniinkuna ma dhacay si sharci ah? Haweeneydu ma dhammaysatay ciddadii loo baahnaa ka hor guurka dambe? Ninka labaad ma ogaa inay haweeneydu weli guur ku jirto ama ay ciddadii ku jirto? Goorma ayay galmo suuragal ahi dhacday, goormase ilmuhu dhashay? Laba guur oo is khilaafsan laguma xallin karo sheegasho keliya; waa in la caddeeyo xaaladda sharci ee mid kasta. Haddii guurka labaad si ogaal ah loogu galay guurkii hore ama ciddadii aan dhammaan Haddii la caddeeyo in ninka labaad uu ogaa in haweeneydu weli xaas tahay, ama ay ciddadii ku jirtay, arrintu waxay yeelanaysaa xukun ka duwan guur uu qofku u galay isagoo aan ogayn xaaladda dhabta ah. Haddii guurkii hore weli sharci ahaan nasab u sugayo, xeerka waladul-firaash ayaa muhiim noqonaya. Hase yeeshee, waa in marka hore la caddeeyo guurka saxda ah, xaaladda ciddada iyo suurtagalnimada in ilmuhu ninkaasi ka dhasho. Haddii ninka labaad uusan ogayn xaaladda guurka Halkan waxaa soo geli karta mas’alada وطء بالشبهة (galmo shubho ku dhacday) , taas oo ah galmo uu qofku u galay isagoo haysta shubho sharci ama khalad macquul ah oo ku saabsan xalaalnimada xiriirka. Madhabka Shaaficiga ahi wuxuu xaaladahan ku eegaa duruufaha gaarka ah, waqtiga galmada, muddada uurka iyo suurtagalnimada in ilmuhu mid kasta ka dhasho. Sidaas darteed, ma aha in si guud loo yiraahdo ilmaha waxaa iska leh ninkii guursaday markii hore ama kii dambe; waa in faahfaahinta la hubiyaa. Laakiin xisaabtan keliya laguma go’aamin karo kiis kasta iyadoo aan la hubin dhammaan duruufaha. 3. Haddii nasabku muran galo, maxaa la samaynayaa? items.title: President Hassan Sheikh’s economic rhetoric collides with the reality on the ground
items.description: Sheikh Mohamed Idris challenges the president’s claims of economic transformation, arguing that Somalia cannot become an export-driven economy without reliable electricity, infrastructure, political stability, industrial investment and credible economic policies. MOGADISHU (WDN) — President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has spoken of transforming Somalia from an import-dependent economy into an export-oriented nation. But where is the evidence that the country is ready to make that leap? That question has been raised by prominent Somali Islamic scholar Sheikh Mohamed Idris, who has sharply criticised the president’s recent economic statements, accusing him of presenting ambitions as though they were achievements while failing to address the structural obstacles preventing Somalia from becoming a productive, investment-driven economy. In a statement published on Facebook, Sheikh Idris challenged the president’s claim that Somalia spends approximately $300 million importing low-quality powdered milk. He also questioned the government’s stated ambition to move the country away from dependence on imports towards producing and exporting goods. His criticism strikes at a fundamental weakness in Somalia’s economic debate: announcing an ambition to become an export-oriented economy is not the same as building the infrastructure, industries and institutions needed to make it happen. The president may be right that Somalia must produce more and import less. But Sheikh Idris argues that the government has offered insufficient evidence that the country is prepared to make that transition. From Presidential Promises to Economic Reality Addressing Hassan Sheikh directly, Sheikh Idris questioned why the president was speaking about export-led growth without demonstrating that his administration, or successive governments, had established the foundations necessary to achieve it. His criticism extends beyond the current presidency. He argued that administrations governing Somalia since 2012 have failed to make sufficient progress in addressing the fundamental constraints on domestic production. The scholar’s central argument is straightforward: a country cannot become a major exporter simply by declaring that it wants to export. Before goods can be manufactured for international markets, investors must be willing to finance production. Businesses need reliable electricity, roads, transport networks, functioning ports, predictable regulations and a stable political environment. Manufacturers also require access to finance, skilled workers and markets in which they can compete. Without these foundations, export-oriented growth risks remaining a political slogan rather than a credible economic strategy. Somalia cannot manufacture its way into prosperity without first creating the conditions in which manufacturing becomes commercially viable. Electricity: A Fundamental Barrier to Investment Sheikh Idris highlighted electricity generation as one of the most important constraints facing Somalia, comparing the country’s reported capacity with that of other African economies and major manufacturing nations. The figures he cited put Somalia’s electricity generation capacity at approximately 0.48 gigawatts, compared with around 6.75–7 gigawatts for Ethiopia, 3.8 gigawatts for Kenya, 2.73 gigawatts for Tanzania and 2.06 gigawatts for Uganda. He also pointed to the much larger power systems of countries such as Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Türkiye, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and the United Arab Emirates, arguing that their industrial and export capabilities depend partly on substantial energy infrastructure. The figures require verification against comparable, up-to-date energy statistics, and installed capacity should not be confused with the electricity actually generated or reliably delivered. Nevertheless, the underlying issue is difficult to dismiss: affordable and dependable power is essential for modern industry. Manufacturing requires electricity to operate machinery, process agricultural products, preserve food, produce construction materials and maintain cold-storage facilities. Unreliable or expensive power raises production costs and makes locally manufactured goods less competitive. For Somali businesses, these costs can undermine the very objective the president says he wants to achieve: replacing imported goods with products made domestically. Investment Requires More Than Political Announcements Sheikh Idris argues that industrialisation depends on a combination of investment, stability, infrastructure, effective laws and a deliberate commitment to developing productive sectors. Investors—whether Somali or foreign—need confidence that their capital will be protected, contracts enforced and commercial regulations applied consistently. They also need functioning roads, ports, electricity networks and other infrastructure that allows goods to move efficiently from factories and farms to consumers and export markets. Economic free zones and other investment incentives may help attract capital, but they cannot compensate for insecurity, unreliable services or unpredictable government decisions. Somalia also needs to strengthen its capacity to process the products it already produces. Livestock, fisheries and agricultural goods offer potential opportunities, but expanding exports requires investment in processing facilities, veterinary and quality-control systems, cold chains, logistics and access to international markets. The objective should not simply be to export more raw commodities. It should be to create greater domestic value by processing, packaging and manufacturing products within Somalia, generating jobs and expanding the tax base. The Evidence the Government Must Produce The president’s ambition to make Somalia more export-oriented is not inherently unrealistic. The question is whether his administration can demonstrate a credible pathway from aspiration to measurable results. That requires more than speeches. The government should publish clear evidence of progress in electricity generation and distribution, infrastructure development, industrial investment, business formation, manufacturing output and export performance. It should also explain how its economic policies will reduce production costs, improve access to finance, strengthen commercial regulations and attract investment into productive sectors. The claim that Somalia is becoming an investment hub must likewise be supported by evidence: actual investment commitments and disbursements, completed projects, new productive capacity, jobs created and measurable improvements in the business environment. Announced deals alone do not establish that an investment transformation has occurred. Sheikh Idris’s intervention highlights a broader challenge for Somalia’s leadership. Economic confidence cannot be built on ambitious declarations alone. It must be earned through policies and results that businesses, workers and investors can see. items.title: Somalia warned, but not ready: Galkacyo floods expose the failure of disaster preparedness
items.description: Hospitals, markets, schools and roads inundated as El Niño rains expose dangerous gaps in urban infrastructure, emergency planning and the ability of Somali administrations to protect their populations. Galkacyo (WDN) — Somalia was warned to prepare for severe El Niño-related flooding. Yet as heavy rains inundate parts of Galkacyo, the consequences are exposing a deeply troubling question: why do warnings so often arrive before disasters, while effective protection appears to lag behind? Puntland’s minister of humanitarian affairs and disaster management, Abdinasir Haji Yusuf, says heavy rainfall has flooded health facilities, markets, educational institutions and roads in Galkacyo, disrupting essential public services and leaving large amounts of standing water across the city. The situation is particularly alarming because the flooding has reportedly caused toilets and household water-storage facilities in residential neighbourhoods to overflow into stagnant floodwater. This creates conditions that could contaminate water supplies, spread disease and place already vulnerable communities at further risk. The minister described Galkacyo as the district hardest hit by the recent rainfall in Somalia and warned that the situation could deteriorate. He appealed to humanitarian organisations operating in Puntland and elsewhere in the country to provide urgent assistance, particularly to help remove accumulated water from the city. His warning deserves immediate attention, but it also raises a larger question about Somalia’s ability to turn forecasts into practical protection before lives, livelihoods and essential services are endangered. Early warnings are not a substitute for preparedness The danger was not entirely unexpected. In September, the Food and Agriculture Organization ( FAO) warned that strengthening El Niño conditions and forecasts of above-normal rainfall raised the risk of significant flooding during Somalia’s October–December Deyr season. The UN office for disaster risk reduction likewise highlighted the potential for severe flooding and the need for early action, stronger evacuation planning, and health and sanitation preparedness The Somali disaster management agency (SODMA) also organised national preparedness activities in Mogadishu in late September, including a simulation exercise intended to test early-warning communication, inter-agency coordination and the mobilisation of emergency assistance. officials acknowledged that warnings must be translated into timely decisions and practical action. Yet Galkacyo’s reported conditions illustrate the gap that can emerge between identifying a hazard and preparing communities to withstand it. A warning does not drain a flooded street, protect a hospital, clear a blocked road or prevent contaminated water from entering homes. preparedness requires resources, infrastructure, coordination and action before the rain arrives. The flooding does not, by itself, establish that every warning or preparedness measure failed. but it raises legitimate questions about whether the city’s drainage capacity, emergency response arrangements and protection of essential services were adequate for the risks that had been forecast. A national problem, not just a Puntland emergency Galkacyo’s predicament should concern every Somali administration, including the federal government in Mogadishu. Across Somalia, the capacity to manage floods depends not only on emergency announcements but also on urban planning, drainage systems, waste management, reliable public-health services, emergency funding and clearly defined responsibilities between federal, state and district authorities. Where these systems are weak, even predictable seasonal rainfall can become a public emergency. Water accumulates in streets, transport routes become difficult to use, health facilities face disruption, and sanitation failures increase the risk of disease. The problem is especially serious in rapidly growing urban areas where infrastructure may not have kept pace with population growth. without effective drainage and properly maintained water and sanitation systems, heavy rain can overwhelm neighbourhoods and critical public facilities. Emergency teams should also identify households and neighbourhoods at greatest risk and ensure that assistance reaches people whose homes, livelihoods or access to healthcare have been affected. Federal institutions must support coordination and preparedness across jurisdictions, while international partners should help finance practical measures that reduce risk before emergencies occur. Puntland needs urgent assistance to address the immediate crisis, while the federal government, federal member states and local administrations must confront the infrastructure and institutional weaknesses that make predictable weather hazards so destructive. The rain may eventually stop. but unless Somalia acts on the lessons exposed by this flooding, the next forecast could bring the same warnings, the same appeals for help and the same preventable disruption. items.title: Guddoomiyihii gobolka Hiiraan oo xilka laga qaaday iyo Cali Guudlaawe oo…
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha HirShabeelle, Cali Guudlaawe Xuseen ayaa xilka ka qaaday guddoomiyihii gobolka Hiiraan, Maxamed Xuseen Maxamed Carab, isaga oo xilkaas u magacaabay Muuse Salaad Weheliye, sida lagu shaaciyay wareegto uu soo saaray. Afhayeenka madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in go’aanka xil ka qaadista iyo magacaabista cusub uu yimid kaddib soo jeedin ka timid Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Dowladaha Hoose ee maamulka. Tallaabadan ayaa timid maalmo kaddib markii maamulka gobolka Hiiraan uu soo saaray war-saxaafadeed uu kaga hadlay khilaaf ka dhashay dakhliga canshuuraha laga qaado Suuqa Xoolaha ee magaalada Beledweyne iyo qaabka loogu qaybinayo deegaannada gobolka. Guddoomiyaha xilka laga qaaday ayaa horay walaac uga muujiyay qorshe la xiriira in dakhliga canshuuraha Beledweyne loo qaybiyo deegaanno kale. Wuxuu ku dooday in deegaannadaas aysan lahayn adeegyo iyo kaabayaal ku filan oo sabab u noqonaya in ay qayb ka helaan dakhligaas. Wareysi uu bixiyay, Maxamed Carab ayuu sidoo kale ku tilmaamay mid aan caddaalad ahayn in deegaanno gaar ah la siiyo saamiyo ka badan kuwa ay helayaan deegaannada kale, isaga oo dhaliilay habka loo qaybinayo dakhliga canshuuraha. Inkasta oo xil ka qaadistu ay kusoo beegantay xilli uu taagnaa muranka dakhliga canshuuraha, haddana lama oga in arrintaasi ay sabab toos ah u ahayd go’aanka madaxweynaha HirShabeelle. Si kastaba, isbeddelkan maamul ayaa imaanaya xilli HirShabeelle ay ku jirto marxalad doorasho, iyadoo Cali Guudlaawe uu yahay musharrax mar kale u taagan xilka madaxweynaha maamulka. items.title: SoDMA, FAO iyo Dowladda Norway oo ka wada hadlay xoojinta u-diyaargarowga musiibooyinka la xiriira El Niño
items.description: Muqdisho – Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Qaranka (SoDMA), Mudane Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle, ayaa kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay Agaasimaha Gurmadka Degdegga ah ee Hay’adda Cuntada iyo Beeraha ee Qaramada Midoobay (FAO), Rein Paulsen, Wakiilka FAO ee Soomaaliya, Etienne Peterschmitt, iyo wakiillo ka socday Dowladda Norway. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada u-diyaargarowga xaaladaha El Niño, horumarinta nidaamyada digniinaha hore iyo qaadista tallaabooyin degdeg ah oo looga hortagayo saameynta musiibooyinka. Intii uu kulanku socday, dhinacyadu waxay ka wada hadleen sidii digniinaha hore loogu xiriirin lahaa tallaabooyin wax-ku-ool ah oo isku-duuban, si loo badbaadiyo nolosha dadka, loo ilaaliyo hab-nololeedka bulshada, loona yareeyo saameynta fatahaadaha iyo khataraha kale ee la xiriira El Niño. Sidoo kale, waxaa la adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay abaabulka dhaqaale iyo helitaanka taageero dheeraad ah oo wax looga qabanayo baahiyaha bani’aadantinimo ee jira. Waxa kale oo la isku raacay muhiimadda maalgelinta muddada fog ee u-diyaargarowga musiibooyinka, yareynta khataraha iyo dhismaha adkeysiga bulshada. Ugu dambeyn, Guddoomiyaha SoDMA, Mudane Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle, ayaa xaqiijiyay sida ay Hay’addu uga go’an tahay hoggaaminta dadaallada dowladda ee maareynta khataraha musiibooyinka, xoojinta isku-duwidda gurmadka iyo horumarinta iskaashiga hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo bahwadaagta kale. Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la helo gurmad waqtigiisa ku habboon, qors

items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka oo shaaciyay jadwalka doorashooyinka Hirshabeelle
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa shaaciyay jadwalka doorashooyinka hoggaanka iyo guddonnada dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle, iyadoo hawlaha doorashadu ay bilaabanayaan 19-ka Oktoobar 2026. Sida ku cad jadwalka la shaaciyay, 19-ka iyo 20-ka Oktoobar waxaa la qabanayaa doorashooyinka guddoonka iyo ku-xigeennada Golaha Wakiillada Hirshabeelle, halka 21-ka Oktoobar la qabanayo qabadashada araajida musharraxiinta guddoonka iyo ku-xigeennada. 22-ka Oktoobar ayaa loo qorsheeyay hadal-jeedinta iyo musharraxnimada doorashada guddoonka Golaha Wakiillada. Dhanka kale, jadwalka doorashooyinka hoggaamiyaha dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle ayaa dhigaya in 23-ka Oktoobar la qabanayo qabadashada araajida musharraxiinta hoggaamiyaha iyo ku-xigeenkiisa, halka 24-ka Oktoobar ay dhici doonto hadal-jeedinta iyo doorashada hoggaamiyaha iyo ku-xigeenkiisa. Guddiga ayaa jadwalkan u soo bandhigay qayb ka mid ah diyaar-garowga doorashooyinka maamulka Hirshabeelle, iyadoo la sugayo in hawlaha loo qabto sida ku cad jadwalka rasmiga ah ee la shaaciyay

items.title: Wasaaradda Warfaafinta oo digniin u dirtay warbaahinta iyo maamulayaasha baraha bulshada
items.description: Muqdisho, 19-ka Oktoobar 2026: Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa digniin adag u dirtay hay’adaha warbaahinta, mareegaha iyo maamulayaasha akoonnada baraha bulshada ee ay sheegtay inay si ula kac ah u faafiyaan dacaayadaha argagixisada iyo maleeshiyaadka hubaysan. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in digniintan ay salka ku hayso shuruucda dalka, oo ay ku jiraan Sharciga Saxaafadda, Sharciga La-dagaallanka Argagixisada, Xeerka Ciqaabta Soomaaliyeed iyo xeerarka kale ee la xiriira ka-hortagga maalgelinta argagixisada. Qoraal ay soo saartay Wasaaraddu ayay ku sheegtay in aan la aqbali karin in warbaahinta iyo baraha bulshada loo adeegsado abaabulka weerarro, dhiirrigelinta ku biirista kooxaha argagixisada ama kicinta rabshado hubaysan oo khatar ku ah amniga dalka, isla markaana sababi kara barakaca shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Wasaaraddu waxay intaas ku dartay in cid kasta oo lagu helo inay si ula kac ah warbaahinta ama baraha bulshada ugu adeegsatay falal dembiyeed oo noocaas ah laga qaadi doono tallaabo waafaqsan sharciga, iyadoo la tixgelinayo caddaymaha la hayo iyo mas’uuliyadda qofka. Sidoo kale, waxay sheegtay in dadka lagu helo inay taageero maaliyadeed siiyeen kooxaha argagixisada ama ay ka qaybqaateen maalgelintooda la horkeeni doono caddaaladda, haddii ay jiraan caddaymo ku filan oo sharciga waafaqsan. Ugu dambayn, Wasaaradda Warfaafinta ayaa ugu baaqday hay’adaha warbaahinta iyo maamulayaasha akoonnada baraha bulshada inay ka fogaadaan faafinta waxyaabaha ay Wasaaraddu ku tilmaantay dacaayadaha argagixisada, isla markaana ay dhowraan shuruucda dalka iyo anshaxa saxaafadda.

items.description: Muqdisho, 19-ka Oktoobar 2026 – Maxkamadda Sare ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta ansixisay natiijada doorashada Golaha Wakiillada Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabeelle, kaddib markii uu Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha u gudbiyay natiijada doorashada.
