items.title: Xuseen Dhagaweyne oo si rasmi ah ula wareegay hoggaanka Baarlamaanka Galmudug
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoonka cusub ee Golaha Wakiillada Maamulka Galmudug ayaa maanta si rasmi ah xilka ula wareegay, kadib munaasabad ka dhacday xarunta Golaha oo ku taalla magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee xarunta gobolka Galgaduud. ‎Munaasabadda xil-wareejinta waxaa ka soo qeyb galay xildhibaano ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaalka Wasiirro, xubnaha cusub ee Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug,hawlwadeennada Baarlamaanka, iyo marti-sharaf kale. Xuseen Dhagaweyne oo shalay uun loo doortay xilka guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiilada, maanta la wareegay ayaa marka hore u mahadceliyay guddoonkii hore ee Golaha, isaga oo ku amaanay shaqadii iyo dadaalkii ay soo qabteen muddadii ay xilka hayeen. Sidoo kale mahadnaq u jeediyay dhammaan marti-sharaftii iyo masuuliyiinta ka soo qeyb galay munaasabadda xil-wareejinta oo si nabad ah uga qabsoontay Dhuusamareeb. ‎‎Waxaa kale oo uu muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadidda howlaha Golaha, xoojinta wada-shaqeynta iyo gudashada waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug. Dhankiisa, Guddoomiyihii hore ee Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug, Dr. Maxamed Nuur Gacal oo munaasabadda ka hadlay ayaa mas’uuliyiinta la doortay eebbe uga baryay inuu la garab galo ma’uuliyadda culus ee loo igmaday, isagoo ballan qaaday inuu la shaqeyn doono. Saddexda xubnood ee loo doortay guddoonka Baarlamaanka cusub ee Galmudug ayaa dhammaantood ka tirsan xisbiga JSP ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, taas oo ka dhigan in Villa Somalia ay hanatay hoggaanka sare ee Baarlamaanka Galmudug. Doorashada guddoonka kadib, waxaa iyana ku xigi doono midda Madaxweynaha Galmudug oo dhici doonta maalmaha soo socda, waxaana loo saadaalinayaa musharrax Liibaan Axmed Xasan oo ay wadato Villa Soomaaliya, kaas oo isna horay oo siiyay kaarka xisbiga JSP. The post Xuseen Dhagaweyne oo si rasmi ah ula wareegay hoggaanka Baarlamaanka Galmudug appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: United States Hosts Caribbean Dialogue to Advance Shared Security and Prosperity
items.description: United States Hosts Caribbean Dialogue to Advance Shared Security and Prosperity Office of the Spokesman On October 15, Deputy Secretary of State Landau hosted the U.S.-Caribbean Dialogue at the Department of State, delivering on the commitment Secretary Rubio made to Caribbean Community (CARICOM) Heads of Government at their February meeting in Saint Kitts and Nevis. High-level delegations from Antigua and Barbuda, The Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Dominica, the Dominican Republic, Grenada, Guyana, Haiti, Jamaica, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Suriname, and Trinidad and Tobago joined the United States to expand cooperation on shared economic, energy, and security priorities. At a business luncheon and an evening reception, Caribbean delegations met with American business leaders to discuss opportunities for projects in energy, critical minerals, ports, and digital infrastructure that will create jobs and growth in both the United States and the Caribbean. Dialogue sessions addressed energy security, economic growth, critical infrastructure, trusted technology, disaster response and health cooperation, and the fight against narco-terrorists and transnational criminal organizations. Participants discussed access to U.S. energy and technology, fair and transparent procurement, trusted digital and port infrastructure, self-sufficient health workforces, and closer coordination to disrupt illicit narcotics and firearms trafficking. Advancing U.S.-Caribbean Commercial Diplomacy Caribbean Investment Summit: The Department of State announced that it will host a Caribbean Investment Summit in early 2027 to connect U.S. companies, financiers, and government finance agencies with Caribbean partners to help them close deals in open, competitive markets. Promoting Trusted Digital Technology Caribbean and Central America Undersea Cables Program: The Department of State announced $175.8 million to expand trusted, high-speed undersea cable connectivity across the Caribbean and Central America and make trusted connections more resilient to disruption. Strengthening Health Self-Sufficiency Americas Strategic Partnership for Independent Regional Healthcare Excellence (ASPIRE): Working with Congress, the Department of State intends to provide $61.5 million through ASPIRE to help Caribbean governments build self-sufficient health workforces by hiring health professionals ethically and transparently, with fair pay going to the workers themselves. Advancing Regional Security Through the Caribbean Basin Security Initiative (CBSI) Protecting Critical Infrastructure and Maritime Resources: The Department of State announced $37 million in CBSI programming to secure critical digital infrastructure and ports, and counter illegal, unreported, and unregulated fishing. Law Enforcement and Security Cooperation: The State Department announced $66 million in CBSI programming to strengthen Caribbean partners’ ability to counter transnational criminal organizations and secure the region’s borders. The total includes $55 million in International Narcotics Control and Law Enforcement assistance and $11 million in Foreign Military Financing. CBSI Security Ministerial: The United States will work with Caribbean security ministers and the CARICOM Implementation Agency for Crime and Security (IMPACS) to convene the next CBSI Security Ministerial in spring 2027.

items.title: Somalia angry as Ethiopia refuses to intervene in South West State conflict
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s federal government is furious with Ethiopia for refusing to intervene in the conflict in South West State, where Mogadishu lost five strategic towns in a week to the forces of former state leader Abdiasis Laftagaren. Mogadishu asked the commanders of Ethiopian troops in Somalia to join the fighting between its forces and Laftagaren’s troops, and to take its side. The federal government removed Laftagaren from power by force in March. It specifically asked the Ethiopian troops to defend the major towns they have garrisoned for more than a decade. Laftagaren’s forces retook those five towns last week with little to no resistance. The Ethiopian commanders stated explicitly that their mandate does not extend to involvement in a political conflict between Somali stakeholders and elites contesting power. The response has angered Somali government officials, who are now considering their next move. Ethiopia Also Rejects Egyptian Forces and Turkish Base Ethiopia’s military also refused to let Mogadishu bring Egyptian forces into South West State, or establish a Turkish military base in the parts of Bay and Bakool regions under Ethiopian control. Apparently angered by these refusals, Parliament Speaker Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur called on the federal government to hold Ethiopian forces accountable for not defending the towns Laftagaren’s forces have recently captured. Ethiopian Troops’ Mandate and Past Political Assistance Ethiopian forces entered Somalia in the early 2010s to fight Al-Shabaab, under both a bilateral agreement and an African Union peacekeeping mission. Aiding Mogadishu in political conflicts has never been part of their mandate, although they have sometimes helped the authorities in Mogadishu on political matters, including the arrest of Mukhtar Robow in 2018. Talks Between Somalia’s President and Abiy Ahmed Collapsed Last month, the Somali president met Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed to urge him to help defeat Laftagaren’s forces. The two sides had earlier appeared close to an agreement, but the talks collapsed when President Mohamud travelled to Egypt the same week. In Egypt, he attended a meeting with the leaders of Egypt and Eritrea, two arch-rivals of Addis Ababa. The meeting produced a communiqué that was in some way sharply critical of Ethiopia. Mogadishu Accuses Ethiopia, UAE and Al-Shabaab of Plotting Since then, Mogadishu has used its social media influencers and affiliated media outlets to accuse Ethiopia, the United Arab Emirates and Al-Shabaab of plotting together to defeat it in South West State. It alleges that all three are fighting alongside Laftagaren’s forces to topple the regional administration it installed after its March offensive, in which it ousted Laftagaren and his administration. Ethiopia and Kenya Neutral, but Mogadishu Angry With Both Ethiopia and Kenya both appear to be taking a neutral stance in Somalia’s political power struggle. Mogadishu is angry with both for not cooperating when it needed them, and for not helping it remove its domestic opposition, a goal in which neither country sees a national security interest. items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo dhammaystiray akhrinta koowaad ee heshiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee ka dhanka ah ka ganacsiga daroogada
items.description: Muqdisho, 19 Oktoobar 2026 – Xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa dhammaystiray akhrinta koowaad ee heshiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee ka dhanka ah ka ganacsiga sharci-darrada ah ee maandooriyeyaasha iyo walxaha maskaxda saameeya, kaas oo la xiriira heshiiskii caalamiga ahaa ee la ansixiyey 1988-kii. Kulanka oo ahaa kalfadhiga siddeedaad, kulankiisa 26-aad, ayaa ka dhacay xarunta Golaha Shacabka, waxaana shir-guddoominayey Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), oo uu wehelinayey Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Golaha, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow. Heshiiskan oo ay Golaha Shacabka u soo gudbisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada ayaa xildhibaannadu su’aalo ka weydiiyeen Wasiirka Wasaaradda Caafimaadka, Dr. Cali Xaaji Aadan, kaas oo ka jawaabay su’aalihii ay mudanayaashu ka qabeen heshiiska. Heshiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee 1988-kii ayaa saldhig u ah iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee lagula dagaallamayo ka ganacsiga sharci-darrada ah ee maandooriyeyaasha iyo walxaha maskaxda saameeya. Dhanka kale, Golaha Shacabka ayaa akhrinta saddexaad mariyey heshiisyada u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ee ku saabsan iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee dhinaca garsoorka. Warbixinta heshiisyadan waxaa Golaha la wadaagay Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Golaha Shacabka, Xildhibaan Maxamed Jaamac Mursal (Geelle). Sidoo kale, xildhibaannadu waxay akhrinta saddexaad mariyeen Hindise-sharciyeedka wax-ka-beddelka Sharciga Bankiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya, Sharci Lr. 130 ee 2012-kii. Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Guddiga Miisaaniyadda, Maaliyadda, Qorsheynta, Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah iyo La-xisaabtanka Hay’adaha Dowladda, Xildhibaan Maxamed Haaruun Cabdullaahi, ayaa Golaha u faahfaahiyey warbixinta akhrinta saddexaad ee hindise-sharciyeedka. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa kulanka soo xiray, isaga oo xildhibaannada uga mahadceliyey ka qaybgalka kulanka iyo gudashada waajibaadkooda dastuuriga ah.

items.title: Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Dominican Republic Foreign Minister Bisonó Haza
items.description: Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Dominican Republic Foreign Minister Bisonó Haza Office of the Spokesman Secretary of State Marco Rubio met today with Dominican Republic Foreign Minister Víctor Bisonó Haza in Washington to advance the strong U.S. – Dominican Republic partnership. The two discussed deepening security cooperation against the cartels and narco-terrorist groups that threaten our hemisphere. They also discussed continued collaboration under the U.S. – Dominican Republic Critical Minerals Framework to advance concrete investment in the mining sector.

items.title: Cali Guudlaawe oo xilka ka qaaday guddoomiyihii gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha maamulka Hirshabeelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe), ayaa xilka ka qaaday guddoomiyihii gobolka Hiiraan, Maxamed Xuseen Maxamed (Carab), isagoo xilkaas u magacaabay Muuse Salaad Wehliye oo hore u soo noqday guddoomiyaha gobolka. Xil ka qaadistan ayaa timid xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo khilaafka u dhexeeya maamulka Hirshabeelle iyo guddoomiyihii gobolka Hiiraan, kaas oo la xiriira arrimaha canshuuraha laga qaado gobolka. Guddoomiyihii xilka laga qaaday, Maxamed Xuseen Maxamed (Carab), ayaa xalay ka horyimid maamulka Hirshabeelle, kaddib markii uu soo baxay khilaafka la xiriira maamulka iyo canshuuraha gobolka Hiiraan. Magacaabista Muuse Salaad Wehliye ayaa dib ugu soo celinaysa xilka guddoomiyenimada gobolka Hiiraan, oo uu hore u soo qabtay, iyadoo la sugayo sida uu isbeddelkan cusub u saameyn doono xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo maamulka gobolka. Khilaafkan ayaa imanaya iyadoo gobolka Hiiraan uu ka mid yahay deegaannada ay ka jiraan doodaha ku saabsan awoodaha maamulka Hirshabeelle, maamulka gobolka iyo maaraynta dakhliga laga ururiyo gudaha gobolka.

items.title: Xukuumadda Somaliland oo xoojisay dadaalladeeda ay ku raadinayso aqoonsiga
items.description: Wabaahinta caalamiga ah ee The World Brief ayaa sheegay in xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay si weyn u xoojisay dadaalladeeda ay ku raadinayso aqoonsiga caalami ah, isla markaana ay Maraykanka u soo bandhigtay fursado la xidhiidha khayraadka macdanta, iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo badda, xilli Madaxweynaha Maraykanka, Donald Trump, uu Somaliland ku tilmaamay dal gebi ahaanba ka duwan dalka fashilmay ee Soomaaliya. The World Brief waxa kale oo ay sheegtay in hadalkii Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump, ka jeediyay magaalada Youngstown ee gobolka Ohio, 13-kii Oktoobar, uu rejo cusub ka abuuray gudaha magaalooyinka Somaliland, iyada oo caasimadda Somaliland ee Hargeysa, ay isugu soo baxeen kumannaan dadweyne ah oo iyagoo lulaya calamada Somaliland iyo Maraykanka, isla markaana muujinaya taageerada ay u hayaan dadaallada aqoonsi-raadinta. Sidoo kale Warbixino ay baahiyeen warbaahinno caalami ah, oo ay ka mid yihiin bne IntelliNews, ayaa tilmaamay in Somaliland ay doonayso inay xidhiidhka ay la leedahay Washington ku xoojiso iskaashi dhaqaale, amni iyo istaraatiiji ah. Bne IntelliNews waxa kale oo ay xustay in Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), uu bishii September booqasho ku tagay magaalada Washington iyo New York, taas oo qayb ka ah dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Somaliland ugu jiray sidii loo ballaadhin lahaa xidhiidhka Somaliland iyo Maraykanka. items.title: Hawlgalka Midowga Yurub Ee Badda Cas oo Wajahaya Maraakiib-Yaraan
items.description: BRUSSELS (Goobjoog News) — Kooxda hawlgalka Midowga Yurub u qaabilsan Badda Cas ayaa Brussels ku yeelatay kulan heer sare ah oo looga hadlay weerarrada maraakiibta, amniga Bab al-Mandab iyo mustaqbalka howlgalka badeed ee Aspides. Kulanka waxaa hoggaaminayey ku-xigeenka Xoghayaha Guud ee Adeegga Arrimaha Dibadda Midowga Yurub, Olof Skoog, waxaana ka qaybgalay wakiillada gaarka ah ee Midowga Yurub u qaabilsan Geeska Afrika, Badda Cas iyo Khaliijka. Dooddu waxay xoogga saartay khataraha degdegga ah iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa isku-duwidda amniga gobolka. Hawlgalka Aspides, oo la bilaabay bishii Febraayo 2024 si uu maraakiibta ganacsiga uga difaaco weerarrada Xuutiyiinta, ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inuu hadda haysto qiyaastii lix markab dagaal. Madaxa siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda Midowga Yurub, Kaja Kallas, ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan toban markab loo baahan yahay si hawlgalku u bixiyo dabool ku filan. Yaraanta maraakiibta ayaa sababtay in qaar ka mid ah maraakiibta ganacsigu sugaan galbin, halka dalalka xubnaha ka ah Midowga Yurub lagu cadaadinayo inay soo kordhiyaan maraakiib iyo awood difaac. Qaar ka mid ah dowladaha Yurub ayaa ciidamadooda badda mudnaan ku siiyey Badda Baltic iyo Badda Madow, taas oo xaddidaysa awoodda loo diri karo Badda Cas. Soomaaliya, yaraanta awoodda Aspides waxay si dadban u saamayn kartaa ganacsiga mara Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Bab al-Mandab. Haddii khatarta maraakiibtu sii kororto, shirkadaha caymiska iyo kuwa xamuulku waxay kordhin karaan kharashaadka ama waxay dooran karaan marinno dhaadheer, taas oo sare u qaadi karta qiimaha shidaalka iyo badeecadaha Soomaaliya la keeno. Hase yeeshee, Aspides si toos ah uguma xil-saarna la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya; waajibaadkiisu wuxuu ku kooban yahay difaaca maraakiibta laga ilaaliyo weerarrada Badda Cas. Hawlgalka Midowga Yurub ee Atalanta ayaa leh waajibaadka la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda iyo ilaalinta maraakiibta nugul ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo xeebaha Soomaaliya. Maraakiib-yaraanta Aspides waxay muujinaysaa culayska saaran awoodda badeed ee Midowga Yurub xilli khataraha Badda Cas iyo burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya ay isku mar soo kordhayaan. Shirarka diblomaasiyadeed waxay hagaajin karaan isku-duwidda, balse badbaadada marin-biyoodku waxay ku xirnaan doontaa maraakiibta, shaqaalaha iyo qalabka ay dowladaha xubnaha ahi dhab ahaan u diyaariyaan hawlgallada

items.title: Guddoonka cusub ee Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug oo xilka la wareegay
items.description: Guddoonka cusub ee Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug ayaa maanta si rasmi ah xilka ula wareegay, munaasabad ka dhacday xarunta Golaha ee magaalada Dhuusamareeb. Munaasabadda xil-wareejinta oo qabsoontay 19-ka Oktoobar 2026 ayaa waxaa ka qeyb galay xildhibaano ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, mudanayaasha Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug, wasiirro ka tirsan dowladda Galmudug, maamulka iyo hawlwadeennada Baarlamaanka iyo marti-sharaf kale. Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug, Xuseen Maxamed Nuur, ayaa u mahadceliyay guddoonkii hore ee Golaha, isaga oo ku ammaanay shaqadii iyo dadaalkii ay qabteen muddadii ay xilka hayeen. Waxa uu sidoo kale mahadnaq u jeediyay masuuliyiintii iyo marti-sharaftii ka soo qeyb gashay munaasabadda xil-wareejinta. Guddoomiyaha cusub ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadidda howlaha Golaha, xoojinta wada-shaqeynta iyo gudashada waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug. Xil-wareejintan ayaa timid kaddib markii la doortay guddoon cusub oo hoggaamin doona Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug, kaas oo mas’uul ka noqon doona hagidda howlaha sharci-dejinta iyo gudashada waajibaadka Golaha.

items.title: Hay’adaha amniga DF oo loo gudbiyay liiska daawooyin halis ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cali Xaaji Aadan oo manta hortegay xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka ee Baaramaanka Federaalka ayaa sheegay in hay’adaha amniga, gaar ahaan Nabadsugidda iyo Booliiska uu u gudbiyay liiska dawooyin halis ah oo si khaldan loogu adeegsado maandooriyaha. Dr Cali Xaaji Aadan ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in muhiimadda ay tahay in laga hortago dadka sida sharci-darrada ah u adeegsada iyo kuwa dalka soo geliya daawooyinka khatarta ah, isaga oo xusay in dawooyinkaas ay halis weyn ku yihiin caafimaadka iyo nolosha bulshada. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in tiro-koobyo caalami ah ay muujinayaan in sannad kasta ay boqolaal kun oo qof u dhintaan dawooyinka iyo maaddooyinka loo adeegsado maandooriyaha, isaga oo xusay in raggu ay yihiin qaybta ugu badan ee dadkaasi. “NISA iyo Booliiska waxaan u gudbiyay liiska dawooyinka maandooriyaha ee khatarta badan si ay u qabtaan. 600,000 oo qof, 400,000 oo ka mid ahna ay rag u badan yihiin, ayaa sannad kasta u dhinta dawooyinka daroogada ahaan loo isticmaalo,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Caafimaadka. Intaas kadib qaar kamid ah xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka ayaa arrintan su’aallo ka waydiiyay wasiirka, iyaga oo sheegay inay jiraan mas’uuliyiin ku lug leh maandooriyaha. “Jaad iyo Sigaar oo kaliya miyaad Maandooriye u taqaanaa wasiir? Daawooyinka dhacay ee Taariikhda laga bedalay ma ka warqabtaa”? ayay tiri Xildhibaan Gobsan Muxumed. Si kastaba, ha’ahaateen Soomaaliya ayaa ka mid ah dalalka laga isticmaalo dawooyinka qaarkood oo si khaldan loogu adeegsado maandooriyaha. Waxaa sidoo kale jiray kiisas ay dad dawooyinkaas si aan habboonayn u isticmaalay ay ku lug yeesheen falal dambiyeed kala duwan, kuwaas oo qaarkood ay maxkamadaha dalka, gaar ahaan Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, ay wax ka qabteen. Tallaabadan ayaa la xiriirta dadaallada lagu xakameynayo isticmaalka sharci-darrada ah ee dawooyinka khatarta badan, iyadoo loo baahan yahay iskaashi dhexmara hay’adaha caafimaadka, amniga iyo kuwa kale ee ay khusayso si looga hortago waxyeellada ay ku hayaan bulshada. items.title: Maxaa ka jira in ciidamo boolis ah ay gudaha u galeen xarumaha shirkadda Hormuud?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliska Qaybta Guud ee Booliska Gobolka Banaadir, oo uu hoggaamiyo Macallin Mahdi ayaa beeniyay warar saacadihii la soo dhaafay lagu faafiyay baraha bulshada, kuwaas oo sheegayay in ciidamo Boolis ah ay galeen xarumo ay shirkadda Hormuud ku leedahay magaalada Muqdisho, isla markaana ay ka sameeyeen baaritaanno. Booliska ayaa wararkaas ku tilmaamay kuwo aan waxba ka jirin, isla markaana ay yihiin kuwa been-abuur ah oo laga faafiyay ciidamada ammaanka. “Taliska Booliiska Gobolka Banaadir wuxuu caddeynayaa in warka lagu faafiyey baraha bulshada ee sheegaya in ciidamo ka tirsan Booliiska Gobalka banaadir ay galeen xarumaha Shirkadda Hormuud, isla markaana ay halkaas ka wadaan baaritaanno, uu yahay war been abuur ah oo aan sal iyo raad toona lahayn,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale, taliska ayaa digniin u diray dadka wararka been abuurka ah ku baahiya baraha bulshada, wuxuuna sheegay in lala xisaabtami doono cid kasta oo faafisa warar been abuur ah, si loogu marin habaabiyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed. “Taliska wuxuu uga digayaa warbaahinta iyo dadka isticmaala baraha bulshada faafinta wararka aan la xaqiijin, Wuxuuna caddeynayaa in cid kasta oo si ula kac ah u abuurta ama u faafisa warar been abuur noocan oo kale ah laga qaadi doono tallaabo sharci oo waafaqsan shuruucda dalka,” ayaa mar kale yiri qoraalka kasoo baxay Taliska Booliska Gobolka Banaadir. Waxaa kale oo uu bayaanka intaas kusii daray “Bulshada waxaa lagu boorrinayaa inay xogaha ka hubiyaan ilo rasmi ah, kana fogaadaan faafinta wararka marin-habaabinta ah”. War-saxaafadeedka Booliska ayaa yimid, kadib markii Axaddii si weyn baraha bulshada loogu faafiyay warar sheegaya in ciidamo Boolis ah oo wata amar maxkamadeed ay galeen xarunta shirkadda Hormuud ee ku taalla suuqa Bakaaraha iyo xarunta weyn ee maamulka shirkadda oo ku taalla waddada Airport-ka, halkaas oo la sheegay inay ka sameeyeen baaritaanno. Si kastaba, wararkan ayaa waxaa si cad u beeniyay Taliska Qaybta Guud ee Booliska Gobolka Banaadir, kaas oo meesha ka saaray sheegashada ah in ciidamadu ay howlgal baaritaan ah ka sameeyeen xarumaha qaar ee shirkadda Hormuud ku leedahay magaalada Muqdisho. Booliska ayaa wararkaas ku tilmaamay kuwo aan waxba ka jirin, isla markaana ay yihiin kuwa been-abuur ah oo laga faafiyay ciidamada ammaanka. “Taliska Booliiska Gobolka Banaadir wuxuu caddeynayaa in warka lagu faafiyey baraha bulshada ee sheegaya in ciidamo ka tirsan Booliiska Gobalka banaadir ay galeen xarumaha Shirkadda Hormuud, isla markaana ay halkaas ka wadaan baaritaanno, uu yahay war been abuur ah oo aan sal iyo raad toona lahayn,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale, taliska ayaa digniin u diray dadka wararka been abuurka ah ku baahiya baraha bulshada, wuxuuna sheegay in lala xisaabtami doono cid kasta oo faafisa warar been abuur ah, si loogu marin habaabiyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed. “Taliska wuxuu uga digayaa warbaahinta iyo dadka isticmaala baraha bulshada faafinta wararka aan la xaqiijin, Wuxuuna caddeynayaa in cid kasta oo si ula kac ah u abuurta ama u faafisa warar been abuur noocan oo kale ah laga qaadi doono tallaabo sharci oo waafaqsan shuruucda dalka,” ayaa mar kale yiri qoraalka kasoo baxay Taliska Booliska Gobolka Banaadir. Waxaa kale oo uu bayaanka intaas kusii daray “Bulshada waxaa lagu boorrinayaa inay xogaha ka hubiyaan ilo rasmi ah, kana fogaadaan faafinta wararka marin-habaabinta ah”. War-saxaafadeedka Booliska ayaa yimid, kadib markii Axaddii si weyn baraha bulshada loogu faafiyay warar sheegaya in ciidamo Boolis ah oo wata amar maxkamadeed ay galeen xarunta shirkadda Hormuud ee ku taalla suuqa Bakaaraha iyo xarunta weyn ee maamulka shirkadda oo ku taalla waddada Airport-ka, halkaas oo la sheegay inay ka sameeyeen baaritaanno. Si kastaba, wararkan ayaa waxaa si cad u beeniyay Taliska Qaybta Guud ee Booliska Gobolka Banaadir, kaas oo meesha ka saaray sheegashada ah in ciidamadu ay howlgal baaritaan ah ka sameeyeen xarumaha qaar ee shirkadda Hormuud ku leedahay magaalada Muqdisho. items.title: Netanyahu oo Puntland iyo Somaliland ku tilmaamay saxiibada Israel iyo Imaaraadka
items.description: Tel aviv (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu, ayaa soo bandhigay khariidad xasaasi ah oo ku saabsan amniga qaranka Israel, taas oo maamullada Puntland iyo Somaliland ku dartay dhulalka loo arko inay “saaxiib” la yihiin dalalka Israel iyo Imaaraadka Carabta. Khariidaddan oo kasoo muuqatay shaashad weyn oo taallay gadaasha Netanyahu xilli uu Axaddii jeedinayay khudbad ku saabsan khataraha amniga Israel, ayaa muujineysa isbeddellada iyo isbaheysiyada cusub ee ka abuurmaya Geeska Afrika iyo Bariga Dhexe. Sida ku cad sawir ay xaqiijisay xafiiska warfaafinta dowladda Israel, khariidadda ayaa dhulalka Somaliland iyo Puntland ku muujisay midab buluug khafiif ah, taas oo micnaheedu yahay in Israel iyo Imaaraadka ay u arkaan deegaanadaas kuwo saaxiib la ah. Waxaa sidoo kale safkaas ku jira Itoobiya. Dhanka kale, “Soomaaliya” iyo si gaar ah “Waqooyi Bari” ayaa lagu muujiyay cagaar khafiif ah, taas oo ka dhigan inay xulafo la yihiin isbaheysiga ay hoggaamiyaan Turkiga, Masar, Pakistan, iyo Sacuudiga (oo loo bixiyay Sunni Diamond). Khariidaddan ayaa asal ahaan laga soo xigtay cilmi-baarayaal lagu magacaabo Marc Saxer iyo Marcus Schneider, mana aha mid rasmi ahaan uga dhigan aqoonsi ay Israel siisay Puntland ama sameynta isbaheysi rasmi ah, balse waxay ka tarjumeysaa qiimeynta dhinacyada falanqeeya siyaasadda xulafada gobolka. Sidoo kale, khariidadda ayaa muujisay in Israa’iil ay u aragto in Waqooyi Bari aysan ka tirsaneyn Somaliland, sida ay sheegato Hargeysa, inkastoo Israa’iil aqoonsatay Somaliland. Isbaheysiyada cusub iyo qorshaha Netanyahu Intii uu socday kulanka, Netanyahu ayaa isbaheysiga ay hoggaamiso Iiraan iyo kan “Ikhwaanka” ee uu hoggaamiyo Turkiga ku tilmaamay caqabado iyo khataro weyn oo wajahaya gobolka. Wuxuu xusay in dowladdiisu ay muhiimadda koowaad siineyso ka hortagga khataraha soo ifbaxaya, isagoo yiri: “Sidoo kale, waxaa soo ifbaxay fursado lagu abuuri karo isbaheysiyo cusub oo gobolkeena ah iyo wixii ka baxsanba.” Netanyahu ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in Israel ay tahay inay ka faa’iideysato labada sano ee soo socota ee maamulka Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump si ay u ballaariso xulafadeeda, isagoo ka digay in maamullada mustaqbalka aysan taageero intaas le’eg siin doonin. Wuxuu sidoo kale rajo ka muujiyay inuusan isku dhac toos ah dhex marin Israel iyo Turkiga, balse wuxuu xusay in Israel ay qaaday tallaabooyin ay uga hortageyso ballaarinta joogitaanka milatari ee Ankara ee gudaha Suuriya. Xiisadda u dhaxeysa maamullada dalka iyo dowladda federaalka ayaa u muuqata mid salka la galeysa loollanka quwadaha shisheeye. Israel ayaa 26-kii December 2025 si rasmi ah u aqoonsatay Somaliland inay tahay dal madax-bannaan, tallaabadaas oo dowladda Soomaaliya ay si adag u diidday, kuna tilmaantay xadgudub qaawan oo ka dhan ah qaranimadeeda. Dhanka kale, xiriirka Puntland iyo Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa khilaaf xooggan dhex dhigay Garoowe iyo Muqdisho. Bishii Janaayo, Puntland ayaa diiday go’aankii dowladda federaalka ay ku burisay heshiisyadii lala galay Imaaraadka Carabta ee horumarinta dekedda Boosaaso iyo iskaashiga amniga, iyadoo Puntland ku tilmaantay go’aankaas mid “waxba kama jiraan ah.” Dhanka dowladda federaalka, Turkiga ayaa ka ciyaaraya door weyn oo isugu jira tababarida ciidamada iyo ballaarinta iskaashiga amniga badda. Heshiis difaac iyo dhaqaale oo 10 sano ah, oo la saxiixay 2024, ayaa qeyb ka ah taageerada Ankara ee lagu horumarinayo awoodaha badda Soomaaliya. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay falcelin adag oo kasoo yeertay Somaliland. Horraantii bishan, lataliyaha arrimaha dibadda ee madaxweynaha Somaliland, Maxamed Cismaan Fadal, ayaa u sheegay warbaahinta in Somaliland ay dooneyso in Israel ay ka caawiso hannaanka difaaca cirka. “Waxaan rabnaa in Israel ay naga taageerto ka hortagga Turkiga,” ayuu yiri Fadal. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa isna dhowaan si adag u sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan marnaba aqbali doonin joogitaan Israel “duruuf kasta oo jirta.” Khubarada siyaasadda ayaa ka digaya in dalka uu wajahayo xaalad halis ah. Aweis Ahmed, oo ah cilmi-baare ka tirsan hay’adda Chatham House, ayaa qormo uu daabacay ku sheegay in falgalka u dhexeeya loollanka shisheeye (sida Turkiga oo garab taagan Muqdisho iyo Imaaraadka oo xiriir la leh maamul goboleedyada) iyo khilaafaadka gudaha ee Soomaaliya, ay abuuri karaan “khatar weyn oo isku dhafan oo keeni karta dagaallo iyo isku-dhacyo cusub oo salka ku haya dano shisheeye.” The post Netanyahu oo Puntland iyo Somaliland ku tilmaamay saxiibada Israel iyo Imaaraadka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Ciraaq oo ka Wada hadlay Xoojinta Iskaashiga Dhaqaalaha iyo Beeraha
items.description: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali, ayaa magaalada Baqdaad kulan kula yeeshay dhiggiisa dalka Ciraaq, Fu’aad Xuseen, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo ballaarinta iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan. Kulanka ayaa ka dhacay magaalada Baqdaad, intii uu socday kalfadhiga 52-aad ee Golaha Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC), waxaana labada wasiir ay ka wada hadleen dardargelinta howlaha Guddiga Wadajirka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Ciraaq, si loo xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta labada dowladood. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa isla soo qaaday sidii loo ballaarin lahaa iskaashiga dhaqaalaha iyo beeraha, kuwaas oo loo arko dhinacyo fursado u abuuri kara horumarinta xiriirka ganacsi iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee labada waddan. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa kulanka ku muujisay rabitaankeeda ah inay bilowdo dhoofinta xoolaha nool ee loo iibgeeyo dalka Ciraaq, ayadoo tallaabadani ay qayb ka noqon karta dadaallada lagu ballaarinayo suuqyada caalamiga ah ee xoolaha Soomaaliyeed, inkasta oo aan faahfaahin laga bixin waqtiga la bilaabayo dhoofinta ama heshiisyada farsamo ee arrintaas la xiriira. Dhanka kale, dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa uga mahadcelisay dowladda Ciraaq soo dhoweynta diirran iyo martigelinta kulanka Golaha Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka. Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale xaqiijisay sida ay uga go’an tahay xoojinta xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga labada dal, iyadoo la doonayo in wada-shaqeynta Soomaaliya iyo Ciraaq ay ka gudubto xiriirka siyaasadeed, una gudubto iskaashi dhaqaale, ganacsi iyo mid wax-soo-saar leh.

items.title: Jaamac oo dalbaday in Kenya iyo AUSSOM lagula xisaabtamo xaaladda Koonfur Galbeed
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo ka qayb-galay kulan looga hadlay xaaladda adag ee Koonfur Galbeed ayaa Dowladda Federaalka ugu baaqay inay tallaabo ka qaaddo shaqsiyaadka uu sheegay inay ku lug leeyihiin falalka argagixisada, kuwaas oo uu xusay inay ku sugan yihiin magaalooyin ka tirsan dalka Kenya. Jaamac ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in dowladda looga baahan yahay inay ka jawaabto sababta shaqsiyaad ku jira liiska madow ee argagixisada ay weli ugu sugan yihiin meelo la yaqaan, gaar ahaan hoteello ku yaala magaalada caasimada ah ee Nairobi. Guddoomiyaha ayaa xukuumadda ka dalbaday inay ka jawaabto sababta aan tallaabo muuqata looga qaadin shaqsiyaad uu sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya liiska madow ee argagixisada ku dartay, balse weli ku sugan magaalooyin ka tirsan dalka Kenya, iyadoo la yaqaano goobaha uu deggan yihiin , ayna ilaaliyaan ciidamada amniga ee dalkaasi. “Suuragal ma’ahan in dal uu xiriir wanaagsan naga dhexeeyo, darisnimo naga dhexeyso dadka Soomaaliyeed dhiigooda nin daadinaayo uu dhex jiifo arrinkaasina waa arrin ugub ah oo waayahan dambe soo kordhay,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya. Sidoo kal, Guddoomiye Jaamac ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka looga baahan yahay inay la xisaabtanto ciidamada nabad ilaalinta ee ku sugan degmooyinka ay haatan qabsadeen ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ee isku fidinaya gobolka Baay. “Dowladda waxaan ka rabnaa meesha ay ciidamada nabad ilaalinta joogeen in lagula xisaabtamo waxa ay Khawaarij u joogto. Waxaana kaloo rabnaa in dowladda ay nooga soo jawaabto, gaar ahaan xukuumadda, in nin argagixiso ah oo dowladda Soomaaliyeed liiska madow ku dartay uu magaalooyinka qaarkood ee Kenya joogo, lana yaqaano goobaha ay deggan yihiin, isla markaana ay ilaaliyaan ciidamo amni ah oo dowladdaas leedahay. Maxay tahay sababta ilaa iyo hadda loo fiirsanayo oo dowladdu aysan u qaadin tallaabo muuqata?” ayuu mar kale yiri Jaamac. Waxaa kale uu intaas ku daray in aan la aqbali karin in deegaannada qaar ay sii joogaan Khawaarij, isla markana ay si deg-deg ah uga xoreyn doonaan guud ahaan Koonfur Galbeed. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo dhawaan ciidamada Itoobiya lagu eedeeyey in ay fududeeyeen qabsashadii degmooyinka Koonfur Galbeed, maadaama iyaga oo jooga ay maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo lagu tilmaamay Al-Shabaab ay qabsadeen magaalooyin ay kamid yihiin Buurhakaba, ardaale, Qansaxdheere iyo Diinsoor, taas oo bannaanka keentay inay ka gaabsadeen difaacidda amniga degmooyinka ay ka howlgaan. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Koonfur Galbeed ayaa waxaa xilligan ka jira iska horimaadyo u dhexeya ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa kale oo taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee maamulkaas, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen), waxaana xaaladda amni ee deegaanno ka tirsan gobollada Bay, Bakool iyo Shabeellaha Hoose ay tahay mid cakiran. The post Jaamac oo dalbaday in Kenya iyo AUSSOM lagula xisaabtamo xaaladda Koonfur Galbeed appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Guddoomiyaha ayaa xukuumadda ka dalbaday inay ka jawaabto sababta aan tallaabo muuqata looga qaadin shaqsiyaad uu sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya liiska madow ee argagixisada ku dartay, balse weli ku sugan magaalooyin ka tirsan dalka Kenya, iyadoo la yaqaano goobaha uu deggan yihiin , ayna ilaaliyaan ciidamada amniga ee dalkaasi. “Suuragal ma’ahan in dal uu xiriir wanaagsan naga dhexeeyo, darisnimo naga dhexeyso dadka Soomaaliyeed dhiigooda nin daadinaayo uu dhex jiifo arrinkaasina waa arrin ugub ah oo waayahan dambe soo kordhay,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya. Sidoo kal, Guddoomiye Jaamac ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka looga baahan yahay inay la xisaabtanto ciidamada nabad ilaalinta ee ku sugan degmooyinka ay haatan qabsadeen ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ee isku fidinaya gobolka Baay. “Dowladda waxaan ka rabnaa meesha ay ciidamada nabad ilaalinta joogeen in lagula xisaabtamo waxa ay Khawaarij u joogto. Waxaana kaloo rabnaa in dowladda ay nooga soo jawaabto, gaar ahaan xukuumadda, in nin argagixiso ah oo dowladda Soomaaliyeed liiska madow ku dartay uu magaalooyinka qaarkood ee Kenya joogo, lana yaqaano goobaha ay deggan yihiin, isla markaana ay ilaaliyaan ciidamo amni ah oo dowladdaas leedahay. Maxay tahay sababta ilaa iyo hadda loo fiirsanayo oo dowladdu aysan u qaadin tallaabo muuqata?” ayuu mar kale yiri Jaamac. Waxaa kale uu intaas ku daray in aan la aqbali karin in deegaannada qaar ay sii joogaan Khawaarij, isla markana ay si deg-deg ah uga xoreyn doonaan guud ahaan Koonfur Galbeed. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo dhawaan ciidamada Itoobiya lagu eedeeyey in ay fududeeyeen qabsashadii degmooyinka Koonfur Galbeed, maadaama iyaga oo jooga ay maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo lagu tilmaamay Al-Shabaab ay qabsadeen magaalooyin ay kamid yihiin Buurhakaba, ardaale, Qansaxdheere iyo Diinsoor, taas oo bannaanka keentay inay ka gaabsadeen difaacidda amniga degmooyinka ay ka howlgaan. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Koonfur Galbeed ayaa waxaa xilligan ka jira iska horimaadyo u dhexeya ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa kale oo taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee maamulkaas, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen), waxaana xaaladda amni ee deegaanno ka tirsan gobollada Bay, Bakool iyo Shabeellaha Hoose ay tahay mid cakiran. The post Jaamac oo dalbaday in Kenya iyo AUSSOM lagula xisaabtamo xaaladda Koonfur Galbeed appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Qoysas ku cusub xeryaha Dhadhaab oo wajahaya nolol xumo iyo gargaar la’aan
items.description: (ERGO) –  Ku dhawaad 250 qoys oo qaxooti cusub ah ayaa nolol xumo ku wajahaya xeryaha Dhadhaab, halkaas oo ay ku biireen saddexdii bil ee u danbaysay. Waxay isugu jiraan qoysas ka soo qaxay colaadda magaalada Baydhabo, iyo kuwo ay saamaysay dhul bannaynta dawladda Soomaaliya ay kawado Muqdisho Wax qaabilaad ah, dejin iyo gargaar ah kama helin xeryaha ay soo miciin bideen. Ma haystaan cuno, hoy, musqulo iyo adeegyo kale. Qaarkood ayaa dulsaar ku ah qoysas hore u degganaa oo iyaga laftooda ay noloshu adag tahay. Waxaa ka mid ah qoyska Nuurto Maxamed Cali oo dayac, gaajo iyo hubanti la’aan ku wajahaya xerada xeryaha Ifo-2 oo ay gaareen 20 Augusto. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inaysan helin wax kaalmo ah. “Ilamaha cunto yay u baahan yihiin, gogol ayay u baahan yihiin. Guri ma haysano. hadda ayaan soo degnay dadkii hore u deganaana waa reer tabareed, baahideena cuntada ayaa ugu horreysa.” Nuurto ayaa tilmaantay in carruurteeda oo toddobo ah ay habeennada qaar ku seexiso calool-marnaan marka ay doorasho kale waydo. Waxay tilmaamtay inay galeen nolol liidata oo aysan aqoon si ay u maarayso. Carruurteeda ayay sheegtay in uusan ku taageerin aabbahood oo ay kala tageen. Waxay intaas ku dartay inay ku hungowday filashadeedii xeryaha qaxootiga oo ahayd inay ka helayso nolol wanaagsan. “Meeshaan waxaan u soo doontay caawimaad iyo nolol, waxaa na loo sheegay in nala siin doonto kaar oo guryo nalo dhisayo oo ilmahu ay waxbasho free ah iskuul iyo dugsigaba ay helayaan. Kolay waa aduun in dhibaato la maro, laakiin marna kuma xisaabsamin laakiin dhibaatada aan dhex fadhino.” Nuurto ayaa tilmaantay nolol xumada ay u dheer tahay hoy xumo, taas oo culeysyada haysta ku sii kordhisay. Meel xerada ka baxsan ayay ka dhisatay buul aan awoodin inuu ka celiyo fallaaraha cadceeda oo kulkeeda uu gaaro 37 degree iyo roobabka dayrta. Qoyska Nuurto ayaa magaalada Baydhabo uga qaxay dagaalada noo noq-noqday oo dhex maray ciidamada dowladda iyo Koofurgalbeed oo isKu dhinac ah iyo ciidamo taageersan maamulkii hore. Waxay ahayd beeralay ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd tacabka beer labo higtar oo ay ka soo carartay. Dadka ku biiray xeryaha qaxootiga oo ay ku jiraan waayeelo, carruur iyo haween ayaa ka siman duruufaha. Xaawo Maxamed Cali oo ah hooyada 10 caruur ah cunno yari iyo qaalibaad la’aan ku haysataa xerada Ifo-2 oo ay soo gaareen kowdii Ogosto. Haweenaydan ayaa sheegtay markii ay xerada ka wayday kaarka raashinka gargaarka ah lagu qaato ay ku khasbanaatey in raadiso shaqo dhardhaqis oo aysan joogto u helin. Waxay xustay in dadka wax waydiisato oo kiilooyin raashin ah. “Xaaladaydu bariga dhexe waaye, ilmahayga aabohod waa cunyaan. Noloshu waa liidataa. Ilamahu waa ilmo yaryar wax nolol ah kuma haystaan meeshan. Meel aanaan aqoonin ayaanu nimid, waxbana ma haysano.” Xaawo oo ahayd qofka keliya ee qoyskeeda u dhaq-dhaqaaqa inta aysan soo qixin ayaa tilmaantay in xaaladda ay kala kulmeen xeryaha ay tahay mid marna aysan horay u suuraysan. Hadda wax shaqo ah ma hayso. Waxaa loo sheegay in heli doonaan gargaar iyo garab istaag, balse taa bedelkeeda waxay waysay soo dhawayn. Waxay sheegtay in xaaladda gaajada ah ee ay qoyskeedu ku sugan yahay ay ku hoggaamisay in ay dadka u dan-sheegato. “Ma haysano wax cuno ah meelahaa ayaan u gal-galaa oo dabka ugu shidaa. Walaahay muslim ka ayaan is dhex galaa. Caruurtu aniga ayay i sugaan, markii aan imaado ayaa dabka loo shidaa wakhti ka wakhti ayay wax cunaan.” Qoyska Xaawo ayaa kasoo qaxay degmada Hodon ee gobolka Banaadir markii guri labo qol, jiko iyo suuli ah ay degganaayeen ay dumisey dowladda Soomaaliya, markii loogu sheegay inuu yahay dhul dowladadeed. Xaawo ayaa xustay in inkasta oo aanay haysan sharci dhuleed haddana ay mudo 34 sano ah ku noolayd gurigaas la’aantiisa ay ku noolaan kari wayday magaalada nolosheeda oo qaali ah darteed. “Dhulka ayaa la idiin cabirayaa ayaa nala dhahay, guryihii ayaa nala ka dumiyay oo cagaf nala ka geliyay, dhulka waa la idiin soo celinayaa ayaan is lahayn kadib waxaa nala yiri dhulka waa abosiib iska taga.” Xaawo ayaa sheegtay in burburinta gurigeedii ay badday baro la’aan ku khasabtay in ay soo miciin biddo xeryaha Dhadhaab. Muqdisho waxay ku ahayd muruqmaal nolosheeda ka deberta hilib iyo qare ay ku iibin jirtay suuqyada Muqdisho. Duruufaha adag ee ay ku nool yihiin dadkii ugu dambeeyay waxaa lala wadaagay hay’adaha samafalka ee howlagala xeryaha, balse ma jirto jawaab ka timid sida uu Radio Ergo u sheegay gudoomiyaha xerada Xagardheer khaliif Dhuubow Jeelle. Gudoomiyaha ayaa sheegay inay qoysaskan ku sugan yihiin xaalad banii’adanimo oo ka sii daraysa marba marka ka danbaysa.  “Noloshoodu aad bay u liidataa. Kuwii ka sii horeeyay ayaa sii joogay oo wax waxtar ah oo wayn aan haysan. Markaa dadkaasi aad ayay u dhiban yihiin, cunno ma haystaan, biyo ma haystaan.” Qoysaskan cusub ee ku biiraya xeryaha qaxootiga ayaa kusoo aadan xilii dadkii horay ugu noolaa ay wajahayaan duruufo adag oo ka dhashay hoos u dhaca gargaarkii ay heli jireen oo yaraaday halka qoysaska qaar laga jaray. The post Qoysas ku cusub xeryaha Dhadhaab oo wajahaya nolol xumo iyo gargaar la’aan appeared first on Radio Ergo - Somali Humanitarian News and Information .

items.title: Xog: Golaha Mustaqbalka oo ku shiraya Nairobi, kadib tallaabadii Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Xubnaha Golaha Mustaqbalka oo ka kooban Madasha Samatabixinta Mucaaradka, Jubbaland iyo Puntland ayaa la filayaa in maalmaha socda ay isugu tegaan magaalada Nairobi ee caasimada dalka Kenya, halkaas oo ay ku yeelan doonaan shir xasaasi ah, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo wareedyo xilkas ah oo aad ugu dhow golaha. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, shirka ayaa waxaa diiradda lagu saari doonaa xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee siyaasadda dalka, gaar ahaan arrimaha kasoo kordhay doorashooyinka, maadaama uu Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka uu maalin kahor ku dhawaaqay jadwadalka doorashooyinka ee heer federaal, gaar ahaan doorashada labada Aqal iyo tan Madaxweynaha. Wararka ayaa intaas kusii daraya in xubnaha mucaaradka, iyo madaxda labada maamul ee Jubbaland iyo Puntland ay ka tashan doonaan tallaabada ay qaaday dowladda oo ay horay u qaadaceen dhinacyada, iyaga oo arrintaas ku tilmaamay tallaabo hal dhinac ah oo halis galineysa dalka. Qaar ka mid ah qodobada ugu muhiimsan ee shirka ayaa ah in madaxdu ay si gaar ah uga tashan doonaan fulinta ajendayaal horay ugu diyaarsanaa iyo kuwa kale oo ku aadan in go’aan mid ah ay ka qaataan tallaabada dowladda Soomaaliya ee ku aadan doorashooyinka. Sidoo kale, waxa ay kulamo kala duwan la yeelan doonaan wakiilada beesha caalamka oo ay kala hadlayaan xaaladaha soo kordhay, si xal loogu helo khilaafka daba dheeraaday ee dalka. Kooxaha mucaaradka ayaa horay u sheegay in dowladda aysan cidna kala tashan go’aannada ay qaadanayso, iyaga oo arrintaas ku tilmaamay mid aan horay uga dhicin xitaa dowladdii milatariga. “Talada dhaxda lama dhigaayo kaliya aniga halay dhageysto qofna lama tashanaayo oo hadana loo sacbiyo waa wax cajiib ah xitaa Dowladii malatariga ma sameyn arinkaas,” ayuu yiri Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed oo sabtidii Shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaalada Muqdisho. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu Jimcihii lasoo dhaafay beeniyay hadal-haynta la xiriirta in Dowladda Federaalka ay qorsheyneyso weerar ka dhan ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, isaga oo sheegay inaysan jirin cid ay doonayaan inay dagaal ku qaadaan. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed lagu xallin karo wada-hadal, isaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyay in albaabka wada-xaajoodku mar walba u furan yahay dhinacyada ay kala aragti duwanaanshuhu ka dhexeeyo. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Ciraaq oo ku heshiiyay hal arrin oo muhiim ah + Sawirro
items.description: Baghdad (Caasimada Online) – Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Ciraaq ayaa maanta ku heshiiyay arrim muhiim ah, kadib kulan labada geesood ah oo ay yeesheen wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda labada dal oo is arkay intii lagu guda jiray kulanka 52-aad ee wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC). Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) iyo dhiggiisa dalka Ciraaq Mudane Fu’aad Xuseen ayaa ka wada-hadlay dardargelinta hawlaha guddiga wadajirka ah ee labada dal, si loo ballaarinta iskaashiga dhinacyada dhaqaalaha iyo beeraha. Cabdisalaan oo kulanka ka hadlay muujiyay rabitaanka Soomaaliya ee ku aadan inay bilowdo dhoofinta xoolaha nool ee loo iibgeeyo gudaha dalka Ciraaq. Sidoo kale, wuxuu uga mahadceliyay dowladda Ciraaq soo dhoweynta diirran iyo martigelinta guuleysatay ee kulanka Golaha, isagoo mar kale carrabka ku adkeeyay sida ay uga go’an tahay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal. Dhankiisa, wasiirka arrimaha dibadda dowladda Ciraaq, Fu’aad Xuseen, ayaa ka hadlay sidii loo sii horumarin lahaa xiriirka labada dal, loona dardargelin lahaa wada-shaqeynta dhinacyada ay danaha wadajirka ah ka leeyihiin Soomaaliya iyo Ciraaq. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya iyo Ciraaq ayaa waxaa xilligan ka dhexeeya xiriir diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashi ku saleysan danaha labada dal, iyadoo dhinacyada ganacsiga, beeraha iyo dhaqaalaha ay ka mid yihiin meelaha ay ka jirto fursad lagu ballaarin karo wada-shaqeynta. Soomaaliya ayaa leh kheyraad badan oo xoolaha nool ah, kuwaas oo ka mid ah waxyaabaha ugu muhiimsan ee dalka u dhoofiyo suuqyada dibadda. Dhoofinta xoolaha nool ee loo iibgeeyo Ciraaq waxay noqon kartaa fursad lagu ballaarin karo suuqyada xoolaha Soomaaliyeed, haddii la dhameystiro heshiisyada ganacsi iyo shuruudaha caafimaadka xoolaha ee labada dal. Kulanka ay yeesheen labada wasiir ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka Islaamka, isla markaana ay ku raadineyso fursado cusub oo kor loogu qaadayo ganacsiga iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale. items.title: Masar oo oggolaatay inay Sacuudiga ka taageerto dagaalka ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta Yemen
items.description: Mas’uul sare oo dhanka amniga ah oo u dhashay Masar ayaa Axaddii ku dhawaaqay in dalkiisu oggolaaday inuu taageero Sacuudiga dagaalka uu kula jiro fallaagada Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen. Bayaan ka soo baxay Masar ayaa lagu sheegay in Golaha Difaaca Qaranka, oo uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Cabdel Fattax al-Sisi, uu oggolaaday in Sacuudiga la siiyo “dhammaan taageerada suurtagalka ah” si loo xaqiijiyo ammaankiisa. Inkasta oo bayaanku uusan faahfaahin dheeraad ah bixin, haddana al-Sisi ayaa Axaddii baarlamaanka ka codsaday inuu oggolaado in ciidamo iyo hub la geeyo goobaha dagaalka. Galabnimadii Axadda, waxaa la sheegay in wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Iran, Abbas Araghchi, iyo dhiggiisa Masar, Badr Abdellatif, ay khadka taleefanka kaga wada hadleen “arrimaha gobolka”. Sacuudiga ayaa taageero ka dalbanayay xulafadiisa, kaddib markii fallaagada Xuutiyiintu ay marar badan gantaallo iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku weerareen kaabayaasha shidaalka iyo garoomada diyaaradaha ee dalkaas. Sacuudiga ayaa sheegay inay ku adag tahay inuu soo rido gantaallada ay Xuutiyiintu soo ridaan, maadaama ay beddeli karaan jihada ay u socdaan xilliga la ridayo. Ilaa hadda, ugu yaraan 19 qof ayaa lagu dilay gudaha Sacuudiga oo keliya, halka kumannaan duulimaad la baajiyay. Axaddii, wasiirka gaashaandhigga Sacuudiga ayaa la kulmay madaxweynaha Imaaraadka Carabta, iyagoo ka wada hadlay sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga labada dal. Xiisadda u dhexeysa Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka ayaa sare u sii kacaysay sannadihii la soo dhaafay, maadaama ay taageeraan dhinacyo kala duwan oo ku dagaallamaya Yemen. Dagaalka u dhexeeya Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta ayaa sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac soo gaaray dad rayid ah oo labada dhinacba ku sugan. Garoonka diyaaradaha iyo qasriga ay isticmaasho dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay ayaa la weeraray toddobaadkii hore. Wasaaradda caafimaadka ee Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegtay in duqeyn cirka ah oo Axaddii ka dhacday magaalada Sacada ee ay fallaagadu maamusho ay ku dhinteen sagaal qof, oo ay ku jiraan carruur iyo haween.

items.title: Ruushka iyo Sacuudiga oo ka Digay Xiisadaha Ka Taagan Marinka Bab al-Mandab
items.description: Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee Ruushka iyo Sacuudi Carabiya, Sergey Lavrov iyo Amiir Faisal bin Farhan, ayaa walaac ka muujiyey xiisadaha sii kordhaya ee ka taagan koonfurta Jasiiradda Carabta iyo Marinka Bab al-Mandab, iyagoo ku baaqay in la ilaaliyo amniga maraakiibta iyo xorriyadda isu-socodka badda. Labada wasiir ayaa kulankooda ku yeeshay magaalada Manama ee caasimadda Baxrayn, Axaddii, iyagoo ka qaybgalayay kulanka sagaalaad ee wada-hadalka istaraatiijiyadeed ee u dhexeeya Ruushka iyo Golaha Iskaashiga Khaliijka (GCC). Sida lagu sheegay war ka soo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Ruushka, labada dhinac ayaa adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in maraakiibtu si ammaan ah oo aan carqalad lahayn uga gudbaan marin-biyoodka caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan Bab al-Mandab oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Marinka Bab al-Mandab ayaa muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamiga ah, maadaama maraakiibta xamuulka iyo kuwa shidaalka ay u adeegsadaan isu-socodka u dhexeeya Badweynta Hindiya, Badda Cas iyo kanaalka Suweys. Kulanka waxaa sidoo kale looga hadlay xoojinta xiriirka labada dal, iskaashiga ganacsiga, maalgashiga, dhaqanka iyo arrimaha bani’aadantinimada, ayadoo Labada wasiir ay sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyeen sii wadidda wada-shaqaynta ay ku leeyihiin ururka OPEC+, oo ay qayb ka yihiin dadaallada la xiriira suuqa shidaalka. Dhanka kale, Lavrov ayaa kulan gaar ah la yeeshay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Kuwait, Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, kaas oo ay kaga wada hadleen xaaladda amni ee Khaliijka iyo xiisadaha gobolka. Kulamadan ayaa imanaya xilli walaac laga muujinayo amniga marinnada badda ee gobolka iyo saamaynta ay xiisadaha ka jira Yemen iyo nawaaxigeeda ku yeelan karaan ganacsiga caalamiga ah.

items.title: Netanyahu oo Maamullada Puntland iyo Somaliland ku Daray Dalal uu ku Tilmaamay inay Israa’iil Muhiim u Yihiin
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Maamulka Israa’iil, Benjamin Netanyahu, ayaa soo bandhigay khariidad amni oo uu ku muujinayo isbahaysiyada iyo kooxaha uu u arko inay ku kala jiraan dhinacyada loollanka gobolka, iyadoo Puntland iyo Somaliland lagu daray qaybta khariidadda ee lagu tilmaamay inay saaxiib la yihiin Israa’iil iyo Imaaraadka Carabta. Khariidaddan ayaa la soo bandhigay xilli Netanyahu uu xoogga saarayo arrimaha amniga iyo xiriirrada gobolka, isaga oo ku guda jira ololaha doorashada Israa’iil ee la filayo inay dhacdo 27-ka Oktoobar 2026. Sida ay warbaahinta qaar werisay, khariidaddu waxay sidoo kale muujinaysaa isbahaysiyo kale oo ay ku jiraan dalal Sunni ah, sida Sacuudiga, Masar, Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Ku darista Puntland iyo Somaliland ee qaybtaas ayaa soo jiidatay dareenka la xiriira danaha amni iyo istaraatiijiyadeed ee Israa’iil iyo Imaaraadku ku leeyihiin gobolka Geeska Afrika, gaar ahaan xeebaha ku dhow Gacanka Cadmeed iyo marin-biyoodka Baabul-Mandab. Somaliland ayaa xiriirkeeda Israa’iil sii xoojisay kaddib markii Israa’iil ay aqoonsatay bishii Diseembar 2025, tallaabadaas oo ay dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya si adag uga hortimid, iyadoo ku tilmaantay mid ka hor imaanaysa madaxbannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Puntland, dhankeeda, waxay xiriirro amni iyo dhaqaale la leedahay Imaaraadka Carabta, oo ay ka mid yihiin iskaashiga dhinaca amniga badda iyo dekedda Boosaaso, hase yeeshee, in Puntland lagu daro qaybta khariidadda ee saaxiibbada Israa’iil ma aha wax fudud. Khariidadda ayaa muujinaysa sida Geeska Afrika uu muhiim ugu noqday loollanka amni ee gobolka, maadaama uu ku dhow yahay marinno muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidamada badda, ayadoo sidoo kale qeyb ka ah xad-gudubyada ay wadaan Imaaraadka iyo Israa’iil ee ka dhanka ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada Soomaaliya.

items.title: Mareykanka: $137 Milyan oo Lagu Bixiyey Xayeysiisyo Siyaasadeed oo AI loo Adeegsaday
items.description: In ka badan 137 milyan oo doollar ayaa lagu kharashgareeyay xayeysiisyada siyaasadeed ee adeegsada sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) intii lagu jiray ololaha doorashooyinka dhexe ee Mareykanka ee 2026, taasoo muujinaysa sida tiknoolajiyaddan ay ugu sii fideyso ololayaasha siyaasadeed iyo tartanka doorashada. Warbixin ay soo saartay hay’adda cilmi-baarista Wesleyan Media Project ayaa lagu sheegay in la aqoonsaday 220 xayeysiis siyaasadeed oo adeegsaday AI, kuwaas oo laga baahiyey 34 gobol oo Mareykanka ah. Xayeysiisyadaasi waxay ka koobnaayeen muuqaallo, sawirro iyo codad la sameeyay ama wax laga beddelay iyadoo la adeegsanayo tiknoolajiyadda sirdoonka macmalka ah. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale muujisay in xayeysiisyadaas intooda badan aan si cad loogu sheegin daawadayaasha in AI la adeegsaday, iyadoo boqolkiiba 27 oo keliya ay lahaayeen calaamad muujinaysa adeegsiga tiknoolajiyaddaas. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay walaac ku saabsan hufnaanta ololayaasha siyaasadeed iyo awoodda codbixiyeyaasha ay ku kala saari karaan muuqaallada dhabta ah iyo kuwa la farsameeyay. Marka la eego cidda maalgelisay xayeysiisyada, xogta warbixinta ayaa tilmaantay in musharraxiinta iyo kooxaha taageera Jamhuuriyiinta ay ku lug lahaayeen qaybta ugu badan ee xayeysiisyada AI lagu aqoonsaday. Waxaa la sheegay in kooxahaas ay maalgelinayeen 81 boqolkiiba xayeysiisyada la diiwaangeliyey, halka dhinaca Dimuqraaddiyiintu ay lahaayeen 12 boqolkiiba, inta soo hartayna ay ku jireen kooxo kale. Adeegsiga AI ee siyaasadda ayaa sii kordhinaya doodaha ku saabsan saameynta tiknoolajiyaddu ku yeelan karto doorashooyinka, gaar ahaan marka la sameeyo muuqaallo ama codad been-abuur ah oo u muuqda kuwo dhab ah.

Waxaa la sheegay in kooxahaas ay maalgelinayeen 81 boqolkiiba xayeysiisyada la diiwaangeliyey, halka dhinaca Dimuqraaddiyiintu ay lahaayeen 12 boqolkiiba, inta soo hartayna ay ku jireen kooxo kale. Adeegsiga AI ee siyaasadda ayaa sii kordhinaya doodaha ku saabsan saameynta tiknoolajiyaddu ku yeelan karto doorashooyinka, gaar ahaan marka la sameeyo muuqaallo ama codad been-abuur ah oo u muuqda kuwo dhab ah.

items.title: Kenya oo Xaqiijisay Kiiskii Sideedaad ee Ebola
items.description: Dowladda Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay kiis cusub oo cudurka Ebola ah, taasoo tirada guud ee dadka laga helay cudurka dalkaas ka dhigaysa siddeed qof, sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha caafimaadka ee dalkaasi. Kiiska ugu dambeeyay ayaa laga helay nin 49 jir ah oo ka shaqaynayay isbitaalka, kaas oo hawshiisu ahayd nadiifinta weelasha iyo gogosha bukaannada. Ninkan ayaa la sheegay inay suuragal tahay inuu cudurka ka qaaday xiriir uu la yeeshay bukaankii ugu horreeyay ee Ebola laga helay Kenya, kaas oo ku geeriyooday isbitaal ku yaalla Nairobi 5-tii Oktoobar 2026. Sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha caafimaadka, ninka cusub ayaa yeeshay qandho, madax-xanuun iyo murqo-xanuun. Waxaa la karantiilay, waxaana baaritaan lagu sameeyay oo xaqiijiyay inuu qabo cudurka. Kiisaskan ayaa la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka Ebola ee nooca Bundibugyo , kaas oo markii hore laga soo sheegay Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo, kaddibna kiis laga helay qof u safray Kenya isaga oo sii maray Uganda. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Kenya ayaa sheegtay in la aqoonsaday 130 qof oo xiriir la yeeshay bukaankii ugu horreeyay, iyadoo 128 ka mid ah lagu hayo karantiil ama kormeer caafimaad. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale xoojisay baaritaannada caafimaad ee garoomada diyaaradaha iyo xuduudaha dalka. Inkasta oo tirada kiisasku korortay, haddana saraakiisha caafimaadka ayaa sheegay in ilaa waqtigan aan la hayn caddeyn muujinaysa in cudurku si baahsan ugu dhex faafay bulshada. Ebola waa cudur halis ah oo ku gudba taabashada tooska ah ee dheecaannada qofka qaba ama walxaha uu cudurku ku wasakhoobay, waxaana hay’adaha caafimaadku ay dadka ku boorriyeen inay raacaan tilmaamaha ka hortagga cudurka, kana fogaadaan taabashada qof looga shakiyo inuu qabo Ebola iyaga oo aan haysan ilaalin caafimaad oo habboon.

items.title: Falalka Burcad-badeednimada oo Saameeyay Kalluumeysatada Deegaannada Puntland
items.description: Dib u soo cusboonaaday weerarrada burcad-badeedda xeebaha Soomaaliya ayaa saameyn weyn ku yeeshay nolosha kalluumeysatada iyo ganacsatada ku nool magaalada Bandar Bayla ee Puntland, halkaas oo tallaabooyinka amniga, xarig, iyo xayiraado kalluumeysi la kulmay. Warbixin ay baahisay Al Jazeera ayaa sheegtay in kalluumeysatada deegaanka ay wajahayaan dhaqaale-xumo sii kordheysa, kaddib markii ay yaraadeen kalluunka iyo aargoosatada, isla markaana maraakiib shisheeye oo si sharci-darro ah uga kalluumeysanaya biyaha Soomaaliya ay wiiqeen ilihii dhaqaale ee dadka ku tiirsan badda. Cabdifataax Maxamed, oo muddo 20 sano ah kalluumeysato ahaa, ayaa sheegay in wax-soo-saarka badda uu hoos u dhacay, taas oo ku adkeysay inuu qoyskiisa masruufo. Wuxuu xusay in kalluumeysatada maxalliga ahi aysan awood ahaan la tartami karin maraakiibta waaweyn ee shisheeye, asagoo sheegay in burburkii dowladdii dhexe ee Soomaaliya sanadkii 1991 uu wiiqay ilaalinta biyaha dalka, taas oo fursad u abuurtay kalluumeysi sharci-darro ah, halka qaar ka mid ah dadka deegaanka ay markii dambe ku biireen burcad-badeednimada. Dabayaaqadii bishii Agoosto, maamulka deegaanka ayaa kalluumeysatada ka mamnuucay inay badda galaan muddo laba bilood ah, kaddib walaac laga muujiyey in burcad-badeeddu ay iska dhigayaan kalluumeysato. Xayiraaddaasi waxay dhibaato ku noqotay qoysas badan oo noloshoodu ku tiirsan tahay wax-soo-saarka badda, waxayna Kalluumeysatadu sidoo kale sheegeen inay ka baqayaan in lagu tuhmo inay taageero siiyaan kooxaha burcad-badeedda ama ay ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ahi ku khaldaan burcad-badeed. Cabdirisaaq Saciid, oo muddo 15 sano ah ka shaqeynayey kalluumeysiga Bandar Bayla, ayaa sheegay in dad badan la xiray, qaarkoodna lagu eedeeyey inay raashin ama qaad gaarsiiyeen kooxaha burcad-badeedda. Ganacsiyada deegaanka ayaa sidoo kale looga digay inay wax ka iibiyaan kooxahaas, iyadoo dadka jebiya amarkaasi ay wajihi karaan tuhun amni, waxaana weerarrada burcad-badeeddu ay saameeyeen ganacsiga guud, ayadoo la sheegay in doomo badeecooyin ka keeni jiray Yemen ay joojiyeen safarradii ay ku imaan jireen xeebaha Soomaaliya. Jethro Norman, oo ah cilmi-baare sare oo ka tirsan Machadka Daraasaadka Caalamiga ah ee Denmark, ayaa sheegay in burcad-badeednimada aan loo arki karin oo keliya falal ka dhaca badda, balse ay ku tiirsanaan karto shabakado dhulka ka jira oo bixiya dhaqaale, qalab, shaqaale iyo ilaalin. Wuxuu xusay in xiriirrada qaraabada iyo bulshada ay mararka qaarkood fududeeyaan abaabulka kooxahaas, taas oo ka dhigaysa in la fahmo shabakadaha taageera ay muhiim u tahay la dagaallanka burcad-badeednimada. Inkasta oo xaaladdu adag tahay, haddana qaar ka mid ah dadka deegaanka ayaa isku dayaya inay dhallinyarada ka hor istaagaan ku biirista falalka burcad-badeednimada. Cabdifataax Maxamed ayaa sheegay in dhawaan dhallinyaro hubeysan ay damceen inay badda u baxaan, balse dadka deegaanka ay ku qanciyeen in falalkaasi ay dhaawacayaan bulshada oo dhan. Saraakiil ka tirsan maamulka deegaanka puntland oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa sheegay in xayiraadihii amniga laga qaaday 1-dii Oktoobar, kaddib howlgallo lagu sii daayey saddex markab oo la afduubtay. Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Badaha (IMO) ayaa 2-dii Oktoobar xaqiijisay in la sii daayey maraakiibta Honour 25, Seamull, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Sibu 1, iyo Eureka, waxayna warbixintu sheegtay in 44 shaqaale ah la sii daayey, halka shan shaqaale ah ay ku dhinteen hawlgalkii lagu soo furtay markabka Honour 25. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qaadista xayiraadaha ma aysan soo afjarin kormeerka amniga ee xeebaha Bandar Bayla, waxaana Saraakiishu ay sheegeen in diyaaradaha qumaatiga u kaca ee ciidamada badda Midowga Yurub ay si joogto ah uga kor duulaan magaalada iyo deegaannada xeebaha fog, iyagoo la socda dhaqdhaqaaqyada dadka hubeysan. Dib u soo laabashada burcad-badeednimada ayaa ku soo beegantay xilli ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ahi ay wajahaan caqabado amni oo ka jira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Kalluumeysatada deegaanka ayaa doonaya inay dib ugu laabtaan shaqadooda iyagoo aan ka baqayn xarig ama in lagu khaldo burcad-badeed, halka bulshada inteeda kalena ay wajahayso baahida loo qabo ilaalinta kheyraadka badda, sugidda amniga iyo dib u soo nooleynta ilaha dhaqaale ee xeebaha.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka iyo Hoggaamiyaha KGS oo Kulan la Yeeshay Xildhibaannada Labada Aqal ee laga soo doorto Koonfur Galbeed

Kulanka oo uu soo qabanqaabiyey Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda guud ee deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, arrimaha siyaasadeed iyo amni, iyo caqabadaha ay wajahayaan dadka ku nool deegaannada maamulkaas. Waxaa sidoo kale kulanka looga hadlay xaaladda amni ee deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, xilli ay jiraan dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan iyo xiisado siyaasadeed oo la xiriira maamulka gobolka. Xildhibaannada ka qaybgalay kulanka ayaa fursad u helay inay is-weydaarsadaan aragtiyo iyo xog ku saabsan xaaladda deegaannada ay metelaan. Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada wadatashiga iyo is-xogwareysiga ee u dhexeeya hoggaanka maamulka Koonfur Galbeed iyo xildhibaannada heer federaal, iyadoo muhiimad gaar ah la siinayo xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee deegaannada maamulkaas.

items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo la kulmay Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal ee laga soo doorto Koonfur Galbeed
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa xalay Magaalada Muqdisho kaga qaybgalay kulan casho sharaf iyo is xogwareysi ah, oo Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka, Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) uu u sameeyay Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal ee deegaan doorashadoodu tahay Koonfur Galbeed. Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa warsaxaafadeed ku sheegtay in kulanka looga hadlay xaaladda guud ee deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan arrimaha amniga, dagaalka ka dhanka ah maleeshiyada Al Shabaab iyo weeraro la sheegay inay maleeshiyada ku hayso deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed. Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa la sheegay inuu Xildhibaanada faahfaahin ka siiyay caqabadaha amni ee jira iyo dadaalada Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ugu jiraan sugidda amniga, xoreynta deegaanada ay kooxaha argagixisadu ku sugan yihiin iyo ilaalinta nafta iyo hantida dadka deegaanka. “Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ay door muuqda ka qaataan taageeridda dadaalada Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ee la xiriira amniga, nabadaynta, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo horumarinta deegaanada maamulka.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Warsaxaafadeedka ayaa lagu soo geba-gabeeyay “Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaalada lagu xoojinayo wadatashiga iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Hoggaanka Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed iyo Xildhibaanada ku metela Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, si loo mideeyo dadaalada lagu wajahayo caqabadaha jira, loona xaqiijiyo nabad, xasillooni iyo horumar waara oo ay ka faa’iideystaan shacabka Koonfur Galbeed.” Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed oo muddo isbuuc ah ku sugan Muqdisho ayaa ka wada kulamo uu taageero dheeraad ah ugu raadinayo maamulkiisa, si uu uga gudbo caqabadaha dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo amniga ee soo food saaray. Ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa wada guluf ay ku ballaarinayaan awooddooda militar, isla-markaana ay dhul uga qabsanayaan Maamulka Aadan Madoobe. Cabdicasiis Laftagareen ayaa riixaya kacdoon lagaga soo horjeedo Aadan Madoobe, isagoona doonaya in uu dib u soo ceshado xukunka iyo Hoggaanka Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed.

Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa la sheegay inuu Xildhibaanada faahfaahin ka siiyay caqabadaha amni ee jira iyo dadaalada Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ugu jiraan sugidda amniga, xoreynta deegaanada ay kooxaha argagixisadu ku sugan yihiin iyo ilaalinta nafta iyo hantida dadka deegaanka. “Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ay door muuqda ka qaataan taageeridda dadaalada Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ee la xiriira amniga, nabadaynta, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo horumarinta deegaanada maamulka.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Warsaxaafadeedka ayaa lagu soo geba-gabeeyay “Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaalada lagu xoojinayo wadatashiga iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Hoggaanka Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed iyo Xildhibaanada ku metela Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, si loo mideeyo dadaalada lagu wajahayo caqabadaha jira, loona xaqiijiyo nabad, xasillooni iyo horumar waara oo ay ka faa’iideystaan shacabka Koonfur Galbeed.” Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed oo muddo isbuuc ah ku sugan Muqdisho ayaa ka wada kulamo uu taageero dheeraad ah ugu raadinayo maamulkiisa, si uu uga gudbo caqabadaha dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo amniga ee soo food saaray. Ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa wada guluf ay ku ballaarinayaan awooddooda militar, isla-markaana ay dhul uga qabsanayaan Maamulka Aadan Madoobe. Cabdicasiis Laftagareen ayaa riixaya kacdoon lagaga soo horjeedo Aadan Madoobe, isagoona doonaya in uu dib u soo ceshado xukunka iyo Hoggaanka Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: Baarlamaanka Masar oo dood ka yeelanaya codsi ciidamo loogu dirayo Sacuudiga
items.description: Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Masar ayaa Isniintan guda gelaya wejiga 2aad ee doodda ay ka yeelanayaan codsi uga yimid Madaxweyne Abdel Fattah El Sisi, kaas oo ka codsaday in ay ansixiyaan ciidamo ay Qaahira u dirto Boqortooyada Sacuudiga. Madaxweynaha Masar ayaa Axaddii sheegay in Qaahira ay diyaar u tahay inay Sacuudiga siiso taageerada militari ay u baahan yihiin, si buu yiri ay u difaacdaan amnigooda iyo xasilloonidooda. Madaxweynaha ayaa Baarlamaanka ka codsaday kulan dedeg ah, oo lagu ansixinayo taageerada militari ee la siinayo Sacuudiga, si Ciidamada Masar ay gacan uga gaystaan difaaca xulafadooda. Gelinkii dambe ee Axaddii ayaa la filayay in Baarlamaanka uu cod u qaado soo jeedintaasi, inkastoo la qorsheeyay in dooddu ay sii socoto illaa maanta. Warbaahinta maxaliga ayaa ku warameysa in codaynta ay dib-u-dhici karto Talaadada, iyadoo dhammaan Xildhibaanada la siinayo fursad ay kaga doodaan go’aanka. Codsiga uu Madaxweynuhu u jeediyay Baarlamaanka ayaa yimid, ka dib markii uu shir guddoomiyay Shirka Amniga Qaranka ee Masar, ayna ka qaybgaleen Gudoomiyaha Baarlamaanka, Raysal Wasaaraha iyo Taliyaha Ciidamada Qalabka Sida. Jamhuuriyadda Carbeed ee Masar ayaa ah mid ka mid ah dalalka ugu waaweyn ee dunida Carabta. Taageero kasta oo militari oo Qaahira ay siiso Riyadh ayaa noqon karta kor u kac weyn uu ku yimaada dagaalka Bariga Dhexe, xilli ay weli taagan tahay xiisadda u dhexeyso Mareykanka iyo Iran ee ka dhalatay duulaankii wadajirka ahaa ee Mareykanka iyo Israel ay dhammaadkii bishii February ku qaadeen dalkaasi, kaas oo halis geliyay sahayda tamarta adduunka, isla-markaana sababay sicir barar dunida oo dhan ah. Sacuudiga oo taageeraya Dowladda Yemen ee caalamka uu aqoonsan yahay ayaa weerar ku haya Xuutiyiinta, laakiin falcelinta ka imaaneysa Xuutiyiinta ayaa si ba’an u dhaawaceysa dhaqaalaha boqortooyada. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta oo adeegsanaya gantaalada ballaastikada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee drones-ka ayaa beegsanaya kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah ee boqortooyada, oo ay ku jiraan xarumaha saliidda, garoomada diyaaradaha iyo bartilmaameedyada militari ee ku yaala dalkaasi. Dhaxal-sugaha Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, Mohammed bin Salman oo wajahaya mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinkii ugu weynaa ee dhanka ammaanka ayaa raadinaya xulafo caalami ah iyo kuwa gobolka ah, si ay Riyadh ula tacaasho weerarada gantaalada iyo drones-ka ay Xuutiyiinta ku qaadayaan gudaha Sacuudiga.

items.title: Farmaajo warns Somalia is sliding towards confrontation, accuses Hassan Sheikh of abandoning dialogue
items.description: MOGADISHU (WDN) — Former Somali President Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed Farmaajo has issued a stark warning over the country’s escalating political crisis, accusing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of undermining negotiations, pursuing a disputed electoral process and risking a dangerous confrontation over the nation’s political future. In a strongly worded statement, Farmaajo said the president’s recent remarks revealed what he described as an ambition to cling to power and inflame civil conflict. His accusations reflect the deepening divide between the Federal Government and opposition leaders over elections and proposed constitutional changes. Farmaajo also accused Hassan Sheikh of abandoning internationally facilitated negotiations intended to resolve the dispute over the electoral process. The talks had sought to bring the government and opposition together around an agreed framework for the next federal elections. He argued that the president’s withdrawal from the negotiations demonstrated an unwillingness to pursue genuine consultation or an inclusive political settlement. “For a president whose term has expired to withdraw from the negotiations facilitated by the international community, and to abandon the understanding that no federal election should be held without agreement, demonstrates that he is not prepared for consultation or an inclusive process,” Farmaajo said. He added that, in his view, the objective was to prolong the president’s tenure and implement an electoral process whose outcome he could control. Appeal to international partners Farmaajo directed a pointed appeal to international partners supporting Somalia, urging them not to be persuaded by further calls for dialogue from Hassan Sheikh. He argued that declarations in favour of negotiations would mean little without a genuine commitment to reaching an inclusive and transparent electoral agreement. “We call on Somalia’s international partners, who have been working to resolve the electoral dispute, not to be misled again by calls for agreement and dialogue from a president whose term has expired, because there is no genuine goodwill or willingness on his part to deliver a transparent and inclusive election,” Farmaajo said. The former president’s remarks underline the opposition’s growing distrust of the administration and its handling of the political transition. At the heart of the dispute is whether the next elections will proceed under arrangements agreed by the principal political stakeholders or through a timetable announced by the Federal Government despite continuing objections. Election timetable deepens the divide The statement follows the announcement by the National Independent Electoral Commission of a timetable for elections to both houses of the Federal Parliament and the presidency. Opposition politicians have firmly rejected the proposed schedule, intensifying an already bitter political confrontation. The dispute extends beyond election dates. It concerns the rules governing the transition, constitutional changes and the extent to which federal member states and opposition groups will participate in decisions affecting the country’s political future. Somalia’s recent history offers painful reminders of the consequences when political disputes overwhelm dialogue and institutions. Although Farmaajo’s allegations remain his political assessment, the continuing breakdown in trust between the government and its opponents raises legitimate concerns about the prospects for a peaceful and broadly accepted transition. The president and his administration face mounting pressure to demonstrate that the electoral process can command confidence beyond their own political camp. Opposition leaders, meanwhile, face the challenge of turning their objections into a viable negotiating position that can prevent further escalation. The central question is whether Somalia’s leaders can return to meaningful negotiations before the electoral dispute hardens into a deeper national crisis. Without an agreement accepted by the principal stakeholders, the election timetable risks becoming another source of division rather than a pathway towards political stability. Farmaajo’s statement represents the opposition’s perspective on the crisis. The president’s response and the positions of other political stakeholders remain essential to understanding whether a negotiated settlement is still possible.
