items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo beeniyay warar laga faafiyey xarunta TURKSOM ee Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa beeniyay in xarunta TURKSOM ee Muqdisho ay tahay saldhig ciidan oo ay Turkigu leeyihiin, isaga oo ku tilmaamay sheegashadaas “dacaayad aan sal lahayn”. Madaxweynaha oo wareysi siiyay Al Jazeera ayaa sheegay in TURKSOM ay tahay xarun loogu talagalay tababarka ciidamada Soomaaliya, isla markaana aanu jirin saldhig militari oo Turkigu halkaas ka leeyahay. “Waxaa jira xarun tababar. Goobtaas waa xarun tababar, laakiin ma joogaan ciidamo Turkish ah,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. “Dacaayadda la faafiyay waxay leedahay waxaa halkaas ku yaalla saldhig, oo ah saldhiggii ugu horreeyay ee Turkigu ku yeesho dibadda. Taasi run ma aha.” TURKSOM waxaa Muqdisho laga furay sanadkii 2017, waxaana tan iyo markaas lagu tababaray kumannaan askari iyo saraakiil Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ku jiraan ciidamada kumaandooska Gorgor. Inkasta oo warbaahinta caalamka iyo qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha ay xarunta ku tilmaamaan saldhig militari oo Turkish ah, dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga waxay inta badan ugu yeeraan xarun ama akademi tababar ciidan. Turkiga ayaa haddana Soomaaliya ku leh saraakiil iyo ciidan ka shaqeeya tababar, la-talin iyo taageero dhinaca amniga ah. Dowladda Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale horay u sheegtay in ay Soomaaliya ku leedahay “joogitaan militari iyo hawlo tababar”, kuwaas oo ay ku taageerto dib-u-dhiska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo dagaalka lagula jiro kooxaha argagixisada. Xarunta TURKSOM ee Muqdisho TURKSOM ayaa noqotay mid ka mid ah xarumaha ugu muhiimsan ee lagu tababaro ciidamada Soomaaliya tan iyo markii la furay bishii September 2017. Xarunta ayaa markii la furayay lagu tilmaamay akademiga tababarka militariga ee ugu weyn ee Turkigu ku leeyahay dibadda, iyadoo awood u leh in hal mar lagu tababaro in ka badan 1,500 oo askari. Ciidamo badan oo Soomaaliyeed ayaa halkaas iyo gudaha Turkiga ku qaatay tababaro kala duwan. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa bishii Luulyo ka qeyb galay munaasabad tababar loogu soo xirayay saraakiil iyo saraakiil-xigeenno ka qalin-jabiyay TURKSOM, isaga oo ku tilmaamay kuwa mustaqbalka hoggaamin doona Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Bishii September, wasiirka gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa qaabilay wafdi militari oo Turki ah oo uu hoggaaminayay Major General Sabahattin Kalkan, oo dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku sheegtay taliyaha Akademiga Tababarka Militariga TURKSOM. Wafdigaas waxaa ka mid ahaa saraakiisha dhinacyada ciidanka dhulka, badda iyo cirka ee Turkiga, waxaana kulankooda diiradda lagu saaray tababarka iyo xoojinta awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliya. Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan ayaa isaguna horay xarunta ugu tilmaamay “xarunta tababarka militariga TURKSOM”. Joogitaanka militari ee Turkiga Inkasta oo Xasan Sheekh uu diiday in TURKSOM loo aqoonsado saldhig ciidan oo Turki ah, haddana doorka militari ee Ankara ee Soomaaliya kuma koobna oo keliya xaruntaas. Baarlamaanka Turkiga ayaa bishii Luulyo kordhiyay joogitaanka ciidamada Turkiga ee Soomaaliya muddo laba sano ah, taas oo ka dhigaysa in ay sii joogaan ilaa Luulyo 2028. Oggolaanshahaas ayaa siinaya ciidamada Turkiga awood ay ku taageeraan Soomaaliya dhinacyada la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo khataraha kale ee amniga. Waxa kale oo uu daboolayaa taageerada la xiriirta burcad-badeedda, kalluumeysiga sharci-darrada ah, tahriibka iyo ilaalinta biyaha Soomaaliya. Madaxweynaha Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale awood u leh inuu go’aamiyo tirada, goobta iyo baaxadda ciidamada Turkiga ee la geeyo Soomaaliya. Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa sanadkii 2024 kala saxiixday heshiis iskaashi difaac iyo dhaqaale oo soconaya 10 sano, kaas oo Ankara siinaya door weyn oo ku saabsan dhismaha awoodda ciidamada badda Soomaaliya iyo ilaalinta xeebaha dalka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa hadalka TURKSOM ku daray isaga oo sharaxayay xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, kaas oo uu ku tilmaamay mid “aad u istiraatiiji ah”. Waxa uu xiriirka labada dal dib ugu celiyay booqashadii Erdogan uu Muqdisho ku yimid sanadkii 2011, xilli dalka ay ka jirtay abaar daran iyo xaalad amni oo aad u liidatay. Booqashadaas kadib, Turkiga ayaa si weyn ugu lug yeeshay Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada caafimaadka, waxbarashada, kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha iyo amniga. “Turkigu wuxuu yimid oo maalgeliyay garoonka Muqdisho iyo dekedda Muqdisho, haddana wuxuu galay shidaalka iyo gaaska markii ugu horreysay taariikhdeena,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Turkiga ayaa maanta ka mid ah dalalka ugu dhow Soomaaliya dhinaca amniga, waxaana uu tababaraa ciidamo Soomaaliyeed, siiyaa qalab militari iyo la-talin, halka iskaashiga labada dal uu ku fiday dhinacyada badda, tamarta iyo shidaal baarista. Xasan Sheekh ma uusan diidin in ciidamo iyo saraakiil Turki ah ay Soomaaliya joogaan iyadoo ay jiraan heshiisyo rasmi ah oo labada dowladood u dhexeeya. Hase yeeshee, waxa uu si gaar ah u diiday in xarunta TURKSOM lafteeda lagu tilmaamo saldhig militari oo Turkigu leeyahay, isaga oo ku adkeystay in shaqadeedu tahay tababarka ciidamada Soomaaliya. items.title: Dibadbaxyo ay dhallinyaradu hoggaaminayaan oo ka socda dalal Yurub ah, iyagoo ka cabanaya in mustaqbalkooda la dayacay
items.description: Dibadbaxyo ay hoggaaminayaan dhallinyaro iyo arday ayaa ka socda dalalka Faransiiska, Talyaaniga, Belgium iyo Albania, kuwaas oo muujinaya cabasho sii xoogaysanaysa oo la xiriirta mustaqbalka jiilka cusub iyo dareenkooda ah in aan si ku filan loo tixgelin danahooda. Falanqeeyaha siyaasadda Alberto Alemanno, oo la hadlay warbaahinta, ayaa sheegay in dibadbaxyadani ay ka tarjumayaan waxa uu ku tilmaamay “sheegashada jiil” (generational claim), taas oo ah dalab ay dhallinyaradu ku doonayaan in la maqlo codkooda, lana tixgeliyo baahiyahooda iyo mustaqbalkooda marka la gaarayo go’aannada siyaasadeed. Sida uu Alemanno sheegay, ardayda ka qaybqaadanaysa dibadbaxyadan waxay dareemayaan in mustaqbalkooda aan mudnaan ku filan la siin, taas oo ku riixaysa inay si wadajir ah u muujiyaan walaacooda iyo dalabkooda ku aaddan jihada ay u socdaan bulshooyinkooda. Dhaqdhaqaaqyadan ayaa muujinaya doorka sii kordhaya ee dhallinyaradu ku leeyihiin muujinta aragtidooda siyaasadeed iyo ka qaybgalka doodaha saameeya noloshooda. Inkasta oo dibadbaxyadu ka dhacayaan dalal kala duwan, hadalka Alemanno wuxuu tilmaamayaa in ay wadaagaan dareen guud oo ah in jiilka cusub uusan ku qanacsanayn sida loo tixgelinayo danahooda mustaqbalka. Dhallinyarada iyo ardaydu waxay ka mid yihiin qaybaha bulshada ee sida tooska ah u dareema saameynta go’aannada la xiriira waxbarashada, shaqo-abuurka iyo fursadaha nololeed.

items.title: New York Post oo Bannaanka Soo Dhigey Fadeexad ka Dhan Labo Hay’adood oo Mareykan ah oo 62 Milyan oo Dollar ku Qaatay Magaca Qaxootiga Soomaalida
items.description: Wargeyska Mareykanka ee New York Post ayaa warbixin uu daabacay ku sheegay in laba hay’adood oo samafal oo kaniisadeed ay heleen in ka badan 62 milyan oo dollar oo la xiriira barnaamijyada dib-u-dejinta qaxootiga iyo taageerada bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee gobolka Minnesota, isaga oo arrintan ku xiray isbeddelka bulsho ee gobolka iyo doodaha ka dhashay fadeexadaha musuqmaasuqa ee la xiriira barnaamijyada gargaarka bulshada. Warbixinta ayaa sheegtay in hay’adaha Catholic Charities iyo Lutheran Social Services ay muddo dheer door muhiim ah ku lahaayeen dib-u-dejinta qaxootiga ee Minnesota, iyagoo ka faa’iideysanayay qandaraasyo ay la galeen dowladda federaalka Mareykanka. Sida uu qoray wargeysku, labada hay’adood ayaa ka mid ahaa hay’adihii hormuudka u ahaa soo dhaweynta iyo dejinta qaxootiga kala duwan ee gobolka, taas oo qayb ka ahayd isbeddelka tirada iyo qaab-dhismeedka bulshada Minnesota. Taariikhda dib-u-dejinta qaxootiga ee gobolka ayaa dib ugu laabanaysa sannadihii ka dambeeyay dagaalkii Vietnam, xilligaas oo Minnesota ay noqotay meel muhiim ah oo lagu soo dhaweeyo qaxootiga ka soo cararay Koonfur-bari Aasiya, gaar ahaan bulshada Hmong ee ka timid dalka Laos. Warbixintu waxay xustay in madaxweyne-ku-xigeenkii hore ee Mareykanka Walter Mondale iyo guddoomiyihii Minnesota ee xilligaas, Al Quie, ay taageereen dadaallada dib-u-dejinta bulshadaas, iyadoo qoysaskii ugu horreeyay ee Hmong ay gobolka yimaadeen sannadkii 1975-kii. Muddo ka dib, hay’adaha samafalka ee kaniisadaha ayaa sii ballaariyay howlahooda, iyagoo door ku yeeshay dib-u-dejinta qaxootiga ka soo cararay colaadaha ka dhacay dalal kala duwan. Markii Soomaaliya ay gashay dagaalladii sokeeye ee billowday horraantii sagaashamaadkii, nidaamkii dib-u-dejinta qaxootiga ee Minnesota ayaa durba shaqeynayay, taas oo gobolka ka dhigtay meel ay yimaadaan qaxooti Soomaaliyeed oo badan. Sida ay sheegtay New York Post , labada hay’adood ayaa tan iyo sannadkii 1993-kii Minnesota dib u dejiyay ku dhowaad 29,000 oo Soomaali ah, iyagoo helayay lacag loogu talagalay kharashaadka bilowga ah ee hoyga, cuntada iyo adeegyada bulshada. Wargeysku wuxuu intaas ku daray in tirada Soomaalida ku nool gobolka ay maanta dhaaftay 100,000 oo qof, iyadoo kororka bulshada lala xiriiriyay dib-u-dejintii qaxootiga, isu-keenista qoysaska iyo dadka Soomaaliyeed ee gobollo kale oo Mareykanka ka soo guuray. Magaalada Minneapolis ayaa noqotay xarun weyn oo ay ku nool yihiin Soomaalida Mareykanka, kuwaas oo ka dhex muuqda ganacsiga, waxbarashada, siyaasadda iyo qaybaha kale ee nolosha bulshada. kororka bulshada Soomaaliyeed iyo doorka ay ku leedahay siyaasadda gobolka ayaa sidoo kale noqday mawduuc ay ka taagan yihiin dooddo la xiriira socdaalka, adeegyada dowladda iyo kharashaadka lagu bixiyo barnaamijyada bulshada. Wargeysku wuxuu soo xigtay Parker Thayer, oo lagu tilmaamay khabiir ku takhasusay arrimaha socdaalka, kaas oo sheegay in barnaamijyada dib-u-dejinta qaxootiga ee Minneapolis ay ku baxaan lacago badan oo dowladda laga helo. Thayer ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Shirweynaha Hoggaamiyeyaasha Kaniisadaha Katooliga ee Mareykanka, oo xiriir la leh adeegyada Catholic Charities, uu tan iyo sannadkii 2021 helay qandaraasyo federaal ah oo dib-u-dejinta qaxootiga la xiriira, kuwaas oo gaaraya 140 milyan oo dollar. Warbixinta ayaa intaas ku dartay in maalgelinta dowladda ee hay’adaha dib-u-dejinta ay dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan sida lacagahaas loo maareeyo iyo saameynta ay ku yeelan karaan awoodda hay’adaha samafalka ee ay deeqo uga ururiyaan shakhsiyaadka iyo ururrada gaarka loo leeyahay. Arrintan ayaa si gaar ah u soo shaacbaxday kaddib fadeexado waaweyn oo la xiriira barnaamijyada gargaarka bulshada ee Minnesota, kuwaas oo ay baarayaan hay’adaha sharciga ee Mareykanka. New York Post ayaa sheegtay in eedeymaha qaarkood ay la xiriiraan lacag gaareysa 9 bilyan oo dollar, hase yeeshee qiyaastaas waxay u baahan tahay in lala barbar dhigo xogta rasmiga ah ee baaritaannada iyo kiisaska maxkamadaha, si loo caddeeyo inta la xaqiijiyay iyo inta weli ah eedeyn ama qiyaas. Fadeexadahaas ayaa saameeyay sumcadda barnaamijyada gargaarka bulshada ee gobolka, waxaana doodda lagu soo daray xubno ka tirsan bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Si kastaba, eedeymaha loo jeediyo shaqsiyaad ama shirkado gaar ah ma aha kuwo lagu wada xiriirin karo dhammaan Soomaalida ku nool Minnesota, kuwaas oo intooda badan aan wax lug ah ku lahayn kiisaska la baarayo. Dhanka kale, afhayeen u hadlay Catholic Charities ee aagga Twin Cities ayaa wargeyska u sheegay in hay’addu ay joojisay barnaamijyadeeda la xiriira qaxootiga iyo muhaajiriinta sannadkii 2018-kii, halka Lutheran Social Services ee Minnesota aysan ka jawaabin codsigii wargeyska ee ahaa inay arrintan faallo ka bixiso. Warbixinta New York Post waxay dib u soo nooleysay doodda ku saabsan siyaasadda Mareykanka ee dib-u-dejinta qaxootiga, maalgelinta dowladda, isla xisaabtanka hay’adaha samafalka iyo saameynta eedeymaha musuqmaasuqu ku yeelan karaan bulshooyinka muhaajiriinta ah.

items.title: Badmaax Hindi ah oo Afar Sano Afduub loogu Haystay Soomaaliya oo ka Sheekeeyay Dhibaatadii uu la Kulmay
items.description: Aman Kumar Sharma, oo ahaa badmaax u dhashay dalka Hindiya, ayaa ka sheekeeyay duruufihii adkayd ee uu soo maray kaddib markii uu muddo 43 bilood ah ku jiray gacanta burcad-badeed Soomaali ah, kuwaas oo afduubtay markabkii uu ka shaqeynayay sannadkii 2010-kii. Sida uu sheegay wuxuu ka badbaaday jirdil, lix bilood oo lagu hayay kaymaha Soomaaliya iyo degitaanka markabkii uu saarnaa, ka hor inta uusan qorshe baxsad ah ku helin xorriyaddiisa. Aman Kumar Sharma ayaa dalka Hindiya dib ugu laabtay 9-kii Juun 2014, kaddib ku dhowaad afar sano oo uu ku jiray xaalado adag oo ay ka mid ahaayeen afduub, jirdil iyo cabsi joogto ah. Sharma, oo ka soo jeeda gobolka Himachal Pradesh, ayaa markii uu 19 jirka ahaa sannadkii 2010-kii markii ugu horreysay shaqo badeed u baxay, isaga oo ku biiray markabka MV Albedo oo uu ka raacay dekedda Jebel Ali ee magaalada Dubai. Markabka oo ay saarnaayeen shaqaale u kala dhashay Hindiya, Pakistan, Sri Lanka iyo Masar ayaa la afduubtay 26-kii Nofeembar 2010, xilli uu marayay Badweynta Hindiya, meel qiyaastii 200 mayl-badeed u jirta jasiiradaha Maldives. Sharma ayaa sheegay in shaqaaluhu ay arkeen doon dheereysa oo ay saarnaayeen burcad-badeed hubeysan, kuwaas oo muddo kooban gudaheed ku qabsaday markabka, inkasta oo shaqaaluhu isku dayeen inay albaabbada xiraan oo ay gabaad ka dhigtaan meel loogu talagalay xaaladaha degdegga ah. Burcad-badeeddu markii ay gudaha u galeen markabka ayay qabteen kabtankii iyo saraakiil kale, iyaga oo jirdil u adeegsaday sidii ay shaqaalaha kale ugu qasbi lahaayeen inay is dhiibaan. Markabka ayaa markii dambe loo weeciyay xeebaha Soomaaliya, waxaana lagu xiray meel u dhow Xarardheere oo xilligaas ka mid ahayd goobaha ay burcad-badeeddu ku haysteen maraakiibta ay afduubtaan. Markii markabka la geeyay xeebaha Soomaaliya, kooxo kale ayaa ku biiray afduubayaashii, waxaana la bilaabay wada-hadallo madax-furasho ah oo lala xiriiriyay milkiilaha markabka. Burcad-badeeddu waxay dalbadeen lacag dhan 20 milyan oo doollar, iyadoo shaqaalihii la haystay ay noqdeen kuwa lagu cadaadiyo in lacagtaas la bixiyo. Sharma ayaa sheegay in jirdilka shaqaalaha uu sii kordhay, qaarna lagu khasbay inay saacado badan bannaanka jiifaan, halka shaqaale kale la dhaawacay, qaarna laga jaray faraha. Xaaladda ayaa sii xumaatay markii burcad-badeeddu dileen Raju Rajvar, oo ahaa shaqaalihii kale ee Hindiya u dhashay, isla markaana saaxiib dhow la ahaa Sharma. Rajvar ayaa la toogtay kaddib markii burcad-badeeddu ku hanjabeen inay dilayaan qaar ka mid ah shaqaalaha, waxaana sharma uu sheegay in markii uu arkay saaxiibkiis oo la dilay ay afduubayaashu isaga ugu hanjabeen in uu noqon doono qofka xiga ee la dilo, taas oo ku abuurtay cabsi iyo rajo-beel. Dhanka kale, qoyska Sharma ayaa dadaal weyn u galay sidii loo heli lahaa lacag madax-furasho ah, ayadoo waalidkiis iyo walaashiis ay kaalmo ka raadiyeen hay’ado samafal, dad ay qaraabo yihiin iyo dad xiriir la lahaa warshadaha maraakiibta. Dadaalladaas waxaa qayb ka ahaa hay’ado u dooda badqabka shaqaalaha badda, balse wada-hadallada madax-furashada ayaa dhowr jeer fashilmay, iyadoo ay jireen khilaafaad u dhexeeyay dhinacyadii ku lugta lahaa heshiisyada lacag-bixinta. Markii toddoba shaqaale oo u dhashay Pakistan la sii daayay kaddib markii la bixiyay lacag madax-furasho ah, Sharma iyo shaqaalihii kale waxaa loo kaxeeyay kaymo ku dhow Xarardheere, halkaas oo ay ku jireen muddo lix bilood ah. Wuxuu sheegay in nolosha kaymaha ay ahayd mid aad u adag, maadaama ay ku seexan jireen geedaha hoostooda, ay xanuunsan jireen, isla markaana ay heli jireen biyo kooban oo qiyaastii laba litir maalintii ah. Sannadkii 2013-kii ayaa shaqaalihii dib loogu celiyay markabka MV Albedo, kaddib markii loo sheegay in heshiis madax-furasho ah la gaaray, Hase yeeshee, xaaladdu mar kale ayay ka sii dartay markii markabka ay biyo soo  galeen oo uu bilaabay inuu dego. Afar shaqaale oo u dhashay Bangladesh ayaa isku dayay inay u dabaashaan doon kalluumeysi oo meel fog ka muuqatay, balse waxay ku dhinteen biyaha. Sharma oo aan dabaalan karin ayaa xarig qabsaday, waxaana ugu dambeyn badbaadiyay kalluumeysato u dhalatay Cambodia oo biyaha ugu degtay si ay u soo samatabbixiso. Inkasta oo markabkii uu degay, Sharma iyo shaqaalihii kale xorriyad ma helin, waxaana mar kale dib loogu celiyay kaymaha. Wuxuu sheegay in jirdilkii halkaas ka socday uu sii xoogaystay, isaga laftiisana laga siibay ciddiyaha, islamarkaana uu billowday Isku day kale oo lagu doonayay in madax-furasho lagu bixiyo, balse uu fashilmay markii kabtan Jarmal ah oo loo diray inuu lacagta keeno uu la baxsaday lacagtii. Ugu dambeyn, Sharma iyo shaqaalaha kale waxay go’aansadeen inay qorsheeyaan baxsad,  iyaga oo kaashanaya qof ka tirsanaa burcad-badeedda  oo ka heleen telefoon iyo kaar SIM ah, waxayna xiriir la sameeyeen dad ku sugnaa Hindiya iyo Qaramada Midoobay. Waxay diyaariyeen qorshe ay dawo hurdo keenta ugu dari lahaayeen cuntada ilaaladooda, si ay fursad ugu helaan inay baxsadaan. Qorshaha ayaa hirgalay, waxaana abaare 3-dii habeenimo baxsaday 11 shaqaale ah oo ka haray 23-kii qof ee markii hore markabka saarnaa, waxayna ka baxeen hoygii lagu hayay, iyaga oo watay dukumentiyo ay ka soo badbaadiyeen markabkii degay. Kadib markii ay socdeen ilaa waaberigii, waxay la kulmeen ciidamo Soomaali ah oo geeyay hoteel, kuna caawiyay cunto iyo dhar. Maalintii xigtay ayay diyaarad Qaramada Midoobay leedahay u qaaday dalka Kenya, halkaas oo ay kula kulmeen dad ka qayb qaadanayay dadaalladii lagu doonayay sii deyntooda, waxaana sharma uu dib ugu laabtay Hindiya 9-kii Juun 2014, halkaas oo qoyskiisu si weyn ugu sugayay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, soo kabashadiisu ma ahayn mid degdeg ah, maadaama uu la kulmay riyooyin cabsi leh, iftiinka oo dhib ku noqday iyo inuu ku adkaaday cunista cuntooyinka caadiga ah. Wuxuu sheegay inuu u baahday la-talin nafsiyeed iyo taageero caafimaad si uu uga soo kabto dhaawacyadii maskaxeed ee uu la kulmay muddadii afduubka. Dadaalka uu Sharma ugu jiray inuu noloshiisa dib u dhisto ayaa miro dhalay, waxaana uu shaqadiisii badda dib ugu laabtay bishii Juun 2015. Hadda wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa maraakiibta isagoo ah sarkaalka masuulka ka ah shaqooyinka sagxadda markabka. Wuxuu guursaday sannadkii 2020, wuxuuna leeyahay laba carruur ah, ayadoo Maalinta uu dib ugu laabtay Hindiya, 9-ka Juun, uu u dabaaldegaa sidii maalin labaad oo dhalasho ah, marka laga soo tago maalinta uu dhashay ee 8-da Nofeembar. Sheekada Sharma ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay dib u soo xoogeysanayaan walaacyada la xiriira burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya, waxaana Sida ay warbixinta The Indian Express ee 18-ka Oktoobar 2026 sheegtay, hay’adda caalamiga ah ee badaha (IMO) ay bishii Luulyo xaqiijisay in 44 shaqaale badeed ah lagu hayay saddex markab oo la afduubtay, kuwaas oo 16 ka mid ahi ahaayeen Hindi. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in laba markab oo kale oo ay saarnaayeen 22 muwaadin oo Hindi ah la afduubtay bishii Agoosto, taas oo tirada Hindida lagu hayay maraakiibta la afduubtay gaarsiisay 38 qof oo saarnaa shan markab. Si kastaba ha ahaatee dhibaatada uu soo maray Aman Kumar Sharma waxay muujinaysaa dhibaatada ba’an ee afduubyada badda ay ku reebaan shaqaalaha iyo qoysaskooda, iyadoo sidoo kale iftiiminaysa halista ay shaqaalaha maraakiibtu kala kulmaan kooxaha burcad-badeedda marka ay maraan goobaha khatarta badan ee Badweynta Hindiya.

Wuxuu sheegay in nolosha kaymaha ay ahayd mid aad u adag, maadaama ay ku seexan jireen geedaha hoostooda, ay xanuunsan jireen, isla markaana ay heli jireen biyo kooban oo qiyaastii laba litir maalintii ah. Sannadkii 2013-kii ayaa shaqaalihii dib loogu celiyay markabka MV Albedo, kaddib markii loo sheegay in heshiis madax-furasho ah la gaaray, Hase yeeshee, xaaladdu mar kale ayay ka sii dartay markii markabka ay biyo soo  galeen oo uu bilaabay inuu dego. Afar shaqaale oo u dhashay Bangladesh ayaa isku dayay inay u dabaashaan doon kalluumeysi oo meel fog ka muuqatay, balse waxay ku dhinteen biyaha. Sharma oo aan dabaalan karin ayaa xarig qabsaday, waxaana ugu dambeyn badbaadiyay kalluumeysato u dhalatay Cambodia oo biyaha ugu degtay si ay u soo samatabbixiso. Inkasta oo markabkii uu degay, Sharma iyo shaqaalihii kale xorriyad ma helin, waxaana mar kale dib loogu celiyay kaymaha. Wuxuu sheegay in jirdilkii halkaas ka socday uu sii xoogaystay, isaga laftiisana laga siibay ciddiyaha, islamarkaana uu billowday Isku day kale oo lagu doonayay in madax-furasho lagu bixiyo, balse uu fashilmay markii kabtan Jarmal ah oo loo diray inuu lacagta keeno uu la baxsaday lacagtii. Ugu dambeyn, Sharma iyo shaqaalaha kale waxay go’aansadeen inay qorsheeyaan baxsad,  iyaga oo kaashanaya qof ka tirsanaa burcad-badeedda  oo ka heleen telefoon iyo kaar SIM ah, waxayna xiriir la sameeyeen dad ku sugnaa Hindiya iyo Qaramada Midoobay. Waxay diyaariyeen qorshe ay dawo hurdo keenta ugu dari lahaayeen cuntada ilaaladooda, si ay fursad ugu helaan inay baxsadaan. Qorshaha ayaa hirgalay, waxaana abaare 3-dii habeenimo baxsaday 11 shaqaale ah oo ka haray 23-kii qof ee markii hore markabka saarnaa, waxayna ka baxeen hoygii lagu hayay, iyaga oo watay dukumentiyo ay ka soo badbaadiyeen markabkii degay. Kadib markii ay socdeen ilaa waaberigii, waxay la kulmeen ciidamo Soomaali ah oo geeyay hoteel, kuna caawiyay cunto iyo dhar. Maalintii xigtay ayay diyaarad Qaramada Midoobay leedahay u qaaday dalka Kenya, halkaas oo ay kula kulmeen dad ka qayb qaadanayay dadaalladii lagu doonayay sii deyntooda, waxaana sharma uu dib ugu laabtay Hindiya 9-kii Juun 2014, halkaas oo qoyskiisu si weyn ugu sugayay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, soo kabashadiisu ma ahayn mid degdeg ah, maadaama uu la kulmay riyooyin cabsi leh, iftiinka oo dhib ku noqday iyo inuu ku adkaaday cunista cuntooyinka caadiga ah. Wuxuu sheegay inuu u baahday la-talin nafsiyeed iyo taageero caafimaad si uu uga soo kabto dhaawacyadii maskaxeed ee uu la kulmay muddadii afduubka. Dadaalka uu Sharma ugu jiray inuu noloshiisa dib u dhisto ayaa miro dhalay, waxaana uu shaqadiisii badda dib ugu laabtay bishii Juun 2015. Hadda wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa maraakiibta isagoo ah sarkaalka masuulka ka ah shaqooyinka sagxadda markabka. Wuxuu guursaday sannadkii 2020, wuxuuna leeyahay laba carruur ah, ayadoo Maalinta uu dib ugu laabtay Hindiya, 9-ka Juun, uu u dabaaldegaa sidii maalin labaad oo dhalasho ah, marka laga soo tago maalinta uu dhashay ee 8-da Nofeembar. Sheekada Sharma ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay dib u soo xoogeysanayaan walaacyada la xiriira burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya, waxaana Sida ay warbixinta The Indian Express ee 18-ka Oktoobar 2026 sheegtay, hay’adda caalamiga ah ee badaha (IMO) ay bishii Luulyo xaqiijisay in 44 shaqaale badeed ah lagu hayay saddex markab oo la afduubtay, kuwaas oo 16 ka mid ahi ahaayeen Hindi. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in laba markab oo kale oo ay saarnaayeen 22 muwaadin oo Hindi ah la afduubtay bishii Agoosto, taas oo tirada Hindida lagu hayay maraakiibta la afduubtay gaarsiisay 38 qof oo saarnaa shan markab. Si kastaba ha ahaatee dhibaatada uu soo maray Aman Kumar Sharma waxay muujinaysaa dhibaatada ba’an ee afduubyada badda ay ku reebaan shaqaalaha iyo qoysaskooda, iyadoo sidoo kale iftiiminaysa halista ay shaqaalaha maraakiibtu kala kulmaan kooxaha burcad-badeedda marka ay maraan goobaha khatarta badan ee Badweynta Hindiya.

items.title: Maxay yihiin dhismayaasha cusub ee lagu soo kordhiyay Villa Somalia? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Agaasime Ku-xigeenka Guud ee Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, ahna ku-simaha Agaasimaha Guud, Sakariye Yuusuf Xuseen ayaa xarigga ka jaray dhismayaal cusub oo qayb ka ah qorshaha dib-u-habaynta iyo casriyeynta Madaxtooyada Qaranka. Dhismaayasha uu xarigga ka jaray Agaasimaha waxaa ka mid ah astaanta Madaxtooyada iyo dhismeyaal kale oo muhiim u ah bilicda iyo muuqaalka guud ee xarunta Madaxtooyada Qaranka. Dhismayaashan ayaa lagu sameeyay dadaallo lagu horumarinayo muuqaalka iyo bilicda Madaxtooyada, iyadoo tallaabadan ay qayb ka tahay qorshaha lagu casriyeynayo xarunta ugu sarreysa dowladda Soomaaliya. Agaasimaha ayaa bogaadiyey dadaallada iyo wada-shaqaynta lagu hirgeliyey hawlahan, isaga oo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii wado mashaariicda lagu horumarinayo xarumaha dowladda. Sidoo kale, Sakariye ayaa mahadcelin gaar ah u jeediyey shaqaalaha, farsamayaqaannada iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee ka qayb qaatay qorshaynta, dhismaha iyo dhammaystirka hawlaha dib-u-habaynta. Waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyey baahida loo qabo xoojinta dadaallada lagu horumarinayo Madaxtooyada Qaranka oo ah xarun muhiim u ah hoggaanka iyo maamulka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Ku-simaha Agaasimaha Guud ayaa ugu dambeyntiina tilmaamay in horumarinta iyo casriyeynta Madaxtooyadu ay astaan u tahay horumarka iyo dib-u-kabashada dalka, isaga oo adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadista dadaallada lagu tayeynayo xarunta. items.title: Soomaaliya, Turkiga, Masar iyo 16 dal oo kale oo si adag u cambaareeyay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Soomaaliya, Turkiga, Masar iyo 16 dal oo kale ayaa si wadajir ah u cambaareeyay go’aanka dowladda Colombia ay safaaraddeeda Israa’iil ugu wareejisay magaalada Qudus. Dalalkan ayaa Bogotá ugu baaqay inay dib uga laabato tallaabadaas, iyaga oo ku dooday inay ka hor imanayso qaraarrada Qaramada Midoobay. Mowqifkan ayaa yimid kaddib markii Colombia ay 14-kii October 2026 xarigga ka jartay safaaraddeeda ku taalla Qudus, xilli Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Colombia, Omar Bula Escobar, uu booqasho rasmi ah ku joogay Israa’iil, sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee dalkaasi. Bayaan wadajir ah oo ay soo saareen wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee 19-ka dal ayaa lagu sheegay in tallaabada Colombia ay ka hor imanayso qaraarrada Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ee la xiriira xaaladda sharci ee magaalada Qudus. Dalalka bayaanka soo saaray ayaa kala ah Soomaaliya, Jabuuti, Sacuudiga, Falastiin, Urdun, Indonesia, Pakistan, Turkiga, Aljeeriya, Suudaan, Suuriya, Cumaan, Qatar, Kuweyt, Lubnaan, Liibiya, Malaysia, Masar iyo Yemen. Wasiirradu waxay caddeeyeen in tallaabo kasta oo lagu beddelayo xaaladda sharci iyo taariikheed ee Bariga Qudus ee la haysto, ama magaalada loogu aqoonsanayo caasimadda Israa’iil, aysan lahayn wax sharciyad caalami ah. Waxay sidoo kale dowladda Colombia ugu baaqeen inay dib uga fiirsato go’aankeeda, kana laabato, iyaga oo ku adkeystay in la dhowro sharciga caalamiga ah iyo xuquuqda shacabka Falastiin, oo ay ku jirto xaqa ay u leeyihiin dowlad madax-bannaan oo caasimaddeedu tahay Bariga Qudus. Dowladaha bayaanka soo saaray ayaa daliishaday qaraarrada 476 iyo 478 ee Golaha Ammaanka, kuwaas oo la ansixiyay sannadkii 1980-kii. Qaraarradaasi waxay diideen tallaabooyinka hal dhinac ah ee lagu beddelayo xaaladda Qudus, waxayna dalalka safaaradaha ku lahaa magaalada ugu baaqeen inay kala baxaan. Ugu dambayntiina, dalalkan ayaa ka digay in go’aanka Colombia uu wiiqi karo dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu raadinayo nabad waarta oo caddaalad ku dhisan oo dhex marta Israa’iil iyo Falastiin, taas oo lagu salaynayo xalka labada dowladood. items.title: Qareenada Ilhaan Cumar oo tallaabo culus qaaday iyo kiiska oo weji cusub yeeshay
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Qareennada xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar ayaa ku eedeeyay hay’adaha federaalka Mareykanka inay jebiyeen shuruudo muhiim ah oo maxkamaddu ku xirtay baaritaankii Isniintii lagu sameeyay gurigeeda Washington, iyagoo dalbaday in si degdeg ah loogu soo celiyo dhammaan hantidii iyo dokumentiyadii laga qaaday. Warqad ay Jimcihii u direen Wasaaradda Cadaaladda Mareykanka, qareennada Amy Jeffress iyo Joshua Matz ayaa ku sheegay in baaritaanka lagu hayo Ilhaan uu yahay mid siyaasadeed oo lagu beegsanayo mid ka mid ah dadka sida weyn u dhaliila Madaxweyne Donald Trump. Waxay ku doodeen in baaritaanka iyo qaabkii loo fuliyay ay xadgudub ku yihiin xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee Ilhaan, isla markaana ay halis gelinayaan mabda’a kala madax-bannaanida awoodaha dowladda Mareykanka. Sida uu qoray wargeyska The Washington Post , qareennadu waxay sheegeen in saraakiishii baaritaanka sameeyay aysan raacin tilmaamo cad oo garsoore federaal ah uu bixiyay ka hor inta aan la oggolaan in guriga la baaro. Tilmaamahaas waxaa ka mid ahaa in qareennada Ilhaan la siiyo nuqulka amarka baaritaanka, isla markaana lala xiriiro xafiiska qareennada Golaha Wakiillada Mareykanka ka hor inta aan howlgalka la bilaabin. Arrintaas ayaa muhiim u ahayd in la kala saaro dokumentiyada shakhsiga ah iyo kuwa la xiriira shaqada Ilhaan ee Congress-ka, kuwaas oo qaarkood uu dastuurka Mareykanku si gaar ah u ilaaliyo. Qareennadu waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in Ilhaan laga hor istaagay inay la xiriirto qareennadeeda muddo ka badan saacad markii baaritaanku bilowday, inkastoo ay jireen shuruudo maxkamadeed oo loogu talagalay ilaalinta xuquuqdeeda. “Ma jirto sabab sharci ah oo lagu tuhmi karo inay Ilhaan jebisay sharci la xiriira jinsiyaddeeda Mareykanka,” ayay qareennadu ku sheegeen warqaddooda. Waxay intaas ku dareen in waayo-aragnimadii dhaweyd ay muujisay in maqnaanshaha caddeymo ku filan uusan maamulka Trump ka hor istaagin inuu baaritaanno dambiyeed oo siyaasadaysan ku qaado dadka ka soo horjeeda madaxweynaha. Dowladda oo beenisay eedeymaha Wasaaradda Cadaaladda Mareykanka ayaa si adag u beenisay eedeymaha qareennada Ilhaan, iyadoo sheegtay in saraakiisheedu ay si buuxda u raaceen amarrada maxkamadda iyo waajibaadka sharciga. Afhayeen u hadlay wasaaradda ayaa sheegay in warqadda qareennadu ay xambaarsan tahay eedeymo been ah iyo macluumaad aan sax ahayn. “Qareennadeenna iyo hay’adaha fulinta sharciga ee nala shaqeeya waxay u hoggaansameen dhammaan amarrada maxkamadda iyo waajibaadka sharciga, sida ay mar walba sameeyaan,” ayuu yiri afhayeenku. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku eedeeyay qareennada inay warqadda saxaafadda u gudbiyeen isla markii ay wasaaradda u direen, isagoo tallaabadaas ku tilmaamay olole warbaahineed oo aan ku dhisneyn niyad wanaagsan. Muranka ayaa ka dhashay baaritaan ay hoggaaminayaan saraakiisha Homeland Security Investigations (HSI), oo ah waaxda baarista dambiyada ee hay’adda socdaalka Mareykanka ee ICE. Baaritaanka ayaa ku saabsan eedeymo sheegaya in Ilhaan ama xubno qoyskeeda ka mid ah ay macluumaad aan sax ahayn ku qoreen dokumentiyo socdaal oo tobannaan sano ka hor la diyaariyay, si ay u helaan sharci deggenaansho iyo ugu dambeyn jinsiyadda Mareykanka. Ilhaan ayaa si joogto ah u beenisay eedeymahaas, iyadoo ku tilmaantay kuwo aan sal lahayn oo ay muddo dheer faafinayeen kooxaha siyaasadeed ee garabka midig ee Mareykanka. Dokumentiyo, taleefan iyo baasaboor la qaaday Intii uu socday baaritaankii Isniintii, saraakiisha federaalka ayaa guriga Ilhaan kala baxay sanduuqyo ay ku jireen dukumentiyo, taleefankeeda gacanta iyo baasaboorkeeda, sida uu hore u sheegay The Washington Post. Qareennadeeda ayaa hadda dalbaday in dhammaan waxyaabahaas dib loo soo celiyo, iyagoo sidoo kale ka codsaday dowladda inay ilaaliso wixii muuqaal iyo cod ah ee laga duubay baaritaanka. Waxay kaloo dalbadeen in la keydiyo dhammaan diiwaannadii baaritaan hore oo maamulka Trump uu sanadkii 2019 ku sameeyay taariikhda socdaalka Ilhaan iyo qoyskeeda. Sida uu wargeysku sheegay Khamiistii, saraakiil xirfadley ah oo ka tirsan hay’adaha socdaalka Mareykanka ayaa xilligaas dib u eegay eedeymo la mid ah kuwa hadda la baarayo, oo ay ku jireen su’aalo ku saabsan taariikhda dhalashada Ilhaan iyo taariikhda shaqada aabbaheed ee ciidamada Soomaaliya. Saraakiishaasi waxay markaas ku soo gabagabeeyeen in aysan jirin caddeymo ku filan oo sabab u noqon kara in baaritaan rasmi ah la furo. Dhanka kale, qareennada Ilhaan ayaa su’aal geliyay waqtiga la fuliyay baaritaanka, oo ku soo beegmay wax ka yar bil ka hor doorashada Congress-ka ee bisha November. Waxay sheegeen in tallaabadani ka hor imaneyso hab-dhaqan muddo dheer ka jiray Wasaaradda Cadaaladda, kaas oo looga fogaado tallaabooyin baaritaan oo si muuqata u saameyn kara musharraxiinta siyaasadeed 60-ka maalmood ee ka horreeya doorashada. Hab-dhaqankaasi ma aha sharci si rasmi ah u mamnuucaya baaritaannada xilligaas. Mas’uuliyiinta wasaaradda ayaa dhankooda sheegay in qorshaha baaritaanka uu maray dib u eegis gudaha ah ka hor inta aan la fulin. Ilhaan, oo Soomaaliya ku dhalatay kana soo qaxday dagaalladii sokeeye iyadoo qoyskeeda la socota, ayaa Mareykanka timid bartamihii sagaashameeyadii, waxayna heshay jinsiyadda Mareykanka sanadkii 2000. Waxay hadda u tartamaysaa markii shanaad kursiga ay ku matasho gobolka Minnesota ee Golaha Wakiillada Mareykanka. Amarkii maxkamadeed ee lagu fasaxay baaritaanka gurigeeda ayaa weli ah mid aan dadweynaha loo soo bandhigin, waxaana dhowr hay’adood oo warbaahineed ay maxkamadda ka codsadeen in la shaaciyo. Qareennada Ilhaan ayaa ku adkeystay in baaritaanku uusan lahayn saldhig sharci oo ku filan, isla markaana waqtigiisa iyo qaabka loo fuliyay ay muujinayaan ujeeddo siyaasadeed. “Ujeeddooyinka siyaasadeed ee ka dambeeya baaritaankan iyo gurigan la baaray ka hor doorashada waa kuwo si cad u muuqda,” ayay ku soo gabagabeeyeen warqaddooda. “Baaritaankani ma ahayn mid sabab sharci ah loo haystay, mana ahayn mid sharciga waafaqsan.” The post Qareenada Ilhaan Cumar oo tallaabo culus qaaday iyo kiiska oo weji cusub yeeshay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Tilmaamahaas waxaa ka mid ahaa in qareennada Ilhaan la siiyo nuqulka amarka baaritaanka, isla markaana lala xiriiro xafiiska qareennada Golaha Wakiillada Mareykanka ka hor inta aan howlgalka la bilaabin. Arrintaas ayaa muhiim u ahayd in la kala saaro dokumentiyada shakhsiga ah iyo kuwa la xiriira shaqada Ilhaan ee Congress-ka, kuwaas oo qaarkood uu dastuurka Mareykanku si gaar ah u ilaaliyo. Qareennadu waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in Ilhaan laga hor istaagay inay la xiriirto qareennadeeda muddo ka badan saacad markii baaritaanku bilowday, inkastoo ay jireen shuruudo maxkamadeed oo loogu talagalay ilaalinta xuquuqdeeda. “Ma jirto sabab sharci ah oo lagu tuhmi karo inay Ilhaan jebisay sharci la xiriira jinsiyaddeeda Mareykanka,” ayay qareennadu ku sheegeen warqaddooda. Waxay intaas ku dareen in waayo-aragnimadii dhaweyd ay muujisay in maqnaanshaha caddeymo ku filan uusan maamulka Trump ka hor istaagin inuu baaritaanno dambiyeed oo siyaasadaysan ku qaado dadka ka soo horjeeda madaxweynaha. Dowladda oo beenisay eedeymaha Wasaaradda Cadaaladda Mareykanka ayaa si adag u beenisay eedeymaha qareennada Ilhaan, iyadoo sheegtay in saraakiisheedu ay si buuxda u raaceen amarrada maxkamadda iyo waajibaadka sharciga. Afhayeen u hadlay wasaaradda ayaa sheegay in warqadda qareennadu ay xambaarsan tahay eedeymo been ah iyo macluumaad aan sax ahayn. “Qareennadeenna iyo hay’adaha fulinta sharciga ee nala shaqeeya waxay u hoggaansameen dhammaan amarrada maxkamadda iyo waajibaadka sharciga, sida ay mar walba sameeyaan,” ayuu yiri afhayeenku. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku eedeeyay qareennada inay warqadda saxaafadda u gudbiyeen isla markii ay wasaaradda u direen, isagoo tallaabadaas ku tilmaamay olole warbaahineed oo aan ku dhisneyn niyad wanaagsan. Muranka ayaa ka dhashay baaritaan ay hoggaaminayaan saraakiisha Homeland Security Investigations (HSI), oo ah waaxda baarista dambiyada ee hay’adda socdaalka Mareykanka ee ICE. Baaritaanka ayaa ku saabsan eedeymo sheegaya in Ilhaan ama xubno qoyskeeda ka mid ah ay macluumaad aan sax ahayn ku qoreen dokumentiyo socdaal oo tobannaan sano ka hor la diyaariyay, si ay u helaan sharci deggenaansho iyo ugu dambeyn jinsiyadda Mareykanka. Ilhaan ayaa si joogto ah u beenisay eedeymahaas, iyadoo ku tilmaantay kuwo aan sal lahayn oo ay muddo dheer faafinayeen kooxaha siyaasadeed ee garabka midig ee Mareykanka. Dokumentiyo, taleefan iyo baasaboor la qaaday Intii uu socday baaritaankii Isniintii, saraakiisha federaalka ayaa guriga Ilhaan kala baxay sanduuqyo ay ku jireen dukumentiyo, taleefankeeda gacanta iyo baasaboorkeeda, sida uu hore u sheegay The Washington Post. Qareennadeeda ayaa hadda dalbaday in dhammaan waxyaabahaas dib loo soo celiyo, iyagoo sidoo kale ka codsaday dowladda inay ilaaliso wixii muuqaal iyo cod ah ee laga duubay baaritaanka. Waxay kaloo dalbadeen in la keydiyo dhammaan diiwaannadii baaritaan hore oo maamulka Trump uu sanadkii 2019 ku sameeyay taariikhda socdaalka Ilhaan iyo qoyskeeda. Sida uu wargeysku sheegay Khamiistii, saraakiil xirfadley ah oo ka tirsan hay’adaha socdaalka Mareykanka ayaa xilligaas dib u eegay eedeymo la mid ah kuwa hadda la baarayo, oo ay ku jireen su’aalo ku saabsan taariikhda dhalashada Ilhaan iyo taariikhda shaqada aabbaheed ee ciidamada Soomaaliya. Saraakiishaasi waxay markaas ku soo gabagabeeyeen in aysan jirin caddeymo ku filan oo sabab u noqon kara in baaritaan rasmi ah la furo. Dhanka kale, qareennada Ilhaan ayaa su’aal geliyay waqtiga la fuliyay baaritaanka, oo ku soo beegmay wax ka yar bil ka hor doorashada Congress-ka ee bisha November. Waxay sheegeen in tallaabadani ka hor imaneyso hab-dhaqan muddo dheer ka jiray Wasaaradda Cadaaladda, kaas oo looga fogaado tallaabooyin baaritaan oo si muuqata u saameyn kara musharraxiinta siyaasadeed 60-ka maalmood ee ka horreeya doorashada. Hab-dhaqankaasi ma aha sharci si rasmi ah u mamnuucaya baaritaannada xilligaas. Mas’uuliyiinta wasaaradda ayaa dhankooda sheegay in qorshaha baaritaanka uu maray dib u eegis gudaha ah ka hor inta aan la fulin. Ilhaan, oo Soomaaliya ku dhalatay kana soo qaxday dagaalladii sokeeye iyadoo qoyskeeda la socota, ayaa Mareykanka timid bartamihii sagaashameeyadii, waxayna heshay jinsiyadda Mareykanka sanadkii 2000. Waxay hadda u tartamaysaa markii shanaad kursiga ay ku matasho gobolka Minnesota ee Golaha Wakiillada Mareykanka. Amarkii maxkamadeed ee lagu fasaxay baaritaanka gurigeeda ayaa weli ah mid aan dadweynaha loo soo bandhigin, waxaana dhowr hay’adood oo warbaahineed ay maxkamadda ka codsadeen in la shaaciyo. Qareennada Ilhaan ayaa ku adkeystay in baaritaanku uusan lahayn saldhig sharci oo ku filan, isla markaana waqtigiisa iyo qaabka loo fuliyay ay muujinayaan ujeeddo siyaasadeed. “Ujeeddooyinka siyaasadeed ee ka dambeeya baaritaankan iyo gurigan la baaray ka hor doorashada waa kuwo si cad u muuqda,” ayay ku soo gabagabeeyeen warqaddooda. “Baaritaankani ma ahayn mid sabab sharci ah loo haystay, mana ahayn mid sharciga waafaqsan.” The post Qareenada Ilhaan Cumar oo tallaabo culus qaaday iyo kiiska oo weji cusub yeeshay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Weerarrada sii kordhaya ee Xuutiyiinta iyo heshiiska difaaca Maka: Muxuu Turkigu samaynayaa si uu u taageero Sacuudiga?
items.description: Waxaa la tixgelinayaa xulashooyin kala duwan oo Turkigu ku taageeri karo Sacuudiga, iyadoo la eegayo weerarrada sii kordhaya ee Xuutiyiintu ku qaadaan Sacuudiga iyo heshiiska difaaca wadajirka ah ee Maka. Bayaan ay wasaaradda difaaca Turkigu soo saartay Khamiistii ayaa lagu sheegay in xulashooyinka taageero milatari ee suurtagalka ah, iyadoo la raacayo heshiiska ay Turkigu la galeen Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan, la go’aamin doono kaddib marka Baarlamaanka Weyn ee Qaranka Turkigu ansixiyo heshiiska, isla markaana la dhammaystiro hannaanka dastuuriga ah. Go’aanka waxaa lagu salayn doonaa baahiyaha ka jira goobta. Marka la eego arrintan, mudnaanta koowaad ee Ankara waa in heshiiska difaaca wadajirka ah ee Makka la horgeeyo baarlamaanka si loo ansixiyo. Intaa kaddib, waxaa qorshuhu yahay in mar kale baarlamaanka la horgeeyo qaraarka oggolaanaya in ciidamo Turkiga ah loo diro dibadda. Dhanka kale, waxaa la qorsheynayaa in la go’aamiyo baaxadda taageerada la bixinayo, iyadoo lagu salaynayo baahiyaha iyo codsiyada Sacuudiga. Xulashada ugu weyn ee la tixgelinayo waa in la hawlgeliyo nidaamyada difaaca cirka iyo awoodaha kale ee saadka milatari, si kor loogu qaado awoodda difaac ee Sacuudiga. Xigashada Sawirka, Saudi Press Agency Taageerada milatari ee Sacuudiga Waxaa sii kordhay dagaallada u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga, gaar ahaan labadii toddobaad ee la soo dhaafay. Iska horimaadyadan waxaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday kaabayaasha tamarta ee Sacuudiga, garoomada diyaaradaha iyo sidoo kale qaar ka mid ah goobaha barakaysan. Dalal dhowr ah, oo ay ku jiraan Turkiga iyo Pakistan, ayaa ka falceliyay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta oo ay taageerto Iiraan. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa 7-dii Oktoobar, isaga oo su’aalo uga jawaabayay suxufiyiinta Aqalka Cad, wax laga weydiiyay go’aanka labada dal ee ah inay Sacuudiga siiyaan taageero milatari. Wuxuu ku jawaabay: “Waxaan u malaynayaa inay doonayaan inay Sacuudiga caawiyaan, taasina waa arrin wanaagsan.” Turkigu wuxuu si gaar ah ajandihiisa ugu daray arrinta taageero milatari oo Sacuudiga lagu siinayo, iyadoo la raacayo isbahaysiga Maka. Madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdoğan iyo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Hakan Fidan ayaa hadalladooda ku caddeeyay in Ankara ay ka jirto go’aan siyaasadeed oo adag oo ku aaddan bixinta taageeradan. Erdoğan ayaa 13-kii Oktoobar khadka telefoonka kula hadlay dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Maxamed bin Salmaan, wuxuuna u sheegay in Turkigu garab istaagi doono Sacuudiga. Hannaanka la xiriira taageerada suurtagalka ah ee Sacuudiga waxaa hoggaaminaya Wasaaradaha Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Difaaca ee Turkiga. Marka hore waxaa la dhammaystiri doonaa hannaanka sharciga ah Bayaan ay Wasaaradda Difaaca Qaranka Turkigu soo saartay Khamiistii ayaa tilmaamo ka bixiyay qorshaha sharci iyo kan milatari ee la xiriira habka loo taageeri karo Sacuudiga. Bayaan ka wasaaradda ayaa muujinaya in hannaanka la xiriira awoodda iyo cududda milatari ee suurtagalka ah ee Turkigu siin karo Sacuudiga loo mari doono si waafaqsan qodobbada dastuurka. Arrintan awgeed, waxaa marka hore loo baahan yahay in Baarlamaanka Turkigu ansixiyo heshiiska difaaca wadajirka ah ee Maka, kaddibna la ansixiyo qaraarka oggolaanaya in ciidamada qalabka sida ee Turkiga loo diro dibadda. Qodobka 92-aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga ayaa dhigaya in awoodda go’aaminta dirista ciidamada Turkiga ee dibadda ama oggolaanshaha in ciidamo shisheeye la geeyo gudaha Turkiga ay leedahay Baarlamaanka dalkaas. Madaxweyne Erdoğan ayaa sidoo kale 12-kii Oktoobar sheegay in heshiiska maalmaha soo socda la horgeyn doono baarlamaanka. Ansixinta heshiiska iyo qaraarka waxaa ku filan aqlabiyad fudud oo baarlamaanka ah. Markii la dhammaystiro hannaanka sharciga ah, Wasaaradda Difaaca Qaranka ayaa sidan uga hadashay sida loo go’aamin doono taageerada milatari: Xeerarka lagu go’aaminayo baaxadda iskaashiga suurtagalka ah waxaa lagu salayn doonaa baahiyaha iyo codsiyada Sacuudiga, xaaladda ka jirta goobta iyo baahiyaha hawlgallada. Waxaa sidoo kale la tixgelin doonaa qiimeynta hay’adaha ay khusayso iyo is-afgaradka ay dhinacyadu gaaraan.” Xigashada Sawirka, EPA Qoraalka sawirka, Lama filayo iska horimaad toos ah oo lala galo Xuutiyiinta Qiimaymaha ka socda Ankara ayaa muujinaya in Turkigu, marka uu taageero siinayo Sacuudiga, uu diiradda saari doono xoojinta awoodda difaac ee Sacuudiga. Gaar ahaan, waxaa mudnaan la siin doonaa difaaca cirka, taageerada saadka milatari iyo sirdoonka. Bayaankii Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga, Hakan Fidan, ee 8-dii Oktoobar ayaa si weyn u muujinaya mowqifka Ankara ee arrintan. Fidan ayaa sheegay: “Heshiiska Maka waa heshiis difaac. Ma aha heshiis weerar. Marka dal ka mid ah dhinacyada heshiiska la soo weeraro, waxaad garab istaagaysaa si aad uga caawiso inuu is difaaco.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray: “Turkigu ciidamo uma diri doono dhulka dal kale si uu halkaas uga fuliyo weerar.” Turkiga, Pakistan iyo Sacuudiga, mudnaanta ugu weyn ee isbahaysiga Maka waa difaaca wadajirka ah iyo awoodda looga hortagayo cadowga inuu weerar qaado. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, heshiiska saddexda dal wuxuu sidoo kale xambaarsan yahay mabda’ la mid ah Qodobka 5-aad ee NATO, kaas oo dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado hal dal oo xubin ka ah loo aqoonsan karo weerar lagu qaaday dhammaan dalalka xulafada ah. Hay’adda ugu muhiimsan ee go’aan-qaadashada isbahaysiga Maka waa Guddiga Istaraatiijiyadda, Siyaasadda iyo Difaaca (SSSK). Kulankii guddiga ee 5-tii Oktoobar ayaa lagu go’aamiyay in Sacuudiga si degdeg ah loo siiyo taageero milatari. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, maadaama isbahaysigu yahay mid aad u cusub, habraacyadiisa hay’addeedna aan weli si buuxda loo dhammaystirin, waxaa la sheegay in tallaabooyinka la xiriira taageerada milatari ay qaadan karaan waqti. Waxaa la filayaa in dhinacyadu sii xoojiyaan wada-tashiyada ku saabsan taageerada milatari ka hor kulanka xiga ee Guddiga Istaraatiijiyadda, Siyaasadda iyo Difaaca. Xaaladda ka jirta goobta dagaalka ayaa saamayn ku yeelan karta taageerada Ankara Iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta, oo gacanta ku haya qaybo badan oo ka mid ah Yemen, ayaa si goos-goos ah u socday tan iyo sannadkii 2014-kii. Isku dayga Xuutiyiinta, gaar ahaan marka la eego dagaalka u dhexeeya Mareykanka, Israa’iil iyo Iiraan, ay ku xaddidayaan isu-socodka maraakiibta shidaalka ee marinka Baab al-Mandab ayaa muujiyay dhinaca caalamiga ah ee khilaafka Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta. Warbaahinta Mareykanka ayaa baahisay warar sheegaya in Washington ay kala kaashanayso Riyadh qiimeynta suurtagalnimada in la bilaabo hawlgal milatari oo ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta. Dhanka kale, Israa’iil ayaa iyaduna qiimeyneysa xulashooyin ay ka mid yihiin taageero sirdoon iyo mid milatari. Bayaanka Wasaaradda Difaaca Qaranka Turkiga ayaa lagu sheegay in marka la go’aaminayo baaxadda iskaashiga la tixgelin doono sidoo kale “xaaladda ka jirta goobta dagaalka”. Turkigu wuxuu samayn karaa qiimeyn kama dambays ah oo ku saabsan ka-qaybgalka iskaashiga milatari, isaga oo tixgelinaya dhammaan xulashooyinkan. Bbc somali

Bayaanka Wasaaradda Difaaca Qaranka Turkiga ayaa lagu sheegay in marka la go’aaminayo baaxadda iskaashiga la tixgelin doono sidoo kale “xaaladda ka jirta goobta dagaalka”. Turkigu wuxuu samayn karaa qiimeyn kama dambays ah oo ku saabsan ka-qaybgalka iskaashiga milatari, isaga oo tixgelinaya dhammaan xulashooyinkan. Bbc somali

items.title: Somalia’s Constitutional Dispute Deepens as Government Moves to Bar MPs from Cabinet
items.description: MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia’s government is moving to end the long-standing practice of allowing members of parliament to serve simultaneously as ministers—a move critics say exposes President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s growing disregard for the country’s agreed constitutional framework. The change effectively overturns a provision of the 2012 Provisional Federal Constitution (PFCS), which established Somalia as a parliamentary system and explicitly allowed members of parliament to serve in the Council of Ministers. Under Article 97 of the 2012 PFCS, a member of parliament could be appointed as a minister. That provision has now been removed under the constitutional changes being implemented by the government. The office of the Chairperson of the Independent Constitutional Review and Implementation Commission, Burhan Aden Omar, has notified members of the Council of Ministers who also serve as MPs that they must choose between the two positions. According to the notification, the six-month transition period began on 14 April 2026 and ends on 14 October 2026. Under the new arrangement, a minister who is also an MP must relinquish one of the positions. Likewise, an MP who accepts another government position would lose parliamentary membership. The committee says the change is intended to establish a clearer separation between the legislative and executive branches and strengthen institutional accountability. But that explanation leaves a much larger constitutional question unanswered: Who authorized the replacement of an agreed constitutional provision with a new rule that fundamentally changes the relationship between Parliament and the executive? The 2012 Constitution vs. Hassan Sheikh’s Constitutional Project The controversy goes beyond whether MPs should be allowed to serve as ministers. The 2012 PFCS was the product of a broad political process and remains the constitutional reference point around which Somalia’s federal institutions were established. Its parliamentary framework was designed to allow political leaders to move between Parliament and the executive without automatically losing their parliamentary mandate. Critics argue that President Hassan Sheikh’s administration is instead relying on a new constitutional framework that has not achieved the same level of political consensus as the 2012 settlement. They contend that the Constitutional Review and Implementation Commission is now treating provisions from that contested framework as though they had already acquired unquestioned national legitimacy. That, they argue, is precisely where the constitutional dispute becomes political. A constitution cannot derive its legitimacy simply from the institution responsible for drafting or implementing it. Its authority depends on political consensus, proper procedure and acceptance by the country’s principal stakeholders. The government, however, has presented the constitutional changes as part of a broader effort to complete Somalia’s constitutional review process and clarify the separation of powers. A Fundamental Parliamentary Question The immediate consequence is straightforward. Once the transition period expires on October 14, a minister who wishes to remain in the cabinet will reportedly have to give up his or her parliamentary seat. An MP who accepts a ministerial or other government position could likewise lose parliamentary membership. That represents a significant departure from the constitutional practice established under the 2012 PFCS. It also raises questions about the nature of Somalia’s parliamentary system. In a parliamentary system, the relationship between the legislature and executive is fundamentally different from that of a presidential system. Ministers are often drawn from parliament precisely because the government depends on legislative political support. The 2012 Somali constitutional framework reflected that principle by permitting MPs to serve in the cabinet. The new restriction therefore does more than separate two offices. It changes the political architecture through which Parliament and the executive interact. Constitution or Constitutional Politics? The controversy comes at an especially sensitive moment, with Somalia already deeply divided over constitutional amendments, elections and the country’s political transition. Opponents of the government’s approach argue that President Hassan Sheikh cannot simply replace provisions of the 2012 PFCS through a constitutional process that lacks broad political agreement and then demand that federal member states and opposition forces treat the resulting document as universally binding. Their concern is not merely about ministers retaining parliamentary seats. It is about who has the constitutional authority to redefine the country’s system of government—and under what political mandate. The government maintains that the constitutional review process is legitimate and that the new provisions should be implemented once duly adopted. But the central political dispute remains unresolved. If Somalia’s constitutional order was built on consensus, then constitutional change without consensus risks becoming an instrument of political power rather than a foundation for political stability.That is why the dispute over MPs serving as ministers matters far beyond the composition of the cabinet. It goes to the heart of Somalia’s unfinished constitutional settlement—and to the increasingly contentious question of whether the country’s political institutions are being governed by an agreed national constitution or by a constitutional project driven primarily by the incumbent administration. items.title: Dawladda Maraykanka oo war ka soo saartay marin biyoodka Hormuz
items.description: Milatariga Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in “inta ugu badan” weerarrada Iran ay ku qaaday maraakiibta marinka Hormuz ay “fashilmeen”. Tim Hawkins, oo ah afhayeenka Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka (CENTCOM), ayaa Fox News u sheegay in “97 boqolkiiba maraakiibta isku dayay inay maraan marinka Hormuz ay si guul leh uga gudbeen marin-biyoodka, iyaga oo aan bartilmaameed u noqon gantaallada Iran”. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in “milatariga Mareykanku uu gacan ka geystay isku-dubaridka ilaalinta kumannaan markab oo si nabad ah uga gudbay marinkan”. Arrintan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa iyadoo maalmihii u dambeeyay ay kordheen weerarrada lagu qaadayo maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo kuwa shidaalka qaada ee marinka Hormuz. Xarunta Hawlgallada Badda ee Ganacsiga ee UK ayaa sheegtay in 12 markab ay soo sheegeen in weerarro lagu qaaday agagaarka marinka Hormuz toddobaadkii la soo dhaafay.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo Sii Daayay 159 Maxbuus oo Lagu Qabtay Dagaallada Dalkaasi
items.description: Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sii daysay 159 qof oo lagu hayay arrimo la xiriira dagaallada dalkaasi, sida ay xaqiijisay Guddiga Caalamiga ah ee Laanqayrta Cas (ICRC), kaas oo taageero ka geystay habraaca sii deyntooda. Sii deyntan ayaa dhacday Sabtidii, 17-ka Oktoobar 2026, iyadoo maxaabiista lagu sii daayay magaalada Sanca ee caasimadda Yemen. Sida uu sheegay mas’uul ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta, dadka la sii daayay waxay ka tirsanaayeen xoogagga taageera dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, waxaana la sheegay inay isa soo dhiibeen iyaga oo aan dagaallamin, xilli Xuutiyiintu ay bishii hore qabsadeen goobo istaraatiiji ah oo ku yaalla xeebaha Badda Cas. Mas’uuliyiinta Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in sii deyntu ay qayb ka tahay cafis guud oo loo fidiyay dadka hubka dhigta oo isa soo dhiiba. Tallaabadan ayaa daba socota sii deyn kale oo bishii Sebtembar lagu fasaxay 323 maxbuus oo ku sugnaa gobolka Xudeyda, sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiinta kooxda. Guddiga Caalamiga ah ee Laanqayrta Cas ayaa xaqiijiyay in uu taageeray howlgalka, isagoo sheegay in shaqaalihiisu ay maxaabiista mid mid ula yeesheen wareysiyo ka hor sii deyntooda, qoysaskoodana la socodsiiyay, isla markaana la qiimeeyay xaaladdooda caafimaad. Guddigu wuxuu sidoo kale ka caawiyay sidii maxaabiistu si ammaan ah ugu laaban lahaayeen guryahooda, oo ay ku jiraan gaadiid iyo taageero gaar ah oo loo fidiyay dadka baahiyaha caafimaad qaba. ICRC waxay caddeysay inaysan qayb ka ahayn go’aaminta dadka la sii deynayo ama tiradooda, isla markaana howlgalka uusan hoos imaan heshiiskii Stockholm ee sannadkii 2018-kii lagu gaaray dadaallada nabadeed ee Yemen. Sii deynta maxaabiistan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli dagaallada Yemen ay mar kale xoogaysteen, kaddib markii ay burburtay xabbad-joojin muddo jirtay, iyadoo iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo ciidamada dowladda ay saamayn ku yeesheen xaaladda amni iyo bani’aadannimo ee dalka. Xuutiyiinta ayaa gacanta ku haya caasimadda Sanca iyo qaybo badan oo ka mid ah waqooyiga iyo galbeedka Yemen tan iyo sannadkii 2014-kii, waxaana dagaalka muddada dheer socday uu sababay dhimasho, barakac iyo dhibaatooyin bani’aadannimo oo baahsan. Sii deynta 159-ka maxbuus ayaa ah tallaabo bani’aadannimo oo muhiim ah, hase yeeshee weli lama oga in tallaabadani horseedi doonto heshiis maxaabiis oo ballaaran ama ay wax ka beddeli doonto xaaladda colaadeed ee Yemen.

items.title: Saudi Arabia says Houthi attacks violate terms of rapprochement with Iran
items.description: Saudi Arabia has publicly accused Iran of encouraging Yemen’s Houthis to attack the kingdom, saying it violates a 2023 diplomatic deal it reached with Tehran to smooth over relations. “We think the escalation by the Houthis at this later stage of the conflict is encouraged by Iran,” Rayed Krimly, deputy minister for public diplomacy at the foreign ministry, told journalists on Friday, in a rare public statement. Krimly’s comments mark the first public signal that the war in Yemen has put pressure on Riyadh’s ties to Tehran. Krimly said that the Houthis’ attacks were a breach of a March 2023 rapprochement that was brokered by China under which Saudi Arabia and Iran resumed diplomatic relations. At the time, the agreement was seen as a sign of China’s successful foreign policy. Beijing has good ties with both Tehran and Riyadh. “[Iran] continues to arm, train and support the Houthi militia in violation of relevant UN Security Council resolutions and in violation of its commitments in the Beijing agreement,” Krimly said. The agreement was generally understood to include a commitment from Tehran to restrain the Houthis in support of a United Nations-backed ceasefire.  Saudi Arabia has faced multiple attacks since the US and Israel launched a war on Iran, putting pressure on the delicate rapprochement the two countries struck. Saudi Arabia even joined the US in launching some strikes on Iran earlier this year in retaliation, although it later pivoted to mediation. Despite the tensions, Saudi Arabia has maintained diplomatic engagement with Iran. Pressure Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan held a phone call with his Iranian counterpart Abbas Araghchi this week. Earlier this month, Saudi Arabia’s ambassador to Iran  publicly attended Araghchi’s sister’s funeral. But the kingdom is now reeling from intense Houthi missile and drone strikes that have targeted civilian infrastructure including airports, oil facilities and the corporate headquarters of Aramco. The Houthis garnered support in the Muslim world for attacking vessels linked to Israel and the US after 7 October 2023, when Israel responded to a Hamas-led attack by launching a war on Gaza, deemed a genocide by the UN, human rights groups and genocide scholars. But the group’s attacks on civilian sites in Saudi Arabia have sparked backlash. Video footage from the Houthis’ Saturday strike on Riyadh airport showed Umrah pilgrims absorbing a strike that killed at least 13 people and severely wounded hundreds more. Saudi Arabia led an intervention into Yemen’s civil war in 2015. The kingdom launched a devastating bombing campaign against the Houthis that contributed to what the UN called the world’s worst humanitarian crisis. In 2022, Yemen’s internationally recognised government, whose biggest backer is Saudi Arabia, reached a ceasefire with the Houthis. The agreement ushered in a fragile truce that endured even during US and Israeli strikes on the Houthis.  The Houthis have received arms, training and intelligence from Iran. The war in Yemen erupted again after Saudi Arabia bombed Sanaa airport in July to prevent a plane carrying Houthi officials from landing. Middle East Eye  reported that Iranian, Syrian and Hezbollah military advisors were on board, along with weapons systems. The Houthis declared a blockade against Saudi shipping as a result, and launched a lightning offensive down the Red Sea coast last month, which the kingdom and its Yemeni allies have struggled to counter. They have also launched hundreds of missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia. items.title: Masar oo ku dhawaaqday in ay difaaceyso Sacuudiga, qaadayna tallaabo degdeg ah
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Masar, Cabdifataax Al-Sisi, ayaa Sabtidii ku dhawaaqay in dalkiisu diyaar u yahay inuu qaado tallaabo kasta oo lagama maarmaan u ah difaaca Sacuudiga, haddii boqortooyadu ka codsato, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan weerarrada kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ku hayso dalkaas. Al-Sisi ayaa sidoo kale dalbaday in baarlamaanka Masar uu yeesho fadhi degdeg ah, si uu u helo oggolaanshaha sharci ee suurta-gelinaya in dalkiisu uu faragelin milatari sameeyo haddii Sacuudigu gargaar weydiisto. Isagoo ka hadlayay munaasabad qalin-jabin ah oo ka dhacday Akadeemiyadda Milatariga Masar, ayuu madaxweynuhu sheegay in Qaahira aysan marnaba aqbali doonin in la waxyeelleeyo amniga iyo xasilloonida Sacuudiga. “Ma aha wax aan qiyaasi karno inaan oggolaanno in Sacuudiga, amnigiisa ama xasilloonidiisa waxyeello la gaarsiiyo,” ayuu yiri Al-Sisi. Wuxuu caddeeyay in Masar aysan dooneyn inay cid weerarto ama dagaal cusub bilowdo, balse ay diyaar u tahay inay difaacdo Sacuudiga haddii loo baahdo. Hadalka Al-Sisi ayaa yimid iyadoo Xuutiyiinta Yemen, oo taageero ka hela Iran, ay maalmihii u dambeeyay weerarro ku qaadeen garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Riyadh iyo xarumo ay leedahay shirkadda shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco. Weerarradan ayaa qeyb ka ah colaadda dib uga qaraxday Yemen, kaddib markii uu burburay heshiis xabbad-joojin ah oo hakad geliyay dagaalka u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, kuwaas oo taageero ka hela Sacuudiga. Madaxweynaha Masar ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu diyaar u yahay inuu qaado tallaabooyinka difaac ee ay codsadaan Boqor Salmaan Bin Cabdicasiis iyo dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Maxamed Bin Salmaan. “Waan ogahay in arrintani u baahan tahay oggolaanshaha baarlamaanka Masar, waxaana codsanayaa in la qabto fadhi degdeg ah, si uu noo siiyo awooddaas haddii nala soo weydiisto,” ayuu yiri Al-Sisi. Wax yar kaddib hadalkiisa, baarlamaanka Masar ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu Axadda, 18-ka Oktoobar, saacadda 1:00 duhurnimo ee waqtiga Qaahira, yeelan doono fadhi aan caadi ahayn oo looga jawaabayo codsiga madaxweynaha. Baarlamaanka ayaan faahfaahin ka bixin ajandaha rasmiga ah ee kulanka, waxaana weli aan la shaacin in Sacuudigu uu Masar si rasmi ah uga codsaday taageero milatari. Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Maxamed Bin Salmaan ayaa 15-kii Sebtembar booqasho ku tagay Masar, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay Al-Sisi. Labada hoggaamiye ayaa xilligaas ka wada hadlay amniga gobolka iyo ilaalinta marinnada maraakiibta ee Badda Cas, iyadoo dagaalka Yemen uu dib u soo cusboonaaday. Masar iyo Sacuudiga ayaa leh xiriir istaraatiiji ah oo dhinacyada amniga, siyaasadda iyo dhaqaalaha ah. Sacuudiga iyo dalal kale oo Khaliijka ah ayaa Masar ku taageeray balaayiin dollar oo gargaar, maalgelin iyo deebaaji bangiyeed ah, tan iyo markii milatariga Masar uu xilka ka tuuray madaxweynihii Maxamed Mursi sanadkii 2013. Masar ayaa sidoo kale qeyb ka ahayd isbaheysigii milatari ee Sacuudigu hoggaaminayay, kaas oo sanadkii 2015 faragelin ku sameeyay Yemen si uu u taageero dowladda dalkaas ee dagaalka kula jirtay Xuutiyiinta. items.fullContent: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Masar, Cabdifataax Al-Sisi, ayaa Sabtidii ku dhawaaqay in dalkiisu diyaar u yahay inuu qaado tallaabo kasta oo lagama maarmaan u ah difaaca Sacuudiga, haddii boqortooyadu ka codsato, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan weerarrada kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ku hayso dalkaas. Al-Sisi ayaa sidoo kale dalbaday in baarlamaanka Masar uu yeesho fadhi degdeg ah, si uu u helo oggolaanshaha sharci ee suurta-gelinaya in dalkiisu uu faragelin milatari sameeyo haddii Sacuudigu gargaar weydiisto. Isagoo ka hadlayay munaasabad qalin-jabin ah oo ka dhacday Akadeemiyadda Milatariga Masar, ayuu madaxweynuhu sheegay in Qaahira aysan marnaba aqbali doonin in la waxyeelleeyo amniga iyo xasilloonida Sacuudiga. “Ma aha wax aan qiyaasi karno inaan oggolaanno in Sacuudiga, amnigiisa ama xasilloonidiisa waxyeello la gaarsiiyo,” ayuu yiri Al-Sisi. Wuxuu caddeeyay in Masar aysan dooneyn inay cid weerarto ama dagaal cusub bilowdo, balse ay diyaar u tahay inay difaacdo Sacuudiga haddii loo baahdo. items.title: Doorashada Guddoonka Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug oo Maanta Ka Dhacaysa
items.description: DhuusamareebMagaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimadda dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug ayaa maanta lagu wadaa inay ka dhacdo doorashada guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada iyo labadiisa ku-xigeen ee maamulkaas, iyadoo ay diyaar-garowga doorashadu ka socoto xarunta lagu qabanayo codbixinta. Goobta doorashada ayaa waxaa ku sugan xildhibaannada Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug, mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan guddiga doorashada, wakiillo ka socda dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo ka tirsan maamulka Galmudug. Musharraxiin kala duwan ayaa u taagan qabashada xilka guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka iyo labada xil ee ku-xigeennada, waxaana la filayaa in xildhibaannadu ay codkooda ku kala saaraan musharraxiinta u tartamaya hoggaanka golaha. Doorashadan ayaa ah tallaabo muhiim u ah dhismaha hoggaanka Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug, maadaama guddoonka cusub uu yeelan doono mas’uuliyadda hagidda howlaha baarlamaanka, maareynta kulammadiisa iyo isku-duwidda shaqada xildhibaannada. Doorashada guddoonka ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli maamulka Galmudug uu ku jiro marxalad siyaasadeed oo muhiim ah, waxaana indhaha lagu hayaa sida ay doorashadu u dhacdo iyo cidda hoggaanka u qaban doonta Golaha Wakiillada.

items.title: Ruushka oo Itoobiya iyo Eritrea u Bandhigay Dhexdhexaadin Xilli Xiisadda Labada Dal ay Sii Kordhayso
items.description: Dowladda Ruushka ayaa soo bandhigtay inay fududeyso wada-hadallo u dhexeeya dalalka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha u dhexeeya labada dal ee deriska ah. Wasiir Ku-xigeenka Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka, Alexander Alimov, ayaa wargeyska Ruushka ee Izvestia u sheegay in Moscow ay walaac ka qabto sii xumaanshaha xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, taas oo uu sheegay inay tahay arrin walaac ku abuureysa dowladda Ruushka. Alimov ayaa sheegay in Ruushku uu labada dalba ugu baaqay inay muujiyaan is-xakameyn, xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka lagu dhisayo kalsoonida, isla markaana khilaafaadkooda ku xalliyaan wada-hadal iyo diblomaasiyad. Dalabka Ruushka ayaa imanaya xilli xiriirka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea uu wajahayo xiisado sii kordhaya, kuwaas oo walaac ka abuuraya xaaladda amni iyo xasilloonida gobolka Geeska Afrika. Moscow ayaa muujisay inay diyaar u tahay inay door ka qaadato fududeynta wada-hadallada, si labada dhinac loogu dhiirrigeliyo inay ka fogaadaan tallaabooyin sii hurin kara xiisadda, ayna raadiyaan xal nabadeed oo lagu maareeyo khilaafaadkooda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xogta la shaaciyay ma caddayn in labada dowladood ay si rasmi ah u aqbaleen soo jeedinta Ruushka ama in la cayimay waqti iyo goob ay wada-hadalladu ka dhacayaan. Haddii dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ay miro-dhal noqdaan, waxay gacan ka geysan karaan yaraynta xiisadaha labada dal iyo ilaalinta xasilloonida Geeska Afrika, oo ah gobol ay danaha amni iyo siyaasadeed ee dalalku si weyn isugu xiran yihiin.

items.title: Xulka Soomaaliya ee U17 oo u Soo Baxay Finalka Tartanka CECAFA
items.description: Xulka qaranka Soomaaliya ee da’doodu ka hooseyso 17-ka sano ayaa u soo baxay finalka tartanka CECAFA U17 ee isreeb-reebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2026, kaddib markii ay rigoorayaal kaga adkaadeen xulka Rwanda. Xulka da’yarta Soomaaliya ee loo yaqaan Ocean Stars ayaa guushan ku gaaray ciyaar adag oo ka tirsanayd wareegga afar-dhammaadka tartanka, taas oo waqtigii loogu talagalay ku dhammaatay barbarro 1-1 ah. Soomaaliya ayaa ugu dambayn 5-4 kaga adkaatay Rwanda, kaddib markii labada xul ay u gudbeen gool-ku-laadyo. Ciyaartoyda Soomaaliya ayaa soo bandhigay ciyaar ay ka muuqatay xirfad, isku xirnaan iyo adkaysi, taas oo u suurtagelisay inay ka gudbaan caqabaddii Rwanda, isla markaana ay xaqiijiyaan booskooda kulanka kama dambaysta ah ee tartanka. Wasiirka Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Maxamed Cabduqaadir Cali, iyo Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Soomaaliyeed ee Kubadda Cagta, ahna Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka CECAFA, Cali Cabdi Maxamed (Cali Shiine), ayaa ammaan u jeediyay ciyaartoyda xulka qaranka, iyagoo ku bogaadiyay dadaalka iyo geesinimada ay muujiyeen, iyo sida ay u difaaceen sharafta iyo sumcadda calanka Soomaaliyeed. Xulka Soomaaliya ayaa hore ugu guuleystay tartankan sannadkii 2022, waxaana hadda u harsan hal kulan oo keliya si ay mar kale ugu guuleystaan koobka. Soomaaliya ayaa kulanka finalka ee la qorsheeyay 19-ka Oktoobar la ciyaari doonta dhiggeeda Uganda, iyadoo labada xul ay u tartami doonaan hanashada horyaalka da’yarta ee CECAFA U17. Guusha ay Soomaaliya ka gaartay Rwanda ayaa xulka u furtay fursad uu mar kale taariikh uga sameyn karo tartanka, iyadoo taageerayaasha kubadda cagta Soomaaliyeed ay indhaha ku hayaan kulanka kama dambaysta ah iyo rajada ah in koobku mar kale ku soo laabto Soomaaliya.

items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka oo Shaaciyay Musharraxiinta Guddoonka Baarlamaanka Galmudug
items.description: Muqdisho (Goobjoog News) – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi ah u shaaciyay liiska musharraxiinta u tartamaya xilalka Guddoomiyaha iyo ku-xigeennada Golaha Wakiillada Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. War-saxaafadeed uu guddigu soo saaray 17-ka Oktoobar 2026 ayaa lagu sheegay in musharraxiinta loo kala saaray saddex xil, kuwaas oo kala ah Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada iyo labada ku-xigeen. Labada musharrax ee u tartamaya xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug ayaa kala ah Ismaaciil Cabdi Jimcaale Calasow oo ka socda urur-siyaasadeedka Sincad iyo Xuseen Maxamed Nuur Maxamed oo ka socda urur-siyaasadeedka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka. Sidoo kale, Cabdulqaadir Axmed Cali Guuri oo ka socda urur-siyaasadeedka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka ayaa ku tartamaya xilka Guddoomiye ku-xigeenka koowaad, halka Mursal Cabdi Aadan Cilmi oo isla ururkaas ka socda uu u taagan yahay xilka Guddoomiye ku-xigeenka labaad. Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa dhammaan xubnaha Golaha Wakiillada, musharraxiinta, warbaahinta iyo bulshada ku wargeliyay in doorashada loo qaban doono si waafaqsan jadwalka, habraacyada iyo xeerarka lagu maamulayo doorashada Guddoonka Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug. Shaacinta liiska musharraxiinta ayaa ah tallaabo ka mid ah hannaanka doorashada hoggaanka cusub ee Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug.

items.title: Somalia president rejects opposition calls for consensus-based election
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has rejected calls for negotiations with opposition leaders over the country’s upcoming elections, insisting that his government’s plans will proceed as intended. Speaking on Thursday night, Mr Mohamud said he would not relinquish control of the electoral process in response to demands from opposition figures and leaders of regional states, dismissing their calls for an agreed approach to the elections. His remarks signalled a rejection of efforts to reach a consensus on how and when elections should be held and how all political contenders could compete freely and fairly. The comments came hours after the government-appointed electoral commission announced that the presidential election would be held in May, with parliamentary elections scheduled for April next year. Mr Mohamud insisted that everything would proceed according to his government’s plans and that efforts to oppose the proposed process would not succeed. Opposition leaders and the regional states of Puntland and Jubaland have condemned the unilateral move, arguing that Somalia can hold free and fair elections only through an agreed process involving the country’s political stakeholders. They oppose an election organised under arrangements controlled by the federal government and the incumbent president, warning against a process that sidelines political opponents and denies them an equal opportunity to compete. Speaking on Saturday, former Somali President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed said it was unprecedented in Somalia’s history for a president to say, as Mr Mohamud had done this week, that he could carry the country’s future on his back without listening to others. The development comes amid an escalating political crisis in Somalia, where state-building efforts, supported by billions of dollars in international security and development assistance since 2004, are facing a serious test. Opposition leaders and the administrations of Puntland and Jubaland have threatened to establish a parallel government if Mr Mohamud proceeds with a unilateral electoral process that excludes his opponents and remains under his control. The standoff threatens to deepen divisions between Somalia’s federal government, opposition leaders and regional administrations, as disagreements over the electoral process raise the prospect of a wider political confrontation. They oppose an election organised under arrangements controlled by the federal government and the incumbent president, warning against a process that sidelines political opponents and denies them an equal opportunity to compete. Speaking on Saturday, former Somali President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed said it was unprecedented in Somalia’s history for a president to say, as Mr Mohamud had done this week, that he could carry the country’s future on his back without listening to others. The development comes amid an escalating political crisis in Somalia, where state-building efforts, supported by billions of dollars in international security and development assistance since 2004, are facing a serious test. Opposition leaders and the administrations of Puntland and Jubaland have threatened to establish a parallel government if Mr Mohamud proceeds with a unilateral electoral process that excludes his opponents and remains under his control. The standoff threatens to deepen divisions between Somalia’s federal government, opposition leaders and regional administrations, as disagreements over the electoral process raise the prospect of a wider political confrontation. items.title: Press release : Hostilities in the city of Taiz sever vital care for 147k+ women & girls
items.description: PRESS RELEASE: Hostilities in the city of Taiz sever vital care for 147k+ women & girls | بيان صحفي: العنف في مدينة تعز يحرم 147 ألف امرأة وفتاة من الرعاية المنقذة للحياة (PRESS RELEASE: Hostilities in the city of Taiz deprive 147,000 women and girls of vital care | Press Release: Violence in Taiz deprives 147,000 women and girls of life-saving care) Amid escalating violence and access restrictions that disrupt life-saving health and protection services in Taiz, women and girls face increased risks and urgent humanitarian needs. Photo: © UNFPA/Future Boys FoundationAs escalating hostilities and access constraints disrupt life-saving health and protection services in Taiz, women and girls face growing Greetings and best wishes, The escalating armed clashes in Taiz have disrupted life-saving health and protection services for more than 147,600 women and girls. With most medical facilities out of service—only 5 of the 27 maternity hospitals are partially operational—more than 13,100 pregnant women, including 1,500 due to give birth in the next two weeks, are without essential care. The crisis has also led to the suspension of approximately 75 percent of protection services for women and girls in the governorate. In light of this critical situation, the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) is launching an urgent appeal for US$22.7 million to ensure the continued provision of emergency supplies and services over the next three months. Please see the attached press release for details regarding coverage and publication. Please accept my highest regards and appreciation. Regional Office of the United Nations Population Fund for the Arab Region

items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo dhaq-dhaqaaq ka bilaabay Muqdisho, kadib tallaabadii Lafta-gareen
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo yimid magaalada Muqdisho ayaa ka bilaabay, dhaq-dhaqaaqyo culus oo la xiriira xaaladda adag ee ka taagan maamulkaasi. Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa maanta kulan la yeeshay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed (Jaamac) oo kasoo jeeda Koonfur Galbeed, waxayna ka wada-hadleen xaaladda kasii dareysa, kadib markii degmooyin horleh ay qabsadeen ciidanka Lafta-gareen. Ujeedka kulanka ayaa ahaa mid is-xogwareysi ah, iyadoo lagu soo qaaday xaaladda amni ee Koonfur Galbeed, maadaama ay kasii dareyso, dagaalkana uu ku fiday deegaanno cusub. Guddoomiye Jaamac oo qoraal soo saaray kulanka kadib ayaa sheegay in sidoo kale laga wada-hadlay arrimaha dib-u-heshiisiinta deegaannada Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, si looga shaqeeyo midnimada iyo wadajirka bulshada deegaanka. “Maanta waxaan xafiiskayga kulan is-xogwareysi ah kula qaatay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Adaan Madoobe) Waxaan ka wada hadalnay xaaladda guud ee dalka, gaar ahaan arrimaha amniga, siyaasadda iyo dib-u-heshiisiinta deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed,” ayuu yiri guddoomiyuhu. Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa haatan qorseyneysa inay qaado guluf culus oo ka dhan ah ciidanka taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ee qabsaday degmooyinka Qansaxdeere, Bardaale, Buurhakaba iyo Diinsoor oo ka wada tirsn gobolka Baay. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Koonfur Galbeed, Nuur Siidow Baaba oo la hadlay Somali Cable Tv ayaa goor sii horeysay sheegay in shacabka ay maqli doonaan war ay ku farxaan, isla markaana ay degmooyinkaas la qabsaday ay kusoo celin doonaan gacantooda, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Maalmaha soo socda shacabka reer Koonfur Galbeed waxay dhagahooda maqli doonaan wax ay aad ugu farxaan, waxaana lasoo celin doonaan neecaawdii dowladnimada. Degmooyinka ay hadda ku sugan Khawaarijta waxaa dib loogu soo celin doonaan gacanta dowladda,” ayuu yiri wasiirku. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aaday xi lli ay haatan sii xoogeysanayaan khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen iyo kuwa taageersan maamulka hadda ka jira Baydhaba, oo garab ka helaya Dowladda Federaalka. The post Aadan Madoobe oo dhaq-dhaqaaq ka bilaabay Muqdisho, kadib tallaabadii Lafta-gareen appeared first on Caasimada Online .
