items.title: Laftagareen’s forces advance as local residents reportedly welcome troops and call for a peaceful handover of Baidao
items.description: BAIDAO (WDN) — In a dramatic shift in the struggle for control of Southwest State, forces aligned with the former Southwest President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed (Laftagareen) have reportedly taken control of four districts of the five Districts of Bay region, with local sources describing withdrawals and handovers that, in most locations, occurred without any fighting. The developments have intensified questions about the support enjoyed by the rival administrations of Abdiasis and the ability of the Mogadishu-backed leadership in Baidao to maintain control beyond the regional capital. Residents and community sources who spoke to WardheerNews from Baidao, say many people are deeply reluctant to see their city become a battlefield. Elders and religious leaders are reportedly urging that Laftagareen’s forces be allowed to enter Baidao peacefully, arguing that civilians should not be forced to flee their homes or suffer the consequences of a battle between rival political factions. Their concerns have grown as reports have emerged of rapid territorial changes across Bay region. Local reporting on October 16 indicated that Laftagareen-aligned forces had taken control of Diinsoor District, Qansax Dheere, Buurhakaba and Bardaale. Awdiinle, near Baidao, has also featured in reports of the advancing forces. The pace of these developments has transformed the political and security landscape around Baidao. Yet the circumstances differ from one location to another: reports indicate that most positions were abandoned without any resistance, while the takeover of Buurhakaba followed heavy fighting. The claim that 90% of the districts changed hands peacefully would therefore hold water. A changing picture on the ground According to sources familiar with conditions inside Baidao, community elders and religious leaders are increasingly concerned that a military confrontation could cause civilian casualties, displacement and destruction of homes and businesses. They are said to favor a peaceful transfer of authority rather than a battle that could devastate the city. The apparent ease with which most locations have changed hands has prompted speculation about whether local communities and security personnel are unwilling to fight for the administration led by Adan Mohamed Nur Madobe. Some residents reportedly believe Laftagareen’s forces are more acceptable to local communities, although the extent of popular support can be established from social-media footage and important individual accounts. There are also reports that Laftagareen-aligned forces have distributed food to residents in some areas. Such assistance could help reinforce their local standing, particularly among communities facing economic hardship. It is not yet clear how extensive these distributions have been or how residents across the affected districts view the forces. For supporters of Laftagareen, the reported withdrawals and peaceful entries represent evidence that the political contest is not being decided solely by military strength. They argue that local acceptance may be playing a role in the rapid changes in territorial control. That interpretation is marked on the ground as per broader independent reporting. Federal troops reportedly face logistical pressure Sources in Baidao have also expressed concern about the position of federal forces deployed to support Madobe’s administration, including Gorgor special forces and Southwest State security personnel. According to these accounts, the forces face increasing isolation as routes supplying Baidao come under pressure. Fuel shipments reportedly destined for the city have been stopped around Buurhakaba, while restrictions on flights have already reduced the options for resupply or evacuation. These claims could not be independently verified in full. If accurate, however, the reported restrictions would complicate the administration’s ability to maintain its security presence, move personnel and sustain operations outside the capital. The reported territorial losses have also raised questions about whether Madobe’s administration retains sufficient local support and operational capacity to prevent further advances. The administration’s next steps remain unclear. Bakool could become the next flashpoint WardheerNews has also received reports that Laftagareen-aligned forces may be moving towards three districts in neighbouring Bakool region: Waajid, Rab Dhuure and Xudur. Local sources suggest that some residents in these areas are anxious to avoid being caught between rival forces. They argue that communities should not be compelled to flee or endure fighting over a political dispute. However, the reported movements and the likelihood of peaceful handovers in these districts have not been independently confirmed. Any expansion of the confrontation into Bakool would widen the geographical scope of the crisis and place additional pressure on already vulnerable communities. It would also test whether the pattern of withdrawals reported in parts of Bay region is likely to be repeated elsewhere. Adan Madobe’s next move Adan Madobe remains in Mogadishu, according to information provided to WardheerNews , while the administration faces mounting pressure in its principal area of control. He has not publicly addressed all the reported territorial changes in a way that resolves the questions surrounding his administration’s next steps. Some residents and political observers believe he may struggle to return to Baidao without risking a confrontation. That remains speculation, however, and his intentions cannot be established without a direct statement from him or his administration. For civilians, the immediate priority is preventing a battle for Baidao. Elders and religious leaders are reportedly advocating a peaceful arrangement to avoid bloodshed, mass displacement and damage to public and private property. The central question is whether the rival sides will heed those calls before the struggle for Southwest State brings another major town into the conflict. The reported advances by Laftagareen-aligned forces have put the administration under growing pressure, the claims of popular backing, the extent of military isolation and the prospects for further peaceful handovers can be seen all over the Baidhao District. For the people of Baidao, the most important outcome is not which political faction claims victory, but whether the city can avoid becoming the next battlefield. items.title: OIC oo Mar Kale Xaqiijisay Taageerada Midnimada iyo Wadajirka Dhuleed ee Soomaaliya
items.description: BAGDAAD (Goobjoog News) — Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC) ayaa mar kale xaqiijiyey taageerada uu u hayo midnimada, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Taageeradan ayaa lagu muujiyey kulan dhexmaray Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cali, iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka, Ismaaciil Ould Sheekh Axmed, kaas oo ka dhacay magaalada Baqdaad ee dalka Ciraaq. Kulanka ayaa qabsoomay intii ay socdeen hawlaha kalfadhiga 52-aad ee Golaha Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee OIC, waxaana labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo ururka iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga labada dhinac. Xoghayaha Guud ee OIC ayaa kulanka ku xaqiijiyey mowqifka ururka ee taageerada midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, taas oo muujinaysa sii socoshada taageerada ururka ee ilaalinta midnimada dalka. Dhankiisa, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cali, ayaa bogaadiyey doorka OIC ee xoojinta midnimada iyo wadajirka dalalka Islaamka, isaga oo adkeeyey muhiimadda uu leeyahay iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo ururka. Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka oo ay ku mideysan yihiin dalal badan oo Muslimiin ah ayaa Soomaaliya kala shaqeeya arrimo la xiriira iskaashiga siyaasadeed, diblomaasiyadda iyo danaha guud ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah.

items.title: Puntland warns Hassan Sheikh: rejection of political compromise could push Somalia towards disintegration
items.description: GAROWE (WDN) — Puntland has issued a sharp warning to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, accusing his administration of pursuing a disputed electoral process that deepens Somalia’s political divisions and threatening the country’s fragile unity. The warning reflects growing frustration among federal member states and opposition figures over what they see as the president’s unwillingness to negotiate a mutually acceptable political settlement. Puntland Vice-President Ilyas Osman Lugatoor, who is currently serving as acting president, delivered the message as tensions escalated following the Federal Government’s announcement of a timetable for parliamentary and presidential elections without a broadly accepted political agreement. Lugatoor called on residents of Mogadishu to oppose the policies of Hassan Sheikh’s administration, using unusually forceful language to describe resistance to the government as a matter of moral duty. He also warned that if the president failed to organise elections based on consensus, Puntland would consult on its own course of action. His remarks underscore the growing risk that Somalia’s electoral dispute could evolve into a wider confrontation between the Federal Government, federal member states and opposition leaders. An electoral timetable without consensus The Puntland warning came a day after the Federal Electoral Commission announced a timetable setting parliamentary elections for 15 April 2027 and the presidential election for 15 May 2027. The announcement has intensified an already contentious debate over the legitimacy of the proposed electoral process, with critics arguing that an election timetable cannot resolve fundamental disagreements over the rules, constitutional arrangements and political participation. At the heart of the dispute is whether the next transition will be organised through a process negotiated among the principal political stakeholders or one driven primarily by the incumbent administration. The opposition and critics within the federal system have repeatedly stressed the need for meaningful consultations involving federal member states, political organisations and other stakeholders. They fear that proceeding without agreement could produce competing electoral processes, deepen institutional divisions and undermine confidence in the federal system. The cost of refusing compromise The latest controversy raises a broader question about Hassan Sheikh’s approach to political negotiation. Rather than securing a common framework acceptable to rival political forces, his administration faces accusations that it is pressing ahead despite unresolved disagreements. A president seeking to manage a fragile federal state must do more than announce dates. He must help establish rules that competing parties regard as legitimate, address constitutional disputes and create confidence that no political faction is being excluded from the process. Without such agreement, even an election conducted according to an official timetable may fail to produce a peaceful and widely accepted transfer of authority. Puntland’s warning suggests that patience with Mogadishu’s approach is wearing thin. Lugatoor’s statement that Puntland will consult on its response if consensus cannot be reached signals the possibility of further political divergence, although the precise measures Puntland may consider remain unclear. Somalia’s unity at stake The danger extends beyond the immediate electoral dispute. Somalia’s federal system depends on cooperation between the Federal Government and the member states, alongside the participation of opposition groups and other political stakeholders. If those relationships deteriorate further, disagreements over elections could become a wider crisis of political legitimacy. Puntland’s remarks are therefore both a warning to the president and a reflection of the stakes involved. Continued confrontation could make it more difficult to agree on election arrangements, weaken federal cooperation and increase the risk of parallel political processes. The responsibility for avoiding such an outcome rests with all parties, but the presidency has a particular responsibility to convene negotiations, demonstrate flexibility and seek an agreement broad enough to command confidence beyond its own political camp. The central issue is no longer simply when Somalia will hold its next elections, but whether the president can secure a political agreement that makes those elections credible and acceptable to the country’s principal stakeholders. If dialogue continues to fail, the electoral timetable intended to guide Somalia’s transition could instead become another source of division. Puntland’s warning reflects its stated position. items.title: Somali MP sounds alarm over Hirshabelle election, warns Baydabo-style crisis could follow
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Hassan Sheikh Mohamud is pressing ahead with his unilateral electoral scheme, a calculated power grab designed to secure JSP’s dominance, orchestrate his return to office, and install his loyalists across the federal member states through a sham electoral process overseen by a commission operating under his directives. The political theatre witnessed most recently in Galmudug and Hirshabelle, following the earlier sham one in Southwest State, serves as further evidence of an electoral process that undermines democracy and federalism while pushing Somalia toward deeper political instability. A Somali federal lawmaker, Abdimalik, representing the Hiiraan region has strongly condemned the electoral process in Hirshabelle, describing it as illegitimate and alleging that its outcome was predetermined before voters had a meaningful opportunity to choose their representatives. Speaking to journalists outside the Somali Parliament, the MP said he could not accept an electoral process in which the winners were allegedly known in advance. He warned that proceeding without genuine competition, transparency and legal legitimacy could trigger a political confrontation similar to the one now unfolding in Southwest State. “We cannot accept an election of this kind, where the outcome is already known,” Abdimalik told reporters. He issued a stark warning about the consequences of imposing a disputed electoral process, saying: “If this type of election is conducted in Hirshabelle, what is happening in Baidabo now will happen here as well.” His comparison refers to the mounting political and military tensions in Southwest State, where disputes over political authority and elections have contributed to a volatile situation. The MP’s remarks suggest that the controversy surrounding Hirshabelle’s election could extend beyond disagreements over individual candidates and become a broader challenge to the administration’s legitimacy. ‘We will not accept what is unlawful’ Journalists also asked Abdimalik whether opposition to the election was confined to his own community, potentially leaving it isolated in its objections. The lawmaker rejected that characterisation, arguing that his position was not about opposing an election for its own sake. Rather, he said, his side would refuse to accept a process it considered unacceptable and inconsistent with the law. His response highlights a central question facing Hirshabelle: whether the electoral process can command sufficient confidence among competing political groups and communities to avoid a deeper confrontation. A warning that should not be ignored The controversy comes amid wider disputes in Somalia over electoral arrangements, political representation and the legitimacy of processes conducted without broad agreement. Critics argue that elections lose credibility when participants believe the results have been decided in advance or that the rules favour particular candidates. Such perceptions can undermine public confidence, deepen political grievances and encourage opponents to challenge the outcome outside established institutions. Abdimalik’s warning that Hirshabelle could face a crisis resembling the one in Baidabo should therefore be understood as a political caution, rather than proof that the same events will occur. Whether tensions escalate will depend on the conduct of the election, the response of rival political groups and the willingness of the relevant authorities to address grievances through dialogue. The central test for Hirshabelle is whether its election can demonstrate genuine competition and public legitimacy—or whether a disputed process will deepen divisions and open another front in Somalia’s wider political crisis. items.title: Dawo: Shariif oo si kulul ugu jawaabay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed, ayaa si kulul uga jawaabay hadalkii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee ahaa in aanay jirin talo dhexda la dhigayo, isla markaana go’aanka ay leedahay dowladda oo kaliya. Shariif oo galabta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay gurigiisa ayaa sheegay in dowladda aysan cidna kala tashan go’aannada ay qaadanayso, isaga oo arrintaas ku tilmaamay mid aan horay uga dhicin xitaa dowladdii milatariga. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay haddii dowladda aysan diyaar u ahayn in talada la wadaagto dhinacyada kale, ay shacabka xaq u leeyihiin inay iyagu tashadaan oo go’aan ka gaaraan mustaqbalkooda. “Talada dhaxda lama dhigaayo kaliya aniga halay dhageysto qofna lama tashanaayo oo hadana loo sacbiyo waa wax cajiib ah xitaa Dowladii malatariga ma sameyn arinkaas,” ayuu yiri Sheekh Shariif. Waxaa kale oo uu raaciyay “Haddii la rabay dadka la rabay talada inay dhexda soo dhigaan aysan talo haynin oo wax ay dhexda soo dhigaan la’yihiin Soomaali ayaa tashaneysa, ha ogolaadano. Talada Soomaali ayaa iska leh, go;aankana Soomaali ayaa leh”. Dhinaca kale, waxa uu soo hadal qaaday xiisadda ka taagan magaalada Muqdisho ee u dhexeysa ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa mucaaradka, isaga oo eedda dusha ka saaray hoggaanka Villa Soomaaliya, wuxuuna sheegay inay ciidamo dul-dhigeen mucaaradka. “Waxaad ogtihiin waqtigii lasoo dhaafay la-talin iyo u nasteexeen ayay ahayd, waxaase ka dhalatay waxaad aragteen oo dhibaatooyin ah oo handadaad ah oo ciidamo in la’isku wareejiyo ah oo haddana laga dhaaranaayo oo la leeyahay ma dhicin,” ayuu mar kale yiri. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu Jimcihii beeniyay hadal-haynta la xiriirta in Dowladda Federaalka ay qorsheyneyso weerar ka dhan ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, isaga oo sheegay inaysan jirin cid ay doonayaan inay dagaal ku qaadaan. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed lagu xallin karo wada-hadal, isaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyay in albaabka wada-xaajoodku mar walba u furan yahay dhinacyada ay kala aragti duwanaanshuhu ka dhexeeyo. The post Dawo: Shariif oo si kulul ugu jawaabay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sooyaal: Abwaan Sugaal Cabdulle Cumar
items.description: 17kii Oktoobar 2024 , maanta oo kale laba sano ka hor, waxaa magaalada Muqdisho ku geeriyooday abwaan Sugaal Cabdulle Cumar, oo ka mid ahaa hal-abuurkii Soomaaliyeed ee kaalinta weyn ka soo qaatay horumarinta suugaanta, fanka iyo wacyigelinta bulshada. Abwaanku wuxuu ku dhintay qarax ismiidaamin ah oo ka dhacay meel u dhow Dugsiga Tababarka Booliska ee degmada Xamarjajab. Runtii wuxuu ahaa suugaanyahan iyo abwaan qiimo badan oo muddo dheer ka maansoonayay waddaniyadda iyo daljacaylka. Wuxuu astaan u ahaa gobannimada iyo is-ahaanshaha ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Abwaan Sugaal Cabdulle Cumar wuxuu ku soo barbaaray miyiga gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo uu yaraantiisii ku bartay ciyaaraha hiddaha iyo dhaqanka, gaar ahaan dhaantada. Sannadka rasmiga ah ee dhalashadiisa lama xaqiijin, waxaase lagu qiyaasaa inuu dhashay horraantii 1950meeyadii. Wuxuu curinta gabayada ka bilaabay magaalada Gaalkacyo, ka hor intii aan loo soo wareejin Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu kaga mid noqday Kooxda Heegan ee Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed. Sugaal wuxuu ahaa gabyaa, heesaa, laxamiiste, iyo jilaa. Wuxuu curiyey heeso, gabayo iyo riwaayado badan oo ka hadlayay waddaniyadda, midnimada, qabyaaladda, jacaylka, iyo arrimaha bulshada. Riwaayadaha lagu xusuusto waxaa ka mid ahaa Magaalajoogxumo iyo Xujo Guur iyo Xaal Masruuf . Waxa kale oo suugaantiisa caan ka noqday heesta Layla , oo uu isagu ku luuqayn jiray, iyo maansooyinka Duuduub ha loo Liqo , Garwaaqsi , Wadajir iyo Dhalanteed . Xilligii dagaalkii 1977dii, abwaan Sugaal wuxuu ka mid ahaa fannaaniintii suugaanta ku dhiirrigelinayay ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ee garabka iyo gaashaankaba u ahaa. Sannadihii danbe ee noloshiisana wuxuu sii waday curinta iyo gudbinta suugaanta, isaga oo macallin iyo abwaan u ahaa Kooxda Heegan. Hal-abuurkiisu wuxuu si gaar ah ugu suntanaa wacyigelinta bulshada, ka digista qabyaaladda iyo dhiirrigelinta wadajirka bulshada. Geeridiisii 17ka Oktoobar 2024 waxay bahda fanka iyo suugaanta Soomaaliyeed u ahayd gabbal dumay iyo gudcur maararuugle ah! Waxaa lagu xusuusan doonaa oo laga dhaxlay suugaan iyo riwaayado weli qayb ka ah hiddaha iyo dhaxalka dhaqameed ee Soomaalida. Alle ha u naxariisto abwaan Sugaal Cabdulle Cumar.

items.title: Iskaashiga Somaliland iyo Sucuudiga Wuxuu Fursad u Noqon Karaa Amniga Gobolka
items.description: Daraasad cusub oo ay soo saartay xarunta cilmi-baadhista ee Jerusalem Center for Security and Foreign Affairs ayaa sheegtay in Dawladda Sucuudi Arabiya ay Somaliland u aragto lammaane istaraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah sugidda amniga Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Baab al-Mandab. Falanqayntan khubarada xarunta JCFA, waxay si gaar ah u iftiiminaysaa muhiimadda juqraafiyeed ee Somaliland iyo doorka ay Dekedda Berbera ka qaadan karto ilaalinta marinnada ganacsiga, la-socodka dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta iyo xoojinta iskaashiga amniga badda Daraasaddu waxay sheegtay in Somaliland ay leedahay door istaraatiiji ah oo sii kordhaya oo ku saabsan amniga Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Baab al-Mandab, iyadoo ay sii xoogaysanayaan walaacyada gobolka ee la xidhiidha weerarrada Xuutiyiinta, amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo tartanka quwadaha caalamiga ah ee Geeska Afrika. Waxaanay xustay in arrintani ay Somaliland u abuuri karto fursado cusub oo la ku salaysan dhinacyada maalgashiga, horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo ballaadhinta xidhiidhada caalamiga ah. Isla markaana ay suuragelin karto iskaashi cusub oo ku saabsan amniga badda iyo ganacsiga gobolka. Daraasadu waxay tilmaantayin Somaliland ay leedahay fursad ay ku xoojiso kaalinteeda gobolka, maaddaama ay ku taallo meel muhiim u ah isu-socodka maraakiibta isku xidha Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Taas oo ay ku tilmaantay sababta dhabta ah ee ay tahay in dawladda Sucuudigu ay tixgeliyo iskaashi dhinaca amniga badda ah oo ay xarun u noqoto Dekedda Berbera. Sidoo kale Daraasaddu waxay Dekedda Berbera iyo Gegida Diyaaradaha Caalamiga ah ee Berbera ku tilmaamaysaa kaabayaal Somaliland siinaya muhiimad gaar ah marka la eego amniga badda iyo isku-xidhka ganacsiga gobolka. Waxa kale oo ay sheegtay in goobta istaraatiijiga ha ee ay Somaliland kaga taallo Gacanka Cadmeed ay u sahlayso inay door ka qaadato la-socodka dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta, ilaalinta marinnada ganacsiga iyo hawlgallada lagu xoojinayo badbaadada badda. Iyada oo xustay in Berbera ay leedahay kaabeyaal loo adeegsan karo iskaashi ku saabsan ilaalinta maraakiibta ganacsiga, la-dagaallanka tahriibinta hubka, samatabbixinta badda, iyo digniinta hore ee khataraha ka iman kara xeebaha Yemen. Qodobka ugu mudan ee daraasaddu soo bandhigayso waa qorshaha ay ugu yeedhay venture sovereignty, taas oo macnaheedu yahay in Somaliland lagu qiimeeyo awooddeeda maamul, xasilloonideeda hay’adeed, goobta ay ku taallo iyo awoodda ay u leedahay inay fududayso hawlgallada ganacsi iyo kuwa amniga ee badda. Isla markaana ay dhinacyada caalamiga ahi Somaliland ula macaamilaan lammaane hawlgal oo lagu qiimeeyo awooddiisa dhabta ah, maamulka dhulka iyo waxtarka uu u leeyahay iskaashiga danaha wadajirka ah. Falanqaynta JCFA waxay soo bandhigaysaa suuragalnimada iskaashi ay danaha Sucuudiga, Imaaraadka Carabta, Israa’iil iyo Itoobiya qayb ka noqon karaan. Waxa ay tilmaanay in Sucuudiga, oo danaynaya sugidda amniga Badda Cas iyo badbaadada marinnada ganacsiga, uu Berbera ka heli karo fursad uu ku xoojiyo la-socodka khataraha badda iyo iskaashiga amni ee gobolka. Sidoo kale, waxa lagu xusay in dawladda Imaaraadka Carabta, oo maalgashi ku leh Dekedda Berbera ay danaynayso ilaalinta kaabeyaasha ganacsiga iyo fududaynta isu-socodka maraakiibta. Dhinaca kale, daraasaddu waxay tilmaantay in Israa’iil oo si rasmi ah u aqoonsatay Somaliland ay tahay lammaane door weyn ka ka qaadan kara horumarinta tiknoolajiyada la-socodka iyo xogta digniinta hore, halka Itoobiya ay danaynayso marin ganacsi oo badeed oo la isku hallayn karo, maaddaama aanay lahayn xeeb badeed. Sidoo kale daraasaddu waxay iftiimisay isku-darka danahaasi, haddii ay hirgalaan in ay Berbera siin karaa kaalinta xarun ganacsi iyo iskaashi amni oo gobolka ah. Guntii iyo gabagabadii daraasadda Jerusalem Center for Security and Foreign Affairs waxay Somaliland iyo Dekedda Berbera u soo bandhigaysaa hanti juqraafiyeed oo door muhiim ah ka ciyaari karta dadaallada lagu xoojinayo amniga Badda Cas. Iyada oo tilmaanay in fursadda ugu weyn ee Somaliland, ay noqonayso inay muhiimadda juqraafiyeed ee Berbera u beddesho horumar dhaqaale, maalgashi waara, shaqo-abuur iyo iskaashi caalami ah oo la taaban karo, iyadoo mudnaanta la siinayo ilaalinta danaha qaranka iyo nabadgelyada gobolka.
items.fullContent: Daraasad cusub oo ay soo saartay xarunta cilmi-baadhista ee Jerusalem Center for Security and Foreign Affairs ayaa sheegtay in Dawladda Sucuudi Arabiya ay Somaliland u aragto lammaane istaraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah sugidda amniga Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Baab al-Mandab. Falanqayntan khubarada xarunta JCFA, waxay si gaar ah u iftiiminaysaa muhiimadda juqraafiyeed ee Somaliland iyo doorka ay Dekedda Berbera ka qaadan karto ilaalinta marinnada ganacsiga, la-socodka dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta iyo xoojinta iskaashiga amniga badda Daraasaddu waxay sheegtay in Somaliland ay leedahay door istaraatiiji ah oo sii kordhaya oo ku saabsan amniga Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Baab al-Mandab, iyadoo ay sii xoogaysanayaan walaacyada gobolka ee la xidhiidha weerarrada Xuutiyiinta, amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo tartanka quwadaha caalamiga ah ee Geeska Afrika. Waxaanay xustay in arrintani ay Somaliland u abuuri karto fursado cusub oo la ku salaysan dhinacyada maalgashiga, horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo ballaadhinta xidhiidhada caalamiga ah. Isla markaana ay suuragelin karto iskaashi cusub oo ku saabsan amniga badda iyo ganacsiga gobolka. Daraasadu waxay tilmaantayin Somaliland ay leedahay fursad ay ku xoojiso kaalinteeda gobolka, maaddaama ay ku taallo meel muhiim u ah isu-socodka maraakiibta isku xidha Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Taas oo ay ku tilmaantay sababta dhabta ah ee ay tahay in dawladda Sucuudigu ay tixgeliyo iskaashi dhinaca amniga badda ah oo ay xarun u noqoto Dekedda Berbera. Sidoo kale Daraasaddu waxay Dekedda Berbera iyo Gegida Diyaaradaha Caalamiga ah ee Berbera ku tilmaamaysaa kaabayaal Somaliland siinaya muhiimad gaar ah marka la eego amniga badda iyo isku-xidhka ganacsiga gobolka. Waxa kale oo ay sheegtay in goobta istaraatiijiga ha ee ay Somaliland kaga taallo Gacanka Cadmeed ay u sahlayso inay door ka qaadato la-socodka dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta, ilaalinta marinnada ganacsiga iyo hawlgallada lagu xoojinayo badbaadada badda. Qodobka ugu mudan ee daraasaddu soo bandhigayso waa qorshaha ay ugu yeedhay venture sovereignty, taas oo macnaheedu yahay in Somaliland lagu qiimeeyo awooddeeda maamul, xasilloonideeda hay’adeed, goobta ay ku taallo iyo awoodda ay u leedahay inay fududayso hawlgallada ganacsi iyo kuwa amniga ee badda. items.title: Madaxweynaha Somaliland oo kulan la yeeshay madaxdii uu dhawaan xilalka u magacaabay
items.description: 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐤𝐮𝐥𝐚𝐧 𝐝𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐧 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐝𝐚𝐫-𝐝𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐡 𝐥𝐚 𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐲 𝐒𝐚𝐟𝐢𝐢𝐫𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐚, 𝐄𝐫𝐠𝐚𝐲𝐠𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐒𝐚𝐟𝐢𝐢𝐫-𝐤𝐮-𝐱𝐢𝐠𝐞𝐞𝐧𝐧𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐮𝐮 𝐝𝐡𝐚𝐰𝐚𝐚𝐧 𝐱𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐮 𝐦𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐜𝐚𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐲. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa kulan dardaaran iyo dardargelin hawleed ah la yeeshay Safiirrada, Ergayga iyo Safiir-ku-xigeennada uu dhawaan xilalka u magacaabay, isaga oo adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in xilalka diblomaasiyadeed loo guto si hufan, masuuliyad leh, isla markaana ku dhisan ilaalinta danaha, karaamada iyo sumcadda Qaranka JSL. Madaxweynaha waxa kulanka ku wehelinayey Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibedda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee JSL, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Daahir Aadan Bakaal. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu xusay in xilalka Danjirennimadu aanay ku koobnayn metelaad rasmi ah oo keliya, balse ay yihiin masuuliyado Qaran oo xambaarsan magaca, jiritaanka dawladnimo, danaha istiraatiijiga ah iyo himilooyinka mustaqbalka ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Waxa uu tilmaamay in xilalkaasi leeyihiin miisaan gaar ah, xilli ay bulshada caalamku si weyn ugu baraarugayso xaqiiqada dalnimo, dawladnimo iyo kaalinta istiraatiijiga ah ee ay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ku leedahay gobolka iyo dunida. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu masuuliyiintan kula dardaarmay in ay xilalkooda u gutaan si xilkasnimo, karti, daacadnimo iyo haybad Qaran leh, isla markaana ay xoojiyaan xidhiidhka diblomaasiyadeed ee ay la leeyihiin waddamada loo igmaday, iyaga oo mudnaanta siinaya is-fahamka, iskaashiga, dano-wadaagga iyo kobcinta xidhiidho caalami ah oo wax-ku-ool ah oo Somaliland u horseeda fursado diblomaasiyadeed, siyaasadeed, dhaqaale iyo horumarineed. Madaxweynaha JSL waxa kale oo uu Danjireyaasha ku adkeeyey in ay door muhiim ah ka qaataan mideynta iyo isku xidhka Jaaliyadaha reer Somaliland ee ku nool waddamada ay Qaranka wakiilka uga yihiin, si loo xoojiyo wadajirka bulshada, loo kobciyo ka qayb qaadashadooda hawlaha Qaranka, loona mideeyo awooddooda, waayo-aragnimadooda iyo xidhiidhadooda caalamiga ah si ay ugu adeegaan danaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Dhankooda, Safiirrada, Ergayga iyo Safiir-ku-xigeennadu waxa ay Madaxweynaha u xaqiijiyeen sida ay uga go’an tahay gudashada waajibaadka diblomaasiyadeed ee loo igmaday, iyaga oo ballanqaaday in ay xilalkooda u gudan doonaan si daacadnimo, xilkasnimo, karti iyo hufnaan leh, mar walbana ay mudnaanta koowaad siin doonaan ilaalinta danaha, karaamada iyo sumcadda Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isla markaana ay si joogto ah uga shaqayn doonaan xaqiijinta himilooyinka diblomaasiyadeed iyo danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee uu leeyahay Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland.

items.title: Mooto Fekon ayaa HirShabelle laga qaadan doonaa sida K/Galbeed, sidaas waxaa yiri..
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Maalik Cabdalla oo beeshiisa Xawaadle ay tabasho xooggan ka qabto arrimaha maamulka HirShabelle ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed ee maamulkaasi, gaar ahaan hannaanka doorashooyinka, isaga oo diray digniin culus. Maalik Cabdalla oo wariyeyaasha kula hadlay bannaanka xarunta Golaha Shacabka ayaa sheegay in khilaafka ka taagan maamulka HirShabelle uu horseedi karo xaalad la mid ah tan ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Sidoo kale wuxuu tilmaamay in mootooyinka Fekon-ta laga qaadan doono HirShabelle, sida ka dhacday Koonfur Galbeed oo meelo kamid ah ay la wareegeen ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. “War ummadda maskaxdeeda yaan lagu ciyaarin Koonfur Galbeed waxa ka socda waad ogtihiin arrintan waxay dhaleysaa waxa ka socda Koonfur Galbeed mootooyin ayaa laga qaadanayaa HirShabelle,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Maalik Cabdalla. Waxaa kale oo uu sheegay inay si cad uga soo horjeedaan waxa uu ku tilmaamay ‘doorasho ku sheega ka socda HirShabelle’, isaga oo ku adkeystay inaysan aqbali doonin hannaan aan sharciyad ku dhisnayn. “Annaga waxaan diidnay wax aan raalli ka ahayn oo aan sharciga ku dhisneyn, waxaana u taaganahay danteenna iyo arrimaheenna, waana iska diidnay wax meeshaas laga wado,” ayuu raaciyay. HirShabelle ayaa la filayaa in dhawaan ay ka dhacaan doorashada madaxweynaha, ku xigeenkiisa iyo tan guddoonka sare ee Baarlamaanka, kuwaas oo uu hareeyay khilaaf siyaasadeed oo u dhexeeya dhinacyada ku loolamaya hoggaanka sare ee maamulkaasi. The post Mooto Fekon ayaa HirShabelle laga qaadan doonaa sida K/Galbeed, sidaas waxaa yiri.. appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: City Memo Hargeisa like a local
items.description: Resilience is victory,” goes a famous Somali proverb, and few places embody it like Hargeisa. Turned to rubble by intense bombings during a decade-long war with Somalia, this Somaliland city was rebuilt through domestic grit and community labour. Somaliland, a breakaway region of Somalia that has enjoyed effective autonomy since it declared independence in 1991, is my home away from home. It is where my mother spent her early childhood and where some of my extended family still live. Though I was born in Bonn, Germany, and grew up in London, where I joined Reuters as a social media editor in 2019, I have regularly visited Hargeisa. Every time, I wish I had stayed longer. Hargeisa translates as “the place where hides are sold” in Somali, and livestock remains the backbone of the economy, alongside remittances. But it is also a city where old meets new: People buy and sell lambs and goats through their phones, using mobile money to pay for food, clothing and much else. Here’s how to experience Hargeisa like a local: Getting around: Somaliland is a devoutly Muslim place where days start early, with the first call to prayer before sunrise acting as a natural alarm for many residents. Walking is a great way to take in the atmosphere of the city. Though be warned: Roads and driving can be chaotic. Everyone is in a rush, so be aware of your surroundings and be mindful of manoeuvring cars, buses, motorbikes and even the occasional determined man with a wheelbarrow. Item 1 of 17 People shop at an open-air market along a street in Hargeisa, Somaliland, a breakaway region of Somalia that has enjoyed effective autonomy since it declared independence in 1991. REUTERS/Mohamed Ahmed [1/17]People shop at an open-air market along a street in Hargeisa, Somaliland, a breakaway region of Somalia that has enjoyed effective autonomy since it declared independence in 1991. REUTERS/Mohamed Ahmed For a more local experience, take a minibus. It’s a hail and ride system, so just flag down the bus as you would a taxi, confirm it’s going to your destination, and let the driver know when you want to get off. Note that they can often be crowded. For journeys outside of the centre, take a taxi or Dhaweeye, which translates as “closer” in English. They are always nearby and easily flagged off the street. Mobile money is king: As is the case in many African cities, mobile money is the preferred payment method in Hargeisa and to pay for anything you will need your phone. You don’t need internet access; just ask which code to use and for the vendor’s number. You can also pay with cash, of course, but it may take a bit longer. What to eat and drink: Many people make a living by selling their wares on the street. As you walk around the city, you will be called into restaurants and street stalls, where fruit sellers pile watermelons as tall as a person, and vendors fry potatoes. Camel meat and camel milk are must-tries. Somalis have been eating camel for centuries, a tradition rooted in the land’s arid landscape. When crops and cattle perished, camels were the only ones to survive. For a traditional snack on the go, try dried camel meat, called muqmaad. Walking is a great way to take in the atmosphere of the city. Though be warned: Roads and driving can be chaotic. For breakfast, people enjoy stir-fried goat, lamb or beef liver with Somali pancakes (lahoox), or a flaky flatbread with honey that goes well with shaax, a spiced, aromatic tea made with camel milk that tastes very similar to chai. A favourite lunch is fragrant Somali rice (bariis) and meat, typically tender, bone-in goat or lamb — with a banana on the side. Tea is at the heart of social life in Hargeisa, and you will regularly see people sitting outside tea houses, drinking and talking politics. With Ethiopia next door, you are never far from a good cup of coffee either. Try Social Cafe, one of several cafes in the city or, for a Somali twist, order Qaxwo, made with spices such as ginger, cinnamon and cardamom. City landmarks: The Hargeisa War Memorial features a downed Somali Air Force MiG-17 aircraft. Located in Freedom Square, it is probably the city’s most recognisable landmark. The livestock market offers a glimpse into one of the city’s main economic drivers, and is particularly interesting if you have never experienced the pastoral side of Somali culture. You’ll see large numbers of goats, sheep and camels being sold. Go in the morning to see it at its busiest. If you are looking for entertainment, stop by the Hiddo Dhawr Cultural Centre. Founded in 2013 by Somali singer and activist Sahra Halgan, it often features live performances of Somali music and poetry. For an authentic shopping experience, visit the Waheen Market, the city’s main commercial market, where you will find everything from mattresses and glassware to gold jewellery. It’s also a great place to pick up a souvenir. One popular option is a dhill, a traditional wooden vessel used to store milk, usually adorned with leather straps and cowrie shells. Another is frankincense, an aromatic resin. Somaliland is one of the few places in the world where frankincense grows naturally. The gum is chewed for its health benefits, while the resin is traditionally burned to freshen homes and welcome guests. items.fullContent: Resilience is victory,” goes a famous Somali proverb, and few places embody it like Hargeisa. Turned to rubble by intense bombings during a decade-long war with Somalia, this Somaliland city was rebuilt through domestic grit and community labour. Somaliland, a breakaway region of Somalia that has enjoyed effective autonomy since it declared independence in 1991, is my home away from home. It is where my mother spent her early childhood and where some of my extended family still live. Though I was born in Bonn, Germany, and grew up in London, where I joined Reuters as a social media editor in 2019, I have regularly visited Hargeisa. Every time, I wish I had stayed longer. Hargeisa translates as “the place where hides are sold” in Somali, and livestock remains the backbone of the economy, alongside remittances. But it is also a city where old meets new: People buy and sell lambs and goats through their phones, using mobile money to pay for food, clothing and much else. Here’s how to experience Hargeisa like a local: Getting around: Somaliland is a devoutly Muslim place where days start early, with the first call to prayer before sunrise acting as a natural alarm for many residents. Walking is a great way to take in the atmosphere of the city. Though be warned: Roads and driving can be chaotic. Everyone is in a rush, so be aware of your surroundings and be mindful of manoeuvring cars, buses, motorbikes and even the occasional determined man with a wheelbarrow. As you walk around the city, you will be called into restaurants and street stalls, where fruit sellers pile watermelons as tall as a person, and vendors fry potatoes. When crops and cattle perished, camels were the only ones to survive. For a traditional snack on the go, try dried camel meat, called muqmaad. A favourite lunch is fragrant Somali rice (bariis) and meat, typically tender, bone-in goat or lamb — with a banana on the side. Tea is at the heart of social life in Hargeisa, and you will regularly see people sitting outside tea houses, drinking and talking politics. With Ethiopia next door, you are never far from a good cup of coffee either. Try Social Cafe, one of several cafes in the city or, for a Somali twist, order Qaxwo, made with spices such as ginger, cinnamon and cardamom. The livestock market offers a glimpse into one of the city’s main economic drivers, and is particularly interesting if you have never experienced the pastoral side of Somali culture. You’ll see large numbers of goats, sheep and camels being sold. Go in the morning to see it at its busiest. If you are looking for entertainment, stop by the Hiddo Dhawr Cultural Centre. items.title: Ciidanka Itoobiya oo lagu eedeeyey in ay fududeeyeen qabsashadii degmooyinka K/G
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Iyadoo ay faraha kasii baxayso xaaladda amni ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa waxaa su’aalo laga keenay doorka Itoobiya ee qalalaasaha ka jira maamulkaasi, maadaama ciidamadooda ay joogaan gobollada Baay iyo Bakool oo kamid ah meelaha ay ka jiraan colaadaha iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ciidan. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay qeyb ka tahay xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo amni ee ka taagan deegaannada maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, iyadoo walaac laga muujiyay dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ciidamadeeda iyo saameynta ay ku yeelan karaan xasilloonida gobolka. Xogahaa la helay ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada Itoobiya oo jooga ay maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo lagu tilmaamay Al-Shabaab ay qabsadeen magaalooyin ay kamid tahay Buurhakaba, taas oo bannaanka keentay inay ka gaabsadeen difaacidda amniga degmooyinka ay ka howlgaan. Koonfur Galbeed ayaa waxaa xilligan ka jira iska horimaadyo u dhexeya ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa kale oo taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee maamulkaas, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen), waxaana xaaladda amni ee deegaanno ka tirsan gobollada Bay, Bakool iyo Shabeellaha Hoose ay tahay mid cakiran. Warbixin lagu daabacay Red Sea Axis oo soo xiganayo ilo maxalli ah ayaa sheegaysa in ciidamada Itoobiya ay si kutala-gal ah uga baxeen magaalooyin katirsan gobolka Baay, iyagoo u fududeeyay inay la wareegaan maleeshiyaadka hubeysan. In Ciidamada Itoobiya ka baxaan saldhigyo markii hore si dhib badan Al-Shabaab looga saaray ayaa warbixintu sheegtay inay tahay arint khatar ah oo wiiqaysa dadaalladii saaxibada caalamka ee taageerada siiya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dowlad-dhiska iyo mlaagelintii dhaqaale ee Midowga Yurub oo tan iyo 2007-dii. Sidoo kale, warbixinta ayaa iftiimeysay in Imaaraadka Carabta uu ku lug leeyahay dagaalka, uuna maalgelinayo dagaalka Koonfur Gabeed, si usii huriyo colaadda ka taagan halkaasi. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Arrimahan ayaa walaac xooggan abuuraya, maadaama Itoobiya ay dhawaan kasoo horjeysatay shirkii Masar ka dhacay ee Amniga Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika looga hadlay, iyadoo maqaal lagu daabacay Wakalaadda Wararka Itoobiya eedeyn culus loogu jeediyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo ka qayb-galay shirkaasi. items.title: Koonfur Galbeed: Dagaal, Barakac iyo Daadad Isbiirsaday oo Halis ku Haya Boqollaal Kun oo Shacab ah
items.description: BAYDHABO (Goobjoog News) — Ciidamada taageersan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen), ayaa ku fiday magaalooyin iyo degaanno hor leh oo ka tirsan gobolka Bay, taas oo colaaddii markii hore ku koobnayd magaalada Baydhabo u beddeshay loollan ballaaran oo saameyn taban ku yeeshay shacabka, isusocodka iyo hawlihii bani’aadannimada. Xafiiska Laftagareen ayaa shaaciyay in ciidankiisu la wareegeen gacan ku haynta afarta degmo ee Qansaxdheere, Buurhakaba, Bardaale iyo Diinsoor, iyo weliba degaanka Awdiinle. Xogta ay xaqiijisay Goobjoog News ayaa caddaynaysa in ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen ay toos ula wareegeen degmooyinka Qansaxdheere, Buurhakaba iyo Bardaale. Warar madaxbannaan ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya inay galeen degaanka Awdiinle, halka xaaladda degmada Diinsoor aysan weli helin xaqiijin madaxbannaan oo dhammaystiran. Qansaxdheere ayaa ahayd magaaladii ugu horraysay ee la xaqiijiyay in ciidamada Laftagareen ay qabsadeen. Dhanka kale, Buurhakaba waxaa lagu qabsaday dagaal toos ah oo dhexmaray ciidamadaas iyo kuwa taageersan Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo maamulka cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed, halka Bardaale ay ciidamadu galeen kaddib markii xoogaggii hore ugu sugnaa ay faarujiyeen fariisimahoodii. Magaalada Buurhakaba waxay ku taallaa jidka halbowlaha ah ee isku xira Muqdisho iyo Baydhabo, halka Bardaale iyo Awdiinle ay ku dhow yihiin marinnada galbeed ee laga soo galo caasimadda gobolka Bay. Isbeddelka gacan ku haynta degaannadan ayaa halis toos ah ku ah isusocodka shacabka, dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga, daabulidda ciidamada iyo sahayda gargaarka degdegga ah. Hasayeeshee, gelitaanka ciidamadani magaalooyinka mar kasta macnaheedu ma aha inay heleen maamul buuxa oo deggan. Waxaa weli muhiim ah in la xaqiijiyo cidda gacanta ku haysa xarumaha maamulka degmooyinka iyo saldhigyada booliska, in hay’adihii rayidka ahaa ay shaqaynayaan iyo in gaadiidka shacabka iyo kan hay’adaha gargaarku ay si nabad ah waddooyinka u isticmaali karaan. Asalka Xiisadda iyo Loollanka Sharciyadda Xiisadda hadda cirka isku shareertay ayaa salka ku haysa khilaaf siyaasadeed oo muddo soo jiitamayay, kaas oo u dhexeeyay Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Cabdicasiis Laftagareen. Ciidamada federaalka ayaa 30kii Maarso 2026 si buuxda ula wareegay ammaanka magaalada Baydhabo, tallaabadaas oo keentay in Laftagareen uu shaaciyo inuu xilka ka degay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wuxuu markii dambe caddeeyay in tallaabadaas lagu khasbay, isagoo weli sheeganaya inuu yahay hoggaamiyaha sharciga ah ee Koonfur Galbeed. Bishii Juun ee sannadkan, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa loo doortay hoggaanka Koonfur Galbeed, waxaana maamulkiisa si rasmi ah u aqoonsatay Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. Dhaqdhaqaaqyada cusub ee ciidamada Laftagareen waxay muujinayaan in murankii sharciyadda hoggaanku uu hadda u xuubsiibtay loollan dhuleed iyo iska horimaad hubaysan oo fool ka fool ah. Khasaaraha ka Dhashay Dagaalka Khasaaraha bani’aadannimo ee ka dhashay colaadda ayaa durba si cad u muuqda. Dagaal ka dhacay gudaha magaalada Baydhabo bishii Agoosto waxaa ku dhintay ugu yaraan afar qof oo rayid ah, halka 98 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Iska horimaad kale oo dhacay bishii Sebteembar ayaa Isbitaalka Guud ee Gobolka Bay la geeyay 71 qof oo dhaawac ah, oo ay ku jireen 15 dumar ah, halka qof rayid ahi uu ku geeriyooday. Tirada dadka ku dhintay ama ku dhaawacmay dagaalladii ugu dambeeyay ee ka dhacay Qansaxdheere, Buurhakaba iyo degaannada kale ee ku xeeran weli si rasmi ah looma shaacin. Sidoo kale, weli lama hayo tirakoob rasmi ah oo ku saabsan qoysaska cusub ee ku barakacay, guryaha burburay iyo xarumaha adeegyada caafimaadka ama waxbarashada ee la xiray. Magaalada Baydhabo oo keliya waxaa ku nool qiyaastii 700,000 oo qof oo barakacayaal ah, kuwaas oo noloshoodu si buuxda ugu tiirsan tahay gargaarka cuntada, biyaha nadiifka ah iyo adeegyada caafimaadka. Dadkan ayaa markii hore ka soo cararay abaaro ba’an, macaluul iyo degaannada ay maamusho Al-Shabaab, waxaana hadda xaaladdoodii hore ugu soo darsantay cabsi xooggan oo ka dhalatay dagaallada u dhexeeya ciidamada dawladda iyo xoogagga taageersan Laftagareen. Culayska Hay’adaha Gargaarka iyo Isbitaallada Isbeddelka gacan ku haynta magaalooyinka iyo xirnaanshaha jidadka ayaa hakad xooggan gelin kara hawlihii gargaarka. Degmada Buurhakaba waxay horeba uga mid ahayd magaalooyinka ay go’doomiyeen xannibaadaha Al-Shabaab, taas oo hay’adaha bani’aadannimada ku qasbi jirtay inay gargaarka degdegga ah ku gaarsiiyaan duulimaadyo diyaaradeed oo kharash badan ku baxo. Dagaallo cusub ama weerarro rogaalcelis ah waxay meesha ka saari karaan awooddii koobnayd ee hay’adaha gargaarku ku bixinayeen cuntada, biyaha iyo dawooyinka. Dhanka kale, isbitaallada gobolka Bay ayaa wajahaya culays xad-dhaaf ah, iyadoo dhaawacyada dagaalku ay kuraasta, sariiraha iyo dawooyinka kooban la qaybsanayaan carruurta nafaqodarradu hayso, hooyooyinka uurka leh iyo bukaannada kale ee qaba xaaladaha degdegga ah. Khatarta Daadadka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada Colaaddan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli roobabkii Deyrta ee lala xiriiriyay ifafaalaha cimilada ee El Niño ay ka da’een qaybo ka mid ah gobolka, taas oo kordhisay khatarta fatahaado baaxad leh. Roobabkan xooggan waxay goyn karaan waddooyinka, waxay burbur u geysan karaan guryaha iyo xeryaha barakacayaasha, waxayna hakad gelin karaan hawlihii gurmadka degdegga ah. Isbiirsashada dagaalka, barakaca iyo fatahaaduhu waxay dhalin karaan musiibo bani’aadannimo oo aad uga darran tii hore. Qoysaskii hore uga soo cararay dagaallada ayaa halis ugu jira inay mar labaad daadadku ka qaxiyaan xeryaha, halka hay’adaha samafalka ay ku adkaanayso inay gaaraan degaannada ay waddooyinkoodu go’een ama ay ku sugan yihiin kooxaha hubaysani. Dadka ugu nugul waxaa ka mid ah carruurta nafaqadarrada la il daran, haweenka uurka leh, waayeelka iyo bulshada ku nool xeryaha barakacayaasha. Fatahaaduhu waxay sidoo kale wasaqayn karaan ilaha biyaha laga cabbo, iyagoo dhulka ku reebaya dac sare u qaadaya halista cudurrada dillaaca, sida daacuunka, shubanka ba’an iyo duumada. Haddii dagaalku sii socdo, fatahaaduhuna ka sii daraan, gobolka Bay wuxuu isku mar wajihi karaa barakac cusub, cuntoyari daran iyo cudurro faafa. Shacabka rayidka ah ayaa noqonaya dhibbaneyaasha ugu weyn ee qaadaya cawaaqibta colaadda iyo masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah. Sidaas darteed, xal siyaasadeed oo degdeg ah ayaa lagama maarmaan u ah badbaadinta nolosha malaayiin qof.

Dagaal ka dhacay gudaha magaalada Baydhabo bishii Agoosto waxaa ku dhintay ugu yaraan afar qof oo rayid ah, halka 98 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Iska horimaad kale oo dhacay bishii Sebteembar ayaa Isbitaalka Guud ee Gobolka Bay la geeyay 71 qof oo dhaawac ah, oo ay ku jireen 15 dumar ah, halka qof rayid ahi uu ku geeriyooday. Tirada dadka ku dhintay ama ku dhaawacmay dagaalladii ugu dambeeyay ee ka dhacay Qansaxdheere, Buurhakaba iyo degaannada kale ee ku xeeran weli si rasmi ah looma shaacin. Sidoo kale, weli lama hayo tirakoob rasmi ah oo ku saabsan qoysaska cusub ee ku barakacay, guryaha burburay iyo xarumaha adeegyada caafimaadka ama waxbarashada ee la xiray. Magaalada Baydhabo oo keliya waxaa ku nool qiyaastii 700,000 oo qof oo barakacayaal ah, kuwaas oo noloshoodu si buuxda ugu tiirsan tahay gargaarka cuntada, biyaha nadiifka ah iyo adeegyada caafimaadka. Dadkan ayaa markii hore ka soo cararay abaaro ba’an, macaluul iyo degaannada ay maamusho Al-Shabaab, waxaana hadda xaaladdoodii hore ugu soo darsantay cabsi xooggan oo ka dhalatay dagaallada u dhexeeya ciidamada dawladda iyo xoogagga taageersan Laftagareen. Culayska Hay’adaha Gargaarka iyo Isbitaallada Isbeddelka gacan ku haynta magaalooyinka iyo xirnaanshaha jidadka ayaa hakad xooggan gelin kara hawlihii gargaarka. Degmada Buurhakaba waxay horeba uga mid ahayd magaalooyinka ay go’doomiyeen xannibaadaha Al-Shabaab, taas oo hay’adaha bani’aadannimada ku qasbi jirtay inay gargaarka degdegga ah ku gaarsiiyaan duulimaadyo diyaaradeed oo kharash badan ku baxo. Dagaallo cusub ama weerarro rogaalcelis ah waxay meesha ka saari karaan awooddii koobnayd ee hay’adaha gargaarku ku bixinayeen cuntada, biyaha iyo dawooyinka. Dhanka kale, isbitaallada gobolka Bay ayaa wajahaya culays xad-dhaaf ah, iyadoo dhaawacyada dagaalku ay kuraasta, sariiraha iyo dawooyinka kooban la qaybsanayaan carruurta nafaqodarradu hayso, hooyooyinka uurka leh iyo bukaannada kale ee qaba xaaladaha degdegga ah. Khatarta Daadadka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada Colaaddan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli roobabkii Deyrta ee lala xiriiriyay ifafaalaha cimilada ee El Niño ay ka da’een qaybo ka mid ah gobolka, taas oo kordhisay khatarta fatahaado baaxad leh. Roobabkan xooggan waxay goyn karaan waddooyinka, waxay burbur u geysan karaan guryaha iyo xeryaha barakacayaasha, waxayna hakad gelin karaan hawlihii gurmadka degdegga ah. Isbiirsashada dagaalka, barakaca iyo fatahaaduhu waxay dhalin karaan musiibo bani’aadannimo oo aad uga darran tii hore. Qoysaskii hore uga soo cararay dagaallada ayaa halis ugu jira inay mar labaad daadadku ka qaxiyaan xeryaha, halka hay’adaha samafalka ay ku adkaanayso inay gaaraan degaannada ay waddooyinkoodu go’een ama ay ku sugan yihiin kooxaha hubaysani. Dadka ugu nugul waxaa ka mid ah carruurta nafaqadarrada la il daran, haweenka uurka leh, waayeelka iyo bulshada ku nool xeryaha barakacayaasha. Fatahaaduhu waxay sidoo kale wasaqayn karaan ilaha biyaha laga cabbo, iyagoo dhulka ku reebaya dac sare u qaadaya halista cudurrada dillaaca, sida daacuunka, shubanka ba’an iyo duumada. Haddii dagaalku sii socdo, fatahaaduhuna ka sii daraan, gobolka Bay wuxuu isku mar wajihi karaa barakac cusub, cuntoyari daran iyo cudurro faafa. Shacabka rayidka ah ayaa noqonaya dhibbaneyaasha ugu weyn ee qaadaya cawaaqibta colaadda iyo masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah. Sidaas darteed, xal siyaasadeed oo degdeg ah ayaa lagama maarmaan u ah badbaadinta nolosha malaayiin qof.

items.title: Somalia’s government loses all major Bay towns but Baidoa to Laftagaren
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s federal government has lost all major towns in Bay region except Baidoa to forces of former Southwest leader Abdiasis Laftagaren, in a speedy counter-offensive that has unexpectedly reversed the gains it made in an offensive in March, when it toppled him as regional president. Laftagaren’s forces seized Burhakabo, Dinsor, Berdale and Awdinle towns on Thursday and Friday, days after taking the town of Qansah-dhere, leaving Baidoa as the only town in the region still under the federal government. Laftagaren, who regards himself as the legitimate regional president and still maintains his cabinet and other regional officials, praised his forces for their success on the ground. Although he left Somalia after being toppled in March and made his home in Kenya, his Darwish forces launched guerrilla warfare against the federal forces that captured most of the region, carrying out dozens of attacks across Bay region. Many other towns in Southwest State, including Baidoa itself and Wajid, are feared to fall in the coming days and weeks. Reports say there are negotiations to hand over Baidoa to Laftagaren’s forces, but there is no independent confirmation. Laftagaren said on Thursday that Turkish F-16 fighter jets have continued pounding areas near Baidoa and other parts of Southwest State since March, killing many civilians and destroying property. The regional government that the federal government installed in Baidoa under Adan Madobe, after toppling Laftagaren with Turkish air support, appears to be taking a heavy beating and falling gradually under the lightning-speed blows of the former regional administration’s forces. Somalia’s crisis is getting out of control. The federal president has extended his term, and regional states and the opposition are at odds with him over delayed elections and his refusal to engage them in talks on the deadlock over the upcoming elections, including the timetable, how they will be held and everything else. items.title: INTERPOL oo diiwaangelisay 34 qof oo looga shakisan yahay falal argagixiso magaalada Boosaaso
items.description: Hay’adda Booliska Caalamiga ah ee INTERPOL ayaa magaalada Boosaaso ee maamulka Puntland ka diiwaangelisay 34 qof oo looga shakisan yahay inay ku lug leeyihiin dambiyo la xiriira argagixisada, intii uu socday howlgal lagu xoojinayo baaritaannada dembiyada iyo ururinta caddeymaha faraha. Howlgalkan ayaa waxaa iska kaashaday INTERPOL, Ciidanka Booliska Badda Puntland (PMPF) iyo hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya, iyadoo diiradda la saaray horumarinta adeegsiga xogta aqoonsiga qofka ee laga helo faraha iyo xoojinta wadaagga xogaha sirdoonka. Intii uu howlgalka socday, khabiir ka tirsan INTERPOL oo ku takhasusay baaritaanka faraha ayaa saraakiisha Soomaaliyeed siiyey tababar ku saabsan adeegsiga qalab casri ah oo lagu ururiyo, lagu aqoonsado, laguna farsameeyo xogta faraha dadka looga shakiyo dambiyada. Tababarka kaddib, saraakiisha ayaa booqday laba xarumood oo lagu hayo maxaabiista, halkaas oo ay ku sameeyeen layliyo la xiriira ururinta xogta faraha iyo ballaarinta diiwaannada baaritaannada dembiyada. INTERPOL ayaa sheegtay in tallaabooyinkan ay gacan ka geysanayaan isku xirka xogaha amniga ee dalalka kala duwan, si hay’adaha sharciga u fuliya ay si wanaagsan ugu aqoonsadaan dadka looga shakisan yahay dambiyada, ugana taageeraan baaritaannada la xiriira argagixisada. Howlgalku sidoo kale wuxuu ka koobnaa taageero farsamo oo la siiyey saraakiisha Soomaaliyeed ee diyaarinaya baaritaanka markabka MT Honour 25, kaas oo horay loogu afduubtay weerar burcad-badeednimo. INTERPOL ayaa saraakiisha siisay tilmaamo ku saabsan sida habboon ee loo baakadeeyo loona sugo caddeymaha laga soo ururinayo markabka, ka hor inta aan loo gudbin shaybaar baaritaan dambiyeed, si loo baaro faraha laga yaabo inay caddeyn muhiim ah noqdaan. Arrintan ayaa muujinaysa doorka ay caddeymaha farsamo ee baaritaanka dembiyadu ku leeyihiin la dagaallanka burcad-badeednimada iyo dambiyada ka gudba xuduudaha, gaar ahaan xeebaha Soomaaliya oo ay weli ka jiraan walaacyo la xiriira amniga badda. Howlgalkan ka dhacay Boosaaso ayaa qayb ka ah iskaashiga ballaaran ee INTERPOL iyo hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya, kaas oo lagu xoojinayo awoodda baaritaanka dembiyada, wadaagga xogaha sirdoonka iyo la dagaallanka argagixisada iyo dambiyada abaabulan.

items.title: Jeneraal Indha-Qarshe oo taariikh cusub dhigay kadib markii uu gaaray…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa dalacsiiyay Taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Daahir Aadan Cilmi (Indha-Qarshe), isaga oo u dallacsiiyay darajada Sarreeye Guud. Dalacsiintan ayaa ka dhigaysa Jeneraal Indha-Qarshe sarkaalkii saddexaad ee taariikhda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed gaara darajadaas. Indha-Qarshe waxaa darajadan kaga horreeyay Alle ha u naxariistee Maxamed Cali Samatar iyo Bashiir Maxamed Jaamac (Bashiir Goobe), oo hadda ah Wasiirka Deegaanka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Jeneraalka ayaa labo jeer soo noqday Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, gaar ahaan 2013 iyo 2018 oo uu soo hoggaamiyay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo weli dagaal adag kula jira kooxda Al-Shabaab. Sarreeye Guud Daahir Aadan Cilmi (Indha-Qarshe) ayaa Ciidanka Xoogga ku biiray sannadkii 1968-kii, isaga oo tababbarro ciidan oo kala duwan ku qaatay gudaha dalka iyo dibaddiisa. Sidoo kale, Daahir Indha-Qarshe ayaa door muhiim ah ku lahaa hoggaaminta iyo maamulka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, isaga oo muddo dheer ka soo shaqeeyay arrimaha milatariga. Jeneraal Indha-Qarshe ayaa ku dhashay magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug sannadkii 1948-kii. Waxbarashadiisii aasaasiga ahayd waxa uu ku qaatay magaalooyinka Buulo Burde, Jowhar iyo Muqdisho, ka hor intii uusan u gudbin tababarrada milatari. Dagaalkii Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ee dhacay sannadkii 1977-kii, Indha-Qarshe wuxuu ka mid ahaa saraakiishii hoggaanka u hayay cutubyada madaafiicda ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo ka qayb qaatay howlgalladii milatari ee xilligaas. Intii uu dagaalku socday, ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ayaa la wareegay magaalooyinka Qabri Dahare iyo Dhagaxbuur ee dhulka Soomaali Galbeed, halkaas oo Indha-Qarshe uu ka qayb ahaa saraakiishii ku lugta lahaa dagaalladaas. Daahir Indha-Qarshe ayaa sidoo kale haysta billadda geesiga oo dowladdii dhexe ay gudoonsiisay, kadib guulo uu hormuud u ahaa oo xilligaas Soomaaliya ay ka gaartay dagaalkii Itoobiya. Dallacsiintiiisa cusub ayaa timid kadib sannado badan oo uu ka tirsanaa Ciidanka Xoogga, isaga oo ka mid ah saraakiisha khibradda iyo taariikhda dheer ku leh milatariga Soomaaliya. items.title: Wargeyska Boston Globe oo shaaciyey arrinta Trump ku qarinayo beegsiga Soomaalida
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Wargeyska Mareykanka ee The Boston Globe ayaa qormo ra’yi ah oo uu Khamiistii daabacay si adag ugu dhaliilay weerarrada afka ah ee Madaxweyne Donald Trump ku hayo Soomaalida, isagoo ku xiriiriyay jawiga doorashooyinka Congress-ka iyo hoos u dhaca taageerada dadweynaha ee siyaasaddiisa socdaalka. Qormada oo ay qortay Yvonne Abraham ayaa lagu sheegay in Trump uu maalmo xiriir ah weerarro ku qaaday Soomaalida Mareykanka, gaar ahaan kuwa ku nool Minnesota. Qoraaga ayaa ku doodday in arrinta ugu walaaca badan aysan ahayn hadallada madaxweynaha oo keliya, balse ay tahay sida ay qaar ka mid ah taageerayaashiisu ugu riyaaqaan marka bulsho dhan la aflagaadeeyo. Abraham ayaa tusaale u soo qaadatay isu-soo-bax uu Trump Talaadadii ka jeediyay magaalada Wasilla ee gobolka Alaska. Madaxweynaha ayaa halkaas ku eedeeyay Soomaalida inay dhac iyo burbur u geysteen Minnesota, isagoo sidoo kale adeegsaday hadallo meel ka dhac ku ah garaadkooda. Eedeymahaas ayuu u jeediyay guud ahaan Soomaalida, halkii uu ka hadli lahaa shakhsiyaad gaar ah. Hadalka Alaska wuxuu daba socday weerar kale oo uu Trump habeenkii Isniinta ka jeediyay Ohio, halkaas oo uu Soomaalida Minnesota ku tilmaamay dad ka yimid dal aysan dadkiisu xitaa haysan surwaal ay xirtaan. Sidoo kale, qoraal uu madaxweynuhu ku baahiyay baraha bulshada ayuu dadka Minnesota ugu baaqay inay ka hortagaan muhaajiriinta Soomaaliyeed, oo uu ku eedeeyay rabshado iyo qalalaase, isaga oo ballanqaaday taageerada dowladda federaalka. Maalintii uu Trump ka hadlay Ohio, saraakiil federaal ah ayaa baaritaan ku sameeyay guriga xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar ee Washington, iyadoo baaritaanku la xiriiray eedeymo ku saabsan socdaalkeeda. Abraham ayaa qormadeeda ku tilmaantay eedeymahaas kuwo aan sal adag lahayn. Baaritaanka laftiisa ma aha caddeyn muujinaysa in xildhibaannadu dembi gashay. Taageerayaasha Trump oo doodda udub-dhexaad u ah Waxa si gaar ah u soo jiitay qoraaga muuqaal laga duubay taageerayaashii Trump ee ka dambeeyay masraxa Alaska. Waxay tilmaantay haweeney jaakad cas xiratay oo dhoollacaddeyneysay markii Soomaalida la weeraray, gabar koofiyad Trump ah xiratay oo muujisay diidmo, iyo rag kale oo ku faraxsanaa hadallada madaxweynaha. Abraham ayaa falcelintaas ku macneysay astaan muujinaysa sida hadallada lagu beegsanayo muhaajiriintu u helaan taageero siyaasadeed. Waxay Trump ku barbar dhigtay George Wallace, siyaasigii Mareykanka ee caan ku ahaa difaaca kala soocidda midabada, iyadoo adeegsatay isbarbardhig ay ku xustay Nelson Mandela. Qoraaga ayaa ka digtay in dadka taageeraya hadalladan ay bulshada Mareykanka ku sii jiri doonaan xitaa marka Trump xilka ka tago. Dhanka kale, wargeysku wuxuu soo xigtay sahanno tilmaamaya in taageerada siyaasadda socdaalka ee Trump ay yaraatay marka loo eego rajadii qaar ka mid ah cod-bixiyeyaashiisa. Waxay xusuusisay in Trump uu ololihiisii 2024 si cad ugu ballanqaaday masaafurin ballaaran, halka taageerayaashiisu ay siteen boorar ay ku qornaayeen baaq ah in masaafurinta si degdeg ah loo bilaabo. Wuxuu sheegay inay cabsi badan tahay in magaca bulshadooda lala xiriiriyo aflagaado ka imaanaysa qofka ugu awoodda badan dunida. Yusuf, oo Mareykanka yimid 1979-kii, ayaa xaruntaas aasaasay qiyaastii 30 sano ka hor. Waxay caawisaa muhaajiriin dalal kala duwan ka yimid, kuwaas oo ay qaar badan noloshooda ka dhisteen Mareykanka, shaqeysteen, qoysas yeesheen, isla markaana ganacsiyo abuureen. Qoraaga ayaa xustay in dad badan oo muhaajiriin ah ay ka soo carareen dagaallo iyo barakac, soo mareen hannaan dheer oo socdaal, dabadeedna ay nolol cusub ka bilaabeen Mareykanka. items.title: DF oo galabta Muqdisho ku tijaabinaysa hub culus
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa galabta magaalada Muqdisho ku tijaabinaysa hub culus, sida lagu sheegay farriin wargelin ah oo Taliska Ciidanka Booliska u diray shacabka ku dhaqan gudaha caasimadda. Taliyaha Qaybta Guud ee Booliska Gobolka Banaadir, Macallin Mahdi, ayaa sheegay in tijaabada hubka la sameyn doono inta u dhexeysa 2:00 iyo 3:00 galabnimo, isaga oo shacabka u xaqiijiyay in tijaabadaasi aysan waxyeello u geysan doonin muwaadiniinta. “Wargalin Dag Dag ah. Dhawaqa aad maqli doontaan maanta marka ay saacadu tahay 2:00 ilaa 3:00 galabnimo ma ahan dhawaq wax u dhibaya muwaadiinta naf iyo maalba,” ayuu yiri Macallin Mahdi. Sidoo kale, wuxuu shacabka ugu baaqay inay is dejiyaan, dulqaadna muujiyaan inta ay socoto tijaabada hubka dowladda. Ciidamada kala duwan ee dowladda ayaa mararka qaar sameeya tijaabooyin hub ridis ah, iyadoo shacabka horay loogu sii wargeliyo si looga hortago cabsi iyo qalqal amni oo ka dhasha dhawaqa hubka. Haddaba, sidee looga fal-celiyay tijaabada hubkan? Cali Xasan Cismaan: ” Habeenkii tijaabiya maalinki waala soo jeedaa, waana la naxaa”. Mire Cali Mire: “Dhawaqa mid kheyr qaba Alle haka dhigee maxaa waayey taliya Mahdi Cumar Muumin?”. Cabdiraxmaan Xaashi Cabdi: “Hubkii mucaaradka lagu garaaci lahaa miyaa la tijaabinayaa?”. Luul Maxamed: “Turki ayaaa hubkiisa nagu tijaabsanayo u sii raaci uu dalkiisa kala soo cararay”. Cabdiraxmaan Cali Abuukar: “Haddii muwadiniintu dhibaayo maa laga hor tago?”. Amniga magaalada Muqdisho ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyay ahaa mid wanaagsan marka loo eego xaaladihii hore, iyadoo caasimada laga dareemayo xasillooni amni iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyo ganacsi iyo kuwa bulsho oo caadi ah. The post DF oo galabta Muqdisho ku tijaabinaysa hub culus appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo go’aan culus qaadatay kadib degmooyinkii laga qabsaday
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Maamul-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu qaadayo guluf culus oo ka dhan ah ciidanka taabacsan Lafta-gareen ee qabsaday degmooyinka Qansaxdeere, Bardaale, Buurhakaba iyo Diinsoor ee gobolka Baay. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Koonfur Galbeed, Nuur Siidow Baaba oo la hadlay Somali Cable Tv ayaa sheegay in shacabka ay maqli doonaan war ay ku farxaan, isla markaana ay degmooyinkaas la qabsaday ay kusoo celin doonaan gacantooda, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Maalmaha soo socda shacabka reer Koonfur Galbeed waxay dhagahooda maqli doonaan wax ay aad ugu farxaan, waxaana lasoo celin doonaan neecaawdii dowladnimada. Degmooyinka ay hadda ku sugan Khawaarijta waxaa dib loogu soo celin doonaan gacanta dowladda,” ayuu yiri wasiirku. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in maleeshiyaada weerarka soo qaaday ee qabsaday degmooyinka ay yihiin “Deegaannadaas waxaa qabsaday kooxda Al-Shabaab, Insha allah dowladda ayaa dib usoo celin doonta,” ayuu mar kale yiri Wasiirka Warfaafinta Koonfur Galbeed. Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ayaa horay guulo uga sheegtay howlgallo ay ciidamadiisa ugaa fuliyeen gobolka Baay, kuwaas oo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo lagu sugayay amniga, laguna soo celinayay xasilloonida deegaannada. “Ciidanka Daraawiishta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya waxay ku guuleysteen inay dib ula wareegaan oo ay xoreeyaan afar degmo iyo deegaanno muhiim ah oo ka tirsan gobolka Bay,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka xafiiska Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Tallaabooyinka ayaa imaanaya xi lli ay sii xoogeysanayaan khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya ciidamada Lafta-gareen iyo kuwa taageersan maamulka hadda ka jira Baydhaba, oo garab ka helaya dowladda federaalka. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay isbeddello waaweyn ka dhacayaan gobolka Baay, halkaas oo ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen ay maalmihii ugu dambeeyay si isdaba joog ah ula wareegayeen magaalooyin muhiim ah. items.title: Waa kuma Sareeye Guud Daahir Aadan Cilmi (Indhaqarshe) oo uu Saacado Ka Hor Dallacsiiyay Madaxweyne ?
items.description: Sarreeye Guud Daahir Aadan Cilmi, oo loo yaqaanno Indhaqarshe, waa sarkaal sare oo muddo dheer ka tirsanaa Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, kaas oo laba jeer soo noqday taliyaha ciidanka. Wuxuu leeyahay waayo-aragnimo milatari oo dheer, isagoo soo qabtay xilal kala duwan oo la xiriira hoggaaminta, tababarka iyo hawlgallada ciidamada. Daahir Aadan Cilmi ayaa la sheegay inuu ku dhashay sannadkii 1948-kii, wuxuuna waxbarashadiisa hoose ku qaatay magaalada Buulo Burte, halka waxbarashada dhexe uu ku qaatay Jowhar. Dugsiga sare wuxuu ka baxay Dugsiga Banaadir ee Muqdisho, waxaana warbixinnada taariikh-nololeedkiisa qaarkood ay sheegayaan inuu waxbarasho jaamacadeed ku qaatay Jaamacadda Massachusetts Boston ee dalka Mareykanka. Wuxuu ku biiray Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed sannadkii 1968-kii, isaga oo markii dambe tababarro milatari ku qaatay magaalada Odessa ee Midowgii Soofiyeeti, iyo meelo kale oo ay ku jiraan Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka. Mudadii uu ku jiray ciidanka, wuxuu ka soo shaqeeyay qaybo kala duwan oo ka tirsan ciidamada, isaga oo qabtay xilal la xiriira hoggaaminta iyo abaabulka cutubyada milatari. Indhaqarshe wuxuu sidoo kale ka mid ahaa saraakiishii ka qayb qaatay dagaalkii 1977-kii ee u dhexeeyay Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya. Warbixinnada laga qoray taariikhdiisa ayaa sheegaya inuu hoggaaminayay cutubyo gaashaaman oo ka hawlgalay furimaha dagaalka, gaar ahaan agagaarka Qabri-daharre. ,Waxaana lagu maamuusay billad la xiriirta geesinnimada iyo adeegga milatari. Markii ugu horreysay, Daahir Aadan Cilmi waxaa loo magacaabay taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed bishii Maarso 2013-kii, xilkaas oo uu hayay ilaa 2015-kii. Saddex sano kaddib, madaxweynihii xilligaas, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo, ayaa 16-kii Agoosto 2018 mar kale u magacaabay taliyaha ciidanka, isagoo xilka kala wareegay Jeneraal Cabdiweli Jaamac Xuseen (Gorod). Sannadkii 2019-kii ayuu xilka kala wareegay Jeneraal Odawaa Yuusuf Raage, ayadoo Labadii jeer ee uu hoggaaminayay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Indhaqarshe uu ka mid ahaa saraakiishii sare ee loo igmaday maamulka iyo hoggaaminta ciidamada xilli Soomaaliya ay dagaal kula jirtay kooxaha hubeysan, isla markaana ay socdeen dadaallo lagu dhisayo laguna tayeynayo hay’adaha amniga dalka. Xogaha ku saabsan taariikhdiisa ayaa sidoo kale xusaya inuu ka soo shaqeeyay arrimo la xiriira tababarka ciidamada iyo horumarinta awoodda hay’adaha milatari. Waayo-aragnimadiisa dheer iyo xilalkii uu soo qabtay ayaa ka dhigay mid ka mid ah saraakiisha milatari ee magac ku leh taariikhda dhow ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, waxaana madaxweyne Xasan Shiikh uu saacado ka hor u dallacsiiyay Sarreeye Guud. Sarreeye Guud Daahir Aadan Cilmi (Indhaqarshe) ayaa leh taariikh milatari oo soo taxnayd tobannaan sano, laga soo bilaabo ku biiristiisii ciidanka sannadkii 1968-kii, ka qaybqaadashadii dagaalkii 1977-kii, ilaa labadii jeer ee uu noqday taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.
items.fullContent: Sarreeye Guud Daahir Aadan Cilmi, oo loo yaqaanno Indhaqarshe, waa sarkaal sare oo muddo dheer ka tirsanaa Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, kaas oo laba jeer soo noqday taliyaha ciidanka. Wuxuu leeyahay waayo-aragnimo milatari oo dheer, isagoo soo qabtay xilal kala duwan oo la xiriira hoggaaminta, tababarka iyo hawlgallada ciidamada. Daahir Aadan Cilmi ayaa la sheegay inuu ku dhashay sannadkii 1948-kii, wuxuuna waxbarashadiisa hoose ku qaatay magaalada Buulo Burte, halka waxbarashada dhexe uu ku qaatay Jowhar. Dugsiga sare wuxuu ka baxay Dugsiga Banaadir ee Muqdisho, waxaana warbixinnada taariikh-nololeedkiisa qaarkood ay sheegayaan inuu waxbarasho jaamacadeed ku qaatay Jaamacadda Massachusetts Boston ee dalka Mareykanka. Wuxuu ku biiray Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed sannadkii 1968-kii, isaga oo markii dambe tababarro milatari ku qaatay magaalada Odessa ee Midowgii Soofiyeeti, iyo meelo kale oo ay ku jiraan Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka. Mudadii uu ku jiray ciidanka, wuxuu ka soo shaqeeyay qaybo kala duwan oo ka tirsan ciidamada, isaga oo qabtay xilal la xiriira hoggaaminta iyo abaabulka cutubyada milatari. Indhaqarshe wuxuu sidoo kale ka mid ahaa saraakiishii ka qayb qaatay dagaalkii 1977-kii ee u dhexeeyay Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya. items.title: Itoobiya oo shaacisay sababta aysan u aqoonsan Somaliland
items.description: Tel Aviv (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa ka digtay in aqoonsiga Somaliland uu sababi karo in Soomaaliya ay dalbato in ciidamada Itoobiya laga saaro dalkeeda, taas oo fursad weyn siin karta kooxda Al-Shabaab, isla markaana halis gelin karta amniga gobolka. Safiirka Itoobiya u fadhiya Israel, Tesfaye Yetayeh Anteneh, oo wareysi siiyay telefishinka i24NEWS, ayaa markii ugu horreysay si faahfaahsan u sharraxay sababaha ay Addis Ababa uga gaabsaneyso aqoonsiga Somaliland, inkastoo ay muddo dheer raadineysay in ay bad hesho. Safiirka oo la weydiiyay sababta Itoobiya aysan ugu dayan Israel oo aqoonsatay Somaliland, ayaa sheegay in go’aanka noocaas ah uu yeelan karo cawaaqib amni oo culus, gaar ahaan marka la eego ciidamada Itoobiya ee ka howlgala Soomaaliya. “Isla marka ay Itoobiya aqoonsato Somaliland, tusaale ahaan, dowladda Soomaaliya waxay dalban doontaa in Itoobiya ay ciidamadeeda kala baxdo Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri safiirka. “Al-Shabaab-na waxay heli doontaa fursad ay si sahlan ugu weerarto Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland labadaba,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Anteneh ayaa sheegay in xaaladda amni ee ka dhalan karta tallaabadaas aysan ku koobnaan doonin Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland, balse ay saameynteedu gaari karto gudaha Itoobiya. “Itoobiya waa in aysan ku degdegin aqoonsiga Somaliland,” ayuu yiri, isaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyay in arrintani u baahan tahay taxaddar iyo qiimeyn qoto dheer. Hadalka safiirka ayaa muujinaya in Addis Ababa ay welwel weyn ka qabto saameynta aqoonsiga Somaliland uu ku yeelan karo iskaashiga milatari ee kala dhexeeya Muqdisho, kaas oo muhiim u ah dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, balse aysan ka wel-welsaneyn ilaalinta madax-banaanida Soomaaliya. Xiisaddii heshiiska badda Itoobiya ayaa Soomaaliya ku leh ciidamo ka tirsan howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, iyo ciidamo kale oo ku jooga heshiisyo amni oo labada dowladood ka dhexeeya, kuwaas oo ka qeyb qaata dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab. Bishii September, Midowga Afrika ayaa xaqiijiyay in ciidamada Itoobiya ay sameeyeen isku-beddel ciidan oo ka dhacay bartamaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo cutubyo cusub la geeyay magaalooyinka Beledweyne iyo Halgan. Joogitaanka ciidamada Itoobiya ayaa horey u noqday arrin muran xooggan dhalisay, kaddib markii Addis Ababa ay bishii Janaayo 2024 heshiis is-afgarad ah la saxiixatay Somaliland. Heshiiskaas ayaa Itoobiya u oggolaan lahaa inay hesho marin xeebeed ku yaalla Gacanka Cadmeed, iyadoo beddelkeeda la hadal hayay inay aqoonsato Somaliland. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa heshiiska si adag uga hortimid, kuna tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee dalka. Khilaafka ayaa gaaray heer ay Soomaaliya ku hanjabtay inay dalkeeda ka saari doonto ciidamada Itoobiya haddii Addis Ababa aysan ka laaban heshiiska. Bishii June 2024, la-taliyihii amniga qaranka Soomaaliya ee xilligaas, Xuseen Sheekh Cali, ayaa wakaaladda Reuters u sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ciidamada Itoobiya eryi doonto haddii aan la burin heshiiska Somaliland. Xiisaddaas ayaa yara degtay bishii December 2024, markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Ahmed ay magaalada Ankara ku gaareen heshiis ay dhexdhexaadisay dowladda Turkiga. Heshiiska Ankara ayaa labada dal ku heshiiyeen inay ixtiraamaan madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee midba midka kale, isla markaana ay ka wada hadlaan sidii Itoobiya ay ku heli lahayd marin ganacsi oo badeed oo hoos imanaya awoodda madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale lagu aqoonsaday kaalinta iyo naf-hurnimada ciidamada Itoobiya ee ka qeyb qaata howlgallada Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya. Bishii September ee sanadkan, dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in heshiiska Ankara uu hadda saldhig u yahay xiriirka labada dal, iyadoo meesha ka saartay muhiimadda su’aalaha ku saabsan heshiiskii hore ee Itoobiya iyo Somaliland. Itoobiya oo ka taxaddareysa aqoonsiga Hadalka safiirka Itoobiya ayaa imanaya ku dhowaad toban bilood kaddib markii Israel ay 26-kii December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland. Go’aanka Israel ayaa dhaliyay diidmo xooggan oo ka timid Soomaaliya iyo ururro goboleed, oo uu ku jiro Midowga Afrika, kaas oo mar kale adkeeyay taageeradiisa madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Somaliland ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay ka go’day Soomaaliya sanadkii 1991, balse Qaramada Midoobay iyo Midowga Afrika ayaa weli u aqoonsan inay qeyb ka tahay Soomaaliya. Intii uu socday wareysiga i24NEWS , weriyaha ayaa safiirka Itoobiya u soo jeediyay in Addis Ababa ay dhibaatadeeda marin-badeedka ku xallin karto aqoonsiga Somaliland, si ay u hesho marin ay ku gaarto dekedda istaraatiijiga ah ee Berbera. Hase yeeshee, Anteneh ayaa ka gaabsaday inuu taageero qorshahaas, wuxuuna ku celiyay in helitaanka marin-badeed ay Itoobiya u aragto baahi dhaqaale oo muhiim u ah mustaqbalkeeda. Safiirka ayaa sheegay in arrintaasi ay u baahan tahay wadahadallo iyo heshiisyo labada dhinac faa’iido u leh, halkii lagu degdegi lahaa tallaabooyin abuuri kara qalalaase amni iyo mid siyaasadeed. Inkastoo uusan gebi ahaanba meesha ka saarin suurtagalnimada in Itoobiya ay mustaqbalka aqoonsato Somaliland, haddana hadalladiisa ayaa muujinaya in Addis Ababa aysan xilligan diyaar u ahayn inay qaaddo tallaabo khatar gelin karta xiriirka ay la leedahay Soomaaliya iyo joogitaanka ciidamadeeda ee dalka. items.title: Markab shidaal qaada oo Marayay Xeebaha Sucuudiga oo lagu dhuftay gantaal aan la aqoonsan
items.description: Markab shidaal qaada ayaa lagu dhuftay walax aan la aqoonsan oo loo maleynayo inay tahay gantaal ama hub kale, xilli uu marayay biyaha xeebaha Sacuudiga, sida ay sheegtay Hay’adda Hawlgallada Ganacsiga Badda ee Boqortooyada Ingiriiska (UKMTO). Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in dhacdadu ka dhacday waqooyi-bari magaalada dekedda leh ee Jubayl, halkaas oo markabka lagu dhuftay walaxda aan weli la aqoonsan nooca ay tahay iyo halka laga soo tuuray. UKMTO ayaa xaqiijisay in dhammaan shaqaalihii markabka ay badqabaan, isla markaana laga daadgureeyay markabka, Ilaa haddana, lama soo sheegin waxyeello deegaanka gaartay, hase yeeshee weli lama faahfaahin khasaaraha kale ee markabka soo gaaray. Mas’uuliyiinta ay khusayso ayaa la socda xaaladda, iyadoo aan weli la shaacin cidda ka dambeysay dhacdada ama ujeeddada weerarka. Baaritaanno ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo ogaado halka ay ka timid walaxda markabka ku dhacday. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay sii jiraan walaacyada la xiriira amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo maraakiibta shidaalka qaada ee mara biyaha istaraatiijiga ah ee Bariga Dhexe. Weerarrada noocan ah waxay khatar ku yihiin badqabka shaqaalaha maraakiibta iyo isku socodka ganacsiga badda.
