items.title: 15 Hay’ad Warbaahineed oo Mareykan ah iyo Kuwo Caalami ah oo Dalbaday in La Shaaciyo Dukumentiyada Baaritaanka Guriga Ilhaan Cumar
items.description: Shan iyo toban hay’adood oo warbaahineed oo waaweyn oo Mareykan ah iyo kuwo caalami ah ayaa maxkamad federaali ah ka codsaday in la shaaciyo dukumentiyada la xiriira waarankii lagu baaray guriga Ilhaan Cumar, oo ah xildhibaanad ka tirsan Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka, kana soo jeedda Soomaaliya. Hay’adaha warbaahinta oo ay ku jiraan Reuters, Associated Press, The Washington Post iyo CNN ayaa si wadajir ah codsi sharci ah ugu gudbiyey Maxkamadda Degmada Mareykanka ee Degmada Columbia, iyagoo dalbaday in dadweynaha loo bandhigo waaranka baaritaanka, codsigii lagu dalbaday, dhaarta caddeymaha ee baarayaasha iyo liiska hantida laga qaaday guriga intii uu socday howlgalka 12-kii Oktoobar 2026. Dhanka kale, wargeyska The New York Times ayaa gudbiyey codsi sharci oo gaar ah, kaas oo sidoo kale dalbanaya in la shaaciyo dukumentiyadaas, iyo qoraallada laga sameeyey dhageysiyada maxkamadeed ee la xiriira kiiska. Warbaahintu waxay codsiyadeeda ku sheegtay in shacabka Mareykanku ay xaq dastuuri ah u leeyihiin inay ogaadaan sababaha ay hay’adaha federaalku ugu galeen guriga qof si dimoqraadi ah loo soo doortay. Waxay ku doodeen in dukumentiyada baaritaanka, marka waaranka la fuliyo oo natiijada baaritaankana maxkamadda loo gudbiyo, guud ahaan loo tixgeliyo kuwo ay tahay in dadweynuhu heli karaan, haddii aysan jirin sabab sharci ah oo lagu sii qarinayo. Dukumentiyada la dalbaday waxaa ka mid ah waaranka iyo lifaaqyadiisa, codsiyadii baarayaasha, caddeymaha ay ku saleeyeen tuhunka dembi, codsiyada lagu doonayey in xogta la qariyo, amarada maxkamadda ee arrintaas la xiriira iyo diiwaannada kale ee dacwadda. Codsigan ayaa yimid kaddib markii saraakiisha federaalka Mareykanka ay 12-kii Oktoobar baaritaan ka sameeyeen guriga Ilhaan Cumar ee Washington, D.C., iyadoo howlgalka lagu sheegay inuu qayb ka yahay baaritaan federaali ah oo socda. Wararka la xiriira kiiska ayaa tilmaamaya in baaritaanku la xiriiro tuhunno ku saabsan arrimaha socdaalka, balse faahfaahinta buuxda ee baaritaanka weli si rasmi ah looma shaacin. Ilhaan Cumar ayaa hore u diidday eedeymaha loo jeediyey, waxayna sheegtay in baaritaanka loo adeegsanayo in lagu bartilmaameedsado sababo siyaasadeed awgood. Dhanka kale, Waaxda Caddaaladda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in saraakiishu fuliyeen waaran baaritaan oo maxkamaddu oggolaatay. Codsiga ay warbaahintu gudbisay ayaa hadda diiradda saaraya helitaanka dukumentiyada iyo hufnaanta habraaca sharciyeed, ayadoo go’aanka kama dambaysta ah ee ku saabsan in dukumentiyada la shaaciyo iyo in kale ay  leedahay maxkamaddu. Dhacdadan ayaa dhalisay dood ku saabsan hufnaanta hay’adaha dowladda, xaqa ay warbaahintu u leedahay helitaanka xogta dacwadaha iyo ilaalinta xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee dadka la baarayo, gaar ahaan marka baaritaanku khuseeyo mas’uul la doortay oo xilli doorasho ku jira.

Hay’adaha warbaahinta oo ay ku jiraan Reuters, Associated Press, The Washington Post iyo CNN ayaa si wadajir ah codsi sharci ah ugu gudbiyey Maxkamadda Degmada Mareykanka ee Degmada Columbia, iyagoo dalbaday in dadweynaha loo bandhigo waaranka baaritaanka, codsigii lagu dalbaday, dhaarta caddeymaha ee baarayaasha iyo liiska hantida laga qaaday guriga intii uu socday howlgalka 12-kii Oktoobar 2026. items.title: Trump oo Hakiyey Cunaqabateyn Cusub oo Mareykanku ku soo Rogi Lahaa Ruushka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa hakiyey dhaqan-gelinta xirmo cunaqabateyn oo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Ruushka, taas oo uu bishii hore saxiixay, isaga oo Congress-ka Mareykanka ku wargeliyey in go’aanka hakinta uu la xiriiro danaha qaranka. Trump ayaa Jimcihii saxiixay amar madaxweyne oo lagu hakiyey cunaqabateynta, laba maalmood ka hor xilligii sharcigu u asteeyey in tallaabooyinkaas ay dhaqan galaan. Cunaqabateyntan ayaa loogu talagalay in lagu yareeyo dakhliga Moscow ka hesho ganacsiga tamarta, kaas oo gacan ka geysanaya maalgelinta dagaalka ay Ruushku ka wadaan Ukraine. Sharciga ayaa dhigaya in cunaqabateyn lagu soo rogo mas’uuliyiinta Ruushka, bangiyada iyo maraakiibta shidaalka qaada ee lagu tuhunsan yahay inay qayb ka yihiin shabakadda ka caawisa Moscow inay sii waddo dhoofinta tamarta iyadoo ka baxsan xayiraadaha caalamiga ah. Waxa kale oo uu Madaxweynaha Mareykanka farayey inuu canshuuro gaarsiisan boqolkiiba 100 ku soo rogo dalalka ugu waaweyn ee soo dhoofsada shidaalka iyo gaaska Ruushka, iyadoo ay jiraan xaalado ka reeban dalalka buuxiya shuruudo gaar ah oo ku saabsan dhimista ku tiirsanaantooda tamarta Ruushka. Sharcigan, oo ay si weyn u taageereen labada aqal ee Congress-ka, waxaa hindisay Senator-kii Jamhuuriga Lindsey Graham iyo Senator-ka Dimuqraadiga Richard Blumenthal. Go’aanka Trump ayaa yimid toddobaad kaddib markii uu sheegay in Mareykanku heshiis la galay Ruushka, kaas oo ku saabsan iibsashada naaftada, tallaabadaas oo uu ku sababeeyey dadaallada lagu dhimayo qiimaha shidaalka ee suuqyada caalamka. Heshiiskaas ayaa dhaliyey dhaleeceyn uga timid siyaasiyiin ka tirsan labada xisbi ee Mareykanka, kuwaas oo ku dooday in iibsashada shidaalka Ruushka ay kordhin karto dakhliga Moscow, isla markaana ay taageeri karto dadaalladeeda dagaalka Ukraine, iyada oo aan la hubin in heshiisku hoos u dhigayo qiimaha shidaalka.

items.title: Lessons from Somali History Precolonial Sultanates and the Legacy of State Building
items.description: Dr. Abdurahman Baadiyow Somali history is too often told through the experiences of colonialism, independence, state collapse, and the continuing struggle to rebuild the country. Although these events are essential to understanding modern Somalia, they represent only a fraction of our collective past. Behind them lies a much longer history of communities that developed political institutions, organized authority, managed resources, and participated in the religious, commercial, and political life of the Horn of Africa. Yet generations of Somalis have grown up knowing more about our recent tragedies than about the achievements, struggles, and institutions of our ancestors. Recovering this history is essential to restoring our historical dignity and helping younger generations understand the depth of their heritage. Part of this neglect emerged from the political priorities of Somali nationalism. In seeking to establish a unified national identity, the nationalist project attempted to overcome clan divisions and minimize their political significance. Although the aspiration for national unity was understandable, marginalizing clan identities from public discourse and historical interpretation did not eliminate their influence in Somali society. Instead, clan affiliations remained significant, while the political institutions and historical experiences associated with them received insufficient scholarly attention. We must therefore confront this contradiction by examining how Somali communities organized themselves, exercised authority, resolved disputes, and developed political relationships across generations. Understanding this history does not undermine national unity; it provides a more honest foundation for it. A fuller understanding of Somali history must extend beyond colonialism and the establishment of the modern state. It should situate Somali communities within the ancient, medieval, and modern history of the Horn of Africa, recognizing their contributions to regional trade, religious scholarship, diplomacy, military struggles, and indigenous governance. Somalis were not merely passive subjects of external powers or victims of political collapse. They participated in shaping the region’s political and economic life and developed institutions adapted to their social, geographical, and historical circumstances. During the medieval period, the Adal and Ajuran political formations occupied important places in the history of the region. The Adal Sultanate emerged as a significant Muslim political power involving Somali communities alongside other Muslim peoples of the Horn of Africa. Its history reflects religious solidarity, political cooperation, commerce, and conflict across community boundaries. On the other hand, the Ajuran Sultanate developed an influential political order associated with territorial networks, organized authority, and resource management, particularly in southern and central parts of the Somali-inhabited region. Their histories demonstrate the capacity of communities in the region to organize political authority beyond individual lineages. The decline of Adal and Ajuran did not end Somali political organization. In subsequent centuries, new political formations emerged across different regions, including sultanates and city-states. Their structures and capacities varied, but many developed leadership arrangements, customary and religious legal traditions, mechanisms for managing community relations, and connections with neighboring powers. Often associated with clans or lineage-based communities, these institutions cannot be understood adequately without examining the social foundations from which they emerged. Their significance lies not simply in the identities of their founders, but in how they organized authority, maintained social order, managed resources, and negotiated relationships with other communities. Studying clan-based political institutions does not mean promoting clannism, legitimizing exclusion, or romanticizing the past. It means examining historical realities without allowing contemporary political concerns to determine which parts of our past deserve attention. These institutions must be investigated critically through their leadership structures, systems of succession, customary laws, religious legitimacy, economic foundations, and diplomatic relationships. Not every clan-based political system constitutes a state in the modern sense, which developed in a different European environment and differs in territorial control, administrative capacity, and political centralization. My ongoing research examines the historical development, governance, and political legacies of Somali sultanates and other indigenous political formations. To date, I have conducted preliminary studies of eight: Majeerteen, Hiraab, Hobyo, Geledi, Gassaregude, Warsangeli, Isaaq, and Gadabursi. The research remains ongoing, with further political formations to be explored as additional evidence becomes available. The purpose is to understand how these political systems emerged, how authority was established and transmitted, how communities were governed, how disputes were resolved, and how institutions interacted with one another and with foreign powers. The research also explores the relationships among leadership, political legitimacy, economic resources, social cohesion, and institutional continuity. A central argument of this research is that the histories of Somali clans, communities, and political institutions are integral to the national story. They should neither be excluded because of their clan foundations nor treated as models to be restored. Instead, we must investigate how clan structures interacted with Islam, customary law, trade, territorial authority, and wider political affiliations. Such an approach recognizes the diversity of Somali historical experience while affirming the possibility of a shared national identity. National unity need not require the erasure of historical identities, just as recognition of those identities need not perpetuate political division. The history of Somali political institutions is a story of achievement, transformation, cooperation, conflict, and decline. Some institutions endured, while others fragmented or lost their authority. These experiences offer valuable opportunities to examine the conditions under which political legitimacy develops, communities cooperate, disputes are managed, and institutions maintain public confidence. They also remind us that no political order is immune to internal divisions, changing circumstances, or failures of leadership. These lessons are particularly relevant as Somalia continues to confront its political crisis and the challenge of building a legitimate, inclusive, and durable state. Our historical experiences invite us to reconsider political approaches that prioritize consultation, consensus-based decision-making, negotiated agreement, and power-sharing. They also raise important questions about the limitations of majoritarian systems inherited from European political models. In a society shaped by complex clan affiliations, majority rule alone may leave significant communities feeling excluded from decisions affecting their future. Consensus-building and inclusive political arrangements therefore deserve serious consideration alongside constitutional government, equal citizenship, accountability, and the rule of law. The objective is not to restore precolonial institutions or transfer historical practices uncritically into the modern state. Rather, it is to learn from the ways earlier Somali political systems established authority, negotiated differences, maintained cooperation, and responded to internal divisions. Their experiences cannot provide ready-made solutions, but they can illuminate the choices facing Somalia today and help inform efforts to resolve contemporary conflicts. Our task is to draw critically on the past in pursuit of a political order that accommodates diversity without institutionalizing exclusion and promotes national unity without denying the country’s social realities. Ultimately, reclaiming Somali history is both a scholarly responsibility and a national undertaking. The histories of Adal and Ajuran, together with those of the Majeerteen, Hiraab, Hobyo, Geledi, Gassaregude, Warsangeli, Isaaq, and Gadabursi political formations, provide important starting points for recovering the diversity of Somali political experience. Further research will deepen our understanding of their origins, institutions, interactions, and legacies. The purpose is neither to glorify the past nor to revive old divisions, but to understand our history honestly and preserve it for future generations. Somali history is neither exclusively the history of the modern state nor merely the history of clans. It is the collective history of the communities, institutions, leaders, and political orders through which our society has evolved. Recovering that history can strengthen historical awareness, support reconciliation, and help us imagine a more inclusive future. Our past cannot resolve today’s crisis for us, but it can illuminate the choices before us. By learning from the achievements and failures of earlier generations, we can build a more informed foundation for a just, inclusive, and durable Somali state. Dr. Abdurahman Baadiyow Email: abdurahmanba@yahoo.com ———- Dr. Abdurahman Baadiyow is a Professor of Modern Islamic History and a Senior Adviser for the Somali President on Peace and Reconciliation. items.title: Fahad oo Xasan ku eedeeyay inuu Soomaaliya u horseedayo xaalad la mid ah tan Suudaan
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Agaasimihii hore ee Hay’adda NISA Fahad Yaasiin ayaa eedeymo u jeediyay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isaga oo ku eedeeyay inuu dalka u horseedayo xaalad siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo la mid ah tan ka taagan dalka Suudaan, halkaas oo ay ku loollamayaan laba hoggaamiye oo kala wata ciidamo iyo maamulo iska soo horjeeda. Fahad Yaasiin ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay bartiisa gaarka ah ee Facebook-ga ku sheegay in Xasan Sheekh uu doonayo inuu Soomaaliya geliyo xaalad keeni karta in dalka ay ka hanaqaadaan laba Madaxweyne, laba dowladood iyo laba ciidan, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in Madaxweynuhu uu wado qar iska tuurnimo halis gelin karta dowladnimada Soomaaliya, isaga oo ka digay in tallaabooyinka noocaas ah ay dalka u horseedi karaan kala qaybsanaan hor leh. “Xasan Sheekh wuxuu doonayaa inuu haadaan ka tuur qaranka oo uu xaaladda Soomaaliya la aado jidka Al Burhaan iyo Xamayiiti: labo Madaxweyne, labo dowladood iyo labo ciidan,” ayuu yiri Fahad Yaasiin. Waxaa kale oo uu carrabka ku dhuftay dowlad shisheeye inay Xasan Sheekh ku dhiirrigelisay inuu kursiga ku sii dhegganaado, taas oo uu sheegay inay qayb ka tahay qorshe lagu sii kala fogeynayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, laguna sii hurinayo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee ka jira dalka. “Dowlad shisheeye ayaa ka dhaadhicisay kursiga haka kicin, iyagoo uga dan leh in Soomaali lasii kala fogeeyo. Ilaahay idankiis damacaas uma hirgalayo,” ayuu mar kale sii raaciyay. Dhanka kale, Fahad Yaasiin Xaaji Daahir ayaa muujiyay walaac xooggan oo uu ka qabo mustaqbalka Soomaaliya, isaga oo ka digay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee taagan ay dalka u horseedi karaan xaalad adag haddii aan la gaarin xal deg-deg ah. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, eedeymahan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay Soomaaliya ka taagan yihiin muranno siyaasadeed oo la xiriira hannaanka doorashooyinka, muddo-xileedka hay’adaha dowladda iyo khilaafka u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka. Xiisadda ayaa sidoo kale sii laba kacleysay toddobaadkii hore, kadib markii Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka uu shaaciyay jadwalka doorashooyinka labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo tan Madaxweynaha, kaas oo ay si cad u diideen siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ee sida wayn uga soo horjeeda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Fahad Yaasiin ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay bartiisa gaarka ah ee Facebook-ga ku sheegay in Xasan Sheekh uu doonayo inuu Soomaaliya geliyo xaalad keeni karta in dalka ay ka hanaqaadaan laba Madaxweyne, laba dowladood iyo laba ciidan, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in Madaxweynuhu uu wado qar iska tuurnimo halis gelin karta dowladnimada Soomaaliya, isaga oo ka digay in tallaabooyinka noocaas ah ay dalka u horseedi karaan kala qaybsanaan hor leh. “Xasan Sheekh wuxuu doonayaa inuu haadaan ka tuur qaranka oo uu xaaladda Soomaaliya la aado jidka Al Burhaan iyo Xamayiiti: labo Madaxweyne, labo dowladood iyo labo ciidan,” ayuu yiri Fahad Yaasiin. Waxaa kale oo uu carrabka ku dhuftay dowlad shisheeye inay Xasan Sheekh ku dhiirrigelisay inuu kursiga ku sii dhegganaado, taas oo uu sheegay inay qayb ka tahay qorshe lagu sii kala fogeynayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, laguna sii hurinayo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee ka jira dalka. “Dowlad shisheeye ayaa ka dhaadhicisay kursiga haka kicin, iyagoo uga dan leh in Soomaali lasii kala fogeeyo. items.title: Farmaajo oo dalab xasaasi ah u diray beesha caalamka kadib tallaabadii Xasan Sheekh

Farmaajo ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in hadalladdii u dambeeyay ee uu jeediyay Madaxwynaha ay muujinayaan damaciisa gurracan ee ku aaddan xukun maroorsiga iyo hurinta colaad sokeeye, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ku eedeeyay inuu ka baxay wada-hadalladii ay garwadeenka ka ahayd beesha caalamka ee lagu doonayo in heshiis looga gaaro khilaafka taagan ee ka dhashay hannaanka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka oo ay weli isku hayaan dowladda iyo mucaaradka. “In Madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisu dhammaday uu ka laabto wadahadalladii muddada socday ee beesha caalamku ay garwadeenka ka ahaayeen, kana baxay heshiiskii ku saabsanaa in aanu qaban karin doorasho heer federaal ah oo aan heshiis lagu ahayn waxa ay caddayn u tahay in aanu diyaar u ahayn wadatashi iyo hannaan loo dhan yahay, yoolkiisuna yahay wakhti dheeraysi uu ku hirgelinayo doorasho uu natiijada qorto,” ayuu yiri Farmaajo. Dhinaca kale, wuxuu farriin culus u diray beesha caalamka oo uu ugu baaqay in aysan mar danbe ku kadsoomin Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, isaga oo tilmaamay in aysan jirin niyad wanaag iyo rabitaan dhankiisa ah oo lagu gaari karo doorasho daah-furan oo loo dhan yahay. “Saaxiibbada taageera Soomaaliya ee ku howllanaa xallinta khilaafaadka doorashada waxaan ugu baaqaynaa in aysan mar danbe ku kadsoomin baaqyada heshiiska iyo wadahadallada ee uu soo gudbiyo Madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisu uu dhammaaday, maadama aysan jirin niyad wanaag iyo rabitaan dhankiisa ah oo lagu gaari karo doorasho daah-furan oo loo dhan yahay,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya, iyadoo toddobaadkii hore Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka uu shaaciyay jadwalka doorashooyinka labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo tan Madaxweynaha, kaas oo ay si cad u diideen siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ee sida wayn uga soo horjeeda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. items.title: INTERPOL Oo Hagaysa Baaritaanka Forensigga Ee Markabka MT Honour 25
items.description: Hay’adda Booliska Caalamiga ah ee INTERPOL ayaa hay’adaha Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Maamulka Puntland ka taageeraysa baaritaanka forensigga ee markabka MT Honour 25, kaas oo laga soo furtay burcad-badeed Soomaali ah. Taageerada INTERPOL ayaa diiradda saaraysa habka loo ururinayo, loo baakadaynayo, loo kaydinayo looguna gudbinayo shaybaarrada caddeymaha laga helo ee Markabka. Baaritaanku wuxuu gacan ka geysan karaa aqoonsiga dadkii afduubka fuliyey iyo isku xirka caddeymaha iyo tuhmanayaasha la qabtay. Caddeymaha laga raadin karo markabka waxaa ka mid noqon kara faraha, muunadaha hidde-sideyaasha, hubka, qalabka isgaarsiinta iyo xogta elektaroonigga ah. Ilaalinta silsiladda caddeymaha ayaa muhiim u ah in xogta laga helo markabka loo adeegsan karo dacwad maxkamadeed. Hawlgal ka dhacay Boosaaso ayaa sidoo kale lagu diiwaangeliyey 34 qof oo lala xiriirinayo dambiyo argagixiso, iyadoo saraakiisha Soomaalida lagu tababaray adeegsiga qalabka biometriga.

items.title: Gaajada ka jirta Gaza oo Sababtay Dhimashada 466 Falastiiniyiin ah oo Carruur iyo Waayeello ay ku jiraan
items.description: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee Marinka Gaza ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 466 Falastiiniyiin ah ay u dhinteen sababo la xiriira nafaqo-darro iyo gaajo tan iyo sannadkii 2024-kii, iyadoo dadka dhintay ay ku jiraan 157 carruur ah iyo 189 qof oo waayeel ah. Tiradan ayaa la shaaciyey xilli Gaza laga xusayay Maalinta Cuntada Adduunka, iyadoo xaaladda macaluushu ay weli walaac ku hayso dadka ku nool dhulka go’doonsan. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in dadka waayeelka ah ay ka yihiin 40.5 boqolkiiba guud ahaan dadka gaajada iyo nafaqo-darradu dishay, taasoo muujinaysa saameynta ba’an ee cunno-yaraantu ku yeelatay dadka ugu nugul bulshada. Carruurta ayaa sidoo kale ka mid ah dadka sida weyn ay u saameysay xaaladda bani’aadannimo, iyadoo kumannaan qoys ay la tacaalayaan helitaanka cunto ku filan. Warbixinta wasaaradda ayaa intaas ku dartay in in ka badan 1.4 milyan oo qof oo ku nool Gaza la filayo inay wajahaan xaalad cunto-yaraan oo heerkeedu yahay mid daran ama ka sii xun ilaa dhammaadka sannadka 2026-ka. Tiradani waxay u dhigantaa qiyaastii 67 boqolkiiba dadka ku nool Marinka Gaza, taasoo muujinaysa baaxadda dhibaatada cunno-yaraanta ee halkaasi ka jirta. Saameynta cunno-yaraanta ayaa si gaar ah saameysay carruurta da’doodu ka yar tahay shan sano, ayadoo wasaaradda Caafimaadku ay sheegtay in la diiwaangeliyey in ka badan 158,000 oo xaaladood oo nafaqo-darro ba’an ah oo carruurta da’daas ah soo wajahday intii u dhexeysay sannadkii 2024-kii iyo bishii Agoosto 2026-ka. Qaar ka mid ah carruurtaas ayaa la sheegay inay qabaan nafaqo-darro halis gelinaysa noloshooda, halka hay’adaha caafimaadku ay ka digayaan dhibaatooyinka muddada dheer ee ay gaajadu ku yeelan karto koritaanka carruurta. Dhibaatada nafaqo-darrada ayaa sidoo kale saameysay haweenka uurka leh, Sida ay sheegtay wasaaraddu, heerka dhiig-yaraanta haweenka uurka leh ay sannadkan gaaray 61 boqolkiiba, marka loo eego 41 boqolkiiba ka hor dagaalka. Waxaa sidoo kale la sheegay in ku dhowaad 4,000 oo xaaladood oo uur-lumis ah la diiwaangeliyey lixdii bilood ee hore ee sannadka 2026-ka. Xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Gaza ayaa sii murugaysay tan iyo markii dagaalku billowday bishii Oktoobar 2023-kii, iyadoo burburka kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, waxyeellada soo gaartay adeegyada caafimaadka iyo beeraha, barakaca dadka iyo caqabadaha hortaagan gaarsiinta gargaarka ay sii adkeeyeen helitaanka cuntada iyo adeegyada aasaasiga ah. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa bishii Agoosto 2025 xaqiijisay xaalad macaluul ah oo ka jirta qaybo ka mid ah Gaza, iyadoo hay’adaha gargaarka ay marar badan ku baaqeen in la fududeeyo lana joogteeyo gaarsiinta cuntada, daawooyinka iyo sahayda nafaqada.

items.title: Khilaafka Doorashada Soomaaliya oo Sii Kordhaya iyo Mucaaradka oo Dowladda ku Eedeeyey Carqaladaynta Wada-hadal
items.description: Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya ka taagan hannaanka doorashooyinka ayaa sii xoogeysanaya, kaddib markii Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka uu shaaciyey jadwalka doorashooyinka, tallaabadaas oo ay mucaaradka iyo siyaasiyiin kale qaarkood ka muujiyeen diidmo, iyaga oo ku baaqay in marka hore heshiis siyaasadeed laga gaaro qaabka doorashada dalka loo qabanayo. Mucaaradka ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku eedeeyey inuu carqaladaynayo wada-hadallada siyaasadeed ee looga hadlayo hannaanka doorashada, isaga oo ka digay in haddii aan heshiis loo dhan yahay laga gaarin arrintan ay dalka horseedi karto muddo-kordhin iyo doorasho aan dhinacyadu ku wada qanacsanayn. Madaxweynihii hore ee Dalka Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo ayaa sheegay in hadalladii ugu dambeeyey ee Madaxweynaha iyo hakadka ku yimid wada-hadallada u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo mucaaradku ay muujinayaan inaan weli la helin tanaasul siyaasadeed oo lagu xallin karo khilaafka taagan. Mucaaradka ayaa sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyey wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka iyo qorshaha doorashooyinka, iyaga oo ku dooday in tallaabooyinkaas ay xoojin karaan awoodda xisbiga talada haya. Waxa uu dowladda ugu baaqay inay dib ugu soo laabato miiska wada-hadallada, iyadoo ay ka qaybgalayaan mucaaradka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada, si loo helo hannaan doorasho oo lagu wada heshiiyey. Mowqifka Muacaaradka ayaa la jaanqaadaya walaacyada ay muujiyeen qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka iyo xubnaha xisbiyada kala duwan ee dalka, kuwaas oo ka horyimid jadwalka doorashooyinka ee guddigu shaaciyey. Mucaaradku waxay dowladda ku eedeeyeen inay waddo qorshe doorasho oo aan heshiis buuxa lagala gaarin dhinacyada siyaasadeed, iyaga oo ku doodaya in go’aannada la xiriira doorashada iyo wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka ay u baahan yihiin wadatashi ballaaran. Qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale soo saaray bayaanno ay ku muujinayaan diidmadooda iyo baahida loo qabo in dib loo furo wada-hadallada. Dhanka kale, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ku adkaysanaysa qorshaheeda ku aaddan hirgelinta doorasho qof iyo cod ah, iyadoo ku doodaysa in nidaamkaasi uu muwaadiniinta siinayo fursad ay si toos ah ugu doortaan hoggaamiyeyaashooda. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sidoo kale xildhibaannada Xisbiga Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) kala hadlay abaabulka doorashada, iyadoo dowladda ay sii waddo dadaallada la xiriira hirgelinta qorshaheeda siyaasadeed. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, kala aragti duwanaanshaha u dhexeeya dowladda iyo mucaaradka ayaa weli salka ku haya habraaca doorashada, jadwalka la shaaciyey, wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka iyo baahida loo qabo heshiis siyaasadeed oo ay dhinacyadu ku wada qancaan.

Mucaaradku waxay dowladda ku eedeeyeen inay waddo qorshe doorasho oo aan heshiis buuxa lagala gaarin dhinacyada siyaasadeed, iyaga oo ku doodaya in go’aannada la xiriira doorashada iyo wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka ay u baahan yihiin wadatashi ballaaran. Qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale soo saaray bayaanno ay ku muujinayaan diidmadooda iyo baahida loo qabo in dib loo furo wada-hadallada. Dhanka kale, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ku adkaysanaysa qorshaheeda ku aaddan hirgelinta doorasho qof iyo cod ah, iyadoo ku doodaysa in nidaamkaasi uu muwaadiniinta siinayo fursad ay si toos ah ugu doortaan hoggaamiyeyaashooda. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sidoo kale xildhibaannada Xisbiga Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) kala hadlay abaabulka doorashada, iyadoo dowladda ay sii waddo dadaallada la xiriira hirgelinta qorshaheeda siyaasadeed. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, kala aragti duwanaanshaha u dhexeeya dowladda iyo mucaaradka ayaa weli salka ku haya habraaca doorashada, jadwalka la shaaciyey, wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka iyo baahida loo qabo heshiis siyaasadeed oo ay dhinacyadu ku wada qancaan.

items.title: Itoobiya oo Ballaarinaysa Awoodda Ciidankeeda Badda, Xilli ay Doonayso inay Saameyn ku Yeelato Badda-Cas
items.description: Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa wada qorshe lagu ballaarinayo awoodda ciidankeeda badda, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo tayeynta tababarrada, dhismaha kaabeyaasha ciidanka iyo sameynta cutubyo gaar ah oo dagaal, si ay uga hortagto khataraha amniga una ilaaliso danaha qaranka. Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidanka Badda Itoobiya, Ku-xigeenka Admiral Kindu Gezu, ayaa sheegay in ciidanka badda uu ku tallaabsaday horumar dhinacyada shaqaalaha, tababarrada, hubka iyo qaab-dhismeedka hay’adda, kuwaas oo uu sheegay in laga soo bilaabay meel eber ah. Kindu Gezu oo wareysi siiyay warbaahin ay dowladda ay maamusho ayaa xusay in horumarinta ciidanka badda ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada lagu xoojinayo awoodda difaaca dalka iyo ilaalinta danaha qaranka Itoobiya. Wuxuu sidoo kale tilmaamay in ballaarinta awoodaha ciidanka ay ujeeddadeedu tahay in Itoobiya ay yeelato awood ay kaga jawaabto caqabadaha amni ee soo wajaha, isla markaana ay ilaaliso danaha ay u aragto kuwo muhiim u ah qarankeeda. Hadalka taliyaha ayaa imanaya iyadoo Itoobiya ay sii waddo horumarinta ciidankeeda badda, inkastoo dalkaasi uusan lahayn xeeb toos ah tan iyo markii Eritrea ay xornimada qaadatay sannadkii 1993-kii. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, faahfaahinta ku saabsan tirada maraakiibta, qalabka cusub ee la qorsheynayo iyo goobaha ay ka howlgeli doonaan cutubyada gaarka ah laguma sheegin xogta la soo xigtay. Ballaarinta ciidanka badda Itoobiya ayaa imaanaysa  xilli uu gobolku wajahayo xiisado Siyaasadeed iyo kuwo amni, islamarkaana uu loolan ka dhex jiro Itoobiya oo bad raadinaysa iyo dalalka dhaca badda cas.

items.title: Abiy oo qaaday talllaabo culus kadib guushii militari ee Tigray
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Ahmed, ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqay dhismaha maamul ku-meel-gaar ah oo cusub oo loo magacaabay gobolka Tigray ee waqooyiga dalkaas, kaas oo loo xil saaray xasilinta gobolka iyo diyaarinta doorashooyin lagu qabto muddo lix bilood gudahood ah. Go’aankan ayaa yimid kadib markii ciidamada dowladda federaalka Itoobiya iyo maleeshiyaad taageersan ay guulo waaweyn ka gaareen dagaalladii dib uga qarxay Tigray, iyagoo la wareegay qeybo badan oo gobolka ka mid ah, oo ay ku jirto magaalada Mekelle oo ah caasimadda Tigray. Dagaalladan ayaa dib u qarxay bishii September, markii Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray (TPLF) ay hoggaamisay weerarro ka dhan ah dowladda Abiy Ahmed, taas oo dib u soo nooleysay colaaddii dhiigga badani ku daatay ee gobolka ka dhacday intii u dhexeysay 2020 iyo 2022. Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya ayaa sheegay in maamulka cusub uu shaqeyn doono muddo lix bilood ah, isla markaana waajibaadkiisa ugu weyn uu noqon doono abuurista jawi siyaasadeed oo xasilloon, kaas oo suuragelin kara qabashada doorashooyin xor iyo xalaal ah. Abiy Ahmed ayaa qoraal uu ku baahiyay bartiisa X ku sheegay in dadka Tigray ay tahay inay ka gudbaan colaadaha soo noqnoqday, si ay u helaan nabad, xuquuqdooda ismaamul iyo fursado horumarineed. “Si ay u helaan nabaddii muddada dheer ka maqneyd, u xaqiijiyaan xuquuqdooda ismaamul, ugana faa’iideystaan miraha horumarka ee sannado badan aysan helin, dadka Tigray waa inay ka baxaan meertadan colaadeed,” ayuu yiri Abiy Ahmed. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa intaas ku daray in maamulka cusub uu sidoo kale dib u dhisi doono kaabeyaashii dhaqaalaha iyo adeegyada bulshada ee dagaalladu burburiyeen, isla markaana uu gacan ka geysan doono dib u celinta dadka ku barakacay colaadaha. Dhanka kale, TPLF oo muddo tobannaan sano ah awood weyn ku lahayd siyaasadda Itoobiya, ka hor inta uusan Abiy Ahmed xilka qaban sanadkii 2018, ayaan weli ka hadlin magacaabista maamulka cusub. Afhayeen u hadlay kooxda ayaan si degdeg ah uga jawaabin codsi warbaahintu u dirtay oo ku saabsanaa arrintan. Gobolka Tigray ayaa weli la daalaa dhacaya saameyntii dagaalkii hore, kaas oo sababay dhimashada boqollaal kun oo qof, halka dad badan ay wajahaan gaajo, barakac iyo burbur baahsan oo soo gaaray adeegyada aasaasiga ah. Sida ay sheegtay hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan qaxootiga, ku dhowaad 750,000 oo qof oo reer Tigray ah ayaa weli ku barakacsanaa gudaha dalka bishii February, iyadoo gobolka uu sidoo kale wajahayo abaaro lala xiriirinayo ifafaalaha cimilada ee El Niño. Colaadda cusub ayaa sidoo kale sii xumeysay xiriirka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, oo mar kale gaaray heer aad u hooseeya. Dowladda Addis Ababa ayaa ku eedeysay Eritrea inay taageerto xoogagga fallaagada ah, hase yeeshee dowladda Asmara ayaa beenisay eedeymahaas. Sidoo kale, Itoobiya ayaa Masar iyo Suudaan ku eedeysay inay taageero siinayaan isbaheysiga hubeysan ee la dagaallamaya dowladda federaalka, balse labada dal ayaa iyaguna iska fogeeyay eedeymaha loo jeediyay. Xiisadahan ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in dagaalka Tigray uu ku fido dalalka deriska ah, xilli Geeska Afrika uu wajahayo loollan siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo sii xoogeysanaya, ayna quwadaha gobolka ku kala aragti duwan yihiin arrimo dhowr ah. Magacaabista maamulka cusub ayaa sidaas darteed imaaneysa xilli dowladda Abiy Ahmed ay isku dayeyso inay dib u soo celiso xasilloonida Tigray, inkastoo ay weli jiraan walaacyo ku saabsan mustaqbalka heshiiskii nabadeed ee sanadkii 2022 lagu soo afjaray dagaalkii hore iyo suurta-galnimada in colaado hor leh ay dib uga qarxaan gobolka. items.title: Maxay ka dhigantahay in Dawladda Kenya ay Dalkeeda ku Martigeliso Laftageen oo Qalalaaso Gudaha Soomaaliya ?
items.description: madaxweynihii hore ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen, iyo xubno ka tirsanaa maamulkiisii hore ayaa ku sugan yihiin magaalada Nairobi ee dalka Kenya, halkaas oo la sheegay inay kulammo iyo wadatashiyo siyaasadeed ka wadaan. Tallaabadan ayaa kusoo aadaysa xilli uu laftageen oo uu guluf dagaal xooggan ka wado deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, islamarkaana uu halis ku yahay xasilloonida deegaannadaas. Dhanka kale, waxaa jira eedeymo loo jeediyay qaar ka mid ah mas’uuliyiintii iyo ciidamadii maamulka Laftagareen, kuwaas oo la xiriira inay xiriir la leeyihiin kooxda Al-Shabaab, isla markaana lagu eedeeyay inay xog iyo agab ciidan gaarsiiyeen kooxdaas. Eedeymahan waxaa ka mid ah warar sheegaya in xog la xiriirta diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn la gaarsiiyay Al-Shabaab, hase yeeshee eedeymahan waxay u baahan yihiin caddeymo madax-bannaan iyo xaqiijin rasmi ah. Joogitaanka Laftagareen iyo xubnaha maamulkiisii hore ee Nairobi ayaa sidoo kale dhalinaya su’aalo ku saabsan doorka dowladda Kenya ee xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Koonfur Galbeed. Haddii la xaqiijiyo in dowladda Kenya ay si rasmi kaalin ugu leedahay dagaalka Koonfur Galbeed ama  martigelinayso laftagareen,arrintaasi waxay saameyn ku yeelan kartaa xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Kenya. Su’aasha taagan ayaa ah waxa ay ka dhigan tahay joogitaanka Laftagareen iyo xubnaha maamulkiisii hore ee Nairobi, iyo sida ay arrintani uga jawaabi doono DFS. Kenya ayaa horay ugu lugleelatay faragelinno badan oo ay ka sameysay gudaha soomaaliya, gaar ahaan Jubbland, martigelinta Laftagareen oo qalalaase ka wada koonfur Galbeed waxay noqanaysaa xad-gudub kale oo ka dhan ah Amniga iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh: Soomaaliya Uma Socoto Dagaal Siyaasadeed
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalku aysan dalka u horseedayn dagaal siyaasadeed, isla markaana aysan qorsheynayn inay weerarto madaxda mucaaradka iyo dadka ka aragtida duwan dowladda. Madaxweynaha ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay kulan uu la yeeshay xildhibaannada labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ka tirsan Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP). Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xoojinta wada-shaqeynta, doorka xildhibaannada iyo diyaar-garowga doorashooyinka federaalka ee la qorsheeyay sannadka 2027-ka. “Cidna dagaal kuma wadno, dagaalna isu diyaarin mayno,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, isaga oo meesha ka saaray walaaca laga qabo in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee dalka ka jira ay isu beddelaan iska-horimaad hubeysan. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli uu taagan yahay muran siyaasadeed oo la xiriira wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka, hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo hakadka ku yimid wada-hadallada u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka. Siyaasiyiin mucaarad ah iyo madax hore ayaa dowladda uga digay in ciidamada ammaanka loo adeegsado khilaafaadka siyaasadeed. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dowladda aysan qofna u xireyn aragtidiisa siyaasadeed, isaga oo xusay inaysan jirin siyaasiyiin xiran oo uu ku tilmaamay maxaabiis siyaasadeed. “Maanta meesha aan joogno, hal qof oo siyaasi ah oo xabsi ku jira ma qabno; maxaabiis siyaasadeed ma qabno,” ayuu yiri madaxweynuhu. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in handadaadda iyo cabsi-gelintu aysan ka mid ahayn mabaadi’da dowladdiisa, isaga oo mucaaradka ugu baaqay inay aragtiyahooda ku soo bandhigaan wada-hadal siyaasadeed, kana fogaadaan hadallada bulshada ku abuuri kara cabsi iyo jahawareer. Dhanka kale, madaxweynaha ayaa xildhibaannada JSP kala hadlay diyaar-garowga doorashooyinka qof iyo codka ah, isaga oo ku boorriyey inay door muuqda ka qaataan wacyigelinta bulshada iyo hirgelinta hannaanka ay dowladda ku doonayso in shacabka ay si toos ah ugu doortaan hoggaamiyeyaashooda. Inkasta oo madaxweynuhu meesha ka saaray suurtagalnimada dagaal siyaasadeed, haddana khilaafka dowladda iyo mucaaradka ayaa weli taagan. Qodobada ugu waaweyn ee la isku hayo waxaa ka mid ah wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka, hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo qaabka loo wajahayo wada-hadallada siyaasadeed.

Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli uu taagan yahay muran siyaasadeed oo la xiriira wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka, hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo hakadka ku yimid wada-hadallada u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka. Siyaasiyiin mucaarad ah iyo madax hore ayaa dowladda uga digay in ciidamada ammaanka loo adeegsado khilaafaadka siyaasadeed. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dowladda aysan qofna u xireyn aragtidiisa siyaasadeed, isaga oo xusay inaysan jirin siyaasiyiin xiran oo uu ku tilmaamay maxaabiis siyaasadeed. “Maanta meesha aan joogno, hal qof oo siyaasi ah oo xabsi ku jira ma qabno; maxaabiis siyaasadeed ma qabno,” ayuu yiri madaxweynuhu. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in handadaadda iyo cabsi-gelintu aysan ka mid ahayn mabaadi’da dowladdiisa, isaga oo mucaaradka ugu baaqay inay aragtiyahooda ku soo bandhigaan wada-hadal siyaasadeed, kana fogaadaan hadallada bulshada ku abuuri kara cabsi iyo jahawareer. Dhanka kale, madaxweynaha ayaa xildhibaannada JSP kala hadlay diyaar-garowga doorashooyinka qof iyo codka ah, isaga oo ku boorriyey inay door muuqda ka qaataan wacyigelinta bulshada iyo hirgelinta hannaanka ay dowladda ku doonayso in shacabka ay si toos ah ugu doortaan hoggaamiyeyaashooda. Inkasta oo madaxweynuhu meesha ka saaray suurtagalnimada dagaal siyaasadeed, haddana khilaafka dowladda iyo mucaaradka ayaa weli taagan. Qodobada ugu waaweyn ee la isku hayo waxaa ka mid ah wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka, hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo qaabka loo wajahayo wada-hadallada siyaasadeed.

items.title: Eedayn la xiriirta falal anshax-xumo ah oo ka dhacay Masaajidka Makka: Nin iyo haweeney u dhashay Bangladesh oo lagu xukumay dil
items.description: Wasaaradda arrimaha gudaha ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sheegtay in nin iyo haweeney u dhashay Bangladesh, oo loo xiray eedeyn la xiriirta falal anshax-xumo oo lagu sheegay inay ka dhaceen gudaha mid ka mid ah masaajidda magaalada barakeysan ee Makka, lagu fuliyay xukun dil ah. Wakaaladda wararka ee dowladda Sacuudiga, ee (SPA), oo soo xiganeysay bayaan ka soo baxay Wasaaradda arrimaha gudaha, ayaa sheegtay in ninka Bangladeshi-ga ah Nazarul Islam Abdul Basir iyo haweeneyda Siti Akter lagu eedeeyay inay gudaha masaajid ku yaalla Makka ku sameeyeen waxa lagu tilmaamay “fal anshax-xumo ah.” Sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga, ciidamada ammaanka ayaa labada qof xiray, kaddibna waxaa loo gudbiyay maxkamadda awoodda u leh inay dacwadda qaaddo. Wasaaradda arrimaha gudaha ayaa intaas ku dartay in maxkamaddu ay soo saartay xukun ka dhan ah Nazarul Islam Abdul Basir iyo Siti Akter, iyadoo ay xaqiijisay eedeymihii loo soo jeediyay. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in xukunka lagu saleeyay culayska dambiga, ku xadgudubka xurmada masaajidka, iyo duruufihii lagu galay falalka lagu eedeeyay. Sidaas darteed, labada qof waxaa lagu xukumay dil ciqaabeed. Mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sheegay in xukunkii hore ee dilka ahaa uu sidoo kale sii maray maxkamad sare kadib racfaan laga qaatay. Markii dambe waxaa la soo saaray amar boqortooyo oo oggolaanaya in xukunka la fuliyo, waxaana amarkaas la dhaqan geliyay Arbacadii 14-ka Oktoobar. Mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga ma aysan shaacin nooca saxda ah ee falka anshax-xumada ah ee lagu eedeeyay labada qof, goorta ay dhacdadu dhacday, xilliga maxkamaddu riday xukunka dilka, ama goorta la diiday racfaankii laga qaatay. Wargeysyada maxalliga ah ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaan sidoo kale bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan kiiskan, waxaana ay daabaceen oo keliya warar ku saleysan bayaanka Wasaaradda arrimaha gudaha. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka wasiirka arrimaha gudaha ee Sacuudi Carabiya, xukunka dilka ah waxaa lagu fuliyay qodobka taasiirka (تعزير). Hase yeeshee, mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga si cad uma aysan shaacin qodob sharciyeed gaar ah oo lagu saleeyay xukunkan. Sida ay sheegtay hay’adda xuquuqda aadanaha ee Amnesty International, maxkamadaha Sacuudi Carabiya waxay xukunnadooda ku saleeyaan shareecada Islaamka, oo ay ku jiraan nidaamyada xuduudda iyo qisaasta, kuwaas oo leh ciqaabo lagu qeexay Qur’aanka Kariimka ah iyo Sunnada. Dhanka kale, taasiirku (ta’zir) waa ciqaab uu garsooruhu si madaxbannaan u go’aamiyo, taas oo lagu dabaqo dambiyada aan shareecada Islaamku u cayimin ciqaab gaar ah. Garsooruhu wuxuu markaas xukunka ku saleeyaa nooca dambiga, duruufaha ku xeeran, iyo culayska falka la galay. Arrintan awgeed, garsoorayaasha Sacuudi Carabiya waxaa la siiyaa awood ballaaran oo ku saabsan qeexidda dambiga iyo go’aaminta ciqaabta ku habboon. Xaaladaha qaarkood, ciqaabaha taasiirta waxay ku ekaan karaan digniin, ganaax lacageed ama xabsi, halka kiisaska kale ay gaari karaan xitaa xukun dil ah. Amnesty International ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Sacuudi Carabiya dhaqan ahaan aanu lahayn xeer ciqaabeed oo dhammaystiran oo qoraal ah oo si gaar ah u nidaamiya taasiirka, iyadoo nidaamku inta badan ku tiirsanaa mabaadi’da shareecada iyo go’aanka garsoorayaasha. Sida ku cad tirokoobyada Amnesty International, ilaa Oktoobar 2026, in ka badan 175 qof ayaa lagu fuliyay xukun dil ah gudaha Sacuudi Carabiya sagaalkii bilood ee ugu horreeyay sannadkaas. Sacuudi Carabiya waxay ka mid tahay dalalka adduunka ugu badan ee fuliya xukunka dilka. Inta badan dadka la dilay sannadkan waxay ahaayeen ajaanib. Intii lagu jiray sannadka 2026, ugu yaraan 94 qof oo ajnabi ah, kuwaas oo ka kala socday in ka badan 20 waddan, ayaa lagu fuliyay xukun dil ah gudaha Sacuudi Carabiya. Sanadihii u dambeeyay, maxkamadaha Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale xukuno xabsi oo muddo dheer ah ku ridayay dad lagu eedeeyay qoraallo ay ku baahiyeen baraha bulshada, iyadoo mararka qaarkood xukunnadaas si weyn loo beddelay inta lagu guda jiray racfaannada. Sacuudi Carabiya ma laha xeer taasiireed oo qoraal ah oo si faahfaahsan u qeexaya dhammaan dambiyada iyo ciqaabahooda. Sida ay sheegtay Amnesty International, dambiyo badan iyo ciqaabahooda waxaa loo daayaa go’aanka garsoorayaasha, kuwaas oo xukunnada ku saleeya fasiraaddooda shareecada Islaamka. Inkastoo ay jiraan sharciyo qoran, mas’uuliyiintu waxay marar badan adeegsadaan qodobo ku jira Sharciga La-dagaallanka Argagixisada iyo Sharciga La-dagaallanka Dambiyada Internetka, kuwaas oo si ballaaran loo fasiri karo. Qodobadaas waxaa ka mid ah kuwa la xiriira waxyeellaynta “nidaamka guud,” “qiyamka diinta,” ama “akhlaaqda guud ee bulshada.” Bbc somali

items.title: Somaliland President Rejects Interference Threatening Ethiopia’s Security
items.description: Somaliland President Rejects Interference Threatening Ethiopia’s Security AMN PLUS-October 16, 2026 Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdillahi said on Thursday that Somaliland strongly opposed interference and any actions that could threaten neighboring Ethiopia’s stability and security. Speaking at the presidential Palace in Hargeisa after returning from visits to the United States and the United Arab Emirates, Abdillahi, widely known as Irro, expressed firm support for Ethiopia’s security. “We strongly oppose interference and any act that could endanger Ethiopia’s stability and security,” he said. His remarks followed diplomatic and military engagements between Somaliland and Ethiopia this week, alongside Somaliland’s renewed willingness to discuss maritime access for its landlocked neighbour. Foreign Minister Abdirahman Dahir Adan Bakal said in an interview with sky news Arabia reported on Monday, that Somaliland was ready to discuss Ethiopian access to its coastline and Berbera port. He described Ethiopia as a close ally and urged dialogue to resolve regional disputes. Ethiopian Ambassador Teshome Shunde separately met Bakal and Somaliland army Chief Brigadier General Nimcan Yusuf Gahnuug in Hargeisa. According to statements from Somaliland’s foreign ministry and military, the discussions covered bilateral relations, defense cooperation and regional security, with both sides emphasizing cooperation to support peace and stability. Somaliland and Ethiopia maintain close ties spanning trade, security and diplomatic engagement. Their shared border and economic links make stability in the region an important interest for both sides, according to allafrica.com

items.title: Lafta-gareen oo war culus soo saaray kadib degmooyinkii ay qabsadeen ciidankiisa
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Xafiiska Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen) ayaa maanta soo saaray war-saxaafadeed uu kaga hadlay guulaha ay maleeshiyadiisa ka gaareen gobolka Baay, kaddib markii ay maalmihii lasoo dhaafay la wareegeen degmooyin dhowr ah oo ay horay u maamulayeen ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. War-saxaafadeedka oo ku taariikheysan 16-ka October 2026 ayaa lagu sheegay in maleeshiyada taabacsan Lafta-gareen ay toddobaadkan howlgallo ka fuliyeen gobolka Baay, kuwaas oo xafiiskiisu ku tilmaamay kuwo lagu sugayay amniga, laguna soo celinayay xasilloonida deegaannada. “Ciidanka Daraawiishta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya waxay ku guuleysteen inay dib ula wareegaan oo ay xoreeyaan afar degmo iyo deegaanno muhiim ah oo ka tirsan gobolka Bay,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Xafiiska Lafta-gareen, oo weli sheegta madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, ayaa degmooyinkaasi ku sheegay Qansaxdheere, Buurhakaba, Bardaale iyo Diinsoor, isagoo sidoo kale xusay deegaanka Awdiile. Qoraalka ayaa eedeyn toos ah loogu jeediyay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo lagu sheegay inuu hoggaaminayo xoogagga ay ciidamada Lafta-gareen kula dagaallamayaan gobolka Baay, kuwaas oo war-saxaafadeedka uu ugu yeeray Salbalaar iyo Afbalaar. “Intii ay hawlgalladu socdeen, waxaa la beegsaday kooxda hubanta ah Salbalaar iyo Afbalaar ee uu hoggaamiyo Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka kasoo baxay xafiiska Lafta-gareen. Eedeyntan ayaa imaneysa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya ciidamada Lafta-gareen iyo kuwa taageersan maamulka hadda ka jira Baydhaba, oo garab ka helaya dowladda federaalka. Dhanka kale, xafiiska Lafta-gareen ayaa bogaadiyay shacabka ku nool deegaannada ay ciidamadiisu la wareegeen, isagoo sheegay inay muujiyeen adkeysi iyo taageero intii ay socdeen howlgallada. Waxaa sidoo kale war-saxaafadeedka lagu soo qaaday xuquuqda shacabka iyo inay awood u yeeshaan go’aaminta arrimaha khuseeya mustaqbalkooda iyo maamulka deegaannadooda. “Shacabka sharafta leh ee Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ay xaq u leeyihiin inay si xor ah uga qaybqaataan go’aannada masiiriga ah ee khuseeya mustaqbalkooda, dowladnimadooda iyo maamulka deegaannadooda,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay isbeddello waaweyn ka dhacayaan gobolka Baay, halkaas oo ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen ay maalmihii ugu dambeeyay si isdaba joog ah ula wareegayeen magaalooyin muhiim ah. Sida ay hore u baahisay Caasimada Online, ciidamada Lafta-gareen ayaa maanta si nabad ah ula wareegay degmada Bardaale, taas oo noqotay magaaladii saddexaad ee ay kala wareegaan maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, kaddib Buurhakaba iyo Qansaxdheere. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Lafta-gareen uu beddelay qaabkii uu ku qabsanayay magaalooyinka, isagoo hadda adeegsanaya wada-hadallo hoose iyo dhaqaale si uu u helo taageerada ciidamada ku sugan deegaannada, taas oo suurta-gelineysa in magaalooyinka qaarkood lala wareego dagaal la’aan. Dhanka kale, maamulka uu hoggaamiyo Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Sheekh Aadan Madoobe) ayaa wajahaya cadaadis militari oo sii kordhaya, iyadoo ciidamada Lafta-gareen ay kusoo siqayaan deegaannada ku dhow Baydhaba, oo ah xarunta maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Lafta-gareen, oo horay xilka madaxweynenimada uga degay kaddib isbeddelladii siyaasadeed iyo militari ee ka dhacay Baydhaba, ayaa markii dambe ka laabtay go’aankaas, isagoo weli sheeganaya hoggaanka Koonfur Galbeed. items.title: Mohamed Sheekh Axmed oo Noqday Guddoomiyaha Kumeelgaarka ah ee Baarlamaanka Galmudug
items.description: DHUUSAMAREEB (Goobjoog News) — Mohamed Sheekh Axmed ayaa noqday guddoomiyaha kumeelgaarka ah ee Baarlamaanka Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, kaddib markii maanta la dhaariyey xildhibaannada cusub ee golaha, oo ka kooban 89 xubnood. Mohamed Sheekh Axmed ayaa xilkan ku helay inuu yahay xildhibaanka ugu da’da weyn xubnaha cusub ee baarlamaanka, taas oo u saamaxday inuu si kumeelgaar ah u hoggaamiyo golaha inta laga dooranayo guddoon rasmi ah. Dhaarinta xildhibaannada cusub ayaa maanta ka dhacday Galmudug, iyadoo ay golaha ku jiraan 89 xubnood oo loo doortay inay matalaan bulshada deegaannada maamulkaas. Tallaabadan ayaa qayb ka ah hannaanka dhismaha hay’adaha maamulka Galmudug, iyadoo la filayo in xildhibaannadu ay doortaan guddoonka rasmiga ah ee baarlamaanka, kaas oo hoggaamin doona howlaha sharci-dejinta muddada soo socota.

items.title: Turkey’s $17bn fund scandal becomes a political crisis for Erdogan
items.description: President vows accountability as the liquidation of 130 investment funds exposes ties to Turkey’s ruling elite A crisis involving Turkish investment funds accused of running Ponzi-like schemes has affected half a million people, with authorities ordering the liquidation of some 130 funds worth $17bn earlier this month. Already historic in scale, the financial turmoil has quickly become a major political crisis for President Recep Tayyip Erdogan’s administration, exposing a web of connections between the funds, their managers and the ruling elite. The most prominent political casualty so far has been Fatma Betul Sayan Kaya , a deputy head of the ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP) and family minister from 2016 to 2018. She resigned on Sunday after the opposition accused her of making substantial profits from share sales shortly before the fund’s crisis triggered a major stock market sell-off on 16 September. Erdogan addressed the controversy on Monday, pledging to pursue those responsible for market manipulation and fraudulent trading schemes. “Whoever lays a hand on the nation’s rights, assets or legal interests will face us and the state,” he said. The funds in question concentrated their holdings in illiquid stocks with low free floats, making their prices easier to inflate because relatively few shares were available for trading. For example, the Tera investment fund generated a return of over 1,500 percent over the past year, a figure that is totally illogical by any market calculation or method. Authorities have set a six-month timeline to sell the funds’ assets and repay investors. But experts are pessimistic about how much investors will recover, with many unlikely to receive the inflated gains reflected in their holdings. Many of those affected are believed to be ruling-party voters, potentially increasing the political cost. Brokerage firms and financial groups accused of involvement in the alleged schemes, including Tera Group and Pusula , have politically connected figures on their boards. Tera and others deny wrongdoing. One of Erdogan’s chief advisers served on the board of Tera Portfolio Management until January 2026. Another former presidential adviser remained on the board until the crisis erupted, while his brother, a former ambassador, also sat on the boards of several companies under Tera Holding. Tera Group chairman Emre Tezmen, who has been arrested on charges of running a Ponzi-like scheme, also held a senior position in Turkey’s capital markets infrastructure. He served on the board of the Central Securities Depository of Turkey (MKK) until his arrest, the official institution responsible for the electronic recording, safekeeping and transfer of securities and other financial instruments. Tezmen denies wrongdoing. Muhammed Yariz , the chairman of Pusula Portfolio, has also recently been arrested. He is known for his past work within the AKP. The connections extend beyond the investment firms themselves. Kaya’s disputed trades primarily involved shares in Ozata Denizcilik , a shipbuilder involved in projects for the Turkish navy. The company’s links to politically connected families have raised questions about the overlap between businesses, regulators and government officials. An Ozata Denizcilik board member arrested on Monday is the son of a former member of the banking regulator that approved Tera Investment Bank, a sister company of Tera’s brokerage business. At one point, Tera’s brokerage reportedly controlled 95 percent of Ozata Denizcilik’s shares. The shipbuilder’s valuation surged to $5bn, exceeding those of major Turkish companies such as automaker Ford Otosan and steel producer Eregli. The arrested board member is also the son-in-law of a deputy finance minister, linking him to the very ministry now tasked with helping resolve the crisis. In a statement on social media, the board member denied the charges, stating that he surrendered to the authorities voluntarily in order to clear his name.  It remains unclear how far accountability will extend. Rumors circulating in Ankara suggest that other senior officials may have been involved, either by turning a blind eye to questionable activities or by investing themselves. Those claims remain unverified. High ‘political cost’ expected The authorities’ response has also been marked by missteps. On Friday, Justice Minister Akin Gurlek announced that authorities had frozen the assets of 46 legal entities, 18 funds and 42 individuals after reviewing fund outflows between 1 July and 16 September. Travel bans were also imposed on 37 suspects as a judicial-control measure. The measures blocked asset transfers, sales, large cash withdrawals and other transactions that could reduce the assets available for recovery. They also required capital market instruments to be frozen and suspicious transactions to be reported to judicial authorities.  The affected entities spanned investment firms, financial services companies, insurers, food producers and other businesses. They included Tera Yatirim, Pusula Yatirim, Ulusoy Un, Tatilbudur, Enuygun, Astor Enerji, IC Ictas, Emin Evim, Turkiye Hayat ve Emeklilik, Yayla Agro, Turkiye Sigorta and Katilimevim. The sweeping order raised fears of severe disruption when Borsa Istanbul reopened on Monday, prompting the authorities to reverse it on Sunday. Astor Enerji, one of the exchange’s largest listed companies, with a market capitalization of $5.3bn, said on Monday that the restrictions and freezing orders affecting it had been lifted. Its operations were continuing uninterrupted, the company added. Despite the reversal, the fallout continued, with Turkish stocks falling 2.38 percent on Monday. Erdogan is due to chair a committee meeting on Tuesday to discuss the next steps, with the mechanism for repaying investors still undecided. Some analysts in Ankara believe the government may have to sacrifice more politically connected figures, as it has the former family minister, to contain public anger. They argue that the scandal is unlikely to have a major impact on the 2028 presidential election. Others disagree. “Erdogan will have to genuinely go after this to show that he doesn’t forgive such transgressions, because the political cost could be worse than people imagine,” an Ankara insider said. Source:  Middle East eye The post Turkey’s $17bn fund scandal becomes a political crisis for Erdogan appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Opposition MP warns Hassan Sheikh’s election plan could push Somalia towards disintegration
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — An opposition lawmaker has warned that President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s handling of Somalia’s disputed electoral process could drive the country towards renewed fragmentation and state collapse, placing responsibility for the consequences squarely on the current administration. Abdilatif Muse Nur, known as Sanyare, made the warning in response to the federal election timetable announced by the National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission. He argued that the government’s approach risks deepening political divisions at a moment when Somalia urgently needs agreement between the federal leadership, opposition groups and federal member states. In remarks reflecting growing opposition concern, Sanyare warned that Mogadishu could return to the kind of political fragmentation that followed the collapse of the central government in 1991. “I believe Mogadishu could end up with a government like that of Ali Mahdi, while Somalia could follow the path of disintegration and collapse,” he said. “Responsibility for that outcome will rest with the current government.” Ali Mahdi Mohamed became president during Somalia’s political breakdown in 1991, but his administration failed to establish effective authority across the country as rival factions fought for control. Sanyare’s comparison invokes one of the most painful chapters in Somalia’s modern history, when political disputes escalated into armed conflict and the collapse of national institutions. An election timetable without political consensus The opposition warning follows the commission’s announcement that parliamentary elections are scheduled for 15 April 2027 and the presidential election for 15 May 2027. The dates have emerged amid continuing disagreements over the constitutional framework, the electoral system and the relationship between the federal government and member states. Opposition figures argue that announcing an election calendar cannot substitute for a negotiated political settlement. They maintain that proceeding without broad agreement risks turning the electoral process into another source of confrontation rather than a mechanism for resolving the country’s leadership dispute. The central concern is that unilateral decisions could further alienate political forces and federal member states that already distrust Mogadishu’s approach. If major stakeholders reject the process, Somalia could face a prolonged dispute over the legitimacy of its institutions and the authority of the next government. Who will bear responsibility? Sanyare’s warning places the political consequences of the dispute directly before Hassan Sheikh’s administration. The president and his supporters may regard the election timetable as a necessary step towards completing the electoral process. His critics, however, argue that the government cannot expect national acceptance simply by announcing dates without first addressing fundamental disagreements. The stakes extend well beyond the next presidential contest. Somalia’s federal system depends on cooperation between the central government and member states, as well as a minimum level of confidence among political rivals. Continued confrontation could weaken those relationships, undermine national institutions and complicate efforts to address insecurity and other urgent challenges. A return to widespread state collapse is not inevitable, and Sanyare’s comparison is a political warning rather than a prediction that the events of 1991 will be repeated. Nevertheless, the danger of escalating fragmentation deserves serious attention when disputes over elections and constitutional authority remain unresolved. Hassan Sheikh’s administration still has an opportunity to reduce those risks by engaging opposition leaders and federal member states in meaningful negotiations, clarifying the constitutional basis for the electoral process and seeking an agreement that commands broad political confidence. If the government instead presses ahead without such a settlement, its opponents will argue that it bears a substantial share of the responsibility for any resulting crisis. The message from the opposition is stark: Somalia cannot afford another political breakdown driven by a struggle for power. If unilateral electoral decisions deepen divisions and push the country towards further fragmentation, Hassan Sheikh’s legacy will be judged not only by the election he seeks to organise, but also by whether his leadership preserves—or further weakens—the Somali state. They maintain that proceeding without broad agreement risks turning the electoral process into another source of confrontation rather than a mechanism for resolving the country’s leadership dispute. The central concern is that unilateral decisions could further alienate political forces and federal member states that already distrust Mogadishu’s approach. If major stakeholders reject the process, Somalia could face a prolonged dispute over the legitimacy of its institutions and the authority of the next government. Who will bear responsibility? Sanyare’s warning places the political consequences of the dispute directly before Hassan Sheikh’s administration. The president and his supporters may regard the election timetable as a necessary step towards completing the electoral process. His critics, however, argue that the government cannot expect national acceptance simply by announcing dates without first addressing fundamental disagreements. The stakes extend well beyond the next presidential contest. Somalia’s federal system depends on cooperation between the central government and member states, as well as a minimum level of confidence among political rivals. Continued confrontation could weaken those relationships, undermine national institutions and complicate efforts to address insecurity and other urgent challenges. A return to widespread state collapse is not inevitable, and Sanyare’s comparison is a political warning rather than a prediction that the events of 1991 will be repeated. Nevertheless, the danger of escalating fragmentation deserves serious attention when disputes over elections and constitutional authority remain unresolved. Hassan Sheikh’s administration still has an opportunity to reduce those risks by engaging opposition leaders and federal member states in meaningful negotiations, clarifying the constitutional basis for the electoral process and seeking an agreement that commands broad political confidence. If the government instead presses ahead without such a settlement, its opponents will argue that it bears a substantial share of the responsibility for any resulting crisis. The message from the opposition is stark: Somalia cannot afford another political breakdown driven by a struggle for power. If unilateral electoral decisions deepen divisions and push the country towards further fragmentation, Hassan Sheikh’s legacy will be judged not only by the election he seeks to organise, but also by whether his leadership preserves—or further weakens—the Somali state. items.title: Poll body has a date for the vote, but no deal to hold it
items.description: The government has named the days citizens will go to the polls, but the country’s politics are still miles from agreeing on how they will get there. On Thursday, the head of the electoral commission went on state television and announced that parliamentary elections will be held on April 15, 2027, with the presidential vote to follow a month later, on May 15. Abdikarim Ahmed Hassan, who chairs the Independent National Elections and Boundaries Commission (INEBC), said the presidential date flows from a rule that a president’s five-year term begins on the day of swearing-in. The timetable was barely out before the opposition shot it down. At the heart of the quarrel is President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s mandate. His term, which began in 2022, expired earlier this year. In May, his government pushed through a constitutional amendment declaring a “transition period,” even though it had agreed with the opposition to hold elections. The opposition boycotted that vote and has refused to recognise the changes since. Critics also accuse the president of using the changes to push through party-based elections and replace the clan-elder system, which they call a power grab. Two former presidents were quick to weigh in. Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo took to X to call the decision a “dangerous threat” to Somalia’s statehood, urging all sides to agree on a way forward before any date is fixed. Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, once a leading voice in the opposition, warned that a contested process could produce parallel elections and, worse, civil conflict. The government, for its part, welcomed the dates as an important step for democracy and urged all parties to take part in good faith. Analyst Samira Gaid was blunt. She says there is no political agreement behind the elections, adding that the government is effectively Mogadishu plus “two or three allied” federal member states. In her view, the vote could deepen confrontation in the rest. Speaking to Al Jazeera earlier this month, President Mohamud acknowledged that serious security challenges remain. He said al-Shabab has no presence in the major cities and is unlikely to take over the country. But the group still holds territory in parts of the south and centre, and has struck deadly blows in Mogadishu and across the border in Kenya in the past. items.title: Xoogaga Laftagareen oo la wareegay Degmada Diinsoor
items.description: Maamulka Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa caawa fiidkii laga la wareegay gacan ku haynta Degmada Diinsoor ee Gobolka Baay, iyadoona noqoneyso degmadii ugu dambeysay gobolkaasi ee laga qabsado maamulkiisa. Ma jirto degmo ka tirsan gobolka oo hadda ku hartay gacanta maamulka, marka laga soo tago magaalada xarunta u ah gobolkaasi ee Baydhabo. Ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa gudaha u galay Degmada Diinsoor, lamana soo sheegin wax iska caabin ah oo ay la kulmeen. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadii ka hawlgelayay magaalada ay qaybtood gabaad weydiisteen Militariga Itoobiya ee qaybta ka ah Hawlgalka AUSSOM ee ku sugan magaaladaasi, halka kuwii kalena ay isu dhiibeen ciidamada cusub. Ciidamada Laftagareen ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyay kordhiyay dhaqdhaqaaqyada iyo hawlgalada ay ka wadaan Gobolka Baay, iyagoona gacanta ku dhigay dhowr degmo iyo deegaano kale. Dhaqdhaqaaqyadan ciidan ayaa horseeday is bedel maamul iyo mid amni oo ku yimid magaalooyinka iyo deegaanada hoostaga Magaalada Baydhabo. Mucaaradka uu Laftagareen hoggaamiyo ayaa haatan si buuxda u maamulaya Degmooyinka Buurhakaba, Berdaale, Qansaxdheere iyo Diinsoor iyo weliba deegaanada ku teedsan Baydhabo.

items.title: Laftagareen’s forces advance towards Baidabo: Four territorial gains in a week raise questions about Southwest’s defences
items.description: Baidabo (WDN) — Forces aligned with Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen have claimed another territorial gain in Southwest State, announcing the capture of Awdiinle, a settlement reportedly just 25 kilometres from Baidabo. The latest development comes amid reports of a series of advances that are putting growing pressure on the administration led by Adan Mohamed Nur Madobe. According to reports circulating locally, Laftagareen-aligned forces have taken control of several strategic locations, including Qansax Dheere, Buurhakaba and, more recently, Awdiinle. Bardale has also been mentioned among the reported gains. The sequence would represent a substantial shift in control across parts of Bay region within a short period. Images shared on social media appear to show residents gathered alongside armed men identified as Laftagareen-aligned fighters in Awdiinle. The footage suggests the settlement changed hands without a major confrontation. Some observers have interpreted the scenes as evidence that the fighters received a welcome from local residents, potentially reflecting dissatisfaction with the rival administration. However, the imagesestablish the wider population’s political preferences or confirm the circumstances under which control changed. A strategy of isolation? The speed and pattern of the reported advances raise a central question: are Laftagareen’s forces preparing for a direct assault on Baidabo, or are they seeking to isolate the regional capital and weaken the administration’s position before any decisive confrontation? The reported capture of Buurhakaba, approximately 60 kilometres from Baidabo, followed by the advance into Awdiinle, now reportedly just 25 kilometres away, has intensified concern about the capital’s security. The loss of surrounding settlements could restrict the administration’s territorial reach, complicate the movement of its forces and increase pressure on supply routes. If the advances continue, Baidabo could face mounting difficulties without the need for an immediate urban battle. By taking control of settlements around the capital, Laftagareen-aligned forces could leave Madobe’s administration increasingly confined to the areas it can still defend. Such a strategy would rely not only on military pressure but also on the willingness of local communities and security personnel to resist, withdraw or change their allegiance. The available reports do establish the territorial changes are the result of coordinated military planning, local political calculations, withdrawals by rival forces or a combination of factors. Adan Madobe remains in Mogadishu as pressure builds Madobe reportedly remains in Mogadishu while the forces aligned with Laftagareen continue their advance towards Baidabo. His absence has added to questions about how the administration intends to respond to the rapidly changing security situation. Madobe has reportedly held over the phone consultations with officials and security commanders, instructing them to strengthen security in areas under their control and prepare for possible attacks. The discussions are said to have focused particularly on preventing Baidabo from becoming isolated and protecting other strategically important towns in Bay region. The crucial question is whether the administration has sufficient loyal forces, operational capacity and support to reverse the reported losses and secure the approaches to the capital. The answer remains unclear. Federal government and Southwest State security personnel have reportedly been instructed to take measures against both Laftagareen-aligned forces and Al-Shabaab. This places additional pressure on security institutions already confronting a complicated political and military environment. What happens next? The apparent absence of major fighting in Awdiinle is particularly noteworthy. As the reported change of control occurred without resistance, it could indicate a withdrawal, limited capacity to defend the settlement or local acceptance of the incoming forces. Determining which explanation is correct will require further independent reporting. For Baidabo’s leadership, the immediate challenge is to assess the security of the capital and neighboring settlements, establish the extent of the territorial losses and decide whether to reinforce defensive positions, seek federal assistance or pursue a political response. The broader implications extend beyond the fate of individual towns. Continued fighting or further shifts in control could expose civilians to insecurity, disrupt trade and movement, and deepen political divisions across Southwest State. For now, the reported advance into Awdiinle has brought Laftagareen-aligned forces closer to Baidabo and intensified scrutiny of Madobe’s response. Whether the objective is to capture the capital or steadily weaken its administration through territorial isolation remains unconfirmed. The defining question is whether Baidabo can prevent further losses before the pressure around the capital becomes more difficult to contain. The coming developments will reveal whether the administration can stabilize its position or whether the reported advances will continue to reshape control across Bay region. items.title: Daawo: Xasan Sheekh oo dul tegay markabka shidaalka qodaya ee Çağrı Bey
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa kormeer shaqo ku tagay markabka shidaalka qodaya ee Çağrı Bey, kaas oo ku sugan biyaha Soomaaliya, halkaas oo uu ka wado hawlaha qodista shidaalka dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa intii uu kormeerka ku jiray kulan la yeeshay khubarada iyo mas’uuliyiinta markabka, isaga oo ka dhageystay warbixin ku saabsan hawlaha qodista, shaqada ilaa hadda la qabtay iyo natiijooyinka hordhaca ah ee laga gaaray. Kormeerkan ayaa imanaya xilli Soomaaliya ay dadaal ugu jirto ka faa’iidaysiga khayraadka dabiiciga ah ee ku jira dhulkeeda iyo biyaha badda, gaar ahaan shidaalka oo la filayo inuu door ka qaato horumarinta dhaqaalaha dalka. Warbixinta laga siiyay madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale la xiriirtay horumarka laga sameeyay hawlaha qodista iyo guulaha hordhaca ah ee la diiwaangeliyay, kuwaas oo dowladda ay danaynayso inay u horseedaan xaqiijinta khayraadka shidaal ee Soomaaliya. Hawlaha uu markabka Çağrı Bey ka wado biyaha Soomaaliya ayaa qayb ka ah qorshaha lagu ogaanayo laguna xaqiijinayo jiritaanka shidaalka ku jira badda dalka, iyadoo natiijooyinka laga helo qodista ay muhiim u yihiin go’aaminta tallaabooyinka xiga ee mashruuca. Markabka Çağrı Bey ayaa qodista ka wada ceelka Curad-1, oo ku yaalla meel qiyaastii 370 kiiloomitir u jirta xeebta Muqdisho. Qorshuhu waa in qodista laga sii dhaadhaco ilaa 4,000 oo mitir oo ka hooseeya gunta badda, iyadoo ceelka oo dhan la doonayo inuu gaaro qoto dhan 7,500 oo mitir. Markabka waxaa taageeraya maraakiibta Altan, Korkut iyo Sancar, halka ciidamada badda Turkiguna ay qayb ka yihiin sugidda ammaanka. Iskaashiga shidaal iyo gaas ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa salka ku haya heshiisyo la kala saxiixday sanadkii 2024. Markabka cilmi-baarista seismic-ka ee Oruç Reis ayaa markii dambe xog saddex-geesood ah ka ururiyay dhul-badeed gaaraya 4,464 kiiloomitir oo isku wareeg ah. Kadib ku dhowaad toddobo bilood oo sahanno iyo falanqayn xogeed ah, ayaa ceelka Curad-1 loo doortay goobta ugu horreysa ee qodista. Si kastaba, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii dambe xoogga saareysay qorshayaasha la xiriira sahaminta iyo soo saarista shidaalka, iyadoo rajada laga qabo khayraadkan ay la xiriirto kobaca dhaqaalaha, abuurista fursado shaqo iyo kordhinta dakhliga dowladda. Kormeerka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa muujinaya muhiimadda ay dowladda siinayso hawlaha shidaal qodista iyo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo khayraadka ku jira biyaha Soomaaliya.
