items.title: Hassan Sheikh’s remarks on political consultation spark public outcry, raise questions over leadership
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has triggered widespread debate on Somali social media after telling lawmakers from the Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP), his own political organisation, that there would be no consultation over the contentious issues facing the country. The president made the remarks during a meeting with JSP-affiliated members of parliament. Speaking about public calls for him to seek consensus on disputed national matters, he reportedly said: “To those telling me, ‘President Hassan, put the matter to consultation and involve people in the disputed issues,’ I want to make it clear: there will be no such consultation.” The statement quickly became a subject of intense discussion online, with critics interpreting it as an outright rejection of dialogue at a time when Somalia remains deeply divided over the electoral process and the country’s political future. For many observers, the controversy goes beyond a single remark. It raises serious questions about the president’s willingness to accommodate opposing views, build political consensus and lead a country whose federal system depends on negotiations among competing political stakeholders. Some social media users also questioned the judgment behind such an uncompromising public statement. However, the remarks alone do not establish anything about the president’s mental health or sanity; the more immediate issue is their political meaning and potential consequences. Lawmakers’ applause draws criticism The response of lawmakers attending the meeting also attracted criticism. According to the account circulated online, JSP-affiliated legislators applauded the president rather than challenging or questioning his rejection of consultation. Critics argue that the reaction illustrates the dangers of a political environment in which governing-party lawmakers may be more concerned with maintaining their positions than representing the concerns of their constituents. Opponents further allege that some legislators favour an election process shaped by the president because they fear losing their seats in a genuinely competitive, transparent and credible contest. These are political accusations, however, and would require independent evidence to establish the individual motives of the lawmakers concerned. The controversy comes amid wider disputes over the proposed transition to direct, one-person-one-vote elections and disagreements about the legitimacy, timing and administration of the process. A rejection of consensus? The phrase that drew the strongest reaction was the president’s reported declaration that there would be no consultation. In a country where disputes over elections, constitutional arrangements and the division of political authority have repeatedly generated tension, the language was widely perceived by critics as confrontational. Somalia’s political stability depends not only on holding elections but also on ensuring that the rules are accepted by the principal political stakeholders. When major decisions are perceived to be imposed unilaterally, the risk of parallel political processes, institutional confrontation and further fragmentation increases. During the meeting, Hassan Sheikh also discussed strengthening cooperation with supportive lawmakers, the role of parliamentarians in advancing state-building and preparations for the direct-election system he is pursuing. Yet critics say that cooperation within the president’s own political camp cannot substitute for broader national consultation. An electoral process that enjoys the support of governing-party allies but lacks wider political agreement risks deepening the very divisions it is supposed to resolve. The central question is therefore not whether the president can secure applause from his supporters, but whether his administration can build sufficient trust to ensure that Somalia’s next political transition is credible, inclusive and peaceful. For a country already facing serious political divisions, the president’s reported rejection of consultation has become a test of leadership. Whether the statement reflects a deliberate political strategy or was an ill-judged expression of frustration, its consequences will depend on whether the administration chooses confrontation or returns to meaningful dialogue. items.fullContent: Mogadishu (WDN) — President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has triggered widespread debate on Somali social media after telling lawmakers from the Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP), his own political organisation, that there would be no consultation over the contentious issues facing the country. The president made the remarks during a meeting with JSP-affiliated members of parliament. Speaking about public calls for him to seek consensus on disputed national matters, he reportedly said: “To those telling me, ‘President Hassan, put the matter to consultation and involve people in the disputed issues,’ I want to make it clear: there will be no such consultation.” The statement quickly became a subject of intense discussion online, with critics interpreting it as an outright rejection of dialogue at a time when Somalia remains deeply divided over the electoral process and the country’s political future. For many observers, the controversy goes beyond a single remark. It raises serious questions about the president’s willingness to accommodate opposing views, build political consensus and lead a country whose federal system depends on negotiations among competing political stakeholders. Some social media users also questioned the judgment behind such an uncompromising public statement. However, the remarks alone do not establish anything about the president’s mental health or sanity; the more immediate issue is their political meaning and potential consequences. Lawmakers’ applause draws criticism The response of lawmakers attending the meeting also attracted criticism. According to the account circulated online, JSP-affiliated legislators applauded the president rather than challenging or questioning his rejection of consultation. Critics argue that the reaction illustrates the dangers of a political environment in which governing-party lawmakers may be more concerned with maintaining their positions than representing the concerns of their constituents. Opponents further allege that some legislators favour an election process shaped by the president because they fear losing their seats in a genuinely competitive, transparent and credible contest. These are political accusations, however, and would require independent evidence to establish the individual motives of the lawmakers concerned. The controversy comes amid wider disputes over the proposed transition to direct, one-person-one-vote elections and disagreements about the legitimacy, timing and administration of the process. A rejection of consensus? The phrase that drew the strongest reaction was the president’s reported declaration that there would be no consultation. In a country where disputes over elections, constitutional arrangements and the division of political authority have repeatedly generated tension, the language was widely perceived by critics as confrontational. Somalia’s political stability depends not only on holding elections but also on ensuring that the rules are accepted by the principal political stakeholders. When major decisions are perceived to be imposed unilaterally, the risk of parallel political processes, institutional confrontation and further fragmentation increases. During the meeting, Hassan Sheikh also discussed strengthening cooperation with supportive lawmakers, the role of parliamentarians in advancing state-building and preparations for the direct-election system he is pursuing. Yet critics say that cooperation within the president’s own political camp cannot substitute for broader national consultation. An electoral process that enjoys the support of governing-party allies but lacks wider political agreement risks deepening the very divisions it is supposed to resolve. The central question is therefore not whether the president can secure applause from his supporters, but whether his administration can build sufficient trust to ensure that Somalia’s next political transition is credible, inclusive and peaceful. For a country already facing serious political divisions, the president’s reported rejection of consultation has become a test of leadership. Whether the statement reflects a deliberate political strategy or was an ill-judged expression of frustration, its consequences will depend on whether the administration chooses confrontation or returns to meaningful dialogue. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo kormeeray markabka shidaal qodista ka wada dalka (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa kormeer shaqo ku tegay markabka Turkiga laga leeyahay ee ÇAĞRI BEY ee shidaal qodista ka wada xeebaha dalka. Markabkan ayaa 9-kii bishii April ku soo xirtay Dekedda Muqdisho, ka dib markii 15-kii bishii February uu ka soo shiraacday Dekedda Taşucu ee Koonfurta Turkiga, iyadoo tan iyo xilligaasina uu howlo shaqo u joogo xeebaha dalka. “Madaxweynaha ayaa khubarada iyo masuuliyiinta markabka ka dhageystay warbixin ku saabsan shaqada la qabtay, natiijooyinka laga gaaray howlaha qodista shidaalka iyo guulaha horudhaca ah ee muuqda, kuwaasi oo qayb ka ah dadaalada lagu xaqiijinayo khayraadka shidaal ee ku jira biyaha Soomaaliya.” Ayaa lagu yiri qoraal lagu daabacay bogga wararka ee Villa Somalia. Turkiga oo ah saaxiib weyn oo Somaliya ay leedahay ayaa maalgelinaya kharashka ku baxaya howlaha shidaal sahminta iyo soo saarista ee laga sameynayo dalka. Markabka ÇAĞRI BEY ayaa ah markabkii ugu horreyay ee shidaal qodis ee Turkiga uu u diro meel ka baxsan biyaha dalkaasi. In badan oo ka mid ah shacabka Soomaaliyeed ayaa waxay qabaan in la gaaray oo la joogo xilligii la soo saari lahaa, lagana faa’iideysan lahaa khayraadka dabiiciga ah dalka ee aan la taaban.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Kormeeray Markabka Shidaalka Qodaya ee Çağrı Bey
items.description: MUQDISHO (Goobjoog News) — Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa kormeer shaqo ku tagay markabka Çağrı Bey oo ku sugan biyaha Soomaaliya, halkaas oo uu ka wado hawlaha qodista shidaalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa intii uu kormeerka ku jiray warbixin ka dhageystay khubarada iyo mas’uuliyiinta markabka, kuwaas oo uga warbixiyay hawlaha qodista ee socda, natiijooyinka laga gaaray iyo xogta hordhaca ah ee laga helay shaqada ilaa hadda la qabtay. Hawlgalkan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ku doonayso in lagu xaqiijiyo jiritaanka iyo baaxadda khayraadka shidaal ee ku jira biyaha dalka, si loo ogaado awoodda khayraadkaasi u leeyahay inuu qayb ka noqdo dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya. Kormeerka Madaxweynaha ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ay socdaan hawlaha qodista shidaalka ee markabka Çağrı Bey, inkasta oo aan faahfaahin dheeraad ah laga bixin natiijooyinka rasmiga ah ee hawlgalka iyo xaddiga shidaal ee la xaqiijiyey.

items.title: Xogta shir ay Isimida beesha Daarood ku yeesheen Nairobi
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Garaad Jaamac Garaad Cali ayaa faahfaahin ka bixiyay kulan ay shalay magaalada Nairobi ee dalka Kenya ku yeesheen inta badan isimada dhaqanka beesha Daarood, kaas oo looga hadlay xaaladda guud ee dalka iyo duruufaha ka jira deegaannada ay kasoo jeedaan. Garaadka ayaa sheegay in kulanka uu ahaa mid ay isimadu isku xog-waraysteen, isla markaana ay ku falanqeeyeen arrimo mudnaan gaar ah u leh deegaannada ay dhaqanka u yihiin. “Kulanka oo ahaa is-xogwaraysi waxaanu odayaasha iska xogwaraysannay xaaladda guud ee dalka iyo deegaannada aanu odayaasha dhaqan u nahay, iyada oo la isku raacay hirgelinta arrimo badan oo deegaannada hortebin u leh,” ayuu yiri Garaad Jaamac. Kulanka kaddib, isimada Daarood ee ku sugan Nairobi ayaa la filayaa inay safar ku tagaan Puntland, halkaas oo ay kaga qayb geli doonaan shir nabadeed oo lagu qaban doono magaalada Badhan ee gobolka Sanaag. Safarkan ayaa la xiriira baaq ay isimadu ka aqbaleen Suldaan Siciid Suldaan Cabdisalaan, kaas oo ku saabsanaa dadaallada lagu nabadeynayo beelaha ku dhaqan Sanaag. Sida qorshuhu yahay, isimadu waxay marka hore tegi doonaan magaalada Garoowe ka hor inta aysan u sii gudbin Badhan, halkaas oo lagu wado in lagu qabto shirka nabadeed. Shirka ayaa qayb ka noqonaya dadaallada dhaqanka ee lagu doonayo in lagu dejiyo xiisadaha beelaha Sanaag, inkasta oo aan faahfaahin dheeraad ah laga bixin ajandaha kulanka iyo beelaha sida tooska ah uga qayb geli doona. The post Xogta shir ay Isimida beesha Daarood ku yeesheen Nairobi appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Marka Itoobiya aqoonsato Somaliland, waxay xoojin doontaa saamaynta gobolka ee Itoobiya Dr. Mohamed Haji
items.description: Safiirka Somaliland ujooga dalka Israel ayaa ka jawaabay hadal ka soo yeedhay safiirka Itoobiya u fadhiya dalka Israel kaasi oo sheegay hadii ay Itoobiya aqoonsato Somaliland in dawladda Somalia ay ciidamda Itoobiya ee ku sugan dalka Soomaaliya ay dal banan doonto in ciidamada Itoobiya iskaga baxaan Somalia arinkaasi hadii uu dhaco waxa uu safiirku sheegay in Kooxda argagaxisada ah ee Alshabaab ay halis galin doonaan Itoobiya iyo Somaliland labadaba. Hadaba qoraal barta X- uu ku baahiyay Dr Maxamed Xaaji waxa uu aaminsanyahay aqoonsiga ay Itoobiya u fidiso Somaliland uu faa’iido ugujirto Itoobiya iyobta gobolka waxana qoraalku uu u dhignaa sidan hoos ku xusan. Waxaan hubaa in lidkeeda ay run tahay: Itoobiya waxay u taagan tahay inay hesho faa’iidooyin istiraatiiji ah, dhaqaale, iyo amni oo aad u weyn iyadoo aqoonsanaysa Somaliland, iyada oo aan wax khatar amni ah lahayn. Waxa Muqdisho ay ku samaynayso Itoobiya waa mid aad u waxyeello badan, maadaama ay si isa soo taraysa ula jaanqaadayso kuwa la tartamaya Itoobiya oo ay siinayso goob ay ku horumariyaan danahooda ka dhanka ah Itoobiya. Marka Itoobiya aqoonsato Somaliland, waxay xoojin doontaa saamaynta gobolka ee Itoobiya, awoodda istaraatiijiyadda mashruuca, waxayna heli doontaa lammaane lagu kalsoonaan karo oo ku sugan Geeska Afrika; waa inaan wajahnaa xaqiiqada: Dadka iyo dawladda Somaliland waxay ka hortageen Al-Shabaab iyo burcad-badeedda inay dhisaan meelo ammaan ah oo ay ka faa’iidaystaan ​​​​meelo kale, iyagoo muujinaya tobanaan sano oo adkaysi ah, maamul maxalli ah oo wax ku ool ah, iyo ballanqaad joogto ah oo ku aaddan amniga gobolka oo ka dhigaya Somaliland hanti istiraatiiji ah, oo aan ahayn mas’uuliyad amni. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ciidamada Afrikaanka ah laguma filan karo inay sii joogaan Soomaaliya si aan xad lahayn, waa inaan eegnaa wixii ka dambeeya qorshayaasha amniga ee hadda jira oo aan qorsheynaa waxa dhici doona marka ay ka baxaan. Aqoonsiga Itoobiya ee Somaliland wuxuu xoojin doonaa amnigeeda, wuxuu dardargelin doonaa kobaca dhaqaalaha, wuxuuna kor u qaadi doonaa awooddeeda ay ku samayn karto awoodda waxayna ballaarin doontaa saameynteeda istaraatiijiyadeed ee Geeska Afrika iyo gobolka Badda Cas ee ballaaran.

items.title: Ciidamada Laftagareen oo la wareegay gacan ku haynta Awdiinle
items.description: Ciidamo horey uga tirsanaa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed iyo maleeshiyaad qaab beeleed u abaabulan ayaa maanta bilaa dagaal kula wareegay gacan ku haynta deegaanka Awdiinle ee gobolkaasi Baay. Xoogagan ayaa taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen), kaas oo hoggaaminaya kacdoon lagaga soo horjeedo Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe). Dadka deegaanka ayaa isugu soo baxay waddooyinka, iyagoo soo dhaweynaya ciidamada la wareegay Awdiinle oo 30km dhanka galbeed uga beegan Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. Ciidamadan ayaa si la yaab leh isugu fidinaya magaalooyinka iyo deegaanada ku dhow dhow Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta KMG Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo meelaha ay illaa iyo hadda qabsadeen aanay iska caabin kala kulmin, marka laga soo tago Buurhakaba. Taageereyaasha Laftagareen ayaa waxay hadda u muuqdaan kuwo si buuxda u go’doomiyay Baydhabo, inkastoo garabka Laftagareen aanu weli ku dhawaaqin in ay go’doomiyeen magaalada amaba ay cunaqabatayn ku soo rogayaan. La wareegitaanka Buurhakaba oo 60km u jirta Baydhabo, Qansaxdheere oo 98km u jirta iyo Berdaale oo 50km u jirta ayaa culeys weyn ku ah Maamulka Aadan Madoobe. Qalalaasaha siyaasadeed iyo ciidan ee Koonfur Galbeed ayaa xoogeystay, ka dib markii ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen ay toddobaadkii hore bedeleen istiraatiijiyadda dagaalkoodii ku koobnaa Baydhabo, markaas oo ay bilaabeen inay qabsadaan magaalooyinka muhiimka ah ee ku xeeran.

items.title: Ciidamada Lafta-gareen oo la wareegay magaaladii saddexaad
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen) ayaa si nabad ah ula wareegay magaalada Bardaale ee gobolka Baay, taas oo noqonaysa magaalada saddexaad ee ay kala wareegaan maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. items.title: Ciidamada Taabacsan Lafta-gareen oo La Wareegay Degmada Bardaale
items.description: BAYDHABO (Goobjoog News) — Ciidamada taabacsan madaxweynihii hore Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Lafta-gareen, ayaa goordhow si rasmi ah ula wareegay gacan-ku-haynta degmada Bardaale ee gobolka Baay, sida ay sheegayaan wararka laga helayo deegaanka. Bardaale ayaa noqoneysa degmadii Saddexaad ee muddo laba maalmood gudahood ay la wareegaan ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen, iyadoo xaaladda amni ee gobolka Baay ay weli tahay mid isbeddelaysa. Dhanka kale, ciidamo kale ayaa la sheegay inay ku sii wajahan yihiin degmada Diinsoor iyo deegaanka Awdiinle, oo ka tirsan gobolka Baay, kuwaas oo aan sidaas uga fogeyn magaalada Baydhabo, xarunta maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Dhaqdhaqaaqyadan ciidan ayaa imanaya xilli ay gobolka Baay ka socdaan xiisado siyaasadeed iyo kuwo amni oo la xiriira xaaladda maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Ilaa hadda ma jiraan faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo la xaqiijiyey oo ku saabsan xaaladda degmada Bardaale kaddib la wareegista ciidamada, iyo tallaabooyinka xiga ee ay qaadi doonaan ciidamada ku sugan nawaaxiga Diinsoor iyo Awdiinle.

items.title: Itoobiya oo faragelin Milatari ka Wadda Gudaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa si qaawan ugu xadgudbtay madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, kaddib markii ay saacadihii la soo dhaafay ay qaaday tallaabo ay ku xoojisay xiriirka dhinaca difaaca iyo amniga ee ay la leedahay Somaliland, oo qayb ka ah Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Tallaabadan ayaa dhalinaysa su’aalo culus oo ku saabsan damaca siyaasadeed ee Addis Ababa iyo sababta ay uga hareer martay Dowladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo si toos ah ugala macaamilaysa maamulka Hargeysa arrimo la xiriira difaaca iyo amniga. Arrintan ayaa soo shaac baxday kaddib kulan magaalada Hargeysa ku dhexmaray Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidanka Maamulka Somaliland, iyo mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan dowladda Itoobiya oo ay ku jiraan Wakiilka Itoobiya u fadhiya Somaliland, qunsulka guud iyo u-qaybsanaha difaaca ee safaaradda. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta kulanka, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca, amniga iyo xaaladaha gobolka. Iskaashi noocan ah oo aysan dowladda federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya qayb ka ahayn wuxuu abuurayaa walaac siyaasadeed oo culus, maadaama Itoobiya ay si gaar ah ugala macaamilayso maamul ka tirsan dhulka Soomaaliya arrimo taabanaya amniga iyo difaaca. Mas’uuliyiin xilal sare ka soo qabtay hay’adaha amniga dalka ayaa arrinta qeyla dhaan ka soo saaray, waxayna Itoobiya u soo jeediyeen in ay ka waantowdo xadgudubka ay ku hayso dalka. Cabdisalaan Guuleed, taliye ku-xigeenkii hore ee Hay’adda NISA, ayaa ka mid ah mas’uuliyiinta arrintan ku dhaliilay dowladda Itoobiya, isaga oo adkeeyay in midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya aanay gorgortan geli karin, Somaliland-na ay qayb ka tahay Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Guuleed ayaa tallaabooyinka Addis Ababa ku tilmaamay kuwo khaldan maadaama ay hareer marreen dowladda federaalka ah, isaga oo sheegay in faragelinta ay Itoobiya ku eedeysay Eritrea iyo Masar in ay ku hayaan iyadu ay ka waddo gudaha Soomaaliya. Waxaa muuqata tallaabadan ay ku kacday Itoobiya mid dabaqeysa oraahdii Soomaaliyeed ee ahayd “Hasha iyada ayaa geela cuneysa, haddana cabaadeysa.” Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed ayaa loo soo jeediyay in uu joojiyo tallaabo kasta oo Soomaaliya u aragto faragelin lagu hayo arrimaheeda gudaha. Dowladda Federaal ah ee Soomaaliya ayaan weli ka hadlin tallaabadan xadgudubka ah ee ay ku kacday dowladda Itoobiya iyo faragelinta qaawan ee Addis Ababa ay ula bareertay Madaxbannaanida Soomaaliya.

items.title: Masar oo god dheer ku riday damaca Itoobiya ee badda
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Masar ayaa digniin dadban u dirtay Itoobiya, iyadoo sheegtay inaysan aqbali doonin in dal aan xeeb lahayn uu Badda Cas u adeegsado ujeeddooyin milatari, xilli Addis Ababa ay sii xoojinayso dadaallada ay ku doonayso marin-badeedka. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar ayaa sheegay in Qaahira ay ku adkeysanayso in mas’uuliyadda amniga Badda Cas ay gaar u tahay dalalka xeebaha ku leh, taas oo u muuqata mowqif ka dhan ah damaca Itoobiya ee helitaanka marin-badeed. “Waa wax aan sinaba loo aqbali karin in dal aan bad lahayn uu Badda Cas u adeegsado arrimo milatari. Dalalka aan badda lahayn waxa keliya ee loo oggolaan karo waa marin ganacsi, haddii ay arrintaas kala heshiiyaan dalalka ay khuseyso,” ayuu yiri wasiirka. Mowqifka Qaahira ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo Itoobiya ay muddooyinkii dambe si cad u muujinaysay muhiimadda ay u leedahay helitaanka marin-badeed, arrin xasaasi ka dhigtay xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka gobolka qaarkood. Dhanka kale, wasiirka ayaa sheegay in Masar iyo Sacuudiga ay ka shaqeynayaan hindise lagu mideynayo dalalka ku teedsan xeebaha Badda Cas, si loo xoojiyo iskaashiga iyo amniga gobolka. Hindisahan ayaa la xiriira Golaha Dalalka Carabta iyo Afrikaanka ee ku teedsan Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed oo lagu aas-aasay magaalada Riyadh bishii Janaayo 2020. Golaha waxaa ku mideysan siddeed dal oo kala ah Masar, Sacuudiga, Urdun, Suudaan, Ereteriya, Jabuuti, Soomaaliya iyo Yemen. Ujeeddada ugu weyn ee golahan loo aas-aasay ayaa ah in dalalka xubnaha ka ah ay iska kaashadaan ilaalinta amniga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isla markaana ay horumariyaan xiriirkooda dhaqaale iyo iskaashiga gobolka. The post Masar oo god dheer ku riday damaca Itoobiya ee badda appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xoolo-dhaqatada Shabeellaha dhexe oo iska bixinaya dayn ay qaateen xilligii abaarta
items.description: (ERGO) – Saddex sanno kaddib, reer-guuraaga dagmooyinka Warsheekh iyo Cadale ee Shabeellaha dhexe ayaa awoodday in ay iska gudaan dayn lagu yeeshay, markii ay ka soo kabteen roob yari suuq la’aan biday xoolahooda. Qoysaskan oo ah qiyaastii 150 ayaa sayladda Muqdisho u suuq geeyay xoolo ugu cayilay daaqa roobka afartii bil ee u danbeeyay. Waxay ka heleen dhaqaale ay ku dabbaraan qoysaskooda, sidoo kalena ay iskaga gudeen daynta. Cabdullaahi Muxyadiin Axmed oo ka mid ah xoolo-dhaqatada ku nool miyiga Cadale waxaa u gadmay 50 ari ah, kuwaas oo uu ka helay $4,200 horraantii bishii Ogosto ee sanadkan. Lacagtan waxay ka dulqaaday culayskii qaan-sheegadka. Wuxuu iskaga bixiyay $1,200 oo ay ku lahaayeen ganacsatada deegaankiisa. Wuxuu uga qaatay raashin iyo arrad-tirka qoyskiisa oo sagaal ah xilli ay baahi badan u qabeen, maaddama xoolahiisa ay ragaadisay roob la’aan jirtay. Wuxuu ku naaloonayaa lacagta u hartay oo qoyskiisa ay ku tiirsan yihiin. Qayb ayuu dhigaalsaday isaga oo casharro xanuun badan ka bartay abaarta iyo kayd la’aanta oo waqtiyo adag soo maray noloshiisa. Waxaan kula kulmay Cabdullaahi suuqa xoolaha Dayax ee dagmada Gubadley, halkaas oo safar labaad uu ku yimid isla bishii Ogosto. Wuxuu rajaynayay in uu helo lacag kooban oo baaqi ku ahayd ganacsatada ka iibsaday xoolaha. Wuxuu dareen farxadeed ku muujiyay isbeddelka nololeed ee qoyskiisa iyo sida ay uga soo bexeen xilliga adag ee roob la’aantu sababtay. “Waxay iigu suurto gashay Ilaahey mahaddiis iyo barwaaqadan Ilaahey noo keenay mooyee haddii abaartu sii socon lahayd maanan baxsheen ee mid kale ayaa nasii gali lahayd, Xooluhu waa kala qiimo. Mid waa $100, $120, $130. Qaar $70 ama $60 ah way jiraan.” “Daynta dadna waa nasiinayeen, dadkana way diidayeen, rafaad badana waa lagu qabay. Ninkii laga xishoonaayo oo wax lagu tabaayo oo la isleeyahay wuu iskaga magayaa waxbuu helayay.” Wuxuu tilmaamay in qaadashada daynta uu billaabay sannadkii 2023, markii xoolihiisa ay nacfi caano iyo mid suuq ay yeelan waayeen. Waxaa saamayn ku yeeshay roob la’aan soo laalaabtay, waxayna duruuftu ku qasabtay ku tiirsanaanta daynta. Hase ahaatee, handadaad joogto ah ayuu kala kumayay ganacsatada uu daynta ka qaatay, kuwaas oo ku cadaadiyay in uu bixiyo lacagaha lagu leeyahay, taasi oo gaartay in laga jarto raashin uu ka qaadan jiray. Xaaladdaas wuxuu wajahay billowgii sanadkan. Eheladiisa oo uu u dan-sheegtay ayaa lacag kooban oo cadad joogto ah aan lahayn ku taageeri jiray, taas oo toddobaadkii 5 maalin oo ka mid ah qoyskiisa ay dabka ku shidan jireen. Wuxuu sheegay in xilli-roobaadyada Gu’ga iyo xagaaga oo isku raacay ay barwaaqo u horseedeen xoolo-dhaqatada uu ka mid yahay. Waxay heleen roob joogto ah bilihii u danbeeyay, kaas oo daaqa iyo biyaha ka dhigay kuwa si fudud lagu helo. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in 100 ari ah oo u hartay ay si wanaagsan u tarmayaan, qoyskiisuna ay helaan cunno ku filan, isla markaana ay ka samatabxeen nolol adag oo ay soo mareen. “Saddexda waqti sifiican baa loo cunaa hadda. Caanihii iyo subagii aduunyadaas way isdulsaaran yihiin, abaarta aad bay dadka u saamaysay. Dad badan baa duruufo badan kala soo darseen. Dad badan baa ka barakacay baadiyo. Laakiin hadda aad baa loo wanaagsan yahay.” “Reerkii soo barakacay dib bay u laabanayaan, reerkii ku harsanaana dhaqaalihii wuu u toosay aad baan u naagsan nahay hadda.” Ninkan oo 50 jir ah wuxuu garowsan yahay in isbeddelka cimilada uu caqabad ku yahay sii socoshada roobabka, taas oo ku dhalisay in dhaqaale uu sii kaydsado si uu uga badbaado saamayn la mid ah tii uu ka dhaxlay waayo aragnimada. Wuxuu ka mid ahaa dadka ugu xoolaha badan deegaankiisa, balse roobabka oo uu ku hungoobay sanadihii 2023, 2024 ilaa 2025 ayaa xoolo yari biday. Waxaa daaq iyo biyo yari uga dhintay 350 ari ah iyo 27 Lo’ ah. Dhanka kale reer-guuraaga deegaankiisa ayuu xusay in ay wadaan qorshe ay ku taageerayaan dadka deegaankooda ee abaarta ku cayrtoobay, kuwaas oo ku xarooday Cadale, Warsheekh iyo Muqdisho sida uu Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay Cabdullaahi. Soddon qoys oo ka mid ah ayaa la siiyay xoolo aan badnayn oo billow u ah caawinta. Qoys kasta wuxuu helay 10 neef ari ah, kuwaas oo billow u ah safarka ay dib ugu dhisayaan noloshooda miyiga, isla markaana ay uga baxayaan xaaladda barakaca. “Waxbaa loo aruurshay oo tabarucaad baa loo sameeyay. Aad bay iyaguna niyaddoodu u wanaagsan tahay, noloshoodana u kaamilaan.” Cabdullaahi iyo xoolo-dhaqatada ka faa’iideysanaya daaqa iyo biyaha roobka ayaa ka siman dareenka farxadeed, maaddama ay iska dulqaadeen heeryadii daynta oo culays iyo cagajuglan kaga imaanaysay dadkii ku lahaa. Madiina Muxyadiin Axmed oo deggan miyiga dagmada Warsheekh waxay qoyskeeda oo saddex ah ay ka soo kabanayaan hubanti la’aan cunno iyo dhibaato ay ku qabayn dayn lagu lahaa, markii xoolahooda ay ka soo doogteen roob la’aanta. items.fullContent: (ERGO) – Saddex sanno kaddib, reer-guuraaga dagmooyinka Warsheekh iyo Cadale ee Shabeellaha dhexe ayaa awoodday in ay iska gudaan dayn lagu yeeshay, markii ay ka soo kabteen roob yari suuq la’aan biday xoolahooda. Qoysaskan oo ah qiyaastii 150 ayaa sayladda Muqdisho u suuq geeyay xoolo ugu cayilay daaqa roobka afartii bil ee u danbeeyay. Waxay ka heleen dhaqaale ay ku dabbaraan qoysaskooda, sidoo kalena ay iskaga gudeen daynta. Cabdullaahi Muxyadiin Axmed oo ka mid ah xoolo-dhaqatada ku nool miyiga Cadale waxaa u gadmay 50 ari ah, kuwaas oo uu ka helay $4,200 horraantii bishii Ogosto ee sanadkan. Lacagtan waxay ka dulqaaday culayskii qaan-sheegadka. Wuxuu iskaga bixiyay $1,200 oo ay ku lahaayeen ganacsatada deegaankiisa. Wuxuu uga qaatay raashin iyo arrad-tirka qoyskiisa oo sagaal ah xilli ay baahi badan u qabeen, maaddama xoolahiisa ay ragaadisay roob la’aan jirtay. Wuxuu ku naaloonayaa lacagta u hartay oo qoyskiisa ay ku tiirsan yihiin. Qayb ayuu dhigaalsaday isaga oo casharro xanuun badan ka bartay abaarta iyo kayd la’aanta oo waqtiyo adag soo maray noloshiisa. Waxaan kula kulmay Cabdullaahi suuqa xoolaha Dayax ee dagmada Gubadley, halkaas oo safar labaad uu ku yimid isla bishii Ogosto. Wuxuu rajaynayay in uu helo lacag kooban oo baaqi ku ahayd ganacsatada ka iibsaday xoolaha. Wuxuu dareen farxadeed ku muujiyay isbeddelka nololeed ee qoyskiisa iyo sida ay uga soo bexeen xilliga adag ee roob la’aantu sababtay. “Waxay iigu suurto gashay Ilaahey mahaddiis iyo barwaaqadan Ilaahey noo keenay mooyee haddii abaartu sii socon lahayd maanan baxsheen ee mid kale ayaa nasii gali lahayd, Xooluhu waa kala qiimo. Mid waa $100, $120, $130. Qaar $70 ama $60 ah way jiraan.” “Daynta dadna waa nasiinayeen, dadkana way diidayeen, rafaad badana waa lagu qabay. Ninkii laga xishoonaayo oo wax lagu tabaayo oo la isleeyahay wuu iskaga magayaa waxbuu helayay.” Wuxuu tilmaamay in qaadashada daynta uu billaabay sannadkii 2023, markii xoolihiisa ay nacfi caano iyo mid suuq ay yeelan waayeen. Waxaa saamayn ku yeeshay roob la’aan soo laalaabtay, waxayna duruuftu ku qasabtay ku tiirsanaanta daynta. Hase ahaatee, handadaad joogto ah ayuu kala kumayay ganacsatada uu daynta ka qaatay, kuwaas oo ku cadaadiyay in uu bixiyo lacagaha lagu leeyahay, taasi oo gaartay in laga jarto raashin uu ka qaadan jiray. Xaaladdaas wuxuu wajahay billowgii sanadkan. Eheladiisa oo uu u dan-sheegtay ayaa lacag kooban oo cadad joogto ah aan lahayn ku taageeri jiray, taas oo toddobaadkii 5 maalin oo ka mid ah qoyskiisa ay dabka ku shidan jireen. Wuxuu sheegay in xilli-roobaadyada Gu’ga iyo xagaaga oo isku raacay ay barwaaqo u horseedeen xoolo-dhaqatada uu ka mid yahay. Waxay heleen roob joogto ah bilihii u danbeeyay, kaas oo daaqa iyo biyaha ka dhigay kuwa si fudud lagu helo. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in 100 ari ah oo u hartay ay si wanaagsan u tarmayaan, qoyskiisuna ay helaan cunno ku filan, isla markaana ay ka samatabxeen nolol adag oo ay soo mareen. “Saddexda waqti sifiican baa loo cunaa hadda. items.title: Waa maxay Ibola?
items.description: Ebola waa fayras halis ah oo dilaa ah, calaamadaha billowgiisuna ay ka mid noqon karaan qandho degdeg ah, daal aad u daran, murqo xanuun iyo cunaha oo xanuuna. Marxaladaha dambe waxay keeni karaan matag, shuban, iyo — xaalado qaarkood — dhiig-bax gudaha iyo dibadda ah, kaas oo loo yaqaan haemorrhaging. Muddada uu fayrasku ku qarsoomi karo jirka, waxay u dhaxaysaa labo maalmood ilaa saddex toddobaad. Calaamadaha Ebola mararka qaarkood waxaa lagu khaldi karaa cudurro kale sida duumada iyo tiifow. Sidee ayuu Ebola ku faafaa? Ebola waxay u gudubtaa dadka iyada oo ka timaadda xayawaanno qaba cudurka, sida chimpanzee-yada, bakaylaha duula, iyo antiloobka kaynta. Hilibka duurjoogta — oo ah xayawaanno kaynjoog ah oo loo ugaarsado si ay dadka u cunaan — ayaa loo maleynayaa inuu yahay meesha uu fayrasku asal ahaan ku nool yahay. Kadibna wuxuu ku faa’faa dadka isagoo ku gudba taabasho toos ah oo la yeesho dheecaannada jirka ee wasakhaysan sida dhiigga, candhuufta, matag, shahwada, dareeraha siilka, kaadida, saxarada iyo dhididka. Ragga ka bogsaday Ebola ayaa sidoo kale laga helay in fayrasku ku sii jiri karo shahwadooda muddo ka dib markii ay bogsadaan. Maxaa la sameyn karaa ka hortagga? Si looga hortago caabuqa, khubarada caafimaadku waxay ku talinayaan in laga fogaado dadka qaba cudurka, oo ay ku jirto in la joojiyo is-gacan qaadka, gacmahana lagu dhaqo saabuun iyo biyo, iyo in dusha sare lagu nadiifiyo biyo leh koloriin. Sidoo kale waa muhiim in la go’doomiyo bukaannada iyo dadka ay la kulmeen. Dalalku badanaa waxay sameeyaan xarumo lagu hayo dadka looga shakiyo cudurka, iyo xarumo lagu daaweeyo kuwa si shaybaar ah looga xaqiijiya

items.title: Kadib go’aankii guddiga doorashada, Shariif oo shaaciyay inuu Maxkamadda Sare u gudbiyay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa si adag uga horyimid jadwalka doorashooyinka ee uu shaaciyay Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha, isaga oo ku tilmaamay tallaabo hal dhinac ah oo aan loo marin habraacyada sharciga ah. Jadwalka guddiga ayaa dhigaya in doorashada Golaha Shacabka la qabto 15-ka April 2027, halka doorashada madaxweynaha loo qorsheeyay 15-ka May ee isla sannadkaas. Shariif ayaa ku dooday in hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo wax-ka-beddellada lagu sameeyay Dastuurka KMG ah aan loo marin habraacyadii sharciga ahaa ee loo baahnaa, taas oo uu sheegay inay sii hurin karto khilaafka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Shariif ayaa markii ugu horreysay shaaciyay inuu Maxkamadda Sare u gudbiyay dacwad dastuuri ah oo uu ku dalbanayo in la buriyo wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka iyo tallaabooyinka ka dhashay. Madaxweynihii hore ayaa ka digay in haddii aan xal laga gaarin muranka taagan ay dhici karaan doorashooyin isbarbar socda, dib-u-dhac ku yimaada dowladnimada iyo xitaa colaado sokeeye. Shariif ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ugu baaqay inuu ka laabto tallaabooyinka uu ku tilmaamay kuwa hal dhinac ah, isagoo dhinacyada siyaasadda ku boorriyay inay wada-hadal ku gaaraan heshiis qaran oo horseeda doorashooyin la isla oggol yahay. Sidoo kale wuxuu Maxkamadda Sare ka codsaday inay si madax-bannaan uga garnaqdo dacwadda loo gudbiyay, halka beesha caalamka uu ugu baaqay inay ka qayb qaadato dadaallada lagu xallinayo khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. items.title: Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed oo laga la wareegay Degmada Berdaale
items.description: Ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa Jimcahan gudaha u galay oo la wareegay Degmada Berdaale ee Gobolka Baay. Magalaada ayaa waxaa ku sugnaa Ciidanka Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed iyo ciidamo dadka deegaanka ah, oo dhawaan loo abaabulay inay difaacaan magaalada, kuwaas oo la sheegay in ay isaga baxeen. Dadka deegaanka ayaa kuu sheegaya in ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed ay gudaha u soo galeen magaalada, iyadoo aanu wax iska horimaad ah ka dhicin. Berdaale ayaa qiyaastii 50km jihada galbeed uga beegan Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay, waxayna noqoneysaa degmadii 3aad oo ka tirsan gobolkaasi, isla-markaana ka baxda gacanta Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Ciidamada Laftagareen ayaa 8-dii bishan bilaa dagaal kula wareegay gacan ku haynta Degmada Qansaxdheere, iyadoona shalay ay dagaal ku qabsadeen Degmada Buurhakaba. Qabsashada Berdaale ayaa Baydhabo ka dhigeysa magaalo go’doonsan oo la hareereeyay, marka aad eegto in magaalooyinka deriska la ah laga la wareegay maamulka. Dhaqdhaqaaqyadii u dambeeyay ee ay sameeyeen ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen ayaa muujinaya in culeys weyn la soo saaray Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ee Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu hoggaamiyo ee fadhigeedu yahay Baydhabo.

items.title: Mareykanka oo Itoobiya Iyo Eritrea Ugu Baaqay Inay Xiisadda Ku Xalliyaan Diblomaasiyad
items.description: WASHINGTON (Goobjoog News) — Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka Marco Rubio ayaa Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ugu baaqay inay joojiyaan tallaabooyinka sii hurinaya xiisadda, khilaafkoodana ku xalliyaan waddo diblomaasiyadeed. Baaqa ayaa yimid iyadoo la soo sheegayo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan iyo hub culus oo ka socda deegaannada ku dhow Zalambessa. Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa isku eedeeyey gardarro iyo faragelin, taas oo kordhisay cabsida laga qabo inuu qarxo dagaal toos ah oo labada dal dhex mara. Human Rights Watch ayaa dhinaceeda sheegtay in duqeymo ka dhacay koonfurta Tigray ay waxyeello gaarsiiyeen dad rayid ah, isla markaana ay sababeen xiritaanka xarumo caafimaad. Dagaallada iyo hakadka adeegyada caafimaadku waxay sii adkeynayaan xaaladda dadka ku nool deegaannada ay colaadaha hore u saameeyeen. Xiisaddu waxay dib u soo celinaysaa xusuusta dagaalkii Tigray ee 2020–2022, kaas oo Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ay markaas isku dhinac ahaayeen. Xiriirka labada dowladood ayaa tan iyo markii la saxiixay heshiiskii Pretoria sii xumaanayey, iyadoo murannada marin-badeedka iyo siyaasadda Tigray ay sii kala fogeeyeen. Dagaal Itoobiya iyo Eritrea dhex mara wuxuu saameyn ku yeelan karaa Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan Geeska Afrika. Wuxuu abuuri karaa qaxooti cusub, carqaladeyn karaa ganacsiga gobolka, kordhin karaa loollanka Badda Cas, isla markaana Itoobiya ku qasbi karaa inay dib u eegto ciidamadeeda iyo kaalinteeda amni ee Soomaaliya.

items.title: Baaritaanka Ilhaan Cumar oo La Sheegay In Lagu Beegsanayo Jinsiyaddeeda Mareykanka
items.description: WASHINGTON (Goobjoog News) — Maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inuu baaritaan ku hayo xogta socdaalka iyo jinsiyadda xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar, iyadoo la eegayo suurtagalnimada in maxkamad laga dalbado in laga laalo dhalashada Mareykanka. Wargeyska Wall Street Journal, oo soo xigtay ilo aan magacyadooda la shaacin, ayaa sheegay in baaritaanku diiradda saarayo dukumentiyadii socdaalka, xogta dhalashada iyo taariikhda qoyskeeda. Warbixinno ay daabaceen Al Jazeera iyo Axios ayaa sidoo kale faahfaahin ka bixiyey arrintan. Ilhaan Cumar wax dacwad ah laguma soo oogin, mana jiro go’aan maxkamadeed oo lagu laalay jinsiyaddeeda. Xafiiskeeda ayaa baaritaanka ku tilmaamay mid siyaasadaysan oo qayb ka ah weerarro muddo dheer lagu hayey xildhibaanka asal ahaan kasoo jeeda Soomaaliya. Khubarada sharciga ayaa sheegay in Madaxweynaha Mareykanku aanu amar keliya qof ugaga qaadi karin jinsiyadda. Dowladda waa inay maxkamad federaal ah ka furtaa dacwad, isla markaana soo bandhigtaa caddeyn muujinaysa in jinsiyadda lagu helay khiyaano ama xog muhiim ah oo si ula kac ah loo qariyey. Kiisku wuxuu sii xoojin karaa muranka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya maamulka Trump iyo Ilhaan Cumar, oo si joogto ah u dhaliisha siyaasadaha Madaxweynaha. Haddii dacwad rasmi ah la furo, waxay yeelan kartaa saameyn siyaasadeed iyo mid sharciyeed oo dhaafsiisan Ilhaan, gaar ahaan muwaadiniinta jinsiyadda Mareykanka ku helay dhalasho-siinta.

items.title: Fatahaad Ka Dhacday Godob-Yar oo Barakac Iyo Khatar Caafimaad Abuurtay
items.description: GAROOWE (Goobjoog News) — Roobab xooggan oo ka da’ay deegaanka Godob-yar ee gobolka Nugaal ayaa sababay fatahaad gashay guryaha, goysay waddooyinka, qoysasna ku khasabtay inay u barakacaan bannaanka tuulada. Muuqaallo laga soo duubay deegaanka ayaa muujiyey biyo dhex fadhiya guryaha iyo waddooyinka, iyadoo dadka qaar ay ka guureen hoygoodii si ay uga badbaadaan fatahaadda. Weli lama shaacin tirada rasmiga ah ee qoysaska barakacay ama baaxadda hantida ku burburtay. Burburka musqulaha iyo isku-darka bulaacadaha iyo biyaha fatahaadda ayaa abuuraya khatar caafimaad. Haddii aan la helin biyo nadiif ah iyo adeegyo fayadhowr, waxaa kordhi kara cudurrada shubanka, daacuunka iyo infekshannada kale ee biyaha wasakhaysan la xiriira. Waddooyinka go’ay ayaa sidoo kale caqabad ku noqon kara gaarsiinta cuntada, daawooyinka iyo gurmadka degdegga ah. Carruurta, haweenka uurka leh, waayeelka iyo dadka qaba cudurrada joogtada ah ayaa si gaar ah ugu nugul saameynta fatahaadda iyo hakadka adeegyada. Dadka deegaanka ayaa maamulka Puntland iyo hay’adaha gargaarka ka dalbaday cunto, hoy ku-meel-gaar ah, dhar, biyo nadiif ah iyo adeegyo caafimaad. Gurmad degdeg ah ayaa loo baahan yahay, iyadoo sidoo kale muhiim ay tahay in la sameeyo qiimeyn rasmi ah oo lagu ogaanayo tirada dadka iyo guryaha ay fatahaaddu saamaysay.

items.title: Wabiga Shabeelle oo Qarka U Saaran Inuu Ku Fataho Jowhar Iyo Deegaannada Ku Dhow
items.description: JOWHAR (Goobjoog News) — Heerka biyaha Wabiga Shabeelle ee magaalada Jowhar ayaa si weyn sare ugu kacay, iyadoo digniino laga soo saarayo fatahaad saamayn karta magaalada, degmada Balcad iyo tuulooyinka beeraleyda ah ee ku yaalla hareeraha wabiga. Xogta FAO-SWALIM ayaa muujisay in 14-kii Oktoobar heerka wabigu gaaray 5.38 mitir, taas oo 13 sentimitir oo keliya ka hooseysa heerka uu qarka ka buuxsamayo. Kororku wuxuu daba socdaa roobabka Deyrta iyo biyaha ka imaanaya dhinaca Beledweyne iyo Buuloburde. Roobab kale oo ka da’a gudaha Soomaaliya iyo buuraleyda Itoobiya ayaa kordhin kara biyaha ku qulqulaya Wabiga Shabeelle. Xaaladdaasi waxay khatar gelin kartaa xaafadaha hoose, dhul-beereedyada, waddooyinka iyo tuulooyinka ku teedsan marinka wabiga. Bulshada ayaa loogu baaqay inay xoojiyaan xirida iyo meelaha jilicsan ee wabiga, diyaariyaan waddooyinka daad-gureynta, kana fogeeyaan carruurta iyo xoolaha biyaha socda. Beeraleyda ayaa sidoo kale looga digay inay qalabka iyo dalagyada ka raraan dhulka hoose. Fatahaad ka dhacda Jowhar iyo Balcad waxay waxyeello u geysan kartaa dalagyada, guryaha iyo isu-socodka gaadiidka, iyadoo sidoo kale kordhin karta barakaca iyo faafitaanka cudurrada biyaha ka dhasha. Sidaas darteed, digniinta hore waxay u baahan tahay inay la socoto hawlgal degdeg ah oo lagu xoojinayo difaacyada wabiga.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo meesha ka saaray walaaca mucaaradka, caddeeyayna in aan…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa beeniyay hadal-haynta la xiriirta in Dowladda Federaalka ay qorsheyneyso weerar ka dhan ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, isaga oo sheegay inaysan jirin cid ay doonayaan inay dagaal ku qaadaan. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed lagu xallin karo wada-hadal, isaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyay in albaabka wada-xaajoodku mar walba u furan yahay dhinacyada ay kala aragti duwanaanshuhu ka dhexeeyo. “Cid dagaal lagu qaadayo iyo cid dagaal u socota ma jirto, siyaasad qori caaraddiisa lagu fulinayo ma jirto, qof iyo guri la weerarayo ma jirto, waxaana caddayn u ah ma jiro qof siyaasi ah oo xabsi ku jira,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay inaan loo baahnayn in loollanka siyaasadeed loo beddelo iska horimaad, maadaama ay jiraan waddooyin kale oo lagu xallin karo khilaafaadka. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa tilmaamay in tartanka ku saabsan mustaqbalka dalka iyo hoggaamintiisa uu u furan yahay qof kasta oo aaminsan inuu awood u leeyahay inuu ka qayb qaato siyaasadda Soomaaliya. Waxa kale uu xaqiijiyay in dowladdu diyaar u tahay inay dhageysato siyaasiyiinta iyo dhinacyada qaba aragtiyo ka duwan kuwa dowladda, isaga oo muujiyay in kala aragti duwanaanshaha siyaasadeed lagu wajihi karo is-faham iyo wada-hadal. Ugu dambeyntiina, madaxweynaha ayaa ku celiyay in wada-hadalku yahay waddada lagu xallin karo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed, isagoo meesha ka saaray eedeymaha sheegaya in Dowladda Federaalka ay qorsheyneyso inay awood ciidan u adeegsato mucaaradka. items.title: Ilhaan Cumar ma laga qaadi karaa dhalashada? – Aqriso caqabadaha sharci ee jira
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Baaritaanka ay dowladda Madaxweyne Donald Trump ku waddo xildhibaanadda asal ahaan Soomaaliga ah ee Ilhaan Cumar ayaa dhaliyey su’aal weyn oo ku saabsan in dowladda Mareykanku ay sharci ahaan kala noqon karto dhalashadeeda, isla markaana dalka ka masaafurin karto. Inkasta oo sharciga Mareykanku oggol yahay in xaalado gaar ah qofka lagala noqdo dhalashada uu qaatay, haddana arrintaasi waxay u baahan tahay caddaymo adag iyo go’aan maxkamadeed. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka awood uma laha inuu keligiis amar ku laalo dhalashada muwaadin. Warbixin uu Arbacadii daabacay The Wall Street Journal ayaa sheegtay in maamulka Trump uu baaritaan ku wado sidii Ilhaan Cumar looga qaadi lahaa dhalashada Mareykanka, loogana masaafurin lahaa dalka haddii lagu helo inay dhalashada ku heshay xog aan sax ahayn. Maxkamadda ayaa qiimeynaysa caddaymaha iyo sharciga khuseeya, waxaana go’aanka laga qaadan karaa rafcaan. items.title: Aadan Madoobe iyo saraakiisha ciidanka oo wada qorshe go’doomin looga hortagayo
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Hoggaamiyaha maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Sheekh Aadan Madoobe) ayaa kulan amniga looga hadlay la yeeshay saraakiil ka tirsan maamulkiisa, xilli uu sii kordhayo cadaadiska ciidan ee uga imaanaya maleeshiyaadka taabacsan Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Ilo kala duwan ayaa xaqiijiyay in Aadan Madoobe uu saraakiisha, oo qaarkood uu taleefanka kula hadlay, faray inay xoojiyaan amniga deegaannada ay maamulaan, isla markaana ay u diyaar garoobaan ka hortagga weerarrada lagu beegsanayo maamulkiisa. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in wadatashiga uu si gaar ah diiradda ugu saarnaa sidii looga hortagi lahaa isku day kasta oo lagu go’doominayo xarunta KMG ah ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed iyo magaalooyinka kale ee gobolka Baay. Dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidan ee ka socda gobolka ayaa walaac hor leh abuuray, gaar ahaan kaddib markii maleeshiyaadka taabacsan Lafta-gareen ay weerar ku qaadeen degmada Buurhakaba, ayna sheegeen inay la wareegeen gacan ku haynteeda. Weerarka Buurhakaba ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay in halista amni aysan ku koobnaan karin magaalada Baydhabo oo keliya, balse ay saameyn karto magaalooyin kale oo muhiim u ah maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Dhanka kale, saraakiisha ciidamada ammaanka ee dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa la sheegay in lagu amray inay qaadaan tallaabooyin ka dhan ah maleeshiyaadka Laftagareen iyo Al-Shabaab, si looga hortago weerarro lagu qaado magaalooyinka muhiimka ah. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo uu sii xoogeysanayo loollanka siyaasadeed iyo kan milatari ee ka jira Koonfur Galbeed, kaas oo halis gelin kara xasilloonida deegaanno badan haddii aan xal laga gaarin. items.title: Ciidamo ka hortaga duulaanka Al Shabaab oo lagu abaabulayo Matabaan
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Magaalada Matabaan ee Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sheegaya in lagu abaabulayo ciidamo ay tahay inay ka hortaggaan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, oo culeys soo saaray deegaanada hoostaga magaaladaasi. Ciidamadan oo u badan ciidamo dadka deegaanka ah ayaa la doonayaa in ay xoojin u noqdaan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee fariisimaha ku leh deegaanada qaar ee hoostaga magaaladan. Ka dib markii Shabaabku ay 9-kii bishan dagaal kula wareegeen deegaanka Hees oo hoostaga Matabaan ayaa waxay bilaabeen in ay isku soo fidiyaan deegaanada kale ee hoostaga magaaladaasi, sida Coomaad oo muhiim u ah amniga Matabaan. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in xubno ka mid ah maleeshiyada Shabaabka guur-guura ay ku sii siqayaan deegaanada kale ee Qabno iyo Bacda, taasoo kor u qaadday cabsida laga qabo in ay jaraan jidka isku xira Matabaan iyo Beledweyne. Taliyaha Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Cali Axmed Xaashi (Cagey) oo maalin ka hor ku laabtay Magaalada Beledweyne, ka dib howlo shaqo oo maalmihii u dambeeyay uu u joogay Caasimadda Muqdisho ayaa la filayaa in uu bixiyo taakulada ay ciidamada u baahan yihiin, si looga hortago duulaanka iyo is ballaarinta Al Shabaab. Taliye Cagey ayaa waxaa suurtagal ah in uu iskaashi la sameeyo Taliyaha Qaybta 21aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Korneyl Maxamed Cabdi Daahir (Maxamed Dhagaweyne), si taliskiisu uu ciidamo ugu soo diro aagga Matabaan. Militariga ayaad mooddaa in aysan ogolaan karin in ay go’do waddada xiriirisa Beledweyne iyo Matabaan, maadaama ay tahay marinka uu saadka iyo sahayda u maro Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Macawiisleyda ku sugan deegaanada ku dhow dhow Matabaan. Waa marin weyn oo sidoo kale muhiim u ah nabadgelyada Gobolka Hiiraan, isu socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka ganacsiga ee gobolkaasi iyo gobolka kale ee ku dhegan ee Galgaduud.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo weerar dhimasho iyo dhaawac badan ku qaaday madaxtooyada…
items.description: Cadan (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa Khamiistii weerar gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku qaaday xarunta madaxtooyada ee magaalada Cadan, halkaas oo ay ku shaqeyso dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, waxaana weerarka ku dhintay ugu yaraan shan qof, halka 16 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Weerarka ayaa lagu beegsaday qasriga Al-Maashiq, oo ah xarunta rasmiga ah ee dowladda Yemen ee taageerada ka hesha Sacuudiga, wuxuuna noqonayaa kii ugu horreeyay ee Xuutiyiintu ku qaadaan xaruntan tan iyo markii ay dib u qarxeen dagaallada u dhexeeya kooxda iyo Sacuudiga. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Yemen, Moammar al-Eryani, ayaa sheegay in ra’iisul wasaaraha iyo xubnaha golaha wasiirrada ay ka badbaadeen weerarka, inkastoo qaraxyo xooggan laga maqlay agagaarka madaxtooyada. Wasiirka Caafimaadka Yemen, Qasim Buhaibeh, ayaa xaqiijiyay in shan qof ay ku dhinteen, 16 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen weerarka, isagoo sheegay in dadka waxyeelladu gaartay ay ku jiraan ilaalada xarunta iyo shaqaale rayid ah. Dhinaca kale, afhayeenka militariga Xuutiyiinta, Yahya Saree, ayaa sheegtay mas’uuliyadda weerarka, isagoo sheegay in kooxdiisu ay duqeysay xarun uu Sacuudigu ka maamulo hawlgallada militari ee magaalada Cadan. Saree ayaa sheegay in weerarku uu qeyb ka yahay siyaasadda Xuutiyiinta ee lagu beegsanayo ciidamada iyo gurmadka militari ee Sacuudiga meel kasta oo ay ku sugan yihiin. Wakaaladda wararka SABA ee Xuutiyiintu maamulaan ayaa sheegtay in xarunta la weeraray ay ku sugnaayeen saraakiil Sacuudiyaan ah, isla markaana ay ku yaalleen bakhaarro hub ah. Hase yeeshee, sheegashadaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Weerarkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dagaalka Yemen uu mar kale sii xoogeysanayo, kaddib markii bishii hore ay dib u billowdeen dagaallada u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo ciidamada dowladda ee taageerada ka hela Sacuudiga. Toddobaadkii hore, ciidamada dowladda Yemen ayaa billaabay hawlgal ay dib ugu qabsanayaan deegaannada ay Xuutiyiintu maamulaan, iyagoo sheegay inay guulo ka gaareen dhul ku dhow marinka Bab al-Mandab, oo ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo isu socodka maraakiibta caalamiga ah. Sacuudiga oo shaaciyay khasaaraha weerarrada Xuutiyiinta Dhanka kale, isbaheysiga militari ee Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa Khamiistii faahfaahin ka bixiyay weerarro isdaba joog ah oo Xuutiyiintu toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay ku qaadeen garoomada diyaaradaha, dekedaha iyo xarumaha shidaalka ee Sacuudiga. Afhayeenka isbaheysiga, Turki al-Maliki, ayaa shir jaraa’id ku sheegay in Xuutiyiintu bishan October oo keliya 20 weerar ku qaadeen garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee King Khalid ee magaalada Riyadh. Wuxuu sheegay in weerarradaas ay ku dhinteen 17 qof, halka 333 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen, taas oo muujineysa baaxadda khasaaraha ka dhashay duqeymaha lagu beegsanayo kaabeyaasha rayidka ah ee boqortooyada. Sidoo kale, isbaheysiga ayaa sheegay in weerarro lagu qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaalada Abha, oo ku dhow xadka Yemen, ay sababeen dhimashada saddex qof iyo dhaawaca 28 kale. Al-Maliki ayaa Xuutiyiinta ku eedeeyay inay heleen hub casri ah iyo farsamooyin militari oo ay ka caawiyeen dhinacyo gobolka ka tirsan, isagoo xusay gantaallada riddada dheer, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo doomaha dheereeya ee laga soo buuxiyo walxaha qarxa. Inkasta oo uusan si toos ah u magacaabin dhammaan dhinacyada uu eedeynayo, haddana Iran ayaa muddo dheer lagu eedeeyay inay Xuutiyiinta siiso hub, dhaqaale iyo tababar militari. Tehran ayaa dhankeeda beenisay inay kooxda hubeyso si ka hor imaaneysa cunaqabateynta hubka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Afhayeenka ayaa intaas ku daray in isbaheysigu burburiyay 127 goobood oo ay Xuutiyiintu ku keydsanayeen hubka iyo xarumo laga rido gantaallada, kuwaas oo ku yaalla deegaannada buuraleyda ah ee Yemen. Wuxuu ugu baaqay kooxda inay si degdeg ah u joojiso weerarrada ka dhanka ah dadka rayidka ah iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha. Hase yeeshee, wax yar kaddib hadalkaas, afhayeenka militariga Xuutiyiinta ayaa mar kale uga digay shirkadaha diyaaradaha inay isticmaalaan hawada iyo garoomada Sacuudiga, isagoo sheegay in goobahaas aysan ammaan ahayn. Kooxda ayaa digniinteeda ka reebtay hawada magaalooyinka barakeysan ee Maka iyo Madiina. Hay’adda difaaca madaniga ah ee Sacuudiga ayaa Khamiistii digniino amni ka soo saartay magaalooyinka Najran iyo Jizan, iyadoo ka digtay weerarro suurtagal ah, inkastoo markii dambe ay sheegtay in khatartii meesha ka baxday. Isbaheysiga Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu soo riday laba diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn, oo mid ka mid ah lagu beegsaday magaalada Khamis Mushait, halka tan kalena loo soo diray koonfurta dalka. Dagaalka Yemen oo qeyb ka noqday colaadda gobolka Xiisadda cusub ee Yemen ayaa qeyb ka noqotay dagaalka ballaaran ee Bariga Dhexe, kaas oo billowday bishii February markii Mareykanka iyo Israel ay weerarro ku qaadeen Iran. Xuutiyiinta oo xiriir dhow la leh Tehran ayaa kordhiyay weerarrada ay ku qaadayaan Sacuudiga, iyagoo cadaadis saaraya boqortooyada xilli ay taageero militari siineyso dowladda Yemen. Weerarrada lagu qaaday garoomada diyaaradaha iyo xarumaha shidaalka ayaa sidoo kale halis gelinaya qorshayaasha dhaqaale ee Sacuudiga, oo dadaal ugu jira inuu yareeyo ku tiirsanaanta dakhliga shidaalka, isla markaana soo jiito maalgashi iyo dalxiis caalami ah. Dagaalka Yemen ayaa billowday sanadkii 2014, markii Xuutiyiintu qabsadeen caasimadda Sanca, taas oo ku khasabtay dowladda inay u guurto koonfurta dalka. Sacuudiga ayaa sanadkii xigay hoggaamiyay faragelin militari oo lagu taageerayay dowladda, balse dagaalku wuxuu muddo dheer galay xaalad aan dhinacna guul weyn gaarin. Xabbad-joojin la gaaray sanadkii 2022 ayaa muddo dhowr sano ah yareysay dagaallada waaweyn, ka hor inta aysan colaaddu mar kale dib u qarxin sanadkan. Intii lagu jiray dagaalladii hore, Xuutiyiinta iyo ciidamo ay xulafo ahaayeen ayaa muddo kooban gacanta ku dhigay qasriga Al-Maashiq, balse markii dambe way ka baxeen. Dib u soo cusboonaanshaha dagaalka ayaa sii xumeeyay xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Yemen, iyadoo hay’adaha gargaarku ay ka digeen in isbitaallada dalka ay la daalaa dhacayaan dhaawacyada sii kordhaya iyo adeegyada caafimaad oo aan dabooli karin baahida jirta. Weerarkii Khamiista ee madaxtooyada Cadan iyo duqeymaha joogtada ah ee lagu hayo Sacuudiga ayaa muujinaya in dagaalka Yemen uu mar kale galay marxalad khatar badan, iyadoo ay sii kordheyso suurtagalnimada in colaadda gudaha dalkaasi ay si qoto dheer ugu milanto dagaalka ka socda gobolka. items.title: Khayre oo shaaciyey waxa dhici doona kadib shaacintii jadwalka doorashada qaran
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Khayre, ayaa si adag uga hor yimid jadwalka doorashooyinka federaalka ee shalay uu shaaciyey Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka iyo Soohdimaha, isagoo ka digay in tallaabadaasi ay dalka u horseedi karto qalalaase siyaasadeed, mid amni iyo doorashooyin isbarbar socda. Khayre ayaa bayaan uu soo saaray ku tilmaamay jadwalka doorashada mid hal dhinac ah oo aan ku dhisnayn heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, xilli ay weli taagan yihiin khilaafaadka u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo dhinacyada mucaaradka ee ku saabsan dastuurka iyo hannaanka doorashooyinka. “Waxaan si adag u qaadacayaa jadwalka doorashada halka dhinac ah ee uu maanta ku dhawaaqay taliska Madaxweynaha muddo-xileedkiisu dhammaaday,” ayuu Khayre ku yiri bayaankiisa. Waxa uu sheegay in jadwalkaasi uu sii wiiqayo dadaalladii iyo wada-hadalladii siyaasadeed ee lagu doonayey in dalka looga saaro hubanti la’aanta siyaasadeed, maadaama aan weli heshiis laga gaarin qodobbada aasaasiga ah ee doorashada. Khayre ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in shaacinta jadwal doorasho oo aan heshiis siyaasadeed lagu ahayn ay sii kala fogeyn karto dhinacyada isku haya hannaanka doorashada, isla markaana ay khatar gelin karto xasilloonida dalka. “Shaacinta jadwal doorasho iyadoo aan heshiis laga ahayn arrimaha siyaasadda iyo mabaadi’da doorashada waxay sii kala dhantaalaysaa midnimada dalka iyo wadajirka ummadda,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in tallaabadaasi ay dalka u horseedi karto “qalalaaso siyaasadeed, mid amni, iyo doorashooyin isbarbar-socda”, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay halis gelin karaan mustaqbalka dalka iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliyeed. Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ayaa sidoo kale eedeymo culus u jeediyey Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isagoo ku tilmaamay hoggaamiye uu dhammaaday muddo-xileedkiisii, kuna eedeeyey inuu doonayo inuu xukunka sii haysto. “Waxaan ummadda Soomaaliyeed u caddaynayaa in Madaxweyne hore Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu qaadayo masuuliyadda cawaaqib kasta oo ka dhasha go’aankan qar-iska-tuurnimada ah oo ujeeddadiisu tahay in Madaxweynaha muddo-xileedkiisu dhammaaday uu ku boobo xukunka dalka,” ayuu Khayre ku yiri bayaankiisa. Eedeyntan ayaa salka ku haysa khilaafka ka taagan wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, kaas oo muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha iyo baarlamaanka ka dhigay shan sano halkii uu markii hore ka ahaa afar sano. Dowladda federaalka ayaa ku adkeysanaysa in dastuurka cusub uu sharci yahay, halka mucaaradku ay diiddan yihiin in wax-ka-beddelkaasi lagu kordhiyo muddo-xileedka madaxda hadda xilalka haya. Jadwalka uu guddiga doorashadu shaaciyey ayaa dhigaya in doorashada labada aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka ay dhacdo 15-ka Abriil 2027, halka doorashada madaxweynaha loo asteeyey 15-ka May 2027. Madaxweynayaashii hore ee Soomaaliya, Shariif Sheekh Axmed iyo Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo, ayaa iyaguna qaadacay jadwalka doorashada, iyagoo ka digay in doorasho aan heshiis lagu ahayn ay dhalin karto hannaan doorasho oo isbarbar socda iyo khilaaf siyaasadeed oo sii xoogaysta. Dowladda federaalka ayaa dhankeeda soo dhaweysay jadwalka cusub, iyadoo sheegtay in diyaarinta doorashooyinka iyo sii wadista wada-hadallada siyaasadeed ay yihiin laba arrimood oo is barbar socon kara. items.title: Somaliland: Its strategic importance in the red sea
items.description: SOMALILAND: ITS STRATEGIC IMPORTANCE IN THE RED SEA PRESS STATEMENT AND POLITICAL PERSPECTIVE SOMALILAND INTELLECTUAL ORGANISATION (SIO) The Somaliland Intellectual Organisation (SIO) warmly welcomes the participation of Ambassador Bashir Goth, Somaliland’s Representative to the United States, at the 19th Annual ASMEA Conference, scheduled for 7–9 November 2026 in Washington, D.C. We particularly welcome the important discussion entitled: “Somaliland: The Overlooked Critical Component in the Red Sea Geopolitical Jigsaw.” 1. Recognition and Appreciation of Ambassador Bashir Goth SIO commends Ambassador Bashir Goth for his diplomatic efforts to strengthen Somaliland’s international visibility and bring its strategic importance to the attention of American policymakers, diplomats, academics and influential institutions. His participation represents a valuable opportunity to advance Somaliland’s diplomatic engagement and strengthen the international discussion surrounding its recognition. 2. Special Appreciation of Ambassador J. Peter Pham SIO extends its sincere appreciation to Ambassador J. Peter Pham, a respected American diplomat, scholar and longstanding advocate for greater international recognition and understanding of Somaliland. Ambassador Pham is no newcomer to Somaliland’s cause. Through his research, publications and policy discussions, he has consistently highlighted Somaliland’s distinctive history, democratic achievements, state-building experience and strategic significance. We particularly commend him for: – His longstanding commitment to raising international awareness of Somaliland. – His valuable research on Somaliland’s statehood and the consequences of non-recognition. – His contributions to American foreign policy discussions concerning Somaliland. – His continued efforts to encourage informed debate about Somaliland’s future and its strategic role in the Horn of Africa. SIO believes that international friends of Somaliland, such as Ambassador Peter Pham, deserve genuine appreciation and continued academic and diplomatic engagement. 3. SIO’s Perspective on the Conference Theme SIO believes the discussion should highlight five strategic priorities: 1. Red Sea Security: Somaliland occupies an important geographical position along the Gulf of Aden, close to one of the world’s most significant maritime trade corridors. 2. Berbera Port: Berbera has the potential to become a major regional hub connecting African markets, the Middle East and international trade routes. 3. United States Cooperation: Somaliland and the United States have opportunities to strengthen cooperation in maritime security, counterterrorism, investment and economic development. 4. Regional Stability: Somaliland can serve as a valuable partner in promoting stability, protecting trade routes and strengthening security cooperation in the Horn of Africa. 5. International Recognition: Somaliland’s strategic and economic importance should reinforce its historical and legal case for international recognition as an independent state. 4. SIO’s Message to the International Community SIO firmly believes that Somaliland should not be viewed merely as a country seeking recognition, but as a strategically important nation capable of making meaningful contributions to regional security, international trade and stability in the Red Sea. We once again congratulate and commend Ambassador Bashir Goth and Ambassador J. Peter Pham for their valuable contributions to bringing Somaliland’s case before an important international audience. Somaliland needs proactive diplomacy, credible research, strategic partnerships and international friends who understand its historical, legal and political realities. Mohamed Ali Chairman SOMALILAND INTELLECTUAL ORGANISATION (SIO) Courage • Unity • Sovereignty • Wisdom

items.title: Magaalada Baydhabo oo qarka u saaran in la go’doomiyo
items.description: Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay ayaa wajaheysa halis ah in ay noqoto magaalo go’doonsan, iyadoo ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ay qabsanayaan magaalooyinka ku dhow dhow magaaladaasi. Ciidamadan ayaa Khamistii shalay dagaal kula wareegay Degmada Buurhakaba ee Gobolka Baay, waxayna toddobaadkii hore ay bilaa dagaal kula wareegeen gacan ku haynta Degmada Qansaxdheere ee gobolkaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada ka amarka qaata Cabdicasiis Laftagareen ay haatan isha ku hayaan Degmada Berdaale iyo deegaanka kale ee Awdiinle ee u dhexeeya Baydhabo iyo Berdaale. Haddii ciidamadan ay la wareegaan Degmada Berdaale ayaa waxay u suurtagelin kartaa in ay si buuxda u xakameeyaan dhaqdhaqaaqa gaadiidka iyo badeecadaha la geeyo Baydhabo. Buurhakaba ayaa ku taala jidka weyn ee isku xira Baydhabo iyo Muqdisho, waxayna fariisin muhiim ah u tahay isu socodka gaadiidka ganacsiga labada magaalo. Waddadan ayaa waxay halbowle u tahay dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga Baydhabo, iyadoo magaaladan ay ka adeegtaan shacabka ku dhaqan deegaanada aadka uga durugsan ee Gobolada Baay, Bakool iyo Gedo. Meesha ay ku taalo Buurhakaba ayaa xitaa door weyn ka qaadata isu socodka badeecadaha ka yimaada Dekedda Muqdisho ee la geeyo Gobolka Baay iyo gobolada kale ee deriska la ah. Ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen ayaa wada guluf ay dhul cusub isugu fidinayaan, taas oo sii xoojineysa difaaca iyo fariisimahooda Gobolka Baay. Khubarada dhanka amniga ayaa kuu sheegaya in garabka mucaaraadka ee Laftagareen uu hoggaamiyo uu ujeedkoodu yahay in ay culeys amni saaraan Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta KMG Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, oo ay ku yaallaan Xarumaha Maamulka ee Madaxtooyada iyo Baarlamaanka. Koonfur Galbeed ayaa waxaa muuqato inay ka jiraan laba awoodood oo isku garbinaya talada maamulka.

items.title: UK oo Eritrea Ugu Hanjabtay Mamnuucidda Fiisooyinka, Haddii Aanay Dib u Qaabilin Muwaadiniinteeda
items.description: Dowladda Boqortooyada Midowday ee UK ayaa Eritrea uga digtay inay mamnuuci karto dhammaan muwaadiniinta dalkaas inay soo galaan Britain, haddii dowladda Eritrea ay diido inay dib u qaabisho muwaadiniinteeda ku galay UK doonyo yaryar ama lagu helay dambiyo, kuwaas oo aan xaq sharci ah u lahayn inay dalka sii joogaan. Tallaabadan ayaa qayb ka ah cadaadiska ay dowladda Britain ku doonayso in dalalka ay muwaadiniintoodu ku sugan yihiin UK ay kala shaqeeyaan dib u celintooda. Dowladda UK ayaa sheegtay in Eritrea aysan si buuxda ula shaqayn dadaallada lagu celinayo muwaadiniinta aan xaqa u lahayn inay Britain sii joogaan. Waxay ka digtay in haddii aan la helin iskaashi ku filan, ay qaadi karto tallaabooyin dheeraad ah oo ay ka mid tahay joojinta fiisooyinka la siiyo muwaadiniinta Eritrea. Tallaabooyinka kale ee la shaaciyay waxaa ka mid ah in diblomaasiyiinta Eritrea lagu xaddido safarrada ay ku tagayaan meel ka baxsan 60 kiiloomitir magaalada London, haddii aysan fasax ka helin dowladda Britain, iyo in la joojiyo adeegyada fiisooyinka degdegga ah ee mudnaanta gaarka ah siin jiray mas’uuliyiinta sare iyo martida muhiimka ah. Xiisadda labada dal ayaa la xiriirta siyaasadda socdaalka iyo dib u celinta dadka magangelyadooda la diiday iyo ajaanibta lagu helay dambiyada. Dowladda Britain waxay ku doodaysaa in dalalka ay muwaadiniintoodu ku sugan yihiin UK ay tahay inay la shaqeeyaan sidii dib loogu celin lahaa dadka aan haysan sharci ay dalka ku sii joogaan. Sida lagu sheegay xogta laga soo xigtay baarlamaanka UK, muwaadiniinta Eritrea ayaa ka mid ahaa kooxaha ugu badan ee dalka ku galay doonyaha yaryar muddadii 12-ka bilood ahayd ee ku ekeyd Juun 2026, iyagoo ka ahaa 18 boqolkiiba dadka ku yimid waddadaas. Dhanka kale, khilaafka ku saabsan dib u celinta muwaadiniinta ayaa sii adkaynaya xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee labada dal, iyadoo dowladda UK ay ku adkaysanayso in iskaashiga dib u celintu muhiim u yahay hirgelinta siyaasaddeeda socdaalka. Tallaabada ay Britain ku hanjabtay waxay muujinaysaa inay diyaar u tahay inay adeegsato xayiraadaha fiisooyinka iyo tallaabooyin diblomaasiyadeed si ay cadaadis ugu saarto dalalka aan kala shaqayn dib u celinta muwaadiniintooda.

items.title: Somali Opposition Leader Rejects 2027 Election Timetable, Warns of Renewed Political Conflict
items.description: MOGADISHU, Somalia — Somali opposition lawmaker Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame has rejected the newly announced timetable for Somalia’s 2027 parliamentary and presidential elections, warning that proceeding without a broad political agreement could deepen divisions and risk renewed conflict.

items.title: Somalia, UN Officials Discuss Flood Preparedness Amid Heavy Rainfall Risks
items.description: MOGADISHU, Somalia — Somalia’s National Disaster Management Agency (SoDMA) Commissioner, Mohamud Moallim Abdulle, has met senior United Nations officials to discuss the country’s humanitarian situation and preparations for potential flooding associated with heavy rains linked to the Super El Niño weather phenomenon.

items.title: JSP Oo Bilaabay Abaabulka Doorashooyinka 2027, Xilli Khilaafka Siyaasadeed uu Sii Xoogeysanayo
items.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa kulan la qaatay xildhibaannada Baarlamaanka Federaalka ee ka tirsan Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP), xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo khilaafka siyaasadeed ee la xiriira hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka. items.title: Sirdoonka Suuriya oo Xiray Nin Lagu Eedeeyay Xasuuq Lagu Diley 459 Qof
items.description: Hay’adaha sirdoonka Suuriya ayaa ku dhawaaqay xarigga Cali Kiyaali (Ali Kiyali), oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan “Ma’raj Oural,” kaas oo lagu eedeeyay inuu ku lug lahaa xasuuqyo ka dhacay xeebaha Suuriya sannadkii 2013-kii, gaar ahaan deegaannada Al-Bayda iyo Ras al-Nubay ee magaalada Baniyas. Sida lagu sheegay xogta la baahiyay, Shabakadda Xuquuqda Aadanaha Suuriya ayaa diiwaangelisay dilka 459 qof oo rayid ah intii ay socdeen xasuuqyadii ka dhacay deegaannadaas, waxaana dadka la dilay ku jiray 92 carruur ah iyo 71 haween ah. Baaritaannada xuquuqda aadanaha ayaa muujiyay in dhacdooyinkaas ay ka dhaceen xadgudubyo culus, oo ay ka mid ahaayeen dilal toos ah, qoysas dhan oo la laayay iyo meydadka dhibbanayaasha oo la gubay. Sidoo kale, hay’adda Human Rights Watch ayaa sheegtay in la helay meydad badan oo lagu aasay gudaha dukaan dab la qabadsiiyay oo ku yaalla tuulada Al-Bayda, taas oo qayb ka ahayd caddeymaha la xiriira xasuuqii halkaas ka dhacay. Xarigga Cali Kiyaali ayaa dib u soo nooleynaya xusuusta dhacdooyinkii dhiigga badnaa ee ka dhacay xeebaha Suuriya sannadkii 2013-kii, kuwaas oo sababay dhimashada dad badan oo rayid ah.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya Oo Soo Dhawaysay Jadwalka Doorashada ee uu Soo Saaray Guddiga Doorashooyinku
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo dhaweysay jadwalka ay guddiga doorashooyinku soo saareen ee ku saabsan xilliga la qabanayo doorashada madaxweynaha dalka, iyadoo sheegtay inay bilaabi doonto diyaar-garowga lagama maarmaanka u ah hirgelinta doorashadaas. Ra’iisul Wasaare ku-xigeenka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Saalax Axmed Jaamac, ayaa sheegay in dowladdu ay muhiimad gaar ah siinayso diyaarinta doorashada, si loo waafajiyo jadwalka la shaaciyay, loona helo waqti ku filan oo loogu diyaar garoobo hannaanka doorashooyinka. Waxa uu tilmaamay in xukuumaddu ay ka shaqayn doonto sidii doorashada loo hirgelin lahaa, iyadoo la tixgelinayo amniga, diyaar-garowga hay’adaha ay khusayso iyo sidii shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay uga qayb qaadan lahaayeen geeddi-socodka doorashada. Saalax Jaamac ayaa sidoo kale xusay in dowladda ay tallaabooyin ku habboon u qaadi doonto fulinta jadwalka doorashada, isla markaana ay arrinta kala tashan doonto dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed, si loo helo hannaan doorasho oo loo dhan yahay. Waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyay in qabashada doorashadu ay u baahan tahay dadaal iyo isku-duwid hay’adeed, maadaama waqtiga loo qorsheeyay diyaar-garowga uu kooban yahay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa uu sheegay in xukuumaddu ay ka go’an tahay fulinta jadwalka ay soo saareen guddiga doorashooyinku. Dhanka kale, guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka iyo saaxiibbada caalamiga ah ayaa la sheegay inay shaaciyeen xilliga la qabanayo doorashada madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, taas oo lagu tilmaamay inay ku dhici doonto nidaamka qof iyo cod. Madaxweynaha ayaa ku celiyay in dowladda ay diyaar u tahay wada-hadal iyo dhegeysiga talooyinka dhinacyada siyaasadda, isaga oo ku baaqay in khilaafaadka la xiriira doorashooyinka, dastuurka iyo awoodda siyaasadeed lagu xalliyo hannaan sharci ah. Hadalladiisa ayaa imanaya xilli hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo xiriirka dowladda iyo mucaaradka ay weli yihiin arrimo muhiim u ah siyaasadda Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo xal u heliddoodu saameyn ku yeelan karto xasilloonida siyaasadeed ee dalka.

items.title: Azerbaijan’s hijab restrictions spark protests over religious freedom
items.description: BAKU (WDN) — Azerbaijan’s enforcement of new school dress-code rules has sparked protests after Muslim students and teachers wearing hijabs were reportedly denied entry to educational institutions, intensifying debate over religious freedom in the predominantly Muslim country. The amendment to school uniform regulations does not explicitly ban the hijab. Instead, it prohibits clothing deemed inconsistent with the country’s principle of secularism. Critics argue that the rules are being applied in ways that restrict the constitutional right to religious freedom. Azerbaijan’s government maintains that the regulations are intended to standardise school uniforms and uphold secular principles. However, reports of students being turned away and teachers being told to remove their headscarves have raised questions about whether the policy unfairly targets religious expression. Videos circulating on social media reportedly show emotional scenes as students bid farewell to teachers affected by the restrictions. Local media have also reported classroom boycotts at several schools. Teacher Zahra Hasanova told Al Jazeera that she felt hurt after being informed she could no longer wear her hijab at school, arguing that the decision to wear or remove it should be a personal choice. Constitutional rights under scrutiny Approximately 96 per cent of Azerbaijan’s population identifies as Muslim, according to the figures cited in the original report. Although the constitution defines the country as secular, it also guarantees religious freedom. The controversy centres on how authorities interpret the principle of secularism. Critics question why religious clothing should be treated as incompatible with education in state schools when the constitution protects freedom of belief. The rules reportedly allow certain traditional and cultural clothing during celebrations, subject to approval by school authorities. Opponents argue that this provision raises further questions about the consistency of enforcement. Imprisoned journalist Polad Aslanov has also protested against the restrictions through a hunger strike, according to reports. Meanwhile, claims of internet disruptions during the unrest have circulated, although independent monitoring organisations have not confirmed a nationwide blackout. Protests spread to Turkiye The controversy has extended into neighbouring Turkiye, where demonstrators have protested outside Azerbaijan’s consulate in Istanbul. Some have compared the restrictions with Turkiye’s own history of banning headscarves in universities and public institutions, particularly following the 1997 military intervention. Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev appeared to criticise outside commentary in a speech, warning against attempts to interfere in the country’s way of life. Although he did not directly name Turkiye, his remarks came amid growing public debate over the issue. Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has spoken more broadly about discrimination against Muslim women, though his remarks were not explicitly linked to Azerbaijan’s school regulations. The dispute has exposed a sensitive tension between two closely aligned countries over secularism, religious identity and the limits of state authority. The central question facing Azerbaijan is whether secularism should mean religious neutrality or restrictions on visible religious expression. As protests continue, the government faces calls to ensure that school regulations respect both educational standards and the constitutional freedoms of students and teachers.
