items.title: Somalia’s election crisis deepens: Farmaajo, Sharif and Khayre warn Hassan Sheikh risks national disintegration
items.description: MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia’s political crisis escalated sharply after three prominent former national leaders and senior opposition figures c ondemned the federal government’s newly announced election timetable , warning that President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s unilateral approach could trigger parallel elections, renewed conflict and further fragmentation of the Somali state. Former presidents Mohamed Abdullahi Farmaajo and Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, former prime minister Hassan Ali Khaire and opposition politician Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame all rejected the timetable, arguing that it was announced without the political consensus needed to secure a credible and nationally accepted electoral process. Their statements reflect growing opposition fears that Hassan Sheikh’s determination to proceed with his preferred electoral arrangements, despite unresolved disputes with opposition leaders and federal member states, could push Somalia into another dangerous confrontation over political legitimacy and control of the state. The central message from the opposition is unmistakable: if the president proceeds without a negotiated settlement and the country descends into further instability, his administration will bear substantial political responsibility for the consequences. Farmaajo accuses Hassan Sheikh of endangering the state In a strongly worded statement, former president Farmaajo condemned what he described as a unilateral decision by an electoral commission established by a president whose term, in Farmaajo’s assessment, has expired. He warned that the proposed process threatened Somalia’s statehood and political future, potentially producing competing elections and spreading civil conflict across the country. Farmaajo argued that Somalia’s political destiny could not be determined through unilateral decisions or the personal wishes of one leader. He called for the continuation of political negotiations and an inclusive election to be organised without further delay. He also urged former national leaders, federal member state presidents and other political stakeholders to work together towards a transparent electoral settlement. International partners, he added, should continue their mediation efforts and help the Somali parties reach agreement. Farmaajo’s intervention underscores the opposition’s central objection: the dispute is not simply about election dates, but about who has the authority to determine the electoral framework and whether the process commands sufficient political legitimacy. Sharif Sheikh Ahmed warns of parallel elections and conflict Former president Sharif Sheikh Ahmed also strongly rejected the announced timetable, warning that a disputed electoral process could lead to parallel elections, institutional paralysis, deeper political divisions and civil conflict. His warning highlights the risk that rival political camps could establish competing electoral arrangements, each claiming legitimacy while rejecting the other’s authority. Such a confrontation would leave Somalia facing more than a disagreement over the presidency. It could undermine the functioning of federal institutions, deepen mistrust between Mogadishu and federal member states, and weaken the political cooperation needed to confront the country’s security and development challenges. Khayre: Hassan Sheikh must answer for the consequences Former prime minister Hassan Ali Khaire issued one of the sharpest condemnations, rejecting what he described as a unilateral election timetable lacking an inclusive political agreement and carrying disputed legitimacy. Khaire argued that announcing election dates before resolving disagreements over the political framework and the principles governing the vote undermined ongoing negotiations intended to end the country’s uncertainty. He warned that the decision could intensify political and security instability, encourage parallel elections and threaten national unity. “The president whose term has expired, Hassan Sheikh, will bear responsibility for any consequences arising from this reckless decision,” Khaire said in his statement. His remarks place the question of political accountability at the centre of the dispute. The opposition’s argument is that the president cannot disregard the concerns of major political stakeholders and then avoid responsibility if the resulting confrontation damages the country’s stability. Opposition warns of a return to Somalia’s darkest chapter Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame, an opposition leader associated with the Future Council, also warned that Hassan Sheikh’s move could lead to renewed division and conflict. Opposition lawmaker Abdilatif Muse Nur, known as Sanyare, invoked the traumatic period following the collapse of Somalia’s central government in 1991. He warned that Mogadishu could return to a situation resembling the fragmented political order associated with the administration of Ali Mahdi Mohamed, while the wider country could again move towards disintegration. The comparison is a stark political warning, not proof that Somalia will repeat the events of the 1990s. Nevertheless, it reflects the depth of concern among opponents who believe that unilateral electoral decisions could turn a political dispute into a much wider crisis. Hassan Sheikh faces a defining test The latest reactions expose the widening gulf between the federal government and influential political figures who reject its approach to the next election. The unresolved question is whether the administration will reopen negotiations and seek an agreement with opposition groups and federal member states, or press ahead with a process that major stakeholders have already condemned. A published timetable cannot, by itself, resolve disputes over constitutional authority, electoral procedures or the legitimacy of the institutions organising the vote. Without an agreed framework, Somalia risks entering a contest in which rival sides challenge one another’s authority and the outcome becomes another source of instability. The consequences could extend far beyond the presidential contest. A breakdown in political cooperation could deepen divisions between federal institutions and member states, distract the government from security priorities and further weaken public confidence in Somalia’s fragile federal system. Hassan Sheikh’s supporters may argue that the government must proceed with elections rather than allow political negotiations to continue indefinitely. But that argument does not remove the need to establish a process that is legally defensible, transparent and accepted by the country’s principal political stakeholders. The president still has an opportunity to reduce the risk by returning to negotiations, addressing constitutional disagreements and pursuing an inclusive electoral settlement. Whether he chooses that path will help determine whether Somalia moves towards a peaceful political transition or another period of confrontation. The warning from Farmaajo, Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, Khaire and other opposition figures is that Somalia’s unity cannot be preserved through unilateral political decisions. If the current electoral dispute escalates into parallel elections, widespread conflict or further fragmentation, Hassan Sheikh’s leadership will face serious questions about whether his choices helped prevent a national crisis—or helped bring one about. items.title: Somaliland oo caddeysay mowqifkeeda xiisadda ka taagan gobolka
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro ayaa si adag uga horyimid tallaabooyinka dowladaha uu hoggaamiyo Masar ee dhowaan isbahaystay, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan Soomaaliya, Suudaan iyo Ereteriya, isaga oo ku eedeeyay inay ka hor imaanayaan qarannimada Somaliland. “Waxaanu ka soo horjeednaa tallaabada qarannimadeenna liddiga ku ah ee ay ku kaceen dowladaha ay Masar hormuudka ka tahay ee dhowaan is bahaystay,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Cirro. Mowqifka Cirro ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dowladahaasi ay muujiyeen iskaashi ku saabsan arrimaha siyaasadda iyo amniga gobolka, halka Somaliland ay tallaabooyinkooda u aragto kuwo ka hor imaanaya qadiyaddeeda. Xukuumadda Somaliland ayaa si gaar ah uga soo horjeedda qoraal ay si wadajir ah u soo saareen dowladahaas, kaas oo ay kaga horyimaadeen aqoonsiga Somaliland. Cirro ayaa sheegay in maamulkiisu uu difaacayo jiritaanka, qarannimada iyo madaxbannaanida Somaliland, isaga oo tallaabooyinka dowladahaas ku tilmaamay kuwo lidd ku ah qaranimadeeda. Dhanka kale, Somaliland ayaa muddooyinkii dambe xoojisay dadaallada ay ku doonayso aqoonsi caalami ah, gaar ahaan kaddib markii ay sheegtay inay aqoonsi rasmi ah ka heshay dowladda Israa’iil. Tallaabadaas ayaa dhalisay cambaareyn ballaaran oo ka timid dowlado Carbeed iyo Afrikaan ah, iyo sidoo kale dhinacyo kale oo caalamka ah, kuwaas oo qaarkood taageeray midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. items.title: President Hassan sheikh announces election timetable unliterally without consensus
items.description: MOGADISHU (WDN) — In a move likely to intensify Somalia’s political crisis, the National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission has announced dates for federal parliamentary and presidential elections without an apparent political settlement between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, opposition leaders and federal member states over the country’s disputed electoral future. The commission announced today that elections for both houses of the Federal Parliament will take place on 15 April 2027, followed by the presidential election on 15 May 2027. The timetable appears to advance the president’s preferred electoral path despite months of failed efforts to secure broad political agreement on how Somalia should proceed. A statement from the commission cited Article 18(2) of the National Elections Law in setting the parliamentary election date and Article 112 of the President Hassan’s own constitution in support of the presidential timetable. It also stated that the terms of government institutions would be five years. But announcing dates is not the same as securing political legitimacy. The central question remains whether a commission can credibly organize national elections when the country’s principal political stakeholders have yet to reach consensus on the constitutional and electoral framework. An election timetable without a political settlement For much of this year, Hassan Sheikh’s administration has failed to achieve a comprehensive agreement with opposition leaders and federal member states on the way forward. Disputes over constitutional changes, the electoral system and the distribution of political authority have continued to divide the country’s leadership. Instead of first resolving those disputes through negotiations, the president’s government now appears determined to move ahead with an electoral timetable announced by the national commission. Critics are likely to view the decision as an attempt to establish the rules of a highly contested political process before agreement has been reached on the rules themselves. They argue that an election cannot resolve a constitutional crisis if the principal parties disagree over the legal and political framework under which it is conducted. The commission’s announcement also raises questions about the distinction between its formal independence and its ability to command confidence across the political spectrum. The existence of an electoral body and an official calendar do not, on its own, demonstrate that the process has the necessary political support. The commission’s statement refers to constitutional provisions, but the announcement does not explain how outstanding disagreements with opposition groups and federal member states will be resolved, or what arrangements would ensure that the proposed elections are accepted as legitimate by the competing political camps. A president increasingly detached from the political reality Hassan Sheikh faces a growing challenge to his claim to lead Somalia through a nationally accepted political process. His critics argue that his administration has become increasingly isolated from opposition leaders and federal member states, many of whom reject the president’s approach to constitutional and electoral change. The latest announcement reinforces their concern that the president is pursuing a political project centered on his own administration rather than building the broad agreement required for a credible national transition. Among his opponents, a growing perception is that Hassan Sheikh is operating inside a political bubble, disconnected from the frustrations and priorities of Somalis. That is a political judgement rather than a measurable national consensus, but it reflects the depth of distrust surrounding the electoral dispute. The danger for the president is that a timetable designed to demonstrate political momentum could instead expose the weakness of the consensus behind his plans. If significant opposition groups and federal member states refuse to recognize the process, the country could enter another period of confrontation over the legitimacy of its institutions. Can an election be legitimate without consensus? The announcement leaves Somalia facing a fundamental question: will the next election emerge from a negotiated political settlement, or will it become another unilateral exercise contested by major political stakeholders? The five-year term cited by the commission does not, by itself, settle disputes over the applicable constitutional framework, the legitimacy of proposed electoral arrangements or the acceptance of the process by competing political actors. Those questions require legal clarity and political agreement, not merely a published calendar. For Somalia, the stakes extend beyond the contest for the presidency. A disputed electoral process could deepen divisions between the federal government and member states, undermine confidence in national institutions and distract the country from pressing security, economic and humanitarian challenges. Hassan Sheikh’s administration still has an opportunity to prevent that outcome by reopening negotiations with opposition leaders and federal member states, addressing outstanding constitutional questions and establishing an electoral framework that commands broad confidence. But if Mogadishu proceeds without such an agreement, the announced dates may mark not the beginning of a settled democratic transition, but another chapter in Somalia’s prolonged struggle over political legitimacy. The central issue is no longer simply when Somalia will vote. It is whether the country’s political leaders can agree on the rules, institutions and constitutional arrangements that would make the result credible. Without that agreement, an election timetable risks becoming a source of further division rather than a path out of the crisis. items.title: President Hassan sheikh’s Southwest gamble backfires
items.description: BUURHAKABA, Somalia (WDN) — President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s controversial campaign to remove former Southwest State President Abdiasis Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen is producing consequences that may be far more damaging than Mogadishu anticipated. Within a week, forces loyal to Laftagareen have reportedly captured two strategically important districts in Bay region, challenging the authority of the administration backed by the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS). The latest setback came on Thursday, when Laftagareen-aligned forces attacked Buurhakaba, approximately 60 kilometres from Baidoa, the interim capital of Southwest State. After fierce fighting, the forces reportedly took control of the district, where federal government and Southwest State troops had previously been stationed. Videos circulating on social media appeared to show officials from Laftagareen’s former administration in central Buurhakaba. Those officials claimed that their forces had taken control of the town. Laftagareen’s fighters also displayed individuals they said had been captured during the fighting. However, these claims could not be independently verified, and Somali federal security officials had not publicly commented on the reported takeover at the time of publication. The situation remained tense, with competing military movements reported in and around the district. No independently verified figures were immediately available for casualties, and the whereabouts of the government-aligned forces previously stationed there remained unclear. Buurhakaba is the second district in Bay region reportedly to have fallen to Laftagareen-loyal forces within a week. On Friday, the same forces reportedly seized Qansaxdheere, approximately 90 kilometres from Baidoa. The successive losses represent a serious challenge to the authority of the current Southwest administration and raise questions about its ability to defend territory beyond the state capital. A military setback with national political consequences The developments come amid escalating political and security tensions following the confrontation over Southwest State’s leadership. Laftagareen’s removal and the installation of a rival administration, backed by Mogadishu, have intensified a dispute that is increasingly being fought not only through political manoeuvring but also through armed force. Rather than consolidating federal authority, the campaign against Laftagareen risks opening another front in an already fragmented country. If his forces continue to gain ground, the federal government could find itself spending more resources defending its political allies while struggling to demonstrate effective authority outside Mogadishu. Southwest State has previously warned about the activities of forces loyal to Laftagareen, particularly the possibility of attacks on other towns in the state. The administration has also said that attempts to advance on Baidoa had failed. The reported capture of Qansaxdheere and Buurhakaba, however, suggests that the military balance may be more complicated than those assurances indicated. The immediate question is whether Laftagareen’s forces can consolidate their gains and sustain pressure on Baidoa, or whether government-aligned troops will launch counteroffensives to recover the districts. For now, the absence of independently verified information about troop positions, casualties and the circumstances of the takeovers makes it difficult to determine the full military picture. Mogadishu’s shrinking political reach The unfolding crisis also exposes a broader problem for President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud: the widening gap between the federal government’s formal claims to national leadership and its practical ability to secure political cooperation across Somalia. Puntland and Jubaland have increasingly pursued their own political positions outside Mogadishu’s direction. Southwest State is now embroiled in an armed confrontation linked to its disputed leadership. In parts of Hirshabelle, the federal government’s influence is also contested, with Hiraan presenting particular challenges to Mogadishu’s authority. Galmudug remains an important part of the federal political landscape, but it cannot by itself compensate for deteriorating relations with other federal member states. These divisions raise a fundamental question about the strategy of concentrating political power in the presidency while failing to secure broad agreement on constitutional arrangements, elections and the relationship between the federal government and member states. A president’s constitutional title does not automatically translate into effective national authority. That authority depends on political legitimacy, functioning institutions, negotiated agreements and the willingness of federal member states to cooperate with the centre. Critics of Hassan Sheikh’s approach argue that his confrontation with Laftagareen has turned a political dispute into a potentially costly security crisis. Instead of bringing Southwest State more firmly under federal influence, the intervention may have strengthened resistance to Mogadishu and encouraged further fragmentation. The political consequences could extend beyond Bay region. If federal member states conclude that negotiations and constitutional procedures can be displaced by force whenever their leadership conflicts with the president’s preferences, trust in the federal system will deteriorate further. The danger of governing through confrontation Somalia’s federal arrangement was intended to distribute authority, accommodate regional interests and provide a framework for resolving disputes without returning to nationwide conflict. It cannot function effectively if disagreements over leadership are treated primarily as security problems rather than matters requiring political settlement and constitutional clarity. The latest developments do not, by themselves, establish that Laftagareen’s forces can capture Baidoa or overturn the administration backed by Mogadishu. Nor do they prove that the federal government has lost all influence across the country. They do, however, demonstrate that the confrontation has produced serious territorial and political consequences that cannot be dismissed as isolated incidents. For Hassan Sheikh, the strategic risk is clear: an operation intended to remove a political opponent may instead deepen opposition to his leadership, weaken an allied administration and further erode confidence in federal institutions. The growing alienation between Mogadishu and several federal member states has also fuelled increasingly dismissive political rhetoric about the president’s reach. Some critics deride him as little more than the president of Mogadishu, while others use divisive clan-based language to question his national standing. Such labels reflect the intensity of the political dispute, not a constitutional description of his office, and risk deepening Somalia’s clan divisions. The more consequential test, however, is not what political opponents call the president. It is whether his administration can rebuild consensus, respect constitutional procedures and persuade federal member states that their disputes with Mogadishu can be resolved through negotiation rather than coercion. For now, the reported loss of Qansaxdheere and Buurhakaba offers a stark warning: the effort to impose political control over Southwest State may be turning into a military and political liability for the very government that initiated the confrontation. If the conflict continues to escalate, the consequences could extend well beyond Baidoa, further weakening Somalia’s already fragile federal compact. items.title: Farmaajo oo ka horyimid go’aanka guddiga doorashooyinka, soona saaray digniin culus
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo ayaa si adag uga horyimid go’aanka Guddiga Madaxa Bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha, isaga oo ka digay in tallaabadaasi ay halis gelin karto dowladnimada iyo mustaqbalka dalka. Guddiga doorashada ayaa war-saxaafadeed uu maanta soo saaray ku sheegay in doorashada labada aqal ee baarlamaanka federaalka la qaban doono 15-ka April 2027, halka doorashada madaxweynaha loo asteeyay 15-ka May 2027. Farmaajo ayaa go’aanka guddiga ku tilmaamay mid goonni-qaadasho ah, isagoo sheegay in guddiga uu sameystay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo ku tilmaamay madaxweyne muddo xileedkiisu dhammaaday. “Hannaanka is-doorashada ee uu qaatay Madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisu dhammaaday, waxa uu halis gelinayaa dowladnimada iyo mustaqbalka dalka, waxa uuna horseedayaa doorashooyin isbarbar socda iyo dagaallo sokeeye oo dalka ku baaha,” ayuu yiri Farmaajo. Madaxweynihii hore ayaa ku baaqay in la sii ambaqaado wada-hadallada socda, lana qabto doorasho loo dhan yahay oo degdeg ah, isaga oo ku dooday in aan masiirka siyaasadeed ee dalka lagu go’aamin karin hannaan hal dhinac ah iyo rabitaanka shakhsiga. Sidoo kale, Farmaajo ayaa Xasan Sheekh ku eedeeyay inuu doonayo inuu xukunka dalka ku boobo, isaga oo sheegay in qorshaha doorasho aan heshiis lagu ahayn, talana aysan ku lahayn dowlad-goboleedyada iyo mucaaradka, uu muujinayo siyaasad kali-talisnimo ah iyo ku tumasho dastuur. Waxa uu sidoo kale ka digay in tallaabooyinka noocaas ahi ay dalka gelin karaan xaalad la mid ah tii uu sheegay inay ka dhalatay faragelintii lagu sameeyay qaar ka mid ah dowlad-goboleedyada, taas oo uu ku eedeeyay inay horseedday dagaallo sokeeye. Farmaajo ayaa ugu baaqay madaxda iyo mas’uuliyiintii hore ee dalka, madaxweynayaasha dowlad-goboleedyada iyo dhammaan dhinacyada siyaasadeed inay si wadajir ah ugu istaagaan hirgelinta doorasho hufan oo loo dhan yahay, si dalka looga samatabixiyo marxaladda adag ee uu ku jiro. Ugu dambeyntiina, waxa uu dowladaha saaxiibka la ah Soomaaliya iyo beesha caalamka ugu baaqay inay door wax ku ool ah ka qaataan xal u helidda khilaafaadka doorashooyinka, ayna sii wadaan dadaallada dhexdhexaadinta ee lagu xaqiijinayo doorasho mideysan, daah-furan oo loo dhan yahay. The post Farmaajo oo ka horyimid go’aanka guddiga doorashooyinka, soona saaray digniin culus appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sooyaal: Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke
items.description: Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke wuxuu ahaa Ra’iisalwasaarihii ugu horreeyay ee Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya ay yeelato, xorriyaddii 1960kii kaddib (1960—1964), iyo Madaxweynihii labaad ee Jamhuuriyadda (1967—1969). Waxaa ka horreeyay Cabdullaahi Ciise Maxamuud, oo Ra’iisalwasaare ka ahaa Maamulkii Soomaaliya ee xilligii Wasaayadda Talyaaniga, intii u dhexaysay 1956 ilaa 1960. Cabdullaahi Ciise wuxuu hoggaaminayay xukuumaddii Soomaaliyeed ee la dhisay xilligii dalka loo diyaarinayay gobannimada. Markii ay dhalatay Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya, Cabdirashiid ayaa noqday Ra’iisalwasaarihii ugu horreeyay ee jamhuuriyadda cusub, halka Cabdullaahi Ciise uu ka mid noqday xukuumaddii dalka, isaga oo qabtay xilka Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda (Heritage Institute for Policy Studies, 2022, p. 6; Mukhtar, 2003, pp. 21, 273). Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke wuxuu sannadkii 1919kii ku dhashay degmada Xarardheere ee gobolka Mudug. Waxbarashadiisii aasaasiga ahayd ayuu ku soo qaatay Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu dugsiga hoose ku dhammaystay sannadkii 1936. Intaas ka dib, wuxuu ka shaqeeyay hawlaha maamulka, isaga oo shaqaale ka noqday maamulladii Talyaaniga iyo Ingiriiska ee Soomaaliya soo maray. Sannadkii 1943, wuxuu ku biiray Ururkii Dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed (Somali Youth Club – SYC), oo markii danbe, sannadkii 1947, isu beddelay Ururka Dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed (Somali Youth League – SYL). Sannadkii 1950, wuxuu xubin ka noqday guddiga dhexe ee ururkaas, oo hormuud u ahaa halgankii gobannimodoonka Soomaaliya. Cabdirashiid, isaga oo sii watay shaqadiisii maamulka, ayuu dib u bilaabay waxbarashadiisii. Sannadkii 1953dii, wuxuu dhammaystay waxbarashadii dugsiga sare ee siyaasadda iyo maamulka. Ka dib, wuxuu deeqwaxbarasho u aaday dalka Talyaaniga, halkaas oo uu cilmiga siyaasadda ka bartay Jaamacadda Rooma (Sapienza University of Rome). Sannadkii 1958dii, wuxuu ka qalinjebiyay jaamacaddaas, isaga oo qaatay shahaadada heerka kowaad ee cilmiga siyaasadda. Wuxuu ka mid noqday Soomaalidii ugu horreysay ee xilligaas shahaado jaamacadeed hesha. Waxaa kale oo uu ahaa xubintii keliya ee shahaado jaamacadeed haysatay xukuumaddii ugu horraysay ee Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya. Markii uu dalka ku soo laabtay, wuxuu si toos ah ugu biiray dhaqdhaqaaqyadii siyaasadda iyo dawladdhiska. Sannadkii 1959kii ayaa loo doortay xubin ka tirsan Golihii Sharcidejinta Soomaaliya (Assemblea Legislativa), isaga oo Ururka SYL ku matalayay degmada Qardho. Waqtigaas, Soomaaliya waxay ku jirtay marxaladihii ugu danbeeyay ee u diyaargarowga gobannimada iyo midowga gobolladii ay kala gumaysan jireen Ingiriiska iyo Talyaanigu. 26kii Juun 1960kii, gobolladii waqooyi ee Ingiriisku gumaysan jiray ayaa xornimada qaatay, halka gobolladii koonfureedna ay xoroobeen 1dii Luulyo 1960, markaas oo labada dhinac ay ku midoobeen Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya. Waxaa Madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay ee Jamhuuriyadda noqday Aadan Cabdulle Cismaan (Aadan-Cadde), halka Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke loo magacaabay Ra’iisalwasaare. Xilkaas ayuu hayay ilaa 1964tii, markaas oo uu ku beddelay Cabdirisaaq Xaaji Xuseen. Xukuumaddii ugu horreysay ee Cabdirashiid waxay ka koobnayd 11 wasaaradood, waxaana ka mid ahaa wasiirradii xukuumadda Cabdullaahi Ciise Maxamuud iyo Maxamed Xaaji Ibraahin Cigaal. Muddadii uu Ra’iisalwasaaraha ahaa, Cabdirashiid wuxuu dadaal geliyay dhismaha hay’adihii dawladda, horumarinta xiriirka dibadda iyo xoojinta madaxbannaanida siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Wuxuu taageersanaa siyaasadda dhexdhexaadnimada, xilli ay dunidu ku jirtay Dagaalkii Qaboobaa ee u dhexeeyay quwadihii reer Galbeedka iyo Midowgii Soofiyeedka. Sannadkii 1962dii, isagoo booqasho rasmi ah ku tagay dalka Maraykanka, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay Madaxweyne John F. Kennedy. Waxaa kale oo ay xukuumaddiisu dadaal u gashay sidii Soomaaliya u heli lahayd taageero dhaqaale iyo mid ciidan oo ay ka hesho dalalka reer Galbeedka iyo Midowgii Soofiyeedka (Mukhtar, 2003, p. 17; U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian, n.d.). Cabdirashiid wuxuu sidoo kale kaalin ku lahaa siyaasaddii lagu taageerayay midnimada dhulka Soomaalida. Xukuumaddiisii ayaa bishii Maarso 1963dii xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed u jartay Ingiriiska, ka dib markii dawladda Ingiriisku ay taageertay in degaanka NFD uu ka mid ahaado Kenya, inkasta oo qayb weyn oo dadkii degaankaasi ay doonayeen in ay la midoobaan Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, dagaalkii Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya dhex maray sannadkii 1964tii wuxuu dhacay muddadii uu Cabdirashiid Ra’iisalwasaare ahaa, ee ma ahayn markii uu Madaxweyne noqday (Mukhtar, 2003, p. 17; UK Parliament, 1963). Markii la gaaray sannadkii 1967dii, waxaa dhammaaday muddaxileedkii Madaxweyne Aadan-Cadde. Doorashadii madaxtinnimada ee sannadkaas waxaa ku tartamay Aadan-Cadde iyo Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke, oo hore u soo noqday Ra’iisalwasaarihiisa. Cabdirashiid ayaa ku guulaystay doorashada, wuxuuna noqday Madaxweynihii labaad ee Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya. Aadan-Cadde ayaa xilka si nabad ah ugu wareejiyay madaxweynaha cusub, taas oo noqotay dhacdo muhiim ah oo ku saabsan sooyaalka dimuqraadiyadda Soomaaliya. Markuu Cabdirashiid noqday Madaxweyne, wuxuu Ra’iisalwasaare u magacaabay Maxamed Xaaji Ibraahin Cigaal. Xukuumadda cusub waxay xoogga saartay hagaajinta xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya la lahayd dalalka deriska ah, gaar ahaan Itoobiya iyo Kenya. Siyaasaddan oo ku dhisnayd wadahadal iyo xallinta ismaandhaafka ayaa ka duwanayd siyaasaddii adkayd ee ay Soomaaliya horay uga lahayd murannada xuduudaha. Hasayeeshee, waxaa jiray kooxo siyaasadeed oo ka soo horjeeday siyaasaddaas, iyaga oo u arkayay in ay wiiqayso dadaalladii lagu doonayay midnimada dhulka Soomaalida. items.fullContent: Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke wuxuu ahaa Ra’iisalwasaarihii ugu horreeyay ee Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya ay yeelato, xorriyaddii 1960kii kaddib (1960—1964), iyo Madaxweynihii labaad ee Jamhuuriyadda (1967—1969). Waxaa ka horreeyay Cabdullaahi Ciise Maxamuud, oo Ra’iisalwasaare ka ahaa Maamulkii Soomaaliya ee xilligii Wasaayadda Talyaaniga, intii u dhexaysay 1956 ilaa 1960. Cabdullaahi Ciise wuxuu hoggaaminayay xukuumaddii Soomaaliyeed ee la dhisay xilligii dalka loo diyaarinayay gobannimada. Markii ay dhalatay Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya, Cabdirashiid ayaa noqday Ra’iisalwasaarihii ugu horreeyay ee jamhuuriyadda cusub, halka Cabdullaahi Ciise uu ka mid noqday xukuumaddii dalka, isaga oo qabtay xilka Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda (Heritage Institute for Policy Studies, 2022, p. 6; Mukhtar, 2003, pp. 21, 273). Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke wuxuu sannadkii 1919kii ku dhashay degmada Xarardheere ee gobolka Mudug. Waxbarashadiisii aasaasiga ahayd ayuu ku soo qaatay Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu dugsiga hoose ku dhammaystay sannadkii 1936. Intaas ka dib, wuxuu ka shaqeeyay hawlaha maamulka, isaga oo shaqaale ka noqday maamulladii Talyaaniga iyo Ingiriiska ee Soomaaliya soo maray. Sannadkii 1943, wuxuu ku biiray Ururkii Dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed (Somali Youth Club – SYC), oo markii danbe, sannadkii 1947, isu beddelay Ururka Dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed (Somali Youth League – SYL). Sannadkii 1950, wuxuu xubin ka noqday guddiga dhexe ee ururkaas, oo hormuud u ahaa halgankii gobannimodoonka Soomaaliya. Cabdirashiid, isaga oo sii watay shaqadiisii maamulka, ayuu dib u bilaabay waxbarashadiisii. Sannadkii 1953dii, wuxuu dhammaystay waxbarashadii dugsiga sare ee siyaasadda iyo maamulka. Ka dib, wuxuu deeqwaxbarasho u aaday dalka Talyaaniga, halkaas oo uu cilmiga siyaasadda ka bartay Jaamacadda Rooma (Sapienza University of Rome). Sannadkii 1958dii, wuxuu ka qalinjebiyay jaamacaddaas, isaga oo qaatay shahaadada heerka kowaad ee cilmiga siyaasadda. Wuxuu ka mid noqday Soomaalidii ugu horreysay ee xilligaas shahaado jaamacadeed hesha. Waxaa kale oo uu ahaa xubintii keliya ee shahaado jaamacadeed haysatay xukuumaddii ugu horraysay ee Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya. Markii uu dalka ku soo laabtay, wuxuu si toos ah ugu biiray dhaqdhaqaaqyadii siyaasadda iyo dawladdhiska. Sannadkii 1959kii ayaa loo doortay xubin ka tirsan Golihii Sharcidejinta Soomaaliya (Assemblea Legislativa), isaga oo Ururka SYL ku matalayay degmada Qardho. Waqtigaas, Soomaaliya waxay ku jirtay marxaladihii ugu danbeeyay ee u diyaargarowga gobannimada iyo midowga gobolladii ay kala gumaysan jireen Ingiriiska iyo Talyaanigu. 26kii Juun 1960kii, gobolladii waqooyi ee Ingiriisku gumaysan jiray ayaa xornimada qaatay, halka gobolladii koonfureedna ay xoroobeen 1dii Luulyo 1960, markaas oo labada dhinac ay ku midoobeen Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya. Waxaa Madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay ee Jamhuuriyadda noqday Aadan Cabdulle Cismaan (Aadan-Cadde), halka Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke loo magacaabay Ra’iisalwasaare. Xilkaas ayuu hayay ilaa 1964tii, markaas oo uu ku beddelay Cabdirisaaq Xaaji Xuseen. Xukuumaddii ugu horreysay ee Cabdirashiid waxay ka koobnayd 11 wasaaradood, waxaana ka mid ahaa wasiirradii xukuumadda Cabdullaahi Ciise Maxamuud iyo Maxamed Xaaji Ibraahin Cigaal. Muddadii uu Ra’iisalwasaaraha ahaa, Cabdirashiid wuxuu dadaal geliyay dhismaha hay’adihii dawladda, horumarinta xiriirka dibadda iyo xoojinta madaxbannaanida siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Wuxuu taageersanaa siyaasadda dhexdhexaadnimada, xilli ay dunidu ku jirtay Dagaalkii Qaboobaa ee u dhexeeyay quwadihii reer Galbeedka iyo Midowgii Soofiyeedka. Sannadkii 1962dii, isagoo booqasho rasmi ah ku tagay dalka Maraykanka, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay Madaxweyne John F. Kennedy. Waxaa kale oo ay xukuumaddiisu dadaal u gashay sidii Soomaaliya u heli lahayd taageero dhaqaale iyo mid ciidan oo ay ka hesho dalalka reer Galbeedka iyo Midowgii Soofiyeedka (Mukhtar, 2003, p. 17; U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian, n.d.). Cabdirashiid wuxuu sidoo kale kaalin ku lahaa siyaasaddii lagu taageerayay midnimada dhulka Soomaalida. Xukuumaddiisii ayaa bishii Maarso 1963dii xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed u jartay Ingiriiska, ka dib markii dawladda Ingiriisku ay taageertay in degaanka NFD uu ka mid ahaado Kenya, inkasta oo qayb weyn oo dadkii degaankaasi ay doonayeen in ay la midoobaan Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, dagaalkii Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya dhex maray sannadkii 1964tii wuxuu dhacay muddadii uu Cabdirashiid Ra’iisalwasaare ahaa, ee ma ahayn markii uu Madaxweyne noqday (Mukhtar, 2003, p. 17; UK Parliament, 1963). items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo dhoweysay jadwalka uu shaaciyey Guddiga Madaxa Bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha, kaas oo ku saabsan qabashada doorashooyinka labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo doorashada Madaxweynaha dalka. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa lagu sheegay in xukuumaddu jadwalkan u aragto tallaabo muhiim ah oo loo qaaday hirgelinta geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka iyo xoojinta hannaanka dimuqraadiyadda dalka. Xukuumaddu waxay xusuusisay shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo daneeyayaasha kale in 18-kii bilood ee lasoo dhaafay ay waday dadaallo wadatashi iyo wada-xaajood, si dhinacyada siyaasadeed ay isula meel dhigaan arrimaha masiiriga ah ee dalka, gaar ahaan geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka. Waxay caddeysay in wadatashiyada iyo wada-xaajoodyadu ay sii socon doonaan, iyadoo muujisay sida ay uga go’an tahay in dadaalladaasi miro-dhal noqdaan, isla markaana ay horseedaan is-afgarad ballaaran oo dhex mara dhinacyada Soomaaliyeed. Dhanka kale, xukuumaddu waxay sheegtay in soo dhoweynta jadwalka doorashooyinka iyo sii wadidda wada-xaajoodyadu ay yihiin laba dadaal oo is-dhammeystiraya, kuwaas oo ka tarjumaya mas’uuliyadda ka saaran ilaalinta xasilloonida dalka iyo xoojinta midnimada qaranka. Waxay sidoo kale tilmaantay in dadaalladani ay qayb ka yihiin xaqiijinta xaqa dastuuriga ah ee muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo muujisay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii wado geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka iyo wada-hadallada siyaasadeed. Ugu dambeyn, xukuumadda ayaa ugu baaqday dhammaan dhinacyada siyaasadda inay si niyad-wanaag iyo mas’uuliyad qaran leh uga qayb qaataan wadatashiyada, ayna ka wada shaqeeyaan qabashada doorashooyin nabdoon oo xoojiya kalsoonida shacabka iyo mustaqbalka dowladnimada Soomaaliya. items.title: Somalia’s New Constitution and Lack of Good Faith
items.description: By Farah Mire Good faith is the foundation of any working constitution. It means that the same rules bind everyone, including those in power. When rules are applied only when convenient, confidence collapses and institutions lose their meaning. Somalia’s current constitutional dispute is, at its heart, a test of this principle. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud was elected in May 2022 under the Provisional Constitution for a four-year term. That term ended in May 2026. In March 2026, Parliament approved amendments that changed the presidential term to five years. The President now relies on those amendments to remain in office until May 2027. Earlier in the process, officials had indicated that the new rules would apply after the next election and would not extend the current mandate. That position later changed. The same Constitution is now used to justify a longer term. If those rules are accepted as law, they must be applied fully, not selectively. The clearest illustration of selective application is the composition of the cabinet. A large majority of ministers also sit as members of Parliament. The Independent Constitutional Review and Implementation Commission has ordered them to choose one role. The relevant provision is Article 81(1)(f), which prohibits dual membership of the executive and the legislature. The transition periods provided by the Constitution have already expired. Keeping both positions after those deadlines have passed shows that the written rules are treated as optional. This is not a minor technical issue. It is a direct test of whether the Constitution limits power or simply serves it. The same selective approach appears at the level of the federal member states. Term extensions in Galmudug, Hirshabelle and Southwest were arranged with the federal centre despite legal questions and strong objections from opposition groups. Elections have since been held in these states. In Southwest, the Justice and Solidarity Party, linked to the President, secured a clear majority of seats and the state presidency went to a close federal ally. In Hirshabelle, the same party won 78 of 99 seats in the House of Representatives and a large majority of local council seats.  In Galmudug, after a court-ordered rerun, it won 67 of 89 assembly seats and most local council seats. These results matched earlier predictions of ruling-party dominance. Major opposition groups boycotted or were excluded from parts of the process and continue to dispute the fairness and inclusiveness of the polls. Official results have been published by the electoral commission, yet the absence of broad participation weakens any claim that these elections fully reflect constitutional good faith. The opposition, organised mainly under the Somali Future Council, is fragile, fragmented and frustrated. The Council brings together former presidents, former prime ministers and the leaders of Puntland and Jubaland. It has publicly rejected the March 2026 amendments as lacking consensus and has described them as illegitimate. Its members argue that the President’s term ended in May 2026 and do not recognise the five-year extension. They have called for inclusive dialogue, international mediation and a return to negotiated rules. They have also boycotted elections in places such as Southwest State. Yet the opposition has not turned the principle of good faith into a consistent national demand. Instead of pressing for the full and equal application of the Constitution, many of its figures focus on issues that protect their own local and clan-based interests. They criticise the President’s selective use of rules mainly when those rules work against them, while remaining quieter when similar practices benefit their own regions or groups. Their reluctance to attack the cabinet dual-role issue has deeper roots. Challenging the dual roles of ministers would require accepting that parts of the new Constitution are valid and must be enforced. Many opposition leaders reject the document as a whole and regard it as the product of a flawed process. In addition, some appear reluctant to press the point because they do not wish to alienate current political leaders, including ministers and MPs, whom they may later hope to attract into their own ranks. In Somalia’s fluid political environment, alliances shift and individuals move between camps. A public campaign against sitting ministers over dual roles could close the door to future cooperation or defections. The result is that the opposition avoids using constitutional provisions as a tool for accountability, even when those provisions could strengthen its case. Because priorities remain localised and clannish, because hostility to the new Constitution persists, and because the possibility of later recruitment from the current political class is kept open, the opposition struggles to build a broad national argument for consistent constitutional rule. Its objections remain loud but limited in practical effect. Civil society faces similar constraints. Groups such as Somalia Non-State Actors have issued public statements calling for immediate political dialogue, an inclusive agreement on constitutional implementation, and a consensual electoral framework. They have criticised the lack of broad consultation and warned that unilateral steps risk instability. Yet these organisations are often under-resourced, divided by regional and other lines, and exposed to political pressure. They operate in a fragmented environment and have limited capacity to force consistent application of the Constitution. Public debate therefore stays narrow, and the demand for genuine accountability remains weak. The amendments were passed by a majority in the Federal Parliament. That is a formal fact. At the same time, important federal member states and opposition groups rejected the process as insufficiently inclusive. The gap between a parliamentary majority and broad political agreement remains real. Somalia does not need a dramatic deadline to judge the situation. The transition periods set by the Constitution have already passed. What matters is whether the same document used to extend a presidential term is also used to require ministers to give up dual roles and to guide state elections with greater fairness and genuine competition. Selective application of rules erodes confidence. It suggests that the Constitution serves power rather than limits it. Restoring good faith requires consistency: the rules must bind the President, the cabinet, the states and the opposition alike. Without that consistency, frustration will grow on all sides and the gap between written law and daily practice will continue to widen. Farah Mire The post Somalia’s New Constitution and Lack of Good Faith appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Somalia’s government loses Burhakabo to ousted Southwest leader’s forces
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Forces loyal to Somalia’s former Southwest State president, Abdiasis Laftagaren, seized another strategic town in Bay region on Thursday, deepening the federal government’s territorial losses. The assault on Burhakabo began early in the day. The town lies on the road linking Mogadishu and Baidoa, the Bay region’s administrative capital, 64 km to the east. A brief gunfight preceded the town’s fall, after which forces loyal to the former regional leaders took full control. It was not immediately clear whether there were any casualties, although there were reports of injuries on both sides. Ministers of the ousted Southwest State administration visited Burhakabo shortly after its fall. They had been part of the former regional Darwish forces, which have waged guerrilla warfare against federal forces in the region since Laftagaren’s ouster in March. Laftagaren’s side displayed dozens of federal troops captured in the town. The federal government and its allied new administration in the region have not commented so far. The capture came days after the government lost the town of Qansah-dhere. Analysts say this is an early sign that the federal government is gradually losing the war it launched to dominate the federal member state completely. After ousting Laftagaren and his administration, it installed a loyal administration that has so far failed to find its footing, win local support or build security institutions able to keep Laftagaren’s forces away from Baidoa and other major towns in the region. items.title: Baarlamaanka oo wasiir ka tirsan xukuumadda Xamza u qabtay 48 saac + Sababta
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Beeraha ee Golaha Shacabka ayaa Wasiirka Beeraha iyo Waraabka u qabtay muddo 48 saacadood ah kadib khilaaf ka dhashay xogta xubnaha loo xulay Golaha Hagista Hay’adda Sharciyeynta Adeegyada iyo Baaritaanka Beeraha Soomaaliyeed (SARIS). Guddiga Beeraha, Horumarinta Reer Miyiga, Xoolaha iyo Khayraadka Badda ayaa wasiirka ka dalbaday inuu muddadaas ku soo gudbiyo dukumentiyada xubnaha golaha, si loo xaqiijiyo in magacaabistooda loo maray habraacyada sharciga. Dukumentiyada la doonayo waxaa ka mid ah aqoonsiyada xubnaha, shahaadooyinka waxbarashada, warqadaha dembi-la’aanta, taariikh-nololeedyada iyo caddeymaha asluub-wanaagga ee Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka Qaranka. Arrintan ayaa daba socota jawaab uu wasiirku ka bixiyay codsi hore oo guddigu ku dalbaday xogta xubnaha la xushay. Wasiirka ayaa dhankiisa ku dooday in helitaanka macluumaadka shakhsiga ah ee xubnaha uu magacaabay aanu ku jirin waajibaadka guddiga. Hase yeeshee waxaa ka horyimid guddiga, oo ku adkaystay in baarlamaanku awood sharci u leeyahay inuu xogtan dalbado. Guddigu wuxuu arrinta ku saleeyay qodobka 95-aad ee Dastuurka Federaalka Soomaaliya, kaas oo dhigaya awoodda labada gole ee Baarlamaanka u leeyihiin korjoogteynta iyo baaritaanka hay’adaha dowladda. Dooddiisa sharciyeed ayuu guddigu ku xoojiyay qodobka 59-aad ee xeer-hoosaadka Golaha Shacabka, kaas oo u oggolaanaya guddiyada Baarlamaanka inay dowladda iyo hay’adaha kale ka dalbadaan xogta iyo warbixinnada ay ugu baahan yihiin gudashada waajibaadkooda. Xogta xubnaha ayaa si gaar ah loogu doonayaa in lagu hubiyo waafaqsanaanta sharciga tirsigiisu yahay LR.32, kaas oo la soo saaray 24-kii December 2024, laguna aasaasay SARIS. Guddigu wuxuu doonayaa inuu xaqiijiyo in la buuxiyay shuruudaha xubinnimada Golaha Hagista ee ku xusan qodobka 7-aad ee sharcigaas. Hay’adda SARIS waxay qaabilsan tahay sharciyeynta adeegyada iyo baaritaanka beeraha Soomaaliyeed. Sida uu guddigu sheegay, hay’addu maamul ahaan way ka madax-bannaan tahay Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Waraabka, inkasta oo ay siyaasad ahaan hoos timaaddo wasaaradda. The post Baarlamaanka oo wasiir ka tirsan xukuumadda Xamza u qabtay 48 saac + Sababta appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xukuumadda Soomaaliya oo Soo Dhaweysay Jadwalka Doorashooyinka Qaranka
items.description: MUQDISHO (Goobjoog News) — Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo dhaweysay jadwalka uu shaaciyey Guddiga Madaxa Bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha, kaas oo la xiriira qabashada doorashooyinka labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo tan Madaxweynaha dalka. War-saxaafadeed ay Khamiistii soo saartay Xukuumaddu ayay ku sheegtay in jadwalkani yahay tallaabo muhiim ah oo loo qaaday hirgelinta geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka iyo xoojinta hannaanka dimuqraadiyadda Soomaaliya. Xukuumadda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in 18-kii bilood ee la soo dhaafay ay wadday dadaallo wadatashi iyo wada-xaajood oo ay ku doonaysay in dhinacyada siyaasadda Soomaaliyeed ay isula meel dhigaan arrimaha masiiriga ah ee dalka, gaar ahaan hannaanka doorashooyinka. Waxay caddeysay in wada-tashiyada iyo wada-xaajoodyadu ay sii socon doonaan, iyadoo sheegtay inay ku dadaalayso sidii ay u horseedi lahaayeen is-afgarad ballaaran oo ay gaaraan dhinacyada siyaasadda. Xukuumaddu waxay tilmaantay in soo dhoweynta jadwalka doorashooyinka iyo sii wadidda wada-xaajoodyadu ay yihiin laba dadaal oo is-dhammeystiraya, kuwaas oo ay ku sheegtay inay qayb ka yihiin mas’uuliyadda dowladda ee ilaalinta xasilloonida dalka, xoojinta midnimada qaranka iyo xaqiijinta xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed. Ugu dambeyn, Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ugu baaqday dhammaan dhinacyada siyaasadda inay si niyad-wanaag iyo mas’uuliyad qaran leh uga qayb qaataan wadatashiyada, isla markaana ay iska kaashadaan qabashada doorashooyin nabdoon oo xoojiya kalsoonida shacabka iyo mustaqbalka dowladnimada Soomaaliya.

items.title: Mucaaradka oo ka hor-yimid tallaabada uu maanta qaaday guddiga doorashooyinka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maxamed Aadan Jimcaale (Koofi) oo ah xoghayaha siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ah ee ku mideysan Madasha Samatabixinta, ayaa war qoraal ah oo uu soo saaray kaga fal-celiyay jadwalka doorashada heer federaal ee uu maanta shaaciyay Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka. Jadwalka ayaa dhigaya in doorashada labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ay dhacdo 15-ka Abriil 2027, halka doorashada Madaxweynaha loo asteeyay 15-ka May 2027. “Guddigu waxa uu si rasmi ah u shaacinayaa arrimahan soo socda: In Doorashada Labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya la qabanayo (15-April-2027), si waafaqsan qodobka 18-aad faqradiisa 2-aad ee sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka oo sheegaya in la cayimo taariikhda doorashada 180 maalin ka hor maalinta codbixinta,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Sidoo kale, waxaa lasii raaciyay “In Doorashada Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay dhacdo (15-May-2027), si waafaqsan qodobka 112-aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee sheegaya in muddada xil-haynta Madaxweynuhu tahay shan (5) sano oo ka bilaabanaysa maalinta xilka loo dhaariyo”. Maxamed Aadan Jimcaale (Koofi) ayaa ka horyimid jadwalka, wuxuuna madaxda Dowladda Federaalka ku eedeeyay inay wadaan boob doorasho iyo awood sheegasho, sida uu hadaka u dhigay. “Calool waxay ku bukootay kuma bogsato” Cudurka sababay burburka Soomaaliya wuxuu ka bilaawday doorasho la boobay iyo awoodda dowladnimada oo si qaldan loo adeegsaday. Afartan sano kaddib, Xasan Sh wuxuu doonayaa in isla cudurkii uu daawo ka dhigo mana dhacayso! “Alloow yaa talo maalinteeda qaata,” ayuu qoraalkiisa ku yiri Maxamed Aadan Koonfi. Dhinaca kale, waxaa soo jawaabay Wasiirka Warfaafinta Soomaaliya, Cabdifitaax Qaasim oo bogaadiyay tallaabada uu qaaday guddiga doorashada, isagoo tilmaamay in dalka uu aaday doorashooyin qof iyo cod ah. “Tan iyo markii la ansixiyey, madaxweynuhuna saxiixay afartii cutub ee ugu horreeyey ee Dastuurka Qaranka, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay wadday dadaallo lagu xaqiijinayo dhaqan-gelintiisa, iyadoo la meel mariyey xeerarkii iyo hay’adihii lagama maarmaanka u ahaa hirgelinta doorashooyinka. Doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ee ku dhisan nidaamka axsaabta badan ayaa ka qabsoomay Muqdisho, waxaana hannaanka doorashooyinku ka socdaa dowlad-goboleedyada qaarkood,” ayuu ku jawaabay wasiirku. Waxaa kale oo kusii daray “Maanta, Soomaaliya waxay u jihaysan tahay doorashooyinka heer federaal ee qof iyo cod, kuwaas oo qayb muhiim ah ka ah dowlad-dhiska, xoojinta dimuqraadiyadda iyo awoodsiinta shacabka. Doorashada qof iyo cod waa xaqaaga iyo mustaqbalka dalkaaga. Isu diyaariya ka-qaybgalka doorashooyinka”. Tallaabadan ayaa kusoo aadeyso, xilli uu weli taagan yahay khilaafka ka dhashay hannaanka doorashada dalka, oo ay isku hayaan dowladda dhexe, mucaaradka, Jubbaland iyo Puntland. The post Mucaaradka oo ka hor-yimid tallaabada uu maanta qaaday guddiga doorashooyinka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Hundreds celebrate in Somaliland’s capital after Trump comments
items.description: https://qarannews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/1cec49d071a81443784541e540dc563e_1792074487888.mp4 Hundreds of people rallied in Somaliland’s capital Hargeisa on Wednesday, waving United States and Somaliland flags, celebrating US President Donald Trump calling it “a totally different country”. The breakaway region of Somalia runs its own affairs, and is widely seen as more stable and democratic than the rest of the country, though it has so far only been recognised by Israel. However, during a rally in Ohio on Monday US President Donald Trump said Somaliland was “a totally different country” from Somalia. Hargeisa welcomed the president’s remarks, posting on X on Tuesday that they “underscore Somaliland’s distinct identity and its separate political reality” and adding it remained “steadfast in its pursuit of international recognition”. “Donald Trump’s statement marks the beginning of US recognition for Somaliland,” said Ali Hashi, among those celebrating in Hargeisa’s Kheyriyadda Square. Videos and images shared on social media, which AFP could not independently verify, showed hundreds gathering. Waving US and Somaliland flags — some of which were emblazoned with Trump’s face — they shouted: “Victory to Somaliland” and “Long live America”. Another participant, Ilhaan Abdirahman, called it a “major development”, similarly saying it could mean that “US will formally recognise Somaliland”. “We deserve recognition because we are distinct from Somalia in every respect,” she said. University student Mohamed Yasin, while not agreeing with everything Trump said — at one point during his speech the president suggested changing the name from Somaliland — still welcomed his comments. “It feels as though Somaliland has already been recognised. It is a cause for celebration and a major victory for us,” he said. Somaliland enjoys a strategic position on the Gulf of Aden and has its own currency, passport and army, but has struggled to win international recognition. Israel’s recognition in December 2025 drew condemnation from Somalia, the African Union and the Arab League among others. The hope that others might follow Israel’s lead — including the United States, United Arab Emirates and Ethiopia — has not come to fruition. They see Somaliland’s value as a strategic military and trade hub on the Gulf of Aden, close to Yemen, and as a haven of democracy in a volatile region. But secession remains controversial: strongly opposed by the African Union and other partners, who fear it could encourage breakaway movements elsewhere. Mogadishu has not commented. African news

items.title: Taliyaha Booliska Soomaaliyeed oo shir guddoomiyey kulan looga hadlay amniga dalka iyo weerarrada burcad-badeedda
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa shir guddoomiyey kulan ay ka qeybgaleen hoggaannada, qeybaha iyo fadhiyada madaxa-bannaan ee Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed. Kulanka oo uu sidoo kale ka qeybgalay Taliye ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Booliska, Sarreeye Guuto Cismaan Cabdullaahi Maxamed, ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda guud ee amniga dalka, weerarrada ay geysanayaan kooxaha burcad-badeedda iyo diyaarinta miisaaniyadda Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed. Kulankan toddobaadlaha ah ayaa qeyb ka ah kulamada lagu qiimeeyo xaaladda amniga iyo howlaha shaqo ee Ciidanka Booliska, iyadoo sidoo kale laga hadlay arrimaha la xiriira qorsheynta miisaaniyadda ciidanka. Ma jiro faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo laga bixiyey tallaabooyinka gaarka ah ee laga qaadayo weerarrada burcad-badeedda ama natiijooyinka laga gaaray kulanka.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo Shir Guddoomiyey Kulanka Guddiga Joogtada
items.description: MUQDISHO — Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa shir guddoomiyey kulanka 11-aad ee Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Golaha Shacabka, kaas oo ka tirsan Kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Baarlamaanka. Kulanka oo ka dhacay xarunta Guddoonka iyo Guddiyada ee Villa Hargeysa, waxaa sidoo kale ka qeyb galay Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow. Guddoomiyaha ayaa xubnaha Guddiga Joogtada ah warbixin ka siiyey natiijooyinka Shirweynihii 153-aad ee Midowga Baarlamaanada Adduunka (IPU) iyo kulankii 21-aad ee Guddoomiyeyaasha Baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC), kuwaas oo labaduba lagu qabtay magaalada Arusha ee dalka Tanzania. Sidoo kale, kulanka waxaa warbixinno looga dhageystay guddiyada kala duwan ee Golaha Shacabka, kuwaas oo ka hadlay hindise-sharciyeedyada iyo shuruucda ay gacanta ku hayaan, heerarka ay marayaan iyo waqtiga la filayo in ay soo dhammaystiraan. Ugu dambeyn, Guddiga Joogtada ah ayaa dejiyey ajandaha iyo jadwalka kulamada guud ee Golaha Shacabka ee toddobaadka soo socda. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa xubnaha guddiga uga mahadceliyey dadaalkooda iyo wada-shaqeyntooda ku aaddan dardargelinta howlaha Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya.

items.title: Ciidanka Laftagareen oo la wareegay degmadii labaad kadib dagaalkii maanta
items.description: Buurhakaba (Caasimada Online) — Ciidamada taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) oo saaka weerar ku qaaday degmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Baay ayaa la wareegay gacan ku haynta degmadaasi oo ay horay ugu sugnaayeen ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed. Dagaal qaraar oo ka dhacay gudaha Buurhakaba ayaa waxaa kadib maleeshiyaadka u suuragashay inay si buuxda gacanta ku dhigaan degmadaasi ooq qiyaastii illaa 60 KM u jirta magaalada Baydhaba, oo ah xarunta ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, muuqaalo ku baahan baraha bulshada ayaa muujinayo wasiirro ka tirsan maamulkii Lafta-gareen oo ku sugan bartamaha magaalada, kuwaas oo qayb ka ahaa dagaalka ka dhacay halkaasi, waxayna xaqiijiyeen inay la wareegeen maamulka degmada. Waxaa kale oo ay ciidamada Laftagareen soo bandhigeen maxaabiis ay sheegeen inay ku qateen dagaalkii saaka, balse ma jiraan ilo madax bannaan oo xaqiijin kara sheegadaas, mana jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay saraakiisha ciidanka dowladda Soomaaliya. Xaaladda ayaa weli kacsan, waxaana haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeedo laga daareemayaa gudaha iyo daafaha degmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Baay. Waa degmadii labaad oo todobaad gudihiisa u gacan gacan gasha ciidamada taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen), kuwaas oo Jimcihii la wareegay degmada Qansaxdheere ee gobolka Bay oo iyana qiyaastii 90 KM u jirta magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta KMG ah ee Koonfur Galbeed. items.title: Galgaduud: In ka badan 100 qoys oo nolol adag uu galiyay bacaadka saamayn ku haya
items.description: (ERGO) – Cunno xumo iyo hoy la’aan ayay wajahayaan 130 qoys oo danyar iyo xoolo dhaqato iskugu jira, kuwaas oo bishii Ogosto ee sanadkaan bacaad ku soo rogmaday uga barakacay deegaanka Hul-caduur ee gobolka Galgaduud. Dadkaan oo horrayba ugu sugna nolol xumo ka dhalatay roob yari tuullada ka jirtay in ka badan sanad ayaa sheegay in bacaadka oo markii ugu horaysay ku fiday uu xaaladdooda uga sii daray. Waxay ku waayeen guriyahooda, waddooyinkii, xaruntii caafimaadka iyo goobtii waxbarashada. Abuukar Maxamuud Iidow oo ka mid ah wuxuu qoyskiisa oo 10 ah u awoodi la’yahay cunno iyo gabaad. Waxa keli ah ee ay noloshoodu ku tiirsan tahay waa 20 kiilo oo bur, baris, sonkor iyo saliid iskugu jira oo ay iskugu soo dardareen dad ay ehel yihiin oo jooga degmada Ceel-dheer. Wuxuu tilmaamay in kalmadaas oo ay tashilayeen tan iyo bartamihii bishii hore ay hadda gababasi sii tahay aysan jirin meel kale oo ay deeq ama dayn ka heli karaan. “Xoolihii aan ku tiirsanayna waa nacfi beelen. Waddooyinkii waa burbureen. Gawaarida qiimo sare ayay raashinka ku keenaan deegaanka oo aan awoodin inaan iibsano.” Abuukar ayaa sheegay in qoyskiisa ay duleedka deeganka ku wajahaya hoy xumo. Carruurtiisa oo kan ugu yar uu jira 1 sano, horrayna aan u mudan dugsi la’aan tan lamid ah ayuu xusay in ay la qabsan la’yihiin. Wuxuu tilmaamay in bacadka uu hoygiisa ku yimid xilli uu dayac tir ku sameeyay saddex qol oo jingad ah oo ay daganayeen. Wuxuu xusay in carrada ay duugtay dhamaan qolalkii iyo meelihii ay biyaha ku kaydsan jireen, taasina ay ku qasab tay in ay iskaga soo tagaan. “Guriga marka uu bacadku duugo halkiisa ayaa looga tagaya iyadoon waxbo laga qaadan. Waxyabaha iga qasaaray waxaa ka mid bac aan dhulka galinay oo ay reerka iyo xoolaha biyaha iga cabi jireen, $300 oo ay dad ehel ah igu caawiyeen ayaana markii hore ku samaystay.” Abukar ayaa sheegay in 20 neef oo ari oo u jooga ay yihiin wayd aan iib galin, sidoo kalana aysan qoyskiisa ka helin wax cad iyo caano toona. Daaq xumo haysata iyo inuusan calaf u gadi karin ayuu u sababeeyay. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay in muddadii ay roob yaridu jirtay ay daaq la’aan uga dhinteen 55 neef ari ah. Dhanka kale wuxuu tilmaamay in qoyskiisa ay maalinkii cabaan jirgaan ay xaskiisa dhabarka uga qaato ceellal rig bilaash ah oo deeganka ku yaalla. Wuxuu xusay in ceelasha ay biyaha ka cabaan uusan wali bacaadku gaarin. Xaaskiisa ayuu tilmaamay in ay ku qaadato qiyaastii in ka badan sacad iyo bar si ay biyo ugu soo dhaamiso. Waxaa xaaladdan darteed waxbarasho la’aan ka noqday 3 carruur ah oo wax uga dhigan jiray iskuulka hoose dhexe ee deeganka oo hadda xirmay, markii bacadka iyo dabaylo is biirsaday awgeed uu burburay. Carruurtiisa oo marayay fasalka labaad ee dugsiga hoose ayuu xusay in ay guri joog noqdeen. Iskuulka xirmay ayuu sheegay in uu ahaa xarunta kaliya ee waxbarasho ee tuullada ku taallay, taas oo ay bulshada isku tashi ku dhisteen sanado ka hor. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay in degmada Ceel-dheer oo u jirta qiyaastiii 40 km ay tahay halka ugu soo sokaysa ee uu tacliin uga heli karo carruurtiisa, balse ma hayo kharashkii uu ku gayn laha. Waxaa culayska ku sii kordhinaya $800 oo uu qayb raashin iyo arad-tir ugu qaaday reerka, qaybna uu ku soo qaatay agabkii uu guriga ku dhisay. “Culays wayn ayay dayntaas igu haysa. Habeennada qaar hurdada ayaan ka toosa walwalka ay igu haysa awgeed Illahey ayaan ka baryaya in uu I siiyo wax aan iskaga bixiyo.” Abukar ayaa sheegay inusan hayn wax qorsha ah oo uu xaaladdan uga samata-bixi karo, maaddama uu faro maran yahay. Qoysaska ku barakacay bacaadka ku habsaday tuulada Hul-cudur iyo hareeraheeda ayaa ka siman saamaynta nololeed ee haysta. Cabdullaahi Maxamed Kulmiye wuxuu tilmamtay in qoyskiisa oo 13 qof ka kooban ay wajahayaan daruufo liita oo dhanka nolosha ah. Bacaadka awgiis waxaa ka xirmay sandaqad uu ku iibin jiray bagaash iyo raashin, taas oo uu maalinkii kaga tashan jiray $8 illaa $10 oo faa’ido ah. “Ganacsi yar ayaan haystay, wax kale iima raacin. Dukankii waa iga burburay. Gurigii uu igu yaallay ayaa burburay. Si walbo oo aan bacaadka ula dagalami karno waa samaynay, markii wixii kharash aan hayay uu iga dhamaaday ayaan quustay oo aan reerka u soo waday duleedka deegaanka.” Cabdullahi ayaa sheegay in labadii bil ee la soo dhaafay ay qoyskiisa ku tiirsanayeen raashin 35 kiilo ah oo bur bariis, saliid, sonkor iyo Digir iskugu jiray oo dukaanka u yaallay. Wuxuu xusay in ay tashiilanayeen, balse uu ka idlaaday bartamihii bishii hore. Waxay dabka ku shitaan daymo ay ka soo qaatan dukaamo ku yaalla degmada Ceel-dheer. Wuxuu sheegay in uu noqday baaga-muudo ku hungoobay raadinta shaqooyinka xamaalka ah oo ay adag tahay in laga helo tuulladii uu ku noola iyo degmad Ceel-dheer. Wuxuu tilmaamay in qoyskiisa ay nolol xumo dhinacyo kala duwan leh ku wajahayaan duleedka tuullada oo ay soo miciin bideen. Culaysyada ugu daran ee uusan xalka u hayn waxaa ka mid ah tacliin la’aan soo food saartay labo ka mid ah carruurtiisa oo horray wax u baran jiray.  “Bacadka waxbarashada waa naga sameeyay. Culays badan ayay igu haysa tacliin la’aanta carruurtayda. Ma hayo kharash aan meel kale ugu diro. Culays wayn ayaa dareemaya.” Sidoo kale gawaarida yimaada ayuu xusay in ay shidaal badan gubaan si ay deeganka u soo gaaran ama ay ka soo wareegtaan waddooyin fogfog oo qiyaastii illa 25 km ah. Wuxuu xusay in kirada lagu keeno kiishka raashinka ah ee Gaalkacyo ama Xamar laga soo qaado uu qofka ganacsadaha ahi ku bixiyo $5 halka markii hore u ahaa $2.5. Bacaadka oo si xowli ah u fidayA ayaa wada gaaray inta badan dadkii dagana konfurka deeganka iyo miyiga hoostaga, taas oo ka dhigaysa meel qarka u saaran in ay noqoto lama deegaan sida uu sheegay Yuusuf Cabdulle Xasan Xoghayaha deegaanka Hul-cudur “Daruufaha ugu daran ee dadka haysta waa hoy la’aan, waxbarasho la’aan, bubur ku yimid xaruntii MCH ka iyo suuqi lagu ganacsan jiray. Bulshada tabar ay ku dhistaan mahayan.” “Cid kasto oo nagu caawinta karta xakamaynta bacaadka iyo sidii aan u dhisan lahayn xarumihii naga burburay waa u baahanahay.” The post Galgaduud: In ka badan 100 qoys oo nolol adag uu galiyay bacaadka saamayn ku haya appeared first on Radio Ergo - Somali Humanitarian News and Information .

items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka oo shaaciyay jadwalka doorashooyinka 2027
items.description: MUQDISHO (Wararka Goobjoog) — Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa shaaciyay jadwalka rasmiga ah ee qabashada doorashooyinka labada aqal ee Baarlamaanka iyo Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. War-saxaafadeed uu guddigu soo saaray 15-ka Oktoobar 2026, ayuu ku sheegay in doorashada labada aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka la qaban doono 15-ka Abriil 2027, halka doorashada Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya la qaban doono 15-ka May 2027. Guddigu wuxuu sidoo kale shaaciyay in dib-u-furista diiwaangelinta ururrada siyaasadda iyo codbixiyeyaasha muddada labaatan iyo kow maalmood ah ay bilaaban doonto 1-da Nofeembar 2026, iyadoo la soo gabagabeyn doono 22-ka isla bishaas. Sidoo kale, liisaska murashaxiinta labada aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka ayaa la soo gudbin doonaa 22-ka Nofeembar 2026, halka liiska kumeel-gaarka ah ee codbixiyeyaasha la soo saari doono 21-ka Janaayo 2027, kaddib marka la dhammeystiro diiwaangelinta. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa intaas ku daray in ololaha doorashada labada aqal ee Baarlamaanka la bilaabi doono 27-ka Febraayo 2027, iyadoo muddada ololuhu ay socon doonto 45 maalmood ka hor maalinta doorashada. Dhanka kale, liiska kama dambaysta ah ee codbixiyeyaasha ayaa la soo saari doonaa 15-ka Maarso 2027, kaddib marka guddigu sixitaan iyo dib-u-eegis ku sameeyo liiska kumeel-gaarka ah. Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa sheegay in jadwalkan loo dejiyay si waafaqsan Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, isagoo xusay in hawlaha doorashooyinka iyo xilliyada la cayimay loo fulin doono si waafaqsan shuruucda iyo xeerarka dalka.

items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo shaacisay howlgallo lagu soo celinayo amniga Buurhakaba
items.description: MUQDISHO (Goobjoog News) — Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa shaaciyay in ay socdaan howlgallo lagu soo celinayo amniga iyo kala dambeynta degmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Bay, kaddib markii ay gudaha u galeen ciidamo taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee maamulkaas, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen. Afhayeen u hadlay maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sheegay in howlgallada ay iska kaashanayaan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isaga oo adkeeyay in aan la aqbali doonin kooxo uu ku eedeeyay inay la shaqeeyaan Al-Shabaab oo khatar ku ah amniga iyo kala dambeynta degmada Buurhakaba. Wararka laga helayo degmada ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen ay gudaha u galeen magaalada kaddib dagaal ay la galeen ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo kuwa maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Warbaahinta qaar ayaa ku warrantay in ciidamadaasi ay sheegteen inay la wareegeen degmada, inkasta oo xaaladda amni ee goobaha qaarkood ay weli u baahan tahay xaqiijin dheeraad ah. Xiisaddan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo kan militari ee u dhexeeya taageerayaasha Laftagareen iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ee uu hoggaamiyo Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe). Ilaa hadda, faahfaahin rasmi ah lagama hayo khasaaraha ka dhashay dagaallada iyo natiijada howlgallada uu maamulka Koonfur Galbeed sheegay inuu ka wado degmada.

items.title: Yaa ka Dambeeyay Dilka Madaxweyne Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke?
items.description: Dilkii Madaxweyne Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke, oo ahaa madaxweynihii labaad ee Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya, ayaa ka mid ah dhacdooyinkii ugu waaweynaa ee taariikhda siyaasadeed ee dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa la dilay 15-kii Oktoobar 1969-kii, xilli uu booqasho ku joogay magaalada Laascaanood, waxaana dhacdadaasi ay Soomaaliya gelisay xaalad siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah, iyadoo lix maalmood kaddib uu dhacay afgambigii milatariga ee talada dalka ku qabsaday. Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke ayaa xilka madaxweynaha hayay tan iyo sannadkii 1967-kii, kaddib markii loo doortay inuu hoggaamiyo dalka. Ka hor intii aanu madaxweyne noqon, wuxuu soo noqday ra’iisul wasaarihii ugu horreeyay ee Soomaaliya kaddib xornimadii 1960-kii, isaga oo xilkaas hayay intii u dhexeysay 1960-kii iyo 1964-kii. Maalintii la dilayay, Sharmaarke wuxuu ku sugnaa magaalada Laascaanood, halkaas oo uu booqasho ku marayay deegaanno ay abaaro saameeyeen. Sida ay sheegayaan waaya-jooggii xilligaas iyo qoraallo taariikheed, waxaa madaxweynaha rasaas ku furay nin lagu magacaabi jiray Siciid Yuusuf Ismaaciil, oo loo yaqaanay Siciid Orfano, kaas oo markii dambe la toogtay. Ninkan ayaa si weyn loogu aqoonsaday inuu ahaa qofkii toogashada geystay, waxaana sidoo dhacdadaas loo xiray dhowr eedaysane oo lala xariiriyay inay falkaas kaalin ku lahaayeen. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, aqoonsiga ninka toogashada geystay kama jawaabin dhammaan su’aalihii ka dhashay dilka, gaar ahaan cidda amartay, sababta dhabta ah ee keentay iyo in ay jireen dad kale oo ka qayb qaatay qorsheynta falka. Muddo dheer ka dib, dilka madaxweynaha waxaa lala xariiriyay khilaafaad siyaasadeed iyo arrimo qabiil, balse daraasado taariikheed oo dambe ayaa dib u eegis ku sameeyay aragtiyahaas. Daraasad uu sannadkii 2017-kii daabacay taariikhyahan Maxamed Xaaji Ingiriis ayaa falanqaysay dukumentiyo iyo qoraallo taariikheed oo la xiriira dilka, iyadoo su’aalo ka keentay fasiraadihii hore ee dhacdada. Daraasaddu waxay eegaysay suurtagalnimada in dilku lahaa dhinacyo siyaasadeed oo ka ballaaran khilaaf shakhsi ama mid qabiil, iyo in ay jireen dad kale oo laga yaabo inay ku lug lahaayeen diyaarinta falka. Dilkii Sharmaarke ayaa dhacay xilli Soomaaliya ay ka jireen loollan siyaasadeed iyo khilaafaad la xiriiray maamulka dalka, waxaana xaaladdaasi ay sii murugtay markii 21-kii Oktoobar 1969-kii, lix maalmood kaddib dilka madaxweynaha, oo ay ciidanka milatarigu talada dalka la wareegeen. Afgambiga waxaa hoggaaminayay Jeneraal Maxamed Siyaad Barre, waxaana la kala diray baarlamaanka, halka la hakiyay dastuurkii iyo nidaamkii dowladeed ee rayidka ahaa. Isku soo beeganka dilka madaxweynaha iyo afgambiga milatariga ayaa sabab u noqday in taariikhyahanno ay sii baaraan xiriirka suuragalka ah ee ka dhexeeyay labada dhacdo. Si kastaba, xaqiiqda ah in afgambigu dhacay lix maalmood kaddib dilka madaxweynaha kaligeed ma caddaynayso in labada dhacdo ay qayb ka ahaayeen hal qorshe. Qoraallo taariikheed ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in ninka loo aqoonsaday inuu toogtay madaxweynaha markii dambe la dilay 10-kii Febraayo 1971-kii, hase yeeshee, tallaabadaasi ma aysan soo afjarin doodaha ku saabsan cidda qorshaysay dilka iyo sababihii siyaasadeed ee ka dambeeyay. Dilkii Madaxweyne Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke wuxuu noqday dhacdo si weyn u saamaysay taariikhda Soomaaliya, maadaama uu dhacay xilli xasaasi ah, isla markaana uu ka horreeyay isbeddelkii weynaa ee nidaamka dowladeed ee dalka. Inkasta oo magaca ninka toogashada geystay si weyn loo yaqaan, haddana su’aalaha ku saabsan cidda amartay dilka iyo sababaha dhabta ah weli waxay u baahan yihiin in lagu qiimeeyo dukumentiyada iyo daraasadaha taariikhiga ah.

items.title: Mareykanka oo Abiy Ahmed gaarsiiyey digniin culus oo ku saabsan dagaalka Eritrea
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa uga digtay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Ahmed, wax kasta oo horseedi kara xad-gudub ama duullaan ka tallaaba xuduudaha, xilli ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya ay si xawli ah ugu siqayaan xadka Eritrea, arrintaas oo sare u qaadday cabsida laga qabo in dagaal cusub uu ka qarxo Geeska Afrika. Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka, Marco Rubio, oo khadka taleefanka kula hadlay Abiy Ahmed Arbacadii shalay, ayaa ku baaqay in dhinacyada oo dhan ay xaaladda dejiyaan, isagoo adkeeyay in dalalka gobolka looga baahan yahay inay xurmeeyaan madaxbannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee deriskooda. War-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka ayaa lagu yiri: “Xoghayuhu waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyay in gobolku uusan marnaba qaadi karin colaad hor leh.” Washington waxay labada dal ee Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ku boorisay inay khilaafkooda ku xalliyaan miiska wada-hadalka, iyadoo tusaale u soo qaadatay heshiiskii nabadeed ee 2018-kii, kaas oo soo afjaray labaatan sano oo cadowtooyo iyo colaad ahayd. Dhinaca kale, qoraalka uu Abiy Ahmed kaga hadlay wadahadalka labada mas’uul ayaa diiradda saaray xoojinta xiriirka labada dal. Abiy wuxuu wadahadalka ku tilmaamay mid “midho-dhal weyn leh,” isagoo soo dhoweeyay fursadaha iskaashi istiraatiijiyadeed oo dhex mara Addis Ababa iyo Washington. “Waxaan soo dhoweynayaa xaqiijinta taageerada joogtada ah ee Mareykanka uu siiyo Itoobiya iyo ballan-qaadkeenna wadajirka ah ee lagu horumarinayo iskaashiga labada geesoodka ah iyo wax ka qabashada mudnaanta gobolka iyo arrimaha caalamiga ah,” ayuu Abiy ku daabacay bartiisa X. Qoraalka Abiy kuma jirin wax xusid ah oo ku saabsan xaaladda Eritrea ama baaqii Mareykanka ee ahaa in xiisadda la qaboojiyo, halka bayaanka Mareykankuna uusan faahfaahin ka bixin nooca taageerada uu Abiy sheegay in loo xaqiijiyay. Ciidamada Itoobiya oo gaaray xadka Wadahadalladan diblomaasiyadeed ayaa ku soo beegmay xilli wararku sheegayaan in ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya ay gaareen magaalada muhiimka ah ee Zalambessa, oo ku taalla xadka Eritrea, horeyna ay u maamulayeen xoogagga Tigrayga. Wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada dowladda ay gaareen magaaladaas, iyadoo soo xiganaysa ilo-wareedyo ay ka mid yihiin dadka deegaanka, diblomaasiyiin iyo khubaro dhanka amniga ah. Goobjoogayaal ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyay in ciidamada Eritrea ay toddobaadkii hore gudaha u galeen Zalambessa si ay u taageeraan kooxaha mucaaradka ah, inkastoo aan la hubin inay weli ku sugan yihiin xilligii ay ciidamada Itoobiya halkaas tageen. Tallaabadan ayaa timid kaddib guluf rogaal-celis ah oo ay qaadeen ciidamada dowladda, kaas oo lagu qasbay dagaalyahannada TPLF inay isaga baxaan magaalooyin dhowr ah oo waqooyiga ku yaalla, oo ay ku jirto caasimadda gobolka ee Mekelle. Dagaalka ayaa dib u qarxay 23-kii Sebtembar, kaddib weerar ay soo qaadeen isbahaysi mucaarad ah oo TPLF hoggaaminayso, taasoo khatar gelisay heshiiskii Pretoria ee 2022. Dacwadda QM iyo xiriirka la jaray Addis Ababa ayaa ku eedeysay Eritrea inay ciidamo gaaraya ilaa 60 kiilomitir (37 mayl) soo gelisay gudaha dhulkeeda, isla markaana ay taageerto kooxo hubeysan oo doonaya inay xukunka ka tuuraan xukuumadda Abiy Ahmed, eedeymahaas oo ay Asmara si adag u beenisay. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Itoobiya, Gedion Timothewos, oo warqad u diray Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay 9-kii bishan Oktoobar, ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu xaq u leeyahay inuu is-difaaco, isagoo Asmara ku eedeeyay gardarro iyo faragelin toos ah. Eritrea ayaa gebi ahaanba diiday eedeymahaas, waxayna Golaha Ammaanka ka codsatay in tallaabo degdeg ah laga qaado Itoobiya, iyadoo ku eedeysay inay isu diyaarinayso weerar gardarro ah iyadoo marmarsiinyo ka dhiganaysa “is-difaac.” Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Eritrea, Cismaan Saalax, ayaa dalbaday in Itoobiya lagu dabaqo tallaabooyinka Qodobka 7-aad (Chapter VII) ee Axdiga QM, kaas oo awood u siinaya golaha inuu soo rogo cunaqabatayn iyo tallaabooyin ciidan. Xiisaddan ayaa ka dambeysay burburkii xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee labada dal 1-dii October, markaas oo Eritrea ay xiriirka u jartay Itoobiya, kadib markii Addis Ababa ay dalkeeda ka eriday 10 diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah, isla markaana ay xirtay safaaraddeedii Asmara. Khilaafka Badda Cas iyo xiriirkii burburay Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa mar kale ku dhow inay isku dhacaan, inkastoo ay dhowr sano ka hor ahaayeen xulafo militari oo ka wada dagaallamayay waqooyiga Itoobiya. Labada dal ayaa dagaal dhiig badan ku daatay dhexmaray intii u dhexeysay 1998 iyo 2000, ka hor inta aysan Abiy Ahmed iyo Madaxweynaha Eritrea, Isaias Afwerki, heshiis nabadeed saxiixin 2018-kii. Kadib heshiiska, labada dal ayaa iska kaashaday dagaalkii ka dhanka ahaa TPLF ee socday intii u dhexeysay 2020 iyo 2022. Hase yeeshee, xiriirkooda ayaa xumaaday kadib heshiiskii Pretoria, oo Eritrea aysan qeyb ka ahayn, waxaana khilaafka sii huriyay dadaallada Itoobiya ay ku dooneyso marin ay ku gaarto Badda Cas. Abiy Ahmed ayaa marar badan ku tilmaamay helitaanka marin badeed arrin muhiim u ah horumarka dhaqaalaha Itoobiya, inkastoo uu ku adkeysto in dowladdiisu ay dooneyso xal nabadeed oo lagu gaaro wadahadal. Soomaaliya ayaa markii dambe ku dhawaaqday inay dhexdhexaad ka tahay xiisadda Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, iyadoo ku adkeysatay inay dooneyso xiriir nabadeed oo ay la yeelato dhammaan dalalka ay arrintu khuseyso, inkastoo ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga amni ee ay la leedahay Qaahira iyo Asmara. Digniinta Mareykanka ayaa imaneysa xilli dagaalladu ay weli ka socdaan waqooyiga Itoobiya, isla markaana aysan muuqan dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu guuleystay in lagu dejiyo xiisadda labada dal. Xaaladda ayaa sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo in colaadda gudaha Itoobiya ay isu beddesho dagaal toos ah oo dhex mara Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, kaas oo saameyn ballaaran ku yeelan kara amniga iyo xasilloonida guud ahaan Geeska Afrika.
