items.fullContent: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa uga digtay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Ahmed, wax kasta oo horseedi kara xad-gudub ama duullaan ka tallaaba xuduudaha, xilli ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya ay si xawli ah ugu siqayaan xadka Eritrea, arrintaas oo sare u qaadday cabsida laga qabo in dagaal cusub uu ka qarxo Geeska Afrika. Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka, Marco Rubio, oo khadka taleefanka kula hadlay Abiy Ahmed Arbacadii shalay, ayaa ku baaqay in dhinacyada oo dhan ay xaaladda dejiyaan, isagoo adkeeyay in dalalka gobolka looga baahan yahay inay xurmeeyaan madaxbannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee deriskooda. War-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka ayaa lagu yiri: “Xoghayuhu waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyay in gobolku uusan marnaba qaadi karin colaad hor leh.” Washington waxay labada dal ee Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ku boorisay inay khilaafkooda ku xalliyaan miiska wada-hadalka, iyadoo tusaale u soo qaadatay heshiiskii nabadeed ee 2018-kii, kaas oo soo afjaray labaatan sano oo cadowtooyo iyo colaad ahayd. Dhinaca kale, qoraalka uu Abiy Ahmed kaga hadlay wadahadalka labada mas’uul ayaa diiradda saaray xoojinta xiriirka labada dal. Abiy wuxuu wadahadalka ku tilmaamay mid “midho-dhal weyn leh,” isagoo soo dhoweeyay fursadaha iskaashi istiraatiijiyadeed oo dhex mara Addis Ababa iyo Washington. “Waxaan soo dhoweynayaa xaqiijinta taageerada joogtada ah ee Mareykanka uu siiyo Itoobiya iyo ballan-qaadkeenna wadajirka ah ee lagu horumarinayo iskaashiga labada geesoodka ah iyo wax ka qabashada mudnaanta gobolka iyo arrimaha caalamiga ah,” ayuu Abiy ku daabacay bartiisa X. items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Qaramada Midoobay oo ka Wada hadlay Wejiga ugu Dambeeya ee Kala-guurka UNTMIS
items.description: Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cali Maxamed Cumar, ayaa Muqdisho kula kulmay wafdi ka socda Qaramada Midoobay oo uu hoggaaminayay mas’uulka ku-meel-gaarka ah ee hawlgalka UNTMIS, Raisedon Zenenga. Kulanka oo dhacay 14-kii Oktoobar 2026 ayaa diiradda lagu saaray wejiga ugu dambeeya ee kala-guurka hawlgalka Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee siyaasadda iyo amniga, iyo sidii xil-wareejinta loo qorsheynayo ay u xoojin lahayd hay’adaha dowladda Soomaaliya. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay muhiimadda ay leedahay ilaalinta guulaha laga gaaray nabad-dhisidda iyo dowlad-dhiska, si loo xaqiijiyo in isbeddelka hawlgalka Qaramada Midoobay uusan wiiqin horumarka laga sameeyay dalka. Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa mar kale xaqiijiyay sida ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay in geeddi-socodka kala-guurka uu noqdo mid ay Soomaalidu hoggaaminayso, isla markaana ay hay’adaha dalka si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadaha ku habboon. Cali Maxamed Cumar ayaa sidoo kale uga mahadceliyay Qaramada Midoobay wada-shaqeynta muddada dheer ay la lahayd Soomaaliya iyo taageerada ay ka geysatay dadaallada nabad-dhisidda iyo dowlad-dhiska. Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah wada-shaqeynta u dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Qaramada Midoobay, xilli la wajahayo wejiga ugu dambeeya ee kala-guurka hawlgalka UNTMIS iyo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo awoodda hay’adaha qaranka.

items.title: Maamulka Trump oo wada qorshe dhalashada Mareykanka looga qaadayo Ilhaan Cumar
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa wada baaritaan uu doonayo inuu ku dhiso dacwad dhalashada Mareykanka looga qaadayo xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar, si ugu dambeyn dalka looga masaafuriyo, sida uu Arbacadii shaaciyey wargeyska The Wall Street Journal. Baaritaanka ayaa salka ku haya eedeymo la xiriira in Ilhaan Cumar ama aabaheed oo geeriyooday ay macluumaad aan sax ahayn ku qoreen dukumentiyada socdaalka tobannaan sano ka hor, gaar ahaan da’deedii xilligii ay qaadaneysay dhalashada Mareykanka sanadkii 2000. Wargeyska The Wall Street Journal , oo soo xigtay saraakiil Mareykan ah iyo dad xog-ogaal u ah baaritaanka, ayaa sheegay in hay’adaha dowladda ay si gaar ah u baarayaan qaabkii Ilhaan ku heshay dhalashada Mareykanka, kaddib markii ay dalkaas qaxooti ahaan ku tagtay sanadkii 1995. Ilhaan Cumar, oo 44 jir ah, ayaa marar badan beenisay eedeymaha la xiriira khiyaano dhanka socdaalka ah, iyadoo ku tilmaantay weerarro siyaasadeed oo uu gadaal ka riixayo madaxweyne Trump. Ilaa hadda wax dacwad dambiyeed ah laguma soo oogin xildhibaannadda, sidoo kalena hay’adaha baaritaanka ma soo bandhigin caddeymo dadweyne oo muujinaya inay dembi gashay. Warbixintan cusub ayaa timid laba maalmood kaddib markii ciidamada federaalka Mareykanka ay baaritaan ku sameeyeen guriga Ilhaan Cumar ay ku leedahay magaalada Washington, halkaas oo ay Isniintii galeen saraakiil ka tirsan waaxda baarista dambiyada ee Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Kastamka Mareykanka (HSI). Saraakiisha ayaa la wareegay taleefanka gacanta ee Ilhaan, halka dacwad-oogayaasha federaalka ay soo saareen in ka badan 12 amar oo dad loogu yeerayo inay caddeymo horgeeyaan guddi xeerbeegti ah oo ku sugan gobolka Minnesota. Dadka amarradaasi lagu soo saaray waxaa ku jira xubno ka tirsan qoyska Ilhaan, sida ay sheegeen wakaaladda wararka ee Associated Press iyo wargeyska The New York Times. Sida ay CNN Arbacadii werisay, garsooraha ayaa shuruudahan soo rogay ka hor inta uusan oggolaan amarkii lagu baaray guriga xildhibaannadda, kaddib wadahadallo dhowr maalmood socday oo dhexmaray isaga iyo dacwad-oogayaasha. Wasaaradda Caddaaladda ayaa dooneysay inay hesho awood ballaaran oo ay ku baarto dokumentiyada guriga yaallay, balse garsooraha ayaa ku adkeystay in marka hore la ilaaliyo xogta uu dastuurku ka dhowrayo baaritaanka hay’adaha fulinta. Baarayaasha ayaa si gaar ah u eegaya in Ilhaan ama aabaheed, Nuur Cumar Maxamed, ay da’deeda si khaldan ugu sheegeen dokumentiyada socdaalka, taas oo saameyn ku yeelan kartay xaqii ay u lahayd inay dhalashada Mareykanka ku hesho muwaadinnimada aabaheed. Ilhaan ayaa sheegtay in qoyskeedu ka qaxay dagaalladii sokeeye ee Soomaaliya, muddo ay ku noolaayeen xero qaxooti oo ku taalla Kenya, ka hor inta aysan Mareykanka tegin sanadkii 1995. CNN ayaa intaas ku dartay in baarayaashu ay sidoo kale eegayaan xog ku qoran dukumentiyo ay dowladda u gudbisay sanadihii dambe, iyo in eedeymahaasi saldhig u noqon karaan dacwad ballaaran oo la xiriirta falal la tuhunsan yahay inay dad kale ku lug lahaayeen. Baaritaanno hore oo lagu sameeyey taariikhda socdaalka Ilhaan, xilligii madaxweyne Joe Biden, ma aysan horseedin wax dacwad ah. Xitaa haddii maxkamad ay go’aamiso in Ilhaan laga qaado dhalashada, taasi si toos ah uma horseedeyso masaafurin, waxaana loo baahan doonaa tallaabooyin sharci oo dheeraad ah. Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka, Markwayne Mullin, ayaa isaguna bishii September sheegay in Ilhaan dalka laga masaafurin karo haddii la caddeeyo inaysan markii hore xaq u lahayn inay Mareykanka joogto. “Haddii aan caddeyn karno in markii horeba aadan xaq u lahayn inaad halkan joogto, waan ku masaafurin doonnaa,” ayuu yiri Mullin. Wasaaradda Caddaaladda Mareykanka ayaa muddo dheer ku dhaqmeysay nidaam looga fogaanayo tallaabooyinka baaritaan ee si muuqata u saameyn kara musharraxiinta 60-ka maalmood ee ka horreeya doorashooyinka, inkastoo nidaamkaasi uusan ahayn mamnuucid sharci oo aan laga leexan karin. items.title: Cirro oo ku laabtay Hargeysa, kadib safarro uu ku tegay Maraykanka iyo Imaaraadka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi (Cirro), iyo wefdigii uu hoggaaminayey ayaa maanta dalka dib ugu soo laabtay, kaddib safarro shaqo oo ay ku tageen dalalka Maraykanka iyo Isu-tagga Imaaraadka Carabta. Safarradan ayaa qayb ka ahaa dedaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee uu Madaxweynaha Somaliland ku doonayo xoojinta xidhiidhka uu la leeyahay dalalka caalamka, ballaadhinta iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan iyo horumarinta danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland. Cabdiraxmaan Cirro ayaa muddadii uu maqnaa waday hawlo la xidhiidha danaha qaranka, kuwaas oo diiradda lagu saaray sidii Somaliland u xoojin lahayd xidhiidhka ay la leedahay saaxiibbada caalamiga ah, isla markaana loo abuuri lahaa fursado cusub oo taageeri kara qorshayaasha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa dhaqaale ee maamulka. Sidoo kale, booqashooyinka uu Madaxweynaha ku tegay Maraykanka iyo Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa loo arkaa qayb ka mid ah dadaallada lagu ballaadhinayo wada-shaqaynta caalamiga ah, iyadoo la eegayo muhiimadda ay dalalkaasi u leeyihiin dhinacyada diblomaasiyadda, ganacsiga, maalgashiga iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale. Dhanka kale, safarrada noocan oo kale ah ayay Somaliland u aragtaa fursad ay ku soo bandhigto aragtideeda siyaasadeed, qorshayaasheeda horumarineed iyo danaha ay ka leedahay gobolka Geeska Afrika, iyadoo doonaysa inay xoojiso xidhiidhka ay la leedahay dalalka iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah. Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa haatan la filayaa inuu sii wado hawlaha shaqo ee madaxtooyada, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo hirgelinta qorshayaasha maamulka iyo horumarinta danaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Si kastaba, Safarradan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Somaliland ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo xidhiidhka ay la leedahay beesha caalamka, isla markaana ay raadineyso fursado cusub oo ay ku horumariso iskaashiga dhinacyada siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha iyo maalgashiga. items.title: Somalia: Laftagareen-Aligned Forces Reportedly Seize Control of Burhakaba
items.description: Forces aligned with former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen reportedly seized control of the strategic town of Burhakaba on Thursday morning following fierce clashes with forces supporting the regional administration, according to residents and local sources.

items.title: Somalia and UN Discuss Final Phase of UNTMIS Transition
items.description: Somalia’s State Minister for Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Ali Mohamed Omar, met with a United Nations delegation led by Raisedon Zenenga, Officer-in-Charge of the UN Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS), on October 14, 2026, to discuss the final phase of the mission’s transition.

items.title: Somaliland Supporters Rally in Hargeisa After Trump Comments
items.description: Hundreds of people gathered in Somaliland’s capital, Hargeisa, on Wednesday, waving United States and Somaliland flags in celebration after US President Donald Trump described Somaliland as “a totally different country” from Somalia.

items.title: Dagaal u dhexeeya ciidamada DF iyo kuwa Lafta-gareen oo ka qarxay degmada Buurhakaba
items.description: Buurhakaba (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya gobolka Baay ayaa sheegaya in saaka dagaal u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa maamulka Koonfur galbeed oo isku dhinac iyo ciidamo taabacsan Laftagareen uu ka socda Degmada Buurhakaba ee Gobolka Baay, kaas oo la’isku adeegsanayo hubka noocyadiisa kala duwan. Dagaalka ayaa yimid, kadib markii ciidamada taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed ay weerareen fariisimo ciidan oo ku yaalla gudaha degmadaas, waxaana kadib xigay dagaal toos ah oo u dhexeeya labada dhinac. Ilo deegaanka ah ayaa innoo sheegay in xaaladda ay faraha ka baxday, isa markaana ay ku waabariisteen dhawaqa rasaas ay is-weydaarsanayaan labada dhinac. Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo ah mas’uulka warfaafinta ugu magacaaban kooxda Laftagareen oo qoraal soo saaray ayaa sheegay inay gudaha u galeen magaalada, isla markaana ay haatan ka wadaan howlgal amni xaqiijin ah, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Waxaa saaka magaalada Buurhakabo ka bilowdey howlgal amini xaqiijin ah oo ay halkaa ka wadaaan geesiyaasha ciidamada daraawiishta dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya waxaan shacbigeena sharafta leh ee degmada buur ka codsaneynaa in ay guryahooda kusugnaadaan,” ayuu yiri Ugaas Xasan. Dhanka kale ma cadda khasaaraha rasmiga ah ee ka dhashay dagaalka haatan ka scoda degmada Buurhakaba, iyadoo weli xaaladdu ay tahay mid adag. Buurhakaba oo ka tirsan gobolka Baay ayaa qiyaastii 60 KM u jirta magaalada Baydhaba, oo ah xarunta ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Koonfur Galbeed, waxaana dagaalka halkaasi ka socda uu kusoo aadayaa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha u dhexeeya Aadan Madoobe iyo Laftagareen. Dagaallada u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Laftagareen ayaa u muuqda kuwa kusii fidaya deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, waxaana ay ahayd maalmo kahor markii ay ciidamada Cabdicasiis Laftagareen ay la wareegeen degmada Qansaxdheere, kadib weerar ay ku qaadeen. Si kastaba, dagaalladan ayaa daba socda iska hor imaadyo horay uga dhacay magaalada Baydhaba oo marar kala duwan ay isku fara saareen labada dhinac, inkastoo dib loo celiyay ciidamada taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. The post Dagaal u dhexeeya ciidamada DF iyo kuwa Lafta-gareen oo ka qarxay degmada Buurhakaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia quarantines fellow traveler of Kenyan who died from Ebola
items.description: In Mogadishu, Somalia, authorities quarantined a citizen of the country who had traveled with a Kenyan who later died of Ebola in Nairobi. The man was isolated on October 11, although he did not have a positive test result for the disease.

items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo dalka ku soi laabtay
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Dr Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro iyo weftigii uu hoggaaminayey ayaa saaka dalka dib ugu soo laabtay. Madaxweynaha oo si diiran dalka loogu soi dhaweeyay ayaa ka soo lasbtay safaro guulaystay oo uu in mudo ah ugu maqnaa dalka Maraykanka iyo wadamo kaleba

items.title: Kuuriyada Waqooyi oo Tijaabisay Laba Gantaal oo Nooca Maraakiibta Quusta Laga Rido Ah
items.description: Dowladda Kuuriyada Waqooyi ayaa sheegtay inay tijaabisay laba nooc oo gantaallada istaraatiijiga ah ee nooca cruise-ka ah, kuwaas oo laga rido maraakiibta quusta, xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha milatari ee ka taagan Jasiiradda Kuuriya. Wakaaladda wararka dowladda Kuuriyada Waqooyi ee KCNA ayaa sheegtay in tijaabada, oo Arbacadii ka dhacday biyaha xeebta bari ee dalka, loogu talagalay in lagu qiimeeyo kalsoonida awoodda milatari ee ka hortagga weerarrada iyo in kor loo qaado xirfadda ciidamada badda ee fulinta hawlgallada istaraatiijiga ah. Sida ay wakaaladdu baahisay, mid ka mid ah gantaallada la tijaabiyay ayaa ahaa nooca loo yaqaan Pulhwasal-3-31, kaas oo dowladda Kuuriyada Waqooyi ay horay u sheegtay inay ka tijaabisay dhulka toddobaadkii ka horreeyay. Saraakiil sare oo ka tirsan milatariga dalkaas ayaa goob joog ka ahaa tijaabooyinka. KCNA ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in tijaabooyinku aanay wax saameyn taban ah ku yeelan ammaanka dalalka deriska la ah, inkasta oo aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin faahfaahinta ay dowladdaasi bixisay. Tijaabadan ayaa imanaysa iyadoo hoggaamiyaha Kuuriyada Waqooyi, Kim Jong Un, uu mudnaan gaar ah siinayo horumarinta awoodda milatari ee dalka, gaar ahaan gantaallada istaraatiijiga ah iyo awoodda ciidamada badda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, warbixintu waxay tilmaamaysaa in aan weli la rumaysnayn in Kuuriyada Waqooyi ay si buuxda hawlgal ugu bilowday markab quus oo casri ah oo gantaallo casri ah qaada. Toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay, Pyongyang waxay kordhisay tijaabooyinka gantaallada, ayadoo horraantii toddobaadkan, ay ridday dhowr gantaal oo ballistic ah oo ku wajahnaa badda xeebteeda bari, halka 3-dii Oktoobar ay tijaabisay gantaal nooca hypersonic-ka ah oo masaafo dhexe gaari kara, kaas oo loogu talagalay inuu ka gudbo nidaamyada difaaca gantaallada. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa imanaya iyadoo xiriirka Kuuriyada Waqooyi iyo Kuuriyada Koonfureed uu sii xumaanayo. Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaa iyaduna dhawaan tijaabisay hub nooca hypersonic-ka ah, iyadoo madaxdeedu sheegeen in hubkaasi mustaqbalka kor u qaadi karo awoodda dalka ee weerarrada degdegga ah ee ka dhanka ah bartilmaameedyada muhiimka ah. Xiisadaha labada dal ayaa sidoo kale sii kordhay kaddib markii qarax miino dhulka lagu aaso uu dhaawacay saddex askari oo Kuuriyada Koonfureed ah bishii Sebtembar, gudaha aagga milatari ahaan kala qaybiya labada dal. Baaritaan ay sameeyeen Kuuriyada Koonfureed iyo Qaramada Midoobay ayaa lagu sheegay in miinooyinka qarxay ay ciidamo Kuuriyada Waqooyi ahi dhigeen qiyaastii sannad ka hor, eedeymahaas oo Pyongyang aanay halkan lagu soo xigtay si madax-bannaan uga jawaabin. Dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu dejin lahaa xiisadda Jasiiradda Kuuriya ayaa hakad galay tan iyo markii ay burbureen wada-hadalladii Washington iyo Pyongyang ee ku saabsanaa hub-ka-dhigista nukliyeerka sannadkii 2019-kii. Tijaabooyinka cusub ayaa muujinaya sida labada Kuuriya ay u sii horumarinayaan awooddooda milatari, taas oo sii adkaynaysa dadaallada lagu yareynayo xiisadaha iyo dib loogu bilaabayo wada-hadallada nabadeed ee gobolka.

items.title: Laba markab oo ku degay Marinka Hormuz, xilli Iiraan ay sii xoojisay weerarada
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Laba markab oo xamuul ah ayaa ku degay gudaha iyo agagaarka marinka istaraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz 24-kii saac ee lasoo dhaafay, kaddib markii ay waxyeello kasoo gaartay weerarro kala duwan, sida ay Arbacadii sheegeen mas’uuliyiinta iyo ilo ka tirsan hay’adaha ammaanka badaha. Dhacdooyinkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo tobankii maalmood ee lasoo dhaafay ay si weyn u kordheen weerarrada ka dhacaya marinkan, iyadoo Iran ay sheegtay inay xoojisay weerarradeeda, si ay uga jawaabto go’doominta Mareykanka uu ku hayo dekedaheeda iyo cunaqabateyntii dhaqaale ee la adkeeyay bishii hore. Markabka GFS Pride, oo sitay calanka Singapore, isla markaana qaadi kara 2,824 konteenar oo cabbirkoodu yahay 20 fiit, ayaa degay xilli uu marayay marinka Hormuz, sida ay xaqiijiyeen ilo dhinaca ammaanka badda ah. Hay’adda Maamulka Badaha iyo Dekedaha Singapore (MPA) ayaa sheegtay in markabka, oo marinka marayay Talaadadii, uu dab qabsaday kaddib markii la weeraray, taasoo ugu dambeyn sababtay inuu dego. “Markabka GFS Pride waxaa soo gaaray burbur, waxaana ka kacay dab, kaddibna wuu degay. Dhammaan 21-kii shaqaale ee saarnaa si nabad ah ayaa looga daadgureeyay, mana jiraan wax dhaawacyo ah oo la soo sheegay,” ayay hay’addu ku sheegtay war-saxaafadeed. Dhanka kale, markabka Cape Dao, oo sitay calanka Antigua iyo Barbuda, ayaa isna ku degay meel u dhow marinka Hormuz, toddobaadyo kaddib markii uu weerar la kulmay 23-kii September, sida lagu sheegay xog ay Arbacadii soo saartay Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Badaha ee Qaramada Midoobay (IMO). Hal qof oo ka tirsanaa shaqaalaha markabkaas ayaa ku dhintay weerarkii hore, halka shaqaalihii kale la daadgureeyay isla markii uu weerarku dhacay, sida ay sheegeen ilo dhinaca badaha ah. Labadan markab ayaa noqonaya kii labaad iyo kii saddexaad ee dega tan iyo markii uu 28-kii February billowday dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Iran, sida lagu ogaaday falanqayn lagu sameeyay xogta IMO. Hay’adda badaha Singapore ayaa walaac xooggan ka muujisay weerarrada sii kordhaya ee lagu beegsanayo maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraya Hormuz, iyadoo ku tilmaantay kuwo aan sabab loo hayn, aan cudurdaar lahayn, isla markaana jebinaya sharciga caalamiga ah. Shirkadda MARISKS, oo ku takhasustay qiimeynta khataraha badaha, ayaa sidoo kale ka digtay in dhacdooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ay muujinayaan khatarta joogtada ah ee soo wajahday maraakiibta ganacsiga. “Khatarteedu kuma koobna maraakiibta shidaalka qaada, balse maraakiibta konteenarrada iyo kuwa xamuulka kale qaada ayaa sidoo kale la kulmaya burbur xooggan,” ayay shirkaddu sheegtay. Iran oo adkeysay gacan-ku-haynta Hormuz Marinka Hormuz, oo ka mid ah marinnada ganacsiga ugu muhiimsan dunida, ayaa waxaa mari jiray qiyaastii shan meelood meel ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee shidaalka iyo gaaska dabiiciga ah ee dareeraha ah, ka hor inta uusan dagaalku qarxin. Tan iyo markii Mareykanka iyo Israel ay weerarrada ku qaadeen Iran 28-kii February, Tehran ayaa isku dayaysay inay adkeyso gacan-ku-haynteeda marinkan, iyadoo xaddidaysa isu socodka maraakiibta si ay cadaadis ugu saarto Washington. Laba mas’uul oo sare oo Iranian ah ayaa wakaaladda Reuters u sheegay in Tehran ay bilowday adeegsiga xeelado cusub oo lagu bartilmaameedsanayo maraakiibta maraysa Hormuz, iyadoo doonaysa inay sare u hayso qiimaha shidaalka, isla markaana saameyn ku yeelato doorashooyinka dhexe ee Mareykanka ee dhacaya bisha November. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in xeeladahan cusub ay qeyb ka yihiin dadaallada Iran ee ay ku doonayso inay ku kordhiso cadaadiska dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed ee saaran Mareykanka. Inkasta oo weerarrada labada dhinac ay inta badan diiradda saareen maraakiibta shidaalka, haddana waxaa sii kordhaya maraakiibta xamuulka iyo konteenarrada ee la weerarayo, kuwaas oo qaarkood la curyaamiyay ama gebi ahaanba degay. Bishii March, markabka Safeen Prestige, oo sitay calanka Malta, ayaa la weeraray, waxaana uu markii dambe ku degay waqooyiga marinka Hormuz. Sidoo kale, bishii April, ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ayaa weeraray oo gacanta ku dhigay markabka konteenarrada qaada ee MSC Francesca. Weerarradan is-daba jooga ah ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo ammaanka marinka Hormuz, iyadoo khatarta ku wajahan maraakiibta ganacsiga ay sii adkeynayso dadaallada lagu doonayo in dib loogu soo celiyo isu socodka caadiga ah ee mid ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga iyo tamarta adduunka. The post Laba markab oo ku degay Marinka Hormuz, xilli Iiraan ay sii xoojisay weerarada appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Tan iyo markii Mareykanka iyo Israel ay weerarrada ku qaadeen Iran 28-kii February, Tehran ayaa isku dayaysay inay adkeyso gacan-ku-haynteeda marinkan, iyadoo xaddidaysa isu socodka maraakiibta si ay cadaadis ugu saarto Washington. Laba mas’uul oo sare oo Iranian ah ayaa wakaaladda Reuters u sheegay in Tehran ay bilowday adeegsiga xeelado cusub oo lagu bartilmaameedsanayo maraakiibta maraysa Hormuz, iyadoo doonaysa inay sare u hayso qiimaha shidaalka, isla markaana saameyn ku yeelato doorashooyinka dhexe ee Mareykanka ee dhacaya bisha November. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in xeeladahan cusub ay qeyb ka yihiin dadaallada Iran ee ay ku doonayso inay ku kordhiso cadaadiska dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed ee saaran Mareykanka. Inkasta oo weerarrada labada dhinac ay inta badan diiradda saareen maraakiibta shidaalka, haddana waxaa sii kordhaya maraakiibta xamuulka iyo konteenarrada ee la weerarayo, kuwaas oo qaarkood la curyaamiyay ama gebi ahaanba degay. Bishii March, markabka Safeen Prestige, oo sitay calanka Malta, ayaa la weeraray, waxaana uu markii dambe ku degay waqooyiga marinka Hormuz. Sidoo kale, bishii April, ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ayaa weeraray oo gacanta ku dhigay markabka konteenarrada qaada ee MSC Francesca. Weerarradan is-daba jooga ah ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo ammaanka marinka Hormuz, iyadoo khatarta ku wajahan maraakiibta ganacsiga ay sii adkeynayso dadaallada lagu doonayo in dib loogu soo celiyo isu socodka caadiga ah ee mid ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga iyo tamarta adduunka. The post Laba markab oo ku degay Marinka Hormuz, xilli Iiraan ay sii xoojisay weerarada appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen oo weerar ku ekeeyay Degmada Buurhakaba
items.description: Ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa saaka weerar ku galay Degmada Buurhakaba ee Gobolka Baay. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ee ku sugan degmadaasi ayaa iska caabin kala hortagey ciidamadaasi oo gudaha u soo galay magaalada. Dadka deegaanka ayaa soo sheegaya in labada dhinac ay dagaalka isku adeegsanayaan hubka noocyadiisa kala duwan, isla-markaana ciidamada soo duulay ay u muuqdaan kuwo xoogan. Afhayeenkii hore ee Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed, Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed ayaa sheegay in Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ay hawlgal ka bilaabeen Degmada Buurhakaba. “Waxay saaka Ciidamada Daraawiishta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya hawlgal ka bilaabeen Degmada Buurhakaba, sidii loo soo celin lahaa amnigii iyo kala dambayntii Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenkii hore ee Maamulkii Cabdicasiis Laftagareen. Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed ayaa shacabka ugu baaqay “Shacbigeenna sharafta leh ee reer Buurhakaba, waxaan leeyahay inta ay ciidamada geesiyaasha ah ee Daraawiishta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ay amniga iyo kala dambaynta degmadaasi dib ugu soo celinayaan inay guryahooda ku sugnaadaan.” Ugaas Xasan Cabdi ayaa muuqaal uu soo duubay ku sheegay “Waxaan mar labaad iyo mar saddexaad u xaqiijinaynaa shacbigeenna in Degmada Buurhakaba saaka Ciidamada Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya ay ka bilaabeen hawlgal aad u ballaaran oo lagu soo celinayo kala dambayntii iyo sharaftii dowladnimada Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya.” Weerarkan ayaa noqonaya kiisii ugu horreyay ee ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen ay ku qaadaan Degmada Buurhakaba. Ciidamada Laftagareen ayaa toddobaadkii hore bilaa dagaal kula wareegay gacan ku haynta Degmada Qansaxdheere ee Gobolka Baay. Laftagareen oo ku adkeysanaya in uu weli yahay Madaxweynaha sharciga ah ee Koonfur Galbeed ayaa loolan dhanka awoodda maamulka kula jira maamulka cusub ee Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu hoggaamiyo.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo Ka Qaybgalay Xuska 9 Sano Guuradii Ka soo Wareegtay Qaraxii Soobe
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa ka qaybgalay munaasabad lagu xusayay dadkii Soomaaliyeed ee ku naf waayay qaraxii 14-kii Oktoobar 2017 ka dhacay Isgoyska Soobe ee magaalada Muqdisho. Munaasabadda ayaa lagu xusuustay dadkii ku dhintay iyo kuwii ku dhaawacmay qaraxii oo ay mas’uuliyiintu ku tilmaameen weerar argagixiso oo ay Khawaarijtu ka geysteen goobtaasi, kaas oo sababay khasaare naf iyo maalba leh. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa sheegay in 14-ka Oktoobar ay tahay maalin murugo iyo tiiraanyo ku reebtay shacabka Soomaaliyeed, xusuusteeduna aanay ka go’i doonin quluubta dadka Soomaaliyeed. Waxa uu xusay in qaraxaasi uu ahaa dhacdo naxdin leh oo lagu laayay boqollaal muwaadiniin ah oo aan waxba galabsan. Guddoomiye Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa sidoo kale Alle uga baryay dadkii ku dhintay qaraxaasi inuu naxariistiisa Janno ka waraabiyo, eheladoodana uu ka siiyo samir iyo iimaan. Xuskan ayaa qayb ka ah munaasabadaha loogu ducaynayo dadkii ku waxyeelloobay qaraxii Soobe, islamarkaana lagu xusuusanayo dhibaatadii uu dalka u geystay iyo xanuunka ay weli la nool yihiin qoysaskii ay musiibadu saamaysay.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Shir Guddoomisay Kulammo kamid ah Shirweynaha WHO ee Qaahira
items.description: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Dr. Cali Xaaji Aadan Abuubakar, ayaa guddoomiyay kulammo muhiim ah oo ka tirsan shirweynaha 73-aad ee Guddiga Gobolka Bariga Mediterranean-ka ee Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO), kaas oo ka socda magaalada Qaahira ee dalka Masar. Guddoominta kulammadan ayaa muujinaysa ka-qaybgalka Soomaaliya ee geeddi-socodka go’aan-qaadashada iyo dejinta siyaasadaha caafimaadka ee heer gobol, iyadoo dowladda Soomaaliya ay dadaal ugu jirto xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay hay’adaha caafimaadka caalamiga ah. Shirkan oo ay sannad kasta isugu yimaadaan wakiillada 22-ka dal ee xubnaha ka ah Gobolka Bariga Mediterranean-ka ee WHO ayaa diiradda lagu saaraa arrimaha mudnaanta u leh caafimaadka bulshada, caqabadaha ka jira nidaamyada caafimaadka iyo dejinta istaraatiijiyado lagu horumarinayo adeegyada caafimaadka ee dalalka gobolka. Kulammada waxaa sidoo kale lagu falanqeeyaa siyaasadaha iyo go’aannada lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga caafimaadka, si wax looga qabto baahiyaha caafimaad ee malaayiin qof oo ku nool dalalka xubnaha ka ah gobolka. Ka-qaybgalka iyo guddoominta kulammada uu wasiirku hoggaaminayo ayaa Soomaaliya siinaya fursad ay kaga qayb qaadato doodaha iyo go’aannada saameeya jihada siyaasadaha caafimaadka gobolka, isla markaana ay ku soo bandhigto mudnaanta iyo baahiyaha nidaamkeeda caafimaad. Soomaaliya ayaa muddadii u dambeysay dadaal ugu jirtay xoojinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee dhinaca caafimaadka, gaar ahaan horumarinta adeegyada caafimaadka, dhismaha awoodda hay’adaha caafimaadka iyo helitaanka taageero wax looga qabanayo caqabadaha ka jira dalka. Shirweynaha 73-aad ee Guddiga Gobolka Bariga Mediterranean-ka ee WHO ayaa qayb ka ah kulammada joogtada ah ee lagu dejiyo jihada iyo mudnaanta caafimaadka gobolka, iyadoo go’aannada ka soo baxa ay muhiim u yihiin isku-duwidda dadaallada caafimaadka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya dalalka xubnaha ka ah hay’adda.

items.description: Somalia’s Junior Stars eliminated Kenya from the CAF Under-17 Africa Cup of Nations CECAFA qualifiers after securing a 2-0 victory at Kigali Pele Stadium on Wednesday.

items.title: Shabaab oo culeys saaraya Magaalada Matabaan
items.description: Maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ayaa u muuqdo kuwo sii kordhinaya culeyska ay saarayaan deegaanada hoostaga Magaalada Matabaan ee Gobolka Hiiraan, ka dib markii Jimcihii ay dagaal kula wareegeen gacan ku haynta deegaanka Hees oo hoostaga magaaladaasi. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo Sabtidii qaaday guluf ay dib ugu la wareegayaan Hees ayaa ku guuldareystay in ay hawlgalka sii wadaan, taas oo Al Shabaab ka caawisay in ay isku soo fidiyaan deegaanka Madhooy oo u dhow deegaanka Coomaad, oo ah difaaca ugu weyn ee laga ilaaliyo amniga Magaalada Matabaan. Tani ayaa sidoo kale xiisad ka abuurtay deegaanada Qabno iyo Bacda oo hoostaga Matabaan, iyadoo dadka deegaanka ay kuu sheegayaan in Shabaabku ay ku sii siqayaan deegaanadaasi. Dadka deegaanku keliya kama cabsi qabaan in lagu dul dagaalamo, balse waxay sidoo kale walaac ka muujinayaan in Shabaabku ay jaraan isu socodka waddada laamiga ee xiriirisa Magaalooyinka Beledweyne iyo Matabaan. Waddada laamiga waxay muhiim u tahay isu socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka ganacsiga ee qaybo ka mid ah Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Galgaduud. Waddadan ayaa sidoo kale ah marinka ugu weyn ee saadka iyo sahayda uu u maro Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee fariisimaha ku leh deegaanada hoostaga Matabaan. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan ayaa meelaha qaar ka wada diyaargarow ay uga hortaggayaan duulaanka Al Shabaab. Xaaladda deegaanada hoostaga Matabaan ayaa ah mid kacsan, sababo la xiriira is bedelada dhanka amniga ee ka jira gobolka.

items.title: Mareykanka oo Itoobiya iyo Eritrea Ugu Baaqay Ixtiraamka Madax-bannaanida Dalalka Gobolka
items.description: Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, Marco Rubio, ayaa ku baaqay in dalalka Geeska Afrika ay ixtiraamaan madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalalka deriska ah, isla markaana ay ka fogaadaan tallaabooyinka xuduudaha looga gudbayo ee sii hurin kara colaadaha gobolka. Rubio ayaa hadalkan sheegay intii uu khadka taleefanka kula hadlayay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen arrimo la xiriira xaaladda gobolka iyo xiriirka labada dal. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta rasmiga ah ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, Rubio ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in dhammaan dalalka Geeska Afrika ay waajib ku tahay inay dhowraan madax-bannaanida iyo xuduudaha dalalka deriska la ah, waxa uuna sidoo kale ka digay in gobolka uusan u dulqaadan karin colaado hor leh. Wadahadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli ay jiraan walaacyo la xiriira xiisadaha ka dhex aloosan Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, kuwaas oo hore heshiis nabadeed u kala saxiixday sannadkii 2018-kii, kaddib muddo dheer oo ay labada dal colaad iyo is-aaminaad la’aan ka dhex jirtay. Dhankiisa, Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Axmed ayaa wada-hadalka ku tilmaamay mid miro-dhal ah, isaga oo sheegay in labada dhinac ay ka arrinsadeen qodobo muhiim ah oo khuseeya xiriirka laba geesoodka ah, arrimaha gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Abiy ayaa sidoo kale xusay in wada-hadalku muujinayo sida ay labada dal uga go’an tahay inay xiriirkooda muddada dheer jiray u beddelaan iskaashi istaraatiiji ah oo wax-ku-ool ah. Mareykanka ayaa hadalladan ku muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in khilaafaadka gobolka lagu xalliyo hab diblomaasiyadeed, iyadoo la dhowrayo madax-bannaanida dalalka iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika.

items.title: Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo Isgoyska Zoobe kaga qaybgalay xuska qaraxii 14-kii October
items.description: Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka, Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) iyo xubno uu ka mid yahay Gudoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) ayaa xalay Isgoyska Zoobe uga qaybgalay xuska boqolaalkii qof ee ku geeriyooday qaraxii 14-kii bishii October ee sanadkii 2017 ka dhacay isgoyskaasi. Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka ayaa 10-kii bishii November ee sanadkii hore ansixyay qaraar lagu dalbanayay in 14-ka October loo aqoonsado Maalin Qaran, oo la xuso dhibaneyaasha weerarada argagixisada, gaar ahaan dhibaneyaasha qaraxii 14-kii bishii October ee sanadkii 2017 ka dhacay Isgoyska Zoobe. Raysal Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre oo shalay ka hadlayay Muqdisho ayaa yiri “Maalintani waxay sanad kasta noqon doontaa maalin la xuso oo la cusbooneysiiyo go’aanka qaran ee ka hortagga xagjirnimada rabshadaha wata.” Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa xalay Isgoyska Zoobe ka sheegay in 14-ka October ay tahay maalin murugo iyo tiiraanyo qaran oo aan duugoobayn, xusuusteeduna ay ebid ku suntanaan doonto quluubta shacabka Soomaaliyeed. “Dadka waxay halkan u taagan yihiin inay xusuustaan walaalahooda, gabdhahooda, hooyooyinkooda, ilmahooda iyo dhammaan dadkii Soomaaliyeed ee halkan wax ku gaaray inaysan hilmaamin oo Khawaarijtu weli dagaalkeedii uu socdo.” Ayuu yiri Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Gudoomiye Jaamac ayaa amaanay doorka muhiimka ah ee shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay ku leeyihiin nabadda iyo amniga Caasimadda Muqdisho, gaar ahaan la dagaalanka maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. “Waxaa xaqiiqo ah maanta nabadda lagu naaloonaayo Magaalada Muqdisho, waxaa sabab u ah shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Meel walboo ay joogaan ayay qoryaha qaateen, meel walboo ay joogaan ayayna Khawaarijta ku baacsadeen.” Ayuu yiri Jaamac oo shacabka ku booriyay inay ilaashadaan amnigooda. Qaraxii 14-kii October, 2017 oo kii ugu dhimashada badnaa taariikhda Somaliya ah ayaa waxaa ku dhintay dad gaaraya 587 qof, in ka badan 300 oo kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen.

items.title: President Hassan’s isolation deepens as UAE arms regional ties
items.description: Reports of Emirati military training for forces from Puntland and Somaliland expose the widening rift between Mogadishu and Somalia’s federal member states. Critics argue that President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s confrontational approach to federalism, constitutional reform and elections has helped fuel the crisis. MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia’s political crisis is deepening as reports emerge that the United Arab Emirates is providing advanced military training to forces from Puntland and Somaliland, including instruction in drone operations and counter-drone defence, amid deteriorating relations between Mogadishu and Abu Dhabi. The reported training is said to involve Emirati facilities and, according to unconfirmed accounts, Israeli military personnel. However, no independent confirmation has emerged regarding the number of personnel involved, the precise nature of the training or the alleged Israeli role. Neither the UAE, Puntland nor Somaliland has publicly confirmed the reported arrangements. For President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration, the reports raise concerns about military cooperation outside the federal government’s direct control. But the growing estrangement between Mogadishu and other Somali political centres cannot be understood solely as a foreign interference problem. It also reflects a deeper domestic dispute over federalism, constitutional legitimacy and the rules governing the country’s next elections. Mogadishu is not Somalia Critics of President Hassan argue that his government has contributed to the current crisis by weakening the federal compact, pursuing constitutional changes without a broadly accepted political settlement and failing to reach agreement with opposition leaders and federal member states on the constitution and electoral arrangements. Instead of building consensus on the distribution of powers and the rules of political competition, the administration has faced persistent disputes with political opponents and regional authorities. Those disagreements have weakened trust in Mogadishu’s claim to speak for the entire country. The result is a political landscape in which federal member states increasingly pursue their own diplomatic and security relationships, while the federal government views some of those arrangements as challenges to national authority. The fundamental problem is that Mogadishu is the seat of the federal government, not a substitute for Somalia itself. A president cannot secure national political legitimacy simply by consolidating control over the capital while relations with important federal member states remain strained. Somalia’s federal system was designed to distribute authority and accommodate regional interests in a country emerging from decades of conflict. Its durability depends on negotiation, constitutional clarity and cooperation—not unilateral decisions followed by demands for compliance. The UAE dispute exposes a deeper political failure The federal government has previously expressed concern that the UAE is supporting armed forces outside Mogadishu’s direct command, warning that such arrangements could create competing security structures. Officials have invoked Sudan’s Rapid Support Forces as a cautionary comparison. That comparison remains a political warning rather than proof that Puntland or Somaliland forces are intended to follow the Sudanese model. The reported training arrangements also remain unverified and should not be treated as established fact. Nevertheless, the controversy illustrates the risks created when national institutions lack a trusted mechanism for resolving disagreements over security, constitutional authority and foreign partnerships. If President Hassan’s government believes that military cooperation between the UAE and regional authorities threatens Somalia’s sovereignty, it must address the issue through credible diplomacy, intergovernmental dialogue and an agreed constitutional framework. Public alarm and accusations alone will not repair the fractured relationship. At the same time, Puntland and Somaliland must consider how their external security relationships affect wider regional stability and the prospects for a negotiated political settlement. Negotiation, not confrontation, is the way forward The crisis ultimately returns to the unresolved questions of constitutional reform and elections. Who has the authority to determine the constitutional rules? What electoral system will govern the next political transition? How will federal and regional institutions reach agreement on matters affecting the entire country? These questions cannot be settled sustainably by one administration acting alone. They require negotiations that include the federal government, federal member states and opposition stakeholders, with clear commitments to constitutional procedures and an agreed electoral roadmap. President Hassan’s government risks making its own position more difficult if it treats dissent as disloyalty and regional autonomy as a threat rather than a constitutional reality. Conversely, regional authorities must also recognise that durable national security requires cooperation and clearly defined responsibilities. The UAE’s reported training programme may become another source of confrontation, but it is not the origin of Somalia’s political divisions. Those divisions have been aggravated by the failure to establish a broadly accepted settlement on federalism, constitutional reform and elections. Somalia’s crisis cannot be resolved by treating Mogadishu as the country’s sole political centre. The way forward is to restore confidence in the federal compact, negotiate constitutional and electoral arrangements with the opposition and regional authorities, and ensure that national security policy rests on cooperation rather than political coercion. items.title: Saudi Arabia’s war on Yemen: Airstrikes cannot bomb a people into submission
items.description: By Abdikarim H. Abdi Buh Riyadh condemns Houthi missiles and drones crossing into Saudi territory, yet Yemen’s civilian suffering raises a fundamental question: why should the destruction inflicted by a powerful state receive a different standard of scrutiny from attacks carried out by its adversaries? Saudi Arabia’s renewed military confrontation with Yemen’s Houthi movement exposes the central contradiction of a war that has devastated civilian life, damaged critical infrastructure and failed to deliver a lasting political settlement. Riyadh presents its military campaign as a response to security threats, while the Houthis portray their attacks on Saudi territory as retaliation and self-defence. Yet behind these competing narratives lies a fundamental question of justice: can a state claim the right to protect its citizens while its military operations contribute to the suffering of another country’s population? The latest escalation has disrupted Saudi aviation, heightened security fears and placed civilian infrastructure at risk on both sides of the border. Reports of missile and drone attacks against Saudi airports have been accompanied by renewed airstrikes against Houthi-held areas of Yemen. Human Rights Watch has documented the dangers to civilians from attacks on both Yemeni and Saudi infrastructure, warning that the conflict must not return to a cycle of unlawful strikes and retaliation. But the present crisis cannot be understood without examining the longer history of Saudi intervention in Yemen. A powerful state, a devastated neighbour Saudi Arabia led a military coalition that intervened in Yemen in March 2015 to support the internationally recognised government after the Houthis seized the capital, Sana’a, and expanded their territorial control. The intervention was presented as a campaign to restore the recognised government and contain a movement Riyadh considers a security threat. More than a decade later, however, the war has produced neither a decisive military victory nor a durable political settlement. Instead, Yemen has endured widespread destruction, displacement, economic collapse and a humanitarian emergency that has left millions of people dependent on assistance. Human Rights Watch has documented coalition airstrikes that struck homes, markets, hospitals, schools and other civilian sites. It has also reported on the use of US support, including aerial refuelling and targeting intelligence, during earlier phases of the conflict. These findings raise serious questions about the responsibilities of Saudi Arabia and the foreign governments that enabled its military campaign. The issue is not whether Saudi Arabia has legitimate security concerns. Every state has a responsibility to protect its population. The issue is whether that responsibility can justify military operations that cause disproportionate civilian harm or damage infrastructure essential to ordinary life. Under international humanitarian law, civilians and civilian objects must be protected. Attacks must distinguish between military targets and civilian objects, and the expected civilian harm must not be excessive in relation to the concrete and direct military advantage anticipated. These obligations apply to every party, regardless of its military strength or political alliances. Sana’a airport and the credibility of the ceasefire The attack on Sana’a International Airport illustrates how quickly fragile restraint can collapse. On July 13, 2026, forces of Yemen’s internationally recognised government, operating in coalition with Saudi Arabia, struck the airport runway to prevent an Iranian aircraft from landing. Human Rights Watch examined satellite imagery and reported that at least five munitions were used, three of which struck the airport’s only operational runway. The organisation noted that the airport was a critical gateway for international travel and humanitarian access to Houthi-controlled territory. It also described the strikes as the first such coalition attacks since the UN-brokered truce began in April 2022. The Houthis subsequently launched missiles and drones towards Saudi Arabia, describing their actions as retaliation. Saudi authorities reported intercepting a ballistic missile threat, while the Houthis announced attacks against Saudi targets. The sequence matters. An attack on infrastructure serving millions of civilians can have consequences far beyond its immediate military objective. Sana’a airport is not simply a runway: it is a route for patients seeking medical treatment abroad, humanitarian personnel, essential supplies and families separated by war. If the objective was to prevent a particular aircraft from landing, the question remains whether the means employed adequately protected civilian needs and complied with international law. The presence of a disputed aircraft does not automatically remove the protections owed to civilian infrastructure. At the same time, the Houthis’ subsequent attacks on Saudi territory cannot be declared lawful merely because they were described as retaliation. The legality of each attack depends on its target, circumstances and compliance with international humanitarian law. Civilians in Riyadh and elsewhere have the same right to protection as civilians in Sana’a. The Western role cannot be ignored Saudi Arabia has benefited from military relationships with Western governments, including arms supplies and, during earlier stages of the war, US aerial refuelling and intelligence support. Such assistance helped sustain a campaign that international human rights organisations repeatedly criticised over civilian casualties and damage to protected infrastructure. These relationships raise a question that Washington and European capitals cannot avoid: what responsibility do external partners bear when their assistance enables military operations that may violate the laws of war? Arms sales, refuelling and intelligence cooperation are not automatically unlawful. But neither should they be treated as politically neutral when credible evidence points to serious civilian harm. Governments supplying military assistance should assess the risk that their support could facilitate violations and take appropriate measures to prevent or address that risk. The same scrutiny must apply to assistance provided to the Houthis. No armed movement should receive a free pass because it opposes a powerful neighbour. The principle is universal: military objectives do not erase civilian rights. Can Saudi Arabia win this war? The central strategic mistake may be the belief that superior air power can force the Houthis into submission. A movement that has survived years of bombardment, retained control over substantial territory and developed the capacity to strike across borders is unlikely to be defeated simply by increasing the number of airstrikes. The latest escalation has also demonstrated that Saudi Arabia’s own infrastructure remains vulnerable. Missile and drone attacks have disrupted aviation and raised concerns about the security of important economic facilities. Reuters reported on October 12 that renewed Houthi attacks had severely disrupted Saudi aviation, while Saudi Arabia responded with further military action in Yemen. This is the strategic paradox of the conflict: the greater the destruction inflicted on Yemen, the greater the danger that the war will generate further retaliation rather than lasting security. The Houthis may ultimately emerge from the conflict with greater political leverage if they continue to withstand military pressure. But claiming that their victory is inevitable would be premature. Their long-term position will depend not only on military resilience but also on Yemen’s internal politics, regional diplomacy and their ability to address the needs of the population under their control. What is clear is that neither side can bomb its way to a sustainable peace. The alternative is accountability and negotiation Saudi Arabia has legitimate security interests, and attacks that kill or endanger its civilians deserve condemnation. But those interests cannot justify indiscriminate or disproportionate attacks against Yemen. Likewise, the Houthis cannot invoke self-defence to excuse unlawful strikes against Saudi civilians or civilian infrastructure. The way forward requires renewed diplomatic engagement, meaningful guarantees against cross-border attacks, protection for humanitarian access and credible investigations into alleged violations by all parties. External powers must use their influence to encourage restraint rather than enable another cycle of escalation. Yemen’s civilians have paid an intolerable price for a war shaped by domestic rivalries and regional competition. Their suffering should not be treated as collateral to the security ambitions of Saudi Arabia, the strategic calculations of Western governments or the military objectives of the Houthis. Saudi Arabia may possess superior air power, but military superiority is not the same as political victory. If Riyadh continues to rely on bombardment while failing to secure a lasting settlement, it risks prolonging the very insecurity it says it wants to end. The Houthis may survive and gain leverage, but the greatest measure of success should be whether Yemen’s people can live without fear of the next airstrike, missile or drone. A durable peace will require something that years of warfare have failed to deliver: accountability, mutual restraint and a political settlement that recognises the rights and security of civilians on both sides of the border. A durable peace will require something that years of warfare have failed to deliver: accountability, mutual restraint and a political settlement that recognises the rights and security of civilians on both sides of the border. items.title: Xogta halka uu marayo geeddi socodka kala guurka UNTMIS
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiiru-Dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cali Maxamed Cumar (Cali Balcad) ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay wafdi ka socda Hawlgalka Kaalmada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya (UNTMIS). Wafdiga ayaa waxaa hoggaaminayay Ku-simaha Madaxa Hawlgalka UNTMIS, Raisedon Zenenga, waxaana kulanka looga hadlay arrimo la xiriira geeddi-socodka kala guurka hawlgalka Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya. Xogta halka uu marayo geeddi-socodka kala guurka UNTMIS Kulanka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray wejiga ugu dambeeya ee geeddi-socodka kala guurka UNTMIS, xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee siyaasadda iyo amniga dalka, iyo tallaabooyinka loo baahan yahay si loo xaqiijiyo in xil-wareejintu u dhacdo si habsami leh. Sidoo kale, waxaa laga wada hadlay muhiimadda ay leedahay in hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed ay door hoggaamineed ka qaataan xil-wareejinta, si loo xoojiyo awoodda dowladda iyo mas’uuliyadda hay’adaha dalka. Wadahadallada ayaa sidoo kale lagu adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in la ilaaliyo guulihii laga gaaray nabad-dhiska iyo dowlad-dhiska Soomaaliya, iyadoo la tixgelinayo marxaladda kala guurka ee uu marayo hawlgalka UNTMIS. Wasiiru-Dowlaha ayaa mar kale caddeeyay sida ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay in geeddi-socodka kala guurka UNTMIS uu noqdo mid ay Soomaaliya hoggaamiso, isla markaana ay hay’adaha qaranku si buuxda uga qayb qaataan. Ugu dambayn, Cali Balcad ayaa Qaramada Midoobay uga mahadceliyay iskaashiga muddada dheer ee ay la lahayd dowladda Soomaaliya, isagoo muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadista wada-shaqeynta labada dhinac inta lagu jiro wejiga ugu dambeeya ee kala guurka. items.title: Soomaaliya oo heshiis ganacsiga iyo warshadaha la saxiixatay dalka…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Soomaaliya iyo Liibiya ayaa kala saxiixday heshiis lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga dhinacyada warshadaha iyo ganacsiga, kaas oo lagu horumarinayo fursadaha maalgashi laguna fududeynayo isu-socodka badeecadaha labada dal. Heshiiska ayaa la saxiixay intii uu Muqdisho ku sugnaa Mustafa al-Sumu oo ah ku-xigeenka xoghayaha guud ee Wasaaradda Warshadaha iyo Macdanta ee Liibiya. Qodobbada heshiiska waxaa ka mid ah in suuqyada Soomaaliya loo furo badeecadaha Liibiya, isla markaana la fududeeyo ganacsiga labada dhinac. Waxaa sidoo kale la isku raacay in la isku dubbarido sahayda xoolaha nool, gaar ahaan adhiga, geela iyo lo’da, iyadoo la raacayo heerarka caafimaadka iyo daryeelka xoolaha ee ay labada dal ansixiyeen. Dhanka maaliyadda, labada dowladood ayaa ku heshiiyay in la fududeeyo xawaaladaha iyo bixinta lacagaha la xiriira ganacsiga, iyadoo la adeegsanayo nidaamyada bangiyada ee sharciga ah. Intii ay booqashada ku joogeen Muqdisho wafdiga Liibiya, waxaa sidoo kale la furay xarun loogu magac daray Xarunta Cabdulxamiid Maxamed Dabiiba ee Isdhexgalka Warshadaha iyo Ganacsiga Carabta. Xaruntan ayaa loogu talagalay xoojinta xiriirka warshadaha, is-weydaarsiga aqoonta iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee dalalka Carabta. Tallaabo kale oo lagu xoojinayo xiriirka labada dal ayaa ah in Soomaaliya ay oggolaatay in dhul loo qoondeeyo safaaradda Liibiya ee dalka. Arrintan ayaa la filayaa inay fududeyso hawlaha diblomaasiyadeed iyo wada-shaqeynta labada dowladood. Heshiiskan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu horumarinayo xiriirka dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya iyo Liibiya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada ganacsiga, maalgashiga iyo warshadaha. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, miro-dhalka heshiiska ayaa ku xirnaan doona sida ay labada dhinac u dhaqan geliyaan qodobbada lagu heshiiyay. items.title: Kenya oo xaqiijisay kiiskii labaad ee Ebola
items.description: Nairobi, Oktoobar 14, 2026 — Wasiirka Caafimaadka ee Kenya, Aadan Barre Ducaale, ayaa shaaciyey in dalkaas laga xaqiijiyey kiiskii labaad ee cudurka Ebola, kaddib markii qof kale laga helay fayraska oo la xiriira bukaankii ugu horreeyey ee cudurka laga diiwaangeliyey dalkaas. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Kenya ayaa sheegtay in bukaanka labaad uu yahay nin 39 jir ah oo ay qaraabo dhow yihiin bukaankii ugu horreeyey. Ninkan ayaa ku jiray karantiil, waxaana maalin kasta lala socday xaaladdiisa caafimaad, hase yeeshee waxaa lagu arkay astaamaha cudurka 13-kii Oktoobar 2026. Sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiinta caafimaadka, bukaanka ayaa la karantiilay, waxaana laga qaaday muunado baaritaan oo markii dambe xaqiijiyey inuu qabo cudurka Ebola. Kiiskan cusub ayaa yimid maalmo kaddib markii Kenya ay xaqiijisay kiiskeedii ugu horreeyey ee cudurka, kaas oo sababay dhimashada bukaankii laga helay. Kiisaska cusub ayaa imanaya xilli cudurka Ebola uu si weyn ugu faafayo qaybo ka mid ah bartamaha iyo bariga Afrika, gaar ahaan Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo, halkaas oo uu ka dillaacay cudur-faal aad u ballaaran oo ay sababtay nooc dhif ah oo fayraska Ebola ah, kaas oo loo yaqaan Bundibugyo. Kenya ayaa xoojisay tallaabooyinka lagula socdo dadka ay suuragalka tahay inay la kulmeen bukaannada, iyadoo la adkeeyey baaritaannada caafimaadka iyo dadaallada lagu xakameynayo faafitaanka cudurka. Cudurka Ebola wuxuu ku faafaa taabashada tooska ah ee dheecaannada jirka qofka qaba cudurka ama qof u dhintay, wuxuuna sababi karaa qandho, daal, murqo xanuun, matag iyo shuban, iyadoo xaaladaha qaarkood ay dhici karto dhiig-bax. Mas’uuliyiinta caafimaadka ayaa bulshada ugu baaqay inay raacaan talooyinka caafimaadka, kana fogaadaan taabashada qof looga shakiyo cudurka, isla markaana si degdeg ah xarun caafimaad ula xiriiraan haddii ay yeeshaan astaamo looga shakiyo Ebola.

items.title: Markab ku degay koonfurta HORMUZ kadib qarax miino oo…
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran (IRGC) ayaa sheegay in markab xamuul uu ku qarxay miino badeed, kaddib markii uu isku dayay inuu fasax la’aan maro Marinka Hormuz. War kasoo baxay Waaxda Xiriirka Dadweynaha ee IRGC ayaa lagu sheegay in markabka, oo ay ku tilmaameen mid xad-gudub sameeyay, uu ku dhacay miino badeed taallay marinkan muhiimka ah ee isku xira Gacanka Faaris iyo Gacanka Cumaan. Ciidamada Iran ayaa intaas ku daray in markabka uu dab qabsaday kaddib qaraxa miinada, taas oo ugu dambeyn sababtay inuu ku dego biyaha koonfureed ee Marinka Hormuz. “Markab siday in ka badan 2,500 oo konteenar ayaa saaka ku degay biyaha koonfureed ee Marinka Hormuz, sababo la xiriira dab aad u xooggan,” ayaa laga soo xigtay Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran. Si kastaba, warbixinta IRGC laguma faahfaahin magaca markabka, waddanka uu ka diiwaangashanaa iyo halka uu ku wajahnaa markii ay dhacdadani dhacaysay. Dhanka kale, hay’adaha kale ee la socda amniga iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ee Marinka Hormuz ayaan weli soo saarin warbixin ku saabsan dhacdadan, mana jirto xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo ku saabsan sheegashada ciidamada Iran. Sidoo kale, weli lama hayo xog rasmi ah oo ku saabsan xaaladda shaqaalihii saarnaa markabka iyo in ay jiraan khasaare nafeed. items.title: Somalia agrees to buy Pakistani JF-17 fighters
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia has agreed to buy JF-17 Thunder fighter jets from Pakistan, a Turkish defence outlet reported, but neither government has confirmed that a contract exists and no price, aircraft number or delivery date has been published. TRHaber posted the claim on X on Oct 7. Officials in Mogadishu and Islamabad have not publicly commented on a final procurement agreement. The report follows months of unconfirmed accounts. Defence Security Asia reported in February that Somalia was negotiating for up to 24 Block III variants in a deal worth about $900 million, and Pakistani media relayed the claim. Neither government confirmed those figures. In April, Somali outlet Radio Dalsan cited unnamed officials as saying contracts had been signed, but no government statement followed. Pakistani media at the time quoted Defence Production Minister Raza Hayat Harraj as saying Western alternatives cost more than three times as much as a JF-17, which he put at $30 million to $40 million. No embargo barrier Somalia is legally free to buy such aircraft. The U.N. Security Council lifted its arms embargo on the federal government in December 2023 through Resolution 2714, while keeping restrictions on Al Shabaab. The resolution urged Mogadishu to strengthen weapons and ammunition management and prevent imported equipment from reaching unauthorised hands. Somalia has sought foreign help to rebuild an air force weakened by decades of conflict. Analysts quoted by Somali media have said that any fast-jet purchase would also require new airbase, air traffic control and maintenance infrastructure, as well as pilot training. Diplomatic groundwork Defence Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi held talks with Pakistan’s naval and air force chiefs in Islamabad on Aug 5. Pakistan’s air force said afterwards it was ready to support Somali Air Force modernisation through training and institutional development. Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz, Pakistan’s air defence commander and deputy chief of the air staff, then travelled to Mogadishu, arriving on Sept 19. On Sept 20 he met President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, with Fiqi, the army commander and Air Force commander Brigadier General Abdirisaaq Mahmoud Haji present. A presidency statement said the talks focused on accelerating air force development, personnel training and protecting Somali airspace. Sarfraz gave Haji a model of the JF-17. No purchase was announced. The aircraft Pakistan Aeronautical Complex and China’s Chengdu Aircraft Corporation jointly build the single-engine JF-17. The Block III is the newest version, fitted with a KLJ-7A active electronically scanned array radar. Pakistan’s air force has said the jet can carry China’s long-range PL-15 air-to-air missile. Published range and weight figures vary by source and weapons load. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Somalia’s financial sanctions spark political controversy
items.description: The government accuses ten individuals of links to Al-Shabaab, but the sanctions risk being seen as a political weapon unless the authorities disclose credible evidence and apply the same scrutiny to allegations of corruption involving public assets in Mogadishu. MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia’s National Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Committee has imposed targeted financial sanctions on former South West State president Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen and nine associates, accusing them of involvement in financing or supporting Al-Shabaab. The announcement comes amid an escalating political and security confrontation involving Laftagareen’s political camp and the Federal Government. The committee said the restrictions are intended to disrupt terrorist financing and strengthen national security. It also ordered individuals and institutions to freeze assets belonging to those listed, refrain from prohibited financial dealings and report relevant transactions to the Financial Reporting Centre. But the decision raises a fundamental question: is Somalia’s financial sanctions regime being applied impartially to protect national security, or selectively to serve the political interests of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration? The government’s allegations are serious. Yet the public announcement, as presented, does not provide the underlying evidence needed to independently establish that the ten individuals financed or supported Al-Shabaab. An accusation is not proof, and the designation of political opponents should not substitute for a transparent, evidence-based process. Terrorism allegations require evidence, not political convenience The committee named Laftagareen and nine associates, including individuals based around Baidoa and in Nairobi, following attacks in Baidoa involving vehicles reportedly loaded with explosives. Authorities allege that the targeted individuals were connected to Al-Shabaab financing or support. Such allegations warrant serious investigation. But the government must demonstrate the connection between the individuals sanctioned and the alleged terrorist financing through credible evidence, subject to appropriate legal safeguards. Without that evidence, the sanctions risk deepening the perception that counterterrorism institutions are being drawn into a political dispute. Laftagareen’s political camp is engaged in a confrontation with the federal authorities, making impartiality particularly important. The committee has publicly asserted its commitment to enforcing financial sanctions. Its credibility, however, will depend not on the strength of its declarations but on whether it can demonstrate independence from political pressure and apply the law consistently to allies and opponents alike. Where is the same scrutiny of Mogadishu’s public land? The controversy becomes sharper when measured against longstanding allegations concerning the sale, auctioning and transfer of public land in Mogadishu. Critics of the federal administration allege that public properties have been transferred to private interests, that proceeds from all transactions bypassed the national treasury, and that displaced residents were left without adequate alternative accommodation. The scale of forced evictions in the capital has made land ownership and the management of public assets major issues of public accountability. These allegations require independent investigation and documentary verification. But if the anti-money laundering committee is genuinely independent, it should be willing to examine credible financial evidence involving any public official, regardless of rank or political affiliation—including President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and members of his inner circle. If evidence establishes that proceeds from public land sales were unlawfully diverted or laundered, the authorities should investigate the transactions, trace the funds and impose legally justified measures where the evidence warrants them. The same standards should apply to every individual named in a financial investigation. The public has a legitimate right to ask why financial sanctions are being imposed on Laftagareen and his associates while allegations concerning the disposal of public assets and the handling of the proceeds remain unresolved. An anti-money laundering body cannot credibly claim impartiality if it aggressively pursues one political camp while appearing indifferent to credible allegations involving those close to the president. That is a demand for equal enforcement, not a presumption of guilt against the president or anyone else. An institution’s independence must be demonstrated The committee’s warning that individuals and institutions must freeze designated assets and report transactions carries significant consequences. Financial sanctions can restrict access to money, damage reputations and affect the ability of individuals to conduct ordinary business. Such measures must therefore rest on a lawful basis, reliable evidence and procedures that permit appropriate review or challenge. The committee should publish a clear explanation of the legal grounds for its decision, disclose as much supporting evidence as the law permits, and explain what review or appeal mechanisms are available to those affected. It should also demonstrate that its investigations extend beyond political opponents. That means examining credible allegations of corruption, illicit financial flows and the diversion of public funds wherever they lead. If the committee cannot demonstrate these safeguards, its actions risk being interpreted as an extension of the political struggle rather than an independent effort to protect Somalia’s financial system. Political conflict cannot be resolved through financial blacklists Somalia’s confrontation with Al-Shabaab is too serious to be compromised by political selectivity. Terrorist financing must be investigated and disrupted, but counterterrorism measures lose legitimacy when the public suspects that accusations are being used to weaken political rivals. The federal government should present credible evidence supporting its allegations against Laftagareen and his associates. Those targeted should have access to the legal procedures available to challenge the sanctions. And the committee should apply the same scrutiny to allegations involving senior federal officials and the handling of public assets. Until those standards are demonstrated, the sanctions declaration risks becoming another document in Somalia’s political confrontation—long on accusations, but short on publicly verifiable evidence of impartial enforcement. The decisive test is simple: will the committee follow the evidence wherever it leads, even when it reaches the president’s inner circle, or will its financial powers be used primarily against political adversaries? Somalia needs an independent financial watchdog, not an institution whose credibility is determined by whom the government chooses to target. items.title: Puntland police arrest Garowe killing suspect within two days, reinforcing the rule of law
items.description: The swift arrest following a deadly shooting in Garowe offers a clear example of how law enforcement can help prevent clan-based revenge killings and ensure that criminal disputes are resolved through the courts, not retaliation. GAROWE (WDN) — Puntland police have arrested Mowliid Siciid Warsame, known as Dhakhare, who is suspected of killing three people and injuring three others in a shooting in Garowe on Sunday, October 11, 2026. In a statement, Puntland Police said officers from the Nugaal regional command, working with their counterparts in Sool, apprehended the suspect in the Jidhaan area near Carooley, in Sool region. The arrest came within two days of the attack near Garowe’s Inji market. Police said the suspect would be handed over to the relevant judicial authorities for legal proceedings. He remains an accused person, and his guilt must be determined through due process. The swift operation is significant in a society where deadly violence can trigger clan-based retaliation, turning an individual criminal act into a wider cycle of revenge. When families or clans take justice into their own hands, further deaths can follow, deepening mistrust and threatening community stability. The law must come before clan allegiance The Garowe killings underscore the importance of a consistent principle: no individual, family or clan should stand above the law, and no grievance justifies taking revenge outside the judicial system. When a killing occurs, the responsibility for identifying suspects, gathering evidence and determining guilt belongs to law enforcement agencies and the courts. Relatives of victims deserve justice, but justice must be pursued through lawful procedures rather than retaliatory violence. Clan-based revenge killings undermine public security and weaken confidence in state institutions. They can also punish people who had no involvement in the original crime, perpetuating a cycle in which one killing becomes the justification for another. Governments therefore have a responsibility not only to arrest suspects, but also to prevent reprisals, protect threatened communities, investigate crimes impartially and ensure that prosecutions proceed without undue delay. An example for Somalia’s federal member states Puntland police’s arrest of the suspect within two days demonstrates the value of prompt coordination between regional police commands. The operation offers a practical example for other federal member states seeking to strengthen public safety and prevent criminal cases from escalating into clan conflicts. The next test will be whether the authorities preserve the evidence, conduct a fair investigation and bring the case before a competent court. Police action must be followed by an effective judicial process, while authorities should remain alert to any threat of retaliatory attacks. The federal government and state administrations should reinforce the same message nationwide: disputes involving killings must be resolved through the rule of law, not clan power, collective punishment or revenge. The arrest in Garowe is an important first step. Lasting justice will depend on a fair trial, protection against retaliation and a firm commitment to ensuring that the law—not clan allegiance—stands at the apex of every dispute. items.title: Markab nooca kunteenarada qaada oo ku degay marin biyoodka Hormuz
items.description: Markabkan oo lagu magacaabo GFS Pride, watayna Calanka Singapore ayaa ku degay marin biyoodka Hormuz, ka dib markii uu gantaal ku dhacay, sida ay Arbacadan xaqiijiyeen hay’adaha amniga badda. Markabka ayaa weerarka la kulmay, xilli uu ku gooshayay Marinka Hormuz, halkaas oo Iran aysan ogoleyn in ogolaansho la’aanteeda ay maraakiibtu maraan. Wasaaradda Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda ee Singapore ayaa maanta sheegtay in markabka uu dab qabsaday Talaadadii, ka hor inta aanu degin. Wasaaradda ayaa warsaxaafadeed ku sheegtay in dhammaan 21 shaqaale oo markabka saarnaa si badqab leh looga daadgureeyay. Taliska Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran ayaan ogoleyn in markab aan fasax ka haysan uu maro marinka ugu muhiimsan ee sahayda tamarta adduunka. Iran ayaa ogol in maraakiibta ganacsiga ay adeegsadaan Hormuz, haddii ay raacayaan habka isku dubaridka Tehran ee habaynta amniga iyo badbaadada, taas oo Mareykanka uu si adag uga horyimid. Xiisadda Hormuz ayaa cawaaqib ku yeelatay badqabka maraakiibta booyadaha shidaalka, kuwa shixnadaha badeecadaha, qiimaha sicirka saliidda iyo deganaanshaha dhaqaalaha caalamka. Hormuz ayaa gashay xaalad fowdo iyo hubanti la’aan ah, ka dib duulaankii wadajirka ahaa ee Mareykanka iyo Israel ay 28-kii bishii February ku qaadeen dalkaasi Iran. Marinkan ayaa ah marin badeedka ugu weyn caalamka ee ay adeegsadaan maraakiibta batroolka iyo gaaska. Labaatan boqolkiiba (20%) batroolka iyo gaaska laga isticmaalo dunida ayaa ka gudba marinka ku yaala Bariga Dhexe.

items.title: War cusub oo kasoo kordhay doorashada madaxweynaha maamulka Galmudug
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa saaka shaaciyay jadwalka doorashada hoggaaanka sare ee Galmudug, gaar ahaan doorashada guddoonka baarlamaanka, midda madaxweynaha iyo ku xigeenkiisa. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in 18-ka bishan ay dhacayso doorashada guddoonka Golaha Wakiilada, taas oo haatan si loogu diyaar garoobayo. Sidoo kale, doorashada madaxweynaha cusub ee Galmudug iyo ku xigeenkiisa ayaa iyana loo qorsheeyay 22 October, sida uu muujinayo jadwalka cusub ee la shaaciyay. Qoraalka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in Guddiga Doorashooyinka uu mudnaan gaar ah siinayo dhammaystirka hay’adaha dastuuriga ah ee Galmudug, iyadoo loo marayo hannaan sharci ah oo waafaqsan xeerarka doorashada. Talaabadan ayaa kusoo aadeyso, xilli Maxkamadda Sare Dalka ay ansixisay natiijada doorashadii ku celiska ahayd ee Galmudug, taas oo dhacday 30-kii Sebtembar ee sanadkan 2026. Maxkamaddu oo qoraal soo saartay ayaa sheegtay in aanay jirin dacwad sharci ah oo laga keenay natiijada doorashada Galmudug, sidaas darteedna ay si rasmi ah u ansixisay natiijada doorashada ku-celiska ahayd ee Golaha Wakiillada Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Natiijada oo horay la shaaciyay ayaa muujineysa in ururka Caddaaladda iyo Midnimadda uu ku guuleystay 1,085 cod iyo hal kursi, halka Madalsan uu helay 4,025 cod iyo laba kursi. Ururka Muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ayaa helay 842 cod iyo hal kursi, halka Dimuqraadiga Soomaaliyeed uu ku guuleystay 2,283 cod iyo hal kursi. Caddaaladda iyo Wadajir ayaa noqday ururka ugu codadka badan, isagoo helay 110,072 cod iyo 67 kursi, halka Dadka Soomaaliyeed uu helay 158 cod, balse uusan wax kursi ah ku guuleysan. Sidoo kale, Karaama ayaa heshay 10,309 cod iyo lix kursi, halka SAAB ay heshay 880 cod iyo hal kursi. Dan Shacab ayaa isna helay 738 cod, balse wax kursi ah ma uusan helin. Ururka Sincad ayaa helay 10,895 cod iyo toddoba kursi, halka Dhallinyarada Talo-Qaran ay heleen 2,043 cod iyo hal kursi. RamaaS ayaa iyaduna heshay 3,044 cod iyo laba kursi. Natiijada guud ayaa muujineysa in 89-ka kursi ee Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug loo kala helay 12-ka urur siyaasadeed, iyadoo Caddaaladda iyo Wadajir ay heleen 67 kursi, Sincadna uu ku xigay toddoba kursi, halka Karaama ay heshay lix kursi. Doorashadan ayaa qayb ka ah hannaanka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo guddigu sheegay in hawlaha doorashooyinku ay ka socdaan meelo kala duwan oo dalka ah.
