items.title: Hamas, Dahlan and Barghouti: Palestinian hopes fade as elections cancelled
items.description: By Lubna Masarwa Jerusalem Bureau Chief, Middle East Eye Last week marked three years since 7 October 2023. Over the years of covering Israel ’s occupation of Palestine, I have developed an aversion to anniversaries. Almost every day in Palestine marks one of some sort: Nakba Day, Prisoners’ Day, the First Intifada, the Second Intifada. The list is long. For this anniversary, Israel announced a shutdown of the West Bank , tightening the siege on Palestinians even further. A senior contact in Fatah, the ruling party, called me. He wanted to tell me about the forthcoming Palestinian elections and how Mohammed Dahlan , the Gaza-born aide to UAE President Mohammed bin Zayed, was trying to return to Palestinian politics. Dahlan is living in exile in Abu Dhabi. “I have news for you about the electoral coalition between Mohammed Dahlan and Hamas. They may run for the next election on one list,” the Fatah contact said. So I went to see him in Bethlehem. We were the only customers in a restaurant that normally seats 1,500 people. The economy is dead in the city of Jesus. My contact told me that 40 of Bethlehem’s hotels were closed and that a friend of his, who owns one of them, could not find a buyer – even at half its value. Movement throttled Like anyone trying to drive around the occupied West Bank, I checked different apps to see which roads and checkpoints were open or closed before heading to the meeting. These apps rely on information volunteered by Palestinian drivers, who update the situation on the roads to help one another navigate the occupation and get to work or school. Last month, during the Jewish holidays, Israel shut all the checkpoints and gates into towns and villages. A Middle East Eye reporter travelling from Ramallah to a small nearby village had to spend the night in her car with her husband and two children, after being stranded on the road. Hundreds of Palestinians faced the same ordeal, as Israeli military closures made every available route impossible. Meanwhile, Israelis enjoyed celebrating the holidays with their families. To get to Bethlehem, I drove past the Har Gilo settlement, with its orderly rows of houses, green trees and paved streets, surrounded by a security wall and CCTV cameras to ensure that no Palestinian could get close to the Jewish colony. As I approached Bethlehem, I reached a gate across the road, manned by a female Israeli soldier sitting in a bunker and pointing her gun at everyone who passed. On the left was a military base built on top of a Palestinian home confiscated from a local family. Bethlehem is empty. The Covid-19 pandemic shut down its tourism industry, and it never had the chance to recover, as Israel’s occupation grew ever more brutal, and the genocide in Gaza raged just a short distance away. Formidable challenge I wanted to find out what Palestinian leadership had to offer at a time when everything was collapsing around us. So here we were: two Palestinians in an empty restaurant, clutching at straws. My contact told me that the talks between Dahlan’s representatives and Hamas officials in Cairo were serious and going well. If successful, the coalition could bring together Hamas, Dahlan and Marwan Barghouti , the Fatah figure sometimes dubbed Palestine’s Nelson Mandela. Barghouti has spent the past 24 years in an Israeli prison, but he consistently tops the polls . In other words, these are three of the most popular forces in Palestinian politics. A joint electoral list bringing them together would pose a formidable challenge to the ageing Fatah leader, Mahmoud Abbas, and his increasingly moribund Palestinian Authority (PA). My contact was animated. He seemed excited by the prospect of a Hamas-Dahlan electoral list and said he had even attended some of the talks in Cairo. But Palestinians do not believe the election will ever go ahead. Abbas always finds an excuse to postpone or cancel it. That is why there has not been an election for 20 years . And for as long as I can remember, there have been rounds of talks in Cairo between Hamas, Fatah and other Palestinian factions. Why, I asked my contact, should I, as a Palestinian journalist, take these talks seriously or treat them any differently from those that came before? He looked at me and said: “You are right.” And the meeting ended. Father separated from son Across the road from the restaurant, I met Saleem, a disabled Palestinian man. We spoke about the collapse of Palestine’s economy and the poverty into which it has plunged people. He told me that his nine-year-old son, Akram, was all alone in an Israeli hospital. The little boy had been hit by a car and transferred to a children’s hospital in Israel because hospitals in the West Bank could not provide the treatment he desperately needed. But for more than a month, Israel refused to grant Akram’s parents the permits to visit their son, leaving him alone and surrounded by strangers. I asked Saleem whether the authorities had given any explanation for refusing to let the child see his family. At first, he said the permits were refused because Israel had closed the West Bank during the Jewish holidays. Later, a social worker told him that the man responsible for issuing permits simply did not like Palestinians. items.title: Xamza oo ka sheekeeyay sida uu uga badbaaday qaraxii Zoobe + Sawirro

Ugu dambayn, Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa ugu baaqay shacabka Soomaaliyeed in ay gacmaha isu qabsadaan sidii loo ciribtiri lahaa kooxaha cadowga ah ee fikirkoodu khaldamay ee meelaha kooban kaga sugan dalkeenna, iyada oo dowladduna ay dagaal xooggan kula jirto sidii looga tir-tiri laha guud ahaanba gayiga Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Raysal Wasaare Barre oo sheegay inuu ka badbaaday qaraxii Isgoyska Zoobe
items.description: Raysal Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka, Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay inuu ka mid ahaa dadkii ka badbaaday qaraxii boqolaalka qof ku dhinteen ee 14-kii bishii October ee sanadkii 2017 ka dhacay Isgoyska Zoobe ee Magaalada Muqdisho. Maanta oo kale sagaal sano ka hor ayay ahayd, markii nin kaxeynayay gaari nooca xamuulka oo walxaha qarxa laga soo buuxiyay uu si kedis ah isugu qarxiyay isgoyskaasi, xilli uu mashquul ka jiray. Xogaha la diiwaangeliyay ayaa muujinaya in 587 qof ay ku dhinteen qaraxaasi, in ka badan 300 oo kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Qaraxan oo noqday midkii ugu dhimashada badnaa ee ka dhaca Somaliya ayaa waxaan jirin cid sheegatay masuuliyaddiisa, inkastoo si dhow loola xiriiriyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. “Anigu maalintaa runtii dadkii Ilaahay ka badbaadiyay baan ku jiray. Markaas ayaan maray oo meel 200 oo tallaabo ka fogeyn ama wax yar ay raaceyso guri aan deganaa markaan saas u galay guriga ayuu qaraxaasu uu dhacay. Anigii dhulkan ku dhacay, baabuur ordaaya Ilaahay baa i dhaafiyay meel uu ka yimid aanan garaneynin waxa uu ku dhacay agteeda.” Ayuu yiri Raysal Wasaaraha Xukuumadda oo xusay “Culeys aad u weyn ayaa runtii dhacay. Marka kulligeen dadkii Ilaahay maalintaas ka badbaadiyay inta hadda joogta ayaan ka mid nahay oo goobjoog baanu u ahayn, wixii dhacay.” Raysal Wasaaraha oo Arbacadan ka hadlayay Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa yiri “Maalintaas murugada lahayd, argagixisadu waxay doonayeen in ay cabsi abuuraan, rajada Soomaaliyeed-na ay baabi’iyaan, laakiin waxaa Ilaahay mahadiis ah inaysan ku guuleysan. Waxay argagixisadu shacabkeenna gaarsiiyeen xanuun iyo murugo aan la qiyaasi karin, balse Somaliya ma aysan jebin. Waxay dileen dad aan waxba galabsan, laakiin nagama aysan reebin dadnimadeenna, Muslimnimadeenna, midnimadeenna iyo go’aankeenna ku aaddan in aan nabad ku wada noolaano.” Raysal Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa tilmaamay in maanta oo kale ay u aqoonsadeen Maalin Qaran, isagoo daba jooga qaraarkii ay Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka ansixiyeen 10-kii bishii November ee sanadkii hore ee 2025, kaas oo 14-ka October looga dhigayo maalin lagu xuso dhibaneyaasha argagixisada. “Waxaad ogtihiin sida horeyba Baarlamaanku la sheegay inay soo saareen in lagu maamuusay maanta oo kale inay noqoto, oo ah maalinta 14-ka October in loo asteeyo Maalinta Qaran ee Somaliya ee la dagaalanka iyo ka hortagga xagjirnimada. Maalintani waxay sanad kasta noqon doontaa maalin la xuso oo la cusbooneysiiyo go’aanka qaran ee ka hortagga xagjirnimada rabshadaha wata.” Ayuu yiri Raysal Wasaare Barre. Barre ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay Shirweynaha Qaran ee Ka hortagga iyo La dagaalanka Fekerka Xagjirka ah oo maanta ka furmay Muqdisho, kaas oo laba maalmood socon doona. Dowladda Somaliya ayaa muddo dheer dagaal kula jirtay Al Shabaab, oo lagu tilmaamo ururka argagixiso ee ugu khatarta badan ee ka jira Afrika.

items.title: BF oo meel-mariyay sharci muddo la diidanaa + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka ayaa maanta cod aqlabiyad leh ku ansixiyay Hindise sharciyeedka dambiyada kufsiga iyo anshax xumada, kaas oo ay golaha horgeysay wasaaradda qoyska iyo horumarinta xuquuqul Insaanka. Sharcigan oo muddo dheer la diidanaa ayaa ugu dambeyn waxaa ogolaaday 132 xildhibaan, waxaa diiday saddex mudane, halka ay ka aamuseen 5 kale, sida uu ku dhawaaqay guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac). Inta lagu guda jiray ka doodista sharcigan ayaa la marsiiyay dhammaan habraacyada ansixinta hindise sharciyeedyada ee qodobka 98-aad, sida lagu xusay warbixinta. Dhinaca kale, wasiirka wasaaradda qoyska iyo horumarinta xquuqul Insaanka Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, ayaa u mahadcelisay Guddoonka iyo Xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ansixinta Hindise Sharciyeedka Dembiyada Kufsiga iyo Anshax-Xumada. Khadiija ayaa xustay in hindise sharciyeedkani uu soo maray marxalado kala duwan, isla markaana muddo dheer horyaallay Golaha Shacabka, iyadoo bogaadisay sida hufan ee Xildhibaannadu u guteen waajibaadkooda dastuuriga ah. Wasiir Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, oo ku hadlaysay magaca Wasaaradda iyo haweenka Soomaaliyeed ee dhibbanayaasha u ah tacaddiyada galmada, ayaa sheegtay in ansixinta hindise sharciyeedkani ay tahay tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo ilaalinta karaamada aadanaha, badqabka bulshada iyo xuquuqda dhibbanayaasha. Waxay tilmaantay in tallaabadani ay muhiim u tahay xoojinta helitaanka caddaaladda iyo ilaalinta haweenka, carruurta iyo dadka kale ee nugul. Waxaa kale oo ay u mahadcelisay Guddiga Xuquuqul Insaanka iyo Haweenka ee Golaha Shacabka, culimada Soomaaliyeed, bulshada rayidka ah iyo dhammaan dhinacyadii ka qayb qaatay talooyinka, doodaha iyo dib-u-eegista hindise sharciyeedka. Waxay xustay in wada-shaqaynta hay’adaha dowladda iyo bulshada ay door muhiim ah ka qaadato horumarinta shuruucda ilaalinaya xuquuqda aadanaha iyo xoojinta nidaamka caddaaladda dalka. Ugu dambayn, Wasiir Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi ayaa carrabka ku adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay in dadaallada sharci-dejinta lagu xoojiyo ilaalinta xuquuqda haweenka iyo carruurta, la taageero dhibbanayaasha, lana abuuro bulsho ku dhisan caddaalad, karaamo iyo isla xisaabtan. Waxay muujisay in Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanku ay sii wadi doonto dadaallada lagu horumarinayo ilaalinta xuquuqda aadanaha iyo xoojinta shuruucda lagu xaqiijinayo badqabka iyo karaamada muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed The post BF oo meel-mariyay sharci muddo la diidanaa + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Aljeeriya oo ka wada hadlay ballaarinta iskaashiga ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga
items.description: Muqdisho, 14 Oktoobar 2026 — Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cali, ayaa qaabilay safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Shacabka Aljeeriya u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Maxamed Caalim, iyagoo ka wada hadlay sidii loo ballaarin lahaa iskaashiga ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga ee labada dal. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka dhaqaale iyo iskaashiga laba geesoodka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Aljeeriya, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan inay dhisaan saldhig dhaqaale oo xooggan oo taageera xiriirkooda soo jireenka ah. Soomaaliya iyo Aljeeriya ayaa leh xiriir saaxiibtinimo oo soo jireen ah, waxaana dadaallada lagu ballaarinayo ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga la filayaa inay fursado cusub u abuuraan iskaashiga labada dal. Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee ay la leedahay dalalka kale.

items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo ansixiyey hindise-xeerka dembiyada kufsiga iyo anshax-xumada
items.description: Muqdisho, 14 Oktoobar 2026 — Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ansixiyey Hindise-Xeerka Dembiyada Kufsiga iyo Anshax-xumada, kaddib codbixin ay ka qaybgaleen 140 xildhibaan. Codbixinta oo ka dhacday kulanka 24-aad ee kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Golaha Shacabka, waxaa oggolaaday 132 xildhibaan, halka saddex xildhibaan ay diideen, shan kalena ay ka aamuseen. Kulanka oo ka dhacay xarunta Golaha Shacabka ee Muqdisho, waxaa shir-guddoomiyey Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), oo uu weheliyo Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Golaha, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow. Sidoo kale, xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka ayaa akhrinta saddexaad marsiiyey Hindise-Sharciyeedka Macmiilka Danabeysan, iyagoo ka dooday qodobbadiisa iyo muhiimadda uu dalka u leeyahay. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), oo kulanka soo xiray, ayaa xildhibaannada uga mahadceliyey gudashada waajibaadkooda dastuuriga ah, wuxuuna ugu baaqay inay ilaaliyaan dhaqanka, anshaxa iyo sharafta Golaha.

items.title: Aqalka Sare oo ka dooday hindise-sharciyeedka dhismaha Hay’adda Saadaasha Hawada
items.description: Muqdisho, 14 Oktoobar 2026 — Golaha Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa akhrinta labaad marsiiyey hindise-sharciyeedka dhismaha Hay’adda Saadaasha Hawada, kaas oo muhiim u ah horumarinta adeegyada saadaasha hawada iyo xogta cimilada ee dalka. Kulanka Kalfadhiga 8-aad, kulankiisa 9-aad, waxaa shir-guddoomiyey Guddoomiyaha Aqalka Sare, Cabdi Xaashi Cabdullaahi, oo uu weheliyo Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Aqalka Sare, Cabdullaahi Cali Xersi Timacadde. Kulanka oo ku furmay kooram dhan 28 senator, ayaa waxaa warbixin ku saabsan hindise-sharciyeedka ka jeedisay Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Khayraadka Qaranka ee Aqalka Sare, Senator Saynab Ismaaciil Maxamed, iyadoo faahfaahin ka bixisay wax-ka-beddellada, sixitaannada iyo dib-u-eegista lagu sameeyey hindise-sharciyeedka. Senatorrada ayaa intaas kaddib ka dooday qodobbada hindise-sharciyeedka, iyagoo soo bandhigay talooyin iyo aragtiyo la xiriira hagaajinta iyo dhammaystirka xeerka. Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda Deegaanka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada, Cabdirisaaq Axmed Cali, oo kulanka goobjoog ka ahaa, ayaa sidoo kale ka jawaabay su’aalo ay senatorradu ka weydiiyeen hindise-sharciyeedka. Hindise-sharciyeedkan ayaa ujeeddadiisu tahay dhismaha Hay’adda Saadaasha Hawada, si loo horumariyo tayada xogta cimilada, loona xoojiyo awoodda Soomaaliya ee saadaalinta xaaladaha hawada. Hirgelinta hay’addan ayaa muhiim u ah helitaanka xog saadaasha hawada oo la isku hallayn karo, taas oo wax ka tari karta badbaadada bulshada, qorsheynta horumarka dalka iyo ka jawaabista xaaladaha la xiriira cimilada.

items.description: Muqdisho, Talaado, 14 Oktoobar: 2026 — Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u daahfuray Shirweynaha Qaran ee Ka-hortagga iyo La-dagaallanka Fikirka Xagjirka ah, kaasi oo ay soo diyaarisay xarunta Qaran ee Tubsan ee Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, ayaa sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay xoogga saartay ciribtirka kooxaha Khawaarijta awood ahaan iyo fikir ahaanba taasi oo sababtay in maanta dadka Soomaaliyeed ay ku baraarugaan in fikirka kooxdaas uu halis ku yahay jiritaankooda ummadnimo iyo dowladnimo. Mudane Xamsa, ayaa xusay in maanta oo kale 14-kii Oktoobar 2017, ay kooxaha arxanka daran dalkeenna ka fuliyeen musiibadii weynayd ee ay ku dhibaateeyeen kumanyaal shacab ah, halka boqollaalna ay ku dhinteen taasi oo indhaha bulshada tustay in aysan dhaqanka kooxdu diin islaam shaqo ku lahayn, beddelkeeda ay u adeegayaan cadowga ummadda Soomaaliyeed. “Dadkii Illaahay ka badbaadiyay baan ka mid ahaa, markaas baan maray isgoyska Soobe, guri aan degennaa oo 200 tallaabo u jira meesha wax ka dhaceen ayaan tagay, markii uu qaraxa dhacay dhulka ayaan ku dhacay, baabuur ordayana illaahay baa I dhaafiyay, gurigii waa uu dumay, dhammaanteen dadkii ka badbaaday baan nahay”. Ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaaraha. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, ayaa tilmaamay in markii ay Xukuumaddan la-wareegtay talada dalka ay xoogga saartay in la caddeeyo aragtida Shabaab ee gurracan, kadib kulankii ay isugu yimaadeen culimada Soomaaliyeed ay soo saareem fatwo ay ku xaqiijinayaan in kooxaha argagixisada ah ay ku sifoobeen dhaqankii iyo ficilkii Khawaarijta, isla markaana ay waajib tahay in loola diriro fikir ahaan, awood iyo hab walba oo loo ciribtiri karo. Ugu dambayn, Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa ugu baaqay shacabka Soomaaliyeed in ay gacmaha isu qabsadaan sidii loo ciribtiri lahaa kooxaha cadowga ah ee fikirkoodu khaldamay ee meelaha kooban kaga sugan dalkeenna, iyada oo dowladduna ay dagaal xooggan kula jirto sidii looga tir-tiri laha guud ahaanba gayiga Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Dagaalka Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta oo si xun u dhaawacaya dhaqaalaha Boqortooyada
items.description: Sacuudiga ayaa caqabado isku dhafan oo dhinacyada difaaca, amniga iyo dhaqaalaha kala kulmaya dagaalka lagu taageerayo Dowladda Yemen ee caalamka uu aqoonsan yahay ee ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta oo Iran ay taageerto. Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo adeegsanaya gantaalaha ballaastikada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee drones-ka ayaa beegsanaya xarumaha muhiimka ah ee ku yaala magaalooyinka waaweyn ee dalkaasi. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ayaa si firfircoon u garaacaya kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo militariga ee ku yaala gudaha dalkaasi, iyagoona burbur u gaysanaya garoomada diyaaradaha iyo xarumaha tamarta ee boqortooyada. Sacuudiga ayaa waxyeelo dhaqaale iyo dib-u-dhac sanado ah kala kulmaya dagaalkan, marka aad eegto in nidaamkiisa difaaca hawada ay ka fara baxsanayaan drones-ka iyo gantaalaha ka soo dhacaya jihada Yemen, kuwaas oo si toos ah u garaacaya kaabeyaashiisa ugu muhiimsan. Xiisadda labada dhinac ayaa cirka isku shareertay, ka dib markii Xuutiyiinta ay 20-kii bishii July ku dhawaaqeen go’doomin badeed oo ka dhan ah Dekedaha Sacuudiga, iyagoona sheegay in maraakiibta ku wajahan ama ka imanaya dalkaasi aysan adeegsan karin Badda Cas iyo Marinka Bab El-Mandeb. Ku dhawaaqista Xuutiyiinta ayaa ka dambeysay, ka dib weerar xagga cirka ah oo 13-kii July lagu qaaday Garoonka Diyaaradaha Sanca, taas oo Xuutiyiinta ay ku eedeeyeen inuu gaystay Sacuudiga. Afhayeenka isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ee ka hawlgala Yemen, General Turki Al Maliki ayaa xilligaasi sheegay inaanan la ogolaan doonin xayiraadaha dhanka badda ee ay Xuutiyiinta ku soo rogeen Dekedaha Sacuudiga, waxayna 24-kii July duqeeyeen bartilmaameedyo militari oo Xuutiyiinta ay ku leeyihiin Magaalada Hodeidah iyo Jasiiradda Kamaran ee Galbeedka Yemen, taasoo aad uga carreysiisay ururka reer Yemen, keentayna in ay weeraraan maraakiibta shidaalka ee Sacuudiga. Weeraradan ayaa dhabaha u xaaray in dagaal ballaaran uu bishii September ka dhex qarxo Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta, tani oo xaaladda uga sii dartay. Sida ay horeyba u saadaaliyeen khubarada dhanka militariga, Sacuudiga ayaa noqday kan khasaaraha ugu weyn kala kulmay dagaalka weli socda ee isbahaysiga uu hoggaamiyo uu kula jiro Xuutiyiinta. In kasta oo Sacuudigu uu leeyahay awood militari oo baaxad leh, haddana weerarada ay Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen dalkaasi waxay muujiyeen nuglaanta iyo inaanan si buuxda loo wada difaaci karin kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah ee dalkaasi. Muddada uu dagaalku socdo, Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa boqolaal gantaal oo nooca ballaastikada iyo diyaarado drones ah ku weeraray magaalooyinka waaweyn ee dalkaasi sida Riyadh, Jizan, Najran, Dhahran, Yanbu, Abha iyo Abqaiq. Weerarada Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale carqaladeeyay duulimaadyada rayidka ee dalkaasi, waxaana xusid mudan in duulimaadyada caalamiga ah ay hakiyeen duulimaadyadii ay ku tagayeen dalkaasi. Dagaalka Xuutiyiinta ayaa qalqal amni oo aan horey loo arag ka abuuray gudaha Sacuudiga, waana culeys soo kordhay oo muwaadiniinta iyo dadka kale ee ku nool dalkaasi ay dareemeen. Iyadoo waxaas oo dhan oo dib-u-dhac ah ay jiraan, Sacuudiga ayaa la sheegaya in weli uu ballaayiin dollar oo hor leh ku bixinayo iibsashada hubka, saadka iyo hawlgalada cirka, iyadoo tani ay culeys weyn ku tahay miisaaniyadda dalka, xilli boqortooyada ay wadday hirgelinta qorshaha nashqadaynta dhaqaalaha ee 2030. Qorshaha Riyadh ee hiigsiga 2030 ayaa ah qorshe uu sanadihii u dambeeyay riixayay Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Mohammed bin Salman oo lagu casriyeynayo dalka iyo ballaarinta dhaqaalihiisa, si aan loogu tiirsanaan keliya dakhliga saliidda, loona abuuro ilo kale oo dhaqaale, iyadoo la soo jiidanayo dalxiiseyaasha iyo maalgashiga shisheeye. Mohammed bin Salman, Raysal Wasaaraha Sacuudiga ayaa la sheegay inuu raadinayo xulafo cusub, oo ka qayb qaata dagaalka ay hormuudka ka tahay Dowladda Yemen.

items.title: Shuute: Aabahay waxaa loo dilay kiiska qaraxii Zoobe dartiis
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Darajada Koowaad ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, Xasan Cali Nuur (Shuute) oo ka qayb-galay shirweynaha qaran ee ka hortagga iyo la dagaallanka fikirka xagjirka ah oo ka socda magaalada Muqdisho ayaa ka sheekeeyey sidii loo dilay Aabhiis oo ay horay u khaarijiyeen maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab. Shuute ayaa soo hadal qaaday qiso xanuun badan oo ku aadan dilka Aabihiis oo uu la xiriiriyay kiiska qaraxii weynaa ee 9 sano kahor maanta oo kale ka dhacay isgoyska Zoobe. “Markii uu dhacay qaraxii Zoobe nimankii argagixisada ahaa waxay isku dayeen inay ka leexdaan oo aysan sheegan waxa meesha ka dhacay nasiib wanaag hay’adaha amniga markaas waxay ku guuleysteen inay qabtaan qof kamid ah dadkii hagaayay gaariga oo waday gaari mar dambe ku qarxay aagga Danwadaagta,” ayuu yiri Xasan Cali Nuur (Shuute). Guddoomiyaha ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in Aabihiis loo dilay si loo baajiyo dhageysiga dacwadda ninkii hagayay gaarigii ku qarxay Isgoyska Zoobe ee magaalada Muqdisho, isagoo xusay in dilka Aabihii uu dhacay xilli la doonayay in la hor istaago in kiiskaasi la dhageysto. Shuute ayaa sheegay in inkastoo dilka Aabihii uu ahaa dhacdo xanuun badan oo saameyn ku yeelatay qoyskooda, haddana aysan taasi noqon sabab ay uga tanaasulaan gudashada waajibaadkooda shaqo. Wuxuu tilmaamay in markii la aasay meydka Aabihii ay isla maalintaas guda galeen dhageysiga dacwadda, taas oo muujineysa sida ay uga go’nayd in kiiskaasi uu socdo. “Nimankaas December dhammaadkeeda ee sanadkaas ayaa la keenay maxkamadda kadib waxaan ballaminay taariikhda ku xigta ee la’isku imaanaayo markii aan sidaas ku ballaminay maalintii kiiska la geli lahaa habeenkii ka horreeyay ayaa wiil yar oo xaafadeenna deggan isoo wacay wuxuu igu yiri Aabaha iyo Hooyadaa ayaa xabad lagu dhifanowaa yaa ku wada? wiil yar oo shaati cad wata, waxyar kadib waa igu soo laabtay ninkii wuxuuna igu yiri Aabahaa waa la dilay,” ayuu iisii raaciyay,” Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii daray “Aabahey marka la dilaayo saddex maalin kahor ayuu ka yimid meel ay maamulaan Al-Shabaab mana jirin sabab loo dilo oo aanan ahayn kiiskan in la baajiyo maalintaas waa fahmay marka kadib waa aasnay maydka, isla subaxdi dacwadda ayaan horay ka aadnay”. items.title: Jubaland Forces Seize Government Offices in Beled-Hawo After Federal Intelligence Officers Defect
items.description: Jubaland forces have formally taken control of government facilities in Beled-Hawo, Gedo region, following the reported defection of federal intelligence officers stationed in the town to the Jubaland administration. The move enabled Jubaland forces to assume direct control of key government installations, including the Immigration and Citizenship Agency office, marking a significant development in the security and administrative situation in the border town. The takeover follows peace efforts led by the Jubaland administration, aimed at restoring government authority, security and public order in Beled-Hawo. The transfer of control over the government facilities is being viewed as a step towards re-establishing administrative operations and resuming the delivery of government services in the town. The latest development is expected to have implications for the local administration and security situation, as attention turns to the continuation of peace efforts and measures to maintain stability in Beled-Hawo. Further developments are likely to shape relations between the Jubaland administration and Somalia’s Federal Government, particularly regarding security arrangements and control of government institutions in the Gedo region. items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse  Sheegay inuu Kamid ahaa Dadkii ka Badbaaday Qaraxii Soobe
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa sheegay inuu ka mid ahaa dadkii ka badbaaday qaraxii weynaa ee 14-kii Oktoobar 2017 ka dhacay isgoyska Soobe ee magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo sababay dhimashada boqolaal qof iyo dhaawaca dad kale oo badan. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sheegay in xilliga uu qaraxu dhacay uu ku sugnaa guri ku yaallay agagaarka goobta uu musiibadu ka dhacday, isla markaana uu si dirqi ah uga badbaaday qaraxa oo sababay burbur xooggan. Wuxuu xusay in gurigii uu ku jiray uu waxyeello weyn ka soo gaartay qaraxa, isaga oo tilmaamay in dhacdadaasi ay ahayd mid si gaar ah u taabatay noloshiisa, maadaama uu ka mid noqday dadkii sida tooska ah u la kulmay musiibadaas. Qaraxii Soobe ee 14-kii Oktoobar 2017 ayaa ka mid ah qaraxyadii ugu khasaaraha badnaa taariikhda Soomaaliya, waxaana qaraxa oo ka dhacay isgoyska Soobe uu sababay dhimashada boqolaal qof, halka tiro kale ay ku dhaawacmeen, waxaana burbur xooggan uu soo gaaray dhismayaal iyo gaadiid ku sugnaa agagaarka goobta. Musiibadaasi ayaa weli xusuus murugo leh ku leh shacabka Soomaaliyeed, waxaana 14-ka Oktoobar loo asteeyay maalin lagu xusuusto dadkii ku naf waayay qaraxa iyo dadkii ku dhaawacmay. Kooxda Al-Shabaab ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay ka dambeysay qaraxaasi, inkastoo aysan si rasmi ah u sheegan mas’uuliyadda weerarka.

items.title: Somalia Marks Nine Years Since Deadly Zobe Bombing That Killed Hundreds
items.description: Somalia on Wednesday marks nine years since the devastating October 14, 2017, bombing at the Soobe junction in Mogadishu, one of the deadliest attacks in the country’s history, which killed hundreds of people and left hundreds more injured. The attack occurred on October 14, 2017, when a truck loaded with explosives detonated near the Safari Hotel in the capital’s Hodan district. The blast struck a busy commercial area, causing extensive destruction to buildings, businesses and vehicles, while inflicting devastating casualties on civilians. United Nations reports put the death toll at at least 587, with a further 316 people injured. The scale of the devastation made the bombing one of the deadliest attacks in Somalia and a defining tragedy in the country’s recent history. In the immediate aftermath, emergency responders, medical personnel and ordinary residents rushed to the scene to rescue survivors and transport the injured to hospitals. Medical facilities across Mogadishu were overwhelmed as casualties poured in, while families searched desperately for missing relatives. The bombing triggered an unprecedented public response, with Somalis mobilising to donate blood, provide emergency assistance and support victims and bereaved families. The collective response became a powerful demonstration of national solidarity in the face of a devastating humanitarian tragedy. Beyond the immediate loss of life and destruction, the attack left lasting consequences for survivors and families who lost loved ones. Many were left to cope with physical injuries, psychological trauma and the enduring pain of bereavement. Nine years on, the anniversary remains an occasion for remembrance and reflection on the devastating impact of violence against civilians. It also renews calls for stronger security measures, the protection of civilian lives and greater efforts to prevent similar attacks. As Somalia remembers the victims on October 14, 2026, the tragedy continues to hold a significant place in the country’s collective memory, serving as a reminder of the human cost of insecurity and the resilience demonstrated by communities in the aftermath of national crises. items.title: Xiisadda Itoobiya iyo Eritrea oo Sii Kordhaysa, Ciidamada Itoobiya oo ku Dhowaanaya Xuduudda
items.description: Xiisadda u dhexeysa Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa sii xoogeysanaysa, kaddib markii ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya ay u dhaqaaqeen dhanka magaalada xuduudda ku taalla ee Zalambessa, iyadoo dagaallo hor leh oo dib uga soo cusboonaaday gobolka Tigray ay sare u qaadeen cabsi laga qabo iska horimaad militari oo dhex mara labada dal. Warbixin ay wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters baahisay Talaadadii ayaa sheegtay in dhaq-dhaqaaqa ciidamada Itoobiya uu ku soo beegmayo xilli ay sii xumaanayaan xiriirka Addis Ababa iyo Asmara, kuwaas oo hore u ahaa xulafo intii uu socday dagaalkii Tigray ee 2020 ilaa 2022, balse hadda ay isku aragti ka duwan yihiin xaaladda amni ee gobolka. Sidoo kale, warbixin uu daabacay wargeyska The New York Times ayaa muujisay in labada dal ay ku sii siqayaan xaalad keeni karta dagaal, iyadoo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada milatari ee waqooyiga Itoobiya ay barbar socdaan khilaafaad muddo dheer soo jiray oo la xiriira murannada dhuleed, helitaanka badda iyo loollanka saameynta gobolka. Dagaallada dib uga soo cusboonaaday Tigray ayaa sii adkeeyay xaaladda amni ee waqooyiga Itoobiya, iyadoo laga cabsi qabo in xiisadda u dhexeysa labada dowladood ay isu beddesho iska horimaad toos ah. Dhanka kale, dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed ayaa socda si looga hortago in xaaladdu sii xumaato, loona yareeyo khatarta dagaal cusub oo saameyn ku yeelan kara Geeska Afrika. Haddii xiisaddani isu beddesho dagaal toos ah, waxaa laga cabsi qabaa inay saameyn ku yeelato xasilloonida gobolka, ganacsiga iyo xaaladda bani’aadannimo, gaar ahaan deegaannada ay hore u saameeyeen colaaduhu.

items.title: Madaxweynihii Hore ee DRC Joseph Kabila oo Isbahaysi Cusub la Sameystay Jabhadda M23
items.description: Madaxweynihii hore ee Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo (DRC), Joseph Kabila, ayaa ku dhawaaqay isbahaysi siyaasadeed iyo mid milatari oo cusub oo ay ku mideysan yihiin kooxaha hubeysan ee la dagaallamaya dowladda dalkaas, tallaabadaas oo sare u qaadaysa walaaca laga qabo in colaadda bariga dalkaasi ay sii xoogeysato. Kabila ayaa Isniintii magaalada Goma kaga dhawaaqay isbahaysiga cusub oo lagu magacaabo Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN) , kaas oo la doonayo inuu beddelo isbahaysigii hore ee M23 iyo Isbahaysiga Wabiga Congo (AFC). Kabila ayaa sheegay inuu hoggaamin doono isbahaysigan, halka mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan AFC iyo M23 loo magacaabay xilal kale oo hoggaamineed. Afhayeenka isbahaysiga cusub, Claude Ibalanky, ayaa sheegay in dhaqdhaqaaqa cusub uu doonayo inuu soo afjaro waxa uu ku tilmaamay kalitalisnimo, isaga oo aan meesha ka saarin adeegsiga xoogga. Hadalkan ayaa sii kordhiyey walaaca laga qabo in khilaafka u dhexeeya dowladda Kinshasa iyo kooxaha hubeysan uu yeesho weji cusub. Ku dhawaaqistan ayaa timid iyadoo dowladda Congo ay muddo dheer Kabila ku eedeyneysay inuu xiriir la leeyahay jabhadda M23 iyo isbahaysiga AFC. Bishii Oktoobar ee sannadkii hore, maxkamad milatari oo ku taalla Kinshasa ayaa dil ku xukuntay Kabila, iyadoo lagu eedeeyey khiyaano qaran, dambiyo dagaal iyo inuu la shaqeeyey kooxaha hubeysan. Kabila, oo dalka Congo hoggaaminayey intii u dhexeysay 2001 iyo 2019, ayaa sidoo kale bishii Abriil ee sannadkan cunaqabateyn kala kulmay Mareykanka, kaas oo ku eedeeyey inuu maalgeliyo kooxaha fallaagada. Bariga Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo ayaa muddo dheer la daalaa dhacayey colaado hubeysan oo salka ku haya muranno siyaasadeed, dhul, qowmiyado iyo kheyraadka dabiiciga ah. Jabhadda M23 ayaa dib u soo xoogeysatay sannadkii 2022, iyadoo dagaallo culus kula jirta ciidamada dowladda, isla markaana la wareegtay dhul ballaaran oo ku yaalla gobollada Waqooyiga iyo Koonfurta Kivu, oo ay ku jiraan magaalooyinka Goma iyo Bukavu. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in colaadaha dalkaasi ay sababeen barakaca in ka badan 7.8 milyan oo qof, halka ku dhowaad 28 milyan oo qof ay wajahayaan cunto yari. Mareykanka iyo Qaramada Midoobay ayaa Rwanda ku eedeeyey inay taageerto M23, balse dowladda Kigali ayaa eedeymahaas beenisay. , ayadoo dhanka kale, tallaabada Kabila ay walaac ka dhalisay mustaqbalka wada-hadallada nabadeed ee lagu doonayo in lagu soo afjaro colaadda.

Mareykanka iyo Qaramada Midoobay ayaa Rwanda ku eedeeyey inay taageerto M23, balse dowladda Kigali ayaa eedeymahaas beenisay. , ayadoo dhanka kale, tallaabada Kabila ay walaac ka dhalisay mustaqbalka wada-hadallada nabadeed ee lagu doonayo in lagu soo afjaro colaadda.

items.title: Fal-celin aan caadi ahayn oo ka dhalatay go’aanka golaha wasiirrada ee dastuurka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Falcelin aan caadi ahayn ayaa ka dhalatay tallaabadii ay xalay qaadeen golaha wasiirrada Soomaaliya, kadib markii ay ansixiyeen qaraar cusub oo lagu dardargelinayo dhaqan-gelinta Dastuurka dalka, kaas oo dhigaya in hay’adaha dowladda ay waafajiyaan shaqadooda qodobbada dastuuriga ah, isla markaana la diyaariyo xeer qeexaya tirada wasaaradaha iyo waajibaadkooda. Go’aankan ayaa lagu gaaray shir aan caadi ahayn oo uu guddoomiyey Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre, iyadoo goluhu uu magacaabay guddi heer wasiir ah iyo guddi farsamo oo isku dubbarida howlaha la xiriira hirgelinta Dastuurka. Qaraarka oo ka kooban shan qodob, laguna faahfaahiyey dokumenti laba bog ah oo kasoo baxay Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, ayaa faraya hay’adaha dowladda inay qaadaan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka u ah hirgelinta qodobbada Dastuurka ee aan u baahnayn in marka hore loo sameeyo xeerar kale. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre oo kulanka ka hadlay ayaa sheegay in Dastuurka cusub uu dhaqan galay, isla markaana fulintiisa loo marayo marxalado kala duwan oo lagu waafajinayo nidaamka maamulka iyo hay’adaha dowladda. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in xukuumaddu ay ka shaqaynayso sidii sannadka soo socda dalka looga qaban lahaa doorashooyin heer federaal ah oo ku dhisan nidaamka qof iyo cod. Go’aankan ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo 14-ka Oktoobar ay ku egtahay muddadii lixda bilood ahayd ee loo qabtay dhaqan-gelinta qodobbada Dastuurka ee kala saaraya xilalka wasiirnimada iyo xildhibaannimada. Haddaba sidee looga fal-celiyay go’aanka golaha wasiirrada ee dhaqan-gelinta Dastuurka? Avv Cali Cabdullahi: “Qodabka 4aad ayaa ugu muhiimsan, waana in la sameeyo xeerka nidaaminaaya xukuumadda (Law on the Council of Ministers), sidookale waa in lasameeyo Administrative Law (Sharciga Maamulka)”. Dr. Mahad Deerow: “Dastuurkii aad qorateen qeybta muddo xileedka miyaad ka qaadateen wasiir ahna xildhibaan goormee kala qaadeysaan”. Axmed Arad: ““Falaadhi gilgilasho kaagama hadho” baa la dhahaa arintaan”. Kamaal Xuseen: “Caruur maa u sheekeenaysan dastuur Waa kii 12kii dalkaan dastuur kale maleh”. Maxamed Cali Khaliiji: “Waxaas wax soconaayo ma’aha waa in xilibaannada iyo wasiirradaas hal meel haku toosaan arintaan baarlamaanka u talaa”. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Dastuurka cusub ayaa Baarlamaanka Federaalka ansixiyey 4-tii Maarso 2026, waxaana afar maalmood kaddib saxiixay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isagoo soo afjaray geeddi-socod dib-u-eegis dastuuri ah oo socday muddo ka badan toban sano. Hase yeeshee, wax ka beddelka Dastuurka ayaa weli xuddun u ah khilaaf siyaasadeed oo u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo qaar ka mid ah dhinacyada mucaaradka, oo ay ku jiraan Puntland iyo Jubbaland, kuwaas oo diiddan hannaanka loo maray iyo isbeddellada lagu sameeyey muddo-xileedyada hay’adaha federaalka. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo burbur u gaystay Xarunta Dhexe Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco
items.description: Waxyeelo ba’an ayaa soo gaartay Xarunta Dhexe Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco, ka dib markii Xuutiyiinta ay xalay weerar ku qaadeen. Xaruntan oo ku taala Magaalada Dhahran ee Bariga Sacuudiga ayaa waxaa qabsaday dab ku faafay dhowr dabaq, sida ay ku warantay Wakaaladda Wararka Reuters. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in howlihii shaqo ee ka socday xarunta ay sidoodii u socdaan, balse shaqaalaha la faray inay guryahooda ka soo shaqeeyaan. Xarunta Aramco ee Dhahran waxay kormeertaa dhammaan hawlgalada wax soo-saarka, sifeynta iyo dhoofinta saliidda ee shirkadda adduunka ugu weyn, iyadoo isticmaaleysa teknolojiyad casri ah oo lagu la socdo dhuumaha iyo ceelasha saliidda ee dhulka iyo baddaba ku yaala. Weerarkan ayaa yimid, ka dib markii isbahaysiga uu Sacuudiga hoggaamiyo ay garaaceen goob lagu kaydiyo shidaalka oo ku taala Magaalada Sanca. Ururka Xuutiyiinta ayaa ka hor weerarkaasi ka digay in la bartilmaameedsado goobaha shidaalka ee Sanca, iyagoo daba jooga digniin uu soo saaray isbahaysiga. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ayaa la sheegay inay habeenkii Talaadada gantaal nooca ballaastikada ku dhufteen Xarunta Shirkadda Aramco ee Dhahran, iyadoo laga jawaabayo duqaynta ka dhacday Sanca. Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sii wada weerarada ay ku hayaan kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo militariga ee gudaha Sacuudiga, wuxuuna General Yahya Saree, Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta uu ku hanjabay inay sii socon doonaan weeraradooda, illaa iyo inta uu Sacuudiga ka joojinayo gardarrada uu ku hayo dalkaasi, sida uu yiri.

items.description: Shirweynaha Qaran ee Ka Hortagga iyo La-Dagaallanka Fikirka Xagjirka ah oo ka Furmay Muqdisho Waxaa magaalada Muqdisho ka furmay Shirweynaha Qaran ee ka hortagga iyo la-dagaallanka fikirka xagjirka ah, kaas oo ay ka qaybgalayaan mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, xildhibaanno, saraakiil ka socda hay’adaha amniga, culimada diinta iyo wakiillo ka socda bulshada rayidka ah. Shirweynaha ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa sidii loo xoojin lahaa dadaallada lagu wajahayo fikirka xagjirka ah, loo horumarin lahaa wacyigelinta bulshada, loona adkayn lahaa iskaashiga u dhexeeya dowladda, culimada iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Inta uu shirku socdo, waxaa la filayaa in laga hadlo qorshayaasha dowladda ee la xiriira ka hortagga fikirka xagjirka ah, iyadoo sidoo kale la falanqayn doono doorka ay culimada, bulshada rayidka ah iyo hay’adaha amnigu ku leeyihiin wacyigelinta bulshada iyo ka hortagga faafitaanka fikradaha xagjirka ah. Soomaaliya ayaa muddo ku dhow labaatan sano la tacaalaysay dhibaatooyinka ka dhashay kooxaha xagjirka ah iyo amni-darrada la xiriirta, kuwaas oo saameyn ku yeeshay nabadda, amniga iyo nolosha bulshada. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa dadaalladeeda ku wajahan la-dagaallanka kooxahaas ku darsanaysa ka hortagga fikirka xagjirka ah, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo wacyigelinta, faafinta fahamka diinta ee dhexdhexaadka ah iyo sidii bulshada looga ilaalin lahaa fikradaha horseedi kara rabshadaha.

items.title: Ciidanka Itoobiya oo gaaray xadka Eritrea kuna dhow in ay…
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya ayaa Talaadadii gaaray magaalada Zalambessa ee ku taalla xadka Eritrea, kaddib markii ay halkaasi dib uga riixeen xoogaggii fallaagada Tigray, xilli ay sii kordhayaan walaaca laga qabo in xiisadda labada dal ay isu beddesho dagaal toos ah. Dhaqdhaqaaqan militari ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo diblomaasiyiinta caalamku ay dadaal ugu jiraan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dagaal cusub oo dhex mara Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, kuwaas oo mar kale isku haya arrimo amni iyo muranka ku saabsan damaca Itoobiya ee helitaanka marin badeed. Lix ilo wareed, oo ay ku jiraan afar qof oo xiriir la leh dadka deegaanka, diblomaasi iyo khabiir ku xeeldheer colaadda, ayaa wakaaladda Reuters u sheegay in ciidamada Itoobiya ay Talaadadii gaareen Zalambessa, oo ah magaalo ay ku nool yihiin qiyaastii 15,000 oo qof. Magaaladan oo ku taalla dhanka Itoobiya ee xadka Eritrea ayaa horay gacanta ugu jirtay xoogagga Tigray, balse ciidamada dowladda federaalka ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyey waday weerarro rogaalcelis ah oo ay dib ugu qabsanayaan deegaannadii laga saaray. Goobjoogayaal iyo hay’ad la socota colaadaha ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Eritrea ay toddobaadkii hore kasoo gudbeen xadka, ayna galeen Zalambessa si ay u taageeraan fallaagada Tigray. Hase yeeshee, ma cadda in ciidamada Eritrea iyo xoogaggii ay taageerayeen ay weli ku sugnaayeen magaalada Talaadadii. Hay’adda ACLED, oo diiwaangelisa colaadaha, ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya iyo maleeshiyaadka dowladda taageera ee Tigray Peace Force ay Isniintii la wareegeen Zalambessa iyo deegaanka Fatsi, iyadoo ciidamada Eritrea ay dib uga gudbeen xadka. Si kastaba, afhayeen u hadlay maleeshiyaad taageera dowladda Itoobiya ma uusan xaqiijin in ciidamada federaalku ay si buuxda ula wareegeen magaalada, halka taliska ciidanka Itoobiya iyo xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed aysan jawaab degdeg ah ka bixin codsiyo loo diray. Dagaallada dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya bishii Sebtembar ayaa bilowday markii isbahaysi fallaago ah oo uu hoggaaminayo Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray (TPLF) uu qaaday weerarro ka dhan ah dowladda federaalka. Hase yeeshee, ciidamada dowladda ayaa tan iyo markaas dib u qabsaday magaalooyin dhowr ah, iyagoo ku qasbay fallaagada inay dhanka waqooyi u gurtaan. Itoobiya iyo Eritrea oo isku dacweeyey QM Horumarkan militari ayaa sii xoojiyey xiisadda diblomaasiyadeed ee u dhexeysa Addis Ababa iyo Asmara, iyadoo labada dowladood ay Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay u gudbiyeen waraaqo ay midba midda kale ku eedeynayso gardarro iyo hurinta colaadda. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa Eritrea ku eedeysay inay taageerto fallaagada ka dagaallamaysa waqooyiga dalka, waxayna sheegtay in ciidamo Eritrean ah ay gudaha dhulkeeda usoo galeen masaafo dhan 60 kiiloomitir. Addis Ababa ayaa warqad ay u dirtay Golaha Ammaanka ku sheegtay in joogitaanka ciidamada shisheeye ee dhulkeeda uu ku khasbayo inay qaaddo tallaabooyin ay isku difaacayso. Dhankeeda, Eritrea ayaa si adag u beenisay eedeymahaas, iyadoo ku tilmaantay isku day ay Itoobiya ku raadineyso marmarsiiyo ay dagaal ku qaaddo dalkeeda. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Eritrea, Osman Saleh, ayaa Golaha Ammaanka ka dalbaday inuu cambaareeyo waxa uu ku tilmaamay ku dhawaaqista dagaal ee Itoobiya, isla markaana uu qaado tallaabooyin looga hortagayo gardarro militari. Saleh ayaa codsigiisa ku saleeyey cutubka toddobaad ee Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay, kaas oo Golaha Ammaanka awood u siinaya inuu soo rogo cunaqabateyn ama oggolaado tallaabooyin militari oo lagu ilaalinayo nabadda iyo ammaanka caalamka. Golaha Ammaanka ayaa lagu waday inuu Talaadadii yeesho kulan albaabadu u xiran yihiin oo looga hadlayo xaaladda Geeska Afrika, kaddib markii Mareykanku codsaday in xubnaha goluhu ka arrinsadaan colaadda sii xoogeysanaysa. Kulankan ayaa noqonaya kii labaad ee muddo laba toddobaad gudahood ah ay xubnaha Golaha Ammaanku kaga hadlaan xaaladda waqooyiga Itoobiya, taas oo muujinaysa walaaca caalamiga ah ee laga qabo in dagaalku ku fido dalalka deriska ah. Muranka badda iyo xiriirka labada dal Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa muddo dheer lahaa xiriir colaadeed, balse waxay heshiis nabadeed gaareen sanadkii 2018, markii uu Abiy Ahmed bilaabay dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu soo afjarayo khilaafkii labada dal. Xiriirkooda ayaa markaas hagaagay, iyadoo Eritrea ay ciidamada dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ka garab dagaallantay dagaalkii Tigray ee socday intii u dhexeysay 2020 iyo 2022, kaas oo ay ku dhinteen boqollaal kun oo qof. Si kastaba, xiriirka labada dal ayaa mar kale xumaaday, gaar ahaan markii Itoobiya ay billowday inay si xooggan uga hadasho baahida ay u qabto marin ay ku gaarto badda. Itoobiya ayaa lumisay xeebihii ay isticmaali jirtay markii Eritrea ay xornimada qaadatay sanadkii 1993, waxaana tan iyo markaas ay ku tiirsaneyd dekedaha dalalka deriska ah. Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed ayaa ku dooday in helitaanka marin badeed uu yahay arrin muhiim u ah mustaqbalka iyo jiritaanka dhaqaale ee Itoobiya, inkastoo dowladdiisu ay sheegtay inay doonayso in arrintaas lagu xalliyo wadahadal iyo hannaan nabadeed. Eritrea ayaa dhankeeda ka walaacsan hadallada Itoobiya ee ku saabsan marin badeedka, iyadoo u aragta inay halis ku yihiin madax-bannaanideeda iyo ammaankeeda. Xiisadda hadda taagan ayaa sidaas darteed ka gudubtay dagaalka gudaha Itoobiya, waxaana sii kordhaya cabsida laga qabo in iska horimaadyada Tigray ay isu beddelaan dagaal goboleed ballaaran, xilli Geeska Afrika iyo gobolka Badda Cas ay horeba uga jiraan khilaafaad amni iyo kuwo siyaasadeed. Magaaladan oo ku taalla dhanka Itoobiya ee xadka Eritrea ayaa horay gacanta ugu jirtay xoogagga Tigray, balse ciidamada dowladda federaalka ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyey waday weerarro rogaalcelis ah oo ay dib ugu qabsanayaan deegaannadii laga saaray. Goobjoogayaal iyo hay’ad la socota colaadaha ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Eritrea ay toddobaadkii hore kasoo gudbeen xadka, ayna galeen Zalambessa si ay u taageeraan fallaagada Tigray. Hase yeeshee, ma cadda in ciidamada Eritrea iyo xoogaggii ay taageerayeen ay weli ku sugnaayeen magaalada Talaadadii. Hay’adda ACLED, oo diiwaangelisa colaadaha, ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya iyo maleeshiyaadka dowladda taageera ee Tigray Peace Force ay Isniintii la wareegeen Zalambessa iyo deegaanka Fatsi, iyadoo ciidamada Eritrea ay dib uga gudbeen xadka. Si kastaba, afhayeen u hadlay maleeshiyaad taageera dowladda Itoobiya ma uusan xaqiijin in ciidamada federaalku ay si buuxda ula wareegeen magaalada, halka taliska ciidanka Itoobiya iyo xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed aysan jawaab degdeg ah ka bixin codsiyo loo diray. Dagaallada dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya bishii Sebtembar ayaa bilowday markii isbahaysi fallaago ah oo uu hoggaaminayo Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray (TPLF) uu qaaday weerarro ka dhan ah dowladda federaalka. Hase yeeshee, ciidamada dowladda ayaa tan iyo markaas dib u qabsaday magaalooyin dhowr ah, iyagoo ku qasbay fallaagada inay dhanka waqooyi u gurtaan. Itoobiya iyo Eritrea oo isku dacweeyey QM Horumarkan militari ayaa sii xoojiyey xiisadda diblomaasiyadeed ee u dhexeysa Addis Ababa iyo Asmara, iyadoo labada dowladood ay Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay u gudbiyeen waraaqo ay midba midda kale ku eedeynayso gardarro iyo hurinta colaadda. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa Eritrea ku eedeysay inay taageerto fallaagada ka dagaallamaysa waqooyiga dalka, waxayna sheegtay in ciidamo Eritrean ah ay gudaha dhulkeeda usoo galeen masaafo dhan 60 kiiloomitir. Addis Ababa ayaa warqad ay u dirtay Golaha Ammaanka ku sheegtay in joogitaanka ciidamada shisheeye ee dhulkeeda uu ku khasbayo inay qaaddo tallaabooyin ay isku difaacayso. Dhankeeda, Eritrea ayaa si adag u beenisay eedeymahaas, iyadoo ku tilmaantay isku day ay Itoobiya ku raadineyso marmarsiiyo ay dagaal ku qaaddo dalkeeda. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Eritrea, Osman Saleh, ayaa Golaha Ammaanka ka dalbaday inuu cambaareeyo waxa uu ku tilmaamay ku dhawaaqista dagaal ee Itoobiya, isla markaana uu qaado tallaabooyin looga hortagayo gardarro militari. Saleh ayaa codsigiisa ku saleeyey cutubka toddobaad ee Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay, kaas oo Golaha Ammaanka awood u siinaya inuu soo rogo cunaqabateyn ama oggolaado tallaabooyin militari oo lagu ilaalinayo nabadda iyo ammaanka caalamka. Golaha Ammaanka ayaa lagu waday inuu Talaadadii yeesho kulan albaabadu u xiran yihiin oo looga hadlayo xaaladda Geeska Afrika, kaddib markii Mareykanku codsaday in xubnaha goluhu ka arrinsadaan colaadda sii xoogeysanaysa. Kulankan ayaa noqonaya kii labaad ee muddo laba toddobaad gudahood ah ay xubnaha Golaha Ammaanku kaga hadlaan xaaladda waqooyiga Itoobiya, taas oo muujinaysa walaaca caalamiga ah ee laga qabo in dagaalku ku fido dalalka deriska ah. Muranka badda iyo xiriirka labada dal Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa muddo dheer lahaa xiriir colaadeed, balse waxay heshiis nabadeed gaareen sanadkii 2018, markii uu Abiy Ahmed bilaabay dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu soo afjarayo khilaafkii labada dal. Xiriirkooda ayaa markaas hagaagay, iyadoo Eritrea ay ciidamada dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ka garab dagaallantay dagaalkii Tigray ee socday intii u dhexeysay 2020 iyo 2022, kaas oo ay ku dhinteen boqollaal kun oo qof. Si kastaba, xiriirka labada dal ayaa mar kale xumaaday, gaar ahaan markii Itoobiya ay billowday inay si xooggan uga hadasho baahida ay u qabto marin ay ku gaarto badda. Itoobiya ayaa lumisay xeebihii ay isticmaali jirtay markii Eritrea ay xornimada qaadatay sanadkii 1993, waxaana tan iyo markaas ay ku tiirsaneyd dekedaha dalalka deriska ah. Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed ayaa ku dooday in helitaanka marin badeed uu yahay arrin muhiim u ah mustaqbalka iyo jiritaanka dhaqaale ee Itoobiya, inkastoo dowladdiisu ay sheegtay inay doonayso in arrintaas lagu xalliyo wadahadal iyo hannaan nabadeed. Eritrea ayaa dhankeeda ka walaacsan hadallada Itoobiya ee ku saabsan marin badeedka, iyadoo u aragta inay halis ku yihiin madax-bannaanideeda iyo ammaankeeda. Xiisadda hadda taagan ayaa sidaas darteed ka gudubtay dagaalka gudaha Itoobiya, waxaana sii kordhaya cabsida laga qabo in iska horimaadyada Tigray ay isu beddelaan dagaal goboleed ballaaran, xilli Geeska Afrika iyo gobolka Badda Cas ay horeba uga jiraan khilaafaad amni iyo kuwo siyaasadeed. items.title: Maxamed Bin Salmaan oo diiday codsi uga yimid Israa’iil oo ku saabsanaa Xuutiyiinta
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Dhaxal-sugaha Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, Maxamed Bin Salmaan, ayaa diiday dalab uga yimid Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil, Benjamin Netanyahu, oo ku saabsanaa in Israa’iil ay ku biirto dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee dalka Yemen, sida ay werisay warbaahinta Israa’iil. Wargeyska Israa’iil ee Haaretz ayaa sheegay in Netanyahu uu dalabkaas u gudbiyey Sacuudiga isaga oo adeegsanaya dhexdhexaadinta Mareykanka, waxaana qorshaha Israa’iil uu ahaa in iskaashiga milatari ee ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta uu horseedo soo dhaweynta xiriirka labada dal. Hase yeeshee, Maxamed Bin Salmaan ayaa ka soo horjeestay qorshahan, isaga oo ka cabsi qabay in iskaashi milatari oo dhex mara Sacuudiga iyo Israa’iil uu caro xooggan ka dhex abuuro shacabka boqortooyada, sida uu wargeysku ka soo xigtay ilo diblomaasiyadeed oo xog-ogaal u ah wada-hadallada. Warbixinta ayaa intaas ku dartay in Israa’iil ay dagaalka dib uga qarxay Yemen u aragtay fursad ay dib ugu soo nooleyn karto dadaalladii lagu doonayey in xiriir diblomaasiyadeed looga dhex dhiso labada dal, kuwaas oo muddo dheer uu Mareykanku waday. Sacuudiga ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga jawaabin warbixinta ku saabsan dalabka Netanyahu, mana jiro xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo rasmi ah oo ka dhexeeya Riyadh iyo Tel Aviv. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump iyo Netanyahu ayaa muddo dheer ku dadaalayey in Sacuudigu ku biiro dalalkii Carabta ee xiriirka la sameystay Israa’iil sanadkii 2020, oo ay ka mid yihiin Imaaraadka Carabta, Baxreyn iyo Morocco. Si kastaba, dagaalka Gaza ee billowday bishii Oktoobar 2023 ayaa caqabad weyn ku noqday dadaalladaas, iyadoo Sacuudigu uu ku adkeysanayo in xiriir rasmi ah oo lala yeesho Israa’iil uu ku xirnaan doono xal loo helo qaddiyadda Falastiin, oo ay ku jirto dhismaha dowlad Falastiini ah. Diidmada Maxamed Bin Salmaan ayaa muujineysa caqabadaha siyaasadeed ee weli hortaagan isku soo dhowaanshaha labada dal, inkastoo ay wadaagaan walaaca laga qabo saameynta Iiraan iyo kooxaha ay taageerto ee gobolka. Dhanka kale, dalabka Israa’iil ayaa ku soo aadaya xilli uu si weyn u sii xoogeysanayo dagaalka u dhexeeya Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta, kaas oo sababay weerarro isdaba joog ah oo lagu qaaday garoomada diyaaradaha iyo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha boqortooyada. Sabtidii, weerar lagu qaaday garoonka caalamiga ah ee King Khalid ee magaalada Riyadh ayaa dilay 12 qof, halka ay ku dhaawacmeen 309 kale, sida ay shaacisay Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Sacuudiga. Tirada dhimashada ayaa markii dambe gaartay 13 qof, kaddib markii muwaadin u dhashay Hindiya oo dhaawacmay uu geeriyooday, sida ay werisay wakaaladda wararka Reuters. Netanyahu ayaa cambaareeyey weerarka, isaga oo tacsi u diray qoysaska dadkii ku dhintay, una rajeeyey caafimaad degdeg ah dadkii ku dhaawacmay. “Waxaan si adag u cambaareynayaa weerarkii argagixiso ee foosha xumaa ee lagu qaaday garoonka caalamiga ah ee King Khalid ee magaalada Riyaad, kaas oo galaaftay nolosha 12 qof oo aan waxba galabsan, boqolaal kalena ku dhaawacay,” ayuu Netanyahu ku qoray bartiisa X. Dhinaca diblomaasiyadda, Iiraan ayaa Sacuudiga ugu baaqday inuu ka fogaado sii ballaarinta dagaalka, isla markaana uu mudnaanta siiyo xal siyaasadeed oo lagu soo afjaro colaadda Yemen. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan, Cabbaas Caraqchi, ayaa Axaddii khadka taleefanka kula hadlay dhiggiisa Sacuudiga, Amiir Faysal Bin Farxaan, isaga oo u soo bandhigay in Tehran ay gacan ka geysan karto wada-hadallo lagu raadinayo xal siyaasadeed. Caraqchi ayaa ka digay in ku adkeysiga xalka milatari iyo iska indhatirka wada-hadallada siyaasadeed ay sii adkeyn doonaan xaaladda gobolka, isaga oo sheegay in colaadaha ka socda Bariga Dhexe aan lagu xallin karin awood ciidan oo keliya. Sidoo kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa Talaadadii sheegay inay gobolka Sacda ee waqooyiga Yemen ku soo rideen diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo nooca Wing Loong II ah, taas oo ay leeyihiin ciidamada Sacuudiga. Afhayeenka milatariga kooxda, Yaxya Sareec, ayaa sheegay in diyaaradda ay fulineysay hawlgallo ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta markii la beegsaday. Dagaalka Yemen ayaa billowday sanadkii 2014, markii Xuutiyiintu qabsadeen magaalada Sanca, halka Sacuudigu uu sanadkii 2015 hoggaamiyey isbaheysi milatari oo farageliyey Yemen si uu u taageero dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay. Colaadda ayaa muddo yara degganeyd kaddib xabbad-joojin la gaaray sanadkii 2022, balse xiisadda ayaa mar kale xoogeysatay, iyadoo weerarrada ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga ay sare u qaadeen walaaca laga qabo in gobolka uu galo dagaal ballaaran. Xaaladdan ayaa Sacuudiga gelisay marxalad adag oo dhinaca amniga iyo diblomaasiyadda ah, iyadoo boqortooyadu ay dooneyso inay iska difaacdo weerarrada Xuutiyiinta, balse ay weli ka fogaaneyso iskaashi milatari oo toos ah oo ay la yeelato Israa’iil. items.title: Dib u Milicso 9 Sano Ka Hor Qarixii Soobe iyo 14-ka Oktoobar oo Dadka Soomaaliyeed ugu Suntan Maalin Madow
items.description: 14-kii Oktoobar, Sanadkii 2017, Soomaaliya waxaa ka dhacay mid ka mid ah qaraxyadii ugu waaweynaa uguna khasaaraha badnaa taariikhda dalka, kaas oo ka dhacay isgoyska Soobe ee magaalada Muqdisho, isla markaana sababay dhimashada boqolaal qof iyo dhaawaca dad kale oo aad u tiro badan. Qaraxa ayaa dhacay xilli gaari weyn oo walxaha qarxa laga soo buuxiyey uu ku qarxay agagaarka isgoyska Soobe, oo ka mid ah goobaha ugu mashquulka badan caasimadda. Dhimashada iyo dhaawaca baaxadda leh ka  sokow qaraxa ayaa sababay burbur xooggan, wuxuuna waxyeello u geystay dhismayaal, gaadiid iyo ganacsiyo ku yaallay halkaas. Dad badan oo xilligaas marayey waddada, shaqaale, ganacsato iyo dad kale oo hawlahooda maalinlaha ah ku jiray ayaa ku naf waayey musiibadaas. Qaraxa Soobe ayaa murugo weyn ku abuuray shacabka Soomaaliyeed, waxaana dalka iyo dibaddaba ka dhacay tacsi iyo cambaarayn xooggan. Kumannaan qof ayaa isu abaabulay gurmad, dhiig-bixin iyo taageeridda dadkii ku dhaawacmay ama eheladoodu ku waayeen musiibada. Weerarka ayaa lala xariiriyey kooxda Alshabaab, inkasta oo faahfaahinta mas’uuliyadda weerarka aysan cidina ku dhiirran sheegadiisa. Musiibadaas kaddib, 14-ka Oktoobar waxaa loo asteeyey maalin lagu xuso dadkii ku dhintay qaraxa Soobe iyo dhammaan dadkii kale ee Soomaaliyeed ee naftooda ku waayey falalka argagixisada. Maalintan waxaa lagu xusuustaa dhibbanayaashii, geesinnimadii dadkii gurmadka sameeyey iyo isku-duubnidii shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Qaraxii Soobe wuxuu xusuus murugo leh ku reebay taariikhda Soomaaliya, isagoo muujiyey khasaaraha baaxadda leh ee ay falalka argagixisadu u geystaan bulshada iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay ilaalinta nolosha dadka rayidka ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee maalinta 14-ka Oktoobar waxay shacabka Soomaaliyeed u tahay maalin xusuus, tacsi iyo garab istaag loo muujiyo qoysaskii ay musiibadu saamaysay.

items.title: Taliska Booliska Waqooyi Bari oo u Digey Dhiggiisa Puntland
items.description: Taliska Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Sool ee Dowlad-goboleedka Waqooyi Bari ayaa soo saaray war-saxaafadeed uu ku muujiyey walaac ku saabsan hadal uu sheegay inuu ka soo yeedhay Taliska Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Nugaal, kaas oo la xiriira nidaamka amniga bulshada iyo habraacyada wada-shaqaynta laamaha amniga. War-saxaafadeedka oo ku taariikhaysan 14-ka Oktoobar 2026, ayaa lagu sheegay in Taliska Booliska Gobolka Sool uu ka xun yahay hadalka laga soo xigtay dhiggiisa Gobolka Nugaal, isagoo xusay in arrimaha amniga bulshada iyo habraacyada wada-shaqaynta laamaha amniga ay u baahan yihiin isku-duubni iyo wada-shaqayn. items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka oo Shaaciyey Jadwalka Doorashada Hoggaamiyaha iyo Guddoonka Baarlamaanka Galmudug
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iayaa shaaciyey jadwalka doorashada guddoonka Golaha Wakiillada Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug iyo hoggaanka sare ee maamulkaas, kuwaas oo la qorsheeyey inay qabsoomaan inta u dhexeysa 13-ka iyo 22-ka Oktoobar 2026. Sida ku cad jadwalka uu guddigu soo saaray, doorashada guddoonka Golaha Wakiillada Galmudug ayaa la shaaciyay 13-kii Oktoobar, halka 14-ka iyo 15-ka Oktoobar ay dhici doonaan hawlaha diyaarinta iyo doorashooyinka la xiriira ku-xigeennada guddoonka. Dhaarinta Golaha Wakiillada ayaa jadwalka lagu sheegay 16-ka Oktoobar, halka qabashada araajida musharraxiinta guddoonka iyo ku-xigeennada golaha loo qorsheeyey 17-ka Oktoobar. Hadal-jeedinta musharraxiinta iyo doorashada guddoonka ayaa la filayaa inay dhacaan 18-ka Oktoobar. Dhanka doorashada hoggaamiyaha iyo ku-xigeenka hoggaamiyaha Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, guddigu wuxuu sheegay in qabashada araajida musharraxiinta ay bilaaban doonto 19-ka Oktoobar, halka hadal-jeedinta musharraxiinta loo asteeyey 21-ka Oktoobar. Doorashada hoggaamiyaha iyo ku-xigeenka hoggaamiyaha Galmudug ayaa ugu dambayn loo qorsheeyey 22-ka Oktoobar 2026, sida ku cad jadwalka la shaaciyey. Jadwalkan ayaa qeexaya marxaladaha kala duwan ee doorashooyinka Galmudug, laga bilaabo doorashada hoggaanka Golaha Wakiillada ilaa doorashada hoggaanka sare ee maamulka.

items.title: Golaha wasiirada oo go’aan cusub ka gaaray dhaqan-gelinta dastuurka cusub
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Wasiirrada Soomaaliya ayaa xalay ansixiyey qaraar cusub oo lagu dardargelinayo dhaqan-gelinta Dastuurka dalka, kaas oo dhigaya in hay’adaha dowladda ay waafajiyaan shaqadooda qodobbada dastuuriga ah, isla markaana la diyaariyo xeer qeexaya tirada wasaaradaha iyo waajibaadkooda. Go’aankan ayaa lagu gaaray shir aan caadi ahayn oo uu guddoomiyey Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre, iyadoo goluhu uu magacaabay guddi heer wasiir ah iyo guddi farsamo oo isku dubbarida howlaha la xiriira hirgelinta Dastuurka. Qaraarka oo ka kooban shan qodob, laguna faahfaahiyey dokumenti laba bog ah oo kasoo baxay Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, ayaa faraya hay’adaha dowladda inay qaadaan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka u ah hirgelinta qodobbada Dastuurka ee aan u baahnayn in marka hore loo sameeyo xeerar kale. Sida ku cad qaraarka, tallaabadan ayaa looga gol leeyahay in laga fogaado dib-u-dhac iyo firaaq sharci oo ka dhasha hirgelinta Dastuurka, iyadoo la dejinayo hannaan mideysan oo hay’adaha dowladda ku hagaya gudashada waajibaadkooda. Guddiga cusub iyo xeerka xukuumadda Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa guddiga heer wasiir u magacaabay inuu hoggaamiyo dardargelinta, isku dubbaridka iyo jadwaleynta howlaha dhaqan-gelinta Dastuurka, isla markaana dabagal ku sameeyo qorshayaasha ay hay’adaha dowladdu fulinayaan. Guddigan waxaa guddoomiye ka ah Wasiirka Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka, waxaana xubno ka ah wasiirrada Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta, Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka, Maaliyadda, Waxbarashada, Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska. Qodobka afraad ee qaraarka ayaa dhigaya in muddo aan ka badnayn laba bilood lagu diyaariyo hindise-xeerka nidaaminta xukuumadda, kaas oo qeexaya tirada wasaaradaha iyo waajibaadka ay kala leeyihiin. Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sheegay in xeerkan uu noqon doono kii ugu horreeyey ee noociisa ah ee dalka yeesho tan iyo sanadkii 1968-kii, taas oo ka dhigan in dowladda ay doonayso inay qaab sharciyeed cusub u dejiso dhismaha iyo shaqooyinka wasaaradaha. Hase yeeshee, qaraarka lama shaacin wax tiro ah oo lagu soo koobayo ama lagu kordhinayo wasaaradaha, iyadoo arrintaasi ay qayb ka noqon doonto hindise-xeerka la diyaarinayo. Sidoo kale, Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka iyo hay’adaha kale ee ay khusayso faray inay dadweynaha la wadaagaan hannaanka dhaqan-gelinta Dastuurka iyo tallaabooyinka laga qaaday hirgelintiisa. Dhaqan-gelinta dastuurka iyo khilaafka siyaasadeed Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre oo kulanka ka hadlay ayaa sheegay in Dastuurka cusub uu dhaqan galay, isla markaana fulintiisa loo marayo marxalado kala duwan oo lagu waafajinayo nidaamka maamulka iyo hay’adaha dowladda. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in xukuumaddu ay ka shaqaynayso sidii sannadka soo socda dalka looga qaban lahaa doorashooyin heer federaal ah oo ku dhisan nidaamka qof iyo cod. Go’aankan ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo 14-ka Oktoobar ay ku egtahay muddadii lixda bilood ahayd ee loo qabtay dhaqan-gelinta qodobbada Dastuurka ee kala saaraya xilalka wasiirnimada iyo xildhibaannimada. Guddiga Madaxbannaan ee Dib-u-eegista iyo Hirgelinta Dastuurka ayaa toddobaadkii hore sheegay in xubnaha xukuumadda ee sidoo kale ah xildhibaannada laga doonayo inay kala doortaan labada xil, marka ay dhammaato muddada kala-guurka. Qaraarka cusub ee Golaha Wasiirrada si gaar ah ugama hadlin tallaabooyinka laga qaadayo xubnaha ay arrintaasi khusayso marka la gaaro 14-ka Oktoobar. Dastuurka cusub ayaa Baarlamaanka Federaalka ansixiyey 4-tii Maarso 2026, waxaana afar maalmood kaddib saxiixay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isagoo soo afjaray geeddi-socod dib-u-eegis dastuuri ah oo socday muddo ka badan toban sano. Hase yeeshee, wax ka beddelka Dastuurka ayaa weli xuddun u ah khilaaf siyaasadeed oo u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo qaar ka mid ah dhinacyada mucaaradka, oo ay ku jiraan Puntland iyo Jubbaland, kuwaas oo diiddan hannaanka loo maray iyo isbeddellada lagu sameeyey muddo-xileedyada hay’adaha federaalka. The post Golaha wasiirada oo go’aan cusub ka gaaray dhaqan-gelinta dastuurka cusub appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia’s land evictions: Public property sold to business interests as displaced families are left homeless
items.description: Heritage Institute report says more than 2.1 million people were forcibly evicted between 2017 and September 2026, raising serious questions about the fate of public land, the proceeds from its sale and the government’s failure to resettle displaced families. MOGADISHU (WDN) — The forced eviction of IDPs and the illegal seizure of public land without due process continue to undermine the rule of law and deepen the suffering of vulnerable communities. More than 2.1 million people in Somalia were forcibly evicted from their homes between 2017 and September 2026, according to a report by the Heritage Institute for Policy Studies, with the Banadir region accounting for nearly two-thirds of recorded cases. The figures highlight a deepening displacement crisis in Mogadishu and surrounding areas. But beyond the scale of the evictions, serious questions remain over the fate of public land cleared by government authorities, reports that some of the vacated properties were subsequently sold to business interests, and whether the proceeds were deposited into the public treasury. Equally troubling are concerns that displaced families were left without adequate alternative accommodation or meaningful government assistance. The report identifies Banadir as the epicentre of forced evictions, accounting for 64 per cent of recorded cases. More than one million people in the region were reportedly forced from the places where they had been living. The figures raise fundamental questions about the government’s responsibility to protect vulnerable citizens, manage public property transparently and ensure that urban development does not become a vehicle for dispossession. Public land, private interests and unanswered questions A particularly contentious issue is the clearance of land and buildings owned by the state. Public property is held for the benefit of the public, and any decision to sell or transfer it should be supported by a clear legal basis, transparent procedures and proper financial accounting. Where public land cleared of occupants is subsequently sold to private business interests, authorities should disclose who authorised the transactions, who purchased the properties, how much was paid and where the money went. If proceeds from the sale of public assets were not deposited into the national treasury, the government should explain how the transactions were accounted for and whether any investigation has been conducted. These questions are especially urgent when the people displaced from the same properties have received neither alternative housing nor adequate compensation. The available report figures do not, by themselves, establish that every cleared property was sold, or that sale proceeds were diverted. Those allegations require documentary evidence, including land-transfer records, sale agreements, treasury receipts and official financial accounts. Nevertheless, the reported scale of displacement makes independent scrutiny essential. Families evicted with little warning The Heritage Institute recorded 84 protests against forced evictions between April 2025 and March 2026, of which 78 took place in Mogadishu. Some demonstrations reportedly resulted in arrests and injuries, while deaths occurred in certain incidents. The report also recorded 143,548 people facing forced eviction across Somalia in 2025 alone. Approximately 44 per cent of those affected were living on government-owned land. One prominent example occurred in July 2025, when an operation cleared the former Ministry of Health compound in Mogadishu, reportedly displacing nearly 120 families without adequate warning. Some families had lived at the site for more than 14 years. For households already struggling with poverty and displacement, losing shelter can mean losing access to work, education, healthcare and the fragile support networks on which survival depends. Without alternative accommodation or compensation, eviction can push families into deeper insecurity and expose them to repeated displacement. Government accountability cannot stop at eviction The state has a legitimate interest in recovering public land and enforcing lawful property arrangements. But the exercise of that authority must be transparent, proportionate and consistent with the law. Public ownership should not become a justification for dispossessing vulnerable families without safeguards, nor should the recovery of public property leave unanswered questions about its subsequent commercial use. The government should publish an independently verifiable account of public properties cleared of occupants, identify any assets sold or transferred to private parties, disclose the prices and buyers, and confirm whether all proceeds were paid into the treasury. It should also explain what measures were taken to provide displaced families with alternative accommodation, compensation or other appropriate assistance. Where allegations of irregular sales or missing public revenue arise, an independent audit and investigation would help establish the facts and identify any wrongdoing. Somalia’s displacement crisis is not simply a housing problem. It is also a test of public accountability, property rights and the integrity of government institutions. The central question is stark: if public land was cleared, sold to business interests and the displaced families were left without accommodation, who benefited from the transactions—and where did the money go? The public deserves documented answers, not silence. items.title: Tanzania oo Ku Dhaw Dhammaystirka Mashruuc Gaas oo $42 Bilyan Ku Kacaya
items.description: Dowladda Tanzania ayaa la filayaa inay bilaha soo socda soo gabagabeyso heshiiska mashruuc gaas dabiici ah oo ku kacaya 42 bilyan oo dollar, kaas oo la doonayo inuu dalka ka dhigo xarun muhiim u ah tamarta Bariga Afrika. Mashruucan ayaa qeyb ka ah qorshaha dowladda Tanzania ee lagu ballaarinayo wax-soo-saarka tamarta, kor loogu qaadayo maalgashiga shisheeye, laguna xoojinayo dhaqaalaha dalka. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale hiigsanaysa inay ku dhowaad laba jibbaarto awoodda koronto-soo-saarkeeda, si ay uga jawaabto baahida sii kordhaysa ee korontada iyo horumarinta warshadaha. Mashruuca gaaska waxaa ku lug leh shirkado waaweyn oo caalami ah oo ka shaqeeya tamarta, waxaana la filayaa in gaaska laga soo saaro xeebaha dalka qayb ka mid ah loo dhoofiyo suuqyada caalamka, halka qayb kalena loo adeegsado baahida gudaha. Tanzania ayaa muddooyinkii dambe dadaal ugu jirtay sidii ay uga faa’iidaysan lahayd kaydka badan ee gaaska dabiiciga ah ee ku jira dhulkeeda iyo xeebaha, iyadoo rajaynaysa in mashruucani uu abuuro fursado shaqo, soo jiito maalgelin dheeraad ah, isla markaana kordhiyo dakhliga ka soo xarooda dhoofinta tamarta. Hirgelinta mashruucan ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inay sare u qaaddo kaalinta Tanzania ee suuqa tamarta gobolka, gaar ahaan xilli dalalka Bariga Afrika ay kordhinayaan maalgashiga kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo ilaha tamarta. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, heshiiska kama dambaysta ah ayaa weli u baahan in la dhammaystiro, iyadoo dowladda Tanzania ay rajaynayso in tallaabooyinkaas la soo afjaro bilaha soo socda.
