Askartan oo muddo lagu hayay xerada Garab Case ee magaalada Jigjiga ayaa la sheegay in shalay lagu qaaday basas ay leeyihiin ciidamada Itoobiya, kuwaas oo u gudbiyay caasimadda dalkaas ee Addis Ababa. Ciidamadan ayaa ka mid ahaa askartii uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud bishii August tababarka ugu soo xiray deegaanka Xananbuure ee gobolka Galgaduud oo hoos taga maamulka Galmudug. Ilaa hadda, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya kama aysan soo saarin war rasmi ah oo ku saabsan qabashada askartan iyo tallaabada Itoobiya ay ugu wareejisay Addis Ababa, iyadoo arrintani ay dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan xaaladdooda iyo sababta halkaas loogu qaaday. Dhanka kale, saraakiil amni oo ka tirsan dowladda Itoobiya ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inay aaminsan yihiin in ciidamadaas ay tababartay dowladda Masar, isla markaana ay ku sii jeedeen deegaannada maamulka Jubaland. Arrintan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli uu xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya wajahayo xiisado, kaddib markii ay labada dowladood isku khilaafeen arrimo la xiriira gobolka iyo isbahaysiyada siyaasadeed ee Geeska Afrika. Xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Axmed ayaa dhawaan muujisay caro la xiriirta mowqifka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee xiriirka uu la leeyahay Masar iyo Ereteriya. Wararka laga helayo dhinaca Itoobiya ayaa sheegaya in Addis Ababa ay tallaabooyinkaas u aragto kuwo khatar ah oo ka hor imaanaya danaha ay gobolka ka leedahay. Wareejinta askartan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan loollanka siyaasadeed iyo kan amni ee gobolka. Si kastaba, waxaa weli la sugayaa faahfaahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan sababta loo qabtay ciidamada, xaaladdooda hadda iyo wada-hadallada labada dowladood ee arrintan la xiriira. items.title: Raid on Congresswoman Ilhan Omar’s home sparks political firestorm
items.description: WASHINGTON (WDN) — Democratic Congresswoman Ilhan Omar has accused President Donald Trump of using federal law-enforcement agencies to intimidate political opponents after federal investigators searched her Washington, D.C., residence under a court-authorised warrant. Omar said she was safe but condemned the operation as the latest escalation in what she described as a decade-long campaign of political attacks against her. The search has intensified concerns among Democratic lawmakers about the potential politicisation of federal investigative powers, although authorities have not publicly established that the operation was politically motivated. “Make no mistake, this is an attempt to target political opponents using federal law enforcement,” Omar wrote on X on Monday. She added that she would not be silenced. Rep Ilhan’s office issued a separate statement condemning the search as an extraordinary abuse of power. Jacklyn Rogers, a spokesperson for the congresswoman, argued that Trump’s repeated public attacks against Omar had already raised concerns about her safety and that the investigation represented a further escalation. “No president should be allowed to use the power of the federal government to intimidate political opponents,” her office said. The Trump administration has not publicly detailed the allegations underlying the search. The Justice Department confirmed that Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) agents carried out the operation under judicial authorisation as part of an ongoing criminal investigation. Officials did not identify the suspected offence or disclose what evidence investigators were seeking. Investigation raises questions, but key details remain undisclosed Representative Ilhan Omar faces investigation concerning allegations involving immigration documents completed by Omar’s father when she was a child. The Justice Department has not publicly confirmed that account, and no criminal charges against Omar have been announced in connection with the reported allegations. The operation follows months of public scrutiny of Omar’s immigration history and a previous marriage. In May, Vice-President JD Vance said the Justice Department was examining allegations concerning her background and indicated that legal action could follow if evidence of wrongdoing emerged. Many other senior Trump administration including sectary of Homeland and Immigration  and border Czar made similar accusations Omar has repeatedly denied allegations that she married a man described by some political critics as her brother to facilitate his entry into the United States. No publicly presented evidence has established that claim. The distinction between allegations and proven wrongdoing is central to the controversy. A court-authorised search allows investigators to pursue evidence under legal procedures; it does not, by itself, establish that the person whose home is searched has committed a crime. The government’s refusal so far to disclose the specific basis for the operation has nevertheless left significant questions unanswered. Authorities have not explained the alleged offence, the evidence sought or the expected duration of the investigation. Senior House Democrats have sharply criticised the search, questioning its timing and raising concerns about whether federal investigative powers are being applied impartially. House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries and other Democratic lawmakers issued a joint statement expressing concern about the possibility of government power being used for political purposes. They called for greater clarity about the circumstances surrounding the operation and pledged to pursue accountability. The dispute comes amid an increasingly polarised political climate in which Omar has become a frequent target of Trump’s criticism. The president has repeatedly attacked the congresswoman and the Somali-American community in Minnesota, questioning Omar’s loyalty to the United States and calling for her deportation. Omar arrived in the United States as a refugee in 1995 and became a U.S. citizen in 2000. She has since emerged as a prominent Democratic lawmaker and a vocal critic of Trump’s policies. The search has therefore acquired significance beyond the investigation itself. For Omar and her supporters, it raises the question of whether a federal investigation can be conducted without being overshadowed by the president’s longstanding hostility towards a political opponent. For the administration, the central issue is whether investigators are following legitimate criminal evidence and established legal procedures. The Justice Department has not publicly established a connection between the search and the president’s political rhetoric. Nor has it disclosed sufficient details to allow the public to independently assess the investigation’s basis. Election timing adds to political tensions The search operation has drawn attention because it occurred shortly before the November 3 congressional midterm elections, in which Omar is seeking re-election in Minnesota.  Federal law-enforcement agencies have procedures referred to the “60-day rule” intended to guard against investigative actions improperly influencing elections, particularly when politically sensitive cases involve candidates or public officials. Nevertheless, the search took place 22 days before the November 3, 2026, midterm elections, bypassing the Department of Justice’s (DOJ) traditional rule. The timing is also likely to intensify partisan scrutiny, especially given Omar’s prominence in national political debates and the president’s repeated attacks on her. The Justice Department now faces pressure to demonstrate that the case is being handled according to evidence and established legal standards rather than political considerations. At the same time, public disclosure must be balanced against legitimate investigative requirements and the rights of those involved. A test of public confidence The controversy underscores a wider challenge facing American institutions: maintaining public confidence that federal law enforcement operates independently of partisan interests. If investigators possess credible evidence of a crime, they are entitled to pursue it through lawful procedures, regardless of a suspect’s political position. Equally, the government must not use criminal investigations to punish political criticism or intimidate opponents. Establishing which principle governs this case will require facts, transparency and due process—not political accusations alone. For now, the search has produced a political confrontation without resolving the underlying questions. Omar has denounced the operation as intimidation; Democrats are demanding answers; and federal authorities have confirmed an investigation while withholding its central details. The crucial unanswered question is whether the investigation will produce substantiated evidence of criminal wrongdoing—or remain overshadowed by the political battle surrounding it. Until the Justice Department explains the basis for its actions or the investigation reaches a clearer stage, claims of guilt and claims of political persecution should both be treated with appropriate caution. items.title: Hadalka Madaxweynaha Maraykanku waa aqoonsi uu siiyay Somaliland
items.description: Madaxweynaha dalka Maraykanka hadalka uu jeediyay ee uu kaga hadlay labada dal ee Somaliland iyo Somalia waa aqoonsi buuxa oo uu siiyay dalka Somaliland oo ah dal dimuquraadi ah oo mudo 35 sanadood ah si gaar ahna isu maamulaayay. Dadweynaha ku dhaqan dhamaan magaalooyinka Somaliland ayaa soo dhaweeyay hadalkii madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump oo ahaa Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland ay kala yihiin laba waddan oo kala duwan. Iyada oo hadalkaasi Madaxweynaha Maraykanka laga duulaayo waxa uu ka dhiganyahah aqoonsi toos ah oo uu Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu hawada u mariyay Somaliland.

items.title: Rights under siege: Woman’s reported detention raises alarm over abuse of state power
items.description: The unexplained detention of Ayaan Abdi Nunow raises urgent questions about due process, political intimidation and whether citizens’ fundamental rights are being sacrificed amid Somalia’s escalating political tensions. MOGADISHU (WDN) — Ayaan Abdi Nunow, the wife of a security officer reportedly associated with former South West State president Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen, was detained at Mogadishu’s international airport on Tuesday, according to sources close to South West politicians. The reason for her reported detention has not been officially disclosed. However, political figures from South West State have raised concerns that the action could be connected to her husband’s alleged association with forces opposed to the federal government and the current South West administration. The circumstances surrounding the incident remain unclear. No official explanation has been made public in the account available, and it has not been established whether Ayaan was formally arrested under a court order, questioned by security personnel or held under another legal procedure. The lack of information has fuelled concerns about due process, particularly whether she is being held on the basis of specific evidence or because of her family relationship. Calls for her immediate release Abdi-Satar Ali Hassan, a politician from South West State, appealed for Ayaan’s immediate release, saying she was a mother of 11 children and should not be deprived of her liberty without a lawful reason. “Please release Ayaan Abdi Nunow immediately. She is a mother of 11 children, and it is unacceptable for children to be deprived of their mother without justification,” he said. Hassan also questioned whether politicians from his community and their family members were being singled out for political reasons. He argued that authorities must explain the basis for the detention rather than leave the public to speculate about its motives. His remarks reflect wider concerns among some South West politicians that the political confrontation involving Laftagareen and his opponents could extend beyond political and security figures to their relatives. Those concerns have not been independently verified. Without an official account of the detention, it remains unclear whether the action was connected to the political dispute or arose from a separate investigation. Rule of law must apply to everyone The case raises fundamental questions about the limits of state power and the protection of individual rights in a politically charged environment. Authorities have the responsibility to investigate credible security threats and enforce the law. But any detention must have a lawful basis, and the person concerned must be informed of the reasons for being held and afforded the protections guaranteed under applicable law. Family relationships alone should not be treated as evidence of wrongdoing. If investigators suspect that Ayaan has committed an offence, they should identify the legal grounds for their action and follow the appropriate judicial procedures. If there is no lawful basis to detain her, she should be released. Hassan drew a comparison with opposition figures Abdirahman Abdishakur Warsame and former president Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, asking whether their wives would also be detained if the authorities were targeting relatives of political opponents. His remarks underscored fears that the use of security powers against family members could become a form of collective punishment or political intimidation. Such a conclusion cannot be established from the reported incident alone, but the allegation warrants a clear response from the authorities. The federal government and relevant security agencies should clarify whether Ayaan has been detained, which authority is responsible and what legal grounds justify the action. They should also ensure that she has access to legal assistance and that her family can establish her whereabouts and welfare. In a country where political disputes frequently intersect with security operations, transparency is essential to maintaining public confidence in law-enforcement institutions. Unexplained detentions risk deepening mistrust, particularly when those affected are connected to prominent political figures. The case also comes amid broader tensions surrounding South West State’s leadership and the confrontation between competing political and security forces. Any investigation must remain separate from those political disputes and be judged on evidence and law, not affiliation or family ties. The central issue is not whether Ayaan’s husband is aligned with the government or its opponents, but whether the authorities have a lawful and demonstrable reason to deprive her of her liberty. Until that question is answered, calls for transparency, due process and respect for her fundamental rights will remain pressing. items.title: Jawaabta khiyaanadii Itoobiya ay ku eedeysay Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wakaaladda wararka dowladda Itoobiya ee ENA ayaa dhowaan daabacday maqaal uu si weyn loogu weeraray Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kuna eedeeyay inuu “khiyaamay” Itoobiya kadib markii Soomaaliya ay sii xoojisay xiriirka ay la leedahay Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan. Maqaalkaas ayaa markii dambe laga saaray bogga ENA, iyada oo aan wax sharraxaad ah laga bixin sababta loo tirtiray. Qoraalka ENA wuxuu Itoobiya ku sawirayay dal muddo dheer u soo taagnaa xasilloonida Soomaaliya, ciidankiisana ku waayay dagaallada Al-Shabaab, balse maanta wajahaya isbahaysi dalal ah oo doonaya inay ka hor istaagaan inay hesho marin Badda Cas ah iyo waxa Addis Ababa ay ku tilmaamayso xaqeeda biyaha Nile-ka. Hase yeeshee, marka la eego sida ay ku bilaabatay xiisadda hadda ka dhex taagan Muqdisho iyo Addis Ababa, sheekadaasi waxay meesha ka saareysaa qodobka ugu weyn ee muranka: khilaafka labada dal ma uusan ka bilaaban Masar, Eritrea ama Sudan, ee wuxuu ka dhashay heshiiskii Itoobiya ay 1-dii Janaayo 2024 la gashay maamulka Somaliland. Heshiiskaas ayaa Itoobiya siin lahaa marin badeed oo dhinaca ganacsiga iyo ciidamada ah, waxaana maamulka Somaliland uu xilligaas sheegay in Addis Ababa ay beddelkiisa aqoonsan doonto madax-bannaanideeda. Muqdisho waxay arrintaas u aragtay xadgudub toos ah oo lagu sameeyay madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada Soomaaliya, maadaama Itoobiya ay heshiis ku saabsan xeeb Soomaaliyeed la gashay maamul aan caalamku u aqoonsaneyn dal madax-bannaan, iyada oo gebi ahaanba hareer martay dowladda federaalka. Marka dal deris ahi uu maamul gooni-u-goosad ah kala xaajoodo qeyb ka mid ah dhulkaaga, kadibna arrintaas lagu xiro aqoonsi siyaasadeed, raadinta xulufo cusub ma aha “khiyaano”. Waa tallaabo ay dowlad kasta qaadi lahayd marka ay dareento in dhulkeeda iyo madax-bannaanideeda lagu soo xadgudbay. Waxa taas ka sii cad in Soomaaliya aysan diidneyn in Itoobiya ay isticmaasho dekedaha dalka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa dhowaan sheegay in Soomaaliya diyaar u tahay inay Itoobiya u oggolaato isticmaalka laba ama saddex dekedood oo Soomaaliyeed, haddii arrintaasi ku timaaddo heshiis dowlad-ka-dowlad ah oo dhowraya madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Taasi waxay la jaanqaadaysaa heshiiskii Ankara ee Diseembar 2024, kaas oo Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ku heshiiyeen in Addis Ababa ay heli karto marin badeed oo ganacsi, balse dhammaan heshiisyadaas ay hoos imanayaan awoodda iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Sidaas darteed, muranku ma aha in Itoobiya loo oggolaado inay badeecadeeda ka dhoofiso ama kasoo dejiso deked Soomaaliyeed. Muranku wuxuu yahay in baahida ganacsi ee Itoobiya aysan siin karin xuquuq ay kaga gudubto madax-bannaanida waddan kale. Taariikhda ENA ay been sheegtay Maqaalka ENA wuxuu sidoo kale isku dayay inuu Itoobiya u soo bandhigo dowlad muddo soddon sano ah si joogto ah ugu howlanayd badbaadinta Soomaaliya. Taariikhdu sidaas uma fududa. Xitaa qoraalka ENA wuxuu si khaldan u sheegay in Itoobiya ay martigelisay shirkii dib-u-heshiisiinta Soomaalida ee Mbagathi, iyadoo shirku dhab ahaantii ka dhacay Kenya. Waxaa taas ka muhiimsan, daraasad uu 2006 daabacay Machadka Daraasaadka Amniga ee ISS ayaa sheegtay in siyaasadda Itoobiya ay ku dhisneyd aragti ah in dowlad Soomaaliyeed oo dib u curata ay tahay inay ahaato mid “daciif ah ama ku tiirsan” dalal kale, si aysan mar kale u soo noolaan murannada dhuleed oo u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya. Addis Ababa waxay sannado badan taageertay hoggaamiyeyaal, maleeshiyaad iyo kooxo siyaasadeed oo Soomaali ah oo ay u aragtay inay danaheeda ka shaqeyn karaan. Waxay sidoo kale door weyn ku lahayd loollankii siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya xilligii dowlad la’aanta, iyadoo marar badan taageertay dhinacyo kasoo horjeeday maamullada aysan ku qanacsaneyn. Taasi ma ahayn samafal keliya. Waxay ahayd siyaasad awood goboleed oo Itoobiya ay ku ilaalineysay danaha amni iyo kuwa siyaasadeed ee ay ka lahayd Soomaaliya. Duullaankii 2006 iyo kororka Al-Shabaab Maqaalka ENA wuxuu si weyn u xusay askarta Itoobiyaanka ah ee ku dhintay dagaalladii Al-Shabaab, isaga oo arrintaas u adeegsanaya caddeyn muujinaysa kaalinta Itoobiya ee difaaca Soomaaliya. Askartaas qaar badan ayaa runtii ku dhintay dagaalka kooxda, balse dooddaas waxaa ka maqan qeyb kale oo muhiim ah oo taariikheed. Duullaankii Itoobiya ee Soomaaliya dhammaadkii 2006 wuxuu si weyn uga qeyb qaatay xaaladdii Al-Shabaab u sahashay inay hesho taageero, dagaalyahanno iyo sumcad aysan markii hore lahayn. Ciidamada Itoobiya, oo taageero siyaasadeed, sirdoon iyo mid milatari ka helayay Mareykanka, ayaa gudaha u galay Soomaaliya si ay meesha uga saaraan Midowgii Maxkamadaha Islaamiga ahaa. Dhinaca militariga, howlgalkaasi si degdeg ah ayuu u gaaray hadafkiisii. Maxkamadihii waa laga saaray Muqdisho, waxaana dowladda KMG ahayd lagu soo celiyay caasimadda. items.title: Madaxdii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed oo lagu daray Liiska Cunaqabateynta Maalgelinta Argagixisada
items.description: Muqdisho, 13 Oktoobar 2026 — Guddiga Qaran ee Ka-hortagga Lacag-dhaqidda iyo La-dagaallanka Maalgelinta Argagixisada (NAMLC) ayaa liiska cunaqabateynta maaliyadeed ku daray 10 qof oo uu guddigu ku sheegay inay ku lug leeyihiin arrimo la xiriira maalgelinta argagixisada. Liiska uu guddigu soo saaray waxaa ku jira Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen), madaxweynihii hore ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, iyo xubno kale oo ay ka mid yihiin Xasan Cabdulqaadir Maxamed, Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan (Shub) taliyihii hore ee ciidanka Asluubta, Ibraahim Aadan Cali (Najax) Gudoomiyihii hore ee Shabeellaha Hoose, iyo Xasan Cabdi Maxamed (Ugaas Xasan) Afhayeenkii hore Koonfur Galbeed. Sidoo kale, liiska waxaa ku jira Cabdullaahi Cali Watiin duqii hore ee Baydhabo, Cabdifataax Mahad Cabdiraxmaan, Cabdimajiid Mowliid Xasan, Amiin Macallin Daruur iyo Abshir Aadan Isaaq. War-saxaafadeedka guddiga ee ku taariikhaysan 13-ka Oktoobar 2026 ayaa lagu sheegay in go’aanka lagu saleeyey xogaha iyo macluumaadka la xiriira dadka liiska lagu daray. Guddigu wuxuu faray hay’adaha iyo dadka ay khusayso inay u hoggaansamaan sharciga, ayna xayiraan hantida dadka liiska ku jira, isla markaana ay ka fogaadaan macaamillada maaliyadeed ee mamnuuca ah. Waxaa sidoo kale la faray in dhaqdhaqaaqyada maaliyadeed ee la xiriira dadkaas loo gudbiyo Xarunta Warbixinta Maaliyadda (FRC). Tallaabadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo Cabdicasiis Laftagareen uu hore u soo noqday madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, xilli uu weli jiro khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo la xiriira hoggaanka maamulkaas.

Tallaabadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo Cabdicasiis Laftagareen uu hore u soo noqday madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, xilli uu weli jiro khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo la xiriira hoggaanka maamulkaas.

items.title: Larry André calls Somalia’s government ‘illegitimate,’ urges action to halt Southwest conflict
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Former United States Ambassador to Somalia Larry André Jr. has called on the international community to intensify pressure on President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government to halt conflict and civilian displacement in Southwest State, warning that continued instability could aggravate the region’s humanitarian crisis. Speaking to Sky News, André accused the Somali federal government of exacerbating civilian suffering through political and military confrontations, arguing that its actions were compounding insecurity at a time when vulnerable communities urgently need humanitarian assistance. He questioned the government’s legitimacy and accused it of deploying security forces primarily to advance political interests rather than protect civilians. “It is an illegitimate government that has overstayed its mandate, and it is using its forces primarily as a political militia and producing refugees exactly from the same area,” André said. His remarks underscore concerns about the intersection of political conflict, displacement and food insecurity in Southwest State. For communities already struggling with precarious livelihoods and limited resources, continued violence risks further restricting access to food, shelter and essential services. Reported Turkish F-16 Airstrikes Raise Civilian Protection Concerns André also raised concerns about the reported use of Turkish F-16 fighter jets in airstrikes in the region, warning of the potential consequences for communities already facing serious humanitarian challenges. Military operations in vulnerable areas can disrupt livelihoods, force families from their homes and complicate humanitarian relief efforts. Protecting civilians and maintaining safe, reliable access for aid organisations are therefore essential to preventing further deterioration. André Warns of Humanitarian Funding Shortfalls The former ambassador urged international partners to press Mogadishu to end the violence, prevent further displacement and create conditions in which emergency assistance can reach affected populations. He contrasted the billions of dollars mobilised by international donors during Somalia’s 2022 drought crisis with what he described as a reluctance to provide comparable levels of financial support today. Any shortfall in humanitarian funding could place additional pressure on relief organisations working to support vulnerable households. Yet funding alone cannot resolve the crisis if insecurity prevents aid from reaching communities facing acute hardship. André stressed that Somali authorities bear responsibility for protecting their citizens and addressing the country’s humanitarian needs, even as international assistance remains important. items.title: Wasiir Fiqi oo weerar culus ku qaaday SHARIIF + Video
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo ka hadlay xiisadda siyaasadeed ee ka soo cusboonaatay magaalada Muqdisho ee u dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka iyo mucaaradka ayaa weerar afka ah ku qaaday Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka, Shariif Sheekh Axmed. Fiqi ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay mas’uul ka tahay sugidda amniga caasimadda, sidaas darteedna aysan ka shaqeynayn qalqal-gelin amni. Wuxuu taa beddelkeeda ku eedeeyay mucaaradka inay doonayaan inay Muqdisho ka abuuraan xaalad amni darro. “Meeshaan (aagga guriga Shariif) waa meel bahalo galeen ah, 260 wiil oo hubeysan ayaa ka saarnay labadii toddobaad ee la soo dhaafay, waana soo bandhigi doonnaa. Waxaa la rabay in lagu carqaladeeyo amniga,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Fiqi. Isaga oo ka hadlayay isku-dayga weerar ee lagu eedeeyay dowladda ayuu wasiirku sheegay in dowladda ay Shariif hore ugu galbisay gaadiidkeeda, isla markaana ay fursad u heli lahayd inay waxyeello gaarsiiso haddii ay taasi damacsanayd. “Ninkaas Mirinaayo ayuu galay, dowladda oo baabuurteeda ku waddaa ayaa gurigiisa keentay. Hadday dili lahayd, fursad ayay haysatay, gacanteeduna ku jiray. Meeshaas waa bahalo galeen, maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo daandaansi wada ayaa lagu ururiyey,” ayuu yiri. Sidoo kale, Fiqi ayaa mucaaradka ku eedeeyay inay fulinayaan ajende Imaaraadku leeyahay, isla markaana ay diyaariyeen maleeshiyaad uu sheegay inay daandaansi ku hayaan ciidamada dowladda, si ay halkaas uga qarxaan dagaallo u dhexeeya labada dhinac. “Meesha ma nin siyaasi ah ayaa deggan mise hoggaamiye kooxeed ayaa deggan? Waxaa ayaan-darro ah in isagu wuxuu rabo uu marmarsiyo ka dhigto, kuwo tiro badanina ay la soo istaagaan marqaati been ah, ayna meel la soo istaagaan in dowladda daandaansi ku hayso mucaaradka,” ayuu yiri wasiirka oo u jawaabay siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ee xalay qabtay shirka jaraa’id. Fiqi ayaa hadalkiisa sii raaciyay in dowladda iyo mucaaradku aysan isku mid ahayn marka laga hadlayo mas’uuliyadda amniga, sidaas darteedna aan caasimadda lagu ururin karin maleeshiyaad hubeysan. Ugu dambeyntiina, wasiirka ayaa caddeeyay in dowladda aysan indhaha ka qabsan doonin waxa uu ku tilmaamay abaabul ciidan oo ka socda caasimadda, isla markaana ay tallaabo ka qaadi doonto khatar kasta oo amniga Muqdisho wax u dhimaysa, isagoo ku adkeystay in dowladda ay ka hortageyso in maleeshiyaad hubeysan lagu abuuro caasimadda. items.title: Muxuu yahay shirka ay maanta DF Soomaaliya ka furtay Muqdisho?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta Soomaaliya, Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh) ayaa si rasmi ah u furay Meertada 3-aad ee Shirweynaha U Adkeysiga Aafooyinka Soomaaliya (SDRC 2026). Shirweynaha ayaa sanadkan diiradda lagu saaraya sidii looga gudbi lahaa aafooyinka soo noqnoqda, loona dhisi lahaa adkeysi waara oo dalka u horseeda mustaqbal wanaagsan iyo soo kabasho waarta. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay wax ka qabashada musiibooyinka iyo ka hortagga aafooyinka soo noqnoqda. Waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in laga gudbo gurmadka degdegga ah, loona tallaabsado tallaabooyin ka hortag ah iyo xalal waara oo horseeda isku-filnaanshaha bulshada iyo dowladda. Dhankiisa, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallim Fiqi oo isaguna ka hadlay shirweynaha ayaa sheegay in loo baahan yahay in la qaado tallaabooyin hore oo ku dhisan cilmi-baaris, si loo yareeyo saameynta aafooyinka soo noqnoqda, loona helo xalal waara oo wax looga qaban karo dhibaatooyinka dalka. Fiqi ayaa sidoo kale xusay in taageerada caalamiga ahi ay yaraatay, maadaama dunidu ay ku mashquulsan tahay caqabado iyo dhibaatooyin u gaar ah. Waxa uu tilmaamay in xaaladdani ay sii xoojinayso baahida loo qabo in Soomaaliya ay yeelato qorshayaal iyo xalal waara oo awood u siinaya inay si wanaagsan ula tacaasho aafooyinka. Labada wasiir ayaa bogaadiyay dadaallada cilmi-baariseed iyo qorshayaasha ay iska kaashanayaan Hay’adda Maareynta Masiibooyinka Qaranka (SoDMA) iyo Jaamacadda Muqdisho. Waxay sidoo kale muujiyeen muhiimadda ay dadaalladaasi u leeyihiin fahamka aafooyinka iyo dejinta qorshayaal lagu yareynayo saameyntooda. Wasiirradu waxay adkeeyeen in cilmi-baarista iyo qorsheynta hore ay laf-dhabar u yihiin dhismaha adkeysiga dalka, gaar ahaan xilli ay soo noqnoqonayaan dhibaatooyinka saameeya bulshada. Waxay sidoo kale tilmaameen baahida loo qabo habab wax ku ool ah oo looga hortago khasaaraha ka dhasha aafooyinka. Ugu dambeyntiina, waxay ku baaqeen in dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay iska kaashadaan wax ka qabashada aafooyinka, si loo gaaro yoolalka qaranka ee la xiriira ka hortagga musiibooyinka, xoojinta adkeysiga dalka iyo dhismaha bulsho awood u leh inay ka soo kabato dhibaatooyinka soo noqnoqda. The post Muxuu yahay shirka ay maanta DF Soomaaliya ka furtay Muqdisho? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xogta wada-hadal dhexmaray Abiy Axmed iyo Netanyahu
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed ayaa sheegay in wada-hadal taleefan oo uu la yeeshay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil, Benjamin Netanyahu uu ahaa mid miro-dhal ah, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladda gobolka. Qoraal uu ku baahiyay bartiisa X ayuu Abiy Axmed ku sheegay in labada hoggaamiye ay ka wada-hadleen xoojinta xiriirkooda laba geesoodka ah iyo arrimo kale oo muhiim u ah gobolka. “Waxaan wada-hadal miro-dhal ah taleefoon kula yeeshay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil, Benjamin Netanyahu, kaas oo aan kaga wada-hadallay xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladaha muhiimka ah ee gobolka,” ayuu yiri Abiy Axmed. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada-hadlay iskaashiga ku saabsan arrimaha ay danaha wadajirka ah ka leeyihiin, inkasta oo uusan Abiy bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan qodobbada ay isla soo qaadeen Netanyahu. Wada-hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha milatari ee u dhexeeya Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, taas oo sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo xaaladda amni ee gobolka. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa warqad ay u dirtay Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ku eedeysay Eritrea inay ciidamo usoo dirtay gudaha dhulkeeda. Eedeyntan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay sii kordhayaan khilaafaadka u dhexeeya labada dal. Si kastaba, Abiy Axmed ma uusan caddeyn in xiisadda Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ay qayb ka ahayd wada-hadalkii uu la yeeshay Netanyahu, mana uusan shaacin tallaabooyin gaar ah oo ay labada dhinac ku heshiiyeen. items.title: Muxuu Trump oo ka yiri baaritaanka guriga Ilhaan?
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Isniintii sheegay inuusan wax lug ah ku lahayn baaritaankii ay ciidamada federaalka ku sameeyeen guriga xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar ee magaalada Washington, isagoo isla markaana weerar afka ah ku qaaday xildhibaannada iyo dalka Soomaaliya oo uu ku tilmaamay “dal aan dal ahayn”. Trump oo la hadlay warbaahinta saacado kaddib markii ciidamada federaalka ay baareen guriga Ilhaan, ayaa sheegay in hay’adaha dowladda ay baaritaan ku hayaan xildhibaannada, balse uu isagu ka madax bannaan yahay howlgalkaasi. “Waxaan fahamsanahay inay si weyn u baarayaan arrinteeda. Anigu mar walba waxaan u arkayey qof gebi ahaanba musuq badan, laakiin taasi aniga shaqo iguma laha,” ayuu yiri Trump. Madaxweynaha ayaa intaas ku daray inuu Ilhaan u arko qof aad u xun oo cabasho badan, isagoo ku dhaliilay inay Mareykanka wax ka sheegto, inkastoo ay dalkaasi ku timid qaxootinimo. “Waxay ka timid dal aan dal ahayn, kaddibna halkan ayay timid oo ay ka cabaneysaa dastuurkeenna,” ayuu yiri. Trump ayaa mar kale ku celiyey inuusan wax door ah ku lahayn baaritaanka, isagoo sheegay in arrintaasi ay u taallo Wasaaradda Caddaaladda Mareykanka. “Laakiin taasi waxay u taallaa Wasaaradda Caddaaladda. Anigu wax shaqo ah kuma lihi,” ayuu yiri. Hadalka Trump ayaa yimid xilli Ilhaan Cumar ay maamulkiisa ku eedeysay inuu hay’adaha amniga u adeegsanayo cabsi-gelinta dadka siyaasadda ku mucaaradsan, iyadoo baaritaanka gurigeeda uu dhaliyey caro xooggan oo ka dhex aloosantay xisbiga Dimoqraadiga, saddex toddobaad oo keliya ka hor doorashooyinka dhexe ee Mareykanka. Ciidamo ka tirsan waaxda baaritaannada amniga gudaha ee Homeland Security Investigations (HSI), oo hoos tagta hay’adda socdaalka Mareykanka ee ICE, ayaa subaxnimadii Isniinta baaritaan ku sameeyey guriga Ilhaan Cumar ee Washington, iyagoo watay amar maxkamadeed. Wasaaradda Caddaaladda ayaa xaqiijisay in howlgalkaasi qeyb ka yahay baaritaan dembiyeed oo socda, balse ma aysan shaacin faahfaahinta eedeymaha ama waxa si gaar ah loo baarayo. Qof xog-ogaal u ah baaritaanka ayaa wakaaladda Reuters u sheegay in kiisku la xiriiro tuhuno ku saabsan musuqmaasuq dhinaca socdaalka ah, oo ay ku jiraan dokumentiyo uu aabbaheed oo geeriyooday buuxiyey xilligii ay Ilhaan carruurta ahayd. Ilhaan oo si kulul uga jawaabtay Ilhaan Cumar, oo ah haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee asal ahaan Soomaali ah ee loo doorto Congress-ka Mareykanka, ayaa baaritaanka ku tilmaantay mid salka ku haya dano siyaasadeed, waxayna Trump ku eedeysay inuu muddo dheer waday olole ka dhan ah. “Waan fiicanahay. Ha la ogaado in tani tahay isku day lagu beegsanayo cadaw siyaasadeed, laguna adeegsanayo hay’adaha fulinta sharciga ee federaalka,” ayay ku qortay barteeda X. “Muddo toban sano ah, Trump wuxuu igu bartilmaameedsanayey been iyo ololeyaal sumcad-dil ah oo aan sal lahayn. Tani waa tallaabadii ugu dambeysay ee uu ku sii xoojinayo ololihiisa cabsi-gelinta siyaasadeed. La i aamusiin maayo,” ayay raacisay. Xafiiska Ilhaan ayaa sidoo kale baaritaanka ku tilmaamay ku-takrifal awoodda dowladda, isagoo ku adkeystay in xildhibaannadu aysan wax dembi ah gelin. “Ma jiro madaxweyne ay tahay in loo oggolaado inuu awoodda dowladda federaalka u adeegsado cabsi-gelinta dadka siyaasadda ku mucaaradsan,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan kasoo baxay xafiiskeeda. Hase yeeshee, hadalka Trump ee uu ku diiday inuu baaritaanka ku lug leeyahay ayaa kusoo beegmaya kaddib bilo ay mas’uuliyiin sare oo maamulkiisa ka tirsan si fagaare ah uga hadlayeen baaritaanno la xiriira taariikhda socdaalka ee Ilhaan. Sanadkii 2018 ayay markii ugu horreysay ku guuleysatay kursiga Congress-ka, iyadoo matasha deegaan ka tirsan gobolka Minnesota oo ay ku nool yihiin Soomaali badan. Wasaaradda Caddaaladda Mareykanka ayaa muddo dheer lahayd habraac ay kaga fogaaneyso tallaabooyin baaritaan oo si muuqata u saameyn kara musharraxiinta siyaasadeed, gaar ahaan muddo ku dhow 60 maalmood ka hor doorashooyinka. Hoggaamiyaha Dimoqraadiyiinta ee Aqalka Wakiillada, Hakeem Jeffries, iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo xisbiga ka tirsan ayaa baaritaanka ku tilmaamay mid aad looga walaaco, iyagoo sheegay inuu dhaliyey su’aalo culus oo ku saabsan adeegsiga hay’adaha federaalka ee ka dhanka ah mucaaradka Trump. Guddoomiyaha gobolka Minnesota, Tim Walz, ayaa isaguna Trump ku eedeeyey inuu awooddiisa u adeegsanayo beegsiga dadka siyaasadda ku mucaaradsan ka hor doorashooyinka. Xiisaddan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo xiriirka Trump iyo Ilhaan uu muddo sanado ah ahaa mid colaadeed, isla markaana madaxweynuhu marar badan weerarro afka ah ku qaaday asalkeeda Soomaaliyeed, taariikhdeeda qaxootinimo iyo mowqifyadeeda siyaasadeed. Trump ayaa ku adkeystay inuusan amrin baaritaanka Ilhaan, halka hay’adaha federaalku ay sheegeen inay ku dhaqmeen amar maxkamadeed. Illaa hadda, ma jiraan wax dacwad dembiyeed ah oo si rasmi ah loogu soo oogay Ilhaan Cumar, mana la shaacin caddeymaha ay hay’adaha baaritaanku ku saleeyeen codsiga amarka lagu baaray gurigeeda. items.title: Xiisadaha Badda Cas iyo Hormuz oo Sare u Qaaday Qiimaha Shidaalka iyo Kharashaadka Maraakiibta
items.description: Xiisadaha amni ee ka jira Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz ayaa sare u qaaday qiimaha shidaalka iyo kharashaadka gaadiidka badda, iyadoo suuqyada caalamku ay ka walaacsan yihiin suurtagalnimada weerarro kale oo lagu qaado maraakiibta, dhuumaha shidaalka iyo xarumaha tamarta ee Bariga Dhexe. Qiimaha shidaalka cayriin ee Brent ayaa subaxnimadii Talaadada gaaray 106.04 doollar halkii foosto, kaddib markii uu Isniintii ku xirnaa 106.65 doollar, taas oo ahayd heerkii ugu sarreeyay tan iyo 15-kii Sebteembar. Sidoo kale, shidaalka Mareykanka ee West Texas Intermediate (WTI) ayaa marayay 93.27 doollar halkii foosto, taas oo muujinaysa saameynta ay xiisadaha gobolka ku leeyihiin suuqyada tamarta. Inkasta oo rajada laga qabo in Ruushku kordhiyo sahayda naaftada ee suuqyada caalamka ay xoogaa dejisay walaaca ganacsatada, haddana khatarta amni ee Bariga Dhexe ayaa weli ah arrinta ugu weyn ee saameynaysa qiimaha shidaalka. Ganacsatadu waxay si gaar ah uga walaacsan yihiin in weerarro cusub ay carqaladeeyaan maraakiibta shidaalka qaada, dhuumaha shidaalka iyo xarumaha wax-soo-saarka tamarta. Wasiirrada dalalka ku jira ururka OPEC iyo waddamada la shaqeeya ayaa sheegay in kharashaadka maraakiibta iyo caymiska ay gaareen heerar aan horay loo arag, iyadoo kharashaadkaasi hadda ka badan yihiin saddex-meelood meel qiimaha shidaalka la daabulayo. Kororka kharashaadka ayaa adkeynaya gaadiidka saliidda cayriin iyo shidaalka la farsameeyay, wuxuuna cadaadis dheeraad ah saaraya sicir-bararka caalamka. Saameynta xaaladdan ayaa laga cabsi qabaa inay gaarto dalal badan oo ku tiirsan shidaalka iyo badeecadaha dibadda laga keeno, waxaana Soomaaliya ka mid ah waddamada halista ugu jira inay wajahaan koror ku yimaada kharashaadka nolosha. Dalka ayaa si weyn ugu tiirsan shidaalka dibadda laga soo dejiyo iyo badeecadaha ku yimaada gaadiidka badda, taas oo ka dhigaysa mid u nugul isbeddel kasta oo ku yimaada qiimaha shidaalka, kirada maraakiibta iyo khidmadaha caymiska. Haddii qiimaha shidaalka iyo kharashaadka gaadiidka badda ay heerarkan ku sii nagaadaan, waxaa kordhi kara kharashaadka gaadiidka dadweynaha, korontada iyo badeecadaha daruuriga ah, oo ay ku jiraan cuntada iyo agabka dhismaha. Ganacsatada ayaa laga yaabaa inay kharashaadka dheeraadka ah ku daraan qiimaha ay badeecadaha ku iibiyaan, taas oo culays dhaqaale ku noqon karta qoysaska iyo ganacsiyada Soomaaliyeed. Inkasta oo aan la xaqiijin weerar cusub oo dhacay habeenkii Isniinta, haddana suuqyada caalamku waxay qiimaynayaan halista weerarro mustaqbalka dhici kara. Arrintan ayaa muujinaysa in hanjabaadaha amni iyo cabsi laga qabo carqalad ku timaada marin-biyoodka muhiimka u ah ganacsiga caalamiga ahi ay sare u qaadi karaan qiimaha shidaalka iyo kharashaadka badeecadaha, xitaa ka hor inta uusan dhicin weerar cusub oo si toos ah u saameeya isu-socodka maraakiibta.

items.title: Erdogan oo baarlamaanka Turkiga u gudbinaya heshiiska Maka xilli Sacuudiga uu…
items.description: Ankara (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdogan ayaa sheegay inuu dhawaan baarlamaanka dalkiisa horgeyn doono heshiiska iskaashiga difaaca ee Turkiga la galay Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan, kaas oo lagu magacaabo heshiiska Makka. Erdogan ayaa sheegay in heshiiskani uu ka mid yahay heshiisyada muhiimka u ah dalkiisa, sidaas darteedna uu doonayo in baarlamaanku sida ugu dhaqsaha badan uga doodo, uguna codeeyo si loo helo oggolaanshaha lagama maarmaanka u ah hirgelintiisa. Madaxweynaha Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale caddeeyay in dalkiisu garab taagan yahay Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, isaga oo cambaareeyay tallaabo kasta oo ka dhan ah dalkaas, gaar ahaan weerarrada uu ku tilmaamay kuwo ka hor imanaya mabaadi’da bani’aadannimada. Heshiiska difaaca ee ay wada galeen Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan ayaa la sheegay inuu xoojinayo iskaashiga milatari ee saddexda dal, isla markaana uu saldhig u noqonayo taageerada ay isu fidiyaan marka midkood uu wajaho xaalad amni oo culus. Heshiiskan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada ay saddexdan dal ku doonayaan inay ku xoojiyaan xiriirkooda istaraatiijiyadeed iyo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca, xilli ay gobolka ka jiraan xiisado amni iyo isbeddello siyaasadeed. Dhinaca kale, heshiisyada qaarkood ee ay dowladda Turkigu gasho ayaa loo gudbiyaa baarlamaanka si loo helo oggolaanshaha sharciyeed ee looga baahan yahay dhaqan-gelintooda. Tallaabada Erdogan ayaa sidaas darteed muujinaysa inuu doonayo in heshiiska loo maro habraaca baarlamaanka. Tan ayaa imanaysa xilli Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay xaqiijiyeen inay ciidamo si degdeg ah ugu daabulayaan Sacuudi Carabiya, taas oo qeyb ka ah hirgelinta heshiis cusub oo difaac wadajir ah oo ay saddexda dal ku mideysan yihiin, xilli dagaalka Yemen uu mar kale galay marxalad cusub. Go’aankan ayaa lagu dhawaaqay kadib kulan degdeg ah oo magaalada Riyadh ay ku yeesheen wakiillo ka kala socday Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Saddexda dal ayaa si wadajir ah u cambaareeyay weerarradii dhowaan lagu qaaday Sacuudiga, gaar ahaan kuwa lagu beegsaday magaalooyinka barakeysan ee Maka iyo Madiina, inkasta oo bayaankooda aysan si toos ah ugu magacaabin Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Waxay xaqiijiyeen “diidmadooda aan mugdiga ku jirin ee weerar ama hanjabaad kasta oo lagu beegsado ammaanka iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya”. Sidoo kale waxay ku heshiiyeen in si degdeg ah loo dhaqan-geliyo waajibaadka difaaca wadajirka ah, lana diyaariyo ciidamadii iyo awoodihii milatari ee lagu heshiiyay, si loogu daabulo Sacuudiga muddo kooban gudaheed. Tallaabadan ayaa qeyb ka ah heshiiska loo yaqaan Mecca Pact, kaas oo Riyadh u adeegsanayo inuu xoojiyo iskaashiga dhinaca ammaanka iyo difaaca ee uu la leeyahay Ankara iyo Islamabad. items.title: Bernie Sanders oo Trump ku Eedeeyay Cabsi-gelin Siyaasadeed, Asagoo Difaacay Ilhaan Cumar
items.description: Senator-ka Mareykanka Bernie Sanders ayaa madaxweynaha dalkaas Donald Trump ku eedeeyay inuu isku dayayo inuu cabsi geliyo dadka siyaasadda kaga soo horjeeda, warbaahinta iyo cid kasta oo aan ku raacsanayn aragtidiisa, isaga oo arrintaas ku tilmaamay mid halis ku ah dimuqraadiyadda Mareykanka. Sanders ayaa qoraal uu baahiyay ku sheegay in Trump uu yahay hoggaamiye awood-ku-takri-fal sameeya, isla markaana uu dowladda federaalka u adeegsanayo cadaadis lagu aamusinayo dadka mucaaradka ku ah. Waxa uu ugu baaqay dadka Mareykanka inay ka hortagaan tallaabooyinka uu ku eedeeyay madaxweynaha, ayna difaacaan nidaamka dimuqraadiga ah ee dalka. Senatarka ayaa sidoo kale difaacay Ilhaan Cumar, oo ah xildhibaanad asal ahaan Soomaali ah kana tirsan Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka, isaga oo xusay inay dalka ku timid iyadoo ilmo qaxooti ah oo ka cararaysay dagaalkii sokeeye ee Soomaaliya, markii dambena ay qaadatay dhalashada Mareykanka, ka hor intii aan loo dooran Kongareeska. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Ilhaan Cumar ay wajahaysay hadallo iyo dhaliilo uga imaanayay Trump, gaar ahaan kuwa la xiriira asalkeeda Soomaaliyeed iyo siyaasadaha socdaalka. Arrintan ayaa dib u soo nooleysay doodda siyaasadeed ee Mareykanka ee ku saabsan xuquuqda muhaajiriinta, xorriyadda hadalka iyo sida dowladda federaalka loola dhaqmo dadka siyaasadda ka aragti duwan. Sanders ayaa ugu dambeyn ku baaqay in la iska caabiyo tallaabooyinka uu ku tilmaamay isku day lagu cabburinayo mucaaradka, isaga oo ku adkeystay muhiimadda ay leedahay ilaalinta dimuqraadiyadda iyo xaqa ay muwaadiniintu u leeyihiin inay si xor ah u muujiyaan aragtidooda.

items.title: Dagaalka Tigray: Imaaraadka iyo Sacuudiga oo Indhaha lagu Hayo Kaalintooda Xiisadda Itoobiya
items.description: Dagaallada dib uga soo cusboonaaday gobolka Tigray ee waqooyiga Itoobiya ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika, iyadoo doorka Imaaraadka Carabta iyo Sacuudi Carabiya ee xaaladda Itoobiya uu soo jiitay indhaha siyaasiyiinta iyo falanqeeyayaasha gobolka. Labadan dal ee Khaliijka ayaa dano istaraatiiji ah ku leh Geeska Afrika, hase yeeshee mowqifyadooda ku aaddan xiisadda Itoobiya way kala duwan yihiin. Imaaraadka ayaa si cad u muujiyey taageerada uu u hayo dowladda federaalka Itoobiya, halka Sacuudi Carabiya aanay weli si rasmi ah uga hadlin dagaallada cusub, inkasta oo ay hore uga qayb qaadatay dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu dejinayey khilaafaadka gobolka. Dagaalladan ayaa khatar gelinaya heshiiskii nabadeed ee Pretoria ee la saxiixay bishii Nofeembar 2022, kaas oo soo afjaray dagaalkii u dhexeeyey dowladda federaalka Itoobiya iyo xoogagga Tigrayga. Xiisadaha sii kordhaya ee u dhexeeya Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa sidoo kale kordhinaya walaaca laga qabo in colaadda hadda taagan ay isu beddesho iska horimaad ballaaran oo saameeya dalal kale oo gobolka ah. 25-kii Sebtembar 2026, Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa cambaareeyey weerarro uu sheegay inay TPLF iyo kooxo hubeysan oo xulafo la ah ku qaadeen ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya, iyo qabsashada garoomo diyaaradeed oo ku yaalla Tigray. Imaaraadku wuxuu sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyey dagaallada ku fiday deegaannada deriska la ah ee Canfarta iyo Amxaarada. Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Imaaraadka, Sheekh Shakhboot bin Nahyan Al Nahyan, ayaa muujiyey garab-istaagga dowladda iyo shacabka Itoobiya, isagoo adkeeyey taageerada dalkiisu u hayo madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Itoobiya. Wuxuu sidoo kale ku baaqay in la joojiyo colaadaha, la ilaaliyo dadka rayidka ah, lana ixtiraamo heshiiskii nabadeed ee Pretoria. Mowqifkaasi wuxuu muujinayaa in Abu Dhabi ay taageersan tahay dowladda federaalka Itoobiya, iyadoo dhinaca kalena ku baaqaysa dejinta xiisadda iyo wada-hadal. bayaanka Imaaraadku ma caddaynayo inuu dowladda Itoobiya siinayo kaalmo militari oo la xiriirta dagaallada cusub, mana jiro xog dadweyne oo xaqiijinaysa inuu awood u yeeshay inuu dhinacyada dagaallamaya ku qanciyo joojinta colaadda. Imaaraadka ayaa dano dhaqaale iyo ganacsi oo muhiim ah ku leh Geeska Afrika, ayadoo Shirkadda DP World ee laga leeyahay Dubai ay maamusha dekedda Berbera ee Soomaaliya, waxaana sannadkii 2025 la bilaabay marin maraakiib oo isku xira Berbera iyo dekedda Jebel Ali ee Imaaraadka. Xariirkaasi wuxuu abuuri karaa waddo ganacsi oo u adeegta suuqyada gudaha ee gobolka, oo ay ku jirto Itoobiya oo aan lahayn bad ay si toos ah uga soo degto badeecadaha. Itoobiya ayaa tan iyo markii Eritrea ay xornimada qaadatay sannadkii 1993 si weyn ugu tiirsanayd dekedaha Jabuuti si ay ula macaamisho suuqyada caalamka, xaaladdaas ayaana qayb ka ah sababaha ay Addis Ababa muhiimad u siiso marin-badeedka iyo xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka gobolka. Dhanka Sacuudi Carabiya,ma jiro bayaan rasmi uu ka soo saaray dagaallada cusub ee Tigray, balse boqortooyadu waxay hore uga qayb qaadatay dadaallo lagu doonayey in lagu dejiyo xiisadaha u dhexeeya Itoobiya, Eritrea iyo dhinacyada kale ee gobolka. Bishii Nofeembar 2025, warbixin ay baahisay xarunta cilmi-baarista Chatham House ayaa sheegtay in ilo xog-ogaal ahi ay sheegeen in Sacuudi Carabiya ay soo bandhigtay dhexdhexaadin u dhexeysa Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, xilli ay sii kordhayeen khilaafaadka ku saabsan marin-badeedka iyo amniga gobolka. Falanqayn uu machadka Jarmalka ee SWP soo saaray bishii Juun 2026 ayaa tilmaantay in dadaalladii hore ee dhexdhexaadinta ay fashilmeen, iyadoo mid ka mid ah caqabadaha waaweyn uu ahaa inaan si buuxda looga wada xaajoon danaha Itoobiya ee ku aaddan dekedda Casab ee Eritrea. Sacuudi Carabiya waxay muhiimad gaar ah siisaa amniga Badda Cas, oo ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo dhoofinta shidaalka boqortooyada. Warbixino falanqayn ah ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Masar ay dano amni oo qaarkood la jaanqaadaan mowqifka Eritrea, gaar ahaan marka laga hadlayo hamiga Itoobiya ee helitaanka marin-badeedka Badda Cas, balse arrintaasi ma caddaynayso in Sacuudiga uu taageero militari siinayo Eritrea ama TPLF dagaallada hadda socda.

items.title: Qoysas maciin-biday Janaale, markii ay ka barakceen duqayn saamaysay noloshooda
items.description: (ERGO) – Waxay ka soo tageen guryihii iyo beerahii ay ku tiirsanaayeen, si ay waxyeello nafeed uga badbaadaan tan iyo horraantii bishii September in ka badan 1,700 oo qoys. Duqaymo iyo dagaal toos ah oo dhowr mar dhacay, wellina socda ayaa ku qasbay in ay soo baxaan iyagoo faro maran. Cunno xumo, biyo yari iyo hoy la’aan ayay ku wajahayaan duleedka deegaannka Jannaale oo ay soo maciin bideen. Waxay ka soo barakaceen tuulooyinka Siigaale, Malable, Oow-gunji, Buula-alondi iyo kuwo kale oo ka tirsan gobolka Shabeellaha hoose. Aweys Cabdi Isaaqoo dadkan ka mid ah ayaa sheegay in tan iyo 2 bishii September ay daruuf adag ku haysato Jannaale. Raashin hal mar aan si fiican u deeqin oo beeralayda deegaanku ku caawiyaan ayay ku tiirsan yihiin. Wuxuu xusay in carruurtiisa oo 4 jir ugu yar yahay ay u adkaysan la’ yihiin gaajada. “Cunto iyo lacag aan ku gadano midna ma haysano. Dadka meesha aan ugu nimid ayaa wixii ay noo awoodaan na siiyaa. Madaal galey, koosto beeraha looga soo gooyo, moos iyo wixii ay noo heli karaan ayaan ku nool nahay. Markastana lama helo.” Aweys ayaa sheegay in qoykiisa oo 12 qof ah uusan kala gaarayn raashinka yar ee ay helaan. Dhamaantood waa dad nugul, taas oo keentay in uusan jirin qof u shaqeeya xilligaan adag. Waxay ka soo tageen 13 loor oo galey ah oo markaas uga soo go’day beer hal hektar ah oo ay hal xilli-beereed ku kiraysteen $20. Aamina ayaa sheegtay inay culays ku hayso dayn $50 ah oo looga leeyahay deegaankii ay ka soo barakaceen. Waxay ku gashay raashin iyo biyo uu ninkeedu u soo qaaday, taas oo ay doonayeen inay ku bixiyaan dalaga aysan calfan. Waxay ka kala yimaadeen tuulooyin ku teedsan jiinka wabiga iyo miyiga u dhow oo dagaallo ay ka socdaan. Wuxuu xusay in qaarkood ay gaarsiiyeen kaalmo iskugu jirta agab, raashin, daawo iyo lacago ganacsatada deegaanka ay uga aruuriyeen, balse aan wax badan u tarin, maaddama baahida jirta ay ka sarayso tabartooda dhaqaale. “Dadkaan waxay soo maciin bidden deegaanka, waxayna ka soo guureen ugu yaraan 25 tuulo. Waa guri la’aan. Qaarkood waa jirran yihiin oo dhiig la’aan, maleeriya iyo cuduro kale ayay qabaan. Wax gargaar ah oo meel kale naga soo gaaray ma jiro.” Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in dadkan ay ku soo beegmeen xilli ay roobab da’ayaan. Wuxuu xusay inay dadka magaalada qayb qayb ula dajiyeen, si ay ula wadaagaan khayraadka ay heli karaan iyo guryahooda. Qaarkood ayuu xusay inay bannaan-yaal yihiin, maaddama ay badan yihiin. items.title: Somaliland iyo Somalia wey kala duwanyihiin Madaxweynaha Mareykanka
items.description: https://qarannews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/45549f84aab66ffb124bdd6101c60aa5_1791890201110.mp4 Madaxweynaha waddanka Maraykanka Donald Trump oo khudbad ka jeediyay goob fagaare ah oo ku taalla gobolka Ohio ayaa si rasmiya ugu dhawaaqay in Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland kala yihiin laba waddan oo kala duwan. Trump ayaa sheegay in dad badani jecel yihiin ama ay danaynayaa Somaliland balse waxa uu Trump dood keenay magaca Somaliland isaga oo soo jeediyey in ay iska beddelaan magaca Somaliland oo sida muuqata uu ka dhadhan saday isu-dhawaanshaha labada magac ee Soomaaliya iyo Somalilland. Maaha markii kowaad ee Trump uu soo hadal qaado magaca Somaliland tan iyo markii uu talada ku soo laabtay waxayna ahayd sannadkii hore markiii uu sheegay in ay daraasad ku wadaan arrimaha Somaliland. Trump ayaa si weyn u dhaliilay Soomaaliya oo uu ku tilmaamay dal aan dawladi ka jirin.

items.title: Somaliland President Hails Productive Talks in Washington
items.description: Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro has described his recent meetings with senior U.S. officials as productive, expressing optimism about closer diplomatic, economic and security relations with Washington while urging President Donald Trump to formally recognize Somaliland. In an exclusive interview with Breitbart News, published on October 11, Irro said his delegation had held discussions with members of Congress, senators and officials from several U.S. government departments during a visit to Washington in September. “We had a very cordial, friendly reception in the United States,” Irro said. “We had a productive week in Washington, and met with congressmen. We met with senators. We met with the administration, including the State Department, the Department of War, the Department of Energy, and Department of Treasury. We also met prestigious institutions in Washington, and I have a speech here at the CFR in New York. Yes, we also spoke and met with different organizations in the United States and New York. We have met with some friendly countries, some organizations as well.” The president’s remarks offered details of Somaliland’s diplomatic outreach in Washington as Hargeisa seeks to translate growing engagement with American policymakers into stronger bilateral relations and eventual diplomatic recognition. Although the visit did not produce a formal recognition announcement, Irro said his government was encouraged by the discussions. “Well, we are actually satisfied with the level of engagement we had in the United States now,” he said. “We didn’t get the recognition now on the table, but hopefully things will move forward, and we make great progress, and we are satisfied with the level we have so far done.” Somaliland restored its independence in 1991 following the collapse of Somalia’s central government and has since established its own government, armed forces, currency and electoral institutions. Somalia continues to claim Somaliland as part of its territory. Israel became the first United Nations member state to formally recognize Somaliland in December 2025, marking a significant diplomatic breakthrough for Hargeisa after more than three decades of seeking international recognition. Irro described Israel’s decision as a turning point. “I think I can say that the recognition by Israel of Somaliland was the icebreaker,” he said. “Now Somaliland is feasible to the whole world.” Irro Appeals to Trump for Recognition The Somaliland leader made a direct appeal to Trump, arguing that recognition would strengthen American security and economic interests in the Horn of Africa. “Well, I think President Trump is a great man,” Irro said. “He made history, and he could make more history by recognizing a new country called Somaliland, which will cooperate unconditionally in the fight against terrorism, in the fight against piracy, in the fight for marine security, and safer world trade routes as well, in a strategic, very important location.” The president also expressed support for Trump’s Nobel Peace Prize ambitions, citing his administration’s involvement in international conflict-resolution efforts. “I may be on the record that I am the first African leader to refer the president for a Nobel Peace Prize, because so far for the short time he has been in office, he has resolved many conflicts in the world,” Irro said. Security Cooperation and Berbera Port Irro said Somaliland was already discussing closer counterterrorism cooperation with the United States and saw opportunities to expand the relationship into maritime security, trade and investment. “We are already in discussion with the United States on cooperating with counterterrorism,” he said. “We’re ready to partner with the United States, and also Somaliland historically was fighting alone, single-handedly, as I said, against terrorism and piracy. I see there is a great opportunity for the partnership between the United States and Somaliland in economy, in trade, in security, in counterterrorism, in national security, and more.” Somaliland occupies a strategic position along the Gulf of Aden, near the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, one of the world’s most important maritime passages connecting the Red Sea with the Indian Ocean. The location has gained greater geopolitical significance amid attacks on commercial shipping in the Red Sea and continuing instability in Yemen. Irro said Somaliland’s geographical position and record of maintaining security along its coastline made it a potential partner for Washington. “For 35 years we have been single-handedly securing our waters, which is very important for the world global trade,” he said. The president also promoted the Port of Berbera as a gateway for international commerce, particularly for Ethiopia and other landlocked African economies. “Berbera, as I said, has a very strategic location, and now, because of the certain conditions in the world which now exist regarding the war, even some of the world’s largest shipping companies now use Berbera to bring their goods, and later they ship again to their destinations because of security reasons,” Irro said. “So Berbera’s need and demand is increasing, and Berbera is a viable port that can handle large containers as well.” The port, developed by DP World, forms part of Somaliland’s efforts to establish itself as a regional logistics and trading centre. Irro said the country could become an important commercial corridor linking global markets with Ethiopia, East Africa and Central Africa. Somaliland Seeks Partnership, Not Aid Beyond recognition, Irro emphasized that Somaliland wanted a relationship with Washington built on shared strategic interests rather than dependence on foreign assistance. He said the country could contribute to American priorities through maritime security, counterterrorism and economic cooperation. The president also reiterated his willingness to contribute 2,000 peacekeepers to a potential Gaza peacekeeping mission, although no deployment agreement was announced in the interview. “I told them we can provide 2,000 peacekeepers in Gaza. Yes, we are ready for that,” he said. Concluding his appeal to American policymakers, Irro said Somaliland offered opportunities for cooperation in a strategically important part of Africa. “My last message is that we — as a Somalilander — we didn’t come here for a list of requests or aid,” he said. “We came with partnership. Somaliland is not for aid; it is not for handouts. Somaliland needs partnership in trade, in security, and economic cooperation. I think Somaliland can be part and parcel of making America great.”   Horndiplomat

The president also promoted the Port of Berbera as a gateway for international commerce, particularly for Ethiopia and other landlocked African economies. “Berbera, as I said, has a very strategic location, and now, because of the certain conditions in the world which now exist regarding the war, even some of the world’s largest shipping companies now use Berbera to bring their goods, and later they ship again to their destinations because of security reasons,” Irro said. “So Berbera’s need and demand is increasing, and Berbera is a viable port that can handle large containers as well.” The port, developed by DP World, forms part of Somaliland’s efforts to establish itself as a regional logistics and trading centre. Irro said the country could become an important commercial corridor linking global markets with Ethiopia, East Africa and Central Africa. Somaliland Seeks Partnership, Not Aid Beyond recognition, Irro emphasized that Somaliland wanted a relationship with Washington built on shared strategic interests rather than dependence on foreign assistance. He said the country could contribute to American priorities through maritime security, counterterrorism and economic cooperation. The president also reiterated his willingness to contribute 2,000 peacekeepers to a potential Gaza peacekeeping mission, although no deployment agreement was announced in the interview. “I told them we can provide 2,000 peacekeepers in Gaza. Yes, we are ready for that,” he said. Concluding his appeal to American policymakers, Irro said Somaliland offered opportunities for cooperation in a strategically important part of Africa. “My last message is that we — as a Somalilander — we didn’t come here for a list of requests or aid,” he said. “We came with partnership. Somaliland is not for aid; it is not for handouts. Somaliland needs partnership in trade, in security, and economic cooperation. I think Somaliland can be part and parcel of making America great.”   Horndiplomat

items.title: Weerarrada garoonka Riyaad: Xiisadda Bariga Dhexe ma waxay gashay marxalad khatar ah
items.description: Weerarkii gantaalada ahaa ee dhawaan lagu qaaday Garoonka Diyaaradaha King Khalid ee Riyadh iyo dhimashada ka dhalatay ayaa calaamad u ah gelitaanka marxalad cusub oo khatar ah oo xiisad ah oo ka jirta Bariga Dhexe. Sida muuqata Sacuudi Carabiya uma diyaarsanayn weerarradan lama filaanka ah iyo kuwa aan caadiga ahayn. Ugu yaraan 15 qof oo ka soo jeeda jinsiyado kala duwan ayaa la dilay in ka badan 300 oo kalena way ku dhaawacmeen weerarro taxane ah oo ka dhacay garoonka diyaaradaha ee ugu weyn caasimadda Sacuudiga, Riyadh. Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa digniin u diray shirkadaha diyaaradaha iyo dadka safarka ah ee adduunka oo dhan inay ka fogaadaan garoomada diyaaradaha ee Sacuudiga, taasoo walaac ka muujisay badqabka safarka dhanka cirka ee gobolka. Toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay, Xuutiyiintu waxay kordhiyeen weerarradooda dhulka Sacuudiga, laakiin maalmihii la soo dhaafay, bartilmaameedka weerarrada Xuutiyiintu wuxuu ahaa kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha rayidka ee Sacuudiga. Weerarrada lagu qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha ee ugu weyn caasimadda Riyadh ayaa u muuqda inay bixiyeen aragti ah in Xuutiyiintu ay awood u yeesheen inay si fudud uga gudbaan nidaamyada difaaca hawada ee Sacuudiga. Inkastoo burburka ka dhashay weerarka ee ku yimid kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha laga yaabo inuusan ahayn mid aad u baaxad weyn, haddana hubaal waxaa ah in dharbaaxo ku timid sumcadda caalamiga ah ee Sacuudiga oo loo arko dal xasilloon oo ammaan ah. Marka laga soo tago weerarrada lagu qaaday garoomada diyaaradaha, Xuutiyiintu waxay sidoo kale isku dayeen inay la wareegaan goobo istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim ah oo ku yaalla xeebta Badda Cas iyo agagaarka marinka Bab al-Mandab; arrintaas oo sii kordhinaysa khatarta ku wajahan badqabka socodka maraakiibta ee marinkan badda ee muhiimka ah, inkastoo xukuumadda Yemen ay sheegtay inay ka dhigtay marinka Bab al-Mandab mid “ammaan ah”. Dalka Yemen ayaa waxaa muddo toban sano ka badan ka socday dagaallo sokeeye oo u dhexeeya dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay ee Sucuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta oo ay Iiraan taageerto. Colaadda ayaa waxaa ku dhintay kumannaan qof, waxayna Yemen ka dhigtay mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka bani’aadamnimo ee ugu xun adduunka. Tani waa isku dhac juqraafiyeed oo cakiran oo inta badan jahawareer leh, kororka dhowaantan ayaa muujinaya macnaha guud ee xiisadaha sii socda ee u dhexeeya Iran, Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil. Waa markii ugu horreysay ee Sacuudi Carabiya ay wajahdo khatar halis ah oo noocan oo kale ah tan iyo markii ay kacdoonka Al-Qaacida ka bilowdeen bartamihii 2000-meeyadii. Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya waxay ka gudubtay caqabaddii ay xilligaas la kulantay Al-Qaacida iyadoo adeegsanaysa xeelad wax ku ool ah oo ay ku kasbanayso taageero dadweyne. Waxay sidoo kale ka hortagtay dhaqdhaqaaqyada Gu’ga Carabta ee meesha ka saaray talisyadii Tunisia, Liibiya, Masar iyo Yemen. Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale u dulqaatay weerarkii gantaalada ballistic-ga ee Iiraan ay ku qaadday Riyadh bishii Maarso 2026, inkastoo ay ka xanaaqsanayd. Haddaba xaaladda hadda jirta way ka duwan tahay. Sacuudi Carabiya waxay leedahay mid ka mid ah ciidamada cirka ee ugu awoodda badan Bariga Dhexe waxayna sidoo kale duqeymo ba’an ka geysanaysaa goobaha Xuutiyiinta. Iyadoo ay taasi jirto, ciidamada mucaaradka ee Yemen (Xuutiyiinta) waxay ku guuleysteen inay qabsadaan meelo badan, oo ay ku jiraan qaybaha waqooyi iyo galbeedka dalka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Xuutiyiintu waxay si sax ah u ogyihiin meesha ay ka dhaawici karaan Sacuudi Carabiya: iyagoo bartilmaameedsanaya qaybaha ugu xasaasisan dhaqaalaha Sacuudiga. Iyadoo qayb ka ah ‘Dhinaca Iska caabinta,’ Xuutiyiintu waa saaxiib muhiim u ah Iiraan. Laga bilaabo magaalada xeebta Badda Cas ee Jizan ilaa xarunta batroolka ee Khurais, Xuutiyiintu waxay qaadayaan weeraro sax ah iyagoo adeegsanaya diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo gantaalada. Wadada ganacsiga badda ee Badda Cas ayaa noqotay mid aad muhiim u ah sababtoo ah marin biyoodka Hormuz, oo dhinaca kale ee Gacanka ku yaal, weli si buuxda looma soo celin sababtoo ah ku guuldareysiga in la gaaro heshiis lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iiraan. Weerarrada lagu qaadayo maraakiibta Badda Cas ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa xeelad ay kooxda Xuutiyiintu u adeegsanayaan inay cadaadiska ku kordhiyaan. Weerarradan ayaa waxyeello u geysta dhaqaalaha caalamka, taas oo u ah Tehran hub muhiim ah oo dhanka diblomaasiyadda iyo siyaasadda ah. Horaantii bishii Sebtembar, Aqalka Cad ayaa sheegay inuusan si toos ah u soo faragelin doonin colaadda Yemen, balse uu Sacuudi Carabiya siin karo taageero dhanka sirdoonka ah. Mar dambe, Mareykanka ayaa xaqiijiyay inuu bixinayo xog sirdoon, isla markaana uu Sacuudi Carabiya u diray khubaro dhanka milatariga ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xaaladdu waxay u muuqataa inay qaadatay waji cusub ka dib weerarkii dhawaan lagu qaaday Riyadh, kaas oo sidoo kale sababay dhimashada muwaadin Mareykan ah. Isagoo la hadlayay weriyeyaasha, Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa ku tilmaamay weerarkii Sabtidii mid “naxdin leh,” wuxuuna tilmaamay inuu go’aan ka gaari karo tallaabo milatari oo wadajir ah oo lala qaado Sacuudi Carabiya. “Hadda un baan ka war helnay weerarkaas dhawaan dhacay, sidaa darteed waan go’aan gaari doonnaa. Tallaabo ayaan si degdeg ah u qaadnaa,” ayuu yiri. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, tallaabo kasta oo noocaas ah waxay u muuqataa mid aan macquul ahayn, ugu yaraan ka hor doorashooyinka muhiimka ah ee muddada dhexe ee Mareykanka bisha soo socota. Ka dib markii dib loo doortay 2024, Trump wuxuu ballanqaaday inuu soo afjari doono doorka Mareykanka ee dagaallada adduunka oo dhan. Haddana Mareykanka wuxuu hadda ku jiraa saddex colaadood oo aan la xallin oo ka jira Bariga Dhexe oo ay ku lug leeyihiin Gaza, Lubnaan, iyo Iiraan. Haddii Trump uu ku lug yeesho khilaaf kale, weliba Yemen, waxay u badan tahay in codbixiyeyaasha Mareykanka aysan jeclaan doonin tallaabadaas. Hadda dagaalku wuxuu u muuqdaa inuu xoojinayo aragtida ah inuu sii kordhi doono ka hor inta uusan gaarin xabbad joojin aan la saadaalin karin, haddii Mareykanka uu ku lug leeyahay iyo haddii kaleba. Bbc news

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Dhexdhexaad Ka Noqotay Xiisadda Itoobiya iyo Eritrea
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay dhexdhexaad ka tahay xiisadda sii xoogeysanaysa ee u dhexeysa Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, iyadoo caddeysay inaysan doonayn inay qayb ka noqoto khilaafka labada dal, isla markaana ay muhiimad gaar ah siinayso xasilloonida iyo xal diblomaasiyadeed oo laga gaaro muranka taagan. Wasiir-ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Xasan Maxamed Cali Nadaara, oo wareysi siiyey BBC-da, ayaa sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay si dhow ula socoto xaaladda gobolka, balse aysan dhinacna la safanayn. Wuxuu xusay in mowqifka Muqdisho uu yahay ilaalinta nabadda iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika, iyadoo la dhowrayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee ay la leedahay labada dal. Nadaara ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay ka-qaybgalka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee shirkii ay Masar, Eritrea iyo Suudaan ku yeesheen Qaahira, isagoo meesha ka saaray in kulankaasi Soomaaliya ka dhigay xubin ka tirsan isbahaysi ka dhan ah Itoobiya. Wuxuu sheegay in shirku ahaa wada-tashi ku saabsan arrimaha gobolka, taas oo muujinaysa in ka-qaybgalka Soomaaliya aan loo fasiran karin inay ku biirtay dhinac ka soo horjeeda Addis Ababa. Mowqifkan ayaa imanaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan khilaafaadka u dhexeeya Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, kuwaas oo salka ku haya arrimo la xiriira amniga gobolka, marin-badeedka iyo loollanka istaraatiijiyadeed ee Geeska Afrika. Xiisadda labada dal ayaa dhalisay walaac laga qabo in khilaafku isu beddelo iska horimaad militari oo saameeya dalalka deriska ah. Dhanka kale, Itoobiya ayaa weli door muhiim ah ku leh arrimaha amniga iyo siyaasadda Soomaaliya, halka dowladda federaalku ay xoojisay xiriirka ay la leedahay Masar iyo dalal kale oo ay Itoobiya isku khilaafsan yihiin arrimo gobolka khuseeya. Xaaladdan ayaa Muqdisho gelinaysa xaalad diblomaasiyadeed oo u baahan taxaddar, si ay u ilaaliso xiriirkeeda dalalka kala duwan, ugana fogaato inay ku milanto loollanka ka dhex jira quwadaha gobolka. Dagaal dhex mara Itoobiya iyo Eritrea wuxuu saameyn ku yeelan karaa ganacsiga, isu-socodka xuduudaha, amniga Badda Cas iyo hawlgallada amni ee Geeska Afrika. Sidoo kale, colaadda noocaas ahi waxay carqaladeyn kartaa dadaallada iskaashiga gobolka iyo xasilloonida dalalka deriska ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee dhexdhexaadnimada Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay diblomaasiyad miisaaman oo ku dhisan wada-hadal, ilaalinta danaha qaranka iyo taageeridda dadaallada lagu dejinayo xiisadda. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa wajahaysa baahida ah inay sii waddo xariirka ay la leedahay Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, iyadoo isla mar ahaantaana ka shaqaynaysa sidii looga hortagi lahaa in khilaafka labada dal uu saameyn taban ku yeesho Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan gobolka. Si ay Xeeldheereyaashu qabaan mowqifka ay Soomaaliya ku dhawaaqday wuxuu muujinayaa rabitaanka dowladda ee ah inaysan qayb ka noqon iska horimaad goboleed, balse ay taageerto xasillooni iyo xal diblomaasiyadeed.

Si ay Xeeldheereyaashu qabaan mowqifka ay Soomaaliya ku dhawaaqday wuxuu muujinayaa rabitaanka dowladda ee ah inaysan qayb ka noqon iska horimaad goboleed, balse ay taageerto xasillooni iyo xal diblomaasiyadeed.

items.title: Xiisadda Dowladda Federaalka iyo Mucaaradka oo Sii Kordhaysa Kaddib Dhaqdhaqaaqyo Ciidan oo Muqdisho ka Dhacay
items.description: Xiisadda siyaasadeed ee u dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ayaa sii xoogeysatay, kaddib markii ciidamo amni la geeyey qaybo ka mid ah degmada Wadajir ee magaalada Muqdisho, gaar ahaan waddooyinka ku dhow guryaha ay deggan yihiin qaar ka mid ah madaxda hore ee dalka. Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Shariif Sheekh Axmed, ayaa beeniyey eedeymo uga yimid Hay’adda Nabad-sugidda iyo Sirdoonka Qaranka (NISA), kuwaas oo la xiriiray in xubno ka tirsan ilaaladiisa ay ku lug lahaayeen falal amni-darro. Xafiiska madaxweynihii hore ayaa sheegay in dhaqdhaqaaqiisa la xaddiday, isla markaana ciidamo iyo gaadiid dagaal la dhigay waddooyinka ku dhow hoygiisa. Dhanka kale, NISA ayaa sheegtay in rag hubeysan oo watay qoryaha AK-47, BKM iyo RPG ay xoog ku galeen guryo ku yaalla xaafadda Tiintiinley ee degmada Wadajir. Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Khayre, ayaa ka digay in dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidan ee ka socda agagaarka guryaha madaxda hore ay horseedi karaan qalalaase siyaasadeed iyo mid amni. Wuxuu walaac ka muujiyey saameynta ay xaaladdani ku yeelan karto xasilloonida caasimadda, xilli dalka uu wajahayo khilaafaad siyaasadeed oo la xiriira arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo dastuurka. Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa isaguna dowladda ugu baaqay inay ciidamada ka fogeyso guryaha ay deggan yihiin siyaasiyiinta, isla markaana khilaafaadka jira lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad siyaasadeed. Siyaasiyiinta golaha ayaa habeenkii Isniinta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay hoyga Shariif Sheekh Axmed, iyagoo ka hadlay xaaladda amni iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidanka ee laga dareemayo agagaarka guriga madaxweynihii hore. Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Xuseen Odowaa ayaa sheegay in maalmihii u dambeeyey ay jireen isku-dayo lagu beegsanayo guriga Shariif Sheekh Axmed. Wuxuu odayaasha dhaqanka iyo bulshada Muqdisho ugu baaqay inay soo dhexgalaan xiisadda, kana shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa isku dhac hubeysan oo saameyn ku yeelan kara shacabka iyo amniga caasimadda. Dhanka dowladda, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa mucaaradka ku eedeeyey inay abaabulayaan kooxo hubeysan, isagoo sheegay inaan cidna loo oggolaan doonin inay hub u adeegsato carqaladeynta amniga Muqdisho. Mucaaradka ayaa, dhinacooda, tallaabooyinka ciidanka ku tilmaamay kuwo cabsi-gelin siyaasadeed ah, iyagoo ku baaqaya in la joojiyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada ay u arkaan kuwo cadaadis lagu saarayo hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka. Kala aragti duwanaanshahan ayaa sii adkaynaya xiriirka u dhexeeya dowladda iyo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka. Xiisaddan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay weli taagan yihiin khilaafaad siyaasadeed oo ku saabsan hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo arrimaha dastuurka. Ilaa hadda, ma jiro xog madax-bannaan oo si buuxda u xaqiijinaysa dhammaan eedeymaha ay dhinacyadu is-weydaarsadeen, mana cadda tallaabooyinka xiga ee ay qaadi doonaan dowladda iyo mucaaradku. Dadka siyaasadda falanqeeya ayaa guud ahaan u arka in xaaladahan oo kale ay u baahan yihiin is-xakameyn, hufnaan iyo wada-hadal degdeg ah si looga hortago in khilaafka siyaasadeed isu beddelo iska horimaad amni. Sidoo kale, faragelinta odayaasha dhaqanka iyo dhinacyada bulshada ayaa door ka qaadan karta dejinta xiisadda iyo ilaalinta badbaadada shacabka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee sida ay xaaladdu ku dambayn doonto ayaa ku xirnaan doontaa sida dowladda iyo mucaaradku uga jawaabaan xiisadda taagan, iyo in la helo hannaan lagu kala caddeeyo eedeymaha, laguna xalliyo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed si nabadeed.
