items.title: Somalia’s political vacuum could open a new front of threat
items.description: AFRICOM warns of possible Houthi–Al-Shabaab cooperation as Somalia’s disputed mandate and shifting US military priorities raise concerns over the Horn of Africa, the Gulf of Aden and Bab al-Mandab. MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia’s deepening political crisis is colliding with a growing regional security threat. US military officials have warned that Yemen’s Houthi movement may be seeking to expand its presence in northern Somalia and develop links with Al-Shabaab, raising concerns about the security of the Horn of Africa and one of the world’s most important maritime corridors. A report published by Stars and Stripes on October 9, citing US Africa Command (AFRICOM), said Houthi fighters or representatives may already be present in parts of northern Somalia. US officials fear that potential cooperation could provide Al-Shabaab with advanced weapons, military training and technical expertise in drones and other attack capabilities. The extent of any Houthi presence or operational relationship with Al-Shabaab has not been independently established in public reporting. Nevertheless, the warning highlights the risk that armed groups operating on opposite sides of the Gulf of Aden could share resources and expertise, threatening regional security and international shipping. A disputed mandate and a vulnerable state Somalia’s security challenges cannot be separated from its unresolved political impasse. Opposition leaders maintain that President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s four-year term expired on May 15, 2026, while the federal parliamentary mandate ended in April. The government disputes that interpretation, arguing that constitutional amendments and parliamentary decisions extend its mandate until May 2027. The disagreement has left Somalia without a political settlement accepted by all major stakeholders. Continued confrontation risks weakening cooperation between federal institutions and member states, undermining public confidence and diverting attention from the fight against militant groups. A disputed mandate does not automatically mean that Somalia has become a failed or lawless state. But prolonged political paralysis can weaken the institutions needed to maintain security, coordinate intelligence and exercise authority across national territory. That is particularly dangerous as Somalia confronts Al-Shabaab, an Islamic State affiliate operating in Puntland and wider regional security threats. The concern is that armed groups could exploit political fragmentation, expanding their activities while Somali leaders remain consumed by disputes over power and constitutional authority. The Houthi–Al-Shabaab threat The Houthis operate from Yemen, while Al-Shabaab conducts an insurgency in Somalia. Their positions on opposite sides of the Gulf of Aden give any potential cooperation serious strategic implications. AFRICOM is concerned that the Houthis could provide Al-Shabaab with expertise in drones, weapons and military tactics. The Houthis have demonstrated their ability to use missiles and drones in regional conflicts. If such capabilities were transferred to Al-Shabaab, the group could become more dangerous to Somali forces, international partners and other targets. The threat also extends to commercial shipping. The Gulf of Aden and Bab al-Mandab connect the Red Sea with the Indian Ocean and form a critical passage for trade between Europe, Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Increased militant activity could raise shipping costs, disrupt trade and place greater pressure on regional governments and naval forces. The Islamic State affiliate in Puntland presents an additional security challenge. However, there is no established public evidence that the Houthis, Al-Shabaab and ISIS are operating as a unified alliance. The concern is that a deteriorating security environment could allow these separate groups to expand their activities and exploit gaps in state authority. Djibouti and US military priorities The United States maintains a major military presence at Camp Lemonnier in Djibouti, a key hub for operations in East Africa. AFRICOM has previously expressed concern that Houthi missile and drone capabilities could threaten US facilities if the movement escalated its confrontation with Washington. Any verified Houthi–Al-Shabaab partnership could therefore complicate US counterterrorism operations and regional maritime security. However, the available reporting does not establish that the Houthis have created a confirmed operational base in Somalia or that coordinated attacks are imminent. The concerns come as Washington is reportedly transferring some MQ-9 Reaper drones from Africa to Colombia and Ecuador for operations against drug-trafficking organisations. The New York Times reported on October 6 that an unspecified number of the drones had been moved from Africa to South America. MQ-9 Reapers play an important role in surveillance, intelligence gathering and precision strikes, including US operations against Al-Shabaab. The number of aircraft transferred and the effect on US operations in Somalia have not been fully disclosed. It would therefore be premature to conclude that the redeployment has created a decisive gap in counterterrorism capabilities. Nevertheless, the timing raises questions about how Washington will balance competing military priorities while monitoring a potentially evolving threat in the Horn of Africa. Preventing a wider regional crisis Somalia’s political leaders cannot afford to treat the mandate dispute as separate from national security. A prolonged struggle over constitutional authority could weaken the cooperation required to confront militant groups and protect the country’s territorial integrity. The federal government, opposition leaders and federal member states should urgently negotiate an inclusive political settlement, establish a credible electoral roadmap and restore confidence in national institutions. At the same time, Somali security agencies and international partners should strengthen intelligence-sharing, maritime security and efforts to prevent weapons transfers and militant financing. International partners should support a Somali-led political process while assessing the regional consequences of changes to counterterrorism resources. The greatest danger is not that Somalia has already become a base for every regional militant movement, but that political fragmentation could make it easier for armed groups to gain a foothold. If the impasse continues and state institutions become less effective, the consequences could extend from northern Somalia to Djibouti, the Gulf of Aden and Bab al-Mandab. What begins as a domestic political crisis could then become a wider regional security problem, affecting international shipping and the strategic balance across the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea. items.title: Itoobiya oo Daahfurtay Warshaddii Ugu Horreysay ee Sifaynta Dahabka
items.description: Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa daahfurtay warshaddii ugu horreysay ee dalkaas u qaabilsan sifaynta dahabka, iyadoo tallaabadan lagu doonayo in dalka uu qiimo dheeraad ah ka helo kheyraadkiisa dabiiciga ah, halkii uu dahabka aan la sifayn dibadda ugu dhoofin lahaa. Warshaddan ayaa la furay 10-kii Oktoobar 2026, waxaana daahfurkeeda ku dhawaaqay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed. Mashruuca oo lagu maalgeliyey 50 milyan oo doollar ayaa loo dhisay iskaashi dhexmaray hay’adda maalgashiga dowladda Itoobiya iyo shirkadda Sam Precious Metals. Sida ay sheegtay Wakaaladda Wararka Itoobiya (ENA), warshaddu waxay awood u leedahay inay sannadkii farsamayso in ka badan 600 oo tan oo biraha qaaliga ah ah, waxaana la filayaa inay kaalin ka qaadato kobcinta warshadaha macdanta, kordhinta dakhliga dhoofinta iyo abuurista shaqooyin xirfad leh. Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Axmed ayaa sheegay in warshaddu aanay u adeegayn oo keliya dahabka laga soo saaro Itoobiya, balse ay sidoo kale soo jiidan karto dahabka dalalka deriska ah iyo shirkadaha macdanta ee gobolka, kuwaas oo dalka u keeni kara si loo sifeeyo, loo baaro tayadiisa loona xaqiijiyo halka uu ka yimid. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale rajaynaysa in xaruntani dalka u beddesho xarun goboleed oo lagu farsameeyo laguna suuq-geeyo dahabka, taas oo yareyn karta baahida loo qabo in macdanta loo dhoofiyo dalal ka baxsan qaaradda Afrika. Dahabku wuxuu ka mid yahay ilaha waaweyn ee Itoobiya ka hesho lacagaha qalaad. Sida ay Reuters werisay, dhoofinta dahabka ayaa dalka u soo xaraysay 5.6 bilyan oo doollar sannadkii hore, sida ku cad xogta dowladda. Tallaabada Itoobiya ayaa qayb ka ah isbeddel sii xoogaysanaya oo ka socda dalal Afrikaan ah, kuwaas oo doonaya inay dahabka ku sifeeyaan gudaha dalalkooda, si ay u kordhiyaan faa’iidada dhaqaale ee ka soo baxda kheyraadkooda. Burkina Faso, Mali iyo Côte d’Ivoire ayaa iyaguna qaaday ama ku dhawaaqay tallaabooyin la xiriira dhismaha xarumo sifaynta dahabka ah.

items.title: Hantidhowrka Guud ee Qaranka oo Baaritaan ku Bilaabay Deeqaha Waxbarashada ee Dugsiyada
items.description: Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee Qaranka Soomaaliya ayaa bilaabay baaritaan gaar ah oo lagu qiimeynayo habka loo maareeyey deeqaha waxbarasho ee la siiyey dugsiyada ka faa’iideysanaya Mashruuca Horumarinta Karaanka Aadanaha ee Waxbarashada Soomaaliya (SEHCDP). Baaritaanka ayaa markii hore laga bilaabay dugsiyada ku yaalla Gobolka Banaadir, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo sida loo isticmaalay lacagaha la bixiyey, diiwaannada maaliyadeed, habraacyada qaybinta deeqaha iyo u hoggaansanaanta shuruudaha mashruuca. Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ayaa la filayaa inuu baaritaanka ku fidiyo dowlad-goboleedyada kale ee uu mashruucu ka socdo, si loo helo qiimeyn dhammaystiran oo ku saabsan hirgelinta barnaamijka iyo heerka ay dugsiyada iyo ardaydu uga faa’iideysteen deeqaha la bixiyey. Baaritaankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo isla-xisaabtanka iyo daahfurnaanta maamulka lacagaha loogu talagalay horumarinta waxbarashada, gaar ahaan hubinta in dhaqaalaha la bixiyey loo adeegsaday ujeeddooyinkii loogu talagalay. Ilaa hadda, lama shaacin magacyada dugsiyada baaritaanku saameynayo, wadarta guud ee lacagaha la baarayo ama natiijo hordhac ah oo ka soo baxday hawsha hantidhowrka. Sidaas darteed, bilaabista baaritaanku ma caddaynayso in musuqmaasuq ama wax-is-daba-marin ay dhacday. Natiijada baaritaanka ayaa la filayaa inay iftiimiso habka loo maareeyey deeqaha, dugsiyada helay iyo in lacagahaasi gaareen ujeeddooyinkii waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay. Warbixinta kama dambaysta ah ee Hantidhowrka ayaa muhiim u noqon karta xoojinta kalsoonida bulshada iyo deeq-bixiyeyaasha, iyo hagaajinta maamulka maalgelinta waxbarashada Soomaaliya.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo Maalintii Saddexaad Weerarro Gantaallo ah ku Beegsaday Caasimadda Sacuudiga ee Riyadh
items.description: Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sheegtay inay fashilisay weerar cusub oo gantaallo ballistic ah oo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ku soo rideen caasimadda Riyadh, iyadoo weerarradu maalintii saddexaad oo xiriir ah ka socdaan gudaha dalkaas. Afhayeenka isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ee dagaalka kula jira Xuutiyiinta, Turki Al-Maaliki, ayaa sheegay in ciidamada difaaca cirka ay qabteen oo burburiyeen saddex gantaal oo ballistic ah, kuwaas oo mid lagu soo tuuray Riyadh, halka labada kalena lagu bartilmaameedsaday magaalada Khamis Mushait ee koonfur-galbeed dalka Sacuudiga. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in weerarka Riyadh lagu beegsaday garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee King Khalid, halkaas oo weli hakad ku jiro howlihii duulimaadyada kaddib weerarro hore oo sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac badan. Wararka la xiriira weerarradii maalmihii u dambeeyay ayaa sheegaya in ugu yaraan 14 qof ay dhinteen, halka in ka badan 300 oo qof ay ku dhaawacmeen weerarro kala duwan oo lala beegsaday Riyadh. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inay weerarro diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah ku qaadeen saldhig militari oo ku yaalla Khamis Mushait. Garoonka King Khalid ayaa la sheegay inuu xirnaan doono ilaa Sabtida, iyadoo shirkado diyaaradeed ay baajiyeen ama dib u dhigeen duulimaadyadoodii Sacuudiga. Shirkadda Etihad Airways ee Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay hakisay duulimaadyada Riyadh ilaa toddobaadka xiga, halka Gulf Air ee Baxreyn ay sidoo kale baajisay duulimaadyadii Riyadh ilaa Sabtida. Dhanka kale, mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga ayaa bilaabay baaritaan lagu ogaanayo sababta nidaamyada difaaca cirka ay u joojin waayeen qaar ka mid ah weerarradii hore ee lagu qaaday garoonka Riyadh. Sida ay saraakiil goboleed u sheegeen wakaaladda wararka ee Associated Press, baaritaanka hordhaca ah ayaa tilmaamaya in diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn markii hore la adeegsaday, ka hor inta aan la soo ridin gantaallo noocyo kala duwan leh. Wasiirka Tamarta Sacuudiga, Amiir Cabdulcasiis bin Salmaan, ayaa sheegay in weerarrada lagu qaaday garoomada diyaaradaha ay tijaabo adag ku yihiin adkeysiga dalka, hase yeeshee wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in qorshaha Vision 2030 ee lagu horumarinayo dhaqaalaha Sacuudiga iyo maalgelinta dalka ay sii socon doonaan. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale uga digay shirkadaha diyaaradaha caalamiga ah iyo dadka safarka ah inay isticmaalaan garoomada Sacuudiga, marka laga reebo kuwa ku yaalla Maka iyo Madiina, iyagoo ku dooday in garoomada kale aysan ammaan ahayn. Mas’uul ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta ayaa intaa ku daray in xarumaha shidaalka iyo garoomada diyaaradaha Sacuudiga ay noqon karaan bartilmaameedyo kale. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa dhaleeceeyay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta, balse ma uusan sheegin tallaabo gaar ah oo Washington qaadi doonto. Dhanka kale, mas’uul ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta ayaa ka digay in haddii Mareykanku si toos ah ugu lug yeesho dagaalka Yemen, ay jawaab degdeg ah ka bixin doonaan, taas oo uu sheegay inay beegsan karto Mareykanka iyo danihiisa gobolka. Weerarradan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dagaalka Yemen uu weli ka socdo, iyadoo Xuutiyiintu ay la dagaallamayaan xoogagga taageera dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, halka isbahaysiga Sacuudigu uu taageero dowladdaas.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Aljeeriya oo ka Wada hadlay Xoojinta Xariirka Ganacsi iyo Iskaashiga Labada Dal
items.description: Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Aljeeriya ayaa ka wada hadlay sidii loo xoojin lahaa xiriirka ganacsi iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee labada dal, iyadoo la doonayo in la ballaariyo fursadaha suuq-geynta iyo is-weydaarsiga badeecadaha. Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya u fadhiya Aljeeriya, Yuusuf Axmed Xasan, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Wasiirka Ganacsiga Dibadda iyo Dhiirrigelinta Dhoofinta Algeria, Prof. Kamaal Ruzeeq, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray horumarinta xiriirka ganacsi iyo sahminta fursado dhaqaale oo ay labada dal ka wada faa’iideysan karaan. Intii uu kulanku socday, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada hadlay sidii loo kordhin lahaa suuq-geynta badeecadaha Aljeeriya ee gudaha Soomaaliya, loona sahmin lahaa fursadaha dhoofinta badeecadaha dalkaas si ay uga jawaabaan baahiyaha ka jira suuqa Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, kulanka waxaa lagu soo qaaday qorshaha lagu dhisayo Golaha Ganacsiga Soomaaliya iyo Aljeeriya , kaas oo la doonayo inuu xoojiyo xiriirka ganacsatada labada dal, dhiirrigeliyo hindisayaasha ganacsi ee wadajirka ah, isla markaana fududeeyo iskaashiga ganacsi iyo maalgashi. Wada-hadalladan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu horumarinayo xiriirka dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya iyo Aljeeriya, iyadoo la raadinayo fursado cusub oo kor loogu qaadayo is-weydaarsiga badeecadaha iyo iskaashiga ganacsatada labada dal.

items.title: Ilhaan Cumar oo jawaab kulul soo saartay kadib baaritaankii lagu sameeyey gurigeeda
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar ayaa si kulul uga jawaabtay baaritaan ay ciidamada federaalka Mareykanka ku sameeyeen gurigeeda magaalada Washington DC, iyadoo ku eedeysay Madaxweyne Donald Trump inuu hay’adaha ammaanka dowladda u adeegsanayo cabsi-gelinta iyo bartilmaameedsiga dadka siyaasadda ku mucaaradsan. Ilhaan ayaa qoraal ay Isniintii soo dhigtay barteeda X ku sheegtay inay nabad qabto, balse waxay hawlgalka ku tilmaantay tallaabo cusub oo ka mid ah olole siyaasadeed oo Trump uu muddo toban sano ah ku hayey. “Ha ku khaldamin, tani waa isku day lagu bartilmaameedsanayo dadka siyaasadda lagu kala aragtida duwan yahay, looguna adeegsanayo hay’adaha fulinta sharciga federaalka,” ayay tiri Ilhaan. “Muddo toban sano ah, Trump wuxuu igu bartilmaameedsanayey been abuur aan sal lahayn iyo ololeyaal sumcad dil ah. Tani waa tallaabadii ugu dambeysay ee sii xoojineysa ololihiisa cabsi-gelinta siyaasadeed,” ayay raacisay. “Ma aamusi doono,” ayay hadalkeeda ku soo gabagabeysay. Xafiiska Ilhaan Cumar ayaa isaguna soo saaray bayaan uu hawlgalka ku cambaareeyey, kuna tilmaamay ku takrifal awoodeed oo aan hore loo arag, kaas oo lagu adeegsanayo hay’adaha federaalka si loo beegsado dadka siyaasadda ku mucaaradsan Trump. Afhayeenka xildhibaanadda, Jacklyn Rogers, ayaa sheegtay in Trump uu muddo dheer Ilhaan ku hayey weerarro afka ah oo halis geliyey ammaankeeda, balse hadda uu arrinta gaarsiiyey heer ciidamada federaalka ay baaraan gurigeeda. “Xildhibaanaddu wax dembi ah ma gelin. Madaxweyne kasta waa inaan loo oggolaan inuu awoodda dowladda federaalka u adeegsado cabsi-gelinta dadka siyaasadda ku mucaaradsan,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Baaritaanka iyo eedeymaha jira Jawaabaha Ilhaan ayaa yimid saacado kaddib markii ciidamada hay’adda Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) ay subaxnimadii Isniinta baaritaan ku sameeyeen gurigeeda Washington. Wasaaradda Caddaaladda Mareykanka ayaa xaqiijisay in hawlgalka lagu fuliyey ogolaansho maxkamadeed, isla markaana uu qeyb ka yahay baaritaan dembiyeed socda, balse ma aysan shaacin dembiga la baarayo iyo caddeymaha ay ciidamadu raadinayeen. Warbaahinta Fox News , oo markii ugu horreysay tabisay hawlgalka, ayaa sheegtay in baaritaanku la xiriiro eedeymo ku saabsan dokumentiyo socdaal oo aabbaheed uu buuxiyey xilligii ay carruurta ahayd. Hase yeeshee, Wasaaradda Caddaaladda si rasmi ah uma xaqiijin in baaritaanku ku saabsan yahay eedeymahaas, mana jiraan wax dacwado dembiyeed ah oo ilaa hadda lagu soo oogay Ilhaan Cumar. Baaritaankan ayaa daba socda hadallo ay bilihii la soo dhaafay jeedinayeen mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan maamulka Trump, kuwaas oo su’aal geliyey taariikhda socdaalka Ilhaan iyo guur hore oo ay gashay. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Mareykanka JD Vance ayaa bishii May sheegay in Wasaaradda Caddaaladdu ay baareyso eedeymahaas, isagoo xusay in tallaabo sharci ah la qaadi doono haddii la helo caddeymo muujinaya in dembi dhacay. Ilhaan ayaa marar badan beenisay eedeymaha, gaar ahaan sheegashada ah inay guursatay nin ay siyaasiyiinta qaar ku tilmaameen walaalkeed, si ay ugu fududeyso inuu Mareykanka soo galo. Ilaa hadda ma jiraan caddeymo si fagaare ah loo soo bandhigay oo xaqiijinaya sheegashadaas. Xisbiga Dimoqraadiga oo cambaareeyey Dhanka kale, hoggaamiyeyaasha xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ee Golaha Wakiillada Mareykanka ayaa si adag u cambaareeyey baaritaanka, iyagoo su’aal geliyey waqtiga uu dhacay iyo suurtagalnimada in hay’adaha federaalka loo adeegsado dano siyaasadeed. Hoggaamiyaha Dimoqraadiga ee Golaha Wakiillada, Hakeem Jeffries, iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo xisbiga ka tirsan ayaa bayaan wadajir ah ku sheegay in hawlgalku uu dhalinayo walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan ku takrifalka awoodda dowladda. Waxay dalbadeen in dowladda ay caddeyso sababaha iyo duruufaha keenay baaritaanka, iyagoo ballanqaaday inay ka shaqeyn doonaan isla xisaabtan ku saabsan hawlgalka. Arrintan ayaa ku soo beegantay iyadoo wax ka yar bil ay ka harsan tahay doorashooyinka dhexe ee Congress-ka Mareykanka ee 3-da November, kuwaas oo Ilhaan Cumar ay mar kale ku dooneyso inay ku sii haysato kursigeeda gobolka Minnesota. Wasaaradda Caddaaladda Mareykanka ayaa muddo dheer lahayd habraac looga fogaanayo tallaabooyinka baaritaan ee saameyn ku yeelan kara doorashooyinka, gaar ahaan marka ay soo dhow yihiin. Hase yeeshee, weli lama xaqiijin in hawlgalkan uu jebiyey habraacaas. Ilhaan Cumar, oo Mareykanka ku timid qaxootinimo sanadkii 1995, isla markaana dhalashada dalkaas qaadatay sanadkii 2000, ayaa ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta sida joogtada ah u dhaliila maamulka Trump. Trump ayaa isaguna dhowr jeer weerar afka ah ku qaaday Ilhaan iyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee Minnesota, isagoo su’aal geliyey daacadnimadeeda Mareykanka, kuna baaqay in dalka laga masaafuriyo. Ilaa hadda, maamulka Trump ma uusan soo bandhigin caddeymo dadweynaha loogu xaqiijinayo eedeymaha socdaalka ee loo jeediyey Ilhaan Cumar, halka Wasaaradda Caddaaladdu aysan sheegin muddada baaritaanku socon doono iyo in dacwad laga soo saari doono. Baaritaanka iyo eedeymaha jira Jawaabaha Ilhaan ayaa yimid saacado kaddib markii ciidamada hay’adda Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) ay subaxnimadii Isniinta baaritaan ku sameeyeen gurigeeda Washington. Wasaaradda Caddaaladda Mareykanka ayaa xaqiijisay in hawlgalka lagu fuliyey ogolaansho maxkamadeed, isla markaana uu qeyb ka yahay baaritaan dembiyeed socda, balse ma aysan shaacin dembiga la baarayo iyo caddeymaha ay ciidamadu raadinayeen. Warbaahinta Fox News , oo markii ugu horreysay tabisay hawlgalka, ayaa sheegtay in baaritaanku la xiriiro eedeymo ku saabsan dokumentiyo socdaal oo aabbaheed uu buuxiyey xilligii ay carruurta ahayd. Hase yeeshee, Wasaaradda Caddaaladda si rasmi ah uma xaqiijin in baaritaanku ku saabsan yahay eedeymahaas, mana jiraan wax dacwado dembiyeed ah oo ilaa hadda lagu soo oogay Ilhaan Cumar. Baaritaankan ayaa daba socda hadallo ay bilihii la soo dhaafay jeedinayeen mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan maamulka Trump, kuwaas oo su’aal geliyey taariikhda socdaalka Ilhaan iyo guur hore oo ay gashay. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Mareykanka JD Vance ayaa bishii May sheegay in Wasaaradda Caddaaladdu ay baareyso eedeymahaas, isagoo xusay in tallaabo sharci ah la qaadi doono haddii la helo caddeymo muujinaya in dembi dhacay. Ilhaan ayaa marar badan beenisay eedeymaha, gaar ahaan sheegashada ah inay guursatay nin ay siyaasiyiinta qaar ku tilmaameen walaalkeed, si ay ugu fududeyso inuu Mareykanka soo galo. Ilaa hadda ma jiraan caddeymo si fagaare ah loo soo bandhigay oo xaqiijinaya sheegashadaas. Xisbiga Dimoqraadiga oo cambaareeyey Dhanka kale, hoggaamiyeyaasha xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ee Golaha Wakiillada Mareykanka ayaa si adag u cambaareeyey baaritaanka, iyagoo su’aal geliyey waqtiga uu dhacay iyo suurtagalnimada in hay’adaha federaalka loo adeegsado dano siyaasadeed. Hoggaamiyaha Dimoqraadiga ee Golaha Wakiillada, Hakeem Jeffries, iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo xisbiga ka tirsan ayaa bayaan wadajir ah ku sheegay in hawlgalku uu dhalinayo walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan ku takrifalka awoodda dowladda. Waxay dalbadeen in dowladda ay caddeyso sababaha iyo duruufaha keenay baaritaanka, iyagoo ballanqaaday inay ka shaqeyn doonaan isla xisaabtan ku saabsan hawlgalka. Arrintan ayaa ku soo beegantay iyadoo wax ka yar bil ay ka harsan tahay doorashooyinka dhexe ee Congress-ka Mareykanka ee 3-da November, kuwaas oo Ilhaan Cumar ay mar kale ku dooneyso inay ku sii haysato kursigeeda gobolka Minnesota. Wasaaradda Caddaaladda Mareykanka ayaa muddo dheer lahayd habraac looga fogaanayo tallaabooyinka baaritaan ee saameyn ku yeelan kara doorashooyinka, gaar ahaan marka ay soo dhow yihiin. Hase yeeshee, weli lama xaqiijin in hawlgalkan uu jebiyey habraacaas. Ilhaan Cumar, oo Mareykanka ku timid qaxootinimo sanadkii 1995, isla markaana dhalashada dalkaas qaadatay sanadkii 2000, ayaa ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta sida joogtada ah u dhaliila maamulka Trump. Trump ayaa isaguna dhowr jeer weerar afka ah ku qaaday Ilhaan iyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee Minnesota, isagoo su’aal geliyey daacadnimadeeda Mareykanka, kuna baaqay in dalka laga masaafuriyo. Ilaa hadda, maamulka Trump ma uusan soo bandhigin caddeymo dadweynaha loogu xaqiijinayo eedeymaha socdaalka ee loo jeediyey Ilhaan Cumar, halka Wasaaradda Caddaaladdu aysan sheegin muddada baaritaanku socon doono iyo in dacwad laga soo saari doono. items.title: Golaha Mustaqbalka oo Hawiye ku dacweeyay Xasan, kana dalbaday inay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ee ku mideysan Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed oo caawa shir jaraa’id ku qabtay hoyga uu magaalada Muqdisho ka deggan yahay madaxweynihii hore Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa si adag uga hadlay isku-day weerar oo ka dhan ah Shariif. Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Xuseen (Odowaa) ayaa nasiib-darro ku tilmaamay in Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo uu ugu yeeray madaxweyne hore, laga celcelinayo inuu weeraro guriga Shariif. “Xasanow, ninka lagaa celcelinayo waa ninkii hoggaamiye kooxeedyada dalka ka saaray ee la yaqaan waxa uu yahay ee Sheekh Shariif,” ayuu yiri Odowaa. Waxa uu intaas ku sii daray: “Shantii habeen ee la soo dhaafay gurigiisa ayaa lagaa celcelinayay, adigoo doorashadii maafiyada ahayd qaatay.” Odowaa ayaa beesha Hawiye ku dacweeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, isagoo sidoo kale beesha ugu baaqay inay gacanta ka qabtaan madaxweynaha, isla markaana ay gardaradiisa ku qaadan Madaxweynaha, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Umadda Hawiye ee magaaladan deggan waxaa la rabaa in ciddii gardarrada leh la saaro, cidda aan gardarrada lahayna garteeda loo sheego. Haddii kale, warkii Hawiyaha isku layn jiray ee ahaa ‘Cali-na gar leh, Caydiidna gar leh ayuu warkiinu noqonaya,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Odowaa. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli shalay si weyn looga dareemay magaalada Muqdisho dhaq-dhaqaaqyo xooggan oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada Shariif Sheekh Axmed iyo kuwa dowladda, kuwaas oo qarka u saarnaa inay isku dhacaan kaddib markii ay labada dhinac isku soo dhowaadeen, taas oo dhalisay cabsi laga qabo inuu dagaal dhex maro labada dhinac. Hay’adda Nabad-sugidda iyo Sirdoonka Qaranka (NISA) oo dhankeeda soo bandhigtay caddeymo ayaa sheegtay in ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa Shariif oo ku hubeysnaa qoryaha AK-47, BKM iyo RPG ay xoog ku galeen guryo ku yaalla xaafadda Tiintiinley ee degmada Wadajir. Hase yeeshee, madaxweynihii hore ayaa eedeymahaas iska fogeeyay. Sidoo kale, NISA ayaa sheegtay in 24-kii Juun 2026 ay maleeshiyaadkan weerar ku qaadeen ciidamada Ilaalada Shacabka, isla markaana ay afduubteen mid ka mid ah ciidamadii gudanayay waajibaadkooda. Hay’addu waxay intaas ku dartay in 27-kii Juun 2026 ay mar kale hor istaageen howlaha amni ee ciidamada ka waday Waaxda General Daa’uud. Dhankiisa, madaxweynihii hore ee dowladdii KMG ahayd ayaa soo bandhigay tabashooyinkiisa iyo eedeymo uu u jeediyay ciidamada dowladda. Waxa uu tilmaamay inay jireen dhacdooyin isdaba joog ah oo walaac amni abuuray, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin jidgooyooyin iyo xannibaado saameeyay isu-socodka agagaarka deegaanka uu deggan yahay Shariif. Waxa uu sidoo kale xusay in la hor istaagay adeegyada daruuriga ah ee nolol maalmeedka, sida biyaha iyo cunnada, balse ay muujiyeen dulqaad si looga fogaado isku dhac hubeysan. Si kastaba, xiisadda labada dhinac ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayso xiisadda siyaasadeed ee u dhexeysa mucaaradka iyo dowladda, taas oo salka ku haysa muranka doorashooyinka iyo dastuurka cusub. items.title: Maalinta Calanka Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Toddobaatan iyo laba sano ka hor maanta oo kale, 12kii Oktoobar 1954tii, Maxamed Cawaale Liibaan ayaa hindisay calanka buluugga ah, kaas oo, markii xornimada la helay 1960kii, noqday astaanta rasmiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya. Calankaas ayaa magaalada Hargeysa laga taagay 26ka Juun 1960, xilligaas oo Cabdullaahi Suldaan Timacadde tiriyay geeraarkii: Sarreeyow ma nusqaamow Aan siduu yahay eegnee Kaana siib, kanna saar. Muxuu yahay macnaha dhabta ah ee calanka? Ma wuxuu ka turjumayaa shan Soomaaliyeed? Soomaaliduse ma shan baa? Muuqaal ahaan, calankeenna wuxuu u egyahay cirka, xiddigta dhexdiisa ku taallana waxa ay la mid tahay xiddigaha. Marka intaas la isku geeyo, waxa uu muujin karaa cirka iyo xiddigaha. Xiddigta cad ee dhexda uga xardhan calanka buluugga ah waxaa lagu macneeyaa in ay u taagantahay shanta Soomaaliyeed. Waa hubaal in calankan uu leeyahay qof walba oo Soomaali ah, balse in Soomaalida oo mid ah lagu tilmaamo shan Soomaali waxa ay ka turjumaysaa in la taageerayo kalaqaybintii uu gumaystuhu sameeyay. Qof walba oo Soomaali ah ee aaminsan in ay jiraan shan Soomaaliyeed waa qof faafinaya fikirkii gumaystaha. Macnahaas oo calanka lagu akhriyo waxa uu horseedi karaa in su’aal la geliyo in gumaystuhu uu ku lug lahaa ama uu fikir ku lahaa samaynta calanka, waana sida dhacday marar badan. Muwaadin walba oo naftiisa ku waayay ama dhiiggiisu u huray, isaga oo la dagaallamaya cadow gudaha ah ama mid dibadda ah, si ay ummadda Soomaaliyeed ugu noolaato nabad iyo cisi, waa halyey aan la illaawi doonin! Maanta oo kale, waxaa mudan in si gaar ah loo xuso halyey Maxamed Cabdulle Xalane, oo naftiisa u huray ilaalinta calankeenna, iskana diiday in calanka Soomaaliyeed uu gacanta u galo cadowga guunka ah ee Itoobiya. Alle ha u naxariistee, Xalane ayaa arkay ciidankii Xabashida oo ku soo siqaya halkii uu surnaa calanka Soomaaliyeed. Ciidan kaa tiro badan oo kugu soo wajahan marka aad aragto, waxa ugu horreeya ee maanka aadanaha ku soo dhacaya waa dibugurasho iyo badbaadinta nafta; hasayeeshee Xalane badbaadada calanka ayuu ka doorbiday bixinta naftiisa. Halkaas ayuuna ku shahiiday, isaga oo ku fara-adaygaya in calanku taagnaado, kana dhowraya in uu ciidda taabto. Laba iyo lixdan sano kaddib, cadawgii uu calanka ka ilaalinayay ayaa maanta dalkeenna ku sugan, welibana isla calankaas ayaa ka ag babanaya. Waana waxa laga dhaxlo burburka. Heesta Calanka Heesta calanka waxaa curiyay abwaan Xuseen Aw Faarax Dubbad. Abwaanku waxa uu ereyada ku muujiyay midabka calanka iyo jacaylka uu u qabo, waxaana ereyadeeda ka mid ah: Qolo baa calankeedu, waa caynoo, Innaga keenna waa, Cirkoo kale e, Oon caadna lahayn, Ee caashaqaye. Xiddigyahay caddi, Waad noo ciidamisee, Carradaa keligaa adow curadee, Cadceedda sideedaa u caan noqo ee. Cishadaad dhalataad Calooshayadii sidii culaygii Cidaad marisee, Allow ha ku celin C awooy dhaha. Saamaynta Federaalka ee Cawaale Maanta oo ah maalintii Cawaale ee 12ka Oktoobar, ma dhicin munaasabado lagu weynaynayo calanka Soomaaliyeed, marka laga reebo kuwa ka dhacay xarumaha dawladda. Dhallinyaro badan ayaaba aan ku baraarugsanayn ama garanayn maalinta calanka, halka qaar kalena uusan wax macne ah la lahayn. Dhanka kale, maalmaha dawladgoboleedyada waxaa la isugu soo baxaa fagaarayaasha, calankoodana waxaa lagu xardhaa gaadiidka iyo goobaha ganacsiga. Sababta jiilka maanta calanka dawladgoboleedka u weynaynayo, kii Soomaaliyana uusan ugu xafladayn, ma aha in uu Soomaalinimada necebyahay; balse calanka dawladgoboleedka waxa uu u arkaa mid uu si gaar ah u leeyahay, haddii aan loo xafladaynna ceebtu waxa ay ku dhacaysaa degaankiisa. Hasayeeshee, calankan dadka ka dhexeeya waxa uu u arkaa mid uusan keligiis xil ka saarnayn. Waana halka aynu ku gabnay masuuliyadda iyo danta guud.

items.title: DF oo karantiishay muwaadin la safray qof u dhintay Ebola
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada ee Soomaaliya ayaa shaacisay inay karantiishay muwaadin Soomaaliyeed oo la safray qof markii dambe u geeriyooday cudurka Ebola, kaas oo ka dillaacay dalka Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo (DRC). War-saxaafadeed ay wasaaraddu soo saartay 12-ka October 2026 ayay ku sheegtay in muwaadinka si ammaan ah loo geeyay xarunta karantiilka iyo daaweynta cudurka Ebola ee Isbitaalka Forlanini ee magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo lagu qiimeynayo xaaladdiisa caafimaad. “Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada, oo kaashanaysa Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha iyo hay’adaha ay khusayso, waxay dadweynaha ku wargelinaysaa in maanta oo taariikhdu tahay 12 Oktoobar 2026, saacaddii markay ahayd 11:00 subaxnimo, si ammaan ah oo badqab leh loo karantiilay muwaadin Soomaaliyeed, kasoo la xaqiijiyay inuu la soo safray qof la hubiyay inuu u geeriyooday cudurka Ebola,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in xogta ku saabsan muwaadinka ay ka heshay xafiiska Soomaaliya ee Xeerarka Caafimaadka Caalamiga ah (IHR) kadib markii dhiggiisa Uganda uu soo gudbiyay ogeysiis rasmi ah fiidnimadii 10-ka October 2026. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka, muwaadinka Soomaaliyeed iyo nin u dhashay Kenya ayaa ka soo wada safray Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo, iyagoo soo maray Uganda. Labada nin ayaa la sheegay inay wada degeen hal hoteel, kaddibna ay wada raaceen gaari tagsi ah oo geeyay garoonka diyaaradaha Entebbe ee dalka Uganda. Labada qof ayaa markii dambe u kala safray Nairobi iyo Muqdisho. Muwaadinka Soomaaliyeed ayaa Muqdisho ku yimid isagoo sii maray Addis Ababa, halka muwaadinka Kenya uu u safray dalkiisa, halkaas oo markii dambe uu ugu geeriyooday cudurka Ebola magaalada Nairobi 5-tii Oktoobar 2026, sida ay sheegtay wasaaraddu. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa intaas ku daray in xogta ay Uganda soo gudbisay ay ka koobnayd magaca muwaadinka Soomaaliyeed, lambarka baasaboorkiisa, faahfaahinta duulimaadkiisa iyo lambarka kursiga uu diyaaradda ka saarnaa, taas oo fududeysay aqoonsigiisa iyo raadraaciisa. Wasaaradda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in baaritaan iyo raadraac socday ku dhowaad 24 saacadood ay iska kaashadeen Hay’adda Socdaalka, Waaxda Dambi-baarista (CID), Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Machadka Caafimaadka Qaranka (NIH), kuwaas oo ugu dambeyn ku guuleystay in muwaadinka la helo oo la karantiilo. Wasaaraddu waxay caddeysay in aan weli la xaqiijin inuu muwaadinku qabo cudurka Ebola. “Wasaaraddu waxay xarunta Forlanini ee magaalada Muqdisho u asteeysay maaraynta xaaladaha la xiriira Ebola, waxayna u qoondeysay nidaam u gaar ah xarunta karantiilka,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Dhanka kale, wasaaraddu waxay dadka xiriirka la yeeshay muwaadinka ugu baaqday inay la soo xiriiraan hay’adaha caafimaadka, iyadoo xustay in qof kasta oo xog ka haya xaaladda uu si toos ah usoo wici karo. “Xiriirka muwaadinka lala yeeshay keliya ma caddaynayo in qofku qaaday cudurka, balse qiimeynta iyo dabagalku waxay muhiim u yihiin ka-hortagga faafitaan suuragal ah,” ayay wasaaraddu ku adkaysay. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ugu dambeyn bulshada ugu baaqday inay isdejiyaan, la shaqeeyaan kooxaha caafimaadka, kana fogaadaan faafinta wararka aan la xaqiijin iyo takoorka muwaadinka iyo qoyskiisa. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay inay bulshada la wadaagi doonto xog cusub marka la xaqiijiyo. The post DF oo karantiishay muwaadin la safray qof u dhintay Ebola appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Guriga Ilhaan Cumar oo baaritaan lagu sameeyay (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Wakiilo ka socda Dowladda Federaalka ayaa Isniintan baaray hoyga Xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar oo ka tirsan Congress-ka Mareykanka, lagana soo doorto Gobolka Minnesota. Baaritaankan oo la xiriira qiyaano dhanka socdaalka ayay saraakiishu ku galeen hoyga Xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar ee duleedka Magaalada Washington D.C. Dhowr Sarkaal oo ka tirsan Hay’adda Baarista Amniga Gudaha ee HSI ayaa la sheegay inay baaritaan kedis ah ku sameeyeen hoyga Ilhaan Cumar oo xubin ka ah Xisbiga Dimoqraadiga. Saraakiil kale oo xirnaa jaakado ay ku qoran yihiin magaca HSI ayaa saakay lagu arkay bannaanka guriga Ilhaan Cumar. Waaxda Caddaaladda oo qayb ka ahayd baaritaanka ayaa sheegtay in saraakiishu ay fuliyeen amar baaritaan oo maxkamad ay u fasaxday, isla-markaana uu hawlgalkan qayb ka yahay baaritaan socda. Warbaahinta Mareykanka ayaa ilo aan la magacaabin ka soo xigatay in baaritaanku uu ka dhashay qiyaano dembiyeed, oo lagu sameeyay waraaqaha socdaalka gabadha Soomaaliyeed oo uu buuxiyay aabaheed, yaraanteydii. Tom Homan, oo ah masuulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump U Qaabilsan Arrimaha Xuduudaha ayaa bishii September sheegay in Ilhaan Cumar ay wajaheyso baaritaan dembiyeed oo socda, balse ma uusan sheegin nooca baaritaankaas. Ilhaan Cumar ayaa muddooyinkanba wajaheysay dhalleecayn iyo cadaadis weyn oo kaga imaanayay Maamulka Madaxweyne Trump, iyadoo billihii la soo dhaafay si gaar ah diiradda loogu hayay xogta ku saabsan arrimaheeda maaliyadeed. Trump ayaa sii xoojiyay weerarada afka ee uu ku hayo Xildhibaan Ilhaan Cumar, isaga oo si muuqata u muujiyay naceybka uu u qabo, tan iyo markii uu dib ugu soo laabtay Aqalka Cad. Trump ayaa marar badan fagaareyaasha ka sheegay in aanu jecleyn gabadhaasi, ayna tahay in ay dib ugu laabato Somaliya. Ilhaan Cumar waa xubinta ugu caansan Soomaalida Mareykanka iyo qofkii ugu horreyay ee Soomaali ah ee loo doorto Congress-ka Mareykanka, isla-markaana gaara heerkan siyaasadeed oo kale.

items.title: Somalia’s Mandate Crisis Deepens as Troops Surround Sharif Sheikh Ahmed’s Residence
items.description: MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia’s political crisis is entering another dangerous phase, with reports of government forces deployed near the residence of former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed raising fears of a fresh confrontation between the Federal Government and opposition leaders. The reported military movements come amid a bitter constitutional dispute over President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s mandate, the legitimacy of recent constitutional changes and the failure to secure agreement on the country’s electoral future. A person close to Sharif who is staying at his residence told Wardheernews that no formal order to attack the property had been issued, but government troops had been positioned in the surrounding area since the previous afternoon and remained there. The account does not establish that an assault has been ordered. Nevertheless, the reported deployment has heightened concern among opposition figures and political elders who fear that military pressure against former national leaders could trigger renewed violence in the capital. The immediate danger extends beyond one residence. At stake is whether Somalia’s deepening political dispute will be resolved through negotiations or further militarisation at a time when the legitimacy of the federal leadership remains contested. A government operating under a disputed mandate The confrontation reflects the unresolved dispute over the term of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and the Federal Parliament. The opposition maintains that the president’s four-year mandate expired on May 15, 2026, while the outgoing parliament’s mandate ended on April 14. It rejects the constitutional amendments used by the government to justify extending the terms of federal institutions and argues that any continuation in office without a broadly accepted political agreement undermines constitutional legitimacy. President Hassan Sheikh and his administration reject that interpretation. They argue that constitutional amendments approved by parliament extended the presidential and parliamentary terms to five years, allowing the current administration to remain in office until May 2027. The government also maintains that the changes are necessary to facilitate a transition towards direct elections. The competing interpretations have not been resolved through an agreement accepted by all major political stakeholders. The result is a dangerous institutional impasse: the government continues to exercise executive authority, while prominent opposition figures and regional leaders dispute the legal basis for its continued tenure. The dispute is not simply about dates. It concerns who has the authority to determine the electoral system, amend the constitutional framework and govern during a contested transition. Without agreement on those questions, even routine security operations can be interpreted as attempts to intimidate political opponents. The opposition has repeatedly denounced oppression, violence against peaceful demonstrators, and restrictions on freedom of expression.  The former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire has issued a strong warning against what he described as military intimidation and provocative movements targeting the homes of former national leaders in Mogadishu. Khaire argued that such actions could push the capital towards renewed instability, security breakdown and greater political uncertainty. He placed responsibility for the consequences of any escalation on President Hassan Sheikh’s administration, whose mandate the opposition considers expired. His statement also rejected the idea that military superiority or intimidation could resolve the country’s political crisis. “The only way to rescue Somalia from political uncertainty is to return to the negotiating table,” was the central message of his appeal. He called for a political agreement on elections and the establishment of a government whose legitimacy rests on a process accepted by the country’s principal political stakeholders. Khaire’s accusations represent the opposition’s assessment of the government’s conduct; the reported troop deployment and the possibility of an attack have not been independently established. But the warning reflects the growing mistrust between the two camps and the risks associated with allowing a constitutional dispute to become a security confrontation. Mogadishu risks another cycle of political violence Somalia has experienced the consequences of political disputes escalating into armed confrontation before. In 2021, a disagreement over the extension of President Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed’s term, known as Farmaajo, contributed to clashes in Mogadishu. More recently, government forces and opposition-aligned armed groups clashed in the capital in June 2026 amid the current mandate dispute. The violence caused damage and displacement, demonstrating how quickly political tensions can spill into residential neighbourhoods. International actors subsequently called for restraint and dialogue. <Cite refs={[“turn398711news22″,”turn398711news24”]}/> A renewed confrontation around Sharif’s residence could deepen the crisis. An attack—or even a miscalculation by forces positioned near the property—could provoke retaliation, draw additional armed actors into the dispute and put civilians at risk. It could also further undermine public confidence in national institutions. The federal government has responsibilities extending far beyond the contest with its political opponents, including the fight against al-Shabaab, the provision of essential services and the protection of the country’s territorial integrity. Prolonged internal confrontation would divert attention and resources from those priorities. For the opposition, the challenge is to press its constitutional and electoral demands without allowing political resistance to become another cycle of armed conflict. Negotiations remain the essential exit route The crisis requires urgent political engagement involving the federal leadership, opposition figures, federal member states and credible mediators. The first priority should be to reduce the immediate risk of violence: military deployments around political leaders’ residences should not become instruments of intimidation, and all sides should avoid actions that could trigger an armed confrontation. The second priority is to negotiate an electoral framework. That process must address the disputed constitutional amendments, the timetable for elections, the division of responsibilities between federal and regional institutions, and the safeguards needed to ensure that no side unilaterally determines the country’s political future. A durable agreement will require more than an announcement of a new election date. It must establish rules that the principal political actors can accept and implement, with credible monitoring and clear procedures for resolving disagreements. International partners can support mediation, encourage restraint and help the parties maintain dialogue. But no external actor can substitute for a Somali political agreement that commands sufficient national support. The government, for its part, must recognise that exercising control over security forces does not settle the dispute over political legitimacy. The opposition must also recognise that a peaceful transition requires negotiation, institutional safeguards and a practical agreement on how the next government will be chosen. Somalia’s central challenge is no longer merely how to organise the next election, but how to prevent a disputed mandate from becoming a national security crisis. If troops, political threats and competing claims of authority replace dialogue, the cost will be borne not only by the country’s political leaders but by ordinary Somalis already living with insecurity and economic hardship. The reported presence of government forces near Sharif Sheikh Ahmed’s residence should therefore serve as a warning, not a prelude to another confrontation. Somalia needs an agreed electoral roadmap and a political settlement that can restore confidence in its institutions. The choice facing the country is stark: return to negotiations and establish a mutually accepted path forward, or allow the dispute over constitutional authority to push Mogadishu towards another cycle of violence. items.title: Mucaaradka oo Maxkamadda Sare u gudbiyay dacwad xasaasi ah oo dastuurka cusub
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka ayaa si rasmi ah u qabatay dacwad uu gudbiyay xubin sare oo ka tirsan Madasha Samatabixinta, taas oo ka dhan ah dhaqangelinta dastuurka cusub ee Soomaaliya iyo tallaabooyinka sharci ee ka dhashay. Dacwaddan ayaa la xiriirta muranka ka taagan wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka iyo habka loo dhaqan-geliyay, iyadoo dacwooduhu uu ka horyimid sharciyadda dastuurka cusub iyo go’aannada ku saleysan, oo ay ka mid tahay muddo kororsiga hay’adaha dowladda. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, Maxkamadda Sare ayaa aqbashay inay gacanta ku dhigto kiiska, taas oo tallaabo muhiim ah u noqon karta dadaallada lagu doonayo in garsoorku go’aan ka gaaro muranka sharci ee ka dhashay dastuurka cusub. Kiiskan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay weli taagan yihiin doodaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa sharci ee ku saabsan dastuurka cusub, iyadoo mucaaradka iyo xubno kale oo siyaasadeed ay su’aalo ka keeneen habraacyadii loo maray ansixintiisa iyo saameynta uu ku yeelan karo hannaanka dowladnimada dalka. Qodobada dacwadda ku jira waxaa ka mid ah diidmada dhaqangelinta dastuurka cusub iyo raadadka sharci ee ka dhashay, gaar ahaan arrimaha la xiriira muddo kororsiga. Hase yeeshee, faahfaahin dheeraad ah lagama hayo qodobada gaarka ah ee mucaaradku horgeeyay Maxkamadda Sare iyo doodaha sharci ee uu ku saleeyay cabashadiisa. Qabashada dacwaddan ayaa si dhow isha loogu hayaa, maadaama go’aanka kasoo baxa Maxkamadda Sare uu saameyn ku yeelan karo doodaha sharci ee ku saabsan dastuurka iyo tallaabooyinka siyaasadeed ee la xiriira. Weli lama shaacin waqtiga ay maxkamaddu bilaabi doonto dhageysiga dacwadda ama muddada ay qaadan karto. Maxkamadda Sare ayaa hore u gaartay go’aanno la xiriira murannada siyaasadeed iyo kuwa doorashooyinka, waxaana ka mid ahaa go’aan lagu laalay natiijadii doorashadii ka dhacday dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Go’aankaas ayaa tusaale u ah doorka ay maxkamaddu ku leedahay xallinta khilaafaadka qaarkood ee ka dhasha hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo maamulka dalka. Si kastaba, waxaa la sugayaa tallaabooyinka xiga ee Maxkamadda Sare ee ku aaddan dacwaddan iyo go’aanka ay ka gaari doonto cabashada laga keenay dastuurka cusub, oo haatan dowladdu ku howlan tahay dhaqan-gelintiisa. items.title: Babbo, Babbo Calanyahow!
items.description: Waxaad tahay gabal maro ah, laakiin wax badan ayaad calaamadsanaysaa… Sannad walba 26ka Juun iyo 1da Luulyo, Soomaaliya iyo dadkeeduba waxa ay ku xadreeyaan dareen waddaniyadeed, iyada oo guud ahaan ummaddu ay u dabbaaldegto maalmaha xorriyadda iyo maalinta midnimada labadii gobol ee waqooyi iyo koonfur. Dabbaaldeggaas waxaa lagu xusaa maalmihii taariikhiga ahaa ee lagu dhawaaqay xorriyadhelka iyo qarannimada ummadda Soomaaliyeed 1960kii, xilligaas oo dalku ka xoroobay gumaystihii Ingiriiska iyo Talyaaniga. Waxaa taas la mid Maalinta Calanka, ee Maanta oo kale loo dabbaaldego sannad kasta. Inkastoo muddo kaddib la kala yaacay, midnimadiina luntay, haddana, wixii xorriyad-helkaas ka danbeeyay, maalmahani waxa ay noqdeen mid ay Soomaalidu ku milicsadaan hiddahooda dawladdhis, farxad ku heesaan, xorriyaddoodana xurmeeyaan oo u dammaashaadaan. Dabcan, weli ma joogno meel aan ugu danbayn ku ciidno nabad iyo horumar, balse ahaanshaha qaran madaxbannaan, xor ah, dawlad leh oo nidaam federaal ah ku shaqeeya, isjacaylka shacabka iyo rabitaanka midnimo ummadeed ayaa ah barbilow aynu hore uga sii dhaqaaqi karno, horumarka dalkeennana ku qaabayn karno. Rejaa weli nool! Cawaale, calankaan la hadlayaaye: Sarreeyow calankaygow, summaddii waddankaygow, calankii Soomaaliyeed ee aan jeclahayow, intaan eeganayo babbashadaada, waan hiyikacayaa oo waxaan dareemayaa han iyo bogaadin sare. Marmar waan kaa quustaa; kuwa ku matala ayaa ikaa nacsiiya, darnaanta xaaladaha iyo diifta shacabka ayaa i quusisa, se waan kari waayay in aan kaa quusto. Inkastoo aad tahay gabal maro ah, haddana wax badan ayaad u taagantahay oo aad muujisaa. Maanta oo ay ku beegan maalintii lagu curiyay ee aad ummad dhan u noqotay calan ay majeertaan—Soomaali—waxaan rabaa in aan kuu runwarramo. Haddii aan qiiroodo, keliya waa jacaylka aan kuu qabo; haddii aan ku canaanto, waa rejada aan kaa qabo; haddii aan ku ammaano, waa runnimadaada. Cawaalow calankaygow, waxa aad marag ka ahayd halgankii iyo guulihii uu qarankeennu soo maray. Macnaha astaantaada iyo midabkaaga cirka buluugga ah u eg, ee xiddigta cadna dhexda ku leh, waa summad qaayo badan oo si aan gabbasho lahayn u tilmaamaysa shantii Soomaaliyeed—Soomaaliweyn. Waxaad ka maragkacdaa, had iyo jeer, meerisyadii uu geeraarshihii weynaa, waa Cabdullaahi Suldaan Timacadde, kugu qeexayay, markuu lahaa: “Calankaannu sugaynayee Sahankiisa ahaynow! Seermaweydo hillaacdayow! Sagal maanta darroorayoo Siigadii naga maydhayow! Saq dhexaannu ahayne Kii soo saaray cadceeddow! Samada kii u ekaaye Xiddigaa mid la siiyayow! Saaxirkii kala guuryaye Sarreeyow ma nusqaamow! An siduu yahay eegno e Kaana siib kanna saar!” Waxa aad babbanaysay xilliyo badan oo aan hoostaada dhiig ku daadinaynay, adiguse aad bir dheer ka lulmaysay, adiga oo dunida tusayay in ummadi ku hoos harsato. Waqtiyadii adkaa ee isdooxa, nacaybka, dagaalladii sokeeye iyo caqabadihii jiray oo dhanba, waxa aad ahayd iftiin rejo noo tilmaama, oo ina xusuusiya midnimadeenna, haybta aynu nahay iyo adkaysiga qarannimo. Cawaale, waan ogahay in aad leedahay cadow badan. Waxaa jira duulal jiritaankaaga iyo taariikhdaada dafirsan, duulal dhulkaaga iyo xeebahaaga raba, kuwo kuu dhow iyo kuwo kaa fogba. Hasayeeshee, waxa aad ka dhigantahay riyooyinka iyo rabitaanka malaayiinta shacabka Soomaaliyeed, kuwa haddeer iyo faca danbaba. Waxaa kugu dhigan miisaanka taariikhdeenna, hiddaheenna iyo jiritaankeenna. Adigaas cir caad la’ u eg, ee dhexda xiddigga cad ku leh, waxa aad ka dhigantahay ruuxda ummaddeenna. Waxa aad ina xusuusinaysaa qiyamkeenna iyo jiritaanka aynu wadaagno, waxa aadna xoojinaysaa adkaysigeenna iyo dulqaadkeenna. Babbo, Cawaale, babbo! Cawaale, waan ogahay in lagugu sheego, duniduna kuu taqaan tuke canbaar leh, oo keliya la dhegaysto hal dhinac oo sheekadaada ah. Sida ay Afrika uga weriyaan hal dhinac oo ay ku tilmaamaan in Afrika oo dhanba ay tahay hal waddan oo faqri iyo cudurro daashadeen, goob ba’day iyo geeri-dhaan nololeedna ay tahay, ayaan ogahay in sidaas oo kale ay kaa tebiyeen hal sheeko oo ah in Soomaaliya tahay meesha ugu khatarta badan iyo halka ugu xun ee lagu noolaado. Waan ogahay in dadkaaga qaarkiis, kuwa ku hoos harsada, ay sheekadaas rumaysteen. Waxaanse diyaar u ahay in aan soo bandhigo sheekooyinkaaga iyo in aad leedahay in ka badan hal sheeko. Halkaa iyo halkeerba waxa aan ka sheegi doonaa sheekadaada. Waa ballan, Cawaale. Waxa aan kuu ballanqaadayaa, calanyahow, in aan daacad ku noqon doono, oo aanan qabkaaga iyo qiimahaaga wiiqi doonin, in aan ku sheegan doono, dunidana kuugu faani doono. Intaas ma aha e, waxa aan sidoo kale kuu ballanqaadayaa in aan noqon doono muwaadin mas-uul ah, canshuurbixiye ilaaliya mabaadi’da aad matasho, codeeye doorta midka ugu mudan ee adiga iyo dadkaagaba u roon. Cawaale, waxa aan ballanqaadayaa in aan ka qaybqaadan doono horumarka dadka aad matasho. Carruurtaada waxbariddoodu waa ii mudnaanta koowaad, dhallinyaradaada iyo haweenkaaguna waa qorshaha labaad. Raadinta iyo u doodidda caddaaladda iyo nabaddu waa hawl aan isku diray. Kobcinta dhaqaalaha, qiimahaaga lacageed iyo dawlad-dhiskaaguba maanka ayay iigu qoranyihiin. Haddii aan arko astaantaada duni wada calamo ah, waan ku salaami doonaa, oo waan kuu istaagi doonaa. Waa ballan. Laakiin, Cawaalow, adna ii ballanqaad in aanan daraaddaa hoosaysiin mudan doonin. Si hufan ayaan kuugu adeegi doonaa e, adna iigu dhaami sidaas oo kale. I sii, aan ku siiyo e! Maanta iyo waligeenba, waxaan kaa codsanayaa, Cawaalow, in aad sii ahaato astaanta midnimada iyo nabadda. Quruxdaada iyo qiimahaaga, astaantaada muujinaysa awoodda iyo geesinnimada, midnimada iyo ummadnimada, Soomaalinnimada iyo qabka, waddaniyadda—midabbadaadu ha ahaadeen is-oggolaanta iyo wadanoolaanshaha ummadda Soomaaliyeed oo isku duuban, colaadaha iyo xintankana ka caaggan. Si sharaf leh u lulo, oo u gacanhaati, kuna dhiirri dadkaaga in ay midoobaan, si ay uga gudbaan dhibka, una dhistaan mustaqbal wanaagsan. Lulo, lulo calanyahow, lulo! Midabbadaadu ha muujiyeen adkaysiga iyo kartida ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Daraaddaa, calanyahow, hirarku xuduudaha ha goosheen, socdaallada dhul iyo cirna ha ruqaansadeen, oo ha keeneen heshiisyo waxtar leh iyo isfahan quruumaha dunida ah. Dadkaagu ha garowsadeen dantooda iyo dawladnimada, tartanka ummadeed ee jirana ha ku baraarugeen. Babbo, si weyn u babbo, babbo oo i matal! WQ: Suad Arif Qore

items.title: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar’s home as part of a criminal investigation, AP sources say
items.description: WASHINGTON (AP) – Federal agents on Monday searched the home of Democratic U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar, a frequent target of Trump administration criticism, as part of a criminal investigation, according to two people familiar with the matter. The search was conducted by Homeland Security Investigations agents, said the people, who were not authorized to publicly discuss an ongoing investigation and spoke to The Associated Press on the condition of anonymity. More details about the investigation were not immediately clear, though Vice President JD Vance has in the past accused Omar of committing immigration fraud — an allegation she has denied — and has said he and a top White House official were trying to figure out how to investigate the Minnesota congresswoman. An email seeking comment was sent Monday to a representative for Omar. The Justice Department said in a statement Monday that HSI agents executed a judicially authorized search warrant secured by the department in the Washington, D.C., area but provided no other details. The street was blocked off Monday morning as HSI agents remained near the home. “This enforcement action is part of an ongoing federal criminal investigation,” the department said. A spokesperson for the Department of Homeland Security, of which Homeland Security Investigations is part, referred questions about the search to the Justice Department. US Federal agents search the residence of Rep Ilhan Omar AP Phot0 Omar represents Minnesota’s 5th District, including Minneapolis. She was first elected to the House in 2018 and has been a member of what’s called The Squad of female lawmakers known for their progressive views and pointed opposition to President Donald Trump, a Republican. Republicans have raised questions about Omar’s past since before she was even elected, including asserting that she had married her brother and committed immigration fraud. Omar has broadly denied the allegations as “disgusting lies.” “It certainly seems like something fishy is there, but everybody’s entitled to equal justice under the laws,” Vance told reporters in May. “So we’re going to investigate it. We’re going to take a look at it. items.title: Garowe shooting raises Puntland’s renewed questions over clan revenge and the rule of law
items.description: A deadly shooting at a market workshop highlights the urgent need to end impunity, strengthen criminal justice and prevent retaliatory killings from claiming more innocent lives. GAROWE (WDN) — Two people have been killed and four others wounded after an armed man opened fire on people at a metalworking workshop in Inji Market in Garowe, the capital of Puntland, in a shooting that raises fresh concerns about public safety and the danger of retaliatory violence. The gunman fled the scene. The injured were taken to Garowe General Hospital for treatment, where one of the victims subsequently died, hospital officials confirmed. The circumstances and motive behind the shooting had not been officially established at the time of reporting, and Puntland security authorities had yet to issue a public statement. Beyond the immediate tragedy, the killings underscore a wider challenge facing Puntland: how to ensure that those who commit murder face justice without allowing a cycle of clan revenge to claim additional lives. Justice, not compensation alone When a murder is followed by negotiations overcompensations between clans, the process may sometimes help prevent immediate retaliation. But it can also create a dangerous perception that a killer may escape individual accountability because relatives or clan members can pay compensation to the victim’s family. That perception, if allowed to take root, risks turning murder into a calculated act whose consequences can be transferred from the perpetrator to his wider community. The victim’s family may receive compensation, but no amount of money can restore a life or guarantee that relatives will accept the settlement. Worse, when a bereaved family believes justice has not been served, its members may seek revenge against someone connected to the alleged killer—not necessarily the person responsible for the original crime. An innocent individual can then become the next victim, triggering another round of killings and deepening clan hostility. The state must ensure that murder carries legal consequences for the person responsible, rather than leaving justice to a contest between clans. Anyone suspected of murder should be investigated, arrested where legally justified, prosecuted in a competent court and given a fair trial. Those convicted should face the penalties prescribed by law. No individual should be able to assume that clan compensation will automatically protect them from criminal accountability. The local Xeer Reer Adam example—and the limits of clan-based justice There is a local practice that deserves serious examination. According to the account provided, the Reer Adam community in the Mudug region has traditionally rejected compensation as a substitute for accountability in murder cases, insisting instead on an immediate and direct response against the killer. The account claims that this stance has discouraged killings because potential perpetrators expect severe consequences. That assertion has been independently verified, and it should be treated as established evidence that murder within the community is nearly nonexistent. Nor should extrajudicial execution be promoted as a model for Puntland. Shooting a suspect in public, without lawful investigation and trial, would itself undermine the rule of law and risk killing the wrong person. The potentially valuable lesson is not that one clan should take the law into its own hands. It is that communities can help prevent murder when they reject the idea that a perpetrator can escape personal accountability simply because others can pay compensation on their behalf. Puntland should seek to translate that principle of Reer Adam into a consistent, lawful system of justice—one in which no clan can shield a murderer, no victim’s family is pressured to accept a settlement in place of lawful accountability, and no innocent relative is targeted in retaliation. Puntland cannot afford another cycle of revenge The Garowe shooting must be investigated on its own evidence. Authorities should identify the suspect, establish the motive, determine whether the victims were deliberately targeted and bring any accused person before the courts. The public should not be encouraged to speculate about the perpetrator’s clan or the victims’ identities before reliable information is available. At the same time, community elders, religious leaders and local officials have an important role in preventing the tragedy from becoming a wider conflict. They should urge restraint, reject collective blame and make clear that the actions of one individual do not justify revenge against relatives or members of a wider clan. The government must also strengthen policing, criminal investigations, witness protection and the timely prosecution of serious crimes. If citizens believe that justice is unavailable, they may increasingly turn to informal arrangements or retaliatory violence. That is how a single killing can become a chain of deaths involving people who had no part in the original offence. Puntland’s objective should be to eliminate the incentives for murder, not replace one form of violence with another. Compensation may have a role in reconciliation where it is lawful and freely agreed, but it must not become a guarantee of immunity from criminal prosecution. Peace cannot depend on which clan is prepared to retaliate most forcefully. It must depend on a justice system strong enough to protect every citizen, hold perpetrators accountable and prevent the next innocent person from being killed. items.title: Hay’adda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka oo baaritaan ku sameysay guriga Ilhan Omar
items.description: Muqdisho, 12 Oktoobar 2026 — Saraakiil ka tirsan Hay’adda Baarista Amniga Gudaha ee Mareykanka (HSI) ayaa Isniintii baaritaan ku sameeyay guriga Ilhan Omar, oo ah xildhibaanad Dimuqraadi ah oo ka tirsan Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka, sida ay sheegeen laba qof oo xog-ogaal u ah arrintan. Sida ay werisay wakaaladda wararka ee AP baaritaanka ayaa qayb ka ah kiis dembiyeed oo socda. Labada qof ee xogta bixiyay ayaa codsaday inaan magacyadooda la shaacin, maadaama aan loo oggolayn inay si fagaare ah uga hadlaan baaritaanka. Ilaa hadda lama shaacin faahfaahin ku saabsan sababta gaarka ah ee baaritaanka, waxyaabaha ay saraakiishu raadinayeen iyo eedeymaha uu kiisku la xiriiro. Arrintan ayaa imaanaysa iyadoo Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka Mareykanka JD Vance uu bishii May ee sannadkii hore sheegay in maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu baaritaan ku sameyn doono Ilhan Omar, kaddib eedeymo la xiriira khiyaano dhinaca socdaalka ah. Ilhan Omar ayaa horay u beenisay eedeymahaas. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xogta la helay ma caddaynayso in baaritaanka gurigeedu uu si toos ah ula xiriiro eedeymihii hore loo soo jeediyay.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo karantiishay muwaadin la sheegay inuu la safray qof u geeriyooday Ebola
items.description: Muqdisho, 12 Oktoobar 2026 — Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay si ammaan ah u karantiishay muwaadin Soomaaliyeed oo la xaqiijiyey inuu la soo safray qof u geeriyooday cudurka Ebola. War-saxaafadeed ay Wasaaraddu soo saartay maanta ayay ku sheegtay in muwaadinka loo gudbiyey Xarunta Karantiilka iyo Daaweynta Cudurka Ebola ee Isbitaalka Forlanini ee magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo lagu qiimeynayo xaaladdiisa caafimaad. Wasaaraddu waxay caddeysay in ilaa hadda aan la xaqiijin in muwaadinkaasi uu qabo cudurka Ebola, iyadoo xustay in tallaabada karantiilku ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada looga hortagayo faafitaanka cudurka iyo ilaalinta caafimaadka bulshada. Arrintan ayaa timid xilli Soomaaliya ay xoojisay feejignaanta caafimaad kaddib markii la ogaaday in muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed ay safarro ku tageen dalal uu ka jiro walaac la xiriira cudurka Ebola. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka Wasaaradda, muwaadinka ayaa ka mid ahaa dadka laga baarayay xiriirka ay la yeesheen qof u geeriyooday cudurka, taasoo keentay in la qaado tallaabooyin taxaddar ah. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ugu baaqday bulshada inay muujiyaan feejignaan, ayna ka fogaadaan faafinta wararka aan la xaqiijin ee la xiriira xaaladda cudurka. Waxay sidoo kale dadweynaha ku wargelisay inay adeegsan karaan khadka degdegga ah ee 995 ama WhatsApp-ka +252 61 022 4623 si ay ula xiriiraan Wasaaradda una helaan xog dheeraad ah. Wasaaraddu waxay carrabka ku adkaysay in karantiilka muwaadinka uusan ka dhignayn in laga xaqiijiyey cudurka Ebola, balse uu yahay tallaabo taxaddar ah oo lagu ilaalinayo caafimaadka bulshada.

items.title: Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka qaarkood oo isugu tagey hoyga Shariif Sheekh Axmed
items.description: Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka qaarkood iyo Xildhibaano ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaalka ayaa ku qulqulaya hoyga Madaxweynihii hore ee Somaliya, Shariif Sheekh Axmed uu ka degan yahay Magaalada Muqdisho. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Shariif Sheekh Axmed uu shir guddoomin doono kulan looga hadlayo xiisadda ka dhalatay ciidamada la sheegay inay Dowladda Federaalka gaysay agagaarka hoygiisa oo ku yaala nawaaxiga Garoonka Aadan Cadde. Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Xuseen (Odawaa) oo ka mid ah Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku eedeeyay in uu duulaan ku yahay guriga Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka. “Waxaan aad iyo aad uga xunahay runtii ma ahayn wax ummadda Soomaalyeed ay sugeysay inaan hadda ka hadlayno in Madaxweynaha uu waqtigiisu dhamaaday laga celcelinayo guriga Sheekh Shariif.” Ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Odawaa oo intaa raaciyay “Waxaan ka war haynaa 5-tii illaa 10-kii habeen ee la soo dhaafay, waxa laga celcelinayay dowladda waa guriga Madaxweyne Sheekh Shariif.” Xildhibaan Odawaa ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay in uu wax ka bedelo, isla-markaana uu wanaajiyo qaabka uu sheegay inuu ula dhaqmayo Shariif Sheekh Axmed. “Sida hadda ah in qalqal lagu hayo oo gurigiisii loogu socdo waa laga fiican yahay, waana ceeb, ummadda Soomaaliyeed ee indhaha ka daawaneysana waxaan leenahay cuqaasha, dadka waxgaradka ah ee reer Muqdisho iyo ummadda Hawiye ee baladkan degan, waxaa la rabaa cidda gardarrada leh in gardarrada la saaro, cidda aan gardarrada lahayna loo sheego garteeda.” Ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Odawaa.

items.title: Ciidamada Mareykanka oo baaray guriga Ilhaan Cumar oo lagu tuhmayo dambi la xiriira…
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada ammaanka ee dowladda federaalka Mareykanka ayaa subaxnimadii Isniinta baaritaan ku sameeyey guriga ay magaalada Washington ku leedahay xildhibaanadda Soomaaliyeed ee Ilhan Omar, iyadoo Wasaaradda Caddaaladda Mareykanka ay xaqiijisay in hawlgalku qeyb ka yahay baaritaan dembiyeed socda. Ciidamada fuliyey hawlgalka ayaa ka tirsanaa hay’adda Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) oo hoos tagta Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka, sida ay wakiillada wararka AP u sheegeen laba qof oo xog-ogaal u ah baaritaanka, kuwaas oo codsaday inaan magacyadooda la shaacin. Wasaaradda Caddaaladda ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada ay guriga ku galeen amar baaritaan oo maxkamadeed, balse ma aysan faahfaahin dembiyada la baarayo iyo caddeymaha ay ciidamada raadinayeen. “Hawlgalkan wuxuu qeyb ka yahay baaritaan dembiyeed federaal ah oo socda,” ayay wasaaraddu ku sheegtay war ay soo saartay. Ciidamada ammaanka ayaa sidoo kale xiray waddada ku dhow guriga Ilhan Omar, iyadoo saraakiisha baaritaanka ay muddo ku sugnaayeen goobta, sida ay AP ku warrantay. Warbaahinta Fox News Digital oo markii ugu horreysay tabisay hawlgalka ayaa sheegtay in baaritaanku la xiriiro tuhunno musuq-maasuq oo ku saabsan dukumentiyo socdaal oo aabbaheed oo geeriyooday uu buuxiyey xilligii ay carruurta ahayd. Hase yeeshee, Wasaaradda Caddaaladda weli ma xaqiijin in baaritaanka guriga Ilhan Omar uu si gaar ah ula xiriiro eedeymahaas, mana shaacin wax caddeymo ah oo ay ciidamadu ka heleen guriga. Sidoo kale, ma jiraan wax dacwado dembiyeed ah oo si rasmi ah loogu soo oogay xildhibaanadda, iyadoo xafiiskeeduna uusan markiiba ka jawaabin codsiyada warbaahinta ee ku saabsan dhacdada. Eedeymihii hore ee Ilhan Omar Baaritaanka guriga Ilhan Omar ayaa yimid kaddib bilo ay mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump si cad uga hadlayeen eedeymo la xiriira taariikhda socdaalkeeda iyo qaabkii ay ku heshay dhalashada Mareykanka. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Mareykanka JD Vance ayaa bishii May sheegay in Wasaaradda Caddaaladdu ay baarayso eedeymo la xiriira guur hore oo ay gashay Ilhan Omar iyo suurtagalnimada in ay ku kacday khiyaano dhanka socdaalka ah. Vance ayaa sheegay inay jiraan arrimo shaki dhalinaya oo u baahan in la baaro, balse wuxuu xusay in dacwad lagu soo oogi karo oo keliya haddii la helo caddeymo muujinaya in dembi dhacay. “Waxaan sameyn doonnaa baaritaan. Arrinta waan eegi doonnaa. Haddii aan u aragno in dembi dhacay, waan ku soo oogi doonnaa dacwad,” ayuu yiri Vance. Eedeymahaas ayaa qeyb ahaan ku saleysan sheegashooyin ay muddo dheer faafinayeen siyaasiyiin Jamhuuri ah iyo kooxo muxaafid ah, kuwaas oo ku andacoonaya in Ilhan Omar ay guursatay nin ay ku sheegeen walaalkeed si ay ugu fududeyso inuu Mareykanka soo galo. Ilhan Omar ayaa marar badan si adag u beenisay sheegashooyinkaas, iyadoo ku tilmaantay been-abuur lagu dhaawacayo sumcaddeeda. Ilaa hadda ma jiraan caddeymo si fagaare ah loo soo bandhigay oo xaqiijinaya eedeynta ah inay guursatay walaalkeed. Arrintan ayaa mar kale soo xoogeysatay 13-kii September, markii Tom Homan oo ah la-taliyaha Aqalka Cad u qaabilsan ilaalinta xuduudaha uu xaqiijiyey in dowladda federaalku waddo baaritaan dembiyeed oo ku saabsan Ilhan Omar. “Waan ogahay inay jiraan waxyaabo socda, balse ma bixin karo faahfaahinta waxa dhacaya,” ayuu Homan u sheegay Fox News. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in qof kasta oo lagu helo inuu jebiyey sharciyada socdaalka ama ku kacay khiyaano guur uu wajihi doono sharciga, xitaa haddii uu yahay xildhibaan ka tirsan Congress-ka. Shan maalmood kaddib, Ilhan Omar ayaa Fox News Digital u sheegtay in saraakiisha Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha aysan la soo xiriirin, isla markaana aysan wax ogeysiis ah ka helin baaritaanka ay mas’uuliyiintu ka hadlayeen. Xoghayaha Amniga Gudaha Markwayne Mullin ayaa isaguna hore u sheegay in dowladda ay qaadi karto tallaabooyin lagu masaafurinayo Ilhan Omar haddii la caddeeyo inay khiyaano ku heshay sharciyadii ay Mareykanka ku soo gashay. Si kastaba, Ilhan Omar waxay haysataa dhalashada Mareykanka, waxaana sharciga dalkaasi uu dhigaya in ka qaadista dhalashada qofka ay u baahan tahay hannaan sharci oo gaar ah iyo caddeymo buuxiya shuruudaha uu sharcigu qeexay. Xiisadda Trump iyo Ilhan Omar Hawlgalkan ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmay xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya maamulka Trump iyo Ilhan Omar, oo ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta sida weyn u dhaliila madaxweynaha. Trump ayaa 8-dii October mar kale weerar afka ah ku qaaday bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee gobolka Minnesota, isagoo ku eedeeyey inay gobolka la wareegayaan, isla markaana ay ka dambeeyaan rabshado iyo falal amni-darro. Wuxuu dadka Minnesota ugu baaqay inay ka hortagaan xaaladda uu tilmaamay, halka xeer-ilaaliyaha guud ee gobolka, Keith Ellison, uu cambaareeyey hadalladaas, isagoo difaacay bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Trump ayaa muddo dheer si gaar ah u bartilmaameedsanayey Ilhan Omar, isagoo marar badan su’aal geliyey daacadnimadeeda Mareykanka, kuna baaqay in dalka laga masaafuriyo, inkastoo ay tahay muwaadinad Mareykan ah. Ilhan Omar ayaa dhankeeda ku tilmaantay weerarrada joogtada ah ee Trump kuwo xad-dhaaf ah, iyadoo sheegtay inay ka qeyb qaadanayaan hanjabaadaha iyo cadaadiska ay kala kulanto kooxaha ka soo horjeeda. Baaritaanka gurigeeda ayaa dhacay iyadoo wax ka yar bil ay ka harsan tahay doorashooyinka dhexe ee Congress-ka Mareykanka oo loo qorsheeyey 3-da November, kuwaas oo xisbiga Jamhuuriga uu doonayo inuu ku sii haysto aqlabiyadda labada aqal. Ilhan Omar oo 44 jir ah waxay ku dhalatay Muqdisho sanadkii 1982, waxayna Soomaaliya ka qaxday xilligii dagaalladii sokeeye. Qoyskeeda ayaa muddo ku noolaa xero qaxooti oo ku taalla Kenya ka hor intaysan Mareykanka tegin sanadkii 1995. Waxay dhalashada Mareykanka qaadatay sanadkii 2000, halka sanadkii 2018 ay noqotay haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee Soomaali-Mareykan ah oo loo doorto Congress-ka Mareykanka. Waxay hadda matashaa degmada shanaad ee gobolka Minnesota oo ay ku jirto magaalada Minneapolis, halkaas oo ay ku nool yihiin Soomaali aad u tiro badan. Ilaa hadda, dowladda Mareykanka ma shaacin muddada uu socon doono baaritaanka lagu sameeyey gurigeeda, waxyaabaha ay ciidamada ka soo qaadeen iyo haddii ay qorsheyneyso inay dacwad dembiyeed ku soo oogto xildhibaanadda.
