items.title: Itoobiya ma ka Samatabixi Doontaa Burburka ku Socda Dawladnimadeeda?
items.description: Maalmahan warbaahinta caalamku waxay si weyn u hadalhaysay dagaallada ka soo cusboonaaday waqooyiga Itoobiya iyo is-abaabulka xoogagga ka soo horjeeda xukuumadda Ra’iisalwasaare Abiy Axmed. Haddaba, si fahan buuxa looga helo xaaladdan, waxaa lagamamaarmaan ah in hoos loo eego sababaha ka danbeeya dagaallada soo noqnoqda ee dalkaas. Maqaalkani, oo arrinkaas sharxaya, wuxuu ku doodayaa in mushkiladda Itoobiya ay salka ku hayso qallooc taariikhi ah oo ku jira aasaaskii dawladnimada dalkaas. Qalloocaasi wuxuu soo bilowday xilligii Boqortooyadii Abasiiniya, kaddib markii dhulal iyo shucuub badan oo ku yaallay bariga, galbeedka iyo koonfurta Itoobiya xoog loogu daray boqortooyada. Maqaalkani wuxuu beeninayaa sheekada shaacsan ee ay Boqortooyadii Abasiiniya adduunka ku faafisay, taas oo oranaysa: Itoobiya waa dal leh dawladnimo guun ah oo saldhigatay. Dooddani waa mid siyaasadeed oo loogu talagalay in sharciyad iyo aqoonsi loogu dhiso dawladnimadii jujuubka ahayd ee qarnigii 19aad xoogga kula wareegtay shucuubtii kala duwanayd ee ku dhaqnayd waxa maanta loo yaqaan Itoobiya. Taariikhyahannada badankoodu waxay isku raacsanyihiin in dawladnimada Itoobiya aysan ka dhalan heshiis bulsho oo ay shucuubta dalkaasi si wadajir ah uga qaybqaateen. Taa beddelkeeda, waxay ka soo unkantay Boqortooyadii Abasiiniya ee ay hoggaaminayeen Amxaarada iyo Tigreegu, kuwaas oo xoog ku qabsaday shucuubtii kaladuwanayd ee ku dhaqnayd bariga, galbeedka iyo koonfurta Itoobiya ee maanta. Habkan jujuubka ah, ee soo bilowday xilligii boqortooyada, ayaa u gudbay dawladihii casriga ahaa ee is xigxigay ee Itoobiya soo maamulay. Maamulladii Haile Selassie (1930–1974), Dergigii (1974–1991) iyo EPRDF, oo ay TPLF hoggaaminaysay (1991–2018), waxay ahaayeen maamullo ku kaladuwanaa nidaamka iyo fikradda siyaasadeed, waxayse dhammaantood ka midaysnaayeen aragtida ah in dalka lagu maamulo nidaam dawlad dhexe oo awood badan. Siyaasaddaas xoogga ku dhisnayd waxay dhalisay cabashooyin taariikhi ah, sinnaan-la’aan siyaasadeed iyo khilaaf joogto ah oo ku saabsan cidda awoodda dalka leh iyo sida loo maamulayo. Shucuubta sida gaarka ah u dareemay culayska nidaamyadaas waxaa ka mid ah Oromada, oo tirakoobkii 2007 uu ku sheegay inay yihiin qiyaastii 34% tirada dadka dalkaas, taas oo ka dhigaysa qowmiyadda ugu tirada badan Itoobiya. Qowmiyadda Oromadu waxay waqti dheer soo wadday halgan la xiriira sidii ay uga xoroobi lahayd faquuqa iyo cadaadiskii ay kala kulmaysay dawladnimada jujuubka ah ee ay hoggaaminayeen qowmiyadaha Amxaarada iyo Tigreega. Halgankaas, oo lahaa garab siyaasadeed iyo mid hubaysan, ayaa aakhirkii isu beddelay kacdoon shacab oo ka qarxay gobolka Oromia, kaas oo ugu danbayn sababay in Ra’iisalwasaare Hailemariam Desalegn uu xilka iska casilo bishii Febraayo 2018kii. Waxaa xigtay in bishii Abriil ee isla sannadkaas uu xukunka dalka la wareegay Abiy Axmed, oo noqday ra’iisalwasaarihii ugu horreeyay ee Orom ah. Oromadu waxay arrintaas u arkeen guul taariikhi ah, hasayeeshee dhinaca kale waxaa jirtay caqabad ka imanaysay in dawladnimada ay Oromadu hoggaanka u qabatay ay ahayd dawladnimo ku dhisan fikradda Abasiiniya, oo aysan taariikh ahaan iyo dhaxal ahaanba waxba ku lahayn Oromadu. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xukunkii Abiy wuxuu bilowgii hore qaaday tallaabooyin muujinaya furfurnaan siyaasadeed oo gudaha iyo dibaddaba si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay. Kumannaan maxbuus ayaa la sii daayay, xayiraaddii saarnayd xisbiyada mucaaradka ayaa la qaaday, waxaana la soo afjaray colaaddii dheerayd ee Itoobiya iyo Eritrea. Laakiin sannadkii 2019kii ayay jihadii siyaasadda dalku isbeddeshay, kaddib markii Abiy uu meesha ka saaray isbahaysigii EPRDF, oo ka koobnaa afar qowmiyadood, kuna beddelay hal xisbi oo loo bixiyay Xisbiga Barwaaqo. Go’aankani wuxuu dhaliyay mucaaradad ka timid dhinacyo kala duwan oo kala ujeeddo ah. Qaybo badan oo Oromada ka mid ah waxay u arkeen in Abiy uu ka leexanayo federaalisamka qowmiyadaha ku dhisan, una jeedo dawlad dhexe oo xooggan. Dhinaca kale, Amxaarada iyo Tigreegu waxay isbeddelkan u arkeen qorshe uu Abiy ku dhisanayo nidaam dawlad dhexe oo awood leh oo ay Oromadu ku xooggan tahay, laakiin huwan shaati Itoobiyaannimo. Maamulka TPLF, oo awood ahaan ugu tun weynaa qowmiyadihii ku midaysnaa EPRDF, ayaa ka biyadiiday jihada uu Abiy la aaday siyaasadda dalka, taas oo sababtay in awooddoodii siyaasadeed, dhaqaalahoodii iyo kaadiriintoodiiba u guuraan Mekelle, caasimadda Tigray. Ugu danbayntii, khilaafkaasi wuxuu 4tii Noofeenbar 2020kii isu beddelay dagaal furan, waxaana ciidamada federaalku muddo kooban kaddib qabsadeen Mekelle. Dagaalkii uu Abiy la galay Tigrayga, waxaa la safnaa Amxaarada iyo Eritrea, oo mid kastaa ujeeddo gaar ah lahaa. Amxaaradu waxay doonaysay inay dib ula wareegto Galbeedka Tigray, oo ay u aragto dhul taariikh ahaan iyagu lahaayeen, laakiin uu maamulkii Tigrayga ee Itoobiya xukumay ku daray ismaamulka Tigray. Sidoo kale, Eritrea ayaa doonaysay inay awood ahaan wiiqdo TPLF, oo muddo dheer ahayd cadowgeeda ugu weyn. Kaddib dhimasho iyo barakac baahsan oo ka dhashay dagaalkii Tigray, Abiy iyo TPLF waxay bishii Noofeenbar 2022 heshiis nabadeed ku saxiixdeen magaalada Pretoria. Heshiiska Pretoria wuxuu joojiyay dagaalkii socday, mase uusan xallin asalkii khilaafka, sababo kala duwan awgood, oo ay ugu weynayd kalsoonidarrada u dhexaysay Addis Ababa iyo Mekelle. Taasi waxay hakisay hirgelinta qodobbada heshiiska, sida hubka ka dhigista xoogagga Tigrayga. Waxaa kaloo hirgelinta heshiiskii Pretoria caqabad ku noqday Amxaarada iyo Eritrea, oo aan ka qaybgelin heshiiska, una arkay inuu khatar ku yahay danahooda. Shakiga Amxaarada iyo Eritrea waxaa sii huriyay go’aankii Abiy ee ahaa in ciidamada gaarka ah ee gobollada, oo ay kuwa Amxaaradu ka mid yihiin, la kala diro, laguna daro ciidamada federaalka, iyo hadalladiisii ahaa in Itoobiya ay tahay inay marin badeed hesho, nabad ama colaad midkii ay ku heshaba. Cabsida iyo kalsoonidarrada u dhexaysay dhinacyada kaladuwan ayaa ugu danbayn horseedday in 20kii Sebteenbar 2026 toddoba urur oo mucaarad ahi ay ku dhawaaqaan isbahaysi ka dhan ah xukuumadda Addis Ababa. Ururradaas waxaa ka mid ah Jabhadda Xoraynta Shacabka Tigray (TPLF), Dhaqdhaqaaqyada Hubaysan ee Amxaarada (Fano), Ciidanka Xoraynta Oromada (OLA) iyo Jabhadda Waddaniga Xoraynta Ogaadeeniya (ONLF). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa weli taagan weydiimo waaweyn oo ku saabsan iskuduubnaanta iyo sii jiritaanka isbahaysigan, maadaama kooxaha ku midoobay ay leeyihiin dano isdiiddan iyo khilaafaad taariikhi ah oo aan weli xal loo helin. Tusaale ahaan, Oromadu, xitaa qaybaha sida weyn uga soo horjeeda Abiy Axmed, uma muuqdaan kuwo si fudud u taageeri kara in xukun ay Oromadu hoggaaminayso lagu rido kacdoon ay hormuud ka yihiin Amxaarada iyo Tigreegu. Sidoo kale, Amxaarada iyo Tigreega waxaa weli kala qaybiya loollan siyaasadeed oo ku saabsan hoggaanka dalka iyo khilaafaad dhuleed oo aan weli xal waara laga gaarin. Sidaas darteed, inkastoo ay dhinacyadani si ku-meel-gaar ah ugu midoobeen mucaaradka xukuumadda Addis Ababa, haddana khilaafaadkooda taariikhiga ah ayaa caqabad ku noqon kara iskuduubnaanta isbahaysiga. Gabagabadii, dagaallada iyo qalalaasaha siyaasadeed ee Itoobiya ma aha dhacdooyin kedis ah oo ka dhashay khilaafaadka maanta taagan; waxay qayb weyn ka yihiin dhaxal taariikheed oo soo taxnaa tan iyo Boqortooyadii Abasiiniya. Qaabdhismeedkii Itoobiya ayaa horseeday cabashooyin siyaasadeed, dhaqaale iyo bulsho, taas oo dhalisay dhaqdhaqaaqyo siyaasadeed iyo kuwo hubaysan oo uu ugu weyn yahay kacdoonkii siyaasadeed ee ay Oromadu hormuudka ka ahayd, kaas oo sababay in Abiy Axmed uu xukunka qabto. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, rejadii laga qabay inuu Abiy horseedo isbeddel ayaa meesha ka baxday, kaddib markii xukuumaddiisu dib ugu laabatay fikradda dawlad dhexe oo awood leh oo dalka xoog ku muquunisa. Arrinkaasi wuxuu niyadjab ku abuuray qaybo ka mid ah Oromada, oo u arkay inuu Abiy ka leexday nidaamka federaalisamka qowmiyadaha ku dhisan, halka Amxaarada, Tigreega iyo shucuub kale ay iyaguna ka niyadjabeen rejadii laga qabay dawlad furfuran oo dimuqraadi ah oo ku dhisan heshiis siyaasadeed loo dhanyahay. Ugu danbayntii, haddii aan la helin Itoobiya cusub oo ku dhisan heshiis siyaasadeed ay shucuubta kaladuwani si wadajir ah uga heshiiyaan arrimaha masiiriga ah ee dalka, sida awoodqaybsiga, federaalka iyo qaabka dalka loo maamulayo, waxay u eg tahay in dagaallada soo noqnoqday ay dalka u horseedi doonaan burbur siyaasadeed iyo mid dawladnimo oo aan laga soo waaqsan karin. items.fullContent: Maalmahan warbaahinta caalamku waxay si weyn u hadalhaysay dagaallada ka soo cusboonaaday waqooyiga Itoobiya iyo is-abaabulka xoogagga ka soo horjeeda xukuumadda Ra’iisalwasaare Abiy Axmed. Haddaba, si fahan buuxa looga helo xaaladdan, waxaa lagamamaarmaan ah in hoos loo eego sababaha ka danbeeya dagaallada soo noqnoqda ee dalkaas. Maqaalkani, oo arrinkaas sharxaya, wuxuu ku doodayaa in mushkiladda Itoobiya ay salka ku hayso qallooc taariikhi ah oo ku jira aasaaskii dawladnimada dalkaas. Qalloocaasi wuxuu soo bilowday xilligii Boqortooyadii Abasiiniya, kaddib markii dhulal iyo shucuub badan oo ku yaallay bariga, galbeedka iyo koonfurta Itoobiya xoog loogu daray boqortooyada. Maqaalkani wuxuu beeninayaa sheekada shaacsan ee ay Boqortooyadii Abasiiniya adduunka ku faafisay, taas oo oranaysa: Itoobiya waa dal leh dawladnimo guun ah oo saldhigatay. Dooddani waa mid siyaasadeed oo loogu talagalay in sharciyad iyo aqoonsi loogu dhiso dawladnimadii jujuubka ahayd ee qarnigii 19aad xoogga kula wareegtay shucuubtii kala duwanayd ee ku dhaqnayd waxa maanta loo yaqaan Itoobiya. Taariikhyahannada badankoodu waxay isku raacsanyihiin in dawladnimada Itoobiya aysan ka dhalan heshiis bulsho oo ay shucuubta dalkaasi si wadajir ah uga qaybqaateen. Taa beddelkeeda, waxay ka soo unkantay Boqortooyadii Abasiiniya ee ay hoggaaminayeen Amxaarada iyo Tigreegu, kuwaas oo xoog ku qabsaday shucuubtii kaladuwanayd ee ku dhaqnayd bariga, galbeedka iyo koonfurta Itoobiya ee maanta. Habkan jujuubka ah, ee soo bilowday xilligii boqortooyada, ayaa u gudbay dawladihii casriga ahaa ee is xigxigay ee Itoobiya soo maamulay. Maamulladii Haile Selassie (1930–1974), Dergigii (1974–1991) iyo EPRDF, oo ay TPLF hoggaaminaysay (1991–2018), waxay ahaayeen maamullo ku kaladuwanaa nidaamka iyo fikradda siyaasadeed, waxayse dhammaantood ka midaysnaayeen aragtida ah in dalka lagu maamulo nidaam dawlad dhexe oo awood badan. Siyaasaddaas xoogga ku dhisnayd waxay dhalisay cabashooyin taariikhi ah, sinnaan-la’aan siyaasadeed iyo khilaaf joogto ah oo ku saabsan cidda awoodda dalka leh iyo sida loo maamulayo. Shucuubta sida gaarka ah u dareemay culayska nidaamyadaas waxaa ka mid ah Oromada, oo tirakoobkii 2007 uu ku sheegay inay yihiin qiyaastii 34% tirada dadka dalkaas, taas oo ka dhigaysa qowmiyadda ugu tirada badan Itoobiya. Qowmiyadda Oromadu waxay waqti dheer soo wadday halgan la xiriira sidii ay uga xoroobi lahayd faquuqa iyo cadaadiskii ay kala kulmaysay dawladnimada jujuubka ah ee ay hoggaaminayeen qowmiyadaha Amxaarada iyo Tigreega. Halgankaas, oo lahaa garab siyaasadeed iyo mid hubaysan, ayaa aakhirkii isu beddelay kacdoon shacab oo ka qarxay gobolka Oromia, kaas oo ugu danbayn sababay in Ra’iisalwasaare Hailemariam Desalegn uu xilka iska casilo bishii Febraayo 2018kii. Waxaa xigtay in bishii Abriil ee isla sannadkaas uu xukunka dalka la wareegay Abiy Axmed, oo noqday ra’iisalwasaarihii ugu horreeyay ee Orom ah. Oromadu waxay arrintaas u arkeen guul taariikhi ah, hasayeeshee dhinaca kale waxaa jirtay caqabad ka imanaysay in dawladnimada ay Oromadu hoggaanka u qabatay ay ahayd dawladnimo ku dhisan fikradda Abasiiniya, oo aysan taariikh ahaan iyo dhaxal ahaanba waxba ku lahayn Oromadu. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xukunkii Abiy wuxuu bilowgii hore qaaday tallaabooyin muujinaya furfurnaan siyaasadeed oo gudaha iyo dibaddaba si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay. Kumannaan maxbuus ayaa la sii daayay, xayiraaddii saarnayd xisbiyada mucaaradka ayaa la qaaday, waxaana la soo afjaray colaaddii dheerayd ee Itoobiya iyo Eritrea. Laakiin sannadkii 2019kii ayay jihadii siyaasadda dalku isbeddeshay, kaddib markii Abiy uu meesha ka saaray isbahaysigii EPRDF, oo ka koobnaa afar qowmiyadood, kuna beddelay hal xisbi oo loo bixiyay Xisbiga Barwaaqo. Go’aankani wuxuu dhaliyay mucaaradad ka timid dhinacyo kala duwan oo kala ujeeddo ah. Dhinaca kale, Amxaarada iyo Tigreegu waxay isbeddelkan u arkeen qorshe uu Abiy ku dhisanayo nidaam dawlad dhexe oo awood leh oo ay Oromadu ku xooggan tahay, laakiin huwan shaati Itoobiyaannimo. items.title: Mid kamid ah xildhibaannada BF oo Ambulance looga qaaday xarunta Villa Hargeysa
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo ka hadlayay xaadiritaanka xildhibaannada ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah xildhibaannada oo xanuunsan ay haddana soo xaadiraan kulamada baarlamaanka, halka kuwo kale oo caafimaad qaba ay ka maqnaadaan fadhiyada joogtada ah. Jaamac ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyay in saaka mid ka mid ah xildhibaanada haweenka ah ay xanuunsatay iyada oo gudanaysa waajibaadkeeda shaqo, isla markaana gaari ambalaas ah looga qaaday xarunta Golaha Shacabka, si loogu fidiyo daryeel caafimaad Sidoo kale, wuxuu ballan qaaday inay cadaalad sameyn doonaan ka guddoon ahaan, isla markaana ay sii wadi doonaan lacagaha laga jaro xldhibaannada ka baaqda fadhiyaha golaha. “Saaka gabar baa halkan Ambulance looga qaaday xildhibaan ah nina gurigiisa ayuu jiifaa waa jareynaa lacagta kuwo bishaan ayaa laga jaraa bisha soo socota ayaa la jarayaa sharciga ayaana noo ogol,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiye Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac). Sidoo kale wuxuu intaas kusii daray “Haddii gabadha 800 qaadaneyso mushaarka laga jaraayo askariga 200 oo dollar qaadanaayo laga jaraayo xildhibaan 5000 qaadanaayo waa laga jaraa hal il ayay ka wada imaanayaan”. Dooddan ayaa muddo soo socotay, waxaana ay saameysay qaar kamid ah xildhibaannada baarlamaanka oo bishan laga jartay lacago gaarayo xildhibaankii illaa 800 oo dollar. “$800 ayaa laga jaray Xildhibaannada, dood weyn ayaana ka qabnaa. Isla xisaabtanka waan oggolnahay, laakiin qaabka loo maray ayaa qalad ah,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Yuusuf Gama’adiid oo ka hadlayay lacagaha uu guddoonka ka jaray qaar kamid ah xildhibaannada baarlamaanka. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyadoo horay guddoonka Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya u sheegay inuu tallaabo ka qaadayo Xildhibaannada ka maqan kulamada Golaha Shacabka, si loola xisaabtamo maadaama ay gudan waayeen waajibaadkooda shaqo, xilli dalka uu jiro marxalad adag. items.title: Somalia: Former president Sharif Sheikh Ahmed denies his guards harassed NISA officers
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed on Sunday disputed an account by the National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) that armed men under his command attacked its personnel in the capital. This comes amid fears of armed confrontation, after local media reported that the government had deployed a large number of forces near his residence close to Mogadishu airport. The same media outlets report that the government plans to launch an operation against his home to disarm him, along with other opposition figures. Key points In a statement issued on Sunday, NISA said armed militias under Sharif’s command attacked its Public Protection Forces in Wadajir District, Banadir Region. The agency alleges that one officer was abducted on June 24, 2026, and that its operations were obstructed on June 27, 2026. Sharif responded the same day, saying all incidents must be “properly documented, thoroughly investigated, and independently verified.” Local journalists report a large government deployment near his home and a planned operation to disarm him and other opposition figures. NISA’s allegations In its Sunday statement, NISA said it “strongly condemns the armed attacks and acts of aggression” directed against its Public Protection Forces operating in the General Da’ud Section of Wadajir District. It said the incident involved “armed militias operating under the command of former Somali President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed.” The agency said the militias “attempted to provoke a violent confrontation with security personnel.” Its own forces, it said, “demonstrated restraint, professionalism, and a strong sense of responsibility,” avoiding any action that could have escalated tensions or endangered civilian lives. According to NISA, evidence it has gathered indicates that militia members armed with AK-47 rifles, BKM machine guns and rocket-propelled grenades (RPGs) forcibly entered residential properties in the Tiintiinley neighbourhood of Wadajir District. The agency set out two earlier incidents: June 24, 2026: the militias “attacked NISA’s Public Protection Forces and abducted one officer who was carrying out his official duties.” June 27, 2026: the militias “once again obstructed security operations conducted by NISA personnel in the General Da’ud Section.” NISA described itself as a law enforcement and national security institution that “operates strictly within the framework of the law and remains independent of political rivalries.” It said it “will not allow its personnel to be drawn into political disputes,” and that it remains committed to “maintaining peace and stability in the capital.” Sharif’s response Responding in a statement of his own on Sunday, Sharif called for an independent examination of the incidents. “All these incidents must be properly documented, thoroughly investigated, and independently verified,” he said. “Any unlawful conduct must be addressed, and individuals found responsible must be held personally accountable, regardless of whether they acted under the name or authority of the state.” He called on NISA’s leadership “to refrain from misleading the Somali public, which is already struggling with humanitarian challenges caused by storms, torrential rains, and the forced displacement of people from their homes and the unlawful seizure of their property, particularly land.” National security institutions, he said, “must remain independent of political rivalries and operate strictly within the law, protecting all citizens equally and without discrimination.” Warning over political pressure Sharif cautioned against using security incidents or unverified allegations as political tools. “We warn against the use of security incidents or allegations that have not yet been independently verified as instruments of political pressure, intimidation, or attempts to silence opposition politicians advocating a consensual electoral process,” he said. Somalia’s political situation, he said, “demands prudence, responsibility, and leadership that avoids actions capable of triggering armed confrontation.” He added: “The country does not need another security crisis, nor should political disagreements be transformed into conflict that threatens civilian lives and the stability of the country.” On responsibility for any escalation, he said: “The responsibility for any consequences arising from unlawful actions or measures that provoke confrontation rests with the outgoing administration.” “Peace, Dialogue, and a Political Solution” Under the heading “Our Position: Peace, Dialogue, and a Political Solution”, the statement said Sharif “has no interest in creating insecurity, inciting conflict, or causing bloodshed.” He “firmly believes,” it said, that Somalia’s political disputes can be resolved through “genuine dialogue, mutual trust, and an electoral process based on broad political agreement.” Fears of confrontation Tensions in the capital have risen over the reported deployment. Local journalists say the government has positioned a large number of forces near Sharif’s home close to Mogadishu airport and is preparing an operation against the residence to disarm him and other opposition figures. Sharif responded the same day, saying all incidents must be “properly documented, thoroughly investigated, and independently verified.” Local journalists report a large government deployment near his home and a planned operation to disarm him and other opposition figures. NISA’s allegations In its Sunday statement, NISA said it “strongly condemns the armed attacks and acts of aggression” directed against its Public Protection Forces operating in the General Da’ud Section of Wadajir District. It said the incident involved “armed militias operating under the command of former Somali President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed.” The agency said the militias “attempted to provoke a violent confrontation with security personnel.” Its own forces, it said, “demonstrated restraint, professionalism, and a strong sense of responsibility,” avoiding any action that could have escalated tensions or endangered civilian lives. According to NISA, evidence it has gathered indicates that militia members armed with AK-47 rifles, BKM machine guns and rocket-propelled grenades (RPGs) forcibly entered residential properties in the Tiintiinley neighbourhood of Wadajir District. The agency set out two earlier incidents: June 24, 2026: the militias “attacked NISA’s Public Protection Forces and abducted one officer who was carrying out his official duties.” June 27, 2026: the militias “once again obstructed security operations conducted by NISA personnel in the General Da’ud Section.” NISA described itself as a law enforcement and national security institution that “operates strictly within the framework of the law and remains independent of political rivalries.” It said it “will not allow its personnel to be drawn into political disputes,” and that it remains committed to “maintaining peace and stability in the capital.” Sharif’s response Responding in a statement of his own on Sunday, Sharif called for an independent examination of the incidents. “All these incidents must be properly documented, thoroughly investigated, and independently verified,” he said. “Any unlawful conduct must be addressed, and individuals found responsible must be held personally accountable, regardless of whether they acted under the name or authority of the state.” He called on NISA’s leadership “to refrain from misleading the Somali public, which is already struggling with humanitarian challenges caused by storms, torrential rains, and the forced displacement of people from their homes and the unlawful seizure of their property, particularly land.” National security institutions, he said, “must remain independent of political rivalries and operate strictly within the law, protecting all citizens equally and without discrimination.” Warning over political pressure Sharif cautioned against using security incidents or unverified allegations as political tools. “We warn against the use of security incidents or allegations that have not yet been independently verified as instruments of political pressure, intimidation, or attempts to silence opposition politicians advocating a consensual electoral process,” he said. Somalia’s political situation, he said, “demands prudence, responsibility, and leadership that avoids actions capable of triggering armed confrontation.” He added: “The country does not need another security crisis, nor should political disagreements be transformed into conflict that threatens civilian lives and the stability of the country.” On responsibility for any escalation, he said: “The responsibility for any consequences arising from unlawful actions or measures that provoke confrontation rests with the outgoing administration.” “Peace, Dialogue, and a Political Solution” Under the heading “Our Position: Peace, Dialogue, and a Political Solution”, the statement said Sharif “has no interest in creating insecurity, inciting conflict, or causing bloodshed.” He “firmly believes,” it said, that Somalia’s political disputes can be resolved through “genuine dialogue, mutual trust, and an electoral process based on broad political agreement.” Fears of confrontation Tensions in the capital have risen over the reported deployment. Local journalists say the government has positioned a large number of forces near Sharif’s home close to Mogadishu airport and is preparing an operation against the residence to disarm him and other opposition figures. items.title: President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro: A Vision for Somaliland’s Future
items.description: President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro has an important opportunity to shape Somaliland’s political, economic, and social future. Since assuming the presidency, he has faced the challenge of meeting public expectations, strengthening institutions, promoting stability, and creating opportunities for the people of Somaliland. Leadership is measured not only by political promises but also by the lasting improvements made in people’s lives. For Somaliland, this means building a government that prioritizes public services, economic development, national unity, and accountable governance. Promoting Peace and National Unity. One of the most important responsibilities of President Irro is to strengthen peace and reconciliation among Somaliland’s communities. Political differences and clan divisions can undermine social cohesion when they are not addressed through dialogue and inclusive leadership. By encouraging consultation, respecting different perspectives, and ensuring that all communities have a voice in public affairs, his administration can help build a stronger foundation for long-term stability. National unity should not require uniformity of opinion. Instead, it should be built on mutual respect, equal citizenship, and confidence in public institutions. Economic Development and Employment Somaliland’s future also depends on economic progress. Many young people need better access to employment, education, professional training, and opportunities to establish businesses. President Irro’s administration has an opportunity to encourage domestic entrepreneurship, attract responsible foreign investment, improve infrastructure, and strengthen the business environment. Investment in ports, roads, agriculture, livestock, fisheries, telecommunications, and renewable energy could help diversify the economy. Transparent regulations and reliable public institutions would also help build investor confidence while ensuring that economic opportunities benefit ordinary citizens. Good Governance and Public Accountability Public confidence in government depends on transparency, fairness, and responsible management of public resources. Strengthening independent oversight, improving public financial management, and ensuring that public appointments are based on merit would contribute to more effective institutions. A government that listens to criticism and addresses legitimate public concerns can build greater trust. Accountability should apply consistently, regardless of political affiliation, clan background, or personal connections. Education, Healthcare, and Youth Empowerment. The long-term prosperity of Somaliland requires investment in its people. Expanding access to quality education, improving healthcare services, and supporting vocational training would help prepare younger generations for a changing economy. The administration can also create opportunities for women, entrepreneurs, professionals, and members of the diaspora to contribute their knowledge and resources to national development. International Relations and Somaliland’s Aspirations. Somaliland’s pursuit of international recognition remains a central issue in its political future. President Irro has an opportunity to pursue diplomatic engagement through peaceful dialogue, practical cooperation, and partnerships that support trade, development, and regional stability. Diplomatic progress requires a consistent strategy, credible institutions, and constructive engagement with regional and international partners. At the same time, foreign relations should complement domestic priorities rather than replace the work of improving the lives of Somaliland’s citizens. Conclusion: A Legacy Built on Results President Irro has an opportunity to leave a meaningful legacy through policies that promote peace, economic growth, institutional reform, and social progress. Whether his presidency ultimately fulfills the hopes of Somaliland’s citizens will depend on the results his administration delivers and its willingness to respond to public expectations. The people of Somaliland deserve leadership that places the public interest above political divisions and personal interests. If the administration makes measurable progress in good governance, employment, education, healthcare, and diplomatic engagement, it can contribute to a stronger and more prosperous future for Somaliland. Ultimately, the success of any president is measured not simply by the promises made at the beginning of a term, but by the positive and lasting changes experienced by the people. Rahma Abdulkadir Minnesota

items.title: Khayre oo digniin culus kasoo saaray xiisadda ka taagan Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Cali Khayre ayaa si kulul kaga hadlay xiisadda ka taagan magaalada Muqdisho ee ka dhalatay dhaq-dhaqaaqyada u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan Sheekh Shariif. Xasan Cali Khayre ayaa ka digay tallaabooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ee ay qaaday dowladda, wuxuuna daan-daansi ku tilmaamay ciidamada la dul-dhigay aagga madaxda mucaaradka. Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee dalka ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in tallaabooyinkan ay horseedi karaan colaad horleh iyo xasillooni darro ka dhacda gudaha caasimda. “Waxaan si adag uga digayaa cawaaqibka xun ee ka dhalan kara daandaansiga iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidan ee taliska Madaxweynaha muddo-xileedkiisu dhammaaday uu ku beegsanayo guryaha ay Muqdisho ka deggan yihiin madaxdii hore ee qaranka. Tallaabooyinkani waxay abuurayaan jawi colaadeed oo caasimadda dalka u horseedi kara xasillooni-darro, qalalaaso amni iyo hubanti la’aan siyaasadeed,” ayuu yiri Khayre. Sidoo kale, wuxuu eedeymo culus u jeediyay madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, isaga oo tilmaamay inuu xiiso u qabo dagaal, uuna banneysanayo dhiigga xubnaha mucaaradka, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Waxaa ayaandarro ah in Madaxweyne hore Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu u oomman yahay dhiig hor leh, kuna hawllan yahay ficillo uu ku banneysanayo dhiigga madaxdii hore, waxaana ummadda Soomaaliyeed si cad u sheegaynaa in Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu idlaaday uu qaadayo masuuliyadda cawaaqib kasta oo ka dhasha tallaabooyinkan,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Mudane Xasan Cali Khayre oo hadalkiisa sii wata ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in xiisadda ka dhalatay hubanti la’aanta siyaasadeed aan lagu xallin karin awood ciidan, loona baahanyahay in dib loogu laabto miiska wadahadalka, si heshiis siyaasadeed looga gaaro doorashada. “Awood ciidan iyo cagajugleyn laguma xallin karo xaaladda murugsan ee dalku ku jiro. Dariiqa keliya ee Soomaaliya looga badbaadin karo hubanti la’aanta siyaasadeed waa in dib loogu laabto miiska wadahadalka, si heshiis siyaasadeed looga gaaro doorashada, loona helo dowlad ku timaada hannaan heshiis lagu yahay oo leh sharciyad ay ku hoggaamiso Soomaaliya,” ayuu kusoo gabagabeeyay qoraalkiisa. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli shalay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Sheekh Shariif ay ku dhawaadeen inay isku fara-saaraan agagaarka waddada garoonka diyaaradaha Muqdisho, halkaas oo laga dareemay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeeda, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isu jeediyeen eedeymo culus. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo ka qayb galay munaasabadda xuska Maalinta Calanka Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Muqdisho, 12 Oktoobar 2026 — Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa ka qayb galay munaasabad heer qaran ah oo lagu xusayay Maalinta Calanka Soomaaliyeed, oo ku beegan 12-ka Oktoobar, taas oo astaan u ah gobannimada, midnimada iyo jiritaanka qaranka Soomaaliyeed. Munaasabadda oo ka dhacday xarunta Madaxtooyada Qaranka ayaa waxaa ka qayb galay cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan ciidamada dhulka, cirka iyo badda, kuwaas oo soo bandhigay dhoollatus ciidan oo muujinaya doorka ay ku leeyihiin difaaca qarannimada iyo madax-bannaanida dalka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa xusay muhiimadda taariikheed ee 12-ka Oktoobar, isaga oo tilmaamay in calanka Soomaaliyeed uu astaan u yahay midnimada shacabka, halgankii gobannimo-doonka iyo naf-hurnimadii halgamayaashii Soomaaliyeed ee u soo dagaallamay xorriyadda dalka. Calanka Soomaaliyeed ayaa muddo dheer astaan u ahaa himilada shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee ku aaddan xorriyadda, wadajirka iyo dhismaha dowladnimada, waxaana sannad kasta 12-ka Oktoobar la xusaa taariikhda iyo qiimaha uu u leeyahay qaranka. Munaasabadda waxaa sidoo kale ka qayb galay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Koowaad ee Golaha Aqalka Sare, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare iyo taliyeyaasha ciidamada qalabka sida. Xuska Maalinta Calanka Soomaaliyeed ayaa ah munaasabad qaran oo lagu xoojinayo dareenka waddaniyadeed, midnimada shacabka iyo ilaalinta astaamaha qaranka.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo ka qayb-galay xuska Maalinta Calanka + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta ka qayb galay munaasabad heer qaran ah oo si maqaam sare leh loogu xusay Maalinta Calanka Soomaaliyeed, taasi oo astaan u ah gobannimada, midnimada iyo jiritaanka ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Munaasabadda maalinta Calanka waxaa ka qayb galay Guddoomiyaha Golaha shacabka Soomaaliya, Guddoomiye Ku xigeenka Koowaad ee Golaha Aqalka sare, Ra’iisul wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka, Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda sare iyo Taliyeyaasha ciidamada Qalabka sida ee Qaranka Soomaaliyeed. Xuska oo ka dhacay xarunta Madaxtooyada qaranka ayaa waxaa sidoo kale si weyn uga qayb qaatay cutubyo ka kala socday Ciidamada Dhulka, Cirka iyo Badda ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas bandhig cajiib ah kusoo bandhigay xarunta Villa Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale waxay si xirfad ciidannimo ku dheehan tahay u muujiyeen sida ay uga go’an tahay difaaca calanka, qarannimada, madax-bannaanida dalka iyo jiritaanka ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Inta ay socotay munaasabadda waxaa sidoo kale hadal kooban ka jeediyay madaxweynaha isagoo muujiyay qiimaha taariikheed ee maalinka 12-ka Oktoobar iyo kaalinta uu Calanka Soomaaliyeed ku leeyahay sharafta iyo karaamada ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Waxaa kale oo uu tilmaamay in calanku yahay astaan ka tarjumaysa midnimada shacabka, himiladii xorriyadeed iyo naf-hurnimadii halgamayaashii Soomaaliyeed ee u soo dagaallamay gobanimada. “Munaasabaddan awgeed, waxaan xusuus iyo maamuus gaar ah u dirayaa halgamayaashii naftooda u huray xorriyadda, madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dalkeenna, aniga oo Alle uga baryayaa in uu naxariistiisa Janno ku maamuuso dhammaan shuhadadii Soomaaliyeed ee u naf-waayey difaaca dalka, diinta, dadka iyo qarannimada,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynuhu. Dhanka kale, shacabka Soomaaliyeed ayuu ugu baaqay inay ilaashadaan dhaxalka dowladnimo ee ay nooga tageen halgamayaashii gobannimada, ayna ka wada shaqeeyaan adkaynta midnimada, difaaca madax-bannaanida iyo ilaalinta jiritaanka qarankeenna. Calanka Soomaaliyeed ayaa markii u horreysay la taagay 12-kii Oktoobar 1954-kii, xilli ay ummadda Soomaaliyeed ku jirtay halgankii gobannimada iyo u diyaar-garowga madax-bannaanida, waxa uu astaan u yahay gobannimada, midnimada, wadajirka iyo jiritaanka qaranka Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo xambaarsan taariikhda halgankii dheeraa ee ay awoowayaasheen iyo halgamayaasheenna u soo galeen xorriyadda iyo karaamada ummaddooda. Waxaa kale oo uu tilmaamay in calanku yahay astaan ka tarjumaysa midnimada shacabka, himiladii xorriyadeed iyo naf-hurnimadii halgamayaashii Soomaaliyeed ee u soo dagaallamay gobanimada. “Munaasabaddan awgeed, waxaan xusuus iyo maamuus gaar ah u dirayaa halgamayaashii naftooda u huray xorriyadda, madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dalkeenna, aniga oo Alle uga baryayaa in uu naxariistiisa Janno ku maamuuso dhammaan shuhadadii Soomaaliyeed ee u naf-waayey difaaca dalka, diinta, dadka iyo qarannimada,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynuhu. Dhanka kale, shacabka Soomaaliyeed ayuu ugu baaqay inay ilaashadaan dhaxalka dowladnimo ee ay nooga tageen halgamayaashii gobannimada, ayna ka wada shaqeeyaan adkaynta midnimada, difaaca madax-bannaanida iyo ilaalinta jiritaanka qarankeenna. Calanka Soomaaliyeed ayaa markii u horreysay la taagay 12-kii Oktoobar 1954-kii, xilli ay ummadda Soomaaliyeed ku jirtay halgankii gobannimada iyo u diyaar-garowga madax-bannaanida, waxa uu astaan u yahay gobannimada, midnimada, wadajirka iyo jiritaanka qaranka Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo xambaarsan taariikhda halgankii dheeraa ee ay awoowayaasheen iyo halgamayaasheenna u soo galeen xorriyadda iyo karaamada ummaddooda. items.title: Maxaa ka jira in odayaal ergo ka ah Shariif ay u tageen Xasan Sheekh?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Iyadoo saacadihii ugu dambeeyay siyaabo kala duwan loo baahiyay warar sheegayay in odayaal dhaqameed ay u tageen Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, si ay ugala hadlaan xiisadda kala dhexeysa madaxweynihii hore ee dalka, Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa la sheegay in wararkaas ay yihiin kuwa been abuur ah. Qaar ka mid ah odayaasha oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in aysan jirin wax kulan ah oo ay Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud kala yeesheen arrimaha la xiriira xiisadda kala dhexeysa Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed, iyagoo si cad u beeniyay wararka la baahiyay. Sidoo kale, odayaasha ayaa sheegay in haatan xaaladda magaalada Muqdisho ay dagan tahay, isla markaana aysan jirin wax xaalad amni darro ah oo taagan, sida ay hadalka u dhigeen. Waxaa kale oo ay dadka baraha bulshada ku faafiyey wararkaas ugu baaqeen in aysan bulshada kicin oo aan lagu abuurin khal-khal iyo daganaansho la’aan. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya, iyadoo shalay si weyn magaalada caasimada ah ee Muqdisho looga dareemay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo xooggan oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada Sheekh Shariif iyo kuwa dowladda, kuwaas oo qarka u saarnaa inay isku dhacaan, kadib markii ay labada ciidan isku soo dhawaadeen, taas oo dhalisay cabsi laga qabo inuu dagaal dhex-maro labada dhinac. NISA oo soo bandhigtay caddeymo ayaa sheegtay in ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa Shariif oo ku hubeysnaa AK-47, BKM iyo RPG ay xoog ku galeen guryo ku yaalla xaafadda Tiintiinley ee degmada Wadajir, halka eedeymahaas uu iska fogeeyay madaxweynihii hore ee dalka. Sidoo kale Hay’adda NISA ayaa sheegtay in 24-kii Juun 2026, maleeshiyaadkan ay weerar ku qaadeen ciidamada Ilaalada Shacabka, ayna afduubteen mid ka mid ah ciidamadii waajibaadkooda gudanayay. 27-kii Juun 2026, waxay mar kale hor istaageen howlaha amni ee ciidamada ka howlgalayay Waaxda General Daa’uud. Madaxweynihii hore ee dowladdii KMG ahayd ayaa dhankiisa soo bandhigay tabasho uu qabo iyo eedeymo uu u jeediyay ciidanka dowladda, isaga oo tilmaamay inay jiraan dhacdooyin taxane ah oo walaac amni abuuray, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin jidgooyooyin iyo xannibaadyo saameeyey isu-socodka agagaarka deegaanka uu deggan yahay Shariif, isaga oo sidoo kale xusay in la hor-istaagay adeegyada daruuriga ah ee nolol maalmeedka sida biyaha, cunnooyinka iyo wixii la mid ah, hase-yeeshee laga muujiyay dulqaad, si looga fogaado isku dhac hubeysan The post Maxaa ka jira in odayaal ergo ka ah Shariif ay u tageen Xasan Sheekh? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dowladda Federaalka oo qarameysay ciidamo uu fadhigoodu yahay Buurhakaba
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka ayaa qarameysay ciidamadan oo muddo dheer uu fadhigoodu ahaa Degmada Buurhakaba ee Gobolka Baay, ka dib markii Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda ay diiwaangelisay. Taliyaha cusub Guutada 7aad, Qaybta 12-ka April ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Gaashaanle Maxamed Xasan Aadan (Sandheere) oo Jimcihii gaaray Degmada Buurhakaba ayaa gelinkii dambe ee Axaddii shalay ciidamadaasi u qaybiyay dareyska militariga iyo weliba hub iyo rasaas. Taliyaha oo la magacaabay habeenkii Khamiista ayaa si degdeg ah diyaarad helicopter ah ugu tegay degmadaasi, isagoona ka ambabaxay Magaalada Muqdisho. Magacaabiddiisa ayaa ku timid baahi amni, ka dib markii ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ee saacado ka hor inta aan la magacaabin ay la wareegeen Degmada Qansaxdheere ee Gobolka Baay. Qabsashada Qansaxdheere ayaa soo dedejisay qarameynta ciidamada dadka deegaanka ee ku sugan Buurhakaba, si ay ugu biiraan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo in la dhameeyo khilaaf Taliye Sandheere kala dhexeeyay Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ee Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu hoggaamiyo. Sandheere oo ka mid ahaa saraakiishii hoggaamineysay is bedelkii amni iyo siyaasadeed ee 30-kii bishii March ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa daba-yaaqadii bishii August isaga tegey magaaladaasi, waxayna isaga iyo ciidamadu uu horkacayay ay ku laabteen Buurhakaba, oo ah meesha ay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo ciidamada dadka deegaanka ee la abaabulay ka hujuumeen Baydhabo. Sandheere ayaa hadda looga fadhiyaa in uu dardargeliyo hawlgalada Ciidanka Guutada 7aad, si ay ciidamadu u difaacaan Buurhakaba iyo degmada kale ee deriska yihiin ee Wanlaweyn oo ka tirsan Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose.

items.title: Calooshood u shaqeystayaal Mareykan ah oo uu leeyahay Erik Prince oo lagu laayey dalka…
items.description: Kinshasa (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamo calooshood u shaqeystayaal ah oo ka tirsan shirkadda amniga gaarka loo leeyahay ee Vectus Global, oo uu leeyahay Erik Prince, aasaasihii shirkaddii caanka ahayd ee Blackwater, ayaa khasaare culus kala kulmay weerar gaadmo ah oo ka dhacay bariga Jamhuuriyadda Dimoqraadiga ah ee Congo, kaas oo sababay dhimashada iyo dhaawaca ku dhowaad 20 qof. Weerarka oo dhacay 17-kii September, gobolka South Kivu, ayaa lagu dilay ugu yaraan toddoba qof oo u dhashay Congo iyo askari hore oo ka tirsanaa ciidamada gaarka ah ee New Zealand, sida ay wakaaladda Reuters u sheegeen ilo la shaqeeya dowladda Congo iyo kuwo xog-ogaal u ah howlgalka shirkadda. Dadka dhaawacmay waxaa ka mid ah Tim Kennedy, oo hore uga tirsanaa ciidamada gaarka ah ee Mareykanka, kana mid ahaa dagaalyahannadii caanka ahaa ee tartanka UFC, iyo shaqaale kale oo ajnabi ah oo ka tirsanaa shirkadda. Saddex ilo-wareed ayaa Reuters u sheegay in Kennedy ay saddex xabbadood kaga dhaceen lugta, balse uu ka badbaaday weerarka. Waxaa hadda lagu daweynayaa xarunta caafimaadka militariga Mareykanka ee Walter Reed, oo ku taalla duleedka Washington. Reuters ayaa sheegtay inay la hadashay ugu yaraan 10 ilo-wareed oo qaarkood si toos ah ula socdeen weerarka, halka kuwa kalena laga war-geliyey wixii dhacay. Weerarkan ayaa iftiimiyey doorka sii ballaaranaya ee Erik Prince, oo ah xulufo iyo taageere madaxweyne Donald Trump, uu ku leeyahay colaadda bariga Congo, halkaas oo shirkaddiisa Vectus Global ay ka waddo howlgallo amni oo ay ku taageereyso dowladda dalkaas. Tuhun ku saabsan ciidamada Rwanda Ilo la shaqeeya dowladda Congo ayaa sheegay inay suurtagal tahay in ciidamada Rwanda ee taageera fallaagada M23 ay ka dambeeyeen weerarka, iyagoo tilmaamay in kooxda la weeraray laga yaabo in lagu raadjoogay diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo ay u adeegsanayeen howlgallada sahanka. Mid ka mid ah ilaha sida tooska ah ula socday dhacdada ayaa sheegay in kooxda Vectus Global ay u kala safraysay goobo kala duwan markii gaadmadu dhacday. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in qaabka loo qorsheeyey loona fuliyey weerarka uu muujinayo suurtagalnimada inay ku lug lahaayeen ciidamo Rwanda ka socda. Laba ilo-wareed oo kale ayaa si toos ah ciidamada Rwanda ugu eedeeyey inay fuliyeen weerarka. “Arrintani waxay sii xoojinaysaa baahida loo qabo in dib loo soo celiyo madax-bannaanida Congo. Waa meel aad khatar u ah xilligan,” ayuu yiri mid ka mid ah ilaha xog-ogaalka u ahaa howlgalka. Hase yeeshee, eedeymahan si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Afhayeenno u hadlay dowladaha Congo iyo Rwanda, iyo kooxda M23, ayaan si degdeg ah uga jawaabin codsiyo ay Reuters u dirtay oo ay ku weydiisatay inay ka hadlaan dhacdada. Ilo amni oo Congo ka tirsan ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dadka deegaanka ay suurtagal tahay inay ku jiraan dadkii ku dhintay ama ku dhaawacmay weerarka. Shirkadda Vectus Global ayaa ka gaabsatay inay ka hadasho dhacdada, halka ilo xog-ogaal ah ay sheegeen in tani ay tahay markii ugu horreysay ee shirkaddu khasaare noocan ah kala kulanto howlgalladeeda Congo. Doorka shirkadda Erik Prince ee Congo Erik Prince ayaa markii hore Congo u tegay heshiis la xiriira sugidda amniga iyo hagaajinta dakhliga dowladda ka soo gala macdanta, oo ah il dhaqaale oo muhiim ah, balse muddo tobannaan sano ah ay saameeyeen boob, tahriib iyo colaado hubeysan. Hase yeeshee, howlaha shirkaddiisa ayaa markii dambe ka gudbay ilaalinta dakhliga macdanta, iyagoo gaaray taageerada amniga iyo howlgallada ka socda goobaha dagaalka. Bilihii January iyo February ee sanadkan, ciidamo ka tirsan Vectus Global ayaa la geeyey magaalada istaraatiijiga ah ee Uvira, oo ku taalla gobolka South Kivu, kaddib markii Mareykanku gacan ka geystay heshiis lagu doonayey in fallaagada M23 ee Rwanda taageerto ay uga baxdo magaalada. Ciidamada Prince ayaa xilligaas ka caawiyey militariga Congo sugidda amniga Uvira, iyadoo fallaagada M23 ay weli gacanta ku hayso dhul ballaaran oo ku yaalla bariga dalka. Lama oga tirada guud ee ciidamada iyo shaqaalaha amniga ee Prince uu ka hawlgeliyey Congo, balse weerarkii September ayaa muujinaya khatarta ay wajahayaan ciidamada shisheeye ee ka qayb qaadanaya colaadda. Prince ayaa hore u aasaasay shirkaddii militariga gaarka loo lahaa ee Blackwater, taas oo sumcad-xumo weyn kala kulantay howlgalladii ay ka fulisay Ciraaq. Qaar ka mid ah shaqaalaheeda oo lagu helay dilka dad rayid ah oo Ciraaqiyiin ah ayaa cafis ka helay Trump sanadkii 2020. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa hore u sheegtay inaysan wax heshiis ah Congo kula lahayn Prince. Si kastaba, saraakiil Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay inay qorsheynayaan inay xiriir dhow la yeeshaan shirkadda Vectus Global marka ay timaaddo howlgallada Haiti. Colaadda Congo iyo faragelinta Rwanda Weerarkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya iyadoo dadaallada Mareykanku uu ku doonayo inuu ku soo afjaro colaadda bariga Congo ay weli wajahayaan caqabado waaweyn. Maamulka Trump ayaa dhexdhexaadiyey heshiisyo lagu doonayo in lagu yareeyo xiisadda u dhexeysa Congo iyo Rwanda, iyadoo heshiiska bixitaanka fallaagada M23 ee Uvira uu qayb ka ahaa dadaalladaas. Hase yeeshee, colaadda ayaa weli ka taagan qaybo badan oo bariga Congo ah, gaar ahaan deegaannada hodanka ku ah macdanta qaaliga ah ee ay ka mid yihiin dahabka, lithium-ka iyo tantalum-ka. Qaramada Midoobay iyo dalalka reer Galbeedka ayaa Rwanda ku eedeeya inay taageero militari siiso kooxda M23, isla markaana ay saameyn toos ah ku leedahay hoggaankeeda iyo howlgalladeeda. Rwanda ayaa si joogto ah u beenisa eedeymahaas. Dagaallada ayaa si weyn u xoogaystay horraantii 2025, markaas oo fallaagada M23 ay qabsatay dhul ballaaran oo ku yaalla bariga Congo. Dhanka kale, dhaawaca Tim Kennedy ayaa soo jiitay indhaha warbaahinta Mareykanka, maadaama uu yahay dagaalyahan hore oo UFC ah, isla markaana leh barnaamijyo caan ah oo internet-ka laga daawado iyo malaayiin taageerayaal ah oo baraha bulshada ku xiran. Kennedy, oo ah aabbe leh afar carruur ah, ayaa si joogto ah uga hadla arrimaha siyaasadda, dhaqanka iyo tababarka jirka. Hase yeeshee, ma uusan shaacin faahfaahin ku saabsan safarkiisa Congo ka hor weerarka. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka iyo isbitaalka Walter Reed ayaa ka gaabsaday inay ka hadlaan dhaawaciisa, halka waalidkiis aysan ka jawaabin codsiyo loo diray. Ilo amni oo Congo ka tirsan ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dadka deegaanka ay suurtagal tahay inay ku jiraan dadkii ku dhintay ama ku dhaawacmay weerarka. Shirkadda Vectus Global ayaa ka gaabsatay inay ka hadasho dhacdada, halka ilo xog-ogaal ah ay sheegeen in tani ay tahay markii ugu horreysay ee shirkaddu khasaare noocan ah kala kulanto howlgalladeeda Congo. Doorka shirkadda Erik Prince ee Congo Erik Prince ayaa markii hore Congo u tegay heshiis la xiriira sugidda amniga iyo hagaajinta dakhliga dowladda ka soo gala macdanta, oo ah il dhaqaale oo muhiim ah, balse muddo tobannaan sano ah ay saameeyeen boob, tahriib iyo colaado hubeysan. Hase yeeshee, howlaha shirkaddiisa ayaa markii dambe ka gudbay ilaalinta dakhliga macdanta, iyagoo gaaray taageerada amniga iyo howlgallada ka socda goobaha dagaalka. Bilihii January iyo February ee sanadkan, ciidamo ka tirsan Vectus Global ayaa la geeyey magaalada istaraatiijiga ah ee Uvira, oo ku taalla gobolka South Kivu, kaddib markii Mareykanku gacan ka geystay heshiis lagu doonayey in fallaagada M23 ee Rwanda taageerto ay uga baxdo magaalada. Ciidamada Prince ayaa xilligaas ka caawiyey militariga Congo sugidda amniga Uvira, iyadoo fallaagada M23 ay weli gacanta ku hayso dhul ballaaran oo ku yaalla bariga dalka. Lama oga tirada guud ee ciidamada iyo shaqaalaha amniga ee Prince uu ka hawlgeliyey Congo, balse weerarkii September ayaa muujinaya khatarta ay wajahayaan ciidamada shisheeye ee ka qayb qaadanaya colaadda. Prince ayaa hore u aasaasay shirkaddii militariga gaarka loo lahaa ee Blackwater, taas oo sumcad-xumo weyn kala kulantay howlgalladii ay ka fulisay Ciraaq. Qaar ka mid ah shaqaalaheeda oo lagu helay dilka dad rayid ah oo Ciraaqiyiin ah ayaa cafis ka helay Trump sanadkii 2020. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa hore u sheegtay inaysan wax heshiis ah Congo kula lahayn Prince. Si kastaba, saraakiil Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay inay qorsheynayaan inay xiriir dhow la yeeshaan shirkadda Vectus Global marka ay timaaddo howlgallada Haiti. Colaadda Congo iyo faragelinta Rwanda Weerarkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya iyadoo dadaallada Mareykanku uu ku doonayo inuu ku soo afjaro colaadda bariga Congo ay weli wajahayaan caqabado waaweyn. Maamulka Trump ayaa dhexdhexaadiyey heshiisyo lagu doonayo in lagu yareeyo xiisadda u dhexeysa Congo iyo Rwanda, iyadoo heshiiska bixitaanka fallaagada M23 ee Uvira uu qayb ka ahaa dadaalladaas. Hase yeeshee, colaadda ayaa weli ka taagan qaybo badan oo bariga Congo ah, gaar ahaan deegaannada hodanka ku ah macdanta qaaliga ah ee ay ka mid yihiin dahabka, lithium-ka iyo tantalum-ka. Qaramada Midoobay iyo dalalka reer Galbeedka ayaa Rwanda ku eedeeya inay taageero militari siiso kooxda M23, isla markaana ay saameyn toos ah ku leedahay hoggaankeeda iyo howlgalladeeda. Rwanda ayaa si joogto ah u beenisa eedeymahaas. Dagaallada ayaa si weyn u xoogaystay horraantii 2025, markaas oo fallaagada M23 ay qabsatay dhul ballaaran oo ku yaalla bariga Congo. Dhanka kale, dhaawaca Tim Kennedy ayaa soo jiitay indhaha warbaahinta Mareykanka, maadaama uu yahay dagaalyahan hore oo UFC ah, isla markaana leh barnaamijyo caan ah oo internet-ka laga daawado iyo malaayiin taageerayaal ah oo baraha bulshada ku xiran. Kennedy, oo ah aabbe leh afar carruur ah, ayaa si joogto ah uga hadla arrimaha siyaasadda, dhaqanka iyo tababarka jirka. Hase yeeshee, ma uusan shaacin faahfaahin ku saabsan safarkiisa Congo ka hor weerarka. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka iyo isbitaalka Walter Reed ayaa ka gaabsaday inay ka hadlaan dhaawaciisa, halka waalidkiis aysan ka jawaabin codsiyo loo diray. items.title: Nolol xumo iyo dayac nadaafadeed oo haysta 500 qoys oo la dajiyay duleedka Hargaysa
items.description: (ERGO) – Xaalada caafimaad darro ah oo ka dhalatay nadaafad xumo uu ku sababay qashin lagu aruuriyo halka ay degan yihiin ayay wajahayaan in ka badan 500 oo qoys oo ku nool xerada Qasaali oo 20 km dhanka bariga ka xigta Hargaysa. Waxaa u wehliya cuno xumo iyo daruufo kale. Xaaladaan waxay wajahayaan illaa bishii June, markaas oo dowlada hoose siisay dhul u dhow goobta la geeyo qarashinka, dhiiga iyo uuska xoolaha la qalo. Cudurro aysan horay u qabin oo ay isku arkeen ayay aaminsan yihiin in ay ka qaadeen, balse ma aysan helin baaritaan iyo daaweyn. Dadka ay caqabadaan haysato waxaa ka mid ah qoyska Aamina Cawl Xirsi. Waxay sheegtay in iyada iyo carruurteedu ay 2 bil ee u danbaysay iskugu darsameen shuban, kor cuncun, qufac iyo qandho aysan welli ka bogsoon. Qarash ay isbitaal ku tagan ma awoodo xeradana kuma yaallo. Waxay sheegtay inaysan jirin dhaqaatiir ku xaqiijisay cudurrada haya ama la tacaashay, balse ay calaamadaha isku arkeen. “Diqsi iyo masas ayaa nooga soo baxa oo cabsi ayaan ku jirnaa. Subax kasta waa lagu soo shubaa. Waxaa nagu dhacay shuban iyo xasaasiyad. 60 jir ayaan ahay awoodii waa iga tagtay xanuunka awgiis.” Waxay ku nool yihiin buushash yar yar oo kaabiga ku haya qashin qubka ugu weyn Hargaysa. Diqsiga ka soo duula ayaa ku dega weelasha, cunnada iyo dushooda, waxaana u dheer ur badan oo aan loo adkaysan karin. Aamina ayaa sheegtay in ay ka joogsadeen shaqooyin dhar-dhaqid ah oo noloshooda ay ka maarayn jirtay. Waxaa isku raacay meesha la geeyay oo ka durugsan magaalada Hargaysa oo ay ka xamaalan jirtay iyo xanuunka saameeyay oo tabar la’aan ku sababay. Waxay kali ku tahay korriinada 7 carruur ah oo uu dhalay wiilkeeda uu horay u geeriyooday. Ma lahana ehel taageera iyo meel uu dhaqaale ka soo galo midna. Culaysyadaan isku raacay ayaa u horseeday in ay wajahayaan xaalad adag oo cunno xumo ah. Aamina ayaa sheegtay in 24 saac ay hal mar karsadaan nus kiilo raashin ah oo dariska dhaama ay marmar ku caawiyaan, maalinkii aysan ka helin ayay xustay in ay wajahayaan gaajo iyo murug. “Saaka rooti yar ayay ii keentay gabadh dariska ah. Maanta oo dhan waxba ma aanan karsan, caawana ma hayno, walal iyo wiil midna ma lihi. Cid I caawisa oo aan ilaahay ahayn ma jirto.” Aamina ayaa sheegtay in xerada ay degan yihiin aysan lahan ceel-biyood. Waxay Toddobaadka dhan isku celceliyaan 40 liitar oo khamiis walba ay u keento waasaaradda dib u dajinta Soomaaliland, kuwaas oo aan ku filnayn. Waxaa intaas u dheer in ay dhamaan ilmaheedu waxbarasho la’aaan yihiin. Waxay sheegtay in xeradu aysan lahayn xarun iskuul, aysanna hayn qarash ay ku gayso kuwo magaalada ku yaalla. Waxay ku nool yihiin hal buul oo ka samaysan maryo duug ah iyo geedo aan roobka iyo qoraxda ka celin karin, sidoo kalena cariir ku ah. Waxay sheegtay in marka ay dabaysho ku dhacdo ay si sahlan u dubaan oo ay dib dib u dhisto maalin kasta. “Markii aan magaalada u dhowayn carruurtu iskuul iyo dugsi bilaasha ah ayay ii dhigan jireen, balse hadda waa ka joogsatay oo gaari raaca uma helayo. Qofkiiba $1. Toddobada carruurtaa haddii aan dirayo waa in aan $7 bixiyaana mana hayo.” Aamina ayaa sheegtay in xerada Naasa-hablood oo ay ku noolaayeen 17 sano ay ka helayeen waxbarashada carruurta, suuq iyo shaqo marmar ay ka heli jireen shaqooyin nadaafad ah. Dowlada hoose ee Hargaysa ayaa ka soo rartay, markii dadkii dhulka lahaa ay codsadeen in loo baneeyo. Waxaa qoyskasta la siiyay 19 mitir oo dheerar iyo ballac ah. Waxay la’yihiin awood ay ku dhistaan iyo adeegyadii aas-aasiga ahaa, magaaladana waa ka fog yihiin Dowlada hoose oo dhibaatada dadkaan aan la wadaagnay ayaa ka gaabsatay in ay faahfahin ka bixiso, balse waxay sheetgay in shirkadda Maandeeq oo qaabilsan qallitaanka xoolaha iyo maaraynta wasaqda ay masuul ka tahay goobta laga cabanayo, ayna ka filayaan in ay xaliyaan. Dhanka kale madaxda shirkaddaan oo aan la xiriirnay ayaa sheegay in goobtaan ay qorshaysay dowlada hoose, balse waxay diideen in ay ka jawaabana cabashada qoysaskaan. Qoyska Ifraax Haybe Warsame oo toddoba qof ah ayaa ka mid ah dadka ay saamaysay nadaafad xumada ka jirta xerada Qasaali. Waxay sheegtay in cudurrada ka dhashay urka ay u dheer yihiin xayawaano dhiiga soo raacay oo qaarkood ay carruurta iyo dadka waa weyn soo weerarayaan. Waxay sidoo kale cariiri ku qabaan musqulaha. Dadka oo badan iyo dhamaan adeegyada aas-aasiga ah oo aan meesha ka jirin iyo caqabada ka dhigay mid weyn. Waxay sheegtay in qofkii banaanka u baxa ay waraabeyaal soo weerarayaan. “Suuli gaar ah ma lihin oo boqollaal qoys ayaa 3 xabo wadaagaya. Diqsigii ka soo baxa wuxuu galaya weelkii ilmuhu wax ku cunayeen, waana ku shumeen. Ifraax waxay la nooshahay cudurka sonkorowga oo dhaqaatiirtu ku xaqiijisay waqti hore. Waxay sheegtay in aysan iibsan karin daawada kaalmaatigaa oo ay joogto ugu baahan tahay. Ifraax Haybe Warsame oo hor taagan buush yar oo ay ka degan tahay xerada Qasaali Marmar ayay $1 ama $2 ka hesha qaraabo ay u dan sheegato, taas oo ay u qabiso kaniinkeeda iyo wax ay hal mar u cunaan carruurtu. Maalmaha aysan waxba ka helin waxay sheegtay in ay sonkortu ku kacdo. Carruurtana aan dabka loo shidin. Xaaladaan adag ayay kali ku tahay. Ilameedu waa agoon waana yar yar aan shaqayn karin. Markay roonaato waxay u lugayso magaalada Hargaysa oo ka durugsan si ay uga soo raadisho shaqooyin nadaafad ah. Inta badan galabtii ayay dib u soo laabataa iyadoo aan waxba soo helin. Fursadaha oo yar iyo shaqo doonka oo badan ayay u sababaysay. “Gaajo ayaa loo baqtinayaa. Ilamaha qaar ayaan istaagi karin nafaqo xumo ayaa ka muuqata. Cudurro iyo tabar xumo ayaa iskukaaya raacay, markii cunno dheeli tiran la waayay.” Ifraax ayaa sheegtay in ay ku adag tahay helitaanka biyaha. Waxay tashiishtaan 3 labaatan qaad oo toddobaadkii ay hal mar u shubaan booyada ay u keento wasaaradda dib u dajinta Soomaaaliland. Waxay degan yihiin buur korkeed oo aysan baabuurtu soo gali karin. Arintaas ayaa ku qasabtay in ay dusheeda ku soo qaado biyaha yar ee lagu caawiyo. Waxay kala kulantaa daal, dhabar xanuun iyo culays badan. Dhib kasta oo ay ka marto haddana kuma filna qoyskeeda oo sagaal qof ah, balse doorasho kale ma lahan. Qoyskeeda ayaa sanadkii 2009 ka yimid miyiga deeganka Salaxley, markii ay roob la’aan iyo cudurro isku raacay uga dhamaadeen 80 ari ah oo noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd. Dhanka kale dhaqtar Cabdirashiid Cabdiraxmaan oo ka howlgala isbitaallka Mahdi ee magaalada Hargaysa ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in cayayaanka ka soo duula wasaqda, urta iyo qashinka yar yar ee ay dabayshu qaadayso ay si fudud u gudbin karana cudurro kala duwan. “Diqsiga cagaaran wuxuu gudbin karaa xanuun halis ah oo ku dhaca mindhicirka, caloosha iyo sambabada. Cudurkaas wuu faafi karaa dhimasho ayuuna sababi karaa. Maalin kasta waxaa la ii kulanaa carruur shuban deg deg ah ku dhacay waana nadaaf xumada.” Wuxuu tilmaamay in ay muhiim tahay in qashinka laga fogeeyo meelaha ay dadku ku nool yihiin, in lagu ku dadaalo isticmaalka biyo nadiif, jeermis dileyaal iyo agabyada nadiifinta intii. Qashinka aan si wanaagsan loo marayn iyo haraaga xoolaha dhintay waxay saamayn caafimaad ku yeelan karaan nolosha dadka iyo deegaanka, iyagoo sababi kara faafitaanka jeermiska, wasakheynta hawada, biyaha iyo in ay soo raacaan xayawaano waxyeelo gaysan kara. items.title: Falcelin xooggan oo ka dhalatay xiisadda ka dhex-qaraxday Shariif iyo DF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Falcelin xooggan iyo hadal-heyn ayaa ka dhalatay xiisadda cusub ee ka dhex-qaraxday Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo madaxweynihii hore ee dowladdii ku-meel-gaarka ahayd, Mudane Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed, kadib markii dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo u dhexeeya labada dhinac laga dareemay gudaha magaalada Muqdisho. Hay’adda NISA oo warsaxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa eedeyn u jeedisay Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka, iyada oo shaaca ka qaaday in maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo ka amar qaata ay isku dayeen inay isk hor imaad ku riixaan ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa ilaalada shacabka ee Hay’adda, xilli ay ku sugnaayeen degmada Wadajir ee Gobolk Banaadir. Qoraalka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in ciidamada Dharcadda ay muujiyeen feejignaan iyo xilkasnimo, isa markaana ay ka fogaadeen tallaabo kasta oo horseedi kartay gacan ka hadal iyo in lagu kor dagaalamo dadka shacabka ee aan waxba galabsan. “Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) waxa ay ka xun tahay, si adagna u cambaareyneysaa weerarrada iyo falalka hubeysan ee lagula kacay ciidamada Ilaalada Shacabka ee Hay’adda, kuwaas oo ka howlgalayay Laanta Koowaad ee Waaxda General Daa’uud, degmada Wadajir ee Gobolka Banaadir. Falalkan, oo ay ku lug leeyihiin maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo ka amar qaata Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Shariif Sheekh Axmed,” ayay tiri Hay’adda NISA. Dhankiisa Sheekh Shariif oo ka falceliyay arrintan ayaa si adag u beeniyay sheegashada NISA, isaga oo tilmaamay in eedeymaha loo jeediyay ilaaladiisa ay yihiin kuwa waxba kama jiraan ah, wuxuuna sidoo kale soo bandhigay tabasho uu qabo iyo dhaliil uu u jeediyay dowladda. “Waxaan caddeynaynaa in sheegashadaasi aysan ka tarjumayn xaqiiqada dhacdooyin tixane ah oo lagu khal-khalgalinayay deegaanka Madaxweyne Shariif Sheekh Axmed, iyadoo si gaar ah aan uga digayno warbixinnada looga danleeyahay marin-habaabinta shacabka Soomaaliyeed ama sumcad-dilka siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka,” ayuu ku jawaabay Shariif. Haddaba sidee looga falceliyay xiisadda cusub ee ka dhex-qaraxay Shariif iyo DF? Xamda Xasan Axmed: “Weerar ka guryaha mucaaradka nabee waa la baneystay tan fuusto wa dhaaaftay”. Xuseen Xamaas: “Dowladnima ayaa shaqeyneyso wixii ka horyimaadana tallaabo ha laga qaado”. Haashim Cali Muuke: “Naftaada inaad difaacato goormay dembi noqotay?”. Cabdinaasir Abuukar Bajaali: “Sharciga ma aha wax Facebook lagu baahiyo ee qabta ha sugina intuu dad ka dilaayee”. Mahad Aadan Buulle: “Qiil iidin ma noqoneyso taas ee iska cadeysta waxaa rabtiin”. items.title: Xiisadda ka soo korortay Muqdisho oo walaac ku haysa shacabka
items.description: Shacabka ku dhaqan Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa ka cabsi qaba in uu dagaal ka qarxo magaaladaasi, xilli Dowladda Federaalka ay ciidamo dul dhigtay guryaha Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka. Laamaha amniga ayaa ciidamo iyo gaadiid dagaal geeyay agagaarka guryaha xubno ka mid ah Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka ee ku yaala nawaaxiga Garoonka Diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde, taasoo dhalisay cabsi la xiriirta inuu dagaal ka qarxo magaalada. Xiisadda amni ee ka soo korortay magaala madaxda dalka ayaa salka ku haysa is mari-waaga muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ka taagnaa arrimaha doorashooyinka dalka ee u dhexeeya Villa Somalia iyo Xubnaha Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ee ka aragtida duwan Dowladda Federaalka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in mucaaradku ay dhankooda wadaan abaabul ciidan, si ay uga hortaggaan khatarta weerar abaabulan. Mucaaradka waxay ka digeen in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu qaadi doono, wixii cawaaqib ah ee ka dhasha daandaansi ay ku eedeeyeen in ay dowladdiisu waddo. Hadal hayn xoog leh ayaa ka dhalatay dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidan ee ka soo cusboonaaday magaalada, iyadoo dadku ay weli xusuustaan dagaalkii labada dhinac horaantii bishii June ku dhex maray caasimadda. Dadka dhaliila siyaasadda Villa Somalia ayaa Dowladda Federaalka ku dhalleeceeyay inay ku kaceyso marin habaabin iyo cadaadis siyaasadeed, isla-markaana ay masuul ka noqon doonto wax kasta oo ka dhasha xiisaddan. Dadka reer Muqdisho ayaa kuu sheegaya in ifafaalaha jira ay muujinayaan in dagaal uu soo socdo, haddii xaaladdu ay sidaan ku sii socoto. Shacabka ayaa waxay dareensan yihiin in loolanka u dhexeeya nidaamka talada haya iyo mucaaradka uu khatar gelin karo amniga iyo xasilloonida magaalada, si looga baaqsadana ay laga maarmaan tahay in laga heshiiyo, waxa asalka u ah khilaafka. Mar kasta oo ay adkaato in la xalliyo khilaafka ka dhex aloosan madaxda iyo siyaasiyiinta isku haya doorashooyinka dalka ayaa waxay si toos ah u saameysaa amniga iyo nolosha caadiga ah ee dadka reer Muqdisho. Marka ay meesha ka baxdo wada hadalka iyo tanaasulka, dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidana ay dadku dareemaan waxay furtaa albaabka ugu weyn ee cabsida, taas oo mararka qaar keenta iska horimaadyo u dhexeeya ciidamada amniga iyo xoogaga taageersan mucaaradka.

items.title: Shirweynaha 3aad ee Ururrada Bulshada Bariga Afrika oo Goor dhow ka Furmaya Muqdisho
items.description: Magaalada Muqdisho waxaa la filayaa inuu goor dhow ka furmo Shirweynaha 3-aad ee Ururrada Bulshada Rayidka ah ee Bulshada Bariga Afrika, EACCON 2026, kaas oo diiradda lagu saari doono xoojinta iskaashiga, horumarinta iyo doorka ururrada bulshada rayidka ah ee dalalka ku mideysan Ururka Bulshada Bariga Afrika. Shirkan ayaa la filayaa inay ka qaybgalaan mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, wakiillo ka socda ururrada bulshada rayidka ah ee dalka iyo xubno matalaya ururrada bulshada rayidka ah ee dalalka kale ee xubnaha ka ah ururka. Kulanka ayaa fursad u noqon doona ka qaybgalayaasha inay ka wada hadlaan arrimaha horumarinta, iskaashiga gobolka iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa doorka bulshada rayidka ah ee ka qayb qaadashada qorshayaasha horumarineed ee Bariga Afrika. Soomaaliya, oo xubin ka noqotay Ururka Bulshada Bariga Afrika, ayaa shirkan ku martigelinaysa Muqdisho xilli la doonayo in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka iyo iskaashiga dalalka gobolka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, adeegyada bulshada iyo horumarinta wadajirka ah.

items.title: Qiimaha shiidaalka ayaa hoos u dhacay kadib…..
items.description: Qiimaha shidaalka ayaa Isniintii hoos u dhacay, iyadoo la filayo in sahayda Shidaalka iyo waxyaabaha laga sameeyo ee Ruushku suuqyada u dhoofiyo ay korodho kaddib markii madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump uu shaaciyay in Ruushka iyo Ukraine ay ku heshiiyeen inay joojiyaan weerarrada ay isku hayaan xarumaha tamarta. Qiimaha Shidaalka cayriin ee Brent ayaa hoos u dhacay 1.54 doollar, oo u dhiganta 1.47%, isagoo gaaray 103.18 doollar halkii foosto. Sidoo kale, shidaalka cayriin ee West Texas Intermediate (WTI) ee Mareykanka ayaa hoos u dhacay 1.54 doollar, oo u dhiganta 1.68%, iyadoo gaartay 90.31 doollar halkii foosto. Donald Trump ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in Ruushku uu si degdeg ah suuqyada Mareykanka iyo kuwa caalamka u gaarsiin doono in ka badan 300,000 oo tan oo naafto ah, taas oo u dhiganta 2.25 milyan oo foosto. Sida uu sheegay Trump, Ruushku wuxuu bisha Nofeembar soo diri doonaa 500,000 oo tan oo kale, kaddibna hal milyan oo tan oo dheeraad ah. Trump ayaa sidoo kale Axaddii si lama filaan ah u shaaciyay in Ruushka iyo Ukraine ay ku heshiiyeen inay joojiyaan weerarrada ay ku qaadaan xarumaha tamarta ee dhinaca kale. Hase yeeshee, madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa sheegay inuu weli sugayo faahfaahinta heshiiska, halka Ruushku uusan weli ka hadlin arrintan.

items.title: Kumuu ahaa Maxamed Cawaale Liibaan: Ninkii Naqshadeeyay Calanka Soomaaliya ?
items.description: Maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 12-ka Oktoobar, Soomaaliya waxay xusaysaa Maalinta Calanka Qaranka, oo ah maalin xusuus gaar ah u leh taariikhda, midnimada iyo halgankii ay ummadda Soomaaliyeed u soo martay Madax-bannaanideeda. Maalintan waxaa si gaar ah loo xusuustaa Maxamed Cawaale Liibaan, oo ahaa aqoonyahan Soomaaliyeed oo naqshadeeyay calanka buluugga ah ee xiddigta cad dhexda ku leh, kaas oo noqday astaanta qarannimada Soomaaliya. Maxamed Cawaale Liibaan wuxuu ku dhashay magaalada Gaalkacyo sannadkii 1919-kii, xilli qaybo badan oo dhulka Soomaaliyeed ay ku hoos jireen maamullo gumeysi, waxaana lagu xusuustaa kaalintii uu ka qaatay samaynta astaan qaran oo muujinaysay himiladii Soomaalida ee midnimada iyo xorriyadda. Sannadkii 1954-kii ayuu naqshadeeyay calanka Soomaaliyeed, xilli dhaqdhaqaaqyada gobannimo-doonku ay sii xoogeysanayeen, waxaana calankaasi noqday astaan ay Soomaalidu ku muujiso aqoonsigeeda iyo rabitaankeeda dowladnimo. Calanka Soomaaliya wuxuu ka kooban yahay maro buluug khafiif ah iyo xiddig cad oo shan gees leh oo ku taalla bartamaha, ayadoo Xiddigta taariikh ahaan lala xiriiriyo shanta qaybood ee dhulka ay Soomaalida, kuwaas oo kala ah qeybtii Talyaanigu gumaysan jiray, Soomaalidii Ingiriisku gumaysan jiray, Jabuuti, Soomaali Galbeed iyo NFD oo maanta hoostagta Kenya. Arrintani waxay muujinaysay himiladii midnimada Soomaalida ee ku kala baahsanaa xuduudihii gumeysiga, waxaana Calanka la qaatay 12-kii Oktoobar 1954-kii, ayadoo markii dambe loo aqoonsaday astaanta rasmiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya markii dalka uu xornimada qaatay sannadkii 1960-kii. Maxamed Cawaale Liibaan kuma koobnayn oo keliya naqshadaynta calanka, balse wuxuu sidoo kale ka qayb qaatay maamulka dowladdii Soomaaliyeed ee curdinka ahayd. Intii u dhexeysay 1960-kii ilaa 1967-kii, wuxuu xil ka soo qabtay madaxtooyada Soomaaliya, xilligii madaxweyne Aadan Cabdulle Cismaan, oo loo yaqaanay Aadan Cadde. Sannadihii 1967-kii ilaa 1969-kii, xilligii madaxweyne Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke, Liibaan wuxuu ahaa agaasimaha guud ee shaqaalaha dowladda, xilkaas oo ahaa mid muhiim ah oo la xiriiray maamulka shaqaalaha rayidka ah. Sannadkii 1969-kii waxaa Soomaaliya ka dhacay afgambi militari oo soo afjaray nidaamkii dowladnimo ee rayidka ahaa, kaddibna dalka galay marxalad siyaasadeed oo cusub, Maxamed Cawaalana wuxuu ka fariistay shaqadii dowladda kaddib isbeddelkaas. Sannadkii 1991-kii, markii Soomaaliya ay gashay dagaal sokeeye oo sababay burburkii dowladdii dhexe, Maxamed Cawaale Liibaan wuxuu u haajiray dalka Kanada, asagoo markii dambe ku geeriyooday magaalada Toronto 5-tii Juun 2001-dii, xilligaas oo uu ahaa 82 jir. Inkasta oo uu geeriyooday in ka badan labaatan sano ka hor, haddana dhaxalkiisii ayaa weli muuqda, maadaama calankii uu naqshadeeyay uu yahay astaanta ugu weyn ee lagu aqoonsado qaranka Soomaaliyeed. Maalinta Calanka Soomaaliyeed, oo sanad kasta la xuso 12-ka Oktoobar, waxay fursad u tahay in dib loo milicsado taariikhda calanka iyo dadkii ka qayb qaatay samayntiisa. Calanku ma aha oo keliya maro buluug ah oo xiddig cad dhexda kaga taallo, balse waa astaan xambaarsan taariikh, halgan iyo himilooyinkii ay Soomaalidu u soo martay inay hesho dal madax-bannaan, halka Maxamed Cawaale Liibaan uu ka mid yahay shakhsiyaadka raadkoodu ku waari doono taariikhda dalka.

Calanka Soomaaliya wuxuu ka kooban yahay maro buluug khafiif ah iyo xiddig cad oo shan gees leh oo ku taalla bartamaha, ayadoo Xiddigta taariikh ahaan lala xiriiriyo shanta qaybood ee dhulka ay Soomaalida, kuwaas oo kala ah qeybtii Talyaanigu gumaysan jiray, Soomaalidii Ingiriisku gumaysan jiray, Jabuuti, Soomaali Galbeed iyo NFD oo maanta hoostagta Kenya. Arrintani waxay muujinaysay himiladii midnimada Soomaalida ee ku kala baahsanaa xuduudihii gumeysiga, waxaana Calanka la qaatay 12-kii Oktoobar 1954-kii, ayadoo markii dambe loo aqoonsaday astaanta rasmiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya markii dalka uu xornimada qaatay sannadkii 1960-kii. Maxamed Cawaale Liibaan kuma koobnayn oo keliya naqshadaynta calanka, balse wuxuu sidoo kale ka qayb qaatay maamulka dowladdii Soomaaliyeed ee curdinka ahayd. Intii u dhexeysay 1960-kii ilaa 1967-kii, wuxuu xil ka soo qabtay madaxtooyada Soomaaliya, xilligii madaxweyne Aadan Cabdulle Cismaan, oo loo yaqaanay Aadan Cadde. Sannadihii 1967-kii ilaa 1969-kii, xilligii madaxweyne Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke, Liibaan wuxuu ahaa agaasimaha guud ee shaqaalaha dowladda, xilkaas oo ahaa mid muhiim ah oo la xiriiray maamulka shaqaalaha rayidka ah. Sannadkii 1969-kii waxaa Soomaaliya ka dhacay afgambi militari oo soo afjaray nidaamkii dowladnimo ee rayidka ahaa, kaddibna dalka galay marxalad siyaasadeed oo cusub, Maxamed Cawaalana wuxuu ka fariistay shaqadii dowladda kaddib isbeddelkaas. Sannadkii 1991-kii, markii Soomaaliya ay gashay dagaal sokeeye oo sababay burburkii dowladdii dhexe, Maxamed Cawaale Liibaan wuxuu u haajiray dalka Kanada, asagoo markii dambe ku geeriyooday magaalada Toronto 5-tii Juun 2001-dii, xilligaas oo uu ahaa 82 jir. Inkasta oo uu geeriyooday in ka badan labaatan sano ka hor, haddana dhaxalkiisii ayaa weli muuqda, maadaama calankii uu naqshadeeyay uu yahay astaanta ugu weyn ee lagu aqoonsado qaranka Soomaaliyeed. Maalinta Calanka Soomaaliyeed, oo sanad kasta la xuso 12-ka Oktoobar, waxay fursad u tahay in dib loo milicsado taariikhda calanka iyo dadkii ka qayb qaatay samayntiisa. Calanku ma aha oo keliya maro buluug ah oo xiddig cad dhexda kaga taallo, balse waa astaan xambaarsan taariikh, halgan iyo himilooyinkii ay Soomaalidu u soo martay inay hesho dal madax-bannaan, halka Maxamed Cawaale Liibaan uu ka mid yahay shakhsiyaadka raadkoodu ku waari doono taariikhda dalka.

items.title: Midowga Afrika oo War Ka Soo saaray Geerida 109 Qof oo Tahriibayaal ah oo Dooni kula Degtay Xeebaha Jabuuti
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf, ayaa muujiyay murugo xooggan oo ku aaddan geerida 109 qof oo tahriibayaal ah, oo ay carruur ku jiraan, kaddib markii doon ay la socdeen ay kula degtay xeebaha dalka Jabuuti. Guddoomiyaha ayaa tacsi u diray qoysaska iyo ehellada dadkii ku naf waayay shilka, isagoo sidoo kale muujiyay garab istaaggiisa dhammaan dadka ay musiibadani saamaysay. Bayaan uu soo saaray Midowga Afrika ayuu Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf ku adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in la xoojiyo iskaashiga dalalka gobolka iyo beesha caalamka, si wax looga qabto sababaha asaasiga ah ee dadka ku riixa tahriibka sharci-darrada ah. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku baaqay in la xoojiyo dadaallada lagula dagaallamayo tahriibinta dadka iyo ka ganacsiga bani’aadamka, kuwaas oo khatar weyn ku haya nolosha dadka safarrada halista ah u gala raadinta nolol ka wanaagsan tan ay ku nool yihiin. Guddoomiyaha ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la helo waddooyin ammaan ah, nidaamsan oo sharci ah oo ay dadku u mari karaan socdaalka, si loo yareeyo khataraha ay wajahayaan dadka u tahriibaya dalal kale. Musiibadan ayaa mar kale iftiiminaysa khatarta ay dadka tahriibayaasha ahi kala kulmaan safarrada badda, gaar ahaan marka ay raacaan doonyo aan u qalabaysnayn qaadista dad badan, taas oo kordhisa halista inay ku degaan ama ay ku dhacaan shilal dhimasho sababa. Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf ayaa sidoo kale dib u xaqiijiyay sida Midowga Afrika uga go’an tahay inuu la shaqeeyo dowladaha xubnaha ka ah ururka iyo hay’adaha ay wada shaqeeyaan, si loo ilaaliyo nolosha iyo karaamada muhaajiriinta, gaar ahaan dadka nugul sida carruurta. Waxa uu tilmaamay in loo baahan yahay dadaallo wadajir ah oo lagu hortagayo musiibooyinka noocan oo kale ah, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo ilaalinta dadka safarrada tahriibka ah gala, la dagaallanka shabakadaha dadka tahriibiya iyo wax ka qabashada duruufaha dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee ku khasba dad badan inay galaan safarro halis ah. Bayaanka Midowga Afrika ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan walaacyada laga qabo khasaaraha nafeed ee ka dhasha tahriibka, gaar ahaan marinnada badda ee Geeska Afrika, halkaas oo dad badan ay isku dayaan inay ku gaaraan dalal kale iyagoo raadinaya shaqo, amni iyo nolol ka wanaagsan. Midowga Afrika ayaa ku baaqay in dowladaha gobolka iyo beesha caalamku ay xoojiyaan iskaashiga iyo tallaabooyinka wax ku oolka ah ee lagu badbaadinayo nolosha muhaajiriinta, laguna xaqiijinayo in dadka doonaya inay dalal kale u safraan ay helaan waddooyin ammaan ah oo sharci ah.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Mudnaan Siinaysa Khayraadka Shidaalka iyo Gaaska
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso horumarinta khayraadka shidaalka iyo gaaska dabiiciga ah, soo jiidashada maalgashiga caalamiga ah iyo xoojinta iskaashiga istaraatiijiga ah, si loo kobciyo dhaqaalaha dalka loona horumariyo waaxda tamarta. Dowladdu waxay sheegtay in ka faa’iidaysiga khayraadka dabiiciga ah uu ka mid yahay fursadaha muhiimka ah ee Soomaaliya u leedahay kobcinta dhaqaalaha, abuurista fursado shaqo iyo kordhinta dakhliga qaranka. Waxaana la doonayaa in la helo maalgashi caalami ah oo gacan ka geysta sahminta, horumarinta iyo ka faa’iidaysiga khayraadka shidaalka iyo gaaska. Sidoo kale, dowladda ayaa xoogga saaraysa xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay shirkadaha caalamiga ah iyo dhinacyada kale ee ku lugta leh waaxda tamarta, si loo helo khibrad farsamo, tiknoolajiyad casri ah iyo maalgelin suuragelin karta horumarinta khayraadka dalka. Horumarinta waaxda shidaalka iyo gaaska ayaa ah fursad wax ku ool ah oo Soomaaliya uga faa’iidaysan karto khayraadkeeda dabiiciga ah, iyadoo laga duulayo baahida loo qabo koboc dhaqaale oo waara iyo horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ka faa’iidaysiga khayraadkan wuxuu u baahan yahay hannaan maamul oo hufan, sharciyo cad, ilaalinta deegaanka iyo in bulshada Soomaaliyeed ay si muuqata uga faa’iidaysato dakhliga ka soo baxa khayraadka dalka.

items.title: Kuuriyada Waqooyi oo Tijaabisay Gantaallo Cusub
items.description: Dowladda Kuuriyada Waqooyi ayaa tijaabisay gantaallo cusub oo kuwa ballistic-ga ah, tallaabadaas oo sii kordhinaysa xiisadda amni ee ka taagan Bariga Aasiya, isla markaana walaac ku abuurtay dalalka deriska la ah, gaar ahaan Japan iyo Kuuriyada Koonfureed. Tijaabadan ayaa ku soo aadaysa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan loollanka milatari iyo tartanka hubka ee gobolka, iyadoo Kuuriyada Waqooyi ay dadaal ugu jirto horumarinta awooddeeda gantaallada, halka Kuuriyada Koonfureed iyo Japan ay si dhow ula socdaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada milatari ee Pyongyang. Milatariga Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaa sheegay in gantaallada laga soo riday agagaarka caasimadda Pyongyang, kuwaas oo loo diray dhanka badda ee xeebta bari ee Kuuriyada Waqooyi. Wararka laga helay mas’uuliyiinta gobolka ayaa tilmaamaya in gantaallada la arkay ay duuleen masaafo boqolaal kiiloomitir ah ka hor inta aysan ku dhicin badda. Dowladda Japan ayaa iyaduna sheegtay inay ogaatay gantaallo la rumeysan yahay inay ka yimaadeen Kuuriyada Waqooyi, iyadoo hay’adaha amniga ee labada dal ay bilaabeen falanqaynta xogta la xiriirta jihada, masaafada iyo nooca hubka la tijaabiyay. Tallaabadan ayaa dhalisay walaac cusub oo ku saabsan amniga gobolka, maadaama Kuuriyada Waqooyi ay muddo dheer horumarinaysay gantaallo awood u leh inay qaadaan madaxyo nukliyeer, kuwaas oo khatar ku noqon kara dalalka ku dhow haddii xiisadda siyaasadeed isu beddesho iska horimaad milatari. Gantaallada casriga ah, gaar ahaan kuwa ku socda xawaare aad u sarreeya ama awood u leh inay beddelaan jihada duulimaadkooda, ayaa caqabad ku noqon kara nidaamyada difaaca ee loogu talagalay in lagu ogaado laguna qabto gantaallada weerarka ah. Hoggaamiyaha Kuuriyada Waqooyi, Kim Jong Un, ayaa muddooyinkii dambe xoogga saarayay horumarinta awoodda milatari ee dalkiisa, gaar ahaan gantaallada ballistic-ga iyo hubka istaraatiijiga ah. Dowladda Pyongyang ayaa tijaabooyinkan ku tilmaantay qayb ka mid ah dadaalladeeda lagu xoojinayo awoodda difaaca dalka, halka dalalka kale ee gobolka ay u arkaan tallaabo kordhin karta khatarta amni.
