items.title: DF oo shaacisay mowqifkeeda xiisadda Itoobiya iyo Eritrea
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay dhexdhexaad ka tahay xiisadda sii xoogeysaneysa ee u dhexeysa Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, iyadoo caddeysay inaysan waxba iska beddelin xiriirka ay la leedahay labada dal, inkastoo ay sii kordhayaan walaacyada laga qabo dagaal ballaaran oo ka qarxa Geeska Afrika. Wasiir ku-xigeenka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Xasan Maxamed Cali Nadaara, oo wareysi siiyay BBC-da, ayaa sheegay in mowqifka Muqdisho uu ku dhisan yahay nabad, dhexdhexaadnimo iyo ilaalinta xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka gobolka, kuwaas oo Soomaaliya ay ka dhexeeyaan dano siyaasadeed, dhaqaale iyo amni. Wuxuu tilmaamay in Soomaaliya aysan dooneyn inay qayb ka noqoto khilaafaadka gobolka, balse ay si dhow ula socoto isbeddellada socda, isla markaana ay ka shaqeyneyso sidii looga hortagi lahaa in colaadaha jira ay sii fidaan. Wasiir ku-xigeenka ayaa sidoo kale meesha ka saaray aragtida ah in Soomaaliya ay dhinac la safatay Masar iyo Eritrea, kaddib shirkii afarta geesoodka ahaa ee dhowaan ka dhacay dalka Masar, kaas oo ay ka qeybgaleen madaxda Soomaaliya, Masar, Eritrea iyo Suudaan. Isagoo ka jawaabayay su’aal ku saabsan in Soomaaliya ay dhab ahaantii dhexdhexaad ka tahay khilaafka, ayuu ku adkeystay in Muqdisho ay xiriir wanaagsan la leedahay dhammaan dalalka ay xiisaduhu ka dhex taagan yihiin. “Soomaaliya dhexdhexaad ayey ka tahay arrintaas,” ayuu yiri wasiir ku-xigeenka, isagoo intaas ku daray inaysan jirin wax isbeddel ah oo ku yimid xiriirka wanaagsan ee Soomaaliya kala dhexeeya dalalkaas. Bayaanka shirkii Al-Alamein Hadalka wasiir ku-xigeenka ayaa imanaya toddobaad kaddib markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu 4-tii Oktoobar magaalada Al-Alamein kula kulmay madaxda Masar, Eritrea iyo Suudaan, xilli xiriirka dalalkaas iyo Itoobiya uu marayo marxalad xasaasi ah. Shirkaas ayaa laga soo saaray bayaan wadajir ah oo lagu adkeeyay ilaalinta madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee dalalka gobolka, iyadoo sidoo kale lagu sheegay in maamulka Badda Cas uu yahay mas’uuliyad u gaar ah dalalka xeebaha ku leh. Bayaanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu taageeray mowqifyo la xiriira isticmaalka biyaha webiga Niil, gaar ahaan diidmada tallaabooyinka hal dhinac ah ee waxyeellayn kara danaha Masar iyo Suudaan, kuwaas oo muddo dheer isku hayay Itoobiya biyo-xireenka weyn ee ay ka dhistay webiga Niil. Qodobadan ayaa dhaliyay su’aalo ku saabsan dhexdhexaadnimada Soomaaliya, maadaama ay taabanayaan arrimo ay Itoobiya isku hayaan dalalka kale ee shirka ka qeybgalay. Axmed Kaboole, oo ka faallooda arrimaha ammaanka, ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in ka qeybgalka Soomaaliya ee shirka Masar uu muujinayo kala duwanaansho u dhexeeya hadalka dowladda iyo tallaabooyinka ay diblomaasiyad ahaan qaadday. Sidoo kale, Prof. Liibaan Cigaal, oo ka faallooda siyaasadda Geeska Afrika, ayaa sheegay inay habbooneyd in Soomaaliya ay ku ekaato arrimaha amniga gobolka, kana fogaato khilaafaadka isku murugsan ee u dhexeeya Masar, Eritrea, Suudaan iyo Itoobiya. Hase yeeshee, wasiir ku-xigeenka arrimaha dibadda ayaa diiday aragtidaas, isagoo ku dooday in Soomaaliya ay tahay dal madax-bannaan oo xaq u leh inuu xiriir iyo heshiisyo la yeesho dalalka kala duwan, isla markaana xiriirradaasi aysan ka dhignayn inay dhinac ka noqoneyso khilaafaadkooda. Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya Dhanka kale, wasiir ku-xigeenka ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay xaaladda xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya, isagoo sheegay inaysan hadda jirin wax dhibaato ah oo u dhexeeya labada dowladood. Wuxuu xusay in ciidamada Itoobiya ay weli qeyb ka yihiin howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay sii wadaan wada-shaqeyntii amni ee ay la lahaayeen dowladda federaalka. Hadalkaas ayaa ku soo aadaya iyadoo warar ay baahiyeen qaar ka mid ah warbaahinta gudaha ay sheegayaan inay suuragal tahay in ciidamada Itoobiya laga saaro Soomaaliya, sababo la xiriira dagaallada dib uga qarxay waqooyiga dalkaas. items.fullContent: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay dhexdhexaad ka tahay xiisadda sii xoogeysaneysa ee u dhexeysa Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, iyadoo caddeysay inaysan waxba iska beddelin xiriirka ay la leedahay labada dal, inkastoo ay sii kordhayaan walaacyada laga qabo dagaal ballaaran oo ka qarxa Geeska Afrika. Wasiir ku-xigeenka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Xasan Maxamed Cali Nadaara, oo wareysi siiyay BBC-da, ayaa sheegay in mowqifka Muqdisho uu ku dhisan yahay nabad, dhexdhexaadnimo iyo ilaalinta xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka gobolka, kuwaas oo Soomaaliya ay ka dhexeeyaan dano siyaasadeed, dhaqaale iyo amni. Wuxuu tilmaamay in Soomaaliya aysan dooneyn inay qayb ka noqoto khilaafaadka gobolka, balse ay si dhow ula socoto isbeddellada socda, isla markaana ay ka shaqeyneyso sidii looga hortagi lahaa in colaadaha jira ay sii fidaan. items.title: Warbaahinta Dunida oo Hadal-haysa Hooyo Soomaaliyeed oo 3 maalmood u Lugaynaysay si ay Daawo ugu Hesho Gabadheeda
items.description: Warbaahinta Dunida ayaa si weyn u hadal-haysa Hooyo Soomaaliyeed oo muddo saddex maalmood ah lugaynaysay, iyadoo sidata gabadheeda oo saddex jir ah, si ay u gaarsiiso isbitaal ku yaalla magaalada Kismaayo, kaddib markii xaaladda caafimaad ee ilmaha ay aad u liidatay, isla markaana ay u baahatay daryeel caafimaad oo aan laga heli karin deegaankooda. Hooyadan oo lagu magacaabo Xaliimo Cabdullaahi Ibraahim ayaa gabadheeda, Asho Xasan Cabdi, u soo qaaday masaafo ku dhow 90 kiiloomitir, oo u dhiganta 56 mayl, si loogu daweeyo nafaqo-darrada ba’an ee soo wajahday. Markii ay ugu dambayn gaareen Isbitaalka Kismaayo Referral Hospital, gabadha waxaa la geeyay xarunta lagu xasiliyo carruurta xaaladdoodu liidato, halkaas oo ay shaqaalaha caafimaadku baaritaan ku sameeyeen, iyagoo si gaar ah u eegayay cagaha iyo lugaha hoose ee ilmaha oo bararsanaa. Dhacdadan ayaa muujinaysa xaaladda adag ee ay wajahayaan qoysas badan oo Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan kuwa ku nool deegaannada ay adag tahay in laga helo adeegyada caafimaadka, halkaas oo carruurta ay nafaqo-darradu hayso ay la kulmaan caqabado waaweyn oo ku aaddan helitaanka daaweyn degdeg ah. Socdaalka dheer ee ay hooyadani u martay badbaadinta gabadheeda ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya dhibaatada ay qoysaska nugul kala kulmaan helitaanka adeegyada caafimaadka, gaar ahaan marka xarumaha daaweyntu ay ka fog yihiin deegaannada ay ku nool yihiin. Warbixintan oo ay baahisay wakaaladda wararka ee Associated Press (AP) 12-kii Oktoobar 2026, ayaa iftiiminaysa baahida loo qabo in carruurta ay hayso nafaqo-darrada la gaarsiiyo gargaar nafaqo iyo adeegyo caafimaad oo ku filan, si looga hortago in xaaladdoodu kasii darto.

items.title: Xiisad ka dhalatay is mari-waaga doorashooyinka dalka oo ka taagan Muqdisho
items.description: 72-kii saac ee la soo dhaafay ayaa Magaalada Muqdisho laga dareemay xiisad hor leh oo ka dhalatay khilaafka muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ka taagnaa hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka, oo si weyn ay ugu kala qaybsan yihiin Madaxda Dowladda Federaalka iyo Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka ee ka aragtida duwan. Khilaafkan oo u dhexeeya Villa Somalia iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed, oo la isku yiraahdo Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka ee Madasha Samatabixinta, Puntland iyo Jubbaland ayaa salka ku haya in loo guuro nidaamka codeynta tooska ah ee qof iyo cod iyo in lagu sii socdo nidaamkii hore ee doorashada dadban. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa bilowday tallaabooyin amni oo loo arko in lagu beegsanayo Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka, xilli in muddo ahba ay si adag u dalbanayeen in dalka laga hirgeliyo doorasho loo dhan yahay oo heshiis lagu yahay. Tallaabooyinka amniga ayaa u muuqdo kuwo si gaar ah loogu beegsanayo Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka, Shariif Sheekh Axmed, iyadoona uu jiro dareen ku aaddan in xitaa uu bartilmaameed noqon karo Ex Raysal Wasaare Xasan Cali Khayre. Laamaha amniga ayaa ciidamo ku soo daadiyay waddooyinka soo gala hoyga Shariif Sheekh Axmed uu ka degan yahay Muqdisho. Ciidamo isugu jira Haramcad, Polizia Militare, NISA iyo Booliska Gobolka Banaadir ayaa lagu arkayaa xeendaabka hoyga Shariif Sheekh Axmed oo ku yaala agagaarka waddada gasha Garoonka Diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde. Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda & Sirdoonka Qaranka (NISA) ayaa shalay Shariif Sheekh Axmed ku eedeysay in ciidamo taabacsan ay falal hubeysan kula kaceen Ciidanka NISA, xilli ay ka hawlgelayeen Waaxda 1aad, General Daa’uud ee Degmada Wadajir, eedeyntaas oo si adag uu u beeniyay. Shariif Sheekh Axmed oo loo tixgeliyo Hoggaamiyaha Mucaaradka ayaa mar sii horreysay ka digay in Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ay waddo diyaargarow colaadeed iyo tallaabooyin lagu weerarayo Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka. Raysal Wasaarihii hore ee dalka, Xasan Cali Khayre ayaa isna waxa uu xalay ka digay “Waxaan si adag uga digayaa cawaaqibka xun ee ka dhalan kara daandaansiga iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidan ee taliska Madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisu dhammaaday uu ku beegsanayo guryaha ay Muqdisho ka degan yihiin madaxdii hore ee qaranka. Tallaabooyinkani waxay abuurayaan jewi colaadeed oo caasimadda dalka u horseedi kara xasillooni darro, qalalaaso amni iyo hubanti la’aan siyaasadeed. Waxaa ayaan darro ah in Madaxweyne hore Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu u oomman yahay dhiig hor leh, kuna howlan yahay ficillo uu ku banneysanayo dhiigga madaxdii hore, waxaana ummadda Soomaaliyeed si cad ugu sheegaynaa in Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu idlaaday uu qaadayo masuuliyadda cawaaqib kasta oo ka dhasha tallaabooyinkan.” Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed, oo ah dallad ay ku bahoobeen Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka iyo Dowlad Goboleedyada Jubbaland iyo Puntland ayaa warsaxaafadeed uu goluhu soo saaray lagu sheegay “Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed wuxuu si cad u cambaareynayaa falalka daandaansiga iyo been abuurka ah ee lagu sameynayo Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka, Shariif Sheekh Axmed oo maalmihii la soo dhaafay hoygiisa la dul dhigay ciidamo hubeysan, kuwaas oo carqaladeynayay howl maalmeedkiisa, khatarna geliyay amnigiisa.” Warsaxaafadeedka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisu dhamaaday waxaa laga sugayay in uu dalka u jiheeyo wada hadalo dhab ah oo laga galo, sidii dalka doorasho heshiis lagu yahay uga dhici lahayd, waxaase wax laga xumaado ah in uu hadda ku socdo waddo uu ku banneysanayo dhiigga dadka ka aragtida duwan, gaar ahaan Xubnaha Mucaaradka, isaga oo hay’adaha amniga u adeegsanaya sifo sharci darro ah.” Golaha ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay in uu joojiyo ficilada horseedi kara isku dhacyo, abuuri karana khatar amni, isla-markaana uu u jeesto heshiis laga gaaro doorashooyinka dalka.

Waxaa ayaan darro ah in Madaxweyne hore Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu u oomman yahay dhiig hor leh, kuna howlan yahay ficillo uu ku banneysanayo dhiigga madaxdii hore, waxaana ummadda Soomaaliyeed si cad ugu sheegaynaa in Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu idlaaday uu qaadayo masuuliyadda cawaaqib kasta oo ka dhasha tallaabooyinkan.” Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed, oo ah dallad ay ku bahoobeen Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka iyo Dowlad Goboleedyada Jubbaland iyo Puntland ayaa warsaxaafadeed uu goluhu soo saaray lagu sheegay “Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed wuxuu si cad u cambaareynayaa falalka daandaansiga iyo been abuurka ah ee lagu sameynayo Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka, Shariif Sheekh Axmed oo maalmihii la soo dhaafay hoygiisa la dul dhigay ciidamo hubeysan, kuwaas oo carqaladeynayay howl maalmeedkiisa, khatarna geliyay amnigiisa.” Warsaxaafadeedka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisu dhamaaday waxaa laga sugayay in uu dalka u jiheeyo wada hadalo dhab ah oo laga galo, sidii dalka doorasho heshiis lagu yahay uga dhici lahayd, waxaase wax laga xumaado ah in uu hadda ku socdo waddo uu ku banneysanayo dhiigga dadka ka aragtida duwan, gaar ahaan Xubnaha Mucaaradka, isaga oo hay’adaha amniga u adeegsanaya sifo sharci darro ah.” Golaha ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay in uu joojiyo ficilada horseedi kara isku dhacyo, abuuri karana khatar amni, isla-markaana uu u jeesto heshiis laga gaaro doorashooyinka dalka.

Dhinaca kale,Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed oo ka kooban Madasha Samatabixinta, Jubbaland iyo Puntand ayaa sheegay madaxweynaha ay ka sugayeen inuu diiraddda saaro sidii looga miro-dhalin wada-hadallada u socda labada dhinac, si dalka loogu jiheeyo doorasho heshiis lagu yahay, balse uu hadda u weecday waddo uu ku banneysanayo dhiigga mucaaradka. “Madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisu dhammaaday waxaa laga sugayay in uu dalka u jiheeyo wadahadalo dhab ah oo laga galo sidii dalka doorasho heshiis lagu yahay uga dhici lahayd, waxaase wax laga xumaado ah in uu hadda ku socdo waddo uu ku bannaysanayo diigga dadka ka aragtida duwan, gaar ahaan xubnaha Mucaaradka, isaga oo hay’adihii amniga u adeegsanaya si sharci darro ah,” ayaa lasii raaciyay bayaanka. Waxa kale oo uu guluhu ugu baaqay madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh inuu joojiyo tallaabooyinka daandaansiga ah ee horseedi kara isku dhacyo, abuuri karana khatar amni, isla markaana uu jeesto heshiis laga gaaro doorashooyinka dalka. Shalay ayaa si weyn caasimada looga dareemay xaalad kacsanaan, kadib markii ay isku dhici gaareen ciidamada Hay’adda NISA iyo kuwa kuwa taabacsan Sheekh Shariif, waxaana weli labada dhinac ay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeedo ka wadaan degmada Wadajir ee Gobolka Banaadir. items.title: Dalka oo Maanta laga Xusayo Maalinta Calanka Qaranka
items.description: Maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 12-ka Oktoobar, Soomaaliya waxay xusaysaa Maalinta Calanka Qaranka, oo ka mid ah maalmaha taariikhiga ah ee xusuusta gaarka ah ku leh qarannimada, midnimada iyo halgankii gobannimo-doonka Soomaaliyeed. Calanka Soomaaliya, oo ka kooban midab buluug khafiif ah iyo xiddig cad oo shan gees leh, ayaa markii ugu horreysay la qaatay 12-kii Oktoobar 1954-kii. Waxaa naqshadeeyay aqoonyahankii Soomaaliyeed ee Maxamed Cawaale Liibaan, xilli dhaqdhaqaaqyada gobannimo-doonku ay sii xoogeysanayeen, Soomaaliduna ay ku taamaysay inay hesho xorriyad iyo dowlad madax-bannaan. Calanka buluugga ah ee xiddigta cad dhexda ku leh wuxuu noqday astaan lagu garto Soomaaliya, waxaana loo adeegsaday muujinta aqoonsiga qaranka iyo himiladii midnimada ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Xiddigta shanta gees leh waxaa taariikh ahaan lala xiriiriyaa shantii qaybood ee dhulka ay Soomaalidu degto, kuwaas oo kala ahaa Soomaalidii Talyaanigu gumaysan jiray, Soomaalidii Ingiriisku gumaysan jiray, Jabuuti, Soomaali Galbeed iyo NFD oo maanta ka tirsan Kenya. Markii ay Soomaaliya xornimada qaadatay 1960-kii, calanka ayaa noqday astaanta rasmiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya, wuxuuna tan iyo xilligaas kaalin muhiim ah ku lahaa matalaadda dalka gudaha iyo dibaddaba. Waxaa laga taagaa xarumaha dowladda, safaaradaha, iskuullada iyo goobaha ay ka dhacaan munaasabadaha qaran, isagoo sidoo kale lagu muujiyo aqoonsiga Soomaaliyeed ee fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah. Maalinta Calanka Qaranka waxay fursad u tahay in dib loo xusuusto taariikhda astaantan iyo kaalinta ay ku leedahay mideynta shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Calanku ma aha oo keliya maro buluug ah oo xiddig cad dhexda kaga taallo, balse waa astaan xambaarsan taariikh, waddaniyad iyo himilooyinkii ay Soomaalidu u soo martay xorriyadda. Xuska 12-ka Oktoobar wuxuu shacabka Soomaaliyeed xusuusinayaa muhiimadda ay leedahay ilaalinta astaamaha qaranka, xoojinta midnimada iyo gudbinta taariikhda calanka jiilalka soo koraya. Inkasta oo Soomaaliya ay soo martay marxalado siyaasadeed iyo caqabado kala duwan, haddana calanka qaranku wuxuu weligiis ka mid ahaa astaamaha ugu waaweyn ee lagu garto jiritaanka iyo aqoonsiga dalka.

items.title: Ugu Yaraan 72 Qof oo lagu Diley Duqeyn Cirka Ah oo Ka Dhacday Waqooyiga Suudaan
items.description: Ugu yaraan 72 qof oo ka shaqaynayay goob dahab laga qodo ayaa lagu dilay duqeyn cirka ah oo ka dhacday waqooyiga Suudaan, meel u dhow xadka lagu muransan yahay ee Suudaan iyo Masar, sida ay sheegtay hay’ad xuquuqda aadanaha oo Suudaani ah. Hay’adda Emergency Lawyers , oo diiwaangelisa xadgudubyada ka dhaca dagaalka Suudaan, ayaa sheegtay in diyaaradaha dagaalka Masar ay duqeeyeen goob macdan-qodis oo ku taalla deegaanka Wadi ee waqooyiga Suudaan. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in xogta hordhaca ah ay muujinayso in 72 qof oo rayid ah ay ku dhinteen weerarka oo dhacay Sabtidii, balse warbixinta weerarka si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin, dowladda Masarna weli kama aysan soo saarin wax war rasmi ah oo ku saabsan eedeymaha loo jeediyay. Weerarkan ayaa noqonaya kii labaad ee sanadkan ka dhaca deegaanka buuraleyda ah ee Jabal al-Uqaydat, oo hodan ku ah dahabka iyo macdanta kale, Bishii Juun ee sanadkana, weerar hore oo isla deegaankaas ka dhacay ayaa lagu soo warramay in lagu dilay 23 qof oo ka shaqaynayay goob dahab laga qodo. Milatariga Masar ayaa xilligaas sheegay inuu fuliyay howlgal ballaaran oo ka dhan ah macdan-qodis sharci-darro ah oo ka dhacaysay gudaha dhulka Masar. Hay’adda Emergency Lawyers ayaa sheegtay in weerarkii ugu dambeeyay uu ka dhacay gudaha dhulka Suudaan, iyadoo ku eedeysay mas’uuliyiinta Masar inay doonayaan inay ballaariyaan saameyntooda ayna gacanta ku dhigaan kheyraadka dabiiciga ah ee ku yaalla aagga xadka.

items.title: Waa Tuma Sagal Cabdi-Waali: Gabadha Soomaaliyeed ee kamid Noqatay Baarlamaanka Britain?
items.description: Sagal Cabdi-Waali, oo asal ahaan ka soo jeedda Soomaaliya, ayaa noqotay mid ka mid ah haweenka Soomaaliyeed ee taariikhda ku yeeshay siyaasadda Britain, kaddib markii ay qaxooti ahaan dalkaas ku timid iyadoo yar, balse sannado kaddib ku guuleysatay inay xubin ka noqoto Baarlamaanka Britain. Sagal waxay Britain tagtay horraantii sagaashamaadkii, xilli Soomaaliya ay ka jirtay dagaal sokeeye, waxayna markaas ahayd gabar yar oo ay weheliyeen hooyadeed iyo afar walaalaheed ah, kuwaas oo dalkooda uga soo cararay colaadaha, iyagoo raadinayay nolol nabdoon iyo mustaqbal wanaagsan. Qoyskeedu waxay degeen waqooyiga London, gaar ahaan deegaanka Camden, halkaas oo ay ku soo barbaartay kuna dhisatay nolosheeda cusub. Markii ay Britain timid, kuma hadli jirin luuqadda Ingiriisiga, balse waxay si tartiib tartiib ah ula qabsatay bulshada iyo deegaanka cusub. Waayo-aragnimadii qaxootinimada iyo caqabadihii qoyskeedu la kulmeen ayaa qayb ka noqday fahamkeeda ku aaddan baahiyaha dadka nugul iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in bulshadu hesho taageero iyo fursado nololeed. Ka hor inta aysan siyaasadda si rasmi ah u gelin, Sagal waxay ka shaqaynaysay arrimaha bulshada, iyadoo ka qayb qaadatay hawlo samafal iyo taageerada qoysaska iyo dhallinyarada. Waxay sidoo kale khibrad ka heshay maamulka dugsiyada iyo hay’adaha bulshada, taas oo u sahashay inay si dhow u fahanto dhibaatooyinka la xiriira guryaha, hoy la’aanta iyo fursadaha shaqo. Sannadkii 2022 ayay xubin ka noqotay Golaha Deegaanka Camden, iyadoo ka tirsan Xisbiga Shaqaalaha ee Labour Party, waxayna sii xoojisay kaalinteeda siyaasadeed, waxaana bishii May 2026 loo doortay hoggaamiyaha Golaha Deegaanka Camden, iyadoo noqotay haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee madow ah ee xilkaas qabata. Fursad kale ayaa u furantay markii uu bannaanaaday kursiga baarlamaanka ee deegaanka Holborn and St Pancras, kaddib markii Keir Starmer uu ka tagay kursigaas bishii Sebtembar 2026. Xisbiga Labour Party ayaa Sagal u doortay musharraxiisa doorashada ku-meel-gaarka ah ee deegaankaas, taas oo qabsoontay 8-dii Oktoobar 2026. Natiijadii doorashada ayaa Sagal u noqotay guul weyn, iyadoo heshay 12,292 cod, oo u dhiganta 45.3 boqolkiiba codadka la dhiibtay, waxayna ka guuleysatay Zack Polanski, hoggaamiyaha Xisbiga Cagaaran, oo helay 8,928 cod. Guushaas ayaa u suurtagelisay inay noqoto xildhibaanka cusub ee deegaanka Holborn and St Pancras, kaas oo ku yaalla waqooyiga magaalada London. Ololaheeda doorashada, Sagal waxay xoogga saartay arrimaha guryaha, hoy la’aanta iyo sidii dhallinyarada loogu abuuri lahaa fursado shaqo, ayadoo sidoo kale carrabka ku adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay in dadka deegaanka ay helaan matalaad siyaasadeed oo fahamsan duruufahooda iyo baahiyahooda. Khibraddeeda Golaha Deegaanka Camden ayaa qayb weyn ka qaadatay ololaheeda, iyadoo ballanqaadday inay codka dadka deegaanka gaarsiin doonto heer qaran. Sheekada Sagal Cabdi-Waali waxay tusaale u tahay safar nololeed ka soo bilaabmay qaxootinimo, kuna dhammaaday guul siyaasadeed oo heer qaran ah. Waxay ka gudubtay caqabadihii la xiriiray barakaca iyo la qabsiga bulsho cusub, iyadoo ugu dambayn gaartay heer ay ka qayb qaadato go’aan ka gaarista arrimaha saameeya nolosha shacabka Britain. Guusheeda ayaa sidoo kale muhiimad gaar ah u leh bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee ku nool Britain iyo carruurta qaxootiga ah, maadaama ay muujinayso in dadka ka soo jeeda qoysaska qaxootiga ahi ay ka qayb qaadan karaan hoggaaminta iyo siyaasadda dalka ay ku nool yihiin. Hadda waxaa horyaalla mas’uuliyadda ah inay matasho dadka deegaanka Holborn and St Pancras, iyadoo laga sugayo inay waayo-aragnimadeeda bulshada u beddesho waxqabad wax ku ool ah oo wax ka qabta baahiyaha dadka ay matalayso.

Sagal waxay Britain tagtay horraantii sagaashamaadkii, xilli Soomaaliya ay ka jirtay dagaal sokeeye, waxayna markaas ahayd gabar yar oo ay weheliyeen hooyadeed iyo afar walaalaheed ah, kuwaas oo dalkooda uga soo cararay colaadaha, iyagoo raadinayay nolol nabdoon iyo mustaqbal wanaagsan. Qoyskeedu waxay degeen waqooyiga London, gaar ahaan deegaanka Camden, halkaas oo ay ku soo barbaartay kuna dhisatay nolosheeda cusub. Markii ay Britain timid, kuma hadli jirin luuqadda Ingiriisiga, balse waxay si tartiib tartiib ah ula qabsatay bulshada iyo deegaanka cusub. Waayo-aragnimadii qaxootinimada iyo caqabadihii qoyskeedu la kulmeen ayaa qayb ka noqday fahamkeeda ku aaddan baahiyaha dadka nugul iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in bulshadu hesho taageero iyo fursado nololeed. Ka hor inta aysan siyaasadda si rasmi ah u gelin, Sagal waxay ka shaqaynaysay arrimaha bulshada, iyadoo ka qayb qaadatay hawlo samafal iyo taageerada qoysaska iyo dhallinyarada. Waxay sidoo kale khibrad ka heshay maamulka dugsiyada iyo hay’adaha bulshada, taas oo u sahashay inay si dhow u fahanto dhibaatooyinka la xiriira guryaha, hoy la’aanta iyo fursadaha shaqo. Sannadkii 2022 ayay xubin ka noqotay Golaha Deegaanka Camden, iyadoo ka tirsan Xisbiga Shaqaalaha ee Labour Party, waxayna sii xoojisay kaalinteeda siyaasadeed, waxaana bishii May 2026 loo doortay hoggaamiyaha Golaha Deegaanka Camden, iyadoo noqotay haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee madow ah ee xilkaas qabata. Fursad kale ayaa u furantay markii uu bannaanaaday kursiga baarlamaanka ee deegaanka Holborn and St Pancras, kaddib markii Keir Starmer uu ka tagay kursigaas bishii Sebtembar 2026. Xisbiga Labour Party ayaa Sagal u doortay musharraxiisa doorashada ku-meel-gaarka ah ee deegaankaas, taas oo qabsoontay 8-dii Oktoobar 2026. Natiijadii doorashada ayaa Sagal u noqotay guul weyn, iyadoo heshay 12,292 cod, oo u dhiganta 45.3 boqolkiiba codadka la dhiibtay, waxayna ka guuleysatay Zack Polanski, hoggaamiyaha Xisbiga Cagaaran, oo helay 8,928 cod. Guushaas ayaa u suurtagelisay inay noqoto xildhibaanka cusub ee deegaanka Holborn and St Pancras, kaas oo ku yaalla waqooyiga magaalada London. Ololaheeda doorashada, Sagal waxay xoogga saartay arrimaha guryaha, hoy la’aanta iyo sidii dhallinyarada loogu abuuri lahaa fursado shaqo, ayadoo sidoo kale carrabka ku adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay in dadka deegaanka ay helaan matalaad siyaasadeed oo fahamsan duruufahooda iyo baahiyahooda. Khibraddeeda Golaha Deegaanka Camden ayaa qayb weyn ka qaadatay ololaheeda, iyadoo ballanqaadday inay codka dadka deegaanka gaarsiin doonto heer qaran. Sheekada Sagal Cabdi-Waali waxay tusaale u tahay safar nololeed ka soo bilaabmay qaxootinimo, kuna dhammaaday guul siyaasadeed oo heer qaran ah. Waxay ka gudubtay caqabadihii la xiriiray barakaca iyo la qabsiga bulsho cusub, iyadoo ugu dambayn gaartay heer ay ka qayb qaadato go’aan ka gaarista arrimaha saameeya nolosha shacabka Britain. Guusheeda ayaa sidoo kale muhiimad gaar ah u leh bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee ku nool Britain iyo carruurta qaxootiga ah, maadaama ay muujinayso in dadka ka soo jeeda qoysaska qaxootiga ahi ay ka qayb qaadan karaan hoggaaminta iyo siyaasadda dalka ay ku nool yihiin. Hadda waxaa horyaalla mas’uuliyadda ah inay matasho dadka deegaanka Holborn and St Pancras, iyadoo laga sugayo inay waayo-aragnimadeeda bulshada u beddesho waxqabad wax ku ool ah oo wax ka qabta baahiyaha dadka ay matalayso.

items.title: Ugu Yaraan Hal Qof oo ku Geeriyooday Weerar Lagu Qaaday Garoonka Riyadh
items.description: Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sheegtay in hal qof uu ku dhintay, 11 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen weerar cusub oo lagu qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Boqor Khalid ee magaalada Riyadh, iyadoo weerarrada soo noqnoqday ay sii kordhinayaan walaaca laga qabo amniga dalkaas iyo xaaladda gobolka. Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Sacuudiga (GACA) ayaa xaqiijisay in qofka ku dhintay weerarka Axaddii uu ahaa muwaadin u dhashay Pakistan oo dalkaas degganaa. Dadka dhaawacmay ayaa la geeyay dhowr isbitaal si loogu dabiibo. Weerarka ayaa lagu beegsaday terminaallada 3 iyo 4 ee garoonka, kuwaas oo loo isticmaalo duulimaadyada gudaha, ayadoo dhacdadani ay timid maalin kadib weerar kale oo garoonka lagu qaaday, kaas oo sida uu sheegay isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ay ku dhinteen 12 qof, in ka badan 300 oo kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Safaaradda Hindiya ee Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in muwaadin Hindi ah uu Axaddii u dhintay dhaawacyo ka soo gaaray weerarkii Sabtidii. Arrintan ayaa tirada dhimashada ee weerarkaas gaarsiineysa 13 qof, sida ay muujinayaan xogaha la shaaciyey. Goobjooge la hadlay wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters ayaa sheegay in walax weerar ah ay ku dhacday dhulka garoonka, meel u dhow diyaarado dhowr ah oo halkaas ku sugnaa, abbaaraha 8:30 fiidnimo ee waqtiga Riyadh. Dhacdada ayaa dhalisay dab, waxaana diyaarad xilligaas dhaqaaqaysay dib loogu celiyey albaabka laga raaco, halkaas oo rakaabkii laga dejiyey laguna amray inay garoonka ka baxaan. Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ayaa sheegtay in la bilaabay qiimeynta khasaaraha iyo baaritaanno lagu xaqiijinayo badbaadada garoonka. Sida ay sheegtay Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Sacuudiga, garoonka King Khalid ayaa afar jeer la weeraray shantii maalmood ee ka horreysay warbixintan. Weerarro dhacay Khamiistii ayaa sababay dhimashada ugu yaraan saddex muwaadin oo Sacuudiyaan ah, oo uu ku jiray duuliye. Kooxda Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegatay mas’uuliyadda weerarradii ka horreeyey kii Axaddii, waxayna Xuutiyiinta oo dagaal kula jira dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, ay taageero ka helaan Iiraan, halka Sacuudigu taageero ciidamada dowladda Yemen. Weerarrada lagu qaaday garoonka Riyadh ayaa kordhiyey walaaca laga qabo in dagaalka Yemen uu ku fido dalal kale oo gobolka ah, gaar ahaan haddii Maraykanku si toos ah ugu biiro dagaalka ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta.

items.title: Boqolaal qof oo caawa ka barakacay xaafadda Tiintiinley ee Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho – Boqolaal qof ayaa caawa ka barakacay xaafadda Tiintiinley ee degmada Wadajir, gobolka Banaadir, halkaas oo uu deggan yahay madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Shariif Sheekh Axmed, kaddib markii uu sheegay in ciidamo ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya ay hareereeyeen. Dadka deegaanka ayaa la sheegay inay guryahooda ka baxeen iyagoo ka cabsi qaba in xaaladda amni ee xaafaddu ay sii xumaato, isla markaana uu dhaco iska hor-imaad hubeysan oo waxyeello u geysan kara dadka rayidka ah. Barakaca ayaa imanaya xilli ay isa soo tarayaan wararka la xiriira xiisad amni oo ka taagan xaafadda Tiintiinley, kaddib markii Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) ay war-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in ciidamadeeda Ilaalada Shacabka ay la kulmeen weerarro ay ku eedeysay maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo ay sheegtay inay ka amar qaataan madaxweynihii hore, Shariif Sheekh Axmed. NISA ayaa sheegtay in dhacdooyinku ka dhaceen nawaaxiga Laanta Koowaad ee Waaxda General Daa’uud ee degmada Wadajir, iyadoo dhinaca kale Shariif Sheekh Axmed uu sheegay in ciidamada dowladda ay hareereeyeen. Barakaca dadka rayidka ah ayaa muujinaya walaaca laga qabo in xiisadda ka taagan xaafaddu ay isu beddesho iska hor-imaad hubeysan oo saameeya shacabka ku nool deegaanka. Ilaa hadda ma jiraan faahfaahin dhammaystiran oo ku saabsan halka ay dadka barakacay u hayaameen, khasaaraha ka dhashay xaaladda iyo tallaabooyinka ay dhinacyadu qaadi doonaan saacadaha soo socda.

items.title: Winners and losers as Beledweyne moves to prepare for El Niño floods
items.description: (ERGO) – Hundreds of displaced families have been evicted from houses they had been occupying rent-free in El Jalle, on the outskirts of Beledweyne in central Somalia’s Hiran region, by homeowners making their own preparations ahead of forecast heavy El Niño rains and fears of flooding. The homeowners concerned have been living in the cheaper, low-lying neighbourhoods of Beledweyne town near the river Shabelle, including Kooshin, Bundoweyn, Howlwadag, Radar, Kutiimbo and Laabka. They had built houses in El Jalle, located on higher ground, as alternative shelter for contingencies. The displaced families that have been evicted fled conflict and drought over recent years. Most have lost their original livelihoods. They have been left without shelter as deyr rains start in the region. Salado Abdi Osman was evicted on 20 September from a house in El Jalle where she had lived rent-free for a year and a half. The 62-year-old mother of 12 now shelters under a tree, using plastic sheeting that offers little protection from the rain. “The situation is very difficult. We were told to leave because flooding was expected. When we see lightning, we wonder where we can go. We live in constant fear and have nowhere to shelter,” she told Radio Ergo. Families who can afford to do so are moving to higher ground to escape the floods. But Salado’s family is struggling to find shelter and food. Her husband gets odd jobs as a construction labourer in Beledweyne, six kilometres away, earning no more than $5 a day if he finds work. “Sometimes I can’t cook for the whole day, and the children eat whatever little food we find. My husband spends more days without work than with it. When he finds nothing, we go to bed hungry,” she said. Salado fled Inabaal, in Mahas district of Hiran, following fighting between local forces and Al-Shabaab. The family’s 46 goats, their main source of income, were seized by Al-Shabaab. Her children have been out of school since the family’s displacement in 2025 because they can’t afford fees or books and pens. Three boys and one girl had attended school, while the younger children went to Koranic classes. El Jalle, which lies away from the river on higher ground, has become a refuge during floods. Flooding in 2018, 2019 and 2023 displaced hundreds of thousands of people in Beledweyne, prompting residents to buy land and build alternative houses in El Jalle. The area now has more than 15,000 houses. Homeowner Abdiwali Hassan Dir has begun repairing his house in El Jalle, after asking a family who had lived in it for free to leave. He built it in 2022 after experiencing repeated flooding and needing somewhere to take his family during emergencies. “I built a room and a large veranda so we could move there whenever danger arose. I take special care of the house and sometimes take my children there on Fridays,” he told Radio Ergo. Abdiwali, 44, is a schoolteacher earning $300 a month to support his family of eight children. He fears that permanently leaving Kooshin in Beledweyne town, where he works, would disrupt his income and his children’s education. Moving would also be more costly than he can afford. From previous experience, however, he knows that the temporary shift to El Jalle will be difficult, as thousands of people of all walks of life will gather there to avoid the floods. “People displaced by conflict and those fleeing floods will all gather there. There will be many difficulties, and children will lose access to education. Life will become harder for everyone,” he said. Flooding always disrupts schools, businesses and employment in Beledweyne. Abdiwali said he has not managed to save money for such emergencies, and his teaching salary might stop when flooding occurs. He has fled floods four times and taken refuge in his El Jalle house, which cost him $5,000 to build. “Work is disrupted, and families lose their income and property. We share the suffering of the community,” he said. Luul Abdullahi Omar was also evicted from a house in El Jalle, when the homeowners returned to occupy it in September after leaving Beledweyne over fears of flooding. Luul and her eight children now live in nearby Teedaan internal displacement camp. They depend on relatives for assistance, leaving her struggling to find food, clothing and shelter. “My son sends us some money each month, but sometimes he has nothing to give. Fifty dollars can’t support a large family for a month,” she said. “If it rains tonight, we have nowhere to go. We have young children and no shelter.” Luul said this was her fourth displacement since 2022. She previously lived as a pastoralist in a rural part of Mahas, where they lost 150 goats and two camels during conflict between local forces and Al-Shabaab between 2022 and 2025. items.title: Beyond institutional fetishism: Somalia’s Crisis Is a Failure of Nation-Building
items.description: By Abdirahman A. Issa I recently listened to a debate between Ahmed Issa Awad, a former foreign minister, and Mustafe Guufe, chairman of Puntland First, on the path forward for relations between Puntland and the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS). The intergenerational exchange exposed the rupture that will shape the future of the Somali state. Ahmed grew up in a functioning state and witnessed the reconciliation conference as both observer and participant. Mustafe came of age as the central state collapsed and subnational identity became the main source of belonging as decades of civil war and clan polarization have hollowed out any shared sense of national purpose. For four hours, they argued over whether federal institutions, especially the troops, can operate in Puntland. Ahmed argued that Puntland’s forces should be integrated into the national army, with proper support, including salaries and training. Mustafe countered that federal troops should not operate in Puntland at all, because doing so would undermine its autonomy. Beneath the technical details, the dispute was about who belongs to whom and who has the right to command whom, something no integration formula can settle. Ahmed’s position rests on the assumption that Somalia is a single nation whose authority flows from the center, so that federal forces operating in Puntland are simply the ordinary exercise of national sovereignty. Yet Somalia has long been a striking anomaly: a recognized sovereign nation-state without an effective central government able to hold a monopoly on the legitimate use of force across its territory. Mogadishu enjoys formal diplomatic recognition, but governance on the ground is marked by fragmentation, deep structural dysfunction and competing jurisdictions. The institutions are form with no function. What is missing is the shared belief that gives them authority. Throughout the debate, Awad fetishized inclusive institutions and attributed state failure mainly to their absence. In doing so, he reduced a political and social question to a technical, administrative one. That reduction overlooks the deeper problem. The heart of the Somali crisis is a fractured national identity, a profound deficit of trust and the absence of a genuine social contract. Externally driven state-building has long overemphasized formal administrative structures while ignoring these socio-political realities. Donors have invested in bureaucracy, courts, security forces, and public financial management, yet state failure persists, which is exactly what we should expect when the problem is more than institutional. The result is a dysfunctional center that treats sovereignty as a legal fiction to be leveraged for international aid, while Puntland sees that center as an existential threat to its autonomy. The FGS derives much of its legitimacy from the international community and depends on it for financial support, so external recognition has become a convenient substitute for domestic consent. But foreign-driven administrative reform cannot import stability, nor can centralized decree impose it. It requires a negotiated social contract, born of genuine dialogue between the center and the states. Puntland and the federal government have been at loggerheads for years. Their core disagreement is not about institutional design or policy detail; it is about the rules of the game, and about whether those rules have the consent of those who must live under them.  Puntland severed ties with the center, accusing it of unilaterally amending the provisional federal constitution without broad-based consensus. More recently, the FGS tried to recruit and deploy military units inside Puntland on its own, and Puntland’s authorities, seeing unauthorized federal troops as an encroachment, asserted their autonomy by neutralizing them. A constitution amended without consent and an army deployed without agreement are institutions without a social contract behind them, and Puntland asserted it rejected them for that reason. Similar dynamics played out in Jubaland, where Ahmed Madobe and the FGS clashed over the management of regional elections, culminating in the defeat of federal troops, who were pushed across the Kenyan border. The revised constitutional framework seeks to impose a centralized electoral model that recognizes a single federal body to run both national and regional elections. Madobe rejected it, held his own election, and forced the federal government to recognize the result. Again, the dispute was not over electoral procedure but who holds the legitimate authority to hold elections. In the Southwest, the outcome was the opposite. Hassan Sheikh succeeded in removing Laftagareen and installing Aden Madobe, a former Speaker of Parliament, and the removal was followed by the appointment of a district commissioner and an interim president. This shows that federalism has failed to take hold in some FMS, as they have become extensions of Mogadishu. Somali state-building has steadily drifted from bargaining and consensus toward flexing muscle under successive administrations, most notably under Farmajo and Hassan Sheikh’s second term. This has turned federalism from a cooperative mechanism meant to unite a fractured nation into an arena of perpetual turf wars. In the early days, building the state required extensive negotiation and consensus among stakeholders. But as international resources and recognition concentrated around the central government in Mogadishu, successive leaders centralized power through coercion and co-optation. It now seems that Somalia’s future will be settled by force rather than negotiation, and force cannot produce the consent that institutions need. Inclusive institutions are necessary, but they are not the foundation. The foundation is a social contract built on consent, a shared identity people recognize as their own, and trust earned through honored agreements. These cannot be imported or imposed. They can only be built, together, by Somalis. Without them, institutions are nothing but empty shells. Abdirahman A. Sheekh Shariif oo si adag uga jawaabay qoraalkii Hay’adda NISA
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Shariif Sheekh ayaa si kulul ugu jawaabay Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) oo ciidamadiisa ku eedeysay inay khalkhal-gelin amni ka wadaan magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo soo bandhigtay caddeymo muujinayo in maleeshiyaad ku hubeysnaa AK-47, BKM iyo RPG ay xoog ku galeen guryo ku yaalla xaafadda Tiintiinley ee degmada Wadajir. Sheekh Shariif oo ka falceliyay arrintan ayaa si adag u beeniyay sheegashada NISA, isaga oo tilmaamay in eedeymaha loo jeediyay ilaaladiisa ay yihiin kuwa waxba kama jiraan ah. Madaxweynihii hore ee dowladdii KMG ahayd ayaa dhankiisa soo bandhigay tabasho uu qabo iyo eedeymo uu u jeediyay ciidanka dowladda, isaga oo tilmaamay inay jiraan dhacdooyin taxane ah oo walaac amni abuuray, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin jidgooyooyin iyo xannibaadyo saameeyey isu-socodka agagaarka deegaanka uu deggan yahay Shariif, isaga oo sidoo kale xusay in la hor-istaagay adeegyada daruuriga ah ee nolol maalmeedka sida biyaha, cunnooyinka iyo wixii la mid ah, hase-yeeshee laga muujiyay dulqaad, si looga fogaado isku dhac hubeysan. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in ciidamo badan lasoo dhoobay gurigiisa, lana afduubtay qaar ka mid ah shaqaalaha ka shaqeeya xaruntiisa, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Sheekha ayaa ka digay sii socoshada dhaq-dhaqaaqyadan, wuxuuna carrabka ku dhuftay in mas’uuliyadda wixii ka dhasha ay qaadi doonto dowladda Soomaaliya. Hoos ka akhriso qoraalka oo dhammaystiran;- Muqdisho, Soomaaliya. 11-ka Oktoobar 2026 : Madaxweynihii 7-aad ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Shariif Sheekh Axmed, wuxuu si cad u beeninayaa sheegashada maanta ay baahisay Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabad-sugidda Qaranka ee (NISA), taas oo la xiriirtay eedeymo been abuur ah oo loo jeediyey illaalada Madaxweynaha oo ka tirsan ciidanka Qaranka. Waxaan caddeynaynaa in sheegashadaasi aysan ka tarjumayn xaqiiqada dhacdooyin tixane ah oo lagu khal-khalgalinayay deegaanka Madaxweyne Shariif Sheekh Axmed, iyadoo si gaar ah aan uga digayno warbixinnada looga danleeyahay marin-habaabinta shacabka Soomaaliyeed ama sumcad-dilka siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka. Madaxweyne Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed, wuxuu si buuxda u aqoonsanyahay muhiimadda ay leedahay illaalinta amniga qaranka, madax-bannaanida hay’adaha amniga iyo dhowrista sharciga. Hase-yeeshee, mabaadi’daasi waa inay si siman ugu dhaqmaan dhammaan muwaadiniinta iyo siyaasiyiinta dalka, iyadoo aan loo eegin mowqifkooda siyaasadeed. Maalmihii ugu dambeeyey waxaa jiray dhacdooyin taxane ah oo walaac amni abuuray, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin jidgooyooyin iyo xannibaadyo saameeyey isu-socodka agagaarka deegaanka uu deggan yahay Madaxweynihii hore Mudane Shariif Sheekh Axmed, iyadoo la hor-istaagay adeegyada daruuriga ah ee nolol maalmeedka sida biyaha, cunnooyinka iyo wixii la mid ah, hase-yeeshee laga muujiyay dulqaad, si looga fogaado isku dhac hubeysan. Waxaa intaa dheer in afduub lagula kacay qaar ka mid ah shaqaalaha xarunta Madaxweynihii hore, iyadoo ay jirtay walaac ku saabsan joogitaanka ciidamo hubeysan oo lasoo dhoobay goobaha ku dhow guriga Madaxweynaha, balse marar badan la iska indha tiray in laga falceliyo, si shacabka deegaanka loogu turo, loona illaaliyo ixtiraamka loo hayo dowladnimada nugul.. Dhacdooyinkaas oo dhan waxay u baahanyihiin in si dhab ah loo diiwaangeliyo, loo xaqiijiyo, tallaabo walba oo khaldana lagula xisaabtami doonaa ciddii si shaqsi ah ugu kacday iyadoo adeegsaneysa magaca dowladnimada. Hay’adaha amniga qaranku waa inay noqdaan kuwo ka madax-bannaan loollanka siyaasadeed, kuna shaqeeyaan sharciga, ayna u illaalinayaan muwaadiniinta si siman. Waxaan taliska hay’adda NISA ugu baaqaynaa inay joojiyaan marin habaabinta shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee la daalaa-dhacaya xaaladaha bini’aadannimo ee ka dhashay, duufaannada, roobabka mahiigaanka ah, barakicinta iyo boobka hantidooda ama dhulalkooda loo gaystay. Xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka waxay u baahantahay miyir-qab, masuuliyad iyo hoggaan ka fog tallaabooyin keeni kara iska hor’imaad hubeysan. Soomaaliya uma baahna xiisad amni oo cusub, manna mudna in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed loo beddelo colaad halis galineysa nolosha muwaadiniinta iyo xasilloonida dalka. Waxaan mar kale ka digaynaa in dhacdooyinka amni ama eedeymaha aan weli si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin loo adeegsado cadaadis siyaasadeed, cabsi-gelin ama isku-day lagu aamusiinayo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ee u taagan in dalka laga hirgaliyo doorasho wadar-ogol ah. Sidaa-darteed mas’uuliyadda wixii ka dhasha tallaabo kasta oo sharci-darro ah ama kicin karta iska hor’imaad waxaa qaadaysa xukuumadda muddo-dhaafka ah, mowqifkayaguna waa nabad, wada-hadal iyo xal siyaasadeed. Madaxweyne Shariif Sheekh Axmed wuxuu mar kale xaqiijinayaa inuusan dan ka lahayn abuurista xaalad amni-darro, hurin colaadeed ama dhiig-daata. Wuxuu aaminsanyahay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee dalka lagu xallin karo wada-hadal dhab ah, is-aaminaad iyo hannaan doorasho oo heshiis lagu yahay. Waxaa loogu baaqayaa xukuumadda muddo-dhaafka ah, hay’adaha amniga, siyaasiyiinta dalka iyo dhammaan dhinacyada ay khusayso inay muujiyaan dulqaad, dhowraan sharciga, kana fogaadaan tallaabo kasta oo xaaladda taaggan uga sii dari karta. Waxaan sidoo kale ugu baaqaynaa saaxiibbada caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya inay dhiirrageliyaan hufnaanta, isla-xisaabtan iyo xal u helidda muranka doorashooyinka iyo guud ahaan arrimaha qalafsan ee siyaasadeed dalka. Ugu dambeyn, sheegashada NISA ma beddeli karto xaqiiqada, mana noqon karto xukun lagu banneysanayo dhiigga siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ah, waxaana mar kale aan si cad u diiddannahay eedeymaha lagu sumcad dilayo illlaalada Madaxweynihii hore Mudane Shariif Sheekh Axmed. XAFIISKA MADAXWEYNIHII 7-AAD EE JAMHUURIYADDA FEDERAALKA SOOMAALIYA. The post Sheekh Shariif oo si adag uga jawaabay qoraalkii Hay’adda NISA appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland Politician’s Defection to Mogadishu Signals a Wider Battle for Political Loyalty
items.description: MOGADISHU (WDN) — The arrival of prominent Somaliland politician Liibaan Al-Cadaala in Mogadishu after abandoning his support for Somaliland’s independence has opened a new chapter in the contest over Somali unity. His defection may prove more than an isolated political move: it could signal a broader struggle in which disillusioned figures leave Hargeisa for Mogadishu, while others dissatisfied with federal rule may move in the opposite direction and embrace Somaliland’s independence project. Al-Cadaala was welcomed at Aden Adde International Airport by federal lawmakers, senators, government officials, Banadir regional representatives and members of the public. His reception was presented by supporters of Somali unity as a symbolic victory for the idea of reunification after more than three decades of separation between Somaliland and Somalia. The event also carried a political message. For Mogadishu, attracting a recognisable Somaliland political figure offers an opportunity to demonstrate that support for independence is not irreversible and that individuals who once defended separation may reconsider their position. But the movement of politicians between the two sides is unlikely to be a one-way process. Political loyalties can shift when individuals feel excluded, threatened, marginalised or frustrated by the authorities they once supported. If Al-Cadaala’s departure reflects wider dissatisfaction within Somaliland’s political circles, others could follow him south. Equally, Somalis disillusioned with the Federal Government may gravitate towards Hargeisa, as previous political defections have illustrated. Mogadishu sees an opening At the welcoming ceremony, federal MP Aweys Mohamed Omar described Al-Cadaala’s arrival as the beginning of a potentially larger movement towards unity. He expressed hope that other Somaliland politicians would eventually come to Mogadishu, even invoking Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi, widely known as Cirro, as a future visitor. His remarks reflected the political aspirations of Somalia’s unionist camp, which sees the return of prominent Somaliland figures as a way to weaken the perception that independence enjoys unquestioned support across the region. MP Asha Koos, who represents the north-western regions, also praised Al-Cadaala’s decision and expressed hope that Mogadishu and Hargeisa could one day reunite peacefully. Her comments underscored the enduring emotional and political significance of unity for supporters of a shared Somali state. Al-Cadaala thanked those who welcomed him and praised Mogadishu’s security and development. He described the capital as a centre of Somali intellectual and national life, arguing that Somalis remain connected despite their political divisions. He also criticised Somaliland’s developing relationship with Israel, echoing Mogadishu’s opposition to that engagement. Al-Cadaala said he now felt able to speak freely about political issues that he had previously approached with caution. His remarks may indicate that his change of allegiance involves not only the question of independence but also disagreement with the political direction taken by Somaliland’s leadership. Defections can work in both directions Yet Mogadishu should be careful not to interpret one politician’s arrival as proof that Somaliland’s independence movement is losing broad public support. A political defection is significant, but it does not necessarily represent the views of an entire community or predict the decisions of other leaders. The more important question is whether Al-Cadaala’s move reflects a wider pattern of political dissatisfaction. Politicians often reassess their allegiances when they believe they have lost influence, when internal party disputes intensify, or when they disagree with decisions made by those in power. Such calculations can lead individuals towards either side of the political divide. That is why the flow of political figures between Mogadishu and Hargeisa should be understood as a two-way contest rather than a march inevitably towards reunification. For every Somaliland politician who abandons independence and joins the unionist camp, another frustrated with federal politics could choose to support Somaliland’s separate statehood. The number of future defections cannot be predicted from this single event, but the possibility highlights the fragility of political loyalty when grievances remain unresolved. Neither side can build a durable national strategy simply by celebrating the arrival of defectors or condemning those who leave. Political allegiances are not substitutes for public consent, constitutional clarity or an agreed framework for resolving the longstanding dispute. The real contest is political credibility Somalia’s division has persisted for more than 30 years, and the disagreement between Mogadishu and Hargeisa extends beyond individual politicians. It concerns sovereignty, recognition, security, representation and competing visions of the future. These issues cannot be settled through ceremonial welcomes, political speeches or the movement of a handful of prominent figures. If Mogadishu hopes to persuade more Somaliland politicians and citizens to reconsider independence, it must demonstrate the advantages of a credible and inclusive political settlement. That means addressing concerns about federal governance, power-sharing, security and the protection of regional interests. Likewise, Somaliland’s leadership faces the challenge of maintaining public confidence while navigating internal disagreements and sensitive external relationships. The relationship with Israel, which Al-Cadaala criticised, may become another dividing line in Somaliland’s political debate. But it should not overshadow the wider question of how the people of Somaliland and Somalia can determine their political future without coercion or renewed conflict. Ultimately, Al-Cadaala’s arrival is a political development worth watching, not proof that reunification is imminent. His decision may encourage others to reconsider their positions, but it may also prompt counter-movements among those who feel alienated by Mogadishu. The real test for both sides is whether they can win political confidence through governance, dialogue and a credible vision for the future—not simply through defections. items.title: Fiqi oo ka digay shirqool uu sheegay inay maleegayaan mucaaradka dowladda
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo qoraal soo saaray ayaa u jawaabay mucaaradka kasoo horjeedo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo mar kale dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan ka bilaabay magaalada Muqdisho. Dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ayaa laga dareemay aagga hoteel Jasiira oo ay dagan yihiin mucaaradka, waxaana sidoo kale halkaas lagu arkay ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa ammaanka ee dowladda. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa kooxaha mucaaradka ku eedeeyay inay maleegayeen shirqool cusub oo uu sheegay inuu fashilmay, isagoo intaas ku daray inay hadda marmarsiiyo ka dhiganayaan in la soo weeraray, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in xubnaha qaar mucaaradka ay doonayaan inay dagaal geliyaan, si ay u gaaraan ujeedo gaar ah oo ay leeyihiin, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Shirqoolkii la guntayay bilihii la soo dhaafay iyo shirarkiisii dhowaan soo gabagaboobay markii si kale oo lagu fuliyo iyo marmarsiiyo la cuskado la waayay wuxuu qorshe ka dhigtay “waa la i soo weerarayaa” loo gol-leeyahay habar-wacasho iyo marmarsiiyo maleeshiyaad lagu abaabusho. Kooxaha mucaaradka qaarkood aaminsan in qoriga kursi lagu heli karo waxay saddex jeer oo hore isku dayeen weeraro fashilmay oo shisheeye maalgalinayay bishii September 2025 weerarkii qaawanaa ee saldhigga Wardhiigley iyo bilihii May&Juun ee sanadkaan oo gantaallo iyo madaafiic ay ku garaaceen shacabka ayagoo leh banaanbax ayaan qabanaynaa!,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Dhanka kale, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga ayaa difaacay ciidamada ammaanka, waxaana uu tilmaamay in weligeedood aysan ku horreyn gacanta weerarka, isla markaana mar kasta oo dagaal dhaco ama xaalad timaado, iyaga lasoo weerarro, sida uu ku dooday. “Ma dhicin marna in ciidanka dawladdu uu weeraray ama gacanta la horreeyey, mar walba ayaga ayaa weerar ahaa, haddana maleeshiyaadka ay guryahooda ku uruuriyeen ayay rabaan in ay marmarsiiyo u helaan,” ayuu markale yiri wasiirku. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas raaciyay “Ma jirto cid sharciga ka sarraysa, mana jirto cid laga aqbalayo maleeshiyaad ay rabto in ay Amniga Caasimadda ku qalqal geliso”. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli maanta ciidamada ammaanka dowladda iyo kuwa Sheekh Shariif ay ku dhawaadeen inay isku fara-saaraan agagaarka waddada garoonka diyaaradaha Muqdisho, halkaas oo laga dareemay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo iska soo horjeeda, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isu jeediyeen eedeymo culus. items.title: NISA Accusations Against Former President Sharif Raise Questions Over Political Use of Security Forces
items.description: NISA Accusations Against Former President Sharif Raise Questions Over Political Use of Security Forces NISA’s allegations against former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed raise concerns that security accusations could become a pretext for action against political opponents. The statement does not establish that an attack on his residence is planned. Somalia’s collapse carries a painful lesson: politicized security forces and repression of opponents helped fuel the conflict that destroyed state institutions. The government must prevent that history from repeating. Allegations require credible evidence and due process; political disputes require dialogue. Security institutions must protect citizens, not serve political rivalries. items.description: Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, ayaa saaka kormeer kedis ah ku tagay xarunta Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Macdanta Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isaga oo u kuur-galay habsami-u-socodka shaqada iyo adeegyada ay Wasaaraddu Qaranka uga masuul tahay iyo gudashada waajibaadka shaqo ee Shaqaalaha Wasaaradda. Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenku intii uu kormeerka ku guda jiray waxa uu mid mid u galay waaxyaha iyo xafiisyada kala duwan ee ay Wasaaradda, isaga oo shaqaalaha ka dhegaystay warbixinno ku saabsan hawlaha shaqo ee ay gacanta ku hayaan iyo qorshayaasha u dejisan waax kasta. Intaa ka dib, Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenku waxa uu kulan gaar ah la yeeshay Wasiirka iyo Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Macdanta JSL, isaga oo ka dhegaystay warbixinno faahfaahsan oo la xidhiidha hawlaha shaqo ee Wasaaradda, qorshayaasha u dejisan, wax-qabadka waaxyaha kala duwan ee Wasaaradda ee iyo hiigsiga Qaran ee la xidhiidha horumarinta khayraadka dabiiciga ah, macdanta iyo adeegyada tamarta ee dalka JSL. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi oo hadal kooban ka jeediyey intii uu ku guda jiray booqashada ayaa sheegay in Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Macdantu ay ka mid tahay Wasaaradaha Qaranka u haya hawlo culus oo istaraatiiji ah, isla markaana door muhiim ah ku leh horumarka dhaqaalaha, koboca maalgashiga shisheeye iyo ka faa’iidaysiga khayraadka dabiiciga ah ee dalka JSL. Waxa uu xusay in Tamarta iyo Macdantu ay yihiin laba qaybood oo leh muhiimad istiraatiiji ah, laf-dhabarna u ah horumarka Qaranka, sidaas darteedna ay lagama maarmaan tahay in Wasaaraddu ay si hufan oo qorshaysan u gudato masuuliyadda Qaran ee ka saaran horumarinta labadaas waaxood. Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenku waxa uu masuuliyiinta iyo shaqaalaha Wasaaradda ku boorriyey in ay muujiyaan dadaal dheeraad ah, xilkasnimo iyo daacadnimo, waxana uu yidhi: “Waxa waajib idinku ah in aad si dhab ah uga soo baxdaan masuuliyadda la idiin igmaday, aad dardargelinta hawlaha shaqo, isla markaana aad xoogga saartaan sidii loo heli lahaa qorshayaal wax-ku-ool ah oo lagu horumarinayo adeegyada tamarta iyo maaraynta khayraadka macdanta. Dawladda waxa ka go’an in Hay’adaha Qaranku si hufan u gutaan waajibaadkooda, waxaana la doonayaa in masuul kasta iyo shaqaale kasta uu dareemo masuuliyadda saaran, kuna dadaalo sidii uu wax ugu tari lahaa horumarka iyo adeegyada qaranka.”

items.title: Sawirro: NISA oo caddeymo soo bandhigtay kadib markii ciidamada Sheekh Shariif…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) oo warsaxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa faah-faahin ka bixisay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo hubeysan oo maalmihii ugu dambeeyay laga dareemay magaalada Muqdisho, kuwaas oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada ammaanka ee dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka dalka. NISA ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo ka amar qaata madaxweynihii hore ee dalka Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed ay isku dayeen inay isk hor imaad ku riixaan ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa ilaalada shacabka ee Hay’adda, xilli ay ku sugnaayeen degmada Wadajir ee gobolk Banaadir. Qoraalka ayaa lagu sheegay in ciidamada Dharcadda ay muujiyeen feejignaan iyo xilkasnimo, isa markaana ay ka fogaadeen tallaabo kasta oo horseedi kartay gacan ka hadal iyo in lagu kor dagaalamo dadka shacabka ee aan waxba galabsan. “Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) waxa ay ka xun tahay, si adagna u cambaareyneysaa weerarrada iyo falalka hubeysan ee lagula kacay ciidamada Ilaalada Shacabka ee Hay’adda, kuwaas oo ka howlgalayay Laanta Koowaad ee Waaxda General Daa’uud, degmada Wadajir ee Gobolka Banaadir. items.title: Imaaraadka oo duqeyn ku laayey shacab Soomaali ah oo ka soo jeeday hal qoys
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Duqeyn ay fulisay diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo laga leeyahay dalka Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa dishay afar qof oo ka tirsan hal qoys Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ku jiraan saddex carruur ah, xilli ay socdeen howlgallo militari oo ka dhan ah kooxda Daacish ee ka dagaallanta buuraha gobolka Bari ee Puntland, sida lagu sheegay baaritaan cusub oo la soo saaray Jimcihii. Duqeynta oo dhacday 26-kii Janaayo 2025, meel u dhow Togga-Xarago ee buuraha Cal Miskaad, ayaa sidoo kale dhaawacday shan qof oo kale, waxayna baabi’isay boqollaal neef oo xoolo ah oo qoyskaasi lahaa, sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta Drop Site News , kadib markii ay wareysatay dadkii ka badbaaday weerarka iyo afar sarkaal oo ka tirsan laamaha ammaanka Puntland. Afarta sarkaal, oo codsaday inaan magacyadooda la shaacin sababo la xiriira xasaasiyadda howlgallada militari, ayaa sheegay in duqeynta ay fuliyeen diyaarado ay maamulayeen ciidamada Imaaraadka, kuwaas oo ka soo duulay saldhig militari oo ku yaalla garoonka diyaaradaha Boosaaso. Khadra Cabdi Ismaaciil, oo 38 jir ah, ayaa Drop Site u sheegtay in qoyskeedu isku diyaarinayey casho, xilli ay iyadu ka baxday aqalkoodii si ay u soo booqato deris. Wax yar kadib, waxay maqashay guuxa diyaarad soo dhowaaneysa, waxaana xigay qarax xooggan oo ku dhacay hoygii qoyska. Weerarka ayaa dilay walaasheed ka weyn, Laadan Cabdi Ismaaciil, iyo wiil ay dhashay oo 13 jir ahaa, Cabdisamad Yuusuf Maxamuud. Waxaa sidoo kale ku dhintay Maxamed Cabdiqani Maxamed oo toddoba jir ahaa iyo Xawo Axmed Saalax oo 17 jir ahayd, isla markaana lahayd uur afar bilood ah. Xawo ayaa gacanta ku haysay ilmaheeda oo siddeed bilood jiray markii duqeyntu dhacday, balse ilmahaasi ayaa ka badbaaday weerarka. “Ilmihii wuu badbaaday, laakiin iyadii ma badbaadin,” ayay Khadra u sheegtay Drop Site. Sida ay warbaahintu sheegtay, safaaradda Imaaraadka ee Muqdisho iyo wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda ee dalkaasi kama aysan jawaabin codsiyo ku saabsanaa inay faallo ka bixiyaan duqeynta iyo howlgallada militari ee Imaaraadku ka fuliyo Puntland. Ilaa hadda ma jiro xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo laga helay dhammaan duruufihii ku xeernaa weerarka, mana jiraan tirokoobyo rasmi ah oo dhammaystiran oo muujinaya khasaaraha dadka rayidka ah ka soo gaaray dagaalka ka dhanka ah Daacish ee ka socda buuraha gobolka Bari. Qoys amniga dartii uga qaxay deegaankiisa Qoyska dhibaatadu gaartay ayaa markii hore ku noolaa deegaanka Dhadaar ee buuraha Cal Miskaad, halkaas oo ay eheladoodu sheegeen in bulshadoodu deggenayd qarniyo badan. Bishii Diseembar 2024, ciidamada ammaanka ayaa dadka deegaanka uga digay joogitaanka dagaalyahannada Daacish, iyagoo qoysas dhowr ah ku amray inay u guuraan goobo kale oo loo sheegay inay ka ammaan badan yihiin halka ay joogeen, sida lagu sheegay baaritaanka. Axmed Cabdi Ismaaciil, oo ay Khadra walaalo yihiin, ayaa sheegay in qoyskoodu raacay amarradaas, kadib markii loo xaqiijiyey in deegaanka cusub uu ka badbaadsan yahay dagaallada socda. Hase yeeshee, goobtii ay u guureen ayaa markii dambe noqotay halka ay duqeyntu ku dhacday. “Waxaa loo sheegay inay guuraan, isla markaana deegaanka cusub uu ka ammaan badan yahay dagaalka, laakiin haddana waa la duqeeyey,” ayuu Axmed u sheegay Drop Site . Duqeynta kadib, dadka badbaaday ayaa dhaawacyada ku qaaday geel ay lahaayeen qoysas deriskooda ah, iyagoo geeyey deegaanka Balidhidin. Dadkii u baahday daryeel caafimaad oo dheeraad ah ayaa markii dambe loo qaaday magaalada Boosaaso. Khadra ayaa sheegtay in Xabiibo Yuusuf Maxamuud, oo ka mid ahayd dadka dhaawacmay, ay weli la ildaran tahay dhaawacyo culus, oo ay ku jiraan gacan aan si wanaagsan u dhaqdhaqaaqin iyo firir ku haray qoorteeda. Marka laga soo tago khasaaraha nafeed, qoysku wuxuu waayey lix neef oo geel ah iyo ku dhowaad 400 oo ari ah, kuwaas oo ahaa isha ugu weyn ee ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd. Inkasta oo muddo ka badan sanad iyo bar ay ka soo wareegtay weerarka, haddana xubnaha qoyska ee badbaaday weli kuma laaban deegaankii ay ka soo qaxeen, maadaama ay waayeen xoolihii ay ku noolaan jireen. Dagaallada ka socda gobolka Bari ayaa sidoo kale barakiciyey tobannaan kun oo qof, sida ay sheegtay Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Laanqeyrta Cas , oo bishii Janaayo ka digtay in colaadaha daba dheeraaday iyo abaaraha daran ay si weyn u saameeyeen nolosha dadka reer miyiga ah. Doorka Imaaraadka ee dagaalka Daacish Puntland ayaa dabayaaqadii 2024 billowday howlgal militari oo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Daacish, kadib markii kooxdaasi ay saldhigyo ka sameysatay buuraha ku yaalla bariga magaalada Boosaaso. Howlgalka oo loogu magac daray Hillaac ayaa taageero dhinaca cirka ah ka helay Mareykanka iyo Imaaraadka Carabta, kuwaas oo duqeymo ku beegsaday fariisimaha kooxda, xilli ciidamada Puntland ay dhulka ka wadeen dagaallo. Ciidamada Puntland ayaa sanadkii 2025 qabsaday saldhigyo muhiim ah oo ay Daacish ku lahayd buuraha, hase yeeshee dagaalyahannada kooxda ayaa sii waday dhaqdhaqaaqyo ay ka sameynayaan dhulka buuraleyda ah ee ay adag tahay in la gaaro. Warbixin ay sanadkan soo saartay Hay’adda Midowga Yurub u qaabilsan Magangelyada ayaa xaqiijisay in Mareykanka iyo Imaaraadku duqeymo ka fuliyeen aaggaas, iyadoo sidoo kale sheegtay in Daacish ay dib ugu soo laabatay deegaanno qaarkood oo hore looga saaray. Bishii May, Somalia Today ayaa werisay in dhaqdhaqaaqyada cusub ee Daacish ay ku khasbeen ciidamada Puntland inay dib u xoojiyaan howlgalladooda, kadib markii uu gaabis ku yimid dagaalkii ka dhanka ahaa kooxda. Hase yeeshee, afarta sarkaal ee Puntland ka tirsan ee la hadlay Drop Site ayaa dhaliilo culus u jeediyey qaar ka mid ah duqeymaha Imaaraadka, iyagoo ku tilmaamay kuwo sababay khasaaro aad u weyn, isla markaana lagu fuliyey taxaddar la’aan. Saraakiisha ayaa ku eedeeyey ciidamada Imaaraadka inaysan si ku filan u kala saarin dadka rayidka ah iyo dagaalyahannada Daacish marka ay beegsanayaan goobo looga shakisan yahay inay kooxdu ku sugan tahay. Mid ka mid ah saraakiisha ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Mareykanku inta badan sameeyaan dabagal iyo kormeer cirka ah oo muddo socda ka hor inta aysan weerarin bartilmaameed, halka uu ku eedeeyey ciidamada Imaaraadka inay muujiyaan taxaddar ka yar. “Waxay u eg tahay inay bartilmaameedyo ku tababaranayaan,” ayuu yiri sarkaal kale. Sida ay saraakiisha Puntland u sheegeen Drop Site, Imaaraadka ayaa joojiyey duqeymihii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn bishii Nofeembar 2025, waxaana Mareykanku wixii xilligaas ka dambeeyey hoggaanka u qabtay howlgallada cirka ee ka dhanka ah Daacish. Taliska ciidamada Mareykanka ee Afrika, AFRICOM, ayaa xaqiijiyey inuu sanadkan 2026 duqeymo ka fuliyey goobo ay Daacish ku leedahay agagaarka Boosaaso, isagoo sheegay in howlgalladaas uu la kaashaday dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, Mareykanka ayaa doonaya inuu ballaariyo joogitaankiisa militari ee garoonka diyaaradaha Boosaaso. Baaritaan la soo bandhigay bishii Sebteembar, oo ay Somalia Today werisay , ayaa faahfaahiyey qorshe lagu dhisayo xarumo taageera duqeymaha Mareykanka iyo howlgallada sirdoonka CIA-da. Xiisadda Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka Eedeymahan cusub ayaa soo baxay xilli uu weli taagan yahay khilaaf ku saabsan joogitaanka militari iyo saameynta siyaasadeed ee Imaaraadka uu ku leeyahay Soomaaliya. Bishii Janaayo ee sanadkan, dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa laashay heshiisyadii ay la gashay Imaaraadka ee la xiriiray amniga, difaaca iyo maareynta dekedaha istaraatiijiga ah, iyadoo Abu Dhabi ku eedeysay inay ku xadgudubtay madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dalka. Maamulka Puntland ayaa diiday go’aankaas , isagoo ku dooday in dowladda federaalku aysan keligeed burin karin heshiisyo khuseeya Puntland, iyada oo aan lagala tashan maamulka. Inkasta oo khilaafka diblomaasiyadeed uu sii xoogaystay, isla markaana la sheegay in Imaaraadku joojiyey duqeymihii uu ka fulin jiray Puntland, haddana Abu Dhabi ayaa sii wadday taageerada ay siiso ciidamada ammaanka maamulkaasi, gaar ahaan Ciidanka Booliska Badda Puntland ee PMPF, sida uu sheegay baaritaanka Drop Site. Taageeradaas ayaa isugu jirta tababar militari, mushaaraad iyo iskaashi dhinaca sirdoonka ah, taas oo muujineysa in Imaaraadku weli door ku leeyahay howlgallada amni ee Puntland. Baaritaanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in madaxweynaha Puntland, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, uu 9-kii Oktoobar ku sugnaa magaalada Abu Dhabi, isagoo soo xiganaya saraakiil amni oo ka warqabay socdaalkiisa. Saraakiishaasi ma aysan shaacin ujeeddada booqashada madaxweynaha Puntland. The post Imaaraadka oo duqeyn ku laayey shacab Soomaali ah oo ka soo jeeday hal qoys appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Marka laga soo tago khasaaraha nafeed, qoysku wuxuu waayey lix neef oo geel ah iyo ku dhowaad 400 oo ari ah, kuwaas oo ahaa isha ugu weyn ee ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd. Inkasta oo muddo ka badan sanad iyo bar ay ka soo wareegtay weerarka, haddana xubnaha qoyska ee badbaaday weli kuma laaban deegaankii ay ka soo qaxeen, maadaama ay waayeen xoolihii ay ku noolaan jireen. Dagaallada ka socda gobolka Bari ayaa sidoo kale barakiciyey tobannaan kun oo qof, sida ay sheegtay Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Laanqeyrta Cas , oo bishii Janaayo ka digtay in colaadaha daba dheeraaday iyo abaaraha daran ay si weyn u saameeyeen nolosha dadka reer miyiga ah. Doorka Imaaraadka ee dagaalka Daacish Puntland ayaa dabayaaqadii 2024 billowday howlgal militari oo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Daacish, kadib markii kooxdaasi ay saldhigyo ka sameysatay buuraha ku yaalla bariga magaalada Boosaaso. Howlgalka oo loogu magac daray Hillaac ayaa taageero dhinaca cirka ah ka helay Mareykanka iyo Imaaraadka Carabta, kuwaas oo duqeymo ku beegsaday fariisimaha kooxda, xilli ciidamada Puntland ay dhulka ka wadeen dagaallo. Ciidamada Puntland ayaa sanadkii 2025 qabsaday saldhigyo muhiim ah oo ay Daacish ku lahayd buuraha, hase yeeshee dagaalyahannada kooxda ayaa sii waday dhaqdhaqaaqyo ay ka sameynayaan dhulka buuraleyda ah ee ay adag tahay in la gaaro. Warbixin ay sanadkan soo saartay Hay’adda Midowga Yurub u qaabilsan Magangelyada ayaa xaqiijisay in Mareykanka iyo Imaaraadku duqeymo ka fuliyeen aaggaas, iyadoo sidoo kale sheegtay in Daacish ay dib ugu soo laabatay deegaanno qaarkood oo hore looga saaray. Bishii May, Somalia Today ayaa werisay in dhaqdhaqaaqyada cusub ee Daacish ay ku khasbeen ciidamada Puntland inay dib u xoojiyaan howlgalladooda, kadib markii uu gaabis ku yimid dagaalkii ka dhanka ahaa kooxda. Hase yeeshee, afarta sarkaal ee Puntland ka tirsan ee la hadlay Drop Site ayaa dhaliilo culus u jeediyey qaar ka mid ah duqeymaha Imaaraadka, iyagoo ku tilmaamay kuwo sababay khasaaro aad u weyn, isla markaana lagu fuliyey taxaddar la’aan. Saraakiisha ayaa ku eedeeyey ciidamada Imaaraadka inaysan si ku filan u kala saarin dadka rayidka ah iyo dagaalyahannada Daacish marka ay beegsanayaan goobo looga shakisan yahay inay kooxdu ku sugan tahay. Mid ka mid ah saraakiisha ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Mareykanku inta badan sameeyaan dabagal iyo kormeer cirka ah oo muddo socda ka hor inta aysan weerarin bartilmaameed, halka uu ku eedeeyey ciidamada Imaaraadka inay muujiyaan taxaddar ka yar. “Waxay u eg tahay inay bartilmaameedyo ku tababaranayaan,” ayuu yiri sarkaal kale. Sida ay saraakiisha Puntland u sheegeen Drop Site, Imaaraadka ayaa joojiyey duqeymihii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn bishii Nofeembar 2025, waxaana Mareykanku wixii xilligaas ka dambeeyey hoggaanka u qabtay howlgallada cirka ee ka dhanka ah Daacish. Taliska ciidamada Mareykanka ee Afrika, AFRICOM, ayaa xaqiijiyey inuu sanadkan 2026 duqeymo ka fuliyey goobo ay Daacish ku leedahay agagaarka Boosaaso, isagoo sheegay in howlgalladaas uu la kaashaday dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, Mareykanka ayaa doonaya inuu ballaariyo joogitaankiisa militari ee garoonka diyaaradaha Boosaaso. Baaritaan la soo bandhigay bishii Sebteembar, oo ay Somalia Today werisay , ayaa faahfaahiyey qorshe lagu dhisayo xarumo taageera duqeymaha Mareykanka iyo howlgallada sirdoonka CIA-da. Xiisadda Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka Eedeymahan cusub ayaa soo baxay xilli uu weli taagan yahay khilaaf ku saabsan joogitaanka militari iyo saameynta siyaasadeed ee Imaaraadka uu ku leeyahay Soomaaliya. Bishii Janaayo ee sanadkan, dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa laashay heshiisyadii ay la gashay Imaaraadka ee la xiriiray amniga, difaaca iyo maareynta dekedaha istaraatiijiga ah, iyadoo Abu Dhabi ku eedeysay inay ku xadgudubtay madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dalka. Maamulka Puntland ayaa diiday go’aankaas , isagoo ku dooday in dowladda federaalku aysan keligeed burin karin heshiisyo khuseeya Puntland, iyada oo aan lagala tashan maamulka. Inkasta oo khilaafka diblomaasiyadeed uu sii xoogaystay, isla markaana la sheegay in Imaaraadku joojiyey duqeymihii uu ka fulin jiray Puntland, haddana Abu Dhabi ayaa sii wadday taageerada ay siiso ciidamada ammaanka maamulkaasi, gaar ahaan Ciidanka Booliska Badda Puntland ee PMPF, sida uu sheegay baaritaanka Drop Site. Taageeradaas ayaa isugu jirta tababar militari, mushaaraad iyo iskaashi dhinaca sirdoonka ah, taas oo muujineysa in Imaaraadku weli door ku leeyahay howlgallada amni ee Puntland. Baaritaanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in madaxweynaha Puntland, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, uu 9-kii Oktoobar ku sugnaa magaalada Abu Dhabi, isagoo soo xiganaya saraakiil amni oo ka warqabay socdaalkiisa. Saraakiishaasi ma aysan shaacin ujeeddada booqashada madaxweynaha Puntland. The post Imaaraadka oo duqeyn ku laayey shacab Soomaali ah oo ka soo jeeday hal qoys appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: NISA oo sheegtay in maleeshiyaad hubeysan ay weerareen ciidamadeeda degmada Wadajir
items.description: Muqdisho – Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) ayaa cambaareysay weerarro ay sheegtay in maleeshiyaad hubeysan ay ku qaadeen ciidamada Ilaalada Shacabka ee hay’adda, kuwaas oo ka howlgalayay Laanta Koowaad ee Waaxda General Daa’uud ee degmada Wadajir, gobolka Banaadir. War-saxaafadeed ay NISA soo saartay 11-ka Oktoobar 2026 ayay ku sheegtay in maleeshiyaadka weerarrada geystay ay ka amar qaataan madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Shariif Sheekh Axmed. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in maleeshiyaadku isku dayeen inay ciidamada amniga ku riixaan iska hor-imaad hubeysan, balse ciidamada Ilaalada Shacabka ay muujiyeen feejignaan, kana fogaadeen tallaabo horseedi karta gacan-ka-hadal iyo waxyeello soo gaarta dadka rayidka ah. NISA ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in caddeymaha ay uruurisay ay muujinayaan in maleeshiyaad ku hubeysan qoryaha AK-47, BKM iyo RPG ay xoog ku galeen guryo ku yaalla xaafadda Tiintiinley ee degmada Wadajir. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa lagu xusay in 24-kii Juun 2026 ay maleeshiyaadku weerar ku qaadeen ciidamada Ilaalada Shacabka, isla markaana ay afduubteen mid ka mid ah askartii gudanaysay waajibaadkeeda. Sidoo kale, NISA waxay sheegtay in 27-kii Juun isla sannadkaas ay maleeshiyaadku mar kale hor istaageen howlgallada amni ee ciidamada ka wadeen Waaxda General Daa’uud. Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka ayaa sheegtay inay tahay hay’ad amni oo ku shaqeysa sharciga, kana madax-bannaan loollanka siyaasadeed, iyadoo xustay inaysan oggolaan doonin in ciidamadeeda lagu dhex jiido khilaafaadka siyaasadeed. NISA waxay intaas ku dartay inay ka go’an tahay gudashada waajibaadkeeda sharci, ilaalinta xasilloonida caasimadda iyo ka hortagga fal kasta oo khatar gelin kara nabadgelyada bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Eedeymahan ayaa ku saabsan dhacdooyin ay NISA sheegtay inay ka dhaceen degmada Wadajir, mana jiraan faahfaahin kale oo ku saabsan dhinaca kale oo ku jirta war-saxaafadeedka hay’addu soo saartay.

items.title: Cumar Cartan oo ku biiraya garsoorayaasha horyaalka…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Garsooraha caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliyeed, Cumar Cabdiqaadir Cartan ayaa suuragal ah inuu garsooro kulammada Horyaalka Premier League-ga Masar kadib markii Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya uu codsi rasmi ah u gudbiyay dhiggiisa dalkaas. Warbaahinta Masar ayaa baahisay in codsiga Soomaaliya la gaarsiiyay mas’uuliyiinta kubadda cagta dalkaas, iyadoo hadda la sugayo go’aanka kama dambaysta ah ee Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Masar. La-taliyaha dhinaca garsoorka ee Masar, Samiir Cusmaan ayaa xaqiijiyay inay heleen warqadda ka timid Soomaaliya, isagoo sheegay in maamulka garsoorku taageersan yahay in Cartan uu ka mid noqdo garsoorayaasha horyaalka dalkaas. “Haa, waxaan helnay warqad ka timid Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya, waxaana sugaynaa go’aanka Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Masar. Annaga oo dhinaca maamulka ah waan oggolnahay, wuxuuna wax weyn ku soo kordhin doonaa horyaalka Masar,” ayuu yiri Samiir Cusmaan. Arrintan ayaa timid kadib markii baraha bulshada ay ku faafeen warar sheegaya in garsooraha Soomaaliyeed uu ku biirayo garsoorayaasha ka shaqeeya horyaalka Masar, inkastoo xiriirka dalkaas uusan weli shaacin go’aanka rasmiga ah. Cumar Cartan ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyay sumcad ka dhex sameystay garsoorayaasha kubadda cagta ee qaaradda Afrika. Waxa uu helay aqoonsi heer qaaradeed ah, wuxuuna ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Garsooraha Sanadka ee Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Afrika (CAF). Horyaalka Masar ayaa ka mid ah tartamada kubadda cagta ee sida weyn looga daawado qaaradda Afrika, waxaana ka qeyb gala kooxo taariikhi ah iyo ciyaartoy tayo leh. Haddii codsiga Soomaaliya la oggolaado, waxay Cartan u noqon doontaa fursad uu khibraddiisa garsoornimo ugu sii ballaariyo tartamada caalamiga ah. items.title: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya oo qaabilay safiirka Britain
items.description: Muqdisho – 11-ka Oktoobar 2026: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta xarunta Madaxtooyada Villa Soomaaliya ku qaabilay safiirka dowladda Britain u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Charles King. Kulanka dhexmaray Madaxweynaha iyo safiirka Britain ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga soo jireenka ah ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Midowday ee Britain. Labada dhinac ayaa ka wada hadlay arrimo ay ka mid yihiin mudnaanta labada dal, danaha ay wadaagaan iyo sii wadista wada-shaqeynta lagu horumarinayo nabadda, xasilloonida iyo horumarka Soomaaliya. Kulankan ayaa mar kale muujinaya muhiimadda uu xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo Britain u leeyahay iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan, gaar ahaan dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabad waarta iyo horumar dalka ka hanaqaada. Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in kulanka lagu adkeeyay sii wadista iskaashiga labada dal iyo horumarinta arrimaha ay danaha wadajirka ah ka leeyihiin.
