items.title: DF oo si weyn u kordhisay tababarada ciidamada cusub iyo afar gobol oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa dardar-gelisay qorista dhallinyaro cusub oo lagu biirinayo ciidamada kala duwan ee dalka, iyadoo isu diyaarineysa in ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay la wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga marka la dhimo ama la soo afjaro howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Qorista ciidamada cusub ayaa ka socota gobolka Banaadir iyo maamullada HirShabelle, Galmudug iyo Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo dhallinyarada la qorayo lagu biirinayo ciidanka xoogga, booliska iyo hay’adaha kale ee amniga qaranka. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, madaxda sare ee dowladda iyo hoggaanka ciidamada ayaa mudnaan siinaya diyaarinta ciidan cusub oo xoojiya awoodda amni ee dalka, isla markaana la wareega waajibaadka ay hadda qayb ahaan gutaan ciidamada Midowga Afrika. Xeryaha lagu tababaro ciidamada cusub oo ku kala yaalla Muqdisho iyo qaybo kamid ah gobollada dalka ayaa waxaa booqday mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda, saraakiil ciidan iyo xubno kale oo u kuur-galaya tababarrada iyo diyaar-garowga dhallinyarada la qoray. Qorshaha dowladda ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli la filayo in sannadka 2027 wax laga beddelo joogitaanka ciidamada AUSSOM ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo ay suuragal tahay in tiradooda la dhimo ama qaybo kamid ah dalka laga saaro. Tallaabooyinka hadda socda ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada qaranka ka hor isbeddelkaas. Marka la barbar dhigo sannadihii hore, ciidamada dowladda ayaa haysta fursado dheeraad ah oo la xiriira tababarrada, qalabka milatari iyo taageerada dalalka saaxiibka la ah Soomaaliya. Taageeradaasi waxay muhiim u tahay qorshaha lagu dhisayo ciidan awood u leh inuu si madax-bannaan u sugo amniga dalka. Qorista ciidamada ayaa la xiriirta fursadaha ay dowladda ka heshay dhinaca qalabka iyo taageerada amni, gaar ahaan kaddib markii laga qaaday cunaqabatayntii hubka ee saarnayd Soomaaliya, taas oo u sahashay inay hesho qalab milatari oo dheeraad ah. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale dooneysa inay xoojiso awoodda ciidamadeeda si ay u sugto amniga xarumaha dowladda, hay’adaha qaranka iyo madaxda sare, iyadoo yareyneysa ku tiirsanaanta ciidamada shisheeye. Si kastaba, guusha qorshahan waxay ku xirnaan doontaa tayada tababarka, helitaanka hub iyo saanad ku filan, joogtaynta mushaharka ciidamada iyo awoodda dowladda ee ay ku maareyn karto mas’uuliyadda amniga marka la dhimo taageerada Midowga Afrika. Tallaabooyinka hadda socda ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada qaranka ka hor isbeddelkaas. Marka la barbar dhigo sannadihii hore, ciidamada dowladda ayaa haysta fursado dheeraad ah oo la xiriira tababarrada, qalabka milatari iyo taageerada dalalka saaxiibka la ah Soomaaliya. Taageeradaasi waxay muhiim u tahay qorshaha lagu dhisayo ciidan awood u leh inuu si madax-bannaan u sugo amniga dalka. Qorista ciidamada ayaa la xiriirta fursadaha ay dowladda ka heshay dhinaca qalabka iyo taageerada amni, gaar ahaan kaddib markii laga qaaday cunaqabatayntii hubka ee saarnayd Soomaaliya, taas oo u sahashay inay hesho qalab milatari oo dheeraad ah. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale dooneysa inay xoojiso awoodda ciidamadeeda si ay u sugto amniga xarumaha dowladda, hay’adaha qaranka iyo madaxda sare, iyadoo yareyneysa ku tiirsanaanta ciidamada shisheeye. Si kastaba, guusha qorshahan waxay ku xirnaan doontaa tayada tababarka, helitaanka hub iyo saanad ku filan, joogtaynta mushaharka ciidamada iyo awoodda dowladda ee ay ku maareyn karto mas’uuliyadda amniga marka la dhimo taageerada Midowga Afrika. items.title: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Dastuurka oo dalbaday in la dardargeliyo dib-u-habaynta garsoorka Muqdisho
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Dib-u-eegista iyo Hirgelinta Dastuurka Soomaaliya, Avv. Burhaan Aadan Cumar, ayaa qoraal rasmi ah u diray Guddoomiyaha Golaha Sare ee Garsoorka Dalka ahna Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isagoo ka dalbaday in si degdeg ah loo qaado tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka u ah dib-u-habaynta garsoorka caasimadda Muqdisho. Qoraalka uu guddoomiyuhu diray ayaa la xiriira hirgelinta qodobbada Dastuurka ee khuseeya garsoorka caasimadda, si loo waafajiyo qaab-dhismeedka iyo habsami-u-socodka hay’adaha garsoorka ee Muqdisho Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Avv. Burhaan Aadan Cumar ayaa codsigiisa ku saleeyay axkaamta ku xusan qodobbada 63aad, 129aad iyo 132aad ee Dastuurka, isaga oo sidoo kale tixraacay Qodobka 191aad, faqraddiisa labaad, kaas oo uu sheegay inuu saldhig u yahay waafajinta arrintan Dastuurka. Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo aadaysa xilli ay socdaan dadaallada lagu hirgelinayo Dastuurka Soomaaliya iyo waafajinta hay’adaha dowladda iyo nidaamyadooda sharciyeed qodobbada Dastuurka. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Dastuurka ayaa qoraalkiisa ku adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in si degdeg ah loo qaado tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah, si dib-u-habaynta garsoorka caasimadda loogu waafajiyo Dastuurka dalka. Hirgelinta qodobbada Dastuurka ee khuseeya garsoorka caasimadda ayaa muhiim u ah dhismaha nidaam garsoor oo ku shaqeeya qaab waafaqsan Dastuurka iyo shuruucda dalka.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo la kulmay Guddiga Xuquuqul Insaanka, Haweenka iyo Arrimaha Bani’aadanimada
items.description: Muqdisho – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa kulan la qaatay Guddiga Xuquuqul Insaanka, Haweenka iyo Arrimaha Bani’aadanimada ee Golaha Shacabka, iyagoo ka wada hadlay dardargelinta howlaha guddiga iyo dhammaystirka hindise-sharciyeedyada horyaalla. Kulanka oo ka dhacay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sidii loo dardargelin lahaa shaqada guddiga, loona dhammaystiri lahaa hindise-sharciyeedyada la xiriira xuquuqda aadanaha iyo arrimaha bulshada, kuwaas oo la doonayo in loo gudbiyo Golaha Shacabka. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa guddiga faray inuu mudnaan gaar ah siiyo ka shaqaynta shuruucda la xiriirta xuquuqda haweenka, qoyska iyo carruurta, si loo xoojiyo ilaalinta xuquuqdooda iyo dhowrista karaamadooda. Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo doorka Golaha Shacabka ee sharci-dejinta iyo korjoogteynta, gaar ahaan ilaalinta xuquuqda muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in ay ka go’an tahay in Golaha Shacabka uu sii xoojiyo dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo dhowrista xuquuqda iyo karaamada muwaadin kasta, iyo helitaanka caddaalad loo siman yahay. Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu dardargelinayo howlaha guddiyada Golaha Shacabka iyo diyaarinta shuruucda la xiriirta xuquuqda aadanaha iyo arrimaha bani’aadanimada.

items.title: Mucaaradka oo ka digay ciidan lagu arkay xaafadahooda
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xubnaha mucaaradka ee la baxay Madasha Samatabixinta ayaa digniin culus kasoo saaray ciidamo ‘lagu arkay aggaarka xaafadaha ay dagan yihiin ee aaga hoteel Jasiira’ ee magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo dhaq-dhaqaaq laga dareemay halkaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa ammaanka oo wata gaadiidka dagaalka la geeyay aagga laami yaraha Zoobe iyo aagga waddada garoonka Aadan Cadde, taas oo keentay walaac xooggan oo ku aadan xaaladda soo korortay iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqa ciidankaasi. Xisbiga Himilo Qaran ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweynihii hore ee dowladdii KMG ahayd, Sheekh Shariif SheekH Axmed oo warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa daan-daansi ku tilmaamay abaabulka ciidan ee ay waddo dowladda, isaga oo eedeyn u jeediyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Sidoo kale, Xisbiga Himilo Qaran ayaa si gaar ah u cambaareeyay tallaabooyin uu sheegay in lagu khal-khalgelinayo amniga iyo wada-hadallada u socda mucaaradka iyo dowladda Soomaaliya, iyadoo xisbigu sheegay in arrintan ay dhaawici karto dowladnimada Soomaaliya. “Xisbiga Himilo Qaran wuxuu si dhow ula socdaa daan-daansiga, xasarad abuurrka, hurrinta colaado sokeeye iyo abaabulka ciidamo si gaar ah uga amar qaata Madaxweynaha sharc-darrada ku jooga Villa Somalia ee Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Wuxuu Xisbigu cambaareynayaa tallaabooyinka qaar iska tuurka ah oo lagu khal-khalgelinayo bulshada caasimadda, laguna carqaladeynayo wadahadallada siyaasadeed, islamarkaana dib u celin karta dowladnimada jilicsan ee aan haysano,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Waxaa kale oo uu bayaanka kusii daray “Xisbiga Himilo Qaran wuxuu ummadda Soomaaliyeed la wadaagayaa in Madaxweynaha muddo-xileedkiisu dhammaaday uu qaadi doono mas’uuliyadda iyo cawaaqib-xumo kasta oo ka dhalata duullaan lagu qaado xarumaha siyaasiyiinta”. Dhanka kale, Xisbiga Himilo Qaran wuxuu saraakiisha iyo ciidanka qaranka uga digay qaadashada amarro baal-marsan dowladnimada oo lagu beegsanayo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka. Ugu dambayn, Xisbiga Himilo Qaran ayaa soo jeediyay in si deg-deg ah looga heshiiyo muranka ka taagan doorashada, wuxuuna sidoo kale madaxweynaha ugu baaqay inuu ka waantoobo qalalaase dagaal oo aan la ogayn natiijadiisu meesha ay ku dhammaanayso. “Xisbiga Himilo Qaran wuxuu xalka u arkaa in si deg deg ah looga heshiiyo doorashada dalka, si loo helo hay’ad dowladeed oo haysta sharciyad iyo kalsoonida ummadda Soomaaliyeed, wuxuuna xisbigu ugu yeerayaa madaxweynaha muddo dhaafka ah ee Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud in uu ka waantoobo qalalaase dagaal oo aan la ogayn natiijadiisu meesha ay ku dhammaanayso, taas beddelkeedana uu diiradda saaro heshiis siyaasadeed oo dhab ah, kuna saabsan arrimaha doorashooyinka oo ah dariiqa keliya ee dalka lagu samatabixin karo,” ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyay warsaxaafadeedka The post Mucaaradka oo ka digay ciidan lagu arkay xaafadahooda appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maxay DF Soomaaliya ka tiri guusha Sagal Cabdiweli?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa xiriir la sameeyay Sagal Abdi-Wali oo ah gabadh Soomaaliyeed oo dhowaan loo doortay in ay noqoto xildhibaan ka tirsan baarlamaanka dalka Boqortooyadda Ingiriiska, isaga oo ugu hambalyeeyay guusha taariikhiga ay ee gaartay. Xamza ayaa u rajeeyay Sagal inuu Ebbe u fududeeyo mas’uuliyadda culus ee loo igmaday, wuxuuna tilmaamay in guusheeda ay ku farsaxan yihiin shacabka iyo dowladda Soomaaliyeed. “Waxaan qadka taleefoonka kula hadlay Sagal Cabdi Weli oo ah gabadh Soomaaliyeed oo dhowaan loo doortay in ay noqoto xildhibaan ka tirsan baarlamaanka dalka Boqortooyadda Ingiriiska. Waxaan Sagal ugu hambalyeeyay guusha weyn ee ay ka gaartay doorashada, waxaanan u rajeeyay in alle u fududeeyo xilka culus ee ay xambaartay, aniga oo u sheegay sida dowladda, madaxda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeedba ay ugu faraxsanyihiin guusheeda oo ah mid taariikhi ah,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in Sagaal u tsaale u noqotay dadka Soomaaliyeed meel kasta oo ay joogaan, isaga oo xusay inay muujisay karti iyo dadaal dheeri ah. “Sagal waxa ay tusaale wanaagsan u tahay qurba-joogta Soomaaliyeed ee dunida meelo kala duwan ku nool ee dedaalkooda iyo kartidooda ku gaaray xilal iyo darajooyin waaweyn,” Xamza ayaa sidoo kale Sagal kula dardaarmay in ay si hufan u gudato xilkeeda, u shaqayso bulshadii baarlamaanka u dirsatay, kana qeybqaadato dedaal kasta oo lagu sii xoojinaya xiriirka iskaashi ee ka dhaxeeya Soomaaliya iyo UK. Sagal oo la sheegay inay dhalatay bishii Juun 1984 ayaa doorashada ku gashay loollan adag, iyadoo ka guuleysatay musharrax ka socday Xisbiga Cagaaran (Green Party) oo lagu magacaabo Zack Polanski. Kursigan waxaa hore ugu metelayay Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Britain, Keir Starmer, kaas oo horay u hayay xilka xildhibaannimo ee deegaanka Holborn and St Pancras. Sagal ayaa noqonaysa haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee asal ahaan Soomaali ah, isla markaana Muslim ah, oo ku guuleysata kursigaas. Waxaa la filayaa inay gasho Aqalka Baarlamaanka Britain iyadoo xiran xijaab. Guusheeda ayaa muujinaysa sida dadka asal ahaan Soomaaliyeed ay uga dhex muuqanayaan siyaasadda dalalka ay degeen, iyagoo u tartamaya xilal kala duwan oo heer deegaan iyo heer qaran ah. The post Maxay DF Soomaaliya ka tiri guusha Sagal Cabdiweli? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Faah-faahinta howlgallo culus oo ka socda gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa howlgallo ka dhan ah kooxda Al-Shabaab ka wada deegaanno ku yaalla bariga gobolka Hiiraan, iyagoo kaashanaya ciidamada dadka deegaanka ee Macawiisleyda. Howlgalladan ayaa ujeeddadoodu tahay in laga hortago dhaq-dhaqaaqyada Al-Shabaab iyo cadaadiska ay kooxdu ku hayso deegaannada bariga gobolka, isla markaana lagu xaqiijiyo amniga deegaannadaas. Ciidamada dowladda iyo Macawiisleyda ayaa iska kaashanaya dadaallada lagu xoojinayo difaaca deegaannada, xilli ay sii socdaan isku dhacyada iyo weerarrada lala xiriirinayo Al-Shabaab ee ka dhaca qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Hiiraan. Iskaashiga ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa dadka deegaanka ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo amniga gobolka, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo difaaca deegaannada iyo ka hortagga dhaq-dhaqaaqyada kooxda Al-Shabaab. Dhanka kale, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa wada qorshe ay ciidamo dheeraad ah ugu dirayso deegaanno ka tirsan maamulka HirShabelle, si loo xoojiyo awoodda ciidamada loogana hortago weerarrada lagu beegsanayo saldhigyada milatariga. Qorshahan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada dowladda ee lagu xoojinayo amniga deegaannada ay ciidamada ka howlgalaan, iyadoo la doonayo in la kordhiyo awoodda ciidamada ku sugan furimaha dagaalka. Si kastaba, weli lama shaacin tirada ciidamada dheeraadka ah ee la dirayo iyo deegaannada sida gaarka ah loo geyn doono, iyadoo aan la bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan waqtiga la fulinayo qorshahan. items.title: Somalia: Government forces mass near opposition leaders’ homes
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Large numbers of government forces have been deployed around the residences of Somalia’s former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed and former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire near Mogadishu airport. Local media increasingly report that President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud intends to launch a military operation to disarm opposition leaders. Military trucks and armoured vehicles were seen racing to the area on Saturday night, prompting fears that clashes could erupt overnight. As of Sunday, heavily armed units remained near the opposition politicians’ homes on Jayga Road. Three-day ultimatum reported Zakariye Timo-adde, an exiled Somali journalist, reported on Saturday night that President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud had told clan elders with ties to Sharif that he would launch an operation to disarm him within three days unless he laid down his weapons voluntarily. The journalist said the president had also rebuffed a proposal from Sharif to de-escalate the situation. Somaliguardian could not independently verify the report. Government officials had not responded to a request for comment at the time of publication. On Sunday, a security official, whom local journalists identify as the commander of the forces assigned to the operation against Sharif and Khaire, wrote on Facebook that no one would be permitted to bear arms in Mogadishu. He described the measure as necessary for the security of the city and the safety of its residents. Sharif urges dialogue Sharif addressed the planned operation this week in guarded terms. He said the opposition were not enemies of the government and that nothing justified a government attack upon them. He urged the authorities to engage in dialogue with all those who hold differing views rather than resort to the gun, which, he said, serves neither the interests of the state nor the resolution of the present political deadlock. Echoes of June The deployment revives memories of two days of clashes in June between the guards of both former leaders and government forces. The opposition said the violence stemmed from separate attacks by government forces on compounds hosting its leaders. The fighting ended after international intervention and swift diplomatic efforts, which persuaded both men to return to their residences near the airport and the government to grant them safe passage. Before the clashes of 3 June, the two men had set up temporary residences in Mogadishu neighbourhoods where their clans are powerful and predominant: Sharif in Abdiaziz district and Khaire in Howlwadag. They said they came under attack there, with the authorities using artillery and suicide drones. Warnings of wider conflict For many months, some Somali analysts have warned that such a conflict could pit clans against one another, much as the four-month clan war between General Mohamed Farah Aidid and Ali Mahdi did in the early 1990s. Abdikarim Ali Kar, a former presidential spokesman, recently warned against the operation. He said that if the president believed he alone could defeat and disarm Sharif, events could just as easily turn against him, leaving Somalia in collapse on his watch and returning the country to full-scale civil war like that of 1991. He added that the airport, close to the opposition leaders’ residences, would be caught in the crossfire and forced to close. It is also widely argued that such a war could help militants infiltrate the capital and drain state resources, with insurgents still holding areas less than 30 kilometres from Mogadishu. It is not yet clear whether the government is determined to launch the operation, or how far it would go. Turkish support and Sharif’s standing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has secured substantial military support from Turkey, which has heavily armed government forces. In recent months, Turkey has also moved to provide air support when federal forces engage opposition fighters, as was seen repeatedly in clashes between the government and forces loyal to the ousted Southwest State President Abdiaziz Laftagareen. Sharif led the Union of Islamic Courts, which drove the powerful warlords from Mogadishu in 2006. He later led the Alliance for the Re-liberation of Somalia, one of the armed groups that fought Ethiopian forces after their invasion in late 2006, and subsequently became president. During his presidency he fought the militant group Al-Shabaab, which nearly captured Mogadishu in 2009, coming within a few metres of his seat at Villa Somalia before withdrawing under pressure from African Union forces. Sharif is widely believed to be well armed and to enjoy the full backing of his Harti Agoonyar clansmen of the Abgaal, the clan to which President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud also belongs, though from a different sub-clan, Wacaysle. Analysis To President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, Sharif is the lone thorn in his side: the sole impediment to his reported ambition to cling to office in the manner of his Djiboutian ally, Ismail Omar Guelleh. Heavily armed and sustained by the steadfast allegiance of his clan, Sharif is the only figure with the means to mount formidable resistance against any attempt to prolong a tenure for many more years without recourse to an election. Whether that thorn can be plucked with ease, however, remains profoundly uncertain. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Xaaladda Baydhaba oo laga digayo – Maxaa soo kordhay?
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Isku-dubaridka Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada (OCHA) ayaa walaac ka muujiyay colaadda ka taagan magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay, isagoo ka digay in rabshadaha soo noqnoqday ay sii xumeynayaan xaaladda nololeed ee dadka deegaanka. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in dagaalladu ay dhibaato hor leh ku hayaan bulshada oo markii horeba la tacaalaysay abaaro, barakac daba-dheeraaday iyo duruufo nololeed oo adag, taas oo sii kordhinaysa baahida loo qabo gargaar bani’aadannimo. Dadka ay xaaladdu sida gaarka ah u saameysay waxaa ka mid ah barakacayaasha, haweenka, carruurta, waayeelka iyo dadka naafada ah, kuwaas oo wajahaya khataro dheeraad ah oo ka dhashay amni-darrada iyo barakaca soo noqnoqday. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka OCHA, colaadda ayaa qoysas badan ku khasabtay inay ka baxaan guryahooda, iyagoo luminaya hoygoodii iyo fursadihii ay ku heli lahaayeen adeegyada aasaasiga ah iyo gargaarka ay u baahan yihiin. Xafiiska ayaa sidoo kale ka digay in xaaladda bani’aadannimo ay kasii dari karto, iyadoo ay jiraan walaacyo la xiriira khatarta macaluusha, nafaqo-darrada carruurta iyo saadaasha daadadka ka dhasha roobabka la xiriira El Niño. OCHA ayaa dhinacyada ku lugta leh dagaalka ugu baaqday inay si degdeg ah u dejiyaan xiisadaha, muujiyaan is-xakameyn, kana fogaadaan tallaabo kasta oo sii hurin karta colaadda ama halis gelin karta shacabka. Hay’addu waxay carrabka ku adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah iyo kaabayaasha ay ku tiirsan yihiin, iyadoo xustay in sharciga caalamiga ah ee bani’aadannimadu dhigayo in la dhowro xarumaha caafimaadka, isbitaallada, dugsiyada iyo goobaha kale ee rayidka. Waxay si gaar ah uga digtay weerarrada lagu qaado xarumaha caafimaadka, iyadoo ku baaqday in shaqaalaha gargaarka iyo hantida hay’adaha bani’aadannimada laga ilaaliyo khataraha amni ee ka dhasha colaadda. Sidoo kale, OCHA ayaa dalbatay in hay’adaha gargaarka loo oggolaado marin ammaan ah oo degdeg ah, si ay kaalmo u gaarsiiyaan dadka ay dagaalladu saameeyeen, iyada oo aan la hor istaagin ama la takoorin dadka u baahan taageerada. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in hay’adaha bani’aadannimada ee Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay caawinta dadka ugu nugul, ayna diyaar u yihiin inay la shaqeeyaan maamulka iyo bulshada si loo yareeyo dhibaatada haysata shacabka. Ugu dambeyntiina, OCHA waxay ku celisay baaqeeda ah in si degdeg ah loo joojiyo rabshadaha, lagana hortago barakac hor leh iyo dhibaato kale oo soo gaarta nolosha iyo karaamada dadka rayidka ah ee ku nool Baydhabo. The post Xaaladda Baydhaba oo laga digayo – Maxaa soo kordhay? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Trump oo Sheegtay inuu Xalliyey Siddeed Dagaal, Dhaliilna ka Muujiyay Billadda Nabadda oo uusan Helin
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu door weyn ka qaatay xallinta siddeed dagaal, isla markaana uu ku dhow yahay inuu soo afjaro ama heshiis ka gaaro laba kale, isagoo dhaliilay in isaga iyo Mareykankuba aysan helin abaalmarinta Billadda Nabadda. Qoraal uu ku baahiyey baraha bulshada, Trump ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dib loo soo celiyey dhammaan la haystayaashii Israa’iil, oo ay ku jiraan 28-kii ugu dambeeyey, kuwaas oo isugu jiray kuwo nool iyo kuwo dhintay, waxa uuna intaas ku daray in la sii daayey boqolaal la haystayaal ah oo u kala dhashay dalal kala duwan oo dunida ah. Trump ayaa qoraalkiisa ku muujiyey in dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee uu hoggaamiyey ay wax weyn ka beddeleen xaaladaha colaadeed ee ka jiray meelo kala duwan oo dunida ah. Waxa uu sheegay in heshiisyada iyo wada-xaajoodyada la gaaray ay gacan ka geysteen yareynta rabshadaha, furitaanka waddooyinka gargaarka iyo soo celinta dadkii lagu haystay xaalado adag. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in doorka Mareykanka uu ahaa mid muhiim u ah cadaadiska lagu saaray dhinacyada isku haya inay miiska wada-hadalka ku soo laabtaan. Sida uu sheegay, maamulka Washington wuxuu adeegsaday wada-xaajood, cadaadis siyaasadeed iyo iskaashi caalami ah si loo gaaro heshiisyo lagu joojinayo dagaallada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, sheegashooyinka Trump ayaa dhaliyey dood iyo su’aalo ku saabsan tirada dagaallada uu sheegay inuu xalliyey, iyo heerka uu dhab ahaan uga qayb qaatay heshiisyadaas. Qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha ayaa xusay in xallinta khilaafaadyada caalamiga ahi ay inta badan ku lug leeyihiin dowlado badan, ururro caalami ah iyo dadaallo muddo dheer socday, sidaas darteedna ay adkaan karto in guusha loo tixgeliyo hal hoggaamiye oo keliya. Dhanka kale, Trump wuxuu si cad u muujiyey sida uu uga xumaaday in aan loo guddoonsiin abaalmarinta Nobel-ka Nabadda, waxa uuna sheegay in haddii la tixgeliyo dadaallada uu ku bixiyey joojinta colaadaha iyo sii deynta la haystayaasha, isaga iyo Mareykankuba ay mudnaayeen in lagu daro dadka ama hay’adaha loo magacaabo abaalmarinta. Abaalmarinta Nobel-ka Nabadda waxaa sannad kasta la siiyaa qof, koox ama hay’ad loo arko inay si weyn uga shaqeysay nabadda, xalinta khilaafaadka ama horumarinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah. go’aanka guddiga Nobel-ka waxaa lagu saleeyaa qiimeyn madax-bannaan, waxaana marar badan dhaca in siyaasiyiin iyo hoggaamiyeyaal dunidu ay ku kala aragti duwanaadaan cidda mudan abaalmarinta.

Abaalmarinta Nobel-ka Nabadda waxaa sannad kasta la siiyaa qof, koox ama hay’ad loo arko inay si weyn uga shaqeysay nabadda, xalinta khilaafaadka ama horumarinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah. go’aanka guddiga Nobel-ka waxaa lagu saleeyaa qiimeyn madax-bannaan, waxaana marar badan dhaca in siyaasiyiin iyo hoggaamiyeyaal dunidu ay ku kala aragti duwanaadaan cidda mudan abaalmarinta.

items.title: Pakistan oo Xaalad Degdeg ah ku Soo Rogtay Gobol uu Taageero Badan ku leeyahay Imran Khan
items.description: Dowladda Pakistan ayaa xaalad degdeg ah ku soo rogtay gobolka Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ee waqooyi-galbeed dalkaasi, tallaabadaas oo si weyn u saameynaysa maamulka gobolka oo ay hoggaamiso xisbiga Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), ee uu leeyahay ra’iisul wasaarihii hore Imran Khan oo xiran. Xaaladda degdegga ah ayaa Axaddii lagu dhaqan-geliyay iyadoo la adeegsanayo laba qodob oo ka mid ah dastuurka dalka, kuwaas oo la xiriira arrimaha amniga. Tallaabadan ayaa si wax ku ool ah u hakineysa awoodda dowladda gobolka ee uu hoggaamiyo xisbiga PTI. Madaxweynaha Pakistan, Asif Ali Zardari, ayaa sheegay inuu ansixiyay soo jeedintii Golaha Wasiirrada, kaas oo kulan uu hoggaaminayay Ra’iisul Wasaare Shehbaz Sharif ka yeeshay xaaladda gobolka. War-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa lagu sheegay in Golaha Wasiirradu ay dib u eegeen xaaladda amni, isla markaana ay walaac ka muujiyeen waxa ay ku tilmaameen “ka go’itaanka ula kaca ah ee dowladda gobolka ee dagaalka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.” Go’aankan ayaa imaanaya xilli xisbiga PTI uu diyaarinayay bannaanbax iyo socod lagu tegi lahaa caasimadda Islamabad, kaas oo looga dalbanayo in xabsiga laga sii daayo Imran Khan, oo xirnaa in ka badan saddex sano, balse weli taageero ballaaran ku leh dalka Pakistan. Tallaabadan ayaa la filayaa inay saameyn ku yeelato xiriirka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo maamulka gobolka, iyadoo faahfaahin dheeraad ah laga sugayo qaabka loo dhaqan-gelinayo xaaladda degdegga ah iyo tallaabooyinka xigi doona.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh iyo Safiirka Ingiriiska oo yeeshay wada-hadallo cusub oo muhiim ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Madaxtooyada Qaranka ku qaabilay safiirka dowladda Ingiriiska u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Charles King, iyagoo ka wada-hadlay xaaladda amni iyo tan siyaasadeed ee dalka. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray arrimaha mudnaanta u leh labada dhinac, iyadoo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu safiirka la wadaagay warbixin ku saabsan xaaladda amni iyo siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Dhankiisa, safiirka Ingiriiska ayaa Madaxweynaha kala hadlay doorka ay dowladdiisu ka qaadan karto arrimaha laga wada-hadlay, gaar ahaan taageerada la xiriirta amniga iyo xasilloonida siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Dowladda Ingiriiska ayaa ka mid ah saaxiibada caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya ka taageera dhinacyada amniga iyo dhismaha hay’adaha dowladda, iyadoo labada dhinac ay hore u sheegeen inay iska kaashanayaan xoojinta awoodda hay’adaha amniga iyo kuwa kale ee dowliga ah. London ayaa sidoo kale ka mid ah dalalka taageera howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), kaas oo ciidamada ka jooga dalka ay kaga qeyb qaataan dadaallada amniga. Howlgalkan ayaa wajahaya caqabado la xiriira maalgelinta, taas oo sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo joogtaynta howlaha amniga. Kulanka Xasan Sheekh iyo Charles King ayaa imaanaya xilli ay Soomaaliya waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo amniga, isla markaana ay jiraan wada-hadallo iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo siyaasadeed oo la xiriira xaaladda dalka iyo mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM. The post Xasan Sheekh iyo Safiirka Ingiriiska oo yeeshay wada-hadallo cusub oo muhiim ah appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Saudi Arabia: 12 killed, 300 injured in Riyadh airport attack
items.description: RIYADH (Somaliguardian) – At least 12 people were ​killed and more than 300 wounded in an attack on Riyadh’s international airport on Saturday, the deadliest in the kingdom in more than a decade, as ‌the Iran-backed Houthis escalate a campaign they launched this summer. The dead from the third attack this week on the airport included four Saudis, two people from Bangladesh and one person each from the US, Jordan, Palestine, Syria, Sudan and Egypt, the Saudi civil aviation authority said. At the latest count, 309 were wounded, officials said. President Donald Trump said Washington was considering joining Saudi strikes on the Houthis in the conflict, a spillover ​from the war on Iran that the US and Israel launched in February. Hospitals were flooded with wounded brought by ambulance and helicopter, some in critical condition after ​the attack, which occurred without warning. CONFLICT ESCALATES AFTER YEMEN WAR CEASEFIRE UNRAVELS The two previous attacks on King Khalid International Airport this week killed ⁠four and caused heavy damage to a Saudi commercial plane parked on the tarmac. The strikes have exposed vulnerabilities in Saudi defence capabilities as it wages an air campaign against the ​Houthis to support a ground war by the Yemeni government against the Iran-backed group. The Houthis have not claimed responsibility for the attack, but a Saudi-led military coalition vowed to respond. Trump, asked ​whether the US planned to join Saudi strikes on the Houthis, told reporters: “We may. We’re going to look at it. We just found out about the recent attack, so we’ll make a decision. We move very quickly.” US Secretary of State Marco Rubio condemned the attacks on the airport, saying they “demonstrate a blatant disregard for innocent civilian life”. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres also condemned Saturday’s strike, reiterating that attacks on civilians and ​civilian infrastructure violate international law and must cease immediately. Saudi Arabia and the Yemeni government have claimed hundreds of strikes on targets in Houthi-held territory. The Houthis have said these killed ​civilians including women and children. Reuters could not independently verify those claims. The Saudis entered the Yemen war in 2015 at the head of an Arab coalition to try to force the Houthis out of ‌the Yemeni capital ⁠Sanaa. The war became a bloody stalemate, with hundreds of thousands of Yemenis killed by fighting and famine. A 2022 ceasefire reached by the Saudis and the Houthis unravelled this summer, culminating in a lightning Houthi advance that took the Red Sea chokepoint of Bab el-Mandeb from Saudi-backed government forces. EXPLOSION, PEOPLE ON GROUND, AMBULANCES RUSHING The Saudi-backed Yemeni government began an offensive this week to try to retake that territory, but it has made only slow gains, even as the Houthis put the country’s third-largest city, Taiz, under siege. On Saturday, all flights were diverted from Riyadh ​and operations at the airport that serves a ​city of 8 million people were suspended, ⁠the Saudi civil aviation authority said. The head of the Houthi media office posted on X that the group had “shut down Riyadh international airport”. The Houthis have said airliners should avoid Saudi airspace, declaring it a zone of military operations. The Houthis have warned international airlines against operating ​flights through Saudi airspace, saying it has become a theatre of their military operations, with the exception of airspace over the holy ​cities of Mecca and Medina. An ⁠eyewitness at the airport reported seeing an explosion and then multiple people lying injured on the ground inside. More than a dozen ambulances were seen rushing towards the facility. A video verified by Reuters showed ambulances at the airport. An injured traveller told Reuters they saw something fly across the sky outside the airport before part of the ceiling near a departure gate collapsed. The US embassy ⁠in Riyadh said ​it “strongly recommends all US citizens avoid this airport and surrounding areas.” Earlier Houthi attacks had prompted a number of ​carriers to suspend or cancel services to the Saudi capital, shortly before Riyadh is due to host major energy and investment conferences. Organizers of those conferences said ahead of the strikes on Saturday they would go ahead as planned. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Weerar culus oo lagu qaaday garoonka Riyadh oo dilay 12 qof, dhaawacayna 309 kale
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Ugu yaraan 12 qof ayaa ku dhintay, 309 kalena way ku dhaawacmeen weerar Sabtidii lagu qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Boqor Khaalid ee magaalada Riyadh, iyadoo kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay sheegatay mas’uuliyadda weerarkan oo sii huriyay dagaalka u dhexeeya kooxdaasi iyo Sacuudiga. Weerarkan ayaa noqonaya kii saddexaad ee toddobaad gudihiis lagu qaado garoonka diyaaradaha ee caasimadda Sacuudiga, waxaana uu sababay in gebi ahaanba la hakiyo duulimaadyadii garoonka, halka diyaarado badan loo weeciyay garoomo kale. Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in dadka dhintay ay ku jiraan afar muwaadin oo Sacuudiyaan ah, laba u dhashay Bangladesh, iyo lix qof oo u kala dhashay Mareykanka, Urdun, Falastiin, Suuriya, Suudaan iyo Masar. Dhaawacyada oo gaaray 309 qof ayaa qaarkood xaaladoodu aad u liidataa, waxaana isbitaallada magaalada Riyadh la geeyay dad badan oo dhaawac ah, kuwaas oo lagu daadgureeyay gaadiidka gurmadka degdegga ah iyo diyaaradaha qumaatiga u kaca, sida ay Reuters u sheegeen dad xog-ogaal u ah dhacdada. Weerarka ayaa dhacay iyadoo aan wax digniin ah laga sii bixin, waxaana la sheegay in nidaamka Sacuudiga ee ka digista khataraha cirka uusan soo saarin wax digniin ah ka hor inta uusan weerarku dhicin. Goobjooge ku sugnaa garoonka ayaa sheegay inuu arkay qarax xooggan, ka dibna uu gudaha garoonka ku arkay dad badan oo dhaawac ah oo dhulka yaalla. In ka badan toban gaari oo ambalaas ah ayaa sidoo kale lagu arkay iyagoo ku sii qulqulaya garoonka. Mid ka mid ah rakaabkii ku dhaawacmay weerarka ayaa Reuters u sheegay inuu arkay wax cirka maraya, ka hor inta aysan soo dumin qeyb ka mid ah saqafka u dhow albaabka laga raaco diyaaradaha. Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Riyadh ayaa muwaadiniinteeda si adag ugu boorrisay inay ka fogaadaan garoonka iyo deegaannada ku hareeraysan, iyadoo sheegtay inay ka warqabto weerarrada dhacay. Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Iran ayaa toddobaadkan kordhiyay weerarrada gantaallada ah ee ay ku qaadayaan Sacuudiga, waxaana laba weerar oo hore loogu qaaday garoonka Riyadh ku dhintay afar qof, iyadoo sidoo kale burbur xooggan uu gaaray diyaarad rakaab oo Sacuudiga laga leeyahay. Madaxa xafiiska warbaahinta Xuutiyiinta ayaa qoraal uu ku baahiyay barta X ku sheegay in kooxdiisu ay xirtay garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Riyadh. Kooxda ayaa hore uga digtay in diyaaradaha rayidka ahi ay galaan hawada Sacuudiga, iyadoo ku dhawaaqday inay tahay aag ay ka socdaan howlgallo militari, ka dib markii dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudigu taageero ay Isniintii bilowday duullaan ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in Washington ay ka fiirsaneyso inay ku biirto weerarrada cirka ee Sacuudigu ku hayo Xuutiyiinta. “Waxaa suurtagal ah inaan ku biirno. Waan eegi doonnaa. Hadda ayaan ogaanay weerarkii ugu dambeeyay, sidaas darteed go’aan ayaan gaari doonnaa. Si aad u degdeg badan ayaan u dhaqaaqnaa,” ayuu Trump u sheegay wariyeyaasha isagoo ku sugnaa bannaanka Aqalka Cad. Xiisaddan cusub ayaa ka dhalatay dib u qarxidda dagaalka Yemen, ka dib markii uu burburay xabbad-joojintii sannadkii 2022 ay gaareen Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta, taas oo muddo hakisay dagaalkii muddada dheer ka socday dalkaasi. Dagaalka ayaa mar kale xoogaystay xagaagii la soo dhaafay, markii Xuutiyiintu ay horumar militari oo degdeg ah sameeyeen, kuna qabsadeen marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab, oo ay kala wareegeen ciidammada dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudigu taageero. Dowladda Yemen ayaa toddobaadkan billowday duullaan ay ku doonayso inay dib ugu qabsato deegaannadaas, hase yeeshee horumarka ay ciidammadeedu sameeyeen ayaa ilaa hadda gaabis ah. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa go’doomin ku haya magaalada Tacis oo ah magaalada saddexaad ee ugu weyn Yemen. Sacuudiga iyo dowladda Yemen ayaa sheegay inay boqolaal weerar ku qaadeen bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla deegaannada Xuutiyiintu maamulaan, halka kooxdaasi ay ku eedeysay duqeymahaas inay ku dhinteen dad rayid ah, oo ay ku jiraan haween iyo carruur. Reuters ayaan si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin sheegashooyinkan. Weerarrada soo noqnoqday ee lagu qaaday Riyadh ayaa muujiyay nuglaanta difaaca cirka Sacuudiga, xilli boqortooyadu ay isku dayeyso inay dib u riixdo awoodda militari ee Xuutiyiinta, kuwaas oo weerarradoodu hadda saameynayaan duulimaadyada caalamiga ah iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga dalka. Dhacdooyinkan ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmaya iyadoo Riyadh ay isu diyaarineyso martigelinta shirar waaweyn oo caalami ah oo ku saabsan tamarta iyo maalgashiga, kuwaas oo la filayo inay ka qeyb galaan madax iyo ganacsato caalami ah. Inkasta oo shirkado diyaaradeed oo dhowr ah ay joojiyeen ama baajiyeen duulimaadyadooda Riyadh, qabanqaabiyeyaasha shirarkan ayaa Sabtidii sheegay inay u dhici doonaan sidii loo qorsheeyay, iyagoo ballanqaaday in la xoojin doono ammaanka ka qeybgalayaasha. Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in dadka dhintay ay ku jiraan afar muwaadin oo Sacuudiyaan ah, laba u dhashay Bangladesh, iyo lix qof oo u kala dhashay Mareykanka, Urdun, Falastiin, Suuriya, Suudaan iyo Masar. Dhaawacyada oo gaaray 309 qof ayaa qaarkood xaaladoodu aad u liidataa, waxaana isbitaallada magaalada Riyadh la geeyay dad badan oo dhaawac ah, kuwaas oo lagu daadgureeyay gaadiidka gurmadka degdegga ah iyo diyaaradaha qumaatiga u kaca, sida ay Reuters u sheegeen dad xog-ogaal u ah dhacdada. Weerarka ayaa dhacay iyadoo aan wax digniin ah laga sii bixin, waxaana la sheegay in nidaamka Sacuudiga ee ka digista khataraha cirka uusan soo saarin wax digniin ah ka hor inta uusan weerarku dhicin. Goobjooge ku sugnaa garoonka ayaa sheegay inuu arkay qarax xooggan, ka dibna uu gudaha garoonka ku arkay dad badan oo dhaawac ah oo dhulka yaalla. In ka badan toban gaari oo ambalaas ah ayaa sidoo kale lagu arkay iyagoo ku sii qulqulaya garoonka. Mid ka mid ah rakaabkii ku dhaawacmay weerarka ayaa Reuters u sheegay inuu arkay wax cirka maraya, ka hor inta aysan soo dumin qeyb ka mid ah saqafka u dhow albaabka laga raaco diyaaradaha. Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Riyadh ayaa muwaadiniinteeda si adag ugu boorrisay inay ka fogaadaan garoonka iyo deegaannada ku hareeraysan, iyadoo sheegtay inay ka warqabto weerarrada dhacay. Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Iran ayaa toddobaadkan kordhiyay weerarrada gantaallada ah ee ay ku qaadayaan Sacuudiga, waxaana laba weerar oo hore loogu qaaday garoonka Riyadh ku dhintay afar qof, iyadoo sidoo kale burbur xooggan uu gaaray diyaarad rakaab oo Sacuudiga laga leeyahay. Madaxa xafiiska warbaahinta Xuutiyiinta ayaa qoraal uu ku baahiyay barta X ku sheegay in kooxdiisu ay xirtay garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Riyadh. Kooxda ayaa hore uga digtay in diyaaradaha rayidka ahi ay galaan hawada Sacuudiga, iyadoo ku dhawaaqday inay tahay aag ay ka socdaan howlgallo militari, ka dib markii dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudigu taageero ay Isniintii bilowday duullaan ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in Washington ay ka fiirsaneyso inay ku biirto weerarrada cirka ee Sacuudigu ku hayo Xuutiyiinta. “Waxaa suurtagal ah inaan ku biirno. Waan eegi doonnaa. Hadda ayaan ogaanay weerarkii ugu dambeeyay, sidaas darteed go’aan ayaan gaari doonnaa. Si aad u degdeg badan ayaan u dhaqaaqnaa,” ayuu Trump u sheegay wariyeyaasha isagoo ku sugnaa bannaanka Aqalka Cad. Xiisaddan cusub ayaa ka dhalatay dib u qarxidda dagaalka Yemen, ka dib markii uu burburay xabbad-joojintii sannadkii 2022 ay gaareen Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta, taas oo muddo hakisay dagaalkii muddada dheer ka socday dalkaasi. Dagaalka ayaa mar kale xoogaystay xagaagii la soo dhaafay, markii Xuutiyiintu ay horumar militari oo degdeg ah sameeyeen, kuna qabsadeen marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab, oo ay kala wareegeen ciidammada dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudigu taageero. Dowladda Yemen ayaa toddobaadkan billowday duullaan ay ku doonayso inay dib ugu qabsato deegaannadaas, hase yeeshee horumarka ay ciidammadeedu sameeyeen ayaa ilaa hadda gaabis ah. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa go’doomin ku haya magaalada Tacis oo ah magaalada saddexaad ee ugu weyn Yemen. Sacuudiga iyo dowladda Yemen ayaa sheegay inay boqolaal weerar ku qaadeen bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla deegaannada Xuutiyiintu maamulaan, halka kooxdaasi ay ku eedeysay duqeymahaas inay ku dhinteen dad rayid ah, oo ay ku jiraan haween iyo carruur. Reuters ayaan si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin sheegashooyinkan. Weerarrada soo noqnoqday ee lagu qaaday Riyadh ayaa muujiyay nuglaanta difaaca cirka Sacuudiga, xilli boqortooyadu ay isku dayeyso inay dib u riixdo awoodda militari ee Xuutiyiinta, kuwaas oo weerarradoodu hadda saameynayaan duulimaadyada caalamiga ah iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga dalka. Dhacdooyinkan ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmaya iyadoo Riyadh ay isu diyaarineyso martigelinta shirar waaweyn oo caalami ah oo ku saabsan tamarta iyo maalgashiga, kuwaas oo la filayo inay ka qeyb galaan madax iyo ganacsato caalami ah. Inkasta oo shirkado diyaaradeed oo dhowr ah ay joojiyeen ama baajiyeen duulimaadyadooda Riyadh, qabanqaabiyeyaasha shirarkan ayaa Sabtidii sheegay inay u dhici doonaan sidii loo qorsheeyay, iyagoo ballanqaaday in la xoojin doono ammaanka ka qeybgalayaasha. The post Weerar culus oo lagu qaaday garoonka Riyadh oo dilay 12 qof, dhaawacayna 309 kale appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Itoobiya oo Qaramada Midoobay u Sheegtay inay Isdifaacayso, Eritrea-na ku Eedeysay inay Dhulkeeda Soo Gashay
items.description: Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay u sheegtay inay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin ay ku difaacayso dalkeeda, iyadoo Eritrea ku eedeysay inay ciidamo u soo gudbisay gudaha waqooyiga Itoobiya, isla markaana ay qabsatay deegaanno ka tirsan gobolka Tigray. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya, Gedion Timothewos, ayaa warqad uu u diray Golaha Ammaanka ku saleeyay mowqifka dowladda Itoobiya Qodobka 51-aad ee Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay, kaas oo aqoonsanaya xaqa dalalku u leeyihiin isdifaacid marka uu dhaco weerar hubeysan, balse warqadda laguma faahfaahin tallaabooyinka militari ee ay Itoobiya damacsan tahay inay qaaddo. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada Eritrea ay gudaha dalkeeda u soo galeen masaafo gaareysa tobannaan kiiloomitir. Dhanka kale, muuqaallo ay wakaaladda wararka ee Associated Press (AP) ka duubtay magaalada Adigrat, oo qiyaastii 25 kiiloomitir u jirta xadka Eritrea, ayaa muujinayay ciidamo iyo gaadiid militari oo Itoobiyaan ah oo magaalada soo gelaya. Eritrea ayaa si adag u beenisay eedeymaha Itoobiya, iyadoo ku dooday in Addis Ababa ay isku dayayso inay marmarsiiyo u sameysato dagaal ay ku doonayso inay ku hesho marin madax-bannaan oo ay uga baxdo Badda Cas. Dowladda Eritrea ayaa iyaduna Golaha Ammaanka ka codsatay inuu cambaareeyo Itoobiya, isla markaana qaado tallaabooyin looga hortagayo waxa ay ku tilmaantay damacyada dowladda Itoobiya. Isweydaarsiga waraaqaha diblomaasiyadeed iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada milatari ee labada dal ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in khilaafkoodu isu beddelo iska horimaad hubeysan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, sheegashooyinka ku saabsan halka ay ciidamada Eritrea gaareen iyo deegaannada la sheegay in la qabsaday weli si madax-bannaan looma wada xaqiijin. Haddii xiisaddu isu beddesho dagaal toos ah, waxaa laga cabsi qabaa inuu saameyn ballaaran ku yeesho amniga Geeska Afrika, isla markaana uu sababo barakac hor leh, carqalad ku timaadda isu-socodka ganacsiga iyo isbeddel ku yimaadda xaaladda amni ee gobolka. Soomaaliya, oo xiriir diblomaasiyadeed iyo mid amni la leh dalalka Itoobiya, Eritrea iyo Masar, ayaa sidoo kale wajahaysa xaalad gobolka ka dhalan karta oo saameyn ku yeelan karta xiriirkeeda dibadda iyo qorshayaasheeda amni. Xiisadda sii kordheysa ayaa si gaar ah u saameynaysa gobolka, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo tallaabooyinka xiga ee labada dowladood iyo dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu dejin karo xaaladda.

items.title: Tallaabada ka dhanka ah ku xadgudubka maraakiibta kuma koobnaan doonto marin biyoodka Hormuz
items.description: Iiraan ayaa ka digtay in howlgallada ka dhanka ah maraakiibta sharci darrada ah aan lagu koobin doonin marin biyoodka Hormuz, iyagoo ku adkeysanaya in maraakiibta isticmaalaya waddooyinka aan la ogolayn la dabagali doono oo tallaabo laga qaadi doono meel kasta oo gobolka ka mid ah. War-saxaafadeed ay soo saareen Taliska Ciidamada Badda ee Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah (IRGC) ayaa lagu sheegay in markab kasta oo mara waddo aan loo ogolayn oo Iiraana la kormeeri doono oo tallaabo laga qaadi doono si aan shaki lahayn. Iiraan waxay ku adkeysaneysaa in dhammaan maraakiibta ay tahay inay isticmaalaan marin biyoodyo loo qoondeeyay si ay uga gudbaan marin biyoodka Hormuz. Bayaanka ayaa yimid iyadoo ay jiraan warar sheegaya in qaar ka mid ah maraakiibta xamuulka qaada iyo booyadaha shidaalka ay bilaabeen isticmaalka waddooyin kale oo la sameeyay toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay si looga fogaado cunaqabataynta ay soo rogtay Tehran. Dhanka kale, Iiraan waxay sheegtay inaysan furi doonin marin biyoodka Hormuz ilaa iyo inta uu Mareykanku uu sii wado waxa uu ugu yeeray xayiraadda badda ee ka dhanka ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Mareykanka ayaa ku adkeystay in marin biyoodkan muhiimka ah ee caalamiga ah ee gaadiidka saliidda uu furan yahay oo ammaan yahay, isagoo xusay in xaddiga saliidda ee ka gudbaya marinka uu kordhay marka la barbar dhigo xilligii ka horreeyay dhibaatada Iiraan. Bbc somali

items.title: Dalalka Caalamka oo si Weyn u Cambaareeyay Weerarkii Xuutiyiintu ku Qaadeen Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee Riyadh
items.description: Dalal iyo hay’ado caalami ah ayaa cambaareeyay weerar ay Sacuudi Carabiya ku eedeysay kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen, kaas oo lagu qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee King Khalid ee magaalada Riyadh, laguna dilay ugu yaraan 12 qof, halka 300 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Sida ay sheegtay hay’adda duulista rayidka ee Sacuudiga, weerarka Sabtidii dhacay ayaa waxaa ku dhintay afar muwaadin oo Sacuudiyaan ah, laba qof oo u dhashay Bangladesh, iyo muwaadiniin ka kala socday Mareykanka, Urdun, Falastiin, Suudaan, Suuriya iyo Masar. Weerarkan ayaa lagu tilmaamay kii ugu khasaaraha badnaa ee ka dhaca gudaha Sacuudi Carabiya muddo ka badan toban sano, iyadoo uu kusoo beegmayo xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo dagaalka Yemen, halkaas oo Xuutiyiinta ay dagaal kula jiraan ciidamada taageersan dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa dhankeeda wada duqeymo cirka ah oo ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta, si ay u taageerto ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee dagaalka kula jira kooxdaas oo taageero ka hesha Iiraan. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa cambaareeyay weerarka, isaga oo ku tilmaamay mid aad u xun, wuxuuna sheegay inuu wadahadal la yeelan doono dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Maxamed bin Salmaan. Trump ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in maamulkiisu qiimeynayo suurtagalnimada in Mareykanku ku biiro dagaalka ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta, isaga oo xusay in go’aan laga gaari doono arrintaas si degdeg ah. Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, Marco Rubio, ayaa sheegay in weerarka lagu dilay muwaadin Mareykan ah. Wuxuu tacsi u diray ehelada dadka ku dhintay, isaga oo caddeeyay in Washington ay garab taagan tahay Sacuudi Carabiya. Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, António Guterres, ayaa sheegay inuu aad uga naxay weerarka, isaga oo si adag u cambaareeyay duqeymaha lagu bartilmaameedsaday garoonka diyaaradaha ee Riyadh. Guterres ayaa xusay in weerarrada lagu qaado dadka rayidka ah iyo kaabayaasha rayidka ay jebinayaan sharciga caalamiga ah, wuxuuna ku baaqay in si degdeg ah loo joojiyo. Ergayga gaarka ah ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Yemen, Hans Grundberg, ayaa isaguna sheegay in weerarrada lagu qaado garoomada rayidka ee Sacuudiga ay muujinayaan koror halis ah oo colaadda ku yimid, isla markaana ay khatar ku yihiin amniga gobolka iyo dadaallada nabadeed ee Yemen. Dowladda Kanada ayaa weerarka ku tilmaantay mid aan la aqbali karin, iyadoo sheegtay inaan wax cudurdaar ah loo heli karin weerarrada lagu qaado kaabayaasha rayidka. Masar, Qatar, Pakistan, Urdun, Cumaan iyo Falastiin ayaa sidoo kale cambaareeyay weerarka, iyaga oo muujiyay taageerada ay u hayaan Sacuudi Carabiya. Qatar ayaa sheegtay in weerarku yahay xadgudub ka dhan ah madaxbannaanida Sacuudiga, isla markaana uu khatar ku yahay amniga gobolka, dadka rayidka ah iyo isu-socodka duulimaadyada. Pakistan ayaa weerarka ku tilmaantay fal argagixiso, iyadoo caddeysay inay si buuxda ula garab taagan tahay Riyadh, dhanka kalena, Urdun ayaa sheegtay in weerarku yahay tallaabo khatar ku ah xasilloonida gobolka iyo sharciga caalamiga ah. Cumaan ayaa ku baaqday in mudnaanta la siiyo wadahadalka, is-xakamaynta iyo dadaallada looga hortagayo in colaadda sii ballaarato, ayadoo Safaaradda Japan ee Sacuudi Carabiya ay iyaduna si adag u cambaareysay weerarrada soo noqnoqday, iyadoo sheegtay inaan la aqbali karin in dadka rayidka ah la bartilmaameedsado. Weerarkan ayaa sare u qaadi kara xiisadda u dhexeysa Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudi Carabiya, xilli dagaalka Yemen uu sii xoogeysanayo, isla markaana dalal badan ay walaac ka muujinayaan saameynta uu khilaafku ku yeelan karo amniga gobolka.

Pakistan ayaa weerarka ku tilmaantay fal argagixiso, iyadoo caddeysay inay si buuxda ula garab taagan tahay Riyadh, dhanka kalena, Urdun ayaa sheegtay in weerarku yahay tallaabo khatar ku ah xasilloonida gobolka iyo sharciga caalamiga ah. Cumaan ayaa ku baaqday in mudnaanta la siiyo wadahadalka, is-xakamaynta iyo dadaallada looga hortagayo in colaadda sii ballaarato, ayadoo Safaaradda Japan ee Sacuudi Carabiya ay iyaduna si adag u cambaareysay weerarrada soo noqnoqday, iyadoo sheegtay inaan la aqbali karin in dadka rayidka ah la bartilmaameedsado. Weerarkan ayaa sare u qaadi kara xiisadda u dhexeysa Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudi Carabiya, xilli dagaalka Yemen uu sii xoogeysanayo, isla markaana dalal badan ay walaac ka muujinayaan saameynta uu khilaafku ku yeelan karo amniga gobolka.

items.title: Masar oo la Sheegay inay Waqooyiga Muqdisho ka Diyaarinayso Goob Ciidamadeeda la Dejiyo
items.description: Warar soo baxaya ayaa sheegaya in saraakiil, la-taliyeyaal iyo kooxo farsamo oo Masaari ah ay diyaarinayaan goob la dejiyo ciidamo laga qorsheynayo inay Masar u soo dirto Soomaaliya, iyadoo aan weli si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin halka rasmiga ah ee la dejin doono. Warbixin uu baahiyey wargeyska The New Arab ayaa tilmaantay in goobta la qorsheynayo ay tahay deegaanka Ceelcade, oo ku dhow garoonkii hore ee Cisiley ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Goobtan ayaa ku taalla waqooyiga Muqdisho, waxaana la sheegay inay qiyaastii 400 oo kiiloomitir u jirto qaybta ugu dhow ee xadka beenaadka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya. Warbixintan ayaa ka duwan xogihii hore ee ciidamada Masar la xiriirinayey gobollada Gedo iyo Hiiraan, kuwaas oo ku dhow xadka Itoobiya. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dowladda Soomaaliya iyo dowladda Masar weli si rasmi ah uma xaqiijin in deegaanka Ceelcade laga dhisayo saldhig ciidan ama xarun tababar oo ay isticmaali doonaan ciidamada Masar. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa sannadkii 2025 sheegay in ciidamada Masar aan loo qorsheyn inay ka hawlgalaan xadka Itoobiya, balse la dejin doono qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, halkaas oo ay hore uga hawlgeli jireen ciidamada Burundi. Madaxweynaha ayaa xilligaas si gaar ah u xusay aagga u dhexeeya degmooyinka Balcad iyo Mahadaay. Masar ayaa hore u xaqiijisay inay ciidamo ku biirinayso Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM). Labada dal ayaa sidoo kale sannadkii 2024 kala saxiixday heshiis iskaashi oo dhinaca difaaca ah. Bilihii la soo dhaafay, wafdiyo militari oo Masaari ah ayaa Muqdisho kulammo kula yeeshay madaxda Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Wadahadallada ayaa la sheegay inay la xiriireen tababarka, tayeynta iyo kor u qaadista awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliya. Ka-qaybgalka ciidamada Masar ayaa la filayaa inuu qayb ka noqdo taageerada dadaallada amniga Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab iyo xoojinta awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Hardanka u dhexeeya Qaahira iyo Addis Ababa ayaa sare u qaadaya muhiimadda ay leedahay in si cad loo qeexo goobaha ay ciidamada Masar ka hawlgeli doonaan iyo waajibaadkooda. Inkastoo ka-qaybgalka Masar ee AUSSOM hore loo xaqiijiyey, haddana tirada ciidamada la soo dirayo, goobta rasmiga ah ee la dejinayo iyo waqtiga ay Soomaaliya imaanayaan weli si faahfaahsan looma shaacin. Waxaa sidaas darteed muhiim ah in dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay caddeyso xogta ku saabsan goobta la soo sheegay, gaar ahaan in loo qorsheeyey saldhig joogto ah, xarun tababar ama fariisin ciidan oo hoos imanaysa howlgalka AUSSOM.

items.title: Webiga Shabeelle oo Ku Dhowaaday Heerka Digniinta Fatahaadaha
items.description: Heerka biyaha Webiga Shabeelle ee magaalada Jowhar ayaa toddobaad gudihiis si weyn kor ugu kacay, isagoo ku dhowaaday heerka digniinta fatahaadda, sida lagu sheegay saadaashii ugu dambeysay ee FAO-SWALIM. Cabbirka webiga ayaa ka kacay 2.48 mitir ilaa 4.70 mitir, taasoo ka dhigan koror dhan 2.22 mitir. Heerka hadda la diiwaangeliyey wuxuu 30 sentimitir oo keliya ka hooseeyaa heerka khatarta dhexdhexaadka ah ee shanta mitir, halka heerka khatarta sare uu yahay 5.25 mitir. FAO-SWALIM waxay sheegtay in xawaaraha kororka biyuhu yara gaabiyey, balse roobab dhexdhexaad ilaa culus laga filayo qaybo ka mid ah Soomaaliya iyo buuraleyda Itoobiya. Roobabka ka da’a dhulka sare ee Itoobiya waxay sare u qaadi karaan Webiyada Shabeelle iyo Jubba, xitaa marka roob yar uu gudaha Soomaaliya ka da’o. Beledweyne ayaa laga diiwaangeliyey afar mitir, Buuloburdina 3.20 mitir, halka xaaladda Webiga Jubba ay xasilloon tahay marka la eego cabbirrada Doolow iyo Luuq. Kororka degdegga ah ee Jowhar wuxuu khatar gelin karaa beeraha, guryaha iyo waddooyinka ku yaalla hareeraha webiga, gaar ahaan haddii roobabka Itoobiya ay sii kordhaan. Fatahaaddu waxay sidoo kale keeni kartaa barakac, burbur dalagyo iyo go’itaanka waddooyinka sahayda iyo gargaarka. Maamulka Hirshabeelle iyo hay’adaha gurmadka ayaa looga baahan yahay inay xoojiyaan jiinka webiga, xiraan meelaha jilicsan, diyaariyaan waddooyinka daadgureynta, isla markaana digniin joogto ah gaarsiiyaan bulshada.

items.title: Khasaare dhimasho iyo dhaawac faro badan oo loo geystay madaarka Riyaad Saudi Arabia
items.description: 12 qof oo dhintay iyo 309 ku dhaawacmay weerar lagu qaaday garoonka Riyaad Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa ku dhawaaqday in ugu yaraan 12 qof ay ku dhinteen 309 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen weerar ka dhacay Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee King Khalid ee Riyaad. Kani waa weerarkii saddexaad ee lagu qaado garoonka diyaaradaha ee Riyaad muddo toddobaad ah gudaheed. Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegtay mas’uuliyadda labadii weerar ee hore, laakiin weli ma aysan sheegan mas’uuliyadda kii ugu dambeeyay. Duulimaadyada ayaa laga weeciyay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Riyaad ka dib weerarkii, dhowr dowladood oo reer Galbeed ahna waxay ku booriyeen muwaadiniintooda inay ka fogaadaan aagga garoonka diyaaradaha. Ilo xog ogaal ah ayaa u sheegay Reuters in tirada dhimashada iyo dhaawaca ay sii kordhi karto iyo in weerarka la fuliyay iyada oo aan la siin digniin hore. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sidoo kale ka jawaabay isagoo sheegay in Washington ay dhawaan go’aan ka gaari doonto inay ku biirto weerarrada Sacuudi Carabiya ee ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta. Weerarkan ayaa yimid iyadoo Sacuudi Carabiya ay xoojisay duqeymaha ay ka geysanayso goobaha Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka oo ka Wada Hadlay Xoojinta Dagaalka Ka dhanka ah Argagixisada
items.description: Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Soomaaliya, Cabdifataax Qaasim Maxamuud, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Robert Flannery, oo ah la-taliyaha Barnaamijka La-dagaallanka Argagixisada ee Bariga Afrika ee Dowladda Mareykanka, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada warbaahinta iyo ka hortagga fikirka xagjirka ah. Kulanka oo ka dhacay xafiiska wasiirka ee Muqdisho 10-kii Oktoobar 2026, ayaa lagu falanqeeyay sidii loo xoojin lahaa wacyigelinta bulshada, looga hortagi lahaa dacaayadaha argagixisada, loona mideyn lahaa farriimaha dowladda ee la xiriira dadaallada ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada. Wasiir Cabdifataax Qaasim ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay baahida loo qabo qorshe warbaahineed oo mideysan iyo ololeyaal wacyigelin oo wax ku ool ah, si bulshada Soomaaliyeed loo gaarsiiyo farriimo sax ah oo kor u qaadaya fahamkeeda iyo ka-qaybgalkeeda dadaallada lagula dagaallamayo argagixisada. Dhankiisa, Robert Flannery ayaa muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadidda iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada warbaahinta iyo isgaarsiinta istaraatiijiga ah, si loo xoojiyo dadaallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada. Kulanka waxaa wasiirka ku wehliyay Agaasimaha Waaxda Xiriirka Istaraatiijiga ah ee Wasaaradda, Cabdishakuur Cali Axmed, iyo la-taliyaha wasiirka, Cabdicasiis Jeylaani.

items.title: Dad badan oo ku dhintay weerar gantaal oo Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen Garoonka Riyadh
items.description: Ugu yaraan 12 qof ayaa la xaqiijiyay inay ku dhinteen, 309 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen weerar gantaal oo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay gelinkii dambe ee Sabtidii ka gaysteen Garoonka Diyaaradaha Boqor Khaalid (King Khalid) ee Magaalada Riyadh. Gantaalka ayaa ku dhacay agagaarka dhismaha loogu talagalay rakaabka ee Terminal 3 & 4, oo qayb ahaan uu saqafku soo dumay. Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Sacuudiga (GACA) ayaa xaqiijisay dhacdadan, waxayna faahfaahin ka bixisay dadka ku dhintay weerarkaasi. Hay’adda ayaa sheegtay in dadka ku dhintay weerarka ay isugu jiraan afar qof oo u dhashay Sacuudiga, laba u dhalatay Bangladesh iyo min hal qof oo u kala dhashay Mareykanka, Masar, Jordan, Suuriya, Falastiin iyo Suudaan. Hay’adda ayaa waaberigii Axaddan war ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in 309 qof ay ku dhaawacmeen weerarka, kuwaas oo qaarkood warka lagu sheegay in xaaladdoodu ay aad u liidato. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay in dhammaan dadka dhaawacmay ay isbitaalada dalkaasi ku helayaan daryeel caafimaad. Weerarka ayaa sidoo kale sababay burbur hantiyadeed, kaas oo la sheegay in weli la qiimeynayo. Hay’adda GACA ayaa sheegtay in si ku-meel-gaar ah loo hakiyay howlihii shaqo ee Garoonka Diyaaradaha Riyadh, ka dib weerarkaasi. Waa weerarkii saddexaad oo Xuutiyiinta ay ku qaadaan Garoonka Diyaaradaha King Khalid toddobaadkan. Weerar Khamiistii ka dhacay garoonkaasi ayaa waxaa ku dhintay saddex muwaadin oo Sacuudiyaan ah, sida ay sheegtay GACA. Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudiga hoggaamiyo ee ka hawlgala Yemen ayaa weerarkan ugu dambeeyay ku tilmaamay dembi dagaal oo buuxa. General Turki Al Maliki, Afhayeenka Isbahaysiga Assifat Al-Hazm ayaa ku hanjabay in isbahaysigu uu si adag uga jawaabi doono weerarkan argagixisanimo, iyadoo la raacayo buu yiri xeerarka caalamiga ah.

Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudiga hoggaamiyo ee ka hawlgala Yemen ayaa weerarkan ugu dambeeyay ku tilmaamay dembi dagaal oo buuxa. General Turki Al Maliki, Afhayeenka Isbahaysiga Assifat Al-Hazm ayaa ku hanjabay in isbahaysigu uu si adag uga jawaabi doono weerarkan argagixisanimo, iyadoo la raacayo buu yiri xeerarka caalamiga ah.

items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo wada qorshe looga hortagayo in la lumiyo dhul cusub
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa wada qorshe lagu adkeynayo amniga degmooyinka hoos yimaada maamulkaasi, si looga hortago in taageereyaasha Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ay magaalooyin hor leh uga la wareegaan maamulka. Ciidamada ka amarka qaata Cabdicasiis Laftagareen ayaa Khamiistii si nabadgelyo leh ula wareegay gacan ku haynta Degmada Qansaxdheere ee Gobolka Baay. Tani waxay ka dambeysay, ka dib markii ciidamadii horey halkaasi ugu sugnaa ay ka war heleen in ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa Laftagareen ay ku soo wajahan yihiin degmadaasi. La wareegitaankooda magaalada ayaa dhalisay tuhun ah in ciidamada maamulka ay si is faham ah u banneeyeen fariisimahoodii ciidan, bacdamaa aysan ka hortagin duulaanka. Khubarada dhanka amniga ayaa kuu sheegaya in ujeedada ka dambeysa la wareegitaanka ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen ee Qansaxdheere ay u muuqato in is bedel weyn lagu sameeyay istiraatiijiyadda dagaalka mucaaradka ee ku wajahan maamulka. Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed iyo siyaasiyiinta deegaanka ee ay xulafada yihiin oo dagaalkoodu uu horey ugu koobnaa Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa waxaa tallaabadan loo arkaa ballaarin lagu sameynayo aagga cadaadiska iyo saamaynta, iyadoo laga faa’iideysanayo daldaloolada amniga ee maamulka. Aadan Madoobe oo aad mooddo in uu diidan yahay is ballaarinta ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen ayaa waxa uu Wasiirkiisa Amniga, Isaaq Maxamed Isaaq (Koosaar) iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Birmadka, Gaashaanle Mustaf Axmed Maxamed (Malaaq Guudow) uu faray in si dhakhsa ah dib-u-habayn loogu sameeyo ciidamada ka hawlgala degmooyinka uu amnigoodu jilicsan yahay, lana geeyo ciidamo xoojin ah. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Aadan Madoobe uu Taliyaha Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Isaaq Aadan Berdaale weydiistay inuu bixiyo taakulada dhinaca amniga ee lagama maarmaanka ah. Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in hindisaha Aadan Madoobe uu qayb ka yahay joogteynta mushaarka ciidamada, si aan looga faa’iideysan baahidooda aasaasiga ah. Hindisaha ayaa ilaalinaya niyadda ciidamada, iyadoo laga fogaanayo inay dhibaato maaliyadeed awgeed ugu dhiiradaan falal amniga wax u dhimaya ama inay garabka ka soo horjeeda maamulka u fududeeyaan qabsashada dhul cusub. Bixinta mushaarka joogtada ah iyo in la damaanad-qaado baahidooda aasaasiga ah, waxay ahmiyad u leedahay niyadda iyo daacadnimada ciidamada, si ay si wax ku ool ah ugu gutaan waajibaadka loo igmaday.

items.title: Somaliland Courts Gulf Capital as Berbera Port Emerges as Strategic Hub
items.description: Somaliland Courts Gulf Capital as Berbera Port Emerges as Strategic Hub Hargeisa — Somaliland is intensifying its diplomatic and economic outreach to Gulf Arab states, with senior officials holding a series of high-level meetings aimed at attracting foreign direct investment and cementing the territory’s growing reputation as a stable and strategically vital partner in the Horn of Africa. The push comes as regional realignment accelerates and international investors reassess risk calculations across the wider Red Sea corridor. Government representatives from Hargeisa have been engaged in sustained dialogue with counterparts and business delegations from the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar in recent weeks, according to sources familiar with the discussions. The conversations have centered on infrastructure financing, port development, and energy sector opportunities — areas where Somaliland’s leadership believes the territory holds a compelling competitive advantage over more volatile neighbors. At the heart of the economic pitch is Berbera Port and the Berbera Corridor , the deep-water facility on the Gulf of Aden that has steadily expanded its handling capacity and attracted significant prior investment from DP World, the Dubai-based port operator. Officials in Hargeisa have signaled their ambition to build on that foundation, positioning Berbera as the premier alternative transit route for landlocked Ethiopia and a regional logistics gateway linking East Africa to global shipping lanes. A Moment of Strategic Opportunity Analysts tracking the Horn of Africa say the timing of Somaliland’s outreach is deliberate and well-calculated. The Red Sea has emerged as one of the world’s most closely watched maritime theatres following Houthi attacks on commercial shipping that have disrupted global trade flows and forced route recalculations by major carriers. In that context, the relative calm and institutional predictability of Somaliland’s coastline and port infrastructure has become an increasingly valuable asset in the eyes of external partners. A Hargeisa-based policy analyst described the current environment as one of the most favorable strategic windows Somaliland has encountered in years, noting that global attention on Red Sea security was naturally drawing decision-makers to reconsider which actors in the region offered reliable partnerships. Somaliland, the analyst argued, was positioning itself to convert that attention into tangible economic and diplomatic gains. The territory, which declared independence from Somalia in 1991 and has maintained a functioning democratic system ever since, continues to operate without formal international recognition. Yet its government has increasingly demonstrated an ability to conduct substantive foreign policy and attract investment on its own terms, suggesting that the recognition question, while unresolved, is becoming less of a practical barrier to engagement. Ethiopia Relationship Remains Central Any discussion of Somaliland’s economic diplomacy is inseparable from its relationship with Ethiopia, Africa’s second most populous nation and the region’s most significant landlocked economy. The Ethiopia-Somaliland Memorandum of Understanding signed in early 2024, which envisaged Ethiopian access to Berbera in exchange for potential diplomatic recognition, remains a live and consequential framework despite ongoing complexities in its implementation. Addis Ababa’s search for reliable sea access has not diminished, and Berbera continues to feature prominently in Ethiopian strategic calculations. Somaliland officials have maintained that the MoU represents a foundation for deeper bilateral cooperation, even as broader regional diplomatic pressures — including pushback from Mogadishu and shifting dynamics within the Intergovernmental Authority on Development — have created headwinds for the agreement’s formal advancement. Gulf investors with interests in Ethiopia are understood to be among those examining Berbera’s potential as a corridor asset, seeing in the port a logistical solution that could underpin broader regional investment packages tied to Ethiopian agricultural exports and manufacturing growth. Domestic Expectations and Governance Pressures Inside Somaliland, the government of President Abdirahman Irro faces significant public expectations that its active foreign engagement will translate into tangible improvements in living standards. Youth unemployment remains stubbornly high, and the local currency has faced periodic pressure. Officials are keenly aware that diplomatic momentum must be paired with visible economic delivery if public confidence is to be maintained. Ministers have sought to frame the Gulf outreach not merely as prestige diplomacy but as a direct pipeline to jobs and infrastructure projects. Energy sector discussions, including potential solar and wind investment to address chronic electricity shortages, have featured alongside port-related conversations, reflecting the breadth of Hargeisa’s economic ambitions. Whether the current diplomatic intensity translates into signed agreements and capital flows in the near term remains to be seen. But observers of Somaliland’s trajectory note that the territory has consistently demonstrated a capacity to punch above its weight in international engagement — and that the current global focus on Red Sea stability may represent the most propitious environment yet for converting that reputation into lasting economic partnerships.     Berbera times

items.title: Masaajidada Soomaalida Minnesota oo amniga adkeeyey kadib baaqii Donald Trump
items.description: Minneapolis (Caasimada Online) – Masjidyada ku yaalla gobolka Minnesota ee dalka Mareykanka ayaa bilaabay inay adkeeyaan ammaankooda, iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan walaaca iyo cabsi laga qabo weerarro lagu beegsado bulshada Soomaaliyeed, kadib hadallo kulul oo Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu ku weeraray Soomaalida ku nool gobolkaas. Walaaca ayaa xoogaystay kadib markii Trump uu Khamiistii bartiisa Truth Social ku daabacay qoraal uu ku sheegay in muhaajiriinta Soomaaliyeed ay la wareegayaan Minnesota, isaga oo dadka gobolka ugu baaqay inay ka dagaalamaan xaaladda uu tilmaamay. “Gobolkii weynaa ee Minnesota waxaa la wareegaya muhaajiriin Soomaaliyeed. Rabshado, dilal iyo fowdo ayaa ka dhacaya gobolka oo dhan. Dadka Minnesota waa inay iska caabiyaan,” ayuu Trump ku yiri qoraalkiisa. Hadalladan ayaa walaac xooggan ka dhex abuuray bulshada Soomaaliyeed iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha Muslimiinta Minnesota, kuwaas oo ka cabsi qaba in hadallada madaxweynaha ay dhiirrigelin karaan falal naceyb iyo rabshado lagula kaco Soomaalida. Sida ay werisay warbaahinta MPR News , laanta Minnesota ee Golaha Xiriirka Islaamka iyo Mareykanka (CAIR) ayaa Khamiistii kulan isugu yeertay imaamyada masjidyada gobolka, si looga arrinsado sidii loo xoojin lahaa ammaanka goobaha cibaadada. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray diyaarinta qorshayaal amni, wacyigelinta dadka masaajidda yimaada iyo sidii loo hubin lahaa in jamaacadu garanayaan albaabbada gurmadka degdegga ah iyo tallaabooyinka ay qaadi karaan haddii ay dhacdo xaalad khatar ah. Suleiman Adan, oo ah ku-xigeenka agaasimaha fulinta ee CAIR Minnesota, ayaa sheegay in hadallada Trump aan loo arki karin oo keliya hadallo siyaasadeed oo aan wax saameyn ah yeelanayn. “Ma iska indho tiri karno arrintan annagoo ku tilmaamayna hadal siyaasadeed oo keliya, ama wax uu madaxweynuhu yiri isaga oo aan dhab ka ahayn,” ayuu yiri Suleiman. “Waxaan hore u aragnay sida hadallada naceybka xambaarsan ay si degdeg ah ugu horseedi karaan dhibaateyn, hanjabaado iyo rabshado,” ayuu raaciyay. Dhacdooyin hore oo kordhiyey cabsida Cabashada madaxda Muslimiinta ayaa sidoo kale salka ku haysa dhacdooyin hore oo muujiyay khatarta ay wajihi karaan goobaha cibaadada. Sheekh Abdulahi Farah, oo ka mid ah imaamyada Masjidka Dar al-Farooq ee magaalada Bloomington, ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in hadallada noocan ah ay leeyihiin cawaaqib dhab ah oo aan la dhayalsan karin. Masjidka Dar al-Farooq ayaa sanadkii 2017-kii lagu qaaday weerar qarax ah oo ay fuliyeen xubno ka tirsanaa koox xagjir ah oo cunsuriyad ku dhisan, xilli ay dad Muslimiin ah ku sugnaayeen masjidka si ay u tukadaan salaadda subax. Ninkii hoggaaminayay weerarkaas ayaa markii dambe lagu xukumay 53 sano oo xabsi ah. “Hadalladani waa kuwo masuuliyad-darro ah, khatar ah, waxayna leeyihiin cawaaqib,” ayuu Sheekh Abdulahi Farah ka sheegay shir jaraa’id oo Jimcihii ay qabteen hoggaamiyeyaasha diimaha ee Minnesota. “Waxaan ognahay waxa ay ka dhigan tahay marka bulsho dhan oo u timaadda cibaado laga dhigo dad aan ammaan dareemayn. In bulsho dhan la eedeeyo ma aha isla-xisaabtan. In bulsho laga dhigto cid lagu eedeeyo dhibaatooyinka ma aha istaraatiijiyad lagu xaqiijinayo amniga,” ayuu yiri. Dhanka kale, qaar ka mid ah dadka deriska la ah masjidyada iyo ganacsiyada Soomaalida ayaa bilaabay inay dib u abaabulaan kooxo ilaalo mutadawiciin ah, kuwaas oo kormeeri doona hareeraha goobahaas si ay uga hortagaan falal amni-darro. Suleiman ayaa sheegay in tallaabadan ay dib u soo noolaynayso hawlgallo ilaalin bulsho oo hore loo sameeyay xilligii hawlgalkii socdaalka ee loo bixiyay Operation Metro Surge, kaas oo dowladda federaalka Mareykanka ay ka fulisay Minnesota, isla markaana saameeyay Soomaalida iyo bulshooyin kale oo muhaajiriin ah. Booliska Minneapolis iyo xafiiska sheriff-ka degmada Hennepin ayaan ka jawaabin su’aalo ay MPR News ka weydiisay inay heleen hanjabaado gaar ah oo ka dhan ah masjidyada, iyo inay qorsheynayaan inay kordhiyaan ilaalintooda. Dhacdooyinka huriyay xiisadda Xiisaddan ayaa soo xoogaysatay kadib dhacdooyin amni oo maalmihii u dambeeyay ka dhacay Minnesota, kuwaas oo sababay in siyaasiyiin iyo dad isticmaala baraha bulshada ay eedeymo guud u jeediyaan Soomaalida. 2-dii October, laba dhallinyaro ah oo Soomaali Mareykan ah ayaa ku dhaawacmay rasaas ka dhacday bannaanka dugsi sare oo ku yaalla Eden Prairie, xilli halkaas lagu qabanayay ciyaar kubbadda cagta Mareykanka ah. Booliska ayaa sheegay in dhacdadaasi ay xiriir la lahayd kooxaha burcadda ah, waxaana saraakiisha ammaanku ku baaqeen iskaashi ballaaran oo lagula dagaallamayo rabshadaha ay geystaan kooxaha hubeysan ee dhallinyarada. Arrinta ayaa sii murugtay Arbacadii, markii hay’adaha ammaanka Mareykanka ay shaaciyeen xarigga Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud, oo ah 18 jir Soomaali Mareykan ah, kaas oo lagu eedeeyay inuu qorsheynayay weerar lagu qaado xarunta ganacsiga Mall of America. Dacwad-oogayaasha federaalka ayaa sheegay in eedeysanuhu doonayay inuu fuliyo weerar dad badan lagu dilo, balse laamaha ammaanka ay fashiliyeen qorshahaas. Kiiskaasi xiriir lama laha rasaastii Eden Prairie. Dhacdooyinkan ayaa sii huriyay doodda ku saabsan amniga gobolka, iyadoo hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaalida ay ku adkeysanayaan in shaqsiyaadka falal dambiyeed lagu eedeeyo aan loo adeegsan karin in lagu cambaareeyo bulsho dhan. Madaxda Minnesota oo u jawaabay Trump Guddoomiyaha gobolka Minnesota, Tim Walz, ayaa ka mid noqday siyaasiyiinta cambaareeyay hadallada Trump, isagoo ku eedeeyay madaxweynaha inuu isku dayayo inuu kala qaybiyo dadka Mareykanka. “Waxaad filaysaa in madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu haysto arrimo ka muhiimsan inuu galabtiisa ku bixiyo isku dirka dadka Mareykanka,” ayuu Walz ku sheegay farriin uu u diray taageerayaashiisa. Xeer-ilaaliyaha guud ee Minnesota, Keith Ellison, ayaa isna difaacay bulshada Soomaaliyeed, isagoo sheegay inay qayb ka yihiin bulshada gobolka, isla markaana aanay mudnayn in la takooro. Qaar ka mid ah hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada ayaa sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyay in dowladda federaalka ay rabshadaha ka dhacay gobolka u adeegsan karto marmarsiinyo ay ciidamo federaal ah dib ugu soo dirto Minnesota. Walaacan ayaa yimid kadib markii Trump uu qoraalkiisa ku sheegay in dadka Minnesota ay codsan karaan in dowladda federaalka ay u soo gurmato. Suleiman Adan ayaa ugu dambeyn ugu baaqay siyaasiyiinta Minnesota inay si cad u difaacaan xuquuqda iyo amniga Soomaalida, isagoo xusay in Soomaalidu ay qayb muhiim ah ka yihiin nolosha iyo bulshada gobolka. “Soomaalidu waa dad reer Minnesota ah, sida ay uga mid yihiin dhaqanka iyo nolosha gobolka. Waa inaad u istaagtaan difaacooda, sida aad u difaaci lahaydeen qayb kasta oo bulshadaada ka mid ah oo si gardarro ah loo eedeynayo,” ayuu yiri. Sheekh Abdulahi Farah, oo ka mid ah imaamyada Masjidka Dar al-Farooq ee magaalada Bloomington, ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in hadallada noocan ah ay leeyihiin cawaaqib dhab ah oo aan la dhayalsan karin. Masjidka Dar al-Farooq ayaa sanadkii 2017-kii lagu qaaday weerar qarax ah oo ay fuliyeen xubno ka tirsanaa koox xagjir ah oo cunsuriyad ku dhisan, xilli ay dad Muslimiin ah ku sugnaayeen masjidka si ay u tukadaan salaadda subax. Ninkii hoggaaminayay weerarkaas ayaa markii dambe lagu xukumay 53 sano oo xabsi ah. “Hadalladani waa kuwo masuuliyad-darro ah, khatar ah, waxayna leeyihiin cawaaqib,” ayuu Sheekh Abdulahi Farah ka sheegay shir jaraa’id oo Jimcihii ay qabteen hoggaamiyeyaasha diimaha ee Minnesota. “Waxaan ognahay waxa ay ka dhigan tahay marka bulsho dhan oo u timaadda cibaado laga dhigo dad aan ammaan dareemayn. In bulsho dhan la eedeeyo ma aha isla-xisaabtan. In bulsho laga dhigto cid lagu eedeeyo dhibaatooyinka ma aha istaraatiijiyad lagu xaqiijinayo amniga,” ayuu yiri. Dhanka kale, qaar ka mid ah dadka deriska la ah masjidyada iyo ganacsiyada Soomaalida ayaa bilaabay inay dib u abaabulaan kooxo ilaalo mutadawiciin ah, kuwaas oo kormeeri doona hareeraha goobahaas si ay uga hortagaan falal amni-darro. Suleiman ayaa sheegay in tallaabadan ay dib u soo noolaynayso hawlgallo ilaalin bulsho oo hore loo sameeyay xilligii hawlgalkii socdaalka ee loo bixiyay Operation Metro Surge, kaas oo dowladda federaalka Mareykanka ay ka fulisay Minnesota, isla markaana saameeyay Soomaalida iyo bulshooyin kale oo muhaajiriin ah. Booliska Minneapolis iyo xafiiska sheriff-ka degmada Hennepin ayaan ka jawaabin su’aalo ay MPR News ka weydiisay inay heleen hanjabaado gaar ah oo ka dhan ah masjidyada, iyo inay qorsheynayaan inay kordhiyaan ilaalintooda. Dhacdooyinka huriyay xiisadda Xiisaddan ayaa soo xoogaysatay kadib dhacdooyin amni oo maalmihii u dambeeyay ka dhacay Minnesota, kuwaas oo sababay in siyaasiyiin iyo dad isticmaala baraha bulshada ay eedeymo guud u jeediyaan Soomaalida. 2-dii October, laba dhallinyaro ah oo Soomaali Mareykan ah ayaa ku dhaawacmay rasaas ka dhacday bannaanka dugsi sare oo ku yaalla Eden Prairie, xilli halkaas lagu qabanayay ciyaar kubbadda cagta Mareykanka ah. Booliska ayaa sheegay in dhacdadaasi ay xiriir la lahayd kooxaha burcadda ah, waxaana saraakiisha ammaanku ku baaqeen iskaashi ballaaran oo lagula dagaallamayo rabshadaha ay geystaan kooxaha hubeysan ee dhallinyarada. Arrinta ayaa sii murugtay Arbacadii, markii hay’adaha ammaanka Mareykanka ay shaaciyeen xarigga Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud, oo ah 18 jir Soomaali Mareykan ah, kaas oo lagu eedeeyay inuu qorsheynayay weerar lagu qaado xarunta ganacsiga Mall of America. Dacwad-oogayaasha federaalka ayaa sheegay in eedeysanuhu doonayay inuu fuliyo weerar dad badan lagu dilo, balse laamaha ammaanka ay fashiliyeen qorshahaas. Kiiskaasi xiriir lama laha rasaastii Eden Prairie. Dhacdooyinkan ayaa sii huriyay doodda ku saabsan amniga gobolka, iyadoo hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaalida ay ku adkeysanayaan in shaqsiyaadka falal dambiyeed lagu eedeeyo aan loo adeegsan karin in lagu cambaareeyo bulsho dhan. Madaxda Minnesota oo u jawaabay Trump Guddoomiyaha gobolka Minnesota, Tim Walz, ayaa ka mid noqday siyaasiyiinta cambaareeyay hadallada Trump, isagoo ku eedeeyay madaxweynaha inuu isku dayayo inuu kala qaybiyo dadka Mareykanka. “Waxaad filaysaa in madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu haysto arrimo ka muhiimsan inuu galabtiisa ku bixiyo isku dirka dadka Mareykanka,” ayuu Walz ku sheegay farriin uu u diray taageerayaashiisa. Xeer-ilaaliyaha guud ee Minnesota, Keith Ellison, ayaa isna difaacay bulshada Soomaaliyeed, isagoo sheegay inay qayb ka yihiin bulshada gobolka, isla markaana aanay mudnayn in la takooro. Qaar ka mid ah hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada ayaa sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyay in dowladda federaalka ay rabshadaha ka dhacay gobolka u adeegsan karto marmarsiinyo ay ciidamo federaal ah dib ugu soo dirto Minnesota. Walaacan ayaa yimid kadib markii Trump uu qoraalkiisa ku sheegay in dadka Minnesota ay codsan karaan in dowladda federaalka ay u soo gurmato. Suleiman Adan ayaa ugu dambeyn ugu baaqay siyaasiyiinta Minnesota inay si cad u difaacaan xuquuqda iyo amniga Soomaalida, isagoo xusay in Soomaalidu ay qayb muhiim ah ka yihiin nolosha iyo bulshada gobolka. “Soomaalidu waa dad reer Minnesota ah, sida ay uga mid yihiin dhaqanka iyo nolosha gobolka. Waa inaad u istaagtaan difaacooda, sida aad u difaaci lahaydeen qayb kasta oo bulshadaada ka mid ah oo si gardarro ah loo eedeynayo,” ayuu yiri.
