items.title: Yemen War Reaches Riyadh Airport as Houthi Attacks Kill Airline Pilot
items.description: RIYADH (WDN) — The war in Yemen is reaching deeper into Saudi Arabia, with attacks on Riyadh’s international airport killing three Saudi citizens, including a national airline pilot, damaging a passenger aircraft and raising fresh fears that the conflict is spreading beyond the battlefield into civilian infrastructure. Saudia, Saudi Arabia’s national carrier, confirmed the death of Captain Hamoud Ali Al-Kalthami following Thursday’s attacks on King Khalid International Airport. The airline expressed condolences to his family, friends and colleagues. The Saudi General Authority of Civil Aviation said two attacks targeted the airport on October 8. The first struck airport facilities, while the second targeted an aircraft belonging to Saudia. The attacks killed three Saudi citizens and injured several other people, including citizens and residents of different nationalities. Some injuries were reported to be serious. The aircraft was damaged while parked at the airport, with no passengers on board at the time, according to the airline. Airport operations subsequently resumed. The deaths mark a sobering escalation in a conflict whose consequences are increasingly extending beyond Yemen’s borders. When missiles threaten a major international airport, the war is no longer confined to military positions or distant front lines. It puts civilian lives, commercial aviation and regional connectivity at risk. A War With Increasingly Wider Consequences The attack on Riyadh’s airport highlights the vulnerability of civilian infrastructure as hostilities intensify between Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces and the Houthi movement. The Houthis claimed responsibility for strikes on the airport, saying they had used cruise missiles. The full circumstances of the attacks and the precise mechanism by which the Saudia aircraft was damaged were not immediately clear in the initial reporting. The consequences, however, were unmistakable. Airport facilities were damaged, people were killed and injured, and aviation operations faced disruption as airlines and authorities assessed the security risks. The incident followed other reported attacks on Saudi airports, adding to concern that air travel and critical infrastructure are becoming increasingly exposed to the widening conflict. For passengers, airline employees and residents, the implications are immediate: a journey through a major civilian airport can no longer be treated as entirely separate from the military confrontation unfolding across the region. Yemen’s conflict has endured for more than a decade, devastating communities and weakening the country’s institutions. The renewed escalation is now raising fresh concerns about the security of neighbouring states and the potential for further regional involvement. Saudi Arabia has backed internationally recognised Yemeni government forces against the Houthis, who control the capital, Sanaa, and other parts of the country. The latest attacks have intensified the confrontation, with Saudi Arabia and its partners facing pressure to protect their territory and infrastructure. The danger is that attacks and retaliation could produce a cycle in which each military response creates further incentives for escalation. That prospect carries consequences well beyond the immediate combatants. A widening conflict could disrupt commercial aviation, threaten regional transport links and increase pressure on countries already navigating a volatile security environment. The stakes are especially significant because the conflict is unfolding amid wider regional tensions. The more countries become involved militarily, the greater the risk that Yemen’s war will become entangled in a broader confrontation with consequences that are difficult to contain. The Human Cost Behind the Headlines The death of Captain Al-Kalthami gives the latest escalation a human face. He was an airline professional whose death has brought grief to his family and colleagues, while the other fatalities and injuries underscore the broader civilian toll. Airports are essential public infrastructure, serving not only business and tourism but also families, humanitarian workers, medical travel and international connections. Attacks that endanger them can generate fear and disruption far beyond the immediate site of impact. The incident also raises urgent questions about how civilian facilities can be protected when missile threats extend into major population centres. Although Saudi authorities have said airport operations returned to normal, the restoration of flights does not erase the loss of life or the security concerns exposed by the attack. A Dangerous Threshold for the Region The attacks on Riyadh are a reminder that the consequences of Yemen’s war cannot be measured solely by territory gained or lost by the opposing forces. They must also be measured in civilian deaths, damaged infrastructure, disrupted travel and the possibility of further escalation. The immediate priority is to protect civilians and prevent additional attacks on facilities essential to public life. The longer-term challenge is to prevent military retaliation from drawing more countries and critical infrastructure into the conflict. For Yemen, continued escalation threatens to deepen an already devastating crisis. For Saudi Arabia and its neighbours, it raises the prospect of a wider and more costly confrontation. Captain Al-Kalthami’s death is more than another casualty in a regional conflict. It is a stark reminder that when war expands toward civilian airports and public infrastructure, the boundary between the battlefield and everyday life becomes dangerously thin. items.title: Somalia’s govt loses three towns in 48 hours as rivals advance
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Al-Shabaab militants have severed a vital army supply road in central Somalia, and Jubaland forces have wrested a southern town from federal control, leaving the government in Mogadishu with three territorial losses in 48 hours. Fighters from the jihadist group captured Hees, in the central Hiran region, on Friday after a brief battle with the Somali National Army. The town sits close to strategic town of Mataban, astride the road that connects it to the regional capital, Beledweyne. Its fall cuts a lifeline for government troops in the area. Hundreds of kilometres to the south, forces from the semi-autonomous state of Jubaland seized Balad Hawo, in the Gedo region, from federal troops who had taken it only months earlier. The reversal rekindles a bitter contest between Mogadishu and Jubaland over control of Gedo’s principal towns. Jubaland now holds Balad Hawo, Dolow, Luuq and El Wak, while federal-aligned forces retain Bardere and Garbaharey. The back-to-back reverses follow Thursday’s loss of Qansax Dheere, in the Bay region, to fighters loyal to Abdiaziz Laftagareen, the ousted president of South West state. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee xiisadda Eritrea iyo Itoobiya – Maxay Asmara sameysay?
items.description: Asmara (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Eritrea ayaa Sabtidii Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ka dalbatay inuu cambaareeyo waxa ay ku tilmaantay dagaal ay Itoobiya ku dhawaaqday, isla markaana qaado tallaabooyin looga hortagayo weerar ay sheegtay in Addis Ababa ay ku soo wajahan tahay dalkeeda, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha u dhexeeya labada waddan. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Eritrea, Osman Saleh, ayaa warqad uu 10-ka October u diray Golaha Ammaanka ku eedeeyay dowladda Itoobiya inay diyaarineyso duullaan ka dhan ah dalkiisa, isla markaana ay isku dayeyso inay weerarkaasi ugu qiil hesho sheegashooyin la xiriira xaqa is-difaacidda. Saleh ayaa si adag u beeniyay eedeymaha Itoobiya ee sheegaya in ciidamo Eritrean ah ay gudaha u galeen dhulkeeda, wuxuuna ku tilmaamay marmarsiinyo lagu doonayo in lagu sharciyeeyo dagaal ka dhan ah dalkiisa. “Isku dayga marin-habaabinta ah ee Itoobiya ay ku dooneyso inay falalkeeda dagaal ee ka dhanka ah dal madax-bannaan oo xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ugu qiil hesho ‘is-difaacid’ waa arrin aan sal iyo raad lahayn, isla markaana meel ka dhac ku ah garashada beesha caalamka,” ayuu Saleh ku yiri warqadda. Wasiirka ayaa Golaha Ammaanka ugu baaqay inuu si adag u cambaareeyo waxa uu ugu yeeray dagaalka ay Itoobiya ku dhawaaqday, isla markaana uu qaado tallaabooyin ka hortag ah oo waafaqsan cutubka toddobaad ee Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay. Cutubkaasi ayaa Golaha Ammaanka awood u siinaya inuu soo rogo cunaqabateyn iyo tallaabooyin kale oo lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda iyo amniga caalamka, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa militari haddii loo baahdo. Warqadda Eritrea ayaa timid maalin kaddib markii wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Itoobiya, Gedion Timothewos, uu isaguna Golaha Ammaanka u gudbiyay qoraal uu ku eedeeyay Eritrea inay duullaan ballaaran ku soo qaadday waqooyiga Itoobiya. Gedion ayaa sheegay in ciidamo Eritrean ah, oo ay ku jiraan cutubyo wata gaadiidka gaashaaman, ay gudaha u galeen gobolka Tigray, iyagoo gaaray goobo dhulka Itoobiya u jira illaa 60 kiiloomitir xadka labada waddan. “Duullaanka ballaaran ee Eritrea ku soo qaadday qeybo ka mid ah waqooyiga Itoobiya waa arrin si cad loo ogyahay,” ayaa lagu yiri warqadda Itoobiya, oo weerarkaasi ku tilmaantay xadgudub u oggolaanaya Addis Ababa inay adeegsato xaqeeda is-difaacidda. Itoobiya ayaa qoraalkeeda ku cuskatay qodobka 51-aad ee Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay, kaas oo dalalka siinaya xaqa inay iska difaacaan weerar hubeysan, hase yeeshee ma aysan faahfaahin tallaabooyinka militari ee ay qaadeyso. Eritrea ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay in dowladda Itoobiya ay saddexdii sano ee lasoo dhaafay waday siyaasad colaadeed oo ka dhan ah dalkeeda, iyadoo ku adkeysatay in eedeymaha hadda la soo jeediyay ay qeyb ka yihiin isku day lagu qiil siinayo weerar hore loo qorsheeyay. Dagaalka ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya Xiisadda diblomaasiyadeed ayaa kusoo beegantay iyadoo ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya iyo maleeshiyaad la safan ay kusii siqayaan deegaannada u dhow xadka Eritrea, kaddib ku dhowaad saddex toddobaad oo dagaallo culus ay kula jireen isbahaysi kooxo hubeysan ah. Saddex qof oo ku sugan magaalada Adigrat, oo qiyaastii 30 kiiloomitir u jirta xadka Eritrea, ayaa wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters u sheegay in ciidamada Itoobiya iyo kuwa taageera ay Sabtidii gudaha u galeen magaaladaasi. Reuters ayaa sheegtay inaysan xaqiijin karin in ciidamada dowladda ay si buuxda ula wareegeen Adigrat, oo warar hore ay tilmaamayeen inay ka hawlgalayeen ciidamo Eritrean ah. Hay’adda ACLED ee la socota colaadaha caalamka ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada Eritrea ay Arbacadii kasoo gudbeen xadka agagaarka magaalada Zalambessa, kaddibna ay u dhaqaaqeen dhinaca Adigrat iyo Idaga Hamus. Sida ay hay’addu sheegtay, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Itoobiya ayaa duqeeyay fariisimo ay ciidanka Eritrea ku lahaayeen deegaannadaasi, taas oo keentay inay dib uga gurtaan goobo ku dhow Adigrat. Eritrea ayaa beenisay inay ciidamadeedu gudaha u galeen Itoobiya, waxayna wararkaasi ku tilmaantay eedeymo Addis Ababa ay u adeegsaneyso marmarsiinyo dagaal. Dagaallada ayaa sidoo kale ku lug leh isbahaysi ka kooban toddoba kooxood oo hubeysan, oo uu qeyb ka yahay Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray ee TPLF, kuwaas oo sheegay inay doonayaan inay meesha ka saaraan xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed. Isbahaysiga ayaa 23-kii September bilaabay weerarro ka dhan ah ciidamada dowladda, taas oo dhalisay dagaalladii ugu cuslaa ee waqooyiga Itoobiya ka dhaca tan iyo markii uu dhammaaday dagaalkii sokeeye ee dalkaasi sanadkii 2022. Ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taageera ayaa horraantii bishan dib ula wareegay magaalada Mekelle, oo ah xarunta gobolka Tigray, kaddib markii ay halkaasi ka baxeen dagaalyahannada TPLF. Hase yeeshee, dagaallada ayaa weli ka socda deegaanno kale. Itoobiya ayaa Eritrea ku eedeysay inay taageero militari siineyso isbahaysiga hubeysan, balse Asmara ayaa beenisay eedeyntaasi. Muranka marin-u-helidda Badda Cas Warqaddiisa Golaha Ammaanka, wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Eritrea ayaa dhaqdhaqaaqyada militari ee Itoobiya ku xiriiriyay damaceeda muddada dheer ee marin-u-helidda Badda Cas, isagoo ku eedeeyay Addis Ababa inay dooneyso inay xoog ku qabsato dhul Eritrea ka tirsan. Saleh ayaa sheegay in dowladdiisu ay marar badan beesha caalamka uga digtay hadallada Itoobiya ee ku saabsan helitaanka marin badeed ay madax-bannaani ku leedahay, taas oo Eritrea ay u aragto khatar ku wajahan qarannimadeeda iyo wadajirka dhulkeeda. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale soo hadal qaaday hadallo uu sheegay inuu 27-kii September jeediyay taliye ku-xigeenka ciidamada Itoobiya, General Abebaw Tadesse. Sida uu Saleh ku andacooday, General Abebaw ayaa qabsashada dekedda Assab ee Eritrea ku tilmaamay hadafka ugu dambeeya ee dagaalka, isaga oo magaalada Mekelle ku sheegay meel loo sii marayo duullaan lagu qaado Eritrea. Si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin karo hadalladaasi uu wasiirka Eritrea u nisbeeyay sarkaalka Itoobiya. Itoobiya ayaa noqotay dal aan bad lahayn markii Eritrea ay madax-bannaanideeda qaadatay sanadkii 1993, waxaana xukuumadda Abiy Ahmed ay marar badan sheegtay in helitaanka marin badeed uu muhiim u yahay horumarka dhaqaalaha dalka. Abiy ayaa Isniintii mar kale ku celiyay mowqifkaasi, xilli uu khudbad u jeedinayay baarlamaanka kaddib markii loo dhaariyay muddo-xileed cusub. “Annagoo ku saleyneyna mabda’a wax is-dhaafsiga, waxaan si dadaal leh uga shaqeyn doonnaa inaan xaqiijinno in Itoobiya ay hesho marin ay badda uga baxdo,” ayuu yiri. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ku adkeysanaya in dowladdiisu ay doonayso inay marin-badeedka ku hesho wada-hadal nabadeed, balse Eritrea ayaa walaac ka muujisay hadallada madaxda Itoobiya ee ku saabsan dekedda Assab, oo ka mid ah goobaha istaraatiijiga ah ee Badda Cas. Xiriirkii labada dal oo burburay Xiisadda hadda taagan ayaa dib usoo nooleysay colaaddii taariikhiga ahayd ee labada waddan, kuwaas oo dagaal dhiig badan ku daatay uu dhexmaray intii u dhexeysay 1998 iyo 2000, ka hor inta aysan kala saxiixan heshiiskii nabadda ee Algiers. Xiriirkooda ayaa si weyn u soo hagaagay sanadkii 2018, markii Abiy Ahmed iyo Madaxweynaha Eritrea, Isaias Afwerki, ay gaareen heshiis nabadeed oo soo afjaray ku dhowaad labaatan sano oo colaad iyo kala fogaansho ah. Heshiiskaasi ayaa qeyb weyn ka qaatay in Abiy Ahmed uu sanadkii 2019 ku guuleysto abaalmarinta Nobel Peace Prize. Labada dal ayaa markii dambe isku dhinac ka dagaallamay dagaalkii Tigray ee socday intii u dhexeysay 2020 iyo 2022, balse xiriirkooda ayaa xumaaday kaddib heshiiskii Pretoria ee lagu soo afjaray colaaddaasi. Warqaddiisa, Saleh ayaa xusay digniino ay Qaramada Midoobay iyo dalal kale soo saareen bishii December 2025, markaas oo ay ku beegnayd sannad-guuradii 25-aad ee heshiiskii Algiers, kuwaas oo labada waddan loogu baaqay inay ilaaliyaan nabadda iyo madax-bannaanida midba midka kale. Waxa uu dowladda Itoobiya ku eedeeyay inay iska indhatirtay baaqyadaasi, isla markaana ay qorshaheeda uu ku eedeeyay ee duullaanka Eritrea ku dartay dagaalka hadda ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya. Saleh ayaa ugu dambeyn ka digay in dagaal cusub oo dhex mara labada dal uu sababi karo burbur baaxad leh oo soo gaara shucuubtooda, isla markaana uu khalkhal gelin karo xasilloonida guud ahaan gobolka Geeska Afrika. items.fullContent: Asmara (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Eritrea ayaa Sabtidii Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ka dalbatay inuu cambaareeyo waxa ay ku tilmaantay dagaal ay Itoobiya ku dhawaaqday, isla markaana qaado tallaabooyin looga hortagayo weerar ay sheegtay in Addis Ababa ay ku soo wajahan tahay dalkeeda, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha u dhexeeya labada waddan. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Eritrea, Osman Saleh, ayaa warqad uu 10-ka October u diray Golaha Ammaanka ku eedeeyay dowladda Itoobiya inay diyaarineyso duullaan ka dhan ah dalkiisa, isla markaana ay isku dayeyso inay weerarkaasi ugu qiil hesho sheegashooyin la xiriira xaqa is-difaacidda. Saleh ayaa si adag u beeniyay eedeymaha Itoobiya ee sheegaya in ciidamo Eritrean ah ay gudaha u galeen dhulkeeda, wuxuuna ku tilmaamay marmarsiinyo lagu doonayo in lagu sharciyeeyo dagaal ka dhan ah dalkiisa. “Isku dayga marin-habaabinta ah ee Itoobiya ay ku dooneyso inay falalkeeda dagaal ee ka dhanka ah dal madax-bannaan oo xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ugu qiil hesho ‘is-difaacid’ waa arrin aan sal iyo raad lahayn, isla markaana meel ka dhac ku ah garashada beesha caalamka,” ayuu Saleh ku yiri warqadda. Wasiirka ayaa Golaha Ammaanka ugu baaqay inuu si adag u cambaareeyo waxa uu ugu yeeray dagaalka ay Itoobiya ku dhawaaqday, isla markaana uu qaado tallaabooyin ka hortag ah oo waafaqsan cutubka toddobaad ee Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay. Cutubkaasi ayaa Golaha Ammaanka awood u siinaya inuu soo rogo cunaqabateyn iyo tallaabooyin kale oo lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda iyo amniga caalamka, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa militari haddii loo baahdo. Warqadda Eritrea ayaa timid maalin kaddib markii wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Itoobiya, Gedion Timothewos, uu isaguna Golaha Ammaanka u gudbiyay qoraal uu ku eedeeyay Eritrea inay duullaan ballaaran ku soo qaadday waqooyiga Itoobiya. Gedion ayaa sheegay in ciidamo Eritrean ah, oo ay ku jiraan cutubyo wata gaadiidka gaashaaman, ay gudaha u galeen gobolka Tigray, iyagoo gaaray goobo dhulka Itoobiya u jira illaa 60 kiiloomitir xadka labada waddan. “Duullaanka ballaaran ee Eritrea ku soo qaadday qeybo ka mid ah waqooyiga Itoobiya waa arrin si cad loo ogyahay,” ayaa lagu yiri warqadda Itoobiya, oo weerarkaasi ku tilmaantay xadgudub u oggolaanaya Addis Ababa inay adeegsato xaqeeda is-difaacidda. Itoobiya ayaa qoraalkeeda ku cuskatay qodobka 51-aad ee Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay, kaas oo dalalka siinaya xaqa inay iska difaacaan weerar hubeysan, hase yeeshee ma aysan faahfaahin tallaabooyinka militari ee ay qaadeyso. Eritrea ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay in dowladda Itoobiya ay saddexdii sano ee lasoo dhaafay waday siyaasad colaadeed oo ka dhan ah dalkeeda, iyadoo ku adkeysatay in eedeymaha hadda la soo jeediyay ay qeyb ka yihiin isku day lagu qiil siinayo weerar hore loo qorsheeyay. Dagaalka ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya Xiisadda diblomaasiyadeed ayaa kusoo beegantay iyadoo ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya iyo maleeshiyaad la safan ay kusii siqayaan deegaannada u dhow xadka Eritrea, kaddib ku dhowaad saddex toddobaad oo dagaallo culus ay kula jireen isbahaysi kooxo hubeysan ah. Saddex qof oo ku sugan magaalada Adigrat, oo qiyaastii 30 kiiloomitir u jirta xadka Eritrea, ayaa wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters u sheegay in ciidamada Itoobiya iyo kuwa taageera ay Sabtidii gudaha u galeen magaaladaasi. Reuters ayaa sheegtay inaysan xaqiijin karin in ciidamada dowladda ay si buuxda ula wareegeen Adigrat, oo warar hore ay tilmaamayeen inay ka hawlgalayeen ciidamo Eritrean ah. Hay’adda ACLED ee la socota colaadaha caalamka ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada Eritrea ay Arbacadii kasoo gudbeen xadka agagaarka magaalada Zalambessa, kaddibna ay u dhaqaaqeen dhinaca Adigrat iyo Idaga Hamus. Sida ay hay’addu sheegtay, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Itoobiya ayaa duqeeyay fariisimo ay ciidanka Eritrea ku lahaayeen deegaannadaasi, taas oo keentay inay dib uga gurtaan goobo ku dhow Adigrat. Eritrea ayaa beenisay inay ciidamadeedu gudaha u galeen Itoobiya, waxayna wararkaasi ku tilmaantay eedeymo Addis Ababa ay u adeegsaneyso marmarsiinyo dagaal. Dagaallada ayaa sidoo kale ku lug leh isbahaysi ka kooban toddoba kooxood oo hubeysan, oo uu qeyb ka yahay Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray ee TPLF, kuwaas oo sheegay inay doonayaan inay meesha ka saaraan xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed. Isbahaysiga ayaa 23-kii September bilaabay weerarro ka dhan ah ciidamada dowladda, taas oo dhalisay dagaalladii ugu cuslaa ee waqooyiga Itoobiya ka dhaca tan iyo markii uu dhammaaday dagaalkii sokeeye ee dalkaasi sanadkii 2022. Ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taageera ayaa horraantii bishan dib ula wareegay magaalada Mekelle, oo ah xarunta gobolka Tigray, kaddib markii ay halkaasi ka baxeen dagaalyahannada TPLF. Hase yeeshee, dagaallada ayaa weli ka socda deegaanno kale. Itoobiya ayaa Eritrea ku eedeysay inay taageero militari siineyso isbahaysiga hubeysan, balse Asmara ayaa beenisay eedeyntaasi. Muranka marin-u-helidda Badda Cas Warqaddiisa Golaha Ammaanka, wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Eritrea ayaa dhaqdhaqaaqyada militari ee Itoobiya ku xiriiriyay damaceeda muddada dheer ee marin-u-helidda Badda Cas, isagoo ku eedeeyay Addis Ababa inay dooneyso inay xoog ku qabsato dhul Eritrea ka tirsan. Saleh ayaa sheegay in dowladdiisu ay marar badan beesha caalamka uga digtay hadallada Itoobiya ee ku saabsan helitaanka marin badeed ay madax-bannaani ku leedahay, taas oo Eritrea ay u aragto khatar ku wajahan qarannimadeeda iyo wadajirka dhulkeeda. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale soo hadal qaaday hadallo uu sheegay inuu 27-kii September jeediyay taliye ku-xigeenka ciidamada Itoobiya, General Abebaw Tadesse. Sida uu Saleh ku andacooday, General Abebaw ayaa qabsashada dekedda Assab ee Eritrea ku tilmaamay hadafka ugu dambeeya ee dagaalka, isaga oo magaalada Mekelle ku sheegay meel loo sii marayo duullaan lagu qaado Eritrea. Si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin karo hadalladaasi uu wasiirka Eritrea u nisbeeyay sarkaalka Itoobiya. Itoobiya ayaa noqotay dal aan bad lahayn markii Eritrea ay madax-bannaanideeda qaadatay sanadkii 1993, waxaana xukuumadda Abiy Ahmed ay marar badan sheegtay in helitaanka marin badeed uu muhiim u yahay horumarka dhaqaalaha dalka. Abiy ayaa Isniintii mar kale ku celiyay mowqifkaasi, xilli uu khudbad u jeedinayay baarlamaanka kaddib markii loo dhaariyay muddo-xileed cusub. “Annagoo ku saleyneyna mabda’a wax is-dhaafsiga, waxaan si dadaal leh uga shaqeyn doonnaa inaan xaqiijinno in Itoobiya ay hesho marin ay badda uga baxdo,” ayuu yiri. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ku adkeysanaya in dowladdiisu ay doonayso inay marin-badeedka ku hesho wada-hadal nabadeed, balse Eritrea ayaa walaac ka muujisay hadallada madaxda Itoobiya ee ku saabsan dekedda Assab, oo ka mid ah goobaha istaraatiijiga ah ee Badda Cas. Xiriirkii labada dal oo burburay Xiisadda hadda taagan ayaa dib usoo nooleysay colaaddii taariikhiga ahayd ee labada waddan, kuwaas oo dagaal dhiig badan ku daatay uu dhexmaray intii u dhexeysay 1998 iyo 2000, ka hor inta aysan kala saxiixan heshiiskii nabadda ee Algiers. Xiriirkooda ayaa si weyn u soo hagaagay sanadkii 2018, markii Abiy Ahmed iyo Madaxweynaha Eritrea, Isaias Afwerki, ay gaareen heshiis nabadeed oo soo afjaray ku dhowaad labaatan sano oo colaad iyo kala fogaansho ah. Heshiiskaasi ayaa qeyb weyn ka qaatay in Abiy Ahmed uu sanadkii 2019 ku guuleysto abaalmarinta Nobel Peace Prize. Labada dal ayaa markii dambe isku dhinac ka dagaallamay dagaalkii Tigray ee socday intii u dhexeysay 2020 iyo 2022, balse xiriirkooda ayaa xumaaday kaddib heshiiskii Pretoria ee lagu soo afjaray colaaddaasi. Warqaddiisa, Saleh ayaa xusay digniino ay Qaramada Midoobay iyo dalal kale soo saareen bishii December 2025, markaas oo ay ku beegnayd sannad-guuradii 25-aad ee heshiiskii Algiers, kuwaas oo labada waddan loogu baaqay inay ilaaliyaan nabadda iyo madax-bannaanida midba midka kale. Waxa uu dowladda Itoobiya ku eedeeyay inay iska indhatirtay baaqyadaasi, isla markaana ay qorshaheeda uu ku eedeeyay ee duullaanka Eritrea ku dartay dagaalka hadda ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya. Saleh ayaa ugu dambeyn ka digay in dagaal cusub oo dhex mara labada dal uu sababi karo burbur baaxad leh oo soo gaara shucuubtooda, isla markaana uu khalkhal gelin karo xasilloonida guud ahaan gobolka Geeska Afrika. items.title: Xuska Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Caafimaadka Dhimirka
items.description: Sannad kasta, marka la gaaro 10ka Oktoobar, caalamka waxaa si wadajir ah loo xusaa Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Caafimaadka Dhimirka. Munaasabaddan caalamiga ahi waxay bulshooyinka adduunka u tahay fursad ay ku milicsadaan muhiimadda bedqabka dhimirka, isaguna baraarujiyaan baylahda ka dhalata fahandarrada, wacyixumada iyo iska indhatiridda daryeelkiisa. Bulshooyin badan ayaa weli caafimaadka dhimirka u arka arrin ahmiyad sii ridan lahayn, iyaga oo u haysta dhibaato qofeed oo aan dhaafsiisnayn cidda ay haleeshay. Ka gaabsashada ka hadalka bedqabka dhimirku waxay sii fogayn kartaa dadka la daalaadhacaya xanuunnada nafsadeed, waxayna ku riixi kartaa go’doon iyo aamusnaan ka hor istaagta in ay raadsadaan daryeel caafimaad iyo kaalmo nafsiyeed. Bedqabka dhimirku waa arrin bulsho oo saamayn toos ah ku leh habnololeedka guud, waxsoosaarka bulshada, nabadda, xasilloonida iyo wada noolaanshaha bulsho kasta. Bulsho kasta oo aan u heellanayn in ay dadkeedu helaan daryeel ku habboon caafimaadka dhimirka waxay la kulmi kartaa hoosudhac ku yimaada dhinacyada horumarka, sababta oo ah waxaa wiiqma awoodda fikirka iyo go’aanqaadashada ee xubnaha bulshadaas. Caafimaadka Dhimirka iyo Nolosha Aadanaha Bedqabka dhimirku wuxuu ka mid yahay tiirarka ay ku qotomaan tayada nolosha aadanaha, horumarka bulshada iyo xasilloonida guud ee wada noolaanshaha. Caafimaadka maskaxeed inta badan ma aha mid si muuqata u soo baxa sida bedqabka jireed ee qofku dareemi karo. Waxaa xaqiiqo ah in marka laga hadlayo bedqabka jireed, qofku si fudud uga sheegan karo xanuun ama dhaawac ku dhacay xubnaha jirka, sida gacanta, lugta ama jirka intiisa kale. Xanuunnada jireed ee noocaas ahi waa kuwo si muuqata loo arki karo ama loo dareemi karo; xitaa qof aan aqoon dheeraad ah u lahayn daryeelka caafimaadka ayaa si fudud uga caawin kara qofka xanuunsan in la geeyo goob caafimaad ama cisbitaal, si loogu fidiyo daryeel iyo baxnaano. Dhibaatooyinka dhimirka ku dhaca badankoodu ma aha kuwo raadkooda si toos ah looga dheehan karo oogada jirka. Hasayeeshee, saamayntoodu waxay si gun dheer u taaban kartaa habfekerka, dareenka, hal-abuurka iyo habdhaqanka qofka. Qof kasta oo bulshada ka tirsan wuxuu nololmaalmeedkiisa ku maareeyaa garashadiisa, habfikirkiisa iyo awoodda uu ula tacaalo duruufaha kala geddisan ee soo wajaha. Sidaas darteed, bedqabka dhimirku wuxuu kaalin tiirdhexaad ah kaga jiraa qummanaanta shakhsiyadda iyo hannaanka nolosha aadanaha. Qeexidda Hay’adda WHO iyo Nuxurka Fayoqabka Maskaxeed Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) waxay caafimaadka dhimirka ku qeexday in uu yahay xaalad la xiriirta maskaxda iyo dareenka qofka, taas oo muujisa sida uu u fikirayo, sida uu wax u dareemayo, sida uu ula dhaqmo dadka kale iyo sida uu ula falgalo nololmaalmeedka. WHO waxay caafimaadka dhimirka ku qeexday in uu yahay: “Xaalad qofku awood u leeyahay in uu garto kartidiisa shakhsiyeed, maareeyo walbahaarka iyo culayska noloshiisa soo wajaha, qabsado hawlmaalmeedkiisa si wax-ku-ool ah, waxna ku biiriyo bulshada uu ku dhex nool yahay.” Qeexitaankani wuxuu caddaynayaa in caafimaadka dhimirku uusan ku koobnayn la’aanta cudur ama xaalad xanuun oo cad, uuse yahay xaalad caafimaad oo dhammaystiran iyo fayoqab maskaxeed iyo mid dareen oo qofka u suurageliya in uu si caafimaad leh u maareeyo caqabadaha soo wajaha. Qofka dhimirkiisu caafimaad qabo wuxuu awoodaa in uu adeegsado garashadiisa, la qabsado xaaladaha nololeed ee kala duwan, una noqdo xubin wax ku darsata horumarka guud ee bulshadiisa. Dhaawacyada Nafsiyeed (Trauma) iyo Sida ay Bulshada Soomaaliyeed u Saameeyeen Bulshooyinka ay ragaadiyeen colaadaha hubaysan, saboolnimada, barakaca daba dheeraaday, abaaraha iyo qalalaasaha siyaasadeed waxay si gaar ah ugu nugul yihiin dhibaatooyinka dhimirka iyo dhaawacyada nafsadeed ee ka dhasha waayaha qallafsan ee ay soo mareen. Bulshada Soomaaliyeed, oo dalkeedu ka soo kabanayo dhibaatooyinkii ba’naa ee dagaalladii sokeeye, waxay isla markaasna la tacaalaysaa dhibaatooyin raagay oo ay ka mid yihiin aanooyinka qabiilka, abaaraha la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada iyo ladagaallanka argagixisada. Dhibaatooyinkan sii dheeraaday waxay sababeen in qayb badan oo bulshada ka mid ahi la noolaato dhaawacyo nafsiyeed (trauma) oo ay aad u adag tahay in laga soo kabto. Mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka ugu waaweyn ee ka dhashay xaaladahan waa xanuunka loo yaqaanno PTSD (Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder), ama walbahaarka ka dhasha dhacdooyin saamayn xooggan lahaa oo hore u dhacay. Dad badani waxay maalin kasta la nool yihiin xusuusta ama saamaynta dhacdooyinkii xanuunka lahaa ee ay soo mareen, sida dhawaaqa qaraxyada, dagaalladii hore, waayidda xubno ka mid ah qoyska, dhaawacyada jireed iyo abaaraha joogtada ah ee dadka ku qasba in ay barakacaan. Dadka la nool dhibaatooyinkan ma helin daryeel caafimaad oo ku filan, mana jiro baraarug ku filan oo bulshada dhexdeeda ka jira oo ku saabsan muhiimadda ay leedahay in loo raadiyo daryeelka caafimaadka dhimirka iyo taageero nafsiyeed oo joogto ah. Fahanla’aanta Bulshada iyo Caayidda Dadka Qaba Xanuunnada Dhimirka Ilaa maanta, bulshadeenna Soomaaliyeed inteeda badan ma fahansana ama ma leh wacyi dhab ah oo ilaalinta caafimaadka dhimirka ah. Marka la arko qof wajahaya xanuun dhimirka ah ama dhibaato nafsiyeed, bulshadu waxay inta badan arrintaas u tiirisaa ama u aragtaa in ay tahay diindarro, wax la xiriira shaydaan ama jinni, ama daciifnimo shakhsiyeed. Halkii qofkaas loo aqoonsan lahaa bukaan ama qof wajahaya xaalad caafimaad oo u baahan daryeel, turaale iyo taageero caafimaad oo cilmi-nafsiyeed, waxaa inta badan loo muujiyaa takoor iyo fahandarro sii kordhiya dhibaatadiisa. Dadkeenna badankooduna waxay la daalaadhacayaan dhibaatooyin la xiriira bedqabka dhimirka. Dhallinyaradu waxay la nool yihiin walbahaar iyo welwel (stress) ka dhasha shaqa-la’aanta; ma jirto cid tixgelin gaar ah siisa bedqabkooda maskaxeed, waxayna halis ugu jiraan in ay la kulmaan dhibaatooyin kale oo caafimaad oo halis gelin kara noloshooda! Saamaynta Caafimaadka Dhimirku ku Leeyahay Dhismaha iyo Wadajirka Bulshada Marka caafimaadka dhimirka ee bulshadu la kulmo caqabad uu ka socon waayo, waxaa wiiqma habdhaqankii bulshada iyo wanaaggiisa. Waxa kale oo saamayn ku timaadda nidaamka bulshada, sharciyaddeeda, maamulkeeda iyo isfahankeeda guud. Bulshooyinka waxaa inta badan wanaajiya ama haga dad caafimaadkooda dhimirku xasilloon yahay. Haddii caafimaadka dhimirka bulshadu wanaagsan yahay, waxaa yaraada rabshadaha sababa dambiyada, waxaana, sidoo kale, kordha waxsoosaarka bulshada iyo waxwadaqabsigeeda. Haddii bulshadu tahay mid uu wanaagsanyahay caafimaadkeeda dhimirku, waxaa si muuqata u yaraada rabshadaha, dambiyada iyo isqabqabsiga, halka uu dhanka kalana si weyn u kordho waxsoosaarka guud iyo waxwadaqabsiga bulshada. Waxaa jira waxyaabo badan oo saamayn toos ah ku leh caafimaadka dhimirka bulshada, kuwaas oo loo qaybin karo dhowr dhinac oo waaweyn: Arrimaha Nafsiyeed: Waxaa ka mid ah walwalka joogtada ah, walaaca, walbahaarka, murugada, tiiraanyada, dhaawacyada nafsiyeed ee ka dhashay burburka qoysaska, dagaallada isbahaysiga ah ama qabiilka, iyo xadgudubyada kufsiga ama jirdilka qof loo geysto. Arrimaha Bulshada: Waxaa ka mid ah saboolnimada daran iyo diihaalka nololeed, shaqa-la’aanta baahsan, aqoondarrada iyo barakaca bulshada, iyagoo degaannadooda uga tegay raadinta fursado nololeed. Arrimaha Jireed (Biological): Waxaa ka mid ah nafaqaxumada, hurdala’aanta baahsan iyo cudurrada raaga ee jirka ku dhaca, sida sonkorowga ama dhiigkarka, kuwaas oo cadaadis toos ah ku keena habfikirka iyo shaqada maskaxda. Hiddaha ama Dhaxalka Qoyska: Waxaa sidoo kale ka mid ah cudurrada dhimirka ee laga dhaxlo qoyska, iyadoo ay dhici karto in qofku waalidkiis ama awoowayaashiis ka dhaxlo hiddasidayaal u nugleeya xanuunnada dhimirka. Cudurrada Gaarka ah ee Dhimirka ku Dhaca Ugu danbayntii, waxaa jira cudurro gaar ah oo la xiriira caafimaadka dhimirka, kuwaas oo ay dadku la kulmi karaan marka ay wajahaan caqabadahaas ama xaaladahaas jireed iyo kuwa bulsho. Jirrooyinkaas waxaa ka mid ah: Depression (Murugada): Waa xaalad ay qofka ku raagaan murugo iyo niyadjab, waxaana la socon kara xiisihii nolosha oo yaraada, rejabeel iyo hoosudhac ku yimaadda habfikirkiisa iyo hawlmaalmeedkiisa. Phobias (Cabsida Xaddhaafka ah): Qofka oo yeesha ama samaysta cabsi xaddhaaf ah oo la xiriirta dhacdooyin, walxo ama xaalado gaar ah; cabsi aysan dadka kale la qabin ama aan lahayn sabab maangal ah oo looga baqo. Schizophrenia: Waa cudur dhimir oo aad u culus oo qofka ka fogeyn kara xaqiiqada; wuxuuna sababi karaa in uu maqlo codad aan jirin, arko waxyaabo ismoodsiis ah ama uu muujiyo cabsi daran oo aan dhab ahayn. Gunaanad Ilaalinta bedqabka dhimirku waxay u baahan tahay daryeel joogto ah, baraarujin bulsheed iyo helitaanka goobo lagu bixiyo adeegyada caafimaadka dhimirka, oo ay ka mid yihiin talabixinta nafsadeed iyo daawaynta cilmi-nafsiga ku dhisan. Hawshani waxay si gaar ah masuuliyad uga saarantahay khubarrada caafimaadka dhimirka, dadka barta cilmi-nafsiga iyo cid kasta oo aqoon iyo waaya-aragnimo ku leh daryeelka nafsadda iyo maanka. Caafimaadka dhimirku waa tiirxoog ay ku qotamaan bedqabka qofka, wanaagga qoyska iyo horumarka bulshada. Fahandarrada iyo dayacaadda ku xeerani waxay sii kordhin karaan baylahda nafsadeed, dhibaatooyinka qoysaska iyo kala fogaanshaha bulshada. Sidaas darteed, dhowrista bedqabka dhimirku waa qayb lagama maarmaan u ah dhismaha bulsho iskuduuban, isgarab taagan, kuna dhisan isfahan, turaal iyo wada noolaansho wanaagsan.
items.fullContent: Sannad kasta, marka la gaaro 10ka Oktoobar, caalamka waxaa si wadajir ah loo xusaa Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Caafimaadka Dhimirka. Munaasabaddan caalamiga ahi waxay bulshooyinka adduunka u tahay fursad ay ku milicsadaan muhiimadda bedqabka dhimirka, isaguna baraarujiyaan baylahda ka dhalata fahandarrada, wacyixumada iyo iska indhatiridda daryeelkiisa. Bulshooyin badan ayaa weli caafimaadka dhimirka u arka arrin ahmiyad sii ridan lahayn, iyaga oo u haysta dhibaato qofeed oo aan dhaafsiisnayn cidda ay haleeshay. Ka gaabsashada ka hadalka bedqabka dhimirku waxay sii fogayn kartaa dadka la daalaadhacaya xanuunnada nafsadeed, waxayna ku riixi kartaa go’doon iyo aamusnaan ka hor istaagta in ay raadsadaan daryeel caafimaad iyo kaalmo nafsiyeed. Bedqabka dhimirku waa arrin bulsho oo saamayn toos ah ku leh habnololeedka guud, waxsoosaarka bulshada, nabadda, xasilloonida iyo wada noolaanshaha bulsho kasta. Bulsho kasta oo aan u heellanayn in ay dadkeedu helaan daryeel ku habboon caafimaadka dhimirka waxay la kulmi kartaa hoosudhac ku yimaada dhinacyada horumarka, sababta oo ah waxaa wiiqma awoodda fikirka iyo go’aanqaadashada ee xubnaha bulshadaas. Caafimaadka Dhimirka iyo Nolosha Aadanaha Bedqabka dhimirku wuxuu ka mid yahay tiirarka ay ku qotomaan tayada nolosha aadanaha, horumarka bulshada iyo xasilloonida guud ee wada noolaanshaha. Caafimaadka maskaxeed inta badan ma aha mid si muuqata u soo baxa sida bedqabka jireed ee qofku dareemi karo. Waxaa xaqiiqo ah in marka laga hadlayo bedqabka jireed, qofku si fudud uga sheegan karo xanuun ama dhaawac ku dhacay xubnaha jirka, sida gacanta, lugta ama jirka intiisa kale. Xanuunnada jireed ee noocaas ahi waa kuwo si muuqata loo arki karo ama loo dareemi karo; xitaa qof aan aqoon dheeraad ah u lahayn daryeelka caafimaadka ayaa si fudud uga caawin kara qofka xanuunsan in la geeyo goob caafimaad ama cisbitaal, si loogu fidiyo daryeel iyo baxnaano. Dhibaatooyinka dhimirka ku dhaca badankoodu ma aha kuwo raadkooda si toos ah looga dheehan karo oogada jirka. Hasayeeshee, saamayntoodu waxay si gun dheer u taaban kartaa habfekerka, dareenka, hal-abuurka iyo habdhaqanka qofka. Qof kasta oo bulshada ka tirsan wuxuu nololmaalmeedkiisa ku maareeyaa garashadiisa, habfikirkiisa iyo awoodda uu ula tacaalo duruufaha kala geddisan ee soo wajaha. Sidaas darteed, bedqabka dhimirku wuxuu kaalin tiirdhexaad ah kaga jiraa qummanaanta shakhsiyadda iyo hannaanka nolosha aadanaha. Qeexidda Hay’adda WHO iyo Nuxurka Fayoqabka Maskaxeed Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) waxay caafimaadka dhimirka ku qeexday in uu yahay xaalad la xiriirta maskaxda iyo dareenka qofka, taas oo muujisa sida uu u fikirayo, sida uu wax u dareemayo, sida uu ula dhaqmo dadka kale iyo sida uu ula falgalo nololmaalmeedka. WHO waxay caafimaadka dhimirka ku qeexday in uu yahay: “Xaalad qofku awood u leeyahay in uu garto kartidiisa shakhsiyeed, maareeyo walbahaarka iyo culayska noloshiisa soo wajaha, qabsado hawlmaalmeedkiisa si wax-ku-ool ah, waxna ku biiriyo bulshada uu ku dhex nool yahay.” Qeexitaankani wuxuu caddaynayaa in caafimaadka dhimirku uusan ku koobnayn la’aanta cudur ama xaalad xanuun oo cad, uuse yahay xaalad caafimaad oo dhammaystiran iyo fayoqab maskaxeed iyo mid dareen oo qofka u suurageliya in uu si caafimaad leh u maareeyo caqabadaha soo wajaha. Qofka dhimirkiisu caafimaad qabo wuxuu awoodaa in uu adeegsado garashadiisa, la qabsado xaaladaha nololeed ee kala duwan, una noqdo xubin wax ku darsata horumarka guud ee bulshadiisa. Dhaawacyada Nafsiyeed (Trauma) iyo Sida ay Bulshada Soomaaliyeed u Saameeyeen Bulshooyinka ay ragaadiyeen colaadaha hubaysan, saboolnimada, barakaca daba dheeraaday, abaaraha iyo qalalaasaha siyaasadeed waxay si gaar ah ugu nugul yihiin dhibaatooyinka dhimirka iyo dhaawacyada nafsadeed ee ka dhasha waayaha qallafsan ee ay soo mareen. Bulshada Soomaaliyeed, oo dalkeedu ka soo kabanayo dhibaatooyinkii ba’naa ee dagaalladii sokeeye, waxay isla markaasna la tacaalaysaa dhibaatooyin raagay oo ay ka mid yihiin aanooyinka qabiilka, abaaraha la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada iyo ladagaallanka argagixisada. Dhibaatooyinkan sii dheeraaday waxay sababeen in qayb badan oo bulshada ka mid ahi la noolaato dhaawacyo nafsiyeed (trauma) oo ay aad u adag tahay in laga soo kabto. Mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka ugu waaweyn ee ka dhashay xaaladahan waa xanuunka loo yaqaanno PTSD (Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder), ama walbahaarka ka dhasha dhacdooyin saamayn xooggan lahaa oo hore u dhacay. Dad badani waxay maalin kasta la nool yihiin xusuusta ama saamaynta dhacdooyinkii xanuunka lahaa ee ay soo mareen, sida dhawaaqa qaraxyada, dagaalladii hore, waayidda xubno ka mid ah qoyska, dhaawacyada jireed iyo abaaraha joogtada ah ee dadka ku qasba in ay barakacaan. Dadka la nool dhibaatooyinkan ma helin daryeel caafimaad oo ku filan, mana jiro baraarug ku filan oo bulshada dhexdeeda ka jira oo ku saabsan muhiimadda ay leedahay in loo raadiyo daryeelka caafimaadka dhimirka iyo taageero nafsiyeed oo joogto ah. Fahanla’aanta Bulshada iyo Caayidda Dadka Qaba Xanuunnada Dhimirka Ilaa maanta, bulshadeenna Soomaaliyeed inteeda badan ma fahansana ama ma leh wacyi dhab ah oo ilaalinta caafimaadka dhimirka ah. Marka la arko qof wajahaya xanuun dhimirka ah ama dhibaato nafsiyeed, bulshadu waxay inta badan arrintaas u tiirisaa ama u aragtaa in ay tahay diindarro, wax la xiriira shaydaan ama jinni, ama daciifnimo shakhsiyeed. Halkii qofkaas loo aqoonsan lahaa bukaan ama qof wajahaya xaalad caafimaad oo u baahan daryeel, turaale iyo taageero caafimaad oo cilmi-nafsiyeed, waxaa inta badan loo muujiyaa takoor iyo fahandarro sii kordhiya dhibaatadiisa. Dadkeenna badankooduna waxay la daalaadhacayaan dhibaatooyin la xiriira bedqabka dhimirka. Dhallinyaradu waxay la nool yihiin walbahaar iyo welwel (stress) ka dhasha shaqa-la’aanta; ma jirto cid tixgelin gaar ah siisa bedqabkooda maskaxeed, waxayna halis ugu jiraan in ay la kulmaan dhibaatooyin kale oo caafimaad oo halis gelin kara noloshooda! Saamaynta Caafimaadka Dhimirku ku Leeyahay Dhismaha iyo Wadajirka Bulshada Marka caafimaadka dhimirka ee bulshadu la kulmo caqabad uu ka socon waayo, waxaa wiiqma habdhaqankii bulshada iyo wanaaggiisa. Waxa kale oo saamayn ku timaadda nidaamka bulshada, sharciyaddeeda, maamulkeeda iyo isfahankeeda guud. Bulshooyinka waxaa inta badan wanaajiya ama haga dad caafimaadkooda dhimirku xasilloon yahay. Haddii caafimaadka dhimirka bulshadu wanaagsan yahay, waxaa yaraada rabshadaha sababa dambiyada, waxaana, sidoo kale, kordha waxsoosaarka bulshada iyo waxwadaqabsigeeda. Haddii bulshadu tahay mid uu wanaagsanyahay caafimaadkeeda dhimirku, waxaa si muuqata u yaraada rabshadaha, dambiyada iyo isqabqabsiga, halka uu dhanka kalana si weyn u kordho waxsoosaarka guud iyo waxwadaqabsiga bulshada. Waxaa jira waxyaabo badan oo saamayn toos ah ku leh caafimaadka dhimirka bulshada, kuwaas oo loo qaybin karo dhowr dhinac oo waaweyn: Arrimaha Nafsiyeed: Waxaa ka mid ah walwalka joogtada ah, walaaca, walbahaarka, murugada, tiiraanyada, dhaawacyada nafsiyeed ee ka dhashay burburka qoysaska, dagaallada isbahaysiga ah ama qabiilka, iyo xadgudubyada kufsiga ama jirdilka qof loo geysto. Arrimaha Bulshada: Waxaa ka mid ah saboolnimada daran iyo diihaalka nololeed, shaqa-la’aanta baahsan, aqoondarrada iyo barakaca bulshada, iyagoo degaannadooda uga tegay raadinta fursado nololeed. Arrimaha Jireed (Biological): Waxaa ka mid ah nafaqaxumada, hurdala’aanta baahsan iyo cudurrada raaga ee jirka ku dhaca, sida sonkorowga ama dhiigkarka, kuwaas oo cadaadis toos ah ku keena habfikirka iyo shaqada maskaxda. Hiddaha ama Dhaxalka Qoyska: Waxaa sidoo kale ka mid ah cudurrada dhimirka ee laga dhaxlo qoyska, iyadoo ay dhici karto in qofku waalidkiis ama awoowayaashiis ka dhaxlo hiddasidayaal u nugleeya xanuunnada dhimirka. Cudurrada Gaarka ah ee Dhimirka ku Dhaca Ugu danbayntii, waxaa jira cudurro gaar ah oo la xiriira caafimaadka dhimirka, kuwaas oo ay dadku la kulmi karaan marka ay wajahaan caqabadahaas ama xaaladahaas jireed iyo kuwa bulsho. Jirrooyinkaas waxaa ka mid ah: Depression (Murugada): Waa xaalad ay qofka ku raagaan murugo iyo niyadjab, waxaana la socon kara xiisihii nolosha oo yaraada, rejabeel iyo hoosudhac ku yimaadda habfikirkiisa iyo hawlmaalmeedkiisa. Phobias (Cabsida Xaddhaafka ah): Qofka oo yeesha ama samaysta cabsi xaddhaaf ah oo la xiriirta dhacdooyin, walxo ama xaalado gaar ah; cabsi aysan dadka kale la qabin ama aan lahayn sabab maangal ah oo looga baqo. items.title: Xildhibaanno u badan kuwa mucaaradka oo lacago laga jiray
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Yuusuf Gama’adiid oo ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ayaa ka hadlay lacago horleh oo laga jaray qaar kamid ah Xildhibaannada Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, una badan kuwa mucaaradka, kaddib markii ay ka maqnaadeen fadhiyada Golaha. Xildhibaan Gama’adiid oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa sheegay in ay dood weyn ka qabaan qaabka loo maray jarista lacagtaasi oo dhan 800 oo dollar, isaga oo caddeeyay in aysan diiddanayn isla xisaabtanka, balse ay tabashadoodu ku saabsan tahay habka loo fuliyay tallaabadaas. “$800 ayaa laga jaray Xildhibaannada, dood weyn ayaana ka qabnaa. Isla xisaabtanka waan oggolnahay, laakiin qaabka loo maray ayaa qalad ah,” ayuu yiri Yuusuf Gama’adiid. Dhinaca kale, Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), oo ay gaartay cabashada Xildhibaannada, ayaa ugu baaqay kuwa tabashada qaba inay cabashadooda u maraan habraaca ku cad xeer-hoosaadka Golaha, isla markaana si rasmi ah usoo gudbiyaan, si looga qanciyo sababaha keenay in mushaaraadkooda lacag laga jaro. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyadoo horay guddoonka Baarlamaanka u sheegay inuu tallaabo ka qaadayo Xildhibaannada ka maqan kulamada Golaha, si loola xisaabtamo, maadaama ay gudan waayeen waajibaadkooda shaqo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, maqnaanshaha Xildhibaannada ayaa saameyn ku yeeshay kulamada Baarlamaanka, iyadoo Golaha laga dareemayo caqabado la xiriira kooram la’aan soo noqnoqotay. Arrintan ayaa sidoo kale keentay in shaqada Baarlamaanka ay noqoto mid hakad iyo dib-u-dhac uu ku yimaado, taas oo caqabad ku noqon karta gudashada waajibaadka sharci-dejinta, doodaha ajandayaasha horyaalla Golaha iyo la xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowladda. The post Xildhibaanno u badan kuwa mucaaradka oo lacago laga jiray appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sooyaal: Taariikhnololeedka Abwaan Abshir Nuur Faarax (Bacadle)
items.description: Maanta oo kale, 10kii Oktoobar 2010kii, waxaa dunida ka tegay, Alle ha u naxariistee, abwaan Abshir Nuur Faarax, oo ku magacdheeraa Abshir-Bacadle, oo ahaa suugaanyahan, samafale iyo xaqudirir. Qormadan kooban waxaan ku qaadaadhigi doonnaa qaybo ka mid ah sooyaalkiisii nololeed iyo suugaantiisa dhaxalgalka ah. Dhalashadiisii iyo Barbaariddiisi Aabbe Abshir wuxuu ku dhashay baadiyaha Gaalkacyo sannadkii 1946kii, isaga oo aabbihii ku maqan yahay safar ganacsi oo dhulka ah. Laba bilood kaddib dhalashadiisii ayaa awoowe loo sheegay in wiil u dhashay. Halkaas ayuu ka yiri: “Waa Abshir”, isaga oo ula jeeday in loogu bishaareeyay war wanaagsan oo farxad leh. Sidaas ayuu Aabbe magaca “Abshir” kula baxay. Hasayeeshee, awoowe Nuur Faarax, Alle ha u naxariistee, nasiib uma yeelan inuu arko wiilkiisa Abshir, waayo, intii uu safarkaas ku jiray ayaa loo dilay aano qabiil. Sida Aabbe Abshir ku sheegay gabaygii uu aabbihiis ugu duceeyay, wuxuu yiri: “Anoo dharabta jiifaa la yiri dhimay adoogaaye Dhudhunkayga goortuu alluhu igu dhaqaaleeyey Waataan dhismaha jaarigaa dhidibbadow aasay Oo waataan xajkiisii dhigoo duco u dheereeyey Dhismo khayr leh goortaan arkaan dhagax u saaraaye Oo goortaan wejiga dhigo ducaan dhag uga siiyaaye Ilaahow u dhaaftaan Kacbada uga dhawaaqaayay Waatay ilmada iga dhacdaa dhabannaday qoysay Waxaan dhiibay iyo ducaba wuu dhuran adoogeeye Inshaa Allaahu way soo dhunkaday ducana soo dhiibye.” Geeridii aabbihiis Nuur kaddib, Aabbe iyo reerkiisii waxay u soo guureen magaalada Mustaxiil, oo ka tirsan Godeey, Soomaali Galbeed. Halkaas ayay degaan beeraley ah ku lahaayeen reer abtiyaasha hooyadiis. Si gaar ah, waxaa aabbe iyo qoyskiisa Mustaxiil aad ugu soo dhoweeyay abtigiis labaad, Axmed Cilmi Geeddi (Urufey). Halkaas ayay qoyskoodu ku noqdeen beeraley iyo xooladhaqato. Aabbe Abshir halkaas ayuu ku soo barbaaray, kuna bilaabay dugsigiisii Qur’aanka. Waxaa gacanta ku haysay oo ku soo dadaashay hooyadii, ayeeyo Xaawo Faarax Geeddi. Waxbarashadiisii Aabbe Abshir waxbarashadiisa wuxuu ka bilaabay dugsi Qur’aan, sida caadada u ahayd bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Qur’aanka waxaa u dhigay macallimiin dhawr ah oo ay ka mid ahaayeen Macallin Ibraahin, Macallin Cumar Libaax iyo Macallin Abuukar Macoow. Intaas kaddib, wuxuu u gudbay tacliinta inteeda kale; wuxuu raacan jiray kutubta laga akhriyo masaajidda, wuxuuna si gaar ah u sii baran jiray fiqiga Shaaficiga. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ahaa mu’addin masjid, codkiisana aad ayay dadku ula jeclaan jireen. Dadkii degaankiisa xilligaas waxay ugu yeeri jireen “Sheekh Abshir”.  Sidoo kale, wuxuu xiriir la lahaa Sheekh Nuuraddiin Cali Axmed, oo uu ka bartay tafsiirka Qur’aanka iyo cilmiga tawxiidka, oo uu sheekhu caan ku ahaa. Soogeliddiisii Muqdisho iyo Bilowgii Ganacsigiisii Intii Aabbe iyo qoyskiisu joogeen Mustaxiil, waxay lahaayeen beer iyo lo’ ay ka soo saaran jireen nololmaalmeedkooda. Xilligaas waxaa Aabbe shaqo looga dhigi jiray inuu beerta ka ilaaliyo haadda duulaysa iyo xayawaanka. Aad ayuu hawshaas u dhibsan jiray. Isaga oo ka daalay hawshaas ayuu yiri: “Abidkay aabbahay ma arag beer anfacadeede Anna saan u dhowrahayay bay indhihii i dhaceene Hurda kama dhargoo maalintii hoos ma jiifsade Sidii boon halgaantay unbaa hiiradii kiciye Sidii tuug wax soo xaday unbaa sii xaduur tamiye Allahayoow cadkaas mar iga goo” uma gaddoomeene.” Intaas kaddib, Aabbe hooyadiis waxa ay geysay magaalada Beledweyne, halkaas oo uu muddo joogay. Dabadeed, ayeeyo waxay u iibisay dibi reerku lahaa. Lacagtii dibiga lagu iibiyay ayaa safarkiisii Muqdisho loogu soo anbabixiyay, intii hartayna guntiga ayaa loogu soo guntay. Safarkaas waxaa Aabbe soo wehliyay niman ay isku hayb ahaayeen, oo iyaguna ka mid ahaa dadkii u socday Muqdisho. Ayeeyo Xaawo ayaa nimankaas kula soo dardaarantay. Ugu danbayn, Aabbe wuxuu Muqdisho soo gaaray horraantii 1964kii, halkaas oo uu ka bilaabay ganacsiga xorta ah, gaar ahaan ganacsiyada yaryar. Xilligaas, Aabbe wuxuu ka bilaabay shaqooyin yaryar oo kala duwan, kaddibna wuxuu u gudbay ganacsiyo kale. Intii uu ku guda jiray ganacsiyadaas, Aabbe mar walba noloshiisa wuxuu ku xiriirin jiray Ilaahay, ducana wuu isku dhuldhigi jiray si uu u weydiisto waxa uu doonayo. Mar uu muddo suuqa ku jiray, Aabbe wuxuu tiriyay gabay gaaban oo uu Alle kaga baryayay inuu u barakeeyo ganacsigiisii yaraa. Sidoo kale, gabayadiisu waxay xoogga saari jireen arrimaha bulshada, waddaniyadda iyo xaqudirirka. Gabayadiisa qaarkood, Aabbe wuxuu ku hadli jiray afka dadka masaakiinta ah ee dhibban ama dadka aan codkooda meel sare gaarsiin karin, isaga oo u doodi jiray xuquuqdooda. Inta badan gabayadiisu waxay ka hadli jireen waaqica taagnaa. Sidoo kale, gabayadiisa wuxuu si toos ah ula hadli jiray suufiyada iyo dadka qubuuraha barya,isaga oo u iftiimin jiray xaqa una sheegayay tawxiidka iyo dariiqa toosan. Inta badan gabayadiisa wuxuu ku duubi jiray cajalado; qaarkoodna waxay ahaan jireen kuwo qoran oo keliya, oo uusan ku luuqayn. Wuxuu lahaa luuq/siiq kala duwan oo uu gabayada ku qaadi jiray, hal luuqna kuma koobnayn. Qaar ka mid ah gabayadiisa aadka loo yaqaanno waxaa ka mid ah: Gabayga “Qaadow Adigaa Leh” Gabayga “Qabyaaladda” Gabayga “Maxamadow Qaado Taladayda” (Guurka) Gabayga “Towxiidka” Gabayga “Maxkamadihii” Gabayga “Dib-u-heshiisiin” Inta badan gabayada Aabbe waxaa laga heli karaa buugga “Diiwaankii Abwaan Abshir Bacadle” ee uu qoray qoraa, Dr. Maxamed Xuseen Macallin. Samafale: Caawintiisii Masaakiinta iyo Dhaleecayntii Bulshada Aabbe wuxuu ahaa qof ay bulshadu aad ugu taqaannay kaalmaynta masaakiinta iyo deeqsinnimada; wuxuu dadka siin jiray wax ka badan intii ay filayeen. Dadka wuxuu ku caawin jiray, wixii Alle siiyay. Inta aan ka xasuusto carruurnimadaydii, waxaan arki jiray in maalinta Ciidda, salaadda kaddib, dad masaakiin ahi guriga buuxdhaafin jireen ilaa bannaanka, iyaga oo safaf ku jira. Kaddib wuxuu u qaybin jiray lacago gaaraya 50 kun oo shilin Soomaali ah oo isku xiran. Sidoo kale, waxaa jiray lacago ay u soo dhiibi jireen dad dalka ka maqan, iyaga oo doonaya in loo saddaqeeyo. Lacagahaasna Aabbe wuxuu gaarsiin jiray dadkii danyarta ahaa ee tabaalaysnaa. Dabeecadaha Aabbe waxaa ka mid ahaa in galbaha qaarkood, marka uu soo carraabayo, uu suuqa soo eegi jiray wixii ka haray dadka ganacsiyada yaryar leh, si uu uga soo wada iibsado haraaga. Hadday ahayd hooyo alaabtii ay iibinaysay ku baartay, ama nin aan ilaa saaka waxba laga iibsan, xataa haddii ay ahaayeen wax uusan gurigu u baahnayn, wuu soo iibsan jiray. Waxbixintiisii badnayd iyo gacanfurnaantiisii, waagii danbe, waxay Aabbe ku noqdeen wax lagu dhaleeceeyo, kaddib markii ganacsigiisu hoos u dhacay. Waxay ku yiraahdeen: “Nin dhiidhiibay dhaxal beel.” Hasayeeshee Aabbe weligiis wuxuu aaminsanaa in gacantii wax bixisaa ay wax ku soo galaan. Isagoo u jawaabaya dadkii dhalleecaynta u soo jeediyay, wuxuu yiri: “Dhux-dhux been ahoo waxay maqleen laygu dhaawacaye Dhanbaalay ku soo wada direen maynagaan dhihine Nin dhiidhiibay dhaxal beelyey bey dhaar ku marayaane Dhoolaha maroodiga xayiga loogu dhici waayay Maantuu dhintaa kii helaa dhalaq ka siiyaaye Taasaa u dhigan tiinna oon idin ku dheeraane Dhoolaha ku muda lacagta yaan la’ idin dhaafsiine. Markaan dhimanno kii laga manciyay sow ma dhici doono Oo sow dhaxal uumaan helin waxay dhiibtay midigtaydu Ha dhammaato waligeedna yay dhaqan carruurtaydu Rabbi baan ku dhaafaye si wacan ha u dhaqaaleeyo Anna waysu dhiibaye jannada hayga dhaxalsiiyo.” Xabsiyadii iyo Xariggii uu Mutay  Aabbe waxaa soo maray ilaa saddex xarig: laba xilligii Xukuumaddii Kacaankii Askarta ah iyo hal xarig oo Xukuumaddii Cabdullaahi Yuusuf ah. Mar kasta waxaa loo xiri jiray ku dhiirrashadiisii sheegidda xaqa iyo gabayadii uu tiriyay ee uu dawladda ku mucaaradi jiray. Hasayeeshee, xarigyadii uu soo maray kama hor-istaagin inuu xaqa ka hadlo. Wuxuu ahaa qof mawqif adag ku taagan, kuna adkaysta waxa uu aaminsanyahay. Ka Qayb Ahaanshihii Midowgii Maxaakiimta iyo Diidmadii Fikirka al-Shabaab Aabbe wuxuu ka mid ahaa dadkii aasaasay dawladdii Maxaakiimta ee jirtay lixdii bilood ee ay bulshadu ka mahdisay nabaddeedii. Wuxuu ahaa qofkii bixiyay lacagtii ugu horraysay ee lagu bilaabay shaqada Midowgii Maxaakiimta Islaamka. Wuxuu ku taageeri jiray xoolihiisa, wuxuuna dadka ku dhiirrigelin jiray inay taageeraan Midowgii Maxaakiimta Islaamiga ah. Maadaama uu ahaa qof ay dadku jeclaayeen, bulshadana xiriir badan la lahaa, wuxuu u sahlayay dawladda inay bulshada taageero ka hesho. Wuxuu gabayo dhiirrigelin ah ka jeedin jiray Isgoyska Tarabuunka, oo xilligaas dadku isugu iman jireen, si ay u dhegaystaan gabayada Aabbe iyo hadaljeedinnadii Sheekh Shariif, oo xilligaas ka mid ahaa hoggaankii Midowgii Maxaakiimta. Kaddib markii ay meesha ka baxeen Maxaakiimtii Islaamiga ahaa oo ay ciidamadii Itoobiya dalka xoog ku soo galeen, bulshadu waxay weyday nabaddii ay haysatay. Waxaa dhacday in dadka la cabburiyo; ragga garka leh la xiro, dumarka xijaabka waaweyn iyo indhashareerka watana cabsi lagu abuuro. Culayskii iyo dhibaatooyinkii ay bulshadu dareemaysay awgood, Aabbe wuxuu tiriyay maansadan oo uu ku cabbirayay dhibkii dadka haystay. Wuxuuna yiri: “Markii cadowgi loo jabay, Culimadina yaaceen, Meydku waa cashara-dhaaf Cishiriin haddow sigin, Ama caga cageyneyn Cawiyo berriba waa toban Cayayaanka hoosiyo Cadad ma leh isbaaradu, Waa ceeryaamo tuugadu, Dadkii waa cabburiyeen Calaladay ka siibtaan, Casirkii baan xaroonaa, Caruurta iyo dumarkana Cilallowga fiidnimo Cajiin looma diri karo, Waa loo cabsanayaa Albaabkaan ku celinaa, Cishaha looma bixi karo, Maqribkaa ciriiriya, Cidi ma gadato moobayl, Cadowgiisii baa badan Oo waa loo cabsnayaa, Ciribtaanse leennahay Nabadi waa cakirantahay, Nin iyo cududi mooyee, Cadli iyo garsoor ma leh, Ciribtaanse leennahay. Cisigi iyo sharaf ma leh, Xukunkii caddaa ma leh, Amnigii caam ahaa ma leh, Nabadii cukaneyd ma leh, Cosobki iyo ubax ma leh, Cagaar iyo udgoon ma leh, Saxansaxo cosoba ma leh Culumadu nufuud ma leh, Codkii Sheekh Shariif ma leh, Oo iimaanka culi jiray, Caqiidadana sixi jiray, Asleynkana ku caanbaxay, Shacabkana u ciiltiray, Ciribtaanse leennahay;” Burburkii Maxaakiimta Islaamka ah kaddib, waxaa aasaasmay kooxo kala duwan oo sheeganayay ururro diimeed. Waxaa magacdheeraa kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee al-Shabaab, oo aan ah kuwo aan xanbaarsanayn caqiiddada saxda ah ee diinteenna. Xilligaas waxay bilaabeen inay dadka dilaan, iyaga oo ku tilmaamaya inay riddoobeen ama gaalaraac noqdeen. Waxay si gaar ah u beegsan jireen wariyayaasha iyo cid kasta oo ay uga shakiyaan inay nidaamka dawladnimada ku lug leeyihiin. Aabbe Abshir wuxuu ka mid ahaa dadkii sida adag uga soo horjeeday fikirkooda gurracan. Isaga oo idaacad waraysi siinaya ayuu yiri: “Diinta oo si qaldan kuu gashaa waxay ka daran tahay foolkaano qaraxday.” Marar badan, waxaa jiray cabsi laga qabay in Aabbe la dilo, maaddaama uu subax kasta shaqo u aadi jiray ganacsigiisii ku yaallay Bakaaraha, halkaas oo ay ahayd saldhigga kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee al-Shabaab. Carruurtii uu Ifka uga Tegay Aabbe wuxuu adduunka kaga tagay 30 iyo dhawr carruur ah. Wuxuu mar walba ku dadaali jiray in carruurtiisu bartaan culuumta diinta in ka badan waxbarashada maaddiga ah. Alle ha u naxariistee, wuxuu ahaa waalid aad u jecel carruurtiisa, aadna ugu naxariista. Dhaxalka ugu wanaagsan ee uu carruurtiisa uga tagay wuxuu ahaa inuu ku soo barbaariyay barashada culuunta diinta, gaar ahaan tawxiidka. Geeridiisii Aabbe Abshir wuxuu geeriyooday habeenkay ku beegnayd 10kii Oktoobar 2010kii, kaddib markii uu ku sii siyaaday xanuun wadnaha ka hayay oo uu muddo 15 maalmood ah la daalaadhacayay. Aabbe ma ahayn qof xanuunkiisa la jiifta, wuxuuse muujin jiray adkaysi badan. Subax kasta wuxuu aadi jiray shaqadiisa, casarka kaddibna, marka uu soo hoydo, salaadda Maqrib wuxuu ku tukan jiray masjidka xaafadda. Maalinta uu geeriyoon doono, aroortii wuxuu aaday shaqadiisii sidii caadada u ahayd. Galabtii markii uu soo noqday, salaaddii Maqrib wuxuu ku tukaday masjidkii xaafadda, isaga oo xanuunsan. Balse salaaddii Cishaha ma uusan awoodin inuu masjidka aado, waayo xanuunkii ayaa ku sii kordhay. Waxay ahayd markii ugu horraysay ee uu xanuunkaas dartiis masjidka u tegi waayo, tan iyo markii uu xanuunku ku bilowday. Salaaddii Cishe kaddib, Aabbe wuxuu ku tukaday guriga. Saacado kaddibna, isagoo sariirtiisa dul jiifa ayuu geeriyooday. Gabagabadii, suugaantii ay dadku geeridii Aabbe kaddib aadka u hadalhayeen, kuna xusuusanayeen, wuxuu ahaa geerasrkii uu kaga hadlay qabriga, kaas oo ahaa: “Ilaahoow ixsaan badanow Arxamu raaximiin la hubow Ayaanta mowd i asiiboo Ajashayda la gaaroo Adduunyo aan ka aruuro Ereyga iigu danbeeyoo Afkaygu ow ku dhawaaqo Uurkana aan ka jeclaado Ikhlaasna aan u iraahdo La aqbaloo la ajiibo Laa ilaaha ilallaahu Iyo udgoonoow Nebigeennii [SCW] Allahayow igu aaddi Argaggaxna iga ilaali.” WQ: Caa’isha Abshir-Bacadle Nuur Faarax Qore iyo Nashqadeeye

items.title: Qansaxdheere’s Capture Highlights Why South West State’s Political Crisis Needs Negotiations, Not More War
items.description: BAIDOA (WDN) — The reported capture of Qansaxdheere by forces loyal to former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen marks another escalation in the region’s political and military crisis. But as rival forces compete for territory, the latest developments underscore a fundamental reality: South West State’s struggle for political legitimacy cannot be resolved through continued warfare. It requires negotiations, an inclusive political settlement and an end to the cycle of armed confrontation. Forces aligned with Laftagareen reportedly took control of Qansaxdheere, in Bay region, approximately 90 kilometres from Baidoa. According to local reports, some government troops surrendered, while others sought refuge inside a camp operated by Ethiopian forces. These details have not been independently verified. Hassan Abdikadir Mohamed, Laftagareen’s security adviser, announced that South West State Darawish forces had taken full control of the district and claimed that residents had welcomed them. The statement reflects Laftagareen’s supporters’ account of the operation; the circumstances surrounding the takeover and the extent of local support remain unclear. The capture represents a fresh challenge to the authorities aligned with federal parliamentary speaker and South West State political figure Aden Mohamed Nur, widely known as Aden Madoobe, amid the continuing contest over who should govern the region. A military advance cannot settle a political dispute For Laftagareen’s supporters, the recapture of Qansaxdheere is more than a battlefield achievement. Ugaas Hassan Abdi Mohamed, a former spokesman for the administration that lost power, described the development as a step towards restoring what he considers the region’s legitimate government. He argued that bringing Qansaxdheere back under Laftagareen’s leadership represented the recovery of South West State’s political authority, legal order and territorial control. But competing claims of legitimacy lie at the heart of the crisis. One side presents its military campaign as a struggle to restore constitutional government; the other seeks to reassert its own authority. Neither claim, by itself, can establish a durable political settlement. The danger is that each territorial gain will encourage the opposing side to mobilise, counterattack and seek outside military assistance. In such circumstances, towns and districts risk becoming prizes in a contest for power, while civilians bear the consequences of displacement, insecurity and interrupted livelihoods. Diinsoor could become the next flashpoint Reports also suggest that Laftagareen-aligned forces may be preparing to advance towards Diinsoor, another district in Bay region. The reported deployment has not been independently confirmed, and it remains unclear whether an offensive is imminent. If the reports prove accurate, the prospect of further fighting would deepen fears that the conflict is spreading rather than moving towards a political solution. A new advance could trigger counter-mobilisation, increase pressure on communities and draw additional armed actors into the confrontation. The possibility of further operations makes urgent dialogue more important, not less. Every new battle risks hardening positions, increasing mistrust and making compromise politically more difficult. Negotiations offer the only durable way forward South West State’s crisis cannot be reduced to a question of which force controls Qansaxdheere, Diinsoor or Baidoa. The underlying dispute concerns political legitimacy, the exercise of authority, security arrangements and the process through which the region’s leadership should be chosen. Those questions cannot be settled sustainably by force. Even if one side gains additional territory, military control does not automatically produce public consent, institutional legitimacy or lasting peace. The Federal Government of Somalia, regional political leaders, traditional elders and credible independent mediators should therefore work towards negotiations that address the causes of the conflict rather than simply its latest battlefield developments. Such a process would need to establish a mutually acceptable political framework, protect civilians, prevent reprisals and create a credible path towards representative governance. Any agreement must also address the role of armed forces and external security actors. Ethiopian forces reportedly sheltering troops who withdrew from Qansaxdheere illustrate how military developments in South West State can intersect with wider security relationships. Regional actors should help prevent escalation rather than become instruments in Somalia’s internal political competition. Negotiations do not require either side to abandon its political claims before talks begin. They require both to recognise that continued warfare carries mounting costs and offers no reliable guarantee of a legitimate or lasting outcome. Qansaxdheere may have changed hands, but the central political dispute remains unresolved. If the parties respond to every military advance with another offensive, South West State risks being trapped in a prolonged conflict. The alternative is to turn the current crisis into an opportunity for dialogue, compromise and a political settlement that can command broader public confidence. The question is no longer simply who can capture the next town. It is whether South West State’s leaders can find the political courage to negotiate before further fighting exacts an even greater price from the people they claim to represent. items.title: Daawo: Siyaasi Somaliland ka soo goostay oo maanta lagu soo dhaweeyay Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Siyaasiga caanka ah ee reer Somaliland, Liibaan Al-Cadaala ayaa maanta isagoo midnimo doon ah lagu soo dhaweeyay magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimada Soomaaliya, kadib markii uu ka tanaasulay aragtidii gooni-isu-taagga Somaliland. Xildhibaanno, Senatorro, agaasimeyaal, mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan maamulka Gobolka Banaadir iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada ayaa ka qayb-galay soo dhaweyn heer sare oo maanta Liibaan loogu sameeyay garoonka diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde ee magaalada Muqdisho. Xildhibaan Aweys Maxamed Cumar oo ka hadlay munaasabadda soo dhaweynta ayaa sheegay in soo laabashada Liibaan Al-Cadaala ay bilow u tahay siyaasiyiin kale oo reer Somaliland ah oo ay kusoo dhaweyn doonaan magaalada Muqdisho, kuwaas oo uu ku jiro Madaxweynaha maamulka Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi (Cirro), sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Liibaan kusoo dhawaaw caasimada Soomaaliya ee Muqdisho waxaa la dhihi jiray mudul ninkii dhisaa ka wayn mar dhowna waxaan sugi doonaa Cabdiraxmaan Cirro oo aan isagana soo dhaweyneyno. Waxaan leenahay kala go’go’ iyo kala qaybsanaan horumar lagu gaari waay,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Aweys Maxamed Cumar. Sidoo kale, Xildhibaan Caasho Koos oo kasoo jeeda Waqooyi Galbeed ayaa si weyn u bogaadisay go’aanka Liibaan, waxayna sidoo kale rajo ka muujisay in mar kale ay dib u midoobi doonaan Muqdisho iyo Hargeysa oo hadda kala maqan muddo ka badan 30 sanno. “Calanka inta aan koonfur ka qaadno ayaa Hargeesa ka dajin doonaa dhiig isagoon daadan ayayna midnimada dhici doontaa,” ayay tiri Xildhibaan Caasho Koos. Intaas kadib Liibaan Al-Cadaala ayaa u mahadceliyay dadka soo dhaweeyay, wuxuuna sidoo kale sheegay inuu ku faraxsan yahay inuu yimaado magaalada Muqdisho, isaga oo si weyn u boggaadiyay amniga iyo horumarka haatan ka jira caasimada dalka. “Halkan waxaa weeye magaaladii caqliga iyo maskaxda ummadda Soomaaliyeed oo dhan ay gashay, Soomaaliduna waa dad is-jecel dal iyo dibad meel kasta oo ay joogto,” ayuu yiri Liibaan Al-Cadaala. Dhanka kale wuxuu duray xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ay Somaliland la bilowday maamulka Israa’iil, kaas oo ay horay u diiday Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. “Israel iyo cadow ayaa qabsaday halis ayay ku jirtaa, markaan hadlaayo hareeraha ayaan feerin jiray balse maanta anoo xor ah ayaan hadlayaa,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Al-Cadaala ayaa ahaa siyaasi firfircoon oo si weyn uga muuqan jiray doodaha siyaasadda ee Somaliland iyo kuwa arrimaha bulshada ee deegaannada maamulkaasi. Intaas kadib Liibaan Al-Cadaala ayaa u mahadceliyay dadka soo dhaweeyay, wuxuuna sidoo kale sheegay inuu ku faraxsan yahay inuu yimaado magaalada Muqdisho, isaga oo si weyn u boggaadiyay amniga iyo horumarka haatan ka jira caasimada dalka. “Halkan waxaa weeye magaaladii caqliga iyo maskaxda ummadda Soomaaliyeed oo dhan ay gashay, Soomaaliduna waa dad is-jecel dal iyo dibad meel kasta oo ay joogto,” ayuu yiri Liibaan Al-Cadaala. Dhanka kale wuxuu duray xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ay Somaliland la bilowday maamulka Israa’iil, kaas oo ay horay u diiday Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. “Israel iyo cadow ayaa qabsaday halis ayay ku jirtaa, markaan hadlaayo hareeraha ayaan feerin jiray balse maanta anoo xor ah ayaan hadlayaa,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Al-Cadaala ayaa ahaa siyaasi firfircoon oo si weyn uga muuqan jiray doodaha siyaasadda ee Somaliland iyo kuwa arrimaha bulshada ee deegaannada maamulkaasi. items.title: Xogta halka ay degayaaan ciidamada Masar ee ku soo wajahan Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Masar ayaa billowday diyaar-garowgii ugu dambeeyay ee ay ciidamo milatari ugu soo diri lahayd Soomaaliya, iyadoo saraakiil, tababarayaal iyo la-taliyeyaal ciidan oo Masaari ah ay ka shaqeynayaan qabanqaabada howlgalka, sida ay werisay warbaahinta The New Arab. Ciidamadan ayaa la filayaa inay Soomaaliya ku yimaadaan laba hannaan oo kala ah iskaashiga milatari ee tooska ah ee Muqdisho iyo Qaahira iyo howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, iyadoo tallaabadani ay qeyb ka tahay heshiiskii difaaca ee labada dal kala saxiixdeen sanadkii 2024. Warbixinta ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada Masar la qorsheynayo in la dejiyo deegaanka Ceelcade, oo ku yaalla waqooyiga Muqdisho, gaar ahaan aagga garoonkii diyaaradaha ee Cisiley, kuna dhow xadka gobolka Banaadir iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe. Hase yeeshee, dowladda Masar weli si rasmi ah uma shaacin tirada ciidamada ay Soomaaliya u soo direyso, waqtiga ay imaanayaan iyo sida ay u kala qeyb noqon doonaan kuwa hoos tegaya AUSSOM iyo kuwa ku imaanaya heshiiska labada dowladood. Sidoo kale, ma jiro war rasmi ah oo si madax-bannaan u xaqiijinaya goobta la sheegay in ciidamadan la dejinayo. Warbaahinta milatariga ee Defense Arabic ayaa 30-kii September sidoo kale werisay in saraakiil Masaari ah ay gaareen deegaanka Ceelcade, halkaas oo la sheegay in laga diyaarinayo xarun milatari oo loogu talagalay ciidamada Masar iyo tababarka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Xaruntan ayaa la filayaa inay noqoto saldhigga ugu weyn ee ciidamada Masar uga howlgalaan Soomaaliya, haddii qorshahaasi u hirgalo sida la sheegay. Iskaashiga milatari ee labada dal Diyaar-garowgan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay Soomaaliya iyo Masar si weyn u xoojinayaan xiriirkooda difaac, iyadoo bishii September ay Muqdisho ka dhaceen kulamo dhowr ah oo dhexmaray saraakiisha milatariga labada dal. 15-kii September, wafdi milatari oo Masaari ah ayaa la kulmay saraakiil sare oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, iyagoo ka wada hadlay tababarka ciidamada, tayeynta awooddooda iyo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca. Shan maalmood kaddib, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa qaabilay wafdi kale oo saraakiil Masaari ah, oo uu wehliyay safiirka Masar ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Saalax Keshtah. Kulankaas ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga amniga iyo difaaca, iyadoo Fiqi uu bogaadiyay taageerada Masar ee ku aaddan dib-u-dhiska ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Xiriirka labada dal ayaa heer cusub gaaray bishii January 2025, markaas oo Soomaaliya iyo Masar ay xiriirkooda u qaadeen iskaashi istaraatiiji ah, iyagoo ballaariyay wada-shaqeynta siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha iyo amniga. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa 3-dii October magaalada Alamein kula kulmay dhiggiisa Masar Cabdifataax Al-Sisi, oo mar kale xaqiijiyay taageerada Qaahira ee madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Maalintii xigtay, madaxda Soomaaliya, Masar, Eritrea iyo Suudaan ayaa isla magaaladaas ku yeeshay shir afar geesood ah, waxayna soo saareen bayaan wadajir ah oo lagu adkeeyay ilaalinta madax-bannaanida dalalka, amniga Badda Cas iyo ka hortagga faragelinta arrimaha gudaha. Caqabadaha hortaagan howlgalka Inkasta oo Masar ay muddo ku dhow laba sano diyaarineysay ciidamadeeda, haddana qorshaha lagu keenayo Soomaaliya ayaa dhowr jeer dib u dhacay, sababo la xiriira dhaqaalaha, saadka iyo qabanqaabada howlgalka AUSSOM. Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya Cali Maxamed Cumar ayaa horraantii September sheegay in Masar ay diyaar u tahay inay ciidamadeeda soo dirto, balse ay weli jiraan arrimo farsamo iyo dhaqaale oo u baahan in la dhammaystiro. Qorshayaasha Qaramada Midoobay ayaa hore u tilmaamay in 1,091 askari oo Masaari ah ay qeyb ka noqon karaan howlgalka AUSSOM, inkasta oo tirada kama dambaysta ah ee ciidanka la keenayo aan weli si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin. Dhanka kale, ciidamada Masar ayaa haddii ay Soomaaliya yimaadaan wajihi doona xaalad amni oo adag, iyadoo Al-Shabaab ay weli awood u leedahay inay fuliso weerarro ka dhan ah ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Midowga Afrika. Falanqeeyaha siyaasadda Soomaaliya Xasan Maxamed ayaa The New Arab u sheegay in imaanshaha ciidamada Masar ay gacan ka geysan karto tayeynta hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya, balse guusha howlgalka ay ku xirnaan doonto isku-duwidda labada dhinac iyo ilaalinta madax-bannaanida dalka. Wuxuu sidoo kale tilmaamay in dagaalka Al-Shabaab aan lagu guuleysan karin dadaal milatari oo keliya, balse loo baahan yahay in wax laga qabto dhibaatooyinka siyaasadeed, dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee saameeya xasilloonida Soomaaliya. Loollanka Masar iyo Itoobiya Joogitaanka milatari ee Masar ay ka sameysaneyso Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale leh muhiimad istaraatiiji ah oo ka baxsan dagaalka Al-Shabaab, maadaama uu kusoo aadayo xilli ay sare u kaceen xiisadaha u dhexeeya Masar iyo Itoobiya. Labada dal ayaa muddo dheer isku haya biyo-xireenka weyn ee Itoobiya ka dhistay webiga Niil, iyadoo Qaahira ay ka cabsi qabto in maamulka biyo-xireenku uu saameyn ku yeesho biyaha ay ka hesho webigaas. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kaddib markii Itoobiya ay dib u cusbooneysiisay dadaalladeeda ku aaddan helitaanka marin Badda Cas ah, halka Masar ay ku adkeysaneyso in amniga iyo maamulka baddaas ay tahay in la dhowro madax-bannaanida dalalka xeebaha leh. Madaxweyne Al-Sisi ayaa 5-tii October sheegay in Masar aysan marnaba ka tanaasuli doonin saamigeeda biyaha Niil, isaga oo ku tilmaamay xuquuq taariikhi ah iyo mid sharci oo aan lagu xadgudbi karin. Khilaafka Itoobiya iyo Masar ayaa hadda ku soo beegmaya iyadoo xaaladda amni ee gobolka ay sii cakirmeyso, gaar ahaan xiisadda dagaal ee u dhexeysa Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, taas oo sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo isku dhac gobolka ku fida. Khabiirka amniga Masar, Jeneraal Khaled Okasha, ayaa The New Arab u sheegay in Soomaaliya ay muhiimad gaar ah u leedahay amniga qaranka Masar, maadaama xasilloonida Soomaaliya ay si toos ah ula xiriirto amniga Badda Cas, marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab iyo Kanaalka Suweys. Wuxuu sheegay in Qaahira ay doonayso inay Soomaaliya ka caawiso ilaalinta biyaha dhulkeeda, la dagaallanka argagixisada iyo burcad-badeedda, iyo ka hortagga faragelinta shisheeye. Sidoo kale, professor Ayman Shabana oo ku takhasusay cilmiga siyaasadda ayaa warbaahintaasi u sheegay in joogitaanka ciidamada Masar ee Geeska Afrika uu qeyb ka yahay dadaalka Qaahira ay ku ilaalineyso danaheeda amniga qaranka, isla markaana ay taageero ugu muujineyso dalalka ay xulafada yihiin ee Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea. Shabana ayaa tilmaamay in tallaabadani ay sidoo kale fariin u direyso dalalka kale ee gobolka, gaar ahaan kuwa ay Masar isku hayaan arrimaha amniga iyo istaraatiijiyadda. items.title: Diyaarad dagaal oo duqayn ka gaysatay deegaanka Hees
items.description: Wararka laga helayo Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sheegaya in weerar xagga cirka ah uu Sabtidan ka dhacay deegaanka Hees oo hoostaga Magaalada Matabaan ee gobolkaasi. Duqaynta ayaa daba socoto dagaal xoogan oo Jimcihii ka qarxay deegaankaasi iyo iska horimaadyo goos goos ah, oo maanta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ku dhex maray duleedka deegaankaasi. Shabaabka ayaa shalay weerar ballaaran ku qaaday xero ciidan oo halkaasi ay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ku lahaayeen, iyadoona ciidamada ay weerarka ka dib dibadda uga baxeen deegaankaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in duqayntan lagu taageerayo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Macawiisleyda, oo wada hawlgal ay si buuxda dib ugu qabsanayaan deegaankaasi. Wararka ay Warbaahintu heleyso ayaa sheegaya in inta badan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ay dib uga gurteen deegaankaasi, isla-markaana ay aadeen dhinaca deegaanka Teedaan oo xiriiriya Magaalooyinka Matabaan, Beledweyne iyo Maxaas. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan ay ku sugan yihiin afaafka hore ee deegaankaasi, isla-markaana ay qorsheynayaan inay dib ula wareegaan. Deegaankan ayaa waxa uu leeyahay muhiimad weyn oo isugu jirta mid istiraatiijiyadeed, amni iyo dhaqaale, wuxuuna ku yaallaa waddada isku xirta Matabaan iyo Beledweyne. Cid kasta oo maamusha Hees ayaa waxay awood u yeelan kartaa inay la socoto isu socodka gaadiidka iyo dadweynaha isugu gooshaya qaybo ka mid ah gobolkaasi.

items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – 10 October 2026: Mudanayaasha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa xarunta Golaha Shacabka ku yeeshay kalfadhiga 8-aad, kulankiisa 22-aad, waxaana shir Guddoominayey Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Cabdulqaaxir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac). Sidoo kale mudanayaasha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa Akhrinta labaad marsiiyey Heshiisyada u dhaxeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ee ku saabsan Iskaashiga Garaoorka Caalamiga ah oo ay Xildhibaanada ka doodeen muhiimadda uu dalka u leeyahay. items.title: Dalka uu jaajuuska u ahaa madaxii sirdoonka Jarmalka ee la xiray oo la ogaaday
items.description: Berlin (Caasimada Online) – Faahfaahin cusub ayaa kasoo baxaysa xiriir muddo dheer ka dhaxeeyey madaxii hore ee hay’adda sirdoonka dibadda Jarmalka, August Hanning, iyo sarkaal sare oo hore uga tirsanaa milateriga Shiinaha, xilli Hanning uu xabsiga ugu jiro eedeymo la xiriira basaasnimo iyo bixinta siraha dowladda. Wargeyska Jarmalka ee Der Spiegel ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in Hanning, oo hoggaaminayey hay’adda sirdoonka BND intii u dhaxeysay 1998-kii iyo 2005-tii, uu xiriir dhow la lahaa Wang Jianzheng, oo ahaa jeneraal sare oo ka tirsanaa ciidamada Shiinaha, isla markaana aqoon durugsan u lahaa arrimaha Jarmalka. Sida wargeysku sheegay, Hanning ayaa dhowr jeer safarro ku tagay Shiinaha kaddib markii uu ka fariistay xilkiisa, halkaas oo uu xiriir kula lahaa Wang, oo horay uga soo shaqeeyey safaaradda Shiinaha ee Jarmalkii Bari xilligii uu dalkaasi ku jiray nidaamkii shuuciga. Wang ayaa sidoo kale lagu tilmaamay khabiir ku xeeldheer arrimaha Jarmalka, waxaana uu afka Shiinaha u turjumay buugaag dhowr ah oo ku qornaa afka Jarmalka. Shaacinta xiriirkan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa maalmo kaddib markii ciidamada ammaanka Jarmalka ay Talaadadii xireen Hanning, oo 80 jir ah, iyagoo ku eedeeyey inuu helay dokumentiyo sir ah oo dowladda leedahay, isla markaana qaar ka mid ah xogahaas u adeegsaday hawlo la xiriira sirdoon shisheeye. Si kastaba, mas’uuliyiinta dacwad-oogista Jarmalka ayaan weli shaacin dalalka ama hay’adaha sirdoon ee la tuhunsan yahay inay heleen xogahaasi, mana jirto caddeyn si rasmi ah loo soo bandhigay oo muujinaysa in siraha lagu eedeeyey Hanning loo gudbiyey Shiinaha. Baarayaasha ayaa ku eedeynaya Hanning inuu xogaha sirta ah ka heli jiray madaxii hore ee xafiiskiisa, oo magaciisa lagu sheegay Manfred D., kaas oo sii watay shaqada hay’adda BND kaddib markii Hanning uu xilka ka degay. Sida ay dacwad-oogayaashu sheegeen, labada nin ayaa sanadkii 2010-kii ku heshiiyey in Manfred uu Hanning si joogto ah ugu gudbiyo xogaha sirdoonka, isagoo taas beddelkeeda lacago ka qaadanayey. Waxaa la tuhunsan yahay in ku dhowaad 2,000 oo dokumenti loo gudbiyey Hanning muddo 12 sano ah, kuwaas oo qaar badan ay ahaayeen xog sir ah oo loogu talagalay isticmaalka gudaha ee hay’adda BND iyo warbixinnada amniga ee loo diyaariyo madaxda dowladda. Dacwad-oogayaashu waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in Hanning uu xogahaas uga faa’iideystay shaqooyin gaar loo leeyahay oo la xiriira la-talinta amniga, kuwaas oo uu bilaabay markii uu ka tegay hay’adda sirdoonka. Qareenka Hanning, Leon Kruse, ayaa beeniyey in macmiilkiisu uu xogaha sirta ah u gudbiyey cid waxyeello u geysan karta danaha Jarmalka, isagoo ku adkeystay in eedeymaha loo haysto aysan sal lahayn, isla markaana si khaldan dacwad loogu soo oogay. Kiiskan ayaa walaac weyn ka dhex abuuray hay’adaha amniga Jarmalka iyo kuwa dalalka ay xulafada yihiin, kuwaas oo doonaya inay ogaadaan in xogihii sirta ahaa ee ay wadaagi jireen ay gaareen gacmo shisheeye. Dowladda Jarmalka ayaa sheegtay inay si dhab ah u qaadanayso eedeymaha, isla markaana ay taageerayso baaritaanka socda, iyadoo kiiskani uu dib u soo celiyey su’aalaha ku saabsan sida loo ilaaliyo xogaha sirdoonka marka saraakiisha sare ay ka fariistaan xilalkooda. Kiiskan ayaa sidoo kale kusoo aadaya xilli dowladda Jarmalka ay waddo qorshe lagu ballaarinayo awoodaha hay’adaha sirdoonka dalka, si ay uga hortagaan khataraha amni ee sii kordhaya. Fadeexadda cusub ayaa sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo ilaalinta xogaha qaranka iyo kalsoonida ay hay’adaha sirdoonka dalalka xulafada ahi ku qabaan sirdoonka Jarmalka.
