items.title: Maxamed Daahir Afrax: Xusuus Toolmoon iyo Raad aan Tirmayn
items.description: Waa adduun oo laguma waaree, waxaa 9kii Oktoobbar 2021kii ay caleentiisii caddaatay Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax, oo ku geeriyooday cusbitaal ku yaalla magaalada London. Dr. Afrax, Alle ha u naxariistee, oo sannadkii 1952dii ku dhashay degmada Jarriiban ee gobolka Mudug. Wuxuu ahaa foolaadka qalinleyda Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo wax ku qori jirey afafka Soomaaliga, Carabiga iyo Ingiriiska, haba ugu badnaado afka Soomaaliga e. Qoraagu wuxuu waxbarashadii dugsi Quraanka ku soo qaatay isla degmadii uu ku dhashay ee Jarriiban. Kaddibna wuxuu u soo wareegay caasimadda Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu ku qaatay waxbarashadii dugsiga hoose, dhexe iyo saraba. Kaddib wuxuu waxbarashada sare ee jaamacadda u aaday Cadan, halkaas oo uu ku qaatay aqoonsiga kowaad ee adabka (Bachelor of Arts). Dr. Afrax wuxuu ahaa qoraa iyo faaqide fiiradheer oo ku kalsoon hibadiisa iyo kartidiisa farshaxannimo oo marka aad akhrinayso qoraalladiisa aad moodayso in uu ku horjoogo siduu u garanayo geeddigelinta qoraalka iyo wuxuu leeyahay isaga oo u adeegsanaya erayada iyo weeraha hadba meesha ku habboon, siiba marka uu tusaalayaal ka soo dhanbalanayo kayda hidda-afeedka Soomaaliyeed ( Somali Oral Tradition ). Dr. Afrax hibadiisa qoraanimo waxa ay soo ifbaxday, isaga oo weli ku jira dugsigii sare ee magaalada Muqisho. Xilligaas waxa uu seeska u dhigay wargeyskii billaha ahaa ee ugu horreeyay, ee ku soo bixi jiray afafka Soomaaliga iyo Carabiga, ee lagu magacaabi jiray “ Codka Jubba ”, kaas oo soo bixi jiray intii u dhexaysay 1972dii illaa 1975. Halkaas waxa ka cad in soo ifbaxa halabuurkiisa qoraaleed uu la kowsaday kuna soo beegmay qoristii af Soomaaliga ee 1972.  Shanta sano ee u dhaxeysay 1975 ilaa 1980 oo laguna tilmaamo berisamaadka hibada qoraalka Dr. Afrax waxa uu qoray saddex sheeko oo dhaadheer oo aad loogu bogey dhallinyaraduna ay ku daadatay: sheekada kowaad waa Guur-ku-sheeg oo soo baxday 1975, ta labaadna waa Maana-faay oo noqotay sannadkii 1979 ibafurkii sheekafaneedka Soomaaliyeed ee laga dabadhacay iyo sheekada saddexaad oo ah Galti-macruuf oo sannadkii 1980 ku bilaabantay taxane ku soo bixi jiray wargeyskii maalinlaha ahaa ee Xiddigta Oktoobar, iyada oo markii danbe lagu joojiyay qaybtii 37aad kaddib markii ay dawladda military terigu qoonsatay farriintii ay sheekadu gudbinaysay. Taasi waxa ay sabab u noqotay inuu qoraagu eersado sheekadaas muddo yar kaddibna uu sannadkii 1981kii uu dibadda uga baxo Soomaaliya, kuna noolaado qurbaha. Sida laga dheehan karo marka la akhriyo buugtiisa iyo qormooyinkiisa, Dr. Afrax waxa uu dhammaantood kula dagaalamayay dhaqanburburka iyo marinhabowga da’da soo koraysa, isaga oo kuna bidhaaminayay dhaqammadii dhowaansoogalka ahaa iyo kaalinta silloon ee jiilka hoggaanka hayay ay ku horkacayeen dadweynaha. Dr. Afrax ma uu qorin oo keliya buugaag sheeko oo mala-awaal ah iyo sheekooyin gaagaaban sida Talaseeg ikk ee sidoo kale waxa uu cilmibaaris baaxadweyn leh ku sameeyay horumarinta afka, dhaqanka iyo suugaanta qaybaheeda kala duwan. Afrax, Rabbi ha u naxariistee, wuxuu si gaar ah ugu tilmaannaa in uu ahaa gorfeeye iyo faaqide fiiradheer, sida laga dheehanayo dhiganihiisa “ Fan-Masraxeedka Soomaalida: Raad-raac Taariikheed iyo Faaqidaad Riwaayado Caan-baxay (1987)’’ iyo gorfayntiisa shiiqsiga danbe leh ee uu ku sameeyay buugga “ Gaso, Ganuun iyo Gasiin ” oo ah sheekafaneed uu qoray buuni, Dr. Cali Jimcaale Axmed oo isna ah qoraa iyo bare sare. Dr. Afrax, xagga curinta sheekafanneedyada, danaynta, hodminta iyo horumarinka af Soomaaliga waxa uu ula mese yahay ama ugu jiraa dadka Soomaaliyeed, kaalinta George Orwell ee ingiriiska, Chinua Achebe ee Nigeria iyo Ngugi  Thiong’o ee Kiinya. Markiii dadka Soomaaliyeed ay muujinayeen dareenkooda ay ku diiddanaayeen falalkii dhaqandooriska ahaa ee gumaysiga shisheeye la mataanaysnaa, ee ayna ku heesayeen meerisyadii ku jiray riwaayaddii “Xoriyo”: “Ma duugoobo dhaqankay,  Ma doorsoomo midabkay,  Ma bakhtiyo dabkaygu …” Waxa ay kasha ku hayeen in qalinleyda uu horseedkeeda yahay Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax iyo kuwa la midka ahi ay guntiga labada low u geyn doonaan si ay u oogaan, una sii qamxiyaan, dabka afka, dhaqanka iyo hiddaha Soomaaliyeed. Si la mid ah af Soomaaliga ayuu Dr. Afrax ku qoray Afka Carabiga qoraalo iyo buugaag kale sida buug taariikheedka ‘‘ Nidaa ul – Xorriyaha’’ oo uu qoray 1976dii. Sidoo kale, waxaa barbaryaal hibadiisa qoraal  inuu lahaa hibo kale oo ah curinta ruwaayadaha, oo aan ka xusi karo riwaayaddii “Durbaan Been ah” oo la soo bandhigay 1979 iyo soosaarista barmaamij dhaqameed uu magaciisu ahaa ‘Kulmis’ kaas oo ka bixi jiray Raadiyow Muqdisho. Afrax waxa uu daw u lee yahay in lagu tiriyo qoraayaasha Soomaliyeed kuwa ugu horreeya, ee afka hooyo wax ku qora, marka si gaar ah loo fiiriyo buugaagtiisa sheekooyinka ah sida “ Maanafaay ”, “ Galti-macruuf ” iyo midkiisa hawaala warran ka ah ee lagu magaacbo “ Dal Dad Waayey iyo Duni Damiir Beeshay ” kaas oo gilgila damiirka akhristaha Soomaaliyeed. Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax, isaga oo u baroordiiqaya bare sare Bogumil Witalis Andrzejewski oo ku caan ahaa “Macalin Guush” ahaana cilmibaare af Soomaaliga iyo suugaantiisa ayuu ku halqabsaday meerisyadii gabyaagii Cali Jaamac Haabiil, si uu u muujiyo kaalinta uu macallin Guush banneeyay. Aniguna hadda sidaas oo kale ayaan ugu baroordiiqayaa saaxiibkay: “Alle wuxuu golxaalow ahaa, gedefka reeraaye  Magaciisu waa gudubsanaa gaaliyo islaane Galbeed iyo baraa laga yiqiin, gololkii dheeraaye Gaashaan biruu noo ahaa, goconayaa mooyi!” Sannadkii 1990kii, Dr. Afrax, wuxuu u guuray London, halkaas oo uu ku dhammaystay shahaadada PhD-da Jaamacada SOAS isaga oo sameeyay qoraalka qalinjebinta ee uu cinwaankiisu ahaa “ Literature in Transition: Continuity and Innovation in Post-independence Somali Drama and Poetry . Dr. Afrax muddadii dagaalada sokeeye ka dib, kuma uu mashquulin oo keliya kobcinta iyo gorfeynta qabybaha kala duwan ee suugaanta, ee waxa uu sida oo kale isku hawlay assaasidda agabyo iyo ka mid noqoshada ururro u taagan ilaalinta iyo horumarinta af Soomaaliga. Waxaa ka mid ahaa agabyadaas iyo ururradaas wargeys-xilliyeedka dhaqanka iyo suugaanta Soomaalida ee Hal-abuur oo uu London ku aasaasay 1993dii uuna ka noqday tifaftire, Naadiga Somali PEN ee qalinleyda iyo hal-abuurka Soomaaliyeed oo uu isagana London ku asaasay 1996dii kana ahaa aasaase-guddoomiye Akadeemiya-Goboleedka Af Soomaaliga (AGA) oo uu hadda madax u ahaa. Sooyaalka Dr. Afrax waxaa ka mid ahaa ka qaybgalka siyaasada isaga oo noqday xildhibaan ka tirsan baarlamaankii 6aad ee Soomaaliya ee lagu soo yagleeylay Carta, Jabuuti sannadkii 2000, kaddibna waxa uu isla dowladii uu madaxweynaha ka ahaa mudane Cabdiqaasim Salaad Xasan ka noqday Wasiirudawlaha Iskaashiga Caalamiga Oktoobar 2000 – Luulyo 20003. Ka qaybgalkiisii ugu danbeeyay ee dadaalka dibudhiska dawladnimadda Soomaaliyeed waxaa 4tii Juun 2015 loo magacaabay xubin ka tirsan Guddiga Madaxa Bannaan ee Dib-u-eegista iyo Hirgelinta Dastuurka KMG ah, kaddibna xubnihii guddigaas ayaa u doortay Guddoomiyaha Guddiga. Dr. Maxamed Afrax, Alle ha u naxariistee, waxa uu geeridiisa ka hor ku foogganaa soosaarista buugag kala duwan, oo ku kala qoran saddexda af ee uu wax ku qori jirey: Soomaali, Carabi iyo Ingiriisiba, buugaagtaas oo badankooda uu u harsanaa tifaftir keliya. Qaar ka mid ah an qoraalkooda mar hore ayuu dhammeeyay, qaarna sixitaan aan badnayn ayaa u harsanaa, halka qaarka kale ayba daabcaadda ku jiraan.  Marxuun Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax, waxa uu ahaa nin af gaaban, debecsan, laab furan oo fiiro dheer, lehna anshax iyo sarriig u dhalasho ah. Wuxuu la tegay lana godgalay boholyowgii uu u qabay af Soomaaliga, tixdiisa iyo tiraabtiisaba labadaba, waxaana sharaf iyo abaalmarinba ugu filan in uu waariyay “xusuus toolmoon” iyo “raad aan tirmayn”, innagana wuxuu inaga mutaystay mahad, ammaan iyo duco ah: Eebbow sii naxariis iyo janno. Aamiin! Abshir Maxamed Axmad (Bukhaari) Wasiirka Madaxtooyada Qaranka

Wuxuu ahaa foolaadka qalinleyda Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo wax ku qori jirey afafka Soomaaliga, Carabiga iyo Ingiriiska, haba ugu badnaado afka Soomaaliga e. Qoraagu wuxuu waxbarashadii dugsi Quraanka ku soo qaatay isla degmadii uu ku dhashay ee Jarriiban. Kaddibna wuxuu u soo wareegay caasimadda Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu ku qaatay waxbarashadii dugsiga hoose, dhexe iyo saraba. Kaddib wuxuu waxbarashada sare ee jaamacadda u aaday Cadan, halkaas oo uu ku qaatay aqoonsiga kowaad ee adabka (Bachelor of Arts). Dr. Afrax wuxuu ahaa qoraa iyo faaqide fiiradheer oo ku kalsoon hibadiisa iyo kartidiisa farshaxannimo oo marka aad akhrinayso qoraalladiisa aad moodayso in uu ku horjoogo siduu u garanayo geeddigelinta qoraalka iyo wuxuu leeyahay isaga oo u adeegsanaya erayada iyo weeraha hadba meesha ku habboon, siiba marka uu tusaalayaal ka soo dhanbalanayo kayda hidda-afeedka Soomaaliyeed ( Somali Oral Tradition ). Dr. Afrax hibadiisa qoraanimo waxa ay soo ifbaxday, isaga oo weli ku jira dugsigii sare ee magaalada Muqisho. Xilligaas waxa uu seeska u dhigay wargeyskii billaha ahaa ee ugu horreeyay, ee ku soo bixi jiray afafka Soomaaliga iyo Carabiga, ee lagu magacaabi jiray “ Codka Jubba ”, kaas oo soo bixi jiray intii u dhexaysay 1972dii illaa 1975. Halkaas waxa ka cad in soo ifbaxa halabuurkiisa qoraaleed uu la kowsaday kuna soo beegmay qoristii af Soomaaliga ee 1972.  Shanta sano ee u dhaxeysay 1975 ilaa 1980 oo laguna tilmaamo berisamaadka hibada qoraalka Dr. Afrax waxa uu qoray saddex sheeko oo dhaadheer oo aad loogu bogey dhallinyaraduna ay ku daadatay: sheekada kowaad waa Guur-ku-sheeg oo soo baxday 1975, ta labaadna waa Maana-faay oo noqotay sannadkii 1979 ibafurkii sheekafaneedka Soomaaliyeed ee laga dabadhacay iyo sheekada saddexaad oo ah Galti-macruuf oo sannadkii 1980 ku bilaabantay taxane ku soo bixi jiray wargeyskii maalinlaha ahaa ee Xiddigta Oktoobar, iyada oo markii danbe lagu joojiyay qaybtii 37aad kaddib markii ay dawladda military terigu qoonsatay farriintii ay sheekadu gudbinaysay. Taasi waxa ay sabab u noqotay inuu qoraagu eersado sheekadaas muddo yar kaddibna uu sannadkii 1981kii uu dibadda uga baxo Soomaaliya, kuna noolaado qurbaha. Sida laga dheehan karo marka la akhriyo buugtiisa iyo qormooyinkiisa, Dr. Afrax waxa uu dhammaantood kula dagaalamayay dhaqanburburka iyo marinhabowga da’da soo koraysa, isaga oo kuna bidhaaminayay dhaqammadii dhowaansoogalka ahaa iyo kaalinta silloon ee jiilka hoggaanka hayay ay ku horkacayeen dadweynaha. Dr. Afrax ma uu qorin oo keliya buugaag sheeko oo mala-awaal ah iyo sheekooyin gaagaaban sida Talaseeg ikk ee sidoo kale waxa uu cilmibaaris baaxadweyn leh ku sameeyay horumarinta afka, dhaqanka iyo suugaanta qaybaheeda kala duwan. Afrax, Rabbi ha u naxariistee, wuxuu si gaar ah ugu tilmaannaa in uu ahaa gorfeeye iyo faaqide fiiradheer, sida laga dheehanayo dhiganihiisa “ Fan-Masraxeedka Soomaalida: Raad-raac Taariikheed iyo Faaqidaad Riwaayado Caan-baxay (1987)’’ iyo gorfayntiisa shiiqsiga danbe leh ee uu ku sameeyay buugga “ Gaso, Ganuun iyo Gasiin ” oo ah sheekafaneed uu qoray buuni, Dr. Cali Jimcaale Axmed oo isna ah qoraa iyo bare sare. Dr. Afrax, xagga curinta sheekafanneedyada, danaynta, hodminta iyo horumarinka af Soomaaliga waxa uu ula mese yahay ama ugu jiraa dadka Soomaaliyeed, kaalinta George Orwell ee ingiriiska, Chinua Achebe ee Nigeria iyo Ngugi  Thiong’o ee Kiinya. Markiii dadka Soomaaliyeed ay muujinayeen dareenkooda ay ku diiddanaayeen falalkii dhaqandooriska ahaa ee gumaysiga shisheeye la mataanaysnaa, ee ayna ku heesayeen meerisyadii ku jiray riwaayaddii “Xoriyo”: “Ma duugoobo dhaqankay,  Ma doorsoomo midabkay,  Ma bakhtiyo dabkaygu …” Waxa ay kasha ku hayeen in qalinleyda uu horseedkeeda yahay Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax iyo kuwa la midka ahi ay guntiga labada low u geyn doonaan si ay u oogaan, una sii qamxiyaan, dabka afka, dhaqanka iyo hiddaha Soomaaliyeed. Si la mid ah af Soomaaliga ayuu Dr. Afrax ku qoray Afka Carabiga qoraalo iyo buugaag kale sida buug taariikheedka ‘‘ Nidaa ul – Xorriyaha’’ oo uu qoray 1976dii. Sidoo kale, waxaa barbaryaal hibadiisa qoraal  inuu lahaa hibo kale oo ah curinta ruwaayadaha, oo aan ka xusi karo riwaayaddii “Durbaan Been ah” oo la soo bandhigay 1979 iyo soosaarista barmaamij dhaqameed uu magaciisu ahaa ‘Kulmis’ kaas oo ka bixi jiray Raadiyow Muqdisho. Afrax waxa uu daw u lee yahay in lagu tiriyo qoraayaasha Soomaliyeed kuwa ugu horreeya, ee afka hooyo wax ku qora, marka si gaar ah loo fiiriyo buugaagtiisa sheekooyinka ah sida “ Maanafaay ”, “ Galti-macruuf ” iyo midkiisa hawaala warran ka ah ee lagu magaacbo “ Dal Dad Waayey iyo Duni Damiir Beeshay ” kaas oo gilgila damiirka akhristaha Soomaaliyeed. Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax, isaga oo u baroordiiqaya bare sare Bogumil Witalis Andrzejewski oo ku caan ahaa “Macalin Guush” ahaana cilmibaare af Soomaaliga iyo suugaantiisa ayuu ku halqabsaday meerisyadii gabyaagii Cali Jaamac Haabiil, si uu u muujiyo kaalinta uu macallin Guush banneeyay. Aniguna hadda sidaas oo kale ayaan ugu baroordiiqayaa saaxiibkay: “Alle wuxuu golxaalow ahaa, gedefka reeraaye  Magaciisu waa gudubsanaa gaaliyo islaane Galbeed iyo baraa laga yiqiin, gololkii dheeraaye Gaashaan biruu noo ahaa, goconayaa mooyi!” Sannadkii 1990kii, Dr. Afrax, wuxuu u guuray London, halkaas oo uu ku dhammaystay shahaadada PhD-da Jaamacada SOAS isaga oo sameeyay qoraalka qalinjebinta ee uu cinwaankiisu ahaa “ Literature in Transition: Continuity and Innovation in Post-independence Somali Drama and Poetry . Dr. Afrax muddadii dagaalada sokeeye ka dib, kuma uu mashquulin oo keliya kobcinta iyo gorfeynta qabybaha kala duwan ee suugaanta, ee waxa uu sida oo kale isku hawlay assaasidda agabyo iyo ka mid noqoshada ururro u taagan ilaalinta iyo horumarinta af Soomaaliga. Waxaa ka mid ahaa agabyadaas iyo ururradaas wargeys-xilliyeedka dhaqanka iyo suugaanta Soomaalida ee Hal-abuur oo uu London ku aasaasay 1993dii uuna ka noqday tifaftire, Naadiga Somali PEN ee qalinleyda iyo hal-abuurka Soomaaliyeed oo uu isagana London ku asaasay 1996dii kana ahaa aasaase-guddoomiye Akadeemiya-Goboleedka Af Soomaaliga (AGA) oo uu hadda madax u ahaa. Sooyaalka Dr. Afrax waxaa ka mid ahaa ka qaybgalka siyaasada isaga oo noqday xildhibaan ka tirsan baarlamaankii 6aad ee Soomaaliya ee lagu soo yagleeylay Carta, Jabuuti sannadkii 2000, kaddibna waxa uu isla dowladii uu madaxweynaha ka ahaa mudane Cabdiqaasim Salaad Xasan ka noqday Wasiirudawlaha Iskaashiga Caalamiga Oktoobar 2000 – Luulyo 20003. Ka qaybgalkiisii ugu danbeeyay ee dadaalka dibudhiska dawladnimadda Soomaaliyeed waxaa 4tii Juun 2015 loo magacaabay xubin ka tirsan Guddiga Madaxa Bannaan ee Dib-u-eegista iyo Hirgelinta Dastuurka KMG ah, kaddibna xubnihii guddigaas ayaa u doortay Guddoomiyaha Guddiga. Dr. Maxamed Afrax, Alle ha u naxariistee, waxa uu geeridiisa ka hor ku foogganaa soosaarista buugag kala duwan, oo ku kala qoran saddexda af ee uu wax ku qori jirey: Soomaali, Carabi iyo Ingiriisiba, buugaagtaas oo badankooda uu u harsanaa tifaftir keliya. Qaar ka mid ah an qoraalkooda mar hore ayuu dhammeeyay, qaarna sixitaan aan badnayn ayaa u harsanaa, halka qaarka kale ayba daabcaadda ku jiraan.  Marxuun Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax, waxa uu ahaa nin af gaaban, debecsan, laab furan oo fiiro dheer, lehna anshax iyo sarriig u dhalasho ah. Wuxuu la tegay lana godgalay boholyowgii uu u qabay af Soomaaliga, tixdiisa iyo tiraabtiisaba labadaba, waxaana sharaf iyo abaalmarinba ugu filan in uu waariyay “xusuus toolmoon” iyo “raad aan tirmayn”, innagana wuxuu inaga mutaystay mahad, ammaan iyo duco ah: Eebbow sii naxariis iyo janno. Aamiin! Abshir Maxamed Axmad (Bukhaari) Wasiirka Madaxtooyada Qaranka

items.title: Soomaaliya: 595 ilood oo biyo ah oo wajahaya khatar fatahaad oo aad u sareysa
items.description: Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Khayraadka Biyaha ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, oo kaashanaysa hay’adda FAO-SWALIM, ayaa soo saartay warbixin qiimayn ah oo ku saabsan saamaynta la filayo in roobabka Deyrta ee la xiriira El Niño ay ku yeeshaan kaabayaasha biyaha ee dalka. Warbixinta ayaa lagu sheegay in qiimayn lagu sameeyay 7,517 ilood oo biyo ah ay muujisay in 595 ka mid ah ay wajahayaan khatar fatahaad oo aad u sareysa, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan 68 ceel-biyood oo istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah helitaanka biyaha. Sida lagu xusay daraasadda, boqolkiiba 65 ilaha biyaha ee khatarta fatahaad ku jira ayaa ku yaalla toban degmo oo dalka ka tirsan, taas oo muujinaysa baahida loo qabo in meelahaas mudnaan gaar ah la siiyo marka la qorsheynayo ka hortagga khataraha fatahaadaha. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in warbixintu tilmaamayso tallaabooyin muhiim ah oo ay tahay in la qaado ka hor inta aysan fatahaaduhu dhicin, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin ilaalinta ceelasha iyo qalabkooda, yaraynta khatarta wasakhowga biyaha, diyaarinta agabka sifaynta biyaha iyo qalabka dayactirka kaabayaasha waxyeelladu gaarto. Sidoo kale, qiimayntan ayaa la filayaa inay gacan ka geysato hagidda qorshayaasha diyaar-garowga, isku-duwidda hawlaha hay’adaha ka shaqeeya biyaha iyo fayadhowrka, iyo go’aannada la xiriira maalgelinta tallaabooyinka ka hortagga fatahaadaha. Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Khayraadka Biyaha ayaa ugu baaqday bahwadaagta ka shaqeeya biyaha, fayadhowrka iyo nadaafadda inay natiijooyinka iyo talooyinka warbixinta ku saleeyaan qorshayaashooda diyaar-garowga, si loo yareeyo khasaaraha ka dhalan kara fatahaadaha, loona ilaaliyo ilaha biyaha ee ay bulshadu ku tiirsan tahay.

items.title: Garsoore Cumar Cartan oo la Sheegay inuu Dawladda Masar ka Dalbaday inuu Dhexdhexaadiyo Ciyaaraha Dalkaas
items.description: Garsooraha caanka ah ee Soomaaliyeed, Cumar Cartan, ayaa la sheegay in dowladda Masar uu ka codsaday inuu ka shaqeeyo garsoorka ciyaaraha dalkaas, isla markaana uu dego magaalada Qaahira. Warbixinno soo baxay ayaa sheegaya in Masar ay doonayso in Cartan uu garsoor ka noqdo ciyaaraha dalkaas, isla markaana uu halkaas sii joogo illaa dhammaadka sannadka 2027, xilligaas oo la sheegay in loo oggolaan doono inuu dalkiisa dib ugu soo laabto. Xogtani waxay soo baxday xilli ay isa soo tarayaan walaacyada laga muujinayo mustaqbalka xirfadlayaasha kubadda cagta Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan fursadaha ay u helaan inay xirfadahooda ku horumariyaan gudaha dalka. Dhanka kale, musharraxa xilka madaxweynaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya (SFF), Deeq Maxamed Xasan oo loo yaqaan Deeq Afrika, ayaa ka digay in qorshe la’aanta, tartamada oo aan joogto loo qaban iyo fursadaha shaqo oo xaddidan ay sababi karaan in Soomaaliya ay lumiso ciyaartoy, tababarayaal iyo garsoorayaal tayo leh. Deeq Afrika ayaa maamulka hadda ee xiriirka ku dhaliilay dib-u-dhacyada tartamada iyo maqnaanshaha jadwal qaran oo joogto ah, isaga oo ku baaqay in la sameeyo qorshe cad oo lagu horumarinayo kubadda cagta dalka. Haddii warka ku saabsan fursadda la sheegay in Masar uu ka helay  Cumar Cartan uu xaqiiqo noqdo, arrintani waxay dib u soo cusboonaysiin kartaa doodda ku saabsan sida Soomaaliya u ilaalin karto una horumarin karto xirfadlayaasheeda ciyaaraha.

items.title: Maxaa ka jira in hub lala raacay diyaaraddii uu la socday madaxweyne Firdhiye?
items.description: Laascaanood (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya ayaa beeniyay wararka sheegaya in la carqaladeeyay amniga madaxweynaha maamulkaas, Cabdulqaadir Axmed Aw-Cali (Firdhiye), xilli uu ka dhoofayay garoonka diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde ee magaalada Muqdisho. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Waqooyi Bare, Mudane Axmed Cabdirisaaq Diiriye ayaa waxba kama jiraan ku tilmaamay wararka ku baahay baraha bulshada ee sheegaya in rag hubeysan ay raaceen diyaaraddii uu la socday madaxweyne Firdhiye, kuwaas oo dhaliyay hadal-heyn xooggan oo ku saabsan xaaladda amni ee garoonka iyo safarka madaxweynaha. Wasiir Axmed Cabdirisaaq ayaa sheegay in aysan jirin wax dhacdo amni ah oo la xiriirtay safarka madaxweynaha, isagoo caddeeyay in wararka la faafiyay aysan ku saleysneyn xaqiiqo. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ugu baaqay warbaahinta iyo dadka isticmaala baraha bulshada inay ka fogaadaan faafinta xogaha aan la hubin, ayna xogta rasmi ah ka qaataan ilaha dowladda, si looga hortago marin-habaabinta bulshada iyo faafinta warar aan xaqiiqada ku dhisnayn. “Waxaan si rasmiya u xaqiijinayaa in aanay jirin wax dhacdo amni ah oo ka dhacday Garoonka Diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde xilligii uu safrayay Madaxweynaha Dowladda Waqooyi Bari, Mudane Cabdiqaadir Axmed Aw-Cali Firdhiye,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Warfaafinta. Waxaa kale oo uu kusii daray “Waxaan warbaahinta ugu baaqayaa inay ka fogaadaan faafinta wararka aan xaqiiqada ku dhisnayn”. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli baraha bulshada ay si weyn ugu faafaan warar la xiriira amniga iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada mas’uuliyiinta siyaasadeed, kuwaas oo mararka qaar dhaliya dood iyo hadal-heyn ka hor inta aan laga helin xaqiijin rasmi ah oo ka timaadda dhinacyada ay khuseyso. items.title: Houthi war risks dragging Israel and Turkey into Horn of Africa standoff
items.description: The escalating clash between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia now threatens to ignite the already tense rivalry between Israel and Turkey in the Horn of Africa. This week, Turkey threw its military weight behind Saudi Arabia, while Somaliland – a self-declared state recognised only by Israel – is urgently seeking Israeli military support. Houthi supporters carry weapons as they gather in solidarity with the movement as fighting intensifies across several fronts, in Sanaa, Yemen, 7 October, 2026. © REUTERS/Mohammed al-Mahdi Somaliland, a breakaway state from Somalia, is calling on Israel to provide military hardware. “We need air defence systems,” Mohamed Osman Fadal, a senior foreign affairs adviser to Somaliland’s president, said in a Middle East Eye interview this month. Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi made a similar request last month for Israeli military support. Last December, Israel became the first nation to recognise Somaliland, which declared independence from Somalia in 1991. Because of its close ties to Israel , Somaliland now fears it could become a target for the Houthis, who operate from Yemen just across the Gulf of Aden and have previously targeted Israel. “The Houthi threat is growing; it’s a major issue,” said Gallia Lindenstrauss of the Institute for National Security Studies at Tel Aviv University. “Access to the Red Sea and Somaliland’s location just across from Yemen are very important, and I think this is where Israel recognises that it’s difficult to deal with the threat only from afar, and it’s important to have allies in the Horn of Africa,” she added. Israel, which is in the midst of an election campaign ahead of the 27 October vote, has not commented on the request. But Lindenstrauss predicts a favourable response. “Obviously, if you look at the location, there should be some military support,” she said. Turkey’s backing for Somalia Yet Somaliland’s call for military aid is fuelled by more than just anxiety over the Houthis. Somalia’s government is still intent on reclaiming Somaliland , branding it a rogue state. At the same time, Turkey has stepped up its military support for Somalia, deploying F-16s and advanced drones in January, and running its largest overseas military base to train Somali troops. Somaliland president makes ‘historic’ visit to Israel “Turkey has strong defence cooperation with Somalia ; Somaliland sees that as an issue for them. It sees them as a potential future threat down the road. And so that’s why they’re calling for Israeli security support,” explained Horn of Africa analyst Omar Mahmood of the International Crisis Group . “I think what’s happening is both sides, Somalia and Somaliland, are drawing external actors into their local dispute,” added Mahmood. “So it’s elevating what has been an unresolved but a local dispute for quite some time into something broader, something more regional.” Tensions between Turkey and Israel have also been mounting, fuelled by Israel’s ongoing wars in Gaza and Lebanon and Ankara’s vocal support for Hamas. Both nations now see each other as an increasing threat. “There is a security dilemma evolving between Turkey and Israel,” warns Lindenstrauss. “What Turkey does for its security, Israel sees as threatening. What Israel does for its defences in [Syria] is seen as threatening.” Soli Ozel, an expert on Turkey at the I nstitut Montaigne in France, warns that because Somalia holds such strategic value for Turkey, any Israeli military involvement in Somaliland could dangerously escalate the situation. “They may consider the deployment of Israeli missiles in Somaliland another destabilising factor,” said Ozel. “But I don’t think that the F-16s or the drones would be used against Somaliland, honestly; at least for the moment, I wouldn’t expect that to happen.” Lebanon becomes latest battleground in Turkish-Israeli tensions Containment, not conflict Ozel argues that while Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan are trading increasingly bellicose rhetoric, both countries are engaged in a high-stakes battle of containment rather than conflict. “The theatrics and the realities of Turkish-Israeli relations may not be exactly the same,” explained Ozel. “I don’t think they will fight, but they are both showing their colours, right? Israel sent missiles to Somaliland; the Turks send F-16s and drones in order to set limits to what the other party will do.” Turkey is preparing to expand its military footprint in the region. This week, Turkey and Pakistan pledged armed support to Saudi Arabia against the Houthis under the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement signed in August, a pact binding the three nations to mutual defence. While the specifics remain unclear, Lindenstrauss notes that despite rising friction between Turkey and Israel, both countries may still find common cause in confronting the Houthis. “I think the recognition that the Houthis are not something that is seen as only Israel’s problem, and it’s not just a minor proxy of Iran, but it’s a major problem that many states have to join together to deal with. I think that’s actually good news,” said Lindenstrauss. Turkey warns it could be Israel’s ‘next enemy’ as tensions escalate Yet Mahmood cautions that as clashes in the Red Sea escalate, Israel’s possible deployment of military hardware to Somaliland points to a worrying new trend. “Horn actors need to realise that while they’re inviting external actors in to support their own ambitions locally, to get one step over their political adversaries, they risk turning their theatre into a wider proxy battleground. And so certainly, I think there’s a risk that those types of tensions can spill over,” he warned.   Source Rfi.fr.

items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo riixaya in Qansaxdheere lagu soo celiyo gacanta maamulka
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa Saraakiisha Ciidamada Qalabka Sida kala hadlaya, sidii ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) looga saari lahaa Degmada Qansaxdheere ee Gobolka Baay. Ciidamadan ayaa Khamiistii bilaa dagaal kula wareegay gacan ku haynta degmadaasi, iyagoo aan wax iska horimaad ah kala kulmin Booliska Qansaxdheere iyo kuwa Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed. Dhacdadan ayaa waxaa loo arkaa inay dilaac siyaasadeed iyo mid ciidan ku tahay Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo qabsashada Qansaxdheere ay ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen siin karto awood ay isku ballaariyaan, waxaana xusid mudan in Qansaxdheere ay noqoneyso magaaladii ugu horreysay ee ay la wareegaan garabka mucaaradka ee Laftagareen uu hoggaamiyo. Waxaa soo baxaya warar sheegaya in garabka Laftagareen ay ka faa’iideysteen gadood iyo kala qaybsanaan gudaha ciidamadii horey ugu sugnaa Qansaxdheere oo 98km u jirta Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. “Arrintan waxay abuurtay welwel iyo shaki ah in aan la difaaci doonin magaalooyinka kale ee sidaan oo kale ay u soo abaaraan. Waxaa hadda miiska saaran oo laga hadlayaa sababta ay ciidamada ugu guuldareysteen inay difaacaan Qansaxdheere.” Ayuu yiri Sarkaal ka tirsan Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed oo Universaltv la hadlay. Saraakiisha Taliska Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee fadhigoodu yahay Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa kuu sheegaya in aan la ogolaan doonin in taageereyaasha Laftagareen ay sii haystaan Degmada Qansaxdheere. Warar aan la xaqiijjin ayaa sheegaya in ciidamo u hoggaaminayo Abaanduulaha Qaybta 60aad, G/dhexe Faysal Cabdullaahi Cali (Beene) ay ku wajahan yihiin degmadaasi, si ay gacanta maamulka ugu soo celiyaan. Xaaladda ka taagan Degmada Qansaxdheere ayaa imaneysa, xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo loolanka dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo militariga ee u dhexeeya dhinacyada isku haya Hoggaanka Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: Somalia’s Northeast state denies president escaped abduction plot
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s Northeast State has dismissed social media reports that its president, Abdulkadir Ahmed Aw-Ali, known as Firdhiye, escaped an abduction attempt on a plane that flew him out of Mogadishu airport on Friday. Some well-known journalists said on Facebook on Saturday that armed men had travelled on the aircraft with him, and that the plan was to divert it to Hargeisa, leaving him in the hands of Somaliland authorities. Regional Information Minister Ahmed Abdirizak Diriye described the reports as fake and baseless. He urged journalists to avoid misleading information and misinformation, and to report the truth and material that would benefit their audiences. He said there had been no security incident on the president’s plane or during his journey from Mogadishu, and that no armed men had flown with him. The minister did not address the claim that the alleged incident was part of a plan to divert the plane to Hargeisa, where Somaliland authorities would arrest Firdhiye. Background Northeast State, which Firdhiye leads, is a region Somaliland regards as part of its territory. Somaliland lost control of it after fierce clashes with local militias in 2023. The two sides have fought a war lasting more than a year, and each still holds dozens of prisoners captured from the other. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Muxuu yahay qorshaha Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen kadib qabsashadii Qansaxdheere?
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen) oo Jimcihii la wareegay degmada Qansaxdheere ee gobolka Bay ayaa haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo culus ka wada degmadaas oo qiyaastii 90 KM u jirta magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta KMG ah ee Koonfur Galbeed. Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo ku magacaaban mas’uulka warfaafinta kooxda Lafta-gareen ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in tallaabada ay qaadeen ay tahay mid ay dib ugu soo celinayaan dowladnimada sharciga ah ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Ugaas Xasan ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in howlgalkooda ay sii wadi doonaan, isla markaana qorshahooda uu yahay dib usoo celinta wax uu ku tilmaamay gobannimada Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. “In Degmada Qansaxdheere ay dib ugu soo laabato dowladnimada sharciga ah ee Koonfur Galbeed, ee uu Hogaamiyo madaxweyne Lafta-gareen waxay tusaale u tahay inaan dib u soo ceshanayno gobannimadeenna, sharcigeenna iyo awoodeena dowladnimo ee dhulkeenna,” ayuu yiri Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo qoraal kooban soo dhigay bartiisa Facebook-ga. La wareegidda degmada Qansaxdheere ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli maamulka Koonfur Galbeed uu wajahayo xiisado siyaasadeed iyo kuwo amni, kuwaas oo la xiriira loollanka hoggaanka maamulka iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ay wadaan dhinacyada isku haya maamulka. Tallaabadan ayaa cadaadis hor leh ku abuuri karta hoggaanka siyaasadeed ee hadda ka jira Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo xaaladda degmada iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqa ciidamada ay u baahan yihiin in si dhow loola socdo. Si kastaba, Ilaa hadda, ma jiraan faahfaahin madax-bannaan oo laga hayo qaabka uu garabka Lafta-gareen ugu suurtagashay la wareegidda degmada iyo halka ay ku sugan yihiin ciidamadii hore ugu sugnaa. Sidoo kale, ma jiro war rasmi ah oo laga soo saaray khasaaraha ka dhashay la wareegidda. Koonfur Galbeed ayaa horay uga digtay qorshaha ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen, gaar ahaan inay weerarro ka fuliyaan deegaannada kale ee maamulkaasi, iyadoo sheegtay inay ku fashilmeen isku dayo ay ka sameeyeen magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. items.title: DF oo garab istaag u muujisay Sacuudiga, kadib weerarradii Xuutiyiinta Yemen
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si kulul uga hadashay weerarro gantaallo ah oo Jimcihii kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay ku qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee King Khalid ee magaalada Riyadh, kaas oo dhaliyay dhimashada ugu yaraan illaa saddex qof iyo dhawaca dhowr qof oo kale. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa marka hore si adag u cambaareysay weerarradan, waxayna tilmaamtay inay khatar ku yihiin madaxbannaanida Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya iyo amniga gobolka. Sidoo kale, Soomaaliya ayaa xadgudub weyn ku tilmaamtay weerarrada joogtada ah ee ay kooxda Xuutiyiinta ku hayaan gudaha dalka Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo sii xoogeystay maalmihii lasoo dhaafay. “Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay si xooggan u cambaareyneysaa weerarrada ay kooxda Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen Garoonka Diyaaradaha Caalamiga ah ee Abha iyo Garoonka Diyaaradaha Caalamiga ah ee King Khalid ee Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, weerarradaas oo sababay dhimashada dad rayid ah iyo dhaawaca dad kale oo badan. Weerarradani waxay xadgudub weyn ku yihiin sharciga caalamiga ah, waxayna khatar toos ah ku yihiin madaxbannaanida Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya iyo amniga gobolka,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya. Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in garab istaag buuxa ay la garab taagan tahay dowladda iyo shacabka Sacuudi Carabiya. “Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay garab taagan tahay Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, maadaama dowladda Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay dalalka xeebaha ku leh Badda Cas, waxay aaminsan tahay in amniga gobolka Gacanka iyo Badda Cas uu si dhow ula xiriira amnigeeda,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Sidaas darteed, Dowladda Soomaaliyeed waxay ku baaqeysaa in si degdeg ah loo joojiyo weerarrada lagu beegsanayo kaabeyaasha rayidka. Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay tacsi tiiraanyo leh u direysaa qoysaska dadkii ku dhintay weerarrada, Sidoo kale, waxay u rajeynaysaa dhammaan dadkii ku dhaawacmay weerarradaas caafimaad degdeg ah”. Si kastaba, W eerarrada Riyadh ayaa kusoo beegmay xilli ciidamada Sacuudi Carabiya ay kordhiyeen duqeymaha cirka ee ay ka fulinayaan gudaha Yemen, gaar ahaan caasimadda Sanca oo ay maamulaan Xuutiyiintu. Dagaalka ayaa si weyn u xoogaystay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay, kaddib markii Xuutiyiintu ay bishii September horumar militari ka sameeyeen xeebaha Badda Cas, iyagoo la wareegay dhul ku dhow marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab. Horumarkaasi ayaa Sacuudi Carabiya ku kallifay inay dib u xoojiso faragelinteeda militari ee Yemen, iyadoo taageero cirka ah siinaysa ciidamada dowladda ee isku dayaya inay dib ula wareegaan deegaannada ay Xuutiyiintu qabsadeen. Sidoo kale, Soomaaliya ayaa xadgudub weyn ku tilmaamtay weerarrada joogtada ah ee ay kooxda Xuutiyiinta ku hayaan gudaha dalka Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo sii xoogeystay maalmihii lasoo dhaafay. “Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay si xooggan u cambaareyneysaa weerarrada ay kooxda Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen Garoonka Diyaaradaha Caalamiga ah ee Abha iyo Garoonka Diyaaradaha Caalamiga ah ee King Khalid ee Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, weerarradaas oo sababay dhimashada dad rayid ah iyo dhaawaca dad kale oo badan. Weerarradani waxay xadgudub weyn ku yihiin sharciga caalamiga ah, waxayna khatar toos ah ku yihiin madaxbannaanida Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya iyo amniga gobolka,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya. Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in garab istaag buuxa ay la garab taagan tahay dowladda iyo shacabka Sacuudi Carabiya. “Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay garab taagan tahay Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, maadaama dowladda Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay dalalka xeebaha ku leh Badda Cas, waxay aaminsan tahay in amniga gobolka Gacanka iyo Badda Cas uu si dhow ula xiriira amnigeeda,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Sidaas darteed, Dowladda Soomaaliyeed waxay ku baaqeysaa in si degdeg ah loo joojiyo weerarrada lagu beegsanayo kaabeyaasha rayidka. Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay tacsi tiiraanyo leh u direysaa qoysaska dadkii ku dhintay weerarrada, Sidoo kale, waxay u rajeynaysaa dhammaan dadkii ku dhaawacmay weerarradaas caafimaad degdeg ah”. Si kastaba, W eerarrada Riyadh ayaa kusoo beegmay xilli ciidamada Sacuudi Carabiya ay kordhiyeen duqeymaha cirka ee ay ka fulinayaan gudaha Yemen, gaar ahaan caasimadda Sanca oo ay maamulaan Xuutiyiintu. Dagaalka ayaa si weyn u xoogaystay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay, kaddib markii Xuutiyiintu ay bishii September horumar militari ka sameeyeen xeebaha Badda Cas, iyagoo la wareegay dhul ku dhow marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab. Horumarkaasi ayaa Sacuudi Carabiya ku kallifay inay dib u xoojiso faragelinteeda militari ee Yemen, iyadoo taageero cirka ah siinaysa ciidamada dowladda ee isku dayaya inay dib ula wareegaan deegaannada ay Xuutiyiintu qabsadeen. The post DF oo garab istaag u muujisay Sacuudiga, kadib weerarradii Xuutiyiinta Yemen appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Khilaafka u dhexeeya Firdhiye iyo ku-xigeenkiisa oo ka daray
items.description: Laascaanood (Caasimada Online) – Khilaafka u dhexeeya madaxweynaha maamulka Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Axmed Aw Cali (Firdhiye) iyo ku xigeenkiisa Cabdirashiid Yuusuf Jibriil (Abwaan) ayaa sii xoogeystay, kaas oo ka dhashay kala-aragti duwanaansho ku saabsan maamulka iyo sida loo wadaago awoodaha hay’adaha dowladda. Khilaafka ayaa haatan gaaray heerkii ugu sarreeyay, iyadoo labada mas’uul ay u muuqdaan inay kala tageen, marka la eego tallaabooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ee ay qaadeen labada dhinac. Madaxweyne Firdhiye ayaa maanta furay kalfadhiga saddexaad ee Golaha Wakiilada DWBS. iyadoo uu munaasabadda ka baaqday Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka, Cabdirashiid Yuusuf Jibriil, sababo la xiriira khilaafka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya labada mas’uul. Xildhibaan Kilwe Aadan oo laga soo doorto gobolka Sanaag oo ka hadlay arrintan ayaa tilmaamay in madaxweyne ku xigeenku uu ku maqan caro, isaga oo nasiib darro ku tilmaamay khilaafka cusub ee soo kala dhex-galay madaxweynaha iyo ku xigeenkiisa. “Maanta waxaa nasiib darro ah in madaxweyne ku xigeenkii Waqooyi Bari caro darteed uga maqan yahay hoolka baarlamaanka oo ah meeshii aan codka ku siinay arrintaasna waxay muujineysaa inuu jiro khilaaf xooggan oo aan wada-hadal lagu xallin Karin,” ayuu yiri Kilwe. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in khilaafka u dhexeeya labada mas’uul uu salka ku hayo arrimo la xiriira awood-qaybsiga iyo sida loo wajahayo xaaladda gobolka Sanaag, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay sababeen kala-fogaanshaha siyaasadeed ee haatan ka dhex taagan hoggaanka maamulka Waqooyi Bari. “Wixii madaxweyne Firdhiye uu horay u qalday ayuu hadda guranayaa miraheedii, sababtoo wuxuu xooray dastuurka, marka reer Sanaag waxaa soo kartay taladii uu la ambaday madaxweyne ku xigeenku, iyadoo ay u muuqato inuu yahay nin kaligii taliye ah oo isagu sida uu jecel yahay ku maamula saamigii gobolka oo xildhibaannadii ula dhaqmo sida niman u dhigta dugsi qur’aan taas qaladkeeda waxaa iska leh Firdhiye oo uu faraha uga qaaday,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Todobaadkii hore Madaxweynaha Waqooyi Bari ayaa dib ugu laabtay Laascaanood, kadib safar dhowr bilood qaatay oo uu ku joogay magaalada Muqdisho, waxaana halkaasi loogu sameeyay soo dhoweyn ballaaran oo uusan ka qayb-gelin Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka maakulka, taas oo sii xoojisay hadal-heynta khilaafka siyaasadeed ee labada mas’uul. Haddii khilaafkan uu sii xoogeysto wuxuu saameyn ku yeelan karaa wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha ugu sarreeya maamulka Waqooyi Bari, gaar ahaan xiriirka labada mas’uul iyo shaqada baarlamaanka. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee Firdhiye iyo Abwaan ayaa xilka wada haya muddo ku dhow sanad iyo laba bilood, hase yeeshee khilaafka u dhexeeya ayaa la sheegay inuu soo noq-noqday, sababo la xiriira kala-aragti duwanaansho ku saabsan maamulka iyo sida loo wadaago awoodaha hay’adaha dowladda. The post Khilaafka u dhexeeya Firdhiye iyo ku-xigeenkiisa oo ka daray appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo hawlgal ka wada Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sheegaya in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo garabsanaya kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisey ay hawlgal ka wadaan gobolkaasi, ka dib markii laga la wareegay deegaanka Hees. Maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ayaa Jimcihii weerar uu qaraxyo bilowday ku qaaday deegaankaasi oo hoostaga Magaalada Matabaan, taas oo keentay inay ciidamadu dib uga gurtaan. Warbaahinta ayaa fahamsan in Shabaabka soo weeraray Hees ay ka yimaadeen dhinaca deegaanka Teedaan, oo ka mid ah deegaanada ku yaala inta u dhexeyso Magaalooyinka Matabaan iyo Maxaas, waxaana xusid mudan in Shabaabku ay 2-dii bishii August dagaal culus kula wareegeen gacan ku haynta Teedaan oo deegaan istiraatiiji ah, isla-markaana isku xira Matabaan, Maxaas iyo Beledweyne. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan ay haatan ku sugan yihiin afaafka hore ee deegaanka Hees, isla-markaana halkaasi ay dagaalo goos goos ah ku dhex marayaan maleeshiyada Shabaabka. Dadka deegaanka ee aagga ka ag-dhow ayaa laga soo xigtay in Shabaabka ay intooda badan deegaankaasi uga baxeen jihada Teedaan, ciidamadana ay dadaal ugu jiraan, sidii ay dib ugu la wareegi lahaayeen deegaanka. Weerarka ay Shabaabku shalay ku qabsadeen Hees ayaa dad badani ka yaabiyay, marka aad milicsato in ciidamadii halkaasi ku sugnaa loo waday inay xoreeyaan Teedaan. Weerarkan ayaa loo fasirtay mid ay Shabaabku dagaalka uga fogeynayeen Teedaan, oo ah deegaan muhiim u ah isu socodka dadka iyo ganacsiga ee Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Galgaduud. Si kastaba ha-ahaatee, haddii ciidamadu ay si buuxda dib ugu la wareegaan deegaanka Hees ayaa waxay taasi ka yarayn doontaa cadaadis militari ee ka haysta jiidaha hore.

items.title: Trump oo dalbaday dagaal ka dhan ah Soomaalida Minnesota
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa dhaliyay caro iyo cambaareyn xooggan kadib markii uu shacabka gobolka Minnesota ugu baaqay inay iska caabiyaan Soomaalida ku nool gobolkaas, isaga oo ku eedeeyay inay la wareegeen Minnesota, isla markaana ay mas’uul ka yihiin rabshadaha iyo falalka dembiyada ah ee halkaas ka dhaca. Hadalka Trump, oo uu Khamiistii ku baahiyay bartiisa Truth Social, ayaa ururrada xuquuqda aadanaha iyo madaxda gobolka Minnesota ku tilmaameen mid cunsuriyad ah oo dhiirrigelin kara rabshado ka dhan ah bulshada Soomaaliyeed. “Gobolkii weynaa ee Minnesota waxaa la wareegaya soo-galooti Soomaali ah. Waxaa gobolka oo dhan ka jira rabshado, dilal iyo qalalaase. Dadka Minnesota waa inay iska caabiyaan,” ayuu Trump ku yiri qoraalkiisa. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay Soomaalida inay dadka Minnesota u arkaan kuwo daciif ah oo aan waxba garanayn, isaga oo mar kale ku celiyay baaqiisa ah in shacabka gobolkaasi ay iska caabiyaan. “Soomaalida waa inaan loo oggolaan inay ka baxsadaan waxa ay sameynayaan. Waxay idiin arkaan dad daciif ah oo doqonno ah. Iska caabiya Minnesota, iska caabiya!” ayuu yiri. Trump ayaa intaas ku daray in dowladda federaalka ay diyaar u tahay inay soo farageliso haddii loo baahdo, isaga oo guddoomiyaha gobolka Minnesota, Tim Walz, iyo duqa magaalada Minneapolis, Jacob Frey, ugu baaqay inay si degdeg ah u codsadaan kaalmo federaal ah. “Haddii aad u baahataan, dowladda federaalka ayaa idiin soo gurman doonta. Guddoomiyaha Tim Walz iyo duqa Minneapolis Jacob Frey waa inay si degdeg ah u codsadaan caawimaad federaal ah, inta kalena annaga noo daaya,” ayuu yiri. Hadalka madaxweynaha ayaa yimid xilli ay gobolka Minnesota ka dhaceen dhowr dhacdo oo toogasho ah oo boolisku la xiriiriyeen kooxo dhallinyaro Soomaali ah, halka dowladda federaalka ay toddobaadkan dacwad ku soo oogtay wiil 18 jir ah oo asal ahaan Soomaali ah, kuna eedeysan inuu qorsheynayay weerar argagixiso oo ka dhaca xarunta ganacsiga Mall of America. Dhacdooyinkaas ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo amniga gobolka, balse dadka dhaliilaya Trump ayaa ku eedeeyay inuu dembiyada loo haysto shaqsiyaad gaar ah u adeegsanayo eedeymo guud oo ka dhan ah bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Jawaab adag oo ka timid Minnesota Guddoomiyaha gobolka Minnesota, Tim Walz, ayaa si kulul u cambaareeyay hadalka Trump, isaga oo ku tilmaamay qoraallada madaxweynaha kuwo aan caqli-gal ahayn oo looga jeedinayo indhaha dadweynaha dhibaatooyinka kale ee dalka ka jira. “Qoraallada waalida ah ee madaxweynaha ee baraha bulshada kama leexin karaan xaqiiqda ah inuu ku guuldarreysanayo dagaal, isla markaana uu sare u qaadayo qiimaha nolosha,” ayuu Walz ku yiri bayaan. “Wuxuu weerarayaa gobollada ay Dimoqraaddiyiintu maamulaan, sababtoo ah ma awoodo inuu wax ka qabto cadowga dhabta ah ee Mareykanka,” ayuu raaciyay. Walz ayaa sidoo kale farriin taageero ah u diray bulshada Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo u sheegay inay yihiin dad qiimo ku leh Minnesota, xaqna u leh inay halkaas ku noolaadaan. Dhanka kale, ururka xuquuqda Muslimiinta Mareykanka ee Council on American-Islamic Relations (CAIR), gaar ahaan laantiisa Minnesota, ayaa hadalka Trump ku tilmaamay cunsuriyad cad iyo baaq dadban oo dhiirrigelinaya rabshado ka dhan ah bulsho dhan. “Madaxweyne Trump wuxuu bartilmaameed dul dhigay dhabarka Soomaalida Mareykanka. Hadalladiisu ma aha oo keliya hadallo siyaasadeed, balse waa casuumaad khatar ah oo horseedi karta nacayb iyo rabshado,” ayuu yiri agaasimaha CAIR ee Minnesota, Jaylani Hussein. Jaylani ayaa xusay in Minnesota ay hore uga dhaceen weerarro lagu beegsaday masaajidda, isaga oo ka digay in hadallada siyaasadeed ee naceybka xambaarsan ay dhalin karaan falal rabshado ah. “Soomaalida Mareykanka ma aha dad shisheeye ah. Waa dad reer Minnesota ah, waxayna xaq u leeyihiin ammaan, sharaf iyo ilaalinta dastuuriga ah ee uu leeyahay qof kasta oo Mareykan ah,” ayuu raaciyay. Ururka ayaa ugu baaqay madaxda labada xisbi ee Mareykanka inay cambaareeyaan hadalka madaxweynaha, halka hay’adaha ammaanka laga dalbaday inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta masaajidda, ganacsiyada Soomaalida iyo xarumaha bulshada. Xildhibaan Jamal Osman oo ka tirsan golaha deegaanka Minneapolis ayaa isna Trump xusuusiyay in Soomaalida Minnesota ay ka mid yihiin muwaadiniinta uu mas’uulka ka yahay. “Soomaalida Minnesota waa muwaadiniintaada sidoo kale. Mas’uuliyadda kaa saaran ilaalintooda kama duwana tan kaa saaran ilaalinta Mareykan kasta,” ayuu yiri Osman. Weerarrada Trump ee Soomaalida Hadalka cusub ayaa qeyb ka ah weerarro afka ah oo Trump muddooyinkii dambe si joogto ah ugu qaaday Soomaalida Mareykanka, gaar ahaan kuwa ku nool Minnesota, halkaas oo ay deggen yihiin bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee ugu badan dalka. Trump ayaa bishii December ee sanadkii hore Soomaalida ku tilmaamay “qashin”, isaga oo sheegay inuusan dooneyn inay ku sii noolaadaan Mareykanka, hadalkaas oo xilligaas dhaliyay cambaareyn ballaaran. Maamulkiisa ayaa sidoo kale kumannaan askari oo ka tirsan hay’adaha socdaalka u diray Minnesota, isaga oo tallaabadaas ku sababeeyay baaritaanno musuqmaasuq oo lagu sameeyay barnaamijyo dowladda maalgeliso, kuwaas oo qaar ka mid ah dadkii lagu helay dambiyada ay ahaayeen Soomaali. Howlgalladaas ayaa dhaliyay muran sharci iyo mid siyaasadeed, waxaana dacwado maxkamadeed lagu eedeeyay saraakiisha socdaalka inay dadka ku bartilmaameedsadeen midabkooda iyo asalkooda. Sida ay muujinayaan qiyaasaha tirakoobka Mareykanka, in ka badan 107,000 oo qof oo asal ahaan Soomaali ah ayaa ku nool gobolka Minnesota, kuwaas oo in ka badan 83,000 ay deggen yihiin magaalooyinka Minneapolis, St. Paul iyo nawaaxigooda. Inta badan Soomaalida gobolka ayaa ah muwaadiniin Mareykan ah, halka tiro badan oo kalena ay ku dhasheen dalkaas. Hadalka Trump ayaa kusoo aadaya iyadoo Mareykanka uu ku jiro olole siyaasadeed oo kulul oo ka horreeya doorashooyinka bartamaha muddo-xileedka ee November, kuwaas oo go’aamin doona awoodda labada xisbi ku yeelan doonaan Congress-ka. Trump ayaa intaas ku daray in dowladda federaalka ay diyaar u tahay inay soo farageliso haddii loo baahdo, isaga oo guddoomiyaha gobolka Minnesota, Tim Walz, iyo duqa magaalada Minneapolis, Jacob Frey, ugu baaqay inay si degdeg ah u codsadaan kaalmo federaal ah. “Haddii aad u baahataan, dowladda federaalka ayaa idiin soo gurman doonta. Guddoomiyaha Tim Walz iyo duqa Minneapolis Jacob Frey waa inay si degdeg ah u codsadaan caawimaad federaal ah, inta kalena annaga noo daaya,” ayuu yiri. Hadalka madaxweynaha ayaa yimid xilli ay gobolka Minnesota ka dhaceen dhowr dhacdo oo toogasho ah oo boolisku la xiriiriyeen kooxo dhallinyaro Soomaali ah, halka dowladda federaalka ay toddobaadkan dacwad ku soo oogtay wiil 18 jir ah oo asal ahaan Soomaali ah, kuna eedeysan inuu qorsheynayay weerar argagixiso oo ka dhaca xarunta ganacsiga Mall of America. Dhacdooyinkaas ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo amniga gobolka, balse dadka dhaliilaya Trump ayaa ku eedeeyay inuu dembiyada loo haysto shaqsiyaad gaar ah u adeegsanayo eedeymo guud oo ka dhan ah bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Jawaab adag oo ka timid Minnesota Guddoomiyaha gobolka Minnesota, Tim Walz, ayaa si kulul u cambaareeyay hadalka Trump, isaga oo ku tilmaamay qoraallada madaxweynaha kuwo aan caqli-gal ahayn oo looga jeedinayo indhaha dadweynaha dhibaatooyinka kale ee dalka ka jira. “Qoraallada waalida ah ee madaxweynaha ee baraha bulshada kama leexin karaan xaqiiqda ah inuu ku guuldarreysanayo dagaal, isla markaana uu sare u qaadayo qiimaha nolosha,” ayuu Walz ku yiri bayaan. “Wuxuu weerarayaa gobollada ay Dimoqraaddiyiintu maamulaan, sababtoo ah ma awoodo inuu wax ka qabto cadowga dhabta ah ee Mareykanka,” ayuu raaciyay. Walz ayaa sidoo kale farriin taageero ah u diray bulshada Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo u sheegay inay yihiin dad qiimo ku leh Minnesota, xaqna u leh inay halkaas ku noolaadaan. Dhanka kale, ururka xuquuqda Muslimiinta Mareykanka ee Council on American-Islamic Relations (CAIR), gaar ahaan laantiisa Minnesota, ayaa hadalka Trump ku tilmaamay cunsuriyad cad iyo baaq dadban oo dhiirrigelinaya rabshado ka dhan ah bulsho dhan. “Madaxweyne Trump wuxuu bartilmaameed dul dhigay dhabarka Soomaalida Mareykanka. Hadalladiisu ma aha oo keliya hadallo siyaasadeed, balse waa casuumaad khatar ah oo horseedi karta nacayb iyo rabshado,” ayuu yiri agaasimaha CAIR ee Minnesota, Jaylani Hussein. Jaylani ayaa xusay in Minnesota ay hore uga dhaceen weerarro lagu beegsaday masaajidda, isaga oo ka digay in hadallada siyaasadeed ee naceybka xambaarsan ay dhalin karaan falal rabshado ah. “Soomaalida Mareykanka ma aha dad shisheeye ah. Waa dad reer Minnesota ah, waxayna xaq u leeyihiin ammaan, sharaf iyo ilaalinta dastuuriga ah ee uu leeyahay qof kasta oo Mareykan ah,” ayuu raaciyay. Ururka ayaa ugu baaqay madaxda labada xisbi ee Mareykanka inay cambaareeyaan hadalka madaxweynaha, halka hay’adaha ammaanka laga dalbaday inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta masaajidda, ganacsiyada Soomaalida iyo xarumaha bulshada. Xildhibaan Jamal Osman oo ka tirsan golaha deegaanka Minneapolis ayaa isna Trump xusuusiyay in Soomaalida Minnesota ay ka mid yihiin muwaadiniinta uu mas’uulka ka yahay. “Soomaalida Minnesota waa muwaadiniintaada sidoo kale. Mas’uuliyadda kaa saaran ilaalintooda kama duwana tan kaa saaran ilaalinta Mareykan kasta,” ayuu yiri Osman. Weerarrada Trump ee Soomaalida Hadalka cusub ayaa qeyb ka ah weerarro afka ah oo Trump muddooyinkii dambe si joogto ah ugu qaaday Soomaalida Mareykanka, gaar ahaan kuwa ku nool Minnesota, halkaas oo ay deggen yihiin bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee ugu badan dalka. Trump ayaa bishii December ee sanadkii hore Soomaalida ku tilmaamay “qashin”, isaga oo sheegay inuusan dooneyn inay ku sii noolaadaan Mareykanka, hadalkaas oo xilligaas dhaliyay cambaareyn ballaaran. Maamulkiisa ayaa sidoo kale kumannaan askari oo ka tirsan hay’adaha socdaalka u diray Minnesota, isaga oo tallaabadaas ku sababeeyay baaritaanno musuqmaasuq oo lagu sameeyay barnaamijyo dowladda maalgeliso, kuwaas oo qaar ka mid ah dadkii lagu helay dambiyada ay ahaayeen Soomaali. Howlgalladaas ayaa dhaliyay muran sharci iyo mid siyaasadeed, waxaana dacwado maxkamadeed lagu eedeeyay saraakiisha socdaalka inay dadka ku bartilmaameedsadeen midabkooda iyo asalkooda. Sida ay muujinayaan qiyaasaha tirakoobka Mareykanka, in ka badan 107,000 oo qof oo asal ahaan Soomaali ah ayaa ku nool gobolka Minnesota, kuwaas oo in ka badan 83,000 ay deggen yihiin magaalooyinka Minneapolis, St. Paul iyo nawaaxigooda. Inta badan Soomaalida gobolka ayaa ah muwaadiniin Mareykan ah, halka tiro badan oo kalena ay ku dhasheen dalkaas. Hadalka Trump ayaa kusoo aadaya iyadoo Mareykanka uu ku jiro olole siyaasadeed oo kulul oo ka horreeya doorashooyinka bartamaha muddo-xileedka ee November, kuwaas oo go’aamin doona awoodda labada xisbi ku yeelan doonaan Congress-ka. items.title: DFS Iyo Waqooyi Bari oo Adkeeyey Qaadista Hubka Ee Duullimaadyada Laascaanood
items.description: Maamulka Garoonka Aadan Cadde iyo Wasaaradda Amniga Waqooyi Bari ayaa soo saaray awaamiir cusub oo lagu adkaynayo qaadista hubka ee duullimaadyada isaga kala goosha Muqdisho iyo Laascaanood. Wasaaradda Amniga Waqooyi Bari ayaa shirkadaha diyaaradaha ka mamnuucday inay rakaab hubaysan ama ciidamo qaadaan iyagoo aan oggolaansho hore haysan. Qofka haysta hub sharciyeysan waxaa laga doonayaa inuu wasaaradda ku wargeliyo ugu yaraan saddex maalmood ka hor safarkiisa, isla markaana soo bandhigo dukumentiyada hubka. Maamulka Garoonka Aadan Cadde ayaa dhinaciisa maamulka terminal-ka Reflector faray in hub aan lagu dhex qaadan goobta. Waxaa sidoo kale la amray in toban maalmood gudahood lagu dhejiyo ogeysiis cad oo mamnuucaya gelitaanka dadka hubaysan ee aan fasaxa haysan. Amarka ayaa ka digaya in ruqsadda shaqo lagala noqon karo terminal-ka haddii aan la fulin tilmaamaha. Si kastaba, waxaa weli loo baahan yahay in la caddeeyo sida loo waafajinayo fasaxa ay Waqooyi Bari siin karto qof hub sita iyo mamnuucidda hubka ee terminal-ka Muqdisho. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa yimid kaddib dhacdo amni oo la sheegay inay la xiriirtay duullimaadkii Madaxweynaha Waqooyi Bari, Cabdulqaadir Axmed Cali Firdhiye. Hay’adaha rasmiga ahi ma shaacin cidda ku lug lahayd dhacdada, ujeeddadeeda ama sida dad hubaysani ugu dhowaadeen duullimaadka madaxweynaha.

items.title: 𝐀𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐚 𝐊𝐞𝐲𝐟 𝐨𝐨 𝐝𝐚𝐚𝐡-𝐟𝐮𝐫𝐭𝐚𝐲 𝐁𝐚𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐣 𝐮 𝐇𝐚𝐝𝐥𝐚𝐲𝐚 𝐇𝐚𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐝
items.description: Aamina Keyf Axmed, oo ah Agaasimaha Isku-duwaha Arrimaha Haweenka ee Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, ayaa daah-furtay barnaamij cusub oo warbaahineed oo loo bixiyay IFTIIN DUMAR, kaas oo diiradda saaraya nolosha, codka, caqabadaha iyo fursadaha haweenka Soomaaliyeed. Barnaamijkan oo podcast ah ayaa noqonaya madal joogto ah oo lagu dhageysto, laguna soo bandhigo sheekooyinka iyo arrimaha saameeya nolol maalmeedkooda haweenka Soomaaliyeed. Aamina Keyf, oo ah curiyaha barnaamijka, ayaa sheegtay in fikradda IFTIIN DUMAR ay ka dhalatay baahida loo qabo meel si joogto ah looga hadlo arrimaha haweenka, iyadoo aan sheekadu ku koobnaan oo keliya dhibaatooyinka ay la kulmaan. “IFTIIN DUMAR waa madal warbaahineed oo diiradda saaraysa nolosha, codka iyo doorka haweenka Soomaaliyeed,” ayay tiri Aamina Keyf. Barnaamijku wuxuu taaban doonaa mowduucyo ay ka mid yihiin waxbarashada, caafimaadka, shaqada, ganacsiga, amniga, qoyska, iyo ka-qaybgalka hoggaaminta. Aamina waxay sheegtay in ujeeddadu aysan ahayn in haweenka mar walba lagu sawiro dhinaca caqabadaha oo keliya. “Waxaan rabnaa in haweeneyda loo arko qof leh awood, karti, rajo iyo fursad, iyadoo isla markaana la aqoonsanayo caqabadaha ay la kulanto,” ayay tiri. Mid ka mid ah waxyaabaha IFTIIN DUMAR lagu saleeyay ayaa ah isku xirka waayo-aragnimada qofka, xogta iyo xal-raadin. Aamina waxay sheegtay in sheekada haweeneyda ay muujin karto sida arrin bulsho uga muuqato nolosha dhabta ah, halka xogtu ay ka caawin karto bulshada inay fahanto baaxadda iyo saameynta arrintaas. Sidaas darteed, barnaamijku wuxuu doonayaa in marka dhibaato la soo bandhigo aan lagu ekaan tebin oo keliya, balse la raadiyo sababta keentay, cidda ay saameyneyso iyo waxa laga qaban karo. Waxaa sidoo kale la qorsheynayaa in barnaamijku dib ugu laabto arrimaha uu soo bandhigo, si loo ogaado waxa ka dambeeya doodda iyo haddii ay jiraan tallaabooyin ama isbeddello ka dhashay. IFTIIN DUMAR wuxuu sidoo kale doonayaa in haweenka laftoodu ay qayb firfircoon ka noqdaan ajendaha barnaamijka. Aamina waxay sheegtay in haweenku soo jeedin karaan mawduucyo, la wadaagi karaan waayo-aragnimadooda, isla markaana ay qayb ka noqon karaan sheekooyinka barnaamijka. Barnaamijku sidoo kale ma doonayo inuu ku ekaado codadka haweenka oo keliya. Ragga, khubarada, aqoonyahannada, sharci-yaqaannada iyo dadka kale ee door ku leh xalinta arrimaha laga hadlayo ayaa lagu martiqaadi doonaa. Aamina waxay tilmaantay in xogtu ay qayb muhiim ah ka noqon doonto barnaamijka, iyadoo ballanqaadday in marka tirooyin iyo xog la adeegsanayo la caddeyn doono halka ay ka yimaadeen iyo waxa ay dhab ahaan cabbirayaan. Ujeeddadu, ayay sheegtay, ma aha in xogta loo adeegsado qurxinta doodda ama taageeridda aragti hore loo qaatay, balse in bulshada laga caawiyo fahamka xaaladda dhabta ah. Gaar ahaan arrimaha waxbarashada gabdhaha, caafimaadka hooyada, fursadaha dhaqaale iyo ka-qaybgalka bulshada kuwo saameynaya qoysaska iyo bulshada oo dhan. Sidaas darteed, barnaamijku wuxuu doonayaa inuu arrimaha haweenka u soo bandhigo qayb ka mid ah doodda ballaaran ee ku saabsan horumarka Soomaaliya. Aamina Keyf ayaa IFTIIN DUMAR ku soo koobtay hal fikrad: in la dhageysto codka haweenka Soomaaliyeed, la iftiimiyo xaqiiqadooda, lana raadiyo fursadaha iyo xalalka noloshooda wax ka beddeli kara. The post 𝐀𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐚 𝐊𝐞𝐲𝐟 𝐨𝐨 𝐝𝐚𝐚𝐡-𝐟𝐮𝐫𝐭𝐚𝐲 𝐁𝐚𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐣 𝐮 𝐇𝐚𝐝𝐥𝐚𝐲𝐚 𝐇𝐚𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐝 first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Al-Shabaab’s Cross-Border Reach Exposed by Deadly Kenya Roadside Bombing
items.description: GARISSA, Kenya (WDN) — A deadly roadside bomb that killed a Kenyan police commander and one of his bodyguards has renewed concerns over Al-Shabaab’s ability to threaten security forces across the Somalia-Kenya border, underscoring the group’s capacity to sustain attacks beyond Somalia. The explosion struck a vehicle travelling along the road linking Saretho and Dadaab in Kenya’s Garissa County. According to local media reports, the blast occurred when the vehicle ran over an explosive device buried in the road, killing the commander and one member of his security detail. Kenyan security personnel, including units specialising in counterterrorism and explosive-device investigations, were deployed to the scene. Security officials reportedly suspect Al-Shabaab was responsible, while investigations continue to identify those behind the attack and determine whether others assisted them. The bombing highlights the persistent danger facing Kenyan security forces operating in areas near the Somali border, where Al-Shabaab has repeatedly been linked to roadside explosives, ambushes and attacks on security personnel. A Threat That Crosses Borders The latest attack reinforces a central challenge confronting Kenya and Somalia: Al-Shabaab’s operations are not confined by the international border separating the two countries. The militant group, which is based primarily in Somalia, has demonstrated an ability to conduct or inspire attacks inside Kenya while continuing its insurgency against Somali authorities and their international partners. Kenya’s northeastern counties, including Garissa, remain particularly vulnerable because of their proximity to Somalia, the long and difficult-to-police border, and the group’s history of exploiting local networks and security gaps. The use of buried explosives is especially challenging for security forces. Such devices can strike patrols and official vehicles without warning, inflict casualties and force authorities to divert personnel and resources toward route clearance and protective operations. A Wider Regional Security Challenge The bombing also illustrates why military operations against Al-Shabaab in Somalia cannot be separated from security conditions inside Kenya. Even when the group faces pressure in one area, its ability to exploit cross-border networks and conduct attacks elsewhere complicates efforts to contain it. The latest incident does not, by itself, establish that Al-Shabaab carried out coordinated attacks simultaneously in both countries. It does, however, underline the transnational nature of the threat Kenyan authorities are confronting. Kenyan security forces have previously investigated roadside bombings and ambushes along the Saretho-Dadaab corridor, with some earlier incidents attributed to suspected Al-Shabaab members, including Kenyan nationals. The latest explosion is a reminder that local recruitment, intelligence networks and familiarity with border communities can make counterterrorism operations more difficult. For Kenya, the immediate priority is to establish who planted the explosive device, identify any support networks and prevent further attacks on security personnel and civilians. For Somalia and its neighbours, the broader challenge is to strengthen intelligence-sharing, border security and cooperation against militant networks that operate across national boundaries. The killing of a police commander and his bodyguard demonstrates the continuing reach of the Al-Shabaab threat. Preventing further attacks will require more than operations on one side of the border: it will demand sustained cooperation against a group capable of exploiting security vulnerabilities across the region. A Wider Regional Security Challenge The bombing also illustrates why military operations against Al-Shabaab in Somalia cannot be separated from security conditions inside Kenya. Even when the group faces pressure in one area, its ability to exploit cross-border networks and conduct attacks elsewhere complicates efforts to contain it. The latest incident does not, by itself, establish that Al-Shabaab carried out coordinated attacks simultaneously in both countries. It does, however, underline the transnational nature of the threat Kenyan authorities are confronting. Kenyan security forces have previously investigated roadside bombings and ambushes along the Saretho-Dadaab corridor, with some earlier incidents attributed to suspected Al-Shabaab members, including Kenyan nationals. The latest explosion is a reminder that local recruitment, intelligence networks and familiarity with border communities can make counterterrorism operations more difficult. For Kenya, the immediate priority is to establish who planted the explosive device, identify any support networks and prevent further attacks on security personnel and civilians. For Somalia and its neighbours, the broader challenge is to strengthen intelligence-sharing, border security and cooperation against militant networks that operate across national boundaries. The killing of a police commander and his bodyguard demonstrates the continuing reach of the Al-Shabaab threat. Preventing further attacks will require more than operations on one side of the border: it will demand sustained cooperation against a group capable of exploiting security vulnerabilities across the region. items.title: Jubaland Strengthens Its Grip on Gedo
items.description: BELED – HAAWO (WDN) — In a potentially significant shift in Somalia’s federal power struggle, former security chief Cabdirashiid Xasan Cabdinuur, widely known as Janan, has handed over the forces under his command in Beled Xaawo to the Jubaland administration, ending a prolonged standoff without reported fighting. The peaceful transfer marks an important step in Jubaland’s efforts to consolidate control over the strategically sensitive Gedo region, where disputes over local authority and security command have repeatedly brought the regional administration into conflict with Somalia’s federal government under President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. The handover followed several days of negotiations between Janan and Jubaland officials. Local sources said Jubaland security officers, many reportedly associated with its intelligence services, arrived at positions previously occupied by Janan’s forces and assumed responsibility for them. Janan reportedly departed Mandera, Kenya, aboard a Kenyan military aircraft bound for Nairobi after the transfer was completed. Reports also indicated that he was expected to meet Jubaland officials in Nairobi to discuss implementation of the preliminary understanding. The full terms of the agreement, however, have not been publicly disclosed. It remains unclear who guaranteed the deal, what arrangements were made for the transferred personnel, or what political role Janan may play in the future. A Strategic Gain for Jubaland For Jubaland, the transfer could represent a major advance in a prolonged effort to bring Beled Xaawo under its effective authority. Located along Somalia’s border with Kenya, Beled Xaawo occupies a strategically important position in cross-border trade, population movement and regional security. Control of the town carries both practical and political significance in the wider contest over authority in Gedo. Janan’s forces had previously been registered with Somalia’s federal government during his tenure as the National Intelligence and Security Agency’s official in Gedo. Their transfer to Jubaland therefore represents more than a change in command: it potentially alters the local balance of power between the regional administration and federal-aligned forces. Videos circulated on social media appeared to show crowds welcoming the troops, underscoring the public attention surrounding a development that could affect a community long exposed to political and security uncertainty. The absence of reported fighting is particularly significant. If the agreement holds, it could provide a route out of a confrontation that has threatened to deepen instability along the border. Implications for Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s Government The handover also carries broader implications for the relationship between Jubaland and President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration. Jubaland and Mogadishu have been at odds over federal authority, regional autonomy and the political arrangements governing Somalia’s federal system. Disputes over Gedo have become one of the most sensitive fronts in that wider confrontation, with control of local administration and security forces central to the contest. By securing the transfer of Janan’s forces, Jubaland appears to have strengthened its position on the ground. The development could limit the ability of rival political actors to use competing chains of command to challenge the regional administration in Beled Xaawo. However, the handover alone does not establish that the federal government has accepted Jubaland’s position or abandoned its own political and security interests in Gedo. The federal administration’s response, and whether the agreement receives wider political recognition, will be important indicators of its lasting significance. The central question is whether this arrangement will help establish a more coherent security structure—or simply shift the balance in an unresolved political dispute. Negotiations Continue in Nairobi The anticipated meeting in Nairobi is expected to address the implementation of the preliminary agreement and the next steps for security and administration in Gedo. Much remains unknown. No comprehensive official statement has yet clarified the agreement’s provisions, the status of the transferred forces, or the arrangements governing Janan’s future. Those details will determine whether the transfer becomes a durable political settlement or a temporary accommodation between actors whose interests may diverge again. For residents of Beled Xaawo, the immediate priority is the prevention of renewed clashes and the restoration of predictable local administration. For Jubaland, the challenge is to translate its apparent security gain into stable governance. For Mogadishu, the development raises questions about its influence in a region where federal and regional authority have long been contested. A Test of Federal Relations Janan’s decision to hand over his forces peacefully could mark a turning point in Beled Xaawo. But its wider significance will depend on what follows. If Jubaland can integrate the forces, maintain security and avoid retaliation, the agreement could reduce tensions in Gedo. If the terms remain unclear or competing political interests undermine implementation, the underlying dispute may re-emerge. The episode highlights a persistent weakness in Somalia’s federal system: disagreements between Mogadishu and regional administrations can become struggles over who commands armed personnel and exercises authority on the ground. For now, Jubaland has secured a potentially important gain without a reported battle. Whether that translates into lasting stability—and whether it further strains relations with Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration—will depend on the agreement’s implementation and the political choices made in the days ahead. items.title: Duulimaadyada Addis Ababa iyo Mekelle oo Dib u Billaabanaya
items.description: Shirkadda diyaaradaha ee Ethiopian Airlines ayaa lagu wadaa inay maalinta Axadda dib u billowdo duulimaadyada isku xira caasimadda Itoobiya ee Addis Ababa iyo magaalada Mekelle ee xarunta gobolka Tigray. Dib u bilaabista duulimaadyadan ayaa imaanaysa kaddib isbeddello amni oo dhowaan ka dhacay magaalada Mekelle, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin wararka sheegaya in ciidamada Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray (TPLF) iyo xoogagga la safan ay magaalada ka baxeen. Maalintii xigtay, ciidamada difaaca qaranka Itoobiya (ENDF) iyo maleeshiyaad la safan oo loo yaqaan Ciidamada Nabadda Tigray (TPF) ayaa la sheegay inay gudaha u galeen magaalada. Isbeddelladan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli xaaladda amni iyo siyaasadeed ee gobolka Tigray ay weli tahay arrin si dhow loola socdo, kaddib colaaddii muddada dheer ka jirtay gobolkaas. Dhanka kale, duulimaadyada ganacsi ee taga magaalooyinka Shire iyo Axum ayaa weli hakad ku jira. Ethiopian Airlines ayaan weli shaacin xilliga rasmiga ah ee dib loo bilaabi doono duulimaadyada magaalooyinkaas. Dib u bilaabista duulimaadyada Addis Ababa iyo Mekelle ayaa ah tallaabo muhiim u ah isu socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka cirka, inkasta oo xaaladda amni ee gobolka ay weli u baahan tahay in si dhow loola socdo.

items.title: Roobabka Deyrta oo Hargeysa Ka Billowday iyo Digniin Laga Soo Saaray Daadad Xooggan
items.description: Roobabkii ugu horreeyey ee xooggan ee xilliga Deyrta ayaa ka da’ay Hargeysa iyo deegaannada ku dhow, iyadoo saadaalaha cimiladu muujinayaan inay sii kordhi karto halista daadadka iyo biyaha sida degdegga ah ugu rogmanaya magaalada. Xarunta Maareynta Macluumaadka Somaliland—IMC—ayaa saadaalisay in muddada u dhexeysa 7-da iyo 13-ka Oktoobar ay roobab dhexdhexaad ilaa aad u culus ka da’aan qaybo ka mid ah Boorama, Gabiley, Hargeysa, Sheekh iyo Burco. Deegaannada qaarkood waxaa laga yaabaa inay helaan roob isu-geyntiisu gaarto 150 ilaa 250 millimitir. Khatarta roobabka ayaa durba soo muuqatay markii daad qaaday gaari ay saarnaayeen laba qof oo la sheegay inay iska dhego-tireen digniin boolisku ka bixiyey jidka. Labada qof waa la badbaadiyey, balse dhacdadu waxay muujisay halista ka dhalan karta isku dayga in gaari lagu gudbiyo biyo xooggan. Saadaalaha gobolka waxay tilmaamayaan suurtagalnimada roob ka sarreeya heerka caadiga ah inta lagu jiro bilaha Oktoobar ilaa Diseembar. boqolleyda lagu qiyaasay xoogga El Niño iyo magaca “Super El Niño” waa saadaal cimilo, mana aha xaqiijin in dhammaan roobabka ama daadadka la saadaaliyey ay dhacayaan. Hargeysa waxay si gaar ah ugu nugushahay daadadka degdegga ah sababo la xiriira dhulka buuraha leh, togagga dhex mara magaalada iyo biyo-mareennada xaddidan. Maamulka waxaa looga baahan yahay nadiifinta marinnada biyaha, calaamadeynta waddooyinka halista ah iyo gaarsiinta digniinaha hore dadka ku nool hareeraha togagga.

items.title: Elon Musk oo Ganacsade Hindi ah ku eedeeyay inuu caqabad ku yahay Starlink ee Hindiya
items.description: Ganacsadaha Maraykanka ah ee Elon Musk ayaa dhaliil u jeediyay bilyaneerka Hindiya Mukesh Ambani, isaga oo ku eedeeyay inuu adeegsanayo saameyn siyaasadeed si loo carqaladeeyo qorshaha shirkaddiisa Starlink ee ku aaddan inay suuqa Hindiya ka bilowdo adeegga internet-ka dayax-gacmeedka. Musk ayaa su’aal geliyay awoodda iyo saameynta Ambani ku leeyahay go’aannada dalka Hindiya, isaga oo ku tilmaamay inuu yahay qofka awoodda dhabta ah ku leh dalkaas. Starlink, oo hoos timaadda shirkadda SpaceX ee uu Musk leeyahay, ayaa qorsheyneysa inay internet-ka dayax-gacmeedka gaarsiiso macaamiisha Hindiya, gaar ahaan dadka ku nool deegaannada ay adag tahay in la gaarsiiyo adeegyada internet-ka caadiga ah. Dhanka kale, shirkadda Reliance Jio ee uu leeyahay Mukesh Ambani ayaa ka mid ah shirkadaha isgaarsiinta ugu waaweyn Hindiya, iyadoo leh in ka badan 500 oo milyan oo macaamiil ah. Soo gelitaanka Starlink ayaa abuuri kara tartan cusub oo ku saabsan adeegyada internet-ka, taas oo saameyn ku yeelan karta suuqa isgaarsiinta dalkaas. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, eedeymaha Musk ee ku saabsan faragelinta siyaasadeed weli ma laha caddeyn si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyay oo muujinaysa in Ambani uu si toos ah u carqaladeeyay hawlaha Starlink. Khilaafkan ayaa muujinaya loollanka u dhexeeya shirkadaha waaweyn ee isgaarsiinta iyo adeegyada internet-ka dayax-gacmeedka, iyadoo Hindiya ay tahay suuq muhiim ah oo ay shirkado caalami ah doonayaan inay ku ballaariyaan ganacsigooda.

items.title: Itoobiya oo uga digtay Eritrea inay isdifaaci doonto kaddib markii ciidamo ay ka gudbeen xadka
items.description: Itoobiya ayaa Eritrea ku eedaysay inay “duullaan xooggan oo dhan walba ah” ku qaadday gobolka waqooyi ee Tigray, waxayna ka digtay inay isdifaaci doonto, maalmo kaddib markii dadka deegaanka ay BBC-da u sheegeen in ciidamada Eritrea ay ka gudbeen xadka oo ay gudaha u galeen Itoobiya. Warqad loo diray Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay oo ay BBC-du aragtay, wasiirka arrimaha dibadda ee Itoobiya ayaa tallaabada Eritrea ku tilmaamay “fal gardarro cad ah oo siinaya Itoobiya xaqeeda sharciyeed ee isdifaaca.” Wasiirka Warfaafinta Eritrea, Yemane Gebremeskel, ayaa arrintaas kaga jawaabay isagoo sheegay in dalkiisu wajahayo “dagaal gardarro ah oo aan wax sabab ah loo hayn” oo uga imanaya deriskiisa Itoobiya. Dagaallo ayaa laba toddobaad ka hor ka dhex qarxay dowladda Itoobiya iyo xisbiga maamula gobolka Tigray, ee loo yaqaan Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray (TPLF). Labada dhinacba wuxuu midba kan kale ku eedaynayaa inuu jabiyay heshiiskii 2022 ee soo afjaray dagaalkii sokeeye. Itoobiya ayaa sheegaysa in Eritrea ay taageerayso TPLF, balse Eritrea way beenisay eedeyntaas. Intii uu socday dagaalkii sokeeye ee labada sano qaatay, Eritrea waxay ahayd xulafo muhiim ah oo dowladda Itoobiya la safnayd, iyadoo ciidamada Eritrea ay garab dagaallamayeen kuwa Itoobiya si ay ula dagaallamaan TPLF. Hase yeeshee, xidhiidhka labada dal ee deriska ah ayaa tan iyo markaas sii xumaaday, arrintaas oo inta badan la xiriirta damaca Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya ee ah inuu gacanta ku dhigo mid ka mid ah dekedaha Eritrea ee Badda Cas. Xiisaddaas ayaa ugu dambayn sababtay in xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed la jaro toddobaadkii hore. Isagoo Eritrea ku eedeeyay inay ku xadgudubtay madaxbannaanida Itoobiya, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya, Gedion Timothewos, ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Eritrea ay gudaha u soo galeen gobolka Tigray masaafo gaareysa 60km (37 mayl). Waxaa la soo wariyay in duqeymo ay fuliyeen diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Itoobiya ay Arbacadii iyo Khamiistii bartilmaameedsadeen ciidamada Eritrea ee ku sugnaa magaalada Adigrat ee gobolka Tigray, iyadoo ay jirto cabsi laga qabo inuu dagaalku ku fido guud ahaan gobolka. Hay’adda fadhigeedu yahay Maraykanka ee la socota isku dhacyada, ACLED, ayaa sheegtay in “ciidamo iyo saanad militari oo Eritrea leedahay” oo ku sugnaa Adigrat lagu dhuftay “duqeymo badan oo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah” habeenkii. Mid ka mid ah dadka deegaanka ayaa wakaaladda wararka AFP u sheegay in “ay jireen duqeymo aad u fara badan”, isagoo intaas ku daray in qaar ka mid ah gaadiidkii xamuulka ee ay lahaayeen ciidamada Eritrea la burburiyay. Goobjooge kale ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Eritrea ay u muuqdeen kuwa dib ugu guranaya waqooyiga kaddib duqeymahaas, sida ay AFP sheegtay. Ilaa hadda, ma jiraan warar si madaxbannaan loo xaqiijiyay oo ku saabsan khasaaraha nafeed ee ka dhashay weerarradaas. BBC-da ma awooddo inay si toos ah uga warranto gudaha gobolka Tigray. Warqadda Itoobiya ee ku taariikhaysnayd 8-da Oktoobar kuna socotay xubnaha Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa lagu yiri: “Xilligan adag, marka Itoobiya aysan haysan wax kale oo ay samayso oo aan ka ahayn inay isdifaacdo, waxaan ku tiirsannahay fahamkiinna, taageeradiinna iyo garab istaaggiinna.” Hase yeeshee, iyadoo Itoobiya ay ku eedaynayso deriskeeda Eritrea inay taageerto TPLF, Eritrea ayaa dhankeeda ku eedaysay hoggaanka Itoobiya inay mas’uul ka yihiin colaadda sii huraysa, isla markaana ay raadinayaan marmarsiinyo ay ku qabsadaan dhul ka tirsan Eritrea. Maanta, Wasiirka Warfaafinta Eritrea, Yemane Gebremeskel, ayaa ku tilmaamay eedeymaha loo jeediyay Asmara inay yihiin “laba-wejiilennimo heerkeedii ugu sarreeyay.” Qoraal uu ku daabacay barta X, wuxuu ku sheegay in Itoobiya ay “si cad uga shaqaynayso sidii ay isbeddel maamul uga hirgelin lahayd Eritrea, iyadoo hoy iyo taageero siinaysa kooxo calooshood-u-shaqaystayaal ah oo isu sheegaya mucaarad.” Eritrea waxay ka go’day Itoobiya sannadkii 1993, hase yeeshee xiriirka labada dal ayaa caadi kusoo noqday sannadkii 2018 markii Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Ahmed, uu xukunka la wareegay. Xiisaddan ugu dambeysay ayaa daba socota bilo ay jireen khilaafyo iyo sidoo kale dhismaha isbahaysi cusub oo kooxo hubeysan oo Itoobiyaan ah, oo ay ku jirto TPLF, ay sameysteen bishii Sebtembar. Toddobaadkii hore, ciidamada TPLF ayaa ka baxay magaalada Mekelle oo ah magaalada ugu weyn gobolka Tigray. Magaaladaasi waxay qiyaastii 115km (71 mayl) koonfur kaga beegan tahay Adigrat, waxaana hadda gacanta ku haya ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya.
