items.title: Soomaaliya oo Isu Diyaarinaysa Hirgelinta Nidaamka Lacag-bixinta Duulimaadyada IATA BSP
items.description: Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed SCAA ayaa sheegtay in Soomaaliya isu diyaarinayso hirgelinta guud ee nidaamka IATA Billing and Settlement Plan, kaddib markii lagu guuleystay wejigii tijaabada ahaa. BSP waa nidaam mideeya iibka tikidhada iyo xisaab-celinta lacageed ee u dhexeysa shirkadaha diyaaradaha iyo wakaaladaha safarka ee IATA aqoonsan tahay. Nidaamku wuxuu yareeyaa kala wareejinta lacago badan oo gooni-gooni ah, isagoo xogta iibka iyo lacagaha ku ururinaya hannaan dhexe. Wejiga tijaabada oo billowday bishii Abriil waxaa ka qaybgalay afar wakaaladood iyo shirkado diyaaradeed oo ay ku jirto Ethiopian Airlines, waxaana marka hirgelinta la ballaariyo, in ka badan 300 oo wakaaladood oo Soomaaliya la filayaa  inay ku biiraan nidaamka. SCAA waxay qorshahan ku tilmaantay tallaabo Soomaaliya loogu xirayo nidaamka caalamiga ah ee iibka tikidhada. Waxa kale oo laga filayaa inuu fududeeyo dabagalka lacagaha, xisaab-celinta iyo xiriirka ganacsi ee ka dhexeeya diyaaradaha iyo wakiillada socdaalka. Weli lama shaacin taariikhda rasmiga ah ee hirgelinta dalka oo dhan, khidmadaha lagu soo rogayo wakaaladaha ama shuruudaha farsamo ee ay buuxinayaan. Waxa kale oo muhiim ah in la caddeeyo sida loo xallinayo cabashooyinka macaamiisha iyo ilaalinta lacagaha tikidhada haddii wakaalad ama shirkad diyaaradeed ay shaqada joojiso.

items.title: Maxaa Ka Jira In La Hakiyey Mashruuca Biyo-mareennada Muqdisho?
items.description: Warar soo baxay ayaa sheegaya in la hakiyey saxiixa heshiis la xiriira mashruuc biyo-mareenno oo Muqdisho laga fulin lahaa, kaas oo qiimihiisa lagu sheegay $51 milyan. Mashruuca ayaa la filayey inuu wax ka qabto daadadka, biyo-fadhiisiga iyo burburka waddooyinka Muqdisho xilliyada roobabka. Baahida loo qabo biyo-mareenno ayaa sii kordhaysa, maadaama dhismaha magaalada iyo ciriiriga waddooyinku ay xannibeen marinnadii dabiiciga ahaa ee biyaha. Wararka ayaa intaas kudaray inuu jiro muran ku saabsan in qayb ka mid ah maalgelinta loo weeciyo waddooyin laga hirgelinayo Somaliland iyo Puntland, waxay sidoo kale su’aalo ka keentay hufnaanta maamulka mashaariicda iyo cidda go’aamisa sida loo kala hormarinayo dhaqaalaha kaabayaasha. Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir iyo Bangiga Adduunka midkoodna ma xaqiijin in heshiiska la hakiyey ama in qayb ka mid ah dhaqaalihii mashruuca meel kale loo wareejiyey. Hakinta mashruuc noocan ahi waxay kordhin kartaa khatarta daadadka xilligan roobabka Deyrtu ku soo wajahan yihiin caasimadda. Kobaca degdegga ah ee dhismayaasha Muqdisho, oo aan la socon qorshe mideysan oo lagu maareeyo bulaacadaha iyo biyo-mareennada, wuxuu sii xannibayaa marinnada hadda ah ee biyaha, taasoo sababi karta biyo-fadhiisi, burburka waddooyinka, barakac iyo hakad ku yimaada isu-socodka iyo ganacsiga magaalada.

items.title: AFRICOM oo Ka Digay In Xuutiyiintu Hawlgalladooda Ku Fidin karaan Soomaaliya
items.description: Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika—AFRICOM—ayaa ka digay in Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay isku dayayaan inay hawlgalladooda ku fidiyaan Soomaaliya, taas oo abuuri karta jiho cusub oo laga fuliyo weerarro ka dhan ah maraakiibta mara Gacanka Cadmeed iyo ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Sarkaal ka tirsan AFRICOM ayaa sheegay in dagaalyahanno ama wakiillo Xuutiyiin ah ay suuragal tahay inay mar horeba joogaan waqooyiga Soomaaliya, iyagoo xiriir la leh Al-Shabaab. Sarkaalka, oo magaciisa loo qariyey sababo la xiriira habraaca wareysiga, wuxuu sheegay in baaxadda joogitaanka Xuutiyiinta aan weli si buuxda loo ogaan, waxaana Stars and Stripes AFRICOM ay si gaar ah uga walaacsan tahay in Xuutiyiintu Al-Shabaab u gudbiyaan hub casri ah, tababar iyo aqoon farsamo oo la xiriirta diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Taageerada noocaas ahi waxay sare u qaadi kartaa awoodda Al-Shabaab ay ugu hanjabeyso ciidamada Mareykanka, xarumaha dowladda Soomaaliya iyo bartilmaameedyada kale ee Bariga Afrika. Xuutiyiinta ayaa dhinacooda ka faa’iidaysan kara deegaannada ay Al-Shabaab ka taliso ama ka hawlgasho, si ay ugu ballaariyaan joogitaankooda meel ka baxsan Yemen. Haddii iskaashigaasi xoogeysto, labada dhinac ee Gacanka Cadmeed ayaa laga abaabuli karaa weerarro lagu beegsado maraakiibta, taas oo sii adkeyn karta ilaalinta mid ka mid ah marinnada ganacsi ee ugu muhiimsan dunida. Digniintan ayaa imanaysa xilli AFRICOM ay weerarro ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab ka fulinaysay waqooyiga Soomaaliya. Bishii Sebteembar, talisku wuxuu sheegay inuu duqeeyey bakhaar lagu kaydinayey hubka Al-Shabaab oo ku yaalla gobolka Sanaag, qiyaastii 80 kiiloomitir koonfur-galbeed kaga beegan Boosaaso. Suuragalnimada xiriir hawlgal oo dhex mara Xuutiyiinta iyo Al-Shabaab waxay Soomaaliya ku soo kordhin kartaa hub casri ah, weerarro badeed iyo loollan ay ku lug yeeshaan quwadaha gobolka. Waxay sidoo kale khatar gelin kartaa dekedaha waqooyiga, xeebaha Puntland iyo Somaliland, saldhigga Mareykanka ee Jabuuti iyo guud ahaan isu-socodka maraakiibta Gacanka Cadmeed.

items.title: UK PM Burnham’s Labour fends off left-wing Greens in London
items.description: LONDON, (Reuters) – Andy Burnham’s Labour Party won an election for a parliamentary seat vacated by former leader Keir Starmer on Friday, fending off a ​strong challenge from the left-wing Green Party in a boost for the British prime minister. Labour candidate Sagal Abdi-Wali, the leader of the ‌local council, won the seat in the central London constituency of Holborn and St Pancras with 12,292 votes, compared with 8,928 for Zack Polanski, the Green Party leader. The victory, which had been expected, will buoy Burnham, installed as prime minister by lawmakers fearful Starmer’s unpopularity was opening the way for a challenge by the populist Reform UK party at the next national election. After losing ​left-wing support to the Greens earlier this year, Labour looks to have won many voters back, a result which triggered more questions about the leadership ​of Polanski, who had promised to make his party “an eco-populist” movement. POLANSKI VOWS TO STAY ON AS GREEN PARTY LEADER The 43-year-old former ⁠actor and hypnotherapist, who had some success in drawing voters away from Labour before Burnham came to power, has come under fire after party members passed a motion ​declaring that Zionism is racism at their annual conference. The move, which called for “the establishment of a single democratic Palestinian State in all of historic Palestine” was criticised by Jewish groups, ​other parties and most Green Party lawmakers. Polanski did not vote on the motion. After conceding defeat in the fiercely contested by-election, Polanski answered his critics, saying he would stay on as leader, and described the result as part of “Andy Burnham’s honeymoon”. Yet he did not get a full endorsement from the party’s former leader, Caroline Lucas, who struggled to contain her anger over what she said was his ​lack of leadership over the motion on Zionism at last week’s conference. Asked whether he should stay on as leader, she told the BBC: “I think just let’s see ​what happens in the coming days and weeks.” “I want him to speak now about what has happened, I want him to show the leadership that was frankly missing on Sunday.” Labour’s ‌Abdi-Wali, who arrived ⁠in Britain as a child refugee from Somalia, said her victory was a defeat for “those who seek to divide us”. “We have a responsibility to defend what we’ve built and pass it on,” she said. POLANSKI FACES DOWN CRITICS It was an early test for Burnham, whose predecessor, Starmer, stood down as a lawmaker in September after being ousted as prime minister in July. Under Starmer, Labour had also ceded ground to the Green Party, which made record gains in London in May’s local elections with its widening appeal among younger, ​left-leaning voters in the capital and other ​urban areas. The Greens have fallen back ⁠in opinion polls since, after Burnham made policy pitches that boosted Labour’s standing among voters to the left, including a tougher line on Israel and a more ambitious approach to relations with the European Union. Bridget Phillipson, Labour’s chair, said the election result showed the ​party’s “message of hope is really cutting through”, describing the Greens’ conference motion as something that held “British Jews to a standard ​that we do not ⁠apply to others”. “We tackled antisemitism in our own ranks but all political parties have to be ever vigilant,” she told Times radio, describing a period when Labour had to deal with antisemitism in the party under former leader Jeremy Corbyn. Polanski, who is Jewish, was questioned repeatedly after the by-election over the conference vote on Zionism. The Green leader responded by ⁠saying that he ​believed displacement of Palestinian people and “ongoing genocide” in Gaza were racist. Israel rejects claims of genocide and ethnic cleansing. Labour candidate Sagal Abdi-Wali, the leader of the ‌local council, won the seat in the central London constituency of Holborn and St Pancras with 12,292 votes, compared with 8,928 for Zack Polanski, the Green Party leader. The victory, which had been expected, will buoy Burnham, installed as prime minister by lawmakers fearful Starmer’s unpopularity was opening the way for a challenge by the populist Reform UK party at the next national election. After losing ​left-wing support to the Greens earlier this year, Labour looks to have won many voters back, a result which triggered more questions about the leadership ​of Polanski, who had promised to make his party “an eco-populist” movement. The move, which called for “the establishment of a single democratic Palestinian State in all of historic Palestine” was criticised by Jewish groups, ​other parties and most Green Party lawmakers. Polanski did not vote on the motion. After conceding defeat in the fiercely contested by-election, Polanski answered his critics, saying he would stay on as leader, and described the result as part of “Andy Burnham’s honeymoon”. Yet he did not get a full endorsement from the party’s former leader, Caroline Lucas, who struggled to contain her anger over what she said was his ​lack of leadership over the motion on Zionism at last week’s conference. Asked whether he should stay on as leader, she told the BBC: “I think just let’s see ​what happens in the coming days and weeks.” “I want him to speak now about what has happened, I want him to show the leadership that was frankly missing on Sunday.” Labour’s ‌Abdi-Wali, who arrived ⁠in Britain as a child refugee from Somalia, said her victory was a defeat for “those who seek to divide us”. “We have a responsibility to defend what we’ve built and pass it on,” she said. Under Starmer, Labour had also ceded ground to the Green Party, which made record gains in London in May’s local elections with its widening appeal among younger, ​left-leaning voters in the capital and other ​urban areas. The Greens have fallen back ⁠in opinion polls since, after Burnham made policy pitches that boosted Labour’s standing among voters to the left, including a tougher line on Israel and a more ambitious approach to relations with the European Union. Bridget Phillipson, Labour’s chair, said the election result showed the ​party’s “message of hope is really cutting through”, describing the Greens’ conference motion as something that held “British Jews to a standard ​that we do not ⁠apply to others”. “We tackled antisemitism in our own ranks but all political parties have to be ever vigilant,” she told Times radio, describing a period when Labour had to deal with antisemitism in the party under former leader Jeremy Corbyn. Polanski, who is Jewish, was questioned repeatedly after the by-election over the conference vote on Zionism. The Green leader responded by ⁠saying that he ​believed displacement of Palestinian people and “ongoing genocide” in Gaza were racist. Israel rejects claims of genocide and ethnic cleansing. For now, ​he said, the Green Party should focus on whether Labour’s first budget under Burnham on October 28 delivers. “So many people told me on the doorstep that they want to give Andy Burnham a chance,” Polanski told broadcasters. “Well, he’s ​got a chance now. items.title: Mareykanka oo shaaciyey in Xuutiyiinta ay soo gaareen Waqooyiga Somalia + Qorshaha
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliska ciidamada Mareykanka ee Afrika (AFRICOM) ayaa ka digay in kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay doonayso inay hawlgalladeeda ku ballaariso Soomaaliya, tallaabadaas oo abuuri karta khatar cusub oo ku wajahan maraakiibta isaga kala goosha Gacanka Cadmeed iyo ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Sida uu maanta oo Jimce ah qoray wargeyska militariga Mareykanka ee Stars and Stripes , taliska AFRICOM ayaa sheegay in dagaalyahanno ama wakiillo ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta ay suuragal tahay inay durba ku sugan yihiin waqooyiga Soomaaliya, halkaas oo ay xiriir la leeyihiin xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Taliska ayaa ka cabsi qaba in Al-Shabaab ay Xuutiyiinta siiso gabaad iyo dhul ay ka hawlgalaan, taas oo u sahli karta kooxda Yemen inay ballaariso awooddeeda militari ee ka baxsan dalkeeda. Arrintan ayaa walaac gaar ah ku abuurtay Mareykanka, maadaama ay suuragal ka dhigi karto in maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraya Gacanka Cadmeed laga soo weeraro labada dhinac ee gacanka, halkii ay khatartu markii hore inta badan kaga imaan jirtay xeebaha Yemen. Gacanka Cadmeed ayaa ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka, wuxuuna isku xiraa Badweynta Hindiya iyo Badda Cas, iyada oo maraakiib badan ay halkaas u maraan dhinaca Kanaalka Suweys. Sarkaal ka tirsan AFRICOM oo si qarsoodi ah ula hadlay Stars and Stripes ayaa sheegay in iskaashiga labada kooxood uu kordhinayo khatarta ku wajahan ciidamada Mareykanka. “Xiriirkani wuxuu sare u qaadayaa awoodda Al-Shabaab ee ay ku halis gelin karto ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka iyo danaha Mareykanka ee Bariga Afrika,” ayuu yiri sarkaalka. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Xuutiyiintu ay Al-Shabaab siin karaan hub casri ah, tababaro militari iyo aqoon farsamo oo la xiriirta diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, kuwaas oo loo adeegsan karo weerarro ka dhan ah ciidamada Mareykanka. Walaacaas ayaa si gaar ah u taabanaya saldhigga Camp Lemonnier ee dalka Jabuuti, oo ah xarunta ugu weyn ee Mareykanku ka maamulo hawlgalladiisa militari ee Bariga Afrika. Xiriirka Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta Digniinta cusub ee AFRICOM ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli ay sii kordhayaan xogaha muujinaya iskaashi militari oo u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo Al-Shabaab, inkastoo labada kooxood ay ku kala duwan yihiin caqiidada iyo ujeeddooyinka siyaasadeed. Warbixin ay khubaro Qaramada Midoobay soo saareen sanadkii 2025 ayaa lagu sheegay in xiriirka labada dhinac uu ka gudbay ganacsiga hubka, isla markaana uu gaaray tababaro militari iyo isdhaafsi aqoon farsamo. Khubaradu waxay heleen xog ku saabsan laba injineer oo militari oo ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay tageen magaalada Jilib ee gobolka Jubbada Dhexe, halkaas oo ay xubno Al-Shabaab ah ku bareen samaynta walxaha qarxa, farsamada diyaaradaha drone-ka iyo dayactirka hubka. Sidoo kale, warbixin ay hay’adda Century International soo saartay bishii Agoosto ee sanadkan ayaa lagu sheegay in inta u dhexeysa 120 iyo dhowr boqol oo dagaalyahan oo Al-Shabaab ah ay tababaro militari ku qaateen Yemen. Hase yeeshee, warbixintaasi waxay xustay in aan weli la xaqiijin in Xuutiyiintu ay Al-Shabaab ku wareejiyeen hubkooda ugu casrisan, oo ay ku jiraan diyaaradaha weerarrada fog fulin kara iyo nidaamyada difaaca cirka. Diyaarado laga saaray Soomaaliya Digniinta AFRICOM ayaa sidoo kale kusoo aadeysa xilli Wasaaradda Difaaca Mareykanka ay qaar ka mid ah diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee MQ-9 Reaper ka wareejineyso Soomaaliya, si loogu adeegsado hawlgallo cusub oo ka socda Koonfurta Ameerika. Wargeyska The New York Times ayaa toddobaadkan sheegay in Mareykanku uu tiro aan la shaacin oo diyaaradahaas ah u wareejiyay Colombia iyo Ecuador, si loogu adeegsado hawlgallada ka dhanka ah kooxaha ka ganacsada daroogada. Diyaaradaha MQ-9 Reaper ayaa door muhiim ah ka ciyaara hawlgallada Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya, iyaga oo loo adeegsado sirdoonka, la socodka dhaqdhaqaaqyada kooxaha hubeysan iyo duqeymaha cirka. Wareejintooda ayaa dhalisay walaac ku saabsan awoodda AFRICOM ee la socodka Al-Shabaab, xilli talisku uu sidoo kale wajahayo khatarta cusub ee suuragalka ah ee Xuutiyiinta. Arrintaas waxaa sii adkeeyay khasaaraha diyaaradeed ee Mareykanka kasoo gaaray dagaalka Iran ee billowday dabayaaqadii bishii Febraayo. Warbixin ay diyaarisay hay’adda cilmi-baarista Congress-ka Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 45 diyaaradood oo MQ-9 Reaper ah lagu waayay hawlgallada dagaalkaas. AFRICOM ayaa Jimcihii sheegtay in sababo la xiriira amniga hawlgallada aysan shaacin goobaha ay diyaaradaha militari ku sugan yihiin iyo qorshayaasha mustaqbalka ee la xiriira meelayntooda. Dhanka kale, taliyihii hore ee AFRICOM, Jeneraal Michael Langley, ayaa sanadkii hore Congress-ka Mareykanka u sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay awood u leeyihiin inay weeraraan saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Jabuuti, haddii ay go’aansadaan inay sii ballaariyaan dagaalka ay kula jiraan Washington. Inkastoo AFRICOM ay hadda muujisay walaac ku saabsan isku xirnaanta labada kooxood, haddana weli ma cadda baaxadda joogitaanka Xuutiyiinta ee Soomaaliya iyo heerka ay gaarsiisan tahay awoodda ay halkaas ka dhisan karaan. items.title: Why Museveni’s Full Name Is Suddenly Making Political Headlines in Uganda
items.description: KAMPALA (WDN) — Uganda President Yoweri Tibuhaburwa Kaguta Museveni has turned an old personal name into a fresh subject of political curiosity after Tibuhaburwa featured prominently in his official name during his latest presidential swearing-in. But despite the renewed attention, the name is not a recent invention—and Museveni did not add it to his name in 2026. The legal change dates back to October 2020, when Museveni executed a legal deed poll , formally establishing Yoweri Tibuhaburwa Kaguta Museveni as the name he would use on official documents. The name has since appeared in Uganda’s official records and was used during his swearing-in for another five-year term in 2026. A Name with a History According to reporting by Uganda’s Daily Monitor at the time, Museveni said he was born in September 1944 and was given the name Yoweri Tibuhaburwa Kaguta. For years, however, his name appeared in different forms across official and personal documents, including Yoweri Museveni, Yoweri Kaguta Museveni and Yoweri Tibuhaburwa Museveni. The 2020 deed poll was intended to settle the discrepancy. Museveni formally declared that Yoweri Tibuhaburwa Kaguta Museveni would be his official name for future documentation. Tibuhaburwa comes from Runyankore, one of the languages spoken in western Uganda. Why the Name Became Political The renewed fascination with the name is partly linguistic and partly political. Tibuhaburwa has been interpreted as referring to someone who is not easily persuaded, advised or corrected. That interpretation has inevitably attracted political commentary in a country where Museveni has remained in power since 1986. Some Ugandans regard the word simply as a traditional childhood name with no particular political significance. Others have treated its meaning humorously, suggesting that it is remarkably appropriate for a president who has governed Uganda for four decades and has repeatedly resisted calls to leave office. The political interpretation, however, should not be confused with the legal history of the name. There is no established evidence that Museveni adopted “Tibuhaburwa” for a new political purpose. The documented record shows that it was a name associated with him from childhood and was formally incorporated into his legal name in 2020. Why 2020 Matters The timing of the legal change is significant. Museveni completed the deed poll in October 2020, only months before Uganda’s 2021 presidential election. At the time, Ugandan electoral and administrative requirements placed considerable importance on ensuring that candidates’ names matched across identity, educational and other official records. Daily Monitor reported that hundreds of politicians were undertaking similar legal name adjustments to reconcile discrepancies in their documentation. Uganda’s National Identification and Registration Authority, or NIRA, also requires a legally registered deed poll and supporting documentation when an individual seeks to add, remove or alter a name. The change was therefore not, in itself, an extraordinary political act. It was a formal legal procedure. The name became especially visible again in 2026. When Museveni was sworn in on May 12, 2026, for what was described as his seventh presidential term, the official name used during the ceremony was Yoweri Tibuhaburwa Kaguta Museveni. Reuters also recorded Museveni beginning his presidential oath using the name. Uganda’s Supreme Court likewise used a version of the full name in its ruling concerning the 2026 presidential election, referring to him as Yoweri Kaguta Museveni Tibuhaburwa and recognizing him as the lawfully elected president. The variations in ordering do not alter the central point: Tibuhaburwa is now firmly incorporated into the president’s official legal identity. Four Decades in Power The fascination with the name cannot be separated entirely from Museveni’s political longevity. He has ruled Uganda since 1986, making him one of Africa’s longest-serving heads of state. His seventh consecutive presidential term has inevitably intensified public discussion about his leadership style, political longevity and resistance to calls for political transition. Against that background, the meaning attributed to Tibuhaburwa has taken on an almost symbolic quality. For some Ugandans, it is simply an old Runyankore name. For others, its popular interpretation—someone who does not readily accept advice or correction—has become an irresistible source of political jokes and commentary. Social media users have also questioned why such a seemingly technical matter has generated so much public attention, particularly when Museveni has an extensive political, legal and administrative apparatus around him. Yet the legal explanation is considerably less dramatic. Tibuhaburwa was not suddenly added to Museveni’s name in 2026. It was legally formalized six years earlier, in 2020, as part of an effort to establish consistency across his official documents. What changed in 2026 was not the name itself, but its visibility. As Museveni entered another five-year presidential term, Yoweri Tibuhaburwa Kaguta Museveni became the name appearing on the presidential oath, government documents and other official records. The name may have become a political talking point, but its legal journey is much simpler: an old personal name was formally regularized in 2020 and is now fully embedded in the identity of Uganda’s long-serving president. items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Cambaareysay Weerarrada Lagu Qaaday Garoomada Diyaaradaha Sacuudiga
items.description: Muqdisho, 9 Oktoobar 2026 — Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si xooggan u cambaareysay weerarro ay sheegtay in kooxda Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen garoomada diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Abha iyo King Khalid ee Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, kuwaas oo sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac soo gaaray dad rayid ah. War-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayay ku sheegtay in weerarradu ay xadgudub ku yihiin sharciga caalamiga ah, isla markaana ay khatar ku yihiin madaxbannaanida Sacuudi Carabiya iyo amniga guud ee gobolka. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa caddeysay inay garab taagan tahay Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, iyadoo xustay in amniga gobolka Gacanka iyo Badda Cas uu xiriir dhow la leeyahay amniga Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, dowladda ayaa ku baaqday in si degdeg ah loo joojiyo weerarrada lagu beegsanayo kaabeyaasha rayidka, si looga hortago khasaaraha nafeed iyo khataraha amni ee ka dhalan kara weerarrada noocan ah. Ugu dambeyn, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa tacsi u dirtay qoysaska dadkii ku dhintay weerarrada, iyadoo sidoo kale caafimaad degdeg ah u rajeysay dadkii ku dhaawacmay.

items.title: Operation Economic Outcast Sanctions on Iran’s Shadow Fleet Network
items.description: Operation Economic Outcast Sanctions on Iran’s Shadow Fleet Network Press Statement Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, Spokesman Office of the Spokesman Under Operation Economic Outcast, the United States is using every diplomatic and economic tool available to isolate the Iranian regime, sever its economic lifelines, and protect the United States, our partners, and freedom of navigation. Today, the Department of State is taking action to dismantle Iran’s shadow fleet and the Iranian regime’s ability to use the illicit oil trade to fund its malign activities. The Department of State is sanctioning ten entities, six individuals, and five vessels involved in the trade of Iranian-origin petroleum or petrochemical products. Additionally, the Department of the Treasury is sanctioning 17 entities and their shadow fleet vessels. These measures will deprive the Iranian regime of funds and prevent it from using the shadow fleet to transport Iranian petroleum and petrochemicals and evade U.S. sanctions. All Department of State targets are being sanctioned pursuant to Executive Order (E.O.) 13846 , which authorizes and reimposes certain sanctions with respect to Iran. Treasury’s action was taken pursuant to Executive Order (E.O.) 13902, which targets the Iranian petroleum sector, among other key sectors of the Iranian economy. For more information on today’s action, please see the Department of the Treasury’s press release and State’s Fact Sheet .

items.title: Hub kala shaki abuuray oo Xasan Sheekh ka dajiyay Laascaanood
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka ayaa u dirtay magaalada Laascaanood shixnad hub ah oo laga qariyey Hoggaamiye Firdhiye, laguna socodsiiyey xubno kamid ah guddoonka golaha Wakiilada, taas oo ugu dambeyntii gashay gacanta Firdhiye, abuurtayna kala shaki cusub oo ku saabsan ajendaha laga lahaa, tuhuna durba keentay. Warar ay heshay Gaylan Media ayaa xaqiijinaya in garoonka hubkan looga saaray ogolaanshaha qaar kamid ah madaxda ugu sareysa Hay’addaha amniga, loogana dajiyey Laascaanood, iyadoo loo waday mid kamid ah masuuliyiinta maamulka ay DFS dhistay. Firdhiye ayaa ka carooday talaabada hubkan uusan ogoleyn loo siiyey qaar kamid ah xubnaha guddoonka golaha, taas oo keentay in Hubkan uu qaato lagana geeyey goob si gaar ah u ilaaliyo. Dhinaca Firdhiye ayaa ka tirsanayay DFS dhacdo habmaamuus xumo iyo shaki amni darro ka dhashay Axadii ka qabsatay garoonka Muqdisho, markii diyaarada ay la raaceen xubno kasoo jeeda deegaanka Adhicadeeye oo kooxda habmaamuuska ka shakiday. Xubnaha diyaarada fasaxay ee hubka gashay garoonka ayaa sheegay in ay heleen warqad katimi qaar kamid ah madaxda maamulkan ay dhistay DFS, taas oo doodeedu hadda taagan tahay.

items.title: Itoobiya oo warqad ay QM u dirtay ku shaacisay go’aan xasaasi ah kuna dhowaaqday…
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa maanta oo Jimce ah sheegtay in ciidamada Eritrea ay duullaan ballaaran ku soo qaadeen waqooyiga dalkeeda, isla markaana aysan haysan wax ikhtiyaar ah oo aan ka ahayn inay is-difaacdo, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha militari ee u dhexeeya labada dal. Eedeyntan ayaa ku jirtay warqad uu Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya, Gedion Timothewos, u diray Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, taas oo nuqul ka mid ah ay heshay wakaaladda wararka Reuters. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Eritrea, oo wata gaadiid dagaal, ay gudaha u galeen dhulka Itoobiya masaafo gaaraysa 60 kiiloomitir, taas oo uu ku tilmaamay xadgudub culus oo ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida dalkiisa. “Duullaanka ballaaran ee Eritrea ku soo qaadday qaybo ka mid ah waqooyiga Itoobiya waa arrin si cad loo og yahay. Waa fal gardarro ah oo Itoobiya siinaya xaqa ay isku difaaci karto,” ayaa lagu yiri warqadda. Warqaddan, oo ku taariikheysneyd Khamiistii, ayaa loo diray Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Faransiiska, Jean-Noel Barrot, oo dalkiisu xubin ka yahay Golaha Ammaanka. Sarkaal sare oo Itoobiyaan ah ayaa Reuters u sheegay in sidoo kale loo gudbiyay xubnaha kale ee golaha. Waa markii ugu horreysay ee dowladda Itoobiya ay si rasmi ah uga hadasho eedeymaha ku saabsan ciidamada Eritrea ee gudaha u galay dalkeeda toddobaadkan, kuwaas oo sare u qaaday cabsida laga qabo inuu qarxo dagaal toos ah oo dhexmara labada dal. Hadalka Itoobiya ayaa yimid maalmo yar kadib markii labada dal ay jareen xiriirkoodii diblomaasiyadeed, iyadoo dagaallada ka socda gobolka Tigray ay sii murjiyeen xaaladda amni ee xadka. Eritrea oo diiday eedeynta Dhanka kale, dowladda Eritrea ayaa Itoobiya ku eedeysay inay muddo sannado ah wadday qorshe dagaal oo ka dhan ah dalkeeda, iyadoo sheegtay in Addis Ababa ay doonayso inay xoog ku qabsato dekedda Casab ee ku taalla Badda Cas. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Eritrea, Yemane Gebremeskel, ayaa qoraal uu Jimcaha ku baahiyay barta X ku sheegay in dalkiisu uu muujiyay dulqaad iyo is-xakameyn, inkastoo uu ku eedeeyay Itoobiya inay muddo ka badan saddex sano wadday gardarro aan cidina ku soo qaadin. Yemane ayaa sheegay in khatartaasi ay soo bilaabatay markii madaxda Itoobiya ay sannadkii 2023 ku dhawaaqeen qorshahooda ku aaddan inay helaan marin badeed ay madax-bannaani ku leeyihiin. Wuxuu ku dooday in dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed ay dagaallada hadda socda u adeegsanayso marmarsiinyo ay ku qabsato dekedda Casab, si ay dib ugu hesho marin ay ku gaarto Badda Cas. Si kastaba, wasiirka Eritrea si toos ah ugama jawaabin eedeynta ah in ciidamada dalkiisa ay gudaha u galeen Itoobiya. Arbacadii ayuu wararkaasi ku tilmaamay qayb ka mid ah qorshe ay Addis Ababa ku doonayso inay ku sharciyeyso dagaal ka dhan ah Eritrea. Itoobiya ayaa tan iyo markii Eritrea ay xorriyadda qaadatay sannadkii 1993 noqotay dal aan lahayn xeeb, waxaana madaxdeedu muddooyinkii dambe si joogto ah u sheegayeen in helitaanka marin badeed uu muhiim u yahay mustaqbalka dalka. Hase yeeshee, Addis Ababa ayaa ku adkeysatay in arrintaasi lagu xallinayo wada-hadal iyo hab nabadeed, halka Eritrea ay ka cabsi qabto in damaca Itoobiya uu ugu dambeyn horseedo isku day militari oo lagu qabsanayo dekedaheeda. Duqeymo iyo qaraxyo cusub Is-weydaarsiga eedeymaha ayaa ku soo beegmaya iyadoo qaraxyo cusub laga maqlay agagaarka magaalada Adigrat ee gobolka Tigray, halkaas oo maalmihii la soo dhaafay laga soo sheegay dhaqdhaqaaqyo militari oo ay sameynayeen ciidamada labada dal. Hay’adda Mareykanka fadhigeedu yahay ee ACLED, oo la socota colaadaha, ayaa sheegtay in duqeymo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn lagu qaaday ciidamada Eritrea Arbacadii iyo Khamiistii, xilli ay dib uga guranayeen fariisimo ku dhow Adigrat. Hay’adda ayaa sheegtay in duqeymahaasi loo maleynayo inay fuliyeen ciidamada Itoobiya, balse weli ma jirto xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo dhammaystiran oo ku saabsan khasaaraha ka dhashay. Qof deggan Adigrat ayaa Reuters u sheegay Jimcihii in habeenkii iyo subaxnimadii ay maqleen qaraxyo soo noqnoqday oo ka dhacayay meel dhowr kiiloomitir u jirta magaalada. Goobjoogayaal kale ayaa horraantii toddobaadkan sheegay inay arkeen ciidamo Eritrean ah oo gaadiid militari ku marayay gudaha Tigray, taas oo sii xoojisay walaaca laga qabo in dagaallada Itoobiya ay isu beddelaan colaad goboleed. Dhanka kale, ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya ayaa maalmihii dambe dib ula wareegayay deegaanno ka tirsan Tigray, oo ay ku jirto magaalada Mekelle, kadib markii xoogagga ka soo horjeeda dowladda ay halkaasi isaga baxeen. Shirkadda Ethiopian Airlines ayaa sidoo kale ku dhawaaqday inay 11-ka October dib u bilaabi doonto duulimaadyada Mekelle, taas oo muujineysa isku dayga lagu soo celinayo adeegyada caadiga ah ee magaalada. Xiisad halis ku ah gobolka Dagaallada cusub ayaa billowday 23-kii September, markii ay isku dhaceen ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya iyo isbaheysi kooxo hubeysan ah oo ka dagaallamaya gobollada Tigray, Amhara iyo Afar. Itoobiya ayaa Eritrea ku eedeysay inay taageerto isbaheysigaasi, balse dowladda Asmara ayaa beenisay eedeynta. Xiriirka labada dal ayaa maray isbeddello waaweyn sannadihii dambe. Itoobiya iyo Eritrea waxay heshiis nabadeed gaareen 2018, kadib colaado muddo dheer soo jiitamayay, waxaana heshiiskaasi uu Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed ku mutaystay abaalmarinta Nobel Peace Prize. Labada dal ayaa markii dambe iska kaashaday dagaalkii Tigray ee socday intii u dhaxeysay 2020 iyo 2022, markaas oo ciidamada Eritrea ay garab siinayeen dowladda federaalka Itoobiya. Hase yeeshee, xiriirkooda ayaa dib u xumaaday dhammaadkii dagaalkaasi. Dagaalka Tigray ayaa sababay dhimashada boqollaal kun oo qof, waxaana dagaallada dib u qarxay bishii hore ay noqdeen kuwii ugu cuslaa tan iyo markii heshiis nabadeed lagu soo afjaray colaaddaasi sannadkii 2022. Xiisadda hadda taagan ayaa dhalisay cabsi hor leh oo ku saabsan xasilloonida Geeska Afrika, maadaama muranka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea uu ku soo beegmay xilli ay gobolka ka jiraan colaado kale iyo loollan sii xoogeysanaya oo ku saabsan marin-badeedka Badda Cas. items.title: Weerar sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac badan oo lagu qaaday garoonka diyaardaha Riyadh
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Ugu yaraan saddex qof ayaa ku dhintay, dhowr kalena way ku dhaawacmeen weerarro gantaallo ah oo kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay ku qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee King Khalid ee magaalada Riyadh, iyadoo dagaalka u dhexeeya Sacuudi Carabiya iyo kooxdaasi uu sii xoogeysanayo. Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa Jimcihii xaqiijisay in weerarrada, oo dhacay Khamiistii, ay ku dhinteen saddex muwaadin oo Sacuudi ah, isla markaana ay waxyeello soo gaartay diyaarad ay leedahay shirkadda Saudia Airlines. Weerarka koowaad ayaa lala beegsaday xarumaha garoonka, halka kan labaad uu ku dhacay diyaarad taallay garoonka, taas oo sababtay khasaare hantiyeed iyo qiiq xooggan oo cirka isku shareeray. Shirkadda Saudia Airlines ayaa sheegtay in mid ka mid ah dadka dhintay uu ahaa duuliye ka tirsan shaqaalaheeda, halka dhaawacyada dadka kale ay isugu jiraan kuwo fudud iyo kuwo culus. Weerarradan ayaa sababay in shirkado badan oo diyaaradeed ay joojiyaan ama dib u dhigaan duulimaadyadii ay ku tegi jireen Riyadh, iyadoo Xuutiyiintu ay ku hanjabeen inay hawada Sacuudi Carabiya ka dhigi doonaan goob dagaal. Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in shaqadii garoonka ay dib ugu soo laabatay xaaladdeedii caadiga ahayd, inkastoo qaar ka mid ah shirkadaha caalamiga ah ay weli hakad geliyeen duulimaadyadooda. Sacuudiga oo duqeeyay Sanca Weerarrada Riyadh ayaa kusoo beegmay xilli ciidamada Sacuudi Carabiya ay kordhiyeen duqeymaha cirka ee ay ka fulinayaan gudaha Yemen, gaar ahaan caasimadda Sanca oo ay maamulaan Xuutiyiintu. Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta iyo warbaahinta kooxda ayaa sheegay in diyaaradaha dagaalka Sacuudiga ay habeenkii Khamiista duqeymo ka fuliyeen goobo ay kooxdu ku leedahay magaalada Sanca. Isbaheysiga militari ee Sacuudiga hoggaamiyo, kaas oo taageera dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, ayaa dhankiisa sheegay inuu burburiyay saddex xarumood oo Xuutiyiintu ka ridi jireen gantaallada. Isbaheysiga ayaa sidoo kale ka digay in weerarrada lagu beegsanayo dadka rayidka ah iyo kaabayaasha muhiimka ah ay la kulmi doonaan jawaab militari oo adag. Dagaalka ayaa si weyn u xoogaystay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay, kaddib markii Xuutiyiintu ay bishii September horumar militari ka sameeyeen xeebaha Badda Cas, iyagoo la wareegay dhul ku dhow marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab. Horumarkaasi ayaa Sacuudi Carabiya ku kallifay inay dib u xoojiso faragelinteeda militari ee Yemen, iyadoo taageero cirka ah siinaysa ciidamada dowladda ee isku dayaya inay dib ula wareegaan deegaannada ay Xuutiyiintu qabsadeen. Ciidamada dowladda Yemen ayaa Isniintii sheegay inay dib ula wareegeen deegaanno ku dhow xeebaha Bab al-Mandab, hase yeeshee dagaallo culus ayaa weli ka socda buuraha ku teedsan marin-biyoodkaas. Safiirka Sacuudiga ee Yemen ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in Xuutiyiinta laga saaray aagga Bab al-Mandab, balse wakaaladda Reuters ayaa sheegtay inaysan si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin sheegashadaas, iyadoo kooxdaasi ay weli joogto magaalada xeebeedka Mocha. Dhinaca kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa horumar ka sameeyay deegaannada buuraleyda ah ee ku dhow magaalada Taiz, halkaas oo ay go’doomin ku hayaan ciidamo badan oo dowladda Yemen ka tirsan, iyagoo jaray waddo muhiim u ahayd isu socodka magaalada. Hanjabaadda diyaaradaha iyo shidaalka Xuutiyiinta ayaa Jimcihii ku celiyay hanjabaaddooda ah inay beegsan doonaan diyaaradaha isticmaala hawada Sacuudi Carabiya, marka laga reebo kuwa dul mara magaalooyinka barakeysan ee Maka iyo Madiina. Kooxda ayaa sheegtay inay hawada boqortooyada u aragto goob ay ciidamadeeda gantaalladu ka fulin karaan howlgallo militari, iyadoo sidoo kale uga digtay shaqaalaha xarumaha shidaalka inay ka fogaadaan goobahaas. Hanjabaadahan ayaa walaac ku abuuray shirkadaha duulimaadyada caalamiga ah, waxaana Hay’adda Badbaadada Duulista ee Midowga Yurub ay ballaarisay digniinaha ay ka soo saartay duulimaadyada mara hawada Sacuudiga. Sidoo kale, safaaradda Mareykanka ee Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa muwaadiniinteeda ugu baaqday inay feejignaan dheeraad ah muujiyaan, iyadoo ka digtay in colaadda gobolka ay si degdeg ah uga sii dari karto. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa dhinaceeda taageero militari ka dalbatay Pakistan iyo Turkiga, oo ay kula jirto heshiis difaac wadajir ah, si ay uga caawiyaan ka hortagga weerarrada Xuutiyiinta. Xiisaddan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa maalmo ka hor shir weyn oo caalami ah oo ay madaxda shirkadaha shidaalka iyo wasiirrada tamarta dalal kala duwan ku yeelanayaan Riyadh, kaas oo lagu wado inuu furmo Axadda. Wasiirka Tamarta Talyaaniga, Gilberto Pichetto Fratin, ayaa sheegay inuusan shirka shaqsi ahaan uga qeybgeli doonin, balse uu kaga qeybqaadan doono muuqaal, isagoo aan faahfaahin sababta go’aankiisa. Dagaalka Yemen ayaa hadda noqday mid ka mid ah furimaha ugu culus ee colaadda gobolka, taas oo sii xoogaysatay tan iyo markii Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay 28-kii February weerarro ku qaadeen Iran. Colaadda ayaa sidoo kale saameyn weyn ku yeelatay isu socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo shidaalka, iyadoo Xuutiyiintu ay weerarro ka wadaan Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, halka Iran ay qeyb ahaan xannibtay marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Labadan marin-biyood ayaa ah kuwo muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo sahayda shidaalka caalamka, waxaana dagaallada ka socda ay sii kordhinayaan walaaca laga qabo amniga maraakiibta iyo duulimaadyada gobolka. items.title: Ciidamada Lafta-gareen oo maanta la wareegay magaalo muhiim ah oo u dhow Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Lafta-gareen ayaa la wareegay gacan ku-haynta degmada Qansaxdheere ee gobolka Bay oo qiyaastii 90KM u jirta magaalada Baydhabo. Wararka laga helayo degmada ayaa sheegaya in qaar ka mid ah ciidamadii halkaas ku sugnaa ay isu dhiibeen xoogagga taageersan Lafta-gareen, halka askar kale ay gudaha u galeen xerada ciidamada Itoobiya ku leeyihiin degmada. Xasan Cabdulqaadir Maxamed oo ku magacaaban mas’uulka amniga ee Lafta-gareen ayaa qoraal uu soo saaray ku sheegay in ciidamadoodu ay si buuxda ula wareegeen degmada, isla markaana ay halkaas kala kulmeen soo dhoweyn dadweyne. “Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ayaa si buuxda ula wareegay degmada Qansaxdheere, waxaana magaalada si diirran noogu soo dhoweeyey shacabka degmada,” ayuu ku yiri qoraalkiisa. La wareegidda degmada Qansaxdheere ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli maamulka Koonfur Galbeed uu wajahayo xiisado siyaasadeed iyo kuwo amni, kuwaas oo la xiriira loollanka hoggaanka maamulka iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ay wadaan dhinacyada isku haya maamulka. Tallaabadan ayaa cadaadis hor leh ku abuuri karta hoggaanka siyaasadeed ee hadda ka jira Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo xaaladda degmada iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqa ciidamada ay u baahan yihiin in si dhow loola socdo. Ilaa hadda, ma jiraan faahfaahin madax-bannaan oo laga hayo qaabka uu garabka Lafta-gareen ugu suurtagashay la wareegidda degmada iyo halka ay ku sugan yihiin ciidamadii hore ugu sugnaa. Sidoo kale, ma jiro war rasmi ah oo laga soo saaray khasaaraha ka dhashay la wareegidda. The post Ciidamada Lafta-gareen oo maanta la wareegay magaalo muhiim ah oo u dhow Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sooyaal: Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax
items.description: Taariikhda ummadda Soomaaliyeed waxaa soo maray foolaad iyo haldoor u huray naftooda iyo aqoontooda sidii ay u hanuunin lahaayeen bulshadooda, una diiwaangelin lahaayeen hiddaha iyo dhaqanka ay ummaddu leedahay. Dadka ugu horreeya ee la xusuusan karo ama safka hore kaga jira hal-abuurka iyo aqoonyahannada Soomaaliyeed waxaa ka mid ah Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax. Wuxuu ahaa qoraa, aqoonyahan, hal-abuure, hoggaamiye bulsheed, bare jaamacadeed, siyaasi aftahan ah iyo halgame u taagnaa in afka iyo fanka Soomaaliyeed ay gaaraan maqaamka ay ku leeyihiin suugaanta caalamka. Haddaba, haddaan milicsanno taariikhnololeedkiisa, halka uu ka soo bilowday iyo heerarkii kala duwanaa ee uu soo maray intii uu ku guda jiray u adeegidda bulshada, waxaan helaynaa suugaanyahan iyo aqoonyahan raad weyn ku reebay taariikhda qowmiyadda Soomaaliyeed. Dhalashadii iyo Barbaarintiisii Hore Hilaaddii sannadkii 1952kii ayuu Maxamed Daahir Afrax ku dhashay degaanka Jariibban ee ku yaal waqooyiga gobolka Mudug. Wuxuu ka soo jeeday qoys reermiyi ah, wuxuuna ku dhex barbaaray bulsho dhaqan ahaan geeljirayaal ah oo noloshoodu ku salaysnayd dhaqanka baadiyaha. Wuxuu ku soo barbaaray nolol adag oo jawigeeda iyo degaankeeduba ahaayeen miyiga. Wuxuu carruurnimadiisii iyo kuraynimadiisii ku dhex barbaaray bulsho geeljirayaal ah oo aan inta badan lahayn dhaqan beeralaynimo. Wuxuu ku hanaqaaday dhaqankii iyo hiddihii ay dadka halkaas ku noolaa lahaayeen. Muddo uu reermiyi ahaa kaddib, wuxuu u soo wareegay magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu ka billaabay noloshii magaalada. Waxbarashadiisa nidaamiga ahi waxay ka billaabatay dugsigii hoose/dhexe ee Xamarjajab, kaddibna wuxuu u gudbay dugsigii sare ee Jamaal Cabdinaasir, halkaas oo uu ku dhammaystay waxbarashadiisii dugsiga sare ee dalka gudihiisa. Halkaas wixii ka dambeeyey, wuxuu safar aqooneed ugu ambaqaaday magaalada Cadan ee dalka Yemen, halkaas oo uu ka billaabay waxbarashadiisa heerka koowaad ee jaamacadda, isaga oo ka qalinjebiyey kulliyaddii waxbarashada ee Jaamacadda Cadan. Markii uu waxbarashadii Cadan soo gabagabeeyey, wuxuu uga sii gudbay dalka Ingiriiska, halkaas oo uu ka billaabay cilmibaaris iyo daraasaad sare. Jaamacadda London (SOAS), oo ahayd xarun caalami ah oo lagu barto taariikhda iyo dhaqanka Afrika, ayuu ka qaatay shahaadooyinkiisa sare ee maajisteerka (Master’s degree) iyo weliba shahaadada diktoorada (PhD), kuwaas oo qayb weyn ka qaatay in uu noqdo aqoonyahan caalami ah oo miisaan culus ku leh cilmiga afafka iyo bulshada. Hal-abuurkii Suugaaneed iyo Buugaggii Dhaxalka ahaa Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax wuxuu si weyn ugu caanbaxay qoraalka sheekooyinka iyo fanka curinta sheeko-faneedka (fiction). Dr. Maxamed waxa uu qori jiray sheekooyin gaagaaban iyo sheekooyin dhaadheer. Waxaa la isku waafaqsan yahay in uu qoray mid ka mid ah sheekooyinkii ugu xiisaha badnaa nuxur ahaan iyo suugaan ahaan taariikhda af Soomaaliga, taas oo ahayd buuggii caanka ahaa ee Maana-faay . Buuggan, oo qoraagu ku qoray af Soomaaliga isaga oo xilligaas ay ku gedaamnaayeen duruufo nololeed iyo caqabado badan oo wajahayey qoraanimadiisa, waxaa ka mid ahaa caqabadahaas in uusan haysan qalabka casriga ah ee kumbuyuutarka ama teebka fududeeya qoraalka. Sidaas oo ay tahay, waxa uu u kacay in uu soo saaro sheeko Soomaaliyeed oo dhinac kasta ka dhisan. Wuxuu ku mutaystay in dadkii suugaanta ka akhriyey ay u aqoonsadaan shaqo farshaxan oo heer sare ah. Prof. B. W. Andrzejewski, oo ahaa afyaqaan caalami ah oo danaynayey afafka Kushitigga, ayaa buuggan ka hadlay isaga oo la ashqaraaray hibada farshaxannimo ee qoraaga, wuxuuna ku tilmaamay shaqo faneed, taas oo gaarsiisay suugaanta Soomaalida maqaam ay kaga mid noqon karto suugaanta caalamka. Sannadkii 2019, buuggan ayaa dib loo daabacay si loogu celiyo jiilasha cusub ee soo kacaya. Intaas waxaa dheer, Afrax wuxuu qoray buugaag kale oo qiimo weyn ku leh suugaanta iyo siyaasadda Soomaalida, sida Guur-ku-sheeg (1975), Galti-macruuf (1980), Durbaan Been ah iyo buugga Dal dad waayey iyo duni damiir beeshay , oo uu qoray sannadkii 1994, xilligii uu dalku ku jiray qalalaasaha iyo dagaallada sokeeye, kaas oo si dhab ah u sawiraya waaqicii dalka ka jiray. Sidoo kale, wuxuu muddo dheer tifaftire ka ahaa wargeys-xilliyeedka Hal-abuur ee ka hadlayey dhaqanka iyo suugaanta. Qoraagu waxa uu wax ku qoray afaf kala duwan oo ay ka mid yihiin afafka Carabiga, Ingiriisiga iyo Soomaaliga. Intaas waxay inoo muujinaysaa in waxsoosaarkii aqooneed ee Dr. Maxamed uu aad u ballaarnaa. items.fullContent: Taariikhda ummadda Soomaaliyeed waxaa soo maray foolaad iyo haldoor u huray naftooda iyo aqoontooda sidii ay u hanuunin lahaayeen bulshadooda, una diiwaangelin lahaayeen hiddaha iyo dhaqanka ay ummaddu leedahay. Dadka ugu horreeya ee la xusuusan karo ama safka hore kaga jira hal-abuurka iyo aqoonyahannada Soomaaliyeed waxaa ka mid ah Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax. Wuxuu ahaa qoraa, aqoonyahan, hal-abuure, hoggaamiye bulsheed, bare jaamacadeed, siyaasi aftahan ah iyo halgame u taagnaa in afka iyo fanka Soomaaliyeed ay gaaraan maqaamka ay ku leeyihiin suugaanta caalamka. Haddaba, haddaan milicsanno taariikhnololeedkiisa, halka uu ka soo bilowday iyo heerarkii kala duwanaa ee uu soo maray intii uu ku guda jiray u adeegidda bulshada, waxaan helaynaa suugaanyahan iyo aqoonyahan raad weyn ku reebay taariikhda qowmiyadda Soomaaliyeed. Dhalashadii iyo Barbaarintiisii Hore Hilaaddii sannadkii 1952kii ayuu Maxamed Daahir Afrax ku dhashay degaanka Jariibban ee ku yaal waqooyiga gobolka Mudug. Wuxuu ka soo jeeday qoys reermiyi ah, wuxuuna ku dhex barbaaray bulsho dhaqan ahaan geeljirayaal ah oo noloshoodu ku salaysnayd dhaqanka baadiyaha. Wuxuu ku soo barbaaray nolol adag oo jawigeeda iyo degaankeeduba ahaayeen miyiga. Wuxuu carruurnimadiisii iyo kuraynimadiisii ku dhex barbaaray bulsho geeljirayaal ah oo aan inta badan lahayn dhaqan beeralaynimo. Wuxuu ku hanaqaaday dhaqankii iyo hiddihii ay dadka halkaas ku noolaa lahaayeen. Muddo uu reermiyi ahaa kaddib, wuxuu u soo wareegay magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu ka billaabay noloshii magaalada. Waxbarashadiisa nidaamiga ahi waxay ka billaabatay dugsigii hoose/dhexe ee Xamarjajab, kaddibna wuxuu u gudbay dugsigii sare ee Jamaal Cabdinaasir, halkaas oo uu ku dhammaystay waxbarashadiisii dugsiga sare ee dalka gudihiisa. Halkaas wixii ka dambeeyey, wuxuu safar aqooneed ugu ambaqaaday magaalada Cadan ee dalka Yemen, halkaas oo uu ka billaabay waxbarashadiisa heerka koowaad ee jaamacadda, isaga oo ka qalinjebiyey kulliyaddii waxbarashada ee Jaamacadda Cadan. items.title: Midowga Baarlamaannada Adduunka oo Doortay Madaxweyne Cusub
items.description: Arusha, Tansaaniya – Midowga Baarlamaannada Adduunka (IPU) ayaa maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 9-ka Oktoobar 2026, magaalada Arusha ee dalka Tansaaniya ku doortay madaxweyne cusub, kaas oo noqonaya hoggaamiyaha ururkan caalamiga ah ee ay ku mideysan yihiin baarlamaannada dalalka dunida. Milton Dick, oo ah Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Baarlamaanka Australia, ayaa ku guuleystay doorashada madaxweynaha cusub ee IPU, kaddib markii uu ka adkaaday labadii musharrax ee kale ee la tartamayay. Labada musharrax ee laga guuleystay ayaa kala ahaa Sahiba Gafarova, Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Azerbaijan, iyo Rojo Edwards Silva, oo ah senator ka tirsan Baarlamaanka dalka Chile. Doorashada ayaa ka dhacday magaalada Arusha, iyadoo qeyb ka ahayd Shirweynaha 153-aad ee Midowga Baarlamaannada Adduunka. Dhanka kale, wafdi ka socda labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, oo ay hoggaaminayso Senator Samsam Daahir Maxamuud, ayaa ka qeyb galay doorashada madaxweynaha cusub ee ururka. Ka qeybgalka wafdiga Soomaaliya ayaa muujinaya doorka ay Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ku leeyihiin xiriirka iyo iskaashiga baarlamaannada caalamka, iyo ka qeybgalka go’aan-qaadashada ururka. Midowga Baarlamaannada Adduunka (IPU) ayaa ah urur caalami ah oo u ololeeya dimuqraadiyadda, nabadda, wada-hadalka iyo iskaashiga baarlamaannada dalalka xubnaha ka ah.

items.title: AFRICOM Warns Houthis May Be Seeking to Expand Operations Into Somalia
items.description: Yemen’s Houthi movement is seeking to expand its presence into Somalia, potentially opening another front for attacks against shipping in the Middle East and increasing risks to U.S. forces in the region, according to U.S. Africa Command (AFRICOM).

items.title: Somalia Reportedly Agrees to Acquire Pakistan’s JF-17 Fighter Jets
items.description: Somalia has reportedly reached an agreement with Pakistan to acquire JF-17 Thunder fighter jets as part of efforts to rebuild and modernize its air force, although neither government has publicly confirmed a final procurement deal.

items.title: Somaliland oo si yaab leh uga hadashay shirkii Masar ee looga horyimid aqoonsiga Israel
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Danjiraha Somaliland u fadhiya Israa’iil, Maxamed Cumar Xaaji Maxamuud ayaa si adag uga hadlay kulanka ay dhawaan yeesheen madaxda Soomaaliya, Eritrea, Masar iyo Suudaan, kaas oo lagu cambaareeyay aqoonsiga ay Israa’iil siisay Somaliland. Danjiraha ayaa sheegay in shirarka siyaasadeed ee ay yeeshaan hoggaamiyeyaasha gobolka aysan awood u lahayn inay go’aan ka gaaraan mustaqbalka Somaliland, isla markaana aysan waxba ka beddeli karin taariikhdeeda, madax-bannaanideeda iyo rabitaanka shacabkeeda. “Shirarka noocaan ah waxay abuuri karaan cinwaanno warbaahineed, balse awood uma laha inay Somaliland ka hor istaagaan xaqiijinta himilooyinkeeda siyaasadeed,” ayuu yiri Danjire Maxamed Xaaji. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in kulankaasi uusan khatar ku ahayn oo keliya danaha Somaliland, balse uu sidoo kale wax u dhimayo danaha istaraatiijiyadeed ee dalal muhiim ah oo gobolka ku yaalla iyo kuwa deriska la ah Somaliland. Danjiraha ayaa dhaleeceyn xooggan u jeediyay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isagoo ku tilmaamay maamul fashilmay, kuna eedeeyay in loo adeegsanayo awood wakiil ah oo lagula dagaallamayo Somaliland iyo saaxiibadeeda gobolka iyo caalamka. “U adeegsiga maamulka fashilmay ee Muqdisho sidii awood wakiil ah oo lagaga soo horjeedo Somaliland iyo saaxiibadeeda kale ee muhiimka ah ee gobolka iyo meelo ka baxsan weligiis ma shaqayn doono,” ayuu yiri Danjiraha. Hadallada danjiraha ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada diblomaasiyadeed ee la xiriira aqoonsiga Somaliland kadib markii Israa’iil ay aqoonsatay, taas oo dhalisay falcelinno kala duwan oo ka yimid dalalka gobolka. Madaxda Soomaaliya, Ereteriya, Suudaan iyo Masar ayaa dhawaan kulan ku yeeshay dalka Masar, iyagoo ka horyimid aqoonsiga ay Israa’iil siisay maamulka Somaliland, kuna dooday in tallaabadaasi ay dhaawacayso madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. The post Somaliland oo si yaab leh uga hadashay shirkii Masar ee looga horyimid aqoonsiga Israel appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Egypt Prepares for Potential Military Deployment to Somalia Amid Rising Horn of Africa Tensions
items.description: MOGADISHU, Somalia — Egyptian military technical teams, including advisers, trainers and officers, are reportedly preparing for the deployment of Egyptian army personnel to Somalia, according to regional security and defence reports.

items.title: Somalia: Jubbaland Forces Take Control of Beled Hawo Amid Political Shifts in Gedo
items.description: BELED HAWO, Somalia — The Jubbaland administration has taken control of Beled Hawo in Somalia’s Gedo region, following a period during which the town was held by forces and an administration aligned with the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS).

items.title: Somalia: Laftagareen-Aligned Forces Take Control of Qansaxdheere
items.description: BAIDOA, Somalia — Forces aligned with former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen on Thursday took control of Qansaxdheere district in Bay region, approximately 90 kilometers southwest of Baidoa.

items.title: Political Dispute Deepens Between North Eastern Somalia Leaders
items.description: LAS ANOD, Somalia — A political dispute has emerged between the President of the North Eastern State of Somalia, Abdiqadir Ahmed Aw-Ali (Firdhiye), and his Vice President, Abdirashid Yusuf Jibril (Abwaan), amid differences over the administration of government institutions, constitutional powers, and the two leaders’ approach to consultation and decision-making.

items.title: Faah-faahinta dagaal culus oo maanta ka dhacay Hiiraan

items.title: Dagaal Khasaare Sababay oo Ka Dhex Qarxay Waqooyi Bari iyo Somaliland
items.description: Dagaal sababay khasaare ayaa la sheegay inuu ka dhex qarxay dhinacyada Waqooyi Bari iyo Somaliland, kaddib markii uu muran ka dhashay geel la kala dhacay jiidda deegaanka Buqdharkayn. Wararka hordhaca ah ayaa sheegaya in dagaalka ay ku lug leeyihiin laba beelood, kaas oo salka ku haya muran la xiriira xoolo la kala dhacay. Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan khasaaraha ka dhashay dagaalka, tirada dadka waxyeelladu gaartay iyo xaaladda ugu dambeysay ee deegaanka ayaan weli la xaqiijin. Wixii warar ah ee soo kordha kala soco.

items.title: Kenya: Taliye saldhig boolis oo lagu dilay qarax
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyihii booliska Kenya ee saldhigga Xarardheere iyo mid kamid ah ilaaladiisa ayaa ku dhintay qarax miino oo haleelay gaarigii ay la socdeen, xilli ay marayeen waddada isku xirta deegaannada Saretho iyo Dadaab ee gobolka Garissa. Qaraxa ayaa dhacay markii gaariga ay la socdeen uu dulmaray miino lagu aasay waddada, taas oo sababtay dhimashada Taliyaha iyo mid kamid ah ilaaladiisa. Kadib qaraxa, goobta waxaa gaaray ciidamo kala duwan oo ka tirsan laamaha amniga Kenya oo ay ku jiraan cutubyo qaabilsan la-dagaallanka kooxaha hubeysan iyo baarista miinooyinka. Saraakiil ka tirsan ciidamada ammaanka Kenya ayaa weerarka ku eedeeyay kooxda Al-Shabaab, iyagoo sheegay inay baaritaanno ku wadaan dhacdada si loo ogaado dadkii ka dambeeyay qaraxa iyo cid kasta oo xog ka haysay. Waddada isku xirta deegaannada Saretho iyo Dadaab ayaa waxaa hore uga dhacay qaraxyo miinooyin iyo weerarro jid-gal ah oo lala xiriiriyay xubno ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab oo u dhashay dalka Kenya. Qaar kamid ah dadka lagu tuhmay inay ku lug lahaayeen weerarradii hore ayaa la qabtay, halka kuwo kale ay ka baxsadeen ciidamada ammaanka intii ay socdeen howlgallo qorsheysan oo laga fuliyay deegaannadaas. Dhacdadan ayaa mar kale muujineysa caqabadaha amni ee ciidamada Kenya kala kulmaan waddooyinka ku yaalla deegaannada ay ka socdaan howlgallada ka dhanka ah kooxda Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan weerarrada loo adeegsado miinooyinka dhulka lagu aaso. The post Kenya: Taliye saldhig boolis oo lagu dilay qarax appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Qoysas ku nool Ceel-jaale oo hoy la’aan noqday xilli digniinaha El Niño ay xoogaysteen
items.description: (ERGO) – Boqollaal qoys oo ah dad soo barakacay ayaa laga saaray guryo ay sanado ku degganaayeen bilaash oo ku yaalla deegaanka Ceeljaale ee duleedka Baladwayne. Qoysaskii lahaa guryahan ayaa sheegay in xilligan aysan ka maarmin, maaddama ay jiraan digniino la xiriira fatahaado iyo daadad, kuwaas oo ay sababi karto EL Nino. Waa guryo ay baaraan deg u dhisteen dadka ku nool xaafadaha Baledweyne ee ku dhow wabiga ee kala ah Kooshin, Buundoweyn, Xaawo Taako, Raadaarka, Kutiimbo iyo laabka. Waxay sheegay inay dib ugu baahdeen, maaddama ay ka guurayaan xaafadaha godanka ah ee ay ku noolaayeen.  Danyarta sida kumeel gaarka ah u degganaa guryahan oo ah dad sanado ka hor ka soo barakacay colaado iyo abaar ayaa hadda ah bannaan yaal ah aan haysan hoy. Salaado Cabdi Cusmaan oo ka mid ah dadka xaaladan ay saameysay ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay in dantu biday geed hoostiis iyo aqal cooshad ah oo aan ka xajin karin roobka. Labaatankii bishii September laga saaray guri ay bilaash ku degganeyd muddo sannad iyo bar ah. “Guriga iiga bax biyo baxo ayaa soo socoto ayaa ley dhahay. Waan ka soo baxay meeshan bannaanka ah ayaan soo dagay. Qorax ayaa xitaa na leysay. Roob hilaaciisa markii aan Aragno intee gashaan ayaan is dhahnaa. Hoy la’aan aad ah ayaa na hayso.” Dadka inta awoodda ayaa xilligan u diga roganaya dhul aan godan aheyn oo ay uga badbaadaan daadadka iyo fatahaadaha laga cabsi qabo, balse qoyska Salaado waxaa u billowday barakac, hoy xumo iyo xaalad ay maareyn teedu ku adag tahay. Waa hooyo haysata 12 carruur ah, seygeeduna yahay xoogsade u shaqo taga Baledweyne oo u jirta 6km. Dhismaha guryaha ayuu ka shaqeeya. Waa howl aan joogto aheyn oo ay xustay in maalinka uu qabto uu ka helo ugu badnaan $5. Cunto yarida ayaa ah walaac kale oo u dheer hoy xumada ay wajahayaan xilli roobaadkan. “Odaygeyga ayaa meelahan or orda oo dhagaxa ka shaqeeya, inta uu shaqo helo waxaa ka badan inta uu waayo. Markii uu shaqo waayo wax dab la saaro maleh, waan iska seexanaa anagoo gaajeysan. Rafaad weyn ayaa maesha nagu haysta.” Dagaal u dhexeeyay dadka deegaanka iyo Alshabaab ayaa Salaado oo 62 jir ah ka soo barakaciyay deegaanka Inabaal oo hoos taga degmada Maxaas. Xaaladaas waxay ku waysay ishii dhaqaale ee qoysku ku tiirsanaa oo ahaa 46 ari ah oo Alshabaab ay ka dhacday. Tan iyo sanadkii 2025 oo ay ku jirto xaalad hubanti la’aan ah oo barakac ah ayay tilmaamtay in caruurteeda oo dhigan jiray iskuul hoose iyo dhexe aysan waxbarasho aadin, dhaqaale yari awgeed. “Iskuul haddii canugii la geeyo, buug iyo qalimaan iyo qarash kale ayuu u baahan yahay, anigana dhaqaale la’aan ayaan u geyn waayay oo iskaga dhaafay. Ciyaal waa dhib badan yihiin guri maba lagu hayn karo.” Ceel-jaalle oo ah dhul ka durugsan Wabiga Shabeelle, sidoo kalana aan jooggiisu hoosayn ayaa noqda deegaan muhiim ah xilliyada laga cabsi qabo inay dhacaan fatahaado iyo daadad. Sanadihii 2018,2019 iyo 2023 oo ay Baledweyne ku dhufteen fatahaado ay ku barakaceen boqollaal kun oo qof ayaa deegaankan Ceel-jaalle ka dhigtay lamahuraan. Wixii intaas ka dambeeyay ayay dadku ka gateen dhul ay ka dhisteen guryo ku meel gaar ah oo ay maciin bidaan xilligan oo kale marka ay jirto qatar fatahaad la xiriirta. Waxaa ku yaalla in ka badan 15 kun oo guri. Cabdiwali Xasan Diir oo musiibadan ka sii baraan dagaya ayaa dayac-tir ku billaabay guri uu ku leeyahay deegaanka Ceel-jaalle, kaas oo uu ka saaray qoys danyar ah oo bilaash ku sii degganaa. Wuxuu sheegay in baahidii uu u dhistay sanadkii 2022 ay hadda taagantay. Wuxuu u diyaar garoobayaa guuritaan uu ku qasbanaan karo xilli kasta. Waa xaalad muujineysa sida fatahaadaha soo noqnoqday ay dadku casharro uga baranayaan, waloow ay yar yihiin qoysaska awooda inay helaan guryo ay isku badashaan.  “Aniga waxaa kamid ahay dadka guryaha ka sameeystay meelaha loo barakaco. Si ay hadhow ugu badbaadaan masiiboooyinka iyo dhibaatada ay wataan fatahaadaha.” “Waxaan ugu talo galay in mar kasta oo culeys uu jiro aan kaga badbaado. Guriga meeshaas ku yaala daryeel gaar ah ayaan siiyaa, marmar xataa ilmaha waan geeyaa jimcaha oo kale.” Cabdiwali oo 44 jir ah ayaa ah ayaa bare iskuul. Wuxuu nolosha reerka ku maareeyaa $300 oo uu ku shaqeeyo. Waxaa iskuul u dhigta shan carruur ah. Walaaca uu qabo ayaa ah in isha dhaqaale iyo waxbarashaduba aysan sii jiri doonin haddii ay ka barakacaan xaafadda Kooshin oo ay ka deggan yihiin Baledweyne. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in guuritaanka qoysku uu u baahan doono ugu yaraan $100 oo uu sheegay in hadda uusan gacan ku hayn, ayna taasi u sii dheer tahay inuu maciin bidi doono deegaan kulminaya kummannaan qoys.  “Hadda cid caawineyso ma jirto. Caruurtii waxbarasho la’aan ayay noqonayaan, nolosha sii adkaaneysa. Marka koley dadkaasi ayaan kamid noqon doonaa. Waa dhibaato Ilaahey ha noo gargaaro. Dadka dhammaan barakac ayay noqonayaan.” Cabdiwali oo ah aabbaha siddeed carruur ah ayaa xusay in mar kasta oo fatahaad ay dhacdo ay xirmaan goobaha waxbarashada, ayna yaraadaan dhaq-dhaqaaga ganacsiga iyo fursadaha shaqo helinta. Uma suurta galin inuu keydsado dhaqaale uu nolosha reerka ku maareeyo xilliga ay fatahaaddu taagan tahay oo sidoo kale mushaarka uu ku shaqeeyo uu istaagi doono. “Mar kasta oo barakac dhaco waad garan kartaa shaqadii ayaa halaabeyso, qoyska isbeddel badan ayaa ku imaanaaya. Dhibaatada umadda ayaan la qabnaa. Culeyska imaanaaya waxaa ugu weyn xag shaqada, dhaqaalaha iyo hantida.” Cabdiwali ayaa sheegay in afar mar oo fatahaad uu ka barakacay uu degay guriga ugu yaalla deegaanka Ceel-jaalle oo uu ku dhistay dhaqaale gaaraya shan kun oo Doollar. Dhanka kale waxaa jira danyar ay ka mid tahay Luul Cabdullaahi Cumar oo xilli roobaadkan laga saaray hoygii ay uga nooleyd deegaanka Ceel-jaalle. Dadkii lahaa ayaa cabsi fatahaad la xiriirta uga soo guuray Baledweyne, halkaas oo ay dib ugu soo laabteen bishii September. Qoyska Luul ayaa hadda ku nool xerada Teedaan oo aan ka fogeyn, halka laga barakiciyay. Waxay xustay inay yihiin danyar ku tiirsan kaalmada qaraabada. Halka qoysas kale ay diyaar garow ugu jiraan maareynta qataraha ka dhalan kara roobabka iyo fatahaadda webiga Shabeelle, iyadu waxay la tacaaleysaa siday hu, hoy iyo cunto ay ugu heli laheyd siddeed carruuur ah. “Warwar weyn ayay nagu haysa xaaladan cunto yarida iyo guri la’aanta ah. Ciyaal yaryar ah iyo roob meel laga galo aan laheyn waa dhibaato badan yahay.” Luul ayaa sheegtay in barakan uu yahay kii afaraad oo ay wajahdo tan iyo sanadkii 2022. Waxay aheyd xoolo dhaqato ku nool miyiga degmada Maxaas ee gobolka Hiiraan. Dagaaladii adkaa ee u dhexeeyay dadka deegaanka iyo Al-shabaab oo socday 2022, illaa 2025 ayay tilmaamtay inay ku waysay 150 ari ah iyo labo geel ah oo shabaab ay ka dhacday. Xilligan waxaa magaalada Baledweyne ka jirta cabsi xoogan oo laga qabo daadad iyo fatahaad. Xaddiga biyaha wabiga Shabeelle ayaa sareeya, saadaashuna waxay sheegeysaa in roobab xoogan ay da’ayaan bishan October. Ma jiro qorshe uu maamulka gobolka Hiiraan ugu diyaar garoobay maareynta xaalad bani’aadamnimo oo ka dhalan karta musiibooyinka dabiiciga ah. Si ay hadhow ugu badbaadaan masiiboooyinka iyo dhibaatada ay wataan fatahaadaha.” “Waxaan ugu talo galay in mar kasta oo culeys uu jiro aan kaga badbaado. Guriga meeshaas ku yaala daryeel gaar ah ayaan siiyaa, marmar xataa ilmaha waan geeyaa jimcaha oo kale.” Cabdiwali oo 44 jir ah ayaa ah ayaa bare iskuul. Wuxuu nolosha reerka ku maareeyaa $300 oo uu ku shaqeeyo. Waxaa iskuul u dhigta shan carruur ah. Walaaca uu qabo ayaa ah in isha dhaqaale iyo waxbarashaduba aysan sii jiri doonin haddii ay ka barakacaan xaafadda Kooshin oo ay ka deggan yihiin Baledweyne. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in guuritaanka qoysku uu u baahan doono ugu yaraan $100 oo uu sheegay in hadda uusan gacan ku hayn, ayna taasi u sii dheer tahay inuu maciin bidi doono deegaan kulminaya kummannaan qoys.  “Hadda cid caawineyso ma jirto. Caruurtii waxbarasho la’aan ayay noqonayaan, nolosha sii adkaaneysa. Marka koley dadkaasi ayaan kamid noqon doonaa. Waa dhibaato Ilaahey ha noo gargaaro. Dadka dhammaan barakac ayay noqonayaan.” Cabdiwali oo ah aabbaha siddeed carruur ah ayaa xusay in mar kasta oo fatahaad ay dhacdo ay xirmaan goobaha waxbarashada, ayna yaraadaan dhaq-dhaqaaga ganacsiga iyo fursadaha shaqo helinta. Uma suurta galin inuu keydsado dhaqaale uu nolosha reerka ku maareeyo xilliga ay fatahaaddu taagan tahay oo sidoo kale mushaarka uu ku shaqeeyo uu istaagi doono. “Mar kasta oo barakac dhaco waad garan kartaa shaqadii ayaa halaabeyso, qoyska isbeddel badan ayaa ku imaanaaya. Dhibaatada umadda ayaan la qabnaa. Culeyska imaanaaya waxaa ugu weyn xag shaqada, dhaqaalaha iyo hantida.” Cabdiwali ayaa sheegay in afar mar oo fatahaad uu ka barakacay uu degay guriga ugu yaalla deegaanka Ceel-jaalle oo uu ku dhistay dhaqaale gaaraya shan kun oo Doollar. Dhanka kale waxaa jira danyar ay ka mid tahay Luul Cabdullaahi Cumar oo xilli roobaadkan laga saaray hoygii ay uga nooleyd deegaanka Ceel-jaalle. Dadkii lahaa ayaa cabsi fatahaad la xiriirta uga soo guuray Baledweyne, halkaas oo ay dib ugu soo laabteen bishii September. Qoyska Luul ayaa hadda ku nool xerada Teedaan oo aan ka fogeyn, halka laga barakiciyay. Waxay xustay inay yihiin danyar ku tiirsan kaalmada qaraabada. Halka qoysas kale ay diyaar garow ugu jiraan maareynta qataraha ka dhalan kara roobabka iyo fatahaadda webiga Shabeelle, iyadu waxay la tacaaleysaa siday hu, hoy iyo cunto ay ugu heli laheyd siddeed carruuur ah. “Warwar weyn ayay nagu haysa xaaladan cunto yarida iyo guri la’aanta ah. Ciyaal yaryar ah iyo roob meel laga galo aan laheyn waa dhibaato badan yahay.” Luul ayaa sheegtay in barakan uu yahay kii afaraad oo ay wajahdo tan iyo sanadkii 2022. Waxay aheyd xoolo dhaqato ku nool miyiga degmada Maxaas ee gobolka Hiiraan. Dagaaladii adkaa ee u dhexeeyay dadka deegaanka iyo Al-shabaab oo socday 2022, illaa 2025 ayay tilmaamtay inay ku waysay 150 ari ah iyo labo geel ah oo shabaab ay ka dhacday. Xilligan waxaa magaalada Baledweyne ka jirta cabsi xoogan oo laga qabo daadad iyo fatahaad. Xaddiga biyaha wabiga Shabeelle ayaa sareeya, saadaashuna waxay sheegeysaa in roobab xoogan ay da’ayaan bishan October. Ma jiro qorshe uu maamulka gobolka Hiiraan ugu diyaar garoobay maareynta xaalad bani’aadamnimo oo ka dhalan karta musiibooyinka dabiiciga ah. items.title: Awoodda dhaqaale ee Daacish-ta Soomaaliya oo si weyn hoos ugu dhacday
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Daacish ee Soomaaliya ayaa wajahaysa hoos u dhac dhaqaale oo xooggan kadib markii howlgallada ciidamada Puntland iyo taageerada Mareykanka ay wiiqeen shabakado muhiim u ahaa ururinta iyo gudbinta lacagaha kooxda. Warbixin cusub oo uu soo saaray Machadka Africa Center for Strategic Studies ayaa muujinaysa in Daacishta Soomaaliya ay hore u lahayd ilo dhaqaale oo xooggan, kuwaas oo u suurtageliyay inay hesho boqolaal kun oo dollar bishii. Lacagahaas ayaa inta badan ka iman jiray baad iyo canshuuro sharci-darro ah oo laga qaado ganacsatada iyo ilo kale oo maaliyadeed. Xog uu Mareykanku horay u shaaciyay ayaa tilmaamaysa in kooxda ay sanadkii 2021 ururisay ku dhowaad 2.5 milyan oo dollar, halka lixdii bilood ee ugu horreeyay 2022 ay heshay lacag ku dhow laba milyan oo dollar. Doorka ugu weyn ee maareynta dhaqaalahaas waxaa la sheegay inay lahayd xarunta Al-Karrar ee Daacish, taas oo Soomaaliya u adeegsan jirtay meel lagu maareeyo laguna gudbiyo dhaqaalaha taageeraya laamaha kooxda ee Afrika iyo gobollo kale. Warbixin Mareykan ah oo la soo saaray 2026 ayaa sidoo kale tilmaantay in xaruntani weli muhiim u tahay isku xirka dhaq-dhaqaaqa lacagaha ee shabakadda Daacish. Dhibaato kale oo weyn ayaa kooxda soo wajahday sanadkii 2025, markii la qabtay Cabdiweli Maxamed Yuusuf oo Mareykanku ku tilmaamay madaxa maaliyadda Daacish-Soomaaliya, sidoo kalena waxay dhaawacday nidaamkii ay kooxdu u adeegsan jirtay maareynta dakhliga iyo isku dubbaridka dhaqaalaha. Sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka, Cabdiweli ayaa door ku lahaa dakhliga kooxda iyo fududeynta dhaq-dhaqaaqa lacagaha, dagaalyahannada iyo sahayda. Hawlahaas ayaa muhiim u ahaa sii wadista howlgallada Daacish iyo xiriirka ay la leedahay shabakaddeeda kale. Dhanka kale, howlgallada ka dhanka ah Daacish ee Puntland oo billowday dabayaaqadii 2024 ayaa cadaadis dheeraad ah saaray ilihii dhaqaale ee kooxda, gaar ahaan shabakadaha baadda iyo canshuuraha sharci-darrada ah ee ay ka ururin jirtay ganacsatada iyo dadka ku nool deegaannada ay saameynta ku lahayd. Machadka Africa Center for Strategic Studies ayaa qiimeeyay in tallaabooyinkan ay si weyn u wiiqeen awoodda kooxda ee dakhli-abuurka iyo fulinta howlgallada gudaha. Si kastaba, kooxda ayaan weli lumin dhammaan ilihii dhaqaale, waxaana jira fursad ay dib ugu dhisan karto qaybo ka mid ah shabakadeeda. Si kastaba, hoos u dhaca dhaqaale ee Daacishta Soomaaliya ma tilmaamayo in kooxda gebi ahaanba laga adkaaday, iyadoo xogaha soo baxaya ay muujinaya inay weli haysato dhaqaale xaddidan oo ay ku sii wadi karto howlgallo kooban, isla markaana ay ilaalin karto xiriirrada qaar ee shabakaddeeda caalamiga ah. items.title: Kadib kulan ka dhacay Villa Soomaaliya, DF oo xaqiijisay in…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay diyaar u tahay la wareegidda mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka, xilli la qorsheynayo in Ciidanka Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed ay si tartiib-tartiib ah ula wareegaan waajibaadka ay hadda hayaan ciidamada howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Arrintan ayaa looga hadlay kulan saacado qaatay oo ka dhacay Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya, kaas oo dhexmaray La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka iyo Madaxa Howlgalka AUSSOM. Wada-hadallada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda amniga dalka iyo dadaallada lagu dhisayo awoodda Ciidanka Qalabka Sida. Madaxa Howlgalka Midowga Afrika ayaa kulanka ku xaqiijiyay inay ka go’an tahay inay sii xoojiyaan wada-shaqeynta Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo ciidamada amniga dalka, kuwaas oo isu diyaarinaya inay si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga. Dhankiisa, La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka ayaa uga mahadceliyay howlgalka AUSSOM doorkii uu ka qaatay sugidda amniga Soomaaliya iyo dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab muddadii uu dalka ka howlgalayay. Howlgalka Midowga Afrika ayaa muddo ku dhow labaatan sano qayb ka ahaa dadaallada amni ee Soomaaliya, isagoo soo maray isbeddello kala duwan tan iyo markii ciidamadii Midowga Afrika ay dalka yimaadeen sanadkii 2007. Qorshaha hadda jira ayaa dhigaya in mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka si marxalado ah loogu wareejiyo Ciidanka Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed, si dowladda iyo hay’adaha amniga qaranku ay u qaataan doorka ugu weyn ee sugidda amniga. Si kastaba, howlgalka AUSSOM ayaa wajahaya caqabado la xiriira maalgelinta, xilli la dardargelinayo qorshaha kala-guurka amniga iyo diyaarinta ciidamada Soomaaliyeed si ay ula wareegaan waajibaadka ay hadda hayaan ciidamada Midowga Afrika. La wareegidda amniga ayaa ah tallaabo muhiim u ah dadaallada Soomaaliya ay ku dooneyso inay ku dhisto ciidan qaran oo awood u leh sugidda amniga dalka, inkastoo hirgelinta qorshahan ay ku xirnaan doonto awoodda ciidamada, taageerada dhaqaale iyo wada-shaqeynta dowladda iyo saaxiibbada caalamka. items.title: Can Somalia Have One Currency When It Cannot Agree on One Political System
items.description: By Abdiqani Haji Abdi Somalia is preparing to put a national currency back into the hands of its citizens at a moment when the country itself is struggling to agree on what kind of state it wants to be. There is no consensus on the electoral system, constitutional disputes remain unresolved, and relations between Mogadishu and Puntland, Jubaland and South West State remain deeply strained. Large parts of the countryside remain outside effective federal control. The government is preparing one of Somalia’s most consequential economic experiments since the collapse of the state in 1991: restoring the Somali shilling after more than three decades of an economy heavily dominated by the US dollar. The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has urged Somalia to approach the reform with caution. The Central Bank of Somalia is preparing to introduce new shilling banknotes to replace obsolete currency and remove large quantities of suspected counterfeit notes. The objective is ambitious: restore confidence in the national currency, strengthen the financial system and expand access to formal financial services. But the timing raises a fundamental question: Can a politically fragmented country successfully restore confidence in a currency whose credibility ultimately depends on the institutions of the state? No Political Settlement, No Electoral Agreement Somalia remains locked in a deep political crisis. The Federal Government and its principal political opponents have yet to reach a durable agreement on the country’s electoral system. Constitutional disagreements remain unresolved, while Puntland, Jubaland and South West State have each become deeply embroiled in disputes with Mogadishu over political authority and the future direction of federalism. The risk is that the political divide could widen further. Large rural areas remain outside effective federal government control, with Al-Shabaab maintaining influence across significant parts of the country. If the current trajectory continues, additional territories and local administrations could find themselves operating beyond the practical reach of Mogadishu. That presents a fundamental problem for monetary policy. A national currency requires more than a central bank and newly printed banknotes. It requires confidence in the institutions issuing the money and confidence that the currency will be accepted across the country. The Legitimacy Problem The Federal Government led by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud faces significant political opposition. Critics argue that the administration lacks the broad political consensus needed to undertake a reform as consequential as restoring the national currency. The currency question therefore cannot easily be separated from Somalia’s wider political crisis. If major political actors and sections of the population reject the government’s political direction, persuading citizens, businesses and regional administrations to move away from the dollar could prove extremely difficult. For decades, the dollar has filled the vacuum created by the collapse of Somalia’s formal monetary and banking institutions. It remains widely used for major transactions, savings, trade and pricing. Replacing that system will require far more than issuing new notes. The IMF’s Warning The IMF has emphasized that introducing new banknotes alone will not restore confidence in the Somali shilling. The credibility of the reform will depend on the independence and capacity of the Central Bank, adequate foreign-exchange reserves, effective monetary policy, control of inflation and strict limits on monetary financing of government spending. That final issue is particularly important. A government that cannot generate sufficient domestic revenue to finance its budget faces a dangerous temptation when it controls the machinery for issuing national currency: financing expenditure through money creation. Such a policy can rapidly undermine confidence in the currency, fuel inflation and erode household purchasing power. Currency printing is not revenue. Without adequate taxation and other sustainable sources of government income, monetary financing can turn a currency reform intended to restore confidence into a mechanism for destroying it. Somalia’s Fiscal Reality This is where Somalia’s political and economic crises intersect. The government must establish a sufficiently credible and predictable domestic revenue base before relying heavily on monetary instruments to finance public expenditure. That means strengthening taxation, customs administration, public financial management and the institutions responsible for collecting and protecting government revenue. It also means ensuring that monetary policy is not subordinated to short-term political spending. If the government attempts to introduce the shilling while facing weak fiscal capacity, limited territorial control, political opposition and unresolved disputes with federal member states, the reform could face serious credibility problems. The Dollar Will Not Disappear Overnight The IMF-backed reform does not mean the US dollar will suddenly disappear from Somalia’s economy. The dollar is expected to remain an important medium of exchange during the initial stages of the transition, particularly in private commerce and larger transactions. The challenge will be creating sufficient confidence in the shilling for people and businesses to voluntarily use it. That confidence cannot simply be imposed.It must be earned. Somalia’s currency experiment therefore carries a lesson that cannot be separated from its political crisis. A national currency ultimately depends on national institutions. If Somalia cannot reach agreement on its electoral system, constitutional order and federal political settlement, it will be difficult to convince citizens that its monetary system is stable and predictable. Puntland, Jubaland, South West State and other areas outside effective federal control cannot simply be assumed to function as a single monetary market because Mogadishu introduces new banknotes. And where Al-Shabaab controls territory or exercises substantial influence, the reach of the Central Bank and federal financial institutions is inevitably constrained. The danger is not that introducing a Somali currency is inherently wrong. The danger is attempting to impose monetary unity before Somalia has achieved sufficient political and fiscal unity to sustain it. The Somali shilling can become a symbol of national recovery—but only if the institutions behind it are credible, the Central Bank is sufficiently independent, government revenue is strong enough to finance expenditure and citizens believe their money will retain its value. Otherwise, a reform intended to restore monetary sovereignty could expose the country to another crisis of confidence. Somalia does not merely need a new currency. It needs the political legitimacy, fiscal discipline and institutional credibility required to make that currency worth trusting. The Dollar Will Not Disappear Overnight The IMF-backed reform does not mean the US dollar will suddenly disappear from Somalia’s economy. The dollar is expected to remain an important medium of exchange during the initial stages of the transition, particularly in private commerce and larger transactions. The challenge will be creating sufficient confidence in the shilling for people and businesses to voluntarily use it. That confidence cannot simply be imposed.It must be earned. Somalia’s currency experiment therefore carries a lesson that cannot be separated from its political crisis. A national currency ultimately depends on national institutions. If Somalia cannot reach agreement on its electoral system, constitutional order and federal political settlement, it will be difficult to convince citizens that its monetary system is stable and predictable. Puntland, Jubaland, South West State and other areas outside effective federal control cannot simply be assumed to function as a single monetary market because Mogadishu introduces new banknotes. And where Al-Shabaab controls territory or exercises substantial influence, the reach of the Central Bank and federal financial institutions is inevitably constrained. The danger is not that introducing a Somali currency is inherently wrong. The danger is attempting to impose monetary unity before Somalia has achieved sufficient political and fiscal unity to sustain it. The Somali shilling can become a symbol of national recovery—but only if the institutions behind it are credible, the Central Bank is sufficiently independent, government revenue is strong enough to finance expenditure and citizens believe their money will retain its value. Otherwise, a reform intended to restore monetary sovereignty could expose the country to another crisis of confidence. Somalia does not merely need a new currency. It needs the political legitimacy, fiscal discipline and institutional credibility required to make that currency worth trusting.
