items.title: Soomaaliya oo si rasmi ah ugu biiraysa nidaamka caalamiga ah ee BSP
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Soomaaliya ayaa qaaday tallaabo cusub oo la xiriirta casriyeynta adeegyada duulista rayidka, iyadoo magaalada Muqdisho lagu qabanayo munaasabad lagu daahfurayo ku biirista dalka ee nidaamka caalamiga ah ee iibinta tigidhada diyaaradaha iyo dejinta lacagahooda. Nidaamkan oo loo yaqaan BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) waxaa maamula Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Gaadiidka Cirka (IATA), wuxuuna fududeeyaa habraacyada la xiriira iibinta tigidhada iyo dejinta lacagaha u dhexeeya wakaaladaha safarka iyo shirkadaha diyaaradaha. Maareeyaha Guud ee Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed (SCAA), Axmed Macallin Xasan ayaa sheegay in hirgelinta nidaamkan ay dalka u abuuri karto fursado cusub oo la xiriira koboca dhaqaalaha, shaqo-abuurka iyo soo jiidashada maalgashiga. Sida uu sheegay, ku biirista BSP waxay sidoo kale gacan ka geysan kartaa horumarinta adeegyada duulista rayidka, iyadoo la fududeynayo hababka ganacsi ee ay adeegsadaan shirkadaha diyaaradaha iyo wakaaladaha tigidhada. Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada ayaa qaabilsan isku-dubaridka iyo kormeerka nidaamka, si loo hubiyo in hirgelintiisu waafaqsan tahay shuruucda dalka iyo heerarka caalamiga ah ee duulista. Waxaa sidoo kale la filayaa in nidaamku xoojiyo xiriirka iyo wada-shaqeynta shirkadaha diyaaradaha, hay’adaha duulista iyo IATA, taas oo qayb ka noqon karta dadaallada Soomaaliya ay ku doonayso inay ku ballaariso ka-qaybgalkeeda suuqa duulista caalamiga ah. Ku biirista BSP ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli dowladda Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu casriyeynayo kaabayaasha iyo adeegyada duulista rayidka, isla markaana lagu horumarinayo jawiga ganacsi ee ay ka shaqeeyaan shirkadaha diyaaradaha. Hirgelinta nidaamkan ayaa la filayaa inay Soomaaliya u furto fursado dheeraad ah oo dhinaca adeegyada tigidhada iyo wada-shaqeynta shirkadaha diyaaradaha ah, inkastoo faa’iidooyinka laga helayo ay ku xirnaan doonaan sida nidaamka loo hirgeliyo iyo awoodda hay’adaha ay khusayso. The post Soomaaliya oo si rasmi ah ugu biiraysa nidaamka caalamiga ah ee BSP appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Taliyaha Booliiska Gobolka Gedo oo Sheegay in Ciidamada Jubbaland Si Nabad ah Ku Galeen Beledxaawo
items.description: Taliyaha Qaybta Booliiska Gobolka Gedo, Korneyl Diyaad Cabdi Khaliil, ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Daraawiishta Maamulka Jubbaland ay si nabad ah ku galeen magaalada Beledxaawo, isla markaana aysan jirin wax dagaal ah oo ay magaalada kula galeen ciidamo kale. Taliyaha ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Jubbaland ay degeen goobihii horay loogu qorsheeyay, isagoo xusay in soo gelitaankoodu uusan ku imaan dagaal ama iska horimaad. Wuxuu sidoo kale tilmaamay in ciidamada ay soo dhoweeyeen qaar ka mid ah dadka deegaanka iyo saraakiisha ku sugan magaalada. Korneyl Diyaad Cabdi Khaliil oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa beeniyay wararka sheegaya in ciidamada Jubbaland ay xoog kula wareegeen magaalada Beledxaawo ama ay la wareegeen qaybo ka mid ah magaalada. Wuxuu caddeeyay in magaalada ay weli ku sugan yihiin ciidamada Jubbaland iyo ciidamada dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay muhiim tahay in labada dhinac ay iska kaashadaan sugidda amniga iyo xasilloonida magaalada Beledxaawo iyo guud ahaan gobolka Gedo. Taliyaha ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay wada shaqeynta ciidamada kala duwan ee ku sugan deegaanka, si looga hortago wax kasta oo keeni kara khalkhal amni, loona ilaaliyo badqabka shacabka. Hadalkan ayaa imaanaya iyadoo ay jireen warar kala duwan oo ku saabsan dhaqdhaqaaqa ciidamada Jubbaland ee magaalada Beledxaawo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, sida uu sheegay taliyaha booliiska gobolka, ciidamada Jubbaland waxay magaalada ku galeen si nabad ah, mana jirin dagaal dhacay intii ay halkaas soo gelayeen.

items.title: Mekelle Oo Weli Aan Lahayn Maamul Rayid Ah Oo Shaqeynaya Kaddib La Wareegiddii Ciidamada Dowladda Itoobiya
items.description: Magaalada Mekelle, oo ah caasimadda gobolka Tigray ee waqooyiga Itoobiya, ayaa weli ka maqan maamul rayid ah oo si buuxda u shaqeynaya, maalmo kaddib markii ciidamada taageersan dowladda Itoobiya ay la wareegeen magaalada. Xafiisyada dowladda, saldhigyada booliska iyo xarunta duqa magaalada ayaa xirnaa Khamiistii, iyadoo aan weli la shaacin maamul ku-meel-gaar ah oo la wareega howlaha maamulka iyo adeegyada dadweynaha. Xirnaanshaha hay’adaha dowladda ayaa muujinaya in la wareegidda magaalada aysan weli horseedin dib u soo celinta nidaamkii maamulka rayidka iyo adeegyada aasaasiga ah. Inkastoo ciidamada Tigray Peace Force ay magaalada ka dhaqan geliyeen bandow habeenkii ah, haddana weli ma cadda cidda si rasmi ah u maamuli doonta Mekelle iyo waqtiga dib loo bilaabi doono howlaha hay’adaha dowladda. Xaaladdan ayaa walaac ku abuurtay shacabka iyo ganacsatada magaalada, iyadoo ganacsiyo badan ay weli xiran yihiin sababo la xiriira cabsi laga qabo dhac iyo bililiqo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qaar ka mid ah maqaayadaha, dukaamada raashinka iyo goobaha ganacsiga yaryar ayaa dib u furmay, inkastoo dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsi uusan weli ku soo noqon heerkiisii caadiga ahaa. Dhanka kale, waxaa dib loo furay waddada koonfureed ee isku xirta Mekelle iyo caasimadda Addis Ababa. Dib u furitaanka waddadan ayaa suurageliyey in shidaal iyo sahay kale oo muhiim ah ay magaalada soo gaaraan, kaddib markii isku dhacyadii hubeysnaa ay hakad geliyeen isu socodka iyo gaadiidka badeecadaha. Hubanti la’aan amni iyo mid maamul ayaa sidoo kale laga soo sheegay magaalada Shire ee gobolka Tigray. Laba qof oo deegaanka ah ayaa wakaaladda wararka Associated Press (AP) u sheegay inay arkeen xoogagga Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray (TPLF) oo magaalada ka baxaya. Xaaladdaasi waxay sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo amniga shacabka, iyadoo ganacsato badan ay albaabada u laabeen goobahooda ganacsi, halka qaar kalena ay badeecadahooda u wareejiyeen meelo kale si ay uga badbaadiyaan bililiqo. Maqnaanshaha maamul rayid ah oo shaqeynaya iyo hubanti la’aanta amni ayaa khatar ku ah dadka rayidka ah, gaar ahaan qoysaska horey ugu barakacay dagaalladii gobolka ka dhacay. Mekelle ayaa sidoo kale ah xarun muhiim u ah howlaha hay’adaha gargaarka bani’aadannimo, kuwaas oo taageera dadka ay saameeyeen colaadaha iyo xaaladaha nololeed ee adag. Dib u soo celinta amniga, howlaha booliska, maamulka rayidka iyo adeegyada aasaasiga ah ayaa muhiim u ah sidii looga hortagi lahaa bililiqada, loo ilaalin lahaa shacabka, loona fududeyn lahaa gaarsiinta gargaarka dadka u baahan. Ilaa hadda, ma jiro war rasmi ah oo caddeynaya goorta maamul rayid ah oo shaqeynaya laga hirgelin doono Mekelle ama sida loo maareyn doono xaaladda amni ee magaalada Shire. Xaaladda labada magaalo ayaa weli u baahan in si dhow loola socdo, iyadoo shacabka ay sugayaan dib u soo celinta adeegyada dowladda iyo xasilloonida nolol maalmeedkooda.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee dagaalka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Xiisadda u dhexeysa Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa gaartay heer cusub oo halis ah, kadib markii diyaaradaha dagaalka ee aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Itoobiya la rumeysan yahay inay duqeymo ku qaadeen ciidamo Eritrean ah oo gudaha u galay gobolka Tigray, xilli ay sii kordhayaan walaaca laga qabo in labada dal ay galaan dagaal toos ah. Duqeymahan ayaa lagu beegsaday gaadiid militari oo ay la socdeen ciidamo Eritrean ah, kuwaas oo ka soo baxayay fariisimo ku yaalla agagaarka magaalada Adigrat, sida ay sheegtay hay’adda dabagalka colaadaha ee ACLED oo fadhigeedu yahay Mareykanka. Ciidamada Eritrea ayaa Arbacadii ka soo gudbay xadka labada dal, iyagoo tobannaan kiiloomitir gudaha u galay gobolka Tigray, balse waxay markii dambe bilaabeen inay dib ugu laabtaan dhanka waqooyi, xilli ay wajahayeen duqeymo xooggan. Goobjoogayaal ayaa Arbacadii sheegay inay arkeen ciidamo Eritrean ah oo gaadiid waaweyn lagu daabulayo, kuwaas oo marayay magaalada Adigrat, oo qiyaastii 25 kiiloomitir gudaha uga jirta xadka Itoobiya. Tani waxay noqotay xaqiijintii ugu horreysay ee joogitaanka ciidamada Eritrea ee waqooyiga Itoobiya, tan iyo markii bishii hore ay dagaallo culus ka dhex qarxeen ciidamada dowladda federaalka Itoobiya iyo isbaheysi kooxo hubeysan ah oo kasoo horjeeda xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed. Duqeymo culus iyo dib u gurasho Hay’adda ACLED ayaa sheegtay in duqeymaha lagu beegsaday gaadiid ay saarnaayeen ciidamo iyo saanad militari, xilli ciidamada Eritrea ay ka baxayeen deegaanno ay hore u gaareen. Laba ilo-wareed oo kala ah diblomaasi iyo khabiir dhinaca colaadaha ah, kuwaas oo xiriir la leh labada dhinac, ayaa wakaaladda Reuters u sheegay inay heleen warar muujinaya in ciidamada Eritrea ay dib ugu dhaqaaqeen waqooyiga, kadib duqeymo xooggan oo ay fuliyeen diyaaradaha Itoobiya. Hase yeeshee, weli ma cadda in ciidamadaasi ay gebi ahaanba ka baxayaan dhulka Itoobiya iyo in ay dib uga abaabulanayaan goobo kale oo gudaha dalkaas ah. Mid ka mid ah dadka deggan magaalada Adigrat ayaa sheegay inuu habeenkii maqlay saddex qarax oo xooggan oo ka dhacay dhanka waqooyi ee magaalada. Sarkaal sare oo Itoobiyaan ah, oo codsaday inaan magaciisa la shaacin, ayaa sheegay in Eritrea ay gobolka Tigray ku leedahay hal guuto oo gaadiidka gaashaaman ah iyo saddex guuto oo ciidanka lugta ah, kuwaas oo mid kasta lagu qiyaasay 1,500 oo askari. Hase yeeshee, Reuters ayaa sheegtay inaysan si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin tirada iyo xogta ku saabsan ciidamadaas. Itoobiya oo is-difaac ballan-qaaday Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa Khamiistii si rasmi ah ugu baaqday Eritrea inay ciidamadeeda kala baxdo dhulkeeda, iyadoo ku adkeysatay inay xaq u leedahay difaaca madax-bannaanideeda iyo midnimada dhuleed. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya, Gedion Timothewos, ayaa dalabkaas hor dhigay ku-xigeenka Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, Amina J. Mohammed, oo uu kulan la yeeshay Khamiistii. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya ayaa sheegtay in wasiirku uu dalbaday in si degdeg ah ciidamada Eritrea looga saaro dhulka Itoobiya, isla markaana uu caddeeyay xaqa dalkiisu u leeyahay inuu difaaco madax-bannaanidiisa iyo xuduudihiisa, si waafaqsan sharciga caalamiga ah. Dhanka kale, Eritrea ayaa ku gacan seyrtay eedeymaha Itoobiya, iyadoo ku tilmaantay qayb ka mid ah qorshe ay Addis Ababa ku doonayso inay ku sharciyeyso dagaal ka dhan ah dalkeeda. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Eritrea, Yemane Gebremeskel, ayaa Arbacadii sheegay in wararka ku saabsan ciidamada Eritrea ee gudaha Itoobiya ay qayb ka yihiin qorshe lagu abuurayo marmarsiiyo dagaal. Labada dal ayaa toddobaadkii hore jaray xiriirkoodii diblomaasiyadeed, kadib markii Itoobiya ay Eritrea ku eedeysay inay taageerto kooxaha hubeysan ee la dagaallamaya dowladdeeda. Asmara ayaa marar badan beenisay eedeymahaas. Muranka Badda Cas iyo cabsi dagaal Xiisadda labada dal ayaa si weyn u sii xoogeysatay bilihii u dambeeyay, iyadoo Eritrea ay Itoobiya ku eedeysay inay qorsheyneyso duullaan militari oo lagu qabsado qayb ka mid ah xeebteeda Badda Cas. Eritrea ayaa walaaceeda sal uga dhigaysa hadallada soo noqnoqday ee Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed, kaas oo sheegay in helitaanka marin badeed uu muhiim u yahay amniga iyo dhaqaalaha Itoobiya. Abiy ayaa ku adkeysanaya in dowladdiisu ay marin badeed ku raadineyso waddo nabadeed, balse hadalladiisa ayaa walaac xooggan ka abuuray Eritrea, gaar ahaan suurtagalnimada in Itoobiya ay isku daydo inay gacanta ku dhigto dekedda Casab. Dagaallada bishii hore dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya ayaa noqday kuwii ugu xoogga badnaa tan iyo markii uu dhammaaday dagaalkii sokeeye ee Tigray ee socday intii u dhexeysay 2020 iyo 2022. items.fullContent: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Xiisadda u dhexeysa Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa gaartay heer cusub oo halis ah, kadib markii diyaaradaha dagaalka ee aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Itoobiya la rumeysan yahay inay duqeymo ku qaadeen ciidamo Eritrean ah oo gudaha u galay gobolka Tigray, xilli ay sii kordhayaan walaaca laga qabo in labada dal ay galaan dagaal toos ah. Duqeymahan ayaa lagu beegsaday gaadiid militari oo ay la socdeen ciidamo Eritrean ah, kuwaas oo ka soo baxayay fariisimo ku yaalla agagaarka magaalada Adigrat, sida ay sheegtay hay’adda dabagalka colaadaha ee ACLED oo fadhigeedu yahay Mareykanka. Ciidamada Eritrea ayaa Arbacadii ka soo gudbay xadka labada dal, iyagoo tobannaan kiiloomitir gudaha u galay gobolka Tigray, balse waxay markii dambe bilaabeen inay dib ugu laabtaan dhanka waqooyi, xilli ay wajahayeen duqeymo xooggan. Goobjoogayaal ayaa Arbacadii sheegay inay arkeen ciidamo Eritrean ah oo gaadiid waaweyn lagu daabulayo, kuwaas oo marayay magaalada Adigrat, oo qiyaastii 25 kiiloomitir gudaha uga jirta xadka Itoobiya. Tani waxay noqotay xaqiijintii ugu horreysay ee joogitaanka ciidamada Eritrea ee waqooyiga Itoobiya, tan iyo markii bishii hore ay dagaallo culus ka dhex qarxeen ciidamada dowladda federaalka Itoobiya iyo isbaheysi kooxo hubeysan ah oo kasoo horjeeda xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed. Duqeymo culus iyo dib u gurasho Hay’adda ACLED ayaa sheegtay in duqeymaha lagu beegsaday gaadiid ay saarnaayeen ciidamo iyo saanad militari, xilli ciidamada Eritrea ay ka baxayeen deegaanno ay hore u gaareen. Laba ilo-wareed oo kala ah diblomaasi iyo khabiir dhinaca colaadaha ah, kuwaas oo xiriir la leh labada dhinac, ayaa wakaaladda Reuters u sheegay inay heleen warar muujinaya in ciidamada Eritrea ay dib ugu dhaqaaqeen waqooyiga, kadib duqeymo xooggan oo ay fuliyeen diyaaradaha Itoobiya. Hase yeeshee, weli ma cadda in ciidamadaasi ay gebi ahaanba ka baxayaan dhulka Itoobiya iyo in ay dib uga abaabulanayaan goobo kale oo gudaha dalkaas ah. Itoobiya oo is-difaac ballan-qaaday Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa Khamiistii si rasmi ah ugu baaqday Eritrea inay ciidamadeeda kala baxdo dhulkeeda, iyadoo ku adkeysatay inay xaq u leedahay difaaca madax-bannaanideeda iyo midnimada dhuleed. items.title: Eboluhu Xuduud Siyaasaddeed Ma Leh: Baahida Qorshe iyo Mudnaanta Badbaadada Bulshada
items.description: Muqdisho (WDN)- Xaqiijinta kiiskii ugu horreeyay ee cudurka Ebola ee Kenya ayaa walaac hor leh ka abuuray Geeska Afrika, iyadoo ay soo baxday baahida degdegga ah ee loo qabo in hay’adaha caafimaadka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dowlad-goboleedyadu ay qprshe meel iska dhigaan, isla markaana si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan ka hortagga faafitaanka cudurkan halista ah. Wasiirka Caafimaadka Kenya, Aadan Barre Ducaale, ayaa xaqiijiyay in bukaankii laga helay cudurka Ebola uu geeriyooday. Arrintan ayaa sii kordhisay walaaca gobolka, xilli cudurka Ebola uu weli khatar caafimaad oo weyn ka yahay qaybo ka mid ah  dalka Congo, iyadoo sidoo kale kiisas laga soo sheegay dalalka deriska ah oo ay ka mid yihiin Uganda iyo Rwanda. Dhanka Soomaaliya, fariintu waa inay noqotaa mid cad: Ebolu-hu ma aqoonsana xuduudaha siyaasaddeed, maamul-goboleedyada ama khilaafaadka dastuuriga ah. Fayrasku ma kala sooco Muqdisho, Garoowe, Kismaayo, Baydhabo ama meel kale oo Soomaaliya ka mid ah. Xaqiiqadan ayaa ka dhigaysa iskaashiga dhow ee u dhexeeya Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo wasaaradaha caafimaadka dowlad-goboleedyada xubnaha ka ah Federaalka mid aan ahayn oo keliya wax la doonayo, balse ah lama huraan. Dowladda Federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyadu waxay ku kala aragti duwanaan karaan siyaasadda, maamulka iyo qaybsiga awoodaha, balse cudurrada faafa waxay u baahan yihiin hannaan ka duwan. Marka cudur si fudud u kala qaadi kara oo halis ku ah nolosha dadka uu soo baxo, khilaafaadka siyaasaddeed waa in si ku-meel-gaar ah loo meel dhigaa, iyadoo mudnaanta la siinayo tallaabo caafimaad oo wadajir ah. Khatar Caafimaad oo Qaran Waxay u Baahan Tahay Jawaab Qaran Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto xaaladda Ebola, isla markaana ay qaaday tallaabooyin taxaddar ah oo lagu xoojinayo diyaar-garowga dalka. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Puntland ayaa iyaduna sheegtay inay xoojisay diyaar-garowga Ebola kaddib markii Kenya ay xaqiijisay kiiskeedii ugu horreeyay. Puntland waxay sheegtay in ilaa hadda aan laga xaqiijin wax kiis Ebola ah, iyadoo carrabka ku adkaysay inay si dhow ula socoto xaaladda ka jirta dalalka deriska ah iyo guud ahaan gobolka. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay inay xoojinayso diyaar-garowga, ogaanshaha hore iyo qorshe jawaabta degdegga ah, si loo kordhiyo awoodda Puntland ee ka hortagga iyo xakamaynta cudurrada faafa. Tallaabooyinkaas waa muhiim, balse diyaar-garowga Ebola kuma ekaan karo hal maamul oo keliya. Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay nidaam qaran oo isku-xiran oo lagu ilaaliyo caafimaadka bulshada laguna wajaho cudurrada faafa, kaas oo isku xiraya Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Federaalka iyo wasaaradaha caafimaadka Puntland, Jubaland, Koonfur Galbeed, Galmudug, Waqooyi Bari iyo Hirshabeelle. Iskaashigaas waa inuu ka koobnaadaa is-dhaafsiga xogta, la socodka cudurrada, baaritaannada shaybaarrada, baaritaannada xuduudaha iyo garoomada diyaaradaha marka loo baahdo, tababarka shaqaalaha caafimaadka, diyaar-garowga xaaladaha degdegga ah, wacyigelinta bulshada iyo habab degdeg ah oo dadka looga shakiyo cudurka loogu gudbin karo xarumaha loo asteeyay daaweynta iyo karantiilka. Khatartu waa mid aad u weyn. Ebolaha waxaa keena fayraska Ebola, wuxuuna qofka ugu gudbi karaa taabasho toos ah oo lala sameeyo dhiigga ama dheecaannada jirka qof qaba cudurka, gaar ahaan marka qofka uu leeyahay calaamadaha cudurka. Calaamaduhu waxay soo bixi karaan laba ilaa 21 maalmood kaddib marka qofku la kulmo fayraska, waxaana ka mid noqon kara qandho, tabar-darro daran, murqo-xanuun, madax-xanuun, matag, shuban iyo calool-xanuun. Xaaladaha daran, cudurku wuxuu sababi karaa dhiig-bax gudaha ah, xubnaha jirka oo shaqadooda gabaya iyo dhimasho. Soomaaliya ma awooddo kala-qaybsanaan hay’adeed Juqraafi ahaan, Soomaaliya waxay ku taallaa meel ka dhigaysa feejignaanta mid si gaar ah muhiim u ah. Dalka wuxuu xiriir ballaaran la leeyahay dalalka deriska ah, iyadoo ay jiraan ganacsi, socdaal, tahriib, isu-socod iyo xiriirro qoys. Sidaas darteed, cudur ka dillaaca gobolka wuxuu si toos ah ama si dadban u saameyn karaa Soomaaliya. Tani waa sababta kala-qaybsanaanta hay’adaha ay u noqon karto khatar. Haddii hay’adaha caafimaadka Federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyadu si kala gooni ah u shaqeeyaan, xogtu ay si gaabis ah isu dhaafsato, ama khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ay carqaladeeyaan isku-duwidda xaaladaha degdegga ah, waxaa lumin kara waqti qaali ah xilliyada ugu horreeya ee uu cudurku dillaaco. Taasi waa wax aan la aqbali karin. Eboluhu ma aha arrin federaal, arrin Puntland, arrin Jubaland ama arrin siyaasaddeed. Waa xaalad caafimaad oo degdeg ah oo halis ku ah qof kasta oo Soomaali ah. Sidaas darteed, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Federaalka iyo wasaaradaha caafimaadka dowlad-gobolleedyadu waa inay dhisaan ama xoojiyaan hannaan joogto ah oo lagu wada shaqeeyo, kaas oo diiradda saaraya cudurrada faafa ee soo ifbaxaya. Hannaankaasi waa inuu shaqeeyaa iyadoon loo eegin khilaafaadka siyaasaddeed ee u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo dowlad-gobolleedyada. Isla mabda’aas waa inuu khuseeyaa bah-wadaagta caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya ka taageerta dhinaca caafimaadka. Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO), UNICEF, hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay iyo hay’adaha kale ee bani’aadannimo iyo horumarinta waa inay taageeraan hannaan qaran oo mideysan oo loogu diyaar-garoobo cudurrada faafa, iyagoo si toos ah ula shaqeynaya hay’adaha mas’uulka ka ah bixinta adeegyada caafimaadka ee gudaha dalka. Puntland oo Bulshada ugu Baaqday Feejignaan Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Puntland ayaa shacabka ugu baaqday inay si degdeg ah u raadsadaan daryeel caafimaad haddii ay isku arkaan calaamado ay ka mid yihiin qandho, daal daran, madax-xanuun, murqo-xanuun, matag, shuban ama dhiig-bax aan caadi ahayn, gaar ahaan haddii ay dhawaan u safreen goob uu cudurka Ebola ka jiro. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay inay la shaqaynayso hay’adaha dowladda ee u xilsaaran maaraynta khataraha caafimaad iyo bah-wadaagta caafimaadka, si loo xoojiyo awoodda Puntland ee ka hortagga, ogaanshaha iyo ka jawaabidda cudurrada faafa iyo xaaladaha caafimaad ee degdegga ah, oo uu ka mid yahay Ebola. Habkan waa in lagu dabaqaa dhammaan Soomaaliya. Wacyigelinta bulshada ayaa sidoo kale muhiimad gaar ah leh. Bulshada waa in la siiyaa macluumaad cad oo sax ah oo ku saabsan sida Ebola u faafo, calaamadaha laga feejignaado iyo meelaha lagu wargelinayo haddii laga shakiyo qof qaba cudurka. Isla markaana, hay’adaha caafimaadku waa inay ka hortagaan wararka aan salka lahayn, faquuqa bukaannada iyo cabsi aan loo baahnayn oo bulshada ku dhex faafa. Baahida qorshe loo dhan yahay oo lagaga hortego cudurka Ebola Soomaaliya kama maaranto khilaafaadka siyaasaddeed. Dowladda Federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada xubnaha ka ah Federaalka ayaa marar badan ku kala aragti duwan awooddaha dastuuriga ah, doorashooyinka, amniga iyo qaybsiga awooddaha. Balse dillaaca cudur faafa waa caqabad gebi ahaanba ka duwan khilaafaadka siyaasadeed. Fayrasku ma gorgortamo. Ma sugo in wada-hadallada siyaasadeed la soo gabagabeeyo. Mana ixtiraamo xuduudaha dastuuriga ah. Haddii Ebola uu gaaro Soomaaliya, cawaaqibka ka dhalan kara loollanka hay’adaha waxaa lagu cabbiri karaa, ma aha cinwaannada siyaasadeed, balse nolosha dadka Soomaaliyeed. Xaqiijinta kiiska Ebola ee Kenya waa inay Soomaaliya u noqotaa digniin hore, balse aysan noqon sabab keenta cabsi iyo argagax. Soomaaliya weli waxay haysataa fursad ay ku xoojiso la socodka cudurrada, diyaar-garowga iyo isku-duwidda ka hor inta uusan cudurku soo gaarin xuduudaheeda. Dowladda Federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyadu waa inay fursaddan ka faa’iidaystaan. Iyadoo aan loo eegin khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee jira, hay’adaha caafimaadka Soomaaliya waxay wadaagaan hal mas’uuliyad oo aasaasi ah: ilaalinta nolosha iyo caafimaadka shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Marka laga hadlayo Ebola, waa inaysan jirin kala-qaybsanaan federaal iyo dowlad-goboleed, xisaab siyaasadeed ama loollan hay’adeed. Waa inay jirtaa hal ujeeddo oo caafimaad: in cudurka si hore loo ogaado, si degdeg ah loo xakameeyo, lagana hortago inuu sii faafo. Calaamaduhu waxay soo bixi karaan laba ilaa 21 maalmood kaddib marka qofku la kulmo fayraska, waxaana ka mid noqon kara qandho, tabar-darro daran, murqo-xanuun, madax-xanuun, matag, shuban iyo calool-xanuun. Xaaladaha daran, cudurku wuxuu sababi karaa dhiig-bax gudaha ah, xubnaha jirka oo shaqadooda gabaya iyo dhimasho. Soomaaliya ma awooddo kala-qaybsanaan hay’adeed Juqraafi ahaan, Soomaaliya waxay ku taallaa meel ka dhigaysa feejignaanta mid si gaar ah muhiim u ah. Dalka wuxuu xiriir ballaaran la leeyahay dalalka deriska ah, iyadoo ay jiraan ganacsi, socdaal, tahriib, isu-socod iyo xiriirro qoys. Sidaas darteed, cudur ka dillaaca gobolka wuxuu si toos ah ama si dadban u saameyn karaa Soomaaliya. Tani waa sababta kala-qaybsanaanta hay’adaha ay u noqon karto khatar. Haddii hay’adaha caafimaadka Federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyadu si kala gooni ah u shaqeeyaan, xogtu ay si gaabis ah isu dhaafsato, ama khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ay carqaladeeyaan isku-duwidda xaaladaha degdegga ah, waxaa lumin kara waqti qaali ah xilliyada ugu horreeya ee uu cudurku dillaaco. Taasi waa wax aan la aqbali karin. Eboluhu ma aha arrin federaal, arrin Puntland, arrin Jubaland ama arrin siyaasaddeed. Waa xaalad caafimaad oo degdeg ah oo halis ku ah qof kasta oo Soomaali ah. Sidaas darteed, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Federaalka iyo wasaaradaha caafimaadka dowlad-gobolleedyadu waa inay dhisaan ama xoojiyaan hannaan joogto ah oo lagu wada shaqeeyo, kaas oo diiradda saaraya cudurrada faafa ee soo ifbaxaya. Hannaankaasi waa inuu shaqeeyaa iyadoon loo eegin khilaafaadka siyaasaddeed ee u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo dowlad-gobolleedyada. Isla mabda’aas waa inuu khuseeyaa bah-wadaagta caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya ka taageerta dhinaca caafimaadka. Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO), UNICEF, hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay iyo hay’adaha kale ee bani’aadannimo iyo horumarinta waa inay taageeraan hannaan qaran oo mideysan oo loogu diyaar-garoobo cudurrada faafa, iyagoo si toos ah ula shaqeynaya hay’adaha mas’uulka ka ah bixinta adeegyada caafimaadka ee gudaha dalka. Puntland oo Bulshada ugu Baaqday Feejignaan Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Puntland ayaa shacabka ugu baaqday inay si degdeg ah u raadsadaan daryeel caafimaad haddii ay isku arkaan calaamado ay ka mid yihiin qandho, daal daran, madax-xanuun, murqo-xanuun, matag, shuban ama dhiig-bax aan caadi ahayn, gaar ahaan haddii ay dhawaan u safreen goob uu cudurka Ebola ka jiro. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay inay la shaqaynayso hay’adaha dowladda ee u xilsaaran maaraynta khataraha caafimaad iyo bah-wadaagta caafimaadka, si loo xoojiyo awoodda Puntland ee ka hortagga, ogaanshaha iyo ka jawaabidda cudurrada faafa iyo xaaladaha caafimaad ee degdegga ah, oo uu ka mid yahay Ebola. Habkan waa in lagu dabaqaa dhammaan Soomaaliya. Wacyigelinta bulshada ayaa sidoo kale muhiimad gaar ah leh. Bulshada waa in la siiyaa macluumaad cad oo sax ah oo ku saabsan sida Ebola u faafo, calaamadaha laga feejignaado iyo meelaha lagu wargelinayo haddii laga shakiyo qof qaba cudurka. Isla markaana, hay’adaha caafimaadku waa inay ka hortagaan wararka aan salka lahayn, faquuqa bukaannada iyo cabsi aan loo baahnayn oo bulshada ku dhex faafa. Baahida qorshe loo dhan yahay oo lagaga hortego cudurka Ebola Soomaaliya kama maaranto khilaafaadka siyaasaddeed. Dowladda Federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada xubnaha ka ah Federaalka ayaa marar badan ku kala aragti duwan awooddaha dastuuriga ah, doorashooyinka, amniga iyo qaybsiga awooddaha. Balse dillaaca cudur faafa waa caqabad gebi ahaanba ka duwan khilaafaadka siyaasadeed. Fayrasku ma gorgortamo. Ma sugo in wada-hadallada siyaasadeed la soo gabagabeeyo. Mana ixtiraamo xuduudaha dastuuriga ah. Haddii Ebola uu gaaro Soomaaliya, cawaaqibka ka dhalan kara loollanka hay’adaha waxaa lagu cabbiri karaa, ma aha cinwaannada siyaasadeed, balse nolosha dadka Soomaaliyeed. Xaqiijinta kiiska Ebola ee Kenya waa inay Soomaaliya u noqotaa digniin hore, balse aysan noqon sabab keenta cabsi iyo argagax. Soomaaliya weli waxay haysataa fursad ay ku xoojiso la socodka cudurrada, diyaar-garowga iyo isku-duwidda ka hor inta uusan cudurku soo gaarin xuduudaheeda. Dowladda Federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyadu waa inay fursaddan ka faa’iidaystaan. Iyadoo aan loo eegin khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee jira, hay’adaha caafimaadka Soomaaliya waxay wadaagaan hal mas’uuliyad oo aasaasi ah: ilaalinta nolosha iyo caafimaadka shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Marka laga hadlayo Ebola, waa inaysan jirin kala-qaybsanaan federaal iyo dowlad-goboleed, xisaab siyaasadeed ama loollan hay’adeed. Waa inay jirtaa hal ujeeddo oo caafimaad: in cudurka si hore loo ogaado, si degdeg ah loo xakameeyo, lagana hortago inuu sii faafo. items.title: The Growing Exodus of Israelis Emigrating Abroad
items.description: TEL AVIV (WDN) — Israel is confronting a striking shift in population movement: nearly 270,000 Israeli citizens were outside the country for at least three consecutive months between 2023 and 2025, according to a study by researchers at Tel Aviv University using data from Israel’s Central Bureau of Statistics. The figure—268,509 people—has intensified concern over whether Israel is experiencing a temporary wave of overseas migration or the beginnings of a more lasting demographic and economic problem. The number is substantially higher than the levels recorded in the previous decade. Between 2010 and 2019, an average of about 60,000 Israelis a year were absent from the country for extended periods. Between 2023 and 2025, the annual average rose to almost 90,000. The numbers were relatively consistent across the three years: about 86,509 in 2023, 91,499 in 2024 and 90,922 in 2025. But the most consequential feature of the trend may not be the size of the exodus. It is who is leaving. Young and Highly Educated Israeli parliamentary research indicates that those leaving or remaining abroad for extended periods include a disproportionate number of young adults, university graduates and highly skilled professionals. In 2023, the average age of an Israeli emigrant was approximately 32.5 years, with almost half between the ages of 20 and 44. The group therefore includes a large share of people in their prime working years. Researchers have also identified doctors, engineers, PhD holders and other high-income professionals among those leaving Israel. That has raised fears of a “brain drain”—the loss of precisely the people Israel relies upon to sustain its health system, technology sector, universities and wider economy. The concern is no longer theoretical. In 2024, approximately 530 doctors left Israel, nearly two-thirds of whom had been trained in Israel, according to parliamentary data. At the same time, the number of Israeli doctors returning from abroad has declined. Among university students, the warning signs are equally striking. Israel’s National Union of Students has reported that 33% of students surveyed said they wanted to leave the country after completing their studies, citing the high cost of living and difficulty finding affordable housing among their concerns. War, Security and the Cost of Living The reasons behind the movement are complex. The security environment has become a major factor since the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack and the wars and regional confrontations that followed. For some Israelis, prolonged military conflict and uncertainty have strengthened the attraction of living abroad. Political tensions inside Israel have also contributed to uncertainty for some citizens, while economic pressures—including expensive housing and a high cost of living—have added another incentive to consider leaving. The Tel Aviv University research suggests that those spending extended periods abroad tend to have higher levels of education and income than the population as a whole. That makes the trend potentially more consequential than ordinary temporary travel. A Country Built Around Immigration Faces the Opposite Problem The development is particularly striking because Israel has long encouraged Jewish immigration from around the world through Aliyah, the policy of encouraging Jews to move to Israel. But Israel is now facing the opposite phenomenon: increasing numbers of its own citizens are spending extended periods abroad, while fewer are returning. Knesset research indicates that Israel lost roughly 140,000 citizens on a net basis between 2022 and 2024, when departures were compared with returning Israelis. In 2024, only about 18,800 Israelis returned, one of the lowest figures in recent years. In 2025, the number of returning Israelis was reported at about 4,483, compared with 10,903 in 2009—a decline of roughly 58%. The Taub Center has also reported that Israel experienced negative net migration in 2024, with departures exceeding arrivals by approximately 26,000 people. The gap was projected to widen further in 2025. There is, however, an important distinction. The 268,509 figure does not mean that 268,509 Israelis permanently emigrated. The Tel Aviv University study counts citizens who were outside Israel for at least three months. Some may have travelled temporarily, studied abroad, worked overseas or subsequently returned. Israeli parliamentary data separately show that the number of people officially classified as long-term emigrants increased sharply—from approximately 59,400 in 2022 to 82,800 in 2023 and 69,500 in 2024. The Tel Aviv University study estimates that between 45,000 and 50,000 Israelis in 2025 alone may have left the country for a year or longer, providing a more meaningful indication of permanent or long-term migration. A Demographic Warning Taken together, the figures point to a significant change in Israel’s migration pattern. Nearly 270,000 Israeli citizens spent at least three months abroad during just three years, while young people, highly educated professionals and workers in their prime earning years appear prominently among those leaving. The combination of war, security concerns, political uncertainty and economic pressure is creating an environment in which an increasing number of Israelis are considering life outside the country. For a state that has historically focused heavily on attracting people to Israel, the emerging challenge is strikingly different. The question is no longer simply how many people Israel can attract from abroad. It is how many of its own young, educated and economically productive citizens it can persuade to stay. items.title: Ethiopia’s Sea Ambition Exposes Somalia’s Strategic Weakness
items.description: Addis Ababa (WDN) — The paradox reshaping the Horn of Africa: Ethiopia has no coastline, yet Ethiopian forces have spent more than a decade operating inside Somalia, while Somalia—with one of Africa’s longest coastlines—still depends heavily on foreign forces for its security. Now Ethiopia is openly demanding access to the sea. The juxtaposition exposes more than a dispute over ports. It lays bare the extraordinary imbalance between Somalia’s geographic advantage and its limited state capacity—at a moment when the waters off its coast are becoming increasingly valuable to regional and global powers. Former Ethiopian parliament speaker Abadula Gemeda has reinforced Addis Ababa’s position, declaring that nobody can permanently prevent Ethiopia from obtaining access to the sea. “It is impossible to keep Ethiopia isolated from the sea,” Abadula told the Ethiopian News Agency. His remarks reflect a position increasingly echoed by Ethiopia’s leadership: maritime access is being treated as a long-term national interest, not simply a commercial convenience. For Somalia, that creates an uncomfortable strategic question: How can a country with a vast coastline exercise maximum leverage over its maritime assets when it has struggled for years to provide security across its own territory? Ethiopia’s Maritime Ambition Ethiopia lost its direct access to the sea after Eritrea became independent in 1993. Since then, much of its international trade has depended on ports in Djibouti. Abadula argued that Ethiopia’s loss of its former coastline was never adequately subjected to national debate or a sufficient legal process. He said decisions of enormous consequence were taken by a limited number of actors when Ethiopia lacked a fully developed constitutional system. Those are Abadula’s historical and political interpretations, rather than independently established conclusions. The strategic message, however, is unmistakable: Ethiopia does not intend to accept its landlocked status as an unquestionable permanent condition. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has again pledged to pursue maritime access through negotiation and mutual benefit. President Taye Atske Selassie has likewise said Addis Ababa will intensify efforts to secure access, citing economic and strategic interests. The Somalia Paradox The Ethiopian campaign takes on added significance because of Somalia’s security dependence. Ethiopian troops have operated inside Somalia for more than a decade through bilateral arrangements and regional and African Union-backed missions, principally in efforts to combat Al-Shabaab and support Somali security institutions. Their presence reflects a broader reality: Somalia has struggled to build a security apparatus capable of independently controlling its territory. That creates a striking strategic imbalance. Somalia possesses a coastline along the Gulf of Aden and western Indian Ocean, giving it access to some of the world’s most strategically important maritime routes. Yet its government has repeatedly required substantial external military support to maintain security. This does not establish that Ethiopia’s military presence is connected to its maritime ambitions. Nor does it prove that Addis Ababa intends to exploit Somalia’s vulnerabilities. But it does illustrate the difference between possessing strategic geography and possessing the state capacity to turn that geography into leverage. Mogadishu’s Offer The Somali government has said it is not opposed to Ethiopia obtaining commercial access to Somali ports, provided any agreement is reached through formal negotiations and respects Somalia’s sovereignty. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has said Somalia could allow Ethiopia to use two or three Somali ports for imports and exports. Mogadishu has also said Addis Ababa has yet to submit a formal request clearly defining the maritime access it seeks.  That distinction matters. Commercial port access is not the same as territorial sovereignty, permanent control or military access. For Somalia, the challenge is to establish exactly what Ethiopia wants and negotiate from a position that protects sovereignty while extracting meaningful economic and strategic benefits. A Regional Power Struggle The maritime dispute is unfolding alongside growing competition involving Ethiopia, Egypt, Eritrea and Sudan. Abadula accused Egypt and other countries he described as Ethiopia’s historical adversaries of supporting forces opposed to Addis Ababa, including Eritrean and TPLF movements. Those allegations are his own and were not supported by new evidence in the interview. The claims come against the backdrop of continuing Ethiopian-Egyptian tensions over the Nile and the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam. Somalia’s increasingly close relations with Egypt, Eritrea and Sudan have added another layer to the regional competition, particularly over Red Sea security and maritime affairs. Ethiopia has responded by emphasizing what it calls its legitimate interests as a landlocked country. The result is a maritime question that is becoming entangled with a much larger contest for influence across the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea. Somalia’s Strategic Test For Somalia, the dilemma is profound. Ethiopia is a powerful neighbour whose forces have played an important role in Somalia’s security for years. At the same time, Somalia controls a coastline whose ports and maritime position are becoming increasingly valuable. Somalia has the geography. Ethiopia has the economic and military weight. The challenge for Mogadishu is to ensure that geography translates into bargaining power. That requires more than diplomatic declarations. It requires functioning institutions, capable national security forces, political cohesion and the ability to exercise effective authority over the territory surrounding the country’s strategic ports. Ethiopia says it wants a negotiated and mutually beneficial maritime arrangement. Somalia says it is open to commercial access while insisting on sovereignty and formal government-to-government negotiations. Those positions do not necessarily have to collide. But the underlying imbalance cannot be ignored. A country cannot fully capitalize on its coastline while remaining dependent on foreign forces to secure significant parts of its territory. Ethiopia’s pursuit of maritime access has therefore exposed an uncomfortable truth about Somalia. The country with the coastline still has to build the state capacity needed to protect, negotiate and profit from it. Until then, Somalia’s greatest geographic asset may remain its greatest unrealized strategic opportunity. items.title: Somalia’s Political Deadlock Raises Fear of National Disintegration
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia is approaching a political crossroads with no broadly accepted agreement on the rules of the next election and widening disputes over who has the authority to determine them. What began as a disagreement over electoral arrangements now risks becoming a wider contest over political legitimacy, federal authority and the future direction of the state. Former President Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed has called for dialogue, national consensus and adherence to constitutional rules. In a strongly worded statement, he warned against unilateral decisions and what he described as the use of state power to intimidate political opponents. His intervention comes after repeated efforts to bridge differences between the federal government and opposition forces have failed to produce a settlement. For Sharif, the issue is not simply when Somalis will vote. He argues that the country needs an electoral framework accepted by the principal political actors before an election can provide a credible way out of the crisis. The Election Dispute Sharif says any electoral plan should be clear, lawful, specific and acceptable to political stakeholders, federal member states and the Somali public. He has urged the government to establish conditions for free and credible elections, including an agreed timetable and legal framework. The federal government maintains that it is committed to a one-person, one-vote election and says it has a constitutional mandate to proceed. The dispute therefore concerns more than the mechanics of voting. It is fundamentally about who sets the rules and whether those rules will be accepted by those who lose as well as those who win. Without that acceptance, an election could settle the presidency while leaving the underlying political conflict unresolved. Federal Authority The disagreement also exposes a deeper tension within Somalia’s federal system. Electoral rules, constitutional amendments and the distribution of political authority have become closely connected. With the federal government and some federal member states holding different positions, the electoral dispute has effectively become a test of the balance of power within the federation. If that balance is altered without broad political consent, the dispute could extend beyond the election itself and weaken cooperation between federal institutions and the states. Sharif has strongly opposed what he describes as the use of government security forces against political opponents. He argues that opposition figures should not be treated as enemies of the state and that political competition should not become a security confrontation. He has also previously alleged that government forces targeted his residence and warned that weapons intended for the fight against Al-Shabaab could be used against political opponents. Those claims remain allegations and have not all been independently verified. The broader security risk is nevertheless clear: Somalia has already seen political disagreements acquire an armed dimension, demonstrating how quickly institutional disputes can spill into violence. A Shrinking Space for Compromise Sharif has urged the government to focus on poverty, unemployment, corruption, rising living costs and the country’s continuing security challenges. He has called on political leaders, national stakeholders and civil society to return to dialogue and has said he is prepared to participate in a broader national settlement. The challenge is that time itself is becoming a political factor. The closer the country moves toward an election without agreement on the framework, the greater the pressure on every actor to secure its own position rather than compromise. That leaves Somalia facing a stark choice: reach a political settlement that can command broad acceptance, or risk turning an electoral dispute into a deeper struggle over political authority. For a country still consolidating its federal institutions, the consequences could reach well beyond the ballot box. The ultimate test is whether Somalia can resolve its political differences through negotiation—or allow them to harden into divisions that threaten the cohesion of the state itself. Former President Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed has called for dialogue, national consensus and adherence to constitutional rules. In a strongly worded statement, he warned against unilateral decisions and what he described as the use of state power to intimidate political opponents. His intervention comes after repeated efforts to bridge differences between the federal government and opposition forces have failed to produce a settlement. For Sharif, the issue is not simply when Somalis will vote. He argues that the country needs an electoral framework accepted by the principal political actors before an election can provide a credible way out of the crisis. The Election Dispute Sharif says any electoral plan should be clear, lawful, specific and acceptable to political stakeholders, federal member states and the Somali public. He has urged the government to establish conditions for free and credible elections, including an agreed timetable and legal framework. The federal government maintains that it is committed to a one-person, one-vote election and says it has a constitutional mandate to proceed. The dispute therefore concerns more than the mechanics of voting. It is fundamentally about who sets the rules and whether those rules will be accepted by those who lose as well as those who win. Without that acceptance, an election could settle the presidency while leaving the underlying political conflict unresolved. Federal Authority The disagreement also exposes a deeper tension within Somalia’s federal system. Electoral rules, constitutional amendments and the distribution of political authority have become closely connected. With the federal government and some federal member states holding different positions, the electoral dispute has effectively become a test of the balance of power within the federation. If that balance is altered without broad political consent, the dispute could extend beyond the election itself and weaken cooperation between federal institutions and the states. Sharif has strongly opposed what he describes as the use of government security forces against political opponents. He argues that opposition figures should not be treated as enemies of the state and that political competition should not become a security confrontation. He has also previously alleged that government forces targeted his residence and warned that weapons intended for the fight against Al-Shabaab could be used against political opponents. Those claims remain allegations and have not all been independently verified. The broader security risk is nevertheless clear: Somalia has already seen political disagreements acquire an armed dimension, demonstrating how quickly institutional disputes can spill into violence. A Shrinking Space for Compromise Sharif has urged the government to focus on poverty, unemployment, corruption, rising living costs and the country’s continuing security challenges. He has called on political leaders, national stakeholders and civil society to return to dialogue and has said he is prepared to participate in a broader national settlement. The challenge is that time itself is becoming a political factor. The closer the country moves toward an election without agreement on the framework, the greater the pressure on every actor to secure its own position rather than compromise. That leaves Somalia facing a stark choice: reach a political settlement that can command broad acceptance, or risk turning an electoral dispute into a deeper struggle over political authority. For a country still consolidating its federal institutions, the consequences could reach well beyond the ballot box. The ultimate test is whether Somalia can resolve its political differences through negotiation—or allow them to harden into divisions that threaten the cohesion of the state itself. items.title: Haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee Soomaali ah oo London uga guuleysatay…
items.description: London (Caasimada Online) – Sagal Cabdiweli oo asal ahaan Soomaali ah kana tirsan Xisbiga Shaqaalaha ee Britain (Labour Party), ayaa ku guuleysatay kursiga deegaanka Holborn and St Pancras, kaddib markii ay heshay 12,292 cod, iyadoo ka adkaatay musharraxiintii la tartamayay. Sagal oo la sheegay inay dhalatay bishii Juun 1984 ayaa doorashada ku gashay loollan adag, iyadoo ka guuleysatay musharrax ka socday Xisbiga Cagaaran (Green Party) oo lagu magacaabo Zack Polanski. Kursigan waxaa hore ugu metelayay Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Britain, Keir Starmer, kaas oo horay u hayay xilka xildhibaannimo ee deegaanka Holborn and St Pancras. Sagal ayaa noqonaysa haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee asal ahaan Soomaali ah, isla markaana Muslim ah, oo ku guuleysata kursigaas. Waxaa la filayaa inay gasho Aqalka Baarlamaanka Britain iyadoo xiran xijaab. Guusheeda ayaa muujinaysa sida dadka asal ahaan Soomaaliyeed ay uga dhex muuqanayaan siyaasadda dalalka ay degeen, iyagoo u tartamaya xilal kala duwan oo heer deegaan iyo heer qaran ah. Sanadihii u dambeeyay, Soomaalida ku nool dalal kala duwan oo caalamka ah ayaa si isa soo taraysa uga qayb qaadanayay siyaasadda iyo hoggaanka bulshada. Arrintani waxay fursad u abuureysaa inay door muuqda ku yeeshaan Soomaalidu go’aan-qaadashada iyo matalaadda bulshooyinka ay ka tirsan yihiin. items.title: Cusbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa oo laga hirgeliyey Xarun Tallaal
items.description: Cusbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa oo laga hirgeliyey Xarun Tallaal Cusbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa ayaa laga hirgeliyey xarun cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada tallaalka carruurta iyo dadka waaweyn. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka JSL, Dr. Xuseen Bashiir Xirsi, ayaa xadhigga ka jaray xarunta cusub, taas oo qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo adeegyada caafimaadka iyo ka-hortagga cudurrada tallaalka lagaga hortagi karo, gaar ahaan Cagaarshowga B (Hepatitis B). Munaasibadda ayaa waxa ka qaybgalay maamulka Cusbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa, madaxda WHO, UNICEF iyo Save the Children, masuuliyiin ka tirsan Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka iyo Isuduwaha Gobolka Maroodijeex, iyo masuuliyiin kale.

items.title: Dukaamo ay Soomaalidu Leedahay oo Lagu Bililiqaystay Rabshado Ka Dhan ah Ajaanibta Koonfur Afrika
items.description: Rabshado ka dhan ah ajaanibta oo ka dhacay deegaannada Soweto iyo Durban ee dalka Koonfur Afrika ayaa sababay bililiqo, gubidda gaadiidka iyo burbur hantiyeed, iyadoo ganacsatada ajaanibta ah, oo ay Soomaalidu ka mid tahay, ay wajahaan walaac cusub oo la xiriira badbaadadooda. Wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters ayaa goob joog ka ahayd dhacdo ay dad ku bililiqaysanayeen dukaan la sheegay inuu leeyahay muwaadin Soomaaliyeed. Milkiilaha dukaanka ayaa la sheegay in laga eryay goobta markii rabshaduhu billowdeen, halka dadku ay badeecooyin kala baxayeen dukaanka ka hor inta aysan kala cararin markii ay goobta soo gaareen ciidamada booliska. Dhacdadan ayaa mar kale soo cusboonaysiisay walaaca laga qabo weerarrada iyo bililiqada lagu beegsado ganacsatada ajaanibta ah ee Koonfur Afrika, gaar ahaan Soomaalida maamusha dukaamada yaryar ee ku yaalla xaafadaha kala duwan ee dalkaas. Sida ay sheegeen booliska, ugu yaraan 24 gaari ayaa lagu gubay deegaannada Soweto iyo Durban, halka bakhaarro iyo goob ganacsi oo martigelin ahna ay waxyeello soo gaartay. Booliska ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in saddex qof lagu xiray magaalada Durban, iyadoo ciidamo dheeraad ah la geeyay goobaha ay rabshaduhu ka dhaceen si loo xakameeyo xaaladda loogana hortago falal kale oo rabshado wata. Dhanka kale, dowladda Koonfur Afrika ayaa sheegtay in rabshadaha ay qayb ahaan ka dhasheen xog khaldan oo laga faafiyay go’aan ay Maxkamadda Dastuuriga ahi ka gaartay arrimaha codsiyada magangelyada. Dowladda ayaa caddeysay in go’aanka maxkamaddu aanu ajaanibta si toos ah u siinayn sharci degenaansho, balse uu mamnuucayo in codsiga magangelyada qofka lagu diido oo keliya sababta la xiriirta qaabkii uu dalka ku soo galay. Rabshadahan ayaa khatar hor leh ku ah ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed ee ku nool Koonfur Afrika, kuwaas oo sannado badan la kulmayay weerarro, bililiqo iyo dilal la xiriira nacaybka ajaanibta. Ganacsiyada yaryar ee Soomaalidu ku tiirsan tahay ayaa si gaar ah ugu nugul rabshadaha noocan ah, maadaama burburka ama dhac kasta uu sababi karo khasaare dhaqaale oo weyn iyo in qoysas badan ay waayaan ilihii ay noloshooda ka maareynayeen. Inkastoo boolisku sheegeen in xaaladda qaar ka mid ah goobihii rabshaduhu ka dhaceen la xakameeyay, haddana waxaa weli jira walaac ku saabsan badbaadada ganacsatada iyo suurtagalnimada in rabshaduhu ku fidaan deegaanno kale. Waxaa sidoo kale muhiim ah in la helo xog sax ah oo ku saabsan go’aannada maxkamadaha iyo siyaasadaha socdaalka, si looga hortago wararka marin-habaabinta ah ee sii hurin kara xiisadaha bulshada. Ilaa iyo inta laga xaqiijinayo xaaladda guud, badbaadada ganacsatada iyo hantidooda ayaa weli ah arrin u baahan feejignaan, iyadoo laga sugayo hay’adaha amniga inay ilaaliyaan dhammaan dadka rayidka ah, kana hortagaan weerarrada lagu beegsanayo ajaanibta iyo ganacsiyadooda.

items.title: Duqeymo Diyaaradaha Drone-ka ah oo Lagu Weeraray Ciidamo Eritrean ah oo la Sheegay inay Gudaha Itoobiya Galeen
items.description: Diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo la tuhunsan yahay inay leeyihiin ciidamada Itoobiya ayaa la sheegay inay duqeeyeen gaadiid ay wateen ciidamo Eritrean ah oo ku sugnaa agagaarka magaalada Adigrat, ee gobolka Tigray, sida ay sheegtay hay’adda dabagalka colaadaha ee ACLED. Warbixinta ayaa tilmaamaysa in ciidamada Eritrea ay ka soo gudbeen xadka, iyagoo ka soo galay dhinaca deegaanka Zelambesa, ka hor inta aan la beegsan gaadiidkooda xilli ay ku sii jeedeen deegaannada Adigrat iyo Idaga Hamus. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, weli lama shaacin tirada ciidamada la beegsaday iyo khasaaraha ka dhashay duqeymaha la sheegay. Wakaaladda wararka ee Associated Press (AP) ayaa soo xigatay taliye ka tirsan xoogagga taageera dowladda Itoobiya, kaas oo sheegay in ciidamo Eritrean ahi ay galeen magaalooyinka Adigrat iyo Idaga Hamus. Dhanka kale, dowladda Eritrea si cad uma aysan xaqiijin in ciidamadeedu gudaha u galeen deegaannadaas, halka AP ay sheegtay inaysan si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin dhaqdhaqaaqa ciidamada la sheegay. Dhacdadan ayaa imaanaysa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha amni iyo diblomaasiyadeed ee u dhexeeya Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, kuwaas oo hore isaga kaashaday dagaalkii gobolka Tigray intii u dhexeysay 2020 iyo 2022. Xariirka labada dal ayaa tan iyo markaas wajahayay khilaafaad sii kordhaya, taasoo sare u qaadaysa walaaca laga qabo in xiisaddu isu beddesho iska horimaad militari oo toos ah. Haddii ay sii xoogeysanayaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidamada iyo weerarrada la soo sheegayo, waxaa laga cabsi qabaa in gobolka Tigray uu mar kale galo xaalad amni oo cakiran, taasoo sababi karta barakac hor leh, khasaare naf iyo maalba leh iyo carqalad ku timaadda ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka dadka ee gobolka. Dagaal toos ah oo dhex mara Itoobiya iyo Eritrea wuxuu sidoo kale saameyn ballaaran ku yeelan karaa amniga Geeska Afrika, ayadoo Itoobiyana laga yaabaa inay ku khasbanaato inay ciidamo iyo dhaqaale dheeraad ah u weeciso xuduuddeeda waqooyi, arrintaas oo saamayn ku yeelan karta mudnaanta amni iyo siyaasadeed ee ay ku leedahay gobolka, oo ay Soomaaliya ka mid tahay. Ilaa hadda, faahfaahin madax-bannaan oo dhammaystiran lagama hayo khasaaraha ka dhashay duqeymaha la soo sheegay iyo xaaladda dhabta ah ee ciidamada Eritrea ee la sheegay inay gudaha u galeen gobolka Tigray.

items.title: Sagal Cabdi-Wali oo Ku Guuleysatay Kursigii Keir Starmer ee Baarlamaanka Britain
items.description: Sagal Cabdi-Wali oo ka tirsan Xisbiga Shaqaalaha ee Labour Party ayaa ku guuleysatay doorashadii ku-celiska ahayd ee deegaanka Holborn and St Pancras ee magaalada London, iyadoo ku guuleysatay kursigii uu banneeyey ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Britain, Keir Starmer. atiijada rasmiga ah ee doorashada, oo lagu dhawaaqay Jimcihii, ayaa muujisay in Sagal ay heshay 12,292 cod, oo u dhiganta 45.17% codadkii la dhiibtay . Dhanka kale, hoggaamiyaha Xisbiga Green Party, Zack Polanski, ayaa helay 8,928 cod, oo u dhiganta 32.82%. Labada musharrax waxaa u dhexeeyey farqi dhan 3,364 cod. Ka-qaybgalka doorashada ayaa gaaray 38.76%, taasoo ka hooseysa heerkii laga diiwaangeliyey doorashadii guud ee sannadkii 2024. Inkastoo Xisbiga Labour Party uu sii haystay kursiga, haddana farqiga guusha ayaa aad uga yaraaday kii doorashadii guud ee 2024, markaas oo Keir Starmer uu kursigan ku helay in ka badan 11,500 oo cod oo dheeraad ah musharraxa kaalinta labaad galay. Natiijadan ayaa muujinaysa tartanka adag ee ka dhex dhacay musharraxiinta, gaar ahaan loollanka ay Green Party ku gashay kursiga, ayadoo Sagal  oo ku dhalatay Soomaaliya, ay carruurnimadeedii ku timid Britain iyadoo qaxooti ah, waxayna muddo dheer ku noolayd degmada Camden ee London. Waxay siyaasadda deegaanka ka soo gashay golaha deegaanka sannadkii 2022, halka bishii May 2026 loo doortay hoggaamiyaha Golaha Camden, iyadoo noqotay haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee madow ah ee xilkaas qabata. Khudbad ay jeedisay kaddib markii ay guusha gaartay, Sagal ayaa sheegtay in matalaadda dadka deegaanka Holborn and St Pancras ay macne gaar ah u leedahay, maadaama Camden uu hoy iyo fursado siiyey qoyskeeda markii ay qaxootiga ahaayeen. items.title: Ku Dhawaad 7 Milyan oo Soomaali ah oo Wajahaya Cunto-Yaraan Ba’an
items.description: Ku dhawaad toddoba milyan oo qof oo ku nool Soomaaliya ayaa wajahaya cunto-yari iyo nafaqo-darro, iyadoo colaadaha, xannibaadaha waddooyinka iyo hoos-u-dhaca maalgelinta gargaarka bani’aadannimo ay sii adkeynayaan gaarsiinta caawinta dadka ay xaaladdu saameysay. Warbixin ay baahisay wargeyska Faransiiska ee Le Monde ayaa tilmaamaysa in waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee isku xira Baydhabo iyo deegaannada kale ay wajahayaan xannibaado la xiriira amniga, kuwaas oo saameyn ku yeeshay gaarsiinta gargaarka. Waddada isku xirta Buurhakaba iyo deegaannada kale ee gobolka ayaa la sheegay inay xannibtay Al-Shabaab, taasoo ku khasabtay shaqaalaha samafalka inay mararka qaarkood adeegsadaan diyaarado qaada xaddi kooban oo gargaar ah, iyadoo duullimaad kasta uu ku kacayo kumannaan doollar. Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa hoy u ah qiyaastii 700,000 oo barakacayaal ah, kuwaas oo intooda badan ku tiirsan gargaarka bani’aadannimo si ay u helaan cunto, biyo nadiif ah iyo adeegyo caafimaad. Dadka ka soo cararaya abaaraha, colaadaha iyo deegaannada ay go’doomiyeen kooxaha hubeysan ayaa sii kordhinaya baahida loo qabo adeegyada aasaasiga ah ee magaalada. Dhanka kale, maalgelinta gargaarka degdegga ah ayaa si weyn hoos ugu dhacday. Sida ay sheegtay UNICEF, miisaaniyadda ay u qoondeysay gargaarka degdegga ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa hoos uga dhacday 122 milyan oo doollar sannadkii 2023 ilaa 38 milyan oo doollar sannadkan. Hoos-u-dhacan ayaa halis gelinaya sii socoshada adeegyada ay ku tiirsan yihiin carruurta iyo qoysaska nugul. Warbixinta Le Monde ayaa sidoo kale xustay in la xiray goobo carruurta loogu adeegayay. Xogta la soo xigtay ayaa kala tilmaamaysa 205 xarumood oo caafimaad iyo nafaqo ah iyo ugu yaraan 65 goobood oo bixiya adeegyada ilaalinta carruurta, taasoo muujinaysa baaxadda saameynta ay yaraanta maalgelintu ku yeelan karto adeegyada bani’aadannimo. Dagaalladii ugu dambeeyay ee ka dhacay Baydhabo ayaa sii xumeeyay xaaladda barakacayaasha, iyadoo ay carqaladoobeen isu-socodka dadka, gaadiidka gargaarka iyo helitaanka xarumaha caafimaadka. Qoysaska ku nool xeryaha barakacayaasha ayaa si gaar ah ugu nugul inay waayaan cunto ku filan, biyo nadiif ah iyo daryeel caafimaad, halka walaaca laga qabo in colaado hor leh ay dhacaan uu adkeyn karo howlaha hay’adaha samafalka. Isku-darka colaadaha, xannibaadaha waddooyinka iyo yaraanta maalgelinta ayaa sare u qaadaya halista barakac hor leh, nafaqo-darro carruurta ku dhacda iyo faafitaanka cudurrada. Haddii aan la sugin marinnada gargaarka, dibna aan loo hawlgelin adeegyada hakaday, kumannaan qoys oo horey uga soo barakacay deegaannadooda ayaa wajihi kara xaalad bani’aadannimo oo kasii daran. Xaaladdan ayaa muujinaysa baahida degdegga ah ee loo qabo in la fududeeyo gaarsiinta gargaarka, la xoojiyo maalgelinta samafalka, lana ilaaliyo dadka rayidka ah si loo xaqiijiyo in qoysaska ugu nugul ay helaan cuntada, biyaha iyo adeegyada caafimaad ee ay u baahan yihiin.

items.title: Shirkado Diyaaradeed oo joojiyay duulmaadyadii ay ku tagi jireen Sucuudiga
items.description: Shirkadaha diyaaradaha ee Lufthansa ee Jarmalka iyo Air India ee Hindiya ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay joojinayaan duullimaadyadooda taga Riyad, caasimadda Sacuudiga, kaddib weerarrada Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Joojinta duullimaadyada ayaa timid iyadoo ay sii xoogeysanayaan weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee lagu beegsanayo garoomada diyaaradaha iyo xarumaha shidaalka ee Sacuudiga. Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo xulafo la ah Iran ayaa Khamiistii kordhiyay weerarrada ay ku qaadayaan Sacuudiga, iyagoo gantaallo ku beegsanaya hawada dalka iyo xarumaha shidaalka. Weerarrada toddobaadkan ayaa sababay dhimashada saddex qof, waxayna si weyn u waxyeelleeyeen diyaarad. Kooxda ayaa sheegtay inay bartilmaameedsatay garoonka diyaaradaha Riyad, waxayna shaqaalaha uga digtay inay ka fogaadaan xarumaha tamarta oo ay qorsheynayaan inay weeraraan. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in diyaarad rakaab oo ay leedahay shirkadda diyaaradaha qaranka Sacuudiga ay waxyeello ka soo gaartay weerarradii lagu qaaday garoonka King Khalid ee Riyadh.

items.title: Biixi, Ayuub iyo agaasimayaal is-hortaagay mashaariic laga fulin lahaa Muqdisho si loogu wareejiyo gobollo kale
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Waxaa shalay oo Khamiis ah magaalada Muqdisho lagu hakiyay saxiixa heshiis lagu fulin lahaa mashruuc lagu dhisayo qeybo ka mid ah biyo-mareennada caasimadda, kaas oo qeyb ka ah mashaariic kaabayaal dhaqaale oo uu maalgelinayo Bankiga Adduunka. Xog ay heshay Caasimada Online ayaa sheegeysa inuu jiro qorshe lagu doonayo in qeyb ka mid ah dhaqaalaha mashruuca loo wareejiyo dhismaha waddooyin laga hirgelinayo Somaliland iyo Puntland. Heshiiskan, oo la qorsheeyay inay kala saxiixdaan Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya iyo Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir, ayaa la joojiyay iyadoo la adeegsanayo cudur-daarro dhowr ah oo xogta la helay ay tilmaamayso in badankood la hindisay. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, hakinta heshiiska ayaa lala xiriirinayaa Wasiirka Maaliyadda Biixi Iimaan iyo Wasiirka Hawlaha Guud Ayuub Ismaaciil Yuusuf, oo labaduba ka soo jeeda Somaliland, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay doonayaan in dib loo eego dhaqaalaha loo qoondeeyay biyo-mareennada Muqdisho, si qeyb ka mid ah loogu weeciyo mashaariic laga fulinayo meelo kale oo dalka ah. Qorshaha ayaa la sheegay inuu ku dhisan yahay in Muqdisho lagu tilmaamo magaalo aan weli diyaar u ahayn fulinta mashruuca, halka Somaliland loo soo bandhigayo inay diyaar u tahay dhismaha waddooyin cusub, gaar ahaan waddo dhererkeedu yahay 90 kiiloomitir oo ka bilaabaneysa deegaanka Ina Guuxa, kuna dhammaaneysa xuduudda Itoobiya. Xogta ayaa sidoo kale tilmaameysa in waddadaasi ay mareyso deegaanno ay deggan yihiin ehelada Wasiirka Maaliyadda, taas oo lala xiriirinayo dadaallada lagu doonayo in mashruucan la hormariyo. Wasiirka Maaliyadda ayaa mas’uul ka ah arrimaha qoondada dhaqaalaha, waxaana xogta ay Caasimada Online heshay ay muujineysaa inuu hore u riixay qorshe ballaaran oo lagu maalgelinayo mashaariic kala duwan, oo ay ku jiraan waddooyinka Somaliland, horumarinta garoomada diyaaradaha iyo duulista hawada, iyo biyo-mareennada Muqdisho. Mashaariicdan ayaa waxaa fulintooda qeyb ku leh Wasaaradda Hawlaha Guud, Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, hase yeeshee waxaa hadda soo baxay muran ku saabsan sida dhaqaalaha loogu kala hormarinayo. Is-hortaagga dhaqaalaha Muqdisho Mashruuca biyo-mareennada Muqdisho ayaa loo qoondeeyay dhaqaale gaaraya 51 milyan, waxaana loogu talagalay in lagu dhiso laguna horumariyo qeybo ka mid ah kaabayaasha biyo-mareennada caasimadda. Hase yeeshee, xogta ay heshay Caasimada Online ayaa sheegeysa in qorshaha hadda socda uu yahay in dhaqaalahaas loo kala qeybiyo laba qeybood, iyadoo qeyb lagu sii fulinayo biyo-mareennada Muqdisho, halka qeybta kale loo adeegsanayo dhameystirka waddooyin laga hirgelinayo Somaliland iyo Puntland. Dadaallada lagu hakiyay saxiixa heshiiska ayaa waxaa door weyn ku lahaa Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda Hawlaha Guud, Faarax Cabdinuur, iyo Xuseen Jaamac, oo ka tirsan mas’uuliyiinta gacanta ku haya mashaariicda kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, sida ay tilmaameyso xogta la helay. Labadan mas’uul ayaa la sheegay inay dadaal xooggan geliyeen sidii loo baajin lahaa heshiiska maanta la filayay inay Muqdisho ku kala saxiixdaan Wasiirka Maaliyadda iyo Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir. Ujeeddada ayaa lagu sheegay in la helo fursad dib loogu qeybin karo dhaqaalaha 51-ka milyan ah, iyadoo qeyb ka mid ah laga jarayo mashruuca Muqdisho, laguna wareejinayo waddooyinka kale ee la doonayo in la hormariyo. Arrintan ayaa qeyb ka ah muran ka ballaaran mashruuca biyo-mareennada Muqdisho, kaas oo la xiriira sida loo maamulayo mashaariicda waddooyinka ee uu Bankiga Adduunku maalgeliyo iyo dowlad-goboleedyada mudnaanta la siinayo. Mashruuca SHIIP iyo Somaliland Mid ka mid ah mashaariicda muranku hareeyay ayaa ah SHIIP, oo ay Wasaaradda Hawlaha Guud ku diyaarineyso naqshadaha waddooyinka isku xira xarumaha dhaqaalaha, loona yaqaan economic corridors , ee dowlad-goboleedyada dalka, oo ay Somaliland ku jirto. Qorshihii hore ee mashruucan ayaa ahaa in si isku mar ah loo bilaabo diyaarinta waddooyinka loo qoondeeyay dowlad-goboleed kasta, si hawlaha naqshadeynta iyo diyaarinta dhismuhu u socdaan iyadoo aan deegaan gaar ah mudnaan dheeraad ah la siin. Hase yeeshee, xogta ay heshay Caasimada Online ayaa muujineysa in qorshahaas wax laga beddelay, isla markaana amar lagu bixiyay in dib loo dhigo shaqooyinka qaar ka mid ah dowlad-goboleedyada, si marka hore loo diyaariyo waddooyinka Somaliland. Waddooyinka mudnaanta la siiyay ayaa kala ah waddada Ina Guuxa ilaa xuduudda Itoobiya, oo dhererkeedu yahay 90 kiiloomitir, iyo waddada isku xirta Boorame iyo Baki ee gobolka Awdal, oo dhererkeedu yahay 60 kiiloomitir. Awdal waxaa ka soo jeeda wasiir Ayuub. Mudnaanta ugu weyn ayaa la sheegay in la siinayo waddada 90-ka kiiloomitir ah, si dhaqaalaha ugu horreeya ee mashruuca loogu bilaabo dhismaheeda. Xogta ayaa tilmaameysa in shaqooyinkaasi uu gacanta ku hayo mas’uul ay isku beel yihiin Wasiirka Maaliyadda Biixi Iimaan, kaas oo la sheegay in lagu amray inuu hakiyo ama dib u dhigo hawlaha waddooyinka dowlad-goboleedyada kale, kuna hormaro kuwa Somaliland. Diyaarinta waddooyinka Somaliland ayaa hadda mareysa heerkii dhismaha lagu bilaabi lahaa, waxaana loo qoondeeyay dhaqaale gaaraya 50 milyan, iyadoo qorshuhu yahay in hawlaha dhismuhu bilowdaan bisha soo socota. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan sababta waddooyinka qaarkood loo gaarsiiyay heerka dhismaha, halka kuwo kale oo isla mashruuca ku jira aysan weli dhameystirmin naqshadahooda. Doorka Xuseen Jaamac Xogta ay heshay Caasimada Online ayaa sidoo kale iftiimineysa doorka Xuseen Jaamac, oo hore uga shaqeynayay mashruuca Barwaaqo, halkaas oo uu ka ahaa khabiirka qandaraasyada iyo soo iibinta adeegyada, ama procurement specialist . Xuseen Jaamac ayaa la sheegay in loo soo wareejiyay hawlaha diyaarinta mashruuca SHIIP, isagoo door weyn ku yeeshay maamulka qandaraasyada iyo go’aannada la xiriira mashaariicda waddooyinka. Waxaa sidoo kale soo baxaya eedeymo ku saabsan inuu isku mar ka shaqeynayo labada mashruuc ee SHIIP iyo Barwaaqo, oo labaduba uu maalgeliyo Bankiga Adduunka, iyadoo xogta la helay ay sheegeyso in arrintaasi ka hor imaaneyso shuruudaha shaqaaleysiinta ee mashaariicdan. Si kastaba, weli lama xaqiijin qodobka heshiisyada ama xeerarka shaqo ee si gaar ah u mamnuucaya inuu hal qof labada mashruuc isku mar ka shaqeeyo. Xuseen Jaamac, oo ka soo jeeda Puntland, ayaa lagu eedeeyay inuu si weyn ula wareegay maamulka mashruuca SHIIP, isla markaana hoos u dhigay hawlihii loogu talagalay inta badan dowlad-goboleedyada, marka laga reebo Somaliland, Puntland iyo Jubbaland. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu tilmaamay mas’uul si dhow ula shaqeeya wasiirrada ay khuseeyaan mashaariicdan, gaar ahaan dhinacyada qandaraasyada iyo habraacyada lagu fulinayo shaqooyinka. items.title: Taliye Sare iyo 300 Askari oo ka Goostay Kooxda RSF ee Suudaan
items.description: Taliye ka tirsanaa maleeshiyaadka Rapid Support Forces (RSF) ee dalka Suudaan, Gaashaanle Dhexe Mohammed Azraq al-Fanjari, ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu ka goostay kooxdaas, isaga oo la socda 300 oo saraakiil iyo askar ah iyo 30 gaari oo dagaal. Taliyaha ayaa go’aankiisa ku dhawaaqay maalintii Khamiista, isaga oo dagaalka ka socda dalka Suudaan ku tilmaamay dagaal aan sabab lahayn, waxa uuna sidoo kale ugu baaqay xubnihii uu horay uga tirsanaa inay ka baxaan RSF, isla markaana ay garab istaagaan Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Suudaan. Ka-goosashadan ayaa imanaysa xilli dalka Suudaan uu weli ka socdo dagaal u dhexeeya Ciidamada Qalabka Sida iyo RSF, kaas oo sababay xaalad amni iyo mid bini’aadantinimo oo aad u adag.

items.title: The Government issued advice to Brits as the Covid variant spreads.
items.description: Covid (Image: Getty)and The Government has urged some Brits to mask up as the ‘American Covid’ variant spreads across the country. The warning comes as COVID-19 rates in the UK continues to fluctuate. The XFG variant, also known as ‘American Covid’, has been circulating across the UK and other countries for about a year. However, data from the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) shows that COVID-19 positive test rates rose to around 7% in September, with hospital admission rates increasing by approximately 50% over the same period. The increase in hospitalisations rising in line with overall increase in COVID-19 circulatio n, suggest there is a general rise in COVID-19 activity. Therefore, the UKHSA has offered some guidance on what Brits should do if they have symptoms of any sort of respiratory infection, such as Covid. If you have a high temperature or do not not feel well enough to go to work or carry out normal activites, then you should avoid contact with vulnerable people and stay at home if possible. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay xaaladda Tardo oo Shabaab iyo dadka deegaanka ay ku dagaalameen
items.description: Maleeshiyada Al Shabaab oo galabta dib ugu laabtay deegaanka Tardo ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa caawa bandow ku soo rogay deegaankaasi, ka dib iska horimaadkii maanta ku dhex maray iyaga iyo dadka deegaanka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Shabaabku ay bilaabeen baaritaano iyo culeysyo ay saarayaan dadka shacabka ah, si ay u xakameeyaan dhaqdhaqaaqa deegaanka, inkastoo inta badan dadka deegaanka ay isaga baxeen deegaankaasi, ka hor inta aysan Shabaabka dib ugu soo laaban. Dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in Shabaabku ay duhurnimadii maanta banneeyeen deegaanka, ka dib markii afar nin ay kaga dhinteen iska horimaadkii ay kula galeen shacabka ku dhaqan deegaankaasi qaarkood. Iska horimaadkan ayaa waxa uu ka dambeeyay, ka gadaal markii Shabaabku ay rasaas ku fureen dad isku dayay in ay ka celiyaan nin ay jirdil ugu gaysanayeen suuqa ku yaala deegaankaasi, kaas oo ay doonayeen inay ka qaadaan qori uu ku haystay goob ganacsi. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in tacshiiraddaasi ay galaafatay nolosha saddex qof oo shacab ah oo goobta ku geeriyooday iyo dhaawaca toban kale, inkastoo laba ka mid ah dadkii dhaawacmay ay mar dambe u geeriyoodeen dhaawicii soo gaaray. Tani oo ka sii carreysiisay dadka deegaanka oo qaarkood si qarsoodi ah hub ugu dhex haystay deegaankaasi ayaa ku dhiiraday inay iska horimaad la galaan maleeshiyada, iyagoona ka dilay afar nin. Sarkaal ka tirsan Taliska Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ku sugan Degmada Buuloburde ee Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa Universaltv u sheegay in ay la socdaan in Shabaabka ay caawa guryaha shacabka ka raadinayaan wax uun hub ah. Iska horimaadkan ayaa noqonaya kii ugu horreyay ee deegaankaasi ku dhex mara Al Shabaab iyo dadka deegaanka, tan iyo markii Shabaabku ay 13-kii bishii July ee sanadkii hore la wareegeen gacan ku haynta Tardo. Tardo ayaa waxay ka mid tahay deegaanada istiraatiijiga ah ee Gobolka Hiiraan, iyadoona xiriirisa Degmooyinka Jalalaqsi, Moqokori, Maxaas iyo Buuloburde.

items.title: Sharif calls for ‘united national front to save Somalia’
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Opposition leader and former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed has warned that threats of force and military mobilization against political opponents risk pushing Somalia toward “chaos or authoritarianism.” He called for a broad national front to “save Somalia.” In a statement issued on Thursday, Sharif said the dispute over the constitutional mandate of the country’s current institutions “cannot be resolved through the use of force or unilateral measures.” He argued that it must be settled through dialogue, national consensus and adherence to the constitutional and legal rules governing the political transition. “The opposition is not an enemy of the state” The sharpest passages of the statement concern the government’s treatment of its critics. Sharif said he “categorically” rejected “threatening rhetoric, the threat of force, or military mobilization against political opposition groups.” “Political disagreement is not a crime,” he said. “The opposition is not an enemy of the state, and political competition must never be allowed to turn into a security or military confrontation.” He warned that using state institutions or the security and military forces to pressure political opponents “risks undermining the country’s unity and stability,” and cautioned against “pushing Somalia down this dangerous path.” Sharif said Somalia needs “a strong state, not a powerful authority at the expense of the state.” He called for “constitutional institutions, not institutions used as instruments in political conflict,” and for “a national army that protects the people and the state, not the use of military force as a tool of political competition.” He said the opposition and the Somali people would confront any attempt to drag the country toward chaos or authoritarianism “through all legitimate political, legal, constitutional, and peaceful means.” Demand for a clear election timetable Sharif said the government’s responsibility is to create the conditions for free, fair and transparent elections and to meet its constitutional obligations within clearly defined and mutually agreed timelines. He said every constitutional or electoral milestone must be “clear, specific, and acceptable” to political forces, Federal Member States and the Somali people. He called for a credible timetable, made public, setting out each stage of the electoral process. He said Somalis have the right to know: when the elections will be held, and the key stages that will precede them; what safeguards will ensure their integrity; and how political forces and Federal Member States will take part. “The country cannot remain hostage to political uncertainty,” he said, “nor should constitutional obligations be used as tools in the struggle for political power.” Livelihoods, security and regional pressures Sharif said Somalia faces major security, economic and social challenges, while the wider region is experiencing “successive security and political upheavals.” He said the national priority should be to unite efforts to confront these challenges rather than “distract public attention with political side battles.” He said Somalis expect the government to address livelihood concerns, improve economic conditions, create jobs, combat unemployment and corruption, improve public services and strengthen security. He said continuing economic and social pressures, the rising cost of living and the declining ability of citizens to meet daily needs “should compel the government to reassess its priorities and not escalate its political confrontation with its opponents.” Call for a broad national front Sharif said the political stakeholders “are not required to agree on everything.” He said they are required to agree on “the rules of political engagement, respect for the Constitution, rejection of violence, protection of the state, and the peaceful transfer of power.” He called on all Somali national forces, whether political, social, federal or civil, to build “a broad and united national front to save Somalia.” He said it should “target no one and seek to exclude no one,” and should work to protect the state, safeguard the Constitution, complete the democratic transition, achieve national reconciliation and create the conditions for development and the rebuilding of state institutions. “Saving Somalia will not come from outside, nor will it be achieved through internal conflict or the use of force against political opponents,” he said. “It must be achieved by Somalis themselves, through consensus, dialogue, participation, and national responsibility.” Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com
