items.title: Somalia’s Constitutional Dispute Deepens as Government Moves to Bar MPs from Cabinet
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s government is moving to end the long-standing practice of allowing members of parliament to serve simultaneously as ministers—a move critics say exposes President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s growing disregard for the country’s agreed constitutional framework. The change effectively overturns a provision of the 2012 Provisional Federal Constitution (PFCS), which established Somalia as a parliamentary system and explicitly allowed members of parliament to serve in the Council of Ministers. Under Article 97 of the 2012 PFCS, a member of parliament could be appointed as a minister. That provision has now been removed under the constitutional changes being implemented by the government. The office of the Chairperson of the Independent Constitutional Review and Implementation Commission, Burhan Aden Omar, has notified members of the Council of Ministers who also serve as MPs that they must choose between the two positions. According to the notification, the six-month transition period began on 14 April 2026 and ends on 14 October 2026. Under the new arrangement, a minister who is also an MP must relinquish one of the positions. Likewise, an MP who accepts another government position would lose parliamentary membership. The committee says the change is intended to establish a clearer separation between the legislative and executive branches and strengthen institutional accountability. But that explanation leaves a much larger constitutional question unanswered: Who authorized the replacement of an agreed constitutional provision with a new rule that fundamentally changes the relationship between Parliament and the executive? The 2012 Constitution vs. Hassan Sheikh’s Constitutional Project The controversy goes beyond whether MPs should be allowed to serve as ministers. The 2012 PFCS was the product of a broad political process and remains the constitutional reference point around which Somalia’s federal institutions were established.  Its parliamentary framework was designed to allow political leaders to move between Parliament and the executive without automatically losing their parliamentary mandate. Critics argue that President Hassan Sheikh’s administration is instead relying on a new constitutional framework that has not achieved the same level of political consensus as the 2012 settlement. They contend that the Constitutional Review and Implementation Commission is now treating provisions from that contested framework as though they had already acquired unquestioned national legitimacy. That, they argue, is precisely where the constitutional dispute becomes political. A constitution cannot derive its legitimacy simply from the institution responsible for drafting or implementing it. Its authority depends on political consensus, proper procedure and acceptance by the country’s principal stakeholders. The government, however, has presented the constitutional changes as part of a broader effort to complete Somalia’s constitutional review process and clarify the separation of powers. A Fundamental Parliamentary Question The immediate consequence is straightforward. Once the transition period expires on October 14, a minister who wishes to remain in the cabinet will reportedly have to give up his or her parliamentary seat. An MP who accepts a ministerial or other government position could likewise lose parliamentary membership. That represents a significant departure from the constitutional practice established under the 2012 PFCS. It also raises questions about the nature of Somalia’s parliamentary system. In a parliamentary system, the relationship between the legislature and executive is fundamentally different from that of a presidential system. Ministers are often drawn from parliament precisely because the government depends on legislative political support. The 2012 Somali constitutional framework reflected that principle by permitting MPs to serve in the cabinet. The new restriction therefore does more than separate two offices. It changes the political architecture through which Parliament and the executive interact. Constitution or Constitutional Politics? The controversy comes at an especially sensitive moment, with Somalia already deeply divided over constitutional amendments, elections and the country’s political transition. Opponents of the government’s approach argue that President Hassan Sheikh cannot simply replace provisions of the 2012 PFCS through a constitutional process that lacks broad political agreement and then demand that federal member states and opposition forces treat the resulting document as universally binding. Their concern is not merely about ministers retaining parliamentary seats. It is about who has the constitutional authority to redefine the country’s system of government—and under what political mandate. The government maintains that the constitutional review process is legitimate and that the new provisions should be implemented once duly adopted. But the central political dispute remains unresolved. If Somalia’s constitutional order was built on consensus, then constitutional change without consensus risks becoming an instrument of political power rather than a foundation for political stability. That is why the dispute over MPs serving as ministers matters far beyond the composition of the cabinet. It goes to the heart of Somalia’s unfinished constitutional settlement—and to the increasingly contentious question of whether the country’s political institutions are being governed by an agreed national constitution or by a constitutional project driven primarily by the incumbent administration. items.title: Ethiopia Rebukes Hassan Sheikh Over Al-Alamein Summit
items.description: ADDIS ABABA (WDN) — A summit in Egypt has triggered a new diplomatic dispute between Somalia and Ethiopia, with Addis Ababa sharply criticizing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud over Somalia’s endorsement of a joint declaration alongside Egypt, Eritrea and Sudan. The October 4 meeting in New Alamein was intended to strengthen regional cooperation on security, the Horn of Africa, the Red Sea, economic relations and transboundary water issues. Instead, Somalia’s position has exposed a widening gap with Ethiopia on issues that go to the heart of Addis Ababa’s regional strategy: The Nile, Red Sea security and Ethiopia’s quest for reliable maritime access. The fallout could extend beyond rhetoric. Ethiopia and Somalia remain important security partners in the fight against Al-Shabaab, while Addis Ababa has played a significant role in regional security operations. A growing perception in Ethiopia that Mogadishu is aligning diplomatically with Egypt and other states opposed to key Ethiopian interests could complicate that relationship and make future security cooperation more politically sensitive. For Addis Ababa, the issue is therefore not simply Hassan Sheikh’s attendance at an Egyptian-hosted summit. It is that Somalia endorsed a regional position that Ethiopia sees as directly challenging its strategic interests. The Ethiopian News Agency singled out provisions concerning transboundary waters and Red Sea security, arguing that Somalia’s position conflicts with Ethiopia’s interests in the Nile dispute and its pursuit of maritime access. That creates a difficult diplomatic equation for Mogadishu. Somalia is seeking deeper strategic ties with Egypt while still depending on security cooperation with Ethiopia. Those relationships are increasingly intersecting in the same strategic theatre, making it harder for Mogadishu to keep each partnership insulated from the other. The consequences could also reach Somalia’s maritime diplomacy. Ethiopia has repeatedly emphasized the strategic importance of gaining dependable access to the sea, while Somalia insists that any arrangement involving its territory or maritime waters must be based on Somali sovereignty and consent. Any perception that Mogadishu is coordinating with Egypt and other regional actors to constrain Ethiopia’s ambitions could further harden Addis Ababa’s position. The dispute also risks complicating Ethiopia’s broader relationship with Somalia at a time when both countries have strong incentives to cooperate against common security threats. What began as a regional summit has therefore become a test of Somalia’s foreign-policy balancing act. Hassan Sheikh’s government is attempting to maintain relations with competing regional powers, but the Ethiopian reaction demonstrates the limits of that strategy when diplomatic commitments begin touching directly on Ethiopia’s core national interests. The Somali government has not publicly responded to the Ethiopian criticism cited by the Ethiopian News Agency. For now, there is no indication that the summit has formally ended Somalia-Ethiopia security cooperation. But the diplomatic message from Addis Ababa is clear: Mogadishu’s alignment with Egypt and its partners on the Nile and Red Sea will not be treated as separate from the wider strategic relationship between Somalia and Ethiopia. The question facing Mogadishu is increasingly difficult: Can Somalia deepen its partnerships with Egypt and other regional powers without eroding the security relationship it still needs with Ethiopia? items.title: Itoobiya: Ma jirto cid naga hor-istaagi karta in aan bad helno
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) — Guddoomiyihii hore ee baarlamaanka Itoobiya Abadula Gemeda ayaa sheegay in aysan jirin cid ka hor istaagi karta Itoobiya inay hesho marin ay ku gaarto badda, xilli Addis Ababa ay sii xoojineyso olole ay ku doonayso marin badeed oo ay ku tilmaantay dan qaran oo muddo dheer ah. Abadula, oo wareysi siiyay wakaaladda wararka dowladda Itoobiya ee ENA, ayaa sheegay in arrinta marin-badeedku aysan ahayn mid Itoobiya ay ka tanaasuli karto, isagoo ku dooday in sida dalku ku waayay xeebtiisii hore aysan marin dood qaran iyo hannaan sharci oo ku filan. “Suurtagal ma aha in Itoobiya laga sii go’doomiyo badda,” ayuu yiri Abadula. Itoobiya ayaa noqotay dal aan bad lahayn markii Eritrea ay madax-bannaanideeda qaadatay sanadkii 1993, waxaana tan iyo markaas inta badan ganacsigeeda dibadda uu maraa dekedaha Jabuuti. Abadula ayaa ku dooday in go’aamadii horseeday xaaladdaas ay qaateen tiro kooban oo dad ah, isaga oo su’aal geliyay awooddii sharci ee dowladdii ku-meel-gaarka ahayd ee xilligaas jirtay. “Ma jirin go’aan ku saabsan marin-badeedka oo lagu gaaray dood ama heshiis ka dhacay madal rasmi ah oo sharci ah,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu sheegay in go’aamo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo saameyn weyn ku yeeshay danaha qaranka Itoobiya la qaatay xilli uusan weli dalka ka jirin nidaam dastuuri ah oo dhameystiran. Eedeyn loo jeediyay Masar Mas’uulka hore ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay dalal uu ku tilmaamay “cadowga taariikhiga ah” ee Itoobiya inay muddo dheer isku dayayeen inay dalka ka hor istaagaan marin badeed. Waxa uu si gaar ah u xusay Masar, isagoo ku eedeeyay inay taageertay xoogag gudaha Itoobiya ka jiray, isla markaana door ku lahayd taageeridda dhaqdhaqaaqii Shabia ee Eritrea iyo TPLF. Eedeymahaas waa aragtida Abadula, mana uusan soo bandhigin caddeymo cusub oo lagu xaqiijinayo. Waxay sidoo kale kusoo beegmayaan xilli xiriirka Itoobiya iyo Masar uu sii xumaanayo, iyadoo labada dal ay isku hayaan arrimo ay ka mid yihiin webiga Nile iyo danaha gobolka. Abadula ayaa sheegay in markii isku dayo militari oo lagu wiiqayo Itoobiya ay guuldarreysteen, waxa uu ugu yeeray cadowga dalka ay u wareegeen taageeridda kooxo gudaha ka shaqeeya. Wuxuu ku dooday in arrimahaas ay ugu dambeyn qeyb ka noqdeen go’aamo dhaawacay danaha Itoobiya, oo ay ku jirto luminta marin ay toos ugu gaarto badda. Cadaadiska marin-badeedka Hadalka Abadula ayaa yimid maalmo kadib markii ra’iisul wasaare Abiy Ahmed uu mar kale ku celiyay in Itoobiya ay sii wadi doonto dadaallada ay ku raadineyso marin badeed. Abiy, oo Isniintii loo dhaariyay muddo xileed cusub oo shan sano ah, ayaa baarlamaanka u sheegay in Addis Ababa ay arrinta ku raadin doonto hannaan ku dhisan “wax is dhaafsi” iyo wada-xaajood. “Annaga oo ku saleyneyna mabda’a wax is-dhaafsiga, waxaan si adag uga shaqeyn doonnaa in Itoobiya ay hesho marin badeed,” ayuu yiri Abiy Axmed. Madaxweynaha Itoobiya Taye Atske Selassie ayaa isna Talaadadii sheegay in dowladdu ay sii xoojineyso dadaallada ku aaddan helitaanka marin badeed, iyadoo Addis Ababa ay arrinta ku xireyso danaha dhaqaale iyo kuwa istaraatiijiyadeed ee dalka. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa dhinaceeda sheegtay in aysan kasoo horjeedin in Itoobiya ay hesho marin ganacsi oo ay ku isticmaasho dekedaha Soomaaliya, balse waxay ku adkeysatay in heshiis kasta uu ku yimaado wada-xaajood rasmi ah oo dhex mara labada dowladood, isla markaana uu dhowro madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa dhowaan sheegay in Muqdisho ay diyaar u tahay in Itoobiya loo oggolaado isticmaalka laba ama saddex dekedood oo Soomaaliyeed oo ay wax kala soo degto ama ka dhoofiso, laakiin Addis Ababa aysan weli soo gudbin codsi rasmi ah oo qeexaya nooca marin-badeed ee ay doonayso. Arrinta ayaa weli ah mid xasaasi ah gobolka, gaar ahaan kadib markii Soomaaliya, Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan ay shir ka dhacay New Alamein ku adkeeyeen in maamulka iyo arrimaha ammaanka Badda Cas ay masuuliyaddiisu gaar u tahay dalalka xeebaha leh. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya ayaa maalintii xigtay ku jawaabtay in dood kasta oo ku saabsan Badda Cas ay tahay inay tixgeliso waxa ay ugu yeertay “xaqiiqada juqraafiyeed” iyo “danaha qaranka ee sharciga ah” ee Itoobiya. Abadula ayaa taageeray habka dowladda Abiy ay hadda u waddo arrinta, isagoo sheegay in marin-badeed lagu raadiyo wada-hadal nabadeed, dano wadaag iyo heshiis labada dhinacba wax ku helayaan. Hase yeeshee, hadalkiisa ah in “cidna aysan ka hor istaagi karin” Itoobiya marin badeed ayaa sii xoojinaya farriinta Addis Ababa ee ah in arrintan aysan u arkin oo keliya baahi ganacsi oo ku-meel-gaar ah, balse ay tahay dan qaran oo muddo dheer sii jiri doonta. The post Itoobiya: Ma jirto cid naga hor-istaagi karta in aan bad helno appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sooyaal: Dr. Cali Khaliif Galaydh
items.description: 8dii Oktoobar 2020, waxaa magaalada Jigjiga ku geeriyooday, Alle ha u naxariistee, Dr. Cali Khaliif Galaydh, oo ahaa aqoonyahan, dawladyaqaan iyo siyaasi Soomaaliyeed oo sooc ah. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ahaa Ra’iisalwasaarihii Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka ahayd, Wasiirkii Hore ee Warshadaha, bare jaamacadeed iyo hoggaamiyihii Maamulka SSCaKhaatumo (oo hadda ah Dawlgoboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee Waqooyibari). Sooyaalkiisa nololeed wuxuu isaga kala gooshay marxalado badan oo muhiim u ahaa taariikhda Soomaaliya, sida: xilligii gobannimadu curdanka ahayd, dhismihii hay’adaha qaranka, mashaariicdii waaweynaa ee horumarinta iyo waxsoosaarka, taliskii militariga, noloshii qurbaha ee aqoonyahannada Soomaaliyeed, shirarkii dibuheshiisiinta, dibuyagleeliddii dawladnimada iyo halgankii siyaasadeed ee degaannada Sool, Sanaag iyo Cayn. Bilowgii Noloshiisa Dr. Cali Khaliif Galaydh 15kii Oktoobar 1941kii ayuu ku dhashay magaalada Laascaanood ee gobolka Sool. Yaraantiisii, Galaydh, wuxuu ku qaatay waqooyiga Soomaaliya. Waxbarashadiisii hore kaddib wuxuu galay Dugsiga Sheekh, oo xilligaas ka mid ahaa goobihii ugu mudnaa ee lagu barbaariyay jiilkii loo diyaarinayay maamulka iyo hoggaaminta dawlad Soomaaliyeed oo dhalanaysay. 1962kii ayuu dhammaystay waxbarashadii Dugsiga sare ee Sheekh, dabadeedna waxbarasho jaamacadeed ayuu u aaday Maraykanka. 1965kii wuxuu Boston University ka qaatay shahaaddada heerka koowaad ee jaamacadda, isaga oo bartay cilmiga siyaasadda. Kaddib wuxuu waxbarashada sare ka sii watay  Maxwell School of Citizenship and Public Affairs ee Syracuse University.  Halkaas ayuu ku bartay maamulka dadweynaha iyo siyaasadda, kuna qaatay shahaadooyinka sare ee jaamacadda, ugu danbaynna heerka  PhD . Waxbarashadaasi waxay qayb weyn ka qaadatay garaad qaabayntiisa. Maamulka dawladda, siyaasadda guud iyo dhismaha hay’adaha ayaa noqday kuwo mar kasta dib uga muuqanayay hawlihiisii danbe. Maamulkii dawladda iyo SIPA : Markii uu Soomaaliya ku soo noqday, Galaydh wuxuu ka shaqeeyay maamulka dawladda, waxaana muddadii danbe hawshiisu si gaar ah ugu xirantay  Somali Institute of Public Administration — SIPA, Machadkii Maamulka Dadweynaha Soomaaliyeed. Wuxuu ka shaqeeyay qaybaha tababbarka iyo cilmibaarista, dabadeedna wuxuu noqday Agaasimaha Guud ee machadka. Shaqadii SIPA waxay ka mid ahayd waayihii salka u dhigay khibraddiisa maamul. Machadku wuxuu ku hawlanaa tababbarka shaqaalaha dawladda, kobcinta aqoontooda iyo tayeynta maamulka hay’adaha. Galaydh, sidaas awgeed, wuxuu ka muuqday oo foolaad u ahaa jiilkii aqoonyahannada ahaa ee rumaysnaa in dawladnimadu aysan ku koobnayn dhismaha hay’ado, ayse u baahantahay hawlkareen aqoon leh, hannaan maamul oo shaqaynaya iyo hay’ado leh karaan ay hawlahooda ku gutaan. Warshaddii Sonkorta Jowhar : 1974kii ayaa loo dhiibay maamulka Warshaddii Sonkorta Jowhar, oo markaas ka mid ahayd xarumaha waxsoosaar ee ugu waaweynaa Soomaaliya. Halkaas ayuu Galaydh ka helay waaya-aragnimo ballaaran oo la xiriira maaraynta shaqaalaha, waxsoosaarka, maaliyadda iyo hawlgelinta warshad weyn. Khibraddaasi waxay u gogolxaaryay inuu ka qaybqaato mashruuc ka sii ballaarnaa oo xilligaas Soomaaliya laga hirgelinayey. Mashruucii Sonkorta Jubba : Dabayaaqadii 1970meeyadii Galaydh, wuxuu noqday Guddoomiyaha Fulinta ee Mashruucii Sonkorta Jubba ee Mareerey. Mashruucaasi wuxuu ka mid ahaa mashaariicdii ugu waaweynaa ee warshadeed ee Soomaaliya ka socday. Waxaa loogu talaggalay kordhinta waxsoosaarka sonkorta, shaqa-abuurka iyo xoojinta awoodda waxsoosaar ee dhaqaalaha dalka. Marka sooyaalkiisa dib loo raaco, waayahan waxaa mararka qaarkood hareeya siyaasaddii uu markii danbe ku caanbaxay. Hasayeeshee, Galaydhka siyaasiga waxaa ka horreeyay Galaydhkii maamulaha, qorsheeyaha iyo madaxii mashaariicda waaweyn ahaa. Wasiirkii Warshadaha : 1980kii waxaa Cali Khaliif Galaydh loo magacaabay Wasiirka Warshadaha Soomaaliya. Xilkaasi wuxuu ku soo beegmay xilli ay dalka ka socdeen dadaallo lagu ballaarinayay warshadaha iyo waxsoosaarka gudaha, iyadoo dhinaca kalana ay soo kordhayeen culaysyo dhaqaale iyo kuwo siyaasadeed. Wuxuu xilkaas hayay ilaa 1982kii. Khilaafkii siyaasadeed ee sii xoogaysanayay ayuu ugu danbayn dalka uga baxay, waxaana halkaas uga billaabmay cutub kale oo noloshiisa ah, oo aan ugu yeeri karno “waayihii qurbaha ee aqoonyahanka”. Harvard iyo Cilmibaaristiisa : Markii uu Maraykanka ku noqday, Galaydh wuxuu ku biiray xarumo cilmibaariseed oo ka tirsan Harvard University, gaar ahaan kuwa ku hawlanaa arrimaha caalamiga ah iyo daraasaadka Bariga Dhexe. Wuxuu muddadaas ku foogganaa cilmibaaris la xiriira siyaasadda, colaadaha, maamulka iyo xaaladaha Afrika. Dabayaaqadii 1980meeyadii, wuxuu, sidoo kale, lataliye u noqday hay’ado iyo shirkado kala duwan, oo ay ku jireen hay’ado horumarineed iyo kuwo caalami ah. 1989kii ayuu dib ugu noqday Syracuse University, halkaas oo uu sannado badan ka ahaa bare. Maamulka dadweynaha, xiriirka caalamiga ah iyo siyaasadda guud ayaa ka mid ahaa meelihii aqooneed ee uu ka shaqaynayay. Waxaa caadyaal ah in uu isaga kala gudbay laba aafaaq oo waaweyn oo kala ah: aqoonta iyo siyaasadda. Galaydh iyo Dr. Mariam Abdi Bihi: Lammaanihii Tacliinta ku Midoobay Noloshiisa qoyseed waxaa qayb weyn ka ahayd xaaskiisa, Dr. Mariam Abdi Bihi, oo iyaduna ahayd aqoonyahanad Soomaaliyeed. Mariam waxay waxbarashadeedii hore ku soo qaadatay dhinaca beeraha, dabadeedna bartamihii 1980meeyadii ayay waxbarasho sare u aaday Maraykanka. Waxay, dhinaca kale, ka soo shaqaysay dhinacyada shaybaadhka iyo waxbarashada jaamacadeed.  Cali Khaliif Galaydh iyo Mariam waxay dabayaaqadii 1980meeyadii isku guursadeen magaalada Boston. Noloshooda qoys waxay sannado badan ku xirnayd dunida jaamacadaha iyo aqoonta ee Maraykanka, gaar ahaan Harvard iyo Minnesota. Carta iyo Dibuyagleeliddii Dawladnimada Sannadkii 2000, ayuu Galaydh ka qaybgalay Shirkii Dibuheshiisiinta Soomaaliyeed ee Carta, Jabuuti. Shirkaasi wuxuu ka mid ahaa iskudayadii ugu waaweynaa ee lagu doonayay in dib loogu yagleelo dawlad Soomaaliyeed burburkii 1991 kaddib. Waxaa ka dhashay Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka Qaranka, ee Madaxweynaha loo doortay Cabdiqaasin Salaad Xasan. 8dii Oktoobar 2000 ayuu Madaxweyne Cabdiqaasim Cali Khaliif Galaydh u magacaabay Ra’iisalwasaaraha Soomaaliya. Galaydh wuxuu sidaas ku noqday Ra’iisalwasaarihii ugu horreeyay ee Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka Qaranka. Waxay ahayd masuuliyad timid xilli dalku ku jiray xaalad aad u adag. Hay’adihii qaranku burbur ayay ka soo kabanayeen, kooxo hubaysan ayaana qaybo badan oo dalka ka mid ah gacanta ku hayey. Awoodda dawladda cusubna aad ayay u koobnayd. Xukuumaddii Galaydh waxay u xusulduubtay dibudhiska hay’adaha qaranka, fidinta awoodda dawladda iyo raadinta taageero caalami ah. 19kii Oktoobar 2001dii, isaga oo weli Ra’iisalwasaare ah, Galaydh wuxuu Golaha Ammaanka ee Qarammada Midoobay ka codsaday taageero xooggan oo lagu garab-istaago dibudhiska nabadda iyo dawladnimada Soomaaliya. 28kii Oktoobar 2001, ayuu Baarlamaanku kalsoonidii kala noqday xukuumaddiisa, sidaas ayayna ku soo dhammaatay Ra’iisalwasaaranimadiisii socotay sannad iyo labaatan maalmood. Minnesota: Kunoqoshadiisii Macallinimada Markii uu xilka ka tegay, Galaydh, wuxuu dib ugu noqday Maraykanka. Wuxuu wax ka dhigay  Humphrey Institute of Public Affairs ee University of Minnesota,  halkaas oo uu ardayda kula wadaagay aqoontii iyo waaya-aragnimadii uu ka soo ururiyay maamulka, horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo siyaasadda. Minnesota waxay noqotay degaan uu muddo dheer ku noolaa isaga iyo qoyskiisu. Sooyaalkiisa waxaa ka muuqdaa in markii uu siyaasadda ka lugbaxo uu aqoonta ku noqon jiray; markii duruufaha dalku u gacanhaadiyaanna uu siyaasadda uu dib ugu soo laaban jiray. Siyaasaddii Federaalka 2012kii ayuu Galaydh mar kale si toos ah ugu soo noqday siyaasadda Soomaaliya, isaga oo xubin ka noqday Baarlamaanka Federaalka ah. Wuxuu u tartamay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, haseyeeshee waxaa doorashada kaga guulaystay Maxamed Sheekh Cismaan Jawaari. Galaydh intaas kaddib kama uusan bixin fagaaraha siyaasadda. Doodihiisu waxay si gaar ah ugu sii jeedeen qaabdhismeedka Federaalka, qaybsiga awoodda iyo mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee degaannada Sool, Sanaag iyo Cayn. Waxaa lagu xusuusan doonaa inuu ahaa siyaasi hadal cad, doodkar ah, go’aan-adag oo leh af siyaasadeed u gaar ah. Waxa uu ku tilmaannaa in uu yahay nin waxa uu qabo si cad ah u yiraahda, taas oo marna u soo hoynaysay taageero, marna dhalinaysay muran. Sida hoggaamiye kasta oo muddo dheer siyaasadda ku jiray, Galaydh wuxuu lahaa go’aanno lagu bogaadiyay iyo kuwo lagu dhaliilay. Waxqabadkiisa waxaa ka mid ahaa maamulkii hay’adaha dawladda, hoggaamintii mashaariicdii sonkorta, waxbariddii jaamacadaha, qaybtii uu ka qaatay dibuyagleelidda dawladnimada iyo dadaalkii uu ku bixiyay in degaannada SSC-Khaatumo ay yeeshaan cod siyaasadeed iyo metelaad dhab ah. Geeridiisii 8dii Oktoobar 2020 ayuu Dr. Cali Khaliif Galaydh ku geeriyooday magaalada Jigjiga. Waxay ahayd taariikh xusuus gaar ah ku leh sooyaalkiisa: 8dii Oktoobar 2000 ayuu labaatan sannadood ka hor noqday Ra’iisalwasaaraha Soomaaliya; 8dii Oktoobar 2020 ayuuna godgalay. Meydka marxuunka ayaa loo soo qaaday magaalamadaxda dalka ee Muqdisho, halkaas oo lagu aasay. Waxaa sagootintiisa ka qaybgalay madaxda dawladda, siyaasiyiin iyo dadweyne aad u badan.  Ugu danbayntii, taariikhda Dr. Cali Khaliif Galaydh waa muraayad laga daawan karo qayb weyn oo ka mid ah sooyaalka dawladnimada Soomaaliyeed lixdankii sannadood ee ugu danbeeyay.
items.fullContent: 8dii Oktoobar 2020, waxaa magaalada Jigjiga ku geeriyooday, Alle ha u naxariistee, Dr. Cali Khaliif Galaydh, oo ahaa aqoonyahan, dawladyaqaan iyo siyaasi Soomaaliyeed oo sooc ah. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ahaa Ra’iisalwasaarihii Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka ahayd, Wasiirkii Hore ee Warshadaha, bare jaamacadeed iyo hoggaamiyihii Maamulka SSCaKhaatumo (oo hadda ah Dawlgoboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee Waqooyibari). Sooyaalkiisa nololeed wuxuu isaga kala gooshay marxalado badan oo muhiim u ahaa taariikhda Soomaaliya, sida: xilligii gobannimadu curdanka ahayd, dhismihii hay’adaha qaranka, mashaariicdii waaweynaa ee horumarinta iyo waxsoosaarka, taliskii militariga, noloshii qurbaha ee aqoonyahannada Soomaaliyeed, shirarkii dibuheshiisiinta, dibuyagleeliddii dawladnimada iyo halgankii siyaasadeed ee degaannada Sool, Sanaag iyo Cayn. Bilowgii Noloshiisa Dr. Cali Khaliif Galaydh 15kii Oktoobar 1941kii ayuu ku dhashay magaalada Laascaanood ee gobolka Sool. Yaraantiisii, Galaydh, wuxuu ku qaatay waqooyiga Soomaaliya. Waxbarashadiisii hore kaddib wuxuu galay Dugsiga Sheekh, oo xilligaas ka mid ahaa goobihii ugu mudnaa ee lagu barbaariyay jiilkii loo diyaarinayay maamulka iyo hoggaaminta dawlad Soomaaliyeed oo dhalanaysay. 1962kii ayuu dhammaystay waxbarashadii Dugsiga sare ee Sheekh, dabadeedna waxbarasho jaamacadeed ayuu u aaday Maraykanka. 1965kii wuxuu Boston University ka qaatay shahaaddada heerka koowaad ee jaamacadda, isaga oo bartay cilmiga siyaasadda. Kaddib wuxuu waxbarashada sare ka sii watay  Maxwell School of Citizenship and Public Affairs ee Syracuse University.  Halkaas ayuu ku bartay maamulka dadweynaha iyo siyaasadda, kuna qaatay shahaadooyinka sare ee jaamacadda, ugu danbaynna heerka  PhD . Waxbarashadaasi waxay qayb weyn ka qaadatay garaad qaabayntiisa. Maamulka dawladda, siyaasadda guud iyo dhismaha hay’adaha ayaa noqday kuwo mar kasta dib uga muuqanayay hawlihiisii danbe. Maamulkii dawladda iyo SIPA : Markii uu Soomaaliya ku soo noqday, Galaydh wuxuu ka shaqeeyay maamulka dawladda, waxaana muddadii danbe hawshiisu si gaar ah ugu xirantay  Somali Institute of Public Administration — SIPA, Machadkii Maamulka Dadweynaha Soomaaliyeed. Wuxuu ka shaqeeyay qaybaha tababbarka iyo cilmibaarista, dabadeedna wuxuu noqday Agaasimaha Guud ee machadka. Shaqadii SIPA waxay ka mid ahayd waayihii salka u dhigay khibraddiisa maamul. Machadku wuxuu ku hawlanaa tababbarka shaqaalaha dawladda, kobcinta aqoontooda iyo tayeynta maamulka hay’adaha. Galaydh, sidaas awgeed, wuxuu ka muuqday oo foolaad u ahaa jiilkii aqoonyahannada ahaa ee rumaysnaa in dawladnimadu aysan ku koobnayn dhismaha hay’ado, ayse u baahantahay hawlkareen aqoon leh, hannaan maamul oo shaqaynaya iyo hay’ado leh karaan ay hawlahooda ku gutaan. Warshaddii Sonkorta Jowhar : 1974kii ayaa loo dhiibay maamulka Warshaddii Sonkorta Jowhar, oo markaas ka mid ahayd xarumaha waxsoosaar ee ugu waaweynaa Soomaaliya. Halkaas ayuu Galaydh ka helay waaya-aragnimo ballaaran oo la xiriira maaraynta shaqaalaha, waxsoosaarka, maaliyadda iyo hawlgelinta warshad weyn. Khibraddaasi waxay u gogolxaaryay inuu ka qaybqaato mashruuc ka sii ballaarnaa oo xilligaas Soomaaliya laga hirgelinayey. Mashruucii Sonkorta Jubba : Dabayaaqadii 1970meeyadii Galaydh, wuxuu noqday Guddoomiyaha Fulinta ee Mashruucii Sonkorta Jubba ee Mareerey. Mashruucaasi wuxuu ka mid ahaa mashaariicdii ugu waaweynaa ee warshadeed ee Soomaaliya ka socday. Waxaa loogu talaggalay kordhinta waxsoosaarka sonkorta, shaqa-abuurka iyo xoojinta awoodda waxsoosaar ee dhaqaalaha dalka. Marka sooyaalkiisa dib loo raaco, waayahan waxaa mararka qaarkood hareeya siyaasaddii uu markii danbe ku caanbaxay. Hasayeeshee, Galaydhka siyaasiga waxaa ka horreeyay Galaydhkii maamulaha, qorsheeyaha iyo madaxii mashaariicda waaweyn ahaa. Wasiirkii Warshadaha : 1980kii waxaa Cali Khaliif Galaydh loo magacaabay Wasiirka Warshadaha Soomaaliya. Xilkaasi wuxuu ku soo beegmay xilli ay dalka ka socdeen dadaallo lagu ballaarinayay warshadaha iyo waxsoosaarka gudaha, iyadoo dhinaca kalana ay soo kordhayeen culaysyo dhaqaale iyo kuwo siyaasadeed. Wuxuu xilkaas hayay ilaa 1982kii. Khilaafkii siyaasadeed ee sii xoogaysanayay ayuu ugu danbayn dalka uga baxay, waxaana halkaas uga billaabmay cutub kale oo noloshiisa ah, oo aan ugu yeeri karno “waayihii qurbaha ee aqoonyahanka”. Harvard iyo Cilmibaaristiisa : Markii uu Maraykanka ku noqday, Galaydh wuxuu ku biiray xarumo cilmibaariseed oo ka tirsan Harvard University, gaar ahaan kuwa ku hawlanaa arrimaha caalamiga ah iyo daraasaadka Bariga Dhexe. Wuxuu muddadaas ku foogganaa cilmibaaris la xiriira siyaasadda, colaadaha, maamulka iyo xaaladaha Afrika. Dabayaaqadii 1980meeyadii, wuxuu, sidoo kale, lataliye u noqday hay’ado iyo shirkado kala duwan, oo ay ku jireen hay’ado horumarineed iyo kuwo caalami ah. 1989kii ayuu dib ugu noqday Syracuse University, halkaas oo uu sannado badan ka ahaa bare. Maamulka dadweynaha, xiriirka caalamiga ah iyo siyaasadda guud ayaa ka mid ahaa meelihii aqooneed ee uu ka shaqaynayay. Waxaa caadyaal ah in uu isaga kala gudbay laba aafaaq oo waaweyn oo kala ah: aqoonta iyo siyaasadda. Galaydh iyo Dr. Mariam Abdi Bihi: Lammaanihii Tacliinta ku Midoobay Noloshiisa qoyseed waxaa qayb weyn ka ahayd xaaskiisa, Dr. Mariam Abdi Bihi, oo iyaduna ahayd aqoonyahanad Soomaaliyeed. Mariam waxay waxbarashadeedii hore ku soo qaadatay dhinaca beeraha, dabadeedna bartamihii 1980meeyadii ayay waxbarasho sare u aaday Maraykanka. Waxay, dhinaca kale, ka soo shaqaysay dhinacyada shaybaadhka iyo waxbarashada jaamacadeed.  Cali Khaliif Galaydh iyo Mariam waxay dabayaaqadii 1980meeyadii isku guursadeen magaalada Boston. Noloshooda qoys waxay sannado badan ku xirnayd dunida jaamacadaha iyo aqoonta ee Maraykanka, gaar ahaan Harvard iyo Minnesota. Carta iyo Dibuyagleeliddii Dawladnimada Sannadkii 2000, ayuu Galaydh ka qaybgalay Shirkii Dibuheshiisiinta Soomaaliyeed ee Carta, Jabuuti. Shirkaasi wuxuu ka mid ahaa iskudayadii ugu waaweynaa ee lagu doonayay in dib loogu yagleelo dawlad Soomaaliyeed burburkii 1991 kaddib. Waxaa ka dhashay Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka Qaranka, ee Madaxweynaha loo doortay Cabdiqaasin Salaad Xasan. 8dii Oktoobar 2000 ayuu Madaxweyne Cabdiqaasim Cali Khaliif Galaydh u magacaabay Ra’iisalwasaaraha Soomaaliya. Galaydh wuxuu sidaas ku noqday Ra’iisalwasaarihii ugu horreeyay ee Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka Qaranka. Waxay ahayd masuuliyad timid xilli dalku ku jiray xaalad aad u adag. Hay’adihii qaranku burbur ayay ka soo kabanayeen, kooxo hubaysan ayaana qaybo badan oo dalka ka mid ah gacanta ku hayey. Awoodda dawladda cusubna aad ayay u koobnayd. Xukuumaddii Galaydh waxay u xusulduubtay dibudhiska hay’adaha qaranka, fidinta awoodda dawladda iyo raadinta taageero caalami ah. 19kii Oktoobar 2001dii, isaga oo weli Ra’iisalwasaare ah, Galaydh wuxuu Golaha Ammaanka ee Qarammada Midoobay ka codsaday taageero xooggan oo lagu garab-istaago dibudhiska nabadda iyo dawladnimada Soomaaliya. 28kii Oktoobar 2001, ayuu Baarlamaanku kalsoonidii kala noqday xukuumaddiisa, sidaas ayayna ku soo dhammaatay Ra’iisalwasaaranimadiisii socotay sannad iyo labaatan maalmood. Minnesota: Kunoqoshadiisii Macallinimada Markii uu xilka ka tegay, Galaydh, wuxuu dib ugu noqday Maraykanka. Wuxuu wax ka dhigay  Humphrey Institute of Public Affairs ee University of Minnesota,  halkaas oo uu ardayda kula wadaagay aqoontii iyo waaya-aragnimadii uu ka soo ururiyay maamulka, horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo siyaasadda. Minnesota waxay noqotay degaan uu muddo dheer ku noolaa isaga iyo qoyskiisu. Sooyaalkiisa waxaa ka muuqdaa in markii uu siyaasadda ka lugbaxo uu aqoonta ku noqon jiray; markii duruufaha dalku u gacanhaadiyaanna uu siyaasadda uu dib ugu soo laaban jiray. Siyaasaddii Federaalka 2012kii ayuu Galaydh mar kale si toos ah ugu soo noqday siyaasadda Soomaaliya, isaga oo xubin ka noqday Baarlamaanka Federaalka ah. Wuxuu u tartamay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, haseyeeshee waxaa doorashada kaga guulaystay Maxamed Sheekh Cismaan Jawaari. Galaydh intaas kaddib kama uusan bixin fagaaraha siyaasadda. Doodihiisu waxay si gaar ah ugu sii jeedeen qaabdhismeedka Federaalka, qaybsiga awoodda iyo mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee degaannada Sool, Sanaag iyo Cayn. Waxaa lagu xusuusan doonaa inuu ahaa siyaasi hadal cad, doodkar ah, go’aan-adag oo leh af siyaasadeed u gaar ah. Waxa uu ku tilmaannaa in uu yahay nin waxa uu qabo si cad ah u yiraahda, taas oo marna u soo hoynaysay taageero, marna dhalinaysay muran. Sida hoggaamiye kasta oo muddo dheer siyaasadda ku jiray, Galaydh wuxuu lahaa go’aanno lagu bogaadiyay iyo kuwo lagu dhaliilay. Waxqabadkiisa waxaa ka mid ahaa maamulkii hay’adaha dawladda, hoggaamintii mashaariicdii sonkorta, waxbariddii jaamacadaha, qaybtii uu ka qaatay dibuyagleelidda dawladnimada iyo dadaalkii uu ku bixiyay in degaannada SSC-Khaatumo ay yeeshaan cod siyaasadeed iyo metelaad dhab ah. Geeridiisii 8dii Oktoobar 2020 ayuu Dr. Cali Khaliif Galaydh ku geeriyooday magaalada Jigjiga. Waxay ahayd taariikh xusuus gaar ah ku leh sooyaalkiisa: 8dii Oktoobar 2000 ayuu labaatan sannadood ka hor noqday Ra’iisalwasaaraha Soomaaliya; 8dii Oktoobar 2020 ayuuna godgalay. Meydka marxuunka ayaa loo soo qaaday magaalamadaxda dalka ee Muqdisho, halkaas oo lagu aasay. Waxaa sagootintiisa ka qaybgalay madaxda dawladda, siyaasiyiin iyo dadweyne aad u badan.  Ugu danbayntii, taariikhda Dr. Cali Khaliif Galaydh waa muraayad laga daawan karo qayb weyn oo ka mid ah sooyaalka dawladnimada Soomaaliyeed lixdankii sannadood ee ugu danbeeyay.

items.title: Somalia: Laftagaren forces take Qansah-dhere, west of Baidoa
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Forces loyal to Abdiasis Laftagaren, Somalia’s former Southwest leader, captured the strategic town of Qansah-dhere in the Bay region on Thursday without a gunfight, local media reported. The town, 90 kilometers west of Baidoa, is the first to pass fully out of federal control since a military offensive launched by the Somali federal government on Baidoa removed Mr. Laftagaren from power in late March. Mr. Laftagaren, who still recognizes himself as the region’s legitimate president, plans to retake Baidoa, the region’s administrative capital, as tensions continue to mount. A minister in Mr. Laftagaren’s cabinet was also expected to arrive in Qansah-dhere after its fall, according to media reports. The federal government, meanwhile, continues to deploy additional troops to Baidoa to strengthen its defenses. Mr. Laftagaren’s forces have attacked the city multiple times, briefly capturing a number of neighborhoods and inflicting losses on federal troops and their regional allies. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Mucaaradka oo si adag u cambaareeyay safarrada Xasan Sheekh ee laba dal oo col ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag uga hadlay safarradii uu dhawaan Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku tegay Itoobiya iyo Masar, isagoo dhaliilay kulamadii uu halkaasi kula yeeshay hoggaamiyeyaasha dalalkaas. Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa sheegay inaysan habboonayn in Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya uu waqti isku dhow booqdo laba dal oo ay xilligan ka dhex taagan yihiin xiisado siyaasadeed oo culus. “Waxay ceeb ku tahay Soomaaliya iyo diblomaasiyadda in madaxweynuhu uu labo guruub oo xoog isaga soo horjeeda isku mar u tago,” ayuu yiri Sheekh Shariif. Sheekh Shariif ayaa muujiyay in Golaha Mustaqbalka uu kasoo horjeedo habkaasi, isagoo sheegay in siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee isbahaysiga ay ku dhisan tahay in aan dhibaatooyinka gudaha Soomaaliya lagu dhex darin khilaafaadka iyo loollanka ka jira gobolka. “Dalkii wuxuu kusoo koobnay hal gacan, mas’uuliyadaas haddii wax ka dhacaan dalka ama dagaal ka dhaco waxay taabaneysa hoggaanka dowladda iyo xukuumadda ka shaqeynaysa ee hantidii qaranka ku bixinaysa in dhiig la daadsho,” ayuu hadalkiisa sii raaciyay Shariifka. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya kaddib markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu safarro is-xigay ku tegay Itoobiya iyo Masar, halkaas oo uu kulamo kula yeeshay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Axmed iyo Madaxweynaha Masar Cabdulfataax Al-Sisi. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale kulan la yeeshay Madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki, iyadoo kulamadaasi ay dhacayeen xilli ay jiraan xiisado dhowr ah oo ka taagan Geeska Afrika iyo arrimaha la xiriira Badda Cas iyo Wabiga Nile. Sidoo kale, Madaxda Soomaaliya, Masar, Eritrea iyo Suudaan ayaa kulan wadajir ah ku yeeshay magaalada Alamein ee dalka Masar, kaasi oo lagu gaaray iskaashi ay yeeshaan dalalkaasi. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa si taban uga falcelisay kulankaasi, iyadoo arrinta ku tilmaantay mid ka hor imaanaysa mowqifkii ay filaysay in Soomaaliya ay ka qaadato xiriirka labada dal. Si kastaba, Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa ku adkeysanaya in Soomaaliya ay lahaato siyaasad arrimo dibadeed oo u gaar ah, isla markaana aysan qayb ka noqon loollanka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya quwadaha iyo dowladaha gobolka. The post Mucaaradka oo si adag u cambaareeyay safarrada Xasan Sheekh ee laba dal oo col ah appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dozens Feared Hit as Al-Shabaab Clashes With Residents in Hiiraan
items.description: Heavy fighting has erupted in Tardo, Hiiraan region, between Al-Shabaab militants and local residents, following an armed confrontation in the center of the area, according to local officials and residents. The fighting reportedly broke out after Al-Shabaab fighters attempted to confiscate a weapon from a local resident. The confrontation escalated into an exchange of gunfire that subsequently spread to other parts of Tardo, the area’s local administration told Risaala Media. Residents said Al-Shabaab fighters opened fire on civilians who were in the center of the area, resulting in multiple reported casualties. Initial reports indicate that more than 10 people may have been killed or injured, although the figure has not been independently verified. Tardo is a busy commercial hub, particularly on Thursdays, when traders and residents from parts of Hiiraan and Middle Shabelle travel to the area for commerce and other activities. The violence has disrupted movement and raised concerns over the safety of civilians and traders in the area. Details about the casualties and the current security situation remain unclear, with reports from Tardo continuing to emerge. items.title: Qabsashada xoogaga Laftagareen ee Qansaxdheere oo aan u wanaagsanayn Aadan Madoobe
items.description: Ciidamada u daacadda ah Ex Madaxweyne Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa maanta si buuxda ula wareegay gacan ku haynta Degmada Qansaxdheere ee Gobolka Baay, iyadoo aanu wax iska horimaad ah ka dhicin degmadaasi. Magaalada ayaa waxaa ku sugnaa ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, kuwaas oo gabaad weydiistay Ciidanka Itoobiya ee ka tirsan Hawlgalka AUSSOM, halkii ay ahayd inay ka hortaggaan ciidamada soo hujuumay degmadaasi. In degmo dhan oo ka tirsan Gobolka Baay si fudud looga la wareego maamulka ayaa waxay calaamad u tahay in ciidamadii ku sugnaa degmada ay u xagliyeen garabka Laftagareen, inkastoo aysan muuqan inay ku biireen. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen ee la wareegay Qansaxdheere ay ka yimaadeen dhinaca Magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoo labada magaalo ay isku jiraan qiyaastii 98km. La wareegitaanka Degmada Qansaxdheere ayaa waxay xoojineysaa difaaca iyo fariisimaha ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen ee Gobolka Baay. Tani ayaa waxay sidoo kale muujineysaa in Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ee Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu hoggaamiyo ay yar tahay taageeradeeda ciidan ee lagu difaaci karo deegaanada ka baxsan Xarunta Gobolka Baay ee Baydhabo. In Maamulka Aadan Madoobe laga fara-maroojiyo Degmada Qansaxdheere ayaa direysa farriin ah in dagaalku uu ka gudbay Magaalada Baydhabo, marka aad eegto in taageereyaasha Laftagareen ay si gaar ah hadaf uga dhiganayeen magaaladaasi. Ciidamada ka amarka qaata Laftagareen oo 8-dii bishii May bilaabay in ay bartilmaameed ka dhigtaan Baydhabo iyo nawaaxigeeda ayay bartilmaameedyadoodu ku koobnaayeen Baydhabo iyo agagaarkeeda, iyadoo aysan jirin goob kale oo ka baxsan oo ay weerareen, illaa Khamiistan ay la wareegeen Qansaxdheere. Maadaama ay Baydhabo tahay Xarunta Ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ahna meesha ay ku yaallaan Xarumaha Maamulka ee Madaxtooyada iyo Baarlamaanka ayaa loo maleynayaa inay taasi tahay sababta ay diiradda u saarayeen. Qabsashada garabka Laftagareen ee Qansaxdheere ayaa ku soo beegmeysa, xilli Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu riixayo gogol nabadeed iyo dib-u-heshiisiin dadka reer Koonfur Galbeed ah, oo uu doonayo in xal lagaga gaaro khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo midka ciidan ee kala dhexeeya hoggaankii hore ee maamulka. Tallaabada lagu la wareegay Qansaxdheere ayaa waxay dadka qaarkii u fasiran karaan in Laftagareen iyo siyaasiyiinta xulafada la ah ay xalka siyaasadeed u marayaan dhabo aan ahayn wada hadal iyo gorgortan siyaasadeed. Dhaqdhaqaaqyada ciidan ee sii xoogeysanaya ee ka jira Gobolka Baay ayaa halis gelin kara masiirka maamulka cusub ee Aadan Madoobe. Cabdicasiis Laftagareen oo weli ku adkeysanaya in uu yahay Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaan aqoonsanayn madaxtinimada Aadan Madoobe, wuxuuna horey ugu hanjabay in ay xoog dib ugu la wareegi doonaan hoggaanka maamulka, isagoo daba jooga in sifo baalmarsan sharciga xilka looga qaaday.

items.title: Itoobiya ‘oo khiyaano’ ku eedeysay Xasan Sheekh kadib shirkii..
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa si adag uga fal-celisay mowqifka Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee ku aaddan bayaankii kasoo baxay shirkii ay Soomaaliya, Masar, Ereteriya iyo Suudaan, 4-tii Oktoobar ku yeesheen magaalada Al-Calamayn ee dalka Masar, kaas oo lagu soo qaaday xiisadda ka taagan Wabiga Nile. Madaxda afarta dal ayaa si weyn u adkeeyay muhiimadda ixtiraamka sharciga caalamiga ah ee nidaamiya webiyada xuduudaha ka gudba, oo uu ku jiro webiga Niil, gaar ahaan mabda’a ah inaan waxyeello la geysan, iyo waajibka iskaashiga ee loo marayo wargelin horudhac ah, wadatashi iyo isku-raac; iyadoo si buuxda loo diidayo tallaabo kasta oo hal dhinac uu qaado, taas oo si taban u saamaynaysa isticmaalka biyaha ee hadda ka jira labada dal ee ku yaalla qaybta hoose ee webiga Niil. Wakaaladda Wararka Itoobiya oo warbixin soo saartay ayaa ku eedeysay Xasan Sheekh inuu taageeray tallaabooyin ay sheegtay inay dhaawacayaan danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee Itoobiya, gaar ahaan kuwa la xiriira isticmaalka biyaha Wabiga Nile iyo arrimaha amniga Badda Cas. Warbixinta oo ciwaan looga dhigay “Khayaamada Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh waxa ay wax u dhimeysa xaqiiqooyinka gobolka” waxayna Itoobiya ku dooday in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu si dadban u taageerayo mowqif siyaasadeed oo lagu xaddidayo doorka Itoobiya ee gobolka. Itoobiya ayaa dhinaca kale soo hadal qaaday xiriirka dheer ee kala dhexeeya Soomaaliya, iyadoo tilmaantay inay kaalin wayn ay ka qaadatay arrimaha dib-u-heshiisiinta Soomaaliya iyo taageerada ciidamada Itoobiya ay siiyaan Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan la dagaallanka Al-Shabaab. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in taageerada uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh u muujiyey bayaanka Al-Calamayn ay keeni karto in dib loo eego xiriirkii amni iyo iskaashi ee Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya soo dhex maray sannado badan. Dhanka kale, warbixinta Itoobiya ayaa dhaliil loogu jeediyay Madaxweynaha dalka Ereteriya, Isaias Afwerki, iyadoo qoraagu ku dooday in doorka Ereteriya ee shirka Al-Calamayn uu u muuqday mid u janjeera dhanka danaha Masar, gaar ahaan arrimaha la xiriira biyaha Niilka. Si kastaba, Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer khilaaf kala dhexeeyey Masar iyo Suudaan oo ku saabsan maamulka iyo isticmaalka biyaha Niilka, iyadoo muranka ugu weyn uu yahay Biyo-xireenka weyn ee Itoobiya oo Masar iyo Suudaan ay walaac ka muujiyeen saameyntiisa. Waxaa kale oo jirta in Itoobiya oo aan lahayn xeeb ay sannadihii u dambeeyey aysi weyn u muujineysay baahida ay u qabto marin-badeed ganacsi, arrintaas oo qayb ka noqotay siyaasadda dibadda ee Addis Ababa iyo xiriirrada ay la sameysay dalalka gobolka. items.title: In Defense of Western Civilization
items.description: Author: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio There are great ruins all across the world. In many cases, they are places where history seems to have exhausted itself: remnants of distant cultures that have long passed beyond living memory. But the Acropolis is different. For thousands of years, the civilization that built what stands behind me has captivated the imagination of the Western world. Generations of our statesmen, artists, and philosophers have looked to it – they’ve looked to it with wonder and they’ve looked to it with awe. Now time has a tendency to dull the senses: great victories and catastrophic defeats, they seem to shrink to becoming like a footnote in a textbook, another fact for our schoolchildren to memorize and forget. But the Greeks of antiquity, they seem to have an almost mystical hold on our memory. They call us back to them, again and again. 480 years before Christ, the armies of Xerxes arrived in this city and they put its sanctuaries to the torch. Most Athenians had by then evacuated by ship to a nearby island. But there was a handful of them that refused to leave their home. So instead, they barricaded themselves in the rocky fortress of the Acropolis to fight an extraordinary last stand, heaving massive stones down the cliffs onto the Persian invaders and holding the greatest empire of the age at bay for days. They were eventually overwhelmed. The Persians plundered the temples, burned the shrines, and razed the Acropolis to the ground but when the Athenians returned, they gathered the broken remains of the old Acropolis and buried them in the hill where it had stood. And decades later, under Pericles, they raised the Parthenon. For 25 centuries since, the Parthenon has stood. Empires have risen and fallen beneath its shadow. And the progeny of the men who built it – the sons of Athens and Rome – have carried their civilization with them to the ends of the Earth. Two and a half centuries after the founding of the American republic halfway across the world from where I stand now – I stand here today as the Secretary of State of that republic, and a great-grandson of settlers who arrived in the new world from Spain – I stand here to testify to a debt that no lapse of time, no distance of space can ever extinguish. The history of America, the history of my country, is covered with the fingerprints of antiquity. Greece is literally carved into the architecture of our government: in the towering columns, in the domes and the monuments across our capital city. The city where our Constitution was born – Philadelphia – is itself a Greek name. The men who founded my country were fascinated by the heritage we inherited from yours. They were exceptionally well-read in history – they were vividly aware of their unique place in it – but no other age of the past held their attention or their imagination quite like that of antiquity. Many, many people are surprised to learn that the most commonly cited author in the Federalist Papers was not an Enlightenment philosopher or political theorist. No, the most commonly cited author in the Federalist Papers was Plutarch, the Greek biographer of Greece and Rome’s great men. Now, much has been written and said about the influence of ancient Greece on the ideas of the American Founders – and, for that matter, on all of the Western philosophers and statesmen that preceded them. Most of us are familiar with the basic history. Athens gave us democracy. Plato and Aristotle gave us Western philosophy. Our ideas of law, of virtue, of citizenship, and republican government were shaped in the Greek city-states. Even much of our political vocabulary – words like democracy, tyranny, the word “politics” itself – found its origins here. Now, all of that is true. But the things we owe to this place – as Americans, and as Westerners – are actually far far deeper. These institutions and ideas – these institutions and ideas were the outward expression of more fundamental qualities we see in the ancient Greeks – qualities that can’t be reduced to any particular political system or theory. Here, in Athens, we found the first full realization of all the essential traits that would come to define the West: fierce individuality and relentless ambition; daring exploration and invention; a yearning for discovery, for adventure, risk and glory. An insatiable curiosity about the world and the principles by which it operates, a hunger to know the mysteries of nature and grasp the secrets of the cosmos. An impatience with the notion of impossibility, chafing at all boundaries and limits, straining to peer into the depths of the unknown. These were not just the formulas or precepts of a particular school of philosophy. They were the characteristic of a people – expressed in their traditions, their stories, their imagination; in the qualities they demanded of their citizens; in the things they lived and fought and died for. To know them is to know ourselves. What blossomed here in this place was the Western desire to uncover all that ignorance, darkness, and distance had kept hidden from the mind of man. The Greeks did not just shape history; the Greeks gave us history itself. Much about – much of what we know about many ancient civilizations comes almost entirely from the records of Greek explorers and historians, explorers and historians who didn’t just chronicle the histories of their own people, but ventured outwards to observe and record the sagas of foreign peoples and cultures all across the world. Where others looked inward, the Greeks were the first to direct their focus outward, to chase the thrill and glory of seeing all that was strange and new. It was this trait – it was this trait that would push the West to create and build things that others could not, marking us out from so many other cultures and civilizations where stability and subsistence were the highest ends of life. But it is not just the ambition to explore the unknown that we inherit from the Greeks; it is the conviction that the unknown can be known. The confidence that the world can be charted and measured and mapped and understood – and that there is a rational order to the cosmos, governed by certain fundamental laws, laws that men can observe and the mind can come to understand. This was the foundation of the Western mind: our math, our science, our medicine. Our philosophy, ethics, and religion. It paved the way for the gospel of Jesus Christ to find fertile soil in Europe and flourish into the empire of Christendom. It was the foundation of the riches of Christian theology – of Augustine and Aquinas and the whole tradition of natural law. It gave birth to a civilization marked not just by a common culture, it was marked by a common anthropology – a common view of man and his place in the universe. Its descendants would share not just the idea of a natural order, but a distinctive understanding of virtue; of destiny and fate; of truth, goodness, and beauty; of a code that dictates how men ought to live; of objective standards and ideals to strive towards. For the Greeks of antiquity, the pursuit of excellence was the very principle of man’s existence. They organized all of civic life around contest, ambition, competition: in philosophy and poetry, in sculpture and drama, in athletics and art, in war and statecraft. The classical Greek city was an arena for great men to test and prove themselves, to hone their potential through perpetual struggle – to be the best, the strongest, the most beautiful, straining to inch ever closer to perfection. Now I know that to modern ears, what I just described, this way of life, may sound odd; it may even sound cruel. The ideal of many ideologies in our time has, frankly, become a world of perfect safety, devoid of risk or failure, with neither the glory of victory nor the shame of defeat. Too often these days, we build downwards. We design our standards to ensure no one will lose; we preoccupy ourselves more with the comfort of the worst than the potential of the best. We hold the most exceptional things among us hostage to the average, the ordinary, the mediocre. The men who made the Parthenon, they built upwards. They held that the highest and most noble aspiration in life was to surpass all others, to strive to be the best in all things. The ancient Greek city-states were filled. They were filled with intense passion and rivalry and faction and conflict. But from that constant struggle for distinction – from that came the great flowering of art and philosophy and political and intellectual energy that would transform a collective of Mediterranean cities into the birthplace of the greatest civilization in the world. The thumos, as the ancient Greeks called it – the fire of passion, strength, courage, pride – is the heart of great civilization. And without it? Without it, nations lose their will to fight, the will to strive, the will to survive.     Today, too much of the West has forgotten this quality. Over time, we in the West came to feel ashamed of the very things that made us exceptional. We felt embarrassed that our achievements set us apart from the rest of the world. items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo shaacisay waji cusub oo uu galay dagaalka Baydhaba + Video
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Wasiirrada Koonfur Galbeed oo maanta shir ku yeeshay Baydhaba ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda amni ee deegaanada maamulkaasi, gaar ahaan dagaallada u dhexeeya ciidamada ammaanka iyo kuwa daacadda u ah Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Koonfur Galbeed, Nuur Siidow Baaba oo ka warbixiyay kulanka ayaa sheegay in dagaalka uu galay waji cusub, isagoo ku eedeeyay ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen inay qorsheynayaan weerarro ay ka fuliyaan deegaanno kale oo ka tirsan Koonfur Galbeed, kaddib markii uu sheegay inay ku fashilmeen isku dayo ay ka sameeyeen magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. Nuur Siidow ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in maamulka Koonfur Galbeed uu sameeyay diyaar-garow xooggan oo looga hortagayo weerarro iyo falal amni-darro oo ka dhacay halkaasi. Waxaa kale oo uu intaasi ku daray in ciidamada ammaanka iyo hay’adaha amniga ay heegan sare ku jiraan, si looga hortago isku day kasta oo lagu carqaladeynayo amniga iyo xasilloonida deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed. “Sida caadada ah qolyaha Khawaarijta markii meel looga adkaado waxay isku dayaan inay carqaladeyn ku sameeyaan deegaanno kale, taasina waxaa jirta diyaar garow aad iyo aad u xooggan oo loogu diyaar garoobay sidii looga hortagi lahaa,” ayuu yiri wasiirka warfaafinta. items.title: Madasha indheer’garadka Somaliland oo guul ku tilmaamay safarka Madaxweynaha Somaliland
items.description: WAR-SAXAAFADEED MADASHA INDHEER-GARADKA SOMALILAND (SIO) SAFARKII MADAXWEYNAHA SOMALILAND EE MARAYKANKU WUXUU AHAA GUUL DIBLOMAASIYADEED OO QARANKA U SOO HOYATAY Madasha Indheer-Garadka Somaliland (SIO), oo xogogaal u ah dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu baadi-goobayo aqoonsiga caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, waxay si kalsooni leh u caddaynaysaa in safarkii Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), uu ahaa safar guul diblomaasiyadeed oo muhiim ah u soo hooyey qaranka Somaliland. Safarka Madaxweynuhu ma ahayn mid loogu talagalay in aqoonsi rasmi ah isla markiiba lagaga soo helo Maraykanka oo keliya, balse wuxuu ahaa olole diblomaasiyadeed oo ballaadhan oo lagu horumarinayey qadiyadda aqoonsiga Somaliland, laguna dhisayay xidhiidho siyaasadeed, dhaqaale iyo istaraatiiji ah oo lala yeesho Maraykanka iyo dalal kale oo badan oo ka qaybgalayey shirarka Qaramada Midoobay. Intii uu safarku socday, Madaxweynuhu wuxuu kulammo muhiim ah la yeeshay masuuliyiin ka tirsan dawladda Maraykanka, xubno ka tirsan Congress-ka, madax ka socday dalal kala duwan, safiiro iyo maal-gashadayaal caalami ah. Sida xogta ay Madashu hayso, kulammadaas qaarkood waxay ahaayeen kuwo diblomaasiyadeed oo aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin, balse qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu ballaadhinayo xidhiidhada iyo saaxiibbada Somaliland. SIO, oo qayb muuqata ka qaadatay ololaha aqoonsi-raadiska, isla markaana ku dhowaad 160 waraaqood u kala dirtay madaxda dalalka adduunka, waxay safarkan u aragtaa mid Somaliland u furay xidhiidho cusub, fursado dhaqaale iyo waddooyin diblomaasiyadeed oo muhiim u ah mustaqbalka qaranka. Waxaanu sidoo kale shacabka Somaliland la wadaagaynaa in ololaha aqoonsi-raadisku aanu ku joogsanayn safarkan, balse la sii xoojin doono, lana filayo safarro kale oo badan, kulammo heer sare ah iyo dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo joogto ah oo lala yeelanayo madaxda dalalka caalamka. Madashu waxay shacabka Somaliland ugu bishaaraynaysaa in qadiyadda aqoonsigu ay marayso marxalad muhiim ah oo rajo leh, isla markaana ay jiraan dadaallo iyo xidhiidho caalami ah oo laga filayo inay mustaqbalka dhow dhaliyaan guulo la taaban karo. AQOONSI-RAADISKU WAA MASUULIYAD QARAN OO MUWAADIN KASTA U FURAN Madasha Indheer-Garadka Somaliland (SIO) waxay ugu baaqaysaa dhammaan shacabka Somaliland, meel kasta oo ay dunida ka joogaan, inay si firfircoon uga qayb qaataan ololaha aqoonsi-raadiska qaranka. Uma baahnid inaad Madaxweyne, Wasiir ama Xildhibaan noqoto si aad aqoonsiga dalkaaga ugu ololeyso. Waa qadiyad qaran oo u furan muwaadin kasta oo aaminsan madax-bannaanida iyo xaqa aayo-ka-tashiga Somaliland. Guusha diblomaasiyadda laguma cabbiro oo keliya aqoonsiga hal maalin lagu dhawaaqo, balse waxaa lagu cabbiraa albaabbada la furay, xidhiidhada la dhisay iyo fursadaha qaranka loo abuuray. Aqoonsiga Somaliland waa qadiyad ina wada khusaysa, guushiisuna waxay u baahan tahay midnimo, dadaal joogto ah iyo ka-qaybgalka muwaadin kasta. Mohamed Ali Gudoomiyaha MADASAHA INDHEER-GARADKA SOMALILAND (SIO) Courage • Unity • Sovereignty • Wisdom

items.title: Al-Shabaab oo shacab ku laayay Hiiraan iyo sababta
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Ugu yaraan shan qof ayaa ku dhintay, sagaal kalena way ku dhaawacmeen, kaddib markii rag hubeysan oo ka tirsan Al-Shabaab ay rasaas ku fureen suuq ku yaalla deegaanka Tardo ee gobolka Hiiraan. Ilo wareedyo deegaanka ah ayaa innoo sheegay in dhacdadan ay timid kaddib markii rag ka tirsan Al-Shabaab ay suuqa yimaadeen, iyagoo isku dayay inay qoriga ka dhigaan nin hubeysan oo goobta ku sugnaa, kaas oo la sheegay inuu diiday inuu hubka dhigo, waxyna taas keentay in halkaasi ay ka bilaabato iska horimaad iyo tacshiirad xooggan. Rasaasta ayaa sababtay dhimashada shanta qof iyo dhaawaca sagaal kale, sida ay sheegeen ilo deegaanka ah, waxaana dadka dhaawacmay loo qaaday goobo caafimaad si loogu dabiibo. Xaaladda ayaa hadda ah mid deggan, mana jiro wax hadal ah kasoo baxay dhinaca Al-Shabaab oo ku aadan shaqaaqada ka dhacday halkaasi. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli haaran deegaanka iyo guud ahaan gobolka Hiiraan ay ka socdaan dadaallo lagu doonayo in lagu xoojiyo amniga iyo wada shaqeynta bulshada deegaanka. Maalmo kahor ayay sidoo kale ahayd markii ay heshiis gaareen odayaal ka tirsan beesha Xawaadle iyo Al-Shabaab, kaas oo lagu sheegay mid nabadeed oo lagu soo afjarayo colaaddii ka dhexeysay beesha iyo Khawaarijta oo horay ugu dagaalamay Gobolka Hiiraan. Heshiiskaasi ayaa kusoo aaday, xilli ay deegaannada Gobolka Hiiraan ka socdeen dadaallo lagu doonayo in mar kale dib loogu abaabulo howlgallo wadajir ah oo ay gobolka ka fuliyaan maleeshiyaadka deegaanka iyo ciidamada dowladda ee ku sugan gudaha gobolkaasi. The post Al-Shabaab oo shacab ku laayay Hiiraan iyo sababta appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo Kampala kaga qeybgalay shir looga hadlay hawlgallada aan dagaalka ahayn
items.description: Kampala, Uganda — Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada Kampala kaga qeybgalay Shirka 1-aad ee Taliyeyaasha Difaaca Afrika ee Hawlgallada Milatari ee aan Dagaalka ahayn (MOOTW). Shirka oo muddo saddex maalmood ah socday ayaa diiradda lagu saaray doorka ciidamada ee hawlgallada aan dagaalka ahayn, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin taageerada bulshada, ilaalinta nabadda, gurmadka musiibooyinka iyo ka jawaabista xaaladaha degdegga ah. Waxaa shirka ka qeybgalay taliyeyaasha ciidamada iyo saraakiil sare oo ka kala socday dalal Afrikaan ah, Midowga Afrika, ururrada goboleed iyo hay’adaha ku howlan hawlgallada nabad-ilaalinta. Intii uu socday shirka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadlay sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga, isku-duwidda iyo wada shaqeynta ciidamada Afrika, gaar ahaan marka ay timaaddo hawlgallada milatari ee ka baxsan dagaallada caadiga ah. Madaxweynaha Uganda, Yoweri Kaguta Museveni, ayaa shirka soo xiray, isagoo khudbaddiisa ku adkeeyay muhiimadda iskaashiga iyo isku-duwidda ciidamada Afrika si loo horumariyo awoodda qaaradda ee wax ka qabashada xaaladaha degdegga ah, musiibooyinka iyo hawlgallada nabad-ilaalinta. Ka qeybgalka Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga ee Soomaaliya ay kula leedahay dalalka Afrika iyo hay’adaha qaaradda.

items.title: Qiimaha shidaalka Soomaaliya oo mar kale kor u kacaya
items.description: Muqdisho, 8 Oktoobar 2026 — Qiimaha shidaalka ee Soomaaliya ayaa maalmahan laga dareemayaa koror cusub, iyadoo ganacsatada qaar ay litirka shidaalka ku iibinayaan qiime u dhexeeya $1.15 ilaa $1.17, halka meelo ka mid ah dalka laga soo sheegayo inuu gaaray $1.19 halkii litir. Maalmo ka hor, qiimaha shidaalka ayaa ahaa ku dhowaad $1.10 halkii litir, taas oo ka dhigan in muddo kooban gudaheed uu suuqu mar kale kor u kacay. Kororkaan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli suuqa caalamka ee shidaalka uu weli wajahayo cadaadis ka dhashay xiisadaha Bariga Dhexe iyo khataraha ku saabsan maraakiibta iyo marinnada muhiimka ah ee shidaalka. Soomaaliya waxay si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay shidaalka la soo dejiyo, taasoo ka dhigaysa qiimaha gudaha mid si degdeg ah uga falceliya isbeddellada ka dhaca suuqa caalamka, kharashaadka maraakiibta iyo gaadiidka, iyo xaaladda amniga ee waddooyinka ganacsiga. Warbixinno hore oo ku saabsan Soomaaliya ayaa muujiyay in xiisadihii Bariga Dhexe ay horey u saameeyeen qiimaha shidaalka gudaha. Daraasad ay soo saartay Somali Public Agenda ayaa tilmaantay in Muqdisho qiimaha shidaalku xilliyadii hore ee xiisadda uu ka kacay $0.65 ilaa heer gaaraya $1.50 halkii litir. Kororka shidaalka kuma ekaanayo goobaha shidaalka oo keliya. Soomaaliya oo gaadiidka, korontada iyo ganacsiga intiisa badan ay si toos ah ama dadban ugu tiirsan yihiin shidaalka, koror ku yimaada litirka wuxuu kordhin karaa kharashaadka gaadiidka iyo adeegyada kale.

items.title: Afhayeenka Laftagareen: “Qasaxdheere maanta ayay dib ugu soo noqotay gacanta Koonfur Galbeed”
items.description: Afhayeenka madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen, ayaa sheegay in degmada Qasaxdheere ee gobolka Bakool ay maanta dib ugu soo laabatay gacanta ciidamada uu ugu yeeray Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed. Afhayeenka, Maxamed Xuseen Xasan, ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay baraha bulshada ku sheegay in degmada Qasaxdheere ay ciidamada Laftagareen la wareegeen maanta qeybtii hore ee maalinta. “Waxaan guud ahaan shacabka KGS ku wargelinaynaa in degmadii qadiimiga ahayd ee Qasaxdheere ay maanta dib ugu soo gashay gacanta dowladda KGS,” ayuu yiri afhayeenku. Wuxuu sheegay in shacabka iyo mas’uuliyiinta degmada Qasaxdheere ay si weyn u soo dhaweeyeen ciidamada, isagoo ciidamada ku tilmaamay “Daraawiishta KGS.” Afhayeenka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ciidamada iyo saraakiisha la socota ay yihiin dad deegaanka ah, ayna ka shaqeyn doonaan waxa uu ku tilmaamay dowladnimada iyo dib-u-soo-celinta maamulka.

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada oo maanta qaaday tallaabo culus kadib arrin soo korortay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, oo maanta yeeshay kulankooda toddobaadlaha ah, ayaa lagu soo bandhigay warbixinno kala duwan oo la xiriira, amniga, caafimaadka, doorashooyinka, ganacsiga iyo arrimo kale oo muhiim ah, iyaga oo sidoo kale qaaday tallaabo culus, si ooga hortago halista kasoo korortay ee gobolka ee ku aadan faafitaanka cudurka Ebola. Waaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada ayaa soo jeedisay warbixin ku saabsan xaaladda cudurka Ebola iyo tallaabooyinka looga hortagayo in cudurku soo gaaro dalka. Warbixinta kadib, Golaha Wasiiradda ayaa meel-mariyay qaraar ku saabsan sidii looga diyaar-garoobi lahaa cudurka safmarka ah ee Ebola, waxaana loo saaray guddi ka kooban 6 Wasaaradood oo uu guddoomiyanayo Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Labaad Mudane Jibriil Xaaji Cabdi, waxana ay kala yihiin Wasaaradaha Caafimaadka, Amniga, Arrimaha Dibedda, Gaadiidka, Warfaafinta iyo Xannaanada Xoolaha. Sidoo kale, shirka oo uu guddoominayey Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre, ayaa waxaa looga dhagaystay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka & dib-u-heshiisiinta, warbixin ku saabsan doorashooyinkii qof iyo cod ee ka qabsoomay Dowlad Goboleedyada Galmudug iyo Hirshabeelle, kuwaas oo si guul ah ku soo dhammaaday, iyada oo goluhu bogaadiyey habka dimoqraadiga ah ee ay dadweynuhu ugu dareereen doorashada, taas oo qeyb ka ah dedaalada xukuumadda ee la xiriira fulinta dastuurka jamhuuriyadda oo marayo marxaladdo kala duwan. Kulanka Wasiirrada ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo bandhigay warbixin ku saabsan faa’iidooyinka lagu helay kamid noqoshada Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC), taas oo xubinimadeeda laga dhaxlay in ardayda Soomaaliyeed ay jaamacadaha ku dhigtaan qidmadda go’an ee Bariga Afrika, halka dalxiisayaasha aanan laga qaadin lacagaha ajaaniibta kale. Sidoo kalena ganacsatada iyo xirfadleyaasha Soomaaliyeed ay fursad u heleen in aanan lala tiigsan xeerar cusub oo dalalka qaar ku mamnuuceen ajaaniibta. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda & Xiriirka Caalamiga ah, ayaa warbixinta ku sheegtay in ku biirista Bulshada Bariga Afrika, ay dadkeenna u fududeysay arrimaha degenaanshaha, socdaalka iyo caafimaadka, waxa ayna intaas ku dartay in markii ugu horreysay Soomaaliya loo sameeyay qoondo shaqaalaha joogtada ah ee Bulshada Bariga Afrika. Dhankeeda, Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, ayaa iyaduna Golaha Wasiirrada u soo bandhigtay warbixin ku saabsan halka uu marayo geeddi-socodka ku biirista Soomaaliya ee Ururka Ganacsiga Adduunka (WTO) oo soo socday muddo 10 sanadood ah, kaas oo maraya meel gebogebo ah, Soomaaliyana ay dhammaystireyso dhammaan shuruudihii looga baahnaa, oo ay ka mid tahay jaangoynta tariifooyinka badeedaha dibedda ka yimaadda iyo dhismaha hay’ado maamul. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre oo kulanka ka hadlay ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada kula dardaarmay in la dardargaliyo howlaha Xukuumadda DanQaran horyaalla ee mudnaanta u leh iyo xoojinta wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha Qaranka, si loo xaqiijiyo qorshayaasha dowladda ee sanadkan, gaar ahaan adeegyada la doonayo in la gaarsiiyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Ugu dambeyn, Golaha Wasiiradda ayaa ansixiyay Guddiga Shirkadda Kalluumaysiga Qaranka oo ka kooban 9 xubnood , kadib soo jeedinta Wasaaradda Kalluumaysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah. items.title: 17 Wasiir iyo 2 Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeen oo wajahaya kala doorashada Xildhibaannimada iyo Wasiirnimada
items.description: Muqdisho, 8 Oktoobar 2026 — Waxaa maalmo kooban ka harsan yihiin dhaqan-gelinta qodobbada Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee kala saaraya xildhibaannimada iyo xilka wasiirnimo, iyadoo arrintan ay si toos ah u saameynayso 16 wasiir oo ka tirsan Golaha Wasiirrada, kuwaas oo sidoo kale ah xildhibaanno. Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Dib-u-eegista iyo Hirgelinta Dastuurka ayaa sheegay in 14-ka Oktoobar 2026 ay dhaqan-gelayaan Qodobka 81aad, Faqraddiisa 1aad, xarafka (f), iyo Qodobka 117aad, Faqraddiisa 3(a). Qodobbadan ayaa kala saaraya labada xil. Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh) — Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta Maxamed Aadan Macallim Cali (Maxamed Soomaali) Wasiirka Isgaarsiinta iyo Tiknoolijiyada Saalim Caliyow Ibrow Wasiirka Shaqada iyo Arrimaha Bulshada. Cabdifataax Qaasim Maxamuud Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Abdisalam Abdi Ali — Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga Mohamoud Abdirahman Sheikh Farah (Beena Beene) — Wasiirka Qorshaynta, Maalgashiga iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha Khadija Mohamed Al-Makhzoumi — Wasiirka Haweenka iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka Abdullahi Sheikh Ismail (Fartaag) Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha Mohamed Abdi Hayir Mareye — Wasiirka Beeraha iyo Waraabka Wasiirka Deegaanka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada, Bashiir Maxamed Jaamac Hassan Hussein Mohamed (Elaay) Wasiirka Xannaanada Xoolaha iyo Daaqa Mohamed Farah Nuh — Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Ayuub Ismaaciil Yuusuf — Wasiirka Hawlaha Guud, Dib-u-dhiska iyo Guriyeynta. Bihi Iman Egeh — Wasiirka Maaliyadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Saalax Axmed Jaamac Wasiirka Beeraha iyo Waraabka ee Soomaaliya Maxamed Cabdi Xayir Ali Haji Adan Wasiirka Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada Abdullahi Bidhan Warsame Wasiirka Tamarta iyo Biyaha Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Labaad Jibriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji Cabdi

items.title: Ciidamada Laftagareen oo bilaa dagaal kula wareegay Degmada Qansaxdheere
items.description: Ciidamo Daraawiish ah, isla-markaana taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa Khamiistan la wareegay gacan ku haynta Degmada Qansaxdheere ee Gobolka Baay. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada ay bilaa dagaal kula wareegeen gacan ku haynta magaalada, iyadoo aan la soo sheegin wax iska horimaad ah oo ka dhacay. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in ciidamadii Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ee horey ugu sugnaa degmadaasi ay gabaad weydiisteen Militariga Itoobiya ee qaybta ka ah Ciidanka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Dadka deegaanka ayaa kuu sheegay in wax u muuqdo is bedel maamul uu ka dhacay Degmada Qansaxdheere, isla-markaana Ciidanka Itoobiya ee degan aysan ka hortagin ciidamada cusub ee soo galay degmadaasi. Qansaxdheere ayaa waxay noqoneysaa degmadii ugu horreysay ee ay la wareegaan taageereyaasha Laftagareen, tan iyo markii la riday amaba meesha la saaray hoggaankii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, 30-kii bishii March. Qabsashada Qansaxdheere ayaa waxay sii xoojineysaa loolanka awoodeed, maamul iyo midka ciidan ee billihii u dambeeyay ka jiray Koonfur Galbeed. Qansaxdheere waxay 98km dhanka koonfureed uga beegan tahay Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaan weli ka hadlin tallaabada uu garabka Laftagareen kula wareegay degmdaasi.

Warbaahinta Itoobiya oo wajahaysa jahwareer, kadib markii Xasan Sheekh…
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Warbaahinta Itoobiya ayaa haatan wajheysa jahwareer xooggan oo ka dhashay maqaal ka dhan ah Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo ay baahisay Wakaaladda Wararka dalkaasi ee ENA. Warbixinta oo ciwaan looga dhigay “Khiyaamada Xasan Sheekh waxa ay wax u dhimeysa xaqiiqooyinka gobolka” ayaa markii dambe laga saaray bogga Wakaaladda Wararka Itoobiya (ENA), iyadoo maqaalka si adag loogu dhaliilayay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya oo lagu eedeeyay inuu qaatay siyaasado ka hor imaanaya danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee Itoobiya. Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale ku dooday in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu si dadban u taageerayo mowqif siyaasadeed oo lagu xaddidayo doorka Itoobiya ee gobolka. Maqaalka ayaa waxaa qoray saxafi Gezmu Edicha, iyadoo lagu falanqeeyay mowqifka Soomaaliya ee arrimaha Badda Cas, Webiga Nile iyo xiriirka gobolka, kadib markii uu Xasan Sheekh ka qayb-galay shirkii ay Al-Calamayn ku yeesheen madaxda dalalka Soomaaliya, Masar, Ereteriya iyo Suudaan. Tirtirista maqaalka ayaa dhalisay su’aalo la xiriira sababta Wakaaladda Wararka Itoobiya (ENA) ay u qaaday tallaabadaas iyo in wakaaladdu bixin doonto sharaxaad rasmi ah oo ku saabsan sababta loo daabacay maqaalka, kaas oo loo arkayay inuu ka hor imaanayo aragtida madaxda Itoobiya. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Tirtirista maqaalka ENA ayaa ah arrin xasaasi ah, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay si muuqata u kordhisay xiriirrada ay la leedahay dalalka gobolka ee ku loollamaya saameynta siyaasadeed iyo amni ee gobolka Geeska Afrika. Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer khilaaf kala dhexeeyey dowladaha Masar iyo Suudaan, kaas oo ku saabsan maamulka iyo isticmaalka biyaha Nile, iyadoo muranka ugu weyn uu yahay Biyo-xireenka weyn ee Itoobiya oo Masar iyo Suudaan ay walaac ka muujiyeen saameyntiisa. Waxaa kale oo jirta in Itoobiya oo aan lahayn xeeb ay sannadihii u dambeeyey aysi weyn u muujineysay baahida ay u qabto marin-badeed ganacsi, arrintaas oo qayb ka noqotay siyaasadda dibadda ee Addis Ababa iyo xiriirrada ay la sameysay dalalka gobolka. Tirtirista maqaalka ayaa dhalisay su’aalo la xiriira sababta Wakaaladda Wararka Itoobiya (ENA) ay u qaaday tallaabadaas iyo in wakaaladdu bixin doonto sharaxaad rasmi ah oo ku saabsan sababta loo daabacay maqaalka, kaas oo loo arkayay inuu ka hor imaanayo aragtida madaxda Itoobiya. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Tirtirista maqaalka ENA ayaa ah arrin xasaasi ah, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay si muuqata u kordhisay xiriirrada ay la leedahay dalalka gobolka ee ku loollamaya saameynta siyaasadeed iyo amni ee gobolka Geeska Afrika. Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer khilaaf kala dhexeeyey dowladaha Masar iyo Suudaan, kaas oo ku saabsan maamulka iyo isticmaalka biyaha Nile, iyadoo muranka ugu weyn uu yahay Biyo-xireenka weyn ee Itoobiya oo Masar iyo Suudaan ay walaac ka muujiyeen saameyntiisa. Waxaa kale oo jirta in Itoobiya oo aan lahayn xeeb ay sannadihii u dambeeyey aysi weyn u muujineysay baahida ay u qabto marin-badeed ganacsi, arrintaas oo qayb ka noqotay siyaasadda dibadda ee Addis Ababa iyo xiriirrada ay la sameysay dalalka gobolka. items.title: Soomaalida oo Saameyn sii kordheysa ku yeelanaysa siyaasadda Itoobiya
items.description: Soomaalida ayaa sanadihii u dambeeyay si weyn uga dhex muuqday siyaasadda iyo maamulka sare ee dalka Itoobiya, iyadoo xubno Soomaali ah ay qabteen xilal muhiim ah oo ka tirsan Jagooyinka dowladda federaalka Itoobiya. Mid kamid ah tallaabooyinka ugu muhiimsan ayaa ahayd markii Axmed Shide loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Shacabka Itoobiya, kaddib markii loo magacaabay Wasiirka Maaliyadda dalka. Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Axmed ayaa dhisay xukuumaddiisa cusub, iyadoo Soomaalida Itoobiya ay ka heshay xil wasiirnimo oo muhiim ah, kaas oo qeyb ka ah hoggaanka dowladda dhexe ee fadhigeedu yahay Addis Ababa. Waxaa sidoo kale soo baxaya magacyo Soomaali ah oo loo saadaalinayo inay gaaraan xilal sare oo siyaasadeed, iyadoo Aadan Faarax lagu wado inuu kamid noqon karo hoggaanka sare ee xisbiga talada haya ee Itoobiya. Itoobiya waa dal ay ku nool yihiin qowmiyado badan, sidaas darteed ka mid noqoshada Soomaalida ee xilalka sare ee dowladda federaalka ayaa ah arrin si gaar ah looga hadal hayo gudaha bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee Itoobiya.

items.title: Maxaa looga Hadlay Kulankii Golaha Wasiirrada XFS ee Maanta ?
items.description: Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, oo maanta yeeshay kulankooda toddobaadlaha ah, ayaa lagu soo bandhigay warbixinno kala duwan oo la xiriira amniga, caafimaadka, doorashooyinka, ganacsiga iyo arrimo kale oo muhiim ah. Shirka oo uu guddoominayey Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa waxaa looga dhagaystay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta, warbixin ku saabsan doorashooyinkii qof iyo cod ee ka qabsoomay Dowlad Goboleedyada Galmudug iyo Hirshabeelle, kuwaas oo si guul ah ku soo dhammaaday, iyadoo Goluhu bogaadiyey habka dimoqraadiga ah ee ay dadweynuhu ugu dareereen doorashada, taas oo qayb ka ah dadaallada Xukuumadda ee la xiriira fulinta Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda oo maraya marxalado kala duwan. Kulanka Wasiirrada ayaa lagu soo bandhigay warbixin ku saabsan faa’iidooyinka lagu helay ka mid noqoshada Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC), taas oo xubinimadeeda laga dhaxlay in ardayda Soomaaliyeed ay jaamacadaha ku dhigtaan qidmadda go’an ee Bariga Afrika, halka dalxiisayaasha aan laga qaadin lacagaha ajaaniibta kale. Sidoo kale, ganacsatada iyo xirfadlayaasha Soomaaliyeed ay fursad u heleen in aan lala tiigsan xeerar cusub oo dalalka qaar ku mamnuuceen ajaaniibta. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda iyo Xiriirka Caalamiga ah ayaa warbixinta ku sheegtay in ku biirista Bulshada Bariga Afrika ay dadkeenna u fududeysay arrimaha degenaanshaha, socdaalka iyo caafimaadka, waxa ayna intaas ku dartay in markii ugu horreysay Soomaaliya loo sameeyay qoondo shaqaalaha joogtada ah ee Bulshada Bariga Afrika. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada ayaa soo jeedisay warbixin ku saabsan xaaladda cudurka Ebola iyo tallaabooyinka looga hortagayo in cudurku soo gaaro dalka. Warbixinta kadib, Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa meel mariyay qaraar ku saabsan sidii looga diyaar-garoobi lahaa cudurka safmarka ah ee Ebola, waxaana loo saaray guddi ka kooban 6 Wasaaradood oo uu guddoominayo Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Labaad, Mudane Jibriil Xaaji Cabdi, waxana ay kala yihiin Wasaaradaha Caafimaadka, Amniga, Arrimaha Dibedda, Gaadiidka, Warfaafinta iyo Xannaanada Xoolaha. Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha ayaa iyaduna Golaha Wasiirrada u soo bandhigtay warbixin ku saabsan halka uu marayo geeddi-socodka ku biirista Soomaaliya ee Ururka Ganacsiga Adduunka (WTO), oo soo socday muddo 10 sano ah, kaas oo maraya meel gebogebo ah, Soomaaliyana ay dhammaystireyso dhammaan shuruudihii looga baahnaa, oo ay ka mid tahay jaangoynta tariifooyinka badeecadaha dibedda ka yimaadda iyo dhismaha hay’ado maamul. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada kula dardaarmay in la dardargeliyo hawlaha Xukuumadda DanQaran horyaalla ee mudnaanta u leh iyo xoojinta wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha Qaranka, si loo xaqiijiyo qorshayaasha dowladda ee sanadkan, gaar ahaan adeegyada la doonayo in la gaarsiiyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Ugu dambeyn, Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa ansixiyay Guddiga Shirkadda Kalluumaysiga Qaranka oo ka kooban 9 xubnood, kadib soo jeedinta Wasaaradda Kalluumaysiga iyo Dhaqaalaha Buluugga ah.

items.title: Taliyaha Booliiska Soomaaliyeed oo soo Xiray Tababar ku saabsan Hoggaaminta iyo Maamulka
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliiska Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi , ayaa soo xiray tababar ku saabsan hoggaaminta wanaagsan oo loo qabtay saraakiil sare oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Booliiska Soomaaliyeed. Tababarka waxaa bixiyay khubaro ka socday Midowga Yurub (EUCAP) , waxaana saraakiisha lagu baray xeelado iyo istaraatiijiyado casri ah oo la xiriira maamulka iyo hoggaaminta. Intii uu tababarku socday, saraakiisha ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sidii ay ula jaanqaadi lahaayeen isbeddellada ka socda dunida casriga ah, gaar ahaan horumarka tiknoolajiyadda iyo sida looga faa’iideysan karo shaqada ciidanka iyo maamulka hay’adaha amniga. Taliyaha Booliiska Soomaaliyeed, Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa sheegay in horumarinta aqoonta iyo xirfadaha ciidamadu ay kamid tahay mudnaanta uu siinayo hoggaanka Booliiska Soomaaliyeed. Taliyuhu wuxuu sidoo kale xoogga saaray muhiimadda ay leedahay in tababarrada iyo aqoon-kororsiga la gaarsiiyo dhammaan heerarka kala duwan ee Ciidanka Booliiska, laga bilaabo askarta ilaa saraakiisha sare ee hoggaanka haya. Tababarkan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu horumarinayo awoodda iyo xirfadda Ciidanka Booliiska Soomaaliyeed, si ay ula jaanqaadaan hababka casriga ah ee hoggaaminta, maamulka iyo shaqada amniga.
