items.title: Shabaab iyo dad shacab ah oo ku dagaalamay deegaanka Tardo
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sheegaya in iska horimaad u dhexeeya dadka deegaanka iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab uu maanta ka dhacay deegaanka bariga Gobolka Hiiraan ku yaala ee Tardo. Iska horimaadkan oo lagu dilay afar nin oo ka tirsanaa maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ayaa ka dambeeyay carro ka dhalatay jirdil ay maleeshiyada Shabaab u gaysteen nin ka mid ahaa dadka deegaanka, oo ay xigtay dil ay u gaysteen saddex qof oo ka mid ahaa dadka deegaanka. “Dadka deegaanka ayaa ka carooday niman ka tirsan Al Shabaab oo jirdilayay wiil oo ay doonayeen inay qorigiisa ka qaataan. Markii ay dadka isku dayeen inay ka celiyaan rasaas ayay oodda uga qaadeen, waxaana halkaasi ku dhintay saddex qof, illaa toban qofna way ku dhaawacmeen.” Ayuu yiri nin ka mid ah dadka reer Tardo oo aan la hadalnay. Ninkan oo codsaday inaanan magaciisa la soo xigan, sababo amni awgood ayaa intaasi ku daray “Intaas ka dib dadka deegaanka qaarkood oo si qarsoodi ah hub ugu dhex haystay magaalada ayaa hubkoodii la soo baxay, waxayna dagaal toos ah la galeen Shabaabkii meesha joogay oo laga dilay afar nin.” Xaaladda deegaanka Tardo ayaa weli ah mid aad u kacsan, iyadoo Shabaabka sida booliska oo kale u tababaran ee lagu magacaabo Xisbada ay dibadda uga baxeen deegaankaasi. Tuulooyinka ku dhow dhow deegaanka ayaa waxaa ka jira kacdoon aad mooddo in ay dadka deegaanka ku diidan yihiin Al Shabaab. Dhanka kale Duqa Magaalada Beledweyne, haweeneyda lagu magacaabo Nadar Tabaax Maalin ayaa cambaareysay falka ay maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ku dileen dadka rayidka ah ee huriyay iska horimaadka. Nadar Tabaax Maalin ayaa dadka reer Hiiraan ugu baaqday inay u midoobaan, isla-markaana ay iska kaashadaan la dagaalanka bay tir Khawaarijta iyo ka hortagga dhagarta ay u maleegayaan shacabka. Shabaabka ayaa Tardo oo ku taala goob istiraatiji ah, waxay la wareegeen 13-kii bishii July ee sanadkii 2025.

items.title: Fal-celin aan caadi ahayn oo ka dhalatay kala saaridda xukuumadda iyo baarlamanka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Falcelin xooggan iyo hadal-heyn ayaa ka dhalatay go’aanka uu Arbacadii uu soo saaray Guddiga Madaxbannaan ee Dib-u-eegista iyo Hirgelinta Dastuurka oo shaaciyay in la kala saarayo xukuumadda iyo baarlamaanka, si loo dhaqan-geliyo dastuurka cusub ee ay horay u meel-mariyeen labada gole ee Baarlamaanka dalka. Qodobka 97-aad ee dastuurkii KMG ahaa ee 2012 oo oggolaanayay in xildhibaan uu kamid noqdo Golaha Wasiirrada, ayaa hadda meesha laga saaray, iyadoo la dhaqan-gelinayo nidaam kala saaraya labada xil. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Dastuurka, xubnaha Golaha Wasiirrada ee sidoo kale ah xildhibaanno ayaa loo sheegay inay kala doortaan labada xil, iyadoo muddada lixda bilood ah ee loo qabtay in qodobka cusub uu dhaqan-galo ay bilaabatay 14-kii April 2026, kuna eg tahay 14-ka bishaan October ee sanadka 2026-ka. “Wasiirka xildhibaan ah wuxuu luminayaa xubinnimada Golaha Wasiirrada. Sidoo kale, xildhibaanku wuxuu luminayaa xildhibaannimada haddii uu aqbalo xil kale oo dawli ah,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan kasoo baxay xafiiska Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxbannaan ee Dib-u-eegista iyo Hirgelinta Dastuurka, Avv. Burhaan Aadan Cumar Haddaba sidee looga fal-celiyay kala saaridda labada hay’adood? Cabdisamad Jayte: “Waa guul in la helo heyad fulin iyo mid sharci dajin oo leh awood korjoogteyn”. Maxamed Muumin Ibraahim: “Todobo maalin oo kaliya ayaa ka dhimman, bal aan aragno waxa isbeddala”. Cumar Xasan Cabdi: “Waa wax wanagsan waa in la kala saaro xildhibaan iyo wasiir hal qof isku ah, waana in Dastuurka cusub lagu dhaqmaa”. Farxaan Xasan Cismaan: “Waa guul laba muushaar in la’iska cuno ma jireyso mid u go’ waa go’aan fiican”. Cabdullahi Maxamuud Saney: “Qodobka ugu wanaagsan aad sameyseen waa kan kala saaraya labada hay’ad ee kala ah fullinta iyo sharci dejinta, waxaan rajeynayaa inuu fuli doono”. Qodobka 97-aad ee dastuurkii KMG ahaa ee 2012 oo oggolaanayay in xildhibaan uu kamid noqdo Golaha Wasiirrada, ayaa hadda meesha laga saaray, iyadoo la dhaqan-gelinayo nidaam kala saaraya labada xil. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Dastuurka, xubnaha Golaha Wasiirrada ee sidoo kale ah xildhibaanno ayaa loo sheegay inay kala doortaan labada xil, iyadoo muddada lixda bilood ah ee loo qabtay in qodobka cusub uu dhaqan-galo ay bilaabatay 14-kii April 2026, kuna eg tahay 14-ka bishaan October ee sanadka 2026-ka. “Wasiirka xildhibaan ah wuxuu luminayaa xubinnimada Golaha Wasiirrada. Sidoo kale, xildhibaanku wuxuu luminayaa xildhibaannimada haddii uu aqbalo xil kale oo dawli ah,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan kasoo baxay xafiiska Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxbannaan ee Dib-u-eegista iyo Hirgelinta Dastuurka, Avv. Burhaan Aadan Cumar Haddaba sidee looga fal-celiyay kala saaridda labada hay’adood? Cabdisamad Jayte: “Waa guul in la helo heyad fulin iyo mid sharci dajin oo leh awood korjoogteyn”. Maxamed Muumin Ibraahim: “Todobo maalin oo kaliya ayaa ka dhimman, bal aan aragno waxa isbeddala”. Cumar Xasan Cabdi: “Waa wax wanagsan waa in la kala saaro xildhibaan iyo wasiir hal qof isku ah, waana in Dastuurka cusub lagu dhaqmaa”. Farxaan Xasan Cismaan: “Waa guul laba muushaar in la’iska cuno ma jireyso mid u go’ waa go’aan fiican”. Cabdullahi Maxamuud Saney: “Qodobka ugu wanaagsan aad sameyseen waa kan kala saaraya labada hay’ad ee kala ah fullinta iyo sharci dejinta, waxaan rajeynayaa inuu fuli doono”. items.title: African Development Bank Group supports Somalia’s transition from recovery to sustainable development financing
items.description: The African Development Bank Group has reaffirmed its support for Somalia’s shift from aid dependence towards sustainable, private sector-led growth, backed by stronger domestic institutions and greater mobilisation of long-term development finance. The Bank gave this assurance at the Somali Development Finance Forum, convened in Mogadishu on 19 September by the Somali Development and Reconstruction Bank (SDRB) under the theme, “Financing Somalia’s Next Chapter: From Recovery to Sustainable Development.” First created in 1968 and re-established in 2014, the Somali Development and Reconstruction Bank is Somalia’s national development finance institution. Speaking during the opening session, the President of Somalia, Hassan Sheikh Mohamud said, “The Federal Government of Somalia is committed to advancing development finance that takes a long-term view – creating sustainable markets, strengthening the private sector and directing investment toward the productive sectors that will drive Somalia’s future growth.” Somalia’s Deputy Prime Minister, Salah Jama, argued that the country’s development finance transition requires building domestic capacity rather than simply seeking to replace aid. He outlined a financing model capable of mobilising sustainable public and private investment in sectors including agriculture, livestock, fisheries, renewable energy and small and medium-sized enterprises. Speaking on a panel on strengthening Somalia’s development finance architecture, African Development Bank Director General for East Africa, Alex Mubiru , called for a more disciplined investment pipeline and greater use of risk-mitigation instruments to unlock private capital. “Somalia’s sustainable development requires strong institutions that can mobilise long-term finance, attract private-sector investment, reduce perceived risks, and develop bankable investment pipelines that support job creation and lasting impact,” he said. Mubiru also urged Somalia to focus its resources on a few high-potential value chains that can create jobs, strengthen local production and deliver lasting development impact. SDRB enters a new era During the Forum, the SDRB signed financing partnership agreements with Asal Microfinance, Maal Microfinance and Himilo Microfinance under its Ramad Microfinance Programme, to expand access to Sharia-compliant financing for micro, small and medium-sized enterprises and productive sectors. President Mohamud said, “Today marks a historic moment. A public development bank in Somalia making its first investment is a clear sign of the progress our country is making in rebuilding its institutions and advancing its economic development.” The African Development Bank Group’s participation in the Somali Development Finance Forum builds on its longstanding partnership with Somalia, and the priorities in its Country Strategy Paper 2025–2030. These priorities aim to strengthen the foundations for productive investment, private-sector development, economic resilience, and employment. Strengthening institutions such as SDRB forms part of the broader effort to help Somalia build the financial architecture, investment pipelines and partnerships required to translate development finance into productive investment, jobs and sustainable economic growth. African Development Bank Group.

items.title: Maduro iyo Xaaskiisa oo Wajahaya Dacwado Cusub oo la xiriira jirdilka Muwaadiniin Mareykan ah
items.description: Xeer-ilaaliyeyaasha Mareykanka ayaa la filayaa inay dacwado cusub ku soo oogaan madaxweynihii hore ee Venezuela Nicolás Maduro iyo xaaskiisa Cilia Flores , kuwaas oo lagu eedeynayo inay door ku lahaayeen jirdil loo geystay muwaadiniin Mareykan ah oo lagu hayay xabsiyada Venezuela xilligii Maduro uu talada dalka hayay. Sida ay sheegtay CBS News , dacwadaha cusub ayaa la xiriira in ka badan toban muwaadin Mareykan ah oo dowladda Venezuela ay si sharci-darro ah u xirtay, iyadoo baarayaashu ay sidoo kale qiimeynayaan in dad kale lagu soo oogo dacwado la xiriira jirdilka la sheegay. Ilo xog-ogaal u ah baaritaanka ayaa sheegay in eedeymaha cusub lagu dhawaaqi karo sida ugu dhakhsaha badan Khamiista, 8-da Oktoobar 2026 . Si kastaba, qareenka Maduro, Barry Pollack, ayaa CBS u sheegay inuusan helin wax ogeysiis ah oo ku saabsan dacwadaha cusub ee la filayo. Maduro iyo Cilia Flores ayaa horay Mareykanka loogu soo oogay dacwado kale oo la xiriira shirqool lagu soo gelinayay kookayn gudaha Mareykanka , waxaana labadooduba iska fogeeyeen eedeymahaas. Maxkamad Mareykan ah ayaa tijaabada kiiskooda u qorsheysay Juun 2027. Wararka ku saabsan dacwadaha cusub ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Maduro iyo xaaskiisa ay weli ku jiraan xabsi federaal ah oo ku yaalla Brooklyn, iyadoo Cilia Flores ay maanta maxkamad ka dalbanayso in xabsiga laga sii daayo ama loogu beddelo xabsi guri sababo caafimaad awgood.

items.title: Somalia’s Fragmentation Deepens as Doolow District Defies Mogadishu
items.description: DOOLOW, GEDO (WDN) — Somalia’s political fragmentation is now reaching the district level. After prolonged disputes between Mogadishu and Puntland, Jubaland and South West State, a district administration in Gedo has now declared that it will follow Ethiopian security policies until a Somali government capable of exercising authority across the country emerges. The declaration came from Doolow District Commissioner Mohamed Hussein Abdi “Lafeey”, who made the remarks while inspecting local security forces and Jubaland Darawiish troops. Lafeey said Doolow would henceforth operate in accordance with the orders and policies of Ethiopian forces, arguing that the district could not simply wait for a functioning Somali government to assume responsibility for the country’s security and administration. “Until a capable Somali government is established that can take responsibility everywhere for our interests and the way we live, we will not wait for anyone. We will determine what is best for our people. We will also not implement a policy that Ethiopia does not approve of,” Lafeey sstated. The statement represents a striking challenge to the authority of the Federal Government in Mogadishu. It also exposes how Somalia’s prolonged political crisis is increasingly moving beyond disputes between the federal government and federal member states—and into the districts themselves. From Federal States to Districts For years, Somalia’s political confrontation has largely been framed as a struggle between Mogadishu and federal member states. Puntland has openly rejected several initiatives by the Federal Government. Jubaland has remained locked in a bitter political and security dispute with Mogadishu, while South West State has also become deeply embroiled in the country’s wider political crisis. Now the fragmentation is beginning to penetrate the administrative structures below the federal-state level. Doolow’s declaration is particularly significant because it places a district administration in a position of openly conditioning its cooperation with the Federal Government on the existence of a future Somali authority capable of exercising nationwide control. That is not merely a local security statement. It is a warning about how quickly the authority of the central government is eroding when political disagreements remain unresolved. Ethiopia’s Growing Role Lafeey also praised Ethiopian forces operating in the area and called on local security personnel to respect them. He said Ethiopian and local forces had coexisted in the region and argued that Ethiopia’s military presence had contributed to stability and security. “The two forces live alongside each other. We want these forces to be respected and treated as brothers because they have been in the country for more than 30 years, and what they are doing among us is maintaining stability and security,” he said. His remarks underscore the complicated security reality in Gedo, where local authorities and security forces have long operated in an environment shaped by cross-border military involvement, federal-state rivalry and competition over political authority. Gedo Once Again on the Edge The declaration comes as tensions have again intensified in Gedo, with reports of opposing military movements involving Federal Government forces and Jubaland’s Darawiish forces. The region has remained one of the most sensitive flashpoints in the dispute between Mogadishu and Jubaland, with political disagreements repeatedly spilling into security arrangements and local administration. The danger is that Somalia’s political crisis is no longer confined to constitutional negotiations in Mogadishu. It is increasingly being expressed through competing chains of command, competing security forces and competing claims to political authority on the ground. Puntland. Jubaland. South West State. And now individual districts. The pattern is becoming harder to dismiss as a series of isolated disputes. A country cannot remain politically united for long when its institutions disagree over who has authority, its states challenge the centre, and its districts begin deciding which external power’s policies they will follow. Doolow’s declaration should therefore be viewed against the much larger question confronting Somalia: How long can the Federal Government claim national authority when an increasing number of political and administrative actors are deciding for themselves whose authority they recognize? The answer may determine whether Somalia’s current political crisis remains a dispute over federalism and elections—or becomes a deeper fragmentation of the state itself. items.title: Somalia’s Election Crisis Takes a Dangerous Turn
items.description: MOGADISHU (WDN) — Security checkpoints now reportedly surround the roads leading to former President Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed’s residence, while opposition sources allege that cameras have been installed to monitor visitors—a striking escalation as Somalia remains deadlocked over the rules of its next election. The Federal Government has not publicly explained the reported security measures. The allegation about surveillance cameras has not been independently verified. But the developments have sharpened an already explosive political dispute. Sheikh Sharif accuses President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government of pursuing an electoral process without first securing agreement with the country’s principal political actors. He says the government is showing little readiness for genuine negotiations over the election, constitutional arrangements and the rules of political competition. He has also accused the government of “provocation” and of preparing for confrontation with the opposition—claims the government has not publicly substantiated or accepted. The former president’s warning is stark: political disputes already producing violence in some federal member states, he says, must not be allowed to spill into Mogadishu. “The federal member states have already been destroyed and fighting is taking place there; now you want to bring that fighting into the capital,” Sheikh Sharif said. The confrontation is increasingly about more than an election date. It is about who sets the rules, who controls the institutions and whether Somalia’s political leadership will agree on the process before the country votes. Opposition figures accuse President Hassan Sheikh of treating the election as an administration-led project rather than a national political settlement. That is an opposition characterization, not an independently established fact. Yet the question it raises is difficult to avoid: Can an election deliver legitimacy if the major political players cannot agree on the rules of the contest? Security Becomes Part of the Political Crisis The reported security restrictions around Sheikh Sharif have added a dangerous new dimension. People familiar with the situation say roads leading to his residence have been subjected to checkpoints and security personnel deployed around the area. Opposition sources separately allege that surveillance cameras are being used to monitor visitors. Those claims should not be conflated: the reported security deployment and the surveillance allegation come from different sources, and the camera claim remains unverified. The government has not publicly provided a detailed explanation. If the surveillance allegation is eventually confirmed, it would raise serious questions about whether ordinary political meetings and associations are being treated as security matters. Sheikh Sharif says the wider political environment is already moving in that direction. He has also warned against using security forces in political disputes, arguing that weapons and personnel should be directed toward fighting Al-Shabaab. “The weapons intended to fight Al-Shabaab are now being prepared to be used in Mogadishu,”  he said. That is Sheikh Sharif’s allegation, not independently verified evidence of government plans to attack the opposition. But it captures the fear now hanging over Mogadishu: that a political dispute over elections could gradually become a security confrontation. The UAE Dispute Sheikh Sharif has also rejected suggestions that his residence in the United Arab Emirates provides grounds for action against him. He confirmed that he lives in the UAE with his family and accused President Hassan Sheikh of using the country as a pretext to target him and other opposition figures. “Hassan Sheikh wants to legitimize shedding my blood by using the UAE as a pretext. I live in the UAE.” The accusation has not been independently established. But it adds another layer to Somalia’s increasingly bitter political contest, in which rival factions have repeatedly accused one another of foreign backing. The Moment of Choice President Hassan Sheikh now faces a defining political test: whether his government can bring the principal political stakeholders into a credible agreement on the rules of the next election. The opposition has its own responsibility to pursue its demands through political and constitutional means. But the fundamental problem remains unresolved. Somalia is approaching an election without consensus on the political framework under which that election is supposed to take place. And as security tightens around opposition figures, the political space for resolving that dispute appears to be narrowing. Somalia has experienced the consequences of political disagreements turning into armed confrontations before. It cannot afford another. An election should settle Somalia’s political crisis—not become the spark that reignites it. WardheerNews The post Somalia’s Election Crisis Takes a Dangerous Turn appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo Howlgal ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab ka Sameeyay Tuulooyin hoos taga Deegaanka Caad
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, kuwa deegaanka iyo Maamulka Degmada Xarardheere ayaa howlgal qorsheysan oo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab ka sameeyay tuulooyinka Jiracle iyo Hareeri Jimcaad , oo hoostaga deegaanka Caad ee degmada Xarardheere. Ciidamada ayaa gaaray goobihii la sheegay inay ku dhuumaaleysanayeen xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, iyagoo howlgalka ka sameeyay deegaannadaasi. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyay ammaanka tuulooyinka ay howlgalka ka sameeyeen, iyadoo tallaabadan qeyb ka tahay howlgallada lagu doonayo in lagu xoojiyo amniga deegaannada hoos yimaada degmada Xarardheere.

items.title: Abiy Axmed oo dhisay Xukuumadda Cusub iyo  Soomaalida heshay hal Wasiir
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Dalka Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed, ayaa dhisay xukuumadda cusub ee dalka, kaddib markii uu u billowday muddo-xileedkiisa cusub oo ah 5 sano. items.title: President Mustafe Omer: Eight Years of Power, Personalization of the System and Patronage
items.description: By Abdullahi A. Nor When Mustafe Omer came to power in August, 2018, he represented a break from the past. An activist and outspoken advocate for justice, accountability, and the rights of the Somali people, he was widely seen as the face of a new political era. Nearly eight years later, that promise has given way to a far more troubling question : Has the Somali Regional State become a government for its people—or a political system built around Mustafe Omer and his inner circle, not different from his predecessor Abdi Iley and his ruthless regime? Where is the institutional reform that was promised? Where are the stronger systems of accountability? What has been done to improve education, healthcare, public utility (water, and electricity), employment, and economic opportunity? And why, after eight years, do so many fundamental governance questions remain unresolved? Perhaps the most striking feature of Mustafe Omer’s political journey is the distance between the man who entered politics and the leader he has become. In 2018, Mustafe was known primarily as an activist—someone who challenged abuses of power, spoke for marginalized communities, and demanded greater accountability from those in government. Today, what was presented as a project of reform is not more than the personalization of the state. Political loyalty matters more than institutional independence, access to power is concentrated around those close to President Mustafe and public institutions has become an instruments for protecting political authority rather than serving citizens. The concern is not simply about one individual. It is about what happens when a government becomes dependent on one person and the network surrounding him. When officials owe their positions to political loyalty, they have little incentive to challenge the leadership. When institutions become extensions of the executive, accountability weakens. And when legitimate and genuine criticism is treated as disloyalty, public debate and freedom of speech begins to disappear. This is precisely why the record of the past eight years deserves much greater scrutiny. The issue extends beyond governance inside Jigjiga. There are growing concerns about the protection of Somali interests and territory, particularly amid continuing tensions and disputes involving Somali and Oromo areas. Questions surrounding the Oromo expansionist policy in Fafan and Daakhato, together with longstanding memories of Dire Dawa, Jinacsani, Babali, and Moyale, continue to fuel public anxiety, while Mustafe is looking the other way to protect his position and interest. Reliable reports indicate that Oromia’s territorial ambitions continues across the Somali Region, with Jigjiga, Tuli Guuleed, and other Somali-administered territories, raising serious concerns about the future integrity of Somali-administered territories. The people have a right to ask whether their government is doing enough to protect their territorial, political, and economic interests. Equally troubling is the shrinking space for freedom of speech. Mustafe built his reputation as an activist and critic of authoritarianism. Yet his administration’s treatment of dissenting voices, journalists, activists, political opponents, and social-media users has been deeply repressive. The government may legitimately act against incitement and violence, but legitimate criticism of those in power cannot simply be recast as a security threat. President Mustafe in the Oromo’s tradition A government cannot claim to represent the people while making its critics afraid to speak. And this is where the contradiction in Mustafe’s political journey becomes difficult to ignore : the activist who once challenged concentrated power now presides over a system of concentrating power around himself. The deeper concern is the emergence of a political patronage system—one in which loyalty creates access, access creates influence, and influence protects loyalty. That is how a public institution becomes a personal political network. Although the Somali Region operates within Ethiopia’s broader authoritarian political system, that reality cannot excuse President Mustafe from responsibility. He still has significant authority within the regional government and could have done far more to protect the interests of the Somali people, strengthen regional institutions, and assert the region’s legitimate political and economic rights. Other regional administrations, including the Oromo regional government, have demonstrated that regional leaders can exercise considerable political space within the federal system. The constraints imposed by Addis Ababa may be real, but they should not become a blanket justification for failing to fulfill the responsibilities of leadership. The Somali Region is not the property of its president. Its institutions do not belong to his supporters. Its public resources are not the private assets of those close to power. Government is a public trust. After nearly eight years, Mustafe should therefore be judged not by the promises he made when he entered office, but by the institutions he has built, the freedoms he has protected, the resources he has safeguarded, and the opportunities he has created for ordinary Somalis. The state itself has become personalized. And that should concern every Somali in the Somali State, who cares about the Somali region’s future. T he Somali Region must belong to its people—not to one man, one clan, or one political circle. From Activist to Gatekeeper The transformation from activist to president is not, in itself, a contradiction, Today, Mustafe occupies the very center of power. Activists can become leaders, and leaders can legitimately change their approach once they assume responsibility for governing. The real test, however, is whether the principles that brought them to prominence survive after they acquire power. That is where Mustafe’s record raises difficult questions. The man who once challenged political gatekeepers is now has become one himself. Instead of opening political space, his administration has increasingly concentrated decision-making around the presidency and a small circle of trusted political allies. Instead of empowering independent institutions, the system appears increasingly dependent on personal loyalty and proximity to power. The irony is difficult to miss: the activist who once demanded that government answer to the people now leads a government that his critics say increasingly expects the people to answer to it. This transformation matters because political power changes the relationship between the individual and the state. As an activist, Mustafe could challenge the government from outside. As president, he controls—or exercises substantial influence over—the institutions that shape political life inside the region. That places a far greater responsibility on him to protect the very freedoms and institutional safeguards that he once demanded from others. The question is therefore not whether Mustafe has changed. Every leader changes. The question is what happened to the principles he once represented? Where is the uncompromising commitment to accountability and public service? Where is the insistence that public institutions must serve citizens rather than political interests? Where is the protection of dissenting voices? Where is the conviction that government must be subject to scrutiny rather than scrutiny being treated as a threat? A political system should not require citizens to be loyal to those in power. Leaders should be accountable to citizens. That distinction is fundamental. When an activist becomes a gatekeeper, the danger is not merely personal contradiction. It is institutional. The same individual who once fought to open the doors of government can, once inside, end up deciding who gets access, who gets heard, who gets appointed, and who is pushed outside the political system. That is why Mustafe Omer’s greatest test is no longer whether he can retain power. It is whether he can prevent power from becoming the organizing principle of the state itself. After nearly eight years, the Somali people deserve an answer not speeches or political slogans, but from the institutions that surround them and the freedoms they are allowed to exercise. A reformer is ultimately defined not by how fiercely he challenges power before acquiring it, but by how willing he is to restrain power after acquiring it. Abdullahi A. items.title: Mareykanka oo shaaciyey weerar culus oo ku soo socda xarumaha militariga Itoobiya
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa Arbacadii ka digtay suurta-galnimada weerarro masaafo dheer ah oo lagu qaado xarumaha militariga Itoobiya, kuwaas oo laga yaabo inay gaaraan bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla caasimadda Addis Ababa, xilli dagaallada waqooyiga dalka ay sii xoogeysanayaan. Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Addis Ababa ayaa digniin amni oo ay soo saartay ku sheegtay inay ka warqabto warar ku saabsan weerarro suuragal ah oo masaafo dheer ah oo lagu beegsan karo xarumaha ciidamada Itoobiya. Safaaraddu ma aysan sheegin cidda fulin karta weerarradaas, nooca hubka la adeegsan karo ama inay hayso xog muujineysa in weerar uu dhow yahay. Waxay muwaadiniinta Mareykanka ugu baaqday inay ka fogaadaan xarumaha militariga iyo goobaha kale ee xasaasiga ah, feejignaadaan, isla markaana si dhow ula socdaan wararka gudaha. Muwaadiniinta Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale looga digay inay u safraan gobollada Tigray iyo Amhara iyo qeybo ka mid ah Afar oo ay saameeyeen dagaallada. Kuwa hadda ku sugan goobahaas ayaa lagula taliyay inay baxaan haddii ay si ammaan ah u sameyn karaan, ama ay meel ammaan ah ku nagaadaan haddii bixitaanku halis yahay. Safaaradda ayaa sidoo kale ka digtay in adeegyada internet-ka iyo taleefannada ay go’i karaan digniin la’aan, inkastoo ay sheegtay in xaaladda amni ee Addis Ababa ay weli deggan tahay. Qaraxyo laga maqlay Addis Ababa Digniinta cusub ayaa timid lix maalmood kadib markii qaraxyo laga maqlay qeybo ka mid ah Addis Ababa, xilli dagaalka waqooyiga Itoobiya uu galay marxalad cusub. Sarkaal ka tirsan sirdoonka Itoobiya ayaa Associated Press u sheegay in saddex qarax ay ka dhaceen goobo kala duwan habeenkii 1-dii October. Ilo diblomaasiyadeed ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in qarax laga maqlay meel u dhow xarunta wasaaradda gaashaandhigga Itoobiya. Ilaa hadda si cad looma xaqiijin waxa sababay qaraxyadaas. Reuters ayaa xilligaas soo xigatay ilo ku dhow isbahaysiga Ethiopian Peoples’ Forces Coalition for Survival, oo dagaal kula jira dowladda federaalka, kuwaas oo sheegay in isbahaysigu weerarro diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku qaaday Addis Ababa, oo ay ku jirto xarunta militariga. Reuters waxay sheegtay inaysan si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin sheegashadaas, halka dowladda Itoobiya aysan xaqiijin in qaraxyadu ahaayeen weerarro drone ah. Qaraxyada ayaa dhacay saacado kadib markii hay’adda sirdoonka Itoobiya ay mamnuucday duulimaadyada diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Addis Ababa iyo deegaannada ku hareeraysan. Digniinta Mareykanka ee Arbacada ma aysan xiriirin hanjabaadda cusub ee weerarrada masaafo dheer qaraxyadii 1-dii October, mana aysan magacaabin koox gaar ah oo ay sheegtay inay weerarrada qorsheyneyso. Dagaalka waqooyiga oo sii xoogeysanaya Digniinta ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli dagaallo xooggan ay ka socdaan waqooyiga Itoobiya, gaar ahaan gobolka Tigray. Ciidamada federaalka iyo xoogag Tigray ah oo dowladda taageersan ayaa maalmo kahor dib ula wareegay magaalada Mekelle, kadib markii Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) ay isaga baxday caasimadda gobolka. Dagaallada oo billowday 23-kii September ayaa ah kuwii ugu cuslaa tan iyo heshiiskii Pretoria ee 2022, kaas oo soo afjaray dagaalkii laba sano socday ee dowladda federaalka iyo ciidamada Tigray. Xiisadda gudaha Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale kusoo aadeysa xilli xiriirka Addis Ababa iyo Asmara uu si weyn u xumaaday. Itoobiya ayaa Eritrea ku eedeysay inay taageerto TPLF iyo kooxaha kale ee la dagaallamaya dowladda federaalka, isla markaana ciidamo dheeraad ah soo gelisay gudaha Itoobiya. Eritrea ayaa eedeymahaas beenisay. Labada dal ayaa toddobaadkii hore jaray xiriirkooda diblomaasiyadeed kadib markii Itoobiya ay xirtay safaaraddeedii Asmara oo ay dalka ka cayrisay 10 diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah. Warar Arbacadii kasoo baxay waqooyiga Tigray ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ciidamo Eritrean ah lagu arkay agagaarka magaalada Adigrat, taas oo sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo in xiisadda labada dal ay isu beddesho dagaal toos ah. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa hadda muwaadiniinteeda kula talineysa inay dib uga fiirsadaan safarrada Itoobiya, iyadoo sabab uga dhigeysa dagaallada, qalalaasaha, afduubyada, argagixisada iyo khatarta go’itaanka isgaarsiinta. items.title: Djibouti Reportedly Tops Africa in Average Net Monthly Salaries
items.description: DJIBOUTI (WDN) — Djibouti has reportedly emerged as the African country with the highest average take-home salary, according to data cited from LiveGDP, with workers said to receive an average of $2,836 per month after taxes and other payroll deductions. The figure places Djibouti at the top of the ranking for average net monthly wages in Africa, according to the report. The data refers to the amount employees are estimated to retain after income taxes and other deductions have been removed from their salaries—arguably a more practical measure of disposable earnings than gross pay. South Africa ranks second, with workers reportedly taking home an average of approximately $1,270 per month after deductions. The gap is substantial. Based on the figures cited by LiveGDP, Djibouti’s average net salary is more than twice that of South Africa. The report puts Djibouti’s average monthly salary at approximately 544,000 Djiboutian francs (DJF). A High Salary Does Not Tell the Whole Story The figures place Djibouti well above many African countries in terms of reported average take-home pay. However, salary levels alone do not necessarily determine workers’ living standards. The cost of housing, food, transportation, utilities and other essential goods, as well as taxation and purchasing power, are critical factors in determining how far an income actually goes. Djibouti’s relatively high reported wages should therefore be considered alongside the country’s cost of living and broader economic conditions. It is also important to emphasize that the $2,836 figure represents an average, not the salary received by every worker in Djibouti. Actual earnings vary significantly depending on profession, qualifications, education, employer, sector and years of experience. Many workers will earn substantially less than the reported national average, while highly skilled professionals may earn considerably more. Nevertheless, if the LiveGDP figures are accurate and comparable across countries, they put Djibouti at the top of Africa’s reported average net-wage rankings, followed by South Africa. The figures offer an intriguing snapshot of African wage levels—but they also underline why salary comparisons need to be viewed alongside the cost of living and purchasing power before drawing conclusions about living standards. items.title: Warar laga helaayo ciidamada Eritrea ee gudaha u galay Itoobiya
items.description: Ciidamo Eritrean ah ayaa galay waqooyiga Itoobiya, iyagoo ku sii jeeda deegaan ay iska horimaadyo ka socdaan oo u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya iyo ciidamada gobolka, sida ay BBC-da u sheegeen dadka deggan magaalada Adigrat ee Tigray. Dagaallada gobolka ayaa billowday laba toddobaad ka hor, kaddib bilo ay jireen xiisado u dhexeeyay dowladda Itoobiya iyo xisbiga maamula Tigray, TPLF. Labada dhinac ayaa midba midka kale ku eedeynaya inuu jebiyay heshiiskii 2022-kii soo afjaray dagaal sokeeye oo socday laba sano. Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale Eritrea ku eedeysay inay taageerto TPLF, taas oo Asmara ay hore u beenisay. Xiisadda cusub ayaa timid kaddib markii bishii Sebtembar la sameeyay isbahaysi cusub oo ay ku mideysan yihiin kooxo hubeysan oo ka jira Itoobiya, kaas oo ay TPLF ka mid tahay. Toddobaadkan dhammaadkiisii, ciidamada TPLF ayaa isaga baxay Mekelle, oo ah magaalada ugu weyn gobolka Tigray, taas oo 115 kiiloomitir koonfur ka xigta Adigrat, waxaana hadda gacanta ku haya ciidamada dowladda. Eritrea waxay xulafo muhiim ah la ahayd Itoobiya oo aan bad lahayn intii uu socday dagaalkii 2020 ilaa 2022, iyadoo la dagaallantay TPLF. Dagaalkaasi wuxuu ka mid ahaa colaadaha ugu dhimashada badnaa qarnigan, wuxuuna gobolka Tigray gaarsiiyay xaalad u dhow macaluul. Hase yeeshee, xiriirka labada dal ayaa tan iyo markaas xumaaday, gaar ahaan arrinta ku saabsan hamiga Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya ee ah in Itoobiya ay maamusho mid ka mid ah dekedaha Eritrea ee ku yaalla Badda Cas. Toddobaadkii hore, Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa jaray xiriirkooda diblomaasiyadeed, kaddib markii dagaallada cusub ay sare u qaadeen cabsi laga qabo in colaadda ay ku fido gobolka. BBC-da ma awooddo inay warbixin toos ah ka soo gudbiso Tigray iyo deegaannada ku xeeran, inkastoo inta badan meelahaasi dib loogu soo celiyay adeegyada taleefannada gacanta iyo internet-ka tan iyo markii ciidamada dowladda ay la wareegeen Mekelle. Sida ay sheegayaan ilo kala duwan, ciidamada Eritrea ayaa ka soo dhaqaaqay magaalada xuduudka ku taalla ee Zalambessa, iyagoo u sii gudbaya bartamaha Tigray. Kolonyo ciidamo ah ayaa la sheegay inay soo mareen Adigrat, una sii jeedeen Edaga Hamus, oo u dhaxaysa Adigrat iyo Mekelle. “Waxaan arkay ku dhawaad 40 gaari oo xamuul ah oo siday askar. Kolonyadu waxay u socotay dhanka koonfureed,” ayuu BBC Tigrinya u sheegay mid ka mid ah dadka deggan Adigrat, kaas oo codsaday inaan magaciisa la shaacin sababo amni awgood. Xigashada Sawirka, Anadolu via Getty Images Qof kale oo deggan magaalada ayaa sheegay inuu arkay dhaq-dhaqaaq ciidan, gaar ahaan habeenkii. Wuxuu yiri: “Waxaan arkaynay gawaari ay ku xardhan yihiin taargooyinka Eritrea oo magaalada dhex maraya.” “Saaka waxaan aragnay ku dhawaad 20 ilaa 30 gaari oo waaweyn oo u socda dhanka Edaga Hamus.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in dad uu yaqaan oo safar ku marayay waddadaasi ay arkeen gawaari kale oo siday hub culus, oo ay ku jiraan qoryaha lidka diyaaradaha, halka qaar ka mid ah ciidamada ay lug ku socdeen. Ilo ku sugan Mekelle ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in eheladooda ku sugan Adigrat ay soo sheegeen dhaq-dhaqaaq ciidan oo intaas ka weyn, iyagoo qiyaasay in ay arkeen ilaa 60 gaari oo siday askar, kuwaas oo markii dambe la geeyay dhul buuraley ah oo u dhow Edaga Hamus. Sawirro lagu faafiyay baraha bulshada ayaa u muuqda inay muujinayaan gawaari militari oo si weyn loo buuxiyay, kuwaas oo askar u wada Adigrat, Edaga Hamus iyo Wukro, oo ah magaalo kale oo muhiim ah oo ku taalla waddada u dhexeysa Adigrat iyo Mekelle. BBC-da si madax-bannaan uma xaqiijin sawirradaas. Ilo ku sugan Wukro ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya iyo dagaalyahanno xulafo la ah ay Arbacadii gudaha u galeen magaalada, kaddib markii rasaas iyo hub culus la isku adeegsaday meel qiyaastii 15 kiiloomitir koonfur ka xigta Wukro. BBC-da weli si madax-bannaan uma xaqiijin dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ciidamada ee la soo sheegay. Wararka sheegaya in ciidamada Eritrea ay dib ugu soo laabteen Tigray ayaa walaac ka abuuray dadka deegaanka, iyadoo qaar ay dib u xusuusteen xadgudubyo ay ciidamada Eritrea lagu eedeeyay inay geysteen intii uu socday dagaalkii sokeeye ee dhowaan ka dhacay gobolka, markaas oo ay la dagaallamayeen TPLF. Qof deggan Adigrat ayaa sheegay in dib u aragga ciidamada Eritrea uu dadka ku abuuray xanuun iyo cabsi, isagoo yiri: “Xusuustii weli waa cusub tahay. Aniguba waan murugooday. Dadku way ka xumaadeen inay mar kale arkaan.” Qof deggan Edaga Hamus ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ciidamada Eritrea ay magaalada soo mareen, isla markaana duqeymo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ay ka dhaceen meel u dhow, iyadoo ciidamada la bartilmaameedsaday. Wareysi uu dhawaan siiyay telefishinka gaarka loo leeyahay ee Fana, sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan dowladda Itoobiya, Abraham Belay, ayaa Eritrea ku eedeeyay inay si toos ah uga qeyb qaadanayso colaadda. “Ciidanka Eritrea waxay dagaalka uga qeyb qaateen awooddooda iyo saadka oo dhan,” ayuu yiri. “Ciidamo badan oo Eritrean ah ayaa la dilay lana qabtay. Shaki kuma jiro in aargoosigu uu laba jibbaarmi doono. Waxay arki doonaan waxa ay ka dhigan tahay inay xadka dal kale soo galaan oo ay garab ka dagaallamaan kooxo burcad ah.”

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo sheegay in ay soo rideen diyaarad howgal ku jirtay oo Sacuudigu leeyahay
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegay inay soo rideen diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo nooca Bayraktar Akinci ah oo lagu sameeyo Turkiga, taas oo ay sheegeen inuu leeyahay Sacuudigu. Xuutiyiintu waxay sheegeen in diyaaradda ay hawlgallo ay ku tilmaameen “ kuwa colaadeed” ka waday gobolka Tacis. Afhayeenka militariga Xuutiyiinta, Yahya Saree, ayaa sheegay in diyaaradda lagu soo riday “hub ku habboon”. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in kooxda ay gantaallo ballistic ah ku bartilmaameedsatay goobo ay ku sugnaayeen ciidamo iyo maleeshiyaad Sacuudigu taageero oo ku dhow marinka Bab al-Mandab. Yahya Saree ayaa sidoo kale hore u sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay gantaal ku weerareen garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee King Khalid ee Riyad. Tani waa markii saddexaad toddobaadkan ee ay kooxdu sheegato inay weerartay garoonka. Sacuudiga ayaa sheegay in hal qof oo u dhashay Sudan uu ku dhintay weerarka, halka siddeed qof oo kale ay ku dhaawacmeen.

items.title: Erdogan oo shaaciyey in si rasmi ah Soomaaliya looga billaabay dhismaha xarunta…
items.description: Ankara (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa sheegay in si rasmi ah loo bilaabay dhismaha xarun lagu rido gantaallada hawada sare oo Turkigu ka dhisayo Soomaaliya, mashruuc ay Ankara u aragto mid muhiim u ah qorshaheeda ah inay yeelato awood madax-bannaan oo ay ku gaarto hawada sare. Erdoğan, oo ka hadlay furitaanka shirweynaha 77-aad ee Caalamiga ah ee Hawada Sare oo ka dhacay magaalada Antalya, ayaa sheegay in awoodda lagu sameeyo dayax-gacmeedyada oo keliya aysan maanta ku filneyn waddan doonaya inuu door weyn ku yeesho hawada sare. “Dunida maanta, sameynta dayax-gacmeedyo keliya kuma filna inaad joogitaan ku yeelato hawada sare; waa inaad sidoo kale awood u leedahay inaad hawada sare gaarto,” ayuu yiri Erdoğan. Sababtaas awgeed, ayuu sheegay, Turkigu muhiimad gaar ah ayuu siiyey sidii uu u heli lahaa xarun uu si madax-bannaan uga diri karo gantaallada iyo dayax-gacmeedyada. Erdoğan ayaa sheegay in xaaladda juqraafiyeed ee Turkiga ay Ankara ku qasabtay inay raadiso goob ka baxsan dalka, taas oo ugu dambeyn keentay iskaashiga Soomaaliya. “Waxaan bilownay shaqada dhismaha xarunta hawada sare ee aan ka sameyneyno Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri. “Waxaan si go’aan leh u sii wadeynaa dadaallada lagu hirgelinayo mashruucan istaraatiijiga ah.” Madaxweynaha Turkiga ayaa sheegay in xaruntan aysan kaliya xoojin doonin awoodda Turkiga ee hawada sare, balse ay sidoo kale gacan ka geysan karto horumarinta qeybta hawada sare ee qaaradda Afrika. Mashruuca Warsheekh Safaaradda Turkiga ee Muqdisho ayaa iyaduna xaqiijisay in xarunta laga dhisayo agagaarka degmada Warsheekh ay hadda ku jirto marxaladda dhismaha. Wafdi Turki ah oo uu hoggaaminayey safiirka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya Ferhat Alkan, ayna weheliyeen taliyaha ciidamada Turkiga ee Soomaaliya, Major General Sebahattin Kalkan, ayaa dhowaan booqday goobta mashruuca. Wafdiga ayaa warbixin ku saabsan halka uu mashruucu marayo ka dhageystay Ahmet Sami İşler, oo ah maamulaha Albayrak Group ee Soomaaliya iyo guddoomiyaha Golaha Ganacsiga Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya ee DEİK. “Kadib mashruucan, Soomaaliya waxay noqon doontaa mid ka mid ah xarumaha dunida ugu muhiimsan ee daraasaadka hawada sare,” ayay safaaraddu sheegtay. Goobta mashruuca ayaa ku dhow Warsheekh, oo ah magaalo xeebeed qiyaastii 70 kiiloomitir waqooyi kaga beegan Muqdisho. Sawirro dayax-gacmeed oo horay loo qaaday ayaa muujiyey howlo dhisme oo ka socda deegaankaas. Mid ka mid ah sababaha ugu waaweyn ee Turkigu Soomaaliya ugu doortay mashruuca ayaa ah halka ay dalka kaga taallo dhul-baraha. Gantaallada laga diro meelaha ku dhow dhul-baraha ayaa ka faa’iideysan kara xawaaraha wareegga dhulka, taas oo yareyn karta shidaalka loo baahan yahay ama suuragelin karta in culays badan hawada sare loo qaado. Sidoo kale xeebta dheer ee Soomaaliya ee Badweynta Hindiya ayaa gantaallada siin karta waddooyin ay dul maraan bad furan, taas oo yareyneysa khatarta ka dhalan karta qeybaha gantaalka ee dib ugu soo dhacaya dhulka. Qorshe caalami ah Turkigu wuxuu sidoo kale qorsheynayaa in xarunta Soomaaliya aysan ku koobnaan oo keliya barnaamijkiisa hawada sare, balse mustaqbalka loo furo dalal iyo shirkado caalami ah. Arif Karabeyoğlu, oo xubin ka ah guddiga Hay’adda Hawada Sare ee Turkiga, ayaa sheegay in Ankara ay doonayso inay xarunta ka dhigto goob ay isticmaali karaan shirkadaha iyo hay’adaha kale ee ka shaqeeya hawada sare. “Türkiye waxay dooneysaa inay goobtan u isticmaasho gaadiidkeeda hawada sare, laakiin isla waqtigaas waxay dooneysaa inay u furto isticmaalka caalamiga ah,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu sheegay in mustaqbalka xaruntu ay ka gudbi karto meel gantaallo laga diro oo keliya, ayna isu beddeli karto xarun ballaaran oo adeegyo kala duwan oo hawada sare ah laga bixiyo. Karabeyoğlu ayaa Soomaaliya ku tilmaamay goob leh faa’iidooyin dhowr ah, oo ay ka mid yihiin u dhowaanshaha dhul-baraha, xaaladaha cimilo ee ku habboon iyo badbaadada dariiqyada gantaallada. Wasiirka Warshadaha iyo Teknolojiyadda Turkiga Mehmet Fatih Kacır ayaa bishii December sheegay in daraasadaha suurtagalnimada iyo naqshadeynta mashruuca la soo gabagabeeyey, isla markaana la bilaabay wejigii koowaad ee dhismaha. Kacır ayaa sheegay in daraasadaha la sameeyey ay Soomaaliya ku tilmaameen goobta ugu habboon mashruucan sababo la xiriira meelaha ay kaga taallo dhul-baraha, xeebteeda, cimilada iyo heerka hoose ee isku socodka diyaaradaha iyo maraakiibta ee qeybo ka mid ah aagga. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in xaruntu awood u yeelan karto inay u adeegto suuqa ganacsiga hawada sare ee caalamka, oo ay ku jiraan dirista dayax-gacmeedyada, tijaabooyinka farsamada iyo isku-dubaridka qalabka hawada sare. Mas’uuliyiinta Turkiga ayaa rajeynaya in mashruucu mustaqbalka dhaqaale u soo saaro Turkiga, isla markaana uu fursado horumarineed iyo kuwo dhaqaale u abuuro Soomaaliya. items.fullContent: Ankara (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa sheegay in si rasmi ah loo bilaabay dhismaha xarun lagu rido gantaallada hawada sare oo Turkigu ka dhisayo Soomaaliya, mashruuc ay Ankara u aragto mid muhiim u ah qorshaheeda ah inay yeelato awood madax-bannaan oo ay ku gaarto hawada sare. Erdoğan, oo ka hadlay furitaanka shirweynaha 77-aad ee Caalamiga ah ee Hawada Sare oo ka dhacay magaalada Antalya, ayaa sheegay in awoodda lagu sameeyo dayax-gacmeedyada oo keliya aysan maanta ku filneyn waddan doonaya inuu door weyn ku yeesho hawada sare. “Dunida maanta, sameynta dayax-gacmeedyo keliya kuma filna inaad joogitaan ku yeelato hawada sare; waa inaad sidoo kale awood u leedahay inaad hawada sare gaarto,” ayuu yiri Erdoğan. Sababtaas awgeed, ayuu sheegay, Turkigu muhiimad gaar ah ayuu siiyey sidii uu u heli lahaa xarun uu si madax-bannaan uga diri karo gantaallada iyo dayax-gacmeedyada. Erdoğan ayaa sheegay in xaaladda juqraafiyeed ee Turkiga ay Ankara ku qasabtay inay raadiso goob ka baxsan dalka, taas oo ugu dambeyn keentay iskaashiga Soomaaliya. “Waxaan bilownay shaqada dhismaha xarunta hawada sare ee aan ka sameyneyno Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri. “Waxaan si go’aan leh u sii wadeynaa dadaallada lagu hirgelinayo mashruucan istaraatiijiga ah.” Madaxweynaha Turkiga ayaa sheegay in xaruntan aysan kaliya xoojin doonin awoodda Turkiga ee hawada sare, balse ay sidoo kale gacan ka geysan karto horumarinta qeybta hawada sare ee qaaradda Afrika. Mashruuca Warsheekh Safaaradda Turkiga ee Muqdisho ayaa iyaduna xaqiijisay in xarunta laga dhisayo agagaarka degmada Warsheekh ay hadda ku jirto marxaladda dhismaha. Wafdi Turki ah oo uu hoggaaminayey safiirka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya Ferhat Alkan, ayna weheliyeen taliyaha ciidamada Turkiga ee Soomaaliya, Major General Sebahattin Kalkan, ayaa dhowaan booqday goobta mashruuca. Wafdiga ayaa warbixin ku saabsan halka uu mashruucu marayo ka dhageystay Ahmet Sami İşler, oo ah maamulaha Albayrak Group ee Soomaaliya iyo guddoomiyaha Golaha Ganacsiga Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya ee DEİK. “Kadib mashruucan, Soomaaliya waxay noqon doontaa mid ka mid ah xarumaha dunida ugu muhiimsan ee daraasaadka hawada sare,” ayay safaaraddu sheegtay. Goobta mashruuca ayaa ku dhow Warsheekh, oo ah magaalo xeebeed qiyaastii 70 kiiloomitir waqooyi kaga beegan Muqdisho. Sawirro dayax-gacmeed oo horay loo qaaday ayaa muujiyey howlo dhisme oo ka socda deegaankaas. Mid ka mid ah sababaha ugu waaweyn ee Turkigu Soomaaliya ugu doortay mashruuca ayaa ah halka ay dalka kaga taallo dhul-baraha. Gantaallada laga diro meelaha ku dhow dhul-baraha ayaa ka faa’iideysan kara xawaaraha wareegga dhulka, taas oo yareyn karta shidaalka loo baahan yahay ama suuragelin karta in culays badan hawada sare loo qaado. Sidoo kale xeebta dheer ee Soomaaliya ee Badweynta Hindiya ayaa gantaallada siin karta waddooyin ay dul maraan bad furan, taas oo yareyneysa khatarta ka dhalan karta qeybaha gantaalka ee dib ugu soo dhacaya dhulka. Qorshe caalami ah Turkigu wuxuu sidoo kale qorsheynayaa in xarunta Soomaaliya aysan ku koobnaan oo keliya barnaamijkiisa hawada sare, balse mustaqbalka loo furo dalal iyo shirkado caalami ah. Arif Karabeyoğlu, oo xubin ka ah guddiga Hay’adda Hawada Sare ee Turkiga, ayaa sheegay in Ankara ay doonayso inay xarunta ka dhigto goob ay isticmaali karaan shirkadaha iyo hay’adaha kale ee ka shaqeeya hawada sare. “Türkiye waxay dooneysaa inay goobtan u isticmaasho gaadiidkeeda hawada sare, laakiin isla waqtigaas waxay dooneysaa inay u furto isticmaalka caalamiga ah,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu sheegay in mustaqbalka xaruntu ay ka gudbi karto meel gantaallo laga diro oo keliya, ayna isu beddeli karto xarun ballaaran oo adeegyo kala duwan oo hawada sare ah laga bixiyo. Karabeyoğlu ayaa Soomaaliya ku tilmaamay goob leh faa’iidooyin dhowr ah, oo ay ka mid yihiin u dhowaanshaha dhul-baraha, xaaladaha cimilo ee ku habboon iyo badbaadada dariiqyada gantaallada. Kacır ayaa sheegay in daraasadaha la sameeyey ay Soomaaliya ku tilmaameen goobta ugu habboon mashruucan sababo la xiriira meelaha ay kaga taallo dhul-baraha, xeebteeda, cimilada iyo heerka hoose ee isku socodka diyaaradaha iyo maraakiibta ee qeybo ka mid ah aagga. Mashruuca Warsheekh ayaa sidoo kale Turkiga ka caawin kara inuu buuxiyo mid ka mid ah meelaha weli ka bannaan barnaamijkiisa hawada sare — awoodda uu si madax-bannaan gantaallo ugu diro hawada sare. items.title: Qasaare ka dhashay roob dabeyl watay oo saamayn ku yeeshay danyar ku nool Bari
items.description: (ERGO) – Cunto yari, hoy xumo iyo dhaqaale darro saameysay ayay wajahayaan boqollaal qoys oo toddobadii bishan dhibane u noqday roob dabeylo watay oo ku dhuftay deegaanka Ceel-gaal oo hoos taga degmada Qandala ee gobolka Bari. Qoysaskan ayaa ah kuwo ay ku adag tahay in maalinkii ay helaan hal waqti oo cunto ah. Waa musiibo aan laga sii baaraan dagin oo ay ku naf waayeen dad iyo duunyo, isla markaana dumisay bollaal guri. Waxaa lagu waayay ilihii dhaqaale oo ay ku tiirsanaayeen qoysas danyar ah oo ay ku adag tahay inay ka soo kabtaan saameynta taban ee ay ku reebtay. Cabdimudalib Axmed Maxamed, waa 18 jir ay mustaqbal ka sugayaan siddeed walaalo ah oo ka yar. Qoyska waxaa u shaqeyn jiray isaga iyo hooyadiis oo geeriyootay, markii uu ku dumay gurigii ay degganaayeen. Wuxuu tilmaamay in hadda aysan laheyn ildhaqaale, ayna ku tiirsan yihiin kaalmo yar oo baahidooda aan dabuuli karin oo uga timaada dadka dariskooda ah. “Garab la’aan ayaa nagu dhacday. Waxaan hadda isku maareynaa waxay noo keenaan dadka na dhaama ee nagu hareereysan, iyaguna wax badan oo la sheego nooma ay keenin.” Cabdimudalib ayaa sheegay inay ku nool yihiin aqal cooshad ah oo dantu bidday, markii uu ka dumay hoygoodii oo ka koobnaa labo qol. Wuxuu xusay inaysan hadda heli karin dhaqaale dib loogu dhiso. Qoyska ayaa ku tiirsanaa goob ganacsi oo lagu gado dhuxusha iyo hilibka cayriin, isaga iyo hooyadiis ayaana wadajir uga shaqeyn jiray. Dhaqaalaha maalinkii ka soo gali jiray oo uu sheegay inuu ahaa $7 illaa $10 ayay ku tiirsaneyd noloshoodu. Waa da’yar la’ meel uu wax ka billaabo, ayna garabkiisa ka baxday hooyadiis, aabbahiina yahay 85 jir aan shaqeyn karin. “Awood iyo itaal lama hayo wax Ilaahay keeni doono maahee, waxaa carruurta haya caluul xanuun, waana wax u badan carruurta iyo waayeelka oo magaalada ka jira. Meeshu caafimaad malahan, mana la awoodo in meel kale aan u tagno.” Cabdimudalib ayaa tilmaamay in dhaqaale la’aan uu uga haray waxbarashada dugsiga dhexe, sanadkii 2023, haddana ay xaaladaas oo kale wajahayaan walaalihiis oo dhigan jiray iskuulka hoose iyo dhexe ee Cumar binu-cabdi casiis ee deegaanka Ceel-gaal, kaas oo ku dumay dabeylaha roobka. Waa iskuulka kaliya ee deegaanku lahaa, waxaana dhiganayay 300 oo arday. Ma jirto cid ku howlan dhisamahiisa, sida uu sheegay maamulka deegaanka. Cabdimudalib ayaa sheegay in haddii dib loo dhiso ay wali hor taallo caqabad dhanka dhaqaalaha ah, maadaama aysan awoodin bixinta boqol Doollar oo bishii ay wax ku baran jireen afar walaalihiis ah oo iskuulka dhigan jiray. Saameynta ka dhalatay roobka dabeylaha watay ma ah mid ku kooban magaalada ee waxay taabatay xoolo dhaqatada iyo dadka ku tiirsanaa xabagta geedka xijigga. Maxamuud Maxamed Cabdikariim oo ka mid ah dadka ay saameeysay ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in dabeyshu wax yeeleysay ilihii dhaqaale ee qoyskiisu ku tiirsanaa oo ahaa xoolo iyo xabagta xijigga. Qoyskiisa oo ku nool miyiga ku dhow deegaanka Ceelgaal ayuu xusay in sidoo kale ay dabeyshu ka dumisay hoygii ay ku noolaayeen. “Tuuladan wax walba waa qaali oo labolaab ah ayay ka sareeyaan qiimaha ay ka joogaan Boosaaso. Waa tuulo ku taal meel fog oo gaariga ka soo baxa Boosaaso wuxuu jidka ku jiraa labo habeen. Galab hadduu ka soo baxo, habeenka dambe ayuu tagaa.” Maxamuud ayaa tilmaamay in musiibadan ay uga dhinteen 20 ari ah, sidoo kalana ay dabeyshu ka goysay geedaha xijigga oo xabagtooda uu sheegay inuu ka heli jiray sanadkii ku dhowaad kun Doollar. Ninkan oo ah aabbaha toddobo carruur ah ayaa intaas ku daray in dabeyshu ka dumisay guri deegaanka uu ku lahaa oo bishii uu ka qaadan jiray kiro $25 ah. Maareynta nolosha reerka oo uusan ka warwari jirin ayuu sheegay in hadda ay tahay caqabad uu xalkeedu ku adag yahay. Xaaladan ayuu xusay in qoyskiisa ay dhaxal siisay cunno yari. “Xoolaha iyo maydiga ayaan ku tiirsaneyn, xoolihiina dee dabeyl iyo abaartaas ayaa ku dhacday. Haddii wax naloo heli karo, miyi iyo magaalada nalooga soo gurman karo waan u baahanahay.” Maxamuud ayaa tilmaamay in roobka dabeylaha watay da’ayay lix saacadood uu ahaa mid aysan fileyn, xilliga oo jiilaal ah awgeed. Wuxuu intaas ku daray inaysan soo gaarin digniinaha la xiriira El Nino oo ah roobab dabeyl wata oo saadaashu sheegeyso inay Soomaaliya ka da’ayaan bisha tobnaad ee October illaa dhammaadka sanadkan. Dhanka kale maamulka deegaanka Ceelgaal ee gobolka Bari ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in qoysaska dhibaatadu gaartay ay wajahayaan xaalad hubanti la’aan ah oo ay adag tahay inay ka soo kabtaan. Shire Cabdullaahi Siciid oo ah guddoomiye ku xigeen ayaa xusay in maamul ahaan aysan hayn waxay ku taageeraan qoysaska dhibban. Shire ayaa tilmaamay in roobka dabeylaha wata ay ku dhinteen saddex qof,  xoolo gaaraya  saddex boqol, ayna ku ku dumeen 150 guri. Qiimeyn ay sameeyeen ayuu xusay inay ku ogaadeen in saameyntu ay gaartay saddex boqol iyo konton qoys oo iskugu jira dadka ku nool deegaanka Ceelgaal iyo miyiga ku xeeran, kuwaas oo lumiyay ilihii dhaqaale ee ay ku tiirsanaayeen oo ahaa xoolo, beero  iyo mehrado ganacsi. “Dadkii hadda waxay noqdeen isku duruuf oo wax badan isma dhaamaan. Dhulka qaar xataa hadda biyo ayaa laga dhaamiyaa oo ma gaarin roobka noo da’ay. Dhibaatooyinka noocaas ah oo awood aan loo hayn ayaa jira.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in musiibadan ay ku soo beegantay xilli adag oo aysan xoolo dhaqatadu ka soo kaban abaaro iyo jiilaal nacfi tiray xoolaha. items.title: Afgaanistaan oo Diiday Dalab ka yimid Maxkamadda Caalamiga ah ee Dambiyada
items.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Afghanistan ayaa si rasmi ah u diidday waarannada xarigga ee Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah (ICC) ay soo saartay, kuwaas oo lagu beegsaday afar masuul oo sare oo ka tirsan Taliban. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in go’aanka Maxkamadda uu yahay “xadgudub cad oo ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo madaxbannaanida Afghanistan” , iyadoo ICC ku eedeysay inay leedahay hab-dhaqan ay ku tilmaantay mid xulasho iyo siyaasad ku dhisan . Afar qof ee waarannada loo soo saaray ayaa kala ah Hibatullah Akhundzada , hoggaamiyaha Taliban; Abdul Hakim Haqqani , madaxa Maxkamadda Sare; Habibullah Agha , wasiirka waxbarashada; iyo Neda Mohammad Nadim , wasiirka tacliinta sare. Maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay in waarannada la soo saaray 2025, balse si rasmi ah loo shaaciyay 5-dii Oktoobar 2026. ICC ayaa sheegtay in baaritaankeeda uu ku salaysan yahay eedeymo la xiriira dambiyo ka dhan ah aadanaha , gaar ahaan cadaadis lagu eedeeyay inuu ku salaysan yahay jinsiga iyo aragtiyada siyaasadeed. items.title: Wiil Soomaali-Mareykan ah oo loo xiray qorshe weerar oo ka dhan ahaa Mall of America
items.description: Minneapolis (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa dacwad ku soo oogtay wiil 18 jir ah oo ku dhashay Mareykanka, asal ahaanna Soomaali ah, kaas oo lagu eedeeyay inuu qorsheynayay weerar ballaaran oo uu ka geysto xarunta ganacsiga Mall of America ee gobolka Minnesota, isagoo la sheegay inuu taageersanaa kooxda Daacish. Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud ayaa Talaadadii la xiray kaddib markii uu, sida ay sheegtay dacwad federaal ah oo Arbacadii la gudbiyay, $600 ku iibsaday qori nooca AK-47 ah, afar qasnadood oo midkiiba qaado 30 xabbadood iyo ku dhowaad 200 oo xabbadood oo rasaas ah. Qofka uu hubka ka iibsanayay ayaa ahaa sarkaal FBI ah oo si qarsoodi ah uga shaqeynayay howlgalka. Qoriga la siiyay Sheikhdoon ayaa horay looga dhigay mid aan shaqeyn karin, balse rasaasta ayaa ahayd mid dhab ah, sida lagu sheegay dokumentiyada maxkamadda. FBI-da ayaa qabatay Sheikhdoon wax yar kaddib markii uu hubka la wareegay, xilli uu ku sugnaa magaalada Richfield oo dhowr mayl u jirta Mall of America. Dacwad-oogayaasha federaalka ayaa ku eedeeyay inuu si ula kac ah u helay hub iyo rasaas isagoo og ama haysta sabab macquul ah oo uu ku fahmi karo in loo adeegsan doono fal dambiyeed iyo fal argagixiso oo federaal ah. Haddii lagu helo dambiga, wuxuu wajihi karaa xabsi gaaraya 15 sano. “Waxa uu ahaa nin dhalinyaro ah oo xagjir noqday, kaas oo loo baahnaa in lala socdo,” ayuu yiri Daniel Rosen, xeer-ilaaliyaha Mareykanka ee gobolka Minnesota. Rosen ayaa sheegay in baarayaashu ay awood u yeesheen inay ogaadaan khatarta oo ay fashiliyaan ka hor inta uusan eedeysanuhu fulin qorshihiisa, kaas oo uu sheegay inuu doonayay inuu ku dilo “qiyaastii 30 ilaa 60 qof”. Mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Sheikhdoon uu yahay muwaadin Mareykan ah oo dalkaas ku dhashay, kana soo jeeda qoys Soomaali ah, isla markaana baaritaanka hadda jira uu muujinayo inuu kaligiis ku dhaqaaqayay. Safarka Soomaaliya FBI-da ayaa baaritaanka Sheikhdoon billowday bishii December 2024, sida lagu sheegay warqadda dhaarta ah ee lagu lifaaqay dacwadda. Baarayaashu waxay sheegeen in muddo ku dhow laba sano uu boqolaal farriimood is dhaafsaday qof xog-siiye sir ah oo la shaqeynayay FBI-da, iyagoo adeegsanayay baraha Telegram, Signal, Discord, TikTok iyo kuwo kale. Sida ku xusan dacwadda, Sheikhdoon ayaa markii hore ka hadlayay inuu dibadda u safro si uu ugu biiro Al-Shabaab, kooxda xiriirka la leh Al-Qaacida ee dagaalka muddada dheer ka wada Soomaaliya. Waxaa lagu eedeeyay inuu xog-siiyeha u sheegay inuu doonayo inuu Soomaaliya tago oo uu kooxda u dagaallamo, isagoo mararka qaar sidoo kale ka hadlay suurtagalnimada inuu weerar khasaare badan geysta ka fuliyo Minnesota haddii uu awoodi waayo inuu dibadda u baxo. Baarayaashu waxay sheegeen in hadalladiisu markii dambe si isa soo taraysa ugu wareegeen Daacish, isagoo lagu eedeeyay inuu daawanayay isla markaana faafinayay dacaayadaha kooxda, ugu dambeynna duubay muuqaal uu ku sheeganayo inuu daacad u yahay Daacish iyo hoggaankeeda. Dokumentiyada maxkamadda ayaa tilmaamaya in qorshihii safarka dibadda uu isu beddelay mid gudaha Mareykanka ah kaddib markii Sheikhdoon uu sheegay inuusan haysan lacag ku filan oo uu ku safro. Bishii July ayuu, sida dacwaddu sheegtay, xog-siiyeha u sheegay in haddii uusan dalka ka bixi karin uu “halkan Mareykanka isku diyaarin doono”, isagoo ka hadlay iibsashada hub iyo weerar lagu qaado Mall of America ama goobta madadaalada Valleyfair ee Minnesota. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay inuu ugu dambeyn bartilmaameedkiisa ka dhigtay Mall of America. 24-ka October Dacwadda ayaa sheegtay in Sheikhdoon uu markii dambe 24-ka October u asteeyay maalinta uu doonayay inuu weerarka fuliyo, xilli xarunta Mall of America lagu waday munaasabad farshaxan oo ay leeyihiin bulshada Hmong. Waxaa la sheegay inuu xog-siiyeha u diray macluumaad ku saabsan munaasabadda, isagoo filayay inay goobta isugu yimaadaan dad badan. Dacwadda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inuu sheegay inuu xarunta ganacsiga u doortay sababo la xiriira waxa uu aaminsanaa inay leedahay cid Yuhuud ah. Dhammaadkii September, baarayaashu waxay sheegeen in qorshuhu sii faahfaahayay. Markii la weydiiyay inuu dhab ka yahay weerarka, Sheikhdoon ayaa la sheegay inuu ku jawaabay inuu “100% hubay”, isagoo isku tilmaamay inuu diyaar u yahay “maskax ahaan iyo jir ahaanba”. Baarayaashu waxay markaas u diyaariyeen inuu la kulmo sarkaal FBI ah oo si qarsoodi ah u shaqeynayay, kaas oo uu Sheikhdoon aaminsanaa inuu ka tirsan yahay Daacish isla markaana awood u leeyahay inuu hub siiyo. 6-dii October, kooxaha dabagalka ayaa la socday Sheikhdoon ilaa goobta kulanka, halkaas oo lagu eedeeyay inuu bixiyay $600 isla markaana la wareegay qoriga, qasnadaha iyo rasaasta. Intii lagu jiray kulanka la duubayay, dacwaddu waxay sheegtay inuu ka hadlay taageeradiisa Daacish iyo qorshaha uu doonayay inuu ku weeraro Mall of America. Wax yar kaddib ayay FBI-du xirtay. “Halkii uu ka heli lahaa wax uu ku dilo tiro badan oo Mareykan ah, eedeysanuhu wuxuu halkaas ka helay koox FBI ah oo sugaysay inay xirto,” ayuu yiri Christopher Dotson, madaxa xafiiska FBI-da ee Minneapolis. Xabsiga ayuu ku sii jirayaa Sheikhdoon ayaa Arbacadii kasoo muuqday maxkamad federaal ah oo ku taalla magaalada St. Paul, isagoo hor-tagay garsoore Elizabeth Cowan Wright. Maxkamadda ayaa u magacowday qareen federaal ah oo difaaca, waxayna amartay inuu xabsiga ku sii jiro ilaa 19-ka October, xilligaas oo la filayo in maxkamaddu go’aan ka gaarto in lagu sii hayo inta dacwaddu socoto. Mas’uuliyiinta federaalka ayaa sheegay in aysan jirin ilaa hadda wax muujinaya in qorshaha lagu eedeeyay uu qeyb ka ahaa shabakad ka ballaaran ama ay dad kale si toos ah ugu lug lahaayeen. Maamulka Mall of America ayaa sheegay inuu leeyahay heerar kala duwan oo amni, isla markaana uu si joogto ah ula shaqeeyo hay’adaha ammaanka ee heer deegaan, gobol iyo federaal. Dhammaan eedeymaha loo jeediyay Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud ayaa weli ah kuwo ku jira marxaladda dacwadda, mana jiro xukun maxkamadeed oo lagu caddeeyay dambiga. items.title: Soomaaliya oo Xoojinaysa Iskaashiga Amniga Badaha, kuna biirtay laba Shabakad oo Caalami ah
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Badda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Jeneraal Cabdiwahaab Cabdullaahi Cumar, ayaa magaalada Venice ee dalka Talyaaniga kaga qayb galay Shirweynaha 15-aad ee Awoodda Ciidamada Badda ee dalalka caalamka, kaas oo lagu qabtay xarunta Arsenal ee Ciidamada Badda Talyaaniga. Shirweynaha waxaa ka qayb galay taliyeyaasha ciidamada badda ee dalal kala duwan, iyadoo looga hadlay arrimo la xiriira xoojinta amniga badaha caalamka, ilaalinta iyo sahminta fiilooyinka mara badda, horumarinta qalabka casriga ah ee ciidamada badda iyo xoojinta iskaashiga dowladaha leh dhul-badeedyo kala duwan. Sidoo kale, shirka waxaa diiradda lagu saaray is-weydaarsiga xogta maraakiibta iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa gaadiidka badda, iyo sidii loo horumarin lahaa iskaashiga istiraatiijiyadeed ee dalalka ku lugta leh amniga badaha. Jeneraal Cabdiwahaab Cabdullaahi Cumar oo khudbad ka jeediyay shirka ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ku taallo goob istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah isku xirka ganacsiga iyo bulshooyinka caalamka, isla markaana ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya dadaal ugu jirto xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka kale ee leh marin-badeedyo. Taliyaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Soomaaliya ay xoogga saarayso sugidda iyo xakamaynta amniga dhul-badeedkeeda, iyadoo muhiimad gaar ah siinaysa iskaashiga caalamiga ah iyo wadaagga xogaha la xiriira amniga badda. Intii uu ku sugnaa Talyaaniga, Taliyaha Ciidanka Badda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale si rasmi ah u saxiixay laba heshiis oo Soomaaliya ka dhigaya xubin ka tirsan laba shabakad oo caalami ah oo lagu xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta dhinaca amniga iyo maamulka gaadiidka badda. Labada shabakad ayaa kala ah Virtual Regional Maritime Traffic Centre (V-RMTC) iyo Trans-Regional Maritime Network (T-RMN) , kuwaas oo diiradda saaraya wadaagga macluumaadka iyo xoojinta iskaashiga dowladaha ku hawlan ilaalinta iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa gaadiidka badda. Dhanka kale, Jeneraal Cabdiwahaab Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa kulamo doceedyo la yeeshay Taliyaha Ciidamada Badda Qatar, Major General Abdullah Hassan Al-Sulaiti, iyo Taliyaha Ciidamada Badda Turkiga, Admiral Ercüment Tatlıoğlu. Kulamada ayaa looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga dhinaca ciidamada badda iyo horumarinta xiriirka saddex-geesoodka ah ee Soomaaliya, Qatar iyo Turkiga, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga badda, tababarka iyo wadaagga khibradaha.

Jeneraal Cabdiwahaab Cabdullaahi Cumar oo khudbad ka jeediyay shirka ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ku taallo goob istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah isku xirka ganacsiga iyo bulshooyinka caalamka, isla markaana ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya dadaal ugu jirto xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka kale ee leh marin-badeedyo. Taliyaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Soomaaliya ay xoogga saarayso sugidda iyo xakamaynta amniga dhul-badeedkeeda, iyadoo muhiimad gaar ah siinaysa iskaashiga caalamiga ah iyo wadaagga xogaha la xiriira amniga badda. Intii uu ku sugnaa Talyaaniga, Taliyaha Ciidanka Badda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale si rasmi ah u saxiixay laba heshiis oo Soomaaliya ka dhigaya xubin ka tirsan laba shabakad oo caalami ah oo lagu xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta dhinaca amniga iyo maamulka gaadiidka badda. Labada shabakad ayaa kala ah Virtual Regional Maritime Traffic Centre (V-RMTC) iyo Trans-Regional Maritime Network (T-RMN) , kuwaas oo diiradda saaraya wadaagga macluumaadka iyo xoojinta iskaashiga dowladaha ku hawlan ilaalinta iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa gaadiidka badda. Dhanka kale, Jeneraal Cabdiwahaab Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa kulamo doceedyo la yeeshay Taliyaha Ciidamada Badda Qatar, Major General Abdullah Hassan Al-Sulaiti, iyo Taliyaha Ciidamada Badda Turkiga, Admiral Ercüment Tatlıoğlu. Kulamada ayaa looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga dhinaca ciidamada badda iyo horumarinta xiriirka saddex-geesoodka ah ee Soomaaliya, Qatar iyo Turkiga, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga badda, tababarka iyo wadaagga khibradaha.

items.title: Sucuudiga oo Sheegay in 3 qof ay  ku dhinteen Weerarro lagu qaaday laba Garoon Diyaaradeed
items.description: Ugu yaraan 3 qof ayaa ku dhintay, 36 kalena way ku dhaawacmeen weerarro ay Xuutiyiintu sheegteen inay ka geysteen laba garoon diyaaradeed oo ku yaalla Sacuudi Carabiya, sida ay sheegtay Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Sacuudiga (GACA). Weerarrada ayaa lagu beegsaday Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Abha iyo Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Boqor Khalid ee magaalada Riyaad , kuwaas oo la sheegay inay weerarradu dhaceen Talaadadii iyo Arbacadii. Hay’adda GACA waxay sheegtay in weerarka lagu qaaday garoonka Abha ay ku dhinteen laba haween ah oo u dhashay Morocco iyo Algeria , halka 28 qof oo kale ay ku dhaawacmeen . Dhanka kale, weerarka lagu qaaday Garoonka Boqor Khalid ee Riyaad ayaa sababay dhimashada muwaadin Suudaani ah , halka 8 qof oo kale ay dhaawacmeen , oo ay ku jiraan shan muwaadiniin Sacuudiyaan ah. Afhayeenka isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo, Sarreeye Gaas Turki Al-Maliki , ayaa sheegay in ciidamada difaacu ay qabteen oo burburiyeen gantaal ballistic ah oo ku wajahnaa waqooyiga Riyaad. Waxa kale oo uu sheegay in la burburiyay goob ku taalla caasimadda Yemen ee Sanca oo loo adeegsaday weerarro lagu qaaday Riyaad. GACA waxay sheegtay inay si joogto ah ula shaqaynayso hay’adaha amniga si loo qiimeeyo khasaaraha ka dhashay weerarrada, loona qaado tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah ee lagu xaqiijinayo amniga rakaabka iyo shaqaalaha garoomada. Weerarradan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo ciidamada Yemen ee taageerada ka hela Sacuudiga . Xuutiyiintu waxay sidoo kale sheegteen weerarro loo adeegsaday gantaallo ballistic ah iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo lagu qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha Cadan, balse aan la soo sheegin wax dhimasho ama dhaawac ah. Sidoo kale, safaaradda Mareykanka ee Riyaad ayaa soo saartay digniin amni oo ku socota muwaadiniinta Mareykanka, iyadoo ugu baaqday inay muujiyaan feejignaan dheeraad ah sababo la xiriira xaaladda amni ee ka jirta Sacuudiga.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaalka Yemen iyo duqeymaha Xuutiyiinta
items.description: Cadan (Caasimada Online) – Dagaalka Yemen ayaa sii xoogeysanaya, iyadoo maanta Xuutiyiinta ay laba gantaal ku bartilmaameedsadeen garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee magaalada Cadan, sida uu sheegay Xafiiska Warbaahinta ee Agaasinka Amniga Cadan. Weli lama soo sheegin wax khasaare ah oo ka dhashay weerarka. Isbahaysiga Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa dhankiisa sheegay inuu qabtay oo burburiyay gantaal ballistic ah oo loo waday magaalada Khamis Mushait ee koonfurta Sacuudiga. Sida uu sheegay isbahaysiga, gantaallada iyo hanjabaadaha kale ee cirka ah ayaa laga soo diray deegaanno ay Xuutiyiintu maamulaan, oo ay kamid yihiin caasimadda Sanca iyo gobollada Saada iyo Camraan. Warbaahinta taageerta Xuutiyiinta ayaa iyaduna sheegtay in ciidamada Sacuudigu duqeymo ka geysteen qaybo kamid ah gobollada Ibb iyo Taiz ee bartamaha Yemen. Hase yeeshee, ilaa hadda ma jirto xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo ku saabsan sheegashadaas. Isbahaysiga Sacuudiga ayaa Talaadadii sidoo kale sheegay inuu qabtay gantaal ay Xuutiyiintu u soo rideen dhanka dhulka Sacuudiga, iyadoo dhacdooyinkan ay kusoo beegmayaan xilli ciidamada dowladda Yemen ay sheegayaan inay wadaan howl-gallo ay ku doonayaan inay dib ugu qabsadaan deegaanno ay Xuutiyiintu hore ula wareegeen. Afhayeenka militariga Xuutiyiinta, Yahya Saree ayaa dhankiisa beeniyay sheegashooyinka ku saabsan in kooxdu lumisay dhulalkii ay hore u qabsatay, isagoo sheegay inay weli gacanta ku hayaan dhammaan goobihii ay bishii hore la wareegeen, gaar ahaan deegaannada ku teedsan xeebta Badda Cas. Dowladda Yemen ayaase sheegtay in ciidamadeedu ay Xuutiyiinta ka saareen goobo ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab iyo magaalada dekedda ah ee Mocha, iyadoo howlgalladaasi ay qayb ka yihiin dagaallada ka socda galbeedka dalka. Xaaladda dhabta ah ee dhulka ayaa weli adag in si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyo, maadaama sheegashooyinka dhinacyada dagaalka ay iska hor imaanayaan, halka xaaladda amni iyo dagaallada socda ay sidoo kale adkeynayaan in saxafiyiintu gaaraan goobaha ay iska horimaadyadu ka dhacayaan. Dhanka khasaaraha, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegtay in lix qof oo hal qoys ah oo ay ku jiraan afar carruur ah lagu dilay duqeyn cirka ah oo Sacuudigu ka fuliyay tuulo ku taalla gobolka Hajjah. Sheegashadan ayaan sidoo kale si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay inay Isniintii weerareen garoonka diyaaradaha Riyadh iyo warshad sifeysa shidaalka oo ay leedahay shirkadda Sacuudiga ee Aramco, taasoo qayb ka noqonaysa weerarrada isa soo taraya ee dhinacyadu isku adeegsanayaan gantaallada iyo duqeymaha cirka. The post Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaalka Yemen iyo duqeymaha Xuutiyiinta appeared first on Caasimada Online .
