items.title: Xogta QM oo beenisay sawirka Wasiir Cali Xaaji uu ka bixiyay xaaladda caafimaadka Soomaaliya
items.description: Wasiirka Caafimaadka Soomaaliya Cali Xaaji oo shalay hortagay Guddiga Horumarinta Adeegga Bulshada ee Golaha Shacabka BJFS, ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda caafimaad ee dalka, hase yeeshee sheegashooyinkii uu Guddiga ka hor sheegay waxaa si weyn uga hor imanaya xog ay soo saartay Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan isku-duwidda arrimaha bani’aadannimada ee OCHA. Wasiirka ayaa ku faanay in xaaladda caafimaad ee Soomaaliya ay mareyso meeshii ugu wanaagsaneyd, isaga oo sheegay in tan iyo bishii Janaayo ee sanadkan la badbaadiyey in ka badan 600 oo xarumo ama adeegyo caafimaad ah oo uu sheegay inay halis ugu jireen inay u xirmaan dhaqaale la’aan. Laakiin xogta OCHA ayaa sawir gebi ahaan ka duwan sheegashada wasiirka ka bixinaysa xaaladda dhabta ah ee caafimaadka dalka. Warbixin ay OCHA soo saartay 22-kii September 2026 ayaa lagu sheegay in muddadii u dhexeysay Janaayo iyo Agoosto 2026 ay Soomaaliya ka xirmeen 495 xarumood oo caafimaad, kuwaas oo ay saameeyeen dhaqaale la’aanta iyo hoos u dhaca maalgelinta adeegyada caafimaadka. 380 ka mid ah xarumahaas ayaa ahaa xarumo rasmi ah oo si joogto ah u shaqeynayay, balse sababo la xiriira dhaqaale xumo ayaa intooda badan albaabada loogu laabay, halka qaar kalena si weyn loo dhimay shaqaalihii iyo adeeggyadii caafimaad ee ay bulshada siin jireen. Waxaa intaas dheer, 115 xarumood oo guurguura ayaa sida OCHA sheegtay gebi ahaanba xirmay, taas oo goysay adeegyadii caafimaadka ee ay heli jireen dadka ku nool miyaga fog iyo deegaannada ay adagtahay in la gaaro. Marka la isbarbar dhigo hadalka Wasiirka Caafimaadka iyo xogta hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay, waxaa soo baxaya su’aal weyn oo ah: Sidee loo sheegan karaa in xaaladda caafimaad ee dalka ay mareyso meeshii ugu wanaagsaneyd, iyadoo boqolaal xarumo caafimaad ah ay xirmeen, qaar kalena ay yareeyeen adeeggyadii ay bulshada siin jireen? Su’aashan ayaa sii xoogeysanaysa iyadoo Wasiirku uu Guddiga ka hor sheegtay horumar caafimaad oo ballaaran, halka xogta OCHA ay tilmaamayso in maalgelin la’aantu ay keentay in adeegyo caafimaad oo muhiim ah ay istaagaan ama hoos u dhacaan. Arrinta kale ee sii xoojineysa tuhunka dul hoganaya sheegashada wasiirka waa dalabkii uu sameeyay intii uu socday kulanka, kaas oo ahaa in warbaahinta madaxa-bannaan laga saaro goobta si aan loo duubin kulanka. Tallaabadan ayaa dhalisay su’aalo la xiriira hufnaanta kulanka iyo sababta Wasiirku u doonayay in aan shacabka Soomaaliyeed si toos ah loo gaarsiin doodda iyo su’aalaha ay Guddigu ka weydiinayeen xaaladda Caafimaad ee dalka. Waxaa xusid mudan in marka laga hadlayo caafimaadka bulshada, aan la iska indho tiri karin xaqiiqada ka jirta goobaha caafimaadka, gaar ahaan marka xog rasmi ah oo ka timid hay’ad Qaramada Midoobay ay muujineyso in boqolaal xarumo caafimaad ay xirmeen. Shacabka Soomaaliyeed ma mudna in laga qariyo xaqiiqada ku saabsan adeegyada caafimaad ee ay noloshoodu ku tiirsan tahay. Sidoo kale, ma mudna in xaalad caafimaad oo halis ah loo sawiro si ka duwan sida ay dhab ahaan uga jirto dalka. Caafimaadku ma aha arrin siyaasadeed oo lagu qurxin karo tirooyin ama hadallo masuuliyadeed; waa adeeg si toos ah u taabanaya nolosha iyo badbaadada dadka Soomaaliyeed. Haddii xarumo caafimaad xirmaan, shaqaale la yareeyo, adeegyo hoos loo dhigo, isla markaana dadka ku nool miyiga fog ay waayaan adeegii caafimaad ee ay ku tiirsanaayeen, shacabka waxay xaq u leeyihiin in si cad loogu sheego waxa dhacay iyo sababta keentay. Shacabka Soomaaliyeed waxay sugayaan xog furan, isla-xisaabtan iyo tallaabo dhab ah oo lagu badbaadinayo adeegyada caafimaad ee dalka.

items.title: Maxay HirShabelle ka tiri odayaashii heshiiska lasoo galay Al-Shabaab?

Muuqaallo ay dhawaan baahisay kooxda ayaa waxaa kasoo muuqday odayaal sheegay inay heshiis nabadeed la gaareen Khawaarijta, kadib kulamo toos ah oo ay yeesheen labada dhinac. items.title: Kulankii Golaha Shacabka oo Mar kale u Baaqday koram la’aan
items.description: Kulankii ay maanta yeelan lahaayeen Xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale u baaqday, kadib markii aan la helin tiradii xildhibaannada ee uu kulanku ku furmi lahaa. Tan ayaa noqoneysa mid ka mid ah kulamadii u dambeeyay ee Golaha Shacabka ee aan u qabsoomin sababo la xiriira koram la’aan . fadhigii Golaha Shacabka ee 28-kii Sebtembar uu isna u baaqday koram la’aan, iyadoo markaas uu kulanka xaadiray 123 xildhibaan, waxaana ay tilmaamayaan xeerarka iyo habraacyada Baarlamaanka, koramku haddii uusan buuxsanin inay kulamadu baaqdaan. Golaha Shacabka ayaa mas’uul ka ah ansixinta sharciyada, kormeerka howlaha dowladda iyo ka shaqeynta arrimaha siyaasadeed iyo sharciyeed ee dalka. Baaqashada kulamada soo noqnoqota ayaa dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan joogitaanka xildhibaannada iyo awoodda Golaha Shacabka ee uu si joogto ah ugu gudan karo waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah.

items.title: Rakaab ku geeriyooday Diyaaradda Kenya Airways oo ku sii jeedday Lagos
items.description: Rakaab saarnaa diyaarad ay leedahay shirkadda Kenya Airways oo ka duushay magaalada Nairobi kuna sii jeedday Lagos ee dalka Nigeria ayaa ku geeriyooday gudaha diyaaradda, kadib xaalad caafimaad oo degdeg ah oo soo wajahday wax yar ka hor inta aysan diyaaraddu gaarin halka ay ku socotay. Kenya Airways ayaa Arbacadii sheegtay in dhacdadu ay dhacday Talaadadii, 6-dii Oktoobar, iyadoo rakaabka la sheegay inuu miyir beelay qiyaastii 20 daqiiqo ka hor inta aysan diyaaradda ka degin garoonka caalamiga ah ee Murtala Muhammed ee Lagos. Shaqaalaha diyaaradda ayaa isla markiiba bixiyay gargaarka degdegga ah, waxayna raaceen habraacyada loogu talagalay xaaladaha caafimaad ee ka dhaca gudaha diyaaradaha. Diyaaraddu waxay si caadi ah ugu degtay garoonka Lagos abbaaro 9:41 habeenimo waqtiga Nigeria , waxaana diyaaradda ku sugnaa shaqaale caafimaad oo baaritaan ku sameeyay rakaabka. Shaqaalaha caafimaadka ayaa markii dambe xaqiijiyay inuu qofkaasi geeriyooday. Shirkadda Kenya Airways ma shaacin magaca, da’da ama jinsiyadda rakaabka, sidoo kalena ma aysan sheegin sababta saxda ah ee keentay geeridiisa. Shirkaddu waxay sheegtay inay si dhow ula shaqeynayso qoyska marxuumka, maamulka deegaanka iyo hay’adaha qaabilsan duulista, iyadoo ilaalinaysa xogta gaarka ah iyo karaamada qofka geeriyooday. Dhacdadan ayaa sidoo kale waxaa la sheegay in mas’uuliyiinta Nigeria ay darsayaan, iyadoo hay’adda duulista rayidka Nigeria ay xaqiijisay in booliiska uu qayb ka yahay baaritaanka dhacdada. Kenya Airways ayaa tacsi u dirtay qoyska iyo ehelada rakaabka geeriyooday, iyadoo sheegtay inay bixinayso taageerada lagama maarmaanka ah inta ay socoto la macaamilka qoyska iyo hay’adaha ay khusayso.

items.title: Daawo: Maamulka Doolow oo ku dhawaaqay inay ku shaqeynayaan amarrada Itoobiya
items.description: Doolow (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Degmada Doolow, Maxamed Xuseen Cabdi (Lafeey) oo maanta kormeer ugu tegay ciidamada amniga degmadaas iyo kuwa Daraawiishta Jubbaland ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aaddan xaaladda gobolka Gedo oo marar kala duwan ay ka dhaceen dagaallo ka dhashay siyaasadaha is-diidan ee ka jira gobolkaasi. Lafeey ayaa marka hore ku dhawaaqay go’aan xasaasi ah oo la xiira xaaladda degmada Doolow, wuxuuna sheegay in hadda kadib ay ku shaqeyn doonaan amarrada ciidamada Itoobiya, inta laga helayo dowlad Soomaaliyeed oo si guud ula wareegta talada dalka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa ciidamada Itoobiya ku amaanay wada shaqeynta ay la leeyihiin ciidamada deegaanka, isaga oo intaas ku daray in hadda kadib ay ku shaqeyn doonaan siyaasadoooda, ayna iska diidi doonaan wax kasta oo aysan raali ka ahayn ciidanka Itoobiya. “Intii dowlad Soomaaliyeed laga helayo oo awood leh oo meel kasta la wareegeysa danaheenna iyo waxa aan ku noolnahay cidna uma daba fariisaneyno annaga ayaan fiirineyno sida dadka u wanaagsan, sidoo kale Policy aysan Itoobiya raalli ka ahayn kuma shaqeyn doono,” ayuu yiri guddoomiye Maxamed Xuseen Cabdi (Lafeey). Sidoo kale, wuxuu faray ciidamada amniga inay ixtiraamaan ciidamada Itoobiya oo uu tilmaamay inay muddo dheer ka shaqeynayeen xasilloonida gobolka, sida uu hadaka u dhigay. “Labada ciidan waa wada dagan yihiin waxaan rabnaa in la ixtiraamo ciidamadaas walaalnimo loo muujiyo maxaa yeelay 30 sano ka badan ayay waddanka joogaan waxa ay ugu dhex jiraana waa xasilooni iyo nabad-gelyo,” ayuu sii raaciyay guddoomiyaha maamulka Doolow. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyadoo haatan ay mar kale soo laba kacleysay xiisadda Gedo, waxaana weli dhaq-dhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeedo laga dareemaaa dgemooyin ka tirsan gobolkaasi oo ay wada joogaan ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Daraawiishta Jubbaland. items.title: Ethiopia Slams Somalia’s Alignment With Egypt, Sudan and Eritrea
items.description: Ethiopia’s state-run Ethiopian News Agency (ENA) has launched a sharp criticism of Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud following Somalia’s decision to join a joint statement issued by Somalia, Egypt, Sudan and Eritrea in El-Alamein on October 4, 2026. In a lengthy article, ENA accused the Somali president of taking a position that it said contradicts Ethiopia’s strategic interests and the broader political realities of the Horn of Africa. The article, titled “How President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s Betrayal Undermines the Realities of the Region,” focused on Somalia’s participation in the joint declaration and its potential regional implications. ENA argued that Mogadishu’s decision could affect Ethiopia’s interests over the Nile waters and Red Sea security, framing Somalia’s alignment with Egypt, Sudan and Eritrea as a significant development in the region’s shifting political landscape. The agency also highlighted the longstanding relationship between Ethiopia and Somalia, particularly Ethiopia’s involvement in Somalia’s political reconciliation and state-building efforts following the collapse of the country’s central government in 1991. ENA cited the Sodere and Mbagathi conferences, arguing that Ethiopia played an important role in political processes that contributed to the formation of Somalia’s transitional administrations. The article further emphasized Ethiopia’s military involvement in Somalia, including operations against Al-Shabaab and participation in African Union-led missions such as AMISOM, ATMIS and AUSSOM. It cited Ethiopian military deployments in areas including Baidoa, Luuq and Beledweyne as examples of Ethiopia’s contribution to Somalia’s security. ENA’s criticism comes amid growing regional competition over strategic interests in the Horn of Africa, particularly the Nile waters, the Red Sea and regional security alliances. Somalia’s participation in the El-Alamein statement has added another layer to the increasingly complex relationship between Mogadishu and Addis Ababa, as the two countries pursue competing diplomatic and strategic interests in a rapidly shifting regional environment. items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo Weeraray Garoonka Diyaaradaha Cadan iyo Sacuudiga oo sheegay inuu qabtay Gantaal
items.description: Dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay ayaa Xuutiyiinta ku eedeysay inay gantaallo ballistic ah iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weerareen garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Cadan, xilli diyaarad rakaab ah oo ka timid magaalada Qaahira ee dalka Masar ay ku sii jeedday garoonka. Wasaaradda Gaadiidka Yemen ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan laba gantaal oo ballistic ah iyo dhowr diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn lagu bartilmaameedsaday dhabaha diyaaradaha iyo xarunta rakaabka ee garoonka. Sida ay wasaaraddu sheegtay, mid ka mid ah gantaallada ayaa ku dhacay meel u dhow dhabaha diyaaradaha, daqiiqado ka hor intii aysan soo degin diyaaraddii ka timid Qaahira, taas oo keentay in diyaaradda laga joojiyo inay Cadan ku degto, waxaana loo weeciyay magaalada Jeddah ee Sacuudiga si loo ilaaliyo badqabka rakaabka. Mas’uuliyiinta Yemen ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in xarunta rakaabka garoonka laga daadgureeyay, halka laba diyaaradood oo ku sugnaa garoonkana laga fogeeyay goobta ay weerarradu ka dhacayeen. Dowladda Yemen ayaa ka digtay in weerarku uu sababi karay khasaaro badan oo rayid ah haddii diyaaradda rakaabka ah ay xilligaas soo degi lahayd. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in bartilmaameedkoodu aanu ahayn diyaaradaha rayidka ah, balse ay weerareen sahay milatari oo Sacuudigu waday, taas oo ku wajahneyd xerada Badr ee ku dhow garoonka Cadan. Isbahaysiga milatari ee uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa sheegay inuu qabtay oo burburiyay gantaal ballistic ah oo Xuutiyiintu u rideen dhanka waqooyi ee magaalada Riyadh. Afhayeenka isbahaysiga, Sarreeye Guuto Turki Al-Maliki, ayaa sheegay in ciidamada ay dabagal ku sameeyeen goobtii laga soo tuuray gantaalka, isagoo sheegay in goobtaas laga raadinayay agagaarka magaalada Sanca. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay weerarro ku qaadeen garoomada diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Riyadh iyo Abha, taasoo muujinaysa in xiisadda u dhaxaysa Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga ay sii xoogeysanayso. Weerarradan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dagaallada Yemen ay mar kale xoogeysteen, gaar ahaan gobolka Taiz iyo deegaannada ku dhow marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab. Ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee taageerada ka hela Sacuudiga ayaa wada howlgallo ay doonayaan inay dib ugu qabsadaan dekedda Mocha iyo goobo muhiim ah oo ku yaalla xeebaha Badda Cas. Dagaallada ayaa sidoo kale ku soo aadaya xilli xiisadaha gobolka Bariga Dhexe ay sare u sii kacayaan, iyadoo Xuutiyiinta iyo dowladaha taageera dowladda Yemen ay isku dayayaan inay gacanta ku dhigaan goobo istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah dhaq-dhaqaaqa milatari iyo ganacsi ee gobolka.

Sida ay wasaaraddu sheegtay, mid ka mid ah gantaallada ayaa ku dhacay meel u dhow dhabaha diyaaradaha, daqiiqado ka hor intii aysan soo degin diyaaraddii ka timid Qaahira, taas oo keentay in diyaaradda laga joojiyo inay Cadan ku degto, waxaana loo weeciyay magaalada Jeddah ee Sacuudiga si loo ilaaliyo badqabka rakaabka. Mas’uuliyiinta Yemen ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in xarunta rakaabka garoonka laga daadgureeyay, halka laba diyaaradood oo ku sugnaa garoonkana laga fogeeyay goobta ay weerarradu ka dhacayeen. Dowladda Yemen ayaa ka digtay in weerarku uu sababi karay khasaaro badan oo rayid ah haddii diyaaradda rakaabka ah ay xilligaas soo degi lahayd. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in bartilmaameedkoodu aanu ahayn diyaaradaha rayidka ah, balse ay weerareen sahay milatari oo Sacuudigu waday, taas oo ku wajahneyd xerada Badr ee ku dhow garoonka Cadan. Isbahaysiga milatari ee uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa sheegay inuu qabtay oo burburiyay gantaal ballistic ah oo Xuutiyiintu u rideen dhanka waqooyi ee magaalada Riyadh. Afhayeenka isbahaysiga, Sarreeye Guuto Turki Al-Maliki, ayaa sheegay in ciidamada ay dabagal ku sameeyeen goobtii laga soo tuuray gantaalka, isagoo sheegay in goobtaas laga raadinayay agagaarka magaalada Sanca. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay weerarro ku qaadeen garoomada diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Riyadh iyo Abha, taasoo muujinaysa in xiisadda u dhaxaysa Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga ay sii xoogeysanayso. Weerarradan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dagaallada Yemen ay mar kale xoogeysteen, gaar ahaan gobolka Taiz iyo deegaannada ku dhow marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab. Ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee taageerada ka hela Sacuudiga ayaa wada howlgallo ay doonayaan inay dib ugu qabsadaan dekedda Mocha iyo goobo muhiim ah oo ku yaalla xeebaha Badda Cas. Dagaallada ayaa sidoo kale ku soo aadaya xilli xiisadaha gobolka Bariga Dhexe ay sare u sii kacayaan, iyadoo Xuutiyiinta iyo dowladaha taageera dowladda Yemen ay isku dayayaan inay gacanta ku dhigaan goobo istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah dhaq-dhaqaaqa milatari iyo ganacsi ee gobolka.

items.title: Khilaafka Madaxda Waqooyi Bari oo sii Xoogeysanaya
items.description: Khilaaf siyaasadeed oo u dhexeeya Madaxweynaha Maamulka Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Axmed Aw-Cali (Firdhiye) , iyo Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka maamulkaas, Cabdirashiid Yuusuf Jibriil (Abwaan) , ayaa maalmahan sii xoogeysanaya, iyadoo muranka labada mas’uul uu saameyn ku yeeshay xiriirkooda siyaasadeed iyo shaqada Baarlamaanka maamulka. Xogaha ayaa sheegaya in khilaafku uu salka ku hayo kala aragti duwanaansho ku saabsan maamulka hay’adaha, awoodaha dastuuriga ah iyo heerka talo-wadaagga u dhexeeya Madaxweynaha iyo ku-xigeenkiisa. Xiisadda ayaa si weyn loo dareemay kadib markii Madaxweyne Firdhiye uu magaalada Laascaanood ku soo laabtay, kaddib muddo ka badan 50 maalmood oo uu safar ku joogay magaalada Muqdisho. Firdhiye ayaa Laascaanood loogu sameeyay soo dhaweyn ay ka qaybgaleen xubno ka tirsan maamulka, saraakiil ciidan, isimmo iyo qeybaha bulshada, balse waxaa goobta ka maqnaa Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Abwaan. Warbaahinta gudaha ayaa maqnaanshihiisa la xiriirisay khilaafka labada mas’uul, ayadoo Mid ka mid ah arrimaha la sheegay inuu khilaafka sii huriyay ayaa tahay magacaabista taliyaha Qaybta 26-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed , iyadoo warbixinno gudaha ahi ay sheegayaan in Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka aan lagala tashan magacaabista taliyaha oo kasoo jeeda gobolka Sanaag. Khilaafkan ayaa saameyn ku yeeshay Baarlamaanka Waqooyi Bari, iyadoo xildhibaannada lagu soo warramayo inay u kala jabeen taageerayaasha labada dhinac. Wararka qaar ayaa sheegaya in xildhibaanno taageersan Madaxweyne Firdhiye ay wadaan qorshe la xiriira xasaanadda Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Abwaan, xilli kalfadhiyadii Baarlamaanka qaarkood ay dib u dhaceen iyadoo ay jirto kala qaybsanaan siyaasadeed. Dhanka kale, Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Cabdirashiid Abwaan ayaa saacado ka hor qoraal uu baraha bulshada ku baahiyay kaga hadlay hadal-haynta khilaafka. Inkastoo uusan si faahfaahsan u shaacin qodobada ay isku hayaan Madaxweynaha, haddana qoraalkiisa waxaa laga fahmay inuu ka jawaabayo eedeymo ay jeedinayaan dhinacyada taageersan Firdhiye, isagoo sheegay inuu weli ku taagan yahay mowqifkiisa ku aaddan jiritaanka iyo midnimada Maamulka Waqooyi Bari. Khilaafkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Waqooyi Bari uu yahay maamul cusub oo curdun ah, kaas oo la dhisay kadib isbeddelladii siyaasadeed iyo amni ee ka dhacay Laascaanood iyo deegaannada ku xeeran.

items.title: Madaxii sirdoonka Jarmalka oo la ogaaday in uu 12 sano jaajuus u ahaa dal kale
items.description: Berlin (Caasimada Online) — Madaxii hore ee hay’adda sirdoonka dibadda Jarmalka, August Hanning, ayaa Talaadadii la xiray, isaga oo lagu tuhunsan yahay basaasnimo iyo isku day khiyaano qaran, kiis loo arko inuu noqon karo mid ka mid ah jebinnadii ugu waaweynaa ee dhinaca sirdoonka ee dalkaas tan iyo dhammaadkii Dagaalkii Qaboobaa. Xafiiska Xeer-ilaaliyaha Federaalka Jarmalka ayaa sheegay in Hanning, oo madax ka ahaa hay’adda BND intii u dhaxeysay 1998 iyo 2005, lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu muddo dheer helayay xog iyo dokumiintiyo sir ah oo ka imanayay gudaha hay’adda. Sida ay xeer-ilaaliyeyaashu sheegeen , shaqsi lagu magacaabay Manfred D., oo xilal sare ka soo qabtay BND, ayaa la tuhunsan yahay inuu Hanning siiyay ku dhowaad 2,000 oo dokumiinti muddo ku dhow 12 sano ah, ilaa 2022. Dokumiintiyadaas waxaa ka mid ahaa kuwo sir ah oo loogu talagalay in lagu wargeliyo hoggaanka sare ee BND ka hor shirar joogto ah oo ka dhici jiray xafiiska ra’iisul wasaaraha Jarmalka, kuwaas oo ay ka qeybgeli jireen saraakiil sare oo ka kala socday wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha ammaanka. Xeer-ilaaliyeyaasha ayaa sheegay in Hanning uu xogtaas u adeegsan jiray shaqadiisa gaarka ah ee la-talinta, isla markaana ugu yaraan hal kiis uu xog sir ah uga diyaariyay qiimeyn loo gudbiyay shaqaale ka tirsan hay’ad sirdoon oo dal kale. “Eedeysanaha Hanning waxaa si xooggan loogu tuhunsan yahay basaasnimo gaareysa heer khiyaano qaran,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka xeer-ilaalinta. Ilaa hadda lama shaacin hay’adda sirdoon ee ajnabiga ah ee uu la xiriiray ama dalka ay ka tirsan tahay. Sarkaal sirdoon oo Jarmal ah oo la hadlay warbaahinta Politico , isagoo codsaday inaan magaciisa la shaacin sababo la xiriira baaritaanka socda, ayaa sheegay in hay’adaha sirdoonka Ruushka iyo Shiinaha aysan ku lug lahayn labada xiriir ee baaritaanku diiradda saarayo. Xog muddo dheer socotay Manfred D., oo lagu sheegay inuu ahaa madaxii shaqaalaha Hanning, ayaa markii dambe sii joogay gudaha BND, isagoo madax xafiis u ahaa dhowr madaxweyne oo hay’adda hoggaamiyay intii u dhaxeysay Maarso 2012 iyo Maarso 2026, sida ay sheegeen xeer-ilaaliyeyaasha. Waxaa lagu soo oogay dacwad la xiriirta “kaalmeynta iyo fududeynta isku day khiyaano qaran iyo basaasnimo loogu adeegayo quwad shisheeye”. Xeer-ilaalinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Hanning uu sanado badan “xiriir aad u xooggan” la lahaa qof kale oo ka tirsan hay’ad sirdoon oo ajnabi ah, kaas oo uu siin jiray xog siyaasadeed, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah xogtaas lagu saleynayay dokumiintiyada uu ka helay Manfred D. Kiiska ayaa hadda dhalinaya su’aalo culus oo ku saabsan sida xog intaas le’eg looga saari karay gudaha BND muddo ka badan toban sano iyadoo aan la ogaan. Waxa kale oo uu dhaawac cusub ku yahay sumcadda hay’adda sirdoonka dibadda Jarmalka, oo horey ula kulantay kiisas la xiriira shaqaale lagu eedeeyay inay u basaasayeen dalal kale. Sanadkii 2022, mas’uul hore oo BND ka tirsanaa oo lagu magacaabo Carsten L. ayaa la xiray isaga oo lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu xog sir ah u gudbiyay Ruushka. Wuxuu beeniyay eedeymaha loo heysto, iyadoo dacwaddiisu weli socoto. Kiisaska noocaas ah ayaa waqtiyadii hore walaac ku abuuray qaar ka mid ah hay’adaha sirdoonka reer Galbeedka, kuwaas oo mararka qaar ka taxaddarayay xogta xasaasiga ah ee ay la wadaagaan BND. Waqti xasaasi ah Xarigga Hanning ayaa yimid xilli dowladda Chancellor Friedrich Merz ay qorsheyneyso inay awood dheeraad ah siiso BND, oo ay ku jiraan awoodaha hawlgallada weerarka dhanka internet-ka, basaasnimo ballaaran iyo tallaabooyin kale oo looga jawaabayo khataraha ka imanaya dibadda, gaar ahaan Ruushka. Maalin ka hor xarigga, madaxa hadda ee BND, Martin Jäger, ayaa baarlamaanka uga digay in Jarmalku halis ugu jiro inuu galo “isku dhac rabshado wata” oo Ruushka kala dhexeeya, isaga oo Moscow ku eedeeyay inay sare u qaaday dagaal qarsoon oo ka dhan ah Berlin. Jäger ayaa isla markaas taageeray sharci cusub oo hay’addiisa siinaya awoodo dheeraad ah. “Waxaan noqon doonnaa BND ka duwan, BND cusub,” ayuu yiri. “Waan ognahay in awoodaha dheeraadka ahi ay la socdaan mas’uuliyad dheeraad ah.” Laakiin maalin kadib, Jäger ayaa is arkay isagoo difaacaya hay’addiisa, kadib markii eedeymaha cusub ay kiciyeen walaac ku saabsan amniga gudaha BND iyo sida ay xog xasaasi ah muddo dheer uga bixi kartay hay’adda. “BND iyo anigaba, wax tanaasul ah kama geli karno marka ay timaaddo amniga gudaha,” ayuu Jäger ku yiri bayaan. “Dhacdadan waxba kama beddeleyso himilooyinkeena iyo mudnaanteena.” Hase yeeshee, kiiska ayaa la filayaa inuu sii kordhiyo cadaadiska baarlamaanka iyo su’aalaha ku saabsan sida BND u maareyso sirteeda xilli Jarmalku isku diyaarinayo inuu jawaab adag ka bixiyo basaasnimo, weerarro dhanka internetka ah iyo falal carqaladeyn ah oo uu ku eedeeyo Ruushka. Konstantin von Notz, oo ka tirsan xisbiga Greens kana mid ah guddiga baarlamaanka ee kormeera hay’adaha sirdoonka, ayaa ku tilmaamay eedeymaha loo jeediyay Hanning kuwo “culus oo naxdin leh”. “Waxyeello kasta oo soo gaartay hay’adaha sirdoonka waa in si degdeg ah oo dhameystiran loo ogaadaa loona baaro,” ayuu u sheegay wargeyska WELT. The post Madaxii sirdoonka Jarmalka oo la ogaaday in uu 12 sano jaajuus u ahaa dal kale appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya oo sare u qaaday la socodka diyaaradaha Afrika, kadib halis soo korortay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa haatan bilowday inay si dhow ula socoto dhaq-dhaqaaqa diyaaradaha ka imaanaya Afrika, gaar ahaan meelaha uu ka dilaacay cudurka Ebola, oo haatan soo gaaray qaar kamid ah waddamada dariska, gaar ahaan Kenya oo shalay laga helay kiiskii ugu horreeysay, sida ay xaqiijisay wasaaradda caafimaadka dalkaasi. Wasiirka caafimaadka Soomaaliya, Dr. Cali Xaaji Aadan oo ka hadlayay halista soo korortay ee Ebola ayaa sheegay inay qaadeen tallaabooyin dheeraad ah oo looga hortagayo in cudurka uu soo gaaro Soomaaliya. Cali Xaaji Aadan ayaa tilmaamay in howlwadeenno caafimaad ay geeyeen garoonka diyaaradaha, si ay ula socdaan diyaaradaha ka imaanaya waddamada Afrika, loona hubiyo xaaladda caafimaad ee rakaabka ka soo degaya. Shaqaalaha caafimaadka ee la geeyay garoonka ayaa sidoo kale baaritaanno ku sameynaya rakaabka la socda diyaaradaha, iyagoo hubinaya xaaladdooda, ka hor inta aysan gudaha u gelin magaalada. “Garoonka waxaan u sameynay koox caafimaad oo ka dhex shaqeysa lana soconaya dhaq-dhaqaaqa diyaaradaha ka imaanaya dalalka Afrika marka waxaan hadda sii xoojineynaa diyaar garowga markii haddii kenya oo daris nala ah uu soo gaaray Ebola,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka. Dhinaca kale, bayaan ay soo saartay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada ayaa lagu sheegay inay xoojinayso diyaargarowga dalka, iyadoo wargelin la wadaagtay shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Wasaaradda ayaa soo saartay saddex qodob oo muhiim ah sidoo kalena uu qofka isaga iaalin karo xanuunka. 1-Si joogto ah u dhaq gacmahaaga. 2-Ha taaban dhiigga iyo dheecaannada jirka ee qof jiran. 3-Haddii aad xanuun daran dareento, gaar ahaan kaddib safar aad ku tagtay meel uu Ebola saameeyay, si degdeg ah u raadso daryeel caafimaad. Calaamadaha: qandho lama filaan ah, daal daran, xanuun murqaha ah, madax-xanuun, cune-xanuun, matag, shuban iyo dhiigbax aan sabab cad lahayn. Calaamaduhu waxay soo bixi karaan 2 ilaa 21 maalmood kaddib marka qofka uu fayrasku ku dhaco. items.title: Kenya Ebola case: Somalia screens Mogadishu airport arrivals
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s federal government is closely monitoring flights from Ebola-affected African countries and has deployed health staff at Mogadishu airport, after neighbouring Kenya reported its first case of the virus on Tuesday, Caasimada Online reported on Wednesday. Health Minister Ali Hajji Adan said the government had taken additional steps to keep the virus out of Somalia, including checking the health of travellers before they enter the country. The Ministry of Health said it had made preparations to prevent a spillover and had launched an awareness campaign on how to prevent the virus spreading and on seeking medical attention immediately if symptoms appear. Somalia faces particular risks. Three decades of conflict have left its health sector weak and largely outside government regulation, and the federal government does not control all of the country’s airports and borders. That could make it harder to track arriving travellers and, if the virus were found in the country, to contain its spread and treat those affected. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Ebola Has No Political Borders: Somalia’s Health Authorities Must Put Public Safety Above Politics
items.description: Mogadishu – (WDN) – Kenya’s confirmation of its first Ebola case has triggered renewed concern across the Horn of Africa, highlighting the urgent need for Somalia’s federal and Federal Member State health authorities to set politics aside and work together to prevent the potentially devastating spread of the disease. Kenya’s Health Minister, Aden Barre Duale, confirmed that the patient diagnosed with Ebola had died. The development has heightened regional concern at a time when Ebola remains a serious threat in parts of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with cases also reported in neighboring countries, including Uganda and Rwanda. For Somalia, the message should be clear: Ebola does not recognize political boundaries, administrative jurisdictions, or constitutional disputes. A virus cannot distinguish between Mogadishu, Garowe, Kismayo, Baidoa, or any other part of the country. That reality makes close cooperation between the Federal Government of Somalia’s Ministry of Health and the health ministries of the Federal Member States not merely desirable, but essential. The federal and state authorities may disagree over politics, governance, and the distribution of powers, but infectious diseases demand a different approach. When a highly contagious and potentially deadly disease threatens the population, political differences should be temporarily shelved in favor of coordinated public-health action. A National Health Threat Requires a National Response Somalia’s Ministry of Health has said it is closely monitoring the Ebola situation and has taken precautionary measures to strengthen the country’s preparedness. Puntland’s Ministry of Health has likewise announced that it has intensified Ebola preparedness following Kenya’s confirmation of its first case. Puntland said no Ebola case has so far been confirmed in the state, while emphasizing that it is closely monitoring developments in neighboring countries and across the region. The ministry said it was strengthening preparedness, early detection, and rapid-response mechanisms to improve Puntland’s capacity to prevent and contain infectious diseases. Those measures are important, but Ebola preparedness cannot be confined to individual administrations. Somalia needs a coordinated national surveillance and response system linking the federal ministry with health authorities in Puntland, Jubaland, South West, Galmudug, North East, and Hirshabelle. Such cooperation should include information-sharing, disease surveillance, laboratory testing, border and airport screening where appropriate, training of health workers, emergency preparedness, public awareness, and mechanisms for rapidly transporting suspected cases to designated treatment and isolation facilities. The stakes are exceptionally high. Ebola is caused by the Ebola virus and can be transmitted through direct contact with the blood or bodily fluids of an infected person, particularly when the person is symptomatic. Symptoms can appear between two and 21 days after exposure and may include fever, severe weakness, muscle pain, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain. In severe cases, the disease can lead to internal bleeding, organ failure, and death. Somalia Cannot Afford Institutional Fragmentation Somalia’s geographic position makes vigilance particularly important. The country has extensive links with neighboring states through trade, migration, travel, and family networks. Any outbreak in the region, therefore, could have consequences for Somalia. This is precisely why institutional fragmentation could become dangerous. If federal and state health authorities operate separately, exchange information slowly, or allow political disagreements to interfere with emergency coordination, valuable time could be lost during the early stages of an outbreak. That would be unacceptable. Ebola is not a federal issue, a Puntland issue, a Jubaland issue, or a political issue. It is a public-health emergency that threatens every Somali. The federal Ministry of Health and the health ministries of the Federal Member States should therefore establish or strengthen a permanent coordination mechanism for emerging infectious diseases. It should function regardless of political disagreements between the federal government and individual member states. The same principle should apply to Somalia’s international health partners. The World Health Organization, UNICEF, UN agencies, and other humanitarian and development partners should support a unified national preparedness framework while working directly with the authorities responsible for delivering health services on the ground. Puntland Calls for Vigilance Puntland’s Ministry of Health has urged residents to seek medical attention immediately if they develop symptoms such as fever, severe fatigue, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, or unexplained bleeding—particularly if they have recently traveled to an area where Ebola is circulating. The ministry said it is working with government institutions responsible for managing health risks and with health partners to strengthen Puntland’s capacity to prevent, detect, and respond to infectious diseases and health emergencies, including Ebola. That approach should be replicated across Somalia. Public awareness is equally important. Communities should receive clear, accurate information about how Ebola is transmitted, what symptoms to watch for, and where suspected cases should be reported. At the same time, authorities must avoid misinformation, stigma, and unnecessary public panic. Politics Can Wait; Public Health Cannot Somalia has no shortage of political disagreements. The federal government and Federal Member States frequently clash over constitutional authority, elections, security, and the allocation of powers. But an infectious disease outbreak presents an entirely different kind of challenge. A virus does not negotiate. It does not wait for political dialogue to conclude. And it does not respect constitutional boundaries.If Ebola reaches Somalia, the consequences of institutional rivalry could be measured not in political headlines but in human lives. The confirmation of an Ebola case in Kenya should therefore serve as an early warning rather than a reason for panic. Somalia still has an opportunity to strengthen surveillance, preparedness, and coordination before the disease crosses its borders. The federal government and the Federal Member States should seize that opportunity. Whatever their political differences, Somalia’s health authorities share one fundamental responsibility: protecting the lives of the Somali people. When it comes to Ebola, there should be no federal-versus-state divide, no political calculations, and no institutional rivalry. There should be one public-health objective: detect it early, contain it quickly, and prevent it from spreading. items.title: Political Rift Threatens to Undermine North Eastern Somalia’s Fragile New Administration
items.description: LAS ANOD (WDN) — A growing political dispute has emerged within Somalia’s newly established North Eastern Federal Member State, raising concerns that a deepening rift between its top two leaders could undermine the administration’s stability and derail its early development efforts. The dispute reportedly pits President Abdulqadir Ahmed Aw-Ali (Firdhiye) against his Vice President, Abdirashid Yusuf Jibril (Abwaan). The two leaders have served together for nearly a year and two months, but differences between them are reportedly becoming increasingly visible, with disagreements centering on the administration of government institutions and the distribution of executive powers. Sources familiar with the situation say the dispute also involves competing interpretations of constitutional powers, the mechanisms for consultation and decision-making, and the relationship between the president and his deputy. The tensions became more visible following President Firdhiye’s return to Las Anod after spending several months in Mogadishu. He received a large public welcome upon his arrival, but Vice President Abwaan was notably absent from the reception. His absence has intensified speculation about the state of relations between the two leaders and fueled concerns that the disagreement may be developing into a broader institutional crisis. Parliament Drawn Into the Dispute The political divide appears to have extended into the North Eastern parliament, where lawmakers are reportedly split between the two camps. Some legislators are said to support President Firdhiye, while others have aligned themselves with Vice President Abwaan. The dispute has also reportedly affected parliamentary business, with sessions of the legislature being postponed on several occasions. More seriously, lawmakers aligned with President Firdhiye are reportedly considering efforts to lift Abwaan’s parliamentary immunity, a move that could further escalate the confrontation and transform a political disagreement at the executive level into a wider institutional conflict. If pursued, such measures could deepen divisions within the state’s political institutions at a particularly sensitive stage in its development. A Critical Test for a Newly Established Federal Member State The dispute comes at a consequential moment for the North Eastern Federal Member State, which is still in the process of building the institutions required to govern a newly established federal administration. Its immediate priorities include establishing effective public institutions, strengthening security and justice systems, developing basic infrastructure, expanding public services, attracting investment, and building confidence among communities and political stakeholders. A prolonged confrontation between the president and vice president could divert political attention and administrative resources away from those priorities. More importantly, a sustained leadership dispute could weaken coordination between the executive and legislature, delay government decisions, undermine institutional confidence and complicate efforts to establish predictable systems of governance. For a young administration, the consequences could extend well beyond the personalities involved. Political stability is particularly important during the formative period of a new federal member state because institutions, procedures and conventions are still being established. If disagreements over constitutional authority and executive powers are not managed through established legal and consultative mechanisms, they risk creating precedents that could shape the administration for years to come. The North Eastern administration cannot afford prolonged institutional paralysis at a time when expectations among its population are high. Residents are likely to judge the new administration not simply by political representation but by whether it can deliver tangible improvements in security, education, healthcare, infrastructure, employment and other essential public services. A prolonged dispute at the top could slow decision-making precisely when the administration needs to demonstrate that the new federal arrangement can translate political aspirations into functioning government. The situation could also affect relations between the executive branch and parliament. If lawmakers become divided along competing political lines, legislative oversight and lawmaking could become increasingly entangled in the leadership dispute, potentially delaying critical legislation and government programs. The reported division within parliament is therefore particularly significant. A legislature divided by executive rivalries could find it difficult to provide the stable institutional environment needed for the administration’s early development. A Dispute Bigger Than Two Leaders The emerging confrontation between Firdhiye and Abwaan should therefore be viewed not merely as a personal or political disagreement between two officials. For the North Eastern Federal Member State, the larger issue is whether its institutions can withstand political differences without becoming paralyzed. The administration is still establishing its identity, institutions and governing systems. At this stage, political disputes are inevitable, but the mechanisms used to resolve them may prove more consequential than the disagreements themselves. If constitutional and institutional disputes are handled through dialogue, consultation, parliament and clearly defined legal procedures, they could ultimately strengthen the administration’s institutional foundations. If they instead develop into a prolonged struggle for political control, the consequences could be considerably more damaging—slowing development, weakening public confidence and diverting attention from the urgent task of building effective government. For a newly established Federal Member State seeking to consolidate its institutions and deliver development, political stability is not a luxury. It is a prerequisite for progress. The coming weeks could therefore prove critical. How President Firdhiye, Vice President Abwaan and the North Eastern parliament manage their differences may determine whether the administration moves forward with a unified institutional framework—or becomes consumed by an internal political struggle at the very moment it is attempting to establish itself. items.title: Kenya oo xoojisay Tallaabooyinka ka Dhanka Ebola kaddib kiiskii ugu horreeyay Dalkaas laga diiwaangeliyo
items.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa amray in la xoojiyo tallaabooyinka looga hortagayo cudurka Ebola, kaddib markii dalka laga xaqiijiyay kiiskii ugu horreeyay ee cudurkaasi oo dibadda laga soo geliyay. Sida lagu sheegay war kasoo baxay afhayeenka Madaxweynaha Kenya, 8 xubnood oo ka tirsanaa qoyska bukaankii geeriyooday ayaa la geliyay karantiil, si loola socdo xaaladdooda caafimaad loogana hortago faafitaanka cudurka. Sidoo kale, 21 shaqaale caafimaad ah oo daryeel u fidiyay bukaanka ayaa lagu karantiilay tallaabo ka hortag ah, iyadoo la doonayo in la ogaado haddii qof kamid ah uu la kulmay fayraska. Kiiskan ayaa walaac ka dhaliyay Kenya, maadaama Ebola uu yahay cudur halis ah oo si toos ah ugu gudbi kara dadka marka ay la xiriiraan qof qaba cudurka ama dheecaannadiisa. Madaxweyne Ruto ayaa faray hay’adaha caafimaadka iyo dowladda inay kordhiyaan dadaallada lagu ogaanayo dadka laga yaabo inay xiriir la yeesheen bukaanka, isla markaana la xoojiyo diyaar-garowga caafimaad iyo wacyigelinta bulshada. Mas’uuliyiinta caafimaadka ayaa sidoo kale diiradda saaraya raadraaca dadka xiriirka la sameeyay bukaanka , si haddii kiis kale soo baxo si degdeg ah loo ogaado loona karantiilo. Kiiskan ayaa yimid iyadoo dalalka gobolka ay si dhow ula socdaan cudurrada faafa, waxaana muhiimad gaar ah la siinayaa in la xakameeyo faafitaanka Ebola ka hor inta uusan ku dhex faafin bulshada. Dowladda Kenya ayaa sheegtay inay qaadday tallaabooyin degdeg ah oo lagu xakameynayo xaaladda, iyadoo dadka lagu boorinayo inay raacaan tilmaamaha caafimaad ee dowladda iyo hay’adaha caafimaadka.

Sidoo kale, 21 shaqaale caafimaad ah oo daryeel u fidiyay bukaanka ayaa lagu karantiilay tallaabo ka hortag ah, iyadoo la doonayo in la ogaado haddii qof kamid ah uu la kulmay fayraska. Kiiskan ayaa walaac ka dhaliyay Kenya, maadaama Ebola uu yahay cudur halis ah oo si toos ah ugu gudbi kara dadka marka ay la xiriiraan qof qaba cudurka ama dheecaannadiisa. Madaxweyne Ruto ayaa faray hay’adaha caafimaadka iyo dowladda inay kordhiyaan dadaallada lagu ogaanayo dadka laga yaabo inay xiriir la yeesheen bukaanka, isla markaana la xoojiyo diyaar-garowga caafimaad iyo wacyigelinta bulshada. Mas’uuliyiinta caafimaadka ayaa sidoo kale diiradda saaraya raadraaca dadka xiriirka la sameeyay bukaanka , si haddii kiis kale soo baxo si degdeg ah loo ogaado loona karantiilo. Kiiskan ayaa yimid iyadoo dalalka gobolka ay si dhow ula socdaan cudurrada faafa, waxaana muhiimad gaar ah la siinayaa in la xakameeyo faafitaanka Ebola ka hor inta uusan ku dhex faafin bulshada. Dowladda Kenya ayaa sheegtay inay qaadday tallaabooyin degdeg ah oo lagu xakameynayo xaaladda, iyadoo dadka lagu boorinayo inay raacaan tilmaamaha caafimaad ee dowladda iyo hay’adaha caafimaadka.

items.title: Qoysas nolol quus ah ku wajahaya xeryaha Caabudwaaq oo ay maciin bideen
items.description: (ERGO) –  Cunno xumo, biyo yari iyo hoy la’aan ayay wajahayaan in ka badan saddax boqol qoys oo ku sugan xeryo ku yaalla duleedka magaalada Caabudwaaq ee gobolka Galgaduud. Xaaladdan ayay ku sugan yihiin tan iyo bishii July ee sanadkaan, markii xoolihii ay ku tiirsanaayeen ay ku waayeen roob-yari soo laalabatay. Dadkan waxay ka kala yimaadeen deggaannada Koora-goys, Jir iyo Shiikhaley oo gobolka Galgaduud ah iyo qaybo ka mid ah dowlad deegaanka Soomaalida. Faadumo Cabdullaahi Cali iyo qoyskeeda oo 11 qof ah waxay labadii bilood ee la soo dhaafay hubanti la’aan ku haysataa xerada Mubarak ee degmada Cabudwaaq. Waxay sheegtay in dulsaar ku noqdeen qoys ay ehel yihiin oo xerada horay u deganaa, kuwaas oo ah danyar ah. Waxay tilmaamtay inay hal mar maalinkii la cunaan wixii ay karsadaan ama raashin bisil oo aan ku filnayn ay ka soo dawarsadaan xaafadaha dariska ah ee nolol dhaama. ‘’Meel biil noo saaran oo aan Ilaahay deeqiisa ahayn ma jidho, marna islaamka Ilaahay baan wax ka soo qaadannaa. Ilmo yaryar baan haystaa hal waqti ayaan helna, mararka qaar wixii aan helno ayaan kala reebana subixi oo ilmaha duhurkii lagu samarsiiya.’’ Faadumo oo 53 jir ah iyo qoyskeedu waxa ay ka soo lugeeyeen deegaanka Buullalley oo ku yaal xadka ay wadaagaan Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya, kaas oo dhanka waqooyi-bari ka xiga Caabudwaaq ku dhawaad 70 km. Intii ay jidka ku soo jireen, carruurta waxa ay u soo dhiibeen dad gaari watay oo ay is garanayeen, iyadoo dadka waaweyn ay ku qaadatay muddo laba cisho inay ku soo gaaraan xerada ay hadda ku suganyihiin. Waxay xaaladdan ku qasbanaadeen markii biyo yari, daaq la’ aan iyo cudurro isku raacay ay ku waayeen labo boqol oo ari ah iyo soddon geel ah oo ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd. Waxay tilmaamtay in muddo saddex sano ah tartiib-tartiib ugu la’anayeen xoolaha. Intii ugu danbeeyay ayay xustay inay ka dhinteen bishii Juun.   Dhanka kale waxa ay tilmaamtay inay dhibaaato ku qabaan helitaanka biyaha. ‘’Biyo ma haysanno oo caagadda la keeno daqiiqad ayay cabitaan ugu dhamaaneysaa, adoo maradii wasaq kaa tahay haddaad rabto aan salaad ka tukan, oo ilmaha midka daran asagoon soo gaarin ayay dhamaanayaan.” “Haddana caagadda waxay kaa rabtaa dhowr kilo mitir inaad u doontaa adoo oonkii qaba ood garabkii ku soo qaaddo mar labaad.’’ Faadumo ayaa sheegtay in cunto xumada iyo biyo yarida xerada ku haysato ay u dheertahay hoy’ la’ aan. Waxay reerkeeda badan ku nool yihiin buush ay ku caawiyeen dadka ay ehel yihiin, balse ah mid duug ah oo maryaha saaran ay noqdeen kuwa dhamaaday. Waxaa barakaca uga waxbarasho beelay 6 carruur ah oo horray dugsi Qur’aan u dhigan jiray. Waxay tilmaamtay in xerada aysan ka jirin dhamaan adeegyada aas-aasiga ah aysan u awoodin inay geyso goobaha lacagta ah ee magaalada. Waxaa culaysyada xerada ku haysta u dheer waydiin joogta ah oo ay kala kulmayso $330 oo ah dayn ay ku lahaayeen dukaamada raashin iyo dharka ee tuulladii ay ka yimaadeen. Waxay xustay in ay arrad-tir iyo cunno ay carruurta uga soo qaaday aysana hadda awoodin inay guddo. Haweeynaydaan ayaa xustay in xaalladan ay garab la’aan ku tahay oo ilmaheeda aabbaahood uu yahay wayeel aan waxbo ku soo kordhin karin nolosha reerka. Nolol xumada xerada ku haysa waa mid ay ka wada siman yihiin dhamaan qoysaska dhawaan ku soo biiray. Maxamed Aadan Jaamac oo 62 jir ah waa aabaha sideed carruur ah kaas oo cimrigiisa oo dhan ku soo qaatay xoolo-dhaqashada. Wuxuu sheegay in qoyskiisu ay xilligaan ku jiraan noloshii ugu adkeed ee ay abid mutaan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in arrintaas ay ku abuurayso rajo xumo, maaddama xoolihiisii dhamaadeen uusanna haysan wax beddel u noqon kara. Wuxuu xusay in xerada Mubaarak oo ay soo gaareen bartamihii bishii sideedaad aysan ku helin wax gargaar ah, dadkii uga soo horreeyayna aysan wax badan ku dhaamin. Qoysas ehel la ah oo deggen Caabudwaaq ayuu tilmaamay inuu u tago si ay u siiyaan xoogaa raashin ah oo ay mar dabka saartaan. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay in ay dhibaaato ku qabaan helitaanka biyaha. Qoysas degan meel qiyaastii 3 km u jirta xerada ayay ka soo baryaan 20 liitar oo ay xaaskiisa dhabarka ku soo qaado, joogto ugama helaan oo maalmaha qaar wuxuu xusay inay ka soo waayaan. Daruufaha isku biirsaday ayuu rajo xumo ka muujiyay. ‘’Hoy nagu filan ma haysanno, biyo nagu filan ma haysanno, cunto nagu filan ma haysanno, musqul ma haysanno, waxbarasho ma haysanno, caafimaad ma haysanno. Subaxdii sidii dad ugaarsato ah intaan kala yaacno ayaan habiinkii soo dheelmannaa mararka qaarkood.’’ Maxamed ayaa sheegay in magaalada uu subax kasto ka raadiyo shaqooyin xamaal ah oo ay kamid yihiin dhagax jabin iyo ilaalo inkasta oo uusan wali helin. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay inuusan xirfad kale lahayn si uu ugu shaqeysto magaalada oo uu ku cusub yahay. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay in sidoo kale ay wabarsho la’aan ka yihiin afar carruur oo dugsi Qur’aan uga dhigan jiray deegankoodii, kuwaas oo uu afartii bilba mar neef ari ah siin jiray macalinkooda. Wuxuu xusay in xerada ay yimaadeen aysan hadda ka jirin waxbarasho isagana uusan u awoodin in uu geeyo iskuullada lacagta ah oo ardayda wax loogu dhigo $10. Qoyska Maxamed ayaa ka yimid deegaanka Booro-cad oo katirsan gobolka Qorraxey ee dowlad deegaanka Soomaalida ee Itoobiya. Wuxuu tilmamaay inay barakaca ku qasbanaadeen markii roob yarida darteed ay uga le’deen intii ugu badnayd xoolihiisa. Wuxuu xusay inay u hareen 18 neef oo ari ah kuwaas oo aan nacfi lahayn markii ay ka dhamaadeen xoolihiisa oo ahaa saddex boqol oo ari ah iyo labaatan iyo shan neef oo geel ah, xoolahaas oo ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd. Gudoomiyaha xerada Mubaarak Maxamuud Aadan Warsame ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u shegay in qoysaska xeradaan soo gaaray ay yihiin 340 qoys tan iyo bishii July, kuwaas oo xaalad aad u liidata ku sugan. Wuxuu xusay in dhamaan dadkaan aysan heli karin baahiyaha aas-aasiga ah, maamul ahaana aysan waxbo ku tari Karin dhankooda. Xaalaadda dadkaan ayuu ka dayriyay waxa uuna xusay inay gar gaar dhaqso ah u baahi qabaan, gaar ahaan biyaha iyo cuntada. “Hooy ma haystaan, waxay huwadaan ma haystaan, Teendhooyin ma haystaan, maacuun ma haystaan, biyo mahayaan. Hadda xilli roob baa lagu jiraa haddii caawa roob yimaadana waxaa laga yaabaa xanuunno kale inay ka dillaacaan meesha oo ay ka dhashaan nadaafad la’aanta si deg deg ah in looga jawaabo baan aad iyo aad u codsanayaa.” Gudoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in maalin kasta xerada ay soo gaaraan qoysas cusub oo roob-yarida ka jirtay deegaannadii ku qasabtay inay soo barakacaan. Wuxuu xusay in xaalada dadkan ay la wadaageen maamulka Galmudug iyo hay’ adaha gargaarka, basle aysan wax jawaab ah ka helin. The post Qoysas nolol quus ah ku wajahaya xeryaha Caabudwaaq oo ay maciin bideen appeared first on Radio Ergo - Somali Humanitarian News and Information .

items.title: Maxay tahay Caasho badhi Maxaase lagu falaa?
items.description: Wasaaradda Deegaanka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada ee Somaliland ayaa shaacisay in ciidanka boolisku ay gacanta ku dhigeen muwaadin u dhashay dalka Australia oo isku dayayay inuu dalka ka tahriibiyo nooc ka mid ah xamaaratada loo yaqaanno Caasha-badhi ama Daba-saqafle oo xeebaha laga helo. Agaasimaha Waaxda Duur-joogta ee Wasaaradda Deegaanka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada Somaliland, Cabdinaasir Xuseen Saciid ayaa BBC u sheegay in xayawaankan uu ka mid yahay noocyada qarka u saaran inay dabar-go’aan. “Waxaa na soo wargeliyay shacabka deegaanka oo arkay nin ajaanib ah oo duurka ka guraya xamaarato. Ciidanka Booliska ayaa si degdeg ah u qabtay, waxaana lala qabtay darawalkii waday,” ayuu yiri Cabdinaasir. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in ninkan oo dalxiis ku yimid Somaliland uu duurka ku dhex uruursanayay xamaaratadan, kadib markii ay bulshada deegaanka ka shakiyeen. Eedeysanaha waxaan u gudbinnay Xeer Ilaalinta, Maxkamadduna waxay ku xukuntay 40 Milyan oo Shilinka Somaliland ah iyo inuu dalka kaga baxo 24 saac gudahood,” ayuu yiri. Darawalkii la socday ninkan ayaa isna xabsi ku jira, halka ay socdaan baaritaanno lagu beegsanayo dadkii dalka soo geliyay iyo shabakadda ka dambeysa tahriibinta duur-joogta. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in kiisas kale oo la xiriira tahriibinta duur-joogta loo qabtay dad kale, ayna qaadi doonto tallaabooyin adag si mustaqbalka looga hortago falalka noocan ah Xeerka Ilaalinta Duur-joogta ee Somaliland ayaa si cad u mamnuucaya in duur-joogta la dilo, la qabto ama laga ganacsado, waxaana ciqaab adag ay ka dhalanaysaa cid kasta oo ku xad-gudubta, ajaanib iyo muwaadinba. “Xeerka Ilaalinta Duur-joogtu wuxuu si cad u mamnuucayaa in la qabto, la dilo ama laga ganacsado duur-joogta dalka, cid kasta oo ku xad-gudubtana waxay wajihi doontaa ciqaab adag.” Ugu dambeyn, Cabdinaasir Xuseen Saciid ayaa baaq u diray shacabka Somaliland, isagoo ka codsaday in ay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan laamaha ammaanka si loo ilaaliyo kheyraadka dabiiciga ah ee dalka. Haddaba waxaa su’aal la iska waydiin karaa waxa uu yahay xayawaanka Caasha-badhi, maxaase lagu jeclaaday? Muxuu yahay Caasha-badhi? Xigashada Sawirka, Getty Images Waa xayawaan ka mid ah xamaaratada, gaar ahaan bahda mulacyada ee noocyada kala duwan leh. Xayawaannada ay isku haybta yihiin waxa uu uga duwan yahay qaabka ay u samaysan tahay sayntiisa, oo u eg sida gaashaanka loo adeegsado dagaalka. Waxaa markii ugu horraysay la arkay sanadkii 1935-kii, xilligaas oo uu askari ka tirsanaa ciidamadii gumaysiga Ingiriiska ka helay dhul saxare ah oo ka mid ah deegaannada kulul, sida lagu shaaciyay bogagga wax ka qora arrimaha xayawananada ee Backwater Reptiles iyo BION. Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya oo keliya ayaa laga helaa xayawaankan oo ka mid ah noocyada dhiigga qabow. Ma aha xayawaan wayn. Dhirirkiisu waa 10 cm oo ay ku jirto seyntiisa cajiibka ah. Maxaa loo xiisaynayaa? Xigashada Sawirka, Getty Images Suuqyada online-ka haddii aad eegto waxaad arkaysaa bogag badan oo lagu kala iibiyo Caasha-badhida. Halkii xabbo ee Caasha-badhi ah ayaa lagu iibiyaa qiyaastii $600, taasoo dabcan u muuqata inay tahay sababta ay dad badan u danaynayaan inay dhoofiyaan noolahan ay qaniga ku tahay Soomaaliya. Mid ka mid ah sababaha loo xiisaynayo ayaa noqon karta maaddaama uu xayawaankan yahay mid dhif ah oo aan meelo badan laga helin. Waxyaabaha kale ee uu gaarka la yahay waxaa ka mid ah in sayntiisa ballaaran ee u eg gaashaanka ay u tahay hub uu isku difaaco. Marka uu godkiisa ku xaroodo waxa uu albaabka godka ku daboolaa seynta, waxa uuna sidaas uga nabadgalaa xayawaannada kale ee ay suurtagalka tahay inay ugaarsadaan.
items.fullContent: Wasaaradda Deegaanka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada ee Somaliland ayaa shaacisay in ciidanka boolisku ay gacanta ku dhigeen muwaadin u dhashay dalka Australia oo isku dayayay inuu dalka ka tahriibiyo nooc ka mid ah xamaaratada loo yaqaanno Caasha-badhi ama Daba-saqafle oo xeebaha laga helo. Agaasimaha Waaxda Duur-joogta ee Wasaaradda Deegaanka iyo Isbeddelka Cimilada Somaliland, Cabdinaasir Xuseen Saciid ayaa BBC u sheegay in xayawaankan uu ka mid yahay noocyada qarka u saaran inay dabar-go’aan. “Waxaa na soo wargeliyay shacabka deegaanka oo arkay nin ajaanib ah oo duurka ka guraya xamaarato. Ciidanka Booliska ayaa si degdeg ah u qabtay, waxaana lala qabtay darawalkii waday,” ayuu yiri Cabdinaasir. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in ninkan oo dalxiis ku yimid Somaliland uu duurka ku dhex uruursanayay xamaaratadan, kadib markii ay bulshada deegaanka ka shakiyeen. Eedeysanaha waxaan u gudbinnay Xeer Ilaalinta, Maxkamadduna waxay ku xukuntay 40 Milyan oo Shilinka Somaliland ah iyo inuu dalka kaga baxo 24 saac gudahood,” ayuu yiri. Darawalkii la socday ninkan ayaa isna xabsi ku jira, halka ay socdaan baaritaanno lagu beegsanayo dadkii dalka soo geliyay iyo shabakadda ka dambeysa tahriibinta duur-joogta. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in kiisas kale oo la xiriira tahriibinta duur-joogta loo qabtay dad kale, ayna qaadi doonto tallaabooyin adag si mustaqbalka looga hortago falalka noocan ah Xeerka Ilaalinta Duur-joogta ee Somaliland ayaa si cad u mamnuucaya in duur-joogta la dilo, la qabto ama laga ganacsado, waxaana ciqaab adag ay ka dhalanaysaa cid kasta oo ku xad-gudubta, ajaanib iyo muwaadinba. “Xeerka Ilaalinta Duur-joogtu wuxuu si cad u mamnuucayaa in la qabto, la dilo ama laga ganacsado duur-joogta dalka, cid kasta oo ku xad-gudubtana waxay wajihi doontaa ciqaab adag.” Ugu dambeyn, Cabdinaasir Xuseen Saciid ayaa baaq u diray shacabka Somaliland, isagoo ka codsaday in ay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan laamaha ammaanka si loo ilaaliyo kheyraadka dabiiciga ah ee dalka. Haddaba waxaa su’aal la iska waydiin karaa waxa uu yahay xayawaanka Caasha-badhi, maxaase lagu jeclaaday? Muxuu yahay Caasha-badhi? Xigashada Sawirka, Getty Images Waa xayawaan ka mid ah xamaaratada, gaar ahaan bahda mulacyada ee noocyada kala duwan leh. Xayawaannada ay isku haybta yihiin waxa uu uga duwan yahay qaabka ay u samaysan tahay sayntiisa, oo u eg sida gaashaanka loo adeegsado dagaalka. Waxaa markii ugu horraysay la arkay sanadkii 1935-kii, xilligaas oo uu askari ka tirsanaa ciidamadii gumaysiga Ingiriiska ka helay dhul saxare ah oo ka mid ah deegaannada kulul, sida lagu shaaciyay bogagga wax ka qora arrimaha xayawananada ee Backwater Reptiles iyo BION. Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya oo keliya ayaa laga helaa xayawaankan oo ka mid ah noocyada dhiigga qabow. Ma aha xayawaan wayn. Dhirirkiisu waa 10 cm oo ay ku jirto seyntiisa cajiibka ah. Maxaa loo xiisaynayaa? Xigashada Sawirka, Getty Images Suuqyada online-ka haddii aad eegto waxaad arkaysaa bogag badan oo lagu kala iibiyo Caasha-badhida. Halkii xabbo ee Caasha-badhi ah ayaa lagu iibiyaa qiyaastii $600, taasoo dabcan u muuqata inay tahay sababta ay dad badan u danaynayaan inay dhoofiyaan noolahan ay qaniga ku tahay Soomaaliya. Mid ka mid ah sababaha loo xiisaynayo ayaa noqon karta maaddaama uu xayawaankan yahay mid dhif ah oo aan meelo badan laga helin. items.title: Cilmi-baaris: Maxey aqoonyahanndu ka yiraahdeen arrintaan xilliga hurdada la isku arko?
items.description: Warbixin lagu daabacay mareegta Qaranka ee daawada Mareykanka iyo cilmi-baarayaal ka socda Jaamacadda Caafimaadka ee Tongji ee Shiinaha ayaa isbarbardhig ku sameeyay shahwo rag laga qaaday, waa kuwa sida lama filaanka ah u shahwo-baxa iyo minida rag caafimaadka qaba. Xaaladdan, oo loo yaqaan shahwa-baxa aan ku tala galka ahayn (involuntary ejaculation), waxaa lagu gartaa in ninku uu la kulmo dhibaato shahwo-bax, xitaa haddii isla fal-galka si dhaqso ah uu dhaco. Cilmi-baaristu waxay sheegtay in xaaladdani tahay sababta ugu weyn ee 72% ilma la’aanta ragga sababta mararka qaar. Ragga la kulma biyo-baxa aan ku tala galka ahayn, waxay dhibaato ku qabaan inay shahwo baxaan marka ay galmo samaynayaan ama xitaa marka dareenkoodu kacsanyahay iyaga oo hurda. Shahwada waxaa laga qaaday 91 nin oo la ildaran xaaladdan biyo-baxa hurdada ku yimaada, iyadoo la adeegsanayo qalab gaar ah oo ku shaqeeya gariir (PVS iyo EEJ). Gunaanadkii daraasadda ayaa muujisay in shahwada laga helo hab dhaqameed (intii uu hurdo ku biyo-baxayo) ay 30.6% u badan tahay inay dhaqso u dhaqaaqdo (motility), isla markaana ay 61.4% u badan tahay inay lahaato qaab-dhismeed isku mid ah marka loo eego hababka kale ee shahwada lagu helo. Daraasadaha waxay muujinayaan in ragga aan ka warqabin biyo-baxa xilliga hurdada ay leeyihiin shahwo tayo fiican leh. Maaddaama biyo-baxa xilliga hurdada uu yahay xaalad aan la saadaalin karin goorta ay dhici doonto, ragga waayo-aragnimadaas lahaa saddexdii bilood ee la soo dhaafay waxaa lagula taliyay in ay xirtaan habeenkii qalab marka ay hurdaan si ay u keydiyaan muunad shahwo ah cilmi-baarista awgeed. Daraasad kale oo lagu daabacay mareegta Machadka Qaranka ee Caafimaadka Taranka ee Ragga iyo Dumarka ee Maraykanka waxay qiimeysay awoodda ragga dhibaatada ku qaba dareenka inay ku bacramin karaan lammaanayaashooda iyagoo adeegsanaya shahwada laga helay intii ay huradayeen. Daraasaddu sidoo kale waxay sheegtay in inkastoo tayada shahwada laga helo biyo-baxa hurdada ay kala duwanaan karto ragga dhexdooda, haddana waa la adeegsan karaa si cilmi ah, si loogu xiro ugxanta dumarka, iyadoo la iska ilaalinayo hababka adag sida kuwa koronto ama qalliin lagu sameeyo oo shahwada lagu helo. Dr. Kamaraj wuxuu yiri:”Qof kasta laga bilaabo wiilasha 12 jirka ah ilaa ragga waayeelka ah wuu ku shahwa-bixi karaa intuu hurdo. Ilmala’aan ama shahwo yari laguma xiro mini-baxa xilliga hurdada la arko. Jirka bani’aadamku wuxuu soo saaraa shahwo cusub mar kasta oo qofku biyo-baxo. Hurdo ama adeegsiga gacanta midkoodna ma saameeyo awoodda taranka ee ninka.” Bbc somali

items.title: Abiy Ahmed oo kadib xil u dhaarintiisa mowqif cusub ka soo saaray damaciisa badda
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Ahmed ayaa mar kale ku celiyey in dalkiisu uu sii wadi doono dadaallada uu ku doonayo marin uu ku gaaro Badda Cas, xilli xiisadaha gobolka iyo dagaallada waqooyiga Itoobiya ay sare u sii qaadayaan walaaca laga qabo iska horimaad ballaaran. Abiy ayaa hadalkan jeediyey Isniintii, xilli loo dhaarinayey muddo xileed cusub oo shan sano ah, isagoo sheegay in Itoobiya ay marin-badeedkeeda ku raadin doonto hannaan ku dhisan wax-is-weydaarsi. “Annagoo ku saleyneyna mabda’a wax-siinta iyo wax-helidda, waxaan si adag uga shaqeyn doonnaa sidii Itoobiya ay u heli lahayd marin ay badda ku gaarto,” ayuu yiri Abiy. Itoobiya ayaa noqotay dal aan bad lahayn kaddib markii Eritrea ay madax-bannaanideeda qaadatay sanadkii 1993-kii, taasoo Addis Ababa ka goysay xeebaha Badda Cas iyo dekedda Assab. Tan iyo xilligaas, Itoobiya waxay inta badan ganacsigeeda caalamiga ah ugu tiirsan tahay dekedda Jabuuti, balse dowladda Abiy ayaa sanadihii dambe si isa soo taraysa u muujisay rabitaankeeda ah inay hesho marinno kale oo badeed. Murankaas ayaa si weyn u soo shaac-baxay bishii Janaayo 2024, markii Itoobiya ay heshiis is-afgarad ah la saxiixatay Somaliland, kaas oo Addis Ababa siin lahaa marin-badeed iyo suurta-galnimada saldhig ciidan-badeed. Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u diidday heshiiskaas, iyadoo ku tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanideeda iyo midnimada dhuleed. Xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Addis Ababa ayaa hase yeeshee markii dambe soo hagaagay. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa dhowaan sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan diiddaneyn in Itoobiya ay badda ka hesho marin ganacsi, balse arrintaas lagu gaari karo oo keliya heshiis rasmi ah oo ilaalinaya madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale Abiy ugu hambalyeeyey muddo xileedkiisa cusub, isagoo sheegay inuu rajeynayo in labada dal ay si dhow uga wada shaqeeyaan nabadda, xasilloonida iyo barwaaqada gobolka Geeska Afrika. Xiisadda Badda Cas Hadalka cusub ee Abiy ayaa yimid maalin kaddib markii hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaaliya, Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan ay ku kulmeen magaalada New Alamein ee dalka Masar, halkaas oo ay ka soo saareen bayaan wadajir ah oo taabanaya arrimaha Badda Cas iyo webiga Nile. Afarta dal ayaa adkeeyey muhiimadda xorriyadda isu-socodka maraakiibta, balse waxay isla markaas sheegeen in maamulka iyo arrimaha Badda Cas ay mas’uuliyaddeeda leeyihiin dalalka xeebaha ku yaalla. Bayaanka ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqay in la dhowro sharciga caalamiga ah ee nidaamiya webiyada isaga gudba dalalka, gaar ahaan Nile, iyadoo la diiday tallaabooyin hal dhinac ah oo wax u dhimaya isticmaalka biyaha ee Masar iyo Sudan. Mowqifkaas ayaa si toos ah ula xiriira laba muran oo waaweyn oo Itoobiya kala dhexeeya dalalka gobolka: dadaalkeeda ku aaddan helitaanka marin-badeed iyo khilaafka muddada dheer ka taagnaa biyo-xireenka weyn ee GERD. Itoobiya waxay sheegtay in helitaanka marin lagu gaaro badda uu muhiim u yahay dhaqaalaha iyo ammaanka mustaqbalka ee dalka ay ku nool yihiin in ka badan 120 milyan oo qof. Balse Eritrea, Masar, Sudan iyo Soomaaliya ayaa dhammaantood adkeeyey in arrimaha xeebaha, dekedaha iyo biyaha dhuleed lagu maamulo madax-bannaanida dalalka iyo sharciga caalamiga ah. Itoobiya iyo Eritrea Xiisadda ayaa si gaar ah u sii kordheysa xiriirka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, iyadoo Addis Ababa muddo dheer indhaha ku haysay dekedaha Eritrea, gaar ahaan Assab. Xiriirka labada dal ayaa mar kale si weyn u xumaaday toddobaadkii lasoo dhaafay, markii Eritrea ay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed u jartay Itoobiya, kaddib markii Addis Ababa ay xirtay safaaraddeeda Asmara, isla markaana ay dalka ka saartay toban diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah. Arrintan ayaa sii xoojisay walaaca laga qabo in muranka marin-badeedku isu beddelo xiisad amni oo cusub oo ka qaraxda Geeska Afrika. Xiisadda diblomaasiyadeed waxay sidoo kale kusoo beegmeysaa xilli dagaallo cusub ay ka socdaan waqooyiga Itoobiya. Ciidamada taageersan dowladda Itoobiya ayaa dib ula wareegay magaalada Mekelle, caasimadda gobolka Tigray, kaddib dagaallo cusub oo ay la galeen isbahaysi mucaarad ah oo ay hoggaamineyso TPLF. Dagaallada cusub ayaa soo celiyey cabsi laga qabo in colaadda gudaha Itoobiya ay ku faafto dalalka deriska ah, gaar ahaan iyadoo xiriirka Addis Ababa iyo Asmara uu mar kale gaaray heer aad u hooseeya. Midowga Afrika ayaa dhinacyada ugu baaqay inay muujiyaan is-xakameyn, isla markaana khilaafaadka jira lagu xalliyo wadahadal iyo hannaan nabadeed. Hase yeeshee, hadalka cusub ee Abiy wuxuu muujinayaa in helitaanka marin-badeed uu weli yahay mid ka mid ah mudnaanta ugu weyn ee dowladda Itoobiya, xilli dalalka xeebaha Badda Cas ay iyaguna sii adkeynayaan mowqifkooda ku aaddan ilaalinta madax-bannaanidooda. The post Abiy Ahmed oo kadib xil u dhaarintiisa mowqif cusub ka soo saaray damaciisa badda appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse oo Balanballe ka dhagax-dhigay Guriga Nabadda iyo Dugsiga Agoonta
items.description: Balanballe, Galgaduud: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa degmada Balanballe ee gobolka Galgaduud ka dhagax-dhigay Guriga Nabadda iyo Dugsiga Agoonta, kaddib heshiis nabadeed oo lagu soo afjaray colaado muddo dheer u dhexeysay laba beelood oo walaalo ah oo ku kala nool deegaannada Balanballe iyo Guriceel. Dhagax-dhigga ayaa yimid kaddib kulan lagu dhammaystiray heshiiska nabadeed ee labada beelood, kuwaas oo muddo dheer ay dirir sokeeye ku dhex mareysay deegaannada ku teedsan labada degmo, taas oo saamayn ku yeelatay nolosha bulshada iyo deegaanka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha waxaa munaasabadda ku wehliyey Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil Fartaag, Agaasimaha Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka ee NISA, Mahad Maxamed Salaad, iyo Madaxweynaha Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye. Guriga Nabadda ee laga dhagax-dhigay degmada Balanballe ayaa la qorsheeyay inuu noqdo xarun astaan u ah nabadda, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo wadajirka bulshada, iyadoo laga rajeynayo inuu door ka qaato xoojinta xiriirka labada beelood iyo ka hortagga colaado hor leh. Sidoo kale, Dugsiga Agoonta ayaa loogu talagalay carruurta waalidkood ku waayay colaadaha sokeeye, waxaana la sheegay inuu qaadi karo illaa 600 oo arday, si loo siiyo fursado waxbarasho oo ka caawiya inay helaan mustaqbal wanaagsan. Heshiiska lagu dhammaystiray nabadda labada beelood ayaa waxaa goobjoog ka ahaa 52 oday-dhaqameed oo kala matalayay dhinacyada, iyadoo Ugaas Xasan iyo Ugaas Maxamed ay saxiixeen heshiiska lagu xaqiijinayo soo afjaridda colaadda iyo xoojinta nabadda. Dhagax-dhigga xarumahan iyo heshiiska nabadeed ayaa muujinaya dadaallada lagu doonayo in lagu xoojiyo dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada, iyadoo muhiimad gaar ah la siinayo waxbarashada carruurta ay saameeyeen colaadaha iyo dhismaha mustaqbal nabdoon oo ay wadaagaan dadka ku nool Balanballe, Guriceel iyo deegaannada ku xeeran.

items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo howlgal qorsheysan ka Fuliyey Deegaanno ka tirsan Shabeellaha Dhexe iyo Hoose
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan Ururka 164-aad ee Guutada 16-aad ee Kumaandooska Danab, ayaa howlgal qorsheysan ka fuliyey deegaanno ku teedsan gobollada Shabeellaha Dhexe iyo Shabeellaha Hoose. Howlgalka oo lagu beegsanayay goobo ay ku sugnaayeen maleeshiyaad hubeysan ayaa lagu burburiyey jidgooyooyin iyo isbaarooyin ay kooxdu u adeegsan jirtay inay ku carqaladeyso isu-socodka shacabka iyo gaadiidka isaga kala goosha deegaannadaasi. Ciidanka Danab ayaa intii uu howlgalka socday ka saaray isbaarooyinkaas, kuwaas oo sida lagu sheegay warbixinta caqabad ku ahaa dhaqdhaqaaqa dadka iyo gaadiidka, gaar ahaan kuwa isaga kala goosha labada gobol. Howlgalkan ayaa qeyb ka ah howlgallada ciidamada dowladda ay ka wadaan deegaanno ka tirsan Shabeellaha Dhexe iyo Shabeellaha Hoose, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay sugidda amniga iyo fududeynta isu-socodka bulshada. Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka ayaa sidoo kale wada howlgallo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga waddooyinka iyo deegaannada muhiimka ah, iyadoo shacabka loogu baaqayo inay la shaqeeyaan ciidamada, isla markaana ay soo gudbiyaan xogaha la xiriira dhaqdhaqaaqyada kooxaha hubeysan.

items.title: Weerarada Ka Dhan ka ah Maraariibka Maraysa Marin-biyoodka Hormuz oo sii Kordhaya
items.description: Ciidanka Cirka ee Cumaan ayaa daadgureeyay 10 shaqaale ah oo ka tirsanaa markab shidaal oo ka babanayay calanka Panama, kaddib markii markabka On Peace lagu weeraray marinka muhiimka ah ee Hormuz. Wasaaradda Difaaca Cumaan ayaa sheegtay in markabka lagu weeraray meel qiyaastii 9 mayl-badeed, oo u dhiganta ku dhowaad 17 kiiloomitir, u jirta magaalada dekedda ah ee Limah, iyadoo weerarku sababay inuu dab ka kaco markabka. Shaqaalaha dhaawacmay ayaa loo qaaday Isbitaalka Khasab ee gobolka Musandam, halkaas oo lagu daweeyay. Ilaa hadda ma jirto koox si rasmi ah u sheegatay mas’uuliyadda weerarka, iyadoo dhacdadan ay kusoo beegantay xilli ammaanka marinka Hormuz uu sii xumaanayo, iyadoo gobolka uu ka socdo dagaalka u dhexeeya Mareykanka, Israel iyo Iiraan. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Hindiya ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 12 ka mid ah 19-kii shaqaale ee markabka saarnaa ay dhaawacmeen kadib markii wax lagu tilmaamay madfac ama gantaal uu ku dhacay markabka xilli uu marayay marinka Hormuz. Wasaaraddu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in 17 ka mid ah 19-ka shaqaale ay ahaayeen muwaadiniin Hindi ah, halka 11 ka mid ah dadka dhaawacmayna ay Hindi yihiin. Dowladda Hindiya ayaa muujisay walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan weerarrada sii kordhaya ee lagu qaadayo maraakiibta ganacsiga ee gobolka, waxayna ku baaqday in si degdeg ah loo joojiyo weerarrada noocan ah, iyadoo sheegtay in arrintani muhiim u tahay nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Hindiya ayaa kamid ah dalalka ugu badan ee shaqaale u dira maraakiibta ganacsiga ee caalamka, waxaana dowladda Hindiya ay sheegtay in ugu yaraan 10 badmaaxiin Hindi ah lagu dilay tan iyo markii uu dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Israel ee Iran billowday dhammaadkii Febraayo. Xaaladda marinka Hormuz ayaa sii murugtay tan iyo markii dagaalku billowday, iyadoo Iran ay si weyn u xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta biyaha maraya, isla markaana ay dhowr jeer weerartay maraakiib ganacsi oo aan marin waddooyinka ay tilmaantay. Adeegga xogta maraakiibta ee Marisks ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan toddobo dhacdo oo kale oo la xiriirta weerarro ama xaalado amni ay la kulmeen maraakiib shidaal toddobaadkii u dambeeyay. Inkasta oo weerarrada iyo khatarta amni ay sii kordhayaan, dhoofinta shidaalka ee Bariga Dhexe ayaa toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay gaartay heerarkii ka horreeyay dagaalka. Xog hordhac ah oo ay bixisay shirkadda Kpler ayaa muujisay in celceliska toddobada maalmood ee dhoofinta shidaalka ceyriinka ah ee Bariga Dhexe uu 30-kii Sebtembar gaaray 18.3 milyan oo foosto maalintii, marka loo eego celcelis ahaan ku dhowaad 18 milyan oo foosto maalintii 12-kii bilood ee ka horreeyay dagaalka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qiimaha shidaalka ayaa weli sarreeya, iyadoo qiimaha Brent crude uu Talaadadii gaaray 101.51 dollar foostadii , marka loo eego 72.48 dollar maalintii ka horreysay bilowgii dagaalka. Weerarkan cusub ayaa mar kale soo nooleynaya walaaca laga qabo amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo saameynta ay xaaladda marinka Hormuz ku yeelan karto isu-socodka shidaalka iyo suuqyada tamarta ee caalamka.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya oo khudbad ka jeediyey Shirweynaha 153-aad ee IPU
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa khudbad ka jeediyey Shirweynaha 153-aad ee Midowga Baarlamaanada Adduunka (IPU), oo si rasmi ah uga furmay magaalada Arusha ee dalka Tanzania, iyadoo shirku uu isu keenay madax iyo wakiillo ka kala socda baarlamaannada dalal badan oo caalamka ah. Guddoomiyaha ayaa khudbaddiisa ugu horreyn dowladda iyo shacabka Tanzania uga mahadceliyey martigelinta shirweynaha iyo soo dhoweynta diirran ee loo sameeyey wufuudda ka qeybgalaysa kulanka. Waxa uu sidoo kale ka hadlay himilada Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan dhismaha Baarlamaan madax-bannaan, hufan oo loo dhan yahay, shacabka u dhow, isla markaana door muuqda ka qaata dowlad-dhiska, horumarinta dimuqraadiyadda iyo xoojinta isla xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowladda. Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ku tallaabsanayso geeddi-socod dimuqraadiyadeed, isagoo tilmaamay in doorashooyin toos ah ay ka dhaceen magaalada Muqdisho iyo qaar ka mid ah dowlad-goboleedyada dalka, oo ay ka mid yihiin Koonfur Galbeed, Hirshabeelle iyo Galmudug, halka geeddi-socodka doorashooyinkuna uu meelo kale ka sii socdo. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda xoojinta hay’adaha qaranka, wada-hadalka siyaasadeed iyo ka-qaybgalka shacabka, isagoo sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay in Baarlamaanku noqdo hay’ad ilaalisa danaha shacabka Soomaaliyeed, xoojisa kalsoonida lagu qabo hay’adaha dowladda, isla markaana dowladda kula xisaabtanta gudashada waajibaadkeeda. Waxa uu sheegay in arrimahaasi ay muhiim u yihiin dhismaha Soomaaliya nabdoon, horumarsan oo barwaaqo ah, iyadoo baarlamaanka iyo hay’adaha kale ee dowladda laga doonayo inay sii xoojiyaan doorkooda ku aaddan dowlad-dhiska iyo horumarinta nidaamka dimuqraadiyadeed. Shirweynaha 153-aad ee Midowga Baarlamaanada Adduunka ayaa sanadkan diiradda lagu saarayaa horumarinta dowlad-wanaagga, xoojinta iskaashiga baarlamaannada iyo awood-siinta bulshooyinka, iyadoo la adeegsanayo ka-qaybgal loo dhan yahay, kalsooni iyo fursado loo siman yahay.

items.title: DF oo isha ku haysa xiisadda ka dareysa ee Itoobiya iyo Eritrea
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirkii hore ee amniga gudaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Xundubey Jimcaale oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Idaacadda Kulmiye ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ku aadan siyaasadda dibadda Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan xiisadda ka taagan gobolka. Xasan Xundubey oo si gaar ah uga hadlay khilaafka u dhexeeya Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in dowladda Soomaaliya ay si dhow ula socoto xaaladda labadaas dal, maadaama ay saameyn ku yeelan karto amniga iyo xasilloonida guud ahaan Geeska Afrika. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ugu baaqay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya in ay si gaar ah isha ugu hayso isbeddellada ka dhalanaya khilaafka labada dal oo haatan u muuqda mid kasii daraya. “Soomaaliya waxay isha ku haysaa khilaafka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, maadaama wixii ka dhaca labada dal ay si toos ah ama si dadban u saameyn karaan amniga iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika,” ayuu yiri Xasan Xundubey Jimcaale. Dhanka kale, wasiirkii hore ee amniga gudaha Soomaaliya oo hadalkiisa sii wata ayaa madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo dowladdiisa ku amaanay guulaha ay ka gaareen siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda, gaar ahaan la macaamilka dalalka dariska iyo kuwa caalamka. “Aniga waxaa dhihi karaa siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya guullo wayn ayay keentay hadda madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh wuxuu ku guuleystay inuu isku wado waxaas oo dalal ah,” ayuu sii raaciyay wasiirkii hore ee arrimaha amniga gudaha xukuumadda Soomaaliya. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo haatan meel xun uu gaaray khilaafka Addis Ababa iyo Asmara, iyadoo Itoobiya ay Khamiistii amartay in la xiro safaaraddeeda magaalada Asmara, dhaka kalena 10 diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah ku amartay inay dalka kaga baxaan 48 saacadood gudahood, tallaabasaas oo muujineysa heerka uu gaaray khilaafka kasii daraya ee labada dal.
