items.title: Berbera Port Positions Itself as the Horn of Africa’s Next Major Trade Hub
items.description: Berbera Port Positions Itself as the Horn of Africa’s Next Major Trade Hub Hargeisa — Somaliland’s government is intensifying its push to attract Gulf investment into the rapidly developing Berbera Port and the Berbera Corridor , as regional trade dynamics shift and international interest in alternative Red Sea shipping routes continues to grow. Officials in Hargeisa have been engaged in a series of diplomatic and economic outreach efforts targeting the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar, seeking to convert existing goodwill into concrete investment commitments that could transform Somaliland’s economic outlook over the coming decade. The renewed focus on Gulf partnerships comes at a moment when global attention to Red Sea trade security has never been higher. Disruptions caused by Houthi attacks on commercial shipping in the Red Sea have forced shipping companies and logistics operators to reassess their regional strategies, and Berbera — situated on the Gulf of Aden — has emerged in conversations among freight analysts as a potentially pivotal transhipment and logistics hub. Somaliland’s port authority has reportedly been in contact with several major international shipping firms exploring long-term berthing and warehousing arrangements. Infrastructure and Connectivity Drive Investment Case The economic case for Berbera rests heavily on infrastructure improvements that have been underway since DP World, the Dubai-based port operator, took over management of the facility under a 30-year concession agreement. Since then, the port has seen significant upgrades to its container terminal, expanded storage capacity, and improved deep-water berth facilities capable of handling larger modern vessels. Somaliland’s government argues that the port can serve not only its own import-export needs but also act as a gateway for landlocked Ethiopia — a country of over 120 million people desperately seeking reliable maritime access. The Ethiopia dimension remains one of the most strategically significant elements of Somaliland’s economic pitch to foreign investors. The broader framework of the Ethiopia-Somaliland port access MoU , signed in early 2024, signaled a potential realignment of regional trade flows that could bring enormous volumes of Ethiopian cargo through Berbera rather than through Djibouti. While the full implementation of that agreement has faced diplomatic headwinds, Somaliland officials continue to stress that the commercial logic of the Berbera Corridor — shorter distances, lower tariffs, and modern facilities — remains fundamentally sound and attractive to Ethiopian importers and exporters. Gulf Investors Weigh Opportunities Against Political Uncertainty Despite the optimism in Hargeisa, Gulf investors and their advisers remain cautious about committing large capital without greater clarity on Somaliland’s political and legal status. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991 and has maintained its own functioning government, currency, and security forces for over three decades, but its international recognition remains elusive. Without formal recognition, large-scale foreign direct investment must navigate complex legal and insurance frameworks that add cost and risk to potential deals. Sources familiar with ongoing Gulf-Somaliland discussions suggest that investors from the UAE in particular are looking for signals that Somaliland’s political environment will remain stable and that the port’s operating environment will continue to improve. They are also watching how the broader Horn of Africa diplomatic landscape evolves, including how relations between Somaliland and Mogadishu develop, and whether any third-party governments move toward formal or informal recognition arrangements that could reduce the legal ambiguity surrounding business dealings. Government Pledges Business-Friendly Reforms Somaliland’s finance and commerce ministries have been working on a package of business environment reforms aimed at making it easier for foreign companies to register, operate, and repatriate profits. Officials have indicated that simplified customs procedures, strengthened commercial courts, and expanded banking linkages with international financial institutions are all on the agenda. There is particular emphasis on ensuring that the Berbera Free Zone — an economic zone adjacent to the port — becomes operational and attractive at scale, with competitive tax rates and streamlined regulatory oversight. Regional economists have noted that Somaliland’s window of opportunity may be narrow. Djibouti, long the dominant port power in the subregion, is not standing still, and competition from ports in Kenya and the emerging Lamu corridor also intensifies year by year. For Berbera to claim its share of regional cargo and investment, Somaliland will need to move quickly on both the diplomatic and infrastructure fronts. The government appears to understand the urgency, and the pace of engagement with Gulf partners over recent months suggests that Hargeisa is treating this economic push as a strategic priority for the remainder of the current administration’s term. Whether Gulf capitals will ultimately convert interest into investment remains to be seen. But the momentum building around Berbera, combined with the shifting dynamics of Red Sea trade, has given Somaliland’s economic advocates more to work with than at any point in recent memory.     Berbera news

items.title: Trump Oo Ansixiyey Fulinta Xukunka Dilka ee Nidal Hasan
items.description: WASHINGTON (Goobjoog News) — Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa ansixiyey in dil toogasho ah lagu fuliyo Nidal Malik Hasan, oo ahaa dhakhtar dhimirka iyo sarkaal sare oo ka tirsanaa ciidamada Mareykanka, laguna helay dilkii 13 qof oo ka dhacay saldhigga Fort Hood ee Texas sannadkii 2009. Afhayeenka Pentagon-ka Sean Parnell ayaa sheegay in Wasiirka Difaaca Pete Hegseth uu soo jeediyey in xukunka ay fuliso koox toogasho oo ka tirsan ciidamada Mareykanka, Trump-na uu oggolaaday. Wasiirka Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa go’aamin doona goobta iyo waqtiga fulinta xukunka, kuwaas oo aan weli la shaacin. (reuters.com) Hasan ayaa 5-tii Nofeembar 2009 rasaas ka dhex furay xarun caafimaad oo ku taallay Fort Hood, halkaas oo askar loogu diyaarinayey in dibadda loo diro. Weerarka waxaa lagu dilay 12 askari oo shaqaynayey iyo hal askari oo hawlgab ahaa, halka 32 qof oo kale ay ku dhaawacmeen. Maxkamad militari ayaa 2013 ku heshay 13 kiis oo dil ula kac ah iyo 32 isku-day dil, waxayna ku xukuntay dil. Hasan oo maxkamadda iska difaacay ayaa qirtay inuu ahaa qofkii rasaasta furay, isagoo sheegay inuu doonayey inuu joojiyo askarta loo dirayey Afghanistan. (apnews.com) Muhiimadda ugu weyn ee go’aankan ayaa ah in haddii xukunka la fuliyo, uu noqonayo dilkii ugu horreeyey ee nidaamka caddaaladda militariga Mareykanku fuliyo tan iyo 1961. Waxa kale oo uu noqon karaa dilkii ugu horreeyey ee ciidamada Mareykanku ku fuliyaan koox toogasho tan iyo 1945, taas oo kiiska ka dhigaysa dhacdo taariikhi ah. (reuters.com) Ansixinta Madaxweynaha ayaa ahayd tallaabo sharciyeed muhiim ah, maadaama xukun dil ah oo ay riddo maxkamad militari aan la fulin karin ilaa Madaxweynuhu oggolaado. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Hasan wuxuu racfaan cusub u gudbin karaa maxkamadaha federaalka ee rayidka ah, taas oo fulinta xukunka dib u dhigi karta sannado. Go’aanka ayaa sidoo kale dib u soo celinaya doodda Mareykanka ee ku saabsan xukunka dilka iyo hababka lagu fuliyo. Taageerayaashu waxay ku tilmaamayaan caddaalad muddo dheer ay sugayeen qoysaska dhibbanayaasha, halka kooxaha ka soo horjeeda xukunka dilku ay dhaliilayaan adeegsiga kooxaha toogashada iyo ballaarinta awoodda dowladda ee dil-fulinta.

items.title: Wasiirka caafimaadka oo carooday xilli uu hortagay barlamaanka + Video
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada Soomaaliya Cali Xaaji Aadan oo maata hortagay Guddiga Adeegga Bulshada ee Baaralamaanka, si ay su’aallo u waydiiyaan ayaa ka carooday kulanka, kadib dood xasaasi ah oo meesha ka dhalatay. Doodda ayaa timid kadib markii wasiirka uu diiday in Telefishinka Universal uu si toos ah u tabiyo su’aalaha ay xildhibaannada guddigu weydiinayaan, isaga oo dalbaday in la joojiyo baahinta tooska ah ee kulanka. Cali Xaaji ayaa si cad u sheegay in uusan ka jawaabi doonin su’aalaha xildhibaannada, haddii Telefishinka Universal uu sii wado baahinta tooska ah ee kulanka, isaga oo guddoomiyaha guddiga ka codsaday in wariyeyaasha Tv-gaas laga saaro hoolka. “Guddoomiye TV-ga Universal hoolka waa inay ka baxaan, haddii kale aniga su’aalaha kama jawaabayo. TV-ga wuu diidan yahay inuu joojiyo Live-ka, sidaas darteed haddii uusan baxaynin, annaga ayaa baxayna,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Cali Xaaji Aadan. Hadalkan ayaa dhaliyay dood iyo is-fahamwaa ka dhex dhacay wasiirka iyo guddiga, iyadoo markii dambe ay soo faragelisay Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Adeegga Bulshada ee Baaralamaanka Soomaaliya. “Walaalayaalow joojiya Live-ka ee noo duuba canjaladda,” ayay ku jawaabtay Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Adeegga Bulshada oo soo faragelisay dagaalka wasiirka iyo Universal Tv. Dhinaca kale, Gudoomiye ku xigeenka Guddiga Warfaafinta Golaha Shacabka Xildhibaan Maxamed Xasan Murjaan oo ka hadlay dhacdadaan ayaa tilmaamay in tallaabada wasiirka ay dhaawaceyso xorriyadda saxaafadda iyo in shacabku ay helaan xogta rasmiga ah ee dowladda. “Warbaahinta madax bannaan ma aha hanti uu wasiir leeyahay oo uu amar ku xannibi karo xannibaadda Universal TV waa tallaabo dhaawacaysa xorriyadda saxaafadda iyo xaqa shacabka u leeyihiin helitaanka xogta iyo wararka dowladda Wasiirku ha caddeeyo sharciga uu ku dhaqmay xilku qofna kama sarreeyo sharciga,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Murjaan. Waxaa kale oo uu sii raaciyay “Xildhibaannadu waa wakiillada shacabka, warbaahintuna waa halka ay shacabka kala socdaan dowladda Anigoo ah Guddoomiye Kuxigeenka Guddiga Warfaafinta, waxaan arrintan wasiirka kula xisaabtami doonaa Golaha hortiisa Awood dowladeed looma adeegsan karo xannibaadda ama caburinta warbaahinta madax bannaan”. items.title: Madaxii amniyaadka Al-Shabaab iyo maskaxdii qaraxii Zoobe oo la dilay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka ee NISA ayaa sheegtay inay degmada Jilib ku dishay Bashiir Axmed Xaaji Nuunow, oo ay ku tilmaantay madaxii hore ee laanta sirdoonka iyo amniga ee Al-Shabaab, laguna eedeeyey inuu ku lug lahaa qaar ka mid ah weerarradii ugu khasaaraha badnaa ee ka dhacay Soomaaliya. NISA ayaa sheegtay in Bashiir lagu dilay howlgal qorsheysan oo habeenkii 1-da October 2026 ka dhacay degmada Jilib ee gobolka Jubbada Dhexe, iyadoo howlgalkaas ay hay’addu sheegtay inay kala kaashatay saaxiibbo caalami ah. Hay’addu ma aysan shaacin cidda ay ahaayeen saaxiibbadaas, sidoo kalena faahfaahin kama aysan bixin qaabka loo fuliyey howlgalka. NISA ayaa sheegtay in Bashiir Axmed Xaaji Nuunow uu madax ka ahaa qeybta Amniyaadka ee Al-Shabaab intii u dhexeysay 2016 iyo 2024, isla markaana uu adeegsan jiray magacyo dhowr ah oo ay ka mid yihiin Geescadde, Fanax, Gardhuub iyo Cali Dheere. Jilib ayaa muddo dheer loo arkaa mid ka mid ah xarumaha ugu muhiimsan ee Al-Shabaab, halkaas oo kooxda ay ku leedahay hoggaan, maamul iyo kaabayaal ciidan. Doorkii Amniyaadka Amniyaadka ayaa ah mid ka mid ah laamaha ugu awoodda badan uguna qarsoon Al-Shabaab, waxayna qaabilsan yihiin sirdoonka, dabagalka, dilalka qorsheysan iyo hawlgallada qarsoon ee kooxda. Hase yeeshee, magaca ay NISA u adeegsatay ninka ay sheegtay in la dilay ayaa ka duwan magaca hore loogu diiwaangeliyey mas’uulka Al-Shabaab ee loo yaqaan Geescadde. Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa sanadkii 2022 magaca Yusuf Ahmed Hajji Nurow , oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Gees Cadde , ku sheegtay madaxii Amniyaadka Al-Shabaab, iyadoo ku eedeysay inuu door weyn ku lahaa qorsheynta weerarro ismiidaamin iyo dilal. Liis cunaqabateyn ah oo dowladda Soomaaliya ay soo saartay sanadkii 2024 ayaa sidoo kale magaca Yuusuf Axmed Xaaji Nuunow , oo loo yaqaan Geescadde iyo Bishaar , ku sheegay madaxii Amniyaadka. items.title: Kadib halis soo korortay, DF iyo Puntland oo qaaday tallaabooyin degdeg ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Kenya ayaa maanta xaqiijisay kiiskii ugu horreeyay ee cudurka Ebola ee laga helay dalkaas, iyadoo Wasiirka Caafimaadka Kenya, Aadan Barre Ducaale uu sheegay in bukaankii laga helay cudurka uu u geeriyooday. Xaqiijinta kiiskan ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo faafitaanka cudurka ee gobolka, xilli Ebola uu si weyn uga jiro Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo, halka sidoo kale laga helay dalalka deriska la ah sida Uganda iyo Rwanda. Iyadoo laga duulayo xaaladda cusub ee ka soo korortay Kenya, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay si dhow uga feejigan tahay faafitaanka cudurka Ebola, iyadoo xustay inay qaaday tallaabooyin muhiim ah oo looga hortagayo khatarta uu cudurku ku yeelan karo dalka. Cudurka Ebola waxaa sababa fayruska loo yaqaan Ebolavirus, kaas oo qof ilaa qof ugu gudbi kara taabashada dhiigga ama dheecaannada jirka qof qaba cudurka, gaar ahaan marka qofka ay ka muuqdaan calaamadaha cudurka. Qofka uu cudurku ku dhaco waxaa calaamadaha looga arki karaa muddo u dhexeysa 2 ilaa 21 maalmood, waxaana kamid noqon kara qandho daran, murqo-xanuun, daal xad-dhaaf ah, lalabo, shuban iyo calool-xanuun. Calaamadaha kale ee lagu arki karo qofka qaba cudurka waxaa kamid ah cunaha oo xanuuna, indhaha oo casaada ama gaduuta, dhiig-bax gudaha ah, finan kasoo baxa maqaarka iyo xubnaha jirka qaarkood oo shaqada joojiya. Dhanka Puntland, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Dowladda Puntland ayaa sheegtay inay xoojisay u-diyaargarowga cudurka Ebola, kaddib markii Kenya ay xaqiijisay kiiska ugu horreeyay ee cudurkaas, iyadoo sidoo kale sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto xaaladda caafimaad ee gobolka. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Puntland ayaa caddeysay in ilaa hadda aan Puntland laga xaqiijin wax kiis ah oo Ebola ah, balse ay si gaar ah ula socoto xaaladda cudurka ee ka jirta dalalka deriska ah iyo guud ahaan gobolka, gaar ahaan kiiska laga xaqiijiyey Kenya. Wasaaraddu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay inay xoojisay tallaabooyinka u-diyaargarowga, ogaanshaha hore iyo jawaabaha degdegga ah ee la xiriira ka hortagga cudurka Ebola, iyadoo tallaabooyinkaas lagu xoojinayo awoodda looga hortagi karo faafitaanka cudurka. Puntland ayaa shacabka ugu baaqday in qof kasta oo leh qandho, daal daran, madax-xanuun, murqo-xanuun, matag, shuban ama dhiig-bax aan caadi ahayn, gaar ahaan qof safar ku tagay dal uu cudurku ka jiro, uu si degdeg ah ula xiriiro xarunta caafimaad ee ugu dhow. “Wasaaraddu waxay si joogto ah ula shaqaynaysaa hay’adaha dowladaha ee ku shaqada leh maaraynta khataraha iyo bah-wadaagta caafimaadka, si loo xoojiyo awoodda Puntland ee ka hortagga, ogaanshaha iyo ka jawaabidda cudurrada faafa iyo xaaladaha degdegga ah ee caafimaadka, oo uu ka mid yahay Ebola,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Puntland. Si kastaba, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka heer federaal iyo maamulka Puntland ayaa ku booriyay bulshada inay ka feejignaadaan calaamadaha cudurka, isla markaana ay raacaan tilmaamaha caafimaad ee la xiriira ka hortagga iyo xakameynta Ebola, iyadoo la xoojinayo diyaar-garowga caafimaad ee Soomaaliya. items.title: Ethiopia and Neighbours Trade Warnings as Regional Trust Collapses
items.description: Nile Dispute, Red Sea Access and Security Rivalries Bring Egypt, Sudan, Eritrea and Somalia Closer Together Addis Ababa (WDN) — Ethiopia is facing a widening diplomatic challenge as Egypt, Sudan, Eritrea and Somalia increasingly coordinate their positions on issues touching some of Addis Ababa’s most sensitive interests — the Nile, Red Sea access and regional security. A summit of the four countries in El Alamein, Egypt, called for strict adherence to international law governing transboundary rivers, including prior notification, consultation and the obligation to avoid significant harm. The countries also rejected unilateral measures affecting existing downstream uses of Nile waters. Addis Ababa responded by defending its right to pursue its national interests and rejecting any attempt to limit its sovereignty. The exchange highlights a deeper problem than the wording of a single declaration. Trust between Ethiopia and several of its neighbours is deteriorating — and water, maritime access and security are increasingly becoming part of the same regional confrontation. The Nile Remains the Core Dispute At the centre is the long-running dispute over the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD). Egypt and Sudan want guarantees that Ethiopia’s management of the dam will not threaten downstream water security. Ethiopia, meanwhile, maintains that it has a sovereign right to develop its water resources and argues that the Nile should be managed through equitable use and cooperation. The disagreement has persisted for years despite repeated negotiations. The latest four-country declaration gives Egypt’s position a broader regional platform and reinforces the perception in Addis Ababa that neighbouring states are attempting to constrain Ethiopia’s strategic and economic ambitions. The Red Sea Adds a New Fault Line The dispute is no longer confined to the Nile. Ethiopia, one of the world’s most populous landlocked countries, has repeatedly stressed the strategic importance of securing reliable access to the Red Sea. Addis Ababa argues that its geography and economic interests give it a legitimate stake in Red Sea affairs, while coastal states insist that decisions concerning the sea must respect the sovereignty of countries that control its shores. That disagreement has become particularly sensitive because Ethiopia’s relationship with Eritrea has sharply deteriorated. Eritrea severed diplomatic ties with Ethiopia earlier this month amid escalating accusations between the two governments. Ethiopia has accused Eritrea of supporting armed groups opposed to Abiy Ahmed’s government; Asmara has rejected the allegations. Against that background, Ethiopia’s demand for maritime access is viewed in Asmara through a far more security-sensitive lens. Four Neighbours, One Concern Egypt, Sudan, Eritrea and Somalia do not share identical interests. But they increasingly share concerns about Ethiopia’s growing regional ambitions. For Egypt, the central issue is Nile water security. For Sudan, the Nile is intertwined with both water and border disputes. For Eritrea, Ethiopia’s Red Sea ambitions have direct implications for national security. For Somalia, the relationship is more complicated: Mogadishu has strengthened ties with Egypt while maintaining its own difficult security and political relationship with Ethiopia. Their alignment should therefore not be interpreted as a formal anti-Ethiopian bloc. But it does demonstrate that Ethiopia’s neighbours are becoming more willing to coordinate when they believe their strategic interests are at stake. A Cycle of Strategic Distrust The danger is that each dispute now reinforces the others. Ethiopia sees efforts to constrain its use of the Nile or exclude it from Red Sea arrangements as attempts to contain its influence. Egypt and Sudan view unilateral Ethiopian action on the Nile as a potential threat to downstream security. Eritrea views Ethiopia’s maritime ambitions through the prism of their deteriorating bilateral relationship. Somalia’s closer partnership with Egypt adds another layer to an already complicated regional balance. Water, ports, borders and security partnerships are increasingly connected. That makes compromise more difficult because a disagreement in one area can quickly affect another. The Bigger Risk The immediate danger is not necessarily a single confrontation. It is the gradual collapse of the trust required to prevent several disputes from becoming one larger regional crisis. Ethiopia says it prefers dialogue, cooperation and mutual respect while defending its sovereignty and national interests. Its neighbours are making similar appeals to international law and diplomacy. But the language coming from both sides reveals how narrow the space for trust has become. The Nile is no longer simply a water dispute. The Red Sea is no longer simply a question of maritime access. Together, they are becoming part of a larger struggle over sovereignty, security and influence in the Horn of Africa. The challenge now is whether diplomacy can rebuild enough trust to keep those disputes separate — before they begin reinforcing one another. Addis Ababa responded by defending its right to pursue its national interests and rejecting any attempt to limit its sovereignty. The exchange highlights a deeper problem than the wording of a single declaration. Trust between Ethiopia and several of its neighbours is deteriorating — and water, maritime access and security are increasingly becoming part of the same regional confrontation. The Nile Remains the Core Dispute At the centre is the long-running dispute over the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD). Egypt and Sudan want guarantees that Ethiopia’s management of the dam will not threaten downstream water security. Ethiopia, meanwhile, maintains that it has a sovereign right to develop its water resources and argues that the Nile should be managed through equitable use and cooperation. The disagreement has persisted for years despite repeated negotiations. The latest four-country declaration gives Egypt’s position a broader regional platform and reinforces the perception in Addis Ababa that neighbouring states are attempting to constrain Ethiopia’s strategic and economic ambitions. The Red Sea Adds a New Fault Line The dispute is no longer confined to the Nile. Ethiopia, one of the world’s most populous landlocked countries, has repeatedly stressed the strategic importance of securing reliable access to the Red Sea. Addis Ababa argues that its geography and economic interests give it a legitimate stake in Red Sea affairs, while coastal states insist that decisions concerning the sea must respect the sovereignty of countries that control its shores. That disagreement has become particularly sensitive because Ethiopia’s relationship with Eritrea has sharply deteriorated. Eritrea severed diplomatic ties with Ethiopia earlier this month amid escalating accusations between the two governments. Ethiopia has accused Eritrea of supporting armed groups opposed to Abiy Ahmed’s government; Asmara has rejected the allegations. Against that background, Ethiopia’s demand for maritime access is viewed in Asmara through a far more security-sensitive lens. Four Neighbours, One Concern Egypt, Sudan, Eritrea and Somalia do not share identical interests. But they increasingly share concerns about Ethiopia’s growing regional ambitions. For Egypt, the central issue is Nile water security. For Sudan, the Nile is intertwined with both water and border disputes. For Eritrea, Ethiopia’s Red Sea ambitions have direct implications for national security. For Somalia, the relationship is more complicated: Mogadishu has strengthened ties with Egypt while maintaining its own difficult security and political relationship with Ethiopia. Their alignment should therefore not be interpreted as a formal anti-Ethiopian bloc. But it does demonstrate that Ethiopia’s neighbours are becoming more willing to coordinate when they believe their strategic interests are at stake. A Cycle of Strategic Distrust The danger is that each dispute now reinforces the others. Ethiopia sees efforts to constrain its use of the Nile or exclude it from Red Sea arrangements as attempts to contain its influence. Egypt and Sudan view unilateral Ethiopian action on the Nile as a potential threat to downstream security. Eritrea views Ethiopia’s maritime ambitions through the prism of their deteriorating bilateral relationship. Somalia’s closer partnership with Egypt adds another layer to an already complicated regional balance. Water, ports, borders and security partnerships are increasingly connected. That makes compromise more difficult because a disagreement in one area can quickly affect another. The Bigger Risk The immediate danger is not necessarily a single confrontation. It is the gradual collapse of the trust required to prevent several disputes from becoming one larger regional crisis. Ethiopia says it prefers dialogue, cooperation and mutual respect while defending its sovereignty and national interests. Its neighbours are making similar appeals to international law and diplomacy. But the language coming from both sides reveals how narrow the space for trust has become. The Nile is no longer simply a water dispute. The Red Sea is no longer simply a question of maritime access. Together, they are becoming part of a larger struggle over sovereignty, security and influence in the Horn of Africa. The challenge now is whether diplomacy can rebuild enough trust to keep those disputes separate — before they begin reinforcing one another. items.title: Soomaaliya oo sheegtay inay buuxisay shuruudihii lagu maalgashan lahaa
items.description: Muqdisho, 6 Oktoobar 2026 — Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay diyaar u tahay inay soo dhaweyso maalgashiga caalamiga ah, iyadoo xoogga saaraysa khayraadka dabiiciga ah, goobta istaraatiijiga ah iyo fursadaha dhaqaale ee dalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay xiritaanka Madasha Ganacsiga Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Yurub (EU-Somalia Business Forum 2026) oo muddo laba maalmood ah ka socotay Muqdisho, waxaana ka qeyb galay bah-wadaagta horumarinta, hay’adaha maaliyadeed iyo ganacsatada Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Yurub. Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay dooneyso inay si furan ula shaqeyso cid kasta oo danaynaysa maalgashiga dalka, balse ay muhiim tahay in maalgashigu la jaanqaado amniga, midnimada iyo danaha qaranka. “Soomaaliya waxa ay diyaar u tahay in ay dhahdo cid walba oo doonaysa in ay dalkaan ka faa’ideysato, nala saaxiibto, nala qaadato amniga iyo midnimada dalkeenna, gacmo furan kusoo dhawaada.” Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Xukuumadda DanQaran ay xoogga saartay amniga, dib-u-habeynta hay’adaha dowladda iyo abuurista nidaam dhaqaale oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. Waxa uu tilmaamay in Soomaaliya ay leedahay fursado maalgashi oo ballaaran, gaar ahaan kheyraadka badda, macdanta, xoolaha iyo dhulka beeraha, kuwaas oo uu sheegay in qayb weyn oo ka mid ah aan weli si buuxda looga faa’iideysan. Dhanka kale, Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa Midowga Yurub uga mahadceliyay taageerada iyo xiriirka ay la leeyihiin Soomaaliya, isaga oo ku boorriyay maalgashadayaasha Yurub inay ka faa’iideystaan fursadaha ganacsi iyo maalgashi ee ka jira dalka. Madasha Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Yurub ayaa lagu soo bandhigay fursadaha maalgashi ee Soomaaliya iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga ganacsi iyo dhaqaale ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Yurub.

items.title: NISA oo sheegtay in Jilib lagu dilay horjooge Sare
items.description: Muqdisho, 6 Oktoobar 2026 — Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA) ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadeeda, oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamka, ay howlgal qorsheysan ka fuliyeen degmada Jilib, kaas oo lagu dilay Bashiir Axmed Xaaji Nuunow. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka NISA, howlgalka ayaa dhacay habeenkii 1-da Oktoobar 2026, waxaana Bashiir lagu tilmaamay horjoogihii hore ee kooxda Amniyaadka ee Al-Shabaab, xilkaas oo uu hayay intii u dhexeysay 2016 iyo 2024. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in Bashiir uu sidoo kale adeegsan jiray magacyada Geescadde, Fanax, Gardhuub iyo Cali Dheere. NISA ayaa ku eedeysay Bashiir inuu muddo dheer ka mid ahaa hoggaanka sare ee Al-Shabaab, isla markaana uu door ku lahaa qorsheynta iyo fulinta weerarro ka dhacay Muqdisho iyo meelo kale oo dalka ah. Waxaa ka mid ahaa weerarkii 14-kii Oktoobar 2017 ee Isgoyska Soobe, weerarkii Ex-Control Afgooye iyo weerarro kale oo lagu qaaday goobo ku yaalla xeebta Liido. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in howlgalka uu qeyb ka yahay howlgallo joogto ah oo lagu baacsanayo xubnaha sare ee Al-Shabaab ee lagu eedeeyo inay ku lug leeyihiin qorsheynta iyo fulinta weerarrada. NISA ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in dilka Bashiir uu saameyn ku yeelan karo hoggaanka iyo shabakadaha kooxda, iyadoo ciidamadu ay sii wadaan howlgallada ka dhanka ah kooxaha hubeysan. Hay’addu waxay shacabka ugu baaqday inay la wadaagaan macluumaad kasta oo la xiriira khataraha amni iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish.

items.title: Daawo: Koonfur Galbeed oo heegan gelisay ciidamadeeda kuna dhawaaqday…
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa maanta ku dhawaaqday go’aan culus oo la xiriira xaaladda magaalada Baydhaba, si looga hortago dagaallada kusoo noqnoqday magaaladaas oo saameyn ku yeeshay dadka shacabka ah. Koonfur Galbeed ayaa shaaca ka qaaday inay heegan gelisay ciidamadeeda, iyadoo sheegtay inay ka hortagi doonaan duulaan kasta oo lagu soo qaado xarunta KMG ah ee maamulka. Madaxweyne Aadan Madoobe oo ka hadlayay dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ay wadaan ciidanka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sheegay inay ka hortagi doonaan wax kasta oo liddi ku ah amniga, isla markaana ay shacabka ka dul-qaadaan kooxaha Khawaarijta ee dhibta ku haya. “Dowladda Koofnur Galbeed waxay u taagan tahay difaaca Shacabkeeda oo fahmaya dhagarta Khawaarijta u diidan nabadda iyo deganaashaha deegaankooda, Khawaarijta dhibaateysa Shacabka qof aan ayaga ahayn uma ogola nolol,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Aadan Madoobe. Dhankiisa Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha Koonfur Galbeed Mudane Isaaq Maxamed Isaaq Mohamed (Korsaar) oo maanta booqday furimaha hore ayaa sheegay inay u diyaar garoobeen qaadista howlgallo culus, isla markaana ciidamada ay geeyeen bannaanka magaalada, si looga hortago dagaal mar kale ka dhacay gudaha magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu shacabka ugu baaqay inay joojiyaan barakaca, iyagoo ku kalsoonaanaya xaaladda amni ee magaalada, isaga oo xusay in magaalada ay nabad tahay, isla markaana aysan jirin wax sabab ah oo ku qasbaya inay guryahooda ka baxaan. “Hadda kadib, dagaal kama dhici doono gudaha magaalada. Cidanka ayaa ku jira bannaanka magaalada, waxaana shacabka ugu baaqeynaa inay joojiyaan barakaca oo ay ku nagaadaan guryahooda,” ayuu yiri wasiirka amniga ee Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Xaaladd Baydhaba ayaa hadda deggan, kadib dagaallo qaraar oo maalmo kahor ka dhacay magaaladaas, kuwaas oo ka dhashay weerarro ay kusoo qaadeen ciidanka Lafta-gareen. \ The post Daawo: Koonfur Galbeed oo heegan gelisay ciidamadeeda kuna dhawaaqday… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Amir Tataloo: Iran’s Tattooed Pop Star Faces Death as His Case Becomes a Symbol of Repression
items.description: From Underground Music Icon to Death Row: The Extraordinary Rise and Fall of One of Iran’s Most Controversial Artists Tehran (WDN) — Amir Tataloo once stood at the unlikely intersection of Iran’s conservative establishment and its rebellious youth culture. Now, the tattooed singer sits in prison facing the ultimate punishment after Iran’s Supreme Court upheld his death sentence for blasphemy. The case of Amirhossein Maghsoudloo, better known by his stage name Amir Tataloo, has become one of the most striking examples of how dramatically an Iranian artist’s relationship with the state can change. Once courted by conservative politicians seeking to connect with younger Iranians, Tataloo is now behind bars and facing execution. His transformation—from underground musician to politically controversial celebrity, from occasional establishment ally to condemned prisoner—mirrors the extraordinary political and cultural tensions that have shaped Iran over the past two decades. From Underground Music to National Fame Tataloo began his music career in the early 2000s, developing a distinctive mixture of rap, pop and R&B that resonated particularly strongly with young Iranians. His heavily tattooed appearance and unconventional style stood out in a country where artistic expression and personal appearance are subject to strict restrictions. Tataloo music initially existed largely outside Iran’s official cultural system. But his popularity eventually became impossible to ignore. In a striking example of the complicated relationship between the singer and Iran’s political establishment, Tataloo met then-presidential candidate Ebrahim Raisi in a televised encounter in 2017. He also released a song supporting Iran’s nuclear programme during the international negotiations over Tehran’s nuclear activities. The relationship between Tataloo and the establishment, however, did not last. The Relationship with the State Collapses Tataloo increasingly found himself on the wrong side of Iran’s cultural and political authorities. He moved to Turkey in 2018 after facing restrictions on his musical activities in Iran. His career abroad continued to attract a substantial following among Iranian youth. His music also became increasingly political, particularly after the death of Mahsa Amini in 2022 and the nationwide protests that followed. According to the Associated Press, Tataloo’s later work increasingly criticized Iran’s political system. His public image changed from that of an unconventional entertainer into something more politically charged. But his return to Iran would fundamentally change his life. Tataloo was living in Istanbul when Turkish authorities handed him over to Iran in December 2023. He was arrested upon his return and subsequently faced several criminal cases. One case resulted in a 10-year prison sentence over charges including promoting corruption and prostitution. He also faced accusations involving propaganda against the Islamic Republic, obscene material and other offenses. The most consequential case involved allegations of blasphemy. Tataloo was initially sentenced to five years in prison in that case. The Supreme Court later overturned the ruling following a prosecution appeal and sent the case back for retrial. The retrial produced a dramatically different outcome. A Tehran court sentenced him to death for insulting the Prophet, and the Supreme Court subsequently upheld the sentence. Iran’s judiciary spokesman, Asghar Jahangir, said in May 2025 that the ruling had been confirmed and was ready for enforcement. A Death Sentence That Drew International Alarm Human-rights organizations have strongly criticized the death sentence. Iran Human Rights said Tataloo was at serious risk of execution and argued that capital punishment for blasphemy violates international human-rights standards. The case has also attracted attention because Iran is among the countries that continue to impose capital punishment for religious offenses. That makes Tataloo’s case much larger than the fate of one celebrity. It raises a fundamental question about the limits of artistic and religious expression in Iran—and about how far the state is prepared to go when a once-popular public figure falls out of favor. Despite the Supreme Court’s confirmation of the death sentence, Tataloo’s legal team has continued to seek avenues for review. According to Iran Human Rights, his lawyer filed a request under Article 477 of Iran’s Criminal Procedure Code, a mechanism that can permit extraordinary judicial review of final verdicts. The organization reported in July 2025 that the request remained under consideration. It also said Tataloo had sought amnesty. That means the legal situation requires careful wording. Tataloo has been sentenced to death and the sentence was upheld, but available reporting does not establish that he has been executed. The Contradiction at the Heart of His Story Perhaps the most remarkable aspect of the Tataloo case is the contradiction in his political journey. The same artist who once appeared alongside a conservative presidential candidate and produced music supporting Iran’s nuclear programme eventually became a prisoner facing execution. His story demonstrates how quickly the boundaries between cultural popularity, political usefulness and political dissent can shift in Iran. At one point, Tataloo was viewed by some conservative politicians as a way of reaching young Iranians. Later, his music and public statements became associated with a very different political atmosphere—one in which young Iranians were openly challenging restrictions imposed by the Islamic Republic. His tattoos, music and unconventional personality had always made him a symbol of rebellion. His imprisonment has transformed that symbolism. More Than the Fate of a Singer Tataloo’s case has become a test of Iran’s treatment of controversial artists and public figures. His supporters see a popular musician facing the harshest possible punishment after falling out with the authorities. Iranian authorities, meanwhile, have prosecuted him under several criminal provisions and have treated the blasphemy allegations as a serious religious offense. Those competing narratives have made his case particularly sensitive. But regardless of one’s view of Tataloo’s music, personality or past conduct, the death sentence places the case in a much larger debate over capital punishment, freedom of expression and the boundaries of religious law. A Career That Came Full Circle Tataloo once built his reputation by refusing to fit comfortably into Iran’s cultural rules. That refusal helped make him famous. It also eventually placed him in conflict with the state. Now, behind prison walls and facing a death sentence, the singer who once commanded enormous attention among Iran’s youth has become the subject of international concern. His fate remains tied to decisions by Iran’s judiciary and authorities considering his legal and clemency requests. The extraordinary journey of Amir Tataloo—from underground music sensation, to establishment curiosity, to political outsider, and finally to a prisoner facing execution—has turned one man’s case into a window onto the shifting boundaries of culture, religion and political dissent in modern Iran. For Tataloo, the question is no longer whether his music can survive Iran’s restrictions. It is whether he will survive the Iranian justice system itself. It raises a fundamental question about the limits of artistic and religious expression in Iran—and about how far the state is prepared to go when a once-popular public figure falls out of favor. Despite the Supreme Court’s confirmation of the death sentence, Tataloo’s legal team has continued to seek avenues for review. According to Iran Human Rights, his lawyer filed a request under Article 477 of Iran’s Criminal Procedure Code, a mechanism that can permit extraordinary judicial review of final verdicts. The organization reported in July 2025 that the request remained under consideration. It also said Tataloo had sought amnesty. That means the legal situation requires careful wording. Tataloo has been sentenced to death and the sentence was upheld, but available reporting does not establish that he has been executed. The Contradiction at the Heart of His Story Perhaps the most remarkable aspect of the Tataloo case is the contradiction in his political journey. The same artist who once appeared alongside a conservative presidential candidate and produced music supporting Iran’s nuclear programme eventually became a prisoner facing execution. His story demonstrates how quickly the boundaries between cultural popularity, political usefulness and political dissent can shift in Iran. At one point, Tataloo was viewed by some conservative politicians as a way of reaching young Iranians. Later, his music and public statements became associated with a very different political atmosphere—one in which young Iranians were openly challenging restrictions imposed by the Islamic Republic. His tattoos, music and unconventional personality had always made him a symbol of rebellion. His imprisonment has transformed that symbolism. More Than the Fate of a Singer Tataloo’s case has become a test of Iran’s treatment of controversial artists and public figures. His supporters see a popular musician facing the harshest possible punishment after falling out with the authorities. Iranian authorities, meanwhile, have prosecuted him under several criminal provisions and have treated the blasphemy allegations as a serious religious offense. Those competing narratives have made his case particularly sensitive. But regardless of one’s view of Tataloo’s music, personality or past conduct, the death sentence places the case in a much larger debate over capital punishment, freedom of expression and the boundaries of religious law. A Career That Came Full Circle Tataloo once built his reputation by refusing to fit comfortably into Iran’s cultural rules. That refusal helped make him famous. It also eventually placed him in conflict with the state. Now, behind prison walls and facing a death sentence, the singer who once commanded enormous attention among Iran’s youth has become the subject of international concern. His fate remains tied to decisions by Iran’s judiciary and authorities considering his legal and clemency requests. The extraordinary journey of Amir Tataloo—from underground music sensation, to establishment curiosity, to political outsider, and finally to a prisoner facing execution—has turned one man’s case into a window onto the shifting boundaries of culture, religion and political dissent in modern Iran. For Tataloo, the question is no longer whether his music can survive Iran’s restrictions. It is whether he will survive the Iranian justice system itself. items.title: Kiiskii ugu horreeyay ee cudurka Ebola oo laga helay KENYA
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Kenya ayaa maanta xaqiijisay in dalkaasi laga helay kiiskii ugu horreeyay ee cudurka Ebola, iyadoo Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Kenya ay sheegtay in qofkii uu cudurka ku dhacay uu markii dambe u geeriyooday. Wasiirka Caafimaadka Kenya Aden Barre Ducaale ayaa sheegay in qofka laga helay cudurka uu ahaa muwaadin Kenyaan ah oo muddo ku noolaa Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo, halkaas oo uu hadda ka jiro faafitaan weyn oo Ebola ah. Bukaanka ayaa Congo uga soo gudbay dhinaca Uganda, kadibna diyaarad uga soo duulay Kampala, kuna soo gaaray magaala Nairobi oo uu ugu dambeyn ku geeriyooday. Kiiskan cusub ee laga helay Kenya ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo faafitaanka Ebola ee Bariga Afrika, maadaama cudurka laga soo sheegay dalal dhowr ah oo gobolka ah. Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo ayaa kamid ah dalalka uu cudurka Ebola si weyn uga soo noqnoqday, iyadoo sidoo kale kiisaska cudurka laga diiwaangeliyay dalalka deriska la ah Congo, oo ay kamid yihiin Uganda iyo Rwanda. Xaaladdan ayaa keentay in dalalka gobolka ay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka caafimaad iyo kuwa looga hortagayo in cudurka uu si dheeraad ah ugu faafo bulshada. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto xaaladda cudurka Ebola, iyadoo xustay inay qaaday tallaabooyin muhiim ah oo looga hortagayo khatarta uu cudurkani ku keeni karo dalka. Wasaaradda ayaa sidoo kale muhiimad gaar ah siisay feejignaanta iyo diyaar-garowga hay’adaha caafimaadka, si looga hortago in cudurka uu gudaha Soomaaliya kusoo gaaro ama ku faafo haddii kiis laga helo. Ebola waxaa sababa fayruska loo yaqaan Ebolavirus, waxaana qof ilaa qof loogu gudbin karaa taabashada dhiigga ama dheecaannada jirka qof qaba cudurka, gaar ahaan marka qofka uu leeyahay calaamadaha cudurka. Calaamadaha Ebola ayaa qofka kasoo muuqan kara muddo u dhexeysa 2 ilaa 21 maalmood kadib marka uu fayrasku ku dhaco. Calaamadaha ugu waaweyn waxaa kamid ah qandho daran, murqo-xanuun, daal xad-dhaaf ah, lalabbo, shuban, calool-xanuun iyo cunaha oo xanuuna. Waxaa sidoo kale qofka lagu arki karaa indhaha oo casaada, finan maqaarka kasoo baxa iyo xaalado daran oo keeni kara dhiig-bax gudaha ah iyo in xubnaha muhiimka ah ee jirku ay shaqadooda gabaan. Khubarrada caafimaadka ayaa xusaya in qofka qaba Ebola uu u baahan yahay in si degdeg ah loo ogaado loona geeyo xarun caafimaad, si loo yareeyo halista dhimashada iyo faafitaanka cudurka. items.title: NISA Expands Security Operations Across Galgaduud
items.description: Somalia’s National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) has expanded its operational presence in Galgaduud region, part of the federal state of Galmudug, as the government steps up efforts to strengthen security and expand the capacity of national forces. The agency has increased the number of NISA commands operating across the region and is training newly recruited personnel as part of the expansion. Several training facilities in districts across Galgaduud are currently hosting recruits who are expected to be deployed to NISA stations upon completion of their training. NISA Director-General Mahad Mohamed Salad has inspected a number of the agency’s facilities in the region, meeting with intelligence and security officers to assess the condition of the forces and receive briefings on their operational requirements. The expansion comes as the Somali government continues efforts to strengthen the country’s security institutions and increase the capacity of national forces to assume responsibility for security operations across the country. Somalia is also preparing for a broader transition in which national security forces are expected to take on a greater role in maintaining security as the African Union-backed security mission reduces its direct involvement. The increased NISA presence in Galgaduud is expected to strengthen intelligence operations, improve security coordination and support ongoing efforts to counter militant threats in central Somalia. The move is part of the federal government’s broader strategy to build a capable national security architecture and reduce reliance on external forces as Somalia works toward assuming full responsibility for its national security. items.title: Somalia President Rules Out Al-Shabaab Return as War Continues
items.description: Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has ruled out the possibility of Al-Shabaab regaining control over the country, while acknowledging that the government’s military campaign against the militant group could continue for some time. Speaking in an interview with Al Jazeera, Hassan Sheikh said Somalia’s security situation has undergone significant changes in recent years, pointing to the government’s efforts to push Al-Shabaab away from areas surrounding the capital, Mogadishu. The president said Al-Shabaab once maintained a significant presence across large parts of Somalia and was capable of carrying out attacks in areas close to the presidential palace. He said the group is now operating hundreds of kilometres away from Mogadishu, describing the development as evidence of a major shift in the country’s security environment. “This war may continue for a little longer, but there is no possibility that Al-Shabaab can once again take control of the entire country,” Hassan Sheikh said. He credited Somali government forces and their partners with making progress in the campaign against Al-Shabaab, arguing that the group’s current capabilities are significantly different from those it possessed during earlier periods of the conflict. Hassan Sheikh also dismissed the prospect of Somalia returning to widespread civil war, clan-based violence or political disputes escalating into armed conflict. “It is impossible for Al-Shabaab to return, and it is also impossible for the country to return to civil war, clan conflict or political conflict,” he said. The president’s comments come as Somalia continues to face political tensions involving the Federal Government, some federal member states and opposition politicians. Opposition figures have expressed concern that prolonged political disputes could undermine the government’s campaign against Al-Shabaab and create opportunities for the group to rebuild its influence. They have also warned that continued political divisions could affect international confidence and potentially reduce external support for Somalia’s security efforts. The opposition has argued that political disagreements risk diverting attention and resources away from the fight against Al-Shabaab at a time when the government is seeking to consolidate security gains. Hassan Sheikh, however, maintained that Somalia has moved beyond the period when Al-Shabaab was able to exercise extensive territorial control. He insisted that the group no longer has a realistic pathway to retake control of the country as a whole. The president’s remarks reflect the government’s position that, despite continuing security challenges and political tensions, Al-Shabaab’s territorial reach and military capabilities have been substantially reduced compared with previous years. items.title: Soomaaliya oo tababar ku saabsan xasaanadda diblomaasiyadeed u qabatay hay’adaha amniga
items.description: Muqdisho, 6 Oktoobar 2026 – Xoghayaha Joogtada ah ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Xamsa Aadan Xaadoow, ayaa maanta Muqdisho ka daah-furay tababar ku saabsan mudnaanta iyo xasaanadda diblomaasiyadeed, kaas oo loo qabanayo hay’adaha amniga dalka. Tababarkan oo soconaya muddo saddex maalmood ah, waxaa bixinaya Machadka Diblomaasiyadda ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, waxaana ka qaybgalaya mas’uuliyiin ka kala socda CID, Ciidanka Taraafikada, Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, NISA, Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha, Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada iyo hay’ado kale oo amni. Ujeeddada tababarka ayaa ah in la xoojiyo fahamka hay’adaha amniga ee ku aaddan xuquuqda, mudnaanta iyo xasaanadaha diblomaasiyiinta, iyadoo si gaar ah looga hadlayo waajibaadka ku xusan Heshiiska Vienna ee Xiriirka Diblomaasiyadeed. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in tababarku sidoo kale muhiim u yahay fahamka waajibaadka Soomaaliya ka saaran ilaalinta diblomaasiyiinta Soomaaliyeed ee ka howlgala dalalka kale. Xoghayaha Joogtada ah ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, Xamsa Aadan Xaadoow, ayaa tilmaamay in dhowrista xasaanadaha iyo mudnaanta diblomaasiyadeed ay muujinayso mas’uuliyadda Soomaaliya ee bulshada caalamka, isla markaana ay door muhiim ah ka qaadanayso xoojinta xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Tababarkan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu horumarinayo aqoonta iyo xirfadaha hay’adaha dowladda ee la macaamilka arrimaha diblomaasiyadda iyo wakiillada dalalka shisheeye ee Soomaaliya.

items.title: IMF oo hoos u dhigtay saadaasha kobaca dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya ee 2026
items.description: Muqdisho, 6 Oktoobar 2026 – Hay’adda Lacagta Adduunka ee IMF ayaa hoos u dhigtay saadaasha kobaca dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya ee sannadka 2026, iyadoo hadda lagu qiyaasay 2.3%, halka dhaqaalaha dalka ay saameynayaan hoos u dhaca gargaarka dibadda, abaaraha iyo dhibaatooyinka cimilada iyo saameynta colaadda Bariga Dhexe. IMF ayaa sheegtay in Soomaaliya ay wajahdo caqabado is-biirsaday, oo ay ka mid yihiin jarista gargaarka caalamiga ah tan iyo 2025, abaaro soo noqnoqda, xaaladaha cimilada oo sii xumaanaya iyo saameynta dhaqaale ee colaadaha gobolka. Koox IMF ah oo uu hoggaaminayay Ran Bi ayaa wadahadallo la yeelatay mas’uuliyiinta Soomaaliya intii u dhaxaysay 21-kii Sebtembar iyo 1-dii Oktoobar, kuwaas oo qayb ka ahaa qiimeynta dhaqaale ee sannadlaha ah ee IMF. Hay’addu waxay saadaalisay in kobaca dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya uu 2.7% gaari karo 2027, halka muddada dhexe lagu wado inuu gaaro 4%, haddii la hirgeliyo dib-u-habeyn dhaqaale iyo maaliyadeed oo muhiim ah. Dhanka kale, sicir-bararka Soomaaliya ayaa la filayaa inuu gaaro 6.5% sannadka 2026, iyadoo IMF ay sababaha ugu waaweyn ku sheegtay abaarta daba dheeraatay iyo carqaladaha ku yimid ganacsiga caalamiga ah. IMF ayaa sidoo kale ka digtay in hoos-u-dhac dheeraad ah oo ku yimaada gargaarka, colaado cusub oo gobolka ka dhaca iyo xaalado cimilo oo ka sii daran ay halis ku yihiin dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya. Hay’addu waxay ku baaqday in la xoojiyo ururinta canshuuraha, kastamyada iyo dakhliga gudaha, iyadoo sidoo kale muhiimad siisay horumarinta maareynta maaliyadda dowladda, kobcinta ganacsiga iyo maalgelinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha. IMF ayaa tilmaamtay in xawaaladaha dibadda ay weli yihiin il muhiim ah oo qoysaska Soomaaliyeed ka caawisa dakhliga iyo helitaanka lacagaha qalaad, balse ay weli jiraan nuglaansho dhinaca dhaqaalaha dibadda ah. Sidoo kale, IMF waxay ku talisay in la sii wado maalgashiga waxbarashada iyo u adkaysiga isbeddelka cimilada, si loo abuuro saldhig dhaqaale oo waara. IMF ayaa ku adkaysatay in taageerada joogtada ah ee deeq-bixiyeyaasha ay muhiim u tahay Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan haddii khataraha hoos u dhigi kara kobaca dhaqaalaha ay sii xoogaystaan.

Dhanka kale, sicir-bararka Soomaaliya ayaa la filayaa inuu gaaro 6.5% sannadka 2026, iyadoo IMF ay sababaha ugu waaweyn ku sheegtay abaarta daba dheeraatay iyo carqaladaha ku yimid ganacsiga caalamiga ah. IMF ayaa sidoo kale ka digtay in hoos-u-dhac dheeraad ah oo ku yimaada gargaarka, colaado cusub oo gobolka ka dhaca iyo xaalado cimilo oo ka sii daran ay halis ku yihiin dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya. Hay’addu waxay ku baaqday in la xoojiyo ururinta canshuuraha, kastamyada iyo dakhliga gudaha, iyadoo sidoo kale muhiimad siisay horumarinta maareynta maaliyadda dowladda, kobcinta ganacsiga iyo maalgelinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha. IMF ayaa tilmaamtay in xawaaladaha dibadda ay weli yihiin il muhiim ah oo qoysaska Soomaaliyeed ka caawisa dakhliga iyo helitaanka lacagaha qalaad, balse ay weli jiraan nuglaansho dhinaca dhaqaalaha dibadda ah. Sidoo kale, IMF waxay ku talisay in la sii wado maalgashiga waxbarashada iyo u adkaysiga isbeddelka cimilada, si loo abuuro saldhig dhaqaale oo waara. IMF ayaa ku adkaysatay in taageerada joogtada ah ee deeq-bixiyeyaasha ay muhiim u tahay Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan haddii khataraha hoos u dhigi kara kobaca dhaqaalaha ay sii xoogaystaan.

items.title: Ebola: Taariikhda Cudurka, Dalalkii uu Gaaray iyo Tirada Dhimashada
items.description: Muqdisho, 6 Oktoobar 2026 – Cudurka Ebola ayaa mar kale soo noqday isagoo walaac caafimaad ka abuuraya qaar ka mid ah dalalka Afrika, gaar ahaan Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo (DRC), halkaas oo uu ka socdo dillaac cusub. Kenya ayaa sidoo kale 6-dii Oktoobar xaqiijisay kiiskii ugu horreeyay ee Ebola, kaddib markii qof Kenyan ah oo ka yimid DRC uu cudurka la yimid, markii dambena uu ku geeriyooday Nairobi. Ebola markii ugu horreysay waxaa la aqoonsaday sannadkii 1976, iyadoo laba dillaac ay isku mar ka dhaceen qaaradda Afrika. Mid wuxuu ka dhacay dalka maanta loo yaqaan Koonfurta Suudaan, halka kii labaad uu ka dhacay Zaire, oo maanta loo yaqaan Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo. Magaca Ebola waxaa laga soo qaatay Webiga Ebola ee ku yaalla DRC, oo u dhow goobtii cudurka markii ugu horreysay laga aqoonsaday. Tan iyo markii la ogaaday, Ebola wuxuu marar kala duwan ka dillaacay dalal ay ka mid yihiin DRC, Uganda, Sudan, Koonfurta Suudaan, Gabon, Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone iyo Jamhuuriyadda Congo. Kiisas cudurka ah oo dibadda looga soo qaaday ayaa sidoo kale laga diiwaangeliyey dalal ay ka mid yihiin Nigeria, Senegal, Mali iyo Koonfur Afrika. Dillaacii ugu weynaa ee Ebola ee taariikhda wuxuu ka dhacay Galbeedka Afrika intii u dhexeysay 2014 iyo 2016, gaar ahaan Guinea, Liberia iyo Sierra Leone. In ka badan 28,000 kiis ayaa la diiwaangeliyey, halka in ka badan 11,000 qof ay u dhinteen cudurka. Dillaacaasi wuxuu si weyn u saameeyay adeegyada caafimaadka, dhaqaalaha, waxbarashada iyo nolosha bulshada. Sannadka 2026, DRC ayaa mar kale noqotay xudunta dillaaca Ebola. Xogta la soo sheegay ilaa horraanta Oktoobar waxay muujinaysaa in dalkaas laga diiwaangeliyey kumannaan kiis iyo in ka badan afar kun oo dhimasho ah. Dillaacu wuxuu ku fiday deegaanno badan, iyadoo xaaladda ay sii adkeynayaan colaadaha, barakaca dadka iyo adeegyada caafimaad oo aan si fudud loo gaari karin. Uganda ayaa sidoo kale sannadkan la kulantay dillaac Ebola ah oo uu sababay nooca Bundibugyo. Dalkaas waxaa laga diiwaangeliyey kiisas iyo dhimasho, balse dowladda Uganda ayaa markii dambe ku dhawaaqday in dillaaca dalkaasi uu dhammaaday kadib markii aan muddo ku filan la helin gudbin cusub. Kenya ayaa 6-da Oktoobar 2026 noqotay dalka cusub ee xiriirka la leh dillaaca hadda ka socda gobolka. Qof Kenyan ah oo muddo ku noolaa DRC ayaa cudurka la yimid, waxaana markii dambe lagu xaqiijiyey Ebola kaddib markii uu Nairobi yimid. Bukaanka ayaa geeriyooday, iyadoo Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Kenya ay bilowday raadraaca dadka uu xiriirka la sameeyay. Ebola waa cudur fayras ah oo halis ah, waxaana badanaa lagu kala qaadaa xiriir toos ah oo lala yeesho dhiigga ama dheecaannada jirka qof qaba cudurka ama walxaha uu ku wasakhoobay. Calaamadaha waxaa ka mid noqon kara qandho, daal, madax-xanuun, murqo-xanuun, matag iyo shuban, iyadoo xaaladaha daran ay keeni karaan dhiig-bax iyo dhimasho. Cudurka Ebola saameyntiisa kuma koobna caafimaadka oo keliya. Dillaacyadu waxay carqaladeyn karaan ganacsiga, isu-socodka dadka, waxbarashada iyo shaqada isbitaallada. Shaqaalaha caafimaadka ayaa sidoo kale wajahaya khatar sare, halka qoysaska iyo bulshada ay la kulmi karaan cabsi, kala fogaansho iyo dhibaatooyin dhaqaale. Taariikhda Ebola waxay muujinaysaa in cudurku awood u leeyahay inuu si degdeg ah u saameeyo bulshooyinka marka ogaanshaha iyo xakamaynta cudurka ay dib u dhacaan. Sidaas darteed, baaritaanka hore, go’doominta dadka qaba cudurka, raadraaca dadka ay la xiriireen bukaannada iyo wacyigelinta bulshada ayaa muhiim u ah in laga hortago faafitaan ballaaran. Ilaa 6 Oktoobar 2026, Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo ayaa ah meesha ugu weyn ee uu ka socdo dillaaca Ebola, Uganda waxay soo afjartay dillaaceedii, halka Kenya ay xaqiijisay kiis cusub oo xiriir la leh DRC.

items.title: Xog: Khilaaf xooggan oo ka dhex aloosan Firdhiye iyo ku-xigeenkiisa
items.description: Laascaanood (Caasimada Online) – Khilaaf siyaasadeed ayaa markale soo shaac baxay gudaha maamulka Waqooyi Bari, iyadoo uu soo kala dhex galay Madaxweynaha maamulka, Cabdulqaadir Axmed Aw Cali (Firdhiye) iyo ku-xigeenkiisa, Cabdirashiid Yuusuf Jibriil (Abwaan). Labada mas’uul ayaa xilka wada haya muddo ku dhow sanad iyo laba bilood, hase yeeshee khilaafka u dhexeeya ayaa la sheegay inuu soo noq-noqday, iyadoo ay jiraan kala-aragti duwanaansho ku saabsan maamulka iyo sida loo wadaago awoodaha hay’adaha dowladda. Xogaha laga helayo gudaha maamulka ayaa tilmaamaya in muranka labada dhinac uu sidoo kale salka ku hayo arrimo la xiriira awoodaha dastuuriga ah, habka talo-wadaagga iyo xiriirka ka dhexeeya Madaxweynaha iyo ku-xigeenkiisa. Madaxweyne Firdhiye ayaa maalin ka hor dib ugu laabtay Laascaanood kadib safar dhowr bilood qaatay oo uu ku joogay magaalada Muqdisho, waxaana halkaasi loogu sameeyay soo dhoweyn ballaaran oo uusan ka qayb-gelin Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka maakulka. Kasoo muuqasho la’aanta Cabdirashiid Abwaan ee soo dhoweyntii Firdhiye ayaa sii xoojisay hadal-heynta ku saabsan khilaafka siyaasadeed ee labada mas’uul. Dhinaca kale, xubnaha baarlamaanka Waqooyi Bari ayaa la sheegay inay ku kala qeybsan yihiin labada dhinac, iyadoo qaar kamid ah xildhibaannadu ay taageersan yihiin Madaxweynaha, halka kuwo kalena ay garab taagan yihiin ku-xigeenka. Xaaladda ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeelatay shaqada baarlamaanka, iyadoo kalfadhiga golaha uu dhowr jeer dib u dhacay, waxaana la sheegay in xildhibaannada taageersan Firdhiye ay wadaan qorshe la xiriira qaadista xasaanadda Abwaan. Haddii khilaafkan uu sii xoogeysto wuxuu saameyn ku yeelan karaa wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha ugu sarreeya maamulka Waqooyi Bari, gaar ahaan xiriirka labada mas’uul iyo shaqada baarlamaanka. The post Xog: Khilaaf xooggan oo ka dhex aloosan Firdhiye iyo ku-xigeenkiisa appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sooyaal: Faadumo Qaasin Hilowle (Faynuustii Fanka)
items.description: Maanta oo kale, 6dii Oktoobar 2011kii, waxaa magaalada London ee dalka Ingiriiska ku geeriyootay Faadumo Qaasin Hilowle, oo ka mid ahayd haldoorkii fanka Soomaaliyeed sida gaarka ah raad aan sahal ku tirmayn ugu reebay fanka Banaadiriga. Faadumo, oo lagu naanaysi jiray “Faynuustii Fanka”, waxaa lagu xusuustaa codkeedii dahabiga ahaa, habkii bandhigeed ee toolmoonaa, hannaanwanaaggii ay masraxa dushiisa ku muujin jirtay iyo dhadhankii faneed ee ay hees kasta oo ay ku luuqayso ku larnaa. Waxay ahayd fannaanad hibadeedu qarsoomi wayday, sidaas awgeedna lagu sifeeyay “faynuus” uu “fankeennu” iftiinsado; maxaayeelay, codkeeda madoorsoonka ahi wuxuu tiirxoog u ahaa qayb weyn oo ka mid ah xusuuswadareedda bulshada Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan bulshada uu fanka Banaadirigu manka iyo magoolkaba u yahay. Fan Magaalo oo Jirdo Adag Leh Si kaalinta Faadumo loo majeersado, waxaa mudan in dhab ahaan la jaleeco fanka ay dhexdiisa ku ababtay oo ay ka soo dhex hilaacday. Fanka Banaadirigu waa fan leh saldhig dhaqameed iyo sooyaal magaalo, kana muuqda laxan, luuq, ciyaar, jilid, labbis iyo hab bandhigeed oo u gaar ah. Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax, oo buuggiisa Fan-masraxeedka Soomaalida (1987): Raadraac iyo Faaqidaad ku sameeyay geeddisocodka masraxa Soomaaliyeed, wuxuu hoosta ka xarriiqay kaladuwanaanta saldhigga dhaqameed ee fanka Banaadiriga iyo qaybo kale oo fan Soomaaliga ka mid ah. Buuggaas, oo 1987dii la daabacay, ayaa ka mid ah marjacyada waaweyn ee taariikhda fanmasraxeedka Soomaalida. Fankaas qaayaha leh waxaa soo gardaadiyay oo taabbageliyay jiilal rag iyo dumarba leh oo waxsoosaarkooda faneed ku sii ballaariyey aafaaqiisa. Qaar waxay ahaayeen curiyayaal, qaar laxamiistayaal, qaar hooballo, qaarna jilayaal; dhammaantoodna waxay qayb ka ahaayeen silsilad dhaxalsiin faneed oo facba fac u sii gudbinayay. Faadumo waxay ka mid ahayd mudankii dabkaas sii qamxiyay . Qoys Faneed Hibada Faadumo meel bannaan kama soo fufin. Waxay ku aroortaa oo meelkasoojeed ku leedahay qoys faneed si gun iyo baar ah ugu suntanaa sooyaalka fanka Koonfurta Soomaaliya. Aabbaheed, abwaan Qaasin Hilowle (1923–1984), oo lagu naanaysi jiray “Iskiifo”, wuxuu ka mid ahaa hormuudkii fanka Banaadiriga. Wuxuu yaraantiisii ka soo muuqday fagaarayaashii suugaanta, fankana wuxuu u arkayey cudud lagu baraarujiyo bulshada, laguna guubaabiyo halgankii gobannimadoonka. Wuxuu curin jiray riwaayado iyo heeso ay daljirnimo ku dheehan tahay, wuxuuna ku heesi jiray afafka Soomaaliga, Talyaaniga iyo Carabiga. Qaasin ayaa, sidoo kale, ka mid ahaa hormuudkii kooxfaneedyada Koonfurta Soomaaliya, isagoo ka hawlgali jiray Raadiyow Muqdisho.  Qaasin Hilowle fanku wuxuu fanku u ahaa muraayad bulsheed, farriindawiye iyo aalad baraarujineed. Xilligii gobannimadoonka, isaga iyo jaallayaashiisii waxay waxsoosaarkooda ugu adeegayeen dareenka qaran, midnimada iyo hiigsiga gobannimada. Hobollo uu Qaasin Hilowle ka mid ahaa ayaa xilligaas xarumihii SYL ka qaadi jiray heesaha guubaabada iyo qiiragelinta. Dhaxalkii Qaasin wuxuu noqday qori-isu-dhiib faneed. Faadumo Qaasin iyo walaasheed Muslimo Qaasin Hilowle labaduba waxay ka mid noqdeen bahda fanka Soomaaliyeed; carruurta Faadumana qaarkood ayaa iyaguna fanka sii waday. Sidaas ayay Faadumo dhexda kaga jirtay silsilad faneed facyaal isku xidha: aabbe hal-abuur iyo hoobal ahaa, gabdho fanka ku hanaqaaday iyo jiil kale oo dhaxalkii sii anbaqaaday. Lix Jir ilaa Masraxa Qaran Faadumo waxay heesidda bilowday iyadoo lix sano jirta, waxayna ka mid ahayd gabdhihii ugu horreeyey ee ka heesa Raadiyow Muqdisho. Barbilowgaas hore ayaa u gogoldhigay geeddisocod faneed dheer, kaas oo ay kaga mid noqotay codadkii haweenka ee hormuudka ka ahaa fanka Soomaaliyeed.  Waxay ku soo kortay jawi ay heesta, laxanka iyo hal-abuurku qayb ka ahaayeen nololmaalmeedka qoyskeeda. Taasi waxay siisay saldhig faneed ay hibadeedu ku hanaqaaddo, hannaankeeda masraxuna ku bislaado. Waxa iyana kobocaas kaalingal ku lahaa hal-abuurayaal iyo muusikiistayaal ay ka mid ahaayeen Axmed Naaji Sacad. Axmed Naaji wuxuu ka mid ahaa tiirarkii muusigga Soomaaliyeed: laxamiiste, muusikiiste, curiye iyo hoobal. Xilligii uu fankiisu bislaaday uu soosaaray fannaaniin rag iyo dumarba leh, Faadumo Qaasinna ay ka mid ahayd.  Iskaashigaas faneed wuxuu qayb ka ahaa jawi hal-abuur oo ay curiye, laxamiiste iyo hoobal islafalgal ku dhisayeen hees isu dheellitiran erey, luuq iyo laxan. Heesta  “Guwaas”,  oo Faadumo Qaasin iyo Axmed Naaji lagu xusuusto, ayaa tusaale u ah dhadhankaas faneed iyo sida dareenka jacaylka loogu waarido ereyo kookooban oo misana ashqaraar leh: “Goobtii aad joogtidaa Gacalkayga yaallee…” Inkasta oo Faadumo ay qaadi jirtay noocyo kaladuwan oo heesaha Soomaaliyeed ah, haddana magaca iyo codkeedu si gaar ah ayay ugu mataanoobeen fanka Banaadiriga. Heesaheedu waxay noqdeen kuwo aad ugu sidkan jaadkaas faneed, waxaana si weyn loogu xusuustaa heeso ay ka mid yihiin  “Aaway hee, inankii aan is arkoonaayeey”  iyo  “Ceelka soo jiidee.”  Habkaas bandhigeed waxaa ku kulmay cod, luuq, xarrago, dhaqdhaqaaq masraxeed iyo dareen dhowrid. Keliya ma ahayn hoobal cod macaan ee waxay lahayd karti ay dareenka dhegaystaha ku hanato, ereygana ugu rogto dareen taabanaya nudayaasha qof kasta. Sababtaas darteed buu codkeedu u noqday raad faneed oo jiilal badan isaga gudba. Sidaas awgeed, marka si dhow loo dhugto waxsoosaarka Faadumo, waxaa la muuqanaysa in uu koobsaday sooyaal, dhaqan, magaalow iyo xusuus ummadeed. Waa maragmadoonto in uu codkeedu kaydiyay qayb ka mid ah ilbaxnimadii hore ee Muqdisho iyo noloshii faneed ee jeerkaas. Ugu danbayn, maanta oo kale, 6dii Oktoobar 2011, ayay “faynuustii” ifka weynayd ee uu jeer “fanka Soomaaliyeed” iftiinsan jiray dentay!
items.fullContent: Maanta oo kale, 6dii Oktoobar 2011kii, waxaa magaalada London ee dalka Ingiriiska ku geeriyootay Faadumo Qaasin Hilowle, oo ka mid ahayd haldoorkii fanka Soomaaliyeed sida gaarka ah raad aan sahal ku tirmayn ugu reebay fanka Banaadiriga. Faadumo, oo lagu naanaysi jiray “Faynuustii Fanka”, waxaa lagu xusuustaa codkeedii dahabiga ahaa, habkii bandhigeed ee toolmoonaa, hannaanwanaaggii ay masraxa dushiisa ku muujin jirtay iyo dhadhankii faneed ee ay hees kasta oo ay ku luuqayso ku larnaa. Waxay ahayd fannaanad hibadeedu qarsoomi wayday, sidaas awgeedna lagu sifeeyay “faynuus” uu “fankeennu” iftiinsado; maxaayeelay, codkeeda madoorsoonka ahi wuxuu tiirxoog u ahaa qayb weyn oo ka mid ah xusuuswadareedda bulshada Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan bulshada uu fanka Banaadirigu manka iyo magoolkaba u yahay. Fan Magaalo oo Jirdo Adag Leh Si kaalinta Faadumo loo majeersado, waxaa mudan in dhab ahaan la jaleeco fanka ay dhexdiisa ku ababtay oo ay ka soo dhex hilaacday. Fanka Banaadirigu waa fan leh saldhig dhaqameed iyo sooyaal magaalo, kana muuqda laxan, luuq, ciyaar, jilid, labbis iyo hab bandhigeed oo u gaar ah. Dr. Maxamed Daahir Afrax, oo buuggiisa Fan-masraxeedka Soomaalida (1987): Raadraac iyo Faaqidaad ku sameeyay geeddisocodka masraxa Soomaaliyeed, wuxuu hoosta ka xarriiqay kaladuwanaanta saldhigga dhaqameed ee fanka Banaadiriga iyo qaybo kale oo fan Soomaaliga ka mid ah. Buuggaas, oo 1987dii la daabacay, ayaa ka mid ah marjacyada waaweyn ee taariikhda fanmasraxeedka Soomaalida. Fankaas qaayaha leh waxaa soo gardaadiyay oo taabbageliyay jiilal rag iyo dumarba leh oo waxsoosaarkooda faneed ku sii ballaariyey aafaaqiisa. Qaar waxay ahaayeen curiyayaal, qaar laxamiistayaal, qaar hooballo, qaarna jilayaal; dhammaantoodna waxay qayb ka ahaayeen silsilad dhaxalsiin faneed oo facba fac u sii gudbinayay. Faadumo waxay ka mid ahayd mudankii dabkaas sii qamxiyay . Qoys Faneed Hibada Faadumo meel bannaan kama soo fufin. Waxay ku aroortaa oo meelkasoojeed ku leedahay qoys faneed si gun iyo baar ah ugu suntanaa sooyaalka fanka Koonfurta Soomaaliya. Aabbaheed, abwaan Qaasin Hilowle (1923–1984), oo lagu naanaysi jiray “Iskiifo”, wuxuu ka mid ahaa hormuudkii fanka Banaadiriga. Wuxuu yaraantiisii ka soo muuqday fagaarayaashii suugaanta, fankana wuxuu u arkayey cudud lagu baraarujiyo bulshada, laguna guubaabiyo halgankii gobannimadoonka. Wuxuu curin jiray riwaayado iyo heeso ay daljirnimo ku dheehan tahay, wuxuuna ku heesi jiray afafka Soomaaliga, Talyaaniga iyo Carabiga. Qaasin ayaa, sidoo kale, ka mid ahaa hormuudkii kooxfaneedyada Koonfurta Soomaaliya, isagoo ka hawlgali jiray Raadiyow Muqdisho.  Qaasin Hilowle fanku wuxuu fanku u ahaa muraayad bulsheed, farriindawiye iyo aalad baraarujineed. Xilligii gobannimadoonka, isaga iyo jaallayaashiisii waxay waxsoosaarkooda ugu adeegayeen dareenka qaran, midnimada iyo hiigsiga gobannimada. Hobollo uu Qaasin Hilowle ka mid ahaa ayaa xilligaas xarumihii SYL ka qaadi jiray heesaha guubaabada iyo qiiragelinta. Dhaxalkii Qaasin wuxuu noqday qori-isu-dhiib faneed. Faadumo Qaasin iyo walaasheed Muslimo Qaasin Hilowle labaduba waxay ka mid noqdeen bahda fanka Soomaaliyeed; carruurta Faadumana qaarkood ayaa iyaguna fanka sii waday. Sidaas ayay Faadumo dhexda kaga jirtay silsilad faneed facyaal isku xidha: aabbe hal-abuur iyo hoobal ahaa, gabdho fanka ku hanaqaaday iyo jiil kale oo dhaxalkii sii anbaqaaday. Lix Jir ilaa Masraxa Qaran Faadumo waxay heesidda bilowday iyadoo lix sano jirta, waxayna ka mid ahayd gabdhihii ugu horreeyey ee ka heesa Raadiyow Muqdisho. Barbilowgaas hore ayaa u gogoldhigay geeddisocod faneed dheer, kaas oo ay kaga mid noqotay codadkii haweenka ee hormuudka ka ahaa fanka Soomaaliyeed.  Waxay ku soo kortay jawi ay heesta, laxanka iyo hal-abuurku qayb ka ahaayeen nololmaalmeedka qoyskeeda. Taasi waxay siisay saldhig faneed ay hibadeedu ku hanaqaaddo, hannaankeeda masraxuna ku bislaado. Waxa iyana kobocaas kaalingal ku lahaa hal-abuurayaal iyo muusikiistayaal ay ka mid ahaayeen Axmed Naaji Sacad. Axmed Naaji wuxuu ka mid ahaa tiirarkii muusigga Soomaaliyeed: laxamiiste, muusikiiste, curiye iyo hoobal. Xilligii uu fankiisu bislaaday uu soosaaray fannaaniin rag iyo dumarba leh, Faadumo Qaasinna ay ka mid ahayd.  Iskaashigaas faneed wuxuu qayb ka ahaa jawi hal-abuur oo ay curiye, laxamiiste iyo hoobal islafalgal ku dhisayeen hees isu dheellitiran erey, luuq iyo laxan. Heesta  “Guwaas”,  oo Faadumo Qaasin iyo Axmed Naaji lagu xusuusto, ayaa tusaale u ah dhadhankaas faneed iyo sida dareenka jacaylka loogu waarido ereyo kookooban oo misana ashqaraar leh: “Goobtii aad joogtidaa Gacalkayga yaallee…” Inkasta oo Faadumo ay qaadi jirtay noocyo kaladuwan oo heesaha Soomaaliyeed ah, haddana magaca iyo codkeedu si gaar ah ayay ugu mataanoobeen fanka Banaadiriga. Heesaheedu waxay noqdeen kuwo aad ugu sidkan jaadkaas faneed, waxaana si weyn loogu xusuustaa heeso ay ka mid yihiin  “Aaway hee, inankii aan is arkoonaayeey”  iyo  “Ceelka soo jiidee.”  Habkaas bandhigeed waxaa ku kulmay cod, luuq, xarrago, dhaqdhaqaaq masraxeed iyo dareen dhowrid. Keliya ma ahayn hoobal cod macaan ee waxay lahayd karti ay dareenka dhegaystaha ku hanato, ereygana ugu rogto dareen taabanaya nudayaasha qof kasta. Sababtaas darteed buu codkeedu u noqday raad faneed oo jiilal badan isaga gudba. Sidaas awgeed, marka si dhow loo dhugto waxsoosaarka Faadumo, waxaa la muuqanaysa in uu koobsaday sooyaal, dhaqan, magaalow iyo xusuus ummadeed. Waa maragmadoonto in uu codkeedu kaydiyay qayb ka mid ah ilbaxnimadii hore ee Muqdisho iyo noloshii faneed ee jeerkaas. items.title: Maxaa ka cusub xarunta dayax-gacmeedka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya?
items.description: Warsheekh (Caasimada Online) – Safiirka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan ayaa kormeer ku tagay xarunta laga diri doono dayax-gacmeedka ee degmada Warsheekh, gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, halkaas oo ay ka socdaan dhismayaal la xiriira mashruuca. Intii uu ku sugnaa goobta, Danjiraha Turkiga waxaa la socday saraakiil kale, waxaana uu indha-indheeyay qaybaha kala duwan ee xarunta oo uu dhismuhu ka socdo. Safiirka ayaa sidoo kale kulan la yeeshay hawl-wadeennada iyo maamulka gacanta ku haya mashruuca, isagoo ka xog-wareystay halka ay marayaan shaqooyinka dhismaha iyo qorshayaasha lagu dhammaystirayo xarunta. Mashruucan ayaa ka mid ah iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, iyadoo labada dowladood ay muddooyinkii dambe xoogga saarayaan dardargelinta dhismaha xarunta dayax-gacmeedka ee ku taalla gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Kormeerka ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdogan uu ka hadlay mashruuca xarunta dayax-gacmeedka, isagoo tilmaamay inay faa’iido u yeelan karto Turkiga, Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan qaaradda Afrika. Erdogan ayaa sidoo kale xusay muhiimadda uu mashruucu u leeyahay iskaashiga labada dal, xilli Ankara iyo Muqdisho ay ballaarinayaan mashaariicda iyo xiriirka dhinacyada kala duwan. Xarunta ayaa lagu wadaa in laga fuliyo hawlo la xiriira dayax-gacmeedyada, iyadoo goobta laga hirgelinayo ay ku taallo deegaanka Warsheekh ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Si kastaba, dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa wada dadaallo lagu dardargelinayo dhismaha xarunta, iyadoo mashruucu uu qayb ka yahay iskaashiga labada dhinac ee dhinacyada tiknoolajiyadda iyo hawada sare. items.title: Dhaqaalaha Somalia oo wajahaya caqabado is-biirsaday iyo IMF oo digniin soo saartay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya ayaa wajahaya caqabado is-biirsaday, iyadoo Hay’adda Lacagta Adduunka ee IMF ay saadaalisay in kobaca dhaqaalaha dalka uu sannadka 2026 ku ekaan doono 2.3%. Warbixinta IMF ayaa lagu sheegay in hoos u dhaca gargaarka dibadda tan iyo 2025, abaaraha soo noqnoqda, saameynta colaadda Bariga Dhexe iyo isbeddellada la xiriira doorashooyinka dalka ay ka mid yihiin arrimaha cadaadiska ku haya dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya. Sida ay hay’addu sheegtay, xaaladahan ayaa saameyn ku yeeshay dhaq-dhaqaaqa dhaqaale, waxayna sidoo kale sare u qaadeen cadaadiska sicir-bararka iyo cunto-yaraanta, iyadoo dhaqaalaha dowladda uu isna wajahayo culaysyo dheeraad ah. Marka la eego saadaasha sanadaha soo socda, IMF waxay filaysaa in kobaca dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya uu 2027 kor ugu soo laaban karo 2.7%, halka muddada dhexe uu gaari karo ilaa 4%, haddii la sii wado dadaallada dib-u-habeynta iyo xoojinta dhaqaalaha. Dhinaca sicir-bararka, hay’addu waxay saadaalisay inuu sannadkan gaari doono 6.5 boqolkiiba. Abaaraha daba dheeraaday iyo carqaladaha ku yimid ganacsiga caalamiga ah ayaa lagu sheegay inay ka mid yihiin waxyaabaha sare u qaadaya qiimaha badeecooyinka. Xitaa iyadoo ay jiraan cadaadisyadaas, xawaaladaha ay Soomaalida dibadda kasoo diraan ayaa weli ah il muhiim ah oo dhaqaale iyo lacag qalaad u ah qoysas badan. Si kastaba, IMF waxay ka digtay in dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya uu weli nugul yahay marka la eego xaaladaha dibadda. Miisaaniyadda dowladda ayaa iyaduna wajahaysa cadaadis, iyadoo IMF ay qiyaastay in khasaaraha miisaaniyadda Soomaaliya uu 2026 noqon doono 0.9% wax-soo-saarka gudaha. Hay’addu waxay saadaalisay in khasaarahaasi uu 2027 hoos ugu dhici karo 0.5%. Si loo yareeyo cadaadiska maaliyadeed, IMF waxay dowladda kula talisay inay sii xoojiso ururinta dakhliga gudaha, gaar ahaan canshuuraha iyo kastamyada, isla markaana ay xakameyso kharashaadka dowladda, iyadoo horumar laga sameynayo maamulka maaliyadda iyo deynta. IMF ayaa sidoo kale tilmaantay in Bangiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya uu horumar ka sameynayo kormeerka hay’adaha maaliyadeed iyo ballaarinta adeegyada maaliyadeed. Waxay dowladda ku boorrisay inay si taxaddar leh u sii waddo dib-u-habeynta lacagta dalka marka la buuxiyo shuruudaha lagama maarmaanka ah. Dhanka khataraha mustaqbalka, hay’addu waxay ka digtay in xaaladda dhaqaale ay kasii dari karto haddii ay dhacaan abaaro ama dhibaatooyin cimilo oo daran, colaado cusub oo gobolka ka qarxa ama hoos u dhac dheeraad ah oo ku yimaada gargaarka caalamiga ah. Qiimeyntan ayaa timid kaddib wadahadallo ay wafdi IMF ah oo uu hoggaaminayay Ran Bi la yeesheen mas’uuliyiinta Soomaaliya intii u dhexeysay 21-ka September iyo 1-da October 2026, kuwaas oo qayb ka ahaa qiimeynta sannadlaha ah ee hay’addu ku sameyso dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya. items.title: Puntland haddii ay ka go’ayso Soomaaliya yaa go’aanka leh?
items.description: Doodda ku saabsan mustaqbalka Puntland iyo xiriirka ay la leedahay Soomaaliya waa dood u baahan in si qotodheer loo galo, lagana fogaado in arrin masiiri ah lagu koobo hadalka xukuumad ama koox siyaasadeed oo xilligaas talada haysa. Waxaan qabaa in ugu yaraan saddex su’aalood oo waaweyn la is weydiiyo: 1. Haddii Puntland ay Soomaaliya inteeda kale ka go’ayso, yaa xaq u leh in ay go’aankaas gaarto? Puntland ma aha hanti ay leedahay xukuumad, madaxweyne, xisbi ama koox siyaasadeed. Puntland waxaa leh shacabka deggan dhulkeeda, waxaana taariikhdeeda aasaasiga ah lagu dhisay wadatashi iyo is’afgarad. Dastuurka Puntland  qodobkiisa 3aad faqradda 1aad iyo 2aad wuxuu si cad u sheegayaa in awoodda ay leeyihiin  shacabka, isla markaana aan qof ama koox gaar ahi awoodda dowladnimo si gaar ah ugu adeegsan karin. Waxa kale oo uu sheegayaa in Puntland ay qayb ka tahay Soomaaliya, ayna xil ka saaran tahay hirgelinta Soomaaliya federaal ah. Sidaas darteed, haddii maalin la keeno go’aan ah in Puntland ay Soomaaliya ka go’do, ma noqon karto arrin xukuumad markaas joogta ama koox siyaasadeed oo keliya ay go’aan sankarto. Waa arrin taabanaysa jiilal, dhul, dad, dhaqaale, amni iyo mustaqbal siyaasadeed, sidaas darteed waxay u baahan tahay wadatashi aad u ballaaran iyo oggolaanshaha shacabka. Dastuurka Puntland laftiisa wuxuu xusayaa in haddii mowqifka Puntland laga beddelayo qodobadaas, arrintu u baahan tahay in Golaha Wakiilladu 2/3 ku ansixiyo, dabadeedna afti loo qaado. Haddii xitaa baarlamaanku uu codkaas aqlibiyadda leh ku meel mariyo go’anku ma dhameeystirna ilaa afti dadweyne laga qaadayo sida Ku cad dastuurka puntland. 2. Puntland-ta Soomaaliya ka go’aysa waa Puntland-tee? Su’aashan waa in si dhab ah la isku weydiiyo. Puntland waxaa lagu dhisay shir iyo is’afgarad dhex maray gobollo iyo bulshooyin kala duwan.  Shan gobol iyo degmada Buuhoodle maanta 5tii gobol ee 1998kii Puntland wada dhistay si run ah oo xaqiiqo ah u ma wada jiraan oo isku dood ma aha? Waa su’aal kale iyaduna. Dastuurka Puntland wuxuu xusayaa in Puntland 1998 lagu aasaasay wadatashi iyo is’afgarad gobollo ku bahoobay dhismaha maamul, iyadoo himiladii aasaaskuna ahayd in ay qayb ka noqoto Soomaaliya federaal ah sida Ku cad dastuurka. Sidaas darteed, haddii maanta la yiraahdo “Puntland ayaa Soomaaliya ka go’aysa”, waa in marka hore la is weydiiyo: yaa matalaya Puntland oo dhan? Dadka ku nool dhammaan gobollada iyo degmooyinka Puntland ma isku aragti bay ka qabaan? Bulshooyinka kala duwan ee Puntland deggan ma isku raacsan yihiin? Sidaaan wada ognahay Soomaaliya maamulada ka jira oo dhan ilaa dowladda faderaalka ah maamulkeedu wuxuu Ku dhisan yahay awood-qaybsiga 4.5 ama qabaail dowladnimadda inta isku aamini waayay iskuna afgaran waayay reero u qeeybsaday. Xuduudaha la sheeganayo ma yihiin kuwo dhammaan dadka ay khusayso ay isku raacsan yihiin? Ololaha ah in Puntland laga jaro Soomaaliya  yaa xiiso gooniya u haya yaa calankaas lulaya, qabaailka Puntland wada deggan isku dareen maka yihiin doodda mise reer gooniya ayaa riixaya oo qaba dodda? Dhammaan su’aalahan lama dhaafi karo. Ma aha wax sax ah in go’aan taabanaya mustaqbalka dhammaan dadka Puntland lagu saleeyo aragtida hal koox, hal reer, ama xukuumad xilligeeda joogta. Haddii go’aan noocaas ahi dhab ahaan miiska yimaaddo, waa in dadka ay khusayso loo oggolaadaa in ay si xor ah oo muuqata uga tashadaan. 3. Puntland waxay tan iyo 1998 lahayd maamul, baarlamaan, xukuumad, ciidan, nidaam canshuureed iyo hay’ado u gaar ah. Warbixinnada cilmiga ah ee Puntland asaaskeeda laga qoray waxa lagu tilmaamaa in Punland ay ahayd maamul iskiis isu maamlayey (Semi-autonomous ) tan iyo 1998. Waa xilligii dowladda dhexe aanay jirin ama daciifka ahaydba. Sidaas darteed, haddii dhibaatadu tahay in Puntland aysan horumar ku filan gaarin, su’aashu ma noqon kartaa  oo keliya “Xamar ayaa hormarka inagga hortaagan waa suaal u baahan in dadka reer Puntland si dhabb ah isu weydiiyaan?
