Maxaa laga qabtay waddooyinka? Maxaa laga qabtay shaqo’abuurka iyo dhaqaalaha? Maxaa laga qabtay hay’adaha dowliga ah iyo islaxisaabtanka? Maxaa laga qabtay in awoodda dowladdu gaarto dhammaan bulshada? Maxaa laga qabtay khayraadka Puntland iyo sidii shacabka looga faa’iideyn lahaa? Ma la joogaa xiligii bulshadda Puntland ay si dhab ah isu weydiin lahaayeen waxa ay xukumadihii kala danbeeyay ee Puntland soo maray ay ka qabteen baahiyaha asaasiga ah ee nololeed ee muwaadinka si dhab ah u taabanaya noloshiisa? Inta aan xamar ku heeysano ee ah inay xamar doonayso inay nidaamkii faderaalka ahaa ay duminayso oo awodihii oo dhan ay rabto in Xamar lagu soo koobo taas oo ah xaqiiqo laga arkay rajiimyadii kala duwanaa ee faderaalka soo maray. Intaas oo dhami waxay ka jiraan Puntland. Garoowe waxay ay Xamar ku haysato oo dhan iyada ayaa magaalooyinkii kale ee Puntland ku haysa. Iyada ayaan doonayn inay kamadax banaanadaan dagmooyinka kale ee Puntland iyada ayaa doonaysa inay awoodda inta ay Xamar kasoo qaadato rabta in ay Fiillada Garoowe  ku haysato. Marka suaalo badan oo dhab ahaantii aytahay inaan si dhaba isku weeydiino ayaa inala gudboon in aynu wax iska weydiino. Waxa jira waxyaabo badan oo gudaha Puntland looga baahan yahay in dib loo eego. Haddii hay’adihii Puntland iyo xukuumadihii kala dambeeyay ay Ku fashilmeen  dhismaha hay’ado xooggan, oo kala madax banaan adeegyo bulsho oo ku filan, islaxisaabtan iyo horumar dhaqaale, markaas waa muhiim in mas’uuliyadda gudaha la aqoonsado, oo gudaha isla xisaabtan iyo kacdoon wax isweeydiin ahi ay ka bilaabmato ’ halkii dhammaan dhibaatooyinka loo aanayn lahaa xiriirka Federaalka. Sidoo kale, federaalka laftiisa waa in la dhaliilaa marka uu ku guuldarraysto shaqooyinkii loo igmaday oo ay ugu weynayd ilaalinta wadajirka iyo midnimada ummadda, qaybinta awoodda,, amniga iyo adeegyada si caddaalad ah. Dastuurka Federaalka Soomaaliya wuxuu dhigayaa in xiriirka Dowladda Federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyadu ku dhisnaadaan iskaashi, wadatashi, qaybsi kheyraad oo caddaalad ah iyo midnimo qaran. Qodobka 54-na wuxuu dhigayaa in awoodaha iyo khayraadka la isla garto lana wada xaajoodo. Markaa Puntland iyo Xamar labadaba waa in la la xisaabtamaa. Haddii Puntland ay leedahay cabashooyin siyaasadeed, dhaqaale ama dastuur, waa in la soo bandhigaa, lagana raadiyaa xal siyaasadeed oo cadaalad ah. Laakiin haddii jawaabtu noqoto “Soomaaliya waan ka go’aynaa”, waa in marka hore la caddeeyo waxa go’aankaas lagu gaadhayo iyo waxa uu shacabka Puntland u soo kordhinayo. Midnimada Soomaaliya Midnimadu ma aha in Puntland ay awooddeeda iyo xuquuqdeeda ka tanaasusho. Sidoo kale federaalnimadu ma aha in Xamar ay maamul-goboleedyada ugu taliso wax kasta. Waxa loo baahan yahay waa Soomaaliya federaal ah oo awoodaha la isku raacsan yahay, khayraadka si caddaalad ah loo qaybsado, dowlad-goboleedyadana ay leeyihiin awood dastuuri ah, halka Dowladda Federaalka ay ilaaliso danaha qaranka ee wadajirka ah. Sidaas darteed, haddii maanta la doonayo in himiladaas laga baxo, ma aha in hal xukuumad ama koox siyaasadeed ay tiraahdo “waan go’aynaa.” Waa in shacabka Puntland oo dhan ay helaan fursad ay ku ogaadaan waxa ay kala dooranayaan: Soomaaliya federaal ah oo dib loo saxo, mise waddo kale oo aan cawaaqibkeeda si buuxda loo hubin. Ugu dambayn, waxaan qabaa in Puntland ay xaq u leedahay in ay si adag u difaacato danaha dadkeeda, laakiin isla markaana ay tahay in ay si daacad ah u eegto waxa iyada gudaheeda ka qaldan. Su’aashu ma aha oo keliya “Maxay Soomaaliya inteeda kale Puntland u qaban weyday?” Su’aashu waa: “Maxay Puntland iyadu awood u lahayd in ay qabato, balse aan weli la qaban?” Haddii labada su’aalood si daacad ah looga jawaabo, markaas ayaa la heli karaa dood dhab ah oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka Puntland iyo Soomaaliya. items.title: Xasan Sheekh: Imaaraadka ayaa Somaliland kala shaqeynaya in ay go’do
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta ku eedeeyay inay taageereyso dadaallada Somaliland ay ugu jirto inay Soomaaliya ka go’do, isagoo sheegay in arrintani ay sabab weyn u tahay xumaanshaha xiriirkii dhowaa ee u dhexeeyay Muqdisho iyo Abu Dhabi. Wareysi uu siiyay Al Jazeera ayuu madaxweynuhu ku sheegay in Imaaraadku muddo dheer ahaa saaxiib muhiim u ah Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinaca amniga, balse uu markii dambe si isa soo taraysa ula saftay Somaliland halkii uu taageeri lahaa dowladda federaalka. “Waxay la safteen, ma ahan dowladda federaalka, balse gaar ahaan Somaliland,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. “Waxay yihiin qodobka ugu weyn ee Somaliland ku dhiirrigelinaya inay Soomaaliya ka go’do, mana garanayo sababta ay sidaas u sameynayaan.” Hadallada madaxweynaha ayaa imanaya bilo kadib markii dowladda Soomaaliya ay baabi’isay heshiisyadii ay la lahayd Imaaraadka, oo ay ku jireen iskaashi dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca ah iyo heshiisyo la xiriiray dekedaha Berbera, Boosaaso iyo Kismaayo. Si kastaba, xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee labada dal weli ma go’in. “Weli xiriir ayaan la leenahay Imaaraadka, mana aanan jarin,” ayuu Xasan Sheekh yiri. “Safaaraddeennu halkaas ayay joogtaa, safaaraddooduna halkan ayay joogtaa. Laakiin waxaan baabi’innay dhammaan heshiisyadii naga dhexeeyay, intooda badanna waxay ahaayeen kuwa amni iyo difaac.” Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa si rasmi ah marar badan u sheegay inuu taageersan yahay madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, mana uusan shaacin inuu taageerayo madaxbannaanida Somaliland. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in Muqdisho ay walaaceeda dhowr jeer u gudbisay Abu Dhabi ka hor inta aan heshiisyada la laalin. “Waan isku daynay. Caddeymaha waan hor dhignay, waanan kala hadalnay, laakiin nasiib-darro nama aysan dhageysan,” ayuu yiri. Xiriir amni oo xooggan Madaxweynaha ayaa burburka xiriirka ku tilmaamay “sheeko aad u murugo badan”, isagoo dib u xusuustay sannado ay Imaaraadku taageero weyn siinayeen Soomaaliya. “Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka Carabta wuxuu ahaa mid aad iyo aad u wanaagsan,” ayuu yiri. “Waxaan aad ugu dadaalay inaan hagaajiyo xiriirkaas intii aan xilka hayay muddadii koowaad.” Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay inuu muddadaas booqday Imaaraadka in ka badan toddoba jeer, isagoo Abu Dhabi ku ammaanay taageeradii ay siisay ciidamada Soomaaliya. Imaaraadka ayaa tababarka ciidamada Soomaaliya bilaabay sanadkii 2014, balse barnaamijkaas hakiyay kadib khilaafkii 2018, markaas oo ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya ay garoonka diyaaradaha Muqdisho ku qabteen lacag dhan 9.6 milyan oo dollar oo laga dejiyay diyaarad laga leeyahay Imaaraadka. Abu Dhabi waxay sheegtay in lacagtaas loogu talagalay mushaharka ciidamada Soomaaliya. Xiriirka labada dal ayaa markii dambe dib loo hagaajiyay, waxaana bishii Janaayo 2023 ay kala saxiixdeen heshiis cusub oo ku saabsan iskaashiga milatari, amniga iyo la-dagaallanka argagixisada. Baaxadda iskaashigaas ayaa mar kale muuqday bishii Febraayo 2024, markii askari Soomaali ah uu rasaas ku furay saraakiil Imaaraati ah oo ciidamada Soomaaliya ku tababarayay xerada Gordon ee Muqdisho. Afar askari oo Imaaraati ah iyo sarkaal u dhashay Bahrain ayaa ugu dambeyn ku dhintay weerarka, oo ay mas’uuliyaddiisa sheegatay Al-Shabaab. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa xilligaas Imaaraadka uga tacsiyeeyay dhimashada saraakiisha. “Waxay Soomaaliya ka taageereen dhinaca amniga muddo wanaagsan,” ayuu madaxweynuhu yiri. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu sheegay in khilaafka ku saabsan midnimada Soomaaliya uu ugu dambeyn ka culus noqday iskaashigaas. “Nasiib-darro, dhibaatada ugu weyn waxay la xiriirtaa dowladda,” ayuu yiri. “Ma aysan awoodin inay taageeraan in dowladda Soomaaliyeed dib u mideysanto, Soomaaliya-na ay u dhaqaaqdo sidii dal mideysan. Taasi waa dhibaatada naga dhexeysa.” Khilaafka Somaliland Imaaraadka ayaa sannadihii la soo dhaafay xiriir ganacsi iyo mid amni oo ballaaran la sameeyay Somaliland, oo ku dhawaaqday inay Soomaaliya ka go’day sanadkii 1991, balse aan helin aqoonsi caalami ah ilaa Israel ay aqoonsatay bishii December 2025. Shirkadda DP World ee laga leeyahay Dubai ayaa maamusha dekedda Berbera, iyadoo boqolaal milyan oo dollar ku maalgelisay ballaarinteeda. Baarlamaanka Somaliland ayaa sidoo kale sanadkii 2017 ansixiyay qorshe Imaaraadku saldhig milatari uga sameysan lahaa Berbera, inkastoo goobtaas markii dambe loo beddelay adeegsi rayid. items.fullContent: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta ku eedeeyay inay taageereyso dadaallada Somaliland ay ugu jirto inay Soomaaliya ka go’do, isagoo sheegay in arrintani ay sabab weyn u tahay xumaanshaha xiriirkii dhowaa ee u dhexeeyay Muqdisho iyo Abu Dhabi. Wareysi uu siiyay Al Jazeera ayuu madaxweynuhu ku sheegay in Imaaraadku muddo dheer ahaa saaxiib muhiim u ah Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinaca amniga, balse uu markii dambe si isa soo taraysa ula saftay Somaliland halkii uu taageeri lahaa dowladda federaalka. “Waxay la safteen, ma ahan dowladda federaalka, balse gaar ahaan Somaliland,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. “Waxay yihiin qodobka ugu weyn ee Somaliland ku dhiirrigelinaya inay Soomaaliya ka go’do, mana garanayo sababta ay sidaas u sameynayaan.” Hadallada madaxweynaha ayaa imanaya bilo kadib markii dowladda Soomaaliya ay baabi’isay heshiisyadii ay la lahayd Imaaraadka, oo ay ku jireen iskaashi dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca ah iyo heshiisyo la xiriiray dekedaha Berbera, Boosaaso iyo Kismaayo. Laakiin waxaan baabi’innay dhammaan heshiisyadii naga dhexeeyay, intooda badanna waxay ahaayeen kuwa amni iyo difaac.” Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa si rasmi ah marar badan u sheegay inuu taageersan yahay madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, mana uusan shaacin inuu taageerayo madaxbannaanida Somaliland. items.title: Wararkii ugu Dambeeyay ee Dagaalka Yemen iyo Dowladda oo sheegtay inay dib ula wareegtay dhul muhiim ah
items.description: Dagaalka Yemen ayaa galay marxalad cusub oo colaadeed, kaddib markii ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, oo taageero ka helaya Sacuudiga, ay bilaabeen howlgallo milatari oo ay ku doonayaan inay dib ugu qabsadaan dhul ballaaran oo ay gacanta ku hayaan Xuutiyiinta. Howlgalladan ayaa si gaar ah uga socda xeebaha Badda Cas, gobolka Taiz iyo nawaaxiga marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab, ayadoo Dowladda Yemen ay sheegtay in ciidamada iyo xoogagga taageersan ay qabsadeen magaalada Mocha, magaalada Dhubab iyo dhowr goobood oo muhiim ah oo ku dhow Bab al-Mandab. Ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay la wareegeen buuraha Al-Manzara, Al-Ashari iyo Dhiban ee deegaanka Haifan, koonfurta Taiz. Hawlgalkan cusub oo dowladda ay ugu magac dartay “Waaberiga Yemen” ayaa sida ay sheegtay ujeeddadiisu tahay in dib loo qabsado dhammaan dhulka ay Xuutiyiintu hayaan, oo ay ku jirto caasimadda Sanca oo kooxdaasi gacanta ku haysay tan iyo 2014. Ciidamada dowladda ayaa sheegay in horumarkooda militari uu helayo taageero xooggan oo dhinaca cirka ah oo ka imaanaysa Sacuudiga. Sida ay ilo ka tirsan dowladda Yemen u sheegeen Reuters, ciidamada ayaa Isniintii gaaray duleedka magaalada Mocha, xilli dagaalyahannada Xuutiyiintu ay dib ugu gurayeen dhanka dhulka buuraleyda ah. Wasaaradda Difaaca Yemen ayaa markii dambe sheegtay in Mocha ay gacanta dowladda gashay. Hase yeeshee, Xuutiyiintu waxay beeniyeen sheegashada dowladda, iyagoo sheegay inay wali haystaan goobihii ay horey uga qabsadeen ciidamada ka soo horjeeda, isla markaana wararka ku saabsan guulaha dowladda ay yihiin kuwo aan sax ahayn. Magaalada Mocha ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah labada dhinac, maadaama ay ku taallo xeebta Badda Cas isla markaana ay u dhowdahay Bab al-Mandab, oo ah marin-biyood muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo maraakiibta caalamka. Khabiir horey ula taliye uga ahaa Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegay in awoodda ciidamada dowladda ay u yeeshaan inay Mocha sii haystaan ay noqon doonto calaamad muhiim ah oo muujinaysa jihada uu dagaalku qaadan karo. Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale ku fiday waqooyiga xeebaha Badda Cas, gaar ahaan gobolka Hodeidah oo Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku hayaan tan iyo 2014. Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa sheegay in ciidamadiisa badda ay weerareen goobo uu ku sheegay bartilmaameedyo militari oo Xuutiyiintu leeyihiin, oo ay ku jiraan bakhaarro hub iyo goobo lagu keydiyo doonyo qaraxyo lagu soo raro iyo miinooyin badeed. Isbahaysigu wuxuu sheegay in howlgalladaasi ay ka hortageen weerar lagu qorsheynayay marinnada biyaha ee koonfurta Badda Cas, sidoo kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa iyaguna sheegay inay qaadayaan weerarro ka dhan ah ciidamada iyo goobaha ay u arkaan bartilmaameedyada cadowgooda. Warbaahinta xiriirka la leh kooxda ayaa sheegtay in Xuutiyiintu ay gantaallo iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku weerareen dhowr goobood oo ku yaalla gudaha Sacuudiga, oo ay ka mid yihiin Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Boqor Khaalid ee Riyadh, xarun Aramco oo ku taalla Rabigh, Garoonka Abha iyo saldhigga militariga Khamis Mushait. Sacuudiga kama uusan hadlin dhammaan sheegashooyinkaas, balse Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Sacuudiga ayaa xaqiijisay in laba garoon diyaaradeed oo ku yaalla koonfurta dalka, kuwaas oo kala ah Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Boqor Cabdullaah Bin Cabdulcasiis ee Jazan iyo Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Najran, lagu qaaday laba weerar fiidnimadii Isniinta. Kororka dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale sii xumeynaya xaaladda bani’aadantinimo ee Yemen, oo horeyba uga mid ahayd dhibaatooyinka ugu waaweyn ee dunida. Hay’adda Socdaalka Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in in ka badan 184,000 oo qof ay barakaceen tan iyo markii dagaalladu dib u billowdeen, halka Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka uu sheegay in ugu yaraan 959 qof lagu dilay dagaallada cusub, in ka badan 4,200 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. WHO waxay ka digtay in colaadda cusub ay nidaamka caafimaadka Yemen ku riixeyso xaalad aad u adag, iyadoo isbitaallada iyo adeegyada caafimaad ay durba la daalaa dhacayaan burburkii ka dhashay dagaalka muddada dheer socday. Dhanka dibadda, dagaalka Yemen wuxuu sidoo kale bilaabay inuu saameyn ku yeesho xiriirrada iyo iskaashiga amni ee gobolka, ayadoo Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay la sheegeen inay ku heshiiyeen inay si degdeg ah Sacuudiga ugu diraan ciidamo iyo awood militari, iyadoo tallaabadaasi lagu saleynayo Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makkah oo la saxiixay bishii Agoosto. Heshiiska ayaa dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado Sacuudiga, Pakistan ama Turkiga loo arki karo weerar lagu qaaday dhammaan saddexda dal. Mareykanka, oo ah xulafo muhiim ah oo Sacuudiga ah, ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo warramay inuu Riyadh siinayo taageero dhanka sirdoonka ah. Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka Marco Rubio ayaa sheegay in Sacuudiga iyo dowladda Yemen ay xaq u leeyihiin inay is-difaacaan, xilli ciidamada dowladda Yemen ay isku dayayaan inay dib u qabsadaan dhulalkii ay Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku dhigeen. dagaalka Yemen ayaa hadda u muuqda inuu galay marxalad aad uga xoog badan tii hore, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isku dayayaan inay helaan gacan-sarreyn militari. Magaalada Mocha, xeebaha Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab ayaa noqon kara meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee lagu kala ogaado jihada dagaalka, halka sii socoshada duqeymaha iyo weerarrada labada dhinac ay kordhin karaan khasaaraha bani’aadantinimo iyo walaaca laga qabo amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara Badda Cas.

Sacuudiga kama uusan hadlin dhammaan sheegashooyinkaas, balse Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Sacuudiga ayaa xaqiijisay in laba garoon diyaaradeed oo ku yaalla koonfurta dalka, kuwaas oo kala ah Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Boqor Cabdullaah Bin Cabdulcasiis ee Jazan iyo Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Najran, lagu qaaday laba weerar fiidnimadii Isniinta. Kororka dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale sii xumeynaya xaaladda bani’aadantinimo ee Yemen, oo horeyba uga mid ahayd dhibaatooyinka ugu waaweyn ee dunida. Hay’adda Socdaalka Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in in ka badan 184,000 oo qof ay barakaceen tan iyo markii dagaalladu dib u billowdeen, halka Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka uu sheegay in ugu yaraan 959 qof lagu dilay dagaallada cusub, in ka badan 4,200 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. WHO waxay ka digtay in colaadda cusub ay nidaamka caafimaadka Yemen ku riixeyso xaalad aad u adag, iyadoo isbitaallada iyo adeegyada caafimaad ay durba la daalaa dhacayaan burburkii ka dhashay dagaalka muddada dheer socday. Dhanka dibadda, dagaalka Yemen wuxuu sidoo kale bilaabay inuu saameyn ku yeesho xiriirrada iyo iskaashiga amni ee gobolka, ayadoo Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay la sheegeen inay ku heshiiyeen inay si degdeg ah Sacuudiga ugu diraan ciidamo iyo awood militari, iyadoo tallaabadaasi lagu saleynayo Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makkah oo la saxiixay bishii Agoosto. Heshiiska ayaa dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado Sacuudiga, Pakistan ama Turkiga loo arki karo weerar lagu qaaday dhammaan saddexda dal. Mareykanka, oo ah xulafo muhiim ah oo Sacuudiga ah, ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo warramay inuu Riyadh siinayo taageero dhanka sirdoonka ah. Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka Marco Rubio ayaa sheegay in Sacuudiga iyo dowladda Yemen ay xaq u leeyihiin inay is-difaacaan, xilli ciidamada dowladda Yemen ay isku dayayaan inay dib u qabsadaan dhulalkii ay Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku dhigeen. dagaalka Yemen ayaa hadda u muuqda inuu galay marxalad aad uga xoog badan tii hore, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isku dayayaan inay helaan gacan-sarreyn militari. Magaalada Mocha, xeebaha Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab ayaa noqon kara meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee lagu kala ogaado jihada dagaalka, halka sii socoshada duqeymaha iyo weerarrada labada dhinac ay kordhin karaan khasaaraha bani’aadantinimo iyo walaaca laga qabo amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara Badda Cas.

items.title: Kenya oo xaqiijisay Kiiskii ugu Horreeyay ee Ebola iyo 28 Qof oo lala xiriirinayo Cudurkaas oo la raadinayo
items.description: Dowladda Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay kiiskii ugu horreeyay ee cudurka Ebola, kaddib markii muwaadin Kenyan ah oo dhawaan ka soo safray Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo (DRC) uu ku geeriyooday isbitaal ku yaalla magaalada Nairobi. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Kenya, Aden Duale, ayaa sheegay in bukaanka uu Sabtidii soo gaaray Nairobi, iyadoo garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Jomo Kenyatta lagu sameeyay baaritaannadii caafimaad ee caadiga ahaa. Kadibna waxaa isbitaalka Nairobi geeyay qof qaraabo la ah iyo saaxiib. Bukaanka ayaa markii dambe lagu arkay astaamo ay ka mid yihiin qandho, qarqaryo, daal iyo tabar-darro daran, murqo xanuun, liqid xanuun leh, cune xanuun iyo dhiig-bax ka hooseeya maqaarka , gaar ahaan goob cirbad laga muday. Bukaanka ayaa la go’doomiyay, waxaana la siiyay daaweyn taageero ah, balse wuxuu geeriyooday qiyaastii 11:30 habeenimo Isniintii . Dowladda Kenya ayaa sheegtay in loo diyaarinayo aas ammaan ah oo sharaf leh, iyadoo la raacayo habraacyada caafimaadka dadweynaha ee loogu talagalay kiisaska Ebola. Dhanka kale, saraakiisha caafimaadka Kenya ayaa sheegay inay aqoonsadeen 28 qof oo xiriir la sameeyay bukaanka , kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan xubno qoyskiisa ah iyo shaqaale caafimaad. Dadkan ayaa hadda lagu sameynayaa dabagal iyo kormeer caafimaad si loo ogaado haddii ay jiraan kuwo cudurka qaaday iyo in laga hortago faafitaan dheeraad ah. Kiiskan ayaa xiriir la leh cudurka Ebola ee ka dillaacay DRC. Sida xogta ay soo xigatay Goobjoog News, xogtii Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) ee ku ekeyd 2-dii Oktoobar ayaa sheegtay in DRC laga diiwaangeliyay 8,442 kiis oo la xaqiijiyay iyo 4,080 dhimasho . Kenya ayaa horey u xoojisay baaritaanka caafimaad ee xuduudaha, awoodda shaybaarada iyo diyaar-garowga xarumaha caafimaadka, iyadoo laga cabsi qabay in cudurku uga gudbo dalalka deriska ah. Kiiska cusub ayaa sidoo kale muhiimad gaar ah u leh gobolka Bariga Afrika, maadaama Uganda ay horey u diiwaangelisay kiisaska Ebola ee uga yimid DRC. Sida warbixintu sheegtay, Uganda waxay diiwaangelisay 20 kiis oo la xaqiijiyay iyo laba dhimasho ka hor inta aan la soo gabagabeyn jawaab-celinteeda cudurka. Hay’adda WHO ayaa bishii May Ebola-da noocan ah ee ka dillaacay DRC iyo Uganda ku tilmaantay xaalad caafimaad oo degdeg ah oo walaac caalami ah , iyadoo xustay khatarta faafitaanka cudurka ee xuduudaha dalalka gobolka. Hadda, dowladda Kenya waxay mudnaanta siinaysaa raadraaca 28-ka qof ee xiriirka la yeeshay bukaanka, kormeerka caafimaadkooda iyo xoojinta tallaabooyinka looga hortagayo in Ebola uu ku faafo gudaha dalka.

items.title: Ragga biraha tuma oo ka cabanaya nolol xumo iyo faquuq ka saaray suuqyada Dhadhaab
items.description: (ERGO) – Suuq xumo iyo dhaqaale yari ayay wajahayaan farsamo yaqaanada soo saara agabyo ay ka mid yihiin qalabka beeraha, sida yaambada, faaska iyo kuwa lagu isticmaalo guryaha ee cunnada lagu kariyo. Xirfadlayaashan oo ku nool xeryaha qaxootiga Dhadhaab ayaa sheegay in dadkii macmiilka u ahaa ay uga wareegeen dhanka badeecadaha ay warashaduhu sameeyaan ee dibadda laga soo dhoofiyo. Dadka ayaa u batay iibsashada qalabka warshadaha oo lagu iibiyo suuqyada, halka kuwa ay farsameeyeen xirfadlayaasha uu yahay mid ku kooban goobaha fariisinka u ah. Dhanka kale waxaa jira xoogsato agabka dibadda laga keenay ku dhex wareejiya xeryaha. Waxaan meesha ka marneyn in dadku ay xiiso u qabaan, kal soonina ku qabaan qalabka warshadaha oo ay aaminsan yihiin inuu tayo iyo quruxba ka fiican yahay midka kale, qiimahana aysan ku kala duwaneyn. Arimahaas oo is biirsaday waxay suuqa ka saareen 200 oo qof, sida uu Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay Yoonis Abukar oo ah guddoomiyaha dadka birta tuma ee xeryaha Qaxootiga. Saameynta ugu weyn ee ka dhalatay ayaa ah dhaqaale yari saameysay nolosha boqollaal qoys oo danyar ah. Kamaal Maxamed Xuseen oo xirfadan ay u ahayd isha kaliya ee dhaqaale uu ka soo galayay muddo 10 sano ah ayaa xusay in goobtiisu xirantay bishii Maarso ee sanadkan, markii uu waayay cid wax ka gadata. Shaqo la’aanta ayuu sheegay in qoyskiisa oo markii hore ku jiray nolol warwar la’aan ah ay bidday inay ku adkaato helitaanka hal waqti oo cunto ah. “Shalay iyo maanta isku mid maaha, sababta oo ah shaqadii fiicneyd haddey istaagtay gaajo waa qasab way imaaneysaa. Waxaa meesha ka baxaya raashiinkii saddexda waqti ahaa ee quraacda, qadada, cashada iyo caanihii ilmuhu helayeen.” Qoyska Kamaal oo ka kooban toddobo qof ayaa hadda ku tiirsan kaalmada qaxootiga oo ah 70 kiilo oo masago iyo misir ah iyo 17 liiter oo saliid ah, taas oo labadii bilba mar la siiyo. Kaal-madan ayuu xusay inay tahay mid kooban oo aan dabooli karin baahidooda. Wuxuu intaas ku daray inuu raadiyay ildhaqaale oo beddal u noqota shaqadiisii hore. Waxa kaliya ee uu helayna ay tahay shaqo aan joogto aheyn oo ah gurista qoryaha dabka lagu shito oo bishii uu ka helo ugu badnaan $60. Wuxuu sheegay inay tahay howl dhib badan, dhaqaalaheeduna uu yar yahay, balse uu ku qasban yahay, maadaama uusan hayn xal kale. “Hadda aniga waxaan wataa dameer iyo gaarigiisa. Markaan xaabo ama qoryo doonanayo waxaan ku maqnaadaa labo habeen. Qoryaha aan keeno lacag fiican ma gooyaan, markiiba waxaan ka helaa illaa $20. Mararka qaar shan habeen ayay ooleysaa oo aan leyga gadaneyn. Dhaqaalaha aan helo qoyska kuma filna, dabkuna nagama damo, balse ma ahan shaqadii hore oo kale, taasi way nagu filneyd oo aadbay u fiicneyd.” Kamaal ayaa tilmaamay inay wajahayaan xaalad hubanti la’aan ah oo uusan maareyn karin, dhaqaale yari awgeed. Wuxuu sheegay inay ku jiraan xilligii ugu liidatay ee soo mara tan iyo 2008 oo uu ku nool yahay xerada Xagardheer oo ka mid ah qaxootiga Dhadhaab. Ninkan oo 45 jir ah ayaa xusay inuusan isku dhiibi doonin waayaha adag ee uu wajahayo, waloow uu muujiyay rajo xumo, maaddama ay dhaqaale xumo ay daashatay. “Qofku isagoo jooga meel hooseysa haddii uu ka sii aado meel kale oo sii hooseysa xaaladdu way ka sii dareysaa. Marka waxaan ka qabsi qabaa in gaajo loo baaba’o. Aniga waa markii iigu horeysay noloshan mid la mid ah horay ulama kulmin.” Kamaal ayaa sheegay in ku sii noolaanshaha qaxootiga uu ku door bidayo waxbarashada oo bilaash ah, hoy aan kiro aheyn iyo amni. Wuxuu faah faahin ka bixiyay caqabadihii ku qasbay inuu ka soo qaxo magaalada Muqdisho oo uu ku noolaa iyo sida dib loogu soo nooleyn karo xirfaddii uu ku shaqeysan jiray ee tumista biraha. “Aniga waxaan imid 2008, Muqdisho ayaana ka imid. Magaalada waxaa ka jirtay nabad galyo la’aan oo aan oga soo cararay. Soomaaliya inaan ku laabto waa laga yabaa, laakiin hadda ciyaalkii ayaa waxbarasho ku jira oo ma noqon karo.” “Bulshada Soomaaliyeed waxaan ka codsanayaa in dhaqaalahooda aysan meel kale geyn oo ay iska daayaan wax yaabaha dibadda laga keenayo. Wax haka gataan farsamo yaqaanada Soomaaliyeed.” Farsamo yaqaano aan ka badneyn 20 qof ayaa hadda ku sii harsan shaqada tumista biraha ee Xeryaha Dhadhaab, sida aan ka soo xigtay hormuud kooda, balse, kama helaan dhaqaalihii ka soo gali jiray markay suuqa haysteen oo u dhexeeyay bishii $180 illaa $250. Madaahir Salaad Samow oo wali jooga goobtiisa ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in waxa ka soo gala bishii aysan gaareyn $40. Duruufta dhaqaale iyo shaqo kale oo uusan meel ku ogeyn ayuu xusay inay qasbeyso, balse uusan ku niyad sameyn howsha uu maalin kasta qabto oo dheefteedu ay yartahay. “Sidaa oo ay tahay shaqada waa nalaku faquuqaa. Marmar waxay iga gaartaa ma iska dhaaftaa, misana shaqo kale ma aqaanee waa iska sabraa.” Ninkan 58 jir ah ayaa intaas ku daray in reerku ay sidoo kale ku tiirsanaayeen kaalmada qaxootiga oo kabi jirtay, balse gargaarkaas la dhimay boqolkiiba 50, intaasna aysan mararka qaar helin. Wuxuu sheegay in iyaga oo aan muddo sanad ah qaadan wax kaalmo ah ay bishii Sebteember heleen 100 kiilo oo ah masago, misir iyo 17 liiter oo saliid ah. Madaahir ayaa xusey in gacmo marnaan uu inta badan kala laabto goobtiisa shaqo oo muddo 38 sano ah laf dhabar u ahayd nolosha qoyskiisa oo 14 qof ka kooban. “Anigu maanta oo dhan sida aan u joojo aniga oo gamo-maran ayaan iska tagaa oo eber ah aan waxba helin. Maalmaha aanan waxba helin ayaaba ugu badan.” Caqabadaha nololeed waxaa u dheer in lagu leeyahay deyn $150 ah oo iskugu jirta kirada meesha uu birta ku tumo oo uu iska bixin waayay iyo raashiin uu qoyska u qaaday. Xaaladda ay wajahayaan ayuu ku sheegay tii ugu liidatay, tan iyo sanadkii 2010 oo uu ku nool yahay xeryaha qaxootiga Dhadhaab oo uu soo maciin biday. Abaar soo noqnoqotay ayaa caqabad ku noqday inuu tacbado beer hal hektar ah oo uu ku lahaa degmada Saakow ee gobolka Jubbada Dhexe. “Xoogayga keliya weeye maanta waxaan ku tiirsanahay. Haddii aan xanuusado ama shaqada ka baaqdo, caruurtu waa qadeysaa. Waligay hal Shilling oo meel ka imaaday ma cunin.” Dadka birta tuma ayaa ah kuwo iyagu is baray xirfadan oo sanooyin badan ay ku tiirsanaayeen, balse hadda u muuqata mid qariib noqotay. Yoonis Abukar oo guddoomiyaha dadka birta tuma ee xeryaha Qaxootiga ayaa xusay in xifadan ay dad badan ka sii macaashi lahaayeen haddii la xaddidi lahaa agabka la midka ah ee dibadda laga keeno. Dadka ku nool xeryaha qaxootiga Dhadhaab ayaa xilligan wajahaya sicir barar, kaalmada gargaarka oo hoos u dhacday iyo fursadaha shaqo helista oo ah kuwo qariib ah. Wax haka gataan farsamo yaqaanada Soomaaliyeed.” Farsamo yaqaano aan ka badneyn 20 qof ayaa hadda ku sii harsan shaqada tumista biraha ee Xeryaha Dhadhaab, sida aan ka soo xigtay hormuud kooda, balse, kama helaan dhaqaalihii ka soo gali jiray markay suuqa haysteen oo u dhexeeyay bishii $180 illaa $250. Madaahir Salaad Samow oo wali jooga goobtiisa ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in waxa ka soo gala bishii aysan gaareyn $40. Duruufta dhaqaale iyo shaqo kale oo uusan meel ku ogeyn ayuu xusay inay qasbeyso, balse uusan ku niyad sameyn howsha uu maalin kasta qabto oo dheefteedu ay yartahay. “Sidaa oo ay tahay shaqada waa nalaku faquuqaa. Marmar waxay iga gaartaa ma iska dhaaftaa, misana shaqo kale ma aqaanee waa iska sabraa.” Ninkan 58 jir ah ayaa intaas ku daray in reerku ay sidoo kale ku tiirsanaayeen kaalmada qaxootiga oo kabi jirtay, balse gargaarkaas la dhimay boqolkiiba 50, intaasna aysan mararka qaar helin. Wuxuu sheegay in iyaga oo aan muddo sanad ah qaadan wax kaalmo ah ay bishii Sebteember heleen 100 kiilo oo ah masago, misir iyo 17 liiter oo saliid ah. Madaahir ayaa xusey in gacmo marnaan uu inta badan kala laabto goobtiisa shaqo oo muddo 38 sano ah laf dhabar u ahayd nolosha qoyskiisa oo 14 qof ka kooban. “Anigu maanta oo dhan sida aan u joojo aniga oo gamo-maran ayaan iska tagaa oo eber ah aan waxba helin. Maalmaha aanan waxba helin ayaaba ugu badan.” Caqabadaha nololeed waxaa u dheer in lagu leeyahay deyn $150 ah oo iskugu jirta kirada meesha uu birta ku tumo oo uu iska bixin waayay iyo raashiin uu qoyska u qaaday. Xaaladda ay wajahayaan ayuu ku sheegay tii ugu liidatay, tan iyo sanadkii 2010 oo uu ku nool yahay xeryaha qaxootiga Dhadhaab oo uu soo maciin biday. Abaar soo noqnoqotay ayaa caqabad ku noqday inuu tacbado beer hal hektar ah oo uu ku lahaa degmada Saakow ee gobolka Jubbada Dhexe. “Xoogayga keliya weeye maanta waxaan ku tiirsanahay. Haddii aan xanuusado ama shaqada ka baaqdo, caruurtu waa qadeysaa. Waligay hal Shilling oo meel ka imaaday ma cunin.” Dadka birta tuma ayaa ah kuwo iyagu is baray xirfadan oo sanooyin badan ay ku tiirsanaayeen, balse hadda u muuqata mid qariib noqotay. Yoonis Abukar oo guddoomiyaha dadka birta tuma ee xeryaha Qaxootiga ayaa xusay in xifadan ay dad badan ka sii macaashi lahaayeen haddii la xaddidi lahaa agabka la midka ah ee dibadda laga keeno. Dadka ku nool xeryaha qaxootiga Dhadhaab ayaa xilligan wajahaya sicir barar, kaalmada gargaarka oo hoos u dhacday iyo fursadaha shaqo helista oo ah kuwo qariib ah. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh: Lagama yaabo in Al-Shabaab abid dib u xukunto Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa meesha ka saaray suurta-galnimada in kooxda Al-Shabaab ay mar kale awood u yeelato inay la wareegto talada dalka, isaga oo sheegay in inkastoo dagaalku sii socon karo, aysan kooxdu dib ugu noqon karin heerkii ay horey uga gaartay Soomaaliya. “Dagaalkan waxaa laga yaabaa inuu sii socdo muddo kale, laakiin ma jirto suurta-galnimo ah in Al-Shabaab ay soo laabato oo ay dalka oo dhan gacanta ku dhigto,” ayuu Xasan Sheekh ku yiri wareysi uu siiyey Al Jazeera. “Soo laabashada Al-Shabaab waa wax aan macquul ahayn. Sidoo kale dib ugu noqoshada dagaal sokeeye, dagaal beeleed ama dagaal siyaasadeed waa wax aan macquul ahayn,” ayuu intaas ku daray. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Al-Shabaab aysan hadda gacanta ku hayn magaalooyinka waaweyn ee Soomaaliya, isaga oo sidoo kale meesha ka saaray sheegashada ah in kooxdu ay maamusho “dowlad barbar socota” dowladda federaalka. Waxa uu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay hadda hoggaamineyso istaraatiijiyadda dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, isla markaana furitaankii furimo cusub uu kooxda ku riixay dhul miyi ah. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in nidaamka canshuuraha ee Al-Shabaab uu ku dhisan yahay cabsi iyo xoog, halkii uu ka ahaan lahaa adeegyo ay kooxdu siiso dadka ay lacagaha ka qaaddo. Si kastaba, Al-Shabaab ayaa weli awood militari ku leh qeybo ka mid ah koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya, waxayna sii waddaa weerarro, qaraxyo iyo dilal lala beegsado ciidamada dowladda, saraakiisha iyo dadka rayidka ah. ‘Saaxiibka ugu xooggan’ Wareysiga dhexdiisa, Xasan Sheekh ayaa Mareykanka ku tilmaamay saaxiibka ugu xooggan ee Soomaaliya kala shaqeeya la-dagaallanka argagixisada, isaga oo sheegay in iskaashiga amni ee Muqdisho iyo Washington uu sii socdo. Hadalkaas ayaa kusoo beegmay xilli madaxweynaha uu Muqdisho kula kulmay Massad Boulos, oo ah la-taliyaha Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ee arrimaha Carabta iyo Afrika. Villa Somalia ayaa sheegtay in Xasan Sheekh iyo Boulos ay ka wada hadleen arrimo goboleed iyo kuwo caalami ah oo labada dhinac muhiim u ah, isla markaana ay mar kale xaqiijiyeen muhiimadda iskaashiga istaraatiijiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka. Madaxtooyadu ma aysan sheegin in kulanka si gaar ah looga hadlay howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Kulanka ayaa yimid iyadoo Mareykanku sanadkan si weyn u kordhiyey duqeymaha uu Soomaaliya ka fuliyo, kuwaas oo lagu bartilmaameedsado Al-Shabaab iyo kooxda Daacish. Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika, AFRICOM, ayaa tobannaan weerar oo cirka ah ka fuliyey Soomaaliya sanadkan, kuwaas oo intooda badan lagu sheegay inay la socdaan iskaashi ay la leeyihiin dowladda federaalka. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale tababar iyo taageero siiya ciidamada Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan ciidanka Danab, oo door weyn ku leh howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Al-Shabaab weli waa khatar Inkasta oo Xasan Sheekh uu meesha ka saaray in Al-Shabaab ay dib ugu soo laaban karto talada dalka, haddana kooxdu weli waxay awood u leedahay inay dagaal dheer sii waddo. Al-Shabaab waxaa Muqdisho laga saaray sanadkii 2011, waxaana sannadihii xigay laga qabsaday magaalooyin kale oo waaweyn, balse waxay weli ku sugan tahay deegaanno badan oo miyi ah. Kooxdu waxay sidoo kale sii waddaa qaraxyo, weerarro toos ah iyo dilal qorsheysan oo ay ka fuliso gudaha dalka. Ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya, oo ay taageerayaan ciidamada deegaanka, howlgalka Midowga Afrika iyo saaxiibbo caalami ah, ayaa dhowr jeer qaaday weerarro lagu doonayo in kooxda looga saaro deegaannada ay maamusho. Howlgalladaas waxay dowladda u horseedeen guulo dhowr ah, balse Al-Shabaab ayaa iyaduna marar kala duwan dib u qabsatay deegaanno iyo fariisimo ay ciidamada dowladda horey uga saareen. Hadallada Xasan Sheekh ayaa kala saaraya laba arrimood: in Al-Shabaab ay weli awood u leedahay inay sii waddo dagaal dhuumaaleysi ah, iyo in ay mar kale awood u hesho inay talada dalka la wareegto. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in tan labaad aysan hadda suurtagal ahayn, inkastoo dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxda uu weli sii socon karo. items.title: Hassan Sheikh’s Election Strategy: Reform or Route to Another Term?
items.description: By Ahmed A. Yusuf Somalia’s political crisis has entered a far more dangerous phase. What began as a dispute over elections, constitutional amendments and presidential mandates is now raising the possibility of deeper state fragmentation — including the potential separation of Puntland from Somalia’s federal system. At the same time, some of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s former political allies have broken ranks with him, with one of the most senior figures in his own ruling party accusing him of concentrating decision-making in his own hands and refusing to listen to those around him. The striking feature of these departures is the explanation offered by former allies: that they no longer felt able to influence decisions and did not want to become mere supporters of decisions already made. In March, Abdirahman Mohamed Hussein Odowaa, then secretary-general of Hassan Sheikh’s Justice and Solidarity Party and a former interior minister, resigned from both positions. He accused the president of making decision-making in the country and the party something that “begins and ends with him alone,” and said the president had rejected dissenting views and refused to consult his political team. That rupture is politically significant because Odowaa was not a traditional opposition figure. He was part of Hassan Sheikh’s own political structure. It adds another dimension to a crisis that is already dividing the federal government from major federal member states. At the centre of the confrontation is Hassan Sheikh, who is pushing ahead with a new constitutional and electoral order while maintaining that his mandate extends into May 2027. His opponents reject that interpretation and argue that his original four-year mandate expired in May 2026 under the previous constitutional framework. The disagreement has already fractured relations between Mogadishu and several federal member states. Puntland has refused to recognize federal institutions since its 2024 dispute with Mogadishu over constitutional amendments. Jubaland has also been in prolonged confrontation with the federal government, while South West suspended cooperation with Mogadishu amid the escalating dispute over political control and the future of President Abdiaziz Laftagareen. The result is an increasingly fragmented political landscape in which the question is no longer simply who will win the next election, but whether Somalia’s federal system can remain politically intact long enough to hold one. Puntland’s Warning Changes the Stakes For years, Puntland’s position has generally been that it wants a functioning federal Somalia with substantial powers for the member states. The latest warning from Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni goes further. In a September 13 letter to the United Nations, Deni warned that Puntland could eventually consider permanently severing ties with Mogadishu if an inclusive political settlement cannot be reached. The letter also referred to pressure from citizens favouring full independence from the centre. The letter does not declare independence, call for a referendum or establish a formal secession process. But the political significance is considerable: the possibility of permanent separation has now been formally placed before the United Nations. That does not mean Puntland has decided to follow Somaliland’s path, nor does it establish that a majority of Puntland residents support independence. But it signals how far the political relationship between Puntland and Mogadishu has deteriorated. Could Others Follow? The prospect of Puntland separating raises a wider and more consequential question for Somalia’s future. If Mogadishu fails to reach political agreements with the federal member states, could Jubaland and South West eventually conclude that remaining within the federal arrangement no longer serves their political interests? There is currently no evidence that either administration has formally announced a plan to secede from Somalia. But both have already experienced severe political and institutional confrontation with Mogadishu. That creates a potentially dangerous sequence: political disagreement produces institutional separation; institutional separation produces competing security and administrative structures; and prolonged separation can eventually make political reunification increasingly difficult. Puntland’s warning therefore matters not only because of what Puntland itself might eventually do, but because it introduces the possibility of a much wider fragmentation of Somalia’s federal system. The erosion of Hassan Sheikh’s political coalition adds another layer to the crisis. The departure of Odowaa was particularly significant because he had occupied senior positions inside Hassan Sheikh’s political camp. His resignation suggested that disagreement was no longer confined to opposition leaders, Puntland, Jubaland or other external political actors. It had reached the president’s own inner political structure. Odowaa’s central complaint was consultation. He said the president was making decisions alone, rejecting alternative views and disregarding advice from his political team and state institutions. He also challenged the government’s constitutional and electoral strategy, arguing that major changes required broader political agreement. The political message from such departures is therefore more consequential than the loss of individual personalities. When senior allies leave while saying they can no longer influence decisions, it raises a fundamental question about how much room remains inside the governing coalition for disagreement, consultation and compromise. Hassan Sheikh himself has defended a different approach. In April, while responding to criticism from former President Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed “Farmaajo,” he said he had deliberately moved away from the previous political model of consulting opponents and argued that Somalia needed to move forward rather than remain trapped in the old system. The contrast is striking: the president presents his approach as decisive reform, while former allies describe the same style of leadership as excessive concentration of decision-making. Hirshabelle Adds Another Fault Line Hirshabelle demonstrates how quickly political disputes can acquire a security dimension. Hawadle leaders have rejected the state’s electoral process without a prior political agreement over power-sharing. The dispute intensified after Hirshabelle Vice President Yusuf Hagar Dabageed accused Hassan Sheikh of reversing an earlier understanding that the presidency would go to a Hawadle candidate and instead supporting incumbent Ali Abdullahi Hussein Guudlaawe, who is from the Abgaal community. The Justice and Solidarity Party associated with Hassan Sheikh subsequently won 78 of the 99 parliamentary seats, giving it a commanding position in the state assembly. Then came reports that segments of the Hawadle community, including former Macawisley fighters, reached an understanding with Al-Shabaab in Maxaas after years of conflict. The reported agreement has not been independently verified in full and should not be interpreted as a decision by the entire Hawadle clan to support Al-Shabaab. But the sequence is significant. A community that played a major role in fighting Al-Shabaab during the 2022 offensive is now experiencing a political dispute with the federal leadership while some of its members are reportedly seeking an accommodation with the insurgency. The Disintegration Scenario This is where Somalia’s current crisis becomes more serious than an ordinary electoral confrontation. A country can survive a disputed election. It becomes far more difficult to preserve national institutions when major political units no longer recognize the same constitutional framework, electoral timetable or central authority. The possibility of full political disintegration is therefore no longer merely an abstract scenario. Puntland has placed permanent separation on the political agenda. Jubaland and South West have experienced severe institutional breakdowns with Mogadishu. Hirshabelle is facing internal political divisions with security implications. Somaliland has operated outside the federal system for decades and continues to seek international recognition as an independent state. None of these developments, individually, establishes the breakup of Somalia. Together, however, they demonstrate how prolonged political disagreement can progressively weaken the institutions that hold a federal state together. The 2027 Election Could Become a Test of the Union The government maintains that constitutional reform and direct elections are necessary to build a more democratic political system. Its opponents argue that the rules must first be agreed upon by the country’s principal political stakeholders and federal member states. That disagreement is now occurring against a much more consequential backdrop. If the federal government proceeds toward the 2027 election without restoring political relations with the major federal states, the central question may eventually become not who wins the election, but who accepts its authority. An election held without broad political agreement could deepen rather than resolve the existing divisions. And if political institutions continue separating along regional lines, the country could move toward a situation in which Somalia remains one country legally while functioning increasingly as several competing political systems. The political crisis is therefore no longer simply about Hassan Sheikh’s electoral strategy. It is about whether the president can rebuild enough political consensus to keep the federal system together. Puntland has now raised the possibility of permanent separation. Jubaland and South West remain deeply estranged from Mogadishu. Political disputes are intensifying inside Hirshabelle. And senior figures who once stood beside Hassan Sheikh have publicly complained that their advice is no longer being heard. The president and his supporters can present this as the difficult price of pursuing constitutional and electoral reform. His former allies and political opponents see something very different: a presidency increasingly operating without the consultation needed to carry the country through a contested transition. The immediate dispute may be about elections and constitutional authority. The larger question is whether Somalia can resolve those disputes before political fragmentation becomes permanent. Because once federal states begin contemplating whether they are better off outside the political system, and senior political allies conclude that they can no longer influence decisions from within, the crisis is no longer merely about who governs Somalia. It becomes a question of whether there will still be one political Somalia to govern. Ahmed A. In April, while responding to criticism from former President Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed “Farmaajo,” he said he had deliberately moved away from the previous political model of consulting opponents and argued that Somalia needed to move forward rather than remain trapped in the old system. The contrast is striking: the president presents his approach as decisive reform, while former allies describe the same style of leadership as excessive concentration of decision-making. Hirshabelle Adds Another Fault Line Hirshabelle demonstrates how quickly political disputes can acquire a security dimension. Hawadle leaders have rejected the state’s electoral process without a prior political agreement over power-sharing. The dispute intensified after Hirshabelle Vice President Yusuf Hagar Dabageed accused Hassan Sheikh of reversing an earlier understanding that the presidency would go to a Hawadle candidate and instead supporting incumbent Ali Abdullahi Hussein Guudlaawe, who is from the Abgaal community. The Justice and Solidarity Party associated with Hassan Sheikh subsequently won 78 of the 99 parliamentary seats, giving it a commanding position in the state assembly. Then came reports that segments of the Hawadle community, including former Macawisley fighters, reached an understanding with Al-Shabaab in Maxaas after years of conflict. The reported agreement has not been independently verified in full and should not be interpreted as a decision by the entire Hawadle clan to support Al-Shabaab. But the sequence is significant. A community that played a major role in fighting Al-Shabaab during the 2022 offensive is now experiencing a political dispute with the federal leadership while some of its members are reportedly seeking an accommodation with the insurgency. The Disintegration Scenario This is where Somalia’s current crisis becomes more serious than an ordinary electoral confrontation. A country can survive a disputed election. It becomes far more difficult to preserve national institutions when major political units no longer recognize the same constitutional framework, electoral timetable or central authority. The possibility of full political disintegration is therefore no longer merely an abstract scenario. Puntland has placed permanent separation on the political agenda. Jubaland and South West have experienced severe institutional breakdowns with Mogadishu. Hirshabelle is facing internal political divisions with security implications. Somaliland has operated outside the federal system for decades and continues to seek international recognition as an independent state. None of these developments, individually, establishes the breakup of Somalia. Together, however, they demonstrate how prolonged political disagreement can progressively weaken the institutions that hold a federal state together. The 2027 Election Could Become a Test of the Union The government maintains that constitutional reform and direct elections are necessary to build a more democratic political system. Its opponents argue that the rules must first be agreed upon by the country’s principal political stakeholders and federal member states. That disagreement is now occurring against a much more consequential backdrop. If the federal government proceeds toward the 2027 election without restoring political relations with the major federal states, the central question may eventually become not who wins the election, but who accepts its authority. An election held without broad political agreement could deepen rather than resolve the existing divisions. And if political institutions continue separating along regional lines, the country could move toward a situation in which Somalia remains one country legally while functioning increasingly as several competing political systems. The political crisis is therefore no longer simply about Hassan Sheikh’s electoral strategy. It is about whether the president can rebuild enough political consensus to keep the federal system together. Puntland has now raised the possibility of permanent separation. Jubaland and South West remain deeply estranged from Mogadishu. Political disputes are intensifying inside Hirshabelle. And senior figures who once stood beside Hassan Sheikh have publicly complained that their advice is no longer being heard. The president and his supporters can present this as the difficult price of pursuing constitutional and electoral reform. His former allies and political opponents see something very different: a presidency increasingly operating without the consultation needed to carry the country through a contested transition. The immediate dispute may be about elections and constitutional authority. The larger question is whether Somalia can resolve those disputes before political fragmentation becomes permanent. Because once federal states begin contemplating whether they are better off outside the political system, and senior political allies conclude that they can no longer influence decisions from within, the crisis is no longer merely about who governs Somalia. It becomes a question of whether there will still be one political Somalia to govern. Ahmed A. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Hindiya oo wada-hadallo cusub yeeshay
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Soomaaliya, Cabdifataax Qaasim Maxamuud ayaa magaalada Nairobi ee dalka Kenya kulan kula yeeshay Wakiilka Sare ee Hindiya u fadhiya Kenya ahna Safiirka Hindiya ee Soomaaliya, Adarsh Swaika. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Hindiya ee dhinacyada warfaafinta iyo dhaqanka, iyadoo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray sidii loo horumarin lahaa wada-shaqeynta labada dal. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay horumarinta iyo kobcinta xirfadaha shaqaalaha, u guurista nidaamyada dhijitaalka ah iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga kooxaha fanka iyo dhaqanka. Arrimaha kulanka lagu falanqeeyay waxaa sidoo kale kamid ahaa sidii loo horumarin lahaa awoodda hay’adaha warbaahinta iyo dhaqanka, iyadoo la adeegsanayo fursadaha iskaashi ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Hindiya. Wasiir Cabdifataax Qaasim ayaa uga mahadceliyey Dowladda Hindiya taageerada iyo iskaashiga ay la garab taagan tahay Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dadaallada lagu horumarinayo warbaahinta qaranka. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay taageerada Hindiya ee kobcinta awoodda shaqaalaha iyo horumarinta xirfadaha la xiriira warbaahinta iyo dhaqanka. Kulanka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu horumarinayo nidaamyada warbaahinta iyo dhaqanka, iyadoo la raadinayo iskaashi caalami ah oo gacan ka geysta kobcinta xirfadaha iyo adeegsiga tiknoolajiyadda casriga ah. The post Soomaaliya iyo Hindiya oo wada-hadallo cusub yeeshay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: DEGDEG: Laba Garoon Diyaaradeed oo ku yaalla Sacuudiga oo la Weeraray
items.description: Laba garoon diyaaradeed oo ku yaalla koonfurta Boqortooyada Sacuudiga ayaa fiidnimadii Isniinta, 5-dii Oktoobar 2026, lagu qaaday laba weerar oo kala duwan, sida ay xaqiijisay Hay’adda Guud ee Duulista Rayidka Sacuudiga. Weerarada ayaa lagu beegsaday Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Boqor Cabdullaah Bin Cabdulcasiis ee magaalada Jazan iyo Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Najran , iyadoo la sheegay in weerarradu waxyeello u geysteen qaar ka mid ah xarumaha iyo kaabayaasha garoomada. Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ayaa sheegtay in saddex qof ay soo gaareen dhaawacyo fudud , kuwaas oo loo qaaday isbitaallo si loo siiyo daryeel caafimaad. Waxaa sidoo kale la soo sheegay khasaare hantiyeed , balse faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan baaxadda khasaaraha lama shaacin. Kooxaha gurmadka iyo hay’adaha ay khuseyso ayaa si degdeg ah uga hawlgallay goobaha ay weerarradu ka dhaceen, iyadoo la raacayo qorshayaasha degdegga ah ee loo dejiyay xaaladaha noocan ah. Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka waxay sheegtay inay si wadajir ah ula shaqeynayso hay’adaha ammaanka si loo qiimeeyo khasaaraha, loona qaado tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah ee lagu xaqiijinayo badbaadada rakaabka, shaqaalaha iyo amniga guud ee duulista rayidka ee dalka. Weeraradan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan dagaallada u dhexeeya Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Reuters waxay sheegtay in weerarrada lagu qaaday labada garoon ay dhacayeen iyadoo colaadda u dhexeysa Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta ay sii kordheyso. Wararka hadda la xaqiijiyay waxay tilmaamayaan in saddexda qof ay qabaan dhaawacyo fudud, halka baaritaanno lagu sameynayo khasaaraha ka dhashay weerarrada iyo tallaabooyinka amni ee xiga.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya oo ka qeyb galay Furitaanka Shirweynaha 153-aad ee Midowga Baarlamaanka Adduunka
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) , ayaa magaalada Arusha ee dalka Tanzania kaga qeyb galay furitaanka Shirweynaha 153-aad ee Midowga Baarlamaanada Adduunka (IPU) . Shirweynaha oo si rasmi ah uga furmay magaalada Arusha ayaa waxaa furay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Tanzania, Mwigulu Lameck Nchemba , waxaana ka qeybgalaya madaxda iyo wakiillo ka socda baarlamaannada dalal badan oo caalamka ah. Kulanka oo socon doona muddo shan maalmood ah ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa arrimo la xiriira horumarinta dowlad-wanaagga, xoojinta iskaashiga baarlamaannada iyo awood-siinta bulshada , iyadoo xoogga la saarayo ka-qaybgal loo dhan yahay, kalsooni iyo helitaanka fursado loo siman yahay. Ka qeybgalka Soomaaliya ee shirweynahan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya uu ku xoojinayo xiriirka iyo iskaashiga uu la leeyahay baarlamaannada caalamka, iyadoo sidoo kale fursad u ah wafdiga Soomaaliyeed inuu kala hadlo dhinacyada kale arrimaha khuseeya horumarinta hay’adaha sharci-dejinta iyo dowlad-wanaagga. Shirweynaha IPU ayaa sidoo kale lagu wadaa in lagu gorfeeyo arrimo muhiim u ah doorka baarlamaannada, oo ay ka mid yihiin ka-qaybgalka bulshada, isla-xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowladda iyo sidii baarlamaannadu ugaalin uga qaadan lahaayeen horumarinta dowladnimo loo dhan yahay.

items.title: Abiy Begins Third Term as Ethiopia Enters a Period of Political and Security Uncertainty
items.description: Prosperity Party Sweeps Parliament as Opposition Questions the Election and Abiy Faces Mounting Pressure at Home and Abroad Addis Ababa (WDN) — Ethiopia’s parliament has re-elected Abiy Ahmed to a third five-year term, giving his Prosperity Party overwhelming control of the legislature just as his government confronts renewed fighting, deep political divisions and worsening tensions with neighbouring Eritrea. Abiy was sworn in on Monday after the newly elected House of Peoples’ Representatives re-elected him as prime minister. His Prosperity Party won 438 of the 501 contested parliamentary seats in the June 1 election, giving it a commanding majority. The result gives Abiy substantial institutional power. But it does not necessarily amount to broad political confidence in his government. Voting did not take place in Tigray, while insecurity disrupted polling in parts of Amhara and Oromia. Opposition parties also accused the government of restricting political competition, allegations Addis Ababa has rejected. Abiy therefore begins his third term with a powerful parliamentary majority but significant political and security disputes still unresolved. A Powerful Parliament, an Incomplete Political Settlement The June election produced a decisive victory for the Prosperity Party, but it was conducted under conditions that limited participation in some of Ethiopia’s most politically contested regions. The exclusion of Tigray and disruption of voting in parts of Amhara and Oromia mean the election did not provide a uniform national political contest. Opposition groups have consequently questioned whether the result should be viewed as a comprehensive political settlement. That distinction matters. Abiy now has the parliamentary numbers to form and lead the federal government. What remains uncertain is whether that institutional strength can translate into wider political acceptance among regions and opposition forces that remain outside his political coalition. A Third Term Begins Under Security Pressure The timing of Abiy’s new term is particularly difficult. Fighting has erupted again in Tigray, with federal forces recently retaking Mekelle after Tigrayan forces withdrew from the regional capital. The escalation is the most serious since the 2020–2022 conflict and has raised fears of a wider deterioration. Armed opposition also remains active in Amhara and Oromia, while a newly formed alliance of seven opposition groups has declared its intention to remove Abiy’s government. The new administration therefore inherits a security environment that cannot be resolved through parliamentary authority alone. The Regional Dimension Ethiopia’s internal tensions are also increasingly connected to its relations with neighbouring states. Relations with Eritrea have deteriorated sharply, culminating in Eritrea’s decision to sever diplomatic ties with Ethiopia amid accusations over support for opposing armed groups. Eritrea has denied supporting forces fighting Abiy’s government. At the same time, Abiy continues to insist that Ethiopia needs reliable access to the Red Sea, an issue that has heightened sensitivities with Eritrea and other countries in the region. The domestic crisis is therefore unfolding alongside a broader regional confrontation in an already fragile Horn of Africa. Abiy enters his third term with substantial institutional advantages: a dominant parliamentary majority, control of the federal government and a constitutional mandate to pursue his programme. But the pressures confronting him extend well beyond Parliament. Renewed fighting in Tigray, armed opposition elsewhere, unresolved political grievances and deteriorating relations with Eritrea could consume the political space created by his electoral victory. The central challenge is therefore turning parliamentary dominance into political stability — before unresolved regional and political disputes become entrenched during his new term. Abiy has now secured another five years as prime minister. But the parliamentary victory has not resolved Ethiopia’s deeper political divisions, nor has it removed the security pressures confronting the federal government. He begins his third term stronger inside Parliament than at any previous point in his tenure, while significant political and armed challenges remain outside it. That is the central contradiction of Abiy’s new mandate. He has the numbers to govern. Whether he can use those numbers to broaden political accommodation and prevent Ethiopia from entering a prolonged period of instability will define the substance of his third term. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Hindiya oo Xoojinaya Iskaashiga Warbaahinta iyo Dhaqanka
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa dadaal ugu jirta casriyeynta waaxyaha warbaahinta iyo dhaqanka dalka, iyadoo iskaashi dheeraad ah la sameyneysa dowladda Hindiya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada isbeddelka dijitaalka ah, tababarrada xirfadeed iyo xoojinta xiriirka hay’adaha dhaqanka ee labada dal. Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Soomaaliya, Cabdifataax Qaasim Maxamed , ayaa sheegay in taageerada Hindiya ay gacan ka geysatay horumarinta warbaahinta qaranka, tayeynta shaqaalaha iyo taageerada kooxaha dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed. Wasiirka ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay kulan uu magaalada Nairobi kula yeeshay Safiirka Hindiya u fadhiya Soomaaliya ahna Wakiilka Sare ee Hindiya ee Kenya, Adarsh Swaika . Iskaashiga labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka u dhexeeya kooxaha fanka iyo dhaqanka, iyadoo la filayo in arrintani ay abuuri karto fursado dheeraad ah oo loogu talagalay is-dhaafsiga dhaqanka iyo iskaashiga hay’adaha labada waddan. Dhinaca kale, Soomaaliya waxay waddaa dadaallo lagu casriyeynayo habka loo soo saaro, loo maareeyo loona gaarsiiyo bulshada wararka iyo xogta dowladda, iyadoo nidaamyada dijitaalka ah ay qayb muhiim ah ka yihiin qorshayaashaasi. Wasiir Cabdifataax Qaasim ayaa dowladda Hindiya uga mahadceliyay taageerada ay Soomaaliya siiso, isaga oo tilmaamay in iskaashiga labada dal uu muhiim u yahay horumarinta hay’adaha warbaahinta iyo dhaqanka. Iskaashigan ayaa qayb ka noqonaya dadaallada Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso awoodda hay’adaha qaranka, iyadoo adeegsanaysa iskaashi caalami ah oo lagu horumarinayo warbaahinta, ilaalinta dhaqanka iyo hababka casriga ah ee gudbinta xogta dadweynaha.

Wasiir Cabdifataax Qaasim ayaa dowladda Hindiya uga mahadceliyay taageerada ay Soomaaliya siiso, isaga oo tilmaamay in iskaashiga labada dal uu muhiim u yahay horumarinta hay’adaha warbaahinta iyo dhaqanka. Iskaashigan ayaa qayb ka noqonaya dadaallada Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso awoodda hay’adaha qaranka, iyadoo adeegsanaysa iskaashi caalami ah oo lagu horumarinayo warbaahinta, ilaalinta dhaqanka iyo hababka casriga ah ee gudbinta xogta dadweynaha.

items.title: Somalia’s Federal Army Drawn Deeper into Political Battles
items.description: Beledxaawo Tensions Raise Fresh Alarm as Mogadishu Faces Accusations of Using National Forces to Pressure Jubaland and Remove Regional Leaders Beledxaawo (WDN) — Somalia’s political crisis is increasingly spilling onto the battlefield, with local authorities in Beledxaawo warning of a new federal military offensive against Jubaland — months after federal forces seized Baidoa in a confrontation that ended the tenure of South West President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. The latest warning came from Beledxaawo District Commissioner Abdiasis Xareed Abdullahi, who said forces commanded by federal officers were moving from Doolow and Luuq toward Beledxaawo and appeared to be preparing to target military positions in the town. “There is a new military movement. Forces led by officers have come from Doolow through Luuq and are heading toward Beledxaawo, targeting the military camps and the people of the town,” Xareed said. He accused federal security officials of driving the mobilisation and warned that it could trigger another conflict in Gedo. The Federal Government had not immediately issued a response to the allegation. From Baidoa to Beledxaawo The warning comes at a critical moment for Somalia’s federal system. In March 2026, federal forces entered Baidoa after relations between Mogadishu and Laftagareen collapsed. The Somali National Army took control of the city, and Laftagareen subsequently resigned. Reuters reported that his departure came days after he had been re-elected for another five-year term. Federal troops later clashed with forces loyal to Laftagareen, turning a political confrontation into an armed struggle over control of South West’s capital. For critics of Mogadishu, the episode is evidence that the federal government is increasingly willing to deploy the national army to reshape political leadership in federal member states. The government has presented its actions as efforts to restore state authority and maintain security. But the sequence has created a difficult question for Somalia: if federal forces can be used to remove or pressure the leadership of one federal state, what prevents the same model from being applied elsewhere? Jubaland Is Now in the Line of Fire Beledxaawo is precisely where that question is becoming urgent. The border town has repeatedly been at the centre of the confrontation between Mogadishu and Jubaland. Federal and Jubaland forces have fought for control of strategic locations in Gedo, including Beledxaawo and Doolow. EUAA reporting has documented the wider military and political confrontation between the Federal Government and Jubaland in the region. Recent developments show that the security situation remains fluid. Jubaland security forces recently conducted operations along the Doolow–Luuq corridor, while Jubaland’s security leadership placed forces on heightened alert amid efforts to consolidate a political and security agreement in Gedo. Xareed’s latest warning therefore comes against an already tense backdrop. He appealed to the forces involved to avoid confrontation. “We do not want war. We want peace. We do not want two more young men to die.” A National Army or a Political Instrument? The developments in South West and Gedo point to a problem far larger than either Baidoa or Beledxaawo. Somalia’s national army was created to defend the country and fight threats such as Al-Shabaab. Yet it is increasingly becoming involved in disputes over who controls federal member states and who has the authority to lead them. That risks undermining the very federal system the national security institutions are supposed to protect. The South West episode does not, by itself, prove that the sole purpose of the federal intervention was to remove Laftagareen. But the documented sequence — federal forces taking Baidoa, Laftagareen leaving office, and subsequent fighting with forces loyal to him — has strengthened that perception among his opponents. Now, with federal-aligned forces reportedly moving toward Beledxaawo, similar concerns are resurfacing in Jubaland. A Political Crisis Becoming a Security Crisis The situation has become even more sensitive following the September 3–4 drone strike in Doolow that wounded former Somali corrections commander General Mahad Abdirahman Aden, known as Shub, and civilians, according to Jubaland. Jubaland alleged that Turkish-operated aircraft carried out the attack and linked it to political differences with Mogadishu. The Federal Government denied involvement and said an investigation would be conducted, while Türkiye has not publicly confirmed responsibility. The episode has further intensified concerns over the use of military capabilities in Somalia’s internal political disputes. And because Beledxaawo sits on Somalia’s border with Kenya, any renewed fighting could quickly acquire regional consequences. The Bigger Danger The immediate question is whether the reported troop movements will result in fighting. The larger question is whether Somalia’s federal institutions can survive when political disagreements are increasingly settled through military deployments. Baidoa showed that a dispute over political authority can become a military confrontation. Beledxaawo now raises the possibility that the pattern could spread to another federal member state. If national forces become instruments in political battles between Mogadishu and the federal states, Somalia risks weakening the distinction between the national army and the political authority that controls it. That would carry consequences far beyond Gedo. The danger is no longer simply another battle in Beledxaawo. It is the gradual militarization of Somalia’s federal politics — and the possibility that the army created to hold the country together could become one of the forces pulling it apart. items.title: Yemen War Enters New Phase as Saudi-Backed Forces Push Toward Mokha
items.description: Saudi Air Campaign Backs Yemeni Counteroffensive as Fighting Reaches the Strategic Bab al-Mandab Corridor MOKHA, YEMEN (WDN) — Yemen’s war has entered a new and potentially decisive phase, with Saudi-backed government forces launching a major counteroffensive along the Red Sea coast and claiming significant gains around the strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait. The offensive comes weeks after Houthi forces seized Mokha and advanced toward the maritime corridor, threatening a shipping route connecting the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden. Yemeni government forces say they have retaken key positions in the Dhubab area, including an airstrip, and advanced toward Mokha. Government officials have also claimed that the city itself has fallen back under their control. Those claims have not been independently verified. Reuters reported that government forces had reached the outskirts of Mokha and that Houthi fighters were retreating toward the highlands, while the Houthis rejected the government’s account. Saudi Arabia Opens a Major Air Campaign The ground offensive has been backed by an intensive Saudi-led air operation. The Saudi-led coalition said 100 fighter jets were participating in the campaign, providing continuous air support to Yemeni government forces and air protection over Bab al-Mandab. Coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki al-Malki said 324 high-value Houthi targets had been destroyed since the operation began. The campaign represents a sharp escalation after the collapse of the ceasefire that had largely held since 2022. Saudi-backed forces are now attempting to reverse the Houthi advance before the movement can consolidate its position along the Red Sea coast. Why Mokha Matters Mokha’s importance lies less in the city itself than in its location. The port sits close to Bab al-Mandab, the narrow passage through which shipping moves between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden. Control of surrounding territory can give an armed group greater ability to threaten maritime traffic and the coastal routes supporting military operations. The Houthis’ September advance therefore represented more than another territorial gain in Yemen’s long-running war. It brought the movement closer to a position from which it could exert greater pressure on one of the world’s most important maritime corridors. The Saudi-backed counteroffensive is now designed to push them away from that corridor, but the Houthis are still advancing elsewhere. The battlefield picture remains far from one-sided. While government forces are pushing along the Red Sea coast, Houthi fighters have made gains around Taiz, including positions along routes that have placed additional pressure on government forces there. Reuters reported that Houthi advances near Taiz had tightened the pressure on the government-held city, although some battlefield claims remained disputed. The Houthis have also threatened Saudi airspace. That makes the current offensive more complicated than a simple government drive to retake lost territory. The Houthis are being pushed back in one strategic corridor while attempting to strengthen their position on another front. Washington’s Role Is More Limited Than Direct Combat The campaign also has an important American dimension, although Washington has stopped short of directly joining the air war. According to The New York Times , more than 200 U.S. military and intelligence personnel are operating from Saudi command centres, providing intelligence and targeting assistance. Their reported role gives the United States an indirect but significant connection to the campaign. The distinction matters: American involvement is centred on intelligence and technical support rather than direct U.S. strikes. The struggle over Bab al-Mandab now extends beyond Yemen’s internal political conflict. Saudi Arabia views Houthi control or influence around the strait as a direct security and economic threat, while the Houthis have used their position and missile and drone capabilities to challenge Saudi interests and maritime traffic. The renewed fighting is also unfolding amid wider regional tensions and disruption around other major shipping routes, increasing the international significance of developments on Yemen’s western coast. The UN migration agency said 184,000 people had been displaced since the war resumed, adding a humanitarian cost to the strategic contest. The War’s Next Test The immediate objective for Saudi-backed forces is clear: consolidate their gains around Bab al-Mandab, push the Houthis away from the coast and reverse the territorial advances made in September. But holding territory may prove harder than taking it. The Houthis retain substantial military capabilities and continue to operate across multiple fronts. Their advances around Taiz demonstrate that losing ground near Bab al-Mandab does not necessarily mean losing the wider war. For now, the battle for Mokha has become a test of whether the Saudi-backed coalition can turn a rapid military counteroffensive into a sustained reversal of Houthi gains. The Houthis moved toward Bab al-Mandab in a major September advance. Saudi-backed forces are now fighting to push them back — making the Red Sea coast the most important battlefield in Yemen’s renewed war. items.title: Axmed Shide: Soomaaligii ugu horreeyay ee hoggaamiya baarlamanka Itoobiya
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Axmed Shide ayaa loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Shacabka Itoobiya, isagoo noqday Soomaaligii ugu horreeyay ee qabta xilka hoggaanka aqalka hoose ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Itoobiya. Kalfadhigii ugu horreeyay ee Baarlamaanka 7-aad ayaa lagu doortay Axmed Shide kadib doorashadii guud ee dalka ka dhacday 1-dii Juun 2026. Isla kalfadhigaas ayaa sidoo kale lagu magacaabay Abiy Axmed oo mar kale loo doortay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya. Axmed Shide oo kasoo jeeda Deegaanka Soomaalida Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer kasoo shaqeynayay dowladda federaalka, isagoo soo qabtay xilal kala duwan oo sare. Xilkii ugu dambeeyay ee uu hayay wuxuu ahaa Wasiirka Maaliyadda Itoobiya. Marka loo eego awoodda hay’adda uu hadda hoggaaminayo ee Golaha Wakiillada Shacabka wuxuu leeyahay door muhiim ah oo ku saabsan sharci-dejinta federaalka iyo kormeerka hay’adaha dowladda. Hase yeeshee, xilka Axmed Shide ma noqonayo markii ugu horreysay ee siyaasi Soomaali ah uu hoggaamiyo mid ka mid ah labada aqal ee baarlamaanka Itoobiya. Aadan Faarax Ibraahim ayaa sanadkii 2020 loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Federaalka, oo ah aqalka sare ee baarlamaanka dalka. Kala duwanaanshaha ayaa ah in Axmed Shide uu noqday Soomaaligii ugu horreeyay ee loo doorto Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada Shacabka, kaas oo ah aqalka hoose iyo mid ka mid ah hay’adaha ugu muhiimsan ee sharci-dejinta Itoobiya. Xilkan cusub ayuu Axmed Shide qabanayaa xilli Itoobiya ay wajahayso xaalado siyaasadeed iyo amni oo adag, iyadoo qaybo ka mid ah waqooyiga dalka laga soo sheegayo xiisado iyo iska horimaadyo, gaar ahaan Tigray iyo deegaanada ku dhow. Guddoomiyaha cusub ayaa hadda hoggaamin doona gole ay ku mideysan yihiin wakiillo ka kala socda qowmiyadaha iyo deegaanada kala duwan ee Itoobiya, iyadoo xilkiisa cusub uu ka dhigay mid kamid ah masuuliyiinta ugu sarreeya hay’adaha federaalka dalka. items.title: Turkiga iyo Pakistan oo ciidan degdeg ah u diraya Sacuudiga
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa sheegay inay ciidamo si degdeg ah ugu daabulayaan Sacuudi Carabiya, taas oo qeyb ka ah hirgelinta heshiis cusub oo difaac wadajir ah oo ay saddexda dal ku mideysan yihiin, xilli dagaalka Yemen uu mar kale galay marxalad cusub. Go’aankan ayaa lagu dhawaaqay Isniintii kadib kulan degdeg ah oo magaalada Riyadh ay ku yeesheen wakiillo ka kala socday Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Saddexda dal ayaa si wadajir ah u cambaareeyay weerarradii dhowaan lagu qaaday Sacuudiga, gaar ahaan kuwa lagu beegsaday magaalooyinka barakeysan ee Maka iyo Madiina, inkasta oo bayaankooda aysan si toos ah ugu magacaabin Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Waxay xaqiijiyeen “diidmadooda aan mugdiga ku jirin ee weerar ama hanjabaad kasta oo lagu beegsado ammaanka iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya”. Sidoo kale waxay ku heshiiyeen in si degdeg ah loo dhaqan-geliyo waajibaadka difaaca wadajirka ah, lana diyaariyo ciidamadii iyo awoodihii milatari ee lagu heshiiyay, si loogu daabulo Sacuudiga muddo kooban gudaheed. Tallaabadan ayaa qeyb ka ah heshiiska loo yaqaan Mecca Pact , kaas oo Riyadh u adeegsanayo inuu xoojiyo iskaashiga dhinaca ammaanka iyo difaaca ee uu la leeyahay Ankara iyo Islamabad. Dagaalka Yemen Kulanka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudigu taageero ay bilaabeen weerar ballaaran oo ay sheegeen inuu ujeedkiisu yahay dib u qabsashada dhammaan dhulalkii Xuutiyiintu la wareegeen intii uu socday dagaalka Yemen. Illaa hadda ma cadda saameynta tooska ah ee ciidamo dheeraad ah oo Turkiga iyo Pakistan la geeyo Sacuudiga ay ku yeelan doonaan dagaalka Yemen. Pakistan ayaa horey ciidamo badan ugu lahayd gudaha Sacuudi Carabiya, halka Reuters ay toddobaadkii hore sheegtay in Islamabad ay afar diyaaradood oo hub sida u dirtay magaalada dekedda ah ee Cadan si loogu taageero dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudigu garab istaago. Middle East Eye ayaa sidoo kale kasoo xigatay sarkaal reer Galbeed ah oo ku sugan Khaliijka in shaqaale ama ciidamo Pakistani ah ay durba joogaan koonfurta Yemen. Hase yeeshee, ma cadda inay halkaas u joogaan iyagoo si rasmi ah uga tirsan ciidamada Pakistan iyo in qaarkood ay qandaraas kula shaqeynayaan ciidamada Sacuudiga. Farriin siyaasadeed Inkasta oo saameynta militari ee tallaabadan aysan weli caddayn, waqtiga lagu dhawaaqay ayaa siinaya miisaan siyaasadeed oo weyn, maadaama howlgalka ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta uu socdo. Sarkaal kale oo reer Galbeed ah oo ku sugan gobolka ayaa Middle East Eye u sheegay in Riyadh ay dooneysay inay hesho taageero caalami iyo mid goboleed ka hor inta aan la bilaabin weerar rogaal-celis ah oo ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta. items.title: Hasan ayaa lagu xukumay dil toogasho ah, maadama isagu horey dad u toogtay
items.description: Pentagon-ka ayaa ku dhawaaqay in dil toogasho ah lagu fulin doono Nidal Malik Xasan, oo ahaa sarkaal iyo dhakhtar ka tirsanaa ciidamada Mareykanka. Tani waxay noqon doontaa dilkii ugu horreeyay ee askari Mareykan ah lagu fuliyo toogasho tan iyo dhammaadkii Dagaalkii Labaad ee Adduunka. Xassan ayaa 5-tii November 2009 ku toogtay saldhigga Fort Hood ee Texas 13 askari oo Mareykan ahaa oo aan hubaysnayn, halka 32 kale ay ku dhaawacmeen dhacdadaa. Afhayeenka Pentagon-ka Sean Parnell ayaa sheegay in Xoghayaha Difaaca Pete Hegseth uu soo jeediyay in Xasan lagu fuliyo dil toogasho ah, isla markaana Madaxweyne Donald Trump ansixiyay. Xasan waxaa lagu helay 13 dacwadood oo dil ah iyo 32 dacwadood oo isku day dil ah. Guddiga maxkamadda oo ka koobnaa 13 sarkaal ayaa si wadajir ah ugu taliyay in lagu xukumo dil. Parnell ayaa sheegay in waqtiga iyo goobta lagu fulinayo xukunka la go’aamin doono. Wuxuu bartiisa X ku qoray: “Maalintii xisaabtanka Xasan ayaa ugu dambeyn timid.” Intii lagu jiray maxkamadeyntiisa militari ee 2013, Xasan wuxuu sheegay inuu aaminsanaa inuu ilaalinayay Muslimiinta iyo Taalibaanka ee Afghanistan, isagoo sidoo kale qirtay inuu ahaa qofkii toogashada geystay. Weerarkii 5-tii November 2009 ayaa loo arkaa weerarkii ugu dhimashada badnaa ee aan militari ahayn ee lagu qaado saldhig ciidamada Mareykanka ah taariikhda dalka. Bbc somali
