The declaration’s language on transboundary rivers rejects unilateral measures affecting shared water resources. This formulation originates in Egyptian policy designed to maintain control over Nile utilization. The Ethiopian statement responds by recording that the highlands of Ethiopia generate approximately eighty-five percent of the Nile’s total flow through the Abay River. Any workable arrangement for managing these waters must therefore incorporate Ethiopia’s right to develop resources originating within its territory. Between 1929 and 1959 Egypt secured bilateral agreements with Sudan that allocated the bulk of the water and asserted a veto over upstream projects. Those agreements excluded Ethiopia and later served as the basis for systematic opposition to international financing of Ethiopian infrastructure. The Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam proceeded solely through domestic bonds and public contributions, establishing a non-consumptive hydroelectric facility that ended the prior pattern of external blockage. Continued insistence on zero-sum control of the river ignores the established principle of equitable and reasonable utilization that underpins modern basin cooperation. Egyptian policy toward Ethiopia has followed a consistent pattern of containment since the mid-twentieth century. From the 1950s onward Cairo provided organizational space, media platforms, and political sanctuary for Eritrean separatist groups, including the Eritrean Liberation Front whose formation was announced in the Egyptian capital in 1960. The practical effect was to divert Ethiopian military and fiscal resources into prolonged internal conflict, reducing the capacity available for major development works on the Blue Nile. Contemporary Egyptian activity extends this approach through bilateral defense agreements, joint exercises, and intelligence arrangements with states that border Ethiopia. The same government that invokes sovereignty to oppose Ethiopian maritime access has for decades supported mechanisms that weaken Ethiopian internal cohesion. The declaration asserts that responsibility for Red Sea security belongs exclusively to littoral states. The Ethiopian statement rejects this boundary by noting that the country’s nearest border lies approximately thirty miles from the Red Sea coast and that Ethiopia’s population exceeds one hundred twenty million. As the largest economy and primary source of commercial traffic in the region, Ethiopia generates the bulk of demand for ports serving the southern Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. Exclusion of this stakeholder from maritime security arrangements leaves the framework without the demographic weight and logistical capacity needed to secure approaches to the Bab el-Mandeb. The littoral states currently lack the combined naval assets, internal coherence, and sustained logistics required for independent enforcement. A security structure organized around political exclusion rather than geographic and economic integration therefore contains built-in enforcement shortfalls. Eritrea and Sudan introduce further inconsistencies into the sovereignty claims advanced at El-Alamein. Eritrean statements routinely affirm the inviolability of borders and non-interference. Operational practice after the November 2022 Pretoria Agreement has included continued military presence in Ethiopian border areas and efforts to establish unilateral buffer zones inside Ethiopian territory. In the current conflict that erupted in late September 2026, Ethiopian federal authorities and regional leaders have reported that Eritrean troops are actively fighting alongside the Tigray People’s Liberation Front and other members of the seven-group coalition known as the Ethiopian Peoples’ Forces Alliance for Survival against the federal government. An Afar regional official told Al Jazeera that Eritrean forces were participating in fighting in that region, while Ethiopia’s army chief publicly accused Eritrea of providing backing to the rebel alliance. These reports, documented by the International Crisis Group in its September 2026 CrisisWatch update on Eritrea, underscore the contradiction between Asmara’s formal sovereignty rhetoric and its operational conduct. A government whose forces are reported to be engaged inside Ethiopian territory alongside groups seeking to overthrow the federal administration possesses limited standing to enforce territorial norms on others. Sudan’s record along the shared border with Ethiopia reveals a clear inconsistency with the sovereignty principles advanced at El-Alamein. In November 2020, while Ethiopian forces were concentrated on northern operations, the Sudanese Armed Forces advanced into the fertile Al Fashaga triangle and occupied areas long cultivated by Ethiopian farmers under the soft-border arrangements maintained through the 1972 exchange of notes and subsequent practical understandings. Sudanese units rapidly consolidated control over agricultural lands previously farmed by Ethiopian communities, expelling residents and altering the long-standing status quo that had preserved local livelihoods while formal demarcation remained unresolved. Ethiopia responded through diplomatic channels and continued advocacy for peaceful, African-led mechanisms under IGAD and the African Union rather than reciprocal military advances into Sudanese territory. The contrast is instructive. Sudan elected to exploit a moment of Ethiopian internal focus to alter facts on the ground by force, while Ethiopia has consistently channelled border disagreements into negotiation and regional mediation frameworks. This unilateral territorial action by Sudan undercuts the summit’s claims of principled support for sovereignty and institutional unity. The same tension becomes even more consequential in Somalia, where the declaration invokes sovereignty and institutional unity while overlooking Ethiopia’s longstanding role in sustaining both. The declaration’s treatment of Somalia therefore presents the clearest divergence between its stated principles and the regional realities that have shaped their survival. Somalia’s ability to preserve its federal institutions and territorial integrity has for more than two decades depended in significant part on Ethiopian security involvement. External military support has sustained the Federal Government of Somalia since the early 2000s, with Ethiopian forces playing a particularly persistent role in the country’s most contested areas. Under AMISOM and later ATMIS, Ethiopian deployments concentrated in Bay, Bakool and Gedo, sectors where other contingents were often less active. These forces absorbed sustained combat losses while maintaining the territorial and logistical links on which the federal government depended. Ethiopian policy consequently treated the survival of a functioning Somali state as directly connected to Ethiopia’s own border security. Somalia’s participation in a regional declaration centred on sovereignty while excluding one of the states that has repeatedly borne the operational burden of protecting that sovereignty therefore exposes a central contradiction in the framework. The transition from ATMIS to AUSSOM on 1 January 2025 further demonstrated the importance of operational continuity. Al-Shabaab launched a coordinated offensive in February 2025 across Hiiraan, Middle Shabelle, Lower Shabelle and parts of South West State, reversing important territorial gains made during the 2022–2023 government offensive through sustained attrition and the restoration of rural control. Ethiopian units remaining under AUSSOM and bilateral arrangements continued to hold forward positions, conduct joint operations with Somali forces and defend logistical corridors around Baidoa and other strategically important areas. This continuity matters to the argument of the El-Alamein declaration because the security of the Somali state cannot be separated from the actors that have actually maintained its territorial and institutional resilience. Political efforts in Mogadishu to limit or restructure Ethiopian participation therefore unfolded alongside the security responsibilities those forces continued to perform. The resulting tension illustrates the broader problem exposed by Ethiopia’s 5 October statement. Regional arrangements can formally invoke institutional unity and sovereignty, yet their effectiveness still depends on cooperation with Ethiopia where the security burden is greatest. The subsequent expansion of Egyptian participation within AUSSOM adds a further complication. Egypt brings military capacity and can contribute to Somalia’s security, but its strategic relationship with Mogadishu has developed alongside the Egypt-Ethiopia dispute over the Nile and wider competition over Ethiopia’s regional position. The arrival of another external military actor whose strategic interests intersect with Ethiopia’s introduces a broader geopolitical dimension into a theatre whose immediate security challenge remains Al-Shabaab. Ethiopia’s long operational presence, established intelligence relationships and direct security interests in Somalia give it a different strategic stake from states entering the theatre primarily through bilateral partnerships. The issue is therefore not whether Somalia should diversify its security partnerships. It is whether a regional framework built around Somali sovereignty and security can function coherently while politically marginalizing a neighbouring state that has repeatedly contributed forces, logistics and territorial knowledge to the preservation of that same sovereignty. Somalia’s signature at El-Alamein thus reinforces, rather than resolves, the contradiction identified by Ethiopia’s statement. Taken together, the El-Alamein declaration unites four states around the single objective of limiting Ethiopian influence while offering limited shared capacity for implementation. The signatories lack integrated economies, interoperable military forces, and internal stability sufficient to sustain the regional claims they advance. The practical challenges facing the Horn, including insurgency, maritime insecurity, and state fragility, require arrangements that incorporate the region’s largest demographic and economic actor. Frameworks organized solely around exclusion omit the geographic and commercial realities that determine security outcomes. By Bezawit Eshetu, Researcher, Horn Review

items.title: Safiirka Somaliland u fadhiya Israa’iil Ayaa sheegay
items.description: Safiirka Somaliland u fadhiya Israa’iil, Dr. Maxamed Xaaji, ayaa sheegay in kulamo siyaasadeed aysan go’aamin karin mustaqbalka Somaliland ama meesha ka saari karin taariikhdeeda, madaxbannaanideeda iyo rabitaanka shacabka. Dr. Maxamed Xaaji ayaa qoraal uu soo saaray ku sheegay in kulamada noocaas ahi ay sidoo kale saamayn ku yeelan karaan danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee dalalka muhiimka ah ee gobolka iyo kuwa Somaliland deriska la ah. Safiirka ayaa sidoo kale dhaliilay in maamulka Muqdisho loo adeegsado sidii wakiil siyaasadeed oo ka dhan ah Somaliland iyo dalal kale oo uu sheegay inay saaxiib la yihiin. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in tallaabadaas ayna shaqayn doonin, isagoo ku adkaystay in mustaqbalka Somaliland iyo rabitaanka shacabkeeda aan lagu go’aamin karin kulamo siyaasadeed.

items.title: Serious buildup of troops and hardware on the Ethiopia-Eritrea border.
items.description: Serious buildup of troops and hardware on the Ethiopia-Eritrea border. There have been sustained external pressure, principally the United States in the last 24 hours, to stop the almost inexorable slide toward full-blown war. The massing of large rival forces along a volatile border is always dangerous even when order for invasion not given. The risk of an accidental war – an escalated artillery duel quickly sparking bigger conflict – is significally elevated. There is also the fatal war calculations of the two sides. Both sides have an incentive for escalation – PM Abiy is under immense pressure from his core base to press his current advantage while his army has the initiative and the upper hand in the north to finish the ‘Eritrea problem’ once and for all. Asmara, fully supported and possibly instigated by Egypt, calculates Ethiopa is too weakened, battling large internal armed insurrections, fighting on multiple fronts, and lacking the strength to take on Eritrea. Moving against Addis now, with active support from TPLF factions, possibly with support from other rebel groups like Fano and OLA, is from Asmara’s perspective advantageous. Rashid Abdi

items.title: Ciidamo duulaan ah oo ka baxay Luuq iyo Dooow, kuna jeeda…
items.description: Beledxaawo (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya gobolka Gedo ayaa sheegaya in maanta xaalad kacsanaan ah laa dareemayo aagga degmada Beledxaawo ee gobolkaasi, kadib markii halkaas laga dareemay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo iska soo horjeedo. Guddoomiyaha degmada Beledxaawo Cabdicasiis Xareed Cabdullaahi oo shir jaraa’id u qabtay wariyeyaasha ayaa sheegay in xaalad cusub ay kasoo korortay degmada, ayna ka war heleen duulaan uu sheegay inay soo qaadeen ciidamo ay hoggaaminayaan saraakiil ka amar qaata Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Xareed ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in ciidamadaas oo duulaan ah ay kasoo baxeen magaalooyinka Luuq iyo Doolow, kuna soo wajahan yihiin degmada Beledxaawo, si ay beegsadaan xerayaha ciidamada ee ku yaalla halkaasi. “Waxaa jira oo cusub maanta ciidan niman saraakiil ah wataan oo ka yimid Doolow illaa Luuq oo duulaan ku ah bulshada Beledxaawo iyo xeryaha ciidamada, sababtana aan la garaneyn hadda kahorna aan ka hadalnay arrin noocaas oo kale inay suuragal tahay,” ayuu yiri Xareed. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in haatan colaad cusub laga dareemayo Beledxaawo, isaga oo arrintaas ku eedeeyay dowladda Soomaaliya oo weli khilaaf uu kala dhexeeyo Jubbaland. “Waxaan bulshada Beledxaawo u sheegeynaa in ay jirto colaad cusub oo ka timid Doolow iyo Luuq wadaan rag saraakiil ah oo ka amar qaadanayaa wasiirka amniga iyo rag kale, annaga oo horay uga dignay arrintaas,” ayuu mar kale yiri guddoomiyaha degmada Belexaawo. Waxaa kale uu intaas sii raaciyay “Colaad ma rabno nabad baa rabnaa in laba wiil oo dambe ay isku dhintaan ma rabno waxaana raggaas ugu baaqeynaa inay ka fogaadaan wax kasta oo suuragelinaya inay colaad mar labaad ka qaraxdo degmada Beledxaawo”. Xiisaddan cusub ayaa kusoo aaday, xilli dhawaan ay heshiis gaareen Cabdirashiid Janan oo la safnaa dowladda dhexe iyo Jubbaland, kadib wada-hadallo ay yeesheen labada dhinac. items.title: Dab qasaare gaystay oo saamayn ku yeeshay boqollaal qoys oo ku nool Hargaysa
items.description: (ERGO) –  Hoy la’aan ayay wajahayaan labo boqol soddon iyo siddeed qoys oo ku nool magaalada Hargeysa iyo deegaannada kale ee Somaliland. Waxay ku guryo beeleen dabab u kacay si kedis ah tan iyo bishii 7aad ee sanadkan. Waxaa ka mid ah qoyska Foosiya Cabdi Aadan oo ka kooban 10 qof, kuwaas hoy la’aan ah. Waxay xaaladdan galeen markii bishii Luulyo uu dab baabi’yay guri labo qol jiingad ah oo ay degganaayeen xaafadda Dhego-sayn ee magaalada Hargeysa. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inay waayeen dhaqaale ay dib ugu dhistaan, taas bidday inay marba qoys ku noqdaan dul-saar, maaddaama aysan haysan doorasho kale. “Wax mahaysataan iska ahay. Makhsin ayuu dabku ka kacay. Carruur yaryar baa huruday waan ka kiciyay. Carruurtii baan ka saaray markaa sidaas ayuu dabkaasi aan ula kulmay. Wax kama hadhin wixii hanti noo dhex-taalay halkaasay ku gubatay.” Foosiya waxay sheegtay in xilliga uu gurigu gubanayay ay ku maqneyd raadinta shaqo nadaafad ah si ay uga soo dhiciso biilka reerka. Nasiib darro, waxay ku soo beegan tahay gurigeedii oo holcaya. Foosiya ayaa sheegay inay xaaladdan ugu soo aaday xilli ninkeeda oo macallin dugsi ah uu shaqo la’aan yahay markii laga maarmay, taas oo keentay inay kiro iyo noloshii kale awoodi waayaan. Dhaqaale xumada iyo duruufaha kale ee awoodooda ka baxsan ayay tilmaamtay inay ku hoggaamiyeen inay ehelka u dan-sheegtaan. “Waxaan maanta i dhaahdo wax buuran baan meel ka sugaa wallaahi wuxuu ilaahay ii ogyahay mooyee ma jiro. Cuntada hooyaday baan ku tiirsanahay iyaduun baan ku cararaa.” Foosiya ayaa sheegtay in guriga ka gubtay ay u dhistay soddohdeed, markii ay awoodi waayeen inay iska bixiyaan kirada guryaha magaalada oo sanadihii danbe uu qiimahooda kordhayay. Waxay tilmaamtay inay gurigaas kaga baxday dhibaato ahayd in marba guri laga saaro, balse waxay mar kale wajahayaan hubanti la’aan dhanka hoyga ah. Foosiya gabbaad li’idda ku dhacday waxaa u raacda inaysan arrad-tir u gadan karin carruurteeda maaddaama dharkoodii uu ka mid noqday waxyaabihii gurigoodii uga dhex bas-beelay. “Jeebkaygii ma awoodo inaan maryo u iibiyo. Wixii aan wax gashaday dabkii buu iga raacay maanta laakiin walaahi halka iigu darani waa qaawanidaa awlaadaa yaryar uun haddana alxamdulilaah intaa hadduu odaygu noo camal helo waanu iska iibsan oo mar walba ilaahay baanu khayr ka rajaynaynaa.” Foosiya ayaa xustay in saddex ka mid ah carruurteeda oo kala jira 9, 13 iyo 16 oo kala dhiganayay fasallada 3aad, 4aad iyo shanaad ay ku dhacday waxbarasho la’aan. Waxay awoodi 18 doollar oo ay bishii ka dhiibaysay. Dababka ka kaca Somaliland ayaa sababay in qoysas badan ay waayaan hantidoodii iyo guryihii ay ku noolaayeen, taas oo keentay inay mutaan nolol adag. Dabka ayaa ka dhashay koronto sida Radio Ergo ka soo xigatay Ciidamada Dab damiska Somaliland. Xamda Xaashi Guuleed iyo qoyskeeda 13 ayaa ka mid ah qoysaskaas ka soo kaban la’ qasaaraha. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inuu dab baabi’iyay bishii sagaalaad ee sanadkan labo qol oo ay ku lahaayeen xaafadda Ugaaso ee magaalada Hargeysa. Xamda ayaa tilmaamtay inaysan keliya waayin guri balse ay maanta ka faro maran tahay wixii gogol, maacuun, sariiro iyo dhar ay haysteen, taas oo keentay inay saamaynta ku badato. “Hantidii aan ku waayay waxaan ku qiyaasi lahaa hanti badan, sariirtayda oo qudha ayaaba ahayd kun iyo shan boqol oo dollar. Dee carruurtaydii dirayskii baa kaga jirey wax badan baan ku waayay buugaagtoodii hawl badan ayaa iga soo gaadhay reer dab galay ma yara hawshoodu.” Xamda ayaa xustay in xilligii uu dabka ka kacay gurigeeda ay ilmo yar kula maqnayd madarasad, isla markii ay soo noqotayna ay aragtay iyadoo aysan wax uga cayman. Halka xubna kale ee qoyska ay reer qaraabo ah ku maqnaayeen. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inay hadda isku biirsadeen maaraynta nolosha oo ku adag iyo hoy la’aan. Saygeeda oo ka shaqayn jiray dhismaha guryaha magaalada ayay xustay inuusan shaqo hayn. Waxaa intaas u dheer inay hayso hooyadeed oo waayeel ah, isla markaana aan si buuxda wax u kala garanayn oo daryeel iyo ilaalin uga baahan maaddaama ay sheegtay inay iska baxayso. Xamda tilmaantay inay ku dedaasho sidii ay u heli lahayd daawooyinka ay u baahan tahay balse aysan dantu u saamixin. Marka ay waxba u wayso waxay caawin waydiisataa ehelkeeda. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inay xammili la’ yihiin hoy xumada iyo duruufaha ku xeeran oo aysan xilli maarayn u hayn. Haweeneydan ayaa ku taamaysay in lagu caawiyo sidii ay dib ugu dhisan lahayd hoygeedii. Cabdiqani Saleebaan Maxamed, oo ka mid ah shaqaalaha hay’adda Cadaalight kuna takhasusay arrimaha masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah, ayaa sheegay in waxyaabaha ugu badan ee sababa dababka ay ka mid yihiin dab qaybisooyinka la isticmaalo iyo fiilooyinka aan laga taxadarin dhaawaca soo gaara iyo tayadooda. “Waxyaabaha sababayaa waxa weeyaan hab nidaamyada, dagsiimada ama cufnaantooda way ka qayb qaadanaysaa. Waxaa kale oo sababaya dhismaha. Waxaa dhacda mararka qaar xadhig dhex roorkiisu aanuu qaadi karayn maayad laydh oo ku habboon ayaa dabeetana qofku soo iibsanayaa isaga oo aan hubin in shaygani u shaqaynaayo iyo inuu badbaado leeyahay. Cabdiqani ayaa sheegay in dababka noocan ah laga hortagi karo haddii bulshada la wacyigeliyo, isla markaana kor loo qaado fahamka iyo garaadka dadka ee ku aaddan khatarihiisa. Wuxuu bulshada ku baraarujiyay inay si gaar ah uga digtoonaadaan waxyaabaha sababi kara dabka, ayna qaataan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah ee looga badbaadi karo. Cabdiqani ayaa sheegay in waxyeellada dabka keliya aysan ku koobnayn inuu  guryo iyo hanti kale kale burburiyo, balse ay uu saamayn ku yeelan karo mustaqbalka qoysaska. Wuxuu soo jeediyay in taxaddarka iyo ka hortaggu ay yihiin tallaabooyinka ugu horreeyaa ee lagu yareyn karo khasaaraha. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in bulshada  looga baahan yahay inay si masuuliyad leh u isticmaalaan qalabka korontada. Waxaa muhiim ah in bulshada la baro aqoonta maaraynta dababka iyo in la helo iskaashi bulshada dhexdeeda ah si sanadkan kasta looga baaqsado qasaaraha dabka oo ku soo noqnoqda deegaannada Soomaalida. Foosiya ayaa sheegay inay xaaladdan ugu soo aaday xilli ninkeeda oo macallin dugsi ah uu shaqo la’aan yahay markii laga maarmay, taas oo keentay inay kiro iyo noloshii kale awoodi waayaan. Dhaqaale xumada iyo duruufaha kale ee awoodooda ka baxsan ayay tilmaamtay inay ku hoggaamiyeen inay ehelka u dan-sheegtaan. “Waxaan maanta i dhaahdo wax buuran baan meel ka sugaa wallaahi wuxuu ilaahay ii ogyahay mooyee ma jiro. Cuntada hooyaday baan ku tiirsanahay iyaduun baan ku cararaa.” Foosiya ayaa sheegtay in guriga ka gubtay ay u dhistay soddohdeed, markii ay awoodi waayeen inay iska bixiyaan kirada guryaha magaalada oo sanadihii danbe uu qiimahooda kordhayay. Waxay tilmaamtay inay gurigaas kaga baxday dhibaato ahayd in marba guri laga saaro, balse waxay mar kale wajahayaan hubanti la’aan dhanka hoyga ah. Foosiya gabbaad li’idda ku dhacday waxaa u raacda inaysan arrad-tir u gadan karin carruurteeda maaddaama dharkoodii uu ka mid noqday waxyaabihii gurigoodii uga dhex bas-beelay. “Jeebkaygii ma awoodo inaan maryo u iibiyo. Wixii aan wax gashaday dabkii buu iga raacay maanta laakiin walaahi halka iigu darani waa qaawanidaa awlaadaa yaryar uun haddana alxamdulilaah intaa hadduu odaygu noo camal helo waanu iska iibsan oo mar walba ilaahay baanu khayr ka rajaynaynaa.” Foosiya ayaa xustay in saddex ka mid ah carruurteeda oo kala jira 9, 13 iyo 16 oo kala dhiganayay fasallada 3aad, 4aad iyo shanaad ay ku dhacday waxbarasho la’aan. Waxay awoodi 18 doollar oo ay bishii ka dhiibaysay. Dababka ka kaca Somaliland ayaa sababay in qoysas badan ay waayaan hantidoodii iyo guryihii ay ku noolaayeen, taas oo keentay inay mutaan nolol adag. Dabka ayaa ka dhashay koronto sida Radio Ergo ka soo xigatay Ciidamada Dab damiska Somaliland. Xamda Xaashi Guuleed iyo qoyskeeda 13 ayaa ka mid ah qoysaskaas ka soo kaban la’ qasaaraha. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inuu dab baabi’iyay bishii sagaalaad ee sanadkan labo qol oo ay ku lahaayeen xaafadda Ugaaso ee magaalada Hargeysa. Xamda ayaa tilmaamtay inaysan keliya waayin guri balse ay maanta ka faro maran tahay wixii gogol, maacuun, sariiro iyo dhar ay haysteen, taas oo keentay inay saamaynta ku badato. “Hantidii aan ku waayay waxaan ku qiyaasi lahaa hanti badan, sariirtayda oo qudha ayaaba ahayd kun iyo shan boqol oo dollar. Dee carruurtaydii dirayskii baa kaga jirey wax badan baan ku waayay buugaagtoodii hawl badan ayaa iga soo gaadhay reer dab galay ma yara hawshoodu.” Xamda ayaa xustay in xilligii uu dabka ka kacay gurigeeda ay ilmo yar kula maqnayd madarasad, isla markii ay soo noqotayna ay aragtay iyadoo aysan wax uga cayman. Halka xubna kale ee qoyska ay reer qaraabo ah ku maqnaayeen. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inay hadda isku biirsadeen maaraynta nolosha oo ku adag iyo hoy la’aan. Saygeeda oo ka shaqayn jiray dhismaha guryaha magaalada ayay xustay inuusan shaqo hayn. Waxaa intaas u dheer inay hayso hooyadeed oo waayeel ah, isla markaana aan si buuxda wax u kala garanayn oo daryeel iyo ilaalin uga baahan maaddaama ay sheegtay inay iska baxayso. Xamda tilmaantay inay ku dedaasho sidii ay u heli lahayd daawooyinka ay u baahan tahay balse aysan dantu u saamixin. Marka ay waxba u wayso waxay caawin waydiisataa ehelkeeda. Haweeneydan ayaa sheegtay inay xammili la’ yihiin hoy xumada iyo duruufaha ku xeeran oo aysan xilli maarayn u hayn. Haweeneydan ayaa ku taamaysay in lagu caawiyo sidii ay dib ugu dhisan lahayd hoygeedii. Cabdiqani Saleebaan Maxamed, oo ka mid ah shaqaalaha hay’adda Cadaalight kuna takhasusay arrimaha masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah, ayaa sheegay in waxyaabaha ugu badan ee sababa dababka ay ka mid yihiin dab qaybisooyinka la isticmaalo iyo fiilooyinka aan laga taxadarin dhaawaca soo gaara iyo tayadooda. “Waxyaabaha sababayaa waxa weeyaan hab nidaamyada, dagsiimada ama cufnaantooda way ka qayb qaadanaysaa. Waxaa kale oo sababaya dhismaha. Waxaa dhacda mararka qaar xadhig dhex roorkiisu aanuu qaadi karayn maayad laydh oo ku habboon ayaa dabeetana qofku soo iibsanayaa isaga oo aan hubin in shaygani u shaqaynaayo iyo inuu badbaado leeyahay. Cabdiqani ayaa sheegay in dababka noocan ah laga hortagi karo haddii bulshada la wacyigeliyo, isla markaana kor loo qaado fahamka iyo garaadka dadka ee ku aaddan khatarihiisa. Wuxuu bulshada ku baraarujiyay inay si gaar ah uga digtoonaadaan waxyaabaha sababi kara dabka, ayna qaataan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah ee looga badbaadi karo. Cabdiqani ayaa sheegay in waxyeellada dabka keliya aysan ku koobnayn inuu  guryo iyo hanti kale kale burburiyo, balse ay uu saamayn ku yeelan karo mustaqbalka qoysaska. Wuxuu soo jeediyay in taxaddarka iyo ka hortaggu ay yihiin tallaabooyinka ugu horreeyaa ee lagu yareyn karo khasaaraha. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in bulshada  looga baahan yahay inay si masuuliyad leh u isticmaalaan qalabka korontada. Waxaa muhiim ah in bulshada la baro aqoonta maaraynta dababka iyo in la helo iskaashi bulshada dhexdeeda ah si sanadkan kasta looga baaqsado qasaaraha dabka oo ku soo noqnoqda deegaannada Soomaalida. items.title: Maxaa ka jira in maalmo kadib la xirayo garoonka Muqdisho?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed oo war-saxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa ka hadashay wararka sheegaya in maalmaha soo socda la xiri doono garoonka diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde, kadib markii arrintaas si weyn loogu faafiyay baraha bulshada. Hay’adda ayaa marka hore shacabka Soomaaliyeed la wadaagtay in aysan waxba iska beddelin shaqada garoonka, isla markaana ay sidii caadiga ahayd u socdaan duulimaadyada gudaha iyo kuwa caalamiga ah ee garoonka diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde. Sidoo kale, hay’addu waxay beenisay wararka la faafiyay ee ku aaddan in maalmaha soo socda la xirayo garoonka Muqdisho, iyadoo wararkaas ku tilmaantay kuwo aan waxba ka jirin, sida lagu caddeeyay bayaanka. “Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed (SCAA) waxay shacabka Soomaaliyeed la wadaageysaa inaysan waxba iska bedelin howlaha Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Aadan Cadde, ayna duulimaadyadii imaan jiray garoonka ay sidoodii u shaqeynayaan. Hay’addu waxay si cad u beenisay wararka dhoowaan la faafiyay ee sheegayay in garoonka la xirayo maalmaha soo socda,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka kasoo baxay Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka. Dhanka kale, Hay’adda ayaa farriin u dirtay guud ahaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed, waxayna ugu baaqday in xogta rasmiga ah ay kala socdaan bogga rasmiga ah ee Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka. “Shacabka waxaa lagu boorrinayaa inay xogta saxda ah ee ku saabsan duulimaadyada iyo howlaha garoomada dalka ka helaan oo keliya baraha rasmiga ah ee HDRS,” ayaa la raaciyay. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Wararka la xiriira xaaladda garoonka Aadan Cadde ayaa si weyn ugu fiday baraha bulshada, taas oo keentay walaac iyo hadal-heyn ku saabsan shaqada garoonka iyo suurtagalnimada in la xiro maalmaha soo socda, balse waxaa arrintaas meesha ka saartay Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed. Garoonka diyaaradaha magaalada Muqdisho ayaa ah garoonka ugu weyn ee Soomaaliya, waxaana si joogto ah uga howlgala diyaarado isaga kala goosha magaalada Muqdisho iyo magaalooyin gudaha dalka ah, iyadoo sidoo kale ay yimaadaan duulimaadyo caalami ah. items.title: Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan oo soo saaray mowqif adag oo ka dhan ah Somaliland
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan ayaa Axaddii si wadajir ah Soomaaliya ugula saftey mowqif ka dhan ah aqoonsi ama taageero loo fidiyo maamulka Somaliland, kadib shir afar geesood ah oo ka dhacay magaalada New Alamein ee dalka Masar. Mowqifkan ayaa lagu caddeeyey bayaanka wadajirka ah ee El Alamein, kaas oo kasoo baxay kulankii ay yeesheen madaxweynaha Masar Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki iyo hoggaamiyaha Sudan Abdel Fattah al-Burhan. Afarta hoggaamiye ayaa mar kale taageeray midnimada, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, iyagoo si gaar ah uga horyimid tallaabo kasta oo lagu aqoonsanayo ama lagu taageerayo Somaliland. Bayaanka ayaa si cad loogu yiri hoggaamiyeyaashu waxay isku raaceen “in la diido aqoonsi kasta ama taageero kasta oo loo fidiyo waxa loogu yeero ‘Somaliland’” , iyagoo sheegay in tallaabooyinka noocaas ah ay xadgudub ku yihiin madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Qodobkan ayaa ka sii ballaaran diidmada aqoonsiga diblomaasiyadeed oo keliya, maadaama uu sidoo kale si cad uga horyimid taageero kasta oo dibadeed oo loo fidiyo Somaliland. Somaliland ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay ka go’day Soomaaliya sanadkii 1991, balse muddo ka badan 35 sano ma aysan helin aqoonsi caalami ah. Israel ayaa 26-kii December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland, waxaana tan iyo markaas sii xoogeysanayey xiriirka labada dhinac. Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi ayaa bishii June booqasho rasmi ah ku tagay Israel, halkaas oo lagu qaabilay baarlamaanka Knesset, xilli Hargeysa ay sidoo kale safaarad ka furtay Jerusalem. Bayaanka El Alamein ayaa hadda Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan si rasmi ah ugu daraya dalalka gobolka ee si cad uga soo horjeeda in Somaliland loo aqoonsado dal madax-bannaan ama taageero gaar ah loo fidiyo. Taageerada amniga Soomaaliya Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale taageero loogu muujiyey dadaallada Soomaaliya ee la dagaallanka argagixisada iyo xoojinta hay’adaha dowladda. Afarta hoggaamiye ayaa beesha caalamka iyo saaxiibada gobolka ugu baaqay inay bixiyaan “maalgelin ku filan, joogto ah oo la saadaalin karo” oo loogu talagalay howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Bayaanka ayaa sheegay in maalgelintaasi muhiim u tahay sidii Soomaaliya loogu wareejin lahaa mas’uuliyadda amniga, iyadoo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si tartiib ah ula wareegayaan howlaha ay hadda qabtaan ciidamada Midowga Afrika. Maalgelinta AUSSOM ayaa muddooyinkii dambe ahayd mid ka mid ah caqabadaha ugu waaweyn ee horyaalla dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika. Badda Cas iyo Niilka Afarta dal ayaa sidoo kale mowqif wadajir ah ka qaatay arrimaha Badda Cas, iyagoo sheegay in maamulka iyo mas’uuliyadda marin-biyoodkaasi ay tahay “mas’uuliyad gaar ah oo u taal dalalka xeebaha ku leh Badda Cas.” Waxay sidoo kale adkeeyeen muhiimadda xorriyadda maraakiibta iyo isu socodka ganacsiga ee Badda Cas, oo ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan dunida. Arrimaha webiga Niilka, hoggaamiyeyaashu waxay ku adkeysteen mabda’a ah inaan waxyeello loo geysan dalalka kale, isla markaana arrimaha biyaha xuduudaha isaga gudba lagu maareeyo ogeysiis hore, wadatashi iyo heshiis wadajir ah. Waxay si cad u diideen tallaabooyin hal dhinac ah oo wax u dhimaya isticmaalka biyaha ee Masar iyo Sudan. Inkastoo Itoobiya aan si toos ah loogu magacaabin qodobkan, haddana Masar iyo Sudan ayaa muddo dheer khilaaf kala dhexeeyey Addis Ababa oo ku saabsan biyo-xireenka Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam. Dhanka Sudan, hoggaamiyeyaashu waxay taageereen midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalkaas, iyagoo sidoo kale diiday dhismaha hay’ado ama maamullo barbar socda dowladda. Waxay ku baaqeen geeddi-socod siyaasadeed oo ay Sudan leedahay, ayna hoggaaminayaan dadka reer Sudan, iyagoo sidoo kale ka digay taageerada calooshood u shaqeystayaasha ku lug leh dagaalka dalkaas. Masar, Soomaaliya, Eritrea iyo Sudan ayaa ugu dambeyn isku raacay in la sameeyo hannaan lagula socdo fulinta qodobada lagu heshiiyey, isla markaana kulamada afarta dhinac ah la joogteeyo marka loo baahdo. items.title: Dowladda Yemen oo xuutiyiinta ku qaadday weerarro tiro badan
items.description: Afhayeen u hadlay ciidamada dowladda Yemen ayaa sheegay in ay qaadeen 1,122 weerar oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday fariisimo ay leeyihiin Xuutiyiinta, oo ay ku jiraan goobo madaafiic, gantaallo iyo xarumo talis. Majid Cabdullaahi Nazili ayaa qoraal uu ku daabacay barta X ku sheegay in weerarrada loo adeegsaday diyaarado dagaal, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, gantaallo, madaafiic iyo hoobiyaal. Wuxuu sheegay in weerarradu ka dhaceen gobollada Saada, Al-Jawf iyo Tacis, iyo sidoo kale deegaannada xeebaha Yemen. items.title: Ku dhowaad 2,800 qof oo hal Maalin gudaheed uga Barakacay Gobalka Blue Nile ee Suudaan
items.description: Ku dhowaad 2,800 qof ayaa hal maalin gudaheed ka barakacay 10 tuulo oo ku yaalla gobolka Blue Nile ee koonfur-bari Suudaan, kaddib markii ay sii xumaadeen xaaladaha amni ee deegaanka. Sida ay sheegtay Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Socdaalka (IOM), dadkaasi waxay ka carareen deegaannadooda, iyadoo amni-darrada sii kordheysa ay ku qasabtay qoysas badan inay raadsadaan goobo ay ku helaan badbaado. Barakaca cusub ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Suudaan uu weli wajahayo xaalad bani’aadannimo oo aad u adag, iyadoo colaadaha iyo amni-darradu ay sababeen in malaayiin qof ay ka qaxaan guryahooda. Gobolka Blue Nile ayaa ka mid ah deegaannada ay saameeyeen colaadaha iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada amni, waxaana barakaca cusub uu kordhin karaa baahida loo qabo gargaar bani’aadannimo, hoy iyo adeegyo aasaasi ah. IOM ayaa sheegtay in xaaladda amni ee sii xumaanaysa ay sababtay barakacan degdegga ah, iyadoo aan weli la ogeyn muddada ay dadkaasi ku maqnaan doonaan deegaannadooda. Mas’uuliyiinta iyo hay’adaha gargaarka ayaa wajahaya caqabado sii kordhaya oo ku saabsan sidii loo gaarsiin lahaa dadka barakacay adeegyada iyo taageerada ay u baahan yihiin.

items.title: R/W Xamza oo ka degay degmo ka tirsan Galmudug + ujeedka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa goordhow gaaray degmada Balanballe ee gobolka Galgaduud ee bartamaha Soomaaliya, halkaas oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay. Xamza ayaa waxaa garoonka diyaaradaha Balanballe kusoo dhaweeyay Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoor Qoor), Taliyaha Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka ee NISA Mahad Maxamed Salaad iyo mas’uuliyiin kale. Ujeedka Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza ayaa ah inuu ka qayb-galo gogol nabadeed oo taalla Balanballe, taas oo lagu soo afjarayo colaad beeleed muddo ka taagneyd degmadaasi. Ra’iisul wasaaraha waxaa kaga sii horreeyay Balanballe mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda dhexe oo uu ugu horreeyo Taliye Mahad Salaad oo shalay booqday ciidamo ka tirsan NISA oo uu tababar uga socdo halkaasi, isagoo inta uu kormeerka ku jiray la kulmay ciidamada tababarka qaadanaya, wuxuuna kula dardaarmay inay ka dhabeeyaan ballanta ay u qaadeen difaaca dalka, dadka iyo diinta. Dhanka kale waxaa kulanka dib u heshiisiinta ah la filayaa inay ka qayb-galaan bulshada deegaanka oo ay ugu horreeyaan waxgaradka beelaha, si ay goobjoog ahaadaan heshiiska lagu gaarayo halkaasi. Horay dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa go’aanno adag uga soo saartay colaadihii ka taagnaa gobollada dhexe, kadib markii uu amarro la siiyay ciidamada dowladda ee ku sugan halkaasi, kuwaas oo ka hortegoay dagaal beeleedyada iyo dilalka la xiriira aanooyinka qabiil ee deegaanada Galmudug. Xaaladda guud ayaa hadda ah mid deggan, waxaana haatan qorshaha uu yahay in la guda galo dib-u-heshiisiin dhab ah oo lagu soo afjarayo colaadaha ka taagan gobollada dhexe. items.title: Ururka Bisha Cas ee Soomaaliya iyo ICRC oo u Diyaar garoobaya Fatahaadaha El Niño
items.description: Ururka Bisha Cas ee Soomaaliyeed (SRCS), oo taageero ka helaya Guddiga Caalamiga ah ee Laanqayrta Cas (ICRC), ayaa bilaabay diyaar-garow iyo tababarro loogu talagalay ka jawaabidda fatahaadaha laga cabsi qabo inay ka dhacaan Soomaaliya xilliga xaaladaha cimilada ee El Niño. Diyaargarowgan ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray webiyada Jubba iyo Shabeelle, oo ka mid ah goobaha ay fatahaaduhu si joogto ah uga dhacaan xilliyada roobabka. SRCS ayaa tababarka ku diyaarisay 72 qof, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan 60 mutadawiciin ah oo ka kala socda bulshada deegaanka. Tababarrada waxaa lagu qabtay qaar ka mid ah deegaannada inta badan ay fatahaaduhu saameeyaan, oo ay ka mid yihiin Baardheere, Jowhar, Beledweyne iyo Kismaayo. Tababarka ayaa isugu jiray casharro aragti ah iyo tababarro la xiriira hawlgalka doomaha, si mutadawiciintu u helaan xirfadaha looga baahan yahay gurmadka degdegga ah. Intii tababarku ka socday magaalada Jowhar iyo hareeraha Webiga Shabeelle, ka-qaybgalayaashu waxay barteen farsamooyin ay ka mid yihiin wadista doomaha, jeereysiinta iyo dib-u-wadista doonta si xakameysan. Waxaa sidoo kale la baray hababka isgaarsiinta ee loo isticmaalo xaaladaha ay matoorrada doomuhu sameynayaan sawaxan, iyadoo xoogga la saaray adeegsiga calaamadaha gacmaha. Tababarka ayaa sidoo kale lagu baray ka-qaybgalayaasha sida matoorka doonta si sax ah loogu rakibo, hubinta badqabka ka hor inta aan doonta la dhaqaaqin iyo diyaarinta shaqaalaha iyo qalabka gurmadka. Mid ka mid ah casharrada muhiimka ah ayaa ahaa adeegsiga xarigga badbaadada ee matoorka, kaas oo xaalad degdeg ah lagu jiidi karo si matoorka si dhaqso ah loo damiyo, taasoo muhiim u ah badbaadada shaqaalaha iyo dadka gurmadka u baahan. SRCS ayaa sheegtay in tababarradan ay qayb ka yihiin dadaallada lagu xoojinayo awoodda gurmadka fatahaadaha, gaar ahaan maadaama fatahaado hore oo Soomaaliya ka dhacay ay muujiyeen muhiimadda ay leeyihiin kooxaha doomaha iyo mutadawiciinta deegaanka. Sanadkii 2023, kooxaha doomaha ee Bisha Cas ayaa door ka qaatay hawlgallada badbaadinta dadka ay fatahaaduhu saameeyeen, waxaana hadda la doonayaa in khibradahaas lagu sii xoojiyo tababarrada iyo diyaar-garowga cusub. Guud ahaan, 72-ka qof ee tababarka qaatay ayaa la diyaariyey, halka SRCS ay haysato sagaal doon oo lagu kala meeleeyay goobaha ay fatahaaduhu inta badan ka dhacaan. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa loogu talagalay in bulshada si degdeg ah loogu gurmado haddii fatahaado ka dhashaan xaaladaha El Niño iyo roobabka xiga. Diyaargarowga Bisha Cas iyo ICRC ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahdo khataro la xiriira fatahaado, abaaro iyo xaalado cimilo oo isbedbedelaya, taasoo sare u qaadaysa baahida loo qabo in hay’adaha gurmadka ay hore ugu sii diyaar garoobaan xaaladaha degdegga ah.

items.title: Somalia’s Parliament Kills the Merit Hiring Plan: An Analytical Perspective
items.description: By Farah Mire Somalia’s parliament has struck down one of the government’s key reforms. On Wednesday, 23 September, the House of the People voted to cancel Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre’s order requiring open competition for director posts across government. The vote wasn’t close. 136 MPs backed the annulment. Only two voted against it. Two more abstained. Deputy Speaker Abdullahi Omar Abshir chaired the session and announced the result. About 30 lawmakers had pushed for the debate in the first place. Their motion made it onto the agenda after hours of argument over what changing the system might mean for Somalia’s civil service law. The directive at the center of this fight was only six days old. Barre issued it on 17 September. It told the Civil Service Commission to start grading department directors on competence, knowledge, experience, leadership and performance — the first phase beginning 20 September. Barre grounded the order in Article 161(1) of the Constitution and Article 7 of the Civil Service Law. He called directors general the backbone of the state. Build a professional, permanent leadership layer, he said, and government policy actually gets implemented. Two days after the PM’s order, the National Civil Service Commission followed up with its own directive — reference XGG/NCSC/1488/09/2026, sent to every ministry and agency, copied to the Prime Minister’s office. It laid out three rules. Fill director general posts through internal merit-based competition first, giving current qualified staff priority. Fill future vacancies through open competition, open to any qualified Somali. And the Commission itself would set the timetable and conditions. Ministries were told to freeze any appointments that might disrupt the process. Pay had to keep flowing. And — a detail easy to miss — the directive specifically told agencies to prioritize and encourage qualified women to apply. Then parliament stepped in. The House Committee on Social Services Development, led by MP Nadra Salah Abdi, had already challenged the directive before the vote. Some lawmakers argued it threatened people currently holding director jobs — that competence testing could simply push sitting officials out. After the vote, the Deputy Speaker sent the matter back to the federal government. The Civil Service Commission, for its part, came out publicly defending merit-based hiring anyway. Step back, and this fight sits inside a much bigger story. In December 2023, Somalia hit the Completion Point under the IMF and World Bank’s HIPC debt relief programme. External debt fell from $5.3 billion — 64 percent of GDP — down to $0.6 billion, less than 6 percent of GDP. That wasn’t charity. It came with strings attached: An Extended Credit Facility arrangement running from December 2023 to December 2026, built on reforms to tax policy, debt management, PPP legislation, central bank operations, and — this is the part that matters here — payroll integration. Most of those benchmarks are met or on track, according to a Central Bank of Somalia policy brief. But the brief also names eight fault lines still threatening the country’s fiscal footing: weak revenue collection, bloated recurrent spending, heavy aid dependence, thin debt-management capacity, and more. The wage bill tells the story on its own. It climbed from 1.29 percent of GDP in 2013 to almost 6 percent by 2021, according to the World Bank. In that same year, wages alone ate up 53 percent of everything the Federal Government spent — a figure the Bank says puts Somalia in the same bracket as other fragile, conflict-affected states, where personnel costs routinely crowd out nearly everything else. Temporary workers sit at the center of this problem, and here, at least, there’s a genuine success story. The Finance Ministry’s own review, published in March 2026, found that non-formal wages — money paid to staff outside the official payroll system — dropped from 36.3 percent of total compensation in 2021 to just 0.03 percent by the end of 2025. The original target was full payroll integration by the end of 2024. It arrived a year late, but it arrived. That’s real progress, and it’s worth saying so plainly. Recruitment itself is the piece still stuck. A 2024 Heritage Institute report on the civil service didn’t mince words: hiring has run for years on nepotism, favouritism, clan affiliation and political patronage. Its fix was straightforward — move qualified temporary staff into permanent roles based on merit, not connections. Separately, an audit of 6,448 positions found 1,626 of them belonged to “ghost employees” — people drawing salaries for jobs that, in practice, don’t exist. Somalia’s Finance Minister puts the total civil service headcount somewhere between 10,000 and 11,000, and says the government is actively working to stop it from growing further. So why did this particular reform collapse so fast? Look at how it was built. The procedure behind it — the Habraaca Hirgelinta Hannaanka Tartanka Furan — was never meant to go through parliament at all. Its Article 15 let it take effect by executive decree: Cabinet approval, the PM’s signature, publication in the gazette. Nothing more. That’s a deliberate design choice. It’s also a fragile one. A rule that skips parliamentary approval can’t be repealed by parliament either — but parliament can still gut the decisions that come out of it, which is exactly what happened here. The exam requirement specifically, sitting in Article 4 and Article 10 of the procedure, is now dead in practice, even if the underlying document technically still exists. What comes next isn’t clear yet. If parliament can strike down this decision, nothing obviously stops it from unwinding the rest of the framework too. And that raises the real question hanging over Somali governance: does hiring go back to competence, or back to clan and connections? The IMF’s benchmarks stay on paper regardless. So does the World Bank’s praise for retention gains. But the actual distribution of power inside Somalia’s civil service — who gets which post, and why — is still being fought over, not settled. This week’s vote didn’t answer that question. It just made clear how far Somalia still is from answering it. items.title: Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan oo Riyadh kaga wada hadlaya xoojinta heshiiska difaaca
items.description: Guddiga heshiiska difaaca ee Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan ayaa maanta oo Isniin ah kulan ku yeelanaya magaalada Riyadh, iyadoo mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka kala socda saddexda dal ay ka qeybgalayaan. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Turkiga ayaa sheegtay in kulanka looga hadli doono xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee gobolka , iyo heerka uu marayo dadaalka lagu dhisayo, laguna xoojinayo qaab-dhismeedka hay’adaha ee isbahaysiga saddexda dal. Kulanka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xaaladda amni ee gobolka ay sii xasaasiyeynayso, gaar ahaan dagaalka Yemen iyo howlgallada militari ee ka dhanka ah kooxda Xuutiyiinta. Sida ay Reuters werisay, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga Hakan Fidan , Wasiirka Difaaca Yasar Guler iyo Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidamada Turkiga, General Selcuk Bayraktaroglu , ayaa ka qeybgalaya shirka, iyadoo sidoo kale ay joogaan mas’uuliyiin ka socda Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu wadaa in lagu falanqeeyo soo jeedin la xiriirta in Xuutiyiinta Yemen lala yeesho wada-hadallo siyaasadeed, ayadoo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Pakistan uu hore u sheegay in Iran ay soo jeedisay in si siyaasadeed loola macaamilo Xuutiyiinta kaddib weerarradii ay geysteen. Dhinaca kale, hoggaamiyaha dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudigu taageero ayaa ku dhawaaqay bilowga howlgal militari oo ballaaran oo lagu doonayo in dib loogu qabsado dhul ay Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku hayaan. Heshiiskan saddex geesoodka ah ayaa muhiimad gaar ah yeelanaya xilli Turkiga, Sacuudiga iyo Pakistan ay doonayaan inay xoojiyaan iskaashigooda dhinacyada difaaca, amniga iyo siyaasadda , iyadoo xaaladda Bariga Dhexe iyo gaar ahaan Yemen ay weli tahay arrin si dhow loola socdo.

items.title: Turkey’s Growing Military Role Raises Alarm, Prompting Somaliland to Seek Israeli Air Defences
items.description: Hargeisa’s Wake-Up Call: Baidoa Fighting Raises Fears That Turkish Military Power Could Become Entangled in Somalia’s Political Conflicts HARGEISA (WDN) — For Somaliland, the lesson from Baidoa is no longer theoretical. As Turkish F-16s, drones and other military capabilities have become increasingly visible in Somalia, the violent confrontation surrounding Baidoa has given Hargeisa a powerful reason to reconsider its own air-defence needs and to look toward Israel for protection against a changing regional military balance. The warning from Hargeisa is becoming increasingly direct. Mohamed Osman Fadal, a senior foreign-affairs adviser to Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi, told Middle East Eye that Somaliland wants Israeli air-defence systems because of Türkiye’s expanding military presence in Somalia. “We need air defence systems,” Fadal said, specifically citing Turkish F-16s in Mogadishu and Ankara’s growing drone capabilities. “We want Israel to support us against Turkey.” The statement does not establish that Israel has agreed to provide such systems. Nor does it demonstrate that Türkiye intends to attack Somaliland. But it reveals a significant change in how Somaliland officials are assessing the regional security environment. And that change has been shaped by what has happened in Baidoa. Baidoa Changed the Calculation Türkiye says its military partnership with Somalia is designed to strengthen Somali security institutions and fight terrorism. Ankara has repeatedly denied allegations that its forces are being used to influence Somalia’s internal political struggles. But the political controversy surrounding Türkiye’s military role has intensified as Somalia’s federal crisis has turned violent. In and around Baidoa, Turkish aircraft and drones have been reported during periods of intense fighting involving federal forces and forces aligned with former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. Laftagareen-aligned authorities have accused Türkiye of conducting F-16 strikes against their forces. Those allegations have not been independently verified, and Turkish authorities have not publicly accepted responsibility for the alleged attacks. Nevertheless, the controversy itself matters. For observers in Hargeisa, the question is no longer simply how many Turkish weapons or aircraft Somalia possesses. It is how those capabilities might be used if Somalia’s political disputes become military confrontations. That is the wake-up call Somaliland appears to have taken from Baidoa. From Counterterrorism to Political Risk Türkiye’s defence relationship with Somalia is substantial. The two countries signed a ten-year defence and economic cooperation framework in 2024 under which Türkiye committed to building, training and equipping the Somali navy. Türkiye has also maintained a major military training presence in Mogadishu, while its parliamentary authorization for military deployment in Somalia has been extended through July 2028. The deployment has now expanded to include advanced aircraft. Three Turkish F-16s have been publicly seen operating in Somalia, while Turkish helicopters , drones and other military assets have also been deployed. Reporting has increasingly linked Turkish aircraft to security operations in Somalia, although the circumstances and targets of particular air operations remain disputed. For Türkiye, these capabilities are part of its defence partnership with Mogadishu. For Somaliland, however, they represent a potential strategic vulnerability. Critics argue, if Turkish military assets are used or are perceived to be used in Somalia’s internal political conflicts, Hargeisa has reason to ask what safeguards exist to prevent the same capabilities from eventually becoming relevant to a confrontation involving Somaliland. A Growing Political Backlash The controversy is also beginning to affect Türkiye’s wider political standing among Somalis. There is no reliable nationwide polling establishing that a majority of Somalis now oppose Türkiye.  But criticism of Ankara’s role has become increasingly visible among opposition politicians, former officials and commentators who argue that Türkiye’s close relationship with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud makes it difficult for Ankara to be viewed as a neutral actor in Somalia’s political disputes. That perception has become particularly important because Türkiye has simultaneously presented itself as a diplomatic partner capable of facilitating dialogue among Somali political actors. The contradiction is increasingly obvious to Türkiye’s critics: a country perceived by some political actors as closely aligned with the federal government may find it difficult to convince those same actors that it can serve as an impartial mediator. Türkiye rejects that characterization, saying its military presence is focused on counterterrorism, strengthening Somali institutions and respecting Somalia’s political process. But perceptions can have consequences even when allegations remain unproven. Could a Future Government Reconsider the Relationship? The political debate raises another question that is attracting increasing attention in Somalia: what happens to the Turkish partnership if a future federal government takes a different view of Ankara’s role? Some opposition figures and political commentators have argued that Somalia’s next government could review existing defence and security arrangements with Türkiye if Ankara is perceived to have abandoned neutrality in domestic political disputes. That is a political expectation, not an established government policy. The current defence framework remains in force, and Somalia continues to describe Türkiye as an important strategic security partner. But the Baidoa crisis has introduced a new variable. Military cooperation that is broadly welcomed when directed against Al-Shabaab can become politically contentious if the same military capabilities are perceived as being deployed during disputes between Somali political factions. That distinction could become increasingly important as Somalia approaches another political transition. Why Somaliland Is Looking to Israel This is the strategic calculation behind Hargeisa’s request. Somaliland has watched Türkiye build a sophisticated military relationship with Mogadishu while its own relationship with Israel has developed rapidly following Israel’s recognition of Somaliland in December 2025. Israel has already begun security cooperation with Somaliland. Somaliland Defence Minister Mohamed Yusuf Ali previously confirmed that Israel was providing training to Somaliland police and military personnel, while saying there were no discussions or plans for an Israeli military base. The request for air-defence systems would take that relationship into a considerably more sensitive area. For Somaliland, Israeli technology could provide a potential defensive counterweight to the growing military capabilities associated with Mogadishu. For Israel, however, supplying advanced air-defence systems would be a major strategic decision with implications for its relationship with Türkiye, Somalia and other regional actors. A New Security Equation in the Horn The emerging regional picture is striking. Türkiye has established a deep military relationship with Mogadishu. Israel has established diplomatic relations with Hargeisa and begun security cooperation. Somaliland is now publicly asking Israel for air-defence capabilities. Meanwhile, Somalia’s unresolved political divisions have demonstrated in Baidoa how quickly political disputes can become armed confrontations. The danger is not that a Turkish-Somaliland military confrontation is inevitable. There is no established evidence that Türkiye is preparing to attack Somaliland. The danger is that the expansion of foreign military capabilities could become entangled with Somalia’s unresolved political disputes, creating perceptions of threat even where governments insist that their objectives are defensive or counterterrorism-related. For Somaliland, Baidoa appears to have provided the clearest warning yet. Hargeisa is looking at what happened when advanced military capabilities entered a deeply divided Somali political environment—and it does not want to wait until a crisis reaches its own doorstep before developing an air-defence strategy. That is why the Israeli request matters. It is not simply about buying weapons. It is about Somaliland’s attempt to ensure that the rapidly changing military balance around Somalia does not leave it without options. And it raises a much larger question for Somalia’s next political chapter: can foreign military partnerships remain credible as neutral security arrangements when Somalia’s political actors increasingly disagree over who controls the state, its forces and its territory? For Türkiye, the answer will depend not only on what Ankara says about neutrality, but on how its military partnership is perceived by the Somali political actors who may govern the country in the future. For Somaliland, the lesson from Baidoa is already clear: air power changes political calculations—and Hargeisa does not intend to ignore the warning. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudiga oo ka wada hadlay Xoojinta Xariirka iyo Amniga Badda Cas
items.description: Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cali Maxamed Cumar , ayaa kulan la yeeshay Safiirka Boqortooyada Sacuudiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Axmed Maxamed Al-Mould , kaas oo ka dhacay xarunta Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Muqdisho. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sidii loo xoojin lahaa xariirka taariikhiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Sacuudiga , iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen fursadaha lagu horumarin karo iskaashiga labada dal. Wada-hadallada ayaa si gaar ah loogu eegay dhinacyada ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga , iyadoo la adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la kordhiyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee labada dal iyo in la abuuro fursado cusub oo maalgashi. Sidoo kale, Wasiiru-dowlaha iyo Safiirka Sacuudiga ayaa ka wada hadlay amniga Badda Cas , oo ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka gobolka iyo caalamkaba. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu sii xoojinayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, iyadoo labada dal ay leeyihiin xiriir muddo dheer soo jiray oo ku saleysan iskaashi iyo dano wadaag.

items.title: Hiiraan Community Power Struggle Threatens to Deepen Hirshabelle Crisis
items.description: Hawadle Demand for Hirshabelle Presidency Collides With Hassan Sheikh’s Backing of Abgaal President Ali Guudlaawe BELEDWEYNE (WDN) — The crisis in Hirshabelle is increasingly becoming a struggle over political power, with the Hawadle community demanding the presidency of the regional state while President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has backed incumbent President Ali Abdullahi Hussein Guudlaawe, an Abgaal politician, for another term. The dispute has gone far beyond an ordinary election contest. Hawadle political leaders and elders say they were led to expect that the presidency would return to their community under an informal power-sharing understanding, but President Hassan Sheikh ultimately supported Guudlaawe instead. Hirshabelle Vice President Yusuf Hagar Dabageed has publicly accused the president of breaking that understanding. The confrontation has now spilled into the political and security environment of Hiiraan. Hawadle leaders have rejected the planned election without a prior political agreement, while elders have moved to prevent Hirshabelle officials and aircraft from operating through airports in Hiiraan until their grievances are addressed. Al-Shabaab also says it has reached an understanding with Hawadle elders in Maxaas to end years of fighting. The reported agreement has not been independently verified, and it is unclear whether the elders involved represent the wider Hawadle community. But its emergence at a time of intense political confrontation with Mogadishu gives the development far greater significance. Macawisly militia A Presidency Dispute with Wider Consequences The immediate dispute is about who should lead Hirshabelle. Hawadle leaders argue that political representation and power-sharing must be settled before an election can proceed. President Hassan Sheikh’s support for Guudlaawe has therefore been interpreted by opposing Hawadle figures as a departure from an earlier political understanding. At the same time, the Hawadle community is not politically united. A separate Hawadle political council led by former Hirshabelle President Ali Abdullahi Osoble has backed Guudlaawe and supported participation in the election. That division is important. The confrontation should not be presented as if every Hawadle leader holds the same position. But the scale of the opposition is significant. Hawadle elders and politicians have demanded a political settlement, and demonstrations in Beledweyne have rejected an election without an agreement on representation and power-sharing. The Al-Shabaab Factor Hawadle communities were among the most important local forces in the fight against Al-Shabaab during the 2022 Macawisley offensive. Local fighters, working alongside Somali government forces, helped drive Al-Shabaab from large areas of central Somalia. But the gains were not permanent. Al-Shabaab later regained territory, while prolonged fighting imposed heavy costs on communities that had participated in the war. The reported understanding in Maxaas therefore raises a serious question: what happens when a community that once fought Al-Shabaab begins looking for local arrangements with the group while simultaneously confronting the federal government over political representation? Al-Shabaab has previously sought agreements with local clans and sub-clans when such arrangements serve its interests. Similar understandings involving Hawadle subdivisions were reported in 2023. The latest development should therefore not automatically be interpreted as a Hawadle alliance with Al-Shabaab. It may instead reflect a combination of local security concerns, political frustration and war fatigue. A Political Crisis Becoming a Security Risk For Mogadishu, the danger is that a dispute over the Hirshabelle presidency could gradually become something much larger. The federal government faces an increasingly difficult choice: push ahead with an election that significant Hawadle figures reject, or reopen negotiations over the political settlement and power-sharing arrangements. The Al-Shabaab development adds urgency to that choice. The central question is no longer simply who will become president of Hirshabelle. It is whether the struggle over political power will deepen the alienation of a community that has already paid a heavy price fighting Al-Shabaab — and create new space for the militant group to exploit. If political disputes continue without a settlement, Al-Shabaab may not need to defeat its former opponents militarily. It may simply wait for political frustration, insecurity and exhaustion to do the work. A Political Crisis Becoming a Security Risk For Mogadishu, the danger is that a dispute over the Hirshabelle presidency could gradually become something much larger. The federal government faces an increasingly difficult choice: push ahead with an election that significant Hawadle figures reject, or reopen negotiations over the political settlement and power-sharing arrangements. The Al-Shabaab development adds urgency to that choice. The central question is no longer simply who will become president of Hirshabelle. It is whether the struggle over political power will deepen the alienation of a community that has already paid a heavy price fighting Al-Shabaab — and create new space for the militant group to exploit. If political disputes continue without a settlement, Al-Shabaab may not need to defeat its former opponents militarily. It may simply wait for political frustration, insecurity and exhaustion to do the work. items.title: Madaxda Soomaaliya,  Masar, Eritrea, iyo Suudaan oo ku baaqay xal Siyaasadeed
items.description: Mas’uuliyiinta ugu sarreeya ee Soomasliya, Masar, Eritrea, Masar, iyo Suudaan ayaa soo saaray bayaan wadajir ah oo ay ku baaqayaan in colaadaha ka socda gobolka lagu dhammeeyo wada-hadal iyo xalal siyaasadeed , xilli dagaalladu ka sii xoogeysanayaan Suudaan iyo Itoobiya. Madaxweynaha Masar Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, Madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Suudaan Abdel Fattah al-Burhan ayaa kulmay Axaddii magaalada New Alamein ee dalka Masar, halkaas oo ay ka soo saareen bayaanka wadajirka ah. Bayaanka ayaa si gaar ah u taageeray in colaadda Suudaan lagu dhammeeyo hannaan siyaasadeed oo ay hoggaaminayaan dhinacyada Suudaan, iyadoo dalkaasi uu dagaal kula jiray tan iyo Abriil 2023 ciidamada dowladda iyo ciidamada gurmadka degdegga ah ee RSF. Afarta dal ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in maamulka iyo amniga Badda Cas ay tahay inay door weyn ku yeeshaan dalalka xeebaha leh, arrintaas oo ku soo beegmaysa dadaallada Itoobiya ay ku doonayso inay ku hesho marin ganacsi iyo joogitaan badeed, maadaama Itoobiya ay tahay dal aan bad lahayn. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa hore u sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan diiddanayn in Itoobiya hesho marin ganacsi oo ay isticmaasho dekedaha Soomaaliya, balse uu shardi yahay in arrintaasi lagu heshiiyo Soomaaliya. Bayaanka ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay muranka ka dhashay Biyo-xireenka Weyn ee Itoobiya ee Renaissance Dam , iyadoo Masar iyo Suudaan ay ka digeen tallaabooyin hal dhinac ah oo ay sheegeen inay saameyn ku yeelan karaan dalalka ku teedsan webiga Nile. Kulanka afarta dal ayaa ku soo beegmay xilli dagaallo culus ay ka socdaan Itoobiya, gaar ahaan gobolka Tigray, halkaas oo ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo isbahaysi hubeysan oo ka kooban dhowr kooxood ay isku hayaan dagaallo cusub. Ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya iyo kuwa xulafada la ah ayaa Axaddii dib ula wareegay magaalada Mekelle, caasimadda gobolka Tigray, kadib markii TPLF ay sheegtay inay si ku-meel-gaar ah uga baxday magaalada, ayna hawlgalladeeda ka sii wadi doonto meel kale. Mas’uuliyiinta Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale Eritrea ku eedeeyay inay taageerayso isbahaysiga hubeysan ee dagaalka kula jira dowladda federaalka. Eritrea ayaa beenisay eedeymahaas, iyadoo wasiirka warfaafinta Eritrea uu sheegay in Addis Ababa ay isku dayayso inay abuurto marmarsiiyo ay Eritrea ku weerarto. Hoggaamiyeyaasha afarta dal ayaa, iyadoo xaaladdu sidaas tahay, xoogga saaray muhiimadda wada-hadalka, xasilloonida gobolka iyo xal siyaasadeed , xilli colaadaha Suudaan iyo Itoobiya ay saameyn ku yeelan karaan amniga guud ee Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas.

items.title: Mekelle Falls as Tigray War Explodes Into a Regional Crisis
items.description: TPLF Withdraws After 11 Days of Fighting as Ethiopia-Eritrea Relations Collapse and Regional Powers Move to Coordinate MEKELLE (WDN) — Ethiopia’s renewed Tigray war has moved with extraordinary speed from a major Tigrayan offensive to the fall of Mekelle, while a parallel diplomatic crisis between Ethiopia and Eritrea threatens to turn the conflict into a wider Horn of Africa confrontation. The current round of fighting began on September 23, when forces led by the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) launched a major offensive against Ethiopian federal forces. The Tigrayan side initially made advances, including taking control of Mekelle’s main airport. The federal government responded with a rapid counteroffensive. Over the following days, Ethiopian federal forces and allied fighters retook strategic positions and advanced toward Mekelle. By the end of September, fighting had intensified around the capital, while reports of drone strikes and disruptions to communications and commercial flights underscored the growing severity of the conflict. Then the crisis widened beyond the battlefield. On October 1 , Eritrea announced that it was severing diplomatic relations with Ethiopia after Addis Ababa accused Eritrea of supporting the TPLF-led opposition alliance. Eritrea rejected the accusation. Ethiopia had already closed its embassy in Asmara and expelled Eritrean diplomats. By October 2–3 , federal forces and their allies were closing in on Mekelle. The airport was retaken, and pro-government Tigray Peace Forces advanced into the city. On October 3 , the TPLF announced that it was withdrawing from Mekelle and that the regional government would temporarily operate from elsewhere. By October 4, Reuters confirmed that Ethiopian federal forces and allied militias had regained control of the Tigrayan capital. The entire sequence unfolded in just 11 days. That speed is what makes the latest crisis so dangerous. Mekelle has fallen, but there has been no declaration that the war is over. items.title: Weerarrada lagu Bartilmaameedsanayo Maraakiibta Shidaalka oo Ku Sii kordhaya Bariga Dhexe
items.description: Weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo maraakiibta qaadda shidaalka ayaa sii kordhaya, inkastoo dhoofinta saliidda cayriin ee gobolka Bariga Dhexe ay weli ku socoto heerar xooggan. Maraakiibta xamuulka shidaalka ayaa weli maraya qaar ka mid ah waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee badda, kuwaas oo laf-dhabar u ah ganacsiga iyo gaarsiinta tamarta ee suuqyada caalamka. Kororka khataraha amni ee ka jira marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo badqabka maraakiibta, hakad ku yimaada silsiladaha sahayda iyo saameynta ay tani ku yeelan karto suuqyada tamarta ee caalamka . Khubarada iyo shirkadaha ka shaqeeya gaadiidka badda ayaa si gaar ah isha ugu haya xaaladda, maadaama carqalad weyn oo ku timaadda isu-socodka maraakiibta shidaalka ay saameyn ku yeelan karto qiimaha iyo helitaanka saliidda ee suuqyada caalamka. Inkasta oo dhoofinta shidaalka Bariga Dhexe ay weli tahay mid xooggan, haddana sii kordhaya khataraha amni ayaa muujinaya caqabadda ka dhex jirta sii socoshada ganacsiga tamarta iyo ilaalinta amniga maraakiibta . Xaaladda ayaa weli u baahan in si dhow loola socdo, iyadoo marin-biyoodka Bariga Dhexe uu yahay mid muhiim u ah dhaq-dhaqaaqa saliidda iyo badeecooyinka tamarta ee suuqyada caalamka.

items.title: Madaxda Soomaaliya iyo Suudaan oo Kulan ku yeeshay Al-Alamein
items.description: Madaxweynaha Golaha Madaxbannaanida Ku-meelgaarka ah ee Suudaan, General Cabdifataax Al-Burhan , ayaa kulan la yeeshay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Dr. Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud , magaalada New Alamein ee dalka Masar. Kulanka ayaa ka dhacay xilli labada madaxweyne ay ka qeybgalayeen shir wadatashi oo ay isugu yimaadeen madaxda Masar, Suudaan, Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea , kaas oo looga hadlay xaaladaha siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Geeska Afrika iyo gobolka Badda Cas. Madaxda afarta dal ayaa kulanka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la ixtiraamo madaxbannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalalka gobolka, iyadoo sidoo kale lagu baaqay in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo waddooyin siyaasadeed iyo nabadeed. Arrimaha Suudaan ayaa si gaar ah uga mid ahaa qodobadii laga hadlay, iyadoo madaxdu taageereen midnimada iyo hay’adaha qaranka Suudaan, isla markaana ku baaqeen in dib loo bilaabo hannaan siyaasadeed ay hoggaaminayaan dhinacyada Suudaan. Kulanka Al-Alamein ayaa sidoo kale lagu isla meel dhigay in la xoojiyo wada-tashiga iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya afarta dal, iyadoo la sameynayo hannaan dabagal ku sameeya natiijooyinka shirarka, kuwaas oo la qorsheeyay in si joogto ah loo qabto. Shirkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli gobolka Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas ay wajahayaan caqabado siyaasadeed iyo amni oo isbiirsaday, taas oo sii kordhisay muhiimadda wada-shaqeynta iyo isku-duwidda dalalka gobolka.

items.title: Dagaalka Tigray oo Saameyn ku yeeshay Xiriirka dalalka Geeska Afrika
items.description: Xiisadda ka taagan gobolka Tigray ee waqooyiga Itoobiya ayaa mar kale dhalisay walaac ku saabsan xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee gudaha dalka Itoobiya, iyadoo saameynteedu ay gaareyso xiriirka Itoobiya ay la leedahay dalalka kale ee Geeska Afrika. Xaaladda Tigray ayaa ah mid xasaasi ah, maadaama gobolka uu horey u soo maray dagaal culus oo sababay khasaare ballaaran iyo barakac, waxaana dagaalkii weynaa lagu soo afjaray heshiis nabadeed, balse khilaafaadka siyaasadeed iyo arrimaha la xiriira amniga ayaa weli ah kuwo u baahan xal iyo wada-hadal. Xiisadaha gudaha Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmaya xilli xiriirka dalalka Geeska Afrika ay wajahayaan caqabado siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed. Isbeddel kasta oo ka dhaca Tigray ayaa laga yaabaa inuu saameyn ku yeesho xisaabaadka amni iyo siyaasadeed ee gobolka, waxaana Dalalka Geeska Afrika ay si dhow ula socdaan xaaladda Itoobiya, iyadoo xasilloonida dalkaasi ay saameyn ku leedahay amniga iyo xiriirka siyaasadeed ee gobolka oo dhan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee colaadda Tigray ayaa dib u soo nooleynaysa doodaha ku saabsan mustaqbalka nabadda Itoobiya, xiriirka u dhexeeya dhinacyada gudaha iyo sida xiisaddu dalkaasi ay u saameyn karto xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee dalalka deriska ah.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo Kulan Muhiim ah la yeeshay Madaxweynaha Baarlamaanka Carabta
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) , ayaa magaalada Arusha ee dalka Tanzania kulan kula yeeshay Madaxweynaha Baarlamaanka Carabta, Mohamed Ahmed Al-Yamahi . Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga baarlamaaniga ah ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo dalalka Carabta, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isla garteen muhiimadda ay leedahay in la joogteeyo wada-tashiyada iyo isku-duwidda mowqifyada laga yeesho arrimaha ay wadaagaan. Sidoo kale, waxaa kulanka looga hadlay sidii loo xoojin lahaa doorka Soomaaliya ee iskaashiga baarlamaaniga ah ee dunida Carabta, iyadoo la adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii horumariyo xiriirka ka dhexeeya hay’adaha sharci-dejinta Soomaaliya iyo kuwa dalalka Carabta. Guddoomiye Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur iyo Madaxweyne Mohamed Ahmed Al-Yamahi ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo dalalka Carabta, kaas oo ku saleysan is-ixtiraam, dano wadaag iyo iskaashi. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay muhiimad gaar ah siinayso xoojinta xiriirka baarlamaaniga ah ee ay la leedahay dalalka Carabta. Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa sidoo kale uga mahadceliyay dowladaha Carabta taageerada ay Soomaaliya ka siiyaan ilaalinta midnimada, madax-bannaanida, qarannimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalka . Kulankan ayaa ka mid ahaa kulamada ka socda magaalada Arusha ee Tanzania, iyadoo mas’uuliyiinta Soomaaliya ay halkaasi kaga qaybgalayaan hawlo la xiriira iskaashiga iyo xiriirka baarlamaaniga ah.

Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay muhiimad gaar ah siinayso xoojinta xiriirka baarlamaaniga ah ee ay la leedahay dalalka Carabta. Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa sidoo kale uga mahadceliyay dowladaha Carabta taageerada ay Soomaaliya ka siiyaan ilaalinta midnimada, madax-bannaanida, qarannimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalka . Kulankan ayaa ka mid ahaa kulamada ka socda magaalada Arusha ee Tanzania, iyadoo mas’uuliyiinta Soomaaliya ay halkaasi kaga qaybgalayaan hawlo la xiriira iskaashiga iyo xiriirka baarlamaaniga ah.

items.title: Somaliland oo sheegtay in DF Soomaaliya ay qorsheyneyso duullaan ay ku qabsaneyso
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Mas’uul sare oo ka tirsan maamulka Somaliland ayaa sheegay in Muqdisho ay ka fekereyso duullaan ka dhan ah Somaliland oo ku qabsato, isaga oo ku dooday in Turkey uu taageerayo tallaabadaas haddii ay dhacdo. Maxamed Cabdiraxmaan Xasan, agaasimaha guud ee wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Somaliland, ayaa hadalkan ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyay warbaahinta Middle East Eye . “Muqdisho waxay ka fekereysaa duullaan, Turkey-na wuu taageeri lahaa,” ayuu yiri Maxamed, isaga oo intaas ku daray in Somaliland ay u baahan tahay inay “isu diyaariso mustaqbalka”. Sheegashadan si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin, dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya-na ma shaacin wax qorshe ah oo ku saabsan howlgal militari oo ka dhan ah Somaliland. Hadallada Maxamed ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiriirka Somaliland iyo Israel uu sii yeelanayo dhinac amni, iyadoo mas’uuliyiin kale oo Somaliland ah ay sheegeen inay doonayaan taageero militari oo Israel ay ka helaan si ay uga hortagaan waxa ay ku tilmaameen awoodda militari ee Turkey ee Soomaaliya ku sii kordheysa. Israel oo laga doonayo difaaca hawada Maxamed Cusmaan Fadal, oo ah la-taliye sare oo arrimaha dibadda u qaabilsan madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi, ayaa Middle East Eye u sheegay in Somaliland ay si gaar ah u dooneyso nidaamyada difaaca hawada ee Israel. “Waxaan u baahanahay nidaamyada difaaca hawada,” ayuu yiri Fadal. “Turkey wuxuu F-16 ku leeyahay Muqdisho, wuxuuna doonayaa inuu saldhig diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ka sameeyo Soomaaliya,” ayuu raaciyay. Fadal ayaa kadib si toos ah u yiri: “Waxaan rabnaa in Israel ay naga taageerto Turkey.” Hadalladan ayaa muujinaya sida ay qaar ka mid ah mas’uuliyiinta Somaliland u arkaan xiriirka cusub ee Israel, iyadoo Israel ay bishii December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee Somaliland u aqoonsada dal madax-bannaan. Turkey ayaa ka mid ah saaxiibada istaraatiijiga ah ee ugu dhow dowladda Soomaaliya, wuxuuna sanadihii dambe si weyn u ballaariyay joogitaankiisa militari, dhaqaale iyo diblomaasiyadeed. Ankara ayaa Muqdisho ku leh xarunteeda militari ee ugu weyn ee dibadda, waxaana halkaas lagu tababaray kumannaan askari oo Soomaali ah. Soomaaliya iyo Turkey ayaa 2024 sidoo kale kala saxiixday heshiis difaac iyo iskaashi dhaqaale oo muddo 10 sano ah, kaas oo Ankara kaalin ka siinaya dhismaha iyo tababarka ciidamada badda Soomaaliya iyo ilaalinta xeebaha dalka. Turkey ayaa sanadkan sidoo kale Soomaaliya keenay diyaarado dagaal oo F-16 ah, kuwaas oo bishii April ka qeyb-galay dabaaldegga sanad-guurada ciidamada xoogga dalka ee Muqdisho. Joogitaankaas militari ayaa hadda u muuqda inuu yahay mid ka mid ah waxyaabaha ugu waaweyn ee ay Somaliland ku saleyneyso dalabkeeda taageerada amni ee Israel.
