items.title: Mareykanka oo deg deg uga baxay saldhig ku yaal UK kadib markii la ogaaday in Iran ay…
items.description: London (Caasimada Online) – Mareykanka ayaa si degdeg ah dhammaan 12-ka diyaaradood ee dagaalka ee B-1 uga saaray saldhigga RAF Fairford ee koonfurta Britain, kadib markii saraakiisha militariga ay heleen xog cusub oo ku saabsan qorshe weerar oo la tuhunsan yahay inuu xiriir la leeyahay Iran. Tallaabadan oo dhacday dhammaadkii toddobaadka ayaa ahayd mid aan caadi ahayn, maadaama Mareykanku uu si dhif ah diyaarado tiro intaas le’eg uga daadgureeyo saldhig ku yaalla waddan xulafo la ah oo kumannaan kiiloomitir u jira goobaha dagaalka. Laba sarkaal oo Mareykan ah ayaa New York Times u sheegay in xaaladda loo arkay mid aad u degdeg badan, taasoo keentay in qaar ka mid ah diyaaradaha iyo shaqaalahooda ay duulaan xilli diyaaradaha shidaalka hawada ku bixiya weli loo diyaarinayey inay taageeraan safarkooda dib ugu laabanaya Mareykanka. Ugu yaraan saddex ka mid ah diyaaradaha ayaa Axaddii gaaray saldhiggooda South Dakota, sida ay saraakiishu sheegeen. Taliska Mareykanka ee Yurub ayaa xaqiijiyey in dhammaan diyaaradaha laga saaray Britain, balse wuxuu ka gaabsaday inuu faahfaahin ka bixiyo hanjabaadaha cusub ee sababay go’aanka. “Waxaan hadda xaqiijin karnaa in dhammaan diyaaradaha wax duqeeya ee Mareykanka ee lagu geeyey RAF Fairford dib loogu celinayo saldhigyadooda gudaha Mareykanka,” ayuu talisku ku yiri bayaan. Wasaaradda Difaaca Britain ayaa iyaduna diiday inay ka hadasho dhaqdhaqaaqa hantida militariga Mareykanka. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ma aysan shaacin nooca xogta cusub ee keentay in diyaaradaha sida degdegga ah looga saaro saldhigga, balse hal sarkaal ayaa sheegay in xogtu ay la xiriirto digniino soo baxay saddex toddobaad ka hor, iyadoo faahfaahinta iyo heerka degdegga ahi ay si weyn u kordheen 24-kii saac ee ugu dambeeyey. Qaar ka mid ah B-1-yada la saaray ayaa saldhigga yimid toddobaadkii lasoo dhaafay oo keliya, iyagoo qayb ka ahaa wareeg caadi ah oo ciidamada Mareykanka ah. Go’aanka ayaa yimid toddobaad kadib markii booliska Britain ay xireen shan nin oo lagu arkay baabuurro cadcad meel u dhow RAF Fairford, oo ka mid ah saldhigyada ay diyaaradaha Mareykanku u adeegsadeen hawlgallada dagaalka ka dhanka ah Iran. Raggaas ayaa maalintii xigtay damiin lagu sii daayey kadib markii aan wax walxaha qarxa ah laga helin baabuurtooda, balse boolisku waxay sheegeen in baaritaankoodu weli socdo. Khamiistii, booliska la-dagaallanka argagixisada Britain ayaa sidoo kale xiray nin haysta dhalashada Britain iyo Iran, kaas oo looga shakisan yahay diyaarinta falal argagixiso oo la xiriira baaritaanka RAF Fairford. Ninkaas ayaa markii dambe damiin lagu sii daayey iyadoo baaritaanku sii socdo. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Britain Andy Burnham ayaa toddobaadkii hore sheegay in dowladda Britain ay hayso xog muujinaysa in Iran ay door ku lahayd qorshaha la tuhunsan yahay. Saraakiil Mareykan iyo British ah ayaa sidoo kale baaraya suurtagalnimada in qorshuhu xiriir la leeyahay Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran, IRGC, ama xarun kale oo militari oo ku taal Tehran. Iran ayaa si adag u beenisay eedeymahaas. Booliska Britain ayaa sheegay inay baarayaan dhammaan jihooyinka suurtagalka ah, oo ay ku jirto ku lug lahaanshaha dowlad shisheeye. Xiisadda ku saabsan RAF Fairford ma ahan mid cusub. Bishii July, Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ayaa si cad uga digtay Britain inay Mareykanka u oggolaato inuu saldhiggaas u isticmaalo weerarro ka dhan ah Iran. “Wax saldhig ah oo loo adeegsado weerarro lagu qaado dhulka Iran wuxuu bartilmaameed sharci ah u yahay ciidamadeenna,” ayaa lagu yiri digniinta Iran. Bishii September, saraakiisha militariga Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale helay digniino sirdoon oo Mareykan iyo reer Galbeed ah oo sheegayey in RAF Fairford uu halis ugu jiro weerar ay Iran taageerto. Sida laga soo xigtay saraakiisha xogtaas lagu wargeliyey, hay’adaha sirdoonka ayaa sawir ka sameeyey qorshaha la tuhunsan yahay iyagoo adeegsanaya isgaarsiino la qabtay, xog ay bixiyeen ilo sirdoon iyo macluumaad kale. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa isna sheegay in sirdoonka dalkiisa uu Britain uga digay suurtagalnimada weerar ay Iran taageerto, inkastoo digniintaasi aysan magacaabin bartilmaameed gaar ah. Qiimeynaha sirdoonka ayaa sidoo kale ka digay in haddii weerar dhaco ay suurtagal tahay in weerarro kale oo daba socda loo adeegsado diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Digniinahaas ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Yurub. Sida uu sheegay sarkaal sare oo Mareykan ah, Israel ayaa Jarmalka uga digtay in saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Spangdahlem iyo Ramstein ay iyaguna wajahaan halis sare. Ka saarista dhammaan B-1-yada RAF Fairford ayaa hadda muujineysa sida dhab ah ee Washington u qaadatay khatarta la tuhunsan yahay. Reuters iyo warbaahin kale ayaa Axaddii xaqiijiyey in diyaaradaha laga saaray saldhigga iyadoo baaritaanka Britain ee qorshaha argagixiso uu weli socdo. Haddii la xaqiijiyo in Tehran ay ka dambeysay qorshe lagu weerarayo saldhig militari oo ku yaalla Britain, waxay noqon doontaa sare-u-kac weyn oo ku yimaada xiisadda Iran iyo dalalka reer Galbeedka, xilli dagaalka Iran iyo xulafada Mareykanka uu sii kordhiyey halista ka dhalan karta saldhigyada ay ciidamada Mareykanku ku leeyihiin Yurub. items.title: Higher Education and Federalism in Somalia: What the Constitution and Higher Education Laws Actually provide
items.description: By Dr. Abdirazak Takar On 4 March 2026, Somalia adopted a new constitution in Mogadishu , ratified under President Hassan Sheikh Mohamed, replacing the Provisional Constitution that had governed the federal project since 2012.  For outside observers, Somali’s federal experiment is easy to misrepresentation as either a fragile arrangement barely holding the country together or a formality that changes little in practice. Neither view survives contact with the text. Among its articles and schedules is a clear answer to a question that has troubled Somali higher education policy for over a decade: does responsibility for universities, research institutes and technical colleges belong the Federal Government or to the Federal Member States? The new text is unambiguous about the multi-level character of higher education governance. Article 25(5) assigns the development of higher education to the different levels of government, and the Second Schedule places both higher education, technology and research institutions, and the development and quality of education more broadly, among the powers the Federal Government and Federal Member States hold concurrently. The constitutional framework envisions a system of shared and collaborative governance, rather than one in which either level of government administers exclusively    Article 29(5): A Deliberate Rewrite The old Provisional Constitution’s Article 30(7) read simply: “The State shall promote higher education, technical institutes, and technology and research institutions.” In Somali constitutional practice, “the State” (Dawladda) has generally been understood, rightly or wrongly, as shorthand for the Federal Government. The new constitution abandons that language. Article 29(5) now reads: “Heerarka kala duwan ee hay’adaha dawladda ee u xilsaaran waxbarashada waa in ay horumariyaan tacliinta sare, machadyada farsamo, tiknoolijiyada, cilmibaarista, hal-abuurka, cayaaraha, hiddaha iyo dhaqanka.”  (“The various levels of government institutions responsible for education shall develop higher education, technical institutes, technology, research, innovation, sport, heritage and culture.”) This is not a minor stylistic change. Replacing “the State” with “the various levels of government institutions” broadens the provision deliberately, recognising that federal, state and local institutions each carry this obligation. The 2012 text could reasonably be read as assigning higher education to Mogadishu alone. The 2026 text closes off that reading. The Schedule Confirms the Position If any doubt remained after Article 29(5), the Second Schedule settles it. The constitution distinguishes between Schedule Two (A), the exclusive powers of the Federal Government; Schedule Two (B), powers held concurrently by both levels of government; and Schedule Two (C), the exclusive powers of the Federal Member States. Item 8 of Schedule Two (B) lists “the development plan for education and the protection of its quality” among the concurrent powers. Item 41 of the same schedule, the final entry under its education heading, then adds: “Tacliinta sare, tiknoolijiyadda iyo hay’adaha cilmibaarista.”  (“Higher education, technology, and research institutions.”) Both provisions sit in Schedule Two (B). Neither appears in Schedule Two (C), which begins immediately afterwards with an entirely different list covering matters such as state constitutions and state budgets. Higher education and the development and quality of education generally are, in other words, companion entries within the same concurrent list, not powers split across separate federal and state schedules. The constitution treats them as a shared undertaking. A Deliberate Distinction, Not an Omission The drafters plainly understood the difference between functions that require a single national authority and those that do not, because they drew that line explicitly in the neighbouring schedule. Item 40 of Schedule Two (A), the exclusive federal list, gives the Federal Government sole authority over curriculum setting, teacher training, and national secondary school certification examinations. Those functions demand a single national standard, and the constitution says so without qualification. Higher education was not given the same treatment. It was placed instead in the concurrent schedule, alongside the general duty to develop education and protect its quality. The stronger constitutional inference is that curriculum, teacher training and national examinations were considered to need one national voice, while higher education, technology and research were considered to need shared national and state involvement rather than exclusive control by either level. Articles 64 and 68: How the Shared Power Operates The position becomes clearer still when the surrounding articles are read alongside Article 29(5) and Schedule Two (B). Article 64 sets out the constitution’s general principles of federalism, including the requirement that governmental power be distributed across all levels of government, that levels of government cooperate continuously with one another, and that responsibility for delivering services be assigned to whichever level of government has sufficient capacity to deliver them most effectively and is closest to the citizen being served. Article 68 then gives the concurrent powers listed in Schedule Two (B) a specific operating structure, rather than leaving them undifferentiated. It assigns responsibility for legislation, policy, regulation, standards and monitoring in concurrent areas to the Federal Government, while assigning implementation and execution of those same powers to the Federal Member States. The Federal Member States’ role is to implement them, including through their own institutions such as state-level higher education commissions. Quality assurance systems need to command the confidence of employers and international partners. Research institutions should be able to meet recognised benchmarks. None of this requires concentrating every regulatory decision in one federal office. What the Higher Education Laws Actually Provide The constitutional question becomes more concrete when the two higher education laws already in force are examined. The Federal Higher Education Law, enacted in December 2024, creates a substantial national regulatory architecture. It defines “Government” as the Federal Government, provides that the Minister leads national higher education policy after consultation with Federal Member State education authorities and the National Higher Education Commission, and establishes the National Commission with its headquarters in the capital and branches in the Federal Member States. The Commission is given broad functions, including setting standards for higher education institutions, inspecting and evaluating them, granting accreditation, determining qualification requirements, and recognising degrees and diplomas. (Federal Higher Education Law, Law No. 30, 4 December 2024, Articles 2, 4, 9 to 10 and 19 to 20.) The Federal law also recognises a Federal Member State role. Article 35 provides that a Federal Member State may establish a university and assumes responsibility for its facilities, with the university’s budget approved by the state parliament. The same provision, however, requires the state university to proceed through procedures set by the Federal law, while the law separately allows the Federal Government to establish higher education institutions elsewhere in the country. The statutory model is therefore mixed: it recognises state institutions while placing extensive licensing, accreditation and quality control functions within the federal framework. (Federal Higher Education Law, Articles 23 to 35.) Puntland’s amended Higher Education Law establishes a parallel state-level framework. Its scope extends throughout Puntland and applies to Puntland’s higher education institutions. It establishes the Puntland Higher Education Commission as a legally independent administrative body under the political supervision of the Ministry of Education, empowered to set standards for opening and operating higher education institutions, determine qualification requirements, inspect and evaluate institutions, grant accreditation, and develop higher education policy and strategy for Puntland. It also gives the Commission a direct role in establishing and accrediting universities and other institutions, and places responsibility for their facilities and budgets on the Puntland Government. (Puntland Higher Education Law, as amended in 2025, Articles 3 to 6, 19 to 20 and 23 to 30.) The comparison reveals a genuine overlap. The two statutes cover much of the same regulatory ground: standards, accreditation, inspection, recognition and institutional establishment. That overlap does not by itself show that either level possesses exclusive authority. It shows instead that the statutory framework developed with substantial regulatory roles at both levels, before the 2026 Constitution clarified how those roles should relate to one another. The Federal law predates the new constitution, and so do Puntland’s 2025 amendments. But a national framework does not require every accreditation, licensing, inspection or institutional decision to be administered from the centre. Puntland’s law shows that substantial regulatory capacity already exists at the Federal Member State level. The more coherent solution is a functional division consistent with Article 68: national standards and monitoring, exercised through Federal Member State implementation, with agreed mechanisms for mutual recognition. Two Commissions, One Constitutional Logic The coexistence of a National Higher Education Commission and a Puntland Higher Education Commission should be read in light of both the constitutional allocation of powers and the statutes enacted under it. Neither institution’s existence is, by itself, evidence that the other must yield. The precise legal task is to harmonise their statutory powers with the constitutional division set out above. That task is not to decide which commission should give way, but to identify which functions are genuinely national, which sit within Federal Member State authority, and which require cooperation. Common benchmarks, mutual recognition, compatible accreditation procedures, shared data and a standing federal and state dialogue on quality assurance can supply the connective structure. A National Higher Education Commission can perform national coordination and standard setting where constitutionally authorised, while a state-level commission regulates and supervises institutions within its own jurisdiction. The aim should be complementarity, not duplication or unilateral expansion by either side. Towards a Federal Higher Education Compact What Somalia needs now is not a further contest over jurisdiction, but a negotiated Federal Higher Education Compact that translates the constitutional allocation into workable administrative arrangements: agreed national quality benchmarks, clear accreditation and licensing pathways, mutual recognition between federal and state regulators, shared data systems, and a standing mechanism for resolving disputes through dialogue and constitutional procedure. Such a compact matters because the existing statutes predate the 2026 Constitution and were drafted against an earlier and less settled understanding of how federal and state authority over higher education should relate. The aim should not be to invalidate the legitimate regulatory objectives of either law, but to clarify institutional boundaries and build a coherent federal and state system consistent with what the constitution now provides. Why Adherence to the Text Matters Now The analysis above is not a merely academic exercise. It has direct bearing on how the Federal Ministry of Education, and Federal Member State authorities such as Puntland’s Ministry of Education and its Higher Education Commission, should conduct themselves in practice. Where the constitution assigns a function concurrently, as it does with higher education, technology, research institutions, and the development and protection of education quality, the Federal Government’s role under Article 68 is to set policy, standards and regulation and to monitor their application. It is not to administer Puntland’s universities directly, to bypass Puntland’s own statutory Higher Education Commission, or to treat implementation, which the constitution assigns to Federal Member States, as a federal prerogative. A Federal Government that exceeds this role, whether by asserting licensing or accreditation authority the constitution does not give it, by disregarding Puntland’s Higher Education Law, or by making appointments and decisions that displace rather than coordinate with Puntland’s Commission, is not exercising national leadership. It is departing from the constitutional text this article has set out. The remedy is not political improvisation on either side, but adherence to Article 29(5), Schedule Two (B) and Article 68 as written, and to the Federal Higher Education Law and Puntland’s Higher Education Law as they stand until lawfully harmonised through negotiation. This matters beyond the immediate dispute. Federal systems are judged internationally by whether their central governments observe the limits the constitution places on them, not only by whether subnational governments comply with the centre. A Federal Government that treats concurrent powers as an opening for administrative expansion, rather than a basis for cooperation, risks the same institutional distrust, duplicated structures and politicised disputes over academic quality that this article has warned against throughout. That outcome would serve neither Somalia’s national cohesion nor Puntland’s legitimate institutional interests. It would serve only the temporary convenience of whichever office in Mogadishu found it expedient to disregard the allocation of powers the constitution itself sets out. None of this is a case against federal involvement in higher education. Somalia needs the national standards, coordination and monitoring that Article 68 assigns to the Federal Government. It is a case against mistaking that concurrent role for exclusive control, and against any ministry, federal or state, substituting personal or factional discretion for the procedures the constitution and the existing statutes already provide. The Wider Lesson Somalia’s higher education debate is not simply about which institution holds regulatory authority. It is about whether the federal system can distinguish national leadership from centralised administration, and whether its institutions, federal and state alike, will be bound by the constitution they operate under rather than by convenience. The constitution, read together with the existing higher education laws, points to a system in which national standards and coordination coexist with meaningful Federal Member State implementation and institutional authority. Any departure from that allocation, in either direction, is a constitutional problem to be corrected, not a political victory to be defended. Somalia does not need a higher education system organised around which institution holds the pen. It needs one that is coherent, credible and cooperative: national where the constitution assigns a national standard, shared where the constitution assigns a concurrent responsibility, and implemented locally where the constitution assigns that role to the Federal Member States. That is the more sustainable way to reconcile national standards with federalism. items.title: Suudaan, Eritrea, Masar iyo Somaliya oo kala saxiixday heshiis wadajir ah
items.description: Hoggaamiyeyaasha Somaliya, Masar, Suudaan iyo Eritrea ayaa Axaddan Magaalada Alamein ku kala saxiixday heshiis afar geesood ah oo loogu magac-daray “Bayaanka wadajirka ah ee Alamein”. Heshiiskan ayaa waxa uu udub-dhexaad u yahay iskaashi cusub oo dhanka amniga, difaaca iyo siyaasadda oo dalalkan ay yeelanayaan, kaas oo si toos ah u taabanaya is bedelada iyo xiisadaha ka taagan Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas. Bayaanka oo la tarjumay, laguna daabacay bogga wararka ee Villa Somalia ayaa u qornaa:- 1. Iyadoo laga jawaabayo martiqaadkii uu Mudane Cabdifataax Al-Siisi, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Carabta ee Masar, u fidiyey Mudane Isaias Afwerki, Madaxweynaha Dowladda Eritrea; Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya; iyo Jeneraal Cabdifataax Al-Burhaan, Guddoomiyaha Golaha Madaxbannaanida Ku-meelgaarka ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Suudaan, madaxweynayaashu waxay maanta, 4 Oktoobar 2026, shir-madaxeed afargeesood ah ku yeesheen magaalada cusub ee El Alamein. Waxay yeesheen wadatashiyo mug lehoo ku dhisan walaaltinnimo, kuwaas oo ku saabsanaa arrimaha gobolka iyo kuwa caalamka ee taagan, iyo sidoo kale siyaabaha lagu xoojin karo iskaashiga siyaasadda, ganacsiga iyo dhaqaalaha ee afarta dal, laguna adkayn karo wadatashiga iyo isku-duwidda dhexdooda. 2. Shir-madaxeedku wuxuu ka hadlay baahida loo qabo dhowrista mabaadi’da iyo tiirarka aasaasiga ah ee sharciga caalamiga ah, kuwaas oo saldhig u ah xasilloonida iyo iskaashiga gobolka; gaar ahaan ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida, xasilloonida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalalka gobolka; dhowrista mabaadi’da deris-wanaagga; diidmada faragelinta arrimaha gudaha ee dalalka gobolka, marmarsiiyo kasta oo loo cuskadaba; iyo ka shaqaynta taageeridda hay’adaha qaranka iyo dhiirrigelinta xalalka siyaasadeed iyo kuwa nabadeed ee khilaafaadka. 3. Shir-madaxeedku wuxuu ka wada hadlay isku-duwidda dadaallada wadajirka ah ee lagu xaqiijinayo xasilloonida gobolka, lagu abuurayo jawi ku habboon horumar la wadaago oo waara, laguna horumarinayo xiriirka dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga iyo dhaqanka. Dadaalladan waxaa loo wajahaya hab gacan ka geysanaya isdhexgalka dhaqaale iyo isku-xirnaanta, dhiirrigelinaya horumarka waara, isla markaana xoojinaya xiriirka ka dhexeeya shucuubta dhammaan dalalka ka qaybgalaya, iyadoo la tixgelinayo ujeeddooyinkooda guud iyo aayaha ay wadaagaan. 4. Shir-madaxeedku wuxuu ka hadlay arrimaha soo socda, kuwaas oo ay madaxda ka qaybgashay isku raaceen: a. Taageeridda midnimada, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Suudaan iyo hay’adaheeda qaranka; diidmada dhismaha hay’ado barbar socda hay’adaha qaranka; dhiirrigelinta dib-u-bilaabidda hannaan siyaasadeed oo ay dadka Suudaan leeyihiin, hoggaankiisana iyagu hayaan; taageeridda hay’adaha qaranka; iyo si buuxda u diididda taageero kasta oo la siiyo calooshood u shaqeystayaasha. b. Taageeridda midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo diidmada faragelin kasta oo lagu wiiqayo midnimada iyo madax-bannaanidaas, gaar ahaan aqoonsiga waxa loogu yeero “Somaliland”. c. Taageeridda dadaallada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo u suurtagelinta hay’adaha dowladda inay awooddooda ku fidiyaan dalka oo dhan; iyo ugu baaqidda saaxiibbada gobolka iyo kuwa caalamka inay Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) siiyaan maalgelin ku filan, waarta, lana saadaalin karo, si uu u guto waajibaadka loo igmaday. d. Adkaynta mabda’a xorriyadda isu-socodka maraakiibta iyo in maamulka Badda Cas uu yahay mas’uuliyad u gaar ah dalalka xeebaha ku leh baddaas. e. Adkaynta muhiimadda ixtiraamka sharciga caalamiga ah ee nidaamiya webiyada xuduudaha ka gudba, oo uu ku jiro webiga Niil, gaar ahaan mabda’a ah inaan waxyeello la geysan, iyo waajibka iskaashiga ee loo marayo wargelin horudhac ah, wadatashi iyo isku-raac; iyadoo si buuxda loo diidayo tallaabo kasta oo hal dhinac uu qaado, taas oo si taban u saamaynaysa isticmaalka biyaha ee hadda ka jira labada dal ee ku yaalla qaybta hoose ee webiga Niil. f. Sii wadidda xoojinta wadatashiga iyo isku-duwidda ka dhexeeya afarta dal. DHAMMAAD.

Iyadoo laga jawaabayo martiqaadkii uu Mudane Cabdifataax Al-Siisi, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Carabta ee Masar, u fidiyey Mudane Isaias Afwerki, Madaxweynaha Dowladda Eritrea; Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya; iyo Jeneraal Cabdifataax Al-Burhaan, Guddoomiyaha Golaha Madaxbannaanida Ku-meelgaarka ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Suudaan, madaxweynayaashu waxay maanta, 4 Oktoobar 2026, shir-madaxeed afargeesood ah ku yeesheen magaalada cusub ee El Alamein. Waxay yeesheen wadatashiyo mug lehoo ku dhisan walaaltinnimo, kuwaas oo ku saabsanaa arrimaha gobolka iyo kuwa caalamka ee taagan, iyo sidoo kale siyaabaha lagu xoojin karo iskaashiga siyaasadda, ganacsiga iyo dhaqaalaha ee afarta dal, laguna adkayn karo wadatashiga iyo isku-duwidda dhexdooda. 2. Shir-madaxeedku wuxuu ka hadlay baahida loo qabo dhowrista mabaadi’da iyo tiirarka aasaasiga ah ee sharciga caalamiga ah, kuwaas oo saldhig u ah xasilloonida iyo iskaashiga gobolka; gaar ahaan ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida, xasilloonida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalalka gobolka; dhowrista mabaadi’da deris-wanaagga; diidmada faragelinta arrimaha gudaha ee dalalka gobolka, marmarsiiyo kasta oo loo cuskadaba; iyo ka shaqaynta taageeridda hay’adaha qaranka iyo dhiirrigelinta xalalka siyaasadeed iyo kuwa nabadeed ee khilaafaadka. 3. Shir-madaxeedku wuxuu ka wada hadlay isku-duwidda dadaallada wadajirka ah ee lagu xaqiijinayo xasilloonida gobolka, lagu abuurayo jawi ku habboon horumar la wadaago oo waara, laguna horumarinayo xiriirka dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga iyo dhaqanka. Dadaalladan waxaa loo wajahaya hab gacan ka geysanaya isdhexgalka dhaqaale iyo isku-xirnaanta, dhiirrigelinaya horumarka waara, isla markaana xoojinaya xiriirka ka dhexeeya shucuubta dhammaan dalalka ka qaybgalaya, iyadoo la tixgelinayo ujeeddooyinkooda guud iyo aayaha ay wadaagaan. 4. Shir-madaxeedku wuxuu ka hadlay arrimaha soo socda, kuwaas oo ay madaxda ka qaybgashay isku raaceen: a. Taageeridda midnimada, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Suudaan iyo hay’adaheeda qaranka; diidmada dhismaha hay’ado barbar socda hay’adaha qaranka; dhiirrigelinta dib-u-bilaabidda hannaan siyaasadeed oo ay dadka Suudaan leeyihiin, hoggaankiisana iyagu hayaan; taageeridda hay’adaha qaranka; iyo si buuxda u diididda taageero kasta oo la siiyo calooshood u shaqeystayaasha. b. Taageeridda midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo diidmada faragelin kasta oo lagu wiiqayo midnimada iyo madax-bannaanidaas, gaar ahaan aqoonsiga waxa loogu yeero “Somaliland”. c. Taageeridda dadaallada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo u suurtagelinta hay’adaha dowladda inay awooddooda ku fidiyaan dalka oo dhan; iyo ugu baaqidda saaxiibbada gobolka iyo kuwa caalamka inay Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) siiyaan maalgelin ku filan, waarta, lana saadaalin karo, si uu u guto waajibaadka loo igmaday. d. Adkaynta mabda’a xorriyadda isu-socodka maraakiibta iyo in maamulka Badda Cas uu yahay mas’uuliyad u gaar ah dalalka xeebaha ku leh baddaas. e. Adkaynta muhiimadda ixtiraamka sharciga caalamiga ah ee nidaamiya webiyada xuduudaha ka gudba, oo uu ku jiro webiga Niil, gaar ahaan mabda’a ah inaan waxyeello la geysan, iyo waajibka iskaashiga ee loo marayo wargelin horudhac ah, wadatashi iyo isku-raac; iyadoo si buuxda loo diidayo tallaabo kasta oo hal dhinac uu qaado, taas oo si taban u saamaynaysa isticmaalka biyaha ee hadda ka jira labada dal ee ku yaalla qaybta hoose ee webiga Niil. f. Sii wadidda xoojinta wadatashiga iyo isku-duwidda ka dhexeeya afarta dal. DHAMMAAD.

items.title: Sooyaal: Danjire Maxamed Cusmaan Cumar (1937—04 Oktoobar 2014)
items.description: Danjire Maxamed Cusmaan Cumar wuxuu ku dhashay Xamar, 1937dii. Wuxuu ka mid ahaa Soomaalidii ku soo hanaqaadday waayihii gumaysiga, kuna ababay xilligii uu dalku ku jiray marxaladdii kalaguurka ee gobannimadoonka iyo sees-u-dhiggii dawladnimada Soomaaliyeed. Isaga oo da’ yar ayuu shaqo dawladeed bilaabay, taas oo markii danbe u ibafurtay mihnad dheer oo ku suntan u-adeegidda qaranka, saxaafadda, diblomaasiyadda iyo werinta taariikhda. Kontonnadii qarnigii tagay ayuu shaqaale ka noqday Wisaayadii Koonfureed ee Qaramada Midoobay. Shaqadiisii ugu horraysay wuxuuu ka bilaabay Boostada Guud, halkaas oo uu ka gaaray xilka Kormeeraha Guud  ee Waaxda Lacagaha. Wuxuu ka mid ahaa Soomaalidii ugu horraysay ee xilalka kala wareegtay shaqaalihii Talyaaniga, xilligii ay socotay Soomaaliyaynta hay’adaha dawliga ah. Isla sannadahaas ayuu ka hawlgalay Golihii Shacabka ee Daakhiliyada (Constituent Assembly), isagoo ka mid ahaa shaqaalihii diiwaangelinayay doodaha iyo fadhiyada Golaha, xilligii loo diyaargaroobayay madaxbannaanida Soomaaliya. Hawlahaasi waxay barbilow u ahaayeen waaya-aragnimadiisii maamulka, dawladnimada iyo habraacyada hay’adaha qaranka. Xornimadii kaddib, sannadkii 1960kii, wuxuuu ka mid noqday 41 dhallinyaro Soomaaliyeed oo deeq waxbarasho loogu diray Jamhuuriyadda Shacabka Shiinaha. Waxay Muqdisho ka anbabaxeen, iyaga oo sii maray Rooma, Fiyeena, Baraag iyo Moosko, dabadeedna tareenka Trans-Siberian ku tegay Biijiin, oo ay gaareen bartamihii Nofeenbar 1960. Muddadii uu Shiinaha joogay wuxuu ku bartay afka Jayniiska ( Mandarin ), isagoo isla markaana aqoonkororsi iyo waaya-aragnimo nololeed ka helay bulsho, dhaqan iyo habnololeed ka duwanaa kuwii uu ku soo barbaaray. Safarkaasi wuxuu ka mid noqday waayihii waxbarasho ee raadadka muuqda ku reebay noloshiisii danbe, gaar ahaan, ku-xeeldheeraantii afafka iyo lamacaamilkii bulshooyinka kala geddisan. Bilowgii 1962dii ayuu Soomaaliya ku soo laabtay. Maalin keli ah kaddib soo-noqoshadiisii ayuu wariyanimo kaga shaqo bilaabay Wasaaraddii Warfaafinta, isagoo noqday wariyaha baarlamaanka ee wargeyskii af Talyaaniga ku soo bixi jiray ee Il Corriere della Somalia. Bartamihii lixdannadii ayuu ka hawlgalay Wakaaladda Wararka Soomaaliyeed (SONNA), halkaas oo uu ka qabtay xilal kala duwan, uuna mar noqday Siihayaha Madaxa Wakaaladda. Waxa kale oo uu warar u diri jiray wakaalado wararka caalamka gudbiya. Shaqadiisii saxaafadeed waxay u sahashay inuu si dhow ula socdo geeddisocodkii siyaasadeed ee Jamhuuriyaddii curdinka ahayd, fadhiyadii baarlamaanka, isbeddelladii maamulka iyo doodihii la xiriiray dhismaha dawladnimada. Sidaas ayuu ku kasbaday waayo-aragnimo uu markii danbe ka anbaqaaday shaqadiisii diblomaasiyadeed iyo qoraalladiisii taariikhiga ahaa. Waxa uu marba dhinac ka dersayay siyaasaddii dalka, isagoo dhacdooyin badan goobjoog u ahaa, kuwo kalena xogtooda ururinayay. Intii uu saxaafadda ka shaqaynayay, waxa uu safarro ku tegay dibedda. Anita S. Adam, oo ay SONNA ka wadashaqayn jireen, waxay xustay in safar uu Maraykanka ku tegay 1963 uu kaga qaybgalay socodkii taariikhiga ahaa ee March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom, oo lagu qabtay Washington, D.C., 28kii Agoosto 1963kii. Socodkaasi wuxuu ka mid ahaa dhacdooyinkii waaweynaa ee halgankii xuquuqda madaniga  ee Maraykanka. Sannadkii 1965, markii uu siihayaha SONNA ahaa, wuxuu, sidoo kale, ka mid noqday wafdi Wasiirkii Warfaafinta u raacay Maraykanka. 1967dii ayuu ku biiray diblomaasiyiintii Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda ee Jamhuuriyaddii Soomaaliya. 13kii Jannaayo 1968 ayuu Landhan ( London ) gaaray, isagoo la socday Danjire Axmed Jaamac Cabdille ( Jangali ). Hawshiisii diblomaasiyadeed ee ugu horraysay wuxuu ku bilaabay darajada Attaché, waxaana loo xilsaaray maamulka, maaliyadda iyo saxaafadda safaaradda. 1968–1972 wuxuu ka hawlgalay safaaradihii Soomaaliya ee UK iyo Shiinaha, isagoo Landhan ka noqday Uqaybsanaha Maamulka, Biijiinna ka soo qabtay xilka Xoghayaha Koowaad. Muddadii uu Biijiin joogay, wuxuu ku sugnaa Shiinaha xilligii booqashadii Madaxweyne Maxamed Siyaad Barre ee sannadkii 1972. Aqoontiisii af Jayniiska, oo uu safarkiisii waxbarasho ku soo bartay, ayaa qayb ka ahayd waxtarkii uu ku lahaa hawlaha safaaradda. Sidaas ayuu marxaladdii hore ee mihnaddiisa diblomaasiyadeed uga soo dhammaystay laba xarumood oo mug weyn ku lahaa xiriirkii dibedda ee Soomaaliya. Markii uu dalka ku soo laabtay, wuxuu ka mid noqday saraakiishii Waaxda Habmaamuuska ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda. 1972–1976 waxa uu ahaa Madaxa Habmaamuuska ( Chief of Protocol ) ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda, xilkaas oo uu mar kale qabtay sannadkii 1980. Isaga qudhiisu wuxuu xusay inuu guud ahaan ku dhowaad lix sano iyo bar soo hayay xilkaas. Muddadii uu hoggaaminayay Waaxda Habmaamuuska, wuxuu ku hawllanaa nidaaminta, hagidda iyo isku-dubbaridka booqashooyinka madaxda dawladaha, soodhowaynta wufuudda caalamiga ah, xiriirka safaaradaha iyo habsami u socodka hawlaha habmaamuuska qaranka. Waxay ahayd hawl u baahnayd xilkasnimo, waaqacfahan, aqoon durugsan oo habraacyada diblomaasiyadda ah iyo ku-xeeldheeraan xiriirka dawladaha. Hawlaha WAAWEYN ee aan ku xusuusan karno Danjire Maxamed Cusmaan Cumar waxaa ka mid ah kaalintii uu ku lahaa furiddii iyo sees-u-dhiggii Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Tansaaniya, oo uu markii danbe ka hawlgalay, inkastoo faahfaahinta kaalintiisa furitaanka safaaraddaasi ay weli u baahan tahay maragsugid dheeraad ah. Waxaase si gaar ah loogu xusuustaa sidii uu u maamulay, una hagay, isaga oo dabcanna kaashanaya saraakiishii Waaxda Habmaamuuska ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda, habsami-u-socodka iyo qabsoomidda Shirmadaxeedkii Ururkii Midnimada Afrika (OAU) ee lagu qabtay Muqdisho, sannadkii 1974tii. Wuxuu ka mid ahaa dadkii garwadeenka ka ahaa hawlaha habmaamuuska iyo qabanqaabada shirkaas, oo ahaa dhacdo mug weyn ku lahayd sooyaalkii diblomaasiyadda Soomaaliya. Shirkaasi waxa uu ahaa mid ka mid ah shirarkii caalamiga ahaa ee ugu waaweynaa ee Muqdisho martigeliso xilligii dawladdii dhexe, waxaana hirgelintiisa gacan weyn ka geystay hay’adihii iyo saraakiishii loo xilsaaray qabanqaabadiisa. Bishii Juun 1976, waxa loo diray Dehraan ( Tehran ), caasimadda Iiraan, isagoo ahaa Chargé d’Affaires . Waxa loo xilsaaray yagleeliddii safaaraddii joogtada ahayd ee ugu horraysay ee Soomaaliya ku yeelato Iiraan, inta laga magacaabayo danjire rasmi ah. Hawshaasi waxay ahayd seesudhig hay’adeed oo isugu jiray diyaarinta xarunta safaaradda, nidaaminta shaqadeeda iyo hirgelinta hawlihii xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee labada dal. Intii u dhexaysay 1976–1979, waxa uu xilal diblomaasiyadeed, oo ay ku jirto la-talintii koowaad, ka soo qabtay safaaradihii Soomaaliya ee Iiraan iyo Tansaaniya. Bilowgii 1978dii ayuu gaaray Daarusalaam (Dar es Salaam), halkaas oo ay xilligaas ku taallay xarunta Guddiga Xoraynta ee Ururkii Midnimada Afrika. Tansaaniya waxay markaas ahayd saldhig muhiim u ah dhaqdhaqaaqyadii gobannimadoonka Afrika iyo dadaalladii loogu jiray xoraynta dalalkii weli ku jiray gacanta gumaysiga. Sidaas darteed, hawlihiisii halkaasi waxay ku soo beegmeen marxalad ay diblomaasiyadda Afrika ku foorartay arrimaha gobannimada iyo isgarabsiinta dalalka qaaradda. Sannadkii 1979kii, waxa uu muddo kooban ka shaqeeyay Belgarayd (Belgrade), isaga oo qayb ka ahaa hawlihii seesudhigga Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Yugoslavia. Jannaayo 1980 ayuu Muqdisho ku soo laabtay, waxaana mar kale loo magacaabay Madaxa Habmaamuuska ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda. Hawshaas wuxuu sii waday ilaa 1982dii, markaas oo uu u gudbay heerkii ugu sarreeyay ee mihnaddiisa diblomaasiyadeed. 1982dii waxa loo magacaabay Danjiraha Soomaaliya ee Suudaan, xaruntiisuna waxay noqotay Kharduun (Khartoum). Magacaabistaasi waxay ku soo beegantay xilli uu muddo 22 sano ah ka soo shaqaynayay hay’adaha dawladda, 15 sannadoodna ka tirsanaa Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda. Suudaan waxa uu danjire ka ahaa ilaa bartamihii 1986dii, isagoo muddadaas Soomaaliya u metelayay dalkaas. Bishii Luulyo 1986 waxa uu noqday Danjiraha Soomaaliya ee Yugoslavia, isagoo fadhiisinkiisu ahaa Belgarayd, oo uu hore uga soo shaqeeyay. Yugoslavia waxay xilligaas ka mid ahayd dalalkii miisaanka ku lahaa dhaqdhaqaaqii dalalka dhexdhexaadka ahaa (Non-Aligned Movement). Waxa uu xilkaas hayay ilaa 1989kii, markaas oo loo wareejiyay saldhig kale oo diblomaasiyadeed. Bishii Juun 1989 waxa loo magacaabay Danjiraha Soomaaliya ee Hindiya, xaruntiisuna waxay ahayd Niyuu Delhi (New Delhi). Isla muddadaas waxa uu Soomaaliya danjire uga ahaa Sri Lanka iyo Singapore. Waxa uu xilkaas ku jiray markii ay burburtay dawladdii dhexe ee Soomaaliya 1991. Burburkaasi waxa uu ahaa dhacdo si toos ah u saamaysay hawshii uu qaranka u hayay, waxaana waayahaas iyo dhacdooyinkii ka horreeyay uu si qoto dheer uga warramay buuggiisii The Road to Zero: Somalia’s Self-Destruction. Buuggaas waxa uu qayb weyn ka qoray Niyuu Delhi, isaga oo isku dubbariday xusuustiisii, waaya-aragnimadiisii iyo dhacdooyinkii siyaasadeed ee uu goobjoogga u ahaa. Sidaas darteed, in badan oo noloshiisa ka mid ah waxa uu ahaa diblomaasi, isagoo ka soo shaqeeyay Landhan (London), Biijiin (Beijing), Dehraan (Tehran), Daarusalaam (Dar es Salaam), Kharduun (Khartoum), Belgarayd (Belgrade) iyo Niyuu Delhi (New Delhi). Saddexda xarumood ee ugu danbeeya ayuu si rasmi ah danjire uga ahaa, halka kuwii hore uu xilal kale oo diblomaasiyadeed ka soo qabtay. Waa geeddisocod shaqo oo muujinaya sida uu uga soo gudbay hawlihii maamulka iyo saxaafadda ilaa heerkii danjiranimada, isaga oo marxalad kasta la soo kulmay duruufo siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed oo kala geddisan. Burburkii dawladdii dhexe ka dibna kama uusan harin hawlaha diblomaasiyadda iyo u-adeegidda dalka. Muddadii u dhexaysay 2000–2004, xilligii maamulkii Madaxweyne Cabdiqaasin Salaad Xasan, waxa uu ka shaqaynayay arrimaha xiriirka caalamiga ah iyo diblomaasiyadda Soomaaliya. Waxaa kale oo lagu xusuustaa furitaankii Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Tuunis, oo Danjire Cabdisalaan Xaaji Axmed Liibaan, oo ay wadashaqayn jireen, si gaar ah ugu xusay tacsidii laga qoray geeridiisa. Hawlahaasi waxay muujinayaan inuu sii anbaqaaday shaqadii uu muddada dheer ku soo dhex jiray, xitaa xilligii ay hay’adihii dawladda Soomaaliyeed burbureen. Wuxuu ahaa luuqadaale (multilingual speaker), isagoo ku hadli jiray afaf dhawr ah, sida af Soomaali, af Carabi, af Ingiriisi, af Talyaani iyo af Jayniis (Mandarin). Waxa kale oo uu aqoon u lahaa af Isbaanish, af Faransiis iyo af Hindi. Aqoontiisa afafka, aqoonkororsigii uu dibedda ku soo sameeyay iyo waaya-aragnimadii uu bulshooyinka kala duwan ka helay ayaa qayb ka ahaa garaadkobcintiisa iyo fahamkii uu u lahaa dhaqammada, siyaasadaha iyo xiriirka dawladaha. Dhan kale, Danjire Maxamed wuxuu ahaa qoraa iyo taariikhyahan ruugcaddaa ah—waana ii sharaf ah in aan ku bartay akhrinta buugaggiisa. Qalin macaan iyo af Ingiriisi fudud buu iigu suntan yahay. Qoraalladiisa waxa si gaar ah loogu gartaa taariikhwerin hufan, habwarineed dhiirran iyo gorfayn uu ku laray waaya-aragnimadii uu shaqadiisa ka dhaxlay. Wuxuu isku soohi jiray dhacdooyinkii uu goobjoogga u ahaa, xusuustiisii shakhsiga ahayd iyo xogihii uu ka soo ururiyay ilaha taariikheed, isagoo akhristaha u furayay dariiq uu ku fahmi karo sooyaalkii siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, marxaladihii dawladdhisku soo maray iyo sida taaganta loo fahmi karo.  Qoraalladiisa waxaa ka dhex muuqda dadaal uu ku raadraacayay dhacdooyinkii gumaysiga, halgankii gobannimadoonka, dhismihii dawladnimada, xiriirkii dibedda iyo sababihii horseeday burburkii dawladdii dhexe. Qayb ka mid ah waxsoosaarkiisu waa xusuusqor ku salaysan xog uu gacantii kowaad ka helay, halka qaybaha kalana ay yihiin cilmibaaris taariikheed oo uu ku dhiraandhiriyay dhacdooyin, ku kala miiray xogaha, kuna lafaguray siyaasadihii iyo duruufihii dalka soo maray. Sidaas ayay qoraalladiisu isugu noqdeen xusuusqor nololeed, maragfur taariikheed iyo dhaxal aqooneed. Wuxuu qoray buugag ay ugu magacdheer yihiin The Road to Zero: Somalia’s Self-Destruction (1992), oo ah xusuusqor taariikheed uu kaga warramayo waayihii siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo geeddisocodkii horseeday burburkii dawladda; Somalia: A Nation Driven to Despair: A Case of Leadership Failure (1996), oo uu ku lafaguray hoggaankii siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo dhibaatooyinkii ka dhashay burburkii qaranka; The Scramble in the Horn of Africa: History of Somalia, 1827–1977 (2001), oo ah dhigaal taariikheed mug weyn; Somalia: Between Devils and Deep Sea (2004), oo uu ku gorfeeyay dhacdooyinkii Geeska Afrika iyo duruufihii Soomaaliya; iyo Somalia: Past and Present (2006), oo dibujaleecis ku samaynaya sooyaalkii Soomaaliya, laga soo bilaabo waayihii gumaysiga ilaa marxaladihii siyaasadeed ee xigay. Waxaa kale oo uu qoray buugga af Soomaali ah ee Diblomaasiyad iyo Habmaamuus, kaas oo ka hadlaya diblomaasiyadda iyo habmaamuuska dawladnimo. Waa buugga keliya ee aan markii hore ogaa inuu af Soomaali ku qoray. Hasayeeshee, waxaa jira Somaaliya: Horay iyo Hadda, oo ah nooca af Soomaaliga ee Somalia: Past and Present, kuna jira Kaydka Cilmibaarista Soomaaliyeed ee Jaamacadda Roma Tre. Buuggaasi wuxuu ka midyahay qoraalladiisa ku saabsan sooyaalka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo dhacdooyinkii raadadka waaweyn ku reebay dalka. Buugaggiisa waxaa si gaar ah uga dhex muuqda The Scramble in the Horn of Africa: History of Somalia, 1827–1977, oo uu ku ururiyay xog taariikheed iyo dukumentiyo badan oo uu ka soo raadraacay kaydadka caalamiga ah. Ilaha uu u cuskaday cilmibaaristiisa waxaa ka mid ahaa Kaydka Qaranka Hindiya, Maktabadda Qaranka Talyaaniga, Machadkii ISIAO, Kaydka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda ee Ingiriiska, kaydadka madxafyada dagaalka iyo ciidammada cirka ee Ingiriiska iyo Maktabadda Congress-ka Maraykanka. Habkaas cilmibaariseed waxa uu muujinayaa dadaalkii uu geliyay baadisoocidda xogaha, raadraaca ilaha, maragsugidda dhacdooyinka iyo isku dubbaridka dukumentiyada taariikheed. Halkii uu ku ekaan lahaa xusuuskaashi iyo wartebin afeed, wuxuu iskudayay inuu dhigo taariikh ku qotonta xog, maragfur iyo dukumentiyo ay akhristayaasha iyo cilmibaarayaasha dambe dib ugu noqon karaan. Waxa uu sidaas ku kaydiyay qayb ka mid ah xusuusta ummadeed, isagoo dhacdooyin badan oo halmaan taariikheed geli karay ku soo bandhigay qoraal iyo caddaymo raadraac leh. Waxaa kale oo qoraalladiisa laga dheehan karaa aragtidiisii ku aaddan qaranimada, dawladnimada iyo aaya-ka-talinta Soomaaliyeed. Intii uu diblomaasiyadda ku soo jiray waxa uu la kulmay hoggaamiyeyaal, saraakiil iyo diblomaasiyiin ka kala socday dalal badan, waxaana waaya-aragnimadaasi u noqotay il uu ka ambaqaado milicsigiisa taariikheed. Taariikhayntiisu, sidaas darteed, kuma koobnayn soo tebinta dhacdooyinkii hore; waxa kale oo ay xambaarsanayd gorfayn ku saabsan hoggaanka, danaha qaranka iyo casharradii laga baran karay waayihii Soomaaliya soo martay. Dhanka kale, Danjire Maxamed wuxuu ahaa nin ku dheggan dhaqankiisii iyo sooyaalkiisii Reer Xamar. Anita S. Adam, oo muddo dheer taqaannay, waxay ku tilmaantay nin bulshaawi ah, martisoorka jecel, sheeko iyo maad badan, aqoon dheerna u lahaa dhaqanka iyo taariikhda bulshada Reer Xamarka ah. Wuxuu ka soo jeeday beesha Shaanshi, oo ka mid ah beelaha Reer Xamar, waxaana lagu xusuustaa sida uu ugu faani jiray sooyaalka bulshadiisa, gaar ahaan kaalintii ay ku lahayd fidinta diinta Islaamka, dhaqanka magaalooyinka Banaadir iyo halgankii gobannimadoonka. Wuxuu jeclaa inuu dadka la wadaago sheekooyin iyo xusuus ku saabsan noloshii hore, dhaqankii magaalada iyo waayihii uu ku soo barbaaray. Waxaa kale oo lagu xusuustaa martisoorkiisa iyo habka uu dadka ula dhaqmi jiray. Sifooyinkaas shakhsiyadeed waxay dhinac kale ka iftiiminayaan taariikhnololeedkiisa, oo inta badan lagu derso xilalkii uu soo qabtay iyo qoraalladii uu ka tegay. Noloshiisa qoys, wuxuu muddo ka badan nus qarni la noolaa xaaskiisii Mana, oo geeriyootay 2009kii. Waxay isu dhaleen shan wiil iyo laba gabdhood. Qoyskiisa iyo dadkii aqoonta u lahaa waxay xusuustaan noloshiisii shakhsiga ahayd, saaxiibbadiisna waxay ka marag fureen waxqabadkiisii, aqoontiisii iyo kaalintii uu ku lahaa u-adeegidda dalka. Marka laga yimaaddo shaqadii uu qaranka u qabtay, waxsoosaarkiisa qoraaleed waxaa loo arki karaa dadaal uu ku badbaadinayay qayb ka mid ah xusuusta ummadeed iyo dhaxalka taariikheed ee Soomaaliya. Wuxuu diiwaangeliyay dhacdooyin, ururiyay xog iyo dukumentiyo, dhiraandhiriyay siyaasado, isla markaasna ka tegay xusuusqor iyo dhigaallo taariikheed oo ay jiilasha danbe ka anbaqaadi karaan aqoonraadis iyo cilmibaaris cusub. Kaydinta dhaxalka qoraalka ahi ma aha oo keliya dhowrista buug ama waraaq duug ah; sidoo kale, waa dhowrista caddaymaha iyo xusuusta lagu raadraaci karo sooyaalka bulsho iyo geeddisocodka nolosheeda. Alle ha u naxariistee, Danjire Maxamed Cusmaan Cumar waxa uu Landhan ku geeriyooday 4tii Oktoobar 2014, isaga oo 77 jir ah. Geeridiisu waxay soo afmeertay nolol dheer oo ku suntan xilgudasho, u-adeegid qaran, diblomaasiyad iyo taariikhwerin. Wuxuu ka tegay dhaxal aqooneed iyo raad taariikheed oo mudan in la dhowro, la derso, lana sii taabbageliyo. Buugaggiisa iyo xusuusqorradiisu waa ilo laga tisqaadi karo qaybo ka mid ah sooyaalkii siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya, laga soo bilaabo waayihii wisaayada ilaa burburkii dawladdii dhexe. Waxa kale oo ay qayb ka yihiin silsiladda aqooneed ee jiilba jiilka ka danbeeya u dhiibo xogta, xusuusta iyo waaya-aragnimada qaranka, si aysan ugu lumin halmaan taariikheed. Danjire Maxamed Cusmaan Cumar, sidaas darteed, wuxuu ugu horreeyaa Soomaalida farakutiriska ah ee qayb noloshooda ka mid ah ku soo qaatay, shaqadoodana kaga qaybqaatay, marxalado waaweyn oo taariikhda dalka ah; dabadeedna ku dadaalay inay dhacdooyinkaasi yeeshaan kayd qoran oo laga dhaxlo aqoon, waaya-aragnimo iyo cibaaro taariikheed.
items.fullContent: Danjire Maxamed Cusmaan Cumar wuxuu ku dhashay Xamar, 1937dii. Wuxuu ka mid ahaa Soomaalidii ku soo hanaqaadday waayihii gumaysiga, kuna ababay xilligii uu dalku ku jiray marxaladdii kalaguurka ee gobannimadoonka iyo sees-u-dhiggii dawladnimada Soomaaliyeed. Isaga oo da’ yar ayuu shaqo dawladeed bilaabay, taas oo markii danbe u ibafurtay mihnad dheer oo ku suntan u-adeegidda qaranka, saxaafadda, diblomaasiyadda iyo werinta taariikhda. Kontonnadii qarnigii tagay ayuu shaqaale ka noqday Wisaayadii Koonfureed ee Qaramada Midoobay. Shaqadiisii ugu horraysay wuxuuu ka bilaabay Boostada Guud, halkaas oo uu ka gaaray xilka Kormeeraha Guud  ee Waaxda Lacagaha. Wuxuu ka mid ahaa Soomaalidii ugu horraysay ee xilalka kala wareegtay shaqaalihii Talyaaniga, xilligii ay socotay Soomaaliyaynta hay’adaha dawliga ah. Isla sannadahaas ayuu ka hawlgalay Golihii Shacabka ee Daakhiliyada (Constituent Assembly), isagoo ka mid ahaa shaqaalihii diiwaangelinayay doodaha iyo fadhiyada Golaha, xilligii loo diyaargaroobayay madaxbannaanida Soomaaliya. Hawlahaasi waxay barbilow u ahaayeen waaya-aragnimadiisii maamulka, dawladnimada iyo habraacyada hay’adaha qaranka. Xornimadii kaddib, sannadkii 1960kii, wuxuuu ka mid noqday 41 dhallinyaro Soomaaliyeed oo deeq waxbarasho loogu diray Jamhuuriyadda Shacabka Shiinaha. Waxay Muqdisho ka anbabaxeen, iyaga oo sii maray Rooma, Fiyeena, Baraag iyo Moosko, dabadeedna tareenka Trans-Siberian ku tegay Biijiin, oo ay gaareen bartamihii Nofeenbar 1960. Muddadii uu Shiinaha joogay wuxuu ku bartay afka Jayniiska ( Mandarin ), isagoo isla markaana aqoonkororsi iyo waaya-aragnimo nololeed ka helay bulsho, dhaqan iyo habnololeed ka duwanaa kuwii uu ku soo barbaaray. Safarkaasi wuxuu ka mid noqday waayihii waxbarasho ee raadadka muuqda ku reebay noloshiisii danbe, gaar ahaan, ku-xeeldheeraantii afafka iyo lamacaamilkii bulshooyinka kala geddisan. Bilowgii 1962dii ayuu Soomaaliya ku soo laabtay. Maalin keli ah kaddib soo-noqoshadiisii ayuu wariyanimo kaga shaqo bilaabay Wasaaraddii Warfaafinta, isagoo noqday wariyaha baarlamaanka ee wargeyskii af Talyaaniga ku soo bixi jiray ee Il Corriere della Somalia. Bartamihii lixdannadii ayuu ka hawlgalay Wakaaladda Wararka Soomaaliyeed (SONNA), halkaas oo uu ka qabtay xilal kala duwan, uuna mar noqday Siihayaha Madaxa Wakaaladda. Waxa kale oo uu warar u diri jiray wakaalado wararka caalamka gudbiya. Shaqadiisii saxaafadeed waxay u sahashay inuu si dhow ula socdo geeddisocodkii siyaasadeed ee Jamhuuriyaddii curdinka ahayd, fadhiyadii baarlamaanka, isbeddelladii maamulka iyo doodihii la xiriiray dhismaha dawladnimada. Sidaas ayuu ku kasbaday waayo-aragnimo uu markii danbe ka anbaqaaday shaqadiisii diblomaasiyadeed iyo qoraalladiisii taariikhiga ahaa. Waxa uu marba dhinac ka dersayay siyaasaddii dalka, isagoo dhacdooyin badan goobjoog u ahaa, kuwo kalena xogtooda ururinayay. Intii uu saxaafadda ka shaqaynayay, waxa uu safarro ku tegay dibedda. Anita S. Adam, oo ay SONNA ka wadashaqayn jireen, waxay xustay in safar uu Maraykanka ku tegay 1963 uu kaga qaybgalay socodkii taariikhiga ahaa ee March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom, oo lagu qabtay Washington, D.C., 28kii Agoosto 1963kii. Socodkaasi wuxuu ka mid ahaa dhacdooyinkii waaweynaa ee halgankii xuquuqda madaniga  ee Maraykanka. Waxaase si gaar ah loogu xusuustaa sidii uu u maamulay, una hagay, isaga oo dabcanna kaashanaya saraakiishii Waaxda Habmaamuuska ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda, habsami-u-socodka iyo qabsoomidda Shirmadaxeedkii Ururkii Midnimada Afrika (OAU) ee lagu qabtay Muqdisho, sannadkii 1974tii. Wuxuu ka mid ahaa dadkii garwadeenka ka ahaa hawlaha habmaamuuska iyo qabanqaabada shirkaas, oo ahaa dhacdo mug weyn ku lahayd sooyaalkii diblomaasiyadda Soomaaliya. Shirkaasi waxa uu ahaa mid ka mid ah shirarkii caalamiga ahaa ee ugu waaweynaa ee Muqdisho martigeliso xilligii dawladdii dhexe, waxaana hirgelintiisa gacan weyn ka geystay hay’adihii iyo saraakiishii loo xilsaaray qabanqaabadiisa. Bishii Juun 1976, waxa loo diray Dehraan ( Tehran ), caasimadda Iiraan, isagoo ahaa Chargé d’Affaires . Waxa loo xilsaaray yagleeliddii safaaraddii joogtada ahayd ee ugu horraysay ee Soomaaliya ku yeelato Iiraan, inta laga magacaabayo danjire rasmi ah. Hawshaasi waxay ahayd seesudhig hay’adeed oo isugu jiray diyaarinta xarunta safaaradda, nidaaminta shaqadeeda iyo hirgelinta hawlihii xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee labada dal. Intii u dhexaysay 1976–1979, waxa uu xilal diblomaasiyadeed, oo ay ku jirto la-talintii koowaad, ka soo qabtay safaaradihii Soomaaliya ee Iiraan iyo Tansaaniya. Bilowgii 1978dii ayuu gaaray Daarusalaam (Dar es Salaam), halkaas oo ay xilligaas ku taallay xarunta Guddiga Xoraynta ee Ururkii Midnimada Afrika. Tansaaniya waxay markaas ahayd saldhig muhiim u ah dhaqdhaqaaqyadii gobannimadoonka Afrika iyo dadaalladii loogu jiray xoraynta dalalkii weli ku jiray gacanta gumaysiga. Sidaas darteed, hawlihiisii halkaasi waxay ku soo beegmeen marxalad ay diblomaasiyadda Afrika ku foorartay arrimaha gobannimada iyo isgarabsiinta dalalka qaaradda. Sannadkii 1979kii, waxa uu muddo kooban ka shaqeeyay Belgarayd (Belgrade), isaga oo qayb ka ahaa hawlihii seesudhigga Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Yugoslavia. Jannaayo 1980 ayuu Muqdisho ku soo laabtay, waxaana mar kale loo magacaabay Madaxa Habmaamuuska ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda. Hawshaas wuxuu sii waday ilaa 1982dii, markaas oo uu u gudbay heerkii ugu sarreeyay ee mihnaddiisa diblomaasiyadeed. 1982dii waxa loo magacaabay Danjiraha Soomaaliya ee Suudaan, xaruntiisuna waxay noqotay Kharduun (Khartoum). Magacaabistaasi waxay ku soo beegantay xilli uu muddo 22 sano ah ka soo shaqaynayay hay’adaha dawladda, 15 sannadoodna ka tirsanaa Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda. Suudaan waxa uu danjire ka ahaa ilaa bartamihii 1986dii, isagoo muddadaas Soomaaliya u metelayay dalkaas. Bishii Luulyo 1986 waxa uu noqday Danjiraha Soomaaliya ee Yugoslavia, isagoo fadhiisinkiisu ahaa Belgarayd, oo uu hore uga soo shaqeeyay. Yugoslavia waxay xilligaas ka mid ahayd dalalkii miisaanka ku lahaa dhaqdhaqaaqii dalalka dhexdhexaadka ahaa (Non-Aligned Movement). Waxa uu xilkaas hayay ilaa 1989kii, markaas oo loo wareejiyay saldhig kale oo diblomaasiyadeed. Bishii Juun 1989 waxa loo magacaabay Danjiraha Soomaaliya ee Hindiya, xaruntiisuna waxay ahayd Niyuu Delhi (New Delhi). Isla muddadaas waxa uu Soomaaliya danjire uga ahaa Sri Lanka iyo Singapore. Waxa uu xilkaas ku jiray markii ay burburtay dawladdii dhexe ee Soomaaliya 1991. Burburkaasi waxa uu ahaa dhacdo si toos ah u saamaysay hawshii uu qaranka u hayay, waxaana waayahaas iyo dhacdooyinkii ka horreeyay uu si qoto dheer uga warramay buuggiisii The Road to Zero: Somalia’s Self-Destruction. Buuggaas waxa uu qayb weyn ka qoray Niyuu Delhi, isaga oo isku dubbariday xusuustiisii, waaya-aragnimadiisii iyo dhacdooyinkii siyaasadeed ee uu goobjoogga u ahaa. Sidaas darteed, in badan oo noloshiisa ka mid ah waxa uu ahaa diblomaasi, isagoo ka soo shaqeeyay Landhan (London), Biijiin (Beijing), Dehraan (Tehran), Daarusalaam (Dar es Salaam), Kharduun (Khartoum), Belgarayd (Belgrade) iyo Niyuu Delhi (New Delhi). Saddexda xarumood ee ugu danbeeya ayuu si rasmi ah danjire uga ahaa, halka kuwii hore uu xilal kale oo diblomaasiyadeed ka soo qabtay. Waa geeddisocod shaqo oo muujinaya sida uu uga soo gudbay hawlihii maamulka iyo saxaafadda ilaa heerkii danjiranimada, isaga oo marxalad kasta la soo kulmay duruufo siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed oo kala geddisan. Burburkii dawladdii dhexe ka dibna kama uusan harin hawlaha diblomaasiyadda iyo u-adeegidda dalka. Muddadii u dhexaysay 2000–2004, xilligii maamulkii Madaxweyne Cabdiqaasin Salaad Xasan, waxa uu ka shaqaynayay arrimaha xiriirka caalamiga ah iyo diblomaasiyadda Soomaaliya. Waxaa kale oo lagu xusuustaa furitaankii Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Tuunis, oo Danjire Cabdisalaan Xaaji Axmed Liibaan, oo ay wadashaqayn jireen, si gaar ah ugu xusay tacsidii laga qoray geeridiisa. Hawlahaasi waxay muujinayaan inuu sii anbaqaaday shaqadii uu muddada dheer ku soo dhex jiray, xitaa xilligii ay hay’adihii dawladda Soomaaliyeed burbureen. Wuxuu ahaa luuqadaale (multilingual speaker), isagoo ku hadli jiray afaf dhawr ah, sida af Soomaali, af Carabi, af Ingiriisi, af Talyaani iyo af Jayniis (Mandarin). Waxa kale oo uu aqoon u lahaa af Isbaanish, af Faransiis iyo af Hindi. Aqoontiisa afafka, aqoonkororsigii uu dibedda ku soo sameeyay iyo waaya-aragnimadii uu bulshooyinka kala duwan ka helay ayaa qayb ka ahaa garaadkobcintiisa iyo fahamkii uu u lahaa dhaqammada, siyaasadaha iyo xiriirka dawladaha. Dhan kale, Danjire Maxamed wuxuu ahaa qoraa iyo taariikhyahan ruugcaddaa ah—waana ii sharaf ah in aan ku bartay akhrinta buugaggiisa. Qalin macaan iyo af Ingiriisi fudud buu iigu suntan yahay. Qoraalladiisa waxa si gaar ah loogu gartaa taariikhwerin hufan, habwarineed dhiirran iyo gorfayn uu ku laray waaya-aragnimadii uu shaqadiisa ka dhaxlay. Wuxuu isku soohi jiray dhacdooyinkii uu goobjoogga u ahaa, xusuustiisii shakhsiga ahayd iyo xogihii uu ka soo ururiyay ilaha taariikheed, isagoo akhristaha u furayay dariiq uu ku fahmi karo sooyaalkii siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, marxaladihii dawladdhisku soo maray iyo sida taaganta loo fahmi karo.  Qoraalladiisa waxaa ka dhex muuqda dadaal uu ku raadraacayay dhacdooyinkii gumaysiga, halgankii gobannimadoonka, dhismihii dawladnimada, xiriirkii dibedda iyo sababihii horseeday burburkii dawladdii dhexe. Qayb ka mid ah waxsoosaarkiisu waa xusuusqor ku salaysan xog uu gacantii kowaad ka helay, halka qaybaha kalana ay yihiin cilmibaaris taariikheed oo uu ku dhiraandhiriyay dhacdooyin, ku kala miiray xogaha, kuna lafaguray siyaasadihii iyo duruufihii dalka soo maray. Sidaas ayay qoraalladiisu isugu noqdeen xusuusqor nololeed, maragfur taariikheed iyo dhaxal aqooneed. Wuxuu qoray buugag ay ugu magacdheer yihiin The Road to Zero: Somalia’s Self-Destruction (1992), oo ah xusuusqor taariikheed uu kaga warramayo waayihii siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo geeddisocodkii horseeday burburkii dawladda; Somalia: A Nation Driven to Despair: A Case of Leadership Failure (1996), oo uu ku lafaguray hoggaankii siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo dhibaatooyinkii ka dhashay burburkii qaranka; The Scramble in the Horn of Africa: History of Somalia, 1827–1977 (2001), oo ah dhigaal taariikheed mug weyn; Somalia: Between Devils and Deep Sea (2004), oo uu ku gorfeeyay dhacdooyinkii Geeska Afrika iyo duruufihii Soomaaliya; iyo Somalia: Past and Present (2006), oo dibujaleecis ku samaynaya sooyaalkii Soomaaliya, laga soo bilaabo waayihii gumaysiga ilaa marxaladihii siyaasadeed ee xigay. Waxaa kale oo uu qoray buugga af Soomaali ah ee Diblomaasiyad iyo Habmaamuus, kaas oo ka hadlaya diblomaasiyadda iyo habmaamuuska dawladnimo. Waa buugga keliya ee aan markii hore ogaa inuu af Soomaali ku qoray. Hasayeeshee, waxaa jira Somaaliya: Horay iyo Hadda, oo ah nooca af Soomaaliga ee Somalia: Past and Present, kuna jira Kaydka Cilmibaarista Soomaaliyeed ee Jaamacadda Roma Tre. Buuggaasi wuxuu ka midyahay qoraalladiisa ku saabsan sooyaalka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo dhacdooyinkii raadadka waaweyn ku reebay dalka. Buugaggiisa waxaa si gaar ah uga dhex muuqda The Scramble in the Horn of Africa: History of Somalia, 1827–1977, oo uu ku ururiyay xog taariikheed iyo dukumentiyo badan oo uu ka soo raadraacay kaydadka caalamiga ah. Ilaha uu u cuskaday cilmibaaristiisa waxaa ka mid ahaa Kaydka Qaranka Hindiya, Maktabadda Qaranka Talyaaniga, Machadkii ISIAO, Kaydka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda ee Ingiriiska, kaydadka madxafyada dagaalka iyo ciidammada cirka ee Ingiriiska iyo Maktabadda Congress-ka Maraykanka. Habkaas cilmibaariseed waxa uu muujinayaa dadaalkii uu geliyay baadisoocidda xogaha, raadraaca ilaha, maragsugidda dhacdooyinka iyo isku dubbaridka dukumentiyada taariikheed. Halkii uu ku ekaan lahaa xusuuskaashi iyo wartebin afeed, wuxuu iskudayay inuu dhigo taariikh ku qotonta xog, maragfur iyo dukumentiyo ay akhristayaasha iyo cilmibaarayaasha dambe dib ugu noqon karaan. Waxa uu sidaas ku kaydiyay qayb ka mid ah xusuusta ummadeed, isagoo dhacdooyin badan oo halmaan taariikheed geli karay ku soo bandhigay qoraal iyo caddaymo raadraac leh. Waxaa kale oo qoraalladiisa laga dheehan karaa aragtidiisii ku aaddan qaranimada, dawladnimada iyo aaya-ka-talinta Soomaaliyeed. Intii uu diblomaasiyadda ku soo jiray waxa uu la kulmay hoggaamiyeyaal, saraakiil iyo diblomaasiyiin ka kala socday dalal badan, waxaana waaya-aragnimadaasi u noqotay il uu ka ambaqaado milicsigiisa taariikheed. Taariikhayntiisu, sidaas darteed, kuma koobnayn soo tebinta dhacdooyinkii hore; waxa kale oo ay xambaarsanayd gorfayn ku saabsan hoggaanka, danaha qaranka iyo casharradii laga baran karay waayihii Soomaaliya soo martay. Dhanka kale, Danjire Maxamed wuxuu ahaa nin ku dheggan dhaqankiisii iyo sooyaalkiisii Reer Xamar. Anita S. Adam, oo muddo dheer taqaannay, waxay ku tilmaantay nin bulshaawi ah, martisoorka jecel, sheeko iyo maad badan, aqoon dheerna u lahaa dhaqanka iyo taariikhda bulshada Reer Xamarka ah. Wuxuu ka soo jeeday beesha Shaanshi, oo ka mid ah beelaha Reer Xamar, waxaana lagu xusuustaa sida uu ugu faani jiray sooyaalka bulshadiisa, gaar ahaan kaalintii ay ku lahayd fidinta diinta Islaamka, dhaqanka magaalooyinka Banaadir iyo halgankii gobannimadoonka. Wuxuu jeclaa inuu dadka la wadaago sheekooyin iyo xusuus ku saabsan noloshii hore, dhaqankii magaalada iyo waayihii uu ku soo barbaaray. Waxaa kale oo lagu xusuustaa martisoorkiisa iyo habka uu dadka ula dhaqmi jiray. Sifooyinkaas shakhsiyadeed waxay dhinac kale ka iftiiminayaan taariikhnololeedkiisa, oo inta badan lagu derso xilalkii uu soo qabtay iyo qoraalladii uu ka tegay. Noloshiisa qoys, wuxuu muddo ka badan nus qarni la noolaa xaaskiisii Mana, oo geeriyootay 2009kii. Waxay isu dhaleen shan wiil iyo laba gabdhood. Qoyskiisa iyo dadkii aqoonta u lahaa waxay xusuustaan noloshiisii shakhsiga ahayd, saaxiibbadiisna waxay ka marag fureen waxqabadkiisii, aqoontiisii iyo kaalintii uu ku lahaa u-adeegidda dalka. Marka laga yimaaddo shaqadii uu qaranka u qabtay, waxsoosaarkiisa qoraaleed waxaa loo arki karaa dadaal uu ku badbaadinayay qayb ka mid ah xusuusta ummadeed iyo dhaxalka taariikheed ee Soomaaliya. Wuxuu diiwaangeliyay dhacdooyin, ururiyay xog iyo dukumentiyo, dhiraandhiriyay siyaasado, isla markaasna ka tegay xusuusqor iyo dhigaallo taariikheed oo ay jiilasha danbe ka anbaqaadi karaan aqoonraadis iyo cilmibaaris cusub. Kaydinta dhaxalka qoraalka ahi ma aha oo keliya dhowrista buug ama waraaq duug ah; sidoo kale, waa dhowrista caddaymaha iyo xusuusta lagu raadraaci karo sooyaalka bulsho iyo geeddisocodka nolosheeda. Alle ha u naxariistee, Danjire Maxamed Cusmaan Cumar waxa uu Landhan ku geeriyooday 4tii Oktoobar 2014, isaga oo 77 jir ah. Geeridiisu waxay soo afmeertay nolol dheer oo ku suntan xilgudasho, u-adeegid qaran, diblomaasiyad iyo taariikhwerin. Wuxuu ka tegay dhaxal aqooneed iyo raad taariikheed oo mudan in la dhowro, la derso, lana sii taabbageliyo. Buugaggiisa iyo xusuusqorradiisu waa ilo laga tisqaadi karo qaybo ka mid ah sooyaalkii siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya, laga soo bilaabo waayihii wisaayada ilaa burburkii dawladdii dhexe. Waxa kale oo ay qayb ka yihiin silsiladda aqooneed ee jiilba jiilka ka danbeeya u dhiibo xogta, xusuusta iyo waaya-aragnimada qaranka, si aysan ugu lumin halmaan taariikheed. Danjire Maxamed Cusmaan Cumar, sidaas darteed, wuxuu ugu horreeyaa Soomaalida farakutiriska ah ee qayb noloshooda ka mid ah ku soo qaatay, shaqadoodana kaga qaybqaatay, marxalado waaweyn oo taariikhda dalka ah; dabadeedna ku dadaalay inay dhacdooyinkaasi yeeshaan kayd qoran oo laga dhaxlo aqoon, waaya-aragnimo iyo cibaaro taariikheed.

items.title: Masar, Soomaaliya, Suudaan iyo Eritrea oo heshiis ku gaaray xoojinta iskaashiga iyo taageerada Soomaaliya
items.description: El Alamein, 4 Oktoobar 2026 — Madaxweynayaasha Masar, Eritrea iyo Soomaaliya iyo Guddoomiyaha Golaha Madaxbannaanida Ku-meelgaarka ah ee Suudaan ayaa magaalada El Alamein ku yeeshay shir-madaxeed afargeesood ah oo diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda gobolka, amniga, madax-bannaanida dalalka iyo xoojinta iskaashiga dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed. Shirkan oo uu martigeliyay Madaxweynaha Masar, Cabdifataax Al-Siisi, ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay Madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, iyo Guddoomiyaha Golaha Madaxbannaanida Ku-meelgaarka ah ee Suudaan Cabdifataax Al-Burhaan. Madaxdu waxay isku raaceen muhiimadda ay leedahay dhowrista madax-bannaanida, wadajirka dhuleed iyo xasilloonida dalalka gobolka, iyagoo sidoo kale diiday faragelinta arrimaha gudaha iyo taageerada kooxaha ama hay’adaha ka hor imanaya hay’adaha dowladeed ee rasmiga ah. Soomaaliya oo taageero cad heshay Arrinta Soomaaliya ayaa si gaar ah uga mid ahayd qodobadii muhiimka ahaa ee shir-madaxeedka. Afarta dal ayaa ku adkeystay taageerada midnimada, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, iyagoo diiday tallaabo kasta oo wiiqi karta arrimahaas, gaar ahaan aqoonsiga waxa loogu yeero “Somaliland.” Madaxdu waxay sidoo kale taageereen dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo xoojinta awoodda hay’adaha dowladda si ay uga hawlgalaan dhammaan dalka. Waxaa sidoo kale baaq loo diray saaxiibbada gobolka iyo beesha caalamka in la siiyo AUSSOM maalgelin ku filan, waarta oo la saadaalin karo, si howlgalka Midowga Afrika uu u guto waajibaadka loo igmaday. Badda Cas iyo webiga Niil Shirku wuxuu sidoo kale diiradda saaray muhiimadda xorriyadda isu-socodka maraakiibta iyo in maamulka iyo amniga Badda Cas ay door muhiim ah ku leeyihiin dalalka xeebaha ku leh. Dhanka kale, madaxdu waxay adkeeyeen in dhammaan dalalka ay ixtiraamaan sharciga caalamiga ah ee maamula isticmaalka webiyada xuduudaha ka gudba, gaar ahaan webiga Niil. Waxay carrabka ku adkeeyeen mabaadi’da ah inaan waxyeello loo geysan dalalka kale, iyo in arrimaha biyaha lagu xalliyo wargelin, wadatashi iyo isku-raac, iyagoo diiday tallaabooyin hal dhinac ah oo waxyeello u geysan kara danaha dalalka ku yaalla qaybta hoose ee webiga Niil. Ugu dambeyn, madaxdu waxay ku heshiiyeen in la sii xoojiyo wadatashiga iyo isku-duwidda joogtada ah ee afarta dal, iyadoo la horumarinayo xiriirka siyaasadeed, dhaqaale, ganacsi iyo dhaqan, si loo gaaro xasillooni iyo horumar waara oo gobolka ah.

items.title: Ganacsade Suudaan u dhashay oo lagu dilay gudaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Dhahar (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya gobolka Sanaag ee waqooyiga Soomaaliya ayaa sheegaya in maanta halkaasi lagu dilay ganacsade ajanbi ah oo u dhashay dalka Suudaan, kaas oo ku sugnaa gudaha deegaanka Milxo ee gobolkaasi. Marxuumka ayaa waxaa lagu magacaabi jiray Cabdalle Suudaani, waxaana la sheegay inuu dilkiisa ka dambeeyay mid kamid ah ilaaladiisa oo goobta ka baxsaday, kadib dhacdada. Ilo deegaanka ah ayaa innoo xaqiijiyay in markii hore uu Cabdalle Suudaani uu dhaawac soo gaaray, balse uu ku dhintay magaalada Boosaaso oo loola cararay dhaawaciisa. Illaa iyo hadda ma jirto cid faah-faahin ka bixisay sababta rasmiga ah ee ka dambeysa dilka muwaadinkan kasoo jeeda dalka Suudaan, waxaase lasoo wariyay in marxuumka iyo askariga oo kamid ahaa ilaaladiisa gaarka ah ay wada murmeen, kadibna uu sidaas rasaas ugu furay. Ciidamada ammaanka ayaa haatan wada baaritaanno ku aadan dhacdadan, waxayna sidoo kale baadi goob ugu jiraan eedeysanaha ka dambeeyay dilka oo baxsad ka ah cadaaladda. Sida ay sheegeen dadka deegaanka, Cabdalle Suudaani ayaa muddo dheer ku sugnaa gudaha deegaanka Milxo, halkaas oo uu ka waday ganacsiyo la xiriira qodista macdanta, kala shaandheynta Dahabka iyo dhoofintiisa. Milxo oo ah deegaan ku yaalla gobolka Sanaag ayaa hodan ku ah macdanta, waxaana muddooyinkan si weyn uga shaqeynayay ganacsato kala duwan oo isugu jirto Soomaali iyo Ajaaniib, iyada oo sidoo kale ay dadka deegaanka ka shaqeeyaan hawlaha qodista macdanka. items.title: Somalia: Al-Shabaab signs deal with Hawadle clan to end 4-year war
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Al-Shabaab said on Saturday it had signed an agreement with the Hawadle clan to end a four-year conflict in central Somalia’s Hiran region. The group’s Al Furqan media arm posted videos on Facebook of a meeting in the town of Mahas, attended by dozens of Hawadle elders and Al-Shabaab officials, where it said the agreement was signed. Al-Shabaab officials, speaking to the group’s media, said the deal was intended to end the fighting and that it had the clan’s support in “implementing Islamic law in the areas the Hawadle inhabit.” The Somali government and Hawadle politicians in federal institutions had not responded by the time of publication. Battlefield reversal The Hawadle launched an offensive that drove Al-Shabaab out of most of the towns and villages the clan inhabits in Hiran, with the support of federal troops on the ground and US air strikes. Al-Shabaab reversed those gains in an offensive in early 2025, retaking much of the territory it lost in 2022 and some areas it lost in 2014 to an African Union offensive. Those areas had been under peacekeeper and government control for more than a decade. Rift with Mogadishu The announcement comes amid rising tension between the clan and the federal government. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud nominated Hirshabelle state president Ali Gudlawe, a fellow member of his Abgal clan, as his ruling party’s candidate in the regional presidential election, allegedly reneging on a promise to back a Hawadle candidate. The Hawadle have boycotted the Hirshabelle elections and held mass protests in Hiran, including in the regional capital, Beledweyne. The federal government has yet to take any steps to ease the tension. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee dagaalka gobolka Tigray iyo jab weyn oo gaaray…
items.description: Mekelle (Caasimada Online) — Ciidamada dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ayaa si buuxda ula wareegay magaalada Mekelle, caasimadda gobolka Tigray, kadib markii hoggaamiyeyaasha iyo dagaalyahannada TPLF ay isaga baxeen magaalada, iyadoo colaadda waqooyiga Itoobiya ay gashay marxalad cusub. Ciidamada federaalka iyo xoogag hubeysan oo dowladda taageersan ayaa Sabtidii gudaha u galay Mekelle iyagoo aan la kulmin dagaal weyn, kadib weerar rogaal-celin ah oo maalmo gudahood si qoto dheer ugu galay dhulka ay TPLF maamusho. Wariye ku sugan magaalada ayaa AFP u sheegay Axaddii in ciidamada federaalka ay gaaf-wareegayeen waddooyinka Mekelle, isla markaana ay ilaalo ka hayeen xarumaha muhiimka ah ee dowladda. Isgaarsiinta magaalada ayaa sidoo kale dib loo soo celiyey markii ugu horreysay muddo ka badan toddobaad. “Waxaan la wareegnay Mekelle, horayna waan u sii soconnaa,” ayuu taliye ka tirsan maleeshiyaadka dowladda taageera u sheegay AFP. Si kastaba, xaaladda magaalada ayaa weli ahayd mid aan caadi ku soo noqon. Ganacsiyada iyo dukaamada ayaa xirnaa, iyadoo qaar badan oo ka mid ah ganacsatada ay badeecadahooda horay uga rareen goobaha ganacsiga iyagoo ka cabsi qabay bililiqo iyo burbur. Qof deggan Mekelle ayaa AFP u sheegay in booliska aysan magaalada joogin, taas oo ku qasabtay dadka xaafadaha qaarkood inay habeenkii iskood isu abaabulaan si ay ammaanka u ilaashadaan. TPLF oo xaqiijisay inay ka baxday Mekelle TPLF ayaa dhankeeda si rasmi ah u xaqiijisay inay ciidamadeeda kala baxday caasimadda Tigray. Bayaan ay soo saartay ayay ku sheegtay in maamulka gobolka Tigray “si ku-meel-gaar ah looga rarayo Mekelle”, isla markaana uu meel kale ka sii shaqeyn doono. Kooxda Tigray Peace Forces, oo ka tirsan xoogagga dowladda taageera, ayaa sheegtay in dagaalyahannadeedu ay galeen bartamaha Mekelle galabnimadii Sabtida, ka hor inta aysan daba gelin ciidamada federaalka. Ilo bani’aadannimo iyo qof deggan Mekelle ayaa sidoo kale Reuters u xaqiijiyey in magaalada ay gacanta ku hayaan ciidamada dowladda iyo xulafadooda. Luminta Mekelle ayaa dhabar-jab weyn ku ah TPLF iyo isbahaysiga hubeysan ee ay hoggaamiso, kaas oo 23-kii September qaaday weerarro ballaaran oo ka dhan ah ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya. Weerarkaas ayaa markii hore u suurageliyey xoogagga Tigray inay gaaraan guulo dhowr ah, balse ciidamada dowladda ayaa markii dambe qaaday rogaal-celin degdeg ah, iyagoo dib u qabsaday magaalooyin muhiim ah sida Alamata ka hor inta aysan u gudbin dhinaca Mekelle. TPLF ma ku laaban doontaa dagaal jabhadeed? La wareegista Mekelle macnaheedu ma aha in dagaalka Tigray uu dhammaaday. Hoggaamiyaha TPLF Debretsion Gebremichael ayaa toddobaadkan tilmaamay in xoogaggiisu ay u wareegi karaan qaab dagaal jabhadeed oo la mid ah kii ay adeegsadeen dagaalkii hore. “Waxaan ku shaqeynaa istaraatiijiyad noo oggolaaneysa inaan cadowga ku weerarno meesha aan dooranno,” ayuu yiri Debretsion. Xaalad tan la mid ah ayaa dhacday 2020, markii ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya ay qabsadeen Mekelle. TPLF ayaa markaas u wareegtay dagaal jabhadeed, ka hor inta aysan dib ula wareegin magaalada sannadkii 2021. Dagaalkii u dhexeeyey dowladda federaalka iyo TPLF ee 2020 ilaa 2022 ayaa sababay dhimasho baahsan iyo burbur xooggan, waxaana heshiiskii Pretoria ee November 2022 uu soo afjaray colaaddaas. Dagaalka cusub ayaa hadda halis gelinaya heshiiskaas. Hoggaamiyeyaasha gobolka oo Masar ku kulmaya La wareegista Mekelle ayaa ku soo beegantay iyadoo hoggaamiyeyaasha dalal dhowr ah oo gobolka ah ay Axaddii ku kulmayeen magaalada Alamein ee Masar, xilli ay sii kordhayaan walaaca laga qabo in dagaalka Itoobiya uu ku fido gobolka. Madaxweynaha Masar Abdel Fattah al-Sisi ayaa lagu waday inuu la kulmo Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, Madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki iyo taliyaha ciidamada Sudan Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, kuwaas oo ka qeybgalaya kulan ka dhacaya dhinaca African Business Forum. Itoobiya ayaa Eritrea ku eedeysay inay si toos ah u taageerto xoogagga Tigray, iyadoo sidoo kale Masar iyo Sudan ku eedeysay inay garab siinayaan isbahaysiga mucaaradka. Saddexda dalba way beeniyeen eedeymahaas. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Masar Badr Abdelatty ayaa Reuters Axaddii u sheegay in Qaahira aysan wax lug ah ku lahayn dagaalka gudaha Itoobiya. “Annagu qeyb kama nihin qalalaasaha gudaha ee hadda ka jira Itoobiya,” ayuu yiri Abdelatty. Xiisadda Itoobiya iyo Masar ayaa sidoo kale muddo dheer salka ku haysa muranka biyo-xireenka weyn ee Itoobiya ka dhistay webiga Nile, kaas oo Qaahira u aragto arrin si toos ah u taabanaysa ammaankeeda biyaha. Abdelatty ayaa murankaas ku tilmaamay arrin “nolol ama geeri” u ah in ka badan 100 milyan oo Masriyiin ah. Hase yeeshee, isha ugu weyn ee walaaca degdegga ah ayaa hadda ah waxa TPLF sameyn doonto kadib luminta Mekelle, iyo in dib-u-gurashadeedu ay noqon doonto bilowga dagaal jabhadeed oo daba-dheeraada ama inay ciidamada dowladda sii ballaariyaan gacan-ku-hayntooda Tigray. items.title: War cusub oo kasoo kordhay muwaadiniintii Pakistan ee lagu dilay Soomaaliya
items.description: Karachi (Caasimada Online) – Diyaarad gaar ah oo sidday maydadka badmaaxiintii u dhashay dalka Pakistaan iyo kuwa dhaawaca ah ayaa maanta oo Axad ah ka degtay garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Jinnah ee magaalada Karachi. Diyaaradda ayaa sidday meydadka saddex badmaax oo Pakistani ah iyo afar shaqaale ah oo ku dhaawacmay markabka MT Honour 25, kadib markii ay kooxdu rasaas ku furtay, xilli ay markabka ku dhawaadeen ciidamada badda Puntland oo howlgal ku qaaday burcadbadeedda. Maydadka saddex badmaaxi ee dib loogu celiyay dalkooda ayaa kala ah; Rafiullah Khan, Syed Kashif Umer iyo Mahmood Ahmad Ansari, halka afarta dhaawaca ah ay kala yihiin; Usman Ghani, Aqeel Khan, Ameen bin Shams iyo Yasir Khan. Tallaabadan ayaa timid kaddib markii ehellada marxuumiinta iyo dowladda Pakistan ay si rasmi ah u dalbadeen in meydadka lagu soo celiyo Pakistan, halkaas oo maalmaha soo socda aas loogu sameyn doono. Markabka MT Honour 25 oo ka diiwaangashan Palau ayaa 21-kii April lagu afduubtay xeebaha Puntland, xilli ay saarnaayeen 17 shaqaale ah, oo 10 ka mid ah ay ahaayeen Pakistani, kuwaas oo saddex kamid ah ay geeriyoodeen, kuwaas maanta maydadkooda laga dajiyay dalkaasi. Markabka ayaa xiliga la afduubanayay ku sugnaa qiyaastii 30 mayl-badeed meel u jirta xeebaha Puntland, iyadoo maalmo badan ay haysteen kooxaha burcadbadeedda Soomaalida. Si kastaba, waxaa haatan ay Puntland gacanta ku haysaa 16 kamid burcadbadeeddii afduubatay markabka, kuwaas oo lagu qabtay howlgalkii ay qaadeen ciidamada maamulkaas. The post War cusub oo kasoo kordhay muwaadiniintii Pakistan ee lagu dilay Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .
