items.title: Xusuusta Qaraxii Hargaha iyo Saamaha
items.description: Shan iyo toban sano ayaa ka soo wareegtay qaraxii bahalnimada ahaa ee 4tii Oktoobar 2011 lala beegsaday xaruntii hore ee Wakaaladda Hargaha iyo Saamaha ee magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo raad taariikheed ku reebay xusuus-wadareedka bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Weerarkaas, oo ay ku naf waayeen dad ku dhow boqol qof, una badnaa arday, waalidiin iyo dad rayid ah, ayaa ka mid noqday dhacdooyinkii ugu murugada badnaa ee sooyaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan xilligii uu dalku la daalaa dhacayay colaadaha daba dheeraaday iyo duruufihii adkaa ee ka dhashay. Wuxuu qayb ka noqday taariikh ummadeed ay hareeyeen ba’ iyo hoog. Subaxnimadii Talaadada ee 4tii Oktoobar 2011, abaare tobankii iyo barkii barqannimo, ayaa gaari xamuul ah oo nooca candhameydlaha (DYNA) loo yaqaanno, lagana soo buuxiyay walxaha qarxa iyo shidaal, lala beegsaday Xaruntii Hore ee Wakaaladdii Hargaha iyo Saamaha, oo ku dhow isgoyska Lanbar 4 (KM4), kana soo horjeedday Xarunta Denbibaarista (CID). Gaariga ayaa ku qarxay barta koontaroolka ee laga ilaaliyo dhismaha, halkaas oo xilligaas ay ku shaqaynayeen wasaarado ka tirsanaa Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka ahayd ee Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo tiradooda warbixinnada qaarkood ku sheegeen illaa siddeed wasaaradood, ayna ka mid ahayd Wasaaradda Waxbarashadu. Xaruntu waxay maalintaas ahayd meel aad u mashquul badan, maaddaama ay u soo kallaheen boqollaal arday iyo waalidiin doonayay in ay ogaadaan natiijadii imtixaanka deeqaha waxbarasho ee Dawladda Turkigu ugu talagashay ardayda Soomaaliyeed. Dhallinyaradaasi waxay rejaynayeen in ay helaan fursad ay waxbarashadooda ku sii wataan, aqoonna ku soo kororsadaan, mustaqbalkoodana ku dhisaan, kuna xaqiijiyaan himiladoodii aqoonkororsiga, garaadkobcinta iyo hanaqaadka. Hasayeeshee, rejadii iyo himiladii aqooneed ee ay xambaarsanaayeen ayaa daqiiqado gudahood isu beddelay masiibo, ba’ iyo hoog, markii qaraxa xooggiisu gilgilay dhismayaashii xarunta iyo goobihii ka ag dhawaa. Qaraxa ayaa burbur baaxad leh gaarsiiyay dhismaha xarunta, waxaana dumay qaybo ka mid ah derbiyadii iyo saqafyadii, iyada oo burburku haleelay dadkii ku sugnaa gudaha dhismaha iyo kuwii marayay waddada hortiisa. Baabuur ayaa dab qabsaday, halka dad kalena ay ku hoos xannibmeen dhismayaashii dumay, taas oo sii kordhisay mugga iyo baaxadda dhibaatada. Gurmadkii loo fidiyay dadkii waxyeelladu gaartay ayaa durba billowday, iyada oo la guda galay hawlihii badbaadinta iyo samatabbixinta, waxaana isbitaallada Muqdisho buux dhaafiyay dhaawacyadii la soo gaarsiinayay iyo eheladii baadigoobayay dadkooda. Waalidiin, walaalo iyo qaraabo ayaa isbitaallada iyo goobta qaraxa ugu kala cararay sidii ay war uga heli lahaayeen dadkii ay filayeen in ay maalintaas xarunta tagaan, iyaga oo la daalaa dhacayay murugo, walaac iyo dareen naxdin leh. Warbixinnadii xilligaas la baahiyay waxay muujiyeen baaxadda khasaaraha nafeed, waxayna noqdeen qayb ka mid ah diiwaanka iyo raadraaca dhacdadaas taariikheed. Tirakoobyadii hordhaca ahaa ayaa kala duwanaa, hasayeeshee xogihii markii dambe la diiwaangeliyay waxay sheegeen in ugu yaraan boqol qof ay ku dhinteen qaraxa, halka ugu yaraan 90 kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Dadka dhintay iyo kuwa dhaawacmayba waxaa ku badnaa ardaydii deeqaha waxbarasho sugaysay, waalidiintoodii iyo dad kale oo rayid ahaa. Warbixin maxalli ah oo la baahiyay 6dii Oktoobar 2011 ayaa tirada ardaydii qaraxa ku dhimatay ku sheegtay 45 arday, inkasta oo aan si madaxbannaan loo xaqiijin tirada gaarka ah ee ardaydaas. Burburka dhismayaasha ayaa, sidoo kale, adkeeyay hawlihii samatabbixinta iyo soo saarista meydadka, kuwaas oo u baahday dadaal, raadraac iyo baadigoob joogto ah. Waxaa hawlaha gurmadka loo adeegsaday qalab culus iyo cagafyo lagu qaadayo burburka dhismayaasha. Hawshaasi kuma soo afjarmin maalintii qaraxu dhacay oo keliya, balse waxay sii socotay maalmihii xigay, iyada oo dad la la’aa iyo meydad kale laga raadinayay dhismayaashii dumay. Warbaahinta maxalliga ah ayaa 9kii Oktoobar 2011, shan maalmood ka dib qaraxa, weli tebaysay in meydad laga soo saarayo burburka xarunta Hargaha iyo Saamaha. Taasi waxay muujinaysay baaxadda burburkii dhacay iyo dhibaatadii haysatay kooxihii gurmadka iyo qoysaskii dadkooda baadigoobayay. Waxay, sidoo kale, marag u ahayd mugga masiibada iyo ba’ iyo hooggii maalintaas dhacay. Qaraxa maalintaas dhacay, dadkii ka badbaaday oo maanta miisaan ku leh siyaasadda iyo hoggaanka dalka, waxaa kamid ah, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha dalka, Xamse Cabdi Barre . RW ayaa taagnaa marka uu qaraxaas dhacayay Laamiyaraha Zoobe oo aad ugu dhowaa goobta masiibadu ka dhacday, isagoo indhihiisa ku arkay saamaynta dhibaatada meesha ka dhacday. Sidoo kale, waxaa masiibadaas si nasiib lehuga badbaaday Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Darajada Koowaad ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, Xasan Cali Nuur (Shuute) , oo xilligaas kamid ahaa ardaydii ka faa’iidaysan lahayd deeqdaas waxbarasho ee Turkiga, balse ka daahay inuu subaxaas hore tago xarunta, si uu natiijadiisa u soo eego, taasi oo noqotay sababta uu ku badbaaday halkaasna ay ku ku dhinteen saaxiibbadiisii ballanta kula lahaa. Masuuliyadda Weerarka iyo Ujeeddadiisii Masuuliyadda weerarkaas waxaa sheegatay kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee al-Shabaab. Afhayeenkeedii, Cali Maxamuud Raage (Cali-Dheere), ayaa shaaciyay in qaraxa ay kooxdiisu fulisay, waxaana ay weerarka ku tilmaantay mid lala beegsaday xarumaha Dawladdii Kumeelgaarka ahayd iyo ciidammadii ka hawlgalayay. Al-Shabaab ayaa, sidoo kale, sheegtay in qofkii gaariga isku qarxiyay lagu magacaabi jiray Bishaar Cabdullaahi Nuur, kaas oo, sida ay warbixinnadii xilligaas tilmaameen, hore u duubay farriin uu ku muujinayay aragtidiisa ka dhanka ah waxbarashada uu ku tilmaamay mid aan diini ahayn. Weerarkaas ayaa soo jiitay canbaarayn xooggan oo uga timid Dawladdii Soomaaliyeed, Qaramada Midoobay, Dawladda Turkiga, hay’adaha xuquuqda aadanaha iyo dalal kale oo caalamka ka tirsan. Canbaarayntaasi waxay muujinaysay dareenka iyo walaaca laga qabay dhibaatada gaartay dadka rayidka ah. Gaar ahaan, Hay’adda Human Rights Watch ayaa qaraxa ku tilmaantay weerar aan cudurdaar loo heli karin oo lagu waxyeelleeyay dad rayid ah, oo noqday dhibbanayaasha masiibadaas. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale ku xustay warbixinnaheeda dhibaatadii xilligaas loo geysanayay waxbarashada Soomaaliya, oo ay ka mid ahaayeen weerarro lagu qaaday xarumo waxbarasho, arday iyo macallimiin. Warbixinnadaasi waxay qayb ka noqdeen diiwaanka iyo maragfurka dhibaatadii xilligaas dhacday. Isbeddelkii Xeeladaha Dagaal ee Al-Shabaab Marka laga yimaaddo khasaaraha nafeed iyo burburkii hantiyeed, qaraxii Hargaha iyo Saamaha wuxuu muujiyay isbeddel ku yimid xeeladihii dagaal ee Al-Shabaab, waana ifafaale mudan milicsi iyo dhiraandhirin. Laba bilood ka hor weerarkaas, bishii Agoosto 2011, Al-Shabaab ayaa isaga baxday fariisimihii waaweynaa ee ay Muqdisho kaga sugnayd, ka dib dagaallo ay la gashay ciidammadii Dawladda Kumeelgaarka ahayd iyo kuwii Midowga Afrika ee AMISOM. Inkasta oo ay ka baxday inta badan fariisimahaas, haddana ma aysan lumin awooddii ay weerarro uga fulin karaysay gudaha caasimadda. Arrintaasi waxay qayb ka ahayd geeddisocodkii colaadaha iyo isbeddelkii xeeladaha dagaal ee xilligaas. Sidaas darteed, weerarkaasi wuxuu caddeeyay in ka bixitaankii al-Shabaab ee fariisimihii ay Muqdisho kaga sugnayd uusan meesha ka saarin khatartii ay weli ku haysay amniga caasimadda iyo dadka rayidka ah. Wuxuu sidoo kale noqday marag muujinaya geeddisocodka iyo ifafaalaha isbeddelkaas. Masiibo Raadkeedu weli sii Muuqdo Qaraxii Hargaha iyo Saamaha wuxuu si gaar ah u dhaawacay rajadii dhallinyaro Soomaaliyeed oo doonayay in ay waxbarasho iyo aqoon ku dhistaan mustaqbalkooda, kuna tallaabsadaan aqoonkororsi, garaad-kobcin iyo hanaqaad aqooneed. Wuxuu sidoo kale iftiimiyay dhibaatadii colaadaha dalka ka jiray ay ku hayeen nolosha bulshada, gaar ahaan ardayda iyo goobaha waxbarashada. Wuxuu raad ku reebay himilooyinkii iyo aafaaqdii aqooneed ee ay dhallinyaradaasi hiigsanayeen. Masiibadaas waxaa xigay cambaarayn caalami ah iyo baaqyo lagu dalbanayay ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah, iyadoo Dawladda Turkiguna ay, mar kale, muujisay sida ay uga go’an tahay taageerada Soomaaliya iyo sii wadidda dadaallada nabadda iyo horumarka. Dadaalladaasi waxay qayb ka ahaayeen geeddisocodkii nabadaynta iyo garabistaagga bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Shan iyo toban sano kaddib, qaraxii Hargaha iyo Saamaha wuxuu weli xusuus murugo leh ku reebay eheladii iyo qaraabadii dadkii ku naf waayay, dadkii ka badbaaday iyo guud ahaan bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Waa xusuus ay weheliyaan boholyow iyo dhaawac nafeed, qaybna ka noqotay xusuus bulsheedka iyo taariikhda ummadeed. Xusuusta dhacdadani kuma koobna oo keliya tirada dadkii dhintay, baaxadda burburkii dhacay ama khasaaraha ka dhashay, waxayse sidoo kale xanbaarsantahay xusuusta himilooyinkii iyo mustaqbalkii aqooneed ee dhallinyaradii maalintaas naf waayay. Waa qayb ka mid ah xusuus-wadareedka ummadda, kaydka taariikheed iyo waaya-aragnimada nololeed ee u baahan milicsi iyo dibujaleecis, si looga baaqsado halmaan taariikheed. Qaraxii 4tii Oktoobar 2011 wuxuu reebay nabar taariikheed oo aan weli bogsan, iyo xusuus ina tusinaysa qiimaha nabadda, bedqabka muwaaddinka iyo ilaalinta nolosha dadka rayidka ah. Waa raad taariikheed iyo dhaxal xusuuseed ay tahay in laga tilmaanqaato, oo qayb ka ah sooyaalka iyo xusuusta ummadeed ee Soomaaliyeed.

Waa qayb ka mid ah xusuus-wadareedka ummadda, kaydka taariikheed iyo waaya-aragnimada nololeed ee u baahan milicsi iyo dibujaleecis, si looga baaqsado halmaan taariikheed. Qaraxii 4tii Oktoobar 2011 wuxuu reebay nabar taariikheed oo aan weli bogsan, iyo xusuus ina tusinaysa qiimaha nabadda, bedqabka muwaaddinka iyo ilaalinta nolosha dadka rayidka ah. Waa raad taariikheed iyo dhaxal xusuuseed ay tahay in laga tilmaanqaato, oo qayb ka ah sooyaalka iyo xusuusta ummadeed ee Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo ku dhawaaqay dib-u-hawlgelinta Taliska Qaybta 26-aad
items.description: Muqdisho – 4 Oktoobar 2026: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar (Jeneraal Khaalid), ayaa sheegay in dib loo hawlgeliyey Taliska Qaybta 26-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, oo qaabilsan Gobollada Waqooyi. Taliyaha ayaa tallaabadan ku tilmaamay guul qaran oo taariikhi ah, kaddib muddo 35 sano ah oo taliskaasi aanu si buuxda u shaqayn. Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa sheegay in dib-u-hawlgelinta Qaybta 26-aad ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada lagu dhammaystirayo dib-u-dhiska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo xoojinta cududda difaaca qaranka. “Waa inoo guul qaran oo taariikhi ah in maanta, 35 sano kaddib, aan dib u hawlgelinnay Taliska Qaybta 26-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Gobollada Waqooyi.” Sida uu sheegay Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka, tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale muhiim u ah wadajirka iyo midnimada ummadda Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo qayb ka noqonaysa dhismaha hay’ad difaac oo qaran oo gudata waajibaadkeeda dastuuriga ah. Dib-u-hawlgelinta Qaybta 26-aad ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay waddo qorshayaal lagu xoojinayo qaab-dhismeedka iyo awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, iyadoo la doonayo in ciidamada qaranku ay si isku-dhafan uga hawlgalaan dhammaan gobollada dalka. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa sidoo kale sanadkan si joogto ah uga qaybgalay howlaha dib-u-dhiska iyo tababarka ciidamada. Qaybta 26-aad waxay taariikh ahaan kamid ahayd qaybaha muhiimka ah ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, waxaana dib-u-hawlgelinteeda lagu tilmaamay tallaabo lagu xoojinayo joogitaanka iyo qaab-dhismeedka hay’adaha difaaca qaranka ee Gobollada Waqooyi.

items.title: Mareykanka Oo Itoobiya Iyo Eritrea Ugu Baaqay Xakamayn Iyo Wada-hadal
items.description: WASHINGTON (Goobjoog News) — Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ugu baaqday inay muujiyaan xakamaynta ugu sarreysa, kana fogaadaan tallaabooyin horseedi kara dagaal cusub oo saameeya guud ahaan Geeska Afrika. Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, ayaa sheegay in xiisadaha sii kordhaya ee xuduudda Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ay awood u leeyihiin inay qalalaase ka abuuraan gobolka oo dhan. Wuxuu ka digay in Geeska Afrika uusan xamili karin dagaal kale iyo masiibo bani’aadannimo oo cusub. Washington waxay labada dowladood ugu baaqday inay ixtiraamaan madaxbannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalalka deriska la ah, isla markaana ay dib ugu laabtaan wada-hadalka iyo iskaashiga lagu heshiiyey heshiiskii nabadeed ee 2018. Mareykanku wuxuu sheegay in nabad lagu gaaro wada-hadal ay tahay waddada keliya ee horseedi karta amni, koboc dhaqaale iyo barwaaqo waarta. Bayaanka ayaa soo baxay kaddib markii Itoobiya ay xirtay safaaraddeeda Asmara, isla markaana ay dalka ka cayrisay toban diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah. Eritrea ayaa tallaabadaas kaga jawaabtay inay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed u jarto Itoobiya, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isku eedeeyeen falal cadaawadeed iyo faragelin amni. Itoobiya waxay Eritrea ku eedeysay inay taageerayso isbahaysiga hubeysan ee TPLF hoggaamiso, kaas oo dagaal kula jira ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo xoogagga taageersan. Eritrea way beenisay eeddaas, halka dagaallada waqooyiga Itoobiya ay sii kordhiyeen cabsida laga qabo in colaadda gudaha ay isu beddesho dagaal goboleed. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dagaal cusub uu halis gelin karo iskaashiga uu la leeyahay Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ee arrimaha ay wadaagaan. Bayaanka laguma dhawaaqin cunaqabatayn cusub, dhex-dhexaadin rasmi ah ama jadwal loo dejiyey wada-hadalka labada dowladood. Soomaaliya, isku dhac toos ah oo dhex mara Itoobiya iyo Eritrea wuxuu saameyn ku yeelan karaa amniga Geeska Afrika, hawlgallada ka dhanka ah Al‑Shabaab iyo doorka ciidamada Itoobiya ee Soomaaliya. Waxa kale oo uu kordhin karaa barakaca, baahiyaha bani’aadannimo iyo loollanka quwadaha gobolka ee ku saabsan Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Geeska Afrika.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo wada-hadal xasaasi ah la yeeshay Mareykanka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta kulan gaar ah la yeeshay La-taliyaha sare ee Madaxweynaha Mareykanka u qaabilsan arrimaha Carabta iyo Afrika Massad Boulos, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka. Labada mas’uul ayaa kulankooda waxa ay kaga wada-hadleen arrimo la xiriira xaaladda gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan qodobbada ay labada dhinac danaha wadaagga ah ka leeyihiin iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada muhiimka u ah labada dal. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo Massad Boulos ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay adkeynta iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee labada dal, iyagoo isla eegay fursadaha lagu horumarin karo xiriirka labada dowladood iyo wada-shaqeynta ku aaddan arrimaha gobolka. Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka ayaa leh xiriir diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashi muddo dheer soo jiray, waxaana labada dhinac ay iska kaashadaan arrimo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, la-dagaallanka kooxaha hubeysan, xasilinta gobolka, horumarinta hay’adaha dowladda iyo taageerada dadaallada Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan dhismaha dowladnimada. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya muhiimadda sii kordheysa ee xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Washington, xilli ay Soomaaliya dooneyso in ay ballaariso iskaashiga caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan dhinacyada taageerada amniga, horumarinta hay’adaha dowladda iyo xoojinta doorka Soomaaliya ee arrimaha gobolka. Si kastaba, Kulanka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo La-taliyaha sare ee Madaxweynaha Mareykanka u qaabilsan arrimaha Carabta iyo Afrika ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli haatan Soomaaliya ay si weyn u xoojinayso xiriirka ay la leedahay saaxiibbada caalamka, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka ay xoogga saareyso iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha diblomaasiyadda. Mareykanka ayaa kamid ah dowladaha waa wayn ee taageerada siiya Soomaaliya, wuxuuna sidoo kale ka qayb-qaata dagaalka adag ee lagula jiro kooxda Al-Shabaab. Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka ayaa leh xiriir diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashi muddo dheer soo jiray, waxaana labada dhinac ay iska kaashadaan arrimo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, la-dagaallanka kooxaha hubeysan, xasilinta gobolka, horumarinta hay’adaha dowladda iyo taageerada dadaallada Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan dhismaha dowladnimada. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya muhiimadda sii kordheysa ee xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Washington, xilli ay Soomaaliya dooneyso in ay ballaariso iskaashiga caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan dhinacyada taageerada amniga, horumarinta hay’adaha dowladda iyo xoojinta doorka Soomaaliya ee arrimaha gobolka. Si kastaba, Kulanka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo La-taliyaha sare ee Madaxweynaha Mareykanka u qaabilsan arrimaha Carabta iyo Afrika ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli haatan Soomaaliya ay si weyn u xoojinayso xiriirka ay la leedahay saaxiibbada caalamka, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka ay xoogga saareyso iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha diblomaasiyadda. Mareykanka ayaa kamid ah dowladaha waa wayn ee taageerada siiya Soomaaliya, wuxuuna sidoo kale ka qayb-qaata dagaalka adag ee lagula jiro kooxda Al-Shabaab. items.title: Ethiopia’s government forces retake Mekelle from Tigray rebels
items.description: ADDIS ABABA (Somaliguardian) – Ethiopian government forces and allied militias have regained control of the capital of Tigray, three sources told Reuters ​on Sunday, dealing a major setback to the ‌opposition alliance that rules the northern region. The Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF), which leads the opposition alliance, said in a statement posted on ​Facebook it had retreated from the capital and that ​the regional government would be “temporarily moved out of ⁠Mekelle and operate from somewhere else.” A source close to ​the pro-government militia, the Tigray Peace Forces, said its fighters ​entered the centre of Mekelle on Saturday afternoon, followed by the Ethiopian military. A humanitarian source and a Mekelle resident, who asked not ​to be named, confirmed the city was controlled by ​government forces. The prime minister’s office did not respond immediately to a request ‌for ⁠comment. LOSS OF MEKELLE A MAJOR BLOW FOR TPLF The taking of Mekelle by pro-government forces is a major loss for the opposition alliance led by the TPLF, which launched a big ​offensive on September ​23 against ⁠the Ethiopian military. Ethiopian federal forces and allied fighters have made a quick counterattack into Tigray, ​but analysts say the fighting — the worst escalation ​since ⁠a 2020-2022 civil war — threatens to escalate into a wider regional conflict. The federal government in Addis Ababa severed diplomatic ties ⁠with ​Eritrea last week, accusing it of ​supporting the rebel alliance alongside Sudan and Egypt. The three countries deny this.

items.title: Mahad Salaad oo lagu arkay furimaha dagaalka + Sawirro
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Agaasimaha Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka ee NISA Mudane Mahad Maxamed Salaad ayaa maanta lagu arkay furimaha dagaalka, gaar ahaan aagga degamada Balanballe ee gobalka Galgaduud. Mahad Salaad ayaa kormeer ku tegay xarun ay NISA ku leedahay halkaasi oo lagu tababarayo ciidamo ka tirsan Hay’adda. Agaasimaha ayaa inta uu kormeerka ku jiray la kulmay ciidamada tababarka qaadanaya, isagoo kula dardaarmay inay ka dhabeeyaan ballanta ay u qaadeen difaaca dalka, dadka iyo diinta. Sidoo kale, Mahad Salaad iyo wafdiga uu hoggaaminayo ayaa sii joogi doono degmada Balanballe oo maalmaha soo socda marti geli doonta munaasabado waaweyn oo dib u heshiisiin ah, kuwaas oo ay ka qayb-galayaan bulshada deegaanka. Horay Agaasimaha NISA ayaa go’aanno adag uga soo saaray colaadihii ka taagnaa gobollada dhexe, kadib markii uu amarro siiyay ciidamada dowladda ee ku sugan halkaasi, si looga hortego dagaal beeleedyada iyo dilalka la xiriira aanooyinka qabiil ee deegaanada Galmudug. Xaaladda guud ayaa hadda ah mid deggan, waxaana haatan qorshaha uu yahay in la guda galo dib-u-heshiisiin dhab ah oo lagu soo afjarayo colaadaha ka taagan gobollada dhexe.   The post Mahad Salaad oo lagu arkay furimaha dagaalka + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo ku dhawaaqay dib-u-hawlgelinta Taliska Qaybta 26-aad
items.description: Muqdisho – 4 Oktoobar 2026: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar (Jeneraal Khaalid), ayaa sheegay in dib loo hawlgeliyey Taliska Qaybta 26-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, oo qaabilsan Gobollada Waqooyi. Taliyaha ayaa tallaabadan ku tilmaamay guul qaran oo taariikhi ah, kaddib muddo 35 sano ah oo taliskaasi aanu si buuxda u shaqayn. Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa sheegay in dib-u-hawlgelinta Qaybta 26-aad ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada lagu dhammaystirayo dib-u-dhiska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo xoojinta cududda difaaca qaranka. “Waa inoo guul qaran oo taariikhi ah in maanta, 35 sano kaddib, aan dib u hawlgelinnay Taliska Qaybta 26-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Gobollada Waqooyi.” Sida uu sheegay Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka, tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale muhiim u ah wadajirka iyo midnimada ummadda Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo qayb ka noqonaysa dhismaha hay’ad difaac oo qaran oo gudata waajibaadkeeda dastuuriga ah. Dib-u-hawlgelinta Qaybta 26-aad ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay waddo qorshayaal lagu xoojinayo qaab-dhismeedka iyo awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, iyadoo la doonayo in ciidamada qaranku ay si isku-dhafan uga hawlgalaan dhammaan gobollada dalka. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa sidoo kale sanadkan si joogto ah uga qaybgalay howlaha dib-u-dhiska iyo tababarka ciidamada. Qaybta 26-aad waxay taariikh ahaan kamid ahayd qaybaha muhiimka ah ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, waxaana dib-u-hawlgelinteeda lagu tilmaamay tallaabo lagu xoojinayo joogitaanka iyo qaab-dhismeedka hay’adaha difaaca qaranka ee Gobollada Waqooyi.

items.title: Meydadka Saddex Badmaax oo Soomaaliya Lagu Dilay oo Loo Qaaday Pakistan
items.description: ISLAAMABAAD (Goobjoog News) — Meydadka saddex badmaax oo Pakistani ah oo lagu dilay dhacdadii markabka MT Honour 25, iyo afar badmaax oo kale oo dhaawacmay, ayaa maanta magaalada Addis Ababa looga qaaday Karachi. Badmaaxiinta la dilay ayaa kala ah Rafi Ullah Khan, Syed Kashif Umer iyo Mahmood Ahmad Ansari. Afarta dhaawacantay Usman Ghani, Aqeel Khan, Ameen bin Shams iyo Yasir Khan ayaa iyaguna la socday duulimaadka Ethiopian Airlines ee ET 694. Safiirrada Pakistan u fadhiya Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti ayaa meydadka iyo dhaawacyada ka sagootiyey Addis Ababa. Dowladda Pakistan waxay sheegtay inay la shaqaynaysay mas’uuliyiinta ay khusayso si muwaadiniinteeda loogu celiyo Karachi loona siiyo daryeel caafimaad. Markabka MT Honour 25, oo ku gooshayey calanka Palau, ayaa 21-kii Abriil laga afduubtay meel u dhow xeebaha Puntland. Ciidamada Badda Puntland ayaa 29-kii Sebteembar dib ula wareegay markabka, balse burcad-badeedda ayaa la sheegay inay rasaas ku fureen shaqaalaha, iyagoo dilay shan qof oo ay ku jireen saddexda Pakistani-ga ah. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif ayaa qoys kasta oo ka mid ah saddexda badmaax u ballanqaaday 12.5 milyan oo rupees qiyaastii $44,000 iyo guri. Carruurta ay ka tageenna waxaa loo ballanqaaday waxbarasho iyo adeegyo caafimaad oo bilaash ah. Dhacdadan ayaa mar kale muujisay khatarta ka dhalanaysa soo-noqoshada burcad-badeedda xeebaha Soomaaliya. Dowladda Pakistan ayaa sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto taageerada qoysaska dhibbanayaasha iyo daryeelka badmaaxiinta dhaawacmay.

items.title: Beesha Xawaadle oo la sheegay inay heshiis la gashay Al Shabaab
items.description: Ka dib kulan ay Saraakiisha Al Shabaab iyo Odayaasha Dhaqanka ee Beesha Xawaadle qaarkood ku yeesheen Degmada Maxaas ee Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa la sheegay inay ku gaareen heshiis lagu soo afjarayo colaadda labada dhinac. Bayaan wadajir ah oo Sabtidii lagu baahiyay Warbaahinta ku hadasha afka Al Shabaab ayaa lagu sheegay in labada dhinac ay si rasmi ah uga heshiiyeen colaadda iyo dagaaladii ku dhex marayay bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Bayaanka ayaa lagu sheegay in dhinacyadu ay ka heshiiyeen dhammaan khilaafyadii iyo mad madowgii soo kala dhex galay, isla-markaana ay beeshu ogolaatay in deegaanadeeda ay ku nabad gelaan dagaal-yahanada Al Shabaab. “Beeshu waxay isla garatay inay xoojiso garab istaaga Jihaadka iyo Mujaahidiinta, ayna u hurto naftooda iyo maalkooda.” Ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Bayaanka ayaa lagu xusay inay beeshu aqbashay inaanan deegaanadeeda laga abaabulin, laga hawlgelin, magangelyana aan lagu siinin Ciidanka Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley ee ka soo jeeda Gobolka Hiiraan. Qodobkan ayaa u gogol xaaraya in la kala diro Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan oo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ka taageera la dagaalanka maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. “Beesha waxay adkeynaysaa ilaalinta, xoojinta iyo fulinta ballamihii ay wada galeen iyaga iyo Mujaahidiinta, lagana hortago wax kasta oo dhaawac u keeni kara heshiiskii la gaaray.” Ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Bayaankan oo 16 qodob ka koobnaa ayaa waxaa geba-gabadii kulanka ka akhriyay Nabadoon Cabdishakuur Muuse Cilmi Ugaas. Kulanka ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay tobanaan nin oo lagu sheegay Odayaasha Dhaqanka ee Beesha Xawaadle, halka dhinaca Al Shabaab ay ku metelayeen xubno ay ka mid yihiin Xuseen Cali Fiidow, Xasan Yacquub Cali iyo Maxamed Abuu Cabdalla. Heshiiskan ayaa imanaya, ka dib khilaafkii xooganaa ee bishii September soo kala dhex galay Dowladda Federaalka iyo hoggaanka siyaasadeed iyo dhaqanka gobolkaasi, ka gadaal markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu taageeray musharaxnimada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe). Urur Siyaasadeedka JSP ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu hoggaamiyo ayaa 13-kii September si rasmi ah Cali Guudlaawe ugu xushay inuu noqdo musharaxa ku metelaya doorashada madaxtinimada Hirshabelle. Haldoorka beesha bariga Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa si adag uga horyimid in Cali Guudlaawe uu mar labaad u tartamo xafiiska, iyagoona Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku eedeeyay in uu jebiyay heshiiskii siyaasadeed ee ilaalinayay in xilka hoggaanka sare ee Hirshabelle uu si meerto ah ugu kala wareego labada gobol ee Hiiraan iyo Shabellaha Dhexe. Si kastaba ha-ahaatee heshiiska lagu gaaray Degmada Maxaas ayaa halis gelin kara kacdoonkii ka dhanka ahaa Al Shabaab ee sanadkii 2022 ka bilowday Gobolka Hiiraan.

Bayaanka ayaa lagu sheegay in dhinacyadu ay ka heshiiyeen dhammaan khilaafyadii iyo mad madowgii soo kala dhex galay, isla-markaana ay beeshu ogolaatay in deegaanadeeda ay ku nabad gelaan dagaal-yahanada Al Shabaab. “Beeshu waxay isla garatay inay xoojiso garab istaaga Jihaadka iyo Mujaahidiinta, ayna u hurto naftooda iyo maalkooda.” Ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Bayaanka ayaa lagu xusay inay beeshu aqbashay inaanan deegaanadeeda laga abaabulin, laga hawlgelin, magangelyana aan lagu siinin Ciidanka Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley ee ka soo jeeda Gobolka Hiiraan. Qodobkan ayaa u gogol xaaraya in la kala diro Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan oo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ka taageera la dagaalanka maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. “Beesha waxay adkeynaysaa ilaalinta, xoojinta iyo fulinta ballamihii ay wada galeen iyaga iyo Mujaahidiinta, lagana hortago wax kasta oo dhaawac u keeni kara heshiiskii la gaaray.” Ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Bayaankan oo 16 qodob ka koobnaa ayaa waxaa geba-gabadii kulanka ka akhriyay Nabadoon Cabdishakuur Muuse Cilmi Ugaas. Kulanka ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay tobanaan nin oo lagu sheegay Odayaasha Dhaqanka ee Beesha Xawaadle, halka dhinaca Al Shabaab ay ku metelayeen xubno ay ka mid yihiin Xuseen Cali Fiidow, Xasan Yacquub Cali iyo Maxamed Abuu Cabdalla. Heshiiskan ayaa imanaya, ka dib khilaafkii xooganaa ee bishii September soo kala dhex galay Dowladda Federaalka iyo hoggaanka siyaasadeed iyo dhaqanka gobolkaasi, ka gadaal markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu taageeray musharaxnimada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe). Urur Siyaasadeedka JSP ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu hoggaamiyo ayaa 13-kii September si rasmi ah Cali Guudlaawe ugu xushay inuu noqdo musharaxa ku metelaya doorashada madaxtinimada Hirshabelle. Haldoorka beesha bariga Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa si adag uga horyimid in Cali Guudlaawe uu mar labaad u tartamo xafiiska, iyagoona Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku eedeeyay in uu jebiyay heshiiskii siyaasadeed ee ilaalinayay in xilka hoggaanka sare ee Hirshabelle uu si meerto ah ugu kala wareego labada gobol ee Hiiraan iyo Shabellaha Dhexe. Si kastaba ha-ahaatee heshiiska lagu gaaray Degmada Maxaas ayaa halis gelin kara kacdoonkii ka dhanka ahaa Al Shabaab ee sanadkii 2022 ka bilowday Gobolka Hiiraan.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh: Xuutiyiintu Waxay Khalkhal Gelinayaan Xasilloonida Gobolka
items.description: MUQDISHO (Goobjoog News) — Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ku eedeeyey inay u dhaqmayso si cadaawad leh, isla markaana ay khalkhal gelinayso xasilloonida gobolka iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta ee marin-biyoodka Bab al‑Mandab. Madaxweynaha oo wareysi siiyey telefishinka Al Jazeera ayaa sheegay in falalka Xuutiyiintu ay carqaladeynayaan mid ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga caalamka. Bab al‑Mandab wuxuu isku xiraa Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, wuxuuna aad ugu dhow yahay xeebaha Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti. Hadalka Madaxweynaha ayaa muujinaya walaaca Muqdisho ka qabto in xiisadaha Yemen iyo Badda Cas ay saameeyaan amniga xeebaha Soomaaliya, dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta iyo qiimaha badeecadaha dibadda laga keeno. Weerarrada ama khataraha ka jira marinkan waxay maraakiibta ku qasbi karaan waddooyin dhaadheer oo kordhiya kharashka gaadiidka iyo caymiska. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay dhaqdhaqaaqyada Israa’iil ee Somaliland, isaga oo sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan aqbali doonin saldhig ama joogitaan Israa’iil oo laga sameeyo Berbera. Wuxuu ku dooday in qorshahaasi la xiriiri karo danaha amni ee Khaliijka, Iiraan, Yemen iyo marinnada Badda Cas, balse faahfaahin madax-bannaan oo xaqiijinaysa saldhig la dhisayo lama soo bandhigin. Dhanka la-dagaallanka argagixisada, Madaxweynaha ayaa Mareykanka ku tilmaamay saaxiibka amni ee ugu xooggan Soomaaliya, isagoo sheegay in iskaashiga labada dal uu sii socdo. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Al‑Shabaab laga saaray magaalooyinka waaweyn, isla markaana aysan awood u lahayn inay dib ula wareegto dalka. Hadalladan waxay Soomaaliya si cad ugu meeleynayaan dal diiddan in colaadaha Bariga Dhexe loo soo gudbiyo Geeska Afrika. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa wajahaysa caqabadda ah inay ilaaliso madaxbannaanida dalka, xeebaha iyo marin-biyoodka ku dhow, iyadoo isla waqtigaas la tacaalaysa Al‑Shabaab iyo saameynta dhaqaale ee ka dhalan karta qalalaasaha Badda Cas.

items.title: Somaliland oo Israa’iil ka dalbatay difaacyada casriga si ay uga hortagto Turkiga
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Somaliland ayaa la sheegay inay Israa’iil ka dalbatay nidaamyo difaac oo casri ah, oo ay ku jiraan diyaaradaha iswada, iyadoo tallaabadan ay la xiriirto walaaca ay ka qabto awoodda militari ee Turkiga iyo joogitaankiisa Soomaaliya. Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Somaliland ayaa wargeyska Middle East Eye u sheegay in Hargeysa ay dooneyso inay hesho qalab iyo nidaamyo difaac oo ay uga hortagto waxa ay u aragto khatar ka imaan karta dhinaca Turkiga. “Waxaan u baahanahay nidaamyada difaaca cirka, Turkigu wuxuu leeyahay diyaaradaha F-16 ee Muqdisho. Wuxuu doonayaa inuu saldhig ka dhiso Soomaaliya,” ayay mas’uuliyiinta Somaliland u sheegeen wargeyska. Warbixinta ayaa tilmaamaysa in Somaliland ay si gaar ah u danaynayso nidaamyada difaaca cirka, iyadoo sidoo kale la sheegay inay doonayso diyaaradaha iswada ee casriga ah, kuwaas oo qayb ka noqon kara qorshe ay ku xoojinayso awooddeeda difaac. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan walaacyada uu maamulka Somaliland ka qabo xiriirka militari ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, gaar ahaan taageerada difaac ee Ankara ay siiso Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa dhawaan dhistay Taliska Waqooyi oo fadhigiisu yahay magaalada Laascaanood, kaas oo lagu daray qaab-dhismeedka ciidamada dowladda ee ka howlgala waqooyiga dalka. Somaliland ayaa u aragta khatar amni oo ka dhan ah jiritaankeeda ciidamada ay Dowladda Federaalka ka qarameysay gobolka Sool, xilli Laascaanood uu si buuxda uga arrimiyo maamulka Waqooyi Bari. The post Somaliland oo Israa’iil ka dalbatay difaacyada casriga si ay uga hortagto Turkiga appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Siddeed Badmaax Oo Masaari Ah Oo Burcad-badeed Laga Sii Daayey Oo Muqdisho La Keenay
items.description: MUQDISHO (Goobjoog News) Siddeed badmaax oo Masaari ah oo muddo ku dhow shan bilood lagu haystay markabka M/T Eureka ayaa Muqdisho soo gaaray, kaddib markii laga sii daayey kooxihii afduubka ku haystay xeebaha Puntland. Safiirka Masar ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Salaax, ayaa badmaaxiinta ku qaabilay garoonka diyaaradaha Muqdisho, isaga oo u galbiyey xarunta safaaradda Masar. Halkaas ayaa hoy iyo ilaalin loogu diyaariyey inta laga dhammaystirayo safarkooda Qaahira. Badmaaxiinta ayaa lagu haystay markabka M/T Eureka tan iyo 2-dii May, markii markabka oo ka yimid biyaha Yemen loo kaxaystay dhinaca xeebaha Puntland. Waxay ka mid ahaayeen 22 shaqaale ah oo saarnaa markabka shidaalka qaada ee ku gooshayey calanka Togo. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Masar ayaa sheegtay in sii-dayntooda lagu gaaray xiriirro diblomaasiyadeed oo heer sare ah oo lala sameeyey mas’uuliyiinta Soomaaliya iyo Yemen. Safaaradda Masar ee Muqdisho ayaa muddadii afduubka fududaynaysay xiriirka badmaaxiinta iyo qoysaskooda. Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Masar Cali Cabdi Awaare ayaa sheegay in badmaaxiintu nabad qabaan, isla markaana labada dowladood ay iska kaashanayaan dhammaystirka habraacyada dib loogu celinayo dalkooda. Waxaa la filayaa inay Qaahira ugu safraan duulimaadka ugu horreeya ee loo heli karo. Sii-daynta shaqaalahan ayaa kusoo beegantay xilli ciidamada Puntland ay kordhiyeen hawlgallada ka dhanka ah burcad-badeedda. Hase yeeshee, weli lama shaacin faahfaahinta heshiiska lagu sii daayey badmaaxiinta ama in lacag madax-furasho ah la bixiyey.

items.title: Golaha wakiillada oo laalay wax-ka-beddelkii xeerka jinsiyadaha.
items.description: Golaha wakiillada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa laalay wax-ka-beddelkii xeerka jinsiyadaha. Mudanayaasha golaha wakiillada ayaa saaka cod aqlabiyad ku meel mariyay laalista wax-ka-beddelka xeerka jinsiyadaha. Golaha waxa fadhiyay 45 mudane, waxa oggolaaday laalista xeerka 43 mudane, halka guddoomiyahununa aanu codayn, 1 mudane diiday, cid ka aammustay na aanay jirin.

items.title: When geopolitics becomes economics
items.description: When geopolitics becomes economics From the Red Sea to the Strait of Hormuz, economic interests are driving a new contest for global influence By Dr Raza Muhammad PUBLISHED October 04, 2026 Currently, the world has 65 active conflicts, which is the highest number post WWII. Out of these nine are interstate and the remaining 57 are intra state. However, the most significant one that affects the whole world is the Iran-US war. Though scaled down in intensity after the Pakistan-brokered ceasefire and the Islamabad MoU, it still impacts the world economy the most. The recent unprecedented and quick sweep of Houthis capturing the southern coast of Yemen along the Red Sea has added a newer dimension to this imbroglio. To top it all, US President Trump’s denial to Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman’s requests to conduct strikes against the Houthis, and the Houthis’ assurances of not attacking the US and Israeli vessels, came as a surprise to all, but more so for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, an old US ally. Connecting these developments to Somaliland and its recognition by Israel in December 2025, and UAE’s reported intent to establish a military base there make it a complex maze of geo-strategy. Is it a complementary effort by Iran to counter the alternative oil supply route of KSA? Or is it a US-Israel tit-for-tat endeavour to pressurise KSA to join the Abraham Accords? Nonetheless, it implies that the Bab al-Mandeb and Red Sea maritime route can be controlled any time by the Houthis and Somaliland, albeit with external support. One must acknowledge that Trump has a strategic sense and vision that he is proudly implementing for the US. It was well deduced at the beginning of Iran-US-Israel War, that the whole effort centres around control of oil, critical minerals, the oceanic chokepoints, keeping petro dollars thriving, continuation of Israeli atrocities and expansion in this garb, and to carve a new security architecture in the region built around the Abraham Accords and Make America Great Again (MAGA). A hold on Venezuelan oil, planned efforts to control Latin American and African oil, and the US-Denmark-Greenland accord on Greenland, where melting ice is creating new water ways and, its possession is essential for establishing Golden Dome air defence system by US, as well as denial of access to its natural riches to Russia and China are the means to gain the ends of this strategy. It’s only apt to emphasise here that all these conflicts are least about religion or ideology. These are primarily part of economic contestation including trade, control of resources, sea and land accesses and war economy. Interestingly, as of now, the largest oil and gas producing, and exporting country is the US. Despite war, Iran earns billions of dollars from oil sales and Russian gas passes through Ukraine and Ukraine gets royalty. The other element of the war economy is who benefits maximum from prolongation of the conflict(s) and restricted oil flows? The chief beneficiaries are oil producing countries, insurance and shipping companies, black market and military industrial complexes. Israel has been intentionally kept out of this phase of the war affording it opportunity to regroup, reequip and rebuild to continue with its expansionist policy and become strong enough to perpetuate as regional might. Systemic genocide of Palestinians, especially children persists in this moral and legal vacuum. In this whole scenario, the shedding of responsibility by the US to oversee “the rules-based world order” as a super power engenders chaos, anarchy and increasing sense of insecurity. Consequently, the smaller and middle powers are building interest based alliances to secure their interests, and are hedging to join the blocs/camps. China’s speedy rise through win-win economic cooperation stays the prime focus of Trump’s MAGA strategy, which boils down to imperialist expansion to enhance US sphere of influence, slow down US decline and scuttle Chinese rise. The recent meeting of President Xi and Trump at the White House may not end their contest, but could help keep it non-kinetic for now. The Iran-US war is likely to continue until both sides lower their truce aims. Iran is not likely to settle for less than royalty for strait of Hormuz, like Suez canal, assured cessations of hostilities, lifting of sanctions and integration into the world economic system. The Houthis may follow the lead to come to terms with Yemen and KSA in somewhat similar manner. The long term solution of the Iran-US, Houthis-Yemen-KSA and Israel’s accesses resides in diplomacy and politics, not in the use of military instruments. Pakistan’s brokering of ceasefire, making the Islamabad MoU happen, KSA-Pakistan bilateral, and then trilateral joint defence agreement including Türkiye and continued improvement in our relations with all major and middle powers are manifestations of this fact. Pakistan must continue with efforts for longer lasting regional peace by bringing Iran-US back to table and help effect a ceasefire and forge a long-term solution of Yemen-Houthis-KSA issue. At the same time, new-found relevance and friendships are to be translated into B2B and P2P long-term partnerships to construct complex interdependence with edifice in intertwined destinies for longer lasting good relations with all, especially immediate neighbours. China Pakistan time-tested and trusted bond has to be cemented further. The writer is a (Retired) Major General, former ambassador, a PhD and a freelance contributor All facts and information are the sole responsibility of the writer Tribune

The recent meeting of President Xi and Trump at the White House may not end their contest, but could help keep it non-kinetic for now. The Iran-US war is likely to continue until both sides lower their truce aims. Iran is not likely to settle for less than royalty for strait of Hormuz, like Suez canal, assured cessations of hostilities, lifting of sanctions and integration into the world economic system. The Houthis may follow the lead to come to terms with Yemen and KSA in somewhat similar manner. The long term solution of the Iran-US, Houthis-Yemen-KSA and Israel’s accesses resides in diplomacy and politics, not in the use of military instruments. Pakistan’s brokering of ceasefire, making the Islamabad MoU happen, KSA-Pakistan bilateral, and then trilateral joint defence agreement including Türkiye and continued improvement in our relations with all major and middle powers are manifestations of this fact. Pakistan must continue with efforts for longer lasting regional peace by bringing Iran-US back to table and help effect a ceasefire and forge a long-term solution of Yemen-Houthis-KSA issue. At the same time, new-found relevance and friendships are to be translated into B2B and P2P long-term partnerships to construct complex interdependence with edifice in intertwined destinies for longer lasting good relations with all, especially immediate neighbours. China Pakistan time-tested and trusted bond has to be cemented further. items.title: Agaasimaha NISA oo Kormeeray Ciidamo Tababar ku Jira Balanballe
items.description: Balanballe, Galgaduud – 4 Oktoobar 2026: Agaasimaha Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA), Mudane Mahad Maxamed Salaad, ayaa maanta kormeeray xarunta ciidamada NISA ee degmada Balanballe ee gobolka Galgaduud, halkaas oo tababar loogu wado ciidamo ka tirsan hay’adda. Agaasime Mahad Salaad ayaa intii uu kormeerka ku guda jiray la kulmay ciidamada tababarka ku jira, isagoo kula dardaarmay inay si dhab ah uga dhabeeyaan waajibaadka iyo ballanta ay u qaadeen difaaca dalka, shacabka iyo diinta. Kormeerkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli NISA ay xoojineyso joogitaankeeda iyo kaabeyaasha amni ee gobolka Galgaduud. Bishii June ee sanadkan, Agaasimaha NISA ayaa Balanballe ka dhagax-dhigay xarun cusub oo loogu talagalay ciidamada hay’adda ee ka howlgeli doona degmada iyo deegaannada ku xeeran. Agaasimaha NISA iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa haatan ku sugan Balanballe, iyadoo degmada lagu wado inay martigeliso maalmaha soo socda munaasabado iyo kulamo waaweyn oo la xiriira dib-u-heshiisiin, gaar ahaan dadaallada lagu xoojinayo nabadda iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada. Booqashada Mahad Salaad ee Galmudug ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmaysa kulamo uu dhawaan la yeeshay qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada, kuwaas oo diiradda lagu saaray nabadda, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo xoojinta wada shaqeynta bulshada iyo hay’adaha dowladda.

items.title: Duqa Muqdisho oo la kulmay Safiirka Aljeeriya, casuumaad rasmi ahna ka helay Algiers
items.description: Muqdisho, 4 Oktoobar 2026: Guddoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Dr. Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa kulan la yeeshay Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Aljeeriya u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Mudane Mohamed Alim. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Muqdisho iyo Algiers, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen sidii loo dhisi lahaa barnaamijyo iskaashi oo wax-ku-ool ah oo labada caasimadood ay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan. Sidoo kale, waxaa kulanka lagu soo qaaday fursadaha lagu horumarin karo xirfadaha shaqaalaha, is-weydaarsiga khibradaha iyo aqoonta, iyo sidii Muqdisho ay uga faa’iideysan lahayd waayo-aragnimada Aljeeriya ee maamulka iyo horumarinta caasimadaha. Safiirka Aljeeriya ayaa Duqa Muqdisho u gudbiyay casuumaad rasmi ah oo uu ka siday Guddoomiyaha caasimadda Algiers, Mohamed Abdenour Rabhi, taas oo loogu martiqaaday Duqa Muqdisho inuu booqasho rasmi ah ku tago Aljeeriya. Duqa Muqdisho ayaa uga mahadceliyay Safiirka dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Aljeeriya, isagoo sidoo kale bogaadiyay doorka Aljeeriya ee taageerada horumarinta iyo bilicda caasimadda Muqdisho.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo Itoobiya u yaboohay saddex deked
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalka ay diyaar u tahay inay Itoobiya u oggolaato inay isticmaasho laba ama saddex dekedood oo Soomaaliyeed, si ay uga dhoofiso ugana soo dejiso badeecadaha. Xasan Sheekh ayaa arrintan ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyey Al Jazeera, maalmo kaddib markii uu magaalada Addis Ababa kula kulmay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Axmed. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan kasoo horjeedin in Itoobiya, oo aan bad lahayn, ay hesho marin ganacsi oo ay ku gaarto badda, balse arrintaas ay tahay inay ku timaaddo heshiis ay labada dowladood wada galaan. “Waxaan diyaar u nahay inaan Itoobiya u oggolaanno inay isticmaasho laba ama saddex dekedood oo Soomaaliyeed si ay wax uga soo dejiso ugana dhoofiso,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Waxa uu sheegay in heshiisyo dhaqaale lagu nidaamin karo canshuuraha, khidmadaha iyo arrimaha kale ee la xiriira isticmaalka dekedaha. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Itoobiya ay Soomaaliya u sheegtay inay u baahan tahay marin-badeed, balse aysan weli soo gudbin codsi rasmi ah oo qeexaya nooca marin ama heshiis ay dooneyso. Hadalka madaxweynaha ayaa yimid afar maalmood kaddib markii uu 29-kii September safar shaqo ku tegay Addis Ababa, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay Abiy Axmed. Safarkaas ayaa ku yimid codsi ka yimid Abiy, waxaana labada hoggaamiye ay ka wada hadleen xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Geeska Afrika. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya midkoodna kulankaas kaddib ma shaacin heshiis cusub oo laga gaaray arrinta marin-badeedka. Heshiiskii Ankara Hadalka Xasan Sheekh ayaa ah mid ka mid ah tilmaamaha ugu cadcad ee ilaa hadda laga helay waxa Muqdisho ay diyaar u tahay inay Itoobiya ka siiso arrinta badda. Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ayaa bishii December 2024 magaalada Ankara ku gaaray heshiis ay Turkigu dhexdhexaadiyeen, kaas oo lagu dejiyey qaab ay labada dal uga wada xaajoon karaan marin-badeed ay Itoobiya hesho, iyadoo la ilaalinayo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Heshiiskaas ayaa dhigaya in Itoobiya ay heli karto marin ganacsi oo “ammaan ah, joogto ah oo lagu kalsoonaan karo”, iyada oo loo marayo heshiisyo ay labada dal wada galaan, sida kireysi ama habab kale oo ganacsi. Labada dowladood ayaa bishii February 2025 Ankara ka bilaabay wada-hadallo farsamo oo lagu hirgelinayo heshiiskaas, balse ilaa hadda lama shaacin heshiis kama dambeys ah oo ku saabsan deked ay Itoobiya isticmaali doonto. Khilaafka labada dal ayaa markii hore ka dhashay heshiiskii Itoobiya ay bishii January 2024 la gashay Somaliland, oo ah gobol ka tirsan Soomaaliya. Heshiiskaas ayaa Itoobiya siin lahaa marin badeed, halka Somaliland ay sheegtay inuu ku xirnaa suurta-galnimada in Addis Ababa ay aqoonsato madax-bannaanideeda ay sheegato. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa heshiiskaas si adag u diiday, iyadoo ku tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee dalka. Heshiiskii Ankara ayaa markii dambe wadahadallada ku soo celiyey hannaan ay Muqdisho iyo Addis Ababa si toos ah uga wada xaajoonayaan marin-badeedka. Maxay Itoobiya dhab ahaan rabtaa? Qodobka weli aan caddayn ayaa ah in marin ganacsi oo ay Soomaaliya bixiso uu dabooli karo waxa Itoobiya dhab ahaan ka dooneyso Badda Cas. Mas’uuliyiin Itoobiyaan ah ayaa bilihii dambe sii kordhiyey isticmaalka erayga “sovereign access” marka ay ka hadlayaan baahida dalkooda ee marin-badeedka, hadal ka ballaaran marin ganacsi oo keliya. Bishii September, mas’uuliyiin Itoobiyaan ah ayaa mar kale ku celceliyey in helitaanka marin ay Itoobiya si gaar ah u maamusho uu muhiim u yahay mustaqbalka dhaqaale iyo amni ee dalka. Dhanka kale, madaxda Itoobiya waxay sidoo kale sheegeen inay doonayaan inay arrintaas ku raadiyaan wada-hadal iyo hannaan diblomaasiyadeed. Heshiiska Ankara wuxuu Itoobiya siinayaa waddo ay ku heli karto marin-badeed, balse wuxuu si cad u dhigaya in heshiis kasta uu hoos imaanayo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Sidaas darteed, farqi ayaa weli u muuqda inuu u dhexeeyo waxa Muqdisho diyaar u tahay inay bixiso — oo ah marin ganacsi oo dekedaha Soomaaliyeed ah — iyo hadallada qaarkood ee kasoo baxaya Addis Ababa ee ku saabsan “sovereign access”. Xasan Sheekh ma uusan magacaabin dekedaha labada ama saddexda ah ee Soomaaliya ay Itoobiya u furi karto, mana uusan bixin faahfaahin ku saabsan muddada heshiiska, waddooyinka isku xiri kara Itoobiya iyo dekedahaas ama qaabka loo maamuli lahaa. Waxa uu sidoo kale caddeeyey in Itoobiya aysan weli soo gudbin codsi rasmi ah oo lagu ogaan karo waxa ay si dhab ah uga dooneyso Soomaaliya. Taasi waxay ka dhigan tahay in inkastoo Muqdisho ay hadda si cad miiska u saartay fursad ay Itoobiya ku isticmaali karto dhowr dekedood oo Soomaaliyeed, haddana faahfaahinta iyo baaxadda dalabka Addis Ababa ay weli yihiin kuwo aan si rasmi ah loo qeexin. items.title: Cutubyo kale oo Ciidamada Militariga oo la geeyay Baydhabo
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sare u qaadday taageeradeeda militari ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, ka dib dagaalkii qaraaraa ee Isniintii ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. Cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, isla-markaana u badan Kumaandooska Gorgor iyo gaadiid dagaal ayaa dhowrkii maalmood ee u dambeeyay laga dejiyay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud ee magaaladaasi. Ciidamadan oo laga daabulay Caasimadda Muqdisho ayaa loogu talagalay inay xoojin u noqdaan Militariga Somaliya iyo Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed ee horey ugu sugnaa bannaanada magaaladaasi. Saraakiisha Taliska Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa kuu sheegaya in durbaba ciidamada laga keenay Muqdisho la geeyay difaacyada ay ciidamada isku dhafan ku leeyihiin nawaaxiga magaalada. Tallaabada ciidamadan loogu qaaday Baydhabo ayaa muujineysa diyaargarow iyo xaalad dagaal oo aad u sarreysa, ka dib markii ay kordheen weerarada ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ay ka gaysanayaan magaalada ugu weyn ee Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Weeraradan ayaa abuuray walaac dhanka amniga iyo dib-u-dhac siyaasadeed, marka aad eegto in ay curyaaminayaan shaqada maamulka iyo dhismaha dowladnimada. Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa taageero buuxda la garab taagan Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ee Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu hoggaamiyo, si loo sugo amniga, loona difaaco Magaalada Baydhabo. Loolanka awoodeed ee u dhexeeya maamulka cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed iyo hoggaankii hore ayaa horseeday deganaansho la’aan siyaasadeed iyo xasillooni daro amni, taasna waxay carqaladeynaysaa qorshaha siyaasadeed ee Villa Somalia ku maamuleyso dalka. items.title: Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan and Somalia forge unified front on Red Sea governance and state sovereignty
items.description: The leaders of Egypt, Somalia, Sudan, and Eritrea have issued the Alamein Joint Declaration, establishing a unified four-nation front to assert exclusive sovereignty over Red Sea governance, defend the territorial integrity of member states, and categorically reject any unilateral measures affecting the Nile River. Meeting in New Alamein City on October 4, Egyptian President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi, Eritrean President Isaias Afwerki, Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, and Sudanese Transitional Sovereignty Council Chairman General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan agreed to establish a periodic joint mechanism to coordinate regional security. The quadripartite summit outlined a cohesive stance on Horn of Africa flashpoints, emphasising that Red Sea governance remains the exclusive responsibility of littoral states, whilst underscoring the necessity of ensuring the freedom and safety of international navigation in the Gulf of Aden and the Bab-el-Mandeb strait. Regarding transboundary rivers, particularly the Nile, the declaration emphasised the necessity of adhering to international law and the principle of no harm. The summit mandated cooperation through prior notification, consultation, and consensus, stating a complete rejection of any unilateral measures that harm the existing water uses of the Nile’s downstream states. Addressing the situation in Somalia, the declaration affirmed absolute support for the federal republic’s unity and explicitly rejected any interference targeting its sovereignty. The leaders stated they refuse any recognition or support for the so-called Somaliland, deeming it a direct violation of Somalia’s territorial integrity. They backed Mogadishu’s counter-terrorism efforts and called on international partners to provide sufficient, predictable, and sustainable funding for the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) to facilitate the orderly transfer of security responsibilities to Somali forces. On Sudan, the four nations pledged support for the country’s unity, sovereignty, and national institutions, whilst rejecting the establishment of any parallel entities and expressing total refusal of any support for mercenaries. The leaders encouraged the resumption of a Sudanese-owned and Sudanese-led political process. Egyptian Presidency Spokesperson Ambassador Mohamed El-Shenawy stated that al-Sisi outlined Egypt’s efforts to achieve ceasefires and comprehensive political settlements. Al-Sisi warned against foreign interventions that prolong conflicts and exacerbate human suffering, stressing that attempts to undermine state unity are explicit violations of international law, the United Nations Charter, and the Constitutive Act of the African Union. He reaffirmed Egypt’s continued support for national institutions in confronting security challenges, notably terrorism. The leaders also discussed ongoing economic and development cooperation projects, exploring ways to enhance regional integration in infrastructure, energy, and trade. The summit concluded with the visiting presidents expressing their appreciation for Egypt’s role in supporting continental stability and its policy based on African solidarity, dialogue, and the peaceful settlement of disputes. items.title: Maxay tahay digniinta laga soo saaray Hargeysa?
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka magaalada Hargeysa ee caasimadda Somaliland ayaa digniin u diray shacabka, isagoo ugu baaqay inay ka feejignaadaan khatarta daadadka laga cabsi qabo inay ka dhashaan roobabka la saadaaliyay. Maamulka ayaa dadka uga digay inay qaadaan tallaabooyin taxaddar ah si looga hortago khatar nafeed iyo mid maaliyadeed oo ka dhalan karta roobabka iyo daadadka la filayo. Sida digniinta lagu sheegay, roobabka la saadaaliyay ayaa laga yaabaa inay ka bataan heerarkii caadiga ahaa ama ay da’aan saacado badan, taas oo kordhin karta suuragalnimada fatahaado iyo biyo badan oo magaalada kusoo rogmada. Daadadka ayaa sidoo kale sababi kara in waddooyin muhiim ah ay xirmaan, halka goobaha loogu talagalay inay biyaha qaadaan ay buuxsami karaan, taas oo keeni karta in biyuhu ku fatahaan meelaha ay dadku deggan yihiin. Waxaa kale oo laga digay khatarta ka dhalan karta dhismayaasha qadiimiga ah ama kuwa loo yaqaan qabyada ee dhameystirneen, kuwaas oo ay suuragal tahay inay dumaan haddii ay helaan roobab culus oo daba dheeraada. Maamulka Somaliland ayaa sidoo kale shacabka ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan meelaha ay ka jirto khatarta korontada, gaar ahaan goobaha ay biyuhu gaari karaan ama ay fiilooyinka korontadu soo gaari karaan. Dadka ayaa sidoo kale lagu wargeliyay inay ka fogaadaan meelaha biyaha laga gudbo ama la isaga kala tallaabo, maadaama qulqulka biyaha iyo daadadka xooggan ay keeni karaan khatar culus. Maamulka ayaa ugu dambeyn shacabka ugu baaqay inay si gaar ah uga feejignaadaan xaaladaha roobabka inta ay socdaan, isla markaana ay raacaan digniinaha iyo tilmaamaha laamaha ay khuseyso si loo yareeyo khasaaraha ka dhalan kara daadadka. items.title: Somaliland oo war cusub ka soo saartay damaca Itoobiya ee badda iyo heshiiskii MoU
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Somaliland ayaa sheegay inuu taageersan yahay in Itoobiya ay hesho marin badeed, xilli uu hore u fashilmay heshiiskii maamulka uu Itoobiya ugu ogolaanayay badda. Mowqifkan ayaa lagu sheegay bayaan ay 3-dii October 2026 soo saartay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Somaliland, taas oo sheegtay inay si joogto ah u taageertay heshiisyo lagu siinayo Itoobiya marin ay ka hesho badda. “Dowladda Somaliland waxay si joogto ah u taageertay heshiisyo gorgortan lagu gaaro oo u oggolaanaya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Itoobiya inay hesho marin badeed iyada oo loo marayo iskaashi labada dhinacba faa’iido u leh,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Somaliland. Wasaaraddu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in mowqifka Soomaaliya uu ka hor imanayo hadallada Muqdisho ee ku aaddan arrintan, iyadoo si gaar ah u xustay ololaha dowladda Soomaaliya ee ka dhanka ah is-afgaradkii Somaliland iyo Itoobiya ee la saxiixay 2024. Dhanka kale, Somaliland waxay sheegtay inay diiddan tahay faragelin lagu sameeyo heshiisyada ay la gasho dhinacyada kale, iyadoo ku adkaysatay inay sii wadi doonto heshiisyo ay ku sheegtay inay ilaalinayaan madax-bannaanida isla markaana gacan ka geysanaya horumarinta iyo barwaaqada gobolka. Is-afgaradkii ay Somaliland iyo Itoobiya kala saxiixdeen January 2024 ayaa salka ku hayay sidii Itoobiya loogu fududeyn lahaa helitaanka marin badeed. Arrintaasi waxay dhalisay khilaaf diblomaasiyadeed oo xooggan oo u dhexeeyay Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa xilligaas si adag uga hortimid is-afgaradka, iyadoo ku tilmaantay mid xadgudub ku ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, maadaama Somaliland ay Soomaaliya u aqoonsan tahay inay qayb ka tahay dhulkeeda. Hadalkan Somaliland ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan mabda’ ahaan diiddanayn in Itoobiya ay hesho marin badeed, balse uu xusay in arrintaasi ay ku imaan karto heshiis wadajir ah oo Itoobiya loogu oggolaanayo inay isticmaasho dekedaha Soomaaliya. Labada mowqif ayaa muujinaya kala duwanaanshaha ka taagan habka loo wajahayo doonista Itoobiya ee helitaanka marin badeed, iyadoo maamulka Somaliland uu ku adkaysanayo heshiisyo toos ah, halka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay sheegtay in isticmaalka dekedaha dalka lagu heshiin karo qaab wadajir ah. items.title: Gaza’s Medical Crisis Deepens as WHO Warns Aid Is Trapped in Delays
items.description: WHO Says None of Gaza’s Hospitals Is Fully Functional as Critical Medical Supplies Wait Weeks for Israeli Clearance GENEVA (WDN) — Gaza’s humanitarian crisis is deepening as critical medical supplies face prolonged delays before entering the territory, with the World Health Organization warning that patients are paying the price for a system it describes as slow, unpredictable and increasingly difficult to navigate. Reinhilde Van de Weerdt, the WHO’s representative in the Palestinian territories, said Gaza’s health system remains “utterly dire”, with none of its hospitals currently fully functional. “Not enough humanitarian aid is entering Gaza, and definitely not enough to allow for a meaningful expansion and restoration of health services,” she told reporters in Geneva from Jerusalem. At the heart of the problem, according to the WHO, is Israel’s approval system for humanitarian and medical shipments. The WHO says large quantities of medical supplies are waiting for clearance for a median of 74 days. When shipments are rejected, the approval process must begin again, creating further delays for hospitals already struggling to provide basic care. Essential Equipment Rejected The delays are affecting equipment that hospitals depend on to diagnose and treat patients. Van de Weerdt said X-ray machines, sterilization equipment, CT-scan spare parts and other essential medical supplies are regularly rejected. In one case, a shipment containing prosthetics and assistive devices was rejected four times within six months, she said. Medicines have generally faced fewer obstacles, with almost 87 percent of shipments approved and about 1 percent rejected, according to the WHO. But the organization says medicines alone cannot restore a health system whose hospitals, diagnostic equipment and other essential infrastructure have been devastated. “It’s not one single blockage. It’s a system, layered with delay after delay,” Van de Weerdt said. Behind every delay, she added, is a patient waiting for treatment. WHO: Count of Trucks Does Not Tell the Full Story The WHO is calling for the predictable and unimpeded entry of humanitarian and medical supplies into Gaza at scale. It also wants additional crossings opened and clear, publicly available rules governing humanitarian shipments. Van de Weerdt warned that the number of trucks entering Gaza should not be used as the sole measure of humanitarian access. “A truck full of non-priority supplies, or the right supplies arriving too late, doesn’t save lives,” she said. Israel maintains that its screening procedures are necessary to prevent materials with potential military applications from reaching Hamas, which it accuses of using civilian infrastructure and supplies to support its operations. A Health System on the Edge The consequences are being felt across Gaza’s already devastated health system. Hospitals are operating under extraordinary pressure while medical equipment, spare parts and other supplies remain difficult to obtain. For patients requiring specialized treatment, a delayed shipment can mean a delayed diagnosis, interrupted treatment or the absence of essential medical equipment altogether. The war began with Hamas’s October 7, 2023 attack on Israel, which killed 1,221 people, according to an AFP tally based on official Israeli figures. Israel’s subsequent military campaign has devastated large parts of Gaza and killed more than 74,000 people, according to Gaza’s health ministry, which operates under Hamas authorities. The United Nations has generally regarded the ministry’s casualty figures as credible, although they do not distinguish between combatants and civilians. For the WHO, however, the immediate issue is not simply the number of people killed. t is whether those who remain alive can obtain the medical care they need. “On the other side of every one of these delays is a patient who is waiting,” Van de Weerdt said. And in Gaza, where an entire health system is struggling to function, the cost of waiting can be measured in lives. And in Gaza, where an entire health system is struggling to function, the cost of waiting can be measured in lives. items.title: Somalia won’t accept Israeli presence in Somaliland ‘under any circumstances,’ president says
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia will not accept Israeli presence in the country “under any circumstances” and will resist any attempts to be pulled into the Middle East’s crises, its President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud tells Al Jazeera. Speaking in an exclusive interview, Mohamud said that Israel was planning to establish a naval base in Berbera and use the city’s airport, adding that its real aim was to get closer to the Gulf states and Iran. Berbera is a port city on the Gulf of Aden coast in Somaliland – the self-declared republic in northwestern Somalia that Israel recognised last year, but which is claimed by Mogadishu. Berbera faces Yemen across the water near the strategic Bab al-Mandeb strait. The Iran-aligned Houthis have previously enforced a blockade on Israel-linked ships in the area. “We will overcome the challenges posed to our country by Israeli moves,” Mohamud said in his wide-ranging interview. He added that the Israeli plans fall under the “Greater Israel” project – referring to a term for various proposals, often rooted in biblical interpretations, for Israeli control over territory beyond its current borders. Some versions extend from the Nile to the Euphrates. Israel has not adopted it as official policy, but Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in an August 2025 interview that he felt connected to the vision, prompting condemnation from Arab governments. The Somali president described Israel as a “destabilising force” that does not abide by international law. He also criticised Tel Aviv’s recognition of Somaliland in December. No country other than Israel recognises Somaliland, while the region’s own residents are completely opposed to an Israeli presence, Mohamud said. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991 and has governed itself independently for more than three decades. But it had not secured recognition from any United Nations member state until Israel’s move. Fight against armed groups The Somali president told Al Jazeera the United States remains his country’s strongest partner in the fight against “terrorism”, and added that al-Shabab has no presence in the major cities, leaving no possibility of the group taking control in Somalia. Al-Shabab is a Somali armed group that emerged from the Islamic Courts Union in the mid-2000s and pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012. It has fought Somalia’s federal government for years, holds territory in parts of southern and central Somalia, and has carried out deadly attacks, including in Mogadishu and in neighbouring Kenya. Regarding the East Africa region, Mohamud said Somalia’s relations with neighbouring Ethiopia are good, and Mogadishu does not object to Addis Ababa gaining access to the sea through a joint agreement to use Somali ports for its economic interests. Ethiopia has been landlocked since Eritrea became independent in 1993 and relies largely on Djibouti’s ports for trade. In January 2024, Addis Ababa signed a memorandum of understanding with Somaliland on sea access, which Somalia condemned as a violation of its sovereignty. Somalia and Ethiopia later agreed to ease tensions. Houthis ‘destabilising’ region Mohamud also accused Yemen’s Houthis of “destabilising the region” and disrupting navigation in the Bab al-Mandeb strait. His comments come as the group attempts to build on its lightning offensive that captured the country’s Red Sea coast last month. Thus far, Yemeni government forces have been able to hold their positions on the front lines and even claimed to have inflicted heavy losses against the Houthis. The Houthis have also intensified their attacks on Saudi Arabia, but the kingdom’s Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (MBS) has promised not to compromise on its security, saying the Yemeni rebels chose “chaos and destruction, threatening the Yemeni people and the region”.

items.title: Crude Oil Tanker Hit by Projectile Off Oman as Hormuz Shipping Risks Mount
items.description: Latest Attack Raises Fresh Alarm for Global Energy Shipping as Vessel Is Struck Near One of the World’s Most Critical Oil Routes MUSCAT (WDN) — A crude oil tanker was struck by an unknown projectile off Oman on Friday, triggering another maritime security alert in waters surrounding the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. The vessel’s master reported that the tanker was hit on its port side about four nautical miles east of Oman, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO). All crew members were reported safe, and no environmental impact had been reported at the time of the alert. Authorities have not identified the projectile or determined who was responsible for the attack. UKMTO advised vessels operating in the area to exercise caution and report suspicious activity as investigations continue. Another Blow to Commercial Shipping The incident comes amid a series of attacks and reported projectile strikes against commercial tankers transiting the Strait of Hormuz. On September 29, three Liberian-flagged oil tankers were reportedly struck by unidentified projectiles while navigating the waterway, according to maritime intelligence firm Marisks. The origin of those projectiles has not been established. Another tanker was reported struck in the Strait on October 1, with the incident reportedly causing a fire and prompting the evacuation of its crew. The growing number of incidents is placing renewed pressure on one of the world’s most important energy corridors. Why Hormuz Matters The Strait of Hormuz is a narrow maritime passage connecting the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman and the wider Arabian Sea. It is a critical route for international energy shipments, making any sustained disruption potentially significant for global oil markets and commercial shipping. For tanker operators, the latest incidents add another layer of risk to navigation through the waterway, where vessels must already contend with heightened regional military tensions. The latest strike is particularly significant because it occurred only a few nautical miles from the Omani coast. The immediate outcome was less severe than some recent tanker incidents: no crew casualties or environmental damage were reported. But the unanswered questions are increasingly serious. Who launched the projectile? Was the tanker deliberately targeted? Was the incident connected to the wider regional conflict? And can commercial vessels continue to transit the waterway without facing unacceptable risks? None of those questions has yet been answered. For the shipping industry, however, the message is already clear: the security environment around Hormuz remains highly volatile. Every new strike risks increasing insurance costs, disrupting shipping schedules and encouraging operators to reconsider routes through one of the world’s most important energy corridors. For now, the tanker and its crew have survived the latest incident without reported casualties or an oil spill. But with multiple vessels already coming under attack, the wider danger to commercial shipping is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore. items.title: Puntland oo shaqo joojin ku sameysay taliye sare kadib dhacdadii…
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Taliska Ciidanka Booliska Puntland ayaa shaqo joojin ku sameeyay Taliyaha Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Mudug, Maxamuud Muuse Bile (Fardafuul) kadib dhacdadii baxsashada maxaabiista burcad-badeedda. Taliyaha ayaa ku-meel-gaar ahaan lagu beddelay ku-xigeenkiisa, Ayuub Siciid Cali Dheeg, kaas oo hadda sii haya xilka Taliyaha Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Mudug. Go’aanka shaqo joojinta taliyaha ayaa daba socda dhacdadii ay ku baxsadeen maxaabiis burcad-badeed ah oo uu kasoo qaaday deegaanka Garacad, kuwaas oo lagu soo qabtay markabkii SIBU 1. Dhacdada baxsashada ayaa dhacday 26-kii September, waxaana xilligaas goobta ka dhacay iska horimaad sababay dhimashada mid kamid ah maxaabiista burcad-badeedda, halka mid kalena uu ku dhaawacmay. Maxaabiista ayaa lasoo qabtay kadib markii howlgal lagula wareegay markabka SIBU 1, kaas oo kamid ahaa maraakiib ay burcad-badeeddu afduubteen. Tallaabadan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli Puntland ay weli gacanta ku hayso maxaabiis kale oo burcad-badeed ah oo lagu qabtay howlgallo ka dhan ahaa kooxaha afduubka maraakiibta. Tirada maxaabiista ay Puntland hadda gacanta ku hayso ayaa gaaraysa ku dhowaad 30 qof, kuwaas oo laga soo qabtay maraakiibtii Honour 25 iyo SIBU 1 ee lagu afduubtay xeebaha maamulka. Baxsashada maxaabiista ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca habka loo sugayo amniga iyo ilaalinta burcad-badeedda lagu qabto howlgallada badda, iyadoo shaqo joojinta taliyaha booliska Mudug ay qayb ka tahay tallaabada laga qaaday dhacdadaas. items.title: Siisi oo soo faro-geliyey khilaafka siyaasadda Somalia
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Masar Abdel Fattah al-Sisi ayaa markii ugu horreysay ka hadlay khilaafa siyaaasadda Soomaaliya, isaga oo ku baaqay in la xoojiyo heshiiska iyo is-afgaradka qaran ee u dhexeeya dhinacyada kala duwan ee dalka isku haya, isaga oo sheegay in arrintaasi muhiim u tahay midnimada iyo xasilloonida dalka. Sisi ayaa hadalkan jeediyey Sabtidii intii uu kulan la lahaa madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kaas oo ka dhacay magaalada cusub ee Al-Calamayn, sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay madaxtooyada Masar. Madaxtooyada Masar ayaa sheegtay in labada madaxweyne ay ka wada hadleen xaaladaha gudaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo Sisi uu carrabka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo “is-afgaradka qaran” ee u dhexeeya dhinacyada iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee Soomaalida. Sisi ayaa sheegay in is-afgaradkaasi uu gacan ka geysan karo ilaalinta midnimada dowladda, xasilloonida dalka iyo sidii Soomaaliya isaga difaaci lahayd caqabadaha dhinaca amniga. Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay in labada madaxweyne ay ka wada hadleen xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Masar, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, maalgashiga iyo horumarinta iskaashiga labada dal. Taageerada Soomaaliya Madaxweynaha Masar ayaa sidoo kale ku celiyey mowqifka Qaahira ee taageerada madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Waxa uu sheegay in Masar ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, oo ay ku jiraan dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga iyo horumarinta, si loo xoojiyo awoodda hay’adaha dowladda iyo xasilloonida dalka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa dhankiisa uga mahadceliyey Masar taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, isaga oo ammaanay xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee labada dal iyo wada-shaqeynta sii ballaaraneysa. Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Masar ayaa sare loo qaaday Janaayo 2025, markaas oo labada dal ay ku dhawaaqeen iskaashi istiraatiiji ah oo ballaaran, kaas oo ay qeyb ka yihiin siyaasadda, amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo maalgashiga. Amniga gobolka Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadlay xaaladaha amni ee gobolka, gaar ahaan Geeska Afrika, Gacanka Cadmeed, marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab iyo Badda Cas. Madaxtooyada Masar ayaa sheegtay in Xasan Sheekh iyo Sisi ay isku raaceen muhiimadda ay leedahay in Masar, Soomaaliya iyo dalalka gobolka ay sii wadaan wada-tashiga iyo isku-duwidda arrimaha la xiriira amniga iyo xasilloonida goobahaas. Masar ayaa sanadihii dambe kordhisay xiriirka siyaasadeed iyo kan amni ee ay la leedahay Soomaaliya, iyadoo marar badan ku celisay taageerada ay u hayso midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalka. Kulanka Sabtida ayaa dhacay xilli Xasan Sheekh uu ka qeyb-galayo shirar ka socda Al-Calamayn, halka Axadda la filayo inuu ka qeyb-galo kulan afar geesood ah oo ay yeeshaan madaxda Soomaaliya, Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan, kaas oo diiradda lagu saari doono arrimaha gobolka. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo maanta ka qaybgalaya shir-madaxeed afar-geesood ah oo ka dhacaya Masar
items.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta magaalada New Alamein ee dalka Masar kaga qaybgalaya shir-madaxeed wadatashi ah oo ay isugu imanayaan hoggaamiyeyaasha Masar, Soomaaliya, Eritrea iyo Suudaan. Shirka ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalaya Madaxweynaha Masar Cabdifataax Al-Sisi, Madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Guddoomiyaha Golaha Madaxbannaanida Sudan, Cabdifataax Al-Burhan. Sida ay sheegtay Madaxtooyada Masar, kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa wadatashi iyo isku-dubbaridka mowqifyada ku saabsan arrimaha gobolka ee ay dalalku danaha wadaagaan. Kulanka ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee Geeska Afrika. Xiriirka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa si weyn u xumaaday, iyadoo Addis Ababa ay dhawaan jartay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Asmara, halka sidoo kale ay is-weydaarsadeen tallaabooyin diblomaasiyadeed Masar iyo Itoobiya. Xiisadaha ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli dagaallo ay dib uga soo cusboonaadeen waqooyiga Itoobiya. Soomaaliya ayaa ka qaybgalaysa shirka xilli ay xoojinayso xiriirka siyaasadeed iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee ay la leedahay Masar. Madaxweynaha Xasan Sheekh iyo Madaxweyne Al-Sisi ayaa Sabtidii magaalada New Alamein kulan gaar ah yeeshay, iyadoo dhinaca Masar uu mar kale xaqiijiyay taageerada uu u hayo madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal. Ka qaybgalka Soomaaliya ee shirkan ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmaya iyadoo Itoobiya ay weli door ku leedahay amniga Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dadaallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, halka Muqdisho ay dhankeeda sii xoojinayso xiriirrada ay la leedahay dalalka gobolka iyo kuwa kale ee caalamiga ah. Shirka New Alamein ayaa dhacaya iyadoo Masar ay martigelinayso kulamo iyo shirar heer sare ah oo Afrikaan ah, waxaana sidoo kale maanta magaalada lagu qabanayaa shirkii 8-aad ee Isku-dubbaridka Midowga Afrika ee bartamaha sanadka. items.title: Talyaaniga oo Sheegay in Maraakiibta Midowga Yurub aysan  ku filnayn Sugidda Amniga Badda Cas
items.description: Wasiirka Difaaca Talyaaniga, Guido Crosetto, ayaa sheegay in tirada maraakiibta dagaalka ee waddamada Midowga Yurub ay ku biiriyeen Hawlgalka Aspides aysan weli ku filnayn sugidda amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga ee isticmaala Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab . Crosetto ayaa hadalkan sheegay kaddib kulan uu magaalada Rome kula yeeshay Madaxa Siyaasadda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Midowga Yurub, Kaja Kallas. Wuxuu soo dhaweeyay go’aanka ay qaar ka mid ah dalalka xubnaha ka ah Midowga Yurub ku kordhinayaan taageerada Hawlgalka Aspides, balse wuxuu xusay in awoodda hadda jirta aysan weli dammaanad qaadi karin in maraakiibta ganacsiga ay si buuxda oo ammaan ah ugu kala gooshaan gobolka. Sida ay sheegeen ilo diblomaasiyadeed, Hawlgalka Aspides ayaa hadda haysta lix markab dagaal, waxaana Kaja Kallas ay horay u tilmaantay in hawlgalku u baahan yahay in ka badan toban markab si uu si wax-ku-ool ah u guto waajibaadkiisa, gaar ahaan marka la eego baaxadda Badda Cas iyo khataraha ka jira marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Talyaaniga ayaa dhankiisa sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu maraakiib dheeraad ah geeyo gobolka haddii ay dib u dhacaan go’aannada wadajirka ah ee Midowga Yurub. Dowladda Rome ayaa ka digtay in amni-darrada iyo hakadka ku yimaada isu-socodka maraakiibta ay kordhin karaan kharashaadka gaadiidka, dib u dhigi karaan gaarsiinta badeecadaha, isla markaana sare u qaadi karaan qiimaha ay bixiyaan ganacsatada iyo qoysasku. Hawlgalka Aspides waxaa Midowga Yurub bilaabay sannadkii 2024, ujeeddaduna waxay ahayd in maraakiibta ganacsiga laga ilaaliyo weerarrada ka dhaca Badda Cas, gaar ahaan kuwa lala xiriiriyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Xiisadaha ka jira xeebaha Badda Cas iyo khataraha ku dhow Bab al-Mandab ayaa sii adkeeyay amniga mid ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ee isku xira Aasiya, Bariga Dhexe iyo Yurub. Hawlgalka Aspides wuxuu ka duwan yahay Hawlgalka Atalanta ee Midowga Yurub, kaas oo diiradda saaraya la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda iyo ilaalinta amniga badda ee Soomaaliya, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo qaybo ka mid ah Badweynta Hindiya. Inkastoo labada hawlgal ay iska kaashan karaan dhinacyada amniga badda iyo xog-wadaagga, haddana waxay leeyihiin waajibaadyo iyo aagag hawlgal oo kala duwan. Kordhinta awoodda ciidamada badda ee Midowga Yurub ayaa sidaas darteed saameyn ku yeelan karta habka loo wajahayo khataraha amni ee ka jira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Gobolka ayaa weli wajahaya caqabado dhinaca amniga badda ah, iyadoo ay socdaan dadaallo lagu ilaalinayo maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka ganacsiga caalamiga ah.
