items.title: Iran oo ka jawaabtay goodinta Trump ee tallaabada militari iyo cuna-qabateynta
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Iiraan ayaa si adag uga jawaabtay goodinta maamulka Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ee ku saabsan suuragalnimada in tallaabo militari laga qaado Tehran iyo in la kordhiyo cuna-qabateynta dhaqaale ee saaran dalkaasi. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan, Abbas Araghchi ayaa sheegay in cadaadis dheeraad ah iyo tallaabo militari aan marnaba looga guuleysan karin Tehran, isagoo muujiyay muhiimadda in waddada wada-xaajoodka la furo. Araghchi ayaa sheegay in Mareykanku uu horey ugu guuldarraystay siyaasadaha cadaadiska iyo tallaabooyinka militari ee uu qaaday, isagoo tilmaamay in ku celcelinta habkaasi aysan keeni doonin xal waara. “Tallaab militari iyo cuna-qabateyn lagu kordhiyo Iiraan xalka rasmiga ah ma ahan, Mareykanka horay ayuu ugu guuldarraystay arrintaan iyo dagaalka tooska ah,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan, Abbas Araghchi. Tehran ayaa dhinacyada ku howlan dadaallada dhex-dhexaadinta hor dhigtay shuruudo ay sheegtay inay muhiim u yihiin in la abuuro jawi u sahla wada-xaajood iyo xal diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu soo afjaro xiisadda. Mid ka mid ah qodobada ay Iiraan dalbanayso ayaa ah in laga qaado xayiraadaha uu Mareykanku saaray dekedaha dalka, iyadoo sidoo kale doonaysa in loo fasaxo dhaqaalaha ay Washington ka xayirtay. Dowladda Iiraan waxay sidoo kale dalbanaysaa in Mareykanku uu shuruud la’aan ku joojiyo dagaalka uu kula jiro dalkaasi, iyadoo arrimahaasi ay ku tilmaantay kuwo muhiim u ah in wada-hadal dhab ah uu dhex maro labada dhinac. Hadalka Araghchi ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiisadda u dhexeysa Iiraan iyo Mareykanka ay weli taagan tahay, iyadoo Washington ay cadaadis dhaqaale saareyso Tehran, halka dowladda Iiraan ay ku adkaysanayso in xal kasta lagu raadiyo wada-hadal iyo in laga qaado cuna-qabateynaha saaran. The post Iran oo ka jawaabtay goodinta Trump ee tallaabada militari iyo cuna-qabateynta appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: The Government of the Republic of Somaliland Rejects the Somalian President’s Misleading Claims
items.description: Republic of Somaliland Ministry of Foreign Affairs & International Cooperation     The Government of the Republic of Somaliland Rejects the Somalian President’s Misleading Claims The Government of the Republic of Somaliland Rejects the Somalian President’s Misleading Claims Hargeisa, Republic of Somaliland | 3 October 2026 The Government of the Republic of Somaliland firmly rejects the misleading claims made by the Somalian president in his recent interview with Al Jazeera. Somaliland and Somalia are two separate sovereign states with fundamentally different governance realities. The Somalian Government has no authority to determine Somaliland’s foreign relations or speak on behalf of its people. The Republic of Somaliland attained independence on 26 June 1960, before Somalia attained independence on 1 July 1960. Somaliland’s sovereignty rests on the continuity of that independent state within its inherited borders, consistent with the principle of uti possidetis juris (respect for boundaries inherited at independence). The restoration of its sovereignty on 18 May 1991 reaffirmed this enduring statehood. For more than three decades, Somaliland has built functioning institutions, held competitive elections, ensured peaceful transfers of power, and contributed to regional stability. Somalia’s continuing insecurity, political fragmentation, and institutional fragility cannot be obscured by misrepresenting Somaliland or threatening its sovereign partnerships. The Government of the Republic of Somaliland’s diplomatic relations with the State of Israel reflect the sovereign decisions of two states and advance peaceful cooperation, development, and regional stability. Claims that Berbera would serve as a platform for aggression against other countries are unfounded and misrepresent Somaliland’s commitment to peaceful relations. The Somalian president’s attempts to speak on behalf of the people of Somaliland are equally unacceptable. The Government of the Republic of Somaliland has consistently supported negotiated arrangements enabling the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia to secure access to the sea through mutually beneficial cooperation. The Somalian Government’s campaign against the 2024 Ethiopia–Somaliland Memorandum of Understanding directly contradicts its professed support for such access. The Government of the Republic of Somaliland rejects interference in its sovereign agreements and remains committed to arrangements that respect sovereignty and advance regional prosperity. The Government of the Republic of Somaliland condemns threats of force and interference in its internal affairs. It calls on the Somalian leadership to exercise restraint and address its domestic challenges responsibly. Somaliland will continue to safeguard its sovereignty, pursue peaceful diplomacy, and strengthen partnerships that promote stability across the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea. — END —

items.title: Hirshabelle and Galmudug: Elections or Appointments by Another Name?
items.description: By Abdiqani Haji Abdi Somalia’s latest experiments with direct elections in Hirshabelle and Galmudug are being presented by the Federal Government as a historic step toward democracy. But beneath the celebration lies a much deeper political dispute: are voters genuinely choosing their leaders, or are they being asked to validate political outcomes that have already been decided by the ruling party? The question has become particularly sharp because the Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP), led by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, has already selected its preferred candidates for the leadership of the two federal member states. In Hirshabelle, JSP nominated incumbent President Ali Abdullahi Hussein Guudlaawe for another term and subsequently selected former Hiiraan governor Abdifatah Hassan Afrah as its candidate for deputy president. Afrah himself said President Hassan Sheikh played a role in his selection. In Galmudug, JSP emerged from the September 30 rerun with 67 of the 89 parliamentary seats, giving the party a commanding majority in the state legislature. Reports indicate that JSP and the Federal Government are backing Libaan Axmed Xasan (Libaan Shuluq) for the Galmudug presidency. This is where the opposition’s argument begins. The Election Is Direct But the Leadership Is Not The elections in Hirshabelle and Galmudug are technically elections for state assemblies and local councils, not direct presidential elections. But the state parliament ultimately determines who becomes president and deputy president. That distinction is crucial. If one political party controls a commanding majority of the state parliament and has already selected the candidates it wants to see occupy the executive leadership, critics argue that the presidential contest risks becoming a confirmation exercise rather than an open political competition. That concern is particularly strong in Galmudug, where JSP’s 67 seats give it more than enough parliamentary strength to determine the composition of the state leadership without requiring a broad coalition. The same concern exists in Hirshabelle, where JSP has openly backed Guudlaawe and Afrah. The ballot may therefore determine the composition of parliament, while the ruling party’s internal decisions may largely determine who occupies the presidency. That is the central political criticism surrounding the process. Opposition Says the Rules Were Never Agreed The dispute goes beyond individual candidates. Opposition groups have challenged the legitimacy of the electoral framework itself, including the composition and independence of the national electoral commission, the rules governing the elections and the constitutional amendments adopted under President Hassan Sheikh. Earlier opposition discussions with the Federal Government identified precisely these issues as central to reaching an electoral agreement: the election model, an independent and trusted electoral commission, and the constitutional framework. The opposition’s position is that an electoral system of this magnitude should emerge from broad political consensus, rather than being established unilaterally and then implemented by institutions that the opposition does not recognize. The constitutional dispute is particularly consequential. Parliament approved amendments extending presidential and parliamentary terms from four to five years. The Federal Government considers the amendments valid, while opposition groups have rejected them and disputed their application to the current leadership. The disagreement has remained one of the central unresolved issues in Somalia’s political crisis. The International Community Tried to Bridge the Gap This is also why the latest elections cannot be separated from the broader political negotiations that preceded them. For months, international partners and diplomats have sought to bring the Federal Government and opposition groups toward an agreement on the electoral roadmap. The issues were not limited to whether Somalia should have one-person-one-vote elections. They included who controls the electoral institutions, what rules govern the elections, which constitutional framework applies, and whether the major political actors accept the process. The opposition’s argument has been that an election conducted without agreement among the principal political stakeholders risks reproducing the very crisis it is supposed to resolve. The government, by contrast, has argued that Somalia cannot remain trapped indefinitely in negotiations among political elites and that citizens should be allowed to vote directly. Both arguments contain an important democratic principle.The question is whether they can coexist. Baidoa Offers a Warning The controversy is particularly sensitive because of what happened in South West State. The Federal Government’s confrontation with former South West President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen eventually developed into armed conflict after months of political disagreement. The federal intervention in Baidoa was presented by Mogadishu as necessary to restore stability and advance the electoral process. Laftagareen’s supporters, however, described it as an attempt to impose a political outcome on the state. The confrontation subsequently produced repeated fighting and a prolonged security crisis. For critics of the current electoral model, Baidoa is therefore the warning that hangs over Hirshabelle and Galmudug: when political competition is replaced by the imposition of a predetermined outcome, an election can become another source of conflict rather than a mechanism for resolving it. That comparison remains a political interpretation, not proof that the same outcome will occur in Hirshabelle or Galmudug. But the concern is understandable. Galmudug Already Exposed the System’s Weakness Galmudug itself has provided another warning. The Supreme Court annulled the July election after finding that the process had not complied with constitutional and electoral requirements and that irregularities had affected the integrity and outcome of the vote. It ordered a rerun. The rerun subsequently gave JSP 67 of 89 seats. The court’s intervention demonstrates that electoral institutions can correct a disputed process. But it also demonstrates something more uncomfortable: the first election was not sufficiently credible to survive judicial scrutiny. That should make the question of electoral legitimacy central to the next stage. The Bigger Political Objective Opposition figures have interpreted the sequence of events as part of a broader strategy by President Hassan Sheikh to consolidate political influence across South West, Hirshabelle and Galmudug through an electoral architecture that produces governments aligned with Villa Somalia. That is an opposition interpretation and has not been independently established as the government’s stated objective. What can be documented is that JSP has selected candidates in Hirshabelle and has emerged with a dominant parliamentary position in Galmudug. JSP is also the party led by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. The political consequence is therefore real regardless of how the strategy is interpreted. If the same national ruling party controls the parliamentary majorities that select the presidents of several federal member states, the traditional distinction between federal and state-level political power becomes considerably less clear. That raises an important federalism question: How much political independence can a federal member state exercise when its executive leadership depends on a parliamentary majority controlled by the same national party governing from Mogadishu? The government can point to something genuinely significant: people are voting directly. That is an important departure from Somalia’s long-standing system of clan-based indirect elections. But democracy is not simply the act of putting a ballot into a box. It also requires credible rules, trusted institutions, genuine competition, political inclusion and acceptance of the result by those who participate. That is where Somalia’s current experiment remains vulnerable. If opposition parties do not recognize the electoral commission, if major political actors reject the electoral rules, if constitutional amendments remain contested, and if the eventual state leadership appears predetermined by the dominant national party, the government may succeed in holding elections without achieving a political settlement. And that distinction could prove decisive. The Choice Facing Somalia The question facing Somalia is therefore larger than whether Hirshabelle and Galmudug have successfully conducted voting. It is whether direct elections will become a mechanism for broadening political participation or a mechanism for transferring political control from one level of government to another under the appearance of electoral competition. The difference will ultimately be measured not by the number of polling stations or ballots cast, but by whether political opponents believe they had a genuine opportunity to compete and whether citizens believe their votes — rather than decisions made within party headquarters — determined who governs them. Somalia needs elections. But it also needs elections that the losing side can accept. Without that political legitimacy, an election can produce a parliament, a president and a government — and still leave the underlying conflict unresolved. That is the lesson Somalia should take from Baidoa, and the question now hanging over Hirshabelle and Galmudug. items.fullContent: By Abdiqani Haji Abdi Somalia’s latest experiments with direct elections in Hirshabelle and Galmudug are being presented by the Federal Government as a historic step toward democracy. But beneath the celebration lies a much deeper political dispute: are voters genuinely choosing their leaders, or are they being asked to validate political outcomes that have already been decided by the ruling party? The question has become particularly sharp because the Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP), led by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, has already selected its preferred candidates for the leadership of the two federal member states. In Hirshabelle, JSP nominated incumbent President Ali Abdullahi Hussein Guudlaawe for another term and subsequently selected former Hiiraan governor Abdifatah Hassan Afrah as its candidate for deputy president. Afrah himself said President Hassan Sheikh played a role in his selection. In Galmudug, JSP emerged from the September 30 rerun with 67 of the 89 parliamentary seats, giving the party a commanding majority in the state legislature. Reports indicate that JSP and the Federal Government are backing Libaan Axmed Xasan (Libaan Shuluq) for the Galmudug presidency. This is where the opposition’s argument begins. The Election Is Direct But the Leadership Is Not The elections in Hirshabelle and Galmudug are technically elections for state assemblies and local councils, not direct presidential elections. But the state parliament ultimately determines who becomes president and deputy president. That distinction is crucial. If one political party controls a commanding majority of the state parliament and has already selected the candidates it wants to see occupy the executive leadership, critics argue that the presidential contest risks becoming a confirmation exercise rather than an open political competition. That concern is particularly strong in Galmudug, where JSP’s 67 seats give it more than enough parliamentary strength to determine the composition of the state leadership without requiring a broad coalition. The same concern exists in Hirshabelle, where JSP has openly backed Guudlaawe and Afrah. The ballot may therefore determine the composition of parliament, while the ruling party’s internal decisions may largely determine who occupies the presidency. That is the central political criticism surrounding the process. Opposition Says the Rules Were Never Agreed The dispute goes beyond individual candidates. Opposition groups have challenged the legitimacy of the electoral framework itself, including the composition and independence of the national electoral commission, the rules governing the elections and the constitutional amendments adopted under President Hassan Sheikh. Earlier opposition discussions with the Federal Government identified precisely these issues as central to reaching an electoral agreement: the election model, an independent and trusted electoral commission, and the constitutional framework. The opposition’s position is that an electoral system of this magnitude should emerge from broad political consensus, rather than being established unilaterally and then implemented by institutions that the opposition does not recognize. The constitutional dispute is particularly consequential. Parliament approved amendments extending presidential and parliamentary terms from four to five years. The Federal Government considers the amendments valid, while opposition groups have rejected them and disputed their application to the current leadership. The disagreement has remained one of the central unresolved issues in Somalia’s political crisis. The International Community Tried to Bridge the Gap This is also why the latest elections cannot be separated from the broader political negotiations that preceded them. For months, international partners and diplomats have sought to bring the Federal Government and opposition groups toward an agreement on the electoral roadmap. The issues were not limited to whether Somalia should have one-person-one-vote elections. They included who controls the electoral institutions, what rules govern the elections, which constitutional framework applies, and whether the major political actors accept the process. The opposition’s argument has been that an election conducted without agreement among the principal political stakeholders risks reproducing the very crisis it is supposed to resolve. The government, by contrast, has argued that Somalia cannot remain trapped indefinitely in negotiations among political elites and that citizens should be allowed to vote directly. Both arguments contain an important democratic principle.The question is whether they can coexist. Baidoa Offers a Warning The controversy is particularly sensitive because of what happened in South West State. The Federal Government’s confrontation with former South West President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen eventually developed into armed conflict after months of political disagreement. The federal intervention in Baidoa was presented by Mogadishu as necessary to restore stability and advance the electoral process. Laftagareen’s supporters, however, described it as an attempt to impose a political outcome on the state. The confrontation subsequently produced repeated fighting and a prolonged security crisis. For critics of the current electoral model, Baidoa is therefore the warning that hangs over Hirshabelle and Galmudug: when political competition is replaced by the imposition of a predetermined outcome, an election can become another source of conflict rather than a mechanism for resolving it. That comparison remains a political interpretation, not proof that the same outcome will occur in Hirshabelle or Galmudug. But the concern is understandable. Galmudug Already Exposed the System’s Weakness Galmudug itself has provided another warning. The Supreme Court annulled the July election after finding that the process had not complied with constitutional and electoral requirements and that irregularities had affected the integrity and outcome of the vote. It ordered a rerun. The rerun subsequently gave JSP 67 of 89 seats. The court’s intervention demonstrates that electoral institutions can correct a disputed process. But it also demonstrates something more uncomfortable: the first election was not sufficiently credible to survive judicial scrutiny. That should make the question of electoral legitimacy central to the next stage. The Bigger Political Objective Opposition figures have interpreted the sequence of events as part of a broader strategy by President Hassan Sheikh to consolidate political influence across South West, Hirshabelle and Galmudug through an electoral architecture that produces governments aligned with Villa Somalia. That is an opposition interpretation and has not been independently established as the government’s stated objective. What can be documented is that JSP has selected candidates in Hirshabelle and has emerged with a dominant parliamentary position in Galmudug. JSP is also the party led by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. The political consequence is therefore real regardless of how the strategy is interpreted. If the same national ruling party controls the parliamentary majorities that select the presidents of several federal member states, the traditional distinction between federal and state-level political power becomes considerably less clear. That raises an important federalism question: How much political independence can a federal member state exercise when its executive leadership depends on a parliamentary majority controlled by the same national party governing from Mogadishu? The government can point to something genuinely significant: people are voting directly. That is an important departure from Somalia’s long-standing system of clan-based indirect elections. But democracy is not simply the act of putting a ballot into a box. It also requires credible rules, trusted institutions, genuine competition, political inclusion and acceptance of the result by those who participate. That is where Somalia’s current experiment remains vulnerable. If opposition parties do not recognize the electoral commission, if major political actors reject the electoral rules, if constitutional amendments remain contested, and if the eventual state leadership appears predetermined by the dominant national party, the government may succeed in holding elections without achieving a political settlement. And that distinction could prove decisive. The Choice Facing Somalia The question facing Somalia is therefore larger than whether Hirshabelle and Galmudug have successfully conducted voting. It is whether direct elections will become a mechanism for broadening political participation or a mechanism for transferring political control from one level of government to another under the appearance of electoral competition. The difference will ultimately be measured not by the number of polling stations or ballots cast, but by whether political opponents believe they had a genuine opportunity to compete and whether citizens believe their votes — rather than decisions made within party headquarters — determined who governs them. Somalia needs elections. But it also needs elections that the losing side can accept. Without that political legitimacy, an election can produce a parliament, a president and a government — and still leave the underlying conflict unresolved. That is the lesson Somalia should take from Baidoa, and the question now hanging over Hirshabelle and Galmudug. items.title: Maamulka Soomaaliland oo Sheegay inuu Diyaar u yahay Heshiis Itoobiya Bad lagu siinayo
items.description: Maamulka Somaliland ayaa jawaab ka bixiyay hadallo uu Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyay Al Jazeera, isagoo ku saabsanaa xiriirka Soomaaliland iyo Israa’iil, magaalada Berbera iyo heshiiskii is-afgaradka Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliland ee 2024. Bayaan ka soo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Maamulka Soomaaliland ayaa lagu sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan awood u lahayn inay go’aamiso xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliland ama ay ku hadasho magaca shacabka Somaliland, sida hadalka loo dhigey. Maamulka Soomaaliland ayaa sidoo kale bayaanka ku xusay taariikhda uu aaminsan yahay inay saldhig u tahay sheegashadiisa madaxbannaanida, isagoo sheegay in uu xornimada qaatay 26-kii Juun 1960, halka Soomaaliya ay xornimada qaadatay 1-dii Luulyo 1960, ayna dib ula soo noqoshada madaxbannaanida ku dhawaaqday 18-kii May 1991. Dhinaca xiriirka Israa’iil, Maamulka Soomaaliland wuxuu sheegay in xiriirka labada dhinac uu yahay go’aan ay qaateen labada dhinac, isla markaana uu ku salaysan yahay iskaashi diblomaasiyadeed, horumar iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Maamulka Hargeysa waxa uu sidoo kale beeniyay in magaalada Berbera loo adeegsan doono saldhig ama goob laga fuliyo weerarro ka dhan ah dalal kale. Sidoo kale, Maamulka Soomaaliland ayaa difaacay mowqifkiisa ku aaddan heshiiskii is-afgaradka ee Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliland ee 2024, isagoo sheegay inuu taageersan yahay heshiisyo Itoobiya u oggolaanaya inay hesho marin badeed oo lagu gaaro iskaashi labada dhinac faa’iido u leh. Maamulka Somaliland ayaa dhanka kale sheegay inuu diidayo faragelin lagu sameeyo heshiisyada uu la galo dhinacyada kale. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Maamulka Soomaaliland ayaa cambaareeyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay hanjabaadaha xoogga iyo faragelinta lagu sameynayo arrimihiisa gudaha, isagoo sheegay inuu sii wadi doono dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga uu la leeyahay dhinacyada kala duwan ee gobolka, si loo horumariyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas.

items.title: Mekelle on the Brink as Tigrayan Fighters Retreat and Federal Forces Close In
items.description: Federal Forces Retake Mekelle Airport as TPLF Fighters and Leaders Reportedly Leave Tigray’s Capital MEKELLE (WDN) — Ethiopia’s renewed Tigray war has entered a dramatic new phase, with federal forces and their allies closing in on Mekelle after reportedly retaking the city’s main airport and Tigrayan fighters and political leaders beginning to abandon positions inside the capital. The developments represent the most serious battlefield setback for the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) since fighting erupted again on September 23, threatening to bring the renewed conflict directly into Mekelle. Three sources cited by Reuters confirmed that Ethiopian federal forces had regained control of Alula Aba Nega International Airport, roughly 10 kilometres from central Mekelle. A resident also reported hearing gunfire outside the city centre. AFP, meanwhile, reported that TPLF fighters and leaders were leaving Mekelle as pro-government forces advanced toward the city. Federal troops had not yet been independently confirmed inside the city at the time of the reports. Tigrayan Forces Begin to Withdraw The reported departure of Tigrayan fighters could be a major turning point. A journalist and residents in Mekelle told AFP that TPLF fighters and leaders were leaving the capital, while government offices and police stations were reportedly left without security personnel. Residents expressed fears that the security vacuum could lead to looting and wider disorder. A resident cited by Reuters also said some Tigrayan Defence Force fighters had abandoned their posts and returned home, while government facilities were being looted. Reuters said it could not independently verify those reports, and the TPLF had not immediately responded. The reports suggest that the battle for Mekelle may be approaching a decisive stage — but they do not yet establish that the federal government has captured the city itself. A Rapid Federal Advance The federal advance has been remarkably fast. Pro-government Tigrayan fighters said they had captured Milazat, about 20 kilometres southeast of Mekelle, while residents told Reuters that government forces were closing in on the capital. Earlier in the offensive, federal and allied forces also regained strategically important territory in southern Tigray, including Alamata. The government-aligned forces have now pushed the front line deep into Tigray after reversing advances made by TPLF-led forces at the beginning of the renewed conflict. The fighting has been the most serious escalation since the devastating 2020–2022 Tigray war. Mekelle Faces a Dangerous Security Vacuum For civilians, the immediate concern is no longer simply who wins the battlefield. It is what happens to the city if one force withdraws before another establishes effective control. Banks and businesses have already closed amid fears that fighting could reach the capital. Residents have described an atmosphere of fear, while communications disruptions and movement restrictions have complicated access to information and humanitarian assistance. The absence of police and security personnel from some government facilities could create additional risks. A peaceful transfer of control would limit civilian suffering. A contested entry into the city, however, could produce another round of urban fighting in a population centre that has already endured the consequences of war. Even if federal forces ultimately take full control of Mekelle, that would not necessarily mean the conflict is over. The TPLF and allied forces have fought from difficult terrain before, and the 2020 war demonstrated how quickly control of Mekelle could change. Federal forces captured the city during that conflict, only for the TPLF to retake it months later. Reuters noted that history as a warning against assuming that control of the capital alone would settle the conflict. The current war is also considerably broader than a confrontation between Addis Ababa and Mekelle. An alliance led by the TPLF has been fighting federal forces and their allies, while the conflict has spread into neighbouring Amhara and Afar regions. Ethiopia has also accused Eritrea, Sudan and Egypt of supporting the opposition alliance. Those countries have denied the allegations, while the African Union has urged restraint. The diplomatic dimension therefore makes the battle for Mekelle potentially much more consequential than a conventional regional confrontation. The Humanitarian Stakes Tigray is home to millions of people, and the renewed fighting has already disrupted civilian life. Electricity and communications have been affected, roads have been disrupted and civilians have begun moving away from areas where fighting is occurring. Humanitarian organizations are attempting to maintain access as the front lines shift. The immediate priority for civilians in Mekelle is therefore clear: security, functioning public services and protection from revenge, looting and indiscriminate violence. Whatever happens on the battlefield, the city’s population cannot afford another prolonged siege or a repeat of the devastation witnessed during the previous war. A Decisive Moment for Ethiopia The federal advance has placed Mekelle within reach of government forces and appears to have triggered a withdrawal by some Tigrayan fighters and leaders. But the next few days could determine whether the development becomes a rapid change of control or the beginning of another prolonged phase of war. For Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government, capturing Mekelle would represent a major military achievement. For the TPLF, losing the capital would be a severe setback but not necessarily the end of its ability to continue fighting. And for the people of Tigray, the overriding question is far more basic: Will the approach of federal forces bring the restoration of order — or will Mekelle become the opening battlefield of another devastating chapter in Ethiopia’s northern war? items.title: Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen oo sheegay in boqolaal Xuutiyiin ah lagu dilay dagaallada Cusub
items.description: Dagaallada ka socda Yemen ayaa sii xoogeysanaya, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee taageerada ka hela Sacuudiga ay sheegeen inay boqolaal dagaalyahanno Xuutiyiin ah ku dileen howlgallo militari oo ay ku doonayaan inay dib ugu qabsadaan dhul ballaaran oo ay Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku hayeen. Ciidamada dowladda ayaa sheegay in howlgalladaasi ay qeyb ka yihiin guluf ay ku doonayaan inay dib ugu soo ceshadaan deegaanno ay lumiyeen, iyadoo dagaallo culus ay ka socdaan jihooyin kala duwan. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay inay weerar ku qaadeen xarun ay leedahay shirkadda shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco oo ku taalla magaalada Riyadh. Kooxdu waxay sheegatay inay weerarka u adeegsatay hub ay ku jiraan gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn, hase yeeshee maamulka Sacuudiga ayaan si rasmi ah u xaqiijin in xarunta Aramco ee Riyadh la weeraray. Iskahorimaadyadan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dagaalka Yemen uu mar kale xoogeysanayo, iyadoo dhinacyada isku haya dalka ay midba midka kale ku eedeynayo inuu sii hurinayo colaadda. Ciidamada dowladda oo taageero ka hela isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa isku dayaya inay dib u soo ceshadaan dhulal ay Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku hayaan, halka Xuutiyiintu ay wadaan weerarro ay ku sheegayaan inay kaga jawaabayaan duqeymaha iyo howlgallada militari ee ka dhanka ah. Xaaladda ayaa sidoo kale walaac ka abuureysa amniga gobolka, gaar ahaan marinka Bab al-Mandab , oo ah marin-biyood istiraatiiji ah oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isla markaana muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Dagaallo sii xoogeysanaya iyo weerarro ka dhaca gudaha Yemen iyo meel ka baxsan xuduudaha dalka ayaa kordhin kara khatarta ah in colaadda Yemen ay saameyn ku yeelato amniga iyo isu-socodka ganacsiga ee gobolka.

items.title: Hamza Denies Al-Shabaab Talks, Raising Questions Over What He Meant by Opening the Door to Dialogue
items.description: Prime Minister Says No Negotiations Are Underway Two Days After Declaring Government Ready for Dialogue With Militants Who Abandon the Group MOGADISHU (WDN) — Somalia’s Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre has denied that the Federal Government is negotiating with Al-Shabaab , only two days after publicly declaring that his government was prepared to engage members of the militant group who abandon its ideology and armed campaign. The apparent shift in emphasis has raised questions over exactly what the government means by its newly stated willingness to pursue dialogue with Al-Shabaab-linked individuals. Speaking on the Miizaan Podcast on October 2, Hamza said neither he nor President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud had held direct talks with Al-Shabaab and insisted that the government’s relationship with the group remains one of armed conflict. “We have not entered into talks, nor are we engaged with them,” Hamza said. “What stands between us is the liberation of the country.” But in the same interview, the prime minister again left the door open to dialogue. He said the government was prepared to talk to anyone who abandons Al-Shabaab’s ideology and armed campaign, adding that former militants could eventually return to Somali society. The distinction is important. The government is now saying it is not negotiating with Al-Shabaab as an organization, while simultaneously offering dialogue and reintegration to individuals who leave the group. That is different from a political negotiation with the organization itself. What Changed in Two Days? Hamza’s latest clarification follows comments reported two days earlier in which he said the government was ready to talk to those willing to abandon the group and its ideology. Those remarks were widely interpreted as an opening toward dialogue. The latest statement appears designed to draw a line between reintegration of defectors and negotiations with Al-Shabaab’s leadership. There is currently no independently verified evidence establishing that the Federal Government has entered into formal negotiations with Al-Shabaab. Hamza has also rejected allegations that the government has paid the militant group to reduce attacks in Mogadishu, calling such claims false. The government therefore faces a communications challenge: the more openly it talks about dialogue, the greater the likelihood that its opponents and the public will interpret those statements as preparation for negotiations with the organization itself. Why the Timing Matters The issue is emerging at a particularly sensitive moment for Somalia. Al-Shabaab remains one of the country’s most powerful armed actors, maintaining significant influence across parts of south-central Somalia despite years of Somali and international military operations. The group has demonstrated an ability to attack government-held areas and retain networks capable of striking Mogadishu. At the same time, Somalia remains politically divided. The Federal Government is engaged in a prolonged dispute with opposition groups and several federal member states over constitutional changes, elections and the distribution of political authority. That makes the question of who has the mandate to negotiate on behalf of Somalia unavoidable if the government ever moves beyond individual defections and considers talks with Al-Shabaab as an organization. Defectors Are One Question. Al-Shabaab Is Another There is a substantial difference between encouraging an individual militant to surrender and negotiating with an armed organization. The first can involve disarmament, rehabilitation, amnesty and reintegration. The second could involve much larger questions: political authority, territory, security arrangements, justice, constitutional order and the future relationship between the Somali state and an organization that has fought the government for years. Hamza’s latest comments suggest that the government’s immediate position is the former. The government is saying that anyone who abandons Al-Shabaab’s armed campaign can return to Somali society, while denying that it is negotiating with the organization itself. That distinction may allow Mogadishu to pursue defections without formally recognizing Al-Shabaab as a political negotiating partner. If dialogue with Al-Shabaab ever moves beyond individual defections, however, Somalia’s unresolved political crisis would become directly relevant. Any agreement affecting the country’s security or political order would have consequences far beyond the Federal Government. Puntland, Jubaland and other political actors have their own positions on Somalia’s constitutional and electoral future. Opposition groups have also disputed the legitimacy of aspects of the current electoral and constitutional framework. The Federal Government has argued that its constitutional reforms and electoral programme are necessary to move Somalia toward direct elections. Opponents have rejected important elements of the process and have called for broader political consensus. That unresolved dispute creates a fundamental question: Who speaks for Somalia if the government decides to negotiate a political settlement with Al-Shabaab? The Government Has Not Closed the Door Hamza’s statements should not, however, be interpreted as proof that the government has decided to negotiate with Al-Shabaab. The prime minister has explicitly denied that such negotiations are taking place. What he has confirmed is that the government is prepared to engage individuals who leave the organization and renounce its ideology and violence. That policy is not unprecedented in Somalia. Governments have previously encouraged defections and reintegration as part of efforts to weaken Al-Shabaab. The more consequential question would arise if the government moved from individual reintegration to organizational dialogue. That would require a much broader political discussion. A Delicate Message The apparent contradiction between “we are ready to talk” and “we are not talking” may therefore be less dramatic than it initially appears. Hamza appears to be distinguishing between an offer to former or potential defectors and an actual negotiation with Al-Shabaab’s leadership. But the political sensitivity of the issue means that every public statement will be closely examined. For a government fighting an insurgency while simultaneously trying to establish a new electoral and constitutional order, the consequences of opening any political channel with Al-Shabaab would extend far beyond the battlefield. For now, the government’s position is clear enough: there are no declared negotiations with Al-Shabaab, but the door remains open to those who abandon the group and seek a return to Somali society. Whether that remains the government’s position — or becomes the first step toward a broader political dialogue — is a question that only future developments can answer. items.title: Mdaxweyne Xasan Sheekh: Soomaaliya ma Aqbali doonto joogitaanka Israa’iil ee Dalka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan aqbali doonin joogitaanka Israa’iil gudaha dalka “xaalad kasta”, isaga oo sidoo kale sheegay in Muqdisho ay ka hortagi doonto isku day kasta oo Soomaaliya lagu lug gelinayo colaadaha iyo xiisadaha ka taagan Bariga Dhexe. Wareysi gaar ah oo uu siiyay Al Jazeera, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in Israa’iil ay qorsheynayso inay saldhig ciidan oo dhinaca badda ah ka samaysato magaalada Berbera, isla markaana ay isticmaasho garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaaladaasi. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in qorshahaasi uu qeyb ka yahay dadaallo uu sheegay in Israa’iil ay ku doonayso inay ugu dhowaato dalalka Khaliijka iyo Iran. Berbera oo ku taalla xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed ayaa ah magaalo deked leh oo ku taalla waqooyiga Soomaaliya, taas oo ay dunidu u aragto goob muhiim ah markii la eego istiraatiijiyadda Juquraafi. Dekeddan ayaa sidoo kale ku dhow marinka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab, oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, halkaas oo ay horey uga dhaceen weerarro iyo xiisado la xiriira maraakiibta iyo colaadda gobolka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Israa’iil ku eedeeyay inay tahay awood gobolka ka dhalisa xasillooni-darro, isagoo sidoo kale dhaliilay go’aankii Israa’iil ay ku aqoonsatay Somaliland. Wuxuu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ka hortagi doonto tallaabo kasta oo uu sheegay inay wax u dhimi karto madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in isku day kasta oo Soomaaliya lagu dhex gelinayo colaadaha Bariga Dhexe uusan guuleysan doonin, isagoo xusay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay awood u leedahay inay wajahdo caqabadaha ka dhasha tallaabooyinka ay Israa’iil qaaddo ama qorsheyso. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay xaaladda Yemen, isagoo Xuutiyiinta ku eedeeyay inay khalkhal geliyaan amniga gobolka iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta ee marinka Bab al-Mandab. Hadallada madaxweynaha ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiisadaha gobolka iyo amniga marin-biyoodka Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ay weli yihiin arrimo muhiim ah oo saameyn ku leh ganacsiga iyo amniga gobolka.

items.title: Afrika oo ku baaqday in kheyraadka Qaaradda loo beddelo Warshado, Shaqooyin iyo Horumar
items.description: Madaxda Afrika, hay’adaha qaaradda iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha ganacsiga ayaa ku baaqay in Afrika ay ka gudubto marxaladda qorsheyaasha iyo ballanqaadyada, isla markaana ay xoogga saarto fulinta mashaariic wax-ku-ool ah oo lagu horumarinayo dhaqaalaha qaaradda. Baaqan ayaa ka soo baxay shirkii ugu horreeyay ee Alamein Africa Forum , oo lagu qabtay magaalada New Alamein ee dalka Masar, waxaana Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf , uu sheegay in Afrika aysan ka jirin aragti iyo himilo la’aan, balse caqabadda taagan ay tahay sidii qorshayaasha waaweyn loogu beddeli lahaa mashaariic si wanaagsan loo diyaariyey, loo maalgeliyey, loona hirgeliyey. Wuxuu tilmaamay in loo baahan yahay iskaashi dhow oo dhex mara dowladaha iyo waaxda gaarka loo leeyahay si loo dardargeliyo horumarka qaaradda. Madaxweynaha Burundi ahna Guddoomiyaha Midowga Afrika, Évariste Ndayishimiye , ayaa sheegay in Afrika ay leedahay kheyraad aad u badan, balse aan weli si buuxda looga faa’iidaysan. Wuxuu ku baaqay in kheyraadka dabiiciga ah loo beddelo wax-soo-saar, warshado iyo shaqooyin, iyadoo la xoojinayo iskaashiga u dhexeeya dowladaha, maalgashadayaasha iyo ganacsatada. Ndayishimiye ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqay in xiriirka Afrika uu ka gudbo iskaashi diblomaasiyadeed oo keliya, loona gudbo iskaashi dhaqaale, maalgashi iyo wax-soo-saar. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda Heshiiska Ganacsiga Xorta ah ee Qaaradda Afrika (AfCFTA) , isaga oo sheegay in heshiisku u baahan yahay kaabayaal ganacsi oo isku xiran, xuduudo fudud, nidaamyo canshuureed oo is-waafaqsan, adeegyo lacag-bixineed iyo silsilado wax-soo-saar oo isku xira dalalka qaaradda. Madaxweynaha Masar, Cabdel Fattah Al-Sisi , ayaa dhankiisa sheegay in Afrika ay u baahan tahay inay yeelato awood dheeraad ah oo ay mustaqbalkeeda ku qaabeyso, iyadoo nabadda, xasilloonida, madax-bannaanida iyo hay’adaha dowladeed ee xooggan ay yihiin saldhigga horumar waara iyo soo jiidashada maalgashiga. Al-Sisi ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in waaxda gaarka loo leeyahay ay door muhiim ah ka qaadan karto kobaca dhaqaalaha iyo shaqo-abuurka Afrika, wuxuuna ku baaqay in la xoojiyo xiriirka ganacsatada Afrika, lana fududeeyo ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga ka dhex dhaca dalalka qaaradda. Madaxweynaha iyo Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Agaasimayaasha Afreximbank , George Elombi, ayaa isna xoogga saaray muhiimadda ay leedahay in Afrika ay xoojiso hay’adaha maaliyadeed ee ay leedahay. Wuxuu sheegay in hay’adaha Afrika ay awood u leeyihiin inay kaalin muhiim ah ka qaataan wax ka qabashada caqabadaha dhaqaale iyo dibadda kaga yimaada qaaradda, isagoo dalalka Afrika ugu baaqay inay sii xoojiyaan maalgelinta iyo taageerada hay’adahooda. Ganacsade Aliko Dangote ayaa sheegay in Afrika ay u baahan tahay inay wax ka beddesho habka ay uga faa’iidaysato kheyraadkeeda. Wuxuu ku baaqay in qaaraddu ka gudubto dhoofinta kheyraadka ceeriin, isla markaana ay xoogga saarto farsamaynta iyo wax-soo-saarka gudaha si loo abuuro shaqooyin, loo kordhiyo dakhliga gudaha, loona dhiso dhaqaale adkaysi u leh dhibaatooyinka dibadda. Dangote ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in AfCFTA uu Afrika siin karo suuq ballaaran oo dhiirrigeliya warshadaynta iyo maalgashiga, balse arrintaasi ay u baahan tahay in la yareeyo caqabadaha ka jira xuduudaha, gaadiidka, lacag-bixinta iyo xeerarka ganacsiga. Dhanka kale, madaxa AUDA-NEPAD , Nardos Bekele-Thomas, ayaa sheegtay in Afrika aysan u baahnayn shirar badan oo keliya, balse ay u baahan tahay ficil, maalgelin iyo fulin. Waxay ku baaqday in mashaariicda qaaradda loo diyaariyo si ay u noqdaan kuwo maalgashadayaashu maalgelin karaan, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo mashaariicda isku xira dalal iyo gobollo badan. Guud ahaan, Alamein Africa Forum ayaa noqday madal lagu adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in Afrika ay ka faa’iidaysato kheyraadkeeda, suuqa ballaaran iyo awoodda dhalinyarada, iyadoo qorshayaasha Agenda 2063 iyo AfCFTA loo beddelayo mashaariic dhab ah oo keena wax-soo-saar, maalgashi iyo shaqooyin. Fariinta ugu weyn ee ka soo baxday madasha ayaa ahayd in mustaqbalka dhaqaale ee Afrika uusan ku xirnaan oo keliya tirada kheyraadka ay haysato, balse uu ku xiran yahay awoodda ay u leedahay inay kheyraadkaas u beddesho wax-soo-saar, warshado, ganacsi iyo fursado shaqo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Shirku wuxuu sidoo kale ku baaqay in Afrika ay xoojiso iskaashiga dhaqaale, maalgashiga gudaha qaaradda iyo awoodda hay’adaha Afrika, si loo gaaro horumar ay si weyn uga qayb qaataan dowladaha iyo ganacsatada qaaraddu.

Dhanka kale, madaxa AUDA-NEPAD , Nardos Bekele-Thomas, ayaa sheegtay in Afrika aysan u baahnayn shirar badan oo keliya, balse ay u baahan tahay ficil, maalgelin iyo fulin. Waxay ku baaqday in mashaariicda qaaradda loo diyaariyo si ay u noqdaan kuwo maalgashadayaashu maalgelin karaan, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo mashaariicda isku xira dalal iyo gobollo badan. Guud ahaan, Alamein Africa Forum ayaa noqday madal lagu adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in Afrika ay ka faa’iidaysato kheyraadkeeda, suuqa ballaaran iyo awoodda dhalinyarada, iyadoo qorshayaasha Agenda 2063 iyo AfCFTA loo beddelayo mashaariic dhab ah oo keena wax-soo-saar, maalgashi iyo shaqooyin. Fariinta ugu weyn ee ka soo baxday madasha ayaa ahayd in mustaqbalka dhaqaale ee Afrika uusan ku xirnaan oo keliya tirada kheyraadka ay haysato, balse uu ku xiran yahay awoodda ay u leedahay inay kheyraadkaas u beddesho wax-soo-saar, warshado, ganacsi iyo fursado shaqo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Shirku wuxuu sidoo kale ku baaqay in Afrika ay xoojiso iskaashiga dhaqaale, maalgashiga gudaha qaaradda iyo awoodda hay’adaha Afrika, si loo gaaro horumar ay si weyn uga qayb qaataan dowladaha iyo ganacsatada qaaraddu.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh: Soomaaliya kama Hor istaagayso Itoobiya inay hesho Marin-badeed
items.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya uu yahay mid wanaagsan, isagoo xusay in Soomaaliya aysan Itoobiya ka hor istaageyn inay hesho marin-badeed ay u isticmaasho ganacsigeeda iyo danaha dhaqaale, balse arrintaasi ay tahay inay ku timaaddo heshiis rasmi ah oo dhex mara labada dal. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo wareysi siiyay Al Jazeera ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay diyaar u tahay inay Itoobiya siiso fursad ay uga faa’iidaysato marin-badeedyada Soomaaliya, iyadoo la dhowrayo madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo dhuleednimada ee dalka. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya uu horey u soo maray khilaaf xooggan, gaar ahaan kadib heshiiskii is-afgaradka ahaa ee Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliland ay gaareen horraantii 2024, kaas oo dowladda Soomaaliya ay si adag uga hortimid, iyadoo ku tilmaantay mid xadgudub ku ah madax-bannaanida iyo dhuleednimada Soomaaliya. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, labada dowladood ayaa markii dambe qaaday tallaabooyin lagu dejinayo xiisadda, waxaana la isla qaatay in khilaafaadka jira lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo hannaan diblomaasiyadeed. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in Muqdisho aysan diiddanayn baahida Itoobiya ee marin-badeed, balse isticmaalka dekedaha iyo xeebaha Soomaaliya uu u baahan yahay heshiis ay labada dhinac si buuxda u isla oggol yihiin. Hadalka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa muujinaya in Soomaaliya ay arrinta marin-badeedka Itoobiya u aragto mid lagu gaari karo iskaashi iyo heshiis dowladeed, halkii ay noqon lahayd tallaabo hal dhinac ah oo aan oggolaansho ka haysan dowladda Soomaaliya. Itoobiya oo ah dal aan bad lahayn ayaa muddo dheer raadineysay marin-badeed ay ku xoojiso ganacsigeeda iyo isku-xirka gobolka, halka Soomaaliya ay dhinaceeda adkeyneyso in heshiis kasta oo arrintaas ku saabsan uu ku dhisnaado ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida iyo shuruucda caalamiga ah.

items.title: Aqoonyahan Cabdikariim Aw Raali Oo ka warbixiyay Taarikh Nololeedkiisii iyo aasaaskii ururkii UFO
items.description: Waa kulan Aqoon iyo waayo aragnimo badan watay oo aanu wadaagnay Xildhibaan hore C/kariim Aw raali, Dadka aan garanahayn C/kariim waxaan u soo raaciyay intan yar ee kooban oo aan ka qoray illaa 10 sanno ka hor maraan jigjiga ku kulanay anigoo waliba aan xusin Taariikhdiisii SNM iyo marxalado kale oo xiligaa aanu ku talagalin faafintooda. Waa kuma Xildhibaan hore C/kariin Aw Raali? Taariikh nololeed kooban. (Taariikh nololeedka C/kariin laguma soo koobi karo maqaalkan oo kale, laakiin kulan yar oo aan la qaatay kadib ayaan jeclaysatay inaan si dulmar ah idiinku soo gudbiyo qaybo kamida noloshiisa iyo waxqabadkiisa) Magacaciisu waa Abdulkarim Aw Axmed Guuleed, wuxuu ku caanyahay INA AW RAALI. Waxa dhalay Aw Raali oo badi gayiga Soomaalida caanka ahaa, siiba Deegaanka Soomaalida Ethiopia. Wuxuu ku dhashay Deegaanka soomaalida Ethiopia gaar ahaan waqooyiga Degmada Daroor sanad lagu qiyaaso 1940 kii, waxaanu la dhashay 5 wiil iyo 3 gabdhood. WAXBARASHADIISII HOOSE Waxbarashadiisa wuxuu ka bilaabay Quraanka, waxaanu ka bilaabay Deegaanka XAADAW oo ka tirsan deegaanka Jigjiga. Dugsigiisii Hoose, Dhexe iyo sareba wuxuu ku soo qaatay Caasimada dalka Ethiopia ee Adiis Ababa, waxa xusid mudan C/kariin Aw Raali inuu Dugsigiisii dhexe uu kaalinta 1 aad u galay Ethiopia oo dhan. Sidoo kale Dugsigiisii sarena kaalmaha hore ayuu ka galay. JAAMACADDIISII 1 AAD. Kadib markii uu kaalmaha hore galay Dugsigiisii sare waxa Qaadatay oo waxbarasho bilaasha (scholarship) siisay jaamacadii ugu meeqaamka saraysay xilligaa Africa oo ku taalay Harar Ethiopia oo la odhan jiray HAILE SELASIE MILITARY ACADEMY. Sidaas ayuu C/karim Aw Raali ku noqday military kamaan_dawsa kuna qaatay xidigtii 1 aad, 2 aad iyo darajooyin kale oo ciidan, kadib markii uu ka soo baxay jaamacadii military_ga 1965 kii darajo fiican oo ciidanna la siiyay wuxuu noqday madaxa machadka Tobabarka ciidanka military_ga ee HOLETA, sidoo kale wuxuu hogaan ciidanno kala duwan ka noqday xilliyadaa galbeedka Ethiopia, isagoo ka aag badashay dagaaladii Soomaalida iyo Oromadu kula jireen Ethiopia xilligaa. JAAMACADIISII 2 AAD (Master_tiisii) C/kariin Aw Raali markale waxa uu u tartamay imtixaan uu qaaday wadanka GERMANY oo markaa awood badan oo ciidan iyo mid siyaasadeedba caalamka ku lahaa, imtixaankaa wuxuu ka qaaday Jarmalku military_ga wadannada 3 Qaaradood oo Aduunkaa oo kala ahaa AFRICA, ASIA IYO LATIN AMERICA. Nasiib wanaag C/karim Aw Raali imtixaankaa uu Jarmalku qaaday wuxuu galay kaalinta 1aad ee saddexda qaaradood. Sidaa darteed waxa wasaaradii gaashaandiga ee dalka Ethiopia yimi safiirkii Jarmalka ee Ethiopia waxaanu Hanbalyeey guud ahaan wadanka, Taliyihii ciidanka military_ga Ethiopia iyo C/karim oo uu u sheegay inuu kaalintaa ku guulaystay wiig ka dibna loo qaadi doono Germany. “Subax hore ayaa lay yeedhay waxaana laygu yidhi waxa ku doonayaa Taliyihii military_ga, waan u imi anigoo dirayskaygii ku labisan waxaanu ii sheegay inaan maalmo kooban kadib aadi doono jaamacad jarmalkaa. Anigu markaa khayaali ayaan u haystaa oo ma rumaysni, passport degdaga ayaa lay amray wax yar kadibna waanu baxnay oo waxaanu raacnay diyaarad Talyaaniya illaa markay Masar uga kacday Jarmalkana maan rumaysan waayo waxa jiray markaa cadaadis xoogan oo ihoryaalay iyo dadka oo igu odhan jiray military_ga Ethiopia meel ka gaadhi maysid” sidaa waxa yidhi C/kariin Aw Raali. Sidaas ayuu ku galay jaamacadiisii labaad ee MASTER_ta waxaanu diyaariyay BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION. C/KARIIN AW RAALI isagoo ku jira jaamacadii ayuu dhacay inqilaabkii lagu afgambiyay boqor Haile Selasse. Maadaama oo uu wadanki shuuci noqdayna Ethiopia waxay dalbatay in loo soo celiyo saraakiishii Jarmalka wax ka baranayay laakiin C/kariin iyo saraakiishii kaleba way diideen waxaanay siiwateen waxbarashadoodii. C/karim markuu qorayay buugiisii qalinjabinta wuxuu tagay Soomaaliya sababtoo ah wuxuu qorayay mawduuciisii ahaa THE ECONOMY, LIVESTOCK, AND THE SOCIAL STATUS OF THE PASTORALISTS IN SOMALIA. Isla waqtigaasna wuxuu tagay dhakhtarka weyn ee hargaysa isagoo ku soo arkay qisooyin cajiiba iyo dayacnaan badan, sidoo kale wuxuu soo eegay xaalada qaxoontigii Soomaalida ee dagaaladii 1977 ee Somalia iyo Ethiopia oo daadsan kuna darxumaysan xeryo qaxoonti duleedka Hargaysa ku yaal. “Waxaan ku gaadhay go,aan adag sidii aan wax ugu qaban lahaa qaxoontigaa Soomaaliyeed ee maalin kasta dhimanaya iyo dhakhtarka weyn ee Hargaysa oo dhib badani ka jirto” waxa sidaa yidhi C/karim. C/kariin Aw Raali wuxuu ku noqday Germany waxaanay u dhamaatay jaamacadiisii 2aad 1979 kii, waxaana qaadatay shirkadii caanka ahayd ee SIEMENS AG, oo ka mid ahayd shirkadaha ugu waawayn dalka Jarmalka xaruunteeda magaalada MUNICH, waxaanu ka baydhay fiilkii militariga. Isla wakhtigaa uu ka shaqaynayay shirkadaa SIEMENS AG ayaa uu ku dhaqaaqay go,aankiisii ahaa wax u qabashada qaxoontigii Soomaaliyeed ee uu ku soo arkay duleedka Hargaysa iyo dhakhtarkii Hargaysa ee dayacnaa. ” Dadaal badan iyo dhibaatooyin kadib waxa C/karim u suurto gashay inay kulmaan dhakhtar Jarmala oo la odhan jiray DR RUPERT NEUDECK oo baryahaa aas aasay Haayad Jarmala oo qaxoontiga lagu caawiyo kuna bohoobeen dhakhaatiir Jarmali oo la odhan jiray G E D ( GERMAN EMERGENCY DOCTORS). Dr RUPERT Kulanno dhaadheer, xogo ku saabsan xaalada qaxoontiga oo uu la wadaagay, wariyayaal loo diray xeryaha qaxoontiga iyo wasiirkii DALXIISKA ee Somalia MD MAXAMED CUMAR JEES oo uu u keenay kadib waxa uu la qaatay Dr ki C/kariin in si dhakhsaa loo caawiyo qaxoontigaa, waxaanu ka bilaabay Dr RUPERT inuu bangiga dalka Jarmalka ka amaahdo lacag dhan DM 500,000.00 oo lacagta Jarmalkaa isagoo u rahmay gurigiisii. “Bishii May 1980 kii ayaanu soo fasax qaadanay aniga, Dr RUPERT, 4 dhakhtar oo kale iyo 3 nurse, waxaanu diyaarad xamuula ka soo gaxaysanay magaalada PARIS, waxaanan soo qaadnay daawooyin, cunto, bustayaal, taandhooyin, gaadhi Land-drover ah iyo waxyaalii kalee loo baahnaa. Markaa, waxaanu ka soo degnay Djibouti May 10/1980 isla maalintii xigtayna waxaanu u baxnay xaga Hargaysa, annagoo wadana alaabtii oo aanu 4 baabuur oo xamuula ku soo raray sidoo kale wadana gaadhigii Landrover ka ahaa. May 13-keedii ayaanu magaalada Hargeysa goor fiid ah soo gallay. Waagi markuu beryey ayaanu dawladii raadsanay oo aanu u dhaqaaqnay dhinicii Xeradii Biyo Xidhka. Maamulkiibaa noo yimid oo aanu wada sahaminnay meesha xarun caafimaad ku haboon. Degdegbaan ugu heshiinay halkii ugu habooneyd. Dhakhsaanu u bilawnay dhismihii teendhooyinka. Waxaanu dhisnay mid bukaanka carruurta, mid dumarka iyo mid ragga bukaanka ah la dhigi karo iyo mid bukaanka lagu baadho. Waxa kale oo aanu dhisnay laba teendhooyin oo aanu dhigannay kaydadka kala duwan. Gelinkii danbeba Dhakhaatiirti shaqadii bay bilaabeen. 4 dhakhtar iyo 3 nurse ah ayaan shaqada ku bilawnay oo wada ahaa khubaro waaweyn, muddo bil ahna way soo ruqsad qaateen. Todobada subaxnimo ayaa shaqada la bilaabi jiray lixda galabnimana waanu ka noqon jirnay. Qadada shaqadaa loogu geyn jiray. DR. RUPERT NEUDECK, oo ahaa madaxii Haayadda ayaa wacay Germany si uu u ogaado sida loo arkay Programkii Gudigii sahanka ku yimid ka tuseen TV-gii Germanka, madaama aanu isweydaaranay oo aanaan is arkin. Xaskiisii oo uu lahadlay ayaa u sheegtay in muraara dilaac laga qaaday, maalintii u horaysayna lacag ka badan 5 million oo ah lacagta Jarmalka DM (DEUTCH-MARK) account-ka Haayadda lagu soo shubay. Aad ayuu ugu farxay arinkaa Dr RUPERT” C/kariin Aw Raali. Waxa kale oo ay C/kariin Aw Raali iyo Dr RUPERT ay bilaabeen inay furaan 2 xero oo kale maadaamoo qaxoontigu badnaa, waxaanay fureen xeradii ADHI_CADAYS EE DACAR BUDHUQ IYO TII TOG_WAJAALE oo iyagana sidii tii BIYO XIDHKA ay uga shaqeeyeen, 18 cisho kadib waxa yimi safiirkii Somalia u fadhiyay Jarmalka iyo xildhibaano ka socda Jarmalka, waxay aad u amaaneen shaqada fiican ee ay hayaan iyo dadaalka ay sameeyeen sidoo kale waxay balanqaadeen C/karim oo fasaxii shirkadu siisay ka dhacayo inay Baarlamaanku shirkada ka codsandoonaan in fasaxa loo kordhiyo mushaharkiisana la siiyo. Kadib markii hawshii xeryaha qaxoontigu hagaagtay shaqadina iskuugu duba dhacday DR RUPERT wuxuu ku noqday Germany, C/karim Aw Raalina wuxuu abaabulay dib u dhiskii, nadaafadii, iyo qalabayntii Dhakhtarka weyn ee Hargaysa, waa kan isagoo ka sheekaynaya hawsha dhakhtarka weyn “Gudoomiyaha Hayadda ayaan warbixin u qoray oo aan u sheegay baahida Hosbitaalka, isna wuxu isoo weydiiyey inaan Dhakhtar u xilsaaro inuu baahida Hosbitaalka oo idil soo qoro. Maadaama aan fursaddaan doonayey aan helay aniguna dhakhatiirtii oo idil ayaan shir u qabtay inay baahida Hosbitaalka oo tafa tiran qoraan si Hosbitaalka loo casriyeeyo. Shan maalmood gudaheed ayaa lagu dhameeyey baahidii Hosbitaalka aniguna markiiba waan gudbiyey, Dr. Rupert Neudeck-na markiiba qalabkii oo idil ayu dalbay. Markuu ii sheegay inuu alaabtii dalbay ayaan ka codsay inuu nin dayactira dhinaca dhismaha, laydhka iyo biyahana uu soo diro. Taasna wuu sameeyey oo 3 nin oo dayactirka Hosbitaalka qaabilsan ayu ii soo diray anna nin waliba wuxuu qaban lahaa ayaan farta ka saaray. Isla maalintiiba wuxuu Hosbitaalku u baahnaa oo idil ayey soo qoreen aniguna isla maalintiiba nin noqonaayey ayaan u dhiibay si Dayuurad soo baxaysay loo soo saari lahaa, waana la soo saaray 10 maalmoodna wey nagu soo gaadheen. Waxyaabahaanu Hosbitaalka ka qabanay waxaa ka mid ahaa: 1. Qasabadihii biyaha oo idil ayaanu beddellay, taankiga biyaha oo kayd ahna waanu dhisnay, 2. Xadhkihii dabka oo dhanna waanu wada beddelnay, laba Generator oo waaweynna waanu u dalabnay, 3. Drainage-kii (Bulaacadihii) Hosbitaalka oo wada xidhmayna waanu wada dhisnay, 4. Xashiishkii Hosbitaalka dhexdiisa tuulaana waanu ka wada saarnay inkasta oo dhibaatooyinku badnaayeen, 5. Shaqaalihi Hosbitaalka oo maalintii dhawr sacadood oo keliya shaqayn jiraybaan shiriyey sababaha ay shaqada uga tagaana waan weydiiyey. Sababtuna waxay noqotay musharka oo yar aawadeed. Waxaan weydiiyey intey doonayaan in loogu daro si aaney shaqadooda uga tegin. Lacagtii baanu cunto u badalay maadaama cunto badan aan ku hayey bakhaaro noo kireysna. Waxaan bilaabay inaan cunto ku filan qoysaska Hosbitaalka oo idil bishiiba aan u dhigo meelahay ka shaqeeyan si aan cidkale u ogaan” DR RUPERT NEUDECK wuxuu soo raray 1500 oo tan oo qalabkii dhakhtarka iyo xerooyinka qaxoontigaa. C/kariin Aw Raalina wuxuu sii abaabulay dadkii deganaa magaalada Hargaysa si ay uga qaybqaataan nadaafada dhakhtarka weyn. Waxa abaabulkaa kala qaybqaatay Alle hawnaxariistee Suldaan Xasan Barre Warsame oo aad u kala yaqaanay magaalada waxaana isku yimi oo ka qaybqaatay nadaafadii dhakhtarka dad badan oo dhalinyaro iyo waayeeelba leh halkaasna waxa ka bilaabmay URURKII UFO, dadkaa waxa uu aad u xusaa C/karim Aw Raali AHN XAAJI MAXAMED ABU SITTE IYO XAAJI CALI BAANIYAAL oo dhisay qaybta bukaan socodka lagu baadho. SIdoo kale waxay iibiyeen qalabkii iyo gaadiidkii lagu nadiifinayay dhakhtarka, halka C/karim Aw Raali_ na ku daray dhakhtarka qaybta daawooyinka. Waxa kale oo isla markaa ay dhistay Haayadaas G E D ee ay wadeen Dr RUPERT NEUDECK iyo C/KARIIN AW RAALI HARGEISA NURSING SCHOOL. Hawlahaa samafal iyo qaar kaleba markii ay qabteen C/kariim Aw Raali iyo DR RUPERT dawladdii Somalia oo markii hore ka shakidayna aragtay siday wax u wadaan waxay siisay shahaado sharaftii ugu saraysay ee ay bixiso Somalia oo ay haysteen Maxamed Siyaad Barre iyo Cali Samatar oo qudhi (THE SOMALI STAR). Intaa kadib dawladdii Somalia waxa ku bilaabmay jabhado ay ka mid ahayd SNM, c/kariin Aw Raali_na waxa soo food saaray cadaadis, xadhig iyo dhib badan oo kaga imanaysay dawladdii somalia. Kadib waxa uu u baydhay xaga ganacsiga, waxaanu sameeyay mashruucii waynaa ee WAXSOOSAARKABEERAHA ee tuulada CEEL_LA HELAY, shirkad cuntada fudud samaysa oo la odhan jiray HAMBURGER HOUSE oo ku taalay Xamar iyo shirkado kale oo dhisme, isagoo dhisay hangaradii waawaynaa ee duleedka Berbera ku yaalay kuwaas oo uu u dhisay hayada qaxoontiga ee UNHCR. C/kariin Aw Raali markii ay jabhadii Xoraynta Ethiopia ee EPRDF dalka qabsatay wuxuu galay baarlamaankii u horeeyay ee sharci dajinta Ethiopia, kadibna waxa la doortay 3 jeer oo ka danbeeyay, sidaana waxa uu kaga mid noqday xildhibaanada heer fadaraal ee ugu waqtiga dheeraa Ethiopia. Sidoo kale waxa loo magacaabay SAFIIRKA JARMALKA EE ETHIOPIA balse xilkaa iyo qaar kale oo uu ka mid ahaa WASIIRKA KAHORTAGA MASIIBOOYINKA ETHIOPIA waa uu ka cudur daartay. Waxa kale oo uu mudadaa uu xildhibaanka ahaa sameeyay Haayadii HOPE FOR THE HON ee Ethiopia oo uu aas aaskeeda lahaa Agaasimana ka ahaa, iyadoo lagu xasuusto xilligaa 1. Dhismaha illaa 20 dhaam biyood oo uu ka sameeyay inta u dhaxaysa Jigjiga oo uu dhisay Dhaamka HARRE illaa degmada Gaashaamo. 2. Waxa kale oo lagu xasuustaa illaa 50 iskuul oo ay ka mid ahaayeen iskuulada BALI MAXAMED, ABOKOR, RABASO, DAROOR, GOOSAYGA, GAASHAAMO iyo meelo badan oo Degmooyinka GAASHAAMO iyo DAROOR ka tirsan. 3. items.fullContent: Waa kulan Aqoon iyo waayo aragnimo badan watay oo aanu wadaagnay Xildhibaan hore C/kariim Aw raali, Dadka aan garanahayn C/kariim waxaan u soo raaciyay intan yar ee kooban oo aan ka qoray illaa 10 sanno ka hor maraan jigjiga ku kulanay anigoo waliba aan xusin Taariikhdiisii SNM iyo marxalado kale oo xiligaa aanu ku talagalin faafintooda. Waa kuma Xildhibaan hore C/kariin Aw Raali? Taariikh nololeed kooban. (Taariikh nololeedka C/kariin laguma soo koobi karo maqaalkan oo kale, laakiin kulan yar oo aan la qaatay kadib ayaan jeclaysatay inaan si dulmar ah idiinku soo gudbiyo qaybo kamida noloshiisa iyo waxqabadkiisa) Magacaciisu waa Abdulkarim Aw Axmed Guuleed, wuxuu ku caanyahay INA AW RAALI. Waxa dhalay Aw Raali oo badi gayiga Soomaalida caanka ahaa, siiba Deegaanka Soomaalida Ethiopia. Wuxuu ku dhashay Deegaanka soomaalida Ethiopia gaar ahaan waqooyiga Degmada Daroor sanad lagu qiyaaso 1940 kii, waxaanu la dhashay 5 wiil iyo 3 gabdhood. WAXBARASHADIISII HOOSE Waxbarashadiisa wuxuu ka bilaabay Quraanka, waxaanu ka bilaabay Deegaanka XAADAW oo ka tirsan deegaanka Jigjiga. Dugsigiisii Hoose, Dhexe iyo sareba wuxuu ku soo qaatay Caasimada dalka Ethiopia ee Adiis Ababa, waxa xusid mudan C/kariin Aw Raali inuu Dugsigiisii dhexe uu kaalinta 1 aad u galay Ethiopia oo dhan. Sidoo kale Dugsigiisii sarena kaalmaha hore ayuu ka galay. JAAMACADDIISII 1 AAD. Kadib markii uu kaalmaha hore galay Dugsigiisii sare waxa Qaadatay oo waxbarasho bilaasha (scholarship) siisay jaamacadii ugu meeqaamka saraysay xilligaa Africa oo ku taalay Harar Ethiopia oo la odhan jiray HAILE SELASIE MILITARY ACADEMY. Sidaas ayuu C/karim Aw Raali ku noqday military kamaan_dawsa kuna qaatay xidigtii 1 aad, 2 aad iyo darajooyin kale oo ciidan, kadib markii uu ka soo baxay jaamacadii military_ga 1965 kii darajo fiican oo ciidanna la siiyay wuxuu noqday madaxa machadka Tobabarka ciidanka military_ga ee HOLETA, sidoo kale wuxuu hogaan ciidanno kala duwan ka noqday xilliyadaa galbeedka Ethiopia, isagoo ka aag badashay dagaaladii Soomaalida iyo Oromadu kula jireen Ethiopia xilligaa. JAAMACADIISII 2 AAD (Master_tiisii) C/kariin Aw Raali markale waxa uu u tartamay imtixaan uu qaaday wadanka GERMANY oo markaa awood badan oo ciidan iyo mid siyaasadeedba caalamka ku lahaa, imtixaankaa wuxuu ka qaaday Jarmalku military_ga wadannada 3 Qaaradood oo Aduunkaa oo kala ahaa AFRICA, ASIA IYO LATIN AMERICA. Nasiib wanaag C/karim Aw Raali imtixaankaa uu Jarmalku qaaday wuxuu galay kaalinta 1aad ee saddexda qaaradood. Sidaa darteed waxa wasaaradii gaashaandiga ee dalka Ethiopia yimi safiirkii Jarmalka ee Ethiopia waxaanu Hanbalyeey guud ahaan wadanka, Taliyihii ciidanka military_ga Ethiopia iyo C/karim oo uu u sheegay inuu kaalintaa ku guulaystay wiig ka dibna loo qaadi doono Germany. “Subax hore ayaa lay yeedhay waxaana laygu yidhi waxa ku doonayaa Taliyihii military_ga, waan u imi anigoo dirayskaygii ku labisan waxaanu ii sheegay inaan maalmo kooban kadib aadi doono jaamacad jarmalkaa. Anigu markaa khayaali ayaan u haystaa oo ma rumaysni, passport degdaga ayaa lay amray wax yar kadibna waanu baxnay oo waxaanu raacnay diyaarad Talyaaniya illaa markay Masar uga kacday Jarmalkana maan rumaysan waayo waxa jiray markaa cadaadis xoogan oo ihoryaalay iyo dadka oo igu odhan jiray military_ga Ethiopia meel ka gaadhi maysid” sidaa waxa yidhi C/kariin Aw Raali. Sidaas ayuu ku galay jaamacadiisii labaad ee MASTER_ta waxaanu diyaariyay BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION. C/KARIIN AW RAALI isagoo ku jira jaamacadii ayuu dhacay inqilaabkii lagu afgambiyay boqor Haile Selasse. Maadaama oo uu wadanki shuuci noqdayna Ethiopia waxay dalbatay in loo soo celiyo saraakiishii Jarmalka wax ka baranayay laakiin C/kariin iyo saraakiishii kaleba way diideen waxaanay siiwateen waxbarashadoodii. C/karim markuu qorayay buugiisii qalinjabinta wuxuu tagay Soomaaliya sababtoo ah wuxuu qorayay mawduuciisii ahaa THE ECONOMY, LIVESTOCK, AND THE SOCIAL STATUS OF THE PASTORALISTS IN SOMALIA. Isla waqtigaasna wuxuu tagay dhakhtarka weyn ee hargaysa isagoo ku soo arkay qisooyin cajiiba iyo dayacnaan badan, sidoo kale wuxuu soo eegay xaalada qaxoontigii Soomaalida ee dagaaladii 1977 ee Somalia iyo Ethiopia oo daadsan kuna darxumaysan xeryo qaxoonti duleedka Hargaysa ku yaal. “Waxaan ku gaadhay go,aan adag sidii aan wax ugu qaban lahaa qaxoontigaa Soomaaliyeed ee maalin kasta dhimanaya iyo dhakhtarka weyn ee Hargaysa oo dhib badani ka jirto” waxa sidaa yidhi C/karim. C/kariin Aw Raali wuxuu ku noqday Germany waxaanay u dhamaatay jaamacadiisii 2aad 1979 kii, waxaana qaadatay shirkadii caanka ahayd ee SIEMENS AG, oo ka mid ahayd shirkadaha ugu waawayn dalka Jarmalka xaruunteeda magaalada MUNICH, waxaanu ka baydhay fiilkii militariga. Isla wakhtigaa uu ka shaqaynayay shirkadaa SIEMENS AG ayaa uu ku dhaqaaqay go,aankiisii ahaa wax u qabashada qaxoontigii Soomaaliyeed ee uu ku soo arkay duleedka Hargaysa iyo dhakhtarkii Hargaysa ee dayacnaa. ” Dadaal badan iyo dhibaatooyin kadib waxa C/karim u suurto gashay inay kulmaan dhakhtar Jarmala oo la odhan jiray DR RUPERT NEUDECK oo baryahaa aas aasay Haayad Jarmala oo qaxoontiga lagu caawiyo kuna bohoobeen dhakhaatiir Jarmali oo la odhan jiray G E D ( GERMAN EMERGENCY DOCTORS). Dr RUPERT Kulanno dhaadheer, xogo ku saabsan xaalada qaxoontiga oo uu la wadaagay, wariyayaal loo diray xeryaha qaxoontiga iyo wasiirkii DALXIISKA ee Somalia MD MAXAMED CUMAR JEES oo uu u keenay kadib waxa uu la qaatay Dr ki C/kariin in si dhakhsaa loo caawiyo qaxoontigaa, waxaanu ka bilaabay Dr RUPERT inuu bangiga dalka Jarmalka ka amaahdo lacag dhan DM 500,000.00 oo lacagta Jarmalkaa isagoo u rahmay gurigiisii. “Bishii May 1980 kii ayaanu soo fasax qaadanay aniga, Dr RUPERT, 4 dhakhtar oo kale iyo 3 nurse, waxaanu diyaarad xamuula ka soo gaxaysanay magaalada PARIS, waxaanan soo qaadnay daawooyin, cunto, bustayaal, taandhooyin, gaadhi Land-drover ah iyo waxyaalii kalee loo baahnaa. Markaa, waxaanu ka soo degnay Djibouti May 10/1980 isla maalintii xigtayna waxaanu u baxnay xaga Hargaysa, annagoo wadana alaabtii oo aanu 4 baabuur oo xamuula ku soo raray sidoo kale wadana gaadhigii Landrover ka ahaa. May 13-keedii ayaanu magaalada Hargeysa goor fiid ah soo gallay. Waagi markuu beryey ayaanu dawladii raadsanay oo aanu u dhaqaaqnay dhinicii Xeradii Biyo Xidhka. Maamulkiibaa noo yimid oo aanu wada sahaminnay meesha xarun caafimaad ku haboon. Degdegbaan ugu heshiinay halkii ugu habooneyd. Dhakhsaanu u bilawnay dhismihii teendhooyinka. Waxaanu dhisnay mid bukaanka carruurta, mid dumarka iyo mid ragga bukaanka ah la dhigi karo iyo mid bukaanka lagu baadho. Waxa kale oo aanu dhisnay laba teendhooyin oo aanu dhigannay kaydadka kala duwan. Gelinkii danbeba Dhakhaatiirti shaqadii bay bilaabeen. 4 dhakhtar iyo 3 nurse ah ayaan shaqada ku bilawnay oo wada ahaa khubaro waaweyn, muddo bil ahna way soo ruqsad qaateen. Todobada subaxnimo ayaa shaqada la bilaabi jiray lixda galabnimana waanu ka noqon jirnay. Qadada shaqadaa loogu geyn jiray. DR. RUPERT NEUDECK, oo ahaa madaxii Haayadda ayaa wacay Germany si uu u ogaado sida loo arkay Programkii Gudigii sahanka ku yimid ka tuseen TV-gii Germanka, madaama aanu isweydaaranay oo aanaan is arkin. Xaskiisii oo uu lahadlay ayaa u sheegtay in muraara dilaac laga qaaday, maalintii u horaysayna lacag ka badan 5 million oo ah lacagta Jarmalka DM (DEUTCH-MARK) account-ka Haayadda lagu soo shubay. Aad ayuu ugu farxay arinkaa Dr RUPERT” C/kariin Aw Raali. Waxa kale oo ay C/kariin Aw Raali iyo Dr RUPERT ay bilaabeen inay furaan 2 xero oo kale maadaamoo qaxoontigu badnaa, waxaanay fureen xeradii ADHI_CADAYS EE DACAR BUDHUQ IYO TII TOG_WAJAALE oo iyagana sidii tii BIYO XIDHKA ay uga shaqeeyeen, 18 cisho kadib waxa yimi safiirkii Somalia u fadhiyay Jarmalka iyo xildhibaano ka socda Jarmalka, waxay aad u amaaneen shaqada fiican ee ay hayaan iyo dadaalka ay sameeyeen sidoo kale waxay balanqaadeen C/karim oo fasaxii shirkadu siisay ka dhacayo inay Baarlamaanku shirkada ka codsandoonaan in fasaxa loo kordhiyo mushaharkiisana la siiyo. Kadib markii hawshii xeryaha qaxoontigu hagaagtay shaqadina iskuugu duba dhacday DR RUPERT wuxuu ku noqday Germany, C/karim Aw Raalina wuxuu abaabulay dib u dhiskii, nadaafadii, iyo qalabayntii Dhakhtarka weyn ee Hargaysa, waa kan isagoo ka sheekaynaya hawsha dhakhtarka weyn “Gudoomiyaha Hayadda ayaan warbixin u qoray oo aan u sheegay baahida Hosbitaalka, isna wuxu isoo weydiiyey inaan Dhakhtar u xilsaaro inuu baahida Hosbitaalka oo idil soo qoro. Maadaama aan fursaddaan doonayey aan helay aniguna dhakhatiirtii oo idil ayaan shir u qabtay inay baahida Hosbitaalka oo tafa tiran qoraan si Hosbitaalka loo casriyeeyo. Shan maalmood gudaheed ayaa lagu dhameeyey baahidii Hosbitaalka aniguna markiiba waan gudbiyey, Dr. Rupert Neudeck-na markiiba qalabkii oo idil ayu dalbay. Markuu ii sheegay inuu alaabtii dalbay ayaan ka codsay inuu nin dayactira dhinaca dhismaha, laydhka iyo biyahana uu soo diro. Taasna wuu sameeyey oo 3 nin oo dayactirka Hosbitaalka qaabilsan ayu ii soo diray anna nin waliba wuxuu qaban lahaa ayaan farta ka saaray. Isla maalintiiba wuxuu Hosbitaalku u baahnaa oo idil ayey soo qoreen aniguna isla maalintiiba nin noqonaayey ayaan u dhiibay si Dayuurad soo baxaysay loo soo saari lahaa, waana la soo saaray 10 maalmoodna wey nagu soo gaadheen. Waxyaabahaanu Hosbitaalka ka qabanay waxaa ka mid ahaa: 1. Qasabadihii biyaha oo idil ayaanu beddellay, taankiga biyaha oo kayd ahna waanu dhisnay, 2. Xadhkihii dabka oo dhanna waanu wada beddelnay, laba Generator oo waaweynna waanu u dalabnay, 3. Drainage-kii (Bulaacadihii) Hosbitaalka oo wada xidhmayna waanu wada dhisnay, 4. Xashiishkii Hosbitaalka dhexdiisa tuulaana waanu ka wada saarnay inkasta oo dhibaatooyinku badnaayeen, 5. Shaqaalihi Hosbitaalka oo maalintii dhawr sacadood oo keliya shaqayn jiraybaan shiriyey sababaha ay shaqada uga tagaana waan weydiiyey. Sababtuna waxay noqotay musharka oo yar aawadeed. Waxaan weydiiyey intey doonayaan in loogu daro si aaney shaqadooda uga tegin. Lacagtii baanu cunto u badalay maadaama cunto badan aan ku hayey bakhaaro noo kireysna. Waxaan bilaabay inaan cunto ku filan qoysaska Hosbitaalka oo idil bishiiba aan u dhigo meelahay ka shaqeeyan si aan cidkale u ogaan” DR RUPERT NEUDECK wuxuu soo raray 1500 oo tan oo qalabkii dhakhtarka iyo xerooyinka qaxoontigaa. C/kariin Aw Raalina wuxuu sii abaabulay dadkii deganaa magaalada Hargaysa si ay uga qaybqaataan nadaafada dhakhtarka weyn. Waxa abaabulkaa kala qaybqaatay Alle hawnaxariistee Suldaan Xasan Barre Warsame oo aad u kala yaqaanay magaalada waxaana isku yimi oo ka qaybqaatay nadaafadii dhakhtarka dad badan oo dhalinyaro iyo waayeeelba leh halkaasna waxa ka bilaabmay URURKII UFO, dadkaa waxa uu aad u xusaa C/karim Aw Raali AHN XAAJI MAXAMED ABU SITTE IYO XAAJI CALI BAANIYAAL oo dhisay qaybta bukaan socodka lagu baadho. Waxa kale oo isla markaa ay dhistay Haayadaas G E D ee ay wadeen Dr RUPERT NEUDECK iyo C/KARIIN AW RAALI HARGEISA NURSING SCHOOL. items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo shaaciyey qorshe xasaasi ah oo Israel ay ka damacsan tahay Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in Israel ay qorsheyneyso inay saldhig ciidan-badeed ka sameysato magaalada Berbera, isla markaana ay isticmaasho garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaaladaas. Xasan Sheekh ayaa arrintan ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyey Al Jazeera, oo qeybo ka mid ah la sii daayey Sabtida, iyadoo wareysiga oo dhameystiran la baahin doono Axadda. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalka aysan aqbali doonin joogitaan militari oo Israel ay ka sameysato dhul Soomaaliya ka mid ah. “Sinaba uma aqbali doonno joogitaan Israel ay Soomaaliya ku yeelato qaabka ay hadda ugu soo dhowaaneyso Somaliland,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh, sida lagu sheegay qeybo ka mid ah wareysiga la sii daayey. Waxa uu sheegay in, sida uu rumeysan yahay, ujeeddada Israel ay tahay inay Berbera ka hesho meel istaraatiiji ah oo u dhow dalalka Khaliijka iyo Iran, isla markaana ay isticmaasho dekedda iyo garoonka magaalada. Somaliland oo horey u beenisay Hadalka Xasan Sheekh ayaa kusoo aadaya iyadoo madaxda Somaliland ay horey u beeniyeen wararka sheegaya in heshiis laga gaaray saldhig militari oo Israel laga siiyo Berbera. Wasiirka gaashaandhigga Somaliland Maxamed Yuusuf Cali ayaa bishii June Reuters u sheegay in aysan jirin saldhig militari oo Israel ku leedahay Somaliland, isla markaana aysan socdaan wada-hadallo ku saabsan dhismaha saldhig noocaas ah. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu xaqiijiyey in Israel ay tababaro siinayso ciidamada milatariga iyo booliska Somaliland. Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi ayaa sidoo kale bishii February sheegay in aan wax heshiis ah laga gaarin saldhig militari oo Israel ay ka sameysato Somaliland, inkastoo uu meesha ka saarin iskaashi militari oo labada dhinac mustaqbalka dhex mara. Khilaafka ayaa sii xoogeysanaya tan iyo markii Israel ay bishii December 2025 si rasmi ah u aqoonsatay Somaliland, iyadoo noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ee tallaabadaas qaada. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u diiday aqoonsigaas, iyadoo ku tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Midowga Afrika iyo dalal ay ka mid yihiin Masar iyo Turkiga ayaa iyaguna kasoo horjeestay tallaabada Israel. Maxay Berbera muhiim u tahay? Berbera waxay ku taallaa xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed, meel ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Goobtaas ayaa ah mid ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ee ganacsiga caalamka, waxaana muhiimaddeeda militari iyo dhaqaale sii kordhiyey dagaallada Yemen iyo weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee maraakiibta ku socda Badda Cas. Reuters ayaa horraantii sanadkan sheegtay in goobta ay Somaliland ku taallo, gaar ahaan dekedda Berbera, ay soo jiidaneyso danaha dalal badan sababo la xiriira ganacsiga, amniga iyo isku socodka Badda Cas. Xasan Sheekh ayaa wareysiga Al Jazeera ku sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan dooneyn in khilaafaadka Bariga Dhexe loo soo raro Geeska Afrika. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku eedeeyey Xuutiyiinta Yemen inay qalqal geliyaan amniga gobolka isla markaana carqaladeeyaan maraakiibta isticmaasha Bab al-Mandab.
