items.fullContent: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in Israel ay qorsheyneyso inay saldhig ciidan-badeed ka sameysato magaalada Berbera, isla markaana ay isticmaasho garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaaladaas. Xasan Sheekh ayaa arrintan ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyey Al Jazeera, oo qeybo ka mid ah la sii daayey Sabtida, iyadoo wareysiga oo dhameystiran la baahin doono Axadda. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalka aysan aqbali doonin joogitaan militari oo Israel ay ka sameysato dhul Soomaaliya ka mid ah. “Sinaba uma aqbali doonno joogitaan Israel ay Soomaaliya ku yeelato qaabka ay hadda ugu soo dhowaaneyso Somaliland,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh, sida lagu sheegay qeybo ka mid ah wareysiga la sii daayey. Waxa uu sheegay in, sida uu rumeysan yahay, ujeeddada Israel ay tahay inay Berbera ka hesho meel istaraatiiji ah oo u dhow dalalka Khaliijka iyo Iran, isla markaana ay isticmaasho dekedda iyo garoonka magaalada. Somaliland oo horey u beenisay Hadalka Xasan Sheekh ayaa kusoo aadaya iyadoo madaxda Somaliland ay horey u beeniyeen wararka sheegaya in heshiis laga gaaray saldhig militari oo Israel laga siiyo Berbera. Wasiirka gaashaandhigga Somaliland Maxamed Yuusuf Cali ayaa bishii June Reuters u sheegay in aysan jirin saldhig militari oo Israel ku leedahay Somaliland, isla markaana aysan socdaan wada-hadallo ku saabsan dhismaha saldhig noocaas ah. Khilaafka ayaa sii xoogeysanaya tan iyo markii Israel ay bishii December 2025 si rasmi ah u aqoonsatay Somaliland, iyadoo noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ee tallaabadaas qaada. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u diiday aqoonsigaas, iyadoo ku tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Midowga Afrika iyo dalal ay ka mid yihiin Masar iyo Turkiga ayaa iyaguna kasoo horjeestay tallaabada Israel. Maxay Berbera muhiim u tahay? Berbera waxay ku taallaa xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed, meel ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Goobtaas ayaa ah mid ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ee ganacsiga caalamka, waxaana muhiimaddeeda militari iyo dhaqaale sii kordhiyey dagaallada Yemen iyo weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee maraakiibta ku socda Badda Cas. Reuters ayaa horraantii sanadkan sheegtay in goobta ay Somaliland ku taallo, gaar ahaan dekedda Berbera, ay soo jiidaneyso danaha dalal badan sababo la xiriira ganacsiga, amniga iyo isku socodka Badda Cas. Xasan Sheekh ayaa wareysiga Al Jazeera ku sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan dooneyn in khilaafaadka Bariga Dhexe loo soo raro Geeska Afrika. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku eedeeyey Xuutiyiinta Yemen inay qalqal geliyaan amniga gobolka isla markaana carqaladeeyaan maraakiibta isticmaasha Bab al-Mandab. items.title: Duqayn xoogan oo ka dhacday Sanca iyo Xuutiyiinta oo garaacay xarun shidaal oo ku taala Riyadh
items.description: Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen ayaa caawa sheegay inay boqolaal weerar oo xagga cirka ah ka fuliyeen Magaalada Sanca iyo deegaano kale, oo Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ay gacanta ku hayaan, xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo dagaalka u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo Dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudiga uu bari-taaro. Telefishinka afka Xuutiyiinta ku hadla ee Al Masirah ayaa sheegay in Sacuudiga uu duqayntii ugu xooganeyd ka gaystay Caasimadda Sanca. Goobjoogeyaasha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in qaraxyadii ugu badnaa ee hal maalin ay maanta ka dhaceen magaaladaasi. Goobjoogeyaasha ayaa waxay kaloo sheegeen inay arkeen diyaarado dagaal oo gantaalo ku ridaya magaalada. Afhayeen u hadlay Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen oo lagu magacaabo Korneyl Majed Abdullah Al Nazili ayaa sheegay in 257 hawlgal ay si sax ah ula beegsadeen goobaha, dhaqdhaqaaqyada iyo awoodaha militari ee Xuutiyiinta. Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in Militariga Yemen ay adeegsadeen diyaaradaha dagaalka, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, gantaalada la hago iyo madaafiicda qoriga dhuunta dheer ee artillery-ga. Korneyl Al Nazili ayaa intaasi ku daray in qiyaasaha horudhaca ah ay muujinayaan in hawlgaladaasi lagu dilay ugu yaraan 700 oo ka tirsan Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta, isla-markaana lagu burburiyay bartilmaameedyo militari oo istiraatiiji ah, oo ay ku jiraan buu yiri 170 gaadiidka dagaalka ah iyo qalab culus. Al Nazili ayaa sheegay in hawlgaladan ay ka fuliyeen Sanca, Midi, Baqim iyo jiidaha hore ee dagaalka ee Al-Jawf, Marib, Al-Bayda iyo Lahij, isla-markaana hawlgalada qaarkood ay diiradda ku saareen aagga Taiz, sida uu yiri. Dagaal-yahanada Xuutiyiinta ayaa dhankooda sii wada weerarada ay ku hayaan bartilmaameedyada Dowladda Yemen iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee Boqortooyada Sacuudiga. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegtay inay garaaceen xarun shidaal oo Shirkadda Shidaalka Sacuudiga ee Aramco ay ku leedahay Magaalada Riyadh. Wakaaladda Wararka Reuters ayaa goor sii horreysay oo maanta ah ku warantay in dab weyn uu ka kacay mid ka mid ah xarumaha Shirkadda Aramco ee Riyadh. Wakaaladda Wararka AFP ayaa iyana sheegtay in galabnimadii Sabtidan la arkay olol iyo qiiq ka kacaya xarun ay leedahay Shirkadda Aramco oo ku taala koonfurta Riyadh. Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegay in duqaynta ay ka gaysteen gudaha Sacuudiga ay jawaab u tahay boqortooyada oo tobanaan jeer maanta garaacday Sanca. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa muuqaal uu caawa soo duubay ku sheegay in dagaal-yahanadooda ay weerarka u adeegsadeen gantaalo iyo diyaarado drones ah, isagoo intaasi ku daray in uu dab qabsaday xarunta la beegsaday. Masuuliyiinta iyo Saraakiisha Sacuudiga ayaan weli ka hadlin weerarka ay Xuutiyiintu ka gaysteen Riyadh. Xiisadda Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga ayaa cirka isku shareertay, ka dib markii Xuutiyiinta ay bishii July ku dhawaaqeen go’doomin badeed oo ka dhan ah Dekedaha Sacuudiga. Colaadda u dhexeyso labada dhinac ayaa sii xoogeysatay, ka gadaal markii Xuutiyiinta ay bishii September isku fidiyeen deegaanada xeebaha galbeed ee Yemen ee ku teedsan Badda Cas, isla-markaana ay la wareegeen gacan ku haynta marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed.

items.title: Somaliland’s ruling WADDANI Party and opposition parties KULMIYE and Kaah have separately defended Somaliland’s position on Israel’s……
items.description: The people of Somaliland, their clerics, scholars, traditional elders and political parties share a fundamental position on Somaliland as a nation and their right to self-determination, asserts Somaliland’s ruling WADDANI Party and opposition parties KULMIYE and Kaah have separately defended Somaliland’s position on Israel’s recognition of the Republic of Somaliland, and scoffed at insinuations by Somalia’s Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre concerning the response of Somaliland’s political and traditional institutions. KULMIYE Secretary-General Faisal Abdirahman Madar, speaking at a press conference in Hargeisa, said his party supports Israel’s recognition of Somaliland and considers the issue of Somaliland’s statehood to be beyond political negotiation. “The KULMIYE Party once again makes clear that the recognition Somaliland received from Israel is not subject to negotiation, and we support it. The decision concerning Somaliland’s existence is irreversible, and no one can change it,” Madar said. He called on Somalia’s federal government to recognize the Republic of Somaliland, saying Mogadishu still had an opportunity to take such a step. He also urged neighbouring countries to support Somaliland’s bid for wider international recognition. Israel formally recognized Somaliland as an independent and sovereign state on December 26, 2025, according to the statement, with the two sides subsequently signing a joint declaration establishing diplomatic relations. Similarly, Kaah Party leader Abdikarim Mohamed rejected remarks by Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre, who said Somaliland’s religious scholars, traditional elders and political parties did not support Israel’s recognition of Somaliland. Hamza made the remarks during an interview with a Somali TV podcast, saying: “We were pleased that the people of Somaliland, the religious scholars, traditional elders and all the political parties are not in agreement with this, and the Somali people do not accept it.” He disputed that characterization, saying Somaliland’s political parties, religious scholars and traditional elders share what he described as a fundamental position concerning Somaliland’s existence and right to self-determination, despite disagreements over other political issues. “I am telling you that the people of Somaliland, their religious scholars, traditional elders and political parties share one ‘fundamental’ position based on the existence of Somaliland as a nation and their right to self-determination,” he said. He accused the Somali prime minister of misreading political debates within Somaliland and said disagreements among Somaliland’s political actors should not be interpreted as opposition to Somaliland’s statehood. “Your statement appears to show that you have become confused and lost in the debates and views within Somaliland’s political parties and society,” Madar said. He concluded his response with a Somali chiding phrase denoting a browbeaten hypocrite, saying, “Let me cry, shut the door so that I hide,” which he used to characterize what he portrayed as the Somali government’s response to developments concerning Somaliland. The conservative WADDANI Party has, on several occasions, strongly and steadfastly defended Israel’s recognition of Somaliland, while consistently standing up for the interests of the Republic of Somaliland, whether on the issue of recognition or in support of the government and the President’s efforts to secure formal recognition from other countries around the world.   Source horntribune

items.title: Is-beddel lama filaan ah oo ku yimid dagaalkii gobolka Tigray
items.description: Mekelle (Caasimada Online) — Dagaalyahannada iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha TPLF ayaa Sabtida isaga baxayay magaalada Mekelle, caasimadda gobolka Tigray, xilli ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya ay kusoo siqayaan magaalada, isla markaana ay dib ula wareegeen garoonkeeda diyaaradaha. Wariye maxalli ah iyo dad deggan Mekelle ayaa wakaaladda AFP u sheegay in xubnaha Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) ay bilaabeen inay magaalada ka baxaan, iyadoo xarumo dowladeed iyo saldhigyo boolis laga waayay ciidamadii ammaanka. “Dagaalyahannada iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha TPLF way ka baxayaan Mekelle,” ayuu yiri wariyaha, isaga oo sheegay in ciidamada federaalka aan weli lagu arag gudaha magaalada. Dhanka kale, Reuters ayaa Sabtida werisay in ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya ay dib ula wareegeen garoonka Alula Aba Nega ee Mekelle, sida ay sheegeen saddex ilo xog-ogaal ah. Garoonka ayaa ka mid ahaa goobo muhiim ah oo TPLF ay qabsatay markii dagaalka cusub uu qarxay 23-kii September. Qabsashada garoonka iyo ka bixitaanka xubnaha TPLF ayaa muujinaya isbeddel weyn oo ku yimid dagaalka, kadib markii xoogagga Tigray ay maalmo ka hor horumar ka sameeyeen gobollada deriska la ah Tigray. Dagaalka ayaa 23-kii September ka qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya, markii TPLF iyo xoogag ay xulafo yihiin ay weerarro ka bilaabeen qeybo ka mid ah Afar iyo Amhara, taas oo dhalisay cabsi laga qabo inuu dib u qarxo dagaal ballaaran oo la mid ah kii 2020-2022. Laakiin ciidamada federaalka iyo maleeshiyaadka taageersan dowladda ayaa maalmihii dambe qaaday weerar rogaalcelis ah, iyagoo dib u riixay xoogagga TPLF, kadibna dhowr jiho uga soo dhaqaaqay dhinaca Mekelle. Reuters ayaa Jimcihii werisay in ciidamada dowladda iyo xoogagga taageersan ay kusoo dhowaadeen Mekelle, iyadoo dagaalka cusub uu noqday kii ugu xooganaa tan iyo heshiiskii nabadeed ee 2022. Cabsi laga qabo fowdo Ka bixitaanka ciidamada iyo saraakiisha TPLF ayaa walaac ka dhaliyay gudaha Mekelle, halkaas oo dadka deegaanka ay ka cabsi qabaan in la waayo kala dambeynta ka hor inta aysan ciidamada dowladda gaarin gudaha magaalada. “Waxaan ka walaacsanahay in hantida dowladda iyo tan dadweynaha ay u nuglaato bililiqo, sababtoo ah magaalada ma joogaan ciidamo amni,” ayuu qof deggan Mekelle u sheegay AFP. Qof kale ayaa sheegay inuu ka baqayo in sharci-darro ay ku faafto magaalada. “Waxaan ka baqayaa nafteyda. Waxaan dooneynaa in si degdeg ah loogu soo laabto sharciga iyo kala dambeynta,” ayuu yiri. Xaaladda dhabta ah ee qeybo badan oo magaalada iyo gobolka ah ayaa weli adag in si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyo, maadaama gelitaanka warbaahinta uu aad u xaddidan yahay, isla markaana ay jiraan go’itaanno waaweyn oo dhanka isgaarsiinta ah. TPLF ayaa muddo dheer ahayd awoodda ugu weyn ee Tigray, waxaana horaantii sanadkan ay meesha ka saartay maamul ay dowladda federaalku taageeraysay. Hase yeeshee, horumarka ay hadda sameynayaan ciidamada dowladda ayaa TPLF dib ugu celinaya xaalad u eg tii bilowgii dagaalkii 2020, markii ciidamada federaalka ay qabsadeen Mekelle. Hoggaamiyaha TPLF Debretsion Gebremichael ayaa Khamiistii muujiyay in xoogaggiisu ay u wareegi karaan dagaal dhuumaaleysi ah haddii ay lumiyaan magaalooyinka waaweyn. “Waxaan ku shaqeyneynaa istaraatiijiyad aan cadowga ku garaaceyno meel kasta oo aan dooranno,” ayuu yiri. TPLF ayaa qaab la mid ah u dagaallantay kadib markii Mekelle ay ciidamada dowladda qabsadeen dabayaaqadii 2020. Dagaalyahannada Tigray ayaa markaas dib ugu laabtay dhulka miyiga ah, waxayna ugu dambeyn dib ula wareegeen magaalada bartamihii 2021. Xiisadda oo gobolka ku fidaysa Dagaalka cusub ayaan ku koobnaan oo keliya khilaafka gudaha Itoobiya, balse wuxuu sidoo kale sababay burbur weyn oo ku yimid xiriirka Addis Ababa kala dhexeeya Eritrea iyo Masar. Itoobiya ayaa ku eedeysay Eritrea, Masar iyo Sudan inay taageerayaan xoogagga kasoo horjeeda dowladda. Dalalka la eedeeyay ayaa diiday inay taageerayaan fallaagada. Addis Ababa ayaa Khamiistii xirtay safaaraddeeda Asmara, isla markaana cayrisay 10 diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah. Eritrea ayaa jawaab ahaan ku dhawaaqday inay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed u jartay Itoobiya. Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale cayrisay diblomaasi Masri ah, iyadoo Qaahira ay qaaday tallaabo la mid ah. Khilaafka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa bilihii dambe sii xoogeysanayay, iyadoo Asmara ay Addis Ababa ku eedeysay inay damacsan tahay inay xoog ku hesho marin ay uga baxdo Badda Cas. Debretsion ayaa isaguna dagaalka hadda socda ku xiriiriyay loollanka gobolka. “Dagaalku waa mid goboleed, waana dagaal lagu doonayo in lagu xakameeyo Badda Cas,” ayuu yiri. Madaxda gobolka oo ku kulmaya Iyadoo dagaalku sii xoogeysanayo, madaxda Soomaaliya, Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan ayaa Axadda lagu wadaa inay kulan wada-tashi ah ku yeeshaan magaalada New Alamein ee Masar. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki, madaxweynaha Masar Abdel Fattah al-Sisi iyo taliyaha ciidamada Sudan Abdel Fattah al-Burhan ayaa lagu wadaa inay ka qeyb-galaan kulanka. Afhayeenka madaxtooyada Masar ayaa Sabtida sheegay in kulanka afarta dhinac looga tashan doono arrimaha gobolka ee ay wadaagaan dalalkaas. Kulanka ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo Itoobiya uu xiriirkeedu aad u xumaaday Eritrea iyo Masar, isla markaana Addis Ababa ay labada dal ku eedeysay inay taageerayaan TPLF. items.fullContent: Mekelle (Caasimada Online) — Dagaalyahannada iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha TPLF ayaa Sabtida isaga baxayay magaalada Mekelle, caasimadda gobolka Tigray, xilli ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya ay kusoo siqayaan magaalada, isla markaana ay dib ula wareegeen garoonkeeda diyaaradaha. Wariye maxalli ah iyo dad deggan Mekelle ayaa wakaaladda AFP u sheegay in xubnaha Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) ay bilaabeen inay magaalada ka baxaan, iyadoo xarumo dowladeed iyo saldhigyo boolis laga waayay ciidamadii ammaanka. “Dagaalyahannada iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha TPLF way ka baxayaan Mekelle,” ayuu yiri wariyaha, isaga oo sheegay in ciidamada federaalka aan weli lagu arag gudaha magaalada. Dhanka kale, Reuters ayaa Sabtida werisay in ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya ay dib ula wareegeen garoonka Alula Aba Nega ee Mekelle, sida ay sheegeen saddex ilo xog-ogaal ah. Garoonka ayaa ka mid ahaa goobo muhiim ah oo TPLF ay qabsatay markii dagaalka cusub uu qarxay 23-kii September. Qabsashada garoonka iyo ka bixitaanka xubnaha TPLF ayaa muujinaya isbeddel weyn oo ku yimid dagaalka, kadib markii xoogagga Tigray ay maalmo ka hor horumar ka sameeyeen gobollada deriska la ah Tigray. Dagaalka ayaa 23-kii September ka qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya, markii TPLF iyo xoogag ay xulafo yihiin ay weerarro ka bilaabeen qeybo ka mid ah Afar iyo Amhara, taas oo dhalisay cabsi laga qabo inuu dib u qarxo dagaal ballaaran oo la mid ah kii 2020-2022. Laakiin ciidamada federaalka iyo maleeshiyaadka taageersan dowladda ayaa maalmihii dambe qaaday weerar rogaalcelis ah, iyagoo dib u riixay xoogagga TPLF, kadibna dhowr jiho uga soo dhaqaaqay dhinaca Mekelle. Reuters ayaa Jimcihii werisay in ciidamada dowladda iyo xoogagga taageersan ay kusoo dhowaadeen Mekelle, iyadoo dagaalka cusub uu noqday kii ugu xooganaa tan iyo heshiiskii nabadeed ee 2022. Cabsi laga qabo fowdo Ka bixitaanka ciidamada iyo saraakiisha TPLF ayaa walaac ka dhaliyay gudaha Mekelle, halkaas oo dadka deegaanka ay ka cabsi qabaan in la waayo kala dambeynta ka hor inta aysan ciidamada dowladda gaarin gudaha magaalada. “Waxaan ka walaacsanahay in hantida dowladda iyo tan dadweynaha ay u nuglaato bililiqo, sababtoo ah magaalada ma joogaan ciidamo amni,” ayuu qof deggan Mekelle u sheegay AFP. Qof kale ayaa sheegay inuu ka baqayo in sharci-darro ay ku faafto magaalada. “Waxaan ka baqayaa nafteyda. Waxaan dooneynaa in si degdeg ah loogu soo laabto sharciga iyo kala dambeynta,” ayuu yiri. Xaaladda dhabta ah ee qeybo badan oo magaalada iyo gobolka ah ayaa weli adag in si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyo, maadaama gelitaanka warbaahinta uu aad u xaddidan yahay, isla markaana ay jiraan go’itaanno waaweyn oo dhanka isgaarsiinta ah. TPLF ayaa muddo dheer ahayd awoodda ugu weyn ee Tigray, waxaana horaantii sanadkan ay meesha ka saartay maamul ay dowladda federaalku taageeraysay. Hase yeeshee, horumarka ay hadda sameynayaan ciidamada dowladda ayaa TPLF dib ugu celinaya xaalad u eg tii bilowgii dagaalkii 2020, markii ciidamada federaalka ay qabsadeen Mekelle. Hoggaamiyaha TPLF Debretsion Gebremichael ayaa Khamiistii muujiyay in xoogaggiisu ay u wareegi karaan dagaal dhuumaaleysi ah haddii ay lumiyaan magaalooyinka waaweyn. “Waxaan ku shaqeyneynaa istaraatiijiyad aan cadowga ku garaaceyno meel kasta oo aan dooranno,” ayuu yiri. Nabad jilicsan oo burburtay TPLF waxay ahayd awoodda ugu weyn ee isbahaysigii xukumayay Itoobiya intii u dhaxeysay 1991 iyo 2018, kahor inta uusan ra’iisul wasaare Abiy Ahmed talada la wareegin, iyadoo awooddii siyaasadeed ee TPLF ay si weyn hoos ugu dhacday. items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo ahmiyad siinaya dib-u-heshiisiinta dadka Koonfur Galbeed
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa maanta shir guddoomiyay shir la xiriira geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta dadka reer Koonfur Galbeed. Shirkan oo ay yeesheen Golaha Wasiirada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa looga hadlay amniga deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed iyo dardargelinta geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada, sida lagu sheegay war ka soo baxay Xafiiska Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed. “Golaha Wasiirada ayaa si qoto dheer uga hadlay gogosha iyo geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo la adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la helo wada hadal loo dhan yahay, is afgarad siyaasadeed, bulsho iyo in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo hannaan nabadeed oo ku dhisan wadatashi iyo is qancin.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa adkeeyay nabadgelyada, midnimada bulshada iyo dib-u-heshiisiintu inay yihiin tiirarka aasaaska u ah horumarka iyo xasilloonida Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo dowladda ay sii wadi doonto dadaalada lagu mideynayo bulshada iyo xoojinta dowladnimada.” Shirkan ayaa daba socdo kulan uu Aadan Madoobe uu Khamiistii Madaxtooyada Baydhabo kula yeeshay wafdi uu hoggaaminayo Gudoomiyihii hore ee Golaha Shacabka, Maxamed Mursal Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan oo gaaray magaaladaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Aadan Madoobe uu Maxamed Mursal ka codsaday inuu gacan ka gaysto doorka hoggaamineed ee dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada, isla-markaana uu ka aqbalay. Aadan Madoobe ayaa daneynaya in loo kala dab qaado maamulkiisa cusub iyo hoggaankii hore ee maamulka, kaas oo dagaal uu kala kulmayo. Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) oo aan aqoonsanayn doorashada Aadan Madoobe ayay ciidamadiisu weerar ku hayaan Magaalada Baydhabo. Aadan Madoobe oo Khamiistii ka hadlayay shir jaraa’id ayaa ku baaqay in wada hadal iyo is afgarad siyaasadeed lagu dhameeyo wax kasta oo lagu kala aragti duwan yahay. Ma cadda in Laftagareen iyo siyaasiyiinta deegaanka ee ku mowqifka ah ay aqbali doonaan wada hadal nabadeed iyo gorgortan siyaasadeed iyo in kale.

items.title: US air operations killed or wounded at least 216 civilians in Somalia
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – At least 216 civilians in Somalia were recorded as killed or injured by U.S. air operations between 2007 and May 2025, according to an investigation supported by Arab Reporters for Investigative Journalism (ARIJ). The investigation described the figure as the minimum number of civilian casualties its researchers were able to document in the incidents reviewed. It does not mean the United States has confirmed each casualty. Somalia in the four-country picture The investigation covered Somalia, Syria, Iraq and Yemen. Syria recorded the highest toll, with 1,336 people killed or wounded, followed by Yemen with 991, Iraq with 793 and Somalia with 216, for a combined total of at least 3,336. Somalia’s share is the smallest, about 6.5 percent of the total. How the figures were built Investigators analyzed 884 air operations across the four countries, excluding disputed or unclassifiable incidents and using the lowest documented casualty estimates. The Somalia total is therefore a floor, not a ceiling. Two findings are reported for all four countries combined, not for Somalia alone. Children account for nearly 42 percent of the casualties documented across the four countries, and the investigation does not establish that breakdown for Somalia’s figure. The investigation also found 2.3 civilians were killed for every combatant killed during the opening months of President Donald Trump’s second term, again across all four countries. It attributes the civilian toll to U.S. policies governing strike authorization and the level of civilian harm commanders are permitted to accept. An expert view on why civilians are missed The investigation quotes Wes Bryant, a former Pentagon civilian protection official, who said airstrikes often accompany ground operations conducted overnight or at dawn, and that failures to detect civilians contributed to many deaths. His comments address U.S. air operations generally, not Somalia specifically. The strike numbers The investigation’s data ends in May 2025, so it does not cover the full 2025 campaign. U.S. Africa Command (AFRICOM) carried out 124 strikes in Somalia in 2025, up from 10 in 2024, according to an AFRICOM spokesperson. That surpassed the previous all-time high of 63 in 2019. AFRICOM had launched at least 86 strikes in Somalia in 2026 as of September. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Waa Kuwee Shaqooyinka Halista ugu Jira in Garaadgacmeedku Beddelo?
items.description: Markii ChatGPT si rasmi ah dunida loogu soo bandhigay dabayaaqadii 2022, dad badan waxay u arkayeen aalad cusub oo lagu diyaariyo farriimaha iimaylka, lagu xalliyo layliyada waxbarashada ama jawaabo loogu helo weydiimaha fudud. Dad yar ayaa markaas ku baraarugsanaa in sannado kooban gudahood garaadgacmeedku (Artificial Intelligence) saldhig u noqon doono doodda ugu weyn ee ka taagan suuqyada shaqada waa: yaa shaqadiisa sii xejisin doona, yuuse garaadgacmeedku barabixin doonaa? Dooddani kuma koobnaan shirkadaha waaweyn ee teknolajiyadda, sida OpenAI, Google iyo Microsoft. Waxay ku fidday bangiyada, warshadaha, shirkadaha gaadiidka, xarumaha adeegga macaamiisha iyo weliba goobaha shaqo ee ay dhallinyaradu inta badan ka bilaabaan noloshooda xirfadeed. Waxa la isku hayo ma aha oo keliya tirada shaqooyinka meesha ka bixi kara, ee sidoo kale, waa sida uu isbeddelkani u qaabayn doono mustaqbalka shaqooyinka, xirfadaha iyo nololmaalmeedka bulshooyinka. Welwelka laga qabo isbeddelkan waa mid isa soo taraya, mararka qaarkoodna waa la buunbuuniyaa baaxadda halistiisa. Sidaas oo ay tahay, xogaha ay soosaarayaan hay’adaha dhaqaalaha iyo suuqa shaqadu waxay muujinayaan in arrintu ka gudubtay heerkii oddorosidda iyo malaynta, oo garaadgacmeedku durba saamayn ku yeeshay habkii shaqooyinka qaarkood loo qaban jiray. Sanduuqa Lacagta Adduunka (International Monetary Fund) ayaa horraantii 2026 sheegay in ku dhowaad 40% shaqooyinka dunidu ay la kulmi karaan saamaynta garaadgacmeedka. Shaqooyinka qaarkood hawlahooda ayaa la fududayn karaa, kuwo kalena habkii loo qaban jiray ayaa isbeddelaya, halka qaar kale ay suurtaggal tahay in gebi ahaanba la beddelo. Tiradani, si kastaba, macnaheedu ma aha in 40% shaqooyinka dunidu ay meesha ka baxayaan. Hay’addu waxay si gaar ah u tilmaantay cadaadiska sii kordhaya ee shaqooyinka heerka dhexe, gaar ahaan kuwa xafiisyada ee hawlahoodu maalinlaha yihiin. Dhinaca kale, Madasha Dhaqaalaha Adduunka (World Economic Forum) ayaa warbixinteeda The Future of Jobs Report 2025 ku muujisay in isbeddelka suuqa shaqadu uusan ku koobnayn shaqooyin lumaya, maaddaama ay dhinac socoto baahida loo qabo xirfado cusub. Waxa ay si gaar ah u adkaysay muhiimadda tababbarka, kobcinta aqoonta iyo dibubarashada xirfadaha, si shaqaaluhu ula jaanqaadaan teknolajiyadda soo kordhaysa. Marka xogahaas la isu wada geeyo, waxaa soo baxaya sawir ka duwan aragtida guud ee ah in garaadgacmeedku la wareegayo shaqo kasta oo dadku qabtaan. Saamayntu waxay si weyn ugu xiran tahay nooca shaqada, heerka aqoonta ay u baahan tahay iyo sida ay hawlaheedu ugu habboon yihiin in lagu qabto nidaamyo iswada (automated systems). Shaqooyinka ku dhisan habraac joogto ah, hawlo soo noqnoqda iyo xog si fudud loo habayn karo ayaa si gaar ah ugu nugul isbeddelkan. Waxaa tusaale u ah shaqaalaha xoggelinta (data entry). Dadka maalin kasta tirooyin, diiwaanno iyo dukumentiyo ku geliya nidaamyada xogta waxay ka mid yihiin shaqaalaha ay suurtaggal tahay in hawlahooda qaar lagu beddelo barnaamijyada casriga ah. Aaladahani waxay akhriyi karaan dukumentiyada, shaandhayn (filtering ) ku samayn karaan xogta, ogaan karaan khaladaadka qaarkood, dabadeedna xogta ku kaydin karaan nidaamyo diyaarsan, iyaga oo hawlo waqti badan qaadan jiray ku dhammaynaya muddo kooban. Isbeddel la mid ah ayaa ka socda xarumaha adeegga macaamiisha. Shirkado badan ayaa qayb ka mid ah hawlihii jawaabcelinta u wareejiyay barnaamijyada wadasheekaysiga (chatbots). Halkii shaqaale uu maalin kasta ka jawaabi lahaa weydiimo isku mid ah, barnaamij ayaa macaamiisha siin kara macluumaadka ay u baahan yihiin, una gudbin kara adeegyada ku habboon. Nidaamyadani, waxay sidoo kale fududaynayaan helitaanka adeegyada saacad kasta, iyada oo aysan lagamamaarmaan ahayn in shaqaale kastaa xilligaas hawsha joogo. Illowse, weli waxaa jira cabashooyin iyo arrimo murugsan oo u baahan garashada, dhexdhexaadinta iyo go’aanka shaqaale aadane ah. Dukaamada waaweynna waxaa ka muuqda isbeddel kale. Goobo ganacsi oo badan ayaa hirgeliyay nidaamyo uu macmiilku isagu badeecadaha ku diiwaangelinayo, lacagtoodana ku bixinayo, isaga oo aan u baahnayn khasnaji. Nidaamyadan, oo loo yaqaanno “ Self-checkout Systems” , waxay yarayn karaan hawlaha ay shaqaalaha dukaamadu qabtaan. Waxaase muhiim ah in la kala saaro nidaamyada iswada iyo garaadgacmeedka, waayo adeeg kasta oo iswada kuma dhisna garaadgacmeed. Warshaduhu waxay iyaguna muddo dheer adeegsanayeen roboodyo (robots) iyo mashiinno qabta hawlo ay dadku hore u qaban jireen. Aaladahaasi waxay kala saaraan badeecooyinka, xirxiraan alaabta, qabtaanna shaqooyin u baahan saxnaan iyo isku-celcelin joogto ah. Suuqa shaqada ee ku sii tiirsanaanaya nidaamyada dhijitaalka ah waxaa kale oo soo foodsaari kara khataro la xiriira xogsiraysiga (confidentiality), xogsugidda (integrity) iyo badqabka macluumaadka. Shaqaalaha iyo adeegsadayaasha nidaamyadaasi waxay u baahan yihiin wacyiqab saybar (cyber awareness), si ay u fahmaan halisaha la xiriira xogaha shaqada iyo ilaalinta macluumaadka gaarka ah. Inkasta oo arrimahani aysan si toos ah u ahayn shaqooyinka uu garaadgacmeedku beddeli karo, haddana waxay ka mid yihiin aqoonta loo baahan yahay marka hawlaha shaqada loo wareejinayo adeegyada dhijitaalka ah. Sooyaalka horumarka teknolajiyaddu wuxuu ina barayaa in hal-abuur kasta oo cusub uu wax ka beddelo habnololeedka iyo shaqooyinka bulshada. Xuddunta dooddu, sida muuqata, ma aha oo keliya in garaadgacmeedku shaqooyinka dadka la wareegi doono iyo in kale. Waxaa iyaduna muhiim ah in la fahmo sida uu u beddelayo xirfadaha, waxsoosaarka iyo habka dadku u shaqeeyaan. Qofka bartay adeegsiga aaladaha cusub, kuna dara aqoon iyo xirfad sugan, wuxuu yeelan karaa fursado uu kula jaanqaado baahiyaha soo kordhaya. Mustaqbalka shaqadu uma eka mid ay mashiinnadu keli ku noqon doonaan, mana aha mid ay dadku hawlahoodii hore u qaban doonaan iyada oo aysan waxba iska beddelin. Waayo, waxa mustaqbalka shaqada go’aaminaya kuma koobna awoodda ay mashiinnadu yeeshaan, ee waxaa qayb weyn ku leh sida bulshooyinku u maareeyaan teknolajiyadda, shaqaalahoodana ugu diyaariyaan ka faa’iidaysigeeda.

Dad yar ayaa markaas ku baraarugsanaa in sannado kooban gudahood garaadgacmeedku (Artificial Intelligence) saldhig u noqon doono doodda ugu weyn ee ka taagan suuqyada shaqada waa: yaa shaqadiisa sii xejisin doona, yuuse garaadgacmeedku barabixin doonaa? Dooddani kuma koobnaan shirkadaha waaweyn ee teknolajiyadda, sida OpenAI, Google iyo Microsoft. Waxa la isku hayo ma aha oo keliya tirada shaqooyinka meesha ka bixi kara, ee sidoo kale, waa sida uu isbeddelkani u qaabayn doono mustaqbalka shaqooyinka, xirfadaha iyo nololmaalmeedka bulshooyinka. Welwelka laga qabo isbeddelkan waa mid isa soo taraya, mararka qaarkoodna waa la buunbuuniyaa baaxadda halistiisa. Inta ay aaladaha garaadgacmeedku ku sii fidayaan qaybahaas, waxaa sii kordhaya baahida loo qabo fahanka adeegsiga teknolajiyadda, xaqiijinta xogaha iyo ilaalinta tayada shaqada. Waxaana lagamamaarmaan ah in la tixgeliyo duruufaha gaarka ah ee dalka, sida helitaanka waxbarasho iyo tababbar, kaabayaasha teknolajiyadda iyo awoodda ganacsiyada. Suuqa shaqada ee ku sii tiirsanaanaya nidaamyada dhijitaalka ah waxaa kale oo soo foodsaari kara khataro la xiriira xogsiraysiga (confidentiality), xogsugidda (integrity) iyo badqabka macluumaadka. Shaqaalaha iyo adeegsadayaasha nidaamyadaasi waxay u baahan yihiin wacyiqab saybar (cyber awareness), si ay u fahmaan halisaha la xiriira xogaha shaqada iyo ilaalinta macluumaadka gaarka ah. Inkasta oo arrimahani aysan si toos ah u ahayn shaqooyinka uu garaadgacmeedku beddeli karo, haddana waxay ka mid yihiin aqoonta loo baahan yahay marka hawlaha shaqada loo wareejinayo adeegyada dhijitaalka ah. Sooyaalka horumarka teknolajiyaddu wuxuu ina barayaa in hal-abuur kasta oo cusub uu wax ka beddelo habnololeedka iyo shaqooyinka bulshada. Markii internetku baahay, waxaa soo baxay welwel la xiriiray shaqooyinka iyo ganacsiyadii uu saamayn lahaa. Dabadeed waxaa hanaqaaday adeegyo, meherado iyo xirfado cusub oo aan markii hore jirin. Geeddisocodkaas waxaa laga dheehan karaa sida teknolajiyaddu mararka qaarkood u beddesho shaqooyinkii hore, isla markaana u curiso fursado kale. Garaadgacmeedku wuxuu horseedi karaa isbeddel la mid ah, in kasta oo aan weli si buuxda loo saadaalin karin baaxadda saamayntiisa iyo sida ay faa’iidooyinka iyo khasaaruhu ugu kala qaybsami doonaan shaqaalaha, shirkadaha iyo dalalka dunida. Xuddunta dooddu, sida muuqata, ma aha oo keliya in garaadgacmeedku shaqooyinka dadka la wareegi doono iyo in kale. Waxaa iyaduna muhiim ah in la fahmo sida uu u beddelayo xirfadaha, waxsoosaarka iyo habka dadku u shaqeeyaan. Qofka bartay adeegsiga aaladaha cusub, kuna dara aqoon iyo xirfad sugan, wuxuu yeelan karaa fursado uu kula jaanqaado baahiyaha soo kordhaya. Mustaqbalka shaqadu uma eka mid ay mashiinnadu keli ku noqon doonaan, mana aha mid ay dadku hawlahoodii hore u qaban doonaan iyada oo aysan waxba iska beddelin. Waxaa muuqda suuq shaqo oo dib isu qaabaynaya, xirfado cusubna u baahan; suuq ay aqoonta, hal-abuurka, laqabsiga teknolajiyadda iyo garashada aadamuhu weli muhiimad weyn ku yeelan doonaan. Ugu danbayn, waxaa la gudboon shaqaalaha maanta in ay dib u eegaan xirfadahooda, aqoontooda kobciyaan, una diyaar garoobaan isbeddelka socda. Waayo, waxa mustaqbalka shaqada go’aaminaya kuma koobna awoodda ay mashiinnadu yeeshaan, ee waxaa qayb weyn ku leh sida bulshooyinku u maareeyaan teknolajiyadda, shaqaalahoodana ugu diyaariyaan ka faa’iidaysigeeda.

items.title: Daawo: Natiijada doorashada HirShabelle oo la shaaciyay
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa maanta magaalada Jowhar kaga dhawaaqay natiijada doorashadii maalmo kahor ka dhacday deegaannada Dowlad-goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee HirShabelle. Guddoomiyaha guddiga, Cabdikariim Axmed Xasan ayaa sheegay in doorashadu ka qabsoontay 10 degmo, iyadoo tartanka ay ka qayb galeen 13 urur siyaasadeed oo ku loollamay 99 kursi oo Golaha Wakiillada ah. Tirada guud ee codadka la dhiibtay ayaa gaartay 114,633, waxaana guddigu sheegay in 112,451 kamid ah ay ahaayeen codad ansax ah, halka 2,182 cod loo aqoonsaday kuwo aan ansax ahayn. Natiijada la shaaciyay ayaa muujineysa in ururka Caddaalad iyo Midnimadda Tiir uu ku guuleystay 759 cod iyo hal kursi, halka Madalsan uu isna helay 911 cod iyo hal kursi. Ururka Muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ayaa helay 122 cod iyo hal kursi, halka Dimuqraadiga Soomaaliyeed uu ku guuleystay 2,368 cod iyo laba kursi. Caddaaladda iyo Wadajir ayaa noqday ururka ugu codadka badan, isagoo helay 88,130 cod iyo 78 kursi halka Dadka Soomaaliyeed uu helay 113 cod, balse uusan wax kursi ah ku guuleysan. Sidoo kale, Ururka Iftiin Qaran ayaa helay 6,165 cod iyo shan kursi, halka Karaama uu helay 6,875 cod iyo lix kursi. Ururka Saab ayaa sidoo kale helay 120 cod, balse uusan wax kursi ah ku guuleysan, halka Dan Shacab uu isna helay 51 cod, mana helin wax kursi ah. Ururka Sincad ayaa helay 3,701 cod iyo saddex kursi, halka Dhallinyarada Talo-Qaran ay heleen 97 cod, balse uusan wax kursi ah ku guuleysan. Ugu dambeyn Ururka Ramaas ayaa isna helay 1,939 cod iyo laba kursi. Doorashadan ayaa qayb ka ah hannaanka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo guddigu sheegay in doorashooyinku ay u dhaceen si nabdoon oo xor ah. Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in howlaha ka socda dowlad-goboleedyada iyo Banaadir ay qayb ka yihiin diyaar-garowga doorashooyinka heer federaal ee Soomaaliya. The post Daawo: Natiijada doorashada HirShabelle oo la shaaciyay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: JSP oo 78 Kursi Ka Helay Baarlamaanka Hirshabeelle
items.description: Jowhar, 3 Oktoobar 2026 — Doorashada Baarlamaanka Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle ayaa gashay marxalad cusub, kaddib markii la sheegay in Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) uu helay 78 ka mid ah 99-ka kursi ee Baarlamaanka Hirshabeelle sida uu ku dhawaaqay Guddiga doorashooyinka. Tirada kuraasta uu helay JSP ayaa siinaysa ururka aqlabiyad ballaaran oo Baarlamaanka ah, iyadoo Madaxweynaha Hirshabeelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe), uu yahay musharraxa JSP ee xilka hoggaanka maamulka. JSP ayaa 13-kii Sebtembar si rasmi ah Guudlaawe ugu dhawaaqay musharraxiisa doorashada Hirshabeelle. Haddii natiijada 78-ka kursi ay sidaas ku dhammaato, waxay JSP siinaysaa awood baarlamaan oo weyn marka la gaaro doorashada hoggaamiyaha maamulka, iyadoo Guudlaawe uu yahay musharraxa xisbiga. Si kastaba, geeddi-socodka doorashada ayaa waxaa hareeyay khilaaf siyaasadeed, gaar ahaan gobolka Hiiraan. Siyaasiyiin iyo odayaal dhaqameed ayaa ku baaqay in doorashada lagu saleeyo heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay, halka qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta Hiiraan ay ka soo horjeedaan in doorashada lagu qabto qaabka hadda socda. Dhanka kale, dowladda federaalka ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ku adkeysanaysay in dalka loo gudbo nidaam doorasho oo qof iyo cod ah, iyadoo sheegtay in wada-hadallada siyaasadeed ay weli furan yihiin. Doorashada Hirshabeelle waxay sidoo kale kusoo beegmaysaa xilli aan weli heshiis siyaasadeed laga gaarin qaabka iyo maamulka doorashada federaalka, iyadoo dowladda iyo mucaaradku ay ku kala aragti duwan yihiin nidaamka doorashada, hay’adaha maamulaya iyo habka loo gaari karo heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay. Sidaas darteed, doorashada Hirshabeelle waxay noqotay mid si dhow loola xiriirinayo loolanka siyaasadeed ee doorashada federaalka, iyadoo natiijada ka soo baxda Jowhar ay saameyn ku yeelan karto isku dheelitirka siyaasadeed ee dalka xilli Soomaaliya ay isu diyaarinayso doorashooyinka heer federaal.

items.title: Jaamac oo qaaday tallaabo guul u ah Soomaaliya + Sawirro
items.description: Arusha (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa Jimcihii guddoomiyey kulanka 21-aad ee guddoonka guddoomiyeyaasha baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC) kaas oo lagu qabtay magaalada Arusha ee Dalka Tanzania, iyadoo guddoominta shirkan ay guul wayn u tahay Soomaaliya. Jaamac ayaa hadda ah guddoomiyaha guddoomiyeyaasha baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika, taas oo u suuragelisay fursaddan muhiimka ah, waxaana shirka diiradda lagu saaray arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan xaaladda waddamada ku bahoobay ururka EAC. Inta uu socday kulanka ayaa waxaa si gaar ah looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga baarlamaannada, horumarinta diblomaasiyadda baarlamaaniga ah, is-weydaarsiga khibradaha, iyo xaqiijinta in is-dhexgalka Bariga Afrika uu shucuubta Bariga Afrika u horseedo faa’iidooyin la taaban karo. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa ugu horreyn xubnaha kulanka ka qeyb galay la wadaagay horumarka uu sameeyey Baarlamaanka 11-aad ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dowlad-dhiska, dhameystirka iyo ansixinta Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, amniga iyo sarreynta sharciga, maamulka maaliyadda guud iyo sidoo kale horumarinta dhaqaalaha, isagoo tilmaamay in Goluhu uu ansixiyey in ka badan 56 sharci iyo 18 qaraar. Sidoo kale, guddoomiye Jaamac ayaa tilmaamay in himilada Golaha Shacabka ay tahay in si buuxda uu u guto waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee saaran, gaar ahaan sharci-dejinta iyo korjoogteynta, inuu u adeego danaha Shacabka Soomaaliyeed, islamarkaana uu gacan ka geysto xoojinta iskaashiga iyo is-dhexgalka Bulshada Bariga Afrika. Waxaa kale oo uu carabka ku adkeeyey in mustaqbalka Bulshada Bariga Afrika uu ku tiirsan yahay iskaashi xooggan, hay’ado adkaysi leh iyo baarlamaanno si wax-ku-ool ah uga shaqeeya danaha iyo himilooyinka shucuubtooda, sidoo kalena Soomaaliya ay ka go’antahay inay kaalinteeda si buuxda uga qaadato sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in iyadoo arrimahaasi laga duulayo Soomaaliya ay ku faraxsan tahay inay xaqiijiso diyaar-garowgeeda ku aaddan martigelinta Kulanka 22-aad ee Guddoonka Guddoomiyeyaasha Baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC), kaas oo lagu qaban doono Caasimadda Dalka ee Muqdisho dhammaadka bisha Janaayo ee sanadka 2027. Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu rajo wanaagsan ka muujiyey in caasimadda Soomaaliya ee Muqdisho lagu soo dhoweeyo guddoonka guddoomiyeyaasha baarlamaannada Bulshada Bariga Afrika, si loo xoojiyo dadaalada wadajirka ah ee ku aaddan dhismaha Bulshada Bariga Afrika oo mideysan, barwaaqo ah, kuna naaloota nabad waarta. The post Jaamac oo qaaday tallaabo guul u ah Soomaaliya + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Askari saaxiibkiis u dilay caro uu ka qaaday Turub ay wada ciyaarayeen oo la xukumay
items.description: Eedeysane Dable Booliska Nuur Ibraahim Sahal, ayaa lagu soo eedeyay dembiga ah dil kas ah oo uu u geeystay Marxuum Ex Dable Booliska Libaan Nuux Sooc oo ay kawada tirsanaayeen Ciidanka laanta ilaalada canshuuraha Booliska, falkaasi, ayaana ka dhacay degmadda Xamar jajab, taariikhdu markii ay aheyd labo iyo tobankii bishii todobaad ee Sanadkaan 2026. Eedeysanaha ayaa ka carooday in loo diiday Turub ay askartu dheelayeen, madaama loo arkay in uusan wax aqoon ah u laheyn Ciyaarta, waxaana uu doontay Qori AK-47 ah, si xoog uu ugu Ciyaaro, marxuumka ayaana isna ku adkeystay go’aanka Diidmada Turubka uu isagu lahaa. Intaasi kadib Eedeysane Nuur, ayaa aflagaado iyo xabado tiro beel ah is daba dhigay, isaggoo adeegsanaya Qori Ak-47 ah, taasi oo keentay geerida Marxuum Ex Dable Booliska Liibaan Nuux Sooc. Baaris dheer ka dib Xafiiska Xeer ilaalinta Ciidamadda qalabka sida, ayaa Codsaday qaadista kiiskaan, Waxaana laga oggolaaday Kowdii Bishaan October 2026. Garsoorka Maxkamadda ciidamada qalabka sida oo waqti ku filan siiyey dhinacyadda dacwadda ayaa ugu dambeyn maanta ku xukumay Ex-Dable Booliska Nuur Ibraahim Sahal Dil Toogasho oo ah Qisaasta Marxuum Ex Dable Booliska Liibaan Nuux Sooc. items.title: Saraakiisha cusub ee Guutada 22aad Gorgor oo lagu dhaariyay TURKSOM (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Saraakiisha iyo Saraakiil Xigeenada Guutada 22aad ee Ciidanka Kumaandooska Gorgor ayaa lagu dhaariyay munaasabad ka dhacday Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee TURKSOM ee duleedka Magaalada Muqdisho. Kaaliyaha Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Maadey Nuurey Sheekh Ufurow, Taliyaha Taliska Tababarada & Doctrine-ka ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Axmed Ciise Axmed iyo Saraakiil kale oo ka kala tirsan Militariga Somaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa ka qaybgalay munasabadda dhaarinta. “Munaasabadda ayaa lagu muujiyay diyaargarowga, anshaxa iyo heeganka ciidanka cusub, kuwaas oo loo diyaariyay inay gutaan waajibaadkooda qaran, difaacaan dalka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isla-markaana u adeegaan ilaalinta amniga iyo midnimada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Somaliya.” Ayaa lagu yiri war maanta lagu daabacay bogga wararka ee Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Kaaliyaha Taliyaha Militariga Somaliya ayaa ciidamada kula dardaarmay inay ilaaliyaan anshaxa, wadajirka, daacadnimada iyo waajibaadka qaranimo, iyagoo mar walba dhowraya sharciga iyo karaamada shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Turkiga oo ah xulafo muhiim ah oo Somaliya ay leedahay ayaa xoojinaya dhismaha iyo tababarka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, wuxuuna sanad kasta soo saaraa cutubyo cusub oo biira ciidamada. Turkiga ayaa door weyn ka qaata tababarka iyo qalabaynta ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee loo diyaarinayo in ay si buuxda ula wareegaan amniga iyo difaaca dalka. Saldhigga TURKSOM oo qaab casri ah loo dhisay ayaa ah saldhigga ugu weyn ee Saraakiisha Militariga Turkiga ay ku tababaraan ciidamada cusub.

items.title: Somalia won’t accept Israeli presence ‘under any circumstances’: President Hassan Sheikh
items.description: Somalia will not accept Israeli presence in the country “under any circumstances” and will resist any attempts to be pulled into the Middle East’s crises, its President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud tells Al Jazeera. Speaking in an exclusive interview, Mohamud said that Israel was planning to establish a naval base in Berbera and use the city’s airport, adding that its real aim was to get closer to the Gulf states and Iran. Berbera is a port city on the Gulf of Aden coast in Somaliland – the self-declared republic in northwestern Somalia that Israel recognised last year, but which is claimed by Mogadishu. Berbera faces Yemen across the water near the strategic Bab al-Mandeb strait. The Iran-aligned Houthis have previously enforced a blockade on Israel-linked ships in the area. “We will overcome the challenges posed to our country by Israeli moves,” Mohamud said in his wide-ranging interview. He added that the Israeli plans fall under the “ Greater Israel ” project – referring to a term for various proposals, often rooted in biblical interpretations, for Israeli control over territory beyond its current borders. Some versions extend from the Nile to the Euphrates. Israel has not adopted it as official policy, but Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in an August 2025 interview that he felt connected to the vision, prompting condemnation from Arab governments. The Somali president described Israel as a “destabilising force” that does not abide by international law. He also criticised Tel Aviv’s recognition of Somaliland in December. No country other than Israel recognises Somaliland, while the region’s own residents are completely opposed to an Israeli presence, Mohamud said. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991 and has governed itself independently for more than three decades. But it had not secured recognition from any United Nations member state until Israel’s move. Fight against armed groups The Somali president told Al Jazeera the United States remains his country’s strongest partner in the fight against “terrorism”, and added that al-Shabab has no presence in the major cities, leaving no possibility of the group taking control in Somalia. Al-Shabab is a Somali armed group that emerged from the Islamic Courts Union in the mid-2000s and pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012. It has fought Somalia’s federal government for years, holds territory in parts of southern and central Somalia, and has carried out deadly attacks, including in Mogadishu and in neighbouring Kenya. Regarding the East Africa region, Mohamud said Somalia’s relations with neighbouring Ethiopia are good, and Mogadishu does not object to Addis Ababa gaining access to the sea through a joint agreement to use Somali ports for its economic interests. Ethiopia has been landlocked since Eritrea became independent in 1993 and relies largely on Djibouti’s ports for trade. In January 2024, Addis Ababa signed a memorandum of understanding with Somaliland on sea access, which Somalia condemned as a violation of its sovereignty. Somalia and Ethiopia later agreed to ease tensions. Houthis ‘destabilising’ region Mohamud also accused Yemen’s Houthis of “destabilising the region” and disrupting navigation in the Bab al-Mandeb strait. His comments come as the group attempts to build on its lightning offensive that captured the country’s Red Sea coast last month. Thus far, Yemeni government forces have been able to hold their positions on the front lines and even claimed to have inflicted heavy losses against the Houthis. The Houthis have also intensified their attacks on Saudi Arabia, but the kingdom’s Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (MBS) has promised not to compromise on its security, saying the Yemeni rebels chose “chaos and destruction, threatening the Yemeni people and the region”. Al Jazeera.

items.title: Xaalad cusub oo kasoo korortay Koonfur Galbeed kadib dagaalkii Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Xaalad cabsi iyo walaac xooggan ayaa ka dhalatay dagaalladii cuslaa ee maalmahan kusoo noqnoqday magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay, kuwaas oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Dagaalladan ayaa dhaliyay khasaare lixaadleh oo isugu jiro dhimasho, dhaawac, burbur iyo barakac ay sameeyeen dadka deegaanka, waxaana weli taagan cabsi horleh oo ku aadan in mar kale ay dagaalamaan labada dhinac oo weli isku horfadhiya bannaanka magaalada. Xidhibaan hore Maxamed Cumar Dalxa oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Shabelle Tv ayaa shaaca ka qaaday haddii aan wax laga qaban xaaladda taagan ay dagaallada kusii fidi karaan dhammaan deegaannada kale ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Hadda sow Baydhaba kama socda dagaalka, iyadoo tuulooyinka iyo degmooyinka uu ku fiday ayaad arkeysaa, yaa gurigiisa AK47 oolin? sidii shalay maanta ma aha,” ayuu yiri Dalxa. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ku baaqay in deganaan la muujiyo, isla arkaana wada-hadal iyo midnimo lagu wajaho xiisadda siyaasadeed iyo midda amni ee ka taagan Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. “Waxaan leeyahay baahashaan walaalow ayay ku fiican tahay Koonfur Galbeed oo la wada leeyahana ay ku suntanaato laakin dhabar iska taabashadan ma soconeyso,” ayuu sii raaciyay Xildhibaan hore Maxamed Cumar Dalxa oo kasoo jeedo deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyadoo haatan xaalad bandow ah lagu soo rogay Baydhaba, kaas oo xaddidaya dhaq-dhaqaaqa dadka iyo gaadiidka wixii ka dambeeya salaadda Maqrib. Go’aankan ayaa qayb ka ah tallaabooyin lagu xoojinayo amniga magaalada, iyadoo Baydhabo ay weli ka jirto xaalad amni oo u baahan feejignaan dheeraad ah iyo in si dhow loola socdo dhaqdhaqaaqyada ka dhacaya gudaha magaalada. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay iska horimaad ka dhacay Degmada Qoryooley
items.description: Kooxo hubeysan ayaa Sabtidan weerar ku qaaday Degmada Qoryooley ee Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose, halkaas oo la sheegay inay iska horimaad kula galeen Daraawiishta Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in kooxahan ay isku dayeen in ay isku fidiyaan degmada, balse ay ka hor istaaggeen Ciidamada Koonfur Galbeed. Warar is khilaafsan ayaa ka soo baxaya, waxa ay yihiin kooxda weerarka ku qaadday degmadaasi ee markii dambe dib looga saaray. Wararka qaar ayaa sheegaya in ay yihiin maleeshiyaad qaab beeleed u abaabulan, halka warar kalena ay sheegayaan in ay yihiin ciidamo taabacsan maamulka la magac-baxay Koonfur Bari, oo sheegtay in ay yihiin garab ka go’ay Koonfur Galbeed. Dadka deegaanka qaarkood ayaa laga soo xigtay in laba maleeshiyo beeleed ay ku dagaalameen gudaha degmada, maleeshiyo horey u joogtay degmada iyo mid dibadda ka soo duushay. Hase yeeshee Gudoomiyaha Degmada Qoryooley, Cabdi Axmed Cali oo mar dambe ka hadlay iska horimaadka ka dhacay degmadiisa ayaa ku waramay in ciidamo ka tirsan Koonfur Bari ay maanta soo weerareen Qoryooley. “Dagaalku wuxuu salka ku hayaa niman Koonfur Bari sheeganayo oo deegaanadan inay isku fidiyaan rabaan oo saldhiggooda uu Marka yahay.” Ayuu yiri Gudoomiyaha oo Universaltv la hadlay. Gudoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in Qoryooley ay ku sugan yihiin ciidan xoog leh oo ka tirsan Koonfur Galbeed, isla-markaana aysan qabsan karin koox dibadda ka soo duushay. Taliyaha Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ee Degmada Qoryooley, Gaashaanle Cali Maxamed Aadan (Cali Waal) ayaa isna sheegay in ciidamada soo weeraray degmadaasi ay ka tirsan yihiin sida uu yiri Koonfur Bari. “Ciidanka magaalada soo weeraray Koonfur Bari ayaa la dhahaa.” Ayuu yiri Taliyaha oo intaasi ku daray “Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed iyagana way iska caabiyeen.” Taliyaha ayaa ka digay “Annaga nabadda waan jecel nahay, Koonfur Galbeed baana nahay. Koonfur Galbeed cid kasta oo ka soo horjeeddo tallaabo ayaan ka qaadaynaa.” Gaashaanle Cali Waal ayaa sheegay in uu arkay meydka hal nin oo dagaalka ku dhintay, kaas oo uu xusay inuu ka tirsanaa ciidamadii soo weeraray magaalada. Degmada Qoryooley ayaa waxaa sanadihii u dambeeyay ku soo badanayay iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya laba maleeshiyo beeleed oo deegaanka ah, kuwaas oo aad mooddo in ay ku loolamayaan awoodda maamulka. Qoryooley waa mid ka mid ah Degmooyinka Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose ee ugu dadka badan, taas oo qiyaastii 120km dhinaca koonfureed uga beegan Caasimadda Muqdisho.

items.title: Maxay ka wada-hadleen Xasan iyo Al-Sisi? + Sawirro
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta kulan gaar ah la qaatay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Carabta ee Masar, Mudane Cabdulfataax Al-Sisi, intii uu socday shir madaxeedka Madasha Ganacsiga Afrika ee ka socda magaalada cusub ee Al-Calamayn. Xasan iyo Al-Sisi ayaa kulankooda kaga wada-hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga taariikhiga ah ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Masar, iyaga oo si gaar ah diiradda u saaray dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, maalgashiga, ganacsiga iyo horumarinta iskaashiga labada dal. items.title: Sheekh Cali Wajiis: Ugaaska Xawaadle howl aan aheyn howshiisa ayuu galay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Sheekh Cali Maxamuud Xasan (Wajiis) oo kamid ah Culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa si kulul uga hadlay xaaladda HirShabelle, gaar ahaan xiisadda ka taagan magaalada Beledweyne ee ka dhalatay doorashooyinkii ka dhacay halkaasi. Sheekh Cali Wajiis oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Telefishinka Somali Cable ayaa eedeyn culus u jeediyay Ugaaska Beesha Xawaadle, Ugaas Yuusuf Ugaas Xasan Ugaas Khaliif oo isaga iyo siyaasiyiin kale ay haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wadaan magaalada Beledweyne, wuxuuna sheegay inuu gacmaha la galay arrimo uusan shaqo ku lahayn, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Ugaaska Xawaadle howl aan aheyn howshiisa ayuu galay, Ugaaska doorashooyin inuu galo ma ahan, mana loogu talagelin, Imaamka Mudulood iyo Ugaaska Mudulood oo doorasho ka hadlayo ma aragtay?,” ayuu wareysiga ku yiri Sheekh Cali Wajiis. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in doorka dhaqanka uu yahay inuu hoggaamiyo bulshada, sidoo kalena uu la shaqeeyo dowladda Soomaaliya. “Qaylada siyaasi ayaa iska leh waa nin u-gaarsada ah shabaq ayuu tuuranayaa waxbaa ugu soo dhacaayo dowladda ayuu rabaa inuu rux-ruxdo, laakiin dhaqan sidiisa waa dhowrsan yahay qabiil ayuuna hoggaamiyaa dowladdana waa la taliyaa,” ayuu mar kale yiri Sheekha. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii daray “Dhiiqo ayaa lala doonaayay Ugaaska, laakiin nasiib wanaag waa ka badbaaday lama gelin. Niman siyaasiyiin ah ayaa waxa ay rabeen in kaarka Ugaaska ay xoqdaan balse arrintaan Ugaaska ugu dmabeyn ka gaabsaday”. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, xilli ay weli tabasho qabto beesha Xawaadle oo ka hortimid sida loo wajahay doorashooyinkii dhawaan ka dhacay HirShabelle, kadib markii kaarka musharaxnimada ee JSP la siiyay Cali Guudlaawe oo mar kale u taagan xilka madaxweynaha. The post Sheekh Cali Wajiis: Ugaaska Xawaadle howl aan aheyn howshiisa ayuu galay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Steven Cook oo Sharraxay Sababaha Qaddiyadda Somaliland ay Muhiim Ugu Tahay Danaha Maraykanka
items.description: Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) oo soo bandhigtay sida Aqoonsigga Somaliland muhiim ugu yahay Danaha Maraykan Khabhiir isku Xidhay Danaha Istiraatiijiga ah ee Maraykanka iyo Aqoonsiga Somaliland Steven Cook, oo ah khabiir ka tirsan Golaha Xidhiidhka Dibadda ee Maraykanka (Council on Foreign Relations – CFR), isla markaana ku takhasusay arrimaha Bariga Dhexe iyo Afrika, ayaa sharraxay sababta qaddiyadda madax-bannaanida Somaliland ay muhiim ugu noqon karto danaha Maraykanka. Cook waxa uu si gaar ah u tilmaamay taariikhda Somaliland iyo goobta istiraatiijiga ah ee ay ku taallo. Steven xusay in Somaliland ay ku taallo Gacanka Cadmeed, oo ka soo horjeedda Yemen, isla markaana ay aad ugu dhaw marinka Baabul-Mandab, oo ah marin-biyood muhiim u ah isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Cook waxa uu sheegay in aqoonsiga Somaliland uu Washington u yeelan karo faa’iidooyin istiraatiiji ah, gaar ahaan dhinaca amniga iyo danaha juqraafi-siyaasadeed ee Maraykanka. Waxa uu xusay in Somaliland ay haysato deked leh biyo-qoto-dheer iyo garoon diyaaraaradeed (runway) aad u dheer, kuwaas oo, sida uu sheegay, noqon kara kaabayaal muhiim u ah danaha amni ee Maraykanka, isla markaana gacan ka geysan kara haddii loo baahdo hawlgallo ka dhan ah khatarta amni ee ka iman kara gobolka. Steven Cook waxa kale oo uu sheegay inay muuqato xiiso ka jirta gudah aWashington oo ku saabsan qaddiyadda madax-bannaanida Somaliland. Waxa uu xusay in Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), intii uu ku guda jiray safarkiisii Washington, D.C. iyo New York, uu la kulmay saraakiil ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Maraykanka, xubno ka tirsan Kongareeska iyo dhinacyo kale oo saamayn ku leh siyaasadda Maraykanka. Sida uu Cook sheegay, kulamadaasi waxay qayb ka ahaayeen dadaallada dibblumaasiyadeed ee lagu doonayo in Maraykanka lagu qanciyo inuu noqdo dalkii labaad ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada madax-bannaanida Somaliland. Cook waxa uu dooddiisa ku salaynayaa in goobta juqraafiyeed ee Somaliland, dekedda Berbera, marinka Baabul-Mandab iyo xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas ay Somaliland siinayaan muhiimad istiraatiiji ah oo sii kordhaysa marka laga eego danaha Maraykanka. Waxa uu sidoo kale xusay taariikhda Somaliland iyo sida ay 1991-kii ugu dhawaaqday inay dib ula soo noqotay madax-bannaanideeda, kadib markii ay burburtay dowladdii dhexe ee Soomaaliya. Steven Cook oo ka hadlayay xarunta Golaha Xidhiidhka Dibadda ee Maraykanka (Council on Foreign Relations – CFR), ee dalka Maraykanka, ayaa hadalkiisa ku bilaabay sidany “Hogaamiyahan caalamiga ah ayaa booqday xarunta Golaha Xiriirka Arrimaha Dibadda (Council on Foreign Relations) ee magaalada New York. Waa hogaamiyaha Somaliland. Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi, oo si weyn loogu yaqaanno “Cirro”, ayaa safar laba toddobaad ah ku maray Washington, D.C. iyo New York. Wuxuu la kulmay saraakiil ka tirsan Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka, xubno ka tirsan Koongareeska, iyo dad kale. Wuxuu doonayaa in Mareykanku noqdo dalkii labaad ee aqoonsada Somaliland, waxaana muuqata inay jirto xiise loo qabo arrintaas oo gudaha Washington ah” Cook waxa kale oo uu intaas ku daray “Somaliland waxay ku dhawaaqday madax-bannaanideeda sannadkii 1991-kii, waxayna tan iyo markaas u shaqeynaysay sidii dal madax-bannaan. Dalkii ugu horreeyay ee aqoonsada madax-bannaanida Somaliland ayaa noqday Israel oo sidaas samaysay dabayaaqadii sannadkii 2025-kii. Halkan waxaa ku cad sababta ay arrinta madax-bannaanida Somaliland muhiim ugu tahay Mareykanka. Haddii aad eegto khariidadda, Somaliland waxay ku taallaa meel istiraatiiji ah oo ka soo horjeedda Yemen dhanka kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed. Somaliland waxay leedahay deked biyo qoto dheer leh iyo waddo diyaaradeed (runway) aad u dheer, taas oo ay isticmaali karaan ciidamada Mareykanka haddii ay u baahdaan inay qaadaan hawlgal amni.”

items.title: Xamza oo ka hadlay wada-hadal la sheegay inuu dhex-maray DF iyo Al-Shabaab
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa beeniyey wararka sheegaya in dowladda federaalka ay wada-hadallo ama heshiis toos ah la gashay kooxda Al-Shabaab, isaga oo sheegay in xiriir noocaas ah uusan hadda ka dhexeyn labada dhinac. Xamza, oo wareysi siiyey barnaamijka Miizaan Podcast ee Dawan Media, ayaa sheegay in mowqifka dowladda uu yahay in dalka laga xoreeyo Al-Shabaab, balse ay diyaar u tahay inay wadahadal la yeelato cid kasta oo ka tanaasusha fikirka iyo dagaalka kooxda. “Wada-hadal lama gelin, xiriirna nagama dhaxeeyo. Waxa naga dhexeeya waa xoreynta dalka,” ayuu yiri ra’iisul wasaare Xamza. “Qofkii wada-hadal doonaya ee jidkaas ka soo baxa diyaar ayaan u nahay. Wada-hadal weligeen ma diidin, waan la hadleynaa, waana soo dhoweyneynaa,” ayuu raaciyey. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in xubnaha Al-Shabaab ay dib uga mid noqon karaan bulshada Soomaaliyeed haddii ay joojiyaan dilalka, kana tanaasulaan dagaalka ay kula jiraan dowladda. “Maalinta ay dilka joojiyaan oo ay dowladdooda aqbalaan waxay noqonayaan walaalaheen,” ayuu yiri. Xamza ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyey in isaga iyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud midkoodna uusan wada-hadal toos ah la yeelan Al-Shabaab. Hadalladiisa ayaa jawaab u ah warar iyo eedo muddooyinkii dambe soo noqnoqday oo ku saabsan inay jiraan xiriirro ama is-afgaradyo qarsoodi ah oo dhex maray dowladda federaalka iyo kooxda. Eedaha lacagaha amniga Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay eedo sheegaya in dowladda ay lacago bixisay ama laaluush adeegsatay si ay u hesho xasillooni amni. Xamza ayaa beeniyey in dowladdiisu wax lacag ah siisay Al-Shabaab si loo yareeyo weerarrada ama loo gaaro heshiis dhinaca amniga ah. Wuxuu sheegay in dadka faafinaya eedahaas ay ku jiraan shaqsiyaad ay dowladdu ka shakisan tahay inay xiriir la leeyihiin Al-Shabaab, inkastoo uusan soo bandhigin caddeymo faahfaahsan oo arrintaas ku saabsan. Siyaasiyiin ayaa marar qaar sheegay in ay jiraann xiriirro u dhexeeya dowladda iyo Al-Shabaab, taas oo sababtay in ay yaraadaan qaraxyada Muqdisho. Si kastaba, sheegashooyinkaas ayaa badankood waxaa sameeyey dad xiriir la leh ama ka tirsanaa dowladdii madaxweyne Farmaajo, taasi oo loo arkay mid ay isaga leexinayaan sidii ay ugu fashilmeen sugidda amniga caasimadda. Dowladda federaalka ayaa si joogto ah u beenisay eedahaas, iyadoo ku adkeysaneysa in dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab uu weli yahay mid ka mid ah mudnaanta ugu weyn ee dhinaca amniga. The post Xamza oo ka hadlay wada-hadal la sheegay inuu dhex-maray DF iyo Al-Shabaab appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Xamza ayaa beeniyey in dowladdiisu wax lacag ah siisay Al-Shabaab si loo yareeyo weerarrada ama loo gaaro heshiis dhinaca amniga ah. Wuxuu sheegay in dadka faafinaya eedahaas ay ku jiraan shaqsiyaad ay dowladdu ka shakisan tahay inay xiriir la leeyihiin Al-Shabaab, inkastoo uusan soo bandhigin caddeymo faahfaahsan oo arrintaas ku saabsan. Siyaasiyiin ayaa marar qaar sheegay in ay jiraann xiriirro u dhexeeya dowladda iyo Al-Shabaab, taas oo sababtay in ay yaraadaan qaraxyada Muqdisho. Dowladda federaalka ayaa si joogto ah u beenisay eedahaas, iyadoo ku adkeysaneysa in dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab uu weli yahay mid ka mid ah mudnaanta ugu weyn ee dhinaca amniga. items.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo ka hadlaysa xaaladda sii xumaanaysa ee Itoobiya
items.description: New York – 3 Oktoobar 2026: Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa qorsheynaya inuu yeesho wadatashi xiran oo looga hadlayo xaaladda sii xumaanaysa ee waqooyiga Itoobiya, gaar ahaan dagaallada ka socda gobolka Tigray iyo khatarta ay colaadahaasi ku yeelan karaan xasilloonida Geeska Afrika. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay inay si weyn uga walaacsan tahay kororka dagaallada, gaar ahaan adeegsiga drones iyo duqeymaha cirka, kuwaas oo khatar ku haya shacabka, kaabayaasha muhiimka ah iyo hawlaha gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Xogta Qaramada Midoobay waxay sidoo kale muujinaysaa in xaaladda amni ay si gaar ah u adkeyneyso howlgallada gargaarka ee Tigray, iyadoo hay’adaha bani’aadannimada ay dalbanayaan in loo oggolaado inay si ammaan ah oo aan caqabad lahayn u gaaraan dadka u baahan taageerada. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kadib markii Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ay xiriirkooda diblomaasiyadeed si weyn u xumeeyeen, iyadoo Itoobiya ay xirtay safaaraddeeda Asmara, halka Eritrea ay ku dhawaaqday inay jartay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Itoobiya. Qaramada Midoobay waxay horey ugu baaqday dhammaan dhinacyada inay muujiyaan is-xakameyn, yareeyaan xiisadda, ilaaliyaan shacabka, isla markaana dib ugu laabtaan wadahadalka iyadoo la adeegsanayo qaab-dhismeedka heshiiskii Pretoria ee 2022. Walaaca ugu weyn ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ah in dagaalka Tigray uu ka gudbi karo xuduudaha Itoobiya, taasoo khatar gelin karta nabadda iyo xasilloonida guud ee Geeska Afrika.

items.title: Maxa DF ka tiri weerarka lagu qaaday xarunta korontada siisa Masjidka Nabiga SCW?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si kulul u cambaareysay weerarka lagu qaaday xarunta korontada siisa Masjidka Nabiga (NNKH) ee magaalada Madiinah, taas oo ay beegsadeen kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee dagaalka kula jirta Sacuudiga. Bayaan ksoo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay in weerarkaas uu meel ka dhac ku yahay karaamada iyo xurmada goobaha Barakeysan ee Boqotooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. “Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee JFS waxay si adag u cambaareyneysaa weerarka lagu qaaday xarun koronto taas oo bixisa adeegga korontada ee Masjidka Nabiga (NNKH) ee magaalada Madiinah, Boqortooyada aan walaalaha nahay ee Sacuudi Carabiya. Wasaaraddu waxay u aragtaa weerarkaan lagu qaaday kaabayaasha rayidka ah ee u adeegaya mid ka mid ah goobaha ugu barakeysan Islaamka inuu meel ka dhac ku yahay karaamada iyo xurmada Goobaha Barakeysan,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Sidoo kale, waxaa warsaxaafadeedka lagu sheegay in falkan uu xadgudub ku yahay sharciga caalamiga ah iyo madaxbannaanida Dalka Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. Dowladda Soomaaiya ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday inay si buuxda u garab taagan tahay Dowladda iyo shacabka Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. “Soomaaliya waxay taageereysaa dadaallada Boqortooyada Sacuudiga ku ilaalinayso madaxbannaanideeda iyo amnigeeda, iyo sidoo kale badbaadada muwaadiniinteeda, dadka deggan iyo ku soo booqanaya goobaha barakeysan,” aya mar kale lagu yiri qoraalka. Waxaa kale oo uu bayaanka kusii daray “Iyadoo Soomaaliya ay xubin ka tahay Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC), waxay si cad u diiddan tahay dhammaan falalka khatarta ku ah xasilloonida gobolka, waxayna ku baaqeysaa in lala xisaabtamo cid kasta oo ka dambeysa weerarkan. Sacuudiga ayaa ka mid ah dalalka Carbeed ee xiriirka wanaagsan la leh Soomaaliya, iyadoo labada dal ay leeyihiin xiriir ku saleysan iskaashi dhinacyo badan leh, gaar ahaan arrimaha dhaqaalaha, horumarinta, waxbarashada iyo gargaarka bani’aadamnimo. items.title: Ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya oo dib ula wareegay garoonka Mekelle
items.description: Addis Ababa – 3 Oktoobar 2026: Ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya iyo maleeshiyaad taageersan dowladda ayaa la sheegay inay dib ula wareegeen Garoonka Diyaaradaha Alula Aba Nega ee magaalada Mekelle, caasimadda gobolka Tigray, xilli dagaallo xooggan ay ka socdaan waqooyiga dalka. Warbaahinta Reuters ayaa sheegtay in ilo xog-ogaal ah iyo ilo bani’aadamnimo ay xaqiijiyeen in ciidamada dowladda ay gacanta ku dhigeen garoonka, oo qiyaastii 10 kiiloomitir u jira bartamaha Mekelle. Ciidamada nabada Tigray, oo ay taageerto dowladda federaalka, ayaa sheegtay inay si buuxda ula wareegtay garoonka ayna waddo howlgallo ay magaalada Mekelle ku nadiifinayso. Reuters waxay xustay in sheegashadaas aanay si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin xilliga warbixinta la qorayay. Dagaallada u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo isbahaysi hubeysan oo uu hoggaaminayo TPLF ayaa dib uga qarxay Tigray 23-kii Sebtembar, waxaana loo arkaa inay yihiin xiisaddii ugu xoogganayd tan iyo dagaalkii 2020–2022. Ilo deegaanka ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in rasaas laga maqlayay gudaha Mekelle, halka qaar ka mid ah dagaalyahannada Tigray ay ka baxeen fariisimahooda. Qabsashada garoonka Mekelle waxay noqon kartaa isbeddel muhiim ah oo militari, balse falanqeeyayaal ayaa sheegay in aysan taasi ka dhignayn in dagaalku dhammaaday, iyadoo ay weli jiraan ciidamo iyo kooxo hubeysan oo ka dagaallamaya qaybo ka mid ah Tigray.

items.title: Sagaal Soomaali ah oo Guantánamo lagu hayay ayaa loo soo masaafuriyey Soomaaliya
items.description: Hay’adaha socdaalka Mareykanka ayaa sagaal nin oo Soomaali ah ka masaafuriyey Guantánamo Bay, Cuba, una diray Soomaaliya, waxaana dadka la masaafuriyey ku jiray saddex qof oo ka soo jeeda gobolka Minnesota. Dadka diyaaradda gaarka ah lagu qaaday toddobaadkii hore waxaa ka mid ahaa Adam Mohamed Abdullah iyo Hassan Abtidoon. Labadooda iyo ragga kale ayaa muddo ku dhow bil lagu hayay xarumaha lagu hayo dadka ee Mareykanka ee ku yaalla Guantánamo, ka hor inta aan loo masaafurin Soomaaliya. Wareysiyo looga qaaday Guantánamo ayaa muujinaya in maxaabiistu sheegeen in saraakiil ka tirsan Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Dhaqangelinta Kastamyada Mareykanka (ICE) ay ku wargeliyeen in laga masaafurinayo Louisiana loona dirayo Soomaaliya, iyadoo Cuba loo sii marinayo si diyaaradda shidaal loogu shubo. Masaafurintan ayaa timid xilli ay sii kordhayaan walaacyada laga qabo habka ay dowladda Mareykanku u maamusho dadka aan haysan sharciyadda joogitaanka, gaar ahaan kuwa lagu hayo xarumaha ka baxsan dhulka Mareykanka.

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada Koonfur Galbeed oo ka shiray amniga iyo geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta
items.description: Baydhabo, 3 Oktoobar 2026 – Golaha Wasiirrada maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa maanta kulan ku yeeshay magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoo uu shir-guddoomiyay Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe). Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xaaladda guud ee amniga deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, xoojinta nabadgelyada iyo dardargelinta geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada. Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa qiimeeyay xaaladda amni ee deegaannada maamulka, waxaana diiradda lagu saaray dadaallada lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha amniga iyo bulshada. Sidoo kale, kulanka ayaa si qoto dheer looga hadlay gogosha iyo geeddi-socodka dib-u-heshiisiinta Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo la adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay wada-hadal loo dhan yahay, is-afgarad siyaasadeed iyo bulsho, iyo in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo hannaan nabadeed oo ku dhisan wada-tashi. Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa sheegay in nabadgelyada, midnimada bulshada iyo dib-u-heshiisiintu ay yihiin tiirarka aas-aaska u ah xasilloonida iyo horumarka Koonfur Galbeed. Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto dadaallada lagu mideynayo bulshada, xoojinayo nabadgelyada iyo horumarinta dowladnimada.

items.title: Ciidamada Itoobiya oo la wareegay garoonka Mekelle, kun dhawaaqay…
items.description: Mekelle (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay howlgallo nadiifin ah ka wadaan gudaha magaalada Mekelle ee caasimadda gobolka Tigray, sida ay waxyar ka hor baahisay Reuters. Dhankeeda Wakaaladda wararka ee AFP, ayaa werisay in ciidanka Itoobiya iyo kooxaha taageersan ay sidoo kale maalintii labaad maamulayaan garoonka diyaaradaha Mekelle ee Alula Aba Nega, halka saldhigyada iyo xarumaha kale ee dowladda ee ku yaalla Mekelle ay haawanayaan, markii magaalada ay isaga baxeen ciidamada kooxda TPLF. Warbixinta AFP, ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay la wareegista ciidanka taageersan dawladda Itoobiya ee Mekelle, inay ka dhigantahay burbur gaaray TPLF, oo mar kale u muuqata dagaallo ay iskudayeen si deg deg ah inay ula wareegaan gobolka Tigray oo ay cadaadiyaan dawladda Abiy, in looga adkaaday, taasoo dib gacan sareynta ugu soo celinaysa xukuumadda Abiy Axmed. Xaaladdii toddobaadyo ka hor loo arkayay inay khatar gelinayso maamulka Abiy, markii TPLF ay 23 bishii September dib u bilowday dagaalka ayaa hadda u muuqata in meesha laga saaray , isla markaana TPLF iyo qorshihii ay ku mideeyeen kooxaha kale ee ka soo horjeeda xukuumadda Addis Ababa in iska caabin lagu joojiyay oo cadaadiska lagu soo celiyay dhinaca TPLF oo hadda dib ugu guranaya dhulka miyiga iyo buuralayda ah ee gobolka Tigray, halka goobaha TPLF ay ka gaareen gobolka Cafarta ay si dhaqso ah u luminayaan gacan ku heyntooda, taasoo dhabarka u saaraysa guul-darro kale , halka ay xasilloonida dib ugu soo laabanayo Addis Ababa. Dagaalkan ayaa waji kale galaya , haddii ciidanka Itoobiya ay u dhaqaaqaan dhinaca xadka Eritrea, iyadoo goobaha uu isha ku hayo Abiy ay ku jirto Adigrat oo loo tixgeliyo magaalada weyn ee Itoobiya ee ugu dhow xadka Eritrea, waana marin muhiim ah oo u jihaysan Eritrea iyo Badda Cas, taasoo cadaadis saaraysa Eritrea, oo ay dawladda Itoobiya ku eedeysay inay taageerto TPLF oo hadda lumisay xakameynta dagaalka. Si kastaba, h orumarkan ayaa imaanaya kaddib markii ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya iyo maleeshiyaadka taageera ay maalmihii la soo dhaafay guulo degdeg ah ka gaareen gudaha Tigray, halkaas oo dagaal culus uu toddobaadkii hore ka dhex qarxay dowladda iyo isbahaysi hubeysan oo ay hoggaamineyso Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF). Dagaallada hadda socda ayaa kusoo laabtay Tigray afar sano kaddib markii heshiiskii Pretoria uu hakiyey colaad ay ku dhinteen boqollaal kun oo qof, malaayiin kalena ay guryahooda uga barakaceen. Hase yeeshee, isbeddelka xulafeysi ee gobolka — gaar ahaan kala fogaanshaha Itoobiya iyo Eritrea iyo xiisadda sii kordheysa ee Addis Ababa kala dhexeysa Masar iyo Sudan — ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca ah in dagaalka cusub uusan ku ekaan gudaha Itoobiya. items.title: Mareykanka oo kordhiyey masaafurinta Soomaalida iyo 500 qof oo Minnesota lagu…
items.description: Minneapolis (Caasimada Online) — Tirada Soomaalida ku nool gobolka Minnesota ee lagu amray in laga masaafuriyo Mareykanka ayaa si weyn kor ugu kacday sanadkan, iyadoo in ka badan 500 oo qof ay heleen amarro masaafurin, taas oo ku dhow toban jibbaar tiradii sanadkii 2025. Wargeyska Minnesota Star Tribune , oo falanqeeyay xogta dowladda federaalka, ayaa sheegay in guud ahaan in ka badan 1,000 Soomaali magangelyo-doon ah lagu amray inay ka baxaan Mareykanka tan iyo bishii February, kuwaas oo in ka badan kala bar ay ku nool yihiin Minnesota. Qaar ka mid ah dadkaas ayaa durba laga masaafuriyey Mareykanka, halka kuwo kalena loo wareejiyey xarumo lagu hayo dadka socdaalka, oo ay ku jirto xarunta ciidamada Mareykanka ee Guantánamo Bay ee Cuba, sida uu qoray wargeysku. Kororka ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu dedejiyey dacwadaha magangelyo-doonka, isla markaana uu yareeyey qaar ka mid ah waddooyinkii sharci ee Soomaalida u oggolaanayey inay sii joogaan Mareykanka. Inta badan Soomaalida Minnesota waa muwaadiniin Mareykan ah, waxay haystaan sharci ay dalka ku joogaan ama waxay ku jiraan habraaca codsiga magangelyada, sida ay sheegtay Star Tribune . Minnesota waxaa ku nool bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee ugu weyn Mareykanka. Bishii February, maamulka Trump ayaa bilaabay nidaam dacwooyin degdeg ah oo loo bixiyey “rocket docket”, kaas oo garsoorayaasha socdaalka u oggolaanaya inay internet-ka ku qaadaan dacwadaha la xiriira muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed. Star Tribune ayaa sheegtay in tallaabadaasi ay qareennada socdaalka ku khasabtay inay muddo gaaban ku diyaariyaan dacwado markii hore loo qorsheeyey sannad ama ka badan kadib. Ku dhowaad dhammaan go’aannada masaafurinta Soomaalida ee siddeedii bilood ee ugu horreeyey sanadkan ayaa kasoo baxay nidaamkaas degdegga ah, sida uu wargeysku sheegay. Qareenno ku takhasusay arrimaha socdaalka ayaa Star Tribune u sheegay inay tahay arrin aan hore loo arag in maxkamadaha socdaalka loo sameeyo jadwal dacwadeed si gaar ah ugu wajahan dad kasoo jeeda hal waddan. Waxay sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyeen in dadka magangelyo-doonka ahi aysan helin waqti ku filan oo ay ku diyaariyaan dacwadahooda. Afhayeen u hadlay maxkamadaha socdaalka ayaa dhinaca kale sheegay in nidaamku mudnaan siinayo “in dacwadaha lagu soo gabagabeeyo waqtigooda”, isaga oo xusay in sharciga federaalka uu dhigayo in codsiyada magangelyada lagu go’aamiyo 180 maalmood gudahood. “Dib-u-dhac aan loo baahnayn wuxuu dhaawacayaa dadka leh dacwadaha saxda ah iyo shacabka Mareykanka ee doonaya in dadka aan lahayn dacwado sax ah sida ugu dhaqsaha badan dalka looga saaro,” ayuu afhayeenku u sheegay Star Tribune . Wargeysku wuxuu sheegay in qiyaastii 2.3 milyan oo codsi magangelyo ah ay weli ku jiraan maxkamadaha socdaalka ee Mareykanka. DhammaadkaTPS Maamulka Trump ayaa sidoo kale 17-kii March soo afjaray barnaamijka Temporary Protected Status (TPS) ee Soomaaliya, kaas oo qaar ka mid ah Soomaalida siinayey ilaalin ku-meel-gaar ah oo ka hortageysay in la masaafuriyo. Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay inay qiimeyn kadib ku soo gabagabeysay in Soomaaliya aysan mar dambe buuxin shuruudaha sharci ee barnaamijka TPS. Joojinta TPS-ka si toos ah ugama dhigna in qof kasta oo horay barnaamijka uga tirsanaa la masaafurinayo. Dadka haysta sharci kale oo ay Mareykanka ku joogaan way sii joogi karaan, halka codsiyada magangelyada iyo noocyada kale ee ilaalinta sharciyeed lagu go’aamiyo hannaan gooni ah. DHS ayaa sheegtay in 1,082 qof ay haysteen TPS-ka Soomaaliya bishii December 2025, halka 1,383 codsi oo kale ay weli sugayeen go’aan. Dhanka kale, qaar ka mid ah Soomaalida laga saarayo Mareykanka ayaa loo sii marsiiyey dalal kale. Caasimada Online ayaa hore u werisay in Soomaali lagu hayay Guantánamo Bay, halka Star Tribune ay sheegtay in ugu yaraan laba qof oo kasoo jeeda Minnesota ay ka mid ahaayeen Soomaalidii halkaas loo wareejiyey. Qareen Marc Prokosch, oo matalay afar nin oo Guantánamo lagu hayay, ayaa tallaabadaas ku tilmaamay “xeelad cabsi-gelin siyaasadeed”. Afarta nin ayaa ku dhowaad bil ku qaatay Guantánamo ka hor inta aan loo qaadin Kenya. Prokosch ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah raggaasi uu markii dambe gaaray Muqdisho. Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Kastamka Mareykanka ee ICE ayaa difaacday in dadka qaar loo masaafuriyo dal saddexaad, iyadoo sheegtay in heshiisyada noocaas ahi gacan ka geystaan fulinta amarada masaafurinta. Muranka ku saabsan masaafurinta Soomaalida ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmaya iyadoo hay’adaha dowladda Mareykanka ay bixiyeen qiimeynno kala duwan oo ku saabsan xaaladda amni ee Soomaaliya. Star Tribune ayaa sheegtay in saraakiil ka tirsan Waaxda Amniga Gudaha iyo Waaxda Cadaaladda ay maxkamadaha socdaalka u gudbiyeen qoraallo ay ku doodayaan in xaaladda Soomaaliya ay saamaxeyso in qaar ka mid ah Soomaalida dib loogu celiyo dalka. Hase yeeshee, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka waxay Soomaaliya weli ku haysaa heerka ugu sarreeya ee digniinta safarka, Level 4: Do Not Travel , iyadoo sabab uga dhigaysa argagixiso, afduub, dambiyo iyo xaalado amni-darro. Kala duwanaanshaha qiimeyntaas ayaa hadda qeyb ka noqday doodaha sharci ee ku saabsan in Soomaalida wajahaya masaafurinta si ammaan ah dib loogu celin karo Soomaaliya.
