items.title: Dhacdo Dhab Ah Mise Masrax Siyaasadeed? Shakiga Sii Kordhaya oo Ku Gadaaman Dhacdadii Flydubai
items.description: Kaddib wararka sheegaya in iska-horimaad ka dhacay qolka duuliyeyaasha ee diyaarad Flydubai ah oo ku sii jeedday Tel Aviv, halkaas oo kaaliyaha duuliyaha lagu eedeeyey inuu mindi ku dhuftay kabtanka, dabadeedna diyaaraddu gashay hoobasho musiibo keeni kartay. Inkasta oo warbaahinta waaweyn ay dhacdada u soo bandhigeen sida sheeko halyeeynimo, badbaado mucjiso leh iyo adkaysi ka dhan ah argagixisada, haddana falanqeeyayaasha duulista, dadka baraha bulshada wax ku qora iyo indha-indheeyayaasha caalamiga ah ayaa isweydiinaya in dhacdadu ahayd masrax siyaasadeed oo la soo agaasimay. Sheekada dadweynaha loo soo bandhigay waxay sheegaysaa in kaaliyaha duuliyuhu mindi ku weeraray kabtanka, isagoo diyaaradda Boeing-ka ah hoos u dhigay qiyaastii 20,000 oo feet wax ka yar hal daqiiqo, xawaaraheeduna kor u dhaafay 700 mayl saacaddii. Sida sheekadu tilmaamayso, kabtanka oo dhaawac halis ah qaba ayaa haddana ku guuleystay inuu furo albaabka ammaanka adag leh, taasoo u saamaxday rakaabka oo ay ku jireen farsamo-yaqaan tuubooyinka ah oo fasax ku jiray iyo duuliyeyaal shaqo kale u safrayey iney qolka duuliyeyaasha galaan, weeraryahanka ka adkaadaan, diyaaradda xakameeyaan, dabadeedna si nabad ah ugu weeciyaan Sacuudiga. Dad badan ayaa ku doodaya in sheekadani ka hor imaanayso mabaadi’da cilmiga hawada iyo xaqiiqada duulista ee la hirgeliyey wixii ka dambeeyey weerarradii 11-kii Sebteembar. Duuliyaha ganacsiga Aaron Murphy, oo dhacdada ku tijaabiyey qalabka jilidda duulimaadka ee CNN, ayaa tilmaamay in diyaarad ku degaysa ku dhowaad 20,000 oo feet qiyaastii 35 ilbiriqsi, iyadoo ku socota xawaare ka badan 700 mayl saacaddii, ay la kulmi lahayd xoogag hawadeed oo kala goyn kara. Fikradda ah in jirka diyaaradda rakaabku u adkeysan karo culayskaas iyada oo aan burbur weyn gaarin ama aysan lumin qaybaha muhiimka ah ee lagu hago ayaa duuliyeyaal badan ku dhalisay shaki. Muuqaallada gudaha diyaaradda laga duubay ayaa muujinaya rakaab si caadi ah u taagan, wax u duubaya ama marinnada dhex socda, halka hoobasho xawaare sare leh ay caadi ahaan keeni lahayd xoogag G oo taban iyo gariir ka dhigaya in qofku istaago ama qolka duuliyeyaasha u socdo arrin aad u adag. Dadka dhacdada falanqeynaya waxay sidoo kale xuseen in hoobasho baaxaddaas leh ay sababi kartay dhibaatooyin cadaadiska hawada ah iyo soo dhicidda maaskarooyinka oksijiinta, balse muuqaalladu waxay muujinayeen armaajooyinka kore oo xiran iyo maaskarooyinka oo aan soo bixin. Intaa waxaa dheer, albaabbada qolka duuliyeyaasha ee diyaaradaha casriga ah waxay leeyihiin xaqiijin dhowr heer ah iyo qufullo adag; sidaas darteed, sheegashada ah in kabtan dhaawacmay oo weerar ku socda uu furay koodhka albaabka ayaa sii kordhisay shakiga. Joogitaanka laba duuliye oo kayd ah, faragelinta degdegga ah ee qof rakaabka ka mid ahaa iyo dhacdada oo isla markiiba loo adeegsaday xoojinta farriimo siyaasadeed iyo kuwo amni ayaa dadka dhaliilaya ku kallifay inay ku tilmaamaan “sheeko Hollywood” iyo masrax siyaasadeed. Iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan baaqyada lagu dalbanayo xogta aan la tafatirin ee qalabka duuba xogta duulimaadka FDRiyo codadka qolka duuliyeyaasha, ayaa sheekada rasmiga ahi waxay sii wajahaysaa su’aalo culus. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Halkii loo arki lahaa oo keliya dhacdo halyeeynimo hawada ka dhacday, waxay dunida hor dhigtay su’aasha ah in habraacyadii ammaanka duulista dhab ahaan la jebiyey iyo in kale, ama in riwaayadda cirka ka dhacday loo sameeyey dhagaystayaal kale oo dhulka joogay.

items.title: Dagaalka Cusub ee Itoobiya Ma Abuuri Karaa Firaaq Amni oo Soomaaliya Ka Dhasha?
items.description: Dagaalka dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya ayaa dhalinaya walaac ku saabsan mustaqbalka ciidamada Itoobiya ee ka hawlgala Soomaaliya. Warbixin ay Bloomberg baahisay ayaa sheegtay in Addis Ababa ay qorshaynayso inay Soomaaliya kala baxdo in ka badan 3,000 oo askari, si loogu adeegsado dagaalka gudaha Itoobiya, inkasta oo dowladda Soomaaliya aysan weli helin ogeysiis rasmi ah. Ciidamada Itoobiya waxay Soomaaliya uga hawlgalaan laba nidaam: qaar waxay ka tirsan yihiin Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, halka kuwo kalena ay dalka ku joogaan heshiisyo laba geesood ah. Waxay fariisimo muhiim ah ku leeyihiin gobollada Bay, Bakool, Hiiraan iyo deegaanno ku dhow xadka, waxaana dhowaan la beddelay cutubyo AUSSOM ka tirsan oo ku sugnaa Beledweyne iyo Halgan. Weli lama caddeyn in ciidanka la qorsheynayo in laga saaro Soomaaliya ay yihiin kuwa AUSSOM, kuwa heshiiska laba geesoodka ah ama labada qayboodba. Addis Ababa si rasmi ah uma shaacin qorshaha bixitaanka, halka sarkaal ka tirsan Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya uu sheegay inaan Muqdisho lagu wargelin wax ciidan-bixis ah. Haddii bixitaanku noqdo mid degdeg ah oo aan lagu beddelin ciidamo Soomaali ah ama kuwa AUSSOM, Al‑Shabaab waxay heli kartaa fursad ay ku weerarto saldhigyada laga baxo, waddooyinka sahayda iyo magaalooyinka xuduudaha ku dhow. Itoobiya ayaa tallaabo la mid ah qaaday markii dagaalkii Tigray billowday 2020, markaas oo kumannaan askari oo heshiis laba geesood ah ku joogay Soomaaliya dib loogu celiyey dalkooda. Khubaradu waxay hore uga digeen in bixitaanka ciidamada Itoobiya uu abuuri karo firaaq ay Al‑Shabaab ka faa’iidaysato. Khatartu kuma koobna fariisimaha ciidamada oo keliya, balse Itoobiya waxay door muhiim ah ku leedahay ilaalinta xadka dheer ee labada dal, xog-is-weydaarsiga sirdoonka iyo xaddididda dhaqdhaqaaqa Al‑Shabaab ee u dhexeeya Bakool, Gedo iyo Dowlad-deegaanka Soomaalida. Haddii ciidamada, diyaaradaha iyo awoodda sirdoonka Itoobiya loo weeciyo Tigray, Amxaarada iyo Canfarta, cadaadiska lagu hayo marinnada xuduudda ayaa yaraada. Arrintani waxay ku soo beegmaysaa xilli AUSSOM ay horay u wajahaysay maalgelin iyo taageero saadka la xiriirta oo aan degganayn. Mareykanka ayaa Qaramada Midoobay siiyey hal sano oo dheeraad ah si tartiib loogu soo afjaro taageerada hawlgalka, laakiin mustaqbalka raashinka, shidaalka, caafimaadka iyo gaadiidka ay ciidamada ku tiirsan yihiin weli wuxuu ku jiraa xaalad hubanti-la’aan ah. Dagaalka Itoobiya wuxuu sidoo kale keeni karaa barakac, ganacsi xumo iyo hub ku faafa xuduudaha gobolka, ayadoo tobannaan kun oo qof ay durba ka barakaceen dagaallada Canfarta, halka xiriirka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea uu si buuxda u burburay. Haddaba haddii colaadda gudaha Itoobiya isu beddesho dagaal goboleed, Addis Ababa waxaa ku adkaan karta inay sii waddo kaalinteeda milatari iyo midda diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya.

items.title: An Indian airline captain is hailed as a hero after a cockpit attack on a FlyDubai flight
items.description: MUMBAI, India (AP) — An Indian airline captain who was at the controls of a FlyDubai flight when his copilot stabbed him in an apparent attempt to crash the plane has been hailed as a hero, with his actions to thwart the disaster drawing praise from world leaders and those who knew him. Capt. Smit Machchhar, who is from India’s financial hub of Mumbai, was seriously injured in Wednesday’s attack. Passengers described how the pilot still managed to open the cockpit door, allowing them to enter and restrain the attacker as the Boeing 737 descended sharply, according to witnesses and Israeli authorities. The attack forced the flight carrying 182 people from Dubai , United Arab Emirates, to Tel Aviv, Israel, to make an emergency landing in Tabuk in northwestern Saudi Arabia. FlyDubai said the aircraft was secured by on-duty crew “who diverted and landed the aircraft safely.” Machchhar was taken to a hospital in stable condition, the Indian Embassy in Riyadh, the Saudi capital, said late Wednesday. Embassy officials said Thursday that his family had been briefed on his recovery. India’s Modi lauds the pilot’s courage Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday called Machchhar a hero. “In the face of the gravest danger and despite being seriously injured, he showed immense courage and an unwavering resolve to protect the lives of others. His valor helped save hundreds of lives and avert a great tragedy,” Modi wrote on X. Modi also praised the captain for demonstrating ”patience, presence of mind and courage,” saying his “actions prevented another 9/11-like attack from happening.” He said he had spoken with Machchhar’s parents and wife and that the pilot was undergoing treatment. “Smit’s bravery fills every Indian with pride,” Modi said. The captain trained as a pilot in New Zealand According to Machchhar’s LinkedIn profile, he has worked for FlyDubai for about four years. Before joining the airline, he spent 11 years with SpiceJet, an Indian low-cost carrier, where he served as a senior commander and line training captain. He logged more than 9,750 flying hours with SpiceJet, according to the profile. SpiceJet, in a post on X, praised Machchhar’s “heroic courage” and “selfless actions.” “You are a hero to us all, Captain,” the airline wrote. Machchhar, who is married and has two children, trained as a pilot at Mainland Air in the New Zealand city of Dunedin for 18 months, beginning in 2008, the school’s head Philip Kean told 1News, a New Zealand television news channel. Kean said Machchhar “did very well” as a student and later returned to India, where he worked as a recruiter for the school. “We’re all very proud of him here and wish him a speedy recovery,” Kean said. The school, which opened in 1991, offers a range of certifications, from private pilots’ licenses to a diploma in aviation, and is popular with international students. A report published last year by the New Zealand Qualifications Authority found that 39 international students, all from India, were enrolled at the school at the time of its review, accounting for half of its total enrollment. The pilot had previously spoken about handling emergencies In a podcast interview last year, Machchhar recalled how nervous he was and how he made mistakes during his first commercial flight in India, and the lessons he learned from the experience. “At that stage, relaxing would have been the best option,” he told interviewer Zalak Mehta of the “Bona-Fide Banter” podcast. “Stressing is not going to help, at least … in this industry,” he added. Machchhar also described an onboard emergency when a pregnant woman went into premature labor, forcing the crew to divert the plane. He said he followed procedures carefully and ensured a safe landing on the first attempt. “It was methodical. It was quick. It was as quick as it should have been,” he said. Israel’s Netanyahu praises the pilot as do his neighbors in Mumbai Wednesday’s attack triggered a major security response in Israel, with authorities scrambling fighter jets in case of a possible hijacking. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the attacker, an Omani national, was arrested in Saudi Arabia and was undergoing interrogation there. His motive for the attack was not immediately clear. Netanyahu also praised Machchhar’s “extraordinary bravery” in a post on X, saying the wounded captain fought back after being stabbed, opened the cockpit door and helped passengers and crew overpower the attacker, preventing what Netanyahu described as a “catastrophic midair disaster.” Shota Musayev, a dentist and eyewitness, told The Associated Press how the wounded Machchhar managed to open the cockpit door to let them in before they grappled with the copilot. Musayev then treated Machchhar. “Poor pilot, he was just praying the whole time and was in contact with me, and I was afraid we would really lose him,” Musayev said. In Ghatkopar East, the Mumbai suburb where Machchhar’s family lives, neighbors spoke of how easy-going he is and also lauded his courage. “He has a lot of bravery in him,” said Ami Sapani, a neighbor who knows the family. “God is with him.” Source: AP The post An Indian airline captain is hailed as a hero after a cockpit attack on a FlyDubai flight appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Musharraxa Hoggaamiyaha Galmudug Liibaan Axmed Xasan Oo Shaaciyey Hawlgal Ka Dhan Ah Burcad-Badeedda
items.description: Musharraxa Hoggaamiyaha Galmudug Liibaan Axmed Xasan ayaa sheegay in hay’adaha ammaanka Galmudug ay saacadaha soo socda tallaabo ka qaadi doonaan kooxo burcad-badeed ah oo uu sheegay inay ka soo baxsadeen hawlgallada ay ciidamada Puntland ka fuliyeen deegaannada xeebaha. Liibaan Axmed Xasan wuxuu sheegay in kooxahaasi aysan gabbaad ka heli doonin deegaannada Galmudug, isagoo tilmaamay in la diyaarinayo tallaabooyin amni oo looga hortagayo inay saldhigyo cusub ka samaystaan xeebaha maamulkaas. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya iyadoo markabka MT Asana , oo weli gacanta ugu jira koox burcad-badeed ah, la sheegay inuu ku sugan yahay meel u dhow xeebaha Hobyo. Dhaqdhaqaaqa kooxaha burcad-badeedda ayaa kordhay kaddib hawlgallo ay ciidamada Puntland ku soo furteen maraakiib ay afduubteen kooxo hubeysan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee waxaa jira walaac laga qabo in kooxaha ka baxsaday hawlgalladaasi ay u wareegaan xeebaha koonfurta Mudug, halkaas oo masaafada dheer iyo joogitaanka kooban ee ciidamada badda ay siin karaan fursado ay dib isugu abaabulaan.

items.title: Midowga Afrika oo Itoobiya, Eritrea, iyo Masar ugu baaqay Is-xakameyn
items.description: Midowga Afrika ayaa ugu baaqay dowladaha Itoobiya, Eritrea iyo Masar inay muujiyaan is-xakameyn buuxda , iyadoo ururku walaac ka muujiyay xiisadaha u dhexeeya saddexda dal iyo saameynta ay ku yeelan karaan nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa bayaan uu soo saaray ku sheegay in saddexda dal ay ka fogaadaan tallaabooyin ama hadallo sii kordhin kara xiisadaha, isla markaana wiiqi kara nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Ururku wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in xaaladda jirta loo baahan yahay in si taxaddar leh loo maareeyo, si looga hortago in khilaafaadku sii xoogeysto. Midowga Afrika ayaa sidoo kale muhiimad gaar ah siiyay in la ilaaliyo waddooyinka isgaarsiinta ee u dhexeeya Itoobiya, Eritrea iyo Masar, isagoo ku boorriyay dhinacyada inay khilaafaadkooda ku xalliyaan hannaan diblomaasiyadeed oo rasmi ah iyo wada-hadal nabadeed. Guddiga Midowga Afrika wuxuu xusay in dadaallada lagu xallinayo khilaafaadka saddexda dal ay tahay inay waafaqaan mabaadi’da ku xusan Axdiga Aasaasiga ah ee Midowga Afrika , kaas oo dhigaya in khilaafaadka qaaradda lagu raadiyo hannaan nabadeed iyo iskaashi. Bayaanka Midowga Afrika ayaa imanaya xilli ay sare u kacayaan walaacyada ku saabsan xiriirka Itoobiya, Eritrea iyo Masar, inkastoo ururku uusan bayaankiisa ku faahfaahin sababaha gaarka ah ee ka dambeeya xiisadda, haddana wuxuu si cad ugu baaqay saddexda dowladood inay muujiyaan dulqaad iyo is-xakameyn, kana fogaadaan hadallo ama tallaabooyin xaaladda sii adkeyn kara. Midowga Afrika ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu taageero dadaallada lagu dejiyo xiisadda, dib loogu soo celiyo wada-hadalka, laguna gaaro xal nabadeed , isagoo la tashanaya dowladaha ay arrintu khusayso.

items.title: Masar oo Dalkeeda ka eriday la-taliyaha Safaaradda Itoobiya  kadib markii Addis Ababa ay Tillaabo taas lamid ah qaaday
items.description: Masar ayaa dalkeeda ka eriday diblomaasi Itoobiyaan ah, iyadoo tallaabadan lagu tilmaamay jawaab-celin kadib markii Itoobiya saacado ka hor ay diblomaasi Masri ah ku dhawaaqday inuu yahay persona non grata , isla markaana siisay 48 saacadood inuu dalka uga baxo. War ka soo baxay Qaahira ayaa lagu sheegaya in Masar ay diblomaasiga Itoobiyaanka ah, oo ah la-taliye ka tirsan safaaradda Itoobiya ee Qaahira , ku dhawaaqday inuu yahay qof aan dalka looga baahnayn, iyadoo loo qabtay muddo 48 saacadood ah inuu dalka uga baxo. Tallaabadan ayaa timid wax yar kadib go’aankii Addis Ababa ay ka qaadatay diblomaasi Masri ah, ayadoo maalintii Khamiista, 1-da Oktoobar, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya ay si rasmi ah safaaradda Masar ee Addis Ababa ugu wargelisay in Ahmed Moharam Ahmed Soliman , oo ka tirsan shaqaalaha diblomaasiyadda Masar, lagu dhawaaqay persona non grata oo looga baahan yahay inuu Itoobiya ka baxo 48 saacadood gudahood. Itoobiya waxay sheegtay in go’aanka lagu qaaday iyadoo la raacayo Axdiga Vienna ee Xiriirka Diblomaasiyadeed, balse warbixinta rasmiga ah ma aysan faahfaahin sababta gaarka ah ee diblomaasiga loo eryay, inkastoo xiisadda labada dhinac ay salka ku hayso dagaalka waqooyiga Itoobiya oo dalal ay masar kamid tahay ay Addis ababa ku eedaysay inay kaalin ku leeyihiin. Masar ayaa tallaabada Itoobiya u aragtay mid aan loo baahnayn, iyadoo ilo xog-ogaal ah oo Masri ah ay sheegeen in Qaahira ay si joogto ah u diiddo faragelinta arrimaha gudaha ee dalalka kale, ayna sheegtay inay ixtiraamto sharciga caalamiga ah iyo Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay. Is-weydaarsiga diblomaasiyiinta la eryayo wuxuu kusoo beegmayaa xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha ka dhex jira Itoobiya, Masar iyo Eritrea. Isla maalintii ay Itoobiya eriday diblomaasiga Masriga ah, Addis Ababa waxay sidoo kale ku dhawaaqday inay xirayso safaaraddeeda ku taalla Asmara, iyadoo dalka ka eriday 10 diblomaasi Eritrean ah oo ay ku eedeysay inay ku lug lahaayeen hawlo ay Itoobiya ku tilmaantay khatar toos ah oo ku wajahan amniga qarankeeda. Eritrea ayaa ayaduna markii dambe ku dhawaaqday inay jareyso xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee ay la leedahay Itoobiya, ayadoo tallaabooyinka is-daba-joogga ah ee Addis Ababa iyo Qaahira ay muujinayaan in xiriirka labada dal uu galay marxalad xasaasi ah.

items.title: Itoobiya oo cayrisay diblomaasi Masri una qabatay 48 saac
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa Khamiistii dalka ka cayrisay diblomaasi ka tirsan safaaradda Masar ee Addis Ababa, iyadoo siisay 48 saacadood inuu kaga baxo dalka, xilli xiriirka labada dal uu wajahayo xiisado sii xoogeysanaya. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya ayaa qoraal diblomaasiyadeed oo ku taariikheysan 1-da October ku sheegtay in Ahmed Moharam Ahmed Soliman , oo ka tirsan shaqaalaha diblomaasiyadeed ee safaaradda Masar, loo aqoonsaday persona non grata — oo macnaheedu yahay qof aan dalka laga rabin. “Wasaaraddu waxay halkan ku ogeysiinaysaa safaaradda in Ahmed Moharam Ahmed Soliman loo aqoonsaday persona non grata,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Wasaaraddu waxay intaas ku dartay in Soliman laga doonayo inuu Itoobiya uga baxo 48 saacadood gudahood. Itoobiya ma aysan sheegin sababta ay diblomaasiga Masar u cayrisay, mana aysan soo bandhigin wax eedeyn gaar ah oo isaga ka dhan ah. Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo aadeysa xilli xiriirka Addis Ababa iyo Qaahira uu mar kale sii xumaanayo, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isku hayaan muranka webiga Nile iyo biyo-xireenka weyn ee Itoobiya ee GERD, halka Addis Ababa ay dhawaan Masar ku eedeysay inay faragelin ku hayso arrimaheeda gudaha. Taliyaha ciidamada Itoobiya Field Marshal Birhanu Jula ayaa Axaddii ku eedeeyay Masar, Eritrea iyo Sudan inay taageerayaan xoogag dagaal kula jira dowladda federaalka Itoobiya, oo ay ku jiraan Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF). Birhanu ma uusan soo bandhigin caddeyn shaacsan oo taageereysa eedeymahaas. Masar ayaa si adag u diiday eedeynta. Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Masar Nader Zaki ayaa sheegay in siyaasadda dibadda ee dalkiisa ay ku dhisan tahay ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida dalalka iyo faragelin la’aanta arrimahooda gudaha. “Siyaasadda dibadda Masar waxay ku dhisan tahay mabaadi’ adag, oo ay ugu horreeyaan ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalalka, iyo inaan lagu faragelin arrimahooda gudaha,” ayuu yiri Zaki. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in eedeymo kasta oo shaki gelinaya mowqifkaas ay yihiin “kuwo aan sal lahayn”. Xiisadda ayaa sii ballaaratay iyadoo dagaal culus uu mar kale ka qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya, gaar ahaan deegaannada ku dhow Tigray, Amhara iyo Afar, taas oo walaac cusub ka abuurtay mustaqbalka heshiiskii Pretoria ee 2022 lagu soo afjaray dagaalkii dowladda federaalka iyo xoogagga Tigray. Tallaabo ka dhan ah Eritrea Dhanka kale, Itoobiya ayaa isla Khamiistii qaaday tallaabo diblomaasiyadeed oo ka dhan ah Eritrea, iyadoo ku dhawaaqday inay xireyso safaaraddeeda Asmara isla markaana 10 diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah siisay 48 saacadood inay dalka kaga baxaan. Addis Ababa waxay ku eedeysay diblomaasiyiintaas inay ku lug lahaayeen falal ay sheegtay inay khatar toos ah ku yihiin amniga qaranka Itoobiya. Eritrea ayaa eedeymahaas diiday, waxayna ku dhawaaqday inay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed u jareyso Itoobiya, iyadoo iyaduna Addis Ababa ku eedeysay siyaasado colaad ku dhisan. Khilaafka Masar iyo Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale muddo dheer salka ku haya biyo-xireenka GERD. Qaahira waxay ku adkeysaneysaa in hawlgalka biyo-xireenka lagu saleeyo heshiis sharci ahaan waajib ah oo ilaalinaya saami-biyoodka dalalka hoose, halka Itoobiya ay ku dooddo inay xaq u leedahay ka faa’iideysiga Nile si ay u horumariso korontada iyo dhaqaalaha dalka. Ilaa hadda, dowladda Itoobiya ma aysan xiriirin cayrinta Soliman khilaafka Nile ama dagaallada waqooyiga, mana aysan shaacin inay qorsheyneyso tallaabooyin kale oo ka dhan ah safaaradda Masar. items.title: Geesinimada Somaliland iyo Fursadda Cusub ee Dalladda Board of Peace”
items.description: Warbaahinta Il Caffè Geopolitico, oo ah joornaal caalami ah oo fadhigiisu yahay dalka Talyaaniga, kana faallooda siyaasadda caalamka iyo arrimaha juqraafi-siyaasadeed, , ayaa daabacay warbixin cusub oo ciwaan looga dhigay geesinimada Somaliland, “L’audacia del Somaliland”. Warbixintu waxay si gaar ah diiradda u saartay doorka Somaliland ee qorshaha ciidanka caalamiga ah ee International Stabilization Force (ISF), kaas oo la qorsheynayo in loo diro Gaza, iyadoo Maraykanku door hoggaamineed ku leeyahay qorshaha. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, tallaabada Somaliland ayaa ah mid istiraatiiji ah, maadaama ay ku soo beegantay xilli Washington ay raadineyso ciidamo iyo dowlado diyaar u ah inay ka qaybqaataan hawlgalka caalamiga ah ee xasilinta Gaza. Warbixinta oo uu qoray Livia Daccò Coppi waxay si qoto-dheer uga hadashay soo jeedintii Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Dr. Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ee ah in Xukuumadda Somaliland ay diyaar u tahay inay 2,000 askari ku biiriso hawlgalka caalamiga ah ee ciidamada xasilinta Gaza, haddii dhinacyada ay khusayso ay si rasmi ah u codsadaan. Sidoo kale warbixintu waxay si gaar ah uga hadashay doorka caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Somailand ay ka qaadan karto hawlgalkan oo hoos yimaada dalladda Board of Peace iyo qorshaha ballaadhan ee International Stabilization Force (ISF), kaas oo noqonaya ciidan caalami ah oo ay ka qayb qaataan dalal kala duwan. Warbixintu waxay xustay in dalal dhowr ah ay hore u muujiyeen inay diyaar u yihiin inay ciidamo ku biiriyaan hawlgalka, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin Kosovo, Albania, Morocco iyo Kazakhstan, isla markaana ay Somaliland dhawaan ku biirtay dalalka muujiyay diyaar-garowgooda. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, hawlaha loo qorsheeyay ciidamadan waxaa ka mid ah: Tababarka ciidamada booliska, Sugidda xuduudaha; Taageeridda geeddi-socodka hub-ka-dhigista; Ilaalinta shacabka rayidka ah; Sugidda marinnada gargaarka bani’aadantinimo iyo Ka qaybqaadashada xasilinta amniga gudaha Gaza. Sida ay tilmaantay warbixinta Il Caffè Geopolitico, diyaar-garowga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, waxay qayb ka noqon kara dadaallada Hargeysa ay ku xoojinayso xidhiidhkeeda amni iyo diblomaasiyadeed ee caalamka, gaar ahaan Maraykanka. Warbixintu waxay sheegtay in Somaliland doonayso inay muujiso inay tahay lamaane awood u leh inuu ka qaybqaato hawlgallada caalamiga ah ee la xidhiidha nabadda iyo amniga. Waxa kale oo warbixintu tilmaantay in soo jeedinta Somaliland ee ah inay bixiso 2,000 askari ay leedahay miisaan muuqda, maadaama tiradaasi ay noqon karto qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah ciidanka xasilinta ee loo qorsheeyay Gaza. Warbixintu waxay arrintan ku xidhiidhinaysaa dadaalka Somaliland ay ku doonayso inay ku xoojiso xidhiidhkeeda caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah. Sidoo kale waxa lagu xusay warbixinta in haddii soo jeedinta Somaliland la aqbalo, ay taasi Somaliland siin karto fursad ay kaga qaybqaadato hawlgal caalami ah oo diiradda saaraya nabadda iyo amniga. Iyadea oo ka qaybgalkaasi uu sidoo kale u noqon karo fursad ay Somaliland ku muujiso awoodda iyo diyaar-garowga ciidamadeeda, doorkeeda amni ee gobolka, iyo rabitaankeeda ah inay qayb ka noqoto hawlgallada caalamiga ah. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, dhanka kale, ka qaybgalka hawlgal noocan oo kale ah wuxuu Somaliland u abuuri karaa fursad ay ku xoojiso xidhiidhka ay la leedahay dalalka danaynaya xasilloonida Geeska Afrika iyo Bariga Dhexe. Iyada oo arrintani ay si gaar ah muhiim ugu noqon karto dhinaca iskaashiga amniga iyo xidhiidhada diblomaasiyadeed. Sidoo kale waxay sheegtay in arrintani ay yeelan karto muhiimad siyaasadeed iyo amni oo ka gudubta Gaza, iyadoo saamayn ku yeelan karta xidhiidhka Somaliland iyo Maraykanka iyo guud ahaan isbeddellada siyaasadeed iyo amni ee ka socda Geeska Afrika iyo Bariga Dhexe. Axmed M. Saleebaan

items.title: Eritrea oo ku dhawaaqday inay jareyso xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Itoobiya
items.description: Asmara, 1 Oktoobar 2026 — Dowladda Eritrea ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay jarayso dhammaan xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed ee ay la leedahay Itoobiya, tallaabadan oo muujinaysa inuu sii xumaaday khilaafka u dhexeeya labada dal ee deriska ah. Go’aanka Eritrea ayaa yimid xilli Itoobiya ay Asmara ku eedeysay inay taageero siineyso isbahaysi mucaarad hubeysan oo uu hoggaaminayo TPLF, kaas oo dagaallo kula jira dowladda federaalka Itoobiya. Eritrea ayaa si adag u diidday eedeymahaas. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kadib markii dagaallo cusub ay ka billowdeen waqooyiga Itoobiya, gaar ahaan gobolka Tigray, iyadoo wararka Reuters ay sheegayaan in xaaladdu ay khatar ku tahay inay isku beddesho colaad gobolka oo ballaaran. Tallaabadan cusub waxay dhaawac weyn ku keeni kartaa xiriirkii labada dal, kuwaas oo sannadihii lasoo dhaafay soo maray heshiis nabadeed iyo dib-u-soo-noqoshada xiriirkooda diblomaasiyadeed. Reuters ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in go’aanka Eritrea uu yahay mid si weyn u kordhinaya xiisadda ka taagan Geeska Afrika.

items.title: Itoobiya oo xirtay safaaradii Eritrea, cayrisay 10 diblomaasi xilli xiisadda ay ka sii dartay
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa Khamiistii amartay in la xiro safaaraddeeda magaalada Asmara, iyadoo sidoo kale 10 diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah ku amartay inay dalka kaga baxaan 48 saacadood gudahood, tallaabo muujineysa heerka uu gaaray khilaafka sii xoogeysanaya ee labada dal. Go’aanka ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii qaraxyo dhowr ah habeenkii laga maqlay magaalada Addis Ababa, xilli dagaalka dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya uu sii ballaaranayo, isla markaana ay soo baxayaan walaac laga qabo inuu isu beddelo iska horimaad goboleed. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya ayaa sheegtay inay safaaradda Asmara u xireyso waxa ay ku tilmaantay “falal cadaawad iyo dagaal-doon ah oo toos iyo dadban” oo Eritrea ay kula kacday Itoobiya. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in 10-ka diblomaasi ee Eritrea loo aqoonsaday persona non grata kadib markii lagu eedeeyay inay ku lug lahaayeen “dhaqdhaqaaqyo khatar toos ah ku ah amniga qaranka Itoobiya” oo jebinaya xeerarka caalamiga ah ee xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed. Wasaaraddu ma aysan magacaabin diblomaasiyiinta, mana aysan faahfaahin howlaha gaarka ah ee lagu eedeeyay. Itoobiya waxay ugu baaqday dowladda Eritrea inay joojiso falalka ay sheegtay inay ka hor imaanayaan mabaadi’da lagu hago xiriirka dowladaha madax-bannaan. Dhanka kale, Addis Ababa waxay sheegtay inay weli qiimeyneyso “xiriirka taariikhiga ah, dhaqan iyo kan bulsho” ee ka dhexeeya shacabka labada dal, islamarkaana ay ka go’an tahay xalinta khilaafaadka si nabadeed. Qaraxyo ka dhacay Addis Ababa Xiisadda diblomaasiyadeed ayaa kusoo beegantay kadib markii qaraxyo laga maqlay meelo ka mid ah Addis Ababa habeenkii Arbacada. Ilo diblomaasiyadeed oo la hadlay Reuters ayaa xaqiijiyay in dhowr qarax la maqlay, halka ilo xiriir la leh isbaheysiga mucaaradka Itoobiya ay wakaaladda u sheegeen in weerarro diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn lagu qaaday bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla caasimadda, oo ay ku jiraan xarunta taliska ciidamada Itoobiya. Ma jirto xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo muujineysa waxa sababay qaraxyada ama cidda fulisay. Goobjoogayaal ayaa sheegay inaan wax burbur muuqda ah lagu arkin agagaarka xarunta militariga. Haddii la xaqiijiyo in diyaarado drone ah ay mucaaradku ku weerareen Addis Ababa, waxay noqon doontaa markii ugu horreysay ee la ogyahay oo xoogag kasoo horjeeda dowladda ay weerar noocaas ah ka geystaan caasimadda, oo boqolaal kiiloomitir u jirta furimaha dagaalka ee Tigray, Amxaarada iyo Cafarta. Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda, ciidamada Itoobiya iyo TPLF ayaan si degdeg ah uga jawaabin codsiyada Reuters ee ku aaddanaa faallo. Saaxiibo isu beddelay cadow Itoobiya ayaa toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay ku eedeysay Eritrea, Masar iyo Sudan inay taageerayaan isbaheysi mucaarad ah oo ay hormuud ka tahay Jabhadda Xoreynta Shacabka Tigray ee TPLF, kaas oo dagaal kula jira ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo kooxo taageersan. Saddexda dal ayaa beeniyay eedeymahaas. Dagaallada hadda socda ayaa ah kuwii ugu cuslaa ee Itoobiya ka dhaca tan iyo markii heshiiskii Pretoria ee November 2022 uu soo afjaray dagaalkii laba sano socday ee Tigray, kaas oo ay ku dhinteen boqollaal kun oo qof. Xilligaas Eritrea waxay safka dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed kula dagaallantay TPLF, iyadoo ciidamadeedu door weyn ku lahaayeen dagaalka waqooyiga Itoobiya. Hase yeeshee Eritrea qeyb kama aysan noqon heshiiskii Pretoria ee dowladda Itoobiya iyo TPLF, xiriirka Addis Ababa iyo Asmara ayaana markii dambe si tartiib ah u xumaaday. Waxay taasi ahayd isbeddel weyn marka loo eego 2018, markaas oo Itoobiya iyo Eritrea dib u soo celiyeen xiriirkooda diblomaasiyadeed kadib sanado badan oo colaadeed. Itoobiya waxay xilligaas dib u furtay safaaraddeeda Asmara, heshiiska nabadeed ee labada dalna wuxuu qeyb weyn ka qaatay in Abiy Ahmed la siiyo Abaalmarinta Nabadda ee Nobel-ka sanadkii 2019. Hadda, xiriirka labada dowladood ayaa mar kale galay mid ka mid ah marxaladihii ugu xumaa tan iyo heshiiskaas. Madaxa maamulka gobolka Cafarta, Haji Awol Arba, ayaa maalmo kadib markii dagaalka cusub billowday u sheegay Al Jazeera in ciidamo Eritrean ah ay gudaha u galeen Cafarta si ay uga qeyb qaataan weerarrada isbaheysiga mucaaradka. Eritrea si cad ugama jawaabin eedeyntaas. Dhanka kale, ciidanka federaalka Itoobiya iyo maleeshiyaad taageersan dowladda ayaa Khamiistii sheegay inay guulo hor leh ka gaareen furimaha Tigray iyo Cafarta. Reuters sheegashooyinkaas si madax-bannaan uma aysan xaqiijin. Xiisadda cusub ayaa hadda isku dartay dagaal gudaha Itoobiya ah iyo khilaaf sii xumaanaya oo u dhexeeya Addis Ababa iyo Asmara, taas oo sare u qaadaysa cabsida laga qabo in colaadda waqooyiga Itoobiya ay xuduudaha dalka dhaafto. items.title: Xogta kulan caawa dhex-maraya Aadan Madoobe iyo ergo dhex-dhexaadin ah
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Kulan gaar ah ayaa la filayaa inuu caawa magaalada Baydhabo ku dhexmaro hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur Madoobe iyo ergo dhex-dhexaadin ah oo uu hoggaaminayo Guddoomiyihii hore ee Golaha Shacabka, Xildhibaan Maxamed Mursal Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan. Wafdiga Maxamed Mursal ayaa maanta gaaray Baydhabo, waxaana ku jira lix xubnood oo dhammaantood ah xildhibaanno ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya. Wafdigan ayaa qayb ka noqonaya dadaallada lagu doonayo in xal laga gaaro khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed. Intii ay joogeen magaalada, ergadu waxay kulan hordhac ah la yeesheen Aadan Madoobe iyo guddi uu dhawaan magacaabay oo isugu jira dhaqan iyo siyaasiyiin. Guddigaas waxaa guddoomiye u ah Suldaan Warsame Ibroow, waxaana dhinacyadu ka wada-hadleen xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee ka taagan gobolka. Ergada dhex-dhexaadinta wada ayaa sidoo kale hore magaalada Nairobi kula kulantay Madaxweynihii Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Lafta-gareen, kaas oo wada-hadallada miro-dhalka ah shardi uga dhigay in Aadan Madoobe uu xilka ka dego. Kulanka caawa ayaa imanaya xilli labada dhinac ay weli ku kala aragti duwan yihiin cidda maamuleysa Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo khilaafka siyaasadeed uu saameyn ku yeeshay xaaladda magaalada Baydhabo iyo guud ahaan maamulka. Inkastoo dadaallada dhex-dhexaadintu ay hadda bilow yihiin, haddana waxaa muuqata in dhinacyadu ay ku kala fog yihiin qodobbada ugu waaweyn ee khilaafka, taas oo ka dhigaysa inaan si degdeg ah loo filan natiijo kama dambeys ah. Qaar kamid ah siyaasiyiinta Koonfur Galbeed ayaa qaba in mudnaanta koowaad ee wada-hadallada ay tahay in la gaaro xabbad-joojin degdeg ah oo dhex marta labada dhinac ee isku haya hoggaanka maamulka. Wada-hadalladan ayaa imanaya xilli maalmihii dambe ay Baydhabo ka dhaceen dagaallo qaraar, iyadoo haatan mudnaanta la siinayo sidii loo dejin lahaa xaaladda amni ee magaalada iyo isfaham isku soo dhawaansho ah oo dhinacyadu ay gaaraan. items.title: Sooyaal: Maxamed Xaashi Dhamac (Gaarriye)
items.description: 14 sano ayaa laga joogaa markii, 01dii Sibteenbar sannadkii 2012kii, uu dalka Norway ku geeriyooday, Alle ha u naxariistee, macallin iyo abwaan Maxamed Xaashi Dhamac (Gaarriye). Abwaan Maxamed Xaashi Dhamac (Gaarriye) wuxuu ku dhashay magaalada Hargeysa sannadkii 1949kii. Waxbarashadiisii hoose, dhexe iyo sare wuxuu ku qaatay magaalooyinka Hargeysa iyo Sheekh. Dabadeed wuxuu galay Jaamacaddii Ummadda Soomaaliyeed, halkaas oo uu ka qaatay shahaadada jaamacadda. Waxbarashadiisii ka dib, wuxuu ka mid noqday macallimiintii wax ka dhigi jiray Jaamacaddii Ummadda Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan Kulliyaddii Waxbarashada ee Lafoole. Waxa kale oo uu wax ka dhigay jaamacadaha Cammuud iyo Hargeysa, isaga oo dhigi jiray af Soomaaliga iyo suugaantiisa. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ka soo shaqeeyay Akadeemiyadii Cilmiga, Fanka iyo Suugaanta. Marka laga yimaaddo curinta suugaanta, wuxuu waqti iyo dadaal badan geliyay horumarinta af Soomaaliga iyo xeerarkiisa naxwaha, isaga oo kaalintiisa ku darsaday kobcinta afka iyo dhaxalsiinta aqoonta suugaaneed. Gaarriye wuxuu ahaa mufakar hal-abuurkiisa u adeegsan jiray nabadaynta bulshada, garaadkobcinteeda iyo baraaruggeeda aqooneed. Suugaantiisa badda ah waxaa tusaale looga soo qaadan karaa maansada Ergo, oo uu ku muujinayay khasaaraha dagaalka sokeeye iyo sida kii wax dila iyo kii la dilaba uusan midkoodna lib dhab ah uga helayn colaadda. Maansadaas wuxuu Gaarriye ku milicsanayaa waaqaca dagaalka sokeeye, isaga oo su’aalgelinaya waxa dhab ahaan laga dheefi karo colaad ehel iyo xigaal dhexdooda ka dhacda. Hal-abuurku halkan wuxuu uga gudbayaa curin suugaaneed oo keliya, wuxuuna noqonayaa farriin bulsheed oo ku saabsan aayaha, nabadda iyo masuuliyadda jiilasha. Mar kale, isaga oo muujinaya qabyaaladda Soomaalida ku baahday iyo in sheegashada “reer Hebel” aysan keligeed macne samaynayn, ayse macne leedahay in qofku la wadaago dadka kale yool, isfahan iyo waxqabad, ayuu yiri: “Abkuu doono ha sheegto’e Wuxuun baa ehel ii ah Dad ninkaan af aqaanee Si wax iila arkaayee Na midaysow ujeeddo.” Meerisyadani waxay muujinayaan habfikir bulsheed ay ehelnimadu kaga ballaaran tahay dhalasho iyo tol keliya, kuna dhisan tahay afgarad, ujeeddawadaag iyo waxwadaqabsi. Qaar ka mid ah maansooyinkii Abwaan Gaarriye Maansadii Dood Maansadii Ergo Maansadii Gurmad Maansadii Garnaqsi Maansadii Qasab kuma Balweyn Karo Maansadii Hagarlaawe Maansadii Fadgalbeed Gaarriye iyo saaxiibkiisii suugaanta Hadraawi, Alle ha u wada naxariistee, waxay ka mid noqdeen tiro abwaanno ah oo cadaadis kala kulmay nidaamkii Kacaanka, isla markaana curin jiray suugaan maldahan oo ay kaga dhaliilayeen nidaamkaas. Suugaantu sidaas ayay ugu noqotay goob ay fekerka, naqdinta iyo baraarugga bulsheed isku haleelaan. Gaarriye wuxuu markii danbe ku biiray jabhaddii SNM, isaga oo dhinacaas door weyn kaga lahaa guubaabada iyo kutaagnaanshaha fikirkaas. Markii dambe ayuu qurbaha u wareegay, wuxuuna halkaas ka sii waday curintii suugaanta iyo wacyigelinta bulshada. Qurbuhu sidaas uguma noqon kalago’ suugaaneed; wuxuu hal-abuurkiisii ka sii ambaqaaday meel ka baxsan dalkii uu ku soo hanaqaaday. Waxa uu ku guulaystay billado caalami ah, waxaana suugaantiisa in badan lagu turjumay afaf qalaad, taas oo hal-abuurkiisa u furtay aafaaq ka ballaaran geyiga Soomaalida. 30kii Sibteenbar 2012 ayuu ku geeriyooday dalka Norway. Gaarriye wuxuu ka tegay dhaxal suugaaneed iyo raad aqooneed oo ku suntan af Soomaaliga, maansada, fikirka bulshada iyo baraarugga ummadda. Waxsoosaarkiisu wuxuu weli qayb ka yahay xusuusta suugaaneed ee Soomaalida, jiilba jiilkana waxaa looga sii ambaqaadaa af, suugaan iyo feker. Alle ha u naxariisto Macallin iyo Abwaan Maxamed Xaashi Dhamac (Gaarriye).

items.title: Explosions heard in Addis Ababa after Ethiopia bans drone flights
items.description: ADDIS ABABA (Somaliguardian) – Explosions were heard overnight in Ethiopia’s capital ​Addis Ababa, three diplomatic sources said on Thursday, adding to anxiety about the possible spread of renewed conflict in the country’s north . A source ‌linked to the opposition alliance fighting government forces since last week said it had carried out several drone strikes in Addis Ababa, including some targeting the military’s headquarters. Federal troops and allied militiamen, meanwhile, made fresh gains in the northern Tigray and Afar regions in fighting with the opposition Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF), a pro-government militia said. Reuters could not independently verify ​the different claims. The diplomatic sources, who gave scant details of the blasts in Addis Ababa, spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss a ​sensitive matter. Witnesses said there was no damage visible near the military base. If confirmed, it would be the first known ⁠drone attack by anti-government forces on the Ethiopian capital, which is hundreds of kilometres from the front lines in the northern regions of Tigray, Amhara ​and Afar. Spokespeople for Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s office, the federal government, the Ethiopian National Defence Force (ENDF) and the TPLF did not respond to requests for comment. INTELLIGENCE SERVICE ​BANS DRONE FLIGHTS OVER CAPITAL Last week’s clashes were the biggest escalation in Ethiopia since the end of a 2020-2022 civil war that killed hundreds of thousands. The national intelligence service has banned drones over Addis Ababa. Opposition forces had not previously been known to use armed drones but there is growing evidence they may possess some capability. On Tuesday, the pro-government Tigray ​Peace Forces (TPF) militia said it had captured drone frames and batteries from forces linked to the TPLF, which is the main political party in Tigray. Edward ​Bach, Senior Africa Analyst at risk intelligence company Verisk Maplecroft, said the opposition’s ability to strike Addis Ababa would be “a political game-changer,” undermining any government narrative that the capital ‌is unaffected ⁠by the war and narrowing a key tactical advantage for federal forces, their aerial superiority. TENS OF THOUSANDS DISPLACED BY FIGHTING The TPLF has formed an alliance with six other armed groups aiming to overthrow Abiy’s government. Federal forces have been advancing in southern Tigray, edging closer to the regional capital Mekelle, while the opposition alliance has captured towns in neighbouring Afar. The pro-government TPF said on Thursday that it had captured the Tigrayan town of Maychew alongside the ENDF. Maychew is about 75 ​km (47 miles) south of Mekelle, surrounded ​by mountainous terrain that could be ⁠used for an assault on the regional capital. Federal forces captured Mekelle within the first month of the last war as TPLF fighters withdrew into the surrounding mountains. The TPLF then mounted a counter-offensive that reclaimed Mekelle seven months later. FEARS ​OF REGIONAL DESTABILIZATION Pro-government forces also recaptured the town of Erbeti in Afar, which TPLF forces had seized at the ​start of the conflict, ⁠the TPF said on X, thanking the ENDF for “magnificent air support”. In Afar, where the TPLF captured several towns in the early days of the new conflict, fighting has forced tens of thousands of people to flee their homes, Valerie Browning, a founder of the Afar Pastoralist Development Association, told Reuters. Ethiopia’s government has accused Sudan, Egypt ⁠and Eritrea — ​which fought in support of Ethiopia’s federal government in the last war — of supporting the opposition ​alliance. All three deny that. Afar’s chief administrator Haji Awol Arba went a step further earlier this week, telling Al Jazeera that Eritrean soldiers had crossed into Afar to join the alliance’s offensive. Eritrea’s information ​minister did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Baaritaanka gabadhii meydkeeda laga helay Baydhabo oo la soo afjaray
items.description: Hay’adaha nabadgelyada ee Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa soo geba-gabeeyay baaritaanka gabadhii yareyd ee Jimcihii meydkeeda laga helay xaafadda Xaqsoor ee magaaladaasi. Ikhlaas Ibraahim Amiin oo shan jir ahayd ayaa meydkeeda laga helay MCH ku dhegan hoygooda, ka dib 48 saac oo qoyskeeda ay baadigoobayeen. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in dhakhaatiirta ay caddeeyeen in gabadhaasi la dilay, isla-markaana dilkeeda loo adeegsaday xarig lagu ceejiyay. Booliska Baydhabo ayaa isla Jimcihii saddex qof u soo qabtay falkaasi, kuwaa oo isugu jira laba gabar iyo nin dhallinyaro oo waardiye ka ahaa xarunta caafimaad ee laga helay meydka Ikhlaas Ibraahim. Ciidamada amniga ayaa toddobaadkan qof afaraad u soo xiray dilka gabadhaasi, kaas oo lagu sheegay in uu ahaa nin ceel ka qodaayay MCH-ka. Sarkaal ka tirsan Booliska Baydhabo ayaa inoo sheegay in uu socdo qorshe eedeysaneyaasha loogu wareejinayo Jeelka Weyn ee Baydhabo, si halkaasi loogu sii hayo inta laga maxkamadeynayo. Eedeysaneyaasha ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyay ku xirnaa Saldhigga Booliska Baydhabo. Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo si dhow ula socday baaritaanka dhacdadan ayaa saraakiisha laamaha amniga culeys gaar ah ku saaray inaysan ka mashquulin oo la dedejiyo baaritaanka. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Haweenka, Arrimaha Qoyska & Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Koonfur Galbeed, Sahra Cismaan Axmed ayaa hay’adaha ammaanka ka dalbatay in ay sharciga horkeenaan ciddii dishay gabadhaasi yar. Geerida Ikhlaas Ibraahim ayaa argagax ku abuurtay dadka reer Baydhabo iyo dhammaan dadkii baraha bulshada kala socday raadinteeda.

Ciidamada amniga ayaa toddobaadkan qof afaraad u soo xiray dilka gabadhaasi, kaas oo lagu sheegay in uu ahaa nin ceel ka qodaayay MCH-ka. Sarkaal ka tirsan Booliska Baydhabo ayaa inoo sheegay in uu socdo qorshe eedeysaneyaasha loogu wareejinayo Jeelka Weyn ee Baydhabo, si halkaasi loogu sii hayo inta laga maxkamadeynayo. Eedeysaneyaasha ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyay ku xirnaa Saldhigga Booliska Baydhabo. Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo si dhow ula socday baaritaanka dhacdadan ayaa saraakiisha laamaha amniga culeys gaar ah ku saaray inaysan ka mashquulin oo la dedejiyo baaritaanka. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Haweenka, Arrimaha Qoyska & Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Koonfur Galbeed, Sahra Cismaan Axmed ayaa hay’adaha ammaanka ka dalbatay in ay sharciga horkeenaan ciddii dishay gabadhaasi yar. Geerida Ikhlaas Ibraahim ayaa argagax ku abuurtay dadka reer Baydhabo iyo dhammaan dadkii baraha bulshada kala socday raadinteeda.

items.title: Bandow lagu soo rogay Baydhaba kadib markii…
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Amniga Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Isaaq Maxamed Korsaar ayaa ku dhawaaqay in magaalada Baydhabo lagu soo rogay bandow, kaas oo xaddidaya dhaq-dhaqaaqa dadka iyo gaadiidka wixii ka dambeeya salaadda Maqrib. Go’aanka ayaa qayb ka ah tallaabooyin lagu xoojinayo amniga magaalada, iyadoo Baydhabo ay weli ka jirto xaalad amni oo u baahan feejignaan dheeraad ah iyo in si dhow loola socdo dhaqdhaqaaqyada ka dhacaya gudaha magaalada. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in dadka ku nool Baydhabo looga baahan yahay inay u hoggaansamaan awaamiirta la xiriirta amniga, isla markaana aan la oggolaan doonin dhaqdhaqaaqyada aan daruuriga ahayn marka la gaaro waqtiga bandowga. Dhanka kale, ciidamada ammaanka ayuu faray inay kordhiyaan howl-gallada lagu sugayo amniga gudaha Baydhabo, isaga oo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in si wadajir ah looga shaqeeyo xasilloonida magaalada. “Awaamiirtan haddii Ilaahay idmo, guud ahaan amniga ayay ku saabsan yihiin, waana in wada-shaqeyn iyo gacmo is-qabsasho lagu sugo amniga,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur Galbeed. Wasiir Korsaar ayaa sidoo kale bulshada ugu baaqay inay la shaqeeyaan ciidamada ammaanka, isla markaana ay u hoggaansamaan awaamiirta la soo saaray, si looga hortago falal wax u dhimi kara amniga magaalada. Bandowga ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Baydhabo ay maalmihii lasoo dhaafay ka dhaceen iska horimaadyo iyo xaalad amni oo kacsan, kuwaas oo saameyn ku yeeshay shacabka iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqa magaalada. Xaaladda magaalada ayaa weli si dhow loola socdaa, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka lagu amray inay qaadaan tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah ee lagu ilaalinayo amniga iyo kala dambeynta Baydhabo. items.title: Ethiopia to withdraw over 3,000 troops from Somalia
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Ethiopia plans to withdraw more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as fighting escalates in its north, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter. The pullout could begin in the coming days or weeks, Bloomberg said. The troops would be redeployed to areas affected by fighting between government forces, Tigray forces and allied Fano insurgents, it said. A Somali defence ministry official said Mogadishu had not been informed of any such plan. Neither Ethiopia, Somalia nor the African Union has publicly announced any change to Ethiopia’s deployment. It was not clear whether the plan would affect Ethiopian troops serving under the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), forces deployed under bilateral arrangements, or both. Ethiopia is one of Somalia’s main military partners in operations against Al-Shabaab, the Al-Qaeda-linked insurgent group, and has been a key partner in defending the city of Baidoa. The latest fighting in northern Ethiopia began on Aug 1 with clashes near the Sudan border and escalated last week, according to data from the Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED). Tensions between the Tigray People’s Liberation Front and the federal government have risen since a 2022 peace deal ended the two-year Tigray war. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Itoobiya oo xirtay safaaraddeedii Asmara
items.description: Addis Ababa, 1 Oktoobar 2026 — Xiisadda diblomaasiyadeed ee u dhaxaysa Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa gaartay heer cusub, kaddib markii dowladda Itoobiya ay ku dhawaaqday inay xirayso safaaraddeeda ku taalla caasimadda Eritrea ee Asmara. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in 10 diblomaasi oo Eritrean ah lagu dhawaaqay persona non grata, iyadoo lagu amray inay dalka Itoobiya uga baxaan muddo 48 saacadood gudahood ah. Addis Ababa waxay Eritrea ku eedeysay “falal colaad iyo gardarro” ah oo ka dhan ah Itoobiya. Tallaabadan ayaa timid xilli dagaallada ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya ay dib u xoogeysanayaan, gaar ahaan Tigray, halkaas oo dowladda Itoobiya ay hore ugu eedeysay Eritrea inay taageero siiso kooxaha hubeysan ee dagaalka kula jira dowladda federaalka. Eritrea ayaa eedeymahaas beenisay. Xiisadda labada dal ayaa muddooyinkii dambe sii xoogeysanaysay. Bishii Febraayo, Itoobiya waxay Eritrea ku eedeysay inay ciidamo ku haysato dhul Itoobiya leedahay iyo inay taageerto kooxo hubeysan, iyadoo dalbatay in ciidamada Eritrea laga saaro dhulkaas. Dhanka kale, dagaallada gudaha Itoobiya ayaa sii fidaya, iyadoo isbahaysi ay ku mideysan yihiin toddobo kooxood oo hubeysan uu ku dhawaaqay ujeeddo ah in meesha laga saaro dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed. Dowladda Itoobiya waxay sheegtay in Eritrea ay door ku leedahay taageerada kooxahan, balse Asmara ay si joogto ah u diidday eedeymahaas. Xiritaanka safaaradda Itoobiya ee Asmara iyo eryidda diblomaasiyiinta Eritrea ayaa muujinaya hoos u dhac weyn oo ku yimid xiriirka labada dal, iyadoo xaaladda amni ee waqooyiga Itoobiya ay weli tahay mid kacsan. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa hadda wajahaysa dagaallo gudaha ah iyo muranno diblomaasiyadeed oo ay la leedahay dalalka deriska ah.

items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo maanta dhaqan-gelisay amar saameyn culus ku yeeshay Puntland
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Waxaa maanta oo ah 1-da Oktoobar guud ahaan dalka ka dhaqan-galay amarka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan in qof kasta oo raacaya diyaaradaha kuna safraya gudaha dalka uu wato Kaarka Aqoonsiga Qaranka eeNIRA. Tallaabadan ayay Dowladda Federaalka sheegtay inay uga gol-leedahay sida loo ilaalin lahaa manig dalka iyo la socodka dhaq-dhaqaaqa muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda ayaa lagu wargeliyay muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee safraya inay horay usoo qaataan kaarka NIRA, iyadoo la faray inay hoggaansamaan amarka cusub ee soo baxay. “Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda, waxa ay dhammaan muwaadiniinta u safraya gudaha gobolada dalka ku wargelinayaan in ay horay usoo qaataan Kaarka Aqoonsiga Qaranka ama Shahaadada Aqoonsiga laga bilaawo 1da Oktoober 2026,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda Dowladda Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, amarkan ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inuu durbadiiba saameeyay diyaaradaha isaga kala goosha magaalooyinka Muqdisho iyo Garoowe, iyada oo qaar kamid ah ay saaka baaqdeen, sababa la xiriirta istcimaalka kaarka NIRA. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa, xilli uu weli taagan yahay khiaafka u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo maamulka Puntland, kaas oo ku saabsan hirgelinta kaarka aqoonsiga NIRA. Puntland ayaa horay uga hortimid in Hay’adda Aqoonsiga iyo Diiwaangelinta Qaranka ay xarun ka furato deegaannadeeda, tallaabadaas oo caqabad ku noqotay in shacabka maamulkaas ay helaan kaarka NIRA oo hadda si rasmi ah uga dhaqan-galay guud ahaan dalka. The post DF Soomaaliya oo maanta dhaqan-gelisay amar saameyn culus ku yeeshay Puntland appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: As Turkey’s Hostility Grows, Should Somaliland Keep Turkey Consulate Open?
items.description: Some Fear the Consulate Is an Intelligence Hub from Which Turkish Agents Aid Adversaries and Undermine Somaliland’s Cohesion October 1, 2026 Siyad   A view of Hargeisa, the capital of Somaliland. Shutterstock Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan backed stronger security and institutional capacity for Somalia in his address to the United Nations General Assembly on September 22, 2026, implicitly rebuffing Somaliland’s 35-year quest for recognition. For most of the six-and-a-half decades since the 1960 union, Turkey showed little interest in whether Somalia held together, and the Somalia and Somaliland talks it hosted from 2013, with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud at the table, produced communiqués and little else. Four days after Israel recognized Somaliland in December 2025, however, Erdoğan stood beside Mohamud in Istanbul and declared that preserving Somalia’s unity “in all circumstances” held special importance for Turkey. Israel’s entrance into Somaliland and Turkey’s growing threats toward Israel make the question of Turkey’s consulate more urgent. Turkey’s embassy in Mogadishu, which also houses its defense attaché, states that its consular services for Somaliland run through the Hargeisa post, though such activities do not pass the smell test given relative staff size versus the small number of Turks in Somaliland. The fear today within Somaliland is that the Turkish consulate is an intelligence hub from which Turkish agents seek to aid adversaries and undermine Somaliland’s cohesion. Israel’s entrance into Somaliland and Turkey’s growing threats toward Israel make the question of Turkey’s consulate more urgent. Israel’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs appointed Michael Lotem, formerly ambassador to Kenya, to be the Jewish state’s first envoy to Somaliland. No public evidence shows the Turkish post gathering intelligence, but its staff sit a few hours’ drive from Berbera, reporting to an embassy whose government called Israel’s recognition illegitimate. While Turkey denies malfeasance, it has been unable to show why it needs or wants a consulate in Hargeisa given Erdoğan’s hostility toward Somaliland’s recognition or even autonomy. Turkey prides itself on economic diplomacy but Turkish assistance seldom benefits Somaliland. Instead, Turkey’s commercial and military investments center on areas controlled by the Somali government. In April 2026, the drillship Çağrı Bey arrived under escort of three Turkish warships to sink the Curad-1 well off Somalia’s southern coast. A ten-year defense framework signed in February 2024 authorized the Turkish navy to defend Somali waters. Iran’s war has revived Somali piracy, and in August 2026, Somalia’s defense ministry says, Turkish warships and Somali forces killed 14 pirates to free the cargo ship Latuf , which, according to several reports, was carrying Turkish weapons and communications equipment for the Turkish base in Mogadishu. Each such operation normalizes a Turkish homeport in Somali waters and brings the Turkish navy closer to the Gulf of Aden in waters the Somaliland coast guard patrols but over which Somalia has held no sway for decades. Given Mogadishu’s encroachment on Somaliland airspace, Somaliland is right to be concerned that the Turkey-Somalia naval arrangement aims to deny Somaliland full access to the sea and instead seeks to tighten the blockade. Turkey’s behavior elsewhere in Somalia also raises alarm. On September 3, 2026, a strike hit the Doolow residence of General Mahad Abdirahman, former commander of the Somali Custodial Corps and an opposition figure, wounding him, his wife, and several civilians. The Jubaland state’s government blamed Turkey. Mogadishu denied any role, and Ankara has offered no comment. Protesters in Kismayo, Afmadow, Doolow, and Puntland’s Dangoroyo burned Turkish flags. If Ankara seeks to help Hassan Sheikh Mohamud centralize control over federal states, then Hargeisa cannot assume Turkey will stay out of any future contest with Somaliland. Rather than close the consulate, Hargeisa should … demand that Ankara accept a reciprocal Somaliland office in Turkey. There is a case for keeping the consulate. It can process visas for Somalilanders who study, trade or seek treatment in Turkey, though e-visa processing undermines its consular importance relative to what it was a few years ago. Expelling the consulate would hand Mogadishu a narrative that Somaliland has become an Israeli client. Somaliland’s strongest argument for statehood has always been its conduct, and a state that honors consular norms makes that argument better than one that slams doors. The channel also may matter to Ankara, if Turkey needs a way to step back from positions Mogadishu has pushed it into. The Vienna Convention on Consular Relations allows a receiving state to close zones to consular staff for national security and to declare any consular officer unacceptable without explanation. Rather than close the consulate, Hargeisa should apply those rules, placing Berbera’s port, airport, and coastline off-limits to foreign consular personnel, and demand that Ankara accept a reciprocal Somaliland office in Turkey. If Ankara refuses, the consulate should close. Ankara probably will refuse, and Hargeisa should be ready for that answer. A refusal would let Somaliland close the consulate on grounds of reciprocity. The State Department should condition security assistance to Mogadishu on a credible investigation of the Doolow strike and press Ankara, through the alliance, to disclose what missiles and rockets it intends to test at Warsheikh. It should also back Hargeisa’s right to set the terms on which foreign missions operate on its soil   Source Meforum.org

Iran’s war has revived Somali piracy, and in August 2026, Somalia’s defense ministry says, Turkish warships and Somali forces killed 14 pirates to free the cargo ship Latuf , which, according to several reports, was carrying Turkish weapons and communications equipment for the Turkish base in Mogadishu. Each such operation normalizes a Turkish homeport in Somali waters and brings the Turkish navy closer to the Gulf of Aden in waters the Somaliland coast guard patrols but over which Somalia has held no sway for decades. Given Mogadishu’s encroachment on Somaliland airspace, Somaliland is right to be concerned that the Turkey-Somalia naval arrangement aims to deny Somaliland full access to the sea and instead seeks to tighten the blockade. Turkey’s behavior elsewhere in Somalia also raises alarm. On September 3, 2026, a strike hit the Doolow residence of General Mahad Abdirahman, former commander of the Somali Custodial Corps and an opposition figure, wounding him, his wife, and several civilians. The Jubaland state’s government blamed Turkey. Mogadishu denied any role, and Ankara has offered no comment. Protesters in Kismayo, Afmadow, Doolow, and Puntland’s Dangoroyo burned Turkish flags. If Ankara seeks to help Hassan Sheikh Mohamud centralize control over federal states, then Hargeisa cannot assume Turkey will stay out of any future contest with Somaliland. Rather than close the consulate, Hargeisa should … demand that Ankara accept a reciprocal Somaliland office in Turkey. There is a case for keeping the consulate. It can process visas for Somalilanders who study, trade or seek treatment in Turkey, though e-visa processing undermines its consular importance relative to what it was a few years ago. Expelling the consulate would hand Mogadishu a narrative that Somaliland has become an Israeli client. Somaliland’s strongest argument for statehood has always been its conduct, and a state that honors consular norms makes that argument better than one that slams doors. The channel also may matter to Ankara, if Turkey needs a way to step back from positions Mogadishu has pushed it into. The Vienna Convention on Consular Relations allows a receiving state to close zones to consular staff for national security and to declare any consular officer unacceptable without explanation. Rather than close the consulate, Hargeisa should apply those rules, placing Berbera’s port, airport, and coastline off-limits to foreign consular personnel, and demand that Ankara accept a reciprocal Somaliland office in Turkey. If Ankara refuses, the consulate should close. Ankara probably will refuse, and Hargeisa should be ready for that answer. A refusal would let Somaliland close the consulate on grounds of reciprocity. The State Department should condition security assistance to Mogadishu on a credible investigation of the Doolow strike and press Ankara, through the alliance, to disclose what missiles and rockets it intends to test at Warsheikh. It should also back Hargeisa’s right to set the terms on which foreign missions operate on its soil   Source Meforum.org

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay xaaladda Magaalada Beledweyne
items.description: Wararka laga helayo Magaalada Beledweyne ee Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sheegaya in maalintii labaad ay xaalad kacsanaan ah ka jirto magaaladaasi. Magaalada ayaa Arbacadii gashay xaalad fowdo ah oo hal qof uu ku dhintay, dhowr kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Dadka deegaanka ayaa mucaaradsan Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle iyo joogitaanka Cabdifitaax Xasan Afrax ee magaalada. Cabdifitaax Xasan Afrax oo loo wado jegada Madaxweyne Kuxigeenka Hirshabelle ayaa gelinkii dambe ee Talaadadii gaaray magaaladaasi. Beledweyne ayaa waxay ka mid ahayd 12 magaalo oo ka tirsan labada gobol ee Hirshabelle ee horey loo sheegay inay ka dhaceyso doorashada isku sidkan ee Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Hirshabelle. Goobo aad u xaddidan oo Magaalada Beledweyne ah ayay Arbacadii ka dhacday doorashada, taas oo ay wehlisay xaalad kacsan iyo bannaanbaxyo lagaga soo horjeedo. Intii ay socotay codaynta Doorashada Baarlamaanka iyo tan Golaha Deegaanka, dad badan oo reer Beledweyne ah ayaa isugu soo baxay waddooyinka magaalada, iyagoo ka biyo diidan hannaanka doorashada oo ay u arkaan mid aan la isku raacsanayn. Wariyeyaasha ayaa soo sheegaya in goobaha ganacsiga ee magaalada ay xiran yihiin maalintii labaad. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo gacan siinaya laamaha amniga ee Beledweyne ayaa isku dayaya in ay sugaan amniga magaaladaasi. Inkasta oo Xildhibaan Maalik Ibraahim Cabdalla oo ka tirsan Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka uu sheegay in Madaxda Siyaasadda iyo Dhaqanka ee Gobolka Hiiraan ay qaateen in laga hortago colaad ka dhacda magaalada, haddana Beledweyne ayaa waxaa ka jira diidmo xooggan oo ka dhan ah Maamulka Hirshabelle.

items.title: Look at the words: How the Constitution fulfills a promise
items.description: Look at the words: How the Constitution fulfills a promise By Charles Hoskinson On September 17, 1787, America’s Founding Fathers signed the U.S. Constitution, creating a government that would fulfill the promise of the Declaration of Independence, signed 11 years earlier. The framers very consciously wrote a Constitution that, in many ways, reflects the words of the earlier document, says Jason Stevens, a political science professor at Ashland University in Ohio. For instance, the Constitution highlights the Declaration’s principle that “all men are created equal” by prohibiting titles of nobility. The framers underscore the Declaration’s idea that a government derives its power from the people’s “consent” with the Constitution’s first three words: “We the people.” The Declaration’s commitment to liberty is mirrored in the Constitution’s precept that the government “secure the blessings of liberty to ourselves and our posterity.” “In a whole variety of ways it points back to the principles of the Declaration of Independence,” Stevens tells The American Idea podcast. A careful read of the two documents’ language shows a through line from the Declaration of Independence to the U.S. Constitution. (State Dept.) The Constitution was formulated for that September 17 signing after some founders lobbied to amend the existing “Articles of Confederation,” which had guided the new nation since shortly after it declared independence from Britain in 1776. The Constitutional Convention in Philadelphia — presided over by George Washington , the Army’s commander during the Revolutionary War — included several men who had signed the Declaration of Independence , including Benjamin Franklin, who had edited the Declaration’s drafts. At the September 1787 Convention, James Madison took notes and put forth a structure for the Constitution that would base a government on a separation of powers among three independent branches. Some states declined to ratify the Constitution without a bill of rights that expressly guaranteed certain protections they had been denied by the British King George III . Again, the founders looked to the Declaration of Independence, which lists “unalienable rights” and outlines specific grievances against Britain that the new document would aim to prevent. It took until 1789, but the founders proposed to amend the Constitution to include a Bill of Rights that guarantees freedom of religion, the right to trial by jury and the right to petition the government for redress of grievances, among other protections. The words of the Declaration and the Constitution have been repeated by U.S. leaders throughout history. On November 19, 1863, President Abraham Lincoln echoed them in his Gettysburg Address delivered on a Civil War battlefield, describing the then-divided country as “conceived in liberty, and dedicated to the proposition that all men are created equal.” U.S. Supreme Court Justice Neil Gorsuch, speaking on The Blessings of Liberty podcast, describes the U.S. Constitution as “a mission statement” for achieving the ideals of the Declaration of Independence. “As imperfect as the Constitution may be, it’s about the most perfect thing men and women could come up with in their time,” he says.

items.title: Puntland oo soo bandhigtay markabkii laga soo furtay burcad-badeedda ee SIBU-1 + Sawirro
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Markabka SIBU 1/SEAMUL ayaa maanta la soo gaarsiiyay magaalada Boosaaso kadib markii maalmo ka hor laga soo furtay koox burcad-badeed ah oo ku haysatay xeebaha Puntland. Saraakiisha ciidamada Badda Puntland ee PMPF ayaa sheegay in markabka iyo shaqaalihiisu ay hadda ku sugan yihiin xaalad wanaagsan, iyadoo Taliye-ku-xigeenka Howl-gelinta ciidamada, Col. Maxamuud Abshir Leewar uu xubno ka tirsan Golaha Wasiirrada Puntland warbixin ka siiyay xaaladda markabka. Warbixinta uu Taliye-ku-xigeenku bixiyay ayaa la xiriirtay xaaladda shaqaalaha, hantida saaran markabka iyo badqabka guud ee markabka kadib markii ciidamada ay kasoo furteen gacanta burcad-badeedda. Col. Leewar ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in xilligan uusan jirin wax markab ah oo xeebaha Puntland ama gudaha maamulka ugu afduuban kooxaha burcad-badeedda. Kabtanka SIBU 1/SEAMUL ayaa dhankiisa Puntland uga mahadceliyay howl-galka lagu soo furtay markabka iyo shaqaalihiisa, isagoo bogaadiyay dadaalka ciidamada iyo guusha ay ka gaareen howl-galka. Wasiirka Amniga Puntland, Ibraahim Cartan Ismaaciil (Xaaji Bakiin), Wasiirka Dekedaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda, Shaakir Maxamed Guuleed iyo Wasiir-ku-xigeenka Warfaafinta, Bille Maxamuud Qabowsade ayaa iyaguna ka hadlay howl-gallada ka dhanka ah burcad-badeedda. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in Puntland ay waddo dadaallo lagu sugayo amniga iyo xasilloonida xeebaha, iyagoo fariin adag u diray cid kasta oo ku lug yeelata falalka burcad-badeednimada. Waxay sheegeen in dadka lagu helo falalka burcad-badeednimada iyo dambiyada kale ee badda la horkeeni doono sharciga, lana marsiin doono tallaabooyinka waafaqsan dambiyada lagu helo. Puntland ayaa mar kale ku celisay inay ka go’an tahay sugidda amniga xeebaha iyo sii wadidda howl-gallada ka dhanka ah burcad-badeedda iyo dambiyada kale ee ka dhaca biyaha maamulkooda. Ciidamada PMPF ayaa sidoo kale haatan ku jira feejignaan sare inta ay howlgalladaasi socdaan, si looga hortago falal kale oo burcad-badeednimo oo ka dhaca xeebaha Puntland. items.title: Maxay DF ka tiri warka ah in Itoobiya ay ciidamadeeda kala baxeyso Soomaaliya?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in Itoobiya aysan ku soo wargelin wax qorshe ah oo ay ciidamadeeda ugala baxeyso Soomaaliya, kadib markii ay soo baxeen warar sheegaya in Addis Ababa ay qorsheyneyso inay dalka kala baxdo in ka badan 3,000 oo askari. Sarkaal ka tirsan Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa Caasimada Online u sheegay in Muqdisho aysan wax ogeysiis ah ka helin dowladda Itoobiya oo ku saabsan qorshe noocaas ah. “Itoobiya naguma soo wargelin wax qorshe ah oo ah inay ciidankeeda kala baxeyso Soomaaliya. Haddii ay sidaas noo sheegaan, waan idiin sheegi doonnaa,” ayuu sarkaalku yiri. Hadalkan ayaa yimid kadib markii warbaahinta Bloomberg ay werisay in dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed ay diyaarineyso inay kumannaan askari kala baxdo Soomaaliya, xilli dagaallada gudaha Itoobiya ay sii xoogeysanayaan. Bloomberg ayaa sheegtay in in ka badan 3,000 oo askari laga yaabo inay Soomaaliya ka baxaan maalmaha ama toddobaadyada soo socda, iyadoo soo xiganeysa ilo xog-ogaal u ah qorshaha. Weli ma cadda in ciidamada la sheegay in la saarayo ay yihiin kuwa Itoobiya kaga jira howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, kuwa ku jooga heshiisyo laba geesood ah, ama labada qeyboodba. Bixitaan ma yahay suurta-gal? Cabdinaasir Maxamed, oo ah falanqeeye amni oo fadhigiisu yahay Muqdisho, ayaa sheegay inuu soo dhoweynayo haddii ciidamada Itoobiya laga saaro Soomaaliya, isaga oo si adag u dhaliilay kaalintii Addis Ababa ay dalka ku lahayd sanadihii lasoo dhaafay. “Waa war aad loogu farxo in Itoobiyaanka ka baxaan Soomaaliya. Muddo tobannaan sano ah ayey dhibaatooyin ka wadeen gudaha dalka, waxayna ku lahaayeen saameyn aad u taban oo ay tahay inay soo dhammaato, waana la joogaa waqtigii ay dhammaan lahayd,” ayuu Cabdinaasir yiri. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu sheegay inuu weli shaki ka qabo in Itoobiya dhab ahaan qorsheyneyso inay si weyn u yareyso joogitaankeeda militari ee Soomaaliya. “Balse waxaan weli qabaa shaki ah in arrintan dhab tahay iyo in kale, sababtoo ah marna Itoobiya ma dooneyso inay lumiso saameynta ay ku leedahay Soomaaliya, ee taban, si gaar ahna saameynta amni,” ayuu yiri. “Balse haddii ay run tahay waa arrin mudan in la soo dhoweeyo.” Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer ciidamo ku lahayd Soomaaliya, qaar ka tirsan howlgalka Midowga Afrika iyo kuwo kale oo ku jooga heshiisyo laba geesood ah oo ay la gashay dowladda Soomaaliya. Joogitaanka ciidamada Itoobiya ayaa mar kale noqday arrin siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah markii xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Addis Ababa uu xumaaday kadib heshiiskii is-afgaradka ahaa ee Itoobiya la gashay Somaliland horraantii 2024. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa xilligaas si adag uga hortimid heshiiska, waxaana Muqdisho ay sidoo kale dalbatay inaan ciidamada Itoobiya lagu darin howlgalka cusub ee AUSSOM. Cabdinaasir ayaa sheegay in dadaalkii Itoobiya ay xilligaas ugu jirtay inay ciidamadeedu kusii jiraan Soomaaliya uu sabab u yahay shakiga uu hadda ka qabo wararka bixitaanka. “Waxaa xusid mudan markii Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya isku qabteen MoU Somaliland, ee Muqdisho dalbatay in ciidanka Itoobiya laga saaro AUSSOM, Addis Ababa waxay dadaal dheer u gashay sidii taasi aysan u dhici lahayn,” ayuu yiri. “Taasi waxay kuu caddeyneysaa in Itoobiya aysan marna dooneyn inay ka tagto Soomaaliya. Balse waan arki doonnaa.” Kulankii Xasan Sheekh iyo Abiy Wararka ku saabsan suurta-galnimada bixitaanka ciidamada Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmaya maalin kadib markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu Addis Ababa kula kulmay Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed. Labada hoggaamiye ayaa ka wada hadlay xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladaha siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Geeska Afrika, sida ay sheegtay madaxtooyada Soomaaliya. Labada dowladood wax heshiis ah kama aysan shaacin kulanka, mana aysan sheegin in Xasan Sheekh iyo Abiy ay ka wada hadleen suuragalnimada in Itoobiya ciidamo kala baxdo Soomaaliya. Arrintaas ayaa kusoo beegmeysa iyadoo xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Addis Ababa uu soo hagaagay kadib khilaafkii xooganaa ee ka dhashay heshiiskii Itoobiya iyo Somaliland. Hase yeeshee, ilaa hadda dowladda Itoobiya si rasmi ah ugama aysan dhawaaqin inay wax ka beddeleyso tirada ama qaabka ciidamada ay ku leedahay Soomaaliya, halka dowladda federaalkuna ay sheegtay inaan wax qorshe bixitaan ah lala wadaagin. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu sheegay inuu weli shaki ka qabo in Itoobiya dhab ahaan qorsheyneyso inay si weyn u yareyso joogitaankeeda militari ee Soomaaliya. “Balse waxaan weli qabaa shaki ah in arrintan dhab tahay iyo in kale, sababtoo ah marna Itoobiya ma dooneyso inay lumiso saameynta ay ku leedahay Soomaaliya, ee taban, si gaar ahna saameynta amni,” ayuu yiri. “Balse haddii ay run tahay waa arrin mudan in la soo dhoweeyo.” Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer ciidamo ku lahayd Soomaaliya, qaar ka tirsan howlgalka Midowga Afrika iyo kuwo kale oo ku jooga heshiisyo laba geesood ah oo ay la gashay dowladda Soomaaliya. Joogitaanka ciidamada Itoobiya ayaa mar kale noqday arrin siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah markii xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Addis Ababa uu xumaaday kadib heshiiskii is-afgaradka ahaa ee Itoobiya la gashay Somaliland horraantii 2024. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa xilligaas si adag uga hortimid heshiiska, waxaana Muqdisho ay sidoo kale dalbatay inaan ciidamada Itoobiya lagu darin howlgalka cusub ee AUSSOM. Cabdinaasir ayaa sheegay in dadaalkii Itoobiya ay xilligaas ugu jirtay inay ciidamadeedu kusii jiraan Soomaaliya uu sabab u yahay shakiga uu hadda ka qabo wararka bixitaanka. “Waxaa xusid mudan markii Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya isku qabteen MoU Somaliland, ee Muqdisho dalbatay in ciidanka Itoobiya laga saaro AUSSOM, Addis Ababa waxay dadaal dheer u gashay sidii taasi aysan u dhici lahayn,” ayuu yiri. “Taasi waxay kuu caddeyneysaa in Itoobiya aysan marna dooneyn inay ka tagto Soomaaliya. Balse waan arki doonnaa.” Kulankii Xasan Sheekh iyo Abiy Wararka ku saabsan suurta-galnimada bixitaanka ciidamada Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmaya maalin kadib markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu Addis Ababa kula kulmay Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed. Labada hoggaamiye ayaa ka wada hadlay xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladaha siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Geeska Afrika, sida ay sheegtay madaxtooyada Soomaaliya. Labada dowladood wax heshiis ah kama aysan shaacin kulanka, mana aysan sheegin in Xasan Sheekh iyo Abiy ay ka wada hadleen suuragalnimada in Itoobiya ciidamo kala baxdo Soomaaliya. Arrintaas ayaa kusoo beegmeysa iyadoo xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Addis Ababa uu soo hagaagay kadib khilaafkii xooganaa ee ka dhashay heshiiskii Itoobiya iyo Somaliland. Hase yeeshee, ilaa hadda dowladda Itoobiya si rasmi ah ugama aysan dhawaaqin inay wax ka beddeleyso tirada ama qaabka ciidamada ay ku leedahay Soomaaliya, halka dowladda federaalkuna ay sheegtay inaan wax qorshe bixitaan ah lala wadaagin. items.title: MADAXWEYNE XASAN SHEEKH OO WARQADAHA AQOONSIGA KA GUDDOOMAY SAFIIRRADA CUSUB EE TURKIGA IYO MIDOWGA YURUB
items.description: Muqdisho, 1 Oktoobar 2026: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta Madaxtooyada Qaranka kaga guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga danjirenimo safiirrada cusub ee Türkiye iyo Midowga Yurub. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Warqadaha Aqoonsiga ka Guddoomay Safiirrada Cusub ee Turkiga iyo Midowga Yurub Madaxweynaha ayaa warqadaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay Danjire Ferhat Alkan, oo ah safiirka cusub ee Türkiye, iyo Danjire László Máthé, oo ah wakiilka cusub ee Midowga Yurub ee Soomaaliya. Intii uu kulanku socday, Madaxweynaha ayaa danjireyaasha kala hadlay xaaladda Soomaaliya iyo horumarka laga sameeyay dhinacyada amniga, dowlad-dhiska, dimuqraadiyeynta iyo horumarinta dalka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya ay la leedahay Türkiye iyo Midowga Yurub, si loo gaaro himilooyinka iyo danaha wadajirka ah. Dhinaca kale, danjireyaasha ayaa Madaxweynaha soo gaarsiiyay salaan iyo farriimo ay ka sideen madaxdooda, iyagoo bogaadiyay horumarka Soomaaliya ka sameysay dowlad-dhiska, amniga iyo horumarinta dalka.

items.title: Maxamed Mursal oo rajo geliyay Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa Madaxtooyada Magaalada Baydhabo ku qaabilay wafdi uu hoggaaminayo Gudoomiyihii hore ee Golaha Shacabka, Maxamed Mursal Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan oo maanta gaaray magaaladaasi. War ka soo baxay Xafiiska Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa lagu sheegay in kulanka looga hadlay xaaladda guud ee Koonfur Galbeed, arrimaha siyaasadda, amniga, dowlad-dhiska iyo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa midnimada iyo wadajirka bulshada. Ilo wareedyo muhiim ah ayaa sheegaya in Aadan Madoobe uu codsi u dirsaday Maxamed Mursal Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan si uu uga taageero, sidii salka loogu dhigi lahaa maamulkiisa cusub. Maxamed Mursal oo muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ku noolaa dalka dibaddiisa ayaa horey uga horyimid is bedelkii siyaasadeed iyo amni ee 30-kii bishii March ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo, meeeshana looga saaray hoggaankii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed ama Maamulkii Madaxweyne Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Maxamed Mursal oo ka mid ah Siyaasiyiinta Koonfur Galbeed ayaa xitaa ka horyimid doorashadii 10-kii bishii June ka dhacday Baydhabo ee Aadan Madoobe loogu doortay xilka Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Maxamed Mursal ayaa la xusuustaa in uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku dhalleeceeyay in uu ku tumanayo shucuuda dalka, isla-markaana uu dib-u-dhac siyaasadeed u horseedayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Aadan Madoobe oo Khamiistan shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Madaxtooyada Baydhabo ayaa sheegay inuu ku faraxsan yahay booqashada ay ugu yimaadeen wafdiga uu horkacayo Maxamed Mursal, isla-markaana ay ka doonayaan inay hoggaamiyaan dib-u-heshiisiinta dadka reer Koonfur Galbeed. Aadan Madoobe ayaa sheegay inay doonayaan in la xalliyo oo la dhameeyo wax kasta oo lagu kala aragti duwan yahay, isla-markaana aan loo baahnayn iska horimaadyo hubeysan oo dad ku dhintaan. Aadan Madoobe ayaa garabka ka soo horjeeda ugu baaqay wada hadal iyo in is afgarad lagu dhameeyo khilaafka siyaasadeed, halkii la adeegsan lahaa qori caaraddii iyo dagaal keeni kara dhimasho iyo burbur. Maamulka Aadan Madoobe ayaa loolan siyaasadeed iyo mid ciidan kala kulmaya hoggaankii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, oo aan aqoonsanayn doorashadiisa. Safarka wafdiga Maxamed Mursal ee Baydhabo ayaa rajo gelinaya Aadan Madoobe, si uu xasillooni ugu dhameysto shanta sano ee xafiiska loo doortay.
