items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee Dagaalka Itoobiya
items.description: Dagaallada dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya ayaa sii xoogeysanaya, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo xoogagga Tigray ay ku dagaallamayaan meelo kala duwan oo ka tirsan gobolka Tigray, halka colaadduna ay ku fiday gobollada deriska la ah ee Afar iyo Amhara. Dagaalladan cusub ayaa si weyn u wiiqaya heshiiskii nabadeed ee Pretoria ee bishii November 2022 lagu soo afjaray dagaalkii Tigray ee socday 2020 ilaa 2022, kaas oo sababay khasaare naf iyo barakac ballaaran. wararkii ugu dambeeyay ayaa sheegaya in ugu yaraan 52 qof oo rayid ah lagu dilay saddex maalmood oo dagaal oo ah agagaarka Alamata, inkastoo tirada guud ee khasaaraha dhimashada iyo dhaawaca ay weli adag tahay in si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyo. Dagaalladu kuma koobna Tigray oo keliya, balse waxay gaareen gobollada Afar iyo Amhara, ayadoo xoogagga Tigray  la sheegay inay la wareegeen deegaanka Erebti ee gobolka Afar, halkaas oo dagaalladu ay walaac ka abuureen ammaanka waddada muhiimka ah ee isku xirta Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti. Waddadan ayaa ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga Itoobiya iyo badeecadaha iyo shidaalka dalka uga soo gala dekedaha Jabuuti, Gobolka Amhara ayaa sidoo kale laga soo sheegay dagaallo ka dhacay agagaarka Waqooyiga Wollo iyo meelaha ku dhow Lalibela. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa sheegtay in boqolaal dagaalyahanno Tigray ah lagu dilay dagaallada, hase yeeshee tirooyinka khasaaraha ee ay bixiyaan dhinacyada dagaallamaya si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Xaaladda ayaa sii murugtay kadib markii mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Itoobiya iyo maamulka Afar ay Eritrea ku eedeeyeen inay ku lug leedahay dagaallada cusub. Ku-xigeenka guddoomiyaha gobolka Afar ayaa warbaahinta u sheegay in Eritrea ay mas’uul ka tahay weerarka ka dhacay gobolka, halka saraakiil kale oo Itoobiyaan ah ay Eritrea ku eedeeyeen inay taageero siiso xoogagga TPLF. Eedeymahan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiriirka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea uu muddooyinkii dambe sii xumaaday. Eritrea ayaa horey u diidday eedeymaha la xiriira taageerada kooxaha hubeysan ee ka soo horjeeda dowladda Itoobiya, sidaas darteedna sheegashada ku saabsan heerka iyo qaabka ay Eritrea uga qeyb qaadaneyso dagaalka weli waxay u baahan tahay xaqiijin madax-bannaan. Xiisadda ayaa sidoo kale la xiriirta isbahaysi cusub oo ay sameeyeen kooxo hubeysan oo ka soo horjeeda dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed. TPLF ayaa lagu sheegay inay ku biirtay isbahaysi ay sameeyeen toddobo kooxood oo hubeysan, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan Fano-ga Amhara iyo Oromo Liberation Army. Kooxahan ayaa leh dano iyo khilaafaadyo kala duwan, gaar ahaan muranka dhulka Galbeedka Tigray iyo mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee Itoobiya, taasoo sii adkeynaysa xaaladda. Dagaallada ayaa sidoo kale saameyn weyn ku yeeshay dadka rayidka ah, ayadoo Hay’adda MSF ay sheegtay in tirada dadka dhaawaca ah ee la gaarsiiyay isbitaallada Korem iyo Alamata ay 48 saacadood gudahood ka korodhay qiyaastii 180 ilaa in ka badan 420 qof, iyadoo boqolaal kale lagu daweeyay xarumo caafimaad oo kale. Warbixinno kale ayaa sheegaya in ku dhowaad 150,000 oo qof ay ku barakaceen dagaallada cusub, halka adeegyada isgaarsiinta iyo internet-ka ay meelo ka mid ah Tigray ka go’een, taasoo adkeynaysa helitaanka wararka iyo gargaarka bani’aadamnimo. Dib u soo noqoshada dagaallada ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in Itoobiya ay dib ugu laabato colaaddii ballaarneyd ee 2020–2022. Midowga Afrika iyo urur goboleedka IGAD ayaa ku baaqay in dhinacyada dagaallamaya ay joojiyaan colaadda oo ay dib ugu laabtaan wadahadal.

items.title: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda Soomaaliya oo Waraaqaha Aqoonsiga ka guddoontay Safiirka cusub ee Turkiga
items.description: Ku-xigeenka Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Maxamed Cali (Nadaara) , ayaa Muqdisho ku qaabilay waraaqaha aqoonsiga ee Ferhat Alkan , Safiirka cusub ee Turkiga u qaabilsan Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ku tilmaameen labada dal kuwo xiriir dhow oo ku dhisan diin, taariikh iyo iskaashi soo jireen ah . Ku-xigeenka Wasiirka ayaa soo dhaweeyay Safiirka cusub, isagoo muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka labada dal iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan. items.title: Pakistan oo ka tacsiyeysay geerida shan shaqaale Markab ah oo ku dhintay Xeebaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Dowladda Pakistan ayaa tacsi u dirtay qoysaska iyo ehellada shan shaqaale ah oo ku geeriyooday dhacdo ka dhacday meel ka baxsan xeebaha Soomaaliya. Pakistan ayaa muujisay murugada ay ka qabto geerida shaqaalaha markabka, iyadoo tacsi iyo garab istaag u dirtay qoysaskooda xilligan adag. Dhacdadan ayaa la xiriirta markabka M.T. Geerida shantan shaqaale ayaa oo dhowaan ay burcad-badeed Soomaali ahi afduubteen ayaa dhalisay walaac, waxaana markii dambe marka soo furtay ciidaamada puntland. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in burcad-badeedu ay si bareer ah u toogteen shan kamid ah shaqaalihii markabkaas ka hor inta aanay ciidamadu howl-gal furashada ah fulin. Pakistan iyo Soomaaliya waxay leeyihiin xiriir soo jireen ah, gaar ahaan dhinacyada ganacsiga, amniga iyo iskaashiga badda.

items.title: Tigray War Flares Again as Ethiopia Accuses Eritrea and Sudan of Backing Rebels
items.description: Tigray erupts again, Ethiopia teeters on the edge of a wider war as rebels advance, drones strike and regional powers are accused of intervening ADDIS ABABA — (WDN) – Ethiopia’s northern war has erupted again, raising fears of a return to the devastating 2020–2022 conflict as federal forces battle the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) and accuse Eritrea and Sudan of supporting armed groups fighting the government. Heavy clashes have continued since Wednesday, with the TPLF claiming it is fighting a defensive war against Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government. The renewed conflict comes less than four years after the Pretoria peace agreement ended the previous war, which is estimated to have killed hundreds of thousands of people. The renewed fighting is already spreading beyond Tigray. The TPLF has reportedly seized airports and launched attacks into neighbouring Afar and Amhara regions. A humanitarian source said the Afar town of Erebti, near the Tigray border, fell to Tigrayan forces on Sunday following heavy artillery fire. The source said TPLF forces were advancing toward Afdeera, about 100 kilometres farther east. The source estimated that at least 150,000 people had been displaced in Afar, although communications difficulties have made precise figures impossible to establish. Addis Ababa Accuses Regional Powers Ethiopia’s military chief, Field Marshal Birhanu Jula, accused Eritrea and Sudan of supporting forces fighting the federal army. Speaking through the army’s YouTube channel, Jula said the government was confronting armed groups allegedly organised and supported by external powers. He specifically accused Eritrea and Sudan, as well as Egypt and other outside actors, of providing backing. The allegations have not been independently verified. The accusations nevertheless highlight the increasingly regional character of the conflict. Eritrea fought alongside Ethiopian federal forces during the previous Tigray war but has since become increasingly hostile to the TPLF and remains deeply distrustful of developments in Addis Ababa and Tigray. The TPLF, meanwhile, has joined a wider alliance of armed groups opposed to Abiy’s government, creating the possibility that the renewed conflict could extend beyond northern Ethiopia. Tigrai TV Knocked Off Air The conflict has also struck one of Tigray’s principal media outlets. Tigrai TV, based in Mekelle and closely associated with the Tigrayan authorities, was hit by a drone strike on Sunday, according to journalists and local sources. A journalist at the station told AFP that staff heard a loud explosion and fled the building. Photographs showed damage to the facade, blackened walls and shattered windows. The station, which reportedly employs about 400 people, was subsequently taken off air. There were no immediate reports of casualties. The federal government had already announced on September 21 that Tigrai TV would be suspended indefinitely and ordered other media organisations not to broadcast its reports. The attack therefore comes amid an increasingly restricted information environment in which independent verification of battlefield developments is becoming more difficult. Tigray Cut Off from the Outside World Communications across Tigray have also been severely disrupted since Friday, with major interruptions to telephone and internet services. The blackout has revived memories of the communications and humanitarian blockade imposed during the 2020–2022 war, when electricity, banking and much-needed humanitarian assistance were severely disrupted. For civilians, the consequences extend beyond access to news. Communications are essential for hospitals, businesses, financial services, humanitarian agencies and families attempting to locate relatives in conflict zones. The current disruption is also making it increasingly difficult for journalists and aid organisations to independently assess casualties and displacement. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has expressed concern over the renewed fighting, particularly reports of drone attacks and civilian harm. A Wider Battlefield The TPLF’s expansion into Afar is strategically significant. Afar contains key routes connecting Ethiopia to Djibouti, through which much of Ethiopia’s international trade passes. Any sustained fighting along those corridors could disrupt fuel supplies, commercial transport and humanitarian operations. The TPLF’s renewed military campaign also raises memories of the final phase of the previous war, when Tigrayan forces pushed south through Amhara toward Addis Ababa before being driven back. The federal government now possesses substantial military capabilities, including drones and a large standing force, as well as support from regional partners. But military superiority does not necessarily guarantee a quick resolution. A prolonged conflict could draw in neighbouring countries, deepen ethnic and political divisions and create another humanitarian catastrophe. A Peace Agreement Under Strain The TPLF dominated Ethiopian politics for nearly three decades after overthrowing the Derg regime in 1991. Its political dominance ended after Abiy became prime minister in 2018. The relationship between Addis Ababa and the TPLF subsequently deteriorated into open war in November 2020. The conflict was marked by mass civilian suffering, displacement, alleged war crimes and widespread reports of sexual violence. The 2022 Pretoria peace agreement, brokered with African and international support, brought the major fighting to an end but left many issues unresolved. The agreement was never fully implemented. Disputes over territorial control, the return of displaced people, disarmament and political authority remained unresolved, while sporadic clashes continued. Rights organisations have also accused Tigrayan authorities of forced recruitment as tensions increased this year. The federal government, meanwhile, has conducted drone strikes in Tigray and reportedly increased troop deployments around the region. The Risk of Another National War The greatest danger is that the renewed fighting will no longer remain a Tigray conflict. With the TPLF operating beyond its traditional territory, armed groups elsewhere challenging Addis Ababa, and neighbouring states potentially becoming involved, Ethiopia risks sliding into a broader conflict involving multiple regional and ethnic actors. The communications blackout makes the situation even more dangerous: the less information available, the harder it becomes to distinguish battlefield reality from competing propaganda and the harder it is for humanitarian organisations to respond. Ethiopia has already experienced the enormous human cost of a war in Tigray. The renewed fighting demonstrates how little has been resolved beneath the surface of the Pretoria peace agreement. The immediate priority is therefore not simply military advantage, but preventing another conflict from spreading across Ethiopia’s already fragile political landscape. The question now is whether the parties can step back from another devastating war—or whether Ethiopia is once again heading toward a conflict whose consequences will reach far beyond Tigray. items.title: SCAA oo ka digeysa roobab xooggan oo ku soo aadan Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (WDN) — Soomaaliya ayaa la filayaa in maalmaha soo socda ay roobab ba’an ka da’aan qaybo kala duwan oo dalka ah. Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed (SCAA) aya dhawaan soo saarto digniin la xiriirta xaaladda cimilada, isla markaana ugu baaqdo shirkadaha diyaaraddaha, garoomada diyaaradaha iyo rakaabka inay muujiyaan feejignaan dheeraad ah. SCAA ayaa sheegtay in saadaasha cimiladu muujinayso roobab dhexdhexaad ah ilaa kuwa xooggan oo laga filayo qaybo ka mid ah galbeedka Soomaaliya, gobollada dhexe iyo deegaanno ka tirsan bariga dalka. Gobollada la filayo inay helaan roobab dhexdhexaad ah waxaa ka mid ah Sool, Nugaal, Mudug, Shabeellaha iyo Gedo, iyadoo xoogga roobabku uu ku kala duwanaan doono deegaannada. Hay’addu waxay ka digtay in isbeddellada xaaladaha cimiladu ay saamayn ku yeelan karaan badqabka duulimaadyada, waxayna shirkadaha diyaaradaha, garoomada iyo rakaabka kula talisay inay si dhow ula socdaan saadaasha cimilada iyo digniinaha la xiriira duulista. Rakaabka safraya muddadan waxaa sidaas darteed lagula dardaarmay inay si joogto ah ula socdaan wararka rasmiga ah ee cimilada iyo xaaladda duulimaadyada, isla markaana ay raacaan xogaha iyo tilmaamaha ay soo saaraan shirkadaha diyaaradaha iyo hay’adaha duulista. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, SCAA waxay sheegtay in saadaasha hadda jirta aysan muujinayn in Soomaaliya ay toddobaadka soo socda ku wajahan tahay duufaan weyn ama duufaan-badeed (cyclone) saameyn ballaaran leh. Hay’addu waxay intaas ku dartay inay si joogto ah ula socon doonto xaaladd cimilada, iyadoo adeegsanaysa saadaasha hawada iyo warbixinnada maalinlaha ah, si ay bulshada iyo dhinacyada duulista ugu gudbiso xogta ku saabsan isbeddello kasta oo saamayn ku yeelan kara duulimaadyada iyo badqabka hawada Soomaaliya. “Waxaan ugu baaqaynaa dhammaan shirkadaha diyaaradaha, garoomada diyaaradaha iyo dadka isticmaala adeegyada duulista inay si dhow ula socdaan isbeddellada ku yimaadda saadaasha cimilada,” ayay SCAA ku sheegtay digniinteeda. items.title: Laascaanood in wixii ka dhacay ka dhacaan, Somaliland ayay dan wayni ugu jirtay
items.description: Laascaanood in wixii ka dhacay ka dhacaan, Somaliland ayay dan wayni ugu jirtay kana faa’iidday. Xaalad khatar ah ayuu ku jiray jiritaanka Somaliland, dalku wuxuu marayay dhalinyaro Xamar u yaacaysa oo dhashay wixii ka danbeeyay 1991. Dhalinyaradaas may ogeeyn nacaybka Soomaali u qabto, sida loo galayo haddii dagaal dhaco. Laascaanood markii hawshu ka bilaabantay waxay indhahooda ku arkeen, sida maydka Isaaq,Samaroon, Ciise iyo Madigaan loola dhaqmayo, Dagaalku one week ayuu socday markii maydka ciidanka ay soo duubeen Hawidaar yagoo cunaya. Waxay indhahooda ku arkeen Gabdhihii ay qabeen reer Laascaanood ee calanka Somaliland gacmaha ugu jiray oo loosii jiidayo xabsiyada geerida. Waxyaabaha cajiibkaa waxaa kamida caydii, cunsirayaddii iyo nacaybkii reer gaara lagula kacayay sidii inaanay soomaali ahayn. Waxaa kasii cajiibsan in Daarood dhaheen nin Laangaab ah oo Dir ah sidee u xukumi karaa nin Daarood ah?! Hadda waa Dadkii ku baaqayay midnimada ayaa diiday in tuulada Laascaanood ee Somaliland biyaha galisay,cusbitaallada iyo laamiyada u dhistay inay xukummaan Dir!! Taasi waxay kor u qaadday Waddaniyadii, Midnimadii iyo Mintidnimadii shacabka Somaliland. Waxaa la ictiraafay Somaliland yadoo maqan dagmada Laascaanood, taasinna ma timaadeen haddii aan 2023 wixii dhacay aanay dhaceen. (وعسى أن تكرهوا شيئا وهو خير لكم) Ibrahim Yusuf

items.title: Itoobiya oo kumanaan askari kala baxaysa Soomaaliya kadib…
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa qorsheyneysa inay in ka badan 3,000 oo askari kala baxdo Soomaaliya, iyadoo dagaallada sii xoogeysanaya ee gudaha dalkaas ay xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed ku qasbayaan inay dib u habeyso ciidamadeeda, sida ay Arbacadii sheegtay Bloomberg. Ciidamada ayaa la filayaa inay Soomaaliya ka baxaan maalmaha ama toddobaadyada soo socda, sida ay Bloomberg kasoo xigatay dad xog-ogaal u ah qorshaha oo codsaday inaan magacyadooda la shaacin maadaama aan loo oggolaan inay warbaahinta la hadlaan. Bloomberg ma aysan sheegin in ciidamada la qorsheynayo in laga saaro Soomaaliya ay yihiin kuwa Itoobiya kaga jira howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, ciidamo ku jooga heshiis laba geesood ah, ama labadaba. Haddii qorshahan la fuliyo, wuxuu noqon karaa mid ka mid ah dib-u-celintii ugu weyneyd ee ciidamada Itoobiya looga saaro Soomaaliya sanadihii u dambeeyey, xilli dagaalka Al-Shabaab uu weli ka socdo qaybo badan oo dalka ah. Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer kumannaan askari ku haysay Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo qaarkood ka tirsan howlgalka Midowga Afrika, halka kuwo kalena ay ku joogaan heshiisyo toos ah oo dhinaca amniga ah. Ciidamada Itoobiya waxay si gaar ah uga howlgalaan gobollo ay ka mid yihiin Bay, Bakool, Gedo iyo Hiiraan, kuwaas oo qaarkood ku dhow xadka labada dal. Bloomberg ayaa sheegtay in afhayeen u hadlay dowladda Itoobiya uusan ka jawaabin su’aalo ay ka weydiisay dagaallada iyo qorshaha la sheegay ee ciidamada looga saarayo Soomaaliya. items.title: When Clan Becomes the Qualification: Somalia’s Civil Service Crisis Deepens
items.description: By Mohamed A Yasin Allegations of clan-based appointments raise fresh questions about merit, state capture and the future of Somalia’s public institutions. How can Somalia climb out of the hole of corruption when public institutions are increasingly accused of being treated as political and clan possessions rather than national institutions? That question has returned to the centre of Somalia’s political debate after the House of the People overturned a directive requiring senior government positions to be filled through competitive, merit-based recruitment. The directive, issued by Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre’s government, called for senior civil-service posts to be filled through competition based on qualifications, experience, competence and merit. The House of the People voted overwhelmingly to annul it on September 23, according to parliamentary reporting. Supporters of the directive described competitive recruitment as a step toward professionalising Somalia’s civil service. Its opponents, however, argued that the government could use the process to remove existing directors and replace them with political or clan allies under the appearance of an impartial competition. The dispute exposes a much deeper problem: whether Somalia’s public institutions can ever become genuinely professional if access to senior government positions is determined by clan connections rather than competence. The Immigration Agency: A Case That Demands Scrutiny The Immigration and Citizenship Agency provides a particularly striking example of the allegations now circulating. A list circulating publicly identifies 27 senior officials and staff in key positions within the agency and its overseas operations, and claims that all belong to the Murusade Hawiye clan. The list includes the Director General, finance director, visa director, senior advisers, ICT officials, immigration-crime officials, verification and procurement officers, passport-centre officials and supervisors, as well as officials assigned to Somali diplomatic missions in Djibouti, Yemen, Sweden, Syria, South Sudan, Riyadh and Germany. The current Director General, Hussein Qasim Yusuf, is officially confirmed as head of the Immigration and Citizenship Agency. He assumed the position in February 2026, according to the agency’s own records. But the agency’s official sources do not establish the clan identities of the 27 individuals listed above, nor do they establish that appointments were made on the basis of clan affiliation. Those allegations therefore require independent verification. That distinction is critical. If the allegations are accurate, however, the concentration of senior positions in one clan would raise serious questions about equal access to public employment, institutional neutrality and the professional independence of one of Somalia’s most strategically important government agencies. A Government Agency Is Not a Clan Share The broader accusation extends beyond immigration. Critics of Somalia’s federal government argue that a recurring pattern exists in which ministers and senior officials treat ministries and government agencies as political or clan allocations: existing officials are removed, transferred or demoted, while individuals considered politically or clan-connected to the new leadership are appointed. The result, critics argue, is a civil service in which the question is no longer “Who is qualified?” but “Who do you belong to?” Such a system would have consequences far beyond individual appointments. A professional civil service depends on continuity. Directors and technical officials should be able to remain in office because of competence and performance, not because they belong to the political network of the minister currently controlling their institution. When every change of political leadership produces a corresponding change in senior officials, government institutions become vulnerable to political capture. And when clan affiliation becomes an informal qualification for employment, public institutions risk becoming extensions of clan competition rather than instruments of the Somali state. The Parliament’s Intervention The parliamentary rejection of the recruitment directive has therefore exposed a fundamental contradiction. On paper, competitive recruitment sounds like precisely what Somalia needs: advertise positions, establish transparent qualifications, test candidates and select the highest-performing applicants. But the controversy demonstrates why the credibility of the institution conducting the competition matters as much as the competition itself. If existing directors believe that a recruitment exercise is designed to remove them and install politically connected replacements, confidence in the process collapses. Conversely, if directors are protected from legitimate performance-based competition simply because they already occupy their positions, professional reform also becomes impossible. The solution cannot be either unchecked political appointments or a recruitment process that is merely competition in name. The real requirement is an independent, transparent and enforceable civil-service system in which recruitment, promotion, dismissal and disciplinary action are governed by clear rules rather than political or clan influence. The Corruption Problem Is Bigger Than Money Somalia’s corruption problem is often discussed in terms of stolen public funds, procurement irregularities or misuse of government resources. But institutional patronage can be equally damaging. When public employment is distributed through political or clan networks, corruption becomes embedded in the structure of government itself. A position can become a reward. A ministry can become a political asset. A government agency can become a source of patronage. And public employment can become a mechanism for consolidating political influence. That is why the debate over civil-service recruitment matters far beyond the fate of individual directors. Somalia cannot build credible institutions while public positions are perceived to belong to whoever controls the ministry at a particular moment. The Test Is Whether the Rules Apply to Everyone The Immigration and Citizenship Agency is responsible for some of the most sensitive functions of the Somali state, including passports, border management, visas, citizenship and identity-related services. The agency itself describes its mission as safeguarding Somali citizenship and managing the country’s borders. That makes professional standards particularly important. The same principle applies across the government. If officials are appointed because they are qualified, the government should be able to demonstrate the qualifications and recruitment procedures publicly. If officials are removed, the government should explain the legal and performance-based reasons. If positions are advertised, the selection process should be independently monitored. And if allegations of clan concentration arise, the government should be willing to publish sufficient information to allow those allegations to be tested rather than simply dismissed. Transparency is the only credible answer to suspicion. Can Somalia Escape the Cycle? Somalia has spent years attempting to rebuild a functioning state after decades of institutional collapse. Yet state-building cannot succeed if political competition continues to penetrate the civil service. The country does not need ministries that belong to one minister, agencies that belong to one political faction or public jobs that belong to one clan. It needs institutions that belong to the Somali public. The parliamentary rejection of the government’s recruitment directive may have halted one particular process, but it does not resolve the underlying problem. The real challenge is to establish a civil service in which clan identity is irrelevant, political loyalty is not a qualification, and competence is not a threat to whoever happens to control the ministry. Until that principle becomes enforceable rather than aspirational, Somalia’s fight against corruption will remain incomplete. A country cannot climb out of the hole of corruption by changing the people who occupy government offices. It climbs out only when the rules governing those offices become stronger than the clans, politicians and individuals who control them. items.title: Voters Turn Out in Hirshabelle and Galmudug as One-Person, One-Vote Elections Begin
items.description: Beledweyne (WDN) — Voters turned out at polling stations across parts of Hirshabelle and Galmudug on Wednesday, September 30, 2026, casting ballots in simultaneous local council and regional assembly elections conducted under Somalia’s one-person, one-vote system. In Hirshabelle, voters are electing members of the Hirshabelle House of Representatives as well as district and local council members. In Galmudug, voters are likewise casting ballots for the state assembly and local councils. In Beledweyne, officials and residents joined voters at polling stations as the electoral process got underway. Hirshabelle deputy presidential candidate Abdifatah Hassan Afrah praised the turnout, describing public participation as an important step toward strengthening democratic participation, peace and social cohesion. He said the one-person, one-vote system gives citizens a direct role in choosing representatives who will influence decisions affecting their communities and urged voters to maintain peace throughout the process. Meanwhile, Liban Ahmed Hassan (Shuluq), a Galmudug leadership candidate from the JSP party, cast his ballot in Galkayo as voters across the state participated in the September 30 elections. Liban praised voters for their participation, patience and long queues at polling stations despite the heat. He also congratulated the people of Hirshabelle for taking part in the vote, saying the two states were advancing Somalia’s transition toward direct elections. He urged Galmudug residents who had not yet voted to go to polling stations while voting remained open and called for the elections in both states to conclude peacefully and with mutual respect. The unilateral one-person, one-vote elections being pursued in Hirshabelle and Galmudug are little more than political theater, driven by President Hassan, with the outcome predetermined and preferred candidates already selected by Villa Somalia. items.title: NIRA oo ku dhawaaqday in Aqoonsiga Qaranka looga baahan doono safarka gudaha dalka
items.description: Muqdisho, 30 Sebteembar 2026 – Hay’adda Aqoonsiga iyo Diiwaangelinta Qaranka (NIRA) ayaa sheegtay in laga bilaabo 1-da Oktoobar 2026, muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee ku safraya gudaha dalka looga baahan doono inay wataan Aqoonsiga Qaranka marka ay safarayaan. Sida lagu sheegay ogeysiiska NIRA, tallaabadan waxay khuseysaa dadka ku safraya gudaha Soomaaliya, waxaana lagu sheegay in dadka safarka gudaha ku jira laga hubin doono Aqoonsiga Qaranka. NIRA waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in dhammaan muwaadiniinta u safreysa gobollada dalka lagu wargelinayo inay horey u soo qaataan Kaarka Aqoonsiga Qaranka ama Shahaadada Aqoonsiga Qaranka. Hay’addu waxay tilmaantay in nidaamka Aqoonsiga Qaranka uu yahay qayb ka mid ah dadaallada lagu dhisayo nidaam aqoonsi oo mideysan, iyadoo NIRA ay tahay hay’adda qaabilsan bixinta aqoonsiga heer qaran, halka Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadaha (HSJ) ay qaabilsan tahay baasaboorrada iyo arrimaha socdaalka. Ogeysiiska NIRA ayaa xusay in go’aankan uu qeyb ka yahay heshiis ay NIRA iyo HSJ wada gaareen 30-kii Juun 2026. NIRA waxay sidoo kale horey u sheegtay in Aqoonsiga Qaranka loo adeegsan karo xaqiijinta qofka iyo helitaanka adeegyo kala duwan oo ay bixiyaan dowladda iyo hay’adaha gaarka loo leeyahay.

NIRA waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in dhammaan muwaadiniinta u safreysa gobollada dalka lagu wargelinayo inay horey u soo qaataan Kaarka Aqoonsiga Qaranka ama Shahaadada Aqoonsiga Qaranka. Hay’addu waxay tilmaantay in nidaamka Aqoonsiga Qaranka uu yahay qayb ka mid ah dadaallada lagu dhisayo nidaam aqoonsi oo mideysan, iyadoo NIRA ay tahay hay’adda qaabilsan bixinta aqoonsiga heer qaran, halka Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadaha (HSJ) ay qaabilsan tahay baasaboorrada iyo arrimaha socdaalka. Ogeysiiska NIRA ayaa xusay in go’aankan uu qeyb ka yahay heshiis ay NIRA iyo HSJ wada gaareen 30-kii Juun 2026. NIRA waxay sidoo kale horey u sheegtay in Aqoonsiga Qaranka loo adeegsan karo xaqiijinta qofka iyo helitaanka adeegyo kala duwan oo ay bixiyaan dowladda iyo hay’adaha gaarka loo leeyahay.

items.title: Pakistan oo war ka soo saartay muwaadiniinteeda lagu dilay Puntland iyo tallaabo ay qaadeyso
items.description: Islamabad (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Pakistan ayaa Arbacada maanta ah sheegtay inay socdaan dadaallo lagu soo celinayo meydadka saddex muwaadin oo Pakistani ah iyo badmaaxiinta kale ee ka badbaaday markabka MT Honour 25, oo muddo shan bilood ah ay haysteen burcad-badeed ka afduubatay xeebaha Soomaaliya. Markabka MT Honour 25 oo ka diiwaangashan Palau ayaa 21-kii April lagu afduubtay xeebaha Puntland, xilli ay saarnaayeen 17 shaqaale ah, oo 10 ka mid ah ay ahaayeen Pakistani. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Pakistan ayaa xaqiijisay in saddex ka mid ah muwaadiniinteeda ay dhinteen, kuwaas oo lagu kala magacaabi jiray Rafi Ullah Khan, Syed Kashif Umer iyo Mahmood Ahmed Ansari. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in guud ahaan shan shaqaale ah oo markabka saarnaa la dilay ka hor inta aysan ciidamadeedu bilaabin howlgalka lagu soo furtay markabka. Labada qof ee kale ee dhintay ayaa ahaa muwaadiniin u kala dhashay India iyo Myanmar, sida ay sheegtay Ciidanka Booliska Badda Puntland. Hay’addu ma aysan sheegin waqtiga saxda ah ama duruufaha ay ku dhinteen shaqaalaha, balse waxay sheegtay in dhimashadoodu ay dhacday ka hor inta uusan bilaaban howlgalka ciidamada Puntland. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Pakistan ayaa sheegtay inay aad uga murugootay khasaaraha, iyadoo sidoo kale xaqiijisay in afar shaqaale ah ay dhaawacmeen, oo saddex ka mid ah ay yihiin Pakistani. “Dadka dhaawacmay waxaa la geeyey isbitaal u dhow, waxaana la siinayaa daryeel caafimaad,” ayay wasaaraddu tiri. Waxay intaas ku dartay in shaqaalihii kale ee ka badbaaday markabka si nabad ah loo geeyey Bandar Beyla. Saraakiil ka tirsan safaaradda Pakistan ee Jabuuti ayaa loo diray Bandar Beyla si ay gacan uga geystaan daryeelka muwaadiniinta Pakistaniyiinta ah iyo qorshaha dib loogu celinayo dalkooda. “Dadaal kasta oo suurtagal ah ayaa lagu bixinayaa sidii dhaawacyada loo siin lahaa daryeel caafimaad oo habboon, loo fududeyn lahaa qaadista meydadka dadka dhintay, loona xaqiijin lahaa in shaqaalaha Pakistaniyiinta ah ee badbaaday ay si nabad ah dalkooda ugu laabtaan,” ayay wasaaraddu sheegtay. Ciidanka Booliska Badda Puntland ayaa Talaadadii sheegay inay si buuxda ula wareegeen MT Honour 25 kadib howlgalka. “Markabku hadda waa ammaan, wuxuuna ku jiraa gacanta Dowladda Puntland,” ayay ciidanku ku sheegeen qoraal ay ku daabaceen barta X. Waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in 21 qof oo looga shakisan yahay burcad-badeednimo la qabtay, halka baadigoobka xubno kale uu weli socdo. Howlgalka MT Honour 25 ayaa yimid maalmo kadib markii ciidamada Puntland ay dib ula wareegeen markabka SIBU 1, oo isna ay afduubteen kooxo burcad-badeed ah. Ka hor howlgalka Talaadadii, dad loo aqoonsaday inay ka mid ahaayeen shaqaalaha MT Honour 25 ayaa urur samafal oo Pakistani ah u sheegay in kooxdii haysatay ay ku hanjabtay inay dili doonto la haystayaasha haddii ciidamada ammaanku isku dayaan inay xoog ku soo furtaan markabka. Maamulka Puntland weli si faahfaahsan ugama hadlin sida ay u dhinteen shanta shaqaale ama xilliga ay dhacday dhimashadoodu, marka laga reebo inuu sheegay inay dhacday ka hor bilowgii howlgalka lagu soo furtay markabka. The post Pakistan oo war ka soo saartay muwaadiniinteeda lagu dilay Puntland iyo tallaabo ay qaadeyso appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Khudbaddii Midnimada: Ra’iisalwasaaraha JFS oo Jeediyay Khudbad Taariikhi ah
items.description: “Adoo wax ka gows qabsaday, Mar baa gefka loo liqaa, Inaan danta guud murkacan.” —Abwaan Maxamed Xaashi Dhamac (Gaarriye) Khudbaddii uu shalay Ra’iisalwasaaraha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya ka jeediyay furitaanka Bandhigga Dalxiiska ee ay soo agaasinta Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska ee JFS, waxay baaq qarannimo u ahayd ilaalinta iyo adkaynta midnimada dalka iyo dhowridda wadajirka iyo iskuduubnida bulshada, isla markaasna waxay ahayd hogatusaalayn iyo hagid xal u ah murannada hadda ka dhex jira hoggaanka Dawladda Federaalka ah iyo qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta dibedjoogga ka ah xeerarka dawliga ah. Hadaljeedintani ma ahayn khudbad xogtebin siyaasadeed ku kooban, waxay sidoo kale ahayd khudbad dareentaabad ah oo duunka qof kasta oo garasho toolmoon leh xulaysa, isla markaasna xadataynaysa. Mar waxay la hadlaysaa garaadka muwaaddinka Soomaaliyeed ee xilkaska ah, mar waxay carinaysaa xusuuswadareedda bulshada; mar kalana waxay soofaynaysaa damiirka qof kasta oo Soomaali ah. Ra’iisalwasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre wuxuu bilowga khudbaddiisa cod dheer ku sheegayaa in duruufaha maanta jira ay farayaan dadka Soomaaliyeed in lagu baraarujiyo khataraha muuqda, looga digo ciribdanbeedkooda, lana kiciyo “codkooda iyo damiirkooda ummadeed” . Wuxuu dabadeed diiradda saarayaa “midnimada dalka, wadajirka ummadda Soomaaliyeed, nabadda bulshada iyo ilaalinta qiyamka ay ummadani heshiiska ku tahay.” Wuxuu anbaqaadka hadaljeedintiisa ku bilaabayaa gundhigga ay siyaasaddu ku taagan tahay ee ah; qaran jira, bulsho wada nool iyo arrimo, had iyo goor, ka dhumuc weyn hardanka siyaasadeed ee markaas jira. Halkaas waxaa ka dhalanaya arrinta ugu weyn ee khudbaddiisa udubdhexaadka u ah, taasoo tibaaxaysa in is-afgaranwaaga iyo doodda joogtada ah ee dhex maraysa kooxaha siyaasadda isku hayaa ay tahay mid dabiici ah oo astaan u ah nidaamka maamul kasta oo shaqaynaya, loomana fasiran karo inay tahay burburkii ama dhammaadkii wadajirka qaranka. Labadaas arrimood waxay leeyihiin xad iyo xaglo aad u kala durugsan! Nidaamka dawladeed dhexdiisa waa lagu kala aragti duwanaan karaa, waa la isku diidi karaa hannaanka dhammaystirka dastuurka, arrimaha doorashooyinka, awoodqaybsiga, hannaanka federaalaynta, maamulka iyo cidda talada haynaysa; hase yeeshee Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu ku doodayaa in murankaasi yeesho soohdin uusan ka tallaabi karin. Wuxuu dooddiisa sees adag uga yeelay midnimo, isagoo yiri, “Midnimadu waa tiir adag oo la’aantii aysan ummadi taagnaan karin.” Wuxuu iskudayaya inuu midnimada ka dhigo gogosha ay doodaha kale oo dhami dusheeda ka dhacayaan, ee aysan iyadu noqon qodob mar kasta muran la galiyo oo maalinba uu nin dan lihi damaciisa gaarka ah ku qunsado. " “Walaalayaal, midnimadu waa tiir adag oo la’aantiis aysan ummadi taagnaan karin, kaas oo ka sarreeya khilaafaadka siyaasadeed iyo kala aragti duwanaansha jiri kara xilliyada qaar. Haddii midnimo la waayo waxaa baylah loo noqonayaa cadow” ayuu yiri Ra’iisalwasaaruhu. Macnaynta Qarannimada: “Midnimada iyo qarannimadu waa wax aan birina goyn, biyana mayrin!” Qofka Muqdisho jooga iyo qofka, Hargeysa, Gaalkacyo, Garoowe, Baydhabo ama Kismaayo jooga dhammaantood mid-mid isuma yaqaannaan, isku waaya-aragnimana ma wada laha; hayeeshee waa isku uur oo guntay ka midaysanyihiin. Waxa ugu weyn ee isku hayaa waa qarannimada! Waa garashada ah inay isku sooyaal iyo sawrac yihiin. Waa ogaanshaha tagtadooda iyo hilaadinta timaaddadooda. Sidaas awgeed, qarannimadu ma aha xad dhuleed iyo soohdimo khariidadeed. Daw ma aha in is-ahaanshaha ummadda lagu macneeyo seeraha iyo xuduudaha farsamo ee uu nidaamka federaalku sida kumeelgaarka ahi degaannada dalka kala dhex dhigay.  “[War hoy!] Marka hore heshiis iyo midnimo galiya maankiinna.” — Jaamac Kadiye Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu hoosta ka xarriiqay in midnimada ummadda Soomaaliyeedi tahay dhaxal fac ka fac la isu soo dhiibayay oo jiilba jiilka ka sii danbeeya uu, iyadoo ilaashan, ku simayay; maantana ay innaga ina joogto oo waajibka inoo egi yahay in aan ku fara’adaygno dhowriddeeda, oo ka yurayno qabbaannada shisheeye, faca soo kacaamayana iyada oo dhowrsoon gacmahooda ku hubsanno! Wuxuu, Ra’iisalwasaaruhu, sheegay in midnimadu aysan ahayn “mid dhayal ku dhalatay,” ayse tahay wax halgan iyo nafhurid lagu soo gardaadiyay. Wuxuu ganafka ku dhuftay oo uu gaashaanka u daruuray in wadajirka bulshada loo rogo gorgorton siyaasadeed oo cid gaar ahi ku dangaarto, iyadoo ku awrkacsanaysa shacabka ay majaraha u hayso ee taladoodii ku aaminay. Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu adkeeyay in aan midnimada iyo wadajirka shacabka Soomaaliyeed la dhex keenin is-haysadka siyaasiyiinta danleyda ah iyo doodaha xilliyaysan ee soo ifbaxa dhammaadka muddaxileedyada iyo xilliyada doorashada. “Midnimadeennu ma ahan mid maanta dhalatay waa dhaxal jiilba jiil usoo dhiibayay. Waxaa loo soo galay halgan dheer, waxaa loo soo huray naf iyo maal” ayuu khudbaddiisa ku yiri. Isaga oo tilmaamaya siyaasiyiin uu ku sheegay in ay “la hiraanhirayaan dhaawacyadii hore” ayuu Ra’iisalwasaare Xamse yiri: “Walaalayaal, maanta waxaynu u baahannahay siyaasi aragti dheer, siyaasi aan weli la hiraanhiraynin dhaawacyadii shalay. Soomaaliya, walaalayaal uma baahna siyaasi indhihiisu ay gadaal ku yaallaan oo arkaya oo keliya tagtadii la soo dhaafay ee xanuunka badnayd ee aynu ka dhaxalnay qaranjabkii ina soo gaaray, kana indhala’ rejada maanta jirta iyo fursadaha berri imaanaya. Uma baahnin siyaasi isagoo ku duulaya dantiisa oo keliya si xishood-la’aan ah uga beensheega rabitaanka iyo doonista shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Uma baahnin siyaasi aan ixtiraamaynin qiyamka ummadani ay leedahay, siyaasi aan garanayn waxa ummaddan isku haya.” Ra’iisalwasaare Xamse ayaa siyaasiyiinta ka macaasha qardoofihii hore u dhacay ummadda uga digay, wuxuuna farta ku fiiqay in aan magaca ummadda Soomaaliyeed qofna lagu baqamaali karin, iyadoo lagu haadsanayo shacabka. Dhinaca kale, Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu soo hadalqaaday warqaddii qar-iska-tuurnimada ahayd ee 13kii Sibteenbar 2026 ay hoggaanka Buntilaan u direen Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo Madaxweynaha Golaha Ammaanka ee QM. Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu warqadda ku fasiray mid hantaaqo ku ah midnimada dalka, wuxuuna yiri: “Waxaan leeyahay, walaalkay Siciid kuma habboonayn in uu ku qayladhaamiyo kalagoynta dalka iyo dadka Soomaaliyeed. Waxay tani ku noqonaysaa mahadho taariikheed oo ku lammaan sooyaalka noloshiisa!” Ra’iisalwasaare Xamse ayaa diirka ka caddeeyay in ay Soomaaliya u baahantahay siyaasi leh aragti dheer iyo go’aan dhiirran oo dalka u horseeda horumar iyo wadajir, ee aysan u baahnayn siyaasi weli dabajooga dhacdooyinkii shalay sababay burburkii dawladnimo. Wuxuu muujiyay sida ay siyaasiyiintaasi u habowsanyihiin, wuxuuna shacabka Soomaaliyeed uga digay in aysan ku kadsoomin talis maddiidin u ah quminta danaha shisheeye, isagoo bulshada ugu laabqaboojinaya hadal biyidhiciisu ahaa “waa la doogiye, yaan la dacaroon.” Dhinaca kale, Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu si waano iyo waxsheeg ula hadlaya siyaasiyiintaas, ayuu yiri: “Xilku waa meerto, maamulkana waa la isku beddelaa,” isagoo si gaar ah ugu dardaarwerinaya Siciid-Deni in uusan maanta magaciisa bi’in, cimrigiisana ceeb ku sagootin. Wuxuu Ra’iisalwasaaruhu ka digayaa siyaasiga “indhihiisu gadaal ku yaallaan” ee ku dheggan dhaawacyadii qaranjabka, ka indhala’ fursadaha iman kara, ama u adeegaya shisheeye aan turaal lahayn—iyadoo la moodo in Ra’iisalwasaaruhu ka soo xiganayo sifooyinkii ku jiray gabaygii abwaan Xaaji Aadan-Afqallooc ku tilmaamay mid kulansaday: danni/male, qabyaalad iyo uurxumo—kuwaas oo uu miradhalkooda ku sheegay: ibtilo, anbad iyo aayatiin-li’i! “Is-aamina dannigu waa waxaad ku ibtilowdeene Is-aqbala qabiilnimada waad ku anbanaysaane Is-addeeca uurxumidu waa aayatiin-li’iye .”— Xaaji Aadan-Afqallooc Abwaan Xaaji Aadan-Afqallooc wuxuu aad u tilmaamay figradda iyo is-ahaanshaha bulsheed, taasoo qaran shaqaynayaa u baahanyahay in garaadka muwaadinka iyo siyaasigubu ka kor maro reer iyo gobol gaar ah. Intaas kaddib, Ra’iisalwasaaruhu, isagoo ku tookhaya waxqabadka Xukuumaddiisa, wuxuu tibaaxay in aysan Soomaaliyada maanta joogin meeshii shalay. Si uu taas u muujiyo, Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu taxay deyndhaafkii, qaadistii cunaqabatayntii guud ee hubka, kubiiristii Bulshada Bariga Afrika, xubinnimada Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, kursiga Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka Midowga Afrika iyo hawlaha shidaalqodista. Ugu danbayn, Ra’iisalwasaare Xamse C. Barre oo baaq u jeedinaya bulshada Soomaaliyeed ayaa yiri: “Qof kasta oo Soomaali ah meel kasta oo uu joogo waxaa saaran mas’uuliyad ku aaddan ilaalinta midnimada dalka. Culimada waxaa si gaar ah u saaran waajibka ah in ay bulshada wacyigeliyaan kuna baraarujiyaan ahmiyadda ay leedahay midnimada xilligan aan maanta joogno. Waxaan u mahadcelinayaa culimada, siyaasiyiinta, aqoonyahanka iyo cuqaasha sida wadaniyadda leh, damiirka leh uga falceliyay falalka ay ku kaceen qaar kamid ah siyaasiyiinteennu.” Gabagabadii, khudbaddii Ra’iisalwasaaruhu waxay si cad u qeexday waxa uu u arko khatarta taagan iyo meeqaanka midnimada. Waxay milicsi ku samaysay wixii dalka laga soo maray, waxay soo bandhigtay guulaha wax-ku-oolka ah ee Xukuumaddiisa Danqaran, waxayna digniin ka bixisay haadaanta uu siyaasiga danaha hoose lihi ka ridi karo mustaqbalka dalka. Qarannimadu ma aha wax inta mar qura la yagleelo oo dabadeed iska jira; waxay u baahantahay rabitaan joogto ah, ilaalin iyo saxartir; haddii kale, sida uu Ra’iisalwasaaruhu tilmaamay, “waxaa baylah loo noqonayaa cadow!”

Halkaas waxaa ka dhalanaya arrinta ugu weyn ee khudbaddiisa udubdhexaadka u ah, taasoo tibaaxaysa in is-afgaranwaaga iyo doodda joogtada ah ee dhex maraysa kooxaha siyaasadda isku hayaa ay tahay mid dabiici ah oo astaan u ah nidaamka maamul kasta oo shaqaynaya, loomana fasiran karo inay tahay burburkii ama dhammaadkii wadajirka qaranka. Labadaas arrimood waxay leeyihiin xad iyo xaglo aad u kala durugsan! Nidaamka dawladeed dhexdiisa waa lagu kala aragti duwanaan karaa, waa la isku diidi karaa hannaanka dhammaystirka dastuurka, arrimaha doorashooyinka, awoodqaybsiga, hannaanka federaalaynta, maamulka iyo cidda talada haynaysa; hase yeeshee Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu ku doodayaa in murankaasi yeesho soohdin uusan ka tallaabi karin. Wuxuu dooddiisa sees adag uga yeelay midnimo, isagoo yiri, “Midnimadu waa tiir adag oo la’aantii aysan ummadi taagnaan karin.” Wuxuu iskudayaya inuu midnimada ka dhigo gogosha ay doodaha kale oo dhami dusheeda ka dhacayaan, ee aysan iyadu noqon qodob mar kasta muran la galiyo oo maalinba uu nin dan lihi damaciisa gaarka ah ku qunsado. " “Walaalayaal, midnimadu waa tiir adag oo la’aantiis aysan ummadi taagnaan karin, kaas oo ka sarreeya khilaafaadka siyaasadeed iyo kala aragti duwanaansha jiri kara xilliyada qaar. Haddii midnimo la waayo waxaa baylah loo noqonayaa cadow” ayuu yiri Ra’iisalwasaaruhu. Macnaynta Qarannimada: “Midnimada iyo qarannimadu waa wax aan birina goyn, biyana mayrin!” Qofka Muqdisho jooga iyo qofka, Hargeysa, Gaalkacyo, Garoowe, Baydhabo ama Kismaayo jooga dhammaantood mid-mid isuma yaqaannaan, isku waaya-aragnimana ma wada laha; hayeeshee waa isku uur oo guntay ka midaysanyihiin. Waxa ugu weyn ee isku hayaa waa qarannimada! Waa garashada ah inay isku sooyaal iyo sawrac yihiin. Waa ogaanshaha tagtadooda iyo hilaadinta timaaddadooda. Sidaas awgeed, qarannimadu ma aha xad dhuleed iyo soohdimo khariidadeed. Daw ma aha in is-ahaanshaha ummadda lagu macneeyo seeraha iyo xuduudaha farsamo ee uu nidaamka federaalku sida kumeelgaarka ahi degaannada dalka kala dhex dhigay.  “[War hoy!] Marka hore heshiis iyo midnimo galiya maankiinna.” — Jaamac Kadiye Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu hoosta ka xarriiqay in midnimada ummadda Soomaaliyeedi tahay dhaxal fac ka fac la isu soo dhiibayay oo jiilba jiilka ka sii danbeeya uu, iyadoo ilaashan, ku simayay; maantana ay innaga ina joogto oo waajibka inoo egi yahay in aan ku fara’adaygno dhowriddeeda, oo ka yurayno qabbaannada shisheeye, faca soo kacaamayana iyada oo dhowrsoon gacmahooda ku hubsanno! Wuxuu, Ra’iisalwasaaruhu, sheegay in midnimadu aysan ahayn “mid dhayal ku dhalatay,” ayse tahay wax halgan iyo nafhurid lagu soo gardaadiyay. Wuxuu ganafka ku dhuftay oo uu gaashaanka u daruuray in wadajirka bulshada loo rogo gorgorton siyaasadeed oo cid gaar ahi ku dangaarto, iyadoo ku awrkacsanaysa shacabka ay majaraha u hayso ee taladoodii ku aaminay. Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu adkeeyay in aan midnimada iyo wadajirka shacabka Soomaaliyeed la dhex keenin is-haysadka siyaasiyiinta danleyda ah iyo doodaha xilliyaysan ee soo ifbaxa dhammaadka muddaxileedyada iyo xilliyada doorashada. “Midnimadeennu ma ahan mid maanta dhalatay waa dhaxal jiilba jiil usoo dhiibayay. Waxaa loo soo galay halgan dheer, waxaa loo soo huray naf iyo maal” ayuu khudbaddiisa ku yiri. Isaga oo tilmaamaya siyaasiyiin uu ku sheegay in ay “la hiraanhirayaan dhaawacyadii hore” ayuu Ra’iisalwasaare Xamse yiri: “Walaalayaal, maanta waxaynu u baahannahay siyaasi aragti dheer, siyaasi aan weli la hiraanhiraynin dhaawacyadii shalay. Soomaaliya, walaalayaal uma baahna siyaasi indhihiisu ay gadaal ku yaallaan oo arkaya oo keliya tagtadii la soo dhaafay ee xanuunka badnayd ee aynu ka dhaxalnay qaranjabkii ina soo gaaray, kana indhala’ rejada maanta jirta iyo fursadaha berri imaanaya. Uma baahnin siyaasi isagoo ku duulaya dantiisa oo keliya si xishood-la’aan ah uga beensheega rabitaanka iyo doonista shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Uma baahnin siyaasi aan ixtiraamaynin qiyamka ummadani ay leedahay, siyaasi aan garanayn waxa ummaddan isku haya.” Ra’iisalwasaare Xamse ayaa siyaasiyiinta ka macaasha qardoofihii hore u dhacay ummadda uga digay, wuxuuna farta ku fiiqay in aan magaca ummadda Soomaaliyeed qofna lagu baqamaali karin, iyadoo lagu haadsanayo shacabka. Dhinaca kale, Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu soo hadalqaaday warqaddii qar-iska-tuurnimada ahayd ee 13kii Sibteenbar 2026 ay hoggaanka Buntilaan u direen Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo Madaxweynaha Golaha Ammaanka ee QM. Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu warqadda ku fasiray mid hantaaqo ku ah midnimada dalka, wuxuuna yiri: “Waxaan leeyahay, walaalkay Siciid kuma habboonayn in uu ku qayladhaamiyo kalagoynta dalka iyo dadka Soomaaliyeed. Waxay tani ku noqonaysaa mahadho taariikheed oo ku lammaan sooyaalka noloshiisa!” Ra’iisalwasaare Xamse ayaa diirka ka caddeeyay in ay Soomaaliya u baahantahay siyaasi leh aragti dheer iyo go’aan dhiirran oo dalka u horseeda horumar iyo wadajir, ee aysan u baahnayn siyaasi weli dabajooga dhacdooyinkii shalay sababay burburkii dawladnimo. Wuxuu muujiyay sida ay siyaasiyiintaasi u habowsanyihiin, wuxuuna shacabka Soomaaliyeed uga digay in aysan ku kadsoomin talis maddiidin u ah quminta danaha shisheeye, isagoo bulshada ugu laabqaboojinaya hadal biyidhiciisu ahaa “waa la doogiye, yaan la dacaroon.” Dhinaca kale, Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu si waano iyo waxsheeg ula hadlaya siyaasiyiintaas, ayuu yiri: “Xilku waa meerto, maamulkana waa la isku beddelaa,” isagoo si gaar ah ugu dardaarwerinaya Siciid-Deni in uusan maanta magaciisa bi’in, cimrigiisana ceeb ku sagootin. Wuxuu Ra’iisalwasaaruhu ka digayaa siyaasiga “indhihiisu gadaal ku yaallaan” ee ku dheggan dhaawacyadii qaranjabka, ka indhala’ fursadaha iman kara, ama u adeegaya shisheeye aan turaal lahayn—iyadoo la moodo in Ra’iisalwasaaruhu ka soo xiganayo sifooyinkii ku jiray gabaygii abwaan Xaaji Aadan-Afqallooc ku tilmaamay mid kulansaday: danni/male, qabyaalad iyo uurxumo—kuwaas oo uu miradhalkooda ku sheegay: ibtilo, anbad iyo aayatiin-li’i! “Is-aamina dannigu waa waxaad ku ibtilowdeene Is-aqbala qabiilnimada waad ku anbanaysaane Is-addeeca uurxumidu waa aayatiin-li’iye .”— Xaaji Aadan-Afqallooc Abwaan Xaaji Aadan-Afqallooc wuxuu aad u tilmaamay figradda iyo is-ahaanshaha bulsheed, taasoo qaran shaqaynayaa u baahanyahay in garaadka muwaadinka iyo siyaasigubu ka kor maro reer iyo gobol gaar ah. Intaas kaddib, Ra’iisalwasaaruhu, isagoo ku tookhaya waxqabadka Xukuumaddiisa, wuxuu tibaaxay in aysan Soomaaliyada maanta joogin meeshii shalay. Si uu taas u muujiyo, Ra’iisalwasaaruhu wuxuu taxay deyndhaafkii, qaadistii cunaqabatayntii guud ee hubka, kubiiristii Bulshada Bariga Afrika, xubinnimada Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, kursiga Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka Midowga Afrika iyo hawlaha shidaalqodista. Ugu danbayn, Ra’iisalwasaare Xamse C. Barre oo baaq u jeedinaya bulshada Soomaaliyeed ayaa yiri: “Qof kasta oo Soomaali ah meel kasta oo uu joogo waxaa saaran mas’uuliyad ku aaddan ilaalinta midnimada dalka. Culimada waxaa si gaar ah u saaran waajibka ah in ay bulshada wacyigeliyaan kuna baraarujiyaan ahmiyadda ay leedahay midnimada xilligan aan maanta joogno. Waxaan u mahadcelinayaa culimada, siyaasiyiinta, aqoonyahanka iyo cuqaasha sida wadaniyadda leh, damiirka leh uga falceliyay falalka ay ku kaceen qaar kamid ah siyaasiyiinteennu.” Gabagabadii, khudbaddii Ra’iisalwasaaruhu waxay si cad u qeexday waxa uu u arko khatarta taagan iyo meeqaanka midnimada. Waxay milicsi ku samaysay wixii dalka laga soo maray, waxay soo bandhigtay guulaha wax-ku-oolka ah ee Xukuumaddiisa Danqaran, waxayna digniin ka bixisay haadaanta uu siyaasiga danaha hoose lihi ka ridi karo mustaqbalka dalka. Qarannimadu ma aha wax inta mar qura la yagleelo oo dabadeed iska jira; waxay u baahantahay rabitaan joogto ah, ilaalin iyo saxartir; haddii kale, sida uu Ra’iisalwasaaruhu tilmaamay, “waxaa baylah loo noqonayaa cadow!”

items.title: Xamza oo shaaciyay arrin cusub oo la xiriirta wada-hadalka Al-Shabaab
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay diyaar u tahay inay la hadasho xubnaha Al-Shabaab ee doonaya inay ka tanaasulaan kooxda iyo fikirkeeda. Wareysi uu siiyay Dawan TV ayuu Xamza ku sheegay in dowladda aysan diiddanayn in lala xiriiro ama lala hadlo xubnaha kooxda ee doonaya inay ka baxaan, isagoo sheegay in dadka sidaas sameeya ay xaq u leeyihiin inay dib ugu laabtaan nolol caadi ah. Sida uu sheegay Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu, qofka ka tanaasula Shabaabnimada waxaa xitaa suuragal ah inuu dowladda ku biiro haddii uu sidaas doorto. Xamza ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in qaar kamid ah xubnihii hore uga tirsanaa Al-Shabaab ay hadda u shaqeeyaan dowladda Soomaaliya, halka qaarkood ay hayaan xilal sare oo rasmi ah. Dhanka kale, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa waxba kama jiraan ku tilmaamay eedeymaha sheegaya in dowladda Soomaaliya ay lacag siiso Al-Shabaab si loo joojiyo ama loo yareeyo weerarrada ka dhaca Muqdisho. “Dowladda iyo Al-Shabaab wax wada-hadal ah ma yeelan,” ayuu yiri Xamza, isagoo caddeeyay in kooxda uusan ka dhaxeyn waxaan dagaal ahayn. Sidoo kale waxa uu sheegay in wararka ku saabsan lacag-siinta kooxda ay faafiyeen xubno uu sheegay inay kamid ahaayeen dowladdii hore, inkastoo uusan magacaabin mas’uuliyiinta uu ula jeedo. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ugu dambeyntiina eedeymo u jeediyay qaar ka mid ah mas’uuliyiintii hore, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay xiriir la lahaayeen Al-Shabaab, inkastoo uusan faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka bixin. Eedeynta Al-Shabaab ayaa siyaasadda Soomaaliya ka noqotay wax caadi ah oo dhinacyadu isku eedeeyaan, iyadoo aysan soo bandhigin caddeymo xoojinaya eedeymahooda. The post Xamza oo shaaciyay arrin cusub oo la xiriirta wada-hadalka Al-Shabaab appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia’s president Hassan Sheikh turns to Ethiopia, Djibouti and Egypt as Baidoa crisis tests regional alliances
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s diplomatic circuit through Ethiopia and Djibouti, followed by a planned visit to Egypt, is unfolding against a volatile backdrop in which Somalia’s domestic political disputes are increasingly entangled with the strategic calculations of its neighbours. Mohamud met Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed in Addis Ababa on Tuesday for talks on bilateral relations and the political and security situation in the region. A day later, he met Djibouti President Ismail Omar Guelleh in Djibouti City, where discussions centred on bilateral ties, regional security and cooperation. He is expected to travel to Egypt next, with sources indicating that his programme will include meetings in New Alamein and discussions on Somalia-Egypt relations, security in the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea. The sequence is significant because each stop brings Somalia’s president into contact with a government that occupies a different position in the region’s increasingly intricate security architecture. Ethiopia has deep military and political interests in Somalia, particularly in the country’s south-west. Djibouti is a longstanding Somali political and security partner and an important diplomatic hub for the Horn of Africa. Egypt has rapidly expanded its strategic relationship with Mogadishu, including military cooperation and participation in the African Union’s new security mission in Somalia. At the centre of Somalia’s domestic calculations is Baidoa, where a political confrontation between Mogadishu and former South-West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen has developed into a recurring armed conflict. The question now confronting Mohamud is whether his regional diplomacy can secure political and security support for the federal government without allowing Somalia’s internal divisions to become entangled with the rivalries of larger regional powers. From Addis Ababa to Djibouti Mohamud’s visit to Ethiopia was officially described as a one-day working visit. According to Somalia’s state news agency, the president met Abiy Ahmed in Addis Ababa and discussed strengthening Somalia-Ethiopia relations, as well as political and security developments across the region. The two leaders also emphasised regional cooperation to support peace and stability in the Horn of Africa. The meeting came at a sensitive moment in bilateral relations. Ethiopia remains one of Somalia’s most consequential security partners, but the relationship has also passed through periods of severe tension, particularly after Ethiopia signed a memorandum of understanding with Somaliland in January 2024. That dispute eventually produced the Ankara Declaration, a Turkish-mediated agreement under which Somalia and Ethiopia committed to resolving their differences through dialogue and pursuing arrangements for Ethiopia’s access to the sea under Somali sovereignty. The latest A]ddis Ababa meeting suggests that, despite unresolved strategic differences, Mogadishu and Addis Ababa continue to regard direct presidential dialogue as necessary. The timing also matters because Ethiopia’s own security environment has deteriorated again, with renewed fighting in the north adding another layer of uncertainty to a country whose military and political influence extends deeply into Somalia. From Addis Ababa, Mohamud travelled to Djibouti. President Ismail Omar Guelleh received him on Wednesday for talks covering bilateral political, economic and security relations and wider developments in the Horn. Djibouti has historically maintained close relations with Mogadishu and has played a recurring role in Somali diplomacy. Its importance goes beyond its bilateral relationship with Somalia. Djibouti sits at the Bab el-Mandeb, one of the world’s most strategically important maritime chokepoints, and hosts the headquarters of the Intergovernmental Authority on Development, or IGAD. Its geographical position also makes it an important participant in conversations about Red Sea security, Gulf of Aden shipping and the wider competition for influence across the Horn. For Mohamud, therefore, the Djibouti stop provides another diplomatic channel at a time when Somalia is attempting to manage both an internal political crisis and a rapidly shifting regional security environment. The Baidoa question follows Mohamud abroad Behind the formal language of regional cooperation lies a much more immediate domestic problem: Baidoa. The political crisis between Mogadishu and Laftagareen has become one of Somalia’s most consequential disputes between the federal government and a federal member state. Laftagareen had led South-West State since 2018 and became increasingly opposed to Mogadishu’s constitutional and electoral agenda. The dispute intensified in March after Laftagareen’s camp maintained that he had secured another term in office, while the Federal Government rejected the process. On March 30, federal forces seized Baidoa. Laftagareen subsequently resigned, but the resignation did not resolve the political dispute. Instead, the struggle shifted from the question of who controlled the regional presidency to a broader contest over political legitimacy, constitutional authority and the relationship between Mogadishu and South-West State. In June, Sheikh Adan Mohamed Nur Madobe, the former speaker of Somalia’s parliament, was elected president of South-West State. Madobe’s election was backed by the Federal Government, and he was inaugurated in Baidoa in July in the presence of Mohamud and other senior federal officials. Laftagareen’s camp rejected the transition. The dispute subsequently returned to the battlefield. On August 17, fighting erupted in Baidoa between federal forces and armed opponents aligned with Laftagareen. Reuters reported that federal troops regained control after intense fighting, while the Associated Press reported that dozens were killed or wounded in the broader violence, including civilians. The competing sides have offered sharply different accounts of the fighting. The Federal Government has alleged that Laftagareen-aligned forces cooperated with Al-Shabaab. Laftagareen’s camp has rejected that accusation and described its forces as South-West State security personnel defending the region against federal intervention. The allegations of cooperation with Al-Shabaab have not been independently established. The distinction is critical because it places the Baidoa confrontation at the intersection of two very different issues: Somalia’s internal political struggle and the international campaign against Al-Shabaab. For years, Ethiopian forces and Ethiopian-backed security arrangements have influenced the security environment in southern Somalia. Baidoa itself has historically been deeply connected to Ethiopia’s regional security calculations. That history gives Addis Ababa influence that few other external actors possess. It also makes Ethiopian involvement politically sensitive. If Ethiopia supports Somalia against Al-Shabaab, its involvement can be presented as part of a broader counterterrorism partnership. If Ethiopia is perceived to be taking sides in the federal government’s political confrontation with a regional administration, however, its role becomes considerably more contentious. That is the narrow line Mohamud’s diplomacy must navigate. Why Egypt matters now Mohamud’s next stop is expected to be Egypt. Somalia Today reported that the president was expected to travel to Cairo after Djibouti, with sources indicating that the Egyptian leg could take place on Friday. The report said discussions were expected to address bilateral relations, regional security and political developments across the Horn of Africa and Red Sea. Mohamud is also expected to participate in high-level African meetings in New Alamein. The participation of Eritrean President Isaias Afwerki and Sudanese army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan has been reported as possible, but their attendance has not been publicly confirmed. That means the current trip should not be described as a confirmed three-way presidential summit between Somalia, Egypt and Eritrea. The three countries do, however, have an established diplomatic framework. In October 2024, Mohamud, Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi and Eritrean President Isaias Afwerki met in Asmara for a tripartite summit. Their discussions covered regional stability, the sovereignty and territorial integrity of states in the Horn, Red Sea security and support for Somalia’s national security institutions. The three leaders also endorsed stronger coordination on Somalia’s security and expressed support for the Somali National Army. That earlier summit remains an important reference point for understanding the strategic environment surrounding Mohamud’s current Egypt visit. What could be discussed in Egypt? The precise agenda for the forthcoming Egyptian meetings has not been publicly released in full. But recent Somalia-Egypt presidential meetings provide a clear indication of the subjects that have dominated the bilateral relationship. When Mohamud met el-Sisi in Cairo in February 2026, the two presidents discussed Somalia’s unity, security and territorial integrity, military and security cooperation, counterterrorism, regional conflicts and maritime security. They also discussed Egypt’s participation in AUSSOM. Egyptian President el-Sisi said Cairo was prepared to contribute forces to the mission and emphasised the importance of cooperation with Somalia in confronting terrorism and strengthening national institutions. The two presidents also discussed the security of the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden, describing the stability of those waterways as a shared regional concern. Those issues are likely to remain relevant during Mohamud’s forthcoming visit. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

From Addis Ababa, Mohamud travelled to Djibouti. President Ismail Omar Guelleh received him on Wednesday for talks covering bilateral political, economic and security relations and wider developments in the Horn. Djibouti has historically maintained close relations with Mogadishu and has played a recurring role in Somali diplomacy. Its importance goes beyond its bilateral relationship with Somalia. Djibouti sits at the Bab el-Mandeb, one of the world’s most strategically important maritime chokepoints, and hosts the headquarters of the Intergovernmental Authority on Development, or IGAD. Its geographical position also makes it an important participant in conversations about Red Sea security, Gulf of Aden shipping and the wider competition for influence across the Horn. For Mohamud, therefore, the Djibouti stop provides another diplomatic channel at a time when Somalia is attempting to manage both an internal political crisis and a rapidly shifting regional security environment. The Baidoa question follows Mohamud abroad Behind the formal language of regional cooperation lies a much more immediate domestic problem: Baidoa. The political crisis between Mogadishu and Laftagareen has become one of Somalia’s most consequential disputes between the federal government and a federal member state. Laftagareen had led South-West State since 2018 and became increasingly opposed to Mogadishu’s constitutional and electoral agenda. The dispute intensified in March after Laftagareen’s camp maintained that he had secured another term in office, while the Federal Government rejected the process. On March 30, federal forces seized Baidoa. Laftagareen subsequently resigned, but the resignation did not resolve the political dispute. Instead, the struggle shifted from the question of who controlled the regional presidency to a broader contest over political legitimacy, constitutional authority and the relationship between Mogadishu and South-West State. In June, Sheikh Adan Mohamed Nur Madobe, the former speaker of Somalia’s parliament, was elected president of South-West State. Madobe’s election was backed by the Federal Government, and he was inaugurated in Baidoa in July in the presence of Mohamud and other senior federal officials. Laftagareen’s camp rejected the transition. The dispute subsequently returned to the battlefield. On August 17, fighting erupted in Baidoa between federal forces and armed opponents aligned with Laftagareen. Reuters reported that federal troops regained control after intense fighting, while the Associated Press reported that dozens were killed or wounded in the broader violence, including civilians. The competing sides have offered sharply different accounts of the fighting. The Federal Government has alleged that Laftagareen-aligned forces cooperated with Al-Shabaab. Laftagareen’s camp has rejected that accusation and described its forces as South-West State security personnel defending the region against federal intervention. The allegations of cooperation with Al-Shabaab have not been independently established. The distinction is critical because it places the Baidoa confrontation at the intersection of two very different issues: Somalia’s internal political struggle and the international campaign against Al-Shabaab. For years, Ethiopian forces and Ethiopian-backed security arrangements have influenced the security environment in southern Somalia. Baidoa itself has historically been deeply connected to Ethiopia’s regional security calculations. That history gives Addis Ababa influence that few other external actors possess. It also makes Ethiopian involvement politically sensitive. If Ethiopia supports Somalia against Al-Shabaab, its involvement can be presented as part of a broader counterterrorism partnership. If Ethiopia is perceived to be taking sides in the federal government’s political confrontation with a regional administration, however, its role becomes considerably more contentious. That is the narrow line Mohamud’s diplomacy must navigate. Why Egypt matters now Mohamud’s next stop is expected to be Egypt. Somalia Today reported that the president was expected to travel to Cairo after Djibouti, with sources indicating that the Egyptian leg could take place on Friday. The report said discussions were expected to address bilateral relations, regional security and political developments across the Horn of Africa and Red Sea. Mohamud is also expected to participate in high-level African meetings in New Alamein. The participation of Eritrean President Isaias Afwerki and Sudanese army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan has been reported as possible, but their attendance has not been publicly confirmed. That means the current trip should not be described as a confirmed three-way presidential summit between Somalia, Egypt and Eritrea. The three countries do, however, have an established diplomatic framework. In October 2024, Mohamud, Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi and Eritrean President Isaias Afwerki met in Asmara for a tripartite summit. Their discussions covered regional stability, the sovereignty and territorial integrity of states in the Horn, Red Sea security and support for Somalia’s national security institutions. The three leaders also endorsed stronger coordination on Somalia’s security and expressed support for the Somali National Army. That earlier summit remains an important reference point for understanding the strategic environment surrounding Mohamud’s current Egypt visit. What could be discussed in Egypt? The precise agenda for the forthcoming Egyptian meetings has not been publicly released in full. But recent Somalia-Egypt presidential meetings provide a clear indication of the subjects that have dominated the bilateral relationship. When Mohamud met el-Sisi in Cairo in February 2026, the two presidents discussed Somalia’s unity, security and territorial integrity, military and security cooperation, counterterrorism, regional conflicts and maritime security. They also discussed Egypt’s participation in AUSSOM. Egyptian President el-Sisi said Cairo was prepared to contribute forces to the mission and emphasised the importance of cooperation with Somalia in confronting terrorism and strengthening national institutions. The two presidents also discussed the security of the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden, describing the stability of those waterways as a shared regional concern. Those issues are likely to remain relevant during Mohamud’s forthcoming visit. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo maalin taariikhi ah ku tilmaamay kadib doorashadii dhacday
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa ka hadlay doorashooyinka Golaha Wakiillada iyo Goleyaasha Deegaanka ee Galmudug iyo HirShabelle, isagoo ku tilmaamay tallaabo taariikhi ah oo loo qaaday dhanka dimuqraadiyadda iyo horumarinta nidaamka doorashooyinka dalka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in shacabka ku nool gobollada Mudug, Galgaduud, Hiiraan iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe ay si nabad ah uga qayb-galeen codbixinta, isagoo maalinta doorashada ku tilmaamay mid meel wanaagsan kaga jirta taariikhda dimuqraadiyadda Soomaaliya. “Maanta waa maalin kale oo baal wanaagsan ka galaysa sooyaalka dimuqraadiyadda iyo horay u socodka dalkeenna,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha, isagoo bogaadiyay kumannaanka muwaadiniin ee ka qayb ka qaatay geeddi-socodka doorashada. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in ka qayb-galka shacabka uu muujinayo gudashada xaqooda dastuuriga ah ee codbixinta iyo doorka ay ku leeyihiin xoojinta dowladnimada, dimuqraadiyadda iyo matalaadda shacabka. Sidoo kale, Xasan Sheekh wuxuu ammaanay ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliyeed ee sugayay goobaha codbixinta iyo shacabka ka qayb-galayay doorashooyinka, si hawshu ugu dhacdo jawi nabdoon oo xasilloon. Sida uu sheegay Madaxweynaha, wax dhibaato ah lagama soo sheegin goobihii codbixinta, isagoo xusay in ciidamada ammaanku ay si hufan u xaqiijiyeen amniga intii ay socdeen doorashooyinka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa intaas ku daray in doorashooyinkan ay muujinayaan ka go’naanshaha shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee dhismaha dowladnimo loo dhan yahay, xoojinta nabadda iyo hirgelinta hannaan siyaasadeed oo ku salaysan rabitaanka shacabka. Ugu dambeyntiina, Madaxweynaha ayaa doorashooyinka Galmudug iyo HirShabelle ku tilmaamay tallaabo lagu sii xoojinayo nidaamka dimuqraadiyadeed ee ku dhisan doorashooyinka tooska ah. items.title: Taiwan and Somaliland Plan Emergency Care Expansion
items.description: Taiwan and Somaliland plan to expand a joint emergency healthcare project to four additional cities, aiming to extend its coverage to approximately 80% of Somaliland’s population, Taiwan’s Ambassador Allen Chenhwa Lou said on Tuesday. Lou outlined the planned expansion at an achievement ceremony and emergency response conference for the Public Health Emergency Response System Enhancement Project on September 29. The next phase is expected to cover Erigavo, Burco, Berbera and Borama, building on work to strengthen emergency medical services and support ambulance dispatch systems in Hargeisa and Gabiley The initiative began in 2024 and has focused on training local medical trainers, strengthening emergency treatment skills, developing standard operating procedures and supporting ambulance coordination, according to Lou’s remarks. Its training approach equips Somaliland instructors to train other local healthcare personnel, alongside technology transfer and exchanges between the two sides. liLou said the ceremony provided an opportunity to assess progress and discuss the next stage of health cooperation. It is my great pleasure to join today’s event which is not only to review our previous joint efforts and achievements over the past three years, but also to look ahead to the next chapter of Taiwan-Somaliland health cooperation,” he said.The proposed expansion would broaden the geographical reach of the emergency response system. Lou said the second phase was expected to cover approximately 80% of both Somaliland’s population and territory His remarks did not specify a budget or timetable for the expansion. Lou emphasised coordination between the partners as they move towards the next phase, saying the cooperation aimed to strengthen Somaliland’s ability to deliver emergency care. Together we can achieve a healthier and more resilient Somaliland, and an even stronger Taiwan-Somaliland partnership,” he said Source Horn Diplomat

items.title: Crew of MT Eureka Released After Being Held by Pirates in Somalia

items.title: Pirates kill five crew on tanker off Somalia before rescue
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Pirates killed five crew members aboard the hijacked oil tanker MT Honour 25 before Puntland security forces rescued the vessel off Somalia’s coast, the semi-autonomous state’s information ministry said on Tuesday. Three Pakistanis, one Myanmar national and one Indian were killed before the rescue operation began, the ministry said. Four other crew members, three Pakistanis and one Indian, were wounded. Security forces freed the Palau-flagged tanker, which was carrying 18,500 barrels of oil, and captured 16 suspected pirates, the ministry said. Puntland state television reported the suspects would be brought before a court. The Puntland Maritime Police Force said the vessel was safe and under government control, and that efforts were continuing to locate others involved in the hijacking. Seized April 21 Pirates seized the tanker on April 21, about 30 nautical miles off Puntland’s coast, according to media reports. It had 17 crew on board, including 10 Pakistani nationals, and the hijacking prompted concern in Pakistan over their safety. Second rescue in a week The operation followed one last week in which Puntland forces freed the tanker Sibu 1, a vessel under U.S. sanctions that pirates hijacked in August. Of 41 suspected pirates arres’ted in that operation, 28 later escaped while being transferred to jail. Several Puntland security officials have accused local police of complicity in the escape. items.title: Sawirro: Xasan Sheekh oo la kulmay Geelle, kadib Abiy Ahmed – Maxaa xiga, maxaase socda?
items.description: Jabuuti (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta safar shaqo ku tagay dalka Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti, halkaas oo uu kulan miro-dhal ah kula yeeshay dhiggiisa dalkaasi, Mudane Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle. Kulanka labada Madaxweyne ayaa waxaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka walaaltinimo iyo iskaashiga soo jireenka ah ee Soomaliya iyo Jabuuti, iyaga oo si gaar ah u dul istaagay iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha, siyaasadda iyo arrimaha khuseeya nabadda, xasilloonida iyo amniga Geeska Afrika. Sidoo kale, booqashadan ayaa qayb ka ah safarrada Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee lagu xoojinayo xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya ay la leedahay dalalka deriska ah, iyada oo mudnaan gaar ah la siinayo danaha dalkeenna iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa shalay booqday magaalada Addis Ababa ee caasimada ee dalka Itoobiya, halkaas oo uu wada-hadallo kula soo yeeshay Ra’iisul wasaare Abiy Axmed oo ay ka wada-hadleen arrimo xasaasi ah oo ay kamid yihiin xoojinta xiriirka soo jireenka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya iyo sidii loo horumarin lahaa iskaashiga labada dal. Sidoo kale waxaa kulankaas lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay horumarinta iskaashiga dalalka gobolka, iyagoo is dhaafsaday aragtiyo ku saabsan arrimaha saameynta ku leh nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka Geeska Afrika. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa Jabuuti kadib tegi doona magaalada Qaahira ee caasimada dalka Masar, isagoo kulamo kala duwan kula yeelan doono madaxda dalkaasi, sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale inta uu joogo Masar lagu wadaa inuu ka qeyb galo shirar heer sare ah oo Afrikaan ah oo ka dhacaya magaalada New Alamein ee dalkaasi. Xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Qaahira ayaa si weyn u xoogeysanayay sanadihii dambe, gaar ahaan dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, iyadoo sidoo kale labada dal ay sare u qaadeen iskaashiga militariga, waxaana saraakiil sare oo Masri ah ay dhowaan Muqdisho kula kulmeen madaxda Soomaaliya, kana wada hadleen tababarrada, dhismaha awoodda ciidamada iyo taageerada Xoogga Dalka. Safarrada Xasan Sheekh ee Itoobiya, Jabuuti iyo Masar waxay kusoo aadayaan xilli gobolka uu wajahayo xaalado amni iyo siyaasadeed oo adag, oo ay ka mid yihiin dagaallada dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya, colaadda Sudan iyo xiisadaha ka taagan Badda Cas. items.title: Kulan dhex maray Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya iyo Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka
items.description: Muqdisho, 30 Sebtembar 2026 — Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Xuseen Rooble, ayaa kulan la qaatay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdilqaadir Maxamed Nuur. Rooble ayaa sheegay in Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka uu galabta ugu yimid booqasho, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xaaladda dalka iyo sidii loo wada shaqayn lahaa, gaar ahaan arrimaha masiiriga ah ee Soomaaliya. items.title: Doorashooyinka Galmudug Iyo Hirshabeelle: Tijaabada Qof Iyo Codka Soomaaliya
items.description: Shacabka ku nool Galmudug iyo Hirshabeelle ayaa maanta u dareeray goobaha codbixinta si ay ugu codeeyaan musharraxiinta golayaasha degaanka iyo baarlamaannada labada dawladgoboleed. Doorashadu waxay ka dhacaysaa guud ahaan 23 degmo: 11 degmo oo Galmudug ah iyo 12 degmo oo Hirshabeelle ah. Degmooyinka Hirshabeelle waxay u kala baxayaan lix ku yaalla gobolka Hiiraan iyo lix ku yaalla Shabeellaha Dhexe. Doorashooyinkan ayaa ka mid ah tallaabooyinka ugu waaweyn ee Soomaaliya uga guurayso nidaamka doorashooyinka dadban, una gudbayso hannaan ay muwaadiniintu si toos ah ugu dooranayaan wakiilladooda. Qodobka kowaad waa awoodda la siinayo shacabka. Muddo dheer, hoggaanka Soomaaliya waxaa lagu soo xulayay heshiisyo siyaasadeed, odayaal dhaqameed iyo ergooyin kooban. Doorashada maanta waxay muwaadiniinta siinaysaa fursad ay codkooda ugu go’aamiyaan cidda matalaysa. Qodobka labaad waa awoodda Guddiga Doorashooyinka. Maareynta laba doorasho oo isku mar ka dhacaya 23 degmo waxay tijaabinaysaa diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaasha, qaybinta agabka, diyaarinta shaqaalaha, ilaalinta goobaha iyo tirinta codadka. Qodobka saddexaad waa casharka Galmudug. Doorashadii hore waxaa burisay Maxkamadda Sare kaddib cabashooyin laga gudbiyey hannaankii loo maamulay.
