items.title: Kenya oo Lamu ka bilaabeysa warshad shidaal oo $16 bilyan ah
items.description: Lamu, Kenya – 30 Sebtembar 2026: Ganacsadaha reer Nigeria Aliko Dangote iyo Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa dhagax-dhigay mashruuca dhismaha warshad sifeysa shidaalka oo qiimaheedu yahay $16 bilyan, taas oo laga dhisayo magaalada Lamu ee xeebaha Kenya. Warshadda ayaa loogu talagalay inay sifeyso ilaa 700,000 foosto oo saliid cayriin ah maalintii, iyadoo soo saari doonta shidaalka baabuurta, naaftada iyo shidaalka diyaaradaha. Dhismaha mashruuca ayaa la qorsheeyay in la soo gabagabeeyo 2030. Mashruucan ayaa lagu tilmaamay mid ka mid ah mashaariicda warshadeed ee ugu waaweyn ee la qorsheeyay Bariga Afrika, iyadoo ujeeddadiisu tahay in la yareeyo ku-tiirsanaanta gobolka ee shidaalka dibadda laga keeno iyo in gudaha Afrika lagu kordhiyo awoodda lagu farsameeyo saliidda cayriin. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, Dangote ayaa dowladaha Bariga Afrika u bandhigay inay helaan 30% saamiga warshadda, taas oo qayb ka noqon karta qorshaha lagu kordhinayo ka-qaybgalka gobolka. “Tani waa Afrika oo isu imaanaysa si ay Afrika u dhisto,” ayuu yiri Dangote xafladda dhagax-dhigga. Mashruuca waxaa sidoo kale lala xiriiriyay warshad koronto oo awooddeedu tahay 1,000 megawatt, taas oo loogu talagalay inay koronto siiso warshadda iyo warshadaha kale ee laga filayo inay ka dhashaan aagga Lamu. Dangote ayaa sheegay in mashruucu abuuri karo tobannaan kun oo shaqooyin ah inta lagu guda jiro dhismaha iyo marka uu howlgalo. Si kastaba, mashruuca ayaa wajahaya mucaaradnimo ka timid qaar ka mid ah dadka deegaanka iyo kooxaha deegaanka, kuwaas oo walaac ka muujiyay magdhowga dhulka, xuquuqda dadka deegaanka iyo saameynta deegaanka xeebaha Lamu. Maxkamad Kenya ah ayaa sidoo kale amar ku bixisay in xaaladda hadda jirta lagu ilaaliyo qayb ka mid ah goobta muranka ka taagan yahay, kaddib dacwad ay gudbiyeen dadka deegaanka. Muranka ayaa diiradda saaraya dhulka, magdhowga iyo arrimaha deegaanka. Goobta Lamu ayaa muhiimad istiraatiiji ah leh, maadaama ay ku dhowdahay dekedda Lamu iyo marinka LAPSSET, kaas oo isku xiraya xeebaha Kenya iyo suuqyada iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaale ee gobolka. Haddii la dhameystiro sida qorshuhu yahay, warshadda Lamu waxay noqon kartaa mid ka mid ah xarumaha ugu waaweyn ee shidaalka sifeysan ee Bariga Afrika, taas oo saameyn ku yeelan karta sahayda shidaalka, ganacsiga iyo amniga tamarta gobolka.

items.title: War ka cusub xaaladda Beledweyne oo maanta…
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Beledweyne ee xarunta gobolka Hiiraan waxaa maanta si rasmi ah uga bilowday doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee Golaha Wakiilada iyo Deegaanka ee Maamul-goboleedka HirShabelle, iyadoo xaaladda guud ay tahay mid deggan. Shacabka Beledweyne ayaa saaka safaf dhaadheer u galay inay codadkooda dhibtaan, si ay usoo doortaan xildhibaannada ku matalaya dowladda cusub ee HirShabelle, iyadoo meesha ay ka baxday cabsidii laga qabay inay rabshado ka dhacaan magaaladaas, maadaamo ay ku sugan yihiin dhinacyo mucaarad ah. Doorashada ka dhacday Beledweyne waxaa sidoo kale ka qayb-galay mas’uuliyiinta maamulka gobolka Hiiraan iyo musharraxa Madaxweyne ku xageenka HirShabelle ee ay wadato Villa Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdifitaax Xasan Afrax oo shalay ka degay magaaladaasi. Afrax oo codkiisa dhiibtay ayaa ka hadlay doorashadan, wuxuuna boggaadiyay, sida ay uga qayb-galeen reer Hiiraan, isaga oo tilmaamay in taariikh cusub ay dhigeen, ayna ku ciil baxeen codkooda. “Waa soo codeeyay waxaan kasoo codeeyay saldhig galbeed meesha aan joogno waa xaafadda Kooshin oo ah meeshii aan ku dhashay runtii waxaan u mahadcelinayaa dadweynaha isku soo baxay ee codadkooda dhiibtay, waxaan kaloo u mahadcelinayaa maamulka gobolka Hiiraan iyo Maayarka Beledweyne,” ayuu yiri musharrax Cabdifitaax Xasan Afrax. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii daray “Waa taariikh sameysmeysa waxaana rajeyneynaa in ummadda Soomaaliyeed sida ay u dhaqaaqay inay ahaato, safafka waa dheer yihiin sida ay noogu bilaabatay oo nabadda ah Ilaahey ha innoogu soo gabagabeeyo doorashada”. Tallaabadan ayaa ka dhigan in ugu dambeyn ay Villa Soomaaliya ku adkaatay loollankii ka socday magaalada Beledweyne, halkaas oo maalmahan ay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo culus ka wadeen siyaasiyiin kasoo horjeeda qorshaha madaxtooyada ee ku aadan HirShabelle. Arrimahan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo haatan si weyn isha loogu wada hayo doorashooyinka ka bilowday HirShabelle iyo Galmudug oo saaka looga wada dareeray magaalooyinka waa wayn ee labadaas maamul. items.title: Berbera Waa Is-goyska Danaha Siyaasadeed, Dhaqaale iyo Amni ee Somaliland iyo Itoobiya
items.description: Warbixin cusub oo lagu baahiyay kanaalka Geography By Geoff ee dalka Maraykanka ayaa si gaar ah uga hadashay muhiimadda juqraafiyeed, dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed ee Somaliland, sidoo kale warbixinta waxa lagu xusay xidhiidhka istaraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland iyo Itoobiya, taas oo diiradda lagu saaray muhiimadda ay Dekedda Berbera iyo xeebaha Somaliland u leeyihiin Itoobiya iyo guud ahaan gobolka Geeska Afrika. Warbixintu waxay tilmaantay in xidhiidhka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Itoobiya uu noqon karo fursad dhaqaale iyo mid siyaasadeed oo faa’iido ballaadhan u leh labada dhinaca ba. Waxa kale oo lagu xusay suurto-galnimada in Itoobiya ay mustaqbalka si rasmi ah u aqoonsato Somaliland, taas oo haddii ay dhacdo sida lagu sheegay warbixinta noqon karta tallaabo diblumaasiyadeed oo muhiim ah, gaar ahaan aqoosiga caalamiga ah. United States Waxa kale oo lagu sheegay warbixinta in dalka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo guud ahaan gobolka Geeska Afrika ay ku yaallaan goob juqraafi ahaan iyo siyaasad ahaan muhiim u ah dunida. Halkaas oo ay ku taallo marinka istaraatiijiga ah ee isku isku xidha qaaradda Afrika, Bariga Dhexe, Yurub iyo Aasiya. Waxa kale oo ay tilmaantay in Gobolku uu ku dhow yahay marinno-biyood muhiim ah oo ay ka mid yihiin: Gacanka Cadmeed, oo isku xidha Badda Cas iyo Badweynta Hindiya; Marinka Bab-al-Mandab, oo ah mid ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan isu socodka ganacsiga iyo Badweynta Hindiya, oo door weyn ku leh ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Geography By Geoff waxa kale oo ay warbixinteeda ku sheegay in goobta istaraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland ku taallo iyo xeebteeda dheer oo lagu qiyaaso 85km oo ku deedsan Gacanka Cadmeed ay ka dhigayso goob muhiimka u ah ganacsiga, gaadiidka badda iyo amniga gobolka. Sidoo kale waxa lagu xusay in Dekedda Berbera ay Itoobiya siin karto fursado muhiim ah maadaama oo Itoobiya ay maanta tahay dal aan lahayn xeeb iyo deked u gaar ah. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale iftiimiyay sababta Somaliland ay muhiimka ugu tahay Itoobiya waxaana lagu sheegay warbixinta “Somaliland waxay leedahay xeeb dheer oo ku taalla Gacanka Cadmeed, waxaana ku taalla Dekedda Berbera, oo leh muhiimad juqraafiyeed iyo ganacsi. Berbera waxay Itoobiya siin kartaa fursado ay ka mid yihiin: Marin kale oo ganacsi, taas oo ay u yarayn karto ku-tiirsanaanta dekedaha Jabuuti; In Itoobiya ay jid labaad u hesho dhoofinta iyo soo dejiyta badeecadaha, In Itoobiya hesho fursad istiraatiiji ah oo ay ku xoojiso xidhiidhkeeda badeed, isla markaana ay ku horumariso isku-xidhka ganacsi ee u dhexeeya Itoobiya iyo Somaliland. Sidaas awgeed, danaha Itoobiya iyo Somaliland ayaa meelaha qaar si weyn isugu waafaqaya.” Sidoo kale warbixinta ayaa tilmaantay in xidhiidhka Itoobiya uu Somaliland u abuuri karo fursado dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed. Iyada oo xustay in dhinaca dhaqaalaha, isticmaalka iyo horumarinta Berbera ay horseedi karaan: Maalgashi cusub; shaqo abuur ballaadhan, Horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha korodhka ganacsiga gobolka iyo horumarinta waddooyinka iyo isku-xidhka Somaliland iyo Itoobiya. “Dhinaca siyaasadda, taageero rasmi ah oo ka timaadda Itoobiya waxay Somaliland u noqon kartaa arrin muhiim ah marka la eego dadaalkeeda aqoonsi caalami ah,” ayaa lagu yidhi warbixinta. Axmed M. Saleebaan

Berbera waxay Itoobiya siin kartaa fursado ay ka mid yihiin: Marin kale oo ganacsi, taas oo ay u yarayn karto ku-tiirsanaanta dekedaha Jabuuti; In Itoobiya ay jid labaad u hesho dhoofinta iyo soo dejiyta badeecadaha, In Itoobiya hesho fursad istiraatiiji ah oo ay ku xoojiso xidhiidhkeeda badeed, isla markaana ay ku horumariso isku-xidhka ganacsi ee u dhexeeya Itoobiya iyo Somaliland. Sidaas awgeed, danaha Itoobiya iyo Somaliland ayaa meelaha qaar si weyn isugu waafaqaya.” Sidoo kale warbixinta ayaa tilmaantay in xidhiidhka Itoobiya uu Somaliland u abuuri karo fursado dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed. Iyada oo xustay in dhinaca dhaqaalaha, isticmaalka iyo horumarinta Berbera ay horseedi karaan: Maalgashi cusub; shaqo abuur ballaadhan, Horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha korodhka ganacsiga gobolka iyo horumarinta waddooyinka iyo isku-xidhka Somaliland iyo Itoobiya. “Dhinaca siyaasadda, taageero rasmi ah oo ka timaadda Itoobiya waxay Somaliland u noqon kartaa arrin muhiim ah marka la eego dadaalkeeda aqoonsi caalami ah,” ayaa lagu yidhi warbixinta. Axmed M. Saleebaan

items.title: Xog: Yaa dalbaday safarkii Xasan Sheekh uu shalay ku tegay Addis – Isaga mise Abiy?
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online — Faahfaahin cusub ayaa kasoo baxaysa sida uu ku yimid safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu Talaadadii ku tagay magaalada Addis Ababa, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Ahmed. Sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa Caasimada Online u sheegay in booqashada uu codsaday Abiy Ahmed, isla markaana labada dhinac ay arrinta isku afgarteen ka hor shirkii Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee toddobaadkii hore ka dhacay New York. “Abiy ayaa codsaday safarka, madaxweynaha wuu aqbalay, balse wuxuu codsaday in laga dhigo kadib shirka guud ee QM,” ayuu yiri sarkaalku, oo codsaday in aan magaciisa la shaacin maadaama uusan fasax u heysan inuu si rasmi ah uga hadlo qabanqaabada safarka. Villa Somalia ayaa si rasmi ah u sheegtay in booqashadu ahayd mid shaqo oo hal maalin ah, ayna labada hoggaamiye ka wada hadleen xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladaha siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Geeska Afrika. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa iyaduna sheegtay in kulanku ku saabsanaa arrimo laba geesood ah iyo kuwa gobolka. Muhiimadda safarka? Safarka ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Abiy Ahmed uu wajahayo xaalad amni iyo mid siyaasadeed oo culus gudaha Itoobiya. Dagaal xooggan ayaa dib uga qarxay waqooyiga dalka, gaar ahaan deegaannada ku dhow Tigray, waxaana ciidamada dowladda iyo xoogagga la safan ay Isniintii sheegeen inay la wareegeen magaalada istaraatiijiga ah ee Alamata. Xiisadda ayaa timid xilli toddoba kooxood oo hubeysan, oo ay ku jiraan TPLF, Oromo Liberation Army iyo Amhara Fano National Movement, ay sameysteen isbahaysi cusub oo sheegay inuu doonayo inuu meesha ka saaro xukuumadda Abiy Ahmed, islamarkaana dhiso maamul ku-meel-gaar ah. Xuseen Cabdirisaaq, oo ah falanqeeye siyaasadeed oo fadhigiisu yahay Muqdisho, ayaa sheegay in xaaladda gudaha Itoobiya ay muhiim tahay marka la eegayo waqtiga uu kulankan dhacay. “Mar kasta oo Abiy Ahmed uu wajahayo cadaadis xooggan oo gudaha ah, wuxuu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku casuumaa Addis Ababa, isaga oo raadinaya wax u muuqda garab istaag,” ayuu yiri Xuseen. “Waxaan filayaa in booqashada ay qeyb ka tahay taas, inkasta oo aysan labada dhinac sidaas u dhigin. Dhowr jeer oo horeyna waan aragnay sidan oo kale.” Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya midkoodna kulanka Talaadadii kuma xiriirin xaaladda siyaasadeed ama dagaallada gudaha Itoobiya. Xiriir dib loo dhisay Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale imanaya xilli Muqdisho iyo Addis Ababa ay dib u dhisayaan xiriirkooda kadib khilaafkii weynaa ee ka dhashay heshiiskii Itoobiya ay Somaliland la gashay bishii Janaayo 2024. Khilaafkaas ayaa markii dambe lagu dejiyey heshiiskii Ankara ee Xasan Sheekh iyo Abiy Ahmed ay gaareen bishii December 2024, kaas oo labada dhinac ku xaqiijiyeen madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee dalalkooda, isla markaana lagu heshiiyey in laga wada xaajoodo marin ganacsi oo Itoobiya ay ku hesho badda iyadoo la dhowrayo madaxbannaanida Soomaaliya. Kulanka Addis Ababa ee Talaadadii wax heshiis cusub ah lagama shaacin, balse xogta cusub waxay muujineysaa in booqashada ay ka dhalatay codsi hore oo uga yimid Abiy Ahmed, isla markaana waqtigeeda la isla sii qorsheeyey ka hor safarkii Xasan Sheekh ee New York. The post Xog: Yaa dalbaday safarkii Xasan Sheekh uu shalay ku tegay Addis – Isaga mise Abiy? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wasaaradda Ganacsiga oo Ka Digtay Heshiisyadda Qiime-Kordhinta Ganacsatadda
items.description: Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Dalxiiska Somaliland ayaa digniin adag ka soo saartay qiime-kordhin ay ganacsatadu si wadajir ah ugu heshiiyaan, iyadoo sheegtay in tallaabadaasi ka hor iman karto xeerarka tartanka xorta ah, cid kasta oo ku kacdana laga qaadi karo tallaabo sharci ah. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Dalxiiska JSL, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Xasan Nuur, ayaa sheegay in inkasta oo dagaallada iyo xiisadaha Bariga Dhexe ay saameeyeen isu-socodka badeecadaha iyo kharashaadka maraakiibta, haddana duruufahaas aan loo adeegsan karin in si aan waafaqsanayn sharciga loogu kordhiyo qiimaha badeecadaha iyo adeegyada. Wasaaraddu waxay si gaar ah uga digtay ururrada warshadaha laydhka, roodhida iyo kaalmaha shidaalka, iyadoo sheegtay in aanay ururradu awood u lahayn inay si wadajir ah u go’aamiyaan qiime cusub, maadaama suuqu ku dhisan yahay tartan xor ah. Waaxda La-dagaallanka Ganacsiga Sharci-darrada ah ayaa la faray inay xoojiso kormeerka suuqa iyo la socodka tallaabooyinka ganacsi ee xeerarka ka hor iman kara, si loo ilaaliyo tartanka iyo danaha macaamiisha. Wasaaradda Ganacsiga ayaa ugu dambayn ganacsatada iyo ururradooda uga digtay in tallaabo sharci ah laga qaadi doono cid kasta oo samaysa qiime-kordhin ama qiime-jaris wadajir ah oo aan waafaqsanayn sharciga.

items.title: Xukuumadda Somaliland Oo Xarunta Derbijiifka Ku Xaraysay 128 Carruur Ah Oo Waddooyinka Laga Ururiyay
items.description: Wasiirka wasaaradda Shaqada, arrimaha Bulshada iyo Qoyska Somaliland, Marwo Milgo Maxamed Sanbalooshe, ayaa shaacisay in 80% carruurta darbi-jiifka ah ee laga soo ururiyey magaalada Hargeysa ay yihiin Itoobiyaan, iyadoo sheegtay in qaar badan oo ka mid ahi haystaan kaadhadhka qaxoontiga, waalidiintoodna magaalada ku nool yihiin. Wasiirku waxay sheegtay in xogtan lagu ogaaday olole habeenimo oo Wasaaraddu ka samaysay goobaha ay carruurta darbi-jiifka ahi ku hoydaan, iyadoo hal mar laga soo ururiyey 128 carruur ah, kuwaas oo 100 ka mid ahi ahaayeen Itoobiyaan, sida ay sheegtay. Waxaaney tidhi. “Carruurta darbi-jiifka ahi 80% waa dadka inooga imanaya dalka aynu jaarka nahay ee Itoobiya. Maalin dhaweyd waxa aanu ururinay 128 carruur ah, waxaanu geynay Xarunta Darbi-jiifka ee Maxamed Mooge; 28 mooyaane, 100-ka kale waxay ahaayeen Itoobiyaan.” Milgo Maxamed Sanbalooshe waxay sheegtay in dib-u-eegis lagu sameeyey 100-ka carruur ah ay muujisay inay waalidiintoodu magaalada deggan yihiin, balse carruurta aanay si buuxda ula socon, iyadoo dhammaantood, sida ay sheegtay, haysteen kaadhadhka qaxoontiga. Waxaaney tidhi. “Dhammaantood waxay noqdeen carruur waalidkood magaalada degan yahay, balse aan masuuliyad ka hayn oo aan ogeyn meel ay ku maqan yihiin, ilmo kastana waxa loo hayay kaadhkii qaxoontiga.” Wasiirku waxay sheegtay in arrintan ay wadajir uga tashadeen Wasaaradda Dib-u-dejinta iyo Laanta Socdaalka, maadaama kaadhadhka qaxoontigu caqabad ku noqonayeen marka carruurta iyo waalidiintooda la doonayo in xaaladdooda si rasmi ah loo maareeyo. Waxaaney tidhi.“Dhibaatada ugu weyn ee ina haysata waxa weeye in loo baahan yahay in xad loo yeelo dadka aynu siinayno kaadhka qaxoontiga, ama digniin la siiyo in haddii ilmihiisa bannaanka lagu arko la rari doono oo dalkiisa lagu celin doono.” Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in la isla qaatay in carruurta la kala saaro, iyadoo xarumaha daryeelka carruurta lagu hayn doono carruurta Somaliland ee u baahan adeegyadaas. Waxaaney tidhi.“Isfahan buuxa ayaanu ka gaadhnay in carruurta xad loo yeelo, waanu kala saarnay, xaruntana ilmo Somalilander ah mooyaane ilmo kale laguma hayo, umana hayn karno, sababtoo ah miisaaniyad iyo adeegyo ku filan uma hayno.” Waxay sheegtay in awoodda xarumaha daryeelka carruurtu ku xidhan tahay miisaaniyadda, waxbarashada iyo adeegyada kale ee loo baahan yahay. Waxaaney tidhi.“Sababtu waa miisaaniyaddii, akhlaaqdii iyo waxbarashadii, waxaad samayn kartaa markaad carruur xad leh hayso oo aad ku filnaan karto dhaqaalahooda iyo wax walba, haddii kale waxay kugu noqonaysaa masuuliyad weyn oo madaxa kaa saaran.” Wasiirku waxay intaas ku dartay in carruurtii la ogaaday in waalidiintoodu magaalada ku nool yihiin dib loogu celiyey waalidiintood, halka guddi uu hoggaamiyo Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Maroodijeex uu qaabilsan yahay soo ururinta carruurta, Wasaaradduna kala wareegto marka la keeno.Carruurta yaryar ee u baahan daryeel gaar ahna, sida ay sheegtay, waxaa loo gudbiyaa xarumaha agoonta, iyadoo arrintaas lala kaashanayo Wasaaradda Waxbarashada. Waxaaney tidhi “Kuwa dhalanaya marka naloo keeno, waxaanu ku wareejinnaa Xarunta Agoomaha, waxaana ka wada shaqeeya iyaga iyo Wasaaradda Waxbarashada.” Khadar M. Xaashi

items.title: Burcad-badeed Soomaali Ah Oo Dishay Shan Shaqaale Oo Saarnaa Markab Calanka Palau Ku Goosha
items.description: GAROOWE (Goobjoog News) — Burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ayaa dishay shan shaqaale oo saarnaa markabka shidaalka qaada ee MT Honour 25, ka hor inta aysan ciidamada Puntland soo furin markabka, sida ay wakaaladda wararka Reuters ka soo xigatay Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Puntland. Dadka la dilay waxay kala ahaayeen saddex muwaadin oo Pakistani ah, hal Hindi ah iyo hal qof oo u dhashay Myanmar. Afar shaqaale oo kale—saddex Pakistani ah iyo hal Hindi ah—ayaa ku dhaawacmay muddadii uu markabku gacanta ugu jiray burcad-badeedda. Markabka MT Honour 25, oo ku gooshayey calanka Palau, ayaa la afduubtay 21-kii Abriil isagoo sida 18,500 foosto oo shidaal ah, kuna sii jeeday magaalada Muqdisho. Markabka waxaa saarnaa 17 shaqaale ah, oo toban ka mid ahi ahaayeen Pakistaniyiin. Puntland waxay sheegtay in howlgalka lagu soo furtay markabka lagu qabtay 16 qof oo lagu tuhunsan yahay burcad-badeednimo, kuwaas oo la horgeyn doono maxkamad. Maamulka ayaan weli faahfaahin ka bixin waqtiga la dilay shaqaalaha iyo xaaladdii ka horreysay dilkooda. Ciidamada Puntland ayaa isla maalintaas soo furtay markabka MT Eureka, oo burcad-badeeddu afduubteen 2-dii May isagoo ku xirnaa dekedda Qana ee gobolka Shabwa ee Yemen. Markabka oo ku gooshayey calanka Togo ayaa loo soo jiheeyey xeebaha Puntland, waxaana uu siday shidaal ay u socotay dekedda Boosaaso. Reuters waxay sheegtay in dhimashada shaqaalaha MT Honour 25 ay noqon karto dilkii ugu horreeyey ee burcad-badeed Soomaali ahi u geystaan shaqaale markab muddo ka badan toban sano. items.title: Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed oo Booqday Dadkii Ku Waxyeelloobay Weerarkii Baydhabo
items.description: Baydhabo, 30 Sebtembar 2026: Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa Isbitaalka Guud ee Gobolka Baay ku booqday qaar ka mid ah shacabka ku waxyeelloobay weerarkii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhabo. Hoggaamiyaha ayaa maamulka iyo dhakhaatiirta isbitaalka ka dhageystay warbixin ku saabsan xaaladda caafimaad ee dhaawacyada iyo daryeelka caafimaad ee loo fidinayo. Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur ayaa dhaawacyada iyo ehelladooda u muujiyey garab istaag iyo taageero, isagoo Alle uga baryay dadka dhaawacmay inuu caafimaad degdeg ah siiyo, halka dadka ku geeriyoodayna uu u rajeeyay naxariistiisa. Hoggaamiyaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dhaawacyada xaaladdoodu culus tahay, kuwaas oo aan adeegyada caafimaad ee Baydhabo wax looga qaban karin, loo qaadi doono Muqdisho, si halkaasi loogu helo daryeel caafimaad oo dheeraad ah. Sheekh Aadan ayaa intii uu booqashada ku guda jiray adkeeyey in Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ay sii wadi doonto dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo badbaadada shacabka, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka ay sii wadaan howlgallada lagu sugayo amniga magaalada Baydhabo iyo ka hortagga falalka Al-Shabaab.

items.title: Dagaalka Itoobiya oo Khatar Gelin Kara Marinka Ganacsiga ee Jabuuti
items.description: ADDIS ABABA (Goobjoog News)— Dagaallada ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya ayaa ku sii fidaya gobolka Canfarta, iyadoo xoogagga Tigrayga iyo kooxaha Canfarta ee la safan ay u dhaqaaqayaan dhanka waddooyinka isku xira Addis Ababa iyo Jabuuti. Dhaqdhaqaaqan ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in dagaalku halis geliyo marinka ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga Itoobiya. Xoogagga mucaaradka ayaa la sheegay inay qabsadeen Erebti iyo Abala, iyagoo u sii dhaqaaqaya dhanka Afdeera. Waddada ay ku socdaan waxay ku xirmaysaa jidka weyn ee Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti meel u dhow Semera, caasimadda gobolka Canfarta, inkastoo marinka ganacsigu uu weli furan yahay. Qiyaastii 95% ganacsiga dibadda Itoobiya ayaa mara Jabuuti, waxaana jidkan laga soo gudbiyaa shidaalka, cuntada, qalabka warshadaha iyo badeecadaha kale ee dalkaas muhiimka u ah. Carqalad ku timaadda marinkaasi waxay Itoobiya gelin kartaa cadaadis dhaqaale, waxayna xoogagga mucaaradka siin kartaa awood ay ku cadaadiyaan dowladdda. Warbixinnada qaarkood waxay ku qiimeeyeen in ujeeddada dhaq-dhaqaaqa bari ay tahay in la gooyo sahayda ka timaadda Jabuuti, balse weli lama soo bandhigin qorshe hawlgal oo rasmi ah oo arrintaas caddeynaya. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa la filayaa inay si adag u difaacdo jidkan, maadaama uu yahay halbowlaha dhaqaalaha dalka iyo isku xirka Addis Ababa iyo dekedaha Jabuuti. Xiisadda ayaa sidoo kale yeelanaysa muuqaal goboleed. Dowladda Itoobiya waxay Eritrea, Masar iyo Suudaan ku eedeysay inay taageerayaan kooxaha hubeysan, halka dalalkaas ay diideen eedeymaha. Is-eedeymahan ayaa kordhinaya khatarta ah in dagaalka gudaha Itoobiya uu isu beddelo loollan ay dowlado shisheeye dhinacyo kala duwan ku taageerayaan. Soomaaliya, carqalad ku timaadda marinka Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti waxay saameyn ku yeelan kartaa qiimaha shidaalka, cuntada iyo gaadiidka badeecadaha ee Geeska Afrika. Dagaal daba dheeraada wuxuu sidoo kale Itoobiya ku qasbi karaa inay ciidankeeda iyo dadaalkeeda diblomaasiyadeed ka leexiso Soomaaliya, xilli ay door muhiim ah ku leedahay amniga gobolka. Dagaallada Canfarta ayaa durba sababay barakac ballaaran, iyadoo warbixinnadu sheegayaan in ku dhowaad 150,000 qof ay ka hayaameen deegaannadooda. Fiditaanka colaadda wuxuu kordhin karaa qulqulka dadka u gudbaya Jabuuti iyo waddamada kale ee deriska ah, isagoo culays hor leh saaraya adeegyada bani’aadannimo iyo xasilloonida guud ee Geeska Afrika.

items.title: Safaaradda UK ee Muqdisho oo walaac xooggan ka muujisay…
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Britain ayaa ka hadashay dagaallada dib uga soo cusboonaaday magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoo walaac ka muujisay saameynta ay colaaddaasi ku yeelan karto dadka rayidka ah iyo xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Koonfur Galbeed. Safaaradda Britain ee Soomaaliya ayaa bayaan ay maanta soo saartay ku sheegtay inay dhammaan dhinacyada ku lugta leh iska horimaadyada ugu baaqday is-xakameyn iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii loo dejin lahaa xiisadda ka taagan magaalada. Safaaradda ayaa sidoo kale ku boorrisay dhinacyada isku haya xaaladda Baydhabo inay khilaafaadkooda ku xalliyaan wada-hadal, iyadoo sheegtay in rabshado hor leh ay sii adkeyn karaan xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee ka jirta Koonfur Galbeed. Dowladda Britain ayaa tilmaantay in bulshada ku nool deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed ay durba wajahayaan xaalad bani’aadannimo oo jilicsan, taas oo ka dhigaysa in colaado cusub ay yeelan karaan saameyn dheeraad ah. Digniinta safaaradda ayaa sidoo kale lagu xusay walaac ku saabsan saameyn laga yaabo inay ka dhalato El Niño toddobaadyada soo socda, iyadoo xaaladaha cimiladu ay kusoo biiri karaan duruufaha bani’aadannimo ee ka jira deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed. Bayaanka Britain ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Baydhabo ay ka jiraan xiisado siyaasadeed iyo amni oo sababay isku dhacyo u dhexeeya dhinacyada isku haya xaaladda magaalada. Xiisadda ka jirta Baydhabo ayaa sidoo kale la xiriirta khilaaf siyaasadeed oo u dhexeeya nidaamkii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo hoggaanka cusub ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Si kastaba, Britain ayaa adkeysay in dhinacyada isku haya xaaladda Baydhabo ay muujiyaan is-xakameyn, isla markaana ay adeegsadaan wada-hadal si loo yareeyo xiisadda loogana hortago in colaadda ay sii saameyso shacabka. items.title: Trump Administration Secures Historic Greenland Deal to Defend the Arctic
items.description: On September 22, President Trump signed an unprecedented security agreement with the leaders of Denmark and Greenland guaranteeing U.S. security interests in Greenland, at no cost to American taxpayers. “I am pleased to announce that the United States of America has entered into an Agreement… that gives the United States permanent control over security, and all other needs, in Greenland,” President Trump said announcing the deal . “There will be NO COST to the United States!” The agreement includes permanent basing rights, and bars any U.S. adversary from establishing a base, military presence, or sensitive investment in Greenland without American approval. Video of the signing is available at the White House . Greenland is strategically vital to the United States, the President said in his address to the United Nations General Assembly . With this agreement, the United States will have the complete ability to do what is necessary to defend the American continent. “Your security is our security and our security is your security,” Prime Minister of Greenland Jens-Frederik Nielsen said at the signing . “This agreement is historical.” The day before the signing, Secretary of State Rubio met in New York with the Foreign Ministers of Canada, Denmark, the Faroe Islands, Finland, Greenland, Iceland, Norway, and Sweden. The allies agreed that Arctic security requires continued investment to safeguard the region and deter strategic competitors. The agreement settles long-standing American security concerns, and now protects America “in perpetuity,” Secretary Rubio said in an interview with Sean Hannity. “If missiles were ever launched at the U.S., they would come over the Arctic Circle and over the Arctic region,” Secretary Rubio said in an interview with WABC Radio , “having that presence there will be the first line of defense against that.” Under the agreement, any non-NATO country that wants to make sensitive investments in Greenland must go through screening process. With this agreement, “Greenland will forever be part of the strategic defense area of North America and exclude any adversary from it and the surrounding area,” Secretary Rubio said on X . “You’re not going to wake up one day and realize… the Chinese military is not there but their companies own all the ports, Secretary Rubio explained in an interview with Fox News . The agreement expands the 1951 defense agreement between the United States and Denmark, which has been the basis for 75 years of security cooperation. “We are strengthening our common security, boosting our common deterrence, showing our adversaries who we are, and we are doing it together,” Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen said at the signing. “This is tremendous for Europe and for the United States, and for everybody,” President Trump said .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo bogaadiyey shacabka ka qeyb galay doorashooyinka Galmudug iyo Hirshabeelle
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa bogaadiyey shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee maanta ka qeyb qaatay doorashooyinka Golaha Wakiillada iyo Goleyaasha Deegaanka ee dowlad-goboleedyada Galmudug iyo Hirshabeelle. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in maanta ay tahay maalin muhiim ah oo ka mid noqonaysa sooyaalka dimuqraadiyadda Soomaaliya, kaddib markii shacabka gobollada Mudug, Galguduud, Hiiraan iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe ay si nabad ah ugu dareereen goobaha codbixinta. Madaxweynaha ayaa si gaar ah u ammaanay kumannaanka muwaadiniinta ah ee gutay xaqooda dastuuriga ah ee codbixinta, isagoo tilmaamay in ka qaybgalka shacabka uu door muhiim ah ka qaadanayo xoojinta dowladnimada, dimuqraadiyadda iyo matalaadda shacabka. Sidoo kale, Xasan Sheekh ayaa mahadnaq u jeediyay ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliyeed oo sugay amniga goobaha codbixinta iyo shacabka, isagoo sheegay in doorashooyinka lagu qabtay jawi nabdoon, xasilloon oo ammaan ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa xusay in doorashooyinkan ay muujinayaan rabitaanka shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee ku aaddan dhismaha dowladnimo loo dhan yahay, xoojinta nabadda iyo hirgelinta hannaan siyaasadeed oo ku salaysan rabitaanka shacabka. Doorashooyinka Galmudug iyo Hirshabeelle ayaa qayb ka ah geeddi-socodka dalka loogu gudbinayo hannaan doorasho oo toos ah iyo xoojinta hay’adaha dimuqraadiyadeed.

Madaxweynaha ayaa si gaar ah u ammaanay kumannaanka muwaadiniinta ah ee gutay xaqooda dastuuriga ah ee codbixinta, isagoo tilmaamay in ka qaybgalka shacabka uu door muhiim ah ka qaadanayo xoojinta dowladnimada, dimuqraadiyadda iyo matalaadda shacabka. Sidoo kale, Xasan Sheekh ayaa mahadnaq u jeediyay ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliyeed oo sugay amniga goobaha codbixinta iyo shacabka, isagoo sheegay in doorashooyinka lagu qabtay jawi nabdoon, xasilloon oo ammaan ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa xusay in doorashooyinkan ay muujinayaan rabitaanka shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee ku aaddan dhismaha dowladnimo loo dhan yahay, xoojinta nabadda iyo hirgelinta hannaan siyaasadeed oo ku salaysan rabitaanka shacabka. Doorashooyinka Galmudug iyo Hirshabeelle ayaa qayb ka ah geeddi-socodka dalka loogu gudbinayo hannaan doorasho oo toos ah iyo xoojinta hay’adaha dimuqraadiyadeed.

items.title: UK oo walaac ka muujisay dagaallada dib uga qarxay Baydhabo
items.description: Muqdisho, 30 Sebtembar 2026 — Safaaradda Boqortooyada Midowday ee Soomaaliya ayaa walaac ka muujisay dagaallada dib uga bilowday magaalada Baydhabo iyo saameynta ay colaadahaasi ku yeelanayaan dadka rayidka ah. Qoraal ay maanta soo saartay Safaaradda UK ayaa lagu sheegay in dowladda Britain ay ka walaacsan tahay dib u soo cusboonaanshaha dagaallada Baydhabo, iyadoo dhammaan dhinacyada ugu baaqday inay muujiyaan is-xakameyn, isla markaana ay ka shaqeeyaan dejinta xiisadda. Safaaradda ayaa sidoo kale dhinacyada ugu baaqday inay khilaafaadkooda ku xalliyaan wada-hadal iyo hannaan nabadeed, iyadoo ka digtay in rabshado dheeraad ah ay sii xumeyn karaan xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee horey uga jirtay Koonfur Galbeed. UK ayaa sheegtay in bulshada deegaanka ay sidoo kale wajahaan saameynta ka dhalan karta roobabka la xiriira El Niño toddobaadyada soo socda, taas oo walaaca bani’aadannimo sii kordhin karta. Baydhabo ayaa maalmahan wajahaysa xiisad iyo dagaallo u dhexeeya dhinacyo iska soo horjeeda, iyadoo xaaladda amni iyo tan bani’aadannimo ay si dhow isugu xiran yihiin.

items.title: How to become a nation?
items.description: Click here to learn more HOW TO BECOME A NATION? Step one: hold free and fair elections, repeatedly, while your neighbors hold none at all. Step two: build a currency, a police force, a parliament, and a passport nobody will stamp. Step three: wait. Step four: keep waiting. There is no step five. This is the entire curriculum, and Somaliland has completed it with honors, which is precisely the problem. Most aspiring nations fail by collapsing. Somaliland has committed the rarer error of succeeding too quietly, in a region where the world expects its states to announce themselves through catastrophe. Mogadishu, by contrast, has spent three decades proving its statehood the traditional way: through crisis, through outside intervention, through the sheer bureaucratic momentum of being recognized once, long ago, and never properly checked on since. Statehood, it turns out, is a lot like grandma’s cooking pots. Someone hands it down once, and nobody ever asks whether anything is still cooking in it. Kosovo learned that recognition has to be lobbied for, year after patient year, and is still waiting on some of its holdouts. Transnistria has been learning the same lesson for thirty-six years and counting. Consider the guurti, the council of elders that talked a war into peace in 1991 without a single international mediator, donor conference, or PowerPoint. For decades this has been cited approvingly in seminars on “African solutions to African problems.” The solution, however, was sovereignty, and sovereignty turns out to be the one African problem nobody wanted solved. Then there is Laascaanood, where the old clan machinery ground unhappily into reverse, and the world discovered it could, after all, take an interest in Somaliland, as a cautionary tale rather than a candidate. Instability is always news. Functioning is not. The Ethiopia memorandum was illuminating in a different way. Addis Ababa, landlocked since Eritrea’s independence in 1993, spent decades respecting the sanctity of Somalia’s borders right up until the moment it needed somewhere to put a boat. Port access then became more urgent than a plate of injera, and a memorandum was signed with the one government in the neighborhood stable enough to honor a contract. Mogadishu called it an act of aggression. It was, more precisely, an act of arithmetic. Divided we conquer. Taiwan’s involvement supplies the joke with its own punchline: one unrecognized democracy extending recognition-adjacent friendship to another, two members of a small and largely undeclared fraternity comparing notes on what it is like to function perfectly while not, technically, existing. Kosovo has drifted toward the exit of the club. Transnistria has been a member since 1990 and shows no sign of leaving. Membership, it turns out, is not the hard part. Graduation is. And Israel’s initiative completes the pattern. Recognition, when it finally arrives, rarely arrives as a verdict on facts. It arrives the way promised lands arrive in scripture: not discovered, but declared. “The tragedy of Somaliland is not that it failed to become a state. It is that it became one, and nobody told the map.” Statehood was never really a checklist of elections, institutions, and decades of peace. It was a favor, granted not to those who earn it but to those whose existence someone with a seat at the table finds useful enough to acknowledge. The guurti kept the peace. The constitution held. The ballots were counted. And still the only signature that has ever mattered belonged to colonial draftsmen who never had to live with the map they drew, and who have been dead for decades. Somewhere in Hargeisa, presumably, someone is still filling out the paperwork correctly. Which brings us to the long-awaited trip of a lifetime. Somaliland finally got its chance to stand before the world and explain why it exists, and all the more reason why it should. The premium product on offer was not the port at Berbera. It was Somaliland itself: proof that it has built people, leaders, and institutions capable of running the smooth bureaucracy a recognized state requires. If that claim were true, it should not be difficult to articulate before a global elite who are ruthless in an increasingly fragmented and volatile world order. It was, sadly, difficult. The delegation dispatched to Washington was ill prepared for the scrutiny and polished etiquette such grand theatre demands. The performance was lackluster, the rehearsals were thin, and the leader appeared uncoached for exposure at that level. All this, mind you, on a road that Israel and its lobbyists had already paved. The mission should have been executed without a hitch. What the moment required was a slick, cosmetic show: a demonstration that Somaliland’s leaders could sing and dance to the tune of the world stage without a misstep. They could not. I feel almost vindicated in what I have always argued: before the world recognizes Somaliland, it must first build something worth recognizing. To borrow from Sartre, one must exist before one can become. The country has made great strides in political process and peaceful coexistence, within its borders and with its neighbors, given its short history, limited resources, and diplomatic isolation. But the recognition campaign was ill planned, and botched in its entirety. That, then, is the last superstition of the modern state: that legitimacy is something you build, rather than something you are, eventually, granted, by whoever finds it convenient to stop ignoring you. By Cali Cabdi Irro As per usual the opinions expressed in this articale are those of the author and do not reflect the opinions of qarannews.com

items.title: Xiisadda Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Imaaraadka oo u muuqata in ay weji cusub yeelatay
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) — Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa dib ugu soo dhowaaneysa Imaaraadka Carabta, bilo kadib khilaaf weyn oo labada dal ka dhex qarxay Yemen, xilli Riyadh ay wajahayo cadaadis sii kordhaya oo uga imanaya Xuutiyiinta iyo isbeddel degdeg ah oo ka socda furimaha dagaalka. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Imaaraadka Sheekh Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan ayaa Talaadadii booqday Riyadh, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Mohammed bin Salman iyo wasiirka gaashaandhigga Khalid bin Salman. Waxay ahayd booqashadii ugu horreysay ee mas’uul sare oo Imaaraati ah uu ku tago Sacuudiga tan iyo markii uu bannaanka yimid khilaafkii xooggan ee labada dal ee arrimo ay ka mid yihiin Yemen, Sudan iyo Soomaaliya. Booqashada ayaa ku soo beegmeysa xilli Sacuudigu uu isku dayayo inuu dib u xoojiyo xulafadiisa ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta, kadib markii kooxdaasi ay bishan guulo waaweyn ka gaartay galbeedka Yemen, isla markaana ay kordhisay weerarrada gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga. Middle East Eye ayaa isbeddelkan ku tilmaantay Sacuudiga oo mar kale u jeestay Imaaraadka, oo muddo dheer ahaa xulafadiisa ugu muhiimsan dagaalka Yemen, xilli Riyadh ay raadineyso awood dheeraad ah oo lagu hor istaago Xuutiyiinta. Khilaafkii labada xulufo Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka ayaa muddo sanado ah isku dhinac ka ahaa dagaalka Yemen, balse labada dal waxay markii dambe taageereen xoogag Yemeni ah oo leh dano siyaasadeed oo kala duwan. Riyadh waxay taageertay dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, halka Abu Dhabi ay xiriir dhow la lahayd Golaha Ku-meel-gaarka Koonfurta ee STC iyo ciidamo kale oo koonfurta Yemen ka dagaallama. Khilaafka ayaa si weyn bannaanka ugu soo baxay dabayaaqadii 2025, markii xoogag ay Imaaraadku taageeraan ay ku dhaqaaqeen deegaanno u dhow xadka Sacuudiga. Riyadh ayaa tallaabadaas u aragtay mid halis ku ah ammaankeeda, waxayna xitaa duqeysay shixnad hub ah oo ay sheegtay inay Imaaraadka xiriir la leedahay. Imaaraadka ayaa wixii ka dambeeyay ciidamadiisa kala baxay Yemen, taas oo calaamad u noqotay sida uu u xumaaday xiriirka labada xulufo. Laakiin xaaladda Yemen ayaa toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay si weyn isu beddeshay. Xuutiyiinta ayaa weerar ballaaran ka qaaday galbeedka dalka, waxayna la wareegeen deegaanno muhiim ah oo ku yaalla xeebta Badda Cas, oo ay ku jiraan dekedda Mocha iyo jasiiradda Perim ee marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Waxay sidoo kale cadaadis ku hayaan ciidamada dowladda ee gobolka Taiz. Bab al-Mandab ayaa hadda si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Sacuudiga, maadaama uu yahay marin muhiim u ah dhoofinta shidaalka iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan iyadoo xiisadaha ka jira marin-biyoodka Hormuz ay saameeyeen isu-socodka gobolka. Maxaa Imaaraadka mar kale muhiim ka dhigaya? Inkastoo Imaaraadku ciidamadiisa rasmiga ah kala baxay Yemen, haddana wuxuu sannado badan tababaray, hubeynayay oo taageerayay xoogag awood badan ku leh koonfurta iyo galbeedka dalka. Waxaa ka mid ah ciidamada loo yaqaan Giant Brigades, kuwaas oo lagu tiriyo xoogagga ugu tababarka iyo qalabka wanaagsan dhinaca ka soo horjeeda Xuutiyiinta. Sida uu qoray The Guardian , waxaa jira cadaadis lagu saarayo Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka inay khilaafkooda dhinac iska dhigaan si xoogaggaas loogu daro dadaal mideysan oo lagu joojinayo horumarka Xuutiyiinta. Taasi waxay Riyadh gelisay xaalad ka duwan tii bilo ka hor: Sacuudiga oo doonayay inuu yareeyo saameynta Imaaraadka ee Yemen ayaa hadda dan ka yeelan kara inuu dib ula shaqeeyo Abu Dhabi iyo xoogagga ay muddada dheer taageereysay. Kulankii Riyadh, Sheekh Mansour iyo Khalid bin Salman waxay ka wada hadleen danaha labada dal, sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga iyo isku-duwidda, iyo xaaladaha gobolka. Mansour ayaa sidoo kale Mohammed bin Salman kala hadlay xiriirka labada dal iyo horumarrada gobolka. Si kastaba, ilaa hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo sheegaya in Imaaraadku dib ugu biirayo dagaalka Yemen ama in Sacuudigu si rasmi ah uga codsaday inuu ciidamo dib ugu soo celiyo dalka. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in Riyadh ay raadineyso taageero caalami ah oo ay ku wajahdo Xuutiyiinta, balse aysan weli caddeyn in codsigaas si gaar ah loogu gudbiyay Imaaraadka. Booqashada Mansour ayaa sidaas darteed muujineysa ugu yaraan in labada dal ay dib u furayaan marin siyaasadeed oo bilo ka hor si weyn u dhaawacmay. Haddii xiriirkaas uu isu beddelo iskaashi militari oo cusub, waxay noqon kartaa isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada dagaalka Yemen, xilli Xuutiyiintu ay dib u heleen awood ay ku beddeli karaan dheelitirka dagaalka isla markaana cadaadis cusub ku saari karaan Sacuudiga iyo marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Badda Cas. Afar shaqaale oo kale ayaa dhaawacmay, kuwaas oo kala ah saddex Pakistani ah iyo hal Hindi ah, sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka. Puntland waxay dilka dusha ka saartay burcad-badeedda markabka haysatay, hase yeeshee war-saxaafadeedku ma faahfaahin sida ay dilalku u dhaceen ama duruufihii ku xeernaa. Nooca dhacdada ee Puntland soo bandhigtay ayaa ka duwan wararkii ugu horreeyay ee kasoo baxay qaar ka mid ah shaqaalaha markabka ee badbaaday, kuwaas oo warbaahinta Pakistan u sheegay in rasaas lagu furay la-haystayaasha xilli ciidamada Puntland ay ku soo dhowaadeen markabka. Sidaas darteed, inkasta oo Puntland ay xaqiijisay tirada dhimashada iyo dhaawaca, weli si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin qaabka saxda ah ee shaqaaluhu ku dhinteen iyo sida ay dhacdooyinku isugu xigeen. 21 burcad-badeed ah oo la qabtay PMPF ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada ay intii uu socday howlgalka gacanta ku dhigeen 21 qof oo lagu eedeeyay burcad-badeednimo, halka tiro kale ay baxsadeen. Markabka Honour 25 ayaa burcad-badeeddu qabsadeen 21-kii April, xilli uu watay shidaal kuna sii jeeday Muqdisho. Waxaa saarnaa 17 shaqaale ah, oo 10 ka mid ah ay ahaayeen Pakistani, waxaana markabka muddo ka badan shan bilood lagu haystay xeebaha waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya. Qoysaska shaqaalaha Pakistani-ga ah ayaa bilihii la soo dhaafay dhowr jeer dowladda dalkooda ka dalbaday inay dadajiso sidii loo sii deyn lahaa eheladooda. items.title: Isbahaysigii uu hoggaaminayay Mareykanka oo soo gabagabeeyay howlgalka uu ka waday Ciraaq
items.description: Isbahaysiga uu hoggaaminayo Mareykanka ayaa soo gabagabeeyay howlgalkii milatari ee uu muddo ka badan toban sano ka waday dalka Ciraaq, kaas oo si rasmi ah loo bilaabay sanadkii 2014-kii, xilli ciidamada isbahaysiga loo diray Ciraaq iyo Suuriya si ay ula dagaallamaan kooxda Daacish. Ciidamadii ugu dambeeyay ee isbahaysiga ayaa lagu wadaa inay Arbacada ka baxaan gobolka Kurdistaan ee waqooyiga Ciraaq, iyadoo bixitaankaasi uu qayb ka yahay heshiis ay sannadkii 2024 gaareen dowladda Ciraaq iyo Mareykanka, kaas oo lagu heshiiyay in si tartiib ah loo soo afjaro howlgalka isbahaysiga ee gudaha Ciraaq. Howlgalka isbahaysiga ayaa muddo sanado ah diiradda saarayay dagaalka ka dhanka ah Daacish iyo taageerada ciidamada ammaanka ee Ciraaq, iyadoo isbahaysigu uu qayb ka ahaa dadaalladii lagu wiiqayay awoodda kooxdaasi ee Ciraaq iyo Suuriya. Bixitaanka ciidamada isbahaysiga ayaa astaan u ah dhammaadka marxalad milatari oo muddo dheer socotay, iyadoo mas’uuliyadda amniga gudaha dalka ay si weyn ugu sii wareegayso ciidamada iyo hay’adaha ammaanka Ciraaq. Heshiiska Baqdaad iyo Washington ayaa dhigayay in howlgalka isbahaysiga ee Ciraaq si qorshaysan loo soo afjaro, iyadoo labada dhinac ay sii wadi doonaan xiriirka dhinacyada amniga iyo iskaashiga ka dhanka ah khataraha argagixisada.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo kulan la qaatay Madaxweyne Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle
items.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta safar shaqo ku tagay dalka Jabuuti, halkaas oo uu kulan miro-dhal ah kula yeeshay Madaxweynaha Jabuuti, Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle. Labada Madaxweyne ayaa kulankooda diiradda ku saaray xoojinta xiriirka walaaltinimo iyo iskaashiga soo jireenka ah ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada hadlay sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo siyaasadda , iyo arrimaha la xiriira nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Madaxweynayaasha Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti ayaa si gaar ah uga wada hadlay xaaladda amni iyo siyaasadeed ee Geeska Afrika, iyagoo isla eegay sidii loo xoojin lahaa wada-shaqeynta labada dal ee ku aaddan nabadda, xasilloonida iyo amniga gobolka. Booqashada Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee Jabuuti ayaa qeyb ka ah xiriirka iyo wadashaqeynta joogtada ah ee labada dowladood, iyadoo Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti ay leeyihiin xiriir dhow oo ku dhisan derisnimo, walaaltinimo iyo dano wadaag.

items.title: Sideed badmaaxiin Masaari ah oo laga sii daayay afduub ka dhacay xeebaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Sideed badmaaxiin u dhashay dalka Masar oo muddo bilo ah lagu haystay kadib markii lagu afduubtay markabka M/T Eureka oo marayay xeebaha Soomaaliya, ayaa la sii daayay, sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Masar. Badmaaxiintan ayaa la sheegay in laga afduubtay markabka 2-dii May, xilli uu marayay meel ka baxsan xeebaha gobolka Puntland, Sida warbixintu tilmaamayso, rag hubeysan oo la rumeysan yahay inay ahaayeen burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ayaa gacanta ku dhigay markabka, kadibna waxay u jiheeyeen dhanka xeebaha Soomaaliya. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Masar ayaa sheegtay in Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda, Badr Abdelatty, uu faray safaaradda Masar ee Muqdisho inay qaabisho badmaaxiinta, hubiso xaaladdooda caafimaad iyo badqabkooda, isla markaana fududeyso sidii loogu celin lahaa dalkooda diyaarad ugu horreysa. Intii ay afduubka ku jireen, safaaradda Masar ee Muqdisho ayaa fududeysay xiriirka u dhexeeyay badmaaxiinta iyo qoysaskooda, si qoysasku ay uga war hayaan xaaladdooda. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Masar ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in dadaallada lagu sii deynayay badmaaxiinta ay ku yimideen kadib amar iyo dabagal uu sameeyay madaxweynaha Masar, Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, iyo xiriirro heer sare ah oo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar uu la sameeyay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Soomaaliya iyo Yemen. Masar ayaa muddo bilo ah waday dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu xaqiijinayo sii deynta sideedda badmaax, ayadoo Warbixino hore ay sheegeen in afduubayaasha ay dalbadeen lacag la xiriirta sii deynta shaqaalaha iyo markabka, inkastoo faahfaahinta heshiiska lagu gaaray sii deynta aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin. Sii deynta badmaaxiinta ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli xeebaha Soomaaliya ay weli muhiim u yihiin dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagula dagaallamayo burcad-badeednimada iyo sugidda amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara biyaha gobolka.

items.title: Rabshado ka dhex dhacay Diyaaradda Flydubai oo ka duushay Dubai una socotay Israa’iil
items.description: Diyaarad rakaab oo ay leedahay shirkadda Flydubai, taas oo ka duushay magaalada Dubai ee Imaaraadka Carabta kuna sii jeeday Israa’iil, ayaa si degdeg ah ugu degtay dalka Sacuudiga kadib markii ay la kulantay xaalad degdeg ah. Shirkadda Flydubai ayaa xaqiijisay in diyaaradda ay la kulantay dhacdo xilli ay ku sii jeedday halka ay u socotay, balse ay si nabad ah ugu degtay garoonka Tabuk ee waqooyi-galbeed Sacuudiga. Shirkaddu waxay sheegtay in dhammaan rakaabkii iyo shaqaalihii diyaaradda ay badqabaan, isla markaana la xisaabiyay. Xogta la heli karo ee la socodka duulimaadyada ayaa muujisay in diyaaradda, oo ahayd Boeing 737 Max 8, ay si lama filaan ah hoos ugu dhacday jooggeeda. Sida xogta Flightradar laga soo xigtay, ayaa sheegtay in diyaaraddu ay muddo kooban gudaheed uga soo degtay ku dhowaad 34,000 oo fuudh ilaa wax ka yar 17,000 oo fuudh. Warbaahinta Israa’iil ayaa tabisay in digniinta loo yaqaan “faragelin sharci-darro ah” ay suuragal tahay inay la xiriirtay muran dhex maray duuliyeyaasha diyaaradda, iyadoo warbixinnadaasi ay soo xiganayeen saraakiil Israa’iili ah. Qaar ka mid ah rakaabka ayaa warbaahinta Israa’iil u sheegay inay maqleen qaylo ka timid qaybta hore ee diyaaradda, isla markaana ay dareemeen diyaaradda oo si xooggan hoos ugu dhacaysa ka hor inta aysan ku degin Tabuk. Dhanka kale, xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa sheegay in Israa’iil ay diyaarinayso sidii rakaabka Israa’iiliyiinta ah ee diyaaradda saarnaa si ammaan ah loogu soo celin lahaa Israa’iil. Dhacdadan ayaa sidoo kale keentay in madaxda militariga Israa’iil ay qiimeyn ka sameeyaan xaaladda, iyadoo Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidamada Israa’iil, Eyal Zamir, uu kulan la qaatay saraakiil sare. Shirkadda Flydubai ayaa sheegtay inay faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka bixin doonto dhacdada marka ay soo baxaan xog dheeraad ah, xilli duulimaadyada u dhexeeya Imaaraadka Carabta iyo Israa’iil ay yihiin kuwo si joogto ah u socda tan iyo markii labada dal ay xiriirkooda caadiyeeyeen sanadkii 2020.

Warbaahinta Israa’iil ayaa tabisay in digniinta loo yaqaan “faragelin sharci-darro ah” ay suuragal tahay inay la xiriirtay muran dhex maray duuliyeyaasha diyaaradda, iyadoo warbixinnadaasi ay soo xiganayeen saraakiil Israa’iili ah. Qaar ka mid ah rakaabka ayaa warbaahinta Israa’iil u sheegay inay maqleen qaylo ka timid qaybta hore ee diyaaradda, isla markaana ay dareemeen diyaaradda oo si xooggan hoos ugu dhacaysa ka hor inta aysan ku degin Tabuk. Dhanka kale, xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa sheegay in Israa’iil ay diyaarinayso sidii rakaabka Israa’iiliyiinta ah ee diyaaradda saarnaa si ammaan ah loogu soo celin lahaa Israa’iil. Dhacdadan ayaa sidoo kale keentay in madaxda militariga Israa’iil ay qiimeyn ka sameeyaan xaaladda, iyadoo Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidamada Israa’iil, Eyal Zamir, uu kulan la qaatay saraakiil sare. Shirkadda Flydubai ayaa sheegtay inay faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka bixin doonto dhacdada marka ay soo baxaan xog dheeraad ah, xilli duulimaadyada u dhexeeya Imaaraadka Carabta iyo Israa’iil ay yihiin kuwo si joogto ah u socda tan iyo markii labada dal ay xiriirkooda caadiyeeyeen sanadkii 2020.

items.title: Koonfur Afrika oo markii saddexaad u yeertay safiirka Mareykanka
items.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Koonfur Afrika ayaa markii saddexaad muddo sagaal bilood ah u yeertay safiirka Mareykanka ee dalkaas, Leo Brent Bozell III , iyadoo dowladda Koonfur Afrika ay ku eedeysay inuu sameeyay waxa ay ku tilmaantay “dhaqan aan diblomaasiyadeed ahayn.” Mas’uul sare oo ka tirsan Waaxda Xiriirka Caalamiga ah iyo Iskaashiga Koonfur Afrika ayaa xaqiijiyay in safiirka loo gudbiyay demarche , oo ah hab diblomaasiyadeed oo dowlad ay si rasmi ah ugu gudbiso dowlad kale cabasho ama mudaaharaad. Mas’uulku faahfaahin kama bixin sababta gaarka ah ee tallaabadan markan, balse wuxuu sheegay in tani ay tahay markii saddexaad ee safiirka Bozell loo yeero tan iyo markii uu xilka safiirnimo ka bilaabay Koonfur Afrika sagaal bilood ka hor. Xiriirka u dhexeeya Pretoria iyo Washington ayaa bilihii u dambeeyay wajahaya xiisado, iyadoo ay labada dhinac isku hayaan arrimo dhowr ah oo ay ka mid yihiin siyaasadaha gudaha ee Koonfur Afrika iyo arrimaha la xiriira sinnaan la’aanta taariikhiga ah ee ka dhalatay nidaamkii midab-takoorka. Safiir Bozell ayaa markii hore loo yeeray toddobaadyo gudahood markii uu xilka qabtay, kadib hadallo ay mas’uuliyiinta Koonfur Afrika sheegeen inay wiiqayeen garsoorka dalka iyo fahamka taariikhdiisa. Inkasta oo ay jiraan khilaafaadyo diblomaasiyadeed, haddana dowladda Koonfur Afrika waxay sheegtay inay weli diyaar u tahay wada-hadal iyo in labada dal ay sii wadaan dadaallada lagu xallinayo arrimaha ka dhex taagan.

items.title: Xisbiyada mucaaradka Somaliland oo jawaab kulul siiyay R/wasaare Xamza
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Xisbiyada mucaaradka Somaliland ayaa si adag uga fal-celiyay hadal dhawaan kasoo yeeray Ra’iisul wasaaraha xukuumadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre oo ku aadanaa aqoonsiga ay Somaliland ka heshay maamulka Israa’iil. Xamza Cabdi Barre oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Dawan TV ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in aanu jirin taageero ballaaran oo aqoonsiga Israa’iil uu ka haysto bulshada Somaliland. Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa si gaar ah u xusay in qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Somaliland, oo ay ka mid yihiin culimada, madax-dhaqameedka iyo xisbiyada aysan taageersanayn aqoonsiga Israa’iil, isaga oo tilmaamay in arrintaas ay ku kooban tahay xukuumadda oo keliya. Intaas kadib waxaa soo jawaabay xisbiyada mucaaradka Somaliland oo meesha ka saaray hadalka kasoo yeeray wasiirka koowaad ee xukuumadda Soomaaliya. Xoghayaha Guud ee xisbiga Kulmiye, Mudane Faysal Cabdiraxmaan Madar, oo shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaaada Hargeysa ayaa sheegay in ka xisbi ahaan ay si buuxda u taageersan yihiin qaddiyadda aqoonsiga, isla markaana aanu xisbigoodu ka laaban doonin mowqifkaas. “Mar kale Kulmiye waxa uu caddaynayaa in aqoonsiga Somaliland ay ka heshay Israa’iil aanu ahayn arrin laga wada xaajoon karo, waanan taageersannahay,” ayuu yiri Madar. Dhankiisa Cabdirakiim Maxamed, oo kamid ah hoggaanka sare ee xisbiga mucaaradka ee Kaah, ayaa isna hadalka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya ku tilmaamay faham aan sax ahayn oo laga qaatay doodaha siyaasadeed ee Somaliland, gaar ahaan aqoonsiga Israa’iil. Cabdirakiim ayaa xusay in culimada, madax-dhaqameedka, siyaasiyiinta iyo qaybaha kale ee bulshada Somaliland ay leeyihiin aragtiyo kala duwan oo ku saabsan arrimaha siyaasadeed, balse aan taas loo fasiri karin inay ka soo horjeedaan qaddiyadda Somaliland. Waxaa kale oo uu intaasi kusii daray in kala aragti duwanaanshaha siyaasadeed ee ka jira gudaha Somaliland ayaan meesha ka saarayn mowqifka guud ee bulshada ee ku saabsan aaya-ka-tashiga iyo dawladnimada Somaliland. Si kastaba, Israel ayaa bishii December 26, 2025, noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay oo si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland inay tahay dal madax-bannaan, arrintaas oo ay si u cambaareysay, una diiday dowladda Soomaaliya. The post Xisbiyada mucaaradka Somaliland oo jawaab kulul siiyay R/wasaare Xamza appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay doorashooyinka ka bilowday HirShabelle iyo Galmudug
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Waxaa maanta deegaannada HirShabelle iyo Galmudug ka bilowday doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee Golaha Wakiilada iyo Deegaanka, iyadoo saaka ay shacabka u darareen goobaha cod-bixinta, si ay u doortaan xildhibaannada matalaya. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxa-banaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan oo ku sugan Dhuusamareeb ayaa si rasmi ah u furay doorashooyinkan, iyada oo tan Galmudug ay tahay ku celis, halka HirShabelle ay tahay markii ugu horreysay ee ay galeyso doorashooyin qof iyo cod ah. Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in HirShabelle ay doorashooyinku ka dhacayaan 10 degmo, halka Galmudugna loo qorsheeyay illaa 11 degmo, halkaas oo la geeyay shaqaale kumaan kun ah oo ka shaqeynaya habsami u socodka doorashooyinka. Sidoo kale, ammaanka guud ee magaalooyinka Galmudug iyo HirShabelle ayaa aad loo adkeeyay iyadoo la xadiday isu socodka gaadiidka ee labada maamul, si looga hortago in la carqaladeeyo amniga doorashada. Magaalooyinka sida wayn isha loogu hayo ayaa waxaa kamid ah Beledweyne oo ay xiisad xooggan ka taagan tahay, waxaana saaka la geliyay bandow, iyadoo sidoo kale lagu arkayo ciidamo dheeraad ah oo la geeyay goobaha loo qorsheeyay doorashooyinka. Xaaladda guud ee labada maamul ayaa hadda deggan, waxaana la sugayaa natiijtada doorashooyinkan oo ay ku tartamayaan illaa dhowr urur siyaasadeed oo isku diiwaangeliyay. Galmudug ayaa la filayaa inuu isbeddal ka dhaco, ‘kuna soo baxo Liibaan Axmed Xasan’ oo ay wadato Villa Soomaaliya, halka HirShabelle mar labaad la saadaalinayo ‘inuu hoggaamiyo Cali Guudlaawe’ oo isna taageerada ugu badan ka helayo madaxda Dowladda Federaalka. Si kastaba, horay doorashooyin kuwaan lamid ah waxay uga dhaceen Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo lagu soo doortay hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Madoobe, inkastoo isbeddalkaas uu xiisad horleh ka dhaliyay maamulkaasi, waxaana xaaladda ay isku beddashay dagaal joogta ah oo u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. The post Wararkii ugu dambeeyay doorashooyinka ka bilowday HirShabelle iyo Galmudug appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Guddiga doorashooyinka oo faahfaahin ka bixiyay doorashooyinka Galmudug iyo Hirshabeelle
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka, Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan, ayaa sheegay in doorashadu si habsami leh uga bilaabatay 10 degmo oo ka tirsan Hirshabeelle iyo 11 degmo oo ka tirsan Galmudug . Shacabka ku nool 11-ka degmo ee Galmudug ayaa saaka u dareeray goobaha codbixinta, halkaas oo ay ku dhiibanayaan codkooda, iyagoo dooranaya xubnaha matalaya deegaannadooda. Doorashadan qof iyo codka ah ayaa ah mid muhiim u ah hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka, iyadoo markii ugu horreysay muddo dheer kadib shacabka deegaannada qaarkood ay si toos ah uga qayb qaadanayaan doorashada wakiilladooda. Goobaha codbixinta ayaa waxaa ka muuqda isu-socodka iyo safafka shacabka, iyadoo hay’adaha ammaanka iyo guddiyada doorashooyinkuna ay qaadeen tallaabooyin lagu xaqiijinayo in howlaha codbixintu ay u dhacaan si nabad ah oo habsami leh. Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa sheegay in doorashada ay ka socoto degmooyinka loo asteeyey, iyadoo shacabka loogu baaqay inay si nabad ah uga qayb qaataan hannaanka doorashada. Doorashada qof iyo codka ah ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu horumarinayo hannaanka dimuqraadiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo in shacabka ay door muuqda ku yeeshaan soo xulista xubnaha matalaya.

Sarkaalku wuxuu sheegay in qorshaha hadda jira uu yahay in Xasan Sheekh uu Arbacada tago Jabuuti, halka Jimcahana uu u safro Masar. Hase yeeshee, ilo-wareedyo kale oo xog-ogaal u ah qorshaha safarka ayaa sheegay in labada safarba ay dhici karaan Jimcaha, iyadoo madaxweynuhu marka hore sii mari doono Jabuuti, kadibna uu u gudbi doono Masar. Farqiga ku jira xogta ku saabsan maalmaha safarka ayaa muujinaya in jadwalka ugu dambeeya uu weli isbedeli karo. Safarradan ayaa la filayaa in looga hadlo xiriirka Soomaaliya la leedahay labada dal, xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Geeska Afrika, iyo arrimaha ka taagan Badda Cas. Waxay kusoo aadayaan maalmo kadib markii Xasan Sheekh uu booqasho hal maalin ah ku tagay Addis Ababa, halkaas oo uu Talaadadii kula kulmay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Ahmed. Caasimada Online ayaa horey u sheegtay in safarka Itoobiya uu yimid kadib codsi uu Abiy Ahmed u diray Xasan Sheekh, isla markaana lagu heshiiyey ka hor shirkii Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee toddobaadkii hore ka dhacay New York. Safarka Jabuuti Kulamada Xasan Sheekh ee Jabuuti ayaa la filayaa inay diiradda saaraan xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladda gobolka, gaar ahaan arrimaha amniga ee Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas. Jabuuti waxay ku taallaa meel istaraatiiji ah oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, kaas oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isla markaana ka mid ah marinnada ganacsi ee ugu muhiimsan dunida. Dalku sidoo kale wuxuu ka mid yahay saaxiibbada siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Soomaaliya, wuxuuna martigeliyaa xarunta urur goboleedka IGAD. Arrimaha Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ayaa sanadihii dambe noqday kuwo sii kordhaya muhiimaddooda, iyadoo dagaallada Sudan iyo Yemen iyo weerarrada lagu qaaday maraakiibta ganacsiga ay sare u qaadeen walaaca amni ee gobolka. Safarka Masar Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale lagu wadaa inuu safarka Masar ku yeesho kulamo siyaasadeed iyo kuwo amni oo heer sare ah. Xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Qaahira ayaa si weyn u xoogeysanayay sanadihii dambe, gaar ahaan dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga. Labada dal ayaa sare u qaaday iskaashiga militariga, iyadoo saraakiil sare oo Masri ah ay dhowaan Muqdisho kula kulmeen madaxda Soomaaliya, kana wada hadleen tababar, dhismaha awoodda ciidamada iyo taageerada ciidanka xoogga dalka. Kulamada Masar ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inay taabtaan xaaladda Geeska Afrika, Badda Cas iyo arrimaha amniga gobolka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa inta uu joogo Masar lagu wadaa inuu ka qeyb galo shirar heer sare ah oo Afrikaan ah oo ka dhacaya magaalada New Alamein. Masar ayaa magaaladaas ku martigelinaysa shirar dhowr ah oo Afrikaan ah inta u dhaxeysa 2-da ilaa 4-ta October, oo uu ku jiro shir ay isugu imaanayaan madaxda Afrika iyo hay’adaha Midowga Afrika. Ilo-wareedyo ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in madax kale oo Afrikaan ah ay suuragal tahay inay ka qeyb galaan kulamadaas, oo ay ka mid yihiin Madaxweynaha Eritrea Isaias Afwerki iyo hoggaamiyaha ciidamada Sudan Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, inkastoo ka qeyb-galkooda aan weli si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin. Safarrada Xasan Sheekh ee Jabuuti iyo Masar waxay kusoo aadayaan xilli gobolka uu wajahayo xaalado amni iyo siyaasadeed oo adag, oo ay ka mid yihiin dagaallada dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya, colaadda Sudan iyo xiisadaha ka taagan Badda Cas. items.title: Roob la’aan qalajisay beeraha oo barakicisay 300 qoys oo maciin biday Afgooye
items.description: (ERGO) – Biyo yari, cunno xumo iyo hoy la’aan ayay 300 oo qoys tan iyo bishii Ogosto ee sanadkaan ku wajahayaan xerada Sooglow ee magaalada Afgooye ee gobolka Shabeellaha hoose.   Qoysaskaan oo xoola dhaqato iyo beeralay iskugu jira ayaa roob yari saamaysay dallagyadii ay beerteen iyo xoolahoodi uga soo barakacay deegaannada Basra, Alifow iyo Baqdaad. Dadkan oo ay ku adag tahay in hal waqti ay dabka shitaan maalinkii ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay inaysan haysan shaqooyin ay ku dabaraan noloshooda. Xerada ay soo maciin bideen malahan adeegyada bulshada sida waxbarashada, biyaha iyo caafimaadka. Xamdi Muxudiin Cali oo ka mid ah ayaa sheegtay in iyada, haweeynay wayeel ah oo ay ehel yihiin iyo 10 carruur ah oo uu abbbahood ku dayacay aysan gaajo ka bixin tan iyo barakacooda. Waxay xustay In maalinkii ay mar dabka ku shitaan waxay ay dadka ka soo helaan carruurteeda oo magaalada u dawarsi taga. “$1 ama $2 wixii ay carruurta ku soo helaan dawarsiga ayaan dabka ku shidanaa. Hal mar ka badan nooma goyso waxaa aan ka helno dadka Islaamka ah ku soo caawiyaan. Halkaas mar ayaan u kariya qoyska, inta kalana gaajo ayaan ku joogna.” Xamdi ayaa sheegtay in ay wayday shaqooyin dhar-dhaqis ah oo ay magaalada ka raadisay marar kala duwan si ay nolosha qoyskeeeda u maarayso. Waxay xustay in uusan jirin qof kale oo uu qoyskeeda u shaqeeya. Carruurteeda ayay sheegtay in midka ugu wayn uu 12 jir yahay, uusanna ku jirin mid shaqooyinka dhagax jabinta ah qaban kara. Waxay xustay in ay rajo xumo ku beertay darxumada ay kala kulmeen xeryaha magaalada Afgooye oo iyada iyo qoyskeedaa ay ku soo gaareen gaari dameer ay ku caawiyeen dad ay u dan sheegteen.  Safarkaas ayay tilmamtay in uu ku qaatay toddobo habeen iyo malmahooda. Xamdi oo 51 jir ah ayaa xustay in xaaladan ay u dheertahay helitaanka biyaha oo ay ku dhibban yihiin. Ceel riig ah oo gaar loo leeyahay oo biyihiisa bilaash looga dhigay dadka soo barakacay, kaas oo u jira 5 km ayay tilmaamtay in maalinkii ay jirgaan dhabarka uga soo qaado. Waxay ka faro maran tahay $0.25 oo labatanle qaadkii ay iibiyaan ceelasha riiga ah ee xerada u dhaw. Qubeys iyo dhar-dhaqis ayay sheegtay inaysan tabar u hayn oo ay maalinkii jirgaankaasi u tashiishaan cabida iyo karinta cunnada. Qoyskeeda ayaa ah bannaan yaal aan haysan hoy ka xijin karaan qoraxda maalinkii iyo qabowga habeenkii. “Habeenkii dhaxan ayaan ka seexan Karin, maalinkiina qoraxda. buushashka aan gabadsano habeeenkii waa ullo iyo juwaano dhamaad ah oo laisku geeyay waxbo ma celin karaan.” “Anaga guriyaheeni iyo wixii aan haysan dhan waa iskaga soo tagnay, maaddama aan haynin meel aan ku qaadno. Sidoo kale musqul ma haysano oo meelaha banana ayaan isticmaalna.” Xamdi ayaa sheegtay in barakaca ay uga waxbarasho beeleen lix ka mid ah carruurteeda oo horray dugsi Qur’aan ay bishii ka dhiibi jirtay $6 isku darkooda uga dhigan jiray deegaanka Basra oo ay ka yimaadeen. Waxay xustay in aysan hadda qaadan wax daruus ah, maaddaama aysan u awoodin $18 oo qofkiiba ay wax ku baaran iskuullada magaalada Afgooye. Noloshii ay filaysay in ay ka helaan magaalada ayay xustay in ay ku hungoobeen. Qoyska Xamdi oo xoola dhaqato ahaa ayaa barakaca ku qasbanaaday, markii biyo yari, daaq la’aan iyo cudurro aysan aqoon oo ay tabar u waayeen ay uga la’deen 50 neef oo ari iyo lo’ iskugu jiray. Xoola dhaqatada iyo beeralayda Soomaaliyeed ayaa sanooyin badan oo is xiga dhibane u ah musiibooyinka dabiiciga ah ee ka dhashay isbedelka cimilada. Arintaasi waxay sababtay in sanad kasta ay xeryaha lagu barakacay ku soo biiraan kummanaan qoys oo faro maran, sidoo kalana aan laheyn aqoon iyo xirfado ay uga shaqeystaan. Cajaba Maxamed Taakooy oo 39 jir ah ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay in nolosheeda oo dhan ay ku qaadatay miyiga, waligeedna ay jeclayd in ay ku sii nagaato, balse ay barakaca ku qasbanaadeen. Cajaba Maxamed Taakooy oo sheegtay in carruurteeda yaryar aysan u heli karin dhamaan baahiyahooda aas-aasiga ah  Beer saddex hiktar ah oo ay ku leeyihiin deegaanka Alifow waxaa saameysay biyo la’aan. Waxay xustay inay tahay markii ugu horeysay oo ay barakacdo. Wax la’aanta haysa darteed waxay tilmamtay in qoyskeeda oo 11 ah ay ku tiirsan yihiin cunto bisil oo ay ka helaan dadkii xerada uga soo horeeyay. “Caawintaas maahan wax nagu filan oo intii ka go’do reerkiisa ayuu qofka ku soo dhiibaya, laakiin inaan qatooyo ku joogno ayay noo dhanta inta aan dadka ka helno. Qoys dhan oo aan iyaga waxbo heli karin, barakacna ah, waa dareemi karta xaaladda ay ku sugan yihiin.” Cajabo ayaa sheegtay in sidoo kale raadinta shaqooyinka xogsiga ah uu ku hungoobay ilmaheeda aabbahood oo ay sheegtay in subax walbo uu magaalada u kallaho uuna habeenkii soo laabto isago faro maran. Waxay sheegtay in aysan wax khibrad hore ah u lahayn xaaladda barakaca, ayna carruurteeda la qabsan la’yihiin durufaha ka jira xerada oo aan lahayn dhammaan adeegyada aasaasiga ah. “Qofka haddii hoygiisa uu joogo oo ay wax la’aan ku dhacdo waxaa laga yaaba in uu iskaga qanacsanaado sidaas, laakiin magaalo ayaan nimid hadda meel aan wax bilawno ma naqaano. Illahey ayaan qeyr ka sugayna uun.” Cajaabo ayaa sheegtay in 5 bil ka hor ay ugu danbaysay in ay wax beertaan qoyskeeda, markaas oo ay biyo yari awgeed uga dhinteen dallagyo iskugu jira yaanyo, basbaas, ansalaato, kabsar- caleen, masago iyo Galey.  $380 oo ka gashay abuurkii iyo falidii ayay xustay in aysan waxbo uga soo laaban, taas oo quus ku beertay. Haweeynaydan ayaa tilmamtay in sidoo kale dhamaadkii bishii July ay ka idlaadeen masago iyo galay ay carruurta dabka u saaran jirtay, taasi oo ku riixday in ay barakac miciin bidaan. Waxay xustay in aysan hayn wax qorshe ah oo ay uga samata-bixi karaan xaaladda soo wajahday. Guddoomiyaha xerada Sooglow ayaa Raadiywo Ergo u sheegtay in dadka xerada soo gaaray oo 300 oo qoys ay xaaladoodu aad u liidato, ayna u badan yihiin carruur, haween iyo dad da’a ah. Haweeynaydan ayaa tilmamtay in sidoo kale dhamaadkii bishii July ay ka idlaadeen masago iyo galay ay carruurta dabka u saaran jirtay, taasi oo ku riixday in ay barakac miciin bidaan. Waxay xustay in aysan hayn wax qorshe ah oo ay uga samata-bixi karaan xaaladda soo wajahday. Guddoomiyaha xerada Sooglow ayaa Raadiywo Ergo u sheegtay in dadka xerada soo gaaray oo 300 oo qoys ay xaaladoodu aad u liidato, ayna u badan yihiin carruur, haween iyo dad da’a ah. items.title: Mareykanka oo siinaya abaal-marin dhan 15 milyan oo dollar ciddii keenta xog ku saabsan Cabdullaahi, Axmed iyo Cali
items.description: Mareykanka ayaa siinaya abaalmarin dhan 15 milyan oo dollar ciddii keenta xog ku saabsan saddex sarkaal oo sare oo ka tirsan ciidamada cirka iyo hawada sare ee Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran. Magacyada waxaa ka mid ah Sareeye Guuto Cabdullah Mehrabi, oo madax ka ah waaxda cilmi-baarista iyo isku-filnaanshaha ee ciidamada cirka iyo hawada sare ee Ilaalada Kacaanka. Qofka labaad waa Axmad Jafarabadi, oo lagu sheegay inuu yahay sarkaal sare oo mas’uul ka ah hawlgallada ciidamadaas. Si kastaba, bayaanka Mareykanka ma caddaynayo in magacaasi uu ula jeedo Sareeye Guuto Ali Jafarabadi, oo ah taliyaha hawada sare ee ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka, ama qof kale. Magaca saddexaad waa Cali Asghar Norouzi, oo ah ku-xigeenka taliyaha u qaabilsan diyaar-garowga iyo taageerada ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale Talaadadii cunaqabateyn saaray 10 qof iyo hay’ado uu sheegay inay xiriir la leeyihiin Wasaaradda Difaaca Iran. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa yimid xilli Mareykanku uu sii kordhinayo cunaqabateynta Iran, oo ay ku jiraan tallaabooyin lagu xaddidayo duulimaadyada caalamiga ah ee shirkadaha diyaaradaha Iran.

items.title: 15 Days Unconscious, 17 Years with Fistula: Shame, Fear, Isolation and a Journey Back to Hope.
items.description: When “Deeqa” opened her eyes, she had been unconscious for 15 days. She was only 14 years old. She had spent eight days in labour in a rural area without access to a skilled birth attendant. Eventually, her family took her to Baidoa in an old pickup truck. She survived, but her first two children, born when she was 14 and 15, died. When Deeqa regained consciousness, she discovered that she could no longer control her urine. She had developed obstetric fistula, a childbirth injury that can result from prolonged or obstructed labour. From that day, continuous urine leakage became part of her life. She lived with the condition for 17 years. She also lived with fear, shame, and isolation. At one point, after hearing that fistula could be treated through surgery, Deeqa travelled to Daynile in Mogadishu. But when she saw women who had undergone surgery, she became frightened and returned home without treatment. She feared she would die in the operating room. Eventually, she sought help at a fistula service in Baidoa, still afraid of the surgery. After receiving treatment, she learned something she had not known for most of her life: fistula could be treated. Today, Deeqa urges families not to marry off girls at 13 or 14, saying girls that young are not physically ready for pregnancy and childbirth. A condition that affects more than the body The exact number of women living with fistula in Somalia is unknown because the country has not conducted an accurate national survey. A 2020 Islamic Development Bank study estimated that between 3,300 and 4,000 women were living with fistula. In August 2025, MSF and Somalia’s Ministry of Health established a fistula treatment service at Bay Regional Hospital in Baidoa, providing women with treatment and surgery. But fistula is not only a physical injury. Sana Sadiq, MSF Mental Health Activity Manager for Somalia, says women living with fistula can experience persistent sadness, excessive worry, low self-esteem, loss of confidence, shame, and embarrassment. Continuous leakage, wetness, and fear of smell can make women reluctant to leave their homes or interact with others. Some withdraw from social activities and relationships, while others experience anger, helplessness, and frustration. The condition can also create a financial burden through costs such as diapers. Hodan: Finding a way to get treatment “Hodan,” a name changed to protect her privacy, was 20 when she reached the fistula unit in Baidoa. Her condition had begun six years earlier, when she was 14. During her first pregnancy, she experienced a difficult delivery at a local health facility. Her baby was born prematurely at seven months, and forceps were used during the delivery. Afterwards, Hodan lost control of her bladder. She kept the condition hidden from most people, with only her household knowing about it. Her marriage ended within days. Later, she remarried and had more children, but none survived. Her father sold livestock and farmland while searching for treatment. When surgery was recommended, fear and uncertainty prevented her from going ahead. He died before she received treatment. After his death, Hodan’s husband, who was working in another city, refused to pay for her journey. With no other option, Hodan borrowed money through an ayuuto, a community-based rotating savings group, and travelled to Baidoa. At Bay Regional Hospital, she underwent two successful procedures. Her story reflects some of the barriers many women face: long journeys from rural areas, transportation costs, limited specialised services and a shortage of facilities equipped to provide fistula care. Alongside medical treatment, MSF provides mental health support, including individual counselling, group sessions, psychoeducation, and psychosocial support. These services can help women cope with stigma, reduce feelings of isolation, and regain a sense of control. Treatment and prevention Fistula can be treated, but preventing it requires better maternal healthcare. Skilled midwives, accessible health facilities, functioning referral systems, and timely emergency caesarean sections are important in preventing injuries caused by prolonged or obstructed labour. Expanding affordable maternal care, fistula repair services, and psychosocial support is also essential. For women like Deeqa, recovery is about more than surgery. It can mean rebuilding confidence, reconnecting with family, and returning to everyday life without the shame and fear that once kept them isolated. Deeqa spent 17 years living with a condition she believed had no solution. Now, she knows there is one. And for her, treatment has brought something she had been missing for years: hope that life can begin again. Written by Fatima Ahmed The post 15 Days Unconscious, 17 Years with Fistula: Shame, Fear, Isolation and a Journey Back to Hope. first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Baidoa’s Endless War: Civilians Pay the Price as Political Crisis Deepens
items.description: Three Rounds of Fighting in Six Weeks Leave Hospitals Overwhelmed as MSF Warns of a Growing Humanitarian Crisis Baidoa (WDN) — The fighting in Baidoa is becoming a recurring war with no political settlement in sight, and civilians are paying the price. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) has issued a stark warning over the latest clashes in and around Baidoa, saying repeated violence is putting civilians, patients and medical workers at serious risk while preventing people from reaching hospitals for treatment. The latest fighting on September 28 was the third major round of clashes in just six weeks. According to MSF, a health facility was severely damaged, a health worker was killed and an ambulance was looted. Two medical workers associated with MSF were also robbed, with one sustaining injuries. The organisation has called on all parties to protect civilians, patients, medical personnel and health facilities and to ensure that the wounded can reach hospitals safely and without obstruction. 69 Casualties Reach Bay Hospital Medical teams working with Somalia’s Ministry of Health at Bay Regional Hospital have so far treated 69 people injured in the latest violence, including five children. MSF said three people had died. But the organisation warned that the number of casualties could rise sharply because roads leading to hospitals have remained blocked since the fighting began. Only a small number of wounded people have so far reached Bay Regional Hospital, raising fears that others remain trapped in areas where fighting took place. The consequences extend beyond those directly caught in the conflict. Road closures are also preventing patients with unrelated medical emergencies from reaching hospitals, potentially turning an armed confrontation into a wider public-health crisis. A Pattern of Repeated Bloodshed The latest casualties add to an increasingly grim pattern. During fighting on August 17, Bay Regional Hospital received 94 wounded people, including 29 women and 20 children. Four people died. Another round of fighting on September 3 sent 71 wounded people to the hospital, including 15 women and 12 children. One person died. Now, less than a month later, the violence has erupted again. Three major rounds of fighting in six weeks have transformed what might otherwise have been isolated security incidents into a continuing cycle of violence. For residents of Baidoa, the question is no longer simply when the next battle will occur, but how long the city can continue absorbing the human cost of a conflict that has yet to produce a political solution. A Political Crisis Becoming a Humanitarian Crisis The violence is unfolding against a much broader political confrontation between the Federal Government and forces aligned with former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. The dispute has increasingly moved from political disagreement to armed confrontation, with federal forces and opposition fighters repeatedly clashing around Baidoa. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government has maintained its position on the political and constitutional questions at the centre of the dispute, while efforts to reach a broader political settlement have so far failed to prevent repeated fighting. The consequence is becoming increasingly visible on the streets and inside hospitals. Political disputes that cannot be resolved through negotiation eventually create pressure for security solutions. In Baidoa, that dynamic has already produced repeated clashes, civilian casualties and severe restrictions on humanitarian access. MSF Warns of What Comes Next MSF’s warning is particularly significant because the organisation is working directly inside the healthcare system affected by the conflict. The organisation supports Bay Regional Hospital in cooperation with the Ministry of Health, providing emergency care as well as maternal and newborn services, paediatric care, nutrition support and outpatient treatment. That makes the hospital both a medical lifeline and a direct indicator of the consequences of the fighting. When roads are blocked, ambulances are looted and health workers are attacked, the damage goes far beyond the battlefield. The wounded cannot reach doctors. Pregnant women cannot reach maternity services. Children cannot reach treatment. And patients with no connection to the conflict become casualties of the conflict simply because they cannot reach a hospital. The Political Question Can No Longer Be Ignored Military control may temporarily change the balance on the ground, but it cannot by itself resolve the political dispute that continues to drive the confrontation. Baidoa has now experienced three major episodes of fighting in six weeks. The humanitarian consequences are accumulating, while the political disagreement remains unresolved. For President Hassan Sheikh’s government and its opponents, the latest warning from MSF should therefore carry a message beyond the immediate battlefield: every additional round of fighting comes with a growing civilian cost. The central question is no longer simply who controls Baidoa. It is whether Somalia’s political leaders can find a negotiated way out before another round of fighting sends more civilians to the same hospital—and leaves another generation of residents trapped between political ambitions and armed confrontation. Baidoa does not need another battle. It needs a political settlement capable of stopping the next one.
