items.title: Villa Somalia Gains Upper Hand in Beledweyne, But Hirshabelle Election Still in Doubt
items.description: Federal Government Moves to Secure September 30 Vote as Hiiraan Elders Resist Election Without Political Agreement Beledweyne (WDN) — Villa Somalia appears to have gained the upper hand in the political and security confrontation over Beledweyne, clearing the way for the Federal Government to push ahead with its planned Hirshabelle elections. But winning the immediate confrontation may prove easier than holding the election. The Federal Government has been determined to ensure that Beledweyne, the capital of Hiiraan, participates in the September 30 Hirshabelle local council and regional assembly elections. The electoral commission formally set September 30 as polling day after postponing the vote from August. The latest developments suggest that Mogadishu has strengthened its position in the city. A delegation led by Abdifatah Hassan Afrah, the Federal Government-backed candidate for Hirshabelle’s deputy presidency, was expected to travel to Beledweyne to help implement the government’s electoral plans. The deployment comes after weeks of opposition from Hiiraan politicians, traditional elders and community leaders who have demanded a political agreement before any election is held in the region. The Opposition Has Not Disappeared Despite the apparent shift in the balance of power, the political resistance in Hiiraan has not ended.Hawadle politicians and elders have repeatedly rejected an election conducted without prior agreement on political representation and power-sharing. The dispute escalated last week when hundreds of residents, politicians and elders demonstrated in Beledweyne against the planned electoral process.And on September 29, traditional elders and prominent Hawadle figures announced an even more consequential measure: Hirshabelle officials would be prevented from landing at airports in Hiiraan until a political agreement is reached. They specifically warned against the use of Beledweyne airport by military aircraft and said ballot boxes should not be brought into the region before an agreement is reached. That development makes the question of whether the election can actually proceed in Hiiraan far from settled. A Divided Political Landscape while The Clock Is Running The electoral commission has set September 30 as the polling date, leaving virtually no time for the competing sides to bridge their differences. The government may have succeeded in overcoming the immediate political and security challenge surrounding Beledweyne, but an election requires more than controlling the physical environment. It requires polling infrastructure, election officials, voters, political candidates and, critically, a minimum level of acceptance among the communities in which voting is supposed to take place. That is precisely what remains uncertain in Hiiraan. The confrontation has also exposed divisions within the Hawadle community itself. Earlier this month, the Hawadle Supreme Political Council met Hirshabelle President Ali Abdullahi Hussein Guudlaawe and expressed support for his leadership and the planned one-person, one-vote elections. At the same time, the traditional leadership and other political figures in Beledweyne have continued to demand that the process be suspended until a political settlement is reached. This means the Federal Government is not confronting a single, unified opposition. Instead, it faces competing political positions within Hiiraan itself, making the final outcome difficult to predict. AUSSOM’s Security Presence Adds Another Dimension Foreign troops are also part of the security environment surrounding Beledweyne.Ethiopian forces serving under the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia operate in AUSSOM Sector 4, which includes Beledweyne. The AU mission recently confirmed a rotation of Ethiopian troops in the sector. The presence of international forces adds to the government’s ability to maintain security around the city, but it does not resolve the underlying political disagreement over the election. Security can keep polling stations open. It cannot by itself create political consensus. The Real Test Comes on Election Day Villa Somalia may have won the latest round of the confrontation in Beledweyne. But the more difficult question is whether it can turn that apparent advantage into an election that is actually conducted across Hiiraan and accepted by the major political and community stakeholders. With the vote scheduled for September 30, the gap between the government’s timetable and the demands of Hiiraan’s traditional and political leaders has become increasingly difficult to ignore. The government can insist that the election will proceed. The electoral commission can maintain its calendar. Security forces can secure polling locations. But unless the political dispute is addressed, September 30 could become a test not simply of whether Somalia can hold an election, but whether it can hold one without deepening the political confrontation it was supposed to resolve. For now, Villa Somalia appears to have won the battle for control of the process in Beledweyne. Whether it has won the election remains an entirely different question. items.title: Hamza Turns on Deni as Somalia’s Political Crisis Deepens
items.description: Prime Minister Escalates War of Words with Puntland President as Constitutional and Electoral Disputes Remain Unresolved Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s political crisis has entered another tense phase after Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre launched a sharp response to Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni, accusing him of promoting the fragmentation of Somalia after Deni warned the United Nations that growing public pressure in Puntland was pushing the region toward a possible independence path. Hamza’s intervention comes at a politically difficult moment for his government, with no comprehensive agreement yet reached among Somalia’s principal political actors on the constitution, electoral model or the future structure of the election administration. Against that backdrop, the Prime Minister’s attack on Deni can also be viewed as an attempt to shift the political conversation toward national unity and away from the unresolved disputes that continue to paralyse the electoral and constitutional process. Deni Takes Puntland’s Grievances to the UN In a letter dated September 24 to UN Secretary-General António Guterres and the President of the UN Security Council, Jérôme Bonnafont, Deni said Puntland had spent years advocating for a stable federal system in Somalia but had become increasingly frustrated with the direction of the country’s state-building process. According to the letter, Puntland is facing growing pressure from sections of its population calling for a path toward full independence because of what the Puntland government describes as persistent political disagreements and a lack of meaningful cooperation from Mogadishu. Deni said Puntland had long supported federalism as a framework for rebuilding Somalia but suggested that the failure to establish a workable political settlement had intensified calls for a different political future. The letter represents a significant escalation because Puntland’s grievances have now been placed directly before the United Nations. Hamza Fires Back Hamza responded by rejecting any suggestion that Somalia could be divided, insisting that his government would defend the country’s unity, territorial integrity and sovereignty. He also directly rebuked Deni. “Said, it was not appropriate for you to call for the separation of the Somali people. That will remain part of your historical record,” Hamza said. The Prime Minister made the remarks while opening a national tourism exhibition in Mogadishu attended by hundreds of people. His response placed the question of Somali unity at the centre of the political debate—precisely the terrain on which the federal government has traditionally sought to mobilise public support when confronted by disputes with federal member states. But the bigger crisis is still unresolved The exchange between Hamza and Deni comes as Somalia’s political system remains deeply divided over the rules that will determine the country’s next political transition. The most important unresolved questions include the completion and interpretation of the constitutional process, the electoral model, the timetable and mechanisms for elections, and the composition and credibility of the institutions responsible for administering them. These are not secondary disagreements. They determine who can participate in elections, how votes are organised, how political power is transferred and what constitutional rules govern the relationship between Mogadishu and the federal member states. Without agreement on those fundamentals, declarations about national unity do little to resolve the practical political crisis. A Government Under Increasing Political Pressure For Hamza’s government, the confrontation with Deni comes at an increasingly difficult moment. The federal government needs political agreement with the country’s major political stakeholders and federal member states if it is to establish a broadly accepted electoral process. Yet the continuing dispute with Puntland demonstrates how far that consensus remains. The government’s confrontation with Puntland has already disrupted relations between Mogadishu and Garowe. The latest exchange risks widening the divide rather than narrowing it. This creates an obvious political dilemma for the Prime Minister. By confronting Deni publicly, Hamza can place himself on the side of Somali unity and territorial integrity, a position likely to resonate strongly with many Somalis. But the political gain from that argument does not answer the harder questions confronting his government: What constitutional settlement will govern the country? What electoral model will be used? Who will administer the election? And what political agreement will persuade Puntland and other dissatisfied actors to accept the process? Those questions remain unresolved. The Risk of Winning the Argument but Losing the Process The latest confrontation therefore risks becoming another episode in Somalia’s increasingly personalised political struggle. Deni has internationalised Puntland’s grievances by taking them to the United Nations. Hamza has responded by framing the dispute as a question of national unity. But Somalia’s immediate political problem is more complicated than either position. The country needs an agreement on the rules of political competition before the next election can command broad legitimacy. Without such an agreement, accusations of separatism, political attacks and appeals to national unity may dominate the headlines while the underlying institutional crisis remains untouched. Hamza may score an immediate political point by confronting Deni over Somali unity. But Somalia’s deeper crisis cannot be solved through political rhetoric. Until Mogadishu and its opponents reach agreement on the constitution, the electoral model and the institutions that will administer the election, the country’s political future will remain uncertain. items.title: Doorashada ku celiska ah ee Galmudug oo maanta ka dhacaysa deegaannada maamulkaas
items.description: Doorashada qof iyo codka ee dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug ee ku celiska ah ayaa maanta ka dhacaysa deegaanno kala duwan oo ka tirsan maamulkaas, iyadoo shacabka ay safaf dheer dheer ugu  jiraan inay codkooda ka dhiibtaan goobaha loo diyaariyey doorashada. Magaalada caasimadda ah ee Dhuusamareeb iyo magaalooyinka kale ee waaweyn, sida Guriceel, Cadaado iyo Gaalkacyo, ayaa kamid ah meelaha laga filayo inay ka dhacdo doorashadu, iyadoo sidoo kale la qorsheeyay in codbixintu gaarto deegaanno iyo tuulooyin kale oo ka tirsan Galmudug. Guddiga doorashooyinka ayaa doorashada u asteeyay inay dhacdo maanta oo taariikhdu tahay 30-ka Sebtembar, waxaana saaka deegaanno badan laga dareemayay diyaar-garowga doorashada. Wararka laga helayo Galmudug ayaa sheegaya in dadku ay saaka aroortii hore u dareereen goobaha codbixinta, halkaas oo lagu diyaarinayo sanduuqyada iyo agabka doorashada. Dadka ayaa la filayaa inay codkooda ka dhiibtaan goobaha loo asteeyay, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka iyo masuuliyiinta doorashadu ay goobaha qaarkood ku sugan yihiin. Doorasahadan ku celiska ah ee Galmudug ayaa la filayaa inay ka duwanaan doonto doorashadii hore ee ay natiijadii laashay maxkamadda sare ee dalku ka dib markii ay sheegtay inay dheceen qaladaad dhinaca maamulka ahi.

items.title: Ciidamada Mareykanka oo 23 sano kadib ka baxay Ciraaq
items.description: Baghdad (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa maanta oo Arbaco ah, 30-ka Sebtembar 2026, ka baxay saldhigyadii ugu dambeeyay ee ay ku lahaayeen gudaha dalka Ciraaq, taas oo soo afjartay joogitaan milatari oo dalkaas ka socday in ka badan 23 sano, kaddib markii ciidamada Mareykanku ay Ciraaq galeen sanadkii 2003. Ka bixitaanka ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa lagu fuliyay heshiis ay Washington iyo Baghdad gaareen sanadkii 2024, xilligii madaxweyne Joe Biden, iyadoo fulintiisa ay hadda dhammeystirtay dowladda Madaxweyne Donald Trump. Tallaabadan ayaa soo afjareysa wejigii ugu dambeeyay ee joogitaanka ciidamada Mareykanka ee saldhigyada ku yaalla gudaha Ciraaq. Duullaankii 2003-dii ee ciidamada uu hoggaaminayay Mareykanku ayaa waxa ay xukunka ka tuureen madaxweynihii Ciraaq, Saddam Hussein, iyadoo kadib ay xigeen sannado badan oo qalalaase, dagaallo iyo kacdoonno hubeysan ah, kuwaas oo markii dambe horseeday xaalad amni oo aad u adag iyo soo bixitaanka kooxo ay ku jiraan Al-Qaacida iyo Daacish. Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa horay uga baxay Ciraaq dhammaadkii 2011, balse saddex sano kaddib ayay dib ugu soo laabteen dalkaas, kaddib markii Daacish ay qabsatay dhul ballaaran oo ka tirsan waddamada Ciraaq iyo Suuriya. Soo laabashada ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa qeyb ka ahayd dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu dagaallamayay Daacish, iyadoo ciidamada Mareykanka ay door weyn ka qaateen duqeymaha, tababarka iyo taageerada ciidamada Ciraaq. Dagaalka dheer ee Ciraaq ayaa Mareykanka waxaa kasoo gaaray khasaare xooggan. Sida ay Reuters sheegtay, ku dhowaad 4,500 askari oo Mareykan ah ayaa lagu dilay muddadii ka badanayd labaatanka sano ee ay dagaalka iyo hawlgallada militari ka wadeen dalkaas. Maxaa ka dambeeya bixitaanka? Bixitaanka ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa imaanaya xilli ay weli jiraan walaacyo la xiriira awoodda ciidamada ammaanka Ciraaq iyo in ay kaligood ku wajihi karaan khataraha amni. Qaar ka mid ah saraakiisha iyo falanqeeyayaasha Ciraaq ay ka cabsi qabaan in bixitaanka Mareykanku uu abuuri karo firaaq amni, gaar ahaan haddii kooxaha hubeysan iyo Daacish ay ka faa’iideystaan xaaladda cusub. Inkasta oo ciidamada Ciraaq ay muddo dheer heleen tababar iyo taageero uu Mareykanku bixiyay, haddana qaar ka mid ah dadka arrimaha amniga ka faallooda ayaa su’aal geliyay awoodda ay dowladda Ciraaq u leedahay inay si buuxda ula wareegto dhammaan mas’uuliyadda amniga, gaar ahaan dhinacyada sirdoonka, kormeerka iyo awoodda hawada. Waxaa kale oo bixitaanka Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmeysaa xilli Iran ay saameyn xooggan ku leedahay gudaha Ciraaq, iyada oo xiriir dhow la leh kooxo Shiico ah oo hubeysan. items.title: Masar oo beenisay eedeymaha Itoobiya ee ku saabsan faragelinta gudaha dalka
items.description: Dowladda Masar ayaa waxba kama jiraan ku tilmaantay eedeymaha Itoobiya ee la xiriira faragelinta arrimaha gudaha dalkaas iyo taageerada kooxo hubeysan oo ka howlgala waqooyiga Itoobiya. Qaahira ayaa sheegtay in siyaasaddeeda arrimaha dibadda ay ku dhisan tahay ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dowladaha, iyadoo ku adkaysatay in eedeymaha ah in Masar ay taageerto kooxo hubeysan oo ka soo horjeeda dowladda Itoobiya ay yihiin kuwo aan sal lahayn. Jawaabta Masar ayaa timid kaddib markii dhinaca Itoobiya uu soo jeediyay eedeymo ku saabsan taageero shisheeye oo la siinayo kooxo hubeysan oo ka dagaallama waqooyiga dalka. Eedeymahan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ay mar kale ka soo cusboonaadeen waqooyiga Itoobiya. Masar iyo Itoobiya ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay lahaa xiriir ay hareeyeen khilaafaadyo dhowr ah, gaar ahaan muranka ku saabsan Biyo-xireenka Weyn ee Itoobiya ee GERD iyo arrimaha amniga ee gobolka Geeska Afrika. Qaahira ayaa ku celisay inay taageerto xalalka siyaasadeed iyo ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida dowladaha, iyadoo sheegtay in aan loo adeegsan karin siyaasaddeeda dibadda eedeymo ku saabsan faragelin ama taageeridda kooxo hubeysan. Xiisadda u dhexeysa labada dal ayaa weli ah arrin si dhow loola socdo, maadaama khilaaf kasta oo dhexmara Masar iyo Itoobiya uu saameyn ku yeelan karo xasilloonida iyo amniga gobolka Geeska Afrika.

items.title: Shacabka oo maanta ka codeynaya Magaalooyinka Galmudug iyo Hirshabelle
items.description: Shacabka ku dhaqan deegaanada Galmudug iyo Hirshabelle qaybtood ayaa Arbacadan u dareeraya goobaha codbixinta, si ay u soo doortaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka ee labada maamul iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Galmudug iyo Hirshabelle. Doorashada Galmudug oo mid ku celis ah ayaa ka dhaceysa 11 magaalo iyo deegaanada qaar ee hoostaga, kana kala tirsan Gobolada Galgaduud iyo Mudug, waxaana ku tartamaya musharaxiin kala metelaya 12 Urur Siyaasadeed. Sidoo kale doorashada Hirshabelle oo laga qabanayo 12 magaalo oo ka kala tirsan Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Shabellaha Dhexe ayaa waxaa ku tartamaya musharaxiinta 14 Urur Siyaasadeed. Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan oo ku sugan Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ayaa Ururada Siyaasadda ugu baaqay inay ilaaliyaan shuruucda doorashooyinka. “Waxaan rajeynaynaa in Galmudug iyo Hirshabelle ay ka dhici doonto doorasho qurxoon oo hufan, oo aan rabno inay si nabad ah noogu dhacdo, Ilaahay idiinkiisa.” Ayuu yiri Cabdikariin Axmed. Cabdikariin Axmed ayaa dadkii horey isugu diiwaangeliyay doorashada ee qaatay kaarka codbixinta ugu baaqay inay u soo baxaan doorashada, si xor ahna ay codkooda u dhiibtaan. “Waxaan leeyahay dhammaan dadka diiwaangashan oo haysta kaarka codbixinta inay si nadiif ah ugu soo baxaan goobaha doorashada oo codkooda ay si xor ah u dhiibtaan, ururkii ay rabaana u codeeyaan.” Ayuu yiri Cabdikariin Axmed. Doorashooyinka Galmudug iyo Hirshabelle ayaa laga kormeerayaa Magaalooyinka Dhuusamareeb iyo Jowhar, marka aad eegto in Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Kuxigeenkiisa Saadaq Abshir Garaad ay ku kala sugan yihiin magaalooyinkaasi. Urur Siyaasadeedka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu hoggaamiyo ayaa la filayaa in uu ku guuleysan doono kuraasta ugu badan ee doorashooyinka ka qabsoomaya maamuladaasi. Ururkan ayaa loo arkaa midka saamaynta ugu badan ku leh doorashooyinka maxaliga ah ee Galmudug iyo Hirshabelle, iyagoo adeegsanaya taageerada Madaxda Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Dowlad Goboleedyada. Dad badani ayaa waxay qabaan in loolanka doorashada ka socota deegaanadaas uu si weyn ugu xiran yahay go’aamada JSP.

Doorashada Galmudug oo mid ku celis ah ayaa ka dhaceysa 11 magaalo iyo deegaanada qaar ee hoostaga, kana kala tirsan Gobolada Galgaduud iyo Mudug, waxaana ku tartamaya musharaxiin kala metelaya 12 Urur Siyaasadeed. Sidoo kale doorashada Hirshabelle oo laga qabanayo 12 magaalo oo ka kala tirsan Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Shabellaha Dhexe ayaa waxaa ku tartamaya musharaxiinta 14 Urur Siyaasadeed. Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, Cabdikariin Axmed Xasan oo ku sugan Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ayaa Ururada Siyaasadda ugu baaqay inay ilaaliyaan shuruucda doorashooyinka. “Waxaan rajeynaynaa in Galmudug iyo Hirshabelle ay ka dhici doonto doorasho qurxoon oo hufan, oo aan rabno inay si nabad ah noogu dhacdo, Ilaahay idiinkiisa.” Ayuu yiri Cabdikariin Axmed. items.title: Reer Awdal waxay bud-dhig muhiim ah u ahaayeen dhismaha iyo dawladnimada Somaliland.
items.description: Reer Awdal waxay bud-dhig muhiim ah u ahaayeen dhismaha iyo dawladnimada Somaliland. Waxay door muuqda ku lahaayeen shirarkii dib u heshiisiinta iyo dhismaha hay’adihii qaranka, gaar ahaan Shirkii Boorama ee 1993 oo aas-aas u noqday nidaamka dawladnimo ee Somaliland. 00q Reer Awdal waxay sidoo kale dalka Madaxweyne ka soo noqdeen muddo siddeed sano ah, halka ay muddo dheer ku lahaayeen xilka Madaxweyne ku xigeenka. Intaas oo dhan waxa weheliya naf, maal iyo dadaal ay geliyeen nabadda, dib u heshiisiinta iyo dhismaha qaranka. items.title: Dadka reer Hiiraan oo bedelay fekerkii ahaa in dagaal lagaga hortago doorashada Hirshabelle
items.description: Xildhibaan Maalik Ibraahim Cabdalla oo ka mid ah Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka ee laga soo doorto Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sheegay in dadka deegaanka ay qaateen go’aan geesinimo leh, isla-markaana ay go’aansadeen inaanan wax amni darro ahi laga samayn gobolkaasi. Xildhibaan Maalik Cabdalla ayaa sheegay inay iyagu leeyihiin Ugaas, isagoo ula jeeda Ugaaska Beesha Xawaadle, Ugaas Yuusuf Ugaas Xasan Ugaas Khaliif, isla-markaana uu go’aansaday inuu u turo dadka deegaanka, ka dib markii uu arkay sida uu yiri dhibaatooyinkii shalay ka dhacay Baydhabo, isagoo intaasi ku daray in Ugaaska uu go’aansaday inaanan wax colaad ahi laga hurin Magaalada Beledweyne iyo guud ahaanba Gobolka Hiiraan. “Annaga Ugaas ayaan leenahay. Ugaskeenna markuu arkay dhibaatooyinkii shalay ka dhacay Baydhabo, Koonfur Galbeed oo illaa diyaaradaha F-16 la isku duqeeyay oo muwaadiniintii la xasuuqaayo, wuxuu go’aansaday inuu u turo shacabka ku nool Beledweyne iyo Hiiraan inaan wax hub ama colaad ah aan meeshaas laga dhalin, maadaama aysan jirin dowlad masuuliyad iska saareyso amniga iyo badqabka ummadda Soomaaliyeed ee masuulka ka ahayd.” Ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Maalik Cabdalla. Xildhibaan Maalik Cabdalla oo wareysi siiyay Universaltv ayaa yiri “Annaga ciidan nagu filan waan haysanaa oo waan isku kalsoonahay, laakiin markaad masuuliyad haysid ciidankaasi waxaa la imaanaayo masuuliyad, oo ah inaanan wiilasha Soomaaliyeed la isku leynin. Waxaan la soconayaa in hadda ka hor dowladdan uu waqtigeeda dhammaaday ay weerar ku qaadday Maamulka Jubbaland, oo aan aragnay oo marqaati ka noqonay in Ciidankii Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ee loogu talagalay inay la dagaalamaan cadowga ay xuduudda Kenya xagga uga tallaabeen. Annaga waxaa fool xumo nala noqotay in isla wiilashii shalay dagaalka aan ku wada jirnay inaan xuduudda Itoobiya aan ka tallaabino.” Xildhibaanka oo sii hadlayay ayaa yiri “Go’aankaas geesinimada leh ayaan qaadanay, Ugaaskeenna amarkiisa iyo taladiisa ayaan qaadanay, sidoo kale waxaa jira saaxiibo aan leenahay oo caalamka, ayaguna nagu la taliyay in aanan qayb ka noqonin wax fowda ah ama dagaal, taladaas ay na siiyeena waan uga mahadcelinay, waana qaadanay.” Xildhibaan Maalik Cabdalla ayaa meesha ka saaray in dadka reer Hiiraan ay u tanaasuleen musharaxnimada iyo dib-u-doorashada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe) iyo Cabdifitaax Xasan Afrax oo loo wado jegada Madaxweyne Kuxigeenka Hirshabelle. “Haddayba wax loo tanaasulo ay la imaan lahaayeen, annaguna waanba tanaasuli lahaynee doorashadii oo la leeyahay waxay dhaceysaa berritoole, oo aad hadda i leedahay hebelaa Madaxweyne Kuxigeen ah iyo hebelaa Madaxweyne ah, walaalow maxaa loo tanaasulaa bal adigu i fahamsii.” Ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Maalik Cabdalla. Waxa uu ka digay “Annaga waxyaabo badan ayaa miiska noo saaran, haddii ay saan ku sii socoto wiilasheenna dhan ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ku jiro inaan kala baxno ayaan ku khasbananaan doonnaa. Annagu dhihi mayno Dowladda Somaliya ayaan ka baxaynaa oo waddan gooniyaa noqonay, laakiin haddii na lagu sii khasbo wiilashaas oo dhan haddaan furimaha ka saarno amniga Muqdisho qalqal ayaa ku imaanaayo.” Digniintiisa ayaa ku soo beegmeysa, xilli Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud uu aad uga walaacsan yahay in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee deegaanka u dhashay ay soo faarujiyaan furimaha hore ee gobolka, taasoo khatar gelineysa amniga dalka, bacdamaa ay keeneyso in Al Shabaab ay si dhib yar dib ugu qabsan karto goobihii horey looga saaray. Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa waxaa ku sugan cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidamada Militariga iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka (Macawiisley) ee ka taageera la dagaalanka Al Shabaab. Si kastaba ha-ahaatee go’aankan uu Xildhibaanku sheegay inuu Ugaas Yuusuf Ugaas Xasan ugu turayo shacabka ayaa hoos u dhigaya cabsidii laga qabay inay Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa deegaanka ay maalinta doorashada ku dagaalamaan gobolkaasi.

items.title: Musharax Libaan Axmed Xasan oo baaq u diray bulshada Galmudug xilli berri loo dareerayo doorashada
items.description: Musharraxa Xisbiga Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ee hoggaamiyaha Galmudug, Libaan Axmed Xasan, ayaa bulshada reer Galmudug ka codsaday inay codkooda siiyaan, si uu hormuud uga noqdo dhismaha maamul ku dhisan caddaalad, wadajir, nabad iyo horumar. Libaan Axmed Xasan ayaa farriin uu u diray bulshada ku sheegay inuu doonayo in Galmudug ay noqoto maamul ku dhisan midnimo, nabad iyo horumar, isaga oo taageerada shacabka ku tilmaamay mid muhiim u ah xaqiijinta himiladiisa hoggaamineed. “Waxaan idinka codsanayaa codkiinna si aan hormuud ugu noqonno Galmudug ku dhisan caddaalad, wadajir, nabad iyo horumar,” ayuu yiri musharraxa JSP ee hoggaamiyaha Galmudug.

items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka iyo Ururrada Siyaasadda oo Jowhar kaga wada hadlay adkeynta habraacyada doorashada
items.description: Jowhar, 29 Sebteembar 2026 – Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka iyo Soohdimaha, Saadaq Abshir Garaad, iyo xubno ka tirsan Guddiga ayaa magaalada Jowhar kulan kula yeeshay madaxda iyo wakiillada ururrada siyaasadda ee ku sugan caasimadda Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray adkeynta u hoggaansanaanta shuruucda, habraacyada iyo anshaxa doorashada, iyadoo sidoo kale laga hadlay xoojinta wada-shaqeynta Guddiga iyo ururrada siyaasadda xilli lagu jiro u diyaar-garowga doorashada isku sidkan ee Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golayaasha Deegaanka. Guddiga ayaa ururrada siyaasadda kula dardaarmay ilaalinta nabadgelyada, kala dambeynta iyo hufnaanta geeddi-socodka doorashada, isagoo ku boorriyey musharraxiinta, wakiillada iyo taageerayaasha ururrada inay si buuxda ugu hoggaansamaan habraacyada iyo tilmaamaha doorashada. Sidoo kale, waxaa la adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in wakiillada ururrada siyaasadda ee goobaha codbixintu ay dhowraan nidaamka goobaha codbixinta, madax-bannaanida hawlwadeennada doorashada iyo habsami-u-socodka codbixinta, tirinta iyo diiwaangelinta natiijooyinka. Dhankooda, madaxda iyo wakiillada ururrada siyaasadda ayaa muujiyey sida ay uga go’an tahay wada-shaqeynta Guddiga iyo u hoggaansanaanta shuruucda iyo habraacyada doorashada. Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa ugu dambeyn dhammaan dhinacyada ugu baaqay inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii doorashada 30-ka Sebteembar 2026 ay ugu qabsoomi lahayd jawi nabdoon, xasilloon, hufan oo waafaqsan sharciga iyo habraacyada doorashada.

items.title: Xamza oo jawaab ka bixiyay warqaddii uu Deni u diray QM
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta jawaab kulul siiyay Madaxweyne Saciid Cabdullahi Deni, kaas oo dhowaan Qaramada Midoobay u diray warqad uu ku muujiyay doonista Puntland ee ka go’itaanka Soomaaliya. Madaxweynaha Puntland ayaa arrintan xasaasiga ah 24-kii bishan ku sheegay warqad uu u diray Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay António Guterres iyo Madaxweynaha Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, Jérôme Bonnafont, isagoo xusay in Puntland muddo dheer ku dadaalaysay in Soomaaliya lagu dhiso nidaam federaal ah oo nabdoon, balse ay aaminsan tahay in geeddi-socodkii dowlad-dhisidda uusan u hirgelin sidii la filayay. Puntland ayaa warqadda ku sheegtay in qaybo ka mid ah shacabkeeda ay ku cadaadinayaan inay qaadaan waddo madax-bannaani ah, iyadoo sidoo kale ka cabatay iskaashi la’aan ay kala kulantay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. “Puntland waxay wajahaysaa cadaadis kaga imanaya shacabka oo doonaya madax-bannaani buuxda ay kaga go’aan Federaalka,” ayuu qoraalkiisa ku yiri Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni. Intaas kadib, waxaa maanta soo jawaabay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre, oo shaaca ka qaaday in aan marna la aqbali doonin in la kala gooyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed, wuxuuna sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay ka go’an tahay ilaalinta midnimada, wadajirka iyo madax-bannaanida dalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale weerar afka ah ku qaaday Saciid Deni, isaga oo u sheegay in hadallada noocaas ah aysan ku habboonayn, loona baahan yahay in laga fogaado hadallada sii kala fogeynaya shacabka Soomaaliyeed. “Saciidow, kuuma habbooneyn in aad ku qeyliso kala goynta shacabka Soomaaliyeed, taasi waa mid ku xusnaan doonta sooyaalkaaga,” ayuu ku jawaabay Ra’iisul wasaaruhu. Hadalkan ayuu Xamza maanta ka sheegay furitaanka Bandhigga Dalxiiska Soomaaliya oo ay qabanayso Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska, kaas oo ay ka qeyb-galeen boqolaal kamid ah bulshada caasimada, iyadoo lagu soo bandhigay raasumaalka dalxiiska dalkeenna. Si kastaba, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Maamulka Puntland ayaa waxaa haatan ka dhexeeya khilaaf xooggan oo soo maray marxalado kala duwan, isla markaana saameeyay wada shaqeyta labada dhinac, maadaama ay kala furteen Muqdisho iyo Garoowe. The post Xamza oo jawaab ka bixiyay warqaddii uu Deni u diray QM appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Puntland Forces Free Honour 25 From Pirates in Successful Maritime Operation
items.description: PMPF Seizes Control of Hijacked Vessel After Months in Pirate Hands, Rescuing Crew and Cargo Bandarbeyla (WDN) — Puntland security forces have successfully freed the MT Honour 25, a commercial vessel that had reportedly been held by pirates off the coast of Bandarbayla in the Karkaar region since April, in a major maritime operation hailed as another significant blow against piracy along Somalia’s coastline. Puntland authorities said the operation was carried out by the Puntland Maritime Police Force (PMPF), which stormed the vessel and regained control after the pirates had held it for months. In a statement, Puntland said its maritime forces had captured the MT Honour and brought the pirate group under control. Two suspected pirates were reportedly wounded during the operation, while the remaining members of the group were apprehended. Puntland said the vessel’s crew were safe and that the cargo and property aboard the ship remained secure. The successful operation marks another important demonstration of Puntland’s maritime security capabilities at a time when piracy remains a persistent threat to commercial shipping in the waters off Somalia. Negotiations Preceded the Operation Reports indicated that some members of the pirate group had left the vessel a day earlier following discussions with Puntland authorities, before the security forces completed the operation to secure the ship. The development appears to have combined negotiation and security measures, ultimately allowing Puntland forces to regain control of the vessel without reported harm to its crew. The MT Honour 25, sailing under the flag of Palau, was reportedly claimed by Somali businessman Osman Shire Quud, who is from Puntland. He said the vessel had been transporting fuel destined for Mogadishu. Second Vessel Freed in Days The operation comes only days after Puntland forces also freed the SIBU 1, another vessel that had reportedly been held by pirates along the Puntland coast. items.title: Somalia Customs Revenue Falls 40% Amid Hormuz Disruptions
items.description: Hassan Sheikh Says Trade Disruptions Are Driving Up Import Costs and Cutting Government Revenue New York (WDN) — Somalia’s customs revenue has fallen by about 40% amid disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud told the UN General Assembly on Thursday. Hassan Sheikh said Somalia’s heavy reliance on imports from the Middle East has left the country particularly vulnerable to disruptions along the strategic waterway, which have also driven up the cost of food, fuel, transport and insurance. The president did not specify the period covered by the 40% customs-revenue estimate or provide the underlying revenue figures. Earlier government data presented to the Cabinet in May, however, showed that the volume of goods entering Somalia had fallen by nearly 40% during the Hormuz crisis. The two figures measure different indicators. Customs duties collected at Somalia’s ports and other entry points are an important source of domestic government revenue, helping finance public services and economic programmes. Lower import volumes can reduce customs receipts while higher shipping and insurance costs increase costs for consumers and businesses. Hassan Sheikh told the UN that Somalia is continuing efforts to strengthen domestic revenue collection, public financial management and budget transparency, while improving the investment environment. He said Somalia’s economy is expected to record real growth of 3.1% this year, despite continuing pressures from the global economy. The president also called for the free and predictable movement of trade through the Strait of Hormuz, saying stability along the waterway is particularly important for vulnerable economies such as Somalia. items.title: Shan la-hayste oo la dilay xilli ciidanka Puntland ay soo furteen markab la haystay
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Saddex muwaadin oo Pakistani ah iyo laba badmaax oo kale ayaa la sheegay in la dilay xilli ciidamada Puntland ay gacanta burcad-badeedda ka soo furayeen markabka shidaalka qaada ee Honour 25, oo muddo ka badan shan bilood lagu haystay xeebaha Soomaaliya. Ciidamada Puntland ayaa Talaadad maanta ah la wareegay markabka oo ku goosha calanka Palau, sida uu sheegay telefishinka dowladda Puntland, oo intaas ku daray in burcad-badeedda haysatay la qabtay lana horgeyn doono maxkamad. Wakaaladda Reuters ayaa sheegtay in mas’uuliyiinta Puntland aysan ka jawaabin codsiyo ay u dirtay si ay faahfaahin dheeraad ah uga bixiyaan howlgalka. Hase yeeshee, wargeyska Pakistan ka soo baxa ee The Express Tribune ayaa sheegay in shan ka mid ah shaqaalihii markabka la dilay intii uu socday howlgalka, oo ay ku jiraan saddex Pakistani ah. Warbixinta ayaa sheegtay in burcad-badeeddu rasaas ku fureen qaar ka mid ah shaqaalihii ay afduubka ku haysteen markii ay cadaadis kala kulmeen ciidamada Puntland oo ay bilaabeen inay markabka ka baxsadaan. Xogtaas ayaa laga soo xigtay badmaaxiin ka badbaaday dhacdada iyo hay’adda Ansar Burney Welfare Trust, oo muddo la socotay xaaladda shaqaalaha markabka. Sida ay badbaadayaashu sheegeen, iska horimaad ayaa dhex maray ciidamada iyo burcad-badeedda, ka hor inta aysan kooxdu rasaas ku furin shaqaalihii ay gacanta ku hayeen. Saddexda Pakistani ee la dilay ayaa lagu kala magacaabi jiray Kashif Umar, Mahmood Ansari iyo Rafiullah. Waxaa sidoo kale dhintay badmaax Hindi ah oo lagu magacaabo Tanveer iyo madaxa injineerrada markabka oo u dhashay Myanmar, sida uu sheegay Express Tribune. Afar qof oo kale ayaa ku dhaawacmay dhacdada, waxaana saddex ka mid ah lagu sheegay inay yihiin Pakistani. Reuters, oo soo xiganeysa telefishinka dowladda Puntland, waxay xaqiijisay in markabka la soo furtay iyo in burcad-badeedda la qabtay, balse warbixinteeda kama aysan hadlin dhimashada ama dhaawaca shaqaalaha. Hay’adda Ansar Burney Trust ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in burcad-badeeddu ay waxyeelleeyeen nidaamka lagu hago markabka kahor inta aysan ka cararin, taasoo sababtay in Honour 25 aanu iskiis u dhaqaaqi karin. Markabka ayaa hadda loo jiidayaa dhinaca xeebta, sida ay sheegtay hay’addu. Shan bilood oo afduub ah Honour 25 ayaa burcad-badeeddu qabsadeen 21-kii April, xilli uu marayay meel qiyaastii 30 nautical miles ka baxsan xeebaha Puntland, sida ay Reuters sheegtay. Markabka waxaa saarnaa 17 shaqaale ah, oo 10 ka mid ah ay ahaayeen muwaadiniin Pakistani ah. Hay’adda Midowga Yurub ee la dagaallanka burcad-badeedda, EUNAVFOR, ayaa bishii July xaqiijisay in markabka iyo shaqaalihiisuba weli ku jireen gacanta burcad-badeedda. Qoysaska badmaaxiinta Pakistani-ga ah ayaa bilihii la soo dhaafay dhowr jeer dibadbaxyo ka dhigay magaalada Karachi, iyagoo dowladda Pakistan ka dalbaday inay dadajiso sii deynta eheladooda. Dowladda Pakistan ayaa sidoo kale arrinta kala hadashay dowladda Soomaaliya iyo hay’adda caalamiga ah ee badaha ee IMO, iyadoo ku baaqday in la helo waddo lagu sii daayo shaqaalaha. Burcad-badeeddu ayaa markii hore dalbaday madax-furasho gaareysa saddex milyan oo dollar, sida ay sheegeen warar ay baahiyeen warbaahinta Pakistan. Dalabkaas ayaa markii dambe hoos loo dhigay. Howlgalka Honour 25 ayaa yimid wax ka yar toddobaad kadib markii ciidamada Puntland ay gacanta burcad-badeedda ka soo furteen markabka Sibu 1, oo la afduubtay bishii August. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada booliska badda Puntland ay howlgalkaas ku soo furteen Sibu 1, oo Mareykanku cunaqabateyn saaray. Soo laba-kacleynta burcad-badeedda xeebaha Soomaaliya sanadihii ugu dambeeyay ayaa mar kale walaac ka abuurtay maraakiibta isticmaasha Gacanka Cadmeed iyo galbeedka Badweynta Hindiya. Intii u dhaxeysay 2008 iyo 2014, burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya waxay carqaladeeyeen mid ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ganacsi ee ugu mashquulka badan dunida, iyagoo dhaqaalaha caalamka ku sababay khasaare balaayiin dollar ah isla markaana helay boqolaal milyan oo dollar oo madax-furasho ah. items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo kasoo laabtay Itoobiya, una safraya dal kale
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo maanta booqasho hal maalin ah ku tegay magaalada Addis Ababa ee caasimadda dalka Itoobiya ayaa isla galabta dib ugu soo laabtay dalka. Madaxweynaha oo ay wehliyaan mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Madaxtooyada Qaranka ayaa markii ay kasoo dageen garoonka diyaaradaha ee Aadan Cadde loo galbiyay xafiiskiisa, halkaas oo uu kasii watay howlihiisa shaqo iyo waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah. Xasan Sheekh ayaa inta uu ku sugnaa Addis Ababa kulan muhiim ah lasoo yeeshay Ra’iisul wasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed oo ay ka wada-hadleen arrimo xasaasi ah oo ay kamid yihiin xoojinta xiriirka soo jireenka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya iyo sidii loo horumarin lahaa iskaashiga labada dal. Sidoo kale waxaa kulanka lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay horumarinta iskaashiga dalalka gobolka, iyagoo is dhaafsaday aragtiyo ku saabsan arrimaha saameynta ku leh nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka Geeska Afrika. Dhanka kale, ilo-wareedyo xilkas ah ayaa innoo xaqiijiyay in Madaxweynuhu u baxayo safar kale oo la filayo inuu Jimcaha ku tago magaalada Qaahira ee caasimadda dalka Masar, halkaas oo uu kaga qaybgalayaa shir afar geesood ah uu la yeelanayo madaxda dalalka Masar, Suudaan iyo Eritrea. Lama oga ajendaha shirkaasi, balse wuxuu kusoo aadayaa xilli xasaasi ah oo gobolka uu wajahayo xaalado siyaasadeed iyo amni oo isbeddelaya, iyadoo ay socdaan dadaallo diblumaasiyadeed oo lagu wajahayo xaaladaha ka taagan gobolka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale cagta sii mari doona dalka Jabuuti, halkaas oo la filayo inuu kulan la qaato dhiggiisa dalkaas, Madaxweyne Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle, isagoo ka talagelinaya qorshihiisa, ka hor shirka afar geesoodka ah ee ka dhacaya magaalada Qaahira ee caasimada dalka Masar. Safarradan uu Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ku tegayo dalalka deriska iyo kuwa gobolka ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay dalka ka jiraan khilaafaad siyaasadeed iyo xiisado gudaha ah, iyadoo haatan xaalado cakiran ay ka taagan yihiin magaalooyinka Baydhaba iyo Beledweyne ee xarumaha Koonfur Galbeed iyo HirShabelle. items.title: Somalia: Laftagareen accuses Türkiye of six airstrikes on Baidoa
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen has accused Somalia’s federal government and Türkiye of carrying out airstrikes on Baidoa during fierce fighting between his forces and troops loyal to the government, alleging that six missiles struck areas where civilians were present. Laftagareen’s office said the alleged strikes killed civilians, including four children, and damaged civilian property. It also accused Turkish F-16 fighter jets of taking part in the bombardment. The allegations could not be independently verified, and neither the identity of the aircraft involved nor responsibility for individual strikes has been independently established. The accusations came a day after Laftagareen-aligned forces launched a major assault on Baidoa, the administrative capital of Somalia’s South West State, in the latest and most serious escalation of a months-long political and military confrontation over control of the region. Heavy fighting erupted early Monday and continued for hours across several parts of the city. Local residents reported explosions, sustained gunfire and difficulty reaching medical facilities as rival forces fought for control of strategic positions. Laftagareen says forces entered Baidoa In a statement issued on Tuesday, Laftagareen’s office described the offensive as a security operation intended to restore order in Baidoa and remove federal-aligned forces from the city. His forces, it said, fought troops it referred to as “Salbalaar” and “Afbalaar” – terms used by Laftagareen’s camp in describing forces it regards as having entered and taken control of parts of South West State. The statement claimed that Laftagareen-aligned Darawish forces inflicted heavy losses on opposing troops but did not provide casualty figures. The account could not be independently verified. Reports from the region indicate that fighters loyal to Laftagareen did enter parts of Baidoa during Monday’s fighting before government forces regained control of the city. The competing sides subsequently claimed success, making it difficult to independently establish the extent of territorial gains during the battle. Six missiles alleged to have hit civilian areas The most serious allegation in Laftagareen’s latest statement concerns the reported airstrikes. His office said six missiles were fired at Baidoa and accused Turkish F-16 aircraft of carrying out the strikes. It said civilians were among those killed and alleged that civilian property was destroyed. The statement did not provide independently verifiable evidence identifying the aircraft or establishing the chain of command behind the alleged attacks. Independent reports from Baidoa confirmed that aircraft and drones were seen during Monday’s fighting, but did not establish that Turkish F-16s carried out the strikes alleged by Laftagareen. AFP also reported that residents heard explosions but could not determine who was responsible for the bombing. Laftagareen’s office has made similar accusations against Türkiye following earlier fighting in Baidoa. After clashes on Sept. 3, his political camp accused Türkiye of conducting F-16 strikes against forces loyal to him. What happened in Baidoa Monday’s fighting began early in the morning, with explosions reported near military positions before clashes spread into the city. The South West administration and Laftagareen’s camp offered sharply different accounts of the assault. Laftagareen’s supporters said their forces had launched an operation to restore security and order and claimed significant gains inside Baidoa. The South West administration, led by President Adan Mohamed Nur Madobe, said government forces had repelled an attack and restored security. Its spokesperson accused Laftagareen-aligned fighters of working with Al-Shabab, while Laftagareen’s camp has rejected allegations that its forces are cooperating with the militant group. The competing accounts could not be independently reconciled. The fighting nevertheless had a clear civilian cost. Local media reported that medical teams at Bay Regional Hospital received 69 patients affected by the violence, including five children. Doctors Without Borders said three people had died, including a healthcare worker, and warned that blocked roads were preventing some wounded people from reaching medical care. Baidoa has become the centre of a wider political struggle The battle for Baidoa is rooted in a political dispute that has steadily evolved into an armed confrontation. Federal forces seized control of Baidoa in March after tensions between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government and Laftagareen’s administration escalated over political authority, elections and constitutional changes. Laftagareen subsequently left office, while Adan Madobe became president of South West State. Laftagareen and his supporters have rejected the political transition and continued to claim authority in South West State. Since then, Baidoa has experienced repeated clashes. The repeated violence has raised concerns that a political dispute between Mogadishu and South West State could increasingly divert Somali security forces from their fight against Al-Shabaab and expose civilians to further conflict. Türkiye’s expanding security role under scrutiny The allegations against Türkiye come as Ankara maintains a close defence relationship with Somalia. Türkiye has provided military training and security assistance to Somalia for years, including through the TURKSOM military training facility in Mogadishu. Somalia’s Defence Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi met a Turkish military delegation in Mogadishu in September and publicly thanked Türkiye for its support in rebuilding Somalia’s armed forces and strengthening the country’s security capabilities. Türkiye’s own foreign ministry describes its relationship with Somalia as encompassing security, development and humanitarian cooperation, with Ankara having maintained a significant diplomatic and development presence in the country since the early 2010s. That partnership has become increasingly sensitive as fighting between Somalia’s federal authorities and regional political forces has intensified. For Laftagareen’s camp, alleged Turkish military involvement represents foreign intervention in a domestic political dispute. For Mogadishu, Türkiye remains an important security partner as the federal government attempts to strengthen national institutions and combat armed groups. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com
items.fullContent: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen has accused Somalia’s federal government and Türkiye of carrying out airstrikes on Baidoa during fierce fighting between his forces and troops loyal to the government, alleging that six missiles struck areas where civilians were present. Laftagareen’s office said the alleged strikes killed civilians, including four children, and damaged civilian property. It also accused Turkish F-16 fighter jets of taking part in the bombardment. The allegations could not be independently verified, and neither the identity of the aircraft involved nor responsibility for individual strikes has been independently established. Reports from the region indicate that fighters loyal to Laftagareen did enter parts of Baidoa during Monday’s fighting before government forces regained control of the city. items.title: Sawirro: Xeebaha Puntland oo isku beddelay aag dagaal iyo u gaarsiga…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xeebaha Maamul-goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee Puntland ayaa isku beddelay aag dagaal oo ay ka socdaan howlgallo culus oo lagu u gaarsanayo kooxaha burcadbadeedda oo maalmihii u dambeeyay weerarro ka fuliyay maamulkaasi. Ciidamada ilaalada xeebaha Puntland ayaa haatan sii laba jibbaaray howlgallada ay ka wadaan halkaas, si looga hortago falalka burcadbadeedda oo mar kale kusoo rogaal celisay xeebaha Soomaaliya. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Puntland ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay in ciidamadu ay mar kale bilaabeen howlgallo lagu beegsanayo burcadbadeedda, si loo xaqiijiyo amniga xeebaha maamulkaasi, iyada oo shacabka lala wadaagay warbixin ku aadan xaaladaha soo kordhay. “Ciidamada Badda Puntland waxay bulshada Puntland iyo dhammaan dhinacyada ay khusayso ku wargelinayaan in ay bilaabeen hawlgallo lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo badbaadada xeebaha Puntland, gaar ahaan ka hortagga falalka burcad-badeedda iyo khataraha amni ee la xiriira. Hawlgalladani waxay qayb ka yihiin dadaallada lagu ilaalinayo xeebaha, hantida iyo badbaadada shacabka iyo dadka isticmaala badda,” ayaa lagu yiri warka qoraalka ah. Sidoo kale Ciidamada Badda Puntland ayaa digniin adag u diray kooxaha ku howlan ama damacsan falalka burcad-badeednimo, iyagoo shaaca ka qaaday in tallaabooyin sharci ah laga qaadi doono cid kasta oo ku lug yeelata falal khatar gelinaya amniga iyo nabadgelyada badda. Shacabka ayaa sidoo kale loogu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan wax kasta oo gacan siinaya ama fududeynaya falalkaas burcadbadeednimada ee kusoo kordhay xeebaha Puntland. “Wada shaqaynta shacabka iyo ciidamada ayaa muhiim u ah xaqiijinta amniga xeebaha. Bulshada ku dhaqan deegaannada xeebaha, kalluumaysatada, ganacsatada iyo dhammaan dadka isticmaala badda waxaa lagu boorrinayaa inay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan ciidamada, isla markaana ay si degdeg ah u soo gudbiyaan xog kasta oo la xiriirta dhaqdhaqaaqyo ama falal looga shakisan yahay burcad-badeednimo,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Waxaa kale oo ay xoojiyeen baaqooda ku aaddan wadaagista xogta iyo feejignaanta bulshada, maadaama xog sax ah oo waqtigeeda lagu helo ay si weyn uga qayb qaadan karto ka hortagga khataraha iyo ilaalinta badbaadada bulshada. “Qof kasta oo haya xog la xiriirta falal burcad-badeednimo waxaa lagu boorrinayaa inuu si masuuliyad leh ula wadaago hay’adaha amniga ee ay khusayso”, ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyay bayaanka. items.title: Daawo: K/Galbeed oo xabaal wadareedyo u sameyneyso maydadka ciidankii Lafta-gareen
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Koonfur Galbeed, Mudane Nuur Siidoow Baaba oo ay wehliyaan mas’uuliyiin kale ayaa maanta kormeeray goobihii ay shalay ka dhaceen dagaallada, kuwaas oo ay ka muuqdaan saameyn ka dhalatay iska hor imaadkii xoogganaa ee ka dhacay halkaasi, isagoo sheegay inay xabaal wadareedyo u sameysanayaa maydadka ciidankii taabacsan Lafta-gareen ee lagu dilay magaalada Baydhaba. Nuur Siidoow Baaba ayaa sheegay inay dul-tageen maydadka ku dhowaad 100 maleeshiyaad ah oo daadsan goobaha ay dagaallada ka dhaceen, wuxuuna xusay in Koonfur Galbeed ay aasi doonto sida ugu dhaqsiyaha badan. “Waxaa soo kor istaagnay maydadkii oo tiradooda ay ku dhowdahay illaa 100, weliba magaalada qaybahooda kala duwan ay daadsan yihiin oo hadda aan dul-istaagnay waxaa loo sameynayaa Xabaal wadareedyo hal meel ayaan lagu aasi doonaa,” ayuu yiri Wasiirku. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in xubnaha weerarka soo qaaday ay gaysteen dhibaatooyin xooggan oo ay ka mid yihiin burburinta magaalada iyo bililiqada hantida shacabka. “Magaalada shalay marka ay soo galeen waxaa ka dhacday sidii Khawaarijta lagu yaqaanay waxay gaysteen bililiqo oo xoolihii dadweynaha ayaa la dhacay, hoteelladii ayaa la galay waxaa kale oo ay beegsadeen masaajidii oo ay shacabka u diideen inay ku tukadaan,” ayuu raaciyay. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Dagaalkii Isniinta ayaa ahaa kii ugu dambeeyay ee taxane iska hor imaadyo ah oo magaalada Baydhaba ka dhacay bilihii la soo dhaafay, kuwaas oo salka ku haya khilaaf siyaasadeed oo markii dambe isu beddelay loollan militari oo lagu muransan yahay gacan-ku-haynta magaalada iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. 17-kii Agoosto, dagaal culus ayaa ka dhacay gudaha Baydhaba kaddib markii ciidamo taageersan Lafta-gareen ay soo galeen magaalada. Ciidamada dowladda ayaa markii dambe dib uga saaray xoogaggaas, halka Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ay sheegtay in ku dhowaad 30 ka mid ah weeraryahannada la dilay. Dagaal kale ayaa 3-dii Sebtembar ka dhacay duleedka Baydhaba. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa markaas sheegtay in ciidamo taageersan Lafta-gareen iyo dagaalyahanno Al-Shabaab ah ay weerarka ka qeyb qaateen, inkastoo sheegashada ku saabsan Al-Shabaab aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin. Soo noqnoqoshada dagaalladan ayaa walaac gaar ah ka abuurtay magaalada Baydhaba, oo ah xarunta KMG ah ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, isla markaana hoy u ah boqolaal kun oo qof oo ku barakacay colaadaha iyo abaaraha ka jira qeybo kale oo dalka ah. items.title: Somaliland’s opposition Kulmiye Party has strongly defended Israel’s recognition of the Republic of Somaliland
items.description: Somaliland’s opposition KULMIYE Party has strongly defended Israel’s recognition of the Republic of Somaliland, declaring that the decision is not open to negotiation and reaffirming the party’s support for Somaliland’s pursuit of international recognition. KULMIYE Secretary-General Faisal Abdirahman Madar, speaking at a press conference in Hargeisa, said his party supports the recognition granted by Israel and would welcome recognition from any other country. Israel formally recognised Somaliland as an independent and sovereign state on December 26, 2025, becoming the first UN member state to do so. The two sides signed a joint declaration establishing diplomatic relations. Madar said KULMIYE considers the question of Somaliland’s statehood to be a decision made by its people and argued that it cannot be reversed. “The KULMIYE Party once again makes clear that the recognition Somaliland received from Israel is not subject to negotiation, and we support it. The decision concerning Somaliland’s existence is irreversible, and no one can change it,” Madar said. He also called on the Federal Government of Somalia to recognise Somaliland, saying there was still an opportunity for Mogadishu to take such a step. “We call on the Government of Somalia to recognise the Republic of Somaliland while it still has the opportunity,” he said, while also urging neighbouring countries to support and recognise Somaliland. Madar’s comments underscore KULMIYE’s position that Israel’s recognition represents a development that should be maintained, while the party continues to call for wider international recognition of Somaliland.

Madar said KULMIYE considers the question of Somaliland’s statehood to be a decision made by its people and argued that it cannot be reversed. “The KULMIYE Party once again makes clear that the recognition Somaliland received from Israel is not subject to negotiation, and we support it. The decision concerning Somaliland’s existence is irreversible, and no one can change it,” Madar said. He also called on the Federal Government of Somalia to recognise Somaliland, saying there was still an opportunity for Mogadishu to take such a step. “We call on the Government of Somalia to recognise the Republic of Somaliland while it still has the opportunity,” he said, while also urging neighbouring countries to support and recognise Somaliland. Madar’s comments underscore KULMIYE’s position that Israel’s recognition represents a development that should be maintained, while the party continues to call for wider international recognition of Somaliland.

items.title: Xog: Villa Soomaaliya oo ku adkaatay loollankii Beledweyne iyo musharraxa JSP oo..
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Villa Soomaaliya ayaa ugu dambeyn ku adkaatay loollankii ka socday magaalada Beledweyne ee xarunta gobolka Hiiraan, halkaas oo maalmahan ay dhaq-dhaqaaqyo culus ka wadeen siyaasiyiin kasoo horjeeda qorshaha Villa Soomaaliya. Dowladda dhexe ayaa dooneysa in magaaladan ay ka qabato doorashada HirShabelle, xilli siyaasiyiinta iyo waxgaradka beesha Xawaadle ay tabasho ka qabaan sida wax loo wado. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, waxaa goordhow magaalada Muqdisho ka duulay wafdi uu hoggaaminayo musharraxa Villa Somalia ee mdaxweyne ku xigeenka HirShabelle, Cabdifitaax Xasan Afrax oo maanta la siiyay kaarka JSP, kaas oo ku wajahan magaalada Beledweyne, si uu u fuliyo qorshaha dowladda, maadaama berri la filayo in magaaladaas iyo guud ahaan HirShabelle lagu qabto doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee Golaha Wakiilkada iyo Deegaanka. Wararka ayaa intaas kusii daraya in ciidamada Jabuuti iyo kuwa Itoobiya ay si toos ah ula safteen dhanka Villa Somalia, kadib amarrro ay ka heleen madaxda waddamadooda, taas oo soo dadajineysa in durbo lagu kala baxo arrinta magaalada Beledweyne. Saraakiisha ciidamadan oo qayb ka ah howlgalka AUSSOM ayaa lasoo wariyay in sidoo kale ay go’aankooda la wadaageen dhinacyada ku sugan magaalada, gaar ahaan Ugaas Yuusuf Ugaas Xasan, Cabdullahi Maxamed Cali (Sanbaloolshe) iyo Madaxweyne ku xieenka HirShabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed), iyaga oo ku wargeliyay in Beledweyne ay berri ka dhaceyso doorashada HirShabelle, si la mid ah degmooyinka kale ee Shabeellaha Dhexe iyo Hiiraan. Arrimaha ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo haatan si weyn isha loogu wada hayo doorashooyinka HirShabelle iyo Galmudug oo isku mar dhacaya, waxaana si toos ah saameyn ugu leh Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, lama oga sida ay wax noqon doonaan, waxaase jira dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka socda Beledweyne oo ay wadaan dhinacyada kasoo horjeedo qabsoomida doorashada HirShabelle. items.title: 20–28ka Sibteenbar: Toddobaadkii Madoobaa ee Saxaafadda Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Marka dib loo eego dhacdooyinkii isdabajoogga ahaa ee dhacay intii u dhexaysay 20kii illaa 28kii Sibteenbar 2012kii, waxaa cad in xeeladda kooxda argaggixisada ah ee al-Shabaab (AS) ay dhaafsiisnayd dilka wariyayaashii xaqa tebintiisa ku dhiirraday ee baaddilkii argaggaxisada ganafka ku dhuftay. Ujeedda AS ayaa ahayd in ay wiiqaan oo ay aamusiiyaan dareenka iyo dhiirranaanta bulshada inteeda kale. Si aan u fahanno culayska iyo doogta maskaxeed ee kooxda argaggixisada ah ee AS ku reebtay saxaafadda, waa inaan si dhow u milicsannaa dhacdooyinkii isxigxigay ee bilowday 20kii Sibteenbar 2012kii. Maalintaas, laba naftood-halige ah oo walxaha qarxa isku soo xiray ayaa si qorshaysan isku qarxiyay maqaayadda Baar Village oo ku dhowayd guriga Hooyooyinka. Goobtani keliya ma ahayn maqaayad cunto, waxayse xilligaas wariyayaasha u ahayd barkulanka ugu weyn ee ay ku sheekaystaan, iskuguna xogwaraystaan waayaha dalka. Weerarkaas arxandarrada lahaa waxaa ku dhimatay ugu yaraan 15 qof, oo ay ku jireen saddex suxufi oo miisaan ku lahaa dalka. Kuwaas oo ay ka mid ahaayeen Cabdisataar Daahir Sabriye oo ka tirsanaa hawlwadeennada Telefishinka Qaranka, Liibaan Cali Nuur oo ka shaqaynayay Raadiyow Muqdisho, iyo Cabdiraxmaan Yaasiin oo ka tirsanaa warbaahinta qaranka. Gumaadka ka dhacay goobtaas wuxuu xanbaarsanaa farriin xeeladeed oo ah in gebi ahaanba albaabbada loo laabo barkulankii ay wariyayaashu isku xogwaraysan jireen, aragtiyahana ku wadaagi jireen, isla markaasna lagu dhowri jiray xorriyadda ra’yiga iyo fekerka madaxbannaan. Haddaba, xeeladda liidata ee cabsigelinta ee kooxda argaggixisadu kuma ekayn qarax meel qura ka dhacay, waxayse wajigeedu soo ifbaxay maalin kaddib. 21kii Sibteenbar 2012, wax ka yar 24 saac kaddib dilkii saddexdii suxufi ee Baar Village, waxaa magaalada Muqdisho lagu dilay Xasan Yuusuf Absuge, oo ahaa soosaare dhiirran oo ka tirsanaa Radio Maanta. Falalkan wada anfariirka leh ee muddada yar gudaheed ku dhacay, waxay muujiyeen xeelad loogu talagalay in lagu abuuro xaalad argaggax oo baqdin-u-joog ah. Marka uu suxufi kasta oo magaalada jooga ogaado in saaxiibbadiis lagu laayay qarax, isla markaasna kii subaxaas ka hadlay idaacaddana isla habeenkiiba la toogtay, waxaa su’aal gashay dareenkii dhiirranaanta iyo runsheegidda. Haddii ay suxufiyiintu markii hore taxaddar dheeraad ah yeelan jireen marka ay furimaha dagaalka joogaan, maalmahaas waxay ku baraarujiyeen in khatartu aysan ku ekayn goobaha colaadda. Waxay garwaaqsadeen in markan dagaalku u soo guuray xafiisyadii shaqada, goobihii shaaha lagu cabayay, iyo luuq kasta oo ay maraan, iyagoo si cad u fahmay inay yihiin bartilmaameed toos ah oo la ugaarsanayo. Waxyeelladii ka dhalatay weerarradan kuma ekayn keliya dhimashada weriyayaasha, sidoo kale waxay raad weyn ku reebtay guud ahaan madaxbannaanidii iyo tayadii wararka ee dalka. Warbixin rasmi ah oo uu soo saaray ururka National Union of Somali Journalists (NUSOJ) 23kii Sibteenbar 2012, oo xilligaas cinwaan looga dhigay “Impunity: War on Somalia’s Journalists” , ayaa lagu caddeeyey in beegsigan baaxadda leh uu suxufiyiinta geliyay xaalad adag oo cabsi ah. Cabsidani waxay ku khasabtay in wariyeyaal badani ay doortaan badbaadada naftooda, halkii ay runta tebin lahaayeen, iyadoo qaar kalena ay shaqada gebi ahaanba isaga baxeen. Dhinaca kale, hay’adda Committee to Protect Journalists (CPJ) ayaa warbixin ay soo saartay 1dii Oktoobar 2012 ku dhawaaqday in sannadkaas uu yahay kii ugu dhiigga badnaa ee soo maray saxaafadda Soomaaliya, taas oo raad caafimaaddarro ku reebtay xaaladda maskaxeed ee weriyayaasha. Marka ay kooxuhu awood u yeeshaan inay cabsi ku beeraan qofka wararka soo tebiya, waxaa meesha ka baxa kalsoonidii iyo dhiirranaantii lagu sheegi lahaa xaqiiqada jirta. Haddaba, weerarkii maqaayadda Baar Village haddii uu argaggax ku abuuray wariyeyaasha tebiya siyaasadda iyo warbixinnada amniga ee dalka, dhacdooyinkii xigay ee dhacay dhammaadkii bishii Sibteenbar ee isla sannadkaas 2012kii waxay muujiyeen in qorshaha argaggixisada AS uu yahay mid lagu tirtirayo qof kasta oo magaca suxufi sita ama cid kasta oo bulshada u hawlgasha, codna u noqota. Kooxdu waxay billowday inay ugaarsato xataa dhallinyarada ka shaqaynayay qaybaha madaddaallada, ciyaaraha, iyo tebinta wararka caalamiga ah, kuwaas oo isu haystay inay ka fog yihiin loollanka hubaysan iyo kan siyaasadeed ee dalka ka jira. 27kii Sibteenbar 2012, degmada Heliwaa ee magaalada Muqdisho waxaa lagu dilay Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cali. Cabdiraxmaan wuxuu ahaa qoraa iyo weriye firfircoon oo maalin kasta bulshada u tebin jiray wararka ciyaaraha ee shabakadda Ciyaaraha Maanta. Dilka weriyahan wuxuu meesha ka saaray aragtidii ahayd, ‘haddii aadan siyaasadda tebin, dhib kuuma imaanayo’. Danta ay argaggixisada AS ka lahayd dilka wariyahan ayaa ahayd murtidii Soomaaliyeed ee ahayd ‘Waysha gowrac, dibigu ha ku quustee’, oo macna ahaan noqon karta; haddii aanba dilnay wariyihii ciyaaraha tebinayay ee ka fogaa loollanka dalka, kuwii siyaasadda iyo amniga xaggee joogaan?! Maalin kaddib dilkii Cabdiraxmaan, oo ku beegnayd 28kii Sibteenbar 2012, waxaa gudaha caasimadda lagu dilay Axmed Cabdullaahi Faarax, oo ahaa weriye iyo sawirqaade u shaqaynayay wakaaladda wararka rasmiga ah ee dalka Yemen ee SABA. Dilalka isdabajoogga ahaa ee Cabdiraxmaan iyo Axmed waxay soo xireen siddeed maalmood oo gumaad ah, iyadoo muddadaas gudaheed magaalada Muqdisho lagu dilay lix suxufi. Arrintani waxay bishii Sibteenbar ee sannadkii 2012kii ka dhigtay bishii ugu dhiigga badnayd ee soo martay taariikhda saxaafadda Soomaaliya. Ururka caalamiga ah ee Reporters Without Borders (RSF) ayaa warbixin rasmi ah oo uu soo saaray 19kii Diseenbar 2012, cinwaan looga dhigay “War on Somalia’s Journalists” , bishaas Sibteenbarna u aqoonsaday bishii ugu dhiigga badnayd ee sooyaalka saxaafadda Soomaaliya. Maanta oo laga joogo 14 sano, diiwaanka caalamiga ah ee ay ururiyaan hay’adaha u ololeeya xuquuqda wariyayaasha ayaan lagu arkin bil ka danbaysay oo ay ku dhimatay tiro intaas la eg oo suxufiyiin ah, taas oo ka dhigan in toddobaadkan iyo bishan ay weli ku suntanyihiin masiibadii ugu xumayd ee soo marta warbaahinta dalka. Xeeladdan cadowgu adeegsanayay oo ah “codka shacabka aammusi”, ma noqon mid ku kooban Sibteenbar 2012kii oo keliya, waxayse dib u soo laabatay afar sano kaddib. 27kii Sibteenbar 2016, dabley hubaysan oo mooto watay ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ku dhex dilay Cabdicasiis Cali Xaaji, oo ahaa weriye caan ah oo ka tirsanaa idaacadda madaxbannaan ee Radio Shabelle. Toogashada Cabdicasiis waxay ahayd farriin kale oo muujinaysa in bisha Sibteenbar ay noqotay bil xusuus xun u ah saxaafadda, isaga oo noqday weriyihii 13aad ee idaacaddaas laga dilo tan iyo sannadkii 2007dii. Raadka dilalkan isxigxigay ee silsiladda ahaa wuxuu keenay in hay’adaha xuquuqda aadanaha iyo amniga saxaafadda ay qayladhaan ka soo saaraan xaaladda dalka. Warbixin gaar ah oo ay soo saartay hay’adda Amnesty International 24kii Sibteenbar 2012kii, oo cinwaan looga dhigay “Somalia: Human rights priorities for the new Somali government” , ayaa si dadban ugu bidhaamisay nuxurka murtida ah ‘Waysha gowrac, dibigu ha ku quustee’. Hay’adda ayaa warbixinteeda ku sheegtay in beegsiga suxufiyiinta ka shaqeeya arrimaha bulshada ee aan ku jirin loollanka siyaasadda, sida wariyayaasha ciyaaraha, loogu talagalay in lagu argaggaxiyo suxufiyiinta kale oo dhan, si qof kasta u dareemo inuusan badbaado lahayn meel kasta oo uu joogo. Sidoo kale, ururka Reporters Without Borders (RSF) ayaa warbixintoodii sannadlaha ahayd ee soo baxday 19kii Diseenbar 2012kii ku caddeeyay in Soomaaliya ay tahay dalka labaad ee caalamka ugu khatarta badan suxufiyiinta, iyadoo silsiladdan dhacdooyinka Sibteenbar loo soo qaatay marag cad oo muujinaya in cadowgu uusan wax kala sooc ah u samaynayn cid kasta oo bulshada cod u noqota, iyadoo makarafoon ama qalin adeegsanaysa. Gunaanadkii, toddobaadkii madoobaa ee bishii Sibteenbar 2012kii wuxuu cashar iyo cibra u noqday bahda saxaafadda, iyada oo ay ka dhasheen isbeddello waaweyn oo dhanka badqabka iyo sharciga ah. Markii ugu horraysay taariikhda dalka, ururka National Union of Somali Journalists (NUSOJ) oo kaashanaya xiriirka caalamiga ah ee International Federation of Journalists (IFJ) ayaa bishii Nofeenbar 2012kii magaalada Muqdisho ka bilaabay tababbarkii ugu horreeyey ee lagu barayo suxufiyiinta habraacyada badbaadada rasmiga ah ee naftooda. Waxaa la qoray buugag hagaya amniga wariyayaasha. Sidoo kale, ololayaashii dabagalka caddaaladda ee ka dhashay gumaadkii Sibteenbar 2012kii waxay dhaliyeen in dowladda Soomaaliya lagu khasbo isbeddel sharci; waxaana 8dii Sibteenbar 2020 si rasmi ah loo ansixiyey Xafiiska Xeer-ilaaliyaha Gaarka ah ee u xilsaaran baarista denbiyada loo gaysto suxufiyiinta. Inkasta oo weerarradaas ee kooxda argaggixisada ah ee AS ay reebeen masiibo iyo mahadho weyn, haddana suxufiyiinta Soomaaliyeed marna isma dhiibin, mana oggolaan in la aammusiyo codkooda. Waxay muujiyeen dadaal iyo dhiirranaan, iyagoo sii watay tebinta xaqiiqada, maantadan la joogona waxay weli si dhab ah cod iyo indho ugu yihiin bulshada Soomaaliyeed, qalinka iyo makarafoonkuna ay noqdeen kuwo ka adkaaday cabsida iyo qaraxyada.
