items.title: Baidoa Fighting Raises Questions Over Turkey’s Growing Role in Somalia
items.description: Allegations of Turkish Airstrikes Risk Turning a Strategic Partnership Into a Political Liability Baidoa (WDN) — Somalia’s latest fighting in Baidoa is raising uncomfortable questions about Turkey’s expanding security role in the country, after the camp of former Southwest State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen accused Ankara of using Turkish F-16 fighter jets against his forces. Laftagareen’s office said Monday that its forces had launched an operation in Baidoa aimed at restoring security and order. It accused federal and Southwest forces of resisting the offensive and alleged that Turkish aircraft carried out airstrikes that caused civilian casualties and property damage. The claims have not been independently verified. Turkish authorities have not been publicly established as having carried out the alleged strikes, while Somali federal authorities have given a different account of the fighting, saying their forces repelled an attack involving Al-Shabaab and Laftagareen-aligned fighters. What is clear is that Baidoa experienced heavy fighting on Monday, with fighter jets and drones reported during the clashes. Medical authorities and aid agencies reported civilian casualties and serious disruption to access to healthcare. Turkey’s Somalia Partnership Under Pressure The allegations carry particular weight because Turkey is not a distant military partner in Somalia. Ankara has developed one of the country’s deepest security relationships, including a 10-year defense and economic cooperation framework and a military presence focused on training and strengthening Somali security institutions. Turkey’s military deployment in Somalia was also extended through July 2028.That makes the accusations politically significant even before they are independently established. If Turkey were perceived by a substantial section of Somali society as directly intervening on one side of a dispute between the federal government and a Somali political faction, Ankara could face a difficult long-term credibility problem. Turkey has built its Somalia relationship over more than a decade through humanitarian assistance, infrastructure, diplomacy and security cooperation. Its official position has emphasized support for Somalia’s stability and state institutions. Turning that partnership into an instrument associated with one side of Somalia’s internal political struggle could therefore create consequences extending well beyond the battlefield. A Domestic Political Conflict with Foreign Security Power The Baidoa confrontation is fundamentally rooted in a Somali political dispute over control and legitimacy in Southwest State. Federal forces took control of Baidoa earlier this year after relations between Mogadishu and Laftagareen collapsed. Since then, repeated clashes have transformed the political dispute into an increasingly militarized confrontation. Monday’s fighting was the latest and among the most serious episodes. The involvement—or even perceived involvement—of a powerful foreign military partner introduces another layer to the conflict. For Ankara, the distinction between supporting Somalia’s national security institutions and becoming associated with one side of a domestic political confrontation is crucial. For Somalia, the issue is equally sensitive. Foreign military assistance is intended to strengthen national institutions, but if that assistance becomes identified with political factionalism, it risks deepening mistrust rather than strengthening state legitimacy. The Long-Term Cost Turkey has invested heavily in its relationship with Somalia, and the partnership extends beyond military cooperation into economic, humanitarian and diplomatic ties. Ankara’s own official account describes Somalia as a longstanding strategic partner. That relationship could face a very different political environment if Turkish forces or aircraft become widely perceived as participants in Somalia’s internal conflicts. The immediate question is therefore not only who won Monday’s battle, but whether Somalia’s international security partnerships are becoming entangled in its unresolved political disputes. The allegations surrounding Turkish F-16s require independent investigation rather than political assumption. But the controversy itself is significant. For Ankara, the strategic challenge is clear: maintaining a long-term partnership with Somalia may require ensuring that Turkish military power is not perceived as becoming an instrument in Somalia’s domestic political struggle. The allegations surrounding Turkish F-16s require independent investigation rather than political assumption. But the controversy itself is significant. For Ankara, the strategic challenge is clear: maintaining a long-term partnership with Somalia may require ensuring that Turkish military power is not perceived as becoming an instrument in Somalia’s domestic political struggle. items.title: Midowga Yurub oo Itoobiya Ugu Deeqay €18 Milyan oo Gargaar Bani’aadannimo ah
items.description: Midowga Yurub ayaa ku dhawaaqay deeq cusub oo dhan €18 milyan oo loogu talagalay wax ka qabashada xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Itoobiya, xilli colaadaha iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada militari ee ka jira waqooyiga dalka ay sii kordhinayaan baahida dadka rayidka ah, barakaca iyo caqabadaha hortaagan gaarsiinta gargaarka. Deeqdan cusub ayaa lagu taageerayaa dadka ay saameeyeen colaadaha iyo xaaladaha bani’aadannimo, waxaana dhaqaalaha loo adeegsan doonaa dhinacyada muhiimka ah sida cuntada, nafaqada, caafimaadka, biyaha iyo fayadhowrka, hoyga, ilaalinta dadka nugul iyo waxbarashada xaaladaha degdegga ah. Maalgelintan cusub waxay wadarta taageerada bani’aadannimo ee Midowga Yurub uu Itoobiya siiyey sannadka 2026 ka dhigeysaa €61 milyan . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, €18-ka milyan ee hadda lagu dhawaaqay waa maalgelin cusub, halka lacagta kale ay ka kooban tahay qoondooyin hore oo Midowga Yurub uu Itoobiya u qoondeeyey sannadkan. Guddiga Yurub ayaa sheegay in go’aanka lagu bixiyey taageeradan cusub uu la xiriira xaaladda sii xumaanaysa ee waqooyiga Itoobiya, halkaas oo dagaallada iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada militari ay saameyn ku yeesheen dadka rayidka ah iyo helitaanka adeegyada aasaasiga ah. Midowga Yurub ayaa sidoo kale xusay xaaladda ka jirta magaalooyinka Mekelle, Axum iyo Shire , iyo wararka ku saabsan duqaymo ay fuliyeen diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ciidamada Itoobiya. Xaaladda amni ayaa sidoo kale adkeynaysa howlaha hay’adaha samafalka, iyadoo burburka waddooyinka, hakadka isgaarsiinta iyo dagaallada ka socda goobaha muhiimka ah ay caqabad ku yihiin qiimeynta baahida dhabta ah iyo gaarsiinta gargaarka dadka ay xaaladdu saameysay. Midowga Yurub ayaa dhinacyada ay khuseyso ugu baaqay inay dejiyaan xiisadda, ilaaliyaan dadka rayidka ah, isla markaana hay’adaha bani’aadannimada u oggolaadaan inay si ammaan ah oo aan caqabad lahayn u gaaraan dadka u baahan gargaarka. Baaqan ayaa imanaya xilli baahida bani’aadannimo ay sii kordhayso, gaar ahaan meelaha ay colaadaha iyo barakacu saameeyeen. Sii xumaanshaha xaaladda Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeelan kara guud ahaan Geeska Afrika , oo ay Soomaaliya iyo Suudaan ka mid yihiin dalalka wajahaya baahiyo bani’aadannimo oo ballaaran. Maadaama dhaqaalaha gargaarka caalamiga ah uu xaddidan yahay, kororka baahida Itoobiya wuxuu saameyn ku yeelan karaa sida deeq-bixiyeyaashu u kala hormariyaan taageerada dalalka gobolka. Deeqdan €18-ka milyan ah ayaa qayb ka noqonaysa dadaallada Midowga Yurub ee wax looga qabanayo xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Itoobiya, iyadoo mudnaanta la siinayo badbaadinta dadka rayidka ah iyo in la sii wado adeegyada aasaasiga ah xilli colaadaha iyo barakacu ay sii kordhinayaan baahida gargaarka.

items.title: Sheikh Sharif’s Home Surrounded as Somalia’s Political Deadlock Deepens
items.description: Latest Security Move Against Opposition Leader Raises Fresh Questions Over Government Intimidation After Months of Failed Political Talks Mogadishu (WDN) — Somali security forces surrounded the Mogadishu residence of former President Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed on Monday night, blocking roads around the compound and restricting movement in an escalation that opposition figures are likely to view as another attempt at political intimidation. Security forces, reportedly backed by military vehicles, established positions around Sheikh Sharif’s home near Aden Adde International Airport after evening prayers. Witnesses said several roads leading to the compound were blocked and civilians were prevented from passing through. The government has not explained the operation, and the immediate reason for the deployment remains unclear. But the move comes against a deeply polarized political backdrop in which Sheikh Sharif has emerged as one of the leading opposition figures challenging President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud over constitutional changes and the country’s electoral model. A Familiar Pattern of Pressure The deployment is not occurring in isolation. Earlier confrontations involving government forces and opposition-linked figures have already raised accusations of intimidation. In June, Sheikh Sharif accused the government of intimidation after clashes between security forces and opposition-aligned militias in Mogadishu. The latest deployment therefore reinforces a believe among opposition leaders that security institutions are increasingly being used as a political pressure tool. That interpretation remains a political allegation rather than an independently established explanation for Monday night’s operation. No official statement has yet linked the security deployment to Sheikh Sharif’s political activities. Months of Talks, No Settlement The confrontation comes after months of negotiations between the federal government and opposition groups failed to resolve the country’s central political disputes. The two sides remain divided over the constitutional framework, presidential and parliamentary mandates, and the model for the next elections. Opposition figures say no electoral agreement has been reached, while the government maintains that it remains open to dialogue. Sheikh Sharif said on September 18 that the talks had failed to move forward, accusing those in power of lacking interest in a settlement. The opposition has subsequently called for broader political consultations and, if negotiations fail, a national conference to address the impasse. International Mediation Losing Momentum The prolonged deadlock has also tested the patience of Somalia’s international partners. The United States, Britain and other international actors have spent months encouraging the Somali parties to reach an agreement, with diplomatic efforts repeatedly failing to bridge the divide. Earlier international initiatives sought to bring together the federal government, opposition leaders and federal member states around an agreed electoral roadmap. The opposition has now appealed to the UN Security Council for international mediation and support for an agreed electoral model, arguing that previous attempts at dialogue have failed. The continued political impasse is therefore no longer simply a dispute between rival Somali politicians. It is increasingly becoming a test of whether Somalia’s political institutions can produce consensus without resorting to pressure, confrontation or the deployment of security forces around political opponents. From Political Dispute to Security Problem The latest operation around Sheikh Sharif’s residence illustrates the danger. When political negotiations repeatedly fail and security forces become visible around opposition leaders, the boundary between political disagreement and coercive politics becomes increasingly difficult to maintain. President Hassan Sheikh has told the international community that Somalia’s political future should be determined through dialogue, constitutional law and elections. The continuing confrontation with opposition leaders, however, demonstrates how far the political system remains from that objective. After months of negotiations, Somalia still lacks a political settlement acceptable to its principal competing camps. The latest security deployment around Sheikh Sharif’s home risks deepening that mistrust—and turning a political deadlock into an even more dangerous security crisis. items.title: Somaliland Pushes to Take Control of Its Airspace and Border Entry System
items.description: Hargeisa Seeks Greater Control Over Aviation and e-Visa as It Expands Its Drive to Operate as an Independent State Hargeisa (WDN) — Somaliland says it is pursuing efforts to take full control of its airspace and end Somalia’s electronic visa system for travelers arriving in Hargeisa, in another move reflecting its ambition to exercise the functions of an independent state. Somaliland’s Minister of the Presidency, Khadar Hussein Abdi, said the administration was pursuing the issues through diplomatic channels and other initiatives being handled discreetly. He said Aviation and Airports Minister Fuad Ahmed Nur was leading efforts over airspace management and what Somaliland considers obstacles to controlling flights serving the territory. “Minister Fuad is handling the aviation and airspace issues wisely and discreetly, and we hope he will achieve success soon,” Khadar told members of the Somaliland diaspora in the United States. The minister added, Fuad remains in the United States and is continuing diplomatic efforts on the issue. A Challenge to Somalia’s Federal Authority Control of airspace and immigration procedures are among the practical functions associated with state authority. Somaliland’s push to control both therefore goes beyond an administrative dispute and reflects its broader effort to operate independently of Mogadishu. The administration has also challenged Somalia’s e-Visa system, arguing that travellers heading to Somaliland should not be required to obtain entry authorization from Somalia. Khadar linked the campaign to Somaliland’s wider diplomatic strategy, saying some government initiatives are deliberately kept confidential until they produce results. He cited Israel’s recognition of Somaliland as an example, suggesting that the outcome reflected diplomatic efforts that had not previously been publicly disclosed. The minister did not provide details of the other diplomatic initiatives he said were underway. Airspace and Visa Dispute The dispute over airspace and entry procedures highlights the continuing institutional separation between Hargeisa and Mogadishu. While Somalia regards Somaliland as part of its territory, Somaliland maintains that it restored its independence from Somalia in 1991 and has pursued international recognition as a sovereign state. Its latest efforts to control aviation and immigration arrangements are therefore another attempt to exercise authority over functions normally administered by a national government. For Hargeisa, the objective is clear: to strengthen its ability to manage the territory’s airspace, borders and international access independently of Mogadishu. items.title: Dakhliga Kastamka Soomaaliya oo Hoos U Dhacay Ku Dhawaad 40% Sababo la Xiriira xirnaanta Marinka Hormuz
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in carqaladaha ka jira marinka istaraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz ay saameyn weyn ku yeesheen dhaqaalaha dalka, iyadoo dakhliga kastamka Soomaaliya uu hoos u dhacay ku dhawaad 40 boqolkiiba . Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo khudbad ka jeediyay kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegay in carqaladaha ku yimid isu-socodka badeecadaha iyo maraakiibta ay si toos ah u saameeyeen dakhliga dowladda iyo dhaqaalaha guud ee Soomaaliya. Hoos-u-dhaca dakhliga kastamka ayaa ku soo beegmay xilli Soomaaliya ay si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay badeecooyinka dibadda laga keeno, taas oo ka dhigaysa carqaladaha silsiladaha sahayda iyo kororka kharashaadka gaadiidka kuwo si toos ah u saameeya suuqa gudaha. Dhibaatada kuma eka dakhliga dowladda oo keliya, waxaana sidoo kale sare u kacay qiimaha cuntada, shidaalka iyo gaadiidka , halka kharashaadka la xiriira caymiska iyo dhoofinta badeecadaha ay kordheen. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa horey u sheegtay in qiimaha shidaalka Soomaaliya uu si weyn u kacay, taas oo iyaduna kor u qaaday qiimaha cuntada iyo biyaha iyo kharashaadka gaadiidka. Saameynta carqaladaha marinka Hormuz ayaa sidoo kale laga dareemay dhinaca soo dejinta. Warbixin ay Qaramada Midoobay soo bandhigtay ayaa sheegtay in mugga cuntada Soomaaliya loo soo dhoofiyo uu hoos u dhacay 40 boqolkiiba marka loo eego xilligii ka horreeyay bilowgii dhibaatada, taas oo saameyn ku yeelatay helitaanka iyo awoodda dadka ay ku iibsan karaan raashinka muhiimka ah. Soomaaliya waxay xilligan wajahaysaa duruufo dhaqaale iyo bani’aadannimo oo is-biirsaday, iyadoo kororka qiimaha badeecooyinka iyo shidaalka uu ku soo beegmay xilli dalka ay ka jiraan caqabado la xiriira cunto-yarida iyo awoodda qoysaska danyarta ah ee wax iibsiga. Qaramada Midoobay waxay horey uga digtay in malaayiin Soomaali ah ay wajahayaan heerar sare oo cunto-yari ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dowladda Soomaaliya ma aysan caddeyn muddada saxda ah ee hoos-u-dhaca ku dhow 40-ka boqolkiiba uu khuseeyo , mana aysan shaacin qiimaha lacageed ee dakhliga kastamka ee la sheegay inuu lumay. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha ayaa ku soo beegantay xilli walaaca laga qabo saameynta carqaladaha Hormuz uu sii xoogeysanayo, iyadoo hay’adaha caalamiga ah ay ka digayaan in khalkhalka ku yimaada marinkan muhiimka ah uu saameyn ku yeelan karo tamarta, ganacsiga, gaadiidka iyo qiimaha cuntada ee dalal badan, gaar ahaan kuwa dhaqaalahoodu nugul yahay.

items.title: Booliska Soomaaliya oo War ka soo saaray Hooyo iyo Dhallaan dayac kala kulmay mid kamid ah Isbitaallada Muqdishu
items.description: Taliska Booliiska Gobolka Banaadir ayaa faahfaahin ka bixiyay dhacdo ka dhacday Isbitaalka Muqdisho ee degmada Yaaqshiid, taas oo la xiriirta hooyo lagu magacaabo Zamzam Maxamuud Cilmi iyo wiil ay qalliin ku dhashay 20-kii Sebtembar 2026. Sida Booliisku sheegay, Zamzam ayaa isbitaalka tagtay 19-kii Sebtembar, halkaas oo qalliin loogu sameeyay, iyadoo maalintii xigtay dhashay wiil, waxaana qoyska hooyada oo lagu sheegay inay yihiin dad danyar ah  la sheegay inay awoodi waayeen bixinta kharashaadka caafimaadka iyo jiifka, arrintaas oo keentay muran u dhexeeyay qoyska iyo maamulka isbitaalka. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka Booliiska, maamulka isbitaalka ayaa dacwad ka gudbiyay aabbaha ilmaha, kaas oo loo xiray arrinta la xiriirta lacagaha lagu leeyahay isbitaalka. items.title: Soomaaliya oo xubin sare ku yeelatay Golaha Sare ee ururka caalamiga ah ee Tayada Daryeelka Caafimaadka
items.description: Soomaaliya ayaa guul muhiim ah ka gaartay shirweynaha caalamiga ah ee tayada daryeelka caafimaadka, kaddib markii masuul Soomaaliyeed loo doortay xubin buuxda oo ka tirsan Golaha Sare ee La-talinta ee Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Tayada Daryeelka Caafimaadka, ISQua. Maareeyaha Hay’adda Qaran ee Caymiska Caafimaadka Bulshada Soomaaliyeed, Dr. Cabdirisaaq Yuusuf Axmed Jalaaludiin, ayaa ka qaybgalay Meertada 42-aad ee Shirweynaha Caalamiga ah ee Tayada Daryeelka Caafimaadka ee ISQua, kaas oo lagu qabtay magaalada Dublin ee dalka Ireland. Intii uu socday shirweynaha, Dr. Jalaaludiin ayaa soo bandhigay laba dhigaal cilmiyeed oo diiradda lagu saaray tayada adeeg-bixinta caafimaadka, isagoo sidoo kale ka qaybqaatay doodaha iyo falanqaynta ay yeesheen khubarada caalamiga ah ee caafimaadka. Doodaha shirweynaha ayaa xoogga lagu saaray arrimo muhiim u ah horumarinta nidaamyada caafimaadka, gaar ahaan tayada daryeelka caafimaadka, badqabka bukaanka iyo doorka hoggaaminta ee lagu horumarinayo adeegyada caafimaadka. Guusha ugu weyn ee Soomaaliya ka soo hoyatay shirweynaha ayaa timid kaddib markii Dr. Cabdirisaaq Yuusuf Axmed Jalaaludiin loo doortay xubin buuxda oo ka tirsan Golaha Sare ee La-talinta ee ISQua. Dr. Jalaaludiin ayaa golahaasi ku matali doona gobolka Bariga Dhexe iyo Afrika muddo shan sano ah, taas oo Soomaaliya siinaysa fursad ay si toos ah uga qaybqaadato doodaha, talooyinka iyo qorshayaasha caalamiga ah ee la xiriira tayada iyo badqabka daryeelka caafimaadka. Doorashadan ayaa sidoo kale Soomaaliya u abuureysa fursad ay ku soo bandhigto waayo-aragnimadeeda, caqabadaha ka jira nidaamka caafimaadka iyo dadaallada socda ee lagu horumarinayo adeegyada caafimaadka iyo caymiska caafimaadka bulshada. Ka qaybgalka shirweynaha ISQua iyo doorashada Dr. Jalaaludiin ayaa sidaas darteed noqonaya tallaabo muhiim ah oo Soomaaliya ku xoojinayso matalaaddeeda fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah ee caafimaadka, iyadoo sidoo kale sare u qaadaysa doorka dalka ee doodaha ku saabsan tayada adeegyada caafimaadka iyo badqabka bukaannada. ISQua waa urur caalami ah oo diiradda saara horumarinta tayada iyo badqabka daryeelka caafimaadka, iyadoo isu keena khubaro iyo hay’ado caafimaad oo ka kala socda dalal badan oo caalamka ah.

items.title: Xukuumadda Somaliland Oo Miisaaniyada Qaranka Markii ugu Horaysay Ka Maalgelisay Tallaalka Xoolaha
items.description: Xukuumadda Somaliland ayaa markii ugu horreysay miisaaniyadda qaranka ka maalgelinaysa olole ballaadhan oo tallaal iyo nafaqayn xoolaha ah, kaas oo wajigiisa koowaad lagu tallaalayo 250,000 oo neef oo adhi ah, lagana fulinayo gobollada Togdheer iyo Daad-madheedh, iyadoo wajiga labaadna lagu qorsheynayo in adeeggu gaadho ku dhawaad hal milyan oo neef. Wasiir-ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Xannaanada Xoolaha iyo Horumarinta Reer Miyiga, Cali Axmed Cabdi (Cantar), ayaa Ololahan tallaalka xoolaha ka daah-furay magaalada Burco, ee xarunta gobolka Togdheer. Waxaana Wasiir ku xigeenka ku weheliyaan qaar ka mid ah agaasime-waaxeedyada Wasaaradda xannaanada xoolaha iyo maamulka Gobolka Togdheer. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in tallaalkani yahay kii ugu horreeyey ee ay si madax-bannaan u fuliso, iyada oo aanay cid kale ka helin taageero, waxaana wajigiisa koowaad lagu tallaalayaa 250,000 oo neef oo adhi ah oo ku nool Togdheer iyo Daad-madheedh. Wajiga labaad ee ololaha oo lagu qaban doono magaalada Hargeysa ayaa lagu qorsheynayaa in lagu gaadho ku dhawaad hal milyan oo neef, taas oo sare u qaadaysa baaxadda adeegyada caafimaadka xoolaha ee dalka. Agaasimaha Waaxda Caafimaadka Xoolaha iyo isku-duwayaasha gobollada Togdheer iyo Daad-madheedh ayaa sheegay in adeeggan uu ahaa mid xoolo-dhaqatadu baahi weyn u qabeen, iyaga oo xusay muhiimadda uu u leeyahay ka hortagga cudurrada iyo ilaalinta xoolaha. Masuuliyiinta ayaa xoolo-dhaqatada ugu baaqay inay si buuxda uga faa’iidaystaan tallaalka iyo adeegyada caafimaad ee la siinayo xoolahooda, si loo yareeyo khasaaraha ka dhasha cudurrada. Dhanka kale, Maamulaha Cashuuraha Berriga ee Gobolka Togdheer ayaa bulshada ugu baaqay inay ka faa’iidaystaan ololaha, isaga oo sheegay in tallaalka iyo daaweynta xoolaha lagu maalgeliyey cashuurtii ay bulshada bixisay. Ololahan ayaa lagu xoojinayaa caafimaadka iyo wax-soo-saarka xoolaha, kuwaas oo laf-dhabar u ah nolosha xoolo-dhaqatada iyo dhaqaalaha qoysas badan. Khadar M. Xaashi

items.title: Tensions in northern Ethiopia raise concern; EU allocates 61 million in humanitarian aid
items.description: Brussels – In Ethiopia, “as tensions rise again in the north, civilians cannot be made to pay that price once more,” the European Commissioner for Equality, Crisis Preparedness and Management, Hadja Lahbib, warned as fears grow of a further escalation of the conflict in northern Ethiopia. The EU has announced €61 million in humanitarian aid to support the most vulnerable people affected by conflicts, displacement, epidemics and climate-related crises. With the money, “Europe is standing with those most in need, but aid must be able to reach them,” said Lahbib, calling for “an immediate de-escalation of violence in northern Ethiopia” and stressing “urgent de-escalation of violence in Northern Ethiopia.” The decision comes as the European Union is “deeply concerned” over the rapid deterioration of the situation in the north of the country. According to Brussels, military activity has been reported in various locations, and the Tigray People’s Liberation Front’s forces have reportedly seized the airports at Mekelle, Axum and Shire in the Tigray region. The EU has also been following with concern the various drone strikes carried out in recent weeks by the Ethiopian National Defence Forces. Brussels calls for immediate de-escalation, the protection of civilians and unhindered humanitarian access, reiterating that respect for international humanitarian law is “imperative and non-negotiable”. The EU also condemns attacks on humanitarian convoys and any form of denial of access to aid. The funds will finance food and nutritional assistance, healthcare, water and sanitation, protection, shelter and essential goods, as well as education in emergencies. Particular attention will be paid to displaced people, refugees and the communities hosting them. Of the total of 61 million, 18 million form part of the new package announced by Commission President Ursula von der Leyen in New York, bringing the EU’s humanitarian aid to Ethiopia in 2026 to 61 million. The allocation remains subject to approval by the budgetary authority. Source EU news

items.title: Maxay tahay digniinta kasoo baxday hay’adda duulista rayidka Soomaaliyeed?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Roobab kala duwan ayaa laga saadaaliyay qaybo kamid ah Soomaaliya maalmaha soo socda, iyadoo Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed (SCAA) ay soo saartay digniin la xiriirta xaaladaha cimilada iyo saameynta ay ku yeelan karaan duulimaadyada. SCAA waxay sheegtay in saadaasha maalmaha soo socda ay muujinayso roobab xooggan oo ka da’aya meelo kala duwan oo dalka ah, gaar ahaan dhulka galbeedka, gobollada dhexe iyo qaybo kamid ah bariga Soomaaliya. Gobollada Sool, Nugaal, Mudug, Shabeellaha iyo Gedo ayaa kamid ah meelaha saadaashu tilmaamayso in roobab dhex-dhexaad ah ay ka da’i karaan, iyadoo xoogga roobabku uu ku kala duwanaan karo deegaannada. Xaaladdan cimilada awgeed, hay’addu waxay dhinacyada ku shaqada leh duulista ugu baaqday inay muujiyaan feejignaan dheeraad ah. items.title: MSF oo qaylo dhaan ka soo saartay dagaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Hay’adda Dhakhaatiirta Aan Xuduudda Lahayn (MSF) ayaa walaac ka muujisay iska horimaadyada ku soo badanaya Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. Wakiilka Hay’adda MSF ee Somaliya, Dr. Elshafie Mohammed ayaa sheegay in hay’addu ay si weyn uga walaacsan tahay saamaynta rabshadaha sii kordhaya ee ka jira Magaalada Baydhabo ay ku yeelanayaan dadka rayidka ah iyo helitaanka adeegyada caafimaadka ee lagama maarmaanka ah. “MSF waxay si degdeg ah ugu baaqeysaa dhammaan dhinacyada ku lugta leh colaadda inay ilaaliyaan dadka rayidka ah, bukaanada, shaqaalaha caafimaadka iyo xarumaha caafimaadka, ayna xaqiijiyaan in dadka u baahan daryeelka caafimaad ay si ammaan ah oo aan caqabad lahayn u gaari karaan isbitaalada.” Ayuu yiri Wakiilka MSF ee Somaliya. Hay’adda ayaa warsaxaafadeed ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in dagaalkii xooganaa ee maanta ka dhacay magaalada uu noqonayo kiisii saddexaad ee ka dhaca Baydhabo iyo nawaaxigeeda, tan iyo 17-kii bishii hore ee August. “Waxaa la soo sheegay in xarun caafimaad uu burbur xoogan soo gaaray, isla-markaana la dilay shaqaale caafimaad. Gaari gurmadka degdegga ah (ambulance) ayaa la dhacay, iyadoo sidoo kale la soo sheegay in la weeraray guryo ay dad rayid ah deganaayeen. Laba shaqaale caafimaad oo la shaqeynayay kooxaha MSF ayaa la dhacay hantidooda, mid ka mid ahna waa la dhaawacay.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Dr. Elshafie Mohammed, Wakiilka Hay’adda MSF U Qaabilsan Somaliya ayaa warsaxaafadeedka ku sheegay “Kani waa markii saddexaad muddo lix toddobaad ah oo dagaal uu ka qarxo Magaalada Baydhabo, taas oo keentay in dagaalku uu cawaaqib xun ku yeesho dadka rayidka ah. Waa wax aan la aqbali karin in dadka rayidka ah iyo daryeelka caafimaadka lagu hayo rabshado. Dadka dhaawaca ah waxay u baahan yihiin daryeel caafimaad oo degdeg ah, laakiin qaar badan ma gaari karaan isbitaalka. Haddii aan la helin dawayn waqtigeeda ku habboon, kuwo badan ayaa dhiigbax u dhiman kara.” Dr. Elshafie Mohammed ayaa mar kale dhinacyada dagaalka ku lugta leh ugu baaqay “Waxaan ugu baaqaynaa dhammaan dhinacyada inay ilaaliyaan dadka rayidka ah, kaabeyaasha dadweynaha iyo inay hubiyaan in bukaanadu ay si ammaan ah u gaari karaan xarumaha caafimaadka, iyagoon cabsi, dib-u-dhac ama caqabad lahayn.” Kooxaha la shaqeeya Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee Isbitaal Goboleedka Baay ama Isbitaalka Weyn ee Baydhabo ayaa Isniintan qaabilay dhaawacyada 69 qof, kuwaas oo sidoo kale diiwaangeliyay dhimashada saddex qof oo rayid ah, sida ay sheegtay MSF. MSF ayaa sheegtay in waddooyinka Baydhabo ay ku xirmeen dagaalka, taasoo ay sheegtay inay si weyn u xaddiday helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka. MSF ayaa intaasi ku dartay in tiro yar oo ka mid ah dadkii dhaawacmay ay u suurtagashay inay gaaraan Isbitaalka Guud ee Baydhabo.

items.title: Maxkamadda Kenya oo amartay in baasaboorka loo celiyo xildhibaan C/raxmaan Shariif
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamadda Sare ee Kenya ayaa dowladda dalkaas ku amartay inay muddo 24 saac gudahood ah dib ugu soo celiso baasaboorkiisa Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Bashiir Shariif. Xildhibaanka ayaa Soomaaliya ku metela Baarlamaanka Bariga Afrika (EALA). Cabdiraxmaan ayaa 14-kii August lagu qabtay garoonka diyaaradaha Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, xilligaas oo saraakiisha socdaalka ay diideen inuu gudaha u galo Nairobi kadib markii ay su’aalo ka keeneen jinsiyadaha Soomaaliya iyo Kenya ee uu haysto. Cabdiraxmaan ayaa markii dambe loo masaafuriyay Muqdisho, iyadoo laga qaaday baasaboorkiisa. Xildhibaanka ayaa arrintaas u gudbiyay Maxkamadda Sare ee Kenya, isagoo ka horyimid tallaabadii lagu qaaday iyo su’aalaha laga keenay dhalashadiisa Kenya. Dacwadda uu xildhibaanku gudbiyay wuxuu ku sheegay inuu yahay muwaadin Kenyan ah, isla markaana uu dhalashada dalkaas ku helay waalidkiis oo labaduba kasoo jeeda Gaarisa, uuna halkaas ku dhashay. Wuxuu sidoo kale maxkamadda u sheegay inuu sharci ahaan xaq u leeyahay inuu haysto jinsiyad kale, isagoo tixraacay qodobka 16-aad ee dastuurka Kenya oo ogolaanaya. Dhinaca kale, waxaa la sheegay in xogta shakhsiga ah ee ku qoran labada baasaboor ay is waafaqayaan, oo ay kamid yihiin magaca, taariikhda dhalashada iyo goobta uu ku dhashay. Cabdiraxmaan ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu si waafaqsan sharciga Kenya hore ugu gudbiyay dowladda dalkaas xogta ku saabsan qaadashada jinsiyad labaad. Qodobkaas ayaa si weyn u xoojiyay dooddiisa maxkamadda Kenya, iyadoo arrintaas ay ugu dambeyn keentay inuu ku guuleysto dacwaddiisa, ayna amar kasoo saarto Maxkamadda Sare ee Kenya. Xildhibaanka ayaa hore u soo noqday Safiir ku-xigeenka Soomaaliya ee Mareykanka, sidoo kalena wuxuu xil sare uga soo qabtay xarunta Bangiga Adduunka ee Washington, isagoo metelaya Soomaaliya. Kiiska Cabdiraxmaan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli siyaasiyiin iyo mas’uuliyiin Soomaali ah oo haysta dhalashada Kenya ay hore dhibaatooyin kala kulmeen gelitaanka dalkaas. Xildhibaanka ayaa sidaasna ku noqonaya mas’uulkii ugu horreeyay ee Soomaali ah ee dacwad maxkamadeed ku difaacda dhalashadiisa Kenya. Si kastaba, muddooyinkii dambe waxaa soo badanayay mas’uuliyiinta Soomaaliyeed ee laga hor istaago gelitaanka dalka Kenya, kuwaas oo dib loogu celiyay Soomaaliya kadib markii la isku khilaafay xaaladdooda dhalasho. Waxaa kamid ahaa Ra’iisul Wasaare ku-xigeenka dalka Jibriil Cabdirashiid oo isagu dib u celiyay baasaboorkiisa Kenya, kadib markii laga hor istaagay inuu galo dalkaas. items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo sheegtay in dagaalkii Baydhabo lagu dilay in ka badan 70 xubnood oo Al-Shabaab ah
items.description: Baydhabo – Madaxtooyada Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa war-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in dagaalkii maanta ka dhacay magaalada Baydhabo lagu dilay in ka badan 70 xubnood oo ka tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan dagaalyahanno ajaaniib ah. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa lagu sheegay in dagaalka uu ka dhacay magaalada Baydhabo, kaddib markii ciidanka ammaanka ay ka hortageen weerar ay kooxda Al-Shabaab ku soo qaaday magaalada, kaas oo loo adeegsaday gaadiid laga soo buuxiyey walxaha qarxa iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn (drones). Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in dagaalka lagu furtay hub iyo gaadiid dagaal, halka gaadiid kale oo ay kooxda adeegsanaysay la gubay. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka, weerarka ayaa lagu beegsaday goobo ganacsi, xarumo waxbarasho, xarumo caafimaad, masaajiddo iyo dhismayaal kale oo ku yaalla magaalada Baydhabo. Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadeedu si degdeg ah uga jawaabeen weerarka, isla markaana ay ku guuleysteen inay iska caabiyaan kooxda, iyagoo sheegay in xaaladda amniga magaalada ay gacanta ku hayaan. Dhanka kale, war-saxaafadeedka laguma sheegin khasaaraha dhimasho iyo dhaawac ee soo gaaray ciidamada Koonfur Galbeed iyo dadka rayidka ah ee ku nool magaalada Baydhabo. Dagaalka maanta ka dhacay Baydhabo ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay magaalada ka taagan tahay xiisad amni, iyadoo la adeegsanayo hub culus iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn.

items.title: Soomaaliya Iyo UN‑Habitat Oo Qorsheynaya Siyaasad Qaran Oo Guryaha Ah
items.description: NAIROBI (Goobjoog News) — Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Deegaamaynta Aadanaha ee UN‑Habitat ayaa bilaabay wada-hadallo lagu hormarinayo siyaasad qaran oo isku xirta guryaha la awoodi karo, horumarinta magaalooyinka iyo xalalka waara ee dadka barakacayaasha ah. Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Kenya, Jabriil Ibraahim Cabdulle, ayaa magaalada Nairobi kulan kula yeeshay masuuliyiinta xafiiska UN‑Habitat ee Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray kaabayaasha magaalooyinka, hab-nololeedka bulshada, maamulka deegaanka iyo sidii arrimaha guryaha loogu dari lahaa Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka. Dhinacyadu waxay sidoo kale ka wada hadleen diyaarinta kulan loogu magac daray “Somali Housing Breakfast,” kaas oo la filayo inuu isu keeno dowladda, bangiyada, ganacsatada, hay’adaha horumarinta iyo qaybaha kale ee ay arrintu khusayso. Ujeeddadu waa in la abuuro iskaashi lagu dejin karo siyaasad mideysan oo hagta maalgelinta iyo horumarinta guryaha Soomaaliya. Qorshaha ayaa lagu xiriirinayaa hindisaha Africa Affordable Housing Compact, iyadoo UN‑Habitat ay taageero ka geysanayso isku-dubbaridka hay’adaha kala duwan. Siyaasadda la qorsheynayo waxaa la filayaa inay wax ka qabato baahida qoysaska dakhligoodu hooseeyo iyo dadka barakacayaasha ah, isla markaana guryaha lagu xiro adeegyada muhiimka ah iyo qorsheynta magaalooyinka. Safiir Jabriil ayaa muujiyey diyaar u ahaanshaha Soomaaliya ee fududeynta iskaashiga iyo in wada-hadallada loo beddelo tallaabooyin la isku dubbariday. Arrintan ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh magaalooyinka Soomaaliya oo wajahaya koror dadweyne, barakac joogto ah iyo culays ku sii kordhaya guryaha, waddooyinka, biyaha iyo adeegyada kale ee aasaasiga ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qorshuhu weli wuxuu marayaa heer wada-tashi. Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Kenya, Jabriil Ibraahim Cabdulle, ayaa magaalada Nairobi kulan kula yeeshay masuuliyiinta xafiiska UN‑Habitat ee Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray kaabayaasha magaalooyinka, hab-nololeedka bulshada, maamulka deegaanka iyo sidii arrimaha guryaha loogu dari lahaa Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka. items.title: Ethiopia’s Nuclear Dream Meets a Country at War
items.description: By Abdikarim H. Abdi Buh Ethiopia is preparing to enter the nuclear age with Russia’s help, but the country’s most immediate crisis is not an energy shortage. It is political fragmentation and renewed armed conflict. That creates a striking contradiction. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed is pursuing an ambitious nuclear programme designed to give Ethiopia a stable source of electricity beyond its heavy dependence on hydropower. Yet as Addis Ababa looks decades into the future, armed conflicts are again spreading across the country, former enemies are joining forces against the federal government, and the political future of Abiy’s administration is becoming increasingly uncertain. The question is no longer simply whether Ethiopia can build a nuclear power plant. Can a politically unsettled state safely and sustainably pursue such an ambitious strategic project while parts of the country remain at war? Nuclear Ambition Ethiopia and Russia have been advancing plans for Ethiopia’s first nuclear power plant through cooperation with Russia’s state nuclear company, Rosatom. The two countries signed an intergovernmental nuclear cooperation agreement in 2017, ratified by Ethiopia in 2021. In September 2025, Rosatom and Ethiopian Electric Power signed an action plan to advance the project, including detailed technical work, preparation of a feasibility-study roadmap and steps toward a future intergovernmental agreement. For Abiy’s government, nuclear power represents more than electricity. Ethiopia generates the overwhelming majority of its electricity from hydropower, leaving the economy exposed to variations in rainfall and water availability. Nuclear energy could eventually provide a large, continuous source of electricity for industrialisation and economic expansion. Abiy himself has described nuclear power as part of Ethiopia’s effort to build reliable energy, industrial capacity and technological capability.  But the strategic ambition comes at a politically difficult moment. A Country Being Pulled Apart Ethiopia is confronting armed conflicts involving competing ethnic, regional and political forces. The Tigray conflict that devastated the country between 2020 and 2022 has again erupted into serious fighting. In September 2026, clashes intensified between federal forces and Tigrayan forces and spread toward neighbouring Afar and Amhara. Tigrayan forces also seized airports, prompting Ethiopian Airlines to suspend flights to the region. The crisis has become even more complicated with the emergence of the Ethiopian Peoples’ Forces Alliance for Survival, a coalition bringing together seven armed groups, including the Tigray People’s Liberation Front, Amhara Fano and the Oromo Liberation Army. These groups have very different histories and, in some cases, have previously fought each other. Yet they now share a common objective: challenging and removing Abiy’s government and establishing a transitional political order. The significance is difficult to overlook. The conflict is no longer confined to one region or one ethnic constituency. It is becoming a wider confrontation over the political structure and future direction of Ethiopia. The Abiy Question Abiy came to power in 2018 promising political reform and reconciliation. His early rapprochement with Eritrea earned him the 2019 Nobel Peace Prize. But the years since have been dominated by conflict. The Tigray war shattered relations between Addis Ababa and the TPLF. Fighting subsequently spread to Amhara, while armed conflict has continued in Oromia. Now former adversaries have formed an alliance against the federal government. That does not mean the alliance is certain to defeat Abiy or that his government is about to collapse. The coalition itself contains deep ideological, territorial and historical contradictions, and analysts have questioned whether its members can maintain unity beyond their shared opposition to the federal government. But it does mean that Ethiopia’s political trajectory has become considerably harder to predict. Could Nuclear Power Become a Burden? Nuclear energy can offer Ethiopia long-term advantages: dependable electricity, industrial capacity and diversification away from exclusive reliance on hydropower. But nuclear infrastructure also requires something electricity alone cannot provide: long-term institutional stability. A nuclear programme demands strong regulators, secure infrastructure, highly trained personnel, reliable financing, effective emergency systems and political institutions capable of maintaining policy continuity across governments. That is where Ethiopia’s current crisis becomes relevant. If political instability deepens, if regional governments and armed movements continue challenging federal authority, or if Abiy’s government eventually faces a major political transition, the nuclear project could become caught in disputes over financing, security, institutional control and national priorities. The nuclear programme itself is not evidence of political instability, nor is there evidence that it is currently unsafe. The issue is whether Ethiopia’s political and institutional environment can sustain such a complex undertaking over the decades required to build and operate a nuclear facility. The Bigger Contradiction Ethiopia is therefore pursuing two very different futures at the same time. One is technological: nuclear power, industrialization, expanded electricity generation and greater energy independence. The other is political: armed conflict, ethnic and regional tensions, competing visions of federal power and an emerging alliance determined to challenge the government in Addis Ababa. The first requires decades of stability. The second threatens to consume the immediate political horizon. Ethiopia’s nuclear ambition may ultimately become one of the country’s most important development projects. But nuclear power cannot resolve the political conflicts now threatening the country’s unity. The decisive question for Abiy Ahmed may therefore be less about whether Ethiopia can enter the nuclear age than whether he can create the political stability necessary for Ethiopia to reach it. A nuclear future requires more than reactors, engineers and billions of dollars. It requires a state stable enough to outlive its political leaders. And that is precisely the uncertainty Ethiopia is confronting today. The key factual distinction is important: the Russia-Ethiopia agreement is an advancing nuclear-power project, not evidence that construction of the first plant has already begun. The September 2025 action plan called for further project development, feasibility work and preparation for a future intergovernmental agreemen Meanwhile, the political-security backdrop has materially deteriorated in September 2026: seven-armed groups have announced an alliance against Abiy’s government, and fighting has spread from Tigray toward Afar and Amhara. items.title: Lafta-gareen oo war yaab leh soo saaray kadib dagaalkii maanta ka dhacay Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Lafta-gareen ayaa dowladda Turkiga ku eedeeyay in diyaarado dagaal oo F-16 ah ay duqeymo ka fuliyeen magaalada Baydhabo, xilli dagaal culus uu ka socday magaalada Isniintii. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay xafiiska Lafta-gareen maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 28-ka September ayaa lagu sheegay in lix gantaal lagu garaacay gudaha iyo hareeraha Baydhaba, kuwaas oo sida uu sheegay sababay dhimasho, dhaawac iyo burbur hantiyeed. Lafta-gareen ayaa si toos ah dowladda federaalka iyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ugu eedeeyay mas’uuliyadda weerarrada, isagoo sheegay in diyaaradaha F-16-ka ee Turkiga loo adeegsaday dagaalkii maanta ka dhacay Baydhaba. Waxa uu sidoo kale dowladda federaalka ku eedeeyay inay dooneyso inay curyaamiso awoodda iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaale ee Koonfur Galbeed, inkastoo war-saxaafadeedku uusan soo bandhigin caddeymo madax-bannaan oo muujinaya halka ay gantaalladu ku dhaceen, cidda si toos ah u ridday ama tirada dadka ku dhintay iyo kuwa ku dhaawacmay. Eedeynta ku saabsan diyaaradaha F-16-ka ayaa timid iyadoo warbaahinta AFP ay sheegtay in diyaarado dagaal iyo kuwa aan duuliyaha lahayn loo adeegsaday dagaalkii Baydhaba. Dad deegaanka ah oo AFP la hadlay ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay arkeen ama maqleen duqeymo ay ku tilmaameen kuwo ka yimid diyaarado Turki ah, balse si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin cidda fulisay duqeymahaas. Lafta-gareen ayaa dhinaca kale bogaadiyay maleeshiyadiisa oo uu ugu yeeray ciidamada Daraawiishta, isagoo sheegay inay howlgal ka sameeyeen Baydhaba oo ay kaga hortageen ciidamo ku sugnaa aagagga Salbalaar iyo Afbalaar. Waxa uu sheegay in howlgalkaasi “si guul leh” kusoo dhammaaday, isla markaana khasaaro culus la gaarsiiyay ciidamada ka soo horjeeda. Dowladda federaalka iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ee uu hoggaamiyo Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur Madoobe ayaa iyaguna bixiyay war ka duwan, iyagoo sheegay in ciidamada dowladda ay dib u riixeen weerar lagu soo qaaday magaalada. Labada dhinac ayaa sidaas ku kala sheegtay guulo dagaalkii Isniintii. Dagaalka ayaa qarxay aroortii markii ciidamo taageersan Lafta-gareen ay gudaha u galeen qeybo ka mid ah Baydhaba, halkaas oo ay kula dagaallameen ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo kuwa maamulka Sheekh Aadan Madoobe. Madaafiic, rasaas culus iyo qaraxyo ayaa laga maqlayay xaafado badan, kahor inta aysan xaaladdu degin galinkii dambe. Khilaafka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa soo jiitamayay tan iyo markii ciidamada dowladda federaalka ay la wareegeen Baydhaba bishii March, kaddib muran siyaasadeed oo u dhexeeyay dowladda dhexe iyo Lafta-gareen. Lafta-gareen ayaa markii dambe dib u soo nooleeyay sheegashadiisa madaxtinimada, isagoo diiday maamulka Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ee dowladda federaalka aqoonsan tahay. Iska horimaadyo dhowr ah ayaa tan iyo markaas ka dhacay Baydhaba, iyadoo khilaafka siyaasadeed uu si isa soo taraysa ugu wareegayo dagaal hubeysan oo u dhexeeya labada dhinac. The post Lafta-gareen oo war yaab leh soo saaray kadib dagaalkii maanta ka dhacay Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland oo shaacisay in wado qorshe ay maamulka hawada kula wareegayso
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Somaliland ayaa sheegtay inay waddo dadaallo ay ku doonayso inay si buuxda ula wareegto maamulka hawadeeda, iyadoo sidoo kale qorsheyneysa in meesha laga saaro nidaamka dal-ku-galka elektaroonigga ah ee Soomaaliya (e-Visa) ee dadka u safraya Hargeysa. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada Somaliland, Khadar Xuseen Cabdi ayaa sheegay in arrimahan ay xukuumaddu ka waddo dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed iyo kuwo kale oo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo si taxaddar leh oo qarsoodi ah loo maamulayo. Sida uu sheegay wasiirku, Wasaaradda Duulista iyo Horumarinta Madaarrada Somaliland, Fu’aad Axmed Nuur ayaa si gaar ah ugu howlan arrimaha la xiriira duulimaadyada iyo caqabadaha ka taagan maamulka hawada. “Si xikmad leh oo qarsoodi ah ayuu Wasiir Duulista Fu’aad u wadaa hawsha duulimaadyada iyo caqabadaha ka taagan hawada, dhawaana waxa aanu rajaynaynaa inuu guul ka gaadho,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Madaxtooyadda oo la hadlay qaar kamid ah jaaliyadda Somaliland ee ku nool Mareykanka. Khadar ayaa intaas ku daray in Fu’aad Axmed Nuur uu weli ku sugan yahay Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu sheegay inuu ka sii wadi doono hawlaha la xiriira arrinta maamulka hawada iyo caqabadaha Somaliland ay sheegtay inay kala kulanto dhinacyada arrintan ku lugta leh. Hadalkiisa ayuu sidoo kale kusoo qaaday aqoonsigii ay Israa’iil siisay maamulka Somaliland, isagoo sheegay in qaar kamid ah tallaabooyinka diblomaasiyadeed ee xukuumadda aan hore loo shaacin, balse ay soo baxayaan kadib marka la gaaro natiijada laga doonayo. “Waad ogaydeen, aroor qudha uun baa lagu soo toosay aqoonsiga Israa’iil. Waxa la is waydiiyay xaggee bay ka mareen, sirdoonadii ina daba socday sida kuwa Turkiga,” ayuu yiri wasiirka. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada ayaa sheegay in Madaxweyne Cirro uu siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda u maamulo hab uu ku tilmaamay “hanaan qunyar socod ah oo sir ah”, isagoo arrimaha maamulka hawada ku daray dadaallada noocaas ah. Doodda ku saabsan maamulka hawada iyo e-Visa ayaa muddooyinkii dambe kamid ahayd culeysyada uu maamulka Somaliland uu wajahayo, iyadoo xukuumaddu ku doodayso in dadka u safraya Somaliland aan lagu qasbi karin inay dal-ku-gal ka qaataan Soomaaliya, oo ay sheegto inay ka go’day. Khadar ayaa intaas ku daray in Fu’aad Axmed Nuur uu weli ku sugan yahay Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu sheegay inuu ka sii wadi doono hawlaha la xiriira arrinta maamulka hawada iyo caqabadaha Somaliland ay sheegtay inay kala kulanto dhinacyada arrintan ku lugta leh. Hadalkiisa ayuu sidoo kale kusoo qaaday aqoonsigii ay Israa’iil siisay maamulka Somaliland, isagoo sheegay in qaar kamid ah tallaabooyinka diblomaasiyadeed ee xukuumadda aan hore loo shaacin, balse ay soo baxayaan kadib marka la gaaro natiijada laga doonayo. “Waad ogaydeen, aroor qudha uun baa lagu soo toosay aqoonsiga Israa’iil. Waxa la is waydiiyay xaggee bay ka mareen, sirdoonadii ina daba socday sida kuwa Turkiga,” ayuu yiri wasiirka. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada ayaa sheegay in Madaxweyne Cirro uu siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda u maamulo hab uu ku tilmaamay “hanaan qunyar socod ah oo sir ah”, isagoo arrimaha maamulka hawada ku daray dadaallada noocaas ah. Doodda ku saabsan maamulka hawada iyo e-Visa ayaa muddooyinkii dambe kamid ahayd culeysyada uu maamulka Somaliland uu wajahayo, iyadoo xukuumaddu ku doodayso in dadka u safraya Somaliland aan lagu qasbi karin inay dal-ku-gal ka qaataan Soomaaliya, oo ay sheegto inay ka go’day. items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo sheegtay in dagaal-yahanadii ugu badnaa ay maanta soo weerareen Baydhabo
items.description: Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ka hadashay dagaalka qaraar ee maanta ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo, oo Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) uu sheegtay inay ciidamadiisu weerareen magaaladaasi. Afhayeenka Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed, Maxamed Sheekh Cabdullaahi (Xaayow) ayaa sheegay in maleeshiyada Al Shabaab oo keliya ay soo weerareen magaalada, isagoona meesha ka saaray in weerarka ay qayb ka ahaayeen ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Laftagareen. “Nimankii arxanlaaweyaasha ahaa ee Al Shabaab ayaa maanta si argagaxisanimo oo dhab ah magaalada ku soo galay saakay abaare Salaaddii Subax, ayagoo magaalada ku soo galay qaraxyo naf iyo gawaariba leh, isla-markaana drone wax la yiraahdo oo ay wataan la soo galay.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenka oo xusay in saddex kun oo Shabaab ah ay weerarka soo qaadeen. “Nimanka maanta Baydhabo soo weeraray ma ahayn niman la saari karo ama la bixin karo. Waxaa lagu qiyaasay ugu yaraan saddex kun oo nin, sida aan xogta la soconay illaa Galgaduud, Hiiraan iyo Bu’aale Shabaabkii joogay baa isku habar wacday oo la soo daldalaayay maalmahaan oo dhan ayaan ogayn.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenka Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed oo carabta ku adkeeyay “Ugu yaraan saddex kun oo nin iyo dheeraad ayaa Baydhabo maanta soo galay oo soo weeraray.” Afhayeenka oo BBC la hadlay ayaa intaasi ku daray “Ilaahay baa ka awood badnaa, shacabka Koonfur Galbeed baa ka awood badnaa, Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed iyo Ciidamada Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed baa ka awood badnaa.” Dhanka kale Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga Somaliya ayaa sheegtay in weerar qaraxyo ku bilowdeen ay magaalada ku soo qaadeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab iyo kuwa Laftagareen, oo sida ay sheegtay isku milmay. Wasaaradda ayaa warkan ku sheegtay qoraal lagu daabacay boggeeda internet-ka. Xafiiska Laftagareen ayaa beeniyay eedeyntaasi, iyadoona war uu Laftagareen soo saaray lagu sheegay in weerarka ay qaadeen Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed. Siyaasiyiinta iyo Saraakiisha Koonfur Galbeed ee la safan Laftagareen ayaa Isniintan qaarkood lagu arkay magaalada, intii uu dagaalku ka socday. Weerarkan ayaa u muuqdo mid lagu kediyay maamulka cusub Koonfur Galbeed ee Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu hoggaamiyo, xilli Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed ay isku diyaarinayeen hawlgal uu ujeedkiisu ahaa in taageereyaasha Laftagareen iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab lagaga sifeeyo deegaanada hoostaga Baydhabo. Tan iyo markii meesha laga saaray maamulkii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen ayaa afar jeer weeraray Magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoo ay weeraradaasi gaysteen 30-kii bishii May, 17-kii August, 3-dii iyo 28-ka bishan September oo maanta ku beegneyd. Dagaalkan ugu dambeeyay ayaa lagu sheegay kii ugu waqtiga dheeraa ee ka dhaca Baydhabo, marka loo eego saddexdii weerar ay ku lugta lahaayeen ciidamada ka amarka qaata Laftagareen ee ka dhacay magaaladaasi.

items.title: Waa sidee xaaladda Baydhaba kadib dagaalkii saaka?
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Xaaladda magaalada Baydhabo ayaa degan saacado kadib markii uu magaalada ka dhacay dagaal u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda, kuwa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed iyo ciidanka taabacsan Lafta-gareen. Dagaalka ayaa sababay khasaare kala duwan oo isugu jira dhimasho, dhaawac iyo burbur hantiyeed, hase yeeshee tirada rasmiga ah ee khasaaraha weli lama xaqiijin. Wararka laga helayo magaalada ayaa sheegaya in xaaladda amni ay hadda ka wanaagsan tahay sidii ay ahayd xilligii uu dagaalku socday, iyadoo dhaq-dhaqaaqa shacabka uu si tartiib ah dib ugu soo laabanayo. Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ku sugan Baydhabo oo isugu jira militariga iyo booliiska iyo kuwa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ayaa howlgallo xaqiijin amni ah wada, waxaana sidoo kale nawaaxiga magaalada lagu arkayaa ciidamada tiro badan. Goobaha muhiimka ah ee magaalada ayaa weli lagu arkayaa ciidamo dheeraad ah, kuwaas oo qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga kadib iska horimaadkii dhacay saaka. Dadka magaalada ayaa bilaabay inay dib ugu laabtaan goobahooda shaqo iyo hawlahooda maalinlaha ah, iyadoo la sugayo faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo kasoo baxda dhinacyada amniga oo ku saabsan dagaalkii dhacay. Inkasta oo xaaladda magaalada ay hadda deggan tahay, haddana waxaa laga cabsi qabaa in mar kale uu qarxo dagaal u dhaxeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Dagaalka maanta ayaa waxaa guullo ka sheegtay dowladda, iyadoo Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ay sheegtay in ciidamadu ay jab culus gaarsiiyeen ragga weerarka soo qaaday oo ay tilmaamtay inay ahaayeen maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab iyo kuwa Lafta-gareen ee isku milmay, iyadoo soo bandhigtay maydadka xubno la dilay inta uu socday dagaalka. Sidoo kale waxay wasaaraddu sheegtay in ciidamadu ay si geesinimo leh uga hortageen weerarka, isla markaana ay si buuxda ay gacanta ugu hayaan magaalada Baydhaba. Dhanka kale, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo ka hadlay dagaalka Baydhaba ayaa sheegay in la jabiyay maleeshiyaadka weerarka soo qaaday, isaga oo boggaadiyay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Birmadka ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. “Mataanihii Argagixisada ee saakay soo weeraray Baydhabo jab xooggan ayaa dhabarka loo saaray,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Axmed Macallin oo qoraal kooban ku daabacay battiisa Facebook. The post Waa sidee xaaladda Baydhaba kadib dagaalkii saaka? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xildhibaanno Muqdisho ku sugan oo taageero wayn u muujiyay Lafta-gareen
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaanno ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya oo maanta la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa taageero wayn u muujiyay Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo mar kale ciidamadiisa ay saaka weerar kusoo qaadeen Baydhaba, halkaas oo uu ka dhacay dagaal ay la galeen ciidamada dowladda. Xildhibaannadan oo laga soo doorto Koonfur Galbeed ayaa garab istaagay madaxweyne Lafta-gareen iyo kooxdiisa ee haatan dagaalka kula jira Aadan Madoobe iyo xukuumaddiisa, waxayna dhanka kale eedeymo u jeediyeen Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Aadan Lafta-gareen oo kamid ah xildhibaannada hadlay ayaa si weyn u difaacay walaalkiis, wuxuuna tilmaamay in aanu argagixiso ahayn ee uu u dagaalamaya xaqa Koonfur Galbeed. Waxaa kale oo uu meesha ka saaray in diyaarado ay u adeegsadeen weerarkii Baydhaba. “Waxaa magaalada soo weeraray ciidankii dowladda Koonfur Galbeed oo duuulaanka horay loogu qaaday ayaa dib usoo noqday, diyaaradaha iyaga ma wadan waxaa watay niman xildhibaanno ah oo Koonfur Galbeed ka tirsan oo dhibaatada meesha ka wado,” ayuu yiri Aadan Lafta-gareen. Sidoo kale Xildhibaan Maxamed Xasan Maxamed (Murjaan) ayaa tilmaamay ciidamada Lafta-gareen ay yihiin kuwa xaq-u-dirir ah oo u dagaalamaya inay xoreeyaan deegaankooda, isla markaana ujeedkooda uu yahay inay soo celiyaan nidaamkii sharciga ahaa, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Meel ay Shabaab soo weerartay ma arkin, laakiin ciidamo xaq-u-dirir ah oo dagaalamaayo ayaa la’ii sheegay inay weerarka soo qaadeen hadda waxaa maqlaayay waxaa la kiciyay F-16 meesha shacab ayaa la leynayaa,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Maxamed Xasan Murjaan. Dhankeeda Xildhibaan Maryan Macallin oo Baydhaba laga soo doortay ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in dagaalka ka socda Koonfur Galbeed uu yahay mid loo soo xawilay, isla markaana lagu burburinayo jiritaankooda, sida ay hadalka u dhigtay. “Annagu argagixiso ma arkin dadka waxaas leh waxay ka shaqeynayaan burburka Koonfur Galbeed waa kuwa dagaalka qaybta ka ah. Jiriraankeenna ayaa la diidan yahay gobollada kale waxaa la leeyahay maxaa ku mac, maxaase ku qaaraar?” ayay tiri Xildhibaan Maryan Macallin. items.title: Xogta shir muhiim ah oo Soomaaliya ku guddoomisay Nairobi, kaasi oo lagu ansixiyay…
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Maaliyadda Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Biixi Imaan Cige ayaa maanta shir Guddoomiyay kulanka 29-aad ee Madasha Iskaashiga Dalalka Geeska Afrika. Kulanka waxaa ka qayb-galay qaar ka mid ah Wasiirrada dalalka ku bahoobay madasha, wakiillo ka socday dowladaha deeq-bixiyeyaasha iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah, oo ay ka mid yihiin Bangiga Adduunka, Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika, IGAD iyo Midowga Yurub. Shirka oo ahaa kulan hal maalin ah ayaa diiradda lagu saaray horumarinta is-dhexgalka gobolka, xoojinta iskaashiga iyo maalgelinta mudnaanta dhaqaale ee dalalka Geeska Afrika. Waxaa si gaar ah xoogga loo saaray horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, gaar ahaan korontada, biyaha iyo waddooyinka isku xira dalalka ku bahoobay madashaan. Intii uu socday kulanka, waxaa sidoo kale lagu ansixiyay qorshe-hawleedka horumarinta ganacsiga Geeska Afrika, kaas oo ay hore u diyaariyeen Wasiirrada Ganacsiga ee dalalka ku bahoobay Hindisaha Geeska Afrika. Qorshaha ayaa ka dhashay kulankii Wasiirrada Ganacsiga ee Madashani oo bishii Agoosto 2026 lagu qabtay magaalada Addis Ababa ee dalka Itoobiya. Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya ayaa uga mahadceliyay dowladaha ku mideysan Madasha Hindisaha Geeska Afrika iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah taageerada muhiimka si joogto ah u siiya hindisahan, gaar ahaan kaalintooda ku aaddan horumarinta, iskaashiga iyo maalgelinta mashaariicda muhiimka u ah dalalka Geeska Afrika. Kulanka 29-aad ayaa sidoo kale xoojisay muhiimadda ay leedahay in dalalka gobolka iyo saaxiibadooda caalamiga ah ay sii xoojiyaan iskaashiga, si loo dardargeliyo mashaariicda gobolka iyo horumarinta fursadaha dhaqaale ee Geeska Afrika. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay khasaraha nafeed ee dagaalka Baydhabo uu gaystay
items.description: Warar dheeraad ah ayaa ka soo baxaya khasaaraha nafeed ee uu gaystay dagaalka culus ee maanta ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta KMG Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, ka dib markii ay weerar ballaaran ku soo qaadeen ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ciidamadaasi kula dagaalamay xaafadaha magaalada. Ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen ayaana la sheegay in markii ugu horreysay ay magaalada ku soo weerareen diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Ugu yaraan 21 qof oo isugu jira dhinacyadii dagaalamay iyo dad rayid ah ayaa ku dhintay dagaalka, halka tobanaan kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen, sida laga soo xigtay ilaha caafimaadka ee magaalada. Mashquul badan ayaa laga soo sheegaya Isbitaal Goboleedka Baay oo sidoo kale loo yaqaano (Isbitaalka Weyn ee Baydhabo), halkaas oo la geeyay dhaawacyada ugu badan. Gaari laga soo buuxiyay walxaha qarxa oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday Hotel RB ayaa la sheegay in uu ka dhashay khasaaraha ugu badan ee hal goob ah. Dagaalkan ayaa lagu sheegay kii ugu waqtiga dheeraa ee ka dhaca Magaalada Baydhabo, marka loo eego weeraradii ay horey magaaladaasi uga gaysteen ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen. Dagaalka Isniintan ka dhacay Baydhabo oo bilowday xilligii Salaadda Subax ayaa soo geba-gaboobay abaarihii 1-da duhurnimo.

items.title: Qoyska Suldaan Galad Aadan Cismaan oo ka Hadlay Xariggiisa Muqdisho
items.description: Qoyska Suldaan Galad Aadan Cismaan ayaa ka hadlay xarigga Suldaanka oo ay sheegeen in shalay laga xiray degmada Shangaani ee magaalada Muqdisho, iyagoo dalbaday in la dhowro xuquuqdiisa, lana caddeeyo sababta rasmiga ah ee loo xiray. Qoyska Suldaanka ayaa sheegay in xariggiisa uu la xiriiri karo loollanka siyaasadeed ee ka socda maamulka Hirshabeelle, iyagoo farta ku fiiqay Wasiir Ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Cismaan Daalo, oo ay ku eedeeyeen inuu ka dambeeyo xarigga Suldaanka. items.title: Crisis Group: Mucaaradka Itoobiya oo markii ugu horreysay isku dubbariday weerarro ka dhan ah dowladda federaalka
items.description: Hay’adda Xasaradaha Caalamiga ah ee Crisis Group ayaa sheegtay in howlgallada militari ee ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya ay u muuqdaan isku daygii ugu horreeyay ee isbahaysi cusub oo mucaarad ah uu ku qaado weerarro militari oo isku dubbaridan oo ka dhan ah dowladda federaalka. Hay’adda ayaa tilmaantay in weerarradan ay muujinayaan in kooxaha mucaaradka ah ay bilaabeen inay si wadajir ah u abaabulaan howlgallo militari oo ka dhan ah dowladda dhexe. Dhaqdhaqaaqyadan ayaa imaanaya xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee ka jira waqooyiga Itoobiya, iyadoo xaaladda gobolka ay yeelan karto saameyn ku saabsan xasilloonida guud ee dalka. Crisis Group ayaa horey uga hadashay halista colaadaha Itoobiya, gaar ahaan xiisadaha ka jira gobollada waqooyiga dalka.

items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo Tababar u Soo Xiray Dufcaddii 12-aad ee Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab
items.description: Muqdisho, 28 Sebteembar 2026: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa tababar ugu soo xiray Dugsiga Tababarka Shahiid G/le Xasan Tuure dufcaddii 12-aad ee Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab. Ciidanka dufcaddan ayaa muddadii tababarka lagu baray xeerka ciqaabta, xuquuqda aadanaha, xirfadaha caafimaadka iyo isgaarsiinta, cilad-bixinta hubka iyo xeeladaha dagaalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha oo ay wehliyaan Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa ciidanka ku bogaadiyey dadaalka iyo adkaysiga ay muujiyeen muddadii tababarka, isaga oo kula dardaarmay inay aqoonta iyo xirfadaha ay barteen ugu adeegaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana ay ka shaqeeyaan difaaca dalka. Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay in Xukuumadda DanQaran ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso dhismaha iyo tayeynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, si loo helo ciidan leh tababar, tayo iyo awood ay ku gutaan waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee loo igmaday. Waxa uu sidoo kale ciidanka cusub kula dardaarmay inay ilaaliyaan sharciga, kuna sifoobaan waddaniyad, daacadnimo iyo u heellanaanta difaaca dalka. Munaasabadda xiritaanka tababarka ayaa lagu soo bandhigay xirfadaha iyo aqoonta ciidan ee ay barteen dufcadda 12-aad ee Kumaandooska Danab, kuwaas oo loo diyaariyey gudashada waajibaadka qaran ee la xiriira difaaca dalka, sugidda amniga iyo la-dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada ah.

items.title: DF oo maydad soo bandhigtay kadib dagaalkii Baydhaba
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Gaashaanshigga Soomaaliya ayaa faah-faahin hordhac ah ka bixisay dagaalka ka socda magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay, kaas oo u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Mudane Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-areen). Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadu ay jab culus gaarsiiyeen ragga weerarka soo qaaday oo ay tilmaamtay inay ahaayeen maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab iyo kuwa Lafta-gareen ee isku milmay, iyada oo soo bandhigtay maydadka xubno la dilay inta uu socday dagaalka. Sidoo kale waxaa qoraalka lagu sheegay in ciidamadu ay si geesinimo leh uga hortageen weerarka, isla markaana ay si buuxda ay gacanta ugu hayaan magaalada Baydhaba. Dhanka kale, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo ka hadlay dagaalka Baydhaba ayaa sheegay in la jabiyay maleeshiyaadka weerarka soo qaaday, isaga oo boggaadiyay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Birmadka ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. “Mataanihii Argagixisada ee saakay soo weeraray Baydhabo jab xooggan ayaa dhabarka loo saaray,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Axmed Macallin oo qoraal kooban ku daabacay Facebook-giisa. Si kastaba, Xaaladda ayaa weli kacsan, iyadoo wararkii ugu dambeeyay ayaa sheegayaan in weli dagaalka uu socda, isla markaana ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen ay ka dhex-dagaalayamaan Masaajida Carabta iyo Jaamaca oo labaduba ku yaalla agagaarka Afar irdoodka Baydhaba. The post DF oo maydad soo bandhigtay kadib dagaalkii Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Itoobiya Oo Eritrea Ku Eedeysay Iny Toos Uga Qeyb-qaadanayso Dagaallada Ka Socda Canfarta.
items.description: Waxaa sii xoogaystay dagaallada culus ee ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya, kaas oo u dhaxeeya ciidanka Xabshida Itoobiya iyo

Aabbe 13 Sano Carruurtiisu U Haysteen Inuu Dhintay isaga oo la jooga Suuriya waxaa ka dhacday qiso murugo badan oo muujinaysa raadadka culus ee cabsi iyo cabudhin ay qofka ku reebi karaan. Nin Suuriyaan ah ayaa muddo in ka badan 13 sano ku noolaa meel aad u cidhiidhi ah oo uu ku dhex qariyay gurigiisa, isagoo ka baqayay in la qabto oo xabsiga loo taxaabo xilligii xukuumaddii Bashaar Al-Asad. Ninku bannaanka uma soo bixi jirin. Cuntada, biyaha, dharka iyo daawada waxaa si qarsoodi ah ugu keeni jirtay xaaskiisa, iyadoo waxyaabahaas uga soo gudbinaysay dalool yar oo derbiga ku yaallay. Meeshaas cidhiidhiga ah ayuu ku cuni jiray, ku tukan jiray, kuna seexan jiray. Laakiin waxa ugu murugada badnaa waxay ahayd in carruurtiisu ay guriga kula noolaayeen, haddana aysan garanayn in aabbahood uu derbi gadaashiisa nool yahay. Si carruurtu aysan si kama’ ah u fashilin sirta, hooyadood waxay u sheegtay in aabbahood uu dhintay. Sannado badan ayuu ninku maqli jiray codadka carruurtiisa, qosolkooda iyo ciyaartooda, isagoo dhowr tallaabo oo keliya u jira, balse aan awoodin inuu u soo baxo, la hadlo ama laabta ku qaado. Carruurtiisu waxay u haysteen inuu dhintay, halka uu isagu maalin kasta maqli jiray iyaga oo nool. Wax walba waxay is beddeleen markii uu dhacay nidaamkii Bashaar Al-Asad dhammaadkii 2024. Markii uu ogaaday in xukunkii uu ka baqayay uu burburay, ninkii 13-ka sano ku dhuumanayay gidaarka gadaashiisa ayaa ugu dambayn ka soo baxay meesha uu noloshiisa ku aasnaa. Carruurtiina waxaa loo sheegay runta: aabbahood ma dhiman — wuu noolaa, wuxuuna sannado badan ku jiray gurigooda dhexdiisa. Markii ay arkeen, waxaa dib loo soo celiyay kulan ay noloshu muddo dheer ka xayuubisay. 13 sano ayuu derbi gadaashiis ku noolaa, laakiin waxa uu ugu adkaa ma ahayn cidhiidhiga meesha uu ku dhuumanayay; waxa ugu xanuunka badnaa waxay ahayd inuu maqli jiray carruurtiisa isaga oo aan awoodin inuu yiraahdo: “Aabbihiin waan ahay.” Qisadani waxay noqotay mid ka mid ah sheekooyinka xanuun By Maxamed Cadde

Laakiin waxa ugu murugada badnaa waxay ahayd in carruurtiisu ay guriga kula noolaayeen, haddana aysan garanayn in aabbahood uu derbi gadaashiisa nool yahay. Si carruurtu aysan si kama’ ah u fashilin sirta, hooyadood waxay u sheegtay in aabbahood uu dhintay. Sannado badan ayuu ninku maqli jiray codadka carruurtiisa, qosolkooda iyo ciyaartooda, isagoo dhowr tallaabo oo keliya u jira, balse aan awoodin inuu u soo baxo, la hadlo ama laabta ku qaado. Carruurtiisu waxay u haysteen inuu dhintay, halka uu isagu maalin kasta maqli jiray iyaga oo nool. Wax walba waxay is beddeleen markii uu dhacay nidaamkii Bashaar Al-Asad dhammaadkii 2024. Markii uu ogaaday in xukunkii uu ka baqayay uu burburay, ninkii 13-ka sano ku dhuumanayay gidaarka gadaashiisa ayaa ugu dambayn ka soo baxay meesha uu noloshiisa ku aasnaa. Carruurtiina waxaa loo sheegay runta: aabbahood ma dhiman — wuu noolaa, wuxuuna sannado badan ku jiray gurigooda dhexdiisa. Markii ay arkeen, waxaa dib loo soo celiyay kulan ay noloshu muddo dheer ka xayuubisay. 13 sano ayuu derbi gadaashiis ku noolaa, laakiin waxa uu ugu adkaa ma ahayn cidhiidhiga meesha uu ku dhuumanayay; waxa ugu xanuunka badnaa waxay ahayd inuu maqli jiray carruurtiisa isaga oo aan awoodin inuu yiraahdo: “Aabbihiin waan ahay.” Qisadani waxay noqotay mid ka mid ah sheekooyinka xanuun By Maxamed Cadde

items.title: Ciidamo ku biiraya Kumaandooska Danab oo tababar loo soo xiray (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Raysal Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka, Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta ciidamo cusub tababar ugu soo xiray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Gaashaanle Xasan Tuure (Ex Ballidoogle) ee Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose. Ciidamadan oo ku biiraya Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay dufcaddii 12aad ee Danab ee tababar loogu soo xiro dugsigaasi. “Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ayaa la baray xeerka ciqaabta, xuquuqda aadanaha, xirfado kala duwan oo caafimaadka iyo isgaarsiinta ka mid tahay, cilad bixinta hubka iyo xeeladaha dagaalka ee tabaha kala duwan ah.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Xafiiska Raysal Wasaaraha. Raysal Wasaaraha ayaa ciidamada ku bogaadiyay dadaalka iyo adkaysiga ay muujiyeen muddadii ay ku jireen tababarka, sida lagu sheegay warka, waxaana uu kula dardaarmay in aqoonta iyo xirfadaha ay barteen ugu adeegaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo difaaca dalkooda. “Waxa uu sidoo kale ku booriyay ciidanka cusub in ay ilaaliyaan sharcjga, ayna noqdaan kuwo ku suntan waddaniyad, daacadnimo iyo u heelanaanta difaaca dalka, si looga guuleysto kooxaha Khawaarijta ah iyo cid walba oo dalkooda u diidan nabadda iyo horumarka ay u baahan yihiin shacabka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa dhanka kale lagu sheegay “Intii ay socotay munaasabadda ayaa lagu soo bandhigay xirfadaha iyo aqoonta ciidan ee ay muddada tababarka ku qaateen ciidanka ka tirsan dufcaddan, kuwaas oo loo diyaariyay gudashada waajibaadka qaran ee ku aaddan difaaca dalka, sugidda amniga iyo la dagaalanka kooxaha argagixisada ah ee diidan nabadda iyo dowladnimada Somaliya.” Raysal Wasaare Barre ayaa waxaa munaasabadda ku wehlinayay Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud. Somaliya oo sida la sheegay wajaheysa ciidamo yari ayaa diiradda saareysa tababarka ciidamada, si loo helo cutubyo cusub oo buuxiya kaalinta ciidan yarida.

items.title: At UN, Algeria says Israel seeks to divide Somalia, violates Gaza ceasefire
items.description: Algerian Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf on Monday said Israel is seeking to divide Somalia, attacking Syria and Lebanon, and failing to uphold the Gaza ceasefire agreement. Addressing the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York, Attaf said Israel continued to kill Palestinian civilians despite the ceasefire in Gaza, which has been in effect since October 2025. He reaffirmed Algeria’s support for the Palestinian people’s right to establish “an independent, fully sovereign state with Jerusalem as its capital.” Attaf also condemned Israel’s “continued attacks” in Syria and Lebanon and its “efforts to divide Somalia.” Turning to wider international affairs, Attaf warned of mounting crises and declining trust between states, saying the use of force was again taking precedence over consensus. He called for reform of the UN, saying it had become necessary in light of profound global changes and the need for a more just and representative international system. On the Gulf, Attaf said Algeria was following the escalation there with concern and urged steps to reduce tensions to preserve regional security and stability. Anadolu .

items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo shaaca ka qaaday magacyada ragga hoggaaminayay weerarkii…
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Afhayeenka Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamed Sheekh Cabdullaahi(Xaayow) oo shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaalada Baydhaba ayaa ka warbixiyay dagaalka ka socda magaaladaasi, kaas oo dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda, kuwa Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed iyo ciidanka taabacsan Lafta-gareen. Xaayow ayaa sheegay in weerarka ay soo qaadeen maleeshiyaad Al-Shabaab oo doonaya inay carqaladeeyaan ammaanka Baydhaba, isagoo sheegay in cashir lama filaan ah loo dhigay. Sidoo kale wuxuu soo bandhigay magacyada horjoogayaal Al-Shabaab oo uu sheegay inay hoggaaminayeen weerarka saaka lagu qaaday caasimada KMG ah ee Koonfur Galbeed. “Saaka waxaa magaalada soo weeraray naf-lacaarayaashii iyo nabad-diidayaashii Al-Shabaab, iyagoo rabitaankoodii gurracnaa raba inay ummaddaas ku carqaladeeyaan iyo nabadda magaalada arbushaad iyo xumaana inay ka abuuraan, iyaga oo ay hoggaaminayeen niman waa wan oo Shabaab Amiiradoodii ah oo la yiraahdo Macallin Saalax, Jaylaani nin la yaraahdo, Guuleed iyo Xasan Yacquub oo deegaannadan u dhashay,” ayuu yiri afhayeenka Koonfur Galbeed. Sidoo kale wuxuu sii raaciyay “Ilaahey mahaddii cashir ayaa loo dhigay geesiyaasha ciidamada qalabka sida dhammaantood iyo ciidanka Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed waxay u dhigeen cashir lama ilawaan ah. Dadweynaha waxaan u sheegeynaa is dajiya xaaladda magaalada waa nabad”. Afhayeenka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa sidoo kale xusay in saacadaha soo socda ay faah-faahin dheeraad ah ka bixin doonaan dagaalka ayna soo bandhigi doonaan khasaaraha la gaarsiiyay ragga weerarka soo qaaday iyo maxaabiista ay gacanta ku dhigeen. Dhinaca kale, afhayeen u hadlay kooxda Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ayaa isna guul ka sheegtay dagaalka, wuxuuna tilmaamay in ciidamadooda ay gudaha u galeen magaalada, welina uu socda howlgalka, isaga oo shacabka ugu baaqay inay ku sugnaadaan guryahooda. “Guusha waa dhowdahay magaalada Baydhaba iyo Koonfur Galbeed dhammaanteedba gacanteenna ayay mardhow soo geli doontaa haddii Ilaahey idmo,” ayuu isna yiri Ugaas Xasan. Dagaalka Baydhaba ayaa soo noq-noqday bilihii ugu dambeeyay, wuxuuna saameyn wayn ku yeeshay ammaanka guud ee magaaladaas oo ay horay uga dhaceen doorashooyin ay dowladda dhexe ka qabatay Koonfur Galbeed, laguna soo doortay Sheekh Aadan Madoobe. Somali Lawmakers Back Laftagareen as Baidoa Crisis Deepens
items.description: MOGADISHU—Several members of Somalia’s House of the People have publicly voiced their support for former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen, following renewed clashes in Baidoa between forces loyal to him and forces aligned with the Federal Government. The lawmakers, who represent constituencies in South West State, defended Laftagareen and his supporters while accusing the federal government of contributing to the escalating political and security tensions in the region. Aadan Laftagareen, a member of parliament and brother of the former South West State president, rejected allegations that his brother and his forces were linked to terrorism. He said Laftagareen was defending what he described as the rights and interests of the people of South West State. Aadan also disputed reports that Laftagareen’s forces had used aircraft during the latest fighting in Baidoa. He instead accused other lawmakers from South West State of contributing to the escalation. “The forces that attacked the city were South West State forces that had previously been attacked and later returned,” Aadan said, without providing evidence to support his account. Another South West State lawmaker, Mohamed Hassan Mohamed Murjaan, described forces loyal to Laftagareen as “fighters for justice” and said they were seeking to reclaim their territory and restore what he referred to as the legitimate constitutional order. “I have not seen an area attacked by Al-Shabaab,” Murjaan said, while claiming that civilians were being affected by the fighting. He also referred to reports that F-16 fighter jets had been deployed, a claim that could not be independently verified. Maryan Moallin, a lawmaker representing Baidoa, similarly rejected claims that the clashes were linked to an Al-Shabaab assault. She described the conflict as part of a broader effort to undermine the political and institutional standing of South West State. “We have not seen terrorists,” Maryan said, accusing those making such claims of contributing to what she described as the destabilization of South West State. The lawmakers’ statements come amid escalating tensions between federal authorities, South West State officials and supporters of Laftagareen. The competing accounts of the fighting, including claims concerning the identity of the forces involved and the alleged use of military aircraft, remain unverified. items.title: Iiraan oo cabasho u gudbisay ICAO, maxayse ku sheegeen?
items.description: Iiraan oo cabasho u gudbisay ICAO, maxayse ku sheegeen? Madaxa Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee Iiraan ayaa sheegay inuu cabasho rasmi ah u gudbiyay Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Duulista Rayidka (ICAO), isagoo ka jawaabaya xannibaadaha lagu soo rogay warshadaha duulista ee Iiraan. Abuzar Shiroudi ayaa wakaaladda wararka IRNA u sheegay in cabashada rasmiga ah lagu caddeeyay “dukumentiyada iyo caddeymaha Iiraan ee ku saabsan carqaladaynta hawlaha duulimaadyada.” Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in “weerarrada lagu qaado garoomada diyaaradaha, diyaaradaha iyo raadaarrada ay yihiin tusaale cad oo ka mid ah dambiyada dagaalka, marka loo eego sharciga iyo xeerarka caalamiga ah,” isagoo intaas ku daray in Iiraan ay arrintan la xiriirta cabasho kale u gudbisay maxkamadda Hague. Wuxuu yidhi: “Marka laga hadlayo weerarrada iyo duqeymaha lagu qaado garoomada diyaaradaha iyo diyaaradaha, ururka caalamiga ah ee ICAO wuxuu Iiraan siiyay xaqa ay arrintan uga cabanayso. Hase yeeshee, kiisaska ayaa hadda horyaalla maxkamadda Hague, mana jirto wax natiijo ah oo weli naloo soo sheegay. Sidoo kale, in Iiraan ay xaq u yeelan doonto magdhow iyo in kale waxay ku xirnaan doontaa go’aanka maxkamadda Hague.” Tan iyo toddobaadkii hore, markii la dhaqan geliyay cunaqabateyn Mareykanku saaray shirkadaha diyaaradaha ee Iiraan, garoomo diyaaradeed oo ku yaalla dalal kala duwan ayaa joojiyay duulimaadyadii ay sameyn jireen shirkadaha Iiraan. Ciraaq, Georgia, Imaaraadka Carabta, Jamhuuriyadda Azerbaijan iyo Cumaan, kuwaas oo ahaa meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay u safraan Iiraaniyiintu iyo duulimaadyada transit-ka ah ee ku sii jeeda Yurub iyo Mareykanka, ayaa joojiyay duulimaadyadii Iiraan kadib cadaadis uga yimid Mareykanka. Wakaaladda wararka Fars ayaa sheegtay in shirkadaha diyaaradaha ee Iiraan ay wadahadallo kula jiraan dhinacyo kala duwan sidii loo furi lahaa waddooyin cusub oo duulimaad.
