items.title: OCHA oo khariidad cusub ka soo saartay meelaha Soomaaliya ugu nugul fatahaadaha El Niño
items.description: Muqdisho – Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Isku-duwidda Arrimaha Bani’aadantinimada (OCHA) iyo hay’adaha la shaqeeya ayaa aqoonsaday deegaannada Soomaaliya ee sida gaarka ah ugu nugul fatahaadaha la xiriira roobabka El Niño ee la saadaalinayo, kuwaas oo khatar ku keeni kara nolosha dadka iyo hab-nololeedka bulshada. Khariidad ay OCHA soo saartay 27-ka Sebtembar 2026 ayaa muujinaysa heerarka kala duwan ee halista fatahaadaha ee gobollada dalka, iyadoo lagu tilmaamay meelaha ay bulshada iyo ilaha ay ku tiirsan yihiin noloshoodu ugu badan tahay inay saameeyaan roobabka la filayo. Falanqayntan ayaa diiradda saaraysa dadka ku nool deegaannada u nugul fatahaadaha, iyadoo la eegayo khatarta fatahaadaha webiyada iyo kuwa degdegga ah ee ka dhasha roobabka xooggan. OCHA ayaa sheegtay in xogtan ay gacan ka geysanayso qorsheynta tallaabooyinka ka-hortagga musiibooyinka ka hor inta aysan fatahaaduhu dhicin, iyo sidoo kale diyaarinta jawaabaha bani’aadantinimo ee loo baahan karo. Hay’addu waxay xustay in falanqaynta waqtigeeda la helo ay muhiim u tahay in la yareeyo saameynta fatahaadaha, lana ilaaliyo nolosha dadka iyo hab-nololeedkooda.

items.title: Fiqi oo si adag ugu hanjabay hoggaanka mucaaradka kadib…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa digniin culus u diray siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, isagoo ka digay in magaalada Muqdisho laga abaabulo maleeshiyaad ama tallaabooyin wax u dhimaya amniga. Isagoo ka hadlayay xaaladda amniga Muqdisho, Fiqi wuxuu sheegay in dowladda aysan u dulqaadan doonin cid kasta oo isku dayda inay waxyeello u geysato amniga caasimadda, gaar ahaan haddii arrintaasi la xiriirto abaabul ciidan. Wasiirka ayaa si gaar ah farriin ugu diray siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, isagoo sheegay in tallaabo adag laga qaadi doono haddii ay bilaabaan abaabul ciidan, xilli meel xasaasi ah ay mareyso xiisadda siyaasadeed ee dalka. “Nimanka mucaaradka ah haddii ay abaabulaan maleeshiyaad, gacan bir ah ha lagu qabto,” ayuu yiri wasiir Fiqi. Digniinta wasiirka ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli amniga Muqdisho uu kamid yahay arrimaha ugu waaweyn ee Dowadda Federaalka ay mudnaanta siiso, iyadoo Fiqi uu sheegay in amniga lagu bixiyay naf iyo dhaqaale badan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay khasaare badan u soo mareen sugidda amniga, sidaas darteedna aan cidna laga oggolaan karin isku daydo inay dib u dhaawacdo xaaladda amni ee magaalada. “Amniga oo walaal qaali ah ku weynay ayaa 4 milyan oo lacag ah oo fudud lagu soo qadanayaa. Yaan naxariis loo sameyn cid kasta oo gacanta u soo taagta in ay amniga dhibaatayso,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga. Hadallada Fiqi ayaa muujinaya mowqifka dowladda ee ku aaddan abaabul kasta oo ciidan oo ka dhaca Muqdisho, iyadoo uu carrabka ku adkeeyay in aan loo dulqaadan doonin tallaabo kasta oo waxyeello u geysan karta amniga caasimadda. items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse iyo Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo Kulan Degdeg ah Yeeshay
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa kulan degdeg ah la yeeshay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Jaamac, iyadoo ay jirto xiisad siyaasadeed oo ka dhex taagan madaxda dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa imaanaya xilli ay taagan tahay xiisad la xiriirta go’aan uu dhowaan soo saaray Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, kaas oo la sheegay inuu saameyn ku yeelanayo shaqaalaha rayidka ah, isla markaana ay jiraan khilaafaad ku saabsan arrimaha maamulka dowladda. Kulanka labada mas’uul ayaa kusoo aadaya iyadoo Golaha Shacabka uu wajahayo arrimo dhowr ah oo ay ka mid yihiin cabashada la xiriirta xuquuqda 6,000 oo isugu jira agoonta, dadka naafada ah iyo hawlgabka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Ilaa hadda lama shaacin waxyaabihii ay labada mas’uul kaga wada hadleen kulanka iyo natiijada kasoo baxday.

items.title: Ciidamada Waqooyi Bari oo mushaarkii ugu horreeyay ka helay DF Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Waqooyi Bari ayaa si rasmi ah u helay xuquuqda ciidanka heer federaal, kaddib wada-hadallo muddooyinkii dambe u socday maamulka iyo dowladda dhexe. In ka badan 2,500 oo askari oo ku sugan deegaanka ayaa loo fasaxay inay helaan xuquuqda ciidanka heer federaal. Askartan ayaa xalay markii ugu horreysay helay mushaarkooda, kaas oo ay bixisay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Ciidamadan ayaa tan iyo markii Somaliland laga saaray deegaanka ku shaqeynayay si iskaa wax u qabso ah, waxaana bixinta mushaarka federaalku ay qayb ka tari kartaa baahiyaha ay qabaan iyo xaaladda dhaqaale ee ciidanka. Arrintan ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inay yareyso culayska dhaqaale ee maamulka Waqooyi Bari ka haystay sidii uu mushaar ugu heli lahaa ciidamadiisa. Xogaha la helayo ayaa intaas ku daraya in dhallinyarada deegaanka laga qori doono ciidamo cusub, gaar ahaan cutubyada gaarka ah. Dhinaca kale, arrintan ayaa loo arkaa inay keeni karto loollan cusub, maadaama ciidamada loo sii daayay mushaarka federaalka ay ku jiraan kuwo laga qoray gobolka Sanaag. Puntland ayaa arrintan u aragta mid saameyn ku yeelan karta loolanka ka jira gobolkaas. Sanaag ayaa ah deegaan ay joogitaan ku leedahay Somaliland, halka Puntland ay sidoo kale joogitaan ku leedahay, iyadoo maamulka Waqooyi Bari uu doonayo inuu xoojiyo doorkiisa gobolkaas. Bixinta mushaarka ciidamada iyo qorshayaasha qorista dhallinyarada deegaanka ayaa qayb ka noqon kara dadaallada lagu xoojinayo awoodda maamulka ee gobolka. items.title: Sacuudiga oo shaaciyey in Imaaraadka uu ka dambeeyey aqoonsiga Israel ee Somaliland
items.description: Berlin (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa aaminsan in Imaaraadka Carabta uu agaasimay aqoonsigii ay Israel siisay Somaliland, iyadoo heshiiskaas lagu beddelanayo in Israel ay marin amni ka hesho magaalada istiraatiijiga ah ee Berbera, sida lagu sheegay warbixin cusub oo uu daabacay Golaha Yurub ee Xiriirka Dibadda (ECFR). Xogtan ayaa lagu xusay warbixin uu ECFR ka diyaariyey saameynta sii kordheysa ee Imaaraadka Carabta ee gobolka iyo tartanka siyaasadeed ee sii xoogeysanaya ee kala dhexeeya Sacuudi Carabiya. Warbixinta ayaa sheegtay in saraakiil Sacuudi ah ay rumeysan yihiin in Abu Dhabi uu fududeeyey heshiis ay Somaliland xiriir kula yeelatay Israel, halka dhinaca Israel loo oggolaaday inay marin dhinaca ammaanka ah ka hesho Berbera. ECFR ayaa xogta ku xustay qoraal-hoosaad ku lifaaqan warbixinta, waxayna sheegtay inay ka timid wareysi telefoon oo qoraaga warbixintu uu la yeeshay sarkaal sare oo Sacuudi ah. Magaca sarkaalka lama shaacin. Hay’adda ECFR ma aysan soo bandhigin dokumentiyo madax-bannaan oo caddeynaya inuu jiray heshiis rasmi ah oo aqoonsiga Somaliland si toos ah loogu beddelay marin amni oo Israel ay ka hesho Berbera. Sidaas darteed, arrintaas weli waxay ku kooban tahay qiimeyn ay sameeyeen saraakiisha Sacuudiga oo ECFR ay soo xigatay. Hase yeeshee, sheegashada ah in Imaaraadka uu door ku lahaa fududeynta aqoonsiga Somaliland waxaa hore si gaar ah u werisay wakaaladda Reuters. Reuters ayaa bishii April sheegtay in Imaaraadka Carabta uu gacan ka geystay dhex-dhexaadinta aqoonsiga Israel ee Somaliland, xilli Abu Dhabi uu ballaarinayey saameyntiisa siyaasadeed iyo midda amni ee gobolka. Berbera iyo danaha ammaanka Israel ayaa 26-kii December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee si rasmi ah Somaliland ugu aqoonsada dal madax-bannaan, tallaabadaas oo guul diblomaasiyadeed oo weyn u ahayd maamulka Hargeysa oo muddo ka badan 30 sano raadinayey aqoonsi caalami ah. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa xilligaas sheegay in go’aanka lagu gaaray ruuxda heshiisyada Abraham Accords, halka Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi uu sheegay in maamulkiisu doonayo inuu ku biiro heshiisyadaas. Xogta cusub ee ECFR ayaa arrinta aqoonsiga ku dareyso dhinac amni oo muhiim ah, maadaama ay si toos ah ugu xiriirineyso Berbera. Berbera waxay ku taallaa Gacanka Cadmeed, meel u dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, oo ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga caalamka, isla markaana isku xira Badweynta Hindiya, Badda Cas iyo Kanaalka Suweys. Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa hore dan weyn oo ganacsi ugu lahaa Berbera. Shirkadda DP World ee laga leeyahay Dubai ayaa haysata heshiis 30 sano ah oo ay ku maamusho dekedda Berbera, taas oo ECFR ay ku tilmaantay mid ka mid ah hantida ugu muhiimsan ee Imaaraadka uu ku leeyahay Afrika. Warbixinta ECFR ayaa Berbera ku dartay istiraatiijiyad ballaaran oo Imaaraadka Carabta uu ku isku xirayo dekedo, maal-gashi ganacsi iyo iskaashi amni oo ku kala baahsan gobolka Badda Cas. Waxay sidoo kale tilmaantay danaha Imaaraadka ee magaalada Boosaaso ee Puntland. ECFR ayaa intaas ku dartay in saraakiisha Sacuudiga ay rumeysnaayeen in Abu Dhabi ay diyaar u aheyd inuu fududeeyo heshiis kale oo la mid ah oo Israel ku lug leedahay haddii mustaqbalka koonfurta Yemen uu ka dhasho dal madax-bannaan. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Imaaraadka Carabta uu u dhexeeyo tartan sii kordhaya oo ku saabsan saameynta Yemen, Badda Cas iyo guud ahaan gobolka. Soomaaliya oo diidday aqoonsiga Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u diidday aqoonsigii ay Israel siisay Somaliland, iyadoo sheegtay inuu xadgudub ku yahay madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Midowga Afrika ayaa sidoo kale diiday tallaabadaas, isagoo mar kale xaqiijiyey mowqifkiisa ah in Somaliland ay qeyb ka tahay Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Abu Dhabi ayaa si weyn u xumaaday toddobaadyadii xigay aqoonsiga. 12-kii Janaayo, Golaha Wasiirrada Soomaaliya ayaa laalay dhammaan heshiisyadii dowladda ay la lahayd Imaaraadka Carabta, oo ay ku jiraan heshiisyo la xiriira Berbera, Boosaaso iyo Kismaayo. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa Imaaraadka ku eedeysay tallaabooyin dhaawacaya madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo madaxbannaanida siyaasadeed ee dalka. DP World ayaa markii dambe sheegtay in howlaha ay ka waddo Berbera ay sii socon doonaan, inkastoo go’aanka dowladda federaalka. Warbixinta ECFR oo la daabacay 21-kii September, isla markaana ay qortay khabiirka arrimaha Khaliijka Cinzia Bianco, ayaa si ballaaran u eegaysa sida Imaaraadka Carabta uu dekedaha, ganacsiga, maal-gashiga iyo iskaashiga amni ugu adeegsanayo ballaarinta saameyntiisa gobolka. Warbixintu waxay Berbera ku tilmaameysaa qeyb ka mid ah shabakad ballaaran oo Imaaraadku ka sameystay labada dhinac ee Badda Cas, iyadoo tartanka Abu Dhabi iyo Riyadh uu sii saameynayo siyaasadaha labada dal ee gobolka. Xogta laga soo xigtay sarkaalka sare ee Sacuudiga ayaa hadda bixineysa faahfaahin cusub oo ku saabsan sida Riyadh u aragtay kaalinta Imaaraadka ee aqoonsigii Israel ee Somaliland, gaar ahaan shakiga Sacuudiga ee ah in marin amni oo Israel ay ka hesho Berbera uu qeyb ka ahaa arrangement-kaas. items.title: Iraqi Group Says It Reclaimed Oil Tanker From Somali Pirates
items.description: PUNTLAND— A tribal group from Iraq’s southern Basra province has claimed that it successfully recovered an oil tanker allegedly hijacked by Somali pirates in the Gulf of Aden. According to members of the group, nearly 40 people traveled to the Gulf of Aden after learning that an oil tanker owned by an Iraqi businessman had reportedly been seized, with its crew allegedly being held onboard. The group said it launched an operation to locate the tanker and identify those controlling the vessel before moving to recover the ship and secure the release of its crew. Tribal sources claimed that the tanker was taken back from the suspected pirates following a confrontation. They said several individuals believed to be involved in the alleged hijacking were captured, while others fled the area. The circumstances surrounding the reported confrontation, including the identities of those involved and the current status of the crew, remain unclear. The incident comes as the Gulf of Aden and waters off the Somali coast continue to serve as major shipping routes for commercial and energy vessels. Maritime security remains a concern in the region, where piracy and other threats have periodically disrupted international shipping. The claims have not been independently verified, and no official statement confirming the reported operation was immediately available. items.title: Dagaallada waqooyiga Itoobiya oo galay maalintii 6-aad
items.description: Dagaallada ka socda waqooyiga Itoobiya ayaa galay maalintii shanaad, iyadoo iska horimaadyadu ay ka socdaan qaybo ka mid ah gobollada Tigray, Afar iyo Amhara, xaaladduna ay weli tahay mid isbeddeleysa. Wararka laga helayo goobaha colaadda ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya iyo kooxaha hubeysan ee ka soo horjeeda ay ku dagaallamayaan dhowr jiho, iyadoo dhinacyadu ay kala sheeganayaan horumarro militari oo aan dhammaantood si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin karin. Gobolka Tigray ayaa ka mid ah meelaha ugu daran ee xiisaddu ka taagan tahay, waxaana wararku sheegayaan in xoogagga TPLF ay la wareegeen garoomada diyaaradaha ee Mekelle, Axum iyo Shire, taas oo sababtay in duullimaadyadii Ethiopian Airlines ee magaalooyinkaas la hakiyo. Dhanka kale, dagaallo ayaa sidoo kale laga soo sheegay xadka Tigray iyo Afar, halka deegaanno ay ka mid yihiin Abala iyo Erebti ay noqdeen goobaha iska horimaadyada. Gobolka Amhara ayaa sidoo kale laga soo sheegay dagaallo, gaar ahaan meelaha u dhow xadka Tigray iyo waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee isku xira waqooyiga Itoobiya iyo gobollada kale. Deegaannada Alamata iyo Woldia ayaa lagu soo warramay inay ka mid yihiin meelaha ay ka dhaceen iska horimaadyo, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda ay isku dayayaan inay xakameeyaan dhaqdhaqaaqa kooxaha hubeysan. Xaaladda waxaa sii adkeynaya cilado ku yimid internet-ka iyo adeegyada isgaarsiinta qaybo ka mid ah waqooyiga Itoobiya, taas oo caqabad ku noqotay xaqiijinta wararka iyo sheegashooyinka labada dhinac. Sidoo kale, wararka ku saabsan khasaaraha dhimashada iyo dhaawaca ayaa kala duwan, mana jiraan tirooyin dhammeystiran oo si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyay. Dagaalladan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli TPLF iyo kooxo ka tirsan Fano iyo kooxo kale oo hubeysan ay ku dhawaaqeen isbahaysi ka dhan ah dowladda federaalka. Isbahaysigan ayaa kordhiyay walaaca laga qabo in colaadda ay ka gudubto xuduudaha Tigray oo ay saameyso qaybo kale oo dalka ah. Ciidamada Itoobiya ayaa sheegay inay si taxaddar leh uga jawaabayaan xaaladda, halka madaxda militariga ay ka digeen saameynta ay dagaallo ballaaran ku yeelan karaan shacabka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee dagaalladu weli waa ay socdaan, xaaladda amni ee waqooyiga Itoobiyana waa mid si weyn isha loogu wada hayo, balse waxaa adag in si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyo waxa ka dhacaya goobaha dagaalka.

items.title: R/W Xamza oo shaaciyey in doorasho laga qabanayo deeganada Jubaland iyo habka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay in doorasho laga qaban doono deegaannada Jubbaland ee ay xaaladdu saamaxdo, halka meelaha aysan codbixintu ka suurtageli karin loo adeegsan doono hannaan doorasho oo loogu talagalay xaaladahaas. Xamza ayaa arrintan ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyey barnaamijka Miizaan Podcast ee Dawan Media, oo la baahiyey Sabtidii, isaga oo faahfaahin ka bixiyey qorshaha dowladda federaalka ee doorashooyinka dalka. “Doorashadu way dhaceysaa, meel kasta oo ay ka dhici kartana way ka dhaceysaa,” ayuu yiri ra’iisul wasaaruhu. Xamza ayaa sheegay in xaaladda Jubbaland ay ka duwan tahay tan qaar ka mid ah dowlad-goboleedyada kale, isaga oo xusay in dowladda federaalku aysan aqoonsaneyn maamulka hadda ka jira Jubbaland. Waxa uu sheegay in dowladda federaalku dooneyso in Jubbaland ay qeyb ka noqoto doorashada, isla markaana codbixinta laga qaban doono dhammaan deegaannada ay xaaladaha amni iyo kuwa kale saamaxaan. “Waxaan rabnaa in doorashadu dhacdo, Jubbaland-na ay Soomaaliya qeyb ka noqoto,” ayuu yiri. Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa dhinaca kale qiray in xaaladaha ka jira qaar ka mid ah deegaannada Jubbaland ay suuragal ka dhigi karaan in aan halkaas laga qaban karin codbixin toos ah. Waxa uu tusaale ahaan soo hadal qaaday Jilib, Bu’aale, Hagar, Jamaame iyo Badhaadhe, isaga oo sheegay in haddii doorasho aan laga qaban karin deegaannadaas ama meelo kale, loo adeegsan doono habraaca doorasho ee loo dejiyey xaaladaha noocaas ah. Xamza ayaa sheegay in nidaamka loo yaqaan “hal deegaan doorasho” uu siinayo guddiyada doorashada hannaan lagu maareeyo kuraasta ama deegaannada aysan codbixintu ka qabsoomi karin. Waxa uu tusaale u soo qaatay dalalka Ciraaq iyo Afghanistan, isaga oo sheegay in doorashooyin halkaas ka dhacay ay jireen deegaanno aan codbixin laga qaban karin, balse loo adeegsaday habab kale oo lagu maareeyey xaaladahaas. Hadallada ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa muujinaya in dowladda federaalku qorsheyneyso inay doorashada ka sii waddo Jubbaland xitaa haddii codbixin toos ah aan laga qaban karin dhammaan deegaannada maamulka. Xaaladda Waqooyi Bari Xamza ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay Dowlad Goboleedka Waqooyi Bari, isaga oo sheegay in halkaas laga qaban doono diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaasha iyo doorashooyinka dowladaha hoose. Waxa uu sheegay in madaxda iyo baarlamaanka maamulkaas ay weli haystaan muddo-xileedyadooda jira, sidaas darteedna xaaladdiisu ay ka duwan tahay meelaha kale ee uu muranka siyaasadeed ka taagan yahay. Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Puntland ay leedahay duruufo ka duwan kuwa qaar ka mid ah dowlad-goboleedyada kale, isaga oo aan faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka bixin sida arrintaas loogu dabaqi doono doorashooyinka soo socda. Hadallada Xamza ayaa imanaya xilli dowladda federaalku ay sii waddo qorshaheeda doorashooyinka qof iyo codka ah. Dowladda ayaa hore u sheegtay inay ka go’an tahay Si kastaba, ballan-qaadkiisa ayaa wajihi karaa caqabadda khilaafka dowladda kala dhaxeeya maamul goboleedyada Jubbaland iyo Puntland, oo dhowr sano aan xiriir wanaagsan la laheyn Muqdisho. Xamza ayaa arrintan ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyey barnaamijka Miizaan Podcast ee Dawan Media, oo la baahiyey Sabtidii, isaga oo faahfaahin ka bixiyey qorshaha dowladda federaalka ee doorashooyinka dalka. “Doorashadu way dhaceysaa, meel kasta oo ay ka dhici kartana way ka dhaceysaa,” ayuu yiri ra’iisul wasaaruhu. Xamza ayaa sheegay in xaaladda Jubbaland ay ka duwan tahay tan qaar ka mid ah dowlad-goboleedyada kale, isaga oo xusay in dowladda federaalku aysan aqoonsaneyn maamulka hadda ka jira Jubbaland. Waxa uu sheegay in dowladda federaalku dooneyso in Jubbaland ay qeyb ka noqoto doorashada, isla markaana codbixinta laga qaban doono dhammaan deegaannada ay xaaladaha amni iyo kuwa kale saamaxaan. “Waxaan rabnaa in doorashadu dhacdo, Jubbaland-na ay Soomaaliya qeyb ka noqoto,” ayuu yiri. Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa dhinaca kale qiray in xaaladaha ka jira qaar ka mid ah deegaannada Jubbaland ay suuragal ka dhigi karaan in aan halkaas laga qaban karin codbixin toos ah. Waxa uu tusaale ahaan soo hadal qaaday Jilib, Bu’aale, Hagar, Jamaame iyo Badhaadhe, isaga oo sheegay in haddii doorasho aan laga qaban karin deegaannadaas ama meelo kale, loo adeegsan doono habraaca doorasho ee loo dejiyey xaaladaha noocaas ah. Xamza ayaa sheegay in nidaamka loo yaqaan “hal deegaan doorasho” uu siinayo guddiyada doorashada hannaan lagu maareeyo kuraasta ama deegaannada aysan codbixintu ka qabsoomi karin. Waxa uu tusaale u soo qaatay dalalka Ciraaq iyo Afghanistan, isaga oo sheegay in doorashooyin halkaas ka dhacay ay jireen deegaanno aan codbixin laga qaban karin, balse loo adeegsaday habab kale oo lagu maareeyey xaaladahaas. Hadallada ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa muujinaya in dowladda federaalku qorsheyneyso inay doorashada ka sii waddo Jubbaland xitaa haddii codbixin toos ah aan laga qaban karin dhammaan deegaannada maamulka. Xaaladda Waqooyi Bari Xamza ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay Dowlad Goboleedka Waqooyi Bari, isaga oo sheegay in halkaas laga qaban doono diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaasha iyo doorashooyinka dowladaha hoose. Waxa uu sheegay in madaxda iyo baarlamaanka maamulkaas ay weli haystaan muddo-xileedyadooda jira, sidaas darteedna xaaladdiisu ay ka duwan tahay meelaha kale ee uu muranka siyaasadeed ka taagan yahay. Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Puntland ay leedahay duruufo ka duwan kuwa qaar ka mid ah dowlad-goboleedyada kale, isaga oo aan faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka bixin sida arrintaas loogu dabaqi doono doorashooyinka soo socda. Hadallada Xamza ayaa imanaya xilli dowladda federaalku ay sii waddo qorshaheeda doorashooyinka qof iyo codka ah. Dowladda ayaa hore u sheegtay inay ka go’an tahay Si kastaba, ballan-qaadkiisa ayaa wajihi karaa caqabadda khilaafka dowladda kala dhaxeeya maamul goboleedyada Jubbaland iyo Puntland, oo dhowr sano aan xiriir wanaagsan la laheyn Muqdisho. items.title: Trump oo diiday soo shuruud Iiraan ay ku xirtay dib-u-furista marin-biyoodka Hormuz
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu diiday shuruudo ay Iiraan u gudbisay Washington, taas oo ku saabsan dib u furista Marinka Hormuz , oo ah marin muhiim u ah isu socodka shidaalka iyo badeecadaha caalamka. Trump oo Sabtidii la hadlay wariyeyaasha Aqalka Cad ayaa sheegay in Mareykanku uu gacanta ku hayo xaaladda marinka, isagoo xusay in tiro maraakiib ah ay ka gudbeen. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Iran ay doonayso heshiis, balse uu sheegay in shuruudaha ay soo bandhigtay aysan Washington u cuntami karin. Dhinaca kale, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan, Seyed Abbas Araghchi, ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in Tehran ay Mareykanka u sii marisay Qatar qorshe faahfaahsan oo lagu doonayo in Marinka Hormuz dib loogu furo muddo toddoba maalmood gudahood ah, haddii la buuxiyo shuruudo ay Iran soo bandhigtay. Araghchi wuxuu sheegay in muddada toddobada maalmood ah ay bilaabanayso marka Washington ay aqbasho qorshaha, waxaana sida uu sheegay, Mareykanka looga baahan yahay inuu qaado tallaabooyin ay Iiraan u aragto inay qaadan karaan afar ilaa shan maalmood, kadibna maalinta lixaad marinka la furo. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in maalinta toddobaad ay bilaaban doonaan wada-hadallo u dhexeeya Iran iyo Mareykanka, kuwaas oo lagu doonayo in lagu gaaro heshiis kama dambeys ah oo ku saabsan qodobbada labada dhinac ay ku heshiiyaan. Wasiirka Iiraan ayaa sheegay in tallaabooyinka laga doonayo Mareykanka aysan ahayn wax cusub, balse ay hore ugu jireen is-afgarad ay labada dhinac saxiixeen bishii Juun. Hadallada iska soo horjeeda ee Trump iyo Araghchi ayaa muujinaya in weli uu jiro farqi u dhexeeya labada dhinac oo ku saabsan shuruudaha dib loogu furayo Marinka Hormuz iyo sida loo bilaabi karo wada-hadallada tooska ah. Marinka Hormuz ayaa ah marin istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo sahayda tamarta caalamka, waxaana xaalad kasta oo saameysa isu socodkiisa ay yeelan kartaa saameyn ku saabsan qiimaha shidaalka iyo dhaqaalaha dalal badan.

items.title: Su’aalo ka dhashay sii-daynta markabka MTT-SIBU 1 iyo sheegashada koox Ciraaqiyiin ah
items.description: Warar cusub ayaa su’aalo ka keenay cidda hoggaamisay howlgalkii lagu sii daayay markabka ganacsi ee MTT-SIBU 1 , kaas oo la sheegay in burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ay ku qabsadeen xeebaha gobolka Mudug. Ciidanka Booliska Badda Puntland (PMPF) ayaa maalin ka hor ku dhawaaqay in ay gacanta ku dhigeen markabka iyo kooxdii burcad-badeedda ee haysatay, balse warbaahin Carabta ayaa markii dambe baahisay sheegasho ah in koox rag ah oo ka tirsan qabiil Ciraaqi ah ay door ku lahaayeen hawlgalka lagu sii daayay markabka. Ilo dhinaca amniga badda ah oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa sheegay in shaqaale si madax-bannaan ugu shaqeynayay shirkadda leh markabka ay ka qeyb qaateen howlgalka, iyagoo garab siinayay ciidamada badda Puntland. Sawirro iyo muuqaallo ay faafiyeen ilo Ciraaqi ah ayaa u muuqda inay muujinayaan markabka SIBU 1 , burcad-badeedda la qabtay iyo ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya oo goobta ku sugan. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan cidda si dhab ah u hoggaamisay howlgalka iyo kaalinta ay kala qaateen ciidamada Puntland iyo shaqaalaha dhinaca markabka. Maamulka Puntland ayaa Axaddii kooxdii burcad-badeedda ahayd geeyay dekedda Garacad ee gobolka Mudug, waxaana sidoo kale dekedda la geeyay hub laga qabtay burcad-badeedda, dad dhaawacmay iyo meydadka dad ku dhintay iska horimaadkii dhacay intii uu socday howlgalka. Ilaa hadda ma cadda aqoonsiga dadka Ciraaqiyiinta ah ee lagu sheegay inay ka qeyb qaateen hawlgalka iyo nooca saxda ah ee doorkooda, Sidoo kalena, faahfaahin buuxda lagama bixin sida ay ciidamada Puntland iyo shaqaalaha shirkadda markabka u wada shaqeeyeen.

items.title: Xogta sida ay u baxsadeen maxaabiistii burcad-badeeda ee Puntland qabatay
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Ku dhowaad 20 maxbuus oo kamid ahaa burcad-badeeddii lagu qabtay markabka SIBU 1 ayaa xalay ka baxsaday gacanta Puntland, xilli loo waday magaalada Garoowe, sida ay sheegayaan xogaha laga helayo. Dhacdada ayaa sidoo kale sababtay dhimashada mid kamid ah maxaabiista, halka mid kale uu dhaawacmay xilli ay maxaabiistu isku dayayeen inay ka baxsadaan ciidamadii ilaalinayay. Safarka maxaabiista ayaa ka billowday deegaanka Garacad, halkaas oo laga soo qaaday, waxaana loo waday xarunta Puntland ee Garoowe. Balse baxsashadu waxay ka dhacday deegaanka Shakaal oo hoos taga degmada Jariiban, kuna dhow xadka u dhexeeya gobollada Nugaal iyo Mudug. Xogaha laga helayo dhacdada ayaa intaas ku daraya in maxaabiista baxsatay ay ku jireen laba qof oo dhawaan lagu qabtay Garacad, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay kamid ahaayeen burcad-badeed ka degtay markabkii Turkiga ee Lutuf. Ilaa hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay Puntland oo ku saabsan baxsashada maxaabiista, iyadoo ay soo baxayaan warar kala duwan oo ku saabsan xaaladda dhacdada iyo sida ay maxaabiistu uga baxeen gacanta ciidamada. Puntland ayaa hore u sheegtay in tirada maxaabiista lagu qabtay markabka SIBU 1 ay ahayd 46 qof. Hase yeeshee, markii maxaabiista la keenay Garacad, warar madax-bannaan ayaa sheegay in tiradoodu ahayd 21 xubnood. Markabka SIBU 1 ayaa Jimcihii lagu soo furtay howlgal ay iska kaashadeen maleeshiyaad Ciraaqi ah oo ka socday shirkadda leh markabka iyo ciidamada Badda Puntland ee PMPF, kaddib markii ay burcad-badeeddu qabsatay. Baxsashada maxaabiistan ayaa hadda dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan qaabka loo sugayay amniga maxaabiista intii loo waday Garoowe iyo sida ay ku suuragashay inay ka baxsadaan gacanta ciidamada. items.title: Qabiil Ciraaqi ah oo sheegay in Burcad badeed Soomaali ah ay kasoo furteen Markab ay Afduubteen
items.description: Basra ( Raxanreeb Online) Qabiil ka soo jeeda gobolka Basra ee koonfurta Ciraaq ayaa sheegay inuu koox burcad-badeed Soomaali ah kala wareegay markab shidaal oo lagu afduubtay kaddib markii dagaal kula galeen Gacanka Cadmeed. Sida ay sheegeen xubno ka tirsan qabiilka, ku dhowaad 40 qof ayaa u dhaqaaqay dhanka Gacanka Cadmeed, kaddib markii la ogaaday in markab shidaal oo uu lahaa ganacsade Ciraaqi ah la qabsaday, iyadoo shaqaalihii saarnaa lagu hayay gudaha markabka. Kooxda ayaa la sheegay inay dadaal u gashay sidii ay u heli lahayd goobta markabka iyo cidda gacanta ku haysay, kaddibna ay qaadday tallaabo lagu doonayay in lagu soo furto markabka iyo shaqaalihiisa. Wararka laga helayo dhinaca qabiilka ayaa sheegaya in markabkii dib looga wareegay kooxdii lagu eedeeyay burcad-badeednimada, iyadoo sidoo kale la sheegay in qaar ka mid ah la qabtay, halka qaar kalena ay goobta ka baxsadeen. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Gacanka Cadmeed iyo xeebaha Soomaaliya ay weli yihiin marin muhiim ah oo ay maraan maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo kuwa shidaalka, iyadoo amniga xeebaha iyo khatarta burcad-badeednimadu ay mararka qaar walaac ka abuuraan maraakiibta isticmaasha waddadan. Wararka laga helayo dhinaca qabiilka ayaa sheegaya in markabkii dib looga wareegay kooxdii lagu eedeeyay burcad-badeednimada, iyadoo sidoo kale la sheegay in qaar ka mid ah la qabtay, halka qaar kalena ay goobta ka baxsadeen. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Gacanka Cadmeed iyo xeebaha Soomaaliya ay weli yihiin marin muhiim ah oo ay maraan maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo kuwa shidaalka, iyadoo amniga xeebaha iyo khatarta burcad-badeednimadu ay mararka qaar walaac ka abuuraan maraakiibta isticmaasha waddadan. items.title: Gabar 5 jir ah oo si xun loo dilay oo meydkeeda laga helay xarun Caafimaad
items.description: Baydhabo ( Raxanreeb Online) Gabar 5 jir ah oo la la’aa muddo labo habeen ayaa meydkeeda laga helay meel guriga qoyskeeda ee magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay. Meydka gabadha yar ayaa la sheegay in gelinkii dambe ee Jimcihii laga helay xarun caafimaad oo ku dhaggan guriga qoyskeeda oo ku yaalla deegaanka Xaqsoor. Booliska ayaa sheegay in saddeex ruux oo kala ah labo dumar ah iyo Nin loo qabtay dhacdada, isla markaana uu baaritaano ku socdo. Qoyska gabadha ayaa sheegay in Ikhlaas Ibraahim, ay wayeen 2-dii Duhurnimo ee Arbacadii, waxaana ciidamada ammaanka muddo labo maalin ah baaritaano ka wadeen gudaha magaalada iyo nawaaxigeeda. Ibraahim oo ah Aabaha qoyska ayaa sheegay in meydka gabadha ay ku arkeen jirdil iyo garaacid, in lagu ceejiyay xariga, balse weli mas’uuliyiinta baaritaanka ma aysan shaacin. Sidoo kale hoggaamiyaha dowlad goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Sheekh Axmed Madoobe, ayaa la sheegay inuu soo fara-geliyay dhacdada gabadha, isla markaana ciidanka booliska iyo hay’adda Sirdoonka ku amray in ay si degdeg ah u baaraan dhacdada, isla markaana tallaabo sharciga waafaqsan laga qaado shaqsiyadkii loo qabto falkaasi. Sarkaal booliska ah, ayaa sheegay in mid kamid ah dadka la xiray uu ilaalo ka ahaa dhismaha laga helay meydka gabadha yar. Wixii kusoo kordho warkan halkan kala soco. items.title: R/W Xamza oo shaaciyey in Saciid Deni ka shaqeynayo kala goynta Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa si weyn u weeraray Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, isagoo ku eedeeyay inuu qaadayo tallaabooyin maamulka Puntland ka fogeynaya Soomaaliya. Xamza ayaa sheegay in Puntland laga diiday qaar kamid ah astaamaha iyo hay’adaha qaranka, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ahaa manhajka waxbarashada, kaarka aqoonsiga qaranka iyo calaamadaha qaranka, isagoo arrintaas ku xiray siyaasadda hoggaanka Puntland. “Ma aha dadka shacabka, ma aha Puntland oo dhan runtii, laakiin ninka saaxiibkay Siciid Cabdullaahi, wuxuu goostay Puntland inuu Soomaaliya ka jiro,” ayuu yiri ra’iisul wasaare Xamza. Xamza ayaa adkeeyay in Puntland ay tahay dowlad-goboleed ka tirsan nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay muhiim u tahay dalka. Wuxuu xusay doorka ciidamada Puntland ee dagaallada lagula jiro kooxaha argagixisada. “Puntland waa dowlad federaalka tiirsan tahay, waana state-kii ugu horreeyay ee dowlad-goboleedyada federaalka. Wax badan baa uga maqan Dowladda Federaalka,” ayuu yiri. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa su’aal laga weydiiyay in Puntland ay ku socoto waddadii Somaliland, oo in ka badan 30 sano raadinaya aqoonsi ayaa sheegay inuusan sidaas aaminsanayn. Xamza ayaa kala saaray shacabka Puntland iyo siyaasadda maamulka, wuxuuna sheegay inuu si wanaagsan u garanayo shacabka iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee Puntland, isla markaana uu ogyahay sida ay uga go’an tahay Soomaalinimada. “Ma qabo anigu, sababtoo ah waxaan ogahay dadka Puntland. Aqoonyahannadoodana waan aqaan, siyaasiyiintoodana waan ogahay, shacabkana waan ogahay. Dadkaas sida Soomaalinimada meesha uga joogtaan waan ogahay, Soomaaliya oo mid ah ayey qabaan,” ayuu yiri Xamza. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ugu dambeyn ku adkeystay in siyaasadaha iyo tallaabooyinka maamulka Puntland ee hadda jira aan loo qaadan karin inay matalaan dhammaan shacabka Puntland, isagoo mar kale carrabka ku adkeeyay kala duwanaanshaha u dhexeeya bulshada Puntland iyo siyaasadda maaamulka Deni. The post R/W Xamza oo shaaciyey in Saciid Deni ka shaqeynayo kala goynta Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dr.Abdirahman  Baileh in New York: A Demonstration, a Debate and a Public Record!
items.description: By Hussien Mohamed Yusuf Dr. Abdirahman Duale Baileh’s appearance at a demonstration in New York calling for Somaliland’s recognition has stirred an understandably strong reaction. He is a former foreign minister and finance minister of Somalia, and his position today appears strikingly different from the one many people associated with his years in public office. The moment offers an opportunity to reflect on a wider feature of Somali politics: the speed with which prominent figures can change course, and the difficulty the public faces when those changes arrive without an explanation. Political views can change. Experience can alter a person’s judgment, and no former official should be expected to hold every position for life. Somaliland’s status, in particular, is a question shaped by deeply held convictions, painful history and competing ideas about the future. People on all sides deserve to express their views. The issue for a former foreign minister is not whether he is permitted to take a new position. It is whether he can explain how he reached it, especially when he once represented the Somali state on the international stage. Much of the Somali media reaction reflects this apparent contradiction. Dr. Baileh’s public record extends well beyond his ministerial appointments. Through poems and songs, he expressed affection for Somalia, its people and their shared future. Many Somalis heard in that work the voice of a committed national figure. It is little wonder, then, that seeing him advocate a position they associate with a different political future has left them asking questions. Yet his earlier work should not be used to put his identity on trial. A poem written in hope remains part of its author’s history, even if his political judgment later changes. Nor does a position on Somaliland’s recognition determine whether someone belongs to the wider Somali cultural community. The public can acknowledge the sincerity of what Dr. Baileh expressed before while still asking him to account for what he believes now. That distinction matters because personal accusations rarely bring clarity to a difficult political debate. The more useful questions are direct and substantive. What changed in Dr. Baileh’s assessment? How does he reconcile his present advocacy with the positions he represented as a minister? What future does he believe would best protect peace, dignity and opportunity for the people affected? These are fair questions for a public figure who has spoken with authority on both sides of a consequential political journey. The unfortunate pattern is broader than Dr. Baileh. Somali politics has seen leaders adopt positions that the public would once have considered unlikely, sometimes with little effort to explain the reasoning behind them. Such shifts can leave citizens uncertain about what their leaders stand for and whether public commitments will endure beyond a particular office or moment. A politician’s right to reconsider should be accompanied by a willingness to speak honestly about the reconsideration. That is how change becomes a contribution to public debate rather than another source of distrust. I recently had a genuine discussion with a friend about why so much attention has focused on Dr. Baileh, while Professor Samatar’s decision did not provoke quite the same reaction. The person I spoke with offered a thoughtful explanation: Dr. Baileh served in senior positions in the Somali government and, through his poems and songs, built a public record that many Somalis associate with national unity. His appearance at the New York demonstration therefore surprised people who had followed both his political and artistic work. My friend also drew a distinction in how the two men explained their decisions. Professor Samatar spoke openly about his dissatisfaction with what he described as a political duopoly between two clans, which he believed left other Somali clans without a fair voice. Whether one agrees with his assessment or not, he gave the public a reason it could examine and debate. Dr. Baileh has not yet offered an equally clear public explanation for his change of position. That may be why questions about him remain so prominent. A candid account of what led him to support Somaliland’s recognition would help move the discussion beyond surprise and personal criticism, and towards the political issues he believes deserve attention. Dr. Baileh appearance in New York need not become a contest over who is a “true” Somali. His years of public service and his artistic work are matters of record; so, too, is the position he has chosen to express now. The responsible response is to examine the ideas, ask for an explanation and allow room for a thoughtful answer. Somali politics would benefit from more of that candour, particularly when the questions at stake reach so deeply into people’s sense of history and belonging. Hussien Mohamed Yusuf Email: hussienm4@gmail.com The post Dr.Abdirahman Baileh in New York: A Demonstration, a Debate and a Public Record! appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: 17 qof oo lagu dilay toogasho ka dhacday maqaaxi ku taalla Magaalada Johannesburg ee koonfur afrika
items.description: Ugu yaraan 17 qof ayaa ku dhintay, 15 kalena way ku dhaawacmeen toogasho ka dhacday maqaaxi (tavern) ku taalla gobolka Gauteng ee dalka Koonfur Afrika, sida ay sheegeen booliiska. Dhacdadan ayaa ka dhacday deegaanka Wedela , oo ku yaalla koonfur-galbeed magaalada Johannesburg, ayadoo adeegyada gurmadka degdegga ah uu sheegay in dhammaan 17-ka qof lagu dhawaaqay inay ku dhinteen goobta, kaddib markii ay ciidamada gurmadku halkaas gaareen. Booliiska Koonfur Afrika ayaa sheegay in sababta ka dambeysa toogashada aan weli la ogeyn , iyadoo baaritaanno lagu raadinayo xog ku saabsan ujeeddada weerarka iyo cidda ka dambeysay ay socdaan. Ciidamada ammaanka ayaa sidoo kale bilaabay baadi-goob ay ku raadinayaan siddeed qof oo looga shakisan yahay inay ku lug leeyihiin weerarka . Booliisku waxay sheegeen in tuhmanayaasha la sheegay inay ku hubeysnaayeen qoryaha AK-47 iyo bistoolado . Dhaawacyada 15-ka qof ayaa loo qaaday goobaha caafimaadka, iyadoo aan weli la shaacin xaaladdooda caafimaad. Booliiska ayaa wada baaritaanno iyo howlgallo lagu doonayo in lagu soo qabto tuhmanayaasha, halka faahfaahin dheeraad ah laga sugayo hay’adaha ammaanka iyo baarayaasha. Dhacdadan ayaa mar kale soo cusboonaysiisay walaaca laga qabo toogashooyinka ka dhaca goobaha dadweynaha ee Koonfur Afrika , gaar ahaan weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsado goobaha lagu kulmo iyo madadaalada.

items.title: Xasan oo soo jeediyey dalab ka dhan ah QM ee Soomaaliya
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa ku baaqay in isbeddel weyn lagu sameeyo qaabka ay Qaramada Midoobay uga shaqeyso Soomaaliya, isaga oo sheegay in qeyb badan oo ka mid ah taageerada caalamiga ah ay weli marto hannaan ka baxsan nidaamyada dowladda. Madaxweynaha oo Khamiistii ka hadlayay Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegay in, kaddib in ka badan 30 sano oo QM ay si weyn uga howlgaleysay Soomaaliya, loo baahan yahay in taageerada caalamiga ah si dhow loogu waafajiyo mudnaanta iyo qorshayaasha qaranka. Waxa uu sheegay in inta badan taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ay weli marto waxa uu ugu yeeray “nidaamyo isbarbar socda, mashaariic kala googo’an iyo habab ka baxsan miisaaniyadda dowladda”. Sida uu sheegay, qaabkan ayaa dowladda ku adkeynaya inay si wanaagsan u qorsheyso, isu dubbariddo dhaqaalaha iyo mashaariicda, isla markaana cabbirto natiijooyinka laga gaarayo taageerada caalamiga ah. “Soomaaliya ma dalbaneyso in Qaramada Midoobay ay baxdo,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Waxa uu taa beddelkeeda ku baaqay iskaashi cusub oo ay hay’adaha Soomaalida hoggaaminayaan fulinta mashaariicda, isla markaana ku dhisan isla-xisaabtan iyo natiijooyin la cabbiri karo. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in taageerada caalamiga ah ay tahay inay xoojiso hoggaanka iyo hay’adaha qaranka, halkii ay beddeli lahayd ama hareer mari lahayd. Waxa kale oo uu dhaliilay fikradda ah in dalalka sida Soomaaliya oo kale ah aysan lahayn awood ay iyagu ugu maareeyaan horumarkooda hay’adahooda gudaha. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in fikirkaas la joogo waqtigii lagu tuuri lahaa “qashin-qubka taariikhda”, isagoo ku dooday in Soomaaliya maanta leedahay xirfadlayaal, hay’ado iyo siyaasado awood u leh inay hoggaamiyaan qorshaha horumarinta dalka. Isbeddelka howlgalka QM Hadalka madaxweynaha ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Qaramada Midoobay ay ku dhowdahay inay soo gabagabeyso geeddi-socod labo sano ah oo lagu soo afjarayo howlgalkeeda siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Howlgalka Kumeel-gaarka ah ee Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, UNTMIS, ayaa bishii November 2024 beddelay howlgalka UNSOM, kaddib markii dowladda federaalka ay codsatay in si tartiib tartiib ah loogu wareejiyo Soomaalida howlaha uu hayay howlgalka QM. Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa dejiyey hannaan masuuliyadaha loogu wareejinayo hay’adaha Soomaalida, kooxda Qaramada Midoobay ee dalka iyo saaxiibada kale. UNTMIS ayaa lagu wadaa inuu gebi ahaanba soo afjaro howlihiisa 31-ka October 2026, marka la dhammeystiro wejiga labaad ee qorshaha kala-guurka. Arrintan waxay soo afjareysaa howlgalka siyaasadeed ee gaarka ah ee QM ee Soomaaliya, balse ma micna aha in Qaramada Midoobay ay dalka ka baxayso. Hay’adaha, sanduuqyada iyo barnaamijyada kala duwan ee QM ayaa sii wadi doona howlahooda Soomaaliya. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa qiray kaalinta shaqaalaha Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya iyo dalalka kale, balse waxa uu sheegay in dadaalladii lagu doonayay in QM looga dhigo hay’ad isku xiran, hufan oo natiijooyin muuqda keenta aysan weli gaarin heerkii laga filayay. Hadalkiisa ayaa sidoo kale qeyb ka ah dadaal ballaaran oo dowladda federaalka ay ku doonayso inay awood iyo maamul dheeraad ah ku yeelato barnaamijyada horumarineed ee muddo dheer lagu maamulayay nidaamyo caalami ah. Ka hortag halkii laga sugi lahaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqay in wax laga beddelo habka loo isticmaalo dhaqaalaha caalamiga ah, iyadoo maalgelin badan la gelinayo ka hortagga dhibaatooyinka, adkeysiga bulshada iyo tallaabooyinka hore. Waxa uu soo xigtay qiyaaso ay sameysay Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay ee Yareynta Khatarta Musiibooyinka, kuwaas oo sheegaya in hal dollar oo lagu bixiyo tallaabooyinka ka hortagga, kaabeyaasha adkeysiga leh ama waxqabadka hore uu mustaqbalka badbaadin karo inta u dhexeysa saddex ilaa 15 dollar oo ku bixi lahaa khasaaraha iyo gurmadka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan sii ahaan karin dal ay beesha caalamku mar walba lacag ku bixiso cawaaqibka colaadaha, iyadoo maalgelin yar la siinayo nabad-dhisidda. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay inaan habbooneyn in sanad walba dhaqaale badan lagu bixiyo gurmadka xaaladaha bani’aadannimo, iyadoo aan si ku filan loo maalgelin awoodda bulshada iyo dowladda ee ay kaga hortagi karaan dhibaatooyinka soo noqnoqda. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in dhismaha hay’ado dowladeed oo xooggan uu muhiim u yahay beddelidda nidaamkaas. Dowladda ayaa hadda fulineysa Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka, iyadoo sidoo kale dadaal ugu jirta xoojinta maamulka maaliyadda dowladda, kordhinta dakhliga gudaha iyo dhismaha awoodda hay’adaha qaranka. Hadalka Xasan Sheekh ayaa muujinaya in dowladda Soomaaliya ay dooneyso xiriir cusub oo ay la yeelato Qaramada Midoobay marka uu soo dhammaado howlgalka siyaasadeed ee UNTMIS — xiriir ay taageerada caalamiga ah sii socoto, balse hay’adaha Soomaalidu ay door weyn ku yeeshaan go’aaminta sida loo qorsheeyo loona fuliyo barnaamijyada dalka. items.title: Sucuudiga oo waxbarashada iskuullada u badelay hab fogaan arag xaalad ammaan awgeed
items.description: Iskuullada ku yaalla caasimadda Sacuudiga ee Riyadh ayaa muddo hal toddobaad ah u wareegaya waxbarashada fog, iyadoo go’aanka lagu sababeeyay xaaladda amni ee gobolka oo sii kacsanaysa. Sida ay sheegtay wakaaladda wararka AFP , mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga ayaa amray in iskuullada caasimadda la xiro toddobaadka soo socda, iyadoo ardayda iyo macallimiinta waxbarashada ku sii wadan doonaan habka internetka. Go’aankan ayaa yimid xilli xiisadaha gobolka ay sare u kaceen, taas oo keentay in la qaado tallaabooyin dheeraad ah oo lagu ilaalinayo amniga iyo badqabka shacabka, gaar ahaan ardayda iyo shaqaalaha waxbarashada. Hay’adaha ay khusayso ayaa la filayaa inay qiimeeyaan xaaladda amni inta lagu guda jiro muddada hal toddobaad ah, ka hor inta aan la go’aamin in waxbarashada si toos ah loogu soo celiyo fasallada ama loo sii wado habka fog. Tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaysa sida xiisadaha amni ee gobolka ay u saameyn karaan adeegyada bulshada iyo nolol-maalmeedka dadka, iyadoo waxbarashada fog loo adeegsanayo sidii loo sii wadi lahaa waxbarashada iyada oo aan ardayda loo gelin khatar amni.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay is mari-waaga ka taagan doorashada Hirshabelle
items.description: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa isku diyaarinaya inay 30-ka bishan doorasho qof iyo cod ah ka qabtaan Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Shabellaha Dhexe, xilli xaaladda Gobolka Hiiraan ay kacsan tahay. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa riixeysa in doorashada ay waqtigeeda ku qabsoomto, xilli khilaaf iyo kacdoon siyaasadeed oo xoogan uu ka jiro mid ka mid ah labada gobol ee Hirshabelle. Bannaanbax ballaaran oo lagu diidan yahay maamulka iyo doorashada madaxtinimada Hirshabelle ayaa Khamiistii ruxay Magaalada Beledweyne. Siyaasiyiinta, odayaasha iyo waxgaradka dadka gobolka ayaa ka soo horjeeda musharaxnimada iyo dib-u-doorashada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe), iyagoo ku doodaya in aysan doorashadaasi ahayn mid loo dhan yahay oo heshiis lagu yahay. Xildhibaanada laga soo doorto Gobolka Hiiraan oo dibadbaxayaasha kula hadlay Beledweyne ayaa ku baaqay in la tixgeliyo tabashada ay qabaan dadka deegaanka, isla-markaana aan la marin habaabin aayahooda siyaasadeed. Siyaasiyiinta iyo odayaasha gobolka ayaa dalbanaya in laga heshiiyo amaba is bedel lagu sameeyo hoggaanka sare ee Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle, halka Villa Somalia ay ka shaqeynayso in doorashada loo sii wado, sida uu qorshuhu yahay. Magaalada Jowhar iyo deegaano kale oo ka tirsan Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe ayaa waxaa ka socda qaban-qaabo loogu diyaargaroobayo maalinta codbixinta oo ku beegan Arbacada, halka jewi ka duwan uu ka jiro bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Xuseen Sheekh Maxamuud, Xoghayaha Guud ee Urur Siyaasadeedka JSP ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu hoggaamiyo iyo wafdi uu horkacayo ayaa gelinkii dambe ee Sabtidii gaaray Magaalada Jowhar, wuxuuna sheegay in safarkooda uu la xiriiro dardargelinta ololaha doorashada. Xuseen Sheekh ayaa dadka reer Hirshabelle kuwooda qaatay kaarka codbixinta ugu baaqay inay maalinta doorashada soo baxaan, isla-markaana ay codkooda siiyaan xubnaha ka sharaxan JSP. Wariyeyaasha ayaa soo sheegaya in hoggaanka bulshada ee reer Hiiraan ay si weyn uga soo horjeedaan in doorasho laga qabto gobolka, iyadoo aan marka hore la gaarin heshiis siyaasadeed oo la isku raacsan yahay. Madaxweyne Kuxigeenka Hirshabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Yuusuf Dabageed) oo ku sugan Beledweyne ayaa ku adkeysanaya in aan wax doorasho ahi laga qaban karin gobolkaasi, iyadoo aan la helin is afgarad dhex mara dhinacyada isku haya siyaasadda Hirshabelle. Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in siyaasiyiinta iyo odayaasha ku sugan Beledweyne ay qorsheynayaan in ay soo bandhigaan cudud ciidan, oo ay ugu talagaleen in lagaga hortago doorashada lagu kala qaybsan yahay. Tani ayaa khatar gelin karta in doorasho nabdoon oo xasilloon laga qabto Degmooyinka Gobolka Hiiraan ee horey loo sheegay inay doorashadu ka dhaceyso. Guddiga Doorashooyinka ayaa sheegay in doorashadan si isku sidkan loogu tartami doono Kuraasta Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo kuwa Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Hirshabelle.

items.title: Haweenaydii 10’aad ee maydkeeda laga helay
items.description: Booliiska Koonfur Afrika ayaa sheegay inay meyd kale ka heleen xaafad ka tirsan Johannesburg, taasoo tirada haweenka halkaas meydkooda laga helay bilihii u dambeeyay ka dhigaysa toban. Meydka ayaa la helay subaxnimadii Sabtida, waxaana aqoonsaday saaxiib ay fiidkii hore wada joogeen baar. Taliyaha booliiska ee deegaanka ayaa sheegay in ciidamadiisu aysan meesha ka saari karin suurtagalnimada ah in uu jiro gacan-ku dhiigle – si is-daba-joog ah u gaysanaya oo weli baxsan, isagoo xusay isku ekaanshaha ka dhexeeya 10-ka dhimasho ee ka dhacay Ekurhuleni iyo mid kale oo ka dhacay Soweto. Dilalkan ayaa dalka oo dhan ka dhaliyay caro iyo walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan baaxadda rabshadaha loo geysto haweenka dalka, kaas oo ka mid ah dalalka adduunka ugu sarreeya marka laga hadlayo rabshadaha ku salaysan jinsiga. Meydka ugu dambeeyay ayaa laga helay qabuuraha ku yaalla xaafadda Tembisa, oo waqooyi-bari kaga beegan bartamaha Johannesburg. Booliisku waxay wax yar kaddib soo saareen bayaan ay ku sheegeen in baarayaasha goobaha dambiyada ay goobta ku sugnaayeen, iyagoo ururinayay caddaymo. items.title: Wakiilka Maraykanka ee NATO oo ka hadlay diidmada Trump ee soo jeedinta Iiraan
items.description: Wakiilka Maraykanka ee NATO,Matthew Whitaker, ayaa sheegay in Donald Trump uu saxan yahay in uu diiday soo jeedintii Iran ee ahayd in muddo toddoba maalmood ah la furo Marin-biyoodka Hormuz. “Iyagu [Iran] waxay aad ugu baahan yihiin heshiis,” ayuu yiri Mr. Whitaker, isagoo xusay in Mr. Trump uu guulo badan ka gaaray go’doominta badda iyo cunaqabateennada. Waxa kale oo uu yiri: “Laakiin tallaabooyinkan aan dhammaystirnayn ama heshiisyada muuqda ee ay soo jeedinayaan si ay sumcad uga helaan masraxa caalamka sinaba looma aqbali karo.” Diblomaasiga Maraykanka ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay walaaca dadweynaha ee ku saabsan qiimaha sare ee saliidda iyo shidaalka: “Ugu dambayn, marka xaaladdan si guul leh loo xalliyo, marka dagaalladan lagu soo afjaro si waafaqsan danaha Maraykanka iyo xulafadiisa, waxaan suuqa ku arki doonnaa sahay badan oo saliid iyo gaas, waana in arrintaasi dhacdaa sida ugu dhakhsaha badan ee suurtagalka ah

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo sheegtay inay diyaar u tahay wadahadal lala yeesho Al-shabaab
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay diyaar u tahay wadahadal lala yeesho xubnaha Al-Shabaab, haddii ay kooxdaasi qaaddo tallaabo muujinaysa inay ka tanaasushay fikirka ay dowladda ku tilmaantay mid khaldan, isla markaana ay diyaar u tahay in xal nabadeed lagu raadiyo khilaafka dalka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Muadane Xamse Cabdi Barre oo wareysi siiyay mid ka mid ah telefishinnada maxalliga ah ayaa sheegay in dowladda iyo Al-Shabaab aysan hadda wax xiriir ah oo siyaasadeed ama wadahadal ah ka dhaxayn, balse waxa u dhexeeya uu yahay dagaal iyo iska horimaad hubeysan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sheegay in dowladda mar walba diyaar u tahay in la wada hadlo, haddii ay Al-Shabaab qaaddo tallaabo dhab ah oo u gogol xaaraysa wada-hadal. Wuxuu tilmaamay in saraakiil iyo xubno hore uga tirsanaa Al-Shabaab ay maanta ku biireen hay’adaha dowladda iyo ciidamada qaranka, taas oo uu sheegay inay muujinayso in dadka ka tanaasula fikirka kooxda ay heli karaan fursad ay dib ugu soo laabtaan bulshada. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha  ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dowladda ay soo dhoweynayso qof kasta oo ka tanaasula fikirka Al-Shabaab, isaga oo xusay in waddada dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo ku biirista bulshada ay u furan tahay dadka doonaya inay ka fogaadaan dagaalka. Dhanka kale, wuxuu sheegay in haddii Al-Shabaab ay ka tanaasusho waxa uu ku tilmaamay fikirkeeda xagjirka ah, isla markaana ay aqbasho nabadda iyo nidaamka dowladnimo, ay markaas suuragal noqon karto in la helo waddo wadahadal iyo xal siyaasadeed. Hadalka dowladda ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo howlgallo ciidan oo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo dhinaca kale ay dowladda marar kala duwan sheegtay inay muhiim tahay in dadka ka soo baxa kooxda loo sameeyo waddooyin ay bulshada ugu soo laaban karaan.

items.title: Askari ka tirsan ciidamada DF oo maanta lagu riday xukun adag kadib markii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa maanta dil toogasho ah ku xukumay Ex-Dable Xoogga Cabdi Aadan Ibraahim oo lagu naaneyso “Soddon”, taas oo ah qisaasta Marxuum Yuusuf Axmed Cabdi oo la sheegay inuu dilay. Sida uu warbaahinta u sheegay Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Darajada 1-aad ee CQS, Gaashaanle Sare Xasan Cali Nuur Shuute, maxkamaddu waxay waqti ku filan siisay dhinacyada dacwadda, ka hor inta aysan soo saarin xukunka. Cabdi Aadan Ibraahim “Soddon” ayaa lagu eedeeyey dilka Marxuum Yuusuf Axmed Cabdi oo ahaa muwaadin ku shaqeysta xirfadda dhismaha guryaha ee Faryaamo. Marxuumka ayaa xilliga la dilayay saarnaa Mooto Bajaaj uu kireystay, si uu u gaaro hoygiisa, maadaama ay ahayd xilli galab ah oo uu kasoo baxay shaqadiisa. Eedeysane Soddon oo waddada xaafadda Iga-daba-geey ee degmada Garsabaaleey u taagnaa Mooto Bajaaj uu raaco ayaa joojiyey Bajaajtii uu saarnaa marxuumka, qaab u eg awood sheegasho ayuuna ula hadlay, si loo sii qaado. Waxaa loo sheegay in aan la qaadi karin, maadaama aysan isku jiho u socon. Jawaabta eedeysanaha ayaa noqotay inuu hakiyo Bajaajta, kadibna ku handado inuu ka shakiyey, isla markaana ay tahay in la hubiyo. Muran kadib, eedeysanaha ayaa riday labo xabbadood oo rasaas ah, mid dhulka ku dhacday halka tan kalena caloosha ka haleeshay Marxuum Yuusuf Axmed Cabdi oo ahaa kireystihii Mootada. Marxuumka ayaa isla goobtaasi ku geeriyooday. Falka ayaa dhacay 26-kii bishii July ee sanadkan 2026. Eedeysanaha oo isku dayey inuu baxsado ayaa ku dhuuntay geedka Soomaalidu u taqaano Cali-garoobka oo ku yaalla meel aan ka fogeyn goobta uu falka ka dhacay. Balse dad shacab ah ayaa ciidamada ammaanka u tilmaamay halka uu ku jiray, sidaas ayayna ciidamada ugu suuragashay inay gacanta ku dhigaan. Baaris dheer kadib, Xafiiska Xeer Ilaalinta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa codsaday qaadista kiiskan, waxaana laga oggolaaday 16-kii bishan September. Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa ugu dambeyn maanta soo saartay xukunka dilka toogashada ah, kaas oo ah qisaasta Marxuum Yuusuf Axmed Cabdi. items.title: Ugu yaraan 11 qof oo ku dhintay Qarax ka dhacay bar kontorool oo booliis oo ku taalla pakistand
items.description: Ugu yaraan 11 qof ayaa ku dhintay, 20 kalena way ku dhaawacmeen qarax Sabtidii ka dhacay bar kontorool oo ay ciidamada booliisku ku leeyihiin waqooyi-galbeed dalka Pakistan. Qaraxa ayaa ka dhacay Dera Ismail Khan , oo ku dhow xadka ay wadaagaan gobollada Khyber Pakhtunkhwa iyo Balochistan, sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiin maxalli ah oo uu soo xigtay wargeyska Dawn . Hay’adda gurmadka ee Rescue 1122 ayaa sheegtay in dadka ku dhintay qaraxa ay ka mid ahaayeen siddeed nin, laba haween ah iyo hal cunug . Kooxaha gurmadka ayaa weli ka waday goobta hawlgallo samatabbixin ah, iyagoo burburka hoostiisa ka raadinayay dad waxyeelloobay. Booliiska ayaa sheegay in dadka dhaawacmay ay ku jiraan saraakiil booliis, shaqaale ka tirsan waaxda canshuuraha iyo laba qof oo rayid ah. Kooxo ku takhasusay baadhista iyo baabi’inta walxaha qarxa ayaa gaaray goobta, iyagoo bilaabay baaritaanka sababta qaraxa iyo nooca walxaha loo adeegsaday. Bar kontoroolka uu qaraxu ka dhacay ayaa muhiim u ah howlaha ammaanka, waxaana ciidamada halkaas jooga ay hubiyaan dadka iyo gaadiidka isticmaala waddada isku xirta Dera Ismail Khan iyo Quetta . Ilaa hadda ma jirto cid si rasmi ah u sheegatay mas’uuliyadda qaraxa, waxaana socda baaritaanno lagu ogaanayo cidda ka dambeysay iyo ujeeddada weerarka.

items.title: Ciidanka Asluubta oo iyana la dejiyay duleedka Magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed ayaa ku biiray Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ee fariisimaha ku leh darafyada Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar oo tan iyo 12-kii bishan ku sugan Baydhabo uu qoryaha boobeyaasha u qaybiyay askar ka tirsan Ciidanka Asluubta, isla-markaana loo daabulay meelaha laga soo galo xaafadaha Towfiiq iyo Suuqa Xoolaha ee magaaladaasi oo fariisimo cusub ay ka sameysteen. Ciidamadan ayaa waxaa la sheegay in isku goob la dejiyay ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo Ciidanka Asluubta ay yihiin ciidamo si gaar ah u qaabilsan ilaalinta xabsiyada iyo maxaabiista ku xiran. “Waxaa go’aan lagu gaaray in Ciidamada Asluubta ay ka qayb qaataan difaaca magaalada, taasaa keentay in la geeyo meelaha laga soo galo magaalada.” Ayuu yiri Sarkaal ka tirsan Saraakiisha Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. “Hub iyo rasaas fiican ayaa dhowr cisho ka hor la siiyay Ciidamada Asluubta, waxayna hadda isku aag ka hawlgalaan ciidamo kale oo ka tirsan Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed.” Ayuu sii raaciyay Sarkaalkan oo Universaltv la hadlay, isla-markaana codsaday inaanan magaciisa Warbaahinta loo adeegsan. General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa Baydhabo u jooga xoojinta amniga magaalada, iskuna dubarido hawlgalo ka dhan ah maleeshiyada Al Shabaab iyo ciidamada u daacadda ah Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Dowladda Federaalka iyo Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen ku eedeeyay in ay ku milmeen maleeshiyada Shabaabka, inkastoo Laftagareen iyo siyaasiyiinta deegaanka ee ku aragtida ah ay eedeymahaasi beeniyeen.

items.title: Fahad Yasin Condemns Cuts to Benefits for Somalia’s Fallen Soldiers and Veterans
items.description: Former Intelligence Chief Says Reductions Send a “Deeply Disappointing” Message to Those Who Sacrificed Their Lives and Health for the State Mogadishu (WDN) — Former National Intelligence and Security Agency chief Fahad Yasin has sharply condemned what he says is a decision by Somalia’s Federal Government to reduce financial benefits for military retirees, soldiers disabled in service and families of fallen members of the armed forces. In a lengthy statement addressed directly to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and his administration, Fahad described the reported reductions as deeply disappointing and warned that they risk undermining confidence in the state among the very people who have sacrificed most for it. Fahad published the statement on his Facebook page under the title “ A Statement to President Hassan and His Administration.” He argued that the issue did not begin with the latest decision, saying there had previously been complaints about the treatment of vulnerable members of the Somali armed forces, particularly families of fallen soldiers, disabled personnel and retirees. He warned that further reductions in their financial support could reinforce a perception that those who gave their lives, health and working years to Somalia are being neglected rather than protected and honoured by the state. A Question of Law and Accountability Fahad’s criticism comes as the Federal Government has established a legal framework governing the care of orphans of fallen soldiers, disabled personnel and retired members of the Somali Armed Forces. The government issued Regulation No. 198 governing the agency responsible for those groups in March 2026, with the regulation subsequently published in the government’s official bulletin in August. Fahad argued that any decision affecting their financial rights should therefore be supported by a clear legal basis, transparent procedures and accountability. He challenged President Hassan Sheikh and his administration to explain publicly: the legal basis for the reported reductions; who authorized the decision; the legal authority under which it was implemented; and why the financial burden was being placed on what he described as the most vulnerable members of the armed forces. Without such an explanation, Fahad said, serious questions could arise over whether the decision is consistent with the laws and regulations intended to protect the rights of fallen soldiers, disabled personnel and retirees. “This Is More Than a Financial Decision” The former intelligence chief expressed particular disappointment at the prospect of reducing payments to families left behind by soldiers who died serving the country. He argued that such payments should not be treated as charity. The families of fallen soldiers, he said, have a claim on the state because their relatives made the ultimate sacrifice in Somalia’s service. Disabled soldiers, meanwhile, paid for their service with their health and physical abilities. “The martyrs gave the nation the most precious thing a human being possesses — their lives,” Fahad said. He argued that the children and widows of fallen soldiers should therefore not have to regard government assistance as a favour. Instead, he said, it should be understood as an obligation arising from the sacrifices made by those who died defending the country. What Message Does This Send to Soldiers? Fahad’s most pointed argument concerns the effect of the reported reductions on serving troops. He asked how a soldier currently fighting on the front lines could be expected to make the ultimate sacrifice for the country if the message from the state is that his family could later see its support reduced. He argued that an effective military depends not only on weapons and training but also on trust. If that confidence is weakened, he warned, one of the foundations of the national armed forces is also weakened. Fahad’s closing message was therefore directed not only at the government but at the principle of national responsibility itself: Those who died defending Somalia cannot defend themselves today. The state they died for must therefore become their voice, their protection and the guardian of the families they left behind. For Fahad Yasin, reducing their support is not merely a budgetary decision. It is a test of what Somalia believes it owes to those who sacrificed everything for the country. items.title: Future Council Draws the Line as Somalia’s Opposition Hardens
items.description: Puntland, Jubaland and Salvation Forum Bloc Says It Recognizes Farmaajo as an Opposition Figure Aligned with Its Position Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s Future Council has drawn a sharper political distinction within the country’s opposition movement, saying it recognizes former President Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed “Farmaajo” as an opposition figure aligned with its political position, while rejecting claims that certain former members of the Salvation Forum still belong to its opposition camp. The statement, made by Mohamed Abdirahman Dhabancad, a member of the Future Council’s technical committee, specifically distinguished Farmaajo from former members of the Salvation Forum who now participate in election-related meetings with international partners. Dhabancad accused those politicians of maintaining links with Villa Somalia — an allegation that has not been independently established. The distinction is politically significant. The Future Council is positioning itself as a principal opposition bloc, while making clear that not every politician who once belonged to the wider opposition movement is considered part of its current camp. The Council brings together Puntland and Jubaland with opposition figures from the Salvation Forum and has taken its political dispute with the Federal Government to the UN Security Council. Puntland and Jubaland at the Core The Future Council combines the leadership of Puntland and Jubaland with prominent national opposition figures, giving the bloc a political reach beyond Mogadishu. Its appeal to the UN Security Council for international engagement over Somalia’s electoral deadlock has further elevated its role in the national political confrontation. Farmaajo’s Distinct Position The former Puntland Minister, Dhabancad’s reference to Farmaajo is notable because the former president is not being described as a formal member of the Future Council. Rather, the Council says it considers him an opposition figure whose political position is aligned with its broader challenge to the Federal Government. That distinction places Farmaajo in a different category from the former Salvation Forum members whom the Council now accuses of being too closely associated with Villa Somalia. No Deal with Mogadishu Dhabancad also rejected suggestions that the Future Council and the Federal Government are currently negotiating an electoral agreement. He said the two sides have held discussions in the past but remain divided over the fundamental issues surrounding the next election.His message was blunt: there is no agreement and no political breakthrough between the two sides. The dispute remains centred on the electoral framework, constitutional changes and who should determine the rules for Somalia’s next national election. The Battle Over Who Speaks for the Opposition The latest statement underscores a broader struggle within Somalia’s opposition movement over who represents the principal opposition camp and who should have a seat at negotiations over the country’s political future. The Future Council is seeking to establish itself as a central opposition negotiating bloc, backed by Puntland and Jubaland and supported by prominent national political figures. Its recognition of Farmaajo as an aligned opposition figure — while excluding other former Salvation Forum members — further clarifies the political boundaries it is drawing. For now, Dhabancad’s central message is clear: The Future Council says there is no electoral deal with Mogadishu, no breakthrough has been reached, and the political deadlock remains unresolved. items.title: Tigray Cut Off Again as Communications Blackout Deepens Civilian Misery
items.description: Internet and Phone Disruptions Leave Millions Struggling to Access Money, Information and Essential Services as Fighting Returns Mekelle (WDN) — Tigray is once again being pushed into isolation. Internet and telephone services have been severely disrupted across the northern Ethiopian region following the latest outbreak of fighting, cutting millions of people off from essential communications at precisely the moment they most need them. State-owned Ethio Telecom services have been completely disrupted, while the smaller Safaricom network has reportedly remained partially operational. Internet-monitoring group NetBlocks confirmed a regional disruption affecting northern Tigray. The consequences are potentially devastating. Tigray is already facing a severe shortage of cash. Duke Burbridge, an American humanitarian worker in Mekelle, told the BBC that residents had struggled for months to access cash and ATMs, warning that the loss of telecommunications could be “devastating for everybody.” For millions of people increasingly dependent on digital banking and mobile-money services, an internet shutdown is not simply an inconvenience. It can mean being unable to access money, contact relatives, obtain information, conduct business or reach help. A Region Cut Off at the Worst Possible Moment The blackout comes as fighting between Tigrayan forces and Ethiopia’s federal military has sharply escalated, raising fears that the region could again descend into a wider war. That makes the communications disruption particularly alarming. When fighting intensifies, civilians need reliable access to information. Families need to know whether relatives are safe. Hospitals and humanitarian organizations need communications. Journalists need to document events. Aid agencies need to assess needs and reach vulnerable communities. A communications blackout makes all of that harder. It also creates an information vacuum in which abuses can become harder to document and verify. Tigray Has Seen This Before The fear in Tigray is not simply theoretical. During the 2020–2022 war, the region was subjected to prolonged communications and internet restrictions. A UN investigation later documented the suspension of internet, telecommunications and banking services and described how those measures contributed to severe humanitarian consequences. Human Rights Watch previously warned that a complete communications shutdown affecting millions of people in Tigray during armed conflict could cause extensive civilian harm and, depending on the circumstances, potentially constitute collective punishment. It also stressed that communications restrictions must satisfy requirements of necessity and proportionality under international law. That history makes the latest blackout particularly disturbing. Who Ordered the Shutdown? The responsibility for the latest disruption remains contested. Reuters reported that several sources attributed the shutdown to Tigray’s ruling authorities, while a source close to the Tigray People’s Liberation Front denied responsibility and blamed the federal government. Ethiopian federal authorities, Ethio Telecom and Safaricom had not immediately responded to Reuters’ requests for comment. That dispute matters.  A communications blackout imposed during an armed conflict should not be treated as an ordinary technical failure. Whoever ordered or enabled it must be held accountable for its consequences. Millions Should Not Become Hostages to a War The people of Tigray have already endured years of war, displacement, hunger and the destruction of essential infrastructure. They should not now be forced to live through another communications blackout while armed forces fight around them. Cutting civilians off from the outside world does not make them combatants. It makes them more vulnerable. If authorities deliberately shut down communications across a civilian population without a lawful, necessary and proportionate justification, international human-rights standards raise serious concerns about freedom of expression, access to information and other fundamental rights. UN experts have previously condemned broad internet shutdowns as disproportionate measures. The International Community Cannot Look Away The international community should demand immediate clarification over who ordered the shutdown, why it was imposed and how long it is intended to continue. Independent humanitarian access and communications should be protected. Journalists and human-rights monitors should be able to document what is happening. And civilians should not be deprived of basic communications simply because fighting has returned to their region. Tigray has already experienced what happens when an entire population is cut off from the world. The lesson from the previous war should be clear: communications are not a luxury during conflict. They are a lifeline. Whether the latest blackout was ordered by federal authorities, regional authorities or resulted from competing wartime actions, civilians should not pay the price. Tigray’s people have suffered enough. They should not be silenced again. WardheerNews The post Tigray Cut Off Again as Communications Blackout Deepens Civilian Misery appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Xog ay baahisay warbaahinta Ciraaq oo si weyn u beenisay sheegashadii Puntland
items.description: Baghdad (Caasimada Online) – Qiyaastii 40 nin oo ka tirsan qabiil kasoo jeeda koonfurta dalka Ciraaq ayaa la sheegay inay ka qeyb qaateen howlgal hubeysan oo lagu soo furtay markab shidaal oo burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ay afduubteen, dhacdo si weyn looga hadal hayo warbaahinta iyo baraha bulshada ee Ciraaq. Ragga ayaa ka tirsan qabiilka Al-Shaghanba ee gobolka Basra, waxaana hoggaamiye qabiil uu sheegay in ay u dhaqaaqeen sidii ay gacanta burcad-badeedda uga soo celin lahaayeen markabka oo uu lahaa nin kasoo jeeda isla qabiilka. Sheekh Cali al-Shaghanbi ayaa wakaaladda wararka Ciraaq ee Shafaq News u sheegay in markabka lagu qabsaday Gacanka Cadmeed, iyadoo burcad-badeeddu ay haysteen shaqaalihii saarnaa, kadibna ay dalbadeen lacag madax-furasho ah. Sida uu sheegay Sheekh Cali, ku dhowaad 40 nin oo kasoo jeeda degmada Abu al-Khasib iyo tuulada Jikour ee gobolka Basra ayaa abaabulay howlgalka, iyagoo xiriir iyo isku-duwid la sameeyay dhinacyo ka baxsan Ciraaq. Howlgalka ayaa ugu dambeyn lagu soo furtay markabka iyo shaqaalihii la socday, waxaana la qabtay toddobo nin oo lagu eedeeyay burcad-badeednimo, halka kuwo kale ay baxsadeen, sida uu sheegay hoggaamiyaha qabiilka. Muuqaallo lagu faafiyay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinaya rag hub culus sita oo la sheegay inay yihiin xubnaha qabiilka Ciraaqiga ah, kuwaas oo ku jira iska horimaad ka dhacay badda. Warbaahinta Ciraaq ayaa sheegtay in dagaalka lagu soo furtay markabka uu socday dhowr saacadood, inkastoo aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin dhammaan faahfaahinta muuqaallada la baahiyay. Warbaahinta Ciraaq ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in howlgalka uu dhacay kadib markii markabka muddo ku dhow bil uu gacanta ugu jiray burcad-badeedda. Sheegashada Puntland Dhacdadan ayaa waxaa barbar socda warar kale oo sheegaya in ciidamada Puntland ay door weyn ka qaateen soo furashada markabka. Markabka, oo lagu magacaabo Sibu 1 , ayaa la afduubtay bishii Agoosto, isla markaana howlgalka lagu soo furtay lala kaashaday mas’uuliyiinta Puntland. Sida warbixintaas lagu sheegay, Puntland ayaa horraantii toddobaadka billowday daba-galka markabkan iyo saddex markab oo kale oo burcad-badeeddu ku haysteen meel u dhow degmada Bandar Beyla. Ilo amni ayaa sheegay in Sibu 1 markii dambe lagu helay meel koonfur ka xigta Garacad, halkaas oo markab ay leeyihiin ciidamada Puntland uu jidgooyo badeed u dhigay, taasoo lama filaan ku noqotay kooxihii haystay markabka. Dhanka kale, bayaan loo nisbeeyay qabiilka Al-Shaghanba ayaa sheegay in howlgalka uu dhacay kadib “xiriir, isku-duwid iyo oggolaansho” ay ka heleen dowladda Soomaaliya. Wararka kale ayaa si gaar ah u xusaya maamulka Puntland, mana cadda heerka ay dhinacyada kala duwan mid walba uga qeyb qaateen howlgalka. Saddex markab oo kale — Honor 25, MT Eureka iyo MT Asana — ayaa wararku sheegayaan inay weli gacanta ugu jiraan kooxo burcad-badeed ah, kuwaas oo u dhaqaaqay dhanka xeebaha Hobyo ee gobolka Mudug. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli mar kale ay sare u kacayaan falalka burcad-badeednimada ee xeebaha Soomaaliya, kadib sanado ay aad u yaraayeen weerarrada noocan ah. Ilo amni ayaa sheegay in Sibu 1 markii dambe lagu helay meel koonfur ka xigta Garacad, halkaas oo markab ay leeyihiin ciidamada Puntland uu jidgooyo badeed u dhigay, taasoo lama filaan ku noqotay kooxihii haystay markabka. Dhanka kale, bayaan loo nisbeeyay qabiilka Al-Shaghanba ayaa sheegay in howlgalka uu dhacay kadib “xiriir, isku-duwid iyo oggolaansho” ay ka heleen dowladda Soomaaliya. Wararka kale ayaa si gaar ah u xusaya maamulka Puntland, mana cadda heerka ay dhinacyada kala duwan mid walba uga qeyb qaateen howlgalka. Saddex markab oo kale — Honor 25, MT Eureka iyo MT Asana — ayaa wararku sheegayaan inay weli gacanta ugu jiraan kooxo burcad-badeed ah, kuwaas oo u dhaqaaqay dhanka xeebaha Hobyo ee gobolka Mudug. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli mar kale ay sare u kacayaan falalka burcad-badeednimada ee xeebaha Soomaaliya, kadib sanado ay aad u yaraayeen weerarrada noocan ah. items.title: Kulan looga hadlayay amniga Muqdisho oo ka dhacay Xarunta Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Raysal Wasaaraha Somaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa caawa booqday Xarunta Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ee Magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu ku shir guddoomiyay kulan looga hadlayay amniga Caasimadda Muqdisho. Kulanka ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi, Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil Fartaag, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska, General Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, Taliyaha Ciidanka Badda, Admiral Cabdiwahaab Cabdullaahi Cumar, Agaasimaha Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda & Sirdoonka Qaranka (NISA), Mahad Maxamed Salaad, Gudoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) iyo masuuliyiin kale. Raysal Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa sidoo kale xaruntaasi kaga qaybgalay munaasabad lagu maamuusayay Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, kuwaas oo uu uga mahadceliyay doorkooda sugidda amniga caasimadda iyo guud ahaan dalka. Raysal Wasaaraha ayaa ciidamada ku amaanay guulaha ay ka gaareen xaqiijinta amniga magaala madaxda dalka ee Muqdisho. Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa la tilmaamaa in ay wax weyn ka qabatay amniga Muqdisho, dhowrkii sano ee u dambeeyay. Ciidamo isku dhaf ah ayaa bishii April ee sanadkii 2023 lagu wareejiyay howlaha sugidda amniga ee magaalada. Xoogagan oo isugu jira Ciidamada Booliska, Nabad Sugidda Gobolka Banaadir iyo Polizia Militare ayaa ku guuleystay in ay wax ka bedelaan muuqaalkii amniga magaalada.
