items.title: Hassan Sheikh’s Democratic Bubble and Somalia’s Dangerous Political Reality
items.description: By Abdullahi A. Nor President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s message to the United Nations reveals what may be the central contradiction of Somalia’s current political crisis. He wants the international community to support Somalia’s democratic transition — but he also appears to want the international community to accept the Federal Government’s definition of that transition without challenging the political process through which it is being pursued. That is not how democracy works. In his address to the UN General Assembly, Hassan Sheikh called on the United Nations and Somalia’s international partners to support constitutional reform, democratic institutions and the transition toward direct elections. He then emphasized that Somalia’s democratic transformation must remain “owned” and led by Somalis. On the surface, that sounds entirely reasonable. But there is a much harder question underneath it: Which Somalis? If the Federal Government and the principal opposition forces cannot agree on the electoral rules, constitutional changes or the administration of the next election, then it is difficult to argue that there is already a national Somali consensus behind the government’s approach. The President Appears to Be Living Inside a Political Bubble The most troubling feature of Hassan Sheikh’s position is not his stated commitment to direct elections. Somalia needs credible elections. It needs stronger institutions. It needs constitutional government. The problem is the apparent assumption that the government’s preferred route toward those objectives should automatically become the country’s route. That is where the president risks becoming trapped inside a political bubble. From within Villa Somalia, constitutional amendments may look like institutional reform, direct elections may look like democratic progress and government-led electoral preparations may appear to be the natural path forward. Outside that bubble, however, Somalia looks very different. Puntland and Jubaland have sharply disagreed with Mogadishu. Opposition leaders have rejected important aspects of the government’s political approach. The Somali Future Council has taken the dispute to the UN Security Council and called for international mediation. These are not minor disagreements. They concern the fundamental rules by which political power will be acquired and transferred. Who Owns Somali Democracy? Hassan Sheikh’s insistence on “Somali ownership” raises an obvious question. Does Somali ownership mean that the Federal Government in Mogadishu owns the process? If so, that is not national ownership. Somalia is a federal country. Its political legitimacy cannot simply be reduced to the preferences of the government sitting in the capital. Puntland is Somali. Jubaland is Somali. Hirshabelle is Somali. Galmudug is Somali and South West State is Somali. Opposition leaders, political parties, civil society and ordinary citizens are also Somali.If these constituencies disagree over the rules of the political system, their disagreement cannot be erased by declaring the process nationally owned. Ownership requires participation . And participation requires compromise. The UN Is Not Somalia’s Political Enemy There is also something deeply uncomfortable about telling the international community to support Somalia while simultaneously attempting to define the limits of what that support should mean. Somalia has relied on international partners for decades. The United Nations and other international institutions have supported humanitarian operations, state-building, security institutions, elections, constitutional processes and political dialogue. Somalia’s international partners are not strangers arriving at the gates of a fully functioning state. They have been part of Somalia’s survival. That does not mean foreigners should govern Somalia. It means international partners have a legitimate interest in ensuring that political agreements are inclusive, credible and capable of preventing renewed conflict. If Somali leaders cannot reach such an agreement themselves, asking international partners to facilitate dialogue is not a surrender of sovereignty. It is political realism. The Future Council’s Appeal Cannot Simply Be Ignored The appeal by the Somali Future Council to the UN Security Council should therefore not be dismissed as merely another opposition complaint. It represents a fundamentally different interpretation of Somalia’s political crisis. The coalition is arguing that the dispute requires external mediation precisely because the Somali political leadership has been unable to reach an agreement on the electoral framework. Whether one agrees with the Future Council’s proposals or not, its appeal demonstrates that the country’s political crisis has reached a point where international attention is being sought by major Somali actors themselves. That reality should force the president to reconsider the meaning of “Somali ownership.” If Somali political leaders are asking the UN to help them negotiate, the answer should not be to tell the UN to remain on the sidelines. Direct Elections Are Not the Entire Democratic Project Hassan Sheikh presents direct elections as the centrepiece of Somalia’s democratic transformation. But elections alone do not create democracy. The rules must be agreed. The institutions must be trusted. The opposition must have meaningful political space. Federal states must have confidence in the constitutional order. And the losing side must believe that the election was sufficiently legitimate to accept the result. Otherwise, direct elections can become another source of conflict rather than a solution to Somalia’s political crisis. The real democratic achievement would therefore not simply be putting ballots into boxes. It would be creating a political system in which the major Somali stakeholders accept the rules before the voting begins. The President Cannot Dictate Consensus This is where Hassan Sheikh’s position ultimately faces its greatest test. A president can propose constitutional reform. He can advocate direct elections. He can ask international partners for assistance. But he cannot manufacture national consensus by presidential declaration. Nor can he decide unilaterally which Somali political actors deserve to participate in determining the country’s political future. That is the essence of democratic politics. The president’s mandate gives him authority to govern. It does not give him ownership of Somalia’s political future. Somalia needs the International Community — and the International Community needs to be honest. The country remains dependent on international support in ways that cannot simply be wished away. Its security institutions require external assistance. Its humanitarian system depends heavily on international funding. Its political institutions continue to receive international support. It is unrealistic to tell the international community: finance us, protect us and support us — but do not question our political process . International partners should respect Somali sovereignty. But respect for sovereignty does not require silence in the face of political deadlock. Nor should international engagement mean imposing solutions on Somalia. The proper role is mediation, facilitation and support for agreements reached by Somalis themselves. The Choice Before Hassan Sheikh Hassan Sheikh now has an opportunity to demonstrate whether his commitment to democracy means more than direct elections. He can continue along a government-led path and insist that the international community simply support it. Or he can recognize that Somalia’s democratic transition requires something more difficult: political compromise.That means sitting with opponents. Listening to federal member states. Reconsidering disputed constitutional changes. Negotiating the electoral rules. And allowing the international community to help when Somali political leaders cannot resolve their differences alone. That would not weaken Somali ownership. It would demonstrate it. Somalia does not need a president who believes he can dictate the terms of consensus. It needs political leaders capable of building consensus even when they do not control the room. The UN cannot save Somalia from Somali political disagreements. But neither should Somalia’s leaders demand that the UN look away while those disagreements threaten to deepen the country’s political divisions. The future of Somali democracy cannot belong to one president, one government or one political camp. It must belong to Somalia. Abdullahi A. items.title: City Under Fire: Baidoa’s Civilians Pay the Price
items.description: Baidoa (WDN) — Baidoa is being pushed into an increasingly intolerable humanitarian and security crisis as fighting between forces aligned with Somalia’s Federal Government and supporters of former South West President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen continues to expose civilians to artillery, airstrikes and armed confrontation. What makes the situation particularly alarming is the reported use of increasingly sophisticated military capabilities in what remains, at its core, a political dispute over who governs South West State. Laftagareen has appealed to the United States, the United Nations, European Union, African Union and IGAD, urging international actors to condemn what he describes as a military assault on South West State and to launch an independent investigation into the reported air operations. Baidoa’s Civilians Caught in a Political War In his appeal, Laftagareen said federal military operations against his administration and its supporters had continued for approximately six months, with aerial operations intensifying during the past two months. He alleged that aircraft, including F16, had been used in operations around Baidoa and claimed that civilians and livestock had been killed. Those claims have not been independently verified. But the broader civilian danger is no longer theoretical. Fighting around Baidoa in recent weeks has already caused casualties and forced residents to flee their homes. The Associated Press reported that Bay Regional Hospital treated 71 wounded people, including 15 women, following fighting on September 3, while one civilian death was reported. The question is therefore becoming increasingly urgent: how much military force can be used in a political confrontation before the civilian population pays the price? Drones and F-16s Raise the Stakes The most serious allegations concern the reported use of drones and F-16 fighter aircraft. Laftagareen’s office has accused Türkiye-linked military capabilities of being used in strikes around Baidoa and in Doolow, including an attack on the residence of former Somali Correctional Service Commander General Mahad Abdirahman Aden, known as General Shub. The former Southwest administration alleged that an F-16 was involved in the Doolow operation and accused the Federal Government of directing the attack. Those allegations remain unproven. Somalia’s Federal Government denied involvement in the Doolow incident and said preliminary information suggested that explosions at the residence may have resulted from explosives being prepared inside the house. The government said it would establish a fact-finding committee to investigate the incident. That competing account makes an independent investigation all the more important. When Military Power Enters a Political Dispute The central concern is not simply whether Somalia possesses modern military aircraft or armed drones. It is where and why such weapons are being used. Drones and fighter aircraft are designed for military operations against armed threats. Their use in densely populated areas during a political confrontation carries a fundamentally different level of risk. Baidoa is not an empty battlefield. It is a major urban centre and humanitarian hub, home to large numbers of civilians and displaced people. Recent fighting has already disrupted civilian life and humanitarian operations. If advanced air power is being used against forces aligned with one political faction in a dispute over regional authority, the consequences extend beyond the immediate targets. Homes, markets, roads, businesses and families can all become exposed to the conflict. That is why the alleged use of F-16s and armed drones should be treated as a red-line issue for civilian protection, regardless of which political side is responsible. The Conflict Has a Political Origin At the heart of the crisis is not an external invasion or a conventional war between two states. It is a dispute over political authority, legitimacy and the future leadership of Southwest State. Federal forces took control of Baidoa in March, after which Laftagareen resigned. A new Southwest administration was subsequently established with federal backing. Fighting involving forces loyal to Laftagareen has since repeatedly challenged that political settlement. That context matters. When the underlying dispute is political, escalating the military response can deepen rather than resolve the disagreement. Every additional airstrike risks creating new grievances, displacement and demands for retaliation. The result could be a cycle in which a political disagreement increasingly acquires the characteristics of an armed conflict. An International Investigation Is Now Essential Laftagareen has asked international partners to investigate the reported attacks and establish responsibility. Such an investigation should examine the identity of the aircraft involved, the targets selected, the legal authority for each operation, the presence of civilians in affected areas, the chain of command and any civilian casualties or property damage. It should also establish whether military capabilities supplied or supported by foreign partners are being used consistently with their intended purpose and applicable legal obligations. No political faction should be presumed guilty before the facts are established. But neither should allegations involving civilian harm be dismissed without investigation. Baidoa Cannot Become the Battlefield for a Political Settlement Somalia’s political disputes cannot be solved from the air. If the central disagreement is about who should govern South West State, the ultimate solution must come through a political process capable of addressing competing claims of legitimacy and authority. Military aircraft may be capable of destroying positions. They cannot settle the political question that produced the confrontation in the first place. For the people of Baidoa, the immediate priority is simpler: an end to attacks, protection from further violence and the restoration of normal civilian life. The international community should therefore focus not only on who controls Baidoa, but on whether civilians are being protected while that political dispute unfolds. Because when a political crisis reaches the point where drones and fighter aircraft are reportedly being used over civilian areas, the question is no longer merely who wins the political contest. The question is how much of Baidoa will be left for civilians to return to when it is over. WardheerNews The post City Under Fire: Baidoa’s Civilians Pay the Price appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Soomaalidii ku jirtay xabsiga Guantánamo Bay oo laga soo dejiyey Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Siddeed nin oo Soomaali ah oo muddo ku dhow bil lagu hayey saldhigga ciidamada Mareykanka ee Guantánamo Bay ayaa laga soo masaafuriyey Mareykanka, iyagoo ugu dambeyn soo gaaray magaalada Muqdisho. Raggan ayaa Khamiistii ka baxay Cuba, waxayna safarkooda kusoo mareen Puerto Rico, Dakar iyo Nairobi, ka hor inta aysan diyaarad kale uga soo gudbin caasimadda Kenya una imaan Muqdisho. Adam Abdullah, oo ka mid ah ragga la soo masaafuriyey, ayaa MPR News u sheegay in markii hore ay u maleynayeen in diyaaradda ay saarnaayeen ay Guantánamo Bay u tageyso oo keliya inay shidaal qaadato, balse markii ay halkaas gaareen lagu wareejiyey xarun lagu hayo dadka ay dowladda Mareykanka u qorsheyneyso masaafurinta. Adam ayaa sheegay in ragga Soomaaliyeed ay maalintii labaad bilaabeen cunto-joojin, kaddib markii aan loo sheegin sababta halkaas loogu hayo iyo muddada ay ku sugnaan doonaan. “Waxay ahayd xaalad aad u adag,” ayuu yiri Adam. Wuxuu sidoo kale ku eedeeyey ilaalada xarunta inay garaaceen kaddib markii uu ka qeyb qaatay cunto-joojinta. “Way i garaaceen, waxayna i geliyeen qol aad u qabow si ay ragga kale u cabsi geliyaan,” ayuu Adam u sheegay MPR News. Sheegashadaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. MPR ayaa sheegtay in Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka aysan si gaar ah uga jawaabin eedeynta la xiriirta garaacista. Sagaal bilood oo xabsi ah Adam, oo 31 jir ah, ayaa Mareykanka tegay horraantii 2023, isagoo magangalyo-doon ah, waxaana loo oggolaaday inuu shaqeeyo inta dacwadiisa socdaalka ay socotay. Wuxuu ka shaqeynayey farsamada baabuurta gobolka Minnesota markii saraakiisha socdaalka Mareykanka ay xireen 12-kii December 2025. Kaddib waxaa loo kala wareejiyey xarumo ku yaalla Minnesota, Kentucky iyo Louisiana, ka hor inta aan dabayaaqadii August isaga iyo toddobo Soomaali kale loo gudbin Guantánamo Bay. Sahan Journal ayaa hore u sheegtay in garsoore socdaal uu 14-kii May amray in Adam laga masaafuriyo Mareykanka, isla markaana uusan lahayn racfaan weli socda markii loo dirayey Guantánamo. MPR ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in baaritaan ay ku sameysay diiwaannada maxkamadaha Minnesota aysan ku helin wax dambi ah oo Adam lagu helay, marka laga reebo laba ganaax oo la xiriiray meel baabuur la dhigay xilliga barafka. Adam ayaa sheegay in ragga Soomaaliyeed lagu hayey ilaalo adag, maalintii loo oggolaan jiray qiyaastii hal saac oo ay bannaanka ku qaataan, isla markaana silsilado lagu xiri jiray marka loo kaxeynayo inay telefoon isticmaalaan. Wuxuu sheegay inuu sii waday cunto-joojinta ilaa loo oggolaaday inuu la xiriiro qof ka tirsan safaaradda Soomaaliya, markaas oo uu ogaaday in la qorsheynayo in Muqdisho loo masaafuriyo. DHS oo difaacday tallaabada Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka ayaa difaacday tallaabooyinka laga qaaday ragga Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah dadka loo qaaday Guantánamo ay lahaayeen taariikh dambiyeedyo ay ka mid yihiin weerar, hub, dhac iyo dambiyo la xiriira maandooriyaha. Hase yeeshee, waaxdu ma aysan caddeyn eedeymaha gaar ahaan qof kasta lagu xiriirinayo. MPR ayaa sheegtay in dowladda Mareykanka ay siddeedda nin ku tilmaantay “kuwa ugu xun”, balse aysan soo bandhigin caddeymo muujinaya dambiyo ay raggaasi ka galeen Mareykanka ama dal kale. Adam ayaa sheegay in sagaal Soomaali ah ay ugu dambeyn raaceen diyaaraddii ku socotay Bariga Afrika — siddeeddii laga soo qaaday Guantánamo iyo nin kale oo Soomaali ah oo diyaaradda ka raacay Louisiana. Qareen Marc Prokosch, oo matalay Adam iyo saddex ka mid ah ragga kale, ayaa sheegay in maadaama ay haysteen amarro kama dambeys ah oo masaafurin ah, tallaabada lagu celiyey Soomaaliya ay sharci ahaan u muuqatay mid sax ah. Doodda sharci ee ugu weyn waxay hadda ku saabsan tahay adeegsiga Guantánamo Bay oo lagu hayo dadka rayidka ah ee sugaya masaafurinta, arrintaas oo kooxo xuquuqda aadanaha ah ay maxkamadaha Mareykanka ka horyimaadeen. Adam ayaa sheegay in xitaa markii uu Muqdisho yimid uu wajahay su’aalo cusub, maadaama magaca Guantánamo uu muddo dheer la xiriiray dadka looga shakiyo argagixisada. “Xitaa qaar ka mid ah qoyskayga ma rumeysanayaan inaan halkaas ku tegay anigoo aan wax dambi ah lahayn,” ayuu yiri. The post Soomaalidii ku jirtay xabsiga Guantánamo Bay oo laga soo dejiyey Muqdisho appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: BF Soomaaliya oo u yeeray taliyaha ciidanka Xoogga iyo wasiirka difaaca + Sababta
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Difaaca Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ayaa si deg-deg ah ugu yeeray wasiirka gaashaandhigga Axmed Macalin Fiqi iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Jeneraal Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, si wax looga waydiiyo cabasho ku saabsan 6,000 oo askari oo isugu jiro hawlgab, naafo iyo qoysaska askartii dhimatay oo la sheegay in la jaray xuquuqdoodii. Ugu horreyn guddiga ayaa su’aallo ka keenay jarista lacagaha loo qoondeeyay agoonta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, isagoo nasiib darro ku tilmaamay in xuquuqdooda la dudsiiyo askartiii dalkan u shahiiday iyo kuwa u naafoobay, iyagoo la dagaalamaya cadowga. Guddiga oo soo bandhigay 4 su’aallood oo ku geedaamay arrintan ayaa wasiirka gaashaandhigga u qabtay inuu uga soo jawaabo muddo 72 saacadood gudahood ah, sidoo kalena isaga iyo taliyaha Xoogga ay si deg-deg ah u horyimaadaan guddiga difaaca ee Baarlamaanka. “Mudane Wasiir, waxa lagaa sugayaa in aad qoraal ahaan uga soo jawaabto su’aalaha sare ku xusan muddo 72 saacadood gudahood ah. Sidoo kale waxa lagu farayaa in aad hortimaado Guddiga Difaaca adiga iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, taariikhda hoos ku xusan. Taariikhda: 04/10/2026 Saacadda: 11:00 subaxnimo Goobta: Xafiiska Guddiga Difaaca, Golaha Shacabka, Villa Hargeysa,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Tallaabadan waxaa ka horreysay dood ay arrintan maanta ka keeneen xildhibaanno ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka oo eedda ugu wayn dusha u saaray xukuumadda Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza. “Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza iyo Wasiiradiisa ayaa jartay lacagta laga jartay agoonta ciidamada, Baarlamaanka ayaana looga yeerayaa hadddii uu imaan waayana gudoonka golaha ayaa xilkiisa ku weynayo,” ayuu yiri Daahir Amiin Jeesow. Dhankiisa Xildhibaan Cabdullaahi Carab ayaa isaguna ka hadlay arrintan, wuxuuna difaacay qoysaska askarta geeriyootay iyo carruurta agoonta ah ee la sheegay in laga dhiman mushaarka. “Cid awood u leh inay jarto lacagtaas ma jirto waxaa la rabaa in la dhaco lacagta, sababtoo ah ninka askariga ah marka hore mushaar ayuu qaataa raashin ayaa la siiyaa waa in haddii uu dhintayne reerkiisa la daryeelaa,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Cabdullaahi Carab. The post BF Soomaaliya oo u yeeray taliyaha ciidanka Xoogga iyo wasiirka difaaca + Sababta appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sahra Cismaan Axmed oo sheegtay in la dilay gabadhii meydkeeda laga helay Baydhabo
items.description: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Haweenka, Arrimaha Qoyska & Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Koonfur Galbeed, Sahra Cismaan Axmed ayaa sheegtay in la dilay Ikhlaas Ibraahim Amiin, oo ahayd gabar shan jira oo Jimcihii meydkeeda laga helay mid ka mid ah xaafadaha Magaalada Baydhabo. Gabadhan oo qoyskeeda ay waayeen Arbacadii ayaa meydkeeda laga helay MCH ama goob caafimaad oo ku dhegan gurigooda oo ku yaala xaafadda Xaqsoor. Hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa meydkeeda baaritaan ugu diray Isbitaal Goboleedka Baay, xilli ay jireen calaamado muujinaya in xarig lagu ceejiyay. Wasiirka Haweenka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ka tacsiyeysay geerida Ikhlaas Ibraahim, iyadoona war ka soo baxay xafiiskeeda ku sheegtay in la dilay gabadhaasi, inkastoo aysan wax faahfaahin ah ka bixin qaabka loo dilay. “Marwo Sahro waxay si qoto dheer uga tacsiyeynaysaa geerida naxdinta leh ee gabadha yar, iyadoo tilmaameysa in dhacdadan ay tahay murugo weyn oo taabatay qalbiga bulshada, gaar ahaan qoyska iyo dadka reer Koonfur Galbeed ee jecel nabadda iyo badbaadada carruurta.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay “Marwo Sahro Cismaan Axmed waxay sidoo kale ugu baaqeysaa laamaha amniga iyo hay’adaha caddaaladda inay si degdeg ah, hufan oo waafaqsan sharciga u baaraan dhacdadan, cid kasta oo ku lug lahaydna sharciga la horgeeyo, si loo helo caddaalad iyo isla xisaabtan.” Warka ayaa lagu soo geba-gabeeyay”Dil loo gaysto ilmo yar oo aan waxba galabsan, waa dhacdo naxdin leh oo u baahan in si dhab ah loo baaro, iyadoo mudnaanta koowaad la siinayo xaqa dhibanaha iyo caddaaladda qoyskiisa. Waxaan ugu baaqaynaa dhammaan bulshada inay ilaashadaan xurmada nolosha, gaar ahaan tan carruurta, ayna la shaqeeyaan hay’adaha amniga si xaqiiqada dhacdadan loo helo, caddaaladdana loo xaqiijiyo.” Booliska Baydhabo ayaa saddex qof u soo qabtay kiiska gabadhaasi, oo laba ka mid ah ay gabdho yihiin iyo nin dhallinyaro ah, kaas oo waardiye ka ahaa goobta laga helay meydkeeda.

items.title: Guddiga Difaaca Golaha Shacabka oo u yeeray Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka
items.description: Muqdisho – Guddiga Difaaca ee Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa u yeeray Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, si ay uga jawaabaan cabasho la xiriirta xuquuqda 6,000 oo askari oo isugu jira hawlgab, naafo iyo qoysaska askartii ku shahiiday difaaca dalka. Warqad rasmi ah oo uu guddigu u diray mas’uuliyiinta ayaa lagu sheegay in loo baahan yahay in la caddeeyo sababaha keenay in la jaro ama wax laga beddelo xuquuqihii ay lahaayeen askarta hawlgabka ah, kuwa naafada ah iyo qoysaska shuhadada. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in arrintan ay u baahan tahay in si faahfaahsan looga jawaabo, iyadoo la eegayo xaaladda askarta iyo qoysaska ay saameysay. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa lagu wargeliyay inay yimaadaan xarunta Guddiga Difaaca ee Golaha Shacabka 4-ta Oktoobar 2026, saacadda 11:00-ka subaxnimo, si ay uga jawaabaan su’aalaha la xiriira cabashada. Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale doonaya in la helo faahfaahin ku saabsan sababaha keenay isbeddelka xuquuqda, cidda go’aanka gaartay iyo tallaabooyinka lagu xallinayo cabashada.

items.title: Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida oo Dil Toogasho ku Xukuntay Askari Dilay Muwaadin Faryaamo Ahaa
items.description: Muqdisho – Maxkamadda Darajada Koowaad ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa maanta dil toogasho oo ah qisaasta Marxuum Yuusuf Axmed Cabdi ku xukuntay Ex-Dable Xoogga Dalka Cabdi Aadan Ibraahim, oo ku magac dheer “Soddon”, kaas oo lagu eedeeyay dilka muwaadin ku shaqaysanayay xirfadda dhismaha guryaha. Marxuum Yuusuf Axmed Cabdi ayaa la dilay 26-kii Luulyo 2026, xilli uu shaqadiisa kasoo baxay, isla markaana uu saarnaa mooto Bajaaj uu u kireystay si uu ugu gaaro hoygiisa. Sida lagu sheegay faahfaahinta kiiska, eedeysanaha ayaa mooto Bajaajta ku joojiyay waddada xaafadda Iga-daba-geey ee degmada Garasbaaley, isaga oo doonayay in la sii qaado. Markii loo sheegay inaysan isku jiho u socon, ayuu muran kadib rasaas furay, waxaana laba xabbadood oo bastoolad ah uu riday mid kamid ah ay caloosha kaga dhacday Marxuumka, kaas oo isla goobta ku geeriyooday. Eedeysanaha ayaa la sheegay inuu isku dayay inuu baxsado, balse uu ku dhuuntay geed ku yaalla meel aan ka fogeyn goobta falka uu ka dhacay. Dad shacab ah ayaa ciidamada ammaanka ku wargeliyay halka uu ku dhuumanayay, waxaana halkaas lagu soo qabtay. Xafiiska Xeer Ilaalinta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa codsaday in kiiska la qaado, waxaana codsigaas la oggolaaday 16-kii Sebtembar 2026. Ugu dambeyn, Maxkamadda Darajada Koowaad ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa maanta ku dhawaaqday xukunka dilka toogashada ah ee qisaasta Marxuum Yuusuf Axmed Cabdi. Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Darajada Koowaad ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, Gaashaanle Sare Xasan Cali Nuur Shuute, ayaa warbaahinta u sheegay xukunka lagu riday eedeysanaha.

items.title: Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya oo Bilaabay Dhuun Shidaal
items.description: Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya oo Bilaabay Mashruuc Dhuun Shidaal oo 120 KM ah Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya ayaa 24-kii Sebtembar 2026 si rasmi ah u bilaabay mashruuc lagu dhisayo dhuun shidaal oo isku xiri doonta Damerjog ee Jabuuti iyo Dewele ee bariga Itoobiya. Mashruuca oo ay iska kaashanayaan Ethiopian Investment Holdings iyo Dangote Group ayaa loogu talagalay in lagu fududeeyo gaarsiinta shidaalka, yareeyo ku-tiirsanaanta gaadiidka booyadaha iyo xoojiyo isku xirka tamarta ee labada dal. Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya ayaa qaaday tallaabo cusub oo lagu beddelayo habka shidaalka loogu kala gudbiyo labada dal, kaddib markii la dhagax-dhigay mashruuc dhuun shidaal oo dhererkeedu yahay 120 kiiloomitir. Mashruuca ayaa isku xiri doona xarunta shidaalka ee Damerjog ee Jabuuti iyo Dewele oo ku taalla bariga Itoobiya. Waxaa iska kaashanaya Ethiopian Investment Holdings (EIH) iyo Dangote Group , iyadoo munaasabadda lagu bilaabay mashruuca ay ka qaybgaleen Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Ahmed, Madaxweynaha Jabuuti Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle iyo madaxa Dangote Group Aliko Dangote. Mashruucu wuxuu ka kooban yahay dhuun qaadda noocyo kala duwan oo shidaal ah iyo xarumo waaweyn oo kaydinta shidaalka ah oo laga dhisayo labada dhinac.Xarunta Damerjog waxaa loo qorsheeyay awood kaydin oo dhan 375,000 mitir kuyuubik , halka xarunta Dewele lagu qorsheeyay 875,000 mitir kuyuubik , taas oo ka dhigaysa awoodda kaydinta labada dhinac in ay ka badan tahay hal milyan oo mitir kuyuubik. Warbaahinta rasmiga ah ee Jabuuti waxay sheegtay in xarunta Damerjog ay awood u yeelan doonto inay sanadkii maamusho ilaa 5 milyan oo tan oo badeecooyin shidaal ah . Xaruntu sidoo kale waxay xiriir la yeelan doontaa kaabayaasha dekedda iyo tareenka ee Damerjog. Itoobiya oo raadineysa waddo shidaal oo ka hufan Itoobiya oo aan lahayn xeeb ayaa muddo dheer si weyn ugu tiirsanayd kaabayaasha dekedaha Jabuuti si ay u hesho badeecooyin ay ka mid yihiin shidaalka. Mas’uuliyiinta labada dal ayaa sheegay in dhuuntan ay yareyn karto ku-tiirsanaanta gaadiidka booyadaha, kharashaadka saadka iyo ciriiriga ka dhasha waddooyinka isku xira Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya. Ethiopian Investment Holdings ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in dhuuntu dedejin karto gaarsiinta shidaalka gudaha Itoobiya. Tallaabadan waxay sidoo kale la xiriirtaa qorshe ballaaran oo lagu horumarinayo marinka ganacsi iyo tamareed ee u dhexeeya labada dal. Damerjog ayaa horey loogu dhisay kaabayaal loogu talagalay qaabilaadda iyo maaraynta badeecooyinka shidaalka. Hay’adda Dekedaha iyo Aagagga Xorta ah ee Jabuuti waxay sheegtay in terminalka shidaalka ee Damerjog uu leeyahay awood maarayn sannadle ah oo gaareysa 25 milyan oo tan, isla markaana uu leeyahay xiriirro dhuumo oo loogu talagalay badeecooyin shidaal oo kala duwan. Mashruuc ka ballaaran dhuun shidaal Mashruuca cusub ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa qayb ka mid ah qorshe dheer oo lagu dhisayo isku-xir tamareed oo gobolka ah. Sida lagu sheegay wararka rasmiga ah ee Jabuuti, dhuunta 120-ka kiiloomitir ah ayaa noqonaysa tallaabada koowaad ee mashruuc loogu talagalay in si joogto ah shidaalka la sifeeyay looga raro Jabuuti loona gaarsiiyo suuqa Itoobiya. Mustaqbalka, qorshayaal kale ayaa laga yaabaa inay ballaariyaan doorka marinka, oo ay ku jiraan gaadiidka kheyraadka tamarta ee gobolka. Arrimahaas dambe weli waxay ku xiran yihiin qorshayaal iyo hirgelin dheeraad ah. Dhanka Jabuuti, mashruucu wuxuu xoojin karaa doorka dalka ee ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo tamarta gobolka. Dekedda Damerjog waxay ku taallaa meel istiraatiiji ah oo u dhow marin-biyoodka Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab, iyadoo horey loo sameeyay kaabayaal loogu adeegayo gaadiidka iyo kaydinta badeecooyinka tamarta. Ethiopian Investment Holdings iyo Dangote Group ayaa ah labada dhinac ee maalgelinaya horumarinta mashruuca. Warbixinno rasmi ah ayaa xaqiijinaya in dhagax-dhigga la sameeyay 24-kii Sebtembar, halka qiimaha guud ee mashruuca ballaaran uu ilo kala duwan ku kala sheegay tirooyin kala duwan; sidaas darteed qiimaha kama dambaysta ah ee dhammaan qaybaha mashruuca wuxuu u baahan yahay in si rasmi ah loo caddeeyo. Mashruucu, haddii loo hirgeliyo sidii loo qorsheeyay, wuxuu noqon karaa qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah kaabayaasha isku xira dekedaha Jabuuti iyo suuqa weyn ee Itoobiya, isagoo diiradda saaraya kaydinta, gaadiidka iyo qaybinta shidaalka. The post Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya oo Bilaabay Dhuun Shidaal first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Daawo: BF oo mar kale ku dhegan R/W Xamza iyo kiis culus la xiriira lacag laga…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada) – Qaar kamid ah xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka ayaa maanta si kulul uga hadlay wararka sheegaya in lacagaha loo qoondeeyay agoonta Ciidanka Xoogga la dhimay, kaddib markii qaar kamid ah qoysaskooda ay cabasho ka muujiyeen arrintaasi. Xildhibaanno badan oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa si adag uga hadlay arrintan, waxayna kiiskan ku eedeeyeen xukuumadda Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza iyo Golihiisa Wasiirrada. Xildhibaan Maxamed Xasan Murjaan oo kamid ah xildhibaannada ka hadlay xuquuqda laga goostay agoonta ayaa shaaca ka qaaday inay u doodayaan, isla markaana ay wadaan mooshin ka dhan ah Ra’iisul wasaaraha, ayna horkeeni doonaan Baarlamaanka, si looga doodo. “Mooshinka aan wadno wuxuu ku saabsan yahay shaqa gudasho la’aanta Ra’iisul wasaaraha waxaa kasoo dhicinay shaqaalaha rayidka hadda waxaa la aaday ciidanka, waana 6000 oo ah kuwa dhintay oo dalkan usoo jidaahay qoysaskood ayaa laga jartay,” ayuu yiri Murjaan. Sidoo kale, xildhibaan Maxamed Xasan Murjaan ayaa ku goodiyay inay tallaabo ka qaadi doonaan xukuumadda, isla markaana cid uun ay xilkeeda ku waydiin doonto kiiska, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Arrintan qof ayaa ku bixi doono ka xildhibaanno ahaan shaqadeenna ayaan gudan doonaa,” ayuu mar kale yiri Xildhibaanku. Dhankiisa Xildhibaan Daahir Amiin Jeesow oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa eedda ugu wayn dusha u saaray Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza iyo Golihiisa Wasiirrada, isaga oo sii xoojiyay arrinta ku aadan mooshinka socda “Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza iyo Wasiiradiisa ayaa jartay lacagta laga jartay agoonta ciidamada, Baarlamaanka ayaana looga yeerayaa hadddii uu imaan waayana gudoonka golaha ayaa xilkiisa ku weynayo,” ayuu yiri Daahir Amiin Jeesow. Xildhibaan Cabdullaahi Carab ayaa isaguna ka hadlay arrintan, wuxuuna difaacay qoysaska askarta geeriyootay iyo carruurta agoonta ah ee la sheegay in laga dhiman mushaarka. “Cid awood u leh inay jarto lacagtaas ma jirto waxaa la rabaa in la dhaco lacagta, sababtoo ah ninka askariga ah marka hore mushaar ayuu qaataa raashin ayaa la siiyaa waa in haddii uu dhintayne reerkiisa la daryeelaa,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Cabdullaahi Carab. items.title: Baladweyne Splits in Two as Somalia’s Election Crisis Hits the Streets
items.description: Gunfire Reportedly Stops Demonstrators Crossing From Eastern Baladweyne Into Government-Controlled West as Hiiraan Official Warns: “If Hiiraan Dies, Somalia Dies” Baladweyne (WDN) — Somalia’s deepening electoral crisis has erupted onto the streets of Baladweyne, exposing a city increasingly divided between competing political visions for the country’s future. The latest confrontation came after demonstrators who gathered in eastern Baladweyne reportedly attempted to cross into the western part of the city, where Federal Government and Hirshabelle forces are deployed and where support for Mogadishu is said to be stronger. According to reports from the city, the demonstrators were met with gunfire from government and Hirshabelle security forces operating in the western, or Qoraxsin , section of Baladweyne. The demonstrators subsequently turned back toward eastern Baladweyne. The episode has transformed what began as a political demonstration into a stark illustration of the divisions running through one of Somalia’s most strategically important cities. One City, Two Political Camps Baladweyne now appears increasingly divided not simply by geography, but by competing political loyalties and sharply different views over Somalia’s next election. The reported confrontation between demonstrators from the eastern side and security forces deployed in the west has exposed the extent to which the national electoral dispute is being translated into local political tensions. What happens in Baladweyne matters beyond Hiiraan. The city is the political and economic centre of the region and has repeatedly been at the heart of debates over Hirshabelle’s political future. Its divisions therefore carry implications for the wider dispute over who should determine the electoral process and how the next political order should be established. Hiiraan Official Delivers Blistering Warning The political temperature rose further when the chairman of Tardo locality in Hiiraan, who had travelled to Baladweyne to participate in the demonstration, delivered a forceful attack on President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. Addressing the gathering, the official accused the president of pursuing an electoral process in Hirshabelle that would not be accepted in Hiiraan. “The election that Hassan Sheikh is conducting in Hirshabelle will not work in Hiiraan,” he said. He went further, accusing President Hassan Sheikh of having already “auctioned” the rest of Somalia politically while claiming that Hiiraan was the only area that had resisted what he described as that process. His most striking warning was directed at the fate of Hiiraan itself. “If Hiiraan survives, Somalia as a whole will survive. But if Hiiraan dies, Somalia as a whole will die,” he said. The Election Dispute Moves Into the Streets The confrontation in Baladweyne provides a powerful snapshot of Somalia’s wider political crisis. The dispute is no longer confined to negotiations among presidents, opposition leaders and political parties. It is increasingly reaching cities, communities and local administrations, where competing interpretations of the electoral process are generating visible political confrontation. In Baladweyne, the divide is particularly striking. The eastern side has become a visible centre of opposition to the direction of the electoral process, while the western side hosts forces aligned with the Federal Government and Hirshabelle authorities. The reported gunfire — and the demonstrators’ retreat — has now added a security dimension to an already bitter political dispute. Baladweyne Becomes a Warning Sign The central question is no longer simply whether Somalia will hold an election. It is whether Somalia’s political actors can agree on who controls the process, who establishes the rules and whether those rules will be accepted across the country. Baladweyne’s streets are showing what happens when those questions remain unresolved. For now, the city remains physically and politically divided, with rival views of Somalia’s electoral future confronting each other only a short distance apart. And the warning coming from Hiiraan could hardly be more dramatic: What happens in Hiiraan, its political leaders argue, could ultimately shape what happens to Somalia itself. items.title: Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Baabi’inta Hubka Nugliyeerka: Halis aan la Dhaaddayn
items.description: 26ka Sebtembar waxay dunidu isxusuusisaa in khatarta hubka nugliyeerku aysan ku koobnayn goobta uu qaraxu ka dhaco. Waxay gaari kartaa dadka, beeraha iyo nolosha dalal aan dagaalka qayb ka ahayn. Doodda hubka sida arxandarrada wax u gummaada ee nugliyeerka waxaa inta badan lagu soo qaadaa awoodda quwadaha iyo dheellitirka ciidamadooda. Waxaase dooddaas ka danbeeya weydiin culus: maxaa ku dhacaya dadka iyo degaankooda haddii hubkan la adeegsado? Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sannadkii 2013kii u asteeyay 26ka Sebtembar, sannad kasta, Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Baabi’inta Hubka Nugliyeerka ee ba’an wax u gummaada. Maalintani waxay fursad u tahay in dib loo eego raadkii xumaa ee hore loo mutay, halisaha weli taagan iyo dadaalka looga hortagayo in hubkaas halista ah mar kale la isu adeegsado. Amniga ku dhisan hanjabaadda aargoosiga Muddo dheer, dawladaha haysta hubka nugliyeerka waxay amnigooda qayb ahaan ku saleeyeen cabsigelinta nugliyeerka : in cadowga laga baajiyo weerar iyadoo la tusayo in weerarkiisa looga jawaabi karo weerar ba’an. Xisaabtaasi waxay ku tiirsantahay in dhinacyadu si sax ah u fahmaan awoodda iyo ujeeddada midba midka kale. Halkaas ayay tabardarradeedu taallaa. Xiisad siyaasadeed, xog si qalad ah loo fasiray ama digniin aan la xaqiijin waxay madaxda gelin kartaa xaalad ay go’aan culus ku gaaraan waqti kooban. Hubka loogu talaggalay in lagu baajiyo dagaal wuxuu, marka xisaabtu qaldanto, noqon karaa isha musiibada laga baqayo. Qiiqa dagaalku sidee ayuu beeraha u gaari karaa? Khasaaraha dagaal nugliyeer kuma ekaan karo burburka iyo shucaaca ka dhasha qaraxyada. Cilmibaaris ku salaysan moodeello cimileed iyo kuwo waxsoosaarka cuntada ah ayaa baaray waxa dhici kara haddii dababka ka kaca magaalooyinka la beegsado ay hawada sare u diraan qiiq madow oo badan. Qiiqaas oo gaara lakabka sare ee jawiga, istaraatosfeerka , wuxuu yarayn karaa iftiinka qorraxda ee dhulka soo gaara. Hoosudhaca iftiinka iyo isbeddelka heerkulku waxay dhaawici karaan waxsoosaarka dalagyada, kalluunka iyo xoolaha. Saameyntan suuraggalka ah ayaa qayb ka ah waxa loo yaqaan jiilaalka nugliyeerka . Baaxadda dhibaatadu waxay ku xirnaan lahayd baaxadda dagaalka iyo xaddiga qiiqa hawada gala; waa saadaal cilmiyeed, mana aha dhacdo hore dunida uga dhacday heerkaas. Dalka ka fog goobta dagaalka ayaa sidaas oo kale wajihi kara cunto yari. Qiiqa hawada gala iyo hakadka ku yimaadda waxsoosaarka cuntadu ma raacaan soohdimaha siyaasadeed. Casharkii Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki Waxa la hubo, oo aan moodeel lagu saadaalin, waa dhibaatadii ka dhalatay bambooyinkii atomiga ahaa ee lagu tuuray Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki sannadkii 1945. Qaraxyadu waxay dileen dad badan, waxay burburiyeen magaalooyin, waxayna dhaawacyo iyo cudurro muddo dheer jiray ku reebeen dad ka badbaaday. Dadkii ka badbaaday, oo loo yaqaan hibakusha , waxay dunida la wadaageen wixii ay arkeen iyo saamAyntii dhaawaca iyo shucaacu ku yeesheen noloshooda. Isbitaallada Laanqayrta Cas ee Japan ayaa tobannaan sano kaddib weli daryeelayay dad la ildaran dhibaatooyin caafimaad ee ay ka dhaxleen qaraxyadii ay sababeen madaxyadii nugliyeerku, oo ay ka mid yihiin noocyo kansar ah. Markhaatifurkooda ayaa doodda hub-ka-dhigista ku soo celinaya dadka ay go’aannada siyaasadeed saamaynayaan. Teknoolojiyadda iyo go’aanka aadanaha Garaadgacmeedka, weerarrada dhijitaalka ah iyo horumarka hababka hubka ayaa su’aalo cusub ka keenaya kalsoonida lagu qabi karo digniinaha amni. Haddii xog qaldan ama faragelin dhijitaal ahi saamayso nidaam digniin, waqtiga loo helo xaqiijinta xogta ayaa muhiim noqonaya. Taasi macnaheedu ma aha in garaadgacmeedka uu keligiis go’aaminayo adeegsiga hubka sida ba’an wax u gummaada ee nugliyeerka. Khatartu waxay ka dhalan kartaa sida xogta loo ururiyo, loo qiimeeyo, looguna bandhigo dadka go’aanka leh, gaar ahaan xilliga xiisaddu sarrayso. Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay ee Cilmibaarista Hub-ka-dhigista, UNIDIR, waxay tilmaantay in isdhexgalka teknoolojiyadahan iyo nidaamyada nugliyeerku kordhin karo halista xiisad sii xoogaysata. Heshiisyada iyo caqabadda hirgelintooda Heshiiska Kahortagga Faafitaanka Hubka Nugliyeerka ( NPT ) ayaa ka mid ah tiirarka ugu waaweyn ee xeerarka caalamiga ah ee arrintan khuseeya. Waxaa saxiixa loo furay 1968 , wuxuuna dhaqan galay 1970 . Heshiisku wuxuu ka hadlayaa kahortagga faafitaanka hubka nugliyeerka, iskaashiga adeegsiga nabadeed ee tamarta nugliyeerka iyo dadaalka hub-ka-dhigista. Heshiiska Mamnuucidda Hubka Nuliyeerka ( TPNW ) waxaa la ansixiyay 2017 , wuxuuna dhaqangalay 2021 . Dawladaha ku biiray ayuu ka mamnuucayaa, waxyaabo kale oo ay weheliyaan, samaynta, tijaabinta, haysashada, adeegsiga iyo ku hanjabidda adeegsiga hubka nugliyeerka. Baaxadda mamnuuciddaas iyo sida ay u hirgeli karto waxay ku xiran yihiin dawladaha heshiiska ku biira iyo tallaabooyinka ay qaadaan. Heshiisyadu waxay dejin karaan waajibaad iyo hannaan wadahadal. Haseyeeshee, dhimista khatartu waxay sidoo kale u baahan tahay in dawladuhu xoojiyaan kalsoonida, ilaaliyaan waddooyinka wadahadalka, si adag u hubiyaan digniinaha, una sii wadaan wadaxaajoodka hubka dhigista. Xusuus u baahan ficil Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki waxay muujiyeen dhibaatada hubkan marka la adeegsado. Daraasadaha cimilada iyo cuntaduna waxay muujinayaan in dagaal nugliyeer oo mustaqbalka dhaca uu saamayn gaarsiin karo dad aad uga fog goobta qaraxyada. 26ka Sebtembar sidaas darteed waa maalin lagu xusuusto dadkii waxyeelladu gaartay, laguna miisaamo go’aannada maanta la gaarayo. Su’aasha hortaalla dawladaha ma aha oo keliya sida looga baajin karo weerar; waa sida looga hortagi karo in qalad, xiisad ama dagaal uu dadweynaha dunida u horseedo khasaare aan dib loo sixi karin.

Heshiisku wuxuu ka hadlayaa kahortagga faafitaanka hubka nugliyeerka, iskaashiga adeegsiga nabadeed ee tamarta nugliyeerka iyo dadaalka hub-ka-dhigista. Heshiiska Mamnuucidda Hubka Nuliyeerka ( TPNW ) waxaa la ansixiyay 2017 , wuxuuna dhaqangalay 2021 . Dawladaha ku biiray ayuu ka mamnuucayaa, waxyaabo kale oo ay weheliyaan, samaynta, tijaabinta, haysashada, adeegsiga iyo ku hanjabidda adeegsiga hubka nugliyeerka. Baaxadda mamnuuciddaas iyo sida ay u hirgeli karto waxay ku xiran yihiin dawladaha heshiiska ku biira iyo tallaabooyinka ay qaadaan. Heshiisyadu waxay dejin karaan waajibaad iyo hannaan wadahadal. Haseyeeshee, dhimista khatartu waxay sidoo kale u baahan tahay in dawladuhu xoojiyaan kalsoonida, ilaaliyaan waddooyinka wadahadalka, si adag u hubiyaan digniinaha, una sii wadaan wadaxaajoodka hubka dhigista. Xusuus u baahan ficil Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki waxay muujiyeen dhibaatada hubkan marka la adeegsado. Daraasadaha cimilada iyo cuntaduna waxay muujinayaan in dagaal nugliyeer oo mustaqbalka dhaca uu saamayn gaarsiin karo dad aad uga fog goobta qaraxyada. 26ka Sebtembar sidaas darteed waa maalin lagu xusuusto dadkii waxyeelladu gaartay, laguna miisaamo go’aannada maanta la gaarayo. Su’aasha hortaalla dawladaha ma aha oo keliya sida looga baajin karo weerar; waa sida looga hortagi karo in qalad, xiisad ama dagaal uu dadweynaha dunida u horseedo khasaare aan dib loo sixi karin.

items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo ansixiyey Hindise-Sharciyeedka Iskaashiga Garsoorka Caalamiga ah
items.description: Muqdisho, 26 Sebtembar 2026 – Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ansixiyey Hindise-Sharciyeedka Iskaashiga Garsoorka Caalamiga ah, kaddib cod loo qaaday oo ay oggolaadeen 130 xildhibaan. Kulanka 19-aad ee kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Golaha Shacabka ayaa waxaa shir guddoomiyey Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Golaha, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow. Natiijada codbixinta ayaa muujisay in 130 xildhibaan ay oggolaadeen hindise-sharciyeedka, sagaal xildhibaan ay diideen, halka laba xildhibaan ay ka aamuseen. Dhanka kale, xildhibaannada ayaa akhrinta labaad marsiiyey Hindise-Sharciyeedka Wax-ka-beddelka Sharciga Bankiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya, Sharci Lr. 130 ee soo baxay 22-kii Abriil 2012. Xildhibaannada ayaa ka dooday qodobbada hindise-sharciyeedka, iyagoo su’aalo weydiiyey mas’uuliyiinta Wasaaradda Cadaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka iyo kuwa Bankiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya oo kulanka ka qeyb galay. Ugu dambeyn, mudanayaasha Golaha Shacabka ayaa loo qeybiyey warbixinta akhrinta labaad ee heshiisyada u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ee ku saabsan iskaashiga garsoorka caalamiga ah.

items.title: Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo dacwo culus ka gudbiyay Xasan Sheekh iyo Jaamac
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Lafta-gareen ayaa dacwad culus u gudbiyay beesha caalamka, gaar ahaan dowladda Mareykanka, Qaramada Midoobay, Midowga Yurub, Midowga Afrika iyo IGAD, isagoo warqadda uu diray kusoo hadal qaaday xaaladda ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed. Lafta-gareen ayaa marka hore cambaareeyay weerar uu sheegay in madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo dowladdiisa ay ku qaadeen Koonfur Galbeed,isagoo sheegay inay meesha ka saareen maamulkii uu hoggaaminayay oo uu ku tilmaamay mid sharci ah. Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ayaa xusay in weerarka ay ka qayb-qaateen diyaarado dagaal, welina ay duqeymo ka wadaan agagaarka magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay. “Weerarka milatari ee ciidamada federaalka ayaa socday lixdii bilood ee la soo dhaafay. Labadii bilood ee la soo dhaafay, diyaaradaha Cessna ayaa sidoo kale loo adeegsaday, taas oo lagu dilay dad rayid ah iyo xoolo,” ayuu ku yiri qoraalka madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii daray “Diyaaraduhu waxay ku xareysan yihiin garoonka diyaaradaha Magaalada Muqdisho, waxaana weli loo adeegsanayaa duqaymaha”. Sidoo kale, wuxuu soo hadal qaaday weerarkii ka dhacay guriga taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta, Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan ee degmada Dooow, isagoo sheegay in loo adeegsaday diyaaradaha dagaalka F-16 ee dalka Turkiga, isla markaana ay amarka siiyeen madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) “Weerar kale oo ka dhacay Doolow, waxaa fuliyay diyaaradaha F-16 ee dowladda Turkiga, kuwaas oo ku shaqaynayay amarka madaxweynihii hore Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Guddoomiye Jaamac, waxayna weerareen General Mahad Cabdiraxmaan, oo loo yaqaan (General Shub),” ayaaa mar kale lagu yiri warqadda. Arrimahan ayuu tilmaamay inay khatar gelinayaan dadka rayidka ah, ayna wiiqayaan awoodda sharciga iyo guud ahaan xasilloonida Soomaaliya. Ugu dambeyn wuxuu ugu baaqay saaxibada caalamiga ah inay cambaareeyaan ‘weerarka Koonfur Galbeed’ ayna sameeyaan baaritaan madaxbanaan, si loola xisaabtamo kuwii ka dambeeyay. The post Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo dacwo culus ka gudbiyay Xasan Sheekh iyo Jaamac appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: R/W Xamza oo sameeyay magacaabis cusub + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) -Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta magacaabay agaasimeyaasha guud ee qaar ka mid ah wasaaradaha xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, si loo dardargeliyo hawlihii socday. Xamza ayaa wareegto uu soo saaray ku magacaabay agaasimaha guud ee wasaaradda tamarta iyo kheyraadka Biyaha, kaas oo loo magacaabay Cabdullaahi Ibraahim Cabdi. Sidoo kale, Axmed Yuusuf Cabdulle ayaa isna loo magacaabay agaasimaha guud ee wasaaradda isgaarsiinta iyo teknolojiyadda ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, sida lagu sheegay wareegtada. Ra’iisul wasaraaha ayaa magacaabistan u cuskaday qodobada 119-aad, farqada (D) ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, wuxuuna faray agaasimeyaasha cusub inay si hufan u gutaan waajibaadka shaqo ee loo igmaday. Waxaa kale oo uu ku amray inay dardargaliyaan shaqooyinka wasaaradaha ee loo igmaday, si horay loogu sii wado horumarka ay ku tallaabsaneyso xukuumadda Dan-Qaran. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii dambe waday isbeddello cusub oo ku aaddan xukuumaddiisa oo dhawaan u dabaal-dageyso waxqabadkeeda, maadaama ay u buuxsantay 4 sanno. Magacaabistan ayaa kusoo aaday, xilli xasaasi ah oo ay taagan tahay xiisad soo kala dhex-gashay Xukuumadda iyo Baarlamaanka, taas oo ka dhalatay qaraarkii kasoo baxay xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre ee ku aadanaa in xilalka agaasime-waaxeedyada wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha kale ee dowladda lagu buuxiyo hannaan tartan ah, kaas oo ay gebi ahaanba meesha ka saareen xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka. Arrintan ayaa sidoo kale keentay is-qab-qabsi awoodeed oo durbo ka dhex bilowday guddoonka Baarlamaanka iyo xafiiska ra’iisul wasaaraha. Is-haysiga labada xafiis ayaa loo arkaa mid salka ku haya ku tartanka awoodda iyo saamaynta siyaasadda dalka. The post R/W Xamza oo sameeyay magacaabis cusub + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Daawo: Jubaland oo digniin kasoo saartay xaaladda Gedo, kadib cabsi soo korortay
items.description: Doolow (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Gedo Maxamed Xuseen Alqaadi oo shir jaraa’id u qabtay wariyeyaasha ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda gobolka Gedo, gaar ahaan cabsi laga qabo fatahaado mar kale ku dhufta deegaannada gobolkaas oo hoostaga Jubbaland. Guddoomiyaha ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in saadaasha la bixiyay ay muujineyso in gobolka uu kamid ah yahay meelaha sida wayn looga cabsi qabo inay ku dhuftaan fatahaadaha, ayna isa soo tarayaan digniinaha la bixinayo. Al-qaadi ayaa shacabka gobolka Gedo ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan goobaha biyo fariisadka ah iyo hareeraha wabiga, si aysan usoo gaarin waxyeelo. “Waxaan ugu baaqeynaa shacabka dhibaatooyinka laga cabsi qabo inay iska ilaaliyaan, kana fogaadaan meelaha laga fili karo fatahaadaha waxaan ku boorineynaa shacabka inay aadaan meelaha aysan biyaha gaari karin, si aysan waxyeelo usoo gaarin,” ayuu yiri Alqaadi. Sidoo kale, wuxuu carrabka ku dhuftay in meelaha qaar roobabkii ka da’ay ay durbaba sababeen khasaare xooggan oo isugu jiro dhimasho, dhaawac iyo burbur hantiyeed. “Hadda degmada Buurdhuubo roob ayaa ka da’ay xoolana waa ku dhamaadeen, guryihiina way saameeyeen, hal qofna waa ku dhintay marka waxaan rabnaa arrintaas inaan uga digno shacabka,” ayuu mar kale yiri guddoomiyaha maamulka gobolka Gedo. Dhanka kale, wuxuu ku baaqay in dadka ay is caawiyaan, iskuna gurmadaan, haddii ay soo kororto xaalad culus oo ka dhalan karta roobabka la filayo inay ka da’aan gobolka. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in Jubbaland ay waddo dadaalo dheeraad ah, iyada oo kaashaneysa hay’adaha samafalka, si gurmad deg-deg ah loo sameeyo, haddii ay xaalad soo kororto Horay waxaa Gedo marar bdan ugu dhuftay fatahaado xooggan oo burburiyay buundooyinkii muiimka ahaa ee gobolkaas, kuwaas oo illaa iyo hadda aan helin wax dib u dayactir ah. Puntland Forces Reclaim Hijacked Tanker SIBU 1 After 48-Hour Operation
items.description: MOGADISHU— Puntland maritime forces have recaptured the fuel tanker SIBU 1 after a 48-hour operation off the coast of Somalia’s Mudug region, ending a hijacking that lasted more than a month, Puntland authorities said. All 20 crew members aboard the vessel were rescued during the operation, according to Puntland officials, who said the tanker was brought back under government control after security forces confronted the suspected pirates. SIBU 1 was hijacked on August 20. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported at the time that six armed men had seized the vessel off the coast of Yemen. Puntland authorities said their forces had been monitoring SIBU 1 and other vessels seized by suspected pirates before launching the operation to retake the tanker. The operation resulted in casualties among the suspected pirates, according to Puntland officials. One pirate was killed, four were wounded and 15 were captured. One Puntland security officer was also wounded during the operation. SIBU 1 had previously been placed under U.S. sanctions. Washington sanctioned the vessel in December, alleging that it was involved in the transportation of Iranian petroleum products as part of efforts to evade U.S. sanctions. Following the operation, Puntland authorities said the tanker and its crew had been safely recovered and that maritime forces would continue efforts to secure the coastline and combat piracy and other threats at sea. The recovery of SIBU 1 comes amid continued concerns over maritime security in waters off Somalia. Although piracy has declined substantially from its peak, the latest incident demonstrates that the threat has not been completely eliminated. items.title: Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka oo soo saaray amar ku saabsan dib-u-eegista Qaraar uu horay u meelmariyay Golaha Shacabku
items.description: Guddiga Qaranka Shaqaalaha Rayidka ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo saaray qoraal rasmi ah oo ku saabsan fulinta iyo dib-u-eegista Qaraarka Golaha Shacabka , kaas oo loo diray Wasaaradaha iyo Hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka. Qoraalka oo ku taariikhaysan 26/09/2026 , kuna saxiixan Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka, ayaa lagu sheegay in la fulinayo qaraar Golaha Shacabka uu horey u soo gudbiyay, kaas oo wata tixraaca GSHH/B-11/23/09/2026 , lana xiriira xeerarka iyo habraacyada shaqaalaha dowladda. Guddigu wuxuu xusay in qaraarkaasi uu tixraacayo Sharciga Shaqaalaha Rayidka ee Lr. 132 ee 11 May 2025 , iyo qaraar kale oo ku saabsan hannaanka tartanka furan ee shaqaalaha dowladda , kaas oo ka soo baxay Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha. Sida ku cad qoraalka, Agaasimeyaasha Waaxyaha Maamulka Shaqaalaha ee Wasaaradaha iyo Hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka ayaa laga doonayaa inay si dhow uga qayb qaataan hawsha, isla markaana ay gutaan waajibaadka kaga aaddan fulinta qaraarka. Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka ayaa sidoo kale faray Wasaaradaha iyo Hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka inay qaataan mas’uuliyadda ku aaddan fulinta iyo dib-u-eegista Qaraarka Golaha Shaqabka , iyadoo la raacayo qodobbada sharciga iyo Dastuurka Federaalka Soomaaliya. Qoraalka ayaa si gaar ah u xusaya Qodobka 2-aad ee Qaraarka , iyo sidoo kale Qodobbada 158-aad iyo 159-aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya , kuwaas oo saldhig u ah waajibaadka iyo shaqada hay’adaha dowladda ee arrintan. Guddigu wuxuu sheegay in tallaabadan ay qayb ka tahay habraaca lagu hubinayo in qaraarrada iyo xeerarka la xiriira shaqaalaha dowladda loo maro nidaamka sharciga ah, iyadoo hay’adaha ay khusayso laga doonayo inay gutaan waajibaadkooda. Qoraalka waxaa ku saxiixan Xasan Abshirow Maxamed, Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka , waxaana loo diray Wasaaradda Shaqada iyo Hay’adda Dowladda, Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka iyo Xafiiska Madaxtooyada.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo QM u jeexay khad cas oo ku saabsan doorashooyinka Soomaaliya
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Qaramada Midoobay iyo saaxiibada caalamka ugu baaqay inay taageeraan dadaallada Soomaaliya ugu gudbeyso doorasho qof iyo cod ah, balse wuxuu ku adkeystay in Soomaalidu ay yeelato lahaanshaha iyo hoggaanka geeddi-socodkaas. Xasan Sheekh, oo Khamiistii khudbad ka jeediyey Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, ayaa sheegay in dib-u-habeynta dastuurka ay saldhig u tahay hirgelinta codbixin dadweyne, dhismaha hay’ado lala xisaabtami karo iyo nidaam siyaasadeed oo xisbiyo badan leh. “Waxaan Qaramada Midoobay iyo saaxiibadeenna caalamka ku casuumeynaa inay taageeraan isbeddelkan, iyagoo gacan ka geysanaya xoojinta hay’adaha dimoqraadiyadda, laakiin mar walba ixtiraamaya lahaanshaheenna dimoqraadiyadda Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri madaxweynaha. Hadalkiisa ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli khilaaf xooggan uu ka taagan yahay hannaanka loo marayo doorashooyinka soo socda, iyadoo dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradku ay isku hayaan qaabka codbixinta, maamulka doorashada iyo isbeddellada dastuurka. Waxaa sidoo kale sii xoogeysanaya kala duwanaanshaha ku saabsan doorka ay beesha caalamku ku yeelan karto xalinta khilaafka siyaasadeed. Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ku mideysan yihiin madax mucaarad ah iyo hoggaanka Puntland iyo Jubaland, ayaa dhowaan Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ka codsaday inuu dhex-dhexaadiyo khilaafka doorashada, isla markaana beesha caalamku door muuqda ku yeelato ilaalinta heshiis kasta oo siyaasadeed. Warqad uu Golaha Mustaqbalka 11-kii September u diray Golaha Ammaanka ayuu ku dalbaday taageero caalami ah oo lagu gaaro hannaan doorasho oo la isku raacsan yahay. Goluhu wuxuu sidoo kale soo jeediyey in la sameeyo hannaan dhex-dhexaadin iyo dammaanad-qaad ah oo ay qeyb ka yihiin xubnaha Golaha Ammaanka iyo dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya. Mowqifkaas ayaa ka duwan kan uu Xasan Sheekh ka muujiyey Golaha Guud ee QM. Madaxweynaha ayaa soo dhoweeyey taageerada caalamiga ah ee lagu xoojinayo hay’adaha dimoqraadiyadda, balse wuxuu ku adkeystay in geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed ay Soomaalidu hoggaamiso. “Ujeedkeenna waa inaan noqono dimoqraadiyad wax ku ool ah, halkaas oo khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wada-hadal, sharci iyo doorashooyin, ee aan lagu xallin rabshado,” ayuu yiri. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in dowladdiisu ay geeddi-socodka dib-u-habeynta dastuurka kala tashatay hoggaamiyeyaasha siyaasadda, dowlad-goboleedyada, bulshada rayidka ah, haweenka, dhalinyarada iyo Soomaalida dibadda. Hase yeeshee, hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ayaa ku doodaya in dowladda ay si keligeed ah u maamushay qeybo muhiim ah oo ka mid ah geeddi-socodka, isla markaana wadahadallo hore oo lagu doonayey heshiis doorasho aysan wax natiijo ah kasoo bixin. Khilaafka doorashada Wadahadalladii ugu dambeeyey ee dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka ayaa bishii July kusoo dhammaaday heshiis la’aan, kadib markii labada dhinac ay isku mari waayeen nidaamka codbixinta iyo cidda maamuleysa doorashooyinka soo socda. Inkasta oo dowladda iyo mucaaradku ay labaduba taageerayaan in Soomaaliya ay u gudubto doorasho toos ah, haddana waxay si weyn isugu khilaafsan yihiin qaabka loo hirgelinayo. Dowladda federaalka ayaa dooneysa in doorashada lagu galo xisbiyo siyaasadeed oo diiwaangashan, iyadoo ay maamuleyso guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka. Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa dhinaciisa soo jeediyey nidaam ku-meel-gaar ah oo shacabka siinaya fursad ay si toos ah u codeeyaan, balse weli lagu ilaalinayo nidaamka awood-qeybsiga beelaha ee 4.5 marka la qeybinayo kuraasta baarlamaanka. Khilaafka waxaa sii adkeeyey wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka ee baarlamaanka ansixiyey bishii March, kuwaas oo muddada xilka madaxweynaha iyo baarlamaanka ka dhigay shan sano halkii ay markii hore ka ahayd afar sano. Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa Golaha Ammaanka ka codsaday inuu taageero waxa uu ugu yeeray “hannaan doorasho oo loo dhan yahay, lana fulin karo”, kaas oo khuseeya hay’adaha federaalka iyo kuwa dowlad-goboleedyada. Waxa uu sidoo kale dalbaday hannaan ay dhinacyada caalamku ku dhex-dhexaadiyaan siyaasiyiinta Soomaalida, kuna dammaanad-qaadaan heshiis kasta oo laga gaaro khilaafka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa dhankiisa Golaha Guud ee QM u sheegay in Soomaaliya ay galayso marxalad cusub oo dimoqraadi ah, taas oo muwaadiniintu ay codkooda ku go’aaminayaan cidda maamuleysa awoodda siyaasadeed. “Tani waa bog cusub oo horumar leh, halkaas oo awoodda siyaasadeed ay go’aaminayaan muwaadiniinta, iyadoo dastuurku hagayo, sarreynta sharciguna ilaalineyso,” ayuu yiri madaxweynaha. Warqad uu Golaha Mustaqbalka 11-kii September u diray Golaha Ammaanka ayuu ku dalbaday taageero caalami ah oo lagu gaaro hannaan doorasho oo la isku raacsan yahay. Goluhu wuxuu sidoo kale soo jeediyey in la sameeyo hannaan dhex-dhexaadin iyo dammaanad-qaad ah oo ay qeyb ka yihiin xubnaha Golaha Ammaanka iyo dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya. Mowqifkaas ayaa ka duwan kan uu Xasan Sheekh ka muujiyey Golaha Guud ee QM. Madaxweynaha ayaa soo dhoweeyey taageerada caalamiga ah ee lagu xoojinayo hay’adaha dimoqraadiyadda, balse wuxuu ku adkeystay in geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed ay Soomaalidu hoggaamiso. “Ujeedkeenna waa inaan noqono dimoqraadiyad wax ku ool ah, halkaas oo khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wada-hadal, sharci iyo doorashooyin, ee aan lagu xallin rabshado,” ayuu yiri. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in dowladdiisu ay geeddi-socodka dib-u-habeynta dastuurka kala tashatay hoggaamiyeyaasha siyaasadda, dowlad-goboleedyada, bulshada rayidka ah, haweenka, dhalinyarada iyo Soomaalida dibadda. Hase yeeshee, hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ayaa ku doodaya in dowladda ay si keligeed ah u maamushay qeybo muhiim ah oo ka mid ah geeddi-socodka, isla markaana wadahadallo hore oo lagu doonayey heshiis doorasho aysan wax natiijo ah kasoo bixin. Khilaafka doorashada Wadahadalladii ugu dambeeyey ee dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka ayaa bishii July kusoo dhammaaday heshiis la’aan, kadib markii labada dhinac ay isku mari waayeen nidaamka codbixinta iyo cidda maamuleysa doorashooyinka soo socda. Inkasta oo dowladda iyo mucaaradku ay labaduba taageerayaan in Soomaaliya ay u gudubto doorasho toos ah, haddana waxay si weyn isugu khilaafsan yihiin qaabka loo hirgelinayo. Dowladda federaalka ayaa dooneysa in doorashada lagu galo xisbiyo siyaasadeed oo diiwaangashan, iyadoo ay maamuleyso guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka. Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa dhinaciisa soo jeediyey nidaam ku-meel-gaar ah oo shacabka siinaya fursad ay si toos ah u codeeyaan, balse weli lagu ilaalinayo nidaamka awood-qeybsiga beelaha ee 4.5 marka la qeybinayo kuraasta baarlamaanka. Khilaafka waxaa sii adkeeyey wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka ee baarlamaanka ansixiyey bishii March, kuwaas oo muddada xilka madaxweynaha iyo baarlamaanka ka dhigay shan sano halkii ay markii hore ka ahayd afar sano. Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa Golaha Ammaanka ka codsaday inuu taageero waxa uu ugu yeeray “hannaan doorasho oo loo dhan yahay, lana fulin karo”, kaas oo khuseeya hay’adaha federaalka iyo kuwa dowlad-goboleedyada. Waxa uu sidoo kale dalbaday hannaan ay dhinacyada caalamku ku dhex-dhexaadiyaan siyaasiyiinta Soomaalida, kuna dammaanad-qaadaan heshiis kasta oo laga gaaro khilaafka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa dhankiisa Golaha Guud ee QM u sheegay in Soomaaliya ay galayso marxalad cusub oo dimoqraadi ah, taas oo muwaadiniintu ay codkooda ku go’aaminayaan cidda maamuleysa awoodda siyaasadeed. “Tani waa bog cusub oo horumar leh, halkaas oo awoodda siyaasadeed ay go’aaminayaan muwaadiniinta, iyadoo dastuurku hagayo, sarreynta sharciguna ilaalineyso,” ayuu yiri madaxweynaha. items.title: Mareykanka oo soo masaafuriyay Soomaali lagu hayay xabsiga Guantánamo Bay
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa Soomaaliya u masaafurisay siddeed nin oo Soomaali ah, kuwaas oo muddo ku dhow bil lagu hayay saldhigga ciidamada badda Mareykanka ee Guantánamo Bay ee dalka Cuba. Raggaasi ayaa lagu hayay xarunta kaddib markii ay hay’adaha socdaalka Mareykanka ku soo rogeen amarro masaafurin ah. Khamiistii ayay mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanku bilaabeen in Soomaaliya dib loogu celiyo, iyadoo tallaabadan ay qeyb ka tahay kiisaskooda socdaalka. Ragga la masaafuriyey waxaa ka mid ahaa Adam Abdullah, 31 jir ah, oo muddo ku noolaa gobolka Minnesota, kana shaqaynayay farsamada baabuurta xilli uu sugayay go’aanka codsigiisa magangelyo. Sidoo kale Adam ayaa sheegay in wakiillo ka tirsan hay’adda socdaalka iyo fulinta xuduudaha Maraykanka (ICE) ay xireen 12-kii Diseembar, xilli ay dowladdu bilowday howlgalkii ay ugu magac dartay Operation Metro Surge. Sida uu sheegay, marka laga reebo laba ganaax oo baabuurta la xiriiray, uusan lahayn wax dambi ah oo laga diiwaangeliyey Minnesota. Wuxuu Maraykanka yimid horraantii 2023, wuxuuna si sharci ah uga shaqaynayay makaanik. Guantánamo Bay ayaa ah saldhig ciidan oo Mareykanku ku leeyahay Cuba, waxaana muddo dheer loo adeegsanayay xarun lagu hayo maxaabiis iyo dad ay dowladda Mareykanku u aragto inay ku lug leeyihiin arrimo amni ama kiisaska kale ee la xiriira dowladda. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ku qaadeen Sacuudiga
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudiga hoggaamiyo ee dagaalka adag kula jira Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegay inuu qabtay oo uu burburiyay diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn iyo gantaallo ballistic ah oo ay Xuutiyiintu soo rideen. Afhayeen u hadlay isbahaysiga ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in difaaca cirka Sacuudigu uu qabtay labada diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn, kuwaas oo Xuutiyiintu u ganeen dhanka magaalada Riyaad. Sidoo kale wuxuu intaas ku daray in difaaca cirka Sacuudigu uu qabtay oo burburiyay laba gantaal oo ballistic ah oo Xuutiyiintu ku bartilmaameedsadeen magaalada Khamis Mushait, oo ku taalla koonfur-galbeed Sacuudiga. Dhanka kae, Boqortooyada Sacuudiga ayaa xalay soo saaray digniino ku aaddan khatar suurtagal ah oo ka dhici karta Khamis Mushait. Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Iiraan ayaa qaaday weerarro cusub, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa lagu beegsaday Riyaad, iyagoo sii waday weerarrada inkastoo ay beesha caalamku cambaareysay. Dhawaan Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa si kulul u cambaareeyay kororka weerarrada Xuutiyiintu ku hayaan Sacuudiga, isagoo sheegay in weerarradu waxyeello u geysteen dad rayid ah, oo ay ku jiraan haween iyo carruur. Xuutiyiintu waxay sidoo kale weerarro ka fuliyeen meelaha muhiimka u ah maraakiibta shidaalka ee Sacuudiga, iyagoo carqaladeeyay isu-socodka badda ee gobolka. Weerarrada iyo xiisadaha ka dhashay ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeeshay qiimaha tamarta. The post Wararkii ugu dambeeyay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ku qaadeen Sacuudiga appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: “Somaliland waxa Mareykanka ku qabsaday waa cuqubo Rabbaani ah,” waxaa sidaas yiri…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Cabdirashiid Xaashi oo ah falanqeeye siyaasadeed iyo wasiir hore oo heer federaal ah ayaa ka hadlay fashilka safarkii hoggaanka Somaliland ee Mareykanka, xilli maamulka uu dadaal xooggan ugu jiro doonistiisa gooni-u-goosadka. Cabdirashiid ayaa sheegay in sababta fashilka keentay ay tahay in hoggaanka Somaliland ay haleeshay “cuqubbo Rabbaani ah” oo ka dhalatay garab-ka-bixii ay dano ku-meel-gaar ah awgood, garabkooda uga bexeen shacabka Falastiin ee dulman. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in garab istaaga Somaliland ee raggii mas’uulka ka ahaa xasuuqa iyo “isir-goynta” ka dhacday Gaza ee loo geystay carruurta Falastiiniyiinta ay waji gabax caalami ah dhex joojisay maamulka. “Xasuuqa Gaza ayaa keentay in dowladihii Yurub iyo xitaa shacabkii Marakanku ay Natenyahu iyo kooxdiisa ka guureen, halka Cirro iyo koxdiisu u guureen. Sida ay sheegtay UNICEF USA, in ka badan 64,000 oo carruur Falastiiniyiin ah ayaa la dilay ama la naafeeyey tan iyo Oktoobar 2023,” ayuu Cabdirashiid ku yiri qoraal uu soo saaray. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli hoggaanka Somaliland uu dadaal ugu jiro sidii uu u heli lahaa taageero caalami ah oo ku aaddan doonista gooni-u-goosadka, iyadoo safarkiisa Mareykanka uu dhaliyay hadal-heyn siyaasadeed. Hoos ka aqriso qoraalka oo dhameystiran: Kooxda Cirro waxa Maraykanka ku qabsaday cuqubay u eg tahay Sababta safarkii madaxweynaha Somaliland iyo kooxdiisa ee Maraykanku uu u harreereeyey fashilaad is wada fangashan (isdaba socda) — oo xitaaal xalay waxaan ujedey taraarax kale oo hor leh, markii su’aal hiillo (camiraad) u ekayd oo uu Cirro weydiiyey maalqabeen Ugandhees ahi ay si uun ugu leexatay Idi Amin Dada!, iyadoo kaaliye Iidlena baaq aan miro dhalin isku dayay inuu wax caymiyo); Tiiyoo maalintii ka horreyseyna Dr. Beyle iyo Dr. Fadal lagu eryanayey mid ka mid ah waddooyinka New York halka ayna ka sii horreysey Qosol-jabkii Laughter-gate. Sababta waxaas oo dhammi u dheceen waxay aniga iila eg tahay in ay dhacday ama ragaas ay haleeshay CUQUBO Rabbaani ah — oo ka dhalatay garab-ka-bixii ay kooxdani (dano ku-meel-gaar ah awgood), garabkooda ka bexeen shacabka Falastiin ee dulman iyo la faraqa-ku-xirashada raggii shacabkaas u geystay xasuuqa iyo isir-goynta adduunku ka argagaxay gaar ahaan carruurta Gaza. Taasoo keentay in dowladihii Yurub iyo xitaa shacabkii Marakanku ay Natenyahu iyo kooxdiisa ka guureen, halka Cirro iyo koxdiisu u guureen. Sida ay sheegtay UNICEF USA, in ka badan 64,000 oo carruur Falastiiniyiin ah ayaa la dilay ama la naafeeyey tan iyo Oktoobar 2023. Adduunka Rabbi ayaa iska leh, sida Suubanaha Nabigeennu sheegayna habaarka ama inkaarta kuwa la dulmiyey iyo Rabbina waxba uma dhexeeyaan; Marka markii ay nimanku soo labtaan halloo sheego in ay fudaydkii ay galeen ka toobad keenaan, isagana haraan Netanyahu, Smotrich iyo Ben-Gvir. Nin ku jecel baa runta kuu sheega. Towbadunna waa furan tahay. Ragguna waa khaldamaa. Ee akhyaareey u-turn ama kala wareeg sameeya. Ilaahayna Soomaalida gees ha ka mariyo cuqubada aad noo soo jiiddeen. Qab iyo isla weynina yaysan taladaan idinka indha tirin oo Jaamac Gaamushow diinta waa taqaan ee lafahaaga caynso. Oo waa tii Alle yiri: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَـٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ Maalin indhuhu argagax la taagmayaan! Oo Alle waatuu yiri, وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ The post “Somaliland waxa Mareykanka ku qabsaday waa cuqubo Rabbaani ah,” waxaa sidaas yiri… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Puntland forces free hijacked oil tanker Sibu 1 off Somalia’s coast, all 20 crew safe
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Puntland’s maritime police force freed the oil tanker MT Sibu 1 on Friday, ending a five-week hijacking off Somalia’s northern coast after a 48-hour operation that left all 20 crew members unharmed, regional officials said. The Puntland Maritime Police Force (PMPF) said its units stormed the Eritrean-flagged tanker in waters off the Mudug coast, disarming the pirates holding it and securing the vessel without casualties among the hostages. Mohamed Jama, a PMPF commander involved in the raid, said the assault had been underway for two days before the ship was retaken. “The ship is free and the pirates are all in the hands of our forces,” Jama said. Footage shared online showed PMPF forces firing as they approached the tanker before boarding and disarming the pirates found aboard. Six armed men seized the Sibu 1 on August 20 roughly 136 nautical miles east of Al Mukalla, Yemen, in the Gulf of Aden, according to the UK Maritime Trade Operations agency, then steered the tanker toward the Puntland coast. It is the sixth commercial vessel hijacked off the Horn of Africa since April, part of a piracy resurgence in waters that had seen attacks fall sharply over the past decade. The tanker was carrying about 228,000 barrels of gasoil and had been bound for Port Sudan when it was taken. items.title: Guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka dowladda oo qaaday tallaabo dhabar-jab ku ah Xamza
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka ee dowladda ayaa maanta fuliyay qaraarkii kasoo baxay Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ee lagu laalay go’aankii dhawaan kasoo baxay xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre ee ku aadanaa in xilalka agaasime-waaxeedyada wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha kale ee dowladda lagu buuxiyo hannaan tartan ah. Guddoonka Baarlamaanka ayaa Khamiistii amar ku bixiyay in guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka ee dowladda loo madaxbanneeyo gudashada waajibaadkiisa iyo fulinta hawlaha sharci ahaan loo igmaday ee ay kamid tahay shaqo qoridda, magacabidda iyo dalacsiinta shaqaalaha rayidka dowladda. Waxaa kale oo la faray inuu u hoggaansamo kala madaxbanaanida hay’adaha dowladda ee fulinta, garsoorka iyo sharcidajinta ee la xiriira arrimaha shaqaalaha. Intaas kadib guddiga ayaa ugu dmabeyn u hoggaansamay tallaabada Baarlamaanka, wuxuuna joojiyay boosaskii la xayaysiiyay ee agaasimeyaasha waaxda maamulka shaqaalaha ee wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha Dowladda. Tallaabadan ayaa dhabar-jab wayn ku ah Ra’iisul wasaaraha oo damacsanaa qorshe dib u habeyn loogu sameynayo shaqaalaha dowladda. “Iyadoo la fulinayo Qaraarka Golaha Shacabka ee summaddiisu tahay Tix: GHSH/B-11/23/09/2026, kuna taariikheysan 23/09/2026, kaasoo ujeeddadiisu tahay Qaraarka Golaha Shacabka ee Laalista Xeer Lr. 132 ee 11/05/2025 iyo Qaraarka Higelinta Hannaanka Tartanka Furan ee Shaqaalaha Dowladda ee Doorsoocasho ee Ka soo baxay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Lr. 205 ee 17/09/2026. Si waafaqsan Qodobka 1aad ee Qaraarka Golaha Shacabka BJFS, waxaa la hakiyey boosaskii la xayeysiiyey ee Agaasimiyaasha Waaxda Maamulka Shaqaalaha ee Wasaaradda & Hay’adaha Dowladda,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka uu soo saaray guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka. Sidoo kale, waxaa la faray dhammaan wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka ee Soomaaliya in ay ka gutaan waajibaadka kaga aadan fulinta Qaraarka Golaha Shacabka. Waxaa kale oo qoraalka lasii raaciyay “Sidaas darteed, si waafaqsan Qodobka 2aad ee Qaraarka iyo Qodobka 158aad iyo 159aad ee Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka ee Federaalka, waxa uu waajibaadkiisa u gudan doonaa si waafaqsan Dastuurka, sidoo kale, Guddiga wuxuu warbixinno joogto ah siin doonaa Golaha Shacabka arrimaha la xiriira fulinta qaraarka iyo tallaabooyinkiisa waxqabadkiisa”. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Arrintan ayaa keentay is-qab-qabsi awoodeed oo durbo ka dhex bilowday guddoonka Baarlamaanka iyo xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaaraha. Is-haysiga labada xafiis ayaa loo arkaa mid salka ku haya ku tartanka awoodda iyo saamaynta siyaasadda ee dalka. items.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo ka digtay khatarta cunno-yarida ee ka dhalan karta El Nino
items.description: Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay inay heshay kaliya ku dhowaad 20 boqolkiiba lacagta ay u baahan tahay si loogu diyaar garoobo dhibaatooyinka cunno-yarida ee laga cabsi qabo inay ka dhashaan xaaladda cimilada ee El Niño . Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ku qiyaastay in loo baahan yahay 202 milyan oo doolar si loogu diyaargaroobo wax ka qabashada dhibaatooyinka la xiriira cunno-yarida ee laga filan karo 22 dal oo loo aqoonsaday inay khatar sare ku jiraan . sida ay sheegtay AFP oo soo xiganaysa sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan Qaramada Midoobay, illaa hadda waxaa la helay qiyaastii shan meelood meel lacagtaas. Hay’adaha saadaasha cimilada ayaa ka digaya in El Niño uu keeni karo isbeddello cimilo oo baahsan, kuwaas oo meelo ka mid ah dunida ka dhalin kara abaaro , halka meelo kalena ay ka dhici karaan roobab xooggan iyo fatahaado . Xaaladdan ayaa walaac gaar ah laga muujinayaa maadaama dalal badan oo ka mid ah kuwa halista ku jira ay durba la tacaalayaan cunno-yari ba’an , dhaqaale xumo iyo xaalado bani’aadannimo oo nugul. Abaaro daba dheeraada ama fatahaado xooggan ayaa sii dhaawici kara wax-soo-saarka beeraha, xoolaha iyo ilaha biyaha, taasoo cadaadis dheeraad ah saari karta bulshooyinka nugul. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa muhiimad gaar ah siinaysa in tallaabooyin hore loo qaado ka hor inta aysan xaaladaha cimiladu isu beddelin dhibaatooyin bani’aadannimo oo waaweyn. Dhaqaale la’aanta hadda jirta ayaa hase yeeshee adkeyn karta in la helo raashin, biyo, adeegyo caafimaad iyo taageero kale oo degdeg ah marka ay dhibaatooyinku soo baxaan. Khataraha la xiriira El Niño ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeelan kara dadka ku tiirsan beeraha iyo xoolaha, gaar ahaan bulshooyinka dakhligoodu hooseeyo ee aan haysan awood dhaqaale oo ay kaga hortagaan saameynta abaaraha ama fatahaadaha. Qaramada Midoobay waxay sidaas darteed ku boorrinaysaa deeq-bixiyeyaasha iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah inay kordhiyaan maalgelinta diyaar-garowga, si loo yareeyo saameynta ay dhibaatooyinka cimiladu ku yeelan karaan dadka ku nool dalalka halista sare ku jira. Haddii aan la helin dhaqaalaha loo baahan yahay, waxaa kordhi kara khatarta ah in xaaladaha cimilada ee El Niño ay sii xumeeyaan cunno-yarida iyo baahiyaha bani’aadannimo ee ka jira dalalka horeyba u nugul.
