items.title: Local Forces, Faster Results
items.description: Said A. Ali, Researcher INTRODUCTION When pirates seized the oil tanker MT SIBU 1, also known as SEAMUL, off Yemen on August 20, 2026, help came not from an international navy or foreign warship, but from Puntland’s own maritime police. Within 48 hours, the tanker and its cargo were safe. The Puntland Maritime Police Force (PMPF) captured 47 pirates involved in the hijacking. One was killed, five were wounded, and 41 were detained unharmed. All 20 crew members were rescued, including 16 Indians, two Syrians, one Iraqi, and one Sudanese. This was not the first time. In December 2012, the same force freed MV Iceberg 1, a cargo ship whose owner, Azal Shipping, went bankrupt and abandoned ransom talks, leaving the crew captive for nearly 1,000 days. Two crew members died. After a 15-day blockade, PMPF stormed the ship, losing one soldier, and brought the 22 surviving crew members home. Fourteen years apart, these rescues point to the same lesson. local forces can deliver results when trusted to lead. Yet piracy off Puntland’s coast was allowed to fade from priority rather than being dismantled. As funding and attention shifted elsewhere, pirate attacks were rising again by 2024. That gap does not prove local forces cannot solve the problem; it shows they have rarely received sustained support. If Puntland makes maritime security a funded priority, the successes of Sibu 1 and Iceberg 1 could become lasting rather than occasional. The Issues Puntland’s record shows local forces can succeed when trusted to lead. What has not followed is investment commensurate with that success. Consider Calmiskaad. Since late 2024, Puntland’s Counter Terrorism Forces have waged a sustained campaign against ISIS Somalia in the Bari mountains, known as Operation Hilaac. The US and UAE support the operation with airstrikes and logistics, but Puntland forces remain in command. The campaign has been funded and prioritized for over a year. It shows that local forces can do more than perform when given the lead, they can excel when properly resourced. Puntland’s coastal forces, including PMPF, have not received the same commitment. Iceberg 1 and Sibu 1 are 14 years apart not because success is rare, but because piracy slid down Puntland’s priority list after the 2012–2013 crackdown. Funding and attention moved elsewhere, even though the threat remained. By 2024, piracy was rising again, and a weakened maritime force was caught off guard. That weakness was a choice, not a coincidence. The case for local forces becomes stronger when foreign patrols are examined honestly. International navies were not built around Somalia; they follow shifting global crises, from piracy to Red Sea attacks and Gulf tensions. As attention moves, Somalia’s coast receives less coverage. Even at their busiest, foreign patrols largely deterred or intercepted threats from a distance. They did not storm hijacked ships. Puntland’s coastal forces have now done so twice, freeing vessels and crews where foreign patrols could not. That is the advantage foreign missions cannot replicate permanence. A foreign patrol can leave when global priorities change. Puntland’s coastal forces cannot, because they have nowhere else to go. Local-led security can therefore be more sustainable than a temporary outside commitment. It depends on Puntland’s willingness to invest in the force already standing on its coast. Still, force alone will not end piracy. Rescues like Sibu 1 and Iceberg 1 stop hijackings after they happen; they do not remove the reasons young men turn to piracy. The 2026 resurgence is rooted in instability on land, not only gaps at sea (RUSI, 2026), and UNODC argues that piracy is ultimately defeated through courts, ports, and local economies not only at sea. A properly funded coastal force can prevent hijackings and rescue crews. But lasting progress also requires courts to process captured pirates, economic alternatives for young people recruited by pirate networks, and action against illegal foreign fishing, which has pushed coastal communities toward piracy. Local forces are the most reliable security response, tackling piracy’s root causes requires more than any force can provide alone. Conclusion and Recommendations The record is clear. When Puntland’s local forces are trusted to lead, they deliver results. Iceberg 1 and Sibu 1 show their coastal capability. Calmiskaad shows what that capability can achieve with sustained funding. The missing piece is Puntland’s decision to close the gap between what its forces can do and the resources they receive. Three steps follow. First, fund coastal forces as a national priority, not an emergency response. Puntland treats counter-terrorism as a standing commitment, with predictable budgets and long-term planning. Maritime security deserves the same approach, rather than a scramble for resources after a ship is seized. Second, ask international partners to support coastal forces as they support Operation Hilaac. The US and UAE provide airstrikes and logistics while leaving command in local hands. That model funding and equipment without foreign forces taking the lead should extend to maritime security. Third, pair force funding with the land-based work piracy requires. Well-resourced local forces can prevent hijackings and rescue crews. Ending piracy for good also requires courts that can process captured pirates, real jobs for coastal youth recruited by pirate networks, and a serious response to illegal foreign fishing. Puntland does not need to import security. Its forces have shown, twice and 14 years apart, that they can provide it. What remains unproven is Puntland’s willingness to fund that capability before the next ship is seized, rather than after. References Hockey, C. (2026, September 23). items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo weerar culus ka fuliyay Sacuudiga
items.description: Riyaad ( Raxanreeb Online) Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudiga hoggaamiyo ee dagaalka kula jira Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegay inuu qabtay oo burburiyay diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn iyo gantaallo ballistic ah oo ay Xuutiyiintu soo rideen. Afhayeen u hadlay isbahaysiga ayaa sheegay in difaaca cirka Sacuudigu uu qabtay oo burburiyay laba diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn, kuwaas oo Xuutiyiintu u ganeen dhanka magaalada Riyad. Afhayeenku wuxuu intaas ku daray in difaaca cirka Sacuudigu uu sidoo kale qabtay oo burburiyay laba gantaal oo ballistic ah oo Xuutiyiintu ku bartilmaameedsadeen magaalada Khamis Mushait, oo ku taalla koonfur-galbeed Sacuudiga. Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo taageero ka hela Iran ayaa qaaday weerarro cusub, oo ay ku jiraan weerarro lagu qaaday Riyad, iyagoo sii waday weerarrada inkastoo ay beesha caalamku cambaareysay. Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa hore u cambaareeyay kororka weerarrada Xuutiyiintu ku hayaan Sacuudiga, isagoo sheegay in weerarradu waxyeello u geysteen dad rayid ah, oo ay ku jiraan haween iyo carruur. Xuutiyiintu waxay sidoo kale weerarro ka fuliyeen meelaha muhiimka u ah maraakiibta shidaalka ee Sacuudiga, iyagoo carqaladeeyay isu-socodka badda ee gobolka. Weerarrada iyo xiisadaha ka dhashay ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeeshay qiimaha tamarta. The post Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo weerar culus ka fuliyay Sacuudiga appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Safiirka cusub ee Turkiga u qaabilsan Soomaaliya oo xilka la wareegay
items.description: Safiirka cusub ee Jamhuuriyadda Türkiye u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan , ayaa si rasmi ah u bilaabay waajibaadkiisa diblomaasiyadeed ee Muqdisho, xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkigu uu marayo marxalad muhiim ah oo iskaashi iyo xiriir diblomaasiyadeed. Safiir Alkan ayaa sheegay inuu sharaf weyn u arko inuu Soomaaliya u matalo Türkiye xilli la xusayo 60-guurada aasaaska xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee labada dal , iyadoo sidoo kale sanadkan uu ku beegan yahay 15-guurada booqashadii taariikhiga ahayd ee Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, uu ku tagay Soomaaliya . Madaxweynaha Turkiga ayaa booqashadii Muqdisho ku tagay xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahaysay xaalad bani’aadannimo oo aad u daran, waxaana booqashadaasi noqotay mid muhiim u ah xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan. Safiirka cusub ayaa sheegay inuu Muqdisho kula kulmay dhallinyaro Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo la yeeshay kulan iyo wada sheekeysi uu ku tilmaamay mid diirran. Wuxuu xusay in dhallinyaradu ay muujiyeen aragtidooda ku aaddan horumarka amni iyo xasilloonida laga dareemayo Muqdisho iyo nawaaxigeeda sannadihii u dambeeyay. Alkan ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay in Turkiga ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, horumarinta iyo xoojinta awoodda hay’adaha dowladda . Hadalkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya iyadoo xiriirka labada dal uu ku fidsan yahay dhinacyo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, waxbarashada, caafimaadka, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga iyo gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Safiirka Ferhat Alkan ayaa sheegay in mudada uu xilka hayo uu xoogga saari doono horumarinta xiriirka labada dal, isaga oo tilmaamay in iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye lagu dhisayo is-ixtiraam, kalsooni iyo dano wadaag ah . Wuxuu sheegay in hadafka ugu weyn uu yahay in xiriirka labada dal loo sii horumariyo jihada lagu gaari karo barwaaqada iyo daryeelka labada shacab ee uu ku tilmaamay kuwo saaxiib iyo walaalo ah. Safiirka ayaa sidoo kale ballanqaaday inuu dhegaysan doono fikradaha iyo talooyinka muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed iyo saaxiibbada Turkiga ee ku sugan Soomaaliya, isaga oo sheegay in albaabbada Safaaradda Türkiye ay mar walba u furnaan doonaan dadka Soomaaliyeed . Bilowga shaqada Safiir Ferhat Alkan ayaa sidaas ku soo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye ay xusayaan lixdan sano oo xiriir diblomaasiyadeed ah, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan in xiriirkooda iyo iskaashigooda loo sii gudbiyo heerar cusub.

items.title: Nin Soomaali oo maxkamad loo soo taagay inuu isku dayay dilka laba qof oo Yahuud ah
items.description: London (Caasimada Online) – Nin Soomaali haysta dhalashada Britain ayaa Jimcihii iska fogeeyey saddex eedeyn oo isku day dil ah, oo laba ka mid ah la xiriiraan weerar mindi loo adeegsaday oo bishii April lagu dhaawacay laba nin oo Yuhuud ah oo ku sugnaa waqooyiga London. Essa Suleiman, oo 45 jir ah kuna dhashay London, ayaa kasoo muuqday maxkamadda Old Bailey ee London, halkaas oo uu ku diiday laba eedeyn oo isku day dil ah oo ka dhashay weerarkii 29-kii April ka dhacay xaafadda Golders Green, oo ay ku nool yihiin dad badan oo Yuhuud ah. Waxa uu sidoo kale diiday eedeyn saddexaad oo isku day dil ah, taas oo la xiriirta nin ay muddo dheer is-yaqaaneen oo lagu weeraray koonfurta London saacado ka hor dhacdadii Golders Green. Suleiman ayaa sidoo kale diiday eedeyn ah inuu meel fagaare ah ku haystay mindi gacanteedu madow tahay. Dacwad-oogaha Deanna Heer KC ayaa maxkamadda hore ugu sheegtay in Suleiman lagu eedeeyey inuu marka hore tegay guri ku yaalla Southwark, halkaas oo uu mindi ku weeraray nin lagu magacaabo Ishmail Hussein oo ay saaxiibo ahaayeen muddo ku dhow 20 sano. Booliska ayaa sheegay in dhacdadaas laga soo wariyey Great Dover Street abaare 8:50 subaxnimo. Ninka guriga joogay ayaa waxaa soo gaaray dhaawacyo fudud, halka tuhmanaha uu goobta ka baxay ka hor intii aysan boolisku imaan. Saraakiisha ayaa deegaanka ka raadiyey balse waqtigaas ma aysan helin. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaa sheegay in Suleiman uu markii dambe gaadiidka dadweynaha ku tegay Golders Green, halkaas oo uu yimid Highfield Avenue. Halkee ayuu ka dhacay weerarka Yahuudda? Sida maxkamadda loo sheegay, qofka ugu horreeyey ee halkaas lagu weeraray wuxuu ahaa Shloime Rand, oo 34 jir ah, kaas oo wax ku baranayey synagogue ku yaalla Highfield Avenue. Dacwad-oogaha ayaa sheegay in ninka lagu eedeeyey uu u soo dhaqaaqay Rand, kadibna hal mar xabadka kaga dhuftay mindi, taas oo sababtay in sambabkiisu dhaawacmo. Waxaa markaas la weeraray Norman Shine, oo 76 jir ah, kaas oo dacwad-oogayaashu sheegeen inuu soo gaaray dhowr dhaawac oo mindi ah, oo uu ku jiro dhaawac qoorta ah. Waxa uu isbitaalka ku jiray dhowr maalmood. Labada nin ayaa maxkamadda lagu sheegay inay xilliga weerarka xirnaayeen dhar si cad u muujinayey inay ka tirsan yihiin bulshada Yuhuudda Orthodox-ka ah. Dhacdada ayaa ugu dambeyn joogsatay markii qof shacab ah uu isku dayay inuu farageliyo oo mindida ka qaado ninka weerarka lagu eedeeyey. Booliska iyo adeegyada gurmadka ayaa kadib goobta yimid. Booliska ka hortagga argagixisada ayaa sheegay in tuhmanuhu sidoo kale isku dayay inuu weeraro saraakiishii goobta tagtay, ka hor inta aan lagu qabannin qalabka korontada ee Taser-ka. Wax sarkaal boolis ah kuma dhaawacmin dhacdada. Xiriirka argagixiso oo meesha laga saaray Booliska Britain ayaa isla maalintii weerarka si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay in dhacdada Golders Green loo baarayo fal argagixiso, waxaana baaritaanka hoggaaminayey Counter Terrorism Policing London. Hase yeeshee, arrintaas ayaa Jimcihii yeelatay weji cusub. Dacwad-ooge Heer ayaa maxkamadda ka sheegtay in Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) ay dib-u-eegis ku sameysay caddeymaha, kadibna go’aamisay inaan dacwadda maxkamadda lagu sii wadin iyadoo lagu saleynayo xiriir argagixiso. Counter Terrorism Policing London ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in dacwad-oogayaashu aysan maxkamadda ka codsan doonin in falalka lagu xiro argagixiso. Si kastaba, hay’addu waxay sheegtay in CPS ay rumeysan tahay inay jirto caddeyn ku filan oo lagu tilmaami karo falalka lagu eedeeyey Suleiman ee Golders Green inay yihiin dambiyo nacayb ku saleysan. Taliyaha Counter Terrorism Policing London Helen Flanagan ayaa sheegtay in dacwad-oogayaashu qorsheynayaan inay arrintaas u soo bandhigaan garsooraha arrin culays dheeraad ah ku yeelan karta xukunka haddii eedeysanaha dambiga lagu helo. Go’aankaas ayaa ka dhigan in inkastoo boolisku markii hore dhacdada ku tilmaameen weerar argagixiso, dacwad-oogayaashu aysan hadda ku doodi doonin maxkamadda in falalka lagu eedeeyey Suleiman ay lahaayeen xiriir argagixiso. Suleiman weli wuu diidan yahay dhammaan eedeymaha, mana jirto wax xukun ah oo ilaa hadda lagu riday. Wax sarkaal boolis ah kuma dhaawacmin dhacdada. Xiriirka argagixiso oo meesha laga saaray Booliska Britain ayaa isla maalintii weerarka si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay in dhacdada Golders Green loo baarayo fal argagixiso, waxaana baaritaanka hoggaaminayey Counter Terrorism Policing London. Hase yeeshee, arrintaas ayaa Jimcihii yeelatay weji cusub. Dacwad-ooge Heer ayaa maxkamadda ka sheegtay in Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) ay dib-u-eegis ku sameysay caddeymaha, kadibna go’aamisay inaan dacwadda maxkamadda lagu sii wadin iyadoo lagu saleynayo xiriir argagixiso. Counter Terrorism Policing London ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in dacwad-oogayaashu aysan maxkamadda ka codsan doonin in falalka lagu xiro argagixiso. Si kastaba, hay’addu waxay sheegtay in CPS ay rumeysan tahay inay jirto caddeyn ku filan oo lagu tilmaami karo falalka lagu eedeeyey Suleiman ee Golders Green inay yihiin dambiyo nacayb ku saleysan. Taliyaha Counter Terrorism Policing London Helen Flanagan ayaa sheegtay in dacwad-oogayaashu qorsheynayaan inay arrintaas u soo bandhigaan garsooraha arrin culays dheeraad ah ku yeelan karta xukunka haddii eedeysanaha dambiga lagu helo. Go’aankaas ayaa ka dhigan in inkastoo boolisku markii hore dhacdada ku tilmaameen weerar argagixiso, dacwad-oogayaashu aysan hadda ku doodi doonin maxkamadda in falalka lagu eedeeyey Suleiman ay lahaayeen xiriir argagixiso. Suleiman weli wuu diidan yahay dhammaan eedeymaha, mana jirto wax xukun ah oo ilaa hadda lagu riday. The post Nin Soomaali oo maxkamad loo soo taagay inuu isku dayay dilka laba qof oo Yahuud ah appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland offers to rename Berbera Airport after Trump
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro has suggested renaming Berbera International Airport after U.S. President Donald Trump, as his government intensifies a decades-long campaign for independence from Somalia. Irro raised the proposal during an interview with Council on Foreign Relations. This comes after he recently floated the idea of inviting Trump to build a Trump Tower in the capital, Hargeisa. “We are not giving anything for free,” Irro said. “We have to offer something. And we expect the other partner to have the same or equal opportunities.” Why Berbera Matters Berbera sits on the Gulf of Aden, close to the Bab el-Mandeb strait – one of the world’s busiest and most contested shipping corridors, linking the Red Sea to the Indian Ocean. Its airport has one of the longest runways in Africa, built by the Soviet Union in the 1970s and stretching more than 4,000 metres. The port was redeveloped with investment from the United Arab Emirates’ DP World and now anchors a free trade zone that Somaliland’s government presents as an economic gateway for the wider Horn of Africa. Irro has pointed to the port, an 850-kilometre coastline, fisheries, and untapped oil, gas and mineral reserves as leverage in talks with Washington. A Broader Bid for Recognition The airport proposal is one part of a wider package. Irro has said he would consider granting the United States expanded military access, including the possibility of a base at Berbera, and has not ruled out similar arrangements with Israel or other partners. The offer comes against a backdrop of shifting regional alignments. Israel recognised Somaliland in December, the first United Nations member state to do so — a move Hargeisa has cited as evidence that international opinion on its status is moving. The U.S. Africa Command has visited Hargeisa and Berbera to assess the territory’s strategic value, though Washington has not established a military base there. Washington’s Position Remains Unclear No agreement on renaming the airport, granting military access, or formal recognition has been reached. Somalia’s federal government in Mogadishu, which the United States continues to recognise as sovereign over the territory, opposes Somaliland’s independence and remains a U.S. partner on counterterrorism. Somaliland has functioned as a de facto independent state since declaring a break from Somalia in 1991, with its own government, currency and security forces, but it has never secured formal recognition from any UN member. What Comes Next Analysts say Somaliland’s push is unlikely to produce swift recognition given continued U.S. support for Somali sovereignty and regional opposition to redrawing the Horn of Africa’s borders. But officials in Hargeisa are betting that instability along Red Sea shipping lanes – including attacks linked to Houthi forces in Yemen, just across the Gulf from Berbera – will keep Washington’s attention on the territory’s strategic value. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Xoojinta Ammaanka Badda Cas: Qalalaasaha ka Qiiqaya Geeska Afrika
items.description: Khataraha Badda Cas ayaa sii kordhaya, sababtuse aha Xuutiyiinta oo qura ma aha. Loollanada Geeska Afrika ayaa isbuuranaya, sidoo kale, waxay sababayaan faragelinta awoodo dibadeed, taasoo halis cusub ka sii hurinaysa marinbadeed halbowle u ah ganacsiga adduunka. Yemeni soldiers patrol the strategic Bab el-Mandeb Strait, Yemen, Sunday, April 5, 2026. (AP Photo/Abdulnasser Alseddik)Image bypicture alliance / ASSOCIATED PRESS | Abdulnasser Alseddik © Weerarrada ay Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen warshadaha shidaalka ee Sucuudigu waxay sii kordhiyeen aloosnaanta xiisadda iskeed u cakiran ee marinka Baabulmandab. Hasayeeshee kooxdan ay taageerto Iiraan maaha halista keliya ee waxyeellaysa ammaanka Badda Cas. Dhinaca kale ee badda loollan isku maran ayaa ka socda Geeska Afrika, kaas oo ay gadaasha ka hurinayaan awoodo heer dhexe ah oo beretan ku jira. Tanina waxay halis hor leh ku tahay mid ka mid marinnada badda ee ugu muhiimsan caalamka. Waqtigu waa gabaabsi, waayo dagaalka Maraykanka iyo Iiraan u dhexeeyaa wuxuu muujiyay goljilicda marinka Hurmus, taasina waxay cusboonaysiiyay danaynta jidad waxdhoofineed oo beddelkiisa ah. Bilihii Abril iyo May, maalin kasta Sucuudigu wuxuu ka dhoofiyay Badda Cas in u dhexaysa saddex ilaa afar milyan oo foosto oo shidaal ah. Tani waa labanlaabka xaddigii la mariyay marinka Baabulmandab sannadkii 2024. Sidoo kale, mashaariicda tamarta ee lagaga maarmayo marinka Hurmus waxay kordhinayaan ahmiyadda Baabulmandab, sida ballaarinta taxa tuunbooyinka Bari iyo Galbeed ee Sucuudiga, ama khadka la qorshaynayo ee isku xiraya Ciraaq iyo dekedda Caqaba ee Urdun ee Badda Cas. Waxay muujiyeen Xuutiyiintu siday u fududahay in la carqaladeeyo Baabulmandab, halistuse Yaman oo keliya kama imanayso. Waayo dagaalka Suudaan wuxuu xoog ugu sii fidayaa dhibaatada Itoobiya iyo Ereteriya. Waqooyiga Soomaaliyana, waxa isdhexgalay loollanka maxalliga ah iyo tartanka Sucuudiga iyo Imaaraadka iyo ka Israa’iil iyo Turkiga, taas oo qalalaase cusub ka oogaysa Gacanka Cadan. Isla waqtigaas waxaa soo labakacleeyay burcadbadeeddii oo taageero xooggan ka helaya ururka al-Shabaab. Intii u dhexaysay Abriil iyo Meey waxay afduubeen burcadbadeed Soomaali ahi saddex doonyood oo marayay Gacanka Cadan, kuwaas oo ay laba ka mid ahi ahaayeen kuwo shidaal. Tani waa tiro afduub oo ka badan intii aynu aragnay shantii sanno ee ugu danbeeyay oo la isku daray. Faafitaanka diyaaradaha iswada ee raqiiska ahi waxay ka dhigan tahay in dawladaha iyo jihooyinka aan xukuumiga ahayni ay qarash kooban ku beegsan karaan marinbadeedkan ciriiriga ah. Inkasta oo aanay weli kooxo kale ku dhaqaaqin xeeladaha Xuutiyiinta, haddana kooxda Daacish ee Soomaaliya ayaa bishi Jeenaweri ka fulisay Budlaan weerarkii ugu horreeyay ee loo diiwaangeliyay ee ay fulisay diyaarad iswadda. Sida oo kale warbixinno ayaa sheegaya inay kooxda al-Shabaab u adeegsatay diyaarado iswada ujeeddooyin sahan iyo kuwo borobagaando. Carqalad kasta oo ku timaadda qulqulka ganacsi iyo qulqulka tamareed ee marinka BaabulMandab wuxuu yeelanayaa raadayn aad u dhaafsiisan gobolka, gaar ahaanna wuxuu taabanayaa Yurubiyaanka tamarta soo dhoofsada iyo dhaqaalayaasha ku tiirsan waxdhoofinta. Sidaas darteed, mar kasta oo ay kororto ahmiyadda Badda Casi, waxa isna kordhaya ahmiyadda Geeska Afrika. Iskumilanka Loollanada Geeska Afrika Dagaalka u dhexeeya Ciidamada Xoogga ee Suudaan iyo Ciidamada Gurmadka Degdegga ahi (RSF) ma aha loolan xayndaaban. Loollankani wuxuu keenay barakac wadareed, waxaanu khalkhaliyay xasilloonida dawladaha deriska. Sidoo kale wuxuu lugta la galay hirdanka Itoobiya iyo Ereteriya, arrintan oo kor u qaadaysa haliska iskudhac ballaaran oo ku dhereran Badda Cas. Adis Ababa weli waxay waddaa dadaalka ay ku doonayso inay ku hesho irrid badeed oo Badda Cas ah, gaar ahaan dekadda Casab ee Ereteriya. Asmarina dhankeeda waxay xoojisay xiriirka ay la leedahay hoggaanka gobolka Tigraay, iyo kooxo kale oo mucaarad ah oo gudaha Itoobiya ka jira. Tartanka labadooda ka dhexeeyaana wuxuu ku sii fidayaa Suudaan. Warbixinno ayaa sheegaya iskaashi xoogaysanaya oo ka jira jihada bariga oo u dhexeeya xooggaga Tigraay, ciidanka Suudaan iyo Ereteriya. Sida oo kale Ciidanka Gurmadka Degdegga ah (RSF) ee ku sugan gobolka Niilka Buluugga ah ee Suudaan ayaa taageero ka helaya Itoobiya. Farantan cusub ee ay fureen Ciidanka Gurmadka Degdegga ahi waxay dhinaca ku haysaa dalka Koonfurta Suudaan, oo ay xukuumadiisu isku dayayso inay xakamayso fallaagada kobcaysa ee qabiilka Nooyar, oo ah isirka labaad ee ugu badan dalka. Arrinkani wuxuu ka dhigayaa gobolka xuduudda saddexda dal ee ballaaran aag loollan oo weyn. Colaad kasta oo dhex marta Itoobiya iyo Ereteriya waxay u badan tahay inay lug ku yeelan doonaan kooxaha Suudaan iyo awoodo dibadda ahi, kuwaas oo ay ugu mudan tahay Masar, oo si weyn ugu janjeerta dhanka ciidanka Suudaan iyo Ereteriya. Waxay Masar u aragtaa halis amni oo daran Biyaceliyaha Weyn ee Kacaanka Itoobiya (GERD), kaas oo ku yaalla meel u dhow xuduudda Suudaan . Qalalaasahan waxa sii hurinaya isbahaysiyada Bariga Dhexe ee tartamaya. Tusaale ahaan Masar-Turkiga-iyo-Sucuudigu waxay taageeraan ciidanka Suudaan iyo Ereteriya; halka Imaaraadka iyo Israa’iil ay xiriir la leeyihiin Itoobiya iyo Ciidamada Gurmadka Degdegga ah (RSF). Taageeradan awoodaha shisheeye waxay ku dhiirrigelinaysaa dhinacyada maxalliga ah inay awood ka-badbadis ah isbidaan, taas oo keeni karta iskudhac gobol oo ballaaran, kaasoo halis gelin kara amniga Badda Cas iyo ka gooshitaankeeda. Mawjadda Kacsan ee Soomaaliya Soomaaliya waxay noqon kartaa faranta labaad ee ugu weyn qalalaasaha Badda Cas. Sida uu xaalku ahaa saddexgeeska Itoobiya-Ereteriya-iyo-Suudaan loollannada maxalliga ah waxa ku maran hirdanka Bariga Dhexe ee xasaasiga ah. Diisanbar 2025kii waxay aqoonsatay Israa’iil Jamhuuriyadda Soomaalilaan ee goosatada ah, ee uu Imaaraadku taageero. Waxay labada dhinac kala saxeexdeen heshiisyo amni, oo isugu jira tababbarada iyo iskaashiga sirdoonka. Sida oo kale Israa’iil waxa la filayaa inay dhowaan geyso ciidamo kooban saldhigga Imaaraadka ee Berbera, taas oo la sheegayo inay casriyayni ka socoto. Waxay muujisay booqashadii madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Cirro ee uu Israa’iil ku tegay dhammaadkii Juulay heerka qotada dheer ee uu xiriirka labada geesood marayo. Muqdisho waxay kaga jawaabtay aqoonsigan inay jartay xiriirkii diblomaasiyadeed iyo kii amni ee ay la lahayd Imaaraadka. Waqtigaas laga soo bilaabana waxay u dhowaatay Suduudiga iyo Gadar oo ay la galeen heshiisyo difaac, iyada oo sida oo kalana sii xoojisay isbahaysigii hore ee ay la lahayd Turkiga. Iyada oo badhtanka kaga jirta Abu Dabi laacdankeeda Muqdisho, waxay kordhisay taageerada ay siiso Budlaan iyo Jubbalaan, oo ah laba ismaamul oo Dawladda Federaalka ah xiriirka u jaray sannadkii 2024kii, iyaga oo raba inay sii adkeeyaan madaxbannaanidooda. Ahmiyadda taageeradani waxay sii xoogaysatay xilligan oo ay Soomaaliya gashay khilaaf dhanka hoggaaminta federaalka ah. Maaris 2026 wuxuu ku darsaday madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh muddaxileedkiisa iyo ka Baarlamaanka hal sanno oo dheeraad ah, markiii uu waqtigu ka dhammaaday 15 May. Waxa diiday muddokordhintan shakhsiyaad mucaarid ah, oo ay ku jiraan hoggaanka Jubbalaan iyo Budlaan, iyaga oo ku baaqay in doorasho la qabto. Markii ay dhexdhexaadintii burburtay, waxaa qarxay dagaal u dhexeeya xoogagga Xukuumadda iyo isbahaysiyada Mucaaridka Muqdisho 3dii iyo 4tii Juulaay. Tani waxay ina xasuusinaysaa xasarradii la socotay hannaankii doorashada ee sannadihii 2020 iyo 2021. Inkasta oo ciidamada Federaalka ah ee faraha badan ee caasimadda joogaa ay adkaynayaan in madaxweynaha awood xukunka lagaga rido, haddana qalalaasuhu wuxuu ka oogmi karaa goobo kale. Meesha ugu werwerka badanina waa Waqooyiga Soomaaliya, halkaas oo hirdan maxalli ahi xoog u soo jiidanayo dhinacyo dibadadeed. Laga soo bilaabo ku dhawaaqistii goonigoosadkii 1991, degaankan waxa gacanta ku haysay Soomaalilaan. Balse gobollada bariga ee Sool, Sanaag iyo Cayn gacankuhayntoodu waxay ahayd mid muran ka joogo, oo ay kula loollamayeen beelaha degaanka iyo dawladgoboleedka Budlaan ee deriska la ah. Xiisadahani waxay isu rogeen dagaal hubaysan sannadkii 2023, dagaalkaas oo ay ciidamada beesha Dhulbahante ee dawladda dhexe taageersani ku jebiyeen ciidankii Soomaalilaan. Markaas kaddib Muqdisho waxay taageertay in maamulgoboleed cusub laga dhiso degaankan, maamulkaas oo ah dawladda Waqooyibari, oo ku fadhiya dhul ay sheeganayaan Soomaalilaan iyo Budlaanba. Jaa’isadda weyn ee loo ordayaa waa gobolka Sanaag, ee ku yaalla xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed kaas oo leh ahmiyad istiraatiiji ah. Jilibyada gobolkan deggani waxay taageeradoodu u qaybsan tahay Soomaalilaan, Budlaan iyo Muqdisho, iyada oo abaaraha jiraana ay sii hurinayaan loollanka loogu jiro khayraadka. Qaybsanaanta gobolkan ka jirtaa waxay fursado soojiidasho leh u yihiin dhinacyada dibadda. Waxa jira warbixinno sheegaya inuu Turkigu qorshaynayo saldhig inuu ka samaysto Laasqoray, oo ah magaalada ugu muhiimsan xeebta Sanaag. Waxa lagu arkay xeebtan doonyo Turkigu leeyahay iyo diyaarado ku xiran Imaaraadka. Isla waqtigaas Muqdisho waxay doonaysaa inay kasbato jilibbo reer Budlaan ah iyo ganacsato ku xanaaqsan madaxweynaha maamulka, sidoo kalana waxay ishaartay inay ciidano geyn doonto Soomaalilaan. Caynkaas ayuu Waqooyiga Soomaaliya isugu rogayaa barxad dagaal, oo qaybsanaanta maxalliga ah iyo hirdanka awoodaha dibaddu ku kulmayaan. Waa hirdanka u dhexeeya Sucuudiga iyo Imaaraadka, ama Israa’iil iyo Turkiga. Loollan kasta oo toos ah oo gobolkan ka bilaabmaa wuxuu halis ku yahay Gacanka Cadan, sidoo kale wuxuu fursado u abuurayaa jihooyin kale sida: shabakadaha burcadbadeedda, ururka Daacish ee Soomaaliya, iyo argaggaxisada al-Shabaab, oo dhammaantood ka hawlgala gobolka. Labada urur ee jihaadiga ahi waxay hub laga soo tabriibiyay Xuutiyiinta ka heleen xeebaha gobolka. Dhanbaal ku Socda Yurub Xasilloonidarrada Geeska Afrika wuxuu halis kale ku abuurayaa isaga gooshitaanka Badda Cas, kaas oo toos u saamaynaya amniga iyo xasilloonida dhaqaalaha Yurub. Dhaqaalaha Yurub ee dheeldheelliyayaana ma ka karo inuu qaado culays kale oo kii marinka Hurmus ku soo biira. Sidaas darteed, waa inay Yurub iska dhaafto sawirka laga haysto ee ah inay tahay keliya jiho deeqbixiye ah. Waa inay samayso kahortag isugu jira awood debecsan iyo awood adag. Dhab ahaan Midowga Yurub waxa ka jooga Geeska Afriga laba hawlgal badeed oo kala ah “Aspides” iyo “Atalanta”, laakiin labada hawlgal waxa loo hindisay laba halisood oo kaladuwan. Atalanta waxa loo sameeyay si looga hortago burcadbadeedda Soomaalida, halka Asbides loo aasaasay si ay doonyaha uga ilaaliso weerarrada Xuutiyiinta, iyada oo leh waajibaad difaac oo bareer ah. Maadaama oo ay halista badeed sii kordhayso, waa inuu Midowga Yurub kordhiyo tirada baahsanaanta labadan hawlgal, isla markaana waa in lagu soo kordhiyo waajibaadkooda hawlo weerar, gaar ahaan kuwo ka dhan ah argaggaxisada al-Shabaab iyo ururka Daacish ee Soomaaliya. Arrinkani wuxuu keenayaa xoojinta dadaallada ladagaallanka burcadbadeedda, iyo kordhinta cadaadiska la saarayo dhinacyada gildilaya xasilloonida, isla markaana wuxuu dirayaa dhanbaal amni iyo awooded oo ay Yurub ku leedahay Badda Cas kaas oo la isku hallayn karo. Si loo yareeyo cabsida aargoosi, waa inay reer Yurub niyadda u dejiyaan dawladaha gobolka sida Sucuudiga iyo Jabuuti, una sheegaan in ballaarinta hawlaha weerar laga reebayo Xuutiyiinta. Sidoo kale, waa inay reer Yurub ku dadaalaan inay helaan joogitaan ciidan oo ka yimaadda darafyada reer Aasiya ee danaha waaweyn ka leh amniga Badda Cas, sida Kuuriyada Koonfureed iyo Jabbaan. Isla waqtigaas waa inay Midowga Yurub iyo dawladaha xubnaha ka ahiba si toos ah ula xiriiraa dhinacyada Waqooyiga Soomaaliya, sida Soomaalilaan iyo Budlaan. Waayo joogitaanka xooggan ee reer Yurub ee dhanka amniga iyo horumarku wuxuu kordhin karaa saamaynta lagu yeelanayo gobolka xasarrada badan, taasina waxay wax ka taraysaa dedaaladda loogu jiro xasilintiisa. Sida oo kale waxa hawlgalka Midowga Yurub la siin karaa waajibaad dheeraad ah, tusaale ahaan, inuu taageero hawlgallada ka dhanka ah Daacish iyo al-Shabaab ee ay wadaan Budlaan iyo Xukuumadda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. Wadashaqayntan weyni waxay Yurub siinaysaa saamayn dheeraad ah ay ku riixi karto wadahadallada Xukuumadda Federaalka ah iyo Soomaalilaan iyo Budlaan ee ku saabsan dhulka lagu muransan yahay; iyo inay siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliya ku qalqaalliso xal u helidda ismarinwaaga ka jira doorashada. Iyada oo taas laga duulayo, waa inuu Midowga Yurub ku dhaqmo maangalka wax-is-dhaafsiga si ay taageeradiisa dhaqaale uga qaybqaadato yoolalkan xasillinta gobolka, taageeradaas oo sannadka 2026 dhan 139 milyan oo yuuri, oo isugu jirta 76 Milyan oo oo lagu taageero hawlgalka Midowga Afrika, iyo 63 Milyan oo ah taageerada gargaarka aadaminimo. Waa in Midowga Yurub ay si adag ula shaqeeyaan Maraykanka iyo Ingiriiska, labadooda oo hore u hoggaamiyay dadaallo heshiisiineed oo lagu kalsoon yahay, oo la xiriiray ismariwaagii doorashada iyo dadaallada ammaanka ee Waqooyiga, sida ladagaallanka Daacish. Iskaashi kaas la mid ah ayaa xoojin kara dadaallada lagu xasilinayo xasarrada u dhexaysa Itoobiya iyo Ereteriya, iyada oo ay Waashintoon xiriir la samaysay labada dhinacba dhowaan. Ugu danbayntii, waa mahurto in xirhiir lala yeesho dhammaan dhinacyada saamaynta leh ee Bariga Dhexe. Xasilloonidarrada Geeska Afrika waxa sii hurinaya falalka tartan ee u dhexeeya labada garab ee samaysmaya ee kala ah Sucuudiga-Masar-iyo-Turkiga iyo garabka Israa’iil-iyo-Imaaraadka. Dagaalkii ugu danbeeyay ee Iiraan lala galayna wuxuu sare u qaaday qaddarinta ay dawladahani u hayaan iskaashatooyinka caalamiga ee la isku hallayn karo iyo xasilloonida gobolka. items.fullContent: Khataraha Badda Cas ayaa sii kordhaya, sababtuse aha Xuutiyiinta oo qura ma aha. Loollanada Geeska Afrika ayaa isbuuranaya, sidoo kale, waxay sababayaan faragelinta awoodo dibadeed, taasoo halis cusub ka sii hurinaysa marinbadeed halbowle u ah ganacsiga adduunka. Yemeni soldiers patrol the strategic Bab el-Mandeb Strait, Yemen, Sunday, April 5, 2026. (AP Photo/Abdulnasser Alseddik)Image bypicture alliance / ASSOCIATED PRESS | Abdulnasser Alseddik © Weerarrada ay Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen warshadaha shidaalka ee Sucuudigu waxay sii kordhiyeen aloosnaanta xiisadda iskeed u cakiran ee marinka Baabulmandab. Hasayeeshee kooxdan ay taageerto Iiraan maaha halista keliya ee waxyeellaysa ammaanka Badda Cas. Dhinaca kale ee badda loollan isku maran ayaa ka socda Geeska Afrika, kaas oo ay gadaasha ka hurinayaan awoodo heer dhexe ah oo beretan ku jira. Tanina waxay halis hor leh ku tahay mid ka mid marinnada badda ee ugu muhiimsan caalamka. Waqtigu waa gabaabsi, waayo dagaalka Maraykanka iyo Iiraan u dhexeeyaa wuxuu muujiyay goljilicda marinka Hurmus, taasina waxay cusboonaysiiyay danaynta jidad waxdhoofineed oo beddelkiisa ah. Bilihii Abril iyo May, maalin kasta Sucuudigu wuxuu ka dhoofiyay Badda Cas in u dhexaysa saddex ilaa afar milyan oo foosto oo shidaal ah. Tani waa labanlaabka xaddigii la mariyay marinka Baabulmandab sannadkii 2024. Sidoo kale, mashaariicda tamarta ee lagaga maarmayo marinka Hurmus waxay kordhinayaan ahmiyadda Baabulmandab, sida ballaarinta taxa tuunbooyinka Bari iyo Galbeed ee Sucuudiga, ama khadka la qorshaynayo ee isku xiraya Ciraaq iyo dekedda Caqaba ee Urdun ee Badda Cas. Waxay muujiyeen Xuutiyiintu siday u fududahay in la carqaladeeyo Baabulmandab, halistuse Yaman oo keliya kama imanayso. Waayo dagaalka Suudaan wuxuu xoog ugu sii fidayaa dhibaatada Itoobiya iyo Ereteriya. Waqooyiga Soomaaliyana, waxa isdhexgalay loollanka maxalliga ah iyo tartanka Sucuudiga iyo Imaaraadka iyo ka Israa’iil iyo Turkiga, taas oo qalalaase cusub ka oogaysa Gacanka Cadan. Isla waqtigaas waxaa soo labakacleeyay burcadbadeeddii oo taageero xooggan ka helaya ururka al-Shabaab. Intii u dhexaysay Abriil iyo Meey waxay afduubeen burcadbadeed Soomaali ahi saddex doonyood oo marayay Gacanka Cadan, kuwaas oo ay laba ka mid ahi ahaayeen kuwo shidaal. Tani waa tiro afduub oo ka badan intii aynu aragnay shantii sanno ee ugu danbeeyay oo la isku daray. Faafitaanka diyaaradaha iswada ee raqiiska ahi waxay ka dhigan tahay in dawladaha iyo jihooyinka aan xukuumiga ahayni ay qarash kooban ku beegsan karaan marinbadeedkan ciriiriga ah. Inkasta oo aanay weli kooxo kale ku dhaqaaqin xeeladaha Xuutiyiinta, haddana kooxda Daacish ee Soomaaliya ayaa bishi Jeenaweri ka fulisay Budlaan weerarkii ugu horreeyay ee loo diiwaangeliyay ee ay fulisay diyaarad iswadda. Sida oo kale warbixinno ayaa sheegaya inay kooxda al-Shabaab u adeegsatay diyaarado iswada ujeeddooyin sahan iyo kuwo borobagaando. Carqalad kasta oo ku timaadda qulqulka ganacsi iyo qulqulka tamareed ee marinka BaabulMandab wuxuu yeelanayaa raadayn aad u dhaafsiisan gobolka, gaar ahaanna wuxuu taabanayaa Yurubiyaanka tamarta soo dhoofsada iyo dhaqaalayaasha ku tiirsan waxdhoofinta. Sidaas darteed, mar kasta oo ay kororto ahmiyadda Badda Casi, waxa isna kordhaya ahmiyadda Geeska Afrika. Iskumilanka Loollanada Geeska Afrika Dagaalka u dhexeeya Ciidamada Xoogga ee Suudaan iyo Ciidamada Gurmadka Degdegga ahi (RSF) ma aha loolan xayndaaban. Loollankani wuxuu keenay barakac wadareed, waxaanu khalkhaliyay xasilloonida dawladaha deriska. Sidoo kale wuxuu lugta la galay hirdanka Itoobiya iyo Ereteriya, arrintan oo kor u qaadaysa haliska iskudhac ballaaran oo ku dhereran Badda Cas. Adis Ababa weli waxay waddaa dadaalka ay ku doonayso inay ku hesho irrid badeed oo Badda Cas ah, gaar ahaan dekadda Casab ee Ereteriya. Asmarina dhankeeda waxay xoojisay xiriirka ay la leedahay hoggaanka gobolka Tigraay, iyo kooxo kale oo mucaarad ah oo gudaha Itoobiya ka jira. Tartanka labadooda ka dhexeeyaana wuxuu ku sii fidayaa Suudaan. Warbixinno ayaa sheegaya iskaashi xoogaysanaya oo ka jira jihada bariga oo u dhexeeya xooggaga Tigraay, ciidanka Suudaan iyo Ereteriya. Sida oo kale Ciidanka Gurmadka Degdegga ah (RSF) ee ku sugan gobolka Niilka Buluugga ah ee Suudaan ayaa taageero ka helaya Itoobiya. Farantan cusub ee ay fureen Ciidanka Gurmadka Degdegga ahi waxay dhinaca ku haysaa dalka Koonfurta Suudaan, oo ay xukuumadiisu isku dayayso inay xakamayso fallaagada kobcaysa ee qabiilka Nooyar, oo ah isirka labaad ee ugu badan dalka. Arrinkani wuxuu ka dhigayaa gobolka xuduudda saddexda dal ee ballaaran aag loollan oo weyn. Colaad kasta oo dhex marta Itoobiya iyo Ereteriya waxay u badan tahay inay lug ku yeelan doonaan kooxaha Suudaan iyo awoodo dibadda ahi, kuwaas oo ay ugu mudan tahay Masar, oo si weyn ugu janjeerta dhanka ciidanka Suudaan iyo Ereteriya. Waxay Masar u aragtaa halis amni oo daran Biyaceliyaha Weyn ee Kacaanka Itoobiya (GERD), kaas oo ku yaalla meel u dhow xuduudda Suudaan . Qalalaasahan waxa sii hurinaya isbahaysiyada Bariga Dhexe ee tartamaya. Tusaale ahaan Masar-Turkiga-iyo-Sucuudigu waxay taageeraan ciidanka Suudaan iyo Ereteriya; halka Imaaraadka iyo Israa’iil ay xiriir la leeyihiin Itoobiya iyo Ciidamada Gurmadka Degdegga ah (RSF). Taageeradan awoodaha shisheeye waxay ku dhiirrigelinaysaa dhinacyada maxalliga ah inay awood ka-badbadis ah isbidaan, taas oo keeni karta iskudhac gobol oo ballaaran, kaasoo halis gelin kara amniga Badda Cas iyo ka gooshitaankeeda. Mawjadda Kacsan ee Soomaaliya Soomaaliya waxay noqon kartaa faranta labaad ee ugu weyn qalalaasaha Badda Cas. Sida uu xaalku ahaa saddexgeeska Itoobiya-Ereteriya-iyo-Suudaan loollannada maxalliga ah waxa ku maran hirdanka Bariga Dhexe ee xasaasiga ah. Diisanbar 2025kii waxay aqoonsatay Israa’iil Jamhuuriyadda Soomaalilaan ee goosatada ah, ee uu Imaaraadku taageero. Waxay labada dhinac kala saxeexdeen heshiisyo amni, oo isugu jira tababbarada iyo iskaashiga sirdoonka. Sida oo kale Israa’iil waxa la filayaa inay dhowaan geyso ciidamo kooban saldhigga Imaaraadka ee Berbera, taas oo la sheegayo inay casriyayni ka socoto. Waxay muujisay booqashadii madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Cirro ee uu Israa’iil ku tegay dhammaadkii Juulay heerka qotada dheer ee uu xiriirka labada geesood marayo. Muqdisho waxay kaga jawaabtay aqoonsigan inay jartay xiriirkii diblomaasiyadeed iyo kii amni ee ay la lahayd Imaaraadka. Waqtigaas laga soo bilaabana waxay u dhowaatay Suduudiga iyo Gadar oo ay la galeen heshiisyo difaac, iyada oo sida oo kalana sii xoojisay isbahaysigii hore ee ay la lahayd Turkiga. Iyada oo badhtanka kaga jirta Abu Dabi laacdankeeda Muqdisho, waxay kordhisay taageerada ay siiso Budlaan iyo Jubbalaan, oo ah laba ismaamul oo Dawladda Federaalka ah xiriirka u jaray sannadkii 2024kii, iyaga oo raba inay sii adkeeyaan madaxbannaanidooda. Ahmiyadda taageeradani waxay sii xoogaysatay xilligan oo ay Soomaaliya gashay khilaaf dhanka hoggaaminta federaalka ah. Maaris 2026 wuxuu ku darsaday madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh muddaxileedkiisa iyo ka Baarlamaanka hal sanno oo dheeraad ah, markiii uu waqtigu ka dhammaaday 15 May. Waxa diiday muddokordhintan shakhsiyaad mucaarid ah, oo ay ku jiraan hoggaanka Jubbalaan iyo Budlaan, iyaga oo ku baaqay in doorasho la qabto. Markii ay dhexdhexaadintii burburtay, waxaa qarxay dagaal u dhexeeya xoogagga Xukuumadda iyo isbahaysiyada Mucaaridka Muqdisho 3dii iyo 4tii Juulaay. Tani waxay ina xasuusinaysaa xasarradii la socotay hannaankii doorashada ee sannadihii 2020 iyo 2021. Inkasta oo ciidamada Federaalka ah ee faraha badan ee caasimadda joogaa ay adkaynayaan in madaxweynaha awood xukunka lagaga rido, haddana qalalaasuhu wuxuu ka oogmi karaa goobo kale. Meesha ugu werwerka badanina waa Waqooyiga Soomaaliya, halkaas oo hirdan maxalli ahi xoog u soo jiidanayo dhinacyo dibadadeed. Laga soo bilaabo ku dhawaaqistii goonigoosadkii 1991, degaankan waxa gacanta ku haysay Soomaalilaan. Balse gobollada bariga ee Sool, Sanaag iyo Cayn gacankuhayntoodu waxay ahayd mid muran ka joogo, oo ay kula loollamayeen beelaha degaanka iyo dawladgoboleedka Budlaan ee deriska la ah. Xiisadahani waxay isu rogeen dagaal hubaysan sannadkii 2023, dagaalkaas oo ay ciidamada beesha Dhulbahante ee dawladda dhexe taageersani ku jebiyeen ciidankii Soomaalilaan. Markaas kaddib Muqdisho waxay taageertay in maamulgoboleed cusub laga dhiso degaankan, maamulkaas oo ah dawladda Waqooyibari, oo ku fadhiya dhul ay sheeganayaan Soomaalilaan iyo Budlaanba. Jaa’isadda weyn ee loo ordayaa waa gobolka Sanaag, ee ku yaalla xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed kaas oo leh ahmiyad istiraatiiji ah. Jilibyada gobolkan deggani waxay taageeradoodu u qaybsan tahay Soomaalilaan, Budlaan iyo Muqdisho, iyada oo abaaraha jiraana ay sii hurinayaan loollanka loogu jiro khayraadka. Qaybsanaanta gobolkan ka jirtaa waxay fursado soojiidasho leh u yihiin dhinacyada dibadda. Waxa jira warbixinno sheegaya inuu Turkigu qorshaynayo saldhig inuu ka samaysto Laasqoray, oo ah magaalada ugu muhiimsan xeebta Sanaag. Waxa lagu arkay xeebtan doonyo Turkigu leeyahay iyo diyaarado ku xiran Imaaraadka. Isla waqtigaas Muqdisho waxay doonaysaa inay kasbato jilibbo reer Budlaan ah iyo ganacsato ku xanaaqsan madaxweynaha maamulka, sidoo kalana waxay ishaartay inay ciidano geyn doonto Soomaalilaan. Caynkaas ayuu Waqooyiga Soomaaliya isugu rogayaa barxad dagaal, oo qaybsanaanta maxalliga ah iyo hirdanka awoodaha dibaddu ku kulmayaan. Waa hirdanka u dhexeeya Sucuudiga iyo Imaaraadka, ama Israa’iil iyo Turkiga. Loollan kasta oo toos ah oo gobolkan ka bilaabmaa wuxuu halis ku yahay Gacanka Cadan, sidoo kale wuxuu fursado u abuurayaa jihooyin kale sida: shabakadaha burcadbadeedda, ururka Daacish ee Soomaaliya, iyo argaggaxisada al-Shabaab, oo dhammaantood ka hawlgala gobolka. Labada urur ee jihaadiga ahi waxay hub laga soo tabriibiyay Xuutiyiinta ka heleen xeebaha gobolka. Dhanbaal ku Socda Yurub Xasilloonidarrada Geeska Afrika wuxuu halis kale ku abuurayaa isaga gooshitaanka Badda Cas, kaas oo toos u saamaynaya amniga iyo xasilloonida dhaqaalaha Yurub. Dhaqaalaha Yurub ee dheeldheelliyayaana ma ka karo inuu qaado culays kale oo kii marinka Hurmus ku soo biira. Sidaas darteed, waa inay Yurub iska dhaafto sawirka laga haysto ee ah inay tahay keliya jiho deeqbixiye ah. Waa inay samayso kahortag isugu jira awood debecsan iyo awood adag. Dhab ahaan Midowga Yurub waxa ka jooga Geeska Afriga laba hawlgal badeed oo kala ah “Aspides” iyo “Atalanta”, laakiin labada hawlgal waxa loo hindisay laba halisood oo kaladuwan. Atalanta waxa loo sameeyay si looga hortago burcadbadeedda Soomaalida, halka Asbides loo aasaasay si ay doonyaha uga ilaaliso weerarrada Xuutiyiinta, iyada oo leh waajibaad difaac oo bareer ah. Maadaama oo ay halista badeed sii kordhayso, waa inuu Midowga Yurub kordhiyo tirada baahsanaanta labadan hawlgal, isla markaana waa in lagu soo kordhiyo waajibaadkooda hawlo weerar, gaar ahaan kuwo ka dhan ah argaggaxisada al-Shabaab iyo ururka Daacish ee Soomaaliya. Arrinkani wuxuu keenayaa xoojinta dadaallada ladagaallanka burcadbadeedda, iyo kordhinta cadaadiska la saarayo dhinacyada gildilaya xasilloonida, isla markaana wuxuu dirayaa dhanbaal amni iyo awooded oo ay Yurub ku leedahay Badda Cas kaas oo la isku hallayn karo. Si loo yareeyo cabsida aargoosi, waa inay reer Yurub niyadda u dejiyaan dawladaha gobolka sida Sucuudiga iyo Jabuuti, una sheegaan in ballaarinta hawlaha weerar laga reebayo Xuutiyiinta. Sidoo kale, waa inay reer Yurub ku dadaalaan inay helaan joogitaan ciidan oo ka yimaadda darafyada reer Aasiya ee danaha waaweyn ka leh amniga Badda Cas, sida Kuuriyada Koonfureed iyo Jabbaan. Wadashaqayntan weyni waxay Yurub siinaysaa saamayn dheeraad ah ay ku riixi karto wadahadallada Xukuumadda Federaalka ah iyo Soomaalilaan iyo Budlaan ee ku saabsan dhulka lagu muransan yahay; iyo inay siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliya ku qalqaalliso xal u helidda ismarinwaaga ka jira doorashada. Iyada oo taas laga duulayo, waa inuu Midowga Yurub ku dhaqmo maangalka wax-is-dhaafsiga si ay taageeradiisa dhaqaale uga qaybqaadato yoolalkan xasillinta gobolka, taageeradaas oo sannadka 2026 dhan 139 milyan oo yuuri, oo isugu jirta 76 Milyan oo oo lagu taageero hawlgalka Midowga Afrika, iyo 63 Milyan oo ah taageerada gargaarka aadaminimo. Waa in Midowga Yurub ay si adag ula shaqeeyaan Maraykanka iyo Ingiriiska, labadooda oo hore u hoggaamiyay dadaallo heshiisiineed oo lagu kalsoon yahay, oo la xiriiray ismariwaagii doorashada iyo dadaallada ammaanka ee Waqooyiga, sida ladagaallanka Daacish. Iskaashi kaas la mid ah ayaa xoojin kara dadaallada lagu xasilinayo xasarrada u dhexaysa Itoobiya iyo Ereteriya, iyada oo ay Waashintoon xiriir la samaysay labada dhinacba dhowaan. items.title: NISA oo sheegtay in duqeyn ka dhacday Shabeellaha Dhexe ku dishay xubno katirsan AS
items.description: Shabeellaha Dhexe ( Raxanreeb Online) Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka Soomaaliyeed (NISA) ayaa sheegtay in duqayn ka dhacday Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ee Dowlad-Goboleedka HirShabeelle lagu dilay xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Qoraal kasoo baxay hay’adda NISA, ayaa lagu sheegay in duqaynta ay iska kaashadeen ciidamada dowladda iyo saaxiibada Soomaaliya ka taageera hawlgallada cirka, waxa ayna xaqiijisay in Hawlgalka lagu beegsaday xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab oo ku sugnaa deegaanka Cali Gaduud ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Sidoo kale hay’adda ayaa sheegtay in howlgalka lagu dilay 12 xubnood oo katirsan kooxda Al-shabaab oo halkaasi isku uruursanayay. Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ayaa ka mid ah deegaannada ay ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo kuwa deegaanka ka wadaan hawlgallo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo mararka qaar hawlgalladaasi ay taageeraan duqaymo cirka ah. items.title: Isgaarsiinta Tigray oo go’day iyo dagaalka galay oo maalintii afraad
items.description: Gobolka Tigray ee waqooyiga Itoobiya waxaa ka go’ay adeegyada internet-ka iyo taleefannada, xilli dagaal u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda federaalka Itoobiya iyo xoogagga Tigray uu galay maalintii afraad, taasoo sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo in colaadda dib ugu laabato dagaal ballaaran. Hay’adda NetBlocks, oo la socota xaaladda internet-ka caalamka, ayaa xaqiijisay carqaladda weyn ee ku timid isgaarsiinta gobolka, iyadoo xaaladda dhulka ay adkaynayso in si madax-bannaan loo helo xog dhamaystiran. Warbixin ay Reuters soo xigatay ayaa sheegtay in afar ilo-wareed ay TPLF ku eedeeyeen inay shirkadaha Ethio Telecom iyo Safaricom ku amartay inay joojiyaan adeegyada isgaarsiinta. ilo ku dhow TPLF ayaa eeddaas beeniyey, iyagoo sheegay in dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ay mas’uul ka tahay go’itaanka adeegyada. Dhinaca dagaalka, xoogagga Tigray iyo kooxaha ay isbahaysiga yihiin ayaa la sheegay inay la wareegeen saddex garoon diyaaradeed, isla markaana ay weerarro ka fuliyeen gobollada Canfarta iyo Amxaarada. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay inay jebisay weerarradaas, balse xaaladda dhabta ah ee garoomada, khasaaraha ka dhashay dagaalka iyo sheegashooyinka labada dhinac ayaan si madax-bannaan loo wada xaqiijin. Isgaarsiinta oo go’day ayaa sii adkaynaysa helitaanka warar lagu kalsoonaan karo oo ka imanaya goobaha ay colaadaha ka socdaan. Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeeshay isu-socodka hawada, iyadoo la hakiyey duulimaadyadii magaalada taariikhiga ah ee Lalibela kaddib markii dagaalku ku soo dhowaaday garoonka diyaaradaha. Dhanka kale, dadka ku nool Tigray ayaa bilaabay inay kaydsadaan raashin iyo sahay kale oo muhiim ah, halka qaar ka mid ah shacabka ay bangiyada kala baxayaan lacag iyagoo ka cabsi qaba in xaaladdu sii xumaato, isla markaana ay adkaadaan helitaanka adeegyada aasaasiga ah. Go’itaanka taleefannada iyo internet-ka ayaa si gaar ah u saameynaya xiriirka qoysaska, adeegyada lacagaha moobilka iyo awoodda shacabka ee helitaanka macluumaad degdeg ah. Xaaladda hadda ka taagan Tigray ayaa dib u soo celinaysa xusuusta dagaalkii 2020 ilaa 2022, kaas oo gobolka ka dhigay meel muddo dheer ay ka jireen isgaarsiin la’aan, sahay yari iyo dhibaatooyin baahsan oo dhinaca adeegyada caafimaadka iyo bani’aadannimada ah. Heshiiskii nabadda ee 2022 ayaa soo afjaray dagaalkaas, hase yeeshee xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee ka dhex jira dhinacyada Itoobiya ayaa weli ah arrimo xasaasi ah. Dagaallada cusub iyo fiditaanka iska horimaadyada gobollada deriska la ah ayaa walaac ka abuuraya mustaqbalka xasilloonida Itoobiya iyo guud ahaan Geeska Afrika. Haddii colaadda sii faafto, waxaa suurtagal ah inay saameyn ku yeelato isu-socodka ganacsiga, amniga xuduudaha iyo xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee deegaannada ku dhow goobaha dagaalka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xogta la hayo ma xaqiijinayso in dagaalku si toos ah u gaaray Dowlad-Deegaanka Soomaalida Itoobiya ama uu hadda saameyn muuqata ku yeeshay Soomaaliya. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Iyadoo xaaladdu weli kacsan tahay, go’itaanka isgaarsiinta iyo wararka iska soo horjeeda ee ka imanaya dhinacyada dagaallamaya ayaa muujinaya baahida loo qabo xaqiijin madax-bannaan, ilaalinta shacabka iyo in dhinacyadu ka fogaadaan tallaabooyin sii hurin kara colaadda.

items.title: Iska horimaad dhimasho sababay oo xiisad ka dhacay degmada Caluula
items.description: Xiisad ayaa ka dhacay degmada Caluula ee gobolka bari ee Puntland, kaddib iska horimaad sababay dhimashada hal qof iyo dhaawaca qof kale laga soo wariyay halkaas. Wararka ka soo baxaya deegaanka ayaa sheegaya in dhacdadu ay la xiriirto khilaaf ka dhashay maamulka degmada. Qofka dhintay ayaa lagu magacaabay Cabdifitaax Cumar Cali Muumin , waxaana wararka la helayo ay sheegayaan inuu ahaa darawalka guddoomiyaha degmada Caluula. Qof kale ayaa ku dhaawacmay dhacdada, hase yeeshee faahfaahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan xaaladdiisa caafimaad iyo goobta lagu daweynayo weli lama helin. Xiisadda ayaa timid xilli uu ka dhex jiray maamulka degmada khilaaf siyaasadeed, kaddib markii 11 xubnood oo ka tirsan Golaha Deegaanka Caluula ay sheegeen inay xilka ka qaadeen guddoomiyaha degmada, Axmed Maxamed Xasan, oo loo yaqaan Xamari . Golaha Deegaanka Caluula wuxuu ka kooban yahay 33 xubnood , kuwaas oo lagu doortay doorashadii goleyaasha deegaanka ee Puntland ee 2023. Dukumenti ka soo baxay Guddiga Doorashooyinka Puntland ayaa xaqiijinaya tirada 33-ka xubnood iyo natiijooyinkii doorashada degmada Caluula. Si kastaba, weli ma cadda habraaca sharci ee loo maray xil-ka-qaadista guddoomiyaha , iyo in go’aanka ay sheegeen xubnaha golaha uu helay ansixinta hay’adaha kale ee ay khusayso. Sidoo kale, faahfaahin rasmi ah lagama helin cidda uu iska horimaadku dhex maray, waxa si toos ah u sababay rasaasta iyo haddii ay jiraan dad loo qabtay dhacdada. Wararka la heli karo waxay tilmaamayaan in xaaladdu weli tahay mid u baahan dejin iyo xaqiijin dheeraad ah. Dhacdadan ayaa walaac ku abuurtay dadka deegaanka, iyadoo dhimashada iyo dhaawaca ka dhashay iska horimaadku ay kusoo beegmeen xilli uu muran siyaasadeed ka taagan yahay maamulka degmada. Ilaa hadda, maamulka Puntland iyo hay’adaha amniga ayaan soo saarin war rasmi ah oo dhamaystiran oo lagu caddeynayo sababta iska horimaadka, khasaaraha iyo tallaabooyinka laga qaaday dadka ku lugta leh.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ka qayb-gashay kulan soo dhaweyn ah oo Madaxweyne Putin u sameeyey madaxda Madasha Dhaqamada
items.description: Soomaaliya ayaa ka qayb-gashay kulan soo dhaweyn ah oo Madaxweynaha Federaalka Ruushka, Vladimir Putin, u sameeyey madaxda iyo masuuliyiinta ka qaybgalaya Madasha 12-aad ee Caalamiga ah ee Dhaqamada Midoobay , oo ka socota magaalada St. Petersburg ee dalka Ruushka. Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Soomaaliya, Cabdifataax Qaasim Maxamuud , ayaa ka mid ahaa masuuliyiinta Soomaaliyeed ee ka qaybgalay madasha, iyadoo kulamada halkaas ka socda ay diiradda saarayaan dhaqanka, ilaalinta hidaha iyo xoojinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee dhinacyada farshaxanka iyo dhaqanka. Warbaahinta dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in Wasiirku St. Petersburg kula kulmay Wasiirka Dhaqanka Ruushka, Olga Lyubimova, si looga wada hadlo xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal. Madaxweyne Putin, oo khudbad ka jeediyay munaasabadda, ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay doorka dhaqanka ee isku soo dhoweynta shucuubta iyo sii wadidda wada-hadalka xilliyada ay xiriirrada siyaasadeed iyo kuwa dhaqaale adkaadaan. Sidoo kale, waxaa xoogga la saaray ilaalinta kala-duwanaanshaha dhaqamada, ka qaybgalka dhallinyarada iyo is-weydaarsiga aqoonta iyo waayo-aragnimada. Madasha sanadkan waxaa ka qaybgalaya wasiirro iyo masuuliyiin sare oo ka kala socda dalal badan. Warbaahinta rasmiga ah ee Iran waxay sheegtay in madashu ay isu keentay masuuliyiin iyo shaqsiyaad ka socda dhinacyada fanka iyo dhaqanka ee ku dhowaad 70 dal , iyadoo ay jiraan 44 wafdi oo rasmi ah. Intii uu Wasiir Cabdifataax Qaasim ku sugnaa St. Petersburg, wuxuu kulan laba-geesood ah la yeeshay Wasiirka Dhaqanka Ruushka, Olga Lyubimova. Kulanka ayaa lagu soo qaaday ilaalinta iyo horumarinta hidde-dhaqameedka, farshaxanka, suugaanta, tiyaatarrada iyo cilmi-baarista dhaqanka. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay is-dhaafsiga khubarada iyo fanaaniinta, horumarinta xarumaha dhaqanka iyo dardargelinta heshiisyada iskaashiga dhaqanka ee Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka. Wasiir Cabdifataax Qaasim ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay muhiimad gaar ah siinayso dhaqanka iyo farshaxanka, isaga oo tilmaamay in dhaqanku door ku leeyahay ilaalinta aqoonsiga qaranka, isku-xirka bulshada iyo xoojinta xiriirka shacabka labada dal. Ka qaybgalka Soomaaliya ee madashan ayaa sidoo kale u oggolaanaya dhinaca Soomaaliyeed inuu soo bandhigo hodantinimada hiddaha, dhaqanka iyo fanka Soomaaliyeed , isla markaana uu la wadaago dalalka kale khibradaha ku saabsan ilaalinta iyo horumarinta dhaqanka. Dhanka kale, Wasiirka Soomaaliya ayaa 25-kii Sebtembar sheegay in Afrika ay u baahan tahay iskaashi wax-ku-ool ah oo ku dhisan is-ixtiraam oo lala yeesho dalalka iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan arrinta dib-u-soo-celinta hantida dhaqameed ee Afrika. Madasha St. Petersburg ayaa sidaas darteed Soomaaliya uga dhigan goob ay kaga qaybqaadan karto doodaha caalamiga ah ee ku saabsan mustaqbalka dhaqanka, ilaalinta hidaha iyo ballaarinta xiriirrada hay’adaha dhaqanka ee dalalka kala duwan.

items.title: UNHCR Representative: 230,000 Yemenis at Risk of Displacement
items.description: Yemen Monitor / Aden / Exclusive: The representative of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees in Yemen, Armin Yedgariyan, said that more than three thousand Yemenis have crossed into Djibouti since the conflict in the country renewed, warning of the expansion of internal and external displacement movement as military escalation continues on several fronts. Yedgariyan explained, in an interview with “Al-Arabi TV,” that the latest wave of fighting has pushed thousands of Yemenis to leave the country by sea, while UNHCR estimates indicate that the numbers of those leaving are likely to rise in the coming period if the confrontations continue and expand in scope. According to UNHCR, more than three thousand Yemenis have so far reached Djibouti across the Gulf of Aden, while hundreds of others have reached Somaliland and Puntland, amid UN preparations for the possibility of receiving more than ten thousand arrivals with the improvement of maritime navigation conditions and the continued state of instability in Yemen. The sea migration movement comes in conjunction with a wide wave of displacement inside Yemen; more than 130,000 people have fled their homes since the beginning of September, with fighting expanding on several fronts and front lines shifting from one area to another. The UNHCR representative warned that the continuation of displacement at the current pace could raise the number of newly displaced people to more than 230,000, noting that the movement of fighting lines pushes residents to leave from both sides of the contact lines in search of safer areas. Taiz Governorate is the epicenter of the current displacement wave, accounting for more than 60 percent of the total recorded displacement cases, while population movements have also been reported from the governorates of Al-Jawf, Marib, and Al-Hudaidah, in an indication of the multi-front nature of the current escalation. The UN official said that the conditions of the displaced are becoming increasingly difficult as new families arrive in already overcrowded displacement sites, amid growing needs for shelter, food, clean water, health care, and protection, coinciding with the declining capacity of local services and infrastructure to absorb the new numbers. UNHCR data indicate that about 70 percent of the newly displaced are women and children, while some families reported that they are being displaced for the fourth time, after moving repeatedly from one area to another during the years of war. The new displacement wave exacerbates a prolonged humanitarian crisis in Yemen, where more than 5.2 million people were internally displaced before the latest escalation, while more than 22 million people need some form of humanitarian assistance, according to UN estimates. At the same time, the humanitarian response faces an acute funding shortage; UNHCR said its operations in Yemen are only 18 percent funded during 2026, after receiving about 34 million dollars out of the 194 million required, while it urgently needs about 25 million dollars to respond to the needs resulting from the escalation and new displacement. UNHCR warned that continued fighting, insecurity, restrictions on movement, and damage to roads and infrastructure, including Al-Mokha Port, are obstructing the delivery of humanitarian assistance, calling for securing safe and unimpeded access to affected populations in areas witnessing accelerating displacement waves

Taiz Governorate is the epicenter of the current displacement wave, accounting for more than 60 percent of the total recorded displacement cases, while population movements have also been reported from the governorates of Al-Jawf, Marib, and Al-Hudaidah, in an indication of the multi-front nature of the current escalation. The UN official said that the conditions of the displaced are becoming increasingly difficult as new families arrive in already overcrowded displacement sites, amid growing needs for shelter, food, clean water, health care, and protection, coinciding with the declining capacity of local services and infrastructure to absorb the new numbers. UNHCR data indicate that about 70 percent of the newly displaced are women and children, while some families reported that they are being displaced for the fourth time, after moving repeatedly from one area to another during the years of war. The new displacement wave exacerbates a prolonged humanitarian crisis in Yemen, where more than 5.2 million people were internally displaced before the latest escalation, while more than 22 million people need some form of humanitarian assistance, according to UN estimates. At the same time, the humanitarian response faces an acute funding shortage; UNHCR said its operations in Yemen are only 18 percent funded during 2026, after receiving about 34 million dollars out of the 194 million required, while it urgently needs about 25 million dollars to respond to the needs resulting from the escalation and new displacement. UNHCR warned that continued fighting, insecurity, restrictions on movement, and damage to roads and infrastructure, including Al-Mokha Port, are obstructing the delivery of humanitarian assistance, calling for securing safe and unimpeded access to affected populations in areas witnessing accelerating displacement waves

items.title: Misan Harriman: I won’t rest until there are no zero-dose children in Nigeria Written By :
items.description: Misan Harriman: I won’t rest until there are no zero-dose children in Nigeria Written By : Ijeoma Thomas-Odia Misan Harriman is a Nigerian-born photographer, filmmaker, entrepreneur and social activist who built a career around using his camera to document humanity, protest and social change. A self-taught photographer, he became the first Black photographer to shoot the cover of British Vogue’s September issue and has documented major social and cultural moments around the world. He is also Chair of the Southbank Centre in London and an ambassador for Save the Children. His work has taken him to communities affected by conflict, hunger and displacement, including Somalia, Somaliland and Egypt, where he has used photography and advocacy to amplify the voices and experiences of children. Currently in Nigeria supporting Save the Children’s efforts to reach children who have received no routine vaccinations, in this interview held at Federal Palace Resort, he discusses why immunisation became a cause he could not ignore, the barriers Nigerian families face, and why he believes Nigerians can mobilise their collective resources to protect vulnerable children. You have been involved in social activism for several years. What drew you to Save the Children’s work in Nigeria? For me, as a Nigerian with a platform, it is important to use it for good not just outside Nigeria but in Nigeria. Over the last few years, I have had numerous projects with Save the Children in Nigeria. My team has just returned from Borno State, and my focus is on the work we are doing to make sure there are no zero-dose children in Nigeria. By zero-dose, I mean children who have received no vaccinations. That means their early life can potentially become a death sentence from diseases such as diphtheria, pneumonia and measles. All of these can be fatal, and there is no reason why they should be. So, I am trying to make sure these children can go to the nearest primary healthcare facility and receive free vaccines. Any mother or father with a child within the appropriate age range should be able to give that child the same chance my children have the chance to live a healthy life and grow well. That is the very least I can do as someone with a platform and as someone who was born in Nigeria. How can I not help the vulnerable? Why did immunisation become such an important cause for you? There are many things wrong with all countries, but when you know the medicine exists and that children will die without it, how can you sit there knowing that children can live and that the medicine exists? That is why I chose it. The solution to the problem already exists. It is about distribution and resources. When you see that and ignore it, you have to live with that. I couldn’t live with myself knowing that I had the ability to do something about it. From your recent interactions with families, what do you see as some of the biggest barriers to accessing healthcare? There are a lot of cultural and economic issues. Some of the mothers I spoke to in Ikorodu, where I spent time recently, explained that sometimes their husbands do not want to spend money on transportation because the cost of living is so high. That money could become another meal for the whole family. People sometimes prioritise what seems immediately urgent without necessarily understanding that their child could become very sick without vaccination. Education is also important. We need to help mothers know where their nearest primary healthcare facility is. In some places, it is quite far, and even if you have transport, getting there can be difficult. One of the women who came had triplets. She came with her grandmother, and they walked. When you see that level of effort, you realise that these mothers want to protect their children. It is a natural instinct, so how can we not also help facilitate that and make it easier for them? What can Nigerians do to support the work? Save the Children Nigeria has channels through which people can donate directly to the projects we are doing. I would encourage people to support the work. You can go through Save the Children’s platforms and donate directly to the Nigerian projects. Every contribution helps because it goes towards supporting these children. You have described this as an ongoing project. What have you seen on the ground? This is ongoing. I happen to be here now, but this is not a one-off project. I came to oversee the work and make sure everything had been implemented, and I was really blown away. About 90 per cent of the people I met were home-grown Nigerians. They know the area and understand the cultural nuances. It is amazing to see how effective the work can be when people understand the context. We are not asking for somebody to come and save us. We are doing our own work, saving our own children, and it is really important to understand the context of this work. What are the biggest limitations? Resources. There are 2.1 million zero-dose children, so that is a huge challenge. The more resources we have, the more children we can reach and save. It is as simple as that. Vaccine hesitancy remains an issue in some communities. How do you approach those concerns? We speak to people respectfully and provide information. We show them historically how medicine has changed lives. Before penicillin was invented, people were scared of it. Imagine a world without penicillin. Medicine works. It is as simple as that, especially when children are far more vulnerable. As an adult, if you want to make decisions about your own healthcare, that is your choice. But when a child gets measles, can you ignore medicine? You have to ask yourself: are you going to sit and pray and hope your child gets better, or are you going to give that child the medicine that could save his or her life? To me, that is an easy choice. What has been the most rewarding part of this work for you? I am just really proud of everyone I have seen working in humanitarian and primary healthcare services in Nigeria. They are dedicated men and women. They care about children. We are dealing with children and, usually, mothers as well, and there are a lot of people dedicating their lives to this. Let’s support them and recruit more people like them in every state in Nigeria. Let’s expand the work. I won’t rest until there are no zero-dose children in this country. Do you see the government as an important partner in achieving that goal? If the government wants to participate, that is fine. Save the Children is a global humanitarian organisation, and I am its global ambassador. I look at many projects around the world. I was recently in Somaliland and in Cairo, helping Palestinian children in Egypt. There are many projects I get involved in, but as a Nigerian, I take particular pride in the work we do in Nigeria. So, if the government wants to participate, I am sure we can work with them. But I am focused on fundraising from Nigerians, both in the country and in the diaspora. We can do this ourselves. Having worked with children in different parts of the world, what has that experience taught you about Nigerians and our responsibility to one another? I think Nigerians are very aware of how we can make a difference. Before we were colonised, all the tribes and villages knew how to look after their sick and protect their children. It is actually in our bones. Something happened after colonisation, where we became more individualistic capitalism, protecting my own family and that is all I care about. But something is beginning to change. We are going back to a better way of living. Think of all the money we spend on Detty December and what that means in Lagos. Imagine if some of that was spent on children who have a chance of living or dying. Tell me what you would rather be doing. I think people are beginning to grow in what they see as their value system. At the end of the day, we all die. From the people I have met in their final days, they never talk about how much they have. They talk about who they helped and what they did in this life. So, let’s continue to move in that direction. Your photography is another powerful part of your activism. What role does it play in telling these stories? I photograph these stories, and I will be releasing some of the images soon. I have released work before, usually with magazines, newspapers or Save the Children. For me, photography is about truth. There is no small talk in black and white. If you look at history books and some of the most important photographs of all time, many of them are black and white for a reason. I love it. I was inspired by photographers I saw when I was a child, images of Martin Luther King Jr., Malcolm X and so many others. Those are the shoulders I stand on. Gordon Parks and his civil rights photography. Peter Magubane’s photography during the apartheid movement in South Africa. Much of that work was in black and white. I guess my eyes see things in monochrome. Your decision to remain committed to black-and-white photography has become part of your visual identity. What keeps you committed to it? My work is not about being accepted, it is about truth. If you’re a real artist, you don’t care about acceptance. You care about truth. That is why I do what I do. I have no interest in who accepts me. I have every interest in making people see the truth of the human condition through my lens. That is possibly why so many people around the world have responded to my work. Whether it is the #EndSARS protests I photographed, work in Johannesburg and Minnesota with George Floyd’s family, Black children, children with Down syndrome or my sister, people respond to the images. Sometimes people cry when they see my photographs. As a photographer, you have to search for truth. That is why I don’t use Photoshop. I don’t retouch. I don’t use lighting or flash. I have my camera. That’s it. I’m not a wedding photographer. I document the human condition. I have my camera, my eye and my heart. That’s all I need. What do you hope people see when they look at your photographs? I think humans are still humans. We can be good and bad. We can be kind, and people are simply trying to figure out life. The mothers I met just a few days ago are just the same as you and me. They are trying to figure out life. If my images can humanise them and remind everyone that we are all the same that no one is better than anyone else then that is important to me. Guardian Nigeria

items.title: Turkiga iyo Pakistan oo ku dhow in ay ku biiraan dagaalka…
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa taliyeyaashooda ugu sarreeya ciidamada u diraya Sacuudi Carabiya, kadib markii Riyadh ay codsatay kulan degdeg ah oo looga arrinsanayo hirgelinta heshiis difaac wadajir ah, xilli weerarrada gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay sii kordhayaan. Wasaaradda Difaaca Turkiga ayaa Jimcihii xaqiijisay in taliyaha guud ee ciidamada, General Selcuk Bayraktaroglu, uu u safrayo Sacuudi Carabiya si uu uga qeyb galo kulanka taliyeyaasha ciidamada ee dalalka ku mideysan heshiiska difaaca. Taliyaha ciidamada Pakistan, Field Marshal Asim Munir, ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu gaaro Riyadh, sida ay Al Jazeera sheegtay, inkastoo milatariga Pakistan uusan si rasmi ah u xaqiijin safarkiisa. Kulanka ayaa imanaya kadib toddobaadyo ay Xuutiyiintu kordhiyeen weerarrada ay ku qaadayaan gudaha Sacuudi Carabiya, taas oo Riyadh ku riixday inay taageero ka raadiso xulafadeeda cusub ee heshiiska difaaca. Khamiistii, Xuutiyiintu waxay sheegeen inay gantaallo iyo diyaarado drone ah ku weerareen bartilmaameedyo Sacuudi ah, oo ay ku jiraan xarumo ay leedahay shirkadda shidaalka ee Saudi Aramco ee Yanbu iyo goob ay ku tilmaameen “bartilmaameed xasaasi ah” oo ku yaalla Riyadh. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay inay soo ridday lix gantaal oo ballistic ah oo ku wajahnaa Taif iyo Yanbu. Digniino degdeg ah ayaa sidoo kale laga bixiyey dhowr magaalo, iyadoo colaadda Yemen ay si isa soo taraysa uga gudbeyso xadka. Heshiiska difaaca ee Maka Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa 7-dii August ku kala saxiixday magaalada Maka heshiiska Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, kaas oo dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsanayo weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale dhigaya in saddexda dal ay ballaariyaan iskaashiga difaaca iyo awooddooda wadajirka ah ee ka hortagga khataraha. Dhammaadkii August, wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda iyo difaaca iyo taliyeyaasha ciidamada saddexda dal ayaa Istanbul ku yeeshay kulankii ugu horreeyey ee guddiga siyaasadda iyo difaaca ee heshiiska. Waxay isku raaceen in Riyadh laga dhiso xoghayn joogto ah oo maamusha howlaha heshiiska, iyadoo xoghayaha guud ee ugu horreeya uu ka imaanayo Pakistan muddo saddex sano ah. Xiisadda cusub ee Yemen ayaa hadda noqoneysa tijaabadii ugu horreysay ee weyn ee muujin karta sida heshiiskaasi uga shaqeynayo xaalad dagaal oo dhab ah. Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa Khamiistii ku kulmay New York, iyagoo halkaas kaga arrinsaday qabanqaabada kulanka degdegga ah ee taliyeyaasha ciidamada. Sacuudi Carabiya waxay sheegtay in wadahadalladu ay ku saabsan yihiin sidii taageero loogu fidin lahaa boqortooyada iyadoo la adeegsanayo heshiiska difaaca. Saddexda dal ayaa sidoo kale cambaareeyey weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsaday Maka iyo xarumaha rayidka iyo dhaqaalaha ee Sacuudiga, iyagoo xaqiijiyey xaqa Riyadh ay u leedahay inay is-difaacdo. Laakiin Ankara iyo Islamabad waxay muujiyeen hadal ka taxaddar badan kan Sacuudi Carabiya. Pakistan waxay sheegtay in kulanka looga hadlay horumarka laga sameeyey dhismaha hay’adaha heshiiska iyo xaaladda amni ee gobolka, halka ilo diblomaasiyadeed oo Turki ah ay sheegeen in wasiirradu dib u eegeen wada-xaajoodyada farsamo ee lagu hirgelinayo heshiiska. Kala duwanaanshahaas ayaa muujinaya in inkastoo saddexda dal ay leeyihiin waajibaad difaac oo wadajir ah, haddana aan weli la caddeyn nooca taageerada milateri ee Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay diyaar u yihiin inay siiyaan Sacuudi Carabiya. Xuutiyiinta oo digniin diray Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Iran ayaa dhankooda uga digay Ankara iyo Islamabad inay si toos ah ugu lug yeeshaan dagaalka Yemen. Mohammed al-Bukhaiti, oo ka tirsan hoggaanka siyaasadeed ee Xuutiyiinta, ayaa sheegay in Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay wajihi doonaan jawaab adag haddii ay dagaalka ku soo biiraan, sida ay Al Jazeera werisay. Kooxdu waxay toddobaadyadii ugu dambeeyey sidoo kale horumar ka sameysay gudaha Yemen, iyadoo qabsatay dekedda istaraatiijiga ah ee Mocha iyo goobo kale oo ku teedsan Badda Cas. Taasi waxay sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo marinka Bab al-Mandab, oo ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo dhoofinta tamarta caalamka. Dagaallada ayaa sidoo kale sababay barakac cusub. Hay’adda Qaxootiga Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in in ka badan 230,000 qof ay guryahooda ka barakaceen tan iyo bilowgii September, iyadoo dagaalladu ku fidayaan dhowr jiho oo Yemen ah. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa dhanka kale sii xoojinaysa difaaceeda. Faransiiska ayaa sheegay inuu ciidamo, raadaarro iyo nidaamyo difaac u dirayo Yanbu si loo ilaaliyo xarumaha muhiimka ah ee shidaalka, halka Britain ay taageero ka bixineyso howlgallada difaaca Sacuudiga. Kulanka taliyeyaasha ciidamada ee Riyadh ayaa sidaas darteed indhaha lagu hayaa, maadaama go’aannada kasoo baxa ay tilmaami karaan in heshiiska cusub ee difaaca uu ku ekaanayo taageero siyaasadeed iyo farsamo, ama inuu horseedi karo kaalin milateri oo toos ah oo Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay ka qaataan difaaca Sacuudi Carabiya. Heshiiska difaaca ee Maka Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa 7-dii August ku kala saxiixday magaalada Maka heshiiska Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, kaas oo dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsanayo weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale dhigaya in saddexda dal ay ballaariyaan iskaashiga difaaca iyo awooddooda wadajirka ah ee ka hortagga khataraha. Dhammaadkii August, wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda iyo difaaca iyo taliyeyaasha ciidamada saddexda dal ayaa Istanbul ku yeeshay kulankii ugu horreeyey ee guddiga siyaasadda iyo difaaca ee heshiiska. Waxay isku raaceen in Riyadh laga dhiso xoghayn joogto ah oo maamusha howlaha heshiiska, iyadoo xoghayaha guud ee ugu horreeya uu ka imaanayo Pakistan muddo saddex sano ah. Xiisadda cusub ee Yemen ayaa hadda noqoneysa tijaabadii ugu horreysay ee weyn ee muujin karta sida heshiiskaasi uga shaqeynayo xaalad dagaal oo dhab ah. Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa Khamiistii ku kulmay New York, iyagoo halkaas kaga arrinsaday qabanqaabada kulanka degdegga ah ee taliyeyaasha ciidamada. Sacuudi Carabiya waxay sheegtay in wadahadalladu ay ku saabsan yihiin sidii taageero loogu fidin lahaa boqortooyada iyadoo la adeegsanayo heshiiska difaaca. Saddexda dal ayaa sidoo kale cambaareeyey weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsaday Maka iyo xarumaha rayidka iyo dhaqaalaha ee Sacuudiga, iyagoo xaqiijiyey xaqa Riyadh ay u leedahay inay is-difaacdo. Laakiin Ankara iyo Islamabad waxay muujiyeen hadal ka taxaddar badan kan Sacuudi Carabiya. Pakistan waxay sheegtay in kulanka looga hadlay horumarka laga sameeyey dhismaha hay’adaha heshiiska iyo xaaladda amni ee gobolka, halka ilo diblomaasiyadeed oo Turki ah ay sheegeen in wasiirradu dib u eegeen wada-xaajoodyada farsamo ee lagu hirgelinayo heshiiska. Kala duwanaanshahaas ayaa muujinaya in inkastoo saddexda dal ay leeyihiin waajibaad difaac oo wadajir ah, haddana aan weli la caddeyn nooca taageerada milateri ee Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay diyaar u yihiin inay siiyaan Sacuudi Carabiya. Xuutiyiinta oo digniin diray Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Iran ayaa dhankooda uga digay Ankara iyo Islamabad inay si toos ah ugu lug yeeshaan dagaalka Yemen. Mohammed al-Bukhaiti, oo ka tirsan hoggaanka siyaasadeed ee Xuutiyiinta, ayaa sheegay in Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay wajihi doonaan jawaab adag haddii ay dagaalka ku soo biiraan, sida ay Al Jazeera werisay. Kooxdu waxay toddobaadyadii ugu dambeeyey sidoo kale horumar ka sameysay gudaha Yemen, iyadoo qabsatay dekedda istaraatiijiga ah ee Mocha iyo goobo kale oo ku teedsan Badda Cas. Taasi waxay sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo marinka Bab al-Mandab, oo ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo dhoofinta tamarta caalamka. Dagaallada ayaa sidoo kale sababay barakac cusub. Hay’adda Qaxootiga Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in in ka badan 230,000 qof ay guryahooda ka barakaceen tan iyo bilowgii September, iyadoo dagaalladu ku fidayaan dhowr jiho oo Yemen ah. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa dhanka kale sii xoojinaysa difaaceeda. Faransiiska ayaa sheegay inuu ciidamo, raadaarro iyo nidaamyo difaac u dirayo Yanbu si loo ilaaliyo xarumaha muhiimka ah ee shidaalka, halka Britain ay taageero ka bixineyso howlgallada difaaca Sacuudiga. Kulanka taliyeyaasha ciidamada ee Riyadh ayaa sidaas darteed indhaha lagu hayaa, maadaama go’aannada kasoo baxa ay tilmaami karaan in heshiiska cusub ee difaaca uu ku ekaanayo taageero siyaasadeed iyo farsamo, ama inuu horseedi karo kaalin milateri oo toos ah oo Turkiga iyo Pakistan ay ka qaataan difaaca Sacuudi Carabiya.
