items.title: Magaalooyin waa weyn oo la shaaciyey in ay u gacan geli karaan kooxda Al-Shabaab
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Soomaaliya waxay wajihi kartaa inay Al-Shabaab dib ugu lumiso deegaanno ay dowladdu maamusho, xilli ciidamada Midowga Afrika ay isu diyaarinayaan inay yareeyaan joogitaankooda, taageerada saadka ee Qaramada Midoobayna ay sii dhammaaneyso, waxaa sidaas ka digtay hay’adda International Crisis Group. Hay’adda ayaa si gaar ah farta ugu fiiqday magaalooyinka Qoryooley ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose iyo Jalalaqsi ee Hiiraan, kuwaas oo ay sheegtay inay halis weyn wajihi karaan haddii ciidamada shisheeye ay ka baxaan iyadoo aan la helin ciidamo Soomaali ah oo awood u leh inay boosaskooda la wareegaan. Qoryooley ayaa ka mid ah magaalooyinka ay hareeraha kaga sugan yihiin Al-Shabaab, iyadoo Crisis Group ay sheegtay inay “halis ugu jirto inay gacanta u gasho fallaagada” marka ciidamada Midowga Afrika ay ka baxaan. Jalalaqsi ayaa iyaduna wajahaysa cadaadis sii kordhaya, kadib markii Al-Shabaab ay tan iyo 2025 ciidamo badan ku uruurisay qeybo ka mid ah Hirshabelle, gaar ahaan agagaarka waddooyinka muhiimka ah. Crisis Group waxay ka digtay in xitaa luminta deegaanno kooban ay Al-Shabaab siin karto dardar cusub, halka qabsashada waddooyinka iyo xarumaha dhaqaale ay kooxda u abuuri karto ilo dhaqaale oo dheeraad ah. Isbeddel weyn oo amni Digniintan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadeeda caalamka ay isku diyaarinayaan isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada nidaamka amni ee dalka taageerayay ku dhowaad labaatan sano. Mareykanka ayaa bishan ogolaaday in taageerada Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya ee UNSOS la sii wado 12 bilood oo dheeraad ah, halkii si toos ah loo joojin lahaa dhammaadka December 2026. UNSOS ayaa ciidamada AUSSOM siisa adeegyo muhiim ah oo ay ka mid yihiin cunto, biyo, shidaal, gaadiid iyo adeegyo kale oo saadka ah, kuwaas oo u suurtageliya ciidamada Midowga Afrika inay joogaan tobannaan saldhig oo ku yaalla koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya. Crisis Group waxay sheegtay in AUSSOM ay aad ugu adkaan doonto inay qaabkeeda hadda ku sii shaqeyso haddii taageeradaas meesha ka baxdo. Uganda ayaa, tusaale ahaan, in ka badan toban saldhig ku leh Shabeellaha Hoose, kuwaas oo hay’addu sheegtay inay adkaan karto in la sii hayo marka taageerada saadka ee Qaramada Midoobay dhammaato. Hay’addu ma saadaalineyso burbur ku yimaada dowladda federaalka ama in Al-Shabaab ay la wareegto magaalooyinka waaweyn, balse waxay sheegtay in dib-u-gurasho kooban oo laga sameeyo qaar ka mid ah goobaha hadda ay joogaan ciidamada AU-da ay u muuqato mid ay adag tahay in laga fogaado. Ciidamo laba-geesood ah Crisis Group waxay sheegtay in nidaamka amni ee soo socda uu si weyn ugu tiirsanaan karo heshiisyada tooska ah ee Soomaaliya la leedahay dalalka Uganda, Kenya iyo Itoobiya. Dalalkan ayaa sii haysan kara ciidamo gudaha Soomaaliya jooga xitaa haddii howlgalka AUSSOM la dhimo ama mustaqbalka la soo afjaro. Kenya iyo Itoobiya ayaa la filayaa inay xoogga saaraan deegaannada u dhow xuduudahooda, halka Uganda ay mudnaan siin karto Muqdisho iyo hareeraheeda. Türkiye ayaa sidoo kale door weyn ku sii yeelan doonta tababarka iyo taageerada ciidamada Soomaaliya, halka Mareykanka uu sii wadi karo howlgallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada, gaar ahaan taageerada dhinaca cirka. Crisis Group waxay sheegtay in iskaashiyadan laba-geesoodka ahi ay yihiin beddelka ugu macquulsan muddada dhow, balse waxay ku baaqday in la sameeyo hannaan joogto ah oo lagu kala caddeeyo cidda ilaalineysa magaalooyinka, waddooyinka waaweyn iyo goobaha istiraatiijiga ah. Dhulka la haysto ha la difaaco Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale dowladda Soomaaliya kula talisay inay mudnaanta siiso difaaca deegaannada ay hadda maamusho, halkii ay xilligan bilaabi lahayd howlgallo cusub oo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa bishii August sheegtay inay haysato ku dhowaad 14,000 oo askari oo diyaar u ah howlgallo militari. Crisis Group waxay soo jeedisay in qaar ka mid ah ciidamadaas lagu beddelo ciidamada AU-da ee ka baxaya saldhigyada muhiimka ah. Hase yeeshee, waxay ka digtay in ciidamada Soomaaliya guud ahaan aysan haysan qalab iyo taageero la mid ah kuwa ciidamada Midowga Afrika, taas oo beddel toos ah ka dhigaysa mid khatar badan. Qaar ka mid ah goobihii horay ciidamada AU-da loogu wareejiyay ciidamada Soomaaliya ayaa dib ugu dhacay gacanta Al-Shabaab, halka howlgallada ciidamada dowladda ay weli si weyn ugu tiirsan yihiin sirdoon, diyaarado, gaadiid iyo saad ay bixiyaan saaxiibada caalamka. Crisis Group waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo maamulada Puntland iyo Jubaland ay caqabad ku noqdeen dhismaha nidaam amni oo mideysan. Waxay ugu baaqday madaxda Soomaalida inay xalliyaan khilaafaadka doorashooyinka, isla markaana maamul-goboleedyada lagu daro qorsheynta nidaamka amni ee beddeli doona kan hadda jira. Hay’addu waxay ka digtay in haddii waqtiga dheeraadka ah ee la helay aan si wanaagsan looga faa’iideysan, meelaha ay ka baxaan ciidamada shisheeye ay abuuri karaan firaaq amni oo Al-Shabaab ay ka faa’iideysato. items.title: Somalia president pledges democracy at UN amid term extension row
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud said on Thursday his government was laying the foundations of universal suffrage, addressing the United Nations General Assembly as opposition leaders at home said he had left unresolved a dispute over his term extension and changes to the constitution. Mohamud, speaking at the 81st session of the General Assembly in New York, said Somalia was moving toward a multi-party democracy and away from the clan-based power-sharing system that has underpinned its politics for decades. “Through constitutional reform, we’re laying the foundations of universal suffrage, accountable institutions and a multi-party system that allows every Somali citizen to have a voice. Our aim is to become an effective democracy where differences are resolved through dialogue, law and elections, not violence,” president Mohamud said. He added that the United Nations and international partners should support the transition “while respecting Somali ownership of Somali democracy.” Opposition Faults Timing Former President Mohamed Abdullahi Farmajo and other opposition leaders said Mohamud should have resolved Somalia’s political crisis before traveling to New York. Farmajo has accused Mohamud for months of pushing through constitutional changes without consensus and of using a planned shift to one-person-one-vote elections to extend his own time in office. The dispute dates to March 2026, when parliament passed, and Mohamud signed, amendments extending presidential and parliamentary terms to five years from four and pushing national elections back to 2027. Opposition figures, including Farmajo, former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, several former prime ministers, and the Puntland and Jubaland state administrations, said the vote fell short of the consensus required for constitutional change and that some opposition lawmakers were barred from the session. Mohamud’s original mandate expired on May 15, 2026. The government declared what it called a “transition period” after no agreement was reached with the opposition by that date. The standoff has at times turned violent, with clashes reported in Mogadishu and federal forces entering Baidoa amid a related crisis in Southwest State. The political crisis has coincided with strain on Somalia’s security partnerships. The African Union’s stabilization mission in the country has faced a funding shortfall this year, and Ethiopian troops withdrew from the town of Burhakaba, developments that have added to international concern about Somalia’s stability. Wider UN Address Mohamud also called for reform of the UN Security Council, saying Africa’s absence from permanent membership was “a historical injustice” affecting 54 countries. He reaffirmed Somalia’s support for Palestinian statehood along 1967 borders and said instability in the Strait of Hormuz had driven up fuel and food prices at home, adding to economic pressure that has cut customs revenue and pushed up inflation this year. The government has cast the UN appearance as a chance to secure continued international support for Somalia’s institutions. Opposition figures say that support means little without an agreed, consensus-based path to elections at home. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Itoobiya, Jabuuti iyo Dangote oo dhisaya dhuun shidaal oo $660 milyan ah
items.description: Itoobiya, Jabuuti iyo shirkadda Dangote Group ee uu leeyahay ganacsadaha reer Nigeria Aliko Dangote ayaa qorsheynaya in ay si wadajir ah u dhisaan dhuun shidaal oo qiimaheedu gaarayo 660 milyan oo doollar, taas oo isku xiri doonta labada dal, iyadoo mashruucan lagu doonayo in lagu xoojiyo sahayda shidaalka, lana yareeyo kharashaadka iyo dib-u-dhacyada ka dhasha gaadiidka shidaalka ee mara marinka ganacsi ee Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti. Sida ay sheegtay Reuters, mashruuca ayaa ka koobnaan doona dhuun dhererkeedu yahay ku dhowaad 120 kiiloomitir, taas oo qaadi doonta shidaalka la sifeeyey ee u kala gudbaya Jabuuti iyo Itoobiya. Waxaa sidoo kale la dhisi doonaa xarumo waaweyn oo lagu kaydiyo shidaalka. Jabuuti, gaar ahaan deegaanka Damerjog, waxaa laga qorsheeyay xarun kaydin oo qaadi karta ku dhowaad 375,000 mitir kuyuubik oo shidaal ah, halka Dewele ee Itoobiya laga dhisayo xarun kale oo awooddeedu gaareyso 800,000 mitir kuyuubik. Mas’uul ka tirsan xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Ahmed ayaa sheegay in mashruucan la filayo in uu shaqo bilaabo muddo ku dhow 18 bilood gudahood. Abiy Ahmed ayaa sheegay in mashruuca ay iska kaashanayaan Ethiopian Investment Holdings iyo Dangote Group, isaga oo tilmaamay in ujeeddada ugu weyn ay tahay in la yareeyo kharashaadka saadka iyo dib-u-dhacyada ka dhasha gaadiidka shidaalka ee u dhexeeya Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti. Itoobiya oo aan lahayn xeeb ayaa si weyn ugu tiirsan Jabuuti, gaar ahaan dekedaha dalkaas, si ay u hesho badeecooyin muhiim ah oo dibadda laga keeno. Shidaalka ayaa ka mid ah badeecooyinka ugu muhiimsan ee mara marinka Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti, sidaas darteed dhuun shidaal oo si toos ah labada dal u xiriirisa ayaa wax ka beddeli karta habka shidaalka loogu gudbiyo gudaha Itoobiya. Dowladaha labada dal ayaa sidoo kale aaminsan in kaabayaasha cusub ay xoojin karaan ammaanka tamarta, isla markaana ay sare u qaadi karaan adkeysiga silsiladda sahayda. Haddii mashruucu hirgalo, waxaa la filayaa in qayb ka mid ah gaadiidka shidaalka ee hadda ku tiirsan gaadiidka waddooyinka loo wareejiyo dhuunta, taas oo yareyn karta kharashaadka iyo waqtiga loo baahan yahay in shidaalka lagu gaarsiiyo suuqyada Itoobiya. Mashruucan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya sida uu Dangote Group u sii ballaarinayo maalgashigiisa Bariga Afrika, ayadoo Shirkadda ay horey Itoobiya uga wadday mashaariic kale oo waaweyn oo ku kacaya qiyaastii 4 bilyan oo doollar, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin dhuun loogu talagalay warshad bacrimin ah, xarun koronto iyo xarun soo saarta baakadaha polypropylene. Dhanka Kenya, Dangote iyo dowladda dalkaas ayaa sidoo kale lagu wadaa in ay toddobaadka soo socda dhagax-dhigaan mashruuc cusub oo ah warshad sifeysa saliidda ceyriinka ah, taas oo la qorsheeyay in laga dhiso Lamu, iyadoo awooddeedu noqon doonto 700,000 foosto maalintii. Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed ayaa ku dhawaaqay mashruuca dhuunta shidaalka xilli uu booqasho ku joogay Jabuuti, waxaana uu arrinta kala hadlay Madaxweynaha Jabuuti Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle iyo Aliko Dangote. Mashruuca ayaa haddii uu hirgalo noqon kara mid muhiim u ah xiriirka dhaqaale iyo ganacsi ee Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti, gaar ahaan dhinaca tamarta, iyadoo Jabuuti ay sii xoojinayso doorkeeda ah marinka ugu muhiimsan ee Itoobiya u adeegsato ganacsiga iyo soo dejinta badeecooyinka. Dhuuntan shidaalka ee 660-ka milyan ee doollar ah ayaa sidaas darteed noqonaysa mashruuc isku keenaya danaha saddex dhinac: Itoobiya oo raadineysa sahay shidaal oo la isku halleyn karo iyo kharashyo gaadiid oo hooseeya, Jabuuti oo doonaysa in ay sii xoojiso doorkeeda kaabayaasha iyo ganacsiga gobolka, iyo Dangote Group oo sii ballaarinaysa maalgashigeeda dhinacyada tamarta iyo warshadaha Afrika.

Haddii mashruucu hirgalo, waxaa la filayaa in qayb ka mid ah gaadiidka shidaalka ee hadda ku tiirsan gaadiidka waddooyinka loo wareejiyo dhuunta, taas oo yareyn karta kharashaadka iyo waqtiga loo baahan yahay in shidaalka lagu gaarsiiyo suuqyada Itoobiya. Mashruucan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya sida uu Dangote Group u sii ballaarinayo maalgashigiisa Bariga Afrika, ayadoo Shirkadda ay horey Itoobiya uga wadday mashaariic kale oo waaweyn oo ku kacaya qiyaastii 4 bilyan oo doollar, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin dhuun loogu talagalay warshad bacrimin ah, xarun koronto iyo xarun soo saarta baakadaha polypropylene. Dhanka Kenya, Dangote iyo dowladda dalkaas ayaa sidoo kale lagu wadaa in ay toddobaadka soo socda dhagax-dhigaan mashruuc cusub oo ah warshad sifeysa saliidda ceyriinka ah, taas oo la qorsheeyay in laga dhiso Lamu, iyadoo awooddeedu noqon doonto 700,000 foosto maalintii. Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed ayaa ku dhawaaqay mashruuca dhuunta shidaalka xilli uu booqasho ku joogay Jabuuti, waxaana uu arrinta kala hadlay Madaxweynaha Jabuuti Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle iyo Aliko Dangote. Mashruuca ayaa haddii uu hirgalo noqon kara mid muhiim u ah xiriirka dhaqaale iyo ganacsi ee Itoobiya iyo Jabuuti, gaar ahaan dhinaca tamarta, iyadoo Jabuuti ay sii xoojinayso doorkeeda ah marinka ugu muhiimsan ee Itoobiya u adeegsato ganacsiga iyo soo dejinta badeecooyinka. Dhuuntan shidaalka ee 660-ka milyan ee doollar ah ayaa sidaas darteed noqonaysa mashruuc isku keenaya danaha saddex dhinac: Itoobiya oo raadineysa sahay shidaal oo la isku halleyn karo iyo kharashyo gaadiid oo hooseeya, Jabuuti oo doonaysa in ay sii xoojiso doorkeeda kaabayaasha iyo ganacsiga gobolka, iyo Dangote Group oo sii ballaarinaysa maalgashigeeda dhinacyada tamarta iyo warshadaha Afrika.

items.title: Muxuu wasiirkii arrimaha dibedda Maxamed C/risaaq ka yiri warqadda Puntland
items.description: Waxaan akhriyey warqaddii Madaxweyne Deni uu u diray Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo Golaha Ammaanka. Qeybo qoraalka ka mid ah aad bay ii dhibeen—taas macnaheedu ma aha in cabashooyinka Puntland aysan ahayn kuwo jira, balse Deni wuxuu sheeganayaa wax ka baxsan awoodihiisa iyo waajibaadkiisa. Qoraalkiisa wuxuu leeyahay – “Puntland waxay hadda wajahaysaa cadaadis kaga imanaya shacab aad u tiro badan oo doonaya inay si buuxda uga go’aan Soomaaliya.” Meeday caddaynta? Afti miyaa la qaaday? La-tashi dadweyne miyaa dhacay? Afkaarta dadka miyaa la ururiyay? Halkuu mandate-ka ka haystaa? Waxaa kale oo uu leeyahay: “Puntland waxay ugu dambayn ka fiirsan kartaa inay si joogto ah xiriirka uga jarto Muqdisho.” Yaa Deni u siiyey awooddaas uu Puntland kaga jarayo dalka? Puntland ma aha Deni, Deni-na ma aha Puntland. Sannadkii 1998-kii, shacabka Puntland waxay shirkii dastuuriga ahaa ee Garoowe si ku talogal ah ugu go’aansadeen inay qayb ka ahaadaan Soomaaliya ku dhisan nidaam federaal ah. Taariikhdaas hal hoggaamiye siyaasadeed maanta iskama beddeli karo. Tankale, Deni ma iska baxshay galoofisyadii dagaalka oo ma ka tanaasulay hammigiisii ahaa inuu noqdo Madaxweynaha ama Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya? Waayo, warqaddiisu waxay u muuqataa inay leedahay: “ Hadaanan helin heshiiska siyaasadeed ee aan doonayo, Puntland way ka go’aysaa Soomaaliya. ” Taasi waxay ka dhigan tahay ninkii yiri: “Cadyahow ku cunay ama ku ciideeyay.” Maya, taas lagaa diid. Mahadsanid. Waa run, Xasan Sheekh wuxuu galay xadgudubyo culus oo dastuuri ah iyo kuwo siyaasadeedba. Muddadii dastuuriga ahayd ee xil-heyntiisu wey dhammaatay. Xukuumaddiisu waxay awood ciidan u adeegsatay Jubaland iyo Koonfur Galbeed, waxaana ku dhintay dhalinyaro Soomaaliyeed. Kumannaan qof ayaa guryahooda laga barakiciyey, hay’adihii dowladdana waa la wiiqay, musuqmaasuqa iyo eexduna waxay gaareen heerkii ugu darnaa. Cabashooyinkaas ma aha kuwo u gaar ah hal qabiil, hal gobol ama hal dhinac siyaasadeed. Soomaali inteeda badan oo ka kala socota dalka oo dhan—oo ay ku jiraan reer Puntland—iyo qurbo-joogtu way wada qabaan aragtidaas. Haddaba maxaad Xasan Sheekh u siinaysaa meel uu ka baxsado, adigoo leh Puntland waxay ka go’i kartaa Soomaaliya? Maxaad u oggolaanaysaa inuu doodda ka leexiyo xadgudubyadiisa dastuuriga ah, oo uu u beddelo dood ku saabsan difaaca midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya? Maxaad u oggolaanaysaa inuu u muuqdo mid ka macquulsan dadka siyaasadda kaga soo horjeeda, arrin ay ahayd inaan dhammaanteen ka mideysnaano? Maxaad ugu oggolaanaysaa inuu caalamka ugu muuqdo qof ka macquulsan mucaaradkiisa marka ay noqoto midnimada Soomaaliya? Kulama dagaalami karo shakhsi inuu ku-takri-fallay awood, anagoo isla markaana u ogolaanayna inuu midkale sheegto magac iyo awood shacbi uusan ogolaasho u haysan. Soomaaliya waxaa leh dhammaan dadka Soomaaliyeed oo dhan, Puntland-na dadkeeda. Ma jiri karo hoggaamiye siyaasadeed oo xaq u leh inuu magaca Soomaaliya ama Puntland iyo midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya ku bedesho dano gaar ah, ama uu iska sameysto awood uu ku sheegto in dadku doonayaan gooni-isu-taag. Waxaa qoray Maxamed Cabdirisaaq, wasiirkii hore ee arrimaha dibedda Soomaaliya oo reer Puntland ah. items.title: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya oo Qaramada Midoobay ka dalbaday xabbad-joojin degdeg ah oo Gaza ka dhaqan-gasha
items.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Qaramada Midoobay ka jeediyay baaq ku aaddan in si degdeg ah oo waarta loo joojiyo colaadda Gaza, iyadoo sidoo kale loo oggolaado in gargaarka bani’aadannimo uu si aan xannibaad lahayn u gaaro shacabka Falastiiniyiinta. Khudbaddiisa uu ka jeediyay Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya wuxuu sheegay in rabshadaha, barakaca iyo xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee ka jirta dhulka Falastiiniyiinta, gaar ahaan Gaza, ay u baahan yihiin tallaabo degdeg ah oo caalami ah. Wuxuu ku celiyay baaqa Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan xabbad-joojin degdeg ah oo waarta , iyo in la fududeeyo gaarsiinta gargaarka bani’aadannimo dadka u baahan. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay  in dib loogu laabto dadaallada siyaasadeed ee lagu doonayo in lagu gaaro xalka labada dowladood , isaga oo ku tilmaamay waddada keliya ee lagu gaari karo nabad caddaalad ah oo waarta oo ka dhalata Bariga Dhexe. Mawqifkan ayaa sidoo kale ka mid ahaa hadalkii Xasan Sheekh ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, kaas oo lagu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay si qoto dheer uga walaacsan tahay dhibaatada shacabka Falastiiniyiinta. Baaqan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli xaaladda Gaza iyo arrinta Falastiin ay ka mid yihiin qodobada ugu waaweyn ee looga hadlayo kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa iyaduna si gaar ah u adkaysay muhiimadda xalka labada dowladood, iyadoo Xoghayaha Guud António Guterres uu sheegay in xal waara uu ku salaysnaado dowlad Falastiini ah oo madax-bannaan iyo Israel oo si nabad iyo amni ah u wada nool. Mowqifka Soomaaliya wuxuu sidoo kale la jaanqaadayaa siyaasadda ay Muqdisho muddo dheer ka taagnayd arrinta Falastiin, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay taageerto xaqa shacabka Falastiiniyiinta u leeyihiin dowlad madax-bannaan iyo xal siyaasadeed oo ku dhisan xeerarka iyo qawaaniinta caalamiga ah. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha ayaa muujisay in Soomaaliya ay doonayso in dadaallada caalamiga ah lagu saleeyo joojinta colaadda, ilaalinta shacabka, gaarsiinta gargaarka bani’aadannimo iyo dib u soo nooleynta geeddi-socod siyaasadeed oo horseeda xal waara oo u dhexeeya Falastiin iyo Israa’iil.

items.title: Safiirka cusub ee Turkiga ee Soomaaliya oo soo saaray farriin culus kadib markii uu…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Danjiraha cusub ee Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, oo soo gaaray Muqdisho, ayaa sheegay in Ankara ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, horumarinta iyo xoojinta awoodda hay’adaha dowladda. Alkan ayaa hadalkan ku sheegay farriintiisii ugu horreysay ee uu u diray shacabka Soomaaliyeed kaddib markii uu si rasmi ah u bilaabay shaqadiisa safiirnimo ee Muqdisho. Waxa uu sheegay inuu sharaf iyo farxad weyn u yahay inuu xilka la wareego xilli Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ay xusayaan 60 sano oo ka soo wareegtay markii ay labada dal yeesheen xiriir diblomaasiyadeed. Xilligan ayaa sidoo kale ku beegan 15 sano guuradii ka soo wareegtay booqashadii taariikhiga ahayd ee madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan uu ku yimid Soomaaliya sanadkii 2011, xilli uu ahaa ra’iisul wasaare. “Waxaan sharaf iyo farxad weyn u arkaa inaan xilka safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya bilaabo xilligan muhiimka ah,” ayuu yiri Alkan. Danjiraha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu shalay Muqdisho kula kulmay dhalinyaro Soomaaliyeed goob lagu qaxweeyo, isaga oo kala hadlay xaaladda dalka iyo aragtidooda ku saabsan isbeddellada ka jira caasimadda. Sida uu sheegay Alkan, dhalinyarada uu la kulmay ayaa muujiyey inay ku faraxsan yihiin xaaladda amni iyo degganaansho ee sanadihii ugu dambeeyey laga dareemayey Muqdisho iyo nawaaxigeeda. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in Turkigu uu si buuxda u taageerayo dadaallada Soomaaliya ee lagu xoojinayo amniga, horumarka iyo awoodda hay’adaha dowladda. Alkan ayaa sheegay in Ankara ay doonayso in xiriirka labada dal lagu sii horumariyo ixtiraam, kalsooni iyo dano wadajir ah, iyadoo mudnaanta la siinayo horumarka iyo danta labada shacab. “Ujeeddadeenna ugu weyn waa inaan xiriirka Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya sii gaarsiino heer sare, annagoo ku dhiseyna ixtiraam, kalsooni iyo dano wadajir ah,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in safaaradda Turkiga ee Muqdisho ay diyaar u tahay inay dhageysato fikradaha iyo talooyinka muwaadiniinta Turkiga iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. “Albaabada safaaraddeennu mar walba way idiin furnaan doonaan,” ayuu yiri. Ferhat Alkan ayaa xilka kala wareegay Alper Aktaş, iyadoo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga uu sanadihii la soo dhaafay si weyn ugu fiday dhinacyada amniga, tababarka ciidamada, horumarinta, gargaarka bani’aadannimo, ganacsiga iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah. items.title: Ugu yaraan 41 qof oo ku dhintay doon ku degtay harada Tanganyika ee dalka DRC Congo
items.description: Ugu yaraan 41 qof ayaa ku dhintay, halka 49 kalena la soo badbaadiyey, kaddib markii doon ay saarnaayeen ku dhowaad 100 qof oo rakaab iyo xamuul ah ay ku rogmatay harada Tanganyika ee Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo (DRC). Doontan ayaa ka ambabaxday dekedda Kigoma ee dalka Tanzania, iyadoo ku sii jeedday magaalada Kalemie ee DRC, waxaana ay ku degtay meel u dhow tuulada Mapera habeenkii Khamiista. Mas’uuliyiinta gobolka Tanganyika ayaa sheegay in hawlgallada baadigoobka iyo samatabbixinta ay weli socdaan, iyadoo kooxaha gurmadku ay raadinayaan rakaab kale oo laga yaabo inay ku jireen doonta markii ay rogmatay. Ilaa hadda lama xaqiijin tirada saxda ah ee dadka la la’yahay, sidaas darteed waxaa suuragal ah in tirada dhimashada ay isbeddesho marka hawlgallada gurmadku sii socdaan. Mid ka mid ah dadka ka badbaaday shilkan, Annie Moyoni, ayaa Radio Okapi u sheegtay in rakaabka laga kiciyey hurdada abbaaraha 1:00 habeenimo, kaddib markii ay ogaadeen in doontu hal dhinac u janjeertay. Shilkan ayaa mar kale soo bandhigay khatarta ka jirta gaadiidka biyaha ee Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo, halkaas oo doonyuhu ay door muhiim ah ka ciyaaraan isku socodka dadka iyo badeecadaha. Dad badan oo ku nool dalka ayaa doonyaha u isticmaala safarrada maadaama ay yihiin habka ugu jaban ee gaadiid, gaar ahaan meelaha ay ka liitaan waddooyinka iyo kaabayaasha kale ee gaadiidka. doonyaha qaarkood ayaa la sheegay inay qaadaan rakaab iyo xamuul ka badan awooddooda, iyadoo qalabka badbaadada sida jaakadaha dabaasha aanu mar walba ku filnayn dadka saaran. Musiibadan ayaa sidoo kale dhacday xilli wax ka yar hal bil uu ka soo wareegay shil kale oo ka dhacay isla marinka Kigoma iyo Kalemie, waxaana 28-kii Agoosto, markabka MV Pacifique uu dab qabsaday kadibna ku qarxay dekedda Kigoma xilli shidaal lagu shubayey. Sida uu sheegay Radio Okapi, lix shaqaale ah ayaa ku dhintay dhacdadaas, halka qof toddobaad ahna la sheegay inuu weli maqan yahay. Sidoo kale, bishii Luulyo, ugu yaraan 20 qof ayaa ku dhintay bartamaha DRC kaddib markii doon alwaax ah oo ay saarnaayeen arday ka soo laabanayey imtixaannada dowladda ay degtay. Dhacdooyinkan isdaba jooga ah ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo badbaadada gaadiidka biyaha ee dalka. Harada Tanganyika, oo ah mid ka mid ah harooyinka waaweyn ee Afrika, waxay muhiim u tahay isku socodka iyo ganacsiga dadka ku nool gobollada ku hareeraysan.

items.title: Somalia reaffirms support for Palestinian statehood at UN General Assembly
items.description: Somalia called for a resolution to the plight of the Palestinian people on Thursday, while saying the crisis in the Strait of Hormuz poses a threat not only to itself but the rest of the region. Speaking at the UN General Assembly in New York, Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud warned that the world faces uncertainty amid escalating political, military and climate crises, calling on the organization to reform and improve to better serve the needs of the world’s most vulnerable. “For millions of vulnerable people, global development can sometimes appear to be moving from one framework to another framework,” he said. “Trust in the UN won’t be restored through declarations alone. It will be restored when institutions act constituently, uphold international law and produce results that people can see and experience.” On the issue of Palestine, Mohamud was clear: “Somalia stands firmly with the Palestinian people and their legitimate right to self-determination and statehood. “We reaffirm our support for a just and lasting peace based on a two-state solution with an independent and viable Palestinian state along the 1967 borders. “A just resolution of the Palestinian question remains essential to lasting peace and stability in the Middle East and beyond.” He added: “Respect for international law is becoming increasingly selective. Multilateral cooperation is weakening; conflict, geopolitical rivalry and mistrust are becoming the defining features of our time. Uncertainty, unfortunately, has become the new norm.” Mohamud warned that it is not just conflict that poses a threat to humanity, raising climate change as a profound concern of his government and others. “Humanitarian needs are rising while the resources available to meet them are rapidly declining. “Nationalism, intolerance and political polarization are weakening the spirit of international cooperation.” He added: “The climate crisis continues to destroy lives, livelihoods and public infrastructure, particularly across the developing world. “According the UN, over 40 percent of the global population are vulnerable to the destructive effects of climate change, and governments in developing countries spend over 10 percent of their GDP (gross domestic product) to respond to this. “This painful fiscal trade off comes at the expense of investment in education and health, which should never be the case.” The escalation of the conflict in the Gulf, and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, have placed great strain on Somalia, he said. “For Somalia, disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz have serious economic and humanitarian consequences. “As an import-dependent country reliant on the Middle East for much of our food, fuel, trade, Somalia is already facing rising prices, inflation.” He added: “Ensuring free and fair navigation through the strait is therefore essential to protecting vulnerable economies like Somalia, and sustaining stability, advancing development and delivering basic services.” As a non-permanent member of the UN Security Council, Mohamud called for reform of a body that has failed with African representation despite the continent’s various conflicts over the years. The UNSC “must become more representative, transparent and effective,” he said. “Africa remains unrepresented in the permanent category … This historical injustice against 54 sovereign states can’t be postponed indefinitely. “Somalia supports the common African position and meaningful representation in both categories of the council. “Given that many of the discussions directly concern African states, they have the right to full representation on equal par with all other permanent Security Council members.” His country, Mohamud said, has played an outsized role in maintaining international security in its fight against organized terrorist groups in East Africa. “Somalia continues to confront international terrorism with determination and with the support of our international partners. “We’re strengthening our national security institutions, improving force generation, developing intelligence capabilities and expanding security cooperation with our neighbors and the rest of the world,” he said. “But the fight against terrorism in Somalia mustn’t be understood as Somalia’s responsibility alone. “We stand on the frontline for a struggle that directly effects regional and international security. “We therefore call for predictable, sustainable support for Somalia’s security transition, including adequate financing for an African Union mission in Somalia.” He noted that negative effects of international intervention in African states has affected Somalia in particular, saying: “Respect for national sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity isn’t an abstract principle for Somalia only. “It’s a foundation for peace and stability in our country, our region and the wider international community. “Therefore, Somalia firmly rejects unilateral actions that undermine its sovereign, unity and internationally recognized borders.” Mohamud also focused on the need for UN assistance in his country to be better organized and coordinated to allow the government to lead its own development. “The majority of UN assistance continues to be delivered through parallel structures, fragmented projects and off-budget arrangements in Somalia. “This makes it difficult for the government to plan, coordinate resources, measure results and build institutions required for long-term stability. “Let us be clear here, Somalia isn’t calling for the UN to withdraw, we’re simply calling for a more accountable, strategic and result-oriented partnership where Somali institutions are in the lead when it comes to implementation.” Political progress and reform, he said, are of paramount importance for Somalia’s development. “Our people have dreamed of choosing their leaders through their vote. The last democratic election that took place in Somalia was held in 1969. Today, we’re determined to change that history. “Through constitutional reform, we’re laying the foundations of universal suffrage, accountable institutions and a multi-party system that allows every Somali citizen to have a voice. “Our aim is to become an effective democracy where differences are resolved through dialogue, law and elections, not violence.” Mohamud concluded: “Somalia is proudly playing an active role in global stability, both at home and within the key existing multilateral structures of global governance. “We’re also rebuilding our economy and (are) unwaveringly committing to democracy and people-centered, people-led, people-owned development. “As we march forward with purpose and determination, we invite Africa and the rest of the world to remain our steadfast champions on this journey.” Arab news.

items.title: Somalia’s Federal System Frays as Election Crisis Reaches Hirshabelle and Galmudug
items.description: Future Council Takes Somalia’s Electoral Crisis to the UN as Political Rupture Spreads Across the Federal States Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s political crisis is no longer confined to a confrontation between Mogadishu and its most outspoken opponents. It is now spreading into the heart of the federal system, with Hirshabelle and Galmudug increasingly drawn into the same electoral and constitutional disputes that have already fractured relations with Puntland, Jubaland and South West State. The warning could hardly be more stark. The Somali Future Council has taken the country’s political crisis directly to the United Nations Security Council, arguing that repeated attempts to negotiate an electoral settlement have failed and that Somalia is approaching a dangerous constitutional and political confrontation. In a letter addressed to Security Council President Jérôme Bonnafont, the opposition coalition called for international mediation, independent monitoring and an inclusive political agreement covering elections, constitutional arrangements and relations between the Federal Government and the federal member states. The letter was dated September 11, according to reporting on its contents. The significance goes beyond the opposition’s immediate demands. It exposes a federal system increasingly divided over who controls the electoral process, who determines the rules and whether regional governments can legitimately be elected through a process designed or heavily influenced by Mogadishu. The Crisis Moves Into Hirshabelle The most immediate flashpoint is now Hirshabelle.Political leaders and traditional figures in Hiiraan have rejected the planned regional election unless a prior political agreement is reached. Hirshabelle Vice President Yusuf Hagar Dabageed has warned that an election cannot proceed in Hiiraan without broad political consensus. The confrontation intensified after President Ali Abdullahi Hussein Guudlaawe was selected as the ruling Justice and Unity Party’s candidate for another term. Opponents in Hiiraan argue that the next Hirshabelle presidency should be determined through a political agreement involving the region’s principal constituencies. Dabageed has separately accused President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of abandoning an alleged understanding that the Hawadle community would be considered for the Hirshabelle presidency. That allegation has been reported by Somali media but remains a claim by Dabageed rather than an independently established fact. The result is a potentially explosive contradiction: Mogadishu is pressing ahead with a regional electoral timetable while a significant political constituency in one of Hirshabelle’s two constituent regions says the process lacks the necessary agreement. Galmudug Is Also Under Pressure Hirshabelle is not the only federal state facing political uncertainty. Galmudug has also been drawn into the national electoral dispute, with disagreements over its forthcoming leadership election and competing political interests surrounding the process. Earlier this year, reports described a serious political dispute over the future leadership of Galmudug and tensions involving figures close to the federal government. President Hassan Sheikh has reportedly maintained that national electoral discussions should follow regional elections in Galmudug and Hirshabelle, a position that places enormous political importance on the outcome of those two state-level contests. That sequencing is contested by the opposition, which argues that the national electoral framework itself must first be negotiated among the major political actors. The dispute therefore becomes circular: Mogadishu wants regional elections to move forward before a broader national settlement, while its opponents want a national political agreement before the regional electoral process becomes irreversible. Puntland and Jubaland Already Outside the Political Centre The Future Council’s appeal comes against a backdrop of an increasingly fractured relationship between Mogadishu and Puntland and Jubaland, whose leaders have been among the strongest opponents of the Federal Government’s approach to elections, constitutional reform and federal power-sharing. The two administrations have been outside normal political cooperation with Mogadishu for an extended period, while their leaders participate in the Future Council. Puntland separately submitted its own letter to the Security Council this month, calling for greater international engagement with the federal member states and an inclusive political dialogue. The combined effect is striking: the dispute is no longer simply between a federal government and a conventional opposition bloc. It increasingly involves competing centres of political authority across Somalia’s federal map. South West State Shows How Quickly the Crisis Can Turn Violent South West State provides an even more alarming precedent. The political confrontation between Mogadishu and Baidoa has already produced a severe rupture, with the federal government and South West authorities becoming locked in a dispute over political control and the electoral process. The experience has become a warning for other federal states: an argument that begins over electoral rules can quickly become a confrontation over security forces, territorial authority and control of government institutions. That is precisely why the developing disputes in Hirshabelle and Galmudug are attracting such attention. The Bigger Problem: One Election, Multiple Political Systems At the centre of Somalia’s crisis is a deceptively simple question: Who gets to decide the rules of the next election? The Federal Government has pursued constitutional and electoral changes that it presents as part of a transition toward a new political system. Its opponents argue that fundamental changes to the electoral framework require agreement among the federal government, federal member states and other major political stakeholders. The Future Council says it has proposed a transitional model combining direct elections with the 4.5 power-sharing formula as a compromise intended to bring competing camps back to the negotiating table. The government has a different position. The disagreement has already contributed to failed rounds of political talks, while international mediation efforts involving Turkey and other international partners have yet to produce a comprehensive settlement. A Country Divided Over the Rules of Politics The danger is therefore larger than any individual presidential contest. If elections in different federal states are perceived as being determined by competing political centres rather than by negotiated rules accepted by the principal stakeholders, Somalia could end up with multiple governments claiming democratic legitimacy at the same time. That is the deeper fear now hanging over Hirshabelle and Galmudug. The political rupture with Puntland and Jubaland has not been resolved. South West State has experienced its own confrontation with Mogadishu. Now Hirshabelle is entering an increasingly bitter dispute, while Galmudug faces its own contested electoral process. The result is a federal system under extraordinary pressure. The UN Is Being Asked to Step In The Future Council is now asking the Security Council to intervene before the political dispute becomes even more deeply entrenched. Its proposals include an inclusive political dialogue, international mediation and guarantees for any agreement reached, as well as independent monitoring of political and security developments. The timing is significant. The UN Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia is scheduled to complete its transition on October 31, 2026, while international support for Somalia’s security architecture is itself being recalibrated. The United States recently agreed to extend the period for ending UN support to AUSSOM, underscoring the continuing international concern over Somalia’s political and security fragility. The most unsettling feature of Somalia’s current crisis is that the country is not facing one political dispute. It is facing several disputes that are beginning to overlap — elections, constitutional reform, federal authority, regional leadership, security forces and political legitimacy. Puntland and Jubaland remain locked in confrontation with Mogadishu. South West State has experienced a dramatic rupture. Hirshabelle is now approaching its own electoral crisis. Galmudug faces growing political pressure. The Future Council’s appeal to the Security Council is therefore more than another opposition complaint. It is a warning that Somalia’s federal political bargain is beginning to fray across multiple fronts at once. Whether that fragmentation remains political or develops into further security confrontation may depend on one unresolved question: Can Somalia agree on the rules of the next election before competing authorities begin treating their own electoral processes as the only legitimate path forward? The disagreement has already contributed to failed rounds of political talks, while international mediation efforts involving Turkey and other international partners have yet to produce a comprehensive settlement. A Country Divided Over the Rules of Politics The danger is therefore larger than any individual presidential contest. If elections in different federal states are perceived as being determined by competing political centres rather than by negotiated rules accepted by the principal stakeholders, Somalia could end up with multiple governments claiming democratic legitimacy at the same time. That is the deeper fear now hanging over Hirshabelle and Galmudug. The political rupture with Puntland and Jubaland has not been resolved. South West State has experienced its own confrontation with Mogadishu. Now Hirshabelle is entering an increasingly bitter dispute, while Galmudug faces its own contested electoral process. The result is a federal system under extraordinary pressure. The UN Is Being Asked to Step In The Future Council is now asking the Security Council to intervene before the political dispute becomes even more deeply entrenched. Its proposals include an inclusive political dialogue, international mediation and guarantees for any agreement reached, as well as independent monitoring of political and security developments. The timing is significant. The UN Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia is scheduled to complete its transition on October 31, 2026, while international support for Somalia’s security architecture is itself being recalibrated. The United States recently agreed to extend the period for ending UN support to AUSSOM, underscoring the continuing international concern over Somalia’s political and security fragility. The most unsettling feature of Somalia’s current crisis is that the country is not facing one political dispute. It is facing several disputes that are beginning to overlap — elections, constitutional reform, federal authority, regional leadership, security forces and political legitimacy. Puntland and Jubaland remain locked in confrontation with Mogadishu. South West State has experienced a dramatic rupture. Hirshabelle is now approaching its own electoral crisis. Galmudug faces growing political pressure. The Future Council’s appeal to the Security Council is therefore more than another opposition complaint. It is a warning that Somalia’s federal political bargain is beginning to fray across multiple fronts at once. Whether that fragmentation remains political or develops into further security confrontation may depend on one unresolved question: Can Somalia agree on the rules of the next election before competing authorities begin treating their own electoral processes as the only legitimate path forward? items.title: Puntland oo shaacisay inay soo furatay markab shidaal oo afduub loo haystay
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Puntland ayaa sheegtay inay howlgal ku soo furtay markab ay kooxo burcad-badeed ku haysteen xeebaha Mudug, iyadoo maamulka ay xaqiijiyay in markabka iyo shaqaalihii saarnaa lasoo badbaadiyay. Howlgalka ayaa sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac, iyadoo Puntland ay sheegtay in saddex qof ay ku dhinteen dagaalka, halka dhowr kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Markabka oo lagu magacaabo MTT-SIBU 1 ayaa lagu qabtay meel u dhexeysa xeebaha Garacad iyo Hobyo, sida ay sheegeen laamaha ammaanka Puntland. Markabkan ayaa siday shidaal, wuxuuna ku safrayay calanka dalka Eritrea. Ciidamada Badda Puntland ee PMPF ayaa fuliyay howlgalka lagu soo furtay markabka, xilli ciidamadu ay maalmihii lasoo dhaafay howlgallo ka dhan ah kooxaha burcad-badeedda ka wadeen xeebaha Puntland. War kasoo baxay maamulka Puntland ayaa lagu sheegay in howlgalka lagu badbaadiyay markabka iyo shaqaalihii saarnaa, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanku ay gacanta ku dhigeen markabka kaddib iska horimaad ay la galeen kooxdii haysatay. Markabka SIBU 1 ayaa 21-kii August laga afduubtay xeebaha dalka Yemen, ka hor inta aysan kooxihii qabsaday u soo jiheysan xeebaha Soomaaliya. Furashada markabka ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo xeebaha Mudug iyo deegaanno kale oo Puntland ah ay ciidamada badda ka wadaan howlgallo lagu beegsanayo kooxaha ku lugta leh afduubka iyo qabsashada maraakiibta. Puntland ayaa sheegtay in howlgalka uu kusoo dhammaaday si guul leh, laguna soo furashada markabka iyo shaqaalihii saarnaa, iyadoo laamaha ammaanku ay sii wadaan howlgalladooda ka dhanka ah kooxaha burcad-badeedda. items.title: Puntland Appeals to UN Security Council Over Somalia’s Political and Security Crisis
items.description: Puntland Calls for Inclusive Dialogue, Greater International Engagement with Federal States and Continued UN Role Garowe (WDN) — Puntland has appealed to the United Nations Security Council for renewed international engagement in Somalia, warning of deepening political, security and economic tensions between the Federal Government and federal member states. In a letter dated September 13, 2026, addressed to UN Secretary-General António Guterres and the Security Council president for September, French Ambassador Jérôme Bonnafont, Puntland called for an inclusive Somali political dialogue to address disputes over the constitution, elections and the division of powers between Mogadishu and the federal states. Puntland said its relations with the Federal Government have deteriorated significantly since 2023, accusing Mogadishu of interfering in its internal affairs and supporting rival political and armed actors. The allegations represent Puntland’s position and have not been independently established. The Federal Government has previously rejected accusations that it seeks to undermine federal member states. Puntland administration also highlighted its ongoing military campaign against Islamic State militants in the Cal Miskaad mountains, arguing that Puntland forces have not received sufficient federal military, financial or logistical support. Puntland further cited the August confrontation in Gaalkacyo, claiming that weapons and equipment were being transported toward northern Gaalkacyo. It said its forces detained 101 people and seized weapons, vehicles and other equipment. The account has not been independently verified. The letter also raised concerns about maritime security and what Puntland described as signs of a possible resurgence of Somali piracy. It urged renewed international cooperation to protect Somalia’s coastline and commercial shipping. Puntland separately alleged that Turkish forces carried out strikes near Garmaal and Jiifle on August 18 and 20, claiming that 14 Somalis were killed and fishing boats destroyed. The allegations have not been independently verified. The administration also called for an investigation into a September 3 drone strike in Doolow, arguing that modern military capabilities provided for counterterrorism operations should not be used in Somalia’s internal political disputes. Six Requests to the Security Council Puntland outlined six principal requests: 1. Inclusive political dialogue involving the Federal Government, federal member states and other major political stakeholders. 2. Greater direct international engagement with federal member states, particularly on security, humanitarian assistance and development. 3. Restoration of the UN Panel of Experts’ monitoring powers over arms flows, organized crime and militant networks. 4. A review of Somalia’s arms restrictions, amid concerns that military equipment could be diverted to domestic political confrontations. 5. Extension of the UN Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS), which is currently scheduled to complete its transition on October 31, 2026. 6. Greater international scrutiny of resource management and government transparency, including agreements and contracts involving Somalia’s national resources. 7. That Puntland is currently facing pressures from huge masses of its citizens, “who are in favor of full independence from the Center. Puntland also urged the Security Council to support a political process capable of resolving disputes between Mogadishu and the federal member states rather than allowing disagreements to escalate into security confrontations. The administration warned that continued political deadlock could deepen divisions between Somalia’s political authorities and potentially lead to the emergence of competing political centres. Puntland nevertheless reaffirmed its support for a stable, peaceful, democratic and federal Somalia. The letter comes as Somalia faces unresolved disputes over constitutional reforms, elections and federal relations, while international partners prepare for further discussions on the country’s political and security situation. Puntland’s appeal is expected to add to growing international attention on whether Somalia’s political leaders can reach a negotiated settlement before existing disagreements further strain relations between Mogadishu and the federal member states. items.title: Beledweyne Erupts as Hirshabelle Election Crisis Deepens
items.description: Protesters Reject Hirshabelle Vote as Political Disputes Threaten to Deepen Somalia’s Federal Fragmentation Beledweyne (WDN) — Somalia’s political fragmentation is once again spilling into the streets. Hundreds of residents, politicians, elders and community figures gathered in Beledweyne on Thursday, protesting against the planned Hirshabelle leadership election and accusing the Federal Government and Hirshabelle authorities of pursuing a political process without sufficient local consensus. The demonstrations mark a dramatic escalation in a dispute that has been building for weeks and now threatens to destabilize relations between Hiiraan and Middle Shabelle, the two regions that make up Hirshabelle State. At the heart of the confrontation is a demand from influential Hiiraan politicians and elders that no election should proceed until a political agreement is reached on representation and power-sharing. “If You Reject Us, We Reject You” MP Gurey, speaking at the demonstration, delivered a blunt message to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Hirshabelle authorities. “If you reject us, we reject you too,” he said, rejecting what he described as the Hirshabelle election process and warning against governing through clan-based political arrangements. Another lawmaker, Mohamed Buraale, said there had previously been an understanding that political power within Hirshabelle would be shared between Hiiraan and Middle Shabelle. He accused Middle Shabelle of effectively controlling both the state capital and the presidency and warned that failure to resolve the dispute could lead to demands for an alternative political arrangement. A State Already Under Strain The confrontation is not occurring in isolation. Hirshabelle Vice President Yusuf Hagar Dabageed has accused President Hassan Sheikh of abandoning an earlier understanding that the Hawadle community would be considered for the Hirshabelle presidency. The allegation has been denied or disputed politically and has become one of the central grievances surrounding the election. The dispute intensified after the Justice and Unity Party (JSP) nominated incumbent Hirshabelle President Ali Abdullahi Hussein Guudlaawe as its candidate for another term. That decision has further divided political opinion in Hiiraan, where influential figures have demanded that the electoral process be suspended until an agreement is reached. From Federal Dispute to State-Level Crisis The developments are becoming a wider test of Somalia’s federal political system. The Federal Government has promoted a direct electoral model, while opponents have raised concerns over political consensus, representation and the distribution of power among Somalia’s regions and communities. The dispute in Hirshabelle now raises a more fundamental question: what happens when a regional election is regarded by a significant part of one constituent region as lacking political consent? For Hiiraan’s political leaders, the answer appears increasingly confrontational. For the Federal Government, the challenge is to prevent a regional electoral dispute from becoming another centre of political confrontation. The Federal System Under Pressure The crisis comes after months of widening political divisions across Somalia, with disputes over elections, constitutional changes and the relationship between Mogadishu and the federal member states. Critics of President Hassan Sheikh’s approach argue that political arrangements backed by Villa Somalia risk weakening the federal system by empowering preferred candidates and bypassing negotiated agreements. Those accusations are contested, and the political positions of the various federal and regional actors remain sharply divided. But the developments in Beledweyne demonstrate that the dispute is no longer confined to political meetings in Mogadishu. It has reached the streets. The protests in Beledweyne, together with previous opposition to the electoral process from Hiiraan politicians and elders, show how quickly a dispute over one regional presidency can become a broader confrontation over political representation and federal authority. A Warning for Hirshabelle — and Somalia Somalia’s federal structure was designed to distribute political authority among the federal government and member states. Yet the latest confrontation exposes how fragile that arrangement can become when elections are pursued without agreement among competing political constituencies. The danger is not simply another disputed regional election. It is the possibility that political disagreements in one federal state begin to reproduce themselves across the country, deepening the fragmentation already visible in Somalia’s national politics. For now, the immediate flashpoint is Beledweyne. But the question hanging over Hirshabelle is much larger: Can a regional government survive when one of its constituent regions says the political process no longer represents its interests? The answer may determine whether the current crisis remains a Hirshabelle dispute — or becomes another chapter in Somalia’s widening political fragmentation. items.title: Afar boqol oo macalin oo shaqo la’aan noqday, markii ay xirmeen iskuullo ku yaalla Garowe
items.description: (ERGO) – Nolol xumo ayaa soo wajahday qoysaska afar boqol oo bare oo ku nool Garowe iyo tuulooyinka hoos taga, markii iskuullo ay wax ka dhigi jireen ay qaar xirmeen, kuwana ay dhimeen tirada macalimiinta. Jaamac Maxamuud Axmed oo ka mid ah wuxuu Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in dhamaan baahiyaha aas-aasiga ah uu awoodi la’yahay qoyskiisa oo 9 ah, kaligiisna ku tiirsan. Ninkaan oo ka mid ahaa barayaasha iskuulka hoose dhexe ee Waaberi ee magaalada Garowe ayaa xusay in uu ka mid noqday macalimiin shaqadooda waayay, dhaqaala yari iskuulka soo wajahday darteed. Waxaa meesha ka baxday $200 oo ahaa mushaarkiisa bisha. Dhaqaalahaas ayuu ku dabari jiray cunnada, biyaha, kirada iyo waxbarashada carruurtiisa. Wuxuu xusay in baagamuudo-nimada soo wajahday awgeed uu hadda cunno ku filan u awoodi la’yahay reerkiisa. “Hal mar ayaan dabka shidana maalinkii. Wixii Illahey na siiyo ayaan dabka saarana. Ehel, asxaab ama daris aan caawimaad ka dalbano ayaan ku tiirsanahay. Cunno xumada carruurtayd culays aad u wayn ayay igu haysa.” Jamaac ayaa sheegay in uu ahaa macalin ardayda u dhiga luuqadda Ingriiska. Dhanka kale baahiyaha kale ee reerkiisu wajahayaan waxaa ka mid ah biyo yari. Waxay ku tiirsan yihiin jirgaan ama ka yar oo ay ka helaan dadka nolol dhaama dhaqaale ahaan. Wuxuu xusay in uu ka faro maran yahay $0.4 oo ay jirgaankii iibiyaan baraago gaar loo leeyahay. Wuxuu tilmaamay in qoyskiisa dhamaadkii bishii Ogosto laga soo saaray qol dhagax ah oo ay ku noolaayeen, markii uu awoodi waayay kirada, korontada iyo biyaha oo isku darkooda uu ku bixin jiray $80. Arrintan waxay ku qasabtay in ka soo guuran xaafada Koowda August oo ay daganayeen uuna reerka geeyo dhul banana oo duleedka magaalad ah. Waxay qoyskiisa halkaasi ka dhisteen cooshad ay ka samaysteen maryo iyo ullo laisku geeyay. “Kaligay ima saamayn arrintan maclimiin badan oo aan garanaya ayaa shaqo la’aan noqday oo baaga-muudo ah hadda.” Jaamac oo shaqo la’aan ah muddo 2 bil ah ayaa sheegay in marba marka la danbaysa aya ka sii darayso xaaaladda qoyskiisa. Wuxuu sheegay inmarar badan magaalada ka raadiyay shaqooyin xamaal ah si uu reerka dabka ugu shido hasa ahaate uu ku hungoobay. Wuxuu ayaa tilmaamay in xaaladdan ay uga waxbarasho beeleen saddex carruur. Wuxuu xusay in uu awoodi waayay $25 oo wax lagu barayay, taasi oo sababtay in laga soo eryo iskuulka.   Ninkaan oo bare ahaa ku dhawaad 10 sano ayaa tilmaamay in uusan waligiisa wax kayd ah samaysan taasi oo uu hadda uu ka shalaynayo. Iskuullada ay macalimiintooda shaqo la’aanta noqdeen ayaa iskugu jira kuwa gaar loo leeyahay iyo kuwa ay gacanta ku hayeen dowlada Putland iyo hay’ado samafal, kuwaas oo ku yaallay xeryaha lagu barakacay ee Garowe.   Xamdi Cali Axmed oo wax ka dhigaysay muddo 15 sano ah iskuul hoose dhexe oo ku yaallay xerada Shabeelle oo dadkii dagana laga barakiciyay ayaa sheegtay in tan iyo bishii July ay carruurteeda u awoodi la’dahay cunno ku filan. Haweeynaydan waa barakac xirfada macalinimada ay ahayd waxaa kaliya ee ay masruufkooda ka soo saarta 8 carruur ah oo uu aabbaahood ku dayacay. “Shaqo la’aanta aad ayay saamayn igu yeelatay. Macalimad ayaan ahaa oo xirafadeeda wixii ay ku hesho ilmaheeda ku maaraysa. Shaqo kale oo aan aqoono ama meel aan shaqo u raadiyo malahan. Cid aan caawimaad ka dalbanayana ma haysto.” Xamdi waxay sheegtay in tan iyo markii shaqo la’aantu ku dhacaday ay qoyskeedu ku tiirsan yiihiin dayn ay ka qaataan dukaan xaafadooda ku yaalla oo ay horay macaamiil ugu ahaayeen. Waxay xustay in bishaan uu dhimay raashinkii uu siin jiray isaga oo siiyay min 10 kiilo oo bir bariis iyo sinkor ah. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in in ay bisha danbe iska bixiyaan $150 oo dayn ah oo lagu leeyahay isaga oo ugu goodiyay in uu ka goosan doono haddii aysan gudin in uu siiyo dayn kale. Arrintaas ayaa timid markii ay meesha ka baxday lacag $110 oo ahayd oo ay bile mushaar ahaan u qaadan jirtay. Haweeynaydaan ayaa xustay in sidoo kale ay dhibaato ku qabaan helida biyaha. Waxay tilmaamtay in adeegsadaan biyo aan ku filnayn oo ay ka soo dawarsadan dadka dariska la ah, maddaama aysan awoodin $0.2 oo ay jirgaankii iibiyaan ceellal riig ah oo gaar loo leeyahay. Waxay tilmamtay in sidoo kale ay hoy xumo hayso. Wuxuu qoyskeeda ka mid ahaa qoysaskii daganaa xerada Shabeelle ee la barakiciyay. Waxay tilmamtay in ay ku nool yihiin sandaqad uu dhismiiheedu qabyo yahay wax ay ku dhamaystirtana aysan u hayn, maaddaama ay baagamuudo noqotay. Waxay xustay in aysan wax musqul ah lahayn oo ay dariskooda ka codsadaan in ay la isticmaalan. Nolol xumada soo wajahday qoyskeeda oo aysan xal u hayn ayay sheegtay in ay walwal kala kulanto. Burburka ku yimid iskuulka oo wasaaradda waxbarashad Puntland ay gacanta ku haysay ayay tilmaamtay in uu sababay waxbarasho la’aan soo wajahday carruur iyo macalimiin badan oo barakac ah “Dad barakac ah ayaan nahay awood uma lihin inaan iskuul dhisano. Waxaan codsanayna in iskuul naloo dhiso si shaqadeena u soo labato.” Carruurta waxbarashada u dhiganayay oo 4 ah waxay ku jireen fasallada lixaad iyo toddobaad. items.fullContent: (ERGO) – Nolol xumo ayaa soo wajahday qoysaska afar boqol oo bare oo ku nool Garowe iyo tuulooyinka hoos taga, markii iskuullo ay wax ka dhigi jireen ay qaar xirmeen, kuwana ay dhimeen tirada macalimiinta. Jaamac Maxamuud Axmed oo ka mid ah wuxuu Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in dhamaan baahiyaha aas-aasiga ah uu awoodi la’yahay qoyskiisa oo 9 ah, kaligiisna ku tiirsan. Ninkaan oo ka mid ahaa barayaasha iskuulka hoose dhexe ee Waaberi ee magaalada Garowe ayaa xusay in uu ka mid noqday macalimiin shaqadooda waayay, dhaqaala yari iskuulka soo wajahday darteed. Waxaa meesha ka baxday $200 oo ahaa mushaarkiisa bisha. Dhaqaalahaas ayuu ku dabari jiray cunnada, biyaha, kirada iyo waxbarashada carruurtiisa. Wuxuu xusay in baagamuudo-nimada soo wajahday awgeed uu hadda cunno ku filan u awoodi la’yahay reerkiisa. “Hal mar ayaan dabka shidana maalinkii. Wixii Illahey na siiyo ayaan dabka saarana. Ehel, asxaab ama daris aan caawimaad ka dalbano ayaan ku tiirsanahay. Cunno xumada carruurtayd culays aad u wayn ayay igu haysa.” Jamaac ayaa sheegay in uu ahaa macalin ardayda u dhiga luuqadda Ingriiska. Dhanka kale baahiyaha kale ee reerkiisu wajahayaan waxaa ka mid ah biyo yari. Waxay ku tiirsan yihiin jirgaan ama ka yar oo ay ka helaan dadka nolol dhaama dhaqaale ahaan. Wuxuu xusay in uu ka faro maran yahay $0.4 oo ay jirgaankii iibiyaan baraago gaar loo leeyahay. Wuxuu tilmaamay in qoyskiisa dhamaadkii bishii Ogosto laga soo saaray qol dhagax ah oo ay ku noolaayeen, markii uu awoodi waayay kirada, korontada iyo biyaha oo isku darkooda uu ku bixin jiray $80. Arrintan waxay ku qasabtay in ka soo guuran xaafada Koowda August oo ay daganayeen uuna reerka geeyo dhul banana oo duleedka magaalad ah. Waxay qoyskiisa halkaasi ka dhisteen cooshad ay ka samaysteen maryo iyo ullo laisku geeyay. “Kaligay ima saamayn arrintan maclimiin badan oo aan garanaya ayaa shaqo la’aan noqday oo baaga-muudo ah hadda.” Jaamac oo shaqo la’aan ah muddo 2 bil ah ayaa sheegay in marba marka la danbaysa aya ka sii darayso xaaaladda qoyskiisa. Wuxuu sheegay inmarar badan magaalada ka raadiyay shaqooyin xamaal ah si uu reerka dabka ugu shido hasa ahaate uu ku hungoobay. Wuxuu ayaa tilmaamay in xaaladdan ay uga waxbarasho beeleen saddex carruur. Wuxuu xusay in uu awoodi waayay $25 oo wax lagu barayay, taasi oo sababtay in laga soo eryo iskuulka.   Ninkaan oo bare ahaa ku dhawaad 10 sano ayaa tilmaamay in uusan waligiisa wax kayd ah samaysan taasi oo uu hadda uu ka shalaynayo. Iskuullada ay macalimiintooda shaqo la’aanta noqdeen ayaa iskugu jira kuwa gaar loo leeyahay iyo kuwa ay gacanta ku hayeen dowlada Putland iyo hay’ado samafal, kuwaas oo ku yaallay xeryaha lagu barakacay ee Garowe.   Xamdi Cali Axmed oo wax ka dhigaysay muddo 15 sano ah iskuul hoose dhexe oo ku yaallay xerada Shabeelle oo dadkii dagana laga barakiciyay ayaa sheegtay in tan iyo bishii July ay carruurteeda u awoodi la’dahay cunno ku filan. Haweeynaydan waa barakac xirfada macalinimada ay ahayd waxaa kaliya ee ay masruufkooda ka soo saarta 8 carruur ah oo uu aabbaahood ku dayacay. “Shaqo la’aanta aad ayay saamayn igu yeelatay. Macalimad ayaan ahaa oo xirafadeeda wixii ay ku hesho ilmaheeda ku maaraysa. Shaqo kale oo aan aqoono ama meel aan shaqo u raadiyo malahan. Cid aan caawimaad ka dalbanayana ma haysto.” Xamdi waxay sheegtay in tan iyo markii shaqo la’aantu ku dhacaday ay qoyskeedu ku tiirsan yiihiin dayn ay ka qaataan dukaan xaafadooda ku yaalla oo ay horay macaamiil ugu ahaayeen. items.title: Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan oo kulan degdeg ah ka yeelanaya weerarrada Xuutiyiinta
items.description: Sacuudi Carabiya, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa qabanaya kulan heer sare ah oo degdeg ah, si ay uga wada hadlaan sidii Sacuudiga loo taageeri lahaa iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan weerarrada Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee saddexda dal ay ka wada hadleen xaaladda, iyagoo cambaareeyay weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsaday Makka iyo goobo kale oo rayid ah. Waxay sidoo kale xaqiijiyeen xaqa Sacuudiga u leeyahay inuu is-difaaco. Saddexda dal ayaa qorsheynaya kulan ay yeeshaan taliyeyaasha ciidamada, kaas oo lagu qiimeyn doono taageerada Sacuudiga, iyadoo la adeegsanayo heshiiska wadajirka ah ee difaaca ee ay saddexda dal galeen. Heshiisku wuxuu dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado mid ka mid ah dhinacyada loo arko weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay inay Khamiistii weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ah ku qaadeen bartilmaameedyo Sacuudigu leeyahay. Dhanka kale, Sacuudiga ayaa sheegay inuu qabtay lix gantaal oo ballistic ah oo ay soo rideen Xuutiyiintu. Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale digniino degdeg ah ka soo saaray deegaano ay ka mid yihiin Makka, Jeddah iyo Yanbu, oo ah deked muhiim u ah dhoofinta shidaalka. Dhanka kale, Muftiga Guud ee Sacuudiga ayaa ciidamada ugu baaqay inay diyaar u noqdaan inay naftooda u huraan dagaalka ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta, ilaa kooxda laga saaro awoodda. Kulankan ayaa ku soo beegmaya iyadoo Madaxweynaha Iran, Masoud Pezeshkian, uu sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay mas’uul ka yihiin ficilladooda, isagoo isku dayaya inuu kala fogeeyo dowladda Iran iyo weerarrada kooxda. Dhanka kale, Iran iyo Maraykanka ayaa wada dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo in lagu yareeyo dagaalka. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran Cabbaas Caraqji ayaa sheegay in Tehran ay soo jeedisay in Marinka Hormuz dib loo furo, haddii Maraykanku dabciyo cadaadiska milatari iyo cunaqabateynta. Dagaallada iyo xiisadaha gobolka ayaa saameyn ku yeeshay dhoofinta shidaalka iyo maraakiibta ganacsiga, gaar ahaan Marinka Hormuz oo ah waddo muhiim u ah gaadiidka shidaalka caalamka.

items.title: Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan oo kulan degdeg ah ka yeelanaya xiisadda Yemen
items.description: Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa qorsheynaya kulan degdeg ah oo ay yeelanayaan taliyeyaasha ciidamada saddexda dal, iyadoo xaaladda Yemen ay sii xumaaneyso, isla markaana weerarro cusub laga soo sheegay gudaha Sacuudiga. Go’aanka kulanka ayaa yimid kadib kulan Khamiistii magaalada New York ku dhex maray wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee saddexda dal. Kulanka waxaa ka qeyb galay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Sacuudiga Amiir Faisal bin Farhan, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Pakistan Ishaq Dar iyo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga Hakan Fidan. Wada-hadallada ayaa si gaar ah loogu eegay sidii Sacuudiga loo taageeri lahaa iyadoo la adeegsanayo heshiiska cusub ee difaaca wadajirka ah ee saddexda dal. Heshiiska Mecca Joint Defence Agreement ayaa la kala saxiixday 7-dii Agoosto, waxaana uu dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo arko weerar lagu qaaday dhammaan saddexda waddan. Heshiiska ayaa sidoo kale saldhig u noqonaya ballaarinta iskaashiga difaaca iyo isku-duwidda milatari ee Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan, ayadoo 31-kii Agoosto, wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda iyo gaashaandhigga iyo taliyeyaasha ciidamada saddexda dal ay ku kulmeen Istanbul, halkaas oo ay ku heshiiyeen in la dhiso xoghayn ku taalla Sacuudiga iyo in la kordhiyo wada-shaqeynta dhinaca milatariga. Kulanka saddexda dal ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo Sacuudiga uu sheegay in uu wajahayo weerarro cusub oo kasoo socda Yemen, ayadoo Riyadh ay sheegtay in nidaamyadeeda difaaca cirka ay soo rideen lix gantaal oo ballistic ah oo loo waday dhinaca magaalooyinka Taif iyo Yanbu. Mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in digniino amni laga bixiyay dhowr goobood, balse markii dambe la sheegay in khatartii ay dhammaatay. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegay inay fuliyeen weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah oo ay ku bartilmaameedsadeen goob ay ku tilmaameen “xasaasi” oo ku taalla Riyadh iyo xarumo ay leedahay shirkadda Saudi Aramco ee magaalada Yanbu. Afhayeenka isbahaysiga Sacuudiga, General Turki al-Malki, ayaa sheegay in haddii weerarradu sii kordhaan ay jawaab adag ka bixin doonaan. Dhanka Yemen, dagaallo culus ayaa ka socda dhowr jiho, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda iyo Xuutiyiintu ay isku hayaaan goobo istiraatiiji ah, waxaana warbixin ay AFP soo xigatay ay sheegtay in dagaalladii 24-kii saacadood ee ka horreeyay Jimcihii ay ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 150 dagaalyahan , kuwaas oo 98 ay ahaayeen dhinaca ciidamada dowladda, halka 52 ay ka tirsanaayeen Xuutiyiinta. Dagaallada ayaa laga soo sheegay agagaarka buuraha Kahboub iyo dhulka u dhexeeya Lahj iyo Taiz, oo ku dhow marinka muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandeb . Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo warramay inay xoojiyeen joogitaankooda xeebaha Badda Cas, taas oo kordhisay walaaca laga qabo amniga marinka Bab al-Mandeb, oo ah waddo muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka. Dagaallada ayaa saameyn xooggan ku yeeshay dadka rayidka ah, waxaana UNHCR ay sheegtay in in ka badan 230,000 oo qof ay ka barakaceen guryahooda tan iyo bilowgii Sebtembar, halka dadka gudaha Yemen horey ugu barakacay ay gaarayaan ku dhowaad 5.2 milyan .

items.title: Faransiiska oo shaaciyey in uu ciidamo u dirayo Sacuudiga xilli uu xoogeystay dagaalka
items.description: Paris (Caasimada Online) – Faransiiska ayaa ciidamo, raadaarro iyo nidaamyo difaac u diri doona Sacuudi Carabiya si ay gacan uga geystaan ilaalinta magaalada dekedda ah ee Yanbu ee ku taalla Badda Cas, waxaa sidaas Khamiistii ku dhawaaqay madaxweyne Emmanuel Macron. Yanbu ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u yeelatay dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga, xilli weerarro gantaallo ah ay halis geliyeen marinnada kale ee tamarta gobolka. Macron ayaa sheegay in Paris iyo Riyadh ay dhammeystireen heshiis lagu xoojinayo difaaca goobta, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in ciidamada Faransiiska aysan u socon inay si toos ah uga qeyb qaataan dagaallada gobolka. “Waxaan direynaa awood militari, taas oo ah ciidamo, nidaamyo raadaar iyo nidaamyo difaac si loo ilaaliyo goobtan — ma aha inaan ku lug yeelanno wax dagaal ah, balse inaan ilaalinno goobtan,” ayuu Macron u sheegay telefishinnada TF1 iyo France 2. Dekedda Yanbu, oo ku taalla xeebta galbeed ee Sacuudiga, ayaa ah mid ka mid ah xarumaha ugu muhiimsan ee dalkaas uu shidaalka uga dhoofiyo Badda Cas. Muhiimaddeeda ayaa sii korortay iyadoo xiisadaha gobolka ay carqaladeeyeen isu-socodka tamarta, taas oo Sacuudiga ku qasabtay inuu si weyn ugu tiirsanaado waddooyinka dhoofinta ee ka baxsan marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Qiimaha saliidda ayaa sidoo kale sare u kacay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay, iyadoo suuqyada caalamka ay ka walaacsan yihiin weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo kaabayaasha iyo marinnada muhiimka u ah dhoofinta tamarta. Macron ayaa wareysiga ku sheegay in Faransiisku leeyahay kayd ku filan oo gaas iyo shidaal ah xilli jiilaalku soo dhowaanayo, isaga oo sheegay in dowladdiisu ay ka shaqeyneyso sidii loo ilaalin lahaa sahayda tamarta. Madaxweynaha Faransiiska ayaa sidoo kale ka digay suurta-galnimada in Mareykanku xaddido dhoofinta naftada, tallaabadaas oo uu sheegay inay “musiibo” ku noqon karto dhaqaalaha caalamka iyo kan Mareykanka laftiisa. Aqalka Cad ayaa Arbacadii beeniyay warar sheegayay in maamulka Mareykanka uu qorsheynayo mamnuucid 90 maalmood ah oo lagu soo rogo dhoofinta naftada, xilli qiimaha shidaalku sare u kacay. Khatarta Ruushka Macron ayaa isla wareysiga uga hadlay khatarta amni ee uu sheegay inuu Ruushku ku hayo dalalka Yurub, isagoo ku eedeeyay Moscow inay kordhisay weerarrada internetka, falalka burburinta iyo howlaha loo adeegsado diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Waxa uu sheegay in Faransiisku wajahayo khataro la mid ah kuwa dalal kale oo Yurub ah, kadib markii Jarmalku Ruushka ku eedeeyay isku day weerar oo loo adeegsaday drone kaas oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday garoonka Leipzig bishii Agoosto. Macron ayaa toddobaadkii hore madaxda xisbiyada Faransiiska ku casuumay qasriga Elysee, halkaas oo uu uga warbixiyay khataraha sii kordhaya ee uu sheegay inay ka imanayaan Ruushka. Waxa uu sidoo kale dowladda ku amray inay diyaariso qorshe lagu ilaalinayo kaabayaasha muhiimka ah ee dalka weerarrada drones-ka iyo kuwa internetka. Si kastaba, Macron ayaa beeniyay war uu qoray wargeyska El Mundo oo sheegayay in hay’adda sirdoonka Mareykanka ee CIA ay dowladaha Yurub uga digtay weerarro drones ah oo laga yaabo inay ka yimaadaan dhinaca Mediterranean-ka. “CIA-da ma aysan siin hay’adaha Faransiiska digniin noocaas ah,” ayuu yiri Macron. Ruushka ayaa horay u beeniyay eedeymaha dalalka Yurub ee ku saabsan weerarrada isku dhafan, isagoo ku tilmaamay kuwo aan sal lahayn oo ka dhashay waxa Moscow ay ugu yeerto naceybka ka dhanka ah Ruushka. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Liibiya oo xoojinaya iskaashiga socdaalka iyo arrimaha muwaadiniinta
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo dowladda Liibiya ayaa ku heshiiyey in ay xoojiyaan wada-shaqeynta iyo isku-duwidda labada dal, gaar ahaan arrimaha la xiriira socdaalka iyo xaaladda muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee ku sugan gudaha Liibiya. Arrintan ayaa lagu soo qaaday kulan ka dhacay magaalada New York, kaas oo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cali , uu la yeeshay Daahir Saalim Al-Baour , oo ah mas’uulka maareeya arrimaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Liibiya. Kulanka ayaa ka dhacay dhinacyada hawlaha Kalfadhiga 83-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, ayadoo Labada mas’uul ay ka wada hadleen dhowr arrimood oo khuseeya xiriirka labada dal, iyadoo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray xaaladda muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee ku sugan Liibiya iyo iskaashiga dhinaca socdaalka . Soomaaliya iyo Liibiya ayaa sidoo kale isla qaatay in la sii xoojiyo isku-duwidda iyo wada-shaqeynta labada dowladood si wax looga qabto arrimaha labada dhinac ay danaha wadajirka ah ka leeyihiin. Arrimaha socdaalka ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Liibiya, maadaama Liibiya ay tahay mid ka mid ah waddamada muhiimka ah ee Waqooyiga Afrika ee ay maraan muhaajiriin badan oo doonaya in ay u gudbaan dalalka Yurub. Muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed ayaa sidoo kale ka mid ah dadka ku sugan waddankaas, taas oo ka dhigaysa xaaladdooda iyo ilaalinta xuquuqdooda arrin si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah dowladda Soomaaliya. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah kulamo diblomaasiyadeed oo ay Soomaaliya ka waddo magaalada New York inta uu socdo Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa kulamadan uga faa’iideysanaysa xoojinta xiriirrada ay la leedahay dowladaha kale iyo ka wada-hadalka arrimaha khuseeya danaha Soomaaliya iyo muwaadiniinteeda. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in labada dhinac ay muujiyeen diyaar garow ay ku sii xoojinayaan iskaashiga, gaar ahaan dhinacyada socdaalka iyo arrimaha muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee Liibiya , iyadoo la doonayo in labada dowladood ay yeeshaan isku-duwid dhow oo ku saabsan arrimahaas.

items.title: Madaxweynaha Somaliland oo khudbad ka jeediyay golaha caalamiga ah ee 𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐥 𝐨𝐧 𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐢𝐠𝐧 𝐑𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 (𝐂𝐅𝐑), 𝐍𝐞𝐰 𝐘𝐨𝐫𝐤
items.description: 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐤𝐚 𝐣𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐲𝐞𝐲 𝐆𝐨𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐚𝐡 𝐞𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐥 𝐨𝐧 𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐢𝐠𝐧 𝐑𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 (𝐂𝐅𝐑), 𝐍𝐞𝐰 𝐘𝐨𝐫𝐤 Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa magaalada New York khudbad taariikhi ah ka jeediyey Golaha Xidhiidhka Dibedda (Council on Foreign Relations – CFR), oo ka mid ah xarumaha ugu saamaynta badan Maraykanka ee daraasaadka iyo falanqaynta siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu madasha CFR si toos ah ugu bandhigay aragtida Somaliland, isaga oo xusay in Somaliland muddo 35 sano ah ay ahayd Qaran nabad ah, dimuqraadi ah, iskii isu maamula, isla markaana si masuuliyad leh uga qayb qaata xasilloonida gobolka. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu caddeeyey in Somaliland buuxisay dhammaan shuruudaha aasaasiga ah ee dawladnimada, isla markaana aanay aqoonsi u doonayn samafal ama deeq, balse ay doonayso in la aqoonsado xaqiiqada dawladnimo ee ay dhistay iyo madaxbannaanidii ay heshay sannadkii 1960-kii. Waxa uu sidoo kale iftiimiyey in aqoonsiga Somaliland aanu ahayn oo keliya arrin taariikhi ah, balse uu yahay fursad istiraatiiji ah oo xoojin karta ganacsiga, maalgashiga, shaqo-abuurka, iyo amniga Geeska Afrika, gaar ahaan ilaalinta mid ka mid ah marinnada badeed ee ugu muhiimsan dunida. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu si cad u qeexay in Somaliland ay tahay dal dimuqraadi ah oo nabad iyo xasillooni waarta ka hirgeliyey gobol ay qalalaasuhu ku badan yihiin, balse weli laga hor taagan yahay in ay cod yeelato. Halka Soomaaliya oo aan iskeed isku maamulin karin in ka badan 30 sano ay xubinnimadeeda Qaramada Midoobay u adeegsanayso cabbudhinta iyo cadaadiska Shacabka Somaliland. Ugu dambayn, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa Bulshada Caalamka hor dhigay arrin xujo iyo garnaqsiba ku ah Beesha Caalamka, taas oo ah: In ay weli Beesha Caalamku sii wadaan taageerada diblomaasiyad dhalanteed ah oo aan nabad iyo xasillooni waarta midkoodna keeni karin, ama in ay aqoonsato xaqiiqada dhabta ah ee Somaliland oo ah Dawlad nabad ah, dimuqraadi ah oo diyaar u ah in ay horumariso danaha dhaqaale iyo kuwa amni ee caalamku wadaago.

items.title: Madashii caawa Madaxwaynuhu ka qaybgalay ee Council on Foreign Relations waxa ay ahayd mid saddex arimood oo togan leh:
items.description: “Madashii caawa Madaxwaynuhu ka qaybgalay ee Council on Foreign Relations waxa ay ahayd mid saddex arimood oo togan leh: 1. Waxa ka soo qaybgalay dad micno leh oo qaybaha bulshada ka socda oo farriinta ay qaadaan meel gaadhsiin kara. Farriimo micno lehna waa loo dhiibay. 2. Waydiimaha la waydiiyay waxa ay ahaayeen kuwo fursad fiican siiyay madaxwaynaha inuu bixiyo xogta loo baahan yahay. 3. Diyaar garow fiican ayaa ka muuqday Madaxwaynaha iyo degenaansho uu kaga falceliyo waydiimaha. Waxyaabaha waydiimuhu ku saabsanaayeen ee Madaxwaynuhu ka jawaabay waxa ka mid ah ahaa ammaanka marin-biyoodka aynu ku naallo, dhaqaalaha, siyaasadda juquraafiyadeed guud ahaanteed, Taiwan iyo xidhiidhka aynu la leenahay. Waxa sidoo kale ku jiray waydiimo ku aadanaa nolosha hoose ee shacabka Somaliland sida xagga waxbarashada iyo caqabadaha uu aqoonsi la’aantu ku hayo qofka caadiga ah ee Somalilander ka ah. Guntii waxa ay ahayd fursad fiican oo laga faa’iideeyey” Garyaqaan Guuleed Dafac.
