items.title: Officer Alleges Federal and Jubaland Officials Are Coordinating to Ignite Fighting in Balad-Xaawo
items.description: Competing Forces Mobilize in Gedo Border Town as Security Official Makes Explosive Accusation BALAD-XAAWO (WDN) — Balad-Xaawo is witnessing competing military mobilization by forces aligned with Somalia’s Federal Government and Jubaland — and an explosive new allegation now claims that senior officials on both sides are working together to push the town toward open conflict. Independent reports published this week confirmed opposing military movements in and around the strategic Gedo border town, with local residents expressing fears that the standoff could escalate into fighting. The allegation was made by a security officer identified only as Dhafoore, who accused Jubaland’s Minister of Interior Mohamed Ibrahim Oogle and Minister of Security Yusuf Hussein Dhuumaal of coordinating with Federal Government Security Minister Abdullahi Sheikh Ismail Fartaag and a senior military commander identified as General Khalid. According to Dhafoore, the officials are working to create conditions for violence to erupt in Balad-Xaawo. “The conflict in Balad-Xaawo is being fuelled by Jubaland’s Minister of Interior Mohamed Ibrahim Oogle and Minister of Security Yusuf Hussein Dhuumaal, who are working with Khalid and Minister Fartaag. We will not accept their plan,” Dhafoore said. Military Standoff Raises the Stakes The accusation comes as the town faces an increasingly tense security situation. Recent reports describe military movements involving forces directly aligned with the Federal Government and others associated with Jubaland. The competing deployments are reportedly linked to a struggle over control of Balad-Xaawo, while residents fear that the confrontation could turn violent. The situation is further complicated by forces associated with Abdirashid Janan, some of whom have reportedly resisted transferring their allegiance to Jubaland while remaining armed and positioned inside the town. An Allegation That Demands Answers Dhafoore’s claim is politically significant because it alleges cooperation between officials associated with competing political camps at a moment when their respective forces are engaged in a visible security standoff. However, the specific allegation that the named officials are deliberately coordinating to provoke fighting has not been independently established. No documentary evidence or public statement from the officials has been cited to substantiate the accusation. Dhafoore is also described as politically sympathetic to Jubaland President Ahmed Madobe, a factor relevant to assessing his account. The officials named in the allegation have not, in the material reviewed, publicly confirmed such a plan. Balad-Xaawo at a Dangerous Crossroads The developments place Balad-Xaawo once again at the centre of the political and security contest between Mogadishu and Jubaland. The town’s location near the Kenyan border gives any armed confrontation consequences beyond the immediate local dispute, potentially affecting civilian movement, commerce and cross-border activity. For now, the verified picture is of competing military mobilization and heightened tension. The more explosive claim — that senior Federal Government and Jubaland officials are jointly working to ignite the conflict — remains an allegation requiring further evidence. The coming days may show whether the standoff can be contained or whether Balad-Xaawo becomes the scene of another armed confrontation in Gedo. items.title: Somalia’s Flag, Turkey, and the Evidence: A Fact-Based Rebuttal
items.description: By Keynan Jama, International Trade Lawyer and Litigator WardheerNews recently published an opinion piece under the headline “ How Somalia’s Flag Was Sold to Turkey. ” The title makes a serious allegation. The evidence behind it is very thin. The article points to a signed agreement in March, a ship registered three days later, and a drone strike in September, months later and far away. None of those facts, taken alone or together, proves a conspiracy. This analysis separates what the article confirms from what it infers. It then explains what the law actually says under UNCLOS, a relevant international tribunal ruling, and the sanctions rules the article cites but misapplies. Transparency remains a legitimate demand. The agreement should be published. Ship owners should be screened. Public records should be kept. Those are fair points. But calling the arrangement a “sale” of the flag is a leap the facts do not support. What the Article Actually Shows Strip away the framing, and the confirmed facts are narrow. On their own, they prove very little if anything. March 30, 2026: Somalia’s minister for ports signed an agreement with Somali Ship Register Limited. The signatory was a Turkish national. April 2, 2026: The ship GUNEY , previously flagged in Honduras, became the first vessel under Somalia’s revived flag. September 9, 2026: Drones struck the tug TEDY near Odesa. Two Azerbaijani crew died. No Somali was on board. Turkey also holds separate deals with Somalia covering port and airport management, military training, oil rights, and fishing rights. Each fact checks out. None of them, by itself, proves foreign control of the registry. The real question is what the article builds on top of them. Where Reporting Ends and Guessing Begins The headline itself The claim is that Somalia’s flag was sold to Turkey. A government hiring a private company to handle ship paperwork is common. It happens all over the world. Liberia’s registry has been run by a U.S. company since 1948. The Marshall Islands hired a private firm in 1990. Both are among the biggest ship registries on the planet. Nobody calls that a sale. Under UNCLOS Article 94, the flag state keeps full legal responsibility no matter who does the paperwork. The article even admits this: “private administration is not automatically disreputable.” That is an odd thing to write directly under a headline claiming the flag was sold. The three-day gap The agreement was signed March 30. A ship joined the registry April 2. Three days. The article treats this as suspicious. It is not. New registries almost always line up a first ship before launch. That is how a registry proves it actually works. Fast timing is not proof of a secret plan. It is ordinary marketing. No document backs the claim. No message, no record, nothing beyond a calendar. A calendar is not evidence. The burden of proof, flipped The article argues that the burden belongs on the government to prove Somali officials can refuse, suspend, and deregister a ship against Turkish commercial or political pressure. Read that again. The government must prove it can resist pressure. But nobody has shown that pressure even exists. The article asks Somalia to disprove a threat nobody demonstrated. That is backwards. In law, and in plain fairness, the accuser brings the evidence, even in the court of public opinion. Not the other way around. A claim built so it cannot lose The article admits there is no public evidence that Ankara formally directs Somali Ship Register Limited. It then says that does not matter, because control can be “informal.” No evidence supports the claim. And no evidence could ever disprove it either. That is not analysis. That is a circular trap. Using tragedy as proof of something it does not prove Two men died on a tugboat near Odesa. That is a real loss, and it deserves respect. But the article admits elsewhere that no Somali was aboard. A ship’s crew does not need to match its flag. The strike, in the article’s own words, “does not prove that the registry was inappropriate.” Russia’s statement never even named the ship. So why open and close the whole piece with this attack? Because grief moves readers. Timelines do not. That is the function it serves here. Stacking unrelated facts to imply a plot Turkey runs Somalia’s main port and airport. It trains and helps command Somalia’s military. It holds rights to offshore oil and fish stocks. Now it handles the registry too. Listed together, it sounds coordinated. It sounds planned and omnipotent. But separate deals, negotiated separately, do not become one conspiracy just by sitting in the same paragraph. The article also notes that the minister who signed the deal later became Speaker of the House. The implication is obvious: a reward. But the implication is not evidence. Careers move for a hundred reasons. Borrowing the sound of law The article names six criteria from a 1970 British inquiry. It says Somalia’s registry matches several of them. That sounds official. It sounds legal. Two lines later, the article admits these criteria are “descriptive… not a binding legal test.” No treaty enforces them. No court applies them. Sounding like law does not make something law. What the Law Actually Says UNCLOS Article 91 and the M/V Saiga case Article 91 requires a “genuine link” between a ship and its flag state. The article leans hard on this rule. So look closely at the case it cites: M/V Saiga (No. 2) , decided by the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea in 1999. The tribunal’s actual ruling was that a weak genuine link does not cancel a ship’s registration, and other states cannot use it to deny recognition. The article cites this case correctly. Then it argues the opposite of what the case actually says. UNCLOS Article 94 and delegated paperwork Article 94 puts the legal duty on Somalia, not on the company that processes the forms. Hiring a private administrator does not, by itself, break that duty. A real breach needs proof: a botched safety inspection, an ignored complaint, a failed investigation. None of that shows up in the article. Once again, Liberia, the Marshall Islands, and Panama all delegate this way. It is the norm. It is not a red flag. Paris MOU port checks Registries get ranked—white, grey, or black list—only after thirty inspections over three years. Somalia’s new registry has no track record yet. So warnings about blacklisting apply to any brand-new registry, anywhere in the world, after due process. They say nothing specific about Turkey. OFAC sanctions rules Sanctions rules apply when a ship or its owner is already flagged by regulators. Nobody named in the article—not the ship, not the company, not the registrar—is under sanctions. The rule the article cites is real. It just does not fit the case at hand. Fair Points Worth Keeping Strip away the conspiracy, and some of the article’s advice still holds up. These are worth acting on regardless of the Turkey angle, innuendos, fragile time-links and misapplications of the laws: Publish the registry agreement and its terms in full. Keep a real-time, public list of registered ships. Make sure Somali officials, not the private company, hold final say on adding or removing a ship. Screen every ship owner for sanctions and true ownership before registration. Fund the investigation and enforcement work the law already requires. This is basic good governance. Liberia and the Marshall Islands built the same safeguards over time. None of it needs a “ sold ” headline to justify doing it. Conclusion The facts in the article check out. The dates. The ship. The strike. The other Turkish deals. All real. What does not check out is the leap from those facts to a hidden sale of Somali sovereignty. That leap runs on timing, implication, and a burden of proof turned upside down. Even the article’s own legal source—the Saiga ruling—argues against its conclusion, not for it. The better response is not to dismiss the article outright. It is to take its fair points on transparency seriously, and to reject the parts it never actually proved. items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo Golaha Ammaanka ka sheegay in aan la aqbali karin in…
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa khudbad ka jeediyay Fadhiga Guud ee Meertada 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, isagoo kaga hadlay xaaladda Soomaaliya iyo arrimaha caalamka. Madaxweynaha ayaa khudbaddiisa ku xusay caqabadaha ka dhashay colaadaha, loollanka juqraafi-siyaasadeed, isbeddelka cimilada iyo hoos u dhaca iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale soo bandhigay guulaha iyo horumarka Soomaaliya ay ka sameysay dhinacyada dowlad-dhiska, dimuqraadiyeynta iyo amniga, iyo sidoo kale dadaallada lagu dhammaystirayo Dastuurka dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa intaas ku daray horumarka laga sameeyay dib-u-habeynta waxbarashada, kobaca dhaqaalaha iyo hirgelinta doorashooyin loo dhan yahay, isagoo tilmaamay dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay arrimahaasi ku waddo. Dhanka kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa ku baaqay in Qaramada Midoobay dib loogu soo celiyo kalsoonida caalamka, lana xoojiyo nidaamka dhinacyada badan iyo fulinta go’aannada caalamiga ah. Waxa uu sidoo kale carabka ku adkeeyay in aan la aqbali karin in Qaaradda Afrika ay ka maqnaato fadhiyada iyo madallada lagu go’aaminayo masiirka ummadda dunida, isagoo ku baaqay in codka Afrika uu si buuxda uga dhex muuqdo go’aanada caalamiga ah. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale markale xaqiijiyay taageerada Soomaaliya ee xaqa shacabka reer Falastiin u leeyihiin aayo-ka-tashi, dowladnimo iyo nolol ku dhisan nabad iyo amni. Waxa uu ku baaqay in la helo xal waara oo caddaalad ah oo ku saleysan laba dowladood, lana dhiso dowlad Falastiini ah oo madax-bannaan. The post Xasan Sheekh oo Golaha Ammaanka ka sheegay in aan la aqbali karin in… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Isbaheysiga Haybad Qaran iyo Xaqsoor oo xilkii ka qaaday Cumar Cabdirisaaq
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Isbaheysiga Xaqsoor iyo Haybad Qaran, Danjire Cabdiraxmaan Caynte ayaa Cumar Cabdirisaaq Xuseen ka qaaday xilka Xoghayaha Guud ee Isbaheysiga. Cumar Cabdirisaaq ayaa sidoo kale laga qaaday xubinnimadii Golaha Sare ee Siyaasadda ee Isbaheysiga, sida lagu sheegay go’aanka kasoo baxay hoggaanka isbaheysiga. Go’aankan ayaa yimid kaddib markii Guddiga Anshaxa ee Isbaheysiga uu sheegay in Cumar Cabdirisaaq lagu helay inuu ku xadgudbay xeerarka iyo anshaxa u degsan Golaha Sare ee Siyaasadda ee Isbaheysiga. Isbaheysiga ayaan si faahfaahsan u shaacin xeerarka iyo qodobbada anshax ee uu ku xadgudbay Cumar Cabdirisaaq Xuseen, kuwaas oo sababay in tallaabada laga qaado. Go’aanka xil-ka-qaadista ayaa sidoo kale meesha ka saaray doorkii uu Cumar Cabdirisaaq ku lahaa Golaha Sare ee Siyaasadda, kadib markii laga qaaday xubinnimadii uu ku lahaa golahaasi. items.title: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya oo Khudbad ka Jeediyay Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa khudbad ka jeediyay kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, isagoo diiradda saaray xaaladda caalamka, dib-u-habaynta Qaramada Midoobay, arrimaha Soomaaliya iyo doorka caalamka ee nabadda iyo horumarka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dunidu ay wajahday hubanti la’aan sii kordheysa, iyadoo ay jiraan colaado, loollan juqraafi-siyaasadeed iyo hoos u dhac ku yimid iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Waxa uu xusay in horumarka lagu gaarayo Yoolalka Horumarka Waara ee 2030 uu marayo 36%, taas oo uu ku tilmaamay mid aan ku filnayn. Soomaaliya oo dalbatay dib-u-habeyn Golaha Ammaanka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay uu u baahan yahay in laga dhigo mid matalaad badan leh, hufan oo wax-ku-ool ah. Waxa uu si gaar ah u xusay in Afrika aysan weli ku lahayn matalaad joogto ah Golaha Ammaanka, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay taageertay mowqifka guud ee Afrika ee ku aaddan matalaad buuxda oo qaaraddu ka hesho labada qaybood ee Golaha. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Soomaaliya, oo xilligan ka tirsan Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka Midowga Afrika, ay ka shaqaynayso xoojinta iskaashiga Qaramada Midoobay iyo Midowga Afrika, ka hortagga colaadaha iyo taageeridda xalalka nabadeed ee ay Afrika hoggaaminayso. Soomaaliya oo ka hadashay madaxbannaanida iyo Falastiin Khudbadda ayaa sidoo kale lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda dhowrista madaxbannaanida, midnimada iyo xuduudaha caalamiga ah ee dalalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay diiddan tahay tallaabooyin hal dhinac ah oo wax u dhimaya madaxbannaanida iyo midnimada dalalka, isagoo ku baaqay in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo waafaqsanaanta sharciga caalamiga ah. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh wuxuu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay garab taagan tahay shacabka Falastiin, isla markaana ay taageerayso xal laba dowladood ah oo dhidibada u taagaya dowlad Falastiini ah oo madax-bannaan oo ka jirta xuduudihii 1967. Madaxweynaha oo dalbaday in Soomaaliya hoggaamiso mashaariicda UN-ka Madaxweynaha ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Qaramada Midoobay, isagoo sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan doonayn in Qaramada Midoobay dalka ka baxdo, balse ay rabto iskaashi cusub oo isla-xisaabtan leh, kaas oo hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed ay door hoggaamineed ku yeeshaan fulinta mashaariicda. Waxa uu sheegay in gargaar badan oo UN-ku bixiyo uu weli ku socdo hannaan hay’ado barbar socda, mashaariic kala go’an iyo nidaamyo aan si buuxda ugu dhex jirin miisaaniyadda dowladda, taas oo uu sheegay inay caqabad ku tahay qorsheynta iyo dhismaha hay’adaha qaranka. Doorashooyinka iyo dimuqraadiyadda Soomaaliya Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay waddo dib-u-habeyn dastuuri ah oo saldhig u noqonaysa cod-bixin guud, hay’ado isla-xisaabtan leh iyo nidaam siyaasadeed xisbiyo badan leh. Waxa uu xusay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay muddo tobannaan sano ah ku taamayeen inay hoggaankooda ku doortaan codkooda, isagoo sheegay in doorashadii ugu dambeysay ee noocaas ah ay dhacday 1969-kii. Dowladda ayuu sheegay inay doonayso in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed lagu xalliyo wada-hadal, sharci iyo doorashooyin, halkii laga adeegsan lahaa rabshado. La-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo amniga Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Soomaaliya ay sii waddo dagaalka ka dhanka ah argagixisada, iyadoo xoojinaysa hay’adaha amniga, awoodda sirdoonka iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka deriska iyo beesha caalamka. Waxa uu ugu baaqay beesha caalamka taageero joogto ah oo la siiyo marxaladda kala-guurka amniga Soomaaliya, oo ay ku jirto maalgelinta howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, isagoo sheegay in mas’uuliyadda amniga oo si buuxda loogu wareejiyo Soomaaliya ay u baahan tahay dhaqaale, qorshe marxalado leh iyo hay’ado Soomaaliyeed oo awood leh. Dhaqaalaha, cimilada iyo saameynta marin-biyoodka Hormuz Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya uu kobcayo, isagoo khudbadda ku sheegay in kobaca dhabta ah ee GDP-ga Soomaaliya sannadkan uu yahay 3.1%. Waxa uu sidoo kale tilmaamay dadaallada lagu xoojinayo maareynta maaliyadda dadweynaha, kordhinta dakhliga gudaha iyo horumarinta jawiga maalgashiga. Waxa uu ka digay saameynta isbeddelka cimilada, isagoo sheegay in abaarta la xiriirta isbeddelka cimiladu ay saameyneyso in ka badan 6 milyan oo qof oo Soomaaliya ah. Waxa kale oo uu sheegay in khalkhalka ka jira marinka Strait of Hormuz uu saameyn ku yeeshay qiimaha badeecadaha, shidaalka, gaadiidka iyo dakhliga canshuuraha gudaha Soomaaliya. Khudbaddiisa ayuu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku soo gabagabeeyay baaq ku saabsan in Qaramada Midoobay ay ilaaliso kalsoonida caalamka, iyadoo loo baahan yahay matalaad caddaalad ah, kheyraad la heli karo iyo natiijooyin la cabbiri karo, gaar ahaan dalalka soo koraya.

items.title: Wasiirka Warfaafinta oo Saint Petersburg kula kulmay Wasiirka Dhaqanka Ruushka
items.description: Saint Petersburg, Ruushka – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdifataax Qaasim Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada Saint Petersburg kulan laba-geesood ah kula yeeshay Wasiirka Dhaqanka Federaalka Ruushka, Marwo Olga Lyubimova. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka ee dhinaca dhaqanka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay si gaar ah uga wada hadleen ilaalinta iyo horumarinta hidde-dhaqameedka, farshaxanka, suugaanta iyo tiyaatarrada. Sidoo kale, waxaa laga wada hadlay cilmi-baarista dhaqanka, is-dhaafsiga khubarada iyo fanaaniinta, iyo horumarinta xarumaha dhaqanka ee labada dal. Labada Wasiir ayaa isla soo qaaday dardargelinta is-afgaradka iskaashiga dhaqanka ee Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka, iyo sidii loo hirgelin lahaa barnaamijyo iyo mashaariic wax-ku-ool ah oo ka qayb qaata horumarinta iyo kobcinta dhaqanka. Wasiir Cabdifataax Qaasim ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ay Soomaaliya siinayso dhaqanka iyo farshaxanka, isagoo tilmaamay in dhaqanku door muhiim ah ka qaato ilaalinta aqoonsiga qaranka, isku-xirka bulshada iyo xoojinta xiriirka shacabka labada dal. Dhankeeda, Wasiirka Dhaqanka Ruushka Olga Lyubimova ayaa muujisay muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta xiriirka hay’adaha dhaqanka ee Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka, iyadoo ballanqaadday in la sii xoojin doono wada-shaqeynta iyo taageerada labada dhinac. Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ahaa kulamada Wasiirka Warfaafinta uu la qaadanayo madaxda iyo masuuliyiinta ka qaybgalaya Madasha 12-aad ee Caalamiga ah ee Dhaqamada Midoobay, oo sanadkan lagu qabtay magaalada Saint Petersburg ee dalka Ruushka.

items.title: Wasiir Ayuub iyo qalalaasaha Awdal maxaa ka dhexeeya?
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Xogo dheeraad ah oo laga helayo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada siyaasadeed ee ka socda gobolka Awdal ayaa muujinaya eedeymo la xiriira dhaqaale lagu maalgelinayo dhalinyaro deegaanka ah, kuwaas oo lagu sheegay inay qeyb ka yihiin olole lagu abuurayo xiisado colaadeed oo cusub. Wasiirka Howlaha Guud ee Soomaaliya ahna Xildhibaan ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaalka, Ismaaciil Yuusuf ayaa si toos ah loogu xiriirinaya maalgelinta dhaq-dhaqaaqan. Sida xoguhu tilmaamayaan, lacagta ayaa loo adeegsanayaa abaabul, faafinta dacaayado siyaasadeed iyo olole lagu doonayo in lagu kordhiyo xiisadda colaadeed ee ka jirta deegaanka. Dadka loo adeegsanaayo ololahan ayaa iyagu u badan dhalinyaro reer Awdal ah oo qaarkood dano siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale ka leh xaaladda gobolka. Dhaq-dhaqaaqooda ayaa lagu sheegay inuu ka gudbay dood siyaasadeed oo caadi ah, waxaana eedeymaha ugu waaweyn ay yihiin in lacago loo adeegsanayo sidii qalalaase looga abuuri lahaa deegaan muddo lagu yaqaanay xasillooni. Mashruucan ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay in ujeeddadiisu tahay in bulshada deegaanka lagu tuso in wasiirka uu yahay shaqsi si gaar ah u garab taagan arrimaha Awdal, iyadoo dhalinyaro taageerta Ayuub ay si joogto ah baraha bulshada ugu baahiyaan qoraallo iyo muuqaallo lagu amaanayo, iyadoo si weyn loo buunbuuninayo doorkiisa iyo xiriirka uu la leeyahay deegaanka uu kasoo jeedo. Qoraallada iyo farriimaha lagu faafiyo baraha bulshada ayaa inta badan u muuqda kuwo Ayuub loogu soo bandhigayo inuu yahay shaqsi si dhab ah u metelaya danaha dadka deegaanka, taas oo looga dan leeyahay xoojinta muuqaalkiisa siyaasadeed iyo taageerada uu ku leeyahay bulshada. Arrintan ayaa qeyb ka ah olole lagu dhisayo sumcad shaqsiyeed, kaas oo aan ku koobnayn taageero dabiici ah oo ka dhalata bulshada, balse ay jiraan dhalinyaro si gaar ah dhaqaale ugu qaadanaya faafinta iyo buunbuuninta magaca wasiirka, si loogu abuuro sawir ah inuu yahay wakiil dhab ah oo danaha Awdal metela. Tan ayaa la sheegay in wasiir Ayuub uu ku doonayo in uu noqdo mas’uulka keliya ee hoggaanka sare ee dowladda ugala macaamilo malafka Awdal. Sidoo kale, ujeeddada ugu dambeysa ee dhaq-dhaqaaqan ayaa ahayn oo keliya in lagu muujiyo mowqif ku saabsan Soomaali-weyn, balse in xiisad haddii ay ka dhalato Awdal loo isticmaalo in taageero iyo dhaqaale badan looga raadsado Dowladda Federaalka. Tan ayaa arrinta ka dhigaysa mid leh dhinac siyaasadeed iyo mid dhaqaale oo isku xiran. Si kastaba, arrintan ayaa dhalinaysa su’aalo ku saabsan sababta wasiir ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka ugu bareeri karo inuu dhaqaale ku bixiyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo lagu khalkhal-gelinayo xasilloonida gobol nabdoon iyo abuurista colaad ka istaadhanta Awdal loo adeegsado in laga raadiyo macaash siyaasadeed iyo mid dhaqaale oo shaqsi ah. Dabayaaqadii sanadkii hore ayey aheyd markii rabshado xooggan ay ka dhaceen magaalada Borama ee xarunta gobolka Awdal, kuwaas oo sababay dhimashada 20 qof iyo in ka badan dhaawaca 214 qof. Rabshadahaasi oo billowday kadib markii xukuumadda Somaliland ay oggolaatay in magaalada Saylac lagu qabto munaasibadda Xeer Ciise, ayaa sidoo kale waxaa kaalin ka qaatay hurinta xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee gobolka. Dhaq-dhaqaaqooda ayaa lagu sheegay inuu ka gudbay dood siyaasadeed oo caadi ah, waxaana eedeymaha ugu waaweyn ay yihiin in lacago loo adeegsanayo sidii qalalaase looga abuuri lahaa deegaan muddo lagu yaqaanay xasillooni. Mashruucan ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay in ujeeddadiisu tahay in bulshada deegaanka lagu tuso in wasiirka uu yahay shaqsi si gaar ah u garab taagan arrimaha Awdal, iyadoo dhalinyaro taageerta Ayuub ay si joogto ah baraha bulshada ugu baahiyaan qoraallo iyo muuqaallo lagu amaanayo, iyadoo si weyn loo buunbuuninayo doorkiisa iyo xiriirka uu la leeyahay deegaanka uu kasoo jeedo. Qoraallada iyo farriimaha lagu faafiyo baraha bulshada ayaa inta badan u muuqda kuwo Ayuub loogu soo bandhigayo inuu yahay shaqsi si dhab ah u metelaya danaha dadka deegaanka, taas oo looga dan leeyahay xoojinta muuqaalkiisa siyaasadeed iyo taageerada uu ku leeyahay bulshada. Arrintan ayaa qeyb ka ah olole lagu dhisayo sumcad shaqsiyeed, kaas oo aan ku koobnayn taageero dabiici ah oo ka dhalata bulshada, balse ay jiraan dhalinyaro si gaar ah dhaqaale ugu qaadanaya faafinta iyo buunbuuninta magaca wasiirka, si loogu abuuro sawir ah inuu yahay wakiil dhab ah oo danaha Awdal metela. Tan ayaa la sheegay in wasiir Ayuub uu ku doonayo in uu noqdo mas’uulka keliya ee hoggaanka sare ee dowladda ugala macaamilo malafka Awdal. Sidoo kale, ujeeddada ugu dambeysa ee dhaq-dhaqaaqan ayaa ahayn oo keliya in lagu muujiyo mowqif ku saabsan Soomaali-weyn, balse in xiisad haddii ay ka dhalato Awdal loo isticmaalo in taageero iyo dhaqaale badan looga raadsado Dowladda Federaalka. Tan ayaa arrinta ka dhigaysa mid leh dhinac siyaasadeed iyo mid dhaqaale oo isku xiran. Si kastaba, arrintan ayaa dhalinaysa su’aalo ku saabsan sababta wasiir ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka ugu bareeri karo inuu dhaqaale ku bixiyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo lagu khalkhal-gelinayo xasilloonida gobol nabdoon iyo abuurista colaad ka istaadhanta Awdal loo adeegsado in laga raadiyo macaash siyaasadeed iyo mid dhaqaale oo shaqsi ah. Dabayaaqadii sanadkii hore ayey aheyd markii rabshado xooggan ay ka dhaceen magaalada Borama ee xarunta gobolka Awdal, kuwaas oo sababay dhimashada 20 qof iyo in ka badan dhaawaca 214 qof. Rabshadahaasi oo billowday kadib markii xukuumadda Somaliland ay oggolaatay in magaalada Saylac lagu qabto munaasibadda Xeer Ciise, ayaa sidoo kale waxaa kaalin ka qaatay hurinta xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee gobolka. items.title: Mystery Meeting in New York Raises Questions Inside Somalia’s Government
items.description: Unconfirmed Report of Secret Encounter Between Foreign Minister and Somaliland President Fuels Political Suspicion New York (WDN) — A potentially sensitive diplomatic encounter in New York is raising questions inside Somalia’s political establishment after reports emerged that Foreign Minister Abdisalam Abdi Ali and Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi “Irro” were seen together in what was described as a private meeting not formally disclosed by the Somali government. The reported encounter comes at a particularly sensitive moment. President Irro has spent much of September in the United States pursuing Somaliland’s campaign for international recognition and strengthening its diplomatic and strategic relationships, while Somalia’s federal government has been working to counter that campaign. According to the reports circulating in diplomatic circles, the two officials were seen sitting together in New York, but the purpose, duration and circumstances of the alleged meeting remain unclear. There has been no official confirmation from Somalia’s Foreign Ministry, Villa Somalia or the Somaliland presidency establishing that the reported private meeting took place or explaining what was discussed. Why the Encounter is Raising Eyebrows The timing is what makes the report particularly sensitive. President Irro is in New York during the United Nations General Assembly high-level week, where Somaliland has been intensifying its international diplomatic campaign. His delegation has been using the U.S. visit to promote Somaliland’s case for recognition and to present the territory as a potential security and economic partner in the Horn of Africa. The diplomatic activity has included meetings with U.S. lawmakers and foreign-policy institutions. Irro also met Israel’s ambassador to the United Nations, Danny Danon, in New York on September 23. Against that backdrop, any undisclosed contact between Somalia’s foreign minister and the Somaliland president would inevitably attract scrutiny. Was the Meeting Merely Diplomatic — or Something More? At this stage, there is no verified evidence showing that the alleged encounter represented a secret political agreement, a change in Mogadishu’s Somaliland policy or an unauthorized diplomatic initiative. Nor is there evidence establishing that Israel arranged such a meeting. Those possibilities have nevertheless begun circulating because of the wider diplomatic activity surrounding Somaliland in New York. Israel formally recognized Somaliland in December 2025, according to multiple reports, while President Irro has continued to seek additional international recognition, particularly from the United States. That makes the timing and optics of any private encounter involving a senior Somali official particularly sensitive. But an Israeli connection should not be inferred merely because Irro separately met Israel’s UN ambassador. A Potential Test for Hassan Sheikh and His Foreign Minister The report could also raise questions about the relationship between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Foreign Minister Abdisalam. There is currently no verified evidence that Hassan Sheikh opposed any contact between his foreign minister and Irro, nor that the President regarded such contact as a breach of government policy. Indeed, diplomatic engagement between officials from Mogadishu and Hargeisa is not inherently unusual. The significance would depend on who authorized the encounter, what was discussed and whether any proposal or commitments were made. That is precisely why the reported secrecy is attracting attention. The Bigger Diplomatic Picture Somalia has been confronting an increasingly active Somaliland diplomatic campaign in Washington and New York. President Irro has openly presented Somaliland as a potential strategic partner on Red Sea and Gulf of Aden security, trade and investment, while seeking broader international recognition. A reported meeting with Somalia’s foreign minister, if confirmed, would therefore take place against one of the most consequential diplomatic campaigns Somaliland has mounted in years. For now, however, the central question remains unanswered: Did Abdisalam and Irro actually hold a private meeting, who knew about it, and what — if anything — was discussed? Until the Somali government or Somaliland presidency provides an account, the reported encounter remains an unverified claim rather than an established diplomatic event. But its timing alone is enough to ensure that any confirmation would attract considerable attention in Mogadishu, Hargeisa and beyond. items.title: Wafdi sare oo ka socda Talyaaniga oo Muqdisho yimid + Ujeedka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Taliska Hawlgallada Wadajirka ah ee Talyaaniga, S/Guud Giovanni Maria Iannucci ayaa booqasho rasmi ah ku yimid magaalada Muqdisho. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa qaabilay Taliyaha Taliska Hawlgallada Wadajirka ah ee Talyaaniga iyo Danjiraha Talyaaniga, iyadoo kulanka looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal. Kulanka oo uu taliyeyaasha ku weheliyay Danjiraha Talyaaniga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Pier Mario Daccò Coppi ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Talyaaniga. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale si gaar ah uga wada hadlay isbeddellada amni ee kasoo cusboonaaday gobolka, gaar ahaan xaaladda Badda Cas iyo saameynta ay ku yeelan karto amniga Soomaaliya iyo gobolka. Wada-hadallada ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo qaaday saameynta xaaladda Badda Cas ay ku yeelan karto isu-socodka ganacsiga caalamiga ah, iyadoo la eegay muhiimadda ay leedahay xasilloonida iyo amniga marin-biyoodka gobolka. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Taliyaha Taliska Hawlgallada Wadajirka ah ee Talyaaniga ayaa sidoo kale ka wada-hadlay sidii loo xoojin lahaa wada-shaqeynta ku aaddan ka-hortagga khataraha wadajirka ah. Labada dhinac ayaa ugu dambeyn isla eegay sidii loo sii joogteyn lahaa taageerada istiraatiijiga ah ee Talyaanigu siiyo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, iyo xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Talyaaniga oo isla eegay khataraha amni ee gobolka
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa Muqdisho ku qaabilay Taliyaha Taliska Hawlgallada Wadajirka ah ee Taliyaaniga, S/Guud Giovanni Maria Iannucci, oo uu weheliyo Danjiraha Talyaaniga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Pier Mario Daccò Coppi. items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo xiriir diblomaasiyadeed cusub la yeelatay Jamhuuriyadda…
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Dominikaanka ayaa ku heshiiyay aasaasidda xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo rasmi ah, taas oo qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu ballaarinayo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo dalalka Latin America iyo Kariibiyaanka. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali ayaa magaalada New York kula kulmay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Jamhuuriyadda Dominikaanka, Víctor O. Bisonó Haza. Kulanka labada wasiir ayaa dhacay intii uu socday shirka meertada 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Dominikaanka. Labada wasiir ayaa sidoo kale kala saxiixday heshiisyo cusub oo lagu aasaasayo xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo rasmi ah oo dhex mara labada dal. Heshiisyada ayaa sidoo kale lagu tilmaamay mid lagu xoojinayaa isku-duwidda labada dal, kuwaas oo labaduba xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo la rajeynayo in tallaabadan ay horseeddo iskaashi dheeraad ah. Aasaasidda xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku ballaarinayso xiriirrada iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka Latin America iyo Kariibiyaanka. Tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale Soomaaliya u horseedaysa inay yeelato xiriir rasmi ah oo ay la sameysato Jamhuuriyadda Dominikaanka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka shaqeyn doonaan horumarinta xiriirkooda diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashi labada dhinac ah. items.title: Marka Aargoosiga Qabiilku uu Aamusiiyo Bini’aadantinimada: Milicsiga Sheeko Xanuun Badan
items.description: Soomaaliya waxay u baahantahay inay dib u dhisto wax dhaafsiisan waddooyin la maro, hay’ado ama xafiisyo dawladeed. Waxay, dhab ahaan, u baahantahay inay dib u dhisto ‘ kalsooni’: kalsooni ah in qof kasta oo Soomaali uu meel kasta u safri karo isaga oo aan la eegaynin qabiilka uu ka soo jeedo ; kalsooni ah in askarigu uu yahay astaan qaran, uuna ka tirsanyahay qaranka uu u adeegayo; iyo midda ugu muhiimsan oo kalsoonida inaan qof bani’aadan ah loo dili karin keliya jifada ama qabiilka uu ka dhashay awgeed. Dil dhowaan la soo sheegay oo uu ku saabsan yahay milicsigan, wuxuu si xanuun badan u muujinayaa inta uu aargoosiga qabiilku bani’aadanka uga fogayn karo danqashada damiirka. Askari ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed (SNA) ayaa ka safrayay saldhiggiisa milatari, isagoo ku sii jeeday qoyskiisa. Intii uu safarka ku jiray, wuxuu maray degaan ay deggan yihiin dad lala xiriirinayo colaad ka dhex jirta qabiilkiisa. Waa la joojiyay, waxaana loo aqoonsaday inuu ka soo jeedo qabiil kuwa isaga qabtay ay iska soo horjeedaan, waxaana loo bartilmaameedsaday sababtaas awgeed. Waxa ugu murugada badan ee ay sheekadani xanbaarsan thay ayaa ah in dhibbanaha aan si fudud loogu aqoonsan inuu ka tirsan yahay qabiilka loo arkayay in uu cadowga tolka. Wuxuu ahaa qof leh abtirsiin isku dhafan. Hooyadiis waxay ka soo jeedday isla qabiilka kuwa qabtay ay ka soo jeedaan. Xiriirka dhinaca hooyada ahi, marka la eego xiriirrada bulshada Soomaaliyeed, wuxuu masiibada ka dhigayaa mid sii adkaanaysa in la fahmo: raggii qabtay waxa uu ugu yeerayay marxuumka ay dili doonaan “abti” oo ah erey xanbaarsan dhalasho dhow oo ay wadaagaan kuwaan laftooda oo hooyadiis ayay dhaleen. Hasayeeshee, xitaa xiriirkaas abtinimo iyo baryadii uu baryay ma aysan badbaadin naftiisa. Sida ku cad warbixinta, askarigu wuxuu afduubayaashiisii ku baryaayay ereyo ay tahay inay damiirka qof kasta oo bani’aadan ah gilgishaan: " “Abtiyaal, waan gaajaysanahay. Tan iyo subaxdii waxba ma cunin.” “Abtiyaal, ma aanan samayn wax aan ku mutaysto dil.” “Abtiyaal, caafimaadkaygu ma fiicno. Waan xanuunsanahay.” Waxay ahayd fiidkii, wuuna gaajaysnaa. Oo waliba xanuunsanaa. Wuxuu sheegay inuusan wax dembi ah gelin. Wuxuu baryayay rag uu ugu yeerayay abtiyaal. Hasayeeshee, sida la sheegay, baryadiisii waa la iska indha tiray, waana la dilay. Haddii dhacdadan si dhab ah loo xaqiijiyo, dilku ma aha oo keliya masiibo ku dhacday hal qoys. Taasi waa sababta sheekadani aysan u noqon karin dhacdo kale oo murugo leh oo dhowr maalmood la xasuusto dabadeedna lagu aaso dhibaatada xigta. Haddii Soomaaliya ay dhab ka tahay dibudhiska nidaamka dawladnimo, dhacdooyinka noocan ahi waa inay noqdaan xisaabtan akhlaaqeed oo qaran. Dalku wuxuu u baahanyahay hay’ado ka hortagi kara dilalka aan sharciga ahayn, bulsho diidda ciqaabta wadareed, hoggaamiyayaal si aan leexleexasho lahayn u canbaareeya, ugana dhiidhiya aargoosiga, iyo muwaadiniin fahansan in qabiilna uusan ka weynayn nolosha bani’aadanka. Imtixaanka ugu danbeeya ee dhismaha dawladnimadu ma aha in dawladdu ku hadli karto magaca qaranka. Waa in qof kasta oo Soomaali ah oo caadi ahi rumaysan karo in qaranku ilaalin doono naftiisa, sharaftiisa iyo hantidiisaba. Soomaaliya oo askariga qaranka lagu dili karo oo keliya inuu ka tirsan yahay qabiil gaar ah weli ma aha Soomaaliya ballanqaadayso dhismaha dawladnimada bulshadu u baahan tahay. Hawsha ina hor taalla sidaas darteed ma aha oo keliya inaan dhisno dawlad ka xoog badan qabaailka, balse waa inaan dhisno fahan ka xoog badan oo ku saabsan cidda aynu nahay: marka hore Soomaali, muwaadiniin si siman sharcigu u ilaaliyo, iyo bani’aadan noloshooda aan lagu qiimayn karin qabiil. Dhabtiina, qabiil kastana intaas ayaa deeqda. Waddada dibuheshiisiinta qaranku waxay bilaabataa marka aargoosigu dhammaado. Waxayna ku dhammaataa marka nolosha Soomaali kale ay ka qiimo badnaato tabashada aynu ka qabno qabiilkiisa. WQ: Maxamed Aadan Cabdiraxmaan Khabiir Arrimaha Maamulwanaagga

items.title: Sawirro: Isbitaalka Dalmar oo baaritaano bilaash u sameeyey maxaabiista Xabsiga Dhexe
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Isbitaalka Takhasusiga iyo Tacliimiga ah ee Dalmar, oo kaashanaya hay’adda Al-Nur Foundation ee Soomaaliya iyo Al-Basar International, ayaa booqasho caafimaad ku tagay Xabsiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya, halkaas oo maxaabiista ku jirta loogu fidiyey adeegyo caafimaad oo lacag la’aan ah. Dhakhaatiir iyo kalkaaliyeyaal ka socday Isbitaalka Dalmar ayaa qaar ka mid ah maxaabiista xabsiga ku jirta u sameeyey baaritaanno bilaash ah oo la xiriira aragga indhaha, dhegaha, sanka iyo cunaha. Maxaabiista ka faa’iideystay baaritaannada caafimaad ee loo sameeyey ayaa sheegay inay aad ugu baahnaayeen, iyagoo u mahadceliyey maamulka, dhakhaatiirta iyo hawlwadeennada Isbitaalka Dalmar ee xabsiga ku soo booqday. Guddoomiyaha Guud ee Isbitaalka Dalmar, Prof. Abdirisak Ahmed Dalmar, ayaa sheegay in tallaabadan ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada lagu gaarsiinayo adeegyada caafimaad dadka u baahan, iyadoo la sameynayo baaritaanno caafimaad, wacyigelin iyo daaweyn, si loo aqoonsado baahiyaha caafimaad ee jira loona fududeeyo helitaanka daryeelka ku habboon. “Waxaan aaminsannahay in daryeelka caafimaadku yahay adeeg ay mudan yihiin dhammaan dadka, oo ay ku jiraan maxaabiista xabsiyada ku jirta, waxaana naga go’an inaan ka qaybqaadanno dadaallada lagu gaarsiinayo adeeg caafimaad oo tayo leh bulshada Soomaaliyeed meel kasta oo ay joogaan,” ayuu yiri Prof. Dr Abdirisak Dalmar. Kooxda ka socotay Isbitaalka Dalmar, oo ka koobnayd dhakhaatiir, kalkaaliyeyaal iyo hawlwadeenno, ayaa kulan la qaadatay saraakiisha Ciidanka Asluubta ee gacanta ku haya Xabsiga Dhexe. Waxay ka wada hadleen sidii la isaga kaashan lahaa in daryeel caafimaad loo fidiyo maxaabiista ku jirta xabsiga, iyadoo kulankaas uu ku dhammaaday jawi isfaham. Taliyaha Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, S/Gaas Maxamed Sheekh Xasan Xaamud, oo ka hadlay kulankaas, ayaa uga mahadceliyey, soona dhoweeyey dadaalka maamulka, dhakhaatiirta iyo shaqaalaha Isbitaalka Dalmar, booqashada ay ku yimaadeen xabsiga iyo daryeelka caafimaad ee ay u fidiyeen qaar ka mid ah maxaabiista oo ka cabanayey xanuunno kala duwan. Wuxuu xusay inay diyaar u yihiin fududeynta sidii adeegyo caafimaad loo gaarsiin lahaa dadka ku jira xabsiyada. Isbitaalka Dalmar, oo ah isbitaal ka yimid una yimid bulshada, ayaa had iyo jeer ka qaybqaata sidii adeegyo caafimaad oo bilaash ah loo gaarsiin lahaa qaybaha bulshada, gaar ahaan ardayda iskuullada, maxaabiista iyo dadka kale ee danyarta ah. items.title: Somali Parliament Deals Blow to Hamza’s Civil Service Reform Plan
items.description: 136 MPs Reject Proposal as Dispute Over Senior Government Appointments Deepens Mogadishu (WDN) — In a striking parliamentary setback for Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre, Somalia’s House of the People has rejected a proposal linked to his plan to introduce open competition for senior positions across federal government institutions. The vote marks an unexpected confrontation between the executive and parliament at a politically sensitive moment, with 136 lawmakers voting against the proposal, according to reports of Tuesday’s parliamentary session. The measure concerned the recruitment and appointment of department directors across federal ministries and government agencies. Hamza’s government has presented the initiative as part of a broader civil-service reform aimed at making appointments more dependent on qualifications, experience, competence and merit. The Prime Minister had ordered the first phase of the reform to begin on September 20, with the Civil Service Commission overseeing the process. The government said the reform was intended to give qualified civil servants an equal opportunity to compete for senior administrative positions. Many are questioning why the current administration has chosen to propose these reforms only now, when its constitutional term has already expired? The obvious questions are: Why now, and why not during the past four years, when the government had ample time not only to initiate such reforms but, more importantly, to implement them? The timing inevitably raises questions about the government’s motives, priorities, and commitment to meaningful reform. An Unexpected Parliamentary Reversal What made Tuesday’s development particularly striking was the scale of parliamentary opposition. Rather than securing approval for the government’s proposal, the administration faced a clear majority of MPs rejecting the measure. The vote effectively halted the parliamentary initiative in its proposed form and exposed a significant disagreement over how senior positions in the federal civil service should be filled. The development comes after the Prime Minister publicly instructed ministries and government agencies to implement the new competitive recruitment system. Government officials have argued that the reform would strengthen professionalism and accountability within the civil service. Critics in parliament, however, have questioned the legal basis and implementation of the proposed system, according to reports surrounding the vote. Auditor General Also Raises Objections The parliamentary challenge was preceded by objections from Somalia’s Office of the Auditor General. Reports published Wednesday said the Auditor General opposed applying the open-competition system to the office, arguing that doing so could conflict with its constitutional independence. That objection added another layer to an increasingly visible institutional dispute over the Prime Minister’s civil-service initiative. The government’s position is that the recruitment reform rests on existing laws, regulations and institutional frameworks governing the federal civil service. The sequence of events has now raised a larger political question: is the disagreement over civil-service recruitment becoming a broader confrontation between Somalia’s executive institutions and parliament? The parliamentary rejection does not, by itself, establish a wider political rupture between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Prime Minister Hamza. Nor does the vote demonstrate that the President personally supported or opposed the parliamentary position. However, the episode has exposed an important institutional fault line. The Prime Minister has argued that senior government positions should increasingly be filled through transparent competition and professional criteria. Parliament’s rejection of the proposal, meanwhile, demonstrates that there is significant resistance to the way the reform is being pursued. Political Calculations Enter the Debate The dispute has inevitably attracted political interpretation because senior government appointments are highly consequential in Somalia’s political system. Opposition lawmakers who have long challenged policies associated with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Prime Minister Hamza may have found common ground with some government-aligned MPs in rejecting the measure. Whether that cooperation reflects a temporary parliamentary coalition or signals a deeper realignment remains unclear. Equally significant is the question of the President’s position. There is currently no sufficient evidence to conclude from the parliamentary vote alone whether Hassan Sheikh supports Hamza’s proposal, opposes it, or has sought to remain outside the dispute. For now, what is clear is that a major government reform announced only days ago has encountered a formidable parliamentary obstacle. And the surprise is not simply that MPs rejected the proposal — it is that 136 lawmakers were prepared to do so, turning a civil-service reform initiative into a highly visible test of the balance between Somalia’s executive and legislative institutions. items.title: Eritrean Opposition Builds Global Network as Israeli Connection Raises Questions Over Its Real Influence
items.description: Brigade N’Hamedu Organizes Abroad as Opposition Figures Seek to Challenge Isaias Afwerki TEL AVIV (WDN) — An Eritrean opposition movement is building an increasingly organized political network across several countries, including Israel, the United States, Canada and Europe, in an effort to unite Eritreans in the diaspora and prepare for a possible political transition in Eritrea. According to a report by Haaretz , Brigade N’Hamedu has established a 51-member international council following elections held among Eritrean communities in different countries. The movement says its objective is to bring together Eritreans abroad and develop a political structure capable of replacing the government of President Isaias Afwerki. The scale of the organization is notable. Its supporters are reportedly active in Israel, the United States, Canada, Sweden, Germany and Ethiopia, while its leaders say they maintain contacts with people inside Eritrea. Those claims of an internal network, however, have not been independently verified. An Opposition Movement Takes Shape The reported creation of the 51-member council represents an effort to move beyond scattered diaspora activism and establish a more coordinated political organization. The movement says it wants to build a democratic political system to replace the existing government and has been conducting diplomatic outreach, particularly in the United States. Ethiopia has also emerged as an important base for some of the movement’s activities, according to reports. That development is politically significant given the complicated relationship between Addis Ababa and Asmara. The movement has also developed a visible presence in Israel. Eritrean opposition supporters there recently participated in the selection of representatives to the international council. The Israeli connection may attract attention, but it should not automatically be interpreted as evidence of decisive external backing. Israel and Eritrea established diplomatic relations in 1993, and Israel’s Foreign Ministry continues to list Eritrea among the countries with which it has diplomatic relations. Israel has been a UN member since 1949. At the same time, Israel’s role in the Horn of Africa operates within a highly contested regional and international environment. Any assumption that an opposition movement’s presence in Israel necessarily translates into meaningful Israeli state support would therefore require evidence of an official government policy, financial assistance, military cooperation or diplomatic commitment. No such Israeli government commitment is established by the information currently available. This distinction matters. A movement can have members, offices, meetings or political activities inside Israel without those activities representing the policy of the Israeli government. A Network with Serious Controversies Brigade N’Hamedu is also a controversial organization. The movement has faced allegations concerning violent confrontations involving Eritrean diaspora communities in several countries. In Germany, members have faced scrutiny in connection with, clashes and alleged unlawful activities, although the precise responsibility of the organization for individual incidents has been disputed and should not be assumed from the allegations alone. The group’s supporters portray their campaign as a struggle for political change and democratic reform in Eritrea. Critics have accused elements associated with the movement of using confrontational tactics against supporters of the Eritrean government. These competing portrayals make the movement’s emergence particularly sensitive for Eritrean communities abroad. The Bigger Question Is Inside Eritrea Ultimately, the most important test for Brigade N’Hamedu may not be how many supporters it can mobilize overseas, but whether it can establish meaningful political influence among Eritreans inside the country. The movement says it has contacts inside Eritrea and is preparing for eventual political change. Those claims remain difficult to independently verify. For now, what is emerging is an increasingly structured opposition network operating across multiple countries and seeking to transform diaspora activism into a coordinated political force. The Israeli connection may provide the movement with a visible international platform, but a presence in Israel should not be confused with demonstrated Israeli state backing. The real question is whether Brigade N’Hamedu can turn its growing international organization into a credible political force capable of influencing Eritrea’s future. For a movement seeking to challenge one of Africa’s longest-serving governments, that will ultimately matter far more than where its overseas meetings are held. items.description: TAIPEI | Taiwan’s Minister of Foreign Affairs, Lin Chia-lung, received Somaliland’s Minister of Interior, Abdalle Mohamed Arab, and a delegation led by him during a meeting focused on strengthening bilateral relations and expanding cooperation between the two sides. The Somaliland delegation included the Director General of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Mohamed Abdirahman Hassan, and the Commander of the Somaliland Fire Brigade, Brigadier General Ahmed Mohamed Hassan “Sawaaxili.” The meeting focused on consolidating the longstanding and deepening relationship between Somaliland and Taiwan, as well as strengthening bilateral cooperation, which has continued to expand in recent years and increasingly developed into practical cooperation benefiting both sides. The two sides also discussed mechanisms for strengthening institutional links between their respective government agencies in order to create a stronger framework for cooperation and coordination. The discussions further covered ways to deepen diplomatic engagement and advance areas of mutual interest between Somaliland and Taiwan. The meeting reflects the continued development of relations between Somaliland and Taiwan, with both sides seeking to expand institutional cooperation and strengthen their diplomatic engagement.

items.title: Booliiska Soomaaliyeed oo Dib-u-eegis Ku Sameeyey Qorshayaasha Howlgallada Amniga
items.description: Muqdisho, 24 Sebteembar 2026 – Taliyaha Ciidanka Boliiska Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa shir guddoomiyey kulanka hoggaannada, qaybaha iyo fadhiyada madaxa-bannaan ee Ciidanka Boliiska Soomaaliyeed. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray howlgallada amniga, iyadoo saraakiisha amniga ee loo xilsaaray ay kulanka ka jeediyeen warbixinno ku saabsan xaaladda amniga iyo howlaha socda. Sidoo kale, kulanka ayaa dib loogu eegay sida loo fuliyey qodobadii iyo go’aamadii kasoo baxay kulankii toddobaadkii hore, iyadoo la qiimeeyey horumarka laga sameeyey howlaha loo xilsaaray hoggaannada iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee Ciidanka Boliiska Soomaaliyeed. Taliyaha ayaa kulanka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay isku-duwidda howlaha amniga iyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee Booliiska.

items.title: Farmaajo oo warqad furan u diray Xasan, xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahayso…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamed Cabdullahi Maxamed (Farmaajo) oo warqad furan u diray Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa kaga hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo caqabadaha ka taagan gudaha dalka, xilli lagu jiro marxalad adag oo xasaasi ah. Farmaajo ayaa qoraalkiisa ku muujiyay baahida loo qabo in madaxda Soomaaliyeed ay wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad siyaasadeed u maraan xalinta khilaafaadka taagan , wuxuuna Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ugu baaqay in la raadiyo waddo siyaasadeed oo dalka looga gudbiyo xaaladda cakiran. Sidoo kale, wuxuu soo jeediyay talooyin saddex qodob ah oo ku aaddan raadinta xal looga gudbi karo arrimaha taagan ee masiiriga ah, isagoo Madaxweynaha ka dalbaday inuu hormuud ka noqdo wada-xaajood qaran oo ku dhisan tanaasul, si loo gaaro heshiis loo dhanyahay. Madaxweynihii hore ayaa sidoo kale soo hadal qaaday warqadaha ay Puntland iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka u direen Golaha Ammaanka, isagoo sheegay inay muujinayaan heerka uu gaarsiisan yahay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka taagan gudaha dalka Soomaaliya. Hoos ka akhriso warqadda furan ee Farmaajo . Ku: Madaxweynaha Muddo Xileedkiisu Dhammaaday ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud September 24, 2026 Muqdisho, Soomaaliya Mudane madaxweyne, waxaan halkan kuugu soo gudbinayaa salaan qiimo weyn, aniga oo kuu rajaynayaa inaad caafimaad qabto. Warqaddan furan waxaan kuugu soo dirayaa kaalintayda muwaadinnimo, Madaxweynihii 9aad ee xilka kugu wareejiyey iyo hoggaamiyaha Xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolal (N&N). Warqaddan furan waxaa igu kalifay in aan kuu soo diro xilligan uu dalkeennu marayo marxalad xaasaasi ah, marka laga eego dhinacyada amniga, siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha, duruufaha bulsho iyo guud ahaan saamaynta baaxadda leh ee ay nagu yeelatay loolanka juquraafi siyaasadeedka caalamiga ah oo halis weyn ku noqday midnimada iyo wadajirka dalka, sidaas darteed ayay lagama maarmaan iigu noqotay inaan si furan kuula wadaago in dalku samatabixin u baahan yahay, taas oo mas’uuliyaddeeda koowaad adiga kugu dhacayso. Sida aan la socdo, xilligan waxaad ku sugan tahay xarunta Qaramada Midoobey oo aad uga qayb galaysid kulanka Jimciyadda Guud ee Qaramada Midoobey iyo dabcan kulan doceedyo gaar ah oo muhiim u ah Soomaaliya. Maxfalka noocaas ah indhaha Beesha Caalamku waa furan yihiin, si wayna waxa ay ula socdaan waxa dalkeena ka jira iyo caqabadaha siyaasaddeed, amni iyo dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya wajahayso, waxaana aaminsanahay in sharafkaaga iyo midka ummadda Soomaaliyeedba ay ku jiri lahayd inaad kulan caynkaas ah ka qayb gasho, iyada oo uu kaa horreeyo war wanaagsan oo kor u qaadi karay sumcadda Qarankeenna. Waxaa nasiib darradaas tusaale iyo xaqiiq aan la inkiri karin u ah warqadaha ay kala qoreen Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland iyo Madasha Mustaqbalka, ayna u direen Xoghaya Guud ee Qaramada Midoobey iyo Golaha Ammaanka oo ah warqado dhiillo culus xambaarsan, muujinayana heerka aad gaarsiisay khilaafaadka iyo kala irdhowga soo dhexgalay ummadda Soomaaliyeed, muddadii afarta sano ahayd ee xilka laguu doortay. Sida aad la socoto dalkeenna wixii ka dambeeyey shirarkii dib-u-heshiisiinta qaran ee dib loogu soo celiyey hay’addaha qaranka, waxaa isku haynta dalka iyo dadka Soomaaliyeed aas-aas u ahaa afar tiir oo lagu ilaalinayey wadajirka dalka, si aan markale siyaasaddu u horseedin dowlad la’aan iyo kala tag dambe, waxa ayna afartaas tiir kala yihiin. 1.⁠ ⁠Hirgalinta iyo Ilaalinta dastuur si buuxda heshiis loogu yahay. 2. Hirgalinta iyo dhammeystirka hannaanka federaalka ee lagu heshiiyey. 3.⁠ ⁠Doorashooyin xilligooda ku dhaca iyo siyaasad loo dhan yahay. 4.⁠ ⁠Wadahadallada, tanaasulka iyo heshiis siyaasadeed oo ahaa jidka wax xallinta. Iyada oo aan maanka ku hayno in muddadii sharciga ahayd ee xafiiska laguu doortay dhammaatay, haddana waxaa shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo dib u dhiska qaranka dib u dhac weyn ku ah in maanta uusan jirin dastuur heshiis lagu yahay, dalkuna leeyahay labo dastuur, hannaankii federaalka oo wiiqmay, horena aad uga gaabisay wadahadalladii Somaliland, hadana ay qaar ka mid ah dowlad goboleedyadii dalku qarka u saaranyihiin in ay dalka ka go’ayaan iyo in aan wali lahayn hannaan doorasho oo heshiis lagu yahay, taas oo dalka galisay jahwareer siyaasadeed oo horseedi kara burbur. Sida ay khibradda iyo dhacdooyinkii siyaasaddeed ee dalkan soo maray muddooyinkii qaran burburka lagu jirey ay na barayaan in wadada kaliya ee Soomaaliya mashaakilkeeda siyaasaddeed lagu xallin jirey ay ahayd wada-hadal iyo siyaasad loo dhan yahay, jidkaas oo ahaa hab looga badbaaday dib u dhac badan oo dalkeennu la kulmi lahaa, sidaas darteed inaad meesha ka saarto hannaanka wada xaajood ee ku dhisnaa isku tanaasul iyo siyaasad loo dhan yahay, waxa ay muujinaysaa in xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalku sii adkaanayso, ayna ka dhalan karaan natiijooyin aan dalka u wanaagsanayn, adigana aan taariikhdaada madaxweynenimo boos wanaagsan dhigayn. Anniga oo maanka ku haya in wali dalka ay ka jirto khatarta Alshabaab, mustaqabalka Ciidamada Midowga Africa oo aan cadeyn, khilaafaadka baaxada leh ee siyaasadda gudaha ka jira, isbadalladda waaweyn ee siyaasadda aduunka ka taagan iyo duruufaha dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee dadkeenna haysta, waxa ay illa tahay inay kula gudboon tahay inaad qaaddo tillaabooyin siyaasadeed oo dhiirrasho iyo tanaasul ku dhisan, si dalkeenna looga badbaadiyo kala tag iyo dhaawac soo gaara midnimadiisa iyo wadajirkiisa, adiguna aad u gudato waajibka dastuuriga ah ee kaa saaran ilaalinta midnimada iyo isku haynta dalka. Sidaas darteed, waxa aan kuusoo jeedinayaa talooyin kooban oo aan u arko inay muhiim u yihiin raadinta xal looga gudbi karo arrimaha taagan ee masiiriga ah. 1. ⁠Si looga baaqsado fargalin shisheeye iyo go’aanno aan Soomaalida ka imaan waa inaad hormuud u noqotaa wada xaajood qaran oo ku dhisan tanaasul dhab ah oo keeni kara xal looga gudbo ismari-waaga jira. 2. ⁠Heshiis siyaasadeed oo laga gaaro arrimaha doorashooyinka waxa ay saldhig u yihiin sii socoshada dowlad sharciyad ku dhisan iyo qabsoomidda doorasho la isla oggol yahay oo dalka ka saarta hubinti la’aanta. Sidaas darteed, waa lagama maarmaan heshiis laga gaaro doorashooyinka, si looga badbaado khilaafaad keeni kara natiijooyin aan fiicneyn. 3.⁠ ⁠Waxaa lagama maarmaan ah in muddo kooban gudaheed ay qabsoonto doorasho loo dhan yahay, dalkana laga samata bixiyo marxaladdan jaahwareerka ah ee ay xukunka iska joogaan hay’ado sharciyaddii ka dhammaatay, taas oo halis ku ah jiritaanka qaranka iyo dowladnimadda ba. Eebbe dalka ha inoo dhowro, dowladnimadeenna ha xoojiyo, dadkeennana boggooda burcad ha ha isu mariyo. Dhamaad. items.title: Farmaajo oo Xasan Sheekh U Baaqay Wada-hadal
items.description: Farmaajo oo Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay wada-hadal iyo heshiis doorasho Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya Maxamed Cabdullaahi Maxamed (Farmaajo) ayaa warqad furan u diray Madaxweynaha Federaalka Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isagoo ku baaqay wada-hadal siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay iyo heshiis laga gaaro hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka. Warqadda oo ku taariikhaysan 24-ka Sebtembar 2026, Farmaajo wuxuu kaga hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed, amni, dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee Soomaaliya, isagoo sheegay in khilaafaadka u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo qaar ka mid ah dowlad-goboleedyada ay u baahan yihiin xal siyaasadeed. Farmaajo, oo sidoo kale ah hoggaamiyaha Xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolol (N&N), wuxuu warqadda ku sheegay inuu Xasan Sheekh ugu diray xilli madaxweynuhu ku sugan yahay xarunta Qaramada Midoobay ee New York, halkaas oo uu uga qaybgalayo shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo kulamo kale. Farmaajo oo dhaliilay xaaladda siyaasadeed Warqadda, Farmaajo wuxuu ku dhaliilay dowladda federaalka sida ay u maareysay arrimaha dastuurka, federaalka iyo doorashooyinka.Wuxuu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay wajahdo khilaaf siyaasadeed oo salka ku haya dastuurka, xiriirka dowladda dhexe iyo dowlad-goboleedyada iyo hannaanka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka. Farmaajo wuxuu sidoo kale soo hadal qaaday warqado ay Puntland iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka u direen Qaramada Midoobay iyo Golaha Ammaanka, isagoo sheegay in qoraalladaasi ay muujinayaan heerka uu gaarsiisan yahay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Warqadda Puntland ee 13-kii Sebtembar ayaa dhab ahaantii Qaramada Midoobay looga gudbiyay walaacyo la xiriira siyaasadda, amniga, nidaamka federaalka iyo doorashooyinka Soomaaliya. Puntland waxay sidoo kale dalbatay in Golaha Ammaanka uu taageero wada-hadal siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay.Dhanka kale, Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa sidoo kale Qaramada Midoobay u gudbiyay walaacyo ku saabsan xaaladda dastuurka, doorashooyinka iyo khilaafaadka u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada. Talooyinka uu Farmaajo soo jeediyay Farmaajo wuxuu Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay inuu hormuud ka noqdo wada-hadal qaran oo ku dhisan tanaasul iyo heshiis siyaasadeed. Wuxuu sidoo kale ku baaqay in dhinacyada Soomaalida ay heshiis ka gaaraan hannaanka doorashooyinka, isagoo ku dooday in heshiis noocaas ahi muhiim u yahay in dalka laga saaro hubanti la’aanta siyaasadeed. Qodobka saddexaad ee talooyinkiisa wuxuu ahaa in muddo kooban lagu qabto doorasho loo dhan yahay, si dalka looga gudbiyo waxa uu ku tilmaamay jahawareer siyaasadeed.Farmaajo wuxuu sidoo kale warqadda ku xusay khatarta Al-Shabaab, mustaqbalka howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya iyo saameynta isbeddellada siyaasadeed ee caalamka, isagoo sheegay in arrimahaasi ay u baahan yihiin tallaabooyin siyaasadeed oo ku dhisan wada-hadal iyo tanaasul. Khilaafka dastuurka iyo doorashooyinka Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay si gaar ah ugu xooganaa wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka iyo qaabka loo qabanayo doorashooyinka. Warbixin ay soo saartay Security Council Report ayaa hore u diiwaangelisay in mucaaradka, oo ay ku jiraan Farmaajo iyo madaxweynihii hore Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed, ay ka horyimaadeen wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka, iyagoo walaac ka muujiyay in aan heshiis siyaasadeed oo ballaaran laga gaarin.Sidoo kale, warbixin Qaramada Midoobay ah ayaa sheegtay in wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka ay taageereen xubno ka tirsan labada aqal ee Baarlamaanka, balse ay mucaaradku ka hor yimaadeen, taas oo muujinaysa in arrinta dastuurka ay weli tahay mid siyaasadda Soomaaliya si weyn ugu kala qaybinaysa dhinacyada. Warqadda Farmaajo waxay sidaas darteed kusoo beegmaysaa xilli khilaafka siyaasadeed uu weli ka taagan yahay dowladda federaalka, Puntland, Jubaland iyo kooxaha mucaaradka ah.Farmaajo ayaa ugu dambeyn Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay inuu qaado tallaabooyin siyaasadeed oo lagu ilaalinayo midnimada iyo wadajirka Soomaaliya, isagoo ku adkeystay in wada-hadal iyo tanaasul loo baahan yahay si looga gudbo khilaafaadka taagan.
