items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Muqdisho Ka Daah-furtay Shirka Madasha Arrimaha Bani’aaddannimada ee CHF 2026
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh) , ayaa magaalada Muqdisho si rasmi ah uga daah-furay Shirka Madasha Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada Soomaaliya (CHF 2026) . Shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Soomaaliya, isku-duwidda dadaallada gurmadka iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa diyaar-garowga ka hortagga khataraha dabiiciga ah ee laga cabsi qabo inay saameeyaan bulshada. Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha ayaa sheegay in shirka uu ku soo beegmay xilli loo baahan yahay diyaar-garow hore iyo qorshe mideysan , iyadoo la saadaalinayo roobab xooggan iyo fatahaado la xiriira xaaladda cimilada ee El Niño . Mudane Cali Xoosh ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in hay’adaha dowladda, dowlad-goboleedyada, hay’adaha samafalka iyo bah-wadaagta caalamiga ah ay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan yareynta saameynta musiibooyinka iyo ka jawaabista baahiyaha bulshada. items.title: Trump oo hanjabaad kulul u jeediyay Iran
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump ayaa Talaadadii khudbaddiisii Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobey ku muujiyay laba waddo oo u furan maamulkiisa, si loo soo afjaro dagaalka toddobada bilood ay kula jiraan dalkaasi Iran. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa tilmaamay inuu wajahayo go’aan adag, oo ah inuu heshiis la galo Iran ama uu baabi’iyo dalkaasi. Madaxweynaha ayaa Hoggaamiyeyaasha Caalamka hortooda ka sheegay inuu cadaabta u diri doono Iran, iyagoo aan wax fursad ah siinin ama rajo ay ku badbaadi karto. Trump ayaa ku adkeystay inuusan marnaba u ogolaan doonin Iran inay hesho hubka nuclear-ka. Trump ayaa dhanka kale xusay inuu aaminsan yahay in Iran ay heshiis la geli karto Mareykanka, marka ay dhammaato doorashada xilliga dhexe Mareykanka ee bisha November. Inkasta oo hanjabaadda Trump ay ahayd mid kulul, haddana isla shalay wufuud labada dal ah ayaa ku kulmay Magaalada New York. Ergeyga Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe, Steve Witkoff iyo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Abbas Araghchi ayaa yeeshay kulan saddex saacadood qaatay oo uu dhexdhexaadinayay dalka yar ee Qatar. Donald Trump, Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa kulankaasi ku tilmaamay mid aad u wanaagsan.

items.title: Boqor Salmaan oo sheegay in la soo weeraray Maka
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) — Boqorka Sacuudi Carabiya Salman bin Abdulaziz ayaa si kulul u cambaareeyay waxa Riyadh ay sheegtay inuu ahaa isku day ay Xuutiyiinta Yemen ku beegsanayeen magaalada barakeysan ee Maka, isagoo kooxda ku tilmaamay “maleeshiyo argagixiso”. Boqor Salman ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay shir ay Golaha Wasiirrada Sacuudiga yeesheen Talaadadii, sida ay baahisay wakaaladda rasmiga ah ee wararka Sacuudiga ee SPA. Waxa uu sheegay in isku dayga lagu beegsanayo Maka uu yahay “dambi fool xun” oo dhaawacaya dareenka Muslimiinta caalamka. “Isku dayga maleeshiyada argagixisada ah ee Xuutiyiinta ay ku beegsanayaan Maka” ayaa kiciyay cambaareyn caalami ah, ayuu yiri Boqorka, sida ay sheegtay SPA. Hadalka Boqor Salman ayaa ah mid si gaar ah indhaha loogu hayo, maadaama uu sanadihii dambe si dhif ah uga hadlo arrimaha maalinlaha ah ee siyaasadda iyo amniga, kuwaas oo inta badan uu hoggaamiyo Dhaxal-suge Maxamed bin Salman. Boqorka ayaa sidoo kale ammaanay ciidamada qalabka sida iyo laamaha ammaanka Sacuudiga, isaga oo ku bogaadiyay difaaca dalka iyo waxa uu ku tilmaamay ka hortagga weerarrada ka dhanka ah goobaha barakeysan, dadka xajka iyo cumrada u yimaada, muwaadiniinta iyo dadka kale ee ku nool boqortooyada. Hadalkiisa ayaa yimid maalmo kadib markii Sacuudigu sheegay in difaaciisa cirka uu qabtay diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo Xuutiyiintu soo rideen, taas oo Riyadh sheegtay inay ku sii jeedday dhinaca Maka ka hor inta aysan gaarin hawada mamnuuca ah ee magaalada. Xuutiyiinta ayaa si adag u beeniyay inay Maka bartilmaameedsadeen. Afhayeenka militariga Xuutiyiinta Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay in kooxda aysan weerar ku qaadin magaalada barakeysan, isagoo ku eedeeyay Sacuudiga inuu arrinta u adeegsanayo dacaayad. Hoggaamiyaha Xuutiyiinta Abdel-Malik al-Houthi ayaa isaguna eedeynta Sacuudiga ku tilmaamay “been aad u fool xun”. Dhacdada ayaa sababtay digniin amni oo laga dhaqan geliyo Maka, taas oo Al Jazeera ay sheegtay inay ahayd markii ugu horreysay muddo ku dhow 10 sano oo magaaladaas laga qaado tallaabo amni oo noocaas ah. Maka waxaa ku yaalla Kacbada, oo ah goobta ugu barakeysan Islaamka. Xiisadda Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta Eedeynta la xiriirta Maka ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli dagaalka Yemen iyo iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga ay markale xoogeysanayaan. Toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay, Xuutiyiintu waxay gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weerareen bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla Sacuudi Carabiya, halka ciidamada taageersan dowladda Yemen iyo kuwa Sacuudiga ay weerarro ka fuliyeen gudaha Yemen. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in weerarrada cusub ay dagaalka Yemen dib ugu soo celiyeen heer colaadeed oo sare kadib sanado ay xaaladdu ka degganeyd sidii hore. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sidoo kale Sabtidii sheegtay inay qabatay gantaal ballistic ah oo Xuutiyiintu kusoo rideen caasimadda Riyadh. Kooxdu waxay dhankeeda sheegtay inay bartilmaameedsatay goobo xasaasi ah oo gudaha boqortooyada ku yaalla. Xuutiyiinta, oo ay taageerto Iran, ayaa tan iyo 2014 gacanta ku haya caasimadda Yemen ee Sanca iyo qeybo badan oo waqooyiga iyo galbeedka dalka ah. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa 2015 hoggaamisay isbahaysi militari oo dagaalka Yemen ku galay taageerada dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay. Xiisadda hadda taagan ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeelatay ammaanka marin-biyoodka Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab, halka Sacuudiga iyo dalal kale ay ka walaacsan yihiin weerarrada lagu hayo maraakiibta iyo kaabeyaasha tamarta. Hadalka Boqor Salman ayaa sidaas darteed muujinaya sida Riyadh ay muhiimad gaar ah u siineyso eedeynta la xiriirta Maka, iyadoo Sacuudigu arrinta u arko mid ka gudbeysa khilaafka militari ee Yemen oo taabaneysa amniga goobaha ugu barakeysan Muslimiinta. Xuutiyiinta, dhankooda, waxay ku adkeysanayaan in aysan Maka beegsan, taasoo ka dhigeysa cidda iyo halka uu ku wajahnaa diyaaradda aan duuliyaha lahayn arrin ay labada dhinac si weyn isugu khilaafsan yihiin. items.title: Sidee ayay Xuutiyiinta ugu suuro gashay in ay bahdilaan dawladda Sucuudiga?
items.description: Horraantii bishii September, ololihii militari iyo dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed iyo kuwa dhaqaale ee Sucuudigu tobannaanka sano soo waday ayaa si lama filaan ah u fashilmay. Weerar kedis ah oo ay Xuutiyiintu soo qaadeen ayaa ku qasbay maleeshiyaadkii daacadda u ahaa dowladda rasmiga ah ee Yemen inay ka cararaan goobihii ay gacanta ku hayeen. Kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee loo yaqaanno Ansaar Allah ayaa qabsatay xeebta galbeed ee Yemen ee Badda Cas ku taal, waxayna hadda u sii siqayaan dhanka marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ee Baab Al-Mandab, kaasoo ah laf-dhabarta dhoofinta shidaalka Sucuudiga. Bishii February ee sannadkii hore, markii Mareykanku weeraray Iran oo Tehran ay xirtay marin-biyoodka Hormuz, Sucuudigu wuxuu beddel ahaan u isticmaalayay marin-biyoodka Baab Al-Mandab. Xuutiyiintu markii ay Sucuudiga ku tilmaameen “cadawgayaga” ayna xayiraad saareen isku-socodka badda, ciidamadoodu waxay maalmo gudahood ku qabsadeen dhulal cusub. Waxay xoojiyeen duqeymaha ay ku hayaan magaalooyinka Sucuudiga iyo xarumaha tamarta, iyagoo adeegsanaya gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn. Dr. Aziz Alghashian oo ka tirsan Golaha Caalamiga ah ee Khaliijka ayaa tilmaamay in xaaladdan ay ka dhigan tahay in riyadii laga cabsanayay ay run noqotay. “Xudunta dhaqaalaha Sucuudiga, oo ah waddada dhoofinta shidaalka, ayaa si xun loo hakiyay,” ayuu BBC-da u sheegay. Wuxuuna intaa ku daray, “Waxaa adag in laga fikiro xaalad ka sii xun tan.” Ka dib markii la xiray marin-biyoodka Hormuz, Sucuudigu wuxuu ku tiirsanaa dhuumaha shidaalka ee Bari-Galbeed si uu shidaalkiisa uga dhoofiyo dekedda Yanbu ee Badda Cas. Xogta Ururka wadamada shidaalka dhoofiya ee OPEC waxay sheegaysaa in ku dhawaad 80% shidaalka ceeriin ee Sucuudiga loo iib geeyo suuqyada Aasiya. Tani waxay Baab Al-Mandab ka dhigaysaa marin aad muhiim u ah. Hase yeeshee labadii toddobaad ee la soo dhaafay Xuutiyiintu waxay la wareegeen magaalooyinka Mocha iyo Dhubab oo u dhow marin-biyoodka; waxayna gacanta ku dhigeen jasiiradda Perim oo ah qeyb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah marin-biyoodka. Xuutiyiinta oo xaruntoodu tahay Sanca ayaa gacanta ku haya inta badan waqooyiga Yemen oo uu ku jiro xuduudda Sucuudiga. Sannadkii 2015-kii dowladda Sucuudi Carabiya waxay bilowday isbahaysi caalami ah si loo soo celiyo dowladdii caalamku aqoonsanaa ee Yemen. Isbahaysigan uu Sucuudigu hoggaaminayay ayaa qaaday kumanaan duqeyn cirka ah oo ay ku dhinteen kumanaan qof, sida ay sheegtay Qaramada Midoobay. Arrintaasi waxay keentay in isbahaysiga si weyn loo dhaleeceeyo. Sanadkii 2021-kii, Madaxweynihii Mareykanka Joe Biden wuxuu joojiyay taageeradii uu Mareykanku siin jiray dagaalka Yemen, taageeradaas oo ay ku jirtay iibinta hubka. Dagaalku wuxuu galaaftay nolosha in ka badan 150,000 oo qof, wuxuuna dhaliyay musiibo bani’aadamnimo oo sababtay in 4.8 milyan oo qof ay guryahooda ka barakacaan, halka in ka badan kala bar shacabka oo dhan oo ah 19.5 milyan oo qof ay u baahan yihiin gargaar noocyo kala duwan leh. Inkastoo ay jirtay xasillooni iska qaraabo ah tan iyo markii la gaaray heshiiskii 2022-kii, haddana weerarka cusub ee ay Xuutiyiintu hadda wadaan wuxuu muujinayaa sida ay u xoogeysteen awooddooda militari iyo abaabulkoodaba. Dr. Elizabeth Kendall oo ka tirsan Jaamacadda Cambridge ayaa BBC-da u sheegtay, “Waxa aan maanta aragno ma aha oo kaliya dhaqdhaqaaq khibrad leh oo nidaamsan, balse waa mid sidoo kale adeegsanaya tignoolajiyad casri ah oo ku shaqeysa sirdoonka macmalka ah, si ay farriimo u gudbiyaan iyo si ay u aqoonsadaan bartilmaameedyada.” Sucuudiga iyo Mareykanka ayaa Iran ku eedeeyay inay Xuutiyiinta siisay hub ay ku jiraan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, gantaallada Cruise-ka iyo kuwa ridada dheer, taas oo ah jebinta cunaqabateynta hubka ee ay Qaramada Midoobay saartay. Iran dhinaceeda waxay beenisay inay hub siiso Xuutiyiinta, waxayna sheegtay in taageerada ay siiso ay tahay mid siyaasadeed oo kaliya. Si kastaba, sida uu sheegay Machadka Talyaaniga ee Daraasaadka Siyaasadda Caalamiga ah, Iran waxay ka caawisay fallaagada Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen inay dhistaan warshado u suurtagelinaya inay iyagu soo saaraan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Xarunta Mareykanka ee La-dagaallanka Argagixisada ee ku taal Akadeemiyadda Milatariga ee West Point ayaa sheegtay in Xuutiyiintu ay taageero iyo talooyin ciidan ka heleen Xisbullah ee Lubnaan. Xuutiyiintu laftigoodu waxay diidaan in loo arko inay fulinayaan ajandaha Iran. Faria Al-Muslimi oo ka tirsan Machadka Chatham House ee Arrimaha Caalamiga ayaa sheegay in markii ay Xuutiyiintu gaareen marin-biyoodka Baab Al-Mandab, ay taasi xoojisay mowqifka ay Tehran ku leedahay gobolka. “Waxay Iran hadda ka haysataa awood ka badan sidii hore wadahadalladii ay Mareykanka la lahayd,” ayay tiri. Hase yeeshee Kendall ayaa BBC News u sheegtay, “Xitaa haddii aysan jirin taageerada Iran, waxaan filayaa in Xuutiyiintu ay sii wadi doonaan waxa ay hadda sameynayaan. Waxay leeyihiin dhiirigelin iyo ujeeddooyin u gaar ah. Xilligan, dhiirigelintoodu waxay u muuqataa inay ku saabsan tahay lacag, awood, saameyn iyo ugu dambeyn aqoonsi siyaasadeed.” “Xuutiyiintu ma gaari karaan heerkan ay hadda joogaan haddii aysan jirin hubka, tababarka iyo xogta ay ka helaan Iran, hase yeeshee ma cadda in Iran ay si toos ah u amarto oo u maamusho Xuutiyiinta.” Hase yeeshee Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Mareykanka J.D. Vance ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Washington ay si toos ah ula hadashay Xuutiyiinta wixii ku saabsan dhacdooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ee ka dhacay Yemen. Mareykanka ayaa sheegay inuu ka walaacsan yahay kooxdaas oo la wareegtay jasiiradda Perim, isla markaana uu si dhow ula socdo arrintaas. Faallada uu Vance bixiyay ayaa timid kadib markii Trump uu sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay sheegeen inaysan dooneyn in Washington ay farageliso arrimaha Yemen, isla markaana aysan dooneyn wax iska-hor-imaad militari ah oo lala galo Mareykanka. Toddobaad ka hor, Taliyaha Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka Adam Brad Cooper ayaa u safray Sucuudi Carabiya, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay Amiir Maxamed Bin Salmaan. CNN oo soo xiganaysa ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegtay in Salmaan uu laba jeer la hadlay Trump oo uu ka codsaday inay u oggolaadaan weerar militari oo ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta, balse codsigiisa lama aqbalin. items.fullContent: Horraantii bishii September, ololihii militari iyo dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed iyo kuwa dhaqaale ee Sucuudigu tobannaanka sano soo waday ayaa si lama filaan ah u fashilmay. Weerar kedis ah oo ay Xuutiyiintu soo qaadeen ayaa ku qasbay maleeshiyaadkii daacadda u ahaa dowladda rasmiga ah ee Yemen inay ka cararaan goobihii ay gacanta ku hayeen. Kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee loo yaqaanno Ansaar Allah ayaa qabsatay xeebta galbeed ee Yemen ee Badda Cas ku taal, waxayna hadda u sii siqayaan dhanka marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ee Baab Al-Mandab, kaasoo ah laf-dhabarta dhoofinta shidaalka Sucuudiga. Bishii February ee sannadkii hore, markii Mareykanku weeraray Iran oo Tehran ay xirtay marin-biyoodka Hormuz, Sucuudigu wuxuu beddel ahaan u isticmaalayay marin-biyoodka Baab Al-Mandab. Xuutiyiintu markii ay Sucuudiga ku tilmaameen “cadawgayaga” ayna xayiraad saareen isku-socodka badda, ciidamadoodu waxay maalmo gudahood ku qabsadeen dhulal cusub. Waxay xoojiyeen duqeymaha ay ku hayaan magaalooyinka Sucuudiga iyo xarumaha tamarta, iyagoo adeegsanaya gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn. Dr. Aziz Alghashian oo ka tirsan Golaha Caalamiga ah ee Khaliijka ayaa tilmaamay in xaaladdan ay ka dhigan tahay in riyadii laga cabsanayay ay run noqotay. “Xudunta dhaqaalaha Sucuudiga, oo ah waddada dhoofinta shidaalka, ayaa si xun loo hakiyay,” ayuu BBC-da u sheegay. Wuxuuna intaa ku daray, “Waxaa adag in laga fikiro xaalad ka sii xun tan.” Ka dib markii la xiray marin-biyoodka Hormuz, Sucuudigu wuxuu ku tiirsanaa dhuumaha shidaalka ee Bari-Galbeed si uu shidaalkiisa uga dhoofiyo dekedda Yanbu ee Badda Cas. Xogta Ururka wadamada shidaalka dhoofiya ee OPEC waxay sheegaysaa in ku dhawaad 80% shidaalka ceeriin ee Sucuudiga loo iib geeyo suuqyada Aasiya. Tani waxay Baab Al-Mandab ka dhigaysaa marin aad muhiim u ah. Hase yeeshee labadii toddobaad ee la soo dhaafay Xuutiyiintu waxay la wareegeen magaalooyinka Mocha iyo Dhubab oo u dhow marin-biyoodka; waxayna gacanta ku dhigeen jasiiradda Perim oo ah qeyb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah marin-biyoodka. Xuutiyiinta oo xaruntoodu tahay Sanca ayaa gacanta ku haya inta badan waqooyiga Yemen oo uu ku jiro xuduudda Sucuudiga. Sannadkii 2015-kii dowladda Sucuudi Carabiya waxay bilowday isbahaysi caalami ah si loo soo celiyo dowladdii caalamku aqoonsanaa ee Yemen. Arrintaasi waxay keentay in isbahaysiga si weyn loo dhaleeceeyo. Sanadkii 2021-kii, Madaxweynihii Mareykanka Joe Biden wuxuu joojiyay taageeradii uu Mareykanku siin jiray dagaalka Yemen, taageeradaas oo ay ku jirtay iibinta hubka. Dagaalku wuxuu galaaftay nolosha in ka badan 150,000 oo qof, wuxuuna dhaliyay musiibo bani’aadamnimo oo sababtay in 4.8 milyan oo qof ay guryahooda ka barakacaan, halka in ka badan kala bar shacabka oo dhan oo ah 19.5 milyan oo qof ay u baahan yihiin gargaar noocyo kala duwan leh. items.title: Mareykanka oo xayiraad fiiso saaray Cabdifataax al-Burhan
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa wali fiisaha gelitaanka dalkaasi siin hoggaamiyaha ciidamada Sudan, Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, iyadoo maalmo yar ay ka harsan yihiin khudbad la qorsheeyay inuu ka jeediyo shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee magaalada New York. Arrintan ayaa lagu sheegay warqad uu safiirka Sudan ee Qaramada Midoobay, Al-Harith Idriss Al-Harith, u diray Xoghayaha Guud ee QM Antonio Guterres, isagoo ka codsaday hay’adda caalamiga ah inay si degdeg ah arrinta u farageliso. Ilo diblomaasiyadeed oo Sudanese ah iyo falanqeeye reer galbeed ah oo xog-ogaal u ah wada-hadallada labada dhinac ayaa sheegay in bixinta fiisaha lala xiriiriyay in al-Burhan uu oggolaado qorshe xabbad-joojin ah oo soconaya 90 maalmood. Qorshahaas waxaa soo jeediyay Massad Boulos, oo ah la-taliyaha sare ee Mareykanka ee arrimaha Carabta iyo Afrika. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka iyo mas’uuliyiinta Sudan ayaan markiiba jawaab ka bixin codsiyo loo diray oo ku saabsanaa arrintan. Al-Burhan ayaa lagu wadaa inuu Khamiista khudbad ka jeediyo Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Warqadda Sudan, oo ku taariikhaysan 21-ka Sebtembar, ayaa QM ka dalbatay “faragelin degdeg ah” oo ay la sameyso dowladda Mareykanka si loo xaqiijiyo in fiisaha loo soo saaro al-Burhan. “Haddii xaaladdan ay sii socoto, waxay dhab ahaan ka hor istaagi doontaa madaxa dowlad xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay inuu si shaqsi ah uga qeyb galo howlaha Golaha Guud,” ayaa lagu yiri warqadda. Afhayeenka Qaramada Midoobay Stéphane Dujarric ayaa sheegay in Guterres uu si weyn uga walaacsan yahay wararka sheegaya in wali aan fiisaha loo soo saarin madaxa Golaha Sare ee Ku-meelgaarka ah ee Sudan. Dujarric ayaa sheegay in xoghaynta Qaramada Midoobay ay arrinta si toos ah ula xiriirtay mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka, ayna sii waddo wada-hadallada. Khilaaf la xiriira xabbad-joojinta Xiisadda cusub ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli xiriirka Mareykanka iyo hoggaanka ciidamada Sudan uu sii xumaanayay. Ciidamada Sudan ayaa xagaagan muujiyay diidmo iyo shuruudo ku saabsan qorshaha xabbad-joojinta ee uu soo jeediyay Boulos, iyagoo dalbanayay in heshiis kasta uu ku jiro in ciidamada Rapid Support Forces (RSF) ay ka baxaan magaalooyinka ay gacanta ku hayaan. Al-Burhan ayaa maqaal Isniintii lagu daabacay wargeyska Mareykanka ee Foreign Policy ku sheegay inuusan aqbali doonin amarro dibadda looga yeeriyo oo ku saabsan sida loo wajahayo dagaalka Sudan. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku dooday in xabbad-joojinnadii hore ay RSF iyo taageerayaasheeda siisay fursad ay dib isugu abaabulaan. “Xabbad-joojinnadu way burbureen intii uu dagaalkani socday, sababtoo ah waxaa laga qoray Sudan iyadoo aan Sudan qeyb ka ahayn,” ayuu yiri al-Burhan. Mareykanka ayaa isku dayaya inuu dhex-dhexaadiyo dhinacyada ku dagaallamaya Sudan, isagoo adeegsanaya qaab loo yaqaan “Quad”, oo ay sidoo kale ku jiraan Imaaraadka Carabta, Masar iyo Sacuudi Carabiya. Dalalkaas ayaa loo arkaa kuwa saameynta ugu weyn ku leh dhinacyada iyo xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Sudan. Dagaal galay sanadkii afraad Dagaalka Sudan ayaa billowday bishii Abriil 2023, markii uu dagaal toos ah dhex maray ciidamada dowladda ee uu hoggaamiyo al-Burhan iyo RSF oo uu hoggaamiyo Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, oo loo yaqaan Hemedti. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa dagaalka Sudan ku tilmaantay mid sababay dhibaatada bani’aadannimo ee ugu weyn dunida. Hemedti ayaa dhankiisa sameystay maamul la tartamaya dowladda ay taageeraan ciidamada Sudan, inkastoo maamulkaasi uusan weli helin aqoonsi caalami ah oo ballaaran. Al-Burhan ayaa ahaa hoggaamiyaha dhabta ah ee Sudan tan iyo 2019-kii, waxaana isaga iyo Hemedti ay 2021-kii afgambi ku rideen dowladdii rayidka ahayd, taasoo keentay in Midowga Afrika iyo quwadaha reer galbeedka ay ka noqdaan aqoonsigii nidaamka cusub. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, al-Burhan ayaa sanadihii ka dambeeyay afgambiga Sudan ku matalay kulammada Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Khilaafka fiisaha ayaa sidoo kale keenaya su’aalo ku saabsan waajibaadka Mareykanka ee ah dalka martigeliya xarunta Qaramada Midoobay. Heshiiska martigelinta QM ayaa guud ahaan dhigaya in Mareykanku fududeeyo gelitaanka wakiillada dowladaha xubnaha ka ah ee u socda howlaha Qaramada Midoobay. Xiriirka Washington iyo hoggaanka ciidamada Sudan ayaa toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay horey ugu jiray xaalad kacsan, gaar ahaan kadib markii Mareykanku soo jeediyay in cunaqabateynta hubka ee hadda saaran gobolka Darfur lagu ballaariyo Sudan oo dhan. Taageerayaasha al-Burhan ayaa ku doodaya in tallaabadaasi ay si weyn u saameyn doonto ciidamada dowladda marka loo eego RSF. Ra’iisul wasaarihii rayidka ahaa ee Sudan ka hor afgambigii 2021, Abdalla Hamdok, ayaa isna toddobaadkan ku sugan New York, isagoo halkaasi kula sugan xubno ka tirsan isbahaysigiisa ka soo horjeeda dagaalka. items.fullContent: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa wali fiisaha gelitaanka dalkaasi siin hoggaamiyaha ciidamada Sudan, Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, iyadoo maalmo yar ay ka harsan yihiin khudbad la qorsheeyay inuu ka jeediyo shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee magaalada New York. Arrintan ayaa lagu sheegay warqad uu safiirka Sudan ee Qaramada Midoobay, Al-Harith Idriss Al-Harith, u diray Xoghayaha Guud ee QM Antonio Guterres, isagoo ka codsaday hay’adda caalamiga ah inay si degdeg ah arrinta u farageliso. Ilo diblomaasiyadeed oo Sudanese ah iyo falanqeeye reer galbeed ah oo xog-ogaal u ah wada-hadallada labada dhinac ayaa sheegay in bixinta fiisaha lala xiriiriyay in al-Burhan uu oggolaado qorshe xabbad-joojin ah oo soconaya 90 maalmood. Qorshahaas waxaa soo jeediyay Massad Boulos, oo ah la-taliyaha sare ee Mareykanka ee arrimaha Carabta iyo Afrika. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka iyo mas’uuliyiinta Sudan ayaan markiiba jawaab ka bixin codsiyo loo diray oo ku saabsanaa arrintan. Al-Burhan ayaa lagu wadaa inuu Khamiista khudbad ka jeediyo Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Warqadda Sudan, oo ku taariikhaysan 21-ka Sebtembar, ayaa QM ka dalbatay “faragelin degdeg ah” oo ay la sameyso dowladda Mareykanka si loo xaqiijiyo in fiisaha loo soo saaro al-Burhan. “Haddii xaaladdan ay sii socoto, waxay dhab ahaan ka hor istaagi doontaa madaxa dowlad xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay inuu si shaqsi ah uga qeyb galo howlaha Golaha Guud,” ayaa lagu yiri warqadda. Afhayeenka Qaramada Midoobay Stéphane Dujarric ayaa sheegay in Guterres uu si weyn uga walaacsan yahay wararka sheegaya in wali aan fiisaha loo soo saarin madaxa Golaha Sare ee Ku-meelgaarka ah ee Sudan. Dujarric ayaa sheegay in xoghaynta Qaramada Midoobay ay arrinta si toos ah ula xiriirtay mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka, ayna sii waddo wada-hadallada. Khilaaf la xiriira xabbad-joojinta Xiisadda cusub ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli xiriirka Mareykanka iyo hoggaanka ciidamada Sudan uu sii xumaanayay. Ciidamada Sudan ayaa xagaagan muujiyay diidmo iyo shuruudo ku saabsan qorshaha xabbad-joojinta ee uu soo jeediyay Boulos, iyagoo dalbanayay in heshiis kasta uu ku jiro in ciidamada Rapid Support Forces (RSF) ay ka baxaan magaalooyinka ay gacanta ku hayaan. Al-Burhan ayaa maqaal Isniintii lagu daabacay wargeyska Mareykanka ee Foreign Policy ku sheegay inuusan aqbali doonin amarro dibadda looga yeeriyo oo ku saabsan sida loo wajahayo dagaalka Sudan. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku dooday in xabbad-joojinnadii hore ay RSF iyo taageerayaasheeda siisay fursad ay dib isugu abaabulaan. “Xabbad-joojinnadu way burbureen intii uu dagaalkani socday, sababtoo ah waxaa laga qoray Sudan iyadoo aan Sudan qeyb ka ahayn,” ayuu yiri al-Burhan. Mareykanka ayaa isku dayaya inuu dhex-dhexaadiyo dhinacyada ku dagaallamaya Sudan, isagoo adeegsanaya qaab loo yaqaan “Quad”, oo ay sidoo kale ku jiraan Imaaraadka Carabta, Masar iyo Sacuudi Carabiya. Dalalkaas ayaa loo arkaa kuwa saameynta ugu weyn ku leh dhinacyada iyo xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Sudan. Dagaal galay sanadkii afraad Dagaalka Sudan ayaa billowday bishii Abriil 2023, markii uu dagaal toos ah dhex maray ciidamada dowladda ee uu hoggaamiyo al-Burhan iyo RSF oo uu hoggaamiyo Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, oo loo yaqaan Hemedti. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa dagaalka Sudan ku tilmaantay mid sababay dhibaatada bani’aadannimo ee ugu weyn dunida. Hemedti ayaa dhankiisa sameystay maamul la tartamaya dowladda ay taageeraan ciidamada Sudan, inkastoo maamulkaasi uusan weli helin aqoonsi caalami ah oo ballaaran. Al-Burhan ayaa ahaa hoggaamiyaha dhabta ah ee Sudan tan iyo 2019-kii, waxaana isaga iyo Hemedti ay 2021-kii afgambi ku rideen dowladdii rayidka ahayd, taasoo keentay in Midowga Afrika iyo quwadaha reer galbeedka ay ka noqdaan aqoonsigii nidaamka cusub. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, al-Burhan ayaa sanadihii ka dambeeyay afgambiga Sudan ku matalay kulammada Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Khilaafka fiisaha ayaa sidoo kale keenaya su’aalo ku saabsan waajibaadka Mareykanka ee ah dalka martigeliya xarunta Qaramada Midoobay. Heshiiska martigelinta QM ayaa guud ahaan dhigaya in Mareykanku fududeeyo gelitaanka wakiillada dowladaha xubnaha ka ah ee u socda howlaha Qaramada Midoobay. Xiriirka Washington iyo hoggaanka ciidamada Sudan ayaa toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay horey ugu jiray xaalad kacsan, gaar ahaan kadib markii Mareykanku soo jeediyay in cunaqabateynta hubka ee hadda saaran gobolka Darfur lagu ballaariyo Sudan oo dhan. Taageerayaasha al-Burhan ayaa ku doodaya in tallaabadaasi ay si weyn u saameyn doonto ciidamada dowladda marka loo eego RSF. Ra’iisul wasaarihii rayidka ahaa ee Sudan ka hor afgambigii 2021, Abdalla Hamdok, ayaa isna toddobaadkan ku sugan New York, isagoo halkaasi kula sugan xubno ka tirsan isbahaysigiisa ka soo horjeeda dagaalka. items.title: Somaliland president hopes for security cooperation with Israel by end of year
items.description: Somaliland president hopes for security cooperation with Israel by end of year Andrew Bernard Posted 8 hrs ago at 5: 31 PM Stories appearing in our World pages originate from aggregated news feeds obtained from various subscription news Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi expects security cooperation with Israel to begin by the end of the year after the Jewish recognized the breakaway republic in December. Speaking to reporters at the conclusion of a two-week visit to Washington last week, Abdullahi left open the possibility of an Israeli military presence in the country that most of the world, including the United States, still recognizes as part of Somalia. “My priority is water,” Abdullahi said. Israel “gave training for 50 Somaliland water engineers, and they will start some water projects, including desalination of Berbera seawater.” “Hopefully, before the end of the year, they will start to cooperate in the security sector,” he told reporters, including JNS. Berbera is the main port of Somaliland, which declared independence from Somalia in 1991. Abdullahi and Somaliland’s supporters in the United States are pressing for a greater degree of normalization for the country, which has no official diplomatic relations with the United States and is currently recognized only by Israel. Those measures include access to the SWIFT banking system, separating the State Department’s travel advisory for Somaliland from that of Somalia and greater military cooperation. That potential military cooperation may now have greater importance for the United States given Somaliland’s proximity to Yemen and the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, which is under threat from the Iran-backed Houthi terrorist group. “We gave an offer to the United States for partnership in security, whether it’s counterterrorism, maritime security, protection of ships in the area,” Abdullahi told reporters. “Officials from the administration, the Department of War, confirmed that they wish for the relationship to grow.” (U.S. President Donald Trump refers to the Pentagon as the War Department.) During his time in Washington, Abdullahi also met with representatives of the Jewish community, including the American Jewish Committee, and said that he hopes that those talks might lead to greater economic development for the country of six million people, which if it gained independence would be one of the poorest in the world. “We’re discussing with these Jewish organizations that we now have full cooperation with Israel, and hopefully they will encourage Jewish or Israeli investment in Somaliland,” he said. He described some of the economic challenges the country faces, including its reliance on shipping traffic to generate tax revenue, which has plummeted amid the conflict between the United States and Iran. “Because of the war, the number of containers coming to Berbera became maybe 48% less,” he said. “We don’t know if that continues how long we can manage.” “Hopefully, this will be a temporary issue. The war will be over. The problem will be solved,” Abdullahi said. “We pray for that.”

items.title: Hantidhowrka Guud oo Guddiga Shaqaalaha U Digay
items.description: DHOWRIDDA MADAXBANNAANIDA HAY’ADDA HANTIDHOWRKA GUUD Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee JFS waa hay’ad dastuuri ah 00 madax-bannaan, lehna madax-bannaani maamul iyo mid maaliyadeed, laguna dhisay Qodobka 177aad ee Dastuurka JFS. Awoodaha, waajibaadka iyo shaqooyinkiisa waxaa lagu faahfaahiyey Sharciga Maareynta Maaliyadda Guud, Sharci Lr. 17 ee 2019, iyo Sharciga Hantidhowrka Guud, Sharci Lr. 14 ee 2023. Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud waa hay’adda ugu sarreysa ee u xilsaaran hantidhowrista, diiwaangelinta iyo ilaalinta hantida danta guud iyo macaamillada maaliyadeed ee dowladda, isla markaana fulisa kormeer iyo daba-gal ku saabsan maareynta kheyraadka guud. Sidoo kale, waxa uu hubiyaa dhowrista iyo ku dhaqanka shuruucda maamulka maaliyadda iyo miisaaniyadda Dowladda.Sidaas awgeed, si waafaqsan Qodobka 63aad (2) ee Xeer-nidaamiyaha Sharciga Nidaamka Xukuumadda, Xeer Lr. 174 ee 15/02/2025: “Guddiyada iyo Xafiisyada madax-bannaan ee dastuuriga ah, waxaa lagu nidaaminayaa mabaadi’da dastuuriga ah iyo qodobbada ku qeexan xeerarkooda gaarka ah.” Marka la eego qodobbada kor ku xusan, waxaa waajib sharci ku ah Guddiga Qaranka ee Shaqaalaha Rayidka Dowladda in uu si buuxda u dhowro madax-bannaanida dastuuriga ah ee Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee JFS, isla markaana tallaabo kasta, go’aan kasta ama habraac kasta oo khuseeya Xafiiska lagu saleeyo Dastuurka JFS iyo shuruucda kale ee lagu dhisay laguna nidaamiyo Xafiiska. Sidaas darteed, Guddiga Qaranka ee Shaqaalaha Rayidka Dowladda waa in uusan qaadin ama dhaqan-gelin tallaabo wax u dhimaysa, xaddidaysa ama ka hor imaanaysa madax-bannaanida, awoodaha iyo nidaamka sharciyeed ee Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee JFS. The post Hantidhowrka Guud oo Guddiga Shaqaalaha U Digay first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Costa Rica oo horumarinaya xariirkooda dublumaasiyadeed
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Costa Rica ayaa magaalada New York ku yeeshay kulan heer wasiir ah, kaas oo looga hadlay xoojinta xiriirka laba geesoodka ah iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada horumarinta. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cali , ayaa kulan la yeeshay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Cibaadada ee Costa Rica, Manuel Tovar Rivera , iyadoo kulanku ka dhacay magaalada New York, xilli uu socdo Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNGA81) . Labada wasiir ayaa ka wada hadlay sidii loo xoojin lahaa xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Costa Rica , iyo fursadaha lagu horumarin karo iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada horumarinta. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu muujiyay danaha ay labada dal ka wadaagaan iskaashiga horumarineed, iyadoo la doonayo in la sii ballaariyo xiriirka iyo wada-shaqeynta Soomaaliya iyo Costa Rica. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya ay ku ballaarinayso xiriirkeeda caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan Latin America , iyadoo dowladda Soomaaliya ay raadineyso iskaashi iyo xiriirro cusub oo ay la yeelato dalalka ku yaalla gobolkaas. Kulamada Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya uu la yeelanayo dhiggiisa dalalka kala duwan ayaa ka dhacaya iyadoo ay socdaan shirarka iyo kulamada heerka sare ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay , kuwaas oo fursad u siinaya Soomaaliya inay xoojiso xiriirkeeda laba geesoodka ah iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Morooko oo ka wada hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Morocco ayaa magaalada New York ku yeeshay kulan heer wasiir ah, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo horumarinta iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cali, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda, Iskaashiga Afrika iyo Qurbajoogta Morocco, Nasser Bourita, iyadoo kulanku ka dhacay inta lagu guda jiray Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Labada wasiir ayaa kulankooda kaga wada hadlay xaaladda xiriirka laba geesoodka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Morocco, iyagoo isla eegay sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga u dhexeeya labada dowladood. Sidoo kale, waxaa kulanka lagu soo qaaday muhiimadda ay leedahay isku-duwidda mowqifyada labada dal ee arrimaha gobolka iyo kuwa dhinacyada badan leh, gaar ahaan goobaha ay Soomaaliya iyo Morocco ku wada leeyihiin dano iyo iskaashi. Kulanka ayaa qeyb ka ah kulamada diblomaasiyadeed ee ay Soomaaliya ka waddo magaalada New York inta uu socdo shirweynaha Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo mas’uuliyiinta dowladda Soomaaliya ay kulamo kala duwan la yeelanayaan dhiggooda caalamka, si loo xoojiyo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya la leedahay dalalka kale. Kulanka Soomaaliya iyo Morocco wuxuu sidoo kale muujinayaa dadaallada labada dowladood ee lagu horumarinayo xiriirkooda, iyadoo la xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta iyo isku-duwidda arrimaha muhiimka u ah labada dal iyo guud ahaan qaaradda Afrika.

Mareykanka iyo Iiraan oo wada-hadallo ku yeeshay New York
items.description: Mareykanka iyo Iiraan ayaa magaalada New York ku yeeshay wada-hadallo diblomaasiyadeed oo loo marayo dhexdhexaadiyayaal, xilli dadaallo lagu doonayo in lagu soo afjaro dagaalka labada dhinac iyo in dib loo furo Marinka Hormuz ay socdaan. Ergeyga gaarka ah ee Mareykanka, Steve Witkoff , ayaa sheegay in dhexdhexaadiyayaashu maalintii oo dhan u kala gooshayeen wafdiyada Mareykanka iyo Iran, iyagoo gudbinayay farriimo iyo soo-jeedimo. Witkoff wuxuu sheegay in wareegga wada-hadallada la soo gabagabeeyay, isla markaana uu rajeynayo in natiijadu noqoto mid wax-ku-ool ah, iyadoo dhexdhexaadiyayaashu ay sii wadi doonaan dadaallada. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa isna sheegay in Witkoff iyo Jared Kushner ay kulan qaatay ku dhowaad saddex saacadood la yeesheen mas’uuliyiin Iiraan ah. Trump wuxuu kulanka ku tilmaamay mid wanaagsan oo wax-ku-ool ah, isagoo sheegay inuu jiro dhaqdhaqaaq ku wajahan heshiis, xilli Aqalka Cad uu markii dambe caddeeyay in Trump uusan kulankaas ka qaybgelin, balse Witkoff iyo Kushner ay matalayeen dhinaca Mareykanka. Dadaallada lagu dejinayo xiisadda kuma koobna Mareykanka iyo Iiraan oo keliya, waxaana Qatar ay sheegtay inay la shaqaynayso Pakistan si loo yareeyo xiisadda Washington iyo Tehran, loo ilaaliyo xorriyadda maraakiibta ee Hormuz, loona abuuro xaalad u saamaxaysa labada dhinac inay wada-hadal sii wadaan. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha iyo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Qatar, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, ayaa sidoo kale New York kula kulmay Araghchi, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xaaladda gobolka iyo dadaallada lagu dhimayo xiisadda. Warbixinno ay Reuters soo xigatay ayaa intaas ku daraya in Qatar ay soo jeedisay qaab-dhismeed amni oo ay ka qayb qaataan Iiraan iyo dalalka Khaliijka, inkastoo faahfaahinta qorshaha aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin. Wada-hadalladan ayaa yimid saacado kaddib khudbaddii Trump ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, halkaas oo uu sheegay in Washington ay haysato doorasho adag oo u dhexeysa heshiis Iiraan u oggolaanaya inay dib u dhisto dhaqaalihii iyo sii wadista cadaadiska militari. Si kastaba ha ahaatee kulamada New York ayaa dib u soo nooleynaya waddada wada-xaajoodka Mareykanka iyo Iiraan, balse natiijada ugu dambeysa ayaa ku xirnaan doonta sida labada dhinac uga jawaabaan shuruudaha iyo ballanqaadyada miiska saaran.

items.title: Culimada Soomaaliyeed oo cambaareeyay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee Sacuudiga
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa maanta si adag uga hadlay weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, gaar ahaan kuwa lagu waxyeelleynayo amniga magaalada barakeysan ee Makkah iyo hareeraheeda, iyaga oo ku tilmaamay fal xadgudub ku ah xurmada goobaha barakeysan iyo amniga dadka ku nool iyo booqdayaasha. Bayaan ay soo saareen culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa lagu sheegay in ay si adag u cambaareynayaan beegsiga Makkah iyo isku day kasta oo lagu waxyeelleynayo amniga magaaladaasi Culimada ayaa sidoo kale cambaareeyay weerarrada lagu qaadayo gudaha Sacuudi Carabiya, iyaga oo sheegay in falalkaasi ay yihiin kuwo aan la aqbali karin oo waxyeello u geysanaya amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka. “Waxaan si ada u cambaareyneynaa beesiga Makkah iyo hareeraheeda waxyeelleynta amnigeeda iyo cabsi gelinta dadka deggan iyo booqdayaasha. Waa dambi wayn iyo ku xadgudub xormada Alle. Weerarrada Sacuudi Carabiya iyo beegsiga xarumaha muhiimka ah ee dalkaas waa gar-darro iyo fasahaadin,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Dhanka kale, culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa bayaankooda ku soo hadal qaaday xaaladda adag ee dalka Yemen, iyaga oo cambaareeyay beegsiga culimada, dilka dadka rayidka ah, burburinta masaajidda iyo xiritaanka xarumaha dacwada, kuwaas oo ay ku eedeeyeen Xuutiyiinta. “Sidoo kale waxaan cambaareyneynaa beegsiga culimada, daadinta dhiigga dadka aan waxba galabsan, burburinta masaajidda iyo xirtaanka xarumaha dacwadaha Xuutiyiinta ka gaysteen dalka Yemen,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri bayaanka. Ugu dambeyn, culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa sheegay in dowladda Sacuudi ay xaq u leedahay inay difaacdo dalkeeda iyo dadkeeda, waxayna Muslimiinta ugu baaqeen inay ku garab istaagaan iska caabinta gardarrada. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay haatan sii kordhayaan weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee lagu bartilmaameedsanayo Sacuudi Carabiya, kadib markii uu sii xoogeystay dagaalka labada dhinac. The post Culimada Soomaaliyeed oo cambaareeyay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee Sacuudiga appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo madaxda dhowr dal kula kulmay New York
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Talaadadii Magaalada New York kula kulmay Raysal Wasaaraha Pakistan, Shehbaz Sharif. Kulanka ayaa dhacay, intii lagu guda jiray furitaanka Meertada 81aad ee Golaha Loo Dhanyahay ee Qaramada Midoobey, sida uu Raysal Wasaaraha Pakistan ku sheegay bartiisa xiriirka bulshada. War qoraal ah oo ka soo baxay Villa Somalia ayaa lagu sheegay in Madaxweynuhu uu New York kulamo doceedyo kula yeeshay Madaxweynaha Serbia, Aleksandar Vučić, Madaxweynaha Senegal, Bassirou Diomaye Faye, Madaxweynaha Zimbabwe, Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa iyo Raysal Wasaaraha Pakistan. “Kulamada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Somaliya iyo dalalkaasi iyo arrimo la xiriira nabadda, amniga, horumarka iyo danaha wadajirka ah ee ay wadaagaan dhinacyadaasi.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Madaxweynaha ayaa masuuliyiinta uu la kulmay la wadaagay horumarka iyo guulaha Somaliya ka xaqiijisay nabadda iyo amniga, dowlad-dhiska, dimuqraadiyeynta, dhaqaalaha iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, isagoo sidoo kale ka hadlay fursadaha iskaashi ee Somaliya ay la yeelan karto dalalkaasi.” Bog cusub ayaa u furmay xiriirka iskaashiga Somaliya iyo Pakistan ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, ka dib heshiiskii is afgaradka ahaa ee ay labada dowladood bishii August ku kala saxiixdeen Magaalada Islamabad. Heshiiskan ayaa Somaliya looga taageerayaa dhismaha awoodda ciidanka, amniga badda iyo cirka.

items.title: Madaxweynaha Koonfurta Suudaan oo kala diray xukuumaddii ku-meelgaarka ahayd
items.description: Madaxweynaha Koonfurta Suudaan, Salva Kiir Mayardit, ayaa kala diray xukuumaddii midnimada ku-meelgaarka ahayd, isagoo magacaabay maamul ku-meelgaar ah xilli dalka uu isu diyaarinayo doorashadii ugu horreysay ee qaran. Wareegto uu madaxweynuhu soo saaray ayaa meesha ka saartay madaxweyne-ku-xigeennadii, wasiirradii iyo qaar ka mid ah maamulayaasha deegaanka. Sidoo kale waxaa la kala diray goleyaashii baarlamaanka heer qaran iyo heer dowlad-goboleed, halka hay’adaha garsoorka iyo amniga ay sii shaqaynayaan. Go’aankan ayaa yimid maalin kadib markii baarlamaanka Koonfurta Suudaan uu ansixiyay wax-ka-beddel lagu sameeyay Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka , kaas oo u oggolaanaya Madaxweyne Kiir inuu xilka sii hayo inta lagu jiro xilliga doorashada. Doorashada ayaa loo qorsheeyay 22-ka Diseembar , waxaana wax-ka-beddellada cusub ay meesha ka saarayaan shuruuddii ahayd in doorashada laga hor mariyo dhamaystirka dastuur rasmi ah iyo tirakoobka dadweynaha. Si kastaba, mucaaradka dalka ayaa diiday isbeddelladan, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha ay walaac ka muujiyeen awoodda ballaaran ee Madaxweynaha ay siinayaan. Michael Wani, oo ah qareen hore uga tirsanaa guddigii diyaarinta dastuurka, ayaa sheegay in haddii isbeddelladan la dhaqan geliyo, Kiir uu noqonayo qofka ugu awoodda badan dalka, maadaama madaxweyne-ku-xigeennada, baarlamaanka iyo hay’adaha kale ee fulinta la kala diray. Doorashada Koonfurta Suudaan ayaa muddo dheer dib u dhacday, waxaana markii hore la qorsheeyay in la qabto 2022 , balse laba jeer ayaa dib loo dhigay. Waxaa weli jira arrimo muhiim ah oo ku xusan heshiiskii nabadda ee 2018 oo aan si buuxda loo dhammaystirin, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin diyaarinta dastuur rasmi ah, diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaasha iyo mideynta ciidamada ay kala taageeraan dhinacyada siyaasadda. Heshiiskaas nabadeed ayaa soo afjaray dagaal sokeeye oo socday muddo shan sano ah, kaas oo sida Qaramada Midoobay sheegtay sababay dhimashada ku dhowaad 400,000 oo qof , halka malaayiin kalena ay barakaceen. Dhanka kale, hoggaamiyaha mucaaradka iyo madaxweyne-ku-xigeenkii hore, Riek Machar , ayaa weli ku jira xabsi guri, isagoo wajahaya dacwado ay ka mid yihiin khiyaano qaran iyo dil, eedeymahaas oo uu isagu beeniyay. Amnesty International ayaa sheegtay in kala dirista xukuumaddu ay noqon karto tallaabo muhiim ah oo loo qaaday doorashada ugu horreysa ee dalka, balse waxay ugu baaqday mas’uuliyiinta inay hubiyaan in shacabka ay helaan jawi ammaan ah oo ay ku codeyn karaan, musharraxiintuna ay si xor ah uga qayb geli karaan doorashada. Xaaladda amni ee caasimadda Juba ayaa sidoo kale si weyn loo adkeeyay, iyadoo la soo sheegay isbaarooyin iyo waddooyin la xiray agagaarka xarumaha dowladda, halka ciidamada ammaanka lagu amray inay feejignaan sare ku jiraan.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Magaalada Beledweyne ayaa waxaa ka socda dhaqdhaqaaq siyaasadeed iyo mid ciidan, oo lagu diidan yahay in wax doorasho ah oo la xiriira Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle in laga qabto Gobolka Hiiraan. Siyaasiyiinta, odayaasha iyo waxgaradka gobolkaasi qaarkood ayaa Beledweyne ka wada abaabul ciidan iyo diyaargarow ku aaddan dhismaha maamul ka madaxbannaan kan Hirshabelle. Ciidamada dadka deegaanka ayaa loogu talagalay inay taageeraan hannaanka dhismaha maamulka cusub ee la doonayo in laga yegleelo gobolkaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in qorista ciidamada dadka deegaanka ay sidoo kale ka socoto qaybo ka mid ah bariga gobolkaasi, si ay uga hortaggaan doorashada soo socota Hirshabelle ee Dowladda Federaalka taageereyso. Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa qorsheynaya in 30-ka bishan ay gobolka ka qabtaan doorasho qof iyo cod ah, oo shacabku ay ku soo dooranayaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Hirshabelle. Xiisadda siyaasadeed gobolka ee aadka u kacsan ayaa caqabad ku noqon karta in doorasho nabdoon oo xasilloon laga qabto degmooyinka gobolkaasi ee horey loo shaaciyay in doorashada ay ka dhaceyso. Dowladda Federaalka iyo hoggaanka siyaasadeed iyo dhaqanka gobolkaasi ayaa kala dhaqaaqay, ka dib markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu taageeray musharaxnimada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe). Urur Siyaasadeedka JSP ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu hoggaamiyo ayaa 13-kii bishan si rasmi ah Cali Guudlaawe ugu xushay inuu noqdo musharaxooda uga qaybgelaya doorashada madaxtinimada Hirshabelle. Madaxweyne Kuxigeenka Hirshabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Yuusuf Dabageed) ayaa horey u sheegay inaanan wax doorasho ah oo ku saabsan Hirshabelle laga qaban karin Gobolka Hiiraan, iyadoo aan siyaasiyan laga heshiin khilaafka taagan. Khilaafka siyaasadeed ayaa laga cabsi qabaa in uu isku bedelo gacan ka hadal, taasoo saamayn ku yeelaneysa amniga dalka, gaar ahaan midka gobolkaasi. Khilaafkan ayaa wax aad mooddo dabin ku ah Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, oo Villa Somalia ay ku riixeyso inay Ciidamada Militariga gacan ka gaystaan sugidda amniga ee doorashada laga qabanayo degmooyinka gobolkaasi, xitaa haddii ay noqoto in askartaasi laga qaado Caasimadda Muqdisho. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud oo fahamsan cawaaqibka amni ay arrintan leedahay ayaa ka cararaya in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee deegaanka u dhashay iyo kuwa Macawiisleyda ee ka taageera la dagaalanka maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ay soo banneeyaan furimaha hore ee dagaalka. Khilaafkan kala irdheeyay reer Hiiraan iyo Dowladda Federaalka iyo Hirshabelle oo isku garab ah ayaa khatar gelinaya wadajirka iyo isku duubnida ciidamada, wuxuuna fursad siinayaa kooxaha argagixisada inay dib u soo xoogeystaan, iyadoo gobolku uu xudun u yahay kacdoonka dadka deegaanka (Macawiisleyda) ee ka dhanka ah Al Shabaab.

items.title: Trump oo ku hanjabay inuu burburin doono Iiraan, haddii…
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump ayaa khudbaddiisa Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay kaga hadlay dagaalka iyo barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iiraan. Reuters waxay sheegtay in Trump uu khudbadda ku difaacay tallaabooyinka milatari ee Maraykanka ee ka dhanka ah Iiraan. Madaxweyne Trump ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in haddii heshiis lala gaari waayo Iiraan, uu Maraykanku “burburin doono Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan.” Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay inuu aaminsan yahay in Iiraan ay ugu dambayn heshiis la geli doonto Maraykanka kadib doorashooyinka dhexe ee Maraykanka. Trump ayaa mar kale Iiraan ku tilmaamay dalka uu sheegay inuu yahay maalgeliyaha ugu weyn ee argagixisada caalamka, isagoo intaas ku daray in Iiraan aysan hadda khatar ahayn, sida uu sheegay, maadaama Maraykanku uu burburiyay barnaamijkeeda nukliyeerka. Madaxweynaha dalka Maraykanka ayaa sidoo kale ku celiyay sheegashada ah in tobannaan kun oo dibadbaxayaal ah lagu dilay Iiraan xilliyadii u dambeeyay. Waxaa kale oo uu dhaleeceeyay dalalka Yurub, isagoo sheegay inaysan si ku filan uga fiirsan khatarta gantaallada Iiraan. Donald Trump ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ciidanka iyo dhaqaalaha Iiraan si weyn loo burburiyay. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Maraykanka ayaa mar kale fursad uga faa’iidaystay khudbaddiisa Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay inuu ku dhaleeceeyo hay’addaha, isagoo ku eedeeyay inay “soo rogayso ajande xagjirnimo oo garabka bidix ah.” Shaqaalaha Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sannadkii ugu horreeyay ee xilli-xileedka labaad ee Trump ku tilmaamay mid qalalaase badan ku keenay hay’adda, balse waxay aaminsan yihiin in xaaladda Qaramada Midoobay ay hadda wax yar ka soo roonaatay. Maraykanku weli wuxuu Qaramada Midoobay ka hayaa oo ka xannibay balaayiin doollar, inkastoo uu dhowaan bixiyay 827 milyan oo doollar oo ah qayb ka mid ah waajibaadkiisa maaliyadeed ee miisaaniyadda joogtada ah iyo hawlgallada nabad-ilaalinta. Si kastaba, Khudbadda Trump waxay timid kadib markii Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, António Guterres, uu furay kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud. Kalfadhiga doodda guud wuxuu socdaa 22 illaa 28 Sebtembar 2026. The post Trump oo ku hanjabay inuu burburin doono Iiraan, haddii… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Trump oo Dalalka Xubnaha Ka Ah Maxkamadda ICC ugu Baaqay Inay Si Degdeg ah uga Baxaan
items.description: WASHINGTON (Goobjoog News) — Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, ayaa ku baaqay in dhammaan dalalka xubnaha ka ah Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah (ICC) ay si degdeg ah uga baxaan maxkamaddaas.  Baaqan cusub ee uu soo saaray Trump ayaa qayb ka ah cadaadiska joogtada ah iyo mucaaradnimada adag ee uu hore ugu hayay maxkamadda fadhigeedu yahay magaalada Hague, isagoo ku dooday in hay’addani ay ka gudubtay awooddeeda sharciga ah ayna bartilmaameedsato danaha dalalka madaxa-bannaan iyo hoggaamiyeyaashooda. Hadalka Trump ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli maxkamadda ICC ay waddo dacwado iyo baaritaanno xasaasi ah oo la xiriira dambiyo dagaal iyo kuwo ka dhan ah bini’aadannimada, kuwaas oo qaarkood si toos ah u taabanaya xulafada Mareykanka iyo xiisadaha ka taagan gobollo kala duwan oo caalamka ah. Baaqan ayaa la filayaa inuu falcelin xooggan ka dhex dhaliyo dowladaha xubnaha ka ah heshiiskii Rome Statute ee lagu aasaasay ICC, gaar ahaan waddamada reer Yurub iyo hay’adaha u dooda caddaaladda caalamiga ah, kuwaas oo maxkamadda u arka tiir muhiim u ah la-xisaabtanka dambiyada dagaalka.

items.title: Hantidhawrka oo u digay guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka kadib amarkii Xamza
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xafiiska hantidhawrka guud ee qaranka, Mudane Axmed Ciise Guutaale oo bayaan culus soo saaray ayaa u digay guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka oo haatan ku hawlan dib-u-habeynta shaqaalaha iyo saraakiisha sar sare ee dowladda, kadib markii xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaaruhu uu soo saaray amar saameynaya dhammaan wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha dowladda oo ay ku jiraan xafiisyada hantidhawrka iyo xeer-ilaaliyaha guud ee qaranka. Guutaale ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in xafiiska hantidhawrka uu yahay hay’ad dastuuri ah oo madax-bannaan, isla markaana leh madax-bannaani maamul iyo mid maaliyadeed, laguna dhisay qodobka 177-aad ee Dastuurka JFS. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in awoodaha, waajibaadka iyo shaqooyinka hantidhawrka lagu faah-faahiyey sharciga maareynta maaliyadda guud, sharci Lr. 17 ee 2019 iyo sharciga hantidhawrka guud, sharci Lr. 14 ee 2023. Qoraalka ayaa sidoo kale lagu yiri “Xafiiska Hantidhawrka Guud waa hay’adda ugu sarreysa ee u xil-saaran hantidhawrka, diiwaangelinta iyo ilaalinta hantida guud iyo macaamilada maaliyadeed ee dowladda, isla markaana fulisa kormeer iyo daba-gal ku saabsan maaraynta khayraadka guud. Sidoo kale, waxa uu hubiyaa dhowrista iyo ku dhaqanka shuruucda maamulka maaliyadda iyo miisaaniyadda Dowladda”. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Sidaas oo kale, waxa uu hubiyaa dhowrista iyo ku dhaqanka shuruucda maamulka maaliyadda iyo miisaaniyadda Dowladda”. Dhanka kale, wuxuu u digay guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka dowladda oo haatan ku howlan fulinta amar kasoo baxay Ra’iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamza Cabdi Barre oo ku aadan in dib u habeyn lagu sameeyo shaqaalaha rayidka iyada oo ujeedka uu yahay in tartan furan loo galo shaqooyinka dowladda. “Marka la eego qodobada kor ku xusan, waxaa waajib sharci ku ah Guddiga Qaranka ee Shaqaalaha Rayidka Dowladda in uu si buuxda u dhowro madax-bannaanida dastuuriga ah ee Xafiiska Hantidhawrka Guud ee JFS, isla markaana tallaabo kasta, go’aan kasta ama habraac kasta oo khuseeya Xafiiska lagu saleeyo Dastuurka JFS iyo shuruucda kale ee lagu dhisay laguna nidaamiyo Xafiiska,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri warqadda. Hawtidhawrka ayaa si gaar ah u faray guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka in aysan qaadin ama dhaqan-gelin tallaabo wax u dhimaysa, xaddidaysa ama ka hor imaanaysa madaxbannaanida, awoodaha iyo nidaamka sharciyeed ee Xafiiska Hantidhawrka Guud ee JFS. The post Hantidhawrka oo u digay guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka kadib amarkii Xamza appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland president discusses expanded military cooperation with U.S. officials
items.description: Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi, the president of Somaliland, the pro-Western region that broke away from Somalia, discussed deepening partnerships with the U.S., including expanded U.S.-Somaliland military cooperation, during a visit to Washington, D.C. Israel was the first state to recognize Somaliland’s independence last year, more than three decades after the region declared independence, though the U.S. has maintained direct and indirect relationships with the government, based in Hargeisa. The territory in the Horn of Africa is located along the Gulf of Aden and is seen as a potential site for an American or Israeli military base in the Horn of Africa, particularly in light of the growing Houthi control over the Bab al Mandeb Strait. Abdullahi told reporters at a media briefing that he met with representatives of the State Department, Pentagon, Treasury and Department of Energy as well as at least one representative from the National Security Council. “We had [with] all of them fruitful conversations. Short of recognizing Somaliland, we feel that there is progress in our conversation, and we shall continue that conversation,” Abdullahi said. “In the meantime, we understand that our cooperation [in] different sectors, will increase and will expand, and we hope that some American presence will be in Somaliland in the near future.” Full story: https://ji.news/5jea4

items.title: Taiwan launches Somaliland seed development project
items.description: Taiwan has launched a seed industry development project and opened an agricultural demonstration and training farm in Somaliland. Speaking at the farm’s opening ceremony Sunday, Taiwan Representative Allen C. Lou said Taiwan and Somaliland are working together to strengthen farmers’ capabilities through demonstrations, training, and technology transfers. The project will run through 2030 and aims to strengthen food security and climate resilience, according to the Taiwan Representative Office in Somaliland. The office said the two sides were “sowing seeds of friendship, growing a sustainable future together.” “This project will establish a seed quality management system, strengthen testing and inspection capacities, and improve seed production techniques,” the Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund said. The fund added that these efforts would help Somaliland advance toward the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal of zero hunger. Deputy Foreign Minister Francois Wu (吳志中) said in June that bilateral cooperation spans agriculture, healthcare, infrastructure, and other areas. Wu described Somaliland as Taiwan’s first major partner in East Africa and said the relationship could serve as a model for broader engagement across the continent. Last year, President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) met Somaliland Foreign Minister Abdirahman Dahir Adam and pledged to deepen the partnership. Lai said authoritarian regimes had intensified efforts to suppress Taiwan’s and Somaliland’s international participation. He said the two sides should work together to demonstrate the resilience of democratic alliances and their commitment to shared values. Source Taiwan news

items.title: Somalia dispute drives Uganda-Turkey defence rupture: report
items.description: Kampala (Somalia Today) — Uganda’s decision to suspend military cooperation with Turkey is linked to tensions over Kampala’s long-running troop presence in Somalia and Ankara’s expanding role in the country’s security sector, according to sources familiar with the dispute. Middle East Eye reported on Monday that the row over Ugandan government critic Fred Lumbuye, who lives in Turkey, had become the public face of a broader disagreement over Somalia and the future of Uganda’s military deployment there. Sources cited by the publication said Somalia had asked Uganda to end its military presence, pointing to the growing capabilities of Somali forces trained and equipped with Turkish support. Neither Mogadishu nor Kampala has publicly confirmed the reported request “The whole episode is connected to the Ugandan army’s presence in Somalia,” one source familiar with the dispute told Middle East Eye. Uganda has about 4,500 soldiers serving with the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia, or AUSSOM, and roughly 2,000 more under a separate bilateral arrangement with Mogadishu, according to figures previously reported by Somalia Today . The Uganda Peoples’ Defence Forces announced on Saturday that it had suspended all defence and military cooperation with Turkey with immediate effect. Army spokesman Colonel Chris Magezi said the measure would remain in force until “outstanding issues of mutual defence and military cooperation” were resolved, but the UPDF did not publicly identify Somalia as the cause. Somalia at centre Uganda has been a key pillar of the African Union’s military operations in Somalia since becoming the first country to deploy troops under the AU mission in March 2007. Its forces currently lead AUSSOM’s Sector One, covering Mogadishu and parts of Lower Shabelle, both of which remain central to operations against Al-Shabaab. Turkey, meanwhile, has emerged as one of Somalia’s most important defence partners, training thousands of soldiers, supplying military equipment and helping develop specialised Somali units. Its military presence is centred on the TURKSOM training facility in Mogadishu, while Turkish-supplied drones have become increasingly important in government operations against Al-Shabaab. The partnership continues to deepen. On Monday, the same day Middle East Eye published its report, Somali Defence Minister Ahmed Moallim Fiqi met a Turkish military delegation led by TURKSOM commander Major General Sabahattin Kalkan. Somalia’s Defence Ministry said the talks focused on strengthening defence cooperation, training Somali troops and improving the armed forces’ capabilities. Fiqi thanked Turkey for its continued support in rebuilding Somalia’s military. Turkey’s parliament also voted in July to extend the deployment of Turkish forces in Somalia for another two years, until July 2028. Middle East Eye said sources familiar with the Uganda-Turkey dispute believed those growing Somali capabilities had reduced Mogadishu’s dependence on Ugandan forces. The publication said Uganda could lose millions of dollars annually if its deployments ended, citing sources who estimated the financial impact at between $60 million and $72 million a year. Uganda, Somalia or the African Union have not publicly confirmed those figures. Gradual transition Somalia’s government has publicly called for national forces to assume greater responsibility for security, although it has not issued a specific demand that Ugandan troops leave. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud said in August that the time was approaching for Somalia to thank foreign troops and take responsibility for defending the country itself. “The world and our friends have helped us, but our time has come — the time for us to take responsibility,” Mohamud said at a military graduation ceremony. “The time has also come for us to give the forces who are in our country beautiful flowers and say to them, ‘Brothers, thank you.’” Hussein Abdirzak, a Mogadishu-based analyst, told Somalia Today that Somali forces were better prepared for a gradual reduction in international security support than in previous years. “I think what the Somali government opposes is a rapid withdrawal,” Abdirzak said. “Somalia can now largely stand on its own, and its forces are much stronger than they were before.” He said expanded air capabilities, particularly Turkey’s support for Somali drone operations, had altered the military balance. “The government now has air capabilities and Turkish drones, and that has made a significant difference in the war,” he said. The question of how quickly foreign forces can leave remains unresolved. Al-Shabaab continues to operate across parts of southern and central Somalia, while AUSSOM still supports Somali forces, protects strategic infrastructure and holds positions in areas contested by the militants. Funding crisis The mission is also facing a funding crisis. The United States agreed this month to give the United Nations another year to wind down logistical support for AUSSOM beginning in January 2027. However, Washington still intends to end its backing for the UN Support Office in Somalia, which supplies peacekeepers with food, fuel, medical services and transport. Uganda’s military chief, General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, said in August that all Ugandan troops would leave Somalia by August 1, 2027, although the Ugandan government has not publicly adopted his timetable as formal policy. “We are withdrawing completely from Somalia by the 1st of August 2027,” Kainerugaba said. “There will not be UPDF in Somalia after that.” Uganda’s defence minister had previously taken a different position, saying Kampala intended to remain in Somalia under its separate bilateral arrangement even if the structure of the AU mission changed. Lumbuye row The immediate public confrontation with Turkey has centred on Lumbuye, a Ugandan political commentator who has lived in Turkey for years and is wanted by Kampala over allegations including incitement and cyber-related offences. Hundreds of supporters of the Patriotic League of Uganda, a group chaired by Kainerugaba, demonstrated outside the Turkish embassy in Kampala on Friday demanding his extradition. Kainerugaba praised the demonstrators and warned that Turkey would have to meet Uganda’s demands. But Middle East Eye’s sources said the Lumbuye case was not the principal cause of the rupture, describing it instead as part of a wider disagreement over Uganda’s military interests in Somalia and Turkey’s expanding influence there. The dispute has therefore emerged at a sensitive moment for Somalia, as Mogadishu builds stronger national forces while the future size, financing and duration of the African Union mission remains unsettled. The post Somalia dispute drives Uganda-Turkey defence rupture: report appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somali journalists’ Facebook pages hit amid China, Türkiye partnerships
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – A coordinated wave of Facebook account suspensions, removals and false death reports struck Somali journalists and independent media outlets over the weekend of Sept. 12–13, according to the Somali Journalists Syndicate (SJS), landing within days of separate Chinese- and Turkish-backed “strategic communications” engagements with the Somali government in Mogadishu. SJS, an independent journalists’ union, said the attacks — which it has continued to track into a second wave reported Sept. 18 — included suspended pages, deleted content, fraudulent copyright claims and cases in which Meta, Facebook’s parent company, marked living journalists as deceased through its memorialization feature. Accounts suspended, journalists ‘memorialized’ Exiled journalist Zakariye Mohamud Timacadde said his Facebook page and personal profile, followed by more than 1 million people, were suspended around midnight on Sunday, Sept. 13, with no notification or explanation from Meta. The page had recently carried his reporting on forced evictions affecting hundreds of thousands of families in Mogadishu and on rising water prices charged by local companies in the capital. It remained unavailable as of the following Monday. Journalist Farah Abdulkadir Mohamed, who has more than 330,000 Facebook followers, told SJS his personal account was memorialized without warning — a feature Meta applies when a user is reported dead. Abdulkadir said he received hundreds of calls and messages from worried relatives after the change appeared, and that he had no way to reassure them because the same page still displayed the death notice. His account was restored the following day, again with no explanation. Gaylan Media, a diaspora-run outlet founded by Abdulkadir with more than 1.2 million Facebook followers and known for coverage of Somali security and political affairs, was removed from the platform the same weekend. A day earlier, on Saturday, Sept. 12, the page of London-based journalist Abdijaliil Osman — who hosts an interview program with roughly 191,000 followers — was also memorialized. “I actually do not have an idea who did this,” Osman told SJS. His page was later restored. Copyright claims used as a takedown tool SJS separately documented a pattern of fraudulent copyright complaints used to strip down critical reporting. Himilo Media, a Mogadishu outlet, said more than a dozen of its reports on local protests against Turkish military involvement in Somalia were hit with copyright claims in a single week; when the outlet disputed the claims, Meta rejected its appeals and the content came down regardless. Reviewing the claims, SJS found accounts filing them — operating under names including “The Odyssey” and “SACEM” — had no discernible online presence despite claiming to be content creators. Posing as a prospective client, an SJS investigator was told by the operator of “The Odyssey” that a fake copyright strike against a media organization would cost $5,000; the same person claimed to do “communication work for the Somali government,” SJS said. Kaab TV and SJS’s own press-freedom team reported similar copyright attacks the same week. Facebook pages tied to Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni and Jubaland’s presidency were also removed in the same period, according to SJS and a follow-up report by Garowe Online. The Turkey and China connection The attacks followed, by about a week, a Chinese-sponsored “Strategic Communications Forum” held in Mogadishu; SJS said sources told it that Chinese entities had separately invited Somali individuals to train and tour in China, including at a facility run by the Chinese Communist Party. On Sept. 12, Somalia’s Ministry of Information announced a Turkish-sponsored Strategic Communications Conference in Mogadishu and said Minister of Information Abdifatah Qasim Mohamud had met with Deniz Demir, coordinator of the Center for Combating Disinformation at the Turkish presidency’s communications directorate, to discuss “strengthening bilateral cooperation in the field of information,” according to a ministry statement on X. Five days earlier, on Sept. 7, Qasim had said publicly that Somalia’s actions against social media accounts carrying what he called terrorist propaganda had risen from 5,000 in 2012 to 82,000 in 2026 — a figure he did not break down or substantiate with an account list. That statement is not confirmed to relate directly to the weekend’s journalist-targeted incidents. Government denies censorship role, but questions remain A former Ministry of Information employee told SJS that journalists’ names and content had been forwarded to the ministry and the National Communications Authority. A former ministry official confirmed to SJS that the department maintains a working relationship with Meta, but said it has been used to help restore wrongly suspended accounts, not to censor media. SJS said there is no independently verified evidence establishing that Somalia’s federal government directed all of the incidents affecting politicians, journalists and media outlets, and Garowe Online separately reported that no evidence has surfaced showing the Turkish government itself removed accounts or filed copyright claims. Meta’s East Africa team did not respond to SJS’s request for comment. Not the first time Similar tactics surfaced in Somalia in late 2024, when local media organizations documented more than 32 Facebook accounts — including those of Puntland’s presidency, ministers and politicians — affected in comparable attacks, some involving fraudulent death documents submitted to trigger memorialization. The account of former Puntland President Abdirahman Mohamed Mohamud Farole, disabled at the time, has still not been restored, Garowe Online reported. Those 2024 cases were never publicly explained in full. Calls for accountability SJS Secretary-General Abdalle Ahmed Mumin said the organization was “extremely concerned” by what he described as a coordinated wave of online attacks, adding that such actions “directly undermine journalists’ ability to communicate with the public, report on issues of public interest and maintain contact with their audiences, families and communities.” SJS is calling on Meta to investigate the incidents, restore wrongly affected accounts and explain what happened, and on Minister Qasim to disclose the scope of the ministry’s partnerships with Chinese and Turkish entities and guarantee they are not used to intimidate journalists. Mumin said Somalia “should not follow in the footsteps of Turkey or China,” citing restrictions on independent media in both countries. The Ministry of Information has not issued a direct public response to SJS’s Sept. 14 findings as of this writing.

items.title: Muxuu Xasan Sheekh kusoo bandhigayaa shirka QM? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo haatan ku sugan dalka Mareykanka ayaa maanta ka qayb-galay furitaanka meertada 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, oo ka socota xarunta Qaramada Midoobay ee magaalada New York. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo hoggaaminayo wafdiga Soomaaliya ayaa madasha golaha guud ku soo bandhigaya horumarka Soomaaliya ka samaysay dhinacyada dowlad-dhiska, dimuqraadiyeynta, amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada. items.title: Midowga Yurub oo sheegay in howlgalka Badda Cas uu u baahan yahay in ka badan 10 markab dagaal
items.description: NEW YORK — 22 Sebtembar 2026: Madaxa siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Midowga Yurub, Kaja Kallas, ayaa sheegtay in howlgalka ciidamada badda ee Midowga Yurub ee Aspides uu u baahan yahay in la kordhiyo tirada maraakiibta dagaalka, iyadoo xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas ay sii xumaanayso. Kallas ayaa sheegtay in markii howlgalka la bilaabay 2024 loo qorsheeyay inuu u baahdo ugu yaraan 10 markab dagaal, balse hadda xaaladdu ay ka sii daran tahay. Sida ay sheegtay Reuters, waxaa xilligan goobta ka howlgala qiyaastii lix markab. Howlgalka Aspides waxaa Midowga Yurub bilaabay 2024, ujeeddadiisuna tahay ilaalinta maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara Badda Cas, kaddib weerarro ay Xuutiyiintu ku qaadeen maraakiibta. Kallas waxay sheegtay in howlgalka uu u baahan yahay maraakiib iyo diyaarado dheeraad ah, si looga jawaabo heerka khatarta ee sii kordhaya. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in weerarrada Xuutiyiintu ay saameynayaan danaha Yurub iyo dhaqaalaha caalamka, gaar ahaan silsiladaha sahayda iyo qiimaha shidaalka. Kallas ayaa 19-kii Sebtembar warqad u dirtay 27-ka dal ee xubnaha ka ah Midowga Yurub, iyadoo ka codsatay inay kordhiyaan taageerada iyo ciidamadooda ay ku biirinayaan howlgalka Aspides. Dhanka kale, Talyaaniga ayaa sheegay inuu diyaarinayo howlgal ciidan-badeed oo u gaar ah oo gobolka ah, isagoo sheegay inuusan sugi karin jawaabta Midowga Yurub xaaladda cusub awgeed. Kallas waxay sidoo kale xustay in horumarrada Xuutiyiintu ka sameeyeen xeebaha Badda Cas ay kordhiyeen awoodda ay ku carqaladeyn karaan maraakiibta ganacsiga, xilli xaaladda marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab iyo Strait of Hormuz ay horeyba u ahayd mid xasaasi ah.

items.title: Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud oo adkeeyay muhiimadda madaxbannaanida hay’adda
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya — Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in dhowrista madaxbannaanida Hay’adda Hantidhowrka Guud ay tahay mid ka mid ah mabaadi’da dastuuriga ah ee ay waajib tahay in dhammaan hay’adaha dowladda ay ilaaliyaan. Xafiiska ayaa xusay in madaxbannaanida Hantidhowrka Guud ay muhiim u tahay in Xafiisku si madax-bannaan ugu guto waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah, isla markaana uu si hufan u fuliyo shaqooyinka loo igmaday. Sida lagu sheegay qoraalka Xafiiska, waajibaadka iyo shaqooyinka Hantidhowrka Guud waxaa faahfaahinaya Sharciga Maareynta Maaliyadda Guud, Sharci Lr. 17 ee 2019, iyo Sharciga Hantidhowrka Guud, Sharci Lr. 14 ee 2023. Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ayaa ah hay’adda ugu sarreysa ee u xilsaaran hantidhowrista, diiwaangelinta iyo ilaalinta hantida guud iyo macaamilada maaliyadeed ee dowladda. Sidoo kale, wuxuu door ku leeyahay hubinta fulinta maareynta kheyradka guud iyo dhowrista shuruucda maaliyadda iyo miisaaniyadda dowladda. Qoraalka ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaya in, sida ku cad Qodobka 63aad (2) ee Xeer-nidaamiyaha Sharciga Nidaamka Xukuumadda, Xeer Lr. 174 ee 15/02/2025, guddiyada iyo xafiisyada madax-bannaan ee dastuuriga ah loo nidaamiyo si waafaqsan mabaadi’da dastuuriga ah iyo qodobbo kale oo khuseeya. Xafiiska ayaa intaas ku daray in Guddiga Qaranka ee Shaqaalaha Rayidka Dowladda uu si buuxda u dhowro madax-bannaanida dastuuriga ah ee Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud, isla markaana tallaabo kasta oo kasta oo ku saabsan magacaabista, ka qaadista ama go’aannada kale ee shaqaalaha Xafiiska loo maro habraacyada dastuurka iyo shuruucda dalka. Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in ilaalinta madaxbannaanidiisu ay muhiim u tahay gudashada waajibaadkiisa ku aaddan la xisaabtanka, daahfurnaanta iyo ilaalinta hantida guud.

items.title: Berbera port operating at 30% of capacity, DP World official says
items.description: Berbera (Somalia Today) — Berbera port is operating at about 30% of its current capacity despite hundreds of millions of dollars in investment aimed at turning it into a major gateway for Ethiopia and the wider Horn of Africa, according to a senior DP World official. Jama Mohamed Ahmed, DP World’s commercial director for the Horn of Africa, disclosed the figure in an interview with Middle East Eye , saying the port had yet to attract the level of Ethiopian trade anticipated when it was expanded. DP World has increased Berbera’s annual container-handling capacity to 500,000 twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs). The port can also handle about two million tonnes of general, bulk and break-bulk cargo a year. But Middle East Eye reported that the port was operating at roughly 30% of that capacity after plans to substantially increase Ethiopian traffic failed to materialise. The disclosure comes eight months after Somalia’s federal government annulled all agreements with the United Arab Emirates , including arrangements involving the ports of Berbera, Bosaso and Kismayo, as well as security and defence cooperation. Mogadishu said it made the January 12 decision in response to what it described as violations of Somalia’s sovereignty, national unity and political independence. Puntland, Jubaland and Somaliland rejected the federal decision and said their agreements with the UAE would remain in force. Ethiopian trade falls short DP World has promoted Berbera as an alternative maritime gateway for landlocked Ethiopia, which conducts most of its international trade through neighbouring Djibouti. Those ambitions received a potential boost in January 2024 when Ethiopia and Somaliland signed a memorandum of understanding over access to the coast. Somalia rejected the agreement as a violation of its sovereignty, triggering a diplomatic dispute with Ethiopia. Turkey later mediated talks between Mogadishu and Addis Ababa, culminating in the Ankara Declaration in December 2024. The Berbera port plans tied to increased Ethiopian trade have yet to materialise on the scale envisaged. Ahmed Abdi, a Mogadishu-based geopolitical analyst, told Somalia Today that the 30% utilisation figure reinforced long-held concerns about the UAE’s involvement in Berbera and Bosaso. “This confirms what we have believed for some time: that the reason the UAE illegally took control of the ports of Berbera and Bosaso was to suppress competition and protect Jebel Ali port,” Abdi said. “The plan has always been to provide the local administrations with limited funding and modest development, while preventing these ports from growing into serious competitors to Dubai in the long term.” The allegation that the UAE sought to suppress competition is Abdi’s assessment. DP World has instead presented its investments in Berbera as an effort to expand regional trade, improve infrastructure and provide Ethiopia and other Horn of Africa markets with another maritime gateway. Abdi said Somaliland and Puntland should reconsider their agreements with DP World, citing Eritrea and Djibouti, which previously ended their agreements with the Dubai-based port operator. ‘Major investment’ DP World took over management of Berbera under a long-term concession and has committed up to $442 million to the development and expansion of the port. The company said in 2021 that the first phase increased annual container capacity from 150,000 TEUs to 500,000. A planned second phase would extend the quay and raise annual capacity to as much as two million TEUs. DP World has also developed the Berbera Economic Zone and promoted a transport corridor linking the port with the Ethiopian border. In 2021, the company and Ethiopia’s transport ministry signed an agreement to explore development of the Ethiopian side of the corridor. DP World and its partners at the time envisaged up to $1 billion in logistics investment over 10 years, including dry ports, warehouses and container yards. Berbera continues to handle regional and international cargo despite its unused capacity. During Middle East Eye’s visit, Russian grain was being prepared for onward transport to Ethiopia and South Sudan, while containers arriving from China and destined for Egypt were being transferred between vessels. Workers were also unloading Indian sugar and Malaysian timber for the Somaliland market. Ahmed remained confident that traffic would eventually increase. “All the infrastructure is here. It’s only a matter of time,” he told Middle East Eye. The post Berbera port operating at 30% of capacity, DP World official says appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Odayaasha Beledxaawo oo digniin soo saaray kadib xaalad soo korortay + Video
items.description: Beledxaawo (Caasimada Online) – Iyadoo weli xaalad kacsanaan ah laga dareemayo degmada Beledxaawo ee gobolka Gedo ayaa waxaa maanta bayaan culus soo saaray odayaasha dhaqanka ee ku sugan degmadaasi, kaas oo ay kaga hadleen xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay, gaar ahaan colaadda Gedo. Odayaasha oo shir ku yeeshay Beledxaawo ayaa digniin kasoo saaray xiisadda ka taagan degmadaas, iyayga oo Dowladda Federaalka iyo Jubbaland ka codsaday inay culayska ka dul-qaadaan, ayna joojiyaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ka socda halkaasi, si looga hortago dagaal mar kale ka dhaca degmadaasi. Qaar kamid ah duubabka dhaqanka oo kulanka ka hadlay ayaa si gaar ah farriin ugu diray dowladda Soomaaliya, waxayna ka dalbadeen inay joojiso tallaab kasta oo horseedi karta isku dhac mar kale ka dhaca degmada Beledxawo. Waxaa kale oo ay ku baaqeen in arrimaha siyaasadda iyo maamulka ee dhaliyay khilaafka taagan lagu wajaho wada-hadal iyo deganaan. Sidoo kale, odayaasha dhaqanka ayaa shaaca ka qaaday inay qaadan doonaan doorkooda, isla markaana ay ka qayb-qaadanayaan sidii looga gaari lahaa xal waara, si nabad loogu soo dabaalo guud ahaan gobolka Gedo. “Dowladda haddii ay manfac leedahay waaa inuu ahaadaa nabadda ma rabno xabad nalagu laayo mar kale. Nama metalaan nimanka dhahaya is dila ee maalinba nin innoo soo diraayo waxaan leenahay colaadda aad noo soo xawileysaan naga daaya,” ayuu yiri mid kamid ah odyaasha deegaanka.
