items.title: What to know about USAID and the deadly impacts of US foreign aid cut
items.description: KATHMANDU, Nepal (AP) — The foreign aid landscape has changed dramatically since U.S. President Donald Trump’s administration dissolved the United States Agency for International Development, once the world’s largest humanitarian donor. Here’s a quick look at USAID, the impacts of its dissolution and what foreign aid looks like today: USAID’s roots and purpose U.S. President John F. Kennedy and Congress started USAID in the early 1960s. Beyond the belief that the U.S. has a moral obligation to help the world’s most desperate, supporters of USAID say the agency was a crucial tool of soft power diplomacy. Supporters say USAID directly benefited the country by engendering immense global goodwill toward the U.S., helping prevent the spread of diseases that could threaten American lives and providing stability in foreign countries that could otherwise pose a threat to U.S. security. The U.S. typically spent around 1% of its federal budget on U.S. foreign assistance A study published in The Lancet credited USAID programs with preventing 91 million deaths — including 30 million deaths of children under age 5 — in the first two decades of this century alone. Critics of the agency, including Trump, say it was wasteful and poorly run. US foreign aid cuts affect communities worldwide The U.S. foreign aid cuts have been devastating for millions of the world’s most vulnerable people. The Associated Press has documented widespread severe hunger , shortages of lifesaving medicine and spikes in child marriage, kidnapping and trafficking of children — consequences that are all linked to the funding cuts. Experts say the true impact won’t be measurable for years, because the repercussions of issues like malnutrition and untreated diseases take time to manifest. And the full extent of the damage may never be known, in part because the funding cuts eliminated the jobs of scores of front line workers who collected mortality data. Deaths linked to US foreign aid cuts Despite the U.S. government’s repeated insistence that no one has died as a result of its dissolution of USAID, the AP has documented deaths across the world linked to the funding cuts. In Nepal, the AP found that cuts to programs that ensured uneducated, impoverished pregnant women got proper nutrition and prenatal care have led to more babies and pregnant women dying. The AP also found that children in Myanmar , Nigeria and Somalia have died after cuts to food rations and nutrition programs. Because of global cuts to foreign aid, the Gates Foundation has predicted that 2025 will be the first year this century where child deaths will increase. US defends its decision In a statement to the AP, the U.S. State Department said the Trump administration had reinvigorated its assistance programs to focus on efficiency, effectiveness and partnership. The department also said the U.S. spends more on health and humanitarian assistance than any other country. “The rest of the world needs to contribute more and share the burden,” the department said. US foreign aid today The Trump administration’s new foreign aid strategy is more limited and is targeted toward initiatives that government officials say will further the United States’ interests. With health aid, for example, the U.S. is increasingly bypassing NGOs in favor of bilateral agreements with foreign countries . This means the money goes directly to foreign governments in exchange for concessions to the U.S., such as access to a country’s health data, which could be used to help detect outbreaks of infectious diseases. The U.S. says this model is more efficient. But some countries have pushed back , particularly over privacy concerns for their citizens’ medical records. Source: AP The post What to know about USAID and the deadly impacts of US foreign aid cut appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Egypt Declares Suez Canal Secure as August Revenue Surges to $567 Million
items.description: CAIRO- Egypt’s Suez Canal Authority (SCA) has declared the waterway safe, with maritime traffic flowing normally as August revenue rose 56.7 percent year-on-year to $567.1 million, up from $326 million in the same month of 2025. SCA Chairman Osama Rabie announced the figures during a ceremony in Alexandria marking World Maritime Day 2026, organized by the Maritime Transport Sector of the Ministry of Transport. The revenue increase represents a notable rebound for a canal that has endured significant disruptions in recent years. Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty previously said Red Sea tensions had cost Egypt roughly $11 billion in lost Suez Canal income. The latest numbers point to a recovery for one of the country’s most vital sources of foreign currency. The canal transited 1,358 vessels in August 2026, a 27 percent increase from 1,070 vessels in August 2025. Net tonnage rose 51.1 per cent to 68.3 million tonnes, up from 45.2 million tonnes a year earlier. Rabie emphasized that navigation remained stable and services continued at high efficiency. He added that canal pilots were carrying out their duties with the highest levels of readiness and professionalism. Despite the strong year-on-year gains, traffic has not returned to pre-disruption levels. Average canal transits stood at about 40.8 vessels per day between January and August 2026, compared with 73.7 per day in 2023. Canal revenue reached $4.67 billion in fiscal year 2025/2026, a 23 percent increase , though vessel transits and cargo tonnage remain below the canal’s peak performance. The Suez Canal remains a critical artery for global trade, linking the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea and offering the shortest maritime route between Asia and Europe.   The post Egypt Declares Suez Canal Secure as August Revenue Surges to $567 Million first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Maersk adds surcharge on Europe-Somalia container shipments
items.description: Mogadishu (Somalia Today) — Shipping giant Maersk will impose a new surcharge on containers shipped from Northern Europe and the Mediterranean to Somalia from October 7, raising freight costs for importers using the route. The Danish shipping group said it would introduce a Peak Season Surcharge (PSS) of $200 for a 20-foot dry container and $300 for 40-foot and 45-foot dry containers bound for Somalia and Tanzania. The charge will remain in place until further notice, according to a Maersk rate announcement published on Monday. It will apply to non-SPOT bookings, while shipments made through Maersk’s SPOT product will not be subject to the surcharge. The company said it would collect the fee according to each shipment’s freight payment terms and add it to other applicable charges. For an importer sending a standard 40-foot container from the affected European markets to Somalia, the measure means an additional $300 in freight costs under an eligible booking. Importers could absorb the extra expense or pass some of it further down the supply chain, depending on the type and volume of goods being shipped. What is a peak season surcharge? A Peak Season Surcharge is an additional fee that shipping companies add to their normal freight rates, typically when demand for cargo space increases or shipping capacity comes under pressure. Carriers can also introduce the charge when congestion or other operational constraints increase pressure on their networks. Despite its name, a peak season surcharge does not necessarily mean that imports into Somalia have suddenly risen sharply. It can reflect conditions across a wider shipping route or the carrier’s broader network. The surcharge is also not a Somali government tax, customs duty or port levy. It is a commercial shipping charge imposed by Maersk on top of its underlying freight rate. Maersk did not give a specific reason for introducing the new surcharge on shipments to Somalia and Tanzania, saying the measure was intended to allow it to continue providing its global services. Higher charge than Kenya Maersk has also announced a Peak Season Surcharge for shipments from Northern Europe and the Mediterranean to Kenya, effective on the same date. But the Kenyan rates are lower. The company will charge $150 for a 20-foot dry container bound for Kenya and $200 for a 40-foot or 45-foot container, compared with $200 and $300 respectively for Somalia and Tanzania, according to a separate Maersk notice . Maersk did not explain the difference in rates between the destinations. The latest measure follows another surcharge affecting Somalia in the opposite direction. From September 17, Maersk imposed a $500-per-container Peak Season Surcharge on cargo shipped from several East African countries, including Somalia, Kenya, Djibouti, Ethiopia and Tanzania, to Belgium, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland and Switzerland. In that case, the company cited prevailing market conditions and capacity constraints affecting trade into Northern Europe. Somalia relies heavily on imported goods, making international freight costs an important part of the price of bringing products into the country. The effect of the latest surcharge will vary depending on the value and volume of goods carried in each container. A $300 increase spread across a large shipment may add only a small amount to the cost of each item, although higher freight and logistics expenses can increase overall costs for importers. items.title: Nabadda Awdal iyo Selel Waa Mas’uuliyad Inaga Wada Saaran
items.description: Nabadda Awdal iyo Selel Waa Mas’uuliyad Inaga Wada Saaran Nabadda gobollada Awdal iyo Selel waa hanti qaali ah oo aynu dhammaanteen wada leenahay, waana waajib in si wadajir ah loo ilaaliyo. Nabadi jirto ayaa lagu wada noolaan karaa, lagu horumari karaa, laguna ilaalin karaa mustaqbalka jiilasha soo socda. Bulshada Awdal iyo Selel waa dad muddo dheer wada noolaa, is dhalay, is guursaday, is xiga, isla markaana wadaaga deegaan, dhaqan iyo nolol maalmeed. Waa bulsho ay walaaltinimadu ka weyn tahay wax kasta oo kala fogayn kara. Waxaan ugu baaqayaa dhammaan shacabka labada gobol in ay nabadda ilaashadaan, kana fogaadaan hadal ama ficil kasta oo keeni kara xurguf, colaad ama kala fogaansho. Khilaaf kasta waa in lagu dhammeeyaa wada-hadal, dulqaad, isu-tanaasul iyo is-ixtiraam. Waxaan sidoo kale si gaar ah ugu baaqayaa hoggaanka dhaqanka, cuqaasha, salaadiinta, culimada, waxgaradka, haweenka iyo dhalinyarada in ay hormuud ka noqdaan ilaalinta nabadda iyo dejinta bulshada. Hoggaanka dhaqanka ee labada dhinac waxaan ka codsanayaa in ay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan dowladda iyo hay’adaha nabadgelyada, si looga hortago wax kasta oo dhaawici kara xasilloonida iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada. Nabadda Awdal iyo Selel ma aha arrin cid gaar ahi leedahay. Waa mas’uuliyad inaga wada saaran. Waa inaynu ilaashannaa waxa ina mideeya, kana shaqaynaa in jiilasha dambe ay dhaxlaan bulsho nabad, walaaltinimo iyo wadajir ku nool. Walaalayaal, nabadda aynu ilaashanno. Nabadi waa nolol, horumar iyo mustaqbal. Mohamed Farah Tahar maantahar@gmail.com Aqoonyahan bartay Maamulka iyo Qorshaynta, ahna Caaqil ka mid ah Cuqaasha Somaliland.

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya oo Mareykanka kala hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, Sareeye Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji, ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay u-qaybsanaha difaaca Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya, Colonel Egan O’Reilly, iyagoo ka wada-hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan xaaladda dalka. Kulanka oo saacado badan qaatay ayaa waxaa si gaar ah diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, gaar ahaan dib-u-dhiska, tayeynta iyo horumarinta ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Sareeye Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji ayaa dowladda Mareykanka uga mahadceliyay taageerada ay marwalba la garab taagan yihiin ciidamada qalabka sida, gaar ahaan ciidanka cirka Soomaaliyeed oo haatan dib usoo kabasho sameynaya, maadaama ay heleen taageero gudaha iyo dibadda ah. Dhankiisa, Colonel Egan O’Reilly ayaa ballan qaaday in dowladdiisu ay sii wadi doonto taageerada, wuxuuna taliska ciidanka cirka uga mahadceliyay soo dhaweynta ballaaran ee manta loogu sameeyay magaalada Muqdisho. Mareykanka ayaa kamid ah dalalka waa wayn ee taageerada siiya Soomaaliya, iyadoo kulanka lagu soo qaaday doorkiisa ku aadan la dagaallanka Al-Shabaab. Waxaa kale oo uu Mareykanka tababaraa, isla markaana bixiyaa mushaharka ciidamada Danab ee Xoogga dalka Soomaaliya ee la dagaalama kooxda Al-Shabaab, lana rumeysan yahay inay yihiin ciidamada ugu waxtarka fiican kuwa Soomaaliya ay hadda leedahay. Si kastaba, kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada ay dowladda Soomaaliya ku xoojineyso taageerade caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan dhanka difaaca iyo milatariga, maadaama lagu xilli xasaasi ah, uuna weli socdo dagaalka Al-Shabaab. Mareykanka ayaa kamid ah dalalka waa wayn ee taageerada siiya Soomaaliya, iyadoo kulanka lagu soo qaaday doorkiisa ku aadan la dagaallanka Al-Shabaab. Waxaa kale oo uu Mareykanka tababaraa, isla markaana bixiyaa mushaharka ciidamada Danab ee Xoogga dalka Soomaaliya ee la dagaalama kooxda Al-Shabaab, lana rumeysan yahay inay yihiin ciidamada ugu waxtarka fiican kuwa Soomaaliya ay hadda leedahay. Si kastaba, kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada ay dowladda Soomaaliya ku xoojineyso taageerade caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan dhanka difaaca iyo milatariga, maadaama lagu xilli xasaasi ah, uuna weli socdo dagaalka Al-Shabaab. items.title: Uganda Suspends Military Cooperation With Turkey Amid Extradition Dispute
items.description: KAMPALA— Uganda has suspended all military and defense cooperation with Turkey amid a diplomatic dispute over the alleged refusal by Ankara to extradite Ugandan political commentator Fred Lumbuye, a prominent critic of President Yoweri Museveni. Uganda People’s Defence Forces (UPDF) spokesperson Chris Magezi announced the decision in a statement posted on X, saying the suspension would take effect immediately. “The Uganda People’s Defence Forces has, with immediate effect, suspended all defense and military cooperation with the Republic of Turkey,” Magezi said. The move follows growing tensions between Ugandan authorities and Turkish officials over Lumbuye, who is based in Turkey and has been sought by Ugandan authorities. According to Agence France-Presse (AFP), Lumbuye faces 15 criminal charges in Uganda, including allegations of inciting violence, spreading false information and misuse of a computer. He has been a vocal critic of the Ugandan government and President Museveni. Uganda’s army commander, Muhoozi Kainerugaba, the president’s son, has reportedly been involved in efforts to secure Lumbuye’s return to Uganda. AFP reported that Kainerugaba has repeatedly clashed with Turkish officials over the issue. The dispute has also triggered protests in Kampala. On Friday, thousands of Ugandans affiliated with the Uganda Patriotic League, a social and political pressure group linked to Kainerugaba, demonstrated outside the Turkish Embassy in the Ugandan capital, according to AFP. The suspension of military cooperation marks a significant escalation in tensions between Uganda and Turkey as the dispute over Lumbuye’s case continues. items.title: Maalinta Arbacada oo xarunta qaramada midoobay horteeda lagu soo bandhigaayo qadiyada Aqoonsiga Somaliland

items.title: Uganda and Turkey clash over military presence in Somalia
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Uganda’s decision to suspend all defence cooperation with Turkey is linked to the possible end of the African Union mission in Somalia, which could cost Kampala tens of millions of dollars in lost revenue, several sources familiar with the matter told Middle East Eye. The Uganda People’s Defence Forces (UPDF) announced on Saturday that it had suspended all defence and military cooperation with Ankara with immediate effect. Ugandan media had reported that the decision followed demonstrations outside the Turkish embassy in Kampala by supporters of the Patriotic League of Uganda (PLU), a group chaired by Uganda’s military chief, General Muhoozi Kainerugaba. The protesters had demanded the extradition from Turkey of Ugandan political commentator Fred Lumbuye, who has lived in the country since 2013. But sources told MEE that the dispute over Lumbuye was a pretext for a wider disagreement over Uganda’s military presence in Somalia and Turkey’s growing role in the country’s security sector. “Lumbuye has been living in Turkey since 2013 and this crisis has nothing to do with his presence, it is only a smoke screen,” said one of the sources familiar with the matter. “The whole episode is connected to Ugandan army’s presence in Somalia, which has close security ties with Ankara.” Uganda has roughly 4,500 troops in Somalia under the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (Aussom), the main international force supporting the Somali army, and a further 2,000 under a bilateral agreement, a military source told AFP. But the mission’s future was thrown into doubt after the US informed the African Union in July that it would end its payments to the UN Support Office in Somalia, which provides crucial logistical support to Aussom, by the end of the year. The development has raised questions over how the mission will be funded and whether countries such as Uganda will continue deploying troops. Sources told MEE that Somalia had asked Uganda to end its military deployment, citing the growing strength of Somali military brigades trained by Turkey. ‘Uganda could lose millions’ Ugandan forces were once crucial to protecting Somalia. In recent years, however, the Turkish military has trained nearly 25,000 Somali soldiers in Mogadishu and at least 10,000 additional commandos in Turkey. Sources familiar with the issue told MEE that Uganda receives at least $1,000 a month for each soldier deployed in Somalia. “Ending the mission could mean for Uganda to lose millions of dollars in a year,” a second source familiar with the matter told MEE. “Uganda is trying to pressure Turkey to find a solution to the crisis since it sees Ankara as the main stakeholder in Somali security issues.” The source estimated that Uganda could lose between $5m and $6m a month – or $60m to $72m a year – if the mission ends and Kampala withdraws all its forces. Tunc Demirtas, a researcher at the Ankara-based Seta think tank, said the growing capabilities of Somalia’s security forces meant the country was increasingly able to take responsibility for its own security. “Somalia’s government is now capable of providing its own security for its capital and surrounding regions and as its state capacity is built up, it requires less support from abroad,” Demirtas told MEE. “There is a war economy in Somalia and of course it was also contributing to Uganda.” The sources said that Ankara was seeking a solution to the dispute as it feared Turkish companies operating Uganda’s infrastructure and transport projects could be affected. The AFP news agency reported that Uganda could cancel a $3bn railway contract awarded to Turkish construction company Yapi Merkezi and expel Turkish nationals from the country. items.title: Maxaad ka ogtahay sababta ay dawlada Ugaandhi ay xidhiidhka ugu jartay Turkiga?
items.description: Ciidamada Uganda ayaa sheegay inay hakiyeen iskaashigii milateri ee kala dhexeeyay Turkiga, kadib markii la dalbaday in Ankara ay soo wareejiso qoraa siyaasadeed oo caan ah, kaas oo si adag u dhaliila Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni. “Ciidamada Difaaca Dadweynaha Uganda (UPDF) ayaa si degdeg ah u hakiyay dhammaan wixii iskaashi dhanka difaaca iyo milatariga ah ee kala dhexeeyay Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga,” ayuu yiri afhayeenka ciidamada Chris Magezi oo soo saaray bayaan uu ku daabacay bartiisa X. Sida ay tabisay wakaaladda wararka ee AFP, taliyaha ciidanka waddanka Uganda Muhoozi Kainerugaba, oo ah wiilka madaxweyne Museveni oo si weyn loogu arko inuu yahay ninka bedeli doona aabihiis, ayaa si isdaba joog ah waxay isugu dhaceen mas’uuliyiinta Turkiga waxaana uu salka ku hayay isku dhaco Uganda oo isku dayaysa in Fred Lumbuye oo nin dhaliila dowladda Uganda oo ku nool Turkiga loo soo gacan geliyo iyaga. Falanqeeyaha siyaasadda ayaa wajahaya 15 dacwadood oo dambi ah, oo ay ku jiraan kicin rabshado, faafinta macluumaad been abuur ah iyo si xun u isticmaalka kombiyuutarka. Jimcihii, kumanaan reer Uganda ah oo xiriir la leh Ururka Waddaniga ah ee Uganda, oo ah koox cadaadis bulsho iyo siyaasadeed oo xiriir la leh Muhoozi, ayaa dibadbax ka dhigay bannaanka safaaradda Turkiga ee caasimadda Kampala, sida ay tabisay AFP. Qoraal uu soo dhigay baraha bulshada, ayuu Kainerugaba ku yiri: “Waxaan u mahadcelinayaa dadweynaha wadaniyiinta ah ee PLU, kuwaas oo shalay dhigay bannaanbax ka dhacay Safaaradda Turkiga. Waxay caddeeyeen inay leeyihiin geesinimo. Turkidu waxay aqbali doonaan dhammaan dalabaadkayaga. Haddii ay sidaas yeeli waayaanna, ku noolaashaha Uganda waxay ku noqon doontaa mid aan suurtagal ahayn.” Waxa uu sidoo kale ku hanjabay in la xiri doono qof kasta oo u qareema Turkiga gudaha Uganda. “Tallaabadani waxay sii ahaan doontaa mid dhaqangal ah ilaa laga xallinayo arrimaha taagan ee ku saabsan difaaca wadajirka ah iyo iskaashiga milateri ee u dhexeeya labada dal,” ayuu raaciyay hadalkiisa afhayeenka ciidmada Uganda, Magezi, isagoon bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah. Sida ay daabacday wakaaladda wararka AP, Fred Lumbuye oo dhaliila xukuumadda talada haysa ee Uganda ayaa muddo sanado ah ku noolaa dalka Turkiga, balse xaaladdiisa sharci ee waddankaas ayaa ah mid aan caddayn. Qoraalladiisa ku saabsan siyaasadda Uganda ayaa waxaa daawada kumanaan qof, taas oo siinaysa madal iyo saameyn gaar ah oo aysan haysan dadka dalka gudihiisa ku dhaliila dowladda. Xidhiidhka Difaac ee ka dhaxeeyay labada dal Uganda iyo Turkiga waxay lahaayeen xiriir dhow oo difaaca muddo ku dhow toban sano. Bishii Juun 2016 waxay saxiixeen heshiis iskaashi oo ka dhexeeya warshadaha-difaaca, kaas oo lagu sii xijiyay heshiis kale oo tababar militari ah oo dhacay sannadkii 2022. Meelaha iskaashiga waxaa ka mid ah tababarka militariga, qalabka hubka iyo sahanka, is-waydarsiga tignoolajiyada iyo iskaashiga ka dhanka ah argagixisada iyo amniga. Militarigu ma bixin faahfaahin ku saabsan arrimaha taagan ee ka dambeeya joojinta, laakiin sida ay bahisay AFP waxay imaaneysaa arrintani kadib hanjabaado ah in Uganda ay joojinayso qandaraas lagu dhisayo tareen SGR ah oo ay ku baxayso $3 bilyan oo doolarka maraykanka ah ee kaa oo ay Uganda horay ula gashay shirkadda Turkiga ee Yapi Merkezi, iyo sidoo kale hanjabaad kale oo ah in muwaadiniinta Turkiga laga saarayo dalka Uganda. Warbaahinta Turkiga ayaa bishii Juun sheegtay in Muhoozi Kainerugaba uu joojiyay qandaraaska “isagoo xoojinaya falal iyo hadallo cadowtinimo ah oo lala beegsaday Türkiga”. Bbc somali

items.title: Maxaa ka cusub qaraxa lagu beegsaday taliyaha Baydhaba?
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada ammaanka magaalada Baydhabo ayaa gacanta ku dhigay dhowr qof oo looga shakisan yahay inay ku lug leeyihiin qarax xalay ka dhacay magaalada, sida ay sheegeen saraakiil amni. Dhacdadan ayaa dhacday xilli Taliyaha Saldhiga Booliska Baydhabo, Cali Aadan Maxamed (Cali Taageey) uu kasoo baxay gurigiisa, isagoo ku sii jeeday saldhig ciidan oo ku yaalla xaafadda Xero Jaad. Qaraxa ayaa la sheegay inuu ahaa miino dhulka lagu aasay oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday taliyaha, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanku ay markii dambe bilaabeen baaritaanno lagu raadinayo dadka ku lugta leh dhacdada. Saraakiil ka tirsan laamaha ammaanka oo ka gaabsaday in magacyadooda la shaaciyo ayaa sheegay in dadka la qabtay ay kamid yihiin shaqsiyaad lagu tuhunsan yahay inay wax ka og yihiin qaraxa. Mid kamid ah dadka gacanta lagu dhigay ayaa si gaar ah loogu xiriirinayaa qaraxa, sida ay saraakiishu sheegeen, kaddib baaritaanno ay ciidamada ammaanku sameeyeen. Baaritaanku weli wuu socdaa, waxaana saraakiisha ammaanku sheegeen in marka la soo gaba-gabeeyo ay faahfaahinta natiijada baaritaanka iyo sababta loo qabtay dadkaasi la wadaagi doonaan warbaahinta. Si kastaba, dowladda iyo laamaha ammaanka ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga hadlin khasaaraha qaraxa, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo natiijada baaritaanka socda iyo xogta rasmiga ah ee laga filayo inay kasoo baxdo dhacdada. items.title: Guddiga Miisaaniyadda oo dib-u-eegis ku bilaabay Hindise-sharciyeedka wax-ka-beddelka Sharciga Bankiga Dhexe
items.description: Muqdisho, 22 Sebtembar 2026 – Guddiga Miisaaniyadda, Maaliyadda, Qorsheynta, Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah iyo La-xisaabtanka Hay’adaha Dowladda ee Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa kulan wadatashi ah la yeeshay Wasiirka Maaliyadda XFS, Mudane Biixi Iimaan Cige, iyo Guddoomiyaha Bankiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya. Kulanka oo ka dhacay xarunta Guddoonka iyo Guddiyada ee Villa Hargeysa ayaa waxaa shir-guddoomiyey Guddoomiyaha Guddiga, Xildhibaan Cabdi Ibraahim Warsame (Qawdhan). Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray Hindise-sharciyeedka wax-ka-beddelka Sharciga Bankiga Dhexe ee Soomaaliya Lr. 130, iyadoo Guddigu uu Wasiirka Maaliyadda iyo Guddoomiyaha Bankiga Dhexe kala tashaday qodobbada wax-ka-beddelka lagu sameeyey iyo sababaha keenay in sharciga wax laga beddelo. Sidoo kale, waxaa laga hadlay qodobbada cusub ee hindise-sharciyeedka lagu soo kordhiyey iyo saameynta ay ku yeelan karaan siyaasadda lacagta, nidaamka bangiyada iyo dhaqaalaha guud ee dalka. Wasiirka Maaliyadda iyo Guddoomiyaha Bankiga Dhexe ayaa Guddiga faahfaahin ka siiyey ujeeddooyinka hindise-sharciyeedka, baahida loo qabo wax-ka-beddelka sharciga iyo qorshaha lagu hirgelinayo qodobbada cusub. Xubnaha Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale mas’uuliyiinta weydiiyey su’aalo la xiriira hindise-sharciyeedka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay is-weydaarsadeen aragtiyo ku saabsan qodobbada u baahan dib-u-eegis iyo faahfaahin dheeraad ah. Guddiga ayaa sheegay inuu sii wadi doono wadatashiyada, dib-u-eegista iyo falanqaynta hindise-sharciyeedka, si loo hubiyo in wax-ka-beddellada la soo jeediyey ay noqdaan kuwo dhammaystiran oo waafaqsan Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo shuruucda dalka. Marka dib-u-eegista hindise-sharciyeedka la soo gabagabeeyo, waxaa loo gudbin doonaa Akhrinta Labaad ee Golaha Shacabka, halkaas oo Xildhibaannadu ay ka dhiiban doonaan talooyinkooda, aragtiyahooda iyo wax-ku-darradooda ku aaddan sharciga. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah wadatashiyada Golaha Shacabka uu ka sameynayo hindise-sharciyeedka wax-ka-beddelka Sharciga Bankiga Dhexe.

items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo su’aalo ka weydiiyey Wasiirka Warfaafinta shaqada iyo qorshayaasha Wasaaradda
items.description: Muqdisho, 22 Sebtembar 2026 – Guddiga Warfaafinta, Wacyigelinta, Dhaqanka, Dalxiiska, Boostada iyo Isgaarsiinta ee Golaha Shacabka BJFS ayaa maanta kulan gaar ah la yeeshay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulfataax Qaasim Maxamuud oo ay wehliyeen Agaasimaha Guud iyo qaar kamid ah Agaasimayaasha Waaxyaha Wasaaradda. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Mudane Mowliid Cabdi Maxamuud ayaa shir guddomiyey kulanka, waxaana goobjoog ahaa Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Guddiga, Xoghayaha iyo xubnaha Guddiga, iyagoo Wasiirka iyo Agaasimayaasha Wasaaradda Warfaafinta ka dhageystay warbixin ku saabsan shaqada socota iyo caqabadaha jira. Masuuliyiinta Wasaaradda Warfaafinta oo Wasiir Cabdulfataax Qaasim uu hoggaaminayo ayaa ka jawaabay su’aalihii guddigu qabay, iyagoo soo bandhigay qorshe-hawleedka Wasaaradda, sharciyada iyo xeerarka ay diyaarinayso, qorshayaasha casriyeynta iyo ballaarinta Warbaahinta Qaranka iyo howlaha kale ee mudnaanta u leh Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska XFS. Sidoo kale, Wasiir Cabdulfataax Qaasim oo Guddiga siiyey warbixin dhammaystiran oo ku saabsan howlaha Wasaaradda iyo qorshayaasheeda ayaa Guddiga Warfaafinta, Wacyigelinta, Dhaqanka, Dalxiiska, Boostada iyo Isgaarsiinta ee Golaha Shacabka uga mahadceliyey wada-shaqeynta wanaagsan ee kala dhexeysa Wasaaradda.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan oo ka wada hadlay horumarinta Ciidanka Cirka
items.description: Muqdisho, 22 Sebteembar 2026: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa magaalada Muqdisho kulan kula yeeshay wafdi ka socday Dowladda Pakistan oo uu hoggaaminayay Taliyaha Difaaca Cirka, ahna Taliye Ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan, Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, gaar ahaan dhismaha iyo horumarinta Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, tayaynta awooddiisa iyo kobcinta tababarrada ciidanka. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa uga mahadceliyey wafdiga Pakistan booqashada ay ku yimaadeen Soomaaliya, isagoo tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal. Waxa uu sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay dadaal xooggan ku bixinayso dhismaha, tababarka, tayaynta iyo qalabaynta Ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo door muhiim ah ka qaadanaya howlgalada dalka looga ciribtirayo Khawaarijta. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, gaar ahaan horumarinta awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed iyo tayaynta guud ee hay’adaha amniga iyo difaaca dalka.

items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo dalbaday in la kordhiyo goobaha laga qaato Aqoonsiga NIRA
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – 22 Sebtembar 2026: Guddiga Arrimaha Gudaha, Maamulada Gobollada iyo Amniga ee Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta kulan la yeeshay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta, Cali Yuusuf Cali (Cali Xoosh) iyo Maareeyaha Hay’adda Aqoonsiga iyo Diiwaangelinta Qaranka (NIRA), Cabdiwali Cali Cabdulle. Kulanka oo uu shir guddoominayay kusimaha Guddoomiyaha Guddiga, ahna Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Guddiga, Xildhibaan Nuur Axmed Diiriye (Nuur Afey), ayaa Wasiirka iyo Maareeyaha NIRA looga dhageystay warbixinno ku saabsan shaqada, waajibaadka iyo xaaladda guud ee Hay’adda NIRA. Guddiga ayaa si gaar ah diiradda u saaray adeegyada aqoonsiga iyo diiwaangelinta muwaadiniinta, iyadoo xubnaha Guddigu ay su’aalo ka weydiiyeen howlaha Hay’adda, caqabadaha horyaalla, adeegyada ay bulshada siiso iyo qorshayaasha horumarinta. Sidoo kale, kulanka ayaa looga hadlay iskaashiga u dhexeeya Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Hay’adda NIRA, iyo sidii loo sii horumarin lahaa adeegyada aqoonsiga ee dalka. Gebagebadii, Guddiga ayaa maamulka NIRA kula dardaarmay in la kordhiyo goobaha diiwaangelinta iyo adeegyada aqoonsiga, si muwaadiniintu si fudud ugu helaan adeegyada Hay’adda. Guddigu wuxuu sidoo kale ku boorriyay Hay’adda in la kordhiyo saacadaha shaqada, si loo fududeeyo helitaanka adeegyada aqoonsiga iyo diiwaangelinta muwaadiniinta.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ku baaqday iskaashi caalami ah oo lagu xoojinayo badbaadada carruurta
items.description: New York, Mareykanka — 22 Sebteembar 2026: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, ayaa magaalada New York kaga qeyb-gashay kulan heer sare ah oo diiradda lagu saaray ilaalinta carruurta iyo sidii loo dhisi lahaa nidaamyo digital ah oo ammaan u ah carruurta. Kulanka oo cinwaankiisu ahaa “The Invisible Architecture: Building Safe Digital Systems for Children – Advancing International Standards and Shared Responsibility” ayaa ka dhacay inta lagu guda jiro Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNGA81), waxaana martigelisay Marwada Koowaad ee Jamhuuriyadda Türkiye, Emine Erdoğan. Kulanka ayaa xoogga lagu saaray khataraha cusub ee carruurta kala kulmi karaan deegaanka digital-ka, iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sameeyo nidaamyo iyo siyaasado ilaaliya xuquuqda, badqabka iyo fayo-qabka carruurta. Wasiir Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi ayaa kulanka ka muujisay sida Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay ilaalinta carruurta iyo ka hortagga tacaddiyada, dhiigmiirashada iyo xadgudubyada, iyadoo si gaar ah loo eegayo khataraha ka dhalan kara isticmaalka tiknoolajiyadda iyo baraha digital-ka. Waxay sidoo kale adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay in xuquuqda iyo badbaadada carruurta lagu saleeyo siyaasadaha iyo nidaamyada digital-ka, si carruurtu uga faa’iideystaan fursadaha tiknoolajiyadda iyadoo laga ilaalinayo khataraha ka iman kara. Wasiiraddu waxay carrabka ku adkaysay baahida loo qabo iskaashi caalami ah iyo masuuliyad wadaag, si loo hubiyo in nidaamyada digital-ka loo qaabeeyo hab mudnaanta siinaya badbaadada, xuquuqda iyo fayo-qabka carruurta. Ka qeybgalka Soomaaliya ee kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee xoojinta ilaalinta xuquuqda carruurta iyo ka qeybqaadashada dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu horumarinayo badqabka carruurta ee deegaanka digital-ka.

Waxay sidoo kale adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay in xuquuqda iyo badbaadada carruurta lagu saleeyo siyaasadaha iyo nidaamyada digital-ka, si carruurtu uga faa’iideystaan fursadaha tiknoolajiyadda iyadoo laga ilaalinayo khataraha ka iman kara. Wasiiraddu waxay carrabka ku adkaysay baahida loo qabo iskaashi caalami ah iyo masuuliyad wadaag, si loo hubiyo in nidaamyada digital-ka loo qaabeeyo hab mudnaanta siinaya badbaadada, xuquuqda iyo fayo-qabka carruurta. Ka qeybgalka Soomaaliya ee kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee xoojinta ilaalinta xuquuqda carruurta iyo ka qeybqaadashada dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu horumarinayo badqabka carruurta ee deegaanka digital-ka.

items.title: Muqdisho oo lagu daah-furay Bandhigga Caalamiga ah ee Wax-soo-saarka iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho, Sebteembar 22, 2026 — Magaalada Muqdisho waxaa maanta ka furmay Bandhigga Caalamiga ah ee Wax-soo-saarka, Warshadaha iyo Habaynta Soomaaliya (SOMIPEX), oo loogu talagalay in lagu soo bandhigo wax-soo-saarka gudaha dalka, isla markaana lagu mideeyo warshadleyda, ganacsatada iyo maalgashadayaasha. Bandhiggan ayaa fursad u siinaya shirkadaha iyo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed inay bulshada iyo suuqa caalamka tusaan waxyaabaha gudaha dalka lagu soo saaro, kuwa la farsameeyo iyo awoodda warshadaha Soomaaliya. SOMIPEX ayaa sidoo kale diiradda saaraya sidii loo dhiirrigelin lahaa wax-soo-saarka gudaha, maalgelinta warshadaha iyo abuurista suuqyo cusub oo ay gaaraan badeecooyinka lagu soo saaro Soomaaliya. Munaasabadda waxaa lagu daah-furayaa hannaanka “Made in Somalia — Lagu Sameeyey Soomaaliya”, kaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu aqoonsado laguna dhiirrigeliyo badeecooyinka gudaha lagu sameeyo. Bandhigga ayaa la filayaa inuu noqdo madal ay isugu yimaadaan ganacsatada, warshadleyda, maalgashadayaasha iyo daneeyayaasha kale, si looga wada hadlo fursadaha jira iyo horumarinta wax-soo-saarka iyo warshadaha dalka.

items.title: Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed iyo Madaxa WFP Soomaaliya oo ka wada hadlay dardargelinta gargaarka Koonfur Galbeed
items.description: Baydhabo, 22 Sebtembar 2026: Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa Xarunta Madaxtooyada Baydhabo ku qaabilay Madaxa Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Cunnada Adduunka (WFP) ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Hameed Nuru. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed iyo WFP, gaar ahaan xaaladda bani’aadantinimo ee ka jirta deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed iyo baahiyaha dadka nugul. Labada dhinac ayaa si gaar ah uga wada hadlay fududeynta iyo dardargelinta howlaha diyaaradaha WFP ee qaada raashiinka iyo agabka kale ee gargaarka, si loogu gurmado bulshada ay saameeyeen xaaladaha bani’aadantinimo iyo cimilada. Hoggaamiye Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in hay’adaha gargaarka ay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan Dowladda, si gargaarku si habsami leh, ammaan ah oo hufan u gaaro dadka loogu talagalay. Sidoo kale, Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed ayaa WFP uga mahadceliyay taageerada ay siiso shacabka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan bulshada ku nool deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed ee u baahan gurmadka bani’aadantinimo. Kulanka ayaa lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, WFP iyo hay’adaha kale ee bani’aadantinimada, si loo kordhiyo waxtarka gargaarka loona gaarsiiyo dadka ugu baahida badan.

items.title: Kiiska dilka Cabdinaasir Dahable oo dib usoo laba-kacleeyay iyo Somaliland oo…
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Qaraar ku saabsan sidii cadaalad loogu heli lahaa Cabdinaasir Muuse Cabdiraxmaan Dahable oo ka tirsanaa Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliya, ayaa la horgeeyay Golaha Wakiillada Somaliland. Dahable ayaa meydkiisa laga helay gurigii uu ka deggenaa magaalada Muqdisho bishii Febraayo 2024. Marxuumka oo 32 jir ahaa ayaa ka soo jeeday degmada Gebiley ee galbeedka Somaliland. Booliska Soomaaliya ayaa xilligaas sheegay in meydkiisa laga helay degmada Wadajir, iyagoo sidoo kale shaaciyay in lix qof loo qabtay kiiska, isla markaana baaritaan uu socday. Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka 2-aad ee Golaha Wakiillada Somaliland, Cali Xaamud Jibriil, oo Golaha ka hor akhriyey qaraarkan, ayaa sheegay “in golaha uu waajib dastuuri ah u arko ilaalinta iyo difaaca muwaadiniinta Somaliland.” Waxyaabaha qaraarka lagu muujiyay waxaa kamid ah walaac laga qabo dilka Dahable, iyadoo qaraarka lagu sheegay in marxuumka loo beegsaday sababo la xiriira inuu kasoo jeeday Somaliland. Sidoo kale, Golaha ayaa mas’uuliyadda dilka dusha u saaray Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyagoo si gaar ah ugu eedeeyay mas’uuliyiin sare, oo ay kamid yihiin Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, Taliyaha NISA iyo Maareeyaha Hay’adda Duulista inay ku lug lahaayeen dhacdada. Qaraarkan ayaa sidoo kale dalbanaya in kiiska lagu sameeyo baaritaan madax-bannaan oo lagu xaqiijinayo cidda ka dambaysay dilka, iyadoo dadka lagu helo inay ku lug lahaayeen loo horkeeno caddaaladda. Qaraarka ayaa sidoo kale xusay in hay’adaha xuquuqda aadanaha Somaliland ay qaadi karaan tallaabooyin sharci ah, oo ay kamid tahay in kiiska loo gudbiyo maxkamadaha caalamiga ah. Waxa kale oo uu beesha caalamka ugu baaqay inay gacan ka geysato sidii loo heli lahaa baaritaan madax-bannaan iyo hannaan cadaaladeed oo lagu xaqiijinayo xaqiiqada kiiska Dahable. Dhacdada ayaa timid xilli uu jiray muran xooggan oo u dhexeeyay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo maamulka Somaliland oo la xiriiray maamulka hawada. Meydka Cabdinaasir Dahable ayaa markii dambe laga qaaday Muqdisho, waxaana loo qaaday Somaliland, halkaas oo lagu aasay. Si kastaba, si qaraarkan uu u noqdo mid dhaqan-gala, waxaa loo baahan yahay in Golaha Wakiillada Somaliland uu ansixiyo. The post Kiiska dilka Cabdinaasir Dahable oo dib usoo laba-kacleeyay iyo Somaliland oo… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Danyar ku nool Hargaysa oo ka soo kaban waayay burbur ku yimid ganacsiyadooda
items.description: (ERGO) –  Rooda Xasan Aw Axmed waxay cunno ku filan u la’dahay qoyskeeda toban ah. Waxaa kow bishan ka xirantay meherad ganacsi oo ay ku iibin jirtay khudaar iyo cunnooyin bisil oo waddani ah. Waxaa meesha ka baxday lacag u dhaxaysa afar ilaa lix doollar oo ay maalinle uga heli jirtay shaqadeeda, taas oo ay ku maaraynaysay baahiyaha aasaasiga ah ee reerka.   Xaaladdan ayay galeen markii waddo bannayn ay hormuud u ahayd Dawladda Hoose ee Hargeysa ay saamaysay ganacsigeeda iyo 69 kale. Rooda ayaa sheegtay inaan la siin dhul kale. Waxaa u dheer inaysan awoodin inay meel kiraysato. Haweeneydan oo uu qoysku keligeed ku tiirsanaa weli ka quusan la’ halkii ay ku ganacsanaysay oo ay shaqo ka wadaan gawaarida wax dhisaya iyo shaqaale. “Wallaahi cagaftii baa naga qaaday. Meheradihii way naga dumeen alaabtii waataas oo way isku dul rasaysan tahay. Dee imika iyo haatanna waadigaa arkaya xaaladdii halkay marayso. Wax taakulayn ah maanaan, waxba noomay ballanqaadin dawladdu.” Burburka ku yimid ganacsigeeda wuxuu ku soo beegmay xilli qoyskeeda ay horay ula halgamayeen duruufo is-biirsaday. Rooda ayaa sheegtay in wiilkeeda 26 jir ah kaas oo iyadana oo aan oggayn ka tahriibay uu lix bilood Liibiya ugu yahay magafe. Xaaladdiisa ayay tilmaamtay inay ka sii darayso marba marka ka danbaysa. Waxaa soo waca kooxaha haysta iyaga oo jirdilaya si ay degdeg ugu bixiso lacag madax-furasho ah oo ay sii dayntiisa ku xireen, taas oo aysan awoodin bixinteeda. Ehelkeeda ayay xustay inay yihiin danyar aan caawin karin. Waxaa intaas u wehelisa saygeeda oo sariir-yaal ah. Lix bil ka hor ayay sheegtay inuu ku soo booday cudurka qallalka sida xaqiijisay dhaqtar markii danbe loo geeyay oo baaray. Rooda ayaa tilmaamtay in xaaladahan oo feker ku hayay ay u raacday in halkii il ee daqli ay waayeen, taas oo ku kordhisay  culeysyadii nolosha ee haystay iyada iyo qoyskeeda. “Waliba sidaasuu aniga inan yari iga tahriibay, odaygii iga bukaayoo askari buu ahaayoo uu igaga dhacay faalig dee saasay xaaladayadu maraysaa. Kun Shillin oo lacaga loo hayn maxaad u malayn xaaladiisa. Dee ilaahay uun baa gargaari kara.” Rooda waxay xustay in dhaqaalaha ay ka heli jireen ganacsigan uu si wanaagsan ugu filnaa daboolidda baahiyaha nolol maalmeedka qoyskeeda. Hase yeeshee, tan iyo markii ganacsigeedii joogsaday, xaaladooda nololeed ayaa hoos dhacday maaddaama ay dabka ku shidan jireen waxa maalinlaha u soo gala. Qoyskeeda oo in badan 20 sano barakac ku ahaa magaalada Hargeysa ayay sheegtay inay hadda wajahayaan xaaladdii ugu adkayd. Filashadeeda ayaa ahayd inay ganacsigan kaga baxdo xerada balse hadda waxay joogtaa quus. Dhamaan qoysaska ay ganacsiyadooda saamaysay waddo bixinta ayaa ka siman duruufaha dhaqaale ee ka dhashay. Yusur Muxumed Buuni, oo 94 jir ah ayaa sheegtay in qoyskeeda oo ka kooban sagaal qof ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd maqaaxi yar oo ay shaaha ku karin jireen, balse hadda meesha ka baxday. Haweeneydan ayaa tilmaamtay inaysan jirin cid kale oo u shaqaysa reerka. Noloshooda ayaa ku tiirsanayd shan doollar oo ay maalinle u helaysay, taas oo ka caawin jirtay daboolidda baahiyaha oo ay cunnadu ugu horreyso, kuwaas oo hadda ku soo wada furmay. “Ma shaqaysano maqaaxidaa yar baanu ku meermeeraa waanu ka helaynoo maalintii waxaanu ka helaynay intaan aqalka dhan la fujin een la dumin konton kun oo Somaliland Shilling ah oo wuu na deeqayoo wuu nagu filaa. Imikana waa iska joognaa uun Baraka alle. Wax hagaagsan kama helo samir uun baanu ku noolahay wallaahi.” Yusur ayaa sheegtay inuu u joogto wiil ay dhashay oo dhimir-ka jirran muddo saddex sano ah, kaas oo u baahan daryeel dheeraad ah. Waxay tilmaamtay inay dawooyin iyo wixii kale ee uu u baahdo ay uga gadaysay faa’iida ganacsigeeda balse hadda ay gacan maran tahay. Waxaa culeyska ku sii kordhinaya jirradiisa iyo masuuliyadda qoyska oo saaran iyada oo da’daas ah. Wiilkeeda labaad oo dhismaha ka shaqayn jiray ayaa ka kabi jiray nolosha balse hadda wax shaqo ah ma hayo sabab la xiriirta inuu waayay cid hawl u dirsata shaqooyinka magaalada oo yaraaday darteed. Qoysaska waddo bixintu ay saamaysay ayaa isugu jira kuwo wada waayay meelihii ay ku ganacsanayeen markii ay jidka ka mid noqdeen, halka kuwo kale ay u hareen meelo ciriiri ah oo aan ku filnayn. Dawladda Hoose ayaa ka gaabsatay bixinta macmuulaad ku saabsan saamaynta ka dhalatay waddo samaynta iyo inay qorsho kale u hayso dadkan. Cabdirisaaq Cabdillaahi Ismaaciil, oo ah xoghayaha Guddoomiyaha xerada State House, ayaa tilmaamay in arrintay ay keentay saamayn dhaqaale oo muuqata. Wuxuu sheegay inay dadkii waayeen meel kale oo ay si bilaash ah ugu ganacsan karaan. “Shaqadii baa istaagtay dadkiina intan yar buu ku noolaayee meesha ka soo baxaysaa. Dhaqaale la’aan badan bay saamaysay waddo furistaasu. Markaa wallaahi dhaqaale darro faro badan bay keentay.” Cabdirisaaq ayaa xusay in markii la dumiyay ganacsiyadan yaryar, ay qoysaskii ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd ay la kulmeen xaalad dhaqaale oo aad u adag. Wuxuu sheegay in qaar badan oo ka mid ah qoysaskaasi ay maanta ku adag tahay in ay helaan nolol-maalmeedkooda aasaasiga ah. “Wallaahi dab imika maba shitaanba. Meheradiina marka laga dumiyay, carruurtiina halkan u taagan tahay, iskuulkii u taagan yahay ee biyihii u taagan yihiin waad garan karaysaa qof meheradiina ka xidhan tay. Baahida iyo dhaqaale la’aanta annaga aad bay noo saamaysaa.” Burburka ganacsiyada qoysaskan oo deggan xerada State House waxay keentay inay dabooli kari waayaan baahiyahooda lagama maarmaanka ah. Waxay u baahan yihiin in loo raadiyo xal u fududeeya inay ka soo kabtaan dhaqaale burburka ka dhacay ee saameeyay iyaga iyo nolosha iyo waxbarashada carruurtooda. Dee ilaahay uun baa gargaari kara.” Rooda waxay xustay in dhaqaalaha ay ka heli jireen ganacsigan uu si wanaagsan ugu filnaa daboolidda baahiyaha nolol maalmeedka qoyskeeda. Hase yeeshee, tan iyo markii ganacsigeedii joogsaday, xaaladooda nololeed ayaa hoos dhacday maaddaama ay dabka ku shidan jireen waxa maalinlaha u soo gala. Qoyskeeda oo in badan 20 sano barakac ku ahaa magaalada Hargeysa ayay sheegtay inay hadda wajahayaan xaaladdii ugu adkayd. Filashadeeda ayaa ahayd inay ganacsigan kaga baxdo xerada balse hadda waxay joogtaa quus. Dhamaan qoysaska ay ganacsiyadooda saamaysay waddo bixinta ayaa ka siman duruufaha dhaqaale ee ka dhashay. Yusur Muxumed Buuni, oo 94 jir ah ayaa sheegtay in qoyskeeda oo ka kooban sagaal qof ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd maqaaxi yar oo ay shaaha ku karin jireen, balse hadda meesha ka baxday. Haweeneydan ayaa tilmaamtay inaysan jirin cid kale oo u shaqaysa reerka. Noloshooda ayaa ku tiirsanayd shan doollar oo ay maalinle u helaysay, taas oo ka caawin jirtay daboolidda baahiyaha oo ay cunnadu ugu horreyso, kuwaas oo hadda ku soo wada furmay. “Ma shaqaysano maqaaxidaa yar baanu ku meermeeraa waanu ka helaynoo maalintii waxaanu ka helaynay intaan aqalka dhan la fujin een la dumin konton kun oo Somaliland Shilling ah oo wuu na deeqayoo wuu nagu filaa. Imikana waa iska joognaa uun Baraka alle. Wax hagaagsan kama helo samir uun baanu ku noolahay wallaahi.” Yusur ayaa sheegtay inuu u joogto wiil ay dhashay oo dhimir-ka jirran muddo saddex sano ah, kaas oo u baahan daryeel dheeraad ah. Waxay tilmaamtay inay dawooyin iyo wixii kale ee uu u baahdo ay uga gadaysay faa’iida ganacsigeeda balse hadda ay gacan maran tahay. Waxaa culeyska ku sii kordhinaya jirradiisa iyo masuuliyadda qoyska oo saaran iyada oo da’daas ah. Wiilkeeda labaad oo dhismaha ka shaqayn jiray ayaa ka kabi jiray nolosha balse hadda wax shaqo ah ma hayo sabab la xiriirta inuu waayay cid hawl u dirsata shaqooyinka magaalada oo yaraaday darteed. Qoysaska waddo bixintu ay saamaysay ayaa isugu jira kuwo wada waayay meelihii ay ku ganacsanayeen markii ay jidka ka mid noqdeen, halka kuwo kale ay u hareen meelo ciriiri ah oo aan ku filnayn. Dawladda Hoose ayaa ka gaabsatay bixinta macmuulaad ku saabsan saamaynta ka dhalatay waddo samaynta iyo inay qorsho kale u hayso dadkan. Cabdirisaaq Cabdillaahi Ismaaciil, oo ah xoghayaha Guddoomiyaha xerada State House, ayaa tilmaamay in arrintay ay keentay saamayn dhaqaale oo muuqata. Wuxuu sheegay inay dadkii waayeen meel kale oo ay si bilaash ah ugu ganacsan karaan. “Shaqadii baa istaagtay dadkiina intan yar buu ku noolaayee meesha ka soo baxaysaa. Dhaqaale la’aan badan bay saamaysay waddo furistaasu. Markaa wallaahi dhaqaale darro faro badan bay keentay.” Cabdirisaaq ayaa xusay in markii la dumiyay ganacsiyadan yaryar, ay qoysaskii ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd ay la kulmeen xaalad dhaqaale oo aad u adag. Wuxuu sheegay in qaar badan oo ka mid ah qoysaskaasi ay maanta ku adag tahay in ay helaan nolol-maalmeedkooda aasaasiga ah. “Wallaahi dab imika maba shitaanba. Meheradiina marka laga dumiyay, carruurtiina halkan u taagan tahay, iskuulkii u taagan yahay ee biyihii u taagan yihiin waad garan karaysaa qof meheradiina ka xidhan tay. Baahida iyo dhaqaale la’aanta annaga aad bay noo saamaysaa.” Burburka ganacsiyada qoysaskan oo deggan xerada State House waxay keentay inay dabooli kari waayaan baahiyahooda lagama maarmaanka ah. Waxay u baahan yihiin in loo raadiyo xal u fududeeya inay ka soo kabtaan dhaqaale burburka ka dhacay ee saameeyay iyaga iyo nolosha iyo waxbarashada carruurtooda. items.title: Khilaafka Uganda iyo Turkey oo salka ku haya Soomaaliya iyo arrin ay go’aansatay DF
items.description: Kampala (Caasimada Online) – Soomaaliya ayaa la sheegay inay xudun u noqotay khilaafka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya Uganda iyo Turkiga, kadib markii Kampala ay hakisay dhammaan iskaashigii militari iyo difaac ee Ankara, xilli ay soo baxayaan warar sheegaya in muranku si weyn ugu saabsan yahay mustaqbalka ciidamada Uganda ee jooga Soomaaliya. Warbaahinta Middle East Eye ayaa Isniintii werisay in muranka labada dal uusan ku koobneyn oo keliya dalabka Uganda ee ku saabsan in Turkiga uu u gacan geliyo Fred Lumbuye, oo ah nin mucaarad ku ah dowladda Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni, balse uu salka ku hayo khilaaf ballaaran oo ku saabsan joogitaanka ciidamada Uganda ee Soomaaliya. Ilo xog-ogaal ah oo warbaahintu soo xigatay ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay doonayso in Uganda ay soo afjarto joogitaankeeda militari, iyadoo awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliya ay sii kordheyso, gaar ahaan kuwa uu tababaray ama taageeray Turkiga. “Arrintan oo dhan waxay la xiriirtaa joogitaanka ciidamada Uganda ee Soomaaliya,” ayuu mid ka mid ah ilahaasi u sheegay Middle East Eye . Dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Uganda midkoodna si rasmi ah uma xaqiijin in Muqdisho ay Kampala ka dalbatay inay ciidamadeeda kala baxdo dalka. Uganda ayaa Soomaaliya ku leh kumannaan askari oo ka tirsan howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, iyadoo ciidamo kale ay dalka ku joogaan heshiis laba geesood ah oo ay la gashay dowladda Soomaaliya. Middle East Eye ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Uganda ay sanadkii waayi karto malaayiin dollar haddii ciidamadeeda laga saaro Soomaaliya. Ilo ay warbaahintu soo xigatay ayaa qiyaasay khasaaraha dhaqaale inuu u dhaxeyn karo $60 milyan iyo $72 milyan sanadkii . Hase yeeshee, tirooyinkaas si rasmi ah uma aysan xaqiijin dowladaha Uganda iyo Soomaaliya ama Midowga Afrika. Uganda waxay kamid ahayd dalalkii ugu horreeyay ee ciidamo u soo dira Soomaaliya sanadkii 2007, waxaana muddo ku dhow labaatan sano ciidamadeedu door weyn ku lahaayeen howlgalka Midowga Afrika iyo dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab. Doorka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya Dhanka kale, Turkiga ayaa sanadihii dambe si weyn u xoojiyay kaalintiisa difaaca iyo amniga Soomaaliya. Ankara waxay Muqdisho ku leedahay xarunta tababarka ciidamada ee TURKSOM, waxaana halkaas lagu tababaray kumannaan askari oo Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ku jiraan ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Gorgor. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale Soomaaliya ka taageera tababarka, qalabeynta ciidamada iyo dhinacyada kale ee difaaca, halka diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Turkiga ay door sii kordhaya ku yeesheen howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Iskaashigaas ayaa weli sii xoogeysanaya. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Axaddii Muqdisho kula kulmay wafdi saraakiil Turki ah oo uu hoggaaminayay taliyaha xarunta TURKSOM, Major General Sabahattin Kalkan. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa sheegtay in kulanka looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca, tababarka iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Fiqi ayaa sidoo kale Turkiga uga mahadceliyay taageerada joogtada ah ee dib-u-dhiska ciidamada Soomaaliya. Kororka awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo kaalinta Turkiga ayaa, sida ay sheegtay Middle East Eye , kamid noqday qodobbada keenay khilaafka Kampala iyo Ankara, iyadoo Uganda muddo dheer ku tiirsaneyd joogitaankeeda Soomaaliya dhinaca siyaasadda, amniga iyo dhaqaalahaba. Soomaaliya ma isku filan tahay? Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay muddooyinkii dambe xoogga saareysay in ciidanka qaranku si tartiib ah ula wareego mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka, inkastoo wali ay jiraan walaacyo la xiriira awoodda Al-Shabaab iyo maalgelinta howlgalka Midowga Afrika. Xuseen Cabdirisaaq, oo ah falanqeeye fadhigiisu yahay Muqdisho, ayaa horey Somalia Today ugu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay hadda uga diyaarsan tahay sidii hore hoos-u-dhac tartiib ah oo ku yimaada taageerada ciidamada shisheeye. “Waxaan u maleynayaa waxa dowladda Soomaaliya diidan tahay inay tahay bixitaan degdeg ah,” ayuu yiri Cabdirisaaq. “Soomaaliya hadda inta badan way isku filnaan kartaa, ciidamadeeduna aad ayay uga xoog badan yihiin sidii hore.” Waxa uu sheegay in awoodda cirka ee dowladda, gaar ahaan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Turkiga, ay wax weyn ka beddeleen dagaalka. “Dowladdu hadda waxay leedahay awood cirka ah iyo diyaaradaha Turkiga ee drones-ka, taasina wax weyn ayay ka beddeshay dagaalka,” ayuu yiri. Si kastaba, AUSSOM wali waxay door muhiim ah ka ciyaartaa sugidda goobaha istaraatiijiga ah, taageerada ciidamada dowladda iyo dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab, iyadoo mustaqbalka maalgelinta howlgalka uu wali yahay arrin aan xal buuxa loo helin. Uganda oo hakisay xiriirka militari Ciidamada Uganda ee UPDF ayaa Sabtidii ku dhawaaqay inay si degdeg ah u hakiyeen dhammaan iskaashigii difaac iyo militari ee Turkiga. Afhayeenka ciidanka Uganda, Colonel Chris Magezi, ayaa sheegay in go’aankaasi sii jiri doono ilaa laga xalliyo “arrimaha taagan ee iskaashiga difaaca iyo militariga” ee labada dal, balse si rasmi ah uma uusan sheegin Soomaaliya. Khilaafka ayaa yimid xilli taliyaha ciidamada Uganda General Muhoozi Kainerugaba uu horey u muujiyay walaac la xiriira doorka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya. Kainerugaba ayaa bishii August sheegay in ciidamada Uganda ay gebi ahaanba Soomaaliya ka bixi doonaan 1-da August 2027, inkastoo dowladda Uganda aysan jadwalkaas si rasmi ah u ansixin inuu yahay siyaasaddeeda kama dambaysta ah. Dusha sare, khilaafka Uganda iyo Turkiga ayaa maalmahan la xiriiray Fred Lumbuye, oo ah nin Uganda u dhashay oo dowladda Museveni si weyn u dhaliila kana nool Turkiga. Kampala ayaa doonaysa in Ankara ay u gacan geliso Lumbuye, oo wajahaya eedeymo ay kamid yihiin kicin rabshado iyo dambiyo la xiriira internet-ka. Taageerayaasha Patriotic League of Uganda, oo uu hoggaamiyo Muhoozi Kainerugaba, ayaa Jimcihii dibadbax ka hor dhigay safaaradda Turkiga ee Kampala, iyagoo dalbanayay in Lumbuye loo gacan geliyo Uganda. Si kastaba, ilaha ay soo xigatay Middle East Eye ayaa sheegay in kiiska Lumbuye uusan ahayn sababta ugu weyn ee khilaafka, balse uu qeyb ka yahay muran ka ballaaran oo ku saabsan Soomaaliya, joogitaanka ciidamada Uganda iyo doorka sii kordhaya ee Turkiga. Haddii xogtaasi sax noqoto, khilaafka Kampala iyo Ankara wuxuu kusoo aadayaa xilli xasaasi ah oo Soomaaliya ay dooneyso inay kordhiso awoodda ciidamadeeda, isla markaana ay dib u qiimeyn ku socoto mustaqbalka ciidamada shisheeye iyo howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee dalka. The post Khilaafka Uganda iyo Turkey oo salka ku haya Soomaaliya iyo arrin ay go’aansatay DF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo WHO oo xoojinaya u diyaar-garowga caafimaad ee khataraha El Niño
items.description: Soomaaliya iyo Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka ee WHO ayaa xoojinaya iskaashiga iyo qorsheyaasha diyaar-garowga caafimaad, iyadoo dalka laga cabsi qabo inay xilliyada roobabka soo socda kordhaan saameynta cimilada daran ee la xiriirta xaaladaha El Niño. Arrintan ayaa lagu soo qaaday kulan dhexmaray Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Kenya, Jibriil Ibraahim Cabdulle , iyo Wakiilka WHO ee Soomaaliya, Dr. Humphrey Karamagi , oo ka dhacay safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Nairobi. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sidii loo xoojin lahaa hay’adaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, loo horumarin lahaa isku-duwidda hay’adaha kala duwan iyo kor loogu qaadi lahaa awoodda shaqaalaha caafimaadka, si bulshada loogu hubiyo adeegyo caafimaad oo la isku halayn karo xilliyada ay dhacaan xaaladaha degdegga ah ee ka dhasha isbeddelka cimilada. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay si gaar ah uga wada hadleen khataraha ka dhalan kara haddii xaaladaha El Niño ay sii xoogaystaan, iyagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sameeyo qorsheyn hore iyo digniin hore , halkii laga sugi lahaa in musiibo dhacdo kadibna wax laga qabto. Roobabka culus iyo fatahaadaha ayaa culays dheeraad ah saari kara nidaamka caafimaadka Soomaaliya, maadaama ay carqaladeyn karaan gaadiidka iyo helitaanka xarumaha caafimaadka, dhaawici karaan kaabeyaasha caafimaadka, isla markaana kordhin karaan khatarta cudurrada ka dhasha biyaha iyo cudurro kale. ilaalinta adeegyada caafimaad ee aasaasiga ah ayaa loo arkaa qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qorshayaasha guud ee u-diyaargarowga musiibooyinka, gaar ahaan deegaannada ay horay u saameeyeen xaaladaha bani’aadannimo. Safiir Jibriil Ibraahim Cabdulle ayaa soo dhaweeyay taageerada joogtada ah ee WHO ay siiso Soomaaliya, isaga oo uga mahadceliyay hay’adda taageerada ay ka geysanayso horumarinta waaxda caafimaadka iyo hirgelinta mudnaanta caafimaad ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo WHO ayaa sidoo kale looga gol leeyahay in hay’adaha dowladda iyo bah-wadaagta horumarinta ay yeeshaan isku-duwid wanaagsan marka ay dhacaan xaalado degdeg ah oo la xiriira cimilada. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli dalal badan oo ku yaalla Geeska Afrika ay kordhinayaan diyaar-garowga ay ugu jiraan fatahaado, abaaro iyo xaalado kale oo ka dhasha isbeddelka cimilada, iyadoo digniinaha hore iyo qorsheynta degdegga ah loo adeegsanayo in lagu yareeyo saameynta ay musiibooyinku ku yeeshaan bulshada.

Arrintan ayaa lagu soo qaaday kulan dhexmaray Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Kenya, Jibriil Ibraahim Cabdulle , iyo Wakiilka WHO ee Soomaaliya, Dr. Humphrey Karamagi , oo ka dhacay safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Nairobi. Labada mataanaha ah ayaa la sheegay inay muddo ku noolaayeen Sweden, halka hooyadood iyo qaar ka mid ah walaalahood ay weli ku nool yihiin dalkaas. Go’aanka masaafurinta ayaa walaac ku abuuray qoyska, iyadoo qaraabadu ay ka cabsi qabaan in kala-tegidda qoyska ay saameyn ku yeelato labada dhalinyarada ah. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli Sweden ay si adag u waddo siyaasadaha la xiriira socdaalka iyo dadka aan haysan sharci rasmi ah oo ay dalka ku joogaan. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan oo xoojinaya iskaashiga difaaca iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Cirka
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa qaabilay wafdi sare oo ka socda Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan, kaas oo uu hoggaaminayay Taliyaha Difaaca Cirka ahna Taliye Ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan, Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz. Kulanka waxaa qeyb ka ahaa Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji, waxaana looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, iyadoo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray dib-u-dhiska iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay muhiimadda tababarka ciidamada, horumarinta aqoonta iyo xirfadaha saraakiisha Soomaaliyeed, iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya si uu uga qeyb qaato waajibaadka difaaca qaranka. Booqashada wafdiga Pakistan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiriirka iyo iskaashiga amni ee labada dal. Waxay sidoo kale daba socotaa booqasho uu Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi 4-tii Agoosto 2026 ku tagay Pakistan, markaas oo Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan ay kala saxiixdeen Heshiis Is-afgarad (MoU) oo ku saabsan iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa xusay muhiimadda xiriirka saaxiibtinimo ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, isaga oo adkeeyay in iskaashiga labada dal uu si gaar ah uga qeyb qaato mudnaanta Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan dhismaha, tayeynta iyo xoojinta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed . Kulankan ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya dadaallada Soomaaliya ay waddo ee lagu horumarinayo awoodda ciidamadeeda, iyadoo iskaashiga dalalka saaxiibka ah looga faa’iideysanayo tababar, khibrad iyo dhisidda awoodaha hay’adaha amniga iyo difaaca.

items.title: Sabab uusan Maraykanku u Aqoosanayn Soomaalillaan
items.description: Istiifan A. Kuug dhowaan qormadii uu cinwaanka uga dhigay, ‘Sabab uu Marakaynku u Aqoonsado Somalillaan’, waxa uu ku dooday qodobbada ugu mudan ee loo aqoonsayo in ay tahay arrin cuskan Juquraafisiyaasadeed. Taasina waxay door ka qaadanaysaa, “kahortagga Ilaalada Kacaanka Iiraan, iyo Xuutiyiinta, sidoo kale waxay xoojinaysaa madaxbannaanida gaadiidka badda, (isla markaasna dhanka Hormus, Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Suweys).” Qodobba badan oo togan ayuu qoraalkiisa ku xusay, sidaas oo ay tahayba weli dhibaatooyin waa ay ka jiraan Soomaallillaan. Hubaashii wuxuu ka walaacsanaa, “inay qabiillada qaarkood ka biyadiidsan yihiin dawladda, gaar ahaan Bariga, iyaga oo Hargeysa, caasimadda Soomaalillaan ka doorbida inay xidhiidh la yeeshaan Muqdisho. Taasina waxay saadaal u noqon kartaa colaado qabiil oo lagu hoobto. Waa arrin walaaceeda leh. Haddaba, warka bishaarada ahi, waa in Madaxweynaha Soomaalillaan ee Cirro sheegay in uu ‘wadahadal nabadeed’ ku dabbaali doono.” Tani gebi ahaanba waa fahandarro, ama si kas ah ayuu isu diidsiinayaa xaqiiqooyinkaas qallafsan ee hortiisa yaalla. Diidmada ay qabiillada Barigu ka qabaan Soomaalillaan waa mid soojireen ah oo muddo soo taxnayd. Soomaalillaanna weligeed si dhab ah gacanta uma ay wada dhigin soohdimaha Bariga, marka laga reebo muddadii 2007 ilaa 2022 oo ay Laascaanood joogtay. Kacdoon hubaysan ayaa ku kacay horraantii 2009, xoogagga qabiillada Bariga ayaana 2023 soo jebiyay ciidanka Soomaalillaan. Tan iyo markaasna waxaa halkaas laga aasaasay maamulgoboleed ay Muqdisho aqoonsatay oo xaruntiisu tahay Laascaanood. Ogos, 2026, waxaa booqasho ku yimid Ra’iisalwasaaraha Soomaaliya, arrimihii imaatinkiisu daarnaana waxaa ku jiray sidii halkaas looga dhisi lahaa saldhig uu leeyahay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalku. Middaasi waxay tusinaysaa cadaadisyada dibedda ee baritaaraya aqoonsiga Soomaalillaan in ay dhab ahaantii keenayn oo qudha loollan qabiil, balse ay colaad guud hurin karaan. Taasina waa mid ka gudaballaadhan ‘wadahadallo nabadeed’, iyada oo ay sharciyadda maamulka Cirro ku eg tahay Oog oo ah magaalo ay deggen yihiin qabiilka Isaaq, oo 85 KM Laascaanood galbeed ka xigta. Si guud, Isaaqu waxay taageersan yihiin Goosashada Soomaalillaan, balse qolyaha Dhulbahante iyo Warsangeli midnimada Soomaaliya ayay ayidsan yihiin. Istiifan A. Kuug oo hadalkiisa sii wata: “haddii aan xitaa taas ku talagalno (murannada ka aloosan Bariga Soomalillaan), misana Soomaalillaan waa ay ka geddisan tahay Soomaaliya laf ahaanteeda oo iyadu tobannaan sano hoy u ahayd argagixisada, budhcadbadeedda, iyo kooxaha xagjirka ah ee Geeska Afrika.” Haddaba, waxad is weydiisaa, maxay Soomaaliya sidaas oo dhan ugu liidataa? Waxaad dhugataa faragelintii uu Maraykanku Soomaaliya ku hayay, laga soo bilaabo,ololihii ‘Rejo Soocelinta’ ee 1992 oo la fashiliyay 1994; waxa soo galay Itoobiyaanka Diiseember, 2006 oo gulufkooda la huwiyay ladagaallanka argagixisada, Maraykankuna si xooggan ayuu u taageeray. Faragelintaasi waxay sii shiidaalisay suuqii colaadda ee Soomaaliya. Qayb ka mid ah qabqablayaashii ayaa loo dallacsiiyey ‘Saamiley’ (iyo mushaxarrixiin u taagan jagada Madaxweyne), kuwa kalana waxa lagu tilmaamay sharwadayaal. Markii ay isku dayeen ciidammada Marakaynku inay soo xiraan Jeneraal Maxamed Faarax Caydiid, waddooyinka Muqdisho ayaa lagu weeraray. Dhacdadii ‘Black Hawk Down’ waxay ku soo dhammaatay in 18 askari oo Maraykan ah oo la dilo, qaarkoodna dhaawacooda la jarjaro oo carrada la jiidjiido, waxayna muddo soo afjartay hawlgallada Maraykanka ee dibedda. Sidaas darteed, Washington waxay u geddisatay fargelin dadbadan, iyada oo maalgelisay qabqablayaasha, dhiirreglisayna gaboodfalladii ay Itoobiya ka geysatay Soomaaliya. Gaar ahaan kadib weerarradiu 9/11, Soomaaliya waxay ahayd, (iyada oo ay jirto warbixinno sirdoon oo Maraykan ah oo sheegaya inay taasi ahayd xogo la marinhabaabiyay) meel loo tixgeliyo inay ku kobcaan Argagixidasa Islaamdoonka ahi. Washington waxay taageertay faragelintii qaawanayd ee Itoobiyaanka ee soo bilaabatay Diiseembar 2006, oo Muqdisho iyo deegaannada u dhaw ku laysay kumannaan qof oo dad shacab ahi ku jiraan; xasuuqaasina waxa uu sabab u noqday in Soomaalida Geeska oo dhani, Somaalillaanna ka mid tahay, u aragto inay Alshabaab u taagan tahay difaaca umadda Soomaaliyeed. Ilaa iyo dhammaadkii 2006, Alshabaab waxay haysatey wax ka yar boqollaal askari oo heegan ah. Badhtamihii 2007, tiradii waxaa ku kordhey kumannaan, halka ay dhallinyaro badan Hargeysa iyo meelo kale oo Soomaalillaan ah uga yimaaddeen in ay si iskood ah u Muqdisha uga difaacaan Itoobiyaanka (sidoo kale Yugaandhiiska iyo Burundigii soo galay kadib Feebarweri 2007, iyaga oo qayb ka ahaa Hawgalka Ururka Afrika, muddo kale ayay dhibaatada ku sii ragaadiyeen). Ladagaallanka argagixsadu waxa uu Soomaaliya ku ragaadiyay argagixisanimada, waxayna gacan ka geysatay inay Alshabaab kobocdo.  Lifaaqan ka eeg doodda oo faahfaahsan. Haddaba si kooban, waxaad isbarbardhigtaa wixii ka dhashay faragelintii faraha badnayd ee Soomaaliya, iyo natiijada ay yeelatay faragelin-la’aantii Ruwaanda markii uu gumaadku ka dhacay bartamihii 1994. Qaramada Midoobay iyo Marakaynku si ulakac ah ayay indhaha uga qarsadeen, waxayna diideen inay si cad u sheegaan waxa halkaa ka socda, iyada oo laba ogaa waxa jira, taas oo ahayd in gumaad ka socdo, isla markaaana hore loo saadaalin karayay inay dhici karto. Waxay ahayd dhacdo uurkutaallo leh oo galaafatay 800,000 oo qof, haddii aysanba ka badnayn. Hayeeshee, dhacdadaa kadib, waxaa la dhihi karaa farogelin la’aantu waxay u suurtagelisay Jabhadda Waddaniga Ruwaanda, ciidanka Bool Kigaame, inay gumaadka joojiyaan oo yagleelaan Ruwaanda cusub oo xasilloon. Haa, waxay u badan tahay in Jabhadda Waddaniga Ruwaanda lafteeduba laysay boqollaal qof oo fiigo ah oo Huutsi ah. Sidoo kale Ruwaanda waxay noqotay talis macangag ah oo xuquuqda aadanuhu baylah ku dhex tahay; gaar ahaan xubnaha mucaaradka ah. Waxaana la mid ah Yugaandha, Itoobiya, ama xitaa Israa’iil. Kuwan danbe waa saaxiibbo ay Washington ku kalsoonsan tahay. Runta aan sheegno; xuquuqda aadamuhu mudnaan ma laha marka ay timaaddo dan siyaasadeed. Casharku wuxuu ku urursan yahay: faragelintii Soomaaliya waxay horseedday colaado iyo xasillooni la’aaan. Balse in laga maagay faragelintii Ruwaanda oo xilligaa gumaad ka socday, marka dib loo milicsadaba waxay tusinaysaa inay taasi door weyn ku lahayd, colaado lagu riiqmay dabadeed inay Ruwaanda noqotay dal xasilloon oo taabbagal ah. Sida uu qabo Istiifan A. Kuug ee ah inay Soomaaliya tahay “isha argagixsada, budhcadbadeedda, iyo xagjirka,” waa hadal qummanayn, waxayna marinhabaabinaysaa doodda, sida uu qabo Roonal Maarjan, ugu danbaynna waxay tilmaan u tahay dood huwan hullaab gumayste, iyada oo Soomaalida loo dhigayo inay ‘awoodi la’ yihiin’ inay dawlad samaystaan. Tan iyo 1991, qalalaasaha Soomaaliya ka taagan (iyo xitaa siddeetamaadkiii, Dagaalkii Qaboobaa dhexdiisa), waxa Soomaaliya ka aloosan, waxa kaalin weyn ka geystay Maraykanka iyo xulufadiisa Geeska Afrika. Haddaba, aan dib ugu laabanno Soomaalillaan: faragelin kasta oo lagu aqoonsanayo Soomalillaan si ka soohorjeedda doonista Soomaaliya iyo Soomaalida badan ee gobolka (kuna jiraan qabiillada Bariga Soomalilaan, kuwaas oo maanta ah Waqooyibari Soomaaliya) waxay u badantahay inay qaaraan ku darsan doonto xasilloonidarrada ay abuurtay faragelintii shisheeye; waxaana laga yaabaa inay dagaal ka huriso jasiirad-la-moodda dhulweynaha Soomaaliyeed. WQ: Markus V. Hoehne Turjumiddii: Cabdifataax Faanto

Waxaad dhugataa faragelintii uu Maraykanku Soomaaliya ku hayay, laga soo bilaabo,ololihii ‘Rejo Soocelinta’ ee 1992 oo la fashiliyay 1994; waxa soo galay Itoobiyaanka Diiseember, 2006 oo gulufkooda la huwiyay ladagaallanka argagixisada, Maraykankuna si xooggan ayuu u taageeray. Faragelintaasi waxay sii shiidaalisay suuqii colaadda ee Soomaaliya. Qayb ka mid ah qabqablayaashii ayaa loo dallacsiiyey ‘Saamiley’ (iyo mushaxarrixiin u taagan jagada Madaxweyne), kuwa kalana waxa lagu tilmaamay sharwadayaal. Markii ay isku dayeen ciidammada Marakaynku inay soo xiraan Jeneraal Maxamed Faarax Caydiid, waddooyinka Muqdisho ayaa lagu weeraray. Dhacdadii ‘Black Hawk Down’ waxay ku soo dhammaatay in 18 askari oo Maraykan ah oo la dilo, qaarkoodna dhaawacooda la jarjaro oo carrada la jiidjiido, waxayna muddo soo afjartay hawlgallada Maraykanka ee dibedda. Sidaas darteed, Washington waxay u geddisatay fargelin dadbadan, iyada oo maalgelisay qabqablayaasha, dhiirreglisayna gaboodfalladii ay Itoobiya ka geysatay Soomaaliya. Gaar ahaan kadib weerarradiu 9/11, Soomaaliya waxay ahayd, (iyada oo ay jirto warbixinno sirdoon oo Maraykan ah oo sheegaya inay taasi ahayd xogo la marinhabaabiyay) meel loo tixgeliyo inay ku kobcaan Argagixidasa Islaamdoonka ahi. Washington waxay taageertay faragelintii qaawanayd ee Itoobiyaanka ee soo bilaabatay Diiseembar 2006, oo Muqdisho iyo deegaannada u dhaw ku laysay kumannaan qof oo dad shacab ahi ku jiraan; xasuuqaasina waxa uu sabab u noqday in Soomaalida Geeska oo dhani, Somaalillaanna ka mid tahay, u aragto inay Alshabaab u taagan tahay difaaca umadda Soomaaliyeed. Ilaa iyo dhammaadkii 2006, Alshabaab waxay haysatey wax ka yar boqollaal askari oo heegan ah. Badhtamihii 2007, tiradii waxaa ku kordhey kumannaan, halka ay dhallinyaro badan Hargeysa iyo meelo kale oo Soomaalillaan ah uga yimaaddeen in ay si iskood ah u Muqdisha uga difaacaan Itoobiyaanka (sidoo kale Yugaandhiiska iyo Burundigii soo galay kadib Feebarweri 2007, iyaga oo qayb ka ahaa Hawgalka Ururka Afrika, muddo kale ayay dhibaatada ku sii ragaadiyeen). Ladagaallanka argagixsadu waxa uu Soomaaliya ku ragaadiyay argagixisanimada, waxayna gacan ka geysatay inay Alshabaab kobocdo.  Lifaaqan ka eeg doodda oo faahfaahsan. Haddaba si kooban, waxaad isbarbardhigtaa wixii ka dhashay faragelintii faraha badnayd ee Soomaaliya, iyo natiijada ay yeelatay faragelin-la’aantii Ruwaanda markii uu gumaadku ka dhacay bartamihii 1994. Qaramada Midoobay iyo Marakaynku si ulakac ah ayay indhaha uga qarsadeen, waxayna diideen inay si cad u sheegaan waxa halkaa ka socda, iyada oo laba ogaa waxa jira, taas oo ahayd in gumaad ka socdo, isla markaaana hore loo saadaalin karayay inay dhici karto. Waxay ahayd dhacdo uurkutaallo leh oo galaafatay 800,000 oo qof, haddii aysanba ka badnayn. Hayeeshee, dhacdadaa kadib, waxaa la dhihi karaa farogelin la’aantu waxay u suurtagelisay Jabhadda Waddaniga Ruwaanda, ciidanka Bool Kigaame, inay gumaadka joojiyaan oo yagleelaan Ruwaanda cusub oo xasilloon. Haa, waxay u badan tahay in Jabhadda Waddaniga Ruwaanda lafteeduba laysay boqollaal qof oo fiigo ah oo Huutsi ah. Sidoo kale Ruwaanda waxay noqotay talis macangag ah oo xuquuqda aadanuhu baylah ku dhex tahay; gaar ahaan xubnaha mucaaradka ah. Waxaana la mid ah Yugaandha, Itoobiya, ama xitaa Israa’iil. Kuwan danbe waa saaxiibbo ay Washington ku kalsoonsan tahay. Runta aan sheegno; xuquuqda aadamuhu mudnaan ma laha marka ay timaaddo dan siyaasadeed. Casharku wuxuu ku urursan yahay: faragelintii Soomaaliya waxay horseedday colaado iyo xasillooni la’aaan. Balse in laga maagay faragelintii Ruwaanda oo xilligaa gumaad ka socday, marka dib loo milicsadaba waxay tusinaysaa inay taasi door weyn ku lahayd, colaado lagu riiqmay dabadeed inay Ruwaanda noqotay dal xasilloon oo taabbagal ah. Sida uu qabo Istiifan A. Kuug ee ah inay Soomaaliya tahay “isha argagixsada, budhcadbadeedda, iyo xagjirka,” waa hadal qummanayn, waxayna marinhabaabinaysaa doodda, sida uu qabo Roonal Maarjan, ugu danbaynna waxay tilmaan u tahay dood huwan hullaab gumayste, iyada oo Soomaalida loo dhigayo inay ‘awoodi la’ yihiin’ inay dawlad samaystaan. Tan iyo 1991, qalalaasaha Soomaaliya ka taagan (iyo xitaa siddeetamaadkiii, Dagaalkii Qaboobaa dhexdiisa), waxa Soomaaliya ka aloosan, waxa kaalin weyn ka geystay Maraykanka iyo xulufadiisa Geeska Afrika. Haddaba, aan dib ugu laabanno Soomaalillaan: faragelin kasta oo lagu aqoonsanayo Soomalillaan si ka soohorjeedda doonista Soomaaliya iyo Soomaalida badan ee gobolka (kuna jiraan qabiillada Bariga Soomalilaan, kuwaas oo maanta ah Waqooyibari Soomaaliya) waxay u badantahay inay qaaraan ku darsan doonto xasilloonidarrada ay abuurtay faragelintii shisheeye; waxaana laga yaabaa inay dagaal ka huriso jasiirad-la-moodda dhulweynaha Soomaaliyeed. items.title: DF oo dhisaysa ciidan awood badan iyo qorshe culus oo socda
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa dardar-gelisay qorshaha lagu dhisayo ciidamo cusub oo u badan dhallinyaro, kuwaas oo lagu tababarayo xeryaha ciidamada, iyadoo dowladda ay doonayso inay si buuxda ula wareegto mas’uuliyadda amniga guud ee dalka. Qorshahan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dowladda Soomaaliya ay horey Midowga Afrika uga heshay ballanqaad ku saabsan in mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka si buuxda loogu wareejiyo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana laga maarmi doono ciidanka Afrikaanka ah ee ku howlgala howlgalka AUSSOM. Si loo xoojiyo awoodda ciidamada, dowladda ayaa taageero dhinaca qalabka iyo agabka ciidan ka raadinaysa dowladaha saaxiibka la ah Soomaaliya, iyadoo qaar kamid ah dalalkaasi ay horey u sameeyeen ballanqaadyo, halka kuwo kalena laga sugayo inay fuliyaan taageeradii ay ballanqaadeen. Hadafka dowladda ayaa ah in Soomaaliya ay yeelato ciidan leh awood dhul, cir iyo bad, kuwaas oo sidoo kale heli kara qalab casri ah oo ay adeegsadaan ciidamada dalalka horumaray. Tababarrada ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale lagu wadaa in lagu sii xoojiyo gudaha dalka, iyadoo dhallinyaro cusub la qorayo lana geynayo xeryaha ciidamada si ay u qaataan tababarro ciidan oo dheeraad ah. Turkiga ayaa kamid ah dalalka sida weyn u taageera dhismaha ciidamada Soomaaliya, iyadoo dowladda Ankara ay si gaar ah diiradda u saartay tababarka iyo qalabaynta ciidamada, kuwaas oo tababarro ku qaata gudaha Soomaaliya iyo dibadda. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale weli sugaysa taageero iyo fulinta ballanqaadyo ay horey u sameeyeen dalal kale oo saaxiib la ah Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo qayb ka noqon kara qorshaha lagu dhisayo ciidamo Soomaaliyeed oo awood u leh inay si buuxda ula wareegaan amniga dalka. Xilli dhismaha ciidamada qalabka sida uu socdo ayaa xeryaha ciidamada lagu diyaarinayaa goobihii lagu tababari lahaa dhallinyarada cusub, iyadoo dowladda ay waddo qorshe ay ku doonayso in ciidamadan ay mustaqbalka qaadaan mas’uuliyadda amniga guud ee Soomaaliya. items.description: New York ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa gaaray magaalada New York ee dalka Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu kaga qeybgalayo kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu kulamo gaar-gaar ah la yeesho madaxda dalalka iyo mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan hay’adaha caalamiga ah, iyadoo kulamadaasi diiradda lagu saarayo danaha Soomaaliya iyo arrimaha gobolka Geeska Afrika. items.title: Maxey tahay sababta Uganda ay xiriirka ugu jartay dowladda Turkiga ?
items.description: Kambaala ( Raxanreeb Online) Ciidamada Uganda ayaa sheegay inay hakiyeen iskaashigii milateri ee kala dhexeeyay Turkiga, kadib markii la dalbaday in Ankara ay soo wareejiso qoraa siyaasadeed oo caan ah, kaas oo si adag u dhaliila Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni. “Ciidamada Difaaca Dadweynaha Uganda (UPDF) ayaa si degdeg ah u hakiyay dhammaan wixii iskaashi dhanka difaaca iyo milatariga ah ee kala dhexeeyay Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga,” ayuu yiri afhayeenka ciidamada Chris Magezi oo soo saaray bayaan uu ku daabacay bartiisa X. Sida ay tabisay wakaaladda wararka ee AFP, taliyaha ciidanka waddanka Uganda Muhoozi Kainerugaba, oo ah wiilka madaxweyne Museveni oo si weyn loogu arko inuu yahay ninka bedeli doona aabihiis, ayaa si isdaba joog ah waxay isugu dhaceen mas’uuliyiinta Turkiga waxaana uu salka ku hayay isku dhaco Uganda oo isku dayaysa in Fred Lumbuye oo nin dhaliila dowladda Uganda oo ku nool Turkiga loo soo gacan geliyo iyaga. Falanqeeyaha siyaasadda ayaa wajahaya 15 dacwadood oo dambi ah, oo ay ku jiraan kicin rabshado, faafinta macluumaad been abuur ah iyo si xun u isticmaalka kombiyuutarka. Jimcihii, kumanaan reer Uganda ah oo xiriir la leh Ururka Waddaniga ah ee Uganda, oo ah koox cadaadis bulsho iyo siyaasadeed oo xiriir la leh Muhoozi, ayaa dibadbax ka dhigay bannaanka safaaradda Turkiga ee caasimadda Kampala, sida ay tabisay AFP. items.title: Madaxda adduunka oo ku qulquleysa Mareykanka iyo Somaliland oo berri…
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Madaxda dalalka caalamka ayaa kusii qulqulaya magaalada New York ee dalka Mareykanka, halkaas oo ay uga qayb-galayaan shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, kaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo xaaladaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa bulsho ee dunida. Madaxweynayaasha Soomaaliya, Iiraan, Suuriya iyo Ukraine ayaa ka mid ah madaxda gaartay New York, iyadoo xaaladaha dalalkooda ay si gaar ah uga mid yihiin arrimaha laga hadli doono inta uu socdo shirka. Madaxdan ayaa New York gaartay xilli isku dhow, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo hadallada ay jeedin doonaan iyo kulamada ay la yeelan doonaan madaxda kale ee ka qayb-galaysa shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sanadkan isugu keenaya madaxda dalal badan oo caalamka ah, iyadoo ajandayaasha laga hadlayo ay ka mid yihiin xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee taagan iyo xaaladaha bulsho ee dunida. Imaanshaha madaxda Soomaaliya, Iiraan, Suuriya iyo Ukraine ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli xaaladaha dalalkooda ay yihiin kuwo si gaar ah looga hadlo fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah. Kulamada iyo hadallada madaxda ee New York ayaa la filayaa inay qayb ka noqdaan doodaha ku saabsan arrimaha waaweyn ee saameynaya xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo tan bulsho ee caalamka. Shirkan ayaa sidoo kale kusoo aadaya xilli maamulka Somaliland uu doonayo inuu si gaar ah uga dhex muuqdo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ka socda xarunta Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo Madaxweynaha Somaliland uu ku sugan yahay magaalada New York. Somaliland ayaa lagu wadaa in berri ay xarunta Qaramada Midoobay ka hor dhigto bannaanbax ay ku muujinayso dadaalkeeda ku aaddan raadinta aqoonsi caalami ah. items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo shaaciyey musharraxiinta doorashada ku-celiska ah ee Galmudug
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa shaaciyey liiska musharraxiinta ururrada siyaasadeed ee ka qaybgalaya doorashada ku-celiska ah ee isku-sidkan ee Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada Dowlad-Goboleedka Galmudug . Guddiga ayaa sheegay in 12 urur siyaasadeed ay waqtigii loo qabtay ku soo gudbiyeen liisaska musharraxiintooda iyo dukumentiyadii looga baahnaa. Muddada soo gudbinta liisaska musharraxiinta waxay ku ekayd 12-kii Sebteembar 2026 . Guddigu wuxuu sidoo kale caddeeyey in ururradii aan waqtigii loogu talagalay aan soo gudbin liisaska musharraxiintooda loo aqoonsaday kuwo aan diyaar u ahayn ka qaybgalka doorashada ku-celiska ah. Guddigu wuxuu sheegay in go’aankaasi uu ku salaysan yahay u hoggaansanaanta habraaca iyo jadwalka doorashada , uuna macnaheedu ahayn in la baabi’iyey jiritaanka sharci ee ururrada siyaasadeed ee diiwaangashan. Doorashada ku-celiska ah ayaa loo qorsheeyey inay dhacdo 30-ka Sebteembar 2026 , halka ololaha doorashada uu xirmayo 28-ka Sebteembar . Sidoo kale, ururrada siyaasadda waxaa loo asteeyey inay 22-ka Sebteembar soo gudbiyaan wakiilladooda goobaha codbixinta, halka aqoonsiga wakiillada iyo kormeerayaasha la qorsheeyey 26-ka Sebteembar . Doorashadan ayaa ku timid kadib markii Maxkamadda Sare ay 24-kii Agoosto 2026 laashay natiijadii doorashadii isku-sidnayd ee Galmudug ee dhacday 30-kii Luulyo , iyadoo guddigu markii dambe aqbalay go’aanka maxkamadda isla markaana diyaariyey jadwalka doorashada ku-celiska ah. Doorashadii 30-kii Luulyo, doorashada Golaha Wakiillada waxaa u tartamay musharraxiin ka kala socday ururro siyaasadeed, halka Golaha Deegaanka ay sidoo kale ka qaybgaleen ururro badan. Doorashada cusub ayaa sidaas darteed noqonaysa marxalad kale oo lagu soo celinayo hannaanka doorashada Galmudug. Si kastaba ha ahaatee doorashada ku-celiska ah waxaa la qorsheeyey 30-ka Sebteembar, waxaana hadda socda diyaar-garowga iyo fulinta tallaabooyinka ku xusan jadwalka guddiga.
