items.title: Shirkadda Maersk oo ku dhowaaqday go’aan si weyn u saameynaya Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Shirkadda maraakiibta ee Maersk ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay lacag dheeraad ah ku soo rogeyso konteenarrada laga soo raro Waqooyiga Yurub iyo dalalka ku teedsan badda Mediterranean-ka ee loo soo wado Soomaaliya, tallaabadaas oo kordhin karta kharashka soo dejinta badeecadaha. Lacagtan cusub, oo loo yaqaan Peak Season Surcharge (PSS) , ayaa dhaqan geli doonta 7-da October, waxayna noqon doontaa $200 konteenarka 20-foot ah iyo $300 konteenarrada 40-foot iyo 45-foot ah. Maersk ayaa sheegtay in lacagta dheeraadka ah lagu dabaqi doono konteenarrada loo raro Soomaaliya iyo Tanzania, isla markaana ay sii jiri doonto ilaa amar dambe. Shirkaddu waxay sheegtay in lacagta lagu dari doono kharashaadka kale ee ku xiran rarista, iyadoo lagu saleynayo habka lacag-bixinta ee shixnad kasta. Taas waxay ka dhigan tahay in ganacsade konteenar 40-foot ah ka soo raraya suuqyada Yurub ee uu go’aankan khuseeyo uu bixin karo $300 oo dheeraad ah marka badeecaddiisa loo soo wado Soomaaliya. Kharashkaas waxaa qaadi kara ganacsadaha, ama qayb ka mid ah waxaa loo gudbin karaa jumladleyda, tafaariiqleyda iyo ugu dambeyn macaamiisha, taas oo ku xirnaan doonta nooca iyo tirada badeecadaha ku jira konteenarka. Waa maxay Peak Season Surcharge? Peak Season Surcharge waa lacag dheeraad ah oo shirkadaha maraakiibtu ku daraan qiimaha caadiga ah ee xamuulka, gaar ahaan xilliyada baahida boosaska maraakiibta ay kororto ama awoodda gaadiidka iyo shabakadaha dekeduhu ay cadaadis la kulmaan. Waxaa sidoo kale la isticmaali karaa marka ay jiraan ciriiri dekedeed, boos la’aan ama xaalado kale oo hawlgal oo sare u qaada kharashka ama cadaadiska saaran shabakadda shirkadda. Magaca “Peak Season” macnaheedu ma aha in badeecadaha loo soo dhoofinayo Soomaaliya ay si lama filaan ah u bateen. Lacagta noocan ah mararka qaar waxay la xiriirtaa xaaladaha ka jira marin ganacsi oo dhan ama shabakadda caalamiga ah ee shirkadda. Sidoo kale lacagtan ma aha canshuur ay dowladda Soomaaliya soo rogtay, canshuur kastam ama lacag deked. Waa kharash ganacsi oo Maersk ku darto qiimaha rarista konteenarka. Maersk ma aysan faahfaahin sabab gaar ah oo ay lacagta cusub ugu soo rogeyso Soomaaliya iyo Tanzania, waxayna sheegtay in tallaabadu qeyb ka tahay dadaalkeeda ku aaddan sii wadista adeegyadeeda caalamiga ah. Soomaaliya oo ka qaalisan Kenya Maersk ayaa isla 7-da October lacag dheeraad ah ku soo rogeysa konteenarrada Yurub laga soo raro ee loo wado Kenya, balse qiimaha halkaas lagu dabaqayo ayaa ka hooseeya kan Soomaaliya. Konteenarka 20-foot ah ee Kenya loo wado waxaa lagu dari doonaa $150, halka 40-foot iyo 45-foot lagu dari doono $200. Soomaaliya iyo Tanzania, isla konteenarradaas waxaa lagu dari doonaa $200 iyo $300. Shirkaddu ma aysan sheegin sababta Soomaaliya iyo Tanzania looga qaadayo lacag ka badan tan Kenya. Go’aankan cusub wuxuu sidoo kale imanayaa kaddib markii Maersk ay bishan September dhaqan gelisay lacag kale oo $500 ah konteenarkiiba oo saaran xamuulka laga raro dalal dhowr ah oo Bariga Afrika ah, oo ay Soomaaliya ku jirto, loona qaado qaar ka mid ah dalalka Waqooyiga Yurub. Xilligaas shirkaddu waxay sababta ku sheegtay xaaladaha suuqa iyo ciriiriga dhanka awoodda xamuulka ee marinada taga Waqooyiga Yurub. Soomaaliya waxay si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay badeecadaha dibadda laga keeno, sidaas darteedna isbeddellada ku yimaada qiimaha maraakiibta iyo gaadiidka caalamiga ah waxay qeyb ka noqon karaan kharashka ugu dambeeya ee badeecadaha dalka soo gala. Saameynta $200 ama $300 ee konteenarkiiba waxay ku kala duwanaan doontaa nooca iyo tirada badeecadaha la sido. Haddii konteenarku sido badeecooyin badan, kharashka dheeraadka ah ee ku dhacaya shay kasta wuu yaraan karaa, balse kororka joogtada ah ee kharashaadka rarista wuxuu cadaadis dheeraad ah saari karaa ganacsatada wax soo dejisa. items.title: 20 dal iyo Midowga Yurub oo ku baaqay hay’ad caalami ah oo maamusha khataraha AI
items.description: Labaatan dal iyo Midowga Yurub ayaa ku baaqay in la sameeyo iskaashi caalami ah oo lagu xakameynayo khataraha ka dhalan kara horumarka degdegga ah ee sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI), iyadoo la soo jeediyay in la dhiso hay’ad caalami ah oo dejisa isla markaana kormeerta heerarka badbaadada AI. Baaqan ayaa lagu soo bandhigay bayaan wadajir ah oo ay dowladuhu soo saareen xilli madaxda caalamku ay isu diyaarinayaan kulamada Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay , kaas oo ka socda magaalada New York. Dalalka saxiixay waxaa ka mid ah Jarmalka, Koonfur Afrika, Canada, Australia, Imaaraadka Carabta, Singapore iyo Kenya , halka Midowga Yurub uu sidoo kale qayb ka yahay. Bayaanka ayaa ku adkeysanaya in horumarinta AI ay waafaqdo sharciga caalamiga ah, isla markaana tiknoolajiyaddu ay ku sii jirto hagidda, kormeerka iyo xakamaynta aadanaha . Dalalkan ayaa soo jeediyay in la sameeyo heerar caalami ah oo mideysan , in la is-weydaarsado xogta ku saabsan shilalka iyo dhacdooyinka halista ah ee la xiriira AI, iyo in la baaro suurtagalnimada dhismaha hay’ad caalami ah oo awood u leh dejinta heerarka, xaqiijinta u hoggaansanaanta iyo isku keenista dowladaha marka awoodaha AI ay gaaraan heerar cusub oo khatar keeni kara. Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto , Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Jarmalka Friedrich Merz , Madaxweynaha Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev , iyo madax kale ayaa ka mid ah saxiixayaasha bayaanka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Maraykanka iyo Shiinaha , oo ah labada dal ee hormuudka ka ah tartanka horumarinta AI-da casriga ah, kuma jiraan saxiixayaasha bayaanka. Sidoo kale India, Kuuriyada Koonfureed, Japan, Boqortooyada Midowday iyo Faransiiska ayaan ku jirin liiska dalalka saxiixay. Bayaanka ayaa imanaya iyadoo dood xooggan ay ka taagan tahay badbaadada AI, kaddib markii madax ka tirsan shirkadaha waaweyn ee tiknoolajiyadda ay ku baaqeen in la taxaddaro ama la yareeyo xawaaraha horumarinta AI-da si loo yareeyo khataraha iman kara. Dhinaca kale, shirkadda OpenAI ayaa sheegtay in Maraykanku uu hoggaamin karo dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu dejinayo heerarka farsamo ee AI-da horumarsan. Shirkaddu waxay ku doodday in hoggaaminta hadda ay saameyn ku yeelan karto sida mustaqbalka loo dhisayo nidaamka caalamiga ah ee lagu maamulayo AI. Arrintan ayaa muujinaysa in dadaallada lagu doonayo in AI loo sameeyo xeer iyo kormeer caalami ah ay sii xoogeysanayaan, inkastoo weli ay jiraan kala aragti duwanaansho ku saabsan cidda dejinaysa xeerarka iyo heerka ay dowladuhu ku lug yeelanayaan.

items.title: Qatar oo shaacisay mowqif uusan Mareykanka jecleysan doonin oo ku saabsan Iran
items.description: Doha (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Qatar ayaa ku baaqday in Bariga Dhexe loo sameeyo hannaan cusub oo amni oo ay Iran qeyb ka tahay, iyadoo sheegtay in dagaalka socda uu cashar weyn u yahay dalalka gobolka, gaar ahaan kuwa Khaliijka oo si toos ah u dareemaya saameyntiisa amni iyo dhaqaale. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Qatar, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, ayaa sheegay in dalalka gobolka aysan ka maarmi karin inay xiriir wanaagsan la yeeshaan Iran, oo uu ku tilmaamay dal deris la ah waddamada Khaliijka. “Iran waa deriskeenna,” ayuu ka sheegay Madasha Dhaqaalaha Qatar ee ka dhacday New York Axaddii. “Waa inaan si mas’uuliyad leh gobol ahaan u wada shaqeynaa, oo aan xaqiijinnaa inaan xiriir wanaagsan la leenahay Iran,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu intaas ku daray: “Waxaan rajeyneynaa in dagaalkan uu qof walba u noqdo baraarug.” Hadalka Qatar ayaa imanaya xilli walaaca laga qabo in dagaalka Iran uu mar kale sii xoogeysto uu kordhayo, kaddib bilo ay heerka weerarradu yaraayeen. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Axaddii si lama filaan ah uga soo laabtay booqasho uu ku joogay Camp David, iyadoo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ay digniin amni u dirtay muwaadiniinta Mareykanka ee ku sugan Bariga Dhexe. Trump ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in “waxyaabo aad u waaweyn” ay dhici karaan mustaqbalka dhow, isagoo xusay in Washington ay qiimeyneyso dhowr waddo oo ku saabsan Iran. Xiisadda u dhexeysa Mareykanka, Israel iyo Iran ayaa socotay in ka badan lix bilood, iyadoo Tehran ay weerarro aargoosi ah ku qaaday saldhigyo Mareykanku ku leeyahay gobolka. Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale si weyn u carqaladeeyay isu socodka maraakiibta ee marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Khaliijka oo cadaadis wajahaya Dalalka Carabta ee Khaliijka ayaa isku dayaya inay ka fogaadaan in dagaalku sii ballaarto, maadaama qaarkood ay martigeliyaan saldhigyo ciidan oo Mareykan ah isla markaana dhaqaalahoodu si weyn ugu tiirsan yahay xasilloonida gobolka. La-taliyaha diblomaasiyadda madaxweynaha Imaaraadka Carabta, Anwar Gargash, ayaa isna Axaddii sheegay in gobolka uu u baahan yahay “fikir cusub”, isagoo ku baaqay in dadaallada lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka lagu daro wadahadal toos ah oo u dhexeeya Iran iyo dalalka Carabta. Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Iraq iyo Imaaraadka ayaa dhammaantood si weyn ugu tiirsan marin-biyoodka Hormuz, oo ah jid muhiim u ah dhoofinta saliidda iyo gaaska iyo soo dejinta badeecadaha. Xirnaanshaha iyo khatarta ka jirta Hormuz ayaa gaar ahaan culays weyn saartay Qatar, oo ka mid ah dalalka ugu waaweyn dunida ee dhoofiya gaaska dabiiciga ah ee la qaboojiyey ee LNG. Qatar ayaa kordhisay xaaladda force majeure ee qaar ka mid ah shixnadaha gaaska dabiiciga ah ee LNG-ga ilaa horraanta November, iyadoo qalalaasaha marin-biyoodku sidoo kale halis gelinayo qaar ka mid ah qorshayaasha waaweyn ee dalka ee lagu kordhinayo wax-soo-saarka gaaska. QatarEnergy ayaa sheegtay in dhibaatooyinka Hormuz ay dib u dhigi karaan qaar ka mid ah mashaariicda ballaarinta, sababtoo ah qalab muhiim ah oo loo baahan yahay mashaariicda ayaan si caadi ah dalka ku soo geli karin. Qatar oo diidday dhuumo kale Qalalaasaha ayaa mar kale soo nooleeyay dood ku saabsan in dalalka Khaliijka ay sameystaan marinno kale oo ay uga maarmayaan Hormuz. Hase yeeshee Wasiirka Tamarta Qatar Sacad al-Kacbi ayaa meesha ka saaray in Doha ay qorsheyneyso dhuumo cusub oo gaaska looga leexiyo marin-biyoodka. Kacbi ayaa sheegay in fikradda ah in maalgelin lagu sameeyo dhuumo cusub ay Hormuz ka dhigi karto marin aan muhiim ahayn laba sano gudahood aysan macquul ahayn. “Waxaan u maleynayaa in taasi gebi ahaanba khalad tahay,” ayuu yiri. “Waxaan go’aansannay inaanan sameyn dhuumo, go’aanka Qatar-na waxa uu ku saleysnaa arrimo ganacsi iyo farsamo,” ayuu raaciyay. “Waxaan sii isticmaali doonnaa marin-biyoodka.” Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa dhinaciisa sheegay inuu kordhinayo maalgelinta dhuumaha u oggolaanaya inuu qayb ka mid ah saliidda uga dhoofiyo meelo aan Hormuz marin, balse Bahrain iyo Kuwait waxay leeyihiin ikhtiyaar aad uga kooban. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa muddo dheer isticmaashay dhuunta East-West Pipeline, oo saliidda ka qaadda bariga dalka una gudbisa dekedda Yanbu ee Badda Cas, balse weerar diyaaradeed oo aan duuliye lahayn ayaa dhowaan carqaladeeyay dhuuntaas. Arrintaas ayaa muujisay in xitaa waddooyinka loogu talagalay in looga baxsado Hormuz aysan ka badbaadsaneyn khatarta dagaalka gobolka. Sacuudiga ayaa toddobaadyadii dambe sidoo kale wajahaya weerarro ka imanaya Xuutiyiinta Yemen, iyadoo dagaalka Yemen uu mar kale xoogaystay. Reuters ayaa Isniintii sheegtay in Riyadh ay kordhisay dhoofinta saliidda ee dekedaha Khaliijka kaddib weerarkii lagu qaaday dhuunta bari-galbeed. items.title: Somaliland Parliament Reopens Sensitive Dahable Death Case
items.description: Resolution Calls for Independent Investigation into Aviation Employee’s Death in Mogadishu Hargeisa (WDN) — More than two years after the death of Somaliland-born aviation professional Abdinasir Muse Abdirahman Dahable in Mogadishu, the case has returned to the political spotlight after Somaliland’s House of Representatives presented a resolution calling for an independent investigation. The resolution was presented by Second Deputy Speaker Ali Hamoud Jibril, who said the parliament has a constitutional responsibility to protect the rights of Somaliland citizens. Dahable, 32, was an employee of the Somali Civil Aviation Authority. His body was discovered at his residence in Mogadishu’s Wadajir district on February 18, 2024. Somali police said at the time that an investigation had begun and that six people had been detained in connection with the case. Competing Claims The proposed resolution expresses concern that Dahable may have been targeted because of his regional background and refers to allegations involving officials of Somalia’s Federal Government. Those allegations remain claims contained in the Somaliland parliamentary resolution and have not been independently established. Dahable’s family had also alleged that he received threats before his death and accused NISA of pressuring and threatening him. Those allegations were reported at the time but were not independently substantiated. The circumstances surrounding the death therefore remain unresolved in the public record. Why the Case Is Sensitive The case is particularly sensitive because Dahable’s death occurred during a major political dispute between Somalia’s Federal Government and Somaliland over the administration of Somali airspace and civil aviation services. His professional position, Somaliland background and involvement in the aviation sector placed the case against an already highly contentious political backdrop. The resolution calls for an independent investigation to establish the circumstances of his death and identify those responsible. It also urges that anyone found culpable be brought before the appropriate judicial authorities. The parliament has further called on Somaliland’s human-rights institutions and the international community to support efforts to obtain a credible investigation and judicial process. If approved, the resolution would become the formal position of Somaliland’s legislature on the case. At its heart, the demand is simple: establish what happened to Abdinasir Dahable, determine who was responsible and ensure that the facts—not competing political narratives—guide the search for justice. items.title: Soomaaliya oo xoojisay diyaar-garowga Ebola iyadoo Muqdisho lagu qabtay tababar xaalad-degdeg ah
items.description: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada Soomaaliya iyo Machadka Qaranka Caafimaadka, oo taageero ka helaya Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka ee WHO, ayaa Muqdisho ku soo gabagabeeyay tababar socday saddex maalmood oo lagu tijaabinayay diyaar-garowga dalka ee ka hortagga iyo wax-ka-qabashada cudurka Ebola. Tababarka ayaa lagu tijaabiyay awoodda hay’adaha caafimaadka Soomaaliya ay u leeyihiin inay ogaadaan, xaqiijiyaan, soo sheegaan, isla markaana ka jawaabaan xaalad loo malaynayo inuu qof dalka soo galay oo qaba Ebola . Soomaaliya illaa hadda ma aysan soo sheegin kiis Ebola oo la xaqiijiyay. Waxaa ka qaybgalay ku dhowaad 70 qof oo ka kala socday Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Federaalka, Machadka Qaranka Caafimaadka, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo hay’adaha kale ee bahwadaagta la ah Soomaaliya. Intii uu socday tababarka waxaa la tijaabiyay wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada, habraacyada baaritaanka dadka soo galaya dalka, gudbinta bukaannada, xog-wadaagga, wacyigelinta bulshada iyo qorsheynta jawaabta xaaladaha degdegga ah. Ka qaybgalayaashu waxay ka shaqeeyeen lix xaaladood oo tusaale ahaan loo sameeyay, kuwaas oo ay ka mid ahaayeen digniin caafimaad oo ka timaadda gobol, dhaqdhaqaaq dadweyne oo kordha, qof looga shakiyo Ebola oo lagu arko goob laga soo galo dalka, warar aan la xaqiijin iyo xaalad u baahan go’aan hoggaamineed. Tababarka ayaa ku soo beegmay xilli Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo ay wajahaysay dillaac Ebola ah oo ka dhashay fayraska Bundibugyo . Sida xogta WHO ee 7-dii Sebtembar 2026, waxaa dalkaas laga diiwaangeliyay 6,757 kiis oo la xaqiijiyay iyo 3,267 dhimasho, kuwaas oo laga soo sheegay 61 goobood oo caafimaad oo ku kala yaalla lix gobol. Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale wajahaysa caqabado caafimaad oo ay ka mid yihiin colaadaha, saameynta isbeddelka cimilada, barakaca dadka iyo cudurro kale oo faafa, taas oo ka dhigaysa diyaar-garowga iyo isku-duwidda hay’adaha caafimaadka mid muhiim u ah wax-ka-qabashada xaaladaha degdegga ah. Tababarka ayaa lagu ogaaday meelo u baahan in la xoojiyo, oo ay ka mid yihiin habka warbixinta, ogeysiinta iyo gudbinta bukaannada, nidaamka goobaha laga soo galo dalka, cidda masuulka ka ah warbaahinta iyo cidda qaadaysa tallaabada xigta . Arrimahaas waxaa loo sameeyay qorshe wax-ka-qabad iyo dabagal. WHO Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in tababarrada noocan ah ay fursad siinayaan hay’adaha inay tijaabiyaan qorshayaashooda iyo nidaamyada wada-shaqeynta ka hor inta aysan dhicin xaalad caafimaad oo dhab ah. Mas’uuliyiintu waxay caddeeyeen in dhammaan xaaladihii tababarka lagu sameeyay ay ahaayeen tusaalooyin la matalay , isla markaana aysan jirin bukaan, muunado caafimaad ama kiis Ebola oo dhab ah oo lagu lug lahaa. Tababarkuna uusan ka dhignayn in Soomaaliya laga helay ama laga shakiyay kiis Ebola oo dhab ah.

items.title: Galkacyo Flashpoint: Puntland Intercepts Federal Recruits in Sensitive Military Move
items.description: Galkacyo (WDN) — A potentially explosive military incident in Galkacyo has exposed just how quickly troop movements can become a flashpoint in Somalia’s deeply contested federal security landscape, after Puntland forces intercepted two military vehicles carrying newly recruited federal personnel. Puntland officials said the vehicles were carrying about 130 recruits, officers and trainers and had crossed into the Puntland-administered northern part of Galkacyo after travelling from the direction of Galmudug. Other local reports have put the number lower, underscoring the need for an official consolidated figure. Somali National Army The recruits were reportedly being transported toward the Xananbuure military training centre in Galgaduud, where they were expected to undergo training as part of the Federal Government’s military recruitment programme. What might otherwise have been a routine military convoy became highly sensitive the moment it entered Galkacyo. The city remains divided between Puntland and Galmudug, with the boundary between the two administrations making the movement of federal forces through the area an especially delicate issue. A Military Convoy in the Wrong Place Puntland security authorities detained the personnel and the vehicles after they entered the area under Puntland control. Accounts differ over precisely why the convoy crossed into the Puntland-controlled section of the city. One explanation reported by several local outlets is that the drivers were unfamiliar with Galkacyo and lost their way, inadvertently taking the convoy into the wrong part of the city. Puntland officials, however, have publicly described the incident in more serious security terms, with the Mudug police commander saying the forces had entered Puntland territory and were taken into custody. The competing accounts have added to the sensitivity surrounding the incident. Galmudug Intervention The confrontation was subsequently defused through contacts between Puntland and Galmudug officials. According to reports, Galmudug officials explained that the drivers were new to Galkacyo and had mistakenly taken the wrong route. The recruits were later released and were reported to have resumed their journey toward Xananbuure. The apparent de-escalation prevented the detention of the recruits from developing into a wider confrontation between Puntland and forces linked to the Federal Government. But the episode has exposed a much larger fault line. Why Galkacyo Matters Galkacyo is not simply another Somali city. It sits directly on the administrative divide between Puntland and Galmudug, and military movements across that divide carry political significance far beyond the number of soldiers involved. The incident comes amid continuing disagreements between Puntland and the Federal Government over military recruitment, the deployment of federal forces and the broader federal-state security architecture. Current reporting has specifically linked the Galkacyo incident to those tensions. That makes the episode more than a dispute over two vehicles. It is a reminder that in Galkacyo, a wrong turn by a military convoy can become a national political incident. items.title: Seven Ethiopian Armed Groups Unite Against Abiy as Opposition Front Widens
items.description: Former Rivals Join Forces to Seek Removal of Prosperity Party Government and Establish Inclusive Transitional Administration Addis Ababa (WDN) — In a stunning development that could reshape Ethiopia’s increasingly fractured political landscape, seven armed and political movements have announced a new alliance dedicated to removing Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government and establishing an inclusive transitional administration. Calling themselves the Ethiopian Peoples’ Forces Alliance for Survival, the groups said they would coordinate their political and organizational capabilities against the Prosperity Party-led government and seek to establish a transitional government operating under a transitional charter. The alliance brings together organizations from several of Ethiopia’s most politically and militarily contested regions: the Amhara Fano National Movement, Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF), Oromo Liberation Army (OLA), Ogaden National Liberation Front (ONLF), Afar Revolutionary Democratic Unity Front (Ugugumo), Benishangul Peoples’ Liberation Movement and Gumuz Peoples’ Democratic Movement. The announcement is particularly striking because some of the groups have previously been adversaries or have pursued competing political and territorial agendas. A Direct Challenge to Abiy In their founding statement, the groups accused Abiy’s government of authoritarian and personalist rule, arguing that its policies have contributed to conflict, displacement, insecurity and political repression. They declared that their immediate objective is to remove what they described as the Prosperity Party’s “personalist and dictatorial system” and replace it with an inclusive transitional government. Those are the alliance’s allegations and political characterizations, rather than independently established findings. The Ethiopian government had not publicly responded to the announcement at the time of reporting. The alliance says a transitional administration would seek to halt the country’s armed conflicts, protect civil and democratic rights, restore security, address economic and social pressures and launch an inclusive national and constitutional dialogue. From Regional Conflicts to a Common Front The emergence of the alliance comes as Ethiopia faces continuing instability in several regions. Fighting has persisted in parts of Oromia and Amhara, while tensions in Tigray have recently raised fears over the durability of the 2022 Pretoria peace agreement. The TPLF has also declared that agreement effectively dead, according to recent reporting. The new alliance therefore represents an unusual convergence of forces that have historically had very different relationships with Addis Ababa — and, in some cases, with each other. Whether the alliance can translate its political declaration into sustained coordination remains uncertain. Its formation does not automatically mean that the seven groups have created a unified military command, and their longstanding differences remain significant. Nevertheless, the decision to establish a common political framework sends a powerful message about the depth of opposition confronting the federal government. The Federal System Under Pressure The development also comes as Ethiopia continues a national dialogue process dealing with fundamental questions about the country’s political system, federal structure, representation, intergovernmental relations and the division of powers between federal and regional authorities. The National Dialogue Commission says it has gathered agendas from across much of the country and is preparing for further stages of the dialogue process. Prime Minister Abiy has publicly said his government is prepared to consider recommendations emerging from that process. The new alliance, however, suggests that significant armed opposition movements remain outside the government’s political framework. That creates a profound challenge for any attempt to achieve a national political settlement through dialogue alone. The significance of the announcement lies not simply in the number of organizations involved, but in the breadth of the geographical and political opposition now represented. From Tigray and Amhara to Oromia, the Somali Region, Afar and Benishangul-Gumuz, the alliance brings together movements rooted in regions with distinct grievances and political demands. The groups say their ultimate objective is not merely to defeat the current government, but to open what they describe as a new transitional chapter based on an inclusive political process, constitutional dialogue and the protection of rights. For Ethiopia, however, the immediate question is whether this extraordinary alliance will become a platform for political negotiation or another chapter in the country’s cycle of armed confrontation. Either way, the formation of the Alliance for Survival represents a remarkable moment: groups that once stood on very different sides of Ethiopia’s conflicts have now found common ground in their opposition to Abiy Ahmed’s government. The alliance has changed the political equation. What remains uncertain is whether Addis Ababa will respond with renewed confrontation, political engagement — or a combination of both. G7 oo Xuutiyiinta ugu baaqay inay si degdeg ah u joojiyaan weerarrada ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga
items.description: Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee dalalka ku bahoobay G7 ayaa ugu baaqay Xuutiyiinta Yemen inay si degdeg ah u joojiyaan weerarrada ay ka fulinayaan gudaha Sacuudiga, xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha ka taagan gobolka Bariga Dhexe. Bayaan ay soo saareen wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee G7 ayaa lagu cambaareeyay weerarrada ka imanaya Yemen ee lagu beegsanayo Sacuudiga, waxaana Xuutiyiinta loogu baaqay inay joojiyaan dhammaan howlgallada militari, gaar ahaan weerarrada ka dhanka ah maraakiibta rayidka ah iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. G7 ayaa sidoo kale Iran ugu baaqay inay joojiso hubeynta iyo taageerada ay siiso Xuutiyiinta, iyadoo wasiirradu sheegeen in taageeradaasi ay qayb ka tahay xaalad sii kordheysa oo khatar ku ah xasilloonida gobolka iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Xiisadda u dhexeysa Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta ayaa toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay sii xoogeysatay, iyadoo la soo wariyay weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ah oo lagu qaaday bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla gudaha Sacuudiga. Weerarradaasi ayaa sidoo kale walaac ka abuuray amniga marinnada muhiimka ah ee Badda Cas iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. G7 ayaa ku boorriyay dhinacyada ay khusayso inay ka fogaadaan tallaabooyin sii hurin kara colaadda, isla markaana dib loogu laabto dadaallada siyaasadeed ee lagu raadinayo xal waara oo laga gaaro colaadda Yemen.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo wefdi uu hoggaaminayo oo gaaray New York
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo wefdi ballaaran oo uu hoggaaminayo ayaa gaaray magaalada New York ee dalka Mareykanka, halkaas oo ah xarunta guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Madaxweynaha iyo wafdi ballaaran oo uu hoggaaminayo ayaa magaalada New York uga qaybgalaya Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, oo ay isugu yimaadeen madaxda iyo wufuudda dalalka xubnaha ka ah Qaramada Midoobay. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa la filayaa inay diiradda saarto xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, horumarka dowlad-dhiska, amniga dalka iyo dadaallada dowladda ee la dagaallanka kooxda Al-Shabaab. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa la filayaa inuu inta uu ku sugan yahay New York uu yeesho kulamo gaar-gaar ah oo uu la qaato madax iyo mas’uuliyiin ka kala socda dalal iyo hay’ado caalami ah, iyadoo kulamadaasi looga hadli doono xoojinta xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo beesha caalamka iyo arrimaha muhiimka u ah dalka.

items.title: The Somaliland President Meets With Members Of The Community In The United States
items.description: Washington, DC. The President of Somaliland, Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi has met with members of the the Somaliland community in North America. The President, speaking to a large gathering on Saturday night, urged the community to remain united, vigilant and dedicated to the Somaliland cause. The President and the accompanying senior delegation, which included, the Speaker of the Parliament, the Ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence, Trade and Commerce, gave a detailed account of their talks with members of both chambers of US Congress, senior officials from the administration, think-tanks and influential figures from the business community. The meeting which was moderated by the Somaliland Representative in the United States of America, had attendees from as far as Minneapolis, Toronto and Ottawa. Qarannews

items.title: General Sahal Cabdullaahi oo weli isku-dubaridaya CXD iyo Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar oo toddobaadkii labaad ku sugan Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa weli ka shaqeynaya isku-dubaridka cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed, oo la doonayo in ay hawlgal xasillin ah ka bilaabaan deegaanada hoostaga magaaladaasi. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo 12-kii bishan ka degay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud ayaa magaalada u tegay qorsheynta hawlgal dhul iyo cir isugu jira, oo laga sameeyo deegaanada ku teedsan Baydhabo ee loo arko in laga soo abaabulo weerarada ka dhanka ah magaaladaasi. Hawlgalkan ayaa ah mid lagu adkeynayo amniga magaalada, iyadoo ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab laga fogeynayo deegaanada ku xeeran Baydhabo. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Birmadka iyo Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed in loo abaabulayo in ay ka hortaggaan khatarta weerarada Al Shabaab iyo taageereyaasha Laftagareen, ka dib markii lagu eedeeyay inay si wadajir ah isaga kaashadeen weeraradii ugu dambeeyay ee ka dhacay magaaladaasi. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa Saraakiisha Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee fadhigoodu yahay Baydhabo kala shaqeynaya hawlgalka lagu sugayo amniga magaalada iyo deegaanada ka baxsan. Saraakiisha Madaxtooyada Baydhabo ayaa laga soo xigtay in qorshaha hawlgalka uu yahay in si adag loo difaaco magaalada, si Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu u guto waajibaadkiisa shaqo. Hawlgalka cusub ayaa ah feker ka yimid Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoona Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu la qaatay. Aadan Madoobe ayaa doonaya in xoogaga u daacadda ah Laftagareen aanay wax joogitaan ah ku yeelan bannaanada Baydhabo, si loo dhimo amaba meesha looga saaro culeyska amni ee ay ku hayaan magaalada. Baydhabo ayaa la sheegay in toddobaadkii hore la geeyay ciidamo cusub oo ka tirsan Kumaandooska Gorgor, si ay kordhin ugu noqdaan ciidamadii horey ugu sugnaa magaaladaasi. Kumaandooska Gorgor, Danab, Polizia Militare, Haramcad, cutubyo ka tirsan Guutada 8aad, Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Daraawiishta iyo Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa haatan fariisimo ku leh afaafka hore ee Baydhabo, waxaana hadda laga shaqeynaya qorshe la rabo in ay uga aag bedeshaan, iyagoo degaya goobo ka durugsan magaalada. Saraakiisha Qaybta 60aad ayaase kuu sheegaya in hawlgalka duleedka Baydhabo uu dib-u-dhac la kulmi karo, sababo la xiriira xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee ka soo kordhay Gobolka Hiiraan. Xiisadda siyaasadeed ee madaxda sare ee dalka kala dhexeysa siyaasiyiinta gobolkaasi ayaa gaartay meeshii ugu sarreysay, taas oo laga cabsi qabo in ay wiiqdo wada-shaqayntii dhanka amniga.

Xiisadda siyaasadeed ee madaxda sare ee dalka kala dhexeysa siyaasiyiinta gobolkaasi ayaa gaartay meeshii ugu sarreysay, taas oo laga cabsi qabo in ay wiiqdo wada-shaqayntii dhanka amniga.

items.title: Puntland oo sii daysay ciidamadii ay ku qabatay Gaalkacyo
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamadii iyo gaadiidkii ay Puntland ku qabatay magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa la sii daayay, kadib markii maamulka Puntland uu sheegay inuu baaritaan ku sameeyay xaaladda ciidanka iyo sababta ay magaalada u soo gaareen. Puntland ayaa sheegtay inay baaristeeda ku ogaatay in ciidanka iyo gaadiidku ahaayeen kuwo habow ah oo soo lumay, ayna ku socdeen deegaan ka tirsan Galmudug, halkaas oo loogu waday tababar. Maamulka Galmudug ayaa dhankiisa Puntland uga mahadceliyay sida ay u sii daysay uguba wareejisay ciidanka iyo gaadiidkii ay wateen. Ciidamada oo tiradoodu gaareyso illaa 130 askari ayaa waxaa waday saraakiil iyo macallimiin tababarayaal ah. Ciidankan ayaa la sheegay inay ku sii jeedeen deegaanka Xananbuure ee gobolka Galgaduud, waxaana la sheegay in halkaas loogu waday tababar ciidan. Ciidamadan ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inay yihiin kuwo ay qortay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, balse ay kasoo jeedaan deegaanada maamulka Galmudug, ayna si toos ah u hoostagaan maamulka. Qabashada ciidanka iyo gaadiidkooda ayaa ka dhacday magaalada Gaalkacyo, taas oo ay ka wada arrimiyaan maamullada Puntland iyo Galmudug, waxaana arrintaasi markii dambe lagu xalliyay baaritaan iyo xaqiijin lagu sameeyay cidda ay ciidamadu ka tirsan yihiin. Si kastaba, markii la xaqiijiyay in ciidanka iyo gaadiidku ay ka tirsanaayeen Galmudug, Puntland ayaa qaaday tallaabadii sii deyntooda, iyadoo maamulka Galmudug lagu wareejiyay ciidanka iyo gaadiidkii ay wateen. Horay Puntland ayaa ula wareegtay xerooyin ay ciidamada dowladda ku lahaayeen gudaha maamulkaasi, kadib markii ciidamadeeda ay weerareen saldhigyo ay joogeen ciidamo la sheegay inay dowladdu ka qoratay halkaasi. The post Puntland oo sii daysay ciidamadii ay ku qabatay Gaalkacyo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wasiirka Cadaaladda Soomaaliya oo Doha kula kulmay dhiggiisa Qatar
items.description: Doha, Qatar – Sebteembar 21, 2026: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Cadaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Macallin Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada Doha kulan muhiim ah kula yeeshay Wasiirka Cadaaladda ahna Wasiiru-dowlaha Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Qatar, Ibraahim bin Cali Al-Muhannadi. Kulanka labada mas’uul ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada sharciga iyo cadaaladda, horumarinta hay’adaha cadaaladda, tayeynta shaqaalaha, casriyeynta adeegyada garsoorka iyo is-dhaafsiga khibradaha labada dal. Wasiir Xasan Macallin ayaa dowladda Qatar uga mahadceliyey taageerada joogtada ah ee ay siiso Soomaaliya, isagoo sidoo kale adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal, xilli gobolka ay ka jiraan xaalado xasaasi ah. Labada dhinac ayaa isku raacay in la sii ambaqaado kulamada wadatashiga farsamo, si loo hirgeliyo barnaamijyo iskaashi oo wax ku ool ah, loona horumariyo xiriirka soo jireenka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Qatar.

items.title: Taliye Cali Taagey iyo ilaaladiisa oo ku dhaawacmay qarax ka dhacay Baydhabo
items.description: Taliyaha Saldhigga Booliska Degmada Baydhabo, Kaptan Cali Aadan Maxamed (Cali Taagey) iyo askar kale oo lagu sheegay ilaaladiisa ayaa caawa fiidkii ku dhaawacmay qarax lagu la beegsaday gudaha Magaalada Baydhabo. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in gaari ay la socdeen uu qaraxa ku haleelay agagaarka Baanka Dhexe ee Baydhabo. Goobjoogeyaasha ayaa sheegay inay maqleen qarax xoogan iyo rasaas daba socotay oo ciidamada ammaanka ay fureen, isla-markaana ay dib ka ogaadeen in la bartilmaameedsaday gaari Qooqan oo uu la socday Taliye Cali Taagey. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in Taliye Cagey oo dhaawac aad u fudud uu soo gaaray iyo saddex askari oo kale in dhaawacooda la gaarsiiyay Isbitaal Goboleedka Baay ama Isbitaalka Guud ee Baydhabo. Inkastoo laamaha amniga aysan weli ka hadlin qaraxan, haddana dadka deegaanka ayaa isla dhex maraya in uu ahaa miino waddada dhinaceeda la dhigay ama bambada nooca gacanta laga tuuro. Ma jirto cid sheegatay masuuliyadda qaraxan, marka laga tago in uu jiro tuhun ku aaddan in ay gaysteen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab amaba ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Si kastaba ha-ahaatee ciidamada amniga oo baaritaano ka sameeyay goobta uu qaraxu ka dhacay ayaa waxaan jirin cid ay u soo qabteen qaraxaasi.

items.title: AQALKA SARE OO ANSIXIYAY HINDISE-SHARCIYEEDKA DHISMAHA HAY’ADDA DAKHLIGA QARANKA
items.description: Muqdisho, 21 Sebtembar 2026 — Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta ansixiyay Hindise-Sharciyeedka Dhismaha Hay’adda Dakhliga Qaranka. Hindise-sharciyeedkan ayaa horey u soo maray habraacyada sharci-dejinta ee labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo ansixintiisa ay paves u furayso hirgelinta hay’ad qaran oo qaabilsan maamulka iyo horumarinta dakhliga gudaha dalka. Hay’adda Dakhliga Qaranka ayaa la filayaa inay yeelato door muhiim ah oo ku saabsan ururinta, maamulka iyo kordhinta dakhliga gudaha, iyadoo la xoojinayo nidaamka canshuuraha iyo ilaha kale ee dakhliga dowladda. Dhismaha hay’addan ayaa qayb ka noqon kara dadaallada lagu horumarinayo maamulka maaliyadda dalka, sare loogu qaadayo hufnaanta dakhliga iyo in la helo nidaam mideysan oo lagu maareeyo ilaha dakhliga qaranka. Ansixinta Hindise-Sharciyeedkan ayaa sidoo kale muhiim u noqon karta qorshayaasha dowladda ee lagu kordhinayo dakhliga gudaha iyo yareynta ku-tiirsanaanta ilaha dhaqaale ee dibadda. Faahfaahinta xeerka iyo qaab-dhismeedka Hay’adda Dakhliga Qaranka ayaa lagu kala caddeyn doonaa marka uu sharcigu maro dhammaan marxaladaha dastuuriga ah ee looga baahan yahay dhaqan-galkiisa. #Somalia #Revenue #Tax #DakhligaQaranka

items.description: Markii ugu horraysay tan iyo markii uu dhacay dagaalkii Laascaanood ayaa baabuur Xamuul ah oo ganacsi u kala gudubtay magaalooyinka Oog iyo Laascaanood oo ahaa aag colaadeed. Afar baabuur oo xamuul ah oo uu leeyahay ganacsadaha reer Laascaanood ee Maxamed Ibraahim Jabuutaawi ayaa maanta ka gudbay laamiga magaalada Oog iyagoo ku sii jeeda magaalada Laascaanood oo ah halka ay u raran yihiin. Waddadan ayaa dagaalka ka hor maalinkasta waxa mari jiray boqolaal baabuur oo ganacsi iyo rakaab isugu jira. items.title: Uganda oo xiriirka militari u jartay Turkey kadib markii ay…
items.description: Kampala (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Uganda ayaa hakisay dhammaan iskaashigii dhinacyada militariga iyo difaaca ee kala dhexeeyay Turkiga, kadib markii Ankara ay muddo dheer diiddaneyd inay Uganda u gacan geliso Fred Lumbuye, oo ah blogger mucaarad ah oo si weyn u dhaliila Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni. Lumbuye, oo Uganda u dhashay balse ku nool Turkiga, ayaa Kampala ka wajahaya 15 dacwadood oo ay ka mid yihiin kicin rabshado, faafinta warar been abuur ah iyo ku xadgudubka sharciyada isticmaalka kombiyuutarrada. Taliyaha ciidamada Uganda, General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, oo ah wiilka Madaxweyne Museveni, ayaa muddooyinkii dambe Turkiga ku cadaadinayay inuu Lumbuye u gacan geliyo dowladda Uganda. Afhayeenka ciidamada Uganda Chris Magezi ayaa Sabtidii sheegay in ciidamada UPDF ay “si degdeg ah u hakiyeen dhammaan iskaashigii difaaca iyo militariga ee Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga”. Magezi ayaa sheegay in tallaabadaasi sii jiri doonto ilaa laga xalliyo arrimaha weli taagan ee la xiriira iskaashiga difaaca iyo militariga ee labada dal. Go’aanka ayaa yimid maalin kadib markii boqolaal taageerayaal ah oo ka tirsan Patriotic League of Uganda, oo ah urur siyaasadeed xiriir dhow la leh Kainerugaba, ay bannaanbax ka dhigeen afaafka safaaradda Turkiga ee Kampala. Dibadbaxayaasha ayaa Ankara ka dalbaday inay Uganda u soo gacan geliso Lumbuye. “Maanta halkan uma imaan inaan colaad u muujinno shacabka Turkiga, balse waxaan nahay waddaniyiin Ugandheys ah oo aad uga niyad jabsan xaaladda,” ayuu yiri xoghayaha guud ee ururka Fadil Twalla. Waxa uu sheegay in Lumbuye uu isagoo jooga Turkiga sii wado weerarrada afka ah ee ka dhanka ah hoggaanka Uganda. Kainerugaba ayaa isna qoraal uu soo dhigay baraha bulshada ku ammaanay bannaanbaxa, isaga oo sheegay in Turkigu ugu dambeyn fulin doono dalabaadka Uganda. “Turkigu wuxuu fulin doonaa dhammaan dalabaadkeenna. Haddii aysan sidaas samayn, noloshu waxay ku adkaan doontaa muwaadiniintooda ku sugan Uganda,” ayuu yiri. Maxkamad ku taalla Turkiga ayaa bishii July 2022 diidday codsi rasmi ah oo Uganda ay ku dalbatay in Lumbuye loo soo gacan geliyo. Xaaladda sharci ee Lumbuye ee Turkiga ayaan hadda si cad loo ogeyn, hase yeeshee wuxuu weli si firfircoon uga hadlaa siyaasadda Uganda, isaga oo adeegsanaya baraha bulshada iyo kanaalkiisa YouTube-ka oo ay daawadaan kumannaan qof. Arrintan ayaa siisay madal weyn oo uu ku dhaliilo dowladda Museveni xilli ay adag tahay in dadka dowladda mucaaradsan ay gudaha Uganda ka helaan fursad la mid ah. Madaxweyne Museveni ayaa bishii May loo dhaariyay muddo xileed toddobaad, halka wiilkiisa Muhoozi Kainerugaba uu sanadihii dambe noqday shaqsi awood weyn ku leh siyaasadda iyo hay’adaha ammaanka ee dalka. Xiriir difaac oo sii xumaanaya Uganda iyo Turkiga ayaa ku dhowaad toban sano lahaa xiriir difaac oo dhow. Labada dal ayaa bishii June 2016 kala saxiixday heshiis iskaashi oo ku saabsan warshadaha difaaca, kaas oo sii ballaartay kadib heshiis kale oo tababar militari ah oo la gaaray sanadkii 2022. Iskaashigaasi wuxuu ku saabsanaa tababarrada ciidamada, hubka, qalabka la socodka, wareejinta tiknoolajiyadda iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada la dagaallanka argagixisada iyo amniga. Ciidamada Uganda si faahfaahsan uma sheegin arrimaha kale ee ay ku muransan yihiin Ankara, balse hakinta iskaashiga militari waxay kusoo beegmeysaa xilli xiriirka labada dhinac uu sii xumaanayo. Kainerugaba ayaa hore ugu hanjabay in la burin karo qandaraas ku kacaya ku dhowaad saddex bilyan oo dollar oo shirkadda Turkiga laga leeyahay ee Yapi Merkezi ay ku dhiseyso waddada tareenka Standard Gauge Railway ee Uganda. Waxaa sidoo kale jiray hanjabaado la xiriiray in muwaadiniinta Turkiga laga saari karo Uganda haddii Ankara aysan wax ka beddelin mowqifkeeda. Warbaahinta Turkiga ayaa bishii June sheegtay in Kainerugaba uu shaaciyay in la kansalay qandaraaska tareenka, iyadoo arrintaas lagu tilmaamay qeyb ka mid ah khilaafka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya Kampala iyo Ankara. Muranka Lumbuye ayaa hadda isu beddelay khilaaf diblomaasiyadeed oo saameyn ku yeeshay xiriirkii difaac iyo ganacsi ee labada dal, iyadoo Uganda ay cadaadiska ku kordhineyso Turkiga si ay ugu qanciso inuu wax ka beddelo mowqifkiisa ku aaddan ninka mucaaradka ah. items.title: Ilhan Omar Unveils $139.6 Billion Plan to Redirect ICE and CBP Funds to Affected Communities
items.description: Make ICE Pay Act’ Would Channel Federal Immigration-Enforcement Funding into Recovery, Schools, Businesses and Community Services Washington (WDN) — U.S. Representative Ilhan Omar has unveiled a sweeping new proposal that would redirect nearly $140 billion in federal funding allocated to Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Protection (CBP) toward communities affected by major federal immigration-enforcement operations. The legislation, introduced as the “Make ICE Pay Act,” would redirect $139.57563 billion in previously appropriated funding into a federal grant program designed to support states and communities that have experienced the impact of large-scale ICE and CBP operations. The proposal marks a striking attempt to turn federal immigration-enforcement resources toward community recovery, with funding potentially supporting economic relief, reimbursement for costs incurred by state and local governments, schools and educational institutions, nonprofit organizations and small businesses. Money for Communities Under the proposed legislation, funds could be used to provide financial assistance to affected communities, reimburse governments for operational costs, support educational institutions and provide psychosocial and social services. The proposal also includes funding for investigations, commissions of inquiry, record-keeping and memorialization related to the impact of immigration-enforcement operations. The legislation specifically identifies Minnesota, California, Illinois, Louisiana, Maine, North Carolina and Oregon as states eligible for assistance because of named federal immigration operations. Omar’s office says the proposal is intended to help communities recover from the economic and social consequences of those operations and direct federal resources toward rebuilding affected communities. A Major Congressional Proposal Omar, a Democrat representing Minnesota, introduced the legislation alongside several House colleagues, including Representatives Angie Craig, Jesús “Chuy” García, Rashida Tlaib, Chellie Pingree, Sydney Kamlager-Dove and Janelle Bynum. Craig separately described the proposal as establishing a federal grant program to reimburse states for costs and damages associated with federal immigration-enforcement operations. The proposal follows intense political and public debate over immigration enforcement, particularly following major operations in Minnesota and other states. Omar has argued that communities affected by federal enforcement deserve financial support and a mechanism through which the consequences of those operations can be documented and addressed. From Enforcement to Recovery At the heart of the legislation is a striking policy proposition: money previously designated for federal immigration enforcement would instead be directed toward communities seeking to recover from its effects. The proposal would therefore shift the emphasis from enforcement capacity to recovery, compensation and community services. However, the legislation remains a proposal rather than law. It must proceed through the congressional legislative process, including consideration by committees and votes in the House and potentially the Senate before it could take effect. For now, the Make ICE Pay Act represents one of the most ambitious congressional proposals to redirect federal immigration-enforcement funding toward communities affected by those operations. items.title: Puntland oo sii daysay ciidamo iyo gaadiid lagu qabtay Gaalkacyo
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Raxanreeb Online) Maamulka Puntland ayaa galabta sii daayay ciidamo iyo gaadiid ay hore ugu qabteen magaalada Gaalkacyo, kuwaas oo lagu wareejiyay maamulka deriska la ah ee Galmudug. Ciidamada iyo gaadiidka ayaa lagu wareejiyay masuuliyiinta Galmudug, kaddib markii ay Puntland gacanta ku dhigtay xilli ay ku sugnaayeen magaalada Gaalkacyo. Tallaabadan ayaa timid xilli magaalada Gaalkacyo ay ka taagan tahay xaalad amni iyo xiisad u dhaxaysa dhinacyada, iyadoo labada maamul ay horey uga wada shaqeeyeen arrimaha amniga iyo xasilloonida magaalada oo labada dhinacba ay wadaagaan. Sii-deynta ciidamada iyo gaadiidka ayaa meesha ka saartay walaac laga qabay in arrintu isu beddesho xiisad dheeraad ah, taasi oo dhex abuuranta maamulada Puntland iyo Galmudug oo kawada taliyaha labada dhinac ee magaalada Gaalkacyo ee gobolka Mudug. items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo ardayda qalin-jabisay ugu baaqay inay aqoontooda bulshada uga faa’iideeyaan
items.description: Muqdisho, 21 Sebteembar 2026: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa maanta ka qeyb galay munaasabad ay ku qalin-jabinayeen arday Soomaaliyeed oo waxbarashada heerka sare ku soo dhammeystay Jaamacadda SIMAD ee Muqdisho. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ardayda ugu hambalyeeyay guusha ay gaareen, isagoo kula dardaarmay inay aqoonta iyo xirfadaha ay barteen uga faa’iideeyaan dalka iyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa sidoo kale ammaanay Jaamacadda SIMAD, isagoo sheegay inay door muhiim ah ka qaadatay horumarinta waxbarashada sare, cilmi-baarista iyo soo saarista arday leh aqoon iyo xirfado tayo leh. “Maanta waxa idiin furmay albaab cusub oo aqooneed. Haddii waxa aad soo barateen iyo marka aad albaabkaas gashaan is-khilaafaan waa dhibaato weyn,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in waxbarashadu ay tahay inay qofka wax ka beddesho, ayna ku dhiirrigeliso inuu aqoontiisa si wanaagsan ugu adeegto bulshada. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa sidoo kale xusay in guusha ardayda qalin-jabisay ay ka dhalatay samirkooda, dulqaadka waalidiintooda iyo dadaalka macallimiintii wax soo bartay. Munaasabadda ayaa kusoo beegantay xilli ay Jaamacadaha dalka sii kordhinayaan fursadaha waxbarashada heerka sare, iyadoo kumannaan arday Soomaaliyeed ay sannad kasta ka qalin-jabiyaan jaamacadaha gudaha dalka.

items.title: Beesha Xawaadle oo diiday doorashada laga qabanayo HirShabelle, kuna dhawaaqday…
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Beesha Xawaadle ayaa sheegtay inaysan aqbalayn doorasho aan laga gaarin heshiis siyaasadeed oo ay dhinacyadu ku mideysan yihiin, kaddib wadatashiyo dhowr maalmood magaalada Beledweyne uga socday siyaasiyiin iyo waxgarad ka tirsan beesha. Natiijada kulamadaas waxaa warbaahinta uga hadlay Xoghayihii hore ee maamulka gobolka Banaadir, Xiirey Axmed Rooble, kaas oo sheegay in wadatashiyada laga soo saaray qodobo ay beesha Xawaadle ku mideysan tahay, kuwaas oo si gaar ah ula xiriira doorashada iyo xaaladda siyaasadeed ee gobolka Hiiraan. Mowqifka ugu weyn ee kasoo baxay shirarka ayaa ah diidmada doorasho aan heshiis siyaasadeed laga gaarin. Xiirey ayaa sheegay inaysan beesha oggolaan doonin doorasho lagu qabto gobolka iyadoo aysan jirin heshiis ay dhinacyadu ku wada qanacsan yihiin. “Waxay beesha mar kale ku celinaysaa inaysan wax doorasho ah oo qasab ah oo aan heshiis lagu ahayn, ka dhici karin gobolka Hiiraan, magaalooyinkiisa, degmooyinkiisa iyo tuulooyinkiisa,” ayuu yiri Xiirey Axmed Rooble. Wuxuu xusay in mowqifkan uu yahay mid kasoo baxay wadatashiyadii ay yeesheen siyaasiyiinta iyo waxgaradka beesha, kaasi oo sidoo kale lagu gaaray in 24-ka September la qabto banaanbaxyo nabadeed oo looga soo horjeedo doorashada la qorsheynayo in laga qabto maamulka HirShabelle. “Qodobka labaad ee kasoo baxay wadatashiyada waa in September loo asteeyo maalin bannaanbaxyo nabadeed oo looga soo horjeedo doorashada aan heshiiska lagu ahayn,” ayuu yiri Xiirey oo ugu baaqay shacabka ku nool gobollada, degmooyinka iyo tuulooyinka inay is abaabulaan oo ay si nabad ah isugu soo baxaan si ay u muujiyaan mowqifkooda. Bannaanbaxyada ayuu sheegay inay shacabka ku muujin doonaan inaysan raalli ka ahayn doorasho uu ku tilmaamay “khasab iyo heshiis la’aan.” Sidoo kale, waxaa la go’aamiyay in la sii wado wadatashiyada lala yeelanayo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada ku nool Beledweyne iyo guud ahaan gobolka Hiiraan. Xiirey ayaa sheegay in marka wadatashiyada la soo gaba-gabeeyo ay kasoo bixi doonaan go’aamo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo masiiri ah, kuwaas oo horseedi kara in dadka reer Hiiraan iyo bulshada HirShabelle ay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan dhismaha maamul loo dhan yahay oo ay dhammaan dhinacyadu ku qanacsan yihiin. Isagoo ka hadlayay xaaladda ka dhalan karta haddii la qabto doorasho uu ku tilmaamay khasab, Xiirey wuxuu sheegay in haddii doorashadaasi ay keento shaqaaqo ama waxyeello loo geysto shacabka ay mas’uuliyadda wixii ka dhasha qaadi doonaan dhinacyada uu ku eedeeyay inay mas’uul ka yihiin geeddi-socodka doorashada, oo ah hoggaanka Dowladda Federaalka. Ugu dambeyntiina, wuxuu u mahadceliyay shacabka ku nool Jalalaqsi, Matabaan iyo Jawiil oo uu sheegay inay hore u muujiyeen diidmada doorasho uu ku tilmaamay mid hal dhinac ah, ayna qabteen bannaanbaxyo looga soo horjeedo. Xiirey ayaa sheegay in marka wadatashiyada la soo gaba-gabeeyo ay kasoo bixi doonaan go’aamo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo masiiri ah, kuwaas oo horseedi kara in dadka reer Hiiraan iyo bulshada HirShabelle ay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan dhismaha maamul loo dhan yahay oo ay dhammaan dhinacyadu ku qanacsan yihiin. Isagoo ka hadlayay xaaladda ka dhalan karta haddii la qabto doorasho uu ku tilmaamay khasab, Xiirey wuxuu sheegay in haddii doorashadaasi ay keento shaqaaqo ama waxyeello loo geysto shacabka ay mas’uuliyadda wixii ka dhasha qaadi doonaan dhinacyada uu ku eedeeyay inay mas’uul ka yihiin geeddi-socodka doorashada, oo ah hoggaanka Dowladda Federaalka. Ugu dambeyntiina, wuxuu u mahadceliyay shacabka ku nool Jalalaqsi, Matabaan iyo Jawiil oo uu sheegay inay hore u muujiyeen diidmada doorasho uu ku tilmaamay mid hal dhinac ah, ayna qabteen bannaanbaxyo looga soo horjeedo. items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo qaabilay Taliyaha Difaaca Cirka ee Pakistan
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa maanta Xarunta Taliska ee Magaalada Muqdisho ku qaabilay wafdi ka socda Dowladda Pakistan. Wafdigan oo uu hoggaaminayo Taliyaha Difaaca Cirka ahna Taliye Kuxigeenka Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan, Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz ayaa Axaddii soo gaaray Caasimadda Muqdisho, iyagoona la kulmay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Kulanka Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka uu la yeeshay wafdigan ayaa looga hadlay dardargelinta dhismaha iyo sare u qaadista awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dhinacyada tababarka, tayaynta iyo horumarinta awoodaha ciidanka, sida lagu sheegay war ka soo baxay Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. “Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta wada-shaqaynta iyo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca iyo amniga, si loo sii horumariyo xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ka dhexeeya Somaliya iyo Pakistan.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Xiriirka iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga ee labada dal ayaa galay weji cusub oo taariikhi ah, ka dib markii labada dowladood ay bishii August Magaalada Islamabad ku kala saxiixdeen heshiis is afgarad oo dhanka difaaca ah. Iskaashigan ayaa lagu sheegay kii ugu ballaarnaa ee dhex mara Muqdisho iyo Islamabad, muddo dhowr iyo toban sano ah, iyadoona uu diiradda saarayo dhismaha awoodda ciidanka, amniga badda iyo cirka.

items.title: Irro-Firdhiye Peace Overture Opens Door to Reconciliation — But Las Anod’s Future Remains the Hardest Question
items.description: Somaliland and Northeastern Leaders Signal Readiness for Dialogue, But Their Visions for Sool Remain Fundamentally Different LasAnod (WDN) — A potentially significant opening for reconciliation has emerged between Somaliland and the Northeastern State administration, as President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi “Irro” signals renewed willingness to resolve the long-running dispute over Las Anod through dialogue, while President Abdikadir Ahmed Aw-Ali “Firdhiye” continues to emphasize peaceful relations with Somaliland as neighboring administrations. Irro has expressed optimism that the people of Sool and Somaliland can overcome their differences, emphasizing their deep family and social ties and saying he has established a peace committee to pursue reconciliation. “We are related by blood and kinship. We are not people who can live without one another,” Irro said, adding that he hoped the two sides’ peace committees could meet and work toward an understanding. The initiative is significant. After years of confrontation surrounding Las Anod, a willingness by the two administrations to engage through dialogue rather than military confrontation could provide an important opportunity for de-escalation and reconciliation. Irro has previously called for a comprehensive peace agreement, prisoner exchanges and the restoration of movement and trade. The Difficult Question Behind the Dialogue Yet beneath the language of reconciliation lies the central political disagreement that has complicated the issue for years: what happens to Las Anod and the wider Sool area after peace is achieved? Somaliland’s position is rooted in its claim that the people and territories it considers part of Somaliland should remain within its political framework. Irro has emphasized the shared identity, blood ties and historical connections between Sool communities and Somaliland, while his administration has also welcomed politicians from the Northeastern State who subsequently returned to Hargeisa. The Northeastern State, by contrast, was formally established as a federal member state of Somalia, with Las Anod as its administrative capital, and President Firdhiye has been operating within that framework. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud attended Firdhiye’s inauguration in Las Anod in January 2026, reinforcing the federal government’s recognition of the administration. That creates the central challenge. Irro appears to see reconciliation as potentially leading toward the reintegration of Las Anod and its surrounding communities into Somaliland, while Firdhiye’s position is centered on maintaining the Northeastern State as a separate Somali administration and establishing peaceful relations with Somaliland as a neighbor. Until that fundamental difference is addressed, even the most encouraging peace initiative will face difficult negotiations. From Battlefield to Dialogue The opportunity nevertheless should not be underestimated. For communities that have experienced years of political tension and armed confrontation, an agreement to communicate directly would represent a meaningful departure from the logic of confrontation. Irro has repeatedly said that his government wants the Las Anod issue resolved through dialogue, reconciliation and consensus rather than renewed conflict. Firdhiye, meanwhile, has an opportunity to demonstrate that the Northeastern State’s relationship with Somaliland can be defined by practical cooperation, security coordination, trade and peaceful coexistence without requiring agreement on their respective political identities. That distinction could be crucial. Peace does not necessarily require the two administrations to agree on every constitutional or political question before they can begin working together. A Chance for Two Brotherly Communities The people on both sides of the political divide share extensive family, clan, cultural and economic ties. Those relationships create a foundation upon which dialogue can potentially be built. The immediate objective could therefore be narrower and more practical: preventing renewed violence, facilitating the movement of people and goods, resolving humanitarian and security concerns, encouraging prisoner or detainee arrangements where applicable, and creating mechanisms through which political disagreements can be addressed without armed confrontation. The larger political question can then be addressed through sustained negotiations. The greatest opportunity in the current moment is that both sides are publicly speaking the language of peace. The greatest obstacle is that they appear to envision different destinations. For reconciliation to succeed, the dialogue will need to move beyond expressions of brotherhood and determine whether the parties can establish a political formula that respects the realities on the ground while preventing the dispute over Las Anod from returning to violence. After years of tension, even that first step would be significant. The door to dialogue appears to be open. The real test now is whether Irro and Firdhiye can walk through it without demanding that the other side first surrender its political position. items.title: Mobile Phone Dispute Ends in Double Killing as Somali Military Court Hears Extraordinary Case
items.description: NISA Officer Tells Court He Intervened as a Mediator and Did Not Know the Weapon Was Loaded MOGADISHU (WDN) — An extraordinary case unfolding before Somalia’s Military Court has offered a striking glimpse into the difficult and sometimes dangerous situations faced by the country’s security personnel, after a seemingly ordinary dispute over a mobile phone allegedly ended in two deaths and another person being wounded. Military Court Chairman General Hassan Nur Shuute and his panel have completed hearings in the case, which has presented the court with sharply conflicting accounts of how a confrontation involving security personnel and civilians escalated into deadly violence. The prosecution has accused NISA officer Dahir Abdi Dahir of killing two people and wounding a third during the incident. But Dahir has strongly disputed the prosecution’s account, telling the court that he intervened only to calm a confrontation between another soldier and a civilian and that the fatal shooting was accidental. According to the case presented before the court, the dispute began after government soldier Sadiq Abdirahman Hashi was accused of taking a mobile phone from a civilian. When an argument subsequently developed, Dahir allegedly intervened after being called upon to assist. The prosecution maintains that Dahir went beyond his assigned duties and became involved in the confrontation, ultimately firing a burst from a weapon that killed two people and injured another. Dahir, however, gave the court a markedly different account. He said he entered the confrontation as a humanitarian intervention and did not even know the other soldier involved. He further testified that the firearm had been handed to him without his knowledge that it contained ammunition. According to his testimony, the deceased civilian later identified as Abdullahi Hassan Socdaal grabbed or struggled with the weapon, resulting in the fatal discharge. The case concerns the deaths of Socdaal and a Haramcad police officer, Hassan Kuusow, as well as injuries sustained by Mohamed Ahmed Hussein. The conflicting accounts have placed the court before a difficult legal question: whether the deaths resulted from deliberate use of force, negligence, an accidental discharge during a struggle, or a combination of circumstances surrounding the confrontation. The prosecution has argued that Dahir failed in his professional responsibilities and improperly intervened in the dispute, with the confrontation ultimately producing fatal consequences. The defence position, meanwhile, portrays the officer as a security professional attempting to prevent a civilian-soldier confrontation from escalating, only for the situation to spiral beyond his control. The case has now entered a decisive stage, with General Shuute and the military court panel expected to consider the testimony and evidence before issuing their ruling. The proceedings underscore the enormous responsibility carried by Somali security personnel, whose decisions in tense situations can have immediate and irreversible consequences. For the court, the central task is now to separate competing claims from established facts and determine responsibility under Somali law. With the hearings concluded, attention turns to the verdict — a decision expected to clarify what happened during the extraordinary confrontation and whether the fatal shooting was an intentional act, negligence or a tragic accident. items.title: Iran Sends Conditions to Washington Through Mediators as Hormuz Standoff Deepens
items.description: Parliament Speaker Says Tehran Wants to Combine Military Pressure with Diplomacy and Rules Out Returning to Previous Talks Until Its Demands Are Met TEHRAN (WDN) — Iran says it has delivered its conditions for renewed negotiations with the United States through intermediaries, opening another potential diplomatic channel even as Tehran warns that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until its demands are addressed. Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf confirmed that Tehran had communicated messages and negotiating conditions to Washington through mediators. Addressing parliament, Ghalibaf said Iran should pursue diplomacy while maintaining its military posture, arguing that the country must be prepared to fight while continuing to negotiate. “We must fight and negotiate at the same time,” he said, according to reports of his remarks. Ghalibaf said Iran’s messages and conditions had been clearly conveyed to the United States through intermediaries. He added that Tehran would not return to the previous framework of negotiations or reopen the Strait of Hormuz until its preliminary conditions were fulfilled. His comments came a day after Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, said Tehran had transmitted conditions for renewed talks through mediators from Qatar and Pakistan and was awaiting a response from U.S. President Donald Trump. Rezaei said the conditions included an end to the war on all fronts, the release of frozen Iranian assets and an end to the U.S. naval blockade. He said Tehran remained in contact with Qatar, which had conveyed Iran’s demands to Washington. Diplomacy Amid Escalation The latest messages point to a striking dual-track strategy from Tehran: maintaining military pressure while keeping a diplomatic channel open. The development comes after months of fighting and the collapse of an earlier Pakistan-hosted understanding intended to halt hostilities and pave the way for broader negotiations. Iran and the United States have continued indirect contacts despite the breakdown. The Strait of Hormuz has become a central element of the confrontation. Iran is making its reopening conditional on the fulfilment of its demands, adding another major obstacle to any immediate return to the previous negotiating framework. The waterway is one of the world’s most important energy corridors, making the dispute over its status consequential far beyond the region. For now, Tehran says the message has been delivered. The next move rests with Washington. With Iranian officials simultaneously speaking of negotiations and military preparedness, the latest developments suggest that diplomacy has not disappeared from the equation — but neither has the threat of further escalation. items.title: Qaxootiga Yemen oo badbaado u raadsanaya Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti
items.description: Tirada qaxootiga Yemeniyiinta ee gaaraya Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti ayaa korortay bishan September, ka dib markii dalkaasi ay dib uga soo cusboonaadeen dagaalada u dhexeeya Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta iyo Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen ee caalamka uu aqoonsan yahay. Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen oo Sacuudiga uu taageero ayaa Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta dagaalo culus kula galay deegaanada xeebaha galbeed ee dalkaasi ee ku teedsan Badda Cas iyo Marinka Bab El-Mandeb, iyadoo tanina ay dadka deegaanka ku khasabtay in ay isaga cararaan guryahooda. Qaxootiga Yemen ayaa toddobaadkii hore bilaabay in ay gaaraan Gobolka Obock ee Waqooyiga Jabuuti, gaar ahaan iyagoo ka gelaya deegaanada Khor Angar, Moulhoule iyo Godoria. Maalmihii u dambeeyay ayaa waxaa dalkaasi gaaray dad qaxooti ah oo tiradooda lagu sheegay 3,100 qof oo ka yimid Yemen, kuwaas oo u badan haween iyo carruur, waxayna Dowladda Jabuuti ay dib u dejin ugu sameysay xerada qaxootiga Markazi. “Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay inaan wax ka qabanayno qaybta ugu nugul dadweynaha.” Ayay tiri Ramatou Toure, Wakiilka Hay’adda UNICEF ee Jabuuti. Waxay sheegtay in qulqulka qaxootiga ee ku sii jeeda Jabuuti uu noqon karo kii ugu ballaarnaa ee ka imaanaya Yemen, tan iyo markii uu dagaalkii sokeeye ka bilowday, sanadkii 2014. Saraakiisha Qaramada Midoobey ayaa sheegay in 120,000 oo qof oo reer Yemen ah ay barakaceen, sababo la xiriira kororka degdegga ah ee dagaalada ka socda xeebaha galbeed ee dalkaasi. Dowladda Jabuuti ayaa qorsheynaysa inay ballaariso xeryaha qaxootiga, haddii ay dagaaladu sii socdaan. Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Jabuuti, Cumar Cabdi Saciid iyo Wasiirka Dhaqaalaha, Ilyaas Muuse Dawaleh ayaa sheegay in qulqulka qaxootiga uu culeys weyn ku keenay adeegyada dalka, iyagoona codsaday kaalmo caalami ah. Hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobey sida IOM iyo UNHCR ayaa wada dadaalo ay gurmad raashiin, biyo iyo dawo ku gaarsiinayaan qaxootiga cusub. Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo sanado ka hor la wareegay inta badan aagagga ay dadku ku badan yihiin ee dalkaasi ayaa horaantii bishan u jiheystay dhanka xeebta, iyagoona la wareegay gacan ku haynta magaalada dekedda leh ee Mokha iyo marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb, kaas oo muhiim u ah isu socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee Asia, Bariga Afrika iyo Yurub, iyadoo marinkan uu Badda Cas ku xiro Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Sacuudiga oo bari-taara Xukuumadda Yemen ee Qaramada Midoobey aqoonsan tahay ayaa wada duulaan ballaaran oo xagga cirka ah, laguna xakameynayo is ballaarinta Xuutiyiinta, halka Xuutiyiinta ay kaga jawaabayaan weeraro ay u adeegsanayaan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo gantaalada ballaastikada, oo ay ku beegsanayaan kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo militariga ee boqortooyada. Qaxootiga reer Yemen oo doomaha nooca yaryar ku tegay Jabuuti ayaa sheegay inay aad uga cabsanayeen duqaymaha dhanka cirka ee Sacuudiga uu sii xoojiyay. Ergeyga Qaramada Midoobey ee Yemen, Hans Grundberg ayaa walaac ka muujiyay xaaladda ka sii dareysa ee dalkaasi.

Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen oo Sacuudiga uu taageero ayaa Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta dagaalo culus kula galay deegaanada xeebaha galbeed ee dalkaasi ee ku teedsan Badda Cas iyo Marinka Bab El-Mandeb, iyadoo tanina ay dadka deegaanka ku khasabtay in ay isaga cararaan guryahooda. Qaxootiga Yemen ayaa toddobaadkii hore bilaabay in ay gaaraan Gobolka Obock ee Waqooyiga Jabuuti, gaar ahaan iyagoo ka gelaya deegaanada Khor Angar, Moulhoule iyo Godoria. Maalmihii u dambeeyay ayaa waxaa dalkaasi gaaray dad qaxooti ah oo tiradooda lagu sheegay 3,100 qof oo ka yimid Yemen, kuwaas oo u badan haween iyo carruur, waxayna Dowladda Jabuuti ay dib u dejin ugu sameysay xerada qaxootiga Markazi. “Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay inaan wax ka qabanayno qaybta ugu nugul dadweynaha.” Ayay tiri Ramatou Toure, Wakiilka Hay’adda UNICEF ee Jabuuti. Waxay sheegtay in qulqulka qaxootiga ee ku sii jeeda Jabuuti uu noqon karo kii ugu ballaarnaa ee ka imaanaya Yemen, tan iyo markii uu dagaalkii sokeeye ka bilowday, sanadkii 2014. Saraakiisha Qaramada Midoobey ayaa sheegay in 120,000 oo qof oo reer Yemen ah ay barakaceen, sababo la xiriira kororka degdegga ah ee dagaalada ka socda xeebaha galbeed ee dalkaasi. Dowladda Jabuuti ayaa qorsheynaysa inay ballaariso xeryaha qaxootiga, haddii ay dagaaladu sii socdaan. Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Jabuuti, Cumar Cabdi Saciid iyo Wasiirka Dhaqaalaha, Ilyaas Muuse Dawaleh ayaa sheegay in qulqulka qaxootiga uu culeys weyn ku keenay adeegyada dalka, iyagoona codsaday kaalmo caalami ah. Hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobey sida IOM iyo UNHCR ayaa wada dadaalo ay gurmad raashiin, biyo iyo dawo ku gaarsiinayaan qaxootiga cusub. Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo sanado ka hor la wareegay inta badan aagagga ay dadku ku badan yihiin ee dalkaasi ayaa horaantii bishan u jiheystay dhanka xeebta, iyagoona la wareegay gacan ku haynta magaalada dekedda leh ee Mokha iyo marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb, kaas oo muhiim u ah isu socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee Asia, Bariga Afrika iyo Yurub, iyadoo marinkan uu Badda Cas ku xiro Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Sacuudiga oo bari-taara Xukuumadda Yemen ee Qaramada Midoobey aqoonsan tahay ayaa wada duulaan ballaaran oo xagga cirka ah, laguna xakameynayo is ballaarinta Xuutiyiinta, halka Xuutiyiinta ay kaga jawaabayaan weeraro ay u adeegsanayaan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo gantaalada ballaastikada, oo ay ku beegsanayaan kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo militariga ee boqortooyada. Qaxootiga reer Yemen oo doomaha nooca yaryar ku tegay Jabuuti ayaa sheegay inay aad uga cabsanayeen duqaymaha dhanka cirka ee Sacuudiga uu sii xoojiyay. Ergeyga Qaramada Midoobey ee Yemen, Hans Grundberg ayaa walaac ka muujiyay xaaladda ka sii dareysa ee dalkaasi.

items.title: Sirta qorshaha Imaaraadku ka lahaa dekedda Berbera oo u muuqda inuu soo shaac baxay
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Dekedda Berbera ayaa hadda ku shaqeysa qiyaastii 30% awoodda ay leedahay, inkastoo boqolaal milyan oo dollar lagu maalgeliyey qorshe lagu doonayey in dekedda looga dhigo marin ganacsi oo weyn oo Itoobiya iyo dalalka kale ee Geeska Afrika adeegsadaan. Jaamac Maxamed Axmed, oo ah agaasimaha ganacsiga DP World ee Geeska Afrika, ayaa xogtan ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyey warbaahinta Middle East Eye , oo Axaddii daabacay warbixin dheer oo ku saabsan dekedda Berbera iyo tartanka istiraatiijiyadeed ee ka jira Badda Cas. Shirkadda DP World ayaa awoodda qaadista konteenarrada ee dekedda gaarsiisay 500,000 TEU sanadkii, halka ay sidoo kale qaadi karto qiyaastii laba milyan oo tan oo xamuul guud iyo badeecooyin kale ah. DP World waxay xaqiijineysaa in awoodda konteenarradu ay korortay 150,000 TEU kahor ballaarinta koowaad ilaa 500,000 TEU maanta. Hase yeeshee, Jaamac ayaa Middle East Eye u sheegay in dekeddu ay hadda isticmaasho qiyaastii 30% awooddeeda, xilli qorshayaashii lagu doonayey in qeybo badan oo ganacsiga Itoobiya loo soo wareejiyo Berbera aysan u hirgelin sidii la filayey. Arrintan ayaa muujineysa farqiga weli u dhexeeya awoodda weyn ee laga dhisay dekedda iyo xaddiga ganacsiga dhab ahaan ka socda. DP World ayaa muddo dheer Berbera u soo bandhigeysay marin kale oo Itoobiya u fududeyn kara ganacsigeeda caalamiga ah, iyadoo dalkaas aan bad lahayn uu inta badan badeecadihiisa kala soo dego dekedaha Jabuuti. Rajadaas ayaa sii xoogeysatay bishii Janaayo 2024, markii Itoobiya iyo Somaliland ay kala saxiixdeen heshiis is-afgarad ah oo la xiriiray marin badeed. Heshiiskaas waxaa si xooggan uga hortimid dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, oo ku tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dalka. Khilaafkii ka dhashay ayaa markii dambe horseeday dhex-dhexaadin ay Turkigu sameeyeen, iyadoo Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ay bishii December 2024 ku gaareen Ankara heshiis dhigaya in arrimaha marin-badeedka Itoobiya lagu wajaho iyadoo la ixtiraamayo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Sida uu sheegay Jama, qorshayaashii ganacsiga Itoobiya ee la filayey inay si weyn u kordhiyaan isticmaalka Berbera ayaan weli rumoobin. Runta qorshaha Imaaraadka Axmed Cabdi, oo ah falanqeeye arrimaha juqraafi-siyaasadeed oo fadhigiisu yahay Muqdisho, ayaa Caasimada Online u sheegay in xogta cusub ee muujineysa in Berbera ay ku shaqeyso 30% awooddeeda ay dib u soo celinayso su’aalihii muddada dheer laga qabay ujeeddada Imaaraadka Carabta ee dekedaha Berbera iyo Boosaaso. “Arrintan waxay caddeyn u tahay wixii aan muddo aaminsaneyn, ee ah in sababta Imaaraadku ula wareegay dekedaha Berbera iyo Boosaaso ay tahay inuu yareeyo tartanka, isla markaana ilaaliyo dekedda Jebel Ali,” ayuu yiri Axmed Cabdi. “Qorshuhu wuxuu mar walba ahaa in maamullada halkaas ka jira la siiyo dhaqaale iyo horumarin kooban, balse mustaqbalka laga hortago inay halkaas ka dhismaan dekedo awood u leh inay la tartamaan dekedda Dubai,” ayuu sii raaciyey. DP World, dhinaceeda, waxay sheegtaa in maalgelinteeda Berbera ay ujeeddadeedu tahay ballaarinta ganacsiga gobolka, casriyeynta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo in dalalka Geeska Afrika loo helo marinno ganacsi oo dheeraad ah. Shirkaddu waxay sheegtay in tan iyo markii ay howlaha Berbera billowday 2017, mugga konteenarrada dekedda uu kordhay 30%, halka xamuulka guud uu kordhay 90%. Axmed Cabdi ayaa Somaliland iyo Puntland ugu baaqay inay dib u eegaan heshiisyada ay la leeyihiin DP World, isagoo tusaale u soo qaatay Jabuuti iyo Eritrea oo horey khilaafyo iyo isbeddello uga dhacay heshiisyadii ay la lahaayeen shirkadda. Dooddan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay 12-kii Janaayo 2026 ku dhawaaqday inay joojisay dhammaan heshiisyadii ay la lahayd Imaaraadka Carabta, oo ay ku jiraan heshiisyo la xiriira dekedaha, hay’adaha dowladda, amniga iyo difaaca. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in go’aankaasi saameynayo heshiisyada la xiriira dekedaha Berbera, Boosaaso iyo Kismaayo, iyadoo dowladda ay ku sababeysay ilaalinta madax-bannaanida, wadajirka dhuleed iyo midnimada qaranka. Somaliland, Puntland iyo Jubbaland ayaa markaas diiday go’aanka Muqdisho, iyagoo sheegay inay sii wadayaan xiriirkooda iyo heshiisyadooda Imaaraadka. DP World-na waxay sheegtay in howlaheeda dekedda Berbera aysan saameyn ku yeelan khilaafka u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo UAE. Maalgashi gaaraya $442 milyan DP World ayaa dekedda Berbera ku maamusha heshiis muddo dheer ah, waxaana shirkaddu ballanqaadday maalgelin gaareysa $442 milyan. Marxaladdii koowaad ee ballaarinta ayaa awoodda konteenarrada ka kordhisay 150,000 TEU ilaa 500,000 TEU sanadkii, halka wejiga labaad ee qorshuhu uu awoodda dekedda gaarsiin karo laba milyan oo TEU sanadkii. Shirkaddu waxay sidoo kale horumarisay Aagga Dhaqaalaha Berbera iyo waddo ganacsi oo isku xirta dekedda iyo xadka Itoobiya. Inkasta oo qeyb weyn oo awoodda dekeddu aysan hadda shaqeyn, Berbera waxay weli qaabilaysaa badeecooyin caalami ah iyo kuwo gobolka loo sii gudbiyo. Middle East Eye ayaa sheegtay in intii weriyaheedu joogay dekedda halkaas laga rarayey qamadi Ruushka ka yimid oo loo sii waday Itoobiya iyo Koonfurta Sudan, halka konteenarro Shiinaha ka yimid oo ku sii jeeday Masar lagu kala wareejinayey maraakiib. Waxaa sidoo kale halkaas laga dejinayey sonkor Hindiya ka timid iyo alwaax laga keenay Malaysia oo loogu talagalay suuqa Somaliland. Jaamac Maxamed Axmed ayaa, inkastoo heerka isticmaalka dekeddu hooseeyo, sheegay inuu weli ku kalsoon yahay in ganacsigu mustaqbalka kordhi doono. “Kaabeyaashii oo dhan waa joogaan. Waa arrin waqti uun ah,” ayuu u sheegay Middle East Eye . The post Sirta qorshaha Imaaraadku ka lahaa dekedda Berbera oo u muuqda inuu soo shaac baxay appeared first on Caasimada Online .
