items.title: Money from Home: How Somalis Abroad Are Quietly Building a Nation
items.description: By Keynan Jama Every year, Somalis abroad send home more money than the federal government spends. In 2023, remittances reached about USD 1.7 billion—more than the federal budget that year and more than the USD 1.1 billion received by aid agencies. The 2025 federal budget was USD 1.34 billion. Remittances equal roughly one-sixth of Somalia’s economy, and about four in ten households receive them. For decades we called this a lifeline. That word now feels too small. A lifeline is thrown once; whether it lands is the whole story. What happens next is changing—from survival to strategy, from family support to community investment. Where the money is going Writing in Kenya’s The Star, Bashir Abdille traced how Somali diaspora finance, with Dahabshiil as a central example, has moved through stages. Money still pays school fees, medical bills, and food. But diaspora resources also support telecommunications, financial services, energy, and property. Abdille argues more could flow into agriculture, technology, housing, education, healthcare, and infrastructure. This is no longer only survival money; it is longer-term capital. Stories that show the shift Consider Amina, a nurse in Minneapolis. For fifteen years she sent $300–400 a month to her mother in Mogadishu for food, medicine, and school uniforms. In 2022, she and three cousins pooled savings and bought a small plot outside the city. They built a modest apartment block. Rents now cover the original family support and generate income for a second building. Amina still sends money—but part of it now supports a lasting local asset. Amina’s story is not isolated. Across the Horn and the Gulf, diaspora resources have helped build private universities, cold-storage facilities, and mobile-money agents that reach villages banks ignore. The pattern is consistent: people who know the local market, trust local networks, and plan to remain connected are directing money into assets that last longer than a monthly transfer. Why this matters The people sending money know the market, trust local systems, and want their hometowns strong in two decades, not just this month. Diaspora resources are patient, informed, and committed. They already function like patient capital; they simply move through family and community ties rather than formal contracts. This support has rewritten parts of Somalia’s economic map. Telecom companies seeded by diaspora resources now connect millions. Real-estate developments in Hargeisa, Garowe, and Mogadishu have been financed by relatives abroad. Energy projects—from solar mini-grids to generator networks—increasingly involve diaspora participants. Why infrastructure is the missing foundation Private activity without reliable infrastructure is structurally incomplete. Individual businesses can succeed, but they struggle to scale, reach wider markets, or deliver productivity gains. Somalia’s gaps remain severe. Electricity reaches roughly half the population, with lower rates outside major cities. Most power comes from fragmented private diesel mini-grids. Tariffs often run between $0.40 and $1.00 per kilowatt-hour—several times the African average—and supply is unreliable. Firms absorb high generator and fuel costs or limit output. Roads tell the same story. Of roughly 21,800 kilometres, only about 13 percent are paved, and most paved sections have deteriorated past their design life. Journeys between major cities can take days. Seasonal flooding cuts routes. Transport costs rise, supply chains fracture, and markets stay small and local. Ports face congestion and high fees; cold-chain storage is scarce. Goods spoil, prices stay high, and expansion becomes prohibitively expensive. These constraints place a ceiling on what private resources can achieve. A well-run clinic or factory still faces steep costs and limited reach if diesel is the only dependable power and moving products costs more than the products themselves. Diaspora participants can support solar systems, apartment blocks, or small logistics ventures. They cannot alone rebuild trunk roads, transmission networks, or port capacity that would let those activities multiply. Long-term infrastructure deficits require deliberate, coordinated effort. Public investment, clearer regulation, public-private partnerships, and sustained external support are necessary. Diaspora resources can and should play a larger role in energy, housing, and logistics. But the foundational networks that lower costs for everyone remain a shared national task. Until they improve, even the most patient private resources will deliver less than they could. The missing option Today a Somali in Manchester, Minneapolis, or Melbourne who wants to direct resources home has two routes: send cash to a relative, or do nothing. There is no widely available, regulated, transparent structure for participating in longer-term local projects with clear information on how resources are used and how they perform. That third route does not yet exist at scale. Building it would not be only a government task. Regulators can set rules; diaspora families, local business owners, and communities would decide what is useful. Any future arrangements would be shaped by the questions people ask: How is information shared? Who is responsible? How are outcomes reported? What protections exist? We want to hear from you Are you part of the Somali diaspora? Do you send money home? We are interested in your views on how remittances and diaspora resources work, and what information or structures would be useful. We are running a short anonymous survey for research purposes. It takes about four minutes. Your answers are anonymous unless you leave an email to be contacted. Full details are on the below survey’s . Take the survey → Important notice This article and the survey are research only. They are not an offer, invitation, or solicitation to invest. No investment product, security, or financial instrument is being offered, promoted, or discussed as available. Nothing here constitutes financial, investment, or legal advice. Any future opportunity would be communicated only through channels permitted under the laws of your country of residence, including the United States, the United Kingdom, and European Union member states. Keynan Jama Email: keynanj123@gmail.com ——– Sources Remittances 2023: The New Humanitarian, 30 September 2025; OCHA 2023 Somalia humanitarian dashboard. Federal budget 2025: Council of Ministers approval, reported by AllAfrica, October 2024. Remittances as share of GDP: World Bank, 11 February 2025. Household reach: Rift Valley Institute, 2018. Sector shift: Bashir Abdille, The Star (Kenya), 16 August 2026. Infrastructure constraints: World Bank, IEA Somalia, AfDB, National Transformation Plan 2025–2029. Diaspora resources are patient, informed, and committed. They already function like patient capital; they simply move through family and community ties rather than formal contracts. This support has rewritten parts of Somalia’s economic map. Telecom companies seeded by diaspora resources now connect millions. Real-estate developments in Hargeisa, Garowe, and Mogadishu have been financed by relatives abroad. Energy projects—from solar mini-grids to generator networks—increasingly involve diaspora participants. Why infrastructure is the missing foundation Private activity without reliable infrastructure is structurally incomplete. Individual businesses can succeed, but they struggle to scale, reach wider markets, or deliver productivity gains. Somalia’s gaps remain severe. Electricity reaches roughly half the population, with lower rates outside major cities. Most power comes from fragmented private diesel mini-grids. Tariffs often run between $0.40 and $1.00 per kilowatt-hour—several times the African average—and supply is unreliable. Firms absorb high generator and fuel costs or limit output. Roads tell the same story. Of roughly 21,800 kilometres, only about 13 percent are paved, and most paved sections have deteriorated past their design life. Journeys between major cities can take days. Seasonal flooding cuts routes. Transport costs rise, supply chains fracture, and markets stay small and local. Ports face congestion and high fees; cold-chain storage is scarce. Goods spoil, prices stay high, and expansion becomes prohibitively expensive. These constraints place a ceiling on what private resources can achieve. A well-run clinic or factory still faces steep costs and limited reach if diesel is the only dependable power and moving products costs more than the products themselves. Diaspora participants can support solar systems, apartment blocks, or small logistics ventures. They cannot alone rebuild trunk roads, transmission networks, or port capacity that would let those activities multiply. Long-term infrastructure deficits require deliberate, coordinated effort. Public investment, clearer regulation, public-private partnerships, and sustained external support are necessary. Diaspora resources can and should play a larger role in energy, housing, and logistics. But the foundational networks that lower costs for everyone remain a shared national task. Until they improve, even the most patient private resources will deliver less than they could. The missing option Today a Somali in Manchester, Minneapolis, or Melbourne who wants to direct resources home has two routes: send cash to a relative, or do nothing. There is no widely available, regulated, transparent structure for participating in longer-term local projects with clear information on how resources are used and how they perform. That third route does not yet exist at scale. Building it would not be only a government task. Regulators can set rules; diaspora families, local business owners, and communities would decide what is useful. Any future arrangements would be shaped by the questions people ask: How is information shared? Who is responsible? How are outcomes reported? What protections exist? We want to hear from you Are you part of the Somali diaspora? Do you send money home? We are interested in your views on how remittances and diaspora resources work, and what information or structures would be useful. We are running a short anonymous survey for research purposes. items.title: AI oo EU Ku Riixday Xeerar Cusub
items.description: Midowga Yurub oo xarumaha xogta ku waajibinaya inay shaaciyaan isticmaalka tamarta iyo biyaha BRUSSELS — Midowga Yurub ayaa soo jeediyay xeerar cusub oo ku qasbaya xarumaha xogta (data centres) ee ku yaalla Yurub inay si cad u soo bandhigaan sida hufan ee ay u isticmaalaan korontada iyo biyaha, iyadoo kororka adeegyada sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) uu sare u qaadayo baahida loo qabo xarumo xogeed waaweyn. Guddiga Yurub ayaa Isniintii, 21-ka Sebtembar 2026, soo bandhigay nidaam Midowga Yurub oo lagu qiimeynayo xarumaha xogta, kaas oo lagu doonayo in xogta ku saabsan isticmaalka tamarta iyo saameynta deegaanka ay noqoto mid la isbarbar dhigi karo oo si fudud loo heli karo. Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Midowga Yurub uu qorsheynayo inuu si weyn u kordhiyo awoodda xarumaha xogta si uu uga jawaabo baahida sii kordheysa ee AI, adeegyada daruuraha iyo teknoolojiyadda dijitaalka ah. Isla markaana, hay’adaha Yurub waxay ka digayaan in ballaarinta xarumahaasi ay cadaadis ku keeni karto shabakadaha korontada iyo kheyraadka biyaha. Maxay xarumaha xogtu shaacin doonaan? Nidaamka cusub wuxuu ku wajahan yahay xarumaha xogta leh baahi koronto oo ka badan 500 kilowatt , kuwaas oo looga baahan yahay inay soo gudbiyaan xog ku saabsan waxtarkooda tamareed iyo isticmaalka biyaha. Xogtaas ayaa qayb ka noqon doonta nidaam qiimeyn iyo calaamadeyn oo Midowga Yurub ah. Xarumaha waxaa sidoo kale laga doonayaa inay soo bandhigaan xiriirka u dhexeeya isticmaalka biyaha iyo heerka culayska biyaha ee deegaanka ay ku yaallaan. Waxaa kale oo la qiimeyn doonaa in xaruntu awood u leedahay inay nidaamka tamarta ka caawiso adeegyo ay ka mid yihiin dib-u-isticmaalka kulaylka ka dhasha hawlgalka xarunta. Si kastaba, nidaamka la soo jeediyay ma dhigayo xad toos ah oo ku saabsan inta koronto ama biyo ah ee xarun xogeed isticmaali karto , balse wuxuu xoogga saarayaa daahfurnaan, isbarbardhig iyo dhiirrigelinta xarumaha inay noqdaan kuwo hufan. AI oo kordhinaysa baahida xarumaha xogta Xarumaha xogta ayaa noqday qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah kobaca sirdoonka macmalka ah, maadaama tababarka iyo socodsiinta nidaamyada AI ay u baahan yihiin awood xisaabeed iyo koronto badan. Guddiga Yurub wuxuu sheegay in xarumaha xogta ay hadda isticmaalaan qiyaastii 1.5% korontada adduunka , oo u dhiganta ku dhowaad 415 terawatt-saacadood sanadkii, iyadoo isticmaalkaasi la filayo inuu in ka badan laba jibbaarmo marka la gaaro 2030, gaar ahaan kororka adeegyada xisaabinta ee AI. Gudaha Midowga Yurub, Reuters ayaa sheegtay in xarumaha xogtu hadda ku xisaabtamaan ku dhowaad 2.5% isticmaalka korontada , halka awoodda xarumaha xogta Yurub la filayo inay ka kacdo qiyaastii 12 gigawatts sannadkii hore ilaa 28 gigawatts marka la gaaro 2030. Kororkaasi wuxuu sare u qaadi karaa baahida koronto iyo biyo, gaar ahaan biyaha loo isticmaalo qaboojinta qalabka, taas oo keeni karta cadaadis dheeraad ah oo saaran kaabayaasha tamarta iyo kheyraadka dabiiciga ah. Tallaabo u gogol xaaraysa xeerar adag Guddiga Yurub ayaa sheegay in nidaamka qiimeynta iyo calaamadeynta uu qayb ka yahay qorshe ballaaran oo lagu hagaajinayo waxqabadka deegaanka iyo tamarta ee xarumaha xogta. Isla maalintaas, Guddigu wuxuu bilaabay wadatashi dadweyne oo soconaya 12 toddobaad, kaas oo looga gol leeyahay diyaarinta heerar waxqabad oo ugu yar oo xarumaha xogta laga doonayo. Soo jeedin sharciyeedka heerarkaasi waxaa la qorsheeyay rubuca labaad ee 2027. Guddiga Yurub wuxuu sheegay in heerarka mustaqbalka ay gacan ka geysan karaan dhimista isticmaalka tamarta iyo raadadka deegaanka ee xarumaha xogta, iyadoo aan la wiiqin kobaca adeegyada dijitaalka ah iyo AI. Xeerarka cusub ee qiimeynta ayaa hadda wajihi doona muddada diidmada ee laba bilood ah. Haddii dalalka xubnaha ka ah Midowga Yurub ama baarlamaanka aysan muddadaas ku soo gudbin diidmo, nidaamka ayaa dhaqan geli kara sida qorshuhu yahay. Tallaabadan ayaa muujinaysa isku dayga Midowga Yurub uu ku doonayo inuu isku dheellitiro ballaarinta AI iyo baahida loo qabo in la xakameeyo saameynta xarumaha xogta ku leeyihiin korontada, biyaha iyo deegaanka. The post AI oo EU Ku Riixday Xeerar Cusub first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Puntland oo sii daysay ciidamadii Dowladda Federaalka ee lagu qabtay Galkacyo
items.description: Maamulka Puntland ayaa sii daayay ciidamadii ay maanta ku qabteen magaalada Galkacyo, kuwaas oo ay Puntland ku tilmaantay inay ka tirsan yihiin Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Ciidamada ayaa Puntland lagu sheegay inay gudaha u galeen qaybta waqooyi ee Galkacyo, waxaana markii dambe lagu wareejiyay dhiggooda maamulka Galmudug. Mas’uuliyiin ka kala tirsan Puntland iyo Galmudug ayaa sheegay in ciidamadaasi ay dayoobeen, isla markaana aanay jirin tallaabo dheeraad ah oo laga qaaday. Dhacdadan ayaa timid xilli ay weli taagan tahay xiisadda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee u dhexeysa Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo Galkacyo ay tahay magaalo u kala qaybsan maamul ahaan Puntland iyo Galmudug.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan oo u baxay Mareykanka + Ujeedka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta u ambabaxay dalka Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu uga qeyb-galayo shirka Golaha Guud ee QM oo berri ka furmaya New York, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo ku dhow madaxtooyada. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa la filayaa in shirka uu ka jeediyo khudbad uu kaga hadlayo xaaladda guud ee dalka, gaar ahaan baahida loo qabo taageero dheeraad ah oo ku aaddan xoojinta amniga iyo dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab. Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa si gaar ah uga hadli doono xaaladda uu dalka ku sugan yahay, gaar ahaan amniga, siyaasadda iyo taageerista ciidamada qalabka sida. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale doonaysa in madasha caalamiga ah lagu muujiyo xaaladaha bani’aadamnimo ee Soomaaliya iyo baahida loo qabo in la kordhiyo taageerada iyo maalgashiga caalamiga ah ee dalka. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa inta uu ku sugan yahay New York ka qayb-galaya kulamada doodaha ah iyo kuwa gaar-gaarka ah ee qabsoomaya, kuwaas oo uu la qaadan doono madaxda iyo saraakiisha sare ee Qaramada Midoobay, dowladda Mareykanka iyo madaxda dalalka kale ee xubnaha ka ah ururka. Safarka Xasan Sheekh ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Soomaaliya ay xubin ka tahay Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka ay fursaddaas u adeegsanayso sidii ay caalamka ugu soo bandhigi lahayd arrimaha mudnaanta u leh Soomaaliya. Xubinnimada Soomaaliya ee Golaha Ammaanka ayaa sidoo kale sare u qaadaysa muhiimadda safarka madaxweynaha, maadaama Muqdisho ay fursad u haysato inay si toos ah uga qeyb qaadato doodaha iyo go’aannada la xiriira arrimaha amniga iyo nabadda caalamka. Waxaa kale oo ay Dowladda Federaalka doonaysa in ka qeyb-galka shirka Golaha Guud uu noqdo fursad lagu xoojiyo taageerada caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo ajandayaasheeda amni, bani’aadamnimo iyo dhaqaale. The post Madaxweyne Xasan oo u baxay Mareykanka + Ujeedka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Polltico oo iftiimisay Muhiimadda Somaliland iyo Istiraatiijiyadeeda Sugidda Amniga Bab Al-Mandab
items.description: Washington, D.C. (Dawan) Warbixin cusub oo ay baahisay warbaahinta POLITICO ayaa lagu sheegay in Somaliland ay caalamka u muujinayso inay tahay saaxiib istiraatiiji ah oo door muhiim ah ka qaadan kara amniga Bariga Dhexe iyo Badda Cas, gaar ahaan marka la eego goobteeda juquraafiyadeed ee a ay kaga taallo marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah ee isku xidha Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas. POLITICO waxa kale oo ay warbixinteeda ku xustay in Somaliland ay sidoo kale isu soo bandhigtay inay tahay tiir muhiim u ah dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo xasiloonida gobolka iyo ka hortagga khataraha ka imanaya kooxaha xagjirka ah, sidoo kalena ay door ballaadhan ka qaadan karto karto difaaca xasiloonida marinadda ganacsiga ee muhiimka ah. Warbixintan cusub ee lagu daabacay warbaahitna caalamiga ah ee Politico oo uu Wargeyska Dawan soo xigtay waxa kale oo lagu sheegay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay ku doodayso in ay tahay lamaane caalami ah oo lagu kalsoonaan karo, isla markaana laf-dhabar u noqon karta xasiloonida mandaqada, isla markaana goobteeda juqraafiyeed, xeebteeda dheer iyo dekedda Berbera ay u saamaxayaan inay door muuqda ka qaadato sugidda amniga Badda Cas iyo ilaalinta isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga. Waxa kale oo warbixintu intaas ku dartay “Somaliland, oo doonaysa inay noqoto dal madax-bannaan, ayaa toddobaadkan Washington ka wadda dadaal cusub oo ay ku doonayso in Mareykanka aqoonsado, iyadoo diiradda saaraysa doorka ay ka qaadan karto difaaca Badda Cas iyo ka hortagga maleeshiyaadka ay taageerto Iran. Somaliland waxay sidoo kale leedahay deked heer caalami ah oo ku taal Berbera, waxaanay xidhiidh diblomaasiyadeed la leedahay dalalka saaxiibka la ah Mareykanka sida Israa’iil iyo Taiwan, waxayna si toos ah ugu taallaa mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu muhiimsan uguna xasaasisan caalamka.” ayaa lagu yidhi warbixinta POLITICO. Warbixintu waxa kale oo ay intaas raacisay “Markan, goobteeda juqraafiyeed ayaa Somaliland ka caawisay inay ku dooddo doorka ay ka qaadan karto sugidda marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah xilli ay jiraan weerarro ay kooxda Xuutiyiintu ku hayso marinka Bab al-Mandeb. Puntland oo sii deysay dhallinyaradii lagu qabtay Gaalkacyo
items.description: Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland ayaa sii deysay dhallinyaradii loo waday tababarka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee ay maanta ciidamadeeda ku qabteen Magaalada Gaalkacyo. Tani ayaa waxay ka dambeysay, ka dib wada hadal lagu sii deynayay dhallinyaradaasi oo masuuliyiinta labada dhinac ay ku yeesheen waqooyiga Gaalkacyo. Masuuliyiinta Gobolka Mudug ee qaybta Puntland ayaa dhallinyaradaasi iyo laba gaari oo ay la socdeen ku wareejiyay dhigooda Galmudug. Masuuliyiinta labada dhinac ayaa laga soo xigtay in dhallinyarada ay ambadeen, isla-markaana aanu jirin qorshe ay ku qalqalgelin lahaayeen amniga Puntland. Dhallinyaradan oo loo qaatay inay ku biiraan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa lagu uruuriyay koonfurta Gaalkacyo, isla-markaana ay saakay ka lumeen waddadii ay u mari lahaayeen dhanka Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure ee Gobolka Galgaduud, sidaasina ay ugu dhaceen goob ay ku sugnaayeen Ciidanka Puntland. Madaxweyne Kuxigeenka Puntland, Ilyaas Cismaan Lugatoor ayaa mar sii horreysay dhallinyaradan ku sheegay ciidamo Soomaaliyeed oo loo soo xawilay Puntland, sida uu yiri. Lugatoor ayaa tirada dhallinyaradan ku sheegay 130 nin oo 5 ka mid ah ay reer Puntland yihiin.

items.title: Daawo: War cusub oo kasoo kordhay ciidamada DF ee u gacan galay Puntland
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha qeybta booliska gobolka Mudug ee Puntland, Gaashaanle Sare Maxamuud Muuse Bille (Fardafuul) oo shir jaraa’id ku qabtay waqooyiga magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa faah-faahin hordhac ah ka bixiyay ciidamo ka tirsan Federaalka oo saaka ciidamada ammaanka Puntland ay qabteen, kadib markii ay kasoo gudbeen dhanka Galmudug. Fardafuul ayaa xaqiijiyay in ciidankaas ay haatan gacanta ku hayaan, isaga oo sheegay in la doonayay in gudaha Puntland la soo geliyo, si ay falal amni-darro ah uga geystaan. Taliyaha ayaa tilmaamay in ciidamadan lagu waday laba gaari oo ay leeyihiin ciidamada Xoogga Dalka, isla markaana ay soo jiireen kastamka dhexe, balse lagu qabtay gudaha waqooyiga Gaalkacyo oo ay maamusho Puntland. Ciidamada oo tiradooda ay gaareyso illaa 130 askari ayaa waxaa waday saraakiil iyo macallimiin tababarayaal ah, sida uu shirka jaraa’id ku sheegay Taliyaha qeybta booliska gobolka Mudug ee maamulka Puntland. “Ciidamada Booliska oo shaqadooda maalinlaha watay waxay gacanta ku dhigeen abaare 6:00 Am laba gaari oo waa wayn oo jeemisyo ah waxayna wadeen ciidan, kuwaas oo ka tirsan Federaalka, waxaaana waday saraakiil oo uu ku jiro madaxa tababarka gobollada dhexe, Carab Maxamed Maxamuud iyo macallimiin kale oo wehlisa iyo askar iyana ilaalo ah,” ayuu yiri Taliyuhu. Waxaa kale oo kusii daray “Waxay si bareer ah ciidamadan usoo jiireen kastamkii dhexe, kadibna halkas ciidanku kasoo raaceen, waxaana lagu qabtay magaalada gudaheeda, iyaga oo ku wajahan dhankaas iyo Puntland”. Dhanka kale, waxa uu hoosta ka xariiqay in ciidamada Federaalka ee la qabtay ay hadda ku socdaan baaritaanno dheeraad ah, iyadoo la xaqiijinayo xogta iyo ujeeddada ay u galeen gudaha Puntland. Illaa iyo hadda ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay dhinaca dowladda dhexe oo ku aadan ciidamada lagu qabtay dhanka waqooyi ee Gaalkacyo, halkaas oo muddooyinkan ay ka jireen dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo iska soo horjeeda. Horay Puntland ayaa ula wareegtay xerooyin ay ciidamada dowladda ku lahaayeen gudaha maamulkaasi, kadib markii ciidamadeeda ay weerareen saldhigyo ay joogeen ciidamo la sheegay inay dowladdu ka qoratay halkaasi. items.title: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga oo Qaabilay Taliyaha TURKSOM iyo Saraakiil Turki ah
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay wafdi saraakiil Turki ah oo uu hoggaaminayay Taliyaha Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee TURKSOM, S/Gaas Sabahattin Kalkan. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca iyo tababarka ciidamada, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen arrimo la xiriira horumarinta awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo doorka tababarrada ay bixiso TURKSOM. Taliyaha TURKSOM iyo wafdiga uu hoggaaminayay ayaa kulanka ku muujiyay muhiimadda sii wadidda iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye, gaar ahaan dhinacyada tababarka, tayeynta iyo kobcinta awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah xiriirka iskaashi ee Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye ee dhinaca amniga iyo difaaca.

items.title: Madaxweyne Sisi oo madaxa hay’adda CIA-da u gudbiyey farriin la xiriirta Soomaaliya
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Masar Abdel Fattah al-Sisi ayaa mar kale xaqiijiyey taageerada dalkiisa ee madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, kadib kulan uu Qaahira kula yeeshay agaasimaha hay’adda sirdoonka Mareykanka ee CIA, John Ratcliffe. Sida lagu sheegay war kasoo baxay madaxtooyada Masar, labada dhinac ayaa kulankooda kaga wada hadlay xaaladda Soomaaliya, ammaanka Geeska Afrika iyo iskaashiga dhinaca sirdoonka iyo la-dagaallanka argagixisada. Madaxweyne Sisi ayaa kulanka ku sheegay in Masar ay si buuxda u taageersan tahay dadaallada lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya, isaga oo mar kale caddeeyey in Qaahira ay si adag uga soo horjeedo tallaabo kasta oo wax u dhimaysa madax-bannaanida ama midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Agaasimaha CIA-da John Ratcliffe ayaa dhankiisa adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in Mareykanka iyo Masar ay sii xoojiyaan wada-shaqeyntooda ku saabsan Soomaaliya, Sudan, guud ahaan Geeska Afrika iyo ammaanka marin-biyoodka caalamiga ah. Madaxtooyada Masar ayaa sheegtay in iskaashiga labada dhinac uu sidoo kale ku saabsan yahay la-dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada, dambiyada abaabulan iyo khataraha kale ee amni ee ka jira gobolka, iyadoo ay barbar socoto is-weydaarsiga xogaha iyo qiimeynta sirdoonka. Kulanka ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli xiriirka amni iyo difaac ee Soomaaliya iyo Masar uu sii xoogeysanayo. Isla maalintaas, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Muqdisho kula kulmay safiirka Masar iyo wafdi militari oo ka socday dalkaas, iyagoo ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga. Soomaaliya iyo Masar ayaa sanadihii u dambeeyey sare u qaaday xiriirkooda militari iyo siyaasadeed. Bishii Janaayo 2025 ayay labada dowladood xiriirkooda gaarsiiyeen heer iskaashi istiraatiiji ah, taas oo daba socotay heshiis iskaashi militari oo ay saxiixeen bishii Agoosto 2024. Heshiisyadaas ayaa diiradda lagu saaray tababarka ciidamada, taageerada milatari, la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo dib-u-dhiska awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Masar ayaa sidoo kale kamid ah dalalka taageeraya howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo Qaahira ay dhowr jeer ku celisay inay garab taagan tahay dowladda federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan arrimaha la xiriira amniga, madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dalka. items.title: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Somaliland oo kormeer kadiso ah ku tegay wasaarada arimaha gudaha iyo amniga
items.description: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ahna Ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, ayaa saaka kormeer kedis ah ku tagay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland.Kormeerkan ayaa qayb ka ahaa u kuur-galka hab-sami-u-socodka hawlaha Qaranka iyo gudashada waajibaadka shaqo ee Hay’adaha Dawladdu ay uga masuuliyihiin Qaranka JSL. items.title: Yes, we need to be inside the UN, and that day will come. Until then, let our voices be heard
items.description: Yes, we need to be inside the UN, and that day will come. Until then, let our voices be heard at its doorstep. A recognition rally during the UN General Assembly is a meaningful opportunity for Somalilanders to peacefully express their collective will and aspirations to the world. My sincere appreciation to Ambassador Bashir Goth and his team for securing the location and helping bring this initiative to life – this is a busy place. 📅 Date: 23 September 2026 📍 Location: Dag Hammarskjöld Plaza, New York City I call on Somalilanders and friends of Somaliland across the United States and Canada to unite in New York and make our people’s voices heard. I also encourage the organizers to engage with major U.S. media outlets, including CNN and Fox News, as well as Taiwanese, UAE, and other international media, to explore opportunities for broadcasting the rally and bringing Somaliland’s aspirations for recognition to a global audience. We may be gathering at the UN’s doorstep today, but tomorrow, our flag belongs inside. Let Somaliland speak. Let the world listen.

items.title: Somalia: Puntland forces intercept more than 100 federal military recruits in Galkayo
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Puntland security forces have intercepted two military trucks carrying more than 100 recruits who were reportedly travelling to a federal government-run military training camp, in a fresh security flashpoint between Puntland and Somalia’s federal authorities. The two vehicles were stopped on Monday in northern Galkayo, where Puntland forces reportedly ordered the recruits to disembark and took them into custody. Videos circulating on social media appeared to show Puntland security personnel surrounding the two trucks and removing the occupants from the vehicles. The footage could not independently establish the precise circumstances surrounding the interception. The recruits are reportedly from southern Mudug, an area under the control of neighboring Galmudug state, and were travelling to the Hanan Bure military academy in the Galgadud region. According to local officials, the convoy apparently took the wrong direction and ended up in northern Galkayo, where it was intercepted by Puntland forces. Number of recruits remains unclear The exact number of recruits involved has not been officially established. Some local journalists have reported that as many as 160 recruits were travelling in the two trucks, while the Caasimada Online news website put the number at approximately 100. Neither Puntland authorities nor Somalia’s federal government had publicly confirmed the number of recruits or provided an official account of the incident at the time of publication. The discrepancy means the size of the group remains uncertain, although all available accounts indicate that more than 100 recruits may have been involved. Interception comes amid Puntland–Mogadishu tensions The incident comes as relations between Puntland and the federal government in Mogadishu have deteriorated sharply, with disagreements between the two sides increasingly taking on a military dimension. The dispute has developed into armed confrontations in recent months. Puntland security forces have moved against federal military units operating in areas under Puntland’s control, detaining federal soldiers, taking possession of their weapons and placing personnel who surrendered under the command of regional security forces. Those developments have completely ended the federal government’s security presence in Puntland and deepened the dispute between the two sides. The interception of the recruits adds another potentially sensitive dimension to that confrontation, particularly because the group was reportedly travelling toward a military training facility associated with the federal government. Galkayo adds a delicate local dimension The fate of the recruits remains unclear. Their detention could prove particularly sensitive in Galkayo, a city divided between Puntland and Galmudug and situated in a region where political, security and clan dynamics frequently intersect. The recruits are reportedly drawn largely from clans with communities in southern Galkayo. Their presence in northern Galkayo, therefore, carries a local dimension that extends beyond the broader political dispute between Puntland and the federal government. It remains unclear whether Puntland will release the recruits, continue to hold them or transfer them to another authority. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Lugatoor oo ka hadlay dhallinyarada lagu xiray Magaalada Gaalkacyo
items.description: Madaxweyne Kuxigeenka Puntland, Ilyaas Cismaan Lugatoor ayaa sheegay in Magaalada Gaalkacyo lagu qabtay ciidamo Soomaaliyeed oo sida uu yiri Puntland loo soo xawilay, markii kuwii Puntland gudaheedii la nadiifiyay. Madaxweyne Kuxigeenka ayaa tilmaamay in raggaasi oo 130 nin gaaraya iyo gaadiidkii ay wateenba ay hadda ku xiran yihiin Saldhigga Booliska. “Saakay ciidamo Soomaaliyeed oo Puntland loo soo xawilay baa Gaalkacyo lagu qabtay 130 nin iyo teknikadii ay wateen ah oo hadda Saldhigga Booliska ku xiran, markii kuwii Puntland gudaheedii la nadiifiyay.” Ayuu yiri Lugatoor oo intaa raaciyay “Shan qof baana reer Puntland ka ah.” Lugatoor ayaa hoosta ka xariiqay in Somaliya ay ku socoto waddo aan sax ahayn, isagoona ka digay burbur ku yimaada dowladnimada dalka. Hadalkiisa ayaa imanaya saacado uun ka dib, markii Ciidanka Puntland ay waqooyiga Gaalkacyo ku qabteen dhallinyaro loo waday tababarka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Dhallinyaradan ayaa ku sii jeedday Xerada Militariga Xananbuure ee Gobolka Galgaduud, kana mid ah xeryaha lagu tababaro Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Tallaabada lagu xiray dhallinyaradaasi ayay dadka qaarkii u arkaan mid uga sii dari karta xiriirka aan wanaagsaneyn ee ay leeyihiin Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland.

items.title: Qorshaha Soomaaliya ee diyaaradaha dagaalka JF-17 oo maraya marxalad Rasmi ah
items.description: Qorshaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee lagu dhisayo awoodda Ciidanka Cirka iyo lagu soo iibsanayo diyaaradaha dagaalka ee nooca JF-17 Thunder Block III ayaa warbixinno cusub oo dhinaca difaaca ah lagu sheegay inuu gaaray marxalad rasmi ah, inkastoo faahfaahinta heshiiska aysan weli si buuxda uga soo bixin labada dowladood. Warbixinno la daabacay horaantii 2026 ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan ay wada-hadallo heer sare ah ka lahaayeen iibsashada illaa 24 diyaaradood oo JF-17 Block III ah , iyadoo qiimaha xirmada lagu qiyaasay ku dhowaad $900 milyan . Wada-hadallada ayaa xoog yeeshay kadib booqasho uu taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya ku tegay Islamabad. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Pakistan ayaa sidoo kale Janaayo 2026 xaqiijisay in dalal kala duwan ay Pakistan kala hadlayeen diyaaradda JF-17 Thunder, iyadoo sheegtay in marka heshiisyadu si rasmi ah u dhammaadaan la shaacin doono. Warbixinnada ku saabsan qorshaha Soomaaliya waxay tilmaamayaan in wada-hadalladu diiradda saarayaan JF-17 Thunder Block III , oo ah nooca ugu horumarsan ee diyaaraddan. Xirmada la sheegay inay Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan ka wada hadlayaan ma ahan oo keliya diyaaradaha, balse waxaa sidoo kale lagu soo waramayaa inay ku jiraan tababar duuliyayaal, tababar shaqaalaha dhulka, dayactir iyo taageero farsamo . Haddii heshiiska la dhammeystiro, wuxuu noqon lahaa mid ka mid ah maalgelinnadii ugu waaweynaa ee Soomaaliya ku sameyso dib-u-dhiska awooddeeda militari tan iyo burburkii dowladdii dhexe ee 1991. Soomaaliya muddo ka badan saddex iyo soddon sano ayay ka maqneyd awood ciidan oo casri ah oo ku salaysan diyaarado dagaal oo ay iyadu leedahay. Warbixinnada ku saabsan JF-17 ayaa sidaas darteed lagu xiriiriyay qorshaha dowladda ee dib-u-dhiska Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed iyo horumarinta awoodda ilaalinta hawada dalka. JF-17 Thunder waa diyaarad dagaal oo ay si wadajir ah u horumariyeen Pakistan iyo Shiinaha , waxaana Block III lagu qalabeeyay nidaamyo casri ah oo ay ka mid yihiin radar AESA, avionics la casriyeeyay iyo awoodaha dagaalka hawada iyo weerarrada bartilmaameedyada dhulka. Inkasta oo warbaahin dhowr ah ay sheegtay in heshiiska Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan uu marayo heer sare, haddana waxaa muhiim ah in la kala saaro wadaxaajoodka, heshiis hordhac ah iyo qandaraas rasmi ah oo si wadajir ah ay dowladuhu u shaaciyeen .

items.title: Puntland oo qabatay ciidamo katirsan dowladda oo gaaraya 130 Askari
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Raxanreeb Online) Ciidamada ammaanka Puntland ayaa magaalada Gaalkacyo ku qabtay ciidamo iyo saraakiil la sheegay inay ka tirsan yihiin dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Sida ay sheegeen saraakiil ciidan oo Puntland ah, ciidamada la qabtay ayaa gaaraya ku dhowaad 130 askari iyo saraakiil, kuwaas oo la socday laba gaari oo milatari. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadaasi ay ka soo gudbeen dhanka Galmudug, waxaana la sheegay in loo waday deegaanka Xananbuure oo ka tirsan gobolka Galgaduud, halkaas oo la qorsheeyay in lagu geeyo xarun tababar ciidan. Ciidamada Puntland ayaa labada gaari iyo dadkii saarnaa ku qabtay gudaha magaalada Gaalkacyo, waxaana sida la sheegay lagu sameynayaa baaritaanno la xiriira ujeeddada safarkooda iyo halka ay ku wajahnaayeen. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay jiraan khilaafaad siyaasadeed iyo kuwo amni oo u dhexeeya Puntland iyo dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan arrimaha ciidamada iyo maamulka Galmudug. items.title: Masar oo Mareykanka kala hadashay ilaalinta madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya
items.description: Madaxweynaha Masar, CabdiFataax Al-Sisi, ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu si buuxda u taageerayo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya, isla markaana uu diiddan yahay tallaabo kasta oo wax u dhimaysa madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Al-Sisi ayaa hadalkan sheegay intii uu kulan la yeeshay Agaasimaha CIA-da Mareykanka, John Ratcliffe , oo booqasho ku joogay Qaahira. Kulanka waxaa sidoo kale ka qeyb galay madaxa Sirdoonka Guud ee Masar, Hassan Rashad . Labada dhinac ayaa kulanka kaga hadlay xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah ee Masar iyo Mareykanka iyo xaaladaha amni iyo siyaasadeed ee gobolka, oo ay ka mid yihiin dagaalka Iran, qorshaha xabbad-joojinta Gaza, arrinta Falastiin iyo colaadda Sudan . Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, Ratcliffe ayaa uga mahadceliyay Masar doorkeeda ku aaddan taageerada amniga iyo xasilloonida Afrika, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in labada dal ay sii wadaan iskaashiga ku saabsan xaaladda Sudan, Soomaaliya iyo Geeska Afrika , iyo sidoo kale amniga maraakiibta caalamiga ah. Hadalkan Al-Sisi ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Masar iyo Soomaaliya ay si weyn u xoojinayaan xiriirkooda siyaasadeed iyo midka difaaca, xilli Labada dal ay xiriirkooda sare ugu qaadeen heer iskaashi istiraatiiji ah intii lagu jiray booqashadii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu Qaahira ku tagay bishii Janaayo 2025. Tan iyo xilligaas, waxaa labada dhinac dhex maray heshiisyo la xiriira difaaca iyo iskaashiga milateri, ayadoo Masar ay sidoo kale sheegtay inay ciidamo ku biirin doonto Howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) , iyadoo wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Masar Badr Abdelatty uu hore u sheegay in ciidamo Masri ah la geyn doono gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe . Iskaashiga labada dal kuma koobna dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca oo keliya, balse waxaa sidoo kale lagu ballaariyay garsoorka, ganacsiga iyo arrimaha la xiriira kheyraadka biyaha . Warbixintu waxay xustay in ganacsiga Soomaaliya iyo Masar uu kordhay 88 boqolkiiba , isagoo gaaray qiyaastii 59 milyan oo dollar lixdii bilood ee hore ee 2024 , marka loo eego 31 milyan oo dollar isla muddadaas sannadkii ka horreeyay. Kulanka Al-Sisi iyo agaasimaha CIA-da ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas ay yihiin goobo ay ku loollamayaan dano amni, siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale oo kala duwan. Masar waxay muddooyinkii dambe si dhow ula shaqaynaysay Soomaaliya, iyadoo xiriirka Qaahira iyo Muqdisho uu sidoo kale ku xiran yahay khilaafka Masar iyo Itoobiya ee ku saabsan Biyo-xireenka Wabiga Niil (GERD) . Dhanka kale, Mareykanka iyo Masar ayaa dan wadaag ah ka leh amniga Badda Cas iyo marinka Bab al-Mandab , oo muhiim u ah isu-socodka ganacsiga iyo maraakiibta caalamiga ah. Hadalkan cusub ee Madaxweyne Al-Sisi ayaa muujinaya in madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya ay ka mid yihiin arrimaha uu Qaahira si cad uga hadlaysay marka ay la macaamilayso dhinacyada caalamiga ah , xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Masar uu sii xoogeysanayo.

Al-Sisi ayaa hadalkan sheegay intii uu kulan la yeeshay Agaasimaha CIA-da Mareykanka, John Ratcliffe , oo booqasho ku joogay Qaahira. items.title: Midowga Yurub oo Google ku ganaaxay in ka badan $462 milyan, kadib muran ka dhashay xogta goobta isticmaaleyaasha
items.description: Hay’adda Ilaalinta Xogta Ireland ( Data Protection Commission – DPC ), oo ah hay’adda ugu weyn ee Midowga Yurub u qaabilsan kormeerka xogta shirkadaha waaweyn ee tiknoolajiyadda, ayaa Google ku soo rogtay ganaax dhan €403 milyan , oo u dhiganta ku dhowaad $463 milyan , kadib markii lagu helay jebinta qaar ka mid ah xeerarka Midowga Yurub ee ilaalinta xogta shakhsiga ah. Kiiskan ayaa si gaar ah ugu saabsan habka Google u maareysay xogta goobta (location data) ee isticmaaleyaasha, ayadoo DPC ay sheegtay in baaritaanka, oo la bilaabay sannadkii 2020 , uu ka dhashay cabashooyin ay soo gudbiyeen ururro Yurub ah oo u dooda xuquuqda macaamiisha. Sida ay sheegtay hay’addu, hababka Google u adeegsanaysay xogta goobta ayaa sababi karay in xogta dadka loo adeegsado ujeeddooyin aysan si buuxda uga warqabin, oo ay ka mid yihiin bartilmaameedsiga xayaysiisyada iyo fahamka ama saadaalinta danaha isticmaalaha . Sidoo kale, hay’addu waxay sheegtay in xogta qaarkeed la hayay muddo ka dheer intii lagama maarmaanka ahayd. DPC ayaa sheegtay in arrimahaasi ay saameeyeen awoodda isticmaaleyaasha ay ku xakameyn karaan xogtooda gaarka ah, taasoo ay ku tilmaantay mid aan waafaqsanayn shuruudaha Xeerka Guud ee Ilaalinta Xogta ee Midowga Yurub (GDPR) . Baaritaanka ayaa dabagal ku sameeyay hab-dhaqannadii Google ee muddadii u dhexeysay May 2018 iyo Febraayo 2020 . Ganaaxan ayaa noqday mid ka mid ah ganaaxyada waaweyn ee ay DPC soo rogtay, xilli Google ay dhankeeda sheegtay in kiisku la xiriiray siyaasado hore , isla markaana shirkaddu tan iyo 2019 ay wax ka beddeshay qaar ka mid ah hababka ay u maamusho xogta goobta, iyadoo soo kordhisay qalabyo u sahlaya isticmaaleyaasha inay si cad u maareeyaan xogtooda. Hay’adda Ireland ayaa sidoo kale Google siisay waqti ay ku waafajiso hababka xog-ururinteeda iyo shuruudaha GDPR, taasoo qayb ka ah tallaabooyinka ka dambeeya go’aanka ganaaxa. Ganaaxan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Midowga Yurub uu sii xoojinayo kormeerka shirkadaha waaweyn ee tiknoolajiyadda , gaar ahaan habka ay u isticmaalaan xogta dadka iyo sida ay u hoggaansamaan xeerarka tartanka iyo ilaalinta xogta.

items.title: Puntland oo sheegtay inay Galkacyo ku qabatay ciidamo ay ku tilmaantay kuwo ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka
items.description: Maamulka Puntland ayaa sheegay in ciidamo uu ku tilmaamay inay ka tirsan yihiin Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya lagu qabtay magaalada Galkacyo, kadib markii ay gudaha u galeen deegaanada ay Puntland maamusho. Wararka hadda la helayo ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadaasi ay ka soo dhaqaaqeen dhanka Galmudug , iyadoo ilo warbaahineed ay sheegeen in laba gaari ay wateen askarta, kuwaas oo tiradooda lagu qiyaasay ku dhowaad 100 askari . Wararkan ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ciidamada ay ku sii jeedeen xarunta tababarka Xananbuure ee gobolka Galgaduud, balse ay gudaha u galeen qaybta waqooyi ee Galkacyo oo Puntland maamusho. Ilaa hadda, tirada saxda ah iyo xaaladda ciidamada la qabtay si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin, waxaana warbaahinta maxalliga ahi ay sidoo kale sheegtay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo maamulka Galmudug aysan weli si rasmi ah uga hadlin dhacdadan. Dhacdadan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli uu sare u kacay khilaafka dhinaca amniga iyo siyaasadda ah ee u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya . Bishii Agoosto, ciidamada Puntland ayaa howlgal ka fuliyay Galkacyo, halkaas oo ay la wareegeen xarun ay joogeen ciidamo lala xiriirinayay dowladda federaalka, Puntland-na ay sheegtay inay qabatay in ka badan 100 askari iyo hub iyo gaadiid ciidan. Puntland ayaa xilligaas ku eedaysay Dowladda Federaalka inay ciidamo iyo hub ku ururinaysay gudaha Puntland, halka dowladda federaalkuna aysan markaas si rasmi ah uga jawaabin eedeymahaas. Xiisadda Galkacyo ayaa soo noqnoqonaysa iyadoo magaalada ay u kala qaybsan tahay dhinaca maamulka Puntland iyo Galmudug, isla markaana ay hore uga dhaceen iska horimaadyo u dhexeeyay ciidamo taabacsan dhinacyada kala duwan.

items.title: Dawladda soomaaliya oo amar culus dul dhigtay bahda caafimaadka
items.description: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo saartay qoraal rasmi ah oo ku saabsan dhaqan-gelinta awaamiir iyo go’aanno ka soo baxay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan kuwa la xiriira shaqaalaha iyo hay’adaha dowladda. Qoraalka oo ku taariikhaysan 20-ka Sebtembar 2026 , kana soo baxay Xafiiska Wasiirka Caafimaadka, ayaa lagu sheegay in Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo waaxyaha hoos yimaada ay tixraacayaan warqad ka soo baxday Golaha Qaranka ee Shaqaalaha Rayidka , taas oo ku saabsan dhaqan-gelinta hannaanada la xiriira shaqaalaha dowladda. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in hay’adaha hoos yimaada ay waajib ku tahay inay qaadaan tallaabooyin maamul, xilliga shaqada, beddelid, wareejin iyo magcaabis iyadoo la raacayo nidaamka iyo habraacyada dowladda. Sidoo kale, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku adkaysay hay’adaha ay khusayso inay ilaaliyaan xaaladda shaqo ee hadda jirta , isla markaana aysan qaadin tallaabo kasta oo wax ka beddelaysa xaaladda shaqaalaha ama qaab-dhismeedka shaqada, ilaa laga helo Qoraalka ayaa sidoo kale faraya in haddii ay jiraan arrimo u baahan in wax laga beddelo xaaladda shaqaalaha ama habraacyada shaqada, loo baahan yahay in marka hore loo maro habraacyada rasmiga ah , iyadoo la sugayo go’aannada iyo awaamiirta hay’adaha ay khusayso. Wasaaradda ayaa ugu dambeyn hay’adaha ay khusayso ka codsatay inay soo gudbiyaan warbixin ku saabsan dhaqan-gelinta iyo xaaladda shaqaalaha , si loo helo xog rasmi ah oo ku saabsan fulinta awaamiirta la soo saaray.

items.title: Ciidanka Puntland oo gacanta ku dhigay dhallinyaro ku biireysay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka
items.description: Ciidanka Puntland ayaa Magaalada Gaalkacyo ku qabtay gaadiid ay la socdeen niman dhallinyaro ah, xilli loo waday tababarka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in dhallinyaradan ay ku sii jeedeen Dugsuga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure ee waqooyiga Gobolka Galgaduud. Warar aan la xaqiijin ayaa sheegaya in dhallinyaradan lagu diyaariyay koonfurta Magaalada Gaalkacyo, isla-markaana ay ka ambadeen jidkii ay u mari lahaayeen dhanka Galgaduud, sidaasina ay gacanta ugu dhigeen Ciidanka Puntland ee ku sugan waqooyiga Gaalkacyo. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in Galmudug iyo Puntland uu u socdo wada hadal la doonayo in lagu sii daayo dhallinyaradaasi iyo gaadiidkii ay la socdeenba. Tani ayaa ku soo aadeysa, xilli uu meeshii ugu hooseysay gaaray xiriirka Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ku howlaneyd, sidii ay dhallinyaro cusub uga qoran lahayd deegaanada Puntland, iyadoo uu qorshaheedu yahay in la dhiso ama la soo celiyo Guutooyinkii Qaybta 54aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa horaantii bishii June General Jimcaale Jaamac Takar u magacawday in uu noqdo Taliyaha Qaybta 54aad, iyadoo siyaasadda soo xulista iyo qorista dhallinyarada ay xiisad ka kicisay gudaha deegaanada Puntland. Guddiga Amniga Puntland ayaa 24-kii June soo saaray amar mamnuucaya inaanay deegaanada Puntland ka hawlgeli karin ciidan aan ahayn kuwa maamulka.

items.title: Daawo: Yabooh oo si kulul ugu jawaabay Cali Yare
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiye ku xigeenka amniga iyo siyaasadda maamulka gobolka Banaadir, Maxamed Axmed Diiriye (Yabooh) oo xalay shir jaraa’id u qabtay Wariyeyaasha ayaa si kulul ugu jawaabay Cali Yare Cali oo maalmahan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka waday gudaha magaalada Muqdisho. Cali Yare oo dhawaan uun kusoo laabtay dalka ayaa bilaabay warar uu ku jahwareerinayo bulshada caasimada, iyada oo lagu eedeeyay inuu doonayo inuu iska horkeeno maamulka gobolka Banaadir iyo shacabka ku dhaqan magaalada Muqdisho. Guddoomiye Yabooh ayaa si adag uga hadlay arrinta Cali Yare, wuxuuna ku eedeeyay inuu bulshada ku marin-habaabinayo sawirro laga soo qaaday waddamo kale oo ay biyo galeen, isaga oo dadka u muujinaya inay yihiin xaaladda dhabta ah ee ka jirta caasimda. items.title: Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Nabadda Adduunka oo maanta dunida laga xusayo
items.description: 21-ka Sebtembar sannad kasta waxaa dunida laga xusaa Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Nabadda (International Day of Peace) , oo ay Qaramada Midoobay u asteeysay in lagu xoojiyo dadaallada nabadda, wada-hadalka iyo joojinta colaadaha ka dhex jira bulshooyinka iyo dalalka. Maalintan waxaa markii ugu horreysay la asteeyay sanadkii 1981-kii , kaddib markii Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay uu meel mariyey Qaraarka 36/67. Maalinta Nabadda markii ugu horreysay waxaa la xusay Sebtembar 1982, iyadoo markii dambe, sannadkii 2001 , Golaha Guud si wadajir ah u go’aamiyey in 21-ka Sebtembar loo aqoonsado maalin joogto ah oo loogu talagalay nabad, rabshad-la’aan iyo xabbad-joojin caalami ah. Mawduuca Maalinta Nabadda ee sannadkan 2026 ayaa ah “Maalgeli Nabadda: Qof kasta, meel kasta, maalin kasta.” Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in nabaddu aysan ku koobnayn maqnaanshaha dagaalka oo keliya, balse ay sidoo kale tahay helitaanka amniga, karaamada, fursadaha iyo iskaashiga nolol maalmeedka. Mawduuca sanadkan wuxuu si gaar ah u xoojinayaa doorka dadka iyo bulshada ee dhismaha nabadda, iyadoo la dhiirrigelinayo wada-hadalka, isu-soo-dhawaanshaha iyo xalinta khilaafaadka si nabadeed. Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay António Guterres ayaa farriintiisa 2026 ku sheegay in dunidu wajahayo rabshado iyo kala-qaybsanaan sii kordhaya, balse uu xusay in mutadawiciin, bulshada rayidka ah, nabaddoonno iyo dadka u ololeeya nabadda ay ka shaqeynayaan isku-xirka bulshooyinka iyo dhiirrigelinta wada-hadalka. Maalintan ayaa sidoo kale ah fursad lagu xusuusto dadka ku nool dalalka ay saameeyeen dagaallada iyo colaadaha, iyadoo loo jeedinayo baaq ku saabsan ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah, dhowrista xuquuqda aadanaha iyo in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wada-hadal, diblomaasiyad iyo heshiis , halkii laga adeegsan lahaa rabshad. Qaramada Midoobay waxay ku boorrisay dowladaha, ururrada bulshada iyo shacabka caalamka inay maalintan uga faa’iideystaan wacyigelinta nabadda, waxbarashada iyo dhiirrigelinta tallaabooyinka yaryar ee gacan ka geysan kara nabad waarta. Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Nabaddu waxay xambaarsan tahay farriin ku wajahan dhammaan bulshada caalamka oo ay kamid yihiin in nabaddu aysan ahayn masuuliyad dowlado iyo hay’ado caalami ah oo keliya, balse ay tahay hawl ay si wadajir ah uga qayb qaadan karaan bulshooyinka, dhalinyarada, haweenka, culimada, aqoonyahannada iyo qof kasta oo doonaya nolol ku dhisan amni, wada noolaansho iyo is-ixtiraam.

items.title: Mareykanka oo Shiinaha kala hadlay tallaabo ay khubaro badan ka digeen
items.description: New York ( Raxanreeb Online) Xoghayaha Maaliyadda Mareykanka, Scott Bessent, ayaa sheegay in Shiinaha iyo Mareykanka ay ka wada hadleen qorshe lagu dhisayo nidaam digniin-wadaag ah oo ku saabsan sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI). Bessent ayaa sheegay in sida uu dhigayo qorshahan, labada dal ay midba midka kale ogeysiin karaan marka ay dhacaan arrimo ama shilal la xiriira AI oo khatar ku ah amniga qarankooda. Wuxuu hadalkan sheegay kaddib kulan uu magaalada New York kula yeeshay Ra’iisul-wasaare ku-xigeenka Shiinaha, He Lifeng. Wadahadalladan ayaa gogol xaar u noqday kulanka toddobaadka soo socda ee madaxweynayaasha Mareykanka iyo Shiinaha oo ka dhici doona Aqalka Cad. Shiinaha kama soo saarin wax bayaan ah arrintan, hase yeeshee Madaxweyne Xi Jinping ayaa hore ugu baaqay in la sameeyo hannaan caalami ah oo lagu maamulo loogana hago sirdoonka macmalka ah. items.title: ONLF oo qeyb ka noqotay isbaheysiga ka dhanka ah Xukuumadda Abiy Axmed
items.description: Addis Ababa ( Raxanreeb Online) Kooxda hubaysan ee ka dagaallanta Itoobiya ayaa ku dhawaaqay sameynta isbahaysi cusub oo lagu magacaabo Alliance for Survival (Isbahaysiga Badbaadada), kaas oo ujeeddadiisu tahay in xukunka laga tuuro dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Axmed, lana dhiso maamul ku-meel-gaar ah oo loo dhan yahay. Isbahaysiga waxaa ku mideysan Amhara FANO, Oromo (OLA), Tigray (TPLF), Ogaden (ONLF). Bayaan ay si wadajir ah u soo saareen ayay kooxuhu dowladda ku eedeeyeen inay mas’uul ka tahay “dagaal, xasuuq, burbur ballaaran iyo saboolnimo ba’an”, iyagoo sheegay in Itoobiya ay noqotay dowlad fashilantay oo wajahaysa khatarta kala-daadashada. Waxay sheegeen in ku dhaqanka sharciga iyo kala dambayntu ay burbureen, malaayiin qofna ay barakaceen, halka rajadii muwaadiniintuna ay meesha ka baxday waxa ay ku tilmaameen “kaligii-talisnimo”. Isbahaysigu wuxuu sheegay in howshiisu tahay in xukunka laga tuuro dowladda Abiy Axmed, la ilaaliyo badbaadada iyo amniga shacabka Itoobiya, la dhiso dowlad ku-meel-gaar ah oo uu hagayo Axdiga Ku-meel-gaarka ah, isla markaana khilaafaadka gudaha lagu xalliyo si nabadeed. items.title: Why did Ted Cruz meet Cirro? Somaliland’s high-stakes Washington move
Doorasho, Dastuur iyo Somaliland: Maxaa Muqdisho Ka Socda?
items.description: Muranka siyaasadeed ee Muqdisho iyo eedaha loo jeedinayo dowladda Federaalka MUQDISHO — Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa wajahaysa muran siyaasadeed oo xooggan oo ku saabsan hannaanka doorashooyinka, muddo-xileedka hay’adaha dowladda iyo xiriirka Muqdisho la leedahay dhinacyada siyaasadda ee dalka, iyadoo dhaleeceeyayaashu ay su’aalo ka keenayaan jihada siyaasadeed ee dowladda iyo waxqabadkeeda. Doodda ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay weli ku jirto khilaaf ku saabsan qaabka doorashooyinka iyo isbeddellada dastuuriga ah ee la ansixiyay 2026. Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa bishii Maarso ansixiyay wax-ka-beddello dastuur oo suuragal ka dhigay in doorashooyinka dib loo dhigo, isla markaana muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha iyo baarlamaanka uu kordho. Arrintaas ayaa dhalisay dood iyo mucaarad siyaasadeed. Muranka ku saabsan doorashooyinka Soomaaliya Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud Qorshihii hore ee Soomaaliya wuxuu ku wajahnaa doorashooyin ku salaysan codka qof iyo cod, laakiin hirgelinta nidaamkaas waxaa hareeyay khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo is-afgaranwaa ku saabsan qaabka loo maamulayo doorashada. Hay’ado caalami ah ayaa hore u diiwaangeliyay in siyaasadda Soomaaliya ay 2026 wajahaysay kala-qaybsanaan iyo muran ku saabsan qaabka doorashooyinka. EUAA waxay sheegtay in khilaafkaasi uu ku saabsanaa, gaar ahaan, muddada xilalka hay’adaha federaalka iyo qaabka loo dhisayo nidaam doorasho oo la isku raacsan yahay. Dowladda Federaalka, dhankeeda, waxay sheegtay inay waddo hannaanka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod iyo dhismaha hay’adaha lagama maarmaanka u ah geeddi-socodkaas. Warbixin rasmi ah oo dowladda Soomaaliya soo saartay bishii May ayaa sheegtay in madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu waday dadaallo la xiriira dhammaystirka kala-guurka dimuqraadiyadeed iyo hirgelinta doorashooyinka qof iyo cod. Sidaas darteed, in si guud loo yiraahdo “wax doorasho ah ma dhicin” waxay u baahan tahay kala saarid: waxaa jira khilaaf iyo dib-u-dhac ku saabsan doorashooyinka federaalka, halka geeddi-socodyo doorashooyin oo heer maamul-goboleed ah ay ka dhaceen meelo ka mid ah dalka. Qaramada Midoobay waxay tusaale ahaan diiwaangelisay doorashooyin qof iyo cod ah oo Puntland ka dhacay bishii Luulyo 2024, inkastoo xogtaas ay tahay dhacdo heer maamul-goboleed. Mukhtaar Roobow iyo xiriirka uu la leeyahay liisaskii Maraykanka Wasiirka wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha islaamka ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane 𝐬𝐡𝐞𝐞𝐤𝐡 𝐌𝐮𝐤𝐡𝐭𝐚𝐚𝐫 𝐑𝐨𝐨𝐛𝐨𝐰 𝐂𝐚𝐥𝐢 Mid ka mid ah qodobada lagu soo hadal qaado dhaleeceynta dowladda ayaa ah magaca wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta, Mukhtaar Roobow Cali, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Abu Mansuur. Dowladda Maraykanka ayaa 2012 ku dartay Roobow barnaamijkeeda Rewards for Justice , iyadoo bixisay abaalmarin gaareysa $5 milyan oo loogu talagalay xog horseedi karta helitaankiisa. Waqtigaas waxaa lagu tilmaamay inuu ahaa hoggaamiye sare oo Al-Shabaab ah. Si kastaba, qodob muhiim ah ayaa ah in abaalmarintaas laga qaaday liiska Rewards for Justice sanadkii 2017, sida ay sheegeen ilo Maraykan ah oo uu soo xigtay Associated Press. Sidaa darteed, in Roobow maanta lagu tilmaamo inuu weli ku jiro “liiska dadka Maraykanku raadinayo” waxay u baahan tahay saxitaan iyo waqti-ku-xirnaan. Dhanka kale, xogta Waaxda Maaliyadda Maraykanka waxay muujinaysaa in Roobow lagu daray liiska Specially Designated Global Terrorist (SDGT) sanadkii 2008. Tani waa nidaam cunaqabateyn dhaqaale oo ka duwan barnaamijka Rewards for Justice. Xogta rasmiga ah ee dowladda Soomaaliya waxay hadda Roobow ku taxdaa wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta. Somaliland iyo siyaasadda gudaha Soomaaliya   Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) Doodda siyaasadeed ee Muqdisho ayaa sidoo kale ku xiran xiriirka dowladda Federaalka iyo Somaliland, gaar ahaan dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Hargeysa ay ka waddo Washington. Reuters waxay sheegtay in Somaliland ay 2026 sii xoojisay xiriirkeeda dibadda, halka dowladda Soomaaliya ay si cad uga soo horjeedo tallaabooyinka ay u aragto inay dhaawacayaan midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Warbixinno kale ayaa sheegay in Muqdisho iyo Hargeysa ay Washington u direen wafdiyo xilli ay sare u kacayeen doodaha ku saabsan siyaasadda Mareykanka ee Somaliland. Doodda ku saabsan waxqabadka dowladda bilicda caasimada oo hoos udhac ku yimid Qiimeynta waxqabadka dowladda Federaalka waxay ku xiran tahay dhinaca laga eegayo. Dowladda waxay tilmaantaa hawlo ay ka waddo amniga, dhismaha hay’adaha, doorashooyinka iyo xiriirka caalamiga ah, halka mucaaradka iyo qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha ay dhaliilayaan khilaafaadka siyaasadeed, dib-u-dhaca doorashooyinka iyo xiriirka u dhexeeya dowladda Federaalka iyo qaar ka mid ah maamul-goboleedyada. items.fullContent: Muranka siyaasadeed ee Muqdisho iyo eedaha loo jeedinayo dowladda Federaalka MUQDISHO — Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa wajahaysa muran siyaasadeed oo xooggan oo ku saabsan hannaanka doorashooyinka, muddo-xileedka hay’adaha dowladda iyo xiriirka Muqdisho la leedahay dhinacyada siyaasadda ee dalka, iyadoo dhaleeceeyayaashu ay su’aalo ka keenayaan jihada siyaasadeed ee dowladda iyo waxqabadkeeda. Doodda ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay weli ku jirto khilaaf ku saabsan qaabka doorashooyinka iyo isbeddellada dastuuriga ah ee la ansixiyay 2026. Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa bishii Maarso ansixiyay wax-ka-beddello dastuur oo suuragal ka dhigay in doorashooyinka dib loo dhigo, isla markaana muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha iyo baarlamaanka uu kordho. Arrintaas ayaa dhalisay dood iyo mucaarad siyaasadeed. Muranka ku saabsan doorashooyinka Soomaaliya Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud Qorshihii hore ee Soomaaliya wuxuu ku wajahnaa doorashooyin ku salaysan codka qof iyo cod, laakiin hirgelinta nidaamkaas waxaa hareeyay khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo is-afgaranwaa ku saabsan qaabka loo maamulayo doorashada. Hay’ado caalami ah ayaa hore u diiwaangeliyay in siyaasadda Soomaaliya ay 2026 wajahaysay kala-qaybsanaan iyo muran ku saabsan qaabka doorashooyinka. EUAA waxay sheegtay in khilaafkaasi uu ku saabsanaa, gaar ahaan, muddada xilalka hay’adaha federaalka iyo qaabka loo dhisayo nidaam doorasho oo la isku raacsan yahay. Dowladda Federaalka, dhankeeda, waxay sheegtay inay waddo hannaanka doorashooyinka qof iyo cod iyo dhismaha hay’adaha lagama maarmaanka u ah geeddi-socodkaas. Warbixin rasmi ah oo dowladda Soomaaliya soo saartay bishii May ayaa sheegtay in madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu waday dadaallo la xiriira dhammaystirka kala-guurka dimuqraadiyadeed iyo hirgelinta doorashooyinka qof iyo cod. Sidaas darteed, in si guud loo yiraahdo “wax doorasho ah ma dhicin” waxay u baahan tahay kala saarid: waxaa jira khilaaf iyo dib-u-dhac ku saabsan doorashooyinka federaalka, halka geeddi-socodyo doorashooyin oo heer maamul-goboleed ah ay ka dhaceen meelo ka mid ah dalka. Qaramada Midoobay waxay tusaale ahaan diiwaangelisay doorashooyin qof iyo cod ah oo Puntland ka dhacay bishii Luulyo 2024, inkastoo xogtaas ay tahay dhacdo heer maamul-goboleed. Mukhtaar Roobow iyo xiriirka uu la leeyahay liisaskii Maraykanka Wasiirka wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha islaamka ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane 𝐬𝐡𝐞𝐞𝐤𝐡 𝐌𝐮𝐤𝐡𝐭𝐚𝐚𝐫 𝐑𝐨𝐨𝐛𝐨𝐰 𝐂𝐚𝐥𝐢 Mid ka mid ah qodobada lagu soo hadal qaado dhaleeceynta dowladda ayaa ah magaca wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta, Mukhtaar Roobow Cali, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Abu Mansuur. Dowladda Maraykanka ayaa 2012 ku dartay Roobow barnaamijkeeda Rewards for Justice , iyadoo bixisay abaalmarin gaareysa $5 milyan oo loogu talagalay xog horseedi karta helitaankiisa. Waqtigaas waxaa lagu tilmaamay inuu ahaa hoggaamiye sare oo Al-Shabaab ah. Si kastaba, qodob muhiim ah ayaa ah in abaalmarintaas laga qaaday liiska Rewards for Justice sanadkii 2017, sida ay sheegeen ilo Maraykan ah oo uu soo xigtay Associated Press. Sidaa darteed, in Roobow maanta lagu tilmaamo inuu weli ku jiro “liiska dadka Maraykanku raadinayo” waxay u baahan tahay saxitaan iyo waqti-ku-xirnaan. Dhanka kale, xogta Waaxda Maaliyadda Maraykanka waxay muujinaysaa in Roobow lagu daray liiska Specially Designated Global Terrorist (SDGT) sanadkii 2008. Tani waa nidaam cunaqabateyn dhaqaale oo ka duwan barnaamijka Rewards for Justice. Xogta rasmiga ah ee dowladda Soomaaliya waxay hadda Roobow ku taxdaa wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta. items.title: Elections, the Constitution, and Somaliland: What Is Happening in Mogadishu?
items.description: Somalia’s political dispute deepens over elections and governance MOGADISHU Somalia’s federal government is facing renewed political criticism over elections, constitutional changes and relations with regional actors, as disagreements continue over the country’s political direction. The dispute comes after Somalia’s parliament approved constitutional amendments in March 2026 that could delay elections and extend the terms of federal institutions. The changes triggered opposition from political figures who questioned the process and its implications for the country’s electoral transition. The dispute over Somalia’s elections The President of the Federal Republic of Somalia, Hassan Sheikh Mohamud Somalia has been working toward a transition to universal suffrage, but disagreements over the electoral system and constitutional changes have complicated the process. The European Union Agency for Asylum reported that Somalia’s political environment remained highly divided in 2026, with disagreements over the electoral model and the constitutional changes affecting the terms of federal institutions. The federal government has defended its efforts to establish a one-person, one-vote system. In a May government briefing, officials said President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud was continuing efforts related to democratic transition, state-building and the implementation of universal suffrage elections. It would therefore be misleading to describe Somalia simply as having had “no elections.” Federal elections have faced delays and political disagreements, while electoral processes have taken place at subnational levels. A UN report, for example, documented one-person, one-vote district council elections held in Puntland in July 2024. Mukhtar Robow and his former US reward The Minister of Endowments and Religious Affairs of Somalia, Sheikh Mukhtar Robow Ali. Another issue raised in criticism of the federal government concerns Minister of Endowments and Religious Affairs Mukhtar Robow Ali, also known as Abu Mansur. The U.S. State Department announced in 2012 that its Rewards for Justice program was offering up to $5 million for information leading to Robow’s location. At the time, he was described by the U.S. government as a senior al-Shabaab leader. However, the reward was later withdrawn. The Associated Press reported in 2017 that Robow had been removed from the State Department’s Rewards for Justice list following consultations with the Somali government. There is an important distinction between that reward program and U.S. sanctions. The Treasury Department’s records show that Robow was designated as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist in 2008. Somalia’s official cabinet website currently lists Robow as the federal minister responsible for religious affairs. Somaliland and Mogadishu’s political debate The President of the Republic of Somaliland, Mr. Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi (Cirro) The political dispute in Mogadishu is also connected to relations between the federal government and Somaliland. Somaliland has continued to pursue international relations independently, while Somalia’s federal authorities oppose diplomatic initiatives that they say challenge the country’s territorial integrity. Reuters reported in June that Somaliland had expanded its engagement with Taiwan despite objections from Somalia and China. Somali and Somaliland delegations have also pursued competing diplomatic efforts in Washington as debate over U.S. policy toward Somaliland has intensified. Somali officials have said they are engaging Washington on territorial integrity, security and the country’s strategic relationship with the United States. Claims that the federal government is deliberately using the Somaliland issue to conceal poor governance are political allegations. The available evidence does not independently establish that this is the government’s purpose. A broader debate over government performance A decline in the capital’s revenue Assessments of the federal government’s performance differ sharply. Government officials point to security operations, institutional reforms, electoral preparations and international engagement, while opposition figures and critics have focused on political disputes, electoral delays and tensions with some federal member states. The United States has also expressed growing concern about Somalia’s governance and security environment. Reuters reported in September that Washington agreed to allow the United Nations another year to wind down logistical support for the African Union mission in Somalia, while maintaining its position that it would not continue supporting the UN Support Office in Somalia after the transition period. The debate therefore extends beyond domestic politics and has implications for Somalia’s relations with international partners and for the future of international security support. The post Elections, the Constitution, and Somaliland: What Is Happening in Mogadishu? first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Egypt, CIA Chief Affirm Support for Somalia’s Sovereignty
items.description: Cairo – Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi met with CIA Director John Ratcliffe in Cairo on Sunday, September 20, 2026, where both leaders reaffirmed support for Somalia’s security and stability. The meeting, also attended by Egyptian General Intelligence Director Hassan Rashad, focused on regional developments including the situations in Somalia, Sudan, Gaza, and the Horn of Africa . The talks underscore Egypt’s deepening role as a security partner in the Horn of Africa. Cairo has consistently opposed any actions undermining Somalia’s territorial integrity, particularly following Israel’s recognition of Somaliland in late 2025 . This meeting signals continued coordination between Egypt and the United States on regional security priorities. During the meeting, El-Sisi affirmed Egypt’s full support for efforts to reinforce security and stability in Somalia. He reiterated Egypt’s categorical rejection of any infringement upon Somalia’s sovereignty or territorial integrity . “Egypt views the United States as a key strategic partner in the political, security and economic spheres,” El-Sisi said during the meeting, commending ongoing coordination on regional issues . Ratcliffe expressed appreciation for Egypt’s active role in fostering security and stability across Africa. He emphasized the importance of sustained coordination between Egyptian and U.S. authorities, particularly regarding Somalia, Sudan, and international maritime security . The CIA director also commended Egypt’s pivotal role in supporting peaceful settlements to regional crises and highlighted existing cooperation between the CIA and Egyptian General Intelligence Service in counterterrorism and combating organized crime . The meeting covered multiple regional crises. On Gaza, El-Sisi called for full implementation of the second phase of the U.S.-proposed ceasefire plan, ensuring humanitarian aid access and creating conditions for a political process toward a two-state solution . Regarding Sudan, El-Sisi reaffirmed Egypt’s support for Sudan’s unity and stability, calling its sovereignty and territorial integrity “non-negotiable principles ” . The discussions also addressed the Iranian crisis, with El-Sisi supporting efforts toward a comprehensive agreement to restore regional stability and ensure freedom of international navigation . items.title: Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay oo xoojinaya iskaashiga, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo nabadda, dhaqaalaha iyo amniga cuntada
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf , iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, António Guterres , ayaa magaalada New York ku wada shir-guddoomiyey kulan heer sare ah oo u dhexeeya Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay, kaas oo looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga labada hay’adood. Kulanka waxaa lagu adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada shaqaynta Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay, gaar ahaan wax ka qabashada caqabadaha dhismeed ee horyaalla qaaradda iyo sidii Afrika ay uga heli lahayd door iyo faa’iido badan nidaamka caalamiga ah. Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay waxay si gaar ah uga wada hadleen dib-u-habaynta nidaamka maaliyadeed ee caalamka, waarta deynta iyo maaraynta deymo waara , iyadoo sidoo kale xoogga la saaray sidii dalalka Afrika ay qiimo dheeraad ah uga heli lahaayeen macdanta muhiimka ah ee qaaradda. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale sheegay baahida loo qabo in la dhammeystiro khariidadda wadajirka ah ee iskaashiga AU iyo UN-ka ee ka dambaysa sannadka 2026. Arrimaha nabadda iyo amniga ayaa ka mid ahaa qodobada ugu waaweyn ee kulanka. Labada dhinac waxay carrabka ku adkeeyeen xoojinta qaab-dhismeedka nabadda iyo amniga Afrika, horumarinta diblomaasiyadda ka hortagga colaadaha iyo dhexdhexaadinta, iyo in la helo khayraadka lagama maarmaanka u ah xalalka ay Afrika hoggaaminayso. Kulanka waxaa lagu eegay xaaladaha ka jira Saaxil, Liibiya, Suudaan, Koonfurta Suudaan, Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo (DRC) . Sidoo kale waxaa la xaqiijiyey sii wadidda taageerada dadaallada dhexdhexaadinta ee Togo ka waddo xaaladda DRC. Soomaaliya oo ka mid ahayd dalalka laga hadlay Soomaaliya waxay ka mid ahayd dalalka si gaar ah loogu xusay wada-hadallada ku saabsan xaaladda nabadda iyo amniga qaaradda. Si kastaba, bayaanka Midowga Afrika ma uusan faahfaahin tallaabo cusub oo gaar ah oo Soomaaliya loogu dhawaaqay kulankan, balse wuxuu Soomaaliya ku daray dalalka laga hadlay xaaladdooda amni iyo siyaasadeed. Labada hay’adood waxay sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyeen saameynta ay Afrika ku leeyihiin colaadaha, carqaladaha silsiladaha sahayda caalamka iyo khalkhal ku yimaada marinnada muhiimka ah ee badda . Arrimahan ayaa cadaadis dheeraad ah saaraya dhaqaalaha Afrika iyo sugnaanta cuntada. Waxaa sidoo kale laga hadlay khatarta ka dhalan karta dhacdooyinka la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada , gaar ahaan marka ay sii kordhiyaan nuglaanta dalalka Afrika. Dhamaadka kulanka, AU iyo UN waxay isku raaceen in la qaado tallaabooyin la taaban karo, oo ay ka mid yihiin dhammeystirka khariidadda iskaashiga AU–UN , qorsheynta hawlgal wadajir ah oo ku saabsan Liibiya iyo Suudaan , aqoonsiga dalalka Afrika ee ugu nugul cunto-yaraanta iyo diyaarinta qorshayaal wax-ka-qabasho iyadoo la xoojinayo isku-duwidda iyo maalgelinta. Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu sii adkeynayo xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay, gaar ahaan xilli qaaradda ay wajahayso caqabado dhinaca amniga, dhaqaalaha, cuntada iyo cimilada ah.

Kulanka waxaa lagu adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada shaqaynta Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay, gaar ahaan wax ka qabashada caqabadaha dhismeed ee horyaalla qaaradda iyo sidii Afrika ay uga heli lahayd door iyo faa’iido badan nidaamka caalamiga ah. Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay waxay si gaar ah uga wada hadleen dib-u-habaynta nidaamka maaliyadeed ee caalamka, waarta deynta iyo maaraynta deymo waara , iyadoo sidoo kale xoogga la saaray sidii dalalka Afrika ay qiimo dheeraad ah uga heli lahaayeen macdanta muhiimka ah ee qaaradda. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale sheegay baahida loo qabo in la dhammeystiro khariidadda wadajirka ah ee iskaashiga AU iyo UN-ka ee ka dambaysa sannadka 2026. Arrimaha nabadda iyo amniga ayaa ka mid ahaa qodobada ugu waaweyn ee kulanka. Labada dhinac waxay carrabka ku adkeeyeen xoojinta qaab-dhismeedka nabadda iyo amniga Afrika, horumarinta diblomaasiyadda ka hortagga colaadaha iyo dhexdhexaadinta, iyo in la helo khayraadka lagama maarmaanka u ah xalalka ay Afrika hoggaaminayso. Kulanka waxaa lagu eegay xaaladaha ka jira Saaxil, Liibiya, Suudaan, Koonfurta Suudaan, Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo (DRC) . Sidoo kale waxaa la xaqiijiyey sii wadidda taageerada dadaallada dhexdhexaadinta ee Togo ka waddo xaaladda DRC. Soomaaliya oo ka mid ahayd dalalka laga hadlay Soomaaliya waxay ka mid ahayd dalalka si gaar ah loogu xusay wada-hadallada ku saabsan xaaladda nabadda iyo amniga qaaradda. Si kastaba, bayaanka Midowga Afrika ma uusan faahfaahin tallaabo cusub oo gaar ah oo Soomaaliya loogu dhawaaqay kulankan, balse wuxuu Soomaaliya ku daray dalalka laga hadlay xaaladdooda amni iyo siyaasadeed. Labada hay’adood waxay sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyeen saameynta ay Afrika ku leeyihiin colaadaha, carqaladaha silsiladaha sahayda caalamka iyo khalkhal ku yimaada marinnada muhiimka ah ee badda . Arrimahan ayaa cadaadis dheeraad ah saaraya dhaqaalaha Afrika iyo sugnaanta cuntada. Waxaa sidoo kale laga hadlay khatarta ka dhalan karta dhacdooyinka la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada , gaar ahaan marka ay sii kordhiyaan nuglaanta dalalka Afrika. Dhamaadka kulanka, AU iyo UN waxay isku raaceen in la qaado tallaabooyin la taaban karo, oo ay ka mid yihiin dhammeystirka khariidadda iskaashiga AU–UN , qorsheynta hawlgal wadajir ah oo ku saabsan Liibiya iyo Suudaan , aqoonsiga dalalka Afrika ee ugu nugul cunto-yaraanta iyo diyaarinta qorshayaal wax-ka-qabasho iyadoo la xoojinayo isku-duwidda iyo maalgelinta. Kulankan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu sii adkeynayo xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay, gaar ahaan xilli qaaradda ay wajahayso caqabado dhinaca amniga, dhaqaalaha, cuntada iyo cimilada ah.

items.title: Toddoba koox oo Itoobiya uga dhowaaqay isbaheysi weyn oo xukunka looga tuurayo Abiy
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online — Toddoba urur oo isugu jira mucaarad siyaasadeed iyo kooxo hubeysan oo Itoobiyaan ah ayaa ku dhawaaqay isbahaysi cusub oo ay sheegeen inuu ujeedkiisu yahay in xilka laga tuuro xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed, laguna beddelo maamul ku-meel-gaar ah oo loo dhan yahay. Isbahaysiga cusub, oo lagu magacaabo Ethiopian Peoples’ Forces Alliance for Survival , ayaa waxaa ku mideysan dhaqdhaqaaqyo ka kala socda gobollo dhowr ah oo Itoobiya ka tirsan, kuwaas oo qaarkood horey iskaga soo horjeeday dagaalladii dalka ka dhacay sannadihii u dambeeyay. Kooxaha xubnaha ka ah waxaa ka mid ah Amhara Fano National Movement, Oromo Liberation Army (OLA), Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF), Ogaden National Liberation Front (ONLF), Afar Revolutionary Democratic Unity Front, Benishangul Peoples’ Liberation Movement iyo Gumuz Peoples’ Democratic Movement. Bayaan ay soo saareen ayay ku sheegeen inay isku raaceen inay mideeyaan awooddooda siyaasadeed iyo abaabulkooda, iyagoo dowladda Abiy ku eedeeyay kali-talisnimo, colaado daba-dheeraaday iyo xaalad dhaqaale oo sii xumaaneysa. “Waxaan, xoogagga shacabka ee ka walaacsan badbaadada shucuubta Itoobiya, qaadeynaa mas’uuliyadda taariikhiga ah ee ah in nidaamkan la rido,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Isbahaysigu wuxuu sheegay in haddii dowladda hadda jirta meesha laga saaro, la dhisi doono dowlad ku-meel-gaar ah oo ku shaqeysa axdi cusub, laguna bilaabo wada-hadal dastuuri ah oo loo dhan yahay. Si kastaba, bayaanka laguma faahfaahin cidda hoggaamineysa isbahaysiga, qaabka taliska milatari ama sida kooxaha xubnaha ka ah ay isugu dubbaridi doonaan howlgaladooda. Khilaafaad hore oo weli taagan Waxyaabaha isbahaysigan ka dhigaya mid si gaar ah isha loogu hayo waxaa ka mid ah taariikhda colaadeed ee u dhexeysa xubnihiisa. TPLF waxay dagaal adag la gashay dowladda federaalka intii u dhexeysay 2020 iyo 2022, halka xoogagga Amxaarada, oo Fano ay ka mid yihiin, ay markaas la dhinac ahaayeen ciidamada dowladda. OLA-na waxay xilligaas xiriir la lahayd dhinaca Tigrayga ee ka soo horjeeday Addis Ababa. Dagaalkii Tigray wuxuu si rasmi ah ugu dhammaaday heshiiskii Pretoria ee November 2022, laakiin xiriirka Addis Ababa iyo TPLF ayaa mar kale xumaaday, taasoo dhalisay cabsi laga qabo in colaado cusub ay ka qarxaan waqooyiga Itoobiya. Dhanka kale, dowladda federaalka iyo Fano ayaa dagaallamaya tan iyo 2023, kadib muran ka dhashay qorshe lagu mideynayay ciidamada gaarka ah ee gobollada iyo hay’adaha amniga federaalka. OLA-na waxay weli dagaal kula jirtaa ciidamada dowladda gudaha Oromia. Bilihii la soo dhaafay waxaa jiray warar sheegaya in TPLF, Fano, OLA iyo ONLF ay ka wada-hadlayeen iskaashi ka dhan ah Abiy Ahmed, inkastoo khilaafaad dhuleed iyo aragtiyo siyaasadeed oo aad u kala duwan ay caqabad ku noqon karaan iskaashi waara. OLA ayaa 17-kii September sheegtay in iskaashiga ka dhexeeya kooxaha mucaaradka uusan weli ka dhigneyn heshiis laga gaaray arrimaha waaweyn sida federaalka, is-maamulka iyo mustaqbalka qaab-dhismeedka Itoobiya. Isbahaysiga cusub ayaa lagu dhawaaqay saddex bilood kadib doorashadii guud ee Itoobiya, taasoo xisbiga Prosperity Party ee Abiy Ahmed uu ku helay 438 kursi oo baarlamaanka ah, sida ay shaaciyeen guddiga doorashada. Doorashadaas kama dhicin dhammaan dalka. Gobolka Tigray wax codbixin ah kama dhicin, halka amni-darro ay carqaladeysay codbixinta qeybo ka mid ah Amhara iyo Oromia. Abiy Ahmed wuxuu talada Itoobiya hayaa tan iyo 2018, wuxuuna sanadkii 2019 sameeyay xisbiga Prosperity Party kadib markii la kala diray isbahaysigii EPRDF ee muddo ku dhow 30 sano dalka maamulayay. Isbahaysiga cusub wuxuu abuurayaa saf mucaarad oo ka ballaaran kuwii hore, laakiin weli waxaa taagan su’aal ku saabsan sida kooxo leh taariikh colaadeed, muranno dhuleed iyo hadafyo siyaasadeed oo kala duwan ay hal mowqif ugu sii jiri karaan ka soo horjeedka dowladda Abiy Ahmed. The post Toddoba koox oo Itoobiya uga dhowaaqay isbaheysi weyn oo xukunka looga tuurayo Abiy appeared first on Caasimada Online .
