items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo u safraya dalka Mareykanka
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa saacadaha soo socda ku wajahan magaalada New York ee dalka Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu uga qaybgeli doono shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Madaxweynaha ayaa Soomaaliya ku matali doona Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo madaxda dowladaha caalamku ay isugu imaanayaan magaalada New York si ay uga qaybgalaan doodaha heerka sare ee Qaramada Midoobay. Inta uu ku sugan yahay New York, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa ka qaybgeli doona kulamada iyo doodaha looga hadlayo arrimaha muhiimka ah ee caalamka, gaar ahaan nabadda iyo amniga, horumarka, isbeddelka cimilada, xaaladaha bani’aadantinimo iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inuu yeesho kulamo gaar-gaar ah oo uu kula qaato madaxda dowladaha iyo mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan hay’adaha caalamiga ah, kuwaas oo looga hadli karo arrimaha khuseeya Soomaaliya iyo xiriirka ay la leedahay bulshada caalamka. Safarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay dadaal ugu jirto xoojinta xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo taageerada caalamiga ah ee dhinacyada amniga, dowlad-dhiska, horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo xasilinta dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale fursad u heli doona inuu madasha Qaramada Midoobay ku soo bandhigo aragtida Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan xaaladda dalka, guulaha la gaaray iyo caqabadaha weli horyalla. items.title: Dawladda Sucuudiga ayaa war ka soo saartay oo xaqiijisay…
items.description: Sacuudiga oo hadda war cusub soo saaray Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa xaqiijisay in Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay isku dayeen inay Riyadh, caasimadda dalka, ku bartilmaameedsadaan gantaal ballistic ah. Tani waa weerarkii ugu horreeyay ee lagu qaado Riyadh tan iyo markii ay sii xooggaysatay xiisada. Horey, Xuutiyiintu waxay iyagoo adeegsanaya gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku bartilmaameedsadeen goobo “xasaasi” ah oo ku yaalla Riyadh, caasimadda Sacuudiga. Sacuudi Carabiya waxay sheegtay in gantaalkii lagu soo riday Riyadh “la qabtay oo la burburiyay.” Wakaaladda Associated Press ayaa sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah dadka deggan Riyadh ay maqleen qarax, kaddibna ay arkeen qiiq madow ooka kacaya meel u dhow garoonka diyaaradaha. AFP-na waxay sheegtay in laba qarax oo xooggan laga maqlay Riyadh Sabtidii, iyadoo wariyayaasheeduna ay arkeen haan shidaal oo ay leedahay shirkadda shidaalka ee Saudi Aramco, oo ku dhow garoonka diyaaradaha, oo dab qabsaday. Khilaafka u dhexeeya Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Xuutiyiinta ayaa galay marxalad cusub. Xuutiyiintu waxay gacanta ku hayaan qayb weyn oo ka mid ah Yemen, waxaana dhowaan ay qabsadeen magaalooyin xeebeedyo ku dhow Marinka Bab al-Mandab iyo jasiiradihiisa. Maraykanka ayaa Sabtidii ka digay in colaadda u dhexeysa Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Xuutiyiinta oo ay Iran taageerto ay “si degdeg ah u sii xoogaysan karto.”

AFP-na waxay sheegtay in laba qarax oo xooggan laga maqlay Riyadh Sabtidii, iyadoo wariyayaasheeduna ay arkeen haan shidaal oo ay leedahay shirkadda shidaalka ee Saudi Aramco, oo ku dhow garoonka diyaaradaha, oo dab qabsaday. Khilaafka u dhexeeya Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Xuutiyiinta ayaa galay marxalad cusub. Xuutiyiintu waxay gacanta ku hayaan qayb weyn oo ka mid ah Yemen, waxaana dhowaan ay qabsadeen magaalooyin xeebeedyo ku dhow Marinka Bab al-Mandab iyo jasiiradihiisa. Maraykanka ayaa Sabtidii ka digay in colaadda u dhexeysa Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Xuutiyiinta oo ay Iran taageerto ay “si degdeg ah u sii xoogaysan karto.”

items.title: Taliyaha ciidanka xoogga oo maanta saxiixay amar cusub
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa saxiixay amar ku saabsan ka hortagga iyo wax-ka-qabashada tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah haweenka xilliyada colaadaha. Amarkan ayaa lagu xoojinayaa dadaallada lagu hor istaagayo tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah haweenka, gaar ahaan kuwa dhaca xilliyada colaadaha, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo ilaalinta xuquuqda, karaamada iyo badqabka haweenka. Sidoo kale, amarka ayaa dejinaya waajibaadyo cad oo la xiriira ka hortagga iyo soo-sheegidda kiisaska tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah haweenka iyo tallaabooyinka lagu baarayo laguna wajahayo kiisaska noocaas ah. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa lagu sheegay in loo marayo shuruucda dalka iyo xeerarka caalamiga ah ee khuseeya ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah xilliyada colaadaha, iyadoo la xoojinayo habraacyada wax looga qabanayo tacaddiyada. Saxiixa amarka Taliyaha ciidanka xoogga dalka ayaa ka dhashay wada-shaqeyn iyo dadaallo joogto ah oo laga sameeyay arrintan, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ahaa hawlo lagu xoojinayo ka hortagga tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah haweenka xilliyada colaadaha. Dadaalladaas waxaa ka qeyb qaatay Kooxda Xuquuqda Aadanaha iyo Ilaalinta ee UNTMIS iyo Wakiilka Gaarka ah ee Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan tacaddiyada lagula kaco haweenka xilliyada colaadaha. Labada dhinac ayaa ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed kala shaqeynayay sidii loo xoojin lahaa ka hortagga iyo wax-ka-qabashada tacaddiyada ka dhanka ah haweenka xilliyada colaadaha, iyadoo amarka cusub uu qeyb ka yahay dadaalladaas. The post Taliyaha ciidanka xoogga oo maanta saxiixay amar cusub appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Daacish oo weerar ku qaaday guriga sarkaal ka tirsan ciidamada Puntland
items.description: Qandala (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Daacish ayaa xalay weerar ku qaaday guriga sarkaal ka tirsan ciidanka Daraawiishta Puntland, kaas oo ku yaalla deegaanka Kayaxa oo u dhow tuulada Sheebaab ee degmada Qandala. Xilliga uu weerarku dhacay, guriga waxaa ku sugnaa saddex carruur ah oo yaryar, hooyadood iyo ayeeyadood, waxaana lagu weeraray rasaas iyo bambooyin gacanta laga tuuro, sida uu sheegay sarkaalka ciidanka oo ah aabaha qoyska. Taliyaha Horinta Daljir ee ciidanka Daraawiishta Puntland, Siciid Cali Orshe oo ka hadlay weerarka lagu qaaday qoyskiisa ayaa sheegay in uusan marnaba noqon doonin cabsi-gelin uu uga haro dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxda Daacish ee Calmiskaad. Inkastoo weerarku sababay burbur hantiyeed, haddana ma jirin wax khasaare nafeed ah oo kasoo gaaray dadka guriga ku sugnaa. Ciidanka Puntland ayaa goobta gaaray kadib markii ay heleen wararka ku saabsan weerarka, balse kooxdii weerarka geysatay ayaa goobta isaga baxsatay, sida uu sheegay Siciid Orshe. Ciidamada ayaa bilaabay raad-raac lagu baadi-goobayo kooxihii weerarka soo qaaday, iyadoo aan weli la shaacin in la qabtay cid loo tuhunsan yahay weerarka. Weerarkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ciidamada Puntland ay wadaan howl-gallo culus oo ka dhan ah kooxda Daacish, taas oo jab xooggan lagu gaarsiiyay kooxda. The post Daacish oo weerar ku qaaday guriga sarkaal ka tirsan ciidamada Puntland appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ganacsiga Bariga Afrika oo kordhay 37%, gaarayna $52.3 bilyan
items.description: Ganacsiga dalalka ku mideysan Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC) ayaa si weyn u kordhay rubucii labaad ee sannadka 2026, iyadoo qiimaha guud ee ganacsiga gobolka uu gaaray $52.3 bilyan , taas oo ah koror dhan 37% marka loo eego isla muddadii 2025-kii oo uu ahaa $38.2 bilyan. Xogtan ayaa ku jirta warbixinta tirakoobka saddex-biloodlaha ah ee EAC ee bilihii Abriil ilaa Juun 2026 . Kororka ganacsiga waxaa si weyn u taageeray kordhinta dhoofinta, gaar ahaan macdanta iyo biraha qiimaha leh. Dhoofinta dalalka EAC waxay korortay 41.3% , iyadoo gaartay $26.3 bilyan , halka badeecadaha dibadda laga soo dejiyay ay kordheen 32.9% , oo gaartay $26 bilyan. Arrintaasi waxay gobolka siisay faa’iido ganacsi oo dhan $300 milyan , halka sanad ka hor uu jiray hoos-u-dhac ganacsi oo gaarayay $945.3 milyan. Macdanta ayaa qayb weyn ka qaadatay kororka dhoofinta. Copper-ka iyo biraha qaaliga ah ayaa kaligood ka dhigay 61.9% dhammaan dhoofinta EAC, marka loo eego 58.7% sanadkii hore. Dhoofinta EAC ee dalalka Afrika ayaa korortay 44.3% , waxayna gaartay $7.2 bilyan, oo u dhiganta 27.5% dhammaan dhoofinta gobolka. Dhoofinta loo iib geeyo dalalka ku jira SADC ayaa korortay 50.8%, iyadoo gaartay $5.1 bilyan, halka dhoofinta loo diray dalalka COMESA ay korortay 48.3%, oo gaartay $3.1 bilyan. Shiinaha ayaa noqday suuqa ugu weyn ee dhoofinta EAC, iyadoo dhoofinta loo diray dalkaasi ay ku dhowaad laba jibbaartay, kana kacday $5.7 bilyan rubucii labaad ee 2025 ilaa $10.7 bilyan isla muddadii 2026, sidoo kale Kororka waxaa si weyn u waday macdanta iyo alaabaha ceeriin. Ganacsiga u dhexeeya dalalka xubnaha ka ah EAC isaguna wuu kordhay, ayadoo dhoofinta gudaha bulshada ay korortay 33.2% , waxayna gaartay $3.2 bilyan. Si kastaba, saamiga ganacsiga gudaha EAC ee dhammaan dhoofinta gobolka ayaa wax yar hoos ugu dhacay 12.1% , marka loo eego 12.8% sanadkii 2025. EAC waxay sheegtay in sababtu tahay in dhoofinta loo diro suuqyada ka baxsan bulshada ay ka dhaqso badan tahay kobaca ganacsiga gudaha. Soomaaliya waxay ka mid tahay siddeedda dal ee hadda xubnaha ka ah EAC , waxaana ururka ku jira Soomaaliya, Burundi, DRC, Kenya, Rwanda, Koonfurta Suudaan, Uganda iyo Tanzania. Kororka ganacsiga gobolka wuxuu Soomaaliya siin karaa fursado dheeraad ah oo la xiriira suuqa Bariga Afrika, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dhoofinta, maalgashiga iyo isku-xirka ganacsiga gobolka.

items.title: Uganda oo hakisay iskaashigii militari ee Turkiga, iyadoo arrintu saameyn ku yeelan karto amniga Soomaaliya
items.description: Dowladda Uganda ayaa si degdeg ah u hakisay dhammaan iskaashigii difaac iyo militari ee ay la lahayd Turkiga, iyadoo sheegtay in tallaabadaasi ay sii jiri doonto ilaa la xalliyo arrimo ay labada dhinac kala tabanayaan. Go’aanka waxaa 19-kii Sebtembar 2026 ku dhawaaqay Korneyl Chris Magezi , oo ah ku-simaha Agaasimaha Warfaafinta Difaaca ee Wasaaradda Difaaca iyo Arrimaha Ciidamadii Hore ee Uganda. UPDF ma aysan faahfaahin waxa ay yihiin arrimaha la isku hayo ama heshiisyada gaarka ah ee uu hakadku saameynayo. Go’aankan ayaa soo baxay xilli xiriirka Kampala iyo Ankara uu muddooyinkii u dambeeyay sii xumaanayay, gaar ahaan arrin la xiriirta Fred Lumbuye , oo ah nin u dhashay Uganda oo dowladda dalkiisa si weyn u dhaliila, kuna nool Turkiga. 18-kii Sebtembar, taageerayaal ka tirsan Patriotic League of Uganda (PLU) ayaa banaanbax ka dhigay bannaanka Safaaradda Turkiga ee Kampala, iyagoo dalbaday in Ankara ay Lumbuye ku wareejiso dowladda Uganda. Warbaahinta ayaa sheegtay in General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, oo ah Taliyaha Ciidamada Difaaca Uganda, uu muddo ku cadaadinayay Turkiga arrintan. Si kastaba, bayaanka rasmiga ah ee UPDF si toos ah uguma xirin hakinta iskaashiga militari arrinta Lumbuye , waxaana ciidamada Uganda aysan shaacin sababta gaarka ah ee ka dambeysa go’aanka. items.title: Mareykanka oo muwaadiniintiisa uga digay safarrada Bariga Dhexe
items.description: Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa muwaadiniinteeda kula talisay inay dib uga fiirsadaan safarrada ay ku tagayaan ama ku sii marayaan dalalka Bariga Dhexe, iyadoo sabab uga dhigtay xiisadaha sii kordhaya ee gobolka iyo khatarta ah in xaaladdu si degdeg ah uga sii darto. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa digniin caalami ah oo cusub ku sheegtay in muwaadiniinta Mareykanka ee ku sugan Bariga Dhexe ay muujiyaan feejignaan dheeraad ah, isla markaana ay diyaar u ahaadaan suurtagalnimada in la joojiyo duulimaadyo, la xiro hawada ama ay dhacaan carqalado kale oo dhinaca safarrada ah. Wasaaraddu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Iiraan iyo kooxaha taageera Tehran ay bartilmaameedsan karaan danaha Mareykanka, shirkadaha iyo xarumaha uu dalkaasi ku leeyahay dibadda. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa weli ku jira heerka saddexaad ee digniinta safarka ee Mareykanka, taas oo muwaadiniinta lagu wargelinayo inay dib uga fiirsadaan safarka dalkaasi. Mareykanku wuxuu digniintiisa ku xusay khatarta weerarro ay diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo gantaallada Iran ku qaadi karaan danaha Mareykanka, iyo sidoo kale khataraha la xiriira colaadaha hubeysan, argagixisada, xannibaadda bixitaanka iyo sharciyada maxalliga ah, gaar ahaan kuwa la xiriira isticmaalka baraha bulshada. Digniintan ayaa soo baxday xilli xaaladda gobolka ay weli kacsan tahay, iyadoo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah u jeediyeen dhanka Sacuudiga. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada difaaca cirka ay qabteen gantaal ballistic ah oo ay Xuutiyiintu ka soo rideen Yemen, kaas oo lagu waday caasimadda Riyadh. Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Xuutiyiintu isku dayeen inay weeraraan kaabayaal rayid oo ku yaalla deegaannada Bisha, Taif, Farasan iyo Yanbu. Digniinta Mareykanka ayaa ku soo beegantay xilli weerarrada iyo xiisadaha militari ee Bariga Dhexe ay kordheen, taas oo Washington ay ku tilmaantay xaalad u baahan feejignaan dheeraad ah, gaar ahaan muwaadiniinteeda iyo danaha Mareykanka ee gobolka.

items.title: Sacuudiga oo sheegay in la qabtay gantaal Xuutiyiintu ku rideen Riyadh
items.description: Isbahaysiga uu hoggaamiyo Sacuudiga ee dagaalka ka wada Yemen ayaa sheegay in nidaamyada difaaca cirka ay qabteen oo burburiyeen gantaal ballistic ah oo kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay ku soo rideen caasimadda Riyadh. Sida ay sheegtay Al Jazeera, gantaalka ayaa la sheegay in la riday waaberigii Sabtidii, iyadoo weerarku dhacay xilli digniino degdeg ah laga bixiyay qaybo ka mid ah Sacuudiga. Tani waxay ahayd markii ugu horreysay ee magaalada Riyadh laga yeeriyo digniin duqeyn cirka ah tan iyo markii uu dagaalka u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudigu dib u xoogaystay bishii July. Afhayeenka ciidamada isbahaysiga, Sarreeye Gaas Turki al-Maliki, ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiintu sidoo kale isku dayeen inay bartilmaameedsadaan dad rayid ah iyo kaabayaal rayid oo ku yaalla magaalooyinka Bisha, Taif, Farasan iyo Yanbu, balse uu sheegay in dhammaan weerarradaas la fashiliyay. Mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga ayaa sheegay in aan la soo sheegin wax dhimasho ama dhaawac ah, balse qarax ayaa laga maqlay Riyadh, halka dad ku dhow garoonka diyaaradaha King Khalid ay sheegeen inay arkeen qiiq madow oo cirka isku shareeray. Dhinaca kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay inay weerareen goobo ay ku tilmaameen “xasaasi” oo ku yaalla Riyadh, iyo xarun shidaal oo ay leedahay shirkadda Aramco oo ku taalla magaalada Yanbu ee xeebta galbeed. Afhayeenka militariga Xuutiyiinta, Yahya Saree, ayaa sheegay in weerarrada loo adeegsaday gantaallo ballistic ah, gantaallo cruise ah iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn. Iskahorimaadyada gudaha Yemen ayaa sidoo kale dib uga soo cusboonaaday dhowr gobol, oo ay ku jiraan Marib, Taiz, Lahj, al-Jawf iyo al-Bayda. Dagaalladan ayaa qayb ka ah kororka xiisadda milatari ee billaabatay horraantii July, kaas oo lagu tilmaamay kii ugu xoogga badnaa tan iyo xabbad-joojintii April 2022 ee hoos u dhigtay dagaalladii dalka.

items.title: Baaq nabadeed Suldaan Daauud suldaan Maxamed
items.description: Suldaan Daa’uud Sul. Maxamed Sul. Cabdiqaadir Suldaanka Guud ee Somaliland oo Baaq Nabaddeed u diray beelo walaalo ah ee Dirir dhex martay. “Waxaan baaq nabadeed udirayaa beelaha walaalaha ah ee Samaroon iyo Ciise ee ku dagaalamaya gobolada galbeedka somaliland. Colaad wiil baa ku dhinta ee wiil kuma dhasho, waxa meesha ku dagaalamayaa waa dad ehel ah oo wada dhashay, waa wiil iyo abtigii waxaan ugu baaqayaa labada dhinac’ba Nabad, Nabad baa naas la nuugo lehe nimanyow illahay ka cab’sada oo toloow colka jooja, una soo noqda gogosha nabada iyo wada hadalka, diyaar baan anaguna unahay in aanu idin kala hawlgalno waxkaste oo ay nabadu ku xidhmayso. Intii dhimatay waxaan leeyahay alle ha unaxariisto inta dhaawac ahna alle ha u booga dhayo. Ugu dambeyn shacabweyna reer somaliland waxaan ugu baaqayaa in ay ka shaqeyyaan nabada iyo wixii wanaag ah ee dadka isu jiidaya ALLA MAHAD LEH

items.title: Dried up water source in Bari mountains leaves thousands facing acute water crisis
items.description: (ERGO) – The drying up of a natural water source in a small town in a mountainous part of Puntland’s Bari region has left more than 10,000 people – including local and conflict-displaced families – facing a critical water shortage. The source in Tasjiic, 90 km south east of Bosaso, dried up in August. The affected communities, including poor families and pastoralists, can’t afford water sold by tankers from Waaciye, 40 km away, that sells for $6-8 per 200-litre drum. Saytun Mahad Mohamed, 48, said her family of 10 relies on 20 litres of water from neighbours. When they can’t get any, they go for long hours without water. “The water shortage has affected us severely. We are struggling to get drinking water, and there is no water for bathing or washing clothes,” she said. “We are suffering from a severe drought. We beg people who have managed to fetch even a small amount of water to give us a container so that we can survive.” Her husband, who worked in the frankincense trade in the Almiskad mountains, has been unemployed for the past six months following a Puntland government order for people to leave the area, where a military operation led by government with foreign backing is underway against the Islamic State – ISIS, or Daesh. The order to evacuate the highland area was intended to protect civilians from airstrikes but also ended opportunities to harvest frankincense, a livelihood on which many families depended. The family moved from the Almiskad mountains to Tasjiic in 2025 because of the conflict. They are eating one small meal a day, relying on food given by better-off people. Saytun said her children, the youngest aged three, have become thin and show signs of malnutrition. The family has been unable to find casual work locally. Most of their 95 goats died from lack of water and pasture and unidentified diseases. Only 10 remain, but the family can’t afford to provide them with feed or water. Saytun owes more than $3,000 to shops for food bought on credit. The shopkeepers stopped extending her further credit in mid-August. “I have been forced to rely on credit to obtain water and food, and this is causing me great distress,” she said. “I can’t repay what I owe because I have no income. We have lost both the livestock and the frankincense work we depended on.” The family has to vacate the two rooms temporarily provided by relatives by the end of September. They can’t afford the $50 monthly rent for similar accommodation in the area. Three of her children have been out of primary and Koranic school since June because she could not pay their combined $45 fees. Another resident, Mumino Shire Nur, said her family had struggled to obtain water since the local source dried up. She saves the few litres given by neighbours. “The most difficult challenge we are facing is the lack of water,” she said. “We divide a single 20-litre container between drinking and cooking one meal, but it is not enough. We cannot continue living like this.” Mumino’s small business selling tea, doughnuts and other goods has collapsed, leaving her without an income to support the nine children in her care. Her husband died in 2024 from a brain haemorrhage linked to high blood pressure after spending a week in a coma in a Hargeisa hospital. She owes $300 to shops for food, and has more than $800 in other outstanding payments for water, household needs and business supplies. The family sometimes eats only once a day using the dollar or so given by relatives in Bosaso and Qardho. They also struggle to access other basic services. “There is no money to pay for education, and healthcare is no different. Life depends on having an income, and without work, everything has fallen apart,” Mumino said. Two of her children, aged three and five, have suffered diarrhoea and vomiting since early September, but she can’t afford medicine. There are no free health services in the area. Four of her children stopped attending the village school in July after she could no longer pay their combined $40 fees. Her family moved from rural Tasjiic in 2020 after drought killed the 180 goats on which they depended. Bari region is known for fishing, frankincense, livestock and natural water sources, but reduced rainfall and climate change have made these resources increasingly scarce. Tasjiic district chairman, Farah Nur Ali, said the water shortage affected more than 10,000 people, including local residents, pastoralists, people displaced by the Almiskad conflict, and also soldiers stationed in the mountains. People living across the nearly 63-kilometre area between Tasjiic and Ufeyn all relied on the free water source. “People who were already facing financial hardship are now struggling with both water shortages and hunger,” Farah said. “They depended on frankincense work and livestock, but drought and conflict have affected their livelihoods and left them without these sources of income. The most pressing needs are healthcare, water and food.” He said the Puntland administration and aid agencies had been informed of the situation but no aid had been delivered. He warned that conditions would worsen without intervention. Source: Ergo The post Dried up water source in Bari mountains leaves thousands facing acute water crisis appeared first on WardheerNews .

Most of their 95 goats died from lack of water and pasture and unidentified diseases. Only 10 remain, but the family can’t afford to provide them with feed or water. Saytun owes more than $3,000 to shops for food bought on credit. The shopkeepers stopped extending her further credit in mid-August. “I have been forced to rely on credit to obtain water and food, and this is causing me great distress,” she said. “I can’t repay what I owe because I have no income. We have lost both the livestock and the frankincense work we depended on.” The family has to vacate the two rooms temporarily provided by relatives by the end of September. They can’t afford the $50 monthly rent for similar accommodation in the area. Three of her children have been out of primary and Koranic school since June because she could not pay their combined $45 fees. Another resident, Mumino Shire Nur, said her family had struggled to obtain water since the local source dried up. She saves the few litres given by neighbours. “The most difficult challenge we are facing is the lack of water,” she said. “We divide a single 20-litre container between drinking and cooking one meal, but it is not enough. We cannot continue living like this.” Mumino’s small business selling tea, doughnuts and other goods has collapsed, leaving her without an income to support the nine children in her care. Her husband died in 2024 from a brain haemorrhage linked to high blood pressure after spending a week in a coma in a Hargeisa hospital. She owes $300 to shops for food, and has more than $800 in other outstanding payments for water, household needs and business supplies. The family sometimes eats only once a day using the dollar or so given by relatives in Bosaso and Qardho. They also struggle to access other basic services. “There is no money to pay for education, and healthcare is no different. Life depends on having an income, and without work, everything has fallen apart,” Mumino said. Two of her children, aged three and five, have suffered diarrhoea and vomiting since early September, but she can’t afford medicine. There are no free health services in the area. Four of her children stopped attending the village school in July after she could no longer pay their combined $40 fees. Her family moved from rural Tasjiic in 2020 after drought killed the 180 goats on which they depended. Bari region is known for fishing, frankincense, livestock and natural water sources, but reduced rainfall and climate change have made these resources increasingly scarce. Tasjiic district chairman, Farah Nur Ali, said the water shortage affected more than 10,000 people, including local residents, pastoralists, people displaced by the Almiskad conflict, and also soldiers stationed in the mountains. People living across the nearly 63-kilometre area between Tasjiic and Ufeyn all relied on the free water source. “People who were already facing financial hardship are now struggling with both water shortages and hunger,” Farah said. “They depended on frankincense work and livestock, but drought and conflict have affected their livelihoods and left them without these sources of income. The most pressing needs are healthcare, water and food.” He said the Puntland administration and aid agencies had been informed of the situation but no aid had been delivered. He warned that conditions would worsen without intervention. Source: Ergo The post Dried up water source in Bari mountains leaves thousands facing acute water crisis appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Leadership Ethics and Institutional Integrity: Two Inseparable Foundations
items.description: By Nur Hassan Gure (Nurdin) Somalia’s crisis will not be solved by piety alone or by institutions alone a response to Dr. Abdurahman Baadiyow and Dayib Sheikh Ahmed Somalia’s Mosques are full, Ramadan is faithfully observed, the Qur’an is recited in homes across the country, and thousands of Somalis travel each year to perform Hajj and Umrah. Yet for more than three decades, this same deeply religious society has remained trapped in conflict, corruption, division, and weak governance. Two recent articles in WardheerNews confront that paradox from different directions. In “Much Worship, Little Morality: What Is Wrong with Us?”, Dr. Abdurahman Abdullahi Baadiyow highlights the gap between the worship we perform and the moral character it is meant to cultivate. In his response, “The Problem Is Not a Lack of Worship It Is the Absence of Accountability,” Dayib Sheikh Ahmed argues that asking “What is wrong with us?” is not enough; we must also ask, “What happened to us?” He points to civil war, mass displacement, institutional collapse, social trauma, and the prolonged absence of accountability as the forces that have shaped Somalia’s political culture. The two writers are examining the same crisis from different angles. Dr. Baadiyow emphasizes personal morality while Dayib emphasizes trauma and institutional failure. Each is one right, and neither is sufficient alone. Somalia’s crisis is neither simply a failure of worship nor solely the collapse of institutions. It is a rupture between what we believe, how we behave, and the political system we have built. Worship and Public Trust Genuine worship does not end at the mosque door. It must be visible in how a person safeguards public resources, administers justice, treats the vulnerable, and exercises the authority entrusted to him or her. The Qur’an commands believers to return trusts to those entitled to them and, when judging between people, to judge with justice (Surat An-Nisa, 4:58). The Prophet Muhammad peace and blessings be upon him taught that every person is a guardian and will be held accountable for whatever has been placed in his or her care. Public office is neither personal property, a political reward, nor a clan inheritance. It is a trust conferred by society. That trust must be exercised with honesty, justice, and integrity. It follows that a leader cannot be judged by his prayers, fasting, mosque attendance, or eloquence about religion alone. As Dayib wrote, he must be judged by what he did with the power entrusted to him: Did poverty decline during his tenure? Was justice strengthened? Did corruption fall? Were public resources protected? Were the rights and dignity of citizens respected? Were institutions stronger when he left office than when he entered them? These are not secular questions competing with religious ones. They are the questions that faith itself requires us to ask. Institutions That Restrain Power Moral preaching and personal virtue cannot, on their own, build a state. Good leaders come and go; the country needs institutions strong enough to outlast them and to bind every officeholder to the law. Institutions cannot replace conscience, but they can limit the damage when conscience fails. Where institutions are weak, a good leader is restrained only by personal morality, while a bad leader faces no effective barrier to corruption, abuse, or authoritarian ambition. Somalia needs an independent judiciary, a parliament capable of genuinely holding the executive to account; a strong and autonomous Auditor General, transparent public finances, credible accountability mechanisms, a professional civil service; security forces that obey the law; and a free and responsible press. These are not ornaments of government. They are the citizen’s strongest protection against oppression, corruption, and the abuse of power. Rules must be stronger than rulers, and institutions stronger than personalities. Social Trauma and Shared Responsibility The trauma of civil war and state collapse is real, and it helps explain much of our destructive political behaviour. But explanation is not justification. Trauma must never become an excuse for corruption, injustice, or the abuse of power. Understanding our wounds should serve a different purpose: to heal the past, reconcile communities, restore public trust, and rebuild state institutions. These are among the most urgent national priorities. What happened to us must not become a permanent inheritance of resentment and mistrust passed from one generation to the next. Genuine healing requires truth-telling, acknowledgment of harm, forgiveness, accountability, and credible justice, and none of these can succeed without the others. Responsibility, however, does not rest with leaders alone. Citizens must fulfil theirs too. We cannot condemn corruption when an opponent commit it and defend it when the offender belongs to our clan, party, or political camp. That is not justice; it is political clannish disguised as justice. A society that applies morality selectively cannot build impartial institutions. The Responsibility of Intellectuals and Advisers. The role of the intellectual cannot end with diagnosing society’s failures in print. Public writing matters: it awakens society, opens debate, challenges complacency, and stirs the collective conscience. But intellectuals with direct access to political leaders carry a heavier burden, because their words can reach the rooms where decisions are made. Dr. Abdirahman Baadiyow, Dayib Sheikh Ahmed, and other men and women of religious learning, professional expertise, and public influence are expected to speak the truth courageously to the leaders they are able to reach and advise. That obligation weighs most heavily on those who hold public office or counsel those who do. Dr. Baadiyow’s role as a presidential adviser on reconciliation gives him both a valuable opportunity and a special obligation. He is well placed to raise directly with the President the grievances of the public, the concerns of Mogadishu’s residents about governance and justice, the continuing disputes between the Federal Government and the Federal Member States, and the need to exercise power through law, consultation, and equality. Writing publicly about injustice is important, but it is only the beginning. A leader must also be advised directly, reminded repeatedly of his duty to uphold justice, and confronted with the moral and political consequences of failing to do so. The Qur’an and the Sunnah of the Prophet peace and blessings be upon him are unequivocal in commanding justice. Truthful advice is rarely what the powerful want to hear; the most valuable counsel is often the least comfortable. At times it means confronting a leader with his failures and reminding him that public office is a trust, power is a test, and authority carries consequences before both the people and God. Conclusion Dr. Abdirahman Baadiyow is right that worship must produce moral character. Dayib is equally right that morality cannot bear fruit unless it is translated into accountability, justice, and functioning institutions. Somalia needs both truths joined in practice. Somalia needs faith to govern the conscience and institutions to govern power. We need leaders guided by the fear of God, and laws that apply equally to every citizen and officeholder. We need people willing to speak uncomfortable truths to those in power. And we need vigilant citizens who know their rights, fulfil their responsibilities, and refuse to defend injustice merely because it benefits their clan, party, or political allies. When worship cultivates integrity, integrity produces responsibility, and responsibility yields accountability and justice, state institutions can finally earn the confidence of the people. That is where legitimate statehood begins: with a government that serves its citizens, rather than citizens compelled to serve those who rule them. Nur Hassan Gure (Nurdin) Email: nurgure87@gmail.com   The post Leadership Ethics and Institutional Integrity: Two Inseparable Foundations appeared first on WardheerNews .

Eritrea oo jawaab ka bixisay tallaabada uu qaaday Mareykanka
items.description: Asmara (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Eritrea ayaa soo dhoweysay go’aanka Mareykanka uu cunaqabateynta kaga qaaday ciidamadeeda, xisbiga talada haya iyo mas’uuliyiin kale, iyadoo sheegtay in tallaabadan ay waddada u xaari karto xiriir cusub oo u dhexeeya Asmara iyo Washington kadib sanado ay xiisad ka dhex jirtay. Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Eritrea ayaa Sabtidii sheegtay in cunaqabateyntii lagu soo rogay dalkaas xilligii dagaalka Tigray ay u geysatay “khasaare aan la qiyaasi karin”, iyadoo ku adkeysatay in tallaabooyinkaasi aanay markii horeba lahayn sabab sax ah. “Go’aanka wanaagsan ee hadda lagu qaaday cunaqabateynta waxaa la filayaa inuu noqdo tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo xiriirka wax-ku-oolka ah iyo iskaashiga Eritrea iyo Mareykanka,” ayay wasaaraddu sheegtay. Hadalka Eritrea ayaa yimid maalin kadib markii Waaxda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ay liiska cunaqabateynta ka saartay Ciidamada Difaaca Eritrea, xisbiga talada haya ee People’s Front for Democracy and Justice (PFDJ), iyo dhowr hay’adood iyo mas’uuliyiin kale. Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in xaaladdii degdegga ahayd ee saldhigga sharci u ahayd cunaqabateynta la xiriirtay Itoobiya ay dhammaatay, taasina ay keentay in magacyada lagu daray barnaamijkaas laga saaro liiska. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu go’aansaday inuusan cusbooneysiin tallaabooyinkaasi, si Washington ay ula jaanqaaddo xaaladda cusub ee gobolka una hormariso danaha Mareykanka. Afhayeen u hadlay wasaaradda ayaa wakaaladda AFP u sheegay in inkastoo fulinta heshiiskii soo afjaray dagaalka Tigray ay ahayd mid “aan sinnayn”, haddana Washington ay rumeysan tahay in la joogo “waqtigii siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda lagu waafajin lahaa xaqiiqooyinka hadda jira”. Xiriir dib u soo kabanaya Eritrea ayaa go’aanka cusub u aragta qayb ka mid ah isbeddel ballaaran oo ku yimid xiriirka labada dal. Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Eritrea ayaa soo xigatay farriin uu Madaxweyne Trump bishii May u diray dalkaas xilli loo dabaaldegayay 35 guurada xorriyaddiisa, taas oo uu ku sheegay in la dhaafo “waayihii hore”, lana bilaabo bog cusub oo ku dhisan iskaashi. Xiriirka Washington iyo Asmara ayaa muddo dheer ahaa mid xasaasi ah, waxaana labada dhinac ay isku khilaafeen arrimo ay ka mid yihiin xuquuqda aadanaha, siyaasadda gobolka iyo cunaqabateynno isdaba joog ah. Maamulkii Madaxweyne Joe Biden ayaa bishii November 2021 cunaqabateyn ku soo rogay Eritrea xilligii uu socday dagaalka gobolka Tigray ee waqooyiga Itoobiya. Ciidamada Eritrea ayaa dagaalkaas garab siinayay ciidamada dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ee la dagaallamayey xoogagga Tigray. Waaxda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ayaa xilligaas sheegtay in dhinacyada Eritrea ay qayb ka ahaayeen sii socoshada colaadda, iyadoo soo xigatay warbixino la xiriiray dilal, dhac, tacaddiyo galmo iyo carqaladeyn lagu sameeyay gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Eritrea ayaa marar badan beenisay eedeymaha la xiriira in ciidamadeedu geysteen xadgudubyo baahsan, waxayna cunaqabateynta Mareykanka ku tilmaantay mid aan xaq ahayn. Si kastaba, go’aanka cusub ee Mareykanka ma tirtirayo qiimeyntii iyo eedeymihii hore ee Washington ee la xiriiray dagaalka Tigray. Waxaa keliya meesha ka baxay awooddii sharci ee cunaqabateyntan gaarka ah lagu soo rogay. Taliyaha ciidamada Eritrea, General Filipos Woldeyohannes, ayaa weli waxaa saaran cunaqabateyn gaar ah oo Mareykanka uu sanadkii 2021 ku soo rogay barnaamijka Global Magnitsky, isagoo ku eedeeyay xadgudubyo culus oo ka dhacay Tigray. items.title: Wafdi Sare oo ka socda Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan oo Muqdisho soo gaaray
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji, ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho ku soo dhaweeyey wafdi sare oo ka socda Ciidanka Cirka Jamhuuriyadda Pakistan. Wafdiga Pakistan waxaa hoggaaminayey Taliyaha Difaaca Cirka ahna Taliye Ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Cirka Pakistan, Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz, oo Muqdisho u yimid booqasho rasmi ah. Soo dhaweynta wafdigan ayaa qeyb ka ah xiriirka iyo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca iyo milatariga ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, gaar ahaan xoojinta wada-shaqeynta labada Ciidan Cirka. Intii uu wafdigu ku sugnaa Muqdisho, waxaa la filayaa in ay kulamo la yeeshaan saraakiisha sare ee Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo diiradda lagu saari doono arrimaha iskaashiga milatari, tababarrada, khibrad-wadaagga iyo horumarinta awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya. Booqashada wafdiga ayaa sidoo kale muujinaysa xiriirka soo jireenka ah ee dhinaca iskaashiga difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, iyadoo labada dhinac ay fursad u helayaan in ay ka wada hadlaan sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa xiriirkooda milatari. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in booqashada wafdiga Pakistan ay muhiim u tahay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinaca difaaca.

Soo dhaweynta wafdigan ayaa qeyb ka ah xiriirka iyo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca iyo milatariga ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, gaar ahaan xoojinta wada-shaqeynta labada Ciidan Cirka. Intii uu wafdigu ku sugnaa Muqdisho, waxaa la filayaa in ay kulamo la yeeshaan saraakiisha sare ee Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo diiradda lagu saari doono arrimaha iskaashiga milatari, tababarrada, khibrad-wadaagga iyo horumarinta awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya. Booqashada wafdiga ayaa sidoo kale muujinaysa xiriirka soo jireenka ah ee dhinaca iskaashiga difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, iyadoo labada dhinac ay fursad u helayaan in ay ka wada hadlaan sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa xiriirkooda milatari. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in booqashada wafdiga Pakistan ay muhiim u tahay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinaca difaaca.

items.title: General Shub Breaks His Silence on Doolow Attack
items.description: Nairobi (WDN) — General Mahad Abdirahman Adan, better known as Taliye Shub, has broken his silence over the attack on his residence in Doolow, delivering a dramatic account of the moments before the explosion that injured him and plunged an already tense political crisis into a new controversy. The former commander of Somalia’s Custodial Corps says he saw an F-16 fighter aircraft overhead shortly before a powerful explosion struck the house where he was staying in Doolow, Gedo region. Speaking on the Geed Fadhi programme, General Shub rejected suggestions that the explosion originated from explosives being prepared inside the residence. “At around midnight, I became aware of an F-16 aircraft above me. I do not know how explosives are assembled, but those who have been trained to make explosives are in Mogadishu,” Shub said. His account directly challenges the explanation previously attributed to the Federal Government, which denied carrying out an airstrike and said preliminary security information indicated that explosives inside the house may have caused the blast. The competing accounts have left one of the most politically sensitive attacks in Somalia in recent weeks surrounded by unanswered questions: What struck General Shub’s residence? Who ordered the operation? And why was a former senior Somali security commander targeted in Doolow? Shub Points to Political Pressure General Shub also revealed details of his exchanges with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, describing political pressure over his position and his relationship with opponents of the Federal Government. According to Shub, he was questioned about his opposition to the Federal Government and his political alignment with Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni, one of Mogadishu’s most prominent political critics. The disclosure gives the Doolow incident an additional political dimension, particularly because Shub has been publicly associated with forces and political figures opposed to Mogadishu’s approach to the South West crisis. Opposition figures and Jubaland officials have previously accused the Federal Government and Turkish-supported military capabilities of involvement in the Doolow attack. Those allegations have not been independently verified, while the Federal Government has denied responsibility. Turkish authorities have also not publicly confirmed that Turkish aircraft carried out the strike. A Strike—or an Explosion From Inside? The circumstances surrounding the attack remain sharply disputed. Local sources and Jubaland officials initially reported that a drone or aircraft struck the compound shortly before midnight, injuring General Shub and several others. General Shub has now gone further, specifically identifying the aircraft he says he saw as an F-16. Former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen has also alleged that F-16 aircraft were involved in attacks in Doolow and areas around Baidoa. His administration has accused Turkey of involvement, while those allegations remain unverified. The Federal Government, however, has rejected the airstrike narrative and offered a fundamentally different explanation for the explosion. That leaves a crucial question still unanswered: was Doolow the scene of an aerial attack, or did an explosion occur inside the residence as the government has suggested? From Security Incident to Political Flashpoint Whatever the final explanation, the Doolow incident has rapidly evolved from a local security episode into a national political flashpoint. General Shub survived the attack, but his allegations have reopened questions about the use of military force in Somalia’s increasingly bitter political disputes. The incident has also intensified scrutiny of foreign military involvement in Somalia and the potential use of externally supplied military capabilities in conflicts involving Somali political actors. The stakes are particularly high because the attack occurred against the backdrop of escalating confrontation between Mogadishu and political forces in South West State, as well as wider disputes involving Puntland, Jubaland and opposition leaders. For General Shub, the account is unequivocal: he says he saw an F-16 above his residence before the explosion. For the Federal Government, the explanation is entirely different. Between those two accounts lies a question that remains unresolved—and one that demands credible, independent answers: What exactly happened at General Shub’s house in Doolow that night? items.title: Ex-PM Warns Somalia’s Third Republic Faces Imminent Collapse
items.description: Mogadishu – (WDN) – In a passionate address at the national congress of the Himilo Qaran Party, former Somali Prime Minister Abdi Farah Shirdon Saacid voiced his deep concerns about the precarious condition of Somalia. His remarks came at a critical moment for the nation, which is facing numerous socio-political challenges. “Our country is currently in a perilous situation, and the Third Republic is teetering on the brink of collapse,” Shirdon cautioned, as he reflected on the various crises threatening the state. He pointed to rampant insecurity, political instability, and economic challenges, underscoring the urgency of the situation. As one of the prominent candidates vying for the presidency, Shirdon urged all Somali citizens, regardless of their political affiliations, to take an active role in the preservation of the nation’s governance. “It is the duty of every Somali to engage and contribute in any way they can to help save the Third Republic, which is facing serious peril,” he emphasized, calling for unity among the populace during these difficult times. Shirdon not only highlighted the collective responsibility of individuals but also reaffirmed the commitment of the Himilo Qaran Party to collaborate with various stakeholders in the effort to stabilize and strengthen Somalia’s governance. “We are prepared to stand alongside any party or group that shares our vision for a stable and prosperous Somalia. Together, we can work towards safeguarding the future of our beloved nation,” he declared. His remarks resonated with attendees at the congress, igniting discussions on the importance of national unity and collective action in overcoming the challenges Somalia faces today. The former Prime Minister’s call to action serves as a reminder of the imperative to put aside differences and unite for the greater good of the country. As Somalia stands at a crossroads, the need for vigilance and cooperation among all citizens has never been more urgent. items.title: Dad dibadbax ka dhigay agagaarka Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Seoul
items.description: Kooxo bulshada rayidka ah ayaa Sabtidan bannaanbax ka dhigay Magaalada Seoul, iyagoo ka soo horjeeda cadaadiska Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump uu ku hayo Dowladda Kuuriyada Koonfureed, si ay ciidamo ugu dirto Marinka Hormuz. Dibadbaxayaasha ayaa isugu soo baxay agagaarka Xarunta Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Seoul, iyagoo ku qaylinaya ereyo ka dhan ah cadaadiska uu Trump ku saarayo madaxda sare ee dalkaasi inay diraan ciidamo ka qayb qaata hawlgal lagu gelbinayo maraakiibta maraya marin biyoodka Hormuz. Taliska Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran ayaa toddobaadkii hore ku celiyay digniintooda ah inaanay Koonfurta Kuuriya ciidamo u soo dirin Hormuz, haddii kalena loo tixgelin doono inay qayb ka tahay dagaalka kala dhexeeya Mareykanka. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran ayaa sidoo kale dowladda dalkaasi uga digtay inay la kulmi doonto cawaaqib daran, haddii ay ciidamo u soo dirto ama ay ku milanto dhaqdhaqaaqa ay Ciidanka Badda Mareykanka ka wadaan meel u dhow Hormuz. Madaxweyne Lee Jae Myung ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in dalkiisu aanu diri doonin wax ciidan ah, si aysan Seoul ugu lug yeelan iska horimaad lala galo Tehran. Hadalkiisa ayaa ka dambeeyay, ka dib maalmo ay bannaanbaxyo ka socdeen dalkaasi. Ciidamada Iran ayaa xakameeyay isu socodka maraakiibta booyadaha shidaalka ee Hormuz, ka dib duulaankii wadajirka ahaa ee Mareykanka iyo Israel ay 28-kii bishii February ku qaadeen dalkaasi. Maamulka Trump ayay caqabad ka haysataa, sidii loo soo celin lahaa xorriyadda socdaalka maraakiibta ee marin biyoodka ku yaala Gacanka Faaris, iyadoo dagaalka ka hor ay maraakiibtu si caadi ah u adeegsan jirtay marinkaasi.

items.title: Crew Rescued After Cargo Ship Drifts 12 Nautical Miles Off Mogadishu
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — All 18 crew members aboard the MV JACUAR have been safely rescued after the cargo vessel suffered an emergency and was left adrift approximately 12 nautical miles north of Mogadishu, Somali authorities said. The vessel, which was anchored off Mogadishu Port, sent an emergency distress message after reporting that water was entering the ship. The Mogadishu Port Authority ordered the vessel to raise anchor and move away from the port to reduce the risk to other ships and port operations. The MV JACUAR later drifted north of the capital. Somali Maritime Police boats evacuated all 18 crew members, who are nationals of India, Syria and Egypt, and transported them safely to Mogadishu. Authorities have arranged accommodation, food and other essential assistance while preparations are made for their return home. The MV JACUAR had sailed from Beira, Mozambique, to Adabiya, Egypt, carrying a cargo of copper cathodes. The vessel is owned by a Syrian company. Somali Maritime Police have boarded the vessel and taken responsibility for securing the ship and its cargo. Access has been restricted to authorized personnel only. The Port Authority and Ministry of Ports and Maritime Transport said they are continuing to assess the vessel and will determine the next steps based on its condition. The immediate emergency is over: all 18 crew members are safe, while authorities now face the task of securing and managing the disabled cargo vessel and its valuable shipment. items.title: Muxuu yahay ujeedka shirka muhiimka ah ee uu maanta furay Xasan? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) -Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho ka daah-furay Shirka Maalgelinta Horumarinta Soomaaliya, kaasi oo uu martigeliyay Bangiga Horumarinta iyo Dib-u-dhiska Soomaaliya (SDRB). Shirka oo ay kasoo qaybgaleen mas’uuliyiin ka socday hay’adaha dowladda, ganacsato, maamuleyaasha shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay iyo bahwadaagta taageerta horumarinta Soomaaliya, ayaa lagu gorfeeyay fursadaha iyo baahiyaha maalgelinta horumarineed ee dalka, iyada oo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray sidii Soomaaliya looga gudbin lahaa marxaladda dib-u-soo-kabashada, looguna gudbi lahaa koboc dhaqaale oo waara. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo madasha ka hadlay ayaa tilmaamay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay mudnaan siinayso maalgelinta horumarka waara, kobcinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo xoojinta doorka ganacsiyada gaarka loo leeyahay, si loo abuuro fursado shaqo iyo koboc dhaqaale oo waara. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in Hiigsiga Qaranka ee 2060 uu yahay jihada fog ee Soomaaliya ku gaari karto dhaqaale kobcaya iyo horumar waara, taas oo u baahan maalgelin istiraatiiji ah oo lagu horumarinayo beeraha, xoolaha, kalluumeysiga, tamarta, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo ganacsiyada. Shirka ayaa sidoo kale fursad u noqday dowladda iyo dhinacyada kale oo is dhaafsadaan aragtiyo ku saabsan sidii loo heli lahaa maalgelin ku filan oo lagu fuliyo mashaariicda horumarineed ee dalka. Waxaa kale oo laga hadlay sidii loo horumarin lahaa kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, loo kordhin lahaa wax-soo-saarka gudaha, loona abuuri lahaa fursado maalgashi oo soo jiita maalgeliyeyaasha gudaha iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Shirka Maalgelinta Horumarinta Soomaaliya ee maanta ka qabsoomay Muqdisho ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay xoogga saareyso kobcinta dhaqaalaha, dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga iyo ka gudbidda marxaladda dib-u-soo-kabashada. Si kastaba, Dadaallada lagu xoojinayo maalgelinta horumarineed ayaa qayb ka ah qorshayaasha lagu dhisayo dhaqaale Soomaaliyeed oo ku tiirsan wax-soo-saarka gudaha, maalgashi waara iyo doorka firfircoon ee ganacsiga gaarka loo leeyahay. items.title: Revenge Killings Raise Alarm as Clan Feuds Claim More Somali Lives
items.description: Galkayo (WDN) — The killing of innocent Somalis in apparent clan-related revenge attacks is raising renewed concern, as murderers frequently evade justice and arrests remain rare in many cases. The latest incidents include the killing of Somali journalist Mohamed Aweys Muudey, popularly known as “Boqorka Bartamaha,” who died in Germany after reportedly being stabbed by another Somali man following an argument. Muudey was living in Germany, where he had moved in 2017. He was reportedly attacked with a knife in the city of Darmstadt and was rushed to hospital with serious injuries but later died. The circumstances surrounding the stabbing, including the motive, remain under investigation. Initial reports said the suspect became involved in an argument or disagreement with the journalist before allegedly stabbing him. The killing has added to growing concerns about the vulnerability of Somalis to violent disputes that can escalate from personal disagreements into fatal attacks. Arrest Made in Mudug Murder In Puntland’s Mudug region, police said they had arrested Zakariye Abdiqadir Hirsi, who is accused of killing Abdirahman Hassan Yusuf in the Tuulo-Xabiibo area three days ago. According to Mudug police, the suspect was arrested in Dudun, in Ethiopia’s Somali Regional State. The operation reportedly involved the suspect’s relatives and security forces from the Somali Regional State, who helped locate and apprehend him before he was handed over to the authorities. The arrest stands out because successful efforts to apprehend suspects in murder cases remain relatively uncommon, particularly where killings are linked to clan revenge and retaliatory violence. Meanwhile, authorities have yet to announce the arrest of those responsible for the killing of businessman Sheikh Ahmed Yusuf Farah, known as Haamay, who was shot dead in Galkayo on September 8. His killing remains unresolved, adding to a growing list of cases in which victims have been killed while perpetrators remain at large. A Cycle That Keeps Producing Victims Mudug has witnessed repeated killings reportedly linked to clan-based revenge and longstanding disputes, with victims including community elders, businessmen and other civilians. The danger extends beyond the original parties to a dispute. Once a killing occurs, retaliation can trigger another killing, creating a cycle in which individuals with no direct involvement can become targets. The central concern is not simply the number of killings, but the apparent difficulty of bringing those responsible to justice. When suspects remain at large, families and clans can be left to seek their own form of justice, potentially deepening the cycle of retaliation. The arrest of one suspect in the Abdirahman Hassan Yusuf case demonstrates that perpetrators can be brought before the law when security agencies and communities cooperate. But for families of victims whose killers remain unidentified or unarrested, justice remains painfully out of reach. The growing challenge for Puntland and communities across Mudug is therefore clear: breaking the cycle of revenge requires not only preventing the next killing, but ensuring that those responsible for previous killings face the full force of the law. items.title: Cali Cosoble oo weerar culus ku qaaday Sanbaloolshe iyo Yuusuf Dabageed
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, Cali Cabdullahi Cosoble oo maanta ka qayb-galay kulan ay Muqdisho ku yeesheen golaha sare ee siyaasadda beesha Xawaadle ayaa si kulul uga hadlay arrimaha kasoo kordhay maamulkaas, gaar ahaan gobolka Hiiraan. Cali Cosoble ayaa marka hore weerar culus ku qaaday Sanbaloolshe iyo Yuusuf Dabageed oo haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wada Beledweyne, kadib markii ay ka caroodeen go’aanka madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo dhawaan kaarka musharraxnimada ee JSP siiyay madaxweynaha HirShabelle Cali Guudlaawe. Waxa uu tilmaamay in Xasan Sheekh uu horay Sanbaloolshe ugu magacaabay xilal kala duwan, balse uusan qaban wax muuqda, isaga oo intaas ku daray in markii uu waayay xilkiisa uu hadda soo kicinayo beesha Xawaadle. “Aniga madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh farriin ayaan u dirayaa madaxweyne waa na dulmisay intaas oo jeer ayaa Sanbloolshe ciddan dusha ka saartay wax uu qabtayna haba yaraatee ma jirto mar dambe yaysan dhicin in uu Sanbaloolshe soo galgasho oo haddane aad tiraahdo hala soo dhaweeyo,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Sidoo kale wuxuu intaas raaciyay “Haddii uu yiri markaan naso waali inuu ka shaqeeyo oo uu yiraahdo Xawaadlow soo kaca dagaalka gala waxaas waxay u egtahay nin wax weliba anaa raba leh”. Dhanka kale, waxa uu eedeeyay Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka HirShabelle Yuusuf Dabageed oo isna ku sugan magaalada Beledweyne, isaga oo sheegay in markii horeba xilka uu ku helay nasiib iyo calaf, wuxuuna ugu baaqay inuu samir muujiyo. “Dabageedow jaranjarada aad fuushay markii horeba jaranjaro aad toos u gaari karto ma ahayn, laakiin Ilaah ayaa ku calfay aqoon kuma aadan gaarin, haddii aad calafkii weyday inaad samirto ayaa loo baahan yahay,” ayuu ku yiri Yuusuf Dabageed. Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu farriin u diray taliyaha qaybta 27-aad ee Xoogga Dalka, isaga oo ugu baaqay inuu gacan bir ah ku qabto amniga, kana hortego cid kasta oo fowdo ka abuurta magaalada Beledweyne ee xarunta gobolka Hiiraan. “Aniga oo ku hadlaayo magaca golaha sare ee siyaasadda beesha Xawaadle waxaan raba in aan taliyaha qaybta 27-aad Cali Cagay u sheego inuu yahay mas’uulka amniga ee gobolka sidaas daraadeedna gobolkaas qof fowdo ka kicinayo inuu haba yaraatee aqbalin,” ayuu mar kale yiri Cali Cosoble. HirShabelle ayaa haatan wajaheysa xiisad siyaasadeed oo ka dhalatay qaabka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka kusoo foodka leh maamulkaasi, iyada oo haatan khilaaf horleh laga dareemayo magaalooyinka Beledweyne iyo Jowhar. items.title: Shirka Maalgelinta ee Horumarinta Somaliya oo ka furmay Muqdisho (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta Magaalada Muqdisho ka daahfuray Shirka Maalgelinta ee Horumarinta Somaliya. Shirka ayaa waxaa la sheegay inuu martigeliyay Bangiga Horumarinta iyo Dib-u-dhiska Somaliya ee SDRB. “Shirka oo ay ka soo qaybgaleen masuuliyiin ka socday hay’adaha dowladda, ganacsato, maamuleyaasha shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay iyo bahwadaagta taageerta horumarinta Somaliya ayaa lagu gorfeeyay fursadaha iyo baahiyaha maalgelinta horumarineed ee dalka, iyada oo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray, sidii Somaliya looga gudbin lahaa marxaladda dib-u-soo-kabashada, looguna gudbi lahaa koboc dhaqaale oo waara.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Villa Somalia. “Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyada ayaa tilmaamay in Dowladda Federaalka Somaliya ay mudnaan siineyso maalgelinta horumarka waara, kobcinta wax soo-saarka gudaha iyo xoojinta doorka ganacsiyada gaarka loo leeyahay, si loo abuuro fursado shaqo iyo koboc dhaqaale oo waara.” Ayaa lagu sheegay warka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in Hiigsiga Qaranka ee 2060 uu yahay jihada fog ee Somaliya ku gaari karto dhaqaale kobcaya iyo horumar waara, taas oo u baahan baa warka lagu sheegay maalgelin istiraatiiji ah oo lagu horumarinayo beeraha, xoolaha, kalluumeysiga, tamarta, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo ganacsiyada. Villa Somalia ayaa diiradda saareysa xoojinta iyo maalgelinta Hiigsiga Qaranka ee 2060, si loo gaaro dhaqaale madaxbannaan, iyadoona dhiirigelineysa ganacsiyada gaarka loo leeyahay, si loo abuuro shaqooyin.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee geerida ku timid Xasan Kaafi Qoyste iyo Boqorka Bartamaha
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa kasoo baxaya geerida naxdinta leh ee ku timid Alle ha u wada naxariistee, Wariye Maxamed Aweys Muudey (Boqorka Bartamaha) iyo Wariye Xasan Kaafi Cabdiraxmaan Sheekh Isxaaq (Qoyste), kuwaas oo ka mid ahaa wariyeyaasha ruugcaddaaga ah ee Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana muddo dheer kusoo jiray saxaafadda dalka. Boqorka Bartamaha oo ka tirsanaa bahda Warbaahinta Qaranka ayaa lagu dilay magaalada Darmstadt ee dalka Jarmalka, kadib markii uu mindi ku dhaawacay nin kale oo Soomaali ah, waxaana markii dambe uu u geeriyooday dhaawaca soo gaaray. Sida ay sheegayaan wararka horudhac ah Boqorka Bartamaha iyo ninka dilka geystay ayaa horay u murmay, iyada oo kadib uu xigay dilka marxuumka, waxaana haatan baaritaanno wada laamaha amniga ee dalka Jarmalka. Wasasaarada Warfaafinta Soomaaliya oo warsaxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa ka tacsiyeeyay geerida ku timid Wariye Maxamed Aweys Muudey (Boqorka Bartamaha), waxaana qoraalka tacsi loogu diray ehellada marxuumka. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulfitaax Qaasim Maxamuud, Wasiir Ku-Xigeenka Wasaaradda, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf Cumar (Al-Cadaala), Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda, Mudane Cabdullaahi Xayir Ducaale, Agaasimeyaasha Waaxyaha iyo dhammaan hawlwadeennada Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay tacsi tiiraanyo leh u dirayaan qoyskii, ehelkii, qaraabadii uu ka geeriyooday Allaha u naxariistee Weriye Maxamed Aweys Muudey (Boqorka Bartamaha) oo ka tirsanaa bahda Warbaahinta Qaranka. Wasiir Cabdulfitaax Qaasim ayaa Alle SWT uga baryay Marxuum Maxamed Aweys Muudey inuu ka waraabiyo Jannatul Firdowsa, qoyskii, ehelkii, qaraabadii, bahda saxaafadda iyo dhammaan umadda Soomaaliyeedna ka siiyo samir iyo iimaan,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Dhinaca kale, waxaa saaka magaalada Muqdisho ku geeriyooday Wariye Xasan Kaafi Cabdiraxmaan Sheekh Isxaaq (Xasan Kaafi Qoyste) oo isna ahaa wariye ruugcadaa ah, kana soo shaqeeyay laanta afka Soomaaliga ah ee VOA-da. Xasan Kaafi Qoyste ayaa lasoo wariyay inuu u geeriyooday xanuun deg-deg ah oo kusoo booday, sida ay xaqiijiyeen qaar kamid ah ehelladiisa. Maamulka iyo shaqaalaha Caasimada Online waxay tacsi tiiraanyo leh u dirayaan ehellada, qaraabada, bahda saxaafadda iyo dhammaan ummadda Soomaaliyeed ee ay ka geeriyoodeen labada suxufi. Waxaan Alle uga baryeynaa inuu marxuumiiinta ku gallado naxariistiisa, kana waraabiyo Jannatul Firdowsa, ehelladii iyo qaraabadiina uu samir iyo iimaan ka siiyo. Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raajicuun. The post Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee geerida ku timid Xasan Kaafi Qoyste iyo Boqorka Bartamaha appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Uganda oo hakisay dhammaan iskaashigii milatari ee ay la lahayd Turkiga
items.description: Kampala, 19 Sebteembar 2026: Ciidamada Difaaca Dadka Uganda (UPDF) ayaa ku dhawaaqay in si degdeg ah loo hakiyay dhammaan iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca iyo milatariga ee u dhexeeyay Uganda iyo Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga. Bayaan uu soo saaray Afhayeenka Warfaafinta Difaaca ee ku-simaha ah, Kornayl Chris Magezi, ayaa lagu sheegay in go’aanka uu dhaqan-galay isla markiiba, isla markaana uu sii jiri doono ilaa laga xalliyo arrimaha weli taagan ee la xiriira iskaashiga difaaca iyo milatariga ee labada dal. UPDF ma aysan faahfaahin nooca ama sababta arrimaha keenay hakinta, iyadoo bayaanka rasmiga ah uusan si gaar ah u xusin khilaaf ku saabsan Soomaaliya ama arrimo kale. Go’aankan ayaa yimid xilli xiriirka dhinaca difaaca ee Uganda iyo Turkiga uu horey u lahaa iskaashi ay ka mid yihiin tababarka, warshadaha difaaca iyo iskaashiga milatari. UPDF waxay hore u sheegtay in labada dal ay leeyihiin heshiisyo iskaashi oo dhinaca warshadaha difaaca ah. Wararka ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaya in go’aanka uu kusoo beegmay kadib dibadbax ka dhacay Kampala oo looga dalbanayay Turkiga in Uganda loo soo celiyo Fred Lumbuye, hase yeeshee UPDF bayaankeeda rasmiga ah kuma xiriirin hakinta iskaashiga arrintaas. Ilaa hadda lama shaacin muddada uu socon doono hakinta ama waxa ay noqon doonaan tallaabooyinka xiga ee labada dowladood.

Go’aankan ayaa yimid xilli xiriirka dhinaca difaaca ee Uganda iyo Turkiga uu horey u lahaa iskaashi ay ka mid yihiin tababarka, warshadaha difaaca iyo iskaashiga milatari. UPDF waxay hore u sheegtay in labada dal ay leeyihiin heshiisyo iskaashi oo dhinaca warshadaha difaaca ah. Wararka ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaya in go’aanka uu kusoo beegmay kadib dibadbax ka dhacay Kampala oo looga dalbanayay Turkiga in Uganda loo soo celiyo Fred Lumbuye, hase yeeshee UPDF bayaankeeda rasmiga ah kuma xiriirin hakinta iskaashiga arrintaas. Ilaa hadda lama shaacin muddada uu socon doono hakinta ama waxa ay noqon doonaan tallaabooyinka xiga ee labada dowladood.

items.title: Shirka Maalgelinta Horumarinta Soomaaliya oo diiradda lagu saaray koboc dhaqaale oo waara
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ka furay Shirka Maal-gelinta Horumarinta Soomaaliya, kaas oo uu martigeliyay Bangiga Horumarinta iyo Dib-u-dhiska Soomaaliya (SDRB). Shirka waxaa ka qeyb galay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan hay’adaha dowladda, ganacsatada, maamulayaasha shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay iyo bahwadaagta taageerta horumarinta Soomaaliya. Intii uu socday shirka ayaa looga hadlay fursadaha iyo baahiyaha maal-gelinta horumarineed ee dalka, iyadoo diiradda la saaray sidii Soomaaliya looga gudbi lahaa marxaladda dib-u-soo-kabashada, looguna gudbi lahaa koboc dhaqaale oo waara. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay mudnaan siinayso maal-gelinta horumar waara, kobcinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo xoojinta doorka ganacsiga gaarka loo leeyahay, si loo abuuro fursado shaqo iyo koboc dhaqaale. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale xusay in Hiigsiga Qaranka 2060 uu yahay jihada fog ee Soomaaliya loogu horseedayo dhaqaale kobcaya iyo horumar waara, iyadoo loo baahan yahay maal-gelin istiraatiiji ah oo lagu horumarinayo beeraha, xoolaha, kalluumeysiga, tamarta, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo ganacsiyada.

items.title: The Somaliland President Meets With Senator Cruz Of Texas
items.description: Washington, DC. The Somaliland President, Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi and his high level delegation currently visiting the United States of America have met with the senior Senator from Texas, Ted Cruz. Senator Cruz who has been a long time advocate for Somaliland’s recognition received the President at the Senate in Washington DC. The President and Senator Cruz discussed the situation in the Red Sea, the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, and the role Somaliland can play in terms of security, logistics and economic development. The meeting is a prelude to an in-depth discussions between Somaliland and the United States of America. Qarannews.

items.title: The United States Extends AUSSOM Support for Somalia by One Year
items.description: US gives UN one more year to wind down Somalia support MOGADISHU — The United States has agreed to give the United Nations another 12 months to wind down its logistical support for the African Union’s mission in Somalia, giving AUSSOM additional time to seek alternative arrangements for sustaining its operations. The decision, detailed in a diplomatic note seen by Reuters, means the drawdown will begin in January 2027 rather than ending immediately when the current mandate of the UN Support Office in Somalia expires at the end of December 2026. The extension does not amount to a renewal of long-term U.S. support. Washington has said it will no longer fund or support the United Nations Support Office in Somalia, known as UNSOS, after the 12-month transition period. The U.S. State Department told Reuters that the office has a total budget of about $500 million. Why AUSSOM relies on UN logistical support AUSSOM, the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia, plays a role in supporting Somalia’s security and stabilization efforts. UNSOS provides the mission with essential logistical services, including food, water, fuel, medical services, transportation, engineering support, communications and equipment maintenance. The UN says its mandate covers support for up to 11,826 AUSSOM uniformed personnel, including police, deployed across five sectors and 49 locations in south-central Somalia. The scale of that logistical operation is significant. UNSOS said in August that it delivers approximately 240 tonnes of food rations each month to AUSSOM and Somali security forces across Somalia. From an abrupt cutoff to a 12-month transition In July, Washington informed the African Union that it would oppose continued UN logistical support for AUSSOM when the existing arrangement expires at the end of 2026. The announcement raised concerns about how the mission would maintain its operations without alternative funding and logistical arrangements. The latest diplomatic note says the United States is willing to support a 12-month drawdown followed by the liquidation of UNSOS. Diplomatic sources and a Somali government source told Reuters that the new countdown will begin in January 2027. The U.S. State Department said it expected the details of the drawdown to be discussed during UN Security Council deliberations in December. Somalia’s Defence Ministry, UNSOS and the African Union Commission did not immediately respond to Reuters’ requests for comment. What comes next for AUSSOM The UN Security Council extended AUSSOM’s mandate through December 31, 2026, under Resolution 2809. The resolution also provides for continued UN logistical support to the mission during the current period. The mission’s financing remains a challenge. Reuters reported that Washington last year blocked a proposal under which UN funding would have covered three-quarters of AUSSOM’s annual budget of about $190 million. The additional year gives Somalia, the African Union and international partners more time to identify alternative sources of financing and logistical support. However, no alternative arrangement has yet been publicly confirmed that would fully replace UNSOS after the transition period. The future of AUSSOM will therefore depend in part on whether new funding and logistical mechanisms can be secured for essential services such as fuel, food, transportation and medical support. The post The United States Extends AUSSOM Support for Somalia by One Year first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Maraykanka oo Soomaaliya U Kordhiyay Taageerada AUSSOM Hal Sano Ah
items.description: Maraykanka oo Qaramada Midoobay u kordhiyay hal sano si loo yareeyo taageerada AUSSOM MOGADISHU — Maraykanka ayaa oggolaaday in Qaramada Midoobay ay hal sano oo dheeraad ah ku bixiso dhimista iyo soo afjaridda taageerada saadka ee ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, taas oo siinaysa AUSSOM waqti dheeraad ah oo ay ku raadiso hab kale oo ay ku sii waddo howlaheeda. Go’aanka, oo lagu sheegay qoraal diblomaasiyadeed ay aragtay Reuters, ayaa dhigaya in muddada 12-ka bilood ah ay bilaabato Janaayo 2027. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in taageerada Qaramada Midoobay aan si degdeg ah loo joojin doonin dhammaadka Diseembar 2026, balse la sameyn doono marxalad kala-guur ah. Si kastaba, Washington waxay caddeysay in aysan doonayn inay sii maalgeliso ama taageerto Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya (UNSOS) marka muddada kala-guurkaasi dhammaato. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Maraykanka ayaa Reuters u sheegtay in miisaaniyadda guud ee UNSOS ay ku dhowdahay $500 milyan. AUSSOM iyo muhiimadda UNSOS AUSSOM waa howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee taageerada iyo xasilinta Soomaaliya. Qaramada Midoobay waxay UNSOS u xilsaartay inay siiso howlgalka taageero saadka ah, oo ay ka mid yihiin cunto, biyo, shidaal, adeegyo caafimaad, gaadiid, dayactir qalab iyo adeegyo kale oo muhiim u ah hawlgallada. UNSOS waxay sheegtay in AUSSOM loo oggolaaday taageero ku wajahan ilaa 11,826 askari iyo boolis ah oo ku sugan shan qaybood oo hawlgal iyo 49 goobood oo ku yaalla koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya. Taageerada waxaa sidoo kale ka mid ah daadgureynta caafimaadka iyo gaadiidka ciidamo iyo qalab. Tusaale ahaan, UNSOS waxay bishii Agoosto sheegtay inay Soomaaliya gudaheeda bil kasta gaarsiiso AUSSOM iyo ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliyeed qiyaastii 240 tan oo raashin ah, taas oo muujinaysa baaxadda silsiladda saadka ee howlgalka. Maxaa is beddelay? Bishii Luulyo, Washington waxay Midowga Afrika ku wargelisay inay ka hor imaan doonto in Qaramada Midoobay ay sii waddo taageerada UNSOS marka muddada hadda jirta ay dhammaato dhammaadka 2026. Tallaabadaas ayaa dhalisay walaac ku saabsan sida AUSSOM u sii wadan karto hawlaheeda haddii aan la helin ilo kale oo dhaqaale iyo saadka ah. Qoraalka cusub ee diblomaasiyadeed wuxuu sheegayaa in Maraykanku diyaar u yahay inuu taageero 12 bilood oo kala-guur ah , oo ay xigto xiritaanka UNSOS. Ilo diblomaasiyadeed iyo ilo ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa Reuters u sheegay in tirinta muddada cusub ay bilaaban doonto Janaayo 2027. Wasaaradda Difaaca Soomaaliya, UNSOS iyo Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaan Reuters uga jawaabin codsiyada faallo laga helayo waqtigii warbixinta la diyaarinayay. Mustaqbalka AUSSOM Qaramada Midoobay ayaa horay u kordhisay muddada AUSSOM ilaa 31-ka Diseembar 2026, iyadoo Resolution 2809 ay sidoo kale oggolaatay in UNSOS ay sii waddo taageerada saadka ee howlgalka. Hase yeeshee, maalgelinta howlgalka ayaa weli ah caqabad. Reuters waxay sheegtay in Maraykanku sannadkii hore hor istaagay qorshe lagu doonayay in qayb weyn oo ka mid ah miisaaniyadda howlgalka Midowga Afrika laga bixiyo dhaqaalaha Qaramada Midoobay. Go’aanka cusub wuxuu siinayaa Soomaaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah waqti dheeraad ah oo ay ku raadiyaan maalgelin iyo nidaam saadka oo beddel u noqda UNSOS. Laakiin illaa hadda ma jirto xaqiijin rasmi ah oo muujinaysa cidda si buuxda ula wareegi doonta adeegyada UNSOS marka muddada kala-guurka ahi dhammaato. Mustaqbalka AUSSOM sidaas darteed wuxuu weli ku xiran yahay sida loo heli doono maalgelin, gaadiid, shidaal, adeegyo caafimaad iyo taageero kale oo howlgalka looga baahan yahay. The post Maraykanka oo Soomaaliya U Kordhiyay Taageerada AUSSOM Hal Sano Ah first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Bayaan Mareykanka ka soo baxay oo meesha ka saaray sheegashadii maamulka Deni
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika (AFRICOM) ayaa Jimcihii soo saaray bayaan si weyn uga hor imanaya sheegashadii ay Puntland Khamiistii ka sameysay howlgal lagu beegsaday kayd hub oo Al-Shabaab ku lahayd gobolka Sanaag. Puntland ayaa 17-kii September sheegtay in howlgalka ka dhacay buuraha Golis ee deegaanka Cal-Madow lagu fuliyey iskaashi iyo isku-duwid dhexmartay hay’adaha maamulka Puntland iyo dowladda Mareykanka. Bayaanka Puntland ayaa lagu sheegay in howlgalka lagu beegsaday goob lagu magacaabo Markad, halkaas oo Al-Shabaab ay ku kaydinaysay hub iyo rasaas ay u adeegsanaysay howlgalladeeda. “Dowladda Puntland iyo Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa xaqiijiyey guusha hawlgalka la-dagaallanka argagixisada,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka Puntland. Hase yeeshee, AFRICOM ayaa 18-kii September soo saartay bayaan rasmi ah oo ay ku caddeysay in howlgalka lagu fuliyey isku-duwid lala yeeshay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo aan wax xusid ah ka sameyn Puntland. “Anagoo la shaqeyneyna Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika wuxuu 17-kii September 2026 fuliyey weerar lagu beegsaday bakhaar lagu kaydinayey hubka caadiga ah ee Al-Shabaab oo ku yaalla waqooyiga Soomaaliya,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka AFRICOM. AFRICOM ayaa intaas ku dartay in weerarku ka dhacay gobolka Sanaag, meel qiyaastii 80 kiiloomitir koonfur-galbeed kaga beegan magaalada Boosaaso. Taliska Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed kala shaqeynayo tallaabooyin lagu wiiqayo awoodda Al-Shabaab iyo khatarta ay ku hayso ciidamada iyo muwaadiniinta Mareykanka ee dibadda. Bayaanka AFRICOM ayaa sidaas ku meesha ka saaray sawirkii ka dhashay hadalkii Puntland ee ahaa in howlgalka uu ahaa mid ay si gaar ah isaga kaashadeen maamulkaas iyo dowladda Mareykanka. Inkastoo AFRICOM aysan si toos ah u sheegin in Puntland aysan wax door ah ku lahayn howlgalka, haddana cidda ay sheegtay in weerarka lala isku dubbariday waxay si cad ugu koobtay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay hadal-heyn, maadaama bayaankii Puntland uu markii hore abuuray su’aalo ku saabsan in Mareykanku howlgal amni si toos ah la fuliyey maamul-goboleed, isagoo dhinac maraya dowladda dhexe. Labada bayaan waxay isku waafaqeen goobta iyo bartilmaameedka weerarka, balse waxay si weyn ugu kala duwan yihiin cidda Mareykanku sheegay inuu la kaashaday howlgalka. Arrintan ayaa kusoo aadeysa toddobaadyo kadib markii Puntland ay sheegtay inay Mareykanka la gashay heshiis amni oo lagu ballaarinayo iskaashiga labada dhinac iyo joogitaanka ciidamada Mareykanka ee Boosaaso. Horaantii August, Madaxweyne Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa Boosaaso kula kulmay wafdi Mareykan ah oo uu hoggaaminayey Taliyaha Hawlgallada Gaarka ah ee AFRICOM, Major General Claude Tudor, iyadoo Puntland ay sheegtay in labada dhinac ay gaareen heshiis ku saabsan ballaarinta iskaashiga amniga iyo xarunta Mareykanka ee Boosaaso. Dabayaaqadii August, Deni ayaa mar kale Boosaaso kula kulmay saraakiil sare oo Mareykan ah oo uu hoggaaminayey Colonel James Rose, oo ah taliyaha Hawlgallada Gaarka ah ee Mareykanka ee Bariga Afrika. Sida ay markaas sheegtay Madaxtooyada Puntland, kulanka waxaa looga hadlay dardargelinta qorshaha saldhigga Mareykanka ee Boosaaso, iskaashiga howlgallada ka dhanka ah Daacish iyo Al-Shabaab ee Calmiskaad iyo Cal-Madow, amniga badaha iyo tababarrada ciidamada Puntland. Sidaas darteed, bayaanka cusub ee AFRICOM ayaa keenaya su’aalo ku saabsan heerka iyo qaabka uu Mareykanku ula shaqeynayo Puntland, gaar ahaan marka la eego in Puntland ay dhowaan sheegatay heshiis amni oo toos ah, halka AFRICOM marka uu ka hadlay howlgalka 17-ka September uu si rasmi ah u magacaabay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya.
