items.title: Puntland Delivers Food and Assistance to 200 Families in Dhinowda
items.description: Jariiban (WDN) — Puntland authorities have delivered emergency humanitarian assistance to approximately 200 vulnerable families in Dhinowda, a remote settlement in Jariiban District of Mudug Region. Government officials traveled to Dhinowda to distribute essential food supplies and cash assistance cards to households facing difficult living conditions. Similar assistance has also been delivered to Towfiiq District and surrounding settlements. Many families in Dhinowda and Towfiiq depend heavily on livestock and pastoral livelihoods. Recurrent drought, reduced access to water and pasture, and declining household incomes have increased food insecurity and placed additional pressure on vulnerable communities across the area. The intervention forms part of Puntland’s broader efforts to provide immediate relief to remote communities while addressing their longer-term development needs. The two areas were among the communities recently visited by Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni during his tour of Mudug Region, which brought renewed attention to the humanitarian and development priorities of southern Puntland. For the families receiving assistance, the immediate support provides essential food and financial relief. At the same time, the situation underscores the importance of sustained investment in water infrastructure, livestock services and resilient rural livelihoods to reduce communities’ vulnerability to future droughts and environmental pressures. items.title: Sanctioning Officials of the Palestinian Authority and Members of the Palestine Liberation Organization
items.description: Sanctioning Officials of the Palestinian Authority and Members of the Palestine Liberation Organization Office of the Spokesman The State Department has reported to Congress that the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) and Palestinian Authority (PA) have, once again, failed to live up to their commitments as described in the PLO Commitments Compliance Act of 1989 (PLOCCA) and the Middle East Peace Commitments Act of 2002 (MEPCA). This includes initiating and supporting actions at international organizations that undermine and contradict prior commitments in support of Security Council Resolution 242 and 338, taking actions to internationalize the Israeli-Palestinian Conflict including through the International Criminal Court (ICC) and International Court of Justice (ICJ), seeking to bypass negotiations through seeking unilateral recognition, and continuing to pay stipends to terrorists and to glorify acts of terrorism and terrorists in public pronouncements and school textbooks. As a consequence of their failure to reform, contrary to their commitments to the United States, and their ongoing activities that undermine the prospects for peace, the United States will extend sanctions that deny visas to PLO members and PA officials in accordance with section 604(a)(1) of the MEPCA. The Department has maintained the standing waiver for personnel notified to the PLO Observer Mission to the United Nations as was the case in the Department’s prior determinations. It is in our national interest to impose consequences and hold the PLO and PA accountable for glorifying terrorism.

items.title: Kadib dibadbaxyadii Koonfur Galbeed, magaalada Muqdisho oo laga difaacay xiriirka…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Kadib falkii sida weyn loo cambaareeyay ee lagu gubay calanka Turkiga, waxaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimadda dalka laga taageeray xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya. Odayaasha dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed oo maanta kulan ku yeeshay magaaada Muqdisho ayaa taageero wayn u muujiyay dowladda Turkiga, iyaga oo boggaadiyay xiriirka labada dal. Kulanka ayaa waxaa ka qayb-galay odayaal dhaqameedyo, salaadiin, ugaasyo, nabaddoonno iyo waxgarad Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo si gaar ah u xusay taageerada Turkiga uu sanadihii lasoo dhaafay siiyay Soomaaliya. Qaar kamid ah odayaasha ka hadlay kulanka ayaa sheegay in taageerada Turkiga ay gaartay qaybo badan oo muhiim ah oo ay ku jiraan gargaarka bani’aadannimo, caafimaadka, waxbarashada iyo adeegyada bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, odayaasha dhaqanka ayaa xusay in Soomaaliya ay muddo dheer soo martay xaalado adag, ayna muhiim ahayd taageerada caalamiga ah ee dalka loo fidiyay. “Turkiga wuxuu ka mid ahaa dalalkii si muuqata uga jawaabay baahiyaha Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan xilligii ay dalka ka jireen macluul iyo xaalado bani’aadannimo oo aad u daran,” ayey sheegeen odayaasha dhaqanka. Waxa kale oo ay xuseen in xiriirka labada dal uu si weyn u kobcay wixii ka dambeeyay 2011-kii, xilligaas oo Muqdisho uu yimid Erdogan oo ra’iisul wasaare ah, xilligaas oo dalka ku dhufatay macluul daran oo ay ku dhinteen ku dhowaad 260 kun oo qof oo carruur u badan. Wixii markaas ka dambeeyay, Turkiga wuxuu ballaariyay gurmadkiisa bani’aadannimo iyo mashaariicda horumarineed ee uu ka fulinayay gudaha Soomaaliya. “Bulshada Soomaaliyeed ma hilmaami karto garab istaaggii dowladda iyo shacabka Turkiga ay muujiyeen xilliyadii adkaa,” ayey kulanka ka sheegeen qaar ka mid ah odayaasha dhaqanka. Taageeradaasi ayey odayaashu sheegeen inay taabatay nolosha dadka Soomaaliyeed, kana qayb qaadatay dib-u-dhiska dalka. Odayaasha ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in xiriirka labada dal uusan ku koobnayn oo keliya iskaashi rasmi ah oo ay yeeshaan dowladuhu, balse uu leeyahay dhinac bulsho oo muddo dheer soo jiray. Sidoo kale intii kulanka socday waxaa lagu soo bandhigay baaq ku aaddan in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka labada dal, iyadoo odayaashu ku adkeysteen muhiimadda iskaashi ku saleysan ixtiraam, dano wadaag iyo mashaariic wax ku ool ah oo faa’iido u leh bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Kulankan aya kusoo beegmaya, iyadoo maalmo kahor deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed ay ka dhaceen dibadbaxyo lagu taageerayay Turkiga, sidoo kalena looga soo horjeeday in meel kamid ah Soomaaliya lagu gubo calankiisa. Si kastaba, xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay si weyn u ballaartay, iyadoo labada dal ay yeesheen iskaashi dhow oo dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha bani’aadannimada ah. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale door muhiim ah ka qaata taageerada dhismaha iyo tababarka ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo beeniyay in ay weerar ku qaadeen Makka Sucuudigana eedeeyay
items.description: Madaxa Xuutiyiinte Mahdi al-Mashat ayaa diiday eedeymaha uga imaanaya Sacuudiga ee ku saabsan in Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay bartilmaameedsatay magaalada Makka, isagoo ku tilmaamay tallaabadaas “isku-day quus ah oo lagu doonayo in lagu kiciyo shucuubta [ka dhanka ah Yemen],” sida ay baahisay warbaahinta Al-Masirah. ￭ Al-Mashat ayaa sheegay in shucuubta Carabta iyo kuwa Muslimiinta ah ay si weyn u fahmeen taariikhda iyo dhaqanka dowladda Sacuudiga, wuxuuna ku eedeeyay maamulkaas inay meel-ka-dhac ku sameynayaan Kacbada, Qur’aanka Kariimka ah iyo Labada Masjid ee Barakaysan, iyagoo isla markaasna adeegsanaya hantida dadweynaha. ￭ Al-Mashat ayaa xusay in dadka reer Yemen ay diyaar u yihiin inay naftooda u huraan difaaca Guriga Barakaysan ee Kacbada, sidii ay u sameeyeen markii ay taageerayeen Masjidka Al-Aqsa, wuxuuna tilmaamay in dadka Yemen ay si joogto ah u dhigaan dibadbaxyo marka meel-ka-dhac loo geysto goobaha barakaysan ee Islaamka. ￭ “Waxay ahayd inay aad uga habboonaan lahayd maamulka Sacuudiga inay abaabulaan shucuubta Ummadda Islaamka xilligii dambiilaha Trump uu meel-ka-dhaca ku sameeyay Kacbada, uuna iska qaaday sawirro muujinaya muuqaal liidaya oo xad-gudub ku ah barakada iyo sharafta Kacbada,” ayuu yiri madaxweynaha Yemen. ￭ “Qofkii hadiyad ahaan u siiyay marada lagu daboolo Kacbada Barakaysan dambiilaha Epstein, waa isla qofkaas bartilmaameedsanaya Makka iyo goobaha barakaysan ee Islaamka,” ayuu yiri al-Mashat. ￭ Wuxuuna hadalkiisa ku soo gabagabeeyay in “Been-abuurka maamulka Sacuudiga uusan mar dambe marin-habaabin karin shucuubta qarankeenna Carabta iyo Islaamka,” isagoo sidoo kale tixraacaya sheegashooyinkii hore ee Sacuudiga ee ku saabsanaa khataraha ku wajahan marin-biyoodyada caalamiga ah.

items.title: “Wareer iguma hayso haddii Indha-cadde uu madaxweyne ku xigeen ka noqdo KGS”
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan hore Maxamed Cumar Dalxa oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Shabelle TV ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan isbeddelladii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba iyo kuwa kale ee la filayo inay ka dhacaan maamulkaasi. Dalxa ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay warar maalmahan si weyn loogu faafiyay baraha bulshada, kuwaas oo sheegayay in Koonfur Galbeed markii ugu horreysay yeelaneyso Madaxweyne Ku-xigeen, ‘loona wado Jeneraal Yuusuf Maxamed Siyaad (Indhacadde)’. Waxa uu sheegay inuu arkay dad ka qaylinaya joogitaanka Jeneraal Indhacadde ee magaalada Baydhaba iyo wararka sheegaya inuu qabanayo xilka Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Dowlad-goboledka Koonfur Galbeed, maadaama ay xogtaas si wayn ugu baahday internet-ka. Prof. Maxamed Cumar Dalxa ayaa tilmaamay in aysan wax dhib ah ku haynin haddii Indhacadde loo magacaabo xilkaasi, isaga oo xusay in dadka arrintaas ka cabanaya ay aragti ka duwan ka qabaan. “Dadka qaylinaya ee dhahaya Indhacadde ayaa jooga Baydhaba, waana naqaanaa anigu uma arko nin shaqsiyad xun, Madaxweyne Ku-xigeen hadii uu KGS ka noqdo wareer iguma heyso,” ayuu yiri Prof. Maxamed Cumar Dalxa. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli haatan magaalada Baydhaba ay ka socdaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo siyaasadeed iyo isbeddello la xiriira maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, iyadoo sidoo kale la hadal hayo qorshayaal cusub oo ku saabsan qaab-dhismeedka hoggaanka maamulkaasi. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Baydhaba ayaa waxaa haatan ka taagan xiisad culus oo ka dhalatay dhawaan isbeddalkii ka dhacay magaaladaasi, taas oo u dhexeysa madaxweyne Sheekh Aadan Madoobe iyo Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Labada dhinac ayaa marar kala duwan ku dagaalamay gudaha magaalada Baydhaba, taas oo keentay in xaalad amni ay gasho Koonfur Galbeed, iyada oo sidoo kale duqeymo xooggan ay ka dhaceen agagaarka Baydhaba. The post “Wareer iguma hayso haddii Indha-cadde uu madaxweyne ku xigeen ka noqdo KGS” appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ka xeeladeysanaya khilaafka Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Taliska Militariga Somaliya ayaa dadaal ugu jira, sidii Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley ay u sii joogi lahaayeen difaacyadooda Gobolka Hiiraan, xilli khilaaf adag oo u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo siyaasiyiinta deegaanka uu ka taagan yahay gobolkaasi. Taliska ayaa ka cabsi qaba in ciidamadu ay ku milmeen xiisadda siyaasadeed ee ka soo korortay gobolkaasi, isla-markaana ay ku mowqif noqdaan siyaasiyiinta, odayaasha iyo waxgaradka ka biyo diidan dib-u-doorashada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe). Gobolkan ayaa waxaa ka hawlgala cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ka soo jeeda deegaanka iyo xoogag Macawiisley ah oo ka taageera la dagaalanka Al Shabaab. Ilo wareedyo muhiim ah ayaa sheegaya in Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud uu dadaal weyn ugu jiro, sidii Ciidamada Qalabka Sida iyo Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan ay baaqi ugu sii ahaan lahaayeen aagagga difaaca, si looga baaqsado in khilaafka siyaasadeed uu abuuro dib-u-dhac weyn oo ku aaddan dagaalkii lagu la jiray Al Shabaab. Siyaasiyiinta iyo dhaqanka ee beesha aqlabiyadda Gobolka Hiiraan oo maalmihii la soo dhaafay uu shir uga socday Magaalada Beledweyne ayaa ku howlan dhismaha maamul ka madaxbannaan kan Hirshabelle iyo qorista ciidamo dadka deegaanka ah, oo ka hortaga doorashada qof iyo codka ee la rabo in dhawaan laga qabto degmooyin ka tirsan gobolkaasi, si shacabku ay u soo doortaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Hirshabelle iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka. Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee halista gelinaya mustaqbalka Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa in uu khatar dhab ah ku yahay amniga dalka. Taliyaha Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Cali Axmed Xaashi (Cagey) oo wajahaya cadaadis uga imanaya Xarunta Taliska Militariga ee Muqdisho ayaa isku dayaya in uu ciidamadu ku sii hayo furimaha hore ee gobolka, iyadoo la muujinayo in ciidamadu ay ka madaxbannaan yihiin khilaafka madaxda sare ee dalka iyo kuwa deegaanka. Sarkaal ka tirsan Xarunta Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa Universaltv u sheegay in ka bixitaanka ciidamada ee fariisimahooda uu kala dhantaali karo nidaamka amarada. Sarkaalkan oo codsaday inaanan magaciisa Warbaahinta loo adeegsan ayaa intaasi ku daray in uu jiro welwel ku saabsan dheelitirka awoodeed ee gobolka, dhowr goobood oo la soo faarujiyana ay Al Shabaab siineyso gacanta sare ee goobaha dagaalka. Shabaabka ayaa ka faa’iideysan kara goobaha laga baxo, si ay dib ugu qabsadaan deegaanadii horey looga saaray. Khilaafka u dhexeeya Villa Somalia iyo hoggaanka siyaasadeed ee Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa gaaray heerkii ugu sarreyay, taasoo saamayn karta awoodda maareynta ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida. General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo fahamsan cawaaqibka ay arrintan ku leedahay shaqada hoggaanka taliska ayaa ku foogan, sidii uu uga xeeladeysan lahaa xiisadda siyaasadeed ee gobolkaasi.

items.title: Puntland oo Raashin iyo Gargaar Gaarsiisay 200 Qoys oo ku Nool Dhinowda
items.description: Jariiban (WDN) — Dowladda Gobolleedka Puntland ayaa gargaar bani’aadantinimo oo degdeg ah gaarsiisay bulshada nugul ee ku nool Dhinowda, oo ah deegaan aad u durugsan ama fog oo ka tirsan Degmada Jariiban ee Gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo dadka deegaanka ay wajahayaaan culaysyo dhaqaale iyo kuwo deegaan. Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Puntland ayaa gaaray Dhinowda, halkaas oo ay gargaar gaarsiiyeen ku dhowaad 200 oo qoys. Gargaarka ayaa isugu jiray raashin muhiim ah iyo kaarar lacag-caawimaad ah, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay in qoysasku ku daboolaan baahiyahooda aasaasiga ah. Dowladda Puntland ayaa sidoo kale gargaar noocan oo kale ah gaarsiisay Degmada Towfiiq iyo deegaannada ku xeeran, si loo taageero bulshooyinka kale ee wajahaya duruufaha adag ee nololleed. Dhinowda iyo Towfiiq ayaa ka mid ah deegaannada ku yaalla koonfurta Puntland, waxaana qoysas badan oo halkaas ku nool ay si weyn ugu tiirsan yihiin xoolaha. Abaaraha soo noqnoqda iyo yaraanshaha biyaha iyo daaqa ayaa hoos u dhigay dakhliga qoysaska, isla markaana kordhiyay cunto-yarida iyo nuglaanta bulshada. Gargaarkan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada Dowladda Puntland ee lagu taageerayo bulshada ku nool deegaannada fogfog, iyadoo sidoo kale la doonayo in wax laga qabto saameynta ay dhibaatooyinka deegaanka ee soo noqnoqda ku leeyihiin nolosha iyo dhaqaalaha bulshada. Dhinowda iyo Towfiiq waxay ka mid ahaayeen deegaannadii uu dhawaan booqday Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, intii uu ku guda jiray safarkiisa Gobolka Mudug. Qoysaska helay gargaarka, taageeradan ayaa siinaysa gargaar degdeg ah oo dhinaca raashinka iyo dhaqaalaha ah. Hase yeeshee, xaaladda ka jirta deegaannadan waxay sidoo kale muujinaysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay in la joogteeyo maalgelinta kaabayaasha biyaha, adeegyada xoolaha iyo hab-nololeedyada miyiga ee adkaysiga u leh abaaraha, si bulshada looga yareeyo nuglaanta ay u leeyihiin abaaraha iyo dhibaatooyinka deegaanka ee mustaqbalka. items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo ka warbixyay cida uu la kulmay iyo wixii ay ka wada hadleen
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliland Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro oo qoraal uu soo dhigay barta uu ku leeyahay X – waxa uu kaga war bixiyay booqashada uu ku joogo dalka Maraykanka gaar ahaan Washington D.C- waxana uu qoraalkaasi oo afka Ingriisiga ku qornaa uu ku yidhi. Intii aan ku guda jiray booqdaygii Washington, D.C., waxaan la kulmay xubno ka tirsan Koongareeska Mareykanka iyo safiirro caalami ah si aan uga wada hadalno xoojinta xiriirka Somaliland iyo Mareykanka, iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah, amniga gobolka, iyo arrimaha ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga. Waxaan mar kale caddeeyay doorka Somaliland ay ku leedahay inay tahay saaxiib istiraatiiji ah oo la isku halayn karo, isla markaana ka go’an tahay horumarinta danaha ay wadaagaan labada dhinac.

items.title: Puntland oo guul wayn ka sheegatay howlgal ay isla fuliyeen ciidanka Mareykanka
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Onine) – Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa lagu faah-faahiyay weerar ay si wadajir u fuliyeen ciidamada Puntland iyo Mareykanka, kaas oo ka dhacay buuraha Calmadow-Golis ee maamulkaasi. Howlgalka oo ahaa duqeyn ayaa u dhacay si guul ah, iyada oo lagu beegsaday maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, laguna burburiyay kayd hub ah oo ay kooxda ku lahayd halkaasi, sida lagu sheegay qoraalka kasoo baxay Puntand. “Dowladda Puntland iyo Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa xaqiijiyey guusha hawlgalka la-dagaallanka argagixisada oo ka dhacay buuraha Golis ee deegaanka Cal-Madow, kaas oo lagu beegsaday goob lagu magacaabo Markad, halkaas oo kooxda u ahayd kaydka hubka iyo rasaasta ee ururka Al-Shabaab,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Puntland. Bartilmaameedka ugu wayn duqeynta ayaa ahaa in lagu burburyiyo goobtan oo ay Al-Shabaab u adeegsan jireen kaydinta hubka iyo rasaasta, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu taageero falalka argagixisada iyo in khatar lagu geliyo shacabka Puntland. “Hawlgalka, oo lagu fuliyey iskaashi iyo isku-duwid lala yeeshay hay’adaha Dowladda Puntland, ayaa lagu beegsaday xarun lagu kaydinayey hub iyo saanad ciidan oo Al-Shabaab u adeegsanaysay taageeridda hawlgalladeeda iyo khatar-gelinta amniga shacabka Puntland iyo guud ahaan Soomaaliya,” ayaa asii raaciyay. Sidoo kale, warka qoraalka ah ayaa lagu sheegay in howlgallada ay sii socon doonaan, isla markaana ujeedkooda uu yahay in lagu wiiqo Al-Shabaab. “Hawlgalkan wuxuu qayb ka yahay dadaallada joogtada ah ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda kooxda Al-Shabaab ee waqooyiga Soomaaliya. Beegsiga goobaha iyo xarumaha ay kooxdu u adeegsato taageeridda hawlgalladeeda ayaa ah mid lagu saarayo cadaadis laguna, laguna burburinayo awooddeeda ay ku qorshayso inay fuliso weeraro,” ayaa mar kale lagu yirwarsaxaafadeedka. Muddooyinkii u dambeeyay howlgallo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab ayaa ka socday deegaanno ka tirsan Puntland, gaar ahaan dhulka buuraleyda ah ee Calmadow-Golis, iyadoo ciidamada Puntland iyo Mareykanka ay iska kaashanayaan bartilmaameedsiga goobaha ay kooxda ku leedahay saldhigyada iyo keydadka hubka. Horay waxay Puntland u weerartay fariisimaha muhiimka ah ee ay kooxda Daacish ku leedahay buuraha Calmadow ee gobolka Bari, kaas oo ay guullo waa wayn kasoo hoyeen ciidamada, maadaama ay xoreen dhul ballaaran. items.title: Daawo: Xamza oo maanta ku dhawaaqay isbeddallo waa wayn – Maxa dhacaya?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamza Cabdi Barre oo maanta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay xafiiskiisa ayaa ku dhawaaqay isbeddallo waa wayn oo ay sameyneyso xukuumaddiisa, kuwaas oo la xiriira dib u habeynta shaqaalaha rayidka ee hay’adaha dowladda, iyada oo wajiga koowaad lagu bilaabi doono agaasime waaxeedyada wasaaradaha. Xamza ayaa faray dhammaan golihiisa wasiirrada iyo mas’uuliyiinta kale ee dowladda in si buuxda loo hirgeliyo hannaanka shaqaalaysiinta iyo magacaabista ku salaysan kartida iyo mudnaanta. “Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, Isaga oo ka duulaya Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Qodobka 161aad farqadda (1), Sharciga Shaqaalaha Rayid ah qodobkiisa 7aad, iyo dhammaan xeerarka, shuruucda iyo qaraarada la xiriira Shaqaalaha Rayidka ah ee Dowladdda Federaalka ah, ayuu faray dhammaan Wasiirrada iyo Mas’uuliyiinta kale ee dowladda in si buuxda oo aan dib-u-dhac lahayn loo hirgeliyo hannaanka shaqaalaysiinta iyo magacaabista ku salaysan kartida iyo mudnaanta,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay xafiiska Xamza Cabdi Barre. Sidoo kale, wuxuu faray guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka dowladda in 20-Sebteembar la bilaabo wajiga 1-aad ee dib-u-habaynta lagu sameynayo agaasime waaxeedyada, maadaama ay laf-dhabar u yihiin maamulka hey’adaha dowladda, ayna door muuqda ka qaataan hoggaaminta, hirgalinta siyaasadda, fulinta qorsheyaasha iyo joogtaynta shaqada hey’adaha. Waxaa kale oo uu Ra’iisul wasaaruh sheegay in marka la hirgaliyo wajiga 1-aad sidoo kale dib-u-habayn lagu samayn doono agaasimayaasha guud ee hey’adaha dowladda, iyada oo lagu salaynayo karti, aqoon, khibrad, hoggaamin iyo waxqabad, si loo dhiso hoggaan maamul oo xirfad leh isla-xisaabtan leh oo ka shaqeeya natiijooyin muuqda. Ujeedada laga leeyahay nidaamkan ayaa ah in dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay yeelato hoggaan maamul oo xirfad leh, joogto ah, awoodda in uu hirgaliyo siyaasadda dowladda, una beddelo natiijooyin muuqda oo ay markhaati ka noqdaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa xusay in afartii sano ee la soo dhaafay, xukuumadda DanQaran ay qaaday tallaabooyin muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo dhismaha, maamulka iyo tayada hay’adaha dowladda, iyada oo ujeeddadu tahay in la helo hay’ado dowladeed oo leh saldhig sharci iyo maamul adag iyo Shaqaale Rayid ah oo leh aqoon, karti iyo karaan ku filan gudashada waajibaadka saaran. “Waxaan dhidibka u taagnay tiirar sharci iyo kuwa hay’adaha ee lagama maarmaanka u ah dib-u-habaynta iyo horumarinta shaqaalaha rayidka ah, Waxa aan ansixinnay sharciyo, siyaasado, xeerar iyo qaab-dhismeedyo muhiim ah oo hagaya maamulka hay’adaha iyo shaqaalaha dowladda”. ayuu raaciyay. Ugu dambayn, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha dalka, ayaa faray dhammaan wasaaradaha iyo hey’adaha dowladda in si buuxda loo hirgeliyo qaab-dhismeedyada hay’adaha ee la ansixiyey, iyada oo xilalka agaasime waaxeedyada lagu buuxinayo hannaan tartan furan, dhammaan shaqaalaha u qalma ee ku jira adeegga rayidka ah la siiyo fursad loo siman yahay oo ay ugu tartamaan xilalkaas, iyo in wixii xil ama jago bannaan ah ee shaqaalaha dowladda ah lagu buuxiyo hannaan tartan furan oo waafaqsan shuruucda iyo xeerarka dowladda. The post Daawo: Xamza oo maanta ku dhawaaqay isbeddallo waa wayn – Maxa dhacaya? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: The Dual Framework of Somali Moral Psychology
items.description: Dr. Ahmed Hassan, LPCC Recent discussions about Somalia’s ongoing political issues often blame the failures on immoral traits of Somali leaders , such as corruption, nepotism, and resource theft . While I agree, I believe the conversation should also include broader societal moral struggles. Politicians mirror their society, and a major root of these moral problems is Somalis’ difficulty extending empathy beyond their immediate group. The tribal divide, characterized by an us-versus-them mentality, plays a significant role in both moral decline and political instability. To understand Somalia’s persistent instability and why individual morals fail, we must examine not only politicians’ actions but also the cultural factors shaping societal values. One central problem with Somali morality is its dual nature. The same cultural values that foster remarkable solidarity and cooperation within clans also systematically justify exclusion and violence against outsiders. This is not a failure of morality but its distortion: the very mechanisms that foster trust and cooperation among clan members become weapons against minorities and rivals when the state collapses and resources become scarce. During the 1991 civil war, the country’s collapse revealed previously managed clan divisions. Clan militias protected their members and targeted others, driven by a moral logic of in-group loyalty that served as both motivation and justification. This behavior was not mere tribalism, but a survival response; extreme resource shortages and the breakdown of institutions pushed individuals to revert to primal instincts, emphasizing clan loyalty and punishing rival clans, reopening old wounds and grievances. While the Somali “clan conscience” fostered remarkable mutual aid and self-sacrifice, its intense solidarity also made it challenging to extend the same empathy to members of rival clans. To analyze Somali moral psychology, I will examine how emotions and reason influence moral decisions. For example, in conflicts, Somalis often use emotions like Shame ( ceeb ), a potent form of social regulator, which can have destructive effects. Shame promotes social conformity by instilling fear of public disgrace and losing face, prompting individuals to act honorably. However, when collective honor is involved, shame may lead to mob mentality and increased violence in inter-clan disputes. A recent incident illustrates this: people were killed along clan lines in Hirshabelle , often to avenge a clan member and defend group honor. Although killing an innocent is morally wrong and contradicts human conscience, cultural values may take precedence. People might justify it, viewing the other person’s clan as a threat because of past incidents. If someone responsible for avenging clan members does not do so, they risk shame from their clan; therefore, exclusion anxiety motivates them to act in ways that shut down conscience ( damiir ) voices.  Even empathy ( naxariis ), the virtue Somali tradition places at the foundation of all others, has limits. In the case of the man recently killed and widely circulated on social media, his plea for empathy, addressed to the people he called uncle on his mother’s side, went ignored. The killer’s lack of empathy can be explained by research showing that oxytocin, the bonding hormone, strengthens prosocial behavior within groups while simultaneously enhancing defensive aggression toward outsiders. In his case, the captors considered him an outsider despite his claim that they were related. This biological mechanism means that intense in-group solidarity can inadvertently justify hostility toward those outside the lineage who are perceived as a threat. The result is a “moral dualism” in which the same emotional bonds that sustain communities become barriers to universal justice. During the civil war, individuals with consciences ( damiir ) often engage in harmful acts they would usually avoid by using “moral disengagement” strategies. These involve justifying violence as necessary or insignificant, dehumanizing out-group members, blaming leaders, and framing violence as “protecting the community.” This process bypasses personal moral standards, allowing typically peaceful young men to commit extraordinary violence, especially under intense stress, charismatic warlords, and when legitimate state authority is absent. Although many human actions are driven by emotions, the key is to restore reason as a check against emotion-led morality. Reason allows careful assessment that can surpass impulsive emotional reactions rooted in self-interest or group loyalty, helping to confront clan biases that empathy alone can’t resolve. It promotes a concept called “responsible interdependence,” a balanced virtue that opposes both extreme tribalism and authoritarian nationalism, fostering personal responsibility while maintaining the advantages of cooperation among diverse groups. Reason also broadens moral concern beyond the clan. Guided by principles of individual dignity and universal rights, reason argues that if I have rights to justice and fairness, I should extend those rights to others. It helps prevent sacrificing individuals for leaders’ gain. Although I argue that reason is needed to address the moral challenges Somalis are struggling with, emotions such as empathy still play an important role in morality. Therefore, the way forward involves “moral pluralism,” acknowledging that different situations demand different ethical approaches; for example, emotions like empathy can be more suitable during crises like famine and drought, but always with a rational check to avoid sacrificing individual rights and to evaluate moral choices using reason. Practical wisdom is essential. The Somali proverb, sidee xeero lagu xagtaa ilkana ku nabad qabaan “How can one scrape the bowl and still keep their teeth safe?” captures the tension between short-term gains such as self-enrichment and long-term collective well-being. Reason enables reflection on this relationship, helping individuals choose restraint over impulsive reaction, whether in overgrazing, corruption, or clan conflict. Moral education, then, is less about transmitting rules and more about cultivating moral perception, the ability to see clearly the stakes and appropriate responses in complex situations. Somali morality isn’t broken but incomplete. Its ability to promote group unity and empathy is a strength, yet it becomes a weakness without universal constraints. To improve, it should be complemented by rational, universal values that expand moral concern beyond family ties. This involves early lessons in self-reflection and moral evaluation, as well as institutions that serve all, whether they are Laandheere or Laangaab , equally. Education must foster practical wisdom, and culture should shift toward embracing responsible interdependence. The real question isn’t if Somali morality can evolve, but if Somalis will prioritize reason over impulse, universal justice over clan loyalty, and long-term prosperity over immediate gains. The way forward is challenging yet straightforward: the moral principles that upheld communities during the war need reform to foster peace, not just through emotional appeals, but through thoughtful, rational engagement with what justice demands for all Somalis. Dr. Ahmed Hassan, LPCC Email: ahmedhassan01@yahoo.com The post The Dual Framework of Somali Moral Psychology appeared first on WardheerNews .

It promotes a concept called “responsible interdependence,” a balanced virtue that opposes both extreme tribalism and authoritarian nationalism, fostering personal responsibility while maintaining the advantages of cooperation among diverse groups. Reason also broadens moral concern beyond the clan. Guided by principles of individual dignity and universal rights, reason argues that if I have rights to justice and fairness, I should extend those rights to others. It helps prevent sacrificing individuals for leaders’ gain. Although I argue that reason is needed to address the moral challenges Somalis are struggling with, emotions such as empathy still play an important role in morality. Therefore, the way forward involves “moral pluralism,” acknowledging that different situations demand different ethical approaches; for example, emotions like empathy can be more suitable during crises like famine and drought, but always with a rational check to avoid sacrificing individual rights and to evaluate moral choices using reason. Practical wisdom is essential. The Somali proverb, sidee xeero lagu xagtaa ilkana ku nabad qabaan “How can one scrape the bowl and still keep their teeth safe?” captures the tension between short-term gains such as self-enrichment and long-term collective well-being. Reason enables reflection on this relationship, helping individuals choose restraint over impulsive reaction, whether in overgrazing, corruption, or clan conflict. Moral education, then, is less about transmitting rules and more about cultivating moral perception, the ability to see clearly the stakes and appropriate responses in complex situations. Somali morality isn’t broken but incomplete. Its ability to promote group unity and empathy is a strength, yet it becomes a weakness without universal constraints. To improve, it should be complemented by rational, universal values that expand moral concern beyond family ties. This involves early lessons in self-reflection and moral evaluation, as well as institutions that serve all, whether they are Laandheere or Laangaab , equally. Education must foster practical wisdom, and culture should shift toward embracing responsible interdependence. The real question isn’t if Somali morality can evolve, but if Somalis will prioritize reason over impulse, universal justice over clan loyalty, and long-term prosperity over immediate gains. The way forward is challenging yet straightforward: the moral principles that upheld communities during the war need reform to foster peace, not just through emotional appeals, but through thoughtful, rational engagement with what justice demands for all Somalis. items.description: Baydhabo (Raxanreeb Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa guddoomiyey shir looga hadlay xaaladda amniga guud ee deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan amniga iyo xasilloonida magaalada Baydhabo. Shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray qiimeynta xaaladda amni ee magaalada Baydhabo iyo guud ahaan deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo warbixinno laga dhageystay mas’uuliyiinta iyo saraakiisha amniga ee ka qeybgalay shirka. Hoggaamiyaha ayaa faray hay’adaha amniga in la xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta, feejignaanta iyo howlaha lagu sugayo amniga shacabka, iyadoo mudnaan gaar ah la siinayo ilaalinta nabadgelyada iyo badqabka bulshada. Sidoo kale waxaa shirka lagu adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in ciidamada amniga ay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan bulshada, si loo xaqiijiyo xasilloonida iyo amniga Magaalada Baydhabo iyo guud ahaan deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed. Hoggaamiyaha oonfur Galbeed ayaa ku boorriyey hay’adaha amniga in ay sii laba-jibaaraan dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida, isla markaana shacabka ay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan ciidamada amniga. Kulanka waxaa ka qeybgalay Wasiirka Amniga, Wasiiru-Dowlaha Madaxtooyada, Agaasimaha Madaxtooyada, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka XDS iyo saraakiisha kala duwan hay’adda amniga ee ka howlgala deeganada Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. items.title: Puntland iyo Mareykanka oo sheegay inay burburiyeen bakhaar hub oo Al-Shabaab leedahay
items.description: Maamulka Puntland iyo Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in si guul leh loo fuliyay howlgal ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab oo ka dhacay buuraha Al-Madow-Golis , gaar ahaan deegaanka Markad , halkaas oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday goob lagu keydinayay hub iyo saanad ciidan. Sida lagu sheegay war kasoo baxay dhinacyada howlgalka, ciidamada ayaa weeraray goob ay sheegeen in Al-Shabaab u adeegsanaysay kaydinta hubka iyo rasaasta , kuwaas oo loogu talagalay taageeridda howlgallada kooxda iyo weerarrada ay ka fuliso Soomaaliya. Howlgalka ayaa la sheegay inuu dhacay iyadoo la kaashanayo oo lala xiriirinayo hay’adaha amniga Puntland , waxaana Mareykanka iyo Puntland ay ku tilmaameen tallaabadan qayb ka mid ah howlgallo ballaaran oo lagu wiiqayo awoodda Al-Shabaab ee waqooyiga Soomaaliya. Labada dhinac ayaa sheegay in bartilmaameedsiga goobaha lagu kaydiyo hubka iyo kaabayaasha kale ee taageera shabakadaha hubeysan uu yareynayo awoodda kooxda ee qorsheynta iyo fulinta weerarrada . Puntland iyo Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in howlgalka uu qayb ka yahay dadaal joogto ah oo lagu wiiqayo awoodda Al-Shabaab, looga hortagayo in kooxda ay hesho goobo ay ku dhuumato, isla markaana lagu taageerayo xasilloonida iyo nabadda muddada dheer ee waqooyiga iyo bariga Soomaaliya.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo cambaareeysay weerarka Xuutiyiinta ay ku qadeen Sacuudiga
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) War qoraal oo ay soo saartay wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay in Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya si adag u cambaaraynayso isku daygii lagu doonayay in diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn lagu bartilmaameedsado magaalada barakeysan ee Makkah iyo weerarradii u dambeeyay ee lagu qaaday deegaanno rayid ah oo ka tirsan Boqortooyada Sacuudiga. Wasaaradda ayaa intaas ku dartay in Soomaaliya si buuxda u garab taagan tahay Boqortooyada Sacuudiga oo uu “hogaamiya khaadimka Labada Masjid ee Barakaysan”, lagu sheegay warsaxaafadeedka. Shalay ayey ahayd markii ay Dowladda Sacuudigu ay ku eedeesay in dagaallayannada Xuutiyiinta ee Yeman ka dagaallama ay isku dayeen in ay weeraraan magaalooyinka Makka iyo Madiina, taas oo ay in ay soo rideyn diyaarad aan duuliye ahayn oo ku socotay dhankaas. Dhanka, Xuutiyiinta ayaa iska beeniyey, kuna tilmaamay in ay tahay arrin been abuur ah. items.title: In ka badan 3,000 oo Yemeni ah oo qaxooti ah ayaa gaaray xeebaha Jabuuti
items.description: In ka badan 3,000 oo qaxooti Yemeni ah , oo u badan haween iyo carruur, ayaa gaaray xeebaha waqooyi ee dalka Jabuuti, gaar ahaan nawaaxiga Obock , kadib markii ay ka gudbeen marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab iyagoo raadinaya badbaado iyo meel ay uga cararaan xaaladaha adag ee ka jira Yemen. Qaxootigan ayaa ka mid ah dadka Yemeniyiinta ah ee ka tallaaba marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, kaas oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iyagoo u gudbaya dhanka Geeska Afrika. Hay’adda Qatar Charity ayaa bilowday gurmad bani’aadamnimo oo degdeg ah oo loogu talagalay qaxootiga cusub ee gaaray Jabuuti. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay inay hal milyan oo doollar ($1 milyan) u qoondeysay marxaladda hore ee gurmadka, iyadoo lacagtaas lagu bixinayo baahiyaha aasaasiga ah ee qaxootiga. Gargaarka waxaa ka mid ah hoy degdeg ah, bustayaal iyo dhar, cunto , iyo sidoo kale biyo nadiif ah oo la cabbo iyo adeegyada fayadhowrka. Waxaa sidoo kale la qorsheeyay in qaxootiga la gaarsiiyo daryeel caafimaad oo aasaasi ah iyo taageero dhinaca nafaqada ah , gaar ahaan hooyooyinka iyo carruurta oo ka mid ah dadka sida weyn ugu nugul xaaladaha bani’aadamnimo.

items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo la kulmay Saraakiisha Militariga iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa Madaxtooyada Magaalada Baydhabo ku qaabilay Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa laamaha amniga ee maamulkiisa. Shirka ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar, Taliyaha Qaybta 60aad, G/dhexe Isaaq Aadan Berdaale, Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Isaaq Maxamed Isaaq (Koosaar), Taliyaha Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Baay, Korneyl Mukhtaar Maxamed Dugudow iyo xubno kale. War Khamiistan ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa lagu sheegay in Aadan Madoobe uu shir guddoomiyay shir looga hadlayay amniga deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan Magaalada Baydhabo. “Shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray qiimeynta xaaladda amni ee Magaalada Baydhabo iyo guud ahaan deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo warbixinno laga dhageystay masuuliyiinta iyo saraakiisha amniga ee ka qaybgalay shirka.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. “Hoggaamiyaha ayaa faray hay’adaha amniga in la xoojiyo wada-shaqaynta, feejignaanta iyo howlaha lagu sugayo amniga shacabka, iyadoo mudnaan gaar ah la siinayo ilaalinta nabadgelyada iyo badqabka bulshada.” Ayaa lagu sheegay warka. Warka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Sidoo kale waxaa shirka lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in ciidamada amniga ay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan bulshada, si loo xaqiijiyo xasilloonida iyo amniga Magaalada Baydhabo iyo guud ahaan deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed.” Shirka ayaa imanaya, iyadoo uu socdo diyaargarow ku aaddan abaabulka cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed, oo la doonayo in ay hawlgal sifayn ah ka bilaabaan deegaanada hoostaga Baydhabo. Aadan Madoobe ayaa dadaal ugu jira in ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen) iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab laga fogeeyo nawaaxiga magaaladaasi.

items.title: IGAD Iyo AUSSOM Oo Ka Digay Maalgelin-Yari Carqaladeyn Karta Howlgalka Soomaaliya
items.description: IGAD iyo hoggaanka Howlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya AUSSOM ayaa walaac ka muujiyey caqabadaha dhaqaale iyo kuwa saadka ee horyaalla howlgalka. IGAD waxay Qaramada Midoobay iyo saaxiibbada caalamiga ah ka dalbatay maalgelin joogto ah, la saadaalin karo oo waarta. Taliyaha ciidamada AUSSOM, Jeneraal Sam Kavuma, ayaa sheegay in Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Taageerada Soomaaliya—UNSOS—uu bixiyo qiyaastii 85% taageerada saadka ee howlgalka. DF oo garab istaag wayn u muujisay Sacuudiga kadib weerarkii Xuutiyiinta Yemen
items.description: Makkah (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si kulul uga hadashay weerar culus oo Talaadadii kooxda Xuutiyiinta ay ku qaadeen magaalada barakeysan Makkah Al-Mukarramah ee dalka Sacuudiga. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa si adag loogu cambaareeyay weerarkan oo loo adeegsaday diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, kaas oo ay ka hortageen ciidamada difaaca dalka Sacuudiga “Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay si adag u cambaareyneysaa isku dayga weerarkii diyaaradda aan duuliyaha lahayn ee lagu qaaday magaalada barakeysan ee Makkah Al-Mukarramah, kaas oo ay Ciidamada Difaaca Cirka ee Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya ku qabteen kuna burburiyeen ka hor inta uusan gaarin magaalada Makkah,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Sidoo kale, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u cambaareysay weerarradii dhowaan lagu qaaday goobaha rayidka ah ee ku yaalla Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, iyadoo muujisay garab istaag buuxa oo ay la garab taagan tahay dowladda iyo shacabka Sacuudiga. “Dowladda Soomaaliyeed waxay muujineysaa garab istaag buuxa oo ay la garab taagan tahay Boqortooyada walaalaha ah ee Sacuudi Carabiya, oo uu hoggaamiyo Khadiimka Labada Masjid ee Barakeysan, waxayna sidoo kale xaqiijineysaa xaqa ay Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya u leedahay inay difaacdo dhulkeeda, dadkeeda iyo goobaha barakeysan ee Islaamkam,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Si kastaba, Riyadh ayaa dhankeeda dhacdadan ku tilmaantay mid ka gudubtay “khad cas”, maadaama ay khatar gelin karto goobaha barakeysan ee Muslimiinta. Xuutiyiinta ayaa beeniyay inay Makka bartilmaameedsadeen, iyagoo ku eedeeyay Sacuudiga inuu arrintaas u adeegsanayo dacaayad dagaal Arrimahan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo uu sii xoogeysanayo d agaalka u dhaxeeya Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta, waxaana haatan diyaaradaha dagaalka Sacuudiga ay duqeymo culus ka wadaan gudaha Yemen, halka Xuutiyiintuna ay gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weerareen bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla gudaha Sacuudiga. Xiisadda cusub ayaa sidoo kale timid kadib markii Xuutiyiinta oo ay taageerto Iran ay toddobaadkii lasoo dhaafay horumar degdeg ah ka sameeyeen xeebaha Badda Cas ee dalka Yemen, iyagoo la wareegay magaalooyin iyo jasiirado muhiim ah oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. items.title: Dowladda Jabuuti oo baaq deg deg ah u dirtay beesha caalamka xilli ay wajaheyso….
items.description: Jabuuti (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Jabuuti ayaa beesha caalamka ugu baaqday inay si degdeg ah gargaar uga geysato qulqulka sii kordhaya ee dadka Yemen ka soo cararaya, iyadoo sheegtay in tirada dadka soo galaya dalka ay durba ka badan tahay awoodda ay dowladdu ku maareyn karto. Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Jabuuti, Cumar Cabdi Saciid, ayaa sheegay in in ka badan 2,500 oo qof oo Yemeni ah ay dalka soo gaareen tan iyo Khamiistii toddobaadkii hore. “Waxaan filaynaa in tirada dadka barakacay ay toddobaadyada soo socda gaarto ku dhowaad 10,000,” ayuu Saciid sheegay Arbacadii. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in qulqulka dadka soo galaya Jabuuti uu cadaadis weyn saarayo adeegyada iyo awoodda dalka, xilli ay sidoo kale sii yaraaneyso maalgelinta caalamiga ah ee loogu talagalay arrimaha bani’aadannimada. “Qulqulka muhaajiriinta wuxuu durba ka sarre maray awooddeena qaran, waxaana wajahaynaa cadaadis sii kordhaya iyadoo maalgelinta caalamiga ah ay hoos u dhacayso,” ayuu yiri. “Waxaan ugu baaqeynaa Qaramada Midoobay iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah inay si degdeg ah u abaabulaan dhaqaale u dhigma baaxadda dhibaatada.” Dadkan ayaa ka soo cararaya dagaallo culus oo ka socda galbeedka Yemen, kuwaas oo u dhaxeeya Xuutiyiinta ay Iran taageerto iyo dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, oo taageero ka heleysa Sacuudi Carabiya. Jabuuti ayaa si toos ah uga soo horjeedda Yemen, iyadoo labada dal ay kala qeybiso Badda Cas, taas oo ka dhigeysa dalka mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu dhow ee ay gaari karaan dadka ka baxsanaya dagaallada. Xiisadda cusub ayaa sii xumeyneysa xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Yemen, oo horey uga mid ahayd dalalka ugu saboolsan Bariga Dhexe. In ka badan 4.5 milyan oo qof ayaa gudaha Yemen ku barakacay tan iyo markii isbahaysiga uu hoggaamiyo Sacuudi Carabiya uu sanadkii 2015 ku biiray dagaalka sokeeye ee dalkaas. Dagaallada cusub ayaa hadda dhalinaya cabsi laga qabo barakac hor leh oo gudaha Yemen ah, iyo in dad badan ay isku dayaan inay dalka ka baxaan. Xafiiska Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Socdaalka ee IOM ee Jabuuti ayaa sheegay in shaqaalaheeda iyo mas’uuliyiinta maxalliga ah ay ku sugan yihiin goobaha ay dadka Yemeniyiinta ahi ka soo degayaan, iyagoo siinaya cunto iyo biyo. Isuduwaha gurmadka IOM ee Jabuuti, Safiya Ibraahim, ayaa sheegtay in maalin kasta ay dalka soo gaarayaan haween, carruur, dhallaanka iyo dad xanuunsan. Waxay sheegtay in hay’addu u baahan tahay taageero dhaqaale oo dheeraad ah si ay u sii waddo howlaha gargaarka ee dadka soo galaya dalka. Jabuuti, oo ka mid ah dalalka ugu yar qaaradda Afrika, ayaa waxaa ku nool dad ka yar 1.2 milyan, taas oo sii kordhineysa walaaca laga qabo awoodda dalka uu ku qaabili karo kumannaan qof oo dheeraad ah haddii dagaallada Yemen ay sii socdaan. items.title: Mareykanka oo kordhiyay xayiraadda fiisaha madaxda Falastiin
items.description: Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa muddo kordhisay cunaqabateynta dhanka fiisaha ah ee lagu soo rogay mas’uuliyiinta Maamulka Falastiin (PA) iyo xubno ka tirsan Ururka Xoreynta Falastiin (PLO), taas oo ka hor istaageysa qaar ka mid ah madaxda Falastiin inay u safraan magaalada New York xilli uu soo dhowaanayo shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Go’aanka ayaa si gaar ah u saameynaya Madaxweynaha Falastiin Mahmoud Abbas , kaas oo sannadkii labaad oo xiriir ah laga hor istaagayo inuu dalka Mareykanka u safro si uu uga qeyb galo kalfadhiga Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee toddobaadka soo socda. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in tallaabadan loo sababeeyay waxa ay ku tilmaantay dib-u-habeyn la’aanta Maamulka Falastiin , iyadoo sidoo kale ku eedeysay PA iyo PLO inay qaadeen tallaabooyin Washington u aragto kuwo wiiqaya fursadaha nabadda. Mareykanka ayaa si gaar ah u sheegay in Maamulka Falastiin uu ku xadgudbay shuruucda Mareykanka isagoo raadinaya aqoonsi caalami ah oo loo sameeyo dowlad Falastiin ah oo aan ku imaan wada-hadallo toos ah oo lala yeesho Israa’iil. Washinton  waxay sidoo kale ku eedeysay PA inay murannadeeda Israa’iil u gudbisay maxkamadaha caalamiga ah iyo inay bixiso lacago ay Mareykanka iyo Israel ku tilmaamaan kuwo la siiyo dad loo xukumay weerarro iyo qoysaskooda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xafiiska wakiillada Falastiin ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa weli loo oggolaaday inuu sii shaqeeyo , iyadoo shaqaalaha caadiga ah ee xafiiska ay haystaan ka-dhaafitaan ku saleysan heshiiska xarunta Qaramada Midoobay, inkastoo mas’uuliyiin gaar ah laga mamnuucay inay galaan Mareykanka. Mahmoud Abbas ayaa la filayay inuu khudbaddiisa Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay xoogga ku saaro dadaallada lagu doonayo aqoonsi caalami ah oo loo sameeyo dowlad Falastiin ah , iyo dib u soo nooleynta xalka labada dowladood. Arrintan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli dhowr dowladood oo reer Galbeed ah, oo ay ku jiraan Boqortooyada Midowday, Faransiiska iyo Kanada , ay bishan qaadeen tallaabooyin ku saabsan aqoonsiga dowladnimada Falastiin.

items.title: Muxuu u kala duwan yahay qiimaha shidaalka dalalka kale ee Afrika?
items.description: Dhammaan dalalka qaaradda Afrika ma aha kuwo hodan ku ah saliidda, waxa ay kasoo dhoofsadaan qaaradaha kale. Qaar ka mid ah dalalka ayaa ku tiirsan inay shidaalka la sifeeyey ka soo dhoofiyaan dalal kale, halka qaar kalena ay haystaan kayd badan oo saliid ceeriin ah, aysan lahayn warshado sifeeya oo ku filan baahida gudaha. Dalalka ay ka mid yihiin Nigeria, Koonfur Afrika, Liibiya iyo Suudaan ayaa hodan ku ah saliidda, inkastoo qaar ka mid ah ay wajahaan caqabado waaweyn oo dhanka shidaalka ah. items.title: IGAD Oo Ka Digtay Cunno-Yari Saameysay 49 Milyan
items.description: Warbixin ay soo saartay IGAD ayaa sheegtay in ku dhowaad 49 milyan oo qof oo ku nool Bariga Afrika ay wajahayaan cunno-yari ba’an. Abaaraha soo noqnoqday, isbeddelka cimilada iyo colaadaha ayaa lagu tilmaamay sababaha ugu waaweyn, halka in ka badan 19 milyan oo qof ay ku barakacsan yihiin gudaha dalalkooda. Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Khayre, ayaa dhanka kale dowladda federaalka ku eedeeyey inay ku guuldarreysatay inay mudnaan ku filan siiso xaaladda bani’aadannimo iyo dadka barakacayaasha ah. Wuxuu ku baaqay in la kordhiyo taageerada la gaarsiinayo qoysaska ay saameeyeen colaadaha iyo masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah. Khayre ayaa soo xigtay xog sheegaysa in Soomaaliya ay ku nool yihiin ku dhowaad 4.8 milyan oo qof oo gargaar u baahan, halka 30.7% oo keliya laga helay dhaqaalihii loo baahnaa. Tirada 49-ka milyan waa wadarta dalalka ay warbixintu daboolayso, mana aha tiro Soomaaliya u gaar ah, balse waxaa la wadaaga dalalka kale ee gobolka.

items.title: Sacuudi Carabiya oo bixisay jawaab culus iyo dagaalka Xuutiyiinta oo xoogeystay
items.description: Jabuuti (Caasimada Online) – Dagaalka u dhaxeeya Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa si weyn u sii xoogeysanaya, iyadoo diyaaradaha dagaalka Sacuudiga ay duqeymo culus ka fuliyeen gudaha Yemen, halka Xuutiyiintuna ay gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weerareen bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla gudaha Sacuudiga. Xiisadda cusub ayaa timid kadib markii Xuutiyiinta oo ay taageerto Iran ay toddobaadkii lasoo dhaafay horumar degdeg ah ka sameeyeen xeebaha Badda Cas ee Yemen, iyagoo la wareegay magaalooyin iyo jasiirado muhiim ah oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Kooxda ayaa sidoo kale baahisay muuqaallo laga soo duubay goobaha dagaalka oo muujinaya dagaalyahannadeeda oo gacanta ku dhigaya gaadiid gaashaaman oo ay lahaayeen ciidamada Yemen ee uu Sacuudigu taageero. Muuqaallada ayaa sidoo kale muujinayay diyaarado dagaal oo dul heehaabaya iyo qaraxyo waaweyn oo ka dhacaya dhulka saxaraha ah. Afhayeenka militariga Xuutiyiinta, Yahya Saree, ayaa Arbacadii sheegay in kooxdu ay weerarro cusub oo gantaallo iyo diyaarado drone ah ku qaaday magaalada dekedda leh ee Yanbu, oo xarun muhiim u ah dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga, iyo saldhigga cirka ee Khamis Mushait ee koonfurta dalka. Saree ma sheegin waqtiga ay weerarradaasi dhaceen. Sacuudiga ayaa Talaadadii digniino amni ka soo saaray magaalooyin badan oo dalkaas ah, oo ay ku jireen goobaha ay Xuutiyiintu sheegeen inay bartilmaameedsadeen. Mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga iyo shirkadda shidaalka ee Aramco ayaan markiiba ka jawaabin codsiyo loo diray oo ku saabsanaa weerarrada. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay soo rideen diyaarad dagaal oo Sacuudigu leeyahay oo nooca F-15 ah, hase yeeshee ma aysan soo bandhigin caddeyn degdeg ah oo xaqiijineysa sheegashadaas. Saree ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Sacuudigu toddobaadkan Yemen ka fuliyeen illaa 450 duqeyn. Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda Yemen ee uu Sacuudigu taageero, taas oo maamusha koonfurta dalka, ayaa qiray in ciidamadooda iyo kuwa Sacuudiga ay duqeynayaan fariisimaha Xuutiyiinta, inkastoo Riyadh aysan si rasmi ah u xaqiijin tirada duqeymaha. Xuutiyiinta ayaa maalmihii lasoo dhaafay dhowr jeer weerarro ku qaaday gudaha Sacuudiga, taas oo digniino hawada ah ka dhalisay magaalooyin ku yaalla koonfurta iyo galbeedka boqortooyada. Sacuudiga ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in difaaciisa cirka uu soo riday diyaarad drone ah oo Xuutiyiintu leeyihiin xilli ay ku sii jeedday dhanka magaalada barakeysan ee Makka, ka hor inta aysan gelin hawada mamnuuca ah ee magaalada. Riyadh ayaa dhacdadaas ku tilmaantay mid ka gudubtay “khad cas”, maadaama ay khatar gelin karto goobaha barakeysan ee Muslimiinta. Xuutiyiinta ayaa beeniyay inay Makka bartilmaameedsadeen, iyagoo ku eedeeyay Sacuudiga inuu arrintaas u adeegsanayo dacaayad dagaal. Xiisadda ayaa sidoo kale ku sii fideysa kaabayaasha tamarta ee Sacuudiga. Weerar todobaadkii hore lagu eedeeyay kooxo Iran taageerto oo ka howlgala Ciraaq ayaa hakad geliyay dhuumaha shidaalka ee Bariga-Galbeed ee Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo muhiim u ah in shidaalka looga wareejiyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz marka uu khalkhal galo. Hakadka ku yimid dhuumahaas ayaa sii kordhiyay walaaca laga qabo sahayda shidaalka caalamka, xilli dagaalka gobolka uu horey u carqaladeeyay isu socodka maraakiibta ee marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Ganacsatada shidaalka ayaa sheegay in haddii dhuumaha Sacuudiga ay muddo dheer xirnaadaan, ay saameyn karaan sahay u dhiganta ilaa afar boqolkiiba shidaalka caalamka. Sacuudiga wali ma shaacin waqtiga ay dhuumahaasi dib ugu soo laaban doonaan shaqada caadiga ah, hase yeeshee Xoghayaha Tamarta Mareykanka Chris Wright ayaa Talaadadii sheegay inuu filayo in shidaalku uu mar kale dhex maro dhuumaha maalmo gudahood. Kulanka Mareykanka iyo Xuutiyiinta Dagaalka cusub ayaa sidoo kale Mareykanka ku qasbaya inuu si taxaddar leh uga fiirsado doorkiisa gobolka. Washington ayaa adkeysay digniinteeda safarka ee Sacuudiga, iyadoo shaqaalaha dowladda Mareykanka laga mamnuucay inay u safraan meel 20 mayl u jirta xadka Yemen. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa Reuters u sheegay in mas’uuliyiin Mareykan ah ay dhammaadkii toddobaadka kulan qarsoodi ah kula yeesheen wakiillo ka socda Xuutiyiinta magaalada Muscat ee dalka Cumaan. Xuutiyiinta ayaa kulankaas ku sheegay inaysan damacsaneyn inay weeraraan maraakiibta Mareykanka, isla markaana ay weli ku dheggan yihiin heshiiskii xabbad-joojinta ee ay Washington la galeen sanadkii hore. Mareykanka ayaa muddo laba bilood ah duqeymo ku qaaday Xuutiyiinta sanadkii 2025, ka hor inta uusan Madaxweyne Donald Trump ku dhawaaqin heshiis lagu joojinayo weerarrada ay kooxdu ku hayso maraakiibta. Dhanka kale, Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Mohammed bin Salman ayaa toddobaadkii hore telefoon kula hadlay Trump, isagoo dalbaday taageero militari oo Mareykan ah. Taageerada Washington ilaa hadda ayaa inta badan ku koobneyd dhinaca sirdoonka. Sacuudiga ayaa hoggaaminayay isbaheysi dagaal kula jira Xuutiyiinta tan iyo 2015. Dagaalka Yemen ayaa sannadihii dambe aad u yaraaday kadib heshiisyo xabbad-joojin ah, balse mar kale ayuu qarxay kadib markii Xuutiyiintu bishii July ku dhawaaqeen go’doomin badeed oo ka dhan ah Sacuudiga, isla markaana bilaabeen weerarro ka dhan ah gudaha boqortooyada. Dagaallada ayaa bishan sii xoogaystay kadib markii Xuutiyiintu dib u riixeen ciidamada taabacsan dowladda Yemen ee uu Sacuudigu taageero, iyagoo qabsaday dhul ballaaran oo ku teedsan xeebaha Badda Cas iyo goobo istiraatiiji ah oo ku dhow Bab al-Mandab. Horumarka Xuutiyiinta iyo weerarrada lagu hayo kaabayaasha shidaalka Sacuudiga ayaa hadda cabsi cusub ku abuuraya suuqyada tamarta, maadaama dagaalka Yemen uu ku soo biiray qalalaasaha ballaaran ee Bariga Dhexe. Waxaana Washington hortaalla xaalad adag: inay ka fogaato faragelin militari oo cusub, iyadoo halis u ah in Xuutiyiintu sii xoogaystaan oo qalalaasaha shidaalku kasii daro, ama inay taageero militari oo toos ah siiso Sacuudiga, taas oo Mareykanka gelin karta furin kale oo dagaalka gobolka ah. items.title: Ciidanka Danab oo qabtay rag waday qaraxyo culus
items.description: Leego (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno kala duwan ayaa kasoo baxaya howlgal qorsheysan oo maanta ciidamada kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka, gaar ahaan ururka 161-aad, ay ka sameeeyeen deegaanka Leego ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, kaas oo lagu beegsaday kooxda Al-Shabaab. Ciidamada ayaa fashiliyey qorshe ay Khawaarijtu doonayeen in ay miinooyin ku aasaan waddooyinka ay isticmaalaan shacabka gaar ahaan jidadka isku xira gobollada Shabeellaha Hoose iyo Baay ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa lagu sheegay in sidoo kale ciidamada ay nolosha ku qabteen qaar kamid ah raggii qaraxyada ku aasayay halkaasi, kuwaas oo haatan baaritaano ay ku socdaan. “Intii uu socday howlgalka, Ciidanka Danab ayaa sidoo kale qabtay xubno ka tirsan shabakad ku howlanayd abaabulka iyo diyaarinta qaraxyada, kuwaas oo qorsheynayey in ay waxyeello u geystaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo dadka isticmaala waddooyinka,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa sidoo kale weli sii wada howlgallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga, laguna burburinayo shabakadaha kooxda Al-Shabaab ee khatarta ku haya shacabka. Dhanka kale ma jiro illaa iyo hadda wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay dhinaca Al-Shabaab oo ku aadan howlgalladaas ee ay guulaha ka sheegatay dowladda Soomaaliya, welina kasii socda gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Gobolkan waxaa weli ku xoogan Al-Shabaab oo weeraro culus kasoo abaabula halkaasi, kuwaas inta badan ay ku beegsadaan xarumaha ciidamada. The post Ciidanka Danab oo qabtay rag waday qaraxyo culus appeared first on Caasimada Online .

War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa lagu sheegay in sidoo kale ciidamada ay nolosha ku qabteen qaar kamid ah raggii qaraxyada ku aasayay halkaasi, kuwaas oo haatan baaritaano ay ku socdaan. “Intii uu socday howlgalka, Ciidanka Danab ayaa sidoo kale qabtay xubno ka tirsan shabakad ku howlanayd abaabulka iyo diyaarinta qaraxyada, kuwaas oo qorsheynayey in ay waxyeello u geystaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo dadka isticmaala waddooyinka,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa sidoo kale weli sii wada howlgallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga, laguna burburinayo shabakadaha kooxda Al-Shabaab ee khatarta ku haya shacabka. Dhanka kale ma jiro illaa iyo hadda wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay dhinaca Al-Shabaab oo ku aadan howlgalladaas ee ay guulaha ka sheegatay dowladda Soomaaliya, welina kasii socda gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Gobolkan waxaa weli ku xoogan Al-Shabaab oo weeraro culus kasoo abaabula halkaasi, kuwaas inta badan ay ku beegsadaan xarumaha ciidamada. The post Ciidanka Danab oo qabtay rag waday qaraxyo culus appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Waxgaradka Beesha Xawaadle Oo Dalbaday Hakinta Doorashada HirShabeelle iyo IGAD oo Ku Baaqday Wada-Hadal Qaran
items.description: Waxgarad, odayaal dhaqameed iyo siyaasiyiin ka tirsan beesha Xawaadle ayaa kulan ballaaran oo ay ku yeesheen Beledweyne kaga dalbaday in la hakiyo howlaha doorashada HirShabeelle, waxayna sheegeen in hakinta loo baahan yahay inta xal siyaasadeed laga gaarayo tabashooyinka ka jira gobolka Hiiraan. Ka qayb-galayaasha kulanka ayaa ku dooday in hannaanka doorashada ee hadda socda uusan si buuxda uga tarjumin rabitaanka bulshada deegaanka. Waxay ku baaqeen hannaan ku dhisan caddaalad, matalaad dhab ah iyo awood-qaybsi ay ku qanci karaan dhammaan dhinacyada wadaaga maamulka HirShabeelle. Dhanka kale, IGAD ayaa madaxda Dowladda Federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo saamileyda siyaasadda Soomaaliya ugu baaqday wada-hadal qaran oo loo dhan yahay. Baaqa ururka wuxuu khuseeyaa xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo doorashooyinka Soomaaliya guud ahaan, mana ahayn hindise si gaar ah loogu dhex-dhexaadinayo muranka HirShabeelle. Baaqa waxgaradka Xawaadle ayaa imaanaya xilli dhowaan  ururka JSP uu shaaciyay in madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe uu yahay murashaxooda doorashada Hirshabeelle, islamarkaana siyaasiyiinta iyo waxgaradka Hiiraan ay arrintaas ka biya diideen.

items.title: Dowladda Oo Sheegtay In Dakhliga Gudaha Laba Jibaarmay Afar Sano Gudahood
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in dakhliga gudaha uu laba jibaarmay afartii sano ee u dambeysay. Wasiirka Maaliyadda, Biixi Iimaan Cige, ayaa kororka u sababeeyey hirgelinta nidaamka canshuuraha SOMCAS, adeegyada canshuuraha dhijitaalka ah iyo dib-u-habeynta maamulka maaliyadda guud. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay in dowlad-goboleedyadu heleen taageeradii maaliyadeed ee ugu badnayd intii lagu jiray sannadkii 2025. Wuxuu tilmaamay in dowladda federaalku ay doonayso in dakhliga iyo kheyraadka qaranka loo adeegsado xoojinta adeegyada bulshada ee gobollada dalka. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inaysan qaadan deyn cusub tan iyo markii Soomaaliya loo dhammeystiray barnaamijka deyn-cafinta. Wasaaradda Maaliyadda ayaa sheegtay inay diyaarinayso istiraatiijiyad iyo sharciyo lagu nidaaminayo amaah kasta oo mustaqbalka loo qaato horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha. xogta la shaaciyey kuma jirin jadwal muujinaya dakhliga sannad kasta, ilaha kororka ama lacagaha la gaarsiiyey dowlad-goboleed kasta.

items.title: US counterterrorism officials are replicating their Pakistan mistakes in Somaliland
items.description: The idea that supporting Somaliland means sacrificing Somalia’s cooperation rests on foolish assumptions and inherently highlights how poor the partnership with Mogadishu is. By Michael Rubin, Middle East Forum President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi (“Irro”) continues his visit to the United States, with a heavy schedule of government and think tank meetings in Washington.Still, the drive for U.S. recognition of Somaliland appears to be stalled. While the Trump administration remains tight-lipped, insiders place the blame on two offices: One is Deputy Secretary of State Chris Landau, who, short of being told otherwise, is unwilling to buck a Mogadishu-centric policy that dates to Secretary of State Hillary Clinton. The other block reportedly is the National Security Council’s counterterrorism office. Officials there worry that recognition of Somaliland will undercut ongoing U.S. counterterrorism cooperation with Somalia. The U.S. military long has deployed trainers and special operators to Somalia to bolster that country’s fight against Al Shabaab and to help support African Union peacekeepers. While President Donald Trump withdrew U.S. forces from Somalia during his first term, President Joe Biden returned them after he took office. There reportedly are small contingents of U.S. troops at the Baledogle airfield, an old Italian base, inland from Mogadishu, and some U.S. personnel reportedly operate in the Halane compound area they share with the United Nations and African Union missions. There also reportedly are some Navy SEALS and other special operators in Bosaso and Kismayo. There have been, at least temporarily, U.S. personnel in Baidoa, Dhusamareb, and Jowhar. Inaddition, U.S. military and intelligence officials increasingly support the counterterrorism mission from Camp Lemonier in Djibouti, Kenya, and Somaliland itself. There have been two main targets for U.S. action: the Islamic State encampment in the Golis Mountains in Puntland, near Bosaso, and the broader fight against Al Shabaab. The idea that supporting Somaliland means sacrificing Somalia’s cooperation rests on foolish assumptions and inherently highlights how poor the partnership with Mogadishu is. First, consider Puntland and the fight against the Islamic State. Puntland resents the federal government in Mogadishu because Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud—selected, rather than elected, and now past his constitutional term—rejects the federal rights of states like Puntland. Although Puntland and Somaliland are rivals and have a border dispute, they also cooperate. While Puntland remains in the federal government for now, Mogadishu’s centralization drive is as likely to force Puntland to follow Somaliland’s path as it is to bring Puntland to heel. Nor does it make sense that Puntland would stop assistance containing and countering the Islamic State. While some Somali officials and the Turkish intelligence officials who support them dream they can leverage the Islamic State against Somaliland, Puntland is unlikely to stop counterterrorism cooperation. Its capital, Garowe, is a sleepy, inland town, ironically dependent on Somaliland trade; Puntland’s broader economic future rests with its Bosaso port, located just 44 miles from the Islamic State Somaliland’s mountain headquarters. Somalia’s cooperation with Al Shabaab is trickier. While Al Shabaab threatens President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s appointed government, the president’s corruption ensures that even the U.S.-trained Danab Special Forces cannot win. Meanwhile, the Turkish-trained Gorgor unit is as likely to support Al Shabaab as to fight its members. Repeatedly, Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has shown himself more willing to deploy Somali forces against his political competitors or federal state challengers than to defeat the Islamists. Today, it is impossible to run a business or construct a building in Mogadishu without an Al Shabaab permit. Somalis are more willing to trust Al Shabaab justice than state courts due to the speed of operation and perceived lack of corruption. In effect, the pattern in Somalia now is akin to what the United States experiences in Pakistan. As Washington shelled out billions of dollars to support Pakistani counterterror efforts, it created a moral hazard in which continuation of lucrative military assistance required that Pakistani forces never completely defeat the Taliban, Al Qaeda, or other radial Deobandi groups. If the National Security Council believes defeating Al Shabaab requires sacrificing the aspirations of democratic, pro-West, and secure Somaliland and winning the good graces of a Mogadishu government that repeatedly has shown itself to be little more than a Chinese puppet and a Turkish satrapy, Americans will die. Counterterrorism cooperation and extortion are not synonymous. The only way to truly secure the Gulf of Aden and, eventually, roll back Al Shabaab’s gains in Somalia will be to recognize and partner with Somaliland, then to consolidate security in Puntland and Jubaland, and finally to extricate and then deal with Al Shabaab, despite Mogadishu rather than necessarily in partnership with it. Source Worldisraelnews

items.title: How Somalia’s Flag Was Sold to Turkey
items.description: By Isha Qarsoon On the night of September 9, 2026, drones struck a tugboat named TEDY near Odesa, Ukraine . The vessel was hit again as it tried to reach Constanta. Two Azerbaijani crew members were killed and two suffered burns. Its ten-person crew included Azerbaijani, Turkish, German and Ukrainian nationals. Mert Marine Corporation, a Turkish company, owned the tug. TEDY sailed under the Somali flag. No Somali was aboard. [1] Ukraine’s government blamed Russia and described the attack as part of a wider campaign against civilian shipping. Russia’s Defence Ministry said it had struck two cargo vessels and a tugboat near Odesa, alleging that the ships were carrying military supplies. It did not identify TEDY, and the connection between its statement and the attack has not been independently confirmed. Azerbaijan did not attribute responsibility. The competing accounts do not change the point. A Turkish-owned vessel with an entirely foreign crew carried Somali nationality into a European war. The attack does not prove that the registry was inappropriate. A ship under any flag can be attacked in a war. Also, a ship crew does not have to include nationals of the flag it is sailing under. The attack exposes, however, the scale of the risk Somalia accepted: within months of reviving its ship registry, Somali nationality appeared on a foreign-owned ship with a foreign crew operating in a European conflict. Somalia acquired the flag state’s legal duties and reputational exposure without acquiring control of the voyage. The Turkish ownership was not incidental: Turkish interests already run Somalia’s main port and airport, train and help command its military, hold rights to its offshore oil and fish stocks, and now operate the very registry that flagged TEDY in the first place. TEDY is the trigger for examining what happens when that system is abused. What a flag of convenience is The term flag of convenience entered common use in the 1950s. American owners had used Panama between the two world wars to avoid domestic taxes, labour rules and crewing requirements. Liberia opened its international registry in 1948, and Honduras later joined the historical group known as PanLibHon. A flag of convenience generally describes a vessel registered in a country other than the country of its beneficial ownership or commercial control, often to reduce costs or avoid stricter regulation. A 1970 British government inquiry identified six common features of flag of convenience: foreign ownership or control, easy registration and withdrawal, low taxation, a registry maintained mainly for fee income rather than national shipping needs, unrestricted foreign crews, and limited capacity or willingness to enforce shipping rules.[3] These are descriptive indicators, not a binding legal test. Somalia’s new registry displays several of those features. On March 30, 2026, Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur, then minister of ports and marine transport, signed a memorandum with Somali Ship Register Limited, represented by Turkish national Cagdas Oykun Saltas. On April 2, 2026, the government announced GUNEY as the first vessel admitted under the revived flag. It was foreign-owned or controlled, had just left the Honduran flag, and was registered while in Turkey.[2] The memorandum was signed on March 30, 2026, and Guney entered the register three days later, on April 2. That interval is too short for an owner unfamiliar with a newly created registry to locate it, complete a flag change out of Honduras, and clear administrative review. It indicates the vessel’s move to the Somali flag was arranged before the memorandum was signed, not decided afterward, which means the registry and its first customer were not two separate developments but one planned transaction presented as two. The September attack revealed that TEDY, another Turkish-owned vessel, was flying the Somali flag.[1] The public record establishes that Somalia opened its nationality to foreign shipping through a foreign private operator before publishing how that operator would be supervised. Private administration is not automatically disreputable. Liberia and the Marshall Islands show that an overseas administrator can coexist with effective state regulation. Somalia’s problem is the political setting. The registry entered a relationship in which Turkey and Turkish-linked bodies already occupy Somalia’s airport, port, military and maritime security, petroleum, fisheries licensing and prospective minerals.[8] In that setting, abuse cannot be treated as a remote possibility to be considered after the first scandal. It is the working risk that should govern the registry. The burden belongs on the government to prove that Somali officials can refuse, suspend and deregister a ship against Turkish commercial or political pressure. The duties stay with Somalia Article 91 of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea requires a genuine link between a ship and the state whose flag it flies. Article 94 requires the flag state to exercise effective jurisdiction and control over administrative, technical and social matters. Those duties include maintaining a register, enforcing safety and crewing standards, and investigating serious casualties.[4] A private registrar may process applications, collect fees and arrange surveys. It cannot take Somalia’s international responsibility with it. UNCLOS’s genuine-link rule offers less protection than its wording suggests. In M/V Saiga, the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea held that the absence of an effective link does not, by itself, allow another state to refuse recognition of a vessel’s nationality. Coastal and port states retain enforcement powers under other rules, but they cannot erase the Somali flag simply because Somalia fails to control the ship. UNCLOS therefore leaves the main burden where Somalia placed it: on Somalia. What abuse would cost Somalia The first cost is damage to the flag’s reputation. A poorly maintained vessel may be detained because of its own deficiencies. The Paris Memorandum of Understanding on Port State Control coordinates inspections of foreign ships entering participating European and North Atlantic ports. It classifies flags according to their inspection and detention records over a rolling three-year period. A flag enters the white, grey or black list only after at least thirty inspections. Once that threshold is met, repeated deficiencies and detentions can push the flag into a worse category and subject other vessels flying it to greater scrutiny.[5] Reputable owners then face higher inspection, insurance and chartering costs merely for carrying the same flag. The fastest customers to leave are often the ones Somalia should want to keep. The second cost is loss of control over who claims Somali nationality. The International Maritime Organization has documented fraudulent registrations and unauthorized use of flags, including several African flags targeted by vessels seeking a permissive or unverifiable identity.[6] A new international registry with opaque records is attractive to operators fleeing another flag, concealing ownership, manipulating vessel identities or avoiding scrutiny. If Somalia cannot publish and verify its register in real time, foreign authorities and commercial databases will struggle to distinguish a valid Somali ship from a fraudulent one. Both damage the same name. The third cost is sanctions exposure. The US Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control administers sanctions in support of United States foreign policy and national security. A Somali flag provides no immunity when a vessel, owner, manager, or service provider is subject to a US sanctions program. OFAC has warned that helping a blocked carrier reflag its vessels may constitute providing services to a blocked person and may itself support designation.[7] Misconduct by one vessel would not automatically subject Somalia or its registry to sanctions. It could nevertheless associate the Somali flag with weak screening, increase scrutiny of other vessels flying it, and discourage reputable owners from using the registry. The remaining costs are practical and political. Unsafe ships injure crews. Uninsured ships leave pollution and wreck-removal claims behind. Deceptive ships switch off tracking, falsify cargo papers or move sanctioned oil and weapons. Ships trading near wars pull the flag state into disputes it did not create. Each event demands records, investigation, cooperation and enforcement from Mogadishu. If the Somali government cannot or will not act against a vessel admitted by a Turkish operator, Somalia carries the liability while foreign owners and managers keep the commercial benefit. The control question The registry memorandum has not been published. The public therefore cannot see who has final authority over admission, beneficial-ownership checks, sanctions screening, surveyors, casualty investigations, suspension, deregistration, data and audits. Even if there is no public evidence that Ankara formally directs Somali Ship Register Limited, formal instructions are not the only measure of control. When a government already depends on the same foreign partner across its principal gateways, security and resources, the registrar’s independence cannot simply be presumed. Nur, who signed the registry memorandum and invited international owners to use the flag, later became Speaker of the House of the People. The issue is larger than one official. Somalia has built a structure in which the state must police ships brought to it through a relationship it may be politically unable to challenge. That conflict is exactly how a flag of convenience becomes dangerous: enforcement against a ship can also become a confrontation with the power behind the registry. Conclusion TEDY is a warning of potential misconduct. It shows how quickly Somalia’s legal identity can travel far beyond Somali commerce, territory or control. The next case may involve sanctions evasion, pollution, crew abuse, false registration or a voyage that serves a foreign war. By the time that case arrives, the cost will already carry Somalia’s name. The government licensed use of its flag through a Turkish-run company inside a relationship already marked by extreme dependence. Before more ships are admitted, Somalia should publish the memorandum and the live register, keep final registration and deregistration authority in accountable Somali hands, require independent ownership and sanctions screening, audit the operator, and fund the investigations and enforcement required by UNCLOS. Without those safeguards, Somalia will collect registration fees while assuming legal, diplomatic and reputational risks it cannot control. That is the harm an abused flag of convenience can do.
