items.title: Dowladda oo Ka Digaysa Roobab Waaweyn oo Muqdisho ku Soo Wajahan
items.description: Muqdisho, 16 Sebteembar 2026 — Roob mahiigaan ah ayaa xalay ka da’ay qaybo badan oo ka mid ah magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo sababay in waddooyin iyo goobo kala duwan ay biyo fariistaan, iyadoo magaalada ay wajahday xaalad la xiriirta fatahaadaha iyo biyo-mareennada oo aan si wanaagsan u qaadin biyaha roobka. Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Soomaaliyeed ayaa sheegay in roobabka waaweyn ee la xiriira saameynta El Niño, ee hore looga digay, aysan weli si buuxda u bilaaban, taasoo sare u qaadaysa walaaca laga qabo haddii roobab ka culus kuwa xalay da’ay ay magaalada ku soo wajan yuhiin. Roobka xalay ka da’ay Muqdisho ayaa mar kale muujiyay nuglaanta magaalada, gaar ahaan meelaha ay biyo-mareennadu xiran yihiin ama aan lahayn nidaam ku filan oo biyaha roobka looga saaro. Xaaladda ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo digniino hore laga bixiyay khatarta roobab xooggan iyo daadad ka dhalan kara, waxaana muuqata baahida loo qabo diyaargarow, nadiifinta biyo-mareennada iyo qorshe degdeg ah oo wax looga qabto meelaha ugu nugul daadadka. Roobabkan ayaa sidoo kale dhaliyay cabashooyin ku saabsan xaaladda waddooyinka iyo adeegyada biyo-mareennada magaalada, iyadoo shacabka qaarkood ay ku qasbanaadeen inay la tacaalaan biyaha fariistay waddooyinka iyo xaafadaha. Haddii roobabka culus ee la saadaaliyay ay sii socdaan, xaaladda Muqdisho waxay u baahan kartaa tallaabooyin degdeg ah oo ka hortag iyo gurmad ah, si loo yareeyo saameynta ay daadadku ku yeelan karaan dadka, guryaha iyo waddooyinka magaalada.

items.title: IGAD oo ku baaqday maalgelin joogto ah oo AUSSOM ah, wada-hadalna uga yeertay hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaaliya
items.description: Urur-goboleedka IGAD ayaa ku baaqay in la helo maalgelin ku filan, la saadaalin karo oo joogto ah oo lagu taageerayo howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), si loo sii xoojiyo dadaallada amniga iyo xasillinta dalka. Baaqan ayaa ka soo baxay war-murtiyeedka Kalfadhiga 74-aad ee aan caadiga ahayn ee Golaha Wasiirrada IGAD, oo 15-kii Sebteembar lagu qabtay magaalada Jabuuti. IGAD waxay sheegtay inay garab taagan tahay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dagaalka lagula jiro kooxaha argagixisada, iyadoo ammaan u jeedisay AUSSOM iyo dalalka ciidamadooda ku biiriyay howlgalka. IGAD ayaa si gaar ah ugu baaqday Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo saaxiibbada caalamka inay xaqiijiyaan maalgelin ku filan, la saadaalin karo oo waarta oo AUSSOM lagu taageero. War-murtiyeedka ayaa sidoo kale adkeeyay in la dhowro madaxbannaanida, midnimada, wadajirka dhuleed iyo madax-bannaanida siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. IGAD oo ku baaqday wada-hadal siyaasadeed oo Soomaaliya ah Golaha Wasiirrada IGAD ayaa sidoo kale bogaadiyay dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan horumarinta geeddi-socodka dimuqraadiyadda iyo dhismaha nidaam doorasho oo loo dhan yahay oo ka qaybgal ballaaran ku dhisan. IGAD waxay ugu baaqday dhinacyada iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaaliyeed inay sii wadaan dadaallada lagu gaarayo hannaan doorasho oo loo dhan yahay, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo wada-tashi iyo xal siyaasadeed oo dalka u horseeda is-afgarad.

items.title: Shiinaha oo Somaliland uga digay cawaaqib culus, kadib hadal ka soo yeeray Cirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Shiinaha ayaa si kulul uga jawaabtay hadallo uu Madaxweynaha maamulka Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro, ka jeediyay dalka Mareykanka oo uu ku muujiyay taageerada uu u hayo Taiwan, iyadoo Beijing ay uga digtay Somaliland “cawaaqib culus” haddii ay sii waddo mowqifkaas. Safaaradda Shiinaha ee Soomaaliya ayaa Arbacada maanta ah sheegtay in hadallada Cirro ay jebinayaan mabda’a “hal Shiinaha”, isla markaana ay dhaawacayaan waxa Beijing ay ku tilmaantay madax-bannaanideeda iyo midnimadeeda dhuleed. “Ka gudbidda xadka arrinta Taiwan waxay horseedi doontaa cawaaqib culus,” ayay safaaraddu ku tiri bayaan ay soo saartay, iyadoo aan faahfaahin ka bixin nooca tallaabada ay qaadi karto. Shiinaha ayaa sidoo kale arrinta Taiwan si toos ah ugu xiray muranka Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland, isagoo mar kale caddeeyay taageerada uu u hayo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. “Somaliland waa qayb aan laga goyn karin dhulka Soomaaliya,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka, oo intaas ku daray in Beijing ay taageereyso Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kana soo horjeeddo tallaabo kasta oo lagu kala qaybinayo dalka. Hadalkan ayaa yimid xilli Madaxweyne Cirro uu booqasho ku joogo Washington, halkaas oo Somaliland ay ka waddo dadaallo ay ku doonayso xiriir siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo dhow oo ay la yeelato Mareykanka. Cirro ayaa intii uu joogay Mareykanka sheegay in Somaliland ay garab taagan tahay Washington, isagoo sidoo kale xusay xiriirka ay la leedahay Taiwan iyo Israel. Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa Isniintii khudbad ka jeediyay Machadka Hudson ee Washington, booqashadiisii ugu horreysay ee Mareykanka tan iyo markii uu ku guuleystay doorashadii madaxtinimada Somaliland bishii November 2024. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xiriirka Somaliland iyo Mareykanka, amniga gobolka iyo dadaalka Hargeysa ee aqoonsi raadinta. Somaliland ayaa sidoo kale muddooyinkii dambe soo bandhigaysay dekedda Berbera, goobta ay ku taallo ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo muhiimadda marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, xilli ay Washington ka raadineyso xiriir dhow iyo taageero siyaasadeed. Xiriirka Taiwan Muranka cusub wuxuu salka ku hayaa xiriirka Somaliland iyo Taiwan, oo si rasmi ah u ballaartay sanadkii 2020 markii labada dhinac ay ku heshiiyeen inay xafiisyo wakiillo ka kala furtaan Hargeysa iyo Taipei. Taiwan ayaa xilligaas sheegtay in iskaashiga labada dhinac uu ka koobnaan doono kalluumeysiga, beeraha, tamarta, macdanta, caafimaadka, waxbarashada iyo teknoolajiyadda. Tan iyo markaas, xiriirkooda ayaa ku fiday ganacsiga, caafimaadka, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo tababarrada xirfadaha. Beijing ayaa si joogto ah uga soo horjeedda xiriirkaas. Shiinaha wuxuu Taiwan u arkaa qayb ka mid ah dhulkiisa, wuxuuna dowladda Jamhuuriyadda Dadka Shiinaha ku tilmaamaa dowladda keliya ee sharci ahaan matasha Shiinaha. Taiwan, oo leh dowlad, ciidan iyo nidaam siyaasadeed u gaar ah, ayaa diiddan sheegashada Beijing. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa taageerta mabda’a hal Shiinaha, halka Shiinuhuna uu si joogto ah u taageero midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Dadaalka aqoonsiga Khilaafka Taiwan ayaa soo baxaya xilli Somaliland ay kordhisay dadaalladeeda diblomaasiyadeed kadib markii Israel ay bishii December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland. Soomaaliya ayaa tallaabada Israel ku tilmaantay xadgudub lagu sameeyay madax-bannaanideeda iyo midnimadeeda dhuleed, halka Midowga Afrika iyo dowlado kale oo gobolka ah ay dib u xaqiijiyeen taageeradooda midnimada Soomaaliya. Xiriirka Israel iyo Somaliland ayaa intaas kadib sii ballaartay, iyadoo Cirro uu bishii June booqday Israel, labada dhinacna ay ka wada hadleen iskaashi dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo maalgashiga. Hargeysa ayaa hadda sidoo kale isku dayaysa inay Washington ka hesho xiriir ka dhow kan hadda jira, balse Mareykanka weli ma aqbalin inuu u aqoonsado Somaliland dal madax-bannaan. Aqalka Cad ayaa dhowaan sheegay in aysan waxba iska beddelin siyaasadda Mareykanka ee Somaliland, halka Cirro laftiisu uu sheegay in wada-hadallada uu Washington ka wado aysan weli dhalin ballanqaad ku saabsan aqoonsi. Digniinta cusub ee Shiinaha ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli Somaliland ay sii xoojinayso xiriirkeeda Taiwan iyo Israel, isla markaana ay Mareykanka ka raadineyso iskaashi siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo ballaaran. items.title: Madaxweyne ku xigeenka Somaliland oo ka qayb galay
items.description: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, ayaa maanta ka qayb galay Shirweynaha Horumarinta Ganacsatada yar-yar, kuwa dhexe iyo Iskaashatooyinka, oo lagu lafo-gurayo doorka ganacsiga yaryar iyo kuwa dhexe ee kobaca dhaqaalaha, abuurista shaqooyinka iyo horumarinta iawoodda dhaqaale ee bulshada. Shirweynahan oo lagu qabtay Hotel Serene Sarovar Premiere Hargeisa, ayaa waxa isugu yimid masuuliyiin ka tirsan Xukuumadda, Hay’adaha ay khusayso horumarinta ganacsiga, Ganacsatada dalka, Wakiillo ka socda iskaashatooyinka iyo qaybaha kale ee bulshada, waxa muhimmad gaar ah lagu siiyey sidii loo xoojin lahaa fursadaha ganacsi ee ay heli karaan ganacsatada yaryar iyo kuwa dhexe, isla markaana loo abuuri lahaa hannaan awood u siinaya in ay si joogto ah u kobciyaan wax-soo-saarkooda. Sidoo kale, Shirweynaha waxa lagaga hadlay caqabadaha haysta ganacsatada yar-yar iyo kuwa dhexe, fursadaha jira, sidii loo horumarin lahaa helitaanka maalgelinta, tababarro iyo aqoon kororsi yo sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashatooyinka oo laf-dhabar u noqon kara horumarinta dhaqaalaha bulshada. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi oo shirka ka hadlay ayaa tilmaamay in ganacsatada yar-yar iyo kuwa dhexe ay yihiin qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah dhaqaalaha dalka, maadaama ay door weyn ka qaataan abuurista fursadaha shaqo, kobcinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo kor u qaadista dhaq-dhaqaaqa dhaqaale ee bulshada. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL ayaa sidoo kale xusay in iskaashatooyinku ay yihiin hannaan muhiim u ah isku-xidhka bulshada iyo isu-geynta awoodda dhaqaale ee muwaadiniinta, gaar ahaan dadka ku hawlan wax-soo-saarka, beeraha, xoolaha, farsamada gacanta iyo adeegyada kala duwan. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL waxa uu tilmaamay in horumarinta ganacsatada yar-yar iyo kuwa dhexe ay muhiim u tahay kobcinta dhaqaalaha bulshada, abuurista fursado shaqo iyo kor u qaadista wax-soo-saarka gudaha, isaga oo ganacsatada ugu baaqay inay ka faa’iidaystaan fursadaha jira, isku-xidhnaantana ka dhaliyaan awood dhaqaale oo waarta. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL ahna kusimaha Madaxweynaha Md.Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi ayaa sheegay in ka xukumad ahaan ka go’an tahay dhiirigelinta Ganacsatada yar yar iyo kuwa dhexe.

items.title: Heavy Rains Disrupt Traffic and Daily Activities in Mogadishu
items.description: MOGADISHU — Heavy rains that fell across Mogadishu for several hours on Wednesday disrupted traffic and slowed the movement of pedestrians and vehicles in several parts of the capital. Several major roads were affected by significant water accumulation, making it difficult for motorists and pedestrians to move through the city. Traffic congestion was reported on some roads as commuters faced challenges caused by the heavy rainfall and flooded streets. The impact of the rain also extended to key areas of the capital, including roads near Aden Adde International Airport, as well as schools and workplaces. Many residents experienced difficulties reaching their educational institutions and places of work as normal. With the rain continuing, concerns have grown that prolonged rainfall could lead to further water accumulation and worsen conditions on major roads. Residents have been urged to exercise caution, particularly when traveling through areas affected by standing water and flooding. Government authorities and municipal officials have been called upon to respond swiftly, particularly in areas where flooding has blocked major roads, in order to restore access and ease movement across the capital. items.title: Egypt Moves to Strengthen Somalia’s Military Capabilities
items.description: MOGADISHU— Egypt has reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening and developing the capabilities of the Somali National Army as Cairo and Mogadishu seek to deepen their longstanding defense and security cooperation. The Egyptian government said its efforts will focus on military training, enhancing the capacity of Somalia’s security institutions and expanding military cooperation between the two countries. The initiative is also intended to support the implementation of existing defense agreements and commitments between Egypt and Somalia. The move comes as Somalia continues its efforts to rebuild and professionalize the Somali National Army and strengthen its ability to respond to the country’s security challenges. Egypt and Somalia have stepped up bilateral cooperation in defense and security in recent years. The two governments have previously signed agreements aimed at expanding military cooperation and providing training and capacity-building support to Somali security forces. Officials from both sides have stressed the importance of further strengthening the strategic relationship between Somalia and Egypt, particularly in the areas of defense, security and military development. The renewed focus on defense cooperation comes as Somalia works to strengthen its national security institutions and develop a more capable and sustainable national military force. items.title: Beeraleyda deegaan hoostaga Afgooye oo ku najaxay adeegsiga koronto laga dhaliyo ilayska
items.description: (ERGO) – Beeraleyda deegaanka Jarran oo hoos taga degmada Afgooye ayaa wax soo saarka beerahoodu uu kordhay, markii in badan oo ka mid ah ay billaabeen in waraabka beeraha ay u adeeg sadaan tamarta cadceedda ku shaqeysa. Waxay tilmaameen in arrintan ay xoogga saareen, markii ay dhaqaale ahaan ku adkaatay iibinta joogtada ah ee shidaalka oo qiimahiisu kordhay. Tamarta cadceedda ku shaqeysa ayay xuseen inay lacagta bixiyaan marka koowaad oo ay soo gadanayaan, kadibna ay si bilaash ah ugu waraabsadaan beeraha marka kasta oo ay u baahdaan. Markii hore waxay adeegsanjireen matoorada shidaalka ku shaqeeya matoorrada, kaas oo ay boqollaal Doollar uga bixi jireen. Maxamed Nuur Isxaaq oo leh beer afar hektar ah ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in isticmaalka tamarta cadceedda uu u hor seeday in wax soo saarkiisu kordho in ka badan labo jibbaar, tan iyo markii uu soo gatay bishii Jannaayo ee sanadkan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in halkii mar oo uu waraabiyo beerta uu ku bixin jiray lacag u dhexeysa $100 illaa $150, halka maanta aysan uga bixin wax lacag ah. Dhaqaalaha oo ku yaraa darteed ayuu sheegay in dantu ku qasbi jirtay inuusan waraabin dalagyada oo biyo u baahan, taasina ay keeni jirtay in wax soo saarkiisu hoos u dhaco. Wuxuu xusay in ugu yaraan labo mar uu hadda bishii waraabiyo beertiisa, halka markii hore uu labadii bilba mar waraabin jiray. Basal, yaanyo, basbaas, ansalaato, kabsar caleen, galley iyo digir oo ah dalagyadii ugu dambeeyay oo u soo go’ay bishii June ayuu sheegay inuu ka helay faa’ido gaareysa $3,000. Sida uu xusay waa dhaqaale ka badan boqolkiiba labo boqol, markii uu adeegsan jiray matoorka ku shaqeeya shidaalka. “Markii aan waayo lacag aan ku iibsado shidaalka waxaan ku qasbanaan jiray inaan dib u dhigo waraabka, taas oo saameyn ku yeelan jirtay dalagyada, gaar ahaan xilliyada ay u baahan yihiin biyaha.” Maxamed ayaa xusay in hadda uusan ka warwarin waraabka beertiisa. Isbedelkaas waxaa u hor seeday Soollar qiimahiisu yahay $4,600. Lacagtaas oo kun ka mid ah lagu lahaa ayuu sheegay inuu iska bixiyay. Faa’idada uu ka helo dalagyada u soo go’a ayuu tilmaamay inuu ka keydsaday dhaqaale gaaraya $1,700. Sanooyin dhowr ah oo uu beeraley yahay ayuu sheegay inuusan waligiis keydsan dhaqaale intan la eg, iyadoo uu xusay in waxa soo gali jiray aysan ka badnaan jirin inuu ku maareeyo nolosha qoyskiisa oo ka kooban siddeed qof. Sababta wuxuu ku sheegay in wax soo saarkiisu yaraa, ayna badneyd lacagta uga bixi jirtay iibinta shidaalka. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in mar hore uu billaabi lahaa isticmaalka Soollarka, balse uusan fahamsaneyn muhiimadda uu leeyahay. Waa go’aan ku dhashay markii ay ku dheeri galiyeen beeraley dariskiisa ah oo uga horreysay adeegsiga tamartan. “Waxaan go’aansaday in maalgalintaan aan sameeyo, sababta oo ah waxaa ii muuqatay in mustaqbalka iga yareyn doonto qarashaadka faraha badan. Lacagta waxaan ka helay dakhli iga soo galay beeraha oo aan keydsaday.” Deegaanka Jarran ayay dadkiisu u badan yihiin beeraley ku tiirsan biyaha webiga Shabeelle. Dalagyada u soo go’a ayay u iib geeyaan suuqyada gobolada Banaadir iyo Shabeellaha Hoose. Ka faa’ideysiga tamarta cadceedda oo fahamkeedu xoogeysanayo ayaa qeyb ka qaadaneysa in beeraleyda uu ka mid yahay Maxamed Nuur ay sameeyaan kobac dhaqaale oo joogta ah, ayna xoogga saaraan iibsashada abuurka, daawooyinka nafaqada iyo sunta cayayaanka. “Beertu waxay ii tahay isha kaliya dhaqaale ee aan ku taageero qoyskeyga. Waxaan isku dayaa faa’idada inaan qeyb keydsado markasta, si aan ugu isticmaalo xaaladaha deg degga ah ama horumarinta beerteyda.” Ninkan ayaa intaas ku daray inuu qorsheynayo inuu soo gato soollar ku kacaya kummanaan Doollar, maadaama uu hadda isticmaalo mid awoodiisu yartahay. items.title: Masar oo sheegtay in ay garab taagan tahay ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Dowladda Masar ayaa sheegtay inay xoogga saarayso horumarinta iyo tayeynta awoodda Ciidamada Militariga Soomaaliya, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la dhaqan-geliyo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca iyo heshiisyadii hore ee u dhexeeyay dowladaha Qaahira iyo Muqdisho. Masar ayaa tilmaantay in iskaashiga labada dal uu diiradda saarayo tababarka ciidamada, kor u qaadista awoodda hay’adaha amniga iyo xoojinta wada-shaqeynta militari ee Soomaaliya. Qorshahan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu dhisayo awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, si ciidamada qaranku ay u yeeshaan awood dheeraad ah oo ay kula tacaalaan caqabadaha amni ee dalka. Masar iyo Soomaaliya ayaa sanadihii u dambeeyay kordhiyay xiriirkooda dhinaca difaaca iyo amniga, iyadoo labada dowladood ay hore u kala saxiixdeen heshiisyo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga militari iyo tababarka ciidamada. Mas’uuliyiinta labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Masar, gaar ahaan dhinacyada difaaca, amniga iyo horumarinta awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Somalia Condemns Reported Drone Attack Toward Makkah
items.description: MOGADISHU, Somalia — Somalia has condemned a reported drone attack directed toward the holy city of Makkah, expressing solidarity with Saudi Arabia and affirming the kingdom’s right to protect its territory, citizens and Islamic holy sites.

items.title: Somalia and Pakistan Strengthen Digital Cooperation Through Peer Learning Mission
items.description: ISLAMABAD — Somalia and Pakistan are strengthening technical cooperation on digital identity, digital public infrastructure and financial inclusion following a 10-day peer learning mission by a high-level Somali delegation to Pakistan.

items.title: DF oo ciidamo cusub ku soo bandhigtay Baydhaba + Sawirro

Sidoo kale, wuxuu ciidamada ku bogaadiyay dadaalka ay muujiyeen, wuxuuna kula dardaarmay inay noqdaan kuwo daacad ah oo u heellan gudashada waajibaadkooda qaran. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa muddooyinkan waday dadaallo lagu tayaynayo ciidamada, si ay u yeeshaan awood iyo diyaar-garow ku filan si ay u gutaan waajibaadka Qaran ee saaran. Soo bandhigidda ciidamadan ayaa kusoo aadaya, iyada oo haatan xiisad culus ay ka taagan tahay Baydhaba, taas oo u dhexeysa ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore e Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Xaaladda ayaa hadda deggan, inkastoo ciidamada labada dhinac ay isku horfadhiyaan goobihii laga dagaalamay, taas oo suuragal ka dhigeysa inuu mar kale qarxo dagaalka, culaysna ku noqneysa shacabka ku dhaqan halkaasi. Dagaalladan waxaa barbar socda duqeymo diyaaradeed oo qaar kamid ah saaxibada caalamiga ah ka fulinayaan aagga magaalada Baydhaba, iyada oo lala beegsanayo ciidamada ku sugan halkaas iyo maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab. items.title: Roobab magiigaan ah oo ka da’ay Muqdisho oo sameeyey isku socodka
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Roobab xooggan oo saacado badan ka da’ayay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa maanta sababay hakad iyo gaabis ku yimid isu socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka ee qaybo badan oo ka mid ah caasimadda. Waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee magaalada ayaa meelo badan waxaa fariistay biyo badan, taas oo adkeysay isu socodka gaadiidka iyo dadka. Qaar ka mid ah waddooyinka ayaa noqday kuwo ciriiri ah, iyadoo gaadiidleyda iyo dadka lugeynaya ay wajahaan caqabado ka dhashay roobka iyo biyaha waddooyinka. Saameynta roobka ayaa sidoo kale gaartay goobaha muhiimka ah ee magaalada, oo ay ka mid yihiin waddada ku dhow Garoonka Diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde, goobaha waxbarashada iyo xarumaha shaqada. Dad badan ayaa ku adkaatay inay si caadi ah u gaaraan goobahooda waxbarasho iyo shaqo. Roobabkan oo weli da’aya ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in biyuhu sii fariistaan waddooyinka haddii roobku sii socdo. Dadka magaalada ayaa loogu baaqayaa inay taxaddar dheeraad ah muujiyaan, gaar ahaan marka ay marayaan waddooyinka ay biyuhu ku badan yihiin. Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda iyo hay’adaha dowladda hoose ayaa looga baaqay inay si degdeg ah uga jawaabaan xaaladda, gaar ahaan meelaha ay biyuhu xireen waddooyinka muhiimka ah, si loo fududeeyo isu socodka bulshada. Qaar ka mid ah waddooyinka ayaa noqday kuwo ciriiri ah, iyadoo gaadiidleyda iyo dadka lugeynaya ay wajahaan caqabado ka dhashay roobka iyo biyaha waddooyinka. Saameynta roobka ayaa sidoo kale gaartay goobaha muhiimka ah ee magaalada, oo ay ka mid yihiin waddada ku dhow Garoonka Diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde, goobaha waxbarashada iyo xarumaha shaqada. Dad badan ayaa ku adkaatay inay si caadi ah u gaaraan goobahooda waxbarasho iyo shaqo. Roobabkan oo weli da’aya ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in biyuhu sii fariistaan waddooyinka haddii roobku sii socdo. Dadka magaalada ayaa loogu baaqayaa inay taxaddar dheeraad ah muujiyaan, gaar ahaan marka ay marayaan waddooyinka ay biyuhu ku badan yihiin. Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda iyo hay’adaha dowladda hoose ayaa looga baaqay inay si degdeg ah uga jawaabaan xaaladda, gaar ahaan meelaha ay biyuhu xireen waddooyinka muhiimka ah, si loo fududeeyo isu socodka bulshada. The post Roobab magiigaan ah oo ka da’ay Muqdisho oo sameeyey isku socodka appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Turkey deports 50 Somalis amid anti-Turkey protests
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Turkey deported 50 Somali nationals to Mogadishu’s Aden Adde International Airport on Tuesday as anger over Ankara’s expanding military and economic footprint in Somalia spread through three regional states and reopened a long-simmering debate over who benefits from one of Somalia’s closest foreign partnerships. The group that landed in Mogadishu – 25 men and 25 women – is reportedly the first tranche of nearly 300 Somali nationals rounded up in recent days and held at a detention facility in Istanbul pending possible removal. Some of those facing deportation told Somali media they had committed no offense in Turkey and included university students and workers; others were reportedly suspected of involvement in irregular migration. Turkish authorities have not issued a public statement detailing the reasons for the removals or confirming the total number of Somalis facing expulsion. No official link has been established between the deportations and the protests convulsing Somalia, and Turkish officials have not commented on any connection. But the timing has fueled speculation in Mogadishu that the two are related, arriving as Somalis in Jubaland, Puntland and South West State states stage the most geographically widespread anti-Turkey demonstrations. Three regions, one grievance In Jubaland, thousands protested in Kismayo and Afmadow after a Sept. 4 drone strike hit the residence of Gen. Mahad Abdirahman Shub, a former Somali Custodial Corps commander who has opposed the federal government politically. Jubaland’s information ministry said the strike was politically motivated and injured civilians at the property, and accused Ankara of abandoning any claim to neutrality in Somalia’s internal disputes. Demonstrators burned the Turkish flag and carried images of Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan defaced with blood; banners read “We don’t need Erdoğan.” In South West State, residents around Baidoa have staged repeated protests since early August, burning the Turkish flag and accusing Turkish aircraft of strikes that they say damaged farmland, killed livestock and, in some accounts, killed civilians. In Puntland, protesters near Eyl burned the Turkish flag over the deaths of more than a dozen people described locally as fishermen, killed in August off the Nugaal coast at Garmaal and Jiifle. Local officials have demanded compensation and an explanation from Ankara, which has not publicly addressed the incident. A federal speaker urges restraint Somalia’s Lower House Speaker, Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur Jama, condemned the flag burnings as “appalling” and blamed what he called a “foreign agenda” aimed at damaging Somali-Turkish relations, saying the acts did not reflect Somali public sentiment. He urged Somalis not to let political disputes jeopardize a relationship he credited with sustaining Somalia through humanitarian, development and security support over the past decade. Jama did not name the foreign actors he held responsible. The economic backdrop The unrest unfolds against a backdrop of deepening Turkish involvement in Somalia’s economy and security architecture. Ankara operates Somalia’s largest overseas military base, Camp TURKSOM, has trained more than 15,000 Somali troops, deployed F-16 fighter jets to Mogadishu for the first time this year, and is building a missile-range facility and satellite launch site near the capital. Turkey’s state energy company began Somalia’s first offshore oil drilling campaign in April under a production-sharing agreement whose terms remain undisclosed, in waters Somali officials say may hold up to 30 billion barrels in reserves. Turkish firms also manage Mogadishu’s port and airport under long-term concessions, and the terms have drawn sustained criticism from Somalia’s own oversight bodies. Favori LLC has run Aden Adde International Airport under a 20-year concession since 2013, and Albayrak has operated Mogadishu Port since 2014. Somalia’s Auditor General, Ahmed Issa Gutale, said in August 2024 that neither company had submitted the independently audited financial statements required to verify the government’s share of revenue – a gap his office was still pressing both firms to close as recently as June 2026. A 2021 special audit found Favori had paid the government just 13% of the airport’s gross revenue that year; separately, the government received $3.1 million from airport operations in 2022, well below projections from its own financial advisers. A Eurasia Review analysis of the broader concession landscape additionally flagged an 80-year port concession at Hobyo, signed in 2024, as unusually long by industry standards, and said Parliament has not voted on the underlying Favori and Albayrak agreements. Those terms have hardened a comparison Somalis are increasingly drawing online: the United Arab Emirates, whose port, security and defense agreements with Somalia were annulled by Mogadishu in January over an unrelated sovereignty dispute involving a Yemeni separatist leader’s transit through Somaliland, has not deported Somali nationals in the aftermath. Turkey’s action this week, critics argue, sits uneasily against Ankara’s framing of itself as Somalia’s most steadfast partner. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Madaxweynaha Koonfurta Suudaan oo qaaday tillaabo walaac laga muujiyay
items.description: Madaxweynaha Koonfurta Suudaan, Salva Kiir Mayardit , ayaa xilka ka qaaday Guddoomiyihii Guddiga Qaranka Doorashooyinka dalkaas, Professor Abednego Akok Kacuol , iyadoo ay wax ka yar saddex bilood ka harsan yihiin doorashooyinka madaxtinimada iyo baarlamaanka ee loo qorsheeyay 22-ka Diseembar 2026. Madaxweynaha ayaa xilka guddoomiyaha u magacaabay Gabriel Bol Deng Majok , oo horey u ahaa Xoghayaha Guud ee Guddiga Qaranka Doorashooyinka. Isbeddelka hoggaanka guddiga ayaa lagu dhawaaqay habeenkii Talaadada, 15-ka Sebtembar, iyadoo warbaahinta dowladda ee South Sudan Broadcasting Corporation (SSBC) laga sii daayay warka. Ilaa hadda ma jiro sabab rasmi ah oo dowladda ay ku sheegtay xil-ka-qaadista Professor Akok , taasoo arrinta ka dhigtay mid dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan waqtiga iyo saameynta ay ku yeelan karto diyaar-garowga doorashada. Koonfurta Suudaan ayaa qorsheysay in doorashooyinka madaxtinimada iyo baarlamaanka la qabto 22-ka Diseembar 2026 , iyadoo dalka uu muddo dheer ku jiray marxalad ku-meel-gaar ah. Guddiga Doorashooyinka ayaa bishii Juun si rasmi ah u shaaciyay taariikhda doorashada, hase yeeshee wuxuu xilligaas sheegay inay jiraan caqabado la xiriira dhinacyada sharciga iyo dhaqaalaha. Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale bishan Sebtembar bilaabay tababarka guddiyada doorashooyinka ee dowlad-goboleedyada iyo saddexda deegaan maamul, si loogu diyaargaroobo diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaasha. Professor Abraham Kuol Nyuon , oo cilmiga siyaasadda ka dhiga Jaamacadda Juba, ayaa sheegay in isbeddelka hoggaanka xilligan uu saameyn ku yeelan karo jadwalka diyaar-garowga doorashada. Nyuon wuxuu xusay in magacaabista Gabriel Bol Deng ay yareyn karto carqaladda ka dhalan karta isbeddelka, maadaama uu horey uga tirsanaa hoggaanka guddiga isla markaana uu aqoon u leeyahay shaqada hay’adda, hase yeeshee, wuxuu sheegay in guddoomiyaha cusub uu weli u baahan doono waqti uu si buuxda ula qabsado waajibaadka cusub. Mid ka mid ah hawlaha ugu muhiimsan ee guddiga doorashooyinka ayaa ah diyaarinta diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaasha, waxaana Guddiga uu 2-dii Sebtembar sheegay in diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaashu aysan weli bilaaban, isla markaana aysan jirin tiro rasmi ah oo cod-bixiyeyaal la diiwaangeliyay. Guddigu wuxuu sheegay in diiwaangelinta lagu sameyn doono hab gacan-ku-qor ah, qof-qof ah iyo waraaqo , kadibna xogta lagu gelin doono nidaamyada kombiyuutarrada ee guddiga. isbeddelka hoggaanka oo ku soo beegmaya xilli ay hawlaha diiwaangelinta iyo diyaar-garowga doorashadu socdaan ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in jadwalka la qorsheeyay uu wajahayo dib-u-dhac. Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ee Koonfurta Suudaan, oo wax laga beddelay 2023-kii, wuxuu qeexayaa xaaladaha iyo nidaamka lagu qaadi karo guddoomiyaha iyo xubnaha kale ee guddiga doorashooyinka. Sababaha uu sharcigu tilmaamayo waxaa ka mid ah eex la xaqiijiyay, awood-darro uu xilka ku gudan waayo iyo anshax-xumo culus. Warbaahinta Radio Tamazuj ayaa sheegtay in aan weli caddayn laga haynin in sababihii sharciga ku xusnaa la adeegsaday iyo in nidaamkii sharci ee xil-ka-qaadista la raacay. Arrintan ayaa muhiim u ah madaxbannaanida hay’adda doorashooyinka, maadaama website-ka rasmiga ah ee Guddiga Qaranka Doorashooyinka Koonfurta Suudaan uu xusayo in hay’addu tahay mid madax-bannaan dhinacyada maamulka iyo dhaqaalaha, isla markaana ay waajib ku tahay inay shaqadeeda u gudato si daacadnimo, hufnaan iyo eex-la’aan ah. Gabriel Bol Deng Majok , oo hadda loo magacaabay guddoomiyaha cusub, wuxuu horey u ahaa Xoghayaha Guud ee Guddiga Doorashooyinka, waana Khabiir la filayo inuu sii dardargeliyo hawlaha doorashada, maadaama uu horey ugu lug lahaa diyaarinta kaabayaasha doorashada, wacyigelinta cod-bixiyeyaasha iyo isku-duwidda hay’adaha dowliga ah.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika oo Ka Wada Hadlay Xoojinta Amniga Xuduudaha iyo La-dagaallanka Argagixisada
items.description: Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Xuseen Qaasim Yuusuf , ayaa xarunta dhexe ee Hay’adda ku qaabilay wafdi uu hoggaaminayay Idriss Mounir Lallali , Agaasimaha Xafiiska La-dagaallanka Argagixisada ee Midowga Afrika. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha Midowga Afrika ee dhinacyada amniga, socdaalka iyo maareynta xuduudaha , iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha ay khuseyso. Qodobada muhiimka ah ee kulanka lagu gorfeeyay waxaa ka mid ahaa wadaagista xogta amniga iyo socdaalka , iyo la socodka dhaqdhaqaaqa dadka looga shakisan yahay inay ku lug leeyihiin falalka argagixisada, gaar ahaan dadka isaga gudba xuduudaha Soomaaliya. Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda ayaa sidoo kale wafdiga Midowga Afrika u soo bandhigtay horumarka ay ka samaysay xaqiijinta iyo hubinta amniga xuduudaha , iyadoo adeegsanaysa teknoolojiyadda casriga ah iyo nidaamyo dhijitaal ah oo lagu maareeyo xogta socdaalka. Nidaamyadaas ayaa lagu sheegay inay gacan ka geysanayaan hagaajinta maamulka xogta socdaalka, xoojinta socdaalka sharciga ah iyo awoodda hay’adaha dowladda ay u leeyihiin inay ogaadaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada laga yaabo inay khatar ku yihiin amniga dalka. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in hay’adaha dowladda Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha gobolka ay yeeshaan wada-shaqeyn joogto ah iyo is-dhaafsi xogeed , si wax looga qabto khataraha amni ee xuduudaha isaga gudba. Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda, Xuseen Qaasim Yuusuf, ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda iskaashi dhow oo dhex mara Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha gobolka, isagoo sheegay in wada-shaqeyntu ay muhiim u tahay xoojinta dadaallada looga hortagayo argagixisada iyo dambiyada xuduudaha isaga gudba, iyadoo isla markaana la fududeynayo socdaalka sharciga ah. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo isku-xirka hay’adaha amniga iyo socdaalka ee Soomaaliya iyo kuwa gobolka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada maareynta xuduudaha, xog-is-weydaarsiga iyo ka hortagga khataraha amni ee ka dhasha dhaqdhaqaaqa sharci-darrada ah ee xuduudaha.

Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda, Xuseen Qaasim Yuusuf, ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda iskaashi dhow oo dhex mara Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha gobolka, isagoo sheegay in wada-shaqeyntu ay muhiim u tahay xoojinta dadaallada looga hortagayo argagixisada iyo dambiyada xuduudaha isaga gudba, iyadoo isla markaana la fududeynayo socdaalka sharciga ah. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo isku-xirka hay’adaha amniga iyo socdaalka ee Soomaaliya iyo kuwa gobolka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada maareynta xuduudaha, xog-is-weydaarsiga iyo ka hortagga khataraha amni ee ka dhasha dhaqdhaqaaqa sharci-darrada ah ee xuduudaha.

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo Baydhabo ku Kormeeray Ciidamo Tababar ku Dhammeystay
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar , ayaa maanta magaalada Baydhabo kormeer ugu tegay ciidamo ka tirsan Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed oo tababar ku soo dhammeystay magaalada. Taliyaha ayaa kormeerkiisa ka bilaabay xerada ay ciidamada ku qaadanayeen tababarka, halkaas oo uu warbixin ka dhageystay macallimiinta iyo saraakiisha mas’uulka ka ah tababarka ciidamada. Warbixinta uu Taliyuhu ka dhageystay saraakiisha ayaa la xiriirtay heerka uu marayo tababarka, noocyada tababarrada ay ciidamada qaateen iyo farsamooyinka milatari ee lagu baray muddadii ay tababarka ku jireen. Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa sidoo kale qiimeyn ku sameeyay xaaladda ciidamada iyo heerka ay gaareen marka la eego tababarka iyo diyaar-garowga ay u leeyihiin gudashada waajibaadkooda ciidan. Kormeerkan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed uu ku doonayo in lagu xoojiyo tayada iyo awoodda ciidamada, iyadoo muhiimad la siinayo tababarro joogto ah iyo kor u qaadista xirfadaha askarta. Taliska Ciidanka XDS ayaa muddooyinkii dambe waday dadaallo lagu tayeynayo ciidamada, si loo helo ciidan leh tababar, aqoon iyo diyaar-garow ku filan oo awood u leh gudashada waajibaadka qaran ee loo igmaday. Kormeerka Baydhabo ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Taliska ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya ay wadaan qorshayaal lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada, gaar ahaan deegaanada ay dowladda dooneyso inay ku ballaariso ama ku xoojiso joogitaankeeda amni.

items.title: Shiinaha oo digniin adag u diray Somaliland
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Dowladda Shiinaha ayaa ugu goodiyey in Somaliland cawaaqib-xumo la kulmi doonto, kaddib markii Madaxweyne Cirro uu ayidey Jasiiradda Taiwan, in ay tahay dalka madax bannaan. Safaaradda Shiinaha ee magaalada Muqdisho, waxa ay hoosta ka xarriiqday in Somaliland ay u aragto Gobol ka tirsan Soomaaliya, sidaasi oo kalena ay tahay Jasiiradda Taiwan. “Gobolka Somaliland wuxuu si cad u jebiyey mabda’a “Hal Shiine” (one-China principle), waana xadgudub ka dhan madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Shiinaha, si adag ayaan uga soo horjeednaa tallaabadaas…Waxaan ku boorrinaynaa siyaasiyiinta tirada yar in ay arkaan xaqiiqda jirta, ku xadgudubka xadka arrinta Taiwan waxay horseedi doontaa cawaaqib xumo daran” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay safaaradda Shiinaha ee Muqdisho. Sidoo kale safiirka Shiinaha, ayaa sheegay in Somaliland ay tahay qayb aan laga goyn karin oo ka mid ah dhulka Soomaaliya. waxa uuna Shiinuhu sheegay in si adag u taageerayo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, waxa uuna xusay inuu kasoo horjeedo tallaabo kasta oo lagu kala qaybinayo dhulka Soomaaliyeed. Sikastaba, ma ahan markii ugu horeeysay oo Shiinaha uu si cad u sheego inuu kasoo horjeedo in la kala qeybiyo dhulkooda Soomaaliyeed iyo aqoonsiga Somaliland ay ka heshay Xukuumadda Talaabiib. The post Shiinaha oo digniin adag u diray Somaliland appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Mareykanka oo $5 Milyan Abaalmarin ah Dul Dhigay Xogta Haweeney Soomaali ah oo Lagu Eedeeyay inay ka tirsantahay Daacish
items.description: Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa ku dhawaaqday abaalmarin gaareysa 5 milyan oo doollar oo lagu raadinayo xog horseedi karta in la helo Khadra Ciise, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan “Umm Qaqa al-Somali”.haweeneydan oo asal ahaan Soomaali ah, haysatana dhalashada Netherlands, ayuu Mareykanku ku eedeeyay inay door sare ku lahayd kooxda ISIS ee Suuriya. Abaalmarinta waxaa bixineya barnaamijka Rewards for Justice ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, waxaana diiradda lagu saarayaa xogta lagu heli karo halka ay ku sugan tahay Khadra Essa. Mareykanku wuxuu sidoo kale si gaar ah u raadinayaa xog ku saabsan halka ay ku dambeeyeen laba carruur ah oo walaalo ah oo Mareykan ah, Yusuf iyo Zahra Shikder . Sida lagu sheegay xogta rasmiga ah ee Mareykanka, Khadra Ciise waxay sannadkii 2014 uga safartay Netherlands una gudubtay Suuriya, halkaas oo ay ku biirtay ISIS. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in haweenaydan lagu tababaray adeegsiga hubka iyo walxaha qarxa iyo sidoo kale hawlgallada ismiidaaminta. Waxaa kale oo lagu eedeeyay inay faafisay fikirka kooxda, shaqsiyaad cusubna u qortay ISIS, iyadoo xubnaha kooxda ku dhiirrigelisay adeegsiga rabshadaha iyo weerarro ka dhaca dalal kala duwan. Mareykanku wuxuu sheegay in Khadra Ciise ay ahayd macallimad sare oo shareecada ah oo ka tirsan Nusaybah Katibah , oo ahayd cutub dumar u gaar ah oo ISIS ka tirsan, laguna aas-aasay magaalada Raqqah ee Suuriya sannadkii 2016. Cutubkan ayaa haween u qori jiray ISIS, abaabuli jiray, isla markaana siin jiray tababarro la xiriira xirfadaha dagaalka iyo hawlgallada milatari. Sida xogta Mareykanka lagu sheegay, xilligii uu cutubkani ugu xoogga badnaa wuxuu lahaa boqolaal haween ah oo tababaran, kuwaas oo ay ku jireen muwaadiniin Mareykan iyo Yurub ah. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka waxay sidoo kale ku eedeysay Khadra inay door ku lahayd dhaqan-gelinta xeerarkii adag ee ISIS ay ku soo rogtay haweenka, iyadoo amarro ay bixisay lagu xiriiriyay ciqaabo jireed iyo dilal. Kiiska Khadra Ciise waxaa si gaar ah muhiim uga dhigay laba carruur ah oo walaalo ah, Yusuf iyo Zahra Shikder . Sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, hooyada carruurta ayaa sannadkii 2015 carruurta u qaaday Suuriya si ay ugu biiraan ISIS iyadoo aan oggolaansho ka haysan aabbahood. Hooyadood ayaa ku dhimatay sannadkii 2019 intii lagu jiray weerar militari oo ka dhan ahaa xoogagga ISIS, Kadib, sida Mareykanku sheegay, Khadra Ciise ayaa carruurta gacanta ku dhigtay oo u qaaday meel aan la shaacin oo ku taalla Suuriya. Yusuf , oo dhashay 2010, iyo Zahra , oo dhalatay 2014, ayaa ilaa hadda la la’yahay halka ay ku dambeeyeen, ayadoo Dowladda Mareykanku ay bixineyso ilaa $5 milyan oo xog lagu heli karo meesha ay ku sugan yihiin, lagu soo badbaadin karo, laguna soo celin karo.

items.title: Mareykanka oo dabciyey mowqif caqabad ku ahaa DF
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa muujisay inay wax ka dabcin karto qorshihii degdegga ahaa ee lagu soo afjarayay Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya (UNSOS), iyadoo soo jeedisay in xafiiska la siiyo muddo 12 bilood ah oo uu si tartiib ah howlaha uga soo baxo ka hor inta aan gebi ahaanba la xirin. Qorshahan ayaa ku xusan warqad aan rasmi ahayn oo Mareykanku dhowaan la wadaagay dhinacyada ay khuseyso, taas oo ay aragtay majaladda The EastAfrican . Waxa uu dhigaya in muddada kala-guurka ay bilaabato marka uu dhammaado oggolaanshaha hadda ee Howlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), 31-ka December 2026. Inkasta oo tallaabadan loo arki karo inay yareyneyso walaacii ka dhashay xiritaanka degdegga ah ee UNSOS, haddana ma aha go’aan kama dambeys ah. Waa mowqifka uu Mareykanku ku galayo wada-hadallada socda ee ku saabsan mustaqbalka xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya. Soo jeedinta Washington waxay sidoo kale ka gaaban tahay muddada ay doonayaan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya AUSSOM, kuwaas oo shir aan caadi ahayn oo 31-kii July ka dhacay Kampala ku dalbaday in taageerada UNSOS la sii wado muddo u dhexeysa 18 ilaa 24 bilood. Dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya howlgalka, oo ay ka mid yihiin Kenya, Burundi, Itoobiya, Masar, Jabuuti iyo Uganda, ayaa ku dooday in muddadaas loo baahan yahay si loo xaqiijiyo kala-guur nidaamsan, loo xoojiyo awoodda hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya, isla markaana mas’uuliyadda amniga si tartiib ah loogu wareejiyo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Xiritaan horey u billowday Doodda cusub waxay timid xilli UNSOS uu durba bilaabay diyaargarowga lagu yareynayo howlihiisa, ka dib markii Mareykanku horey u sheegay inuusan taageeri doonin maalgelinta howlgalka wixii ka dambeeya dhammaadka 2026-ka. Warbixin ay Caasimada Online daabacday bishii hore ayaa sheegtay in shaqooyin ka tirsan UNSOS la dhimayay, qaar ka mid ah shaqaalahana lagu wargeliyay inay baxaan, halka howlgalka saadka uu bilaabay qorshaha lagu iibinayo ama lagu wareejinayo qaar ka mid ah hantidiisa. Haddii la isku raaco muddada 12-ka bilood ah ee Mareykanku soo jeediyay, waxay taasi gaabin kartaa ama dib u dhigi kartaa geeddi-socodka degdegga ah ee xiritaanka, iyadoo Qaramada Midoobay, Midowga Afrika iyo Soomaaliya la siinayo waqti dheeraad ah oo lagu go’aamiyo halka ay ku dambeynayaan howlaha saadka iyo hantida UNSOS. Arrinta ugu weyn ee la isku hayo ayaa ah cidda la wareegi doonta taageerada muhiimka ah ee UNSOS uu siiyo ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada gaadiidka, sahayda iyo adeegyada kale ee lagama maarmaanka u ah howlgalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Mareykanka ayaa doonaya in la dejiyo waqti cad oo lagu soo afjarayo nidaamka hadda jira, isagoo qaba in kharashka ku baxaya uu aad u kordhay, isla markaana dhaqaale badan loo baahan yahay in loo wareejiyo mudnaano amni oo Washington u aragto inay si toos ah u taabanayaan danaheeda. Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika ayaa dhankooda ka walaacsan in xiritaan degdeg ah uu AUSSOM iyo dhinacyada kale ee amniga ka shaqeeya uga tago adeegyo muhiim ah xilli aan weli la diyaarin hannaan kale oo beddela UNSOS. Mareykanka oo diiday 18-24 bil Washington ayaa dowladda Britain, oo hormuud ka ah arrimaha Soomaaliya ee Golaha Ammaanka, u sheegtay inay taageeri karto muddo 12 bilood ah oo UNSOS uu howlihiisa si tartiib ah u soo afjaro, ka dibna si toos ah loo bilaabo xiritaanka iyo kala dirista xafiiska. Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in muddadaas ay AUSSOM iyo dhinacyada kale siin karto fursad ay ugu diyaar garoobaan bixitaanka UNSOS, isla markaana howlaha saadka qaarkood loogu wareejiyo Midowga Afrika ama dhinacyo kale. Hase yeeshee, Washington waxay si cad u diiday dalabkii ahaa in taageerada la sii wado 18 ilaa 24 bilood, sida ay dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya howlgalka kaga dalbadeen shirkii Kampala. Arrintan ayaa Britain gelisay xaalad adag oo ay tahay inay isu soo dhoweyso mowqifka Mareykanka ee ah in la dejiyo waqti cad oo bixitaan ah iyo dalabka Soomaaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo saaxiibadooda ee ku saabsan in kala-guurka waqti dheer la siiyo. Heshiiska ugu dambeeya wuxuu go’aamin doonaa inta uu UNSOS sii shaqeyn doono, howlaha iyo hantida loo wareejin karo dhinacyada kale iyo cidda qaadaysa kharashka kala-guurka. Muran la xiriira $481 milyan Dhinaca dhaqaalaha ayaa ka dhigaya muranka mid sii culus. Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa horey u ansixiyay $481 milyan oo loogu talagalay UNSOS sanad-maaliyadeedka hadda socda. Soo jeedinta Mareykanka ee 12-ka bilood ah ma abuureyso miisaaniyad cusub, mana kordhineyso lacagtaas, balse waxay xafiiska siin kartaa waqti dheeraad ah oo uu ku isticmaalo miisaaniyadda horey loo ansixiyay xilli uu howlihiisa yareynayo. Taas waxay sidoo kale UNSOS siin kartaa waqti uu sii hayo shaqaalaha muhiimka ah, uu u isticmaalo kheyraadka jira howlaha kala-guurka, isla markaana lagu kala saaro hantida la wareejin karo iyo tan la iibinayo ama la baabi’inayo. Sidaas darteed, muranka dhaqaale wuxuu si toos ah ugu xiran yahay muranka siyaasadeed: su’aasha taagan ma aha oo keliya goorta UNSOS baxayo, balse sidoo kale muddada la siinayo inuu isticmaalo, wareejiyo ama soo afjaro kheyraadka horey loogu qoondeeyay. Natiijada wada-hadalladan ayaa saameyn weyn ku yeelan karta qaabka ay Qaramada Midoobay uga baxeyso Soomaaliya iyo haddii taageerada saadka ee ciidamada Midowga Afrika loogu wareejin doono hannaan nidaamsan ama ay ku dhici doonto kala-guur degdeg ah oo khatar gelin kara howlaha amniga. items.fullContent: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa muujisay inay wax ka dabcin karto qorshihii degdegga ahaa ee lagu soo afjarayay Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya (UNSOS), iyadoo soo jeedisay in xafiiska la siiyo muddo 12 bilood ah oo uu si tartiib ah howlaha uga soo baxo ka hor inta aan gebi ahaanba la xirin. Qorshahan ayaa ku xusan warqad aan rasmi ahayn oo Mareykanku dhowaan la wadaagay dhinacyada ay khuseyso, taas oo ay aragtay majaladda The EastAfrican . Waxa uu dhigaya in muddada kala-guurka ay bilaabato marka uu dhammaado oggolaanshaha hadda ee Howlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), 31-ka December 2026. Inkasta oo tallaabadan loo arki karo inay yareyneyso walaacii ka dhashay xiritaanka degdegga ah ee UNSOS, haddana ma aha go’aan kama dambeys ah. Waa mowqifka uu Mareykanku ku galayo wada-hadallada socda ee ku saabsan mustaqbalka xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya. Soo jeedinta Washington waxay sidoo kale ka gaaban tahay muddada ay doonayaan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya AUSSOM, kuwaas oo shir aan caadi ahayn oo 31-kii July ka dhacay Kampala ku dalbaday in taageerada UNSOS la sii wado muddo u dhexeysa 18 ilaa 24 bilood. Dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya howlgalka, oo ay ka mid yihiin Kenya, Burundi, Itoobiya, Masar, Jabuuti iyo Uganda, ayaa ku dooday in muddadaas loo baahan yahay si loo xaqiijiyo kala-guur nidaamsan, loo xoojiyo awoodda hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya, isla markaana mas’uuliyadda amniga si tartiib ah loogu wareejiyo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Xiritaan horey u billowday Doodda cusub waxay timid xilli UNSOS uu durba bilaabay diyaargarowga lagu yareynayo howlihiisa, ka dib markii Mareykanku horey u sheegay inuusan taageeri doonin maalgelinta howlgalka wixii ka dambeeya dhammaadka 2026-ka. Warbixin ay Caasimada Online daabacday bishii hore ayaa sheegtay in shaqooyin ka tirsan UNSOS la dhimayay, qaar ka mid ah shaqaalahana lagu wargeliyay inay baxaan, halka howlgalka saadka uu bilaabay qorshaha lagu iibinayo ama lagu wareejinayo qaar ka mid ah hantidiisa. Haddii la isku raaco muddada 12-ka bilood ah ee Mareykanku soo jeediyay, waxay taasi gaabin kartaa ama dib u dhigi kartaa geeddi-socodka degdegga ah ee xiritaanka, iyadoo Qaramada Midoobay, Midowga Afrika iyo Soomaaliya la siinayo waqti dheeraad ah oo lagu go’aamiyo halka ay ku dambeynayaan howlaha saadka iyo hantida UNSOS. Arrinta ugu weyn ee la isku hayo ayaa ah cidda la wareegi doonta taageerada muhiimka ah ee UNSOS uu siiyo ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada gaadiidka, sahayda iyo adeegyada kale ee lagama maarmaanka u ah howlgalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Mareykanka ayaa doonaya in la dejiyo waqti cad oo lagu soo afjarayo nidaamka hadda jira, isagoo qaba in kharashka ku baxaya uu aad u kordhay, isla markaana dhaqaale badan loo baahan yahay in loo wareejiyo mudnaano amni oo Washington u aragto inay si toos ah u taabanayaan danaheeda. Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika ayaa dhankooda ka walaacsan in xiritaan degdeg ah uu AUSSOM iyo dhinacyada kale ee amniga ka shaqeeya uga tago adeegyo muhiim ah xilli aan weli la diyaarin hannaan kale oo beddela UNSOS. Mareykanka oo diiday 18-24 bil Washington ayaa dowladda Britain, oo hormuud ka ah arrimaha Soomaaliya ee Golaha Ammaanka, u sheegtay inay taageeri karto muddo 12 bilood ah oo UNSOS uu howlihiisa si tartiib ah u soo afjaro, ka dibna si toos ah loo bilaabo xiritaanka iyo kala dirista xafiiska. Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in muddadaas ay AUSSOM iyo dhinacyada kale siin karto fursad ay ugu diyaar garoobaan bixitaanka UNSOS, isla markaana howlaha saadka qaarkood loogu wareejiyo Midowga Afrika ama dhinacyo kale. Hase yeeshee, Washington waxay si cad u diiday dalabkii ahaa in taageerada la sii wado 18 ilaa 24 bilood, sida ay dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya howlgalka kaga dalbadeen shirkii Kampala. Arrintan ayaa Britain gelisay xaalad adag oo ay tahay inay isu soo dhoweyso mowqifka Mareykanka ee ah in la dejiyo waqti cad oo bixitaan ah iyo dalabka Soomaaliya, Midowga Afrika iyo saaxiibadooda ee ku saabsan in kala-guurka waqti dheer la siiyo. Heshiiska ugu dambeeya wuxuu go’aamin doonaa inta uu UNSOS sii shaqeyn doono, howlaha iyo hantida loo wareejin karo dhinacyada kale iyo cidda qaadaysa kharashka kala-guurka. Muran la xiriira $481 milyan Dhinaca dhaqaalaha ayaa ka dhigaya muranka mid sii culus. Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa horey u ansixiyay $481 milyan oo loogu talagalay UNSOS sanad-maaliyadeedka hadda socda. Soo jeedinta Mareykanka ee 12-ka bilood ah ma abuureyso miisaaniyad cusub, mana kordhineyso lacagtaas, balse waxay xafiiska siin kartaa waqti dheeraad ah oo uu ku isticmaalo miisaaniyadda horey loo ansixiyay xilli uu howlihiisa yareynayo. Taas waxay sidoo kale UNSOS siin kartaa waqti uu sii hayo shaqaalaha muhiimka ah, uu u isticmaalo kheyraadka jira howlaha kala-guurka, isla markaana lagu kala saaro hantida la wareejin karo iyo tan la iibinayo ama la baabi’inayo. Sidaas darteed, muranka dhaqaale wuxuu si toos ah ugu xiran yahay muranka siyaasadeed: su’aasha taagan ma aha oo keliya goorta UNSOS baxayo, balse sidoo kale muddada la siinayo inuu isticmaalo, wareejiyo ama soo afjaro kheyraadka horey loogu qoondeeyay. Natiijada wada-hadalladan ayaa saameyn weyn ku yeelan karta qaabka ay Qaramada Midoobay uga baxeyso Soomaaliya iyo haddii taageerada saadka ee ciidamada Midowga Afrika loogu wareejin doono hannaan nidaamsan ama ay ku dhici doonto kala-guur degdeg ah oo khatar gelin kara howlaha amniga. items.title: Dowladda Shiinaha Oo Digniin Adag U Dirtay Maamulka Somaliland.
items.description: Dowladda Shiinaha ayaa si adag uga jawaabtay hadallo uu hoggaamiyaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Cirro, ka jeediyay Mareykanka, kuwaas oo qayb ka mid ah uu uga hadlay mowqifka maamulkiisa ee Taiwan. Warsaxaafadeed ka soo baxay Safaaradda Shiinaha ee Soomaaliya ayay xukuumadda Beijing ku sheegtay in hadalladaasi ay ka hor imaanayaan mabda’a Hal-Shiine, ayna wax u dhimayaan madaxbannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Shiinaha. Beijing waxay sidoo kale ku adkaysatay in Taiwan ay qayb ka tahay dhulka Shiinaha, iyadoo ka digtay tallaabo kasta oo ka hor imaanaysa mowqifkeeda. Dhanka kale, Shiinuhu wuxuu sheegay in Somaliland ay qayb ka tahay dhulka Soomaaliya, isla markaana uu taageerayo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Safaaradda Shiinaha ayaa ugu dambayn sheegtay inay ka soo horjeeddo tallaabo kasta oo lagu kala qaybinayo dhulka Soomaaliya, iyadoo digniin adag u dirtay dhinacyada ay khusayso.

items.title: Muxuu yahay muuqaalka Hadal-haynta dhaliyay ee laga duubay Safiirka Suudaan ee Soomaaliya?
items.description: Muuqaal lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada ayaa dhaliyay hadal-heyn ku saabsan xaaladda amniga magaalada Muqdisho, kaddib markii safiirka Suudaan ee Soomaaliya Cabdiraxmaan Khaliil lagu arkay isagoo gaari ku dhex maraya waddooyinka caasimadda, iyadoo aan muuqaalka laga arkin ciidamo ama gaadiid ilaalin ah oo la socda. Muuqaalka ayaa muujinaya safiirka oo ku jira gaarigiisa, halka darawalku uu si caadi ah u wadayo gaariga, wuxuuna Safiirku sidoo kale wax ka iibsanayay maqaayad ku taalla magaalada Muqdisho. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay su’aalo la xiriira heerka amniga Muqdisho iyo sida ay u kala duwan yihiin hababka ay dadka magaalada ugu kala duwan yihiin inay u socdaan gudaha caasimadda. Diblomaasiyiinta iyo masuuliyiinta sare ee ku sugan Muqdisho ayaa adeegsada gaadiid ay la socdaan ciidamo ilaalo ah, gaar ahaan marka ay u socdaan goobaha muhiimka ah ama ay ka qeybgalayaan munaasabadaha dowladda. Sidoo kale, mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa inta badan magaalada ku dhex mara kolonyo gaadiid ah, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah gaadiidkooda ay yihiin kuwo gaashaaman, halka ciidamo hubeysan ay ka qeyb qaataan ilaaladooda. muuqaalka safiirka Suudaan ayaa dadka qaar ku dhalisay inay isweydiiyaan sababta uu diblomaasi ajnabi ah ugu dhex safri karo qeybo ka mid ah Muqdisho isagoo aan muuqaal ahaan wadan ilaalin badan. Si kastaba, muuqaal keliya lagama xaqiijin karo in safiirku aanu haysan wax qorshe amni ah ama ilaalin kale oo aan ka muuqan muuqaalka, balse kalsoonida ka muuqatay Danjire Cabdiraxmaan Khaliil ayaa muujinaysa sida laysugu halayn karo amniga caasimadda.

items.title: Al-Shabaab oo Labaatan Sano Kadib Weli Caqabad Ku Ah  amniga Soomaaliya iyo AUSSOM oo su’aali ka taagantahay
items.description: In ka badan labaatan sano kadib markii Soomaaliya ay wajahday faragelinno iyo hawlgallo militari oo caalami ah, kooxda Al-Shabaab ayaa weli ah mid ka mid ah caqabadaha ugu waaweyn ee amni ee dalka. Kooxdan hubeysan ee xiriirka la leh shabakadda Al-Qaacida iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa muddo dheer ka dagaallamaysay dowladda Soomaaliya iyo ciidamada taageera, iyadoo awooddeeda iyo saameynteeda ay marba heer gaartay. Inkasta oo sannadihii lasoo dhaafay la sameeyay howlgallo militari oo ballaaran, laguna dilay qaar ka mid ah hoggaamiyeyaasha kooxda, Al-Shabaab waxay sii wadday inay dib isu abaabusho, weerarro ka fuliso qeybo kala duwan oo dalka ah, isla markaana cadaadis ku hayso xarumaha dowladda iyo ciidamada ammaanka. Faragelinta militari ee Soomaaliya waxay soo martay marxalado kala duwan, iyadoo ciidamada Midowga Afrika iyo kuwa kale oo caalami ah ay muddo dheer door ku lahaayeen taageerada dowladda iyo dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Si kastaba, awoodda kooxda oo sii jirta ayaa dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan natiijada laga gaaray dadaalladii militari ee muddada dheer socday. Al-Shabaab ayaa sidoo kale awood u yeelatay inay ka faa’iidaysato meelaha aysan dowladdu si buuxda uga talin, khilaafaadka siyaasadeed iyo tabashooyinka bulshada, iyo daldaloollada amni ee ka jira qeybo ka mid ah Soomaaliya. Xaaladdan ayaa muujinaysa in dagaalka lagula jiro kooxda uusan ku koobnaan karin oo keliya hawlgallo militari, balse Dowladda Soomaaliya ay sidoo kale u baahan tahay in la xoojiyo hay’adaha amniga, maamulka dowladeed, adeegyada bulshada iyo dhaqaale-abuurka, si loo yareeyo fursadaha ay kooxdu uga faa’iidaysan karto duruufaha jira. Inkasta oo dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibbadeeda caalamiga ah ay sheegayaan inay wadaan dadaallo lagu wiiqayo Al-Shabaab, haddana sii jiritaanka kooxda labaatan sano kadib faragelintii militari ee ugu horreysay waxay muujinaysaa sida uu u adag yahay dagaalka Soomaaliya kula jirto kooxdan hubeysan.

items.title: Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda IGAD oo kulan gaar ah la yeeshay Madaxweynaha Jabuuti
items.description: Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah Urur-Goboleedka IGAD ayaa magaalada Jabuuti kulan maamuus ah kula yeeshay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti, Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle , iyadoo kulanka uu qayb ka ahaa hawlaha Kalfadhiga 74-aad ee aan caadiga ahayn ee Golaha Wasiirrada IGAD . Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cabdi Cali , ayaa ka mid ahaa wasiirradii ka qayb galay kulanka, isagoo hoggaaminaya wafdiga Soomaaliya ee ka qaybgalaya shirarka IGAD ee ka socda caasimadda Jabuuti. Kulanka ayaa fursad u noqday madaxda iyo wasiirrada gobolka inay Madaxweynaha Jabuuti kala hadlaan arrimaha khuseeya xoojinta iskaashiga gobolka, nabadda iyo amniga , xilli Geeska Afrika iyo nawaaxigiisa ay ka jiraan caqabado siyaasadeed, amni iyo bani’aadamnimo. Kalfadhiga 74-aad ee Golaha Wasiirrada IGAD ayaa si gaar ah diiradda u saaraya arrimaha gobolka iyo sidii dalalka xubnaha ka ah ururku ay u xoojin lahaayeen wada-shaqaynta iyo jawaabaha wadajirka ah ee caqabadaha gobolka. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay xoojinta iskaashiga gobolka, horumarinta nabadda iyo sugidda amniga , iyadoo loo marayo wada-shaqayn iyo hannaan goboleed. Kulanka Jabuuti ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli dalalka Geeska Afrika ay wajahaan arrimo dhowr ah oo u baahan iskaashi, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin amniga gobolka, colaadaha, xaaladaha bani’aadamnimo, socdaalka iyo isku-xirka dhaqaale. Sidoo kale, joogitaanka wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee dalalka IGAD ee Jabuuti wuxuu xoojinayaa doorka dalkaas uu ku leeyahay diblomaasiyadda gobolka iyo hawlaha ururka. Madaxweynaha Jabuuti, Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle, ayaa martigeliyey madaxda iyo wasiirrada ka qaybgalaya kulanka, iyadoo Jabuuti ay noqotay goobta lagu qabtay kalfadhigan muhiimka ah.

items.title: Waa kuma Safiirka Cusub ee uu Mareykanku u soo magacaabay Soomaaliya?
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa magacaabay diblomaasi lagu magacaabo Devin Kennington inuu noqdo safiirka cusub ee Mareykanka u qaabilsan Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo magacaabista loo gudbiyey Golaha Senate-ka Mareykanka 14-kii September 2026 si loo ansixiyo. Magacaabistan ayaa soo baxday xilli muddo bilo ah aanu Soomaaliya joogin safiir Mareykan ah oo si rasmi ah u ansaxsan, waxaana safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho maamulayey Justin Davis , oo ahaa ku-simaha madaxa safaaradda. Kennington oo ah diblomaasi ka soo jeeda gobolka California,islamarkaana leh 15 sano oo khibrad arrimaha dibadda ah ayaa beddeli doonaa safiirkii hore Richard H. Riley IV , kaas oo xilka hayey 2024 ilaa lagu celiyey Washington bishii December 2025. Devin Kennington waa diblomaasi ka tirsan waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka, wuxuuna diblomaasiyadda Mareykanka ku biiray sanadkii 2011 , asagoo  soo qabtay xilal diblomaasiyadeed oo kala duwan. Khibraddiisa waxaa ka mid ah inuu kasoo shaqeeyey Brazil , halkaas oo uu ahaa ku-xigeenka qunsuliyadda magaalada Sao Paulo, iyo Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Jabuuti , halkaas oo uu kasoo noqday madaxa arrimaha qunsuliyadda. Waxa kale oo uu kasoo shaqeeyey Hong Kong , isagoo mas’uul ka ahaa adeegyada muwaadiniinta Mareykanka, waxaana waajibaadkiisii ugu dambeeyey ee Washington ka mid ahaa inuu hoggaamiyo qaybta Great Lakes Unit iyo inuu noqdo sarkaal sare oo qaabilsan arrimaha Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo. Khibradda Kennington ee Jabuuti ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu noqon karta xilka Soomaaliya, maadaama labada dal ay ku yaallaan meel istiraatiiji ah oo ku dhow Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas . Jabuuti waxay martigelisaa saldhigyo militari oo ay leeyihiin dalal dhowr ah, waxaana gobolka Geeska Afrika uu muhiim u yahay amniga maraakiibta, la-dagaallanka kooxaha hubeysan iyo siyaasadda gobolka. Inkasta oo xogta la helayo aysan muujinayn inuu Kennington horey safiir uga soo noqday dal Afrikaan ah, haddana waayo-aragnimadiisa Jabuuti iyo shaqadiisa arrimaha Afrika waxay siinayaan khibrad la xiriirta deegaanka uu hadda ka shaqo billaabayo. Magacaabista Kennington waxay ku soo beegmaysaa xilli xiriirka Mareykanka iyo Soomaaliya uu weli si weyn ugu tiirsan yahay arrimaha amniga, la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab, taageerada ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika . Sidoo kale, Mareykanka wuxuu Soomaaliya ku leeyahay dano la xiriira amniga gobolka, gaar ahaan Gacanka Cadmeed, Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Liiska cusub ee magacaabista Trump waxaa sidoo kale ku jiray diblomaasiyiin loo magacaabay dalalka deriska la ah Soomaaliya, oo ay ku jirto Jabuuti, taasoo muujinaysa in Washington ay isku mar buuxinayso dhowr xil oo diblomaasiyadeed oo muhiim u ah gobolka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Kennington hadda waa safiir la magacaabay, balse magacaabistiisa waxay u baahan tahay in Senate-ka Mareykanka uu ansixiyo.

items.title: 25 sano kadib weeraradii 9/11, Soomaaliya oo noqotay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Shan iyo labaatan sano kadib weerarradii 11-kii September 2001 ee dunida indhaheeda ku jeediyey al-Qaacida iyo saldhigyadeedii Afghanistan, qaabka iyo goobta ay ka hawlgasho shabakaddaasi ayaa si weyn isu beddelay, iyadoo Soomaaliya maanta hoy u tahay garabka ugu rabshadaha badan kooxaha xiriirka la leh al-Qaacida. Kooxda Al-Shabaab ayaa ku lug yeelatay in ka badan 2,300 oo dhacdo oo rabshado siyaasadeed ah sanadkan 2026, kuwaas oo ku dhow kala bar dhammaan dhacdooyinka rabshadaha ee ay ku lug leeyihiin faracyada al-Qaacida caalamka, sida lagu sheegay qiimeyn cusub oo ay soo saartay hay’adda xogta colaadaha ee ACLED. Dr Ladd Serwat, oo ah falanqeeye sare oo ACLED u qaabilsan Afrika, ayaa sheegay in Al-Shabaab ay weli tahay kooxda hubeysan ee aan dowliga ahayn ee ugu awoodda badan Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay tahay faraca al-Qaacida ee ugu rabshadaha badan dunida. Xogtan ayaa muujineysa sida uu isu beddeshay khatarta al-Qaacida tan iyo weerarradii 9/11, xilli ururku lahaa hoggaan aad u mideysan oo xaruntiisu ahayd Afghanistan, halka maanta awooddiisu ay ku kala firdhisan tahay kooxo goboleedyo ku dhex milmay colaadaha gudaha ee dalal kala duwan. Afghanistan ilaa Soomaaliya Markii ay dhaceen weerarradii 11-kii September 2001, al-Qaacida waxay xarumo ku lahayd Afghanistan, iyadoo heshay gabaad ay siisay Taliban. Weerarradaas, oo ay ku dhinteen ku dhowaad 3,000 oo qof gudaha Mareykanka, ayaa horseeday duullaankii Mareykanka iyo xulafadiisu ku qaadeen Afghanistan iyo olole caalami ah oo lagu burburinayey al-Qaacida. Sanadihii xigay, ururka waxaa ka dhintay ama laga dilay hoggaamiyeyaal badan. Osama bin Laden waxaa ciidamada Mareykanka ku dileen Pakistan sanadkii 2011, halka ninkii beddelay ee Ayman al-Zawahiri lagu dilay weerar diyaaradeed oo Mareykanku ka fuliyey Kabul sanadkii 2022. Hase yeeshee, cadaadiskaas ma uusan soo afjarin al-Qaacida. Halkii ay ahaan lahayd hal urur oo hal meel laga maamulo, waxay si tartiib ah isugu beddeshay shabakad ay ka tirsan yihiin kooxo maxalli ah oo awood ku yeeshay meelo kala duwan. “Jihaad-doonka caalamiga ah hadda kadib kuma wareego hal urur, hal hoggaan ama hal xarun juqraafiyeed,” ayay ACLED sheegtay. Qaar ka mid ah faracyadii hore ee al-Qaacida ayaa iyaguna qaaday waddooyin kale. Faracii Ciraaq ayaa ugu dambeyn isu beddelay kooxda Daacish, halka Jabhat al-Nusra ee Suuriya ay xiriirkii al-Qaacida jartay, kadibna qayb ka noqotay Hayat Tahrir al-Sham. Dhanka kale, Afrika ayaa si tartiib ah uga mid noqotay meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay ka hawlgalaan kooxaha xiriirka la leh al-Qaacida. Al-Shabaab oo adkeysaneysa Al-Shabaab waxay ka soo baxday garabkii hubeysnaa ee Maxkamadihii Islaamiga ahaa, kadib faragelintii ciidamada Itoobiya ee Soomaaliya dabayaaqadii 2006. Kooxdu waxay sannadihii xigay si tartiib ah ugu dhawaatay al-Qaacida, waxaana xiriirkaas si rasmi ah loo shaaciyey bishii February 2012, markii hoggaamiyihii Al-Shabaab Axmed Cabdi Godane uu bayco la galay Ayman al-Zawahiri. Afar iyo toban sano kadib, Al-Shabaab waxay noqotay faraca al-Qaacida ee ugu badan dhacdooyinka rabshadaha lagu diiwaangeliyey. Kooxdu waxay weli ka hawlgashaa dhul ballaaran oo ku yaalla bartamaha iyo koonfurta Soomaaliya, inkastoo muddo dheer ay weerarro ku hayeen ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya, kuwa Midowga Afrika iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah. ACLED ayaa sheegtay in gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose uu sanadkan 2026 ka mid noqday meelaha sida weyn looga diiwaangeliyey rabshadaha ay Al-Shabaab ku lug leedahay. Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadeeda ayaa weli wada howlgallo lagu bartilmaameedsanayo hoggaanka, dagaalyahannada iyo kaabayaasha kooxda. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale kordhiyey duqeymaha uu ka fulinayo Soomaaliya ee ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish. Si kastaba, Al-Shabaab waxay muujisay awood ay kaga badbaadi karto cadaadiska milatari, iyadoo weli haysata deegaano miyiga ah, uruursata dhaqaale badan, isla markaana fulisa weerarro ka dhan ah ciidamada iyo xarumaha dowladda. Saaxilka oo soo xoogeysanaya Inkasta oo Al-Shabaab ay tahay faraca ugu rabshadaha badan al-Qaacida, Soomaaliya ma aha meesha keliya ee Afrika ee shabakaddaasi ku xoogeysatay. Kooxda Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin, oo loo yaqaan JNIM, ayaa si weyn ugu fidday gobolka Saaxilka, iyadoo hawlgalladeedu ka soo gudbeen Mali una gudbeen Burkina Faso, Niger, Benin, Togo iyo Nigeria. ACLED ayaa sheegtay in kooxdaasi ay sanadkan billowday weerarro isku xiran oo gobol ahaan loo abaabulay, isla markaana cadaadis ku kordhisay magaalooyinka waaweyn iyo kaabayaasha muhiimka ah. Arrintaas ayaa keentay in falanqeeyayaasha ACLED ay isweydiiyaan in gobolka Saaxil uu isu beddelayo “xarun cusub oo culayska” al-Qaacida. Taas macnaheedu ma aha in Soomaaliya ay noqotay xarunta taliska al-Qaacida ama in Al-Shabaab ay maamusho faracyada kale ee shabakadda. Waxayse muujineysaa in al-Qaacida maanta ka duwan tahay ururkii aadka u mideysnaa ee laga maamuli jiray Afghanistan, iyadoo kooxaha xiriirka la leh ay awood ka dhisteen colaado iyo xaalado siyaasadeed oo kala duwan. Xiriirka Yemen iyo Soomaaliya Yemen, al-Qaacida Jaziiradda Carabta, oo loo yaqaan AQAP, waxay sanadihii hore ka mid ahayd faracyada ugu khatarta badan al-Qaacida, inkastoo dhaqdhaqaaqeeda militari uu hoos u dhacay. Si kastaba, ACLED waxay sheegtay in xiriirka AQAP iyo Al-Shabaab uu weli fududeeyo isu gudbinta hubka, tiknoolajiyadda diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo khibradaha militari ee mara shabakadaha sharci darrada ah ee isku xira Soomaaliya iyo Yemen. Arrintan ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmeysa xilli ay isa soo tarayaan warbixino ku saabsan xiriirro ka gudba Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan hub, tababar iyo farsamooyin cusub oo ay adeegsadaan kooxaha hubeysan. Khatartii 9/11 oo qaab kale yeelatay Khatarta maanta ka dhalaneysa al-Qaacida aad ayey uga duwan tahay tii Mareykanka iyo xulafadiisu wajahayeen kadib weerarradii 9/11. Waqtigaas, walaaca ugu weyn wuxuu ahaa urur caalami ah oo xaruntiisu tahay Afghanistan, kana awood badan inuu qorsheeyo weerarro waaweyn oo ka dhaca meel kumannaan kiiloomitir u jirta saldhiggiisa. Maanta, qaar badan oo ka mid ah faracyada al-Qaacida waxay awooddooda ka helaan inay si qoto dheer ugu dhex milmaan colaadaha gudaha, canshuur ka qaadaan dadka iyo ganacsatada, kana faa’iideystaan dowladnimo daciif ah iyo khilaafaad siyaasadeed. Soomaaliya waxay noqotay mid ka mid ah tusaalooyinka ugu cad ee isbeddelkan. ACLED ayaa sidoo kale ka digtay in hubanti la’aanta ku saabsan taageerada amni ee caalamiga ah ay fursado cusub siin karto Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan xilli ay jiraan caqabado dhaqaale oo saameynaya howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya. Shan iyo labaatan sano kadib 9/11, al-Qaacida hadda ma aha ururkii mideysnaa ee hal xarun looga talin jiray Afghanistan. Saaxilka ayaa noqday mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu dhaqsaha badan ee ay kooxaha xiriirka la leh ku fidayaan, halka Soomaaliya ay hoy u tahay Al-Shabaab, oo sanadkan ku lug yeelatay ku dhowaad kala bar dhammaan rabshadaha lagu diiwaangeliyey faracyada al-Qaacida caalamka. Maanta, qaar badan oo ka mid ah faracyada al-Qaacida waxay awooddooda ka helaan inay si qoto dheer ugu dhex milmaan colaadaha gudaha, canshuur ka qaadaan dadka iyo ganacsatada, kana faa’iideystaan dowladnimo daciif ah iyo khilaafaad siyaasadeed. Soomaaliya waxay noqotay mid ka mid ah tusaalooyinka ugu cad ee isbeddelkan. ACLED ayaa sidoo kale ka digtay in hubanti la’aanta ku saabsan taageerada amni ee caalamiga ah ay fursado cusub siin karto Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan xilli ay jiraan caqabado dhaqaale oo saameynaya howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya. Shan iyo labaatan sano kadib 9/11, al-Qaacida hadda ma aha ururkii mideysnaa ee hal xarun looga talin jiray Afghanistan. Saaxilka ayaa noqday mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu dhaqsaha badan ee ay kooxaha xiriirka la leh ku fidayaan, halka Soomaaliya ay hoy u tahay Al-Shabaab, oo sanadkan ku lug yeelatay ku dhowaad kala bar dhammaan rabshadaha lagu diiwaangeliyey faracyada al-Qaacida caalamka. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo ballaarinaya gacan-ku-hayntooda xeebaha galbeed ee Yemen iyo Bab al-Mandab-oo wajahaya xiisad cusub
items.description: Xaaladda dagaalka Yemen ayaa si weyn u kacsan kadib markii Xuutiyiintu ay toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay ballaariyeen gacan-ku-hayntooda qaybo muhiim ah oo ka tirsan xeebaha galbeed ee dalka, taasoo keentay in indhaha caalamku si gaar ah ugu jeestaan marinka Bab al-Mandab , oo ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga caalamka. Xuutiyiintu waxay la wareegeen dhulal xeebeed iyo jasiirado ay ka mid yihiin Mayyun (Perim), Hanish-ka Weyn iyo Hanish-ka Yar , iyadoo horumarkooda uu gaaray aagga u dhexeeya Hodeidah, Mocha iyo Bab al-Mandab. Horumarkan ayaa wax ka beddelay khariidadda dagaalka ee xeebaha Badda Cas, oo muddo dhowr sano ah aan isbeddel weyn ka dhicin. Warbixin kale oo Al Jazeera ah ayaa sheegtay in Xuutiyiintu 10-kii September ay qabsadeen magaalada dekedda ah ee Mocha , halka maalintii xigtayna ay sii ballaariyeen gacan-ku-hayntooda Mayyun, Dhubab iyo jasiiradaha Hanish. Inkasta oo Xuutiyiintu ay sameeyeen horumar dhuleed oo degdeg ah, haddana khubaradu waxay tilmaamayaan in ilaalinta dhul ballaaran oo xeebeed ay ka adag tahay qabsashadiisa . Xeebaha Tihama ee galbeedka Yemen waa dhul furan oo ciidamada ka dhigaya kuwo si fudud loogu arki karo looguna bartilmaameedsan karo weerarrada cirka. Sida uu sheegay madaxa xafiiska Al Jazeera ee Yemen, Xuutiyiintu waxay u baahan yihiin ciidamo badan iyo sahay joogto ah si ay u difaacaan aagga ballaaran ee u dhexeeya Hodeidah, Mocha iyo Bab al-Mandab. Khubarada milatariga ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in Xuutiyiintu inta badan ku tiirsan yihiin dagaal dhuumaaleysi ah, dhaqdhaqaaqyo degdeg ah iyo ka faa’iidaysiga dhulka buuraha ah. Dhinaca kale, ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee taageerada ka hela Sacuudiga ayaa bilaabay weerarro rogaal-celin ah oo lagu doonayo in lagu joojiyo horumarka Xuutiyiinta. Ciidamada dowladda ayaa sheegay inay weerareen fariisimo iyo qalab ciidan oo Xuutiyiintu ku lahaayeen Dhubab iyo Al-Khokha , halka dagaallo laga soo sheegay aagga Al-Waziyah iyo duleedka Al-Mudaraba ee gobolka Lahj. weerarradani waxay Xuutiyiinta ku qasbi karaan inay ciidamadooda ku kala firdhiyaan xeebaha, jasiiradaha iyo furimaha kale ee dagaalka, taasoo kordhin karta culayska saaran ciidamadooda iyo sahaydooda. Si loo yareeyo cadaadiska ka haysta xeebaha, Xuutiyiintu waxay sidoo kale kordhiyeen hawlgallada militari ee ka socda Marib iyo Lahj, wuxuuna Gobolka Lahj muhiim u yahay dhinaca istiraatiijiyadda, maadaama uu yahay mid ka mid ah marinnada dhulka ee u dhow magaalada Cadan , oo ah xarunta ku-meel-gaarka ah ee dowladda Yemen. Haddii dagaalku ku sii fido aagaggaas, waxaa suuragal ah in furimaha kala duwan ay isku xirmaan, taasoo sii adkeyn karta xaaladda militari ee dowladda Yemen iyo Xuutiyiinta. Arrinta ugu weyn ee walaaca dhalinaysa ayaa ah meesha uu Bab al-Mandab kaga jiro ganacsiga iyo maraakiibta caalamiga ah, ayadoo Marinkani uu isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed , wuxuuna muhiim u yahay maraakiibta u kala goosha Yurub, Afrika, Aasiya iyo Bariga Dhexe.

items.title: Sawirro: Maxay tahay farriinta uu Muungaab gaarsiiyay madaxweyne Geelle?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, ahna Duqa magaalada Muqdisho, Mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) oo booqasho rasmi ah ku jooga Jabuuti ayaa maanta kulan gaar ah la yeeshay Madaxweynaha dalkaas, Mudan Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle. Muungaab iyo wafdigiisa ayaa salaan sharafeed ugu tegay Madaxweynaha, waxaana sidoo kale wehlinayay dhiggiisa Jabuuti, Said Daoud Mohamed (Saïd Daoud) oo isagu markii horeba ku casuumay dalkaasi. Duqa Muqdisho ayaa Madaxweynaha Jabuuti gaarsiiyey farriin uu ka siday Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo shacabka caasimadda, isaga oo sidoo kale uga warbixiyay horumarrada kala duwan ee ka socda magaalada Muqdisho. Sidoo kale wuxuu ka mahadceliyay soo dhoweynta diirran ee ay u sameeyeen dhiggiisa Jabuuti, xukuumadda iyo shacabka waddankaasi. Dhankiisa, Madaxweyne Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle, oo si diirran u soo dhaweeyey Guddoomiye Muungaab ayaa xusay in uu ku faraxsan yahay heerka xiriirka walaaltinimo iyo iskaashiga ee labada dal iyo labada shacab. Kulankan waxaa ka horreeyay heshiis uu duqa Muqdisho shalay la saxiixday dhiggiisa magaalada Jabuuti Said Daoud Mohamed, kaas oo ku saabsan is-afgarad lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga labada caasimadood, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga, maalgashiga, dhaqanka iyo horumarinta. Heshiiskan ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay inuu saldhig u noqonayo iskaashi toos ah oo dhex mara maamullada Muqdisho iyo Jabuuti, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan inay abuuraan fursado cusub oo ganacsi iyo maalgashi. Si kastaba, h eshiiska labada caasimadood ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti ay iyaguna ballaarinayaan xiriirkooda siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed. The post Sawirro: Maxay tahay farriinta uu Muungaab gaarsiiyay madaxweyne Geelle? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Qalliinkii ugu horreeyay ee maskaxda oo garaadka macmalka ah (AI) ku lug lahaa oo lagu guuleystay
items.description: Qofkii ugu horreeyay adduunka ee lagu sameeyo qalliinka maskaxda iyada oo garaadka macmalka ah (AI) uu qalliinka si toos ah uga caawinayo, ayaa si guul leh looga saaray buro maskaxda kaga taallay. Rhys Hibbert, oo ah aabbe laba carruur ah dhalay kana soo jeeda Bedfordshire ee Britain, ayaa qalliinka lagu sameeyay Isbitaalka University College London. Dhakhaatiirtu waxay sheegeen in haddii aan qalliinkaas aan la samayn, buradu ay keeni kartay inuu araggu ka lumo. Qalliinka dhexdiisa ayaa qalab AI ah wuxuu si toos ah u falanqeynayay muuqaalka kamaradda qalliinka. Wuxuu dhakhaatiirta ka caawinayay inay aqoonsadaan xididdada dhiigga iyo neerfayaasha muhiimka ah ee maskaxda, kuwaas oo mararka qaar qarsoon oo aan si fudud loo arki karin. AI-gu wuxuu calaamadaynayay meelaha ay u badan tahay inay ku yaallaan xididdada iyo neerfayaasha, wuxuuna tilmaamayay meelaha ugu badbaadsan ee buradu laga saari karo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dhakhaatiirtu waxay sheegeen in go’aanka ugu dambeeya iyo xakamaynta qalliinka ay iyagu hayeen, AI-duna uu ahaa qalab caawinayey oo keliya. Prof Hani Marcus, oo ka mid ahaa dhakhaatiirtii qalliinka samaysay, ayaa sheegay in nidaamkan loo tababaray muuqaallo laga qaaday boqolaal qalliin oo burooyinka taas oo siisay AI-ga awood uu ku aqoonsado xididdada iyo neerfayaasha muhiimka ah. Wuxuu qalabka ku tilmaamay inuu noqon karo sida “khabiir labaad oo aragti ku siinaya” kaas oo qolka qalliinka kula jooga, dhakhtarkuna talo ka heli karo marka uu u baahdo. Hibbert oo 48 jir ah wuxuu sheegay inuu caafimaad qabay ilaa qiyaastii 18 bilood ka hor. Wuxuu ahaa maamule adeegga macaamiisha ah, wuxuuna maalin kasta socon jiray qiyaastii laba mayl xilliga qadada. Maalin ka mid ah maalmihii socodkiisa ayuu si lama filaan ah u miyir doorsoomay, isaga oo wadada ku dhacay, xaalad suuxitaan ahna uu galay. Baadhitaan maskaxda ah ayaa lagu ogaaday inuu leeyahay buro aan kansar ahayn oo cabbirkeedu yahay 11 millimitir, taas oo ku kortay mid qanjidhada ka ag dhaw maskaxda. Bbc somali

items.title: Cirro oo la kulmay xubno ka tirsan Congress-ka + Sawirro
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullahi (Cirro) ayaa booqday xarunta Congress-ka Maraykanka (United States Capitol Hill) oo ah goobta ay ku shaqeeyaan Xildhibaannada Aqalka Sare (Senate) iyo kuwa Golaha Wakiillada (House of Representatives), isagoo halkaas kula kulmay xubno ka tirsan Golaha Congress-ka. Kulanka oo ahaa mid muhiim ah ayaa waxa uu si gaar ah u dhex-maray wafdiga madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Cirro iyo xildhibaanno ay kamid yihiin John Rose (R-Tennessee) iyo John Moolenaar (R-Michigan). Labada dhinac ayaa si qoto dheer uga wada-hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga Somaliland iyo Maraykanka, iyaga oo si gaar ah u taabtay arrimaha amniga, iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah, ganacsiga, maalgashiga iyo xasilloonida Gobolka Geeska Afrika. Madaxweynaha oo madasha ka hadlay ayaa adkeeyey muhimadda ay Somaliland u leedahay amniga iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas, isaga oo tilmaamay in juqraafi ahaan Somaliland ay ku taallo meel muhiim u ah ilaalinta marinnada ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee muhiimka u ah dalka Maraykanka. Sidoo kale, wuxuu carrabka ku dhuftay in Somaliland doonayso iskaashi ku salaysan dano-wadaag, masuuliyad iyo natiijooyin la taaban karo, gaar ahaan horumarinta iskaashiga amni, ballaadhinta ganacsiga, dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga Maraykanka iyo xoojinta xidhiidhada dhaqaale. Cabdiraxmaan Cirro oo dhawr cisho ku sugan Mareykanka ayaa horay u booqday National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial ee dalka Maraykanka, oo ah goobaha lagu xuso dadkii ku naf waayey weerarradii argagixiso ee dhacay 11-kii Sebtembar, 2001. Booqashadaas ayaa xambaarsanayd farriin siyaasadeed iyo bani’aadamnimo, iyadoo Madaxweynuhu xusay dhibbanayaashii weerarrada, isla markaana muujiyay in Somaliland ay taageersan tahay dadaallada caalamiga ah ee ka dhanka ah argagixisada. Farriinta Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa mid muujinaysa doonista Somaliland ee ku aaddan xoojinta xiriirka ay la leedahay Maraykanka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Madaxweynaha oo madasha ka hadlay ayaa adkeeyey muhimadda ay Somaliland u leedahay amniga iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas, isaga oo tilmaamay in juqraafi ahaan Somaliland ay ku taallo meel muhiim u ah ilaalinta marinnada ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo danaha istiraatiijiga ah ee muhiimka u ah dalka Maraykanka. Sidoo kale, wuxuu carrabka ku dhuftay in Somaliland doonayso iskaashi ku salaysan dano-wadaag, masuuliyad iyo natiijooyin la taaban karo, gaar ahaan horumarinta iskaashiga amni, ballaadhinta ganacsiga, dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga Maraykanka iyo xoojinta xidhiidhada dhaqaale. Cabdiraxmaan Cirro oo dhawr cisho ku sugan Mareykanka ayaa horay u booqday National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial ee dalka Maraykanka, oo ah goobaha lagu xuso dadkii ku naf waayey weerarradii argagixiso ee dhacay 11-kii Sebtembar, 2001. Booqashadaas ayaa xambaarsanayd farriin siyaasadeed iyo bani’aadamnimo, iyadoo Madaxweynuhu xusay dhibbanayaashii weerarrada, isla markaana muujiyay in Somaliland ay taageersan tahay dadaallada caalamiga ah ee ka dhanka ah argagixisada. Farriinta Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa mid muujinaysa doonista Somaliland ee ku aaddan xoojinta xiriirka ay la leedahay Maraykanka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah.
