items.title: Ujeedka kulan Villa Somalia ku dhex-maray Xasan iyo safiirka Turkiga
items.description: Muqdsho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta Xarunta Madaxtooyada Qaranka ku qaabilay, Danjiraha Turkiga ee Soomaaliya Alper Aktaş, kaas oo soo gaba-gabeeyay howlgalkii diblumaasiyadeed ee dalka. Ujeedka kulanka ayaa ahaa mid sagootin ah, iyadoo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu Danjiraha uga mahadceliyay muddadii uu Soomaaliya ka soo shaqeeyay iyo dadaalladii uu ku bixiyay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa u rajeeyay safiirka guul iyo horumar, maadaama uu soo gaba-gabeeyay howlihii diblomaasiyadeed ee uu dalka u joogay. Danjire Alper Aktaş ayaa isna Madaxweynaha uga mahadceliyay soo dhaweynta iyo sagootinta loo sameeyay, isagoo xusay muddadii uu Soomaaliya ka shaqeynayay iyo xiriirka dhow ee labada dal. Sagootinta Danjire Alper Aktaş ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga uu marayo heer sare, iyadoo labada dowladood ay sii wadaan dadaallada lagu ballaarinayo iskaashiga labada dhinac. Turkiga ayaa kamid ah dalalka xiriirka dhow la leh Soomaaliya, iyadoo labada dowladood ay iska kaashadaan dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha, horumarinta iyo arrimo kale oo muhiim ah. Ankara ayaa sidoo kale door muuqda ka qaadatay taageerada Soomaaliya ee dhinacyada amniga iyo dhismaha hay’adaha dowladda, iyadoo labada dal ay sannadihii lasoo dhaafay xoojiyeen iskaashigooda istiraatiijiga ah. Ujeedka kulanka ayaa ahaa mid sagootin ah, iyadoo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu Danjiraha uga mahadceliyay muddadii uu Soomaaliya ka soo shaqeeyay iyo dadaalladii uu ku bixiyay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa u rajeeyay safiirka guul iyo horumar, maadaama uu soo gaba-gabeeyay howlihii diblomaasiyadeed ee uu dalka u joogay. Danjire Alper Aktaş ayaa isna Madaxweynaha uga mahadceliyay soo dhaweynta iyo sagootinta loo sameeyay, isagoo xusay muddadii uu Soomaaliya ka shaqeynayay iyo xiriirka dhow ee labada dal. Sagootinta Danjire Alper Aktaş ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga uu marayo heer sare, iyadoo labada dowladood ay sii wadaan dadaallada lagu ballaarinayo iskaashiga labada dhinac. Turkiga ayaa kamid ah dalalka xiriirka dhow la leh Soomaaliya, iyadoo labada dowladood ay iska kaashadaan dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha, horumarinta iyo arrimo kale oo muhiim ah. Ankara ayaa sidoo kale door muuqda ka qaadatay taageerada Soomaaliya ee dhinacyada amniga iyo dhismaha hay’adaha dowladda, iyadoo labada dal ay sannadihii lasoo dhaafay xoojiyeen iskaashigooda istiraatiijiga ah. items.title: Bosaso Airport Becomes Latest Front in Mogadishu–Puntland Power Struggle
items.description: Bosaso (WDN) — The deepening political and security rift between Somalia’s Federal Government and Puntland has reached another sensitive flashpoint after Puntland authorities reportedly stopped several officials, including two federal military officers, from leaving Bosaso Airport for Mogadishu. The two officers were reportedly among federal personnel recently brought under the control of the Federal Government following developments in the Kuur-ilaalo area of Rako-Raaxo district. Also prevented from traveling was Abdulkadir Haji Abdullahi “Waraabe,” director of the orthopedic hospital in Carmo. Sultan Mahmoud Haji Abdullahi, a prominent traditional leader from Bari, was also briefly detained before being released. Following his release, the Sultan called for the immediate release of those still being held, arguing that the individuals were traveling for personal reasons and had a legitimate right to do so. “They were traveling for their own personal interests and have the right to travel,” the Sultan said. A Much Deeper Dispute The airport incident is more than an isolated confrontation. It reflects the increasingly troubled relationship between Mogadishu and Garowe over federal authority, security forces, elections and constitutional powers. The Federal Government has increasingly sought to expand its political and security presence across the country, presenting the effort as part of strengthening national institutions. Puntland, however, has repeatedly viewed such moves with suspicion, arguing that federal forces cannot simply deploy or move through Puntland without coordination with the state administration. At the heart of the dispute is a fundamental question: where does federal authority end, and where does the authority of a Federal Member State begin? Trust Is Running Out The most serious consequence of the confrontation is the erosion of trust. Political disagreements between Puntland and Mogadishu are not new, but disputes that were once largely political have increasingly entered the security sphere. The movement of soldiers, military equipment and government officials can now become a source of confrontation. Critics of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration argue that Mogadishu is pursuing greater centralized control without first securing political consensus with the Federal Member States. They warn that expanding federal authority through security deployments rather than dialogue risks weakening, rather than strengthening, Somalia’s federal system. The absence of a clear public explanation from Puntland regarding the airport incident also leaves important questions unanswered. Nevertheless, the episode demonstrates how fragile relations have become. Bosaso as a Symbol Bosaso Airport has now become another visible symbol of Somalia’s unresolved federal crisis. What should have been a routine domestic journey instead became entangled in questions of political allegiance, security authority and competing jurisdictions. The larger danger is that continued confrontation could transform political mistrust into permanent institutional hostility. For Mogadishu, the message from Puntland should be clear: national authority cannot simply be asserted; it must be built through constitutional clarity, political dialogue and cooperation with the Federal Member States. For Puntland, however, the challenge is equally significant: responding to federal pressure without allowing political disagreements to develop into prolonged security confrontation. Until the two sides address the underlying dispute, incidents such as the one at Bosaso Airport are likely to remain symptoms of a much larger problem—the growing distance between Somalia’s Federal Government and one of its most politically assertive Federal Member States. items.title: Somaliland and Puntland Build Cordial Ties Through Security and Trade Cooperation
items.description: Washington (WDN) — Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro has highlighted what he described as a growing and constructive relationship between Somaliland and Puntland, emphasizing dialogue, security cooperation and easier movement of people and goods between the two neighboring administrations. Speaking during his visit to the United States, President Irro said that strengthening internal peace and maintaining stable relations with neighboring administrations had been among his government’s priorities since taking office. He singled out Puntland as an important partner, saying the two sides had established practical cooperation in areas of security, counterterrorism and the fight against piracy. “When I came to office, one of my highest priorities was peace within Somaliland and peace with neighboring administrations. We established relations with Puntland and agreed to cooperate on peace, as well as on combating terrorism and piracy,” Irro said. Joint Committees Strengthen Dialogue According to President Irro, Somaliland and Puntland have established joint committees to maintain regular communication and address issues of mutual concern. The committees have reportedly held several meetings, including sessions in Nairobi and Addis Ababa, where officials discussed ways to strengthen cooperation and facilitate relations between communities on both sides. Among the understandings reached, Irro said, was an agreement to facilitate the movement of people and commercial shipments between the two sides. “Somaliland and Puntland established joint committees that meet regularly. The committees have met twice in Nairobi and Addis Ababa, and we agreed to facilitate the movement of people and shipments,” he said. Security and Economic Interests The cooperation described by Irro extends beyond political dialogue. Security appears to be one of its most important components, particularly in confronting terrorism, piracy and other cross-border security threats. For communities living and trading across the wider region, improved cooperation could also have practical economic benefits. Easier movement of people, vehicles and commercial goods can strengthen trade and reduce disruptions along important transportation routes. The emphasis on practical cooperation is particularly significant given the complex political history between Somaliland and Puntland. Rather than allowing sensitive political questions to prevent communication, the two sides appear to be creating mechanisms through which issues can be discussed directly. A More Mature Approach President Irro’s remarks suggest a pragmatic approach in which Somaliland and Puntland can cooperate where their interests overlap, even while more sensitive political questions remain unresolved. Regular communication between officials, security cooperation and efforts to facilitate trade and movement can help reduce misunderstandings and strengthen confidence between neighboring communities. If sustained, this approach could represent an important shift toward a more cordial, mature and interest-based relationship between Somaliland and Puntland—one focused less on political rhetoric and more on the practical needs of their people. For now, President Irro’s message is clear: despite differences that may remain, Somaliland and Puntland can build common ground through dialogue, security cooperation, trade and people-to-people relations. items.title: Why Somalia matters to Turkey’s growing space ambitions
items.description: Mogadishu, Somalia — Somalia’s position near the equator and its long Indian Ocean coastline are making it a key part of Turkey’s push for independent access to space, as Ankara develops a launch facility near Warsheikh in Middle Shabelle. The project gained fresh attention after outgoing Turkish ambassador Alper Aktaş said a first satellite launch from Somali soil was expected in 2027, bringing a project once seen as a distant ambition closer to possible operation. “If I had said five or 10 years ago that one day Somalia would launch a satellite into space…” Aktaş said at an event in Mogadishu last week. He did not identify the satellite or provide technical details about the planned launch, but his remarks underscored the growing importance of the Warsheikh facility to Turkey’s wider space programme. For Ankara, the reasons for choosing Somalia are increasingly clear. What Somalia ultimately gains from one of the most technologically ambitious projects undertaken on its territory is less well defined. Geography is the asset Somalia’s main advantage is geography. A launch site close to the equator allows rockets heading into suitable orbits to take greater advantage of the Earth’s rotation. NASA explains that a spacecraft launched near the equator is already moving eastwards at more than 1,650 kilometres per hour, reducing the amount of fuel required or allowing a rocket to carry a heavier payload. The same principle helps explain why Europe operates the Guiana Space Centre in French Guiana, only a few degrees north of the equator. Somalia also has a long coastline facing the Indian Ocean. Rockets can be launched eastwards over open water, reducing the risk of populated areas being struck by falling stages or debris and providing greater flexibility in some launch trajectories. Turkish Industry and Technology Minister Mehmet Fatih Kacır said that feasibility studies had examined potential locations before identifying Somalia as the “most advantageous region” for the planned spaceport. He said feasibility and design work had been completed and the first phase of construction had begun on land allocated to Turkey under a bilateral cooperation agreement. The site is near Warsheikh, a coastal town about 70 kilometres north of Mogadishu. Ankara’s missing piece For Turkey, the facility would fill an important gap in a space programme that has expanded rapidly but still relies on foreign launch infrastructure. Turkey has developed its own communications and observation satellites, sent its first astronaut to the International Space Station and is preparing a lunar spacecraft for launch in 2027. But building satellites and spacecraft is different from being able to launch them independently. Turkey’s National Space Programme identifies independent access to space as a strategic objective, including the development of a launch vehicle system and the establishment of a spaceport. The Warsheikh project could provide the geographical component Turkey cannot reproduce at home. Turkish Space Agency chief Yusuf Kıraç said in April that the Somali spaceport was intended to provide Turkey with long-term independent access to space while offering payload advantages due to its equatorial location. Kacır has also said the facility could eventually serve the global commercial launch market, allowing Turkey to generate revenue from satellite launches, testing and integration services. That means Warsheikh could become more than a launch site for Turkish government missions. Ankara envisages infrastructure capable of supporting a commercial space industry while reducing its dependence on foreign launch facilities. Meanwhile, Turkey is preparing a lunar spacecraft for the first months of 2027, using a domestically developed hybrid propulsion system. Kacır has described the Somali spaceport as part of the country’s effort to secure independent and cost-effective access to space. The project may also carry a wider strategic dimension. Somalia Today reported in July that the Warsheikh facility could also be used to test long-range ballistic missiles. Turkey has publicly emphasised the project’s civilian space role and has not confirmed such plans. What does Somalia get? For Somalia, officials have presented the project as an opportunity to move beyond simply hosting infrastructure and develop expertise in science and advanced technology. After talks between Somalia’s ambassador to Turkey and Turkish Space Agency officials in June, the project was expected to create opportunities for Somali youth in science, technology, research, and other skilled sectors. It said the cooperation would also support knowledge transfer, capacity-building and economic growth , while helping Somalia participate more directly in the global space and technology industry. But public statements so far provide much more detail about the strategic and commercial benefits for Turkey than about how those benefits will be shared with Somalia. Neither side has publicly set out how many Somali engineers or other specialists will work at the facility, what role Somali institutions will have in launch operations, how commercial revenues will be structured or how technology transfer will work in practice. Kacır has said the spaceport will generate revenue for Turkey while contributing to Somalia’s development, but the precise economic arrangements have not been disclosed. That distinction matters because hosting a spaceport is not the same as developing an independent national space industry. If launches begin in 2027, the longer-term measure of the project for Somalia will be whether it produces skilled jobs, scientific expertise, institutional capacity and economic returns beyond the launch site itself. Somalia’s geography has already made it valuable to Turkey’s space ambitions. The next question is how much of that advantage Somalia can turn into technological and economic capability of its own. items.title: FBI Offers $150,000 Reward for Somali-American Man Wanted in Multimillion-Dollar COVID Fraud Case
items.description: Washington (WDN)- U.S. authorities allege that Fahad Mohamed Noor participated in a scheme to defraud federal programs established to provide meals to children during the COVID-19 pandemic. The programs were created as part of the U.S. government’s emergency response to the pandemic and distributed substantial amounts of federal money through organizations responsible for providing food to children and families. According to the allegations, a food-supply company associated with Noor received more than $5 million in federal funds. Investigators contend that false invoices, financial records and meal-delivery claims were submitted to make it appear that large quantities of food had been purchased and distributed to children when, in some cases, the meals allegedly had never been provided. The alleged conduct forms part of a much broader investigation into fraud involving COVID-era federal assistance programs in the United States. Prosecutors have pursued numerous individuals and organizations accused of exploiting emergency funding intended for vulnerable communities during the pandemic. The allegations against Noor reportedly include wire fraud and money laundering. These are serious federal offenses, but it is important to distinguish an allegation or criminal charge from a finding of guilt. The government must prove the charges in court, and Noor remains legally presumed innocent unless and until a court determines otherwise. A federal court in Minnesota issued an arrest warrant for Noor in September 2022. Since then, U.S. authorities have continued efforts to locate him and bring him before the American justice system. The FBI now says it believes Noor may be in Somalia, adding an international dimension to the case. The FBI is offering up to $150,000 for information leading to his location and arrest. The size of the reward reflects the bureau’s continuing effort to locate Noor after several years and its belief that information from members of the public could help authorities determine his whereabouts. For journalistic purposes, Noor should therefore be described as a wanted defendant or fugitive accused of federal fraud-related offenses, rather than as a convicted fraudster. The FBI’s reward announcement is an indication that U.S. authorities are actively seeking him; it is not itself a judicial determination that he is guilty. If Noor is arrested and brought before a U.S. court, the prosecution would have to present evidence establishing the charges beyond a reasonable doubt. He would retain all legal rights afforded to an accused defendant, including the presumption of innocence and the right to contest the government’s allegations. The case therefore represents two separate stories: the FBI’s continuing effort to locate a man it says is wanted in connection with an alleged multimillion-dollar COVID-era fraud scheme, and the unresolved legal question of whether the allegations against him can ultimately be proven in court. items.title: Guddiga doorashooyinka  oo magacaabay Madaxa Xafiiska Guddiga ee Galmudug
items.description: Muqdisho, Sebteembar 15, 2026 – Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxa-Bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (GMDQS), Mudane Cabdikariim Axmed Xasan, ayaa magacaabay Madaxa Xafiiska Guddiga ee Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga ayaa, isagoo cuskanaya Qodobka 10-aad, farqaddiisa 9-aad, iyo Qodobka 14-aad ee Sharciga Dhisidda Guddiga Madaxa-Bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha, u magacaabay Mudane Cismaan Geelle Jaamac inuu noqdo Madaxa Xafiiska Guddiga ee Galmudug. Cismaan Geelle Jaamac ayaa lagu amray inuu sida ugu dhaqsiyaha badan ula wareego xilka iyo Xafiiska Guddiga ee Galmudug, isla markaana uu guddo waajibaadka loo igmaday si waafaqsan shuruucda, habraacyada iyo xeerarka doorashooyinka ee GMDQS. Magacaabistan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Guddiga Madaxa-Bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha uu ku xoojinayo xafiisyadiisa heer dowlad-goboleed iyo diyaar-garowga howlaha doorashooyinka ee dalka.

Cismaan Geelle Jaamac ayaa lagu amray inuu sida ugu dhaqsiyaha badan ula wareego xilka iyo Xafiiska Guddiga ee Galmudug, isla markaana uu guddo waajibaadka loo igmaday si waafaqsan shuruucda, habraacyada iyo xeerarka doorashooyinka ee GMDQS. Magacaabistan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Guddiga Madaxa-Bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha uu ku xoojinayo xafiisyadiisa heer dowlad-goboleed iyo diyaar-garowga howlaha doorashooyinka ee dalka.

items.title: Difaaca Madaniga Sacuudiga oo digniin ka soo saaray xaaladda cimilada ee Makkah
items.description: Makkah, Sacuudi Carabiya – 15 Sebtembar 2026: Hay’adda Difaaca Madaniga ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa soo saartay digniin la xiriirta xaalad cimilo oo saameyn karta qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Makkah Al-Mukarramah, iyadoo la filayo roobab dhexdhexaad ilaa kuwo xooggan. Digniinta ayaa sheegaysa in roobabka ay keeni karaan daadad iyo dabaylo xooggan oo boor iyo ciid kicin kara. Hay’addu waxay shacabka iyo dadka booqanaya Makkah ugu baaqday inay qaataan taxaddar dheeraad ah. Difaaca Madaniga ayaa sidoo kale dadka kula dardaarmay inay ka fogaadaan meelaha ay biyuhu ku ururaan, togagga iyo marinada daadadka, ayna si buuxda u raacaan tilmaamaha ay soo saaraan hay’adaha rasmiga ah. Wararka la helayo waxay muujinayaan in digniinaha cimilada ay qayb ka yihiin xaalad roobaad oo ka jirta dhowr gobol oo Sacuudiga ah, iyadoo Makkah ay ka mid tahay meelaha laga filayo roobab iyo suuragalnimada daadad.

items.title: Kalfadhiga 74-aad ee Aan Caadiga ahayn ee IGAD oo Jabuuti Ka Furmay
items.description: Magaalada Jabuuti ayaa si rasmi ah uga furmay Kalfadhiga 74-aad ee aan caadiga ahayn ee Golaha Wasiirrada Urur-Goboleedka IGAD. Soomaaliya waxaa shirka uga qaybgalaya Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali, oo hoggaaminaya wafdiga Soomaaliya. Kalfadhiga ayaa diiradda lagu saaraya arrimaha nabadda iyo amniga Geeska Afrika, iyo sidoo kale xoojinta heshiiska, wadajirka iyo hay’adaha IGAD. Furitaanka kalfadhigan ayaa ah horumar cusub, maadaama xogtii hore ay xaqiijisay oo keliya imaatinka Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ee Jabuuti. Go’aannada kama dambaysta ah ee shirka iyo qodobada Soomaaliya sida gaarka ah u khuseeya ayaa la filayaa in lagu caddeeyo war-murtiyeedka kasoo baxa kalfadhiga.

items.title: Aqalka Sare oo Dib u Eegaya Hindise-Sharciga Hay’adda Saadaasha Hawada iyo Cimilada
items.description: Guddiga Kheyraadka Qaranka, Kaabayaasha, Dhaqaalaha iyo Gaadiidka ee Aqalka Sare ayaa kulan la yeeshay Wasiir-ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Deegaanka, Xuseen Cali Xaaji, iyagoo ka wada hadlay hindise-sharciyeedka lagu dhisayo Hay’adda Adeegyada Saadaasha Hawada iyo Cimilada Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray qodobbada hindise-sharciga, iyadoo guddigu mas’uuliyiinta Wasaaradda Deegaanka weydiiyey su’aalo iyo caddeyn ku saabsan qodobo ka mid ah hindisaha. Mas’uuliyiinta Wasaaradda ayaa ka jawaabay su’aalihii guddiga, iyadoo kulanku qayb ka yahay hannaanka dib-u-eegista iyo diyaarinta sharciga. Hindise-sharcigan ayaa weli ku jira marxaladda dib-u-eegista, mana jirto ilaa hadda xog rasmi ah oo ku saabsan wax-ka-beddellada ugu dambeeya ama waqtiga loo qorsheeyay codbixinta.

items.title: IFC oo $2.8 Milyan ku Maalgelisay KIMS Microfinance
items.description: Hay’adda Maaliyadda Caalamiga ah ee IFC ayaa Soomaaliya ka bilowday maalgelinteedii ugu horreysay, iyadoo $2.8 milyan oo maalgelin waafaqsan mabaadi’da maaliyadda Islaamiga ah u qoondeysay KIMS Microfinance. Maalgelintan ayaa ka kooban $1 milyan oo ay bixisay IFC iyo $1.8 milyan oo ay bixiyeen AtoZ Foundation iyo Symbiotics, iyadoo dammaanad qayb ah laga helayo IDA20 Private Sector Window. KIMS Microfinance ayaa qorsheynaysa in ay kordhiso tirada dadka ay adeegyada maaliyadeed siiso, iyadoo macaamiisheeda amaahda qaata oo hadda lagu qiyaasay 5,200 la doonayo in laga dhigo 10,000 marka la gaaro 2028. Sidoo kale, shirkaddu waxay hiigsanaysaa in ay gaarto 100,000 oo macaamiil cusub marka la gaaro 2030. Maalgelintan ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo muhiim u ah ballaarinta adeegyada maaliyadeed ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dadka iyo ganacsiyada yaryar ee aan si fudud u heli karin adeegyada bangiyada iyo maalgelinta.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Britain oo Ka Wada-hadlay Dib-u-habaynta Dhaqaalaha
items.description: Wasiirka Maaliyadda Soomaaliya, Biixi Iimaan Cige, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Safiirka Britain ee Soomaaliya, Charles King, iyagoo ka wada-hadlay arrimo la xiriira dib-u-habaynta dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya iyo xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale diiradda lagu saaray fursadaha Soomaaliya uga bannaan maalgelinta la xiriirta isbeddelka cimilada iyo taageerada waaxda amniga. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Britain. Ilaa hadda lama shaacin heshiis cusub ama lacag gaar ah oo Britain ay Soomaaliya ugu dhawaaqday, iyadoo faahfaahinta kulanka lagu sheegay in ay ahayd wada-tashi ku saabsan iskaashiga dhaqaale iyo arrimaha mudnaanta u leh Soomaaliya.

items.title: Sacuudi Carabiya oo digniin ka soo saartay halis ku soo wajahan Makka iyo…
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa maanta oo Talaado ah digniin degdeg ah ka soo saartay magaalooyinka Makka, Jeddah iyo Taif, iyadoo shacabka uga digtay “khatar suuragal ah” oo aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin nooca ay tahay. Digniinta ayaa loo diray dadka ku nool magaalooyinkan iyadoo loo marayo nidaamka qaran ee digniinta hore ee xaaladaha degdegga ah, sida ay sheegtay Hay’adda Difaaca Madaniga ah ee Sacuudiga. Hay’addu waxay shacabka ugu baaqday inay isdejiyaan, isla markaana si degdeg ah ugu hoydaan meel ammaan ah, gaar ahaan gudaha dhismayaasha ama qolalka ka fog daaqadaha, ayna halkaas joogaan ilaa laga xaqiijinayo in khatartu dhammaatay. Dadka ayaa sidoo kale lagula taliyey inay ka fogaadaan goobaha bannaan, balakoonnada, saqafyada dhismayaasha iyo meelaha ay dadku isugu yimaadaan. Dadka bannaanka ku sugan waxaa lagu amray inay galaan dhismaha ugu dhow ama ay isku qariyaan meel adag oo difaac leh. Darawallada digniinta helay ayaa iyagana lagu boorriyey inay baabuurta joojiyaan meelo ka fog buundooyinka iyo dhismayaasha dhaadheer, halka shacabka guud ahaan laga codsaday inay macluumaadka iyo tilmaamaha amniga kala socdaan oo keliya ilo rasmi ah. Mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudiga markii hore ma aysan sheegin waxa sababay digniinta ama nooca khatarta laga cabsi qabay. Digniintan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli ay si weyn u kacsan tahay xaaladda amni ee gobolka, kadib markii xoogagga Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay maalmihii u dambeeyey kordhiyeen weerarrada gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ay ku qaadayaan magaalooyin iyo kaabayaal muhiim ah oo ku yaalla Sacuudi Carabiya. Sacuudiga ayaa dhankiisa duqeymo ka fuliyey goobo ay Xuutiyiintu kaga sugan yihiin Yemen, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in colaadda labada dhinac ay mar kale isu beddesho dagaal ballaaran. Makka, oo ah magaalada ugu barakeysan Muslimiinta, ayaa ka mid ahayd goobaha digniinta laga soo saaray, taas oo sare u qaaday dareenka ku saabsan khatarta ka dhalan karta dagaalka sii xoogeysanaya ee gobolka. items.title: Africa’s Growing Divide: Kenya’s Deportation of Small-Scale Foreign Traders
items.description: By Osman Ali Hassan Across Africa, growing restrictions on the movement of people and cross-border trade are deepening economic and social divides, undermining regional integration and challenging the vision of a more connected continent. The recent Kenya’s plan to expel small-scale foreign traders reflects these broader tensions over migration, informal commerce, and economic competition, raising important questions about African solidarity, freedom of movement, and the future of intra-African trade and integration. On the particular matter and the question of whether Somalis are among the small-scale foreign traders being deported from Kenya has become increasingly important because of recent developments surrounding foreign-owned small businesses, immigration enforcement, work permits, and the protection of opportunities for Kenyan citizens. The issue is particularly sensitive because Kenya has a large Somali population, including Kenyan citizens of Somali ethnic origin, Somali refugees, asylum seekers, permanent residents, and Somali nationals who live, work, trade, or operate businesses in the country. It is therefore important to distinguish between being Somali by ethnicity and being a foreign national of Somali citizenship. A Kenyan citizen of Somali ethnicity is not a foreigner and cannot properly be treated as an undocumented foreign trader simply because he or she is Somali. At the same time, a Somali citizen who does not possess the immigration or work authorization required by Kenyan law may be subject to immigration enforcement like other foreign nationals. The current situation therefore requires a careful distinction between nationality, ethnicity, immigration status, and the legality of commercial activity. Recent developments in Kenya have created considerable anxiety among foreign small-scale traders. In September 2026, President William Ruto directed authorities to take action against small-scale businesses operated by foreign traders, following complaints from Kenyan traders concerning economic competition, taxation, and the ability of local citizens to earn a livelihood. The government subsequently has halted and announced a 90-day period for foreign business operators to obtain or update necessary documentation, including work permits and business licenses. The government has also emphasized that the initiative is intended to regularize foreign business activity rather than encourage harassment, intimidation, or xenophobia. This distinction is critical when asking whether Somalis are being deported. At the time of the latest reports, there is no reliable evidence that Kenya has announced a policy specifically targeting Somali nationals for mass deportation because they are Somali small-scale traders. The available reporting has focused heavily on Burundians, many of whom operate informal businesses in Nairobi, and on foreign traders generally. Hundreds of Burundians reportedly sought assistance from their embassy because they feared that the government’s announcement could result in their removal from Kenya. The Kenyan government responded by announcing an amnesty period for undocumented East African nationals and giving them time to regularize their status. Nevertheless, Somali nationals who operate small businesses in Kenya without the required immigration and work authorization could potentially be affected by the enforcement campaign. This is not because they are Somali, but because they are foreign nationals whose legal status and business authorization may not satisfy Kenyan requirements. Kenya’s Citizenship and Immigration Act provides a legal framework for immigration control and defines a foreign national as a person who is not a Kenyan citizen. The law also provides mechanisms for removing persons whose presence in Kenya is unlawful. It further states that a non-citizen who engages in employment, occupation, trade, business, or a profession without the required authorization may commit an offence. The legal distinction between a Kenyan Somali and a Somali foreign national is therefore fundamental. Kenya’s Somali community is one of the country’s historically established communities, particularly in northeastern Kenya and major urban centers such as Nairobi, Garissa, Wajir, Mandera, Mombasa, and other parts of the country. Many people who are culturally, linguistically, and ethnically Somali are Kenyan citizens. Their Somali identity does not make them foreigners. A Kenyan citizen running a small shop, restaurant, clothing business, transportation business, import business, or other enterprise is exercising rights associated with Kenyan citizenship. Such a person should not be classified as a foreign trader merely because of appearance, language, religion, family origin, or ethnic background. The situation is different for Somali nationals who entered Kenya from Somalia and have remained in Kenya as refugees, asylum seekers, visitors, workers, investors, or undocumented migrants. Their legal rights and responsibilities depend upon their particular immigration or refugee status. Some Somali nationals have lived in Kenya for many years and may have established families, businesses, homes, community organizations, and social relationships. Long-term residence, however, does not automatically transform a foreign national into a Kenyan citizen. Where citizenship has not been established, the individual may still be subject to immigration requirements. This distinction becomes particularly important in the context of small-scale trade. Small businesses are often the first economic activity available to migrants who have limited access to formal employment. A foreign national may begin by selling clothing, household goods, food products, electronics, cosmetics, shoes, construction materials, mobile-phone accessories, or other consumer goods. Such businesses can become essential sources of income for entire families. They can also create employment, contribute to local supply chains, pay rent, purchase goods from Kenyan wholesalers, and generate taxes and fees. At the same time, Kenyan citizens who operate similar businesses may believe that they are being placed at a disadvantage when foreign traders enter markets with greater access to imported goods, international financing, family networks, or cross-border supply chains. The tension between local economic opportunity and immigration rights is therefore not unique to Kenya. Many countries face similar debates when foreign nationals participate in sectors traditionally dominated by local citizens. Governments are often pressured to protect citizens from unfair competition while simultaneously maintaining an environment that welcomes legitimate investment, tourism, regional trade, and foreign workers. The challenge is to enforce economic and immigration laws without turning legitimate regulation into collective punishment against an ethnic or national group. Kenya’s current situation demonstrates this challenge clearly. President Ruto’s comments created significant fear among foreign communities because the initial message concerning foreign small-scale businesses was understood by some migrants as a possible order for foreigners to leave. The subsequent government clarification was that foreigners with legitimate status and documentation would have an opportunity to regularize their businesses and immigration status. The government also warned against harassment and xenophobia. The government’s decision to provide a period for regularization is significant. Deportation is a much more serious action than requiring a business owner to obtain a license or a work permit. Under Kenyan law, removal from the country is connected to unlawful presence and formal immigration procedures. The Citizenship and Immigration Act gives the Cabinet Secretary authority to make a written removal order concerning a person whose presence in Kenya is unlawful. The law also provides for detention and judicial review in circumstances involving removal. Consequently, it would be inaccurate to say that every foreign Somali small-scale trader in Kenya is being deported. A person with valid immigration status, appropriate authorization, and lawful business documentation should not automatically be subject to deportation simply because the person is a Somali national. Likewise, a Kenyan citizen of Somali ethnicity is not a foreign national at all. The current policy should therefore be understood primarily through the categories of citizenship, immigration status, business authorization, and compliance with Kenyan law. However, the fear among foreign traders should not be dismissed. The experiences of Burundians reported in Nairobi demonstrate how quickly government announcements can create uncertainty among immigrant communities. Reuters reported that hundreds of Burundians went to their embassy seeking travel documents because they feared possible expulsion and insecurity. Some reportedly felt unwanted despite the government’s subsequent announcement of a 90-day amnesty and its assurances that registered foreigners would have their rights protected. Somali communities may naturally pay close attention to these developments because of Kenya’s long and complicated history with Somali populations. Somali communities in Kenya have experienced periods of discrimination, security screening, restrictions, and suspicion, particularly during periods of terrorism-related security concerns. The historical record demonstrates why immigration enforcement involving Somalis must be carried out carefully and individually rather than through broad assumptions about ethnicity or national origin. At the same time, a Somali citizen who does not possess the immigration or work authorization required by Kenyan law may be subject to immigration enforcement like other foreign nationals. The current situation therefore requires a careful distinction between nationality, ethnicity, immigration status, and the legality of commercial activity. Recent developments in Kenya have created considerable anxiety among foreign small-scale traders. In September 2026, President William Ruto directed authorities to take action against small-scale businesses operated by foreign traders, following complaints from Kenyan traders concerning economic competition, taxation, and the ability of local citizens to earn a livelihood. The government subsequently has halted and announced a 90-day period for foreign business operators to obtain or update necessary documentation, including work permits and business licenses. The government has also emphasized that the initiative is intended to regularize foreign business activity rather than encourage harassment, intimidation, or xenophobia. This distinction is critical when asking whether Somalis are being deported. At the time of the latest reports, there is no reliable evidence that Kenya has announced a policy specifically targeting Somali nationals for mass deportation because they are Somali small-scale traders. The available reporting has focused heavily on Burundians, many of whom operate informal businesses in Nairobi, and on foreign traders generally. Hundreds of Burundians reportedly sought assistance from their embassy because they feared that the government’s announcement could result in their removal from Kenya. The Kenyan government responded by announcing an amnesty period for undocumented East African nationals and giving them time to regularize their status. Nevertheless, Somali nationals who operate small businesses in Kenya without the required immigration and work authorization could potentially be affected by the enforcement campaign. This is not because they are Somali, but because they are foreign nationals whose legal status and business authorization may not satisfy Kenyan requirements. Kenya’s Citizenship and Immigration Act provides a legal framework for immigration control and defines a foreign national as a person who is not a Kenyan citizen. The law also provides mechanisms for removing persons whose presence in Kenya is unlawful. It further states that a non-citizen who engages in employment, occupation, trade, business, or a profession without the required authorization may commit an offence. The legal distinction between a Kenyan Somali and a Somali foreign national is therefore fundamental. Kenya’s Somali community is one of the country’s historically established communities, particularly in northeastern Kenya and major urban centers such as Nairobi, Garissa, Wajir, Mandera, Mombasa, and other parts of the country. Many people who are culturally, linguistically, and ethnically Somali are Kenyan citizens. Their Somali identity does not make them foreigners. A Kenyan citizen running a small shop, restaurant, clothing business, transportation business, import business, or other enterprise is exercising rights associated with Kenyan citizenship. Such a person should not be classified as a foreign trader merely because of appearance, language, religion, family origin, or ethnic background. The situation is different for Somali nationals who entered Kenya from Somalia and have remained in Kenya as refugees, asylum seekers, visitors, workers, investors, or undocumented migrants. Their legal rights and responsibilities depend upon their particular immigration or refugee status. Some Somali nationals have lived in Kenya for many years and may have established families, businesses, homes, community organizations, and social relationships. Long-term residence, however, does not automatically transform a foreign national into a Kenyan citizen. Where citizenship has not been established, the individual may still be subject to immigration requirements. This distinction becomes particularly important in the context of small-scale trade. Small businesses are often the first economic activity available to migrants who have limited access to formal employment. A foreign national may begin by selling clothing, household goods, food products, electronics, cosmetics, shoes, construction materials, mobile-phone accessories, or other consumer goods. Such businesses can become essential sources of income for entire families. They can also create employment, contribute to local supply chains, pay rent, purchase goods from Kenyan wholesalers, and generate taxes and fees. At the same time, Kenyan citizens who operate similar businesses may believe that they are being placed at a disadvantage when foreign traders enter markets with greater access to imported goods, international financing, family networks, or cross-border supply chains. The tension between local economic opportunity and immigration rights is therefore not unique to Kenya. Many countries face similar debates when foreign nationals participate in sectors traditionally dominated by local citizens. Governments are often pressured to protect citizens from unfair competition while simultaneously maintaining an environment that welcomes legitimate investment, tourism, regional trade, and foreign workers. The challenge is to enforce economic and immigration laws without turning legitimate regulation into collective punishment against an ethnic or national group. Kenya’s current situation demonstrates this challenge clearly. President Ruto’s comments created significant fear among foreign communities because the initial message concerning foreign small-scale businesses was understood by some migrants as a possible order for foreigners to leave. The subsequent government clarification was that foreigners with legitimate status and documentation would have an opportunity to regularize their businesses and immigration status. The government also warned against harassment and xenophobia. The government’s decision to provide a period for regularization is significant. Deportation is a much more serious action than requiring a business owner to obtain a license or a work permit. Under Kenyan law, removal from the country is connected to unlawful presence and formal immigration procedures. The Citizenship and Immigration Act gives the Cabinet Secretary authority to make a written removal order concerning a person whose presence in Kenya is unlawful. The law also provides for detention and judicial review in circumstances involving removal. Consequently, it would be inaccurate to say that every foreign Somali small-scale trader in Kenya is being deported. A person with valid immigration status, appropriate authorization, and lawful business documentation should not automatically be subject to deportation simply because the person is a Somali national. Likewise, a Kenyan citizen of Somali ethnicity is not a foreign national at all. The current policy should therefore be understood primarily through the categories of citizenship, immigration status, business authorization, and compliance with Kenyan law. However, the fear among foreign traders should not be dismissed. The experiences of Burundians reported in Nairobi demonstrate how quickly government announcements can create uncertainty among immigrant communities. Reuters reported that hundreds of Burundians went to their embassy seeking travel documents because they feared possible expulsion and insecurity. Some reportedly felt unwanted despite the government’s subsequent announcement of a 90-day amnesty and its assurances that registered foreigners would have their rights protected. Somali communities may naturally pay close attention to these developments because of Kenya’s long and complicated history with Somali populations. Somali communities in Kenya have experienced periods of discrimination, security screening, restrictions, and suspicion, particularly during periods of terrorism-related security concerns. The historical record demonstrates why immigration enforcement involving Somalis must be carried out carefully and individually rather than through broad assumptions about ethnicity or national origin. items.title: Madaxweynaha Somaliland oo khudvad taariikh ah ka jeediyay
items.description: 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐊𝐡𝐮𝐝𝐛𝐚𝐝 𝐓𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐢𝐤𝐡𝐢 𝐚𝐡 𝐤𝐚 𝐣𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐲𝐞𝐲 𝐌𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐝𝐤𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐚𝐡 𝐞𝐞 𝐇𝐮𝐝𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐮𝐭𝐞, 𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐨𝐧 𝐃.𝐂. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, H.E. Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa khudbad taariikhi ah oo dhinacyo badan taabanaysa ka jeediyey Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Hudson Institute, Washington D.C. Machadkan oo ah Xarun Caalami ah oo Cilmi-baadhiseed, Siyaasadeed iyo Istiraatijiyadeed oo muddo dheer saameyn weyn ku leh doodaha ku saabsan amniga dalka Maraykanka, difaaca, siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda iyo nidaamka caalamiga ah; ayaa waxa hore khudbado uga jeediyey hoggaaminayeyaal iyo dad badan oo dunida magac ku leh; sida: Madaxweynihii hore ee Maraykanka Ronald Reagan, Madaxweyne ku-xigeenadii hore ee Maraykanka Mike Pence iyo Dick Cheney, Ra’iisal Wasaaraha Dalka Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu, Ra’iisal Wasaarihii hore ee Japan Shinzo Abe, Xoghayeyaashii hore ee Arrimaha Dibedda Maraykanka Henry Kissinger, George Schultz, Mike Pompeo, iwm. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha oo ku saabsanayd Somaliland oo ah lamaane (saaxiib) istiraatiiji ah oo ku yaalla Geeska Afrika (Somaliland as a Strategic Partner in the Horn of Africa), Madaxweynuhu waxa uu diiradda ku saaray aragtida Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee ku aaddan amniga Gobolka Geeska Afrika, xasilloonida Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah, ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga, iyo kaalinta ay Somaliland ka qaadan karto danaha wadajirka ah ee Maraykanka iyo xulufadiisa. Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Cirro waxa uu sheegay in muddo ka badan soddon sano, Somaliland ay dhisatay Dawlad shaqaynaysa, Haya’do Qaran oo awood leh, dhaqaale kobcaya iyo suq xor ah. Sida oo kale, waxa uu xusay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay qabatay doorashooyin badan oo kala duwan oo u dhacay si xor iyo xalaal ah, xukunka dalkana si nabad ah loola kala wareegay. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu khudbaddiisa si cad ugu iftiimiyey in muddo ka badan labaatan sano aanu dalka Somaliland gudahiisa ka dhicin wax weerarro argagixiso ahi, Qaranka JSL-na uu ku guulaystay in uu dalka iyo xeebihiisa ka ilaaliyo xag-jirnimada iyo budh-cad badeedda. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay guulahan wax-ku-oolka ah gaadhay iyada oo aan haysan aqoonsi caalami ah. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi mar uu ka hadlayay xaqa sharci iyo ka taariikheed ee jiritaanka Qarannimada Somaliland, waxa uu yidhi: “𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗮 𝗱𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗼 𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝘆 𝗱𝗶𝗯 𝘂 𝗯𝗲𝗱𝗲𝘀𝗵𝗼 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝘂𝘂𝗱𝗶𝗵𝗶𝗶 𝘂𝘂 𝗸𝗮 𝘁𝗮𝗴𝗮𝘆 𝗚𝘂𝗺𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗶𝗴𝘂; 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗱𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗮𝗮 𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝘆 𝗱𝗶𝗯 𝘂𝗹𝗮 𝘀𝗼𝗼 𝗻𝗼𝗾𝗼𝘁𝗼 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝘂𝘂𝗱𝗶𝗵𝗶𝗶 𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝘂 𝗹𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆𝗱.” “𝗗𝗼𝗼𝗱𝗱𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗱𝘂 𝗺𝗮 𝗮𝗵𝗮 𝗺𝗶𝗱 𝗸𝘂 𝘀𝗮𝗮𝗯𝘀𝗮𝗻 𝗴𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗶-𝗴𝗼𝗼𝘀𝗶, 𝗯𝗮𝗹𝘀𝗲 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝘀𝗮𝗹𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗮𝗻 𝘁𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆 𝗯𝘂𝗿𝗯𝘂𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗶 𝗺𝗶𝗱𝗼𝘄𝗴𝗶𝗶 𝗹𝗮𝗴𝘂 𝗵𝗼𝗻𝗴𝗼𝗼𝗯𝗮𝘆 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗱𝗶𝗯-𝘂-𝘀𝗼𝗼-𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝗱𝗮𝘄𝗹𝗮𝗱𝗻𝗶𝗺𝗮𝗱𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗱𝗶𝗶, 𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝗼𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗴𝘂 𝘀𝗮𝗹𝗮𝘆𝗻𝗮𝘆𝗼 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝘂𝘂𝗱𝗶𝗵𝗶𝗶 𝗴𝘂𝗺𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗮 𝗲𝗲 𝗰𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗺𝗸𝘂 𝗮𝗾𝗼𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗮, 𝗸𝘂𝘄𝗮𝗮𝘀 𝗼𝗼 𝗷𝗶𝗿𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝗮 𝗵𝗼𝗿 𝗺𝗶𝗱𝗼𝘄𝗴𝗶𝗶 𝟭𝟵𝟲𝟬.” Madaxweynuhu waxa uu xusay in tan iyo markii ay JSL ay dib ula soo noqotay madax-bannaanideeda, isbeddellada Juqraafi-Siyaasadeed ee ka dhacaya daafaha dunida iyo Geeska Afrika ay sii xoojiyeen is-waafajinta danaha wadaagga ah ee u dhexeeya Somaliland iyo Maraykanka. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland mar uu ka hadlayay arrimaha Soomaaliya waxa uu yidhi: “𝗗𝗮𝘄𝗹𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗦𝗼𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝗱𝗵𝗮𝗻 𝘁𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆 𝗦𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗔𝘄𝗼𝗼𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗺𝘂𝘀𝗵𝗼 𝗺𝗲𝗲𝗹 𝗸𝗮 𝗯𝗮𝘅𝘀𝗮𝗻 𝗠𝘂𝗾𝗱𝗶𝘀𝗵𝗼, 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮𝗻𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗻𝗼𝗾𝗼𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝗱𝘂𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝘅𝗮𝘀𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗶-𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝗲𝗲 𝗚𝗼𝗯𝗼𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗚𝗲𝗲𝘀𝗸𝗮𝗔𝗳𝗿𝗶𝗸𝗮. 𝗦𝗼𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝗺𝗮 𝗮𝗵𝗮 𝗼𝗼 𝗸𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝗳𝗮𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗺𝘂𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗱𝗮𝗱𝗸𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗱𝗮𝗹𝗸𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗮; 𝗯𝗮𝗹𝘀𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗱𝗮𝘅𝗯𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗮𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗱𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗼 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝘂 𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗲𝗴𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝘂𝗯 𝘀𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗲𝗱 𝗼𝗼 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝗰𝘂𝗿𝘆𝗮𝗮𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗼 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱.” Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si cad u bayaamiyey amniga iyo xasilloonida ka jira Somaliland iyo sida ay Dawladda Maraykanku isugu hallayn karto Somaliland, waxana uu yidhi: “𝗠𝘂𝗱𝗱𝗼 𝟯𝟱 𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗼 𝗮𝗵, 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗸𝗮𝗺𝗮 𝗱𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗻 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝘆𝗲𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗼 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝘄𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗿 𝗹𝗼𝗼 𝗴𝗲𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗮𝘀𝗸𝗮𝗿𝗶 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗸𝗮𝗻 𝗮𝗵; 𝗱𝗵𝘂𝗹𝗸𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗴𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗯𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗮 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗴𝗮𝗺𝗮 𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗷𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗻 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗮𝗯 𝗮𝗺𝗮 𝗗𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗱 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗸𝗮𝗻 𝗹𝗲𝗲𝘆𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆. 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝘆 𝗻𝗼𝗾𝗼𝗻 𝗵𝗼𝘆 𝗮𝘆 𝗴𝗮𝗯𝗯𝗮𝗮𝗱 𝗸𝗮 𝗱𝗵𝗶𝗴𝘁𝗮𝗮𝗻 𝗸𝗼𝗼𝘅𝗼 𝗸𝗮 𝘀𝗼𝗼 𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗷𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗮 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗸𝗮𝗻𝗸𝗮.” Madaxweynaha Somaliland waxa uu khudbaddiisa ku dul istaagay goobta muhiimka ah ee ay ku taallo Somaliland oo ah marin-biyoodyada iyo hilinnada tamarta ugu istiraatiijisan dunida, taasi oo Maraykanka u suurto gelinaysa in uu mandaqaddan ku yeelan karo saaxiib lagu kalsoonaan karo, isla markaana siinaya awood uu ku ilaashan karo danihiisa buqcaddan muhiimka ah, isaga oo aan ku tiirsanaan hal dhinac oo keliya. Waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in Somaliland ay Maraykanka u soo bandhigayso ikhtiyaar iyo saaxiib la isku hallayn karo, kaasi oo aanu haatan ku haysan xeebtan. Dhinaca kale, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si gaar ah u xusay in Aqoonsiga Israa’iil uu ka tarjumayo isbeddel cusub oo ku wajahan Geeska Afrika, iyada oo ay Dawladuhu haatan ka gudbayaan hab-dhaqankii diblomaasiyadeed ee duugoobay, iyaga oo qiimayntooda ku salaynaya danaha amni ee la wadaago. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in Somaliland iyo Israa’iil ay yihiin laba dal oo dimuqraaddi ah oo ku kala yaalla labada darif ee Badda Cas, kana wada shaqaynaya xasilloonida, barwaaqada iyo amniga Gobolka Geeska Afrika iyo Bariga Dhexe. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Hudson Institute, waxa ay xoojinaysaa dedaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo himiladeeda ku aaddan in Bulshada Caalamku ay si dhab ah u fahanto sooyaalkeeda taariikheed, rabitaanka shacabkeeda, nidaamkeeda dimuqraadiga ah iyo muhiimadda juqraafiyeed iyo ta istiraatiijiyadeed ee ay Somaliland u leedahay Caalamka. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa ay ahayd farriin cad oo ku socota Washington iyo saaxiibbada Somaliland: Somaliland waxa ay diyaar u tahay iskaashi istiraatiiji ah oo ku dhisan dano wadaag, is-ixtiraam, nabad, amni iyo horumar waara.

Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa khudbad taariikhi ah oo dhinacyo badan taabanaysa ka jeediyey Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Hudson Institute, Washington D.C. Machadkan oo ah Xarun Caalami ah oo Cilmi-baadhiseed, Siyaasadeed iyo Istiraatijiyadeed oo muddo dheer saameyn weyn ku leh doodaha ku saabsan amniga dalka Maraykanka, difaaca, siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda iyo nidaamka caalamiga ah; ayaa waxa hore khudbado uga jeediyey hoggaaminayeyaal iyo dad badan oo dunida magac ku leh; sida: Madaxweynihii hore ee Maraykanka Ronald Reagan, Madaxweyne ku-xigeenadii hore ee Maraykanka Mike Pence iyo Dick Cheney, Ra’iisal Wasaaraha Dalka Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu, Ra’iisal Wasaarihii hore ee Japan Shinzo Abe, Xoghayeyaashii hore ee Arrimaha Dibedda Maraykanka Henry Kissinger, George Schultz, Mike Pompeo, iwm. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha oo ku saabsanayd Somaliland oo ah lamaane (saaxiib) istiraatiiji ah oo ku yaalla Geeska Afrika (Somaliland as a Strategic Partner in the Horn of Africa), Madaxweynuhu waxa uu diiradda ku saaray aragtida Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee ku aaddan amniga Gobolka Geeska Afrika, xasilloonida Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah, ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga, iyo kaalinta ay Somaliland ka qaadan karto danaha wadajirka ah ee Maraykanka iyo xulufadiisa. Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Cirro waxa uu sheegay in muddo ka badan soddon sano, Somaliland ay dhisatay Dawlad shaqaynaysa, Haya’do Qaran oo awood leh, dhaqaale kobcaya iyo suq xor ah. Sida oo kale, waxa uu xusay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay qabatay doorashooyin badan oo kala duwan oo u dhacay si xor iyo xalaal ah, xukunka dalkana si nabad ah loola kala wareegay. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu khudbaddiisa si cad ugu iftiimiyey in muddo ka badan labaatan sano aanu dalka Somaliland gudahiisa ka dhicin wax weerarro argagixiso ahi, Qaranka JSL-na uu ku guulaystay in uu dalka iyo xeebihiisa ka ilaaliyo xag-jirnimada iyo budh-cad badeedda. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay guulahan wax-ku-oolka ah gaadhay iyada oo aan haysan aqoonsi caalami ah. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi mar uu ka hadlayay xaqa sharci iyo ka taariikheed ee jiritaanka Qarannimada Somaliland, waxa uu yidhi: “𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗮 𝗱𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗼 𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝘆 𝗱𝗶𝗯 𝘂 𝗯𝗲𝗱𝗲𝘀𝗵𝗼 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝘂𝘂𝗱𝗶𝗵𝗶𝗶 𝘂𝘂 𝗸𝗮 𝘁𝗮𝗴𝗮𝘆 𝗚𝘂𝗺𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗶𝗴𝘂; 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗱𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗮𝗮 𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝘆 𝗱𝗶𝗯 𝘂𝗹𝗮 𝘀𝗼𝗼 𝗻𝗼𝗾𝗼𝘁𝗼 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝘂𝘂𝗱𝗶𝗵𝗶𝗶 𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝘂 𝗹𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆𝗱.” “𝗗𝗼𝗼𝗱𝗱𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗱𝘂 𝗺𝗮 𝗮𝗵𝗮 𝗺𝗶𝗱 𝗸𝘂 𝘀𝗮𝗮𝗯𝘀𝗮𝗻 𝗴𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗶-𝗴𝗼𝗼𝘀𝗶, 𝗯𝗮𝗹𝘀𝗲 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝘀𝗮𝗹𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗮𝗻 𝘁𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆 𝗯𝘂𝗿𝗯𝘂𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗶 𝗺𝗶𝗱𝗼𝘄𝗴𝗶𝗶 𝗹𝗮𝗴𝘂 𝗵𝗼𝗻𝗴𝗼𝗼𝗯𝗮𝘆 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗱𝗶𝗯-𝘂-𝘀𝗼𝗼-𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝗱𝗮𝘄𝗹𝗮𝗱𝗻𝗶𝗺𝗮𝗱𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗱𝗶𝗶, 𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝗼𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗴𝘂 𝘀𝗮𝗹𝗮𝘆𝗻𝗮𝘆𝗼 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝘂𝘂𝗱𝗶𝗵𝗶𝗶 𝗴𝘂𝗺𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗮 𝗲𝗲 𝗰𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗺𝗸𝘂 𝗮𝗾𝗼𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗮, 𝗸𝘂𝘄𝗮𝗮𝘀 𝗼𝗼 𝗷𝗶𝗿𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝗮 𝗵𝗼𝗿 𝗺𝗶𝗱𝗼𝘄𝗴𝗶𝗶 𝟭𝟵𝟲𝟬.” Madaxweynuhu waxa uu xusay in tan iyo markii ay JSL ay dib ula soo noqotay madax-bannaanideeda, isbeddellada Juqraafi-Siyaasadeed ee ka dhacaya daafaha dunida iyo Geeska Afrika ay sii xoojiyeen is-waafajinta danaha wadaagga ah ee u dhexeeya Somaliland iyo Maraykanka. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland mar uu ka hadlayay arrimaha Soomaaliya waxa uu yidhi: “𝗗𝗮𝘄𝗹𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗦𝗼𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝗱𝗵𝗮𝗻 𝘁𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆 𝗦𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗔𝘄𝗼𝗼𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗺𝘂𝘀𝗵𝗼 𝗺𝗲𝗲𝗹 𝗸𝗮 𝗯𝗮𝘅𝘀𝗮𝗻 𝗠𝘂𝗾𝗱𝗶𝘀𝗵𝗼, 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮𝗻𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗻𝗼𝗾𝗼𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝘅𝘂𝗱𝗱𝘂𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝘅𝗮𝘀𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗶-𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝗲𝗲 𝗚𝗼𝗯𝗼𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗚𝗲𝗲𝘀𝗸𝗮𝗔𝗳𝗿𝗶𝗸𝗮. 𝗦𝗼𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝗺𝗮 𝗮𝗵𝗮 𝗼𝗼 𝗸𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘆𝗮 𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝗳𝗮𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗺𝗮𝗮𝗺𝘂𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗱𝗮𝗱𝗸𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗱𝗮𝗹𝗸𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗮; 𝗯𝗮𝗹𝘀𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗱𝗮𝘅𝗯𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗮𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗱𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝗮𝘆𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗼 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝗮 𝗮𝘆 𝘂 𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗲𝗴𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗵𝘂𝗯 𝘀𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗲𝗱 𝗼𝗼 𝗮𝘆 𝗸𝘂 𝗰𝘂𝗿𝘆𝗮𝗮𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗼 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱.” Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si cad u bayaamiyey amniga iyo xasilloonida ka jira Somaliland iyo sida ay Dawladda Maraykanku isugu hallayn karto Somaliland, waxana uu yidhi: “𝗠𝘂𝗱𝗱𝗼 𝟯𝟱 𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗼 𝗮𝗵, 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗸𝗮𝗺𝗮 𝗱𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗻 𝘄𝗮𝘅𝘆𝗲𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗼 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝘄𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗿 𝗹𝗼𝗼 𝗴𝗲𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗮𝘀𝗸𝗮𝗿𝗶 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗸𝗮𝗻 𝗮𝗵; 𝗱𝗵𝘂𝗹𝗸𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗴𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗯𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗮 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗴𝗮𝗺𝗮 𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗷𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗻 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗮𝗯 𝗮𝗺𝗮 𝗗𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗱 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗸𝗮𝗻 𝗹𝗲𝗲𝘆𝗮𝗵𝗮𝘆. 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝘆 𝗻𝗼𝗾𝗼𝗻 𝗵𝗼𝘆 𝗮𝘆 𝗴𝗮𝗯𝗯𝗮𝗮𝗱 𝗸𝗮 𝗱𝗵𝗶𝗴𝘁𝗮𝗮𝗻 𝗸𝗼𝗼𝘅𝗼 𝗸𝗮 𝘀𝗼𝗼 𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗷𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗮 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗸𝗮𝗻𝗸𝗮.” Madaxweynaha Somaliland waxa uu khudbaddiisa ku dul istaagay goobta muhiimka ah ee ay ku taallo Somaliland oo ah marin-biyoodyada iyo hilinnada tamarta ugu istiraatiijisan dunida, taasi oo Maraykanka u suurto gelinaysa in uu mandaqaddan ku yeelan karo saaxiib lagu kalsoonaan karo, isla markaana siinaya awood uu ku ilaashan karo danihiisa buqcaddan muhiimka ah, isaga oo aan ku tiirsanaan hal dhinac oo keliya. Waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in Somaliland ay Maraykanka u soo bandhigayso ikhtiyaar iyo saaxiib la isku hallayn karo, kaasi oo aanu haatan ku haysan xeebtan. Dhinaca kale, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu si gaar ah u xusay in Aqoonsiga Israa’iil uu ka tarjumayo isbeddel cusub oo ku wajahan Geeska Afrika, iyada oo ay Dawladuhu haatan ka gudbayaan hab-dhaqankii diblomaasiyadeed ee duugoobay, iyaga oo qiimayntooda ku salaynaya danaha amni ee la wadaago. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in Somaliland iyo Israa’iil ay yihiin laba dal oo dimuqraaddi ah oo ku kala yaalla labada darif ee Badda Cas, kana wada shaqaynaya xasilloonida, barwaaqada iyo amniga Gobolka Geeska Afrika iyo Bariga Dhexe. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Hudson Institute, waxa ay xoojinaysaa dedaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo himiladeeda ku aaddan in Bulshada Caalamku ay si dhab ah u fahanto sooyaalkeeda taariikheed, rabitaanka shacabkeeda, nidaamkeeda dimuqraadiga ah iyo muhiimadda juqraafiyeed iyo ta istiraatiijiyadeed ee ay Somaliland u leedahay Caalamka. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa ay ahayd farriin cad oo ku socota Washington iyo saaxiibbada Somaliland: Somaliland waxa ay diyaar u tahay iskaashi istiraatiiji ah oo ku dhisan dano wadaag, is-ixtiraam, nabad, amni iyo horumar waara.

items.title: 10 Young Women Begin Journalism Internships Across Somalia
items.description: Ten young women from three Somali universities have begun a four-month journalism internship programme, giving them an opportunity to gain practical experience and strengthen their skills in some of the country’s media organisations. The interns come from the Somali National University, Mogadishu University and Hormuud University. During the four-month programme, they will gain hands-on experience at six media organisations: SONNA, Radio Muqdisho, Somali National Television (SNTV), Astaan Media, Radio Kulmiye and Shabelle Radio & TV. The programme aims to help young women connect their university education with practical newsroom experience. Through the placements, they will have opportunities to develop their skills in reporting, media production and other areas of journalism. For the interns, the opportunity is more than just professional training. It is a chance to take an important step towards careers they have long hoped to pursue. “An opportunity we have been waiting for” Khadijo Salad Abdiqadir, a second-year student at Mogadishu University, said she is very happy to have been selected for the programme. “As women, this is an opportunity we have been hoping for. Bringing young women together, giving them opportunities and connecting them with different media organisations where we can gain valuable experience is very important to us.” Khadijo said the internship could make a significant difference in her life, particularly because she has started her placement at a media organisation where she has always wanted to work. “I hope that by the end of these four months, I will have gained confidence, practical experience and knowledge that will help me in my future career.” She also expressed her appreciation to UNDP for helping make the opportunity possible. “A step towards my dream” Faadumo Abdi Qaasin, a final-year student at the Somali National University, said the internship is an opportunity she has been looking for. “I have always been looking for an internship like this, so this opportunity is very important to me.” Faadumo hopes to use the internship to expand her knowledge and gain the practical experience she needs to pursue a career in journalism. “My dream is to become a skilled and respected journalist who can make a positive contribution to society. I hope this opportunity will be an important step towards achieving that dream.” Creating opportunities for young women The internship programme is part of Bilan Media’s efforts to support young Somali women and create opportunities for them to enter and grow within the media industry. By placing university students in different media organisations, the programme gives the interns an opportunity to learn from experienced journalists, understand professional newsroom environments and build practical skills that can support their future careers. The programme is supported by the European Union in Somalia in partnership with UNDP. For these ten young women, the next four months will be an opportunity to turn classroom knowledge into practical experience and take an important step towards building their careers in Somali journalism. Written by Farhio Mohamed Hussein, Editor-in-Chief of Bilan Media. The post 10 Young Women Begin Journalism Internships Across Somalia first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Trump oo muddo ka dib Safiir u soo magacaabay Somaliya
items.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Danjire Devin Kennington u magacaabay inuu noqdo Safiika xiga Mareykanka ee Somaliya. Magacaabista Safiirka cusub ayaa ka dhigan in Madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu buuxiyay boos diblomaasiyadeed oo bannaanaa, tan iyo bishii December ee sanadkii 2025. Safiirka cusub ayaa noqonaya Safiirkii ugu horreyay ee rasmi ee Washington u joogi doona Muqdisho, tan iyo markii Richard H. Riley uu ka tegay shaqada, ka gadaal markii Maamulka Trump uu daba-yaaqadii sanadkii hore ku wargeliyay in uu dalka ku soo laabto. Justin Davis, oo ah Safiir Kuxigeenka Mareykanka ee Somaliya ayaa muddadaasi dalka uga shaqeynayay Kusimaha Safiirka Mareykanka. Mareykanka ayaa Somaliya ka taageera dhinacyo dhowr ah oo muhiim u ah soo kabashada iyo xasilloonida dalka sida amniga, la dagaalanka argagixisada, bani’aadantinimada iyo tababarka Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa ciidamada cusub ee Danab ku tababara Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Gaashaanle Xasan Tuure (Ex Ballidoogle) ee Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose, iyadoona Mareykanku uu qalabeeyo ciidamadaasi. Magacaabista Devin Kennington ayaa ku soo aadeysa, xilli xasaasi ah oo weli aan heshiis kama dambeys ah laga gaarin nooca doorasho ee laga qabanayo dalka. Mareykanka ayaa waxa uu ka mid yahay deeqbixiyeyaasha ugu weyn ee Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedyada kala shaqeeya xoojinta dowladnimada, dimoqraadiyadda iyo fududeynta hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo wadatashiyada siyaasadeed.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ka qayb gashay Kalfadhiga 74-aad ee Golaha Wasiirrada IGAD
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ka qayb gashay Kalfadhiga 74-aad ee aan caadiga ahayn ee Golaha Wasiirrada Urur-Goboleedka IGAD, kaas oo maanta lagu qabtay magaalada Jabuuti ee Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cali, ayaa hoggaaminayay wafdiga Soomaaliya ee ka qayb galay kulanka. Kalfadhiga waxaa sidoo kale ka qayb galay wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah IGAD, kuwaas oo diiradda saaray arrimo muhiim u ah gobolka, gaar ahaan nabadda iyo amniga, xoojinta wadajirka dalalka xubnaha ka ah ururka iyo dib-u-habaynta hay’adaha IGAD. Kulanka ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli gobolka Geeska Afrika uu wajahayo caqabado siyaasadeed, amni iyo bani’aadamnimo oo u baahan iskaashi iyo isku-duubni dheeraad ah oo dhex mara dalalka gobolka. Soomaaliya ayaa kulanka ka muujisay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo iskaashiga gobolka iyo doorka IGAD ee wax ka qabashada arrimaha saameeya nabadda, amniga iyo horumarka dalalka xubnaha ka ah ururka.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Xoojinaysa Iskaashiga Midowga Afrika ee La-dagaallanka Argagixisada
items.description: Muqdisho, Sebteembar 15, 2026 — Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, ahna Ku-simaha Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, Xildhibaan Cumar Cali Cabdi, ayaa maanta Muqdisho ku qaabilay wafdi ka socday Xarunta Ka-hortagga Argagixisada ee Midowga Afrika (AUCTC). Wafdiga waxaa hoggaaminayay Agaasimaha Xarunta AUCTC, Mudane Idriss Mounir Lallali, iyadoo kulanka diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika ee dhinaca la-dagaallanka iyo ka-hortagga argagixisada. Kulanka ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo awoodda hay’adaha amniga iyo ciidamada qaranka, iyadoo iskaashiga caalamiga ah iyo kan qaaradeed uu muhiim u yahay ka hortagga khataraha amni ee gobolka. Wadahadallada u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo AUCTC ayaa sidoo kale muhiim u noqon kara is-dhaafsiga khibradaha, taageerada farsamo iyo xoojinta hababka looga hortago argagixisada iyo xagjirnimada rabshadaha wata.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Bixinaysa Waxbarashada Tacliinta Sare ee Saddexda Arday ee Ku Guuleystay Tartanka Qur’aanka
items.description: Muqdisho, Sebteembar 15, 2026 — Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay saddex arday oo Soomaaliyeed oo kaalmaha koowaad ilaa saddexaad ka galay tartan caalami ah oo Qur’aanka Kariimka ah oo lagu qabtay dalka Qatar. Ardayda uu Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu qaabilay ayaa kala ah Qaari Cabdiqani Cabdiqaadir Sheekh Xuseen, oo ku guuleystay kaalinta koowaad, Qaari Cabdiraxmaan Qaasim Maxamed, oo galay kaalinta labaad, iyo Qaari Cabdiraxmaan Axmed Maxamuud, oo ku guuleystay kaalinta saddexaad. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa ardayda ugu hambalyeeyay guusha taariikhiga ah ee ay Soomaaliya uga soo hoyeen tartanka caalamiga ah, isagoo ku ammaanay dadaalkooda, kartidooda iyo sida ay magaca Soomaaliya uga dhex muuqdeen tartanka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale ballanqaaday in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay bixin doonto waxbarashada tacliinta sare ee saddexda arday, si ay u sii wataan waxbarashadooda una horumariyaan aqoontooda iyo xirfaddooda. Guusha ay ardaydan ka gaareen tartanka Qur’aanka Kariimka ah ayaa loo arkaa guul sharaf u ah Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed ee ku dadaalaya barashada, xifdinta iyo fahamka Qur’aanka Kariimka ah. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa marar badan adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay taageeridda dhallinyarada, waxbarashada iyo kobcinta aqoonta, iyadoo guulaha noocan ah ay dhiirrigelin u yihiin jiilka cusub ee Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaal culus oo ka socda Yemen
items.description: Sanca (Caasimada Online) – Dagaallo culus ayaa saacadihii lasoo dhaafay ka socday qaybo ka mid ah dalka Yemen, gaar ahaan gobolka Maarib, xilli dalkaasi uu weli wajahayo xaalad siyaasadeed iyo amni oo cakiran. Gobolka Maarib ayaa ah goobta ugu muhiimsan ee ay ciidamada dowladda Yemen ka haystaan dhulka waqooyiga dalka, waxaana halkaasi isku haya ciidamada dowladda iyo Xuutiyiinta oo muddo dheer dagaal kula jiray dowladda dhexe. Maarib ayaa labada dhinac u ah goob istiraatiiji ah, maadaama uu gobolka leeyahay goobo muhiim u ah soo saarista shidaalka iyo gaaska Yemen. Sidaas darteed, gacan ku haynta gobolka ayaa saameyn weyn ku yeelan karta awoodda dhaqaale iyo tan militari ee dhinacyada isku haya dalka. Haddii Xuutiyiintu ay awood u yeeshaan inay si buuxda ula wareegaan Maarib, arrintaasi waxay dhabar-jab weyn ku noqon kartaa dowladda Yemen, maadaama gobolka uu yahay mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay weli ku leedahay awood ciidan iyo dhaqaale. Xuutiyiinta iyo loollanka Badda Cas Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Iran ayaa sidoo kale muddooyinkii dambe xoogga saarayay deegaanada ku dhow xeebaha Badda Cas, taas oo siin karta fursad ay ku sii xoojiyaan awooddooda dhanka marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Baab Al-Mandab. Dhinaca kale, dowladda Yemen waxaa taageera Boqortooyada Sacuudiga Carabiya, oo siisa taageero amni iyo mid militari, iyadoo sidoo kale duqeymo ka fulisay goobaha ay Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku hayaan. Xaaladda Yemen ayaa muddo dheer ahayd mid u dhaxaysa dagaal iyo kala qeybsanaan siyaasadeed, iyadoo dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay iyo Xuutiyiintu ay si gaar ah u kala maamulaan qaybo ka mid ah dalka. Soomaaliya iyo dowlado kale oo caalami ah ayaa horey ugu baaqay dhinacyada Yemen inay wada-hadal ku dhammeeyaan khilaafka. Si kastaba, dagaalka Yemen ayaa xoogaystay tan iyo 2014-kii, xilligaas oo Xuutiyiintu ay qabsadeen caasimadda Sanca, isla markaana ay meesha ka saareen dowladdii uu hoggaaminayay Madaxweyne Cabdirabbu Mansuur Hadi. Tan iyo xilligaas, Yemen waxay wajahday dagaal daba dheeraaday oo ay ku lug yeesheen dhinacyo gudaha ah iyo quwado shisheeye, taas oo dalka ka dhigtay goob muhiim u ah loollanka siyaasadeed iyo militari ee Bariga Dhexe. Xaaladda Yemen ayaa sidoo kale si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Soomaaliya, maadaama labada dal ay kala xigaan dhinaca Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas, halka marin-biyoodka Baab Al-Mandab uu yahay mid muhiim u ah isu socodka ganacsiga iyo amniga gobolka. Tan iyo xilligaas, Yemen waxay wajahday dagaal daba dheeraaday oo ay ku lug yeesheen dhinacyo gudaha ah iyo quwado shisheeye, taas oo dalka ka dhigtay goob muhiim u ah loollanka siyaasadeed iyo militari ee Bariga Dhexe. Xaaladda Yemen ayaa sidoo kale si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Soomaaliya, maadaama labada dal ay kala xigaan dhinaca Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas, halka marin-biyoodka Baab Al-Mandab uu yahay mid muhiim u ah isu socodka ganacsiga iyo amniga gobolka.
