items.title: Hirshabeelle: Himilo, Hoggaan iyo Horumar — Fursadda Cusub ee Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe
items.description: Soomaaliya waxay muddo dheer ku jirtay geeddisocod adag oo dib loogu dhisayo nidaamka dawladnimada. Weydiintu keliya ma ahayn sida loo dhiso hay’ado dawladeed, balse sidoo kale sida loo abuuri karo nidaam siyaasadeed oo bulshada Soomaaliyeed iyo degaannadeeda si dhab ah la isugu soo dhoweyn karo. Hirgelinta nidaamka federaalku waxay ahayd mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinkii muhiimka ahaa ee dibudhiska dawladnimada, hasayeeshee weli waxaa taagan dood ku saabsan in nidaamka federaalku si buuxda ugu habboon yahay xaaladda Soomaaliya. Hayeeshee, waaya-aragnimada dawladgoboleedyada la dhisay waxay muujisay in dawladdhisiddu aysan ku ekaan karin samaynta maamul, baarlamaan iyo madaxweyne. Waxay u baahan tahay heshiis siyaasadeed, awoodqaybsi dheellitiran, kalsooni bulsho, hay’ado shaqeeya iyo hannaan ay dadka degaannadu ku dareemaan in dawladnimadu tahay mid ay wada leeyihiin. Hirshabeelle waxay ka mid tahay dawladgoboleedyada si gaar ah u muujinaya caqabadaha iyo fursadaha ku xeeran geeddisocodkaas. Hirshabeelle waxaa la aasaasay sannadkii 2016, iyadoo la isku daray gobollada Hiiraan iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe, xilli Soomaaliya ay ku jirtay marxalad siyaasadeed oo kalaguur ah, loona baahnaa dhammaystirka geeddisocodka federaalka. Dhismaha maamulka cusub wuxuu ahaa tallaabo ka mid ah dhammaystirka nidaamka federaalaynta Soomaaliya. Hasayeeshee, bilowgii dhismaha maamulka waxaa hareeyay doodo iyo tabashooyin la xiriiray habka loo dhisay, awoodqaybsiga, matalaadda iyo sida labada gobol loogu wada abuuri lahaa dheelitirnaan siyaasadeed. Markii la dhisay Hirshabeelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Cosoble ayaa loo doortay madaxweyne, halka Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Guudlaawe) loo doortay madaxweyne-ku-xigeen. Doorashadii 17kii Oktoobar 2016 waxay ahayd tallaabo taariikhi ah, waxaase jiray diidmo toos ah oo ka imanaysay magaalada Beledweyne. Muddo kooban kaddib, waxaa soo baxay khilaaf siyaasadeed oo culus. 14kii Agoosto 2017, Madaxweyne Cosoble waxaa laga gudbiyey mooshin xil-ka-qaadis ah, waxaana 16kii Sebtembar 2017 madaxweyne loogu doortay Maxamed Cabdi Waare, kaas oo helay 75 cod. Waare wuxuu xilka qabtay xilli Hirshabeelle ay la tacaalaysay khilaaf siyaasadeed, caqabado amni iyo musiibooyin dabiici ah. Intii uu hoggaaminayay maamulka, waxaa lagu xusuustaa doorkii uu ka qaatay dhismaha hay’adaha dawladda Hirshabeelle, arrimaha amniga, dhismaha ciidanka Daraawiishta iyo doodihii ku saabsanaa dawladdhiska federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan shirarkii ka dhacay Baydhabo iyo Dhuusamareeb. Ugu danbayntii, 3dii Nofeenbar 2020 ayuu xilka ka tagay, waxaana Hirshabeelle mar kale gashay marxalad siyaasadeed oo cusub. Cosoble iyo Waare, oo labaduba ka soo jeeda Beledweyne, midkoodna ma helin taageerada beeshiisa; mar kasta Beledweyne laguma qanacsanayn habkii loo maray dhismaha Hirshabeelle. Sannadkii 2020, markii la galay dhismihii labaad ee Hirshabeelle, waxaa mar kale soo baxay weydiimo ku saabsan hoggaanka iyo awoodqaybsiga. Xilligaas, Cali-Guudlaawe, oo hore u ahaa madaxweyne kuxigeenka Hirshabeelle, ayaa loo doortay madaxweynaha Hirshabeelle. Doorashadiisu waxay ku soo beegantay xilli Soomaaliya oo dhan ay ku jirtay marxalad siyaasadeed oo adag, iyadoo Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo dawladgoboleedyadu ay ku jireen doodo la xiriiray doorashooyinka iyo mustaqbalka siyaasadda dalka. Doorashadii Guudlaawe kaddib, waxaa korortay xiisadda Hiiraan ee la xiriirtay diidmada Hirshabeelle. Waxaa bilaabmay kacdoon xooggan oo gudaha Beledweyne ah, waxaana ka dhashay kacdoon siyaasadeed oo ku dhisnaa Hiiraan State, kaas oo uu hoggaaminayey Jeneraal Xuud, iyadoo arrintaas gudaha Beledweyne lagu kala qaybsamay. Arrintani waxay muujisay in tabashooyinka ku saabsan matalaadda, awoodqaybsiga iyo hannaanka siyaasadeed ee Hirshabeelle aysan ahayn kuwo ku eg doorashooyinka oo keliya, balse ay leeyihiin xididdo siyaasadeed oo qoto dheer. Tan iyo dhismihii maamulka, waxaa jiray habraac siyaasadeed oo aan rasmi ahayn, “Gentlemen’s Agreement”, kaas oo ku salaysnaa in madaxweynuhu ka yimaado Hiiraan (Xawaadle), Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenkuna ka yimaado Shabeellaha Dhexe (Abgaal), halka guddoomiyaha baarlamaankuna ka yimaado Hiiraan (Gaaljecel). Hasayeeshee, maadaama heshiiskaasi uusan ahayn hannaan rasmi ah oo dastuurka Hirshabeelle lagu qeexay, wuxuu mar walba ahaa mid u nugul dood, fasiraad iyo khilaaf siyaasadeed. Arrintaas ayaa qayb ka noqotay sababihii ay tabashooyinka siyaasadeed u sii jireen. Waxaa jiray dareen ah in awoodqaybsiga iyo matalaadda aan weli si buuxda loogu heshiin; taasina waxay saamayn ku yeelatay xiriirka labada gobol iyo sida ay bulshada qaarkeed u aragto maamulka Hirshabeelle. Marka laga yimaado taariikhda iyo caqabadihii siyaasadeed ee Hirshabeelle, waxaa muhiim ah in si gaar ah loo fahmo kaalinta iyo waaya-aragnimada Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe. Guudlaawe ma aha siyaasi ku cusub siyaasadda iyo maamulka degaannada maanta ka tirsan Hirshabeelle. In ka badan 20 sannadood ayuu xiriir iyo shaqo siyaasadeed ku lahaa degaannadan, taas oo siisay waaya-aragnimo iyo faham ku saabsan bulshada, degaanka iyo caqabadaha siyaasadeed ee labada gobol. Waaya-aragnimadaas dheer waxay sidoo kale ka dhigtay siyaasi si wanaagsan u fahmi kara iskuxirka siyaasadda degaanka iyo tan heer federaal. Bishii Oktoobar 2016, markii la dhisay Hirshabeelle, Cali Guudlaawe waxaa loo doortay madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka dawladgoboleedka. Xilkaas wuxuu u noqday fursad uu si toos ah uga qaybqaato marxaladdii ugu horreysay ee dhismaha maamulka. Intii uu hayey xilka madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka, wuxuu kaalin ka qaatay dhismaha hay’adaha dawladda, xasilloonida labada gobol, xalinta khilaafaadka iyo dadaallada dibuheshiisiinta. Sidoo kale, muddadaas wuxuu kasbaday waaya-aragnimo ku saabsan sida loo maareeyo siyaasadda gudaha ee Hirshabeelle iyo xiriirka siyaasadeed ee kala duwan ee u dhexeeya dawladgoboleedka iyo Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. Markii Hirshabeelle gashay dhismihii labaad, Guudlaawe ayaa horraantii Nofeembar 2020 loo doortay madaxweynaha dawladgoboleedka, xilli Soomaaliya ay ku jirtay marxalad siyaasadeed oo adag, isla markaana dalku isu diyaarinayay doorashooyinkii federaalka. Xilligaas, khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee heer federaal waxay ahaayeen kuwo xooggan, waxaana Guudlaawe door ka qaatay dadaalladii lagu xallinayey ismariwaagii siyaasadeed ee doorashooyinka federaalka. Dhanka kale, Hirshabeelle waxay xilligaas noqotay mid ka mid ah dawladgoboleedyadii laga soo doortay xildhibaanno badan oo mucaarad ahaa, iyadoo qaar badan oo ka mid ahi aysan taageersanayn doorashadii Guudlaawe. Tani waxay muujinaysay in hoggaankiisu ka bilaabmay marxalad siyaasadeed oo aan sahlanayn, una baahnayd isku dheellitirnaan u dhexaysa siyaasadda gudaha ee Hirshabeelle iyo tan heer federaal. Dabcan, hoggaaminta dawladgoboleed habraaca dhismihiisa la isku diiddan yahay, oo ka jira dal ay bulshadiisu weli ka soo kabanayso colaado sokeeye, isla markaana ay jiraan tabashooyin siyaasadeed iyo kalsoonidarro bulsho, ma aha hawl fudud. Hoggaamiye keliya lagama filan karo inuu muddo kooban ku xalliyo dhammaan caqabadaha siyaasadeed, amni, dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee soo jiray muddo dheer. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, hoggaanka waxaa lagu qiimeeyaa sida uu uga faa’iidaysto fursadaha jira, sida uu u dhiso hay’adaha iyo sida uu caqabadaha ugu beddelo fursado horumarineed. Muddadii Cali-Guudlaawe uu xilalka ka hayey Hirshabeelle, laga soo bilaabo madaxweyne-ku-xigeen ilaa madaxweyne, waxaa jira waxyaabo la taaban karo oo lagu xusi karo. Waxaa si weyn loogu ammaanaa dhismaha xarumaha dawladda Hirshabeelle, oo ay ka mid yihiin qaar ka mid ah wasaaradaha iyo madaxtooyada Hirshabeelle, iyo waddooyin laga hirgeliyey Jowhar, Beledweyne iyo magaalooyin kale. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu tilmaamaa siyaasi xasilloon oo qunyarsocod ah, waxaana lagu ammaanaa inuu door ka qaatay in Hirshabeelle ay xiriir wanaagsan la yeelato Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. Hasayeeshee, hoggaamiyuhu ma aha malaa’ig, Soomaaliduna waxay tiraahdaa: “Gaalka dil, gartana sii.” Sidaas darteed, marka laga soo tago waxqabadkiisa, waxaa jira fursado badan oo Hirshabeelle horyaallay oo aan weli si buuxda looga faa’iidaysan; arrintaasna qayb ahaan waxaa sabab u ah farsamaxumo iyo daciifnimo ka jirta fulinta hay’adaha. Sidaas awgeed, fursadda cusub ee Guudlaawe waa in aysan ku koobnaan waxa la dhisay oo keliya, balse ay noqotaa marxalad lagu xaqiijiyo in dhismayaashaas ay isu beddelaan hay’ado si dhab ah u shaqeeya, leh awood maamul, shaqaale tayo leh iyo nidaam isla-xisaabtan. Madaxweyne Cali-Guudlaawe waxaa horyaalla dhowr arrimood oo mudnaan gaar ah leh, kuwaas oo go’aamin kara jihada siyaasadeed iyo mustaqbalka dawladdhiska Hirshabeelle. Marka koowaad, waxaa muhiim ah in xoogga la saaro dhismaha nabadda iyo wadajirka labada gobol. Hirshabeelle waxay u baahan tahay dibuheshiisiin dhab ah oo dhex marta Beledweyne iyo Jowhar, si loo xalliyo ismariwaaga muddada dheer ka taagnaa awoodqaybsiga iyo hoggaaminta maamulka. Dibuheshiisiintu waa in aysan noqon heshiis siyaasadeed oo kumeelgaar ah oo lagu gaaro duruuf gaar ah, ayse noqotaa hannaan lagu dhisayo kalsooni, is-aaminaad iyo aragti siyaasadeed oo labada dhinac si wadajir ah u leeyihiin. Haddii aan la helin heshiis siyaasadeed oo labada gobol si dhab ah ugu qanacsan yihiin, waxaa adkaan karta in Hirshabeelle yeelato xasillooni siyaasadeed oo waarta. Marka labaad, amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka Hiiraan waa arrin mudan in aan la iska indho tirin. Taariikhda Hirshabeelle waxay ina baraysaa in marxaladaha siyaasadeed ee xasaasiga ahi mararka qaarkood horseedi karaan isbeddello degdeg ah oo lagu sameeyo hoggaanka Hiiraan, taas oo dhalin karta xasilloonidarro siyaasadeed oo ka duwan kuwii hore. Sidaa darteed, Madaxweyne Guudlaawe waxaa looga baahan yahay inuu qaado tallaabooyin siyaasadeed iyo maamul oo xoojinaya amniga, xasilloonida iyo kalsoonida bulshada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xasilloonida siyaasadeed laguma gaari karo amni iyo hay’ado keliya haddii aan la helin dabacsanaan iyo soo dhowayn siyaasadeed. Siyaasadda Soomaaliya sannadihii danbe waxaa aad ugu soo badanayay “winner takes all” , oo ah in cidda guulaysata ay awoodda ku koobato kooxdeeda, halka dhinacyada kale aan fursad la siinin. Madaxweyne Guudlaawe waxaa laga doonayaa inuu ka fogaado habkaas, isla markaana niyadwanaag iyo dabacsanaan siyaasadeed ku soo dhoweeyo dhammaan siyaasiyiinta iyo dhinacyada ka aragti duwan. Waa inuu albaabka u furaa kuwa dibedda ku maqan; ujeeddadu waa in la dhiso dawladgoboleed ka tarjumaysa Hirshabeelle oo dhan, halkii ay noqon lahayd maamul ay koox siyaasadeed oo keliya leedahay. Siyaasad loo dhan yahay waxay abuuri kartaa kalsooni, waxay yarayn kartaa iska-horimaadka siyaasadeed, waxayna suurtagelin kartaa in tartanka siyaasadeed uu isu beddelo wadashaqayn iyo dawladdhisid. Ugu danbayn, fursadda cusub ee horyaalla Madaxweyne Cali-Guudlaawe waa in aan loo fahmin oo keliya fursad uu ku sii wadanayo hoggaanka Hirshabeelle, balse loo arko fursad uu ku dhisi karo heshiis siyaasadeed oo ka waara xilliyada doorashooyinka, ku xoojin karo wadajirka labada gobol, kuna abuuri karo maamul loo dhan yahay. WQ: Mohamed Dahir Abukar Cilmibaare iyo Qore

Hoggaamiye keliya lagama filan karo inuu muddo kooban ku xalliyo dhammaan caqabadaha siyaasadeed, amni, dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee soo jiray muddo dheer. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, hoggaanka waxaa lagu qiimeeyaa sida uu uga faa’iidaysto fursadaha jira, sida uu u dhiso hay’adaha iyo sida uu caqabadaha ugu beddelo fursado horumarineed. Muddadii Cali-Guudlaawe uu xilalka ka hayey Hirshabeelle, laga soo bilaabo madaxweyne-ku-xigeen ilaa madaxweyne, waxaa jira waxyaabo la taaban karo oo lagu xusi karo. Waxaa si weyn loogu ammaanaa dhismaha xarumaha dawladda Hirshabeelle, oo ay ka mid yihiin qaar ka mid ah wasaaradaha iyo madaxtooyada Hirshabeelle, iyo waddooyin laga hirgeliyey Jowhar, Beledweyne iyo magaalooyin kale. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu tilmaamaa siyaasi xasilloon oo qunyarsocod ah, waxaana lagu ammaanaa inuu door ka qaatay in Hirshabeelle ay xiriir wanaagsan la yeelato Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya. Hasayeeshee, hoggaamiyuhu ma aha malaa’ig, Soomaaliduna waxay tiraahdaa: “Gaalka dil, gartana sii.” Sidaas darteed, marka laga soo tago waxqabadkiisa, waxaa jira fursado badan oo Hirshabeelle horyaallay oo aan weli si buuxda looga faa’iidaysan; arrintaasna qayb ahaan waxaa sabab u ah farsamaxumo iyo daciifnimo ka jirta fulinta hay’adaha. Sidaas awgeed, fursadda cusub ee Guudlaawe waa in aysan ku koobnaan waxa la dhisay oo keliya, balse ay noqotaa marxalad lagu xaqiijiyo in dhismayaashaas ay isu beddelaan hay’ado si dhab ah u shaqeeya, leh awood maamul, shaqaale tayo leh iyo nidaam isla-xisaabtan. Madaxweyne Cali-Guudlaawe waxaa horyaalla dhowr arrimood oo mudnaan gaar ah leh, kuwaas oo go’aamin kara jihada siyaasadeed iyo mustaqbalka dawladdhiska Hirshabeelle. Marka koowaad, waxaa muhiim ah in xoogga la saaro dhismaha nabadda iyo wadajirka labada gobol. Hirshabeelle waxay u baahan tahay dibuheshiisiin dhab ah oo dhex marta Beledweyne iyo Jowhar, si loo xalliyo ismariwaaga muddada dheer ka taagnaa awoodqaybsiga iyo hoggaaminta maamulka. Dibuheshiisiintu waa in aysan noqon heshiis siyaasadeed oo kumeelgaar ah oo lagu gaaro duruuf gaar ah, ayse noqotaa hannaan lagu dhisayo kalsooni, is-aaminaad iyo aragti siyaasadeed oo labada dhinac si wadajir ah u leeyihiin. Haddii aan la helin heshiis siyaasadeed oo labada gobol si dhab ah ugu qanacsan yihiin, waxaa adkaan karta in Hirshabeelle yeelato xasillooni siyaasadeed oo waarta. Marka labaad, amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka Hiiraan waa arrin mudan in aan la iska indho tirin. Taariikhda Hirshabeelle waxay ina baraysaa in marxaladaha siyaasadeed ee xasaasiga ahi mararka qaarkood horseedi karaan isbeddello degdeg ah oo lagu sameeyo hoggaanka Hiiraan, taas oo dhalin karta xasilloonidarro siyaasadeed oo ka duwan kuwii hore. Sidaa darteed, Madaxweyne Guudlaawe waxaa looga baahan yahay inuu qaado tallaabooyin siyaasadeed iyo maamul oo xoojinaya amniga, xasilloonida iyo kalsoonida bulshada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xasilloonida siyaasadeed laguma gaari karo amni iyo hay’ado keliya haddii aan la helin dabacsanaan iyo soo dhowayn siyaasadeed. Siyaasadda Soomaaliya sannadihii danbe waxaa aad ugu soo badanayay “winner takes all” , oo ah in cidda guulaysata ay awoodda ku koobato kooxdeeda, halka dhinacyada kale aan fursad la siinin. Madaxweyne Guudlaawe waxaa laga doonayaa inuu ka fogaado habkaas, isla markaana niyadwanaag iyo dabacsanaan siyaasadeed ku soo dhoweeyo dhammaan siyaasiyiinta iyo dhinacyada ka aragti duwan. Waa inuu albaabka u furaa kuwa dibedda ku maqan; ujeeddadu waa in la dhiso dawladgoboleed ka tarjumaysa Hirshabeelle oo dhan, halkii ay noqon lahayd maamul ay koox siyaasadeed oo keliya leedahay. Siyaasad loo dhan yahay waxay abuuri kartaa kalsooni, waxay yarayn kartaa iska-horimaadka siyaasadeed, waxayna suurtagelin kartaa in tartanka siyaasadeed uu isu beddelo wadashaqayn iyo dawladdhisid. Ugu danbayn, fursadda cusub ee horyaalla Madaxweyne Cali-Guudlaawe waa in aan loo fahmin oo keliya fursad uu ku sii wadanayo hoggaanka Hirshabeelle, balse loo arko fursad uu ku dhisi karo heshiis siyaasadeed oo ka waara xilliyada doorashooyinka, ku xoojin karo wadajirka labada gobol, kuna abuuri karo maamul loo dhan yahay. items.title: Mareykanka oo xaqiijiyay inuu hub dagaal geeyay hawada sare
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa markii ugu horreysay si rasmi ah u xaqiijisay in ay hawada sare geysay hub loogu tala-galay hawl-gallada dagaalka hawada sare, taas oo muujinaysa isbeddel cusub oo ku yimid awoodda milatari ee Washington ee ka baxsan jawiga Dhulka. Xoghayaha Ciidanka Cirka Mareykanka, Troy Meink ayaa sheegay in hubka hawada sare ku sugan uu muhiim u yahay ilaalinta ciidamada Mareykanka iyo ka hortagga khataraha uga iman kara dalalka ay loollanka milatari kala dhexeeyo. Meink ayaa caddeeyay in Mareykanku diyaar u yahay inuu wajaho waxa uu ku tilmaamay “khataraha isbeddelaya”, balse ma uusan shaacin nooca hubka la geeyay iyo waqtigii hawada sare loo diray. Maxaa Washington ku riixay hubka hawada sare? Hoggaamiyeyaasha milatariga Mareykanka ayaa muddooyinkii dambe sheegay in Washington ay qorshaynayso inay sii xoojiso awooddeeda milatari ee hawada sare, xilli Ruushka iyo Shiinaha ay horumarinayaan teknoolojiyado lagu weerari karo ama lagu carqaladeyn karo dayax-gacmeedyada muhiimka u ah ciidamada Mareykanka. Maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sidoo kale awoodaha milatari ee hawada sare iyo nidaamyada gantaallada wax-ka-qabta ku daray qorshaha difaaca ee loo yaqaan “Golden Dome”, kaas oo loogu talagalay in Mareykanka laga ilaaliyo gantaallada iyo khataraha kale ee hawada. Heshiis caalami ah oo la saxiixay 1967-kii ayaa mamnuucaya in hubka wax gumaada lagu geeyo ama lagu keydiyo hawada sare. Si kastaba, Mareykanka, Ruushka iyo Shiinaha ayaa sannadihii dambe horumarinayay awoodo kale oo aan si toos ah uga hor imaanayn heshiiskaas, oo ay ka mid yihiin awoodda lagu bartilmaameedsan karo dayax-gacmeedyada. Dayax-gacmeedyadu waxay door muhiim ah ka ciyaaraan isgaarsiinta milatari, sirdoonka, la socodka iyo hagidda ciidamada, taas oo ka dhigaysa inay noqdaan bartilmaameed muhiim ah haddii uu dagaal ka dhex qarxo quwadaha waaweyn. Ruushka iyo Shiinaha oo kordhinaya tartanka hawada sare Madaxweyne Trump ayaa sannadkii hore soo saaray amar xoojinaya doorka Ciidanka Hawada Sare ee Mareykanka, isagoo sheegay in awoodda ciidanku aysan ku koobnaan doonin oo keliya difaaca hantida Mareykanka ee hawada sare, balse ay yeelan karto awood weerar. Ciidanka Hawada Sare ee Mareykanka (US Space Force), oo la aas-aasay 2019-kii, ayaa loo sameeyay ilaalinta hantida Mareykanka ee hawada sare, oo ay ku jiraan boqolaal dayax-gacmeed oo muhiim u ah isgaarsiinta iyo hawlgallada milatari. Afhayeen u hadlay ciidamada ayaa sheegay in “xakamaynta hawada sare” ay ka dhigan tahay awoodda lagu tartami karo laguna xakameyn karo goobta hawada sare, iyadoo la adeegsanayo habab waxyeello geysta iyo kuwo aan waxyeello toos ah geysan si loo carqaladeeyo, loo wiiqo ama haddii loo baahdo loo burburiyo awoodaha cadowga. Dhinaca kale, horraantii bishii Febraayo ayaa la shaaciyay in laba dayax-gacmeed oo Ruushku leeyahay ay u badan tahay inay dhexgaleen ama qabteen isgaarsiinta ugu yaraan 12 dayax-gacmeed oo Yurub leedahay tan iyo markii Ruushku duullaanka ku qaaday Ukraine 2022-kii. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale 2024-kii sheegay in Ruushku hawada sare u diray dayax-gacmeed uu Washington ku qiimeysay inuu awood u leeyahay inuu weeraro dayax-gacmeedyo kale. Ciidanka Hawada Sare ee Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay Shiinaha inuu horumarinayo oo adeegsanayo awoodo hawada sare iyo kuwa lidka-hawada sare ah, halka Ruushkana lagu tilmaamay dal hawada sare u arka goob dagaal oo muhiim u noqon karta natiijada dagaallada mustaqbalka. Horumarradan ayaa muujinaya in loollanka milatari ee quwadaha waaweyn uu si tartiib ah ugu sii fidayo hawada sare, iyadoo dayax-gacmeedyada iyo nidaamyada ku shaqeeya orbit-ka Dhulka ay noqonayaan qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qorshayaasha difaac iyo weerar ee dalalka awoodda leh. items.title: Golaha Aqalka Sare oo u yeeray wasiirka dhallinyarada iyo ciyaaraha kadibna…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Horumarinta Adeegga Bulshada, Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada, Warfaafinta iyo Dhaqanka ee Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta xafiiskooda ugu yeeray mas’uuliyiinta Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha ee XFS. Mas’uuliyiinta wasaaradda waxaa hoggaaminayay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Cali, waxaana kulanka ka qeyb-galay mas’uuliyiin kale oo ka tirsan wasaaradda. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray isla-xisaabtan iyo xog-wareysi ku saabsan hannaanka shaqo ee wasaaradda, iyadoo wasiirka si gaar ah wax looga weydiiyay qorshe-hawleedka wasaaradda iyo howlaha ay waddo. Xubnaha guddiga ayaa sidoo kale wasiirka su’aalo ka weydiiyay horumarinta ciyaaraha dalka, dhismaha iyo dayactirka garoomada isboortiga, iyo xiriirka wasaaradda iyo dowlad-goboleedyada xubnaha ka ah Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha ayaa si waafi ah uga jawaabay dhammaan su’aalihii ay xubnaha guddigu hor-dhigeen, isagoo si faahfaahsan uga hadlay howlaha iyo qorshayaasha mudnaanta u leh Wasaaradda. Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Cali ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay kaalinta wasaaraddu ku leedahay horumarinta ciyaaraha dalka, kobcinta iyo kor u qaadista xirfadaha dhallinyarada, iyo abuurista fursado ay dhallinyaradu ku horumarin karaan kartidooda iyo hal-abuurkooda. Guddoomiyaha guddiga, Senator Cismaan Maxamuud Maxamed (Dufle) oo shir guddoomiyay kulanka ayaa wasiirka uga mahadceliyay sida hufan, faahfaahsan oo togan ee uu uga jawaabay su’aalihii la hor-dhigay. Wuxuu sheegay in kulanku uu qayb muhiim ah ka yahay xoojinta isla-xisaabtanka, korjoogteynta iyo qiimeynta waxqabadka hay’adaha dowladda, iyo adkeynta wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha dowladda iyo Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya. items.title: Bannaanbax lagu muujinayo taageerada loo hayo Turkiga oo ka dhacay Baydhabo (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Bannaanbaxan oo lagu taageerayo doorka Turkiga ee garab istaaga dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ayaa maanta lagu qabtay Garoonka Kubadda Cagta Dr. Ayuub ee Magaalada Baydhabo. Bannaanbaxa oo ahaa mid uu soo qaban-qaabiyay Maamulka Degmada Baydhabo ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Maamulka Gobolka Baay, kan degmada iyo bulshada qaybaheeda kala duwan. Ujeedka ayaa ahaa in Dowladda Turkiga looga mahadceliyo taageeradeeda hagar la’aaneed ee dalka iyo xiriirka adag ee ay la leedahay Dowladda Soomaaliyeed. Masuuliyiintii la hadlay dibadbaxayaasha ayaa si isku mida u sheegay in dadka reer Baydhabo iyo guud ahaanba shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay dareen iyo taageeraba u qabaan dowladda iyo shacabka Turkiga. Turkiga oo lagu tilmaamo saaxiib muhiim ah oo Somaliya ay leedahay ayaa ka taageera dhinacyada amniga, difaaca, dib-u-dhiska iyo qalabaynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, horumarinta iyo gargaarka bani’aadantinimo. Xiriirka labada dal ayaa meeshii ugu sarreysay gaaray dhowr iyo tobankii sano ee u dambeeyay. Turkiga ayaa Muqdisho ku leh saldhigga ugu weyn ee militari ee uu ku leeyahay meel ka baxsan dalkiisa, waana Xerada Militariga TURKSOM iyo dhismaha safaaradeed ee ugu weyn ee caalamka uu ku leeyahay. Turkiga oo xulafo la ah Somaliya ayaa door hoggaamineed ka qaata dhismaha iyo xoojinta ee awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, waana dowladda maalgashiga ugu ballaaran ku sameysata Somaliya. Turkiga ayaana ku howlan, sidii uu shidaal uga soo saari lahaa xeebaha dalka. Bannaanbaxa Baydhabo ayaa imanaya, ka dib markii xulafada Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ay Turkiga ku eedeeyeen in Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ay si guracan u adeegsaneyso taageeradiisa militari. Mucaaradka uu Laftagareen hoggaamiyo ayaa si adag Turkiga ugu eedeeyay in uu ka masuul ahaa duqayntii xagga cirka ee 3-dii bishan loo gaystay hoyga uu Taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, General Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan (Taliye Shub) uu ka deganaa Degmada Doolow ee Gobolka Gedo.

items.title: Sawirro: Taliye Maslax oo gaaray Masagawaa – Maxaa socda?
items.description: Masagawaa (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Guutada 77-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Korneyl Maslax Maxamuud Maxamed ayaa gaaray magaalada Masagawaa ee gobolka Galgaduud, halkaas oo uu kormeer iyo kuurgalid ku sameeyay xaaladda ciidanka iyo howlaha ay ka hayaan deegaanka. Taliyaha ayaa mid mid u booqday fariisimaha iyo goobaha ay Guutada 77-aad kaga sugan yihiin magaalada Masagawaa iyo deegaannada ku xeeran, isagoo indha-indheeyay xaaladda ciidanka iyo habsami-u-socodka howlaha shaqo. Intii uu ku guda jiray kormeerka, Korneyl Maslax Maxamuud Maxamed ayaa qiimeyn ku sameeyay xaaladda guud ee ciidamada iyo sida ay u gutaan waajibaadkooda amni ee loo igmaday. Taliyaha ayaa sidoo kale warbixinno ka dhageystay saraakiisha iyo taliyeyaasha ururrada Guutada 77-aad ee ka howlgala Masagawaa, kuwaas oo faah-faahin ka bixiyay xaaladda ciidanka iyo howlaha ay ka wadaan halkaasi. Saraakiisha ayaa Taliyaha uga warbixiyay xaaladda amni ee deegaanka iyo howlaha ay ciidamada ka wadaan deegaannada bariga gobolka Galgaduud iyo sidoo kale adeegyada ay u hayaan bulshada ku nool deegaannadaasi. Kormeerka Taliyaha ayaa qeyb ka ah howlaha lagu qiimeynayo xaaladda ciidamada, iyadoo sidoo kale diiradda lagu saaray u kuurgalidda howlaha ka socda deegaanka iyo hubinta diyaar-garowga ciidamada. Guutada 77-aad ayaa sidoo kale door ka qaadata howlaha amni iyo howl-gallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ee ka socda deegaannada gobolka Galgaduud, iyadoo kormeerka Taliyaha uu ku qotomo xoojinta diyaar-garowga iyo gudashada waajibaadka ciidanka. The post Sawirro: Taliye Maslax oo gaaray Masagawaa – Maxaa socda? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xisbiga Sheekh Shaakir oo sheegay in aargoosi looga reebay doorashada Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Ururka siyaasadeed ee Towfiiq oo uu hoggaamiyo Sheekh Shaakir ayaa si adag uga horyimid go’aanka guddiga doorashada ee looga reebay liiska ururrada loo oggolaaday inay ka qeyb galaan doorashada ku celiska ah ee maamulka Galmudug. Ururka ayaa sheegay inuusan aqbalayn go’aankaasi, isagoo caddeeyay inuu diyaar u yahay ka qeyb-galka doorashada, balse uu doonayo in hannaanka doorashada loo maro sharciga, xeerarka iyo habraacyada loo dejiyay. Towfiiq ayaa sheegay in arrinta ay si gaar ah walaac ugu abuurtay, maadaama uu ahaa ururkii horey maxkamadda uga dalbaday in dib loogu laabto doorashadii Galmudug, kadib markii uu ku dooday in la jebiyay qaar ka mid ah shuruucda iyo habraacyada doorashada. “Waxaa layaab noqotay in ururkii dalbaday saxidda doorashada uu baraha bulshada ku arko ka reebiddiisa doorashada,” ayuu yiri Towfiiq, oo wax lala yaabo ku tilmaamay go’aanka guddiga doorashada. Ururka ayaa sidoo kale xusay in guddiga doorashada ay hayaan liiska musharraxiintiisa u tartamaya labada gole, taas oo uu ku tilmaamay caddeyn muujinaysa in Towfiiq uu diyaar u ahaa ka qeybgalka hannaanka doorashada. Towfiiq ayaa guddiga doorashada ugu baaqay inay ilaaliyaan dhex-dhexaadnimada, isla markaana ay ka fogaadaan tallaabo kasta oo loo fasiran karo eex ama takoor siyaasadeed. Ururka ayaa tilmaamay in go’aanka looga reebay doorashada uu u muuqdo mid aargoosi ah oo xiriir la leh dacwaddii uu horey uga gudbiyay natiijadii doorashada. “Waxaan aaminsanahay in go’aankan uu xiriir la leeyahay dacwaddii aan horey uga gudbinnay natiijadii doorashada,” ayuu ururku sheegay, isagoo ku tilmaamay arrintaas mid aan waafaqsanayn mabaadi’da caddaaladda iyo hannaanka doorashooyinka xorta ah. Ururka Towfiiq ayaa ugu baaqay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya inuu arrinta soo farageliyo, isla markaana uu gacan ka geysto sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa u hoggaansanaanta sharciga iyo hanaan doorasho oo cadalaad ah. “Taageerayaasheena iyo bulshada reer Galmudug waxaa ugu baaqayna inay u diyaar garoobaan kulamo iyo bannaanbaxyo nabadeed oo lagu muujinayo mowqifkooda ku aaddan doorashada ay ku doonayaan inay u dhacdo si xor iyo xalaal ah,” ayuu ugu dambeyntiina ku baaqay ururka. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo sheegtay inay la wareegeen jasiirado u dhow Geeska Afrika
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa sheegtay inay la wareegeen jasiiradaha Hanish ee u dhow Geeska Afrika. Eritrea iyo Yemen ayaa muddo isku hayay lahaanshaha jasiiradaha ku yaalla koonfurta Badda Cas. Sida ay sheegtay wakaaladda wararka AP, Xuutiyiintu waxay dib u riixeen ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee uu taageero Sacuudigu, waxayna la wareegeen gacan ku haynta aaggan muhiimka ah. Jasiiradahan ayaa ku yaalla meel u dhow xadka u dhexeeya Eritrea iyo Jabuuti. Xuutiyiinta oo la wareegay aagaggaas ayaa sidaas ugu soo dhowaaday ciidamada Mareykanka ee ku sugan Jabuuti, masaafo dhan 32 kiiloomitir. Markii Eritrea ay xornimadeeda qaadatay, waxay dagaal la gashay Yemen oo ku saabsan lahaanshaha jasiiradahaas. Intii uu socday dagaalkaas kooban, ciidamada Eritrea waxay muddo gaaban gacanta ku dhigeen jasiiradda Hanish. Hase yeeshee, muranka waxaa loo gudbiyay maxkamad caalami ah, waxaana lagu go’aamiyay in jasiiradaha aan la deggenayn, marka laga reebo goobaha kalluumeysiga, ay hoos yimaadaan maamulka Yemen. Xuutiyiinta oo tan iyo toddobaadkii hore gacanta ku hayay dekedo iyo jasiirado ku yaalla Badda Cas, ayaa sidoo kale la wareegay magaalada dekedda ah ee Waqa iyo jasiiradda Perim, ka hor intii aysan la wareegin Bab al-Mandab, oo ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan kadib marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Tallaabadan ayaa u sahashay Xuutiyiinta inay si fudud u xakameeyaan marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. The post Xuutiyiinta oo sheegtay inay la wareegeen jasiirado u dhow Geeska Afrika appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Somaliland Reveals Growing Ties With Puntland
items.description: Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi “Irro” has said relations between Somaliland and Puntland have improved since 2024, citing increased cooperation on security and the movement of people and vehicles across the two administrations. Speaking about the relationship between his government and Puntland, Irro said the two sides maintain close ties and have cooperated in addressing shared security concerns, particularly terrorism and piracy. The president said Somaliland and Puntland had also worked to restore cross-border movement, which was disrupted following the fighting in Las Anod. He said traffic has since resumed along the road linking El-Dahir and Erigavo in the Sanaag region. Irro also addressed the situation in areas currently administered by the North East State, saying Somaliland would pursue a peaceful approach to resolving the dispute. He said Somaliland would adopt what he described as a “white flag” approach toward Las Anod, signalling his administration’s intention to pursue a peaceful resolution and help restore stability in the city. The comments come amid continuing political and territorial disputes over Las Anod and surrounding areas in northern Somalia. The region has remained a focal point of tensions involving Somaliland, Puntland and the emerging North East State administration. Irro’s remarks indicate that his administration intends to prioritize dialogue, security cooperation and the restoration of cross-border movement in its engagement with Puntland and communities in the disputed eastern regions. items.title: Trump oo safiir cusub u soo magacaabay Soomaaliya
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Devin Kennington u magacaabay inuu noqdo safiirka cusub ee Mareykanka u fadhiya Soomaaliya, iyadoo magacaabistan ay hadda u gudubtay Aqalka Senate-ka si loo ansixiyo. Aqalka Cad ayaa 14-kii September sheegay in Kennington, oo kasoo jeeda gobolka California, loo magacaabay xilka “Safiirka aan Caadiga ahayn iyo Wakiilka Awoodda Buuxda leh ee Mareykanka u fadhiya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya.” Kennington ma bilaabi karo shaqada safiirnimo ilaa Senate-ka Mareykanka uu ansixiyo magacaabistiisa. Haddii la xaqiijiyo, wuxuu noqon doonaa safiirkii ugu horreeyay ee si rasmi ah xilkaas u qabta tan iyo markii Richard H. Riley uu ka tagay Soomaaliya horraantii sanadkan. Riley, oo ahaa diblomaasi muddo dheer kasoo shaqeynayay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, ayaa lagu daray safiiro uu maamulka Trump dib ugu yeeray Washington bishii December 2025, xilli maamulka cusub uu dib-u-habeyn ku sameynayay wakiilladiisa diblomaasiyadeed ee dibadda. Riley wuxuu xilka safiirnimo ee Soomaaliya hayay tan iyo 2024. Safaaradda ku shaqeyneysay ku-sime Kadib bixitaankii Riley, Justin Davis ayaa xilka hoggaaminta Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho la wareegay isagoo ahaa chargé d’affaires , ama sii-hayaha xilka safiirka. Davis ayaa safaaradda hoggaaminayay muddo ku dhow siddeed bilood, xilli xiriirka Washington iyo Muqdisho uu si weyn ugu qotomo arrimaha amniga, la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada sharci-fulinta. Bishan September ayuu Davis soo gabagabeeyay shaqadiisa Soomaaliya. Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho ayaa 10-kii September sheegtay in muddadii uu Davis joogay uu door ka qaatay hirgelinta mudnaanta Mareykanka ee la xiriira “la-dagaallanka argagixisada, sharci-fulinta iyo arrimaha socdaalka.” Waxaa xilka sii-hayaha safiirka kala wareegtay Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz , oo hadda ah diblomaasiga ugu sarreeya Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya inta laga sugayo in Senate-ku ansixiyo Kennington. Safaaradda ayaa sheegtay in Stevens-Klitz ay sii wadi doonto fulinta siyaasadaha maamulka Trump iyo xoojinta xiriirka Mareykanka iyo Soomaaliya. Waa kuma Devin Kennington? Kennington waa diblomaasi Mareykan ah oo khibrad badan u leh arrimaha Afrika, gaar ahaan Bariga iyo Bartamaha qaaradda. Wuxuu hore uga soo shaqeeyay Waaxda Arrimaha Afrika ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, isagoo xilal ka qabtay qeybta qaabilsan dalalka Harooyinka Waaweyn iyo Bartamaha Afrika. Aqalka Cad faahfaahin dheer kama bixin taariikh nololeedkiisa markii uu magacaabista shaaciyay, sidoo kalena lama sheegin goorta Senate-ka uu bilaabi doono dhageysiga magacaabistiisa. Xiriir ku tiirsan amniga Magacaabista Kennington waxay kusoo beegmeysaa xilli arrimaha amniga iyo la-dagaallanka kooxaha hubeysan ay weli yihiin tiirka ugu weyn ee xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Washington. Mareykanka ayaa kamid ah saaxiibada ugu muhiimsan Soomaaliya ee dhinaca amniga, wuxuuna taageero siiyaa ciidamada dowladda ee dagaalka kula jira Al-Shabaab iyo kooxda Daacish. Haddii Senate-ku ansixiyo Kennington, wuxuu xilka kala wareegi doonaa hoggaanka safaaradda oo muddo bilo ah ku shaqeynaysay sii-hayayaal, isagoo noqon doona wejiga cusub ee siyaasadda Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya xilli ay labada dhinac ka wada shaqeynayaan amniga, siyaasadda iyo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed. items.title: Trump nominates Kennington as US ambassador to Somalia
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – President Donald Trump has nominated Devin Kennington, of California, to serve as Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States to the Federal Republic of Somalia, the White House announced Monday, moving to fill a post that has sat vacant since late last year. The nomination was included in a slate of 41 names the White House sent to the Senate on September 14, covering judicial, diplomatic and agency posts. Alongside Kennington’s nomination for Somalia, the list named Wesley Hunt for ambassador to Saudi Arabia, Austin Holmes for ambassador to Haiti, and Junaid Munir, of Michigan, for ambassador to Djibouti. If confirmed, Kennington would become the first full ambassador Washington has sent to Mogadishu since Richard H. Riley departed the post in December 2025. Riley, a career diplomat who took up the Mogadishu ambassadorship in May 2024, was recalled to Washington as part of a broader wave that pulled back roughly 30 Biden-appointed chiefs of mission, leaving posts across Africa unfilled. Henry Wooster’s nomination as the next US ambassador to Kenya, announced in June, was part of the same effort to rebuild the administration’s diplomatic presence on the continent. In the interim, the US mission in Mogadishu has been run by Justin Davis, a career diplomat who has served as Chargé d’Affaires, a.i. since January 15, 2026. Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz assumed duties as deputy chief of mission in August 2026. The nomination must still clear the Senate, a process that can include committee hearings and background review. No date has yet been set for a confirmation hearing or vote. Kennington’s nomination comes as Somalia continues to face security pressure from Al-Shabaab and navigates ongoing disputes over elections and federal-state relations. It also lands as the Trump administration has signaled plans to cut funding for the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS) and for African Union peacekeepers deployed against Al-Shabaab under the AUSSOM mission – a backdrop that is likely to shape the confirmation debate and, if Kennington is seated, his early agenda in Mogadishu. A confirmed ambassador would take on a lead role coordinating US policy toward Somalia, including counterterrorism cooperation, engagement with federal and regional authorities, and coordination with international partners operating in the Horn of Africa. Taliyaha Ilaalada Madaxtooyada Qaranka oo gaaray deegaanka Masagawaa (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Taliyaha Guutada 77 ee Ciidanka Ilaalada Madaxtooyada Qaranka, Korneyl Maslax Maxamuud Maxamed ayaa booqasho shaqo ku tegay deegaanka Masagawaa ee Gobolka Galgaduud. Deegaankan ayaa waxaa degan cutub ka tirsan Guutada 77, gaar ahaan Ururka 86aad ee Aar, iyadoo sidoo kalena ay halkaasi fariisimo ku leeyihiin Ciidanka Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley. War Talaadadan ka soo baxay Taliska Guutada 77 ayaa lagu sheegay in Taliyuhu uu Masagawaa u tegay kormeer uu ugu kuurgelayo xaaladda ciidanka iyo howlaha ay ka hayaan deegaanka. “Taliyaha ayaa mid mid u booqday fariisimaha iyo goobaha ay Guutada 77aad kaga sugan yihiin magaalada Masagawaa iyo deegaanada ku xeeran, isagoo indha-indheeyay xaaladda ciidanka iyo habsami-u-socodka howlaha shaqo.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa lagu xusay “Korneyl Maslax Maxamuud Maxamed ayaa sidoo kale warbixinno ka dhageystay Saraakiisha iyo Taliyeyaasha Ururada Guutada 77aad ee ka hawlgala deegaanka, kuwaas oo ka warbixiyay xaaladda amni, howlaha ciidanka iyo adeegyada ay u hayaan bulshada ku nool deegaanada bariga Gobolka Galgaduud.” Masagawaa ayaa looga diyaargaroobayaa doorashada isku sidkan ee 30-ka bishan laga qabanayo Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Doorashada ku celiska ah ee Galmudug ayay shacabku ku soo dooranayaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Galmudug.

items.title: Ganacsatada Soomaaliya oo billaabay qorshe cusub kadib markii is-beddel uu ku yimid…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ganacsatada Soomaaliya ayaa bilaabay inay raadiyaan marinno cusub oo ay badeecooyinka dalka ku soo geliyaan, xilli walaac xooggan uu ka taagan yahay ammaanka marinnada muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab iyo Hormuz, oo ay saameeyeen dagaallada iyo xiisadaha sii xoogeysanaya ee gobolka. Arrintan ayaa soo baxday kaddib markii Xuutiyiinta Yemen, oo taageero ka hela Iran, ay qabsadeen magaalo deked muhiim ah iyo jasiirad istaraatiiji ah, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga ee isaga kala goosha Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Shirkadaha Soomaaliyeed ayaa muddo dheer badeecooyinka ka yimaada Aasiya dalka soo marin jiray dalalka Khaliijka, gaar ahaan Imaaraadka Carabta, Cumaan iyo Sacuudi Carabiya. Hase yeeshee, xaaladda cusub ayaa ku qasabtay qaar ka mid ah ganacsatada inay tijaabiyaan safarro toos ah oo aan ku xirneyn dekedaha Khaliijka. Maareeyaha Dekedda Muqdisho, Maxamed Cali Nuur Ameeriko, ayaa sheegay in xiisadaha ka taagan Bab al-Mandab iyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz ay saameyn ku yeesheen ganacsiga iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta. “Xiisadihii ugu dambeeyay ee Bab al-Mandab, iyo sidoo kale kuwa ka jira marin-biyoodka Hormuz, si taban ayay noo saameeyeen,” ayuu yiri Ameeriko. “Laakiin sidoo kale waxaan qaadnay tallaabooyin aan uga fogaaneyno carqaladdaas.” Waxa uu sheegay in maamulka dekedda iyo ganacsatada wax dhoofisa ay ka wada shaqeynayaan sidii loo heli lahaa marinno kale. “Markii ugu horreysay waxaan keenay markab sonkor si toos ah uga soo qaaday Sri Lanka,” ayuu yiri. “Tani waxay noqon kartaa istaraatiijiyad aan sameynay sababo la xiriira xiisadahan.” Tallaabadan ayaa muujineysa sida xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas iyo Khaliijka ay u beddeli karto habka ay Soomaaliya ku hesho badeecooyinka muhiimka ah, iyadoo dalka uu si weyn ugu tiirsan yahay ganacsiga badda. Dekedda Muqdisho ayaa maalin kasta qaabisha maraakiib sida raashinka, qalabka iyo badeecooyinka kale ee muhiimka u ah nolosha shacabka. Dhibaato kasta oo ku timaadda marinnada badda ayaa sidaas darteed si toos ah ama dadban u taaban karta suuqyada gudaha. Haddii maraakiibtu isticmaalaan marinno dheer ama kharash badan, waxaa kordhi kara qarashaadka gaadiidka, halka badeecooyinkuna ay dib uga dhici karaan waqtigii la filayay inay suuqyada soo gaaraan. Kabtan Cali Jemdi, oo asal ahaan kasoo jeeda Suuriya isla markaana qaada shixnado sonkor ah, ayaa wakaaladda wararka AP u sheegay in hubanti la’aanta gobolka ay walaac ku abuurtay maraakiibta isticmaasha marinnadaas. “Dhibaato ayaa halkaas ka jirta dagaalka awgiis,” ayuu yiri, isagoo ka hadlayay Gacanka Carabta iyo biyaha ku hareeraysan. “Bab al-Mandab-na sidoo kale waxaa laga yaabaa inuu dhibaato ku noqdo markabka.” Waxa uu sheegay in xaaladda amni-darro ay sii adkeyn karto gaadiidka badda iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Dhanka Yemen, dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay iyo Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa muddo 12 sano ah dagaal kula jiray Xuutiyiinta. Xiisadda cusub ayaa soo afjartay xabbad-joojin tan iyo 2022 si weyn u yareysay dagaalladii sokeeye ee dalkaas. Dagaallada soo cusboonaaday ayaa sidoo kale horseeday barakac ballaaran. Hay’adda Socdaalka Adduunka ee IOM ayaa Axaddii sheegtay in in ka badan 85,000 oo qof ay barakaceen tan iyo bilowgii bishan. In ka badan 2,000 oo qof ayaa sidoo kale gaaray Jabuuti, oo dhinaca kale ee Bab al-Mandab kaga beegan Yemen isla markaana daris la ah Soomaaliya. Isbeddellada ka socda Yemen iyo marinnada muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab iyo Hormuz ayaa sidaas darteed saameyn ka baxsan goobaha dagaalka ku yeelan kara dalalka gobolka, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay hadda isku dayeyso inay yareyso khatarta ku iman karta silsiladda sahayda iyo badeecooyinka ay dibadda kala soo degto. items.title: Yemen: Yemen conflict enters new phase as clashes move toward Bab Al-Mandab Strait
items.description: Shotlist FILE: Yemen – March 2024 (CCTV – No access Chinese mainland) 1. Various of cityscape, national flag of Yemen Sanaa, Yemen – Sept 12, 2026 (CGTN – No access Chinese mainland) 2. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Hizam al-Asad, member, Political Bureau of Ansar Allah (Houthis): “There are no implications for the security and safety of navigation in the Red Sea, and there is no reason for concern in this regard. We assure everyone that there is no cause for concern about maritime security. Navigation is safe and stable, operating normally and smoothly, and there are no intentions in this regard.” FILE: Yemen – 2022 (CGTN – No access Chinese mainland) 3. Various of Mayun Island in Bab al-Mandab Strait, armed soldiers on vehicles Sanaa, Yemen – Sept 12, 2026 (CGTN – No access Chinese mainland) 4. SOUNDBITE (Arabic)Rashad Al-Wutairi, military expert (starting with shot 3): “The Israeli enemy is trying today, in various ways, to strengthen its presence near the Bab Al-Mandab Strait by building relations with Somaliland. It has also made significant moves and visits to Al Mokha and other areas. However, recent developments have weakened this strategy and undermined the plans and arrangements Israel had built.” FILE: Red Sea – 2024 (CGTN – No access Chinese mainland) 5. Various of ships at sea Storyline Conflict in Yemen between the Houthis–officially known as Ansar Allah, and Saudi-backed government forces has entered a new phase along the western coast, with clashes moving toward the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, a key maritime route in the region. Houthis announced Friday that they had taken control of six districts in the western provinces of Taiz and Al-Hudaydah, covering about 5,400 square kilometers, in an operation that began on Sept. 3. The group also said commercial ships would not be targeted, with the exception of Saudi vessels. “There are no implications for the security and safety of navigation in the Red Sea, and there is no reason for concern in this regard. We assure everyone that there is no cause for concern about maritime security. Navigation is safe and stable, operating normally and smoothly, and there are no intentions in this regard,” said Hizam al-Asad, a member of the Political Bureau of Ansar Allah (Houthis). Yemeni government sources said that Houthis has also taken control of the Mayun Island, also known as Perim, in the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, a strategic waterway linking the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden. In response, forces loyal to Yemen’s internationally recognized government, with backing from Saudi Arabia, launched a military operation described as a “kill zone”. The operation designates areas along the western coast, including Al Mokha and Dhu Bab, as zones for intensive military strikes. “The Israeli enemy is trying today, in various ways, to strengthen its presence near the Bab Al-Mandab Strait by building relations with Somaliland. It has also made significant moves and visits to Al Mokha and other areas. However, recent developments have weakened this strategy and undermined the plans and arrangements Israel had built,” said Rashad Al-Wutairi, a military expert. The escalation is now extending beyond Yemen’s front lines, with fighting reaching areas that overlook the southern entrance to the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, one of the world’s most strategically important shipping routes. The developments are also raising concerns beyond Yemen. Egyptian government has formed a crisis cell, a high-level committee tasked with monitoring the situation along Yemen’s western coast. Egyptian government is concerned that any disruption to shipping through the Red Sea could have a direct impact on traffic through the Suez Canal, a vital artery for global maritime trade.

items.title: The Red Sea Fight Needs an African Shore
items.description: By Jonah Brody and MajGen Robert Sofge The United States (US) military presence in East Africa is well positioned to help defend the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, but its basing arrangements and host-country restrictions were designed primarily for counterterrorism rather than a maritime confrontation with Yemen’s Iran-backed political-military movement Ansar Allah, better known as the Houthis. As the war with Iran exposes the vulnerability of Red Sea commerce, Washington should develop distributed access at Berbera, in Somaliland, and Bosaso, in the semi-autonomous Somali region of Puntland. These footholds would support surveillance, maritime security, and contingency operations. Such arrangements would reduce dependence on Djibouti, bridge the operational divide between Africa Command and Central Command, and strengthen the US military’s ability to defend the chokepoint without requiring immediate recognition of Somaliland. Introduction The war between the US and Iran has opened a new maritime front along the Red Sea. As Washington and Tehran contest the Strait of Hormuz, Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis have declared a blockade of Saudi commerce through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait—the narrow waterway splitting Yemen and Djibouti that forms the southern gateway to the Red Sea. The corridor’s importance has grown for the global economy as Saudi Arabia now leans on the passage to export oil, now that the Strait of Hormuz has seized up. Ships still transit, but under enough risk that Saudi tankers now run dark and reroute . The threat reaches past Saudi Arabia: Houthi missiles have struck vessels flying non-Saudi flags and left merchant crews dead. That southern access point to the Red Sea is now contested, and the US posture there was built for an important but entirely different fight. The Counterterrorism Posture Meets a Maritime War The US military posture in East Africa is well placed but too narrowly tasked. For two decades, US Africa Command (AFRICOM) has optimized its East Africa presence for counterterrorism in Somalia : surveillance flights, strikes, special operations, and partner training against al-Shabaab, the Somalia-based al-Qaeda affiliate, and the Islamic State. That fight is necessary, and it has helped prevent al-Shabaab from overtaking the Somali capital of Mogadishu and driven the Islamic State’s Somalia branch into hiding . But while US forces in Africa, concentrated in Djibouti, sit almost exactly where a Red Sea fight would want them, their basing arrangements were built for striking and advising inland counterterrorism operations , and Djibouti’s restrictions constrain the offshore operations the Houthi threat now requires. The strategic landscape has outgrown an access architecture built for a narrower fight. Geography compounds the problem. The Bab el-Mandeb divides two US combatant commands, AFRICOM to its west and Central Command (CENTCOM)—which remains focused on the fight against Iran—to its east. Adversaries have long worked that seam. Recent public reporting from the Wall Street Journal describes Houthi technicians supplying al-Shabaab with drone and explosive-device expertise. The two groups have not merged their campaigns, but they share a common enemy. Their cooperation shows how untenable it is to treat the two shores as separate files. Djibouti Is Not Enough On the African shore, the American presence rests solely on one installation. Camp Lemonnier in Djibouti sits close to the strait —offering prime real estate for operations—but Djibouti has refused to let US forces strike Houthi positions that threaten the Bab el-Mandeb. Ironically, America’s only base in Africa cannot be used to defend the strait critical to its economic well-being. China’s only overseas base sits a few miles away, a separate reason not to stake America’s presence on one location. On the Arabian side, major CENTCOM operating locations sit well away from the chokepoint. A single base in Djibouti is not enough; Washington needs options. Build a Distributed Network at Berbera and Bosaso The near-term answer to the Houthi challenge is distributed access, and the US can build it quickly. Somaliland has offered the US the use of Berbera, which pairs one of the longest runways in Africa with a deep-water port on the Gulf of Aden. From Berbera, US forces could fly persistent surveillance over the strait; base maritime patrol and counter-drone assets; refuel and stage naval and special operations; and hold a recovery airfield on the chokepoint’s southern flank. Berbera would not win the maritime fight by itself, but it would give the US an additional, politically unencumbered foothold that Djibouti will not provide. The semi-autonomous Somali state of Puntland offers a second option. The US has agreed to expand the base at Bosaso, another Gulf of Aden port, for counterterrorism and maritime security. The deal is young and its results are unproven, but its significance is the shift it represents: the US has demonstrated a willingness to make direct security arrangements with capable sub-federal authorities when operations demand it, rather than wait on the federal government in Mogadishu. Bosaso and Berbera together would give American forces a network across the coast that matters most. Access at Berbera would also align the US with Israel, which recognized Somaliland in December and, according to Bloomberg , has established a small intelligence presence there and is exploring a base from which to monitor and strike the Houthis. Somaliland’s leaders have been guarded about hosting foreign forces, so this remains unsettled. But a shared foothold on the southern flank would knit together partners already hitting the same Iranian adversary. Access Without Immediate Recognition The US needs only enough access to improve its ability to defend the Bab el-Mandeb, and that does not require recognizing Somaliland now. Skeptics will call a base at Berbera a de facto recognition of Somaliland, even if the US does not say so in an official capacity. But access can rest on a security agreement with the Somaliland authorities that govern Berbera by dealing with them as the party in control on the ground, which avoids recognizing Somaliland as a sovereign state. That is the approach the US just took at Bosaso, where it dealt directly with Puntland’s local authorities instead of Somalia’s federal government in Mogadishu. Going around the federal government does carry real costs: strain on a fragile federal system; propaganda for al-Shabaab; and friction with the African Union, Turkey, the UAE, and Ethiopia. But two facts blunt the sovereignty charge. The federal government cannot deliver quick, reliable coastal access in a crisis. And in early 2025 Somalia itself offered the US its strategic ports, Berbera and Bosaso among them, that it does not control. The Houthi threat predates this war and will likely outlast it. The tools to manage it—runways, ports, sensors, patrol aircraft, and counter-drone systems—are available on both shores of the chokepoint. If we have learned anything from the current fight in the Persian Gulf, it is that getting the geography right in front of a full-blown crisis matters.     Source Smallwarsjournal

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo weerarro cusub ku qaaday Sacuudiga
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa qaaday weerarro cusub oo ay ku beegsanayaan gudaha Sacuudiga, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan dagaallada Yemen, isla markaana ay hakadeen dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu doonayay in dib loogu furo Marin-biyoodka Hormuz oo muhiim u ah isu-socodka shidaalka caalamka. Sida ay Reuters werisay, Xuutiyiinta ayaa Isniintii sheegay inay dhowr iyo toban gantaal iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku weerareen saldhigga cirka ee Khamis Mushait ee koonfurta Sacuudiga. Waxay sheegeen in weerarka lagu bartilmaameedsaday hangarrada diyaaradaha, nidaamyada radar-ka, runway-yada iyo bakhaarada rasaasta. Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ee ka dagaallama Yemen ayaa sheegay in weerarradaasi ay ku dhaawacmeen 13 qof oo rayid ah , halka maamulka Sacuudigu uu digniino degdeg ah ka bixiyay Khamis Mushait iyo saddex magaalo oo kale oo ku yaalla koonfurta dalka. Weerarradan ayaa imanaya iyadoo Xuutiyiintu maalmihii u dambeeyay ay ballaarinayeen dhaq-dhaqaaqooda milatari, gaar ahaan xeebaha galbeed ee Yemen ee ku teedsan Badda Cas. Saraakiil ka tirsan dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay weli si wax ku ool ah u maamulaan inta badan xeebaha galbeed ee dalka, oo ay ku jirto jasiiradda Perim , oo ku taalla afka laga galo Badda Cas. Dhanka kale, ciidamada cirka Sacuudiga iyo kuwa dowladda Yemen ayaa kordhiyay duqeymaha ay ku qaadayaan goobaha ay Xuutiyiintu maamulaan, oo ay ku jiraan deegaanada ku dhow dekedda taariikhiga ah ee Mocha . Saraakiil Yemeni ah ayaa sheegay in inkastoo Xuutiyiinta cadaadis milatari lagu hayo, haddana ay iyaguna kordhinayaan weerarrada gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga. Xiisadda ayaa sidoo kale cadaadis ku sii kordhinaysa dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga, kaddib markii weerar cirka ah oo dhacay Khamiistii uu shaqada ka joojiyay dhuumaha shidaalka ee isku xira bariga iyo galbeedka dalka. Riyadh ayaa weerarka ku eedeysay maleeshiyaad Iran taageerto oo ka howlgala Ciraaq. Dhuumahaasi oo dhererkoodu yahay ku dhowaad 1,200 kiiloomitir ayaa Sacuudigu u dhisay inuu shidaalka uga gudbiyo Gacanka una diro Badda Cas, taasoo u oggolaanaysa inuu ka fogaado Marin-biyoodka Hormuz haddii marin-biyoodkaasi halis galo. Ganacsatada shidaalka ayaa sheegay in haddii dhuumahaasi muddo dheer xirnaadaan, iyadoo Hormuz-na uu si weyn u xanniban yahay, ay suuragal tahay in saameyntu gaarto ilaa 4 boqolkiiba sahayda shidaalka adduunka . Qiimaha saliidda cayriin ayaa Isniintii kor u kacay in ka badan 4 boqolkiiba, inkastoo uu markii dambe ku soo xirnaa koror ku dhow 1 boqolkiiba. Mareykanka oo ka gaabsanaya faragelin toos ah Dagaalka cusub ee Yemen ayaa caqabad kale ku noqday madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump. Saddex ilo-wareed oo Reuters la hadlay ayaa sheegay in Washington ay ilaa hadda ka gaabsatay codsiyada Sacuudiga ee ku aaddan faragelin militari oo toos ah, iyadoo taageerada Mareykanka ay inta badan ku kooban tahay xogta sirdoonka. Trump ayaa sheegay inuu dhammaadka toddobaadkii la hadlay dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Maxamed bin Salmaan, halka Xuutiyiintuna ay Washington kala xiriireen inay Mareykanka ka fogaato dagaalka. Warbaahinta dowladda Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Maxamed bin Salmaan uu Isniintii magaalada Jeddah kula kulmay Admiral Brad Cooper, oo ah taliyaha ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Dhanka kale, rajadii laga qabay in xiisadda gobolka lagu dejiyo wada-hadal ayaa sii yaraanaysa. Cumaan ayaa qorsheynayay inuu Isniintii martigeliyo kulan ay Iran iyo dalalka Khaliijku kaga wada hadlaan sidii dib loogu furi lahaa Marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Hase yeeshee, kulanka ayaa dib loo dhigay. Trump ayaa mar kale sheegay in Iran ay diyaar u tahay heshiis degdeg ah, balse Mohsen Rezaei, oo ka tirsan Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran, ayaa hadalkaas ku tilmaamay wax mashquulinaya, isagoo sheegay inaysan jiri doonin wada-hadallo ilaa shuruudaha Iran la buuxiyo. Xiisadda badda ayaa sidoo kale sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo maraakiibta isticmaasha Hormuz. Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ayaa sheegtay in markabka shidaalka El Gaia , oo sita calanka Panama, uu ku dhacay miinooyin badeed isagoo marayay aag Iran ay mamnuucday oo ku yaalla koonfurta Hormuz. Hase yeeshee, Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka ayaa si degdeg ah u beeniyay sheegashadaas, isagoo sheegay in markabka uu bishii hore ku dhacay gantaal laga soo riday Iran, taasoo ka dhigtay mid aan shaqayn karin. Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Badaha ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa xaqiijisay in markabka uu waxyeello soo gaartay Sabtidii, balse ma aysan sheegin sababta, iyadoo sidoo kale sheegtay in Reuters ayaa sheegtay inaysan si degdeg ah ula xiriiri karin milkiilayaasha markabka oo ku sugan Dubai si ay u xaqiijiso wararka iska soo horjeeda. Hormuz ayaa weli ah mid ka mid ah marinnada shidaalka ee ugu muhiimsan dunida, waxaana Reuters ay sheegtay in isu-socodkiisu si weyn u hakaday tan iyo markii dagaalku billowday 28-kii Febraayo. Xuutiyiinta iyo Iran ayaa sii wada tallaabooyinka kordhinaya khatarta ku wajahan maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo sahayda tamarta caalamka.

Saraakiil ka tirsan dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay weli si wax ku ool ah u maamulaan inta badan xeebaha galbeed ee dalka, oo ay ku jirto jasiiradda Perim , oo ku taalla afka laga galo Badda Cas. Dhanka kale, ciidamada cirka Sacuudiga iyo kuwa dowladda Yemen ayaa kordhiyay duqeymaha ay ku qaadayaan goobaha ay Xuutiyiintu maamulaan, oo ay ku jiraan deegaanada ku dhow dekedda taariikhiga ah ee Mocha . Saraakiil Yemeni ah ayaa sheegay in inkastoo Xuutiyiinta cadaadis milatari lagu hayo, haddana ay iyaguna kordhinayaan weerarrada gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga. Xiisadda ayaa sidoo kale cadaadis ku sii kordhinaysa dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga, kaddib markii weerar cirka ah oo dhacay Khamiistii uu shaqada ka joojiyay dhuumaha shidaalka ee isku xira bariga iyo galbeedka dalka. Riyadh ayaa weerarka ku eedeysay maleeshiyaad Iran taageerto oo ka howlgala Ciraaq. Dhuumahaasi oo dhererkoodu yahay ku dhowaad 1,200 kiiloomitir ayaa Sacuudigu u dhisay inuu shidaalka uga gudbiyo Gacanka una diro Badda Cas, taasoo u oggolaanaysa inuu ka fogaado Marin-biyoodka Hormuz haddii marin-biyoodkaasi halis galo. Ganacsatada shidaalka ayaa sheegay in haddii dhuumahaasi muddo dheer xirnaadaan, iyadoo Hormuz-na uu si weyn u xanniban yahay, ay suuragal tahay in saameyntu gaarto ilaa 4 boqolkiiba sahayda shidaalka adduunka . Qiimaha saliidda cayriin ayaa Isniintii kor u kacay in ka badan 4 boqolkiiba, inkastoo uu markii dambe ku soo xirnaa koror ku dhow 1 boqolkiiba. Mareykanka oo ka gaabsanaya faragelin toos ah Dagaalka cusub ee Yemen ayaa caqabad kale ku noqday madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump. Saddex ilo-wareed oo Reuters la hadlay ayaa sheegay in Washington ay ilaa hadda ka gaabsatay codsiyada Sacuudiga ee ku aaddan faragelin militari oo toos ah, iyadoo taageerada Mareykanka ay inta badan ku kooban tahay xogta sirdoonka. Trump ayaa sheegay inuu dhammaadka toddobaadkii la hadlay dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Maxamed bin Salmaan, halka Xuutiyiintuna ay Washington kala xiriireen inay Mareykanka ka fogaato dagaalka. Warbaahinta dowladda Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Maxamed bin Salmaan uu Isniintii magaalada Jeddah kula kulmay Admiral Brad Cooper, oo ah taliyaha ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Dhanka kale, rajadii laga qabay in xiisadda gobolka lagu dejiyo wada-hadal ayaa sii yaraanaysa. Cumaan ayaa qorsheynayay inuu Isniintii martigeliyo kulan ay Iran iyo dalalka Khaliijku kaga wada hadlaan sidii dib loogu furi lahaa Marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Hase yeeshee, kulanka ayaa dib loo dhigay. Trump ayaa mar kale sheegay in Iran ay diyaar u tahay heshiis degdeg ah, balse Mohsen Rezaei, oo ka tirsan Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran, ayaa hadalkaas ku tilmaamay wax mashquulinaya, isagoo sheegay inaysan jiri doonin wada-hadallo ilaa shuruudaha Iran la buuxiyo. Xiisadda badda ayaa sidoo kale sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo maraakiibta isticmaasha Hormuz. Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ayaa sheegtay in markabka shidaalka El Gaia , oo sita calanka Panama, uu ku dhacay miinooyin badeed isagoo marayay aag Iran ay mamnuucday oo ku yaalla koonfurta Hormuz. Hase yeeshee, Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka ayaa si degdeg ah u beeniyay sheegashadaas, isagoo sheegay in markabka uu bishii hore ku dhacay gantaal laga soo riday Iran, taasoo ka dhigtay mid aan shaqayn karin. Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Badaha ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa xaqiijisay in markabka uu waxyeello soo gaartay Sabtidii, balse ma aysan sheegin sababta, iyadoo sidoo kale sheegtay in Reuters ayaa sheegtay inaysan si degdeg ah ula xiriiri karin milkiilayaasha markabka oo ku sugan Dubai si ay u xaqiijiso wararka iska soo horjeeda. Hormuz ayaa weli ah mid ka mid ah marinnada shidaalka ee ugu muhiimsan dunida, waxaana Reuters ay sheegtay in isu-socodkiisu si weyn u hakaday tan iyo markii dagaalku billowday 28-kii Febraayo. Xuutiyiinta iyo Iran ayaa sii wada tallaabooyinka kordhinaya khatarta ku wajahan maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo sahayda tamarta caalamka.

items.title: Soomaaliya Oo Ka Qaybgalaysa Kalfadhiga Degdegga Ah Ee Wasiirrada IGAD
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali, ayaa gaaray magaalada Jabuuti, halkaas oo uu wafdiga Soomaaliya uga hoggaaminayo kalfadhiga 74-aad ee aan caadiga ahayn ee Golaha Wasiirrada urur-goboleedka IGAD. Kalfadhiga oo loo qorsheeyey 15-ka Sebteembar ayaa waxaa ka qayb-galaya wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda iyo wakiillo ka socda dalalka xubnaha ka ah IGAD. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa xaaladda nabadda iyo ammaanka gobolka iyo arrimo la xiriira howlaha ururka. Wasiirrada ayaa la filayaa inay qiimeeyaan isbeddellada siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee ka jira Geeska Afrika, xilli gobolka uu wajahayo colaado, xiisado diblomaasiyadeed iyo xaalado bani’aadannimo. Shirka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadli doonaa qodobbo hay’adeed, oo ay ku jirto xoojinta heshiiska lagu aasaasay IGAD iyo kor u qaadidda awoodda ururka ee wax ka qabashada caqabadaha gobolka. Ka qaybgalka Soomaaliya wuxuu ku soo beegmayaa xilli dalku door muuqda ku leeyahay wada-hadallada gobolka ee ku saabsan amniga, iskaashiga siyaasadeed iyo xallinta khilaafaadka, hase yeeshee, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda weli ma faahfaahin mowqifyada ama soo-jeedimaha gaarka ah ee wafdiga Soomaaliya uu shirka la tegayo. Natiijada kalfadhiga ayaa la filayaa inay muujiso sida dalalka IGAD uga jawaabayaan xaaladaha isbeddelaya ee Geeska Afrika iyo jihada dib-u-habeynta ururka. War-murtiyeedka shirka ayaa sidoo kale caddeyn kara go’aannada laga gaaro arrimaha nabadda, ammaanka iyo xoojinta wada-shaqeynta gobolka.

items.title: G Maraykanka oo markii ugu horreysay xaqiijiyay inuu hawada sare geeyay hub dagaal
items.description: Maraykanka ayaa xaqiijiyay inuu hawada sare, meeraha Dhulka ku wareegsan, geeyay hub loo adeegsado dagaalka hawada sare, taas oo ah markii ugu horreysay ee uu si rasmi ah u qiro inuu leeyahaP0P0⁰Tetd886w awood noocaas ah oo weerar ah. Xoghayaha Ciidanka Cirka ee Maraykanka, Troy Meink, ayaa sheegay in hubka ku sugan hawada sare uu muhiim u yahay ilaalinta ciidamada Maraykanka iyo ka hortagga weerarrada cadowga. Isagoo Isniintii ka hadlayay shirkii Ciidanka Cirka, Hawada Sare iyo Internet-ka ee loo yaqaan Air, Space and Cyber Conference, Meink wuxuu sheegay in Maraykanku diyaar u yahay inuu wajaho “khataraha isbeddelaya”, balse ma uusan faahfaahin awoodda hubkan ama xiligii hawada sare la geeyay. Hoggaamiyeyaasha sare ee milatariga Maraykanka ayaa horey u sheegay inay qorsheynayaan in la xoojiyo awoodda milatari ee hawada sare, iyagoo tilmaamay barnaamijyada Ruushka iyo Shiinaha ee lagu horumarinayo habab lagu weerari karo ama lagu carqaladeyn karo dayax-gacmeedyada Maraykanka haddii uu mustaqbalka dagaal dhaco. Maamulka Trump ayaa sheegay in awoodaha milatari ee hawada sare iyo gantaallada wax-ka-qabta ay qayb muhiim ah ka yihiin nidaamka difaaca uu qorsheeyay ee loo yaqaan “Golden Dome”, kaas oo loogu talagalay in Maraykanka laga ilaaliyo gantaallada iyo khataraha kale ee hawada. Heshiis caalami ah oo la saxiixay sannadkii 1967 ayaa mamnuucaya in hubka wax gumaada la geeyo ama lagu keydiyo hawada sare. Tan iyo markaas, quwadaha waaweyn oo ay ka mid yihiin Maraykanka, Ruushka iyo Shiinaha ayaa baarayay awoodo kale oo aan heshiiskaas si toos ah uga hor imaanayn, sida in la bartilmaameedsado dayax-gacmeedyada dalalka ay iska soo horjeedaan. Dayax-gacmeedyadu waxay muhiim u yihiin isgaarsiinta milatariga, la socodka iyo hagidda ciidamada. Sannadkii hore, Madaxweyne Donald Trump wuxuu soo saaray amar fulineed oo xoojinaya doorka Ciidanka Hawada Sare ee Maraykanka , isaga oo sheegay in ciidanku uusan ku koobnaan doonin oo keliya difaaca hantida Maraykanka ee hawada sare, balse uu sidoo kale yeelan karo awood weerar. US Space Force, oo ah laanta ugu cusub ee ciidamada qalabka sida ee Maraykanka muddo ka badan 70 sano, waxaa la aas-aasay sannadkii 2019 si loo ilaaliyo hantida Maraykanka ee hawada sare, oo ay ku jiraan boqolaal dayax-gacmeed oo loo adeegsado isgaarsiinta iyo kormeerka. Afhayeen u hadlay Ciidanka Hawada Sare ee Maraykanka ayaa sheegay in “xakamaynta hawada sare” ay ka kooban tahay hawlgallada looga baahan yahay in lagu tartamo laguna xakameeyo goobta hawada sare, iyadoo la adeegsanayo habab waxyeello geysta iyo kuwo aan waxyeello toos ah geysan si loo carqaladeeyo, loo wiiqo ama xitaa loo burburiyo awoodaha cadowga haddii loo baahdo. Afhayeenku wuxuu sheegay in awoodahan loo adeegsan karo difaac iyo weerarba, iyadoo lagu salaynayo amarrada hoggaanka ciidamada dagaalka. Horraantii bishii Febraayo, waxaa la shaaciyay in laba dayax-gacmeed oo Ruushku leeyahay ay u badan tahay inay qabteen ama dhexgaleen isgaarsiinta ugu yaraan 12 dayax-gacmeed oo Yurub leeyahay tan iyo markii Ruushku duullaanka ku qaaday Ukraine sannadkii 2022-kii. Dhexgalka noocaas ah ayaa laga yaabaa inuu sirdoonka Ruushka u saamaxay inuu akhriyo xogta xasaasiga ah ee ay dayax-gacmeedyadu gudbinayeen, ama, aragti ahaan, xitaa inuu la wareego gacan-ku-haynta dayax-gacmeedyada. Sannadkii 2024, Maraykanku wuxuu sheegay in Ruushku hawada sare u diray dayax-gacmeed uu Maraykanku aaminsanaa inuu awood u leeyahay inuu weeraro dayax-gacmeedyo kale. Ruushku si rasmi ah ugama uusan hadlin arrintaas. Ciidanka Hawada Sare ee Maraykanka ayaa sheegay in Shiinuhu “horumariyo oo isticmaalo awoodo hawada sare iyo kuwa lidka-hawada sare ah, taas oo qayb ka ah istaraatiijiyaddiisa casriyeynta milatariga.” Waxa kale oo uu sheegay in Ruushku “hawada sare u arko goob dagaal, isla markaana aaminsan yahay in ka sarreysnaanta hawada sare ay noqon doonto arrin go’aamisa dagaallada mustaqbalka.” Bbc somali

items.title: Duurjoog gaajaysan oo qasaare gaarsiiyay dalagyada beeraleyda Togdheer
items.description: (ERGO) – Xayn daab la’aan haysa beeraha tuulooyin hoostaga dagmada Sheekh ee gobolka Togdheer ayaa ka hor istaagay 150 beeraley ah in sii wataan beero falashada oo ahaa ishooda dhaqaale, markii xayawaano ku hungoobay helidda roobka ay caqabd u noqdeen dalagga beeraha. Waxay wajahayaan cunno xumo ka sii daraysa tan bishii Juun ee sanadkan, markaas oo ay joojiyeen tacabka beeraha, kaddib qasaare ay u gaysteen daanyeerro, doofaarro iyo xayawaano kale, kuwaas oo cunay dalagyo ay beerteen labo fasal oo is-xigay. Dhir yaraanta ka jirta deegannadooda Cagaarey, Ximin, Boodhlay ayaa u saamixi wayday in ay beeraha u helaan gaashaan ka difaaca xayawaanka, halka sidoo kale ay iibsan waayeen silig ay ku wareejiyaan sida uu sheegay Axmed Cumar Cige oo ah gudoomiye iskaashato ay leeyihiin. “Ood uun baa celin karta, lamana samayn karo. Xabad laguma ridi karo, gacan kuma dili kartid oo magaaraysidba. Habeenkii iyo maalintiiba way soo galayaan. Haddii aad sumayso xayawanka iyo bini’aadamka waxwalb way sumoobayaan. Waxay noqotay fursad adag oo aan waxba la beeran karin.” Beeraleydii ugu danbeeyay ee qasaraha uu gaaaray beerahooda waxaa ka mid ah Maxamed Cismaan Warsame. Duurjoog u badan daanyeer ayaa ka cunay dalag u saarnaa beer 2 hiktar ah, isla markaana iskugu jiray noocyada kala duwan ee khudaarta, galay iyo digir. Wuxuu tilmaamay in billowgii sanadkan uu joojiyay in uu dalag galiyo beertiisa oo ku taalla cirifka dhul-beereedka deegaanka Cagaarey, halkaas oo uu ku wajahay weerarka xayawaanka oo qasaare gaarsiiyay dalagyo uu ku beertay. Bishii Abriil ayuu kiraystay dhul ku yaalla bartamaha dhul beereedka si uu u helo meel uu kaga badbaado Daanyeerka iyo duurjoogta kale, balse bishii Juun oo dalaggu gurasho ku dhawaa ayuu la kulmay weerar kale, wuxuuna ku waayay dhamaan mirihii uu beertay. “Aniga oo dhex jooga ayuu daanyeerku isaga oo malaha 500 oo xabbo ah 3 qayb inta uu iskadhigay ayuu dhinac waxba ka soo galay, dabadeedna circle buu igaliyay. Waan ka niyad jabay, haddana marka duruuftu ku kalifayso waxaad is oranaysaa, haddana wax tabco; Marka waa kuuna taag li’i, kaamana tagi karo.” Dalagga uu ka cunay xayawaanka ayuu galiyay lacag dhan $800, taas oo qayb ka mid ah uu dayn ku helay, sida kirada dhulka uu beertay oo ahaa $200 iyo abuurka. Waa qasarihii saddexaad ee ka soo gaaray xayawaanka labadii sano ee u danbeeyay, taas oo kaliftay in uu ka quusto beero-falashada. Beertiisa waxaa ku tiirsanaa qoyskiisa oo 12 ah, kuwaas duruufta nolol xumo ay sababtay in ay labo u qayb samaan. Lix ka mid ah ayuu u geeyay qoys ay ehelo yihiin oo ku nool dagmada Sheekh, markii uu awood u waayay in uu dhamaantood wada quudiyo. items.title: TİKA Oo Qalab Tababar Ku Wareejisay Machadka Qaranka Ee Umulisooyinka
items.description: Hay’adda Iskaashiga iyo Isku-duwidda Turkiga ee TİKA ayaa qalab caafimaad ku wareejisay Machadka Qaranka ee Umulisooyinka Soomaaliya. Qalabka ayaa loogu tala-galay in ardayda machadku ay ku qaataan tababarro wax-ku-ool ah oo la xiriira daryeelka hooyada iyo dhallaanka. Munaasabadda wareejinta qalabka waxaa ka qaybgashay Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada, Dr. Maryama Maxamed Xuseen. Waxay sheegtay in taageeradani ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada lagu tayeynayo xarumaha lagu tababaro shaqaalaha caafimaadka, gaar ahaan umulisooyinka. Qalabkan ayaa la filayaa inuu ardayda ka caawiyo inay si toos ah ugu tababartaan xirfadaha ay u baahan yihiin ka hor inta aysan bilaabin adeegga caafimaadka. Tababarka wax-ku-oolka ah ayaa muhiim u ah diyaarinta umulisooyin awood u leh inay si badbaado leh ula tacaalaan xaaladaha uurka iyo dhalmada. Machadka Qaranka ee Umulisooyinka ayaa door muhiim ah ka qaata soo saaridda xirfadlayaal ka shaqeeya xarumaha caafimaadka ee dalka. Tayeynta machadka waxay gacan ka geysan kartaa kordhinta tirada umulisooyinka tababaran iyo hagaajinta adeegyada ay helaan haweenka uurka leh iyo carruurta dhalanaysa. Taageerada TİKA waxay qayb ka tahay iskaashiga caafimaad ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, kaas oo ay ku jiraan tababarrada shaqaalaha, qalabaynta xarumaha caafimaadka iyo horumarinta adeegyada caafimaad. Hay’addu waxay Soomaaliya ka fulisay mashaariic kala duwan oo la xiriira caafimaadka iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada. Faahfaahin dhammaystiran lagama bixin noocyada iyo tirada qalabka lagu wareejiyey machadka, qiimihiisa ama tirada ardayda ka faa’iidaysanaysa. Si kastaba, taageeradan waxay xoojin kartaa tababarka umulisooyinka iyo dadaallada lagu dhimayo khataraha la xiriira caafimaadka hooyada iyo dhallaanka.

items.title: Dalalka Khaliijka oo wajahaya xaalad laba daran mid dooro ah
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) — Qabsashada Xuutiyiinta ee qeybo muhiim ah oo ka tirsan xeebaha Badda Cas ee Yemen ayaa si weyn u beddeleysa miisaanka awoodda Bariga Dhexe, iyadoo Iran siinaysa awood dheeraad ah oo ay ku cadaadiso Sacuudiga iyo dalalka kale ee Khaliijka. Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Tehran ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyay gaaray jasiirado iyo goobo istaraatiiji ah oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, oo ah marin ay maraan qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah ganacsiga iyo shidaalka dunida. Horumarkan ayaa Iran iyo xulafadeeda siinaya awood ay cadaadis uga saaraan laba dhinac oo muhiim u ah dhoofinta tamarta gobolka: Marinka Hormuz ee dhinaca bari iyo Bab al-Mandab ee dhinaca galbeed. Sacuudiga ayaa intii uu socday dagaalka qayb badan oo ka mid ah shidaalkiisa u wareejiyay dekedaha Badda Cas, kadib markii qalalaasaha ka taagan Hormuz uu wiiqay isticmaalka marinkaasi. Hase yeeshee, Riyadh ayaa Jimcihii xirtay dhuun muhiim ah oo shidaalka u qaadda dhinaca Badda Cas kadib markii weerar lagu qaaday, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca ku saabsan awoodda Boqortooyada ay ku sii wadi karto dhoofinta saliidda iyadoo labada marin ee waaweyn ee gobolka ay halis ku jiraan. Khabiirro iyo saraakiil gobolka ah ayaa sheegaya in xaaladdan ay Tehran siinayso fursad ay ku kordhiso cadaadiska dhaqaale iyo kan siyaasadeed ee dalalka Khaliijka, iyadoo sicirka shidaalka iyo qiimaha badeecadaha kale ee caalamka ay kor u kici karaan haddii maraakiibta Badda Cas iyo Hormuz ay sii wajahaan khatar. “Qabsashada Xuutiyiinta ee jasiiradaha istaraatiijiga ah ee ku dhow Bab al-Mandab waa isbeddel weyn,” ayuu yiri Fawaz Gerges, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay arrimaha Bariga Dhexe. “Waxay beddeleysaa miisaanka awoodda, waxayna siinaysaa Xuutiyiinta awood siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale oo aad uga ballaaran tii ay horey u haysteen marka laga hadlayo Sacuudiga, Khaliijka, Mareykanka iyo ganacsiga caalamka.” Cadaadis ku wajahan dalalka Khaliijka Horumarka Xuutiyiinta ayaa imanaya xilli dalalka Khaliijka ay wajahayaan go’aan adag oo ku saabsan sida ay ula macaamilayaan Iran. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa lagu soo warramay inuu diiday codsi uu dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Maxamed bin Salmaan ku dalbaday in Mareykanku weerarro Xuutiyiinta. Go’aankaas, oo ay weheliso khasaaraha dhaqaale ee sii kordhaya, ayaa saraakiil gobolka ah ku riixaya aragtida ah in wada-hadal lala galo Tehran aanu hadda ahayn oo keliya doorasho diblomaasiyadeed, balse uu noqon karo arrin la xiriirta ilaalinta danaha dhaqaale iyo ammaanka. Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda dalalka Khaliijka iyo dhiggooda Iran, Abbas Araqchi, ayaa lagu waday inay Isniinta ku kulmaan dalka Cumaan si ay uga wada hadlaan heshiis ku saabsan maamulka maraakiibta isticmaasha Marinka Hormuz. Kulanka ayaa dib loo dhigay kadib markii la isku khilaafay shuruudaha wada-hadallada, sida uu Reuters u sheegay ilo ka tirsan Khaliijka. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Cumaan Badr Albusaidi ayaa sheegay in kulanka lagu waday inuu ka dhaco magaalada Salalah loo baajiyay “danaha is-afgaradka”, isagoo intaa ku daray in dalkiisu weli ka go’an tahay taageeridda wada-hadalka gobolka. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Iran Masoud Pezeshkian ayaa sheegay inuu wadahadallo wanaagsan la yeeshay Dhaxal-sugaha Imaaraadka Carabta, Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, xilli ay ku sugnaayeen New Delhi oo ay kaga qeyb-galayeen shir madaxeedka BRICS. “Waxaan ku heshiinnay inaan wixii hore iska dhaafno oo aan mustaqbalka eegno, iyo sida aan mustaqbal wadajir ah u dhisi karno,” ayuu yiri Pezeshkian. Arrinta ugu weyn ee dalalka Khaliijka hortaalla ayaa ah in juqraafi ahaan Iran aan laga saari karin nidaamka ammaanka gobolka. Iran waxay ku taallaa meel aad ugu dhow marinada ugu muhiimsan ee shidaalka iyo ganacsiga caalamka, taas oo ka dhigaysa awood aysan Sacuudiga, Imaaraadka iyo dalalka kale ee gobolka si fudud uga gudbi karin. Dagaalka ka dhashay weerarradii Mareykanka iyo Israel ku qaadeen Iran ayaa sidoo kale dhaawacay dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed ee sanadaha badan lagu doonayay in lagu xakameeyo khilaafka Tehran iyo dalalka Khaliijka. Trump oo Axaddii wax laga weydiiyay kulamada u dhexeeya dalalka Khaliijka iyo Iran ayaa sheegay in go’aankaasi iyaga u yaallo. Istaraatiijiyadda tallaabo-tallaabada ah Alex Vatanka oo ka tirsan Machadka Bariga Dhexe ayaa sheegay in su’aasha ugu weyn ee dalalka Khaliijka aysan hadda ahayn inay Iran ku kalsoonaan karaan iyo in kale, balse ay tahay sida ay u ilaalin karaan danahooda xilli Mareykanku u muuqdo in uusan si degdeg ah u soo afjari karin dagaalka. Taasi waxay dalalka Khaliijka ku riixi kartaa inay Tehran la yeeshaan waddo diblomaasiyadeed oo u gaar ah, isla markaana mustaqbalka yareeyaan ku-tiirsanaantooda Mareykanka dhinaca ammaanka. “Dalalka Khaliijka waxay hadda ka fikirayaan xaqiiqada aasaasiga ah ee ah inay khasab ku noqon karto inay iyagu heshiis la galaan Iran, iyadoon loo eegin sida Mareykanku uga falceliyo, sababtoo ah Mareykanku kama saari karo dhibaatadan,” ayuu yiri Vatanka. Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga waxaa ka dhexeeyay dagaallo muddo dheer ka horreeyay colaadda hadda dhex taalla Mareykanka iyo Iran. Xuutiyiinta, oo ka soo jeeda bulshada Zaydiga ee Shiicada Yemen, ayaa dhowr dagaal la galay Sacuudiga ka hor inta aysan 2014 qabsan caasimadda Sanca. Sacuudiga ayaa sanadkii xigay hoggaamiyay isbahaysi militari oo galay Yemen, balse sannado duqeymo iyo dagaallo xuduudeed ah kadib Xuutiyiinta ma aysan burburin. Taa beddelkeeda, waxay ballaariyeen awooddooda militari, iyagoo noqday mid ka mid ah xulafada ugu awoodda badan Iran ee gobolka. Khabiirkii hore ee Mareykanka Aaron David Miller ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiinta aan loo arki karin wakiillo caadi ah oo Iran u shaqeeya. “Waxay hub ka dhigi karaan juqraafiga, waxayna saameyn weyn ku yeelan karaan dhaqaalaha caalamka iyo suuqa shidaalka dunida,” ayuu yiri. Sarkaal ka tirsan gobolka ayaa isna sheegay in horumarka Xuutiyiinta uu qeyb ka yahay istaraatiijiyad ay Tehran si tartiib ah u waddo. “Iran arrintan waxay u aragtaa ciyaar shax ah. Waxay qorsheeyaan waxa xiga. Dhammaan awooddooda isku mar uma adeegsadaan cabsi darteed,” ayuu yiri. “Xuutiyiinta ayaa hadda ah xulafada keliya ee Iran ee weli leh awood militari oo xooggan.” Cadaadiska dhaqaale ee Washington ku hayso Iran ayaa saameynaya Tehran, balse ilo ka tirsan Khaliijka ayaa sheegay in cawaaqib kale oo ka dhalanaya uu yahay in xulafada Mareykanka ee gobolka ay dib uga fikirayaan in iska horimaad joogto ah oo lala galo Iran uu yahay mid ay sii wadi karaan. Qabsashada Xuutiyiinta ee xeebaha iyo jasiiradaha ku dhow Bab al-Mandab ayaa sidaas darteed ka dhigaysa Tehran mid leh kaarar cusub oo ay ku gorgortanto, halka Sacuudiga iyo deriskiisuna ay wajahayaan laba doorasho oo adag: inay sii qaataan kharashaadka dhaqaale iyo amni ee sii kordhaya, ama inay raadiyaan heshiis cusub oo ay Iran kula noolaadaan.
