items.fullContent: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) — Qabsashada Xuutiyiinta ee qeybo muhiim ah oo ka tirsan xeebaha Badda Cas ee Yemen ayaa si weyn u beddeleysa miisaanka awoodda Bariga Dhexe, iyadoo Iran siinaysa awood dheeraad ah oo ay ku cadaadiso Sacuudiga iyo dalalka kale ee Khaliijka. Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Tehran ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyay gaaray jasiirado iyo goobo istaraatiiji ah oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, oo ah marin ay maraan qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah ganacsiga iyo shidaalka dunida. Horumarkan ayaa Iran iyo xulafadeeda siinaya awood ay cadaadis uga saaraan laba dhinac oo muhiim u ah dhoofinta tamarta gobolka: Marinka Hormuz ee dhinaca bari iyo Bab al-Mandab ee dhinaca galbeed. Sacuudiga ayaa intii uu socday dagaalka qayb badan oo ka mid ah shidaalkiisa u wareejiyay dekedaha Badda Cas, kadib markii qalalaasaha ka taagan Hormuz uu wiiqay isticmaalka marinkaasi. Hase yeeshee, Riyadh ayaa Jimcihii xirtay dhuun muhiim ah oo shidaalka u qaadda dhinaca Badda Cas kadib markii weerar lagu qaaday, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca ku saabsan awoodda Boqortooyada ay ku sii wadi karto dhoofinta saliidda iyadoo labada marin ee waaweyn ee gobolka ay halis ku jiraan. Khabiirro iyo saraakiil gobolka ah ayaa sheegaya in xaaladdan ay Tehran siinayso fursad ay ku kordhiso cadaadiska dhaqaale iyo kan siyaasadeed ee dalalka Khaliijka, iyadoo sicirka shidaalka iyo qiimaha badeecadaha kale ee caalamka ay kor u kici karaan haddii maraakiibta Badda Cas iyo Hormuz ay sii wajahaan khatar. “Qabsashada Xuutiyiinta ee jasiiradaha istaraatiijiga ah ee ku dhow Bab al-Mandab waa isbeddel weyn,” ayuu yiri Fawaz Gerges, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay arrimaha Bariga Dhexe. “Waxay beddeleysaa miisaanka awoodda, waxayna siinaysaa Xuutiyiinta awood siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale oo aad uga ballaaran tii ay horey u haysteen marka laga hadlayo Sacuudiga, Khaliijka, Mareykanka iyo ganacsiga caalamka.” Cadaadis ku wajahan dalalka Khaliijka Horumarka Xuutiyiinta ayaa imanaya xilli dalalka Khaliijka ay wajahayaan go’aan adag oo ku saabsan sida ay ula macaamilayaan Iran. items.title: Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Gobolka Hiiraan oo culeys ku ah Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka
items.description: Xiisadda siyaasadeed ee ka soo korortay Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa soo jiidatay indhaha Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, oo laga doonayo inay gacan ka gaystaan sugidda nabadgelyada magaalooyinka waaweyn ee gobolkaasi, gaar ahaan magaalooyinka laga qabanayo doorashada qofka iyo codka ee la rabo inay dadka deegaanka ku soo doortaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Hirshabelle. Magaalada Beledweyne ee Xarunta Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa waxaa ka socdo dhaqdhaqaaq lagu diidan yahay in laga qabto wax doorasho ah, dareenkaas oo la filayo in ay la qaataan shacabka kale ee ku dhaqan labada magaalo ee Buuloburde iyo Jalalaqsi iyo qaybo ka mid ah Matabaan, inkastoo tani ay keeneyso kala qaybsanaan. Xiisadda siyaasadeed ee u dhexeyso Dowladda Federaalka iyo Siyaasiyiinta Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa wadata khatar weyn oo amni, maadaama ay wiiqi karto dagaalkii lagu la jiray maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Walaaca ugu weyn ee soo food saaray Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa ah cabsi laga qabo in ciidamada qaarkood iyo Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan ay soo faarujiyaan difaacyadooda gobolka, taasoo loo arko mid halis ku ah amniga dalka oo Al Shabaab siineysa dhul ballaarsi. Ciidamada qaybtood ayaa waxaa laga cabsi qabaa in ay ku aragti noqdaan siyaasiyiinta diidan dib-u-doorashada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe), isla-markaana ay diidaan u hoggaansanaanta awaamiirta taliska. Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa waxaa ka hawlgala cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ka soo jeeda deegaanka iyo xoogag Macawiisley ah oo ka taageera la dagaalanka Al Shabaab. Goob kasta oo furimaha difaaca ama aagagga hore ee dagaalka oo laga soo baxo ayaa noqoneysa bar maran, oo ay Al Shabaab si dhib yar ah dib ugu qabsan karto, tani oo cawaaqib ku yeelaneysa isu socodka dadka ee magaalooyinka waaweyn iyo waddooyinka sahayda ee gobolka. Xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee ka taagan Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sidoo kale caqabad ku noqon kara diyaargarowgii ugu dambeeyay ee talisku uu ugu jiray inay Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed la wareegaan saldhigyada lagu wado inay banneeyaan Ciidanka Midowga Afrika ee Hawlgalka AUSSOM, marka la gaaro daba-yaaqada sanadkan. Daldaloolada amniga ayaa sii kordhisay baahida loo qabo askar dheeri ah oo haysata tababar iyo qalab ku filan. General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa Isniintii kormeeray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee General Dhega-badan, si loo helo amaba loo soo saaro cutubyo cusub oo buuxiya kaalinta ciidan yarida. Deganaansho la’aanta siyaasadeed ayaa khasbeysa in diiradda la saaro ammaanka magaalooyinka iyo deegaanada muhiimka ah, halkii ciidamadu ay si buuxda ugu weecan lahaayeen dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al Shabaab iyo xoreynta dhulka maqan. Dhibaatooyinka amniga ayaa waxaa looga gudbi karaa xallinta khilaafyada siyaasadeed ee dalka oo cirka isku shareeray.

items.title: Ciidamo Deegaan Oo Waajid Lagu Tababarayo Ka Hor Wareejinta Mas’uuliyadda Amniga
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa degmada Waajid ee gobolka Bakool ka bilaabay tababarka dhallinyaro deegaanka ah oo loo diyaarinayo sugidda amniga magaalada iyo deegaannada hoos yimaada. Tababarkan ayaa qayb ka ah qorshe lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ee ku sugan degmada. Ciidamada la tababarayo ayaa la sheegay inay la shaqayn doonaan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Daraawiishta Koonfur-galbeed, waxaana loo diyaarinayaa ilaalinta goobaha muhiimka ah, ka hortagga weerarrada iyo taageeridda howlgallada amni ee laga fulinayo Waajid iyo nawaaxigeeda. Qorshahan ayaa lagu xiriiriyey diyaar-garowga wareejinta mas’uuliyadda amniga marka ciidamada howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ay ka baxaan deegaanka, hase yeeshee, ma jiro jadwal rasmi ah oo la shaaciyey oo caddeynaya waqtiga ay ciidamada AUSSOM ka baxayaan Waajid. Waajid waa degmo istaraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah isku socodka gobolka Bakool iyo gaarsiinta sahayda deegaannada ku dhow. Magaalada ayaa sidoo kale ku dhow dhul laga soo sheegayo dhaqdhaqaaqyo ay sameeyaan Al-Shabaab, taas oo sare u qaadaysa muhiimadda ay leedahay sugidda amnigeeda. Tababarka ciidamada deegaanka ayaa la filayaa inuu yareeyo firaaqo amni oo ka dhalan karta dhimista ama bixitaanka ciidamada AUSSOM. Guusha qorshaha waxay ku xirnaan doontaa tayada tababarka, nidaamka hoggaanka, helitaanka qalab iyo sida ciidamada cusub loogu dhex daro hay’adaha amniga ee rasmiga ah. Ilaa hadda lama shaacin tirada dhallinyarada la tababarayo, muddada tababarka, hubka ama qalabka la siinayo iyo goobaha loo kala dirayo marka ay dhammaystaan. Sidoo kale, faahfaahin rasmi ah lagama bixin qaabka loo kala hagayo ciidamada federaalka, Daraawiishta Koonfur-galbeed iyo ciidamadan cusub.

Qorshahan ayaa lagu xiriiriyey diyaar-garowga wareejinta mas’uuliyadda amniga marka ciidamada howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ay ka baxaan deegaanka, hase yeeshee, ma jiro jadwal rasmi ah oo la shaaciyey oo caddeynaya waqtiga ay ciidamada AUSSOM ka baxayaan Waajid. Waajid waa degmo istaraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah isku socodka gobolka Bakool iyo gaarsiinta sahayda deegaannada ku dhow. Magaalada ayaa sidoo kale ku dhow dhul laga soo sheegayo dhaqdhaqaaqyo ay sameeyaan Al-Shabaab, taas oo sare u qaadaysa muhiimadda ay leedahay sugidda amnigeeda. Tababarka ciidamada deegaanka ayaa la filayaa inuu yareeyo firaaqo amni oo ka dhalan karta dhimista ama bixitaanka ciidamada AUSSOM. Guusha qorshaha waxay ku xirnaan doontaa tayada tababarka, nidaamka hoggaanka, helitaanka qalab iyo sida ciidamada cusub loogu dhex daro hay’adaha amniga ee rasmiga ah. Ilaa hadda lama shaacin tirada dhallinyarada la tababarayo, muddada tababarka, hubka ama qalabka la siinayo iyo goobaha loo kala dirayo marka ay dhammaystaan. Sidoo kale, faahfaahin rasmi ah lagama bixin qaabka loo kala hagayo ciidamada federaalka, Daraawiishta Koonfur-galbeed iyo ciidamadan cusub.

items.title: Danta Somaliland ay ka leedahay 2,000 askari ee ay ku yaboohday qorshaha Trump

Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi Cirro, ayaa intii uu ku sugnaa Washington sheegay in Hargeysa ay ciidamo diri karto haddii Mareykanka ama Israel ay si rasmi ah uga codsadaan. Dalabkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Somaliland ay Washington ka waddo olole ay ku doonayso xiriir siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo dhow, iyadoo dhinaca kalena sii xoojineysa dadaalkeeda aqoonsi raadinta. Taasi waxay dhalineysaa su’aal muhiim ah: maxay Somaliland ka rajeyneysaa inay ka hesho dalabkeeda ciidanka Gaza, iyadoo Mareykanku weli si cad u sheegay inuusan waxba iska beddelin mowqifkiisa ku aaddan midnimada Soomaaliya? Maxay Somaliland dhab ahaan bixineysaa? Cirro ayaa sheegay in Somaliland ay awooddo inay bixiso ilaa 2,000 oo askari, balse wuxuu caddeeyay inaan weli wax codsi rasmi ah uga iman Washington ama dhinacyada maamulaya ciidanka la qorsheynayo. “Weli nalama soo xiriirin arrintan, laakiin haddii nala weydiisto waan bixin karnaa,” ayuu Cirro u sheegay The Times of Israel . Wuxuu sheegay in Somaliland ay leedahay ku dhowaad 25,000 oo askari iyo 1,500 oo ka tirsan ilaalada xeebaha. Haddii 2,000 askari la geeyo Gaza, waxay noqon lahayd howlgal ciidan oo weyn marka loo eego awoodda ciidamada Somaliland, gaar ahaan maadaama aysan hore ciidamo ugu biirin howlgal nabad-ilaalin oo Midowga Afrika ah. Ciidanka Gaza, oo loo yaqaan International Stabilisation Force, waxaa oggolaaday Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, waxaana loo qorsheeyay inuu qeyb ka qaato sugidda ammaanka, ilaalinta howlaha gargaarka, tababarka booliska Falastiin iyo hirgelinta qeybaha amni ee qorshaha Gaza. Ilaa hadda, Somaliland looma soo dirin wax casuumaad ah, mana jiro heshiis dhigaya in ciidamadeedu ka qeybgalayaan howlgalka. Maxay 2,000 askari muhiim u noqon karaan? Muhiimadda dalabka Somaliland waxay ka imaaneysaa dhibaatada Washington ka haysata dhismaha ciidanka Gaza. Qorshaha Mareykanka wuxuu hiigsanayaa ciidan gaaraya ku dhowaad 20,000 askari, balse ballanqaadyada la helay ilaa hadda aad ayay uga hooseeyaan tiradaas. Uganda ayaa oggolaatay inay dirto ku dhowaad 1,200 askari, Morocco-na waxay ballanqaadday ilaa 500. Kosovo, Kazakhstan iyo Albania ayaa iyaguna ballanqaaday tiro kooban. Indonesia ayaa markii hore sheegtay inay diri karto ilaa 8,000 askari, taas oo ka dhigi lahayd dalka ugu ciidanka badan howlgalka, balse qorshahaas markii dambe waa la hakiyay. Haddii Somaliland ay 2,000 askari keento, waxay keli ahaan dabooli lahayd ku dhowaad 10 boqolkiiba tirada guud ee la doonayo. Taasi waxay dalabkeeda siin kartaa miisaan ka weyn midka uu yeelan lahaa haddii Mareykanku hore u helay ciidamadii uu u baahnaa. Washington waxay sidoo kale muujisay inay weli ka go’an tahay dhismaha ciidankan. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa Congress-ka ogeysiisay qorshe maalgelin oo ka badan $206 milyan, kaas oo loogu talagalay qalab, gaadiid, kaabayaal iyo howlaha ciidanka. Sidaas darteed, caqabadda ugu weyn ee Trump ma aha oo keliya sameynta qorshaha, balse waa helitaanka dalal diyaar u ah inay askar dhab ah ku biiriyaan. Maxay Hargeysa ka dooneysaa arrintan? Dalabka ciidamada Gaza wuxuu la jaanqaadayaa dadaal ballaaran oo Somaliland ay ku doonayso inay Mareykanka tusiso inay leedahay muhiimad istiraatiiji ah. Maamulka Cirro wuxuu Washington ku riixayaa xiriir amni iyo mid siyaasadeed oo dhow, iyadoo isla waqtigaas sii wada ololaha aqoonsiga. Somaliland waxay muddo dheer ku doodeysay in dekedda iyo garoonka Berbera, goobta ay kaga taallo Gacanka Cadmeed iyo u dhowaanshaha Yemen ay siinayaan muhiimad gaar ah oo dhinaca ammaanka Badda Cas ah. Hadda waxay dooddaas ku dartay awoodda ay u leedahay inay ciidamo ku biiriso howlgal uu maamulka Trump muhiimad siinayo. Israel ayaa bishii December 2025 aqoonsatay Somaliland, iyadoo noqotay dalka keliya ee Qaramada Midoobay xubinta ka ah ee sidaas sameeya. Mareykanka, Qaramada Midoobay iyo dhammaan dalalka kale ee xubnaha ka ah QM ma aqoonsana Somaliland dal madax-bannaan, Washington-na weli waxay u aragtaa qeyb ka mid ah Soomaaliya. Cirro laftiisa ayaa qiray in kulamadii uu ku yeeshay Washington aysan kasoo bixin wax ballanqaad ah oo Mareykanku ka bixiyay aqoonsi. “Waxaa jira wadahadallo aan la leenahay Mareykanka, laakiin ma dhihi karo hadda waxaa jira ballanqaadyo Mareykan ah,” ayuu yiri. Sidoo kale ma jirto caddeyn muujineysa in Somaliland si rasmi ah u dalbatay aqoonsi iyadoo ku beddelaneysa ciidamo. Hase yeeshee, haddii Hargeysa ay awooddo inay Washington ka caawiso meel uu Mareykanku caqabad ka wajahayo, waxay taasi kordhin kartaa muhiimadda siyaasadeed ee Somaliland iyo fursadaha ay ugu heli karto xiriir dhow oo ay la yeelato maamulka Trump. Waxaa jira caqabad kale oo ka horreysa su’aasha aqoonsiga: Somaliland ma geli kartaa ciidanka Gaza iyadoo aan Mareykanka iyo Qaramada Midoobay midkoodna u aqoonsan dal madax-bannaan? Ciidanka Gaza ma aha howlgal nabad-ilaalin oo caadi ah oo si toos ah hoos taga Qaramada Midoobay. Golaha Ammaanka ayaa oggolaaday, balse maamulka iyo isku dubbaridkiisa waxaa hormuud ka ah hay’adda uu Mareykanku hoggaamiyo ee Board of Peace. Qaraarka Golaha Ammaanka wuxuu sheegayaa in ciidamadu ka imanayaan “dalalka ka qeybgalaya”. Halkaas ayay arrintu Somaliland kaga adkaan kartaa. Kosovo, oo aan xubin ka ahayn Qaramada Midoobay, ayaa kamid ah dhinacyada la filayo inay ciidamo bixiyaan. Laakiin farqiga weyn ayaa ah in Mareykanku Kosovo u aqoonsan yahay dal madax-bannaan, halka Somaliland uusan aqoonsan. Haddii Washington ay aqbasho ciidamo Somaliland ka socda, waxaa ka dhalan karta su’aal ku saabsan magaca iyo xaaladda sharci ee ay ciidamadaasi ku geli doonaan howlgalka. Waxaa intaas dheer in howlgalka uu u baahan yahay wadashaqeyn dhow oo lala yeesho Israel iyo Masar. Israel waxay aqoonsatay Somaliland, halka Masar si adag u taageerto midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Arrimahaas waxay ka dhigayaan ka qeybgalka Somaliland mid siyaasiyan ka adag sida uu dalabku marka hore u muuqdo. Ilaa hadda, Mareykanka iyo maamulka Board of Peace midkoodna ma shaacin inuu Somaliland ku casuumay ciidanka Gaza. Arrintan ma kasoo bixi karaa aqoonsi? Taasi weli waxay u muuqataa arrin fog. Mareykanka wuxuu si rasmi ah u taageeraa midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, wuxuuna dowladda federaalka la leeyahay iskaashi amni oo muhiim ah, gaar ahaan dagaalka Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish. Aqoonsiga Somaliland wuxuu sidoo kale Washington gelin karaa khilaaf diblomaasiyadeed oo ay la gasho dalal ay kamid yihiin Masar iyo Türkiye, kuwaas oo si xooggan u taageera mowqifka Soomaaliya. Waxaa suurtagal ah in Mareykanku kordhiyo xiriirka uu la leeyahay Hargeysa, iskaashi amni ka sameeyo Berbera ama u furo albaabbo siyaasadeed oo cusub, isaga oo aan waxba ka beddelin mowqifkiisa aqoonsiga. Sidaas darteed, dalabka 2,000 askari wuxuu Somaliland siinayaa fursad ay isku daydo inay Washington tusiso inay wax ka qaban karto baahi uu maamulka Trump qabo. Balse ilaa hadda ma jiraan wax caddeynaya in xeeladdaasi shaqeyneyso. Mareykanku weli kama codsan Somaliland inay ciidamo u dirto Gaza, Aqalka Cad wuxuu sheegay in siyaasaddiisu aysan isbeddelin, Cirro-na wuxuu qiray inuusan Washington ka helin wax ballanqaad ah oo aqoonsi. Sidaas darteed, ciidanka ay Somaliland sheegtay inay bixin karto weli waa dalab aan meel rasmi ah gaarin, halka faa’iidada siyaasadeed ee ay Hargeysa ka rajeyneyso ay iyaduna weli tahay mid aan muuqan. items.title: Kumay ahayd Xaawo Aadan Camey ?
items.description: Allaha u naxariistee waxaa saacado ka hor la xaqiijiyay geerida Xaawo Aadan Camey oo kamid ahayd Haldoorka haweenka Soomaaliyeed Xaawo Aadan Camey waxay ahayd haweeney Soomaaliyeed oo muddo dheer u soo adeegaysay bulshada, gaar ahaan dadka nugul, qaxootiga iyo barakacayaasha gudaha dalka. Waxay ka mid ahayd shaqsiyaadkii Soomaaliyeed ee dadaalka weyn geliyay arrimaha bani’aadantinimada iyo difaaca xuquuqda dadka ay saameeyeen colaadaha iyo barakacu. Muddo sannado ah ayay si hagar la’aan ah uga shaqaynaysay danta guud, iyadoo door muuqda ku lahayd howlaha la xiriira taageerada iyo u adeegidda dadka barakacayaasha ah. Shaqadeeda ayaa ka dhigtay qof si weyn looga yaqaan bahda bulshada rayidka ah iyo hay’adaha ka shaqeeya arrimaha bani’aadantinimada ee Soomaaliya. Xaawo Aadan Camey waxay sidoo kale ka tirsanaan jirtay GECPD , oo ah hay’ad ka shaqaysa arrimaha bulshada iyo dadka nugul. Hawlaheeda iyo dadaalkeeda joogtada ah ayaa gaarsiiyay in shaqadeeda laga aqoonsado heer caalami ah. Guulihii ugu waaweynaa ee lagu xusuusto Xaawo Aadan Camey waxaa ka mid ah Abaalmarinta Nansen Refugee Award , oo ay sannadkii 2012 siisay Hay’adda Qaxootiga Adduunka ee UNHCR . Abaalmarintan waxaa lagu maamuusaa shaqsiyaadka ama kooxaha si gaar ah ugu dadaala u adeegidda iyo ilaalinta qaxootiga, barakacayaasha iyo dadka guryahooda ka hayaamay sababo la xiriira colaado ama dhibaatooyin kale. Helitaanka abaalmarintan ayaa ka tarjumaysay doorkii ay Xaawo Aadan Camey ku lahayd u adeegidda dadka Soomaaliyeed ee nugul iyo dadaalladii ay ku bixisay arrimaha bani’aadantinimada. Xaawo Aadan Camey waxay ka tagtay raad ku saabsan adeegga bulshada iyo u hiilinta dadka nugul. Shaqadeedii muddada dheer socotay iyo aqoonsigii caalamiga ahaa ee ay heshay ayaa ka dhigay mid ka mid ah haweenka Soomaaliyeed ee lagu xusuusan doono kaalintooda ku aaddan arrimaha bani’aadantinimada.

Muddo sannado ah ayay si hagar la’aan ah uga shaqaynaysay danta guud, iyadoo door muuqda ku lahayd howlaha la xiriira taageerada iyo u adeegidda dadka barakacayaasha ah. Shaqadeeda ayaa ka dhigtay qof si weyn looga yaqaan bahda bulshada rayidka ah iyo hay’adaha ka shaqeeya arrimaha bani’aadantinimada ee Soomaaliya. Xaawo Aadan Camey waxay sidoo kale ka tirsanaan jirtay GECPD , oo ah hay’ad ka shaqaysa arrimaha bulshada iyo dadka nugul. Hawlaheeda iyo dadaalkeeda joogtada ah ayaa gaarsiiyay in shaqadeeda laga aqoonsado heer caalami ah. Guulihii ugu waaweynaa ee lagu xusuusto Xaawo Aadan Camey waxaa ka mid ah Abaalmarinta Nansen Refugee Award , oo ay sannadkii 2012 siisay Hay’adda Qaxootiga Adduunka ee UNHCR . Abaalmarintan waxaa lagu maamuusaa shaqsiyaadka ama kooxaha si gaar ah ugu dadaala u adeegidda iyo ilaalinta qaxootiga, barakacayaasha iyo dadka guryahooda ka hayaamay sababo la xiriira colaado ama dhibaatooyin kale. Helitaanka abaalmarintan ayaa ka tarjumaysay doorkii ay Xaawo Aadan Camey ku lahayd u adeegidda dadka Soomaaliyeed ee nugul iyo dadaalladii ay ku bixisay arrimaha bani’aadantinimada. Xaawo Aadan Camey waxay ka tagtay raad ku saabsan adeegga bulshada iyo u hiilinta dadka nugul. Shaqadeedii muddada dheer socotay iyo aqoonsigii caalamiga ahaa ee ay heshay ayaa ka dhigay mid ka mid ah haweenka Soomaaliyeed ee lagu xusuusan doono kaalintooda ku aaddan arrimaha bani’aadantinimada.

items.title: Qiimaha Shidaalka Muqdisho Oo La Sheegay Inuu Toddobaad Gudihiis 15% Kordhay
items.description: Qiimaha shidaalka magaalada Muqdisho ayaa la sheegay inuu qiyaastii 15% kordhay toddobaadkii la soo dhaafay, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha ka jira Bariga Dhexe. Kororkan ayaa laga dareemayaa kaalimo shidaal oo kala duwan, inkastoo qiimaha lagu iibinayo uusan isku mid ka ahayn guud ahaan magaalada. Warbixinta sheegtay kororkan ayaa xogteeda ku salaysay ilo kala duwan oo ay la xiriirtay, balse ma aysan soo bandhigin qiimihii hore iyo kan hadda ee halkii liitar. Sidoo kale, lama shaacin celceliska qiimaha shidaalka ee suuqyada Muqdisho ama goobihii lagu sameeyey xog-ururinta. Kororka waxaa lala xiriiriyey amni-darrada ka jirta marinnada muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab iyo Hormuz iyo sare u kaca qiimaha shidaalka caalamka. Carqaladaha ku yimaadda maraakiibta shidaalka ayaa kordhin kara kharashka gaadiidka, caymiska iyo muddada ay shixnaduhu ku soo gaarayaan Soomaaliya. Marka kharashka soo dejinta ama gaadiidka badda kordho, ganacsatadu waxay inta badan kharashkaas u gudbiyaan macaamiisha. Shidaalka oo qaaliyooba wuxuu saamayn ku yeelan karaa gaadiidka dadweynaha, qiimaha raashinka, korontada iyo badeecadaha kale ee gudaha magaalada lagu kala qaado, hase yeeshee, weli lama soo bandhigin xog rasmi ah oo muujinaysa heerka uu kororkani u saameeyey adeegyadaas ama sicirka guud ee suuqyada Muqdisho.

items.title: Taliyaha Militariga oo kormeeray Dugsiga General Dhega-badan (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa gelinkii dambe ee Isniintii kormeeray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee General Dhega-badan ee Magaalada Muqdisho. Dugsigan oo horey loo oran jiray Jasiira, kuna yaala Degmada Wadajir ayaa waxaa lagu tababaraa dhallinyarada loo qaadanayo in ay ka mid noqdaan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa la sheegay in uu kormeer shaqo ku tegay xeradaasi, isagoo u kuurgelaya xaaladda guud ee dugsiga iyo habsami-u-socodka howlaha tababarka. War ka soo baxay Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa lagu sheegay in Taliyaha uu halkaasi ku soo dhaweeyay Taliyaha Taliska Tababarada iyo Doctrine-ka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Axmed Ciise Axmed iyo Taliyaha Dugsiga General Dhega-badan, Korneyl Maxamed Sheekh. “Intii uu kormeerka ku guda jiray, Taliyaha ayaa indha-indheeyay qaybaha kala duwan ee dugsiga, isagoo warbixinno ka dhageystay masuuliyiinta xarunta, kana warbixiyay xaaladda howlaha tababarka iyo diyaargarowga ciidamada.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Kormeerkan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaalada lagu horumarinayo xarumaha tababarka, tayaynta ciidamada iyo xoojinta diyaargarowga Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.” Dugsigan ayaa 20-kii bishii November ee sanadkii 2015 loogu magac-daray Abaanduulihii hore ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Cabdikariin Yuusuf Aadan (Dhega-badan), kaas oo 1-dii bishaasi ku geeriyooday weerar ay dabley ka tirsan Al Shabaab ka gaysatay Hotel Saxafi ee Magaalada Muqdisho.

items.title: Somali Regional State Emerges as Ethiopia’s Safest and Most Stable Region
items.description: By Abdikarim H. Abdi Buh The Somali Regional State of Ethiopia has undergone a remarkable transformation in security and stability, emerging as one of the country’s most peaceful and secure regional states after decades of conflict and instability. That transformation is perhaps most visible in Jigjiga, the regional capital, where senior political leaders can move among ordinary citizens with a level of public access and security that would be difficult to imagine during the region’s years of armed conflict. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, Somali Regional State President Mustafa Omer, Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamoud and Djibouti President Ismail Omar Guelleh have all been able to participate in public events in Jigjiga without the kind of extraordinary security environment often associated with high-level political gatherings elsewhere in the region. Jigjiga has consequently become more than the administrative capital of the Somali Regional State. It has increasingly developed into a venue for national and regional political meetings, conferences and public events. Indeed, major conferences involving Ethiopia’s regional states have increasingly been hosted in Jigjiga, reflecting the city’s growing reputation as a secure and accessible political centre. A Region That Has Changed Its Security Story The transformation becomes even more striking when viewed against the region’s recent history. For years, the Somali Regional State was associated with armed conflict, political instability and insecurity. Roads and commercial routes were vulnerable, communities lived with uncertainty, and the presence of armed groups profoundly affected daily life. Today, the picture is dramatically different. One of the clearest signs of the change is the movement of commercial trucks across the region. Trucks can now travel along major routes day and night without disruption and insecurity, strengthening trade and connecting communities to markets inside Ethiopia and across the wider Horn of Africa. For businesses, transporters and ordinary citizens, this may be one of the most important measures of whether security has actually improved. Security is not simply about the absence of fighting. It is about whether a farmer can take livestock to market, whether a trader can transport goods, whether a family can travel after dark and whether communities can conduct their daily lives without fear. By those measures, many residents believe the Somali Regional State has made enormous progress. Mustafa Omer: No Return to Armed Conflict It is against this backdrop that President Mustafa Omer has sharply criticized renewed calls by elements of the Ogaden National Liberation Front (ONLF) for a possible return to armed struggle. Mustafa said groups he described as politically failed were attempting to create expectations among the population that a new political transformation—or even renewed conflict—could emerge in the region. He argued that Ethiopia is currently facing serious political and security challenges, with armed confrontations continuing in parts of the country, creating an environment in which some groups may attempt to revive earlier conflicts. The President was particularly critical of organizations that, in his view, spent decades pursuing political and armed struggle without delivering the changes they promised the Somali population. “There are groups telling people that change is coming and seeking to create conflict in the region. These are politically failed groups that have spent more than 42 years pursuing an unproductive political struggle,” Mustafa said. He also dismissed what he described as narratives circulating through the media, arguing that such messaging could not fundamentally alter the political realities of the region. Mustafa urged residents not to be drawn into what he characterized as false expectations, saying the decades of armed and political struggle had failed to produce the promised progress. “For those 40 years, there has been nothing but decline; there has been no progress,” he said. His message was unequivocal: The Somali Regional State should not return to armed conflict. Why the Public Remembers the Past For many residents, the debate over ONLF is not an abstract political argument. The region’s decades-long conflict left deep memories of insecurity, displacement, economic disruption and fear. That history explains why calls for a return to armed struggle encounter resistance among the population. The strongest argument against renewed conflict may therefore come not from government officials, but from the experience of ordinary people who remember what life was like when armed confrontation dominated the region. For those residents, the period of ONLF’s armed struggle represents one of the darkest chapters in the modern history of the Somali Regional State. The prevailing public sentiment among many residents is increasingly straightforward: They do not want to go back. They want roads that remain open, markets that function, trucks that move safely, businesses that operate, children who attend school and communities that can live without the constant fear of renewed violence. ONLF Faces an Uncertain Future Mustafa’s remarks come as ONLF itself faces political and organizational divisions. Different factions have emerged within the movement, with competing leaders advancing different strategies for the organization’s future. The external faction led by Abdirahman Mohamed Sheikh Mahdi has remained strongly opposed to the policies of the Ethiopian government and the Somali Regional State administration. The faction recently suggested that a return to armed struggle could become possible, reigniting debate over ONLF’s future and the region’s political direction. Another faction, led by Abdikarim Sheikh Muse Qalbi-Dhagah, is based in Jigjiga and has pursued a political path, with ONLF’s internal organization moving toward participation in the region’s political and electoral system. The divisions illustrate a fundamental strategic choice confronting the movement: whether to pursue political change through institutions and elections or return to confrontation. For the Somali Regional State, the answer from the administration is clear. The region’s future should be determined through politics, dialogue and peaceful political competition—not through guns. Security as the Foundation of Development The importance of the region’s security transformation extends beyond politics. Peace has economic consequences. A secure road network allows livestock and commercial goods to move. Safe cities attract businesses. Political stability makes it easier to organize conferences and bring national and international visitors to the region. Improved security also creates opportunities for investment in infrastructure, tourism, trade and services. Jigjiga’s emergence as a conference destination is therefore symbolic of something larger. A city once associated with the instability of a conflict-affected region can now host national political gatherings and receive senior leaders without being defined by insecurity. That is a profound transformation. The Somali Regional State is not without challenges. Ethiopia continues to face serious political and security problems, and the region itself must continue strengthening institutions, economic opportunity and public accountability. But the security gains of recent years should not be underestimated. The Choice Before the Somali Regional State The debate over ONLF ultimately presents the Somali Regional State with a choice between two very different futures. One path leads backward—to armed confrontation, insecurity, disrupted trade and renewed fear. The other leads forward—to political competition, economic development, institutional strengthening and deeper integration with Ethiopia and the wider Horn of Africa. For residents who remember the consequences of conflict, the choice may already be clear. The Somali Regional State has experienced the cost of war. Its people now want to experience the benefits of peace. The region’s most powerful message to those advocating a return to armed struggle may therefore be found on its roads, in its markets and in its cities: life has changed, and the people do not want to surrender that progress. The transformation of the Somali Regional State is ultimately a reminder that security is not an abstract political slogan. It is the freedom to travel, trade, work, meet, build and live without fear. And for a region that once endured decades of conflict, that freedom may be its most valuable achievement. Abdikarim H. items.title: Tolkayow waan idiin maqanahay ee idinkuma maqni Fihiim Yuusuf Quuje
items.description: TOLKAYOOW WAAN IDIIN MAQANAHAY EE IDIN KUMA MAQNI Waxaan ahay Fihiim Yuusuf Quuje Tweet . Waxan ahay inantiinii. Waxaan ahay walaashiin. Waan idiin gar dhiganayaa. Ma ihi qof caadifadi qaado oo kolba dhinac u jeesata. Waan sahan tagaa, marka wixii aan u socday arko in aanu shaqaynayn ayaan dhinac kale uga wareegaa anigoo naftaydana qanciyay ciddii kalena qancin kara. Waxaan isleeyahay ma jiro ama wuu yar yahay qof Dhulbahante ah oo halgankii iyo naf-hurnimadaydii sameeyay. Anigoo heli karayay sida dadka qaarkood in aan magaalooyinka waaweyn iskaga soo raaxaysto oo halganka dusha kala socdo ayaan u badheedhay in aan dadkayga dhex joogo oo xabadda isku dhigo. Waxaan ahaa dadkii sida wayn ugu ololaynayay in aynu Muqdisho wax la qabsanno ee maamul goboleedka Waqooyi Bari soo dhiciyay. Hamse Cabdi Barre iyo Xassan Sheekh Maxamuud in ay yimaadaan Laascaanood anigaa kasoo shaqeeyay. Xamar maanta waxba kama hayno. Dhulbahante maanta dhulkiisii isagaa xor u ah, waxaase isweydiin mudan ma isku bixin karnaa sidan. Warsangali oo walaaladeen ah ma hayno oo waa xaqiiq. Puntland oo deriskeenna ah ma hayno. Somaliland oo wax badani inaga dhexeeyaan ma hayno. Xamar oo kumanaan KM inoo jirto oo aynu u godobownay, waynu aragnaa Xassan Sheekh inta jeer ee uu toos inoogu sheegay in aynaan wax jira ahayn. Hooyada iyo caruurta Dhulbahante ee ku nool Sanaag, Sool iyo Cayn waxay u baahan yahiin nabad. Waxay u rabaan nolol. Waxay u baahan yihiin waxbarasho. Waxay u baahan yihiin caafimaad. Waxay u baahan yihiin in la dareeyo oo xuquuqdooda la ilaaliyo. Dadku waa dhal iyo dhasheed. Waa abti iyo ilmaabti. Boqolaal sano ayaynu deegaanka kusoo wada noolayn, ilaa qiyaamuhu ka dhacayana waynu ku wada noolaanaynaa oo sidaasi ayaynu isku ag joogaynaa. Ma sheegin hadii Ilaahay labadeena mid ahaan Meesha ka qaado oo ay hallaagmaan. Ninka geel jiraha ah ee Jaamac Siyaad waxa dad ugu dhaw ninka habarjeclo ee ay derika yihiin ee isku bii’adda ku nool yihiin. Ka hadii roob soo da’o ay ka wada cabbayaan, ka hadii ay abbaari dhacdana ay wada saamaynayso. Waxaynu oghanay dunidii siday maanta tahay. Noloshii siday u adkaatay. Halgankii aynu galnay wixii khasaare inaga soo gaadhay waad ogtihiin. Inta agoon inoo joogta tiro malaha. Hadana inta hadhay in aan nolol u raadino oo caadifada ka korno ayaa loo baahan yahay maanta. Diinteennu iimaanka waxay ka horreysiisay nabadda iyo ammaanka. Nabad la’aan waa nolol la’aan. Koonfur maanta waxba inaga xigaan. Waan soo taabtay gunteeda. Ma aha meel dawladnimo iyo Soomaalinimo u jeedda. Markaan ka soo quustay ayaan xal ka eeg is idhi Hargeysadii aad ogaydeen wixii aynu kala mudannay. Dadka Ilaahay caqli buu siiyay ay ku kala gartaan xumaha iyo sammaha. Caqli ay ku kala gartaan saxa iyo qaladka. Caqli ay ku kala gartaan xaqa iyo baadilka. Maanta waxaynu u baahannay wixii aynu jiritaankeena iyo midnimadeena ku sii badhi-taari lahayn. Anigu waxaan kow ka ahaa dadkii Waqooyi bari aas aasay. Anigu waxaan tagay Muqdisho anigoo aaminsan in Soomaalinimo wax lagu raadiyo. Waxaan kala kulmay niyad jab. Waxaan soo arkay in aan reer Waqooyi la kala jeclayn, hadii cid mudnaan la siinayana ay Isaaq iyo Hargeysa mudnaanta siinayaan. Tusaalaha ugu yar ee in aynu ku hungownay Koonfur, waxa kow ka ah in ciidankeenii aanay wax mushahar ah ka helin Xamar, halka Puntland dhawr kun oo ciidan ahi mushahar ka qaataan Xassan Sheekh. Waxa la inoo quudhi waayay tallaalka Hirshabelle oo Jawhar maamusha la siiyay in la in siiyo. Dadkaygiiyow, tolkay’ow idinkama mudni in aad i caydaan. In aad i af lagaadaysaan. Dantiina ayaan u maqanahay. Idinka ayaan idiin maqanahay. Nabad iyo Horumar ayaan idiinku maqanahay. Haddii uu gaadhi kaa galo meel dhiiqo ah oo aad xaga horena ka aragto dhiiqo kasii badan, caqligu kuma siinayo in aad hore ugu sii socoto. Waxaynu u baahanahay in aynu noolaano. In aynu horumar gaadhno. In aynu la tartanno bulshooyinka qayrkeen ah. Cidda ina ogol ee aynu wax wada qabsan karno anigu waan ogohay, idinna waa ogtihin hadaan la is yeelyaalayn. Dagaalo way dhacaan. Waligeedna way dhici jireen. Ha noqdaan qabiilooyin is dila ama dawladaba. Markasta waxa colaada ka danbeeya nabad. Wax kasta oo dhaca waa laga heshiiyaa. Dalka yar ee Ruwaanda waxii ka dhacay waynu ku haynaa taariikhda, maantana waddanada horumarka Africa hoggaaminaya weeyaan. Bulshooyinkii halkaa ku noolaa dad aan ka yarayn Milyan qof ayay iska xasuuqeen oo waliba qoladi yarayd xasuuq ku dhacay. Waa laga heshiiyay, maanta waa meelaha Afrika ugu horumarsan dhinac kasta. Waxa taa keentay in ay iska illoobeen maalmihii madoobaa ee soo maray, iyo gummaadkii dhacay waayo wixii dhacay way dhaceen oo lama soo celin karo, ee waxa uun la isweydiinayaa sidii aanu wixii oo kale u dhici lahayn. Waana ta keentay in la is cafiyo nolol qurux bandanna la sameeyay. Dadka reer Ruwanda waliba badankoodu waa gaalo. Inaga oo ummad muslim ah, ilaahayna ina faray cafiska ma jirto wax ka wanaagsan in nabad iyo cafis aynu qaadano oo dadka derisnimo iyo walaalnimo u horseedno. Dhulbahantow, tolkaygiiyoow, anigu ma ihi qof la idiin isticmaali karo. Ma ihi qof lacagi goyn karto. Mana ihi qof damiirkeedu liito oo hunguri ku shaqaysata. Idinkaan idiin maqanahay. Wax aan idiin cuntaminna idiin keeni mayo. Wixii aad ka yeelaysaana taladeeda idinkaa leh. Anigu Hargeysa dalxiis umaan iman. Qof u riyaaqsan in la soo dhaweeyo oo qudha ma ihi, hadii aanan dadkayga uga keeni karin hadafkaan lahayn iyo wixii ay xaqa u lahaayeen. Qof cad quudheed soo qaadanaya ma ihi. Ogaadana anigu in aan idin kala furfuro oo khilaaf idin dhex dhigo uma joogo halkan, ee waxaan doonayaa in walaaladeen Dawlad ku dhisan caddaalad iyo sinnaan wada wadaagno.

items.title: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya Oo Gaaray Jabuuti
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali, ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Jabuuti. Wasiirka ayaa halkaasi u tegay si uu u hoggaamiyo wafdiga Soomaaliya ee ka qaybgalaya Kalfadhiga 74-aad ee aan caadiga ahayn ee Golaha Wasiirrada Urur-Goboleedka IGAD. Shirkan ayaa isu keenaya Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah IGAD, iyadoo looga arrinsan doono arrimo muhiim u ah dalalka gobolka iyo xoojinta iskaashiga ka dhexeeya waddamada Geeska Afrika. Ka qaybgalka Soomaaliya ee kalfadhigan ayaa muujinaya doorka firfircoon ee ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka qaadanayso arrimaha gobolka iyo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta dalalka xubnaha ka ah Urur-Goboleedka IGAD. Wasiirka Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali ayaa la filayaa inuu kulamo iyo wada-hadallo la yeesho mas’uuliyiinta ka qaybgalaysa shirka, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo danaha Soomaaliya iyo iskaashiga gobolka.

items.title: Rebuilding America’s manufacturing workforce
items.description: Rebuilding America’s manufacturing workforce By ShareAmerica   Foundry School will train U.S. workers for jobs in advanced manufacturing facilities, such as this one in Hayward, California. (© Josh Edelson/AFP/Getty Images) The United States is launching Foundry School to build an advanced manufacturing workforce to support President Trump’s drive to restore American manufacturing. The State Department-led initiative, announced September 3, brings together the U.S. government, leading universities and global industrial leaders. Developed through a public-private partnership with Stanford University, Foundry School will prepare the next generation of American entrepreneurs, engineers, technicians and industrial leaders to build and operate the advanced manufacturing enterprises of the future. Foundry School begins in September with seven regional sessions hosted by Arizona State University, Georgia Institute of Technology, Ohio State University, Pennsylvania State University, the University of Kansas, Vanderbilt University and Washington University in St. Louis. The regional sessions will cover the fundamentals of modern factory design, materials and supply chains, assembly-line engineering, plant economics, regulation and permitting, and workforce development at scale. In January 2027, Stanford University will host a 10-session core program focused on advanced manufacturing capabilities and featuring live instruction from globally recognized advanced manufacturing leaders. The State Department plans to work with Congress to support Pax Silica economies’ participation in Foundry School. The department is working with Stanford to develop a curriculum for U.S. and foreign counterparts to strengthen allied manufacturing capacity and supply chain resilience. Foundry School is a flagship program of the State Department’s Pax Silica initiative, an economic security partnership connecting governments, industry and universities to strengthen the critical supply chains and industrial capabilities that underpin the AI economy. “For decades, our diplomats have built relationships with the companies that became the best in the world at making things,” Under Secretary for Economic Affairs Jacob Helberg said September 3 at a launch ceremony in Washington. “Now we are bringing it home.” Secretary of State Marco Rubio speaks September 3 at the launch of Foundry School in Washington. (State Dept./Freddie Everett) Foundry School joins the industrial scene amid a U.S. manufacturing revival. The manufacturing sector grew for the seventh straight month in July, which brought the strongest growth in the sector in four years, the White House says. Meanwhile, the U.S. is attracting trillions of dollars of industrial investment. At the launch ceremony, Vice President Vance referred to Foundry School as “reinvesting in American workers.” “We woke up to the reality just a few years ago,” said Secretary of State Marco Rubio at the announcement, “that we are suddenly, as a nation, dangerously dependent — dangerously dependent — on other nations for all sorts of things that we need.”

items.title: Muungaab iyo dhiggiisa Jabuuti oo saxiixday heshiis dhigaya in labada caasimad…
items.description: Jabuuti (Caasimada Online) – Duqa magaalada Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) iyo dhiggiisa magaalada Jabuuti, Said Daoud Mohamed ayaa maanta kala saxiixday heshiis is-afgarad oo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga labada caasimadood, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga, maalgashiga, dhaqanka iyo horumarinta. Heshiiskan oo lagu saxiixay magaalada Jabuuti ayaa lagu sheegay inuu saldhig u noqonayo iskaashi toos ah oo dhex mara maamullada Muqdisho iyo Jabuuti, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan inay abuuraan fursado cusub oo ganacsi iyo maalgashi. Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Muungaab, ayaa munaasabadda ka sheegay in xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti uu yahay mid qoto dheer oo ku dhisan xiriir bulsho, dhaqan iyo diin. “Waa xiriir aysan bir goyn karin, biyana meyri karin,” ayuu yiri Muungaab. Waxa uu sidoo kale safiirka Jabuuti u jooga Soomaaliya, Cusmaan Sugulle Dubad, uga mahadceliyay kaalinta uu ka qaatay fududeynta wada-hadallada iyo xiriirka labada maamul. Muungaab ayaa dhiggiisa Jabuuti u fidiyay casuumaad rasmi ah oo uu ku yimaado Muqdisho, waxaana uu sidoo kale ganacsatada iyo maalqabeennada reer Jabuuti ugu baaqay inay maalgashi ku sameeyaan caasimadda Soomaaliya. Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa sheegay in Muqdisho ay ku jirto marxalad koboc iyo ballaarin ah, taas oo abuureysa baahi loo qabo maalgashi dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan adeegyada, dhismaha, ganacsiga iyo kaabayaasha magaalada. Dhankiisa, Duqa Jabuuti Said Daoud Mohamed ayaa soo dhoweeyay heshiiska, isaga oo sheegay inuu horseedi karo fursado cusub oo labada magaalo ay ka wada faa’iideystaan. Waxa uu sheegay in Jabuuti ay diyaar u tahay inay sii xoojiso iskaashiga dhaqaale, ganacsi iyo horumarineed ee kala dhexeeya Muqdisho. Heshiiska labada caasimadood ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti ay iyaguna ballaarinayaan xiriirkooda siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed. Dhawaan, wasaaradaha arrimaha dibadda ee labada dal ayaa Muqdisho ku kala saxiixday heshiis kale oo lagu dhisayo hannaan joogto ah oo wadatashiyo siyaasadeed ah, kaas oo labada dowladood u oggolaanaya inay si joogto ah isaga kaashadaan arrimaha gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Heshiiska Muqdisho iyo Jabuuti ayaa hadda isku dayaya in xiriirkaas taariikhiga ah loo ballaariyo heer magaalo, ganacsi iyo maalgashi, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan in xiriirka siyaasadeed uu sidoo kale dhalin karo iskaashi dhaqaale oo muuqda. Dhankiisa, Duqa Jabuuti Said Daoud Mohamed ayaa soo dhoweeyay heshiiska, isaga oo sheegay inuu horseedi karo fursado cusub oo labada magaalo ay ka wada faa’iideystaan. Waxa uu sheegay in Jabuuti ay diyaar u tahay inay sii xoojiso iskaashiga dhaqaale, ganacsi iyo horumarineed ee kala dhexeeya Muqdisho. Heshiiska labada caasimadood ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti ay iyaguna ballaarinayaan xiriirkooda siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed. Dhawaan, wasaaradaha arrimaha dibadda ee labada dal ayaa Muqdisho ku kala saxiixday heshiis kale oo lagu dhisayo hannaan joogto ah oo wadatashiyo siyaasadeed ah, kaas oo labada dowladood u oggolaanaya inay si joogto ah isaga kaashadaan arrimaha gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Heshiiska Muqdisho iyo Jabuuti ayaa hadda isku dayaya in xiriirkaas taariikhiga ah loo ballaariyo heer magaalo, ganacsi iyo maalgashi, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan in xiriirka siyaasadeed uu sidoo kale dhalin karo iskaashi dhaqaale oo muuqda. items.title: Hiiraan Region Traditonal Community Leader Returns to Beledweyne Amid Anger and Calls for Mobilization
items.description: Beledweyne, Somalia (WDN) — A visibly angry delegation led by the traditional leader of the Hawadle clan arrived in Beledweyne on Monday afternoon after returning from Mogadishu, where efforts to secure the top leadership position in Hirshabelle reportedly ended in failure. Hundreds of residents gathered at Beledweyne airport to welcome the delegation, reflecting the deep political emotions surrounding the dispute over the leadership of Hirshabelle. Among those accompanying the traditional leader was Hirshabelle Vice President Yusuf Dabageed, whose presence added further political significance to the delegation’s return. But the mood at the airport quickly turned confrontational. Addressing the crowd in brief remarks, the Hawadle traditional leader appeared visibly angry and issued a call for mobilization, urging members of his community to prepare to contribute whatever they could—including manpower and financial support. His remarks were widely interpreted as a call to prepare for confrontation with the Federal Government of Somalia and the Hirshabelle administration. A Political Dispute Taking a Dangerous Turn The developments mark a sharp escalation in the dispute over political leadership in Hirshabelle. The Hawadle delegation had travelled to Mogadishu amid expectations that negotiations could produce a political settlement over the leadership of the regional administration. Instead, the delegation returned to Beledweyne without securing the position it had sought. The return has now transformed what began as a political dispute into a potentially dangerous mobilization. The traditional leader’s appeal for community members to contribute both fighters and financial resources suggests that the dispute may no longer be confined to political negotiations. If the mobilization translates into armed confrontation, the consequences could extend far beyond Hirshabelle’s political institutions. Beledweyne at the Center of the Crisis Beledweyne has long been one of the most politically sensitive cities in central Somalia. The city is the administrative center of Hiiraan and has repeatedly witnessed tensions over the relationship between Hiiraan and the Hirshabelle administration, as well as disputes over political representation and the distribution of power. The latest confrontation therefore comes against an already fragile political backdrop. The involvement of prominent traditional leaders and senior Hirshabelle officials makes the situation particularly sensitive. A Warning to Mogadishu The message from Beledweyne is unlikely to be ignored in Mogadishu. The Federal Government is already facing political disputes with several regional actors over elections, constitutional arrangements and the distribution of political authority. A new confrontation in Hiiraan would add another serious challenge to efforts to maintain political stability and prevent local disputes from becoming armed conflicts. For the moment, there has been no indication that a full-scale conflict has begun. But the language coming from Beledweyne is unmistakably more confrontational. A political disappointment in Mogadishu has now returned to Beledweyne as anger, mobilization and a warning of possible confrontation. The critical question is whether political leaders and traditional authorities can contain the situation before calls for mobilization translate into violence. For Hirshabelle—and for Somalia more broadly—the cost of allowing another political dispute to become an armed confrontation could be devastating. What failed at the negotiating table must not be allowed to become a war in the streets of Beledweyne. items.title: Mogadishu Faces Higher Prices and Revenue Pressure as Shipping Disruptions Hit Imports
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Security tensions around the Bab al-Mandab Strait and Strait of Hormuz are disrupting Somalia’s traditional shipping routes, forcing importers to seek alternatives and raising concerns over higher prices, shortages of essential goods and declining government tax revenues. Somali businesses typically import goods from Asia through Gulf hubs including the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudi Arabia. But growing insecurity along key maritime routes is prompting some traders to establish more direct supply lines. Mogadishu Port manager Mohamed Ali Nur said the security situation around Bab al-Mandab and Hormuz has significantly affected Somali traders and that the port is working with businesses to identify alternative routes. “For the first time, we directly received a ship carrying sugar from Sri Lanka,” Mohamed Ali said, describing the shipment as part of efforts to reduce disruptions caused by the regional security situation. Higher Costs, Higher Prices Alternative routes may keep supplies moving, but longer journeys increase freight, fuel, insurance and storage costs. Combined with shipping delays, these higher costs could push up prices and cause shortages of essentials such as sugar, rice, flour and cooking oil, particularly goods Somalia relies heavily on imports to supply. Captain Ali Jemdi, who works in sugar-cargo transportation, said uncertainty over regional shipping routes has increased concerns among traders and shipping companies operating between Asia, the Gulf and East Africa. The Revenue Problem The consequences extend beyond consumers and businesses. Somalia relies heavily on international trade for customs duties, import taxes and port-related revenues. If shipping disruptions reduce import volumes or discourage businesses from bringing goods into the country, government collections could also decline. That creates a potential fiscal problem. Lower trade-related revenue means less money available to meet government commitments, including salaries for civil servants and security personnel, as well as spending on public services and administration. The effect would not necessarily be immediate, particularly if disruptions remain temporary. But a prolonged decline in imports could widen the gap between government revenue and expenditure. A Chain Reaction Somalia Cannot Ignore The potential economic chain is straightforward: Shipping disruption → higher transport costs → higher import prices → reduced purchasing power → weaker demand and imports → potentially lower customs revenue → greater pressure on government finances. For Somalia, maritime security is therefore also an economic and fiscal issue. The government should closely monitor food prices, import volumes, shipping costs and customs collections while working with traders to diversify supply routes. In the longer term, reducing Somalia’s exposure to external shipping shocks will require stronger domestic production, more efficient ports and broader diversification of supply chains. Disruption thousands of kilometers away can ultimately raise the price of food in Mogadishu, Puntland and Somaliland—and, if it lasts long enough, make it harder for the government to pay its bills. items.title: Puntland oo xirtay saraakiil ciidan oo u dhoofayay Muqdisho
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Puntland ayaa maanta garoonka diyaaradaha magaalada Boosaaso ka xirtay saraakiil ciidan oo la sheegay inay u safrayeen magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimadda Soomaaliya. Laba sarkaal oo ka tirsanaa ciidamadii Dowladda Federaalka ay dhawaan kula wareegtay deegaanka Kuur-ilaalo ee degmada Rako-raaxo ayaa ka mid ah dadka lagu xiray garoonka, sida ay sheegayaan wararka laga helayo Boosaaso. Sidoo kale, garoonka ayaa waxaa lagu qabtay agaasimihii Isbitaalka Lafaha ee Carmo, Cabdiqaadir Xaaji Cabdullaahi (Waraabe) oo isna la sheegay inuu ku wajahnaa Muqdisho. Garoonka ayaa waxa kale oo lagu xayiray Suldaan Maxamuud Xaaji Cabdullaahi oo ka mid ah isimada dhaqanka ee gobolka Bari, iyadoo markii dambe la sii daayay. Suldaanka oo ka hadlay dhacdada ayaa ku baaqay in si degdeg ah loo sii daayo ragga kale ee la xiray, isagoo sheegay inay Muqdisho u safrayeen dano gaar ah oo ay leeyihiin. “Waxay u safrayeen danahooda gaarka ah, waana xaq ay leeyihiin,” ayuu yiri Suldaan Maxamuud Xaaji Cabdullaahi, oo maamulka ugu baaqayo in dadka la xiray loo ogolaado inay safarkooda sii wataan. Xariga saraakiisha ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli uu jiro khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo amni oo u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan arrimaha ciidamada iyo maamulka deegaannada qaarkood. Ilaa hadda Puntland si rasmi ah ugama hadlin sababta loo xiray saraakiisha iyo agaasimaha Isbitaalka Lafaha ee Carmo, mana jirto faah-faahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan tallaabada maamulka uu qaaday. items.title: Southwest Somalia conflict risks spiraling into inter-clan war, ACLED warns
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – A political and military standoff in Somalia’s Southwest state risks escalating beyond a power struggle into a protracted inter-clan conflict that could destabilize the wider Bay region, the Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED) said in a new report. The conflict pits federal government forces and their regional allies against Darwish forces loyal to ousted Southwest State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. According to ACLED, the two sides have fought at least 78 armed engagements in the Bay region between Feb. 2 and Aug. 28, with fighting concentrated overwhelmingly in the Baidoa district. Twenty-two of those clashes occurred in a five-week window from Feb. 4 to March, ACLED found, as federal forces mobilized to remove Laftagareen from power. The push to unseat him followed his decision to hold a state election, in which he was re-elected on March 28 to a second term – a vote Mogadishu did not recognize. The federal government and a new Southwest administration, installed in June, have since branded the opposition forces as terrorists. Officials have accused Laftagareen’s fighters of coordinating with Al-Shabaab militants during an attack on Baidoa city on Aug. 17, and specialized federal forces have begun deploying to the region to launch an operation against them. Spokespersons and supporters aligned with the opposition have firmly rejected the terrorism allegations. ACLED warned that the prolonged standoff carries a strategic cost beyond Southwest state’s borders: it risks diverting federal military resources away from the national campaign against Al-Shabaab at a moment when the group is intensifying its own offensive in the region. Since the new Southwest administration took office on June 11, ACLED has recorded more than 75 Al-Shabaab attacks in the Bay region through Aug. 28 – a surge the group’s analysts linked directly to the political vacuum and security realignment triggered by the leadership dispute. “If left unresolved, this political standoff between the Opposition-SWSPF and the federal government could escalate beyond a simple power struggle and devolve into a protracted inter-clan conflict, severely exacerbating communal instability across the region,” ACLED said. The Southwest crisis has become one of the most closely watched flashpoints in Somalia’s internal politics this year, pitting Mogadishu’s authority to install a federal-aligned administration against a local leader who claims an electoral mandate – with implications for clan cohesion, regional security, and the broader fight against Al-Shabaab. Background: How the Southwest crisis reached this point Laftagareen had governed Southwest state since 2018 before the rupture with Mogadishu. Tensions escalated after President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government pushed through constitutional changes that extended his own term and altered Somalia’s power-sharing arrangement; Laftagareen rejected the changes and severed cooperation with the federal government in March. Federal troops, backed by allied clan militias, entered Baidoa on March 30, and Laftagareen resigned and left for Nairobi rather than fight – the moment that set the current standoff in motion. Since then, fighting around Baidoa has recurred in waves rather than settled into either war or peace: opposition-aligned fighters mounted an attempted incursion in May, came close to reaching the presidential palace in a June 21 assault, and clashed with federal and Southwest forces again in August, including the Aug. 17 attack federal officials have linked to Al-Shabaab. Casualty figures from these episodes are contested and have not been independently verified by either side. The clan dimension ACLED warns about is not abstract. Southwest’s federal-backed administration is led by figures including former parliamentary speaker Aden Mohamed Nur “Madobe,” who comes from the Hadamo sub-clan of the broader Rahanweyn clan family; Laftagareen belongs to the Harin sub-clan, also part of the Rahanweyn. Because both camps draw on branches of the same clan family, analysts have noted that a prolonged military standoff carries a distinct risk of hardening into intra-clan and inter-clan rivalry rather than remaining a straightforward contest between a federal government and a former regional president. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Price Shock Hits Bosaso and Hargeisa as Consumers Feel the Cost of Regional Shipping Disruptions
items.description: Bosaso / Hargeisa(WDN ) — The regional shipping crisis is no longer a story unfolding somewhere far beyond Somalia’s shores. It has reached the markets, the kitchens and the household budgets of ordinary Somalis. In Bosaso and Hargeisa, prices of essential commodities are already climbing, with consumers and traders reporting sharp increases in the cost of sugar, rice, flour, pasta and cooking oil. The sudden price shock has triggered complaints on social media, where some residents are questioning what their respective governments are doing to protect consumers and, in some cases, blaming authorities for failing to contain the increases. The numbers are beginning to tell the story. In Bosaso, a bag of sugar that previously sold for about $27.50 is now reportedly reaching $32.70. A bag of rice has risen from approximately $23 to $26, while flour has increased from $22 to $26. A carton of pasta has reportedly climbed from $9 to $11, while a container of cooking oil has increased from $4.50 to $5.50. For a wealthy household, the difference may appear manageable. For the masses, families already living close to the edge, however, simultaneous increases across several basic commodities can quickly become a serious cost-of-living crisis. And this may only be the beginning. Bosaso Feels the Shock Bosaso is one of Puntland’s principal commercial gateways and depends heavily on imported goods arriving through its port. The immediate cause of the latest price increases remains contested. Traders have not provided a definitive explanation for the increases, but the situation has been linked to recurring tensions between Bosaso businesses and the Puntland authorities over fees reportedly imposed by DP World, the operator involved in the management of Bosaso Port. Local traders have previously complained about port-related charges, arguing that additional costs ultimately make imported goods more expensive. The latest increases have therefore created an uncomfortable chain reaction: costs that traders say they are being forced to absorb may eventually be transferred to consumers. Hargeisa Faces the Same Pressure The problem is not confined to Bosaso. Consumers in Hargeisa have also taken to social media to complain about sudden increases in the prices of essential commodities. Some have blamed Somaliland authorities for failing to contain the rising cost of basic goods. These online reactions should not automatically be interpreted as representing the views of the wider population. But they provide a visible indication of frustration among some consumers who are already feeling the impact of higher prices. The parallel complaints in Puntland and Somaliland are significant because both economies depend heavily on imported food and consumer products. When shipping becomes more expensive or unpredictable, the effects can move rapidly through the supply chain—from importers to wholesalers, retailers and ultimately households. From the Red Sea to the Family Budget The broader regional security situation provides the context. Somali importers traditionally rely on maritime routes connecting Asia, the Gulf and East Africa. Disruptions around the Bab al-Mandab Strait and Strait of Hormuz can force ships to take longer or more expensive routes, increasing freight, fuel, insurance and security costs. Those additional costs do not simply disappear. They are eventually reflected in the price of goods arriving in Somali markets. The result can be a combination of higher prices, shipping delays and tighter supplies, particularly for commodities that Somalia relies heavily on imports to provide. Geopolitical crisis thousands of kilometers away can therefore become a very personal crisis at a Somali market stall. The Political Cost For Puntland and Somaliland authorities, the issue is rapidly becoming more than an economic problem. When the price of food rises suddenly, consumers naturally look to their governments for explanations. That is already happening online. Some residents in Bosaso and Hargeisa are publicly questioning why prices are rising and what their governments are doing to protect consumers. Whether the governments are actually responsible for the increases is a separate question. But politically, perception matters. If citizens conclude that authorities are failing to control unnecessary costs, ensure competitive markets or reduce avoidable fees, rising prices can quickly become a source of political anger. The Revenue Dilemma There is another potential consequence that governments cannot ignore: falling trade revenue. Puntland and Somaliland collect revenue from imports through customs duties, port charges and other trade-related taxes and fees. If higher prices reduce consumer demand or discourage businesses from importing goods, government revenue could eventually decline. That creates a difficult policy dilemma. Governments need revenue to pay salaries, finance security operations and provide public services. But excessive charges on trade can increase the cost of imported goods and potentially discourage commercial activity. Revenue collection must therefore be balanced against the need to keep essential goods affordable and trade competitive. The Warning from Bosaso and Hargeisa What is happening in Bosaso and Hargeisa should be treated as an early warning. The regional shipping crisis may have begun as a security problem at some of the world’s most dangerous maritime chokepoints. But Somalia experiences that crisis differently. It arrives in the price of sugar. It appears in the cost of rice. It shows up in the price of cooking oil. And eventually, it reaches the family budget. That is why the authorities in Puntland and Somaliland face growing pressure to explain the price increases, review trade-related charges and work with importers to prevent unnecessary supply disruptions. The longer-term solution will require more resilient supply chains, diversified shipping routes and efficient ports. items.fullContent: Bosaso / Hargeisa(WDN ) — The regional shipping crisis is no longer a story unfolding somewhere far beyond Somalia’s shores. It has reached the markets, the kitchens and the household budgets of ordinary Somalis. In Bosaso and Hargeisa, prices of essential commodities are already climbing, with consumers and traders reporting sharp increases in the cost of sugar, rice, flour, pasta and cooking oil. The sudden price shock has triggered complaints on social media, where some residents are questioning what their respective governments are doing to protect consumers and, in some cases, blaming authorities for failing to contain the increases. The numbers are beginning to tell the story. In Bosaso, a bag of sugar that previously sold for about $27.50 is now reportedly reaching $32.70. A bag of rice has risen from approximately $23 to $26, while flour has increased from $22 to $26. A carton of pasta has reportedly climbed from $9 to $11, while a container of cooking oil has increased from $4.50 to $5.50. For a wealthy household, the difference may appear manageable. For the masses, families already living close to the edge, however, simultaneous increases across several basic commodities can quickly become a serious cost-of-living crisis. And this may only be the beginning. Bosaso Feels the Shock Bosaso is one of Puntland’s principal commercial gateways and depends heavily on imported goods arriving through its port. The immediate cause of the latest price increases remains contested. Traders have not provided a definitive explanation for the increases, but the situation has been linked to recurring tensions between Bosaso businesses and the Puntland authorities over fees reportedly imposed by DP World, the operator involved in the management of Bosaso Port. Local traders have previously complained about port-related charges, arguing that additional costs ultimately make imported goods more expensive. The latest increases have therefore created an uncomfortable chain reaction: costs that traders say they are being forced to absorb may eventually be transferred to consumers. Hargeisa Faces the Same Pressure The problem is not confined to Bosaso. Consumers in Hargeisa have also taken to social media to complain about sudden increases in the prices of essential commodities. Some have blamed Somaliland authorities for failing to contain the rising cost of basic goods. These online reactions should not automatically be interpreted as representing the views of the wider population. But they provide a visible indication of frustration among some consumers who are already feeling the impact of higher prices. The parallel complaints in Puntland and Somaliland are significant because both economies depend heavily on imported food and consumer products. When shipping becomes more expensive or unpredictable, the effects can move rapidly through the supply chain—from importers to wholesalers, retailers and ultimately households. From the Red Sea to the Family Budget The broader regional security situation provides the context. Somali importers traditionally rely on maritime routes connecting Asia, the Gulf and East Africa. Disruptions around the Bab al-Mandab Strait and Strait of Hormuz can force ships to take longer or more expensive routes, increasing freight, fuel, insurance and security costs. Those additional costs do not simply disappear. They are eventually reflected in the price of goods arriving in Somali markets. The result can be a combination of higher prices, shipping delays and tighter supplies, particularly for commodities that Somalia relies heavily on imports to provide. Geopolitical crisis thousands of kilometers away can therefore become a very personal crisis at a Somali market stall. The Political Cost For Puntland and Somaliland authorities, the issue is rapidly becoming more than an economic problem. When the price of food rises suddenly, consumers naturally look to their governments for explanations. That is already happening online. Some residents in Bosaso and Hargeisa are publicly questioning why prices are rising and what their governments are doing to protect consumers. Whether the governments are actually responsible for the increases is a separate question. But politically, perception matters. If citizens conclude that authorities are failing to control unnecessary costs, ensure competitive markets or reduce avoidable fees, rising prices can quickly become a source of political anger. The Revenue Dilemma There is another potential consequence that governments cannot ignore: falling trade revenue. Puntland and Somaliland collect revenue from imports through customs duties, port charges and other trade-related taxes and fees. If higher prices reduce consumer demand or discourage businesses from importing goods, government revenue could eventually decline. That creates a difficult policy dilemma. Governments need revenue to pay salaries, finance security operations and provide public services. But excessive charges on trade can increase the cost of imported goods and potentially discourage commercial activity. Revenue collection must therefore be balanced against the need to keep essential goods affordable and trade competitive. The Warning from Bosaso and Hargeisa What is happening in Bosaso and Hargeisa should be treated as an early warning. The regional shipping crisis may have begun as a security problem at some of the world’s most dangerous maritime chokepoints. But Somalia experiences that crisis differently. It arrives in the price of sugar. It appears in the cost of rice. It shows up in the price of cooking oil. And eventually, it reaches the family budget. That is why the authorities in Puntland and Somaliland face growing pressure to explain the price increases, review trade-related charges and work with importers to prevent unnecessary supply disruptions. The longer-term solution will require more resilient supply chains, diversified shipping routes and efficient ports. But the immediate political test is much simpler: Can governments keep essential goods affordable while maintaining the revenues they need to run the state? Bosaso and Hargeisa are already demonstrating how quickly a distant maritime crisis can become a domestic economic and political problem. For ordinary Somalis, geopolitics is no longer something happening on the horizon. It is sitting on the market shelf—and it is getting more expensive. items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka Oo Ka Hadlay Ka Reebista Ururka Towfiiq Doorashada Ku-celiska ah ee Galmudug
items.description: Afhayeenka Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, Mudane Cabdifataax Faysal Xuseen, ayaa faahfaahin ka bixiyay sababta Ururka Towfiiq, oo uu hoggaamiyo Sheekh Shaakir, looga reebay doorashada ku-celiska ah ee ka socota Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Cabdifataax Faysal ayaa sheegay in go’aanka lagu reebay Ururka Towfiiq uusan ahayn mid siyaasadeed, balse uu salka ku hayo habraaca iyo shuruudaha looga baahan yahay ururrada doonaya inay ka qayb galaan doorashada. Afhayeenka ayaa xusay in Ururka Towfiiq uusan Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka u gudbin codsi rasmi ah oo muujinaya inuu doonayo ka qaybgalka doorashada ku-celiska ah ee Galmudug. Arrintan ayaa muhiimad gaar ah leh, maadaama Ururka Towfiiq uu hore qayb uga ahaa murankii doorashada Galmudug, kaas oo sababay in Maxkamadda Sare ay baabi’iso doorashadii hore, kadib markii ururkaasi laga reebay geeddi-socodkii doorashada. Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa hadda wada diyaarinta iyo hirgelinta doorashada ku-celiska ah ee Galmudug, iyadoo ururrada siyaasadeed ee doonaya inay ka qayb galaan looga baahan yahay inay buuxiyaan shuruudaha iyo habraacyada rasmiga ah ee guddigu dejiyay. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli ay weli jiraan su’aalo iyo dood siyaasadeed oo ku saabsan ka qaybgalka ururrada siyaasadeed iyo hannaanka doorashooyinka ka socda dowlad goboleedyada dalka.

items.title: General Sahal Cabdullaahi oo ciidamada ku sugan Baydhabo ku wargeliyay in hawlgal la bilaabayo
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka oo booqasho ku jooga Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa ciidamada u sheegay in hawlgal sifayn ah laga bilaabi doono deegaanada hoostaga magaaladaasi. General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar oo weli kormeer ku sameynaya difaacyada ay ciidamadu ku leeyihiin afaafka hore ee magaalada ayaa marka hore ku bogaadiyay, sida ay u gudanayaan waajibaadkooda qaran ee difaaca dalka. Taliyaha oo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka qaarkood kula hadlay mid ka mid ah goobihii uu booqday ayaa u sheegay in ay u diyaargaroobaan hawlgal lagu xasillinayo amniga magaalada, isagoona muujiyay in dhawaan hawlgalka laga bilaabi doono deegaanada ku xeeran magaaladaasi. Taliska Militariga Somaliya ayaa isku-dubaridaya cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed, oo la doonayo in ay ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ka saaraan deegaanada ku dhow dhow Magaalada Baydhabo. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa Sabtidii Baydhabo u tagey qorsheynta hawlgal dhul iyo cirba leh, oo laga sameeyo deegaanada loo arko in laga soo abaabulo weerarada ka dhanka ah magaaladaasi. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ka caawineysa in uu si ammaan ah ugu shaqeeyo Baydhabo. Aadan Madoobe ayaa waxaa walaac ku haya ciidamada diidan maamulkiisa ee ku sugan bannaanada magaalada.

items.title: Ugaashka beesha Xawaadle oo ka degay Beledweyne, kuna dhawaaqay in…
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Ugaaska beesha Xawaadle, Ugaas Yuusuf Ugaas Xasan iyo siyaasiyiin ka tirsan labada Aqal ee baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Beledweyne ee gobolka Hiiraan, halkaas oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay. Wafdiga oo maanta ka soo baxay Muqdisho ayaa waxaa garoonka diyaaradaha Beledweyne kaga hortagay Guddoomiyaha gobolka Hiiraan, Maxamed Xuseen Carab iyo xubno ka tirsan maamulka HirShabelle oo kasoo jeeda beesha Xawaadle, iyadoo amaanka magaalada si weyn loo adkeeyay. Ciidamo, hub iyo gaadiid dagaal ayaa sidoo kale lagu arkayay qeybo ka mid ah magaalada, xilli wafdiga Ugaaska uu halkaas u tagay wada-tashi la xiriira xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo tan amni ee ka taagan gobolka. Ugaas Yuusuf Ugaas Xasan oo warbaahinta la hadlay sheegay in socdaalkoodu qeyb ka yahay qorshe ay beesha Xawaadle uga tashanayso xaaladda taagan, isagoo ku baaqay in la mideeyo talada iyo go’aannada beesha. Ugaaska ayaa ku dhawaaqay in beesha qaadi doonto tallaabooyin wadajir ah oo ka duwan kuwii hore, kadib wada-tashiga ay beesha Xawaadle ku yeelanayso Beledweyne. “Waxaan rabnaa Xawaadle inay tashato. Si guud ayay u tashan doonnaa, si wadajir ah ayay u tashan doonnaa, tallaabo wadajir ahna waan qaadi doonnaa. Tallaabada aan qaadno waxay ka duwanaan doontaa tallaabooyinkii hore,” ayuu yiri Ugaaska. Ugaas Yuusuf ayaa sidoo kale dadka kasoo jeeda beesha ugu baaqay inay u diyaar garoobaan go’aannada kasoo baxa wada-tashiga, isagoo sheegay in looga baahan yahay qof kasta oo leh awood, dhaqaale ama karti inuu ka qeyb qaato fulinta go’aannada. “Maanta waxaan rabnaa go’aanka aan soo gaarno inaan fulinno, cidda fulin kartana waa idinka shacabka ah. U diyaar garooba,” ayuu yiri. Guddoomiyaha gobolka Hiiraan, Maxamed Xuseen Carab ayaa dhankiisa sheegay in maamulka gobolka uu diyaar u yahay inuu kala qeyb qaato talooyinka iyo dadaallada ay mas’uuliyiinta iyo waxgaradka beesha u tageen magaalada Beledweyne. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka HirShabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) oo isna hadlay ayaa sheegay in bulshada Hiiraan ay tabashooyin ka qabto Dowladda Federaalka, balse uu xusay in ujeeddadu aysan ahayn diidmada dowladda, balse ay tahay sidii loo raadin lahaa xuquuqda gobolka iyo bulshada ay ku leeyihiin dowladda. “Calanka Hirshabeelle ayaa noo calan ah, fowdo ma rabno. Annaga wax baan tabanaynaa, dowladda iyo maamulka Hirshabeelle oo aan ka mid nahay ayaan ka tabanaynaa,” ayuu yiri Dabageed. Si kastaba, socdaalka Ugaaska iyo wafdiga la socda ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli beesha Xawaadle ay muddooyinkii dambe dooneysay inay hesho xilka ugu sarreeya ee HirShabelle, waxayna haatan si adag u diidan tahay go’aanka uu xisbiga Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu musharaxa u siiyay Cali Guudlaawe oo haatan hoggaamiya maamulka.
