items.title: Eritrea Warns Israeli Military Presence in Somaliland Could Ignite New Security Crisis in the Red Sea
items.description: Asmara (WDN) — Eritrean Foreign Minister Osman Saleh has warned that any Israeli plan to establish a military presence in Somaliland could have far-reaching consequences for the security and stability of the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden, questioning what strategic purpose such a deployment would serve. Saleh said Eritrea is closely monitoring military and strategic developments in the Red Sea and Horn of Africa, where growing competition among regional and international powers is already reshaping the security environment. His warning comes amid increasing discussion over the possibility of Israel establishing a military foothold in Somaliland. Saleh questioned the rationale behind any Israeli military base in the region and cautioned that such a development could alter the existing strategic balance. The Eritrean minister did not say that Israel had formally established such a base. Rather, his comments focused on the potential consequences should Israel establish a permanent military presence in Somaliland. The Red Sea and Gulf of Aden form one of the world’s most important maritime corridors, linking the Indian Ocean with the Suez Canal and carrying a significant volume of global trade. Eritrea’s concern is therefore that a new foreign military deployment could have consequences well beyond the territory hosting it. The threat of Israeli Presence Eritrea’s warning comes as the Red Sea has become an increasingly contested security environment. Israel already faces security challenges linked to attacks on commercial shipping and the activities of the Iran-aligned Houthi movement in Yemen. A permanent Israeli military facility on the African side of the Gulf of Aden could potentially provide Israel with greater access to maritime surveillance, intelligence gathering and regional security operations. But it could also make Somaliland more exposed to conflicts involving Israel and its adversaries. Eritrea’s central concern is that a military presence intended to strengthen one country’s security could create new risks for the wider region. An Israeli military installation in Somaliland could be viewed by the Houthis or other hostile actors as a strategic extension of Israeli military power into the Red Sea region. The danger, therefore, would not necessarily be the presence of Israeli troops itself. It would be the possibility that Somaliland could become drawn into a wider confrontation involving Israel, Iran and armed groups operating around the Red Sea. Eritrea’s Strategic Concern Saleh’s comments reflect Eritrea’s longstanding sensitivity to the militarization of the Red Sea. Eritrea has a long coastline along the Red Sea, directly opposite Yemen, giving developments on either side of the waterway immediate strategic significance for Asmara. By questioning the purpose of an Israeli military presence in Somaliland, Eritrea is effectively warning that the Red Sea should not become an arena for competing foreign military projects. For Eritrea, the concern is not limited to Israel. Every additional military actor potentially changes the calculations of every other actor already operating in the region. Somaliland Could Become a Front Line The greatest potential risk for Somaliland would be becoming a frontline location in conflicts originating elsewhere. A foreign military presence can bring investment, infrastructure, diplomatic leverage and security cooperation. But it can also make the host territory a potential target. If Israel were to establish a military facility in Somaliland, armed groups hostile to Israel could potentially regard the facility as a legitimate strategic target—even if Somaliland itself had no direct role in the underlying conflict. That could expose civilians, ports, airports and commercial infrastructure to heightened security risks. It could also complicate Somaliland’s relations with Somalia, Djibouti and Eritrea, all of which have strategic interests in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. The Houthi Factor The Houthi movement represents one of the most immediate potential security concerns. The group has demonstrated its willingness to attack commercial vessels and targets it associates with Israel and its allies in and around the Red Sea. A permanent Israeli military presence on the African side of the Gulf of Aden could therefore potentially become another target in the group’s strategic calculations. Even without an actual attack, the perception that Somaliland is hosting an Israeli military facility could alter the security environment. Shipping companies could reassess risks. Regional governments could increase military deployments. Intelligence activity could intensify. Armed groups could attempt to establish new networks along the coastline. That is how a military presence intended to provide security could generate a new layer of insecurity. A Wider Regional Arms Race Eritrea’s warning also points to a broader question: what would other powers do in response to a new Israeli military foothold? The Horn of Africa already hosts or attracts military facilities and strategic interests involving the United States, China, Turkey, Gulf states and other international actors. An Israeli military presence could encourage competing powers to seek greater access to ports, airfields and strategic coastline. The result could be a gradual militarization of the Gulf of Aden rather than greater stability. This is why Eritrea’s warning extends beyond Eritrea’s immediate national interests. The concern is that one new military arrangement could trigger a chain reaction involving several other powers. ForSomalia’s sovereignty question, Eritrea’s warning also intersects with Somalia’s unresolved dispute over Somaliland’s status. The Federal Government regards Somaliland as part of Somalia, while Somaliland operates as a self-governing entity and seeks international recognition as an independent state. Any agreement allowing a foreign military to establish a permanent presence in Somaliland would therefore carry significant political and sovereignty implications. Mogadishu could regard such an arrangement as a challenge to Somalia’s territorial sovereignty, potentially escalating tensions between the Federal Government and Somaliland. The prospect of an Israeli military presence could consequently add another layer to an already complicated political and security dispute. From Strategic Asset to Strategic Liability For Somaliland, the attraction of a military partnership with Israel would be understandable if it promised diplomatic recognition, investment, security cooperation or economic benefits. But Saleh’s warning highlights the other side of that calculation. A military base may increase geopolitical relevance while simultaneously increasing vulnerability. The territory hosting it becomes more important—but potentially more exposed. The critical question would therefore be whether Somaliland could obtain sufficient political and economic benefits to justify the additional security risks. Saleh’s remarks ultimately raise a question that extends beyond the Israeli-Somaliland relationship: Can the Red Sea absorb another major foreign military presence without becoming even more dangerous? Eritrea clearly believes the possibility deserves serious scrutiny.  The Red Sea and Gulf of Aden are already under pressure from regional conflicts, maritime insecurity and competition among external powers. Every new military base changes the regional security calculation. Every new military alliance creates potential targets. And every new foreign deployment risks drawing local territories into conflicts that originate elsewhere. If Israel were to establish a military presence in Somaliland, the question would therefore not simply be what Israel gains. Saleh said Eritrea is closely monitoring military and strategic developments in the Red Sea and Horn of Africa, where growing competition among regional and international powers is already reshaping the security environment. His warning comes amid increasing discussion over the possibility of Israel establishing a military foothold in Somaliland. Saleh questioned the rationale behind any Israeli military base in the region and cautioned that such a development could alter the existing strategic balance. The Eritrean minister did not say that Israel had formally established such a base. Rather, his comments focused on the potential consequences should Israel establish a permanent military presence in Somaliland. The Red Sea and Gulf of Aden form one of the world’s most important maritime corridors, linking the Indian Ocean with the Suez Canal and carrying a significant volume of global trade. Eritrea’s concern is therefore that a new foreign military deployment could have consequences well beyond the territory hosting it. The threat of Israeli Presence Eritrea’s warning comes as the Red Sea has become an increasingly contested security environment. Israel already faces security challenges linked to attacks on commercial shipping and the activities of the Iran-aligned Houthi movement in Yemen. A permanent Israeli military facility on the African side of the Gulf of Aden could potentially provide Israel with greater access to maritime surveillance, intelligence gathering and regional security operations. But it could also make Somaliland more exposed to conflicts involving Israel and its adversaries. Eritrea’s central concern is that a military presence intended to strengthen one country’s security could create new risks for the wider region. An Israeli military installation in Somaliland could be viewed by the Houthis or other hostile actors as a strategic extension of Israeli military power into the Red Sea region. The danger, therefore, would not necessarily be the presence of Israeli troops itself. It would be the possibility that Somaliland could become drawn into a wider confrontation involving Israel, Iran and armed groups operating around the Red Sea. Eritrea’s Strategic Concern Saleh’s comments reflect Eritrea’s longstanding sensitivity to the militarization of the Red Sea. Eritrea has a long coastline along the Red Sea, directly opposite Yemen, giving developments on either side of the waterway immediate strategic significance for Asmara. The Horn of Africa already hosts or attracts military facilities and strategic interests involving the United States, China, Turkey, Gulf states and other international actors. items.title: Xogta ciidamo deegaan oo lagu tababarayo Waajid
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa degmada Waajid ee gobolka Bakool ka bilowday tababarka ciidamo deegaan ah, kaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu xoojiyo ciidamada dowladda ee ka howlgala magaalada iyo deegaanada hoostaga. Dhalinyarada la tababarayo ayaa muujiyay doonis ay kaga mid noqonayaan ciidamada, taas oo keentay in la siiyo tababar ciidan oo u saamaxaya inay ka qeyb qaataan sugidda amniga deegaanadooda, sida ay sheegeen saraakiil ka tirsan ciidanka xoogga dalka. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in ujeeddadu tahay in la xoojiyo difaaca magaalada iyo deegaanadeeda, iyadoo la doonayo in laga hortago khatar kasta oo amni oo sababi karta in Waajid ay gacanta ka baxdo ciidamada dowladda. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale xoogga saaraysa tababarka iyo qalabaynta dhalinyarada deegaanka xilli deegaano hoostaga degmada Waajid lagu soo warramayo inay ka jiraan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ay wadaan dagaalyahannada Al-Shabaab. Waajid ayaa loo arkaa magaalo muhiim u ah dhinaca amniga iyo isku socodka gobolka Bakool, waxaana la qorsheeyay in ciidanka deegaanka ay ka hoos shaqeeyaan ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed. Ciidanka deegaanka ayaa door ka qaadan doona ka hortagga weerarrada iyo ilaalinta goobaha muhiimka ah, iyagoo garab siinaya ciidamada Federaalka iyo kuwa maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, sida ay sheegeen saraakiishu. Tababarka ka socda Waajid ayaa kusoo aadaya iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka ay waddo qorshe lagu kordhinayo awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, si ay ugu diyaargaroobaan mas’uuliyadda amni ee dalka iyo howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. items.title: Soomaaliya oo Nidaaminaysa Baraha Bulshada: Maxaa Isbeddelaya, Yuuse Saamaynayaa?
items.description: Baraha bulshadu waxay noqdeen qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah nolosha bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram iyo aaladaha kale ayaa maanta loo adeegsadaa helitaanka wararka, faafinta xogta, ganacsiga iyo doodaha bulshada. Isla waqtigaas, waxaa kordhay walaaca laga qabo wararka been-abuurka ah, marinhabaabinta, hadallada nacaybka ah iyo waxyaalaha waxyeellada leh ee la baahiyo. Arrintan ayaa keentay in Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya ay bilowdo dadaallo lagu horumarinayo, laguna nidaaminayo hab-adeegsiga warbaahinta dhijitaalka ah. Siyaasadda Baraha Bulshada Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska ayaa bisha Luulyo 2025 qabatay kulan wadatashi qaran oo looga hadlayay diyaarinta siyaasadda baraha bulshada, si loo maareeyo halista ka dhalata adeegsigooda qaldan. Kulanka waxaa ka qaybgalay hay’adaha dawladda, xubnaha dawladgoboleedyada, Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, ururrada warbaahinta, bulshada rayidka ah iyo dadka saamaynta ku leh baraha bulshada. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in talooyinka ka soo baxay wadatashigaas ay gundhig u noqonayaan diyaarinta siyaasadda qaranka ee baraha bulshada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, lama helin nuqul rasmi ah oo muujinaya in siyaasaddii kamadanbaysta ahayd la ansixiyay, oo ay dhaqangashay. Sidaas darteed, waa muhiim in aan la isku qaldin siyaasadaha la diyaarinayo iyo sharciyada dhaqangalay. Arrintani waxay qayb ka tahay qorshe ka baaxad weyn nidaaminta baraha bulshada. Madasha Labaad ee Istiraatiijiyadda Xiriirka Warbaahinta Soomaaliyeed 2026, oo Muqdisho ka dhacday 7da iyo 8da bishan Sibteenbar, waxaa diiradda lagu saaray casriyaynta warbaahinta, helitaanka xog sugan, la dagaallanka xogta qaldan iyo xogta si ulakac ah loo been-abuuray, adeegsiga garaadgacmeedka (AI), anshaxa saxaafadda iyo xoojinta xiriirka warbaahinta dawladda. Dawladdu waxay, sidoo kale, xoogga saartay hirgelinta Istiraatiijiyadda Qaranka ee Isgaarsiinta iyo iskudduwidda farriimaha hay’adaha dawladda. Xorriyadda Hadalka iyo Saxaafadda Nidaaminta baraha bulshadu waxay si toos ah u taabanaysaa xorriyadda hadalka. Qodobka 18aad ee Dastuurka Kumeelgaarka ahi wuxuu tilmaamayaa xorriyadda ra’yiga iyo hadalka, wuxuuna xusaa xorriyadda warbaahinta, oo ay ku jiraan warbaahinta elektaroonigga ah iyo tan internedka. Sidaas darteed, nidaam kasta oo cusub waa in uu si cad u qeexaa waxa mamnuuca ah, cidda go’aanka qaadanaysa iyo hannaanka qofku uga caban karo go’aankaas. Haddaba, wax-isweyddiinta mudani waa: yaa go’aaminaya in xogtu ay tahay mid qaldan, ra’yi qofeed, dhaliil ama war sugan oo saxan? Dhinaca kale, haddii siyaasaddan la hirgeliyo, waxay saamayn, toos ah ama dadban, ku yeelanaysaa adeegsadayaasha, suxufiyiinta, warbaahinta, dadka saamaynta ku leh baraha bulshada, dadka soo saara xogaha lagu baahiyo barahaas, ganacsiyada iyo hay’adaha dawladda. Dadka soo saara waxyaalaha la baahiyo ayaa si gaar ah ahmiyad u leh, maadaama qof kasta oo taageerayaal badan haysta uu awood u leeyahay in uu xog gaarsiiyo dad aad u tiro badan. Sidaas darteed, waxaa loo baahanyahay in si cad loo qeexo xilka qofka saaran marka uu faafinayo war ama xog dadweyne. Waxaa jira weyddiimo badan oo muhiim ah oo weli taagan: goorma ayay siyaasadda kama dambaysta ah ee baraha bulshadu dhaqangelaysaa? Yaa fulinaya? Maxay yihiin tallaabooyinka laga qaadi karo qofka jebiya? Ma jiri doonaa hannaan racfaan? Sidee loo ilaalinayaa suxufiyiinta iyo dadka dawladda dhaliila? Sidee loo kala saarayaa xogta qaldan iyo xogta si ulakac ah loo been-abuuray? Maxayse siyaasaddani kaga duwantahay Sharciga Warbaahinta ee 2020kii la taabbageliyay iyo sharciyada kale ee dalka ka jira? Soomaaliya waxay ku jirtaa marxalad ay si joogto ah oo xawli leh isu beddelayaan warbaahinta iyo tegnoloojiyaddu. Dawladdu waxay doonaysaa in ay wax ka qabato khataraha ka dhasha xogaha qaldan, xogaha sida bareerka ah loo been-abuuray iyo arrimaha kale ee waxyeellada leh ee la baahiyo, isla markaasna ay casriyayso warbaahinta iyo xiriirka dawladda iyo shacabka. Hasayeeshee, hirgelidda nidaamkani kuma xirna in la xakameeyo faafidda xogaha marinhabaabinta ah oo keliya, ee waxay, dhab ahaantii, ku xirnaan doontaa hufnaanta lagu dhaqangeliyo, ilaalinta xorriyadda hadalka iyo in bulshada loo caddeeyo cidda go’aaminaysa waxa sharci ahaan ama siyaasad ahaan qaldan. Doodda muhiimka ahi, sidaas darteed, waa sida loo heli karo dheellitir u dhexeeya badbaadada bulshada iyo suurtagalnimada xorriyadda hadalka, heer kasta ha joogtee.

items.title: Sawirro: Maxay soo arkeen saraakiisha DF u dirtay Baydhaba?

Wafdigan oo uu horkacayay taliyaha ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar soo indha-indheeyay goobaha la difaacayo amniga Baydhaba, iyagoo soo arkay raadadka dagaalkii culsaa ee dhawaan halkaas ku dhex-maray ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. items.title: Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika oo taageeray weerarada bada ee Xuutiyiinta
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa Weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee Maraakiibta Ganacsiga Badda Cas ku tilmaamay Bartilmaameedyo Sharci ah. Ninka hadda hoggaaminaya Guddiga Midowga Afrika, oo hore u ahaa wasiir arrimo dibadeed oo Jabuuti u soo shaqeeyay muddo dheer, ayaa si aan caadi ahayn u qirtay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Badda Cas. Hadallo la duubay, wuxuu ku sheegay in dowladda Jabuuti aysan cambaareyn weerarrada markii ay bilaabeen. Taa beddelkeeda, wuxuu soo bandhigay wax u dhigma cudur daar, isagoo ku dooday in Xuutiyiintu ay u dhaqmayeen si ay u taageeraan “walaalahooda” Falastiiniyiinta ah. Wuxuu sii raaciyay, isagoo soo jeedinaya in maraakiibta ganacsiga ee lagu weeraray Badda Cas loo arki karo bartilmaameedyo sharci ah. Mowqifka noocaas ah wuxuu si qoto dheer uga walaacsan yahay madaxa hay’ad qaarad ah oo loo xilsaaray horumarinta nabadda, xasilloonida iyo ixtiraamka sharciga caalamiga ah. Kuwani ma ahayn hadallo aan caadi ahayn ama aan muhiim ahayn. Waxay halis ugu jiraan inay sharciyad siyaasadeed siiyaan koox xagjir ah oo weerarradoodu ay halis geliyeen badmaaxiinta rayidka ah, carqaladeeyeen ganacsiga caalamiga ah isla markaana halis geliyay mid ka mid ah marinnada badda ee ugu muhiimsan adduunka. Mas’uulka ugu sarreeya Midowga Afrika inuu qiil u sameeyo rabshadaha noocaas ah waxay wiiqaysaa kalsoonida ururka waxayna keenaysaa su’aalo culus oo ku saabsan sida ay uga go’an tahay amniga badda, xasilloonida gobolka iyo xeerarka loogu talagalay inay difaacdo. Source Inside Africa

items.title: Hirshabelle Vice President Rejects Cooperation With Guudlaawe as Political Tensions Escalate
items.description: BELEDWEYNE—Hirshabelle State Vice President Yusuf Hagar Dabageed has ruled out working with President Ali Abdullahi Hussein Guudlaawe if Guudlaawe is re-elected to lead the federal member state. Speaking in an interview, Dabageed said he would not resign from his position but would refuse to cooperate with Guudlaawe if he secures another term as Hirshabelle president. His remarks came a day after the Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP) endorsed Guudlaawe as its candidate for the Hirshabelle presidential election. “The JSP issue and who was given what does not concern us. It concerns the person who gave it and the person who received it. But we, the people of Hirshabelle, are part of whatever decision the people of Hirshabelle make,” Dabageed said. Dabageed said the Hiiraan community would hold a consultative meeting in Beledweyne to deliberate on the political developments following Guudlaawe’s endorsement. He said the gathering was expected to produce a unified position on the emerging political dispute. The vice president also dismissed reports that Hiiraan residents were seeking to withdraw from Hirshabelle State. He said the community remained committed to the state-building process but maintained that its principal grievance was what it considers the denial of a five-year period of leadership that Hiiraan representatives say was agreed as part of the state’s political arrangements. The dispute adds to growing political tensions within Hirshabelle ahead of the state’s leadership elections, with divisions over power-sharing and the political representation of Hiiraan continuing to shape the region’s political landscape. The post Hirshabelle Vice President Rejects Cooperation With Guudlaawe as Political Tensions Escalate appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Daawo: Baarlamanka oo ku dheggan wasiir FIQI: Aroosyada ayaan ugu imaan doonaa
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaanno ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaaka Soomaaliya ayaa baafinaya wasiirka gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo maanta ka baaqday kulanka Golaha Shacabka oo la geeyay Hindise-sharciyeedka Difaaca Qaranka. Hindise-sharciyeedkan ayaa waxaa golaha faah-faahin ka siiyay wasiiru dowlaha wasaaradda gaashaandhigga Xildhibaan Cumar Cali Cabdi oo golaha la wadaagay muhiimadda uu sharcigan u leeyahay dalka. “Sharcigan wuxuu xaqiijinayaa in ciidamadeenna ay ayeeshaan hannaan sharci oo lagula xisaabtao, si awoodda iyo waajibaadka ciidanka marwaliba uga shaqeeyaan xadka uu sharciga dhigayo,” ayuu yiri wasiir Cumar Cali Cabdi. Intaas kadib xildhibaannada qaar ayaa dood ka keenay maqnaashaha wasiir Fiqi oo isagu ah mas’uulka ugu sarreeya wasaaradda, waxayna sheegeen inuu tago xafladaha aroosyada, balse uu ka dhuumanayo baarlamaanka Soomaaliya. “Fiqi aroosyada iyo xafladaha ayuu dadka kasoo dhagax tuuraa ama kasoo caayaa baarlamaankana wuu ka dhuumanaayaa wasiiru dowle ayuu noo soo diraa ha ogaaado inaan aroosyada ugu imaan doono” ayuu yiri yiri Xildhibaan Cali Mahdi Qalato. Sidoo kale, Xildhibaan Saadaq Cabdullahi Cabdi ayaa ku baaqay in sharcigan dib loo celiyo, ilaa uu golaha ka hor imaanayo wasiirka, si su’aalo loo waydiiyo. “Sharcigaan dib haloo dhigo ilaa wasiir Fiqi uu golaha ka hor imaanaayo, fursadna waa uu haayaa fadhi ku dirirku ayuu joogaa waa in uu baarlamaanka uu hor imaadaa, si aan su,aalo uweydiino” ayuu yiri Saadaq Cabdullaahi Cabdi. Dhankeeda Xildhibaan Habdhowre Sahra Bundubte ayaa soo jeedisay in aan ciidamo cusub la aas-asin, int xuquuqdooda ay helayaan ciidamada hadda jooga. “Aniga ma qabo in ciidamo cusub in la aasaaso iyadoo ay ciidamadeeda hada xaalada aan aragnay ay ku sugan yihiin,” ayay tiri Sahra Bundubte. items.title: Danab Forces Capture Two Al-Shabaab Fighters in Bay Region
items.description: BAY —Somalia’s elite Danab Commandos have conducted a planned military operation south of the Leego area in Bay Region, targeting suspected Al-Shabaab positions, according to military sources. The operation, carried out by the Special Operations unit of the Danab forces, resulted in the arrest of two individuals identified as members of the Al-Shabaab militant group. The troops also seized two AK-47 rifles during the operation. Military forces further destroyed a site believed to have been used by Al-Shabaab militants to prepare explosive devices, the sources said. The operation forms part of ongoing counterterrorism efforts by Somali government forces in areas where Al-Shabaab maintains a presence. The military has intensified targeted operations aimed at disrupting the group’s activities and dismantling its bases and hideouts. Danab Special Forces have played a prominent role in Somalia’s counterterrorism campaign, carrying out specialized operations against Al-Shabaab fighters, weapons caches and suspected militant facilities. The Danab forces said they would continue conducting targeted operations as part of efforts to strengthen security and weaken Al-Shabaab’s operational capabilities in the region. items.title: Qiimaha Shidaalka Muqdisho oo markale kor u kacay
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Qiimaha shidaalka ee lagu iibiyo magaalada Muqdisho ayaa sare u kacay qiyaastii 15% muddo toddobaad ah, sida ay xaqiijiyeen darawalada gadiidka. Kororka qiimaha ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xaaladda amni iyo dagaallada ka socda Bariga Dhexe ay saameyn ku yeelanayaan suuqyada shidaalka iyo gaadiidka caalamka. Ganacsatada shidaalka ayaa sheegay in qiimaha gudaha uu si dhow ula socdo isbeddellada ka dhaca suuqyada caalamka, iyadoo xaalad kasta oo dagaal ama xiisad cusub ay keeni karto koror ku yimaada kharashka shidaalka iyo gaadiidka. Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in qiimaha shidaalka uu noqday mid si degdeg ah uga falceliya xaaladda Bariga Dhexe, iyadoo mararka qaar lacag dheeraad ah lagu daro qiimaha marka ay soo baxaan wararka ku saabsan dagaallo ama xiisado cusub. Kororka shidaalka ayaa walaac ku haya bulshada, maadaama isbeddelka qiimaha shidaalku uu si toos ah ama dadban u saameyn karo qiimaha gaadiidka, badeecadaha iyo adeegyada kale ee ku tiirsan shidaalka. Khabiirada dhaqaalaha ayaa muddo dheer tilmaamay in Soomaaliya ay si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay shidaalka dibadda laga keeno, taasina ay suuqa gudaha ka dhigto mid u nugul isbeddellada ku yimaada qiimaha shidaalka ee caalamka iyo kharashaadka gaadiidka. Sikastaba, xiisadaha Bariga Dhexe ay sii socdaan ama ay ka sii daraan, waxaa jirta cabsi laga qabo in qiimaha shidaalka ee Muqdisho uu mar kale kor u kaco, taasoo sii kordhin karta culayska dhaqaale ee saaran shacabka ku nool magaalada Muqdisho. items.title: Calanka Turkiga oo lagu gubaayo magaalooyinka Somalia Nacayb Awgeed
items.description: Waxa Somalia ku soo badanaaya nacaybka loo qabo daka Turkiga oo arimaha Soomaaliya aad u dhex gashay isla markaasna dhinac saartay kooxda ahaan jirtay dawladii hore ee uu hogaamin jiray Xasan Sheekh. items.title: Yuusuf Dabageed oo qaylo dhaan afka furtay kuna hanjabay tallaabo culus
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweyne ku xigeenka Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, Mudane Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) oo wareysi siiyay BBC-da ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ku aadan doorashada HirShabelle, isaga oo si cad u diiday hannaanka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee maamulkaasi. Dabageed ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in xilligan aysan HirShabelle ka dhici karin wax doorasho ah, illaa heshiis laga gaarayo khilaafka taagan, gaar ahaan tabashada ay qabto beeshiisa. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ku hanjabay in tallaabo ay qaadi doonaan, haddii aan xal loo helin tabashada taagan, kahor doorashooyinka ka dhacaya deegaanka. “Wax HirShabelle la yiraahda oo jiraya ma jiraan labadii gobol ee Hiiraan iyo Shabeellada Dhexe ayaa jiri doono haddii aaan hadda laga heshiinin oo aan la dhisin wax heshiis lagu yahay, mana ka dhacaysa wax doorasho ah HirShabelle.” ayuu wareysiga ku yiri Yuusuf Dabageed. Dhanka kale, wuxuu eedeyn culus u jeediyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, isaga oo uu tilmaamay inuu diidan yahay xaqa beesha Xawaadle, wuxuuna sheegay inay dagaalami doonaan, haddii aan la qancin, sida uu ku dooday. “HirShabelle amni darro iyo qalalaase ayay galeysaa sababta oo ah Xasan Sheekh hal reer ayuu wax u ogol yahay Xawaadle wixii kala dhaxeeyay walaalahood waa loo diiday,” ayuu mar kale yiri Madaxweyne ku xigeenku. Yuusuf Dabageed oo la weydiiyay cidda amni darada sameyn doonta ayaa carrabka ku dhuftay in isaga iyo reerkiisaba ay sameyn doonaan wax walba oo ay awoodaan, si ay u helaan xuquuqdooda. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, xiisadda haatan ka taagan HirShabelle ayaa sii laba kacleysay, kadib markii shalay kaarka xisbiga JSP la siiyay Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe, taas oo ka careysiisay siyaasiyiinta beesha Xawaadle, kuwaas oo hadda dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wada magaalooyinka Muqdisho iyo Beledweyne. Arrintan ayaa uga sii dareysa xaaladda adag ee HirShabelle oo tan iyo markii la aas-aasay wajaheysa khilaafaad gudaha oo ka dhashay dhisidda maamulka, kuwaas oo dib u dhigay horumarkii labada gobol ee Hiiraan iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe. items.title: Taliyaha ciidanka dhulka oo abaabul dagaal kawada magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar, oo howlo shaqo u jooga magaalada Baydhabo, xarunta KMG ah ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, ayaa kormeer shaqo ku tegay difaacyada hore ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Taliyaha iyo saraakiisha la socotay ayaa u kuurgalay xaaladda guud ee amniga iyo tan nololeed ee magaalada, iyagoo sidoo kale qiimeeyay xaaladda Ciidamada iyo goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin. Taliyaha Qeybta 60-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Gaashaanle Sare Isxaaq Aadan “Isxaaq Berdaale”, ayaa Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka iyo saraakiisha la socotay warbixin guud ka siiyay xaaladda amniga, howlgalladii iyo dagaalladii ugu dambeeyay ee ay Ciidamadu galeen iyo guulaha laga gaaray kooxda Al-shabaab. Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa ciidamada geesiyaasha ah ugu hambalyeeyay guulaha ay gaareen, isagoo uga mahadceliyay sida joogtada ah ee ay uga feejigan yihiin dhaq-dhaqaaqyada cadowga iyo sida ay uga go’an tahay difaaca shacabka ay dhaarta u mareen inay u adeegaan. items.title: Guddiga Xuquuqul Insaanka Somaliland oo Ka Walaacay Xarigga Suugaan-Yahan iyo Wariyeyaal
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka Somaliland ayaa walaac xooggan ka muujiyay xarigga sharci-darada ah ee lagula kacay suugaan-yahan iyo wariyeyaal, kuwaas oo loo xiray amar maxkamadeed la’aan. Warsaxaafadeed ka soo baxay guddiga ayaa lagu sheegay in suugaan-yahan Ismaaciil Yuusuf (Jiheeye) iyo wariye Cabdiqani Xuseen Abokor (Baylood) ay ciidamada ammaanku xireen iyadoo aysan jirin wax waaran maxkamadeed ah, waxaana xariggooda la xiriiriyay gabay dhowaan la tiriyay oo la faafiyay. Labada nin ayaa weli ku jira xabsiga iyadoo aan wax maxkamad ah la horkeenin, ayadoo dhinaca kale, guddiga uu xaqiijiyay in wariye Xasan Saleebaan Haaruun (Galaydh), oo ay ciidamada baarista dambiyada ee CID-du qabteen 10-kii bishan Sebteembar, la sii daayay taariikhdu markay ahayd 12-ka Sebteembar. Wariye Galaydh ayaa guddiga u xaqiijiyay inaan wax jir-dil ah loo geysan intii uu xirnaa, balse lagu qabtay hab-raac aan waaran maxkamadeed lahayn. Guddiga Xuquuqul Insaanka Somaliland ayaa ku baaqay in la dhowro xorriyadda hadalka iyo xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee muwaadiniinta, iyadoo booliska iyo hay’adaha garsoorkuna aysan ilaa hadda soo bandhigin eedeymo rasmi ah oo maxkamadeed ama bayaan ka jawaabaya sheegashada xarigga sharci-darrada ah.

items.title: Koonfur-Galbeed oo Rayidka uga Digtay Goobaha Hawlgallada iyo Duqeymaha
items.description: Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha ee Dowlad-Goboleedka Koonfur-Galbeed ayaa soo saartay digniin culus oo ku wajahan dadka rayidka ah, iyadoo ku wargelisay inay si degdeg ah uga fogaadaan goobaha iyo fariisimaha la qorsheynayo in laga fuliyo hawlgallo ciidan iyo duqeymo cirka ah. Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur-Galbeed, Isxaaq Maxamed, ayaa sheegay in maamulku uu wado diyaargaroowgii ugu dambeeyay ee hawlgallo ballaaran iyo duqeymo lagu beegsanayo saldhigyada iyo goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin kooxda Al-Shabaab. Wasiirka ayaa si gaar ah ugu baaqay shacabka ku dhaqan deegaannada maamulka inay ka fogaadaan goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab iyo sidoo kale ciidamada taageersan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur-Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen), si looga fogaado waxyeello soo gaarta dadka aan waxba galabsan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, bayaanka laguma shaacin goobaha rasmiga ah ee bartilmaameedka noqon doona, xilliga ay hawlgalladu bilaabanayaan, iyo cidda ama saaxiibbada caalamiga ah ee fulinaya duqeymahaas la qorsheeyay. Labada dhinac ee uu wasiirku farta ku fiiqay ayaa ah kuwo kala madax-bannaan oo ujeeddooyin kala duwan leh, iyadoo warbixintu aysan caddayn wax xiriir ah oo ka dhexeeya Al-Shabaab iyo ciidamada taageersan madaxweynihii hore, balse tallaabadan ayaa muujinaysa xaalad kacsanaan amni iyo mid siyaasadeed oo ka soo cusboonaatay guud ahaan deegaannada Koonfur-Galbeed.

items.title: Shabeellaha Hoose oo Noqday Gobolka Ay Ka Dhacaan Rabshadaha Ugu Badan Ee Al-Shabaab
items.description: Gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa noqday deegaanka ay ka dhaceen rabshadaha ugu badan ee lala xiriiriyay kooxda Al-Shabaab gudaha dalka Soomaaliya, sida lagu shaaciyay warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay hay’adda diiwaangelisa colaadaha caalamka ee ACLED. Daraasaddan, oo la faafiyay xilliga xuska 25-guurada weerarradii 11-kii Sebtembar, ayaa xaqiijisay in Al-Shabaab ay ku lug lahayd in ka badan 2,300 oo dhacdo oo rabshado siyaasadeed iyo amni-darro ah tan iyo bilowgii sanadkan 2026. Tiradan ayaa ka dhigan ku dhowaad kala bar dhammaan falalka rabshadaha ah ee caalamka oo dhan loo diiwaangeliyay dhammaan faracyada kale ee hoos yimaada shabakadda Al-Qaacida. Hay’adda ACLED ayaa Al-Shabaab ku tilmaantay awoodda aan dowliga ahayn ee ugu gacan-sarreysa dalka, isla markaana ah laanta ugu rabshadaha badan guud ahaan xulafada Al-Qaacida ee caalamka, iyadoo Shabeellaha Hoose uu weli yahay xudunta ugu weyn ee ay ka dhacaan isku dhacyada, weerarrada, iyo falalka amni-darrada ah ee kooxdaasi ku lugta leedahay. Dhinaca kale, hay’addu waxay soo saartay digniin ku aaddan cawaaqibka mustaqbalka, iyadoo muujisay in yaraanshaha taageerada caalamiga ah ee hawlgalka nabad-ilaalinta Midowga Afrika ay Al-Shabaab u abuuri karto fursado cusub oo ay ku ballaariso saameynteeda iyo weerarrada ay ka fuliso dalka.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo UNDP oo Ka Wada-hadlay Horumarinta iyo Kobcinta Wax-soo-saarka Xoolaha
items.description: Wasiirka Xoolaha, Dhirta iyo Daaqa ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Xuseen Maxamed, ayaa magaalada Muqdisho kulan kula yeeshay madaxa Barnaamijka Horumarinta ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNDP) u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, Christophoros Politis. Kulankan ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga farsamo ee u dhexeeya labada dhinac, kobcinta wax-soo-saarka xoolaha nool, iyo sidii qorshayaasha waaxda xoolaha loogu waafajin lahaa Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka (NTP). Sidoo kale, mas’uuliyiinta ayaa dib u eegis ku sameeyay dadaallada lagu taageerayo nolol-maalmeedka bulshada xoolo-dhaqatada ah iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha reer miyiga ee ku tiirsan xoolaha. items.title: Qiimaha Raashinka Daruuriga ah oo Sare Ugu Kacay Suuqyada Magaalada Boosaaso
items.description: Suuqyada magaalada Boosaaso ee xarunta ganacsiga dowlad-goboleedka Puntland ayaa laga soo sheegayaa koror xooggan oo ku yimid qiimaha raashinka aasaasiga ah, arrintaas oo culeys dhaqaale ku keentay qoysaska danyarta ah ee ku nool deegaanka. Wararka la helayo ayaa muujinaya in qiimaha kiishka sonkorta ah uu kor uga kacay 32.7, halka kiishka bariiska ah uu isna gaaray 26, halka markii hore uu ahaa 23. items.title: Duqeymaha Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya oo Gaaray 81 Sanadkan 2026 Sida Ay Sheegtay AFRICOM
items.description: Taliska Mareykanka ee Qaaradda Afrika (AFRICOM) ayaa xaqiijiyay inuu weerar dhinaca cirka ah ka fuliyay gobolka Jubbada Hoose, kaas oo lala beegsaday maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab meel u dhow deegaanka Qumbi, oo qiyaastii 80 kiiloomitir dhinaca waqooyi-galbeed kaga beegan magaalada Kismaayo. Duqeyntan, oo dhacday 8-dii bishan Sebteembar, ayaa tiradeeda guud laga soo xigtay inay tahay howlgalkii 81-aad ee diyaaradaha Mareykanku ka fuliyaan gudaha Soomaaliya tan iyo bilowgii sanadkan 2026, marka la eego xogta iyo bayaannada rasmiga ah ee ka soo baxay taliska AFRICOM. Dhinaca kale, xog-ururinta ay samaysay hay’adda cilmi-baarista ee New America ayaa tirada guud ee duqeymaha sanadkan ku sheegtay 83 weerar. Farqiga u dhexeeya labada tiro ee 81 iyo 83 ayaa loo sababeynayaa hab-raacyada kala duwan ee labada dhinac u adeegsadaan diiwaangelinta duqeymaha iyo kala saaridda howlgallada is-daba-joogga ah, taas oo ka dhigan inaan hal tiro oo keliya loo qaadan karin mid kama-dambeys ah. Taliska AFRICOM ayaan dhankiisa faahfaahin ka bixin khasaaraha rasmiga ah ee ka dhashay weerarkan ugu dambeeyay ee ka dhacay meel u dhow Qumbi, nooca hubka la adeegsaday, iyo cutubka gaarka ah ee fuliyay howlgalka, balse howlgalladan joogtada ah ayaa muujinaya cadaadiska joogtada ah ee duqeymaha cirka ee lagu beegsanayo kooxda Al-Shabaab.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Qorsheynaysa Soo-Celinta Ku Dhowaad 1,900 Soomaali ah oo Ku Sugan Jarmalka
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa lagu soo waramayaa inay waddo qorshe dib loogu soo celinayo dalka ku dhowaad 1,900 oo muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed ah oo haatan ku sugan dalka Jarmalka. Qorshahan oo la filayo inuu dhaqangalo bisha Oktoobar ee soo socota ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallo la xiriira maaraynta arrimaha socdaalka iyo dib-u-dejinta dadka aan sharciga degenaanshaha ka helin waddamada Yurub. Sida ay faafiyeen warbaahinta maxalliga ah, tiradan ballaaran ayaa la qorsheynayaa in marxalado kala duwan dalka dib loogu soo celiyo, iyadoo xogta la helay ay muujinayso in arrintani ay daba socoto wadahadallo iyo is-afgaradyo dhexmaray saraakiisha labada dal oo ku saabsan fududeynta soo laabashada muwaadiniinta aan haysan oggolaanshaha joogtada ah ee dalka Jarmalka. Tirokoobyada rasmiga ah ee laga soo xigtay Baarlamaanka Jarmalka ayaa tilmaamaya in saddexdii sano ee u dambaysay ay hooseysay tirada dadka Soomaalida ah ee dalkaas laga masaafuriyay, iyadoo wadar ahaan dib loo soo celiyay 77 qof oo keliya intii u dhaxaysay 2023 iyo 2025. Xogtaas ayaa muujinaysa in 19 qof la masaafuriyay sanadkii 2023, 12 qof sanadkii 2024, halka sanadkii 2025 ay tiradu gaartay 46 qof. Haddii tallaabadan cusub ee la hadal-hayo ay u hirgasho sidii loo qorsheeyay, waxay noqon doontaa tiradii ugu ballaarnayd ee hal mar laga soo celiyo dalka Jarmalka muddooyinkii u dambeeyay, taas oo sidoo kale culeys ku noqon karta qorshayaasha dib-u-dhexgalka bulshada iyo fursadaha shaqo ee dalka ka jira xilli ay Soomaaliya la daalaa-dhacayso duruufo dhaqaale iyo mid bini’aadannimo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Jarmalka midkoodna weli si rasmi ah uma xaqiijin tirada saxda ah ee 1,900 qof, jadwalka ay ku bixi doonaan duullimaadyada soo daabulaya, iyo xaaladda sharciga ee qof kasta oo ka mid ah dadkaas, waxaana xogtan ay weli ku kooban tahay warbixinno warbaahineed oo sugaya xaqiijin dowladeed.

items.title: Safiirkii Türkiye ee Soomaaliya oo ka tegay farriin cajiib ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Safiirkii Dowladda Türkiye u fadhiyey Soomaaliya, Alper Aktaş, oo xilka ka tegay, ayaa shaaciyay inuu soo gabagabeynayo muddo-xileedkiisii Muqdisho, kaddib markii uu Soomaaliya ka howlgalayay tan iyo bishii Maarso 2024. Safiirka ayaa sheegay inuu Soomaaliya uga ambabaxayo xil cusub oo uu ka qabanayo magaalada Skopje ee dalka North Macedonia , isaga oo farriin sagootin ah u diray shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana ka hadlay isbeddellada uu arkay muddadii uu dalka joogay iyo halka uu marayo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye. Aktaş ayaa sheegay in muddadii uu Muqdisho joogay uu si dhow ula shaqeynayay hay’adaha dowladda, bulshada rayidka ah iyo qaybaha kale ee bulshada, isaga oo xusay in xiriirka labada dal uu sii ballaartay. “Türkiye ahaan, Soomaaliya waxaan ka hirgelinaynaa hannaan ku dhisan caddaalad, is-ixtiraam, sinnaanta iyo in qofka bani’aadamka ahi udub-dhexaad u noqdo dadaallada horumarineed,” ayuu ku yiri farriintiisa. Safiirka ayaa sheegay in labada dal ay sii xoojiyeen iskaashiga dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, amniga, waxbarashada, caafimaadka, gargaarka bani’aadannimo, kobcinta awoodaha farsamo iyo maalgashiga. Waxa uu sidoo kale xusay mashaariicda iyo iskaashiga ku saabsan dhaqaalaha buluugga ah, shidaalka iyo gaaska, isaga oo sheegay in xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye uu galay marxalad ka ballaaran gargaarkii iyo taageeradii dhaqameed ee labada dal. Aktaş ayaa sheegay in Ankara ay Soomaaliya kala shaqeyneyso dhinacyo badan oo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo si toos ah ugu xiran mustaqbalka dalka, oo ay ku jiraan horumarinta kaabeyaasha, kobcinta ganacsiga iyo abuurista fursado dhaqaale oo cusub. Aktaş ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay isbeddellada uu ku arkay Soomaaliya, isaga oo sheegay in dalku maanta dhinacyo badan ka horumarsan yahay halkii uu markii hore joogay. Waxa uu tusaale u soo qaatay xaaladda Muqdisho, isaga oo sheegay in magaalada ay sannadihii dambe ka muuqatay nolol iyo dhaqdhaqaaq sii kordhaya, gaar ahaan xilliyada bisha Ramadaan. Waxa uu sheegay in horumarkaasi uu ka muuqdo isu socodka dadka, ganacsiga iyo nolol maalmeedka caasimadda, isaga oo tilmaamay in xaaladda magaalada ay sannadihii dambe si muuqata isu beddeshay. Safiirka ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay kobaca ganacsiga, maalgashiga tooska ah iyo shaqooyinka ay abuurayaan shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay qeyb ka yihiin rajada laga qabo horumarka dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in kororka maalgashiga iyo shaqo-abuurku ay muhiim u yihiin dhalinyarada Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo sida uu sheegay u baahan fursado ay dalkooda kaga dhisan karaan mustaqbalkooda. Dhanka siyaasadda, Aktaş wuxuu sheegay in ka-qaybgalka dimoqraadiyadeed ee Soomaaliya ka hanaqaadaya uu mustaqbalka noqon karo waayo-aragnimo muhiim u ah nolosha siyaasadeed ee dalka, isagoo sheegay in Türkiye ay taageertay geeddi-socodkaas. Safiirka ayaa sidoo kale ku booriyay Soomaalida inay ilaashadaan midnimada iyo wadajirka, isaga oo sheegay in wadajirku laf-dhabar u yahay xasilloonida iyo horumarka dalka. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in Ankara ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, xasilloonida iyo ilaalinta midnimada dhuleed ee dalka. “Türkiye waxay sii wadi doontaa taageerada ay siiso midnimada dhuleed, amniga iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri safiirka. Aktaş ayaa sheegay in xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye, oo muddo dheer soo jiray, uu sii kobcayo, isla markaana iskaashiga labada dal uu yeelanayo dhinacyo cusub oo istiraatiiji ah. Alper Aktaş ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegay in Soomaaliya ay meel gaar ah kaga jirto qalbigiisa iyo siyaasadda dalkiisa, isaga oo u mahadceliyay dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed soo dhoweyntii iyo taageeradii ay u muujiyeen isaga, qoyskiisa iyo shaqaalaha safaaradda muddadii uu joogay Muqdisho. “Waxaan mar kale salaan xushmad, jacayl iyo kalgacal leh u dirayaa muwaadiniinteena ku sugan Soomaaliya iyo dhammaan walaalahayga Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu ku soo xiray farriintiisa sagootinta. items.title: Ganacsatada Soomaaliya Oo Bilaabay Inay Beddelaan Marinnada Badeecadaha
items.description: Ganacsatada Soomaaliya iyo maamulka Dekedda Muqdisho ayaa bilaabay inay raadiyaan marinnno cusub oo badeecadaha si toos ah looga keeno dalalka Aasiya. Tallaabadan ayaa jawaab u ah amni-darrada iyo carqaladaha ka jira marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab iyo Gacanka Hormuz, oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga Soomaaliya. Badeecadaha laga keeno Aasiya ayaa inta badan Soomaaliya loo soo mariyaa Imaaraadka Carabta, Cumaan ama Sacuudiga, ka hor inta aan dib loogu soo rarin dekedaha dalka, hase yeeshee, xaaladda amni ee gobolka ayaa ganacsatada ku qasbaysa inay tijaabiyaan safarro toos ah oo aan ku xirnayn dekedaha Khaliijka. Agaasimaha guud ee Dekedda Muqdisho, Maxamed Cali Nuur Ameeriko, ayaa sheegay in markii ugu horreysay dekeddu qaabishay markab sida sonkor oo si toos ah uga yimid Sri Lanka. Wuxuu tallaabadan ku tilmaamay istiraatiijiyad lagu yareynayo saameynta ay xiisadaha gobolka ku yeelan karaan soo dejinta badeecadaha. items.title: Eritrea oo walaac ka muujisay joogitaanka milateriga Israa’iil ee Somaliland
items.description: Asmara (Raxanreeb Online) Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda dalka Eritrea Cismaan Saalax , ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu walaac ka qabo qorshe kasta oo ay Israa’iil ku doonayso inay joogitaan milatari ka samaysato Somaliland. Cisman Saalax ayaa su’aal geliyey ujeeddada ka dambaysa qorshe kasta oo Israa’iil ay saldhig milatari uga samaysanayso Geeska Afrika, isagoo tilmaamay in arrintan ay yeelan karto saameyn ballaaran oo ku saabsan amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Wasiirku wuxuu sidoo kale muujiyey in Eritrea ay si dhow ula socoto dhaqdhaqaaqyada milatari iyo kuwa istiraatiijiga ah ee ka socda Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika, oo ah deegaan muhiim u ah isu-socodka ganacsiga iyo ammaanka caalamka. Haddii Israa’iil ay dhab ahaan ka samaysato saldhig ama joogitaan milatari Somaliland, arrintaasi waxay noqon kartaa isbeddel istiraatiiji ah oo saameeya xiriirka iyo loollanka ka jira gobolka, gaar ahaan dalalka ku teedsan Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Eritrea waxay muddo dheer muhiimad gaar ah siisay ammaanka Badda Cas, waxaana dowladda Asmara ay si joogto ah uga digtaa faragelinno shisheeye oo ay u aragto kuwo wax ka beddeli kara dheelitirka amni ee gobolka. Sikastaba hadalka Cisman Saalax ayaa sidaas darteed kusoo beegmaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan doodaha ku saabsan doorka quwadaha shisheeye ee Geeska Afrika iyo muhiimadda istiraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland, gaar ahaan marka la eego goobta ay ku taallo oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. The post Eritrea oo walaac ka muujisay joogitaanka milateriga Israa’iil ee Somaliland appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Tucker Carlson oo kashifay qorshe halis ah oo Israa’iil ay u maleegtay dalalka Khaliijka
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Faalleeyaha siyaasadda Mareykanka Tucker Carlson ayaa ku dooday in dagaalka ka socda Iran uu leeyahay ujeeddo ka ballaaran wiiqidda Tehran, isagoo sheegay in Israel ay dooneyso inay daciifiso dalalka Khaliijka, isla markaana ciidamada Mareykanka laga saaro gobolka si ay u hesho awoodda ugu sarreysa Bariga Dhexe. Carlson, oo wareysi siiyey barnaamijka Going Underground , ayaa sheegay inuu aragtidan la wadaagay madaxweyne Donald Trump ka hor inta aysan Mareykanka iyo Israel 28-kii Febraayo bilaabin weerarrada ballaaran ee Iran. “Waxaan ku iri ujeeddadu waa in Israel ay noqoto awoodda gobolka. Taasi waa sababta ay dagaalkan Iran u riixayaan. Waxay doonayaan inay gobolkooda maamulaan,” ayuu Carlson yiri. Waxa uu ku dooday in Israel aysan kaliya doonayn in Iran laga saaro kaalinta quwad goboleed, balse ay sidoo kale dooneyso inay meesha ka saarto awoodda kooxaha Tehran xulafada la ah, sida Hezbollah iyo Hamas. Carlson ayaa intaas ku daray in kobaca dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed ee dalalka Golaha Iskaashiga Khaliijka ee GCC — oo ay ku jiraan Sacuudi Carabiya, Imaaraadka Carabta, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain iyo Cumaan — uu sidoo kale caqabad ku yahay himilada Israel, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Ma rabto GCC, sababtoo ah waxay dhisayaan bulshooyin aad u horumarsan,” ayuu yiri Carlson, isagoo ku tilmaamay kobaca Khaliijka mid uu rumeysan yahay in Israel ay u aragto tartan soo baxaya. Israel iyo maamulka Trump waxay si rasmi ah u sheegeen in hawlgalkooda Iran uu diiradda saarayo wiiqidda barnaamijka gantaallada Tehran, awooddeeda milatari iyo ka hortagga inay hesho hub nukliyeer ah. Ciidamada Israel waxay 28-kii Febraayo sheegeen in hawlgalka wadajirka ah ee Mareykanka iyo Israel looga gol leeyahay “in si weyn loo wiiqo” awoodaha Iran ee ay ku tilmaameen khatar ku wajahan Israel. Khaliijka oo dagaalka ku dhex dhacay Carlson ayaa sheegay in natiijada dagaalku ay noqotay in dalalka Khaliijka ay bixiyaan qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah kharashka amni iyo dhaqaale ee colaadda. “Ujeeddadu waxay ahayd in Iran laga saaro awood goboleed ahaan, GCC-na la jahawareeriyo oo awooddeeda la yareeyo, Mareykankana laga saaro Khaliijka,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu sheegay inuu Trump arrintan kala hadlay mar uu tegay Aqalka Cad qiyaastii 20-kii Febraayo, maalmo ka hor bilowgii weerarrada 28-kii Febraayo. Carlson ayaa sidoo kale ku dooday in joogitaanka ciidamada Mareykanka ee Khaliijka uusan mar walba waafaqsaneyn danaha Israel, isagoo sheegay in saldhigyadaas ay Washington siinayaan awood ay ku xakameyso tallaabooyinka xulafadeeda gobolka. Aragtidaas ayaa timid xilli dagaalka Iran uu si weyn u saameeyey ammaanka dalalka Khaliijka. Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Daraasaadka Istaraatiijiyadda ee IISS ayaa sheegay in Iran ay in ka badan 4,000 oo gantaal iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku ridday dalalka GCC ilaa 19-kii Maarso, inkastoo tiro yar oo ka mid ahi ay gaareen bartilmaameedyadii loo waday. Machadku wuxuu sheegay in weerarradu ay cadaadis saarayaan dalalka Khaliijka, isla markaana ay faafinayaan kharashka dagaalka. Weerarrada Iran ayaa sidoo kale waxyeello xooggan gaarsiiyey saldhigyada ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Baaritaan ay Washington Post ku sameysay sawirrada dayax-gacmeedka ayaa lagu ogaaday in ugu yaraan 228 dhisme ama qalab oo ku yaalla xarumo ay ciidamada Mareykanka isticmaalaan la burburiyey ama waxyeello loo geystay tan iyo bilowgii dagaalka. Joogitaanka Mareykanka oo dib loo eegayo Waxyeelladaas ayaa durba dhalisay dood ku saabsan mustaqbalka ciidamada Mareykanka ee Khaliijka. Pentagon-ka ayaa qiimeynaya in ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka la dhimi karo marka dagaalka Iran dhammaado, gaar ahaan iyadoo qaar ka mid ah saldhigyada waaweyn ay bilooyin la kulmayeen weerarro, sida ay Washington Post sheegtay bishii Agoosto. Qiimeyntu weli ma aha dib-u-eegis rasmi ah, balse waxaa ka mid ah su’aasha ah in Washington dib u dhisto dhammaan saldhigyada waxyeelladu gaartay iyo in ciidamada qaarkood laga raro goobaha aadka ugu nugul weerarrada Iran. Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale sii kordhiyey cadaadiska ka jira marin-biyoodka Hormuz iyo kaabayaasha tamarta Khaliijka, halka weerarrada Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay cadaadis dheeraad ah saareen Sacuudi Carabiya iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Carlson ayaa sheegay in xaaladdaas ay xoojineyso su’aal uu sheegay inuu weli jawaab u la’yahay: sababta Trump, oo xiriir dhow la leh hoggaamiyeyaasha Khaliijka, uu u galay dagaal sababay in dalalkaas ay la kulmaan weerarro iyo khasaare ballaaran. “Taasi waa su’aasha ay warbaahinta Mareykanku si taxaddar leh isaga indha-tireyso,” ayuu yiri. “Waxaan rajeynayaa in mar uun taariikhyahannadu jawaab u helaan.” The post Tucker Carlson oo kashifay qorshe halis ah oo Israa’iil ay u maleegtay dalalka Khaliijka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ciidanka koonfur galbeed oo gacanta kusoo dhigay Nin ka dambeeyey dil ka dhacay Baydhabo
items.description: Baydhabo (Raxanreeb Online) Wararka inaga soo gaaraya magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay, ayaa ku waramaya in ciidanka booliska koonfur galbeed, ay howlgal ku soo qabteen shaqsi xalay qof shacab ah ku dilay magaalada Baydhabo. Shaqsiga lasoo qabtay ayaa lagu eedeeyey in xalay gudaha magaalada Baydhabo uu ku dilay wiil dhallinyaro ah oo lagu magacaabi jiray Alle hau naxariiste Jamaal. Ninka dilka geystay ayaa la sheegay inuu goobta isaga baxsaday, balse howlgal dheer kaddib ay ciidanka maamulka koonfur galbeed, ay gacanta ku soo dhigeen. Weli faah faahin dheeraad ah laga mahayo sababta loo dilay marxuum Jamaal oo kamid ahaa dhallinyarada aad looga yaqaanay gudaha magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay. Sidoo kale taliska ciidanka booliska koonfur galbeed, kama aysan hadlin howlgalka ay ku soo qabteen shaqsiga lagu eedeeyay inuu ka dambeeyey dilka. items.title: Iran oo diyaarad ku soo riday marinka Hormuz
items.description: Tehran (Raxanreeb Online) Wakaaladda wararka rasmiga ah ee Iran, IRNA, ayaa sheegtay in Ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ay soo rideen diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo nooca MQ-1 ah, taas oo lagu soo riday Marinka Hormuz. Waaxda xiriirka dadweynaha ee Ilaalada Kacaanka ayaa sheegtay in diyaaradda la qabtay lana “burburiyay” iyadoo la adeegsanayo nidaam cusub oo casri ah oo difaaca cirka ah, kaas oo ku shaqaynayay shabakadda isku-xiran ee difaaca circa ah. Ilaalada Kacaanka ayaan bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan dhacdadan. The post Iran oo diyaarad ku soo riday marinka Hormuz appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: “Doorashada HirShabelle qof hor istaagi karto ma jiro,” sidaas waxaa yiri…
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Wasiiru dowlaha warfaafinta HirShabelle Cabdikariin Xasan Nuur Doobyare (Doobyare) oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Idaacadda Kulmiye ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan arrimaha doorashooyinka maamulkaas oo uu weli ka taagan yahay khilaaf xooggan. Cabdikariin Doobyare ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay khilaafka ka dhashay musharraxnimada Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe, kaddib markii shalay la guddoonsiiyay kaarka musharraxnimada Xisbiga JSP, isaga oo sheegay in aysan jirin cid awood u leh inay ka hor istaagto ama diido doorashada HirShabelle. “HirShabelle doorasho ayaa ka dhacaysa qof hor istaagi kara majiro,” Cabdikariin Xasan Nuur Doobyare (Doobyare). Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in doorashadu ka dhici doonto dhammaan goobihii loo qorsheeyay, isla markaana amniga goobaha doorashada ay sugi doonaan ciidamada Booliska. Waxaa kale oo uu soo hadal qaaday tabashada reer Hiiraan, isaga oo sheegay in arrimaha taagan lagu xallin doono wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad, isla markaana la qancin doono dhinacyada kasoo horjeedo hannaanka loo wado doorashad Xiisadda ka taagan HirShabelle ayaa sii laba kacleysay, kadib markii kaarka JSP uu qaatay Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe, taas oo ka careysiisay siyaasiyiinta Xawaadle, kuwaas oo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wada Muqdisho iyo Beledweyne. Si kastaba, Madaxweyne ku xigeenka HirShabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) oo kasoo jeeda beesha Xawaadle ayaa horay u sheegay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu si cad ugu sheegay in xilka maamulka HirShabelle uu u wado Cali Guudlaawe, taas oo maanta rumowday, maadaama la siiyay kaarka JSP, kuna metali doono doorashada guud ee HirShabelle. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) ayaa sidoo kale Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku eedeeyay inuu uga baxay ballan siyaasadeed oo uu la galay. Dabageed oo tilmaamay in Madaxweynaha ay horay ugu heshiiyeen, uguna ballanqaaday inuu hoggaanka HirShabelle isaga siiyo ayaa sheegay in Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu hadda waxba kama jiraan kasoo qaaday ballankaas, uuna kursiga siiyay Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe oo markale isa soo sharraxay. The post “Doorashada HirShabelle qof hor istaagi karto ma jiro,” sidaas waxaa yiri… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Trump oo shaaciyey arrin ay soo weydiisteen Xuutiyiinta xilli ay weerarayaan Sacuudiga
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay la soo xiriireen maamulkiisa, kana codsadeen in Washington aysan faragelin dagaalka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya kooxda iyo Sacuudi Carabiya. Trump ayaa hadalkan sheegay, xilli dagaalka Yemen uu galay marxalad cusub, Xuutiyiintuna ay si degdeg ah ugu fideen xeebaha Badda Cas, taas oo sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo ammaanka marinka muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab. “Xuutiyiinta ayaa nala soo xiriiray, waxayna noo sheegeen inaysan dooneyn inay nala dagaallamaan. Ma doonayaan inaan daba galno,” ayuu Trump yiri. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa intaas ku daray in Xuutiyiintu ay oggolaanayaan in maraakiibta intooda badan ay maraan Badda Cas, balse ay jirto “hal dal oo aysan aad ugu faraxsaneyn”, isagoo sheegay in arrintaas la xallin doono. Hadallada Trump ayaa imanaya iyadoo kooxda Iran taageerto ay toddobaadkan horumar ballaaran ka sameysay galbeedka Yemen, kuna sii dhawaatay goobaha muhiimka u ah isu socodka maraakiibta ee Bab al-Mandab. Xuutiyiinta ayaa qabsaday deegaanno xeebeed iyo jasiirado istiraatiiji ah, taas oo u sahleysa inay khatar weyn ku noqdaan maraakiibta maraysa Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Marinkaas ayaa isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, wuxuuna muhiim u yahay ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo dhoofinta shidaalka Khaliijka. Sacuudiga oo dalbaday duqeymo Warbaahinta Axios ayaa Jimcihii sheegtay in Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudi Carabiya Mohammed bin Salman uu laba jeer telefoon kula hadlay Trump, isaga oo ka codsaday Mareykanka inuu duqeymo ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta ka fuliyo Yemen. Codsiga ayaa yimid xilli ciidamada Xuutiyiinta ay ku sii siqayeen koonfurta xeebaha Yemen, halka ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudigu taageero ay dib uga gurayeen qeybo ka mid ah aagga. Trump ayaa diiday codsiga duqeymaha tooska ah, inkasta oo Washington ay oggolaatay inay Riyadh siiso xog sirdoon iyo macluumaad ka caawin kara bartilmaameedsiga Xuutiyiinta, sida ay Axios sheegtay. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in mudnaanta Washington ay tahay ilaalinta isu socodka maraakiibta Badda Cas, balse aysan dooneyn inay furto furin dagaal oo cusub, iyadoo ciidamada Mareykanka ay sidoo kale ku mashquulsan yihiin xiisadda Iran iyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Trump ayaa Sabtidii sheegay inuu sidoo kale la hadlay Mohammed bin Salman, oo uu ku tilmaamay “saaxiib”, isaga oo muujiyay rajo ah in xaaladda la dejin karo. Beegsiga shidaalka Sacuudiga Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kaddib markii diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo laga soo riday gudaha Ciraaq ay weerareen dhuumaha shidaalka ee East-West Pipeline ee Sacuudi Carabiya. Dhuumahaas ayaa shidaalka ka qaada bariga Sacuudiga una gudbiya dekedda Yanbu ee Badda Cas, waxayna Riyadh siinayaan waddo kale oo ay shidaalka ku dhoofin karto iyadoo aan loo marin marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Sacuudiga ayaa si ku-meel-gaar ah u xiray dhuumaha kaddib weerarka, si loo qiimeeyo khasaaraha loona sameeyo dayactir. Baghdad ayaa sheegtay in baaritaan hordhac ah lagu ogaaday in weerarka laga soo qaaday gudaha Ciraaq, meel u dhow xadka Iran. Dowladda Ciraaq ayaa tallaabooyin amni qaaday, iyadoo xirtay qaar ka mid ah marinnada xadka Iran, isla markaana billowday baaritaan ku saabsan cidda ka dambeysay weerarka. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sheegtay inaysan hadda qaadi doonin tallaabo aargoosi ah, si dowladda Ciraaq loo siiyo fursad ay wax uga qabato weerarka. Trump, oo wax laga weydiiyay cidda ka dambeysay weerarka, ayaa sheegay inuu u maleynayo in Iran ay “u badan tahay” inay mas’uul ka ahayd, balse ma uusan soo bandhigin caddeyn taageereysa eedeyntaasi. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa toddobaadkan sidoo kale weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku qaaday bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla Sacuudi Carabiya, iyadoo weerar kale oo Sabtidii ka dhacay meel u dhow xadka Yemen uu dhaawacay laba qof. Horumarka degdegga ah ee Xuutiyiinta ee xeebaha Yemen iyo weerarrada lagu hayo kaabayaasha tamarta Sacuudiga ayaa sare u qaaday cabsi laga qabo in dagaalku saameyn weyn ku yeesho isu socodka maraakiibta iyo suuqyada tamarta caalamka. Bab al-Mandab iyo Hormuz ayaa labaduba ka mid ah marin-biyoodyada ugu muhiimsan ee shidaalka iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Sidaas darteed, awoodda kooxaha Iran taageerto ay ku carqaladeyn karaan marinnadaas ayaa cadaadis cusub saaraysa Sacuudi Carabiya iyo xulafadeeda, xilli Washington ay ilaa hadda isku dayeyso inay ka fogaato furitaanka dagaal toos ah oo kale oo ka dhaca gobolka. The post Trump oo shaaciyey arrin ay soo weydiisteen Xuutiyiinta xilli ay weerarayaan Sacuudiga appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya oo dib u soo xoogeysanaysa iyo walaac laga muujiyay saameynta ganacsiga caalamka
items.description: Burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale muujinaysa dhaqdhaqaaq sii kordhaya oo ka jira xeebaha waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iyadoo xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas ay sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo badqabka maraakiibta ganacsiga. Warbixin ay baahisay Xinhua , oo soo xiganaysa falanqeeyayaal iyo mas’uuliyiin, ayaa sheegtay in weerarro iyo afduubyo maraakiib ah oo dhacay tan iyo bishii Abriil ay dib u soo nooleeyeen walaaca laga qabo burcad-badeedda Soomaalida. Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Badaha (IMO) ayaa 24-kii Agoosto ka digay kororka falalka burcad-badeednimo, isagoo sheegay in in ka badan 90 shaqaale maraakiib ah ay weli gacanta ugu jiraan shabakadaha burcad-badeedda . Falanqeeyayaasha ayaa sababaha dib u soo laabashada burcad-badeedda ku xira arrimo ay ka mid yihiin saboolnimada, shaqo la’aanta, maamul-xumada xeebaha iyo kalluumeysiga sharci-darrada ah ee ay maraakiib shisheeye ka sameeyaan biyaha Soomaaliya. Mohamed Husein Gaas , oo ah agaasimaha Raad Peace Research Institute, ayaa sheegay in hoos u dhaca joogitaanka ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah ee Gacanka Cadmeed, kadib markii xoog badan loo weeciyay xiisadda Badda Cas, uu fursad cusub siiyay kooxaha burcad-badeedda. Gaas wuxuu sheegay in burcad-badeedda hore loo xakameeyay balse aan si dhab ah loo xallin sababihii salka u ahaa, isagoo tilmaamay in amni-darrada xeebaha, saboolnimada iyo dowladnimada daciifka ah ay weli yihiin caqabado waaweyn. Xiisadda ka taagan Yemen iyo weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale wax ka beddelay isu-socodka maraakiibta caalamiga ah, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah maraakiibta ay beddeleen waddooyinkii ay mari jireen. Si kastaba, Gaas wuxuu ka digay in aan loo qaadan xaqiiqo la xaqiijiyay sheegashada ah in kooxaha Xuutiyiinta iyo burcad-badeedda Soomaalida ay leeyihiin xiriir hawlgal oo toos ah. Dhaqdhaqaaqa burcad-badeedda iyo khataraha kale ee amniga badda ayaa sidoo kale walaac ka abuuraya ganacsiga Soomaaliya, oo si weyn ugu tiirsan badeecooyinka dibadda laga keeno. Cabdirisaaq Sabriye , oo ka tirsan Rugta Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliya, ayaa sheegay in shirkadda maraakiibta ee Maersk ay hakisay ballamihii cusub ee xamuulka ee u socday ama ka imaanayay dekedda Berbera, iyadoo shirkaddu sabab uga dhigtay arrimo la xiriira jadwalka iyo dib-u-habeynta waddooyinka maraakiibta ee gobolka. Go’aankaas si toos ah looguma xiriirin burcad-badeedda, balse wuxuu tusaale u yahay caqabadaha saameynaya isku-socodka ganacsiga Geeska Afrika. Ganacsatada ayaa ka digaya in haddii khataraha badda ay sii socdaan ay kordhi karaan qiimaha caymiska maraakiibta, kharashaadka xamuulka iyo shidaalka , taas oo ugu dambeyn saameyn ku yeelan karta qiimaha badeecooyinka gudaha Soomaaliya. Yusuf Mohamed Mahadale, oo ganacsatada Soomaaliya looga yaqaan Shakirow , ayaa sheegay in qiimaha qalabka dhismaha, shidaalka iyo gaaska wax lagu karsado uu sare u kacay bilihii u dambeeyay. Wuxuu tilmaamay in badeecooyin badan oo Soomaaliya laga isticmaalo ay kasoo gudbaan marin-biyoodka Badweynta Hindiya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay inay waddo howlgallo dhulka iyo badda ah oo lagu wajahayo kooxaha burcad-badeedda. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa soo hadal qaaday howlgal 29-kii Agoosto lagu xoreeyay markabka MV Lutuf , oo la sheegay in kooxo burcad-badeed ah ay afduubteen. Dowladdu waxay sidoo kale ku baaqday in ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah ay taageeraan dadaallada Soomaaliya, iyadoo arrinta burcad-badeedda loo gudbinayo Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Warbixintu waxay xustay in Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya uu dhowaan ansixiyay sharciyo la cusbooneysiiyay oo la xiriira la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda. Falanqeeyayaasha ayaa, si kastaba, qaba in howlgalada badda oo keliya aysan ku filnayn xal waara, waxayna ku baaqayaan in la xoojiyo maamulka iyo amniga xeebaha, lana abuuro fursado dhaqaale oo dadka ku nool deegaannada xeebaha ka fogeeya ku biirista burcad-badeedda. Haddii falalka burcad-badeeddu isu beddelaan khatar joogto ah oo nidaamsan, waxaa laga cabsi qabaa in shirkadaha maraakiibta ay mar kale ka fogaadaan Gacanka Cadmeed, taas oo sare u qaadi karta kharashaadka gaadiidka iyo qiimaha badeecooyinka, isla markaana saameyn ku yeelan karta ganacsiga Soomaaliya iyo isu-socodka ganacsiga caalamka.
items.fullContent: Burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale muujinaysa dhaqdhaqaaq sii kordhaya oo ka jira xeebaha waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iyadoo xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas ay sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo badqabka maraakiibta ganacsiga. Warbixin ay baahisay Xinhua , oo soo xiganaysa falanqeeyayaal iyo mas’uuliyiin, ayaa sheegtay in weerarro iyo afduubyo maraakiib ah oo dhacay tan iyo bishii Abriil ay dib u soo nooleeyeen walaaca laga qabo burcad-badeedda Soomaalida. Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Badaha (IMO) ayaa 24-kii Agoosto ka digay kororka falalka burcad-badeednimo, isagoo sheegay in in ka badan 90 shaqaale maraakiib ah ay weli gacanta ugu jiraan shabakadaha burcad-badeedda . Falanqeeyayaasha ayaa sababaha dib u soo laabashada burcad-badeedda ku xira arrimo ay ka mid yihiin saboolnimada, shaqo la’aanta, maamul-xumada xeebaha iyo kalluumeysiga sharci-darrada ah ee ay maraakiib shisheeye ka sameeyaan biyaha Soomaaliya. Mohamed Husein Gaas , oo ah agaasimaha Raad Peace Research Institute, ayaa sheegay in hoos u dhaca joogitaanka ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah ee Gacanka Cadmeed, kadib markii xoog badan loo weeciyay xiisadda Badda Cas, uu fursad cusub siiyay kooxaha burcad-badeedda. Go’aankaas si toos ah looguma xiriirin burcad-badeedda, balse wuxuu tusaale u yahay caqabadaha saameynaya isku-socodka ganacsiga Geeska Afrika. items.title: Cumaan oo sheegtay in dib loo furi doono Marin-biyoodka Hormuz
items.description: Dowladda Cumaan ayaa sheegtay in Marin-biyoodka Hormuz dib loo furi doono, iyadoo xaaladda ka taagan marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ku tilmaantay mid u badan inay noqon doonto mid muddo kooban socota. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli ay gobolka ka jiraan xiisado siyaasadeed iyo amni oo saameyn ku yeeshay isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo gaadiidka badda ee mara Hormuz. Marin-biyoodka Hormuz ayaa ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan dhoofinta saliidda iyo gaaska ee ka baxa dalalka Khaliijka. Carqalad ku timaadda isu-socodka halkaas waxay saameyn ku yeelan kartaa silsiladaha sahayda iyo suuqyada tamarta ee caalamka. Cumaan, oo ku taalla dhinaca koonfureed ee marin-biyoodka, ayaa muddo dheer door ku lahayd dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu dejinayo xiisadaha gobolka. Inkasta oo Muscat ay sheegtay in xaaladdu tahay mid ku-meel-gaar ah, haddana weli waxaa jira walaac ku saabsan amniga maraakiibta iyo sii socoshada gaadiidka ganacsi ee mara marin-biyoodka, iyadoo shirkadaha maraakiibta iyo ganacsatada caalamiga ah ay si dhow ula socdaan xaaladda. Marin-biyoodka Hormuz wuxuu isku xiraa Gacanka Carabta iyo Gacanka Cumaan, waxaana loo arkaa mid ka mid ah marinnada badeed ee ugu muhiimsan dunida.

items.title: Ururka JSP oo si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay in Cali Guudlaawe uu yahay Murasharaxooda Hoggaanka Hirshabeelle
items.description: Urur Siyaasadeedka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ku qabtay kulan siyaasadeed oo lagu shaaciyay musharraxa uu ururku sheegay inuu u meteli doono tartanka doorashada hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabeelle. Kulanka oo ay ka qaybgaleen masuuliyiin iyo xubno ka tirsan JSP ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo diyaar-garowga doorashooyinka la filayo inay ka dhacaan Hirshabeelle. Munaasabadda ayaa si rasmi ah loogu guddoonsiiyay Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen ” Cali Guudlaawe” shahaadada musharraxnimada, iyadoo hoggaanka ururku uu sheegay inuu yahay qofka ay u xuleen inuu magaca JSP ku galo tartanka hoggaanka maamulka. Masuuliyiin ka hadlay kulanka ayaa soo sheegay in Cali Guudlaawe ay u arkaan qofka ugu habboon ee  waayo-aragnimada iyo kartida siyaasadeed u leh xilkaas, iyagoo sidoo kale xusay baahida loo qabo in la sii wado dadaallada la xiriira horumarinta Hirshabeelle. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, magacaabista musharraxa JSP waxay ku soo beegmaysaa xilli ay Soomaaliya ka socoto dhaqdhaqaaqyo siyaasadeed oo la xiriira doorashooyinka dowlad-goboleedyada iyo tartamada hoggaamineed ee soo socda. JSP ayaa tallaabadan ku tilmaamtay qayb ka mid ah diyaar-garowgooda siyaasadeed, iyadoo musharraxa la magacaabay uu hadda wajihi doono marxaladaha kale ee tartanka hoggaanka Hirshabeelle. Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen ” Guudlaawe” ayaa muddo 6 sano ah hoggaanka u hayay dowladda goboleedka Hirshabeelle, ayadoo muddadaas loo diiwaangeliyay waxqabadka iyo dhaliilo isku lammaan.

items.title: Falcelin aan caadi ahayn oo ka dhalatay kaarka xisbiga JSP ee la siiyay Cali Guudlaawe
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Fal-celin xooggan ayaa ka dhalatay in mar kale Cali Guudlaawe Xuseen isku sharraxo xilka Madaxweynaha HirShabelle, kadib markii shalay la siiyay kaarka musharraxnimada ee Xisbiga Cadaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Go’aankan ayaa yimid, kadib markii shalay xarunta dhexe Xisbiga JSP uu ku qabsoomay kulanka guddiga fulinta, kaas oo uu shir guddoomiyay xoghayaha guud ee xisbiga Dr. Xuseen Sheekh Maxamuud. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray u diyaar-garowga doorashada soo socota ee Dowlad Goboleedka HirShabelle, waxaana guddiga fulinta uu go’aamiyay in Madaxweyne Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen uu noqdo musharraxa rasmiga ah ee xisbiga ku metalaya doorashada HirShabelle. “Guddiga fulintu waxa uu si aqlabiyad leh ugu go’aamiyay in Mudane Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen uu noqdo musharraxa rasmiga ah ee Urur Siyaasadeedka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ugu taagnaan doono doorashada hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka HirShabelle,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wdaajirka (JSP) ee uu hoggaamiyo Xasan Sheekh. Go’aankan oo aad loo hadal-hayay, lana filayay ayaa xiisad horleh ka abuuray HirShabelle, iyada oo ay ka hor yimaadeen siyaasiyiinta reer Hiiraan oo markii horeba tabasho ka qabay dhismaha Maamul-goboleedka HirShabelle. Haddaba sidee looga fal-celiyay kaarka JSP ee la siiyay Cali Guudlaawe? Maxamed Maxamuud: “Xalka iyo dowlad dhiska maamulka HirShabelle sidaas kuma haboona ee waxay ahayd in diidmada reer Hiiraan la dhagaysto”. Abuukar Cabdullahi Gaandi: “Mudane madaxweyne soo dhawoow mar kale”. Cabdirisaaq Mustaq: “Waxaan doorasho ma ahan ee waa xulusho, adi leee dubo oo daangayso waayey”. Maxamuud Nuur Safiirka: “Dowladnimadii ma saas ayaa lo galay?”. Liibaan Cali Nuur: “Wey isku soo dhammaatay Guudlawe vote ugu shuba shacabkii HirShabelle guul weyn”. The post Falcelin aan caadi ahayn oo ka dhalatay kaarka xisbiga JSP ee la siiyay Cali Guudlaawe appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Haraad iyo gaajo ka dhashay guridda ilo ay biyaha ka heli jireen qoysas ku nool Bari
items.description: (ERGO) –  Oon daran ayay wajahayaan kummannaan dad ah oo ku nool deegaanka Tasjiic ee gobolka Bari iyo lix tuulo oo hoos yimaada tan iyo billowgii August, markii ay ka qallashy il-biyood dabiici ah oo ay bilaash ku cabbi jireen muddo dheer. Waxay iibsan la’yihiin biyo ay booyado $150 uga keenaan magaalada Waaciye oo qiyaastii 40 KM u jirta. Waxaa fuustadii la gadaa $6-$8 oo aysan awoodin. Arintan ayaa culays ku noqotay dadkan oo xoolo dhaqato roob la’aantu saamaysay iyo danyar u badan. Saytuun Mahad Maxamed ayaa sheegtay in qoyskeeda oo 10 qof ah ay ku tiirsan yihiin 20 liitar oo marmar darisku siiyaan. Waxay xustay in ay u adkaysan la’ yihiin xaaladan. “Biyuhu si xun ayay noo saameeyeen cabitaanka waa dhib, qubays iyo dhar dhaqidna ma jirto. Carruurta meel hoos ah ayaa lagu aruuriyaa oo qorraxda ayaa looga celiyaa. Dhibaato ayaan la kulanay.” “Abaar ayaa na haysa. Dadka biyo yar dhaansada ayaan ka barinaa hal caag oo nafta lagu celiyo.” Saytuun ayaa xustay in biyo yaraanta ay u dheertahay cunno xumo. Odaygeeda oo ka shaqayn jiray xijiga ayaa lixdii bil ee u danbaysay shaqo la’aan ah. Waxaa saameeyay go’aan ay Puntland ku amartay in laga baxo buuraha Calmiskaad oo howlgal Daacish ka dhan ah uu ka socdo. Ujeedku wuxuu ahaa in shacabku ka badbaadaan waxyeelada duqaymaha, balse waxaa meesha ka baxday fursadii gurashada xijiga oo dad badan ay ku tiirsanaayeen. Tuulada ayay joogto uga raadiyaan shaqooyin xoogsi ah oo aysan ka helin. Waxay sheegtay inay qatooyo ku joogaan carruurteeda oo kan ugu yar 3 jir yahay. Waxay xustay inay caatoobeen gaajaduna diif ku reebtay. “Dhaqaale darraa jirta. Heerkii aan saddex waqti ama labo wax karsan jirnay waa ka nimid, sababtoo ah waan gacan marannahay. Waxaan gaarnay in aan dadka ka tuugsanno wax aan hal mar cunno. Nolol aad u liidata ayaaan dareemaynaa xilligaan.” Saytuun oo 48 sano jir ah ayaa sheegtay inaysan xaaladaan oo kale horay ula kulmin. Waxaa qoyskeeda labadii sano ee u danbaysay isku raacay colaadda Calmiskaad, abaar xoolihii dhaafisay, barakac, cuno xumo, biyo yari iyo shaqo la’aan. Ari 95 ah oo ay dhaqanayeen waxay intii badnayd u le’deen biyo, daaq la’aan iyo cuduro aysan garayn oo isku raacay. Waxaa u joogta 10 neef oo aan wax nacfi ah lahayn, kuwaas oo aysan u awoodin calaf iyo biyo ay ku sii noolaadaan. Waxay tilmaamay in dukaamo ay daymo ka qaadan jireen ay ka joojiyeen bartamihii bishii sideedaad. Lacagta lagu yeeshay oo gaartay in ka badan $3,000 ayay waydiimo joogto ah kala kulmaysaa, wax kalena looma ogola. “Waxaan ku daymoobay biyaha iyo raashinka, kurbo weyn ayayna igu haysaa. Awood uma lihi in aan bixiyo waayo dhaqaale ma haysto. Xoolihii iyo xijjigii aan ku tiirsanayn midna ma hayno.” Saytuun ayaa sheegtay in labo qol oo sanad ka hor ay ku caawiyeen qoys ehelkeeda ah loo qabtay inay ka guuraan dhamaadka September. ma awoodaan kirada guryaha deegaanka oo labada qol ay $50 tahay. Saddex carruur ah oo u dhiganayay iskuul hoose iyo dugsi Qur’aan ayaa ka waxbarasho la’ tan iyo bishii June, markii ay bixin wayday isku darka $45 oo laga qaadi jiray. Qoyskeeda waxay 2025 uga soo guureen buuraha Calmiskaad dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxda Daacish. Dhanka kale Muumino Shire Nuur oo ka mid ah dadka ay dhibaatadaan saamaysay ayaa sheegtay inay ku adkaatay helitaanka biyo joogta ah tan iyo horraantii bishii August, markaas oo ishii dadka deegaanku ka cabbayeen ay engegtay. Dhowr liitar oo ay ka hesho dariskeeda ayay beeqaamisaa, maaddaama qoyskeedu ballaaran yahay. “Oon ayaa ka jira, hal labaatan qaad ayaan u qaybinaa cabitaan iyo cunno hal mar ah mana kala gaarayo. Daruuftaa noogu daran ee aanan ku sii noolaan karin waa taas. Ishii aan cabbi jirnay, markii roob la waayay waa gurtay.” Muumino ayaa sheegtay inay ka burburtay meherad ay ku iibin jirtay shaah, bur duban iyo bagaash oo ay nolol-maalmeedka uga soo saari jirtay sagaal carruur agoon ah oo keligeed ay korinayso. items.title: Towfiiq Exclusion Raises Fears of New Political Confrontation in Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (WDN) — Galmudug’s repeat election is facing a serious political test after the Towfiiq Political Association, led by Sheikh Shakir Sheikh Mohamed, was excluded from the list of political organizations approved to participate in the vote scheduled for September 30. The decision is particularly significant because Towfiiq was a major participant in the previous election, winning 12 parliamentary seats before the results were annulled following a legal challenge that reached Somalia’s Supreme Court. Its exclusion from the rerun immediately raises a difficult question: why is a party that played such a significant role in the original election now absent from the process intended to replace it? The National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission has not publicly provided a detailed explanation for the decision. Towfiiq is not a marginal political organization in Galmudug. It has established a significant political presence, particularly in Dhuusamareeb and Guriceel, where the party and its leadership have maintained substantial political and community support. Its previous electoral performance demonstrated that this support could translate into parliamentary representation. Sheekh Shaakir That makes its exclusion more consequential than a routine administrative decision. It could remove a substantial bloc of voters from the competition while giving rival organizations an opportunity to compete for seats and support that Towfiiq previously contested. The result could significantly alter the political balance of the rerun before a single ballot is cast. From Court Challenge to Electoral Exclusion Towfiiq was among the political organizations that challenged the previous election, ultimately taking its case to the Supreme Court. The court’s annulment of the results created the need for a new electoral process. A rerun is normally expected to address the problems that undermined the original vote and restore confidence among competing political actors. Instead, Towfiiq now finds itself excluded from the very process intended to replace the election it helped challenge. If the party is legally ineligible, the commission should explain the legal basis for that decision. If it is eligible, excluding it raises questions about whether the rerun is correcting the previous process or changing the political field. The commission therefore faces a straightforward credibility test. It should explain the eligibility criteria applied to Towfiiq, identify the specific grounds for its exclusion and clarify whether the same standards were applied consistently to all political organizations. If the decision resulted from an administrative or procedural problem, there should be an opportunity to correct it before voting. If it is based on a statutory requirement, Towfiiq should have access to whatever appeal mechanism the law provides. This matters because the previous election was already annulled through judicial proceedings. The credibility of the rerun will consequently depend not simply on holding another vote, but on demonstrating that the new process genuinely addresses the weaknesses that caused the original election to fail. The central question is whether Towfiiq has been excluded for a clear and lawful reason—or whether the decision is effectively reshaping the field of competition. The Risk of Political Escalation The political consequences could extend well beyond the electoral commission. Towfiiq’s supporters are unlikely to regard the deliberate sidelining of a major political organization as a minor administrative matter. The party has a substantial constituency, a history of electoral participation and a direct connection to the legal dispute that resulted in the previous election being annulled. If its supporters conclude that meaningful political participation has been closed to them, the dispute could move beyond electoral procedures into protests, institutional confrontation and, if tensions are badly managed, armed mobilization. That outcome is not inevitable. But Somalia’s political history offers repeated warnings about what can happen when significant constituencies lose confidence in peaceful political mechanisms. The greatest danger would be allowing an electoral dispute to become a broader struggle over political legitimacy. Galmudug’s September 30 election was supposed to resolve an earlier political and legal crisis. The exclusion of Towfiiq risks creating another before voting even begins. The authorities still have an opportunity to prevent that outcome by providing a clear legal explanation and allowing a transparent review or appeal process. If Towfiiq is legally ineligible, the commission must explain why. If it is eligible, it should be allowed to compete. For Galmudug, the stakes extend beyond one party or one election. The immediate challenge is to ensure that political competition remains within the electoral system rather than allowing the exclusion of a major constituency to push the crisis into a far more dangerous arena.
