items.title: Turkey’s Somalia Narrative: Partnership or a Lecture to a Country on Its Knees?
items.description: By Abdiqani Haji Abdi The Turkish ambassador’s recent remarks about Somalia’s future were presumably intended to inspire optimism. Instead, they risk sounding remarkably disconnected from the realities facing the Somali people. The ambassador speaks of satellites, oil discoveries, Turkish fishing fleets, mining, agriculture, roads and ambitious infrastructure projects—as though Somalia were already a stable country preparing to enter an era of technological and economic transformation. There is, however, another Somalia. It is a country where state institutions remain fragile, where international assistance continues to play a major role in financing government functions, where foreign military forces remain essential to national security, where political authority is fiercely contested and where basic questions of governance and public accountability remain unresolved. Somalis are being told that the country will launch its first satellite into space in 2027. A satellite would undoubtedly be an achievement. But the question is not whether Somalia should aspire to space technology. The question is whether the priorities being presented to the public correspond to the country’s most urgent needs. Can the government secure its territory? Can it protect its citizens? Can it pay its civil servants and security personnel? Can it build a professional national army capable of eventually standing on its own? Can it secure its coastline, manage its natural resources and conduct elections that are broadly accepted as credible? These are the foundations of statehood. Without them, technological ambition risks becoming a spectacular symbol built on an unstable political and institutional foundation. The same problem applies to the ambassador’s optimism about Somalia’s oil and gas potential. Exploration is not production. Geological surveys are not producing oil fields. And a potential resource is not yet national wealth. Somalis have heard promises about the country’s natural resources for decades. What they need now is not another prediction of future prosperity, but transparency about the agreements that could determine who ultimately benefits from it. Who owns the resources? Who holds the licenses? What percentage of revenues will remain in Somalia? Who controls the contracts? What protections exist for the environment? What mechanisms will prevent politically connected interests or foreign companies from capturing a disproportionate share of the country’s wealth? Those are not hostile questions. They are the questions any sovereign country should ask before committing its natural resources to long-term foreign partnerships. The same principle applies to fisheries. Somalia possesses one of Africa’s longest coastlines and potentially enormous marine resources. Developing the country’s blue economy could create jobs, generate revenue and transform coastal communities. But the arrival of Turkish fishing vessels should not automatically be presented as development. Somalia’s marine resources belong to Somalia. Any foreign fishing operation should therefore operate under transparent licenses, clear fees, effective monitoring and enforceable environmental rules. Somali fishermen should know where foreign vessels are permitted to operate, how much they pay, who monitors their catches and what portion of the resulting economic value remains in Somalia. Otherwise, the language of partnership can easily conceal an unequal commercial relationship in which Somalia supplies the resources while foreign companies capture most of the value. There is an even more sensitive dimension to the relationship: military cooperation. Turkey has become one of Somalia’s most important security partners, providing training, equipment and weapons to Somali forces. Such assistance can play a legitimate role in the fight against Al-Shabaab and in strengthening Somalia’s national security institutions. But Somalia’s political crisis has increasingly blurred the boundary between national security and domestic political confrontation. When foreign-trained or foreign-equipped security forces become involved in disputes involving political opponents or Federal Member States, questions naturally arise over how foreign-supplied military capabilities are being used. Weapons supplied to defend Somalia should never become instruments for settling Somalia’s political disputes. Turkey therefore has a legitimate interest in ensuring that its military assistance is subject to strict safeguards, clear end-use controls and accountability. The same principle should apply to every foreign partner providing security assistance to Somalia. At the heart of the problem is the imbalance between the two countries. Turkey is a powerful regional state with a sophisticated military, substantial economic resources and growing influence across Africa and the Middle East. Somalia remains one of the world’s most institutionally fragile countries. That imbalance does not automatically make the relationship exploitative. But it means Somalia must negotiate with extraordinary caution. A genuine strategic partnership should strengthen Somali sovereignty and capacity. It should leave Somalia with stronger institutions, greater technical knowledge, better infrastructure and a larger share of the economic value created by its own resources. It should not leave Somalia dependent on a foreign power for security while that same partner gains expanding access to strategic infrastructure, fishing grounds, natural resources and other commercial opportunities. This is why the ambassador’s rhetoric about Somalia’s bright future needs to be accompanied by something far more concrete: details. Where are the satellite agreements? Who owns the infrastructure? Who finances it? Who controls the data and technology? What are the terms of the oil exploration agreements? What are the fishing licenses? How much will Turkish companies pay? Who will enforce the rules? What protections will Somali businesses and fishermen receive? And what safeguards govern Turkish military assistance? Somalis are entitled to ask these questions. Indeed, they have a responsibility to ask them. A country emerging from decades of state collapse cannot afford to build foreign partnerships around speeches, friendship and promises alone. It needs contracts that can be examined, institutions capable of enforcing them, parliamentary oversight, public disclosure and independent auditing. The problem with presenting spectacular future projects to a population struggling with basic state failures is not that the projects are inherently undesirable. It is that grand promises can distract from the much harder work of building the foundations required to make those promises meaningful. A satellite will not build a functioning state. Oil will not automatically create prosperity. Foreign fishing fleets will not automatically strengthen Somali coastal communities. Weapons will not automatically produce security. Roads and infrastructure will not automatically create accountable government. Institutions do Somalia needs a professional civil service, accountable security forces, credible elections, independent courts, transparent management of natural resources and public finances, and a government capable of negotiating with foreign partners from a position of institutional strength. Turkey has every right to pursue its interests in Somalia. Somalia has exactly the same right to pursue its own. That is what a genuine partnership means. If Turkey helps Somalia build a satellite program, Somalia should gain technology and expertise—not merely host the launch facility. If Turkey invests in fisheries, Somali fishermen should become more prosperous, not displaced. If Turkey participates in oil exploration, Somalia should receive a transparent and fair share of the resulting wealth. If Turkey supplies weapons, those weapons should strengthen national security rather than become associated with domestic political confrontation. And if Turkey builds infrastructure, the agreements and ownership structures should be clear to the Somali public. The ambassador may be right that Somalia possesses enormous potential. It does. But potential is not development. Development requires institutions capable of turning national resources into national wealth and foreign partnerships into genuine national capacity. Until those foundations are strengthened, Somalis should welcome investment while questioning the terms behind it. They do not need another foreign power telling them how bright their future will be. They need to know exactly what Somalia is giving away today—and what Somalia will actually receive in return. That is not hostility toward Turkey. It is what sovereignty looks like. What mechanisms will prevent politically connected interests or foreign companies from capturing a disproportionate share of the country’s wealth? Those are not hostile questions. They are the questions any sovereign country should ask before committing its natural resources to long-term foreign partnerships. The same principle applies to fisheries. Somalia possesses one of Africa’s longest coastlines and potentially enormous marine resources. Developing the country’s blue economy could create jobs, generate revenue and transform coastal communities. But the arrival of Turkish fishing vessels should not automatically be presented as development. Somalia’s marine resources belong to Somalia. Any foreign fishing operation should therefore operate under transparent licenses, clear fees, effective monitoring and enforceable environmental rules. Somali fishermen should know where foreign vessels are permitted to operate, how much they pay, who monitors their catches and what portion of the resulting economic value remains in Somalia. Otherwise, the language of partnership can easily conceal an unequal commercial relationship in which Somalia supplies the resources while foreign companies capture most of the value. There is an even more sensitive dimension to the relationship: military cooperation. Turkey has become one of Somalia’s most important security partners, providing training, equipment and weapons to Somali forces. Such assistance can play a legitimate role in the fight against Al-Shabaab and in strengthening Somalia’s national security institutions. But Somalia’s political crisis has increasingly blurred the boundary between national security and domestic political confrontation. When foreign-trained or foreign-equipped security forces become involved in disputes involving political opponents or Federal Member States, questions naturally arise over how foreign-supplied military capabilities are being used. Weapons supplied to defend Somalia should never become instruments for settling Somalia’s political disputes. Turkey therefore has a legitimate interest in ensuring that its military assistance is subject to strict safeguards, clear end-use controls and accountability. The same principle should apply to every foreign partner providing security assistance to Somalia. At the heart of the problem is the imbalance between the two countries. Turkey is a powerful regional state with a sophisticated military, substantial economic resources and growing influence across Africa and the Middle East. Somalia remains one of the world’s most institutionally fragile countries. That imbalance does not automatically make the relationship exploitative. But it means Somalia must negotiate with extraordinary caution. A genuine strategic partnership should strengthen Somali sovereignty and capacity. It should leave Somalia with stronger institutions, greater technical knowledge, better infrastructure and a larger share of the economic value created by its own resources. It should not leave Somalia dependent on a foreign power for security while that same partner gains expanding access to strategic infrastructure, fishing grounds, natural resources and other commercial opportunities. This is why the ambassador’s rhetoric about Somalia’s bright future needs to be accompanied by something far more concrete: details. Where are the satellite agreements? Who owns the infrastructure? Who finances it? Who controls the data and technology? What are the terms of the oil exploration agreements? What are the fishing licenses? How much will Turkish companies pay? Who will enforce the rules? What protections will Somali businesses and fishermen receive? And what safeguards govern Turkish military assistance? Somalis are entitled to ask these questions. Indeed, they have a responsibility to ask them. A country emerging from decades of state collapse cannot afford to build foreign partnerships around speeches, friendship and promises alone. It needs contracts that can be examined, institutions capable of enforcing them, parliamentary oversight, public disclosure and independent auditing. The problem with presenting spectacular future projects to a population struggling with basic state failures is not that the projects are inherently undesirable. It is that grand promises can distract from the much harder work of building the foundations required to make those promises meaningful. A satellite will not build a functioning state. Oil will not automatically create prosperity. Foreign fishing fleets will not automatically strengthen Somali coastal communities. Weapons will not automatically produce security. Roads and infrastructure will not automatically create accountable government. Institutions do Somalia needs a professional civil service, accountable security forces, credible elections, independent courts, transparent management of natural resources and public finances, and a government capable of negotiating with foreign partners from a position of institutional strength. Turkey has every right to pursue its interests in Somalia. Somalia has exactly the same right to pursue its own. That is what a genuine partnership means. If Turkey helps Somalia build a satellite program, Somalia should gain technology and expertise—not merely host the launch facility. If Turkey invests in fisheries, Somali fishermen should become more prosperous, not displaced. If Turkey participates in oil exploration, Somalia should receive a transparent and fair share of the resulting wealth. If Turkey supplies weapons, those weapons should strengthen national security rather than become associated with domestic political confrontation. And if Turkey builds infrastructure, the agreements and ownership structures should be clear to the Somali public. The ambassador may be right that Somalia possesses enormous potential. It does. But potential is not development. Development requires institutions capable of turning national resources into national wealth and foreign partnerships into genuine national capacity. Until those foundations are strengthened, Somalis should welcome investment while questioning the terms behind it. They do not need another foreign power telling them how bright their future will be. They need to know exactly what Somalia is giving away today—and what Somalia will actually receive in return. That is not hostility toward Turkey. It is what sovereignty looks like. items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo dadaal ugu jira in la adkeeyo amniga Baydhabo
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar oo weli ku sugan Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa magaaladaasi u jooga xoojinta amniga iyo isku xirka Ciidamada Qalabka Sida. Taliyaha ayaa magaalada kaga qaybgelaya kulamo looga hadlayo amniga iyo sidii Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ay u qaadi lahaayeen hawlgal wadajir ah, oo daafaha magaalada looga fogeynayo ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa dhowr jeer oo hore sheegay in ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen ay ku kulmeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, eedeymahaas oo mucaaradka uu Laftagareen hoggaamiyo ay beeniyeen. Hawlgalka wadajirka ah ee la qorsheynayo ayaa ah mid la isku-dubaridayo cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Daraawiishta iyo Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed, si loo adkeeyo amniga Baydhabo, loona sugo deegaanada ku teedsan. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo Sabtidii gaaray Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa geeyay agab ciidan oo loogu talagalay ciidamada. Taliyaha ayaa Axaddii shalay kormeeray ciidamada isku dhafka ah ee fariisimaha iyo difaaca ku leh afaafka hore ee magaalada. General Sahal Cabdullaahi iyo Saraakiisha kale ayaa diiradda saaraya in laga hortago weerarada laga soo abaabulo bannaanada magaalada ee ay ku lugta leeyihiin taageereyaasha Laftagareen.

items.title: Muqdisho oo si rasmi ah looga furay Shirweynaha Qaran ee Adeegyada Cimilada Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho, Sebteembar 13, 2026 – Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa maanta si rasmi ah looga furay Shirweynaha Qaran ee Adeegyada Cimilada Soomaaliya (NCOF OND 2026), kaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo saadaasha cimilada iyo xogaha la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada. Shirweynahan ayaa ujeedkiisu yahay in la xoojiyo adeegsiga xogta cimilada, kor loogu qaado diyaar-garowga bulshada iyo hay’adaha dowladda, isla markaana go’aan qaadashada lagu saleeyo xog iyo saadaal cimiladeed oo sax ah. Munaasabadda furitaanka waxaa ka qeyb galay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda, khubaro ku takhasustay arrimaha cimilada, hay’ado iyo daneeyayaal kala duwan oo ka shaqeeya saadaasha hawada iyo la tacaalidda saameynta isbeddelka cimilada. Shirweynaha ayaa la filayaa inuu door muhiim ah ka qaato xoojinta iskaashiga hay’adaha kala duwan iyo horumarinta adeegyada saadaasha cimilada, xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahaysay saameyn xooggan oo ka dhalatay isbeddelka cimilada, oo ay ka mid yihiin abaaro iyo xaalado cimilo oo isbeddelaya.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo abaalmariyay Wasaaradaha ugu waxqabadka sarreeya dalka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa ka qaybgalay munaasabadda xiritaanka bandhigga sannadlaha ah ee la-xisaabtanka Wasaaradaha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Munaasabadda ayaa lagu soo bandhigay natiijooyinka waxqabadka Wasaaradaha, heerka ay ka gaareen fulinta qorshayaashii loo dejiyay, bartilmaameedyadii loo asteeyay iyo waajibaadyadii ay gudanayeen sannadka 2026. Madaxweynaha ayaa billado guddoonsiiyay Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, kuwaas oo kaalmaha ugu sarreeya ka galay qiimeyntii waxqabadka Wasaaradaha ee sannadkan. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ku abaalmariyay hirgelinta hannaanka danabaysan ee lagu la socdo laguna qiimeeyo waxqabadka Wasaaradaha dowladda. Madaxweynaha ayaa bogaadiyay dadaalka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan hirgelinta qorshayaasha dowladda iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, isaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay la-xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowladda, hufnaanta shaqada iyo qiimeynta joogtada ah ee natiijooyinka waxqabadka. Ugu dambeyn, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Wasiirrada iyo hay’adaha dowladda ku booriyay in guulaha iyo natiijooyinka la gaaray ay noqdaan saldhig lagu sii xoojinayo waxqabadka, isla markaana la saxo meelaha ay ka jiraan gaabisyada u baahan dardargelinta. Wuxuu xusay in qorshayaasha dowladda ay muhiim tahay inay si muuqata uga tarjumaan baahiyaha iyo danta shacabka Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Warbixin laga qoray qaar ka mid ah caruurtii Siyaad Bare
items.description: Wargeyska caanka ah ee Mareykanka New York Post ayaa baahiyay warbixin baaritaan ah oo xasaasi ah, taas oo lagu soo bandhigay halka ay maanta ku nool yihiin iyo waxa ay shaqadoodu tahay qaar ka mid ah carruurtii Madaxweynihii hore ee Dowladii dhexe ee Soomaaliya, Janaraal Maxamed Siyaad Barre. Warbixinta ayaa si gaar ah diiradda u saartay Ayaanle Maxamed Siyaad Barre iyo walaashiis Deeqo Maxamed Siyaad Barre, iyadoo sheegtay in labadooduba ay si deggan ugu nool yihiin agagaarka magaaladda Columbus ee Gobolka Ohio, oo ka mid ah meelaha ay ku badan yihiin Soomaalida ku nool Mareykanka. AYAANLE: “GACANTII MIDIG” EE AABBIHIIS Sida lagu sheegay baaritaanka New York Post, Ayaanle Maxamed Siyaad Barre ayaa xilligii ugu dambeeyay ee Dowladdii dhexe ee aabbihiis maamulayay lagu tilmaamay inuu ahaa qof door weyn ku lahaa maamulka Madaxtooyadda iyo arrimaha Amniga Qaranka Soomaaliya Warbixintu waxay Ayaanle ku tilmaantay inuu ahaa mid ka mid ah dadka ugu dhow Janaraal Maxamed Siyaad Barre, gaar ahaan sanadihii ugu dambeeyay ee Dowladdii Kacaanka ka hor inta aysan burburin Dowladdii dhexe sanadkii 1991. New York Post ayaa sheegtay in Ayaanle iyo Deeqo ay hadda ku nool yihiin agagaarka Magaaladda Columbus, iyadoo Ayaanle lagu sheegay inuu ku nool yahay guri caadi ah oo ku yaalla xaafadaha ka baxsan bartamaha magaaladda.Columbus Columbus ayaa sidoo kale hoy u ah jaaliyad Soomaaliyeed oo ballaaran, waxaana magaaladda iyo nawaaxigeeda ku nool Soomaali badan oo dalka u yimid sababo ay ka mid yihiin dagaalladii iyo qalalaasihii siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya ka dhacay kadib burburkii Dowladdii dhexe. $1.8 MILYAN OO MEDICARE AH Qodob kale oo xasaasi ah oo uu New York Post soo bandhigay ayaa la xiriira dhinaca Ganacsiga. Wargeysku wuxuu sheegay in xubno qoyska ka tirsan ama dad lala xiriiriyay qoyska ay ku lug leeyihiin shirkado bixiya adeegyada daryeelka caafimaadka ee guryaha (home-health), iyadoo mid ka mid ah shirkadahaas lagu sheegay inay heshay lacag dhan ku dhowaad $1.8 Milyan oo Dollar oo ka timid barnaamijka Dowladda Mareykanka ee Medicare. Warbixintu New York Post ayaa waxay sidoo kale xustay ganacsi la xiriira adeegyada turjumaadda iyo urur samafal oo magac qoyska Maxamed Siyaad Barre lala xiriiriyay Joogitaanka xubno ka mid ah qoyska Siyaad Barre ee Columbus ayaa, sida New York Post sheegtay, dib u soo celiyay xusuuso culus oo ku saabsan taariikhda Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dadka Soomaaliyeed ee dalka uga qaxay colaadaha iyo tacaddiyada loo aaneynayo inay gaysatay Dowladdii militariga ee Soomaaliya Wargeysku wuxuu soo xigtay xubno ka mid ah jaaliyadda Soomaaliyeed oo ka hadlay xusuusta qoysaskooda iyo dadkii ay waayeen xilligii dowladdii Kacaanka. Mid ka mid ah dadka la wareystay ayaa New York Post u sheegay inuu aad uga xumaaday markii uu arkay wiilka Siyaad Barre oo si xor ah ugu nool magaaladda waliba ku tukanaya Masaajida, isaga oo xusay inuu qoyskiisa ku waayay dhacdooyin uu ku eedeeyay Ciidamadii Dowladdii hore. Waxaa sidoo kale jira baaqyo ka imanaya qaar ka mid ah dadka Soomaaliyeed ee sheegaya inay dhibbanayaal u yihiin xukunkii hore, kuwaas oo doonaya in hay’adaha Mareykanka ay si dheeraad ah u eegaan xiriirrada ganacsi iyo dhaqaale ee dadka ay warbixintu xustay. Fiiro gaar ah: Qodobada kor ku xusan ee la daabacay waxay ku saleysan yihiin oo kaliya warbixinta New York Post iyo xogta lagu soo bandhigay baaritaankeeda, eedeymaha la xiriira dambiyada, Ganacsiyada ama lacagaha Dowladda lagama dhigan karo xaqiiqo qof gaar ah lagu xukumo ilaa ay helaan caddeyn madax-bannaan ama go’aan Maxkamadeed oo rasmi ah.   Codka Bulshada

items.title: To Those People Who Ignorantly Blame S/land Gov’t For Not Doing Anything About Dollar Increase And Higher Commoduty Prices
items.description: Beginning from 19th century, two measurements have been used to get a sense of how well developed countries are doing. One is gross domestic product, the monetary value of all finished goods and services made within a country during a specific period. The other measurement is a country’s unemployment rate. But when it comes to figuring out how well an underdeveloped country like Somaliland is doing and serving its citizens, the above measurements are not taken into consideration. There are other factors that are taken into account when assessing how well a third world country such as Somaliland is progressing and providing services to its people. There is nothing more common to measure economic strength and social progress of an underdeveloped country than self-sufficiency or self-reliance. First, self-sufficiency is having the ability and resources to take care of yourself without outside help. In other words, it is a country’s ability to meet the basic needs of its people, such as basic food and clothing, and/or a country’s ability to identify unmet needs and implement proper use of resources. One good example of self-sufficiency is growing your own food and making your own clothing. Secondly, self-reliance is the ability to depend on yourself to meet your own requirements. The capacity to rely on one’s own capabilities, and to manage one’s own affairs independetly. The concept of self-sufficiency is basically taken to mean the extent to which a country can satisfy its needs from its own domestic production. The difference between self sufficiency and self-reliance is that self-sufficiency relates to the fulfilment of a nation’s basic needs and proper use of its resources, while self reliance refers to control over decision making, which is the reliance on one’s own judgment, abilities, actions etc. Of all the needs that come under self-sufficiency concept, there are two elements for humans to survive. The first one is food, the second is water. Without food and water, human beings cannot live, but without other services humans can survive. How often does insufficiency of food and water supply come into Somaliland’s concern and consideration? Do Somaliland people hold any view of the extent to which their country can satisfy its food needs from its own domestic production, if global food scarcity or shortage will happen? A nation which fails to address its basic needs, encourage itself to improve its learning skills, arrange its ideas with the future challenges, protect the environment, and initiate projections to invest in getting its needs from its own domestic production is not succeeding. Taking life as it comes is simply never pursuing or predicting aspects of what the future would look like. It is a condition in which preparation for tomorrow is not part of one’s culture (How a society leads its own life). In such condition as this, things seem that going forward is unlikeliy to happen, because viewing the world through rose colored glasses is not the answer to overcoming adversity. What scope people wearing rose colored glasses see, determines what story they see and how they look at the world. Of course, seeing the world through different ways is about securing things, defending things, copying technology in order to save cost, as Chinese people do, controlling things, inventing things, protecting and preserving both renewable and non-renewable resources. It’s mostly a fear-based view of the world that is preparing for future events. This approach is humanly normal. Experience shows that developed countries always base their national strategies for their present and future needs on a fear-based stand to minimize the danger that may arise, for instances, from the occurrence of food scarcity or outbreak of world war, while underdeveloped nations mostly fail to set out strategies that can ensure the means to produce sufficient supply of their needs at the domestic level that will help them find a sweet space at which dependence on what others produce is minimized. The difference between the two approaches is that rich countries mostly utilise their mental mechanics for shaping their life as they want, while poverty-stricken countries neither use their effort nor their mental imagination for trying to tame their lives. The shame on Somaliland societies is that they take life as it comes to them. And taking life as it comes is fundamentally an “anti-change state.” That is, the way Somaliland people lead their lives is not about thinking in regards to the survival of the tribe. Nothing is more bitter than truth. Who among us can deny or disagree the fact that Somaliland has been, and still continues to be the dumping ground for the massively produced foreign goods? This reality goes further from this and probably begs the questions such as:- a) What do Somaliland people control? b) What do they own? c) What do they produce? e) What do they distribute? f) What are the goods that are the produce of Somaliland country that citizens of Somaliland consume? In fact Somaliland people are incredibly consumers and have no special creation. They never ever produced an iota of their basic needs in their entire life. Their food, their cloth, their cars, their tea, their phones, their mobiles, their lotion, their guns, all their white goods, etc, are not their own make, but all are made and controlled by people who don’t look like them, who may retain their goods for their own needs in hard times, who may not even be happy to see Somalis and their likes to survive. Academics had it right when they predicted 50 years ago on the prospect of parasite societies: “Non-productivity reduces output, represses levels of living standard for the masses and engenders strife.” A nation is alive only when it constantly revives and revitalises the way in which it manages its problems, aligns its national vision with what is going on in the world and discards its outdated traditions, habits, rituals and assumptions. Of all the problems Somaliland now faces, lack of local production is the elephant in the room. The old saying which goes to say “necessity is the mother of invention” is applicable to Somaliland. A bleak future is for he who knowingly ignores or escapes from this reality. How should Somaliland state get itself out of foreign-produce dependency? How Somaliland would deal with the lack of local production? The solution is simple. Doing what others did and still do, is the answer as to how Somaliland state can free itself from foreign goods and become self-reliant on its own resources rather than that of others. Apart from light, water and air, food is what makes humans survive; what provides human bodies with what they need to stay alive; what makes human beings grow, active, energetic, move and work; what keeps human bodies healthy and heal themselves; what every human who is born into this world requires. Thus, Somaliland must innovate and intellectuslise its weak policies towards its economic growth and come up with the ability, skill and knowledge to boost domestic yield to satisfy its basic needs from within its own domestic production without foreign produce? In the heat of these alarming moments, Somaliland must make sense of food insufficiency and insecurity, recognize climate change and global warming, protect its environment, dream of a regenerative agriculture, envision a green revolution, create an awareness throughout Somaliland, so that the population must plant sea and herd its animals, and dig the land for farms to produce more and better food. A lesson that sends a powerful message to every country that cannot stand on its feet without foreign aid is that, as a result of the sudden outbreak of the pandemic, Covid-19, rich nations have already started intensive researches on de-globalisation and indeed focused on setting up urgent objectives to develop their local production and measures to stop outsourcing supply chains. Remember, environment does not need humans to survive, but humans need it. So, let us get used to the truth that we are all connected to it and must like to live an environment-centered life. Nothing is more attractive than the reality to acknowledge that a healthy environment is the foundation for a healthy and sustainable society. This hope can only come true when all of us look ahead and always try to use our resources wisely for the sake of our future generations. Who knows what the nature will bring to us tomorrow? What matters to us is to get ready for how we can arrange our ideas with how we can shape the sense of tomorrow. By:JamaFalaag. Hargeisa, Somaliland. jamafalaag@gmail.com

items.title: Duqa Muqdisho oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyey dalka Jabuuti
items.description: Muqdisho (RaxanreebOnline) Guddoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Dr. Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa safar ku tegay magaalada Jabuuti, kaddib markii uu casuumaad rasmi ah ka helay dhiggiisa Caasimadda Jabuut, Said Daoud Mohamed (Saïd Daoud). Wefdiga Duqa Muqdisho, Dr. Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa waxaa Garoonka Diyaaradaha Caalamiga ah ee Jabuuti-Ambouli, ku soo dhaweeyay Duqa Magaalada Jabuuti, Said Daoud Mohamed (Saïd Daoud), Danjiraha Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ambassador Cusmaan Dubad Sugulle, Guddoomiyaha Rugta Ganacsiga Jabuuti, mas’uuliyiin reer Jabuuti ah iyo Diblomaasiyiin ka tirsan Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee dalka Jabuuti. Socdaalkan oo muhiim u ah xoojinta xiriirka walaaltinimo iyo iskaashi ee labada magaalo, ayey mas’uuliyiintu ku lafaguri doonaan sidii loo dhisi lahaa hannaan iskaashi oo joogto ah oo ku saleysan; xoojinta xiriirka ganacsi, dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga iyo khibrad-wadaagga ganacsatada labada dhinac. Wefdiga Guddoomiyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir Duqa Muqdisho, Dr. Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), waxaa ka mid ah, mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan tirsan Rugta Ganacsiga iyo Wershadaha oo uu ku jiro Guddoomiyaha Rugta, Yaasiin Maxamuud Cibaar, Agaasimayaal ka tirsan waaxyaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir iyo xubno ka mid ah ganacsatada dalka. The post Duqa Muqdisho oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyey dalka Jabuuti appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle oo noqday musharaxa rasmiga ah JSP ee doorashada Hirshabelle
items.description: Urur Siyaasadeedka JSP ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu hoggaamiyo ayaa si rasmi ah Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe) ugu xushay inuu noqdo musharaxa uga qaybgelaya doorashada madaxtinimada Hirshabelle. Munaasabad lagu qabtay Xarunta Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ee Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa Axaddan lagaga dhawaaqay musharaxtinimada Cali Guudlaawe, iyadoona halkaasi lagu guddoonsiiyay kaarka Shimbirta Cagaaran 15 ee astaanta u ah ururka. Tallaabadan ayaa la filayaa inay sii hurin doonto khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka dhashay, ka dib markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu habeenkii Khamiista uu Madaxweyne Kuxigeenka Hirshabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Yuusuf Dabageed) u sheegay in Villa Somalia ay taageereyso dib-u-doorashada Cali Guudlaawe. Taageerada Villa Somalia ayaa Cali Guudlaawe siineysa guusha doorashada, bacdamaa aanu jirin hannaan daahfuran oo muuqda oo si xor iyo xalaal ah loogu tartamayo doorashada soo socota. Siyaasiyiinta Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa si adag uga horyimid in Cali Guudlaawe uu mar labaad u tartamo xafiiska, iyagoona Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku eedeeyay in uu jebiyay heshiiskii siyaasadeed ee ilaalinayay in xilka hoggaanka sare ee maamulka uu si meerto ah ugu kala wareego labada gobol ee Hiiraan iyo Shabellaha Dhexe. Cali Guudlaawe ayaa 11-kii bishii November ee sanadkii 2020 loo doortay xilka Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle, iyadoona tan iyo xilligaasi uu maamulayay maamulka.

items.title: Sawirro: Xasan Sheekh oo aqoonsaday wasaaradaha ugu wax qabadka badan DF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa galabta ka qayb-galay bandhigga xiritaanka la-xisaabtanka sannadlaha ah ee Wasaaradaha Xukuumadda, kaas oo lagu soo bandhigay natiijooyinka waxqabadka iyo heerka ay ka gaareen fulinta qorsheyaashii loo dejiyay, gaarista bartilmaameedyadii loo asteeyay iyo gudashada waajibaadkooda sannadka 2026. Inta uu socday kulankan ayaa waxaa la sameeyay qiimeynta waxqabadka wasaaradaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo la eegayo heerka ay ka gaareen milestones-ka, hawlaha loo qorsheeyay iyo shaqooyinka qabsoomay. Sidoo kale waxaa lasoo bandhigay shanta wasaaradood ee ugu horeeya, kuwaas oo kala ah:- 1. Wasaaradda Maaliyadda 2. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda 3. Wasaaradda Qorshaynta 4. Wasaaradda Hawlaha Guud 5. Wasaaradda Waxbarashada. Intaas kadib Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa intii ay socotay munaasabadda xiritaanka bandhigga xukuumadda Dan-Qaran, wuxuu billado guddoonsiiyay wasaaradaha maaliyadda iyo arrimaha dibadda, kuwaasi oo kaalmaha ugu sarreeya ka galay qiimeyntii la sameeyay sanadkan. Sidoo kale, wuxuu xafiiska ra’iisul wasaaraha ku abaalmariyay hirgelinta hannaanka danabaysan ee la socodka waxqabadka wasaaradaha oo markii ugu horreysay shaashad weyn laga shiday boqoleyda natiijada kasoo baxday qiimeynta wasaarad kasta, iyo waliba sida wasaaradaha kaalmaha u kala galeen. Dhanka kale Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa ku bogaadiyay xukuumadda dadaalka ay ku bixisay hirgelinta qorsheyaasha dowladda iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, isaga oo adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay la-xisaabtanka hay’adaha iyo howl-wadeennada dowladda, hufnaanta shaqada iyo in si joogto ah loo qiimeeyo natiijooyinka waxqabadka. Waxaa kale oo uu ku booriyay wasiirrada iyo hay’adaha dowladda in natiijooyinka la gaaray ay noqdaan saldhigga lagu sii xoojinayo waxqabadka, laguna saxayo gaabisyada u baahan dardar galinta, si loo xaqiijiyo in qorshayaasha dowladda ay si muuqata uga tarjumaan baahiyaha iyo danta shacabka Soomaaliyeed. La xisaabtankan ayaa looga gol leeyahay in lagu qiimeeyo shaqadii qabsoontay sanadkan, iyada oo lala eegayo ballan-qaadyadii wasiir kasta uu saxiixay, isaga oo xusey in haddii ay soo baxaan caqabado shaqooyinka qaar u qabsoomi waayeen la sixi doono hadafyada iyo bar-hiigsiyada ku qoran jadwalka heshiisyada wasiiradda lala galay.   The post Sawirro: Xasan Sheekh oo aqoonsaday wasaaradaha ugu wax qabadka badan DF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Sidoo kale waxaa lasoo bandhigay shanta wasaaradood ee ugu horeeya, kuwaas oo kala ah:- 1. Wasaaradda Maaliyadda 2. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda 3. Wasaaradda Qorshaynta 4. Wasaaradda Hawlaha Guud 5. Wasaaradda Waxbarashada. Intaas kadib Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa intii ay socotay munaasabadda xiritaanka bandhigga xukuumadda Dan-Qaran, wuxuu billado guddoonsiiyay wasaaradaha maaliyadda iyo arrimaha dibadda, kuwaasi oo kaalmaha ugu sarreeya ka galay qiimeyntii la sameeyay sanadkan. Sidoo kale, wuxuu xafiiska ra’iisul wasaaraha ku abaalmariyay hirgelinta hannaanka danabaysan ee la socodka waxqabadka wasaaradaha oo markii ugu horreysay shaashad weyn laga shiday boqoleyda natiijada kasoo baxday qiimeynta wasaarad kasta, iyo waliba sida wasaaradaha kaalmaha u kala galeen. Dhanka kale Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa ku bogaadiyay xukuumadda dadaalka ay ku bixisay hirgelinta qorsheyaasha dowladda iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, isaga oo adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay la-xisaabtanka hay’adaha iyo howl-wadeennada dowladda, hufnaanta shaqada iyo in si joogto ah loo qiimeeyo natiijooyinka waxqabadka. Waxaa kale oo uu ku booriyay wasiirrada iyo hay’adaha dowladda in natiijooyinka la gaaray ay noqdaan saldhigga lagu sii xoojinayo waxqabadka, laguna saxayo gaabisyada u baahan dardar galinta, si loo xaqiijiyo in qorshayaasha dowladda ay si muuqata uga tarjumaan baahiyaha iyo danta shacabka Soomaaliyeed. La xisaabtankan ayaa looga gol leeyahay in lagu qiimeeyo shaqadii qabsoontay sanadkan, iyada oo lala eegayo ballan-qaadyadii wasiir kasta uu saxiixay, isaga oo xusey in haddii ay soo baxaan caqabado shaqooyinka qaar u qabsoomi waayeen la sixi doono hadafyada iyo bar-hiigsiyada ku qoran jadwalka heshiisyada wasiiradda lala galay.   The post Sawirro: Xasan Sheekh oo aqoonsaday wasaaradaha ugu wax qabadka badan DF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: JSP oo Cali Guudlaawe U Doortay Musharraxa Hirshabeelle
items.description: Cali Guudlaawe oo Si Rasmi ah u Helay Taageerada Xisbiga JSP ee Doorashada Hirshabeelle MUQDISHO, 13 Sebteembar 2026 — Madaxweynaha Hirshabeelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe) , ayaa loo aqoonsaday musharraxa Xisbiga Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ee doorashada madaxtinimada Hirshabeelle, kaddib kulan ay xubnaha fulinta xisbiga ku yeesheen Muqdisho. Sida lagu sheegay xogta la helay, xubnaha fulinta JSP ayaa cod u qaaday in Guudlaawe noqdo musharraxa xisbiga, waxaana munaasabad ka dhacday xarunta xisbiga lagu guddoonsiiyay kaarka musharraxnimada ee JSP. Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Soomaaliya, Jibriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji Cabdi, ayaa ka mid ahaa mas’uuliyiintii goob-joogga ka ahaa munaasabadda. Xoghayaha Guud ee JSP, Xuseen Sheekh, ayaa xubnaha xisbiga ugu baaqay inay taageeraan musharraxa loo doortay inuu matalo JSP ee Hirshabeelle.Guudlaawe ayaa isaguna sheegay in marxaladdii xifaaltanka siyaasadeed ay soo dhammaatay, isagoo ku baaqay in la isku soo wada dhowaado lana wada shaqeeyo. Go’aankan ayaa soo afjaraya hubanti-la’aantii ka jirtay su’aasha ahayd cidda JSP u meteli doonta doorashada Hirshabeelle. Guudlaawe ayaa hore, 28–29 Juun 2026, u sheegay inuu yahay musharrax u taagan inuu mar kale hoggaamiyo Hirshabeelle, isla markaana uu ka tirsan yahay JSP, balse xilligaas xisbiga ayaan weli si rasmi ah u shaacin musharraxiisa. Madaxweynaha Hirshabeelle ayaa xilka hayay tan iyo markii loo doortay hoggaanka maamulka bishii Nofeembar 2020. Doorashada soo socota ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Hirshabeelle ay isu diyaarinayso hannaan doorasho oo ay ku lug leeyihiin xisbiyada siyaasadeed iyo nidaamka qof iyo cod.Guudlaawe ayaa hore u taageeray hannaanka doorashada qof iyo cod, isagoo sheegay in doorashadu ku dhisnaan doonto codka shacabka, halka JSP uu noqonayo xisbiga uu ku tartamayo. Siyaasadda Hirshabeelle ayaa bilihii la soo dhaafay sidoo kale wajahaysay wada-tashiyo ku saabsan hoggaanka mustaqbalka maamulka. Warbixinno hore oo soo baxay ayaa sheegay in kulamo siyaasadeed oo ku saabsan doorashada iyo cidda hoggaamin doonta Hirshabeelle ay dhexmareen madaxda dowladda federaalka iyo dhinacyada siyaasadda ee maamulka, inkastoo qaar ka mid ah sheegashooyinkaas aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin. Aqoonsiga Guudlaawe ee musharraxa JSP ayaa sidaas ku noqonaya tallaabo muhiim ah oo ku saabsan tartanka madaxtinimada Hirshabeelle, iyadoo hadda diiraddu u wareegayso sida musharraxiinta kale, bulshada iyo dhinacyada siyaasadeed ay uga falcelin doonaan doorashada soo socota. The post JSP oo Cali Guudlaawe U Doortay Musharraxa Hirshabeelle first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somaliland seeks political leverage through Gaza troop offer
items.description: Somaliland seeks political leverage through Gaza troop offer For Somaliland’s leadership, the issue is about demonstrating that it can be a participant in regional and international security arrangements, rather than simply a political entity seeking recognition. Israel’s President Isaac Herzog and Somaliland’s President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi hold up glasses of beverage at the President’s Residence in Jerusalem, June 14, 2026. For Somaliland’s leadership, the issue is about demonstrating that it can be a participant in regional and international security arrangements, rather than simply a political WASHINGTON Somaliland’s initiative to offer up to 2,000 soldiers for deployment to Gaza appears less to be a straightforward military contribution to a proposed international force than an attempt by Hargeisa to leverage its strategic security and geographic position in pursuit of a wider political role. President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi said Somaliland was prepared to provide troops if requested to do so by the United States or Israel, making clear that Hargeisa was not currently volunteering to join the force but would be ready to respond if it received a formal request. The move comes at a sensitive time for Somaliland, which has sought international recognition of its independence since declaring a break from Somalia in 1991. Israel recognised Somaliland in December last year, becoming the first country to formally do so, but the decision has not so far triggered a wider wave of international recognition. That gives any potential Somaliland participation in an international force in Gaza significance beyond the number of troops Hargeisa could provide. For Somaliland’s leadership, the issue is about demonstrating that it can be a participant in regional and international security arrangements, rather than simply a political entity seeking recognition. If its forces were to take part in a multinational mission, Hargeisa could present itself to Western capitals as an actor capable of making a security contribution on an issue of exceptional sensitivity, potentially strengthening its political case with the United States and other countries. The United States is planning an international stabilisation force for Gaza that could eventually number around 20,000 troops. Its proposed tasks include maintaining security, training Palestinian police, facilitating the delivery of humanitarian aid and preventing Hamas from returning to military control of the Gaza Strip. Other countries have agreed or pledged to participate, including Uganda, with around 1,200 personnel, and Morocco, with up to 500, as well as personnel from Albania, Kazakhstan and Kosovo. But Somaliland’s offer differs from those of internationally-recognised states because it carries a sensitive political question: can participation in an international mission become one of the tools for building legitimacy? The presence of forces belonging to a territory that lacks broad international recognition in an international operation could give Hargeisa a level of visibility that traditional diplomatic channels have not provided. At the same time, accepting Somaliland’s participation could provoke objections from Somalia and regional states that remain committed to the country’s territorial unity. The issue is made more sensitive by Somaliland’s location. It lies on the Gulf of Aden, across from Yemen and close to one of the world’s most important maritime routes, making it a focus of growing interest from international and regional powers in recent years.The port of Berbera and its position on the Gulf of Aden give Hargeisa a geopolitical asset that it has sought to turn into security and economic partnerships. Amid instability in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab, that geography has become more important to the United States, Israel and other countries concerned with the security of maritime traffic. Somaliland’s offer of troops therefore cannot be separated from its efforts to develop relations with Washington. Abdullahi has said Israel’s recognition has raised international attention towards Somaliland, even though it has not so far been followed by other recognitions. Washington, meanwhile, faces more complicated calculations. Recognition of Somaliland could damage its relations with Somalia’s federal government, an important partner in combating Al Shabaab and jihadist organisations in the Horn of Africa. Turkey, a prominent military and political ally of Somalia, has also rejected Israel’s recognition of Somaliland and reaffirmed its commitment to Somalia’s territorial integrity. For that reason, accepting Hargeisa’s forces into a Gaza mission could become a political issue extending well beyond the borders of the Strip. Hargeisa is also seeking to avoid linking its initiative to more sensitive regional issues. Abdullahi has denied that there have been discussions with Israel or the United States about using Somaliland’s territory or airspace for operations against Houthi forces in Yemen. He has also denied any agreement to receive Palestinians from Gaza. The denials reflect an awareness of the sensitivity of Somaliland’s position in regional power balances and a desire to prevent its security partnerships from becoming a source of further regional isolation. The central question remains whether the offer to send 2,000 soldiers would actually produce political gains. Participation in an international force could give Somaliland the image of an actor capable of contributing to security, but it would not automatically translate into recognition. Deploying forces beyond its borders would also test the military and political capabilities of its army, which the president estimates at around 25,000 soldiers. Somaliland has not previously contributed troops to African Union operations. Even so, the initiative itself reveals a shift in the way Hargeisa is presenting itself. Rather than limiting its case to a demand for recognition, Somaliland is seeking to portray itself as an actor that can perform a role in regional and international security arrangements. From that perspective, Gaza is more than a distant conflict for Somaliland; it is a potential opportunity to demonstrate that an entity seeking recognition can also offer a political and security contribution in return. Hargeisa is therefore betting on a simple equation: strategic geography can be converted into influence, and influence can be converted into legitimacy. items.title: Maaliyadda iyo Arrimaha Dibadda oo Ku Guuleystay Qiimeynta Waxqabadka
items.description: Xasan Sheekh oo Abaalmarinno Guddoonsiiyay Wasaaradaha Ugu Waxqabadka Sarreeya Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa 13-ka Sebteembar 2026 Muqdisho kaga qaybgalay munaasabad lagu soo bandhigay natiijooyinka qiimeynta waxqabadka wasaaradaha Xukuumadda Federaalka, iyadoo lagu eegayay heerka ay wasaaraduhu uga soo baxeen qorshayaashii iyo bartilmaameedyadii loo dejiyay sannadka 2026. Wasaaradaha Maaliyadda iyo Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa galay kaalmaha ugu sarreeya qiimeynta, waxaana Madaxweynaha uu labada wasaaradood guddoonsiiyay billado lagu aqoonsanayo waxqabadkooda. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ku ammaanay hirgelinta nidaamka danabaysan ee lagu cabbirayo laguna la soconayo waxqabadka wasaaradaha. Qiimeyntan ayaa daba socotay kulan la-xisaabtan ah oo Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre uu 12-ka Sebteembar la yeeshay wasiirrada Xukuumadda DanQaran. Kulankaas waxaa lagu eegayay qorshayaashii ay wasaaraduhu hore u dejisteen, heerka fulintooda iyo caqabadaha hortaagan qorshayaasha aan weli la dhammeystirin. Nidaamka cusub ayaa adeegsanaya hab dijitaal ah oo lagu soo bandhigayo natiijooyinka waxqabadka, taas oo Xamsa uu sheegay inay sahlayso in si joogto ah loola socdo shaqada wasaaradaha. Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu wuxuu sheegay in nidaam online ah uu u saamaxayo inuu si joogto ah ula socdo hawlaha ka socda wasaaradaha. Madaxweynaha ayaa xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in hay’adaha dowladda ay yeeshaan isla-xisaabtan joogto ah, hufnaan iyo nidaam lagu cabbiro natiijooyinka shaqada, isagoo wasiirrada iyo hay’adaha dowladda ku boorriyay inay ka faa’iideystaan natiijooyinka qiimeynta si loo sii xoojiyo waxqabadka loona saxo meelaha uu gaabis ka jiro. Hannaanka qiimeynta iyo maamulka danabaysan wuxuu sidoo kale ku jiraa istaraatiijiyadda dowladda ee casriyeynta maamulka, taas oo dhigaysa in tiknoolajiyadda loo adeegsado hagaajinta maamulka iyo adeegyada dowladda, iyo la socodka waxqabadka hay’adaha. Qiimeynta ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Xukuumadda DanQaran ay dib u eegis ku sameyneyso waxqabadkeeda iyo fulinta qorshayaasha qaranka. Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa 10-ka Sebteembar sidoo kale ka hadlay dib-u-eegista waxqabadka Xukuumadda iyo qorshayaasha dowladda. Munaasabadda Muqdisho ayaa sidaas ku muujisay isku dayga dowladda ee ah in waxqabadka wasaaradaha lagu saleeyo cabbirro iyo natiijooyin la qiimeyn karo, iyadoo kaalinta wasaaradaha lagu kala saaray natiijooyinka qiimeynta sannadlaha ah. The post Maaliyadda iyo Arrimaha Dibadda oo Ku Guuleystay Qiimeynta Waxqabadka first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

Nidaamka cusub ayaa adeegsanaya hab dijitaal ah oo lagu soo bandhigayo natiijooyinka waxqabadka, taas oo Xamsa uu sheegay inay sahlayso in si joogto ah loola socdo shaqada wasaaradaha. Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu wuxuu sheegay in nidaam online ah uu u saamaxayo inuu si joogto ah ula socdo hawlaha ka socda wasaaradaha. Madaxweynaha ayaa xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in hay’adaha dowladda ay yeeshaan isla-xisaabtan joogto ah, hufnaan iyo nidaam lagu cabbiro natiijooyinka shaqada, isagoo wasiirrada iyo hay’adaha dowladda ku boorriyay inay ka faa’iideystaan natiijooyinka qiimeynta si loo sii xoojiyo waxqabadka loona saxo meelaha uu gaabis ka jiro. Hannaanka qiimeynta iyo maamulka danabaysan wuxuu sidoo kale ku jiraa istaraatiijiyadda dowladda ee casriyeynta maamulka, taas oo dhigaysa in tiknoolajiyadda loo adeegsado hagaajinta maamulka iyo adeegyada dowladda, iyo la socodka waxqabadka hay’adaha. Qiimeynta ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Xukuumadda DanQaran ay dib u eegis ku sameyneyso waxqabadkeeda iyo fulinta qorshayaasha qaranka. Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa 10-ka Sebteembar sidoo kale ka hadlay dib-u-eegista waxqabadka Xukuumadda iyo qorshayaasha dowladda. Munaasabadda Muqdisho ayaa sidaas ku muujisay isku dayga dowladda ee ah in waxqabadka wasaaradaha lagu saleeyo cabbirro iyo natiijooyin la qiimeyn karo, iyadoo kaalinta wasaaradaha lagu kala saaray natiijooyinka qiimeynta sannadlaha ah. items.title: Xisbiga Towfiiq ee Sheekh Shaakir ‘oo laga reebay’ doorashada Galmudug
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga madaxa bannaan ee doorashooyinka qaranka ayaa galabta shaaciyay liiska ururrada siyaasadda ee ka qayb-galaya doorashada ku celiska ah ee maamulka Galmudug, taas oo la qorsheynayo inay dhacdo 30-ka bishaan September ee sannadka 2026-ka. Liiska ururrada la shaaciyay ayaa gaaraya illaa 12 urur, iyada oo ‘lga reebay Xisbiga Towfiiq ee uu hoggaamiyo Sheekh Maxamed Shaakir Cali Xasan’, kaas oo saameyn wayn ku leh gobollada dhexe. Xisbiga Towfiiq ayaa sabab u ahaa go’aankii kasoo baxay Maxkamadda Sare ee Dalka, ee lagu baab’iyay natiijada doorashadii horay uga dhacday Galmudug, kadib markii ay maxkamaddu shaacisay in aan loo maamulin, loona qaban si waafaqsan dastuurka iyo sharciga doorashooyinka dalka. Guddiga doorashooyinka oo warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa xusay in liiska uu soo saaray isaga oo gudanaya waajibaadka shaqo ee loo igmaday, isla-markaana fulinaya jadwalka doorashada ee uu guddigu soo saaray 31 August. Qoraalka ayaa lagu sheegay in 12-ka urur ee la shaaciyay ay soo gudbiyeen musharrixiintooda, loona gartay inay ka qayb-galaan doorashada, taas oo ka dhigan in ururka Towfiiq aanu ka qayb-gelayn doorashada ku celiska ah ee Galmudug. Haddaba, ururrada siyaasadda ee soo gudbiyey liisaska murashaxiinta doorashada isku-sidkan ee Galmudug ayaa waxay kala yihiin: 1-Caddaaladda iyo Midnimadda Tiir 2-Madalsan, 3-Muwaadanniinta Soomaaliyeed 4- Dimuqraadiyadda Soomaaliyeed 5-Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka 6-Dadka Soomaaliyeed 7-Karaama 8-Saab 9-Dan Shacab 10- Sincad 11-Dhalinyarada Talo Qaran 12-Ramaas. Guddigu sidoo kale ku wargeliyay ururrada siyaasadda iyo daneeyeyaasha doorashooyinka isku-sidkan ee Galmudug in ay xirantay soo gudbinta liisaska murashaxiinta ka tartamaya doorashada ku-celiska ah ee Gamuug. Arrintan ayaa kusoo aadeyso, iyada oo maalmihii u dambeeyay xisbiga Towfiiq uu dhaleeceynayay habka uu wax wado guddiga doorashooyinka qaranka, wuxuuna soo jeediyay dhowr jeer oo hore in la dhowro shuruucda doorashooyinka iyo go’aankii dhawaan kasoo baxay Maxkamadda Sare. Somalis rethink trade routes as Houthis disrupt Red Sea shipping
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s business community is seeking alternative shipping routes due to disruptions and security concerns around the Bab al-Mandab Strait and the Strait of Hormuz after Iran-backed Houthis captured a key port city and an island, sending thousands of Yemenis fleeing to neighboring Djibouti. Companies have traditionally imported goods from Asia through Gulf countries, such as the United Arab Emirates, Oman, and Saudi Arabia. Now, some are trying a more direct approach. “The latest tensions in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, as well as those in the Strait of Hormuz , have negatively impacted us,” said Mohamed Ali Nur, director of Mogadishu Seaport. “But we have also taken measures to avoid that disruption.” Nur said his port has worked with exporters to find alternative routes. “For the first time, we brought a ship carrying sugar directly from Sri Lanka,” Nur said. “This could be a strategy we developed because of these tensions.” Yemen’s internationally recognized government and Saudi Arabia have been battling the Houthis for 12 years. The recent escalation has ended a ceasefire that had largely stopped civil war across Yemen since 2022. Now the number of people from Yemen fleeing the fighting is soaring. On Sunday, the International Organization for Migration said over 85,000 people have been displaced since the beginning of the month. More than 2,000 people have reached Djibouti, which neighbors Somalia, the agency said. At Mogadishu’s busy seaport, cargo ships continue to unload food and other commodities. Somalia is particularly dependent on maritime trade for many of the goods its people use every day. For ordinary Somali consumers, changes in shipping routes can eventually be felt in the markets, where imported food and other goods are sold. Longer or more complicated journeys can mean higher transportation costs and delays in getting products onto store shelves. Capt Ali Jemdi, who is originally from Syria and ships cargoes of sugar, said uncertainty in the region is already creating concerns for ships operating along the routes. “There is some trouble over there because of the war,” he told The Associated Press, referring to the Arabian Gulf and surrounding waters. “The Bab el-Mandeb may also have some issues for the vessel.” He said the instability could make maritime transportation and trade more difficult.

items.title: Ruushka oo Tareen Rakaab Ku Weeraray Xadka Poland
items.description: Boris Johnson oo cambaareeyay weerarka lagu qaaday tareen ku dhow xadka Poland Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Britain, Boris Johnson, ayaa cambaareeyay weerar diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Ruushka lagu qaaday tareen rakaab oo ku sugnaa gudaha Ukraine, meel ku dhow xadka Poland. Weerarka ayaa dhacay 13-ka Sebtembar 2026, gobolka Volyn, halkaas oo diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn ay ku dhufatay tareenka xamuulka jiidayay ee ku socda waddada u dhexeysa Kyiv iyo Warsaw. Shirkadda tareennada Ukraine ee Ukrzaliznytsia ayaa sheegtay in weerarku uusan sababin wax dhimasho ama dhaawac ah, kaddib markii shaqaalaha tareenka hore looga digay khatarta. Boris Johnson, oo ka hadlayay dhacdada bartiisa X, ayaa su’aal geliyay sababta Ruushku u bartilmaameedsaday tareen aan dhaqaaqayn, isaga oo weerarka ku tilmaamay mid aan macno lahayn oo ka mid ah weerarrada maalinlaha ah ee dadka reer Ukraine la kulmaan. Johnson wuxuu sidoo kale ku baaqay in Ukraine la siiyo nidaamyo dheeraad ah oo difaaca cirka ah. Wuxuu sheegay in dalalka reer Galbeedku ay u baahan yihiin inay qaadaan tallaabooyin dheeraad ah si loo yareeyo weerarrada lagu hayo kaabeyaasha rayidka iyo gaadiidka Ukraine. Weerarka tareenka ayaa ku soo beegmay weerarro kale oo ka dhacay agagaarka xadka Ukraine iyo Poland. Reuters waxay sheegtay in diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn ay ku dhufatay gaari xamuul ah meel u dhow isgoyska Yahodyn–Dorohusk, halkaas oo hawlihii xadka si ku-meel-gaar ah loo hakiyay. Masuuliyiinta Poland ayaa sheegay in weerarradu ka dhaceen gudaha Ukraine, isla markaana aan la xaqiijin in hawada Poland la jebiyay. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Ukraine ayaa weerarka ku tilmaantay mid khatar ku ah amniga Yurub, gaar ahaan maadaama uu ka dhacay meel aad ugu dhow xuduudda Midowga Yurub iyo NATO. Masuuliyiinta Ukraine waxay sheegeen in weerarrada noocan ah ay muujinayaan in dagaalku si isa soo taraysa ugu soo dhawaanayo waddamada taageera Kyiv. Dhanka Ruushka, weerarrada ayaa lagu sababeeyay in la bartilmaameedsanayo kaabayaal iyo waddooyin loo adeegsado gaarsiinta qalabka milatari ee reer Galbeedku u diraan Ukraine . Si kastaba, weerarka tareenka rakaabka ayaa walaac ka dhaliyay badbaadada dadka rayidka ah iyo sii socoshada adeegyada gaadiidka ee muhiimka u ah shacabka Ukraine. The post Ruushka oo Tareen Rakaab Ku Weeraray Xadka Poland first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Colaaddii Soomaaliya uga Timid Qoriddii Farta Soomaaliga
items.description: Gumaystayaashii reer Yurub, kolka laga soo tago inay Afrika uga tageen colaado ku salaysan is-haysashada xuduudaha dhuleed, waxa kale oo ay uga tageen afafkoodii iyo dhaqamadoodii oo Afrika dacal ilaa dacal ku faafay. Dal kasta oo Afrikaan ah wuxuu qaatay afka gumaystihiisa. Soomaaliya waxaa kala qaybsaday Faransiis, Talyaani, Ingiriis iyo Itoobiyaan. Mid walba wuxuu doonayay, haddii uu meesha ka baxo, in afkiisu noqdo kan ugu muhiimsan qaybtii uu ku talin jiray. Talyaanigu, tusaale ahaan, wuxuu doonayay in af Talyaanigu noqdo afka hay’adaha dawladda iyo kan shacabkaba: afka wax lagu barto, wax lagu qoro, lagu xiriiro, laguna garto Soomaalidii Talyaanigu gumaystay. Ingiriiskuna sidaas oo kale ayuu doonayay. Af Soomaaliga waxaa lala damacsanaa inuu ku ekaado suuqa iyo guryaha oo keliya, sida ay noqdeen afaf badan oo kale oo Afrikaan ah. Soomaaliya waxay noqotay dalka keliya ee Afrikadii la gumaystay ee iska diidday doonitaankii gumaystayaashii. Markii ay xorowdayba, waxay guda gashay sidii ay u heli lahayd far qoran oo Soomaali ah. Dawladihii rayidka iyo dawladdii ciidamaduba mudnaanta koowaad ayay siiyeen qoridda farta af Soomaaliga. Markii ciidanku dalka qabsaday, wuxuu soo saaray bayaan uu ugu magac daray Xaashida Koowaad. Xaashidan waxaa lagu qeexay arrimaha mudnaanta u leh dawladda cusub iyo hiraalkeeda ku aaddan siyaasadaha gudaha iyo dibaddaba. Qodobka afraad wuxuu ahaa in la helo far u gaar ah afkeenna. Soomaalidu marnaba ma sawiran waxa ka dhalan kara markii ay u dhaqaaqeen hindisidda far u gaar ah afkooda. Warbixintii Guddiga Farta Soomaaliga marna laguma soo qaadin wax colaad ah oo laga filan karo qaadashada far u gaar ah af Soomaaliga. Wasiirkii Waxbarashada Soomaaliya ee xilka ugu muddada dheeraa, Aadan Maxamed Cali, ayaa qoray sidan: “Aniga oo haya Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, xafiiskayga waxaa iigu timid gabar Aljeeriya u dhalatay oo ka socotay wargeys ka hadla hiddaha iyo dhaqanka dalka Aljeeriya… Waxay iga waraysatay sidii farta af Soomaaliga loo qoray ee looga soo shaqeeyay, intii ka qaybqaadatay iyo mashaakilkii iyo dhibaatooyinkii innaga hor yimid. Arrimahaas oo dhan markii aan uga sheekeeyay, waxay igu tiri: ‘Marka ugu horraysa, waan idinku hambalyaynayaa.’ Dabadeedna waxay tiri: ‘Ma ogtihiin inaad miino ku dul taagan tihiin?’ Maye, ma ogi baan ku iri. Maxay se tahay miinadu? Waxay tiri: ‘Afrika laba dal baa isku dayay inay qoraan afkooda. Labadaas dal oo kala ah Kiinya iyo Itoobiya oo aad deris tihiin, labaduba kuma guulaysan, kamana gaarin meeshii la doonayay. Wayna shaqayn weyday. Inta kale, marka laga reebo dawladaha Carabta ee Waqooyiga Afrika deggan, waxay ku dhaqmaan afafkii gumaystayaashu kaga tageen dalalkaas: Ingiriis, Faransiis, Beljim iyo Holland/Netherlands. Waddamadaasina ma oggola in luqaddooda laga gudbo, dhaqankooda iyo hiddahoodiina laga tago. Weli waxay ku hawllan yihiin inay ummadda maskaxda ka sii haystaan. Arrintaasi waa miinada aad ku dul taagan tihiin. Sababtuna waa in aad arrimahoodii dhex gasheen dawlado waaweyn oo aqoon, dhaqaale, saamayn, miisaan, ciidan iyo taariikh dheerba leh. Maalin maalmaha ka mid ahna waxay noqon doontaa miino idinku qaraxda.’” Sida ay gabadhaasi tilmaantay, dawladihii awoodda lahaa ee dunida gumaystay ma doonayn in laga xarig furto. Waddamadii ay siiyeen xorriyadda waxay ka rabeen xorriyad magac-u-yaal ah, ee si buuxda ugama tegin. Dhaqan ahaan, hidde ahaan iyo dhaqaale ahaanba waxay rabeen in iyaga loo hoos joogo. Madaxdii Soomaalidu way ku saxnaayeen inay ka fekeraan, u hawlgalaan, ugu dambaynna meelmariyaan qoridda afkeenna. Dhabtii, dadkii hawshaas qabtay abaal aan la gudi karin ayay nagu leeyihiin. Haddii aysan iyagu ahaan lahayn, maanta maan qoreen sadarradan, adiguna maad akhrideen. Intaas oo keliya ma aha ee, waxaa dhici lahayd in Hargeysa af Ingiriisi looga hadlo, Xamarna af Talyaani looga hadlo, sidaasna laba qowmiyadood lagu kala noqdo, gobollada la haysto inta aan la gaarinba. Helitaanka far uu afkeennu leeyahay wuxuu udub u ahaa in afkeennu noqdo kan mideeya ee isku xira Soomaalida oo dhan, kuwii xor ahaa iyo kuwii gumaysiga ku hoos jirayba. Maanta afkeenna qoran ayaa sabab u ah in buugta ka soo baxda meel kasta oo geyiga Soomaaliyeed ka mid ahi si siman looga akhristo dhammaan dhulweynaha Soomaaliyeed, Jabuuti ilaa Siyeelloow. Hubaashii, waxaa laga yaabi lahaa in maanta dalkeennu u qaybsanaan lahaa qayb Ingiriisi ku hadasha iyo qayb Talyaani ku hadasha, dhinac kastana uu xoogga saari lahaa in tiisa la qaato, sidaasna iscolaadin iyo nacayb gacan ka hadal gaara uu ku dhalan lahaa. Ha u qaadan wax fog in la isku layn lahaa Talyaani baa lagu hadli iyo Ingiriis baa lagu hadli, waayo, waxaa jira waddamo Afrikaan ah oo arrintaas colaad uga aloosan tahay. Tusaale ahaan, dalka Kaamiruun waxaa ka socda dagaal u dhexeeya labada dhinac ee u kala hadla Ingiriis iyo Faransiis. Marka dagaalkaas la tilmaamayo, waxaa loogu yeeraa “Anglophone-Francophone War”, oo macnaheedu yahay dagaalka u dhexeeya kuwa af Ingiriiska ku hadla iyo kuwa af Faransiiska ku hadla. Dhinaca kale, madaxdeennii kuma baraarugsanayn dakanooyinka ay galeen. Miinada ay gabadhaas weriyaha ahi garatay, madaxdii hawsha farta loo xilsaaray warba kama hayn. Dagaal aad ogaal ku gashay waxba kaama dhimo. Waad u diyaargarowdaa, guul iyo guuldarrana midkood ayaad ku talagashaa. Midka se aad indho la’aan ku gasho ama gondahaaga ka dhasha, sahal uma haleeshid maarayntiisa. Wasiir Aadan wuxuu kaga jawaabay weydiintii inantu ahayd “Ma xasuusataan inaad miino ku taagan tihiin?” isagoo yiri: “Ma xasuusni, laakiin innagu waan diyaargarownay. Arrintaasi waxay na siinaysaa geesinnimo ah inaynu nahay ummad isku kalsoon, Ilaahayna ku kalsoon. Sidaas baynu ku qornay…” Waa adag tahay in la fahmo sida ay ugu diyaargaroobeen miinada uu qirayo inuusan warba u hayn. Waxay tusaale u tahay sida madaxda Soomaalidu u sahashato dhibaatooyinka dibedda kaga iman kara. Waa arrin kale oo tilmaamaysa sida dhaqankii miyigu saamayn baaxad weyn ugu yeeshay dhaqanka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Dhaqanka Soomaalida kuma jirin basaasnimo iyo raadinta xogta hoose. Colaadaha dhex mari jiray ma ahayn kuwo u baahnaa raadinta xogta hoose, ogaanshaha cududda ciidanka reerka kale ama soo jaajuusidda waxa ay damacsan yihiin. Wax la qariyaba lama aqoon. Dhaqankaasi markii dambe ayuu dawladnimadeennii galay, wuxuuna keenay in madaxda Soomaalidu aysan waxba ka soo qaadin xogaha iyo khataraha lala wadaago, kuwaas oo mararka qaarkood dalka gelin kara halis weyn. Qoridda fartu laba jiho ayay lahayd: mid farsamo iyo mid siyaasadeed. Jihada farsamo waa middii loo saaray guddigii loo yaqaanay Guddiga Farta Soomaaliga, oo mar Muuse Galaal guddoomiye ka ahaa, marna Shariif Saalax. Jihadaas si wacan oo hawlkarnimo leh ayaa looga soo shaqeeyay, halkii la rabayna waa la dhigay. Dhammaan farihii kala duwanaa ee la soo bandhigay ayay falanqeeyeen. Mid kasta wixii caqabad iyo culays ah ee uu lahaa ayay eegeen, ugu dambaynna middii la qumanaatay ayay qaateen. Jihada siyaasadeed waxay ahayd in xukuumadihii jiray xilliyadii farta lagu mashquulsanaa ay ka fekeraan maaraynta iyo u diyaargarowga colaadda ka dhalan karta madaxbannaanida afeed ee loo socday in la gaaro. Taasi ma dhicin. Sida hadalka wasiirka ka muuqata, wax shiddo lehba looma arag. Wasiirkani wuxuu ahaa ninkii mas-uulka ka ahaa meelmarinta farta, dejinta siyaasaddeeda, eegidda caqabadaha iman kara, sida looga gaashaaman karo wixii ka yimaadda iyo sida la isaga difaaci karo wixii soo kordha. In uu jawaabo u diyaariyo su’aalahaas iska daaye, xataa warba kama hayn in farta la qaatay ay abuuri karto cadaawad. Adiga oo aan qoorta dhiiban ayaa laga fekeraa sida aad isaga furdaamin lahayd dhibaatooyinka kaa soo gaari kara arrimo kuu gaar ah oo masiiri ah. Se dhaqankii geeljiruhu sidaas ma aha. Ma aha mid ka cabsada berri iyo cid maqan wax la jira! Kuwa ka carooday ee Soomaalida ku colaadiyay farta ay qoratay ma ahayn reer Galbeed oo keliya. Waddamadii Carbeedna waxay gaareen meel ay reer Galbeedku ka fogaayeen. Wasiirkii Waxbarashada Soomaaliya, Aadan Maxamed Cali, ayaa sheegay inay shir kaga qaybgaleen dalka Marooko. Shirkaas, oo dhex marayay waddamada ku midaysan Jaamacadda Carabta, waxaa Soomaaliya hoggaaminayay Madaxweyne Maxamed Siyaad Barre. Wasiir Aadan wuxuu sheegay inay haaraan iyo hujuun badan kala kulmeen waddamadii Carbeed ee halkaas yimid, kuwaas oo aad uga caraysnaa farta ay Soomaaliya qaadatay. Wuxuu sheegay in Madaxweyne Siyaad uu isaga xilsaaray ka hadalka arrimaha farta iyo taageero u raadinteeda. Wuxuu yiri: “Shirkaas oo Marooko ka dhacay aad ayuu noogu adkaa. Mashruuca aan wadnay wuxuu ahaa adkaynta iyo xoojinta afka Carabiga. Waxaan ku niri: ‘Annaga waddankayaga afka Carabiga waxaa lagu dhigtaa dugsiyada Qur’aanka iyo xalaqooyinka masaajidda. Dadkayagu waxay u badan yihiin xufaadul Qur’aan, diintuna aad ayay noogu dheer tahay. Laakiin duruufo gaar ah ayaa keenay in aan farta Laatiinka qaadanno.’ Arrintaas aad ayaan u difaacnay, waanna qancinnay oo ka dhaadhicinnay waddamadii intooda badnaa, marka laga reebo waddamada Khaliijka Carabta. Waddamadii kale gacan xoog leh ayay nagu siiyeen arrintaas markii aan caddaymo keennay oo aan niri: ‘Annaga, haddii ay noqon lahayd xagga dhaqaalaha, xagga farsamada, kaalmo la’aanta, waddamada nagu wareegsan iyo waxa na kala haysta…’ Waan ku guulaysannay in aan ku qancinno waddamadii intooda badnaa.” Sida ka muuqata hadalka wasiirka, dalalkii Khaliijka oo ahaa kuwa saamaynta ugu badan ku lahaa, ilaa maantana ku leh Soomaaliya, waxay la gaddoomeen ciil iyo caro ay ka qaadeen farta Soomaalidu dooratay. Waxay ku biireen safkii gumaystaha ee miinada qarxinteeda u hawlgalay. Waxay Soomaalida u arkeen masaakiin kibirtay, waxayna guntadeen in tabartooda la tuso. Dhinac waxay ka tusayeen walaalnimo, dhinaca kalena waxay qodayeen godkii lagu xabaali lahaa agoonka madiga ah ee laandheeraha isku maleeyay! Carabtu markii ay doonayso inay nala dagaallanto, waxay naga soo gashaa masaajidda iyo culimada. Iyaga ayay saartaa manhaj liddi ku ah Soomaalida iyo jihada ay u socoto. Dawladda Masar waxay ka mid ahayd waddamada xiriirka dheer la lahaa Soomaaliya. Ayaamihii la doonayay xornimada, abaal ayay gashatay Soomaaliya. Maddaaris, iskuullo iyo culimo qayb ka noqda ilaalinta diinteenna suubban ayay soo dirtay. Markii xorriyadda la qaatay, weli garab ayay Soomaaliya u ahayd. Danaheedaba ha ku jireen, dagaalkii Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliya dhex maray xoogaa hub ah ayay Soomaaliya ku kaalmaysay. Hubkaasina xaqiiqdii wax weyn ayuu taray. Markii ay meesha ka baxday xukuumaddii Cabdirashiid, Masar waxay halis u aragtay Cabdirisaaq Xaaji Xuseen oo talada la wareegay. Abaalkii ay Soomaaliya u gashay iyo taageeradii yarayd ee ay weli siinaysay ayay doonaysay inay u beddesho aalad gumaysi. Cabdirisaaq wuxuu sheegay in Masar ay la gashay dagaal toos ah, ilaa ay masaajiddii iyo maddaaristii ay Xamar ku lahayd ka dhigtay meelo lagu faafiyo dacaayado ka dhan ah xukuumadda. Culimadii ayay nagu direen. Dawlad dabadhilif u ah reer Galbeedka ayay nagu shaabbadeeyeen. In aan dalkii ka iibinnay reer Galbeedka ayaa si joogto ah loogu soo qaadan jiray khudbadaha jimcaha. Sidaas oo kale, Carabtii Khaliijka ayaa culimada ugu kicisay dawladdii Soomaaliya. Masar marnaba si cad uma sheegan eed gaar ah oo laga galay. Sidaas oo kale, dalalkii Khaliijku wax loo dhibay ma sheegan ee dad u shaqeeya ayay dalka ka adeejiyeen. Dagaalkii 1977 ayay si cad isu muujiyeen aargoosigoodii markii ay garabkeenna ka baxeen. Haddaba, dagaalkii 1977 wuxuu qarxay iyadoo Soomaaliya saddex sano ka tirsanayd ururka Jaamacadda Carabta. Madaxweynihii waqtigaas, Jaalle Siyaad, wuxuu u duulay dalalka Carbeed, isaga oo dhinac kala socodsiinaya xaaladda soo korortay, dhinaca kalena ka doonaya kaalmo dhaqaale iyo saanad milatari. Sida uu qoray Admiral Faarax Axmed Cumar Jaalle Siyaad wuxuu tagay Sacuudiga oo la kulmay madaxdiisa. Madaxda dalkaasi waxay sameeyeen ballanqaad dhaqaale, balse waxay shardi uga dhigeen in Badda Cas ay noqoto bad Carbeed. Bishii sagaalaad 1977, xilligii uu dagaalkii Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliya marayay heerkiisii ugu adkaa, wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee Carabta ayaa si wadajir ah u soo saaray bayaan caddaynaya in ururka Jaamacadda Carabtu dhexdhexaad ka yahay dagaalka. Inkasta oo dagaalku u dhexeeyay xubin ka tirsan ururka iyo dal kale, Soomaaliya marnaba ma filayn in Carabtu qaadan doonto mawqif noocaas ah. Isla bayaankaas ayay Carabtu ku sheegtay in dagaalka la joojiyo, wadahadalkana dib loo furo. Waxay ahayd dharbaaxo mooraal jebisay Soomaaliya iyo tumaati dhabarka lagala dhacay xilli xaalku aad u xumaa. Xaqiiqdii, go’aankii far u samaynta af Soomaaliga wuxuu ahaa go’aan masiiri ah oo hirgelintiisu dalka u ahayd dhalinta gobannimo buuxda. Meesha dhaliishu ka jirto se waa sida loo wajahay, gaar ahaan u diyaargarowga iyo ogaanshaha in eed la galay. Soomaalidu qabweynideeda ayaa ku tiri: “Oo ma Carab baan uga baqaa farta carruurtaydu u baahan tahay? Cirka ha soo dumiyaan, cadceeddana ha damiyaan haddii ay doonaan. Loo joojin maayo.” Iyada oo aan cidna loo joojin ayaa la xeeladaystaa, aadna la isugu dayaa in hadafkaaga lagu gaaro cunfi la’aan. Arrinta fartuna waxay ahayd mid la xiriirta arrimaha gudaha oo, ilaa xad, dhibaatada ka timaadda la xakamayn karay ama ugu yaraan lala noolaan karay. Sidaas ayay Carabtii aan ehelka moodnay ee u irkannay noola dhaqmeen, sidii innaga oo ah dal yar oo dhinacii ay doonaan u jihayn karaan. Waxay doonayeen inay nagu sandulleeyaan dhaqanka iyo hiddaha Carbeed. “Nama qabato haddii aan niri waa inoo tahay,” ayay noogu jawaabeen. Xogo intaas ka sii badan oo isla mawduucan ku saabsan waxaad uga bogan doontaan buug dhawaan soo bixi doona oo cinwaankiisu yahay “Soomaaliya Maxay Saaxiib u Waday”, oo uu qorayo isla qoraha maqaalkani. WQ: braahin Aadan Shire Taariikhyahan iyo Qoraa
items.fullContent: Gumaystayaashii reer Yurub, kolka laga soo tago inay Afrika uga tageen colaado ku salaysan is-haysashada xuduudaha dhuleed, waxa kale oo ay uga tageen afafkoodii iyo dhaqamadoodii oo Afrika dacal ilaa dacal ku faafay. Dal kasta oo Afrikaan ah wuxuu qaatay afka gumaystihiisa. Soomaaliya waxaa kala qaybsaday Faransiis, Talyaani, Ingiriis iyo Itoobiyaan. Mid walba wuxuu doonayay, haddii uu meesha ka baxo, in afkiisu noqdo kan ugu muhiimsan qaybtii uu ku talin jiray. Talyaanigu, tusaale ahaan, wuxuu doonayay in af Talyaanigu noqdo afka hay’adaha dawladda iyo kan shacabkaba: afka wax lagu barto, wax lagu qoro, lagu xiriiro, laguna garto Soomaalidii Talyaanigu gumaystay. Ingiriiskuna sidaas oo kale ayuu doonayay. Af Soomaaliga waxaa lala damacsanaa inuu ku ekaado suuqa iyo guryaha oo keliya, sida ay noqdeen afaf badan oo kale oo Afrikaan ah. Soomaaliya waxay noqotay dalka keliya ee Afrikadii la gumaystay ee iska diidday doonitaankii gumaystayaashii. Markii ay xorowdayba, waxay guda gashay sidii ay u heli lahayd far qoran oo Soomaali ah. Dawladihii rayidka iyo dawladdii ciidamaduba mudnaanta koowaad ayay siiyeen qoridda farta af Soomaaliga. Markii ciidanku dalka qabsaday, wuxuu soo saaray bayaan uu ugu magac daray Xaashida Koowaad. Xaashidan waxaa lagu qeexay arrimaha mudnaanta u leh dawladda cusub iyo hiraalkeeda ku aaddan siyaasadaha gudaha iyo dibaddaba. Qodobka afraad wuxuu ahaa in la helo far u gaar ah afkeenna. Soomaalidu marnaba ma sawiran waxa ka dhalan kara markii ay u dhaqaaqeen hindisidda far u gaar ah afkooda. Warbixintii Guddiga Farta Soomaaliga marna laguma soo qaadin wax colaad ah oo laga filan karo qaadashada far u gaar ah af Soomaaliga. Wasiirkii Waxbarashada Soomaaliya ee xilka ugu muddada dheeraa, Aadan Maxamed Cali, ayaa qoray sidan: “Aniga oo haya Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, xafiiskayga waxaa iigu timid gabar Aljeeriya u dhalatay oo ka socotay wargeys ka hadla hiddaha iyo dhaqanka dalka Aljeeriya… Waxay iga waraysatay sidii farta af Soomaaliga loo qoray ee looga soo shaqeeyay, intii ka qaybqaadatay iyo mashaakilkii iyo dhibaatooyinkii innaga hor yimid. Arrimahaas oo dhan markii aan uga sheekeeyay, waxay igu tiri: ‘Marka ugu horraysa, waan idinku hambalyaynayaa.’ Dabadeedna waxay tiri: ‘Ma ogtihiin inaad miino ku dul taagan tihiin?’ Maye, ma ogi baan ku iri. Maxay se tahay miinadu? Waxay tiri: ‘Afrika laba dal baa isku dayay inay qoraan afkooda. Labadaas dal oo kala ah Kiinya iyo Itoobiya oo aad deris tihiin, labaduba kuma guulaysan, kamana gaarin meeshii la doonayay. Wayna shaqayn weyday. Inta kale, marka laga reebo dawladaha Carabta ee Waqooyiga Afrika deggan, waxay ku dhaqmaan afafkii gumaystayaashu kaga tageen dalalkaas: Ingiriis, Faransiis, Beljim iyo Holland/Netherlands. Waddamadaasina ma oggola in luqaddooda laga gudbo, dhaqankooda iyo hiddahoodiina laga tago. Weli waxay ku hawllan yihiin inay ummadda maskaxda ka sii haystaan. Arrintaasi waa miinada aad ku dul taagan tihiin. Sababtuna waa in aad arrimahoodii dhex gasheen dawlado waaweyn oo aqoon, dhaqaale, saamayn, miisaan, ciidan iyo taariikh dheerba leh. Madaxdii Soomaalidu way ku saxnaayeen inay ka fekeraan, u hawlgalaan, ugu dambaynna meelmariyaan qoridda afkeenna. Dhabtii, dadkii hawshaas qabtay abaal aan la gudi karin ayay nagu leeyihiin.
