Danaheedaba ha ku jireen, dagaalkii Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliya dhex maray xoogaa hub ah ayay Soomaaliya ku kaalmaysay. Hubkaasina xaqiiqdii wax weyn ayuu taray. Markii ay meesha ka baxday xukuumaddii Cabdirashiid, Masar waxay halis u aragtay Cabdirisaaq Xaaji Xuseen oo talada la wareegay. Abaalkii ay Soomaaliya u gashay iyo taageeradii yarayd ee ay weli siinaysay ayay doonaysay inay u beddesho aalad gumaysi. Cabdirisaaq wuxuu sheegay in Masar ay la gashay dagaal toos ah, ilaa ay masaajiddii iyo maddaaristii ay Xamar ku lahayd ka dhigtay meelo lagu faafiyo dacaayado ka dhan ah xukuumadda. Culimadii ayay nagu direen. Dawlad dabadhilif u ah reer Galbeedka ayay nagu shaabbadeeyeen. In aan dalkii ka iibinnay reer Galbeedka ayaa si joogto ah loogu soo qaadan jiray khudbadaha jimcaha. Sidaas oo kale, Carabtii Khaliijka ayaa culimada ugu kicisay dawladdii Soomaaliya. Masar marnaba si cad uma sheegan eed gaar ah oo laga galay. Sidaas oo kale, dalalkii Khaliijku wax loo dhibay ma sheegan ee dad u shaqeeya ayay dalka ka adeejiyeen. Dagaalkii 1977 ayay si cad isu muujiyeen aargoosigoodii markii ay garabkeenna ka baxeen. Haddaba, dagaalkii 1977 wuxuu qarxay iyadoo Soomaaliya saddex sano ka tirsanayd ururka Jaamacadda Carabta. Madaxweynihii waqtigaas, Jaalle Siyaad, wuxuu u duulay dalalka Carbeed, isaga oo dhinac kala socodsiinaya xaaladda soo korortay, dhinaca kalena ka doonaya kaalmo dhaqaale iyo saanad milatari. Sida uu qoray Admiral Faarax Axmed Cumar Jaalle Siyaad wuxuu tagay Sacuudiga oo la kulmay madaxdiisa. Madaxda dalkaasi waxay sameeyeen ballanqaad dhaqaale, balse waxay shardi uga dhigeen in Badda Cas ay noqoto bad Carbeed. Bishii sagaalaad 1977, xilligii uu dagaalkii Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliya marayay heerkiisii ugu adkaa, wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee Carabta ayaa si wadajir ah u soo saaray bayaan caddaynaya in ururka Jaamacadda Carabtu dhexdhexaad ka yahay dagaalka. Inkasta oo dagaalku u dhexeeyay xubin ka tirsan ururka iyo dal kale, Soomaaliya marnaba ma filayn in Carabtu qaadan doonto mawqif noocaas ah. Isla bayaankaas ayay Carabtu ku sheegtay in dagaalka la joojiyo, wadahadalkana dib loo furo. Waxay ahayd dharbaaxo mooraal jebisay Soomaaliya iyo tumaati dhabarka lagala dhacay xilli xaalku aad u xumaa. Xaqiiqdii, go’aankii far u samaynta af Soomaaliga wuxuu ahaa go’aan masiiri ah oo hirgelintiisu dalka u ahayd dhalinta gobannimo buuxda. Meesha dhaliishu ka jirto se waa sida loo wajahay, gaar ahaan u diyaargarowga iyo ogaanshaha in eed la galay. Soomaalidu qabweynideeda ayaa ku tiri: “Oo ma Carab baan uga baqaa farta carruurtaydu u baahan tahay? Cirka ha soo dumiyaan, cadceeddana ha damiyaan haddii ay doonaan. Loo joojin maayo.” Iyada oo aan cidna loo joojin ayaa la xeeladaystaa, aadna la isugu dayaa in hadafkaaga lagu gaaro cunfi la’aan. Arrinta fartuna waxay ahayd mid la xiriirta arrimaha gudaha oo, ilaa xad, dhibaatada ka timaadda la xakamayn karay ama ugu yaraan lala noolaan karay. Sidaas ayay Carabtii aan ehelka moodnay ee u irkannay noola dhaqmeen, sidii innaga oo ah dal yar oo dhinacii ay doonaan u jihayn karaan. Waxay doonayeen inay nagu sandulleeyaan dhaqanka iyo hiddaha Carbeed. “Nama qabato haddii aan niri waa inoo tahay,” ayay noogu jawaabeen. Xogo intaas ka sii badan oo isla mawduucan ku saabsan waxaad uga bogan doontaan buug dhawaan soo bixi doona oo cinwaankiisu yahay “Soomaaliya Maxay Saaxiib u Waday”, oo uu qorayo isla qoraha maqaalkani. items.title: Somalia: Mogadishu could fall without AU troops, says ex-minister
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Mogadishu “cannot be defended” if African Union troops withdraw from the country by December, Somalia’s former Minister of Planning Abdirahman Aynte said, adding that US diplomats have told Somali officials Washington will not reverse its decision to end logistics funding for the African Union peacekeeping mission regardless of the outcome of ongoing political talks. The warning comes against a backdrop of confirmed fact: on July 1, the United States formally notified the African Union it would stop funding the UN Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS) after December 31, 2026 — the logistics mechanism that supplies AUSSOM with food, fuel, transport, medical care and communications. Washington has said it would not block the UN Security Council from renewing AUSSOM’s mandate itself, but would block any UN logistical or operational support for the mission — a distinction analysts say leaves the roughly 12,000-strong force operationally unsustainable without a replacement funding arrangement. Aynte, who served as Somalia’s minister of planning and international cooperation from 2015 to 2017 under President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s first administration and previously worked as a journalist for the BBC, Voice of America and Al Jazeera English, said that during recent talks between the political opposition and the Somali government, US diplomats mediating the discussions delivered that message directly to Somali officials. According to Aynte, the diplomats said that if Somalia’s rival political factions reached a settlement, Washington would not obstruct other countries from stepping in to fund AUSSOM’s logistics after the US withdrawal. But if no settlement was reached, he said, the diplomats warned that Washington would actively work to prevent other nations from filling that gap. Aynte said AUSSOM troops cannot remain in the country without logistical support, and that Mogadishu would fall if the mission’s forces withdraw from the country. He said this assessment is not merely his own opinion but one shared by President Mohamud himself. His account aligns with the public record of a summit Mohamud attended in Kampala on July 31, where leaders of countries contributing troops to AUSSOM concluded three days of talks by agreeing to seek 18 to 24 months of uninterrupted international support for the mission, and endorsed a phased, coordinated withdrawal. Aynte said Mohamud personally appealed to the troop-contributing countries at that summit to keep their forces in Somalia even after logistics funding ends. “If the Somali government believes it can defend Mogadishu, why would it ask AUSSOM’s troop-contributing countries to keep their forces in the country?” Aynte asked. He further said that if Somali leaders fail to reach a political agreement, the international community would be indifferent to who governs the country, and would not object even if Al-Shabaab took power, provided the group renounced its Al-Qaeda affiliation and expelled foreign fighters. “I swear, if al-Shabaab accepts those two conditions and respects the borders of Kenya and Ethiopia, the international community will hand over the country’s security to the group the very next morning,” Aynte said. His remarks follow weeks of public statements from Somali officials seeking to ease fears of a government collapse in the event of an AUSSOM withdrawal. President Mohamud, the Security Minister and the National Security Advisor have all said Somalia’s security forces are fully capable of defending the country and assuming security responsibilities if AUSSOM departs. Mohamud went further on August 16, telling a graduation ceremony for roughly 3,000 newly trained Somali National Army soldiers in Galmudug that the country no longer needed foreign peacekeepers and that it was time to send them home “with a bunch of flowers.” Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Turkish Flag Burned in Puntland and Jubaland as Anger Grows Over Ankara’s Role in Somalia
items.description: EYL (WDN) — Anger over Turkey’s growing military and political role in Somalia has spilled into the streets, with protesters in Puntland burning the Turkish flag and similar displays of hostility reported in Jubaland, reflecting growing opposition to what critics describe as Ankara’s increasingly close alignment with the Federal Government in Mogadishu. In a coastal area near Eyl, Puntland, demonstrators burned the Turkish flag during a protest over the reported deaths of 13 people described by local residents as fishermen. The protesters accused Turkish forces of killing the men and demanded compensation for their families and for property they said was lost in the incident. Local Puntland officials, including Nugaal Governor Abdulkadir Osman Samatar (Food-cade), Deputy Governor Mukhtar Farah Jeer and Gen. Muxyadin Ahmed Muse, participated in the demonstration. The protesters warned that further demonstrations would follow unless Ankara addresses their demands. The incident is particularly significant because similar anti-Turkish sentiments have also surfaced in Jubaland, where the Turkish flag has reportedly been burned amid growing criticism of Ankara’s relationship with Mogadishu. Taken together, the demonstrations suggest that the controversy surrounding Turkey is developing beyond a single maritime incident and becoming part of a wider political debate over foreign military influence and Somalia’s internal political divisions. Turkish Military Role Under Scrutiny The Eyl protest follows conflicting accounts surrounding the reported deaths of 13 fisher men off the Nugaal coast. The Federal Government has described the men as suspected pirates killed during an operation involving Turkish naval forces. Local protesters, however, insist that the victims were fishermen. The circumstances surrounding the deaths, including the identities of those killed and the precise nature of the operation, is verified by the Puntland State. But the dispute has already intensified public scrutiny of Turkey’s military presence in Somali waters, particularly in Puntland, where relations with the Federal Government remain politically sensitive. From Security Partnership to Political Controversy Turkey has become one of Mogadishu’s most important international partners, providing military training, equipment and broader security assistance to Somali forces. Yet Ankara’s relationship with the Federal Government is increasingly being viewed through the lens of Somalia’s political divisions. Critics accuse Turkey of becoming too closely aligned with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration and argue that Turkish military support risks becoming entangled in disputes between Mogadishu and rival Federal Member States. They have also alleged that Turkish-supplied weapons and military capabilities have been used against political opponents and forces aligned with regional administrations. Those are allegations require independent verification. But the perception is becoming politically significant. For critics of Mogadishu, the concern is no longer simply whether Turkey is helping Somalia fight Al-Shabaab and other security threats. It is whether a foreign military power is becoming an actor in Somalia’s internal political struggle. Why Jubaland Matters The reported burning of the Turkish flag in Jubaland adds an important dimension to the controversy. Jubaland has been involved in repeated political and security disputes with the Federal Government, particularly over control of security forces, federal authority and political influence in the region. If anti-Turkish demonstrations emerge in both Puntland and Jubaland, that could indicate that opposition to Ankara’s role is increasingly connected to broader resistance to Mogadishu’s political strategy. The issue is therefore larger than Turkey itself. It concerns whether foreign military partnerships are strengthening Somalia’s national institutions—or unintentionally strengthening one political center against its rivals. A Growing Trust Problem The burning of the Turkish flag in Puntland and Jubaland is consequently more than an expression of anger over individual incidents. It reflects a growing trust problem. Turkey may regard its relationship with Somalia as a strategic partnership based on security, development and mutual interests. But if communities in different parts of Somalia increasingly perceive Turkish military assistance as support for the Federal Government’s political agenda, Ankara risks losing the image of neutrality that such a partnership requires. A foreign partner can provide weapons, training and military assistance without becoming politically neutral in the eyes of the public. Perception matters—particularly in a country where political legitimacy is already deeply contested. The Questions Ankara and Mogadishu Must Answer The latest controversy raises questions that deserve clear answers. Who authorized the operation off the Nugaal coast?  What exactly happened to the 13 men?   Were they armed pirates posing an immediate threat, or fishermen caught up in a disputed military operation? Was the operation conducted under a clearly defined Somali-Turkish legal framework? And what safeguards exist to ensure that Turkish-supplied weapons and military capabilities are not used in Somalia’s internal political conflicts? These questions matter because Somalia has legitimate security needs and requires international assistance. But that assistance must be transparent, accountable and governed by clear rules. The Wider Political Stakes The controversy comes as relations between Mogadishu and several Federal Member States remain strained over elections, constitutional amendments, security arrangements and the distribution of political authority. Turkey’s expanding military relationship with the Federal Government carries unavoidable political implications. For Puntland, Jubaland and other critics of Mogadishu, Ankara risks being seen not simply as a security partner but as a foreign power whose military support strengthens the federal government while Somalia’s political factions are confronting one another. Whether that perception is justified will ultimately depend on evidence, transparency and Turkey’s own conduct. But the political warning is already visible. When the Turkish flag is being burned in different parts of Somalia, Ankara should recognize that its Somalia policy is no longer being judged solely by the security assistance it provides. It is increasingly being judged by whose political power that assistance is perceived to strengthen. Turkey’s partnership with Somalia remains strategically important. But if Ankara wants that partnership to endure, it must convince Somalis that its military relationship is with Somalia as a country—not with one political faction within it. items.title: HirShabelle oo lagu kala baxay iyo Xasan Sheekh oo Guudlaawe siiyay kaarka JSP
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Waxaa si rasmi ah galabta loo soo afjaray dooddii muddada dheer ka taagnayd cidda noqonaysa musharraxa Xisbiga JSP ee doorashada maamulka HirShabelle, iyadoo ugu dambeyn kaarka musharraxnimada la siiyay Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe, kaas oo mar kale u taagan xilka madaxtinnimada Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle. Go’aankan ayaa ka dambeeyay kadib markii maanta xarunta dhexe ee Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wdaajirka (JSP) uu ku qabsoomay kulanka guddiga fulinta kaas oo uu shir guddoomiyay xoghayaha guud ee JSP, Dr. Xuseen Sheekh Maxamuud. Kulanka oo ahaa mid xasaasi ayaa diiradda lagu saaray u diyaar-garowga doorashada soo socota ee Dowlad Goboleedka HirShabelle, waxaana guddiga fulinta uu go’aamiyay in Madaxweyne Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen uu noqdo musharraxa rasmiga ah ee xisbiga ku metalaya doorashada HirShabelle. “Guddiga fulintu waxa uu si aqlabiyad leh ugu go’aamiyay in Mudane Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen uu noqdo musharraxa rasmiga ah ee Urur Siyaasadeedka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ugu taagnaan doono doorashada hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka HirShabelle,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wdaajirka (JSP) ee uu hoggaamiyo Xasan Sheekh. Go’aankan oo aad loo hadal-hayay, lana filayay ayaa xiisad horleh ka abuuray HirShabelle, iyada oo ay ka hor yimaadeen siyaasiyiinta reer Hiiraan oo markii horeba tabasho ka qabay dhismaha Maamul-goboleedka HirShabelle. Madaxweyne ku xigeenka HirShabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) oo kasoo jeeda beesha Xawaadle ee degta Hiiraan ayaa horay u sheegay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu si cad ugu sheegay in xilka maamulka HirShabelle uu u wado Cali Guudlaawe, taas oo maanta rumowday, maadaama la siiyay kaarka JSP, kuna metali doono doorashada guud ee HirShabelle. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) ayaa sidoo kale Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku eedeeyay inuu uga baxay ballan siyaasadeed oo uu la galay. Dabageed oo tilmaamay in Madaxweynaha ay horay ugu heshiiyeen, uguna ballanqaaday inuu hoggaanka HirShabelle isaga siiyo ayaa sheegay in Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu hadda waxba kama jiraan kasoo qaaday ballankaas, uuna kursiga siiyay Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe oo markale isa soo sharraxay. “Madaxweynihii xalay waxaan kala kulmay wax uu nin fiyow oo ehel iyo mas’uul ah oo Madaxweyne Soomaaliyeed uu dhihi karo aanan u qabin. Ballankii reer abtigay waa ka baxay ee kursiga iiga doon, oo iga nabad doonee ayuu igu dhahay,” ayuu yiri Dabageed. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray: “Intee geyni baa dhahay haddaan kasoo helo oo doono. Cali Guudlaawe ayaa siin buu yiri. Madaxweynaha uma badin ee waxaan dhahay arrintaas kama nabad dooneyn karo, nin hadda iga dambeeya oo ka nabaddooneyn kara inuu jiro ilama aha. Raalli ahow, wax aan ka filanayay oo reer abtiga ka sugayeen ma aha, oo xaqoodi ma aha.”   The post HirShabelle oo lagu kala baxay iyo Xasan Sheekh oo Guudlaawe siiyay kaarka JSP appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) ayaa sidoo kale Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku eedeeyay inuu uga baxay ballan siyaasadeed oo uu la galay. Dabageed oo tilmaamay in Madaxweynaha ay horay ugu heshiiyeen, uguna ballanqaaday inuu hoggaanka HirShabelle isaga siiyo ayaa sheegay in Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu hadda waxba kama jiraan kasoo qaaday ballankaas, uuna kursiga siiyay Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe oo markale isa soo sharraxay. “Madaxweynihii xalay waxaan kala kulmay wax uu nin fiyow oo ehel iyo mas’uul ah oo Madaxweyne Soomaaliyeed uu dhihi karo aanan u qabin. Ballankii reer abtigay waa ka baxay ee kursiga iiga doon, oo iga nabad doonee ayuu igu dhahay,” ayuu yiri Dabageed. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray: “Intee geyni baa dhahay haddaan kasoo helo oo doono. Cali Guudlaawe ayaa siin buu yiri. Madaxweynaha uma badin ee waxaan dhahay arrintaas kama nabad dooneyn karo, nin hadda iga dambeeya oo ka nabaddooneyn kara inuu jiro ilama aha. Raalli ahow, wax aan ka filanayay oo reer abtiga ka sugayeen ma aha, oo xaqoodi ma aha.”   The post HirShabelle oo lagu kala baxay iyo Xasan Sheekh oo Guudlaawe siiyay kaarka JSP appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Hirshabelle Drifts Away as Sr. Figures Warn of Another Somali Government
items.description: Jowhar (WDN) — Somalia’s federal system is facing another potentially destabilizing political rupture after senior Hirshabelle figures openly challenged President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s handling of the regional leadership and electoral process. Hirshabelle Vice President Yusuf Hagar (Dabageed) and former National Intelligence and Security Agency chief and lawmaker Abdullahi Mohamed (Sanbalooshe) have critically come against the president’s proposed plan for Hirshabelle election. Sanbaloolshe sharply criticized the president’s decision to support Ali Gudlawe remaining in power despite what Sanbaloolshe said was opposition from the Hawadle community. Sanbaloolshe warned that if Hassan Sheikh is satisfied to control Jowhar and Balcad without broader political agreement, Somalis could ultimately establish another government. “If Hassan Sheikh and Gudlawe are satisfied with Jowhar and Balcad, Somalis will establish another government,” Sanbaloolshe said. The warning comes as tensions over Hirshabelle’s political future increasingly expose the limits of Mogadishu’s influence outside the capital. Dabageed: No Election Without Political Agreement Hirshabelle Vice President Yusuf Hagar Dabageed has separately challenged the proposed electoral process, saying no election should take place in Hiiraan without a prior political agreement acceptable to the relevant stakeholders. Abdullahi Sanbalooshe and Yusuf Dabageed He said the requirement applied even to individual villages, warning that those who attempt to conduct elections without political consensus would bear responsibility for any consequences. Dabageed’s remarks highlight the depth of disagreement over how Hirshabelle’s next political leadership should be chosen. He also called on the Hawadle community to collectively consider its political future, saying discussions should involve members of the community both inside Somalia and abroad. Hirshabelle Joins a Wider Federal Crisis The dispute is unfolding as relations between Mogadishu and several Federal Member States remain strained. Puntland and Jubaland have adopted increasingly independent positions in their disputes with the Federal Government, while Southwest State has faced its own political and security confrontation with Mogadishu. Hirshabelle now appears to be moving toward a similar standoff. The emerging pattern points to a broader problem for the Federal Government: political authority cannot easily be imposed from Mogadishu when regional leaders and influential communities do not accept the process through which that authority is exercised. The risk is therefore not necessarily an immediate formal breakup of Somalia. It is the gradual development of de facto political fragmentation, with regional administrations increasingly making decisions independently of the center. The Test for Hassan Sheikh For President Hassan Sheikh, the choice is becoming increasingly difficult. Attempting to impose a preferred political outcome could intensify resistance in Hirshabelle. But failing to reach agreement with regional stakeholders could further weaken Mogadishu’s influence. The most viable path is political negotiation, not coercion as coercion will sure fail like Baidoa. That means clarifying the constitutional basis of the electoral process, addressing the concerns of Hiiraan and other stakeholders, and creating a framework that competing political actors can accept. Dabageed and Sanbaloolshe’s warning should therefore be viewed as more than another political statement. It reflects a growing challenge to the Federal Government’s ability to maintain a unified political system when regional actors increasingly insist on determining their own political arrangements. If Hirshabelle follows Puntland, Jubaland in distancing itself from Mogadishu, Somalia’s federal crisis will no longer be a series of separate disputes. It will become a national question about whether the current federal model can survive without a new political settlement . items.title: Galkacyo Killing Renews Calls to End Somalia’s Cycle of Clan Revenge
items.description: Galkacyo (WDN) — Government officials in Mudug are conducting efforts to identify and arrest those responsible for the killing of Sheikh Ahmed Yusuf Haamay, who was shot dead in Galkacyo several days ago, as the latest killing raises renewed fears of retaliatory violence. Regional officials said security forces are intensifying investigations and operations to locate the suspected perpetrators and establish both their identities and the motive behind the killing. The death has caused widespread grief and concern in Galkacyo, with residents and community leaders calling for the perpetrators to be brought before the courts and held accountable under the law. But the killing also highlights a much larger problem that Somalia cannot continue to ignore: the endless cycle in which one killing is followed by revenge, another death, another retaliation and eventually another round of clan violence. The immediate responsibility lies with the security authorities. Rather than allowing communities to pursue their own form of justice, the government must demonstrate that it has the capacity and determination to identify those responsible, arrest them and ensure that they face a transparent judicial process. A failure to do so creates a dangerous vacuum. When families and communities believe that the state cannot deliver justice, they may increasingly turn to traditional retaliation. What begins as an individual murder can then become a collective dispute involving entire clans. That is how isolated criminal acts become prolonged cycles of violence. Justice, Not Revenge Authorities have urged residents to provide information that could assist the investigation while warning against retaliatory actions. That message is critical. The murder of Sheikh Ahmed Yusuf Haamay should not become the justification for another killing. If the perpetrators are identified, responsibility must remain individual. Innocent members of their families or communities should not be treated as responsible for a crime they did not commit. The principle is simple: a murder must be answered with justice, not another murder. A Test of State Authority The case presents the Mudug authorities with an important test: whether the government can ensure that those responsible for the killing are identified, arrested and prosecuted through lawful institutions. That requires effective investigation, reliable intelligence, cooperation from local communities and a judiciary capable of delivering credible justice. Community leaders also have a responsibility to discourage inflammatory rhetoric and prevent grief from turning into collective retaliation. The killing of Sheikh Ahmed Yusuf Haamay should end with an investigation and a court case—not another death. For Somalia to escape the cycle of clan revenge, responsibility for justice must rest with the state, while communities reject collective punishment and allow individual perpetrators to answer for their crimes. items.title: Eritrea Accuses UAE of ‘Port Colonialism’ as Abu Dhabi’s Regional Footprint Expands
items.description: Asmara (WDN) — Eritrea has accused the United Arab Emirates of pursuing what it described as “port colonialism” in Africa, warning that Abu Dhabi’s expanding commercial, political and military footprint along the Red Sea, Gulf of Aden and East Africa deserves far greater scrutiny. Eritrea’s Foreign Minister Osman Saleh said the UAE’s growing presence in regional ports should not be viewed simply as a commercial enterprise. He argued that African governments should examine the broader strategic consequences of allowing a foreign power to establish long-term influence over critical maritime infrastructure. The criticism comes as UAE-linked companies, particularly DP World and AD Ports Group, have expanded their involvement in ports across Africa and the wider Red Sea region. Their interests include Berbera in Somaliland, Bosaso in Puntland, as well as port projects in countries including Egypt and Tanzania. For Eritrea, the concern is that commercial port investments can eventually create political and military leverage. From Ports to Power The UAE’s regional strategy illustrates how ports have become instruments of geopolitical influence. Control, management or long-term investment in strategically located ports can provide far more than commercial revenue. It can create logistical access, political relationships and influence over maritime trade routes that connect the Red Sea, Gulf of Aden and Indian Ocean. Dubai port, UAE That is why Eritrea has rejected proposals for a permanent UAE military presence on the Dahlak Islands. Abu Dhabi previously maintained a military facility at Assab, which it used during its involvement in the Yemen war. Asmara now says it does not want Eritrean territory or ports transformed into permanent foreign military platforms. The distinction between commercial investment and strategic influence has consequently become increasingly difficult to ignore. The UAE’s Troubled Regional Record The Eritrean warning also opens a much broader debate about the UAE’s role in conflict zones across the region and Africa. Critics of Abu Dhabi’s foreign policy point to its involvement, directly or indirectly, in conflicts and political struggles in Yemen, Libya and Sudan, among other theaters. They argue that UAE-backed actors and military relationships have frequently intensified existing rivalries rather than producing durable political settlements. The consequences have been particularly devastating in countries already suffering from institutional collapse and armed conflict. In Yemen, the UAE became a major participant in the Saudi-led military intervention and supported local forces pursuing their own political and territorial agendas. In Libya, Abu Dhabi has been accused of providing military and political backing to forces opposed to the internationally recognized authorities, contributing to the country’s complex fragmentation. In Sudan, the UAE has faced persistent allegations of supporting the Rapid Support Forces, accusations Abu Dhabi has repeatedly denied. The devastating war that erupted in 2023 has nevertheless transformed Sudan into one of the world’s worst humanitarian crises. These cases do not prove that the UAE alone caused the conflicts. Local political failures, rival regional powers, armed groups and international actors have all played significant roles. But they raise a legitimate question about Abu Dhabi’s model of foreign engagement: Does the UAE’s pursuit of strategic influence help stabilize fragile states—or does it deepen conflicts by empowering selected local actors? Eritrea Watches Ethiopia and Somalia Asmara is particularly concerned about the UAE’s growing relationship with Ethiopia, especially as Addis Ababa seeks reliable access to the sea. Eritrea also views with suspicion the strengthening relationship between Israel and Somaliland. From Asmara’s perspective, the convergence of UAE, Ethiopian, Israeli and Somaliland interests around ports and maritime access could fundamentally alter the strategic balance along the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. The concern is not simply who owns or manages a port. It is who ultimately gains strategic influence over the surrounding territory, maritime routes and security arrangements. The Red Sea and Horn of Africa are rapidly becoming a major arena of international competition. The UAE is only one of several external powers seeking influence. Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Iran, Israel, the United States, China and European states all have strategic interests in the region. Ports have consequently become much more than infrastructure projects. They are increasingly linked to military logistics, energy security, trade routes, fisheries, investment and geopolitical influence. This makes Eritrea’s warning particularly significant. Asmara is effectively arguing that African countries should not judge foreign port investments solely by the promised economic benefits. They should also examine what political and strategic obligations may accompany those investments over the long term. The Cost of Foreign Intervention The wider lesson from Sudan, Libya and Yemen is that foreign intervention can produce consequences far beyond the original strategic objective. When external powers support competing local factions, provide weapons or establish security partnerships, they can unintentionally—or deliberately—reshape domestic power balances in ways that make political compromise more difficult. The result can be prolonged conflict, fragmented authority and weakened national institutions. This is where the strongest criticism of the UAE emerges. Abu Dhabi has become exceptionally skilled at converting commercial relationships into strategic influence. The question is whether that influence ultimately produces stability—or simply gives the UAE greater leverage over countries already struggling to govern themselves. Africa Must Ask Harder Questions Eritrea’s accusation of “port colonialism” should therefore not be dismissed as simply another regional political dispute. African governments have every right to attract foreign investment and develop their ports. But they also have a responsibility to ensure that strategic infrastructure remains subject to transparent agreements, national oversight and clearly defined security arrangements. Port investments should not quietly evolve into permanent military footholds. Commercial partnerships should not become mechanisms for political dependency. And foreign security assistance should not empower armed actors at the expense of national institutions and peaceful political settlements. The UAE’s expanding footprint across the Red Sea and Africa is a reality. Whether it ultimately contributes to stability or deepens regional fragmentation will depend on how Abu Dhabi uses its growing influence—and how firmly African states insist on transparency and accountability. The real issue is no longer whether the UAE is investing in Africa. It is what Africa is becoming in return: a partner in mutually beneficial development, or a collection of strategic assets in someone else’s geopolitical competition. items.title: General Sahal Cabdullaahi oo kormeeray goobaha laga ilaaliyo amniga Baydhabo
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar oo booqasho ku jooga Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa kormeeray fariisimaha ay Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ku leeyihiin bannaanada magaaladaasi. Ciidamada oo degan darafyada magaalada iyo waddooyinka laga soo galo ayaa ka ilaaliya amniga Baydhabo, si ay uga hortaggaan khataraha amniga. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa qiimayn ku sameynayay qaabka Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ay isaga kaashanayaan howlaha sugidda amniga iyo difaaca magaalada. Magaalada ayaa billihii u dambeeyay isu bedeshay goob ay ku loolamaan maamulka cusub ee Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu hoggaamiyo iyo hoggaankii hore ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Ciidamo taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab oo isku dhafan ayaa lagu eedeeyay in ay qalqalgelinayaan amniga magaaladaasi. General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa waxaa kormeerkan ku wehlinayay Taliyaha Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/dhexe Isaaq Aadan Berdaale iyo Saraakiil kale. Si kastaba ha-ahaatee Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa Taliska Qaybta 60aad iyo hay’adaha ammaanka kala shaqeynaya dadaalada lagu adkeynayo amniga magaalada iyo deegaanada hoostaga.

items.title: Somalia traders seek new shipping routes amid Bab al-Mandab tensions
items.description: Somalia’s business community is seeking alternative shipping routes due to disruptions and security concerns around the Bab al-Mandab Strait and the Strait of Hormuz after Iran-backed Houthis captured a key port city and an island, sending thousands of Yemenis fleeing to neighboring Djibouti. Companies have traditionally imported goods from Asia through Gulf countries, such as the United Arab Emirates, Oman, and Saudi Arabia. Now, some are trying a more direct approach. “The latest tensions in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, as well as those in the Strait of Hormuz , have negatively impacted us,” said Mohamed Ali Nur, director of Mogadishu Seaport. “But we have also taken measures to avoid that disruption.” Nur said his port has worked with exporters to find alternative routes. “For the first time, we brought a ship carrying sugar directly from Sri Lanka,” Nur said. “This could be a strategy we developed because of these tensions.” Yemen’s internationally recognized government and Saudi Arabia have been battling the Houthis for 12 years. The recent escalation has ended a ceasefire that had largely stopped civil war across Yemen since 2022. Now the number of people from Yemen fleeing the fighting is soaring. On Sunday, the International Organization for Migration said over 85,000 people have been displaced since the beginning of the month. More than 2,000 people have reached Djibouti, which neighbors Somalia, the agency said. At Mogadishu’s busy seaport, cargo ships continue to unload food and other commodities. Somalia is particularly dependent on maritime trade for many of the goods its people use every day. For ordinary Somali consumers, changes in shipping routes can eventually be felt in the markets, where imported food and other goods are sold. Longer or more complicated journeys can mean higher transportation costs and delays in getting products onto store shelves. Capt Ali Jemdi, who is originally from Syria and ships cargoes of sugar, said uncertainty in the region is already creating concerns for ships operating along the routes. “There is some trouble over there because of the war,” he told The Associated Press, referring to the Arabian Gulf and surrounding waters. “The Bab el-Mandeb may also have some issues for the vessel.” He said the instability could make maritime transportation and trade more difficult. items.title: Dagaalka Yemen oo Qaxooti Cusub Ku Soo Riixaya Jabuuti
items.description: Ku dhowaad 500 Qaxooti Yemeni ah oo gaaray Jabuuti, iyadoo dagaalladu ka sii darayaan OBOCK, Jabuuti — Ku dhowaad 500 qof oo ka soo qaxay Yemen, oo ay ku jiraan haween iyo carruur, ayaa gaaray magaalada Obock ee waqooyiga Jabuuti, kaddib markii doonyo ay saarnaayeen ay shidaal la’aan ku adkaatay inay sii socdaan. Dhacdadan ayaa muujinaysa sida colaadda Yemen ay u saameynayso dalalka ku yaalla dhinaca kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed. Wasiirka Dhaqaalaha iyo Maaliyadda Jabuuti, Ilyas Moussa Dawaleh, ayaa 11 Sebteembar 2026 ku sheegay qoraal uu ku daabacay X in qaxootiga la badbaadiyay xilli ay badda ku jireen, qaar ka mid ah doonyahooduna ay shidaal ka dhammaaday. Wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada badda, Ilaalada Xeebaha iyo hay’adaha kale ee dalka ay ku howlan yihiin samatabbixinta iyo gargaarka degdegga ah ee dadka soo gaaraya. Jabuuti oo wajahaysa baahiyo bini’aadantinimo Sida uu wasiirku sheegay, dadka soo gaaray Obock waxaa ka mid ah haween iyo carruur, kuwaas oo u baahan hoy, cunto, biyo iyo daryeel caafimaad. Qoraalkiisa kuma cadda tirada saxda ah ee dadka dhaawacmay ama xaaladda caafimaad ee dhammaan dadka la badbaadiyay. Jabuuti waxay muddo dheer martigelinaysay dadka ka soo cararaya colaadda Yemen. Magaalada Obock ayaa sidoo kale ah meel muhiim u ah isu-socodka dadka u kala gudba Geeska Afrika iyo Jasiiradda Carabta, taas oo ka dhigaysa goob ay ku kulmaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada qaxootinimo iyo socdaalka badda. Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan qaxootiga (UNHCR) ayaa sheegtay in Jabuuti ay tahay meel istiraatiiji ah oo ay dadka ka soo gudbaan marka ay u socdaan Yemen iyo dalalka Khaliijka. Warbixin ay soo saartay bishii Luulyo 2026 ayaa xustay in in ka badan 100,000 qof, badankood Itoobiyaan ah, ay sannad kasta Yemen uga safraan Geeska Afrika. Colaadda Yemen oo sii xumaynaysa xaaladda Soo gaarista qaxootigan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli dagaallada Yemen ay mar kale sii xoogeysanayaan. Warbixinno la daabacay 10 iyo 12 Sebteembar 2026 ayaa sheegay in xoogagga Xuutiyiinta ay qabsadeen magaalada dekedda ah ee Mocha, isla markaana ay u dhaqaaqeen deegaanno ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab el-Mandeb. Dhaqdhaqaaqyadaas ayaa sababay barakac cusub iyo cabsi laga qabo in colaadda ay saameyn ku yeelato isu-socodka badda. Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Socdaalka (IOM) ayaa hore uga digtay khataraha ka jira waddada badda ee u dhexeysa Jabuuti iyo Yemen. Warbixin ay soo saartay 2026 ayaa sheegtay in bilihii Janaayo ilaa Sebteembar 2025 la diiwaangeliyay 890 dhimasho iyo dad la waayay oo ku dhacay waddadaas, halka ku dhowaad 94,000 qof ay ka ambabaxeen xeebaha Obock muddadaas. Dowladda Jabuuti oo ballanqaadday sii wadista gargaarka Wasiirka Dhaqaalaha iyo Maaliyadda Jabuuti ayaa sheegay in gurmadka hadda socda uu qayb ka yahay siyaasadda bani’aadantinimo ee Madaxweyne Ismaïl Omar Guelleh, taas oo dalka ku dhiirrigelisay inuu soo dhaweeyo dadka ka cararaya colaadda Yemen. Jabuuti waxay sidoo kale dib u xaqiijisay mowqifkeeda ku aaddan xorriyadda maraakiibta, ixtiraamka sharciga caalamiga ah iyo dadaallada lagu dejinayo xiisadaha gobolka. Dowladda ayaa ku baaqday in la helo xal siyaasadeed oo waara oo lagu soo afjaro colaadda Yemen. Ilaa hadda, tirada dadka la xaqiijiyay inay soo gaareen Obock waa ku dhowaad 500, sida uu sheegay wasiirka Jabuuti. Ma jiraan xog madax-bannaan oo si buuxda u xaqiijinaysa tirada guud ee dadka ka soo qaxay Yemen ee gaaray dalka tan iyo bilowgii xiisadda cusub. The post Dagaalka Yemen oo Qaxooti Cusub Ku Soo Riixaya Jabuuti first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya iyo Yemen oo ka wada hadlay xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladda Yemen
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cali, ayaa khadka telefoonka kula hadlay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Qurba-joogta Jamhuuriyadda Yemen, Dr. Afrah Abdulaziz Al-Zouba. Labada wasiir ayaa ka wada hadlay xoojinta xiriirka laba geesoodka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Yemen, iyo sidoo kale xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee ka socda dalka Yemen. Wasiir Cabdisalaan Cali ayaa mar kale xaqiijiyay mowqifka Soomaaliya ee taageerada midnimada, amniga iyo xasilloonida Yemen. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa adkeeyay danaha wadajirka ah ee ay leeyihiin labada dal ee deriska ah, kuwaas oo ay kala qaybiyaan gacanka Cadmeed, gaar ahaan iskaashiga dhinaca ammaanka badda iyo ilaalinta badqabka maraakiibta iyo socdaalka caalamiga ah ee badda. Wadahadalkan ayaa muujinaya muhiimadda ay Soomaaliya iyo Yemen siinayaan xoojinta iskaashiga gobolka, iyadoo labada dal ay wadaagaan dano istiraatiiji ah oo la xiriira amniga iyo xasilloonida marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah ee Gacanka Cadmeed.

items.title: Sanbalooshe oo dhaliilay siyaasadda madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee Hir-shabeelle
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Taliyihii hore ee Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda iyo Sirdoonka Qaranka Soomaaliya (NISA), Xildhibaan Cabdullaahi Maxamed Cali (Sanbaloolshe) ayaa dhaliil u jeediyay siyaasadda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo habka ay dowladda federaalka u maamusho arrimaha dalka. Sanbaloolshe ayaa sheegay in maamulka dowladda uu qeyb ka yahay xaaladda xasillooni-darrada siyasadeed iyo amnia ee Soomaaliya, isagoo ku eedeeyay dowladda inay qaadato siyaasado aan wax ka qaban karin khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee dalka ka jira. Wuxuu sidoo kale tilmaamay in xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo tan amni ay si weyn isugu xiran yihiin, isla markaana khilaafaadka u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo dhinacyada kale ee siyaasadda ay saameyn ku yeelan karaan dadaallada lagu doonayo in lagu xoojiyo amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka. Ilaa hadda, dhinaca dowladda federaalka kama uusan soo bixin jawaab rasmi ah oo si gaar ah uga falcelinaysa eedeymaha Xildhibaan Cabdullaahi Sanbaloolshe. Hadallada taliyihii hore ee NISA ayaa sidoo kale kusoo kordhaya doodda siyaasadeed ee gudaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo madaxda dowladda iyo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ay si kala duwan u qiimeeyaan habka loo wajahayo caqabadaha amni iyo siyaasadeed ee dalka. The post Sanbalooshe oo dhaliilay siyaasadda madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ee Hir-shabeelle appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Puntland oo Badhan Ka Mamnuucday Hubka iyo Gaadiidka Ciidan ee Aan Rasmiga Ahayn
items.description: Badhan, 13 Sebteembar — Maamulka Puntland ayaa magaalada Badhan ka bilaabay tallaabooyin cusub oo lagu xakameynayo hubka, kaddib iska-horimaad ay laba qof ku dhinteen, saddex kalena ku dhaawacmeen. Qof kasta oo hub ku dhex sita magaalada ama wata gaari ciidan oo aan ka diiwaangashanayn laamaha amniga ayaa la sheegay in la qaban doono. Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Amniga Puntland ee dhinaca Difaaca, Fu’aad Xaanano, ayaa sheegay in amarkan lagu go’aamiyey kulan amni oo looga hadlay shaqaaqadii ugu dambeysay iyo xaaladda xasaasiga ah ee ka dhalatay. Ujeeddada ayaa lagu sheegay in hubka sharci-darrada ah laga fogeeyo magaalada, lagana hortago rabshado kale. Ciidamada amniga ayaa la faray inay gacanta ku dhigaan dadka jebiya amarka iyo gaadiidka ciidan ee aan ka tirsanayn hay’adaha rasmiga ah. Dadka la qabto ayaa lagu wareejin doonaa hay’adaha sharciga, inkastoo aan weli la shaacin ciqaabta lagu mutaysan karo jebinta go’aanka. Xaanano ayaa sidoo kale digniin u diray kooxo uu sheegay inay dibadda uga yimaadeen Badhan, kuwaas oo lagu tuhunsan yahay inay qayb ka ahaayeen shaqaaqadii ka dhacday magaalada. Wuxuu ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan dhaqdhaqaaq kasta oo dib u hurin kara colaadda ama khatar gelin kara dadka deegaanka. Maamulka Puntland ayaa sheegay in ciidamadu sii xoojin doonaan sugidda amniga iyo ilaalinta goobaha muhiimka ah ilaa xaaladdu ka degayso. Lama shaacin in dad loo qabtay shaqaaqada, cidda ay ahaayeen dhinacyadii isku dhacay iyo waxa sababay iska-horimaadka dhimashada iyo dhaawaca geystay. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in marka amniga la xasiliyo loo gudbi doono qorshayaasha horumarinta Badhan. Magaalada iyo deegaannada kale ee Sanaag ayaa muddooyinkii dambe wajahaya xiisado iyo dhacdooyin hubeysan, kuwaas oo caqabad ku noqday xasilloonida iyo nolol-maalmeedka bulshada.

items.title: Eritrea Oo Imaaraadka Ku Eedaysay Gumeysi Dekedeed Oo Afrika Ka Socda
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Eritrea, Cismaan Saalax, ayaa Imaaraadka Carabta ku eedeeyey inuu Afrika ka wado qorshe uu ku ballaarinayo saamayntiisa dekedaha. Wasiirku wuxuu tallaabooyinkaasi ku tilmaamay “gumeysi dekedeed”, isaga oo sheegay in aysan ku koobnayn maalgashi ganacsi, balse ay la xiriiraan dano istiraatiiji iyo kuwo militari. Wareysi uu siiyey Middle East Eye, ayuu Cismaan Saalax su’aal geliyey sababta Imaaraadku xarumo dekedeed uga samaysanayo dalal badan oo ku yaalla Afrika, gaar ahaan Geeska Afrika iyo hareeraha Badda Cas. Wuxuu sheegay in dowladaha Afrika looga baahan yahay inay si taxaddar leh u qiimeeyaan ujeeddooyinka ka dambeeya heshiisyada dekedaha iyo saamaynta ay ku yeelan karaan madaxbannaanidooda. Wasiirku wuxuu si gaar ah farta ugu fiiqay xiriirka Imaaraadka iyo Israa’iil iyo danaha ay ka leeyihiin Somaliland. items.title: Baydhabo oo Loo Sameynayo Saldhigyo iyo Difaacyo Amni oo Cusub
items.description: Baydhabo, 13 Sebteembar — Hoggaanka Koonfur Galbeed iyo saraakiisha ciidamada federaalka ayaa dejiyey qorshe lagu adkaynayo ammaanka magaalada Baydhabo, kaas oo ay qayb ka yihiin saldhigyo iyo difaacyo cusub oo laga sameynayo waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee magaalada soo gala. Qorshahan ayaa la sheegay in lagu go’aamiyey kulan dhexmaray hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur Madoobe, saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Daraawiishta maamulka. Saraakiisha ayaa lagu amray inay joogteeyaan kormeerka furimaha ku dhow Baydhabo. Saldhigyada cusub ayaa laga dhisayaa duleedka magaalada iyo meelaha ugu dambeeya ee laga soo galo, si ciidamada loogu sameeyo difaacyo isku xiran. Hase yeeshee, weli lama shaacin tirada saldhigyada, goobaha saxda ah iyo muddada lagu dhammaystirayo. Ujeeddada qorshaha ayaa lagu sheegay ka hortagga weerarrada Al-Shabaab iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada kooxo hubeysan oo lagu eedeeyo inay taageersan yihiin hoggaamiyihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Laftagareen. Dhinacyada lagu eedeeyey arrintan kama aysan jawaabin sheegashada. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inay ciidamo dheeraad ah geysay Baydhabo, kuwaas oo garab siinaya Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed. Tirada ciidamada la geeyey, cutubyada ay ka tirsan yihiin iyo waajibaadka gaarka ah ee loo xilsaaray lama shaacin. Faahfaahinta qorshaha difaacyada cusub waxay ku salaysan tahay ilo aan magacyadooda la sheegin, mana jiro bayaan rasmi ah oo dhammaan qodobbada xaqiijinaya. Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xaalad amni iyo siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah, balse xiriir toos ah oo ka dhexeeya qorshaha iyo duqaymihii dhowaan dhacay lama xaqiijin.

items.title: DF oo soo saartay digniin halis ah iyo 29 magaalo oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Soomaaliya (SODMA) ayaa soo saartay digniin cusub oo ku saabsan roobab culus iyo fatahaado laga filayo qaybo ka mid ah dalka xilliga Deyrta oo ku beegan bilaha October, November iyo December 2026. SODMA ayaa sheegtay in 29 magaalo oo ku kala yaalla 14 gobol loo aqoonsaday inay yihiin meelaha ugu nugul fatahaadaha ka dhalan kara roobabka la saadaaliyay, kuwaas oo hay’addu sheegtay inay la xiriiraan xaaladda Super El Niño. Hay’addu waxay tilmaantay in digniinta aan looga gol lahayn in bulshada lagu cabsi geliyo, balse ay tahay fursad ay dadka iyo hay’aduhu hore ugu diyaar-garoobi karaan, si loo yareeyo khasaaraha nafeed iyo midka hantiyeed ee ka dhalan kara fatahaadaha. Soomaaliya ayaa la filayaa inay wajahdo laba nooc oo fatahaado ah, sida ay sheegtay SODMA. Midka koowaad waa fatahaadaha webiyada, gaar ahaan meelaha ku teedsan webiyada Shabeelle iyo Jubba, iyadoo roobabka ka da’a gudaha Soomaaliya iyo dhulka sare ee Itoobiya ay kordhin karaan qulqulka biyaha. Nooca labaad ayaa ah daadadka degdegga ah, kuwaas oo ka dhalan kara roobab xooggan oo muddo gaaban da’a, waxaana ay saameyn karaan magaalooyin, tuulooyin, waddooyin, togag iyo dhulalka hoose. Degmooyinka lagu daray meelaha khatarta sare leh waxaa ka mid ah Doolow, Luuq, Baardheere, Bu’aale, Beledweyne, Buulo Burde, Jowhar, Muqdisho, Hargeysa, Garowe, Boosaaso, Qardho, Baydhabo, Gaalkacyo, Kismaayo, Afgooye, Buur-dhuubo, Jilib, Afmadow, Diinsoor, Qansaxdheere, Jamaame, Ceel-Barde, Sablaale, Kuntiwaarey, Marka, Baraawe, Dhuusamareeb iyo Balcad. SODMA ayaa dadka ku nool meelaha khatarta ah ugu baaqday inaysan sugin ilaa biyuhu gaaraan guryahooda, balse ay si joogto ah ula socdaan digniinaha rasmiga ah ee dowladda iyo maamullada deegaanka. “Dadka waa inay sii ogaadaan goobaha ammaan ah ee ay u guuri karaan, waddooyinka daadgureynta, ayna diyaarsadaan waxyaabaha aasaasiga ah sida dawooyinka, biyaha, cuntada, taleefoonnada iyo dukumentiyada muhiimka ah,” ayay sheegtay hay’addu. Hay’addu waxay si gaar ah carruurta uga digtay inay u dhowaadaan biyaha fatahaadaha, halka dadka wata gaadiidka loogu baaqay inaysan gelin biyo socda oo aysan garanayn qotodooda. Sidoo kale, waxay sheegtay inay waddo qorsheyaal lagu xoojinayo isku-duwidda hawlaha gargaarka iyo soo saarista digniinaha hore. Maamullada gobollada iyo degmooyinka ayaa lagu boorriyay inay diyaariyaan goobaha dadka loo daadgureynayo, waddooyinka badbaadada, gaadiidka iyo awoodda gurmadka degdegga ah, gaar ahaan doomaha iyo gaadiidka waaweyn ee lagu samatabbixin karo dadka. SODMA ayaa sidoo kale culimada, odayaasha, haweenka, dhallinyarada, ganacsatada iyo warbaahinta ka codsatay inay ka qayb qaataan gaarsiinta fariimaha digniinta ah ee bulshada. Ugu dambeyn, hay’addu waxay dadka ku nool meelaha fatahaaduhu ku soo noqnoqdaan si gaar ah ugu fartay inay ka fogaadaan togagga, marinnada biyaha iyo dhulka hoose xilliyada roobabka culus, iyadoo sheegtay inay bulshada si joogto ah ula wadaagi doonto digniinaha la xiriira xaaladda. The post DF oo soo saartay digniin halis ah iyo 29 magaalo oo… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Jabuuti oo qaabishay qaxooti kasoo cararay dagaalka Yemen
items.description: Jabuuti (Raxanreeb Online) Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti ayaa muddo 24 saacadood gudahood ah qaabishay ku dhowaad 1,400 qof oo u dhashay dalka Yemen, kuwaas oo ka soo cararay colaadaha iyo xaaladda amni ee ka jirta dalkooda. Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Jabuuti ayaa sheegay in dadkaasi ay dalka soo galeen iyagoo raadinaya badbaado iyo meel ammaan ah, , kaddib markii ay ka soo carareen xaaladda adag ee colaadeed ee Yemen. Jabuuti waxay muddo dheer ahayd meel ay ku hakadaan ama magan-galaan dadka ka soo cararaya colaadaha ka jira gobolka, gaar ahaan dadka ka imaanaya Yemen oo ku dhow dhinaca kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed. Soo-gelitaanka tiradan badan ee qaxootiga ah muddo gaaban ayaa sare u qaadaya baahida loo qabo hoy, cunto, daryeel caafimaad iyo adeegyo kale oo bani’aadamnimo, gaar ahaan haddii qulqulka dadka ka soo baxaya Yemen uu sii socdo. Mas’uuliyiinta Jabuuti ayaa wajahaya caqabado la xiriira sidii loo maareyn lahaa dadka cusub ee soo gaaray dalka, iyadoo loo baahan yahay iskaashi dheeraad ah oo lala yeesho hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo kuwa gargaarka si loo daboolo baahiyaha qaxootiga. Qaxootigan ayaa kusoo biiraya kumannaan qof oo Yemeniyiin ah oo sannadihii lasoo dhaafay u qaxay dalalka ku yaalla gobolka, iyagoo ka cararaya colaadda daba dheeraatay ee Yemen. Xaaladda ayaa muujinaysa saameynta bani’aadamnimo ee colaadaha gobolka oo sii kordheysa. The post Jabuuti oo qaabishay qaxooti kasoo cararay dagaalka Yemen appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Maxkamadda ciidamada oo xukun adag ku riday askari sabab yaab leh u dilay muwaadin
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa maanta xukun dil toogasho ah ku ridday Dable Xoogga Maxamuud Axmed Faarax oo loo yaqaan Kabtan Dhashiike, kaas oo lagu helay dilka marxuum Cabdicasiis Sheekh Xuseen. Xukunka ayaa ah qisaasta marxuumka, waxaana sidaas warbaahinta u sheegay Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee darajada koowaad, Gaashaanle Sare Xasan Cali Nuur Shuute. Dilka ayaa dhacay 15-kii May 2026, gudaha degmada Luuq ee gobolka Gedo, waxaana eedeysanaha lagu soo oogay inuu si kas ah u dilay Cabdicasiis Sheekh Xuseen. Sida lagu sheegay faah-faahinta kiiska, eedeysanaha iyo marxuumka oo uusan ka dhaxeyn xiriir ama wax is-dhaafsi ayaa isku arkay guri ku yaalla dhanka beeraha ee degmada Luuq, xilli uu jiray khilaaf hore oo u dhexeeyay. Kabtan Dhashiike oo sigaar watay ayaa bilaabay inuu raadiyo kabriid ama jante uu ku shito, wuxuuna weydiistay qof lagu magacaabo Koofi oo labadooduba ay saaxiib ahaayeen. Marxuum Cabdicasiis oo haystay jantaha ayaa sida lagu sheegay kiiska jeebka ku ritay, taas oo keentay inuu eedeysanuhu ka caroodo, kadibna uu AK-47 labo xabbadood kaga dhufto marxuumka. Cabdicasiis Sheekh Xuseen ayaa goobtaasi ku geeriyooday, waxaana markii dambe kiiska baaritaan ku sameeyay Xafiiska Xeer Ilaalinta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida. Kadib baaritaan dheer, Xafiiska Xeer Ilaalinta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa codsaday in kiiska la qaado, waxaana codsigaasi la oggolaaday 3-dii Sebtembar 2026. Maxkamadda ayaa waqti ku filan siisay dhinacyada dacwadda, ka hor inta aysan maanta soo saarin xukunka dilka toogashada ah oo ah qisaasta marxuum Cabdicasiis Sheekh Xuseen. The post Maxkamadda ciidamada oo xukun adag ku riday askari sabab yaab leh u dilay muwaadin appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Guddoonka baarlamanka oo joojiyay lacag xildhibaannada laga jari jiray – Maxay ahayd?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoonka Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa go’aan ku gaaray in la joojiyo lacag si joogto ah looga jari jiray xildhibaannada, taas oo loogu tala-galay in lagu daboolo kharashaadka aaska xildhibaan geeriyooda. Lacagtan oo dhaneyd $100 ayaa waxaa la joojiyay kadib markii qaar kamid ah xildhibaannada ay su’aalo ka keeneen lacagta laga jaro mushaharkooda iyo qaabka loo maamulo, iyagoo dalbaday in loo caddeeyo halka ay ku baxdo iyo cidda mas’uulka ka ah maamulkeeda. Guddoonka Golaha Shacabka oo su’aalo dhowr ah kala kulmay xildhibaannada ayaa ugu dambeyn ku dhawaaqay in la joojiyay lacagtaasi oo muddo dheer si joogto ah looga jarayay xildhibaannada. Arrintan ayaa dood ka dhex dhalisay xildhibaannada, iyadoo qaar ay taageereen joojinta lacagta, halka kuwo kale ay sheegeen in ujeeddada su’aalahoodu aysan ahayn in la joojiyo, balse ay ahayd in la ogaado halka ay ku baxdo iyo sida loo maareeyo. Xildhibaan Cabdisalaam Xaaji Axmed Liibaan Dhabancad ayaa sheegay in xildhibaannadu xaq u leeyihiin inay guddoonka wax ka weydiiyaan sida loo maareeyo lacagtaas. “Lacagtaas laga qaado xildhibaannada isku geyn ahaan waxay gaareysa $75,500,” ayuu yiri xildhibaanka oo kamid ahaa xubnihii guddoonka ka dalbaday caddeyn dhab ah. Dhabancad ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in su’aalaha xildhibaannadu ka keeneen lacagta ay la xiriireen isla xisaabtanka iyo helitaanka xog cad oo ku saabsan dhaqaalaha laga jaro xildhibaannada, balse aysan dalban joojinteeda, taas oo guddoonka si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay. Lacagta la joojiyay ayaa ahayd mid xildhibaannada si joogto ah looga jaro, iyadoo loogu tala-galay in lagu daboolo kharashaadka aaska xildhibaan geeriyooda. Go’aanka cusub ayaana soo afjaraya nidaam muddo socday kadib markii xildhibaannadu dalbadeen in arrintaasi si cad loo qeexo. items.title: Soomaaliya oo digniin ka muujisay adeegsiga teknoolijiyadda cusub ee Argagixisada
items.description: New York (Raxanreeb Online) Safiirka Soomaaliya u fadhiya Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, Danjire Abuukar Baalle , ayaa sheegay in khatarta argagixisadu ay si joogto ah isu beddelayso, iyadoo kooxaha argagixisada ah ay si degdeg ah uga faa’iideysanayaan horumarka teknoolojiyadda. Danjiraha ayaa xusay in kooxahaasi ay adeegsanayaan fursadaha ay bixiyaan teknoolojiyadaha cusub, taas oo sare u qaadaysa awoodda ay u leeyihiin inay la qabsadaan xaaladaha cusub iyo inay qaataan habab casri ah oo ay ku fuliyaan howlahooda. Wuxuu tilmaamay in isbeddelka degdegga ah ee teknoolojiyadda uu caalamka ku qasbayo in dib loo eego hababka loo wajaho khataraha argagixisada, maadaama kooxaha hubeysan ay si joogto ah u raadinayaan habab cusub oo ay kaga faa’iideystaan teknoolojiyadda. Sidoo kale danjire Abuukar Baalle ayaa sheegay in kooxaha argagixisadu ay baraha bulshada u adeegsanayaan qorista iyo soo jiidashada xubno cusub, halka barnaamijyada isgaarsiinta ee sirta ah ay u isticmaalaan qorsheynta howlgallada iyo weerarrada. Danjire Abuukar Baalle ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in beesha caalamku si wadajir ah uga hortagto khataraha cusub, iyadoo la horumarinayo awoodaha hay’adaha amniga iyo hababka lagu ogaan karo isbeddellada ku yimaada xeeladaha kooxaha argagixisada. Soomaaliya, oo muddo dheer dagaal kula jirtay kooxaha argagixisada, ayaa si gaar ah u danaynaysa xoojinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee dhinacyada amniga, xog-wadaagga iyo la-dagaallanka maalgelinta argagixisada. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli hay’adaha caalamiga ah ay si isa soo taraysa uga digayaan in horumarka teknoolojiyadeed uu keeni karo fursado cusub oo ay kooxaha rabshadaha wata uga faa’iideystaan hawlahooda, taasoo u baahan jawaab amni oo la jaanqaadda isbeddelladaas. items.title: BRICS oo Isku Raacay Baaq Lagu Dejinayo Dagaalka Bariga Dhexe
items.description: Dalalka ku bahoobay ururka BRICS ayaa si wadajir ah u ansixiyey Baaqa New Delhi, iyagoo walaac xooggan ka muujiyey dagaalka iyo xiisadaha sii kordhaya ee Bariga Dhexe. Bayaanka ayaa dhinacyada ugu baaqay xakamayn buuxda iyo inay ka fogaadaan tallaabooyin sii hurin kara colaadda. Hoggaamiyeyaasha BRICS waxay ku celceliyeen in khilaafaadka caalamiga ah lagu xalliyo wada-hadal, wadatashi iyo hab diblomaasiyadeed. Bayaanka ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqay ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah, dhowrista madax-bannaanida dowladaha iyo in xalalka lagu saleeyo iskaashi dhinacyo badan leh. Ansixinta bayaanka ayaa muhiimad gaar ah leh, maadaama Iiraan iyo Imaaraadka Carabta—oo mowqifyo kala duwan ka leh colaadda gobolka—ay labaduba taageereen. Itoobiya iyo Masar ayaa sidoo kale qayb ka ahaa tobanka dal ee isku raacay bayaanka. BRICS waxaa xubno ka ah Brazil, Ruushka, Hindiya, Shiinaha, Koonfur Afrika, Masar, Itoobiya, Indonesia, Iiraan iyo Imaaraadka Carabta. Isku-raaca dalalkan ayaa muujinaya dadaal lagu raadinayo mowqif mideysan, inkastoo aysan isku aragti ka ahayn dhammaan arrimaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni. Baaqa New Delhi ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyey ilaalinta ganacsiga, silsiladaha sahayda, qulqulka tamarta iyo ammaanka marin-biyoodka. Si kastaba, bayaanku ma magacaabin dhinac gaar ah, mana soo bandhigin hannaan cusub oo xabbad-joojin lagu hirgelinayo. Hoos-u-dhigista xiisadda Iiraan iyo Khaliijka waxay Soomaaliya muhiim ugu tahay helitaanka shidaalka, qiimaha badeecadaha iyo ammaanka Badda Cas, Bab al-Mandab iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Hase yeeshee, bayaanka kuma jiro go’aan ama qorshe si gaar ah Soomaaliya loogu wajahayo.

items.title: Kumaandooska Gorgor oo Sheegay inuu La Wareegay Geel-gub iyo Saldhigyo Ku Dhow
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa sheegay inay la wareegeen deegaanka Geel-gub iyo saldhigyo muhiim ah oo ku dhow, kuwaas oo ka tirsan gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Hawlgalkan waxaa ka qayb qaatay Guutada 18-aad ee Kumaandooska Gorgor, Guutada 12-aad ee Ciidanka Gaarka ah ee Gorgor iyo Guutada 3-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Ciidamada ayaa sheegay inay si wadajir ah uga hawlgaleen deegaanka iyo nawaaxigiisa. Warbaahinta dawladda ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada dowladdu si buuxda ula wareegeen Geel-gub iyo fariisimihii ku dhowaa. Hase yeeshee, lama magacaabin dhammaan saldhigyada la qabsaday ama inta ay deegaanka ka fog yihiin. Ciidamada ayaa goobaha cusub ka samaystay difaacyo, iyagoo adkaynaya fariisimaha si looga hortago isku-day dib loogu soo laabanayo. Hawlgallo amni-xaqiijin ah ayaa sidoo kale laga wadaa deegaanka iyo waddooyinka ku dhow. Geel-gub ayaa ku yaalla goob muhiim u ah dhaqdhaqaaqa ciidamada ee Shabeellaha Dhexe, waxaana aaggiisa hore uga dhacay hawlgallo iyo weerarro ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab. La wareegistiisa waxay ciidamadu ku tilmaameen tallaabo lagu ballaarinayo dhulka ay dowladdu maamusho. Natiijada hawlgalkan waxaa shaaciyey taliska ciidamada iyo warbaahinta dowladda; Al-Shabaab weli kama aysan jawaabin. Sidoo kale, lama soo bandhigin khasaaraha labada dhinac, maxaabiis la qabtay ama hub lagu furtay, mana jirto xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo ku saabsan gacan-ku-haynta dhammaan goobaha la sheegay.

Warbaahinta dawladda ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada dowladdu si buuxda ula wareegeen Geel-gub iyo fariisimihii ku dhowaa. Hase yeeshee, lama magacaabin dhammaan saldhigyada la qabsaday ama inta ay deegaanka ka fog yihiin. Ciidamada ayaa goobaha cusub ka samaystay difaacyo, iyagoo adkaynaya fariisimaha si looga hortago isku-day dib loogu soo laabanayo. Hawlgallo amni-xaqiijin ah ayaa sidoo kale laga wadaa deegaanka iyo waddooyinka ku dhow. Geel-gub ayaa ku yaalla goob muhiim u ah dhaqdhaqaaqa ciidamada ee Shabeellaha Dhexe, waxaana aaggiisa hore uga dhacay hawlgallo iyo weerarro ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab. La wareegistiisa waxay ciidamadu ku tilmaameen tallaabo lagu ballaarinayo dhulka ay dowladdu maamusho. Natiijada hawlgalkan waxaa shaaciyey taliska ciidamada iyo warbaahinta dowladda; Al-Shabaab weli kama aysan jawaabin. Sidoo kale, lama soo bandhigin khasaaraha labada dhinac, maxaabiis la qabtay ama hub lagu furtay, mana jirto xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo ku saabsan gacan-ku-haynta dhammaan goobaha la sheegay.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga oo Iska kaashanaya La-dagaallanka Wararka Been-abuurka ah
items.description: Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Soomaaliya, Cabdifitaax Qaasim, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Deniz Demir, oo ah isku-duwaha Xarunta La-dagaallanka Macluumaadka Marin-habaabinta iyo Wararka Been-abuurka ah ee Madaxtooyada Turkiga. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka oo Xoojinaya Iskaashiga Amniga
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sareeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa qaabilay Taliyaha Howlgallada Gaarka ah ee Mareykanka u qaabilsan Qaaradda Afrika, Sareeye Gaas Tudor, iyadoo kulanka diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga amniga iyo howlgalada milatari. Kulanka ayaa labada dhinac waxay kaga wada hadleen sidii loo sii horumarin lahaa awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo si gaar ah loo eegay taageerada, tababarrada iyo tayeynta ciidanka, iyo sidii loo dhisi lahaa ciidan qaran oo leh awood hawlgal iyo diyaar-garow sare. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa isla eegay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, tababarrada iyo howlgalada gaarka ah. Kulankan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada qaranka iyo in si tartiib ah loo kordhiyo mas’uuliyadda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ee la xiriirta sugidda amniga dalka.

items.title: Eritrea oo shaacisay qorshe halis ah oo Imaaraadka ka damacsan yahay Soomaaliya
items.description: Asmara (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Eritrea ayaa Imaaraadka Carabta ku eedeysay inay Afrika ka wado waxa ay ku tilmaantay “gumeysi dekedeed”, iyadoo su’aal ka keentay ujeeddada ka dambeysa maalgelinta iyo joogitaanka sii ballaaranaya ee Abu Dhabi ee dekedaha ku teedsan Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Bariga Afrika. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Eritrea, Osman Saleh, ayaa wareysi gaar ah oo uu siiyay Middle East Eye ku sheegay in joogitaanka Imaaraadka ee dekedo badan oo gobolka ah aanu ku koobneyn dano ganacsi oo keliya. “Imaaraadku wuxuu xarumo dekedeed ku leeyahay meelo badan oo gobolka ah, dalalka Afrikana waa inay isweydiiyaan sababta,” ayuu yiri Saleh. “Ma dhaqaale keliya ayaa ka dambeeya? Maya.” Labada shirkadood ee waaweyn ee dekedaha Imaaraadka, DP World iyo AD Ports Group, ayaa maalgashi ama maamul ku leh dekedo ku yaalla dalal dhowr ah oo Afrikaan ah, oo ay ku jiraan Masar, Tanzania iyo Soomaaliya. DP World ayaa sidoo kale maamusha dekedda Berbera ee Somaliland, oo ah maamul ka tirsan Soomaaliya, halka shirkaddu ay saamayn weyn ku leedahay dekedda Boosaaso ee Puntland. Puntland ayaa sanadkan iska diidday go’aankii dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay xiriirka ugu jartay Imaaraadka, taas oo sii muujisay kala duwanaanshaha u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo maamul-goboleedka dhinaca xiriirka Abu Dhabi. Inkasta oo dalal Afrikaan ah ay soo dhaweeyeen maalgashiga Imaaraadka, haddana isku dayga Abu Dhabi ee ah inuu saamiyo ama maamul ka helo dekedaha istiraatiijiga ah ee gobolka mar walba ma noqon mid sahlan. Jabuuti ayaa sanadkii 2018 laashay heshiiskii DP World ee dekedda Doraleh, halka dowladda Sudan ay burisay heshiis sanadkii 2022 lagu qorsheeyay in AD Ports Group ay ku dhisto deked ku kacaysa lix bilyan oo dollar xeebta Badda Cas. Khilaafka Sudan ayaa sidoo kale ku dhex jira tartanka awoodaha gobolka. Imaaraadka waxaa lagu eedeeyaa inuu taageero Ciidamada Gurmadka Degdegga ah ee RSF, kuwaas oo dagaal kula jira ciidamada dowladda Sudan, inkasta oo Abu Dhabi ay marar badan beenisay eedeymahaas. Eritrea oo diidday joogitaan Eritrea waxay leedahay xeeb dheer oo ku teedsan Badda Cas, taas oo ka dhigaysa meel muhiim u ah istiraatiijiyadda amniga iyo ganacsiga gobolka. Imaaraadku wuxuu sanadkii 2016 saldhig ciidan ka sameystay dekedda Casab ee koonfurta Eritrea, isaga oo halkaas uga adeegsan jiray howlgalladii militari ee isbahaysiga Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka ka waday Yemen. Hase yeeshee, xiriirka Asmara iyo Abu Dhabi ayaa markii dambe xumaaday. Sarkaal sare oo Eritrean ah ayaa Middle East Eye u sheegay in Eritrea ay ku gacan seyrtay codsi Imaaraadku ku doonayay inuu saldhig militari ka sameysto mid ka mid ah jasiiradaha Dahlak, kaas oo la sheegay in Imaaraadka iyo Israel ay wada isticmaali lahaayeen. Codsigaas ayaa la sheegay inuu dhacay qiyaastii sanadkii 2016, dhowr sano ka hor heshiisyadii Abraham Accords ee xiriirka rasmi ah dhex dhigay Israel iyo Imaaraadka. “Ma aanan dooneyn DP World gudaha Eritrea,” ayuu yiri Saleh. “Ma dooneyno awood shisheeye inay Eritrea ka sameysato xarun weyn oo joogto ah.” Hadalladaas ayaa muujinaya sida Asmara uga walaacsan tahay in maalgashiyada dekedaha ay isu beddelaan joogitaan militari ama saameyn siyaasadeed oo muddo dheer ah. Itoobiya iyo Somaliland Eritrea iyo Imaaraadka ayaa sidoo kale ku kala aragti ka duwan dhowr arrimood oo gobolka ka socda. Asmara ayaa dhowaan martigelisay taliyaha ciidamada Sudan Abdel Fattah al-Burhan laba jeer muddo laba bilood gudahood ah, halka Imaaraadka lagu eedeeyo inuu taageero RSF. Dhanka kale, xiriirka Eritrea iyo Itoobiya ayaa dib ugu laabtay xiisad kaddib iskaashigii labada dal ee dagaalkii Tigray ee 2020 ilaa 2022. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Ahmed ayaa sanadihii dambe si joogto ah uga hadlay baahida dalkiisa ee marin badeed, hadallo ay Eritrea u aragtay kuwo khatar ku ah madax-bannaanideeda iyo xuduudaheeda. Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale noqotay xulafo dhow oo Imaaraadka ah, iyadoo Addis Ababa ay isticmaashay diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo hub kale oo laga keenay Abu Dhabi. Mas’uuliyiinta Eritrea ayaa hadda rumeysan in Imaaraadka iyo Israel ay sii kordhinayaan iskaashigooda Itoobiya iyo guud ahaan Geeska Afrika. “Imaaraadka iyo Israel durba waxay ku kulmeen Somaliland,” ayuu Saleh yiri, isagoo tixraacayay xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee Israel ay la yeelaneyso maamulka Somaliland. Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Somaliland ayaa hore u sheegay inay daneynayaan joogitaan amni ama militari oo Israel ay ka sameysato gobolka, xilli Somaliland ay raadineyso aqoonsi caalami ah. Saleh ayaa sidoo kale dhaliilay damaca Itoobiya ee Badda Cas, isaga oo sheegay in Abiy Ahmed uu leeyahay istiraatiijiyad uu ku doonayo inuu Itoobiya ku gaarsiiyo marin badeed. Walaaca Eritrea ee Israel Israel iyo Eritrea ayaa xiriir diblomaasiyadeed yeeshay kaddib markii Eritrea ay madax-bannaanida ka qaadatay Itoobiya sanadkii 1993. Xilligaas xiriirka labada dhinac wuxuu ahaa mid dhow. Madaxweyne Isaias Afwerki ayaa isla sanadkii 1993 loo qaaday Israel si loogu daweeyo kadib markii uu si daran ugu xanuunsaday duumada maskaxda ku dhacda. Hase yeeshee, xiriirka labada dal ayaa sanadihii dambe qaboobay. “Waa inaan isweydiinnaa sababta Israel ugu degdegeyso inay saameyn ku yeelato Geeska Afrika. Maxay saldhig uga dooneysaa Somaliland?” ayuu Saleh yiri. Wuxuu sheegay in Eritrea aysan Israel u arkin cadow, balse ay go’aansatay inaysan waqtigan doonayn xiriir dhow. “Waxaan go’aansannay inaanan dooneyn safaaraddooda halkan. Israel colaad uma hayno, laakiin waxaan go’aansannay inaanan xiriir la yeelan,” ayuu yiri. items.title: Puntland iyo Jubaland ay si guud uga baxaan xayndaabka
items.description: Warar siyaasadeed oo soo baxaya ayaa sheegaya in Puntland iyo Jubaland ay shir muhiim ah ku yeelan doonaan magaalada Garoowe ka hor dhammaadka bisha September 2026. Maanta waxaa magaalada Nairobi ka bilaabmay gogol-xaadhka iyo diyaar-garowga siyaasadeed ee shirkaas, iyadoo kulamada Nairobi lagu sii diyaarinayo ajandaha iyo qodobbada waaweyn ee la filayo in Garoowe lagu go’aamiyo. Xogaha hordhaca ahi waxay tilmaamayaan in qodobada ugu waaweyn ee miiska saaran ay ka mid tahay in Puntland iyo Jubaland ay si guud uga baxaan xayndaabka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee caasimaddeedu tahay Muqdisho, isla markaana ay qaataan jihayn siyaasadeed oo cusub. Haddii go’aankaasi soo baxo, wuxuu noqon doonaa go’aan taariikhi ah oo si weyn wax uga beddeli kara siyaasadda iyo qaab-dhismeedka Soomaaliya. Suldaan Abdikariim Waayo-Arag&Waayaha Maanta.

items.title: Maxaa kasoo baxay kulanka taliyaha Xoogga iyo wafdiga Mareykanka?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha ciidanka Xoogga dalka, Sareeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa maanta kulan la yeeshay taliyaha howlgallada gaarka ah ee Mareykanka u qaabilsan Qaaradda Afrika, Sareeye Gaas Tudor oo ay ka wada-hadleem arrimo ku aadan howlgallada ka dhanka ah kooxda Al-Shabaab. Kulanka labada taliye ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga dhinaca amniga iyo howlgallada ka socda dalka ee lagu ciribtirayo maleeshiyaadka argagixisada, kuwaas oo uu ka qayb-qaato Mareykanka. Sidoo kale, waxaa kulanka lagu soo qaaday taageerada iyo horumarinta awoodda ciidanka Xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed, tayeynta ciidanka iyo dhismaha ciidan qaran oo leh awood iyo diyaar-garow sare, sida lagu sheegay warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay taliska milatariga Soomaaliya. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale isla eegay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta wada-shaqeynta iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee dhinacyada amniga iyo tababarrada ciidanka. Sareeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud oo madasha ka hadlay ayaa dowladda Mareykanka uga mahadceliyay taageeradeeda, gaar ahaan garab istaagga iyo taageeadooda ciidamada, maadaama ay siiyaan tababar iyo qalab intaba. Dhankiisa taliyaha howlgallada gaarka ah ee Mareykanka u qaabilsan Qaaradda Afrika, Sareeye Gaas Tudor ayaa bogaadiyay guulaha ciidamada Xoogga Dalka, wuxuuna sheegay inay sii xoojin doonaan taageeradooda, gaar ahaan sii wadida dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Kulankan ayaa kusoo aaday xilli xasaasi ah, isla markaana ciidamada dowladda iyo saaxibada caalamiga ah ay sii wadaan howlgallada lagu beegsanayo kooxda Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo jab culus lagu gaarsiiyay maleeshiyaadka argagixisada. Si kastaba, Mareykanka ayaa kamid ah dowladaha ka qayb qaata dagaalka Al-Shabaab, wuxuuna duqeymo ka fuliyaa koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya. items.title: Soomaali ay qabatay Ukraine isaga oo u dagaalamaya Ruushka oo xog yaab leh bixiyey
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Nin Soomaali ah oo maxbuus dagaal ku ah Ukraine ayaa sheegay inuu ku biiray ciidamada Ruushka isagoo raadinayay nolol iyo mustaqbal ka wanaagsan kii uu ku haystay Soomaaliya, balse ugu dambeyn la geeyay meel u dhow furinta dagaalka isagoo helay tababar ciidan oo aad u kooban. Ninkan oo warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay hay’adda xuquuqda aadanaha ee Amnesty International loogu bixiyay magaca “Ahmed” ayaa sheegay in uusan hore u lahayn wax khibrad ciidan ah, isla markaana uusan si dhab ah u fahamsanayn xaaladda dagaalka Ukraine markii uu ku biirayay ciidamada Ruushka. “Shaqo ma haysan, dakhli ma haysan, mustaqbalna ma aanan lahayn,” ayuu ka yiri xaaladdii uu Soomaaliya kaga sugnaa, isagoo intaas ku daray inuu “doonayay inuu baxo kharash kasta ha ku kacdee, meel kastaana uu tegi lahaa.” Ahmed ayaa sheegay in qorshihiisu ahaa inuu helo dhalashada Ruushka kadibna dalkaas ku nagaado. Hase yeeshee, markii uu ku biiray ciidamada Ruushka, wuxuu sheegay inuusan helin “wax tababar sax ah oo ciidan ah”, kahor inta aan loo dirin meel u dhow furinta dagaalka. Wuxuu sheegay in mar uu isku arkay meel u dhow jiidda hore “isagoo xitaa aan hub wadan”. Ahmed ayaa markii dambe gacanta u galay ciidamada Ukraine, waxaana Amnesty International ay kula kulantay xero lagu hayo maxaabiista dagaalka. Xiriir la’aan qoys Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Ahmed uusan awoodin inuu waalidkiis u sheego inuu nool yahay. Xerada uu ku jiro lagama oggola telefoonno ama muuqaallo toos ah, waxaana uu qoyska kula xiriiri karaa oo keliya waraaqo. Waalidkiis ayaase aan wax qorin ama akhrin karin, taasoo ka dhigtay xiriirkooda mid aad u adag. Amnesty International ayaa sheegtay inay faahfaahinta qaar ee dadka ay wareysatay qarisay, mararka qaarkoodna ay magacyada beddeshay si loo ilaaliyo dadka nugul. Hay’addu si cad uma sheegin in “Ahmed” uu yahay magaca dhabta ah ee ninkan Soomaaliga ah. Kiiskiisa wuxuu qeyb ka yahay baaritaan ballaaran oo ay Amnesty ku sameysay habka Ruushku u qorayo ajaanibta si ay uga qeyb qaataan dagaalka Ukraine. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay inay wareysatay dad laga soo kala qortay Soomaaliya, Brazil, Colombia, Sierra Leone, South Africa iyo Sri Lanka, kuwaas oo qaar badan lagu soo jiitay ballanqaadyo shaqooyin rayid ah, mushahar sare ama waddo fudud oo lagu helo dhalashada Ruushka. Warbixintu si gaar ah uma sheegin in Ahmed loo ballanqaaday shaqo rayid ah, balse waxay caddeyneysaa in dhaqaale xumida iyo rajadiisa helitaanka dhalashada Ruushka ay door weyn ku lahaayeen go’aankiisa. ‘Tahriibinta dadka’ Amnesty International ayaa sheegtay in baaritaankeeda uu muujiyay in qorista ajaanibta ay marar badan la socdeen khiyaano, cadaadis iyo ka faa’iideysi xaaladaha nugul ee dadka. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in qaar badan oo ka mid ah kiisaska ay diiwaangelisay ay gaari karaan heer lagu tilmaami karo tahriibinta dadka, inkastoo aysan si gaar ah u sheegin in kiiska Ahmed kaligiis uu buuxiyay shuruudahaas. Intii u dhaxeysay 2024 iyo 2026, Amnesty ayaa lix jeer booqatay laba xero oo maxaabiista dagaalka lagu hayo oo ku yaalla galbeedka Ukraine, halkaas oo ay ku wareysatay tobannaan maxbuus. Waxay ka mid ahaayeen 15 ajaanib ah oo laga soo kala qabtay dalal ay Soomaaliya ku jirto. Saddex keliya oo ka mid ah 15-kaas ayaa sheegay inay si buuxda u ogaayeen markii ay heshiiska saxiixayeen in loo diri doono goob dagaal, halka toddobo kale ay sheegeen in markii hore loo ballanqaaday shaqooyin rayid ah. Mas’uuliyiinta Ukraine ayaa sheegay in illaa bishii April 2026 ay aqoonsadeen ugu yaraan 28,391 ajaanib ah oo ka kala yimid 136 dal, kuwaas oo ka qeyb qaatay dagaalka iyagoo ka tirsan ciidamada Ruushka. Amnesty International ayaa sheegtay inaysan si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin tiradaas. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale diiwaangelisay cabashooyin la xiriira tababar ciidan oo aad u yar, baasaboorrada oo laga qaato qaar ka mid ah askarta ajaanibta ah, xaddidaad dhaqdhaqaaq iyo hanjabaado loo jeediyo dadka doonaya inay ka baxaan adeegga milatari. Amnesty ayaa ugu baaqday Ruushka inuu joojiyo hababka qoris ee ku dhisan khiyaanada, cadaadiska iyo ka faa’iideysiga dadka nugul, isla markaana lala xisaabtamo dadka ku lugta leh xadgudubyada. items.title: Cirro iyo Trump: Kulankii Washington Ka Dhici Waayay iyo sababta
items.description: Cirro oo Mareykanka ka soo laabtay isagoo aan la kulmin Trump Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi “Cirro”, ayaa booqashadiisii Mareykanka ku soo gabagabeeyay isaga oo aan helin kulan uu la yeesho Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump, sida ay qortay warbaahinta Masar ee Daily News Egypt . Cirro ayaa Washington tegay 5 ama 6 Sebteembar 2026, iyadoo booqashadiisu ku qotontay xoojinta xiriirka Somaliland iyo Mareykanka, raadinta taageero diblomaasiyadeed iyo horumarinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo dhaqaalaha. Wararka laga helayo Washington ayaa muujinaya in Madaxweynaha Somaliland uu kulamo la yeeshay xubno ka tirsan Congress-ka Mareykanka, masuuliyiin iyo kooxo daneeya arrimaha Geeska Afrika . Hase yeeshee, ma jirto xaqiijin rasmi ah oo muujinaysa in uu kulan fool-ka-fool ah la yeeshay Trump . Trump ayaa Sabtidii, 12-ka Sebteembar, u ambabaxay dalka Ireland, halkaas oo uu ku tegay booqasho socotay laba maalmood. Booqashadaas ayaa ku soo beegantay xilligii Cirro uu Washington ku sugnaa, taasoo meesha ka saartay fursaddii kulan toos ah oo labada dhinac dhex mara. Dhanka kale, Aqalka Cad ayaa sheegay in siyaasadda Mareykanka ee Somaliland aysan waxba iska beddelin. Warbixin ay daabacday Somalia Today ayaa sheegtay in Washington aysan bixin ballanqaad ku saabsan aqoonsiga Somaliland, iyadoo Cirro laftiisu uu qiray in wada-hadallada uu la yeeshay dhinaca Mareykanka aysan dhalin wax ballanqaad rasmi ah oo aqoonsi ah. Somaliland ayaa tan iyo 1991 raadinaysay aqoonsi caalami ah, halka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ku adkaysanayso in Somaliland ay qayb ka tahay dhulka Soomaaliya. Sidaas darteed, booqashada Cirro ee Mareykanka waxaa si gaar ah loogu eegayay haddii ay keeni karto isbeddel ku yimaada mowqifka Washington ee arrinta aqoonsiga. The post Cirro iyo Trump: Kulankii Washington Ka Dhici Waayay iyo sababta first appeared on Radio Dalsan .
