items.title: Xiisadda Masar iyo Itoobiya – Shiinaha oo dhinac raacay
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Shiinaha ayaa si cad u taageeray xaqa Masar ay u leedahay ilaalinta ammaankeeda biyaha, xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo khilaafka muddada dheer kala dhexeeya Itoobiya ee ku saabsan biyaha webiga Niil iyo biyo-xireenka weyn ee Renaissance. Mowqifka Beijing ayaa lagu shaaciyey bayaan wadajir ah oo kasoo baxay Shiinaha iyo Masar, kaddib booqasho madaxweyne Xi Jinping uu 1-dii iyo 2-dii September ku tagay Qaahira, halkaas oo uu wadahadallo kula yeeshay madaxweynaha Masar Abdel Fattah al-Sisi. Bayaanka ayaa Shiinaha ku sheegay inuu aqoonsan yahay “muhiimadda weyn” ee webiga Niil uu u leeyahay Masar, isagoo ku tilmaamay halbowlaha ugu weyn ee dalkaas. Beijing ayaa sidoo kale aqoonsatay waxa ay ku sheegtay xaqa sharciga ah ee Masar ay u leedahay ilaalinta ammaankeeda biyaha, cuntada iyo danaha horumarineed. Labada dal ayaa ugu baaqay dhammaan waddamada uu maro webiga Niil inay u hoggaansamaan sharciga caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan mabda’a dhigaya inaan dal kale loo geysan waxyeello. Masar, dhankeeda, waxay mar kale taageertay siyaasadda “Hal Shiinaha”, iyadoo Taiwan u aqoonsatay qayb ka mid ah dhulka Shiinaha. Tallaabadan ayaa Shiinaha si weyn ugu soo dhoweyneysa mowqifka Qaahira xilli wada-hadalladii u dhexeeyey Masar iyo Itoobiya ee ku saabsanaa Biyo-xireenka Weyn ee Renaissance ee Itoobiya, GERD, aysan weli dhalin heshiis sharci ahaan labada dhinac ku qasbaya. Masar waxay ku adkeysaneysaa in habka Itoobiya u maamusho biyo-xireenka, gaar ahaan xilliyada abaarta daba-dheeraata, uu halis gelin karo saamiga biyaha ee dalkaas oo inta badan ku tiirsan Niil. Qaahira waxay dooneysaa heshiis qeexaya sida loo maamulo biyo-xireenka iyo biyaha la sii deynayo marka roobabku yaraadaan. Itoobiya ayaa dhinaceeda ku adkeysata inay xaq u leedahay inay ka faa’iideysato biyaha Niil si loo horumariyo dhaqaalaha iyo korontada dalka, iyadoo sheegtay in biyo-xireenka uusan waxyeello weyn u geysan Masar iyo Sudan. Addis Ababa waxay sidoo kale diiddan tahay nidaam kasta oo ay u aragto inuu Masar siinayo awood ay ku xakameyso sida Itoobiya uga faa’iideysaneyso kheyraadkeeda biyaha. Saraakiil iyo khubaro Itoobiyaan ah ayaa toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay ku celceliyey in isticmaalka biyaha Niil uu ku saleysnaado “si caddaalad iyo macquul ah” oo ay wadaagaan dhammaan dalalka uu maro webigu. items.title: Muran ka dhashay khudbad uu jeediyay Madaxweynaha Mareykankau
items.description: Marka hoggaamiye kale oo caalami ah uu la kulmo Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump, waxa keliya ee la hubo ayaa ah hubanti la’aanta ku saabsan waxa dhici kara. Arrintan ayaa si dhab ah u dhacday ka hor booqashadii Madaxweynaha Trump ee labada maalmood ahayd ee uu ku tagay Ireland. Qofna ma saadaalin karin in dhammaadka maalintii koowaad, cinwaanka ugu weyn ee wararka caalamka uu noqon doono rabitaankiisa ah inuu arko Ireland oo midoobay. Iyadoo hadalladiisu ay gilgileen jasiiraddan iyo Great Britain, lama caddayn in tani ay ka dhigan tahay siyaasad cusub oo uu qaatay maamulka Maraykanka, mise ay ahayd hadal uu iska yiri madaxweyne jecel inuu su’aalo ka dhegeysto weriyeyaasha, isla markaana jecel inuu jawaabo bixiyo. Xigashada Sawirka, Reuters Qoraalka sawirka, Madaxweyne Trump oo uu wehliyo Taoiseach-ka (Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Ireland) Micheál Martin Xildhibaan hore oo ka tirsanaa Xisbiga Jamhuuriga, Mick Mulvaney, ayaa ahaa ergayga gaarka ah ee Trump u qaabilsanaa Waqooyiga Ireland xilligii uu madaxweynenimada hayay muddadiisii koowaad. Waxa uu ka digay in aan hadallada madaxweynaha si weyn loo fasiran. “Tani ma ka dhigna isbeddel ku yimid siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Maraykanka,” ayuu yiri. “Waxaa weli si buuxda nooga go’an heshiiska Jimcaha Wanaagsan.” Xildhibaan ka tirsan Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga, Brendan Boyle, ayaa ku raacay. “Waxaa heshiiskaas taageero ka hela labada xisbi, taasina isma beddeli doonto.” Inkasta oo labadooduba ay isku raaceen in Donald Trump ay u badan tahay inuu saxan yahay marka uu leeyahay “ugu dambayn” ay Ireland midoobi doonto, haddana taasi macnaheedu ma ahayn in Maraykanku uu bilaabayo inuu ku dadaalo sidii midowgaas loo hirgelin lahaa. In qof su’aal lagu weydiiyo shir jaraa’id oo si furan u socda oo uu uga jawaabo waa arrin, balse Donald Trump ayaa dareenkiisa ku celiyay wax yar kaddib, xilli uu khudbad ka jeedinayay hoyga safiirka Maraykanka, oo ay isugu yimaadeen dad si gaar ah loogu casuumay. Runtii, waxay ahayd ku dhowaad arrintii ugu horreysay ee uu ka hadlay, taas oo muujinaysa in laga yaabo inuu garwaaqsaday inuu hadalkiisii hore ku furay arrin muran badan dhalin karta. Inta kale ee khudbaddiisu waxay ahayd mid xiiso leh. Waxaa lagu sheegay inay noqon doonto khudbad 20 daqiiqo ah oo uu u jeedinayo hoggaamiyeyaasha ganacsatada Irish-ka iyo Irish-American-ka ah, balse waxay qaadatay ku dhowaad laba jibbaar waqtigaas, waxayna inta badan ku leexatay arrimaha gudaha ee Maraykanka. Madaxweyne Trump wuxuu leeyahay qaab hadal oo uu isagu ugu yeero “the weave”, oo ah hadal mawduucba mawduuc ugu boodaya. Inta uu khudbad jeedinayo, wuxuu ka leexan karaa hal mowduuc oo u gudbi karaa mid kale, isaga oo ka baxaya hadalkii loo diyaariyay, kaddibna dib ugu soo laabanaya qodobkii uu markii hore ka hadlayay. Maanta wuxuu ammaanay waxqabadkiisa, sida uu isagu u arko, oo ay ka mid yihiin adkaynta tallaabooyinka ka dhanka ah socdaalka sharci-darrada ah, heshiisyo uu galay iyo kordhinta wax-soo-saarka difaaca. Waxa uu mar kale ku celiyay dhaliilihiisa ku aaddan waxa uu u arko taageero la’aanta Boqortooyada Midowday ee hawlgalkiisa milatari ee Iran. Xigashada Sawirka, Reuters Qoraalka sawirka, Donald Trump oo la kulmay madaxweynaha Ireland Catherine Connolly Doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe ee Maraykanka ayaa si degdeg ah u soo dhowaanaya Laakiin yaa ahaa dhageystayaashii uu beegsanayay? Ma hoggaamiyeyaashii ganacsatada ahaa ee Dublin isugu yimid, mise dhageystayaal Maraykan ah oo daawanayay ama dhageysanayay khudbadda xilli inta badan dalka Maraykanka aysan weli waagu baryin? Doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe ee muhiimka ah ee la qabanayo bisha November ayaa si xawli ah u soo dhowaanaya, Xisbiga Jamhuurigana wuxuu wajahaya cadaadis xooggan oo ka dhashay siyaasadaha madaxweynaha. Waxay lumin karaan gacan-ku-haynta mid ama labada aqal ee Kongareeska. Qiyaastii toban meelood meel dadka Maraykanka ah ayaa sheegta inay asal ahaan Irish yihiin, balse dadkaasi ma aha koox cod-bixiyeyaal ah oo isku aragti ah. Xigashada Sawirka, Getty Images Qoraalka sawirka, Bill Clinton oo garab taagan madaxweynihii hore ee Ireland, Mary Robinson, sannadkii 1995 Ma wuxuu isku dayayay inuu beegsado cod-bixiyeyaasha Irish-American-ka ah ee madaxbannaan ama kuwa aan weli go’aan ka gaarin cidda ay u codeynayaan ee Maraykanka, kuwaas oo tiro badan oo ka mid ah ay sannadihii u dambeeyay mar u codeeyeen Xisbiga Jamhuuriga, marna Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga? Qaar ka mid ah cod-bixiyeyaashaas waxay taageeraan midowga Ireland, sidaas darteed, xilli cod kasta la raadinayo, waxaa laga yaabaa in arrintaasi qayb ka qaadatay. Bill Clinton wuxuu taageero badan ka helay Irish-American-ka markii uu u tartamayay madaxweynaha, isagoo ballanqaaday inuu si firfircoon uga qaybqaadan doono geeddi-socodka nabadda. Waxay u codeeyeen isaga, isaguna wuu ka dhabeeyay ballanqaadkiisii, waxaana shaqadii badnayd ee uu arrintaas ka qabtay ay horseedday aasaaska Heshiiska Jimcaha Wanaagsan. Laakiin Irish-American-ku maanta waa bulsho ka duwan sidii hore. Runtii, Maraykankuba maanta waa dal ka duwan sidii hore, maadaama siyaasaddiisu noqotay mid aad u kala qaybsan. Ololaha doorashooyinka bisha November ayaa muujinaya inaanay jirin wax calaamad ah oo muujinaysa in xaaladdaasi isbeddeli doonto mustaqbalka dhow. Hase yeeshee, hoggaamiyeyaasha siyaasadda ee Ireland waxay rajayn doonaan in doodda keliya ee berri laga hadlayo ay noqoto ciyaarta golf-ka.

items.title: DENI oo tegay Nairobi + Xogta kulamo ka billaabanaya
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa gaaray dalka Kenya kadib markii uu soo gaba-gabeeyay socdaallo uu ku marayay deegaanno ka tirsan gobollada Mudug iyo Bari. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, Deni ayaa Nairobi u tagay kulamo uu la yeelanayo xubno ka tirsan beesha caalamka, kuwaas oo looga hadlayo xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo sidii loo dardargelin lahaa wada-hadallada ku saabsan doorashooyinka dalka. Kulamada ayaa sidoo kale lagu wadaa in diiradda lagu saaro xaaladda amni ee gobolka iyo xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee ka taagan Soomaaliya, iyadoo Puntland ay ka mid tahay dhinacyada sida weyn ay hoggaanka dowladda federaalka iskugu hayaan arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo hannaanka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Wararka laga helayo Nairobi ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in Madaxweyne Deni uu halkaasi kulamo gaar ah kula yeelan doono dhiggiisa Jubaland, Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe). Sida ay tilmaamayaan ilo xog-ogaal ah, Puntland iyo Jubaland ayaa ka wada-hadlaya tallaabooyin dheeraad ah oo ay doonayaan inay uga jawaabaan siyaasadaha dowladda federaalka iyo waxa ay u arkaan faragelin kaga imaaneysa Villa Soomaaliya. Labada maamul ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inay qorsheynayaan shirar siyaasadeed oo looga hadlayo xaaladda dalka, gaar ahaan khilaafaadka ka taagan hannaanka doorashada iyo jihada siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, magaalada Nairobi waxaa ku sugan qaar ka mid ah isimada dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo la filayo inay kulamo la yeeshaan madaxda Puntland iyo Jubaland, iyadoo aan weli si rasmi ah loo shaacin ajendaha kulamadaasi. Safarka Deni ee Kenya iyo kulamada la filayo ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan doodaha iyo kala aragti-duwanaanshaha siyaasadeed ee ku saabsan doorashada dalka, iyadoo beesha caalamka ay isku dayeyso in xal kama dambeysa la gaaro. items.title: Qaxooti Yemeniyiin ah oo 1,400 gaaraya oo 24 saacadood gudahood ka gudbay Badda Cas una cararay Jabuuti
items.description: Qiyaastii 1,400 qof oo Yemeniyiin ah ayaa gudaha Jabuuti ku gaaray muddo 24 saacadood ah, xilli colaadaha Yemen ay sii xoogeysanayaan, gaar ahaan deegaannada ku dhow marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab . Wasiirka Dhaqaalaha iyo Maaliyadda Jabuuti, Ilyas Moussa Dawaleh , ayaa sheegay in 1,400 qaxooti ah ay Yemen ka soo gaareen Jabuuti hal maalin gudaheed. Wasiirka ayaa qoraal uu ku baahiyay barta X ku sheegay in dadkaasi ay yimaadeen xilli xaaladda amni ee Yemen ay sii xumaanayso, iyadoo dagaalladu ay sababeen barakac ballaaran oo gudaha iyo dibadda dalka ah. Maalin ka hor, wasiirku wuxuu sheegay in 500 qof oo ay ku jiraan haween iyo carruur ay gaareen magaalada xeebta ah ee Obock, kadib markii laga soo badbaadiyay badda, kaddib markii doonyihii ay saarnaayeen shidaalku ka dhammaaday xilli ay ka tallaabayeen marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Obock oo ku taalla waqooyi-bari Jabuuti ayaa qiyaastii 20 kiiloomitir oo dhanka biyaha ah u jirta xeebaha Yemen, waxaana muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ay noqotay meel ay soo gaaraan dadka Yemen uga cararaya colaadaha. Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Socdaalka (IOM) ayaa sheegtay in kooxaha nugul, gaar ahaan haweenka iyo carruurta, ay gaareen xeebaha Obock, iyadoo laga cabsi qabo in maalmaha soo socda ay yimaadaan dad kale oo badan. IOM ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in ugu yaraan 46,000 qof ay gudaha Yemen ku barakaceen tan iyo markii dagaalladu xoogeysteen toddobaadkii hore. Agaasimaha guud ee IOM, Amy Pope , ayaa sheegtay in qoysas badan ay markii labaad ama saddexaad ku qasbanaadeen inay ka cararaan colaadda, iyadoo xaaladdoodu aad u liidato isla markaana ay haystaan waxyaabo kooban oo ay ku noolaadaan. Waxay sidoo kale ku baaqday in hay’adaha gargaarka loo oggolaado inay si ammaan ah oo aan caqabad lahayn u gaaraan dadka u baahan gargaarka degdegga ah. Jabuuti ayaa horey u martigelisay tobannaan kun oo qaxooti iyo magangelyo-doon ah. Xogta Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Qaxootiga ee Maarso 2026 ayaa muujinaysa in dalkaas ay ka diiwaangashnaayeen in ka badan 36,000 qaxooti iyo magangelyo-doon , kuwaas oo badankoodu ka soo jeeda Soomaaliya, Itoobiya iyo Yemen. Barakaca cusub ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo dagaallada Yemen ay saameyn ku yeesheen deegaanno ku dhow Bab al-Mandab, oo ah marin-biyood istiraatiiji ah oo isku xira Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas , isla markaana muhiim u ah isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa dadka u kala gudbaya Geeska Afrika iyo Jasiiradda Carabta.

items.title: Hassan Sheikh and the Politics of Merit: Can the Architect of Patronage Now Lecture Somalia on Nepotism?
items.description: By Abdullahi A. Nor President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud says Somalia is finally preparing to move beyond clan-based recruitment and replace political connections with merit, competence and qualifications. It is a message that would be difficult to oppose—if it were coming from a government with a convincing record of practicing what it preaches. Instead, the president’s latest remarks raise an uncomfortable question: How can a government accused by its citizens and political opponents of institutionalizing nepotism, patronage and the misuse of public resources now present itself as the solution to the very problems it has helped deepen? Speaking at the launch of the “ Abuur ” program at Somali National University in Mogadishu, Hassan Sheikh said government employment should be based on education, ability and performance rather than family connections. “A person seeking a government job should get it through knowledge and ability, not through who your relatives are or whom you know,” the president said. He promised that Somalia would move from the culture of “who do you know?” to “what do you know?” It is an admirable principle. But principles mean little when political practice tells a different story. The President’s Contradiction Hassan Sheikh speaks as though nepotism is a problem that his administration has discovered rather than the one his government is reinforcing. Many including his opponents have repeatedly accused the administration of filling government positions through political loyalty, family connections and patronage rather than transparent competition. Similar allegations have been made about appointments within the security sector, where critics argue that political and personal loyalties have taken precedence over professional qualifications and institutional standards. These are serious allegations and should be investigated through credible, independent mechanisms. But the president cannot expect the public to listen to lectures about meritocracy without asking a simple question: What happened to meritocracy during his own years in power? If the government genuinely wants to replace who you know with what you know , it should begin by opening its own appointment books to public scrutiny. Who was appointed? Why was that person selected? What qualifications did the person possess? Were other candidates considered? Was there a competitive process? And, perhaps most importantly, would the same person have received the position if he or she had no political, family or personal connection to those in power? The Land Question Cannot Be Ignored The contradiction becomes even more striking when considered alongside the controversy surrounding land and public property in Mogadishu. Hassan Sheikh’s administration has faced persistent political criticism and allegations concerning land allocations, demolitions, displacement and the transfer or redevelopment of valuable public property. Those allegations should not be treated as proven without documentary evidence and independent investigation. But neither should they simply disappear because the president has begun speaking about corruption and merit-based government employment. A government cannot credibly demand public confidence in its anti-corruption message while questions about public land and the use of state authority remain unresolved. If the government believes its land policies are lawful, transparency should be the answer: a) Publish the records, b) identify the legal basis for disputed allocations, c) explain who received the properties, d) disclose the decision-making process, e) allow independent institutions to investigate and f) Let the public see the evidence. That is how a government demonstrates that accusations are politically motivated rather than simply declaring them to be so. A Government Cannot Fight Nepotism with Nepotism The deeper problem is institutional. Nepotism is not simply about giving a job to a relative. It is about creating a political culture in which access to public employment, contracts, land and economic opportunity depends on proximity to power. Once that culture becomes entrenched, government institutions cease to function primarily as public institutions. They become networks of political loyalty. The danger is particularly severe in Somalia because government employment is one of the country’s most important sources of economic opportunity for educated young people. A graduate who spends years studying only to discover that government positions are effectively reserved for people with the right connections will quickly lose faith in the state. That is not merely unfair. It is corrosive to nation-building. What Would Real Reform Look Like? If President Hassan Sheikh is serious about his latest promise, the solution is straightforward: a) Create genuinely competitive recruitment systems, b) publish vacancies publicly, c) establish independent selection panels, d) publish qualification requirements, e) conduct standardized examinations, f) publish results where appropriate, g) introduce transparent appeals mechanisms. h) audit government appointments and i) apply the same standards to presidential advisers, ministers, security officials and senior civil servants. Most importantly, the system must apply to everyone—including the president’s political allies and relatives. That is the difference between a speech about reform and actual institutional reform. The President Should Start with His Own Government There is nothing wrong with Hassan Sheikh telling Somali graduates that merit should matter. In fact, Somalia desperately needs precisely that principle. But the president should recognize that credibility is earned through conduct, not speeches. If his administration has genuinely moved toward merit-based recruitment, it should be able to demonstrate that transformation with evidence. If government jobs are now being awarded through competitive examinations, publish the procedures. If nepotism has been eliminated, publish appointment data. If corruption is being fought, publish investigations and prosecutions. If public land is being administered lawfully, open the records. And if the government believes its critics are spreading false allegations, give independent institutions the information necessary to establish the truth. Somalia Deserves Better Than Political Lectures Somalis have heard promises of reform from successive governments. What the country needs now is not another declaration that “who you know” should become “what you know.” It needs institutions that make the first impossible and the second unavoidable. President Hassan Sheikh is right about one thing: Somalia cannot build a modern state on clan connections, political patronage and personal loyalty. But that principle applies first to the government making the promise. The president cannot simultaneously demand an end to nepotism while failing to convincingly address allegations that his own administration has benefited from patronage and political favoritism. He cannot credibly condemn corruption while unresolved questions remain about the use of public resources and land. And he cannot ask young Somalis to trust a merit-based state unless his government is prepared to demonstrate that merit—not proximity to power—is actually what determines opportunity. The president’s words are easy to applaud. His record is what must now be examined. If Hassan Sheikh truly wants to move Somalia from “who do you know?” to “what do you know?” , he should begin with his own administration. Publish the appointments. Open the records. Audit the land. Investigate the allegations. Let the evidence speak. That would be a far more convincing anti-corruption campaign than another presidential speech. Abdullahi A. items.title: Aadan Madoobe iyo DF oo dejiyay qorshe cusub oo magaalada Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Qorshayaal cusub oo lagu xoojinayo amniga magaalada Baydhabo iyo difaacyada ku xeeran ayaa la dejiyay, iyadoo saraakiisha ciidamada lagu amray inay qaadaan tallaabooyin looga hortagayo weerarro ka dhaca Baydhabo. Qorshayaasha ayaa lagu dejiyay kulan hoggaamiyaha maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Madoobe, uu la yeeshay saraakiisha ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo kuwa Daraawiishta maamulkaasi, kaas oo looga hadlayay adkeynta amniga magaalada Baydhabo. Ilo kala duwan ayaa Caasimada Online u sheegay in Aadan Madoobe oo ciidamo dheeraad ah ka helay dowladda federaalka, uu saraakiisha amniga faray inay bannaanka magaalada ka sameystaan saldhigyo cusub oo ciidan. Sida ay ilo xog-ogaal ah sheegeen, saldhigyada cusub ayaa la doonayaa in loo sameeyo dhowr difaac oo hor leh, kuwaas oo laga dhigayo meelaha ugu dambeeya ee laga soo galo magaalada Baydhabo. Ujeeddada qorshahan ayaa lagu sheegay si ciidamada uga hortagaan weerarro ama dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo kusoo wajahan Baydhabo, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo sugidda waddooyinka iyo furimaha laga soo galo magaalada. Saraakiisha ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale lagu amray inay si joogto ah u kormeeraan furimaha ku dhow magaalada, isla markaana ay la socdaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada Al-Shabaab iyo maleeshiyaad lagu eedeeyay inay ka amar qaataan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Baydhabo ayaa maalmahan xasilloonayd, kaddib markii toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay ay magaalada ka dhaceen weerarro ay mas’uuliyaddooda sheegteen maleeshiyaad taageersan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa dhanka kale kordhisay ciidamadeeda ku sugan Baydhabo, kuwaas oo garab siinaya Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo ciidamo dheeraad ah maalmihii lasoo dhaafay la geeyay magaalada si loo xoojiyo amniga loogana hortago khataraha cusub ee ka iman kara gudaha iyo hareeraha Baydhabo. Baydhabo ayaa maalmahan xasilloonayd, kaddib markii toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay ay magaalada ka dhaceen weerarro ay mas’uuliyaddooda sheegteen maleeshiyaad taageersan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa dhanka kale kordhisay ciidamadeeda ku sugan Baydhabo, kuwaas oo garab siinaya Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo ciidamo dheeraad ah maalmihii lasoo dhaafay la geeyay magaalada si loo xoojiyo amniga loogana hortago khataraha cusub ee ka iman kara gudaha iyo hareeraha Baydhabo. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo weerar gantaallo ah ku qaaday gobolka Jizan ee Sucuudiga
items.description: Ugu yaraan laba qof ayaa ku dhaawacmay, halka masaajid iyo dhismayaal kale ay waxyeello soo gaartay, kadib markii wax lagu sheegay gantaal ama madfac ay Xuutiyiinta Yemen ku rideen koonfurta Sacuudiga, sida ay sheegtay Hay’adda Difaaca Madaniga ah ee Sacuudiga. Dhacdadan ayaa ka dhacday gobolka Jizan , gaar ahaan deegaanka Al-Tuwal, halkaas oo sidoo kale ay waxyeello kasoo gaartay gaadiid dhowr ah. Mas’uuliyiinta Difaaca Madaniga ah ayaa sheegay in labada qof ee dhaawacmay la helay kadib markii uu projectile-ku ku dhacay goobta. Afhayeen u hadlay Difaaca Madaniga ah ee Sacuudiga ayaa cambaareeyay waxyeellada loo geystay goobaha rayidka, isagoo ku tilmaamay tallaabadaas xadgudub cad oo ka dhan ah sharciga caalamiga ah ee bani’aadantinimada , wuxuuna sheegay in la dhaqan-geliyay habraacyada gurmadka degdegga ah. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in weerarkoodu uu ahaa mid lagu bartilmaameedsaday saldhig ciidan oo Sacuudiga leeyahay oo ku yaalla Sharurah , oo ka tirsan gobolka Najran ee koonfurta dalkaasi. Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in digniin amni kadib xaaladdii khatarta ahayd laga soo gudbay deegaanka Khamis Mushait , iyadoo dadka deegaanka loo diray digniino la xiriira weerarka. Weerarkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan weerarrada Xuutiyiintu ka fulinayaan koonfurta Sacuudiga. Maalmihii lasoo dhaafay, kooxda ayaa sheegatay weerarro ay ku qaaday magaalooyin ay kamid yihiin Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jizan iyo Najran , iyadoo Sacuudigu sheegay in weerarradii Talaadadii ay ku dhaawacmeen 73 qof, oo ay ku jireen haween iyo carruur. Weerarradan ayaa qayb ka ah dib-u-kicitaanka colaadda daba dheeraatay ee Yemen, taas oo sii xoogeysatay bishii Luulyo kadib muddo ku dhow afar sano oo ay jirtay xasillooni aan buuxda ahayn oo ka dhalatay xabbad-joojin ay Qaramada Midoobay dhexdhexaadisay. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inay gacanta ku dhigeen qaybo muhiim ah oo ka tirsan xeebaha Badda Cas ee Yemen, oo ay ku jirto magaalada dekedda ah ee Mocha , halka ciidamada dowladda Yemen ay dagaallo cusub ka wadaan gobollada Al-Jawf, Marib iyo Al-Bayda. Sida ay sheegeen Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Socdaalka (IOM) iyo mas’uuliyiin maxalli ah, dagaalladii ugu dambeeyay ayaa sababay dhimashada in ka badan 500 qof , halka tobanaan kun oo qof ay ku barakaceen. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa bishan Golaha Ammaanka ku qabatay kulan degdeg ah oo looga hadlay xaaladda Yemen, iyadoo Ergayga Gaarka ah ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Yemen, Hans Grundberg , uu ka digay in dalka uu galay marxalad cusub oo dagaal oo ka khatar badan .

items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo ka digay inay xiraan Marinka Bab El-Mandeb
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa ka digay fara-gelin shisheeye oo lagu taageerayo Dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudiga uu taageero, dagaalkana ay kula jiraan. Ururka ayaa warsaxaafadeed uu Sabtidii soo saaray ku sheegay in dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee Badda Cas uu weli yahay mid caadi ah, isla-markaana ay maraakiibtu si nabdoon ku marayaan marin biyoodka Bab El-Mandeb. Xoogaga Xuutiyiinta ayaa si buuxda ula wareegay xeebaha dalkaasi Yemen ee ku teedsan Badda Cas, ka dib markii guulo is daba joog ah ay ka gaareen dagaalka kala dhexeeya Ciidamada Dowladda Yemen. Xuutiyiinta ayaa Khamiistii la wareegay gacan ku haynta Magaalada Mokha, iyagoona Jimcihii qabsaday Jasiiradda Mayun (Perim), waxayna sidaasi ku dhameystireen in ay gacanta ku hayaan Marinka Bab El-Mandeb. Afhayeenka Militariga Xuutiyiinta, General Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay in dhammaan maraakiibta ganacsiga ay mari karaan marinkaasi, marka laga soo tago maraakiibta Sacuudiga oo uu sheegay in horey xayiraad buuxda loogu soo rogay. General Yahya Saree ayaa ka digay in isku day kasta oo fara-gelin ama weerar ah uu keeni karo in gebi ahaanba la xiro marinka istiraatiijiga ah ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Bab El-Mandeb waa marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo gaadiidka sahayda tamarta ee isugu kala goosha Asia, Yurub iyo Bariga Afrika. Dhanka kale Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiinta ay la soo xiriireen Mareykanka, iyagoo ka codsanaya inaysan fara-gelin ku sameynin dagaalka kala dhexeeya Dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay. Trump oo Sabtidii ay booqasho laba maalmood ah uga bilaabatay Magaalada Dublin ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiinta aysan rabin inay la dagaalamaan Mareykanka. “Xuutiyiintu way na soo waceen, mana doonayaan inay nala dagaalamaan.” Ayuu yiri Trump oo intaasi ku daray “Ma doonayaan inaan beegsano.” Carqaladaynta Xuutiyiinta ee isu socodka maraakiibta ee Bab El-Mandeb ayaa cawaaqib ba’an ku yeelanaya sahayda tamarta adduunka, xilli Iran ay horey u xirtay Marinka Hormuz.

items.title: He Called Them “Uncles.” They Killed Him Anyway
items.description: By Abdijaliil Osman Axmed Shire Xuseen survived the frontline against al-Shabaab. He did not survive the road home. His last plea is a question every Somali now has to answer. A video has been moving across Somali phones this week. I watched it once. It’s very panful to watch.  I will not link to it here, and I would ask you not to forward it. Axmed Shire deserves to be remembered for how he lived, not circulated for how he died. In it, a young man held by armed men speaks slowly, the way people speak when their body is already failing them. He says he is sick. He is hungry, he tells them, and on his way to his family. Then come the words that have not left me since: “Abtiyaalow, ha i dilina.” Uncles, please do not kill me. Abti is the word for a mother’s brother. We also use it for older men we hope will treat us as their own. It is a word of kinship and trust. Axmed chose it in what may have been the final minutes of his life because he believed it still carried weight among Somalis. They killed him anyway. The road home from Buurane According to reports from Somalia media, Axmed Shire Xuseen was a soldier of the Somali National Army who had been serving at the front in Buurane, Middle Shabelle. He had reportedly been ill for some time. He took leave and set out for Buulobarde in Hiiraan to be with his family while he recovered. Near Ceelbaraf, an armed militia stopped him on the road together with two fellow soldiers who were also on leave. The other two were eventually released. Axmed was held, filmed while pleading for his life, and killed. When his body reached Buulobarde, relatives said it showed signs of severe torture. Nabadoon Xuseen Jurus, a traditional elder from Hiiraan, told Caasimada that his eyes had been gouged out. Local reports describe the killing as aano qabiil , clan revenge. If that account holds, then what separated the two soldiers who went home from the one who did not was not rank, conduct or courage. It was ancestry. He had accepted death. Not this one Anyone who puts on the uniform of the Somali National Army accepts a hard bargain: they may be asked to die for Somalia. In Middle Shabelle that bargain is tested constantly, by an enemy that relies on ambushes, roadside bombs and suicide attacks. Axmed kept his side of it. He went to the front, and he came back alive. What he never agreed to was dying at the side of a road at the hands of men who share his faith, his language and his flag. There is a special cruelty in surviving the enemy only to be executed by your own. A soldier killed by al-Shabaab is mourned as a martyr of the nation. When fellow Somalis kill a soldier because of his lineage, he becomes something harder to name. He becomes evidence. Every law we claim told them to let him go Somalis often say we live under three systems of law: the law of the state, the law of Islam and the xeer of our ancestors. On that road near Ceelbaraf, all three failed together. The Qur’an (al-Ma’idah, 5:32) teaches that whoever takes an innocent life has, in effect, killed all of humanity, and whoever saves one life has saved all of humanity. A hadith recorded by al-Tirmidhi and al-Nasa’i goes further still: the end of the entire world would weigh less before God than the unjust killing of a single believer. People like to say one life is worth a million. Our own faith sets the price far higher. The xeer is no less clear. Somali customary law recognises biri-ma-geydo , “those spared from the spear”: people who must not be harmed even in open clan warfare, including women, children, the elderly and others who carry no weapon and pose no threat. The ICRC and the Somali Red Crescent documented these rules in Spared from the Spear in the late 1990s, and in 2011 Somalia’s own government described biri-ma-geydo to the UN Human Rights Council as the nation’s indigenous Geneva Conventions. Axmed was sick, unarmed and travelling in peace. He asked for mercy in the language of family. By the standard of the very tradition his killers claim to defend, he was untouchable. The state’s law needs little explanation. Murder is murder. Killing a serving soldier is also an attack on the republic he swore to defend. That is what should shock us. Brutality is not the whole horror. The deeper horror is that every protection Somali society has ever built, divine, customary and constitutional, gave way at the same moment on a single stretch of road. items.title: Forget Mogadishu: Somaliland’s Future Lies with Addis Ababa and Nairobi
items.description: Forget Mogadishu: Somaliland’s Future Lies with Addis Ababa and Nairobi For thirty-five years, Somaliland has run its own government, printed its own currency, held its own elections, and kept its own peace — all without a single seat at the United Nations. In that time, successive administrations in Hargeisa have periodically entertained “talks” with Mogadishu on the theory that patient diplomacy might eventually yield recognition of the obvious. It hasn’t, and it won’t. The case for abandoning that track entirely, and doubling down on Somaliland’s ties with Ethiopia and Kenya instead, has never been stronger. The talks track is a dead end Somalia’s position has not moved in three decades: territorial unity is not negotiable. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud restated it again this year, offering “dialogue with all Somali parties” while explicitly ruling out any conversation about secession. That is not an opening position to be negotiated from — it is the entire position. Somaliland officials who sit down at that table aren’t negotiating statehood; they’re legitimizing the fiction that Hargeisa is a wayward province rather than a state that never ratified its 1960 union in the first place. Worse, talks give Mogadishu something it desperately needs and cannot otherwise manufacture: the appearance of sovereignty over territory it does not administer, has never administered since 1991, and could not defend if it tried. Every photograph of a joint communiqué is worth more to the Somali Federal Government’s diplomatic standing than it is to Somaliland’s. Engagement, on Mogadishu’s terms, is a subsidy Hargeisa pays to its own rival. Ethiopia: the neighbor with the most to offer Ethiopia’s calculus is different, and increasingly aligned with Somaliland’s. Landlocked since Eritrea’s 1993 secession, Addis Ababa has spent three decades searching for sea access it doesn’t have to beg for. The January 2024 memorandum of understanding — trading Ethiopian recognition for a lease on the Berbera coastline — was a signal, however contested and however slowly it has actually moved since, of where Ethiopian strategic interest points. Ethiopia has the largest army in the Horn, the largest population, and a state apparatus that, unlike Somalia’s, actually functions across most of its territory. A durable partnership with Addis Ababa gives Somaliland something recognition alone cannot: a great-power-adjacent security guarantor with every incentive to keep Berbera open and Somaliland stable. Kenya: recognition politics without the baggage Kenya’s relationship with Mogadishu has been openly hostile for years — over the maritime boundary dispute, over Jubaland, over al-Shabaab spillover across their shared border. Nairobi has little reason to defer to Somali sensitivities and every reason to hedge its Horn of Africa relationships. Kenya is also, unlike Ethiopia, a coastal state with deep-water ports of its own, meaning any partnership with Hargeisa is about diplomatic and security cooperation rather than competition over the same infrastructure. As East Africa’s most influential democracy and diplomatic hub, Kenyan goodwill carries weight in African Union corridors that Somaliland has never managed to unlock through the UN track. The wider trend is already moving this way Israel’s December 2025 recognition — the first from a UN member state — has already reordered the field. It came alongside deepening US security cooperation, visible in Somaliland’s talks with the American commander for Special Operations in Africa this year. A “Berbera axis” is forming, set against a bloc of Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Qatar that continues to back Somali territorial integrity. That alignment is not an accident. Somaliland’s most viable partners are the states with their own reasons to want a stable, functioning, non-Mogadishu-aligned actor on the Gulf of Aden — and Ethiopia and Kenya sit at the top of that list, geographically and strategically, in a way no amount of UN lobbying can substitute for. items.fullContent: Forget Mogadishu: Somaliland’s Future Lies with Addis Ababa and Nairobi For thirty-five years, Somaliland has run its own government, printed its own currency, held its own elections, and kept its own peace — all without a single seat at the United Nations. In that time, successive administrations in Hargeisa have periodically entertained “talks” with Mogadishu on the theory that patient diplomacy might eventually yield recognition of the obvious. It hasn’t, and it won’t. The case for abandoning that track entirely, and doubling down on Somaliland’s ties with Ethiopia and Kenya instead, has never been stronger. The talks track is a dead end Somalia’s position has not moved in three decades: territorial unity is not negotiable. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud restated it again this year, offering “dialogue with all Somali parties” while explicitly ruling out any conversation about secession. That is not an opening position to be negotiated from — it is the entire position. Somaliland officials who sit down at that table aren’t negotiating statehood; they’re legitimizing the fiction that Hargeisa is a wayward province rather than a state that never ratified its 1960 union in the first place. Worse, talks give Mogadishu something it desperately needs and cannot otherwise manufacture: the appearance of sovereignty over territory it does not administer, has never administered since 1991, and could not defend if it tried. Every photograph of a joint communiqué is worth more to the Somali Federal Government’s diplomatic standing than it is to Somaliland’s. Engagement, on Mogadishu’s terms, is a subsidy Hargeisa pays to its own rival. Ethiopia: the neighbor with the most to offer Ethiopia’s calculus is different, and increasingly aligned with Somaliland’s. Landlocked since Eritrea’s 1993 secession, Addis Ababa has spent three decades searching for sea access it doesn’t have to beg for. The January 2024 memorandum of understanding — trading Ethiopian recognition for a lease on the Berbera coastline — was a signal, however contested and however slowly it has actually moved since, of where Ethiopian strategic interest points. Ethiopia has the largest army in the Horn, the largest population, and a state apparatus that, unlike Somalia’s, actually functions across most of its territory. A durable partnership with Addis Ababa gives Somaliland something recognition alone cannot: a great-power-adjacent security guarantor with every incentive to keep Berbera open and Somaliland stable. Kenya: recognition politics without the baggage Kenya’s relationship with Mogadishu has been openly hostile for years — over the maritime boundary dispute, over Jubaland, over al-Shabaab spillover across their shared border. Nairobi has little reason to defer to Somali sensitivities and every reason to hedge its Horn of Africa relationships. Kenya is also, unlike Ethiopia, a coastal state with deep-water ports of its own, meaning any partnership with Hargeisa is about diplomatic and security cooperation rather than competition over the same infrastructure. As East Africa’s most influential democracy and diplomatic hub, Kenyan goodwill carries weight in African Union corridors that Somaliland has never managed to unlock through the UN track. The wider trend is already moving this way Israel’s December 2025 recognition — the first from a UN member state — has already reordered the field. It came alongside deepening US security cooperation, visible in Somaliland’s talks with the American commander for Special Operations in Africa this year. A “Berbera axis” is forming, set against a bloc of Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Qatar that continues to back Somali territorial integrity. That alignment is not an accident. Somaliland’s most viable partners are the states with their own reasons to want a stable, functioning, non-Mogadishu-aligned actor on the Gulf of Aden — and Ethiopia and Kenya sit at the top of that list, geographically and strategically, in a way no amount of UN lobbying can substitute for. The bottom line Recognition will not be won in Mogadishu. It will be won, if it is won at all, through the accumulation of working relationships with states that have concrete reasons to want Somaliland stable, sovereign, and open for business — chief among them Ethiopia and Kenya. Continued talks with Somalia cost Hargeisa legitimacy it doesn’t need to give away, in exchange for a recognition Mogadishu has never once been willing to offer. By Abdirahman Bidhaan Dahir

items.title: Singapore Leadership Study Tour Held for Somalia Leaders
items.description: Senior Somali officials completed a Singapore leadership study tour, gaining governance and public-sector insights at LKYSPP. Singapore leadership study tour delegates at Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy Senior leaders from Somalia’s National Leadership Academy (NLA) and officials from the Office of the Prime Minister completed a Singapore leadership study tour in August 2026. The Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy (LKYSPP) Executive Education programme hosted the delegation in Singapore. Faculty and practitioners guided the visit, which lasted five days. Organisers designed the trip to help Somalia strengthen its own leadership institutions. Why This Tour Matters Now Somalia is working to build stronger public institutions after decades of conflict and fragile governance. As a result, NLA officials view international study visits as a practical way to import proven ideas on leadership training. However, they stress that Somalia does not intend to copy foreign systems wholesale. Instead, the Singapore trip fits into a wider push to professionalise Somalia’s civil service and expand opportunities for young leaders. Four Pillars Shaped the Programme The Singapore leadership study tour focused on four core areas. These included: Executive education governance and design Public sector leadership development Youth leadership programmes Case-based learning and external engagement Delegates held discussions with LKYSPP faculty throughout the week. Meanwhile, practitioners shared real governance case studies drawn from Singapore’s own institutional history. Through these sessions, delegates gained practical insights. They also explored institutional models that could adapt to NLA’s development and to Somalia’s context more broadly. Delegation Visited Singapore’s Continuing-Education Institutions Beyond LKYSPP, the delegation engaged with three additional institutions. The Institute for Adult Learning Singapore hosted sessions on continuing education. NUS Institute of Systems Science (NUS-ISS) presented approaches to digital and public-sector training. NUS School of Continuing and Lifelong Education (SCALE) rounded out the visit with insights on youth development. Together, these engagements gave the delegation a broader view of Singapore’s lifelong-learning ecosystem. Consequently, NLA officials say the exposure goes beyond a single training model. Additional Context: A Broader Institutional Reflection According to a commentary later published by the National Leadership Academy, the trip formed part of a broader institutional learning agenda rather than a single study visit. The commentary, written by a delegation member, argued that Somalia should not attempt to replicate Singapore’s institutions directly. Instead, it should adapt relevant principles to Somalia’s own political, social and economic realities. This additional detail comes from NLA’s own published reflection and is not among the core facts confirmed for this report. What Comes Next for NLA NLA has positioned itself as a national platform for leadership training in Somalia. Officials now plan to translate lessons from the Singapore visit into local programming. Areas of focus reportedly include executive education, digital governance and youth leadership. Meanwhile, the Academy’s Research and Innovation Centre is expected to examine how comparative case studies, including Singapore’s, can inform Somali policy. items.title: Askari Jante dartiis u dilay wiil dhallinyaro ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka sida ayaa xukun dil toogasho ku riday Dable Xoogga Maxamuud Axmed Faarax Kabtan Dhashiike, Lagu helay in uu si kas ah u dilay Marxuum Cabdicasiis Shiikh Xuseen, 15-ka May 2026, falkaas ayaa ka dhacay Degmadda Luuq ee Gobolka Gedo. Kabtan Dhashiike iyo Marxuumka oo Xiriir iyo Wax is dhaafsi uusan ka dhaxeyn, kadib khilaaf horey uga dhaxeeyey, ayaa isku arkay guri ku yaalla dhanka Beeraha Luuq, Waxaana Eedeysanaha oo Sigaar heysta uu bilaabay inuu raadiyo Kabriid ama Jante, si uu u shito. Waxa uu weydiistay Koofi oo labadaba Saaxib lahaa, Marxuumka oo lahaa Jantaha, ayaa Jeebka ku ritay, si diidmo ah, Eedeysanaha oo Intaas caro ka qaaday ayaana keentay inuu labo Baalooto oo AK 47 ah Ku dhufto Alle ha u naxariistee C/casiis Shiikh Xuseen, isla Goobtaasi ayuuna ku geeriyooday Marxuumka. Baaris Dheer ka dib Xafiiska Xeer ilaalinta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, ayaa Codsaday qaadista kiiskaan, waxaana laga oggolaaday Seddexdii Bishaan September. Garsoorka Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka sida oo waqti ku filan siiyey dhinacyadda dacwadda ayaa ugu dambeyn maanta ku xukumay Ex-Dable Xoogga Maxamuud Axmed Faarax Kabtan Dhashiike Dil Toogasho oo Qisaasta Marxuum Cabdicasiis Shiikh Xuseen ah. items.title: Dagaalka Bariga Dhexe oo weji cusub yeeshay iyo Iiraan oo heshay waddo labaad oo guul
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Xiisadda Bariga Dhexe ayaa gashay marxalad cusub oo Iran iyo xulafadeeda u muuqata inay mar kale heleen awood ay cadaadis ku saaraan Mareykanka iyo dalalka Khaliijka, kaddib markii weerarro iyo horumarro militari oo is xigay ay khalkhal geliyeen waddooyinka ugu muhiimsan ee shidaalka gobolka loogu dhoofiyo suuqyada caalamka. Inkasta oo Iran lafteedu ay weli wajahayso cadaadis dhaqaale oo xooggan, cunaqabateyn iyo xanibaad lagu hayo dekedaheeda koonfureed, dhacdooyinkii maalmihii la soo dhaafay ayaa Tehran siisay fursad ay saameynteeda uga muujiso meelo ka baxsan gudaha dalka. Horumarka ugu weyn wuxuu ka dhacay Yemen, halkaas oo Xuutiyiinta Iran taageerto ay Jimcihii la wareegeen jasiiradda Mayun, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Perim, taas oo ku dhex taalla marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Waxay sidoo kale horumar ka sameeyeen xeebaha galbeed ee Yemen, taas oo kordhisay walaaca laga qabo ammaanka maraakiibta ganacsiga. Bab al-Mandab waa mid ka mid ah marinnada ganacsi ee ugu muhiimsan dunida, waxaana xaaladdiisa muhiimad u sii yeelaysa iyadoo marinka kale ee muhiimka ah ee Hormuz uu muddo bilo ah si weyn u carqaladeysnaa. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa si gaar ah u dareemaysa cadaadiskaas. Boqortooyadu waxay bilihii dambe si weyn ugu tiirsaneyd Badda Cas si ay shidaalkeeda u dhoofiso, kaddib markii dagaalka Iran uu hoos u dhigay maraakiibta isticmaasha marinka Hormuz. Laakiin Xuutiyiinta ayaa bishii July ku dhawaaqay xannibaad ay ku beegsanayaan maraakiibta Sacuudiga, iyagoo weerarro ka fuliyey Badda Cas isla markaana bartilmaameedsaday kaabayaasha tamarta ee gudaha boqortooyada. Dhibaatada Riyadh ayaa sii korortay markii weerar diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn lagu qaaday dhuunta weyn ee East-West Pipeline, oo shidaalka ka qaadda bariga Sacuudiga una gudbisa xeebaha Badda Cas. Sacuudiga ayaa Jimcihii sheegay inuu si taxaddar ah u xiray dhuuntaas. Dowladda Ciraaq ayaa markii dambe sheegtay in weerarrada laga soo qaaday gobolka Maysan ee koonfurta dalka, waxayna billowday baaritaan. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Sabtidii sheegay inuu aaminsan yahay in Iran ay “u badan tahay” inay ka dambeysay weerarka, inkasta oo ilaa hadda aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin cidda fulisay. Arrimahan ayaa cadaadis cusub saaray suuqa tamarta. Qiimaha saliidda ayaa toddobaadkan mar kale kor u dhaafay $100 halkii foosto, iyadoo uu Khamiistii ku dhowaaday $108, taas oo sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo sicir-barar iyo kororka qiimaha shidaalka adduunka. Haddii Iran ay awood u yeelato inay carqalad ku sii hayso Hormuz, halka Xuutiyiintuna cadaadis saaraan Bab al-Mandab, dalalka shidaalka dhoofiya ee Khaliijka ayaa wajahaya xaalad ay labada marin ee ugu muhiimsan gobolka isku mar khatar ku jiraan. Taasi waxay Tehran siin kartaa awood gorgortan oo cusub, inkasta oo Iran lafteedu ay ku jirto cadaadis dhaqaale iyo mid militari oo culus. Mareykanka ayaa bilihii dambe awooday inuu qayb ka mid ah maraakiibta ku soo celiyo Hormuz, isagoo adeegsanaya ilaalinta ciidamada badda, balse isu socodka maraakiibta ayaa weli aad uga hooseeya heerkii ka hor dagaalka. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta oo Iran ka hela taageero hub, dhaqaale iyo farsamo, ma aha xoog si buuxda Tehran uga amar qaata, balse horumarkooda Yemen wuxuu si toos ah u xoojinayaa awoodda Iran ee cadaadiska gobolka. Gregory Brew oo ah falanqeeye sare oo ka tirsan Eurasia Group ayaa sheegay in guulaha Xuutiyiinta ay “miisaanka dib ugu soo celiyeen dhinaca Iran”, isagoo tilmaamay in Tehran ay ku guuleysatay inay beddesho xaaladda iyada oo aan weli dib loogu noqon dagaal buuxa oo ka ballaaran kan hadda socda. Saudi Arabia ayaa sidoo kale raadineysa taageero dheeraad ah oo Mareykan ah. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegay in Dhaxal-suge Mohammed bin Salman uu Trump ka codsaday tallaabo militari oo ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta, balse Washington aysan ilaa hadda oggolaan weerarro toos ah, iyadoo halkooda bixisay taageero dhinaca xogta sirdoonka iyo bartilmaameedyada. Trump ayaa Sabtidii sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay la soo xiriireen maamulkiisa, isla markaana ay muujiyeen inaysan doonayn in Mareykanku si toos ah uga qayb galo dagaalka. Xaaladdan ayaa sidoo kale dib u soo celisay su’aalo ku saabsan sida dalalka Khaliijku u arkaan dammaanadda amni ee Mareykanka, maadaama qaar ka mid ah xulafada Washington ay weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn la kulmeen tan iyo markii uu dagaalka Iran billowday bishii February. Dhinaca diblomaasiyadda, Iran waxay isla waqtigaas isku dayaysaa inay awooddeeda militari u beddesho saameyn siyaasadeed. Iran iyo Cumaan ayaa la filayaa inay martigeliyaan kulan ay dalalka xeebaha Khaliijku kaga wadahadlayaan mustaqbalka marinka Hormuz iyo habka loo maareyn karo isu socodka maraakiibta. Kulankaas ayaa muhiimad gaar ah yeelan kara haddii dalalka Khaliijku aqbalaan hannaan Tehran siinaya door weyn oo ku saabsan maamulka ama ammaanka Hormuz. Bahrain ayaa sheegtay inaysan ka qayb geli doonin wadahadalka, halka dalal kale aysan weli si cad u shaacin mowqifkooda. Waxaa weli aan caddayn waxa kulankaasi dhalin doono, laakiin xaaladda hadda jirta waxay muujinaysaa dhibaatada hortaalla dalalka Khaliijka: inay sii wajahaan dagaal aan lahayn dhammaad siyaasadeed oo muuqda, ama inay raadiyaan heshiis yareeya khatarta maraakiibta iyo dhaqaalaha, xitaa haddii taasi Iran siiso saameyn dheeraad ah. Iran, dhankeeda, waxay sii waddaa cadaadis militari iyo mid siyaasadeed oo isku mar socda. Natiijadu waxay tahay in inkasta oo Tehran ay dhaqaale ahaan cadaadis weyn ku jirto, haddana maalmahan ay dib u heshay qaar ka mid ah awooddii ay ku saameyn lahayd xisaabta gobolka — iyada oo Hormuz weli carqaladeysan yahay, Xuutiyiintuna hadda khatar cusub ku yihiin Bab al-Mandab. Xaaladdan ayaa sidoo kale dib u soo celisay su’aalo ku saabsan sida dalalka Khaliijku u arkaan dammaanadda amni ee Mareykanka, maadaama qaar ka mid ah xulafada Washington ay weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn la kulmeen tan iyo markii uu dagaalka Iran billowday bishii February. Dhinaca diblomaasiyadda, Iran waxay isla waqtigaas isku dayaysaa inay awooddeeda militari u beddesho saameyn siyaasadeed. Iran iyo Cumaan ayaa la filayaa inay martigeliyaan kulan ay dalalka xeebaha Khaliijku kaga wadahadlayaan mustaqbalka marinka Hormuz iyo habka loo maareyn karo isu socodka maraakiibta. Kulankaas ayaa muhiimad gaar ah yeelan kara haddii dalalka Khaliijku aqbalaan hannaan Tehran siinaya door weyn oo ku saabsan maamulka ama ammaanka Hormuz. Bahrain ayaa sheegtay inaysan ka qayb geli doonin wadahadalka, halka dalal kale aysan weli si cad u shaacin mowqifkooda. Waxaa weli aan caddayn waxa kulankaasi dhalin doono, laakiin xaaladda hadda jirta waxay muujinaysaa dhibaatada hortaalla dalalka Khaliijka: inay sii wajahaan dagaal aan lahayn dhammaad siyaasadeed oo muuqda, ama inay raadiyaan heshiis yareeya khatarta maraakiibta iyo dhaqaalaha, xitaa haddii taasi Iran siiso saameyn dheeraad ah. Iran, dhankeeda, waxay sii waddaa cadaadis militari iyo mid siyaasadeed oo isku mar socda. Natiijadu waxay tahay in inkasta oo Tehran ay dhaqaale ahaan cadaadis weyn ku jirto, haddana maalmahan ay dib u heshay qaar ka mid ah awooddii ay ku saameyn lahayd xisaabta gobolka — iyada oo Hormuz weli carqaladeysan yahay, Xuutiyiintuna hadda khatar cusub ku yihiin Bab al-Mandab. items.title: Abaabul ciidan oo laga wado Xerada Militariga Xananbuure (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Taliyaha Qaybta 21aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Korneyl Maxamed Cabdi Daahir (Maxamed Dhagaweyne) ayaa galabta booqday Xerada Militariga Xananbuure ee Gobolka Galgaduud, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay cutub ciidan oo loo diyaarinayo inay ka qayb qaataan guluf militari oo laga bilaabayo Galmudug. Taliska Qaybta 21aad ayaa qoraal ku sheegay in guluf militari la filayo in dhawaan laga bilaabo deegaanada Galmudug. Saraakiisha Qaybta 21aad ee taliskoodu yahay Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ayaa kuu sheegaya in ciidamadu ay dhawaan hawlgal ka dhan ah maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ka samayn doonaan deegaanada ay maleeshiyadu kaga sugan tahay Gobolada Galgaduud iyo Mudug. “Taliyaha ayaa xerada u tegay dhiirigelinta ciidamada iyo u kuurgelidda diyaargarowga ka socda.” Ayuu yiri Sarkaal ka tirsan Qaybta 21aad oo aan la hadalnay, kaasoo diiday in magaciisa la adeegsado. Sarkaalkan ayaa ku waramaya in ciidamada loo diyaarinayo in ay ka qayb qaataan hawlgal cusub oo lagu la dagaalamayo kooxaha argagixisada. Saraakiisha Qaybta 21aad ayaa ka gaabsanaya inay sheegaan deegaanada loo socdo in laga saaro amaba laga difaaco Shabaab, waxayse tani ku soo aadeysa, xilli Shabaabku ay maalmihii u dambeeyay soo buuxiyeen deegaanada hoostaga Degmada Xarardheere ee Gobolka Mudug. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, kuwa Galmudug iyo dadka deegaanka ee horey loo abaabulay, kuna sugan magaalada ayaa heegan la geliyay, si ay uga hortaggaan weerar ay Shabaabku ku soo qaadi karaan Xarardheere oo laga saaray 16-kii bishii January ee sanadkii 2023. Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug ayaa looga diyaargaroobayaa doorashada ku celiska ah ee 30-ka bishan laga qabanayo Gobolada Dhexe, taas oo sidoo kale keeneysa in la bilaabo dadaalo lagu adkeynayo amniga magaalooyinka iyo deegaanada ay doorashadu ka dhaceyso, si ay ugu qabsoomto jewi nabdoon.

items.title: Yemen’s Tariq Saleh reportedly flees to Somaliland after Houthi takeover of Al Mukha
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Brigadier General Tariq Saleh, a member of Yemen’s Presidential Leadership Council and commander of the National Resistance on the country’s western coast, has reportedly fled Yemen by sea for Somaliland after his forces withdrew from Al Mukha on Thursday, allowing Houthi militants to seize control of the area, The Daily Somalia reported on Saturday Saleh is reportedly in Hargeisa, the capital of Somaliland, according to information that has yet to be independently confirmed by either Somaliland authorities or Yemen’s government. The reported arrival of one of Yemen’s prominent military figures in Hargeisa comes after the withdrawal of his forces from Al Mukha, where Houthi militants subsequently took control. Somaliland, the breakaway region in northern Somalia, enjoys Emirati support and received recognition from Israel in December. The region also hosts an airbase in the coastal city Berbera established by the United Arab Emirates for joint services with Washington and Tel Aviv. The Berbera facility was also reportedly the route through which Aidarus Al-Zoubaidi , president of the dissolved Transitional Council, escaped in December last year after fleeing Aden by sea. Saleh’s reported movement from Yemen to Somaliland places Hargeisa once again at the center of attention as a destination for senior Yemeni figures fleeing upheaval in the country. The information that Saleh is currently in Hargeisa remains unconfirmed by Somaliland or Yemen’s government. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Xukun lagu riday Askari Jante Dartiis u dilay Muwaadin
items.description: Dable Xoogga Maxamuud Axmed Faarax Kabtan Dhashiike, ayaa lagu eedeeyay in uu si kas ah u dilay Marxuum Cabdicasiis Shiikh Xuseen, Shan iyo tobankii bishii Shanaad ee Sanadkaan 2026, falkaas ayaana ka dhacay Degmadda Luuq ee Gobolka Gedo. Kabtan Dhashiike & Marxuumka oo xiriir & wax is dhaafsi uusan ka dhaxeyn, kadib khilaaf horey uga dhaxeeyey, ayaa isku arkay guri ku yaalla dhanka Beeraha Luuq, Waxaana Eedeysanaha oo Sigaar heysta uu bilaabay inuu raadiyo Kabriid ama Jante, si uu u shito. Waxa uu weydiistay Koofi oo labadaba Saaxib lahaa, Marxuumka oo lahaa Jantaha, ayaa Jeebka ku ritay, si diidmo ah, Eedeysanaha oo Intaas caro ka qaaday ayaana keentay inuu labo Baalooto oo AK 47 ah Ku dhufto Alle ha u naxariistee C/casiis Shiikh Xuseen, isla Goobtaasi ayuuna ku geeriyooday Marxuumka. Baaris Dheer ka dib Xafiiska Xeer ilaalinta Ciidamada QS, ayaa Codsaday qaadista kiiskaan, waxaana laga oggolaaday Seddexdii Bishaan September. Garsoorka Maxkamadda Ciidamada Qalabka sida oo waqti ku filan siiyey dhinacyadda dacwadda ayaa ugu dambeyn maanta ku xukumay Ex-Dable Xoogga Maxamuud Axmed Faarax Kabtan Dhashiike Dil Toogasho oo ah qisaasta Marxuum Cabdicasiis Shiikh Xuseen ah. Sida uu warbaahinta u sheegay Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda darajada 1aad ee Ciidamada Qalabka sida, Gaashaanle sare Xasan Cali Nuur Shuute.

items.title: Hirshabelle oo cagaha la gashay xiisad adag oo siyaasadeed, iyadoo la joogo waqtigii doorashada
items.description: Xiisaddan ka soo korortay Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle ayaa ka dambeysay, ka dib markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu go’aansaday in uu taageero dib-u-doorashada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdulaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe), taasoo ay si weyn uga horyimaadeen Siyaasiyiinta Gobolka Hiiraan. Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka oo habeenkii Khamiista xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Madaxweyne Kuxigeenka Hirshabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Yuusuf Dabageed) ayaa la wadaagay in Urur Siyaasadeedka JSP ee uu hoggaamiyo uu isku raacay in Cali Guudlaawe uu noqdo musharaxa rasmiga ah ee ururka ku meteli doona doorashada madaxtinimada Hirshballe. Dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo dhaqanka ee Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa si adag uga horyimid go’aankan, oo ay ku tilmaameen mid meel ka dhac ku ah hannaanka awood qaybsiga beelaha ee dhismaha Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle. Yuusuf Dabageed, Madaxweyne Kuxigeenka Hirshabelle ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku eedeeyay in uu uga baxay ballanqaad hore, oo ahaa in hoggaanka sare ee Hirshabelle loo dhaafi doono beesha bariga Gobolka Hiiraan, doorashada soo socota. Hirshabelle oo ka kooban Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Shabellaha Dhexe ayaa ku dhisan heshiis siyaasadeed is faham ah awood qaybsi beeleed iyo deegaan, kaas oo lagu dheelitiro hoggaanka labada gobol ee Hiiraan iyo Shabellaha Dhexe. Maadaama Madaxweynaha hadda xafiiska jooga, waa Cali Guudlaawe uu ka soo jeedo Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe ayay reer Hiiraan u doonayaan in la ixtiraamo tookada ay u leeyihiin inay hoggaamiyaan maamulka, dhowrka sano ee ina soo aaddan. Nidaamka tooko-tookada ayay dad badani u arkaan mid ku saleysan, si looga fogaado in awoodda ay hal dhinac u badato, loona xaqiijiyo in dadka deegaanka ee labada gobol ay dareemaan in ay metelaad dhab ah ku leeyihiin maamulka. Yuusuf Dabageed oo Jimcihii ka hadlayay kulan ay siyaasiyiinta iyo odayaasha reer Hiiraan qaarkood ku yeesheen Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa sheegay inaanan wax doorasho ahi laga qaban karin Gobolka Hiiraan, inta laga gaarayo heshiis siyaasadeed. “Tuulo ka mid ah Hiiraan lagama samayn karo doorasho wax la yiraahdo, ciddii isku daydaana ayadoon doorashadaas siyaasiyan aan laga heshiin, ciddii isku daydaa, wixii ka yimaado masuuliyaddeeda iyadaa qaadeyso.” Ayuu yiri Yuusuf Dabageed. Khilaafkan ayaa cawaaqib ku yeelan kara doorashada qof iyo codka ee la filayo in dhawaan laga qabto labada gobol ee Hirshabelle, laguna soo dooranayo Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Hirshabelle.

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka XDS oo gaaray Baydhabo
items.description: Baydhabo: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sareeye Guud Saalax Cabdullaahi Cumar, oo ay wehliyaan saraakiil ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Baydhabo, oo ah xarunta ku-meelgaarka ah ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Taliyaha iyo wafdiga la socday ayaa garoonka diyaaradaha Shaati Gaduud ee magaalada Baydhabo waxaa ku soo dhaweeyay Taliyaha Qeybta 60-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Gaashaanle Sare Isxaaq Aadan (Isxaaq Berdaale) iyo saraakiil kale oo ka tirsan Ciidanka XDS. Markii uu gaaray magaalada, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa salaan sharaf ka qaatay cutub ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed oo safnaa garoonka diyaaradaha. Soo dhaweynta kaddib, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka iyo saraakiisha socdaalka ku wehelinayay ayaa kulan gaar ah la qaatay saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ee ka howlgala magaalada Baydhabo iyo taliska Qeybta 60-aad. Socdaalka Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka XDS ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu dardar-gelinayo howlgalada ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada, iyadoo sidoo kale diiradda lagu saarayo xoojinta awoodda iyo wada-shaqeynta ciidamada ka howlgala deegaannada maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Kulamada iyo kormeerka Taliyaha ayaa la filayaa inay door muhiim ah ka qaataan dardargelinta howlgalada ciidamada iyo sugidda amniga deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya.

items.title: Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada Cirka Soomaaliya iyo Masar oo ku kulmay Qaahira
items.description: Qaahira, Masar: Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, General Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji, ayaa magaalada Qaahira ee dalka Masar kulan kula yeeshay Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Masar, General Amr Abdelrahman Saqr. Labada taliye ayaa kulankooda kaga wada hadlay horumarinta xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah iyo xoojinta iskaashiga ka dhexeeya Ciidamada Cirka Soomaaliya iyo Masar. Kulanka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray dhinacyada tababarka ciidamada, khibrad-wadaagga, dhismaha awoodda iyo horumarinta tayada Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Taliyeyaasha labada ciidan ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta dhinaca difaaca iyo amniga, si loo horumariyo awoodda ciidamada iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee labada dal. Soomaaliya iyo Masar ayaa leh taariikh dheer oo ku dhisan xiriir iyo iskaashi dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca ah, iyadoo labada dowladood ay ka go’an tahay sii xoojinta xiriirka qotada dheer iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee ka dhexeeya labada dal iyo shacabkooda.

items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa la xisaabtan iyo qiimeyn ku sameeyay wasiiradda Xukuumadda Dan Qaran. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha oo la hadlayay wasiiradda ayaa sheegay in la xisaabtankan looga gol leeyahay in lagu qiimeeyo shaqadii qabsoontay sanadkan iyada oo lala eegayo ballanqaadyadii wasiir kasta uu saxiixay, isaga oo xusey in haddii ay soo baxaan caqabado shaqooyinka qaar u qabsoomi waayeen la sixi doono hadafyada iyo bar-hiigsiyada ku qoran jadwalka heshiisyada wasiiradda lala galay. La xisaabtanka iyo qiimeynta ayaa markii ugu horeysey loo adeegsaday habka dowladnimada danabaysan, iyada oo shaashad weyn laga shiday boqoleyda natiijada kasoo baxday qiimeynta wasaarad kasta, iyo waliba sida wasaaradaha kaalmaha u kala galeen. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa Wasiiradda , Agaasimeyaasha guud iyo hawlwadeenada farsamo ee wasaaradaha kula dardaarmay in ay sii dardargaliyaan hawsha qaranka, kana soo dhalaalaan hawshii loo igmaday, isaga oo xusuusiyay in shacab weynaha xukuumadda ka sugayaan wax qabad badan. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa yiri “Qorshe ayaynu samaysanay, idinka ayaa dajiyay, kadibna waan isla saxiixanay, qorshihii ayaan isla qiimeynaynaa, waxaan eegeynaa caqabadaha jira, fursadaha iyo waxyaabaha aan sixi karno, waxaad ogtiiin in aan markasta sii horimarinayno qiimeynta aan samayno, waxaan hadda maraynaa xillihii hab dijitaan aan u guurnay, kaas oo sahlan, waqti badana aanan nagu qaadanaynin”.

items.title: Tareq Saleh Withdraws from Mocha as Houthis Seize Strategic Red Sea Port
items.description: Yemen (WDN) — Yemen’s western front has suffered a dramatic reversal after Houthi forces seized the strategic Red Sea port of Mocha, forcing forces commanded by Gen. Tareq Saleh to withdraw from the city and surrounding positions. Saleh, commander of Yemen’s National Resistance Forces and deputy chairman of the Presidential Leadership Council, has become the focus of conflicting reports about his whereabouts following the Houthi advance. RT reported claims that Saleh left Yemen by boat for Eritrea, but that account has not been independently confirmed. Reuters reported a different picture, saying Saleh ordered his forces to withdraw from threatened positions and establish an alternative command center in a safer location south of Mocha. The distinction is important. Reuters’ reporting points to a strategic military withdrawal and regrouping, rather than confirming that Saleh personally fled to Eritrea. A Major Reversal on the Red Sea Coast The Houthi capture of Mocha represents a major setback for the Saudi-backed Yemeni forces and a significant change in the military balance along the western coast. Reuters reported that Houthi forces seized Mocha after a rapid advance and continued moving toward the strategically important Bab al-Mandab Strait. Government forces and their allies have been withdrawing south toward Dhubab, which sits directly on the approach to the strait. The fighting has reportedly forced Saleh’s forces to abandon positions around Mocha and reorganize farther south. RT, meanwhile, has reported that Saleh’s forces suffered a rapid defeat in fighting that lasted less than 24 hours. That account, including the reported scale of the military setback, should be treated as RT’s assessment rather than an independently established fact. Where Is Tareq Saleh? The most important unresolved question is Saleh’s current location. Reports claiming that he crossed the Red Sea to Eritrea remain unverified. Reuters’ reporting instead indicates that he remained involved in directing his forces’ withdrawal and regrouping. Until Saleh, his military command or the Yemeni government provides a direct statement, claims about his personal flight to Eritrea should therefore be treated cautiously. Why Mocha Matters Mocha’s importance extends far beyond the city itself. Located on Yemen’s Red Sea coast near Bab al-Mandab, the port lies close to one of the world’s most important maritime chokepoints. The strait connects the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden and the wider Indian Ocean and is critical to international shipping and energy supplies. Reuters reported that the Houthi advance toward Mocha and the nearby Hanish Islands is bringing the movement closer to a position from which it could exert greater pressure on Bab al-Mandab. If the Houthis consolidate their control over the western coastline, the consequences could extend well beyond Yemen’s civil war, affecting maritime security, commercial shipping and the wider regional balance. A Withdrawal, Not Necessarily a Collapse For Saleh, the immediate challenge is to preserve his forces and prevent the loss of the remaining strategic positions along the coast. A withdrawal does not necessarily mean the destruction of the National Resistance Forces. It may instead represent an attempt to preserve manpower and equipment and prepare for a counteroffensive. But the loss of Mocha is undeniably a major setback. The Eritrea story remains unconfirmed. What Reuters has established is that Saleh ordered a strategic withdrawal and that his forces are being pushed south by the Houthi advance. The battle for Mocha has therefore created a new strategic reality on Yemen’s western coast—and brought the Houthis significantly closer to one of the world’s most important maritime chokepoints. items.title: Somali Pirates Have The Released Hijacked Vessel
items.description: Bossaso (WDN) — Somali pirates have reportedly released a vessel they had held hostage since April, according to security sources cited by local media, highlighting the continuing vulnerability of commercial shipping in waters already facing growing security threats from piracy and the conflict in Yemen. The vessel, which was reportedly carrying 17 crew members, was released under circumstances that have not yet been fully explained. Security sources have not disclosed the ship’s name, flag, exact location of the hijacking or the precise date of its release. It also remains unclear whether the vessel was freed following negotiations, an agreement with the pirates or the payment of a ransom. No details have been provided on whether any money changed hands. The reported release was first carried by AFP, which said the vessel had been seized by Somali pirates in April. The development comes against the backdrop of a deteriorating maritime-security environment stretching from Somalia’s coastline across the Gulf of Aden and into the Red Sea. A Wider Maritime Security Crisis The resurgence of Somali piracy is unfolding alongside a separate but interconnected security crisis in Yemen, where the Houthi movement has been engaged in an escalating conflict with forces aligned with Yemen’s internationally recognized government. The Houthi conflict has had consequences far beyond Yemen’s borders. Attacks and threats against commercial shipping in and around the Red Sea have forced many vessels to reconsider traditional routes through the Bab al-Mandab Strait, one of the world’s most important maritime chokepoints. The resulting insecurity has created a complex maritime environment in which commercial vessels face risks from multiple directions. Along Somalia’s coast, piracy remains a persistent threat despite a dramatic decline from the peak of the piracy crisis more than a decade ago. Further north, the Red Sea has become increasingly exposed to missile, drone and other attacks associated with the conflict in Yemen. Together, these developments have placed the Gulf of Aden and Red Sea at the center of a broader international maritime-security challenge. Piracy Has Declined—but Not Disappeared Somali piracy reached unprecedented levels in the late 2000s and early 2010s, prompting major international naval deployments and the introduction of stronger security measures aboard commercial vessels. Those efforts dramatically reduced successful hijackings. But the underlying networks did not disappear entirely. The reported seizure of a vessel carrying 17 people in April demonstrates that pirate groups remain capable of exploiting gaps in maritime surveillance and security. The release of the vessel also raises questions about the financial incentives that continue to sustain piracy. If ransom payments were involved, the case would demonstrate that hijacking remains potentially profitable despite years of international efforts to dismantle pirate networks. For Somalia and international maritime forces, the challenge is therefore not simply preventing individual attacks. It is disrupting the criminal networks that finance, organize and profit from maritime kidnappings. The Gulf of Aden’s Strategic Importance The security of the Gulf of Aden matters far beyond Somalia and Yemen. The waterway connects the Indian Ocean to the Red Sea and provides access to the Suez Canal, making it an essential route for global trade between Asia, Europe and the Middle East. Any sustained increase in piracy or attacks on commercial shipping can raise insurance costs, disrupt supply chains and force vessels to take longer and more expensive routes around Africa. That makes the security situation along Somalia’s coastline increasingly important to international governments and naval forces. The challenge is particularly complicated because piracy and the Yemen conflict are separate security problems, even though they occur within the same strategically connected maritime region. Somalia Faces a Continuing Test For Somalia, the latest incident is a reminder that securing one of the world’s longest coastlines remains a major challenge. The country needs stronger maritime surveillance, a capable coast guard and navy, effective intelligence-sharing and closer cooperation with international naval forces. But long-term success will also depend on addressing the economic conditions that can make piracy attractive to coastal criminal networks. The reported release of the hijacked vessel is therefore welcome news for its crew, but it should not obscure the wider problem. From Somali piracy to Houthi attacks and the fighting in Yemen, the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden are becoming an increasingly contested maritime corridor. The immediate question is whether the region’s governments and international partners can prevent these separate threats from reinforcing one another—and ensure that one of the world’s most important trade routes does not become a permanent zone of insecurity. This version deliberately distinguishes Somali piracy from the Houthi-Yemen conflict while showing how both contribute to the broader security risks surrounding the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandab and Gulf of Aden. items.title: Dibad-bax ka dhacay Beledweyne oo taageero loogu muujiyay go’aanka Xasan
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Dibad-bax ballaaran oo lagu taageerayo go’aanka Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee ku aaddan kaarka JSP ee HirShabelle oo la sheegay inla siinayo Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe ayaa maanta lagu qabtay magaalada Beledweyne ee xarunta gobolka Hiiraan. Dibad-baxa ayaa waxaa ka qayb-galaya mas’uuliyiinta gobolka, kuwa degmada iyo boqolaal shacab ah, iyada oo amniga ay sugeen ciidamada ammaanka ee Beledweyne. Mas’uul sare oo ka hadlay dibad-baxa ayaa warbaahinta u sheegay inay taageerayaan xisbiga JSP iyo kaarka in la siiyo madaxweynaha HirShabelle Cali Guudlaawe oo mar kale u sharraxan xilka madaxweynaha ee maamulkaas. “Maanta waxaan isugu soo baxnay banaanbax lagu taageerayo xisbiga JSP, degmada Beledweyne annaga oo ka kooban maamulka heer gobolka, heer degmo, wasiirro, xildhibaanno. Sidoo kale waxaan taagereynaa in kaarka la siiyay madaxweynaheenna Cali Guudlaawe Xuseen, waana garab taaganahay,” ayuu yiri mid kamid ah mas’uuliyiinta ka qayb-galay dibadbaxa Beledweyne. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in diyaar garoga doorashada uu ka socda Beledweyne, isla markaana ay si wanaagsan uga qayb-geli doonaan, maadaama codadka ay dhiibaan doonan dadweynaha reer HirShabelle. “Doorashada si fiican ayay u socotaa wax dhib ah ma jiraan, waxaana leenahay xisbiga JSP ha guuleysto,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Arrintan ayaa durbo khilaaf ka dhalisay deegaannada HirShabelle, waxaana madaxweyne ku-xigeenka maamulka uusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) oo xalay hadlay uu Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ku eedeeyay inuu uga baxay ballan siyaasadeed oo uu la galay. Dabageed oo sheegay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ay horay ugu heshiiyeen, uguna ballanqaaday inuu hoggaanka HirShabelle isaga siiyo ayaa sheegay in Xasan Sheekh uu hadda waxba kama jiraan kasoo qaaday ballankaas. Dabageed ayaa sheegay in xalay kulan albaabadu u xirnaayeen oo uu la yeeshay Xasan Sheekh uu ku wargeliyay in kursigii HirShabelle aan loo hayn, sidaas darteedna uu tanaasulo. “Madaxweynaha shalay markuu isoo wacay, waxaa u qabay laba qodob midkood: Madaxweynihii ayaa ku siinayaa ee reer HirShabelle ku hoggaami oo shaqadii la wareeg, ama inuu leeyahay waxaan ku ballannay waa shaqeyn waayay, oo nin kale oo Xawaadle ah oo ilma adeer tihiin ayaa kursigii la siiyay ee la shaqee ninkaas, sidaas ayuu ku dhihi islahaa hadduu adiga ku siin waayo,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne ku xigeenka Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle. Dabageed ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Madaxweynuhu uu si cad ugu sheegay in xilka maamulka HirShabelle uu u wado Cali Guudlaawe, oo mar kale isku soo taagaya hoggaanka maamulka. “Madaxweynihii xalay waxaan kala kulmay wax uu nin fiyow oo ehel iyo mas’uul ah oo Madaxweyne Soomaaliyeed uu dhihi karo aanan u qabin. Ballankii reer abtigay waa ka baxay ee kursiga iiga doon, oo iga nabad doonee ayuu igu dhahay,” ayuu mar kale yiri Dabageed. Inkastoo weli uusan jirin war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay Villa Soomaaliya oo si cad u xaqiijinaya in heshiis kama dambeys ah laga gaaray musharraxa Madaxweynaha HirShabelle ama in Guudlaawe loo go’aamiyay inuu mar kale hoggaamiyo maamulka, haddana waxaa isa soo taraya wararka sheegay in Xasan uu kaarka JSP siinayo Guudlaawe, si mar kale loogu dhiso hoggaanka maamulka.
