items.title: Sio presents its policy work and intranational campaign for Somaliland recognition
items.description: PRESS STATEMENT SIO PRESENTS ITS POLICY WORK AND INTERNATIONAL CAMPAIGN FOR SOMALILAND RECOGNITION The Somaliland Intellectual Organisation (SIO) — Madasha Indheer-Garadka Somaliland today held a press conference highlighting its policy work and ongoing diplomatic campaign in support of the international recognition of Somaliland. SIO announced the completion and dispatch of 25 individually prepared and signed diplomatic letters addressed to selected world leaders and major international institutions. The campaign has been timed around the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA 81) to bring Somaliland’s historical, legal and political case directly to international decision-makers. The Organisation also expressed its support for the diplomatic efforts of the President of the Republic of Somaliland, calling upon Somalilanders at home and abroad, government and opposition alike, to stand together whenever the President represents Somaliland’s national cause internationally. The press conference also highlighted SIO’s growing body of policy work, including research on Somaliland Recognition; Media and Social Cohesion; National Voter Registration Reform; Climate Change, Drought and Water Security; Fiscal Expansion; Airspace Sovereignty; and National Airport Policy. SIO has also proposed four important pieces of national legislation: the Data Protection Act, Artificial Intelligence Act, Super Security Act, and Media Act. A special appeal was made to Somaliland women throughout the world, regardless of their political affiliation, to unite behind the recognition campaign and use their voices, networks and influence to take Somaliland’s case to parliamentarians, political leaders, civil society and the international media. Our message today is simple: Recognition does not belong to the government. Recognition does not belong to the opposition. Recognition does not belong to any individual, party or region. Recognition belongs to Somaliland. THE WORLD MUST HEAR SOMALILAND. Somaliland Intellectual Organisation (SIO) Madasha Indheer-Garadka Somaliland Courage • Unity • Sovereignty • Wisdom

items.title: Mayarka Hargeysa oo ka qayb-galay xidhitaanka iyo ansixinta Xeerka Nidaamiyaha Maaraynta Qashinka Adag
items.description: Duqa Caasimadda Hargeysa, Eng. Cabdirisaaq Maxamed Faarax (Wiiwaa), ayaa maanta goob-joog ka ahaa xidhitaanka iyo ansixinta Xeerka Nidaamiyaha Maaraynta Qashinka Adag, kaas oo muhiim u ah hagaajinta iyo nidaaminta maaraynta qashinka magaalada. Kulanka oo ka qabsoomay Hotel Serene Sarovar Premiere Hargeysa, ayaa muddo wada-tashi iyo diyaar-garow ah kadib lagu soo gunaanaday xeerka, waxaana ka qayb-galay Wasaaradda Dawladaha Hoose iyo Horumarinta Magaalooyinka JSL, Maamulka Dawladda Hoose ee Hargeysa iyo Hay’adda DT Global. Xeerkan ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh hagaajinta nadaafadda, nidaaminta maaraynta qashinka, ilaalinta bilicda magaalada iyo kor u qaadista adeegyada nadaafadda ee loo fidiyo bulshada reer Hargeysa. Duqa Caasimadda ayaa munaasabadda ka qayb-galkiisa ku muujiyey sida ay Dawladda Hoose ee Hargeysa uga go’an tahay xoojinta nadaafadda iyo hirgelinta nidaamyo casri ah oo lagu maareeyo qashinka magaalada. Dowladda Hoose iyo DT Global waxay hore uga wada shaqeeyeen arrimo la xidhiidha horumarinta magaalooyinka iyo maaraynta qashinka.

items.title: Pakistan oo Xuutiyiinta uga digtay in weerarrada Sacuudigu kicin karaan difaac wadajir ah
items.description: Islamabad, 10 Sebteembar — Wasiirka Difaaca Pakistan, Khawaja Asif, ayaa ka digay in weerarrada Xuutiyiintu ku hayaan Sacuudi Carabiya ay hawlgelin karaan heshiiska difaaca wadajirka ah ee u dhexeeya Pakistan, Sacuudiga iyo Turkiga. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo la sheegay inay qabsadeen dekedda Mocha, kuna sii dhowaanayaan Bab al-Mandab
items.description: Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa la sheegay inay qabsadeen magaalada taariikhiga ah ee dekedda leh ee Mocha, taas oo ku taalla xeebta Badda Cas, iyadoo horumarkan cusub uu sare u qaadayo walaaca laga qabo amniga marin-biyoodka istaraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab. Sida ay sheegeen ilo militari oo Yemen ah, ciidamada Xuutiyiinta ayaa horumar ka sameeyay jiidda dagaalka, iyagoo sidoo kale weerarro ka fuliyay deegaanno iyo jasiirado ku yaalla Badda Cas, halka ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee taageerada ka hela Sacuudiga ay dib ugu gurteen dhinaca deegaanka Dhubab. Dhubab ayaa ah goob istaraatiiji ah oo aad ugu dhow Bab al-Mandab, marin-biyoodka isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Gobolkaasi wuxuu muhiimad weyn u leeyahay isu-socodka ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo maraakiibta shidaalka qaada. Haddii Xuutiyiintu sii xoojiyaan joogitaankooda deegaannada ku dhow Bab al-Mandab, waxay heli karaan awood dheeraad ah oo ay kula socdaan ama khatar ugu geliyaan maraakiibta isticmaasha marinkan muhiimka ah. Bab al-Mandab ayaa ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu istaraatiijisan dunida, maadaama uu isku xiro waddooyinka ganacsiga ee u dhexeeya Yurub, Bariga Dhexe iyo Aasiya. Khalkhal kasta oo ka dhaca halkaasi wuxuu si toos ah u saameyn karaa ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo qiimaha gaadiidka badda. Horumarkan ayaa sidoo kale walaac weyn ku haya dalalka ku yaalla Geeska Afrika, gaar ahaan Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti, kuwaas oo ku dhow goobaha ay colaadaha iyo xiisadaha badda ka socdaan. Soomaaliya ayaa si gaar ah u dareemi karta saameyn kasta oo ka dhalata amni-darrada Bab al-Mandab iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iyadoo khatartu saamayn ku yeelan karto maraakiibta ganacsiga, dekedaha iyo guud ahaan ammaanka xeebaha gobolka. Dagaalladan cusub ayaa muujinaya isbeddel weyn oo ku yimid jiidda hore ee colaadda Yemen tan iyo xabbad-joojintii la gaaray sannadkii 2022, iyadoo laga cabsi qabo in xiisadda hadda taagan ay mar kale isu beddesho dagaal ballaaran. Labada dhinac ee ku lugta leh colaadda ayaa soo bandhigay sheegashooyin kala duwan oo ku saabsan horumarka dagaalka iyo khasaaraha ka dhashay, kuwaas oo aan dhammaantood si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin. Haddii xaaladda Mocha iyo deegaannada ku dhow Bab al-Mandab ay sii xumaato, waxaa sare u kici kara khatarta amni ee Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, taas oo saameynteedu gaari karto guud ahaan gobolka iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah.

Aljeeriya oo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed u jartay Imaaraadka Carabta
items.description: Algiers, Sebteembar 10, 2026 – Dowladda Aljeeriya ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay si rasmi ah u jartay xiriirkii diblomaasiyadeed ee kala dhexeeyay Imaaraadka Carabta, kadib sannado ay sii xoogeysanayeen xiisadaha u dhexeeyay labada dal. Warbaahinta dowladda Aljeeriya ayaa sheegtay in go’aankan la qaatay kaddib markii Aljeeriya ay, sida ay sheegtay, isku day dhammaan waddooyinka lagu badbaadin karo xiriirka labada dhinac. Dowladda Aljeeriya ma aysan bixin faahfaahin buuxda oo ku saabsan sababaha tooska ah ee keenay go’aanka, halka dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta aysan markiiba wax jawaab ah ka soo saarin arrintan. Xiriirka u dhexeeya Algiers iyo Abu Dhabi ayaa sii xumaanayay sannadihii u dambeeyay. Madaxweynaha Aljeeriya, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, ayaa hore u qiray inay jiraan khilaafaad kala dhexeeya mid ka mid ah dowladaha Khaliijka, inkastoo aan si rasmi ah loo magacaabin dalkaasi. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay bishii Febraayo, markii Aljeeriya ay billowday hanaanka lagu burinayo heshiiskii adeegyada duulimaadyada ee ay labada dal wada galeen sannadkii 2013. Go’aanka Aljeeriya ee ay xiriirka ugu jartay Imaaraadka ayaa loo arkaa mid si weyn u saameyn kara xiriirka siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed ee labada dal, kuwaas oo ka mid ah dowladaha saamaynta ku leh dunida Carabta iyo qaaradda Afrika. Waxaa la filayaa in saacadaha iyo maalmaha soo socda ay soo baxaan faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan sababaha go’aankan, iyo sidoo kale jawaabta rasmiga ah ee dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta.

items.title: Somaliland willing to send up to 2,000 troops to Gaza force, president says
items.description: Somaliland willing to send up to 2,000 troops to Gaza force, president says Somaliland is willing to contribute up to 2,000 soldiers to the International Stabilization Force planned for Gaza but is waiting for the US or Israel to ask, Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi said on Wednesday. “If they ask, we can provide,” Abdullahi said in an interview on the sidelines of the MEAD conference, stressing that although Somaliland is not volunteering, “if they ask me, I am ready.

items.title: Xogta duqeyn culus oo ka dhacday duleedka Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa kasoo baxaya duqeymo xooggan oo maanta diyaarado dagaal ay ka fuliyeen agagaarka magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta KMG ah ee Koonfur Galbeed. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in duqeynta lagu garaacay goobo ay ku sugnaayeen ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ee deggan bannaanka magaalada, iyada oo gantaallada lagu burburiyay godad ku yiilay halkaasi. Saraakiil ka tirsan laamaha amniga ayaa sheegay in goobaha la duqeeyay ay kayd u ahayd ciidamada taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, isla markaana la burburiyay, hase yeeshee sheegashadaas weli ma jiraan ilo madax-bannaan oo si rasmi ah u xaqiijiyay. Ma cadda khasaaraha dhabta ah ee ka dhashay duqeynta ka dhacday duleedka magaalada Baydhaba, waxaana weli xaaladdu ay tahay mid kacsan, iyada oo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo xooggan laga dareemayo halkaasi. Dhinaca kale, afhayeenka Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo booqday meeaha la duqeeyay ayaa halkaasi kasoo duubay muuqaal, isaga oo sheegay in goobahaasi ay deganaayeen dad shacab ah, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Shacab la duqeeyo dowlad lagu ma ahaanaayo,” ayuu yiri Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo tegay goobaha la duqeeyay. Weerarkan cusub ee ay qaadeen diyaaradaha dagaalka ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyadoo horay maamulka Aadan Madoobe ugu hanjabay inuu qaadayo tallaab ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab iyo ciidanka taabacsan Lafta-gareen ee ku sugan halkaasi. Tallaabooyinka uu qaadayo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa qayb ka ah dadaaada lagu xoojinayo amniga magaalada Baydhaba iyo guud ahaan deegaannada Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo mudnaanta la siinayo sugidda amniga, taageeridda ciidamada iyo ilaalinta shacabka. The post Xogta duqeyn culus oo ka dhacday duleedka Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland oo shaacisay inay ciidamo u direyso Gaza
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online ) — Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi (Cirro) oo haatan ku sugan Mareykanka, ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in Somaliland ay diyaar u tahay in illaa 2,000 oo askari ay ku biiriso ciidanka caalamiga ah ee loo qorsheynayo xasilinta Gaza, haddii ay arrintaas si rasmi ah uga codsadaan Mareykanka iyo Israel. Cirro ayaa hadalkan Arbacadii ka sheegay magaalada Washington, oo uu uga qeyb-galayay shirka MEAD, isaga oo sheegay in Somaliland aysan si iskeed ah u dalbanaynin inay ciidamo dirto, balse ay diyaar tahay haddii laga sooncodsado. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Somaliland ay leedahay ciidan ku dhow 25,000 oo askari iyo ilaalada Xeebaha oo iyagana gaaraya ku dhawaad 1,500 oo askari. “Haddii nala weydiisto, waan bixin karnaa. Inkastoo aanan annagu iskaa isu soo bandhigayn, haddii la i weydiisto, waa diyaar,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynuhu. Tallaabadan waxaa ka horreeyay in bishii June ay Somaliland safaarad ka furatay magaalada Qudus, xilli uu Cabdiraxmaan Cirro booqasho rasmi ah ku tagay Israa’iil, taas oo dhalisay dood culus. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Somaliland ay dadaal xooggan ugu jirto sii xoojinta xiriirkeeda caalamiga ah, iyadoo tallaabooyin diblumaasiyadeed oo waaweyn qaaday tan iyo markii ay Israa’iil 26-kii December 2025 si rasmi ah ugu aqoonsatay dal madax-bannaan. Dhinaca kale, ciidanka caalamiga ah ee loo qorsheeyay Gaza ayaa lagu wadaa in ugu dambeyn uu gaaro ilaa 20,000 oo askari. Uganda ayaa oggolaatay inay bixiso ku dhawaad 1,200 askari, halka Morocco ay ballanqaadday illaa 500 askari. Albania, Kazakhstan iyo Kosovo ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay ciidamo ku biirin doonaan ciidanka uu hoggaaminayo Mareykanka. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, ciidanka ayaa loo qorsheeyay inuu ka shaqeeyo sugidda amniga, tababarka booliiska Falastiin, fududeynta gargaarka bani’aadannimo iyo ka hortagga in Xamaas dib u soo ceshato awooddeeda militari. The post Somaliland oo shaacisay inay ciidamo u direyso Gaza appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Uganda ayaa oggolaatay inay bixiso ku dhawaad 1,200 askari, halka Morocco ay ballanqaadday illaa 500 askari. Albania, Kazakhstan iyo Kosovo ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay ciidamo ku biirin doonaan ciidanka uu hoggaaminayo Mareykanka. items.title: The Doolow Drone Strike and Its Implications for Somalia, Turkey, and the International Community
items.description: By Djama Mahamoud Ali On the night of September 3, 2026, a drone struck the residence of General Mahad Abdirahman Aden, widely known as “General Shub,” in Doolow, a town in Somalia’s Gedo region along the Ethiopian border. The former commander of Somalia’s Custodial Corps survived with minor injuries, but civilians, including his wife and an Ethiopian national working at the residence, were reportedly wounded or . What makes this incident particularly consequential is not the attack itself but the allegations that have followed: that Turkish drones, operated in coordination with Somalia’s federal government, carried out the strike against a political opponent of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration. The attack occurred as political tensions were at a peak. According to reports, an agreement had been reached on a preliminary electoral framework, raising expectations for a potential deal between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and the opposition. The attack just days before this expected breakthrough is unlikely to be a coincidence; it appears to be a deliberate act of political violence. In this article I will examine three interlocking questions arising from the Doolow strike. First, will the international community maintain its trust in weapons transfers to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s regime? Second, will this incident serve as a cautionary lesson for the Turkish government, prompting it to impose greater accountability on the weapons it supplies? Third, does the attack reveal that Somalia needs not a partisan patron but a friend committed to reconciliation between its warring tribes and factions? The Incident and Its Political Context The Doolow strike did not occur in a vacuum. It followed armed confrontations in Baidoa between federal forces and fighters aligned with former South West State President Abdiaziz Laftagareen, to whom General Shub is closely allied. Jubaland regional authorities immediately accused Turkish drones of carrying out the attack, asserting that Shub was targeted “solely because of his political differences” with the federal government. The South West administration, aligned with Laftagareen, echoed these accusations, warning that the alleged use of Turkish drones against Somali politicians “could further deepen political tensions in the country”. The federal government has denied involvement, claiming instead that the explosions resulted from explosives being prepared inside the house. However, eyewitness reports confirm that a drone has conducted the strike. Turkey has remained publicly silent on the allegations. This silence, however, speaks volumes. The central concern is therefore not simply whether Türkiye is present. Its presence is well established. The question is whether a contested federal administration can authorize foreign military power against Somali actors without consultation, transparent legal oversight or agreement from the federal member state where an operation occurs. International Trust in Weapons to Hassan Sheikh’ s Regime The Doolow strike raises profound questions about the international community’s willingness to continue arming a regime whose political legitimacy is itself contested. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s original four-year mandate reached expired on May 15, 2026. The federal government argues that the unilaterally amended constitution extended presidential and parliamentary terms to five years, but opposition leaders and several federal member states reject this claim. The legality of this extension remains disputed. Jubaland and Puntland have already called for the United Nations to reconsider and potentially reimpose the arms embargo on Somalia that was lifted in December 2023. The regional administrations argued that weapons supplied by international partners “could be used in internal political conflicts and clan-based violence” rather than exclusively for counterterrorism operations. This is not an abstract concern. Earlier in 2026, Somali demonstrators protested outside the Turkish Consulate in Canada, accusing the federal government of deploying Turkish-provided military assets “against political opponents rather than against Al-Shabaab militants”. The international community faces a stark choice. If it continues supplying weapons to the federal government without robust accountability mechanisms, it risks becoming complicit in the militarization of Somalia’s internal political disputes. As Jubaland and Puntland warned, “continued arms transfers risk fueling further instability”. The United Nations, African Union, IGAD, United States, and European Union have all been urged to “examine Türkiye’s actions in Somalia” and reassess military assistance to the country. Trust in weapons transfers is not merely a matter of formal agreements; it depends on observable behavior. When weapons intended to fight Al-Shabaab are perceived rightly or wrongly as being turned against political opponents, the credibility of the entire security partnership erodes. The Doolow strike, has already damaged that credibility. A Lesson for Turkey: The Cost of Unaccountable Arms Transfers Turkey’s military involvement in Somalia has expanded dramatically over the past decade. Ankara operates its largest overseas military base in Mogadishu, trains Somali forces, and has deployed armed drones, attack helicopters, and even F-16 fighter jets to the country. This partnership has been framed as counterterrorism assistance against Al-Shabaab. Yet the Doolow incident reveals the dangers of supplying advanced military capabilities without adequate oversight of how they are used. The Doolow strike fits a broader pattern. In March 2026, authorities in Somalia’s Southwest State accused Turkey of involvement in military operations against the regional administration, alleging that Turkish-trained forces, equipment and drones were used in actions against the administration”. Somali Parliament Speaker expressed “strong concern over reports that Turkish-made drones were used in fighting against regional administration forces. These recurring allegations suggest a systemic problem: Turkish military assistance, however well-intentioned, is being drawn into Somalia’s internal power struggles. The lesson for Turkey is clear. By supplying weapons without demanding accountability for their use, Ankara risks being perceived not as a neutral partner but as a partisan actor backing one side in Somalia’s fractured politics. Jubaland and Puntland statement that “Turkey will no longer be regarded as neutral” captures this reputational damage. The regional administrations further warned that the strike “could damage Türkiye’s role as a mediator in Somalia’s internal political disputes, arguing that Ankara had shown support for one side”. Turkey’s silence on the Doolow strike compounds the problem. As the South West administration demanded, Turkey should “publicly disclose who decided to target General Shub and his residence, as well as the Somali and Turkish officials who allegedly requested, approved or ordered the operation”. Without transparency, Ankara’s protestations of neutrality ring hollow. The reputational consequences extend beyond Somalia. “This recent attack on the general will further smear Turkish image and influence in countries eyeing Turkish military cooperation,” Countries considering Turkish arms deals will observe how Ankara handles accountability when its weapons are used in controversial operations. If Turkey cannot ensure that its military assistance to Somalia remains focused on counterterrorism rather than internal political vendettas, why should other nations trust that their own Turkish-supplied weapons will not be similarly misused? Against this backdrop of the recent political turbulence in Somalia’s Southwest State, Turkey’s unequivocal and increasingly uncritical backing of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud is steadily eroding the widespread popular goodwill that once defined the Somali-Turkish partnership. This trajectory bears a striking resemblance to the French neocolonial playbook in Francophone Africa, where the metropole’s imprimatur historically served as the sole prerequisite for executive survival, reducing sovereign governance to a function of external patronage rather than domestic legitimacy. Somalia’s Need for Reconciliation, Not Partisanship The Doolow strike underscores a deeper truth about Somalia’s political crisis. The country’s fragmentation is not primarily military; it is political, rooted in clan dynamics, regional grievances, and disputes over power-sharing. The solution lies not in drone strikes but in dialogue, reconciliation, and inclusive governance. Turkey itself has attempted to play a mediating role. In July 2026, Ankara brokered talks between Somalia’s federal government and opposition representatives in Mogadishu. Yet Puntland and Jubaland declined to participate, “questioning Ankara’s neutrality”. This highlights the limits of Turkish mediation when Ankara is simultaneously perceived as the federal government’s military backer. What Somalia needs is not a patron that takes sides but a friend committed to reconciliation between its warring tribes and factions. The South West administration articulated this principle clearly: “Somalia’s political disputes should be resolved through dialogue and political processes rather than through the use of foreign military power”. The international community, including Turkey, must take this principle seriously. Military assistance should be contingent on demonstrable commitment to inclusive dialogue, respect for federalism, and accountability for the use of foreign-supplied weapons. Conclusion The Doolow drone strike on General Shub is a watershed moment for Somalia, Turkey, and the international community. For the international community, it raises urgent questions about whether weapons transfers to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s regime can be trusted. When the legitimacy of the federal government itself is contested and when military assistance appears to be used against political opponents, continued arms transfers risk fueling rather than resolving conflict. For Turkey, the incident should serve as a stark lesson. Supplying weapons without demanding accountability risks transforming Ankara from a neutral partner into a partisan actor. Turkey’s silence on the Doolow strike undermines its credibility as a mediator and damages its reputation as a responsible arms supplier. If Ankara wishes to preserve its influence in Somalia and beyond, it must insist on transparency, accountability, and the exclusive use of its military assistance for legitimate counterterrorism operations. Most fundamentally, the Doolow strike reveals that Somalia does not need a foreign power that takes sides in its internal disputes. It needs friends committed to reconciliation, friend who will invest in dialogue between warring tribes and factions, not in drone strikes against political opponents. The path to Somali stability lies not through the militarization of political disputes but through inclusive governance, respect for federalism, and a genuine commitment to peace. The international community and Turkey alike would do well to remember this lesson. items.title: Tacsi: allaha u naxariisto Cismaan Yusuf Xassan (Cismaan Bullo)
items.description: Inaa Lilaahi Wa inaa ileyhi raajicuuna waxaa shalay magaalada Mogadishu ku geeriyooday Allaha u naxariisto Cismaan Yusuf Xassan (Cismaan Bullo) Alfanaan Maxamed Maclow Nuur oo ku hadlaayo magaca fanaaniinta soomaaliyeed iyo anigoo ah madaxa warbaahin somaliweyn dittore Hussein Abdi Alasow waxaan tacsi tiiraanyo leh u direynaa eheladii iyo qaraabadii uu geeriyooday Cismaan Yusuf Xassan. Marxuun Cismaan Yusuf Xassan oo ka mid ahaa dadkii lagu aasaasay kooxdii Somali falkalor danse ee hobaladii waabari markii safar la galaayo dadkii lagu xisaabtamaayey ayuu ka mid ahaa sida asaga, sheekh Abuukar, Kaltuun sheekh Ibraahim, Khadiijo Qalanjo, Cabduqaadir Cismaan Calasow, Feynuus Sheekh Daahir, Shamso Bashiir, Aweys Khamiis, Cali Ganey iyo macalinkooda Axmadey Cabdi Gaashaan. Marxuunka waxaa uu deganaa wadanka Imaaraadka oo uu ka tirsanaa kooxdii Shamsul Amal oo ay aasaaseen Alfanaan Axmed Naaji Iyo Faadumo Qaasin iyo gudoomiyahoodii Maxamed Maclow Nuur, kadibna wuxuu u guura Dalka Mareykanka oo uu ku guursaday halkaadi. Marxuunka Allahu u naxariisto, waxaa warbixintaas noo soo gudbiyey markii aan Khadka telefanka aan kuls yeelanay Alfanaan Maxamed Maclow Nuur. Bahda Fanaaniinta oo dhan iyo bahda somaliweyn (sida Hussein Abdi Alasow) waxay tacsi tiiraanyo u diraayaa Marxuunka Cismaan Xassan Yusuf u diraayaan iyo qaraabadii ii ka baxay, waxaana shalay lagu aasay Mogadishu markii oo uu mudo yar xanuunsanaay. Allaha u naxariisto Aamiin

items.title: Somaliland ready to send up to 2,000 troops to Gaza if asked, president Irro says
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somaliland is prepared to contribute up to 2,000 soldiers to an international stabilization force planned for Gaza, but it is waiting for the United States or Israel to make a formal request, President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi has said. Speaking in an interview on the sidelines of the MEAD conference, President Abdullahi said Somaliland was not volunteering troops for the force, but would be ready to respond if asked. “If they ask, we can provide,” he said. “If they ask me, I am ready.” The comments, reported by The Jerusalem Post , come as countries consider contributing personnel to a US-led force that is ultimately intended to deploy about 20,000 soldiers in Gaza. Uganda has approved a contingent of about 1,200 troops, while Morocco has committed up to 500. Albania, Kazakhstan and Kosovo have also pledged personnel. The force is expected to have responsibilities including maintaining security, training Palestinian police, facilitating humanitarian aid and preventing Hamas from re-establishing its military control. Somaliland says it can provide troops President Abdullahi said Somaliland has an army of approximately 25,000 soldiers and a coast guard of about 1,500 personnel. The territory has not previously contributed troops to an African Union force. His offer to provide up to 2,000 personnel would therefore represent a significant international military deployment by Somaliland if the United States or Israel were to formally request its participation. Israel’s recognition puts Somaliland in the spotlight In December, Israel became the first country to formally recognise Somaliland as an independent state, ending the territory’s 35-year struggle without international recognition. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991, but Mogadishu continues to regard it as part of Somalia. In June, Somaliland opened an embassy in Jerusalem during President Abdullahi’s first official visit to Israel. It was the territory’s first formally designated embassy in the world, although Somaliland also opened an embassy-like representative office in Taiwan in 2020. President Abdullahi said Israel’s recognition had already significantly increased international attention on Somaliland, even though no other country had yet followed Israel’s lead. “There has been much more attention paid to Somaliland following Israel’s recognition,” he said. “Now you can find the word ‘Somaliland’ in every language in the world – in Indian, Arabic and Chinese.” He said Somaliland had spent 35 years asking the world to “see us” and that international attention was now increasing. President Irro expects greater US engagement President Abdullahi is expected to meet members of the US Congress next week, including Senator Ted Cruz, one of Somaliland’s most vocal supporters in Washington. Senator Cruz has called on the United States to recognise Somaliland, arguing that it could serve as an important American security and diplomatic partner in the strategically significant Horn of Africa. President Abdullahi said he could not point to any American promise to recognise Somaliland, but said his government had discussed both recognition and security cooperation with US officials. “We are optimistic,” he said. Israel’s recognition increases tensions with Somalia and Turkey Israel’s recognition of Somaliland has also increased tensions with Somalia and Turkey, one of Mogadishu’s closest military, economic and diplomatic partners. Turkey has strongly opposed Israel’s move, arguing that Somaliland remains part of Somalia and that recognising its independence violates Somalia’s sovereignty and territorial integrity. Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan described the recognition as illegitimate and unacceptable and accused Israel of attempting to destabilise the Horn of Africa. Ankara operates a military base in Mogadishu. It also trains Somali troops, has supplied Somalia with armed drones and is exploring for oil and gas off the Somali coast. Following Israel’s recognition, Turkey also deployed F-16 fighter jets to Somalia, further expanding its military presence there. President Abdullahi said Turkey’s actions demonstrated that Israel’s recognition had produced concrete security consequences for Somaliland. “There is no free lunch,” he said. “Everything has some negative and some positive.” “We created new enemies,” he added, saying countries that had not previously provided Somalia with sophisticated weaponry were now doing so. Somaliland says it needs greater military capabilities Asked whether Somaliland faced a threat of invasion, President Abdullahi said Somalia’s president and defence minister had publicly spoken about invading the territory. He said Somaliland had enough manpower to defend itself but needed more advanced weapons and technology. “We need protection,” he said, adding that Somaliland was seeking assistance from Israel, the United States and other allies to “balance the situation”. President Abdullahi said there was currently no Israeli or American security presence in Somaliland. He did not rule out such a presence in the future, saying it could create both balance and deterrence. Asked directly whether he would like an Israeli security presence in Somaliland, he said he expected a foreign presence “maybe in the near future”. President denies talks on Israeli operations against Houthis President Abdullahi denied that Israel and Somaliland had discussed using Somaliland’s territory or airspace for operations against the Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen. Somaliland and Yemen face each other across the Gulf of Aden and have been neighbours for thousands of years, he said. “As a country, Somaliland, we don’t have any conflict with the Houthis at the moment,” he said. “We haven’t discussed possible Israeli operations against them.” He also denied reports that Somaliland had discussed accepting Palestinians from Gaza as part of its agreement with Israel. “We haven’t discussed it with Israel, we haven’t discussed it with the Americans, we haven’t discussed it with anyone,” he said. Security, trade and investment form part of Israel agreement President Abdullahi said the recognition declaration signed with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu last year provides for cooperation in security, trade, investment and economic development. Water technology will be Somaliland’s top priority because the territory is semi-arid, he said. During his visit to Tel Aviv, President Abdullahi said he met representatives of more than 100 Israeli companies, including firms interested in Somaliland’s potential oil and gas reserves. No concrete Israeli investments have yet been made, he said, but added: “We expect” them. The comments were reported by The Jerusalem Post following President Abdullahi’s interview on the sidelines of the MEAD conference. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991, but Mogadishu continues to regard it as part of Somalia. In June, Somaliland opened an embassy in Jerusalem during President Abdullahi’s first official visit to Israel. It was the territory’s first formally designated embassy in the world, although Somaliland also opened an embassy-like representative office in Taiwan in 2020. President Abdullahi said Israel’s recognition had already significantly increased international attention on Somaliland, even though no other country had yet followed Israel’s lead. “There has been much more attention paid to Somaliland following Israel’s recognition,” he said. “Now you can find the word ‘Somaliland’ in every language in the world – in Indian, Arabic and Chinese.” He said Somaliland had spent 35 years asking the world to “see us” and that international attention was now increasing. President Irro expects greater US engagement President Abdullahi is expected to meet members of the US Congress next week, including Senator Ted Cruz, one of Somaliland’s most vocal supporters in Washington. Senator Cruz has called on the United States to recognise Somaliland, arguing that it could serve as an important American security and diplomatic partner in the strategically significant Horn of Africa. President Abdullahi said he could not point to any American promise to recognise Somaliland, but said his government had discussed both recognition and security cooperation with US officials. “We are optimistic,” he said. Israel’s recognition increases tensions with Somalia and Turkey Israel’s recognition of Somaliland has also increased tensions with Somalia and Turkey, one of Mogadishu’s closest military, economic and diplomatic partners. Turkey has strongly opposed Israel’s move, arguing that Somaliland remains part of Somalia and that recognising its independence violates Somalia’s sovereignty and territorial integrity. Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan described the recognition as illegitimate and unacceptable and accused Israel of attempting to destabilise the Horn of Africa. Ankara operates a military base in Mogadishu. It also trains Somali troops, has supplied Somalia with armed drones and is exploring for oil and gas off the Somali coast. Following Israel’s recognition, Turkey also deployed F-16 fighter jets to Somalia, further expanding its military presence there. President Abdullahi said Turkey’s actions demonstrated that Israel’s recognition had produced concrete security consequences for Somaliland. “There is no free lunch,” he said. “Everything has some negative and some positive.” “We created new enemies,” he added, saying countries that had not previously provided Somalia with sophisticated weaponry were now doing so. Somaliland says it needs greater military capabilities Asked whether Somaliland faced a threat of invasion, President Abdullahi said Somalia’s president and defence minister had publicly spoken about invading the territory. He said Somaliland had enough manpower to defend itself but needed more advanced weapons and technology. “We need protection,” he said, adding that Somaliland was seeking assistance from Israel, the United States and other allies to “balance the situation”. President Abdullahi said there was currently no Israeli or American security presence in Somaliland. He did not rule out such a presence in the future, saying it could create both balance and deterrence. Asked directly whether he would like an Israeli security presence in Somaliland, he said he expected a foreign presence “maybe in the near future”. President denies talks on Israeli operations against Houthis President Abdullahi denied that Israel and Somaliland had discussed using Somaliland’s territory or airspace for operations against the Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen. Somaliland and Yemen face each other across the Gulf of Aden and have been neighbours for thousands of years, he said. “As a country, Somaliland, we don’t have any conflict with the Houthis at the moment,” he said. “We haven’t discussed possible Israeli operations against them.” He also denied reports that Somaliland had discussed accepting Palestinians from Gaza as part of its agreement with Israel. “We haven’t discussed it with Israel, we haven’t discussed it with the Americans, we haven’t discussed it with anyone,” he said. Security, trade and investment form part of Israel agreement President Abdullahi said the recognition declaration signed with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu last year provides for cooperation in security, trade, investment and economic development. Water technology will be Somaliland’s top priority because the territory is semi-arid, he said. During his visit to Tel Aviv, President Abdullahi said he met representatives of more than 100 Israeli companies, including firms interested in Somaliland’s potential oil and gas reserves. No concrete Israeli investments have yet been made, he said, but added: “We expect” them. The comments were reported by The Jerusalem Post following President Abdullahi’s interview on the sidelines of the MEAD conference. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Dagaalka Bariga Dhexe oo waji cusub galay iyo Pakistan oo weerar ku qaadeysa….
items.description: Islamabad (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Pakistan ayaa ka fiirsaneysa inay duqeymo cirka ah ka fuliso goobo ay Xuutiyiintu ku sugan yihiin ee Yemen, haddii Sacuudi Carabiya si rasmi ah uga codsato taageero militari, sida ay Arbacadii sheegeen warbaahinno kala duwan. Arrintan ayaa tijaabadii ugu horreysay ee dhab ah gelin karta heshiiska cusub ee difaaca wadajirka ah ee ay dhowaan kala saxiixdeen Pakistan, Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Turkiga. Warbaahinta Türkiye Today , oo soo xiganeysa ilo Pakistani ah oo magacyadooda qariyey, ayaa sheegtay in Islamabad ay diyaar u noqon karto inay ka qeyb qaadato duqeymo ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta haddii Riyadh si rasmi ah u dalbato gargaar militari. Mid ka mid ah ilahaas ayaa sheegay in magaalada Saada, oo ah saldhigga ugu weyn ee Xuutiyiinta waqooyiga Yemen, ay ka mid noqon karto meelaha la beegsanayo, inkastoo Pakistan aysan weli gaarin go’aan kama dambeys ah. Wakaaladda wararka Spain ee EFE ayaa sidoo kale soo xigatay sarkaal sare oo amniga Pakistan ka tirsan, kaas oo sheegay in Islamabad ay ka baaraan-degeyso suurta-galnimada duqeymo laga fuliyo gudaha Yemen iyadoo diyaaradaha ay ka howlgeli karaan Sacuudi Carabiya. Hase yeeshee, warar kale oo ka soo baxaya Islamabad ayaa muujinaya in dowladda Pakistan ay weli ka taxaddareyso inay si toos ah ugu lug yeelato dagaalka Yemen. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in saraakiil Pakistani ah ay ku adkeysanayaan in kaalinta Islamabad ay ku ekaan karto difaaca dhulka Sacuudiga, iyadoo aan ciidamadeedu weerarro gudaha Yemen ka fulin. Mid ka mid ah ilaha ay wakaaladdu soo xigatay ayaa sheegay in Pakistan aysan weli go’aan ka gaarin inay ku biirto duqeymaha aargoosiga ah ee ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta. Xiisadda Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta Doodda ku saabsan doorka Pakistan ayaa soo xoogeysatay xilli dagaalka u dhexeeya Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen uu mar kale gaaray heerkii ugu xumaa muddo sannado ah. Xuutiyiinta ayaa Arbacadii gantaallo ballistic ah iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weeraray magaalooyinka Abha, Khamis Mushait iyo Jazan, sida uu sheegay isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo. Maalin ka hor, weerarro kale ayaa lagu qaaday xarumo tamareed oo Sacuudiga ku yaalla iyo saldhigga ciidamada cirka ee King Khalid ee Khamis Mushait, waxaana ku dhaawacmay 73 qof. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegaya in weerarradoodu jawaab u yihiin duqeymaha Sacuudiga ee gudaha Yemen. Afhayeenka militariga Xuutiyiinta, Yahya Saree, ayaa sheegay in diyaaradaha Sacuudiga ay 54 duqeyn ka fuliyeen dhowr gobol oo Yemen ah muddo 12 saacadood gudahood ah. Warbaahinta Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in ugu yaraan 32 qof lagu dilay duqeymo ka dhacay gobolka Al Jawf, inkastoo Sacuudi Carabiya aysan xaqiijin tiradaas. Heshiis cusub oo imtixaan wajahaya Xiisadda cusub ayaa indhaha ku soo jeedisay heshiiska difaaca wadajirka ah ee Makkah, oo Sacuudi Carabiya, Pakistan iyo Turkiga ay saxiixeen 7-dii August. Heshiiska ayaa dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo arko weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Hase yeeshee, qodobbada heshiiska ee la shaaciyey si cad uma qeexayaan nooca jawaabta militari ee dal kasta laga filayo. Wasiirka Difaaca Pakistan Khawaja Asif ayaa toddobaadkan sheegay in haddii weerarrada Xuutiyiintu si toos ah u saameeyaan Sacuudi Carabiya, ay taasi keeni karto in heshiiska la dhaqan-geliyo. “Waxaan ku xiran nahay shuruudaha heshiiskan, haddii baahi timaaddana, Ilaahay idankiis waan fulin doonnaa,” ayuu yiri Asif. Si kastaba, wuxuu ku adkeystay in heshiiska uu yahay mid difaac ah, isla markaana uusan ogeyn in Sacuudi Carabiya ay Islamabad si rasmi ah uga codsatay inay qaaddo tallaabo militari. Pakistan ayaa durba ciidan iyo qalab militari ku leh Sacuudi Carabiya. Warbixin ay Reuters daabacday bishii May ayaa sheegtay in Islamabad ay dalkaas geysay ku dhowaad 8,000 oo askari, diyaaradaha dagaalka JF-17, diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn iyo nidaamka difaaca cirka HQ-9. Joogitaankaas wuxuu Pakistan u saamaxayaa inay ka qeyb qaadato difaaca Sacuudiga iyadoo aan si toos ah dagaal uga gelin Yemen. Hase yeeshee, haddii diyaaradaha Pakistan ay duqeeyaan goobo Xuutiyiintu ku leeyihiin Yemen, waxay noqon doontaa tallaabo aad uga weyn doorkii Islamabad ay ilaa hadda qaadaneysay. Xusuusta go’aankii 2015 Pakistan ayaa xaalad la mid ah tan wajahday sanadkii 2015, markii Sacuudi Carabiya uu bilaabay howlgalka militari ee ka dhanka ahaa Xuutiyiinta. Baarlamaanka Pakistan ayaa xilligaas diiday in dalka si toos ah loogu daro dagaalka Yemen, wuxuuna ku baaqay in Islamabad ay dhex-dhexaad ahaato. Si kastaba, baarlamaanku wuxuu caddeeyey in Pakistan ay garab istaagi doonto Sacuudi Carabiya haddii la weeraro dhulkeeda ama madaxbannaanideeda. Kala duwanaanshahaas ayaa mar kale xudunta u ah doodda hadda taagan: Pakistan ma ku ekaan doontaa difaaca Sacuudiga, mise waxay tallaabo militari ka qaadi doontaa gudaha Yemen? Go’aan kasta oo Islamabad ay ka gaarto arrintan wuxuu sidoo kale saameyn ku yeelan karaa xiriirka ay la leedahay Iran, oo deris la ah Pakistan isla markaana xiriir dhow la leh Xuutiyiinta. Pakistan ayaa isku dayeysa inay sii hayso xiriirka dhow ee ay la leedahay Riyadh, iyadoo isla mar ahaantaana aan dhaawaceyn xiriirkeeda Tehran. Sidaas darteed, weerarrada cusub ee Xuutiyiinta ayaa heshiiska cusub ee Pakistan, Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Turkiga ka dhigay mid wajahaya imtixaankiisii ugu horreeyey: in ballanqaadka difaaca wadajirka ahi ku ekaan doono ilaalinta Sacuudiga iyo in kale, ama uu isu beddeli doono howlgal militari oo gudaha Yemen ah. items.title: Dagaalka Yemen oo sii xoogeysanaya iyo Xuutiyiinta oo uu weerarro ku qaadey Sacuudigu
items.description: Dagaallada ka socda dalka Yemen ayaa sii xoogeysanaya, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda Yemen iyo Xuutiyiinta ay iska horimaadyo culus ku dhexmarayaan dhowr gobol, halka colaadda ay sidoo kale ku fidayso xuduudaha Sacuudiga. Dowladda Yemen ayaa Xuutiyiinta ku eedeysay in duqeyn madaafiic ah oo ka dhacday gobolka Marib lagu dilay ugu yaraan saddex carruur ah, oo uu ku jiray ilmo yar , halka lix qof oo kale ay ku dhaawacmeen. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay in weerarkan uu ahaa kii labaad ee noociisa ah muddo 48 saacadood gudahood ah. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Sacuudigu ay muddo 12 saacadood ah gudaha Yemen ka fuliyeen 54 duqeyn oo cirka ah , kuwaas oo lagu bartilmaameedsaday gobollada Al-Jawf, Marib, Taiz, Xudeyda, Saada iyo Al-Bayda. Afhayeenka milatariga Xuutiyiinta, Yahya Saree, ayaa sheegay in weerarradaasi aysan jawaab la’aan noqon doonin. Xuutiyiintu waxay sidoo kale Sacuudiga ku eedeeyeen duqeyn lagu qaaday xabsi ku yaalla gobolka Al-Jawf, halkaas oo ay sheegeen in tirada dadka ku dhintay ay gaartay ugu yaraan 32 qof , toddobo kalena ay dhaawacmeen. Eedeymahan si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Sacuudiga ayaa isna sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay sii wadaan weerarrada lagu beegsanayo kaabayaasha iyo goobaha muhiimka ah ee dalka. Afhayeenka isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo, Major General Turki al-Maliki, ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiintu gantaallo ballistic ah iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku bartilmaameedsadeen Khamis Mushait, Abha iyo Jazan . Maamulka difaaca madaniga ah ee Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale soo saaray digniino amni, inkastoo aan wax dhimasho ah laga soo sheegin digniinahaas. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sanadkii 2014 la wareegay caasimadda Sanca, taasoo keentay in Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo faragelin militari sanadkii 2015. Xabbad-joojin ay Qaramada Midoobay dhexdhexaadisay ayaa 2022 hoos u dhigtay dagaalladii waaweynaa, balse iska horimaadyada ayaa dib u xoogeysanayay tan iyo bishii Luulyo. Dagaallada cusub ayaa sidoo kale muhiimad gaar ah leh, maadaama Xuutiyiintu ay isku dayayaan inay saameyntooda ku ballaariyaan deegaanno ku dhow Bab al-Mandab , oo ah marin-biyood istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo maraakiibta shidaalka ee gobolka. Xaaladda ayaa sidoo kale walaac ka abuurtay gobolka. Pakistan ayaa digniin ka bixisay in haddii weerarrada Xuutiyiintu ay sii socdaan ama colaadda Yemen ay si toos ah ugu faafto gudaha Sacuudiga, ay suuragal tahay in la dhaqan geliyo Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Maka , oo ay dhawaan kala saxiixdeen Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Dhanka kale, Iran ayaa diidday eedeymaha loo jeediyay ee ku saabsan inay faragelin ku hayso arrimaha gudaha Yemen. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran ayaa sheegtay inay diidan tahay sheegashadaas, iyadoo ku adkeysatay in Tehran ay taageerto midnimada Yemen iyo wadahadal ay hoggaaminayaan dadka Yemen. Sida ay sheegtay Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO), dagaallada iyo rabshadaha ka socda Yemen ayaa sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac gaadhaya in ka badan 1,000 qof , halka tobanaan kun oo qof ay ku barakaceen colaadda sii xoogeysanaysa. xaaladda ayaa hadda sii xumaanaysa marka la eego amniga Yemen, sidoo kale Sacuudiga iyo guud ahaan marin-biyoodka Badda Cas ayaa qalqal wajahaya.

Pakistan ayaa digniin ka bixisay in haddii weerarrada Xuutiyiintu ay sii socdaan ama colaadda Yemen ay si toos ah ugu faafto gudaha Sacuudiga, ay suuragal tahay in la dhaqan geliyo Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Maka , oo ay dhawaan kala saxiixdeen Sacuudiga, Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Dhanka kale, Iran ayaa diidday eedeymaha loo jeediyay ee ku saabsan inay faragelin ku hayso arrimaha gudaha Yemen. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran ayaa sheegtay inay diidan tahay sheegashadaas, iyadoo ku adkeysatay in Tehran ay taageerto midnimada Yemen iyo wadahadal ay hoggaaminayaan dadka Yemen. Sida ay sheegtay Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO), dagaallada iyo rabshadaha ka socda Yemen ayaa sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac gaadhaya in ka badan 1,000 qof , halka tobanaan kun oo qof ay ku barakaceen colaadda sii xoogeysanaysa. xaaladda ayaa hadda sii xumaanaysa marka la eego amniga Yemen, sidoo kale Sacuudiga iyo guud ahaan marin-biyoodka Badda Cas ayaa qalqal wajahaya.

items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo shaaciyay goobaha codbixinta ee Galmudug
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha, ayaa shaaciyay xarumaha iyo goobaha codbixinta ee doorashada ku-celiska ah ee Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in tallaabadan ay qeyb ka tahay fulinta jadwalkii doorashada ku-celiska ahaa ee uu soo saaray 31-kii Agoosto 2026. Doorashada ku-celiska ah ee Galmudug ayaa la qorsheeyay in la qabto 30-ka Sebtember 2026, iyadoo Guddigu uu sheegay inuu sii wado dhammeystirka howlaha farsamo iyo diyaar-garowga doorashada. Doorashadan ayaa daba socota go’aan ka soo baxay Maxkamadda Sare ee Soomaaliya oo lagu laalay natiijadii doorashadii Golaha Wakiillada iyo Goleyaasha Deegaanka Galmudug ee horey u dhacday, iyadoo Guddiga Doorashooyinkana lagu amray in dib loo qabto doorashada. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in doorashada cusub lagu qaban doono iyadoo la raacayo Dastuurka, shuruucda iyo habraacyada doorashooyinka dalka. Sidoo kale, waxaa la filayaa in ururrada siyaasadda iyo dhinacyada kale ee doorashada ay gutaan waajibaadkooda ku aaddan diyaar-garowga codbixinta, oo ay kamid yihiin soo gudbinta liisaska musharraxiinta iyo wakiillada goobaha codbixinta. The post Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo shaaciyay goobaha codbixinta ee Galmudug appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Duqeyn dhalisay khasaaro oo laga fuliyay deegaan ku yaalla duleedka Baydhabo
items.description: Baydhabo ( Raxanreeb Online) Wararka inaga soo gaaraya magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay, ayaa sheegay in xalay diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ay duqeyn ka fuliyeen deegaanka Hartiqaanle oo ku yaalla duleedka magaalada Baydhaba ee gobolka Baay. Dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in duqeynta lagu beegsaday bakhaar lagu keediyo raashiinka ay isticmalaan Beeraleyd deegaanka. Sawirrada la helay goobta ayaa muujinaya burbur soo gaaray goobta la sheegay in la duqeeyay. Ilaa hadda lama xaqiijin khasaaraha nafeed ee ka dhashay duqeynta, sidoo kalena ma cadda cidda si rasmi ah uga dambeysay weerarka. Duqeyntan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli maalmihii lasoo dhaafay diyaarado dagaal ay howlgallo duqeyn ah ka wadeen deegaano ku dhow Baydhaba, kuwaas oo lagu sheegay in lagu bartilmaameedsanayo ciidamo ka tirsan maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ee uu hoggaamiyo Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Lafta-gareen. Sido kale Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan cidda fulisay duqeynta, mana jirto hadal kasoo baxay madaxda maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. The post Duqeyn dhalisay khasaaro oo laga fuliyay deegaan ku yaalla duleedka Baydhabo appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Mareykanka oo nin Soomaali ah geeyey xabsiga Guantánamo
items.description: Minneapolis (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa nin Soomaali ah oo magangelyo doon ah u wareejisay xabsiga Guantánamo Bay ee Cuba, kadib markii ay hay’adda socdaalka ICE ku xirtay gobolka Minnesota, iyadoo ninkaasi aanu lahayn wax dambi ah oo hore loogu helay. Adam Abdullah, oo 31 jir ah, ayaa muddo ku dhow laba toddobaad lagu hayaa Camp 6 oo ka tirsan xarunta Guantánamo Bay, sida uu ku sheegay wareysi kooban oo uu siiyay idaacadda Minnesota Public Radio (MPR). Adam ayaa Mareykanka tagay sanadkii 2023 isagoo magangelyo doon ah. Waxa uu helay oggolaansho shaqo iyo lambarka Social Security-ga, waxaana uu ka shaqeynayay farsamada baabuurta ee gobolka Minnesota. Sida ay sheegtay MPR, Adam wuxuu sidoo kale si joogto ah uga qeyb geli jiray ballamaha iyo hubinta ay u qabato hay’adda socdaalka Mareykanka ee ICE. Ciidamada federaalka ayaa gaarigiisa ku joojiyay magaalada St Paul 12-kii December 2025, xilli uu billowday howlgalka socdaalka ee maamulka madaxweyne Donald Trump ugu magac daray “Operation Metro Surge”. Adam wuxuu sheegay inaan waligiis loo sheegin sababta gaar ahaan isaga loo bartilmaameedsaday. “Markii ay ii yimaadeen ayaan weydiiyay sababta ay ii joojiyeen, waxayna igu yiraahdeen, ‘Waxaan nahay socdaalka, ee na sii oggolaanshahaaga shaqada,’” ayuu Adam u sheegay MPR. Wuxuu sheegay inuu markaas weydiiyay haddii ay haystaan amar maxkamadeed iyo sababta ay u joojiyeen. Waxa uu sheegay in saraakiishu ugu jawaabeen: “Uma baahnin amar maxkamadeed; waxaan nahay socdaalka, waanan ognahay inaad tahay Adam Adam.” MPR ayaa sheegtay in baaritaan lagu sameeyay diiwaannada maxkamadaha Minnesota aanu muujin wax dambi ah oo Adam lagu helay, marka laga reebo laba ganaax oo baarkin ah oo la siiyay horraantii 2025 kadib markii uu gaarigiisa ka qaadi waayay waddo xilli baraf laga nadiifinayay. ‘Soomaaliya ayaa laguu celinayaa’ Kadib xarigiisa, Adam waxaa muddo bilo ah loo kala wareejiyay xarumo kala duwan oo lagu hayo dadka ay qabato hay’adda socdaalka. Markii hore waxaa lagu hayay xabsiga Freeborn County Jail ee Albert Lea, Minnesota, kadibna waxaa loo wareejiyay xarun ku taalla Covington, Kentucky, ugu dambeyntiina Louisiana. Adam wuxuu sheegay in saraakiisha socdaalku markii dambe u sheegeen in Soomaaliya loo masaafurinayo, isla markaana laga sii marinayo Miami. “Miami waxay nagu yiraahdeen waxaan aadeynaa Soomaaliya, laakiin marka hore Cuba ayaan shidaal ku qaadaneynaa, kadibna dalal kale ayaan sii mareynaa ilaa Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu sheegay in gacmaha iyo lugaha looga xiray silsilado intii lagu jiray safarka dheer ee diyaaradda. Hase yeeshee, safarkii Soomaaliya ma uusan sii socon. Adam waxaa taa beddelkeeda la geeyay Camp 6 ee Guantánamo Bay, halkaas oo uu sheegay in lagu hayo ilaa hadda. Waxa uu sheegay in fursadaha jimicsiga iyo wicitaannada telefoonku ay kooban yihiin, inkastoo maxaabiistu ay maalintii dhowr saacadood wada qaadan karaan. Adam ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Guantánamo lagu hayo siddeed Soomaali ah, kuwaas oo qaarkood laga soo xiray magaalooyinka mataanaha ah ee Minneapolis iyo St Paul. Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka, DHS, kama aysan jawaabin su’aalaha MPR ee ku saabsan tirada dadka hadda lagu hayo Guantánamo iyo sababta gaarka ah ee Adam loo xiray. Qareenkiisa Marc Prokosch ayaa sheegay in xaaladda Guantánamo ay aad u adkeysay xiriirka uu la leeyahay macmiilkiisa. “Wicitaannadu waxay ku kooban yihiin shan ilaa 10 daqiiqo, xitaa ma naqaan haddii ay yihiin kuwo qarsoodi ah,” ayuu yiri Prokosch. “Taasi waa habka keliya ee aan kula xiriiri karno macaamiisheenna, iyadoo aynaan hubin in wada hadalladaasi ay ilaalinayaan sirta u dhexeysa qareenka iyo macmiilka.” Dood ka dhalatay Guantánamo Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa bishii January 2025 amar ku bixiyay in la ballaariyo awoodda Guantánamo Bay ee lagu hayo dadka ay dowladda Mareykanku qorsheyneyso inay masaafuriso. Maamulka Trump ayaa sheegay in xarunta lagu haynayo dadka uu ku tilmaamay “dambiilayaasha sharci darrada ku jooga Mareykanka ee mudnaanta sare leh”. Hase yeeshee, adeegsiga Camp 6 ayaa dhaliyay dhaleeceyn xooggan, maadaama xaruntan muddo ka badan labaatan sano lala xiriirinayay maxaabiistii loo haystay dambiyada argagixisada kadib weerarradii 11-kii September. Yumna Rizvi oo ka tirsan Center for Victims of Torture ayaa sheegtay in adeegsiga Guantánamo uu abuuri karo aragti isku sidkaysa arrimaha socdaalka iyo argagixisada. “Maamulkani wuxuu doonayaa inuu isu ekaysiiyo khatarta socdaalka iyo argagixisada, si loo abuuro fikrad ah in dadka Camp 6 lagu hayo ay yihiin dad aad u xun oo halis ah,” ayay u sheegtay MPR. Human Rights Watch ayaa sanadkii 2025 sidoo kale walaac ka muujisay xaaladaha ay la kulmeen 20 muhaajiriin Venezuelan ah oo lagu hayay Guantánamo ka hor inta aan la masaafurin. Dadkaasi waxay ururka u sheegeen inay la kulmeen xaalado nadaafadeed oo liita, xog yari ku saabsan xaaladdooda sharci iyo inay qolalkooda ku xirnaayeen ilaa 23 saacadood maalintii. Adam laftiisu ma uusan sheegin dhammaan xaaladaha ay ka warbixiyeen dadka Venezuelanka ah, wuxuuna sheegay inuu awoodo inuu maalin kasta dhowr saacadood la kulmo maxaabiista kale. Dhanka kale, ururrada xuquuqda madaniga ah ayaa maxkamadaha Mareykanka ka wada dacwado ka dhan ah dowladda, iyagoo ku doodaya inaan sharciga socdaalku u oggolaan dowladda inay dadka laga soo qabto gudaha Mareykanka u wareejiso saldhigga milatari ee Guantánamo si halkaas loogu sii hayo. Hay’adda ACLU iyo ururro kale ayaa bishii June 2025 gudbiyay dacwad ay ku dalbanayaan in la joojiyo arrintaasi. MPR ayaa sheegtay in garsoore federaal ah oo ku sugan Washington uu oggolaaday in dacwaddaasi sii socoto, iyadoo dhageysi kale loo qorsheeyay 14-ka October. DHS ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay in diyaarad dhowaan dad geysay Guantánamo ay saarnaayeen qaar ka mid ah dadka ay ugu yeertay “kuwa ugu xun” ee ajaanibta dambiyada galay, balse ma aysan sheegin in tilmaantaasi ay khuseyso Adam Adam. The post Mareykanka oo nin Soomaali ah geeyey xabsiga Guantánamo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Caro xooggan oo ka dhalatay askarigii aanada qabiil loogu dilay Ceelbaraf
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Falcelin xooggan iyo caro ayaa ka dhalatay dil arxan darro ahaa oo maalmo kahor deegaanka Ceelbaraf loogu gaystay Allaha u naxariistee Axmed Shire Xuseen oo ahaa askari ka tirsan Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, kaas oo loo dilay aano qabiil darteed. Axmed Xuseen oo fasax kasoo qaatay furimaha hore, kuna sii jeeday gurigiisa ayaa waxaa jidka u galay maleeshiyaad hubeysan, kuwaas oo ka dejiyay mooto uu la socday, iyaga oo markaas muuqaal ka duubay, kadibna dilay. Maydka marxuumka ayaa markii dambe la geeyay degmada Buulo-Burde ee gobolka Hiiraan iyadoo ehelladiisu ay sheegeen in jirkiisa uu go’go’ay, kadib markii ay jir-dil xoogan u gaysteen maleeshiyaadka dilka u gaystay. “Si arxan daro ah ayaa loo dilay, indhaha ayaa laga riday qaab loo duugo ayaa la garan waayey, dowlada waa in ay ka bixisaa jawaab la taaban karo,” ayuu yiri Nabadoon Xuseen Jurus oo kamid ah odayaasha dhaqanka Gobolka Hiiraan Haddaba sidee looga fal-celiyay dilka arxan darrada ah ee loo gaystay Axmed Shire? Siyaasiga Cabdiraxman Cabdishakuur Warsame oo kamid ah dadka ka falceliyay dilka arxan darrada ah ee loo gaystay askariga ayaa yiri “Isagoo xanuunsan, gaajaysan, aan isdifaaci karin, geeriduna hortaallo ayuu si naxariis leh u baryey kuwii dilayay. Wuxuu magansaday Islaanimo, dadnimo, Soomaalinimo iyo ehelnimo, laakiin midna qalbigooda ma jilcin, ma damqin, baryadiisii ayay duubeen, dabadeedna dileen. Allaha u naxariisto Axmed Shire. Baryadiisii ugu dambaysay yaanay noqon oo keliya wax aan maanta ka murugoonno ee ha noqoto muraayad aynu isku eegno oo aynu isweydiinno: maxaa damiirkeennii ku dhacay”. Fannaanka Dayax Dalnuurshe ayaa isna yiri: “Ninkaa dhalinyarada ah dadka dilay sharciga hala horkeeno ayaga oo aan xitaa maro wajiga looga xerina hala toogto oo hala tuso macaanka eey gardaradu leedah. Aano qabiil waa aafo!”. Maxamed Cabdirashiid: “Runtii waa dhacdo fool xun oo caddayn u ah sida dhaqankii iyo diintii looga sii guurayo. Taariikhda Soomaalida kuma jirto wiil abtigiis dilayo oo waliba muuqaal ka duubayo isagoo leh Abti ha idilin oo aano qabiil oo aan qayb ka ahayn ha ii dilin”. Maryan Maxamed: “Allaha u naxariisto walalkeen dad qalato baa heshay waa in si deg-deg ah loo soo qabtaa tiirkana loo soo taagaa wuxuushtii sida arxanka daran u dishay wiilkan Soomaaliyeed”. Axmed Saadaq Cabdi: “‎Waa murugo iyo naxdin kale oo soo noqotay, iyadoo askari Soomaaliyeed oo dalkiisa iyo dadkiisa u adeegayay uu mar kale naftiisa ku waayay aano qabiil. Marxuumku wuxuu fasax kasoo qaatay taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, isagoo u socday qoyskiisa, balse nasiibkiisu wuxuu ku dhammaaday jidka”. The post Caro xooggan oo ka dhalatay askarigii aanada qabiil loogu dilay Ceelbaraf appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland oo sheegtay inay Gaza u diri karto ilaa 2,000 askari
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi “Cirro”, ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliland ay diyaar u tahay inay ka qeyb qaadato dadaallada lagu sugayo nabadgelyada Gaza, haddii la siinayo fursad ay kaga qeyb qaadato howlaha amni iyo nabad-ilaalin ee halkaasi laga fulinayo. Madaxweyne Cirro oo hadalkan ka sheegay xilli uu booqasho ku joogo dalka Mareykanka ayaa tilmaamay in Somaliland ay diyaar u tahay inay bixiso taageero amni, haddii ay dhinacyada ay khuseyso ka dalbadaan. Booqashada Cirro ee Washington ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa xoojinta xiriirka Somaliland iyo Mareykanka, iskaashiga amniga iyo arrimaha diblomaasiyadda. Hadalka madaxweynaha ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay socdaan dadaallo caalami ah oo lagu raadinayo hannaan lagu xaqiijin karo amniga iyo xasilloonida Gaza, iyadoo fikrado kala duwan laga soo jeedinayo in la sameeyo ciidan ama howgal caalami ah oo ka qeyb qaata ilaalinta amniga iyo fududeynta gargaarka. Soomaaliland ayaa sidoo kale muddooyinkii u dambeeyay xoogga saareysay inay isu soo bandhigto dhinac door ka qaadan kara amniga gobolka Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa horey u sheegay inay diyaar u yihiin iskaashi amni oo ay la yeeshaan quwadaha caalamka, oo ay ku jiraan Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil. Booqashada uu Madaxweyne Cirro ku joogo Mareykanka ayaa ah tii ugu horreysay ee uu dalkaas ku tago tan iyo markii uu xilka qabtay, waxaana ajandaha safarkiisa kamid ah sidii loo xoojin lahaa xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed, iskaashiga amniga iyo taageerada caalamiga ah ee Somaliland. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa dhanka kale si adag uga soo horjeedda dhaqdhaqaaqa Soomaaliland ee aqoonsan raadiska ama loogu sameynayo heshiisyo caalami ah oo ka baxsan awoodda dowladda federaalka.

items.title: Somaliland oo ka hadashay xariga Xasan Galleydh
items.description: Hargeysa ( Raxanreeb Online) Booliska jamhuuriyadda gooni isu taageeda ku dhawaaqday ee Somaliland ayaa ka hadlay xarigga wariye Xasan Galleydh oo shalay la xiray. Waxay sheegeen in Galeydh loo haysto eedo ku saabsan faa-faainta warar been abuur ah. War kooban oo ka soo baxay booliska ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in wariyuhu uu caddeyn u waayay wararka uu baahiyay oo boolisku been abuur ku tilmaameen. Intaa waxey ku dareen laamaha ammaanku in ay maxkamad hor-geyn doonaan isla markaana arrimahaas wax laga waydiin doono. Somaliland bilihii la soo dhaafay waxaa lagu xiray tiro wariyaal ah, iyadoo xukuumaddu ku eedeysay wariyaasha gudbinta warar aan sax aheyn. The post Somaliland oo ka hadashay xariga Xasan Galleydh appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya oo gaartay heerkii ugu sarreeyey muddo toban sano ah
items.description: Falalka burcad-badeedda ee ka dhacaya xeebaha Soomaaliya ayaa gaaray heerkii ugu sarreeyey muddo toban sano ah, iyadoo tan iyo dabayaaqadii bishii Abriil la diiwaangeliyey siddeed afduub oo loo geystay maraakiib ganacsi iyo doonyo marayey biyaha Geeska Afrika. Kooxaha burcad-badeedda ayaa la sheegay inay hadda adeegsanayaan farsamooyin ka casrisan kuwii hore, oo ay ka mid yihiin internet-ka dayax-gacmeedka si ay ula socdaan bartilmaameedyada una xiriiriyaan hawlgalladooda. Waxay sidoo kale maraakiibtii hore loo afduubay u adeegsanayaan saldhigyo ay weerarro kale uga fuliyaan badda. Soo-noqoshada burcad-badeedda waxaa lala xiriiriyey yaraanshaha joogitaanka maraakiibta dagaalka caalamiga ah ee xeebaha Soomaaliya. Qaar ka mid ah awoodihii badda ayaa xoogooda iyo agabkooda u wareejiyey xiisadaha ka taagan Badda Cas iyo marinnada kale ee istaraatiijiga ah ee gobolka. Lacagaha madax-furashada ee la sheegay in lagu bixiyo sii-deynta maraakiibta iyo shaqaalahooda ayaa sidoo kale sare u qaaday walaaca jira. Saraakiil iyo khubaro dhanka amniga badda ah ayaa ka digay in lacagahaas ay dhiirrigelin karaan kooxaha burcad-badeedda, isla markaana ay u sahli karaan inay dib isu abaabulaan. Burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya ayaa heerkii ugu sarreeyey gaartay sannadkii 2011, markaas oo boqollaal weerar laga diiwaangeliyey biyaha Soomaaliya. Weerarrada ayaa si weyn hoos ugu dhacay kaddib markii la geeyey ciidamo caalami ah, maraakiibtuna xoojiyeen ilaaladooda, balse dhacdooyinka ayaa mar kale soo badanayey tan iyo 2023.

items.title: War cusub oo kasoo kordhay xarigga Wariye Hasan Galaydh
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Booliska Somaliland ayaa markii ugu horreysay ka hadlay xarigga Wariye Xasan Saleebaan Haaruun (Galaydh) oo shalay ciidamada ammaanka ay soo xireen isaga oo shalay ka qayb-galayay xafladda qalin jebinta Jaamacadda Timacadde ee magaalada Gebiley. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Booliska Somaliland ayaa lagu xaqiijiyay in wariyaha uu ku jiro gacanta ciidamada, isla markaana loo haysto eedeymo la xiriira faafinta warar been abuur ah. Sidoo kale, taliska ayaa sheegay in haatan ay baaris ku socoto Wariye Xasan Galaydh, isla markaana si deg-deg ah loo horgeyn doono cadaaladda. “Ciidanka Booliska JSL ayaa gacanta ku soo dhigay eedaysane Xasan Saleebaan Haaruun (Gallaydh), oo ku eedaysan faafinta warar been-abuur ah,” ayaa lagu yiri warka qoraalka ah ee kasoo baxay Booliska Somaliland. Sidoo kale waxaa intaas lasii raaciyay “Eedaysanaha ayaa wax laga weydiiyey wararka uu warbaahinta ku faafiyey, taas oo uu wax caddayn ah u waayay, waxaana si degdeg ah loogu horgeyn doonaa Hay’adaha Sharciga”. Xasan Galaydh oo caan ka ah deegaannada Somaliland ayaa dhawaan baahiyay warbixin uu diiradda ku saaray arrimaha nolosha Somaliland, sida sicir bararka, laydhka, caafimaadka, iyo shaqada xukuumadda. Sidoo kale, wuxuu isla warbixintaas kaga hadlay xarigga loo gaystay wariye Cabdiqani Baylood oo weli xiran, isaga oo ku baaqay in si deg-deg ah loo sii daayo. Dhanka kale, falcelin xooggan ayaa ka dhalatay xarigga lagula kacay Hasan Gllaydh, waxaana cambaareeyay mas’uuliyiin iyo xisbiyada Somaliland. “Xadhigga noocan ah, ceeb iyo qiimo la’aan wax aan ahayn xukuumaduhu kama qaadan.. Waxaan ku baaqayaa in wariye Hassan Gallaydh iyo suxufiyiinta kale ba xoriyaddooda loo soo celiyo. Xadhiggina macquul maahee meesha maala rogayaa!” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Maxamed Abiib oo ka tirsan Golaha Wakiilada Somaliland. Dhankiisa, Gudoomiyaha garabka dhallinyarada heer qaran ee Xisbiga Kaah Dr Nimcaan ayaa isaguna qoraal uu soo saaray ku dhaliilay xukuumadda Cirro, wuxuuna sheegay inay caada ka dhigatay xarigga wariyeyaasha Somaliland. “Xukuumadda Xisbiga WADDANI waxay ku curatay caadana ka dhigtay xadhigga suxufiyiinta madaxbannaan, waxayna xabsiga u taxaabtay tiradii ugu badnayd ee suxufiyiina.Tani waa cabudhin iyo carjuuqdhed aan la aqbali karin,” ayuu isna yiri Dr Nimcaan. Si kastaba ha’ahaatee, Hasan Galaydh ayaa noqonaya wariyhii 47-aad ee ay xirto xukuumadda Somaliland, iyada oo sidoo kale Wariye Baylood uu muddo laba todobaad ah si xaq-darro ah ugu xiran yahay waraysi uu qaaday. items.title: Daawo: Jaamac oo si kulul uga hadlay calanka Turkiga ee lagu gubay Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa maanta si adag uga hadlay fal lagu gubay calanka Turkiga oo maalmo ka hor ka dhacay deegaanno ka tirsan Jubbaland, kaddib markii dibadbaxayaal careysan ay dab qabadsiiyeen calanka. Jaamac oo aad ugu dhow Ankara ayaa wax laga xumaado ku tilmaamay in dhul Soomaaliyeed xilligan lagu gubo calanka Turkiga, isaga oo xusay in dalal shisheeye ay ku lug leeyihiin arrintaas, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka ayaa shacabka Soomaaliyeed ugu baaqay inay ka feejignaadaan ajendayaal siyaasadeed ee uu sheegay in bannaanka ay ka imaanayaan, isla markaana lagu fool xumeynaayo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga. “In dhul Soomaaliyeed lagu gubo calanka Turkiga waa arrin ay dalal shisheeye ujeedo ka leeyihiin. Dadka Soomaaliyeed waxaan kula dardaarmayaa in ay ka feejignaadan ficilada lagu xumeynayo xiriirka qurxoon ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga,” ayuu yiri guddoomiye Jaamac. Sidoo kale, guddoomiyaha farriin u diray wariyeyaasha Soomaaliyeed, wuxuuna ka codsaday inay isha ku hayaan wararka xasaasiyada abuuraya ee taabanaya xiriirka Ankara iyo Muqdisho, ayna mas’uuliyad iska saaraan horumarka dalka. “Media-yaha waxaan ka codsaneynaa inay il gaar ah ku hayaan xiriirka labada dal, ayna gutaan waajibjooda qaran ee ka saaran dalka,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo dhawaan dibadbaxyo ka dhan ah Turkiga ay ka dhaceen meelo kamid ah Jubbaland iyo Koonfur Galbeed, kadib markii xukuumadda Ankara lagu eedeeyay duqemyo ka dhacay aagga magaalada Baydhaba oo ay ka taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeysa ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo marar kala duwan gudaha magaaladaasi. Si kastaba, Turkiga ayaa ah saaxibka koowaad ee Soomaaliya, wuxuuna gashaday abaal wayn, kadib markii usoo gurmaday xilli adag oo abaaro daran ay ka jireen meelo badan oo kamid ah dalka. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale taageerada ugu xooggan siiya Dowladda Federaalka, wuxuuna ka caawiyaa dhanka milatariga iyo dib u dhiska ciidanka Xoogga dalka. items.title: Somali Government Says Talks With Opposition Continue Amid Remaining Differences
items.description: MOGADISHU—The Somali Federal Government has said dialogue with opposition politicians is continuing, with the two sides reaching agreement on some issues while differences remain over others that require further negotiations. Speaking to Al Arabiya television, Somalia’s Minister of Information, Abdirahman Yusuf Al-Adala, said the government remains ready to engage in meaningful dialogue on key national issues, particularly the constitutional process and preparations for the country’s upcoming elections. Al-Adala said President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre have consistently urged political stakeholders to resolve their differences through dialogue, consensus and negotiation. “Meetings have been held with opposition groups on several occasions. There were issues on which agreement was reached, while others still require consensus,” the minister said. He stressed that the government remains willing to continue talks but warned that it rejects the use of force, the creation of unrest and any actions that could threaten peace and stability in the country. The minister also provided an update on the government’s campaign against Al-Shabaab, saying Somali security forces have made progress in military operations and succeeded in reclaiming large areas from the militant group. He said, however, that the fight against Al-Shabaab cannot be limited to military operations. The government’s broader strategy, he explained, includes countering extremist ideology, combating misinformation and propaganda, disrupting the financial sources of terrorist groups and supporting the development of areas recovered from militant control. On Somalia’s relations with Ethiopia, Al-Adala said the two countries share a relationship based on geographical proximity and that Somalia remains open to cooperation founded on mutual respect and the protection of the interests of both countries. He said Somalia welcomes legitimate economic cooperation and investment but emphasized that any agreement must comply with Somalia’s sovereignty, territorial integrity and national laws. The minister also reiterated the federal government’s position on Somalia’s northwestern regions, saying the country remains a single and united state and that Mogadishu will not accept any action aimed at undermining Somalia’s unity or territorial integrity. He warned that any unlawful recognition of a part of Somalia would constitute a violation of the country’s sovereignty and could have wider security implications for the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden. The Federal Government has reiterated its commitment to preserving Somalia’s territorial integrity, strengthening state institutions, defeating terrorist groups and resolving political differences through peaceful dialogue and negotiation. items.title: Sagal Abdi-Wali oo gaartay guul loona doortay musharraxa Labour ee kursigii Keir Starmer
items.description: London (Caasimada Online) — Xisbiga Labour-ka ee Britain ayaa Sagal Abdi-Wali, oo ah haweeney Soomaali ah isla markaana carruurnimadeedii qaxooti ahaan ku tagtay Britain, u doortay musharraxiisa doorashada kursiga baarlamaanka ee uu banneeyay ra’iisul wasaarihii hore Keir Starmer. Sagal ayaa Labour u matali doonta doorashada deg degga ah ee deegaanka Holborn and St Pancras ee London, oo la qaban doono 8-da October, kaddib markii xubnaha xisbiga ee deegaanka ay Arbacadii u doorteen musharraxa rasmiga ah. Kursigan ayaa bannaanaaday markii Starmer uu 1-dii September ku dhawaaqay inuu iska casilayo xubinnimada baarlamaanka, kaddib markii uu horay uga degay xilka ra’iisul wasaaraha. Sagal, oo hadda hoggaamisa Golaha Deegaanka Camden, ayaa sheegtay inay ku faraxsan tahay kalsoonida ay siiyeen xubnaha Labour-ka ee deegaanka ay ku soo kortay. “Waxaan aad ugu faraxsanahay in xubnaha deegaanka ay igu aamineen inaan noqdo musharraxa Labour-ka ee goobta aan ku soo koray,” ayay tiri. “Goobtan ayaa qoyskayga soo dhoweysay annagoo qaxooti ah, waxayna na siisay rajo xilli aan ugu baahi badnayn.” Waxay intaas ku dartay inay fursad u heshay inay nolol ka dhisato deegaankaas, iyadoo u adeegaysay bulshada sidii xildhibaan deegaan, xubin ka tirsan maamulka iskuullada iyo qof ka shaqeeya arrimaha bulshada. Doorasho taariikhi ah Sagal Abdi-Wali waxay Soomaaliya ka tagtay iyadoo carruur ah, iyadoo qoyskeedu Britain qaxooti ahaan ku tegay horraantii sagaashamaadkii. Waxay ku noolayd Camden muddo ku dhow 35 sano, waxaana deegaankaas uu noqday halka ay ku barbaartay, wax ku baratay, nolol ka dhisatay, islamarkaana markii dambe siyaasadda ka bilowday. Sagal waxaa markii ugu horreysay xildhibaan looga doortay Camden Council sanadkii 2022, iyadoo mataleysa deegaanka Camden Square. Waxay markii dambe noqotay xubin ka tirsan golaha fulinta oo qaabilsan guryaha, ka hor inta aan bishii May ee sanadkan loo dooran hoggaamiyaha Camden Council. Magacaabistaas ayaa ka dhigtay haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee madow ah ee hoggaamisa Camden Council. Sagal ayaa markii xilkaas loo doortay sheegtay in Camden ay tahay goobtii qoyskeeda siisay hoy iyo badbaado markii ay qaxootiga ahaayeen. “Camden waxay noo aheyd hoy 35 sano. Waa goobtii qoyskayga siisay magangelyo, na soo dhoweysay, isla markaana qeyb weyn ka qaadatay qofka aan maanta ahay iyo waxa aan aaminsanahay,” ayay xilligaas tiri. Ka hor inta aysan qaban xilalka siyaasadeed, waxay muddo dheer ka shaqaynaysay ururrada bulshada iyo hay’adaha samafalka ee deegaanka, iyadoo sidoo kale ka mid ahayd maamulka iskuullo ku yaalla Camden. Waxay sidoo kale horay u soo hoggaamisay laanta Labour-ka ee Holborn and St Pancras, taas oo ka dhigan in xiriirkeeda siyaasadeed ee deegaanka uu soo jiray ka hor inta aysan u tartamin kursiga baarlamaanka. Tartan siyaasadeed Doorashada 8-da October ayaa indhaha lagu hayaa, maadaama kursigu muddo dheer ahaa mid Labour-ku haystay, islamarkaana uu Starmer matalayay tan iyo 2015. Xisbiga Green Party ayaa sidoo kale doonaya inuu si xooggan ugu tartamo kursiga, iyadoo hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Zack Polanski uu doonayo inuu noqdo musharraxa xisbigiisa. Sagal ayaa sidoo kale maalmihii ka horreeyay xulashadeeda wajahday hadallo muran dhaliyay oo ku saabsan halka ay ku dhalatay. Zia Yusuf, oo ka tirsan xisbiga Reform UK, ayaa baraha bulshada ku soo qaaday dhalashadeeda Soomaaliya, arrintaas oo dhaleeceyn xooggan kala kulantay siyaasiyiin ka tirsan Labour iyo xitaa qaar ka mid ah xubnaha Reform UK. Sagal kama aysan dhigin asalkeeda qaxootinimo arrin ka fogeynaysa bulshada ay doonayso inay matasho, balse waxay si joogto ah ugu tilmaantay qayb ka mid ah sababta ku dhiirrigelisay adeegga bulshada. Haddii ay ku guuleysato doorashada October, waxay baarlamaanka Britain ku matali doontaa isla deegaanka ay qoyskeedu magangelyada ka heleen markii ay Soomaaliya kasoo qaxeen in ka badan saddexdii sano ee la soo dhaafay. items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo sheegay in diyaar u yihiin in ay ciidamo nabad ilaalin ah ay u diraan Gaza hadii…
items.description: Wargeyska Jerusalem Post ayaa sheegay intii lagu gudo jiray shirkii MEAD in madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), warraysi ku sheegay in Somaliland diyaar u tahay in ilaa 2 kun oo askari u diri karto degaanka Marinka Gaza, si ay qayb uga noqdaan ciidamada caalamiga ah ee la doonayo in la geeyo Gaza. Sida warka wargeysku saaka faafiyey ku cad, madaxweyne Cirro waxa uu sheegay in dalka Somaliland aanu si mutadawacnimo ah wax ciidan ah ugu diri doonin Gaza, balse ay arrintaasi fulin doonaan haddii laga soo codsado in Somaliland ciidamo u dirto Marinka Gaza. Ciidamada calamiga ah ee xasilinta Marinka Gaza ayaa la filayaa inay degaankaasi ka gaadhaan bishan September ama ilaa October 2026. Dalalka ilaa hadda sheegay inay ciidanka u dirayaan Gaza waxa ka mid ah Marooko, Uganda, Albania, Kosovo, Kazakhstan, waxaana haddii ay dhab noqoto ku biiraya Somaliland.

items.title: Ururka Qareennada Bariga Afrika oo Kenya uga digay cabburinta ganacsatada ajaanibta
items.description: Ururka Qareennada Bariga Afrika (EALS) ayaa dowladda Kenya uga digay in tallaabooyinka lagu bartilmaameedsanayo ganacsatada ajaanibta ah loo fuliyo si waafaqsan dastuurka dalka iyo waajibaadka ka saaran heshiisyada Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC). EALS ayaa walaac ka muujiyey cabsi sii kordheysa oo soo wajahday muwaadiniinta dalalka EAC ee ku nool kana shaqeeya Kenya, gaar ahaan kuwa ka ganacsada goobaha yaryar. Ururku wuxuu sheegay in jinsiyadda qofka oo keliya aan loo qaadan karin caddeyn muujinaysa inuu dalka si sharci-darro ah ku joogo ama uga ganacsado. Ururku wuxuu qiray inay Kenya xaq u leedahay hubinta rukhsadaha shaqada, canshuuraha, shatiyada ganacsiga iyo sharciyada socdaalka. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu ku adkaystay in tallaabo kasta lagu saleeyo xaaladda sharci ee qofka, lagana fogaado takoor, handadaad ama cabburin guud oo lagu bartilmaameedsado ajaanibta. EALS ayaa sidoo kale xusuusiyey Kenya inay xubin ka tahay EAC, isla markaana ay ku xiran tahay Heshiiska Bulshada Bariga Afrika iyo Hab-maamuuska Suuqa Wadajirka ah. Heshiisyadan ayaa oggolaanaya isu-socodka shaqaalaha iyo xaqa muwaadiniinta dalalka xubnaha ka ah inay ganacsiyo sharci ah ka sameystaan waddamada kale ee ururka. Digniintan ayaa timid kaddib markii dowladda Kenya ay ajaanibta siisay 90 maalmood oo ay ku cusboonaysiiyaan ama ku sharciyeystaan dukumentiyadooda. Mas’uuliyiinta Kenya ayaa sheegay in dadka haysta rukhsadaha iyo shatiyada saxda ah ay xaq u leeyihiin inay dalka ku noolaadaan kana shaqeeyaan. Arrintan ayaa saameyn karta Soomaalida ganacsiyada ku leh Kenya, gaar ahaan kuwa haysta dhalashada Soomaaliya oo xubin ka ah EAC. EALS waxay ka digtay⁠￼ in fulin aan isku mid ahayn ay dhaawici karto kalsoonida Suuqa Wadajirka ah iyo dadaallada isdhexgalka gobolka.
