items.title: Confusion and Fear Grip Nairobi as Kenya Intensifies Immigration Crackdown
items.description: Nairobi (WDN) — Confusion and anxiety spread across Nairobi as Kenyan security and immigration authorities intensified a crackdown on foreign nationals believed to be living in the country without valid immigration status, following a recent directive from President William Ruto calling for the removal of undocumented foreigners. The enforcement operation was particularly visible on the streets of Nairobi, where foreign nationals reportedly became increasingly cautious about leaving their homes amid uncertainty over who was being targeted and what legal status was required to avoid arrest or deportation. A significant number of those seen attempting to leave Kenya were reportedly nationals of Burundi, with some beginning overland journeys back to their country while others sought assistance from their respective embassies to facilitate their departure. The operation also caused concern within Nairobi’s Somali community, particularly in Eastleigh, where some Somalis without valid immigration documents reportedly remained inside their homes, fearing that the crackdown could affect them. Questions Over the Scope of the Crackdown The operation has raised questions about how President Ruto’s directive was being interpreted and whether enforcement agencies were adequately distinguishing between foreigners without lawful immigration status and nationals of countries covered by regional arrangements. The uncertainty has been particularly pronounced among members of the East African Community (EAC), which includes Kenya and Somalia. Some members of the Somali community expressed surprise over reports that immigration enforcement was being applied broadly, arguing that citizens of EAC member states may be entitled to specific rights and protections under regional agreements. The Kenyan government has reportedly instructed security and immigration authorities to halt deportation measures targeting nationals of EAC member states, adding another layer to the confusion surrounding the operation and raising questions about how the initial directive was implemented. Fear in Eastleigh : The Question of Enforcement and Regional Rights In Eastleigh, one of Nairobi’s largest Somali-populated neighborhoods, the impact was particularly noticeable. Some residents reportedly chose not to leave their homes, fearing encounters with security or immigration officers and uncertainty over how their individual status would be assessed. For many, the concern was not simply whether they possessed the required documentation. It was the possibility of detention, questioning or deportation before their circumstances were properly examined. The episode has exposed the difficulties that can arise when a broad immigration directive is implemented without sufficiently distinguishing between different categories of foreign nationals. Kenya has a legitimate interest in enforcing its immigration laws and addressing irregular migration. But enforcement must remain consistent with the country’s legal and regional obligations. The operation highlights the importance of distinguishing between undocumented migrants, people whose permits have expired, asylum seekers, refugees and nationals of EAC member states who may benefit from regional mobility arrangements. A blanket approach risks creating unnecessary fear among residents and could undermine confidence among foreign communities that contribute significantly to Kenya’s economy. An Uneasy Day in Nairobi The reported decision to halt deportation measures involving EAC nationals may ease some immediate concerns, but the operation has already unsettled communities across Nairobi. Kenya has the right to enforce its immigration laws, but enforcement must be targeted, lawful and proportionate, with individuals assessed according to their actual immigration status and the protections applicable to them under Kenyan and regional law. For Nairobi’s foreign communities, including its large Somali population, the events served as a stark reminder of how quickly a government immigration directive can affect ordinary lives. The central issue is not whether Kenya should enforce its immigration laws—it is whether those laws are being applied accurately, consistently and within the legal framework governing the people they affect. An Uneasy Day in Nairobi The reported decision to halt deportation measures involving EAC nationals may ease some immediate concerns, but the operation has already unsettled communities across Nairobi. Kenya has the right to enforce its immigration laws, but enforcement must be targeted, lawful and proportionate, with individuals assessed according to their actual immigration status and the protections applicable to them under Kenyan and regional law. For Nairobi’s foreign communities, including its large Somali population, the events served as a stark reminder of how quickly a government immigration directive can affect ordinary lives. The central issue is not whether Kenya should enforce its immigration laws—it is whether those laws are being applied accurately, consistently and within the legal framework governing the people they affect. items.title: U.S. Steps Back as Somalia’s Election Deadlock Deepens
items.description: Mogadishu(WDN) — The United States is reassessing its engagement with Somalia as Washington signals that Somali leaders must take primary responsibility for resolving the country’s deepening political crisis, amid nearly a year of failed negotiations over elections, constitutional changes and the next political transition. Justin Davis, the U.S. Chargé d’Affaires in Mogadishu, is completing his tenure after taking over the embassy in January 2026. U.S. diplomats say Washington is placing greater emphasis on mutual responsibility, with Somalia expected to determine its own political future. Davis has previously said that Somalia’s future belongs to its people and leaders and that the United States does not intend to decide how Somalis choose their government. The message comes as the Federal Government, opposition groups and three federal member states remain deeply divided over the country’s electoral and constitutional framework. No Deal After Nearly a Year of Talks Despite months of negotiations and mediation, t he political actors have failed to resolve the most basic questions surrounding the transition: What electoral system should Somalia use? Who has the authority to organize the vote? What constitutional rules should govern the process? And can an election be legitimate if major opposition forces and federal member states reject the framework? The government has pushed ahead with its electoral agenda, while opposition groups and federal member states have demanded a broader political agreement before the process moves forward. The result is a growing contradiction: Somalia is discussing elections without agreement on the rules under which they will be held. The constitutional dispute has made the situation even more complicated, with disagreements over who can amend the Constitution, how changes should be approved and whether the process has sufficient political consensus. U.S. Focus Remains Security Washington continues to prioritize the fight against Al-Shabaab, security cooperation, counterterrorism financing and migration. American diplomats have also warned that political divisions could undermine Somalia’s security efforts. But the United States appears increasingly unwilling to take ownership of Somalia’s political settlement. The shift comes after international mediation efforts repeatedly failed to produce an agreement between the government, opposition and federal member states. Meanwhile, Turkey, China and the United Arab Emirates are expanding their political, economic and strategic engagement with Somalia, creating an increasingly competitive external environment. The immediate challenge, however, remains inside Somalia.The country does not lack dialogue. It lacks agreement. Until the Federal Government, opposition forces and federal member states reach consensus on the Constitution, electoral rules and transition arrangements, Somalia risks remaining trapped in a cycle of failed negotiations, disputed elections and contested constitutional authority . Washington’s message is increasingly clear: Somalia has international partners, but Somali leaders must decide the country’s political future. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee xiisadda Koonfur Galbeed iyo eedeymaha loo jeediyay Turkiga
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Xaaladda guud ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa weli kacsan, iyada oo dagaalladii ugu dambeeyay ee ka dhacay Baydhaba ay uga sii dareen xiisadda, kuwaas oo saameyn ku yeeshay deegaanka, maadaama dhimasho, dhaawac iyo burbur xooggan ay sababeen. Xiisadda ayaa haatan yeelatay weji cusub, kadib qarxii ka dhacay guriga taliyihii hore ee ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, Jeneraal Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan ee degmada Doolow, waxaana weerarkaas uu dhaliyay tuhun xoogan iyo door ay dalalk shisheeye ku yeelan karaan colaadaha taagan, taas oo noqotay arrimo sida weyn looga hadal-hayo baraha bulshada. Guud ahaan xiisadda ka jirta Koonfur Galbeed ayaa salka ku haysa khilaaf siyaasadeed oo soo jiitamayay tan iyo dhammaadkii 2023, kaas oo u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dhinacyo siyaasadeed oo taageersan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen) oo haatan ciidamadiisa ay joogaan bannaanka magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. Maleeshiyaad daacad u ah Lafta-gareen ayaa maalmahan dambe weerarro ku qaaday ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ka hawlgala Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda ay iska caabin xooggan kala hor tageen weerarradaas. Sidoo kale, khilaafaadka siyaasadeed, gaar ahaan kuwa la xiriira doorashooyinka iyo awood-qaybsiga, ayaa mararka qaarkood isu beddela iska-horimaadyo hubaysan. Xaaladaha noocan oo kale ah waxay sidoo kale fursad u noqon karaan dhinacyo siyaasadeed iyo kuwo shisheeye oo doonaya inay ka faa’iidaystaan qalalaasaha ka jira gudaha dalka. Qaraxii Doolow iyo eedeymaha loo jeediyay Turkiga Xiisadda siyaasadeed iyo midda amni ee Koonfur Galbeed ayaa kasii dartay kaddib qaraxii ka dhacay 4-tii September 2026 degmada Doolow ee gobolka, kaas oo lala beegsaday guriga Jeneraal Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan, oo loo yaqaan (Taliye Shub), kana tirsan qoyska madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen). Qaraxa kadib, waxaa baraha bulshada ku faafay eedeymo iyo warar kala duwan oo ku saabsan cidda mas’uulka ka ahayd dhacdadaas. Qaar ka mid ah farriimaha la faafiyay ayaa Turkiga ku eedeeyay inuu door ku lahaa dhacdada, iyadoo sidoo kale la baahiyay sheegashooyin ah in Ankara ay taageero siyaasadeed siiso Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Waxaa kale oo baraha bulshada lagu baahiyay eedeymo sheegaya in Turkigu uu diyaaradaha dagaalka ee F-16 iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn u adeegsanayo bartilmaameedsiga dhinacyada ka soo horjeeda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Illaa iyo hadda lama helin wax caddeyn ah oo muujinaya in ciidamada Turkigu ay howlgal cirka ama dhulka ah ka fuliyeen goobta dhacdadu ka dhacday maalintii qaraxa, waxaana dowladda Soomaaliya ay weli waddaa baaris ku aadan dhacdadaasi, maadaama loo saaray guddi xaqiiqo raadin ah. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Wararkan iyo eedeymaha kala duwan ee ku saabsan dhacdadan ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo faafitaanka macluumaad aan la xaqiijin iyo dacaayado laga yaabo in loogu talagalay inay saameyn ku yeeshaan aragtida dadweynaha ee ku saabsan doorka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya. Loollanka xogta iyo danaha shisheeye Qaar ka mid ah dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo falanqeeyayaasha ayaa aaminsan in khilaafaadka gudaha Soomaaliya ay mararka qaarkood ka faa’iidaystaan dhinacyo saddexaad oo dano siyaasadeed iyo istaraatiijiyadeed ku leh gobolka. Sida ay sheegayaan aragtiyaha la faafinayo, dhinacyadaasi waxay isku dayaan inay ka faa’iidaystaan kala-qaybsanaanta siyaasadeed iyo xaaladaha amni ee dalka si ay u sii xoojiyaan khilaafaadka jira ama ay u wiiqaan xiriirka Soomaaliya la leedahay qaar ka mid ah saaxiibadeeda caalamiga ah. Waxaa sidoo kale jiray eedeymo ku saabsan in ololeyaasha lagu bartilmaameedsanayo Turkiga ay qayb ka yihiin loollan siyaasadeed iyo mid juqraafiyeed oo ballaaran, inkastoo eedeymahaas qaarkood aysan jirin caddeymo madax-bannaan oo si rasmi ah u xaqiijiyay. Dhinacyada taageersan aragtidan ayaa ku doodaya in Soomaaliya xasilloon, nabdoon oo awood u leh inay si madax-bannaan u doorato xiriirrada ay la yeelanayso waddamada kale ay tahay arrin aan la jaanqaadi karin danaha qaar ka mid ah dhinacyada shisheeye. Doorka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya Turkigu wuxuu muddo dheer ka mid ahaa saaxiibada muhiimka ah ee Soomaaliya, isagoo taageero ka geysta dhinacyada amniga, tababarka ciidamada, gargaarka bani’aadannimada, caafimaadka, waxbarashada iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha. Dhanka amniga, Turkigu wuxuu Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya kala shaqeeyaa dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo kooxaha kale ee hubaysan, iyadoo taageeradaasi ku salaysan tahay heshiisyo iyo codsiyo ka yimid dowladda Soomaaliya. Dadka iyo hay’adaha taageersan iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa ku doodaya in hawlgallada amniga ee uu Turkigu taageero lagu fuliyo iyadoo la tixgelinayo xaaladda rayidka, isla markaana laga fogaanayo khasaaraha shacabka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, howlgallada militari iyo taageerada shisheeye ee Soomaaliya ayaa mararka qaarkood noqda mowduucyada ugu waaweyn ee lagu faafiyo warar is-khilaafsan iyo eedeymo siyaasadeed. Waxaa sidoo kale muuqata in taageerada joogtada ah ee uu Turkigu siiyo Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dagaalka ka dhanka ah argagixisada, ay ka dhigtay doorkiisa mid si weyn loola socdo, isla markaana mararka qaarkood bartilmaameed u noqda ololeyaal siyaasadeed iyo kuwo warbaahineed. Dadaallada dhex-dhexaadinta Marka laga soo tago taageerada amniga iyo horumarinta, Turkigu wuxuu sidoo kale ka shaqeeyay dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo in lagu yareeyo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Dadaalladaas ayaa lagu doonayaa in la fududeeyo wada-hadalka iyo isu-soo-dhowaanshaha dhinacyada kala duwan ee siyaasadda Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan xilli uu dalka wajahayo khilaafyo siyaasadeed oo sii xoogaysanayay sanadkan 2026. Doorka Turkiga ee dadaallada lagu yareynayo xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee Muqdisho iyo meelaha kale ee dalka ayaa taageerayaashiisu u arkaan mid ka hor imanaya eedeymaha sheegaya in Ankara ay si toos ah dhinac uga tahay khilaafaadka gudaha Soomaaliya. Dadaallada dhexdhexaadinta iyo wada-hadallada siyaasadeed ayaa weli muhiim u ah sidii looga hortagi lahaa in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya isu beddelaan iska-horimaadyo hubaysan. Iyadoo xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo tan amni ee Soomaaliya ay weli tahay mid xasaasi ah, ayaa muhiimad weyn leh in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay si taxaddar leh u qiimeeyaan wararka iyo macluumaadka lagu faafiyo baraha bulshada. Sidaas darteed, dhacdooyinka ka socda Koonfur-galbeed iyo eedeymaha la xiriira doorka dalalka shisheeye waa in lagu qiimeeyaa xog la hubiyay iyo caddeymo la isku halayn karo. Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay xasillooni siyaasadeed, wada-hadal iyo iskaashi lagu xalliyo khilaafaadka gudaha, iyadoo isla markaana muhiim tahay in la ilaaliyo xiriirrada ay la leedahay dalalka saaxiibada ah, gaar ahaan kuwa taageerada ka geysta amniga, horumarinta iyo dib-u-dhiska dalka. The post Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee xiisadda Koonfur Galbeed iyo eedeymaha loo jeediyay Turkiga appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Xukuumadda Federaalka ayaa horey u sheegtay inay muddadaas qaadi doonto tallaabooyin lagu dhaqan-gelinayo dastuurka, isla markaana lagu waafajinayo hay’adaha iyo mas’uuliyiinta dowladda qodobbada dastuurka cusub, hase yeeshee waxaa muuqata in qaar ka mid ah qodobbada muhiimka ah aan weli si buuxda loo dhaqan-gelin. Mid ka mid ah arrimaha aan weli la xallin ayaa ah kala saarista xilalka wasiirrada iyo xildhibaannada isku haya, iyadoo dastuurka cusub uu xaddidayo isku haynta xilal gaar ah oo dowladda ah, isla markaana qeexaya habraacyada iyo shuruudaha khuseeya xilalka kala duwan. Sidoo kale, waxaa jira mas’uuliyado kale oo ay hayaan shaqsiyaad ka tirsan dowladda kuwaas oo aan si buuxda ugu waafaqsanayn nidaamka iyo qodobbada dastuurka cusub, iyadoo dowladda aysan weli qaadin tallaabooyin muuqda oo arrimahaas lagu saxayo. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Dowladda Federaalka ay wajahayso cadaadis siyaasadeed oo la xiriira dastuurka cusub iyo hanaanka doorashooyinka dalka, oo ay si weyn iskugu hayaan mucaaradka, isla markaana ay socdaan wada-hadallo ay garwadeen ka tahay beesha caalamka oo xal loogu raadinayo xiisadda taagan. items.title: DF oo qorshaynaysa habraac cusub oo lagu xaddidayo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa waddo qorshe cusub oo lagu nidaaminayo dhaq-dhaqaaqa ajaanibta iyo hay’adaha ku howlan duubista muuqaallada, filimada iyo hawlaha dalxiiska ee gudaha dalka. Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Soomaaliya, Cabdifitaax Qaasim Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay diyaarinayso habraac qeexaya goobaha ay ajaanibtu geli karaan iyo meelaha aan loo oggolaan doonin inay muuqaallo ka duubaan. Nidaamkan cusub ayaa si cad u kala qeexi doona waxyaabaha qof ama hay’ad ajnabi ah loo oggol yahay inay Soomaaliya ku duubto iyo meelaha ama arrimaha laga mamnuucayo. Habraacan ayuu wasiirku sheegay inuu dhawaan soo bixi doono. Cabdifitaax ayaa sheegay in tallaabadan ay qeyb ka tahay dadaal lagu doonayo in lagu habeeyo hay’adaha dhaqanka, ururrada iyo shirkadaha caalamiga ah ee dalka ka howlgala, si loo hubiyo in waxyaabaha ay duubaan ama baahiyaan aysan ka hor imaan dhaqanka iyo qiyamka bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in arrintu aysan ku koobnayn oo keliya dhinaca dhaqanka, balse ay taabanayso amniga qaranka, isagoo xusay in amniga dalka loo baahan yahay in loo fahmo si ka ballaaran arrimaha ciidamada iyo kooxaha hubeysan. “Amniga qaranka marka laga hadlayo, amniga keliya ma aha; inta qoriga wadata keliya ma aha,” ayuu yiri wasiir Cabdifitaax Qaasim. Wasiirka ayaa waxa kale oo uu tilmaamay in ilaalinta dhaqanka, sumcadda dalka iyo sawirka Soomaaliya loogu gudbinayo caalamka ay sidoo kale qeyb ka yihiin amniga qaranka. Dhanka kale, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa qorsheyneysa in la dejiyo siyaasad iyo sharciyo cusub oo lagu maamulayo waaxda dalxiiska, iyadoo la doonayo in la helo nidaam rasmi ah oo ay ku shaqeeyaan hay’adaha iyo shirkadaha bixiya adeegyada dalxiiska gudaha Soomaaliya. Wasiirku wuxuu sheegay in dalka ay hadda ka howl-galaan shaqsiyaad iyo ururro kala duwan oo ku shaqeeya dalxiiska iyo duubista muuqaallada, balse aysan dhammaantood haysan hannaan sharciyeed oo cad oo lagu nidaamiyo howlahooda. Siyaasadda iyo habraacyada cusub ayaa dowladda u fududeyn doona inay kala saarto hay’adaha iyo shirkadaha si rasmi ah u diiwaangashan iyo kuwa aan lahayn sharciyad cad, sida uu sheegay wasiirka. The post DF oo qorshaynaysa habraac cusub oo lagu xaddidayo… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wasiirka Arimaha Gudaha Somaliland Oo Ka Hadley Xaalada Ka Soo Korodhay Gobolnimada Gabiley
Xuska Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Akhrisqoraalka
items.description: Sannad walba, maanta oo kale, waxaa dunida laga xusaa Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Akhrisqoraalka. Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan dhanka waxbarashada ee UNESCO ayaa sannadkii 1966dii u astaysay in 8da Sebteembar ay noqoto Maalinta Akhrisqoraalka ee Adduunka, oo maanta laga joogo sannadguuradii 60aad, si loo ciribtiro aqoondarrada—oo ah cadawga ugu weyn ee ummaduhu la dagaallamaan—la iskuna baraarujiyo muhiimadda akhrisqoraalku bulshada u leeyahay iyo sida uu uga qaybqaadan karo horumarinta bulshada. Akhrisqoraalku waa in qofku wax qori karo, waxna akhrin karo. Dunidu waxay isku raacsan tahay in la dabarjaro akhrisqoraal-la’aanta, qofkuna, ugu yaraan, uu yaqaan sida afkiisa hooyo loo akhriyo, loona qoro. Waddamada Norway, Uzbekistan, North Korea iyo Andorra ayaa ah dalalka muwaadiniintooda oo idil 100% ay wax qori karaan, waxna akhrin karaan, halka Chad iyo Suudaanta Koonfureed ay yihiin waddamada ugu liita akhrisqoraalka. Sooyaalka Akhrisqoraalka ee Ummadda Soomaaliyeed Ka hor Qoraalkii Af Soomaaliga Ka hor hirgelintii iyo rasmiyayntii habdhigaalkii af Soomaaliga 1972, heerka akhrisqoraalka ee bulshadeennu wuxuu joogay meeshii ugu hoosaysay. Dadka wax akhrin karay ama qori karay waxaa lagu qiyaasi jiray 3% ilaa 5%, oo ahaa dadka yaqaanay luuqadaha kale: Carabiga oo ay culimadu adeegsan jireen, halka Talyaaniga iyo Ingiriisiga ay adeegsan jireen dadka sida dhow ula shaqayn jiray gumaystayaashii Ingiriiska iyo Talyaaniga. Isdhaafsiga farriimuhu wuxuu ahaa caqabad weyn; raadinta qof qora iyo mid akhriya marka ay gaarto bartilmaameedkii, taas oo keenaysay in macluumaadka ay ogaadaan qolo saddexaad oo aysan qusayn; taasna waxaa sabab u ahayd aqoondarrada jirtay. Kaddib Qoraalkii Af Soomaaliga Markii si rasmi ah loo qoray Af Soomaaliga 1972, Xukuumaddii Kacaanku waxay ku dadaashay sidii loo hirgelin lahaa qoraalka. Manhajka dugsiyada ayaa laga dhigay mid ku baxa Af Soomaaliga, shaqaalaha dawladda ayaa la baray, tan ugu muhiimsanna waxay ahayd Ololihii Horumarinta Reer Miyiga. Kumannaan qof oo Soomaali ah oo isugu jiray macallimiin, arday, dhakhaatiir, shaqaale rayid ah iyo saraakiil ciidan ayaa ku dhow sannad guryahoodii iyo ehelkoodii uga maqnaa si ay jahliga uga saaraan walaalahood Soomaaliyeed. Heerka akhrisqoraalka ummadda Soomaaliyeed oo hore u joogay 3–5% wuxuu gaaray 55%, taas oo muujinaysa baaxadda ololaha iyo sida looga faa’iidaystay. Maxaa keenay in 52 sannadood kaddib heerka akhrisqoraalku ka hooseeyo meeshii uu joogay? 1974tii, heerka akhrisqoraalka ama dadka wax qori kara waxna akhrin kara ee Soomaaliyeed waxaa lagu qiyaasay 55%. Sannadkan aynu ku jirno ee 2026, sida ay muujinayaan xogihii u dambeeyay, heerka akhrisqoraalka ee ummadda Soomaaliyeed waxaa lagu sheegay 48%. Xilligaas dalku wuxuu lahaa hal jaamacad iyo iskuullo kooban, hasayeeshee maanta Muqdisho oo qura waxaa ku yaalla jaamacado kor u dhaafaya 90 iyo iskuullo gaaraya 690 iskuul. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee JFS, Mudane Faarax Sheekh Cabdulqaadir, oo la hadlay warbaahinta Goobjoog ayaa ugu baaqay ardayda dhigata jaamacadaha iyo dugsiyada sare in ay wax baraan waalidiintooda iyo ehelkooda kula nool guryaha, taas oo yarayn karta heerka akhrisqoraal la’aanta ee dadka Soomaaliyeed. Maxaa hoos u dhigay akhrisqoraalka? Marka laga yimaado dadka ummiga ah oo aan aqoon akhrisqoraalka, waxaa si weyn u yaraaday dhaqankii akhrisqoraalka ee dadka waxbartay. Baraha bulshada Baraha bulshadu waxay saamayn taban ku yeesheen akhrisqoraalka, waxayna ka hor istaageen dhallinta in ay yeeshaan dhaqan akhrisqoraal. Dhaqankii akhriska waxay u beddeleen mid muuqaal daawasho ah, waana hubaal in aad marar badan aragtay dhallinyarada oo dalbanaya in maqaallada dhaadheer cod ama muuqaal looga dhigo, taas oo muujinaysa sida baraha bulshadu saamayn taban ugu yeesheen akhrisqoraalka. Tani waxay keentay in qoraayaashu, si ay farriimahooda bulshada u gaarsiiyaan, buuggii ay hore u qoreen dib cod ahaan ugu duubaan. Maktabado yari ka jirta magaalooyinka dalka Maktabaddu waa hoyga akhriska, yaraanshaheeduna waxay yaraynaysaa akhriska. Dalka oo idil waxaa ka jira maktabado yar; degaannada qaar kuma yaallaan, halka degaannada qaarna aysan maktabadaha ku oollin buugag ku filan. Dhiirriggelin la’aanta qoraayaasha Qoraagu waa soosaaraha quudka maskaxda aadanaha, bidhamiyaha dhibaatooyinka jira iyo ku hagaha xalka dhabta ah. Iibsashada buuggu waxay suurtagelinaysaa in dhambaalladii uu u siday bulshada ay gaaraan iyo in lagu dhiirrigeliyo qoraalka buugag kale. Dhallinyaro badan oo hami ka lahaa xirfadda qoraalka, jeclaana in ay wacyiga bulshadooda kordhiyaan, ayaa duruufo dhaqaale awgood uga haray qoraalka; qaar ayaa diyaariyay buugag, hasayeeshee ma helin cid ka taageerta daabacaadda iyo bandhigga buugga.

Wasiirka Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee JFS, Mudane Faarax Sheekh Cabdulqaadir, oo la hadlay warbaahinta Goobjoog ayaa ugu baaqay ardayda dhigata jaamacadaha iyo dugsiyada sare in ay wax baraan waalidiintooda iyo ehelkooda kula nool guryaha, taas oo yarayn karta heerka akhrisqoraal la’aanta ee dadka Soomaaliyeed. Maxaa hoos u dhigay akhrisqoraalka? Marka laga yimaado dadka ummiga ah oo aan aqoon akhrisqoraalka, waxaa si weyn u yaraaday dhaqankii akhrisqoraalka ee dadka waxbartay. Baraha bulshada Baraha bulshadu waxay saamayn taban ku yeesheen akhrisqoraalka, waxayna ka hor istaageen dhallinta in ay yeeshaan dhaqan akhrisqoraal. Dhaqankii akhriska waxay u beddeleen mid muuqaal daawasho ah, waana hubaal in aad marar badan aragtay dhallinyarada oo dalbanaya in maqaallada dhaadheer cod ama muuqaal looga dhigo, taas oo muujinaysa sida baraha bulshadu saamayn taban ugu yeesheen akhrisqoraalka. Tani waxay keentay in qoraayaashu, si ay farriimahooda bulshada u gaarsiiyaan, buuggii ay hore u qoreen dib cod ahaan ugu duubaan. Maktabado yari ka jirta magaalooyinka dalka Maktabaddu waa hoyga akhriska, yaraanshaheeduna waxay yaraynaysaa akhriska. Dalka oo idil waxaa ka jira maktabado yar; degaannada qaar kuma yaallaan, halka degaannada qaarna aysan maktabadaha ku oollin buugag ku filan. Dhiirriggelin la’aanta qoraayaasha Qoraagu waa soosaaraha quudka maskaxda aadanaha, bidhamiyaha dhibaatooyinka jira iyo ku hagaha xalka dhabta ah. Iibsashada buuggu waxay suurtagelinaysaa in dhambaalladii uu u siday bulshada ay gaaraan iyo in lagu dhiirrigeliyo qoraalka buugag kale. Dhallinyaro badan oo hami ka lahaa xirfadda qoraalka, jeclaana in ay wacyiga bulshadooda kordhiyaan, ayaa duruufo dhaqaale awgood uga haray qoraalka; qaar ayaa diyaariyay buugag, hasayeeshee ma helin cid ka taageerta daabacaadda iyo bandhigga buugga.

items.title: Mogadishu Prepares for Pro-Turkey Rally Amid Gedo Tensions
items.description: MOGADISHU-(Raxanreeb Online) — Youth affiliated with the Banaadir Regional Administration have begun preparations for a planned demonstration in support of Turkey, holding their first organizing meeting in Mogadishu, according to sources familiar with the matter. The planned rally follows mounting pressure on the Somali federal government over an airstrike in Dolow District, Gedo Region, which has sparked criticism and protests in recent days. The demonstration is expected to take place in Mogadishu in the coming days, with members of the federal cabinet and officials from the Banaadir Regional Administration expected to participate. Sources told Raxanreeb Online that Banaadir Governor Muungaab was instructed to organize demonstrations in support of Turkey and in response to recent protests in Jubaland opposing the federal government’s actions. The planned mobilization comes amid heightened tensions between the federal government and Jubaland over the security situation in Gedo and the government’s handling of recent developments in the region. The post Mogadishu Prepares for Pro-Turkey Rally Amid Gedo Tensions appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Xog: Turkiga oo Bashaqle ka dhigaya aag milatari oo istiraatiiji ah xilli uu…
items.description: Warsheekh (Caasimada Online) – Deegaanka Bashaqle ee u dhexeeya Cadale iyo Warsheekh ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ayaa noqonaya aag istiraatiiji ah, iyadoo qorshayaal lagu dhisayo kaabayaal milatari oo la xiriira xarunta hawada sare ee Turkiga ee laga wado duleedka Warsheekh. Mashruuca xarunta hawada sare oo la sheegay inuu soo billowday dhammaadkii sanadkii 2025 ayaa wejigiisa hore la qorsheeyay in la soo gaba-gabeeyo 2027. Soomaaliya ayaa kaalin ka qaadanaysa hirgelinta xaruntan, sida uu horey u sheegay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Xogaha laga helayo deegaanka ayaa tilmaamaya in kaabayaasha laga dhisayo Bashaqle ay yeelan karaan xarumo loogu talagalay taageerada ciidamada dhulka, garoon diyaaradeed iyo sidoo kale adeegyo militari oo dhinaca badda ah. Haddii qorshayaashan la hirgeliyo, Bashaqle wuxuu yeelan karaa muhiimad istiraatiiji ah, maadaama uu ku dhow yahay goobta laga dhisayo xarunta hawada sare, taas oo ka dhigan in deegaanka loo adeegsan karo saldhig taageero oo lagu ilaaliyo laguna xoojiyo howlaha xarunta. Isbeddelkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Ankara ay sii ballaarinayso iskaashiga ay la leedahay Muqdisho ee dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca. Ciidamada Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inay kordhiyeen joogitaankooda qaybo ka mid ah Shabeellaha Dhexe. Joogitaanka ciidamada Turkiga ayaa loo aaneynayaa laba arrimood oo muhiim ah: taageerada iyo tababarka ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo ka qeyb-qaadashada sugidda amniga xarunta hawada sare marka ay shaqadeedu si buuxda u bilaabato. Sidoo kale, cutubyo ka tirsan ciidamada Gorgor oo tababar iyo taageero ka helay Turkiga ayaa loo diyaarinayaa howl-gallo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan goobo istiraatiiji ah oo ka tirsan Shabeellaha Dhexe. Howl-galladaas ayaa qeyb ka noqon kara qorshayaasha lagu ballaarinayo gacanta dowladda ee deegaannada gobolka, iyadoo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed lagu taageerayo tababar, qalab iyo iskaashi milatari oo ay la leeyihiin Turkiga. Bashaqle ayaa sidaas ku yeelanaya door ka weyn kii hore dhanka amniga, gaar ahaan haddii uu hirgalo qorshaha lagu dhisayo kaabayaasha milatari ee la xiriira xarunta hawada sare. Tallaabadaasi waxay sidoo kale sii xoojin kartaa joogitaanka ciidan ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ee xeebaha bartamaha dalka. Mashruuca xarunta hawada sare ayaa Soomaaliya u noqon kara fursad ay kaga mid noqoto dalalka Afrika ee yeesha kaabayaal la xiriira hawada sare, halka dhismaha kaabayaasha amniga ee ku xeeran uu siin karo deegaanka Bashaqle muhiimad cusub oo istiraatiiji ah. items.title: Anti-Turkey protests spread across Somalia after Dolow air strike
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Mass protests against Turkey and President Recep Tayyip Erdogan have swept through major towns in southern Somalia’s Jubaland state this week, following accusations by regional authorities that Ankara carried out an air strike that wounded a prominent Somali opposition figure, his wife and several civilians in the border town of Dolow. Demonstrators in Afmadow, Kismayo and Dolow all under the control of the Jubaland administration led by regional President Ahmed Madobe – burned the Turkish flag and carried images depicting Erdogan with his hands draped in blood. Placards written in Somali bore a blunt message: “We don’t want Erdogan, we don’t want Turkey.” The protests followed a determination announced Friday by Jubaland authorities that Turkey was behind an air strike late Thursday night on the residence of former chief of the Somali Custodial Corps General Mahad Abdirahman. The opposition figure narrowly survived the strike, which left him, his wife and several civilians injured. Jubaland authorities called for international intervention to halt what they described as escalating actions by both Turkey and the federal government of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, which the regional administration says Ankara is backing at all costs. Jubaland also demanded the reimposition of an arms embargo on Somalia. The protests mark a striking escalation in public anger over Turkey’s deepening military and political involvement in Somalia, while exposing a growing rupture in the perception of a country that, only a decade ago, was widely regarded across Somalia as a partner that had come to the country’s aid. Now, some protesters are casting Turkey’s expanding role in starkly different terms, accusing Ankara of pursuing what they describe as neocolonial ambitions. A Pattern Repeating Across Somalia’s States Tuesday’s demonstrations were not an isolated flashpoint. Similar protests previously erupted in parts of Somalia’s Southwest state, where residents angered by Turkish air strikes that killed civilians and their livestock also burned the Turkish flag. Anger over Turkey’s continued involvement in Somali political disputes and its drone strikes has since spread across the country, from the south to the north, marking one of the most geographically widespread waves of anti-Turkey sentiment in Somalia’s recent history. The reaction signals a widening confrontation over the boundaries of foreign military involvement in Somalia – and over Ankara’s increasingly prominent role in the country’s political and security affairs. The Puntland Fishermen Killings The unrest in Jubaland follows a separate and still-unresolved controversy in northeastern Puntland, where authorities last month accused Turkey of killing more than a dozen fishermen — all described as civilians — off the coast of the region’s Nugal area. Turkey’s Counter-Narrative Takes Shape Online As the protests spread, Turkish-aligned social media accounts have mounted an increasingly coordinated counter-narrative on X and other platforms, seeking to redirect blame for the unrest away from Ankara. Those accounts have instead pointed to Israel and the United Arab Emirates as instigators, while also naming a cross-section of prominent Somali figures — Professor Abdi Ismail Samatar, the presidents of both Jubaland and Puntland, and opposition leader Abdirahman Abdishakur — as having a hand in stoking anti-Turkey sentiment. The Turkish government itself has offered no official response. Ankara has not commented on the mounting allegations of its meddling in Somalia’s internal politics, nor has it addressed the specific accusation that it was behind the drone strike in Dolow that triggered this week’s protests. For Turkey, the controversy comes as its role in Somalia faces an increasingly intense public and political challenge. For Jubaland authorities and their supporters, the issue has become part of a broader confrontation over sovereignty, foreign influence and the balance of power between Somalia’s federal government and its regional administrations. What began with a disputed strike in Dolow has therefore widened into a broader reckoning over Ankara’s place in Somalia — with the Turkish flag now being burned in streets where, not long ago, Turkey was celebrated as one of the country’s most visible international partners. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Puntland oo jawaab ka soo saartay muqaal caro xoogan ka dhaliyay baraha bulshada
items.description: Qardho (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Booliska Puntland ayaa jawaab deg-deg ah ka bixiyay muuqaal caro xooggan ka dhaliyay baraha bulshada, kaas oo muujinayo gabar yar oo ay jir-dilayaan gabdho kale oo ka waaweyn. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Booliska ayaa lagu sheegay in falkaas loo soo xiray laba gabdhood oo walaalo ah oo muuqaalka kasoo dhex muuqday, kuwaas oo lagu kala magacaabo Maymuun Sharmaake Nuur iyo Mulki Sharmaake Nuur. “Ciidanka Booliska Puntland, gaar ahaan Taliska Qaybta Gobolka Karkaar, ayaa magaalada Qardho gacanta ku dhigay Maymuun Sharmaake Nuur iyo Mulki Sharmaake Nuur, oo ah laba eedeysane oo loo haysto jirdil iyo tacaddi loo geystay gabar carruur ah,” ayaa agu yiri qoraalka kasoo baxay Puntland. Muuqaal laga helay dhacdada ayaa muujinaya gabar carruur ah oo loo geysanayo fal jirdil iyo tacaddi, iyadoo xilligaas gabadha yar laga duubayay muuqaal, si wayn ugu baahay baraha bulshada ee Internetka. Sida ay sheegtay Puntland, labada gabdhood ayaa loo gudbin doonaa hay’adaha cadaaladda, si looga qaado tallaabo adag oo sharciga wafaaqsan. “Ciidanka Booliska ayaa si degdeg ah uga hawlgalay dhacdadan, waxaana eedeysanayaasha loo gudbin doonaa hay’adaha garsoorka ee ay khuseyso, iyadoo baaritaan rasmi ah uu socdo,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri qoraalka. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Booliska Puntland wuxuu si adag uga digayaa cid kasta oo duubta, faafisa ama dib u baahisa muuqaallo muujinaya jirdil, tacaddi ama falal anshax-xumo ah, gaar ahaan kuwa la xiriira carruurta. Dadka waxaa loogu baaqayaa in aysan sii faafin muuqaallada noocaas ah, balse ay xogta la xiriirta dhacdooyinka noocaas ah si toos ah ugu gudbiyaan hay’adaha amniga”. Dhanka kale Booliska ayaa bulshada ugu baaqay inay la shaqeeyaan hay’adaha amniga, si loo ilaaliyo carruurta loogana hortago fal kasta oo wax u dhimaya badqabka iyo karaamada bulshada. Dhacdadan ayaa dhalisay falcelin xooggan, iyadoo dad badan oo Soomaaliyeed ay ka xumaadeen, isla markaana dalbaday in la soo qabto eedeysanayaasha oo sharciga la horgeeyo. Dalabkaas ayaa Booliska Maamulka Puntland ka jawaabeen, iyagoo gacanta ku dhigay labada gabdhood ee loo haysto falkaasi. items.title: U.S. Sanctions Dismantle the Iranian Regime’s Revenue Streams
items.description: U.S. Sanctions Dismantle the Iranian Regime’s Revenue Streams Press Statement Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, Spokesman Office of the Spokesperson The United States remains committed to cutting off the Iranian regime’s access to the international financial system and the resources it uses to destabilize the region and threaten U.S. interests and partners. Today’s U.S. Department of the Treasury sanctions on Türkiye-based Golden Global Bank mark the latest step in Operation Economic Outcast, a whole-of-government effort to sever the networks that allow the regime to launder funds, evade sanctions, and finance its terrorist proxies across the Middle East. This action sends a clear message to financial institutions worldwide: facilitating Iran’s illicit financial activity carries serious consequences. This demonstrates the Trump Administration’s commitment to eliminating resources the regime uses to threaten regional stability, support terrorism, and advance its military capabilities. The United States will continue to use every diplomatic and economic tool at its disposal to isolate the Iranian regime until it abandons its support for terrorism and its destabilizing activities in the region. We urge the international community to join this effort and ensure no institution serves as a financial lifeline for a regime that threatens peace and security. items.title: Cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidamada Militariga oo loo wado Baydhabo, si ay weerar u qaadaan
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa sheegaya in halkaasi lagu abaabulayo ciidamo cusub oo la filayo in la geeyo Magaalada Baydhabo, si ay uga qayb qaataan hawlgal lagu la dagaalamayo ciidamada u daacadda ah Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in go’aankan uu ka dhashay, ka dib wada hadal ay xalay khadka telefoonka ku yeesheen Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe). Ilo wareedyada ayaa intaasi ku daraya in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka faray in loo dhaqaaqo hawlgal dabka looga fogeynayo, laguna xasillinayo Baydhabo. Aadan Maadoobe ayaa la aaminsan yahay in uu walaac xoog leh ku hayo joogitaanka ciidamada diidan jiritaanka maamulkiisa ee sida firfircoon u jooga hareeraha magaalada uu ku shaqeeyo. Aadan Madoobe ayaa la sheegaya in uu Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda u sheegay in mucaaradka uu Laftagareen hoggaamiyo aysan diyaar u ahayn wada hadal iyo heshiis siyaasadeed, si loo joojiyo weerarada ay ciidamada taageersan iyo Al Shabaab ku hayaan Baydhabo, isla-markaana ay lagama maarmaan tahay in loogu tago barraha ay iska soo abaabulaan. Aadan Madoobe oo 22-kii bishii August shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Madaxtooyada Baydhabo ayaa wax nasiib darro ah ku tilmaamay in saraakiil dhan oo horey uga tirsanaa dowladda ay maanta iskaashi la leeyihiin maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, wuxuuna askarta iyo dhallinyarada u dagaalameysa Laftagareen ugu baaqay inay dadkooda u soo laabtaan, haddii ay ka dhega-adeygaana in dantu keeni doonto in lagu weeraro meelaha ay joogaan. War 31-kii bishii August ka soo baxay Xarunta Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed ee Baydhabo ayaa garabka mucaaradka hubeysan ee Laftagareen loogu baaqay in wada hadal iyo is faham lagu dhameeyo wax kasta oo lagu kala aragti duwan yahay. Ciidamada mucaaradka ayaa Khamiistii oo 3-da September ku beegneyd weerar xoogan ku ekeeyay Magaalada Baydhabo, inkastoo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Maamulka Aadan Madoobe ay ka hortaggeen inay si qoto dheer isugu soo fidiyaan gudaha magaalada. Weerarkan ayaa loo fasirtay in Laftagareen, Saraakiisha iyo Siyaasiyiinta Koonfur Galbeed ee ku aragtida ah ay xalka u arkaan waddo aan wada hadal ahayn. Si kastaba ha-ahaatee cutubyada ciidamada ee loo wado Baydhabo ayuu qorshuhu yahay in kuwii horey fariisimaha ugu lahaa bannaanada magaalada ay iska kaashadaan hawlgal ay dagaalka uga fogeynayaan magaaladaasi.

items.title: Maxaa ka jira in dalalka deriska la ah Somaliland lagu war galiyay aqoonsiga Somaliland?
items.description: Tan iyo intii ay dawadda Somaliland aqoonsiga ka heshay dalka Israa’iil waxa soo kordhaaya rajada ay dalal kalena ku aqoonsan doonaan Somaliland taasi oo walked ku riday wadamada Somaliland la cadawga ah ee ay xulafadda yihiih dalka Masar sida Eritrea, Djibouti iyo dhowr dal Carbeed oo ay ka mid yihiin Qatar iyo Sucuudigu inkasta oo ay jiraan dalal badan oo gobolka ah oo iyagu taageersan in ay Somaliland ay aqoonsi buuxda ay hesho. Xiligani oo uu madaxweynaha Somaliland ku suganyahay dalka Maraykanka laguna wado in uu maanta ama bari la kulmo madaxweynaha dalka Maraykanka mudane Donald Trump ayaanay ilaa hada wax war ahi ka soo bixin xaga Maraykanka iyo Somaliland toona. Hase ahaatee warar ka soo baxaaya dalaka jaarka ayaa sheegaaya in dhamaan dalalka gobolka iyo ka baxsanba lagu war galiyay in dhawaan la aqoonsan doono. Ilaa hada ma jiraan wax war ah oo rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay dalalka jaarka marka laga reebo madaxweynaha Eritrea oo isagu sheegay in uu ka soo hor jeedo aqoonsiga uu Maraykanku uu siinaayo Somaliland ninkani oo kaligii talis ah oo dadkiisa iyo dalkiisaba baabiiyay xukunkana ku haysta xoog mudo 34 sano ah isla markaana aan saamayn badan ku lahayn gobolka gerska Africa waxana uu la mawqif yahay dalka Masar oo adeegsata. Dhanka kalena wasiirka maaliyada ee dalka Djibouti ayaa doraad hadal aan dawladiisa looga baran jeediyay isga oo sheegay in ay wada tashi ugu baaqayàan dadkiisa isaga oo sheegay in gobolka uu ku soo waajahantay isbedel dhaqaale iyo mid siyaasadeed. Sida ay doontaba ha noqotee Somaliland oo aqoonsi buuxa ka hesha wadamada caalmka waxa ay faa’iido ugu jirtaa dalaka caalmka iyo deriskaba waxana haboon in dalka Maraynkanu ay aqoonsadaan Somaliland taasi oo farxad galin doonta dad kor u dhaafaaya Lix milyan oo qof oo noqon doona dal xulafo la ah Maraykanka

items.title: Al-Shabaab iyo Xuuthiyiinta Yemen oo lagu warramay inay xoojinayaan iskaashi khatar ku ah amniga gobolka
items.description: Waxaa isa soo taraya walaaca laga qabo iskaashi la sheegay inuu ka dhexeeyo kooxda Al-Shabaab iyo kooxda Xuuthiyiinta Yemen, kaas oo la xiriira hub, dhaqaale, tababar ciidan iyo xogaha la xiriira dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta ee Gacanka Cadmeed. Warbixinno la daabacay ayaa tilmaamaya in labada dhinac, inkastoo ay kala duwan yihiin dhinacyada fikirka iyo caqiidada, ay yeesheen iskaashi ku dhisan dano militari iyo dhaqaale. Al-Shabaab ayaa lagu sheegay inay leedahay awood dhaqaale oo weyn, taas oo ay ka hesho canshuuraha ay ku qaaddo ganacsatada, gaadiidka iyo deegaannada ay saameynta ku leedahay, halka Xuuthiyiintuna ay khibrad u leeyihiin adeegsiga diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, gantaallada iyo weerarrada dhinaca badda. Sida warbixintu sheegtay, iskaashigan ayaa suuragal ka dhigi kara in Al-Shabaab hesho hub iyo tababarro casri ah, halka Xuuthiyiintuna ay ka heli karaan dhaqaale iyo marin ay ku ballaariyaan saameyntooda dhinaca xeebaha Soomaaliya. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale xustay in la sheegay in xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab loo diray Yemen si ay tababarro uga helaan deegaannada ay Xuuthiyiintu gacanta ku hayaan, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin adeegsiga diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo farsamooyin militari oo kale. Waxaa sidoo kale la sheegay in shabakado tahriib iyo ganacsi loo adeegsado gudbinta hubka iyo qalabka kale ee u kala goosha Yemen iyo Soomaaliya, iyadoo doomaha kalluumeysiga iyo maraakiibta yaryar loo adeegsan karo qaadista alaabaha si looga dhuunto hay’adaha ammaanka. Khubarada amniga ayaa ka digaya in haddii xiriirkan la xaqiijiyo oo uu sii xoogaysto, uu khatar weyn ku noqon karo amniga Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan marin-biyoodka Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas. Arrintan ayaa sidoo kale sare u qaadi karta khatarta ka dhalan karta weerarro lagu beegsado maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo ciidamada ka howlgala gobolka, maadaama Gacanka Cadmeed uu yahay mid ka mid ah marin-biyoodka ugu muhiimsan ee isku xira Afrika, Bariga Dhexe, Yurub iyo Aasiya. Warbixintu waxay tilmaamaysaa in la dagaallanka khatartan aysan ku koobnaan karin oo keliya howlgallada militari, balse loo baahan yahay in la xoojiyo ilaalinta xeebaha Soomaaliya, dabagalka dhaqaalaha, la socodka shirkadaha looga shakiyo inay ku lug leeyihiin shabakadaha hubka iyo xoojinta iskaashiga dhinaca sirdoonka ee dalalka gobolka. Haddii warbixinnadan ay sax noqdaan, xiriirka Al-Shabaab iyo Xuuthiyiinta wuxuu noqon karaa caqabad cusub oo amni oo isku xirta colaadaha Soomaaliya iyo Yemen, isla markaana saameyn ku yeelan karta amniga gobolka iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee mara Gacanka Cadmeed.

items.title: Xog: Nin loo xiray qaraxii ka dhacay guriga taliye SHUB
items.description: Doolow (Caasimada Online) – Wararka laga helayo gobolka Gedo ayaa sheegaya in maanta degmada Doolow lagu xiray nin aad ugu dhow taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta, Jeneraal Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan (Shub), kaas oo looga shakisan yahay inuu ku lug lahaa qaraxii maalmo ka hor ka dhacay gurigiisa. Eedeysanaha oo magaciisa lagu soo koobay Macalimeey aya xabsiga la dhigay, iyada oo haatan ay ku socdaan baaritaanno dheeraad ah, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo wareedyo xilkas ah. Macalimeey ayaa la sheegay in maalmihii ka horreeyay weerarka uu ku sugnaa Muqdisho, balse uu weerarka kadib ku laabtay Doolow, isaga oo dhaawaca taliyaha uu ku booqday isbitaalka. Saraakiisha gacanta ku haysa ninkan ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in tuhun loo soo xiray, isla markaana gacanta lagu hayo taleefannadiisa, si loo baaro dhaq-dhaqaaqyadiisii ugu dambeeyay iyo xogaha kale ee la xiriirta duruufaha ku xeernaa weerarka. Falka lagu beegsaday taliye Shub oo dhacay 3-dii September ayaa dhaliyay hadal-heyn xooggan, iyada oo walaac uu ka dhashay qaraxa lagu burburiyay gurigiisa, waxaana dhacdadan ay uga sii dartay xiisadda taagan ee ka dhalatay isbeddelkii dhawaan ka dhacay Koonfur Galbeed Soomaliya. Sidoo kale, weerarka ayaa dhaliyay cambaareyn loo jeediyay dowlado shisheeye, gaar ahaan Turkiga, kaddib markii xildhibaanno ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ay ku eedeeyeen in diyaaradaha dagaalka ee F-16 ay ka dambeeyeen duqeynta. Xildhibaannada ayaa shaaciyay eedeymahan iyaga oo aan soo bandhigin wax caddeyn ah oo si madax-bannaan u xaqiijinaysa in diyaaradaha F-16 ee Turkiga ay ku lug lahaayeen weerarka. “Waxaan ka walaacsanahay aadna u cambaareyneynaa isku daygii dil siyaasadeedka ahaa ee Jeneral Mahad Cabdiraxmaan gurigiisa Doolow lagu duqeeyay diyaaradaha Turkiga F-16, kaas oo ahaa weerar sharci darro ah oo amarkiisa uu bixiyay madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisa dhammaaday Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Xasan Cabdinuur oo akhriyay bayaan ay soo saareen xildhibaanno ku shiray magaalada caasimada ah ee Nairobi. Dhankeeda d owladda federaalka ayaa war-saxaafadeed soo saartay Jimcihii ku sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto dhacdada ka dhacday degmada Doolow, balse waxay si cad u sheegtay in aysan wax lug ah ku lahayn dhacdadaas. Waxay intaas ku dartay in xogaha hordhaca ah ee hay’adaha ammaanku heleen ay muujinayaan in qaraxyadu ka dhasheen waxyaabo qarxa oo lagu diyaarinayay guri, inkastoo baaritaan rasmi ah aan weli la soo gabagabeyn. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inay si degdeg ah u magacaabi doonto guddi xaqiiqo-raadin ah oo baaritaan madax-bannaan ku sameeya dhacdada. Sidoo kale, weerarka ayaa dhaliyay cambaareyn loo jeediyay dowlado shisheeye, gaar ahaan Turkiga, kaddib markii xildhibaanno ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ay ku eedeeyeen in diyaaradaha dagaalka ee F-16 ay ka dambeeyeen duqeynta. Xildhibaannada ayaa shaaciyay eedeymahan iyaga oo aan soo bandhigin wax caddeyn ah oo si madax-bannaan u xaqiijinaysa in diyaaradaha F-16 ee Turkiga ay ku lug lahaayeen weerarka. “Waxaan ka walaacsanahay aadna u cambaareyneynaa isku daygii dil siyaasadeedka ahaa ee Jeneral Mahad Cabdiraxmaan gurigiisa Doolow lagu duqeeyay diyaaradaha Turkiga F-16, kaas oo ahaa weerar sharci darro ah oo amarkiisa uu bixiyay madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisa dhammaaday Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Xasan Cabdinuur oo akhriyay bayaan ay soo saareen xildhibaanno ku shiray magaalada caasimada ah ee Nairobi. Dhankeeda d owladda federaalka ayaa war-saxaafadeed soo saartay Jimcihii ku sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto dhacdada ka dhacday degmada Doolow, balse waxay si cad u sheegtay in aysan wax lug ah ku lahayn dhacdadaas. Waxay intaas ku dartay in xogaha hordhaca ah ee hay’adaha ammaanku heleen ay muujinayaan in qaraxyadu ka dhasheen waxyaabo qarxa oo lagu diyaarinayay guri, inkastoo baaritaan rasmi ah aan weli la soo gabagabeyn. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inay si degdeg ah u magacaabi doonto guddi xaqiiqo-raadin ah oo baaritaan madax-bannaan ku sameeya dhacdada. items.title: Al-Shabaab oo 10 qof ku afduubtay gobolka Baay
items.description: Buurhakaba (Caasimada Online) – Wararka laga helayo gobolka Baay ayaa sheegaya in xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab ay deegaanka Raar oo qiyaastii 10 KM u jira degmada Buurhakaba ka afduubteen ku dhowaad 10 qof oo ka shaqeynayay hay’ad samafal. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, shaqaalaha ayaa xilliga la qafaashay ku guda jiray howlo gargaar oo ay ka wadeen deegaanka, waxaana la sheegay in kooxdii afduubatay ay si khasab ah goobta uga kaxaysteen. Shaqaalaha ayaa qeyb ka ahaa howlaha lagu gaarsiinayay carruurta adeegyada nafaqeynta iyo sidoo kale gargaar kale oo bani’aadamnimo oo loo waday dadka deegaanka. Wararka ayaa tilmaamaya in shaqaalahaasi ay si lama filaan ah gacanta ugu dhaceen xubnaha Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo sida xogaha la helayo sheegayaan u kaxeeyay dhanka deegaannada ay maamulaan. Degmada Buurhakaba ayaa ka mid ah goobaha muhiimka u ah howlaha bani’aadamnimo ee gobolka Baay, iyadoo hay’adaha samafalku ay halkaasi ku leeyihiin xarumo laga maamulo qaybinta iyo gaarsiinta gargaarka. Gargaarka laga soo abaabulo xarumaha ku yaalla degmada ayaa inta badan loo gudbiyaa tuulooyinka iyo deegaannada ku dhow Buurhakaba, kuwaas oo ay ku nool yihiin dad u baahan adeegyada bani’aadamnimo. Afduubka shaqaalaha ayaa walaac ku abuuri kara howlaha hay’adaha samafalka ee ka socda deegaannada Baay, maadaama amniga shaqaalaha iyo gaarsiinta gargaarku ay muhiim u yihiin sii wadista adeegyada loo fidiyo bulshada. Ilaa hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay maamulka degmada Buurhakaba, saraakiisha amniga ama hay’addii ay u shaqeynayeen dadka la afduubtay oo la xiriira dhacdadan. Sidoo kale, lama hayo faah-faahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan xaaladda shaqaalaha la qafaashay iyo halka ay kooxdu u kaxaysay. Hase yeeshee, wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in loo gudbiyay deegaannada ay Al-Shabaab ka maamusho gobolka Baay. items.title: Masar oo dalab dhib badan oo deg deg ah hordhigtay DF
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Masar ayaa Soomaaliya ka dalbatay inay xoojiso dadaallada lagu soo deynayo siddeed badmaax oo u dhashay Masar, kuwaas oo muddo bilo ah lagu haysto markab ku sugan xeebaha Soomaaliya. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Masar Badr Abdelatty ayaa arrintan kala hadlay dhiggiisa Soomaaliya Cabdisalaam Cabdi Cali, xilli ay Isniintii ku kulmeen Qaahira, halkaas oo ay uga qeyb-galayeen shir heer wasiir ah oo Golaha Jaamacadda Carabta ah. Abdelatty ayaa ku booriyay dowladda Soomaaliya inay sii waddo la macaamilka dhinacyada ku lugta leh arrinta, isla markaana ay qaaddo tallaabooyin lagu xaqiijinayo badqabka iyo sii-deynta badmaaxiinta Masaarida. Siddeedda badmaax ayaa lagu hayaa markabka MT Eureka, oo la afduubtay horaantii sanadkan, kadibna loo kaxeeyay dhinaca biyaha Soomaaliya. Masar ayaa bilihii lasoo dhaafay waday dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo ay kula xiriireyso mas’uuliyiinta Soomaaliya iyo Yemen, iyo sidoo kale milkiilaha markabka, si xal loogu helo xaaladda badmaaxiinta. Wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Masar ayaa toddobaadkii hore sheegtay inay waddo xiriirro xooggan oo lala leeyahay mas’uuliyiinta ay khuseyso ee Soomaaliya iyo Yemen, iyadoo ujeedadu tahay in badmaaxiinta sida ugu dhaqsaha badan loo sii daayo. Qaahira ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inay muhiimad gaar ah siineyso badqabka badmaaxiinta iyo in loo xaqiijiyo xaalado nololeed oo ku filan inta laga gaarayo soo laabashadooda dalkooda. Kulanka labada wasiir kuma koobneyn oo keliya arrinta badmaaxiinta, waxaana Abdelatty uu mar kale xaqiijiyay taageerada Masar ee midnimada, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Wuxuu sheegay in Qaahira ay kasoo horjeeddo tallaabo kasta oo hal dhinac ah oo wax u dhimi karta madax-bannaanida ama midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Masar ayaa sidoo kale ballanqaadday inay sii wadeyso taageerada dadaallada lagu dhisayo hay’adaha dowladda Soomaaliya iyo kor u qaadista awooddooda. Abdelatty ayaa dhinaca kale carrabka ku adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in beesha caalamka laga helo maalgelin joogto ah oo lagu taageero howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya ee AUSSOM, oo Masar ay qeyb ka tahay. Soomaaliya iyo Masar ayaa sanadihii dambe xoojiyay xiriirkooda siyaasadeed iyo amni, iyadoo Qaahira ay kordhisay taageerada ay siiso dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Labada wasiir ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay sidii loo sii ballaarin lahaa iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee labada dal, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, horumarinta iyo maalgashiga. The post Masar oo dalab dhib badan oo deg deg ah hordhigtay DF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Afrika oo Wajahaysa Caqabad Cusub oo Amni
items.description: Hoos u Dhaca Maalgelinta Caalamiga ah oo Afrika Ku Riixaya Inay Dib u Qaabayso Hawlgallada Nabadda Hoos u dhaca maalgelinta caalamiga ah iyo tirada ciidamada nabad ilaalinta ayaa Afrika ku qasbaya inay dib uga fikirto sida ay uga jawaabto colaadaha iyo kooxaha hubeysan, iyadoo khubaradu ka digayaan in nidaamka caalamiga ah ee maaraynta khilaafaadka uu sii daciifayo. Warbixin ay bishii May 2026 soo saartay Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI) ayaa muujisay in tirada shaqaalaha ka qaybgalaya hawlgallada nabadda ee dhinacyada badan ay dhammaadkii 2025 gaartay 78,633 qof . Taasi waxay 49% ka yar tahay heerkii 2016, waana tiradii ugu hooseysay ugu yaraan 25 sano. Sannadkii 2025 oo keliya tiradu waxay hoos u dhacday 17%. SIPRI waxay sheegtay in hoos u dhaca uu ka dhashay isku-darka cadaadis siyaasadeed, isbeddellada juqraafi-siyaasadeed iyo dhibaatooyin dhaqaale. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale tilmaantay in dhibaatada lacagta ee Qaramada Midoobay, oo ay qayb ka yihiin tabarucaad dib u dhacay ama aan la bixin, ay door weyn ku lahayd dhimista ciidamada hawlgallada nabadda. Jaïr van der Lijn, oo ah agaasimaha Barnaamijka Hawlgallada Nabadda iyo Maareynta Khilaafaadka ee SIPRI, ayaa ka digay in haddii xaaladdu sidan ku sii socoto ay wiiqi karto awoodda hay’adaha dhinacyada badan sida Qaramada Midoobay ee wax looga qabto colaadaha. Afrika oo wajahaysa culays gaar ah Saamaynta isbeddelkan ayaa si gaar ah uga muuqata Afrika. SIPRI waxay sheegtay in Afrika ka hooseysa Saxaraha ay martigelisay 70% shaqaalaha hawlgallada nabadda ee caalamka intii lagu jiray 2025, iyadoo gobolkaas uu sidoo kale ahaa meesha ugu weyn ee dhimista shaqaalaha. Marka laga hadlayo Midowga Afrika, caqabadda ugu weyn waxay tahay in hawlgalladiisu aysan lahayn nidaam maalgelin oo joogto ah oo la mid ah kan Qaramada Midoobay. AU waxay muddo dhisaysay Peace Fund , oo loogu talagalay in qaaradda ay yeelato awood dhaqaale oo ay si madax-bannaan ugu maalgeliso dadaallada nabadda iyo amniga. Hase yeeshee, xogta rasmiga ah ee Midowga Afrika waxay muujinaysaa in xaaladda Sanduuqa Nabadda ay hadda ka xoog badan tahay sidii hore. Bishii Febraayo 2026, sanduuqu wuxuu haystay in ka badan $400 milyan , waxaana muddo laba sano iyo bar ah laga bixiyay qiyaastii $39 milyan si loo taageero hawlgallo iyo dadaallo la xiriira nabadda iyo amniga. AU waxay sidoo kale ka shaqaynaysaa in bartilmaameedka maalgelinta sanduuqa loo kordhiyo ilaa $1 bilyan . Sidaas darteed, sawirka maaliyadeed ma aha mid keliya oo muujinaya in AU aysan haysan dhaqaale. Caqabadda weyn ayaa ah in lacagta la heli karo loo beddelo maalgelin joogto ah, la saadaalin karo oo si degdeg ah loogu adeegsan karo hawlgallada. Soomaaliya iyo casharka hawlgallada amniga Dooddan waxay si toos ah u khusaysaa Soomaaliya, oo weli ku tiirsan taageero caalami ah iyo mid Afrikaan ah oo lagu wajahayo Al-Shabaab. Ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya waxay hadda ku shaqeeyaan qaab cusub oo loogu talagalay in masuuliyadda amniga si tartiib ah loogu wareejiyo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Isbeddelkaas wuxuu dhacayaa xilli maalgelinta hawlgallada nabadda ay caalamka ka sii adkaanayso. SIPRI waxay sheegtay in hoos u dhaca shaqaalaha hawlgallada nabadda uu si gaar ah u saameeyay hawlgallada Afrika. Taasi waxay kordhin kartaa cadaadiska lagu saarayo dowladaha Afrika inay iyagu qaataan qayb weyn oo ka mid ah kharashaadka iyo masuuliyadda amniga. Xal militari oo keliya ma filna Khubarada qaar waxay ku doodaan in dhibaatadu aysan ku koobnayn lacag ama tirada askarta. Amani Africa, oo ah hay’ad cilmi-baaris oo fadhigeedu yahay Addis Ababa, ayaa Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee Midowga Afrika bishii Abriil 2026 ku adkaysay in colaadaha qaaradda ay sii adkaanayaan, ayna inta badan ku xiran yihiin loollan siyaasadeed, dhibaatooyin maamul iyo xaalado dhaqaale iyo bulsho. Hay’addu waxay sidaas darteed ku baaqday in jawaabaha amni aan lagu koobin hawlgallo militari, balse lala tacaalo sababaha siyaasadeed iyo bulsho ee abuura rabshadaha. Kulankaas wuxuu ahaa shirkii 1,341aad ee Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee AU, oo diiradda lagu saaray hawlgallada taageerada nabadda. El-Ghassim Wane, oo hore u ahaa Kaaliyaha Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee hawlgallada nabadda, ayaa sheegay in dowladaha xubnaha ka ah AU ay ku adkaatay inay helaan dhaqaale ku filan oo lagu sii wado hawlgallo waaweyn. Sida uu qabo, AU waa inay mudnaanta siisaa hawlgallo yaryar, bartilmaameed leh oo waqti cayiman leh, kuwaas oo waafaqsan awoodda dhaqaale ee hadda jirta. Afrikaanimo badan, balse dhaqaale joogto ah ayaa loo baahan yahay Doodda sii xoogeysanaysa ayaa ah in Afrika ay u baahan tahay inay si weyn u qaadato masuuliyadda amnigeeda. Laakiin taas waxaa barbar socda su’aal muhiim ah: yaa bixinaya kharashka? Midowga Afrika ayaa sanadihii u dambeeyay isku dayay inuu arrintan wax ka beddelo. Bishii Agoosto 2026, Guddiga Maamulka Peace Fund wuxuu sii ambaqaaday qorshayaal lagu xoojinayo joogtaynta dhaqaale, maamulka iyo isla xisaabtanka sanduuqa. AU waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Peace Fund uu yahay tiir muhiim u ah qaab-dhismeedka nabadda iyo amniga Afrika, isla markaana uu taageero ka geysan karo ka hortagga colaadaha, dhexdhexaadinta iyo hawlgallada taageerada nabadda. Laakiin hoos u dhaca taageerada caalamiga ah wuxuu ka dhigan yahay in Afrika ay wajahayso doorasho adag: inay kordhiso maalgelinta gudaha iyo awoodda hay’adaha qaaradda, ama ay aqbasho in hawlgallada amni ay sii yaraadaan oo dalal gaar ahi ay si toos ah ama kooxo yar-yar ugu tiirsanaadaan iskaashi laba-geesood ah. SIPRI waxay ka digtay in isbeddelkaas uu horseedi karo in xalalka colaadaha ay sii noqdaan kuwo kala daadsan oo militariga ku tiirsan. Hase yeeshee, cilmi-baare Claudia Pfeifer Cruz ayaa ku adkaysatay in burburka iskaashiga dhinacyada badan uusan ahayn wax lama huraan ah. Waxa loo baahan yahay, sida ay qabaan khubaradu, ma aha oo keliya in dalalku taageeraan fikradda hawlgallada nabadda, balse inay bixiyaan maalgelin la saadaalin karo iyo meel siyaasadeed oo u oggolaanaysa hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo kuwa Afrika inay si wax ku ool ah uga jawaabaan colaadaha . Mustaqbalka hawlgallada nabadda Afrika ayaa sidaas darteed ku xirnaan doona laba arrimood oo isku xiran: awoodda qaaraddu u leedahay inay maalgeliso amnigeeda iyo awoodda dowladaha Afrika u leeyihiin inay wax ka qabtaan sababaha siyaasadeed, dhaqaale iyo maamul ee colaadaha. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale tilmaantay in dhibaatada lacagta ee Qaramada Midoobay, oo ay qayb ka yihiin tabarucaad dib u dhacay ama aan la bixin, ay door weyn ku lahayd dhimista ciidamada hawlgallada nabadda. Jaïr van der Lijn, oo ah agaasimaha Barnaamijka Hawlgallada Nabadda iyo Maareynta Khilaafaadka ee SIPRI, ayaa ka digay in haddii xaaladdu sidan ku sii socoto ay wiiqi karto awoodda hay’adaha dhinacyada badan sida Qaramada Midoobay ee wax looga qabto colaadaha. Afrika oo wajahaysa culays gaar ah Saamaynta isbeddelkan ayaa si gaar ah uga muuqata Afrika. SIPRI waxay sheegtay in Afrika ka hooseysa Saxaraha ay martigelisay 70% shaqaalaha hawlgallada nabadda ee caalamka intii lagu jiray 2025, iyadoo gobolkaas uu sidoo kale ahaa meesha ugu weyn ee dhimista shaqaalaha. Marka laga hadlayo Midowga Afrika, caqabadda ugu weyn waxay tahay in hawlgalladiisu aysan lahayn nidaam maalgelin oo joogto ah oo la mid ah kan Qaramada Midoobay. AU waxay muddo dhisaysay Peace Fund , oo loogu talagalay in qaaradda ay yeelato awood dhaqaale oo ay si madax-bannaan ugu maalgeliso dadaallada nabadda iyo amniga. Hase yeeshee, xogta rasmiga ah ee Midowga Afrika waxay muujinaysaa in xaaladda Sanduuqa Nabadda ay hadda ka xoog badan tahay sidii hore. Bishii Febraayo 2026, sanduuqu wuxuu haystay in ka badan $400 milyan , waxaana muddo laba sano iyo bar ah laga bixiyay qiyaastii $39 milyan si loo taageero hawlgallo iyo dadaallo la xiriira nabadda iyo amniga. AU waxay sidoo kale ka shaqaynaysaa in bartilmaameedka maalgelinta sanduuqa loo kordhiyo ilaa $1 bilyan . Sidaas darteed, sawirka maaliyadeed ma aha mid keliya oo muujinaya in AU aysan haysan dhaqaale. Caqabadda weyn ayaa ah in lacagta la heli karo loo beddelo maalgelin joogto ah, la saadaalin karo oo si degdeg ah loogu adeegsan karo hawlgallada. Soomaaliya iyo casharka hawlgallada amniga Dooddan waxay si toos ah u khusaysaa Soomaaliya, oo weli ku tiirsan taageero caalami ah iyo mid Afrikaan ah oo lagu wajahayo Al-Shabaab. Ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya waxay hadda ku shaqeeyaan qaab cusub oo loogu talagalay in masuuliyadda amniga si tartiib ah loogu wareejiyo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Isbeddelkaas wuxuu dhacayaa xilli maalgelinta hawlgallada nabadda ay caalamka ka sii adkaanayso. SIPRI waxay sheegtay in hoos u dhaca shaqaalaha hawlgallada nabadda uu si gaar ah u saameeyay hawlgallada Afrika. Taasi waxay kordhin kartaa cadaadiska lagu saarayo dowladaha Afrika inay iyagu qaataan qayb weyn oo ka mid ah kharashaadka iyo masuuliyadda amniga. Xal militari oo keliya ma filna Khubarada qaar waxay ku doodaan in dhibaatadu aysan ku koobnayn lacag ama tirada askarta. Amani Africa, oo ah hay’ad cilmi-baaris oo fadhigeedu yahay Addis Ababa, ayaa Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee Midowga Afrika bishii Abriil 2026 ku adkaysay in colaadaha qaaradda ay sii adkaanayaan, ayna inta badan ku xiran yihiin loollan siyaasadeed, dhibaatooyin maamul iyo xaalado dhaqaale iyo bulsho. Hay’addu waxay sidaas darteed ku baaqday in jawaabaha amni aan lagu koobin hawlgallo militari, balse lala tacaalo sababaha siyaasadeed iyo bulsho ee abuura rabshadaha. Kulankaas wuxuu ahaa shirkii 1,341aad ee Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee AU, oo diiradda lagu saaray hawlgallada taageerada nabadda. El-Ghassim Wane, oo hore u ahaa Kaaliyaha Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee hawlgallada nabadda, ayaa sheegay in dowladaha xubnaha ka ah AU ay ku adkaatay inay helaan dhaqaale ku filan oo lagu sii wado hawlgallo waaweyn. Sida uu qabo, AU waa inay mudnaanta siisaa hawlgallo yaryar, bartilmaameed leh oo waqti cayiman leh, kuwaas oo waafaqsan awoodda dhaqaale ee hadda jirta. Afrikaanimo badan, balse dhaqaale joogto ah ayaa loo baahan yahay Doodda sii xoogeysanaysa ayaa ah in Afrika ay u baahan tahay inay si weyn u qaadato masuuliyadda amnigeeda. Laakiin taas waxaa barbar socda su’aal muhiim ah: yaa bixinaya kharashka? Midowga Afrika ayaa sanadihii u dambeeyay isku dayay inuu arrintan wax ka beddelo. Bishii Agoosto 2026, Guddiga Maamulka Peace Fund wuxuu sii ambaqaaday qorshayaal lagu xoojinayo joogtaynta dhaqaale, maamulka iyo isla xisaabtanka sanduuqa. AU waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Peace Fund uu yahay tiir muhiim u ah qaab-dhismeedka nabadda iyo amniga Afrika, isla markaana uu taageero ka geysan karo ka hortagga colaadaha, dhexdhexaadinta iyo hawlgallada taageerada nabadda. Laakiin hoos u dhaca taageerada caalamiga ah wuxuu ka dhigan yahay in Afrika ay wajahayso doorasho adag: inay kordhiso maalgelinta gudaha iyo awoodda hay’adaha qaaradda, ama ay aqbasho in hawlgallada amni ay sii yaraadaan oo dalal gaar ahi ay si toos ah ama kooxo yar-yar ugu tiirsanaadaan iskaashi laba-geesood ah. SIPRI waxay ka digtay in isbeddelkaas uu horseedi karo in xalalka colaadaha ay sii noqdaan kuwo kala daadsan oo militariga ku tiirsan. Hase yeeshee, cilmi-baare Claudia Pfeifer Cruz ayaa ku adkaysatay in burburka iskaashiga dhinacyada badan uusan ahayn wax lama huraan ah. Waxa loo baahan yahay, sida ay qabaan khubaradu, ma aha oo keliya in dalalku taageeraan fikradda hawlgallada nabadda, balse inay bixiyaan maalgelin la saadaalin karo iyo meel siyaasadeed oo u oggolaanaysa hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo kuwa Afrika inay si wax ku ool ah uga jawaabaan colaadaha . Mustaqbalka hawlgallada nabadda Afrika ayaa sidaas darteed ku xirnaan doona laba arrimood oo isku xiran: awoodda qaaraddu u leedahay inay maalgeliso amnigeeda iyo awoodda dowladaha Afrika u leeyihiin inay wax ka qabtaan sababaha siyaasadeed, dhaqaale iyo maamul ee colaadaha. items.title: Switzerland oo billowday tarxiilka Soomaalida kadib arrin ay sameysay DF
items.description: Zurich (Caasimada Online) – Hay’ad u dooda xuquuqda aadanaha oo fadhigeedu yahay dalka Switzerland ayaa ugu baaqday dowladda dalkaas inay joojiso qorshe lagu masaafurinayo nin Soomaali ah oo qaba dhaawacyo culus, xilli uu weli sugayo daaweyn caafimaad. Hay’adda Augenauf ee magaalada Zurich ayaa sheegtay in ninkan lagu wado in Khamiista, 10-ka September, si khasab ah loogu celiyo magaalada Muqdisho, isaga oo sii maraya Istanbul, inkastoo dhawaan qalliin loogu sameeyay Isbitaalka Jaamacadda Zurich. Sida ay hay’addu sheegtay, ninkan ayaa ku dhaawacmay weerar ay ku qaadeen laba qof oo ay wada degganaayeen xarun dhulka hoostiisa ah oo lagu hayo magangelyo-doonka, halkaas oo ay dejiyeen mas’uuliyiinta Switzerland. Weerarka ayaa la sheegay inuu sababay jab badan oo ka soo gaaray madaxa, dhaawac maskaxda ah iyo dhaawacyo indhaha ah. Augenauf waxay sheegtay in ninkan loo qorsheeyay laba qalliin oo kale toddobaadkan, balse mas’uuliyiinta Switzerland ay ka hor istaageen in qalliinnadaasi dhacaan sababo la xiriira qorshaha masaafurinta. Hay’addu ma aysan faahfaahin sababta sharci ee ninkan looga saarayo Switzerland iyo xaaladda rasmiga ah ee codsigiisa magangelyo. Qareenkiisa ayaa dalbaday in la hakiyo masaafurinta. Ninkan ayaa la sheegay inuu Switzerland ku noolaa muddo 11 sano ah, isla markaana uu leeyahay saddex carruur ah oo ku nool dalal kale oo Yurub ah. Kiiskan ayaa sidoo kale taabanaya Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda Soomaaliya, oo ninkan siisay dokumenti safar oo ku-meel-gaar ah, loona yaqaan laissez-passer , kaas oo suuragelinaya in dib loogu celiyo Soomaaliya. Augenauf ayaa ku eedeysay hay’adda socdaalka Soomaaliya inay dukumentiga bixisay iyada oo aan tixgelin xaaladdiisa caafimaad. Waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in sawirka ku yaalla dokumentiga safarka uusan si wanaagsan ugu ekaan ninka la masaafurinayo. Mas’uuliyiinta socdaalka Switzerland ayaa awood u leh inay dalalka ay dadkaasi u dhasheen ka codsadaan dokumenti safar oo ku-meel-gaar ah marka qofka la masaafurinayo uusan haysan baasaboorka ama dukumenti safar oo la aqoonsan yahay. Walaac laga qabo xaaladda caafimaad Kiiskan ayaa soo baxay xilli ay sii kordhayaan su’aalaha laga qabo habka Switzerland u maareyso dadka si khasab ah looga saarayo dalka, gaar ahaan kuwa qaba xaalado caafimaad oo daran. Bishii July, Guddiga Qaranka Switzerland ee Ka-hortagga Jirdilka ayaa dalbaday in wax laga beddelo habka loo qiimeeyo caafimaadka dadka lagu masaafurinayo diyaaradaha, si loo hubiyo inay awoodaan safarka. Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyay qaabka dadka loo xiro ama loo xakameeyo inta lagu jiro masaafurinta, daawooyinka la siiyo iyo sida loo xaqiijiyo inay helaan daryeel caafimaad marka ay gaaraan dalka loo celiyay. Warbixinta guddiga ayaa si gaar ah diiradda u saartay dadka qaba xanuunnada dhimirka, balse waxay sidoo kale ka hadashay ilaalinta caafimaad ee guud ee dadka si khasab ah loo masaafurinayo. Mas’uuliyiinta Switzerland ayaa dhankooda sheegaya in dadka si khasab ah looga saaro dalka ay yihiin tiro yar marka loo eego dadka lagu amro inay baxaan, isla markaana gargaar caafimaad la diyaarin karo haddii loo baahdo. Augenauf ayaa sheegtay in laba qof oo kale oo Soomaali ah ay horay dacwado uga gudbiyeen qaabkii loo fuliyay masaafurintooda, iyadoo qareenno iyo hay’ado xuquuqda aadanaha ahi ku doodeen in kiisaskaasi ay ku jireen xadgudubyo culus oo ka dhan ah sharciga Switzerland iyo kan caalamiga ah. Hay’addu waxay ku eedeysay mas’uuliyiinta inay “halis weyn geliyeen nolosha dadka ay arrintani saameysay”, iyadoo sheegtay inay arrimahaasi gaarsiisay booliska gobolka Zurich iyo Guddiga Qaranka ee Ka-hortagga Jirdilka. Waxay sidoo kale ugu baaqday dowladda Soomaaliya inay farageliso kiiskan oo aysan aqbalin dib-u-celinta dadka qaba dhaawacyo ama xaalado caafimaad oo halis ah. Cadaadiska dib-u-celinta Soomaalida Murankan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dowladaha Yurub ay kordhinayaan cadaadiska ay saarayaan Soomaaliya si ay ula shaqeyso dalalka doonaya inay dib u celiyaan muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee lagu amray inay ka baxaan dalalkooda. Midowga Yurub ayaa bishii June adkeeyay shuruudaha fiisaha ee muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed, kadib markii uu sheegay in Soomaaliya aysan si ku filan ula shaqeyn hannaanka dib-u-celinta muwaadiniinteeda. Midowga Yurub ayaa Soomaaliya ka dalbaday inay fududeyso xaqiijinta aqoonsiga muwaadiniinta, bixinta dokumentiyada safarka ee degdegga ah iyo fulinta dib-u-celinta dadka, haddii ay tahay mid ikhtiyaari ah ama khasab ah. Tallaabooyinkaasi waxay yareeyeen fiisooyinka gelitaanka badan, waxayna muddada caadiga ah ee baaritaanka codsiyada fiisaha ka dhigeen 45 maalmood halkii ay markii hore ka ahayd 15 maalmood. Switzerland, oo ka tirsan aagga Schengen balse aan xubin ka ahayn Midowga Yurub, ayaa 12-kii August dhaqan-gelisay xayiraadahaasi. Dowladda Switzerland waxay sheegtay in tallaabooyinkaas looga gol leeyahay in Soomaaliya lagu cadaadiyo inay sare u qaaddo wada-shaqeynta ku saabsan dib-u-celinta muwaadiniinteeda. Dhammaadkii bishii June, 57 muwaadin oo Soomaali ah oo ku sugnaa Switzerland ayaa la sheegay inay haysteen amarro rasmi ah oo looga dalbanayo inay dalka ka baxaan. Sanadkii hore, wakiillo ka socday Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda Soomaaliya ayaa booqday Switzerland, xilli labada dal ay kordhinayeen iskaashiga dhinaca socdaalka iyo dib-u-celinta dadka. Switzerland ayaa sidoo kale Soomaaliya siisay taageero la xiriirta qalabka lagu hubiyo baasaboorrada iyo tababarro la siinayo shaqaalaha socdaalka. Augenauf waxay siyaasadda Switzerland ku tilmaantay mid isku dhafaysa “abaalmarin iyo cadaadis”, iyadoo Bern dhinac ka taageereyso hay’adaha Soomaaliya, dhinaca kalena adkeyneysa tallaabooyinka la xiriira fiisaha iyo dib-u-celinta. Qorshaha lagu doonayo in 10-ka September lagu masaafuriyo ninkan dhaawaca culus qaba ayaa hadda dib u soo celiyay doodda ku saabsan sida loo fuliyo masaafurinta khasabka ah iyo kaalinta dowladda Soomaaliya marka qofka la celinayo uu wajahayo xaalad caafimaad oo halis ah. items.title: Garabka Laftagareen oo si toos ah ugu hanjabay Wariyeyaasha
items.description: Xasan Cabdiqaadir Maxamed, Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ku hanjabay inay la xisaamtami doonaan kuwa uu sheegay inay beenta ka sheegayaan Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed. Xasan Cabdiqaadir oo ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta deegaanka ee ku aragtida ah Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa sheegaya inaanu jiri doonin qof la dhaafi doono, haddii ay noqoto askariga la dagaalamaya ciidanka taabacsan Laftagareen iyo kan qalabka Warbaahinta ka taageeraya. “Dadka warxumo tashiilka ee Koonfur Galbeed oo idaacadaha inuu been ka sheego rabo ee leh hebel ayaa la dilay, hebel ayaa diyaarad lagu duqeeyay, hebelaa la weeraray iyo hebelaa ku dhaawacmay, waxaan leenahay waan is arki doonnaa.” Ayuu yiri Xasan Cabdiqaadir oo soo duubay muuqaal uu kaga hadlayo arrintan. Xasan Cabdiqaadir ayaa ku goodiyay in si isku mid ah ay ula dagaaami doonaan askariga u shaqeeya sida uu yiri Salbalaar iyo kan dacaayadda ka fidinaya Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ee ka goostay maamulka ee ku sugan duleedka Baydhabo. “Wixii hadda ka dambeeyo nin la dhaafayo ma jiro. Kan qoriga nagu la dagaalamayo ee Salbalaar u shaqeeyo iyo kan borbagaandada fidinaayo ee ciidanka beenta ka sheegayo ee Shabaab waaye leh ciidankii Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed uu garanaayay ee nooc kale ka dhigayo, waan la xisaabtami doonnaa.” Ayuu yiri Xasan Cabdiqaadir. Hadalka Xasan Cabdiqaadir waa mid dhiilo leh oo muujinaya, sida mucaaradka uu Laftagareen hoggaamiyo uu uga soo horjeedo in lala xiriiriyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Wariyeyaasha Baydhabo ayaa wajahaya cadaadisyo iyo hanjabaado isku dhufan oo uga imanaya dhinacyada isku haya awoodda maamulka. Xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo amni ee ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa gaaray heerkii ugu sarreyay, taas oo keentay in dhinacyada uu loolan u dhexeeyo ay fara-geliyaan shaqada Warbaahinta.

items.title: Somalia: Bashir Mohamed Abdullahi shot twice in the back, impunity for violence against journalists must end
items.description: Journalist Bashir Mohamed Abdullahi, who worked for Alraadi Media Network, died on 7 September, four days after being seriously wounded by gunfire in Baidoa, a city in southwestern Somalia, as rival forces clashed in his neighbourhood. The journalist, who was on his way to his newsroom, was intercepted by armed, masked men in uniform before being shot twice in the back. Reporters Without Borders (RSF) calls on the Somali authorities to immediately establish the circumstances surrounding the attack, identify those responsible and bring them to justice. He was only 23 years old. Journalist Bashir Mohamed Abdullahi was on his way to work on 3 September, passing through the Al-Ahmaar neighbourhood of Baidoa, where violent clashes were taking place between government forces and militias. He was stopped and questioned by unidentified men who were masked and armed who were not among the warring parties. They then shot him twice in the back, leaving him seriously wounded, according to information gathered by the National Union of Somali Journalists (NUSOJ) from local journalists. Bashir Mohamed Abdullahi was taken to Baidoa’s Bay General Hospital, where he received initial treatment. His condition suddenly deteriorated while arrangements were being considered to transfer him to Mogadishu for specialised medical care, NUSOJ said. He died on Monday, 7 September. Bashir Mohamed Abdullahi had worked for Alraadi Media Network from Baidoa for three years, covering general news as well as sports. Aweis Bashir Abdirahman, the media group’s director for the South West State, told RSF that “Bashir was a dynamic and visionary young journalist.” He added, “His murder will not stop journalists from doing their work,” calling on the South West State authorities to arrest those responsible for the attack and bring them to justice. “The death of Bashir Mohamed Abdullahi is yet another tragedy for Somali journalism. The precise circumstances in which this young journalist was targeted must be established, and those responsible for the attack must be held accountable. The Somali authorities must do everything in their power to ensure this case does not go unpunished. Press freedom cannot be guaranteed if journalists can be targeted with impunity.” The National Union of Somali Journalists (NUSOJ) also condemned the journalist’s death, saying that “ Bashir was a young journalist with a promising future, and that future was stolen from him.” Alraadi Media Network describes itself as Somalia’s first media network broadcasting in Maay, one of the country’s main languages. The network includes a radio station, a television channel and a research institute, the Arlaadi Institute for Policy Studies. In Somalia, journalists regularly face attacks , including arrests, harassment, assaults and threats, as the overall environment is highly insecure. Since 2021, RSF has recorded five cases of journalists killed in the country in connection with their work. Somalia ranks 126th out of 180 countries and territories in the 2026 RSF World Press Freedom Index . RSF.org

items.title: Cabdifitaax Qaasim oo weerar ku qaaday dowladdii Farmaajo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Warfaafinta Xukuumadda Soomaaliya Cabdifitaax Qaasim oo maanta la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa weerar afka ah ku qaaday dowladdii hore ee madaxweynihii hore ee Maxamed Cabdullahi Farmaajo, isaga oo dayactirka ay ku sameysay Tiyaatarka Qaranka ku tilmaamay make-up, isla markaana uu tirtirmay, sida uu hadalka u dhiga. Cabdifitaax Qaasim ayaa sheegay in xaaladda Tiyaatarka aysan wanaagsaneyn, balse ay si deg-deg ah dib ugu dhisi doonto xukuumadda Dan-Qaran. “Halkan waa meel aad iyo aad u burbursan, sababtana waxaa weeye meeshaan waxaa lagu sameeyay dayactir make-up ah oo si sax ah looma smeynin,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Cabdifitaax Qaasim. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay in Tiyaatarka uu yahay meel muhiim u ah dhaqanka, fanka iyo wacyigelinta bulshada, ayna ku dadaalayaan sidii loo qurxin lahaa. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in xukuumadda Soomaaliya ay hadda qorsheyneyso in muddo kooban gudaheed dib loogu dhiso xarunta Tiyaatarka Qaranka, isaga oo xusay in hawsha dib-u-dhiska la doonayo in la bilaabo, lana soo gabagabeeyo bishaan September illaa bisha October ee sanadkan 2026. “Xukuumadd DanQaran iyadoo shaqadeeda ay tahay dhisidda hay’adaha dowliga ah ayaa bishan September gudaheeda waxaan dhisi doonaa xarunta goaha murtida iyo wacyigelinta oo aad arki doontaan isaga oo muuqaal ka qurux badan ka hadda uu yahay,” ayuu sii raaciyay Wasiirka Warfaafinta. Ugu dambeyn wuxuu hoosta ka xariiqay in ujeeddada xukuumadda aysan ahayn oo keliya in la dayactiro dhismaha, balse ay doonayso in Tiyaatarka loo sameeyo muuqaal iyo adeegyo ka wanaagsan kuwii hore, si uu mar kale uu kaalin muhiim ah uga qaato fanka, dhaqanka iyo Tiyaatarka Qaranka ayaa muddo dheer ahaa mid ka mid ah goobaha ugu muhiimsan ee lagu soo bandhigo fanka, suugaanta, riwaayadaha iyo dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed, waxaana xaruntan ay door weyn ku leedahay wacyigelinta bulshada iyo kobcinta hal-abuurka. Dib-u-dhiska xarunta ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay sheegtay inay xoogga saarayso dib-u-dhiska hay’adaha iyo goobaha muhiimka u ah qaranka, gaar ahaan kuwa dowliga ah, si loogu adeego bulshada Soomaaliyeed. The post Cabdifitaax Qaasim oo weerar ku qaaday dowladdii Farmaajo appeared first on Caasimada Online .
