items.title: Burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya oo Dib u Soo Laabatay: Khatar Cusub
items.description: Burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya oo Dib u Soo Labanaysa, Khatar Cusubna ku Haysa Maraakiibta Gobolka Burcad-badeedda ka hawlgasha xeebaha Soomaaliya ayaa 2026 si weyn u kordhisay weerarrada iyo afduubyada maraakiibta, iyadoo dhacdooyinka cusub ay gaareen heerkii ugu sarreeyay muddo ka badan toban sano. Tan iyo dhammaadkii Abriil, ugu yaraan siddeed markab ayaa lagu afduubtay weerarro loo aaneynayo kooxaha burcad-badeedda Soomaalida. Mid ka mid ah dhacdooyinkii ugu dambeeyay wuxuu dhacay 17 Agoosto 2026 , markaas oo siddeed nin oo hubeysan ay qabsadeen markabka xamuulka ee MV LUTUF , oo ku safrayay calanka Cameroon, meel qiyaastii afar mayl-badeed u jirta xeebta Mareeyo ee Puntland. Digniinta UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) ayaa xaqiijisay in rag hubeysan ay markabka fuuleen oo ay gacanta ku dhigeen. Markabka ayaa la sheegay inuu siday qalab militari iyo isgaarsiineed oo ku socday xarun tababar militari oo Türkiye ku leedahay Muqdisho. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa 29 Agoosto sheegtay in ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye ay markabka dib ula wareegeen kadib hawlgal socday 10 maalmood. Wasaaradda Difaaca Soomaaliya waxay sheegtay in afar doon oo ay burcaddu adeegsanayeen la burburiyay, halka 14 burcad ah la dilay. Tirada dhimashadaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Dhacdadan ayaa timid xilli ay burcad-badeeddu horey u afduubteen maraakiib kale oo waaweyn. Bishii Abriil waxaa la qabsaday MT HONOUR 25 iyo MV SWARD , halka MT EUREKA lagu afduubtay biyaha Yemen 2-dii May, kadibna loo kaxeeyay dhinaca xeebaha Soomaaliya. Hawlgalka EUNAVFOR ATALANTA wuxuu sheegay in saddexdan markab ay ku jireen gacanta kooxaha burcad-badeedda, iyadoo markab kasta iyo shaqaalihiisa ay ahaayeen xaalad gaar ah. Bishii Luulyo waxaa sidoo kale la qafaashay markabka shidaalka MT ASANA , oo watay calanka Tanzania, xilli uu ka soo baxay Yemen. Sida ay sheegeen ilo ay AP soo xigatay, markabka waxaa loo soo dhaqaajiyay dhinaca gobolka Bari ee Puntland. Tirada weerarrada oo kor u kacday Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan arrimaha badaha, International Maritime Organization (IMO) , waxay 6-dii Luulyo sheegtay in saddexdii bilood ee ka horreeyay ay diiwaangelisay 24 dhacdo oo isugu jiray isku-dayo iyo weerarro dhab ah oo burcad-badeednimo iyo dhac hubeysan ah oo ka dhacay Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. IMO waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in 44 badmaaxayaal ah lagu hayay saddex markab oo ay burcaddu afduubteen. Tiradan waa in aan lagu khaldin xogta International Maritime Bureau (IMB), oo ah qayb ka tirsan International Chamber of Commerce. Labada hay’adood waxay adeegsadaan habab iyo qeexitaanno kala duwan oo ku saabsan dhacdooyinka badda. Xog kale oo ay daabacday dowladda Maraykanka ayaa muujisay in intii u dhexeysay Maarso iyo Luulyo 2026 la soo sheegay afar afduub iyo 17 dhacdo oo ah fuulitaan ama dhac hubeysan oo ka dhacay Gacanka Cadmeed, Badda Carabta iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Si kastaba, khatarta maanta weli kama dhowaan heerkii ugu xumaa ee burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya. Daraasad lagu daabacay 2026 ayaa muujisay in 2011, oo ahaa sanadkii ugu sarreeyay, IMB ay diiwaangelisay 237 dhacdo oo ka dhacay xeebaha Soomaaliya. Maxaa sababay soo laabashada burcad-badeedda? Khataraha cusub ma laha hal sabab oo keliya. Hawlgalka ATALANTA ayaa sheegay in xaaladaha cimilada badda, duruufaha dhaqaale ee bulshada xeebaha iyo xasillooni-darrada gobolka ay dhammaantood qayb ka qaadan karaan kororka dhacdooyinka. Dhinaca kale, dagaallada iyo xiisadaha ka jira Bariga Dhexe ayaa beddelay waddooyinka maraakiibta. Maraakiib badan ayaa ka taxaddaraya marinka Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab, taas oo kordhin karta tirada maraakiibta ku dhow xeebaha Soomaaliya, halkaas oo kooxaha burcaddu horey u yaqaannaan goobaha weerarrada. Waxaa sidoo kale jira dhiirrigelin dhaqaale. Lacagaha madax-furashada ayaa weli ah sabab muhiim ah oo kooxaha burcaddu u bartilmaameedsadaan maraakiibta. Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime waxay sheegtay in madax-furasho lagu qiyaasay $1.2 milyan ilaa $1.5 milyan laga bixiyay sii-deynta markab kalluumeysi oo Shiinaha laga leeyahay, kaas oo la afduubtay Janaayo 2026 laguna sii daayay Maarso. Xiriirka Xuutiyiinta iyo Al-Shabaab Mid ka mid ah arrimaha ugu xasaasisan ee hadda baarayaal iyo hay’adaha amniga ay ka walaacsan yihiin waa xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta Yemen iyo Al-Shabaab. Warbixin Qaramada Midoobay ah ayaa sheegtay in Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiintu ay yeesheen xiriir lagu tilmaamay mid ganacsi-ku-saleysan ama fursad-doon ah , oo aan ku dhisnayn isku aragti diimeed. Warbixintu waxay sheegtay in kulanadii dhex maray labada dhinac lagu soo qaaday hub casri ah, tababar iyo in la kordhiyo weerarrada burcad-badeedda ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo xeebaha Soomaaliya. American Security Project ayaa sidoo kale ka digtay in xiriirkaas uu abuuri karo xaalad ay burcad-badeeddu ka faa’iideystaan tiknoolajiyadda iyo khibradaha kooxaha hubeysan. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in warbixinno ay heleen ay tilmaamayaan isticmaalka qalab GPS iyo farsamooyin casri ah, balse tani ma caddaynayso in weerar kasta oo burcad-badeed ah uu si toos ah u maamulayo ama u maalgelinayo Xuutiyiintu. Sidaas darteed, sheegashada ah in Xuutiyiintu si toos ah u taageerayaan dhammaan burcad-badeedda Soomaalida weli ma aha xaqiiqo guud oo si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyay. Waxa la xaqiijiyay waa in hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay ay soo sheegeen xiriir iyo iskaashi u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo Al-Shabaab, halka falanqeeyayaal amni ay ka digayaan in xiriirkaasi uu saameyn ku yeelan karo amniga badda. Saameynta ganacsiga caalamka Soo laabashada burcad-badeeddu waxay ku soo beegantay xilli maraakiibta ganacsiga ay durba wajahayaan khataro badan oo ka jira Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo marinno kale oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka. Shirkadaha maraakiibta ayaa wajahaya kharashyo dheeraad ah oo ka dhasha ilaalinta, caymiska dagaalka iyo beddelka waddooyinka safarka. Markab kasta oo loo leexiyo waddo dheer wuxuu kordhin karaa waqtiga iyo kharashka gaarsiinta badeecadaha. Khatartu sidoo kale waxay ku fiday xeebaha Soomaaliya. Xogta la ururiyay sanadkan waxay muujinaysaa in kooxaha burcaddu ay awood u leeyihiin inay ka shaqeeyaan meel ka baxsan xeebaha, iyagoo mararka qaar adeegsanaya doomaha la qabsaday sidii maraakiib hooyo oo ay uga duulaan weerarrada. Inkasta oo tirada weerarradu ay si weyn uga hooseyso heerarkii 2009–2011, haddana kororka 2026 wuxuu muujinayaa in shabakadaha burcad-badeeddu aysan si buuxda u baabi’in. Waxa hadda la isku dayayo ayaa ah in la ogaado in kororkani yahay kacdoon ku-meel-gaar ah ama bilowga soo noqoshada khatar ballaaran oo ka jirta xeebaha Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Xaaladda ugu dambeysay waxay muujinaysaa in khatartu weli taagan tahay, inkastoo markabkii LUTUF la sii daayay dhammaadkii Agoosto. items.fullContent: Burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya oo Dib u Soo Labanaysa, Khatar Cusubna ku Haysa Maraakiibta Gobolka Burcad-badeedda ka hawlgasha xeebaha Soomaaliya ayaa 2026 si weyn u kordhisay weerarrada iyo afduubyada maraakiibta, iyadoo dhacdooyinka cusub ay gaareen heerkii ugu sarreeyay muddo ka badan toban sano. Tan iyo dhammaadkii Abriil, ugu yaraan siddeed markab ayaa lagu afduubtay weerarro loo aaneynayo kooxaha burcad-badeedda Soomaalida. Mid ka mid ah dhacdooyinkii ugu dambeeyay wuxuu dhacay 17 Agoosto 2026 , markaas oo siddeed nin oo hubeysan ay qabsadeen markabka xamuulka ee MV LUTUF , oo ku safrayay calanka Cameroon, meel qiyaastii afar mayl-badeed u jirta xeebta Mareeyo ee Puntland. Digniinta UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) ayaa xaqiijisay in rag hubeysan ay markabka fuuleen oo ay gacanta ku dhigeen. Markabka ayaa la sheegay inuu siday qalab militari iyo isgaarsiineed oo ku socday xarun tababar militari oo Türkiye ku leedahay Muqdisho. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa 29 Agoosto sheegtay in ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye ay markabka dib ula wareegeen kadib hawlgal socday 10 maalmood. Wasaaradda Difaaca Soomaaliya waxay sheegtay in afar doon oo ay burcaddu adeegsanayeen la burburiyay, halka 14 burcad ah la dilay. Tirada dhimashadaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Dhacdadan ayaa timid xilli ay burcad-badeeddu horey u afduubteen maraakiib kale oo waaweyn. Bishii Abriil waxaa la qabsaday MT HONOUR 25 iyo MV SWARD , halka MT EUREKA lagu afduubtay biyaha Yemen 2-dii May, kadibna loo kaxeeyay dhinaca xeebaha Soomaaliya. Hawlgalka EUNAVFOR ATALANTA wuxuu sheegay in saddexdan markab ay ku jireen gacanta kooxaha burcad-badeedda, iyadoo markab kasta iyo shaqaalihiisa ay ahaayeen xaalad gaar ah. Bishii Luulyo waxaa sidoo kale la qafaashay markabka shidaalka MT ASANA , oo watay calanka Tanzania, xilli uu ka soo baxay Yemen. Sida ay sheegeen ilo ay AP soo xigatay, markabka waxaa loo soo dhaqaajiyay dhinaca gobolka Bari ee Puntland. Tirada weerarrada oo kor u kacday Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan arrimaha badaha, International Maritime Organization (IMO) , waxay 6-dii Luulyo sheegtay in saddexdii bilood ee ka horreeyay ay diiwaangelisay 24 dhacdo oo isugu jiray isku-dayo iyo weerarro dhab ah oo burcad-badeednimo iyo dhac hubeysan ah oo ka dhacay Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. IMO waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in 44 badmaaxayaal ah lagu hayay saddex markab oo ay burcaddu afduubteen. Tiradan waa in aan lagu khaldin xogta International Maritime Bureau (IMB), oo ah qayb ka tirsan International Chamber of Commerce. Labada hay’adood waxay adeegsadaan habab iyo qeexitaanno kala duwan oo ku saabsan dhacdooyinka badda. Xog kale oo ay daabacday dowladda Maraykanka ayaa muujisay in intii u dhexeysay Maarso iyo Luulyo 2026 la soo sheegay afar afduub iyo 17 dhacdo oo ah fuulitaan ama dhac hubeysan oo ka dhacay Gacanka Cadmeed, Badda Carabta iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Si kastaba, khatarta maanta weli kama dhowaan heerkii ugu xumaa ee burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya. Daraasad lagu daabacay 2026 ayaa muujisay in 2011, oo ahaa sanadkii ugu sarreeyay, IMB ay diiwaangelisay 237 dhacdo oo ka dhacay xeebaha Soomaaliya. Maxaa sababay soo laabashada burcad-badeedda? Khataraha cusub ma laha hal sabab oo keliya. Hawlgalka ATALANTA ayaa sheegay in xaaladaha cimilada badda, duruufaha dhaqaale ee bulshada xeebaha iyo xasillooni-darrada gobolka ay dhammaantood qayb ka qaadan karaan kororka dhacdooyinka. Dhinaca kale, dagaallada iyo xiisadaha ka jira Bariga Dhexe ayaa beddelay waddooyinka maraakiibta. Maraakiib badan ayaa ka taxaddaraya marinka Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab, taas oo kordhin karta tirada maraakiibta ku dhow xeebaha Soomaaliya, halkaas oo kooxaha burcaddu horey u yaqaannaan goobaha weerarrada. Waxaa sidoo kale jira dhiirrigelin dhaqaale. Lacagaha madax-furashada ayaa weli ah sabab muhiim ah oo kooxaha burcaddu u bartilmaameedsadaan maraakiibta. Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime waxay sheegtay in madax-furasho lagu qiyaasay $1.2 milyan ilaa $1.5 milyan laga bixiyay sii-deynta markab kalluumeysi oo Shiinaha laga leeyahay, kaas oo la afduubtay Janaayo 2026 laguna sii daayay Maarso. Xiriirka Xuutiyiinta iyo Al-Shabaab Mid ka mid ah arrimaha ugu xasaasisan ee hadda baarayaal iyo hay’adaha amniga ay ka walaacsan yihiin waa xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta Yemen iyo Al-Shabaab. Warbixin Qaramada Midoobay ah ayaa sheegtay in Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiintu ay yeesheen xiriir lagu tilmaamay mid ganacsi-ku-saleysan ama fursad-doon ah , oo aan ku dhisnayn isku aragti diimeed. Warbixintu waxay sheegtay in kulanadii dhex maray labada dhinac lagu soo qaaday hub casri ah, tababar iyo in la kordhiyo weerarrada burcad-badeedda ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo xeebaha Soomaaliya. American Security Project ayaa sidoo kale ka digtay in xiriirkaas uu abuuri karo xaalad ay burcad-badeeddu ka faa’iideystaan tiknoolajiyadda iyo khibradaha kooxaha hubeysan. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in warbixinno ay heleen ay tilmaamayaan isticmaalka qalab GPS iyo farsamooyin casri ah, balse tani ma caddaynayso in weerar kasta oo burcad-badeed ah uu si toos ah u maamulayo ama u maalgelinayo Xuutiyiintu. Sidaas darteed, sheegashada ah in Xuutiyiintu si toos ah u taageerayaan dhammaan burcad-badeedda Soomaalida weli ma aha xaqiiqo guud oo si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyay. Waxa la xaqiijiyay waa in hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay ay soo sheegeen xiriir iyo iskaashi u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo Al-Shabaab, halka falanqeeyayaal amni ay ka digayaan in xiriirkaasi uu saameyn ku yeelan karo amniga badda. Saameynta ganacsiga caalamka Soo laabashada burcad-badeeddu waxay ku soo beegantay xilli maraakiibta ganacsiga ay durba wajahayaan khataro badan oo ka jira Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo marinno kale oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka. Shirkadaha maraakiibta ayaa wajahaya kharashyo dheeraad ah oo ka dhasha ilaalinta, caymiska dagaalka iyo beddelka waddooyinka safarka. Markab kasta oo loo leexiyo waddo dheer wuxuu kordhin karaa waqtiga iyo kharashka gaarsiinta badeecadaha. Khatartu sidoo kale waxay ku fiday xeebaha Soomaaliya. Xogta la ururiyay sanadkan waxay muujinaysaa in kooxaha burcaddu ay awood u leeyihiin inay ka shaqeeyaan meel ka baxsan xeebaha, iyagoo mararka qaar adeegsanaya doomaha la qabsaday sidii maraakiib hooyo oo ay uga duulaan weerarrada. Inkasta oo tirada weerarradu ay si weyn uga hooseyso heerarkii 2009–2011, haddana kororka 2026 wuxuu muujinayaa in shabakadaha burcad-badeeddu aysan si buuxda u baabi’in. Waxa hadda la isku dayayo ayaa ah in la ogaado in kororkani yahay kacdoon ku-meel-gaar ah ama bilowga soo noqoshada khatar ballaaran oo ka jirta xeebaha Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Xaaladda ugu dambeysay waxay muujinaysaa in khatartu weli taagan tahay, inkastoo markabkii LUTUF la sii daayay dhammaadkii Agoosto. Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo ciidamada Türkiye waxay muujiyeen in ay diyaar u yihiin hawlgallo wadajir ah, halka hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo shirkadaha maraakiibta ay weli ku talinayaan feejignaan sare marka lagu safrayo biyaha Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. items.title: Xuuthiyiinta Yemen oo weeraro sababay khasaaro ku qaaday Sacuudiga
items.description: Sanca (Raxanreeb Online) Xaaladda colaadda Yemen ayaa sii xumaanaysa kaddib markii la sheegay in Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay weerarro isugu jira gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku qaadeen bartilmaameedyo muhiim ah oo ku yaalla Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in qaar ka mid ah weerarrada lagu beegsaday kaabayaal saliid iyo xarumo militari, iyadoo la soo wariyey inay sababeen khasaare isugu jira naf iyo maal. Weerarradan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dagaallada u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo dowladda Yemen oo ay taageerayaan xulafada Sacuudiga ay xoogaysteen, iyadoo dhinacyada dowladda iyo xulafadooda ay wadaan howlgallo ay ku doonayaan inay cadaadis ku saaraan Xuutiyiinta iyo inay dib ula wareegaan deegaano ay gacanta ku hayaan. Wararka qaar ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaya in dagaalladu ay sababeen barakac iyo dhimasho badan, inkastoo tirooyinka lagu sheegay warbixinnada kala duwan ay u baahan yihiin in lala barbar dhigo xogta rasmiga ah ee hay’adaha caafimaadka iyo kuwa bani’aadantinimada. Isbeddelka dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale muuqda, iyadoo wararka laga helayo goobaha dagaalka ay sheegayaan in Xuutiyiintu ay lumiyeen qaar ka mid ah deegaanadii ay horey u haysteen, halka dowladda Yemen iyo xoogagga taageersan ay sheeganayaan horumar dhuleed oo ballaaran. The post Xuuthiyiinta Yemen oo weeraro sababay khasaaro ku qaaday Sacuudiga appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo Kormeeray Dhaawacyada Ciidanka Lagu Dawaynayo Isbitaalka
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa kormeer ku tagay Isbitaalka Rajab Tayib Erdoğan ee magaalada Muqdisho, oo hore loogu yaqaanay Isbitaalka Digfeer, halkaas oo lagu daweynayo qaar ka mid ah askarta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ee ku dhaawacmay howlaha amniga. Taliyaha ayaa intii uu ku guda jiray booqashada u kuurgalay xaaladda caafimaad ee askarta dhaawacantay iyo adeegyada daryeel ee ay ka helayaan isbitaalka. Waxa uu sidoo kale dhageystay baahiyahooda caafimaad, isagoo muujiyay garab istaag iyo walaaltinimo uu u muujinayo ciidamada ku dhaawacmay gudashada waajibaadkooda. S/Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa dhaawacyada Ciidanka u rajeeyay caafimaad degdeg ah, isagoo Alle uga baryay inuu siiyo bogsiin iyo caafimaad taam ah. Intii uu kormeerka ku jiray, Taliyaha ayaa sidoo kale booqday carruur lagu daweynayo isbitaalka, isagoo wax ka weydiiyay xaaladdooda caafimaad iyo daryeelka ay helayaan, waxa uuna carruurta iyo qoysaskooda u muujiyay dhiirrigelin iyo garab istaag. Dhanka kale, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa warbixin ka dhageystay maamulka Isbitaalka Rajab Tayib Erdoğan, oo uu hoggaaminayo Agaasimaha Guud. Warbixinta ayaa diiradda lagu saaray adeegyada caafimaad ee isbitaalku bixiyo iyo daryeelka loo fidiyo bukaannada iyo dhaawacyada ciidamada. Booqashada Taliyaha ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ee lagu xoojinayo daryeelka ciidamada dhaawacmay iyo garab istaagga bulshada Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan dadka u baahan adeegyada caafimaad.

items.title: Sawirro: Muungaab oo boosas iyo guryo ku abaal-mariyay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab), ayaa xalay Aqalka Dowladda Hoose ee Xamar ku qaabilay Abwaan Mustafe Sheekh Cilmi oo dalka dib ugu soo laabtay, iyadoo casho-sharaf loogu sameeyey xarunta maamulka Gobolka. Munaasabadda oo ahayd mid ballaaran waxaa goob-joog ka ahaa: guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka koowaad ee Golaha Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cali Shacbaan Ibraahim; Wasiirka Batroolka iyo Macdanta ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Daahir Shire Maxamed; Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska, Mudane Cabdifataax Qaasim; Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Amniga iyo Siyaasadda Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, Mudane Maxamed Axmed Diiriye (Yabooh); Xildhibaanno, odayaal-dhaqameedyo, fanaaniin, abwaanno iyo marti-sharaf kale. Duqa magaalada Muqdisho oo ka hadlay ayaa munaasabadda ka sheegay muhiimadda ay u leedahay in la aqoonsado lana dhiirrigeliyo hal-abuurayaasha Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan kuwa suugaantooda uga qayb qaata dhismaha bulshada, kobcinta wacyiga muwaadinnimo iyo gudbinta fariimaha xambaarsan nabadda, wadajirka iyo horumarka dalka, oo uu ugu horreeyo Abwaan Mustafe Sheekh Cilmi. Intaas kadib, Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ayaa Abwaankabku wareejiyey dukumentiga dhul laba boos ah, isagoo ka wakiil ah Madaxda Qaranka, wuxuna ka siiyey Degmada Xamarjajab, isagoo ballanqaaday in uu u dhisi doono guri munaasib ku a Abwaan Mustafe Sheekh Cilmi. items.title: As Justin Davis Leaves Mogadishu, Washington Is Asking a Different Question About Somalia
items.description: As Justin Davis concludes his tenure as Chargé d’Affaires at the United States Embassy in Mogadishu, he leaves at a time when the relationship between Somalia and the U.S.is changing, perhaps more significantly than official statements suggest. Over recent months, I have spoken with several American diplomats in Mogadishu, Nairobi, New York, Washington and elsewhere about where the U.S. now stands on Somalia. Some are serving officials, while others know the Somalia file closely. They did not agree on everything and some were more candid than others, but the conversations repeatedly came back to the same question: how much responsibility are Somalis themselves prepared to take for the future of their country? Davis has run the US Embassy through a particularly difficult period. Politics in Washington changed sharply as “America First” came to define the administration’s approach abroad. In Somalia, political divisions deepened, relations between the Federal Government and some Federal Member States deteriorated and Al-Shabaab and Daesh continued to pose serious security threats. At the same time, competition among foreign powers for influence in Somalia and the wider Horn of Africa intensified. One American diplomat described Davis’s challenge to me as finding a way to reconcile “America First” with “Somalia First”. When I asked what “Somalia First” meant, the answer was strikingly straightforward: Somalia for Somalis, strong Somali institutions and political leaders taking responsibility for their own country. Several diplomats worried that foreign interests had become too entangled with Somalia’s domestic political competition and that Somali politicians were themselves sometimes opening the door to that interference. “Somalia’s future is not for sale,” one diplomat told me. It was not an argument for Somalia to turn away from international partners. The country needs them and none of the Americans I spoke with disputed that. Their concern was that Somalia cannot insist on its sovereignty while allowing domestic political disputes to become entangled with competing foreign agendas. In their view, Somali politicians have to find ways of settling their differences without constantly looking towards foreign capitals. Another diplomat was equally direct. “Somalia is not a child. Somalia is a partner,” he said. America was prepared to cooperate with Somalia and support it, but the relationship had to be one between partners, with Somalia taking responsibility for its own choices and future. Under the current US policy, American interests in Somalia have become narrower and more clearly defined. Three priorities came up repeatedly in my conversations: counterterrorism, law enforcement cooperation and immigration coordination. These are increasingly the hard interests around which Washington is organising its relationship with Mogadishu. But the American assessment of Somalia was far from entirely negative. Diplomats acknowledged good progress in law enforcement cooperation and immigration coordination and spoke positively about the working relationship with Somali authorities in these areas. They also recognised that Mogadishu is considerably more peaceful than it was before, something several of them regarded as an important achievement that should not be overlooked. Their frustration was much greater when the conversation moved beyond Mogadishu. American diplomats were unhappy with the pace of counter-offensive operations against Al-Shabaab outside the capital. They had expected greater movement and more sustained gains on the ground. Their concern was not simply about launching military operations but whether those operations were producing lasting results and maintaining sufficient pressure on Al-Shabaab. Politics inevitably entered that discussion. Several diplomats believed the prolonged confrontation between the federal government, federal member states and opposition politicians was taking attention away from the security campaign. To them, political cohesion and the fight against Al-Shabaab are not separate issues. A country whose political leaders are consumed by disputes among themselves will inevitably find it more difficult to sustain a coherent national security effort. The reduction in American humanitarian and development assistance also reflects the wider change in Washington. One diplomat pushed back when I described this as a retreat from humanitarian engagement. He preferred to call it a “reorganisation of assistance”, with more emphasis on priorities, accountability and results. Others were more candid in acknowledging that America’s broader interest in Somalia had declined and that Washington was reconsidering how much money and political attention it was prepared to commit. Some also admitted that Washington itself had spent several years struggling to decide exactly what its overriding national security interests in Somalia were. Over time, American engagement had expanded into counterterrorism, security assistance, humanitarian relief, state-building, democratisation and political mediation. The current approach is much less expansive. The message now is simpler: America will help Somalia, but Somalia must also help itself. That view becomes particularly clear when American diplomats talk about Somali politics. They see fragmentation on almost every side. Within the federal government, the executive, parliament and other state institutions appear increasingly aligned. Yet relations between Mogadishu and important Federal Member States remain badly fractured, particularly with Puntland and Jubaland. The Americans are not putting all the blame on Villa Somalia. They are also critical of the opposition. Several diplomats, in separate conversations, used exactly the same word to describe it: “fragmented”. They questioned how much opposition leaders trust one another and whether their alliances are built around a common political programme or simply the convenience of opposing the current leadership. One diplomat posed a difficult question: if opposition to one administration is what brings everyone together, what happens when that administration is no longer there? What struck me during these conversations was that the Americans were rarely questioning the competence of Somalis themselves. They spoke about capable politicians, professionals, entrepreneurs, civil society leaders and a remarkably resilient population. Their frustration was that all this talent had still not produced enough political cohesion around a minimum national interest. One senior diplomat used the U.S. itself as an example. He spoke about “American exceptionalism”, not to suggest that American politicians agree with one another, but almost to make the opposite point. American politics can be bitterly divided, he said, yet there remains a sense of national identity and certain interests around which Americans can still rally. His question was: what is the Somali equivalent? Curiously, the Americans saw a glimpse of an answer in the controversy involving Somalia’s renowned referee Omar Artan. A senior diplomat told me that when Artan was returned from the U.S. and was not allowed into the country, calls to the US Embassy in Mogadishu were incessant. According to the diplomat, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud was among those seeking an explanation. But what fascinated American officials even more was the public reaction that followed. Diplomats in Washington, Mogadishu, Nairobi and elsewhere were closely watching the scenes of large numbers of young Somalis gathering at Mogadishu Stadium. They saw Somalis who would normally find themselves on different sides of political divides rallying around the same issue. It prompted a question among some of those watching: if Somalis could rally together so powerfully around Omar Artan, why could that same sense of national solidarity not be mobilised around Somalia? For some of the diplomats, the episode demonstrated that the national feeling exists. The problem is turning it into a political culture that can survive elections, clan calculations, disputes between governments and the influence of foreign powers. There is an obvious contradiction in some of this American thinking and the diplomats themselves are not unaware of it. For years, the U.S. was one of the most influential external actors in Somali politics. When a serious political crisis erupted, Somali leaders and international partners looked towards Washington. The Americans convened, persuaded, applied pressure and helped push political rivals towards compromise. That America is less visible today. Some Somali politicians and international partners regard this as a weakness in the current American approach. They believe Washington has withdrawn too far from political engagement and that its reduced role has left a vacuum at precisely the wrong time. Their argument is that America still carries political weight that few other countries can match and that Somalia sometimes needs that weight when its leaders cannot reach compromise. American diplomats increasingly turn the argument around: why should the U.S. always be responsible for bringing Somali politicians together? The question comes at a particularly sensitive moment because while America is becoming more selective, other powers are becoming more active. China’s presence has become increasingly visible. Beijing has expanded its engagement through repeated diplomatic contacts, visits and programmes involving several sectors. China also speaks consistently and forcefully about Somalia’s sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity. Its growing engagement is difficult to ignore at a time when Washington is narrowing the range of issues on which it wants to lead. Türkiye is an even more established presence. Its relationship with Somalia stretches across military training, security, trade, infrastructure, energy and diplomacy. Ankara has invested in Somalia for the long term and has built relationships that go much deeper than conventional development assistance. Its political and economic importance continues to grow. The United Arab Emirates (UAE) presents a different and more difficult picture. Its relationship with the Federal Government has become strained while it maintains much closer ties with Puntland and Jubaland as well as substantial interests and longstanding relationships in Somaliland and with certain Mogadishu-based politicians. There is also a strong perception among many Somali political actors that Abu Dhabi favours Somaliland’s agenda. Somalia therefore finds itself in an increasingly crowded geopolitical arena. Foreign powers have interests in the country and those interests do not always coincide. There is nothing unusual about foreign countries pursuing their own interests. The real question is whether Somalia has a strong enough sense of its own national interest to manage those relationships rather than allowing competing foreign interests to become entangled in its internal political struggles. That may be the wider story of the period in which Justin Davis ran the US Embassy. His tenure may not be remembered for one dramatic agreement or diplomatic breakthrough. Instead, he has managed the relationship during a period when Washington itself was deciding what America still wants from Somalia and what it expects Somalis to do for themselves. America has not abandoned Somalia. It remains an important security partner and counterterrorism cooperation continues. Diplomats point to progress in law enforcement and immigration cooperation and acknowledge the greater peace and security Mogadishu enjoys today. But they are also frustrated by the slow pace of counter-offensive operations outside the capital and deeply concerned that Somalia’s political divisions are making the security challenge harder. As Davis leaves Mogadishu, one thing should also be said about his own record. He took charge of the US mission at a difficult time and managed to keep America engaged and its relationship with Somalia on course despite political tensions in both countries and a changing agenda in Washington. He kept the door open to different Somali political actors and continued to press for Somalis to find common ground. In that sense, Davis leaves having done something important: keeping a difficult relationship together while reminding Somalia’s leaders that, in the end, the country belongs to them and its future has to be decided by them. After all the conversations I have had with American diplomats, their message can perhaps be reduced to this: America is prepared to work with Somalia, but Somalis have to decide what they want Somalia to be. There is also a challenge for Washington in that position. If America reduces its political role faster than Somali institutions can fill the space, that space will not simply remain empty. Foreign powers have their own strategic and economic interests and they will continue to pursue them. As Justin Davis leaves Mogadishu, the bigger question is therefore not simply what America will do next. It is whether Somalia’s leaders can find a minimum national understanding that survives changes of government, disputes between Mogadishu and the Federal Member States, opposition politics and competing relationships with foreign powers. The Americans I spoke with seemed convinced that Somalis are capable of doing that. They are simply becoming less convinced that America should do it for them. The post As Justin Davis Leaves Mogadishu, Washington Is Asking a Different Question About Somalia first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Soomaaliya oo mar kale xaqiijisay Taageerada ay u hayso Falastiin
items.description: Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale xaqiijisay taageeradeeda joogtada ah ee qadiyadda Falastiin, iyadoo ka qeyb gashay shir heer wasiirro ah oo Golaha Jaamacadda Carabta ku yeeshay magaalada Qaahira ee dalka Masar. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cabdi Cali , ayaa dalka ku matalay kalfadhigii 166-aad ee caadiga ahaa ee Golaha Jaamacadda Carabta, kaas oo looga hadlay arrinta Falastiin iyo sidoo kale xaaladaha nabadda, amniga iyo iskaashiga gobolka. Soomaaliya waxay sidoo kale ka qeyb gashay kulankii 11-aad ee Guddiga Wasiirrada Carabta ee qaabilsan tallaabooyinka Israa’iil ka waddo Qudus ee dhulka Falastiin la haysto. Kulankaas ayay Soomaaliya ku celisay taageeradeeda shacabka Falastiin iyo dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee wadajirka ah ee dalalka Carabta. Guddiga Qudus ayaa ku baaqay in la xoojiyo cadaadiska siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu doonayo in lagu joojiyo waxa ay ku tilmaameen tallaabooyin iyo xadgudubyo ka dhan ah goobaha barakeysan ee Islaamka iyo Kiristaanka ee Qudus. Sidoo kale, waxay dalalka Carabta ugu baaqeen inay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu go’aamiyay in la xoojiyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Jaamacadda Carabta iyo Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka, iyadoo la filayo in kulan wasiirro Carab iyo Islaam ah looga hadlo Qudus uu ka dhaco New York inta lagu guda jiro toddobaadka heerka sare ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay dhammaadka bishan. Guddigu wuxuu sidoo kale soo dhoweeyay hindise ka yimid Qatar oo lagu dhisayo hannaan ay ku jirto madal warbaahineed oo lagu diiwaangeliyo laguna soo bandhigo eedeymaha la xiriira xadgudubyada Israa’iil ee Qudus. Dhanka kale, guddiga ayaa cambaareeyay qorshaha lagu dhisayo 1,234 guri oo degaan ah oo qayb ka ah qorshaha E1 ee bariga Qudus, iyagoo ka digay in mashruucaasi uu sii wiiqi karo isku xirnaanta dhuleed ee dhulalka Falastiin iyo suuragalnimada in la dhiso dowlad Falastiini ah mustaqbalka. items.title: Somalia president’s policies have failed the country, says academic
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – A prominent Somali professor has issued a sharp public rebuke of Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, warning that his administration’s policies have failed the country and accusing him of presiding over a political collapse that is pushing Somalis back toward tribal and regional allegiances. Afyare Elmi delivered the warning in an open letter posted to X on Monday, framing it as a direct appeal to the president to change course before, in his words, the country falls apart. “Almost a Full House” in 2022 Elmi opened his letter by recalling the breadth of political support present at Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s inauguration in the Halane area of Mogadishu. “On May 16, 2022, you assumed power with an almost full house. Only Somaliland, which has been seeking international recognition, and the extremist groups, which have been fighting the government, were not in the Halane tent. The rest were present at your inauguration,” Elmi wrote. That coalition, he said, has since collapsed. A Coalition in Retreat “Fast forward to today: the institutions are out of mandate, and you have lost many of the people and groups that were in the Halane tent in 2022,” Elmi wrote, adding that most of the politicians who backed the president’s 2022 victory — including figures from the national opposition, Puntland and Jubaland — are no longer part of the government. He pointed to specific flashpoints across the federal map: Southwest State is experiencing violent conflict, which Elmi attributed to “a poorly conceived and executed transition.” The principle of “do no harm,” which he described as foundational, has “been violated in a big way.” Galmudug and Hirshabelle are, in his words, “ticking time bombs that could explode in any direction.” “Mr. President, your policies have failed the country, and as a result, Somalis are now aligning with regional geopolitics along tribal and regional lines,” Elmi wrote. Elmi’s Prescription: Talks, Not Rhetoric Elmi argued that the way out of the crisis is for the president to recognize the danger the country faces and adopt what he called a pragmatic approach to resolving outstanding disputes “before it is too late.” He said the minimum the Somali public should expect is a credible and competitive political process open to all the actors who were present in 2022. “The time for empty rhetoric and gerrymandering or power-grabbing is over,” he wrote. “It is time to reach a political agreement with the opposition and reconcile with your opponents, both at the state and national levels. You must also return to the dispensation processes that Somalis have known and relied upon in the past.” He closed with a stark warning: “Otherwise, Somalia risks disintegration under your leadership, and such a legacy would be an unbearable burden to bear.” The letter lands as Somalia is contending in real time with escalating political disputes between the federal government in Mogadishu, several regional state administrations, and clan constituencies across the country. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Dhaqaalaha Baydhabo oo qarka u saaran inuu burburo
items.description: Culeyska amni ee ka jira Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa u sabab ah in uu si weyn hoos ugu dhaco dhaqaalaha iyo ganacsiga magaaladaasi, oo aad arki karto in uu galay marxalad ciriiri iyo sugnaansho la’aan ah. Iska horimaadyada hubeysan iyo loolanka dhanka awoodda maamulka ee u dhexeeya maamulka cusub ee taabacsan Dowladda Federaalka iyo hoggaankii hore ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa xaddiday gaadiidkii rarka xamuulka ee imanayay magaalada. Wararka ayaa sheegaya inuu hoos u dhac weyn ku yimid dhaqdhaqaaqa waddooyinka saadka ee Baydhabo, Muqdisho iyo gobolada kale, isla-markaana ay ugu wacan tahay khilaafka siyaaadeed ee isu bedelay gacan ka hadalka. Goobo ganacsi ayaa ku gubtay dagaalkii 17-kii bishii August ka dhacay bartamaha magaalada, iyadoo hoobiyeyaashii la isweydaarsaday dagaalkii 3-dii bishan ka dhacay afaafka hore ee magaaalda ay baabi’iyeen hanti badan iyo dukaamo. Dhacdooyinkii u dambeeyay ee ka dhacay magaalada iyo qulqulka saadka iyo sahayda ee yaraaday ayaa ganacsatada qaar ku khasbay inay xiraan meheradahooda. Magaalada ayaa waxaa laga dareemayaa sicir barar iyo inay wax kasta sii qaaliyoobayaan, iyadoo ayna meesha ka sii baxeyso saxmaddii iyo wax kala iibsigii xooliga lahaa ee Suuqa Weyn ee Baydhabo. “Badeecadihii ama shay kasta oo magaalada yaala qiimihii caadiga ee lagu iibin jiray wuu kordhay, waxayna magaalada gaartay heer adag oo go’doon miiran ah.” Ayuu yiri mid ka mid ah ganacsatada Baydhabo oo aan la hadalnay. Cali Aadan Isaaq oo ka mid ah dhallinyarada deegaanka ayaa inoo sheegay in sidii hore aaddan suuqa uga heli karin, wixii aad u baahneyd, taasoo ku tusineysa, sida loolanka ba’an ee awood muujinta ee dhinacyada iska soo horjeeda uu u burburinayo dhaqaalaha Baydhabo. Qoysaska faraha badan ee cabsida awgeed uga barakacaya magaalada ayaa qayb ka ah inuu hoos u dhaco iibka iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa lacageed ee suuqyada magaaladaasi. Dhanka kale garabka mucaaradka ee Ex Madaxweyne Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa la sheegay inay mar sii horreysay gawaarida dhagxaanta dhismaha ka joojiyeen inay taggaan magaalada. Masuuliyiinta Dowladda Hoose ee Baydhabo ayaa kuu sheegaya in dhismayaashii ka socday magaalada ay ku dhow yihiin inay joogsadaan, sababtuna waa in xoogaga taageersan Laftagareen ee ku sugan darafyada magaalada aysan ogoleyn in la keeno dhagxaanta lagu dhiso guryaha. Khubarada dhanka dhaqaalaha ayaa laga soo xigtay in dhaqaalaha Baydhabo uu burbur qarka u saaran yahay, tanina waxay ku sheegeen cawaaqibka ka dhashay duruufaha amni ee ku xeeran magaalada. Dhaqaalaha Baydhabo ayaa la sheegaya in uu burburi karo, haddii ay xaaladdu sidaan ku sii socoto ama aan la helin heshiis siyaasadeed oo degdeg ah amaba aan la furin waddooyinka xiran. Baydhabo waxay muddo dheer ahayd magaalo ganacsi, waxaana loo tixgeliyaa xarunta iyo isha ugu weyn ee dhaqaalaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo Sacuudiga ku Eedeysay Duqeyn Xabsi oo Lagu Dilay Toddobo Qof oo Yemeni ah
items.description: Kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee ka talisa qaybo ka mid ah Yemen ayaa ku eedeysay Sacuudiga inuu duqeyn cirka ah ka geystay xabsi ku yaalla magaalada Al-Hazm ee gobolka Al-Jawf, halkaas oo ay sheegeen in lagu dilay ugu yaraan toddobo qof , oo uu ku jiro ilmo, halka ugu yaraan toddobo kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta Xuutiyiinta, duqeyntu waxay ku dhacday xarunta dhexe ee xabsiga lagu hayo maxaabiista ee Al-Hazm, oo ku taalla waqooyiga Yemen, meel u dhow xadka Sacuudiga. Telefishinka Al Masirah ayaa baahiyay muuqaallo uu sheegay inay muujinayaan burburka dhismaha iyo dad isku dayaya inay meydadka iyo dadka dhaawaca ah ka soo saaraan burburka. Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee maamulka Xuutiyiinta, Anees al-Asbahi, ayaa sheegay in weerarka lagu dilay toddobo qof, halka toddobo kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen, oo ay ku jirto haweeney. Ilaa hadda, Sacuudiga kama uusan hadlin eedeymahan , mana jirto xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo caddeyneysa cidda ka dambeysay duqeynta. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiintu waxay sheegteen inay weerarro kale ka fuliyeen gobolka Hadramout, halkaas oo ay ku andacoonayaan inay gantaallo ballistic ah ku weerareen gaadiid sahay ah oo ay ku jireen qalab milatari, kuwaas oo ay sheegeen inay taageerayeen ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudigu taageero. Afhayeenka militariga Xuutiyiinta, Yahya Saree, ayaa Sacuudiga ku eedeeyay inuu Yemen ka wado “gardarro” wuxuuna sheegay in weerarradaasi aysan jawaab la’aan noqon doonin. Xaaladda Yemen ayaa hadda mar kale wajahaysa koror colaadeed , iyadoo dhinacyadu ay isku dayayaan inay gacanta ku dhigaan dhulal istiraatiiji ah iyo marinnada muhiimka ah ee dalka, halka bulshada rayidka ah ay weli wajahaan khatarta dagaalka, barakaca iyo burburka ka dhasha colaadda daba-dheeraatay.

items.title: Dadka Ajaanibka ah oo bilaabay in ay isaga baxaan Kiiniya
items.description: Boqolaal muwaadiniin ah oo u dhashay dalka Burundi oo ku sugan Kenya ayaa ku howlan sidii ay u heli lahaayeen dukumentiyada safarka si ay dalka uga baxaan, ka hor inta aan la bilaabin howlgallo ka dhan ah ganacsatada yaryar ee aan haysan sharciyada. Madaxweynaha Kenya, William Ruto, ayaa Isniintii u qabtay dadka ajaanibta ah ee leh ganacsiyada yaryar inay joojiyaan shaqada, kaddib markii Wasaaradda Ganacsigu sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah ay si khaldan uga faa’iideysteen xeerarka fiisaha si ay uga shaqeeyaan Kenya iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsadaha loo baahan yahay. Safaf dhaadheer ayaa lagu arkay bannaanka safaaradda Burundi ee caasimadda Nairobi, kaddib markii safaaraddu sheegtay inay muwaadiniinta doonaya inay dalkooda ku laabtaan siin doonto dukumentiyo safar oo degdeg ah oo bilaash ah. Qaar kale ayaa ku howlan inay iibsadaan tigidhada basaska. Kenya waxaa ku nool boqolaal kun oo muhaajiriin ah oo ka kala yimid dalalka Bariga Afrika, kuwaas oo u yimid inay raadsadaan shaqo iyo fursado ganacsi. Wasaaradda Ganacsiga Kenya ayaa sheegtay inay jireen “si ula kac ah oo khaldan loo adeegsaday codsiyada fiisaha”, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah dadka soo booqday dalka ay ku yimaadeen iyagoo sheegtay inay yihiin maalgashadayaal ama dalxiisayaal, balse markii dambe ku lug yeeshay dhaqdhaqaaqyo ganacsi oo ka hor imanaya ujeeddadii ay ku sheegeen fiisahooda. Sida laga soo xigtay hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan qaxootiga, Kenya waxaa ku sugan ku dhawaad 16,000 qof oo Burundi ah oo ah qaxooti iyo magangalyo-doon. Lama oga tirada dadkaas ku lug leh ganacsiyada yaryar ama inta ka mid ah ee uu saameyn doono ololaha dowladda. Burundianka ayaa la arkayay iyagoo sita dhammaan alaabtooda sida shandado iyo furaashyo, iyagoo isku dayaya inay dalka ka baxaan ka hor inta uusan bilaaban howlgalku. Hase yeeshee, qaar ka mid ah waxay sheegeen inaysan awoodin kharashka safarka, waxayna dowladda Kenya ka codsadeen inay kordhiso muddada kama dambaysta ah ee loo qabtay. Dowladda Kenya ayaa sheegtay in aan la soo saarin wax amar ah oo ajaanibta dalka ku sugan loogu sheegayo inay Kenya ka baxaan, kaddib dood ka dhalatay hadallo uu Madaxweyne William Ruto ka sheegay ka qaybgalka ajaanibta ee ganacsiyada yaryar.

items.title: Banaanbax lagu taageerayo Turkiga oo ka dhacaya Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Dhallinyaro katirsan maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa Muqdisho ku qabtay kulankii ugu horeeyay ee qaban qaabada banaanbaxyo ay dowladu qorsheysay in lagu taageero Turkiga kaasi oo ka dhacaya Muqdisho. Banaanbaxa ayaa daba socda caadis maalmihi lasoo dhaafay dowladda la kulmeysay kaasi oo la xariira duqeyntii diyaaradeed ee ka dhacday degmada Doolow ee gobolka Gedo. Sidoo kale banaanbaxa ayaa la filaya in Muqdisho lagu qabto maalmahan oo ay maanta ugu horeyso Banaanbax ay horkacayaan xubno katirsan Golaha Wasiirada iyo Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir. Geesta kale ilo xogaal ah ayaa inoo sheegay in gudoomiye Muungaab lagu amray in uu diyaariyo Banaanbaxyo lagu taageerayo Turkiga loogana soo horjeedo banaanbaxyadii lagu diidanaa ee maalmahan ka socday Jubbland. items.title: Somalia and Yemen Face a Dangerous New Security Threat as Al-Shabaab–Houthi Links Emerge
items.description: Mogadishu  (WDN) — A potentially destabilizing security development is emerging across the Gulf of Aden and Red Sea following reports from Yemen’s internationally recognized government that Somali fighters are fighting alongside the Iran-backed Houthi movement. Yemeni authorities have reportedly announced that Somali nationals were among fighters killed in recent clashes with Houthi forces, with some of the bodies reportedly believed to belong to individuals affiliated with Al-Shabaab, the militant group fighting the Somali government. If independently confirmed, the presence of Al-Shabaab-linked fighters alongside the Houthis would mark a troubling development, raising the possibility that two conflicts on opposite sides of the Gulf of Aden are beginning to develop operational connections. A Potentially Dangerous Connection The reported discovery of Somali fighters among Houthi forces comes amid growing reports of contacts between the two organizations. The reports follow coverage by The National indicating emerging links between the Houthis in Yemen and Al-Shabaab in Somalia. International media have also previously reported allegations that the Houthis may have provided weapons, training or other assistance to Al-Shabaab. However, conclusive independent evidence establishing the full extent of such cooperation has yet to emerge. The reports should therefore be investigated seriously without being presented as proof of a formal military alliance. The immediate priority is to establish who the reported Somali fighters were, whether they had links to Al-Shabaab, how they reached Yemen and whether weapons, training or other resources have moved between the two groups. Two Fragile States, One Strategic Vulnerability Somalia and Yemen occupy strategically vital positions on opposite sides of the Gulf of Aden, but both face serious institutional and security challenges. Somalia continues to fight Al-Shabaab while struggling with political divisions and limited national security capacity. Yemen remains deeply fragmented, with the internationally recognized government confronting the Houthis, who control substantial territory and possess significant military capabilities. That combination of weak state control, active insurgencies and a strategically connected maritime environment creates opportunities for armed groups to move personnel, weapons, money and expertise across borders. The danger is that separate domestic conflicts could gradually evolve into a connected regional security network. Why the Red Sea Matters? The implications extend far beyond Somalia and Yemen. The Gulf of Aden is the maritime bridge between the Indian Ocean and the Red Sea, while the Red Sea itself is one of the world’s most important commercial shipping corridors. The Houthis have already demonstrated their ability to threaten maritime traffic, while Al-Shabaab remains a persistent insurgent force in Somalia. If meaningful cooperation develops between the two organizations, it could potentially facilitate the movement of weapons, fighters, financing, training or operational expertise across the Gulf of Aden. That would create a new layer of risk for commercial shipping, coastal communities and international maritime-security operations, while making it more difficult for Somalia and Yemen to contain conflicts already stretching their limited state capacities. A Warning for Mogadishu and Sana’a For Somalia, the reported presence of Al-Shabaab-linked fighters in Yemen could provide the group with access to networks and military experience outside its traditional operating environment. It could also increase the risk of weapons and personnel moving through Somalia’s already difficult-to-secure coastline. For Yemen, the presence of Somali militants would suggest that its conflict is attracting fighters from beyond its borders and could expose additional weaknesses in border and maritime controls. Both governments therefore have a direct interest in determining whether the reported connection is isolated or part of a broader pattern. That requires stronger intelligence-sharing, maritime surveillance and cooperation among Somalia, Yemen and the countries surrounding the Gulf of Aden and Red Sea.The central question is whether these reported contacts remain limited or become institutionalized. Al-Shabaab’s principal battlefield remains Somalia, while the Houthi conflict remains centered in Yemen. But geography makes interaction possible. The Gulf of Aden is not an impenetrable barrier; it is a heavily trafficked maritime corridor connecting two countries whose security weaknesses can be exploited by armed groups. If those groups succeed in turning that corridor into a channel for cooperation, the consequences could extend across the Horn of Africa, the Arabian Peninsula and the wider Red Sea. Somalia and Yemen therefore face the same strategic imperative: prevent militant networks from exploiting fragile state institutions to transform separate conflicts into a wider regional security crisis. The reported deaths of Somali fighters in Yemen should be a trigger for investigation, not speculation. Authorities need to establish the facts, identify any organizational links and determine whether weapons, financing or training are moving between militant networks. If a substantive Al-Shabaab–Houthi relationship is confirmed, the international community will need to reassess the security architecture of the Gulf of Aden and Red Sea. For now, the warning is clear: when fragile states lose control of their security environment, conflicts do not necessarily remain within national borders. They can connect, spread and threaten the wider region. WardheerNews The post Somalia and Yemen Face a Dangerous New Security Threat as Al-Shabaab–Houthi Links Emerge appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Duqeyn lagu beegsaday shir ay Al-Shabaab ku lahaayeen duleedka Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno kala duwan ayaa kasoo baxaya duqeyn ay xalay diyaarado dagaal ka gaysteen duleedka magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay, xilli halkaas ay ka taagan tahay xiisad culus oo la xiriirta amniga magaaladaasi. Weerarkan dhanka cirka ah oo bartilmaameed ahaa ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inuu ka dhacay goob uu shir uga socday maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab ee ku sugan bannaanka magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta KMG ah ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Ilo wareedyo xilkas ah ayaa innoo sheegay in goobta la duqeeyay ay ku sugnaayeen horjoogayaal muhiim ah iyo maleeshiyaad kale, isla markaana uu jiro khasaare dhimasho iyo dhaawac lagu gaarsiiyay halkaasi. Wararka ayaa intaas kusii daraya in duqeynta lagu bur-buriyay hub iyo gaadiid dagaal oo ay lahaayeen maleeshiyaadka Khawaarijta, waxaana sidoo kale laga hor tegay qorshe ay ku abaabulayeen weerar ay kusoo qaadaan magaalada. Ilaa iyo hadda lama shaacin tirada rasmiga ah ee lagu dilay weerarka ama lagu dhaawacay, waxaase la filayaa in dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxibada caalamiga ah ay faah-faahin ka bixiyaan howlgallaasi. Xaaladda ayaa haatan ah mid kacsan, waxaana dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan laga dareemayaa duleedka Baydhaba oo ay horay uga taagneyd xiisad dagaal oo uu dhexeysa ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya mudane Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen). Arrimahan ayaa uga sii daraya xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo midda amni ee ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed, oo hadda wajaheysa daruufo adag oo ka dhashay isbeddelkii ka dhacay Baydhaba ee uu kusoo baxay madaxweyne Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe). items.title: Puntland Government Plans to Introduce Free Primary and Intermediate Education
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Puntland is preparing to remove one of the biggest barriers keeping children from school, with the government announcing plans to make primary and intermediate education free across the region, potentially bringing immediate financial relief to thousands of families once the policy takes effect. Puntland Interior Minister Abdi Hersi Ali (Qarjab) said the government is moving quickly to implement the policy, which would eliminate school fees for children at the primary and intermediate levels. “The government is currently working to make primary and intermediate schools free of charge throughout Puntland, and we hope to implement this soon,” Minister Qarjab said during an event in Garowe. The policy is expected to have its greatest immediate impact on orphans and low-income families, many of whom struggle to keep their children in school because they cannot afford tuition and other education costs. For a poor household, removing school fees can mean the difference between a child attending school and staying at home. If implemented as announced, the policy could therefore put basic education within reach of children who have been excluded simply because their families cannot afford it. A Policy with Immediate Consequences Unlike a long-term education strategy, the proposed measure could deliver a direct and tangible benefit to families from the moment it takes effect: less money spent on school fees and more children able to remain in classrooms. Minister Qarjab said the cost of the program would be shared between the Puntland government and the people of Puntland. However, authorities have yet to disclose the full budget, implementation mechanism or exact date when free education will begin. Those details will be critical to determining how quickly families can benefit and whether schools can maintain the quality of education after fees are removed. More Than Free Schooling The significance of the policy extends beyond the immediate savings for families.Removing financial barriers at the basic education level could increase school enrollment, reduce dropout rates and give children from disadvantaged households a greater opportunity to continue their education. For Puntland, it could also become a major investment in human capital at a time when education is increasingly viewed as essential to the region’s economic and social development. The challenge now is implementation, particularly at a time when Puntland is facing severe economic difficulties and government employees have reportedly gone nearly a year without receiving their salaries. Ultimately, the promise is powerful, but its real impact will be measured by whether it can be turned into reality, how quickly it reaches classrooms, and whether every eligible child can benefit—regardless of where they live or how much their parents earn. If delivered effectively, the policy could mark a significant shift in Puntland’s education system: making a child’s access to basic schooling a public responsibility rather than a financial burden carried by individual families. items.title: Qatar oo markii u horeysay su’aal ka keentay joogitaanka Mareykanka ee Khaliijka
items.description: Doha (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Qatar ayaa sheegtay in dalalka Khaliijka aysan mar dambe amnigooda si buuxda ugu tiirsanaan karin ciidamada shisheeye iyo xulafadooda Mareykanka, iyadoo ku baaqday in waddamada gobolka ay dhistaan awood ay iyagu isku difaaci karaan. Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Qatar, Majed al-Ansari, ayaa sheegay in iskaashiga Mareykanka iyo joogitaanka ciidamada caalamiga ah ee gobolka ay weli muhiim yihiin, balse aysan kaligood ku filneyn xaqiijinta amniga dalalka Khaliijka. “Waa inaan Khaliijka ka garwaaqsannaa in joogitaanka ciidamada caalamiga ah iyo xulafada istaraatiijiga ah ee Mareykanka ay aad muhiim u yihiin, laakiin aysan nagu filneyn,” ayuu al-Ansari ka sheegay Madasha Hili Forum ee Abu Dhabi. “Isku-filnaanshaha dhinaca amniga ayaa ah waddada keliya ee loo baahan yahay. Haa, waxaan u baahan nahay saaxiibadeenna iyo xulafadeenna, laakiin amnigeenna kuma tiirsanaan karno iyaga oo keliya,” ayuu raaciyay. Hadalkan ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Qatar, oo martigelisa saldhigga Al Udeid, oo ah saldhigga militari ee Mareykanka ugu weyn dunida Carabta, isla markaana xarun goboleed u ah Taliska Dhexe ee ciidamada Mareykanka. Qatar ayaa sidoo kale kamid noqotay dalalka Khaliijka ee saameynta tooska ah ka dareemay isku dhaca Mareykanka iyo Iran, iyadoo Tehran ay weerarro aargoosi ah ku qaaday bartilmaameedyo Mareykan ah oo ku yaalla gobolka. Hadalka al-Ansari ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay dood ka taagan tahay mustaqbalka joogitaanka militari ee Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe iyo heerka ay dowladaha Khaliijka ugu tiirsanaan karaan Washington marka ay wajahaan khataro amni. Avril Haines, oo xilligii madaxweyne Joe Biden ahayd agaasimaha sirdoonka qaranka Mareykanka, ayaa dhankeeda toddobaadkan ka digtay in hoos u dhac weyn oo ku yimaada joogitaanka Mareykanka ee gobolka uu keeni karo dhibaatooyin cusub. Kumannaan askari iyo shaqaale safaaradeed oo Mareykan ah ayaa horaantii sanadkan laga daadgureeyay qeybo kamid ah Khaliijka markii Iran ay kordhisay weerarrada ka dhanka ah saldhigyada Mareykanka iyo kaabeyaasha tamarta. Xiriirka Qatar iyo Iran Al-Ansari ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dib-u-dhiska kalsoonida Iran ay qaadan karto waqti, balse dalalka Khaliijka aysan ka baxsan karin xaqiiqada ah in Iran ay tahay dal deris la ah gobolka. Wuxuu sheegay in Dooxa ay dooneyso xiriir derisnimo oo nabdoon, balse masuuliyadda ugu weyn ay saaran tahay Tehran si ay uga fogaato cadaadis militari iyo tallaabooyin cabsi gelin kara dalalka deriska ah. “Hadafkeennu waa inaan gacanta fidinno marka waqtigu ku habboon yahay, isla markaana aan sii heysanno awoodda ka hortagga, oo aan si cad u muujinno inaan awoodno inaan is-difaacno,” ayuu yiri. Qatar ayaa muddo dheer xiriir wada-hadal la lahayd Iran, iyadoo isla waqtigaas kamid ah xulafada ugu dhow Mareykanka ee gobolka. Doha waxay sidoo kale door dhexdhexaadin ah ka qaadatay dadaallada lagu yareynayo xiisadda u dhaxeysa Washington iyo Tehran. Al-Ansari ayaa sheegay in gobolka iyo dhaqaalaha caalamka aysan awoodin in dagaalka hadda socda uu muddo dheer sii jiitamo. “Dunidu ma awoodi karto in khilaafkan uu sii socdo. Dunidu ma awoodi karto in marin-biyoodka Hormuz uu sii xirnaado. Gobolkeenna ma awoodi karo in gantaallo ay labada dhinac isaga gudbaan Khaliijka,” ayuu yiri. Hadalkiisa ayaa imanaya maalmo kadib markii Xoghayaha Maaliyadda Mareykanka Scott Bessent uu sheegay in muhiimadda marin-biyoodka Hormuz ay si weyn hoos ugu dhici karto labada sano ee soo socota, haddii dalalka Khaliijka ay dhameystiraan dhuumo shidaal oo u oggolaanaya inay ka gudbaan marin-biyoodkaas. Al-Ansari ayaa taas ka horyimid, isagoo sheegay in Hormuz uu qarniyo badan ahaa marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka, isla markaana aan hal dagaal ama hal isbeddel oo dhinaca kaabeyaasha ah meesha ka saari karin muhiimaddiisa. Wuxuu sidoo kale shaki geliyay siyaasadda Washington ee lagu kordhinayo cunaqabateynta dhaqaale ee Iran si Tehran loogu cadaadiyo inay miiska wada-hadalka kusoo laabato. Al-Ansari ayaa tusaale u soo qaatay cunaqabateyntii hore loogu soo rogay dalal ay kamid yihiin Iraq iyo Libya, isagoo sheegay in cadaadiska dhaqaale uusan mar walba keenin natiijada siyaasadeed ee laga doonayo. “Annaga, natiijada tooska ah ee la doonayo waxay ka imaan doontaa miiska wada-hadalka,” ayuu yiri. Qatar ayaa ku adkeysaneysa in dalalka Khaliijka ay qeyb toos ah ka noqdaan heshiis kasta oo mustaqbalka lagu doonayo in lagu dejiyo xiisadda gobolka, iyadoo al-Ansari uu sheegay in mustaqbalka amniga gobolka aysan go’aamin karin quwadaha dibadda oo keliya. items.title: Mucaaradka oo shirkadaha diyaaradaha ka joojiyay ciidamada ay u daabulaan Baydhabo
items.description: Garabka mucaaradka ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa xalay soo saaray amar ay shirkadaha diyaaradaha kaga mamnuucanayaan ama ku hakinayaan duulimaadyada ciidamada la gaynayo Magaalada Baydhabo. Maamulkii hore ee Laftagareen oo weli ku adkeysanaya in uu yahay midka sharciga ah ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa shirkadaha diyaaradaha ku wargeliyay in la hakiyay dhammaan duulimaadyada, sida gaarka ah u qaada ciidamada iyo wixii agab ciidan la xiriira. “Wasaaradda Gaadiidka & Duulista Hawada ee Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya, waxay ku wargelineysaa dhammaan shirkadaha diyaaradaha, howlwadeennada duulimaadyada iyo dhinacyada ay khuseyso in la hakiyay dhammaan duulimaadyada, sida gaarka ah u qaada ciidamada iyo agabka ciidan ee la xiriira.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeed ay soo saareen. “Amarkani waxa uu dhaqangelayaa 07 September, 2026, wuxuuna sii jiri doonnaa illaa amar dambe. Hakintan waxay khuseysaa dhammaan garoomada diyaaradaha iyo gegiyada duulimaadyada ee ku yaala deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya. Tallaabadan waxaa loo qaaday si loo xaqiijiyo badbaadada iyo amniga dadka rayidka ah, loona ilaaliyo habsami-u-socodka howlaha duulista, iyadoo la tixgelinayo xaaladda amni ee hadda jirta.” Ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Warsaxaafadeedka ayaa lagu sheegay “Duulimaadyada laga reebay hakinta, waxaa ka mid ah duulimaadyada ay fuliyaan Duulista Rayidka, Qaramada Midoobey (UN) iyo AUSSOM, kuwaas oo loo ogolaaday howlo bani’aadantinimo, caafimaad iyo hawlgalo rasmi ah oo la ansixiyay.” Qof kasta iyo hay’ad kasta oo ku xadgudubta amarkan ayaa warsaxaafadeedka lagu sheegay inay wajihi doonto tallaabooyin sharciyeed iyo maamul. Nuxurka amarkan ayaa ah in la joojiyo dhaqdhaqaaqa ciidan ee Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud ee Magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka uu si weyn ugu adeegsado ciidamada laga daabulo Caasimadda Muqdisho ee la geeyo Baydhabo. Xoogaga u daacadda ah Laftagareen ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay si gaar ah u bartilmaameedsanayay Baydhabo, si ka duwan magaalooyinka iyo deegaanada kale ee Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo Baydhabo ay tahay Xarunta KMG Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed iyo goobta uu maamulku ku shaqeeyo, oo ay ku yaallaan Xarumaha Madaxtooyada iyo Baarlamaanka.
